name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.rightCosetMulAction_mk_smul
statement:
@[simp 900] theorem rightCosetMulAction_mk_smul
    (H : Subgroup G) (g a : G) :
    letI
proof:
:= rightCosetMulAction H
    g • (Quotient.mk'' a : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) =
      Quotient.mk'' (a * g⁻¹) :=
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.rightCosetMulAction_inv_mk_smul
statement:
@[simp 900] theorem rightCosetMulAction_inv_mk_smul
    (H : Subgroup G) (g a : G) :
    letI
proof:
:= rightCosetMulAction H
    g⁻¹ • (Quotient.mk'' a : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) =
      Quotient.mk'' (a * g) := by
  rw [rightCosetMulAction_mk_smul (H := H) g⁻¹ a]
  simp only [inv_inv]

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.continuous_rightCosetMulAction_inv_smul_of_open
statement:
theorem continuous_rightCosetMulAction_inv_smul_of_open
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : IsOpen (H : Set G))
    [TopologicalSpace (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))]
    [DiscreteTopology (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))]
    (q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) :
    letI
proof:
:= rightCosetMulAction H
    Continuous fun g : G => g⁻¹ • q := by
  rw [continuous_discrete_rng]
  intro q'
  classical
  let a : G := q.out
  let b : G := q'.out
  have hpre :
      (fun g : G => g⁻¹ • q) ⁻¹' (Set.singleton q') =
        (fun g : G => b * g⁻¹ * a⁻¹) ⁻¹' (H : Set G) := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · intro hg
      have hEq :
          (Quotient.mk'' (a * g) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) =
            Quotient.mk'' b := by
        calc
          (Quotient.mk'' (a * g) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))
              = g⁻¹ • (Quotient.mk'' a : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) := by
                  rw [rightCosetMulAction_inv_mk_smul (H := H) g a]
          _ = g⁻¹ • q := by rw [Quotient.out_eq' q]
          _ = q' := by
            change g⁻¹ • q = q' at hg
            exact hg
          _ = Quotient.mk'' b := by simp only [Quotient.out_eq, b]
      have hrel : QuotientGroup.rightRel H (a * g) b := Quotient.eq''.mp hEq
      simpa [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc] using (QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply.mp hrel)
    · intro hg
      have hrel : QuotientGroup.rightRel H (a * g) b := by
        rw [QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply]
        simpa [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc] using hg
      calc
        g⁻¹ • q = g⁻¹ • (Quotient.mk'' a : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) := by
          rw [Quotient.out_eq' q]
        _ = Quotient.mk'' (a * g) := by
          rw [rightCosetMulAction_inv_mk_smul (H := H) g a]
        _ = Quotient.mk'' b := Quotient.eq''.mpr hrel
        _ = q' := Quotient.out_eq' q'
  change
    (fun g : G => g⁻¹ • q) ⁻¹'
      ({q'} : Set (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))) =
        (fun g : G => b * g⁻¹ * a⁻¹) ⁻¹' (H : Set G) at hpre
  rw [hpre]
  exact hH.preimage ((continuous_const.mul continuous_inv).mul continuous_const)

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.continuous_eval_of_discreteIndex
statement:
theorem continuous_eval_of_discreteIndex :
    Continuous (fun p : (S → A) × S => p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro p
  have hs :
      Prod.snd ⁻¹' ({p.2} : Set S) ∈ nhds p := by
    refine IsOpen.mem_nhds ((isOpen_discrete ({p.2} : Set S)).preimage continuous_snd) ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  have hEq :
      (fun q : (S → A) × S => q.1 q.2) =ᶠ[nhds p] fun q => q.1 p.2 := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_iff_exists_mem.mpr ?_
    refine ⟨Prod.snd ⁻¹' ({p.2} : Set S), hs, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hq
    simp only [hq]
  exact ContinuousAt.congr
    (((continuous_apply p.2).comp continuous_fst).continuousAt) hEq.symm

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.continuous_functionPrecomp
statement:
theorem continuous_functionPrecomp :
    Continuous (fun p : G × (S → A) => functionPrecomp p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_pi ?_
  intro s
  change Continuous (fun p : G × (S → A) => p.2 (p.1⁻¹ • s))
  have h :=
    (continuous_eval_of_discreteIndex (A := A) (S := S)).comp
      (continuous_snd.prodMk
        (((continuous_inv.comp continuous_fst).smul continuous_const) :
          Continuous (fun p : G × (S → A) => p.1⁻¹ • s)))
  change Continuous (fun p : G × (S → A) => p.2 (p.1⁻¹ • s)) at h
  exact h

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.permutationalWreathProductInlToKernel_bijective
statement:
theorem permutationalWreathProductInlToKernel_bijective :
    Function.Bijective
      ((permutationalWreathProductInlToKernelContinuousHom (A := A) (S := S) (G := G)) :
        (S → A) → permutationalWreathProductRightKernel (A := A) (S := S) (G := G))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro f g hfg
    funext s
    have hs := congrArg
      (fun x : permutationalWreathProductRightKernel (A := A) (S := S) (G := G) =>
        ((x : PermutationalWreathProduct A S G).left s)) hfg
    change f s = g s at hs
    exact hs
  · intro x
    refine ⟨x.1.left, ?_⟩
    have hmem :
        (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : PermutationalWreathProduct A S G →* G)
          x.1 = 1 := by
      exact x.2
    have hright : x.1.right = 1 := by
      simpa using hmem
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply SemidirectProduct.ext
    · rfl
    · change (SemidirectProduct.inl x.1.left : PermutationalWreathProduct A S G).right =
          x.1.right
      simp only [SemidirectProduct.right_inl, hright]

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.hasOpenNormalBasisInClass_permutationalWreathProduct
statement:
theorem hasOpenNormalBasisInClass_permutationalWreathProduct
    [CompactSpace A] [T2Space A] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace A]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (hForm : FiniteGroupClass.Formation C)
    (hIso : FiniteGroupClass.IsomClosed C)
    (hExt : FiniteGroupClass.ExtensionClosed C)
    [DiscreteTopology S]
    (hA : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass C A)
    (hG : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass C G) :
    HasOpenNormalBasisInClass C (PermutationalWreathProduct A S G)
proof:
:= by
  let hFunc : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass C (S → A) :=
    HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.pi (C := C) (α := S) (β := fun _ : S => A) hForm (fun _ => hA)
  have hKernel :
      HasOpenNormalBasisInClass C (permutationalWreathProductRightKernel (A := A) (S := S) (G :=
          G)) := by
    let e :=
      permutationalWreathProductInlKernelContinuousMulEquiv (A := A) (S := S) (G := G)
    exact HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.ofContinuousMulEquiv (C := C) hFunc e
  have hQuot :
      HasOpenNormalBasisInClass C
        ((PermutationalWreathProduct A S G) ⧸
          permutationalWreathProductRightKernel (A := A) (S := S) (G := G)) := by
    let α : PermutationalWreathProduct A S G →* G :=
      SemidirectProduct.rightHom
    have hα : Continuous α := continuous_permutationalWreathProduct_right
    have hαbar :
        Continuous (QuotientGroup.kerLift α :
          (PermutationalWreathProduct A S G) ⧸ α.ker →* G) := by
      refine (QuotientGroup.isQuotientMap_mk α.ker).continuous_iff.2 ?_
      change Continuous α
      exact hα
    let αbar : ((PermutationalWreathProduct A S G) ⧸ α.ker) →ₜ* G :=
      { toMonoidHom := QuotientGroup.kerLift α
        continuous_toFun := hαbar }
    have hαbar_bij : Function.Bijective αbar := by
      constructor
      · exact QuotientGroup.kerLift_injective α
      · intro g
        rcases (SemidirectProduct.rightHom_surjective
          (N := (S → A)) (G := G)
          (φ := mulAutArrow (G := G) (A := S) (M := A)) g) with ⟨x, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨QuotientGroup.mk' α.ker x, ?_⟩
        change α x = x.right
        rfl
    let e : ((PermutationalWreathProduct A S G) ⧸ α.ker) ≃ₜ* G :=
      ContinuousMulEquiv.ofBijectiveCompactToT2 αbar αbar.continuous_toFun hαbar_bij
    exact HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.ofContinuousMulEquiv (C := C) hG e.symm
  exact HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.extension (C := C) hIso hForm.quotientClosed hExt
    (permutationalWreathProductRightKernel (A := A) (S := S) (G := G))
    (ContinuousMonoidHom.isClosed_ker
      (permutationalWreathProductRightContinuousHom (A := A) (S := S) (G := G)))
    hKernel hQuot

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.permutationalWreathProduct_inv_left_apply

    x⁻¹.left s = (x.left (x.right • s))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  change ((mulAutArrow (G := G) (A := S) (M := A) x.right⁻¹) (x.left⁻¹)) s =
      (x.left (x.right • s))⁻¹
  change x.left⁻¹ ((x.right⁻¹)⁻¹ • s) = (x.left (x.right • s))⁻¹
  simp only [inv_inv, Pi.inv_apply]

proof:
:= by

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.permutationalWreathProductMapLeft_surjective
statement:
theorem permutationalWreathProductMapLeft_surjective
    (α : A →* B) (hα : Function.Surjective α) :
    Function.Surjective (permutationalWreathProductMapLeft (S := S) (G := G) α)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  let f : S → A := fun s => Classical.choose (hα (x.left s))
  refine ⟨⟨f, x.right⟩, ?_⟩
  ext s
  · exact Classical.choose_spec (hα (x.left s))

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.injective_of_permutationalWreathProductMapLeft_injective
statement:
theorem injective_of_permutationalWreathProductMapLeft_injective
    (α : A →* B) (s : S)
    (hα : Function.Injective (permutationalWreathProductMapLeft (S := S) (G := G) α)) :
    Function.Injective α
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have hEq :
      permutationalWreathProductMapLeft (S := S) (G := G) α
          (SemidirectProduct.inl (fun _ : S => a) : PermutationalWreathProduct A S G) =
        permutationalWreathProductMapLeft (S := S) (G := G) α
          (SemidirectProduct.inl (fun _ : S => b) : PermutationalWreathProduct A S G) := by
    ext t
    · exact hab
    · rfl
  have hPre := hα hEq
  have := congrArg (fun z : PermutationalWreathProduct A S G => z.left s) hPre
  simpa using this

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.surjective_of_permutationalWreathProductMapLeft_surjective

  refine ⟨x.left s, ?_⟩

  simpa using this

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.continuous_rightQuotientSectionEmbedding
statement:
theorem continuous_rightQuotientSectionEmbedding
    [TopologicalSpace (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))]
    [DiscreteTopology (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))]
    (hH : IsOpen (H : Set G))
    (τ : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H) → G)
    (hτ : ∀ q, Quotient.mk'' (τ q) = q)
    (hτcont : Continuous τ) :
    Continuous
      (rightQuotientSectionEmbedding (H := H) τ hτ :
        G → PermutationalWreathProduct H (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) G)
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_induced_rng.2 ?_
  change Continuous fun g : G =>
    ((rightQuotientSectionEmbedding (H := H) τ hτ g).left,
      (rightQuotientSectionEmbedding (H := H) τ hτ g).right)
  have hleft :
      Continuous fun g : G =>
        (rightQuotientSectionEmbedding (H := H) τ hτ g).left := by
    refine continuous_pi ?_
    intro q
    refine Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ ?_
    have hqcont :
        Continuous fun g : G => (g⁻¹ • q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) :=
      continuous_rightCosetMulAction_inv_smul_of_open (G := G) H hH q
    have hcont :
        Continuous fun g : G => τ q * g * (τ (g⁻¹ • q))⁻¹ := by
      exact (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).mul ((hτcont.comp hqcont).inv)
    simpa [rightQuotientSectionEmbedding, rightQuotientSectionCocycle, mul_assoc] using hcont
  have hright :
      Continuous fun g : G =>
        (rightQuotientSectionEmbedding (H := H) τ hτ g).right := by
    change Continuous (id : G → G)
    exact continuous_id
  exact hleft.prodMk hright

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.wreathLeftCoordinate_eq_basepoint_of_rightQuotientSection
statement:
theorem wreathLeftCoordinate_eq_basepoint_of_rightQuotientSection
    (τ : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H) → G)
    (hτ : ∀ q, Quotient.mk'' (τ q) = q)
    (ψ : G →* PermutationalWreathProduct A (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) G)
    (hψ :
      (SemidirectProduct.rightHom :
          PermutationalWreathProduct A (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) G →* G).comp ψ =
        MonoidHom.id G)
    (hτpure :
      ∀ q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H),
        wreathLeftCoordinate ψ
            (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) (τ q) = 1)
    (g : G) (q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) :
    wreathLeftCoordinate ψ
        (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))
        (rightQuotientSectionCocycle (H := H) τ hτ g q) =
      wreathLeftCoordinate ψ q g
proof:
:= by
  let q' : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H) := g⁻¹ • q
  have hτq :
      (τ q)⁻¹ • (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) = q := by
    rw [rightCosetMulAction_inv_mk_smul (H := H) (τ q) 1]
    simpa using hτ q
  have hτq' :
      τ q' • q' = (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) := by
    calc
      τ q' • q' = τ q' • (Quotient.mk'' (τ q') : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) := by
        rw [hτ q']
      _ = Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) := by
        rw [rightCosetMulAction_mk_smul (H := H) (τ q') (τ q')]
        simp only [mul_inv_cancel]
  have hinv :
      wreathLeftCoordinate ψ q' (τ q')⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [wreathLeftCoordinate_inv (ψ := ψ) hψ q' (τ q')]
    simpa [hτq'] using hτpure q'
  have hq' :
      (Quotient.mk'' (τ q * g) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) = q' := by
    calc
      (Quotient.mk'' (τ q * g) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))
          = (τ q * g)⁻¹ • (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) := by
              simp only [mul_inv_rev, rightCosetMulAction_mk_smul, inv_inv, one_mul]
      _ = g⁻¹ • ((τ q)⁻¹ • (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))) := by
            simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_smul, rightCosetMulAction_mk_smul, inv_inv, one_mul]
      _ = g⁻¹ • q := by rw [hτq]
      _ = q' := rfl
  change
      wreathLeftCoordinate ψ
          (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))
          ((τ q * g) * (τ q')⁻¹) =
        wreathLeftCoordinate ψ q g
  rw [wreathLeftCoordinate_mul (ψ := ψ) hψ
      (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))
      (τ q * g) (τ q')⁻¹]
  rw [wreathLeftCoordinate_mul (ψ := ψ) hψ
      (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))
      (τ q) g]
  simp only [hτpure, hτq, one_mul, mul_inv_rev, rightCosetMulAction_mk_smul, inv_inv, hq', hinv,
      mul_one, q']

name: ProCGroups.WreathProducts.rightQuotientBasepointProjectionHom_apply_cocycle
statement:
theorem rightQuotientBasepointProjectionHom_apply_cocycle
    (τ : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H) → G)
    (hτ : ∀ q, Quotient.mk'' (τ q) = q)
    (ψ : G →* PermutationalWreathProduct A (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) G)

        wreathLeftCoordinate ψ
            (Quotient.mk'' (1 : G) : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H)) (τ q) = 1)

    rightQuotientBasepointProjectionHom (H := H) ψ hψ
        (rightQuotientSectionCocycle (H := H) τ hτ g q) =
      wreathLeftCoordinate ψ q g
proof:

statement:
@[simp 900] theorem rightQuotientSectionEmbedding_left_basepoint_of_mem
    (τ : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H) → G)
    (hτ : ∀ q, Quotient.mk'' (τ q) = q)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.absoluteGalois_finiteStepSolvable_centerfree
statement:
theorem absoluteGalois_finiteStepSolvable_centerfree
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (hG : IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m →
      Subgroup.center (MaxSolvQuot Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) m) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hOrient (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
      ∃ θ : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K), FormalHilbert90 θ := by
    by_cases hp : (p : K) = 0
    · have : CharP K p := (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : p.Prime)).mpr hp
      refine ⟨1, formalHilbert90_absolute_of_charP p K 1 ?_⟩
      intro σ
      rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, map_one]
    · have : NeZero (p : K) := ⟨hp⟩
      exact ⟨absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K,
        formalHilbert90_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K⟩
  exact (finiteStepSolvable_centerfree_and_slim_of_formalHilbert90
    (ProfiniteGrp.of Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) hG hOrient).1

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.absoluteGalois_finiteStepSolvable_slim_of_cyclotomic_and_cyclic_extensions
statement:
theorem absoluteGalois_finiteStepSolvable_slim_of_cyclotomic_and_cyclic_extensions
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (hG : IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
    (hCyclotomic : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ringChar K ≠ p →
      ¬ FiniteDimensional K (primaryCyclotomicExtension K p))
    (hCyclic : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ringChar K = p →
      ∃ L : IntermediateField K (SeparableClosure K),
        IsGalois K L ∧ Module.finrank K L = p) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) m)
proof:
:= by
  have hOrient (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
      ∃ θ : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K),
        FormalHilbert90 θ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range θ) := by
    by_cases hp : (p : K) = 0
    · have hpchar : ringChar K = p := CharP.ringChar_of_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : p.Prime) hp
      have : CharP K p := (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : p.Prime)).mpr hp
      obtain ⟨L, hL, hdegree⟩ := hCyclic p (Fact.out : p.Prime) hpchar
      have : IsGalois K L := hL
      exact exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_cyclic_extension p K L hdegree
    · have : NeZero (p : K) := ⟨hp⟩
      refine ⟨absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K,
        formalHilbert90_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K,
        infinite_range_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation_of_infinite_extension p K
          (hCyclotomic p (Fact.out : p.Prime) ?_)⟩
      intro heq
      have : CharP K p := heq ▸ (inferInstance : CharP K (ringChar K))
      exact hp (CharP.cast_eq_zero K p)
  exact (finiteStepSolvable_centerfree_and_slim_of_formalHilbert90
    (ProfiniteGrp.of Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) hG
    (fun p _ => ⟨(hOrient p).choose, (hOrient p).choose_spec.1⟩)).2 hOrient

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.mixed_characteristic_properties_3_6
statement:
theorem mixed_characteristic_properties_3_6
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP base.residueField p] :
    (∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L]
      [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L],
      ∀ τ : Gal(L/K),
        (∀ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
          relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z = z) → τ = 1) ∧
      IsSigmaAbFaithful {p} Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
proof:
:= by
  have hdetect : ∀ (F E : Type u) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
      [IsGalois F E] [CharZero F]
      (source : DVF.{u,v} F) [CharP source.residueField p]
      (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime], Module.finrank F E = r →
        ∃ τ : Gal(E/F), τ ≠ 1 ∧
          ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) p,
            relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F E p τ z ≠ z := by
    intro F E _ _ _ _ _ source _ r _ hdegree
    exact prime_order_detection_of_mixedChar source p r hdegree
  constructor
  · intro L _ _ _ _
    exact relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform_faithful_of_primeDegree_detection
      p hdetect base L
  · exact isSigmaAbFaithful_of_primeDegree_detection p hdetect base

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.prime_order_test_1_2
statement:
theorem prime_order_test_1_2
    {sigma : Set ℕ} (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u}) :
    let residualTest : Prop
proof:
:=
      ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G,
        letI : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
          H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
        ∀ N : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup G),
          Nat.Prime (Nat.card ((H : Subgroup G) ⧸
            (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)))) →
            residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
              (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma)
              (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) N.isClosed ≠ 1
    let powerTest : Prop :=
      ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G,
        ∀ N : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup G),
          Nat.Prime (Nat.card ((H : Subgroup G) ⧸
            (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)))) →
            ∃ ell : ℕ, ell ∈ sigma ∧ Nat.Prime ell ∧
              ∃ s : ℕ, 0 < s ∧
                ∃ g : ((H : Subgroup G) ⧸ (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G))),
                  g ≠ 1 ∧
                    ∃ a : TopologicalAbelianization
                        (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)),
                      ¬ ∃ b : TopologicalAbelianization
                          (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)),
                        quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
                            (N := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G))) g a =
                          a * b ^ (ell ^ s)
    let cohomologyTest : Prop :=
      ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G,
        ∀ N : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup G),
          Nat.Prime (Nat.card ((H : Subgroup G) ⧸
            (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)))) →
            ∃ ell : ℕ, ell ∈ sigma ∧ Nat.Prime ell ∧
              ∃ s : ℕ, 0 < s ∧
                ∃ (g : (H : Subgroup G))
                  (χ : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) →ₜ*
                    Multiplicative (ZMod (ell ^ s)))
                  (n : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G))),
                  χ (MulAut.conjNormal g n) ≠ χ n
    (IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G ↔ residualTest) ∧
      (residualTest ↔ powerTest) ∧ (powerTest ↔ cohomologyTest) := by
  refine ⟨isSigmaAbFaithful_iff_prime_order_test (sigma := sigma) (G := G), ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · intro hres H N hdegree
      have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
        H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
      by_contra hnone
      push Not at hnone
      apply hres H N hdegree
      apply (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_eq_one_iff_primePower
        (sigma := sigma) (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) N.isClosed).mpr
      intro g a ell hellsigma hell s hs
      by_cases hg : g = 1
      · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
        simp only [hg, map_one, MulAut.one_apply, one_pow, mul_one]
      · exact hnone ell hellsigma hell s hs g hg a
    · intro hpower H N hdegree
      have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
        H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
      obtain ⟨ell, hellsigma, hell, s, hs, g, _, a, ha⟩ := hpower H N hdegree
      intro htrivial
      exact ha ((residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_eq_one_iff_primePower
        (sigma := sigma) (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) N.isClosed).mp
          htrivial g a ell hellsigma hell s hs)
  · constructor
    · intro hpower H N hdegree
      have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
        H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
      have : CompactSpace (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) :=
        N.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
      have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (TopologicalAbelianization
          (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G))) :=
        ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal _
          (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator _)
      obtain ⟨ell, hellsigma, hell, s, hs, g, hg, a, ha⟩ := hpower H N hdegree
      have : Fact ell.Prime := ⟨hell⟩
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
        (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) g
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk _ a
      let b := TopologicalAbelianization.mk _ (MulAut.conjNormal g n)
      let a := TopologicalAbelianization.mk _ n
      have hdiff : ¬ ∃ z : TopologicalAbelianization (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)),
          z ^ (ell ^ s) = b * a⁻¹ := by
        rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
        apply ha
        refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
        change b = a * z ^ (ell ^ s)
        rw [hz, mul_comm b, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]
      obtain ⟨k, hk, χ, hχ⟩ := exists_primePower_character_of_not_pow ell s
        (b * a⁻¹) hdiff
      refine ⟨ell, hellsigma, hell, k, hk, g,
        χ.comp (TopologicalAbelianization.mkₜ _), n, ?_⟩
      intro heq
      apply hχ
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, show χ b = χ a from heq, mul_inv_cancel]
    · intro hcoh H N hdegree
      obtain ⟨ell, hellsigma, hell, s, hs, g, χ, n, hχ⟩ := hcoh H N hdegree
      let a := TopologicalAbelianization.mk _ n
      let gbar := QuotientGroup.mk' (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) g
      have hg : gbar ≠ 1 := by
        intro h
        apply hχ
        have hfixed := congrArg (fun e => e a)
          (show quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
            (N := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G))) gbar = 1 from by rw [h, map_one])
        exact congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.lift χ) hfixed
      refine ⟨ell, hellsigma, hell, s, hs, gbar, hg, a, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
      apply hχ
      have heq := congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.lift χ) hb
      have hpow : (TopologicalAbelianization.lift χ b) ^ (ell ^ s) = 1 := by
        apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
        change (ell ^ s) • (TopologicalAbelianization.lift χ b).toAdd = 0
        simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]
      simpa only [map_mul, map_pow, hpow, mul_one, gbar, a,
        quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk,
        TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk] using heq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.centralizer_criterion_6_3
statement:
theorem centralizer_criterion_6_3 {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (hG : IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G)
    (D : ClosedSubgroup G) [(D : Subgroup G).Normal]
    (H : OpenSubgroup G) (hDH : (D : Subgroup G) ≤ (H : Subgroup G)) :
    Subgroup.centralizer ((H : Subgroup G).map (QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D)) :
      Set (G ⧸ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D)) ≤
        (D : Subgroup G).map (QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D))
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) z
  have hxD : x ∈ (D : Subgroup G) := by
    by_contra hxD
    let V := ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.normalCore H
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW⟩ := exists_openNormalSubgroup_le_not_mem_sup_closedSubgroup D hxD V
    have hWH : (W : Subgroup G) ≤ (H : Subgroup G) :=
      hWV.trans (ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.normalCore_le H)
    let N := openNormalSubgroup_sup_normal (D : Subgroup G) W
    apply hxW
    exact sigmaQuotient_mem_openNormal_of_centralizes sigma hG D N le_sup_left x
      (Subgroup.centralizer_le (Subgroup.map_mono (sup_le hDH hWH)) hz)
  exact ⟨x, hxD, rfl⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.pow_action_sub_divisible
statement:
private theorem pow_action_sub_divisible
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[p] M]
    (T : M ≃ₗ[ℤ_[p]] M)
    (hT : ∀ x : M, ∃ y : M, T x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • y) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : M, ∃ y : M, (T ^ n) x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • y
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro x
      exact ⟨0, by change x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • (0 : M); rw [sub_self, smul_zero]⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ih x
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hT ((T ^ n) x)
      refine ⟨b + a, ?_⟩
      rw [smul_add, ← ha, ← hb, pow_succ']
      change T ((T ^ n) x) - x = (T ((T ^ n) x) - (T ^ n) x) + ((T ^ n) x - x)
      abel

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.divisible_subgroup_eq_bot
statement:
private theorem divisible_subgroup_eq_bot
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[p] M]
    (hsep : ∀ x : M, (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ y : M, (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n • y = x) → x = 0)
    (J : AddSubgroup M)
    (hJ : ∀ x : M, x ∈ J → ∃ y : M, y ∈ J ∧ (p : ℤ_[p]) • y = x) : J = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hiter : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : M, x ∈ J →
      ∃ y : M, y ∈ J ∧ (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n • y = x := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact fun x hx => ⟨x, hx, by rw [pow_zero, one_smul]⟩
    | succ n ih =>
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hpy⟩ := hJ x hx
        obtain ⟨z, hz, hpz⟩ := ih y hy
        exact ⟨z, hz, by rw [pow_succ', mul_smul, hpz, hpy]⟩
  apply (AddSubgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
  intro x hx
  exact hsep x (fun n _ => let ⟨y, _, hy⟩ := hiter n x hx; ⟨y, hy⟩)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.prime_order_mod_p_eq_one
statement:
private theorem prime_order_mod_p_eq_one
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[p] M] [Module.IsTorsionFree ℤ_[p] M]
    (hsep : ∀ x : M, (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ y : M, (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n • y = x) → x = 0)
    (T : M ≃ₗ[ℤ_[p]] M) (q : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime) (horder : orderOf T = q)
    (hdiv : ∀ x : M, ∃ y : M, T x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • y) : T = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hqp : q = p
  · rw [hqp] at horder
    have : IsAddTorsionFree M := IsAddTorsionFree.of_isTorsionFree ℤ_[p] M
    let forget : (M ≃ₗ[ℤ_[p]] M) →* AddMonoid.End M :=
      { toFun := fun e => e.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom
        map_one' := rfl
        map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
    let U : AddMonoid.End M := forget T
    have hU : U ^ p = 1 := by
      have hTp : T ^ p = 1 := by simpa only [horder] using pow_orderOf_eq_one T
      change (forget T) ^ p = 1
      rw [← map_pow, hTp, map_one]
    have haug := primeOrder_action_sub_divisible U p (Fact.out : p.Prime) hp2 hU
      (fun x => by
        change ∃ y : M, T x - x = p • y
        simpa only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul] using hdiv x)
    let J : AddSubgroup M := (U - 1).range
    have hJ : J = ⊥ := divisible_subgroup_eq_bot hsep J (by
      rintro x ⟨a, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := haug a
      refine ⟨U b - b, ⟨b, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change (p : ℤ_[p]) • (U b - b) = U a - a
      simpa only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul] using hb.symm)
    apply LinearEquiv.ext
    intro x
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (AddSubgroup.mem_bot.mp (hJ ▸
      (show T x - x ∈ J from ⟨x, rfl⟩)))
  · have hfinite : IsOfFinOrder T := orderOf_pos_iff.mp (horder ▸ hq.pos)
    let Γ := Subgroup.zpowers T
    let e : Fin (orderOf T) ≃ Γ := finEquivZPowers hfinite
    let : Fintype Γ := Fintype.ofEquiv (Fin (orderOf T)) e
    have hcard : Fintype.card Γ = q := by
      rw [Fintype.card_congr e.symm, Fintype.card_fin, horder]
    have hunit : IsUnit (Fintype.card Γ : ℤ_[p]) :=
      PadicInt.isUnit_iff.mpr (PadicInt.norm_natCast_eq_one_iff.mpr
        (hcard ▸ (Fact.out : p.Prime).coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr
          (fun h => hqp ((hq.dvd_iff_eq (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one).mp h))))
    let : Invertible (Fintype.card Γ : ℤ_[p]) := hunit.invertible
    let ρ : Representation ℤ_[p] Γ M :=
      { toFun := fun g => g.val.toLinearMap
        map_one' := rfl
        map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
    have hρ : ∀ (g : Γ) (x : M), ∃ y : M, ρ g x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • y := by
      intro g x
      have hg := pow_finEquivZPowers_symm_apply hfinite g
      change ∃ y : M, g.val x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • y
      rw [← hg]
      exact pow_action_sub_divisible T hdiv _ x
    let J : AddSubgroup M := (LinearMap.ker ρ.averageMap).toAddSubgroup
    have hJ : J = ⊥ := divisible_subgroup_eq_bot hsep J
      (fun x hx => averageMap_ker_divisible_of_action_sub_divisible ρ (p : ℤ_[p]) hρ x hx)
    have havg (x : M) : ρ.averageMap x = x := by
      have hx : x - ρ.averageMap x ∈ J := by
        change ρ.averageMap (x - ρ.averageMap x) = 0
        rw [map_sub, ρ.averageMap_id (ρ.averageMap x) (ρ.averageMap_invariant x), sub_self]
      exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (AddSubgroup.mem_bot.mp (hJ ▸ hx))).symm
    apply LinearEquiv.ext
    intro x
    rw [← havg x]
    exact ρ.averageMap_invariant x (⟨T, Subgroup.mem_zpowers T⟩ : Γ)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finite_order_mod_p_3_3
statement:
theorem finite_order_mod_p_3_3
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ_[p] M] [Module.IsTorsionFree ℤ_[p] M]
    (hsep : ∀ x : M, (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ y : M, (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n • y = x) → x = 0)
    (T : M ≃ₗ[ℤ_[p]] M) (hfinite : IsOfFinOrder T)
    (hdiv : ∀ x : M, ∃ y : M, T x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • y) : T = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hn : orderOf T ≠ 1 := fun h => hne (orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp h)
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqdvd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hn
  have horder : orderOf (T ^ (orderOf T / q)) = q :=
    orderOf_pow_orderOf_div (ne_of_gt hfinite.orderOf_pos) hqdvd
  have heq := prime_order_mod_p_eq_one hp2 hsep (T ^ (orderOf T / q)) q hq horder
    (pow_action_sub_divisible T hdiv _)
  rw [heq, orderOf_one] at horder
  exact hq.ne_one horder.symm

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.relative_centerfree_and_slim_criterion_6_4
statement:
theorem relative_centerfree_and_slim_criterion_6_4
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u}) (hG : IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G)
    (D : ClosedSubgroup G) [(D : Subgroup G).Normal]
    (hDderived : (D : Subgroup G) ≤ topDerivedTop G 1)
    (hOrient : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p ∈ sigma →
      Nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization p (D : Subgroup G)) →
        ∃ θ : Orientation p G, FormalHilbert90 θ) :
    Subgroup.center (G ⧸ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) = ⊥ ∧
      ((∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p ∈ sigma →
        Nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization p (D : Subgroup G)) →
          ∃ θ : Orientation p G, FormalHilbert90 θ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range θ)) →
            IsSlim (G ⧸ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D))
proof:
:= by
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D)
  constructor
  · apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
    intro z hz
    have hzD := centralizer_criterion_6_3 sigma hG D ⊤ le_top
      (Subgroup.center_le_centralizer _ hz)
    obtain ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩ := hzD
    refine sigmaQuotient_eq_one_of_primaryFixed_eq_bot sigma D (⊤ : Subgroup G) ?_ ⟨d, hd⟩ ?_
    · intro p _ hp hNontrivial
      obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := hOrient p hp hNontrivial
      exact (integral_invariants_6_2 G (D : Subgroup G) D.isClosed' hDderived θ hθ).1
    · exact Subgroup.center_le_centralizer _ hz
  · intro hInfinite U
    apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) z
    let V : OpenSubgroup G := OpenSubgroup.comap q QuotientGroup.continuous_mk U
    have hxV : q x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ((V : Subgroup G).map q :
        Set (G ⧸ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D)) := by
      rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact hz (q v) hv
    apply ProCGroups.quotient_eq_one_of_relative_fixedPoints q
      (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _) (D : Subgroup G) D.isClosed'
      (fun N hDN x hx => sigmaQuotient_mem_openNormal_of_centralizes sigma hG D N hDN x hx)
      _ V x hxV
    intro H d hd hfixed
    apply sigmaQuotient_eq_one_of_primaryFixed_eq_bot sigma D (H : Subgroup G) _ ⟨d, hd⟩ hfixed
    intro p _ hp hNontrivial
    obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hImage⟩ := hInfinite p hp hNontrivial
    exact (integral_invariants_6_2 G (D : Subgroup G) D.isClosed' hDderived θ hθ).2 hImage H

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.integral_invariants_6_2
statement:
theorem integral_invariants_6_2
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime] (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u})
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (hDderived : D ≤ topDerivedTop G 1)
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (hθ : FormalHilbert90 θ) :
    primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hDclosed (⊤ : Subgroup G) = ⊥ ∧
      (Set.Infinite (Set.range θ) → ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G,
        primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hDclosed (H : Subgroup G) = ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  have hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    intro d hd
    change θ d = 1
    have hdcomm : d ∈ Subgroup.closedCommutator G := by
      simpa only [topDerivedTop, closedDerivedSeries_top_one_eq_closedCommutator] using
        hDderived hd
    rw [← TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk θ d,
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff.mpr hdcomm, map_one]
  have hLift : RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ :=
    fun N _ n hn => hθ N.toOpenSubgroup n hn
  have h := oriented_invariants G D hDclosed θ hDθ hLift
  exact ⟨h.2.2.1 hDderived, h.2.2.2⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.FaithfulAbelianExtension.difference_action
statement:
theorem difference_action (a : A) (f : functions D M) :
    difference D M (action D M a f) = difference D M f
proof:
:= by
  funext d
  change f.val (a⁻¹ * d) / f.val (a⁻¹ * 1) = f.val d / f.val 1
  rw [mul_one, div_eq_div_iff_mul_eq_mul]
  simpa only [one_mul] using f.property a⁻¹ 1 d

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.FaithfulAbelianExtension.constant_of_difference_eq_one
statement:
theorem constant_of_difference_eq_one (f : functions D M)
    (hf : difference D M f = 1) (x : A) (d : D) :
    f.val (x * d) = f.val x
proof:
:= by
  have hd : f.val d = f.val 1 := div_eq_one.mp (congrFun hf d)
  have h := f.property x 1 d
  rw [one_mul, hd, mul_comm (f.val 1)] at h
  exact mul_right_cancel h

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.FaithfulAbelianExtension.action_eq_self_of_difference_eq_one
statement:
theorem action_eq_self_of_difference_eq_one [D.Normal]
    (a : D) (f : functions D M) (hf : difference D M f = 1) :
    action D M (a : A) f = f
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext x
  let d : D := ⟨x⁻¹ * (a : A)⁻¹ * x,
    by
      simpa only [inv_inv] using
        (inferInstance : D.Normal).conj_mem (a : A)⁻¹ (D.inv_mem a.property) x⁻¹⟩
  have h := constant_of_difference_eq_one D M f hf x d
  change f.val (x * (x⁻¹ * (a : A)⁻¹ * x)) = f.val x at h
  rw [← mul_assoc x, mul_inv_cancel_left] at h
  exact h

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.FaithfulAbelianExtension.coordinate_mul
statement:
theorem coordinate_mul [D.Normal] (x : A) (d : D) :
    coordinate D (x * d) = coordinate D x * d
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (QuotientGroup.mk' D (x * d)).out⁻¹ * (x * d) =
    ((QuotientGroup.mk' D x).out⁻¹ * x) * d
  have hd : QuotientGroup.mk' D (d : A) = 1 :=
    (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := D) _).mpr d.property
  rw [map_mul, hd, mul_one, mul_assoc]

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.FaithfulAbelianExtension.action_injective
statement:
theorem action_injective [D.Normal] [Nontrivial M]
    (ι : D →* M) (hι : Function.Injective ι) :
    Function.Injective (action D M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_one (action D M)).mpr
  intro a ha
  have hfix (f : functions D M) : f.val (a⁻¹) = f.val 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun e : MulAut (functions D M) => (e f).val 1) ha
    change f.val (a⁻¹ * 1) = f.val 1 at h
    simpa only [mul_one] using h
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_ne (1 : M)
  let w : functions D M := ⟨fun x => if QuotientGroup.mk' D x = 1 then c else 1, by
    intro x y d
    have hd : QuotientGroup.mk' D (d : A) = 1 :=
      (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := D) _).mpr d.property
    simp only [map_mul, hd, mul_one]
    exact mul_comm _ _⟩
  have haD : a ∈ D := by
    have hw := hfix w
    change (if QuotientGroup.mk' D a⁻¹ = 1 then c else 1) =
      (if QuotientGroup.mk' D 1 = 1 then c else 1) at hw
    rw [map_one, ite_eq_left rfl] at hw
    have hinv : QuotientGroup.mk' D a⁻¹ = 1 := by
      by_contra h
      rw [ite_eq_right h] at hw
      exact hc hw.symm
    exact D.inv_mem_iff.mp ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := D) _).mp hinv)
  let f : functions D M := ⟨fun x => ι (coordinate D x), by
    intro x y d
    change ι (coordinate D (x * d)) * ι (coordinate D y) =
      ι (coordinate D (y * d)) * ι (coordinate D x)
    rw [coordinate_mul, coordinate_mul, map_mul, map_mul]
    calc
      _ = (ι (coordinate D x) * ι (coordinate D y)) * ι d := mul_right_comm _ _ _
      _ = (ι (coordinate D y) * ι (coordinate D x)) * ι d := by
        rw [mul_comm (ι (coordinate D x)) (ι (coordinate D y))]
      _ = _ := (mul_right_comm _ _ _).symm⟩
  have hf := hι (hfix f)
  have hcoord := coordinate_mul D 1 (⟨a⁻¹, D.inv_mem haD⟩ : D)
  rw [one_mul] at hcoord
  rw [hcoord] at hf
  have hi : (⟨a⁻¹, D.inv_mem haD⟩ : D) = 1 := mul_left_cancel (hf.trans (mul_one _).symm)
  exact inv_eq_one.mp (congrArg Subtype.val hi)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.FaithfulAbelianExtension.difference_eq_one_of_mem_derived
statement:
theorem difference_eq_one_of_mem_derived
    {b : (functions D M) ⋊[action D M] A}
    (hb : b ∈ derivedSeries ((functions D M) ⋊[action D M] A) 1) :
    difference D M b.left = 1
proof:
:=
  Abelianization.commutator_subset_ker (extensionDifference D M) hb

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.faithful_abelian_extension_solvable_length
statement:
theorem faithful_abelian_extension_solvable_length
    (A : Type u) [Group A] [Finite A] (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hA : derivedSeries A m = ⊥) :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommGroup C) (_ : Finite C) (φ : A →* MulAut C),
      Function.Injective φ ∧ derivedSeries (C ⋊[φ] A) m = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := derivedSeries A (m - 1)
  have hD : ⁅D, D⁆ = ⊥ := by
    change derivedSeries A ((m - 1) + 1) = ⊥
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
    exact hA
  let : CommGroup D :=
    { (inferInstance : Group D) with
      mul_comm := by
        intro x y
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm.mp
        have h := Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator x.property y.property
        rw [hD] at h
        exact Subgroup.mem_bot.mp h }
  let M := D × ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
  let C := FaithfulAbelianExtension.functions D M
  let φ : A →* MulAut C := FaithfulAbelianExtension.action D M
  let ι : D →* M := (MonoidHom.id D).prod (1 : D →* ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod 2)))
  have hι : Function.Injective ι := by
    intro x y h
    exact congrArg Prod.fst h
  refine ⟨C, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    φ, FaithfulAbelianExtension.action_injective D M ι hι, ?_⟩
  have hright {b : C ⋊[φ] A} (hb : b ∈ derivedSeries (C ⋊[φ] A) (m - 1)) :
      b.right ∈ D :=
    map_derivedSeries_le_derivedSeries (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : C ⋊[φ] A →* A)
      (m - 1) ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  have hdiff {b : C ⋊[φ] A} (hb : b ∈ derivedSeries (C ⋊[φ] A) (m - 1)) :
      FaithfulAbelianExtension.difference D M b.left = 1 :=
    FaithfulAbelianExtension.difference_eq_one_of_mem_derived D M
      (derivedSeries_antitone (C ⋊[φ] A) (by omega : 1 ≤ m - 1) hb)
  rw [show m = (m - 1) + 1 from (Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)).symm,
    derivedSeries_succ]
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  apply Subgroup.commutator_le.mpr
  intro x hx y hy
  apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr
  apply commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm.mpr
  apply SemidirectProduct.ext
  · change x.left * φ x.right y.left = y.left * φ y.right x.left
    rw [FaithfulAbelianExtension.action_eq_self_of_difference_eq_one D M
      ⟨x.right, hright hx⟩ y.left (hdiff hy),
      FaithfulAbelianExtension.action_eq_self_of_difference_eq_one D M
        ⟨y.right, hright hy⟩ x.left (hdiff hx), mul_comm]
  · exact congrArg Subtype.val (mul_comm (⟨x.right, hright hx⟩ : D) ⟨y.right, hright hy⟩)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.discrete_topDerivedTop_eq_derivedSeries
statement:
private theorem discrete_topDerivedTop_eq_derivedSeries
    (A : Type u) [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A] (n : ℕ) :
    topDerivedTop A n = derivedSeries A n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change (⁅topDerivedTop A n, topDerivedTop A n⁆).topologicalClosure =
      ⁅derivedSeries A n, derivedSeries A n⁆
    rw [ih]
    exact le_antisymm
      (Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal
        (s := ⁅derivedSeries A n, derivedSeries A n⁆)
        (t := ⁅derivedSeries A n, derivedSeries A n⁆) le_rfl (isClosed_discrete _))
      (Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure _)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.abelian_split_solvable_slim
statement:
theorem abelian_split_solvable_slim
    (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u})
    (hsolve : HasFiniteSplitAbelianKernelEmbeddingSolutions FiniteGroupClass.abelian G)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) : IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot G m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q := MaxSolvQuot G m
  let q : G →ₜ* Q := continuousToMaxSolvQuot G m
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := continuousToMaxSolvQuot_surjective G m
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace Q :=
    totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal (topDerivedTop G m) inferInstance
  intro H
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro z hz
  apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr
  by_contra hzone
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ProC.exists_openNormalSubgroup_sub_open_nhds_of_one
    (H.isOpen.inter (isClosed_singleton (x := z)).isOpen_compl)
    (show (1 : Q) ∈ (H : Set Q) ∩ ({z} : Set Q)ᶜ from
      ⟨H.one_mem, Ne.symm hzone⟩)
  have hzN : z ∉ N := fun h => (hN h).2 rfl
  let A := Q ⧸ (N : Subgroup Q)
  let πN : Q →ₜ* A := ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj N
  let π : G →ₜ* A := πN.comp q
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π :=
    (ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_surjective N).comp hq
  have hA : derivedSeries A m = ⊥ := by
    rw [← discrete_topDerivedTop_eq_derivedSeries A m,
      ← topDerived_map_eq_of_surj π hπ (fun n => isClosed_discrete _) m]
    apply (Subgroup.map_eq_bot_iff (f := π.toMonoidHom)
      (H := topDerivedTop G m)).mpr
    intro g hg
    change πN (q g) = 1
    have hqg : q g = 1 := (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := topDerivedTop G m) g).mpr hg
    rw [hqg, map_one]
  obtain ⟨C, hCgroup, hCfinite, φ, hφ, hB⟩ :=
    faithful_abelian_extension_solvable_length A m hm hA
  let : CommGroup C := hCgroup
  have : Finite C := hCfinite
  let B := C ⋊[φ] A
  let : TopologicalSpace B := ⊥
  have : DiscreteTopology B := ⟨rfl⟩
  have : Finite B := Finite.of_equiv (C × A) SemidirectProduct.equivProd.symm
  let α : B →ₜ* A :=
    { toMonoidHom := SemidirectProduct.rightHom
      continuous_toFun := continuous_of_discreteTopology }
  let s : A →ₜ* B :=
    { toMonoidHom := SemidirectProduct.inr
      continuous_toFun := continuous_of_discreteTopology }
  have hα : Function.Surjective α := SemidirectProduct.rightHom_surjective
  have hcomm (a b : α.toMonoidHom.ker) : Commute (a : B) (b : B) := by
    have ha : (a : B).right = 1 := a.property
    have hb : (b : B).right = 1 := b.property
    change (a : B) * b = (b : B) * a
    apply SemidirectProduct.ext
    · change (a : B).left * φ (a : B).right (b : B).left =
        (b : B).left * φ (b : B).right (a : B).left
      rw [ha, hb, map_one, MulAut.one_apply, MulAut.one_apply, mul_comm]
    · change (a : B).right * (b : B).right = (b : B).right * (a : B).right
      rw [ha, hb]
  let P : TopologicalEmbeddingProblem G :=
    ⟨TopGrp.of B, TopGrp.of A, α, hα, π, hπ⟩
  have hsplit : P.IsSplit := ⟨s, by
    apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
    intro a
    rfl⟩
  have hker : FiniteGroupClass.abelian α.toMonoidHom.ker :=
    ⟨inferInstance, fun a b => Subtype.ext (hcomm a b).eq⟩
  obtain ⟨θ⟩ := hsolve P inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance hsplit hker hcomm
  have hderived : topDerivedTop G m ≤ θ.val.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    intro g hg
    have h := topDerived_map_le θ.val m ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    rw [discrete_topDerivedTop_eq_derivedSeries B m, hB] at h
    exact Subgroup.mem_bot.mp h
  let θbar : Q →ₜ* B := QuotientGroup.liftₜ (topDerivedTop G m) θ.val hderived
  have hbar : Function.Surjective θbar := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := θ.property.1 b
    exact ⟨q g, hg⟩
  have hsquare (x : Q) : α (θbar x) = πN x := by
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hq x
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun θ.property.2 g
  have hcentral (c : C) :
      θbar z * (SemidirectProduct.inl c : B) = SemidirectProduct.inl c * θbar z := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hbar (SemidirectProduct.inl c)
    have hxN : x ∈ N := by
      apply ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_eq_one_iff.mp
      change πN x = 1
      rw [← hsquare, hx]
      exact SemidirectProduct.rightHom_inl c
    have hcommx : z * x = x * z := (Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff.mp hz x (hN hxN).1).symm
    have h := congrArg θbar hcommx
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, hx] at h
    exact h
  have hact : φ (θbar z).right = 1 := by
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro c
    have h := congrArg SemidirectProduct.left (hcentral c)
    change (θbar z).left * φ (θbar z).right c = c * φ 1 (θbar z).left at h
    rw [map_one, MulAut.one_apply, mul_comm c] at h
    exact mul_left_cancel h
  have hright : (θbar z).right = 1 := hφ (hact.trans (map_one φ).symm)
  apply hzN
  apply ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_eq_one_iff.mp
  change πN z = 1
  rw [← hsquare]
  exact hright

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.principal_unit_logarithm_3_4
statement:
theorem principal_unit_logarithm_3_4
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [CharZero E]
    (v : Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    let U
proof:
:= CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1
    let log := principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p
    let image : Set E := Set.range (fun u : U => (log u).toAdd)
    (∀ (f : E ≃+* E) (hval : ∀ x : E, v (f x) = v x) (u : U),
      (log (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.equivOfPreserves
        (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) f
        (fun x => by change v x ≤ 1 ↔ v (f x) ≤ 1; rw [hval x]) 1 u)).toAdd =
        f (log u).toAdd) ∧
      (∀ (a : ℤ_[p]) (x : E), x ∈ image → padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p a * x ∈ image) ∧
      (∀ a : v.valuationSubring, (p : E) ^ 2 * (a : E) ∈ image) ∧
      (∀ x : E, (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ y : E, y ∈ image ∧ x = (p : E) ^ n * y) →
        x = 0) := by
  refine ⟨principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_equivOfPreserves v p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro a x ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p a u,
      principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_padicPow v p a u⟩
  · intro a
    exact exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_sq_mul v p a
  · intro x hx
    apply principal_unit_log_image_separated v p x
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · obtain ⟨y, ⟨u, hu⟩, hy⟩ := hx 1 Nat.one_pos
      dsimp only at hu
      refine ⟨u ^ p, ?_⟩
      rw [hn, pow_zero, one_mul, map_pow]
      change x = p • (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd
      rw [nsmul_eq_mul, hu]
      simpa only [pow_one] using hy
    · obtain ⟨y, ⟨u, hu⟩, hy⟩ := hx n (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
      dsimp only at hu
      exact ⟨u, by rw [hu]; exact hy⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.complete_prime_degree_cohomology_3_5
statement:
theorem complete_prime_degree_cohomology_3_5
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [CharZero K] (base : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime] [CharP base.residueField p]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = r) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) K L τ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K L).injective
  obtain ⟨τ, _, z, hz⟩ := prime_order_detection base p r hdegree
  exact ⟨τ⁻¹, inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one_of_moved_abelianModPower K L p τ z hz⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.sigma_properties_1_3
statement:
theorem sigma_properties_1_3
    {sigma : Set ℕ} (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u}) :
    (IsSigmaAbFaithful Set.univ G ↔ IsAbFaithful G) ∧
      (IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G →
        let Q := G ⧸ proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) G
        letI : TotallyDisconnectedSpace Q :=
          totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
            (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) G)
            (proCResidualCore_isClosed (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) G)
        (∀ tau : Set ℕ, sigma ⊆ tau → IsSigmaAbFaithful tau G) ∧
          IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma Q ∧
          (∀ ell : ℕ, sigma = {ell} →
            IsAbFaithful G ∧ IsAbFaithful Q))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isSigmaAbFaithful_univ_iff (G := G), ?_⟩
  intro hG
  let Q := G ⧸ proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) G
  let : TotallyDisconnectedSpace Q :=
    totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) G)
      (proCResidualCore_isClosed (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) G)
  change (∀ tau : Set ℕ, sigma ⊆ tau → IsSigmaAbFaithful tau G) ∧
    IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma Q ∧
    (∀ ell : ℕ, sigma = {ell} → IsAbFaithful G ∧ IsAbFaithful Q)
  have hQ : IsAbFaithful Q := hG.isAbFaithful_residualQuotient
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro tau hsub
    exact IsSigmaAbFaithful.mono hsub hG
  · exact (isSigmaAbFaithful_iff_isAbFaithful_of_proSigma
      (G := Q) (sigma := sigma)
      (proCResidualCoreQuotient_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass
        (G := G) (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_formation sigma))).2 hQ
  · intro ell _
    exact ⟨hG.isAbFaithful, hQ⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finiteStepSolvable_centerfree_and_slim_of_formalHilbert90
statement:
theorem finiteStepSolvable_centerfree_and_slim_of_formalHilbert90
    (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u})
    (hG : IsAbFaithful G)
    (hOrient : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime],
      ∃ θ : Orientation ℓ G, FormalHilbert90 θ) :
    (∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → Subgroup.center (MaxSolvQuot G m) = ⊥) ∧
      ((∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime],
        ∃ θ : Orientation ℓ G,
          FormalHilbert90 θ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range θ)) →
        ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot G m))
proof:
:= by
  have hFaithful (N : OpenNormalSubgroup G) :
      Function.Injective
        (ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
          (G := G) (N := (N : Subgroup G))) := by
    apply quotientConjAbelianization_injective_of_continuousMulEquiv_image
      (ProCGroups.OpenSubgroup.topContinuousMulEquiv G).symm N
    exact hG ⊤ _
  have hRelative (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
      Subgroup.center (MaxSolvQuot G m) = ⊥ ∧
        ((∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime],
          ∃ θ : Orientation ℓ G,
            FormalHilbert90 θ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range θ)) →
          IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot G m)) := by
    let D : Subgroup G := topDerivedTop G (m - 1)
    have hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G) := by
      exact inferInstance
    have hDderived : D ≤ topDerivedTop G 1 :=
      topDerivedTop_antitone (by omega : 1 ≤ m - 1)
    have hOrientD : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime],
        Nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) →
          ∃ θ : Orientation ℓ G, RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ := by
      intro ℓ _ _
      obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := hOrient ℓ
      exact ⟨θ, fun N _ n hn => hθ N.toOpenSubgroup n hn⟩
    have hResult := relative_centerfree_and_slim_criterion G D hDclosed
      hDderived (fun N _ => hFaithful N) hOrientD
    have hIndex : m - 1 + 1 = m := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ m)
    have hCenter : Subgroup.center (MaxSolvQuot G m) = ⊥ := by
      have hCenter' : Subgroup.center (MaxSolvQuot G (m - 1 + 1)) = ⊥ := hResult.1
      exact (congrArg (fun k : ℕ => Subgroup.center (MaxSolvQuot G k) = ⊥)
        hIndex).mp hCenter'
    refine ⟨hCenter, ?_⟩
    intro hInfinite
    have hSlim : IsSlim (RelativeDerivedQuotient D) := hResult.2 (by
      intro ℓ _ _
      obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hθInfinite⟩ := hInfinite ℓ
      exact ⟨θ, (fun N _ n hn => hθ N.toOpenSubgroup n hn), hθInfinite⟩)
    have hSlim' : IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot G (m - 1 + 1)) := hSlim
    exact (congrArg (fun k : ℕ => IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot G k)) hIndex).mp hSlim'
  exact ⟨fun m hm => (hRelative m hm).1,
    fun hInfinite m hm => (hRelative m hm).2 hInfinite⟩

statement:
theorem fundamental_group_integers_1_4
    (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (ξ : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)) :
    Subsingleton π₁ᵉᵗ(ξ)
proof:

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.isBoundaryUnramified_of_abelian_embedding
statement:
private theorem isBoundaryUnramified_of_abelian_embedding
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    (hnc : D.HasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent 2)
    (hgeom : HasGeometricallyIntegralGenericComponents D.1) :
    let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:= boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
    ∀ (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (_hW : IsGalois W)
      {A : Type v} [CommGroup A] (e : (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ →* A),
      Function.Injective e → IsBoundaryUnramified D W := by
  intro hConnected
  let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := hConnected
  intro W hW A _ e he E z hz
  apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
  intro σ hσ
  let s : finiteCoverInertia D W E z := ⟨σ, hσ⟩
  have hodd : ¬ 2 ∣ Nat.card (finiteCoverInertia D W E z) :=
    finite_inertia_control D hhor hreg E 2 Nat.prime_two (hnc E.val E.property) W hW z hz
  have hinv : e (MulOpposite.op σ) = (e (MulOpposite.op σ))⁻¹ := by
    have h := e.map_isConj (finiteCoverInertia_isConj_inv D hhor hreg hgeom W hW E z hz s)
    simpa only [map_inv] using isConj_iff_eq.mp h
  have htwo : (e (MulOpposite.op σ)) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [pow_two]
    exact (congrArg (fun t => e (MulOpposite.op σ) * t) hinv).trans (mul_inv_cancel _)
  have hcard : (e (MulOpposite.op σ)) ^ Nat.card (finiteCoverInertia D W E z) = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun t : finiteCoverInertia D W E z => e (MulOpposite.op (t : Aut W)))
      (pow_card_eq_one' (x := s))
    simpa only [Subgroup.coe_pow, MulOpposite.op_pow, map_pow,
      Subgroup.coe_one, MulOpposite.op_one, map_one] using h
  have hone : e (MulOpposite.op σ) = 1 := orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp
    (Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes (Nat.prime_two.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hodd)
      (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one htwo) (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hcard))
  exact MulOpposite.op_injective (he (hone.trans (map_one e).symm))

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.abelian_invariance_2_1
statement:
theorem abelian_invariance_2_1
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    (hnc : D.HasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent 2)
    (hgeom : HasGeometricallyIntegralGenericComponents D.1) :
    ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
        (point : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement),
        ∃ e : TopologicalAbelianization π₁ᵉᵗ(point) ≃ₜ*
            TopologicalAbelianization π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι),
          ∀ g : π₁ᵉᵗ(point), e (QuotientGroup.mk g) =
            QuotientGroup.mk (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point g)
proof:
:= by
  let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  intro Ω _ _ point
  let f := fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point
  have hf : Function.Surjective f :=
    boundaryComplement_fundamentalGroupHom_surjective D hreg point
  have hker : f.toMonoidHom.ker = boundaryUnramifiedKernelIntersection D point :=
    ((boundary_quotient_finite_cover D hreg).choose_spec Ω point).2
  have hkill : f.toMonoidHom.ker ≤ Subgroup.closedCommutator π₁ᵉᵗ(point) := by
    intro g hg
    apply ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff.mp
    have hclasses : ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.mk π₁ᵉᵗ(point) g =
        ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.mk π₁ᵉᵗ(point) 1 := by
      apply ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_iff_finite_characters_eq.mpr
      intro A _ _ _ _ chi
      obtain ⟨W, hW, w, e, he, hchi⟩ :=
        exists_galoisObject_discreteCharacter_embedding (fiber point) chi
      have hU : IsBoundaryUnramified D W :=
        isBoundaryUnramified_of_abelian_embedding D hhor hreg hnc hgeom W hW e he
      have hgI : g ∈ boundaryUnramifiedKernelIntersection D point := hker ▸ hg
      have hgq : (let : IsGalois W := hW
          galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom (fiber point) π₁ᵉᵗ(point) W w) g = 1 :=
        Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp
          (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp hgI W) hW) w) hU
      calc
        chi g = e ((let : IsGalois W := hW
            galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom (fiber point) π₁ᵉᵗ(point) W w) g) :=
          (DFunLike.congr_fun hchi g).symm
        _ = e 1 := congrArg e hgq
        _ = 1 := map_one e
        _ = chi 1 := (map_one chi).symm
    exact hclasses.trans (map_one _)
  have hinj :=
    (ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.injective_map_iff_ker_le_closedCommutator f
        hf).mpr hkill
  have hsurj := ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_map_of_surjective f hf
  let e := MulEquiv.ofBijective
    (ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.map f).toMonoidHom ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
  have he : Continuous e := (ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.map f).continuous
  refine ⟨{ toMulEquiv := e
            continuous_toFun := he
            continuous_invFun := Continuous.continuous_symm_of_equiv_compact_to_t2
              (f := e.toEquiv) he }, ?_⟩
  intro g
  exact ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.map_apply_mk f g

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundary_quotient_finite_cover
statement:
theorem boundary_quotient_finite_cover
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport) :
    ∃ hU : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement,
      letI : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:= hU
      ∀ (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
        (point : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement),
        Function.Surjective (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point) ∧
          (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point).toMonoidHom.ker =
            boundaryUnramifiedKernelIntersection D point := by
  let hU : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement :=
    boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
  refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
  let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := hU
  intro Ω _ _ point
  refine ⟨boundaryComplement_fundamentalGroupHom_surjective D hreg point, ?_⟩
  exact le_antisymm
    (kernel_le_boundaryUnramifiedKernelIntersection D hreg point)
    (boundaryUnramifiedKernelIntersection_le_kernel D hreg point)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundary_quotient_1_1
statement:
theorem boundary_quotient_1_1
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport) :
    ∃ hU : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement,
      letI : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:= hU
      ∀ (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
        (point : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement),
        Function.Surjective (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point) ∧
          (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point).toMonoidHom.ker =
            boundaryStrictInertiaClosure D hreg point := by
  let hU : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement :=
    boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
  refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
  let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := hU
  intro Ω _ _ point
  refine ⟨boundaryComplement_fundamentalGroupHom_surjective D hreg point, ?_⟩

    (kernel_le_boundaryStrictInertiaClosure D hreg point)
