name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.perfect_kernel_2_5
statement:
theorem perfect_kernel_2_5
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hD : BoundaryCondition D) :
    ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
        (point : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement),
        let f : π₁ᵉᵗ(point) →ₜ* π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι)
proof:
:=
          fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point
        (commutator f.toMonoidHom.ker).topologicalClosure = ⊤ ∧
          ∃ e : Prosolvable π₁ᵉᵗ(point) ≃ₜ* Prosolvable π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι),
            ∀ g : π₁ᵉᵗ(point), e (QuotientGroup.mk g) = QuotientGroup.mk (f g) := by
  obtain ⟨hU, hboundary⟩ := boundary_quotient_1_1 D hD.1
  refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
  let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := hU
  intro Ω _ _ point
  let f : π₁ᵉᵗ(point) →ₜ* π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) :=
    fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := (hboundary Ω point).1
  have hAb : OpenNormalAbelianizationInjective f :=
    openNormalAbelianizationInjective_of_finiteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel
      f hf (boundary_openNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel D hhor hD point)
  refine ⟨kernel_topologicallyPerfect_of_openNormalAbelianizationInjective f hf hAb, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨prosolvableResidualQuotientContinuousMulEquiv f hf hAb, ?_⟩
  intro g
  rfl

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.finite_etale_stability_2_4
statement:
theorem finite_etale_stability_2_4
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hD : BoundaryCondition D) (Y : FiniteEtale X) (_hY : ConnectedSpace Y.left) :
    IsHorizontal (D.comapFiniteEtale Y) ∧ BoundaryCondition (D.comapFiniteEtale Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hregular, hcrossing, hgeneric⟩ := hD
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hbase : Y.hom ≫ toIntegers X = toIntegers Y.left :=
      specZIsTerminal.comp_from Y.hom
    change (D.comapFiniteEtale Y).IsHorizontalOver (toIntegers Y.left)
    rw [← hbase]
    exact D.comap_components_denseRange_of_isHorizontalOver
      (toIntegers X) Y.hom hhor
  · exact Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport.comap_of_etale
      D.1 Y.hom hregular
  · exact D.exists_normalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristic_on_comapComponent
      Y.hom 2 hcrossing
  · intro Z hZ
    change HasGeometricallyIntegralGenericComponents
      ((D.1.comap Y.hom).comap Z.hom)
    rw [← D.1.comap_comp Z.hom Y.hom]
    exact hgeneric (FiniteEtale.mk (Z.hom ≫ Y.hom)) hZ

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryUnramified_of_normalCrossingPoints_at_card_primes
statement:
theorem boundaryUnramified_of_normalCrossingPoints_at_card_primes
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport) :
    let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:= boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
    ∀ (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (_hW : IsGalois W),
      (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ Nat.card (Aut W) →
        D.HasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent p) →
      IsBoundaryUnramified D W := by
  intro hConnected W hW hnc E z hz
  have hcard : Nat.card (finiteCoverInertia D W E z) = 1 := by
    apply Nat.eq_one_iff_not_exists_prime_dvd.mpr
    intro p hp hpdvd
    have hpW : p ∣ Nat.card (Aut W) :=
      hpdvd.trans (finiteCoverInertia D W E z).card_subgroup_dvd_card
    exact finite_inertia_control D hhor hreg E p hp
      (hnc p hp hpW E.val E.property) W hW z hz hpdvd
  have : Subsingleton (finiteCoverInertia D W E z) :=
    (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hcard).1
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro σ hσ
  apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    (Subsingleton.elim (⟨σ, hσ⟩ : finiteCoverInertia D W E z) 1)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundary_invariance_1_3
statement:
theorem boundary_invariance_1_3
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    (hnc : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
      D.HasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent p) :
    ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
        (point : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement),
        ∃ e : π₁ᵉᵗ(point) ≃ₜ* π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι),
          ∀ g : π₁ᵉᵗ(point), e g = fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hU, hquotient⟩ := boundary_quotient_finite_cover D hreg
  let _ : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := hU
  refine ⟨hU, ?_⟩
  intro Ω _ _ point
  have hunramified : ∀ (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement)
      (_hW : IsGalois W), IsBoundaryUnramified D W := by
    intro W hW
    exact boundaryUnramified_of_normalCrossingPoints_at_card_primes D hhor hreg W hW
      (fun p hp _ => hnc p hp)
  let f : π₁ᵉᵗ(point) →ₜ* π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) :=
    fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point
  have hsurjective : Function.Surjective f := (hquotient Ω point).1
  have hkernel : f.toMonoidHom.ker = ⊥ := by
    change (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point).toMonoidHom.ker = ⊥
    rw [(hquotient Ω point).2]
    apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
    intro g hg
    have hall : g ∈ ⨅ (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement)
        (hW : IsGalois W) (w : (fiber point).obj W),
        (let : IsGalois W := hW
         galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom (fiber point) π₁ᵉᵗ(point) W w).ker := by
      simp only [boundaryUnramifiedKernelIntersection, Subgroup.mem_iInf] at hg
      simp only [Subgroup.mem_iInf]
      intro W hW w
      exact hg W hW w (hunramified W hW)
    rw [iInf_galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker] at hall
    exact hall
  have hbijective : Function.Bijective f :=
    ⟨f.toMonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff.mp hkernel, hsurjective⟩
  refine ⟨ProCGroups.ContinuousMulEquiv.ofBijectiveCompactToT2
    f.toMonoidHom f.continuous_toFun hbijective, ?_⟩
  intro g
  exact ProCGroups.ContinuousMulEquiv.ofBijectiveCompactToT2_apply
    f.toMonoidHom f.continuous_toFun hbijective g

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.smooth_boundary_2_3
statement:
theorem smooth_boundary_2_3 :
    (∀ (E : Scheme.{0}),
      Smooth (toIntegers E) →
      LocallyOfFiniteType (toIntegers E) →
      QuasiCompact (toIntegers E) →
      Surjective (toIntegers E) →
      GeometricallyConnected
        ((toIntegers E).fiberToSpecResidueField
          (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)))) →
      ∀ (T : FiniteEtale E) (Z : Set T.left)
        (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents T.left),
        GeometricallyIntegral
          ((T.left.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ ≫ T.hom ≫ toIntegers E).fiberToSpecResidueField
            (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))))) ∧
    (∀ (X : Scheme.{0}) [ConnectedSpace X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
      (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor),
      IsHorizontal D →
      (∀ (Z : Set D.1.subscheme) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents D.1.subscheme),
        Smooth (D.1.componentToBase (toIntegers X) Z hZ) ∧
        LocallyOfFiniteType (D.1.componentToBase (toIntegers X) Z hZ) ∧
        QuasiCompact (D.1.componentToBase (toIntegers X) Z hZ) ∧
        Surjective (D.1.componentToBase (toIntegers X) Z hZ) ∧
        GeometricallyConnected
          ((D.1.componentToBase (toIntegers X) Z hZ).fiberToSpecResidueField
            (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))))) →
      HasGeometricallyIntegralGenericComponentsAfterCovers D)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ), ⊤) :=
    Function.Injective.isDomain (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).hom.hom
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ), ⊤) :=
    IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  constructor
  · intro E hsm _ hqc hsurj hgc T Z hZ
    let : Smooth (toIntegers E) := hsm
    let : QuasiCompact (toIntegers E) := hqc
    let : Surjective (toIntegers E) := hsurj
    let : GeometricallyConnected
        ((toIntegers E).fiberToSpecResidueField
          (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)))) := hgc
    let i : T.left.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ ⟶ T.left :=
      T.left.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ
    let : IsFiniteEtale i :=
      Scheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentι_isFiniteEtale_of_smooth
        (T.hom ≫ toIntegers E) Z hZ
    let C : FiniteEtale E := FiniteEtale.mk (i ≫ T.hom)
    let : ConnectedSpace C.left := inferInstanceAs
      (ConnectedSpace (T.left.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ))
    have hcomp : C.hom ≫ toIntegers E =
        T.left.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ ≫ T.hom ≫ toIntegers E :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
    have hgi :=
      (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups in
        geometricallyIntegral_genericFiber_of_connected_finiteEtale_over_smooth_integers
          (toIntegers E) C)
    rw [hcomp] at hgi
    exact hgi
  · intro X _ _ D _ hD Y _ Z hZ
    obtain ⟨W, hW, himage⟩ :=
      D.1.exists_irreducibleComponent_image_comapSubschemeTo_eq Y.hom Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hsm, _, hqc, hsurj, hgc⟩ := hD W hW
    let E : Scheme := D.1.subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponent W hW
    let p : E ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ) :=
      D.1.componentToBase (toIntegers X) W hW
    let : Smooth p := hsm
    let : QuasiCompact p := hqc
    let : Surjective p := hsurj
    let : GeometricallyConnected
        (p.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)))) := hgc
    let f : (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme ⟶ D.1.subscheme := D.1.comapSubschemeTo Y.hom
    let c : (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ ⟶ E :=
      (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap f Z hZ W hW himage
    let : Smooth (D.1.subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentι W hW ≫
        D.1.subschemeι ≫ toIntegers X) := hsm
    let : IsFiniteEtale c :=
      Scheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_isFiniteEtale_of_smooth
        f (D.1.subschemeι ≫ toIntegers X) Z hZ W hW himage
    let C : FiniteEtale E := FiniteEtale.mk c
    let : ConnectedSpace C.left := inferInstanceAs
      (ConnectedSpace ((D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ))
    have hbase : (D.1.comap Y.hom).componentToBase (toIntegers Y.left) Z hZ = c ≫ p := by
      rw [show toIntegers Y.left = Y.hom ≫ toIntegers X from specZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _]
      exact D.1.componentToBase_comap_eq Y.hom (toIntegers X) Z hZ W hW himage
    change GeometricallyIntegral
      (((D.1.comap Y.hom).componentToBase (toIntegers Y.left) Z hZ).fiberToSpecResidueField
        (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))))
    rw [hbase]
    exact (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups in
      geometricallyIntegral_genericFiber_of_connected_finiteEtale_over_smooth_integers p C)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.finite_inertia_control
statement:
theorem finite_inertia_control
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport) (E : Component D)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hnc : ∃ x : D.1.subscheme, x ∈ E.val ∧
      ringChar (X.residueField (D.1.subschemeι x)) = p ∧
        D.IsNormalCrossingsAt (D.1.subschemeι x)) :
    letI : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:=
      boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
    ∀ (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (_hW : IsGalois W)
      (z : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E)))) ⟶
        (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).normalization),
      z ≫ (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization =
          componentGeometricPoint D E →
        ¬ p ∣ Nat.card (finiteCoverInertia D W E z) := by
  let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
  intro W hW z hz
  obtain ⟨U, f, hf, u, q, hq, hmapped, hpoint⟩ :=
    exists_arithmeticBoundaryChart_with_componentGeometricPoint D hhor hreg E p hp hnc
  let : Etale f := hf
  let : q.IsPrime := hq
  obtain ⟨P, hqP, hPheight, r, t, branch, hVdomain, hVregular, hVnormal,
    hboundary, hNC, hbranch, hqV, hCharZero, hpV, _hmapped⟩ := hmapped
  let : P.asIdeal.IsPrime := P.isPrime
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal
  let : IsDomain V := hVdomain
  let : IsRegularRing V := hVregular
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed V := hVnormal
  obtain ⟨y, hyideal, hy⟩ := hpoint P.asIdeal P.isPrime hqP.le
  have hzy : z ≫ (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization =
      y ≫ Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo U u P.asIdeal ≫ f := by
    exact hz.trans (by simpa only [Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo, Category.assoc] using hy.symm)
  obtain ⟨qA, hqA, hfixA⟩ :=
    exists_boundaryAway_normalizationPoint D.1 f u P t hboundary W z y hzy
  let b := boundaryProduct t r
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero hNC
  let Away := Localization.Away b
  let : IsDomain Away := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain Away hb
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed Away := isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization Away
    (Submonoid.powers b)
    (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb))
  let c := D.1.boundaryAwayToSupportComplement f u P t hboundary
  let a : Spec (.of Away) ⟶ Spec (.of V) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap V Away))
  let s := genericPoint (Spec (.of Away))
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure ((Spec (.of Away)).residueField s)
  let xi : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of Away) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ((Spec (.of Away)).residueField s) Ω)) ≫
      (Spec (.of Away)).fromSpecResidueField s
  obtain ⟨Z, i, qZ, zZ, w, hi, hZ, hiz, hqZ, hlift⟩ :=
    exists_galoisComponent_normalizationPoint_fixed_lift c xi W hW a qA
  let : Mono i := hi
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let : IsIntegral Z.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  let K := (Spec (.of Away)).functionField
  let L := Z.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Z
  let : Algebra V K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra b hb
  let : Algebra V L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra b hb Z
  let : IsScalarTower V K L := finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower b hb Z
  let : IsFractionRing V K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing b hb
  let : FiniteDimensional K L := finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Z
  let : _root_.IsGalois K L := isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Z hZ
  obtain ⟨φ, hφbase, hφfix⟩ := exists_finiteEtaleAway_normalizationPoint_inertia_iff V b hb Z qZ
  let Q := RingHom.ker φ
  have hQprime : Q.IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime φ
  have hQbranch : Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({t branch} : Set V)) := by
    have h := ker_liesOver_of_specMap_comp φ y (hφbase.trans (hqZ.trans hqA))
    simpa only [hyideal, hqV] using h
  let φV : (V ⧸ Ideal.span ({t branch} : Set V)) →+* (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) :=
    (localizationAtPrimeBranchQuotientToResidue q P.asIdeal hqP.le).comp
      (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hqV.symm).toRingHom
  have hcoprime :=
      Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_finiteEtaleGaloisCover_normalizationInertia_coprime
    (A := V) (k := V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)
    hNC branch hbranch hCharZero Z hZ Q hQprime hQbranch φV p hpV hp
  let J := Q.inertia Gal(L/K)
  let e : (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ ≃* Gal(L/K) := finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMulEquiv Z hZ
  let μ : Gal(L/K) →* (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ :=
    (FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom c xi W hW w Z i zZ hiz hZ hi).comp
      e.symm.toMonoidHom
  have hincl : (finiteCoverInertia D W E z).op ≤ J.map μ := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσfixed : z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι)
        σ.unop.hom.left (by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
          exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) σ.unop.hom.w) = z := hσ
    obtain ⟨τ, hτimage, hτfixed⟩ := hlift σ.unop ((hfixA σ.unop).mpr hσfixed)
    refine ⟨finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ, (hφfix τ).mpr hτfixed, ?_⟩
    change (FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
      c xi W hW w Z i zZ hiz hZ hi) (e.symm (e (MulOpposite.op τ))) = σ
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hτimage
  have hdvd : Nat.card (finiteCoverInertia D W E z) ∣ Nat.card J := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr (finiteCoverInertia D W E z).equivOp]
    exact (Subgroup.card_dvd_of_le hincl).trans (J.card_map_dvd μ)
  exact hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mp (hcoprime.of_dvd_left hdvd).symm

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.inertia_control_1_2
statement:
theorem inertia_control_1_2
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport) (E : Component D)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hnc : ∃ x : D.1.subscheme, x ∈ E.val ∧
      ringChar (X.residueField (D.1.subschemeι x)) = p ∧
        D.IsNormalCrossingsAt (D.1.subschemeι x))
    {Ξ : Type} [Field Ξ] [IsSepClosed Ξ]
    (xi : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶ Spec (.of (boundaryStrictFractionField D E))) :
    let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:= boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
    ∀ (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E)).obj W),
      ¬ p ∣ Nat.card
        (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism
          (boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E) xi W hW w).range := by
  let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
  intro _ W hW w
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hle⟩ :=
    exists_componentNormalizationPoint_strictImage_le_inertia D hreg E xi W hW w
  have hnot := finite_inertia_control D hhor hreg E p hp hnc W hW z hz
  have hdvd := Subgroup.card_dvd_of_le hle
  rw [← Nat.card_congr (finiteCoverInertia D W E z).equivOp] at hdvd
  exact fun h => hnot (h.trans hdvd)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.residual_extension_2_6
statement:
theorem residual_extension_2_6
    {X : Scheme.{0}} [ConnectedSpace X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hD : BoundaryCondition D)
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement)
    (A : Type) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    [TopologicalSpace A] (hAdic : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))
    [IsTopologicalRing A]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (p : ℕ) (_hp : p.Prime) [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) p]
    (n : ℕ) (_hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (ρ : π₁ᵉᵗ(point) →ₜ* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A) :
    letI : TopologicalSpace (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
proof:
:= ⊥
    let f := fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point
    let ρbar : π₁ᵉᵗ(point) →* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n)
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) :=
      (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).comp ρ.toMonoidHom
    ((∃ τ : π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) →ₜ*
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A,
        τ.comp f = ρ) ↔
      (∃ τbar : π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) →ₜ*
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A),
        τbar.toMonoidHom.comp f.toMonoidHom = ρbar)) ∧
      ((∃ τ : π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) →ₜ*
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A,
        τ.comp f = ρ) →
        ∃! τ : π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) →ₜ*
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A,
          τ.comp f = ρ) := by
  classical
  let : TopologicalSpace (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) := ⊥
  let f := fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point
  let ρbar : π₁ᵉᵗ(point) →* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) :=
    (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)).comp ρ.toMonoidHom
  change ((∃ τ : π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) →ₜ*
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A, τ.comp f = ρ) ↔
      (∃ τbar : π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) →ₜ*
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A),
        τbar.toMonoidHom.comp f.toMonoidHom = ρbar)) ∧
    ((∃ τ : π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) →ₜ*
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A, τ.comp f = ρ) →
      ∃! τ : π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) →ₜ*
        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A, τ.comp f = ρ)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    rcases boundary_quotient_1_1 D hD.1 with ⟨hU, hf⟩
    let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := hU
    exact (hf Ω point).1
  have hresidue : Continuous (IsLocalRing.residue A) := by
    have hm : IsOpen ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A : Ideal A) : Set A) := by
      simpa only [pow_one] using (isAdic_iff.mp hAdic).1 1
    have : DiscreteTopology (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) := discreteTopology_bot _
    rw [continuous_discrete_rng]
    intro y
    rcases IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (R := A) y with ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hpreimage : IsLocalRing.residue A ⁻¹' ({y} : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) =
        (fun z : A => z - x) ⁻¹' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A : Set A) := by
      ext z
      change IsLocalRing.residue A z = y ↔ z - x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
      rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, hx, sub_eq_zero]
    rw [hpreimage]
    exact hm.preimage (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  let reduction : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A →ₜ*
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) :=
    { toMonoidHom := Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)
      continuous_toFun := by
        apply Continuous.units_map
        exact continuous_id.matrix_map hresidue }
  constructor
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨τ, hτ⟩
      refine ⟨reduction.comp τ, ?_⟩
      ext g : 1
      change reduction (τ (f g)) = reduction (ρ g)
      exact congrArg reduction (DFunLike.congr_fun hτ g)
    · rintro ⟨τbar, hτbar⟩
      have hpaper := perfect_kernel_2_5 D hhor hD
      let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := hpaper.1
      have hperfect : (commutator f.ker).topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
        (hpaper.2 Ω point).1
      let ρK : f.ker →ₜ* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A :=
        { toMonoidHom := ρ.toMonoidHom.comp f.ker.subtype
          continuous_toFun := ρ.continuous_toFun.comp continuous_subtype_val }
      have hmod : ∀ g : f.ker,
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)) (ρK g) = 1 := by
        intro g
        change ρbar g.1 = 1
        rw [← hτbar]
        change τbar (f g.1) = 1
        have hfg : f g.1 = 1 := MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp g.2
        exact (congrArg τbar hfg).trans (map_one τbar)
      have htrivial : ∀ g : f.ker, ρK g = 1 :=
        adic_representation_eq_one_of_dense_commutator
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) hAdic hperfect ρK hmod
      have hker : f.ker ≤ ρ.ker := by
        intro g hg
        exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr (htrivial ⟨g, hg⟩)
      let τ₀ : π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) →*
          Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A :=
        f.toMonoidHom.liftOfSurjective hsurj ⟨ρ.toMonoidHom, hker⟩
      have hcomp : τ₀.comp f.toMonoidHom = ρ.toMonoidHom := by
        ext g : 1
        exact MonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply
          (f := f.toMonoidHom) (f_inv := Function.surjInv hsurj)
          (Function.rightInverse_surjInv hsurj) ⟨ρ.toMonoidHom, hker⟩ g
      have hcontinuous : Continuous τ₀ := by
        apply (Topology.IsQuotientMap.of_surjective_continuous
          hsurj f.continuous_toFun).continuous_iff.2
        change Continuous (τ₀.comp f.toMonoidHom)
        rw [hcomp]
        exact ρ.continuous_toFun
      refine ⟨⟨τ₀, hcontinuous⟩, ?_⟩
      apply ContinuousMonoidHom.toMonoidHom_injective
      exact hcomp
  · rintro ⟨τ, hτ⟩
    refine ⟨τ, hτ, ?_⟩
    intro τ' hτ'
    ext g : 1
    rcases hsurj g with ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun hτ' u).trans (DFunLike.congr_fun hτ u).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.finiteDimensional_genericResidueField_of_functionField
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_genericResidueField_of_functionField
    [IsIntegral S] [IsIntegral T]
    (q : T ⟶ S) (hq : DenseRange q) :
    letI : Algebra S.functionField T.functionField
proof:
:=
      q.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hq
    FiniteDimensional S.functionField T.functionField →
    letI : Algebra (S.residueField (q (genericPoint T)))
        (T.residueField (genericPoint T)) :=
      (q.residueFieldMap (genericPoint T)).hom.toAlgebra
    FiniteDimensional (S.residueField (q (genericPoint T)))
      (T.residueField (genericPoint T)) := by
  let : Algebra S.functionField T.functionField :=
    q.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hq
  intro hfinite
  let : FiniteDimensional S.functionField T.functionField := hfinite
  let : Algebra (S.residueField (q (genericPoint T)))
      (T.residueField (genericPoint T)) :=
    (q.residueFieldMap (genericPoint T)).hom.toAlgebra
  let hη : genericPoint S = q (genericPoint T) :=
    (q.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hq).symm
  let eS : S.functionField ≃+* S.residueField (q (genericPoint T)) :=
    (Scheme.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv S).trans
      (S.residueFieldCongr hη).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let eT : T.functionField ≃+* T.residueField (genericPoint T) :=
    Scheme.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv T
  apply Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv eS eT
  change RingHom.comp (q.residueFieldMap (genericPoint T)).hom eS.toRingHom =
    RingHom.comp eT.toRingHom (q.functionFieldMap hq)
  have hnat := q.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv_naturality hq
  have hnat' := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hnat
  simpa [eS, eT, hη, Category.assoc, RingHom.comp_assoc] using hnat'

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteDimensional_genericResidueField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_genericResidueField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra (X.residueField (Y.hom (genericPoint Y.left)))
        (Y.left.residueField (genericPoint Y.left)) :=
      (Y.hom.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Y.left)).hom.toAlgebra
    FiniteDimensional (X.residueField (Y.hom (genericPoint Y.left)))
      (Y.left.residueField (genericPoint Y.left)) := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let hY : DenseRange Y.hom :=
    finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  apply Scheme.Hom.finiteDimensional_genericResidueField_of_functionField
    (S := X) (T := Y.left) Y.hom hY
  exact finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.isGalois_of_fiber_iso_quotient_openNormal
statement:
theorem isGalois_of_fiber_iso_quotient_openNormal
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup (Aut F)) (X : C)
    (e : (functorToAction F).obj X ≅
      Aut F ⧸ₐ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))) :
    IsGalois X
proof:
:= by
  let : Fintype (Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  let ef : F.obj X ≅
      FintypeCat.of (Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))) :=
    (forget₂ (Action FintypeCat (Aut F)) FintypeCat).mapIso e
  let : Nonempty (F.obj X) := by
    let q : Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F)) := 1
    exact ⟨ef.inv q⟩
  let : MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F) (F.obj X) := by
    constructor
    intro x y
    let qx : Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F)) := ef.hom x
    let qy : Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F)) := ef.hom y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep qx
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep qy
    refine ⟨b * a⁻¹, ?_⟩
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ef.hom).injective
    have hx : ef.hom ((b * a⁻¹) • x) =
        (b * a⁻¹) • ef.hom x := by
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (e.hom.comm (b * a⁻¹)) x
    rw [hx]
    change (b * a⁻¹) • qx = qy
    rw [← ha, ← hb]
    change (⟦(b * a⁻¹) * a⟧ : Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))) = ⟦b⟧
    rw [inv_mul_cancel_right]
  let : IsConnected X :=
    FiberFunctor.isConnected_of_isPretransitive F X
  apply (isGalois_iff_pretransitive F X).mpr
  constructor
  intro x y
  let qx : Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F)) := ef.hom x
  let qy : Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F)) := ef.hom y
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep qx
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep qy
  let r := quotientRightIso F (U : Subgroup (Aut F)) (b⁻¹ * a)
  let s : (functorToAction F).obj X ≅ (functorToAction F).obj X :=
    e ≪≫ r ≪≫ e.symm
  let φ : X ≅ X := (functorToAction F).preimageIso s
  refine ⟨φ, ?_⟩
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ef.hom).injective
  change ef.hom (F.map φ.hom x) = ef.hom y
  have hmap : (functorToAction F).map φ.hom = s.hom := by
    exact (functorToAction F).map_preimage s.hom
  have happ : F.map φ.hom x = s.hom.hom x := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (congrArg Action.Hom.hom hmap) x
  rw [happ]
  have hs : ef.hom (s.hom.hom x) = r.hom.hom (ef.hom x) := by
    change ef.hom (ef.inv (r.hom.hom (ef.hom x))) =
      r.hom.hom (ef.hom x)
    exact FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ef _
  rw [hs]
  change r.hom.hom qx = qy
  rw [← ha, ← hb]
  change (⟦a * (b⁻¹ * a)⁻¹⟧ :
    Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))) = ⟦b⟧
  rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.exists_galois_object_fiber_iso_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_galois_object_fiber_iso_quotient
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup (Aut F)) :
    ∃ (X : C) (hX : IsGalois X),
      letI
proof:
:= hX
      Nonempty ((functorToAction F).obj X ≅
        Aut F ⧸ₐ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))) := by
  let : Fintype (Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  let V : OpenSubgroup (Aut F) := U.toOpenSubgroup
  obtain ⟨X, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    exists_lift_of_quotient_openSubgroup (F := F) V
  have hX : IsGalois X :=
    isGalois_of_fiber_iso_quotient_openNormal F U X e
  exact ⟨X, hX, ⟨e⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq
statement:
theorem exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup (Aut F)) :
    ∃ (X : C) (_ : IsGalois X) (x : F.obj X),
      MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) x = (U : Subgroup (Aut F))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, hX, he⟩ := exists_galois_object_fiber_iso_quotient F U
  let : IsGalois X := hX
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
  let ef : F.obj X ≅ FintypeCat.of (Aut F ⧸ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))) :=
    (forget₂ (Action FintypeCat (Aut F)) FintypeCat).mapIso e
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (U : Subgroup (Aut F)) (1 : Aut F)
  let x : F.obj X := ef.inv q
  refine ⟨X, hX, x, ?_⟩
  ext g
  change g • x = x ↔ g ∈ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))
  rw [← MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
  rw [← MulAction.stabilizer_quotient (U : Subgroup (Aut F))]
  change g • x = x ↔ g • q = q
  constructor
  · intro hg
    calc
      g • q = g • ef.hom x := by
        rw [FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply]
      _ = ef.hom (g • x) :=
        (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (e.hom.comm g) x).symm
      _ = ef.hom x := congrArg ef.hom.hom hg
      _ = q := FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ef q
  · intro hg
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ef.hom).injective
    calc
      ef.hom (g • x) = g • ef.hom x :=
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (e.hom.comm g) x
      _ = g • q := by rw [FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply]
      _ = q := hg
      _ = ef.hom x := (FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ef q).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_equivariant
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_equivariant
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (W : FiniteEtale Y) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (w : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj W)
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj W)
    (z : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiz : (fiber xi).map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) W w)
    (hZ : IsGalois Z) (hi : Mono i)
    (sigma : (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    sigma.unop.hom ≫ i =
      i ≫ (pullback f).map
        ((galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
          f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi sigma).unop.hom)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let F := fiber (xi ≫ f)
  let F' := fiber xi
  let H := pullback f
  let t := pullbackFiberIso f xi
  let y : F'.obj (H.obj W) := transportedPointOfCompIso H t W w
  let qZ := finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom xi Z hZ z
  let qW := Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism f xi W hW w
  let phi := galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi
  obtain ⟨gamma, rfl⟩ :=
    finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_surjective xi Z hZ z sigma
  have hphi : phi (qZ gamma) = qW gamma :=
    MonoidHom.ext_iff.mp
      (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_comp
        f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi) gamma
  change (qZ gamma).unop.hom ≫ i = i ≫ H.map ((phi (qZ gamma)).unop.hom)
  rw [hphi]
  apply evaluation_injective_of_isConnected F' Z (H.obj W) z
  change F'.map ((qZ gamma).unop.hom ≫ i) z =
    F'.map (i ≫ H.map ((qW gamma).unop.hom)) z
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply,
    FintypeCat.comp_apply]
  have hcomponent : F'.map ((qZ gamma).unop.hom) z = gamma • z :=
    finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_evaluation xi Z hZ z gamma
  rw [hcomponent, ← mulAction_naturality, hiz]
  change gamma • y = F'.map (H.map ((qW gamma).unop.hom)) y
  have hquotient : F.map ((qW gamma).unop.hom) w =
      (fundamentalGroupHom f xi gamma) • w :=
    finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_evaluation
      (xi ≫ f) W hW w (fundamentalGroupHom f xi gamma)
  have haction : (t.inv.app W) ((fundamentalGroupHom f xi gamma) • w) =
      gamma • y := by
    change (t.inv.app W) ((t.hom.app W)
      (gamma.hom.app (H.obj W) ((t.inv.app W) w))) =
        gamma.hom.app (H.obj W) ((t.inv.app W) w)
    exact FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply (t.app W) _
  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (t.inv.naturality ((qW gamma).unop.hom)) w
  change (t.inv.app W) (F.map ((qW gamma).unop.hom) w) =
    F'.map (H.map ((qW gamma).unop.hom)) y at hnat
  rw [hquotient, haction] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquivAtSourceGeneric_naturality
statement:
theorem functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquivAtSourceGeneric_naturality
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Z]
    (g : Z ⟶ X) (hg : DenseRange g) :
    CommRingCat.ofHom
        (g.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquivAtSourceGeneric hg).toRingHom ≫
      g.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z) =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (g.functionFieldMap hg) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Scheme.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv Z).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  have hnat := g.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv_naturality hg
  have hnat' := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hnat
  simpa [functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquivAtSourceGeneric,
    Category.assoc] using DFunLike.congr_fun hnat' a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr
statement:
private theorem eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr
    (T : Scheme.{u}) {x x' : T} (h : x = x') :
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun q ↦ T.presheaf.stalk q) h) =
      (T.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h)).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst x'
  exact (T.presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl x).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv_naturality
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Z]
    (g : Z ⟶ X) (hg : DenseRange g) :
    let hη : genericPoint X = g (genericPoint Z)
proof:
:=
      (g.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hg).symm
    CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Scheme.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv X).toRingHom ≫
      (X.residueFieldCongr hη).hom ≫
      g.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z) =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (g.functionFieldMap hg) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Scheme.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv Z).toRingHom := by
  let hη : genericPoint X = g (genericPoint Z) :=
    (g.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hg).symm
  change CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Scheme.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv X).toRingHom ≫
      (X.residueFieldCongr hη).hom ≫
      g.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z) =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (g.functionFieldMap hg) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Scheme.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv Z).toRingHom
  change X.residue (genericPoint X) ≫
      (X.residueFieldCongr hη).hom ≫
      g.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z) =
    (eqToHom (show X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X) =
        X.presheaf.stalk (g (genericPoint Z)) by rw [hη]) ≫
      g.stalkMap (genericPoint Z)) ≫ Z.residue (genericPoint Z)
  rw [eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr]
  · rw [Scheme.residue_residueFieldCongr_assoc]
    rw [Scheme.residue_residueFieldMap]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
  · exact hη

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq_any_universe
statement:
theorem exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq_any_universe
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup (Aut F)) :
    ∃ (X : C) (_ : IsGalois X) (x : F.obj X),
      MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) x = (U : Subgroup (Aut F))
proof:
:= by
  let F' : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{u₁} := F ⋙ FintypeCat.uSwitch.{w, u₁}
  let : FiberFunctor F' := FiberFunctor.comp_right _
  let eF : Aut F ≃ₜ* Aut F' :=
    autEquivAutWhiskerRight F
      (FintypeCat.uSwitchEquivalence.{w, u₁}).fullyFaithfulFunctor
  let U' : OpenNormalSubgroup (Aut F') :=
    ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.map
      (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom eF)
      (Homeomorph.isOpenMap eF.toHomeomorph) eF.surjective U
  obtain ⟨X, hX, x', hx'⟩ :=
    exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq F' U'
  let eX : F'.obj X ≃ F.obj X := FintypeCat.uSwitchEquiv (F.obj X)
  let x : F.obj X := eX x'
  refine ⟨X, hX, x, ?_⟩
  ext g
  change g • x = x ↔ g ∈ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))
  have htransport : eX ((eF g) • x') = g • eX x' := by
    change (F.obj X).uSwitchEquiv
        (((eF g).hom.app X) x') =
      g.hom.app X ((F.obj X).uSwitchEquiv x')
    change (F.obj X).uSwitchEquiv
        (FintypeCat.uSwitch.map (g.hom.app X) x') =
      g.hom.app X ((F.obj X).uSwitchEquiv x')
    exact (FintypeCat.uSwitchEquiv_naturality (g.hom.app X) x').symm
  calc
    g • x = x ↔ (eF g) • x' = x' := by
      change g • eX x' = eX x' ↔ (eF g) • x' = x'
      rw [← htransport]
      exact eX.injective.eq_iff
    _ ↔ eF g ∈ MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F') x' :=
      MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.symm
    _ ↔ eF g ∈ (U' : Subgroup (Aut F')) := by rw [hx']
    _ ↔ g ∈ (U : Subgroup (Aut F)) := by
      dsimp only [U']
      change eF g ∈
          (U : Subgroup (Aut F)).map eF.toMonoidHom ↔
        g ∈ (U : Subgroup (Aut F))
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, ha, hga⟩
        have : a = g := eF.injective hga
        simpa [this] using ha
      · intro hg
        exact ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.nonempty_openNormalPullbackModel
statement:
theorem nonempty_openNormalPullbackModel
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) :
    Nonempty (OpenNormalPullbackModel f xi U)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, x, Z, i, z, hA, hZ, hi, hsq⟩ :=
    exists_openNormal_galoisPullbackComponent_fundamentalGroup_square f xi U
  dsimp only at hsq
  obtain ⟨eSource, eTarget, hcomm⟩ := hsq
  exact ⟨
    { targetCover := A
      targetPoint := x
      sourceCover := Z
      inclusion := i
      sourcePoint := z
      targetIsGalois := hA
      sourceIsGalois := hZ
      inclusionMono := hi
      sourceEquiv := eSource
      targetEquiv := eTarget
      commutes := hcomm }⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_openNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_pullbackModel_extensions
statement:
theorem
    fundamentalGroupHom_openNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_pullbackModel_extensions
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (extend : ∀ (U : OpenNormalSubgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f))
      (W : FiniteEtale (openNormalPullbackModel f xi U).sourceScheme)
      (_hW : IsGalois W),
      IsMulCommutative (Aut W) →
        Σ Z : FiniteEtale (openNormalPullbackModel f xi U).targetScheme,
          (pullback (openNormalPullbackModel f xi U).hom).obj Z ≅ W) :
    OpenNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel
      (fundamentalGroupHom f xi)
proof:
:= by

    fundamentalGroupHom_openNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_local_extensions
      f xi
      (fun U ↦ (openNormalPullbackModel f xi U).sourceScheme)
      (fun U ↦ (openNormalPullbackModel f xi U).targetScheme)
      (fun U ↦ (openNormalPullbackModel f xi U).hom)

      (fun U ↦ (openNormalPullbackModel f xi U).sourceEquiv)
      (fun U ↦ (openNormalPullbackModel f xi U).targetEquiv)
      (fun U ↦ (openNormalPullbackModel f xi U).commutes)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.isGalois_iff_evaluation_bijective
statement:
@[stacks 03SF "four-way characterization by simply transitive fibers"]
theorem isGalois_iff_evaluation_bijective (X : C) [IsConnected X] (x : F.obj X) :
    IsGalois X ↔ Function.Bijective (fun σ : Aut X ↦ F.map σ.hom x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let : IsGalois X := h
    exact evaluation_aut_bijective_of_isGalois F X x
  · intro h
    rw [isGalois_iff_pretransitive F X, MulAction.isPretransitive_iff_base x]
    exact h.surjective

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.isGalois_iff_card_aut_eq_card_fiber
statement:
@[stacks 03SF "four-way characterization by automorphism cardinality"]
theorem isGalois_iff_card_aut_eq_card_fiber (X : C) [IsConnected X] :
    IsGalois X ↔ Nat.card (Aut X) = Nat.card (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  let x : F.obj X := Classical.choice inferInstance
  constructor
  · intro h
    let : IsGalois X := h
    exact Nat.card_congr (evaluationEquivOfIsGalois F X x)
  · intro h
    apply (isGalois_iff_evaluation_bijective F X x).mpr
    let : Fintype (Aut X) := Fintype.ofFinite (Aut X)
    apply (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card _).mpr
    exact
      ⟨evaluation_aut_injective_of_isConnected F X x,
        by simpa only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using h⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.fiberBinaryProduct_ext
statement:
private lemma fiberBinaryProduct_ext {X Y : C} {a b : F.obj (X ⨯ Y)}
    (hfst : F.map prod.fst a = F.map prod.fst b)
    (hsnd : F.map prod.snd a = F.map prod.snd b) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  let e := fiberBinaryProductEquiv F X Y
  apply e.injective
  apply Prod.ext
  · have ha : F.map prod.fst a = (e a).1 := by
      simpa only [e, Prod.eta, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_fst_apply F (e a).1 (e a).2
    have hb : F.map prod.fst b = (e b).1 := by
      simpa only [e, Prod.eta, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_fst_apply F (e b).1 (e b).2
    exact ha.symm.trans (hfst.trans hb)
  · have ha : F.map prod.snd a = (e a).2 := by
      simpa only [e, Prod.eta, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_snd_apply F (e a).1 (e a).2
    have hb : F.map prod.snd b = (e b).2 := by
      simpa only [e, Prod.eta, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_snd_apply F (e b).1 (e b).2
    exact ha.symm.trans (hsnd.trans hb)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.isGalois_of_mono_to_binaryProduct
statement:
@[stacks 03SF "connected components of products of Galois covers are Galois"]
theorem isGalois_of_mono_to_binaryProduct {X Y Z : C}
    [IsGalois X] [IsGalois Y] [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ X ⨯ Y) [Mono i] :
    IsGalois Z
proof:
:= by
  let F := CategoryTheory.GaloisCategory.getFiberFunctor C
  apply (isGalois_iff_pretransitive F Z).mpr
  constructor
  intro a b
  obtain ⟨σX, hσX⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq (Aut X)
    (F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) a) (F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) b)
  obtain ⟨σY, hσY⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq (Aut Y)
    (F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) a) (F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) b)
  change F.map σX.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) a) = F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) b at hσX
  change F.map σY.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) a) = F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) b at hσY
  let τ : X ⨯ Y ≅ X ⨯ Y := prod.mapIso σX σY
  have hfst :
      F.map prod.fst (F.map (i ≫ τ.hom) a) =
        F.map prod.fst (F.map i b) := by
    calc
      _ = F.map σX.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) a) := by
        simp only [← FintypeCat.comp_apply, ← F.map_comp]
        exact congrArg (fun f : Z ⟶ X => F.map f a) (by simp [τ, prod.mapIso])
      _ = F.map (i ≫ prod.fst) b := hσX
      _ = F.map prod.fst (F.map i b) := by
        simp only [F.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
  have hsnd :
      F.map prod.snd (F.map (i ≫ τ.hom) a) =
        F.map prod.snd (F.map i b) := by
    calc
      _ = F.map σY.hom (F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) a) := by
        simp only [← FintypeCat.comp_apply, ← F.map_comp]
        exact congrArg (fun f : Z ⟶ Y => F.map f a) (by simp [τ, prod.mapIso])
      _ = F.map (i ≫ prod.snd) b := hσY
      _ = F.map prod.snd (F.map i b) := by
        simp only [F.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := connected_component_unique F a b (i ≫ τ.hom) i
    (fiberBinaryProduct_ext F hfst hsnd)
  exact ⟨σ, hσ⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autMapHom_prod_injective_of_mono
statement:
@[stacks 03SF "the common Galois group embeds in the product"]
theorem autMapHom_prod_injective_of_mono {X Y Z : C}
    [IsGalois X] [IsGalois Y] [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ X ⨯ Y) [Mono i] :
    Function.Injective
      (MonoidHom.prod (autMapHom (i ≫ prod.fst)) (autMapHom (i ≫ prod.snd)))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ τ hστ
  have hfst : autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) τ := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Aut X × Aut Y ↦ p.1) hστ
    change autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) τ at h
    exact h
  have hsnd : autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) τ := by
    have h := congrArg (fun p : Aut X × Aut Y ↦ p.2) hστ
    change autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) σ = autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) τ at h
    exact h
  apply Aut.ext
  rw [← cancel_mono i]
  apply prod.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) σ, ← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.fst) τ, hfst]
  · simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) σ, ← comp_autMap (i ≫ prod.snd) τ, hsnd]

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.exists_common_galois_cover
statement:
@[stacks 03SF "common domination of two Galois covers"]
theorem exists_common_galois_cover (X Y : C) [IsGalois X] [IsGalois Y] :
    ∃ (Z : C) (hZ : IsGalois Z),
      letI
proof:
:= hZ
      ∃ (f : Z ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y),
        Function.Injective (MonoidHom.prod (autMapHom f) (autMapHom g)) := by
  let F := CategoryTheory.GaloisCategory.getFiberFunctor C
  let x : F.obj X := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let y : F.obj Y := Classical.choice inferInstance
  obtain ⟨Z, i, _, _, hZ, hi⟩ := fiber_in_connected_component F (X ⨯ Y)
    ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F X Y).symm (x, y))
  let : IsConnected Z := hZ
  let : Mono i := hi
  have hGalois : IsGalois Z := isGalois_of_mono_to_binaryProduct i
  let : IsGalois Z := hGalois
  exact ⟨Z, hGalois, i ≫ prod.fst, i ≫ prod.snd,
    autMapHom_prod_injective_of_mono i⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.natCard_left_eq_finrank
statement:
@[stacks 03SF "geometric-fiber cardinality equals degree"]
theorem natCard_left_eq_finrank (X : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of Ω))) :
    Nat.card X.left = X.hom.finrank (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)
proof:
:= by
  change Nat.card X.left =
    (X.left ↘ Spec (.of Ω)).finrank (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)
  rw [← IsFiniteEtale.isoSpecFun_hom_SpecMap Ω X.left,
    Scheme.Hom.finrank_comp_left_of_isIso,
    Scheme.Hom.finrank_SpecMap_algebraMap]
  simp only [Module.rankAtStalk_eq_finrank_of_free, Pi.natCast_apply, Nat.cast_id,
    Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.natCard_fiber_eq_finrank
statement:
@[stacks 03SF "geometric-fiber cardinality equals degree"]
theorem natCard_fiber_eq_finrank (X : FiniteEtale S) :
    Nat.card ((fiber ξ).obj X) =
      X.hom.finrank (ξ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))
proof:
:= by
  let : Limits.HasPullback X.hom ξ := inferInstance
  let Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of Ω)) :=
    FiniteEtale.mk (Limits.pullback.snd X.hom ξ)
  change Nat.card Y.left = X.hom.finrank (ξ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))
  calc
    Nat.card Y.left =
        Y.hom.finrank (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) :=
      natCard_left_eq_finrank Y
    _ = X.hom.finrank (ξ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) :=
      Scheme.Hom.finrank_of_isPullback
        (Limits.pullback.fst X.hom ξ) Y.hom X.hom ξ
        (by
          change IsPullback (Limits.pullback.fst X.hom ξ)
            (Limits.pullback.snd X.hom ξ) X.hom ξ
          exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback X.hom ξ)
        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isGalois_iff_card_aut_eq_finrank
statement:
@[stacks 03SF "four-way characterization by automorphism cardinality and degree"]
theorem isGalois_iff_card_aut_eq_finrank
    (X : FiniteEtale S) [PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected X] :
    PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois X ↔
      Nat.card (Aut X) = X.hom.finrank (ξ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))
proof:
:= by
  rw [PreGaloisCategory.isGalois_iff_card_aut_eq_card_fiber (fiber ξ) X,
    natCard_fiber_eq_finrank ξ X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isGalois_iff_isConnected_and_card_aut_eq_finrank
statement:
@[stacks 03SF "four-way characterization by connectedness and degree"]
theorem isGalois_iff_isConnected_and_card_aut_eq_finrank (X : FiniteEtale S) :
    PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois X ↔
      PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected X ∧
        Nat.card (Aut X) = X.hom.finrank (ξ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let : PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois X := h
    exact ⟨inferInstance, (isGalois_iff_card_aut_eq_finrank ξ X).mp h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hX, h⟩
    let : PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected X := hX
    exact (isGalois_iff_card_aut_eq_finrank ξ X).mpr h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.functionFieldProductMap_surjective_of_pullback_generic_residue
statement:
theorem functionFieldProductMap_surjective_of_pullback_generic_residue
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral S] [IsIntegral Z]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    (i : Z ⟶ pullback g f) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hX : DenseRange (i ≫ pullback.snd g f))
    (hY : DenseRange (i ≫ pullback.fst g f))
    [Algebra S.functionField X.functionField]
    [Algebra S.functionField Y.functionField]
    [Algebra S.functionField Z.functionField]
    (fX : X.functionField →ₐ[S.functionField] Z.functionField)
    (fY : Y.functionField →ₐ[S.functionField] Z.functionField)
    (hfX : fX.toRingHom =
      (i ≫ pullback.snd g f).functionFieldMap hX)
    (hfY : fY.toRingHom =
      (i ≫ pullback.fst g f).functionFieldMap hY)
    (hTensorSurjective :
      let t : ↑(pullback g f) := i (genericPoint Z)
      let T := Triplet.ofPoint t
      letI : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (Y.residueField T.x) :=
        (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hx).inv ≫
          g.residueFieldMap T.x).hom).toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (X.residueField T.y) :=
        (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hy).inv ≫
          f.residueFieldMap T.y).hom).toAlgebra
      Function.Surjective (tensorProductToResidueField t)) :
    Function.Surjective (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap fX fY)
proof:
:= by
  let xMap : Z ⟶ X := i ≫ pullback.snd g f
  let yMap : Z ⟶ Y := i ≫ pullback.fst g f
  let t : ↑(pullback g f) := i (genericPoint Z)
  let T := Triplet.ofPoint t
  let : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (Y.residueField T.x) :=
    (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hx).inv ≫
      g.residueFieldMap T.x).hom).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (X.residueField T.y) :=
    (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hy).inv ≫
      f.residueFieldMap T.y).hom).toAlgebra
  let eXAt : X.functionField ≃+* X.residueField T.y := by
    change X.functionField ≃+*
      X.residueField (xMap (genericPoint Z))
    exact xMap.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquivAtSourceGeneric hX
  let eYAt : Y.functionField ≃+* Y.residueField T.x := by
    change Y.functionField ≃+*
      Y.residueField (yMap (genericPoint Z))
    exact yMap.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquivAtSourceGeneric hY
  let eZ := Scheme.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv Z
  let eI : (pullback g f).residueField t ≃+*
      Z.residueField (genericPoint Z) := by
    change (pullback g f).residueField (i (genericPoint Z)) ≃+*
      Z.residueField (genericPoint Z)
    exact i.residueFieldRingEquivOfIsClosedImmersion (genericPoint Z)
  let eTarget : (pullback g f).residueField t ≃+* Z.functionField :=
    eI.trans eZ.symm
  let iResidue := i.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z)
  let fstResidue := (pullback.fst g f).residueFieldMap t
  let sndResidue := (pullback.snd g f).residueFieldMap t
  have hyResidue :
      (yMap.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z)).hom =
        iResidue.hom.comp fstResidue.hom := by
    have h := Scheme.residueFieldMap_comp
      (f := i) (g := pullback.fst g f) (genericPoint Z)
    change yMap.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z) =
      fstResidue ≫ iResidue at h
    exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom h
  have hxResidue :
      (xMap.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z)).hom =
        iResidue.hom.comp sndResidue.hom := by
    have h := Scheme.residueFieldMap_comp
      (f := i) (g := pullback.snd g f) (genericPoint Z)
    change xMap.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z) =
      sndResidue ≫ iResidue at h
    exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom h
  have hYFactor (y : Y.functionField) :
      eTarget (fstResidue (eYAt y)) = fY y := by
    have hn := yMap.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquivAtSourceGeneric_naturality hY
    have hn' := DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hn) y
    change (yMap.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z)).hom (eYAt y) =
      eZ (yMap.functionFieldMap hY y) at hn'
    rw [hyResidue] at hn'
    change eZ.symm (iResidue (fstResidue (eYAt y))) = fY y
    apply eZ.injective
    rw [eZ.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hn'.trans
      (congrArg eZ (DFunLike.congr_fun hfY.symm y))
  have hXFactor (x : X.functionField) :
      eTarget (sndResidue (eXAt x)) = fX x := by
    have hn := xMap.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquivAtSourceGeneric_naturality hX
    have hn' := DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hn) x
    change (xMap.residueFieldMap (genericPoint Z)).hom (eXAt x) =
      eZ (xMap.functionFieldMap hX x) at hn'
    rw [hxResidue] at hn'
    change eZ.symm (iResidue (sndResidue (eXAt x))) = fX x
    apply eZ.injective
    rw [eZ.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hn'.trans
      (congrArg eZ (DFunLike.congr_fun hfX.symm x))
  have hTensorLeftApply (y : Y.residueField T.x) :
      tensorProductToResidueField t
          (y ⊗ₜ[S.residueField T.s] (1 : X.residueField T.y)) =
        fstResidue y := by
    have hinc := DFunLike.congr_fun
      (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
        (includeLeft_tensorIsoTensorProduct_inv T)) y
    change (T.tensorIsoTensorProduct).inv
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
        (R := S.residueField T.s) (A := Y.residueField T.x)
        (B := X.residueField T.y)) y) = T.tensorInl y at hinc
    change ofPointTensor t
      ((T.tensorIsoTensorProduct).inv
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
          (R := S.residueField T.s) (A := Y.residueField T.x)
          (B := X.residueField T.y)) y)) = fstResidue y
    rw [hinc]
    have hdesc := DFunLike.congr_fun
      (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
        (pushout.inl_desc
          ((pullback.fst g f).residueFieldMap t)
          ((pullback.snd g f).residueFieldMap t)
          (residueFieldCongr_inv_residueFieldMap_ofPoint t))) y
    change ofPointTensor t (T.tensorInl y) = fstResidue y at hdesc
    exact hdesc
  have hTensorRightApply (x : X.residueField T.y) :
      tensorProductToResidueField t
          ((1 : Y.residueField T.x) ⊗ₜ[S.residueField T.s] x) =
        sndResidue x := by
    have hinc := DFunLike.congr_fun
      (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
        (includeRight_tensorIsoTensorProduct_inv T)) x
    change (T.tensorIsoTensorProduct).inv
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
        (R := S.residueField T.s) (A := Y.residueField T.x)
        (B := X.residueField T.y)) x) = T.tensorInr x at hinc
    change ofPointTensor t
      ((T.tensorIsoTensorProduct).inv
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
          (R := S.residueField T.s) (A := Y.residueField T.x)
          (B := X.residueField T.y)) x)) = sndResidue x
    rw [hinc]
    have hdesc := DFunLike.congr_fun
      (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
        (pushout.inr_desc
          ((pullback.fst g f).residueFieldMap t)
          ((pullback.snd g f).residueFieldMap t)
          (residueFieldCongr_inv_residueFieldMap_ofPoint t))) x
    change ofPointTensor t (T.tensorInr x) = sndResidue x at hdesc
    exact hdesc
  have hTensorPure (y : Y.residueField T.x)
      (x : X.residueField T.y) :
      tensorProductToResidueField t (y ⊗ₜ x) =
        fstResidue y * sndResidue x := by
    rw [show y ⊗ₜ[S.residueField T.s] x =
      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : X.residueField T.y)) *
        ((1 : Y.residueField T.x) ⊗ₜ x) by
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]]
    rw [map_mul, hTensorLeftApply, hTensorRightApply]
  apply
    Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap_surjective_of_surjective_reversed_tensor
      fX fY (tensorProductToResidueField t).hom eXAt eYAt eTarget
      hTensorSurjective
  intro x y
  rw [hTensorPure, map_mul, hYFactor, hXFactor, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_of_denseRange
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_of_denseRange
    {T S R : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral T] [IsIntegral S] [IsIntegral R]
    (f : S ⟶ T) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (g : R ⟶ S) (hg : DenseRange g) :
    let hgf : DenseRange (g ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
      change DenseRange (f.base ∘ g.base)
      exact hf.comp hg f.continuous
    (g.functionFieldMap hg).comp (f.functionFieldMap hf) =
      (g ≫ f).functionFieldMap hgf := by
  let hgf : DenseRange (g ≫ f) := by
    change DenseRange (f.base ∘ g.base)
    exact hf.comp hg f.continuous
  change (g.functionFieldMap hg).comp (f.functionFieldMap hf) =
    (g ≫ f).functionFieldMap hgf
  let hfgeneric : f (genericPoint S) = genericPoint T :=
    f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hf
  let hggeneric : g (genericPoint R) = genericPoint S :=
    g.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hg
  let hgfgeneric : (g ≫ f) (genericPoint R) = genericPoint T :=
    (g ≫ f).map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hgf
  unfold Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap
  rw [eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr T hfgeneric.symm,
    eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr S hggeneric.symm,
    eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr T hgfgeneric.symm]
  rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_point_assoc f
      (genericPoint S) (g (genericPoint R)) hggeneric.symm]
  simp only [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom]
  have hstalk := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp_assoc T.presheaf
    (specializes_of_eq (congrArg (fun z : S => f z) hggeneric))
    (specializes_of_eq hfgeneric)
    (f.stalkMap (g (genericPoint R)) ≫ g.stalkMap (genericPoint R))
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (hstalk.trans (congrArg
      (fun k : T.presheaf.stalk (f (g (genericPoint R))) ⟶
          R.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint R) =>
        T.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hgfgeneric) ≫ k)
      (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp g f (genericPoint R)).symm))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackComponentToOriginal_comp
statement:
theorem pullbackComponentToOriginal_comp
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : FiniteEtale Y)
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W) :
    pullbackComponentToOriginal f W Z i ≫ W.hom = Z.hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  exact (Category.assoc i.left (Limits.pullback.fst W.hom f) W.hom).trans
    ((congrArg (fun k : Limits.pullback W.hom f ⟶ Y => i.left ≫ k)
      (Limits.pullback.condition (f := W.hom) (g := f))).trans
      ((Category.assoc i.left (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom f) f).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun k : Z.left ⟶ X => k ≫ f) i.w)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackComponentToOriginal_denseRange
statement:
theorem pullbackComponentToOriginal_denseRange
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsIntegral Y] [IsNormalIntegral Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (W : FiniteEtale Y) [IsConnected W]
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W) :
    DenseRange (pullbackComponentToOriginal f W Z i)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : IsIntegral Z.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  let g : Z.left ⟶ W.left := pullbackComponentToOriginal f W Z i
  let zHom : Z.left ⟶ X := Z.hom
  let wHom : W.left ⟶ Y := W.hom
  have hZ : DenseRange zHom := by
    let : IsFiniteEtale zHom := by
      simpa only [zHom] using Z.2
    let : Surjective zHom := IsFiniteEtale.surjective zHom
    exact zHom.surjective.denseRange
  have hW : DenseRange wHom := by
    let : IsFiniteEtale wHom := by
      simpa only [wHom] using W.2
    let : Surjective wHom := IsFiniteEtale.surjective wHom
    exact wHom.surjective.denseRange
  have hZf : DenseRange (zHom ≫ f) := by
    change DenseRange (f.base ∘ zHom.base)
    exact hf.comp hZ f.continuous
  have hgW : g ≫ wHom = zHom ≫ f := by
    simpa only [zHom, wHom] using pullbackComponentToOriginal_comp f W Z i
  have hsource :
      wHom (g (genericPoint Z.left)) = genericPoint Y := by
    change (g ≫ wHom) (genericPoint Z.left) = genericPoint Y
    rw [hgW]
    exact (zHom ≫ f).map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hZf
  have htarget : wHom (genericPoint W.left) = genericPoint Y :=
    wHom.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hW
  have hgeneric : g (genericPoint Z.left) = genericPoint W.left := by
    symm
    apply (wHom.isDiscrete_preimage_singleton
      (genericPoint Y)).eq_of_specializes
      (genericPoint_specializes (g (genericPoint Z.left)))
    · exact htarget
    · exact hsource
  rw [DenseRange, dense_iff_closure_eq]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.subset_univ _)
  rw [← (genericPoint_spec W.left).def]
  apply closure_mono
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with rfl
  exact ⟨genericPoint Z.left, hgeneric⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackComponentToOriginal_map_genericPoint
statement:
theorem pullbackComponentToOriginal_map_genericPoint
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsIntegral Y] [IsNormalIntegral Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (W : FiniteEtale Y) [IsConnected W]
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W) :
    letI : IsIntegral W.left
proof:
:=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : IsIntegral Z.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
    pullbackComponentToOriginal f W Z i (genericPoint Z.left) =
      genericPoint W.left := by
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : IsIntegral Z.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  exact (pullbackComponentToOriginal f W Z i).map_genericPoint_of_denseRange
    (pullbackComponentToOriginal_denseRange f hf W Z i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackComponent_functionFieldMap_compatibility
statement:
theorem pullbackComponent_functionFieldMap_compatibility
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsIntegral Y] [IsNormalIntegral Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (W : FiniteEtale Y) [IsConnected W]
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W) :
    letI : IsIntegral W.left
proof:
:=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : IsIntegral Z.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
    let g := pullbackComponentToOriginal f W Z i
    let hg := pullbackComponentToOriginal_denseRange f hf W Z i
    letI : Algebra Y.functionField X.functionField :=
      f.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hf
    letI : Algebra Y.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Z
    letI : Algebra W.left.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
      g.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hg
    (algebraMap W.left.functionField Z.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap Y.functionField W.left.functionField) =
      (algebraMap X.functionField Z.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap Y.functionField X.functionField) := by
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : IsIntegral Z.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  let g := pullbackComponentToOriginal f W Z i
  let hg := pullbackComponentToOriginal_denseRange f hf W Z i
  let hW := EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected W
  let hZ := EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Z
  let hWY : IsIntegral ((Functor.fromPUnit Y).obj W.right) := by
    change IsIntegral Y
    infer_instance
  let hZX : IsIntegral ((Functor.fromPUnit X).obj Z.right) := by
    change IsIntegral X
    infer_instance
  let hWW : IsIntegral ((Functor.id Scheme).obj W.left) := by
    change IsIntegral W.left
    infer_instance
  let hZZ : IsIntegral ((Functor.id Scheme).obj Z.left) := by
    change IsIntegral Z.left
    infer_instance
  let : Algebra Y.functionField X.functionField :=
    f.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hf
  let : Algebra Y.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra X.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Z
  let : Algebra W.left.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
    g.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hg
  change
    (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap W.left Z.left g inferInstance
      inferInstance hg).comp
      (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap
        ((Functor.fromPUnit Y).obj W.right)
        ((Functor.id Scheme).obj W.left) W.hom hWY hWW hW) =
    (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap
      ((Functor.fromPUnit X).obj Z.right)
      ((Functor.id Scheme).obj Z.left) Z.hom hZX hZZ hZ).comp
      (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap Y X f inferInstance inferInstance hf)
  let hgW : DenseRange (g ≫ W.hom) := by
    change DenseRange (W.hom.base ∘ g.base)
    exact hW.comp hg W.hom.continuous
  let hZf : DenseRange (Z.hom ≫ f) := by
    change DenseRange (f.base ∘ Z.hom.base)
    exact hf.comp hZ f.continuous
  calc
    _ = (g ≫ W.hom).functionFieldMap hgW := by
      simpa only [hgW] using
        Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_of_denseRange W.hom hW g hg
    _ = (Z.hom ≫ f).functionFieldMap hZf := by
      exact functionFieldMap_eq_of_eq _ _
        (pullbackComponentToOriginal_comp f W Z i) _ _
    _ = _ := by
      symm
      simpa only [hZf] using
        Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_of_denseRange f hf Z.hom hZ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackComponentFunctionFieldProductMap_surjective
statement:
theorem pullbackComponentFunctionFieldProductMap_surjective
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsIntegral Y] [IsNormalIntegral Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (W : FiniteEtale Y) [IsConnected W]
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W) [Mono i] :
    letI : IsIntegral W.left
proof:
:=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : IsIntegral Z.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
    let g := pullbackComponentToOriginal f W Z i
    let hg := pullbackComponentToOriginal_denseRange f hf W Z i
    letI : Algebra Y.functionField X.functionField :=
      f.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hf
    letI : Algebra Y.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Z
    letI : Algebra W.left.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
      g.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hg
    letI : Algebra Y.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap X.functionField Z.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap Y.functionField X.functionField)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower Y.functionField X.functionField
        Z.left.functionField := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    letI : IsScalarTower Y.functionField W.left.functionField
        Z.left.functionField := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      (pullbackComponent_functionFieldMap_compatibility f hf W Z i).symm
    Function.Surjective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom Y.functionField X.functionField
          Z.left.functionField)
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom Y.functionField W.left.functionField
          Z.left.functionField)) := by
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : IsIntegral Z.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  let g := pullbackComponentToOriginal f W Z i
  let hg := pullbackComponentToOriginal_denseRange f hf W Z i
  let : Algebra Y.functionField X.functionField :=
    f.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hf
  let : Algebra Y.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra X.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Z
  let : Algebra W.left.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
    g.functionFieldAlgebraOfDenseRange hg
  let : Algebra Y.functionField Z.left.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap X.functionField Z.left.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap Y.functionField X.functionField)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower Y.functionField X.functionField
      Z.left.functionField := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower Y.functionField W.left.functionField
      Z.left.functionField := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    (pullbackComponent_functionFieldMap_compatibility f hf W Z i).symm
  obtain ⟨_, hiClosed⟩ :=
    (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.mono_iff X Z
      ((FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W) i).mp (inferInstance : Mono i)
  let : IsClosedImmersion i.left := hiClosed
  let z' : Z.left ⟶ X := i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd W.hom f
  have hz'eq : z' = Z.hom := by
    change i.left ≫ ((FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W).hom = Z.hom
    exact i.w
  let zHom : Z.left ⟶ X := Z.hom
  let hZ : DenseRange zHom := by
    change DenseRange Z.hom
    exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Z
  let hz' : DenseRange z' := by
    rw [hz'eq]
    exact hZ
  have hz'Map : z'.functionFieldMap hz' =
      algebraMap X.functionField Z.left.functionField := by
    change z'.functionFieldMap hz' = zHom.functionFieldMap hZ
    exact functionFieldMap_eq_of_eq z' zHom hz'eq hz' hZ
  let t : ((FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W).left :=
    i.left (genericPoint Z.left)
  let T := Scheme.Pullback.Triplet.ofPoint t
  let : IsArtinianRing T.tensor := by
    simpa only [T, t] using
      pullbackComponent_genericPoint_tensor_isArtinian f hf W Z i
  have hTensorSurjective : Function.Surjective
      (Scheme.Pullback.tensorProductToResidueField t) :=
    Scheme.Pullback.tensorProductToResidueField_surjective_of_isArtinian t
  refine
    @Scheme.Pullback.functionFieldProductMap_surjective_of_pullback_generic_residue
      X W.left Y Z.left
      (inferInstance : IsIntegral X) (inferInstance : IsIntegral W.left)
      (inferInstance : IsIntegral Y) (inferInstance : IsIntegral Z.left)
      f W.hom i.left hiClosed hz' hg
      (inferInstance : Algebra Y.functionField X.functionField)
      (inferInstance : Algebra Y.functionField W.left.functionField)
      (inferInstance : Algebra Y.functionField Z.left.functionField)
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom Y.functionField X.functionField
        Z.left.functionField)
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom Y.functionField W.left.functionField
        Z.left.functionField) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · change algebraMap X.functionField Z.left.functionField =
      z'.functionFieldMap hz'
    exact hz'Map.symm
  · change algebraMap W.left.functionField Z.left.functionField =
      g.functionFieldMap hg
    rfl
  · exact hTensorSurjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom_apply
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] (σ : (Aut Y)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom Y σ =
      finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ.unop := by
  unfold finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom_injective
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom_injective
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    Function.Injective (finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom Y) := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : FiniteDimensional X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  intro σ τ h
  apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
  apply finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_injective Y
  simpa only [finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom_apply] using h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.natCard_finiteEtaleAut_eq_finrank_functionField_of_isGalois
statement:
theorem natCard_finiteEtaleAut_eq_finrank_functionField_of_isGalois
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : IsGalois Y) :
    letI : IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    Nat.card (Aut Y) =
      Module.finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField := by
  let : IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : FiniteDimensional X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure X.functionField
  let ξ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X := X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω
  let F := AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiber ξ
  let a : F.obj Y := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let e : F.obj Y ≃
      (Y.left.functionField →ₐ[X.functionField] Ω) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberObjEquivHom ξ Y).trans
      (finiteEtaleGenericHomEquivFunctionFieldAlgHom (Ω := Ω) Y)
  calc
    Nat.card (Aut Y) = Nat.card (F.obj Y) :=
      Nat.card_congr (evaluationEquivOfIsGalois F Y a)
    _ = Nat.card
        (Y.left.functionField →ₐ[X.functionField] Ω) := Nat.card_congr e
    _ = Module.finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      AlgHom.natCard_of_splits X.functionField Y.left.functionField Ω
        (fun _ ↦ IsAlgClosed.splits _)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom_surjective
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom_surjective
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : IsGalois Y) :
    letI : IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    Function.Surjective (finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom Y) := by
  let : IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : FiniteDimensional X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : _root_.IsGalois X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Y hY
  have hcardAut :=
    natCard_finiteEtaleAut_eq_finrank_functionField_of_isGalois Y hY
  have hcardDomain : Nat.card ((Aut Y)ᵐᵒᵖ) =
      Module.finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr MulOpposite.opEquiv.symm]
    exact hcardAut
  have hcardCodomain : Nat.card
      (Y.left.functionField ≃ₐ[X.functionField] Y.left.functionField) =
      Module.finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    _root_.IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank
      X.functionField Y.left.functionField
  exact ((finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom_injective Y).bijective_of_nat_card_le
    (by rw [hcardDomain, hcardCodomain])).surjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMulEquiv_apply
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
