proof:
:= hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMulEquiv Y hY σ =
      finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ.unop := by
  change finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom Y σ = _
  exact finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMonoidHom_apply Y σ

name: ProCGroups.ProC.finiteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_continuousMulEquiv
statement:
theorem finiteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_continuousMulEquiv
    {G Q G' Q' : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [TopologicalSpace Q] [Group Q] [IsTopologicalGroup Q]
    [TopologicalSpace G'] [Group G'] [IsTopologicalGroup G']
    [TopologicalSpace Q'] [Group Q'] [IsTopologicalGroup Q']
    (f : G →ₜ* Q) (f' : G' →ₜ* Q')
    (eG : G' ≃ₜ* G) (eQ : Q' ≃ₜ* Q)
    (hcomm : ∀ x, eQ (f' x) = f (eG x))
    (hkill : FiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel f') :
    FiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel f
proof:
:= by
  intro A _hAfinite _hAtopology _hAcomm _hAdiscrete phi x hx
  let phi' : G' →ₜ* A :=
    phi.comp (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom eG)
  have hx' : eG.symm x ∈ f'.ker := by
    apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
    apply eQ.injective
    change eQ (f' (eG.symm x)) = eQ 1
    calc
      eQ (f' (eG.symm x)) = f (eG (eG.symm x)) := hcomm _
      _ = f x := congrArg f (eG.apply_symm_apply x)
      _ = 1 := MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hx
      _ = eQ 1 := (map_one eQ).symm
  have hphi' : eG.symm x ∈ phi'.ker := hkill A phi' hx'
  apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
  change phi x = 1
  have hphiEq := MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hphi'
  change phi (eG (eG.symm x)) = 1 at hphiEq
  simpa only [eG.apply_symm_apply] using hphiEq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_openNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_local_extensions
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_openNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_local_extensions
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (X' Y' : OpenNormalSubgroup (π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) → Scheme.{u})
    [∀ H, ConnectedSpace (X' H)] [∀ H, ConnectedSpace (Y' H)]
    (g : ∀ H, X' H ⟶ Y' H)
    (xi' : ∀ H, Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X' H)
    (eSource : ∀ H,
      π₁ᵉᵗ(xi' H) ≃ₜ*
        ProCGroups.OpenNormalSubgroup.comap
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).continuous_toFun H)
    (eTarget : ∀ H, π₁ᵉᵗ(xi' H ≫ g H) ≃ₜ* H)
    (hcomm : ∀ H a,
      eTarget H (fundamentalGroupHom (g H) (xi' H) a) =
        ProCGroups.ContinuousMonoidHom.restrictPreimage
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi) (H : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f))
          (eSource H a))
    (extend : ∀ H (W : FiniteEtale (X' H)) (_hW : IsGalois W),
      IsMulCommutative (Aut W) →
        Σ Z : FiniteEtale (Y' H), (pullback (g H)).obj Z ≅ W) :
    OpenNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel
      (fundamentalGroupHom f xi)
proof:
:= by
  intro H
  let fH := ProCGroups.ContinuousMonoidHom.restrictPreimage
    (fundamentalGroupHom f xi) (H : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f))
  let gH := fundamentalGroupHom (g H) (xi' H)
  have hkill : ProCGroups.ProC.FiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel gH :=
    fundamentalGroupHom_finiteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_galoisCover_extensions
      (g H) (xi' H) (extend H)
  exact ProCGroups.ProC.finiteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_continuousMulEquiv
    fH gH (eSource H) (eTarget H) (hcomm H) hkill

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_kernel_fixed_of_obj_iso
statement:
theorem autHomOfCompIso_kernel_fixed_of_obj_iso
    (H : C ⥤ C') (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
    (X : C) (X' : C') (e : H.obj X ≅ X')
    (a : Aut F') (ha : autHomOfCompIso H t a = 1)
    (x : F'.obj X') :
    a • x = x
proof:
:= by
  let s := (functorToContActionCompIso H t).app X
  let ef := F'.mapIso e
  let y : F'.obj (H.obj X) := ef.inv x
  have heq := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (s.hom.hom.comm a) y
  change (t.app X).hom (a • y) =
    autHomOfCompIso H t a • (t.app X).hom y at heq
  rw [ha, one_smul] at heq
  have hy : a • y = y := by
    exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (t.app X).hom).injective heq
  have hxy : ef.hom y = x := FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ef x
  calc
    a • x = a • ef.hom y := congrArg (a • ·) hxy.symm
    _ = ef.hom (a • y) := by
      change a • F'.map e.hom y = F'.map e.hom (a • y)
      exact mulAction_naturality F' a e.hom y
    _ = ef.hom y := congrArg ef.hom hy
    _ = x := hxy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_abelianGaloisCover_quotient_ker_eq
statement:
theorem exists_abelianGaloisCover_quotient_ker_eq
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : Type v) [Finite A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    [CommGroup A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    (phi : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) →ₜ* A) :
    ∃ (W : FiniteEtale X) (hW : IsGalois W)
      (w : (fiber xi).obj W),
      letI : IsGalois W
proof:
:= hW
      IsMulCommutative (Aut W) ∧
        (EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
          xi W hW w).ker = phi.ker := by
  let U : OpenNormalSubgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) :=
    ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.ker phi
  obtain ⟨W, hW, w, hw⟩ :=
    exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq_any_universe
      (C := FiniteEtale X) (fiber xi) U
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  let q :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
      xi W hW w
  have hqker : q.ker = phi.ker := by
    calc
      q.ker = MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) w :=
        EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_ker
          xi W hW w
      _ = (U : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) := hw
      _ = phi.ker := rfl
  have hqsurj : Function.Surjective q :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_surjective
      xi W hW w
  have hcomm : IsMulCommutative (Aut W) :=
    IsMulCommutative.of_comm fun sigma tau ↦ by
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hqsurj (MulOpposite.op sigma)
      obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hqsurj (MulOpposite.op tau)
      have hphi : phi (g * h) = phi (h * g) := by
        simp only [map_mul]
        exact mul_comm _ _
      have hdiffPhi : g * h * (h * g)⁻¹ ∈ phi.ker := by
        apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
        change phi.toMonoidHom (g * h) =
          phi.toMonoidHom (h * g) at hphi
        rw [map_mul, map_inv, hphi, mul_inv_cancel]
      have hdiffQ : g * h * (h * g)⁻¹ ∈ q.ker := by
        rw [hqker]
        exact hdiffPhi
      have hqeq : q (g * h) = q (h * g) := by
        rw [← mul_inv_eq_one]
        rw [← map_inv, ← map_mul]
        exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hdiffQ
      rw [map_mul, hg, hh, map_mul, hh, hg] at hqeq
      have hunop := congrArg MulOpposite.unop hqeq
      exact hunop.symm
  exact ⟨W, hW, w, hcomm, hqker⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_ker_le_finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotient_ker_of_pullback_iso
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_ker_le_finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotient_ker_of_pullback_iso
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (W : FiniteEtale X) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (w : (fiber xi).obj W)
    (Z : FiniteEtale Y) (e : (pullback f).obj Z ≅ W) :
    (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).ker ≤
      (EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
        xi W hW w).ker
proof:
:= by
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  rw [EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_ker]
  intro a ha
  change a • w = w
  exact autHomOfCompIso_kernel_fixed_of_obj_iso
    (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) Z W e a
      (MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp ha) w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_injective_of_galoisCover_extensions
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_injective_of_galoisCover_extensions
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (extend : ∀ (W : FiniteEtale X) (_hW : IsGalois W),
      Σ Z : FiniteEtale Y, (pullback f).obj Z ≅ W) :
    Function.Injective (fundamentalGroupHom f xi)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have hker : a * b⁻¹ ∈ (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).ker := by
    apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
    change (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom a =
      (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom b at hab
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, hab, mul_inv_cancel]
  have hone : a * b⁻¹ = 1 := by
    apply ProCGroups.ProfiniteGrp.eq_one_of_mem_all_openNormalSubgroups
    intro U
    obtain ⟨W, hW, w, hw⟩ :=
      exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq_any_universe
        (fiber xi) U
    let : IsGalois W := hW
    obtain ⟨Z, e⟩ := extend W hW
    have hle : (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).ker ≤
        (EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
          xi W hW w).ker :=
      fundamentalGroupHom_ker_le_finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotient_ker_of_pullback_iso
        f xi W hW w Z e
    rw [← hw, ←
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_ker
        xi W hW w]
    exact hle hker
  have hmul := congrArg (fun z ↦ z * b) hone
  simpa [mul_assoc] using hmul

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_finiteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_galoisCover_extensions
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_finiteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_galoisCover_extensions
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (extend : ∀ (W : FiniteEtale X) (_hW : IsGalois W),
      IsMulCommutative (Aut W) →
        Σ Z : FiniteEtale Y, (pullback f).obj Z ≅ W) :
    ProCGroups.ProC.FiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel
      (fundamentalGroupHom f xi)
proof:
:= by
  intro A _hAfinite _hAtopology _hAcomm _hAdiscrete phi
  obtain ⟨W, hW, w, hWcomm, hker⟩ :=
    exists_abelianGaloisCover_quotient_ker_eq xi A phi
  obtain ⟨Z, e⟩ := extend W hW hWcomm
  calc
    (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).ker ≤
        (EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
          xi W hW w).ker :=
      fundamentalGroupHom_ker_le_finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotient_ker_of_pullback_iso
        f xi W hW w Z e
    _ = phi.ker := hker

statement:
private theorem fundamentalGroupHom_transport_source

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_fundamentalGroup_square_of_galoisPullbackComponent
statement:
theorem exists_fundamentalGroup_square_of_galoisPullbackComponent
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (hA : IsGalois A)
    (x : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj A)
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj A)
    (z : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiz : (fiber xi).map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x)
    (hi : Mono i) :
    let xiZ
proof:
:= (fiberObjEquivHom xi Z z).left
    let g := i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f
    ∃ (eSource : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ) ≃ₜ*
        (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom)
      (eTarget : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ ≫ g) ≃ₜ*
        MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x),
      ∀ a,
        eTarget (fundamentalGroupHom g xiZ a) =
          ProCGroups.ContinuousMonoidHom.restrictPreimage
            (fundamentalGroupHom f xi)
            (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x) (eSource a) := by
  dsimp only
  let : Mono i := hi
  let : IsGalois A := hA
  let y : (fiber xi).obj ((pullback f).obj A) :=
    transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x
  let xiZ : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ Z.left := (fiberObjEquivHom xi Z z).left
  let g : Z.left ⟶ A.left := i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f
  have hxiZ : xiZ ≫ Z.hom = xi := (fiberObjEquivHom xi Z z).w
  have hi_injective : Function.Injective ((fiber xi).map i) := by
    let : Mono ((fiber xi).map i) := Functor.map_mono (fiber xi) i
    exact ConcreteCategory.injective_of_mono_of_preservesPullback ((fiber xi).map i)
  have hstab_component :
      MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) z =
        MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) y := by
    ext a
    simp only [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    constructor
    · intro ha
      calc
        a • y = a • (fiber xi).map i z :=
          congrArg (fun q ↦ a • q) hiz.symm
        _ = (fiber xi).map i (a • z) :=
          mulAction_naturality (fiber xi) a i z
        _ = (fiber xi).map i z := congrArg ((fiber xi).map i) ha
        _ = y := hiz
    · intro ha
      apply hi_injective
      calc
        (fiber xi).map i (a • z) = a • (fiber xi).map i z :=
          (mulAction_naturality (fiber xi) a i z).symm
        _ = a • y := congrArg (fun q ↦ a • q) hiz
        _ = y := ha
        _ = (fiber xi).map i z := hiz.symm
  have hstab :
      MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) z =
        (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom := by
    calc
      MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) z =
          MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) y := hstab_component
      _ = (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom :=
        stabilizer_transportedPointOfCompIso
          (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x
  have hliftZ :
      (fiberObjEquivHom xi Z).symm (Over.homMk xiZ hxiZ) = z := by
    apply (fiberObjEquivHom xi Z).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    rfl
  have htransportZ :
      (hxiZ ▸ MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ ≫ Z.hom)
        (liftedFiberPointOverComposite Z xiZ)) =
          MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)
            ((fiberObjEquivHom xi Z).symm (Over.homMk xiZ hxiZ)) :=
    transported_stabilizer_liftedFiberPointOverComposite Z xiZ hxiZ
  have hSourceSub :
      (hxiZ ▸ MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ ≫ Z.hom)
        (liftedFiberPointOverComposite Z xiZ)) =
        (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom := by
    exact htransportZ.trans ((congrArg
      (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) hliftZ).trans hstab)
  let eSource : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ) ≃ₜ*
      (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
        (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom :=
    (fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLiftOfEq Z xiZ hxiZ).trans
      (subgroupContinuousMulEquivOfEq hSourceSub)
  have hiw : i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f = Z.hom := by
    exact MorphismProperty.Over.w i
  have hsquare : g ≫ A.hom = Z.hom ≫ f := by
    let q0 : Z.left ⟶ Y := g ≫ A.hom
    let q1 : Z.left ⟶ Y :=
      i.left ≫ (Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f ≫ A.hom)
    let q2 : Z.left ⟶ Y :=
      i.left ≫ (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f ≫ f)
    let q3 : Z.left ⟶ Y :=
      (i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f) ≫ f
    let q4 : Z.left ⟶ Y := Z.hom ≫ f
    have h01 : q0 = q1 := by
      dsimp only [q0, q1, g]
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    have h12 : q1 = q2 := by
      exact congrArg (fun q ↦ i.left ≫ q) Limits.pullback.condition
    have h23 : q2 = q3 := by
      dsimp only [q2, q3]
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    have h34 : q3 = q4 := by
      exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ f) hiw
    exact h01.trans (h12.trans (h23.trans h34))
  have hxiA : (xiZ ≫ g) ≫ A.hom = xi ≫ f := by
    calc
      (xiZ ≫ g) ≫ A.hom = xiZ ≫ (g ≫ A.hom) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = xiZ ≫ (Z.hom ≫ f) := congrArg (fun q ↦ xiZ ≫ q) hsquare
      _ = (xiZ ≫ Z.hom) ≫ f := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = xi ≫ f := congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ f) hxiZ
  have hzmap : xiZ ≫ i.left =
      (fiberObjEquivHom xi ((pullback f).obj A) ((fiber xi).map i z)).left := by
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q.left) (fiberObjEquivHom_naturality xi i z)
  have hytransport : (pullbackFiberIso f xi).hom.app A y = x := by
    exact FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ((pullbackFiberIso f xi).app A) x
  have hyprojection :
      (fiberObjEquivHom xi ((pullback f).obj A) y).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f =
        (fiberObjEquivHom (xi ≫ f) A x).left := by
    have h := pullbackFiberIso_hom_fiberObjEquivHom_left f xi A y
    rw [hytransport] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hxiApoint : xiZ ≫ g = (fiberObjEquivHom (xi ≫ f) A x).left := by
    let q0 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left := xiZ ≫ g
    let q1 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left :=
      (xiZ ≫ i.left) ≫ Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f
    let q2 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left :=
      (fiberObjEquivHom xi ((pullback f).obj A)
        ((fiber xi).map i z)).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f
    let q3 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left :=
      (fiberObjEquivHom xi ((pullback f).obj A) y).left ≫
        Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f
    let q4 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left :=
      (fiberObjEquivHom (xi ≫ f) A x).left
    have h01 : q0 = q1 := by
      dsimp only [q0, q1, g]
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    have h12 : q1 = q2 :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f) hzmap
    have h23 : q2 = q3 := by
      exact congrArg
        (fun q ↦ (fiberObjEquivHom xi ((pullback f).obj A) q).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f) hiz
    have h34 : q3 = q4 := hyprojection
    exact h01.trans (h12.trans (h23.trans h34))
  have hliftA :
      (fiberObjEquivHom (xi ≫ f) A).symm
          (Over.homMk (xiZ ≫ g) hxiA) = x := by
    apply (fiberObjEquivHom (xi ≫ f) A).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact hxiApoint
  have htransportA :
      (hxiA ▸ MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ((xiZ ≫ g) ≫ A.hom)
        (liftedFiberPointOverComposite A (xiZ ≫ g))) =
          MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)
            ((fiberObjEquivHom (xi ≫ f) A).symm
              (Over.homMk (xiZ ≫ g) hxiA)) :=
    transported_stabilizer_liftedFiberPointOverComposite A (xiZ ≫ g) hxiA
  have hTargetSub :
      (hxiA ▸ MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ((xiZ ≫ g) ≫ A.hom)
        (liftedFiberPointOverComposite A (xiZ ≫ g))) =
          MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x := by
    exact htransportA.trans (congrArg
      (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) hliftA)
  let eTarget0 : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ ≫ g) ≃ₜ*
      MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x :=
    (fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLiftOfEq A (xiZ ≫ g) hxiA).trans
      (subgroupContinuousMulEquivOfEq hTargetSub)
  let m : Z.left ⟶ Y := Z.hom ≫ f
  have hm1 : m = g ≫ A.hom := hsquare.symm
  have hm2 : m = Z.hom ≫ f := rfl
  have hxi2 : (xiZ ≫ Z.hom) ≫ f = xi ≫ f :=
    congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ f) hxiZ
  let k : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) := fundamentalGroupFactorizationConjugator
    g A.hom Z.hom f m hm1 hm2 xiZ (xi ≫ f) hxiA hxi2
  let H : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) :=
    MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x
  let : H.Normal := stabilizer_normal_of_isGalois (fiber (xi ≫ f)) A x
  let eTarget : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ ≫ g) ≃ₜ* H :=
    eTarget0.trans (ProCGroups.Subgroup.conjNormalContinuousMulEquiv H k⁻¹)
  refine ⟨eSource, eTarget, ?_⟩
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hSourceCoe :
      ((eSource a :
          (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
            (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) =
        hxiZ ▸ fundamentalGroupHom Z.hom xiZ a := by
    dsimp only [eSource, ContinuousMulEquiv.trans_apply]
    rw [subgroupContinuousMulEquivOfEq_coe]
    exact fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLiftOfEq_coe Z xiZ hxiZ a
  have hTargetCoe (b : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ ≫ g)) :
      ((eTarget0 b : MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x) :
          π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) =
        hxiA ▸ fundamentalGroupHom A.hom (xiZ ≫ g) b := by
    dsimp only [eTarget0, ContinuousMulEquiv.trans_apply]
    rw [subgroupContinuousMulEquivOfEq_coe]
    exact fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLiftOfEq_coe
      A (xiZ ≫ g) hxiA b
  have htransportF :
      hxi2 ▸ fundamentalGroupHom f (xiZ ≫ Z.hom)
          (fundamentalGroupHom Z.hom xiZ a) =
        fundamentalGroupHom f xi (hxiZ ▸
          fundamentalGroupHom Z.hom xiZ a) := by
    exact fundamentalGroupHom_transport_source f hxiZ
      (fundamentalGroupHom Z.hom xiZ a)
  have hfactor := fundamentalGroupHom_comp_conj_of_common_composite
    g A.hom Z.hom f m hm1 hm2 xiZ (xi ≫ f) hxiA hxi2 a
  have hfactor' :
      ((eTarget0 (fundamentalGroupHom g xiZ a) : H) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) =
        MulAut.conj k
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi ((eSource a : _) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi))) := by
    rw [hTargetCoe, hSourceCoe, ← htransportF]
    exact hfactor
  change ((eTarget (fundamentalGroupHom g xiZ a) : H) :
      π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) =
    fundamentalGroupHom f xi ((eSource a : _) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi))
  dsimp only [eTarget, ContinuousMulEquiv.trans_apply,
    ProCGroups.Subgroup.conjNormalContinuousMulEquiv_apply]
  rw [MulAut.conjNormal_apply, hfactor']
  simp [MulAut.conj_apply, mul_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_galoisPullbackComponent_fundamentalGroup_square
statement:
theorem exists_galoisPullbackComponent_fundamentalGroup_square
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (hA : IsGalois A)
    (x : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj A) :
    ∃ (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj A)
      (z : (fiber xi).obj Z),
      IsGalois Z ∧ Mono i ∧
        let xiZ
proof:
:= (fiberObjEquivHom xi Z z).left
        let g := i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f
        ∃ (eSource : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ) ≃ₜ*
            (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
              (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom)
          (eTarget : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ ≫ g) ≃ₜ*
            MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x),
          ∀ a,
            eTarget (fundamentalGroupHom g xiZ a) =
              ProCGroups.ContinuousMonoidHom.restrictPreimage
                (fundamentalGroupHom f xi)
                (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x) (eSource a) := by
  obtain ⟨Z, i, z, hiz, hZ, hi⟩ :=
    exists_galoisComponent_pullback f xi A hA x
  refine ⟨Z, i, z, hZ, hi, ?_⟩
  exact exists_fundamentalGroup_square_of_galoisPullbackComponent
    f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_openNormal_galoisPullbackComponent_fundamentalGroup_square
statement:
theorem exists_openNormal_galoisPullbackComponent_fundamentalGroup_square
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) :
    ∃ (A : FiniteEtale Y) (_x : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj A)
      (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj A)
      (z : (fiber xi).obj Z),
      IsGalois A ∧ IsGalois Z ∧ Mono i ∧
        let xiZ
proof:
:= (fiberObjEquivHom xi Z z).left
        let g := i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f
        ∃ (eSource : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ) ≃ₜ*
            ProCGroups.OpenNormalSubgroup.comap
              (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom
              (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).continuous_toFun U)
          (eTarget : π₁ᵉᵗ(xiZ ≫ g) ≃ₜ* U),
          ∀ a,
            eTarget (fundamentalGroupHom g xiZ a) =
              ProCGroups.ContinuousMonoidHom.restrictPreimage
                (fundamentalGroupHom f xi)
                (U : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) (eSource a) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, x, hx⟩ :=
    exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq_any_universe
      (C := FiniteEtale Y) (fiber (xi ≫ f)) U
  obtain ⟨Z, i, z, hZ, hi, hsq⟩ :=
    exists_galoisPullbackComponent_fundamentalGroup_square f xi A hA x
  dsimp only at hsq
  obtain ⟨eSource, eTarget, hcomm⟩ := hsq
  have hSourceSub :
      (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom =
        ((ProCGroups.OpenNormalSubgroup.comap
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).continuous_toFun U :
            OpenNormalSubgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) := by
    change (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
        (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom =
      (U : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)).comap
        (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom
    exact congrArg
      (fun K : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) ↦
        K.comap (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom) hx
  let eSourceU := eSource.trans (subgroupContinuousMulEquivOfEq hSourceSub)
  let eTargetU := eTarget.trans (subgroupContinuousMulEquivOfEq hx)
  refine ⟨A, x, Z, i, z, hA, hZ, hi, eSourceU, eTargetU, ?_⟩
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  let b := fundamentalGroupHom
    (i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f)
    (fiberObjEquivHom xi Z z).left a
  have ha :
      ((eTarget b :
          MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) =
        fundamentalGroupHom f xi
          ((eSource a :
            (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
              (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) := by
    have ha' := congrArg Subtype.val (hcomm a)
    rw [restrictPreimage_coe] at ha'
    simpa only [b] using ha'
  have hTargetCoe :
      ((eTargetU b : U) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) =
        ((eTarget b : MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x) :
          π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) := by
    dsimp only [eTargetU, ContinuousMulEquiv.trans_apply]
    exact subgroupContinuousMulEquivOfEq_coe hx (eTarget b)
  have hSourceCoe :
      ((eSourceU a :
        ProCGroups.OpenNormalSubgroup.comap
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).continuous_toFun U) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) =
        ((eSource a :
          (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
            (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) := by
    dsimp only [eSourceU, ContinuousMulEquiv.trans_apply]
    exact subgroupContinuousMulEquivOfEq_coe hSourceSub (eSource a)
  change ((eTargetU b : U) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) =
    ((ProCGroups.ContinuousMonoidHom.restrictPreimage
      (fundamentalGroupHom f xi) (U : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f))
      (eSourceU a) : U) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f))
  calc
    ((eTargetU b : U) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) =
        ((eTarget b : MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x) :
          π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) := hTargetCoe
    _ = fundamentalGroupHom f xi
          ((eSource a :
            (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f) x).comap
              (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) := ha
    _ = fundamentalGroupHom f xi
          ((eSourceU a : ProCGroups.OpenNormalSubgroup.comap
            (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).toMonoidHom
            (fundamentalGroupHom f xi).continuous_toFun U) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) :=
      congrArg (fundamentalGroupHom f xi) hSourceCoe.symm
    _ = ((ProCGroups.ContinuousMonoidHom.restrictPreimage
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi) (U : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f))
          (eSourceU a) : U) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ f)) :=
      (restrictPreimage_coe _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_exists_lift_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_exists_lift_of_mem_range
    (sigma : (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ)
    (hsigma : (fiber xi).map ((pullback f).map sigma.unop.hom)
      ((fiber xi).map i z) ∈ Set.range ((fiber xi).map i)) :
    ∃ tau : (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ,
      galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
          f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi tau = sigma ∧
        tau.unop.hom ≫ i = i ≫ (pullback f).map sigma.unop.hom
proof:
:= by
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let F := fiber (xi ≫ f)
  let F' := fiber xi
  let H := pullback f
  let t := pullbackFiberIso f xi
  let phi := galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
    f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi
  obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := hsigma
  obtain ⟨tau, htau⟩ := evaluation_aut_surjective_of_isGalois F' Z z z'
  have hequiv : tau.hom ≫ i = i ≫ H.map ((phi (MulOpposite.op tau)).unop.hom) :=
    galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_equivariant
      f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi (MulOpposite.op tau)
  have heval :
      F'.map (H.map ((phi (MulOpposite.op tau)).unop.hom)) (F'.map i z) =
        F'.map (H.map sigma.unop.hom) (F'.map i z) := by
    calc
      F'.map (H.map ((phi (MulOpposite.op tau)).unop.hom)) (F'.map i z) =
          F'.map i (F'.map tau.hom z) := by
        have h := congrArg (fun k ↦ F'.map k z) hequiv
        simpa only [Functor.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply] using h.symm
      _ = F'.map i z' := congrArg (F'.map i) htau
      _ = F'.map (H.map sigma.unop.hom) (F'.map i z) := hz'
  have hnat (a : (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
      (t.inv.app W) (F.map a.unop.hom w) =
        F'.map (H.map a.unop.hom) (F'.map i z) := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (t.inv.naturality a.unop.hom) w
    change (t.inv.app W) (F.map a.unop.hom w) =
      F'.map (H.map a.unop.hom)
        (transportedPointOfCompIso H t W w) at h
    rw [← hiz] at h
    exact h
  have hphi : phi (MulOpposite.op tau) = sigma := by
    apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
    apply evaluation_aut_injective_of_isConnected F W w
    have h := congrArg (t.hom.app W)
      ((hnat (phi (MulOpposite.op tau))).trans (heval.trans (hnat sigma).symm))
    have hinv (x : F.obj W) : (t.hom.app W) ((t.inv.app W) x) = x :=
      FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply (t.app W) x
    simpa only [hinv] using h
  refine ⟨MulOpposite.op tau, hphi, ?_⟩
  exact hequiv.trans (congrArg (fun a : (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ ↦ i ≫ H.map a.unop.hom) hphi)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_mem_range_iff_preserves_component
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_mem_range_iff_preserves_component
    (sigma : (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    sigma ∈ (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
        f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi).range ↔
      (fiber xi).map ((pullback f).map sigma.unop.hom) ''
          Set.range ((fiber xi).map i) = Set.range ((fiber xi).map i)
proof:
:= by
  let F' := fiber xi
  let H := pullback f
  let phi := galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
    f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨tau, rfl⟩
    have hpoint (a : F'.obj Z) :
        F'.map (H.map ((phi tau).unop.hom)) (F'.map i a) =
          F'.map i (F'.map tau.unop.hom a) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun k ↦ F'.map k a)
        (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_equivariant
          f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi tau)
      simpa only [Functor.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply] using h.symm
    apply Set.ext
    intro a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨F'.map tau.unop.hom c, (hpoint c).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨F'.map i (F'.map tau.unop.inv b),
        ⟨F'.map tau.unop.inv b, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hpoint]
      exact congrArg (F'.map i)
        (FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply (F'.mapIso tau.unop) b)
  · intro hset
    have hmem : F'.map (H.map sigma.unop.hom) (F'.map i z) ∈
        Set.range (F'.map i) := by
      rw [← hset]
      exact ⟨F'.map i z, ⟨z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨tau, htau, _⟩ :=
      galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_exists_lift_of_mem_range
        f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi sigma hmem
    exact ⟨tau, htau⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponent_quotient_ker_eq
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponent_quotient_ker_eq
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (hA : IsGalois A)
    (x : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj A)
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj A)
    (z : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiz : (fiber xi).map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x)
    (hZ : IsGalois Z) (hi : Mono i) :
    letI : IsGalois Z
proof:
:= hZ
    (EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
      xi Z hZ z).ker =
      (EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism
        f xi A hA x).ker := by
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let : Mono i := hi
  rw [EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_ker,
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism_ker]
  let y : (fiber xi).obj ((pullback f).obj A) :=
    transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x
  have hi_injective : Function.Injective ((fiber xi).map i) := by
    let : Mono ((fiber xi).map i) := Functor.map_mono (fiber xi) i
    exact ConcreteCategory.injective_of_mono_of_preservesPullback
      ((fiber xi).map i)
  change MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) z =
    MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) y
  ext a
  simp only [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
  constructor
  · intro ha
    calc
      a • y = a • (fiber xi).map i z :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ a • q) hiz.symm
      _ = (fiber xi).map i (a • z) :=
        mulAction_naturality (fiber xi) a i z
      _ = (fiber xi).map i z := congrArg ((fiber xi).map i) ha
      _ = y := hiz
  · intro ha
    apply hi_injective
    calc
      (fiber xi).map i (a • z) = a • (fiber xi).map i z :=
        (mulAction_naturality (fiber xi) a i z).symm
      _ = a • y := congrArg (fun q ↦ a • q) hiz
      _ = y := ha
      _ = (fiber xi).map i z := hiz.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_comp
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_comp
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (hA : IsGalois A)
    (x : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj A)
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj A)
    (z : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiz : (fiber xi).map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x)
    (hZ : IsGalois Z) (hi : Mono i) :
    letI : IsGalois Z
proof:
:= hZ
    (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
      f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi).comp
        (EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
          xi Z hZ z) =
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism
        f xi A hA x := by
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let qZ := EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
    xi Z hZ z
  let qA :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism
      f xi A hA x
  let hqZ :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_surjective
      xi Z hZ z
  let hker : qZ.ker ≤ qA.ker :=
    (galoisPullbackComponent_quotient_ker_eq
      f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi).le
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro a
  exact MonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply
    (f := qZ) (f_inv := Function.surjInv hqZ)
    (Function.rightInverse_surjInv hqZ) ⟨qA, hker⟩ a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_injective
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_injective
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (hA : IsGalois A)
    (x : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj A)
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj A)
    (z : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiz : (fiber xi).map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x)
    (hZ : IsGalois Z) (hi : Mono i) :
    Function.Injective
      (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
        f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let qZ := EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
    xi Z hZ z
  let qA :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism
      f xi A hA x
  let φ := galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
    f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi
  have hqZ : Function.Surjective qZ :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_surjective
      xi Z hZ z
  have hker : qZ.ker = qA.ker :=
    galoisPullbackComponent_quotient_ker_eq
      f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi
  have hcomp : φ.comp qZ = qA :=
    galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_comp
      f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hqZ a
  obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hqZ b
  apply qZ.eq_iff.mpr
  rw [hker]
  apply qA.eq_iff.mp
  calc
    qA g = φ (qZ g) := (MonoidHom.ext_iff.mp hcomp g).symm
    _ = φ (qZ h) := hab
    _ = qA h := MonoidHom.ext_iff.mp hcomp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_range
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_range
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (hA : IsGalois A)
    (x : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj A)
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj A)
    (z : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiz : (fiber xi).map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x)
    (hZ : IsGalois Z) (hi : Mono i) :
    (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
      f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi).range =
      (EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism
        f xi A hA x).range
proof:
:= by
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let qZ := EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom
    xi Z hZ z
  let qA :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism
      f xi A hA x
  let φ := galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
    f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi
  have hqZ : Function.Surjective qZ :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_surjective
      xi Z hZ z
  have hcomp : φ.comp qZ = qA :=
    galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_comp
      f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hqZ b
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    calc
      qA g = φ (qZ g) := (MonoidHom.ext_iff.mp hcomp g).symm
      _ = φ b := congrArg φ hg
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨qZ g, MonoidHom.ext_iff.mp hcomp g⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_map_natCard
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_map_natCard
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (hA : IsGalois A)
    (x : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj A)
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj A)
    (z : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiz : (fiber xi).map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x)
    (hZ : IsGalois Z) (hi : Mono i)
    (H : Subgroup (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    Nat.card (H.map (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
      f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi)) = Nat.card H
proof:
:= by
  exact Subgroup.card_map_of_injective
    (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_injective
      f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_map_coprime_iff
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_map_coprime_iff
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (hA : IsGalois A)
    (x : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj A)
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj A)
    (z : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiz : (fiber xi).map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) A x)
    (hZ : IsGalois Z) (hi : Mono i)
    (H : Subgroup (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ) (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.Coprime
        (Nat.card (H.map (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
          f xi A hA x Z i z hiz hZ hi))) n ↔
      Nat.Coprime (Nat.card H) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_map_natCard]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr
statement:
private theorem eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) {z z' : Z} (h : z = z') :
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun w ↦ Z.presheaf.stalk w) h) =
      (Z.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h)).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst z'
  exact (Z.presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl z).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericPointFunctionFieldMap_comp
statement:
private theorem genericPointFunctionFieldMap_comp
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Z]
    (f : Z ⟶ X) (hf : DenseRange f)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω]
    (q : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Z)
    (hq : q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint Z) :
    let hqf : (q ≫ f) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint X
proof:
:= by
      exact (congrArg (fun z : Z => f z) hq).trans
        (f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hf)
    (genericPointFunctionFieldMap Z q hq).comp
        (f.functionFieldMap hf) =
      genericPointFunctionFieldMap X (q ≫ f) hqf := by
  let hgeneric : f (genericPoint Z) = genericPoint X :=
    f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hf
  let hqf : (q ≫ f) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint X := by
    exact (congrArg (fun z : Z => f z) hq).trans hgeneric
  change (genericPointFunctionFieldMap Z q hq).comp
      (f.functionFieldMap hf) = genericPointFunctionFieldMap X (q ≫ f) hqf
  unfold genericPointFunctionFieldMap Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap
  rw [eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr X hgeneric.symm]
  rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_point_assoc f
    (genericPoint Z) (q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) hq.symm]
  simp only [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom]
  have hstalk := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp_assoc X.presheaf
    (specializes_of_eq (congrArg (fun z : Z => f z) hq))
    (specializes_of_eq hgeneric)
    (f.stalkMap (q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) ≫ Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q)
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (hstalk.trans (congrArg
      (fun k : X.presheaf.stalk (f (q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω =>
        X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hqf) ≫ k)
      (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo_comp (f := q) f).symm))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.stalkMap_eq_of_congr_maps
statement:
private theorem stalkMap_eq_of_congr_maps
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) {x₁ x₂ x : Z} (h₁ : x₁ = x) (h₂ : x₂ = x)
    {A : CommRingCat} (f₁ : Z.presheaf.stalk x₁ ⟶ A)
    (f₂ : Z.presheaf.stalk x₂ ⟶ A)
    (hmaps :
      (Z.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h₁.symm)).hom ≫ f₁ =
        (Z.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h₂.symm)).hom ≫ f₂) :
    f₁ = (Z.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (h₁.trans h₂.symm))).hom ≫ f₂
proof:
:= by
  cases h₁
  cases h₂
  simpa using hmaps

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericPointMorphism_eq_of_stalkMap_eq
statement:
private theorem genericPointMorphism_eq_of_stalkMap_eq
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Z]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω]
    (q₁ q₂ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Z)
    (hq₁ : q₁ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint Z)
    (hq₂ : q₂ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint Z)
    (hmaps :
      (Z.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hq₁.symm)).hom ≫
          Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q₁ =
        (Z.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hq₂.symm)).hom ≫
          Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q₂) : q₁ = q₂
proof:
:= by
  apply (SpecToEquivOfLocalRing Z (CommRingCat.of Ω)).injective
  apply SpecToEquivOfLocalRing_eq_iff.mpr
  let hp : q₁ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) =
      q₂ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) := hq₁.trans hq₂.symm
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  change Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q₁ =
    (Z.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hp)).hom ≫
      Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q₂
  exact stalkMap_eq_of_congr_maps Z hq₁ hq₂
    (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q₁) (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q₂) hmaps

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericHom_comp
statement:
private theorem finiteEtaleGenericHom_comp
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω]
    (g : Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) ⟶ Y.toComma) :
    finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g ≫ Y.hom = X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω
proof:
:= by
  let baseIso :
      (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).left ≅ Spec (.of Ω) :=
    eqToIso (Over.mk_left (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω))
  have baseIso_hom_comp :
      baseIso.hom ≫ X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω =
        (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).hom := by
    change eqToHom (Over.mk_left (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)) ≫
        X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω =
      (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).hom
    exact eq_of_heq (eqToHom_comp_heq (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)
      (Over.mk_left (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)))
  have gw : g.left ≫ Y.hom =
      (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).hom := by
    exact g.w
  change (baseIso.inv ≫ g.left) ≫ Y.hom =
    X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω
  calc
    (baseIso.inv ≫ g.left) ≫ Y.hom =
        baseIso.inv ≫ (g.left ≫ Y.hom) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = baseIso.inv ≫ (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).hom :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ baseIso.inv ≫ q) gw
    _ = baseIso.inv ≫
        (baseIso.hom ≫ X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ baseIso.inv ≫ q) baseIso_hom_comp.symm
    _ = X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω :=
      baseIso.inv_hom_id_assoc _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_genericPoint_of_over_genericExtension
statement:
private theorem finiteEtale_genericPoint_of_over_genericExtension
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω]
    (g : Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) ⟶ Y.toComma) :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) =
      genericPoint Y.left := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let f : Y.left ⟶ X := Y.hom
  let : IsFiniteEtale f := Y.2
  have hg :
      f (finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) =
        genericPoint X := by
    have hcomp : finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g ≫ f =
        X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω := by
      change finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g ≫ Y.hom =
        X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω
      exact finiteEtaleGenericHom_comp Y g
    calc
      f (finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) =
          (finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g ≫ f) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) :=
        (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm
      _ = (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) :=
        congrArg (fun h : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X => h (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) hcomp
      _ = genericPoint X := X.genericExtensionMorphism_apply_closedPoint Ω
  have hgeneric : f (genericPoint Y.left) = genericPoint X :=
    f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange
      (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y)
  symm
  apply (f.isDiscrete_preimage_singleton (genericPoint X)).eq_of_specializes
    (genericPoint_specializes
      (finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))
  · exact hgeneric
  · exact hg

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.stalkClosedPointTo_genericExtensionMorphism
statement:
private theorem stalkClosedPointTo_genericExtensionMorphism
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω] :
    (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq
      (X.genericExtensionMorphism_apply_closedPoint Ω).symm)).hom ≫
      Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap X.functionField Ω)
proof:
:= by
  let z : Σ x, { f : X.presheaf.stalk x ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω //
      IsLocalHom f.hom } :=
    ⟨genericPoint X,
      ⟨CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap X.functionField Ω), inferInstance⟩⟩
  have hz := (SpecToEquivOfLocalRing X (CommRingCat.of Ω)).right_inv z
  obtain ⟨hpoint, hmap⟩ := SpecToEquivOfLocalRing_eq_iff.mp hz
  dsimp [SpecToEquivOfLocalRing, z] at hpoint hmap
  unfold Scheme.genericExtensionMorphism
  let e := X.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hpoint)
  exact (congrArg (fun k => e.inv ≫ k) hmap).trans
    (e.inv_hom_id_assoc (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap X.functionField Ω)))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.stalkClosedPointTo_of_eq_genericExtensionMorphism
statement:
private theorem stalkClosedPointTo_of_eq_genericExtensionMorphism
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω]
    (r : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (hr : r = X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)
    (hpoint : r (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint X) :
    (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hpoint.symm)).hom ≫
        Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo r =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap X.functionField Ω)
proof:
:= by
  subst r
  exact stalkClosedPointTo_genericExtensionMorphism

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap_comp
statement:
private theorem finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap_comp
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω]
    (g : Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) ⟶ Y.toComma) :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y g).comp
        (algebraMap X.functionField Y.left.functionField) =
      algebraMap X.functionField Ω := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let f : Y.left ⟶ X := Y.hom
  let q : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Y.left := finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g
  have hq : q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint Y.left :=
    finiteEtale_genericPoint_of_over_genericExtension Y g
  have hqf : (q ≫ f) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint X :=
    (congrArg (fun z : Y.left => f z) hq).trans
      (f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange
        (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y))
  change (genericPointFunctionFieldMap Y.left q hq).comp
    (f.functionFieldMap (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y)) = _
  refine (genericPointFunctionFieldMap_comp f
    (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y) q hq).trans ?_
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (stalkClosedPointTo_of_eq_genericExtensionMorphism (q ≫ f)
      (finiteEtaleGenericHom_comp Y g) hqf)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_injective
statement:
private theorem finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_injective
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω] :
    Function.Injective
      (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom (Ω := Ω) Y)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  intro g₁ g₂ h
  let q₁ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y.left := finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g₁
  let q₂ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y.left := finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g₂
  have hq₁ : q₁ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint Y.left :=
    finiteEtale_genericPoint_of_over_genericExtension Y g₁
  have hq₂ : q₂ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint Y.left :=
    finiteEtale_genericPoint_of_over_genericExtension Y g₂
  have hmaps :
      (Y.left.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hq₁.symm)).hom ≫
          Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q₁ =
        (Y.left.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hq₂.symm)).hom ≫
          Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q₂ := by
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom h
  have qeq : q₁ = q₂ :=
    genericPointMorphism_eq_of_stalkMap_eq Y.left q₁ q₂ hq₁ hq₂ hmaps
  ext1
  let baseIso :
      (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).left ≅ Spec (.of Ω) :=
    eqToIso (Over.mk_left (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω))
  apply (cancel_epi baseIso.inv).1
  exact qeq

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_surjective
statement:
private theorem finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_surjective
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω] :
    Function.Surjective
      (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom (Ω := Ω) Y)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  intro a
  let z : Σ y, { f : Y.left.presheaf.stalk y ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω //
      IsLocalHom f.hom } :=
    ⟨genericPoint Y.left, ⟨CommRingCat.ofHom a.toRingHom, inferInstance⟩⟩
  let q : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y.left :=
    (SpecToEquivOfLocalRing Y.left (CommRingCat.of Ω)).symm z
  have hz :=
    (SpecToEquivOfLocalRing Y.left (CommRingCat.of Ω)).apply_symm_apply z
  obtain ⟨hq, hmap⟩ := SpecToEquivOfLocalRing_eq_iff.mp hz
  dsimp [SpecToEquivOfLocalRing, z] at hq hmap
  change q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint Y.left at hq
  change Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo q =
    (Y.left.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hq.symm)).inv ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom a.toRingHom at hmap
  have hqmap : genericPointFunctionFieldMap Y.left q hq = a.toRingHom := by
    unfold genericPointFunctionFieldMap
    rw [hmap]
    exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
      ((Y.left.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hq.symm)).hom_inv_id_assoc
        (CommRingCat.ofHom a.toRingHom))
  let f : Y.left ⟶ X := Y.hom
  let : IsFiniteEtale f := Y.2
  have hf : DenseRange f := finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y
  have hgeneric : f (genericPoint Y.left) = genericPoint X :=
    f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hf
  have hqf : (q ≫ f) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint X := by
    calc
      (q ≫ f) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) =
          f (q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) := Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _
      _ = f (genericPoint Y.left) := congrArg f hq
      _ = genericPoint X := hgeneric
  have hqfMap : genericPointFunctionFieldMap X (q ≫ f) hqf =
      algebraMap X.functionField Ω := by
    rw [← genericPointFunctionFieldMap_comp f hf q hq, hqmap]
    change a.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap X.functionField Y.left.functionField) =
      algebraMap X.functionField Ω
    ext x
    exact a.commutes x
  have qcomp : q ≫ f = X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω := by
    apply genericPointMorphism_eq_of_stalkMap_eq X
      (q ≫ f) (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) hqf
      (X.genericExtensionMorphism_apply_closedPoint Ω)
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    change genericPointFunctionFieldMap X (q ≫ f) hqf =
      genericPointFunctionFieldMap X (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)
        (X.genericExtensionMorphism_apply_closedPoint Ω)
    calc
      _ = algebraMap X.functionField Ω := hqfMap
      _ = _ := (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
        stalkClosedPointTo_genericExtensionMorphism).symm
  let baseIso :
      (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).left ≅ Spec (.of Ω) :=
    eqToIso (Over.mk_left (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω))
  have baseIso_hom_comp :
      baseIso.hom ≫ X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω =
        (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).hom := by
    change eqToHom (Over.mk_left (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)) ≫
        X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω =
      (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).hom
    exact eq_of_heq (eqToHom_comp_heq (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)
      (Over.mk_left (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)))
  let g : Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) ⟶ Y.toComma :=
    Over.homMk (baseIso.hom ≫ q) (by
      calc
        (baseIso.hom ≫ q) ≫ Y.hom =
            baseIso.hom ≫ (q ≫ f) := Category.assoc _ _ _
        _ = baseIso.hom ≫ X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω :=
          congrArg (fun r ↦ baseIso.hom ≫ r) qcomp
        _ = (Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω)).hom :=
          baseIso_hom_comp)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have hqg : finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g = q := by
    change baseIso.inv ≫ (baseIso.hom ≫ q) = q
    exact baseIso.inv_hom_id_assoc q
  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
  change finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y g = a.toRingHom
  change genericPointFunctionFieldMap Y.left
      (finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g)
      (finiteEtale_genericPoint_of_over_genericExtension Y g) = a.toRingHom
  simpa only [hqg] using hqmap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap_comp_coverAut
statement:
private theorem finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap_comp_coverAut
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω]
    (g : Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) ⟶ Y.toComma)
    (σ : Aut Y) :
    let : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y (g ≫ σ.hom.hom) =
      (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y g).comp
        (σ.hom.left.functionFieldMap σ.hom.left.surjective.denseRange) := by
  intro hIntegral hAlgebra
  let q : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y.left := finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g
  have hq : q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = genericPoint Y.left :=
    finiteEtale_genericPoint_of_over_genericExtension Y g
  have h := genericPointFunctionFieldMap_comp
    σ.hom.left σ.hom.left.surjective.denseRange q hq
  change (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y g).comp
      (σ.hom.left.functionFieldMap σ.hom.left.surjective.denseRange) =
    finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y (g ≫ σ.hom.hom) at h
  exact h.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq_functionFieldMap
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] (σ : Aut Y) :
    let : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ).toRingHom =
      σ.hom.left.functionFieldMap σ.hom.left.surjective.denseRange := by
  intro hIntegral hAlgebra
  let : FiniteDimensional X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let e := finiteEtaleGenericHomEquivFunctionFieldAlgHom
    (Ω := Y.left.functionField) Y
  let g₀ := e.symm (AlgHom.id X.functionField Y.left.functionField)
  have heg₀ : e g₀ = AlgHom.id X.functionField Y.left.functionField := e.apply_symm_apply _
  have hdef : (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ).toAlgHom =
      e (g₀ ≫ σ.hom.hom) :=
    (algEquivEquivAlgHom X.functionField Y.left.functionField).apply_symm_apply _
  have heg₀_apply (w : Y.left.functionField) :
      finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y g₀ w = w :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun heg₀ w
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  calc
    finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ z = e (g₀ ≫ σ.hom.hom) z :=
      DFunLike.congr_fun hdef z
    _ = finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y (g₀ ≫ σ.hom.hom) z := rfl
    _ = ((finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y g₀).comp
        (σ.hom.left.functionFieldMap σ.hom.left.surjective.denseRange)) z :=
      DFunLike.congr_fun (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap_comp_coverAut Y g₀ σ) z
    _ = σ.hom.left.functionFieldMap σ.hom.left.surjective.denseRange z := heg₀_apply _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_comp_aut
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_comp_aut
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω]
    (g : Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) ⟶ Y.toComma)
    (σ : Aut Y) :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom Y (g ≫ σ.hom.hom)) =
      (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom Y g).comp
        (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ).toAlgHom := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  have hmap := finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap_comp_coverAut Y g σ
  have hσ := finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq_functionFieldMap Y σ
  apply AlgHom.ext
  intro z
  change finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y (g ≫ σ.hom.hom) z = _
  rw [hmap]
  change (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldMap Y g)
      (σ.hom.left.functionFieldMap σ.hom.left.surjective.denseRange z) =
    (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom Y g) (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ z)
  rw [← DFunLike.congr_fun hσ z]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_mul_rev
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_mul_rev
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] (σ τ : Aut Y) :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y (σ * τ) =
      finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y τ *
        finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : FiniteDimensional X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let e := finiteEtaleGenericHomEquivFunctionFieldAlgHom
    (Ω := Y.left.functionField) Y
  let g₀ := e.symm (AlgHom.id X.functionField Y.left.functionField)
  have hdef (ρ : Aut Y) :
      (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y ρ).toAlgHom =
        e (g₀ ≫ ρ.hom.hom) := by
    exact (algEquivEquivAlgHom
      X.functionField Y.left.functionField).apply_symm_apply _
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro z
  have hdefz := congrArg
    (fun a : Y.left.functionField →ₐ[X.functionField]
      Y.left.functionField ↦ a z) (hdef (σ * τ))
  have hmorph : g₀ ≫ (σ * τ).hom.hom =
      (g₀ ≫ τ.hom.hom) ≫ σ.hom.hom := by
    rw [CategoryTheory.Aut.Aut_mul_def]
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  have hnat := finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_comp_aut
    Y (g₀ ≫ τ.hom.hom) σ
  have hnatz := congrArg
    (fun a : Y.left.functionField →ₐ[X.functionField]
      Y.left.functionField ↦ a z) hnat
  have hdefτz := congrArg
    (fun a : Y.left.functionField →ₐ[X.functionField]
      Y.left.functionField ↦
        a (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ z)) (hdef τ)
  calc
    finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y (σ * τ) z =
        e (g₀ ≫ (σ * τ).hom.hom) z := hdefz
    _ = e ((g₀ ≫ τ.hom.hom) ≫ σ.hom.hom) z := by rw [hmorph]
    _ = ((finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom Y
          (g₀ ≫ τ.hom.hom)).comp
        (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ).toAlgHom) z := hnatz
    _ = finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom Y (g₀ ≫ τ.hom.hom)
        (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ z) := rfl
    _ = finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y τ
        (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ z) := hdefτz.symm
    _ = (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y τ *
        finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ) z := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_injective
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_injective
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] :
    Function.Injective (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : FiniteDimensional X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let e := finiteEtaleGenericHomEquivFunctionFieldAlgHom
    (Ω := Y.left.functionField) Y
  let g₀ := e.symm (AlgHom.id X.functionField Y.left.functionField)
  intro σ τ hστ
  have ha : e (g₀ ≫ σ.hom.hom) = e (g₀ ≫ τ.hom.hom) := by
    change
      (algEquivEquivAlgHom X.functionField Y.left.functionField).symm
          (e (g₀ ≫ σ.hom.hom)) =
        (algEquivEquivAlgHom X.functionField Y.left.functionField).symm
          (e (g₀ ≫ τ.hom.hom)) at hστ
    exact (algEquivEquivAlgHom
      X.functionField Y.left.functionField).symm.injective hστ
  have hg : g₀ ≫ σ.hom.hom = g₀ ≫ τ.hom.hom := e.injective ha
  let q₀ : Spec (.of Y.left.functionField) ⟶ Y.left :=
    finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g₀
  have hq₀ : q₀ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Y.left.functionField) =
      genericPoint Y.left :=
    finiteEtale_genericPoint_of_over_genericExtension Y g₀
  let : IsDominant q₀ := by
    constructor
    rw [DenseRange]
    rw [dense_iff_closure_eq]
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact Set.subset_univ _
    rw [← (genericPoint_spec Y.left).def]
    apply closure_mono
    rintro _ rfl
    exact ⟨IsLocalRing.closedPoint Y.left.functionField, hq₀⟩
  have hgleft : g₀.left ≫ σ.hom.left = g₀.left ≫ τ.hom.left := by
    exact congrArg (fun r ↦ r.left) hg
  have hqauto : q₀ ≫ σ.hom.left = q₀ ≫ τ.hom.left := by
    change
      ((eqToIso (Over.mk_left
          (X.genericExtensionMorphism Y.left.functionField))).inv ≫ g₀.left) ≫
          σ.hom.left =
        ((eqToIso (Over.mk_left
          (X.genericExtensionMorphism Y.left.functionField))).inv ≫ g₀.left) ≫
          τ.hom.left
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun r ↦
        (eqToIso (Over.mk_left
          (X.genericExtensionMorphism Y.left.functionField))).inv ≫ r) hgleft
  let f : Y.left ⟶ X := Y.hom
  let : IsFiniteEtale f := Y.2
  have hover : σ.hom.left ≫ f = τ.hom.left ≫ f := by
    exact σ.hom.w.trans τ.hom.w.symm
  have hs : σ.hom.left = τ.hom.left :=
    ext_of_isDominant_of_isSeparated f hover q₀ hqauto
  apply Aut.ext
  apply MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext
  exact hs

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale
statement:
theorem isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : IsGalois Y) :
    letI : IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    IsGalois X.functionField Y.left.functionField := by
  let : IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : FiniteDimensional X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure X.functionField
  let ξ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X := X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω
  let F := AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiber ξ
  let a : F.obj Y := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let e : F.obj Y ≃
      (Y.left.functionField →ₐ[X.functionField] Ω) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberObjEquivHom ξ Y).trans
      (finiteEtaleGenericHomEquivFunctionFieldAlgHom (Ω := Ω) Y)
  have hAut : Nat.card (Aut Y) =
      Module.finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField := calc
    Nat.card (Aut Y) = Nat.card (F.obj Y) :=
      Nat.card_congr (evaluationEquivOfIsGalois F Y a)
    _ = Nat.card
        (Y.left.functionField →ₐ[X.functionField] Ω) :=
      Nat.card_congr e
    _ = Module.finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      AlgHom.natCard_of_splits X.functionField Y.left.functionField Ω
        (fun _ ↦ IsAlgClosed.splits _)
  have hle : Nat.card
      (Y.left.functionField ≃ₐ[X.functionField] Y.left.functionField) ≤
      Module.finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField := calc
    Nat.card
        (Y.left.functionField ≃ₐ[X.functionField] Y.left.functionField) =
        Nat.card
          (Y.left.functionField →ₐ[X.functionField] Y.left.functionField) :=
      Nat.card_congr
        (algEquivEquivAlgHom X.functionField Y.left.functionField)
    _ ≤ Module.finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      card_algHom_le_finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField
        Y.left.functionField
  have hge : Module.finrank X.functionField Y.left.functionField ≤
      Nat.card
        (Y.left.functionField ≃ₐ[X.functionField] Y.left.functionField) := by
    rw [← hAut]
    exact Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
      (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y)
      (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_injective Y)
  exact IsGalois.of_card_aut_eq_finrank
    X.functionField Y.left.functionField (le_antisymm hle hge)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_spec
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_spec
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω]
    (g : Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) ⟶ Y.toComma) :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom Y g).toRingHom) ≫
        Y.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y.left) =
      (eqToIso (Over.mk_left (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω))).inv ≫ g.left := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let j := finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom Y g
  let : Algebra Y.left.functionField Ω := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  change Y.left.genericExtensionMorphism Ω = finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g
  apply genericPointMorphism_eq_of_stalkMap_eq Y.left
    (Y.left.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) (finiteEtaleGenericHom Y g)
    (Y.left.genericExtensionMorphism_apply_closedPoint Ω)
    (finiteEtale_genericPoint_of_over_genericExtension Y g)
  rw [stalkClosedPointTo_genericExtensionMorphism]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_spec_comp
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_spec_comp
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [Algebra X.functionField Ω]
    (g : Over.mk (X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω) ⟶ Y.toComma) :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom Y g).toRingHom) ≫
        Y.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y.left)) ≫ Y.hom =
      X.genericExtensionMorphism Ω := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  exact (congrArg (fun q : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y.left => q ≫ Y.hom)
    (finiteEtaleGenericHomFunctionFieldAlgHom_spec Y g)).trans
      (finiteEtaleGenericHom_comp Y g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackComponent_genericPoint_tensor_isArtinian
statement:
theorem pullbackComponent_genericPoint_tensor_isArtinian
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsIntegral Y] [IsNormalIntegral Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (W : FiniteEtale Y) [IsConnected W]
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W) [Mono i] :
    letI : IsIntegral W.left
proof:
:=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : IsIntegral Z.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
    IsArtinianRing
      (Scheme.Pullback.Triplet.ofPoint
        (i.left (genericPoint Z.left))).tensor := by
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : IsIntegral Z.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  let g : Z.left ⟶ W.left :=
    i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst W.hom f
  let zHom : Z.left ⟶ X := Z.hom
  let wHom : W.left ⟶ Y := W.hom
  have hZ : DenseRange zHom := by
    let : IsFiniteEtale zHom := by
      simpa only [zHom] using Z.2
    let : Surjective zHom := IsFiniteEtale.surjective zHom
    exact zHom.surjective.denseRange
  have hW : DenseRange wHom := by
    let : IsFiniteEtale wHom := by
      simpa only [wHom] using W.2
    let : Surjective wHom := IsFiniteEtale.surjective wHom
    exact wHom.surjective.denseRange
  have hZf : DenseRange (zHom ≫ f) := by
    change DenseRange (f.base ∘ zHom.base)
    exact hf.comp hZ f.continuous
  have hgW : g ≫ wHom = zHom ≫ f := by
    exact (Category.assoc i.left (Limits.pullback.fst W.hom f) W.hom).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k : Limits.pullback W.hom f ⟶ Y => i.left ≫ k)
        (Limits.pullback.condition (f := W.hom) (g := f))).trans
        ((Category.assoc i.left (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom f) f).symm.trans
          (congrArg (fun k : Z.left ⟶ X => k ≫ f) i.w)))
  have hsource :
      wHom (g (genericPoint Z.left)) = genericPoint Y := by
    change (g ≫ wHom) (genericPoint Z.left) = genericPoint Y
    rw [hgW]
    exact (zHom ≫ f).map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hZf
  have htarget : wHom (genericPoint W.left) = genericPoint Y :=
    wHom.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hW
  have hgeneric : g (genericPoint Z.left) = genericPoint W.left := by
    symm
    apply (wHom.isDiscrete_preimage_singleton
      (genericPoint Y)).eq_of_specializes
      (genericPoint_specializes (g (genericPoint Z.left)))
    · exact htarget
    · exact hsource
  let t : ((FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W).left :=
    i.left (genericPoint Z.left)
  let T := Scheme.Pullback.Triplet.ofPoint t
  let T₀ : Scheme.Pullback.Triplet wHom f := {
    x := genericPoint W.left
    y := genericPoint X
    s := wHom (genericPoint W.left)
    hx := rfl
    hy := (f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hf).trans htarget.symm }
  have hTx : T.x = genericPoint W.left := by
    change g (genericPoint Z.left) = genericPoint W.left
    exact hgeneric
  have hTy : T.y = genericPoint X := by
    change ((FiniteEtale.pullback f).obj W).hom
      (i.left (genericPoint Z.left)) = genericPoint X
    have hiw := congrArg
      (fun q : Z.left ⟶ X ↦ q (genericPoint Z.left)) i.w
    exact hiw.trans (zHom.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hZ)
  have hT : T = T₀ := Scheme.Pullback.Triplet.ext hTx hTy
  have hArtinian₀ : IsArtinianRing T₀.tensor := by
    let : Algebra (Y.residueField T₀.s)
        (W.left.residueField T₀.x) :=
      (((Y.residueFieldCongr T₀.hx).inv ≫
        wHom.residueFieldMap T₀.x).hom).toAlgebra
    let : FiniteDimensional (Y.residueField T₀.s)
        (W.left.residueField T₀.x) := by
      dsimp only [T₀, wHom]
      exact
        EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteDimensional_genericResidueField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
    exact
      Scheme.Pullback.Triplet.tensor_isArtinian_of_finiteDimensional_left T₀
  change IsArtinianRing T.tensor
  exact hT.symm ▸ hArtinian₀

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.OpenNormalPullbackModel.inclusion_isIso_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem inclusion_isIso_of_isOpenImmersion
    [IsIntegral Y] [IsNormalIntegral Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    [IsOpenImmersion f] [Nonempty X]
    (M : OpenNormalPullbackModel f xi U) : IsIso M.inclusion
proof:
:= by
  let : IsGalois M.targetCover := M.targetIsGalois
  let : IsConnected ((pullback f).obj M.targetCover) :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.pullback_obj_isConnected_of_isOpenImmersion
      f M.targetCover
  let : IsGalois M.sourceCover := M.sourceIsGalois
  let : Mono M.inclusion := M.inclusionMono
  exact IsConnected.noTrivialComponent M.sourceCover M.inclusion
    (not_initial_of_inhabited (fiber xi) M.sourcePoint)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_evaluation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_evaluation
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace X]
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : IsGalois Y)
    (y : (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).obj Y) (g : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) :
    letI : IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).map
        ((finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom xi Y hY y g).unop.hom) y =
      g • y := by
  let : IsGalois Y := hY
  exact galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_evaluation
    (FiniteEtale.fiber xi) π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) Y y g

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_ker
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_ker
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace X]
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : IsGalois Y)
    (y : (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).obj Y) :
    letI : IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom xi Y hY y).ker =
      MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) y := by
