name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isGalois_of_stabilizer_normal
statement:
private theorem isGalois_of_stabilizer_normal
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{u₂} C] [GaloisCategory C]
    (F : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}) [FiberFunctor F]
    (A : C) [IsConnected A] (a : F.obj A)
    (ha : (MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) a).Normal) :
    IsGalois A
proof:
:= by
  let N := MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) a
  let : N.Normal := ha
  let : MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F) (F.obj A) :=
    FiberFunctor.isPretransitive_of_isConnected F A
  let e : F.obj A ≃ Aut F ⧸ N :=
    (Equiv.Set.univ (F.obj A)).symm.trans <|
      (Set.equivOfEq ((MulAction.orbit_eq_univ (Aut F) a).symm)).trans <|
        MulAction.orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer (Aut F) a
  have he_symm (q : Aut F ⧸ N) :
      e.symm q = MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer (Aut F) a q := by
    rfl
  have he_smul (g : Aut F) (x : F.obj A) :
      e (g • x) = g • e x := by
    apply e.symm.injective
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply, he_symm,
      MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer_smul, ← he_symm,
      e.symm_apply_apply]
  apply (isGalois_iff_pretransitive F A).mpr
  constructor
  intro x y
  let qx : Aut F ⧸ N := e x
  let qy : Aut F ⧸ N := e y
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep qx
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep qy
  let r : (Aut F ⧸ N) ≃ (Aut F ⧸ N) :=
    Equiv.mulRight (QuotientGroup.mk' N (g⁻¹ * h))
  let p : F.obj A ≃ F.obj A := e.trans (r.trans e.symm)
  let s : (functorToAction F).obj A ≅ (functorToAction F).obj A :=
    Action.mkIso (FintypeCat.equivEquivIso p) (fun sigma ↦ by
      apply FintypeCat.hom_ext
      intro z
      let z' : F.obj A := z
      change p (sigma • z') = sigma • p z'
      apply e.injective
      simp only [p, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rw [he_smul, he_smul]
      rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      change (QuotientGroup.mk' N sigma * e z') *
          QuotientGroup.mk' N (g⁻¹ * h) =
        QuotientGroup.mk' N sigma *
          (e z' * QuotientGroup.mk' N (g⁻¹ * h))
      exact mul_assoc _ _ _)
  let phi : A ≅ A := (functorToAction F).preimageIso s
  refine ⟨phi, ?_⟩
  have hmap : (functorToAction F).map phi.hom = s.hom :=
    (functorToAction F).map_preimage s.hom
  have happ : F.map phi.hom x = s.hom.hom x :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (congrArg Action.Hom.hom hmap) x
  change F.map phi.hom x = y
  rw [happ]
  have hs_apply : s.hom.hom x = p x := rfl
  rw [hs_apply]
  apply e.injective
  simp only [p, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change qx * QuotientGroup.mk' N (g⁻¹ * h) = qy
  rw [← hg, ← hh]
  change QuotientGroup.mk' N g * QuotientGroup.mk' N (g⁻¹ * h) = QuotientGroup.mk' N h
  rw [map_mul, map_inv, mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_galoisComponent_pullback
statement:
theorem exists_galoisComponent_pullback
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (W : FiniteEtale Y) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (w : (fiber (xi ≫ f)).obj W) :
    ∃ (Z : FiniteEtale X)
      (i : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj W)
      (z : (fiber xi).obj Z),
      (fiber xi).map i z =
          transportedPointOfCompIso
            (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f xi) W w ∧
        IsGalois Z ∧ Mono i
proof:
:= by
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  let F := fiber (xi ≫ f)
  let F' := fiber xi
  let H := pullback f
  let t := pullbackFiberIso f xi
  let y : F'.obj (H.obj W) :=
    transportedPointOfCompIso H t W w
  obtain ⟨Z, i, z, hiz, hZconnected, hi⟩ :=
    fiber_in_connected_component F' (H.obj W) y
  let : IsConnected Z := hZconnected
  let : Mono i := hi
  have hi_injective : Function.Injective (F'.map i) := by
    let : Mono (F'.map i) := CategoryTheory.Functor.map_mono F' i
    exact ConcreteCategory.injective_of_mono_of_preservesPullback (F'.map i)
  have hstabilizer_component :
      MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F') z =
        MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F') y := by
    ext a
    simp only [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    constructor
    · intro ha
      rw [← hiz, mulAction_naturality, ha]
    · intro ha
      apply hi_injective
      calc
        F'.map i (a • z) = a • F'.map i z :=
          (mulAction_naturality F' a i z).symm
        _ = a • y := congrArg (fun q ↦ a • q) hiz
        _ = y := ha
        _ = F'.map i z := hiz.symm
  have hstabilizer_pullback :
      MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F') y =
        (MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) w).comap
          (autHomOfCompIso H t).toMonoidHom :=
    stabilizer_transportedPointOfCompIso H t W w
  have hnormal_original :
      (MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) w).Normal :=
    stabilizer_normal_of_isGalois F W w
  have hnormal_pullback :
      ((MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) w).comap
        (autHomOfCompIso H t).toMonoidHom).Normal := by
    let : (MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) w).Normal := hnormal_original
    infer_instance
  have hnormal_component :
      (MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F') z).Normal := by
    rw [hstabilizer_component, hstabilizer_pullback]
    exact hnormal_pullback
  have hZgalois : IsGalois Z :=
    isGalois_of_stabilizer_normal F' Z z hnormal_component
  exact ⟨Z, i, z, hiz, hZgalois, hi⟩

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap_surjective_of_surjective_reversed_tensor
statement:
theorem productMap_surjective_of_surjective_reversed_tensor
    {R : Type u₁} {A : Type u₂} {B : Type u₃} {C : Type u₄}
    {R' : Type u₅} {A' : Type u₆} {B' : Type u₇} {C' : Type u₈}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [CommRing R'] [CommRing A'] [CommRing B'] [CommRing C']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C]
    [Algebra R' A'] [Algebra R' B']
    (f : A →ₐ[R] C) (g : B →ₐ[R] C)
    (q : B' ⊗[R'] A' →+* C')
    (eA : A ≃+* A') (eB : B ≃+* B') (eC : C' ≃+* C)
    (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hpure : ∀ (a : A) (b : B),
      eC (q (eB b ⊗ₜ[R'] eA a)) = f a * g b) :
    Function.Surjective (productMap f g)
proof:
:= by
  have hlift (z : B' ⊗[R'] A') :
      ∃ x : A ⊗[R] B, productMap f g x = eC (q z) := by
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul b' a' =>
        refine ⟨eA.symm a' ⊗ₜ[R] eB.symm b', ?_⟩
        simpa using (hpure (eA.symm a') (eB.symm b')).symm
    | add x y hx hy =>
        obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hy
        refine ⟨x' + y', ?_⟩
        rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx', hy']
  intro c
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hq (eC.symm c)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hlift z
  refine ⟨x, hx.trans ?_⟩
  rw [hz]
  exact eC.apply_symm_apply c

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_formallyUnramified
statement:
theorem numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_formallyUnramified
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [Algebra.FormallyUnramified ℤ (𝓞 K)] :
    Module.finrank ℚ K = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (NumberField.discr K) := by
    by_contra hnunit
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd⟩ := WfDvdMonoid.exists_irreducible_factor
      hnunit (NumberField.discr_ne_zero K)
    apply ((NumberField.not_dvd_discr_iff_forall_liesOver K (𝓞 K)
      (irreducible_iff_prime.mp hp)).mpr ?_) hpd
    intro P hP hlying
    let : P.IsMaximal := hP
    exact (Algebra.formallyUnramified_iff_forall.mp
      (inferInstance : Algebra.FormallyUnramified ℤ (𝓞 K)))
      ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
  have habs : |NumberField.discr K| = 1 := Int.isUnit_iff_abs_eq.mp hunit
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℚ K := Module.finrank_pos
  by_contra hne
  have hgt : 1 < Module.finrank ℚ K := by omega
  have hbound := NumberField.abs_discr_gt_two (K := K) hgt
  omega

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integerAlgebraMap_ringOfIntegers_bijective
statement:
theorem integerAlgebraMap_ringOfIntegers_bijective
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [Algebra.FormallyUnramified ℤ (𝓞 K)] :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ℤ (𝓞 K), ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' (1 : K) one_ne_zero).mp
      (numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_formallyUnramified K) (x : K)
  have hqmap : algebraMap ℚ K q = (x : K) := by
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one] using hq
  have hqint : IsIntegral ℤ q :=
    (isIntegral_algebraMap_iff (R := ℤ) (A := ℚ) (B := K)).mp
      (hqmap.symm ▸ x.property)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.algebraMap_eq_of_integral hqint
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change algebraMap ℤ K z = (x : K)
  calc
    (algebraMap ℤ K) z = (algebraMap ℚ K) ((algebraMap ℤ ℚ) z) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℤ ℚ K z
    _ = (algebraMap ℚ K) q := by rw [hz]
    _ = (x : K) := hqmap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integerAlgebraMap_bijective_of_connected_finiteEtale
statement:
theorem integerAlgebraMap_bijective_of_connected_finiteEtale
    (T : Type*) [CommRing T]

proof:
:= by

    finiteEtale_isDomain_of_connectedSpace_primeSpectrum (R := ℤ) (K := ℚ)
  let : Module.Flat ℤ T := inferInstance
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree ℤ T := inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isIso_hom_of_connected_over_integers
statement:
theorem isIso_hom_of_connected_over_integers
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)))
    [ConnectedSpace Y.left] : IsIso Y.hom
proof:
:= by
  let hY : IsFiniteEtale Y.hom := Y.prop
  let : IsAffine ((Functor.fromPUnit (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))).obj Y.right) := by
    change IsAffine (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))
    infer_instance
  let : IsFinite Y.hom := hY.toIsFinite
  let : Etale Y.hom := hY.toEtale
  let : IsAffine ((𝟭 Scheme).obj Y.left) := by
    change IsAffine Y.left
    exact isAffine_of_isAffineHom Y.hom
  let A := Γ(Y.left, ⊤)
  let : Algebra ℤ A := Ring.toIntAlgebra A
  let : Module ℤ A := Algebra.toModule
  let e : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ), ⊤) ≃+* ℤ :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hmap : algebraMap ℤ A = Y.hom.appTop.hom.comp e.symm.toRingHom :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hfinite : RingHom.Finite (algebraMap ℤ A) := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact RingHom.finite_respectsIso.2 Y.hom.appTop.hom e.symm
      Y.hom.finite_appTop
  have hetale : RingHom.Etale (algebraMap ℤ A) := by
    rw [hmap]
    apply RingHom.Etale.respectsIso.2
    exact (HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @Etale)).mp
      (inferInstance : Etale Y.hom)
  let : Module.Finite ℤ A := (RingHom.finite_algebraMap).mp hfinite
  let : Algebra.Etale ℤ A := (RingHom.etale_algebraMap).mp hetale
  let : ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum A) :=
    Y.left.isoSpec.schemeIsoToHomeo.connectedSpace_iff.mp inferInstance
  let eA : ℤ ≃+* A := RingEquiv.ofBijective (algebraMap ℤ A)
    (EtaleFundamentalGroups.integerAlgebraMap_bijective_of_connected_finiteEtale A hfinite)
  let eY : Y.left ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ) :=
    Y.left.isoSpec ≪≫ Scheme.Spec.mapIso eA.toCommRingCatIso.op
  have heY : eY.hom = Y.hom := specZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _
  rw [← heY]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.subsingleton_fiber_of_connected_over_integers
statement:
theorem subsingleton_fiber_of_connected_over_integers
    (Ω : Type) [Field Ω]

    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)))
    [ConnectedSpace Y.left] : Subsingleton ((fiber ξ).obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIso Y.hom := isIso_hom_of_connected_over_integers Y
  let e : (Limits.pullback Y.hom ξ : Scheme) ≃ₜ Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) :=
    (asIso (Limits.pullback.snd Y.hom ξ)).schemeIsoToHomeo
  change Subsingleton (Limits.pullback Y.hom ξ : Scheme)
  exact ⟨fun x y ↦ e.injective (Subsingleton.elim (e x) (e y))⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_localizationAtPrime_etale_of_etale
statement:
theorem integralClosure_localizationAtPrime_etale_of_etale
    {R K L : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower R K L]
    (hEtale : Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R L))
    (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] :
    letI
proof:
:= localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
    Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime P)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) := by
  let S := Localization.AtPrime P
  let C := integralClosure R L
  let Cₚ := Localization
    (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C P.primeCompl)
  let : Algebra.Etale R C := hEtale
  let := localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower R S L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  have hCₚ : Algebra.Etale S Cₚ := by
    let : Algebra.Etale S (S ⊗[R] C) := inferInstance
    exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv
      (Localization.tensorRightAlgEquiv P.primeCompl C)
  let : Algebra.Etale S Cₚ := hCₚ
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv
    (localizationIntegralClosureAtPrimeAlgEquiv
      (K := K) (L := L) P)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_functionField_etale_on_affineOpen_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
statement:
theorem
    integralClosure_functionField_etale_on_affineOpen_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) [Nonempty U] :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Y.left.functionField :=
      X.affineExtensionAlgebra U Y.left.functionField
    Algebra.Etale Γ(X, U)
      (integralClosure Γ(X, U) Y.left.functionField) := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let f : Y.left ⟶ X := Y.hom
  let : IsFiniteEtale f := Y.prop
  let V : Y.left.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ U
  let : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨genericPoint Y.left, by
    change f (genericPoint Y.left) ∈ U
    rw [f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange
      (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y)]
    exact ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr
      (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty U))⟩⟩
  have hV : IsAffineOpen V := hU.preimage f
  let R := Γ(X, U)
  let T := Γ(Y.left, V)
  let K := X.functionField
  let L := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra R T := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Module.Finite R T := by
    rw [← RingHom.finite_algebraMap]
    exact f.finite_app U hU
  have hEtale : (f.app U).hom.Etale := by
    simpa only [f.app_eq_appLE] using
      f.etale_appLE hU hV (show V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U from le_rfl)
  let : Algebra.Etale R T := hEtale.toAlgebra
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed R :=
    IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed U hU
  let : Algebra R K := (X.germToFunctionField U).hom.toAlgebra
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X U hU
  let : Algebra T L :=
    (Y.left.germToFunctionField V).hom.toAlgebra
  let : IsFractionRing T L :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen Y.left V hV
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra R L := X.affineExtensionAlgebra U L
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower R T L := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    exact Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField
      f (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y) U
  exact integralClosure_etale_of_finiteEtale_fractionField
    (R := R) (T := T) (K := K) (L := L)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_functionField_etale_on_stalk_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
statement:
theorem
    integralClosure_functionField_etale_on_stalk_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] (x : X) :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x) Y.left.functionField :=
      X.stalkExtensionAlgebra x Y.left.functionField
    Algebra.Etale (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (integralClosure (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        Y.left.functionField) := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let K := X.functionField
  let L := Y.left.functionField
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra A L := X.stalkExtensionAlgebra x L
  let : IsScalarTower A K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
      (X := X) (U := ⊤) (x := x) trivial
  let : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
  let R := Γ(X, U)
  let : Algebra R K := (X.germToFunctionField U).hom.toAlgebra
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X U hU
  let : Algebra R L := X.affineExtensionAlgebra U L
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hGlobal : Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R L) :=
    integralClosure_functionField_etale_on_affineOpen_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
      Y U hU
  let xU : U := ⟨x, hxU⟩
  let P : Ideal R := (hU.primeIdealOf xU).asIdeal
  let : P.IsPrime := (hU.primeIdealOf xU).isPrime
  let : Algebra R A := (X.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom.toAlgebra
  let : IsLocalization.AtPrime A P := hU.isLocalization_stalk xU
  let : IsScalarTower R A K := functionField_isScalarTower X U xU
  let : IsScalarTower R A L := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro r
    calc
      algebraMap R L r = algebraMap K L (algebraMap R K r) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L r
      _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K (algebraMap R A r)) := by
        rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A K]
      _ = algebraMap A L (algebraMap R A r) :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L _).symm
  let S := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : Algebra S L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower R S L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  have hLocal : Algebra.Etale S (integralClosure S L) :=
    integralClosure_localizationAtPrime_etale_of_etale
      (K := K) hGlobal P
  let e : S ≃ₐ[R] A :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv P.primeCompl S A
  have he :
      (algebraMap S L).comp e.symm.toRingHom = algebraMap A L := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext P.primeCompl
    ext r
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    change algebraMap S L (e.symm (algebraMap R A r)) =
      algebraMap A L (algebraMap R A r)
    calc
      algebraMap S L (e.symm (algebraMap R A r)) =
          algebraMap S L (algebraMap R S r) := by
        rw [← e.commutes r, e.symm_apply_apply]
      _ = algebraMap R L r :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S L r).symm
      _ = algebraMap A L (algebraMap R A r) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A L r
  exact integralClosure_etale_of_baseRingEquiv
    e.symm.toRingEquiv he hLocal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_sectionFunctionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_sectionFunctionField_isScalarTower
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) Γ(Y.left, ⊤) :=
      Y.hom.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y.left, ⊤) Y.left.functionField :=
      topSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra Y.left
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    IsScalarTower Γ(X, ⊤) Γ(Y.left, ⊤) Y.left.functionField := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let f : Y.left ⟶ X := Y.hom
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X), trivial⟩⟩
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : Y.left.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Y.left), trivial⟩⟩
  let : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) Γ(Y.left, ⊤) :=
    f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra Γ(Y.left, ⊤) Y.left.functionField :=
    topSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra Y.left
  let : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
  exact Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField_top f
    (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
statement:
theorem integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsAffine X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    Algebra.Etale Γ(X, ⊤)
      (integralClosure Γ(X, ⊤) Y.left.functionField) := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let f : Y.left ⟶ X := Y.hom
  let : IsFiniteEtale f := Y.2
  let : IsAffine Y.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom f
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X), trivial⟩⟩
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : Y.left.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Y.left), trivial⟩⟩
  let R := Γ(X, ⊤)
  let T := Γ(Y.left, ⊤)
  let K := X.functionField
  let L := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra R T := f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  let : Module.Finite R T := by
    rw [← RingHom.finite_algebraMap]
    exact f.finite_appTop
  have hEtale : f.appTop.hom.Etale := by
    rw [← HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine
      (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale)]
    exact Y.2.toEtale
  let : Algebra.Etale R T := hEtale.toAlgebra
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed R :=
    IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top X)
  let : Algebra R K := topSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra X
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top X)
  let : Algebra T L := topSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra Y.left
  let : IsFractionRing T L :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen Y.left ⊤
      (isAffineOpen_top Y.left)
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra R L := finiteEtaleSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower R T L :=
    finiteEtale_sectionFunctionField_isScalarTower Y
  exact integralClosure_etale_of_finiteEtale_fractionField
    (R := R) (T := T) (K := K) (L := L)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleSpec_functionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleSpec_functionField_isScalarTower
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]

proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y

      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra R Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleSpecFunctionFieldAlgebra R Y
    IsScalarTower R (Spec R).functionField Y.left.functionField := by
  let X := Spec R
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=

  let : Algebra R Y.left.functionField :=

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale_spec
statement:
theorem integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale_spec
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec R)) [IsConnected Y] :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra (Spec R).functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra R Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleSpecFunctionFieldAlgebra R Y
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField) := by
  let X := Spec R
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra R Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleSpecFunctionFieldAlgebra R Y
  have hΓ : Algebra.Etale Γ(X, ⊤)
      (integralClosure Γ(X, ⊤) Y.left.functionField) :=
    integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let e : R ≃+* Γ(X, ⊤) :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have he : (algebraMap Γ(X, ⊤) Y.left.functionField).comp e.toRingHom =
      algebraMap R Y.left.functionField := rfl
  exact integralClosure_etale_of_baseRingEquiv e he hΓ

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.irreducibleSpace_of_connectedSpace_of_irreducible_openCover
statement:
private theorem irreducibleSpace_of_connectedSpace_of_irreducible_openCover
    {A I : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A] [ConnectedSpace A]
    (U : I → TopologicalSpace.Opens A)
    (hcover : (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤)
    (hU : ∀ i, IrreducibleSpace (U i)) : IrreducibleSpace A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r (i j : I) : Prop :=
    ((U i : Set A) ∩ (U j : Set A)).Nonempty
  have hstep {O : Set A} (hO : IsOpen O) {i j : I} (hij : r i j) :
      (O ∩ (U i : Set A)).Nonempty →
        (O ∩ (U j : Set A)).Nonempty := by
    intro hOi
    let : IrreducibleSpace (U i) := hU i
    have hi : IsPreirreducible (U i : Set A) :=
      IsPreirreducible.of_subtype
    obtain ⟨x, hxi, hxO, hxj⟩ :=
      hi O (U j : Set A) hO (U j).isOpen
        (by simpa [Set.inter_comm] using hOi) hij
    exact ⟨x, hxO, hxj⟩
  have hpropagate {O : Set A} (hO : IsOpen O) {i j : I}
      (hij : Relation.EqvGen r i j) :
      (O ∩ (U i : Set A)).Nonempty ↔
        (O ∩ (U j : Set A)).Nonempty := by
    induction hij with
    | rel i j hij =>
        have hji : r j i := by
          obtain ⟨x, hxi, hxj⟩ := hij
          exact ⟨x, hxj, hxi⟩
        exact ⟨hstep hO hij, hstep hO hji⟩
    | refl i => exact Iff.rfl
    | symm i j _ ih => exact ih.symm
    | trans i j k _ _ hij hjk => exact hij.trans hjk
  obtain ⟨a₀⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty A)
  have ha₀ : ∃ i, a₀ ∈ U i := by
    apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp
    rw [hcover]
    trivial
  let i₀ : I := Classical.choose ha₀
  let C : Set A :=
    ⋃ (j : I) (_ : Relation.EqvGen r i₀ j), (U j : Set A)
  have hCopen : IsOpen C := by
    dsimp only [C]
    exact isOpen_iUnion fun j ↦ isOpen_iUnion fun _ ↦ (U j).isOpen
  have hCnonempty : C.Nonempty := by
    let : IrreducibleSpace (U i₀) := hU i₀
    obtain ⟨x⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (U i₀))
    exact ⟨x.1, Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem i₀ <|
      Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem (Relation.EqvGen.refl i₀) x.2⟩
  have hCcomplOpen : IsOpen Cᶜ := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro x hxC
    have hxcover : ∃ j, x ∈ U j := by
      apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp
      rw [hcover]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := hxcover
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset ((U j).isOpen.mem_nhds hxj) ?_
    intro y hyj hyC
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff] at hxC
    simp only [C, Set.mem_iUnion] at hyC
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hyk⟩ := hyC
    have hjk : r j k := by
      change ((U j : Set A) ∩ (U k : Set A)).Nonempty
      exact ⟨y, hyj, hyk⟩
    have hi₀j : Relation.EqvGen r i₀ j :=
      Relation.EqvGen.trans i₀ k j hk
        (Relation.EqvGen.symm j k (Relation.EqvGen.rel j k hjk))
    apply hxC
    exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem j <| Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hi₀j hxj
  have hC : C = Set.univ :=
    IsClopen.eq_univ ⟨isOpen_compl_iff.mp hCcomplOpen, hCopen⟩ hCnonempty
  have hconnected (i : I) : Relation.EqvGen r i₀ i := by
    let : IrreducibleSpace (U i) := hU i
    obtain ⟨x⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (U i))
    have hxC : x.1 ∈ C := by rw [hC]; trivial
    simp only [C, Set.mem_iUnion] at hxC
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := hxC
    have hji : r j i := by
      change ((U j : Set A) ∩ (U i : Set A)).Nonempty
      exact ⟨x.1, hxj, x.2⟩
    exact Relation.EqvGen.trans i₀ j i hj
      (Relation.EqvGen.rel j i hji)
  rw [irreducibleSpace_def]
  refine ⟨Set.univ_nonempty, ?_⟩
  intro O V hO hV hOnonempty hVnonempty
  obtain ⟨x, hxO⟩ := hOnonempty
  obtain ⟨y, hyV⟩ := hVnonempty
  have hxcover : ∃ i, x ∈ U i := by
    apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp
    rw [hcover]
    trivial
  have hycover : ∃ j, y ∈ U j := by
    apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp
    rw [hcover]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxcover
  obtain ⟨j, hyj⟩ := hycover
  have hij : Relation.EqvGen r i j :=
    Relation.EqvGen.trans i i₀ j
      (Relation.EqvGen.symm i₀ i (hconnected i)) (hconnected j)
  have hOj : (O ∩ (U j : Set A)).Nonempty :=
    (hpropagate hO hij).mp ⟨x, hxO.2, hxi⟩
  let : IrreducibleSpace (U j) := hU j
  have hj : IsPreirreducible (U j : Set A) :=
    IsPreirreducible.of_subtype
  obtain ⟨z, -, hzO, hzV⟩ :=
    hj O V hO hV (by simpa [Set.inter_comm] using hOj)
      ⟨y, hyj, hyV.2⟩
  exact ⟨z, Set.mem_univ z, hzO, hzV⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_of_isFiniteEtale_of_isAffine_of_connectedSpace
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_isFiniteEtale_of_isAffine_of_connectedSpace
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFiniteEtale f]
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsAffine X]
    [ConnectedSpace Y] : IsIntegral Y
proof:
:= by
  let R := Γ(X, ⊤)
  let T := Γ(Y, ⊤)
  let K := X.functionField
  let : IsAffine Y := isAffine_of_isAffineHom f
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X), trivial⟩⟩
  let : Algebra R T := f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  let : Module.Finite R T := by
    rw [← RingHom.finite_algebraMap]
    exact f.finite_appTop
  have hfEtale : f.appTop.hom.Etale := by
    rw [← HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine
      (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale)]
    infer_instance
  let : Algebra.Etale R T := hfEtale.toAlgebra
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed R :=
    IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top X)
  let : Algebra R K := X.affineExtensionAlgebra ⊤ K
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top X)
  let : ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum T) := by
    change ConnectedSpace (Spec (.of T))
    exact Y.isoSpec.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mp inferInstance
  let : IsDomain T :=
    finiteEtale_isDomain_of_connectedSpace_primeSpectrum
      (R := R) (T := T) (K := K)
  exact isIntegral_of_isAffine_of_isDomain Y

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_connectedComponent_of_isFiniteEtale_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem isIntegral_connectedComponent_of_isFiniteEtale_of_isAffine
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFiniteEtale f]
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsAffine X]
    [Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents Y)]
    (i : _root_.ConnectedComponents Y) :
    IsIntegral (Y.connectedComponents.X i)
proof:
:= by
  let c : Y.connectedComponents.X i ⟶ Y :=
    Y.connectedComponents.f i
  let g : Y.connectedComponents.X i ⟶ X := c ≫ f
  let : IsOpenImmersion c := by
    dsimp only [c, Scheme.connectedComponents]
    infer_instance
  let : IsClosedImmersion c := by
    dsimp only [c]
    infer_instance
  let hc : IsFiniteEtale c :=
    { toIsFinite := inferInstance
      toEtale := inferInstance }
  let hg : IsFiniteEtale g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    exact MorphismProperty.comp_mem @IsFiniteEtale c f hc inferInstance
  let : IsFiniteEtale g := hg
  exact isIntegral_of_isFiniteEtale_of_isAffine_of_connectedSpace g

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale
statement:
theorem isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : ConnectedSpace Y.left :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedSpace_left_of_isConnected Y
  have hAffine (y : Y.left) :
      ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ Y.hom.base y ∈ U ∧ U ≤ ⊤ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
      (X := X) (U := ⊤) (x := Y.hom.base y) trivial
  let U (y : Y.left) : X.Opens := Classical.choose (hAffine y)
  have hrestrEtale (y : Y.left) : IsFiniteEtale (Y.hom ∣_ U y) := by
    exact MorphismProperty.of_isPullback
      (isPullback_morphismRestrict Y.hom (U y)).flip Y.2
  have hUaffine (y : Y.left) : IsAffineOpen (U y) :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hAffine y)).1
  have hyU (y : Y.left) : Y.hom.base y ∈ U y :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hAffine y)).2.1
  have hUnonempty (y : Y.left) : Nonempty (U y) :=
    ⟨⟨Y.hom.base y, hyU y⟩⟩
  let V (y : Y.left) : Y.left.Opens := Y.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U y
  have hyV (y : Y.left) : y ∈ V y := hyU y
  have hfiniteComponents (y : Y.left) :
      Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents (V y)) := by
    let : Nonempty (U y) := hUnonempty y
    let : IsAffine (U y) := hUaffine y
    let A : FiniteEtale (U y) :=
      @FiniteEtale.mk _ _ (Y.hom ∣_ U y) (hrestrEtale y)
    change Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents A.left)
    infer_instance
  let i (y : Y.left) : _root_.ConnectedComponents (V y) :=
    _root_.ConnectedComponents.mk ⟨y, hyV y⟩
  let C (y : Y.left) : (V y : Scheme).OpenCover :=
    letI : Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents (V y)) :=
      hfiniteComponents y
    (V y : Scheme).connectedComponents
  let Z (y : Y.left) : Scheme.{u} :=
    (C y).X (i y)
  let c (y : Y.left) : Z y ⟶ V y :=
    (C y).f (i y)
  have hcOpen (y : Y.left) : IsOpenImmersion (c y) := by
    let : Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents (V y)) :=
      hfiniteComponents y
    dsimp only [c, C, Scheme.connectedComponents]
    exact (Scheme.connCompOpen (X := (V y : Scheme)) (i y)).instIsOpenImmersionι
  let j (y : Y.left) : Z y ⟶ Y.left := c y ≫ (V y).ι
  have hjOpen (y : Y.left) : IsOpenImmersion (j y) := by
    dsimp only [j]
    exact MorphismProperty.comp_mem @IsOpenImmersion
      (c y) (V y).ι (hcOpen y) inferInstance
  let W (y : Y.left) : Y.left.Opens :=
    (j y).opensRange (H := hjOpen y)
  have hZintegral (y : Y.left) : IsIntegral (Z y) := by
    let : Nonempty (U y) := hUnonempty y
    let : IsAffine (U y) := hUaffine y
    let hUint : IsIntegral (U y) :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (U y).ι
    let : IsIntegral (U y) := hUint
    let hUnormal : IsNormalIntegral (U y) := inferInstance
    let : Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents (V y)) :=
      hfiniteComponents y
    change IsIntegral ((V y : Scheme).connectedComponents.X (i y))
    exact @isIntegral_connectedComponent_of_isFiniteEtale_of_isAffine
      (U y) (V y) (Y.hom ∣_ U y) (hrestrEtale y) hUint hUnormal
      (hUaffine y) (hfiniteComponents y) (i y)
  have hWintegral (y : Y.left) : IsIntegral (W y) := by
    let : IsIntegral (Z y) := hZintegral y
    have : IsOpenImmersion (j y) := hjOpen y
    let e : Z y ≅ W y :=
      IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq (j y) (W y).ι <| by
        rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
        exact (Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange (j y)).symm
    exact IsIntegral.of_isIso e.hom
  have hWcover : (⨆ y, W y) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro y _
    apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    have : Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents (V y)) :=
      hfiniteComponents y
    let v : V y := ⟨y, hyV y⟩
    let z : Z y := by
      dsimp only [Z]
      refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
      change _root_.ConnectedComponents.mk v ∈
        ({i y} : Set (_root_.ConnectedComponents (V y)))
      exact Set.mem_singleton _
    let : IsOpenImmersion (j y) := hjOpen y
    change y ∈ (j y).opensRange
    exact Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr ⟨z, rfl⟩
  let : IrreducibleSpace Y.left :=
    irreducibleSpace_of_connectedSpace_of_irreducible_openCover
      W hWcover (fun y ↦ by
        let : IsIntegral (W y) := hWintegral y
        exact irreducibleSpace_of_isIntegral (W y))
  let : IsReduced Y.left := by
    have hstalk (y : Y.left) : _root_.IsReduced (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y) := by
      have hyW : ∃ z, y ∈ W z := by
        apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp
        rw [hWcover]
        trivial
      obtain ⟨z, hyz⟩ := hyW
      let : IsIntegral (W z) := hWintegral z
      let w : (W z : Scheme) := ⟨y, hyz⟩
      let e : Y.left.presheaf.stalk y ≃+* (W z : Scheme).presheaf.stalk w :=
        (asIso ((W z).ι.stalkMap w)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
      exact isReduced_of_injective e.toRingHom e.injective
    exact isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk Y.left
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced Y.left

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocallyNoetherian_left_finiteEtale
statement:
theorem isLocallyNoetherian_left_finiteEtale
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.left
proof:
:=
  @LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian Y.left X Y.hom
    (((IsFinite.iff_isIntegralHom_and_locallyOfFiniteType Y.hom).mp
      Y.prop.toIsFinite).2)
    (inferInstance : IsLocallyNoetherian X)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isNormalIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale
statement:
theorem isNormalIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    IsNormalIntegral Y.left := by
  classical
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  apply IsNormalIntegral.of_stalks Y.left
  intro y
  have hAffine :
      ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ Y.hom.base y ∈ U ∧ U ≤ ⊤ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
      (X := X) (U := ⊤) (x := Y.hom.base y) trivial
  let U : X.Opens := Classical.choose hAffine
  have hUaffine : IsAffineOpen U :=
    (Classical.choose_spec hAffine).1
  have hyU : Y.hom.base y ∈ U :=
    (Classical.choose_spec hAffine).2.1
  have hUnonempty : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨Y.hom.base y, hyU⟩⟩
  let V : Y.left.Opens := Y.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U
  have hyV : y ∈ V := hyU
  have hrestrEtale : IsFiniteEtale (Y.hom ∣_ U) := by
    exact MorphismProperty.of_isPullback
      (isPullback_morphismRestrict Y.hom U).flip Y.2
  have hfiniteComponents :
      Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents V) := by
    let : Nonempty U := hUnonempty
    let : IsAffine U := hUaffine
    let A : FiniteEtale U :=
      @FiniteEtale.mk _ _ (Y.hom ∣_ U) hrestrEtale
    change Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents A.left)
    infer_instance
  let v : V := ⟨y, hyV⟩
  let i : _root_.ConnectedComponents V :=
    _root_.ConnectedComponents.mk v
  let C : (V : Scheme).OpenCover :=
    letI : Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents V) := hfiniteComponents
    (V : Scheme).connectedComponents
  let Z : Scheme.{u} := C.X i
  let c : Z ⟶ V := C.f i
  have hcOpen : IsOpenImmersion c := by
    let : Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents V) := hfiniteComponents
    dsimp only [c, C, Scheme.connectedComponents]
    exact (Scheme.connCompOpen (X := (V : Scheme)) i).instIsOpenImmersionι
  have hcClosed : IsClosedImmersion c := by
    dsimp only [c]
    infer_instance
  let g : Z ⟶ U := c ≫ (Y.hom ∣_ U)
  have hcFiniteEtale : IsFiniteEtale c :=
    { toIsFinite := inferInstance
      toEtale := inferInstance }
  have hgFiniteEtale : IsFiniteEtale g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    exact MorphismProperty.comp_mem @IsFiniteEtale
      c (Y.hom ∣_ U) hcFiniteEtale hrestrEtale
  have hZintegral : IsIntegral Z := by
    let : Nonempty U := hUnonempty
    let : IsAffine U := hUaffine
    let hUint : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι
    let : IsIntegral U := hUint
    let hUnormal : IsNormalIntegral U := inferInstance
    let : Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents V) := hfiniteComponents
    change IsIntegral ((V : Scheme).connectedComponents.X i)
    exact @isIntegral_connectedComponent_of_isFiniteEtale_of_isAffine
      U V (Y.hom ∣_ U) hrestrEtale hUint hUnormal hUaffine
      hfiniteComponents i
  have hZnormal : @IsNormalIntegral Z hZintegral := by
    let : Nonempty U := hUnonempty
    let : IsAffine U := hUaffine
    let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι
    let : IsNormalIntegral U := inferInstance
    let : IsIntegral Z := hZintegral
    let : IsFiniteEtale g := hgFiniteEtale
    let : IsAffine Z := isAffine_of_isAffineHom g
    let R := Γ(U, ⊤)
    let T := Γ(Z, ⊤)
    let K := (U : Scheme).functionField
    let : Nonempty (⊤ : (U : Scheme).Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨Classical.choice hUnonempty, trivial⟩⟩
    let : Algebra R T := g.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    let : Module.Finite R T := by
      rw [← RingHom.finite_algebraMap]
      exact g.finite_appTop
    have hgEtale : g.appTop.hom.Etale := by
      rw [← HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine
        (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale)]
      infer_instance
    let : Algebra.Etale R T := hgEtale.toAlgebra
    let : IsIntegrallyClosed R :=
      IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top U)
    let : Algebra R K := (U : Scheme).affineExtensionAlgebra ⊤ K
    let : IsFractionRing R K :=
      functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen (U : Scheme) ⊤
        (isAffineOpen_top (U : Scheme))
    let : ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum T) := by
      change ConnectedSpace (Spec (.of T))
      exact Z.isoSpec.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mp inferInstance
    let : IsIntegrallyClosed T :=
      finiteEtale_isIntegrallyClosed_of_connectedSpace_primeSpectrum
        (R := R) (T := T) (K := K)
    exact IsNormalIntegral.of_isAffine Z
  let j : Z ⟶ Y.left := c ≫ V.ι
  have hjOpen : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j]
    exact MorphismProperty.comp_mem @IsOpenImmersion
      c V.ι hcOpen inferInstance
  let z : Z := by
    dsimp only [Z, C]
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    change _root_.ConnectedComponents.mk v ∈
      ({i} : Set (_root_.ConnectedComponents V))
    exact Set.mem_singleton _
  let : IsIntegral Z := hZintegral
  let : IsNormalIntegral Z := hZnormal
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := hjOpen
  have hzNormal : IsIntegrallyClosed (Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    IsNormalIntegral.stalk_isIntegrallyClosed z
  let e : Z.presheaf.stalk z ≃+* Y.left.presheaf.stalk (j z) :=
    (asIso (j.stalkMap z)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hjz : j z = y := rfl
  have htarget :=
    (@IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv
      (Z.presheaf.stalk z) (Y.left.presheaf.stalk (j z))
      _ _ e hzNormal)
  rw [hjz] at htarget
  exact htarget

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.pullback_obj_isConnected_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem pullback_obj_isConnected_of_isOpenImmersion
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [Nonempty U]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] :
    IsConnected ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : ConnectedSpace X := inferInstance
  let : ConnectedSpace U := inferInstance
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let P : FiniteEtale U := (FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj Y
  let : Nonempty P.left :=
    FiniteEtale.pullback_obj_nonempty j Y
  let iP : P.left ⟶ Y.left :=
    pullback.fst Y.hom j
  have hiP : IsOpenImmersion iP := by
    dsimp only [iP]
    exact MorphismProperty.pullback_fst Y.hom j
      (show IsOpenImmersion j from inferInstance)
  let : IsOpenImmersion iP := hiP
  let : IsIntegral P.left := by
    exact isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion iP
  let : ConnectedSpace P.left := inferInstance
  exact FiniteEtale.isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_essSurj_of_connected
statement:
theorem pullback_essSurj_of_connected
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace X] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : ∀ Z : FiniteEtale X, IsConnected Z →
      ∃ W : FiniteEtale Y, Nonempty ((pullback f).obj W ≅ Z)) :
    (pullback f).EssSurj
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro Z
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, C, eZ, hC⟩ := has_decomp_connected_components' Z
  let W (i : ι) : FiniteEtale Y :=
    Classical.choose (h (C i) (hC i))
  let e (i : ι) : (pullback f).obj (W i) ≅ C i :=
    Classical.choice (Classical.choose_spec (h (C i) (hC i)))
  let : Finite ι := hι
  refine ⟨colimit (Discrete.functor W), ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact PreservesCoproduct.iso (pullback f) W ≪≫
    Sigma.mapIso e ≪≫ eZ

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isAdicComplete_of_moduleFinite_of_moduleFree
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_of_moduleFinite_of_moduleFree
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (I : Ideal R) [StrongRankCondition R]
    [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R M]
    [IsAdicComplete I R] :
    IsAdicComplete I M
proof:
:= by
  let n := Module.finrank R M
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M := Module.finBasis R M
  have hpi : IsAdicComplete I (Fin n → R) := by
    rw [← AdicCompletion.of_bijective_iff]
    let e : (Fin n → R) ≃ₗ[R] AdicCompletion I (Fin n → R) :=
      (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight
          (fun _ : Fin n ↦ AdicCompletion.ofLinearEquiv I R)).trans
        ((AdicCompletion.piEquivFin I n).symm.restrictScalars R)
    have heq : (e : (Fin n → R) → AdicCompletion I (Fin n → R)) =
        AdicCompletion.of I (Fin n → R) := by
      funext x
      apply (AdicCompletion.piEquivFin I n).injective
      funext i
      calc
        (AdicCompletion.piEquivFin I n (e x)) i =
            AdicCompletion.ofLinearEquiv I R (x i) := by
          simp [e]
        _ = AdicCompletion.of I R (x i) := rfl
        _ = (AdicCompletion.piEquivFin I n
            (AdicCompletion.of I (Fin n → R) x)) i := by
          rw [AdicCompletion.piEquivFin_apply]
          exact (AdicCompletion.map_of I (LinearMap.proj i) x).symm
    rw [← heq]
    exact e.bijective
  let : IsAdicComplete I (Fin n → R) := hpi
  exact
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.isAdicComplete_of_linearEquiv
      I b.equivFun.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.henselianLocalRing_of_finiteEtale_local_of_isAdicComplete
statement:
theorem henselianLocalRing_of_finiteEtale_local_of_isAdicComplete
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R]
    [Module.Finite R S] [Algebra.Etale R S] :
    HenselianLocalRing S
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Free R S := Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  have hcomplete :
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) S :=
    isAdicComplete_of_moduleFinite_of_moduleFree
      (I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (M := S)
  have hm :
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal
  have hcompleteMax :
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) S := by
    rw [← hm]
    exact (ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.isAdicComplete_map_algebraMap_iff
      (R := R) (S := S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)).2 hcomplete
  let : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) S := hcompleteMax
  let : HenselianRing S (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) := inferInstance
  refine { is_henselian := ?_ }
  intro f hf x hx hderivative
  exact HenselianRing.is_henselian f hf x hx
    (hderivative.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleSpace_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant
statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X)
    [IsPreimmersion f] [IsDominant f] [IrreducibleSpace X] :
    IrreducibleSpace U
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty U := f.denseRange.nonempty
  let hpre : PreirreducibleSpace U :=
    PreirreducibleSpace.of_forall_nonempty_inter
      (fun {A B} hA hB hAne hBne ↦ by
        obtain ⟨A', hA'open, hA'⟩ :=
          f.isEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff.mp hA
        obtain ⟨B', hB'open, hB'⟩ :=
          f.isEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff.mp hB
        have hA'ne : A'.Nonempty := by
          obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hAne
          refine ⟨f a, ?_⟩
          change a ∈ f ⁻¹' A'
          rwa [hA']
        have hB'ne : B'.Nonempty := by
          obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hBne
          refine ⟨f b, ?_⟩
          change b ∈ f ⁻¹' B'
          rwa [hB']
        have hAB'ne : (A' ∩ B').Nonempty :=
          nonempty_preirreducible_inter hA'open hB'open hA'ne hB'ne
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
          f.denseRange.exists_mem_open (hA'open.inter hB'open) hAB'ne
        refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← hA']
          exact ha.1
        · rw [← hB']
          exact ha.2)
  exact { toPreirreducibleSpace := hpre, toNonempty := inferInstance }

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_obj_isConnected_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant
statement:
theorem pullback_obj_isConnected_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant
    {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [ConnectedSpace U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [hjpre : IsPreimmersion j]
    [hjdom : IsDominant j] [hjqc : QuasiCompact j]
    (W : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected W] :
    IsConnected ((pullback j).obj W)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let P : FiniteEtale U := (pullback j).obj W
  let iP : P.left ⟶ W.left := Limits.pullback.fst W.hom j
  let : IsPreimmersion iP := by
    dsimp only [iP]
    exact MorphismProperty.pullback_fst (P := @IsPreimmersion)
      W.hom j hjpre
  let hstd : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant j :=
    IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isDominant j
  let hflat : Flat W.hom :=
    Etale.iff_flat_and_formallyUnramified.mp W.prop.toEtale |>.1
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant iP := by
    dsimp only [iP]
    exact @IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.pullbackFst _ _ _
      W.hom j hstd hjqc hflat
  let : QuasiCompact iP := by
    dsimp only [iP]
    exact MorphismProperty.pullback_fst (P := @QuasiCompact)
      W.hom j hjqc
  let : IsDominant iP := inferInstance
  let : IrreducibleSpace P.left :=
    irreducibleSpace_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant iP
  let : ConnectedSpace P.left := inferInstance
  exact isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_obj_isGalois_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant
statement:
theorem pullback_obj_isGalois_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant
    {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [ConnectedSpace U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [hjpre : IsPreimmersion j]
    [hjdom : IsDominant j] [hjqc : QuasiCompact j]
    (W : FiniteEtale X) (hW : IsGalois W) :
    IsGalois ((pullback j).obj W)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  let P : FiniteEtale U := (pullback j).obj W
  have hPconn : IsConnected P :=
    pullback_obj_isConnected_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant j W
  let : IsConnected P := hPconn
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant j :=
    IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isDominant j
  let F := pullback j
  let : F.Faithful := pullback_faithful_of_isDominant j
  have hAutInj : Function.Injective (F.mapAut W) := by
    intro σ τ hστ
    apply Aut.ext
    apply F.map_injective
    exact congrArg Iso.hom hστ
  have hAutLe : Nat.card (Aut W) ≤ Nat.card (Aut P) :=
    Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (F.mapAut W) hAutInj
  let u : U := Classical.choice j.denseRange.nonempty
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure (U.residueField u)
  let ξ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (U.residueField u) Ω)) ≫
      U.fromSpecResidueField u
  let xΩ := IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω
  have hWcard : Nat.card (Aut W) =
      W.hom.finrank ((ξ ≫ j) xΩ) :=
    (isGalois_iff_card_aut_eq_finrank (ξ ≫ j) W).mp hW
  have hrank : P.hom.finrank (ξ xΩ) =
      W.hom.finrank ((ξ ≫ j) xΩ) := by
    change (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom j).finrank (ξ xΩ) =
      W.hom.finrank (j (ξ xΩ))
    have hpb : IsPullback
        (Limits.pullback.fst W.hom j)
        (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom j) W.hom j :=
      IsPullback.of_hasPullback W.hom j
    exact Scheme.Hom.finrank_of_isPullback
      (Limits.pullback.fst W.hom j)
      (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom j) W.hom j hpb (ξ xΩ)
  have hUpper : Nat.card (Aut P) ≤ P.hom.finrank (ξ xΩ) := by
    have h := card_aut_le_card_fiber_of_connected (fiber ξ) P
    rwa [natCard_fiber_eq_finrank ξ P] at h
  apply (isGalois_iff_card_aut_eq_finrank ξ P).mpr
  apply Nat.le_antisymm hUpper
  calc
    P.hom.finrank (ξ xΩ) = W.hom.finrank ((ξ ≫ j) xΩ) := hrank
    _ = Nat.card (Aut W) := hWcard.symm
    _ ≤ Nat.card (Aut P) := hAutLe

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_fiber_fixed_of_image_fixed
statement:
theorem pullback_fiber_fixed_of_image_fixed
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (W : FiniteEtale Y)
    (hfixed : ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point)) (w : (fiber (point ≫ f)).obj W),
      fundamentalGroupHom f point g • w = w) :
    ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point)) (w : (fiber point).obj ((pullback f).obj W)),
      g • w = w
proof:
:= by
  intro g w
  let t := pullbackFiberIso f point
  have hm : g ∈ (MulAction.stabilizer (Aut (fiber (point ≫ f))) ((t.app W).hom w)).comap
      (PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso (pullback f) t).toMonoidHom :=
    hfixed g ((t.app W).hom w)
  rw [← PreGaloisCategory.stabilizer_transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) t] at hm
  have hw : PreGaloisCategory.transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) t W
      ((t.app W).hom w) = w := FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply (t.app W) w
  rw [hw] at hm
  exact hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.image_fixed_of_pullback_fiber_fixed
statement:
theorem image_fixed_of_pullback_fiber_fixed
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (W : FiniteEtale Y)
    (hfixed : ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point))
      (w : (fiber point).obj ((pullback f).obj W)), g • w = w) :
    ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point)) (w : (fiber (point ≫ f)).obj W),
      fundamentalGroupHom f point g • w = w
proof:
:= by
  intro g w
  let t := pullbackFiberIso f point
  have hm : g ∈ MulAction.stabilizer (Aut (fiber point))
      (PreGaloisCategory.transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) t W w) :=
    hfixed g _
  rw [PreGaloisCategory.stabilizer_transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback f) t] at hm
  exact hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_tensor_algEquiv_pi_of_image_fixed
statement:
theorem exists_tensor_algEquiv_pi_of_image_fixed
    (K L B : Type u) [CommRing K] [Field L] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K B]
    [IsFiniteEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B)))]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of L))
    (hfixed : ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point))
      (w : (fiber (point ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).obj
        (mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))))),
      fundamentalGroupHom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) point g • w = w) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Finite ι), Nonempty ((L ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[L] (ι → L))
proof:
:= by
  let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
  let W : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of K)) := mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B)))
  let P : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of L)) := (pullback f).obj W
  let e : Spec (.of (L ⊗[K] B)) ≅ P.left :=
    (pullbackSpecIso K L B).symm ≪≫ pullbackSymmetry f W.hom
  have he : e.hom ≫ P.hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] B))) := by
    change ((pullbackSpecIso K L B).inv ≫
        (pullbackSymmetry (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B)))).hom) ≫
      Limits.pullback.snd (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) = _
    rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd]
    exact pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst' K L B
  let : IsFiniteEtale e.hom := .mk
  let : IsFiniteEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] B)))) := by
    rw [← he]
    infer_instance
  let T : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of L)) :=
    mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] B))))
  let E : T ≅ P := MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk e he
  apply exists_algEquiv_pi_of_fiber_fixed L (L ⊗[K] B) point
  intro g w
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((fiber point).map E.hom)).injective
  rw [← PreGaloisCategory.mulAction_naturality]
  exact pullback_fiber_fixed_of_image_fixed f point W hfixed g ((fiber point).map E.hom w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_obj_nonempty
statement:
theorem pullback_obj_nonempty {S T : Scheme.{u}} [PreconnectedSpace T]
    (f : S ⟶ T) [Nonempty S] (Y : FiniteEtale T) [Nonempty Y.left] :
    Nonempty ((pullback f).obj Y).left
proof:
:= by
  let : IsFiniteEtale Y.hom := Y.2
  let : PreconnectedSpace ↑((Functor.fromPUnit T).obj Y.right) := by
    change PreconnectedSpace T
    infer_instance
  let : Nonempty ((Functor.id Scheme).obj Y.left) := by
    change Nonempty Y.left
    infer_instance
  let : Surjective Y.hom := IsFiniteEtale.surjective Y.hom
  obtain ⟨s⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty S)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Y.hom.surjective (f.base s)
  obtain ⟨z, -, -⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback y s hy
  exact ⟨z⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.notInitial_of_nonempty_left
statement:
theorem notInitial_of_nonempty_left (Y : FiniteEtale X) [Nonempty Y.left] :
    IsInitial Y → False
proof:
:= by
  let x : X := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X)
  let k : Type u := X.residueField x
  let Ω : Type u := AlgebraicClosure k
  let ξ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap k Ω) ≫
      X.fromSpecResidueField x
  let F := fiber ξ
  apply (not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty F Y).mpr
  let : IsFiniteEtale Y.hom := Y.2
  let : PreconnectedSpace ↑((Functor.fromPUnit X).obj Y.right) := by
    change PreconnectedSpace X
    infer_instance
  let : Nonempty ((Functor.id Scheme).obj Y.left) := by
    change Nonempty Y.left
    infer_instance
  let : Surjective Y.hom := IsFiniteEtale.surjective Y.hom
  obtain ⟨ω⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Spec (.of Ω)))
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Y.hom.surjective (ξ.base ω)
  obtain ⟨z, -, -⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback y ω hy
  exact ⟨z⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.nonempty_left_of_notInitial
statement:
theorem nonempty_left_of_notInitial (Y : FiniteEtale X)
    (hY : IsInitial Y → False) : Nonempty Y.left
proof:
:= by
  let x : X := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X)
  let k : Type u := X.residueField x
  let Ω : Type u := AlgebraicClosure k
  let ξ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap k Ω) ≫
      X.fromSpecResidueField x
  let F := fiber ξ
  exact ((not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty F Y).mp hY).map
    fun z ↦ fiberPt z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedSpace_left_of_isConnected
statement:
theorem connectedSpace_left_of_isConnected (Y : FiniteEtale X)
    [IsConnected Y] : ConnectedSpace Y.left
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty Y.left :=
    nonempty_left_of_notInitial Y IsConnected.notInitial
  let y : Y.left := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Y.left)
  let : Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents Y.left) := inferInstance
  let cover := Y.left.connectedComponents
  let i : _root_.ConnectedComponents Y.left :=
    _root_.ConnectedComponents.mk y
  let : ConnectedSpace (cover.X i) := by
    dsimp only [cover]
    infer_instance
  let hY : IsFiniteEtale Y.hom := Y.2
  let hcomp : IsFiniteEtale (cover.f i ≫ Y.hom) := by
    let _ : IsOpenImmersion (cover.f i) := by
      dsimp only [cover, Scheme.connectedComponents]
      infer_instance
    have hComponent : IsFiniteEtale (cover.f i) :=
      @IsFiniteEtale.mk _ _ _ inferInstance inferInstance
    exact MorphismProperty.comp_mem
      (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) _ _ hComponent hY
  let Z : FiniteEtale X :=
    @FiniteEtale.mk _ _ (cover.f i ≫ Y.hom) hcomp
  let j : Z ⟶ Y :=
    MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (by
      simpa only [Z, FiniteEtale.mk_left] using cover.f i)
  let : Mono j := by
    apply (FiniteEtale.forget _ ⋙ Over.forget _).mono_of_mono_map
    change Mono (cover.f i)
    infer_instance
  let : Nonempty Z.left := by
    have : Nonempty (cover.X i) := by
      refine ⟨⟨y, ?_⟩⟩
      change _root_.ConnectedComponents.mk y ∈
        ({i} : Set (_root_.ConnectedComponents Y.left))
      simp [i]
    simpa only [Z, FiniteEtale.mk_left] using this
  let : IsIso j :=
    IsConnected.noTrivialComponent Z j
      (notInitial_of_nonempty_left Z)
  let hjhom : IsIso j.hom := (FiniteEtale.forget X).map_isIso j
  let : IsIso j.left :=
    @Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ (Over.forget X) j.hom hjhom
  let eZ : Z.left ≅ cover.X i :=
    eqToIso (by simp only [Z, FiniteEtale.mk_left])
  let : ConnectedSpace Z.left :=
    eZ.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance
  exact (@asIso _ _ _ _ j.left inferInstance).hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mp
    (inferInstance : ConnectedSpace Z.left)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left
statement:
theorem isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left (Y : FiniteEtale X)
    [ConnectedSpace Y.left] : IsConnected Y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact notInitial_of_nonempty_left Y
  · intro Z i _ hZ
    let : Nonempty Z.left := nonempty_left_of_notInitial Z hZ
    obtain ⟨hiOpen, hiClosed⟩ :=
      (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.mono_iff X Z Y i).mp inferInstance
    let : IsOpenImmersion i.left := hiOpen
    let : IsClosedImmersion i.left := hiClosed
    have hRangeNonempty : (Set.range i.left.base).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨z⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty Z.left)
      exact ⟨i.left.base z, z, rfl⟩
    have hRange : Set.range i.left.base = Set.univ :=
      IsClopen.eq_univ
        ⟨i.left.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range,
          i.left.isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range⟩
        hRangeNonempty
    have hOpensRange : i.left.opensRange = ⊤ := by
      rw [← SetLike.coe_injective.eq_iff]
      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange,
        TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top] using hRange
    let : IsIso i.left :=
      isIso_of_isOpenImmersion_of_opensRange_eq_top i.left hOpensRange
    exact isIso_of_isIso_left i

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.regularSystem_map_of_etale_local
statement:
theorem regularSystem_map_of_etale_local
    {A : Type u} {C : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [Algebra A C]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing C]
    [Algebra.Etale A C]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C)]
    {ps : List A}
    (hreg : IsRegular A ps)
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList ps = maximalIdeal A) :
    IsRegular C (ps.map (algebraMap A C)) ∧
      Ideal.ofList (ps.map (algebraMap A C)) = maximalIdeal C
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A C :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  have hregC : IsRegular C (ps.map (algebraMap A C)) :=
    hreg.of_faithfullyFlat
  have hgenC : Ideal.ofList (ps.map (algebraMap A C)) = maximalIdeal C := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList (ps.map (algebraMap A C)) =
          (Ideal.ofList ps).map (algebraMap A C) := by
        rw [Ideal.map_ofList]
      _ = (maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A C) := by rw [hgen]
      _ = maximalIdeal C :=
        Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal
  exact ⟨hregC, hgenC⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_regularSystem_geometry
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_regularSystem_geometry
    {A : Type u} {C : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [Algebra A C]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Module.Finite A C] [Algebra.Etale A C]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C)]
    {ps : List A}
    (hreg : IsRegular A ps)
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList ps = maximalIdeal A) :
    IsNoetherianRing C ∧
      IsDomain C ∧
      IsRegular C (ps.map (algebraMap A C)) ∧
      Ideal.ofList (ps.map (algebraMap A C)) = maximalIdeal C ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing C ∧
      (∀ p ∈ ps.map (algebraMap A C), Prime p) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ ps.map (algebraMap A C),
        IsDomain (C ⧸ Ideal.span {p}) ∧
          IsRegularLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {p}))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsNoetherianRing C := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite A C
  obtain ⟨hregC, hgenC⟩ :=
    regularSystem_map_of_etale_local
      (A := A) (C := C) (ps := ps) hreg hgen
  have hdomainC : IsDomain C :=
    Kummer.isDomain_of_regularSystem
      (ps.map (algebraMap A C)) hregC hgenC
  have hregularC : IsRegularLocalRing C :=
    Kummer.isRegularLocalRing_of_regularSystem
      (ps.map (algebraMap A C)) hregC hgenC
  refine ⟨inferInstance, hdomainC, hregC, hgenC, hregularC, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    exact Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem hregC hgenC hp
  · intro p hp
    exact Kummer.quotient_geometry_of_mem_regularSystem hregC hgenC hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_isEquivalence_of_henselian
statement:
@[stacks 09ZS]
theorem pullback_isEquivalence_of_henselian
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] :
    (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback
      ((@IsFinite : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) ⊓ @Etale) ⊤
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I))))).IsEquivalence
proof:
:=
  (pullback_specMap_isEquivalence_iff R (R ⧸ I)).mpr
    (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange_isEquivalence_of_henselian I)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] : DenseRange Y.hom
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsFiniteEtale Y.hom := Y.2
  let : PreconnectedSpace ↑((Functor.fromPUnit X).obj Y.right) := by
    change PreconnectedSpace X
    infer_instance
  let : Nonempty ((Functor.id Scheme).obj Y.left) := by
    change Nonempty Y.left
    infer_instance
  let : Surjective Y.hom := IsFiniteEtale.surjective Y.hom
  exact Y.hom.surjective.denseRange

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_functionFieldMap_essFiniteType
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_functionFieldMap_essFiniteType
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] :
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom).functionFieldMap
      (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y)).EssFiniteType := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsFiniteEtale (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) := Y.2
  unfold Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap
  rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    RingHom.EssFiniteType.respectsIso.cancel_left_isIso]
  exact LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap
    (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) (genericPoint Y.left)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]

    letI : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    FiniteDimensional X.functionField Y.left.functionField := by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
    finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra.EssFiniteType X.functionField Y.left.functionField := by

    change ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom).functionFieldMap

    X.functionField Y.left.functionField

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.coproductComparison_component
statement:
private theorem coproductComparison_component
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {ι : Type*} [HasColimitsOfShape (Discrete ι) C] [HasColimitsOfShape (Discrete ι) D]
    (H : C ⥤ D) [PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete ι) H]
    {A B W : C} (t : A ≅ B) (e : (∐ fun _ : ι => A) ≅ W) (i : ι) :
    Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι => H.obj B) i ≫
        ((Sigma.mapIso (fun _ : ι => H.mapIso t)).inv ≫
          sigmaComparison H (fun _ : ι => A) ≫ (H.mapIso e).hom) =
      H.map (t.inv ≫ Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι => A) i ≫ e.hom)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Sigma.ι_mapIso_inv_assoc, Functor.mapIso_inv,
    ι_comp_sigmaComparison_assoc, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_specPi_iso_of_terminal_coproduct
statement:
theorem exists_specPi_iso_of_terminal_coproduct
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (W : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of R)))
    (ι : Type u) [Finite ι]
    (e : (∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ (FiniteEtale (Spec (.of R)))) ≅ W) :
    ∃ E : Spec (.of (ι → R)) ≅ W.left,
      E.hom ≫ W.hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (ι → R)))
proof:
:= by
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let H := forget X ⋙ Over.forget X
  let : IsFiniteEtale (𝟙 X) := .mk
  let T : FiniteEtale X := mk (𝟙 X)
  let t : ⊤_ (FiniteEtale X) ≅ T := terminalIsTerminal.uniqueUpToIso
    (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) X)
  let s : (∐ fun _ : ι => X) ≅ W.left :=
    (Sigma.mapIso (fun _ : ι => H.mapIso t)).symm ≪≫
      asIso (sigmaComparison H (fun _ : ι => ⊤_ (FiniteEtale X))) ≪≫ H.mapIso e
  have hs (i : ι) : Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι => X) i ≫ s.hom ≫ W.hom = 𝟙 X := by
    have hi := coproductComparison_component H t e i
    change Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι => X) i ≫ s.hom =
      (t.inv ≫ Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι => ⊤_ (FiniteEtale X)) i ≫ e.hom).left at hi
    have hw : (t.inv ≫ Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι => ⊤_ (FiniteEtale X)) i ≫ e.hom).left ≫
        W.hom = 𝟙 X := (t.inv ≫ Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι => ⊤_ (FiniteEtale X)) i ≫ e.hom).w
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun f => f ≫ W.hom) hi).trans hw)
  have hd : s.hom ≫ W.hom = sigmaSpec (fun _ : ι => CommRingCat.of R) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (ι → R))) := by
    apply Sigma.hom_ext
    intro i
    have hpi : Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι => X) i ≫ sigmaSpec (fun _ : ι => CommRingCat.of R) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (ι → R))) = 𝟙 X := by
      rw [ι_sigmaSpec_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
      exact Spec.map_id _
    exact (hs i).trans hpi.symm
  refine ⟨(asIso (sigmaSpec (fun _ : ι => CommRingCat.of R))).symm ≪≫ s, ?_⟩
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    ((Iso.inv_comp_eq (asIso (sigmaSpec (fun _ : ι => CommRingCat.of R)))).mpr hd)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_specPi_iso_of_fiber_fixed
statement:
theorem exists_specPi_iso_of_fiber_fixed
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [ConnectedSpace (Spec (.of R))]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of R)))
    (hfixed : ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point)) (w : (fiber point).obj W), g • w = w) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Finite ι) (E : Spec (.of (ι → R)) ≅ W.left),
      E.hom ≫ W.hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (ι → R)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    (PreGaloisCategory.exists_iso_finite_coproduct_terminal_iff_fixed
      (F'' := fiber point) W).mpr hfixed
  let : Finite ι := hι
  let eLift : (∐ fun _ : ULift.{u} ι => ⊤_ (FiniteEtale (Spec (.of R)))) ≅ W :=
    Sigma.reindex (Equiv.ulift : ULift.{u} ι ≃ ι)
      (fun _ : ι => ⊤_ (FiniteEtale (Spec (.of R)))) ≪≫ e
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ :=
    exists_specPi_iso_of_terminal_coproduct R W (ULift.{u} ι) eLift
  exact ⟨ULift.{u} ι, inferInstance, E, hE⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_algEquiv_pi_of_fiber_fixed
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_pi_of_fiber_fixed
    (R B : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [IsFiniteEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))]
    [ConnectedSpace (Spec (.of R))]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hfixed : ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point))
      (w : (fiber point).obj (mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))))),
      g • w = w) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Finite ι), Nonempty (B ≃ₐ[R] (ι → R))
proof:
:= by
  let W : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of R)) :=
    mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, E, hE⟩ := exists_specPi_iso_of_fiber_fixed R point W hfixed
  let : Finite ι := hι
  let eA : CommRingCat.of B ≅ CommRingCat.of (ι → R) :=
    (Scheme.Spec.preimageIso E).unop
  have hmap : Spec.map eA.hom = E.hom := by
    change Scheme.Spec.map (Scheme.Spec.preimage E.hom) = E.hom
    exact Scheme.Spec.map_preimage E.hom
  have hbase : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B) ≫ eA.hom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (ι → R)) := by
    have hop : (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B) ≫ eA.hom).op =
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (ι → R))).op := by
      apply Scheme.Spec.map_injective
      change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B) ≫ eA.hom) = _
      rw [Spec.map_comp, hmap]
      exact hE
    exact congrArg Quiver.Hom.unop hop
  exact ⟨ι, hι, ⟨{ eA.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with
    commutes' := fun r => ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hbase r }⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.ContAction.hom_apply_rho
statement:
private lemma hom_apply_rho {X Y : Action FintypeCat.{u} G}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : G) (x : X.V) :
    ConcreteCategory.hom f.hom (ConcreteCategory.hom (X.ρ g) x) =
      ConcreteCategory.hom (Y.ρ g) (ConcreteCategory.hom f.hom x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [FintypeCat.comp_apply] using
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.comm g) x

name: CategoryTheory.ContAction.isContinuous_of_finite_limit
statement:
private lemma isContinuous_of_finite_limit
    {J : Type} [SmallCategory J] [FinCategory J]
    (F : J ⥤ Action FintypeCat.{u} G) (c : Cone F) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (hF : ∀ j, Action.IsContinuous (F.obj j)) :
    Action.IsContinuous c.pt
proof:
:= by
  rw [Action.isContinuous_def]
  change Continuous (fun p : G × c.pt.V ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (c.pt.ρ p.1) p.2)
  rw [continuous_prod_of_discrete_right]
  intro x
  rw [continuous_discrete_rng]
  intro y
  have hpreimage :
      (fun g : G ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (c.pt.ρ g) x) ⁻¹' ({y} : Set _) =
        ⋂ j : J, (fun g : G ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom ((F.obj j).ρ g)
          (ConcreteCategory.hom (c.π.app j).hom x)) ⁻¹'
            ({ConcreteCategory.hom (c.π.app j).hom y} : Set _) := by
    ext g
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro h j
      have hcomm := hom_apply_rho (X := c.pt) (c.π.app j) g x
      exact hcomm.symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun z ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (c.π.app j).hom z) h)
    · intro h
      apply Concrete.isLimit_ext (F ⋙ Action.forget FintypeCat G)
        (isLimitOfPreserves (Action.forget FintypeCat G) hc)
      intro j
      change ConcreteCategory.hom (c.π.app j).hom
          (ConcreteCategory.hom (c.pt.ρ g) x) =
        ConcreteCategory.hom (c.π.app j).hom y
      exact (hom_apply_rho (X := c.pt) (c.π.app j) g x).trans (h j)
  rw [hpreimage]
  apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite
  intro j
  have hcontinuous :
      Continuous (fun p : G × (F.obj j).V ↦
        ConcreteCategory.hom ((F.obj j).ρ p.1) p.2) :=
    (Action.isContinuous_def (F.obj j)).mp (hF j)
  exact (isOpen_discrete _).preimage
    (hcontinuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const))

name: CategoryTheory.ContAction.isContinuous_of_finite_colimit
statement:
private lemma isContinuous_of_finite_colimit
    {J : Type} [SmallCategory J] [FinCategory J]
    (F : J ⥤ Action FintypeCat.{u} G) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (hF : ∀ j, Action.IsContinuous (F.obj j)) :
    Action.IsContinuous c.pt
proof:
:= by
  rw [Action.isContinuous_def]
  change Continuous (fun p : G × c.pt.V ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (c.pt.ρ p.1) p.2)
  rw [continuous_prod_of_discrete_right]
  intro x
  obtain ⟨j, y, hy⟩ := FintypeCat.jointly_surjective
    (F ⋙ Action.forget FintypeCat G)
    ((Action.forget FintypeCat G).mapCocone c)
    (isColimitOfPreserves (Action.forget FintypeCat G) hc) x
  have hcontinuous :
      Continuous (fun p : G × (F.obj j).V ↦
        ConcreteCategory.hom ((F.obj j).ρ p.1) p.2) :=
    (Action.isContinuous_def (F.obj j)).mp (hF j)
  have horbit :
      Continuous (fun g : G ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom ((F.obj j).ρ g) y) :=
    hcontinuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hleg :
      Continuous (fun z : (F.obj j).V ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (c.ι.app j).hom z) :=
    continuous_of_discreteTopology
  rw [← hy]
  exact (hleg.comp horbit).congr fun g ↦
    hom_apply_rho (Y := c.pt) (c.ι.app j) g y

name: CategoryTheory.ContAction.full_res
statement:
lemma full_res (f : G →ₜ* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (ContAction.res V f).Full
proof:
:= by
  let : (Action.res V f.toMonoidHom).Full :=
    Action.full_res V f.toMonoidHom hf
  change (ObjectProperty.lift (Action.isContinuous V G)
    ((Action.isContinuous V H).ι ⋙ Action.res V f.toMonoidHom) _).Full
  let : (((Action.isContinuous V H).ι ⋙ Action.res V f.toMonoidHom)).Full :=
    Functor.Full.comp (Action.isContinuous V H).ι (Action.res V f.toMonoidHom)
  exact Functor.Full.of_comp_faithful_iso
    ((Action.isContinuous V G).liftCompιIso
      ((Action.isContinuous V H).ι ⋙ Action.res V f.toMonoidHom) _)

name: CategoryTheory.ContAction.exists_openNormalSubgroup_comap_le
statement:
private theorem exists_openNormalSubgroup_comap_le
    {G' : Type g'} [Group G'] [TopologicalSpace G'] [IsTopologicalGroup G']
      [CompactSpace G']
    {G : Type g} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
      [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (h : G' →ₜ* G) (hinj : Function.Injective h)
    (U : OpenSubgroup G') :
    ∃ V : OpenNormalSubgroup G,
      (V : Subgroup G).comap h.toMonoidHom ≤ (U : Subgroup G')
proof:
:= by
  let H : ClosedSubgroup G :=
    { toSubgroup := h.toMonoidHom.range
      isClosed' := by
        change IsClosed (Set.range h)
        exact (isCompact_range h.continuous_toFun).isClosed }
  have hrangeInj : Function.Injective h.toMonoidHom.rangeRestrict := by
    intro a b hab
    apply hinj
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hab
  let emul : G' ≃* H :=
    MulEquiv.ofBijective h.toMonoidHom.rangeRestrict
      ⟨hrangeInj, h.toMonoidHom.rangeRestrict_surjective⟩
  have hemul_cont : Continuous emul :=
    Continuous.subtype_mk h.continuous_toFun _
  let ehomeo : G' ≃ₜ H :=
    Continuous.homeoOfEquivCompactToT2 (f := emul.toEquiv) hemul_cont
  let e : G' ≃ₜ* H :=
    ContinuousMulEquiv.mk' ehomeo (fun a b => emul.map_mul a b)
  let UH : OpenSubgroup H :=
    { toSubgroup := (U : Subgroup G').map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
      isOpen' := by
        change IsOpen (e '' ((U : Subgroup G') : Set G'))
        exact e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap _ U.isOpen' }
  obtain ⟨V, hVU⟩ :=
    ProCGroups.ProC.exists_openNormalSubgroup_inter_closedSubgroup_le H UH
  refine ⟨V, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have heaComap : e a ∈
      (ProCGroups.OpenNormalSubgroup.comap
        ((H : Subgroup G).subtype) continuous_subtype_val V :
          OpenNormalSubgroup H) := by
    change h a ∈ V
    exact ha
  have heaUH : e a ∈ UH := hVU heaComap
  have heaU : e.symm (e a) ∈ U := Subgroup.mem_map_equiv.mp heaUH
  simpa using heaU

name: CategoryTheory.ContAction.exists_epi_mono_span_of_injective
statement:
private theorem exists_epi_mono_span_of_injective
    (h : G' →ₜ* G) (hinj : Function.Injective h)
    (X' : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G')
    (hnon : Nonempty X'.obj.V)
    (htrans : MulAction.IsPretransitive G' X'.obj.V) :
    ∃ (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G)
      (Y : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G')
      (q : Y ⟶ X')
      (i : Y ⟶ (ContAction.res FintypeCat h).obj X),
      Epi q ∧ Mono i
proof:
:= by
  let : ContinuousSMul G' X'.obj.V := X'.2
  let : MulAction.IsPretransitive G' X'.obj.V := htrans
  let x₀ : X'.obj.V := hnon.some
  let U : OpenSubgroup G' :=
    { toSubgroup := MulAction.stabilizer G' x₀
      isOpen' := stabilizer_isOpen G' x₀ }
  obtain ⟨V, hcomap_le⟩ :=
    exists_openNormalSubgroup_comap_le h hinj U
  let : Finite (G ⧸ (V : Subgroup G)) :=
    ProCGroups.openNormalSubgroup_finiteQuotient V
  let hex := Finite.exists_equiv_fin (G ⧸ (V : Subgroup G))
  let n : ℕ := hex.choose
  let qEquiv : (G ⧸ (V : Subgroup G)) ≃ Fin n :=
    Classical.choice hex.choose_spec
  let A := ULift.{w} (Fin n)
  let eA : A ≃ (G ⧸ (V : Subgroup G)) := Equiv.ulift.trans qEquiv.symm
  let : MulAction G A := eA.mulAction G
  let : TopologicalSpace A := ⊥
  let : DiscreteTopology A := ⟨rfl⟩
  have stabilizer_A_eq (a : A) :
      MulAction.stabilizer G a = MulAction.stabilizer G (eA a) := by
    ext s
    simp only [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, Equiv.smul_def, Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  have hAcont : ContinuousSMul G A := by
    rw [continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen]
    intro a
    rw [stabilizer_A_eq a]
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G
