      (((1 : G) : G ⧸ (V : Subgroup G))) (eA a)
    rw [← hs, MulAction.stabilizer_smul_eq_stabilizer_map_conj,
      MulAction.stabilizer_quotient, Subgroup.coe_map]
    change IsOpen ((fun x : G => s * x * s⁻¹) '' ((V : Subgroup G) : Set G))
    simpa only [Set.image_image] using
      isOpenMap_mul_right s⁻¹ _
        (isOpenMap_mul_left s _ (ProCGroups.openNormalSubgroup_isOpen V))
  let : ContinuousSMul G A := hAcont
  let X : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G :=
    ⟨Action.FintypeCat.ofMulAction G (FintypeCat.of A), hAcont⟩
  let : MulAction G' A := MulAction.compHom A h.toMonoidHom
  let : ContinuousSMul G' A :=
    MulAction.continuousSMul_compHom h.continuous_toFun
  let a₀ : A := eA.symm (((1 : G) : G ⧸ (V : Subgroup G)))
  let p₀ : A × X'.obj.V := (a₀, x₀)
  let B := MulAction.orbit G' p₀
  let : TopologicalSpace B := ⊥
  let : DiscreteTopology B := ⟨rfl⟩
  have stabilizer_B_eq (b : B) :
      MulAction.stabilizer G' b = MulAction.stabilizer G' b.1 := by
    ext s
    simp only [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    constructor
    · exact fun hs => congrArg Subtype.val hs
    · exact fun hs => Subtype.ext hs
  have hBcont : ContinuousSMul G' B := by
    rw [continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen]
    intro b
    rw [stabilizer_B_eq b]
    exact stabilizer_isOpen G' b.1
  let Y : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G' :=
    ⟨Action.FintypeCat.ofMulAction G' (FintypeCat.of B), hBcont⟩
  let q : Y ⟶ X' := ObjectProperty.homMk (Action.Hom.mk
    (FintypeCat.homMk (fun b : B => b.1.2)) (by intro s; ext b; rfl))
  let i : Y ⟶ (ContAction.res FintypeCat h).obj X :=
    ObjectProperty.homMk (Action.Hom.mk
      (FintypeCat.homMk (fun b : B => b.1.1)) (by intro s; ext b; rfl))
  have hqsurj : Function.Surjective (ConcreteCategory.hom q) := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G' x₀ z
    let b : B := ⟨s • p₀, MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
    exact ⟨b, hs⟩
  have hiinj : Function.Injective (ConcreteCategory.hom i) := by
    change Function.Injective (fun b : B => b.1.1)
    intro b c hbc
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext hbc
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp b.2
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp c.2
    have hfirst : s • a₀ = t • a₀ := by
      calc
        s • a₀ = (s • p₀).1 := rfl
        _ = b.1.1 := congrArg (fun z : A × X'.obj.V => z.1) hs
        _ = c.1.1 := hbc
        _ = (t • p₀).1 :=
          (congrArg (fun z : A × X'.obj.V => z.1) ht).symm
        _ = t • a₀ := rfl
    have hd_first : (t⁻¹ * s) • a₀ = a₀ := by
      have heq := congrArg (t⁻¹ • ·) hfirst
      simpa only [← mul_smul, inv_mul_cancel, one_smul] using heq
    have hdV : h.toMonoidHom (t⁻¹ * s) ∈ (V : Subgroup G) := by
      rw [← MulAction.stabilizer_quotient (V : Subgroup G),
        MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
      have heq := congrArg eA hd_first
      simpa only [MulAction.compHom_smul_def, Equiv.smul_def,
        eA.apply_symm_apply, a₀] using heq
    have hdU : t⁻¹ * s ∈ U := hcomap_le hdV
    have hd_second : (t⁻¹ * s) • x₀ = x₀ := hdU
    have hsecond : s • x₀ = t • x₀ := by
      have heq := congrArg (t • ·) hd_second
      simpa only [← mul_smul, mul_inv_cancel_left] using heq
    calc
      b.1.2 = (s • p₀).2 :=
        (congrArg (fun z : A × X'.obj.V => z.2) hs).symm
      _ = s • x₀ := rfl
      _ = t • x₀ := hsecond
      _ = (t • p₀).2 := rfl
      _ = c.1.2 := congrArg (fun z : A × X'.obj.V => z.2) ht
  let : Epi q := ConcreteCategory.epi_of_surjective q hqsurj
  let : Mono i := ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective i hiinj
  exact ⟨X, Y, q, i, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: CategoryTheory.ContAction.injective_of_exists_epi_mono_span
statement:
private theorem injective_of_exists_epi_mono_span
    (h : G' →ₜ* G)
    (hspan :
      ∀ X' : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G',
        Nonempty X'.obj.V →
        MulAction.IsPretransitive G' X'.obj.V →
        ∃ (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G)
          (Y : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G')
          (q : Y ⟶ X')
          (i : Y ⟶ (ContAction.res FintypeCat h).obj X),
          Epi q ∧ Mono i) :
    Function.Injective h
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  let k : G' := a⁻¹ * b
  have hab' : h.toMonoidHom a = h.toMonoidHom b := hab
  have hkmap : h.toMonoidHom k = 1 := by
    simp only [k, map_mul, map_inv, hab', inv_mul_cancel]
  by_contra hkne
  have hkne' : k ≠ 1 := by
    intro hk
    exact hkne (inv_mul_eq_one.mp (by simpa [k] using hk))
  obtain ⟨U, hkU⟩ :=
    ProCGroups.ProC.exists_openNormalSubgroup_not_mem
      (G := G') (x := k) hkne'
  let : Finite (G' ⧸ (U : Subgroup G')) :=
    ProCGroups.openNormalSubgroup_finiteQuotient U
  let hex := Finite.exists_equiv_fin (G' ⧸ (U : Subgroup G'))
  let n : ℕ := hex.choose
  let qEquiv : (G' ⧸ (U : Subgroup G')) ≃ Fin n :=
    Classical.choice hex.choose_spec
  let A := ULift.{w} (Fin n)
  let eU : A ≃ (G' ⧸ (U : Subgroup G')) :=
    Equiv.ulift.trans qEquiv.symm
  let : MulAction G' A := eU.mulAction G'
  let : TopologicalSpace A := ⊥
  let : DiscreteTopology A := ⟨rfl⟩
  have stabilizer_A_eq (x : A) :
      MulAction.stabilizer G' x = MulAction.stabilizer G' (eU x) := by
    ext s
    simp only [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, Equiv.smul_def, Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  have hAcont : ContinuousSMul G' A := by
    rw [continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen]
    intro x
    rw [stabilizer_A_eq x]
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G'
      (((1 : G') : G' ⧸ (U : Subgroup G'))) (eU x)
    rw [← hs, MulAction.stabilizer_smul_eq_stabilizer_map_conj,
      MulAction.stabilizer_quotient, Subgroup.coe_map]
    change IsOpen
      ((fun z : G' => s * z * s⁻¹) '' ((U : Subgroup G') : Set G'))
    simpa only [Set.image_image] using
      isOpenMap_mul_right s⁻¹ _
        (isOpenMap_mul_left s _
          (ProCGroups.openNormalSubgroup_isOpen U))
  let X' : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G' :=
    ⟨Action.FintypeCat.ofMulAction G' (FintypeCat.of A), hAcont⟩
  let x₀ : A :=
    eU.symm (((1 : G') : G' ⧸ (U : Subgroup G')))
  have htrans : MulAction.IsPretransitive G' A := by
    constructor
    intro x y
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G' (eU x) (eU y)
    refine ⟨s, eU.injective ?_⟩
    simpa only [Equiv.smul_def, eU.apply_symm_apply] using hs
  obtain ⟨X, Y, q, i, hq, hi⟩ :=
    hspan X' ⟨x₀⟩ htrans
  let : Epi q := hq
  let : Mono i := hi
  let : Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape Limits.WalkingSpan
      (forget (ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G')) := by
    change Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape _
      (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G') FintypeCat ⋙
        forget FintypeCat)
    infer_instance
  let : Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape Limits.WalkingCospan
      (forget (ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G')) := by
    change Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape _
      (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G') FintypeCat ⋙
        forget FintypeCat)
    infer_instance
  have hqsurj : Function.Surjective (ConcreteCategory.hom q) :=
    ConcreteCategory.surjective_of_epi_of_preservesPushout q
  have hiinj : Function.Injective (ConcreteCategory.hom i) :=
    ConcreteCategory.injective_of_mono_of_preservesPullback i
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hqsurj x₀
  have hki :
      ConcreteCategory.hom i ((Y.obj.ρ k).hom y) =
        ConcreteCategory.hom i y := by
    have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (i.hom.comm k) y
    change ConcreteCategory.hom i ((Y.obj.ρ k).hom y) =
      (X.obj.ρ (h.toMonoidHom k)).hom
        (ConcreteCategory.hom i y) at hcomm
    rw [hkmap, Action.ρ_one] at hcomm
    exact hcomm.trans (ConcreteCategory.id_apply _)
  have hky : (Y.obj.ρ k).hom y = y := hiinj hki
  have hkxρ : (X'.obj.ρ k).hom x₀ = x₀ := by
    rw [← hy]
    have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (q.hom.comm k) y
    change ConcreteCategory.hom q ((Y.obj.ρ k).hom y) =
      (X'.obj.ρ k).hom (ConcreteCategory.hom q y) at hcomm
    rw [← hcomm, hky]
  have hkx : k • x₀ = x₀ := by
    change (X'.obj.ρ k).hom x₀ = x₀
    exact hkxρ
  have hkstab :
      k ∈ MulAction.stabilizer G'
        (((1 : G') : G' ⧸ (U : Subgroup G'))) := by
    rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    have heq := congrArg eU hkx
    simpa only [Equiv.smul_def, eU.apply_symm_apply, x₀] using heq
  apply hkU
  rwa [MulAction.stabilizer_quotient] at hkstab

name: CategoryTheory.ContAction.injective_iff_exists_epi_mono_span
statement:
@[stacks 0BN7]
theorem injective_iff_exists_epi_mono_span
    (h : G' →ₜ* G) :
    Function.Injective h ↔
      ∀ X' : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G',
        Nonempty X'.obj.V →
        MulAction.IsPretransitive G' X'.obj.V →
        ∃ (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G)
          (Y : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G')
          (q : Y ⟶ X')
          (i : Y ⟶ (ContAction.res FintypeCat h).obj X),
          Epi q ∧ Mono i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_epi_mono_span_of_injective h
  · exact injective_of_exists_epi_mono_span h

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.nonempty_iso_of_exact
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_of_exact
    (F : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}) [FiberFunctor F]
    (P : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits P] [PreservesFiniteColimits P] :
    Nonempty (F ≅ P)
proof:
:= by
  let S :=
    FintypeCat.uSwitchEquivalence.{w, max u₁ u₂ w}
  let F' := F ⋙ S.functor
  let P' := P ⋙ S.functor
  let E := functorToContAction F'
  let A := ContAction FintypeCat.{max u₁ u₂ w} (Aut F')
  let U := forget₂ A FintypeCat
  let Q := E.asEquivalence.inverse ⋙ P'
  let : FiberFunctor F' :=
    FiberFunctor.comp_right _
  let : PreservesFiniteLimits P' := by
    apply comp_preservesFiniteLimits
  let : PreservesFiniteColimits P' := by
    apply comp_preservesFiniteColimits
  let : PreservesFiniteLimits Q := by
    apply comp_preservesFiniteLimits
  let : PreservesFiniteColimits Q := by
    apply comp_preservesFiniteColimits
  obtain ⟨e⟩ :=
    FiniteContinuousAction.nonempty_iso_forget_of_exact
      (Aut F') Q
  let eF : E ⋙ U ≅ F' :=
    NatIso.ofComponents (fun _ => Iso.refl _)
  let eP : E ⋙ Q ≅ P' :=
    (Functor.associator E E.asEquivalence.inverse P').symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight E.asEquivalence.unitIso.symm P' ≪≫
        Functor.leftUnitor P'
  let e' : F' ≅ P' :=
    eF.symm ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerLeft E e ≪≫ eP
  exact ⟨
    ((Functor.FullyFaithful.ofFullyFaithful S.functor).whiskeringRight C).preimageIso e'⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.nonempty_iso_comp_of_exact
statement:
@[stacks 0BN5 "an exact functor commutes with chosen fiber functors up to isomorphism"]
theorem nonempty_iso_comp_of_exact
    (F : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}) [FiberFunctor F]
    (F' : C' ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}) [FiberFunctor F']
    (H : C ⥤ C')
    [PreservesFiniteLimits H] [PreservesFiniteColimits H] :
    Nonempty (H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  let : PreservesFiniteColimits F' :=
    FiberFunctor.preservesFiniteColimits F'
  let : PreservesFiniteLimits (H ⋙ F') := by
    apply comp_preservesFiniteLimits
  let : PreservesFiniteColimits (H ⋙ F') := by
    apply comp_preservesFiniteColimits
  exact Nonempty.map Iso.symm
    (nonempty_iso_of_exact F (H ⋙ F'))

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.continuousConjAut_eq_conj
statement:
theorem continuousConjAut_eq_conj (t₁ t₂ : F ≅ G) (a : Aut F) :
    continuousConjAut t₂ a =
      MulAut.conj (G := Aut G) (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂) (continuousConjAut t₁ a)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : t₁ ≪≫ (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂) = t₂ := by
    rw [← Iso.trans_assoc, Iso.self_symm_id, Iso.refl_trans]
  have hconj : t₂.conjAut a = (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂).conjAut (t₁.conjAut a) :=
    (congrArg (fun t : F ≅ G ↦ t.conjAut a) ht.symm).trans
      (Iso.trans_conjAut t₁ (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂) a)
  have hinner (b c : Aut G) : b.conjAut c = MulAut.conj (G := Aut G) b c := by
    apply Aut.ext
    rfl
  exact hconj.trans (hinner (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂) (t₁.conjAut a))

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_comparisonIsoOfContinuousHom
statement:
@[stacks 0BN5 "recovering a continuous homomorphism from its induced functor"]
theorem autHomOfCompIso_comparisonIsoOfContinuousHom
    (h : Aut F' →ₜ* Aut F) :
    autHomOfCompIso (functorOfContinuousHom F F' h)
        (comparisonIsoOfContinuousHom F F' h) =
      h
proof:
:= by
  ext a X x
  rw [autHomOfCompIso_apply]
  let Y := (ContAction.res FintypeCat h).obj
    ((functorToContAction F).obj X)
  let e := (functorToContAction F').asEquivalence.counitIso.app Y
  change
    (ConcreteCategory.hom e.hom.hom.hom)
        ((ConcreteCategory.hom
          (a.hom.app ((functorToContAction F').asEquivalence.inverse.obj Y)))
            ((ConcreteCategory.hom e.inv.hom.hom) x)) =
      (ConcreteCategory.hom ((h a).hom.app X)) x
  have hc := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (e.hom.hom.comm a)
    (ConcreteCategory.hom e.inv.hom.hom x)
  change
    (ConcreteCategory.hom e.hom.hom.hom)
        ((ConcreteCategory.hom
          (a.hom.app ((functorToContAction F').asEquivalence.inverse.obj Y)))
            ((ConcreteCategory.hom e.inv.hom.hom) x)) =
      (ConcreteCategory.hom ((h a).hom.app X))
        ((ConcreteCategory.hom e.hom.hom.hom)
          ((ConcreteCategory.hom e.inv.hom.hom) x)) at hc
  have heq :
      (ConcreteCategory.hom e.hom.hom.hom)
          ((ConcreteCategory.hom e.inv.hom.hom) x) = x := by
    have he := congrArg
      (fun k ↦
        (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{w} (Aut F')) FintypeCat).map k)
      e.inv_hom_id
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom he x
  exact hc.trans
    (congrArg (ConcreteCategory.hom ((h a).hom.app X)) heq)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_conj_eq_one_of_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  let P := (Functor.whiskeringLeft C C' FintypeCat.{w}).obj H
  have hp : P.mapIso a = (1 : Aut (H ⋙ F)) := by
    apply s.conjAut.injective
    exact ha.trans (map_one s.conjAut).symm
  change r.conjAut (P.mapIso (t.conjAut a)) = 1
  have hconj : P.mapIso (t.conjAut a) =
      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft H t).conjAut (P.mapIso a) :=
    Functor.map_conjAut P t a
  exact (congrArg r.conjAut hconj).trans
    ((congrArg (fun b : Aut (H ⋙ F) =>
      r.conjAut ((Functor.isoWhiskerLeft H t).conjAut b)) hp).trans
      ((congrArg r.conjAut (map_one (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft H t).conjAut)).trans
        (map_one r.conjAut)))

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.fiber_fixed_of_conj_fixed
statement:
theorem fiber_fixed_of_conj_fixed
    {F G : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}} (t : F ≅ G) (a : Aut F)
    (W : C) (ha : ∀ w : G.obj W, continuousConjAut t a • w = w) :
    ∀ w : F.obj W, a • w = w
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  have h := ha ((t.app W).hom w)
  change t.hom.app W (a.hom.app W (t.inv.app W (t.hom.app W w))) =
    t.hom.app W w at h
  have hfixed : t.hom.app W (a.hom.app W w) = t.hom.app W w := by
    simpa only [← Iso.app_hom, ← Iso.app_inv, FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply] using h
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (t.hom.app W)).injective hfixed

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.continuous_mapAut_whiskeringLeft
statement:
lemma continuous_mapAut_whiskeringLeft
    (H : C ⥤ C') (F' : C' ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}) :
    Continuous (((whiskeringLeft C C' FintypeCat.{w}).obj H).mapAut F')
proof:
:= by
  rw [Topology.IsInducing.continuous_iff
      (autEmbedding_isClosedEmbedding
        (((whiskeringLeft C C' FintypeCat.{w}).obj H).obj F')).isInducing,
    continuous_pi_iff]
  intro X
  change Continuous fun a ↦ autEmbedding F' a (H.obj X)
  fun_prop

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.continuous_conjAut
statement:
lemma continuous_conjAut
    {F G : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}} (t : F ≅ G) :
    Continuous t.conjAut
proof:
:= by
  rw [Topology.IsInducing.continuous_iff
      (autEmbedding_isClosedEmbedding G).isInducing,
    continuous_pi_iff]
  intro X
  change Continuous fun a ↦ autEmbedding G (t.conjAut a) X
  suffices (fun a : Aut F ↦ autEmbedding G (t.conjAut a) X) =
      fun a ↦ (t.app X).conjAut (autEmbedding F a X) by
    rw [this]
    fun_prop
  funext a
  apply Iso.ext
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma autHomOfCompIso_apply
    (H : C ⥤ C') {F : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}}
    {F' : C' ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}} (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) (a : Aut F') :
    autHomOfCompIso H t a =
      t.conjAut (((whiskeringLeft C C' FintypeCat.{w}).obj H).mapAut F' a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.stabilizer_transportedPointOfCompIso
statement:
theorem stabilizer_transportedPointOfCompIso
    (H : C ⥤ C') {F : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}}
    {F' : C' ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}} (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
    (X : C) (x : F.obj X) :
    MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F') (transportedPointOfCompIso H t X x) =
      (MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) x).comap
        (autHomOfCompIso H t).toMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [transportedPointOfCompIso]
  ext a
  simp only [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, Subgroup.mem_comap]
  change a.hom.app (H.obj X) ((t.app X).inv x) = (t.app X).inv x ↔
    (t.app X).hom (a.hom.app (H.obj X) ((t.app X).inv x)) = x
  constructor
  · intro ha
    simpa only [Functor.comp_obj, FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply] using
      congrArg (fun y ↦ (t.app X).hom y) ha
  · intro ha
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        (fun y : (H ⋙ F').obj X ↦ (t.app X).hom y) := by
      intro y z hyz
      simpa only [FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply] using
        congrArg (fun y ↦ (t.app X).inv y) hyz
    apply hinj
    simpa only [FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply] using ha

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_eq_conj
statement:
@[stacks 0BN5 "changing the fiber-functor comparison conjugates the induced homomorphism"]
theorem autHomOfCompIso_eq_conj
    (H : C ⥤ C') {F : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}}
    {F' : C' ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}} (t₁ t₂ : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) (σ : Aut F') :
    autHomOfCompIso H t₂ σ =
      MulAut.conj (G := Aut F) (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂ : Aut F)
        (autHomOfCompIso H t₁ σ)
proof:
:= by
  change t₂.conjAut
      (((whiskeringLeft C C' FintypeCat.{w}).obj H).mapAut F' σ) =
    MulAut.conj (G := Aut F) (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂ : Aut F)
      (t₁.conjAut
        (((whiskeringLeft C C' FintypeCat.{w}).obj H).mapAut F' σ))
  let τ := ((whiskeringLeft C C' FintypeCat.{w}).obj H).mapAut F' σ
  have conj_eq (a b : Aut F) :
      MulAut.conj (G := Aut F) a b = a.conjAut b := by
    apply Aut.ext
    rfl
  have htrans :
      t₂.conjAut τ =
        (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂).conjAut (t₁.conjAut τ) := by
    have hcomp : t₁ ≪≫ (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂) = t₂ := by
      rw [← Iso.trans_assoc, Iso.self_symm_id, Iso.refl_trans]
    exact
      (congrArg (fun t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F ↦ t.conjAut τ) hcomp.symm).trans
        (Iso.trans_conjAut t₁ (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂) τ)
  exact htrans.trans
    (conj_eq (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂) (t₁.conjAut τ)).symm

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.exists_open_supergroup
statement:
private theorem exists_open_supergroup
    {G' : Type g'} {G : Type g}
    [Group G'] [TopologicalSpace G'] [CompactSpace G']
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G] [T2Space G]
    (h : G' →ₜ* G) (nh : ¬ Function.Surjective h) :
    ∃ U : Subgroup G, IsOpen (U : Set G) ∧
      h.toMonoidHom.range ≤ U ∧ U ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let K : ClosedSubgroup G :=
    { toSubgroup := h.toMonoidHom.range
      isClosed' := by
        change IsClosed (Set.range h)
        exact (isCompact_range h.continuous_toFun).isClosed }
  have hK : K.toSubgroup ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro heq
    apply nh
    exact MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mp heq
  have hnall : ¬ ∀ g : G, g ∈ K := by
    intro hall
    apply hK
    exact eq_top_iff.mpr fun g _ ↦ hall g
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := not_forall.mp hnall
  have hg' :
      g ∉ sInf {N : Subgroup G |
        IsOpen (N : Set G) ∧ K.toSubgroup ≤ N} := by
    rwa [← ProfiniteGrp.closedSubgroup_eq_sInf_open K]
  rw [Subgroup.mem_sInf] at hg'
  push Not at hg'
  obtain ⟨U, ⟨hUopen, hKU⟩, hgU⟩ := hg'
  exact ⟨U, hUopen, hKU,
    fun htop ↦ hgU (htop ▸ Subgroup.mem_top g)⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.exists_small_action
statement:
private theorem exists_small_action
    {G' : Type g'} {G : Type g}
    [Group G'] [TopologicalSpace G']
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
    (h : G' →ₜ* G) (U : Subgroup G)
    (hUopen : IsOpen (U : Set G))
    (hKU : h.toMonoidHom.range ≤ U) (hUne : U ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ (Y : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G) (y : Y.obj.V),
      MulAction.IsPretransitive G Y.obj.V ∧
      (∀ a : G', h a • y = y) ∧ ¬ Subsingleton Y.obj.V
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite (G ⧸ U) :=
    Subgroup.quotient_finite_of_isOpen U hUopen
  let hex := Finite.exists_equiv_fin (G ⧸ U)
  let n : ℕ := hex.choose
  let qEquiv : (G ⧸ U) ≃ Fin n :=
    Classical.choice hex.choose_spec
  let A := ULift.{w} (Fin n)
  let e : A ≃ (G ⧸ U) := Equiv.ulift.trans qEquiv.symm
  let : MulAction G A := e.mulAction G
  let : TopologicalSpace A := ⊥
  let : DiscreteTopology A := ⟨rfl⟩
  have stabilizer_eq (i : A) :
      MulAction.stabilizer G i =
        MulAction.stabilizer G (e i) := by
    ext g
    simp only [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, Equiv.smul_def,
      Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  let : MulAction.IsPretransitive G A := by
    rw [MulAction.isPretransitive_iff]
    intro i j
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G (e i) (e j)
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    rw [Equiv.smul_def, hg, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  let Y : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} G := by
    refine ⟨Action.FintypeCat.ofMulAction G (FintypeCat.of A), ?_⟩
    exact (by
      rw [continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen]
      intro i
      rw [stabilizer_eq i]
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
        MulAction.exists_smul_eq G
          (((1 : G) : G ⧸ U)) (e i)
      rw [← ha, MulAction.stabilizer_smul_eq_stabilizer_map_conj,
        MulAction.stabilizer_quotient, Subgroup.coe_map]
      change IsOpen ((fun x : G ↦ a * x * a⁻¹) '' (U : Set G))
      simpa only [Set.image_image] using
        isOpenMap_mul_right a⁻¹ _
          (isOpenMap_mul_left a _ hUopen)
      : ContinuousSMul G A)
  let y : A := e.symm (((1 : G) : G ⧸ U))
  have hy (a : G') : h a • y = y := by
    apply e.injective
    rw [Equiv.smul_def, e.apply_symm_apply, e.apply_symm_apply]
    change QuotientGroup.mk (h a * 1) = QuotientGroup.mk 1
    rw [mul_one, QuotientGroup.eq]
    have haU : h a ∈ U := by
      apply hKU
      exact MonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨a, rfl⟩
    simpa only [mul_one] using U.inv_mem haU
  have hnsub : ¬ Subsingleton A := by
    intro hsub
    have hnall : ¬ ∀ g : G, g ∈ U := by
      intro hall
      apply hUne
      exact eq_top_iff.mpr fun g _ ↦ hall g
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := not_forall.mp hnall
    have heq :=
      congrArg e (hsub.elim (e.symm (QuotientGroup.mk a)) y)
    have hq :
        (QuotientGroup.mk a : G ⧸ U) = QuotientGroup.mk 1 := by
      simpa only [y, e.apply_symm_apply] using heq
    have hainv : a⁻¹ ∈ U := by
      rw [QuotientGroup.eq] at hq
      simpa only [mul_one] using hq
    exact ha (U.inv_mem_iff.mp hainv)
  refine ⟨Y, y, ?_, hy, ?_⟩
  · change MulAction.IsPretransitive G A
    infer_instance
  · change ¬ Subsingleton A
    exact hnsub

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.point_lifting_implies_surjective
statement:
private theorem point_lifting_implies_surjective
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
    (h4 : ∀ X : C, IsConnected X →
      Nonempty (⊤_ C' ⟶ H.obj X) → Nonempty (⊤_ C ⟶ X)) :
    Function.Surjective (autHomOfCompIso H t)
proof:
:= by
  let h := autHomOfCompIso H t
  by_contra nh
  obtain ⟨U, hUopen, hKU, hUne⟩ :=
    exists_open_supergroup h nh
  have hsmall :
      ∃ (Y : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} (Aut F)) (y : Y.obj.V),
        MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F) Y.obj.V ∧
        (∀ a : Aut F', h a • y = y) ∧ ¬ Subsingleton Y.obj.V :=
    exists_small_action h U hUopen hKU hUne
  obtain ⟨Y, y, hYtrans, hy, hYnsub⟩ := hsmall
  let E := functorToContAction F
  let E' := functorToContAction F'
  let X : C := E.objPreimage Y
  let eX := E.objObjPreimageIso Y
  let ef :=
    (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat (Aut F)) FintypeCat).mapIso eX
  let : Nonempty (F.obj X) := ⟨ef.inv y⟩
  let : MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F) (F.obj X) := by
    constructor
    intro x z
    let ex : Y.obj.V := ef.hom x
    let ez : Y.obj.V := ef.hom z
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hYtrans.exists_smul_eq ex ez
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    have heq := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (eX.hom.hom.comm a) x
    change ef.hom (a • x) = a • ex at heq
    have hmap : ef.hom (a • x) = ef.hom z := heq.trans ha
    have hi := congrArg ef.inv hmap
    exact (FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply ef (a • x)).symm.trans
      (hi.trans (FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply ef z))
  let : IsConnected X :=
    FiberFunctor.isConnected_of_isPretransitive F X
  let R := ContAction.res FintypeCat h
  let fixedMor : ⊤_ (ContAction FintypeCat.{w} (Aut F')) ⟶
      R.obj Y :=
    ObjectProperty.homMk
      (Action.Hom.mk (FintypeCat.homMk (fun _ ↦ y)) (by
        intro a
        ext z
        change y = h a • y
        exact (hy a).symm))
  let s := (functorToContActionCompIso H t).app X
  let m : E'.obj (⊤_ C') ⟶ E'.obj (H.obj X) :=
    (PreservesTerminal.iso E').hom ≫ fixedMor ≫
      (R.mapIso eX).inv ≫ s.inv
  obtain ⟨q⟩ := h4 X inferInstance ⟨E'.preimage m⟩
  let : Mono q := terminalIsTerminal.mono_from q
  let z : (⊤_ FintypeCat.{w}).obj :=
    (terminalIsTerminal.from (FintypeCat.of PUnit.{w + 1}))
      PUnit.unit
  have hterm_noninitial : IsInitial (⊤_ C) → False :=
    (not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty F (⊤_ C)).mpr
      ⟨(PreservesTerminal.iso F).inv z⟩
  let : IsIso q :=
    IsConnected.noTrivialComponent (⊤_ C) q hterm_noninitial
  have hXterm : IsTerminal X :=
    terminalIsTerminal.ofIso (asIso q)
  have hFXterm : IsTerminal (F.obj X) :=
    hXterm.isTerminalObj F _
  have hFXsub : Subsingleton (F.obj X) := ⟨fun a b ↦ by
    let S := FintypeCat.of PUnit.{w + 1}
    let fa : S ⟶ F.obj X := FintypeCat.homMk (fun _ ↦ a)
    let fb : S ⟶ F.obj X := FintypeCat.homMk (fun _ ↦ b)
    have hab : fa = fb := hFXterm.hom_ext fa fb
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hab PUnit.unit⟩
  apply hYnsub
  constructor
  intro a b
  have hi : ef.inv a = ef.inv b := hFXsub.elim _ _
  have hh := congrArg ef.hom hi
  change @Eq
    ((forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat (Aut F)) FintypeCat).obj Y).obj
      a b
  simpa only [FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply] using hh

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.surjective_implies_fullyFaithful
statement:
private theorem surjective_implies_fullyFaithful
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
    (hs : Function.Surjective (autHomOfCompIso H t)) :
    Nonempty H.FullyFaithful
proof:
:= by
  let h := autHomOfCompIso H t
  let E := functorToContAction F
  let E' := functorToContAction F'
  let R := ContAction.res FintypeCat h
  let : R.Full := ContAction.full_res FintypeCat h hs
  let : (E ⋙ R).Full := Functor.Full.comp E R
  let : (H ⋙ E').Full :=
    Functor.Full.of_iso (functorToContActionCompIso H t).symm
  let : H.Full := Functor.Full.of_comp_faithful H E'
  let : H.Faithful := t.faithful_of_comp
  exact ⟨Functor.FullyFaithful.ofFullyFaithful H⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.surjective_implies_connected
statement:
private theorem surjective_implies_connected
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
    (hs : Function.Surjective (autHomOfCompIso H t)) :
    ∀ X : C, IsConnected X → IsConnected (H.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX
  let : IsConnected X := hX
  have hFX : Nonempty (F.obj X) :=
    (not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty F X).mp IsConnected.notInitial
  let e := (functorToContActionCompIso H t).app X
  let ef :=
    (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat (Aut F')) FintypeCat).mapIso e
  let : Nonempty (F'.obj (H.obj X)) := ⟨ef.inv hFX.some⟩
  have htransF :
      MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F) (F.obj X) :=
    inferInstance
  let :
      MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F') (F'.obj (H.obj X)) := by
    constructor
    intro x y
    let ex : F.obj X := ef.hom x
    let ey : F.obj X := ef.hom y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := htransF.exists_smul_eq ex ey
    obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := hs a
    refine ⟨a', ?_⟩
    have heq := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (e.hom.hom.comm a') x
    change ef.hom (a' • x) =
      ((autHomOfCompIso H t a') • ex : F.obj X) at heq
    have hmap : ef.hom (a' • x) = ef.hom y :=
      heq.trans ha
    have hi := congrArg ef.inv hmap
    exact (FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply ef (a' • x)).symm.trans
      (hi.trans (FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply ef y))
  exact FiberFunctor.isConnected_of_isPretransitive F' (H.obj X)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.fullyFaithful_implies_points
statement:
private theorem fullyFaithful_implies_points
    [PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete PEmpty.{1}) H]
    (hff : Nonempty H.FullyFaithful) :
    ∀ X : C, Function.Bijective
      (fun f : (⊤_ C ⟶ X) ↦
        (PreservesTerminal.iso H).inv ≫ H.map f)
proof:
:= by
  intro X
  let ff := hff.some
  constructor
  · intro f g hfg
    apply ff.map_injective
    simpa using
      (cancel_epi (PreservesTerminal.iso H).inv).mp hfg
  · intro q
    let f := ff.preimage ((PreservesTerminal.iso H).hom ≫ q)
    refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
    dsimp [f]
    rw [ff.map_preimage]
    rw [← PreservesTerminal.iso_hom]
    exact (PreservesTerminal.iso H).inv_hom_id_assoc q

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.points_imply_point_lifting
statement:
private theorem points_imply_point_lifting
    [PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete PEmpty.{1}) H]
    (h5 : ∀ X : C, Function.Bijective
      (fun f : (⊤_ C ⟶ X) ↦
        (PreservesTerminal.iso H).inv ≫ H.map f)) :
    ∀ X : C, IsConnected X →
      Nonempty (⊤_ C' ⟶ H.obj X) → Nonempty (⊤_ C ⟶ X)
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ hq
  obtain ⟨f, _⟩ := (h5 X).surjective hq.some
  exact ⟨f⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.connected_implies_point_lifting
statement:
private theorem connected_implies_point_lifting
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
    (h3 : ∀ X : C, IsConnected X → IsConnected (H.obj X)) :
    ∀ X : C, IsConnected X →
      Nonempty (⊤_ C' ⟶ H.obj X) → Nonempty (⊤_ C ⟶ X)
proof:
:= by
  intro X hconn hq
  let : IsConnected (H.obj X) := h3 X hconn
  obtain ⟨q⟩ := hq
  let : Mono q := terminalIsTerminal.mono_from q
  let z : (⊤_ FintypeCat.{w}).obj :=
    (terminalIsTerminal.from (FintypeCat.of PUnit.{w + 1}))
      PUnit.unit
  have hterm_noninitial : IsInitial (⊤_ C') → False :=
    (not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty F' (⊤_ C')).mpr
      ⟨(PreservesTerminal.iso F').inv z⟩
  let : IsIso q :=
    IsConnected.noTrivialComponent (⊤_ C') q hterm_noninitial
  have hHX : IsTerminal (H.obj X) :=
    terminalIsTerminal.ofIso (asIso q)
  have hFHX : IsTerminal (F'.obj (H.obj X)) :=
    hHX.isTerminalObj F' _
  have hFX : IsTerminal (F.obj X) :=
    hFHX.ofIso (t.app X)
  have hX : IsTerminal X :=
    hFX.isTerminalOfObj F X
  exact ⟨hX.from (⊤_ C)⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_surjective_tfae
statement:
@[stacks 0BN6]
theorem autHomOfCompIso_surjective_tfae
    [PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete PEmpty.{1}) H]
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) :
    List.TFAE [
      Function.Surjective (autHomOfCompIso H t),
      Nonempty H.FullyFaithful,
      ∀ X : C, IsConnected X → IsConnected (H.obj X),
      ∀ X : C, IsConnected X →
        Nonempty (⊤_ C' ⟶ H.obj X) → Nonempty (⊤_ C ⟶ X),
      ∀ X : C, Function.Bijective
        (fun f : (⊤_ C ⟶ X) ↦
          (PreservesTerminal.iso H).inv ≫ H.map f)]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 :=
    surjective_implies_fullyFaithful F F' H t
  tfae_have 1 → 3 :=
    surjective_implies_connected F F' H t
  tfae_have 2 → 5 :=
    fullyFaithful_implies_points H
  tfae_have 5 → 4 :=
    points_imply_point_lifting H
  tfae_have 3 → 4 :=
    connected_implies_point_lifting F F' H t
  tfae_have 4 → 1 :=
    point_lifting_implies_surjective F F' H t
  tfae_finish

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_unop_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_unop_apply
    (A : C) [IsGalois A] (a : F.obj A) (g : G) :
    (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom F G A a g).unop =
      (evaluationEquivOfIsGalois F A a).symm (g • a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_evaluation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_evaluation
    (A : C) [IsGalois A] (a : F.obj A) (g : G) :
    F.map ((galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom F G A a g).unop.hom) a = g • a
proof:
:= by
  exact evaluationEquivOfIsGalois_symm_fiber F A a (g • a)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker
statement:
theorem galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker
    (A : C) [IsGalois A] (a : F.obj A) :
    (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom F G A a).ker =
      MulAction.stabilizer G a
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have h := galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_evaluation F G A a g
    rw [hg] at h
    simpa using h.symm
  · intro hg
    apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
    apply (evaluationEquivOfIsGalois F A a).injective
    rw [galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_unop_apply, hg, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    change a = F.map (𝟙 A) a
    simp only [Functor.map_id, FintypeCat.id_apply]

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_surjective
statement:
theorem galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_surjective
    (A : C) [IsGalois A] (a : F.obj A)
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive G (F.obj A)] :
    Function.Surjective (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom F G A a)
proof:
:= by
  intro sigma
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G
    a (F.map sigma.unop.hom a)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
  apply (evaluationEquivOfIsGalois F A a).injective
  rw [galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_unop_apply, hg, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (evaluationEquivOfIsGalois_apply F A a sigma.unop).symm

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.iInf_galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker
statement:
theorem iInf_galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker :
    (⨅ (A : C) (hA : IsGalois A) (a : F.obj A),
      (letI : IsGalois A := hA
       galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom F (Aut F) A a).ker) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro g hg
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Iso.ext
  apply natTrans_ext_of_isGalois F
  intro A hA
  apply FintypeCat.hom_ext
  intro a
  have hfix := (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp
    (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp hg A) hA) a)
  rw [galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker,
    MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff] at hfix
  change g • a = a
  exact hfix

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.fiberOver_map_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fiberOver_map_val {U V : Over X} (f : U ⟶ V) (y : (fiberOver F x).obj U) :
    ((fiberOver F x).map f y).1 = F.map f.left y.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.fiberBinaryProductEquiv_apply
statement:
private theorem fiberBinaryProductEquiv_apply (Y : C) (z : F.obj (Y ⨯ X)) :
    fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X z = (F.map prod.fst z, F.map prod.snd z)
proof:
:= by
  let e := fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X
  apply Prod.ext
  · calc
      (e z).1 = F.map prod.fst (e.symm (e z)) :=
        (fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_fst_apply F (e z).1 (e z).2).symm
      _ = F.map prod.fst z := congrArg (F.map prod.fst) (e.symm_apply_apply z)
  · calc
      (e z).2 = F.map prod.snd (e.symm (e z)) :=
        (fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_snd_apply F (e z).1 (e z).2).symm
      _ = F.map prod.snd z := congrArg (F.map prod.snd) (e.symm_apply_apply z)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.productPoint_naturality
proof:
:= by
  apply (fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Z X).injective
  rw [fiberBinaryProductEquiv_apply F]
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply Prod.ext
  · calc
      F.map prod.fst
          (F.map (prod.map f (𝟙 X)) ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x))) =
          F.map (prod.map f (𝟙 X) ≫ prod.fst)
            ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x)) := by
              rw [F.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
      _ = F.map (prod.fst ≫ f) ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x)) := by
        rw [prod.map_fst]
      _ = F.map f
          (F.map prod.fst ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x))) := by
            rw [F.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
      _ = F.map f y := by rw [fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_fst_apply]
  · calc
      F.map prod.snd
          (F.map (prod.map f (𝟙 X)) ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x))) =
          F.map (prod.map f (𝟙 X) ≫ prod.snd)
            ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x)) := by
              rw [F.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
      _ = F.map prod.snd ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x)) := by
        rw [prod.map_snd, Category.comp_id]
      _ = x := fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_snd_apply F y x

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.productFiberEquiv_naturality
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    F.map (prod.map f (𝟙 X)) ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x)) =
      (fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Z X).symm (F.map f y, x)
  exact productPoint_naturality F x f y

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.productFiberEquivComparison_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem productFiberEquivComparison_symm_apply
    (Y : C) (z : (fiberOver F x).obj ((productOver (X := X)).obj Y)) :
    (productFiberEquivComparison F x Y).symm z = F.map Limits.prod.fst z.1
proof:
:=
  by
    change (productFiberEquiv F x Y).symm z = _
    change ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X) z.1).1 = _
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q.1) (fiberBinaryProductEquiv_apply F Y z.1)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.extendFiberOverAut_hom_app_apply
statement:
private theorem extendFiberOverAut_hom_app_apply
    (a : Aut (fiberOver F x)) (Y : C) (y : F.obj Y) :
    (extendFiberOverAut F x a).hom.app Y y =
      (productFiberEquiv F x Y).symm
        (a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj Y) (productFiberEquiv F x Y y))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.extendFiberOverAut_hom_app_apply_eq
statement:
theorem extendFiberOverAut_hom_app_apply_eq
    (a : Aut (fiberOver F x)) (Y : C) (y : F.obj Y) :
    (extendFiberOverAut F x a).hom.app Y y =
      (productFiberEquivComparison F x Y).symm
        (a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj Y)
          (productFiberEquivComparison F x Y y))
proof:
:=
  extendFiberOverAut_hom_app_apply F x a Y y

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.graphPoint_eq_productPoint
statement:
private theorem graphPoint_eq_productPoint (U : Over X) (y : F.obj U.left)
    (hy : F.map U.hom y = x) :
    F.map (prod.lift (𝟙 U.left) U.hom) y =
      (fiberBinaryProductEquiv F U.left X).symm (y, x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (fiberBinaryProductEquiv F U.left X).injective
  rw [fiberBinaryProductEquiv_apply F, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change F.map prod.fst (F.map (prod.lift (𝟙 U.left) U.hom) y) = y
    rw [← FintypeCat.comp_apply, ← F.map_comp, prod.lift_fst, F.map_id]
    rfl
  · change F.map prod.snd (F.map (prod.lift (𝟙 U.left) U.hom) y) = x
    rw [← FintypeCat.comp_apply, ← F.map_comp, prod.lift_snd]
    exact hy

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.fiberOver_map_graphToProduct
statement:
private theorem fiberOver_map_graphToProduct
    (U : Over X) (y : (fiberOver F x).obj U) :
    (fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) y =
      productFiberEquiv F x U.left y.1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change F.map (prod.lift (𝟙 U.left) U.hom) y.1 =
    (fiberBinaryProductEquiv F U.left X).symm (y.1, x)
  exact graphPoint_eq_productPoint F x U y.1 y.2

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.extendFiberOverAut_fixes_point
statement:
private theorem extendFiberOverAut_fixes_point (a : Aut (fiberOver F x)) :
    extendFiberOverAut F x a • x = x
proof:
:= by
  let U : Over X := Over.mk (𝟙 X)
  let y : (fiberOver F x).obj U := ⟨x, by
    change F.map (𝟙 X) x = x
    rw [F.map_id]
    rfl⟩
  have hay : a.hom.app U y = y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    have ha := (a.hom.app U y).2
    change F.map (𝟙 X) (a.hom.app U y).1 = x at ha
    rw [F.map_id] at ha
    exact ha
  have hnat :
      a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj U.left)
          ((fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) y) =
        (fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) (a.hom.app U y) := by
    simpa only [FintypeCat.comp_apply] using
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (a.hom.naturality (graphToProduct (X := X) U)) y
  have hfixProductU :
      a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj U.left)
          (productFiberEquiv F x U.left y.1) =
        productFiberEquiv F x U.left y.1 := by
    calc
      a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj U.left)
          (productFiberEquiv F x U.left y.1) =
          a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj U.left)
            ((fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) y) := by
              rw [fiberOver_map_graphToProduct]
      _ = (fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) (a.hom.app U y) := hnat
      _ = (fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) y :=
        congrArg ((fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U)) hay
      _ = productFiberEquiv F x U.left y.1 := fiberOver_map_graphToProduct F x U y
  have hfixProduct :
      a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj X) (productFiberEquiv F x X x) =
        productFiberEquiv F x X x := by
    dsimp [U, y, Over.mk] at hfixProductU
    exact hfixProductU
  change (extendFiberOverAut F x a).hom.app X x = x
  rw [extendFiberOverAut_hom_app_apply, hfixProduct]
  exact (productFiberEquiv F x X).symm_apply_apply x

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.extendFiberOverAut_restrictAutToFiberOver
statement:
private theorem extendFiberOverAut_restrictAutToFiberOver
    (a : MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) x) :
    extendFiberOverAut F x (restrictAutToFiberOver F x a) = a.1
proof:
:= by
  apply Aut.ext
  ext Y y
  rw [extendFiberOverAut_hom_app_apply]
  change
    ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X)
      (a.1 • (fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x))).1 = a.1 • y
  rw [fiberBinaryProductEquiv_apply]
  change F.map prod.fst
      (a.1 • (fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x)) = a.1 • y
  calc
    F.map prod.fst (a.1 • (fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x)) =
        a.1 • F.map prod.fst ((fiberBinaryProductEquiv F Y X).symm (y, x)) :=
      (mulAction_naturality F a.1 prod.fst _).symm
    _ = a.1 • y := congrArg (a.1 • ·)
      (fiberBinaryProductEquiv_symm_fst_apply F y x)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.restrictAutToFiberOver_extendFiberOverAut
statement:
private theorem restrictAutToFiberOver_extendFiberOverAut
    (a : Aut (fiberOver F x)) :
    restrictAutToFiberOver F x
        ⟨extendFiberOverAut F x a, extendFiberOverAut_fixes_point F x a⟩ = a
proof:
:= by
  apply Aut.ext
  ext U y
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (extendFiberOverAut F x a).hom.app U.left y.1 = (a.hom.app U y).1
  rw [extendFiberOverAut_hom_app_apply]
  have hnat :
      a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj U.left)
          ((fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) y) =
        (fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) (a.hom.app U y) := by
    simpa only [FintypeCat.comp_apply] using
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (a.hom.naturality (graphToProduct (X := X) U)) y
  have hproduct :
      a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj U.left)
          (productFiberEquiv F x U.left y.1) =
        productFiberEquiv F x U.left (a.hom.app U y).1 := by
    calc
      a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj U.left)
          (productFiberEquiv F x U.left y.1) =
          a.hom.app ((productOver (X := X)).obj U.left)
            ((fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) y) := by
              rw [fiberOver_map_graphToProduct]
      _ = (fiberOver F x).map (graphToProduct (X := X) U) (a.hom.app U y) := hnat
      _ = productFiberEquiv F x U.left (a.hom.app U y).1 :=
        fiberOver_map_graphToProduct F x U (a.hom.app U y)
  rw [hproduct]
  exact (productFiberEquiv F x U.left).symm_apply_apply (a.hom.app U y).1

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.FiberFunctor.isConnected_of_isPretransitive
statement:
theorem FiberFunctor.isConnected_of_isPretransitive
    (X : C) [Nonempty (F.obj X)]
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F) (F.obj X)] :
    IsConnected X
proof:
:= by
  have : IsConnected ((functorToAction F).obj X) :=
    FintypeCat.Action.isConnected_of_transitive (Aut F) (F.obj X)
  refine ⟨(not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty F X).mpr inferInstance, ?_⟩
  intro Y i _ hY
  have hY_nonempty : Nonempty (F.obj Y) :=
    (not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty F Y).mp hY
  have hY_action_not_initial :
      IsInitial ((functorToAction F).obj Y) → False :=
    (not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty
      (Action.forget FintypeCat (Aut F))
      ((functorToAction F).obj Y)).mpr hY_nonempty
  have : Mono ((functorToAction F).map i) :=
    map_mono (functorToAction F) i
  have : IsIso ((functorToAction F).map i) :=
    IsConnected.noTrivialComponent
      ((functorToAction F).obj Y)
      ((functorToAction F).map i)
      hY_action_not_initial
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso i (functorToAction F)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.exists_galoisObject_discreteCharacter_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_galoisObject_discreteCharacter_embedding
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [GaloisCategory C]
    (F : C ⥤ FintypeCat.{w}) [FiberFunctor F]
    {A : Type z} [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    (χ : Aut F →ₜ* A) :
    ∃ (W : C) (hW : IsGalois W) (w : F.obj W),
      letI : IsGalois W
proof:
:= hW
      ∃ e : (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ →* A,
        Function.Injective e ∧
          e.comp (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom F (Aut F) W w) = χ.toMonoidHom := by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, w, hw⟩ :=
    exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq_any_universe F
      (ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.ker χ)
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  let q : Aut F →* (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ := galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom F (Aut F) W w
  have hq : Function.Surjective q :=
    galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_surjective F (Aut F) W w
  have hker : q.ker = χ.toMonoidHom.ker :=
    (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker F (Aut F) W w).trans hw
  let e : (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ →* A :=
    q.liftOfSurjective hq ⟨χ.toMonoidHom, hker.le⟩
  have he : e.comp q = χ.toMonoidHom :=
    congrArg Subtype.val
      ((q.liftOfSurjective hq).symm_apply_apply ⟨χ.toMonoidHom, hker.le⟩)
  refine ⟨W, hW, w, e, ?_, he⟩
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_one e).mpr
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hq a
  have hg : g ∈ χ.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    change χ g = 1
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun he g).symm.trans ha
  rw [← hker] at hg
  exact hg

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.fiber_fixed_of_galoisObjectQuotient_eq_one
statement:
theorem fiber_fixed_of_galoisObjectQuotient_eq_one
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [GaloisCategory C]
    (F : C ⥤ FintypeCat) [FiberFunctor F]
    (W : C) [IsGalois W] (w₀ : F.obj W) (g : Aut F)
    (hg : galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom F (Aut F) W w₀ g = 1)
    (w : F.obj W) : g • w = w
proof:
:= by
  have hg₀ : g • w₀ = w₀ := by
    have hm := MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr hg
    rw [galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker] at hm
    exact hm
  let σ : Aut W := (evaluationEquivOfIsGalois F W w₀).symm w
  have hσ : F.map σ.hom w₀ = w := evaluationEquivOfIsGalois_symm_fiber F W w₀ w
  calc
    g • w = g • F.map σ.hom w₀ := congrArg (fun x => g • x) hσ.symm
    _ = F.map σ.hom (g • w₀) := mulAction_naturality F g σ.hom w₀
    _ = F.map σ.hom w₀ := congrArg (F.map σ.hom) hg₀
    _ = w := hσ

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.quotient_continuousSMul
statement:
private theorem quotient_continuousSMul
    (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]
    [TopologicalSpace (G ⧸ K)] [DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ K)]
    (hK : IsOpen (K : Set G)) :
    ContinuousSMul G (G ⧸ K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen]
  intro q
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective K q
  convert hK using 1
  ext g
  change g • (QuotientGroup.mk a : G ⧸ K) =
      QuotientGroup.mk a ↔ g ∈ K
  constructor
  · intro hg
    change (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ K) * QuotientGroup.mk a =
      QuotientGroup.mk a at hg
    have hq : (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ K) = 1 := by
      exact mul_right_cancel (by simpa only [one_mul] using hg)
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g).mp hq
  · intro hg
    have hq : (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ K) = 1 :=
      (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff g).mpr hg
    change (QuotientGroup.mk g : G ⧸ K) * QuotientGroup.mk a =
      QuotientGroup.mk a
    rw [hq, one_mul]

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.nonempty_image_of_nonempty
statement:
private theorem nonempty_image_of_nonempty
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteColimits F] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G)
    [Nonempty
      ((forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj X)] :
    Nonempty (F.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  let C := ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G
  let : PreservesLimit (Functor.empty.{0} C) (forget C) := by
    change PreservesLimit (Functor.empty.{0} C)
      (forget₂ C FintypeCat ⋙ FintypeCat.incl)
    infer_instance
  let : Unique ((forget C).obj (⊤_ C)) :=
    Concrete.uniqueOfTerminalOfPreserves (⊤_ C) terminalIsTerminal
  let : Unique ((forget FintypeCat.{u}).obj (⊤_ FintypeCat.{u})) :=
    Concrete.uniqueOfTerminalOfPreserves
      (⊤_ FintypeCat.{u}) terminalIsTerminal
  let p : X ⟶ ⊤_ C := terminal.from X
  have hp : Function.Surjective p := by
    intro y
    exact ⟨Classical.arbitrary
      ((forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj X),
      Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  let : Epi p := ConcreteCategory.epi_of_surjective p hp
  let : F.PreservesEpimorphisms := by infer_instance
  let : Epi (F.map p) := Functor.map_epi F p
  have hs : Function.Surjective (F.map p) :=
    ConcreteCategory.surjective_of_epi_of_preservesPushout (F.map p)
  obtain ⟨x, -⟩ :=
    hs ((PreservesTerminal.iso F).inv
      (default : (⊤_ FintypeCat.{u})))
  exact ⟨x⟩

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.actionKernel_isOpen
statement:
private theorem actionKernel_isOpen
    (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) :
    IsOpen
      ((MulAction.toPermHom G
        ((forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj X)).ker :
          Set G)
proof:
:= by
  let S := (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj X
  let a : G →* Equiv.Perm S := MulAction.toPermHom G S
  have hker :
      (a.ker : Set G) =
        ⋂ x : S, (MulAction.stabilizer G x : Set G) := by
    ext g
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
    constructor
    · intro hg x
      change a g = 1 at hg
      change g • x = x
      have hx := congrArg (fun e : Equiv.Perm S => e x) hg
      change g • x = x at hx
      exact hx
    · intro hg
      change a g = 1
      ext x
      have hx := hg x
      change g • x = x at hx
      exact hx
  change IsOpen (a.ker : Set G)
  rw [hker]
  exact isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun x => stabilizer_isOpen G x

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.evaluation_common_refinement
statement:
private theorem evaluation_common_refinement
    {X Y : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (x : (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj X) :
    quotientMap G
          (homOfLE inf_le_left :
            actionKernelIndex G X ⊓ actionKernelIndex G Y ⟶
              actionKernelIndex G X) ≫
        evaluation G X x ≫ f =
      quotientMap G
          (homOfLE inf_le_right :
            actionKernelIndex G X ⊓ actionKernelIndex G Y ⟶
              actionKernelIndex G Y) ≫
        evaluation G Y
          ((forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).map f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
  apply Action.hom_ext
  ext q
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ :=
    QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
      (actionKernelIndex G X ⊓
        actionKernelIndex G Y).toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup q
  change
    ConcreteCategory.hom f.hom.hom
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (X.obj.ρ g) x) =
      ConcreteCategory.hom (Y.obj.ρ g)
        (ConcreteCategory.hom f.hom.hom x)
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.hom.comm g) x

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.rightEndHom_mk_apply
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem rightEndHom_mk_apply
    (H : OpenKernel G) (g a : G) :
    ((rightEndHom G H (QuotientGroup.mk g)).hom.hom :
      G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup →
        G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup)
      (QuotientGroup.mk a) =
        QuotientGroup.mk (a * g⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.rightEndHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem rightEndHom_apply
    (H : OpenKernel G)
    (r q : G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup) :
    ((rightEndHom G H r).hom.hom :
      G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup →
        G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup) q =
      q * r⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ :=
    QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
      H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup r
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ :=
    QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
      H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup q
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.quotient_right_pretransitive
statement:
private theorem quotient_right_pretransitive (H : OpenKernel G) :
    let J
proof:
:=
      rightActionDiagram G H ⋙
        forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat ⋙
          FintypeCat.incl
    MulAction.IsPretransitive
      (G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup)
      (J.obj (SingleObj.star
        (G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup))) := by
  dsimp only
  constructor
  intro x y
  change G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup at x y
  refine ⟨y⁻¹ * x, ?_⟩
  change
    ((rightEndHom G H (y⁻¹ * x)).hom.hom :
      G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup →
        G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup) x = y
  rw [rightEndHom_apply]
  group
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.image_right_pretransitive
statement:
private theorem image_right_pretransitive
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (H : OpenKernel G) :
    let R
proof:
:= G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup
    let JF := rightActionDiagram G H ⋙ F ⋙ FintypeCat.incl
    MulAction.IsPretransitive R
      (JF.obj (SingleObj.star R)) := by
  let R := G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup
  let J := rightActionDiagram G H
  let JF := J ⋙ F ⋙ FintypeCat.incl
  have hterminal : IsTerminal (F.obj (colimit J)) :=
    IsTerminal.isTerminalObj F (colimit J)
      (rightActionColimitTerminal G H)
  let : Unique (F.obj (colimit J) : Type u) :=
    Concrete.uniqueOfTerminalOfPreserves
      (F.obj (colimit J)) hterminal
  let e :
      (F.obj (colimit J) : Type u) ≃
        MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient R
          (JF.obj (SingleObj.star R)) :=
    (preservesColimitIso (F ⋙ FintypeCat.incl) J ≪≫
      Equiv.toIso (SingleObj.Types.colimitEquivQuotient JF)).toEquiv
  let : Unique
      (MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient R
        (JF.obj (SingleObj.star R))) :=
    { default := e default
      uniq := fun x => e.symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _) }
  let : Nonempty (JF.obj (SingleObj.star R)) := by
    change Nonempty (F.obj (quotientObject G H))
    exact quotientFiber_nonempty G F H
  exact
    (MulAction.pretransitive_iff_unique_quotient_of_nonempty
      R (JF.obj (SingleObj.star R))).mpr ⟨inferInstance⟩

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.rightEndHom_fixed_implies_one
statement:
private theorem rightEndHom_fixed_implies_one
    (H : OpenKernel G)
    (r : G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup)
    (q :
      (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj
        (quotientObject G H))
    (hq :
      (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).map
        (rightEndHom G H r) q = q) :
    r = 1
proof:
:= by
  change G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup at q
  change
    ((rightEndHom G H r).hom.hom :
      (G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup) →
        (G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup)) q = q at hq
  rw [rightEndHom_apply] at hq
  have hq' : q * r⁻¹ = q * 1 :=
    hq.trans (mul_one q).symm
  exact inv_eq_one.mp (mul_left_cancel hq')

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.image_right_fixed_implies_one
statement:
private theorem image_right_fixed_implies_one
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (H : OpenKernel G)
    (r : G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup)
    (s : F.obj (quotientObject G H))
    (hs : F.map (rightEndHom G H r) s = s) :
    r = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hr
  let C := ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G
  let U := forget₂ C FintypeCat
  let e : End (quotientObject G H) := rightEndHom G H r
  let E := equalizer e (𝟙 (quotientObject G H))
  have hemptyU : IsEmpty (U.obj E) := by
    constructor
    intro z
    let z' := finiteEqualizerEquiv G U e
      (𝟙 (quotientObject G H)) z
    have hz := z'.property
    apply hr
    apply rightEndHom_fixed_implies_one G H r z'.val
    simpa [e] using hz
  have hEinitial : IsInitial E := by
    refine IsInitial.ofUniqueHom ?_ ?_
    · intro Y
      exact ⟨
        { hom := FintypeCat.homMk (fun x => (hemptyU.false x).elim)
          comm := fun g => by
            apply FintypeCat.hom_ext
            intro x
            exact (hemptyU.false x).elim }⟩
    · intro Y f
      apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
      apply Action.hom_ext
      apply FintypeCat.hom_ext
      intro x
      exact (hemptyU.false x).elim
  have hFEinitial : IsInitial (F.obj E) :=
    IsInitial.isInitialObj F E hEinitial
  have hemptyF : IsEmpty (F.obj E) :=
    Concrete.empty_of_initial_of_preserves
      (F.obj E) ⟨hFEinitial⟩
  apply hemptyF.false
  exact
    (finiteEqualizerEquiv G F e
      (𝟙 (quotientObject G H))).symm
        ⟨s, by simpa [e] using hs⟩

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.image_right_transitive
statement:
private theorem image_right_transitive
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (H : OpenKernel G)
    (x y : F.obj (quotientObject G H)) :
    ∃ r : G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup,
      F.map (rightEndHom G H r) x = y
proof:
:= by
  let R := G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup
  let JF := rightActionDiagram G H ⋙ F ⋙ FintypeCat.incl
  have hpre :
      MulAction.IsPretransitive R
        (JF.obj (SingleObj.star R)) :=
    image_right_pretransitive G F H
  rcases hpre.exists_smul_eq x y with ⟨r, hr⟩
  exact ⟨r, hr⟩

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.fiberComparison_right_equivariant
statement:
private theorem fiberComparison_right_equivariant
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (H : OpenKernel G)
    (r : G ⧸ H.toOpenNormalSubgroup.toSubgroup)
    (q :
      (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj
        (quotientObject G H)) :
    fiberComparisonApp G F (quotientObject G H)
        ((forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).map
          (rightEndHom G H r) q) =
      F.map (rightEndHom G H r)
        (fiberComparisonApp G F (quotientObject G H) q)
proof:
:= by
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    ((fiberComparison G F).naturality (rightEndHom G H r)) q

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.fiberComparison_quotient_bijective
statement:
private theorem fiberComparison_quotient_bijective
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (H : OpenKernel G) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fiberComparisonApp G F (quotientObject G H))
proof:
:= by
  let U := forget₂
    (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat
  let t := fiberComparisonApp G F (quotientObject G H)
  constructor
  · intro q₁ q₂ hq
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ :=
      quotient_right_pretransitive G H |>.exists_smul_eq q₁ q₂
    have hr' :
        U.map (rightEndHom G H r) q₁ = q₂ := hr
    have hfixed :
        F.map (rightEndHom G H r) (t q₁) = t q₁ := by
      calc
        F.map (rightEndHom G H r) (t q₁) =
            t (U.map (rightEndHom G H r) q₁) :=
          (fiberComparison_right_equivariant G F H r q₁).symm
        _ = t q₂ := congrArg t hr'
        _ = t q₁ := hq.symm
    have hrone :=
      image_right_fixed_implies_one G F H r (t q₁) hfixed
    subst r
    simpa using hr'
  · intro y
    let q₀ :
        (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj
          (quotientObject G H) :=
      QuotientGroup.mk 1
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ :=
      image_right_transitive G F H (t q₀) y
    refine ⟨U.map (rightEndHom G H r) q₀, ?_⟩
    exact
      (fiberComparison_right_equivariant G F H r q₀).trans hr

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.copies_ι_cover
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
private theorem copies_ι_cover
    (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G)
    (x : (forget₂
      (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj X) :
    colimit.ι (copiesDiagram G X) ⟨x⟩ ≫ copiesCover G X =
      evaluation G X x
proof:
:= by
  exact colimit.ι_desc
    (Cofan.mk X fun x => evaluation G X x) ⟨x⟩

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.evaluation_one
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem evaluation_one
    (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G)
    (x : (forget₂
      (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj X) :
    (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).map
        (evaluation G X x)
        (QuotientGroup.mk 1) = x
proof:
:= by
  change (1 : G) • x = x
  exact one_smul G x

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.copiesCover_surjective
statement:
private theorem copiesCover_surjective
    (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) :
    Function.Surjective (copiesCover G X)
proof:
:= by
  let U := forget₂
    (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat
  intro x
  let q₀ :
      U.obj (quotientObject G (actionKernelIndex G X)) :=
    QuotientGroup.mk 1
  refine
    ⟨U.map (colimit.ι (copiesDiagram G X) ⟨x⟩) q₀, ?_⟩
  exact
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (copies_ι_cover G X x) q₀).trans
      (evaluation_one G X x)

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.fiberComparison_copies_isIso
statement:
private theorem fiberComparison_copies_isIso
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) :
    IsIso
      ((fiberComparison G F).app (copiesObject G X))
proof:
:= by
  let t := fiberComparison G F
  let D := copiesDiagram G X
  let (j : Discrete
      ((forget₂
        (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat).obj X)) :
      IsIso ((Functor.whiskerLeft D t).app j) := by
    apply (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mpr
    exact fiberComparison_quotient_bijective G F
      (actionKernelIndex G X)
  let : IsIso (Functor.whiskerLeft D t) :=
    NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app _
  exact isIso_app_coconePt_of_preservesColimit
    D t (colimit.cocone D) (colimit.isColimit D)

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.finitePullbackEquiv_symm_fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem finitePullbackEquiv_symm_fst_apply
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    {X A B : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G}
    {f : A ⟶ X} {g : B ⟶ X}
    (a : F.obj A) (b : F.obj B)
    (h : F.map f a = F.map g b) :
    F.map (pullback.fst f g)
        ((finitePullbackEquiv G F f g).symm
          ⟨(a, b), h⟩) = a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePullbackEquiv, Functor.comp_map,
    Iso.toEquiv_comp]
  change ((Types.pullbackIsoPullback _ _).inv ≫ _ ≫
    (F ⋙ FintypeCat.incl).map (pullback.fst f g)) _ = _
  erw [PreservesPullback.iso_inv_fst,
    Types.pullbackIsoPullback_inv_fst]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.finitePullbackEquiv_symm_snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem finitePullbackEquiv_symm_snd_apply
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    {X A B : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G}
    {f : A ⟶ X} {g : B ⟶ X}
    (a : F.obj A) (b : F.obj B)
    (h : F.map f a = F.map g b) :
    F.map (pullback.snd f g)
        ((finitePullbackEquiv G F f g).symm
          ⟨(a, b), h⟩) = b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePullbackEquiv, Functor.comp_map,
    Iso.toEquiv_comp]
  change ((Types.pullbackIsoPullback _ _).inv ≫ _ ≫
    (F ⋙ FintypeCat.incl).map (pullback.snd f g)) _ = _
  erw [PreservesPullback.iso_inv_snd,
    Types.pullbackIsoPullback_inv_snd]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.fiberComparison_surjective
statement:
private theorem fiberComparison_surjective
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) :
    Function.Surjective
      ((fiberComparison G F).app X)
proof:
:= by
  let C := ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G
  let U := forget₂ C FintypeCat
  let t := fiberComparison G F
  let P := copiesObject G X
  let p : P ⟶ X := copiesCover G X
  have hp : Function.Surjective p :=
    copiesCover_surjective G X
  let : Epi p :=
    ConcreteCategory.epi_of_surjective p hp
  let : F.PreservesEpimorphisms := by
    infer_instance
  let : Epi (F.map p) :=
    Functor.map_epi F p
  have hFp : Function.Surjective (F.map p) :=
    ConcreteCategory.surjective_of_epi_of_preservesPushout
      (F.map p)
  let : IsIso (t.app P) :=
    fiberComparison_copies_isIso G F X
  have htP : Function.Bijective (t.app P) :=
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (t.app P)
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hFp y
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := htP.2 z
  refine ⟨U.map p a, ?_⟩
  calc
    t.app X (U.map p a) =
        F.map p (t.app P a) :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (t.naturality p) a
    _ = F.map p z := congrArg (F.map p) ha
    _ = y := hz

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.fiberComparison_injective
statement:
private theorem fiberComparison_injective
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) :
    Function.Injective
      ((fiberComparison G F).app X)
proof:
:= by
  let C := ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G
  let U := forget₂ C FintypeCat
  let t := fiberComparison G F
  let P := copiesObject G X
  let p : P ⟶ X := copiesCover G X
  have hp : Function.Surjective p :=
    copiesCover_surjective G X
  let : IsIso (t.app P) :=
    fiberComparison_copies_isIso G F X
  have htP : Function.Bijective (t.app P) :=
    ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (t.app P)
  intro x₁ x₂ hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hp x₁
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hp x₂
  have habF :
      F.map p (t.app P a) =
        F.map p (t.app P b) := by
    calc
      F.map p (t.app P a) =
          t.app X (U.map p a) :=
        (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
          (t.naturality p) a).symm
      _ = t.app X x₁ := congrArg (t.app X) ha
      _ = t.app X x₂ := hx
      _ = t.app X (U.map p b) :=
        congrArg (t.app X) hb.symm
      _ = F.map p (t.app P b) :=
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
          (t.naturality p) b
  let R := pullback p p
  let zF : F.obj R :=
    (finitePullbackEquiv G F p p).symm
      ⟨(t.app P a, t.app P b), habF⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
    fiberComparison_surjective G F R zF
  have hfstT :
      t.app P (U.map (pullback.fst p p) z) =
        t.app P a := by
    calc
      t.app P (U.map (pullback.fst p p) z) =
          F.map (pullback.fst p p) (t.app R z) :=
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
          (t.naturality (pullback.fst p p)) z
      _ = F.map (pullback.fst p p) zF :=
        congrArg (F.map (pullback.fst p p)) hz
      _ = t.app P a :=
        finitePullbackEquiv_symm_fst_apply
          G F (t.app P a) (t.app P b) habF
  have hsndT :
      t.app P (U.map (pullback.snd p p) z) =
        t.app P b := by
    calc
      t.app P (U.map (pullback.snd p p) z) =
          F.map (pullback.snd p p) (t.app R z) :=
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
          (t.naturality (pullback.snd p p)) z
      _ = F.map (pullback.snd p p) zF :=
        congrArg (F.map (pullback.snd p p)) hz
      _ = t.app P b :=
        finitePullbackEquiv_symm_snd_apply
          G F (t.app P a) (t.app P b) habF
  have hfst :
      U.map (pullback.fst p p) z = a :=
    htP.1 hfstT
  have hsnd :
      U.map (pullback.snd p p) z = b :=
    htP.1 hsndT
  have hcond :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (pullback.condition : pullback.fst p p ≫ p =
        pullback.snd p p ≫ p) z
  change
    U.map p (U.map (pullback.fst p p) z) =
      U.map p (U.map (pullback.snd p p) z) at hcond
  rw [hfst, hsnd] at hcond
  exact ha.symm.trans (hcond.trans hb)

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.fiberComparison_bijective
statement:
private theorem fiberComparison_bijective
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((fiberComparison G F).app X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fiberComparison_injective G F X,
    fiberComparison_surjective G F X⟩

name: CategoryTheory.FiniteContinuousAction.nonempty_iso_forget_of_exact
statement:
@[stacks 0BMV]
theorem nonempty_iso_forget_of_exact
    (F : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G ⥤ FintypeCat.{u})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] :
    Nonempty
      (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) FintypeCat ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  let t := fiberComparison G F
  let (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{u} G) :
      IsIso (t.app X) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective
      (t.app X)).mpr
        (fiberComparison_bijective G F X)
  let : IsIso t :=
    NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app t
  exact ⟨asIso t⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.categorical_span_of_action_span
statement:
private theorem categorical_span_of_action_span
    (H : C ⥤ C') (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
    (hspan : ∀ X' : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} (Aut F'),
      Nonempty X'.obj.V →
      MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F') X'.obj.V →
      ∃ (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} (Aut F))
        (Y' : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} (Aut F'))
        (e : Y' ⟶ X')
        (m : Y' ⟶
          (ContAction.res FintypeCat (autHomOfCompIso H t)).obj X),
        Epi e ∧ Mono m) :
    ∀ X' : C', IsConnected X' →
      ∃ (Y' : C') (X : C) (e : Y' ⟶ X') (m : Y' ⟶ H.obj X),
        Epi e ∧ Mono m
proof:
:= by
  intro X' hconn
  let : IsConnected X' := hconn
  let E := functorToContAction F
  let E' := functorToContAction F'
  let R := ContAction.res FintypeCat (autHomOfCompIso H t)
  have hnon : Nonempty (E'.obj X').obj.V := by
    change Nonempty (F'.obj X')
    infer_instance
  have htrans : MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F') (E'.obj X').obj.V := by
    change MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F') (F'.obj X')
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨Z, Y, e, m, he, hm⟩ := hspan (E'.obj X') hnon htrans
  let Y' : C' := E'.objPreimage Y
  let X : C := E.objPreimage Z
  let eY : E'.obj Y' ≅ Y := E'.objObjPreimageIso Y
  let eZ : E.obj X ≅ Z := E.objObjPreimageIso Z
  let s : E'.obj (H.obj X) ≅ R.obj (E.obj X) :=
    (functorToContActionCompIso H t).app X
  let ee : E'.obj Y' ⟶ E'.obj X' := eY.hom ≫ e
  let mm : E'.obj Y' ⟶ E'.obj (H.obj X) :=
    eY.hom ≫ m ≫ (R.mapIso eZ).inv ≫ s.inv
  let ff := Functor.FullyFaithful.ofFullyFaithful E'
  let e' : Y' ⟶ X' := ff.preimage ee
  let m' : Y' ⟶ H.obj X := ff.preimage mm
  have : Epi ee := by
    dsimp [ee]
    infer_instance
  have : Mono mm := by
    dsimp [mm]
    infer_instance
  have hemap : E'.map e' = ee := ff.map_preimage ee
  have hmmap : E'.map m' = mm := ff.map_preimage mm
  have : Epi (E'.map e') := hemap ▸ inferInstance
  have : Mono (E'.map m') := hmmap ▸ inferInstance
  have : Epi e' := E'.epi_of_epi_map inferInstance
  have : Mono m' := E'.mono_of_mono_map inferInstance
  exact ⟨Y', X, e', m', inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.action_span_of_categorical_span
statement:
private theorem action_span_of_categorical_span
    (H : C ⥤ C') (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
    (hspan : ∀ X' : C', IsConnected X' →
      ∃ (Y' : C') (X : C) (e : Y' ⟶ X') (m : Y' ⟶ H.obj X),
        Epi e ∧ Mono m) :
    ∀ Z : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} (Aut F'),
      Nonempty Z.obj.V →
      MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F') Z.obj.V →
      ∃ (X : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} (Aut F))
        (Y : ContAction FintypeCat.{w} (Aut F'))
        (q : Y ⟶ Z)
        (i : Y ⟶
          (ContAction.res FintypeCat (autHomOfCompIso H t)).obj X),
        Epi q ∧ Mono i
proof:
:= by
  intro Z hnon htrans
  let E := functorToContAction F
  let E' := functorToContAction F'
  let R := ContAction.res FintypeCat (autHomOfCompIso H t)
  let X' : C' := E'.objPreimage Z
  let eZ : E'.obj X' ≅ Z := E'.objObjPreimageIso Z
  let ef :=
    (forget₂ (ContAction FintypeCat (Aut F')) FintypeCat).mapIso eZ
  let : Nonempty (F'.obj X') := ⟨ef.inv hnon.some⟩
  let : MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F') (F'.obj X') := by
    constructor
    intro x y
    let zx : Z.obj.V := ef.hom x
    let zy : Z.obj.V := ef.hom y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := htrans.exists_smul_eq zx zy
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ef.hom).injective
    have hc := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (eZ.hom.hom.comm a) x
    change ef.hom (a • x) = a • zx at hc
    exact hc.trans ha
  let : IsConnected X' :=
    FiberFunctor.isConnected_of_isPretransitive F' X'
  obtain ⟨Y', X, q, i, hq, hi⟩ := hspan X' inferInstance
  let : Epi q := hq
  let : Mono i := hi
  let s : E'.obj (H.obj X) ≅ R.obj (E.obj X) :=
    (functorToContActionCompIso H t).app X
  let q' : E'.obj Y' ⟶ Z := E'.map q ≫ eZ.hom
  let i' : E'.obj Y' ⟶ R.obj (E.obj X) := E'.map i ≫ s.hom
  have : Epi (E'.map q) := E'.map_epi q
  have : Mono (E'.map i) := E'.map_mono i
  have : Epi q' := by
    dsimp [q']
    infer_instance
  have : Mono i' := by
    dsimp [i']
    infer_instance
  exact ⟨E.obj X, E'.obj Y', q', i', inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_injective_iff_exists_epi_mono_span
statement:
@[stacks 0BN7]
theorem autHomOfCompIso_injective_iff_exists_epi_mono_span
    (H : C ⥤ C') (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) :
    Function.Injective (autHomOfCompIso H t) ↔
      ∀ X' : C', IsConnected X' →
        ∃ (Y' : C') (X : C)
          (q : Y' ⟶ X') (i : Y' ⟶ H.obj X),
          Epi q ∧ Mono i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hinj
    exact categorical_span_of_action_span H t
      ((ContAction.injective_iff_exists_epi_mono_span
        (autHomOfCompIso H t)).1 hinj)
  · intro hspan
    apply (ContAction.injective_iff_exists_epi_mono_span
      (autHomOfCompIso H t)).2
    exact action_span_of_categorical_span H t hspan

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_injective_of_essSurj
statement:
theorem autHomOfCompIso_injective_of_essSurj
    (H : Functor C C') [H.EssSurj] (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) :
    Function.Injective (autHomOfCompIso H t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [autHomOfCompIso_injective_iff_exists_epi_mono_span]
  intro X' _
  let X := H.objPreimage X'
  let e : H.obj X ≅ X' := H.objObjPreimageIso X'
  exact ⟨X', X, 𝟙 X', e.inv, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.composite_smul_transport
statement:
private theorem composite_smul_transport
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) (t' : H' ⋙ F'' ≅ F')
    (X : C) (a : Aut F'')
    (x : F''.obj ((H ⋙ H').obj X)) :
    (t.app X).hom ((t'.app (H.obj X)).hom (a • x)) =
      (autHomOfCompIso H t (autHomOfCompIso H' t' a)) •
        (t.app X).hom ((t'.app (H.obj X)).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  let s' := (functorToContActionCompIso H' t').app (H.obj X)
  let s := (functorToContActionCompIso H t).app X
  have ha' := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (s'.hom.hom.comm a) x
  change (t'.app (H.obj X)).hom (a • x) =
      (autHomOfCompIso H' t' a) • (t'.app (H.obj X)).hom x at ha'
  have ha := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (s.hom.hom.comm (autHomOfCompIso H' t' a))
      ((t'.app (H.obj X)).hom x)
  change (t.app X).hom
      ((autHomOfCompIso H' t' a) • (t'.app (H.obj X)).hom x) =
      (autHomOfCompIso H t (autHomOfCompIso H' t' a)) •
        (t.app X).hom ((t'.app (H.obj X)).hom x) at ha
  exact (congrArg (t.app X).hom ha').trans ha

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.composite_trivial_smul
statement:
private theorem composite_trivial_smul
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) (t' : H' ⋙ F'' ≅ F')
    (hcomp :
      (autHomOfCompIso H t).comp (autHomOfCompIso H' t') = 1)
    (X : C) (a : Aut F'') (x : F''.obj ((H ⋙ H').obj X)) :
    a • x = x
proof:
:= by
  apply
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (t'.app (H.obj X)).hom).injective
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (t.app X).hom).injective
  rw [composite_smul_transport H H' t t' X a x]
  have ha := congrArg (fun k : Aut F'' →ₜ* Aut F => k a) hcomp
  change autHomOfCompIso H t (autHomOfCompIso H' t' a) = 1 at ha
  rw [ha, one_smul]

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.fixed_smul_decomposition
statement:
private theorem fixed_smul_decomposition
    (Z : C'')
    (hfixed : ∀ (a : Aut F'') (x : F''.obj Z), a • x = x) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι),
      Nonempty ((∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'') ≅ Z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, hfin, f, e, hf⟩ :=
    has_decomp_connected_components' Z
  have hterm (i : ι) : IsTerminal (f i) := by
    letI : IsConnected (f i) := hf i
    let q : f i ⟶ Z := Sigma.ι f i ≫ e.hom
    haveI : Mono q := mono_comp _ _
    haveI : Mono (F''.map q) := F''.map_mono q
    have hqinj : Function.Injective (F''.map q) :=
      (ConcreteCategory.mono_iff_injective_of_preservesPullback
        (F''.map q)).mp inferInstance
    have hsub : Subsingleton (F''.obj (f i)) := ⟨by
      intro y z
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
        (inferInstance :
          MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F'') (F''.obj (f i))).exists_smul_eq
            y z
      apply hqinj
      rw [← ha, ← mulAction_naturality F'' a q y]
      exact (hfixed a (F''.map q y)).symm⟩
    have hnon : Nonempty (F''.obj (f i)) := inferInstance
    have hFterm : IsTerminal (F''.obj (f i)) := by
      refine IsTerminal.ofUniqueHom
        (fun Y => FintypeCat.homMk (fun _ => hnon.some)) ?_
      intro Y m
      ext y
      exact hsub.elim _ _
    exact hFterm.isTerminalOfObj F'' (f i)
  exact ⟨ι, hfin,
    ⟨Sigma.mapIso
      (fun i => terminalIsTerminal.uniqueUpToIso (hterm i)) ≪≫ e⟩⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.fiber_coproduct_terminal_exists_rep
statement:
private theorem fiber_coproduct_terminal_exists_rep
    {ι : Type} [Finite ι]
    (x : F''.obj (∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'')) :
    ∃ (i : ι) (y : F''.obj (⊤_ C'')),
      F''.map (Sigma.ι (fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'') i) y = x
proof:
:= by
  let f : ι → C'' := fun _ => ⊤_ C''
  let c : Cofan f := Cofan.mk (∐ f) (Sigma.ι f)
  have hc : IsColimit c := colimit.isColimit (Discrete.functor f)
  let s : Cocone (Discrete.functor f ⋙ F'') := F''.mapCocone c
  have hs : IsColimit s := isColimitOfPreserves F'' hc
  obtain ⟨⟨i⟩, y, hy⟩ := Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep _ hs x
  exact ⟨i, y, hy⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.coproduct_terminal_smul_eq
statement:
private theorem coproduct_terminal_smul_eq
    {ι : Type} [Finite ι]
    (a : Aut F'') (x : F''.obj (∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'')) :
    a • x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ :=
    fiber_coproduct_terminal_exists_rep (F'' := F'') x
  rw [mulAction_naturality]
  congr 1
  have hterm : IsTerminal (F''.obj (⊤_ C'')) :=
    terminalIsTerminal.isTerminalObj F'' (⊤_ C'')
  let : Unique (F''.obj (⊤_ C'')) :=
    Concrete.uniqueOfTerminalOfPreserves (F''.obj (⊤_ C'')) hterm
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.terminal_coproduct_iso_smul_eq
statement:
private theorem terminal_coproduct_iso_smul_eq
    {Z : C''}
    (hZ : ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι),
      Nonempty ((∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'') ≅ Z))
    (a : Aut F'') (x : F''.obj Z) :
    a • x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, hfin, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hZ
  let y : F''.obj (∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'') := (F''.mapIso e).inv x
  have hy : a • y = y :=
    coproduct_terminal_smul_eq (F'' := F'') a y
  have hmap : F''.map e.hom y = x :=
    FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply (F''.mapIso e) x
  calc
    a • x = a • F''.map e.hom y := congrArg (a • ·) hmap.symm
    _ = F''.map e.hom (a • y) := mulAction_naturality F'' a e.hom y
    _ = F''.map e.hom y := congrArg (F''.map e.hom) hy
    _ = x := hmap

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.exists_iso_finite_coproduct_terminal_iff_fixed
statement:
theorem exists_iso_finite_coproduct_terminal_iff_fixed
    (Z : C'') :
    (∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι),
      Nonempty ((∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'') ≅ Z)) ↔
      ∀ (a : Aut F'') (x : F''.obj Z), a • x = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hZ ↦ terminal_coproduct_iso_smul_eq (F'' := F'') hZ,
    fixed_smul_decomposition (F'' := F'') Z⟩

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.composite_trivial_decomposition
statement:
private theorem composite_trivial_decomposition
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) (t' : H' ⋙ F'' ≅ F')
    (hcomp :
      (autHomOfCompIso H t).comp (autHomOfCompIso H' t') = 1) :
    ∀ X : C, ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι),
