      Nonempty ((∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'') ≅ (H ⋙ H').obj X)
proof:
:= by
  intro X
  exact
    (exists_iso_finite_coproduct_terminal_iff_fixed
      (F'' := F'') ((H ⋙ H').obj X)).2
      (composite_trivial_smul H H' t t' hcomp X)

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.terminal_decomposition_composite_trivial
statement:
private theorem terminal_decomposition_composite_trivial
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) (t' : H' ⋙ F'' ≅ F')
    (hdecomp : ∀ X : C, ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι),
      Nonempty ((∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'') ≅ (H ⋙ H').obj X)) :
    (autHomOfCompIso H t).comp (autHomOfCompIso H' t') = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro a
  apply Aut.ext
  ext X x
  change autHomOfCompIso H t (autHomOfCompIso H' t' a) • x = x
  let y : F''.obj ((H ⋙ H').obj X) :=
    (t'.app (H.obj X)).inv ((t.app X).inv x)
  have hy : a • y = y :=
    terminal_coproduct_iso_smul_eq (F'' := F'') (hdecomp X) a y
  have htransport := composite_smul_transport H H' t t' X a y
  rw [hy] at htransport
  have hto : (t.app X).hom ((t'.app (H.obj X)).hom y) = x := by
    change (t.app X).hom ((t'.app (H.obj X)).hom
      ((t'.app (H.obj X)).inv ((t.app X).inv x))) = x
    rw [FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply, FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply]
  rw [hto] at htransport
  exact htransport.symm

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_comp_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[stacks 0BS8]
theorem autHomOfCompIso_comp_eq_one_iff
    (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F) (t' : H' ⋙ F'' ≅ F') :
    (autHomOfCompIso H t).comp (autHomOfCompIso H' t') = 1 ↔
      ∀ X : C, ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Finite ι),
        Nonempty ((∐ fun _ : ι => ⊤_ C'') ≅ (H ⋙ H').obj X)
proof:
:=
  ⟨composite_trivial_decomposition H H' t t',
    terminal_decomposition_composite_trivial H H' t t'⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_tmul_right_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_tmul_right_coe
    {A : Type uA} {T : Type uT} {F : Type uF} {Omega : Type uOmega}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing T] [Algebra A T]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F]
    [Field Omega] [Algebra F Omega]
    (E K' : IntermediateField F Omega)
    [Algebra A K'] [IsScalarTower A F K']
    (eGeneric : (F ⊗[A] T) ≃ₐ[F] E) (c : T) :
    (((actualCompositumGenericComponentMap E K' eGeneric)
        (1 ⊗ₜ[A] c) :
          (E ⊔ K' : IntermediateField F Omega)) : Omega) =
      ((eGeneric (1 ⊗ₜ[A] c) : E) : Omega)
proof:
:= by
  simp [actualCompositumGenericComponentMap,
    iteratedGenericFiberEquiv, supFlipProductMapRightAlgHom]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_surjective
statement:
theorem actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_surjective
    {A : Type uA} {T : Type uT} {F : Type uF} {Omega : Type uOmega}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing T] [Algebra A T]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F]
    [Field Omega] [Algebra F Omega]
    (E K' : IntermediateField F Omega)
    [Algebra A K'] [IsScalarTower A F K']
    [FiniteDimensional F E]
    (eGeneric : (F ⊗[A] T) ≃ₐ[F] E) :
    Function.Surjective
      (actualCompositumGenericComponentMap E K' eGeneric)
proof:
:=
  (supFlipProductMapRightAlgHom_surjective E K').comp
    (iteratedGenericFiberEquiv A F K' T E eGeneric).surjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal_isMaximal
    {A : Type uA} {T : Type uT} {F : Type uF} {Omega : Type uOmega}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing T] [Algebra A T]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F]
    [Field Omega] [Algebra F Omega]
    (E K' : IntermediateField F Omega)
    [Algebra A K'] [IsScalarTower A F K']
    [FiniteDimensional F E]
    (eGeneric : (F ⊗[A] T) ≃ₐ[F] E) :
    (actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal E K' eGeneric).IsMaximal
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective
    (actualCompositumGenericComponentMap E K' eGeneric)
    (actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_surjective E K' eGeneric)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.actualCompositumGenericComponentAlgEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem actualCompositumGenericComponentAlgEquiv_mk
    {A : Type uA} {T : Type uT} {F : Type uF} {Omega : Type uOmega}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing T] [Algebra A T]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F]
    [Field Omega] [Algebra F Omega]
    (E K' : IntermediateField F Omega)
    [Algebra A K'] [IsScalarTower A F K']

        (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal E K' eGeneric) z) =
      actualCompositumGenericComponentMap E K' eGeneric z
proof:
:= by
  exact Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk
    (actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_surjective E K' eGeneric) z

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericTensorRestrictBaseMap_surjective

    Function.Surjective
      (genericTensorRestrictBaseMap
        (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁) (F := F) (L := L))
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y => exact ⟨x ⊗ₜ[K₀] y, genericTensorRestrictBaseMap_tmul x y⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_preservesTerminal
proof:
:= by
  let hIdX : IsFiniteEtale (𝟙 X) :=
    MorphismProperty.id_mem @IsFiniteEtale X
  let hIdU : IsFiniteEtale (𝟙 U) :=
    MorphismProperty.id_mem @IsFiniteEtale U
  let TX : FiniteEtale X :=
    @FiniteEtale.mk _ _ (𝟙 X) hIdX
  let TU : FiniteEtale U :=
    @FiniteEtale.mk _ _ (𝟙 U) hIdU
  let (Y : FiniteEtale X) : Unique (Y ⟶ TX) :=
    { default := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk Y.hom (by
        change Y.hom ≫ (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) = Y.hom
        exact Category.comp_id _)
      uniq := fun b ↦ by
        apply MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext
        have hb := b.w
        change b.left ≫ (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) = Y.hom at hb
        exact (Category.comp_id b.left).symm.trans hb }
  let (Y : FiniteEtale U) : Unique (Y ⟶ TU) :=
    { default := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk Y.hom (by
        change Y.hom ≫ (𝟙 U : U ⟶ U) = Y.hom
        exact Category.comp_id _)
      uniq := fun b ↦ by
        apply MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext
        have hb := b.w
        change b.left ≫ (𝟙 U : U ⟶ U) = Y.hom at hb
        exact (Category.comp_id b.left).symm.trans hb }
  have hTX : IsTerminal TX := IsTerminal.ofUnique TX
  have hTU : IsTerminal TU := IsTerminal.ofUnique TU
  let A : FiniteEtale U := (pullback j).obj (⊤_ (FiniteEtale X))
  let B : FiniteEtale U := (pullback j).obj TX
  let eAB : A ≅ B :=
    (pullback j).mapIso (terminalIsTerminal.uniqueUpToIso hTX)
  have : IsIso TX.hom := by
    change IsIso (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X)
    exact CategoryTheory.IsIso.id X
  have hSnd : IsIso (pullback.snd TX.hom j) := inferInstance
  let : IsIso (pullback.snd TX.hom j) := hSnd
  have : IsIso B.hom := by
    change IsIso (pullback.snd TX.hom j)
    exact hSnd
  let eBU₀ : B.left ≅ U := by
    change (Limits.pullback TX.hom j) ≅ U
    exact asIso (pullback.snd TX.hom j)
  let eBU : B ≅ TU :=
    MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk eBU₀ (by
      dsimp only [eBU₀, TU, FiniteEtale.mk_hom]
      exact Category.comp_id _)
  let e : A ≅ TU := eAB ≪≫ eBU
  have hA : IsTerminal A := hTU.ofIso e.symm
  let eTop : A ≅ ⊤_ (FiniteEtale U) :=
    hA.uniqueUpToIso terminalIsTerminal
  let : PreservesLimit (Functor.empty.{0} (FiniteEtale X))
      (pullback j) :=
    preservesTerminal_of_iso (pullback j) eTop
  exact preservesLimitsOfShape_pempty_of_preservesTerminal (pullback j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_surjective_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_surjective_of_isOpenImmersion
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [Nonempty U]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (ξ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U) :
    Function.Surjective (fundamentalGroupHom j ξ)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : ConnectedSpace X := inferInstance
  let : ConnectedSpace U := inferInstance
  let : PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete PEmpty.{1}) (pullback j) :=
    pullback_preservesTerminal j
  change Function.Surjective
    (autHomOfCompIso (pullback j) (pullbackFiberIso j ξ))
  apply ((autHomOfCompIso_surjective_tfae
    (fiber (ξ ≫ j)) (fiber ξ) (pullback j)
    (pullbackFiberIso j ξ)).out 3 1).mp

  let : IsConnected Y := hY
  exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.pullback_obj_isConnected_of_isOpenImmersion
    j Y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isGalois_obj_of_connected
statement:
private theorem isGalois_obj_of_connected
    {C C' : Type*} [Category C] [Category C']
    [GaloisCategory C] [GaloisCategory C']
    (F : C ⥤ FintypeCat) [FiberFunctor F]
    (F' : C' ⥤ FintypeCat) [FiberFunctor F']
    (H : C ⥤ C') (t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F)
    (Z : C) [IsGalois Z] [IsConnected (H.obj Z)] :
    IsGalois (H.obj Z)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isGalois_iff_pretransitive F' (H.obj Z)).mpr
  constructor
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq (Aut Z)
    ((t.app Z).hom x) ((t.app Z).hom y)
  refine ⟨H.mapAut Z σ, ?_⟩
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (t.app Z).hom).injective
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (t.hom.naturality σ.hom) x
  change (t.app Z).hom ((H.mapAut Z σ) • x) = σ • ((t.app Z).hom x) at hn
  exact hn.trans hσ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_ker_eq_iInf_extendableGalois
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_ker_eq_iInf_extendableGalois
    {U X : Scheme.{0}} [ConnectedSpace U] [ConnectedSpace X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (ξ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (fundamentalGroupHom j ξ)) :
    (fundamentalGroupHom j ξ).toMonoidHom.ker =
      ⨅ (W : FiniteEtale U) (hW : IsGalois W) (w : (fiber ξ).obj W)
        (_h : ∃ Z : FiniteEtale X, Nonempty ((pullback j).obj Z ≅ W)),
        (let : IsGalois W := hW
         galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom (fiber ξ) π₁ᵉᵗ(ξ) W w).ker
proof:
:= by
  let F := fiber (ξ ≫ j)
  let F' := fiber ξ
  let H := pullback j
  let t : H ⋙ F' ≅ F := pullbackFiberIso j ξ
  let : Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete PEmpty.{1}) H :=
    pullback_preservesLimitsOfShape_pempty j
  have hconn : ∀ Z : FiniteEtale X, IsConnected Z → IsConnected (H.obj Z) :=
    ((autHomOfCompIso_surjective_tfae F F' H t).out 1 3).mp hsurj
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    simp only [Subgroup.mem_iInf]
    intro W hW w hdescent
    let : IsGalois W := hW
    rw [galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    obtain ⟨Z, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hdescent
    let z : F'.obj (H.obj Z) := F'.map e.inv w
    have hz : g • z = z := by
      have hm : g ∈ (MulAction.stabilizer (Aut F) ((t.app Z).hom z)).comap
          (autHomOfCompIso H t).toMonoidHom := by
        change (fundamentalGroupHom j ξ g) • ((t.app Z).hom z) = (t.app Z).hom z
        have hfg : fundamentalGroupHom j ξ g = 1 := MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hg
        rw [hfg, one_smul]
      rw [← stabilizer_transportedPointOfCompIso H t] at hm
      have hp : transportedPointOfCompIso H t Z ((t.app Z).hom z) = z := by
        change (t.app Z).inv ((t.app Z).hom z) = z
        exact FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply (t.app Z) z
      rw [hp] at hm
      exact MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp hm
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (F'.map e.inv)).injective
    exact (mulAction_naturality F' g e.inv w).symm.trans hz
  · intro g hg
    apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
    apply Iso.ext
    apply natTrans_ext_of_isGalois F
    intro Z hZ
    let : IsGalois Z := hZ
    let : IsConnected (H.obj Z) := hconn Z inferInstance
    let hP : IsGalois (H.obj Z) := isGalois_obj_of_connected F F' H t Z
    apply FintypeCat.hom_ext
    intro z
    have hm := Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp
      (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp
        (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp hg (H.obj Z)) hP)
          (transportedPointOfCompIso H t Z z)) ⟨Z, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩
    let : IsGalois (H.obj Z) := hP
    rw [galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker,
      stabilizer_transportedPointOfCompIso H t] at hm
    change (autHomOfCompIso H t g) • z = z at hm
    exact hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.boundaryComplement_pullback_isConnected
statement:
theorem boundaryComplement_pullback_isConnected
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    (W : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected W] :
    IsConnected ((pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj W)
proof:
:= by
  let : ConnectedSpace W.left := connectedSpace_left_of_isConnected W
  let f : W.left ⟶ X := W.hom
  let : IsFiniteEtale f := W.prop
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian W.left :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
  let D' : W.left.EffectiveCartierDivisor := D.comapFiniteEtale W
  have hreg' : D'.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport :=
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport.comap_of_etale D.1 W.hom hreg
  let : ConnectedSpace D'.1.supportComplement := boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D' hreg'
  let e : ((pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj W).left ≅ D'.1.supportComplement :=
    pullbackSupportComplementIso D.1 W
  let : ConnectedSpace ((pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj W).left :=
    e.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance
  exact isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left ((pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj W)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.boundaryComplement_fundamentalGroupHom_surjective
statement:
theorem boundaryComplement_fundamentalGroupHom_surjective
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement) :
    Function.Surjective (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point)
proof:
:= by
  let j : (D.1.supportComplement : Scheme) ⟶ X := D.1.supportComplement.ι
  let : Limits.PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete PEmpty.{1}) (pullback j) :=
    pullback_preservesLimitsOfShape_pempty j
  change Function.Surjective (autHomOfCompIso (pullback j) (pullbackFiberIso j point))
  apply ((autHomOfCompIso_surjective_tfae (fiber (point ≫ j)) (fiber point)
    (pullback j) (pullbackFiberIso j point)).out 3 1).mp
  intro W hW
  let : IsConnected W := hW
  exact boundaryComplement_pullback_isConnected D hreg W

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fieldPullbackOverEquiv_naturality
statement:
private lemma fieldPullbackOverEquiv_naturality
    {X Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of k))} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (z : Over.mk (ξ K Ω) ⟶ ((pullback (ξ k K)).obj X).toComma) :
    fieldPullbackOverEquiv k K Ω Y
        (z ≫ ((pullback (ξ k K)).map f).hom) =
      fieldPullbackOverEquiv k K Ω X z ≫ f.hom
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Over.OverMorphism.ext
  have hmap :
      ((pullback (ξ k K)).map f).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom (ξ k K) =
        Limits.pullback.fst X.hom (ξ k K) ≫ f.left := by
    change Limits.pullback.lift
        (Limits.pullback.fst X.hom (ξ k K) ≫ f.left)
        (Limits.pullback.snd X.hom (ξ k K)) _ ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom (ξ k K) =
      Limits.pullback.fst X.hom (ξ k K) ≫ f.left
    exact Limits.pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  change (z.left ≫ ((pullback (ξ k K)).map f).left) ≫
      Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom (ξ k K) =
    (z.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst X.hom (ξ k K)) ≫ f.left
  erw [Category.assoc, hmap, ← Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberObjEquivHom_fieldFiberEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fiberObjEquivHom_fieldFiberEquiv
    (X : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of k)))
    (x : (pullback (ξ k K) ⋙ fib K Ω).obj X) :
    fiberObjEquivHom (ξ k Ω) X (fieldFiberEquiv k K Ω X x) =
      fieldPullbackOverEquiv k K Ω X
        (fiberObjEquivHom (ξ K Ω) ((pullback (ξ k K)).obj X) x)
proof:
:= by
  change fiberObjEquivHom (ξ k Ω) X
      ((fiberObjEquivHom (ξ k Ω) X).symm
        (fieldPullbackOverEquiv k K Ω X
          (fiberObjEquivHom (ξ K Ω) ((pullback (ξ k K)).obj X) x))) = _
  exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fieldPullbackOverEquiv_smul
statement:
lemma fieldPullbackOverEquiv_smul
    (X : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of k))) (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
    (z : Over.mk (ξ K Ω) ⟶ ((pullback (ξ k K)).obj X).toComma) :
    fieldPullbackOverEquiv k K Ω X (σ • z) =
      σ.restrictScalars k • fieldPullbackOverEquiv k K Ω X z
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (σ : Ω →+* Ω)) ≫ z.left) ≫
      Limits.pullback.fst X.hom (ξ k K) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (σ.restrictScalars k : Ω →+* Ω)) ≫
      (z.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst X.hom (ξ k K))
  exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fieldFiberEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem fieldFiberEquiv_smul
    (X : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of k))) (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
    (x : (fib K Ω).obj ((pullback (ξ k K)).obj X)) :
    fieldFiberEquiv k K Ω X (σ • x) =
      σ.restrictScalars k • fieldFiberEquiv k K Ω X x
proof:
:= by
  apply (fiberObjEquivHom (ξ k Ω) X).injective
  rw [fiberObjEquivHom_fieldFiberEquiv,
    algEquiv_smul_fiber_def, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [algEquiv_smul_fiber_def, Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
    fiberObjEquivHom_fieldFiberEquiv]
  exact fieldPullbackOverEquiv_smul k K Ω X σ
    (fiberObjEquivHom (ξ K Ω) ((pullback (ξ k K)).obj X) x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fieldFundamentalGroupHom_toAutMulEquiv_core
statement:
private theorem fieldFundamentalGroupHom_toAutMulEquiv_core
    [IsSepClosed Ω] (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) :
    CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso
        (pullback (ξ k K)) (fieldPullbackFiberIso k K Ω)
        (CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.toAutMulEquiv
          (fib K Ω) (Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) σ) =
      CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.toAutMulEquiv
        (fib k Ω) (Ω ≃ₐ[k] Ω) (σ.restrictScalars k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Aut.ext
  ext X x
  rw [CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_apply]
  change fieldFiberEquiv k K Ω X
      (σ • (show (fib K Ω).obj ((pullback (ξ k K)).obj X) from
        (fieldPullbackFiberIso k K Ω).inv.app X x)) =
    σ.restrictScalars k • x
  rw [fieldFiberEquiv_smul]
  change σ.restrictScalars k •
      ((fieldPullbackFiberIso k K Ω).hom.app X
        ((fieldPullbackFiberIso k K Ω).inv.app X x)) = _
  exact congrArg (fun y ↦ σ.restrictScalars k • y)
    (FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ((fieldPullbackFiberIso k K Ω).app X) x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fieldFundamentalGroupHom_toAutMulEquiv
statement:
theorem fieldFundamentalGroupHom_toAutMulEquiv
    (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) :
    fieldFundamentalGroupHom k K Ω (IsSepClosure.sep_closed k)
        (absoluteGaloisToFiberAutMulEquiv K Ω
          (IsSepClosure.sep_closed k) σ) =
      absoluteGaloisToFiberAutMulEquiv k Ω
        (IsSepClosure.sep_closed k) (σ.restrictScalars k)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsSepClosed Ω := IsSepClosure.sep_closed k
  exact fieldFundamentalGroupHom_toAutMulEquiv_core k K Ω σ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupIsoOfFiberIso_eq_conj
statement:
@[stacks 0BND "independence of the fiber comparison up to inner conjugation"]
theorem fundamentalGroupIsoOfFiberIso_eq_conj
    (t₁ t₂ : fiber ξ ≅ fiber ξ') (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(ξ)) :
    fundamentalGroupIsoOfFiberIso ξ ξ' t₂ a =
      MulAut.conj (G := π₁ᵉᵗ(ξ')) (t₁.symm ≪≫ t₂)
        (fundamentalGroupIsoOfFiberIso ξ ξ' t₁ a)
proof:
:=
  continuousConjAut_eq_conj t₁ t₂ a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_injective_of_pullback_essSurj
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_injective_of_pullback_essSurj
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [(pullback f).EssSurj]
    (ξ : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) :

    (pullback f) (pullbackFiberIso f ξ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.sourcePointOfFiberOver_fiberOverOfSourcePoint
statement:
private theorem sourcePointOfFiberOver_fiberOverOfSourcePoint
    (A : FiniteEtale S) (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    (B : FiniteEtale A.left) (z : Over.mk xi' ⟶ B.toComma) :
    sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' B (fiberOverOfSourcePoint A xi' B z) = z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberOverOfSourcePoint_sourcePointOfFiberOver
statement:
private theorem fiberOverOfSourcePoint_sourcePointOfFiberOver
    (A : FiniteEtale S) (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    (B : FiniteEtale A.left)
    (y : (fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).obj
      (toOverObj A B)) :
    fiberOverOfSourcePoint A xi' B (sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' B y) = y
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') (overBaseObj A B)).symm
    (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') (overBaseObj A B) y.1) = y.1
  exact Equiv.symm_apply_apply (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') (overBaseObj A B)) y.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberOverEquiv_apply
statement:
private theorem fiberOverEquiv_apply
    (A : FiniteEtale S) (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    (B : FiniteEtale A.left)
    (y : (fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).obj
      (toOverObj A B)) :

proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.sourcePointOfFiberOver_naturality
statement:
private theorem sourcePointOfFiberOver_naturality
    (A : FiniteEtale S) (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    {B C : FiniteEtale A.left} (f : B ⟶ C)
    (y : (fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).obj
      (toOverObj A B)) :
    sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' C
        ((fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).map
          (toOverMap A f) y) =
      sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' B y ≫ f.hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change
    (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') (overBaseObj A C)
      ((fiber (basePoint A xi')).map (toOverMap A f).left y.1)).left =
    (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') (overBaseObj A B) y.1).left ≫ f.left
  exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q.left)
    (fiberObjEquivHom_naturality (basePoint A xi') (toOverMap A f).left y.1).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberObjEquivHom_map_symm
statement:
private theorem fiberObjEquivHom_map_symm
    (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ S) {B C : FiniteEtale S} (f : B ⟶ C)
    (z : Over.mk xi' ⟶ B.toComma) :
    z ≫ f.hom =
      fiberObjEquivHom xi' C
        ((fiber xi').map f ((fiberObjEquivHom xi' B).symm z))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    z ≫ f.hom =
        fiberObjEquivHom xi' B ((fiberObjEquivHom xi' B).symm z) ≫ f.hom :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ f.hom) (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ z).symm
    _ = fiberObjEquivHom xi' C
        ((fiber xi').map f ((fiberObjEquivHom xi' B).symm z)) :=
      fiberObjEquivHom_naturality xi' f _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberOverFormula_naturality
statement:
private theorem fiberOverFormula_naturality
    (A : FiniteEtale S) (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    {B C : FiniteEtale A.left} (f : B ⟶ C)
    (y : (fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).obj
      (toOverObj A B)) :
    (fiberObjEquivHom xi' C).symm
        (sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' C
          ((fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).map
            (toOverMap A f) y)) =
      (fiber xi').map f
        ((fiberObjEquivHom xi' B).symm (sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' B y))
proof:
:= by
  apply (fiberObjEquivHom xi' C).symm_apply_eq.mpr
  exact (sourcePointOfFiberOver_naturality A xi' f y).trans
    (fiberObjEquivHom_map_symm xi' f (sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' B y))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberOverEquiv_naturality
statement:
private theorem fiberOverEquiv_naturality
    (A : FiniteEtale S) (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    {B C : FiniteEtale A.left} (f : B ⟶ C)
    (y : (fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).obj
      (toOverObj A B)) :
    fiberOverEquiv A xi' C
        ((fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).map
          (toOverMap A f) y) =
      (fiber xi').map f (fiberOverEquiv A xi' B y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [fiberOverEquiv_apply] using fiberOverFormula_naturality A xi' f y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.sourcePointOf_overEquivFiberIso_inv
statement:
private theorem sourcePointOf_overEquivFiberIso_inv
    (A : FiniteEtale S) (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    (B : FiniteEtale A.left) (p : (fiber xi').obj B) :
    sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' B
        ((overEquivFiberIso A xi').inv.app B p) =
      fiberObjEquivHom xi' B p
proof:
:= by
  let y := (overEquivFiberIso A xi').inv.app B p
  have h := FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ((overEquivFiberIso A xi').app B) p
  change fiberOverEquiv A xi' B y = p at h
  change (fiberObjEquivHom xi' B).symm
      (sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' B y) = p at h
  exact (fiberObjEquivHom xi' B).symm.injective
    (h.trans (Equiv.symm_apply_apply (fiberObjEquivHom xi' B) p).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberOver_map_pullbackToProductOver
statement:
private theorem fiberOver_map_pullbackToProductOver
    [ConnectedSpace S] (A : FiniteEtale S) (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    (B : FiniteEtale S) (b : (fiber (basePoint A xi')).obj B) :
    (fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).map
        (pullbackToProductOver A B)
        ((overEquivFiberIso A xi').inv.app ((pullback A.hom).obj B)
          (transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback A.hom)
            (pullbackFiberIso A.hom xi') B b)) =
      productFiberEquivComparison
        (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi') B b
proof:
:= by
  let PB : FiniteEtale A.left := (pullback A.hom).obj B
  let p : (fiber xi').obj PB :=
    transportedPointOfCompIso (pullback A.hom)
      (pullbackFiberIso A.hom xi') B b
  let y := (overEquivFiberIso A xi').inv.app PB p
  let pB : overBaseObj A PB ⟶ B :=
    MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (Limits.pullback.fst B.hom A.hom) (by
      exact Limits.pullback.condition)
  have hySource : sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' PB y =
      fiberObjEquivHom xi' PB p := by
    exact sourcePointOf_overEquivFiberIso_inv A xi' PB p
  have hp : (fiber (basePoint A xi')).map pB y.1 = b := by
    apply (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') B).injective
    rw [← fiberObjEquivHom_naturality (basePoint A xi') pB y.1]
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change ((fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') (overBaseObj A PB) y.1).left ≫
        pB.left : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ B.left) =
      (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') B b).left
    have htransport : (pullbackFiberIso A.hom xi').hom.app B p = b := by
      exact FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ((pullbackFiberIso A.hom xi').app B) b
    have hprojection :
        (fiberObjEquivHom xi' PB p).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst B.hom A.hom =
          (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') B
            ((pullbackFiberIso A.hom xi').hom.app B p)).left := by
      have h :=
        (pullbackFiberIso_hom_fiberObjEquivHom_left A.hom xi' B p).symm
      change ((fiberObjEquivHom xi' PB p).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst B.hom A.hom :
            Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ B.left) =
        (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') B
          ((pullbackFiberIso A.hom xi').hom.app B p)).left at h
      exact h
    let q0 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ B.left :=
      (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') (overBaseObj A PB) y.1).left ≫ pB.left
    let q1 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ B.left :=
      (sourcePointOfFiberOver A xi' PB y).left ≫
        Limits.pullback.fst B.hom A.hom
    let q2 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ B.left :=
      (fiberObjEquivHom xi' PB p).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst B.hom A.hom
    let q3 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ B.left :=
      (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') B
        ((pullbackFiberIso A.hom xi').hom.app B p)).left
    let q4 : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ B.left :=
      (fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') B b).left
    have h01 : q0 = q1 := by rfl
    have h12 : q1 = q2 := by
      exact congrArg
        (fun q ↦ (q.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst B.hom A.hom :
          Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ B.left)) hySource
    have h23 : q2 = q3 := hprojection
    have h34 : q3 = q4 := by
      exact congrArg
        (fun q ↦ ((fiberObjEquivHom (basePoint A xi') B q).left :
          Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ B.left)) htransport
    exact h01.trans (h12.trans (h23.trans h34))
  apply (productFiberEquivComparison
    (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi') B).symm.injective
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, productFiberEquivComparison_symm_apply]
  change (fiber (basePoint A xi')).map Limits.prod.fst
      (((fiberOver (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')).map
        (pullbackToProductOver A B)) y).1 = b
  change (fiber (basePoint A xi')).map Limits.prod.fst
    ((fiber (basePoint A xi')).map (pullbackToProductOver A B).left y.1) = b
  have hq : (pullbackToProductOver A B).left ≫ Limits.prod.fst = pB := by
    change Limits.prod.lift _ _ ≫ Limits.prod.fst = pB
    exact Limits.prod.lift_fst _ _
  calc
    (fiber (basePoint A xi')).map Limits.prod.fst
        ((fiber (basePoint A xi')).map (pullbackToProductOver A B).left y.1) =
      (fiber (basePoint A xi')).map
        ((pullbackToProductOver A B).left ≫ Limits.prod.fst) y.1 := by
          change
            ((fiber (basePoint A xi')).map (pullbackToProductOver A B).left ≫
              (fiber (basePoint A xi')).map Limits.prod.fst) y.1 =
              (fiber (basePoint A xi')).map
                ((pullbackToProductOver A B).left ≫ Limits.prod.fst) y.1
          exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q y.1)
            ((fiber (basePoint A xi')).map_comp
              (pullbackToProductOver A B).left Limits.prod.fst).symm
    _ = (fiber (basePoint A xi')).map pB y.1 :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ (fiber (basePoint A xi')).map q y.1) hq
    _ = b := hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLift_coe
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLift_coe
    [ConnectedSpace S] (A : FiniteEtale S)
    (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left) (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi')) :
    (fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLift A xi' a :
        π₁ᵉᵗ(basePoint A xi')) =
      fundamentalGroupHom A.hom xi' a
proof:
:= by
  change extendFiberOverAut (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi')
      ((autFiberOverEquivFiber A xi').symm a) =
    fundamentalGroupHom A.hom xi' a
  apply Aut.ext
  ext B b
  rw [extendFiberOverAut_hom_app_apply_eq]
  apply (productFiberEquivComparison
    (fiber (basePoint A xi')) (liftedFiberPoint A xi') B).injective
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  let F := fiber (basePoint A xi')
  let x := liftedFiberPoint A xi'
  let d : Aut (fiberOver F x) := (autFiberOverEquivFiber A xi').symm a
  let PB : FiniteEtale A.left := (pullback A.hom).obj B
  let tPull := pullbackFiberIso A.hom xi'
  let p : (fiber xi').obj PB := transportedPointOfCompIso
    (pullback A.hom) tPull B b
  let y := (overEquivFiberIso A xi').inv.app PB p
  let b' : F.obj B := (fundamentalGroupHom A.hom xi' a).hom.app B b
  let p' : (fiber xi').obj PB := transportedPointOfCompIso
    (pullback A.hom) tPull B b'
  let y' := (overEquivFiberIso A xi').inv.app PB p'
  have hdp : d.hom.app (toOverObj A ((pullback A.hom).obj B)) y = y' := by
    change d.hom.app ((overEquiv A).functor.obj PB) y = y'
    have hd : autFiberOverEquivFiber A xi' d = a := by
      exact (autFiberOverEquivFiber A xi').apply_symm_apply a
    have heq : (overEquivFiberIso A xi').hom.app PB (d.hom.app _ y) =
        (autHomOfCompIso (overEquiv A).functor
          (overEquivFiberIso A xi') d).hom.app PB
            ((overEquivFiberIso A xi').hom.app PB y) := by
      simp only [autHomOfCompIso_apply, Iso.conjAut_hom, Iso.conj_apply,
        NatTrans.comp_app, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
      congr 2
      exact (FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply ((overEquivFiberIso A xi').app PB) y).symm
    change autHomOfCompIso (overEquiv A).functor
      (overEquivFiberIso A xi') d = a at hd
    rw [hd] at heq
    have hyp : (overEquivFiberIso A xi').hom.app PB y = p := by
      exact FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ((overEquivFiberIso A xi').app PB) p
    rw [hyp] at heq
    have hy' : (overEquivFiberIso A xi').hom.app PB y' = p' := by
      dsimp only [y']
      exact FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply ((overEquivFiberIso A xi').app PB) p'
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      ((overEquivFiberIso A xi').hom.app PB)).injective
    rw [hy', heq]
    have hpull : tPull.hom.app B (a.hom.app PB p) =
        (fundamentalGroupHom A.hom xi' a).hom.app B (tPull.hom.app B p) := by
      exact pullbackFiberIso_hom_fundamentalGroupHom_apply A.hom xi' a B p
    have hp : tPull.hom.app B p = b := by
      exact FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply (tPull.app B) b
    have hp' : tPull.hom.app B (tPull.inv.app B b') = b' := by
      exact FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply (tPull.app B) b'
    have hb' : (fundamentalGroupHom A.hom xi' a).hom.app B b = b' := by
      rfl
    change a.hom.app PB p = tPull.inv.app B b'
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (tPull.hom.app B)).injective
    exact hpull.trans ((congrArg
      ((fundamentalGroupHom A.hom xi' a).hom.app B) hp).trans
        (hb'.trans hp'.symm))
  have hy := fiberOver_map_pullbackToProductOver A xi' B b
  have hy' := fiberOver_map_pullbackToProductOver A xi' B b'
  change d.hom.app ((productOver (X := A)).obj B)
      (productFiberEquivComparison F x B b) =
    productFiberEquivComparison F x B b'
  calc
    d.hom.app ((productOver (X := A)).obj B)
        (productFiberEquivComparison F x B b) =
      d.hom.app ((productOver (X := A)).obj B)
        ((fiberOver F x).map (pullbackToProductOver A B) y) :=
      congrArg (d.hom.app ((productOver (X := A)).obj B)) hy.symm
    _ = (fiberOver F x).map (pullbackToProductOver A B)
        (d.hom.app (toOverObj A ((pullback A.hom).obj B)) y) := by
      change
        ((fiberOver F x).map (pullbackToProductOver A B) ≫
          d.hom.app ((productOver (X := A)).obj B)) y =
        (d.hom.app (toOverObj A ((pullback A.hom).obj B)) ≫
          (fiberOver F x).map (pullbackToProductOver A B)) y
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (d.hom.naturality (pullbackToProductOver A B)) y
    _ = (fiberOver F x).map (pullbackToProductOver A B) y' :=
      congrArg ((fiberOver F x).map (pullbackToProductOver A B)) hdp
    _ = productFiberEquivComparison F x B b' := hy'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.transported_stabilizer_liftedFiberPointOverComposite
statement:
theorem transported_stabilizer_liftedFiberPointOverComposite
    [ConnectedSpace S] (A : FiniteEtale S)
    (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    {xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ S} (hxi : xi' ≫ A.hom = xi) :
    (hxi ▸ MulAction.stabilizer (π₁ᵉᵗ(xi' ≫ A.hom))
      (liftedFiberPointOverComposite A xi')) =
        MulAction.stabilizer (π₁ᵉᵗ(xi))
          ((fiberObjEquivHom xi A).symm (Over.homMk xi' hxi))
proof:
:= by
  subst xi
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLiftOfEq_coe
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLiftOfEq_coe
    [ConnectedSpace S] (A : FiniteEtale S)
    (xi' : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ A.left)
    {xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ S} (hxi : xi' ≫ A.hom = xi)
    (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi')) :
    ((fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLiftOfEq A xi' hxi a :
        ↥(show Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(xi) from
          hxi ▸ MulAction.stabilizer (π₁ᵉᵗ(xi' ≫ A.hom))
            (liftedFiberPointOverComposite A xi'))) : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) =
      hxi ▸ fundamentalGroupHom A.hom xi' a
proof:
:= by
  subst xi
  exact fundamentalGroupEquivStabilizerOfLift_coe A xi' a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso_hom_fundamentalGroupHom_apply
statement:
theorem pullbackFiberIso_hom_fundamentalGroupHom_apply
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X) (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi))
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (y : (fiber xi).obj ((pullback f).obj A)) :
    (pullbackFiberIso f xi).hom.app A
        (a.hom.app ((pullback f).obj A) y) =
      (fundamentalGroupHom f xi a).hom.app A
        ((pullbackFiberIso f xi).hom.app A y)
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      a.hom.app ((pullback f).obj A) ≫ (pullbackFiberIso f xi).hom.app A =
        (pullbackFiberIso f xi).hom.app A ≫
          (fundamentalGroupHom f xi a).hom.app A := by
    simp only [fundamentalGroupHom,
      CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_apply,
      Iso.conjAut_hom, Iso.conj_apply, NatTrans.comp_app]
    exact (((pullbackFiberIso f xi).app A).hom_inv_id_assoc
      (a.hom.app ((pullback f).obj A) ≫ (pullbackFiberIso f xi).hom.app A)).symm
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso_hom_fiberObjEquivHom_left
statement:
theorem pullbackFiberIso_hom_fiberObjEquivHom_left
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (A : FiniteEtale Y) (y : (fiber xi).obj ((pullback f).obj A)) :
    (fiberObjEquivHom (xi ≫ f) A ((pullbackFiberIso f xi).hom.app A y)).left =
      (fiberObjEquivHom xi ((pullback f).obj A) y).left ≫
        Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Over.mk_left, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj, Functor.const_obj_obj]
  let pc := MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp
    (P := @IsFiniteEtale) (Q := ⊤) xi f
  let baseIso : (Over.mk xi).left ≅ Spec (.of Omega) :=
    eqToIso (Over.mk_left xi)
  let : IsFiniteEtale baseIso.hom := by constructor
  let T : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of Omega)) := FiniteEtale.mk baseIso.hom
  let p : T ⟶ (pullback xi).obj ((pullback f).obj A) :=
    (forgetScheme Omega).preimage (FintypeCat.homMk fun _ ↦ y)
  have hpre :
      (forgetScheme Omega).preimage
          (FintypeCat.homMk fun _ ↦ (forgetScheme Omega).map (pc.inv.app A) y) =
        p ≫ pc.inv.app A := by
    apply (forgetScheme Omega).map_injective
    rw [(forgetScheme Omega).map_comp p (pc.inv.app A),
      (forgetScheme Omega).map_preimage
        (FintypeCat.homMk (fun _ : (forgetScheme Omega).obj T ↦
          (forgetScheme Omega).map (pc.inv.app A) y))]
    change (FintypeCat.homMk fun _ ↦ (forgetScheme Omega).map (pc.inv.app A) y) =
      (forgetScheme Omega).map p ≫ (forgetScheme Omega).map (pc.inv.app A)
    rw [show (forgetScheme Omega).map p =
        FintypeCat.homMk (fun _ ↦ y) from (forgetScheme Omega).map_preimage _]
    apply FintypeCat.hom_ext
    intro q
    rfl
  have hpc :
      (pc.inv.app A).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst A.hom (xi ≫ f) =
        (pc.inv.app A).left ≫ (pc.hom.app A).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f) xi ≫
            Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f := by
    have hcomp :
        (pc.hom.app A).left ≫
            Limits.pullback.fst (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f) xi ≫
              Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f =
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom (xi ≫ f) := by
      exact MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp_left_fst_fst
        (P := @IsFiniteEtale) (Q := ⊤) xi f A
    rw [← hcomp]
  have hpc' :
      (pc.inv.app A).left ≫ (pc.hom.app A).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f) xi ≫
            Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f =
        Limits.pullback.fst (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f) xi ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f := by
    have hinv : (pc.inv.app A).left ≫ (pc.hom.app A).left = 𝟙 _ := by
      calc
        (pc.inv.app A).left ≫ (pc.hom.app A).left =
            (pc.inv.app A ≫ pc.hom.app A).left := rfl
        _ = (𝟙 ((pullback xi).obj ((pullback f).obj A)) :
              (pullback xi).obj ((pullback f).obj A) ⟶
                (pullback xi).obj ((pullback f).obj A)).left :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ k.left) (pc.inv_hom_id_app A)
        _ = 𝟙 _ := rfl
    rw [← Category.assoc (pc.inv.app A).left (pc.hom.app A).left, hinv]
    exact Category.id_comp _
  calc
    ((forgetScheme Omega).preimage
        (FintypeCat.homMk fun _ ↦ (forgetScheme Omega).map (pc.inv.app A) y)).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom (xi ≫ f) =
        (p ≫ pc.inv.app A).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom (xi ≫ f) := by rw [hpre]
    _ = p.left ≫ ((pc.inv.app A).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom (xi ≫ f)) := by rfl
    _ = p.left ≫ ((pc.inv.app A).left ≫ (pc.hom.app A).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f) xi ≫
            Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f) := congrArg (fun k ↦ p.left ≫ k) hpc
    _ = p.left ≫ (Limits.pullback.fst (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f) xi ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f) := congrArg (fun k ↦ p.left ≫ k) hpc'
    _ = p.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f) xi ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom f := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberObjEquivHom_symm_naturality
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fiberObjEquivHom_symm_naturality {X Y : FiniteEtale S} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x) :
    (fiber «ξ»).map f ((fiberObjEquivHom «ξ» X).symm x) =
      (fiberObjEquivHom «ξ» Y).symm (x ≫ f.hom)
proof:
:=
  by
    let baseIso : (Over.mk «ξ»).left ≅ Spec (.of Ω) :=
      eqToIso (Over.mk_left «ξ»)
    let : IsFiniteEtale baseIso.hom := by constructor
    let T : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of Ω)) := FiniteEtale.mk baseIso.hom
    have baseIso_hom_comp : baseIso.hom ≫ «ξ» = (Over.mk «ξ»).hom := by
      change eqToHom (Over.mk_left «ξ») ≫ «ξ» = (Over.mk «ξ»).hom
      exact eq_of_heq (eqToHom_comp_heq «ξ» (Over.mk_left «ξ»))
    let t : T.left := by
      exact baseIso.inv.base
        (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (Spec (.of Ω))))
    let sourceMap {Z : FiniteEtale S} (x : Over.mk «ξ» ⟶ Z.toComma) :
        T.left ⟶ Z.left := x.left
    let liftHom {Z : FiniteEtale S} (x : Over.mk «ξ» ⟶ Z.toComma) :
        T ⟶ (pullback «ξ»).obj Z :=
      MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
        (Limits.pullback.lift (sourceMap x) T.hom (by
          change x.left ≫ Z.toComma.hom = baseIso.hom ≫ «ξ»
          exact x.w.trans baseIso_hom_comp.symm))
        (Limits.pullback.lift_snd _ _ _)
    have liftHom_fst {Z : FiniteEtale S} (z : Over.mk «ξ» ⟶ Z.toComma) :
        (liftHom z).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst Z.hom «ξ» = sourceMap z := by
      change Limits.pullback.lift (sourceMap z) T.hom _ ≫
        Limits.pullback.fst Z.hom «ξ» = sourceMap z
      exact Limits.pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
    have liftHom_snd {Z : FiniteEtale S} (z : Over.mk «ξ» ⟶ Z.toComma) :
        (liftHom z).left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd Z.hom «ξ» = T.hom := by
      change Limits.pullback.lift (sourceMap z) T.hom _ ≫
        Limits.pullback.snd Z.hom «ξ» = T.hom
      exact Limits.pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
    have pullbackMap_fst :
        ((pullback «ξ»).map f).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom «ξ» =
          Limits.pullback.fst X.hom «ξ» ≫ f.left := by
      change
        Limits.pullback.lift
            (Limits.pullback.fst X.hom «ξ» ≫ f.left)
            (Limits.pullback.snd X.hom «ξ») _ ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom «ξ» =
        Limits.pullback.fst X.hom «ξ» ≫ f.left
      exact Limits.pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
    have pullbackMap_snd :
        ((pullback «ξ»).map f).left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd Y.hom «ξ» =
          Limits.pullback.snd X.hom «ξ» := by
      change
        Limits.pullback.lift
            (Limits.pullback.fst X.hom «ξ» ≫ f.left)
            (Limits.pullback.snd X.hom «ξ») _ ≫
          Limits.pullback.snd Y.hom «ξ» =
        Limits.pullback.snd X.hom «ξ»
      exact Limits.pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
    have h : liftHom x ≫ (pullback «ξ»).map f = liftHom (x ≫ f.hom) := by
      apply MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext
      apply Limits.pullback.hom_ext
      · change
          ((liftHom x).left ≫ ((pullback «ξ»).map f).left) ≫
              Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom «ξ» =
            (liftHom (x ≫ f.hom)).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom «ξ»
        have lhs :
            ((liftHom x).left ≫ ((pullback «ξ»).map f).left) ≫
                Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom «ξ» =
              sourceMap x ≫ f.left := by
          calc
            ((liftHom x).left ≫ ((pullback «ξ»).map f).left) ≫
                Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom «ξ» =
              (liftHom x).left ≫
                (((pullback «ξ»).map f).left ≫
                  Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom «ξ») := Category.assoc _ _ _
            _ = (liftHom x).left ≫
                  (Limits.pullback.fst X.hom «ξ» ≫ f.left) :=
                congrArg (fun q ↦ (liftHom x).left ≫ q) pullbackMap_fst
            _ = ((liftHom x).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst X.hom «ξ») ≫ f.left :=
                (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
            _ = sourceMap x ≫ f.left :=
                congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ f.left) (liftHom_fst x)
        have middle :
            sourceMap x ≫ f.left = sourceMap (x ≫ f.hom) := by
          rfl
        have rhs :
            (liftHom (x ≫ f.hom)).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst Y.hom «ξ» =
              sourceMap (x ≫ f.hom) :=
          liftHom_fst _
        exact lhs.trans (middle.trans rhs.symm)
      · change
          ((liftHom x).left ≫ ((pullback «ξ»).map f).left) ≫
              Limits.pullback.snd Y.hom «ξ» =
            (liftHom (x ≫ f.hom)).left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd Y.hom «ξ»
        have lhs :
            ((liftHom x).left ≫ ((pullback «ξ»).map f).left) ≫
                Limits.pullback.snd Y.hom «ξ» = T.hom := by
          calc
            ((liftHom x).left ≫ ((pullback «ξ»).map f).left) ≫
                Limits.pullback.snd Y.hom «ξ» =
              (liftHom x).left ≫
                (((pullback «ξ»).map f).left ≫
                  Limits.pullback.snd Y.hom «ξ») := Category.assoc _ _ _
            _ = (liftHom x).left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd X.hom «ξ» :=
                congrArg (fun q ↦ (liftHom x).left ≫ q) pullbackMap_snd
            _ = T.hom := liftHom_snd x
        have rhs :
            (liftHom (x ≫ f.hom)).left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd Y.hom «ξ» =
              T.hom :=
          liftHom_snd _
        exact lhs.trans rhs.symm
    change ((forgetScheme Ω).map (liftHom x) ≫
        (forgetScheme Ω).map ((pullback «ξ»).map f)) t =
      (forgetScheme Ω).map (liftHom (x ≫ f.hom)) t
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiberObjEquivHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma fiberObjEquivHom_naturality {X Y : FiniteEtale S} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x) :
    (fiberObjEquivHom «ξ» X x) ≫ f.hom = fiberObjEquivHom «ξ» Y ((fiber «ξ»).map f x)
proof:
:=
  by
    apply (fiberObjEquivHom «ξ» Y).symm.injective
    simpa using
      (fiberObjEquivHom_symm_naturality «ξ» f (fiberObjEquivHom «ξ» X x)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isField_of_isConnected
statement:
lemma isField_of_isConnected (X : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of k))) [IsConnected X] :
    IsField Γ(X.left, ⊤)
proof:
:=
  by
    let Omega := AlgebraicClosure k
    let xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ Spec (.of k) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap k Omega)
    let F := fiber xi
    have hX : Nonempty X.left :=
      (nonempty_fiber_of_isConnected F X).map fun x ↦ fiberPt x
    obtain ⟨x⟩ := hX
    let hcomponents : Finite (ConnectedComponents X.left) := inferInstance
    let U := X.left.connectedComponents
    let i : ConnectedComponents X.left := ConnectedComponents.mk x
    let hUconn : ConnectedSpace (U.X i) := by
      dsimp only [U]
      infer_instance
    let hXet : IsFiniteEtale X.hom := X.2
    let hcomp : IsFiniteEtale (U.f i ≫ X.hom) := by
      have : IsOpenImmersion (U.f i) := by
        dsimp only [U, Scheme.connectedComponents]
        infer_instance
      have hComponent : IsFiniteEtale (U.f i) :=
        @IsFiniteEtale.mk _ _ _ inferInstance inferInstance
      let : IsFiniteEtale (U.f i) := hComponent
      infer_instance
    let Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of k)) :=
      @FiniteEtale.mk _ _ (U.f i ≫ X.hom) hcomp
    let j : Y ⟶ X :=
      MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (by
        simpa only [Y, FiniteEtale.mk_left] using U.f i)
    let : Mono j := by
      apply (FiniteEtale.forget _ ⋙ Over.forget _).mono_of_mono_map
      change Mono (U.f i)
      infer_instance
    have : Nonempty Y.left := by
      have hYi : Nonempty (U.X i) := by
        refine ⟨⟨x, ?_⟩⟩
        change ConnectedComponents.mk x ∈ ({i} : Set (ConnectedComponents X.left))
        exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr rfl
      simpa only [Y, FiniteEtale.mk_left] using hYi
    let : Subsingleton (Spec (.of k)) := inferInstance
    have hFY : Nonempty (F.obj Y) := by
      change Nonempty ((pullback xi).obj Y).left
      obtain ⟨ω⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Spec (.of Omega)))
      let : PreconnectedSpace
          ((Functor.fromPUnit (Spec (.of k))).obj Y.right) := by
        change PreconnectedSpace (Spec (.of k))
        infer_instance
      let : Nonempty ((𝟭 Scheme).obj Y.left) := by
        change Nonempty Y.left
        infer_instance
      let : Surjective Y.hom := IsFiniteEtale.surjective Y.hom
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Y.hom.surjective (xi.base ω)
      obtain ⟨z, _, _⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback y ω hy
      exact ⟨z⟩
    let : IsIso j :=
      let : Nonempty ((𝟭 Scheme).obj Y.left) := by
        change Nonempty Y.left
        infer_instance
      IsConnected.noTrivialComponent Y j
        ((not_initial_iff_fiber_nonempty F Y).mpr hFY)
    let hjhom : IsIso j.hom := (FiniteEtale.forget _).map_isIso j
    let hjleft : IsIso j.left :=
      @Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _
        (_root_.CategoryTheory.Over.forget _) j.hom hjhom
    let eY : Y.left ≅ U.X i :=
      eqToIso (by simp only [Y, FiniteEtale.mk_left])
    let hYconn : ConnectedSpace Y.left :=
      eY.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mpr hUconn
    have hconn : ConnectedSpace X.left :=
      (@asIso _ _ _ _ j.left hjleft).hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mp hYconn
    let : ConnectedSpace (Spec Γ(X.left, ⊤)) := by
      rw [← X.left.isoSpec.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff]
      exact hconn
    let : _root_.IsReduced Γ(X.left, ⊤) :=
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field k Γ(X.left, ⊤)
    let : IsArtinianRing Γ(X.left, ⊤) :=
      IsArtinianRing.of_finite k Γ(X.left, ⊤)
    let : PreconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum Γ(X.left, ⊤)) := by
      change PreconnectedSpace (Spec Γ(X.left, ⊤))
      infer_instance
    let : Nontrivial Γ(X.left, ⊤) :=
      PrimeSpectrum.nontrivial
        (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (Spec Γ(X.left, ⊤))))
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.subsingleton_iff_isField_of_isReduced]
    constructor
    intro p q
    exact PreconnectedSpace.constant (f := id)
      (inferInstance : PreconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum Γ(X.left, ⊤))) continuous_id

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackComp_conjAut
statement:
private theorem pullbackComp_conjAut
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) :
      (Functor.isoWhiskerRight
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @IsFiniteEtale) (Q := ⊤) f g)
        (fiber xi)).conjAut
          (((Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ FintypeCat).obj (pullback (f ≫ g))).mapAut
            (fiber xi) a) =
        (((Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ FintypeCat).obj
          (pullback g ⋙ pullback f)).mapAut (fiber xi) a)
proof:
:= by
  let pc := MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp
    (P := @IsFiniteEtale) (Q := ⊤) f g
  apply Aut.ext
  ext C c
  apply ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
  change (fiber xi).map (pc.inv.app C) ≫ a.hom.app _ ≫
      (fiber xi).map (pc.hom.app C) = a.hom.app _
  rw [← a.hom.naturality (pc.hom.app C)]
  have hcancel : (fiber xi).map (pc.inv.app C) ≫
      (fiber xi).map (pc.hom.app C) = 𝟙 _ := by
    calc
      _ = (fiber xi).map (pc.inv.app C ≫ pc.hom.app C) :=
        ((fiber xi).map_comp _ _).symm
      _ = (fiber xi).map (𝟙 _) :=
        congrArg ((fiber xi).map) (pc.inv_hom_id_app C)
      _ = 𝟙 _ := (fiber xi).map_id _
  simp only [← Category.assoc, hcancel, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackCompositeFiberIso_conjAut
statement:
private theorem pullbackCompositeFiberIso_conjAut
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (b : Aut (pullback (f ≫ g) ⋙ fiber xi)) :
    (pullbackCompositeFiberIso f g xi).conjAut b =
      (pullbackFiberIso g (xi ≫ f)).conjAut
        ((Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (pullback g) (pullbackFiberIso f xi)).conjAut
          ((Functor.associator (pullback g) (pullback f) (fiber xi)).conjAut
            ((Functor.isoWhiskerRight
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @IsFiniteEtale) (Q := ⊤) f g)
              (fiber xi)).conjAut b)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_comp_eq_autHomOfCompIso
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_comp_eq_autHomOfCompIso
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X)
    (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) :
    fundamentalGroupHom g (xi ≫ f) (fundamentalGroupHom f xi a) =
      CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso
        (pullback (f ≫ g)) (pullbackCompositeFiberIso f g xi) a
proof:
:= by
  have hpc := pullbackComp_conjAut f g xi a
  let b : Aut (pullback f ⋙ fiber xi) :=
    (((Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ FintypeCat).obj (pullback f)).mapAut
      (fiber xi) a)
  have hassoc :
      (Functor.associator (pullback g) (pullback f) (fiber xi)).conjAut
          (((Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ FintypeCat).obj
            (pullback g ⋙ pullback f)).mapAut (fiber xi) a) =
        (((Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ FintypeCat).obj (pullback g)).mapAut
          (pullback f ⋙ fiber xi) b) := by
    apply Aut.ext
    ext C c
    rfl
  have hwhisker :
      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (pullback g) (pullbackFiberIso f xi)).conjAut
          (((Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ FintypeCat).obj (pullback g)).mapAut
            (pullback f ⋙ fiber xi) b) =
        (((Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ FintypeCat).obj (pullback g)).mapAut
          (fiber (xi ≫ f)) ((pullbackFiberIso f xi).conjAut b)) := by
    apply Aut.ext
    ext C c
    simp only [Iso.conjAut_hom, Iso.conj_apply, NatTrans.comp_app]
    rfl
  unfold fundamentalGroupHom
  simp only [CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_apply]
  rw [pullbackCompositeFiberIso_conjAut f g xi]
  rw [(pullbackFiberIso g (xi ≫ f)).conjAut.apply_eq_iff_eq]
  have hchain0 := congrArg
    (Functor.associator (pullback g) (pullback f) (fiber xi)).conjAut hpc
  have hchain1 := hchain0.trans hassoc
  have hchain2 := congrArg
    (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (pullback g) (pullbackFiberIso f xi)).conjAut hchain1
  have hchain3 := hchain2.trans hwhisker
  change (((Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ FintypeCat).obj (pullback g)).mapAut
      (fiber (xi ≫ f)) ((pullbackFiberIso f xi).conjAut b)) = _
  exact hchain3.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_comp_transport_eq_autHomOfCompIso
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_comp_transport_eq_autHomOfCompIso
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (m : X ⟶ Z) (hm : m = f ≫ g)
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X) (eta : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ Z)
    (heta : (xi ≫ f) ≫ g = eta) (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) :
    heta ▸ fundamentalGroupHom g (xi ≫ f) (fundamentalGroupHom f xi a) =
      CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso
        (pullback m) (pullbackCompositeFiberIsoOfEq f g m hm xi eta heta) a
proof:
:= by
  subst m
  subst eta
  simpa [pullbackCompositeFiberIsoOfEq, pullbackCompositeFiberIso] using
    fundamentalGroupHom_comp_eq_autHomOfCompIso f g xi a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_comp_conj_of_common_composite
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_comp_conj_of_common_composite
    (f₁ : X ⟶ Y) (g₁ : Y ⟶ Z) (f₂ : X ⟶ Y') (g₂ : Y' ⟶ Z)
    (m : X ⟶ Z) (hm₁ : m = f₁ ≫ g₁) (hm₂ : m = f₂ ≫ g₂)
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ X) (eta : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ Z)
    (heta₁ : (xi ≫ f₁) ≫ g₁ = eta)
    (heta₂ : (xi ≫ f₂) ≫ g₂ = eta) (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) :
    heta₁ ▸ fundamentalGroupHom g₁ (xi ≫ f₁)
        (fundamentalGroupHom f₁ xi a) =
      MulAut.conj
        (fundamentalGroupFactorizationConjugator
          f₁ g₁ f₂ g₂ m hm₁ hm₂ xi eta heta₁ heta₂)
        (heta₂ ▸ fundamentalGroupHom g₂ (xi ≫ f₂)
          (fundamentalGroupHom f₂ xi a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fundamentalGroupHom_comp_transport_eq_autHomOfCompIso
    f₁ g₁ m hm₁ xi eta heta₁]
  rw [fundamentalGroupHom_comp_transport_eq_autHomOfCompIso
    f₂ g₂ m hm₂ xi eta heta₂]
  exact CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.autHomOfCompIso_eq_conj
    (pullback m)
    (pullbackCompositeFiberIsoOfEq f₂ g₂ m hm₂ xi eta heta₂)
    (pullbackCompositeFiberIsoOfEq f₁ g₁ m hm₁ xi eta heta₁) a

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocalRing_of_isMaximal_of_le_jacobson
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_of_isMaximal_of_le_jacobson
    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] (J : Ideal S) (hJ : J.IsMaximal)
