name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocalRing_quotient_span_one_sub_of_field_ker
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_quotient_span_one_sub_of_field_ker
    {B D A : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    [CommRing D] [Algebra B D] [Module.Finite B D]
    [Field A] (e : D) (f : D →+* A) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (hker : RingHom.ker f =
      (maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B D) ⊔
        Ideal.span {1 - e}) :
    IsLocalRing (D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e})
proof:
:= by
  let K : Ideal D := Ideal.span {1 - e}
  let Q := D ⧸ K
  let π : D →+* Q := Ideal.Quotient.mk K
  have hK : K ≤ RingHom.ker f := by
    rw [hker]
    exact le_sup_right
  let g : Q →+* A := Ideal.Quotient.lift K f hK
  have hg : Function.Surjective g := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hf a
    exact ⟨π d, Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk K f hK⟩
  let J : Ideal D := (maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B D)
  have hmapJ : J.map π =
      (maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B Q) := by
    dsimp only [J, π, Q]
    rw [Ideal.map_map]
    rfl
  have hker_g : RingHom.ker g =
      (maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B Q) := by
    rw [show RingHom.ker g = (RingHom.ker f).map π by
      exact Ideal.ker_quotient_lift f hK]
    rw [hker]
    change (J ⊔ K).map π = _
    rw [Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_quotient_self, sup_bot_eq, hmapJ]
  have hmax : ((maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B Q)).IsMaximal := by
    rw [← hker_g]
    exact RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective g hg
  let : Module.Finite B Q := moduleFinite_quotient_span_one_sub e
  have hjac : (maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B Q) ≤
      Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal Q) :=
    ideal_map_le_jacobson_bot_of_le_jacobson_bot_of_moduleFinite
      (R := B) (S := Q)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson (⊥ : Ideal B))
  exact isLocalRing_of_isMaximal_of_le_jacobson _ hmax hjac

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ker_evalRingHom_comp_ringEquiv_comp_eq_sup_of_idempotent_lift
statement:
theorem ker_evalRingHom_comp_ringEquiv_comp_eq_sup_of_idempotent_lift
    {D F I : Type u} [CommRing D] [CommRing F]
    [Finite I] [DecidableEq I]
    (A : I → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (A i)]
    (q : D →+* F) (E : F ≃+* ∀ i, A i) (e : I → D)
    (hmap : q ∘ e = E.symm ∘ fun i ↦ Pi.single i 1) (i : I) :
    RingHom.ker ((Pi.evalRingHom A i).comp E.toRingHom |>.comp q) =
      RingHom.ker q ⊔ Ideal.span {1 - e i}
proof:
:= by
  let f : D →+* A i := ((Pi.evalRingHom A i).comp E.toRingHom).comp q
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro d hd
    have hcoord : E (q d) i = 0 := by
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hd
      exact hd
    have hmul : d * e i ∈ RingHom.ker q := by
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_mul]
      apply E.injective
      rw [map_mul, map_zero]
      have hei : E (q (e i)) = Pi.single i 1 := by
        calc
          E (q (e i)) = E (E.symm (Pi.single i 1)) :=
            congrArg E (congrFun hmap i)
          _ = Pi.single i 1 := E.apply_symm_apply _
      rw [hei]
      ext j
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [hcoord]
      · simp [hji]
    have hrest : d * (1 - e i) ∈ Ideal.span {1 - e i} :=
      (Ideal.span {1 - e i}).mul_mem_left d
        (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton (1 - e i)))
    have hadd : d * e i + d * (1 - e i) ∈
        RingHom.ker q ⊔ Ideal.span {1 - e i} :=
      add_mem
        ((le_sup_left : RingHom.ker q ≤
          RingHom.ker q ⊔ Ideal.span {1 - e i}) hmul)
        ((le_sup_right : Ideal.span {1 - e i} ≤
          RingHom.ker q ⊔ Ideal.span {1 - e i}) hrest)
    convert hadd using 1
    ring
  · apply sup_le
    · intro d hd
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hd ⊢
      simp [hd]
    · apply Ideal.span_le.2
      intro d hd
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hd
      subst d
      change E (q (1 - e i)) i = 0
      have hei : E (q (e i)) = Pi.single i 1 := by
        calc
          E (q (e i)) = E (E.symm (Pi.single i 1)) :=
            congrArg E (congrFun hmap i)
          _ = Pi.single i 1 := E.apply_symm_apply _
      rw [map_sub, map_one, map_sub, map_one, hei]
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.one_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, sub_self]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_closedFiber_fieldFactors_and_idempotents_lift
statement:
theorem exists_closedFiber_fieldFactors_and_idempotents_lift
    {B D : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal B) B]
    [CommRing D] [Algebra B D] [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D] :
    let k
proof:
:= ResidueField B
    let F := k ⊗[B] D
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I) (_ : DecidableEq I) (A : I → Type u)
      (_ : ∀ i, Field (A i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra k (A i))
      (E : F ≃ₐ[k] ∀ i, A i) (e : I → D),
      CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e ∧
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : D →ₐ[B] F) ∘ e =
          E.symm ∘ fun i ↦ Pi.single i 1 := by
  classical
  let k := ResidueField B
  let F := k ⊗[B] D
  let q : D →+* F :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : D →ₐ[B] F)
  let : Module.Finite k F := inferInstance
  let : Algebra.Etale k F := Algebra.Etale.baseChange B D k
  obtain ⟨I, hI, A, hAfield, hAalg, E, -⟩ :=
    (Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod k F).mp
      (inferInstance : Algebra.Etale k F)
  let : Finite I := hI
  let : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let (i : I) : Field (A i) := hAfield i
  let (i : I) : Algebra k (A i) := hAalg i
  let eFiber : I → F := fun i ↦ E.symm (Pi.single i 1)
  have heFiber : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents eFiber := by
    change CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents
      (E.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom ∘ fun i ↦ Pi.single i 1)
    exact (CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents.single A).map E.symm.toRingHom
  have hqsurjective : Function.Surjective q := by
    have hresidue : Function.Surjective (algebraMap B k) := by
      change Function.Surjective
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal B))
      exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_surjective D hresidue y
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  let : HenselianRing D
      ((maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B D)) :=
    henselianRing_map_algebraMap_of_moduleFinite_of_isAdicComplete
  let : HenselianRing D (RingHom.ker q) := by
    have hker : RingHom.ker q =
        (maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B D) := by
      simpa only [q] using
        (residueField_tensor_includeRight_ker_eq_maximalIdeal_map
          (R := B) (S := D))
    rw [hker]
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨e, he, hmap⟩ :=
    exists_completeOrthogonalIdempotents_lift_of_surjective_henselianRing_ker
      q hqsurjective eFiber heFiber
  exact ⟨I, inferInstance, Classical.decEq I, A, hAfield, hAalg, E, e, he, by
    funext i
    exact congrFun hmap i⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_closedFiber_fieldFactors_with_finiteEtale_localFactors
statement:
theorem exists_closedFiber_fieldFactors_with_finiteEtale_localFactors
    {B D : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal B) B]
    [CommRing D] [Algebra B D] [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D] :
    let k
proof:
:= ResidueField B
    let F := k ⊗[B] D
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I) (_ : DecidableEq I)
      (A : I → Type u) (_ : ∀ i, Field (A i))
      (_ : ∀ i, Algebra k (A i))
      (E : F ≃ₐ[k] ∀ i, A i) (e : I → D),
      CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e ∧
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : D →ₐ[B] F) ∘ e =
        E.symm ∘ (fun i ↦ Pi.single i 1) ∧
      ∀ i,
        Module.Finite B (D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e i}) ∧
        Algebra.Etale B (D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e i}) ∧
        IsLocalRing (D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e i}) := by
  classical
  let k := ResidueField B
  let F := k ⊗[B] D
  obtain ⟨I, hIfin, hIdec, A, hAfield, hAalg, E, e, he, hmap⟩ :=
    exists_closedFiber_fieldFactors_and_idempotents_lift
      (B := B) (D := D)
  let : Fintype I := hIfin
  let : DecidableEq I := hIdec
  let (i : I) : Field (A i) := hAfield i
  let (i : I) : Algebra k (A i) := hAalg i
  let q : D →+* F :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : D →ₐ[B] F)
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := by
    have hresidue : Function.Surjective (algebraMap B k) := by
      change Function.Surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal B))
      exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_surjective D hresidue y
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hkerq : RingHom.ker q =
      (maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B D) := by
    simpa only [q] using
      (residueField_tensor_includeRight_ker_eq_maximalIdeal_map
        (R := B) (S := D))
  refine ⟨I, hIfin, hIdec, A, hAfield, hAalg, E, e, he, hmap, ?_⟩
  intro i
  refine ⟨moduleFinite_quotient_span_one_sub (e i),
    etale_quotient_span_one_sub_of_isIdempotentElem (e i) (he.idem i), ?_⟩
  let f : D →+* A i :=
    ((Pi.evalRingHom A i).comp E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).comp q
  have hf : Function.Surjective f :=
    (Function.surjective_eval i).comp (E.surjective.comp hq)
  apply isLocalRing_quotient_span_one_sub_of_field_ker
    (B := B) (D := D) (A := A i) (e i) f hf
  rw [ker_evalRingHom_comp_ringEquiv_comp_eq_sup_of_idempotent_lift
    A q E.toRingEquiv e hmap i, hkerq]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.RingHom.FormallyEtale.of_bijective
statement:
lemma RingHom.FormallyEtale.of_bijective
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Bijective f) : f.FormallyEtale
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f]
  exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_equiv (AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId R S) hf)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.RingHom.FormallyEtale.respectsIso
statement:
lemma RingHom.FormallyEtale.respectsIso :
    RingHom.RespectsIso @RingHom.FormallyEtale
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : RingHom.StableUnderComposition @RingHom.FormallyEtale :=
    by
      intro R S T _ _ _ f g hf hg
      exact RingHom.FormallyEtale.comp hf hg
  exact hcomp.respectsIso
    (fun e ↦ RingHom.FormallyEtale.of_bijective e.toRingHom e.bijective)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etale_of_stalkMap_formallyEtale
statement:
theorem etale_of_stalkMap_formallyEtale
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hstalk : ∀ y : Y, (f.stalkMap y).hom.FormallyEtale) :
    Etale f
proof:
:= by
  let P := stalkwise @RingHom.FormallyEtale
  let : P.RespectsIso :=
    stalkwise_respectsIso RingHom.FormallyEtale.respectsIso
  let : IsZariskiLocalAtTarget P :=
    stalkwiseIsZariskiLocalAtTarget_of_respectsIso
      RingHom.FormallyEtale.respectsIso
  let : IsZariskiLocalAtSource P :=
    stalkwise_isZariskiLocalAtSource_of_respectsIso
      RingHom.FormallyEtale.respectsIso
  refine ⟨fun {U} hU {V} hV hVU ↦ ?_⟩
  apply ringHom_etale_of_formallyEtale_localizationsAtPrime_all_primeIdeals
    (f.appLE U V hVU).hom (f.finitePresentation_appLE hU hV hVU)
  intro Q hQ
  have hres : P (f.resLE U V hVU) :=
    IsZariskiLocalAtSource.resLE hVU hstalk
  let e : Arrow.mk (f.resLE U V hVU) ≅
    Arrow.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (f.appLE U V hVU).hom)) :=
    Arrow.isoMk hV.isoSpec hU.isoSpec (by
      change V.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (f.appLE U V hVU) =
        f.resLE U V hVU ≫ U.toSpecΓ
      exact Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_appLE f U V hVU)
  have hspec : P (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (f.appLE U V hVU).hom)) :=
    (P.arrow_mk_iso_iff e).mp hres
  change (Localization.localRingHom
    (Ideal.comap (f.appLE U V hVU).hom Q) Q
    (f.appLE U V hVU).hom rfl).FormallyEtale
  exact (stalkwise_SpecMap_iff RingHom.FormallyEtale.respectsIso
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (f.appLE U V hVU).hom)).mp hspec Q hQ

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isFiniteEtale_of_isFinite_of_stalkMap_formallyEtale
statement:
theorem isFiniteEtale_of_isFinite_of_stalkMap_formallyEtale
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f]
    (hstalk : ∀ y : Y, (f.stalkMap y).hom.FormallyEtale) :
    IsFiniteEtale f
proof:
:= by
  let : Etale f := etale_of_stalkMap_formallyEtale f hstalk
  exact ⟨⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isFiniteEtale_of_isFinite_of_restrict_etale_of_boundary_stalkMap_formallyEtale
statement:
theorem isFiniteEtale_of_isFinite_of_restrict_etale_of_boundary_stalkMap_formallyEtale
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : Etale (f ∣_ U))
    (hboundary : ∀ y : Y, f y ∉ U → (f.stalkMap y).hom.FormallyEtale) :
    IsFiniteEtale f
proof:
:= by
  apply isFiniteEtale_of_isFinite_of_stalkMap_formallyEtale f
  intro y
  by_cases hy : f y ∈ U
  · let yU : f ⁻¹ᵁ U := ⟨y, hy⟩
    let : Etale (f ∣_ U) := hU
    have hlocal : ((f ∣_ U).stalkMap yU).hom.FormallyEtale := by
      change @Algebra.FormallyEtale _ _ _ _
        ((f ∣_ U).stalkMap yU).hom.toAlgebra
      exact (f ∣_ U).stalkMap_formallyEtale_of_etale yU
    exact (RingHom.FormallyEtale.respectsIso.arrow_mk_iso_iff
      (morphismRestrictStalkMap f U yU)).mp hlocal
  · exact hboundary y hy

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isEssentialSubmodule_comap_subtype_iff
statement:
theorem isEssentialSubmodule_comap_subtype_iff
    (N S : Submodule R M) (hNS : N ≤ S) :
    IsEssentialSubmodule (N.comap S.subtype) ↔
      ∀ L : Submodule R M, L ≤ S → Disjoint N L → L = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hN L hLS hNL
    have hdisjoint : Disjoint (N.comap S.subtype) (L.comap S.subtype) := by
      apply Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr
      intro x hxN hxL
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hNL) (x : M)
        (Submodule.mem_comap.mp hxN) (Submodule.mem_comap.mp hxL)
    have hzero : L.comap S.subtype = ⊥ := hN (L.comap S.subtype) hdisjoint
    have hmap := congrArg (Submodule.map S.subtype) hzero
    rw [Submodule.map_comap_subtype, inf_eq_right.mpr hLS, Submodule.map_bot] at hmap
    exact hmap
  · intro hN L hNL
    have hNmap : (N.comap S.subtype).map S.subtype = N := by
      rw [Submodule.map_comap_subtype, inf_eq_right.mpr hNS]
    have hdisjoint : Disjoint N (L.map S.subtype) := by
      rw [← hNmap]
      exact Submodule.disjoint_map S.injective_subtype hNL
    have hLS : L.map S.subtype ≤ S := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨y, _hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hx
      exact y.property
    have hzero : L.map S.subtype = ⊥ := hN (L.map S.subtype) hLS hdisjoint
    apply Submodule.map_injective_of_injective (f := S.subtype) S.injective_subtype
    rw [Submodule.map_bot]
    exact hzero

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.IsEssentialSubmodule.trans_subtype
statement:
theorem IsEssentialSubmodule.trans_subtype
    {N S : Submodule R M} (hNS : N ≤ S)
    (hN : IsEssentialSubmodule (N.comap S.subtype))
    (hS : IsEssentialSubmodule S) : IsEssentialSubmodule N
proof:
:= by
  have hinside : ∀ L : Submodule R M, L ≤ S → Disjoint N L → L = ⊥ :=
    (isEssentialSubmodule_comap_subtype_iff N S hNS).mp hN
  intro L hNL
  apply hS L
  apply disjoint_iff.mpr
  exact hinside (S ⊓ L) inf_le_left (hNL.mono_right inf_le_right)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.ideal_le_prime_colon_of_essential_power_torsion
statement:
private theorem ideal_le_prime_colon_of_essential_power_torsion
    (I : Ideal R) (N : Submodule R E) (hN : IsEssentialSubmodule N)
    (hT : ∀ z : N, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0)
    (P : Ideal R) (hP : P.IsPrime) (y : E)
    (hPy : P = (⊥ : Submodule R E).colon {y}) :
    I ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  by_contra haP
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint N (Submodule.span R {y}) := by
    apply Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr
    intro z hzN hzSpan
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hzSpan
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hT ⟨z, hzN⟩
    have haz : a ^ n • z = 0 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (hn (a ^ n) (Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha n))
    have hab : a ^ n * b ∈ P := by
      rw [hPy, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Submodule.mem_bot]
      rw [mul_smul, hb, haz]
    have haPower : a ^ n ∉ P := fun h ↦ haP (hP.mem_of_pow_mem n h)
    have hbP : b ∈ P := (hP.mem_or_mem hab).resolve_left haPower
    have hby : b • y = 0 := by
      rw [hPy, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Submodule.mem_bot] at hbP
      exact hbP
    exact hb.symm.trans hby
  have hspan : Submodule.span R {y} = ⊥ :=
    hN (Submodule.span R {y}) hdisjoint
  have hy : y ∈ (⊥ : Submodule R E) :=
    hspan ▸ Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self y
  have hOne : (1 : R) ∈ P := by
    rw [hPy, Submodule.mem_colon_singleton]
    simpa only [one_smul] using hy
  exact hP.one_notMem hOne

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_ideal_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_essential_submodule
statement:
theorem exists_ideal_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_essential_submodule
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (N : Submodule R E) (hN : IsEssentialSubmodule N)
    (hT : ∀ z : N, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0) (z : E) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal R := (⊥ : Submodule R E).colon {z}
  have hrad : I ≤ J.radical := by
    rw [← J.sInf_minimalPrimes]
    apply le_sInf
    intro P hP
    obtain ⟨y, hPy⟩ :=
      Submodule.exists_eq_colon_of_mem_minimalPrimes
        (N := (⊥ : Submodule R E)) (x := z) hP
    exact ideal_le_prime_colon_of_essential_power_torsion
      I N hN hT P hP.isPrime y hPy
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg hrad
    I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  have haz : a ∈ (⊥ : Submodule R E).colon {z} := hn ha
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp (Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mp haz)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.eq_zero_of_idealPower_torsion_quotient_primaryComponent
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_idealPower_torsion_quotient_primaryComponent
    (I : Ideal R) (q : M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M I)
    (hq : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • q = 0) : q = 0
proof:
:= by
  let T : Submodule R M := Ideal.primaryComponent M I
  have hT : ∀ z : T, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0 := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
      (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := M) (I := I) (z : M)).mp z.property
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff ((I ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) (z : M)).mp hn ⟨a, ha⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_ideal_pow_le_annihilator_of_finite I hT
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := T.mkQ_surjective q
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hq
  have hproduct : I ^ k * I ^ n ≤ (⊥ : Submodule R M).colon {z} := by
    apply Ideal.mul_le.mpr
    intro a ha b hb
    have hbT : b • z ∈ T := by
      apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero T).mp
      change T.mkQ (b • z) = 0
      rw [map_smul]
      exact hn b hb
    have hab : a • (⟨b • z, hbT⟩ : T) = 0 :=
      Module.mem_annihilator.mp (hk ha) ⟨b • z, hbT⟩
    apply Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mpr
    apply (Submodule.mem_bot R).mpr
    rw [mul_smul]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hab
  have hpower : I ^ (k + n) ≤ (⊥ : Submodule R M).colon {z} := by
    rw [pow_add]
    exact hproduct
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero T).mpr
  apply (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := M) (I := I) z).mpr
  refine ⟨k + n, (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff ((I ^ (k + n) : Ideal R) : Set R) z).mpr ?_⟩
  intro a
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp
    (Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mp (hpower a.property))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.maximalIdeal_not_mem_associatedPrimes_quotient_primaryComponent
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_not_mem_associatedPrimes_quotient_primaryComponent
    [IsLocalRing R] :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∉
      associatedPrimes R (M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))
proof:
:= by
  intro hass
  have hAssociated : IsAssociatedPrime (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
      (M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)) := hass
  obtain ⟨hprime, q, hq⟩ := isAssociatedPrime_iff.mp hAssociated
  have hqT : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ n, a • q = 0 := by
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    rw [pow_one] at ha
    rw [hq] at ha
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp (Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mp ha)
  have hqZero : q = 0 :=
    eq_zero_of_idealPower_torsion_quotient_primaryComponent
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) q hqT
  have hOneColon : (1 : R) ∈
      (⊥ : Submodule R
        (M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))).colon {q} := by
    apply Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mpr
    simpa only [hqZero, smul_zero] using
      (Submodule.zero_mem (⊥ : Submodule R
        (M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))))
  exact hprime.one_notMem (hq.symm ▸ hOneColon)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.ne_zero_of_radical_componentIntersection
statement:
theorem ne_zero_of_radical_componentIntersection
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [IsLocalRing C]
    {x : C} {a b : Ideal C}
    (haRadical : a.IsRadical) (hbRadical : b.IsRadical)
    (haMax : a ≠ maximalIdeal C) (hbMax : b ≠ maximalIdeal C)
    (hinf : a ⊓ b = (Ideal.span {x}).radical)
    (hsup : (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C) :
    x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have haBot : a ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro ha
    apply hbMax
    simpa only [ha, bot_inf_eq, bot_sup_eq, hbRadical.radical] using hsup
  have hbBot : b ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hb
    apply haMax
    simpa only [hb, inf_bot_eq, sup_bot_eq, haRadical.radical] using hsup
  intro hx
  apply Ideal.inf_ne_bot_of_ne_bot haBot hbBot
  simpa only [hx, Set.singleton_zero, Ideal.span_zero,
    Ideal.radical_bot_of_isReduced] using hinf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_nonmaximal_minimalPrime_pair_of_radical_componentIntersection
statement:
theorem exists_nonmaximal_minimalPrime_pair_of_radical_componentIntersection
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C]
    {I a b : Ideal C}
    (haRadical : a.IsRadical) (hbRadical : b.IsRadical)
    (haMax : a ≠ maximalIdeal C) (hbMax : b ≠ maximalIdeal C)
    (hinf : a ⊓ b = I.radical)
    (hsup : (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C) :
    ∃ P Q : Ideal C,
      P ∈ I.minimalPrimes ∧ Q ∈ I.minimalPrimes ∧
      a ≤ P ∧ b ≤ Q ∧
      P ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ Q ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
      (P ⊔ Q).radical = maximalIdeal C
proof:
:= by
  have haTop : a ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro ha
    have hmaxTop : maximalIdeal C = ⊤ := by
      simpa only [ha, top_sup_eq, Ideal.radical_top] using hsup.symm
    exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hmaxTop
  have hbTop : b ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro hb
    have hmaxTop : maximalIdeal C = ⊤ := by
      simpa only [hb, sup_top_eq, Ideal.radical_top] using hsup.symm
    exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hmaxTop
  have haLt : a < maximalIdeal C :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal haTop) haMax
  have hbLt : b < maximalIdeal C :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hbTop) hbMax
  obtain ⟨ya, hyaMax, hya⟩ := (IsConcreteLE.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mp haLt).2
  obtain ⟨yb, hybMax, hyb⟩ := (IsConcreteLE.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mp hbLt).2
  have hPexists : ∃ P ∈ a.minimalPrimes, ya ∉ P := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hyaInf : ya ∈ sInf a.minimalPrimes :=
      Ideal.mem_sInf.mpr fun P hP ↦ h P hP
    exact hya <| by
      simpa only [Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes, haRadical.radical] using hyaInf
  have hQexists : ∃ Q ∈ b.minimalPrimes, yb ∉ Q := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hybInf : yb ∈ sInf b.minimalPrimes :=
      Ideal.mem_sInf.mpr fun Q hQ ↦ h Q hQ
    exact hyb <| by
      simpa only [Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes, hbRadical.radical] using hybInf
  obtain ⟨P, hPa, hyaP⟩ := hPexists
  obtain ⟨Q, hQb, hybQ⟩ := hQexists
  have hPMax : P ≠ maximalIdeal C := by
    intro hP
    exact hyaP (hP ▸ hyaMax)
  have hQMax : Q ≠ maximalIdeal C := by
    intro hQ
    exact hybQ (hQ ▸ hybMax)
  have hPI : P ∈ I.minimalPrimes := by
    refine ⟨⟨hPa.isPrime, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Ideal.le_radical.trans <| hinf ▸ inf_le_left.trans hPa.le
    · intro p hp hpP
      have habp : a ⊓ b ≤ p := by
        rw [hinf]
        exact hp.1.radical_le_iff.mpr hp.2
      rcases hp.1.inf_le.mp habp with hap | hbp
      · exact hPa.2 ⟨hp.1, hap⟩ hpP
      · exfalso
        apply hPMax
        apply le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hPa.isPrime.ne_top)
        rw [← hsup]
        exact hPa.isPrime.isRadical.radical_le_iff.mpr <|
          sup_le hPa.le (hbp.trans hpP)
  have hQI : Q ∈ I.minimalPrimes := by
    refine ⟨⟨hQb.isPrime, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Ideal.le_radical.trans <| hinf ▸ inf_le_right.trans hQb.le
    · intro q hq hqQ
      have habq : a ⊓ b ≤ q := by
        rw [hinf]
        exact hq.1.radical_le_iff.mpr hq.2
      rcases hq.1.inf_le.mp habq with haq | hbq
      · exfalso
        apply hQMax
        apply le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hQb.isPrime.ne_top)
        rw [← hsup]
        exact hQb.isPrime.isRadical.radical_le_iff.mpr <|
          sup_le (haq.trans hqQ) hQb.le
      · exact hQb.2 ⟨hq.1, hbq⟩ hqQ
  have hPQ : (P ⊔ Q).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).isPrime.isRadical.radical_le_iff.mpr <|
        sup_le (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hPa.isPrime.ne_top)
          (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hQb.isPrime.ne_top)
    · rw [← hsup]
      exact Ideal.radical_mono <| sup_le_sup hPa.le hQb.le
  exact ⟨P, Q, hPI, hQI, hPa.le, hQb.le, hPMax, hQMax, hPQ⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_height_le_one_minimalPrime_pair_of_radical_componentIntersection
statement:
theorem exists_height_le_one_minimalPrime_pair_of_radical_componentIntersection
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [IsLocalRing C]
    [IsNoetherianRing C]
    {x : C} {a b : Ideal C}
    (haRadical : a.IsRadical) (hbRadical : b.IsRadical)
    (haMax : a ≠ maximalIdeal C) (hbMax : b ≠ maximalIdeal C)
    (hinf : a ⊓ b = (Ideal.span {x}).radical)
    (hsup : (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C) :
    x ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ P Q : Ideal C,
        P ∈ (Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes ∧
        Q ∈ (Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes ∧
        a ≤ P ∧ b ≤ Q ∧
        P ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ Q ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
        P.height ≤ 1 ∧ Q.height ≤ 1 ∧
        (P ⊔ Q).radical = maximalIdeal C
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ne_zero_of_radical_componentIntersection haRadical hbRadical
    haMax hbMax hinf hsup, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, haP, hbQ, hPMax, hQMax, hPQ⟩ :=
    exists_nonmaximal_minimalPrime_pair_of_radical_componentIntersection
      haRadical hbRadical haMax hbMax hinf hsup
  exact ⟨P, Q, hP, hQ, haP, hbQ, hPMax, hQMax,
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ _ hP,
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ _ hQ, hPQ⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_height_le_one_minimalPrime_pair_of_not_connectedSpace
statement:
theorem exists_height_le_one_minimalPrime_pair_of_not_connectedSpace
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [IsLocalRing C]
    [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ¬ ConnectedSpace (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) →
      x ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ P Q : Ideal C,
          P ∈ (Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes ∧
          Q ∈ (Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes ∧
          P ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ Q ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
          P.height ≤ 1 ∧ Q.height ≤ 1 ∧
          (P ⊔ Q).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro hnot
  obtain ⟨a, b, _hxa, _hxb, _haTop, _hbTop, haMax, hbMax,
      haRadical, hbRadical, hinf, hsup⟩ :=
    exists_radical_nonmaximal_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_not_connectedSpace
      hdim x hx hnot
  obtain ⟨hx0, P, Q, hP, hQ, _haP, _hbQ, hPMax, hQMax,
      hPheight, hQheight, hPQ⟩ :=
    exists_height_le_one_minimalPrime_pair_of_radical_componentIntersection
      haRadical hbRadical haMax hbMax hinf hsup
  exact ⟨hx0, P, Q, hP, hQ, hPMax, hQMax, hPheight, hQheight, hPQ⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_pullback_snd_comp
statement:
private theorem finiteEtale_pullback_snd_comp
    {N X S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : N ⟶ X) (b : S ⟶ X) (a : T ⟶ S)
    [IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd g b)] :
    IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd g (a ≫ b))
proof:
:= by
  let e := pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso g b a
  have ht : IsFiniteEtale (e.inv ≫ pullback.snd (pullback.snd g b) a) := ⟨⟩
  exact (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_inv_snd_snd g b a) ▸ ht

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_iterated_pullback_snd
statement:
private theorem finiteEtale_iterated_pullback_snd
    {N X S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : N ⟶ X) (b : S ⟶ X) (a : T ⟶ S)
    [IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd g (a ≫ b))] :
    IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd (pullback.snd g b) a)
proof:
:= by
  let e := pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso g b a
  have ht : IsFiniteEtale (e.hom ≫ pullback.snd g (a ≫ b)) := ⟨⟩
  exact (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd g b a) ▸ ht

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_normalization_affineChart
statement:
private theorem finiteEtale_normalization_affineChart
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement)
    (hboundary : ∀ x : X, x ∈ D.1.support →
      IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
        (X.fromSpecStalk x)))
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (d : Γ(X, U))
    (hd : D.1.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ = Ideal.span {d}) :
    IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
      hU.fromSpec)
proof:
:= by
  let R := Γ(X, U)
  let : IsNoetherianRing R := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U, hU⟩
  let A := Localization.Away d
  let c := D.1.affineAwayToSupportComplement hU d hd
  let V := (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W
  let a := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
  let b := hU.fromSpec
  let F : W.left ⟶ X := W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι
  let g : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of A) := V.hom
  let f : V.left ⟶ Spec R := g ≫ a
  have H : IsPullback (pullback.fst W.hom c) f F b :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback W.hom c).paste_vert
      (D.1.isPullback_affineAwayToSupportComplement hU d hd)
  let e : pullback F b ≅ V.left := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b).isoIsPullback _ _ H
  have he : e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd F b :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd W.left (Spec R)
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b) H
  let en := normalizationSourceIso (pullback.snd F b) f e he
  let ef : f.normalization ≅ pullback F.fromNormalization b :=
    en.symm ≪≫ asIso (F.normalizationPullback b)
  have hef : ef.hom ≫ pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b = f.fromNormalization := by
    change (en.inv ≫ F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b = _
    rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd]
    exact (Iso.inv_comp_eq en).mpr (normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization _ _ _ _).symm
  have hnormal (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (hp : d ∈ p) :
      IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p) := by
    let q : Spec R := ⟨p, inferInstance⟩
    have hy : hU.fromSpec q ∈ D.1.support :=
      (D.1.fromSpec_mem_support_iff_of_ideal_eq_span hU d hd q).mpr hp
    let : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (hU.fromSpec q)) := hreg _ hy
    let : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p) :=
      IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (hU.stalkIsoLocalization q).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    exact ⟨IsRegularLocalRing.isDomain (Localization.AtPrime p),
      SchemeTheory.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p)⟩
  have hlocal (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
      IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd f.fromNormalization
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))))) := by
    let q : Spec R := p
    let ap := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))
    let l := Spec.map (hU.stalkIsoLocalization q).hom
    have hs : IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization
        (X.fromSpecStalk (hU.fromSpec q))) := by
      by_cases hy : hU.fromSpec q ∈ D.1.support
      · exact hboundary _ hy
      · exact finiteEtale_normalization_stalk_of_mem_open D.1.supportComplement W _ hy
    have hcomp : IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization
        (l ≫ X.fromSpecStalk (hU.fromSpec q))) :=
      finiteEtale_pullback_snd_comp F.fromNormalization _ l
    have hp : IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization (ap ≫ b)) :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun k => IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization k))
        (hU.SpecMap_stalkIsoLocalization_fromSpecStalk q)) hcomp
    have hwhole : IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b) ap) :=
      finiteEtale_iterated_pullback_snd F.fromNormalization b ap
    let m := pullback.map f.fromNormalization ap (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b) ap
      ef.hom (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) ((Category.comp_id _).trans hef.symm)
      ((Category.comp_id ap).trans (Category.id_comp ap).symm)
    have hm : m ≫ pullback.snd (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b) ap =
        pullback.snd f.fromNormalization ap :=
      (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _)
    have ht : IsFiniteEtale (m ≫ pullback.snd (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b) ap) := ⟨⟩
    exact hm ▸ ht
  have hf : IsFiniteEtale f.fromNormalization :=
    finiteEtale_normalization_of_principal_factorization R d A g hnormal hlocal
  have ht : IsFiniteEtale (ef.inv ≫ f.fromNormalization) := ⟨⟩
  have hi : ef.inv ≫ f.fromNormalization = pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b :=
    (Iso.inv_comp_eq ef).mpr hef.symm
  exact hi ▸ ht

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_normalization_of_cartier_boundary_stalks
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_normalization_of_cartier_boundary_stalks
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement)
    (hboundary : ∀ x : X, x ∈ D.1.support →
      IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
        (X.fromSpecStalk x))) :
    IsFiniteEtale (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  choose U hx d hregular hd using D.2
  let cover : X.OpenCover :=
    { I₀ := X
      X := fun x => Spec Γ(X, (U x).1)
      f := fun x => (U x).2.fromSpec
      mem₀ := by
        rw [Scheme.presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff]
        refine ⟨?_, fun x => (U x).2.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec⟩
        intro x
        refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
        rw [(U x).2.range_fromSpec]
        exact hx x }
  let : IsZariskiLocalAtTarget (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) :=
    (HasAffineProperty.iff (P := (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}))
      (Q := affineAnd RingHom.FiniteEtale)).mp inferInstance |>.1
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (P := @IsFiniteEtale) cover
  intro x
  exact finiteEtale_normalization_affineChart D hreg W hboundary (U x).2 (d x) (hd x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_nat_ringKrullDim_eq_of_finiteRingKrullDim
statement:
theorem exists_nat_ringKrullDim_eq_of_finiteRingKrullDim
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [FiniteRingKrullDim R] :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ :=
    WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp (ringKrullDim_ne_bot (R := R))
  have hetop : e ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro heTop
    apply ringKrullDim_ne_top (R := R)
    rw [← he, heTop, WithBot.coe_top]
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hetop
  refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
  calc
    ringKrullDim R = (e : WithBot ℕ∞) := he.symm
    _ = ((d : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hd.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_nonmaximal_prime_over_of_isRadical
statement:
theorem exists_nonmaximal_prime_over_of_isRadical
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (J : Ideal R) (hJradical : J.IsRadical)
    (hJproper : J ≠ ⊤) (hJnonmax : J ≠ maximalIdeal R) :
    ∃ P : Ideal R,
      J ≤ P ∧ P.IsPrime ∧ P ≠ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  have hradical : J.radical ≠ maximalIdeal R := by
    simpa only [hJradical.radical] using hJnonmax
  obtain ⟨P, hJP, hPprime, hPlt⟩ :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_prime_over_lt_maximalIdeal_of_radical_ne
      J hJproper hradical
  exact ⟨P, hJP, hPprime, hPlt.ne⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.zeroLocus_inter_puncture_nonempty_of_isRadical
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_inter_puncture_nonempty_of_isRadical
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (J : Ideal R) (hJradical : J.IsRadical)
    (hJproper : J ≠ ⊤) (hJnonmax : J ≠ maximalIdeal R) :
    (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus J ∩
      ({closedPoint R}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hJP, hPprime, hPnonmax⟩ :=
    exists_nonmaximal_prime_over_of_isRadical
      J hJradical hJproper hJnonmax
  let p : PrimeSpectrum R := ⟨P, hPprime⟩
  have hpnonmax : p ≠ closedPoint R := by
    intro hp
    apply hPnonmax
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hp
  exact ⟨p, hJP, by
    simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hpnonmax⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechNilHomotopyEquiv_inv_f_zero
statement:
theorem cechNilHomotopyEquiv_inv_f_zero (M N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (e : M ≅ N) :
    (cechNilHomotopyEquiv M N e).inv.f 0 = e.inv ≫ (ρ_ M).inv
proof:
:= by
  change (((CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).map (e.inv ≫ (ρ_ M).inv)) ≫
    (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (tensorLeft M)
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0).inv.app (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R))).f 0 = _
  rw [HomologicalComplex.comp_f, CochainComplex.single₀_map_f_zero,
    HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex_inv_app_self]
  change (e.inv ≫ (ρ_ M).inv) ≫ 𝟙 (M ⊗ 𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R)) ≫
    (M ◁ 𝟙 (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R))) = _
  rw [whiskerLeft_id, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.fullSubmoduleIso_inv
proof: := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechNilTorsionIso_inv
statement:
theorem cechNilTorsionIso_inv (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    (cechNilTorsionIso M).inv =

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechInjective_exactAt_succ
statement:
theorem cechInjective_exactAt_succ [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (xs : List R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] (n : ℕ) :
    (((tensorLeft M).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
      (cechLocalizationComplex xs)).ExactAt (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let e := cechInjectiveHomotopyEquiv xs M
  apply (exactAt_iff_of_quasiIsoAt e.hom (n + 1)).mpr

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechCoefficientZeroIso_naturality
statement:
theorem cechCoefficientZeroIso_naturality (xs : List R)
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    ((tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor (cechLocalizationComplex xs)).map f).f 0 ≫
      (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs N).hom = (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs M).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  change (f ▷ (cechLocalizationComplex xs).X 0) ≫
    (N ◁ (cechLocalizationZeroIso xs).hom) ≫ (ρ_ N).hom =
      ((M ◁ (cechLocalizationZeroIso xs).hom) ≫ (ρ_ M).hom) ≫ f
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← whisker_exchange, Category.assoc]
  change (M ◁ (cechLocalizationZeroIso xs).hom) ≫
    (f ▷ (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R))) ≫ (ρ_ N).hom =
      ((M ◁ (cechLocalizationZeroIso xs).hom) ≫ (ρ_ M).hom) ≫ f
  rw [rightUnitor_naturality]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechHomologyZeroToModule_naturality
statement:
theorem cechHomologyZeroToModule_naturality (xs : List R)
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    homologyMap ((tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor (cechLocalizationComplex xs)).map f) 0 ≫
      cechHomologyZeroToModule xs N = cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  let K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ :=
    ((tensorLeft M).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (cechLocalizationComplex xs)
  let L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ :=
    ((tensorLeft N).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (cechLocalizationComplex xs)
  let φ : K ⟶ L := (tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor (cechLocalizationComplex xs)).map f
  have hzero : φ.f 0 ≫ (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs N).hom =
      (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs M).hom ≫ f := cechCoefficientZeroIso_naturality xs f
  change homologyMap φ 0 ≫ (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ L).inv ≫
      L.iCycles 0 ≫ (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs N).hom =
    ((CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ K).inv ≫ K.iCycles 0 ≫
      (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs M).hom) ≫ f
  rw [CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀_inv_naturality_assoc, cyclesMap_i_assoc, hzero]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor_shortExact
statement:
theorem tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor_shortExact
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) [∀ n, Module.Flat R (K.X n)]
    {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor K)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact
  intro n
  change (S.map (tensorRight (K.X n))).ShortExact
  refine ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk'
    (Module.Flat.rTensor_shortComplex_exact (K.X n) S hS.exact) ?_ ?_
  · apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr
    exact Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := K.X n) S.f.hom
      ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective S.f).mp hS.mono_f)
  · apply (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr
    exact LinearMap.rTensor_surjective (K.X n)
      ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective S.g).mp hS.epi_g)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isTorsionFree_linearMap_topLocalCohomology
statement:
theorem isTorsionFree_linearMap_topLocalCohomology
    (E : Type v) [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    Module.IsTorsionFree R
      (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) (d + 1) →ₗ[R] E)
proof:
:= by
  apply Module.IsTorsionFree.of_smul_eq_zero
  intro x f hxf
  by_cases hxzero : x = 0
  · exact Or.inl hxzero
  · apply Or.inr
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective
        (fun z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R)
          (ModuleCat.of R R) (d + 1) => x • z) := by
      by_cases hxm : x ∈ maximalIdeal R
      · exact derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_maximalIdeal_surjective_succ
          d hdim x hxzero hxm
      · exact (notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hxm).smul_bijective.surjective
    ext z
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hsurj z
    rw [← hw, map_smul]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hxf w

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.nontrivial_linearMap_topLocalCohomology
statement:
theorem nontrivial_linearMap_topLocalCohomology
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] [Module.Injective R E]
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    Nontrivial
      (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) d →ₗ[R] E)
proof:
:= by
  let H : ModuleCat.{u} R :=
    derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) d
  have hnonzero : ¬ IsZero
      (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) d) :=
    derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_not_isZero_of_supportDim_eq
      (ModuleCat.of R R) d ((Module.supportDim_self_eq_ringKrullDim R).trans hdim)
  have hnotSubsingleton : ¬ Subsingleton H :=
    fun h => hnonzero (AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr h)
  let : Nontrivial H := not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp hnotSubsingleton
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : H)
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_injective_residueField i hi z hz
  refine ⟨⟨f, 0, ?_⟩⟩
  intro hfzero
  exact hf (DFunLike.congr_fun hfzero z)
