name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquiv_apply_germ
statement:
private theorem puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquiv_apply_germ
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (r : Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤)) :
    let X
proof:
:= Spec (.of R)
    let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion j := by
      dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
    letI : Algebra R X.functionField :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : U.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint U, by trivial⟩⟩
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquivOfPositiveDimension R hpos
        (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r) =
      U.germToFunctionField ⊤ (j.appTop r) := by
  dsimp only
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  let : Algebra R X.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : U.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint U, by trivial⟩⟩
  let hgen : j (genericPoint U) = genericPoint X :=
    genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion j
  change j.stalkMap (genericPoint U)
      ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hgen.symm)).hom
        (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r)) =
    U.germToFunctionField ⊤ (j.appTop r)
  simp only [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom]
  have htransport :
      X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
          (Inseparable.of_eq hgen.symm).ge
          (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial) r) =
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (j (genericPoint U)) (by trivial) r := by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun
      (CommRingCat.hom_ext_iff.mp
        (X.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes
          (show genericPoint X ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) by trivial)
          (Inseparable.of_eq hgen.symm).ge)) r
  rw [htransport]
  exact j.germ_stalkMap_apply (⊤ : X.Opens) (genericPoint U)
    (by trivial) r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.specFunctionField_algebraMap_ΓSpecIso_hom
statement:
private theorem specFunctionField_algebraMap_ΓSpecIso_hom
    (r : Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤)) :
    let X
proof:
:= Spec (.of R)
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
    letI : Algebra R X.functionField :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
    algebraMap R X.functionField ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).hom r) =
      X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r := by
  dsimp only
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  let : Algebra R X.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
  change X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial)
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).hom r)) =
    X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r
  change X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial)
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).hom r)) =
    X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial) r
  exact congrArg (fun s ↦
    X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial) s)
      (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)) r)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.hasPuncturedPurity_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
statement:
theorem hasPuncturedPurity_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    HasPuncturedPurity R
proof:
:= by
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  have hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R := by
    rw [hdim]
    norm_num
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed R :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      hdim
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : ConnectedSpace U := inferInstance
  change (pullback j).EssSurj
  apply pullback_essSurj_of_connected j
  intro W hW
  let : IsConnected W := hW
  exact ⟨connectedPuncturedCoverGenericNormalizationExtension R hdim W,
    ⟨(connectedPuncturedCoverGenericNormalizationExtensionRestrictionIso
      R hdim W).symm⟩⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_regular_mem_maximalIdeal_finiteLength_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_regular_mem_maximalIdeal_finiteLength_quotient
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (A : Type w) [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] [IsArtinian R A]
    (hm : maximalIdeal R ∉ associatedPrimes R M) :
    ∃ x : R, x ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ IsSMulRegular M x ∧
      IsFiniteLength R (A ⧸ (x • (⊤ : Submodule R A)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfinite : (associatedPrimes R M).Finite := associatedPrimes.finite R M
  have hprimes (P : Ideal R) (hP : P ∈ hfinite.toFinset) :
      P.IsPrime ∧ P ≠ maximalIdeal R := by
    have hPa : P ∈ associatedPrimes R M := hfinite.mem_toFinset.mp hP
    refine ⟨(AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff.mp hPa).isPrime, ?_⟩
    intro hPm
    rw [hPm] at hPa
    exact hm hPa
  obtain ⟨x, hxm, havoid, hlength⟩ :=
    exists_mem_maximalIdeal_avoiding_primes_finiteLength_quotient
      A hfinite.toFinset hprimes
  refine ⟨x, hxm, ?_, hlength⟩
  apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
  intro z hz
  by_contra hzne
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ P ∈ associatedPrimes R M, (P : Set R) := by
    rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_zero_divisors R M]
    exact ⟨z, hzne, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxUnion
  obtain ⟨hPa, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxP
  exact havoid P (hfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr hPa) hxP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_injective_essential_extension
statement:
theorem exists_injective_essential_extension
    {R M : Type u} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Injective R M] (N : Submodule R M) :
    ∃ E : Submodule R M, N ≤ E ∧
      IsEssentialSubmodule (N.comap E.subtype) ∧ Module.Injective R E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hNE, hNess, hmax⟩ := exists_maximal_essential_extension N
  obtain ⟨P, hEP, hEPess⟩ := exists_disjoint_essential_quotient E
  let i : E →ₗ[R] M ⧸ P := P.mkQ.comp E.subtype
  have hi : Function.Injective i := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    change P.mkQ (a : M) = P.mkQ (b : M) at hab
    have hzero : P.mkQ ((a : M) - (b : M)) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]
    have hmemP : (a : M) - (b : M) ∈ P :=
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero P).mp hzero
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp
      ((Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hEP) ((a : M) - (b : M))
        (E.sub_mem a.property b.property) hmemP)
  obtain ⟨f, hfi⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property
    R M E (M ⧸ P) i hi E.subtype
  have hfe (e : E) : f (P.mkQ (e : M)) = (e : M) :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun hfi e
  let S : Submodule R M := LinearMap.range f
  have hES : E ≤ S := by
    intro e he
    exact ⟨P.mkQ e, hfe ⟨e, he⟩⟩
  have hEinside :
      ∀ L : Submodule R M, L ≤ S → Disjoint E L → L = ⊥ := by
    intro L hLS hEL
    have hpre : Disjoint (E.map P.mkQ) (L.comap f) := by
      apply Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr
      intro z hzE hzL
      obtain ⟨e, he, hez⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hzE
      have hfz : f z = e := by
        rw [← hez]
        exact hfe ⟨e, he⟩
      have heL : e ∈ L := hfz ▸ (Submodule.mem_comap.mp hzL)
      have heZero : e = 0 := (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hEL) e he heL
      rw [← hez, heZero, map_zero]
    have hpreZero : L.comap f = ⊥ := hEPess (L.comap f) hpre
    apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
    intro z hzL
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hLS hzL
    have hwL : w ∈ L.comap f := Submodule.mem_comap.mpr (hw.symm ▸ hzL)
    rw [hpreZero] at hwL
    have hwZero : w = 0 := (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp hwL
    have hzZero : z = 0 := hw.symm.trans (by rw [hwZero, map_zero])
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mpr hzZero
  have hNinside :
      ∀ L : Submodule R M, L ≤ E → Disjoint N L → L = ⊥ :=
    (isEssentialSubmodule_comap_subtype_iff N E hNE).mp hNess
  have hNSess : IsEssentialSubmodule (N.comap S.subtype) := by
    apply (isEssentialSubmodule_comap_subtype_iff N S (hNE.trans hES)).mpr
    intro L hLS hNL
    apply hEinside L hLS
    apply disjoint_iff.mpr
    exact hNinside (E ⊓ L) inf_le_left (hNL.mono_right inf_le_right)
  have hSE : S = E := hmax S hES hNSess
  let r : M →ₗ[R] E :=
    LinearMap.codRestrict E (f.comp P.mkQ) (by
      intro m
      rw [← hSE]
      exact ⟨P.mkQ m, rfl⟩)
  have hr (e : E) : r (e : M) = e := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hfe e
  refine ⟨E, hNE, hNess, ?_⟩
  apply Module.Baer.injective
  intro I g
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property
    R M I R I.subtype I.injective_subtype (E.subtype.comp g)
  refine ⟨r.comp h, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  change r (h x) = g ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hhx : h x = (g ⟨x, hx⟩ : M) := DFunLike.congr_fun hh ⟨x, hx⟩
  rw [hhx]
  exact hr (g ⟨x, hx⟩)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localCohomology_isZero_of_quotientPowers_hasProjectiveDimensionLT
statement:
theorem localCohomology_isZero_of_quotientPowers_hasProjectiveDimensionLT
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (d i : ℕ) (hdi : d ≤ i)
    (hpd : ∀ n : ℕ,
      HasProjectiveDimensionLT (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) d) :
    IsZero ((localCohomology I i).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply localCohomology_isZero_of_subsingleton_ext_powers
  intro n
  let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)
  let : HasProjectiveDimensionLT N d := hpd n
  have hDerived :
      Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} N M i) :=
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT.subsingleton N d i hdi M
  exact ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
    (legacyExt_isZero_of_subsingleton_derivedExt N M i hDerived)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.quotient_span_singleton_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_two
statement:
theorem quotient_span_singleton_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_two
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (x : R) (hxreg : IsSMulRegular R x)
    (hxmem : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) 2
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (QuotSMulTop x R)
  have hR : projectiveDimension (ModuleCat.of R R) = 0 :=
    ModuleCat.projectiveDimension_eq_zero_of_projective (ModuleCat.of R R)
  have hQ : projectiveDimension Q = 1 := by
    rw [ModuleCat.projectiveDimension_quotSMulTop_eq_succ_of_isSMulRegular
      (ModuleCat.of R R) x hxreg hxmem, hR]
    norm_num
  let : HasProjectiveDimensionLT Q 2 := by
    rw [← projectiveDimension_lt_iff]
    rw [hQ]
    norm_num
  let e : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ≃ₗ[R] QuotSMulTop x R :=
    Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (by
      change (Ideal.span {x} : Submodule R R) =
        x • (⊤ : Submodule R R)
      calc
        (Ideal.span {x} : Submodule R R) =
            Ideal.span {x} • (⊤ : Submodule R R) := by
          rw [smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
        _ = x • (⊤ : Submodule R R) :=
          Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul x ⊤)
  exact ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_linearEquiv
    (M := Q) (N := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) e.symm 1

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localCohomology_span_singleton_isZero_of_isSMulRegular
statement:
theorem localCohomology_span_singleton_isZero_of_isSMulRegular
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (x : R) (hxreg : IsSMulRegular R x)
    (hxmem : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) (hi : 2 ≤ i) :
    IsZero ((localCohomology (Ideal.span {x}) i).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply localCohomology_isZero_of_quotientPowers_hasProjectiveDimensionLT
    (Ideal.span {x}) M 2 i hi
  intro n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
    let N : ModuleCat.{u} R :=
      ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ (⊤ : Ideal R))
    have hN : IsZero N := by
      dsimp only [N]
      exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton
        (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ (⊤ : Ideal R)))
    let : HasProjectiveDimensionLT N 0 :=
      hN.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge N 0 2 (by omega)
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    exact quotient_span_singleton_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_two
      (x ^ (n + 1)) (hxreg.pow (n + 1))
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).pow_mem_of_mem hxmem
        (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C]
    {S : Set (Ideal C)} (hS : S.Finite)
    {P : Ideal C} [P.IsPrime] (h : sInf S ≤ P) :
    ∃ I ∈ S, I ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  have h' := h
  rw [← hS.coe_toFinset, ← hS.toFinset.inf_id_eq_sInf] at h'
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hIP⟩ :=
    (inferInstance : P.IsPrime).inf_le'.mp h'
  exact ⟨I, hS.mem_toFinset.mp hI, hIP⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_cross_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_cross_zeroLocus
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C]
    {S T : Set (Ideal C)}
    (hSfinite : S.Finite) (hTfinite : T.Finite)
    (hSnonempty : S.Nonempty) (hTnonempty : T.Nonempty)
    (hSprime : ∀ P ∈ S, P.IsPrime)
    (hTprime : ∀ Q ∈ T, Q.IsPrime)
    (hcross : ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
        ({closedPoint C} : Set (PrimeSpectrum C))) :
    (sInf S ⊔ sInf T).radical = maximalIdeal C
proof:
:= by
  have hSle : sInf S ≤ maximalIdeal C := by
    obtain ⟨P, hPS⟩ := hSnonempty
    exact (sInf_le hPS).trans <|
      le_maximalIdeal (hSprime P hPS).ne_top
  have hTle : sInf T ≤ maximalIdeal C := by
    obtain ⟨Q, hQT⟩ := hTnonempty
    exact (sInf_le hQT).trans <|
      le_maximalIdeal (hTprime Q hQT).ne_top
  have hsup : sInf S ⊔ sInf T ≤ maximalIdeal C := sup_le hSle hTle
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).isPrime.radical_le_iff.mpr hsup
  · rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf, le_sInf_iff]
    intro K hK
    let : K.IsPrime := hK.2
    have hSK : sInf S ≤ K := le_sup_left.trans hK.1
    have hTK : sInf T ≤ K := le_sup_right.trans hK.1
    obtain ⟨P, hPS, hPK⟩ :=
      exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite hSfinite hSK
    obtain ⟨Q, hQT, hQK⟩ :=
      exists_mem_le_of_sInf_le_prime_of_finite hTfinite hTK
    let k : PrimeSpectrum C := ⟨K, inferInstance⟩
    have hk : k ∈
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q :=
      ⟨hPK, hQK⟩
    have hkclosed : k = closedPoint C :=
      Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hcross P hPS Q hQT hk)
    exact (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hkclosed).ge

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_minimalPrime_cross_zeroLocus
statement:
theorem radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_minimalPrime_cross_zeroLocus
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (I : Ideal C) {S T : Set (Ideal C)}
    (hS : S ⊆ I.minimalPrimes) (hT : T ⊆ I.minimalPrimes)
    (hSnonempty : S.Nonempty) (hTnonempty : T.Nonempty)
    (hcross : ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
        ({closedPoint C} : Set (PrimeSpectrum C))) :
    (sInf S ⊔ sInf T).radical = maximalIdeal C
proof:
:= by
  exact radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_cross_zeroLocus
    (S := S) (T := T)
    ((I.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing C).subset hS)
    ((I.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing C).subset hT)
    hSnonempty hTnonempty
    (fun P hPS ↦ (hS hPS).isPrime)
    (fun Q hQT ↦ (hT hQT).isPrime)
    hcross

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.injectiveResolution_extMk_smul
statement:
theorem injectiveResolution_extMk_smul
    (J : InjectiveResolution M) {X : ModuleCat.{u} R} {n : ℕ}
    (f : X ⟶ J.cocomplex.X n) (m : ℕ) (hm : n + 1 = m)
    (hf : f ≫ J.cocomplex.d n m = 0) (a : R) :
    J.extMk (a • f) m hm (by
      rw [Linear.smul_comp, hf, smul_zero]) =
      a • J.extMk f m hm hf
proof:
:= by
  have h := J.mk₀_comp_extMk f m hm hf (a • 𝟙 X)
  simpa only [Linear.smul_comp, Category.id_comp,
    Abelian.Ext.mk₀_smul, Abelian.Ext.smul_comp,
    Abelian.Ext.mk₀_id_comp] using h.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.injectiveResolutionCyclesToExtSucc_surjective
statement:
theorem injectiveResolutionCyclesToExtSucc_surjective
    (J : InjectiveResolution M) (X : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (injectiveResolutionCyclesToExtSucc J X n)
proof:
:= by
  intro α
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := J.extMk_surjective α (n + 2) (by omega)
  exact ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.injectiveResolutionCyclesToExtSucc_ker_eq_range
statement:
theorem injectiveResolutionCyclesToExtSucc_ker_eq_range
    (J : InjectiveResolution M) (X : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (injectiveResolutionCyclesToExtSucc J X n) =
      LinearMap.range
        (injectiveResolutionLinearCoyonedaShortComplexSucc J X n).moduleCatToCycles
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  change J.extMk f.1 (n + 2) (by omega) f.2 = 0 ↔ _
  rw [J.extMk_eq_zero_iff f.1 (n + 2) (by omega) f.2 n rfl]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    exact ⟨g, Subtype.ext hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    exact ⟨g, congr_arg Subtype.val hg⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.injectiveResolutionCocycleQuotientEquivExtSucc_apply_mk
statement:
theorem injectiveResolutionCocycleQuotientEquivExtSucc_apply_mk
    (J : InjectiveResolution M) (X : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ)
    (f : LinearMap.ker
      (injectiveResolutionLinearCoyonedaShortComplexSucc J X n).g.hom) :
    injectiveResolutionCocycleQuotientEquivExtSucc J X n (Submodule.Quotient.mk f) =
      J.extMk f.1 (n + 2) (by omega) f.2
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.injectiveResolutionCocycleQuotientEquivExtSucc_symm_extMk
statement:
theorem injectiveResolutionCocycleQuotientEquivExtSucc_symm_extMk
    (J : InjectiveResolution M) (X : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ)
    (f : X ⟶ J.cocomplex.X (n + 1))
    (hf : f ≫ J.cocomplex.d (n + 1) (n + 2) = 0) :
    (injectiveResolutionCocycleQuotientEquivExtSucc J X n).symm
        (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨f, hf⟩
proof:
:=
  (injectiveResolutionCocycleQuotientEquivExtSucc J X n).symm_apply_apply
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨f, hf⟩)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.mem_maximalIdealSaturation_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdealSaturation_iff (I : Ideal R) (x : R) :
    x ∈ maximalIdealSaturation I ↔
      ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ k, a * x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  change I.mkQ x ∈ Ideal.primaryComponent (R ⧸ I) (maximalIdeal R) ↔ _
  rw [Ideal.primaryComponent_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨k, fun a ha => ?_⟩
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero I).mp
    change I.mkQ (a • x) = 0
    rw [map_smul]
    exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (R := R) (M := R ⧸ I)
      (s := ((maximalIdeal R ^ k : Ideal R) : Set R)) (I.mkQ x)).mp hk ⟨a, ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff]
    intro a
    rw [← map_smul]
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero I).mpr (hk a a.property)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.le_maximalIdealSaturation
statement: theorem le_maximalIdealSaturation (I : Ideal R) : I ≤ maximalIdealSaturation I
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact (mem_maximalIdealSaturation_iff I x).mpr
    ⟨0, fun a _ => I.mul_mem_left a hx⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.maximalIdealSaturation_mono
statement: theorem maximalIdealSaturation_mono : Monotone (maximalIdealSaturation (R := R))
proof:
:= by
  intro I J hIJ x hx
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (mem_maximalIdealSaturation_iff I x).mp hx
  exact (mem_maximalIdealSaturation_iff J x).mpr ⟨k, fun a ha => hIJ (hk a ha)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.pow_le_maximalIdealSaturatedPower
statement:
theorem pow_le_maximalIdealSaturatedPower (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) :
    I ^ n ≤ maximalIdealSaturatedPower I n
proof:
:=
  le_maximalIdealSaturation (I ^ n)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.maximalIdealSaturatedPower_antitone
statement:
theorem maximalIdealSaturatedPower_antitone (I : Ideal R) :
    Antitone (maximalIdealSaturatedPower I)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm
  exact maximalIdealSaturation_mono (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hnm)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_primeSymbolicPower
statement:
theorem maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_primeSymbolicPower
    (I P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (hIP : I ≤ P)
    (hP : P ≠ maximalIdeal R) (n : ℕ) :
    maximalIdealSaturatedPower I n ≤ primeSymbolicPower P n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hsm, hsp⟩ := IsConcreteLE.exists_of_lt
    (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime P) hP)
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (mem_maximalIdealSaturation_iff (I ^ n) x).mp hx
  exact (mem_primeSymbolicPower_iff P n x).mpr
    ⟨s ^ k, P.primeCompl.pow_mem hsp k,
      (pow_le_pow_left' hIP n) (hk (s ^ k) (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hsm k))⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.iInf_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_eq_bot
statement:
theorem iInf_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_eq_bot
    [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (I P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (hIP : I ≤ P)
    (hP : P ≠ maximalIdeal R) :
    (⨅ n : ℕ, maximalIdealSaturatedPower I n) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  rw [← iInf_primeSymbolicPower_eq_bot P]
  exact iInf_mono (maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_primeSymbolicPower I P hIP hP)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem exists_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_maximalIdeal_pow
    [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (hIP : I ≤ P)
    (hP : P ≠ maximalIdeal R) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, maximalIdealSaturatedPower I n ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ k
proof:
:=
  EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_le_maximalIdeal_pow_of_antitone_iInf_eq_bot
    (maximalIdealSaturatedPower I) (maximalIdealSaturatedPower_antitone I)
    (iInf_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_eq_bot I P hIP hP) k

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isFiniteLength_primaryComponent_quotient
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_primaryComponent_quotient
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) :
    IsFiniteLength R (Ideal.primaryComponent (R ⧸ I) (maximalIdeal R))
proof:
:= by
  apply isFiniteLength_of_finite_of_maximalIdealPower_torsion
  intro z
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem
    (M := R ⧸ I) (I := maximalIdeal R) (z : R ⧸ I)).mp z.property
  refine ⟨k, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (R := R) (M := R ⧸ I)
    (s := ((maximalIdeal R ^ k : Ideal R) : Set R)) (z : R ⧸ I)).mp hk ⟨a, ha⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_pow_of_le_prime
statement:
theorem exists_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_pow_of_le_prime
    [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (hIP : I ≤ P)
    (hP : P ≠ maximalIdeal R) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, maximalIdealSaturatedPower I m ≤ I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  let q : R →ₗ[R] R ⧸ I ^ n := Submodule.mkQ (I ^ n)
  let K : Submodule R (R ⧸ I ^ n) :=
    Ideal.primaryComponent (R ⧸ I ^ n) (maximalIdeal R)
  let : IsArtinian R K := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
    (isFiniteLength_primaryComponent_quotient (I ^ n))).2
  let F : ℕ → Submodule R (R ⧸ I ^ n) :=
    fun i => Submodule.map q (maximalIdealSaturatedPower I (n + i))
  have hF (i : ℕ) : F i ≤ K := by
    rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact maximalIdealSaturatedPower_antitone I (Nat.le_add_right n i) hx
  let G : ℕ →o (Submodule R K)ᵒᵈ :=
    { toFun := fun i => (F i).comap K.subtype
      monotone' := fun _ _ hij =>
        Submodule.comap_mono (Submodule.map_mono
          (maximalIdealSaturatedPower_antitone I (Nat.add_le_add_left hij n))) }
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := IsArtinian.monotone_stabilizes G
  refine ⟨n + N, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (I ^ n)).mp
  have hxF : q x ∈ F N := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := q) hx
  let y : K := ⟨q x, hF N hxF⟩
  have hy : y ∈ (G N).ofDual := hxF
  change q x = 0
  apply IsHausdorff.haus (inferInstance : IsHausdorff (maximalIdeal R) (R ⧸ I ^ n))
  intro k
  apply SModEq.zero.mpr
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_maximalIdeal_pow I P hIP hP k
  have hy' : y ∈ (G (max N m)).ofDual :=
    (hN (max N m) (le_max_left N m)) ▸ hy
  have hxF' : q x ∈ F (max N m) := hy'
  have hsmall : maximalIdealSaturatedPower I (n + max N m) ≤ maximalIdeal R ^ k :=
    (maximalIdealSaturatedPower_antitone I
      ((le_max_right N m).trans (Nat.le_add_left (max N m) n))).trans hm
  have hxmap : q x ∈ Submodule.map q (maximalIdeal R ^ k) :=
    Submodule.map_mono hsmall hxF'
  obtain ⟨a, ha, heq⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hxmap
  have ha' : a ∈ ((maximalIdeal R ^ k) • ⊤ : Submodule R R) := by
    simpa only [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, mul_one] using ha
  have hmap := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := q) ha'
  rw [Submodule.map_smul'', Submodule.map_top] at hmap
  rw [Submodule.range_mkQ] at hmap
  rw [heq] at hmap
  exact hmap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_nonmaximal_prime_over_of_radical_ne
statement:
theorem exists_nonmaximal_prime_over_of_radical_ne
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) (hrad : I.radical ≠ maximalIdeal R) :
    ∃ P : Ideal R, I ≤ P ∧ P.IsPrime ∧ P ≠ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hrad
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).isPrime.radical_le_iff.mpr (le_maximalIdeal hI)
  · rw [I.radical_eq_sInf]
    apply le_sInf
    intro P hP
    rw [h P hP.1 hP.2]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_pow
statement:
theorem exists_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_pow
    [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) (hrad : I.radical ≠ maximalIdeal R) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, maximalIdealSaturatedPower I m ≤ I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hIP, hprime, hP⟩ := exists_nonmaximal_prime_over_of_radical_ne I hI hrad
  let : P.IsPrime := hprime
  exact exists_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_pow_of_le_prime I P hIP hP n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_positiveDimension
statement:
private theorem puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_positiveDimension
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R) :
    Nonempty (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)
proof:
:=
  Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R) :
    let X
proof:
:= Spec (.of R)
    let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_positiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
      dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
    letI : Algebra R X.functionField :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
    letI : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
    IsFractionRing R U.functionField := by
  dsimp only
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
    dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
  let : Algebra R X.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
  let : Algebra R U.functionField :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R X.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.functionField_isFractionRing_of_affine (.of R)
  exact IsFractionRing.of_algEquiv
    (puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgEquivOfPositiveDimension R hpos)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_zero_quotient_primaryComponent
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_zero_quotient_primaryComponent
    [IsLocalRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R)
      (ModuleCat.of R (M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M (maximalIdeal R))) 0)
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ModuleCat.{u} R :=
    ModuleCat.of R (M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M (maximalIdeal R))
  have hEval (z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q 0) :
      derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule (maximalIdeal R) Q z = 0 :=
    Purity.eq_zero_of_idealPower_torsion_quotient_primaryComponent (M := M)
      (maximalIdeal R) (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule (maximalIdeal R) Q z)
      ((mem_range_derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_iff
        (maximalIdeal R) Q _).mp
          (LinearMap.mem_range_self (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule (maximalIdeal R) Q) z))
  apply AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
  refine ⟨fun z w => ?_⟩
  exact (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_injective (maximalIdeal R) Q)
    ((hEval z).trans (hEval w).symm)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.linearYoneda_preservesHomology_of_injective
statement:
theorem linearYoneda_preservesHomology_of_injective
    (E : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R E] :
    ((linearYoneda R (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj E).PreservesHomology
proof:
:= by
  let : CategoryTheory.Injective E := Module.injective_object_of_injective_module R E
  let F : (ModuleCat.{u} R)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} R :=
    (linearYoneda R (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj E
  let U : ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
  let : PreservesFiniteLimits (preadditiveYonedaObj E) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology (preadditiveYonedaObj E)
  let : PreservesFiniteLimits (F ⋙ U) := by
    change PreservesFiniteLimits
      (preadditiveYonedaObj E ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (End E)) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    infer_instance
  let : PreservesFiniteColimits (F ⋙ U) := by
    change PreservesFiniteColimits
      (preadditiveYonedaObj E ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (End E)) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    infer_instance
  let : PreservesFiniteLimits F := preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves F U
  let : PreservesFiniteColimits F := preservesFiniteColimits_of_reflects_of_preserves F U
  exact Functor.preservesHomologyOfExact F

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.derivedLocalCohomologyConnecting_surjective_of_injective
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyConnecting_surjective_of_injective
    (I : Ideal R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [Module.Injective R S.X₂] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS n)
proof:
:= by
  let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule I S.X₂ (n + 1)) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_injective I S.X₂ n)
  intro z
  exact (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficients_afterConnecting_exact I hS n z).mp
    (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.derivedLocalCohomologyConnecting_bijective_succ_of_injective
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyConnecting_bijective_succ_of_injective
    (I : Ideal R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [Module.Injective R S.X₂] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, derivedLocalCohomologyConnecting_surjective_of_injective I hS (n + 1)⟩
  let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule I S.X₂ (n + 1)) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_injective I S.X₂ n)
  apply (LinearMap.injective_iff_eq_zero_of_exact
    (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficients_beforeConnecting_exact I hS (n + 1))).mpr
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  rw [Subsingleton.elim z 0, map_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_radical_nonmaximal_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_not_connectedSpace
statement:
theorem exists_radical_nonmaximal_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_not_connectedSpace
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ¬ ConnectedSpace
        (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) →
      ∃ a b : Ideal C,
        Ideal.span {x} ≤ a ∧ Ideal.span {x} ≤ b ∧
        a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
        a ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ b ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
        a.IsRadical ∧ b.IsRadical ∧
        a ⊓ b = (Ideal.span {x}).radical ∧
        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro hnot
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen D
  have hU_nonempty : Nonempty U := by
    obtain ⟨P, hP, _⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := maximalIdeal D) bot_le
    have hcomponent :
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∈
          irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum D) := by
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents]
      simpa only [(hP.isPrime.isRadical.radical)] using hP
    obtain ⟨p, _hpComponent, hpPuncture⟩ :=
      irreducibleComponent_quotient_span_singleton_inter_puncture_nonempty
        hdim x hx (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) hcomponent
    refine ⟨⟨p, ?_⟩⟩
    exact (Scheme.mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff D p).2 <| by
      simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        using hpPuncture
  have hnontrivialClopen :
      ∃ A : Set U, IsClopen A ∧ A ≠ ∅ ∧ A ≠ Set.univ := by
    by_contra hex
    apply hnot
    rw [connectedSpace_iff_clopen]
    refine ⟨hU_nonempty, ?_⟩
    intro A hA
    by_cases hAe : A = ∅
    · exact Or.inl hAe
    · right
      by_contra hAu
      exact hex ⟨A, hA, hAe, hAu⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hAclopen, hAne, hAuniv⟩ := hnontrivialClopen
  let B : Set U := Aᶜ
  let A₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D) := Subtype.val '' A
  let B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D) := Subtype.val '' B
  have hAopen : IsOpen A₀ := by
    exact U.isOpen.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.isOpen_iff_image_isOpen.mp
      hAclopen.isOpen
  have hBopen : IsOpen B₀ := by
    exact U.isOpen.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.isOpen_iff_image_isOpen.mp
      hAclopen.compl.isOpen
  have hcover :
      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D)) := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ | ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)
      · exact a.property
      · exact b.property
    · intro hp
      have hpU : p ∈ U := by
        exact (Scheme.mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff D p).2 <| by
          simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hp
      let pU : U := ⟨p, hpU⟩
      by_cases hpA : pU ∈ A
      · exact Or.inl ⟨pU, hpA, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨pU, hpA, rfl⟩
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint A₀ B₀ := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro p hpA hpB
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hpA
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := hpB
    have hab' : a = b := Subtype.ext hab.symm
    exact hb (hab' ▸ ha)
  have hAnonempty : A₀.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hAne
    exact ⟨a.1, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩⟩
  have hBnonempty : B₀.Nonempty := by
    have hB : B.Nonempty := by
      dsimp only [B]
      exact Set.nonempty_compl.mpr hAuniv
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hB
    exact ⟨b.1, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩⟩
  exact
    exists_radical_nonmaximal_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
      hdim x hx hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_not_connectedSpace
statement:
theorem exists_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_not_connectedSpace
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ¬ ConnectedSpace
        (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) →
      ∃ a b : Ideal C,
        Ideal.span {x} ≤ a ∧ Ideal.span {x} ≤ b ∧
        a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
        a ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ b ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
        a ⊓ b = (Ideal.span {x}).radical ∧
        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro hnot
  obtain ⟨a, b, hxa, hxb, ha, hb, hamax, hbmax, _haRadical,
      _hbRadical, hinf, hradical⟩ :=
    exists_radical_nonmaximal_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_not_connectedSpace
      hdim x hx hnot
  exact ⟨a, b, hxa, hxb, ha, hb, hamax, hbmax, hinf, hradical⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_pullback_isEquivalence_of_complete_quotient
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_pullback_isEquivalence_of_complete_quotient
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))).IsEquivalence
proof:
:= by
  let F := AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))
  let B := CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange.{u} R (R ⧸ I)
  let E := AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.affineEquivalence
    (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ I))
  let : B.IsEquivalence :=
    finiteEtale_baseChange_isEquivalence_of_le_maximalIdeal I hI
  have :
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.affineEquivalence
          (CommRingCat.of R)).functor ⋙ B).IsEquivalence := inferInstance
  have : (F.op ⋙ E.functor).IsEquivalence :=
    Functor.isEquivalence_of_iso
      (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.affineEquivalenceCompBaseChangeIso
        R (R ⧸ I))
  have : F.op.IsEquivalence :=
    Functor.isEquivalence_of_comp_right F.op E.functor
  have : F.op.unop.IsEquivalence :=
    F.op.asEquivalence.unop.isEquivalence_functor
  exact Functor.isEquivalence_of_iso (Functor.opUnopIso F)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.genericExtensionMorphism_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem genericExtensionMorphism_functionFieldMap
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : DenseRange f) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (f.functionFieldMap hf)) ≫
        X.genericExtensionMorphism X.functionField =
      Y.genericExtensionMorphism Y.functionField ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  let h : f (genericPoint Y) = genericPoint X :=
    f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hf
  unfold Scheme.genericExtensionMorphism
  rw [show CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap X.functionField X.functionField) = 𝟙 _ by rfl]
  rw [show CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap Y.functionField Y.functionField) = 𝟙 _ by rfl]
  rw [Spec.map_id, Spec.map_id, Category.id_comp, Category.id_comp]
  unfold Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap
  rw [show CommRingCat.ofHom
      (CommRingCat.Hom.hom
        (eqToHom _ ≫ f.stalkMap (genericPoint Y))) =
      eqToHom _ ≫ f.stalkMap (genericPoint Y) by rfl]
  rw [Spec.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr]
  all_goals try exact h.symm
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom]
  exact (congrArg (fun k => Spec.map (f.stalkMap (genericPoint Y)) ≫ k)
    (Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk (X := X) (specializes_of_eq h))).trans
      (Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk f (x := genericPoint Y))

theorem normalizationSourceIsoOfEq_hom_fromNormalization

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isConnected_of_pullback_isConnected_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem isConnected_of_pullback_isConnected_of_isOpenImmersion
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] [Nonempty U]
    (Z : FiniteEtale X)
    (hP : IsConnected ((pullback j).obj Z)) : IsConnected Z
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let P : FiniteEtale U := (pullback j).obj Z
  let : IsConnected P := hP
  let : ConnectedSpace P.left :=
    connectedSpace_left_of_isConnected P
  let hjDense : DenseRange j :=
    j.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.denseRange_of_isPreirreducibleSpace j
  let : IsDominant j := ⟨hjDense⟩
  let hstd : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant j :=
    IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isDominant j
  let hjqc : QuasiCompact j := inferInstance
  let iP : P.left ⟶ Z.left := pullback.fst Z.hom j
  let hflat : Flat Z.hom :=
    Etale.iff_flat_and_formallyUnramified.mp Z.prop.toEtale |>.1
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant iP := by
    dsimp only [iP]
    exact @IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.pullbackFst _ _ _
      Z.hom j hstd hjqc hflat
  let : QuasiCompact iP := by
    dsimp only [iP]
    have hbase : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange (C := Scheme.{u})
        (fun {_ _} f => QuasiCompact f) := quasiCompact_isStableUnderBaseChange
    exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
      (P := fun {_ _ : Scheme.{u}} f => QuasiCompact f)
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback Z.hom j).flip hjqc
  let : PreconnectedSpace Z.left :=
    iP.denseRange.preconnectedSpace iP.continuous
  let : ConnectedSpace Z.left :=
    { toNonempty := Nonempty.map iP (inferInstance : Nonempty P.left) }
  exact FiniteEtale.isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left Z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.normalization_isFiniteEtale_of_sourceIso_connectedCover
statement:
theorem normalization_isFiniteEtale_of_sourceIso_connectedCover
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Z] [IsIntegral Z.left]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (eSource : Y ≅ Spec (.of Z.left.functionField))
    (hSource : eSource.hom ≫ connectedCoverGenericComposite Z = f) :
    IsFiniteEtale f.fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  let fZ : Spec (.of Z.left.functionField) ⟶ X :=
    connectedCoverGenericComposite Z
  let eNormalization : f.normalization ≅ fZ.normalization :=
    normalizationSourceIsoOfEq eSource fZ f hSource
  let eZ : fZ.normalization ≅ Z.left :=
    connectedCoverGenericNormalizationIso Z
  let eTotal : f.normalization ≅ Z.left := eNormalization ≪≫ eZ
  have hNormalization :
      eNormalization.hom ≫ fZ.fromNormalization = f.fromNormalization :=
    normalizationSourceIsoOfEq_hom_fromNormalization
      eSource fZ f hSource
  have hInv : eZ.inv ≫ fZ.fromNormalization = Z.hom := by
    dsimp only [eZ, fZ]
    exact connectedCoverGenericNormalizationIso_inv_fromNormalization Z
  have hZ : eZ.hom ≫ Z.hom = fZ.fromNormalization := by
    calc
      eZ.hom ≫ Z.hom =
          eZ.hom ≫ (eZ.inv ≫ fZ.fromNormalization) := by
        exact congrArg (fun k ↦ eZ.hom ≫ k) hInv.symm
      _ = fZ.fromNormalization := Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _
  have hTotal : eTotal.hom ≫ Z.hom = f.fromNormalization := by
    calc
      eTotal.hom ≫ Z.hom =
          eNormalization.hom ≫ (eZ.hom ≫ Z.hom) := by
        change (eNormalization.hom ≫ eZ.hom) ≫ Z.hom = _
        exact Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = eNormalization.hom ≫ fZ.fromNormalization := by
        exact congrArg (fun k ↦ eNormalization.hom ≫ k) hZ
      _ = f.fromNormalization := hNormalization
  have hFiniteEtale : IsFiniteEtale (eTotal.hom ≫ Z.hom) := by
    let : IsFiniteEtale Z.hom := Z.prop
    let : IsFiniteEtale eTotal.hom := by constructor
    infer_instance
  rw [hTotal] at hFiniteEtale
  exact hFiniteEtale

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedCoverGenericNormalization_isFiniteEtale_of_extension
statement:
theorem connectedCoverGenericNormalization_isFiniteEtale_of_extension
    {X U : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsIntegral U] [IsNormalIntegral U] [IsLocallyNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (W : FiniteEtale U) [IsConnected W]
    (Z : FiniteEtale X) (e : (pullback j).obj Z ≅ W) :
    IsFiniteEtale
      (connectedCoverGenericComposite W ≫ j).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  let P : FiniteEtale U := (pullback j).obj Z
  let pHom : P.left ⟶ U := P.hom
  let wHom : W.left ⟶ U := W.hom
  let zHom : Z.left ⟶ X := Z.hom
  let : IsConnected P := isConnected_of_iso_to_isConnected P W e
  let : IsConnected Z :=
    isConnected_of_pullback_isConnected_of_isOpenImmersion j Z inferInstance
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : IsIntegral Z.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  let iP : P.left ⟶ Z.left := pullback.fst Z.hom j
  let : IsOpenImmersion iP := by
    dsimp only [iP]
    exact MorphismProperty.pullback_fst (P := @IsOpenImmersion)
      Z.hom j (show IsOpenImmersion j from inferInstance)
  let heInvHom : IsIso e.inv.hom :=
    (FiniteEtale.forget U).map_isIso e.inv
  let heInvLeft : IsIso e.inv.left :=
    @Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ (Over.forget U) e.inv.hom heInvHom
  let g : W.left ⟶ Z.left := e.inv.left ≫ iP
  let : IsOpenImmersion g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    exact MorphismProperty.comp_mem @IsOpenImmersion
      e.inv.left iP inferInstance inferInstance
  let hg : DenseRange g :=
    g.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.denseRange_of_isPreirreducibleSpace g
  let q : CommRingCat.of Z.left.functionField ⟶
      CommRingCat.of W.left.functionField :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom (g.functionFieldMap hg)
  have hqBijective : Function.Bijective q := by
    change Function.Bijective (g.functionFieldMap hg)
    simpa only using g.functionFieldMap_bijective_of_isOpenImmersion
  let : IsIso q :=
    (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective q).mpr hqBijective
  let eSource : Spec (.of W.left.functionField) ≅
      Spec (.of Z.left.functionField) := asIso (Spec.map q)
  have hgeneric :
      eSource.hom ≫ connectedCoverGenericMorphism Z =
        connectedCoverGenericMorphism W ≫ g := by
    dsimp only [eSource, q, asIso_hom, connectedCoverGenericMorphism]
    exact genericExtensionMorphism_functionFieldMap g hg
  have hP_hom : pHom = pullback.snd Z.hom j := by
    dsimp only [pHom, P, FiniteEtale.pullback]
    rfl
  have hebase : e.inv.left ≫ pHom = wHom := by
    dsimp only [pHom, wHom, P]
    exact e.inv.hom.w
  have hiPbase : iP ≫ zHom = pHom ≫ j := by
    dsimp only [zHom, iP]
    have hcondition : pullback.fst Z.hom j ≫ Z.hom =
        pullback.snd Z.hom j ≫ j := pullback.condition
    have hhomcomp : pHom ≫ j = pullback.snd Z.hom j ≫ j :=
      congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ j) hP_hom
    exact hcondition.trans hhomcomp.symm
  have hgbase : g ≫ zHom = wHom ≫ j := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [Category.assoc, hiPbase, ← Category.assoc, hebase]
  let fZ : Spec (.of Z.left.functionField) ⟶ X :=
    connectedCoverGenericComposite Z
  let fW : Spec (.of W.left.functionField) ⟶ X :=
    connectedCoverGenericComposite W ≫ j
  have hSource : eSource.hom ≫ fZ = fW := by
    change eSource.hom ≫ (connectedCoverGenericMorphism Z ≫ zHom) =
      (connectedCoverGenericMorphism W ≫ wHom) ≫ j
    rw [← Category.assoc, hgeneric, Category.assoc, hgbase,
      ← Category.assoc]
  exact normalization_isFiniteEtale_of_sourceIso_connectedCover
    Z fW eSource hSource

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCoverGenericNormalization_isFiniteEtale_of_hasPuncturedPurity
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCoverGenericNormalization_isFiniteEtale_of_hasPuncturedPurity
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsIntegral (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)]
    (hpurity : HasPuncturedPurity R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    IsFiniteEtale
      (connectedCoverGenericComposite W ≫
        Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨Z, ⟨e⟩⟩ := (hasPuncturedPurity_iff R).mp hpurity W
  exact connectedCoverGenericNormalization_isFiniteEtale_of_extension
    j W Z e

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.span_singleton_mul_ofList
statement:
theorem span_singleton_mul_ofList
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (x : R) (xs : List R) :
    Ideal.span {x} * Ideal.ofList xs =
      Ideal.ofList (xs.map fun y ↦ x * y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Ideal.ofList
  rw [Ideal.span_mul_span, Set.singleton_mul]
  congr 1
  ext z
  exact List.mem_map.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_bot_isZero
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_bot_isZero
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (⊥ : Ideal R) M i)
proof:
:= by
  apply derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_quotientPowers_hasProjectiveDimensionLT
    (⊥ : Ideal R) M 1 i hi
  intro n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
    let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ (⊤ : Ideal R))
    have hN : IsZero N := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton N
    let : HasProjectiveDimensionLT N 0 :=
      hN.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge N 0 1 (by omega)
  · rw [pow_succ, Ideal.mul_bot]
    let F : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R R
    have hF : projectiveDimension F = 0 :=
      ModuleCat.projectiveDimension_eq_zero_of_projective F
    let : HasProjectiveDimensionLT F 1 := by
      rw [← projectiveDimension_lt_iff, hF]
      norm_num
    let e : (R ⧸ (⊥ : Ideal R)) ≃ₗ[R] R :=
      Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot (⊥ : Ideal R) rfl
    exact ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_linearEquiv
      (M := F) (N := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ (⊥ : Ideal R))) e.symm 0

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_top_isZero
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_top_isZero
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (⊤ : Ideal R) M i)
proof:
:= by
  apply derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_quotientPowers_hasProjectiveDimensionLT
    (⊤ : Ideal R) M 0 i (Nat.zero_le i)
  intro n
  rw [← Ideal.one_eq_top, one_pow, Ideal.one_eq_top]
  let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ (⊤ : Ideal R))
  have hN : IsZero N := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton N
  exact hN.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_ofList_isZero_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_ofList_isZero_of_isDomain
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (xs : List R)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) (hi : xs.length < i) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (Ideal.ofList xs) M i)
proof:
:= by
  induction hlen : xs.length using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing xs i with
  | _ n ih =>
    cases xs with
    | nil =>
        simpa only [Ideal.ofList_nil] using
          derivedLocalCohomology_bot_isZero M i (by omega)
    | cons x xs =>
        have htailLength : xs.length < n := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
          omega
        by_cases hxmem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R
        · by_cases hx0 : x = 0
          · subst x
            have hzero := ih xs.length htailLength xs i (by
                simp only [List.length_cons] at hi
                omega) rfl
            simpa only [Ideal.ofList_cons, Set.singleton_zero,
              Ideal.span_zero, bot_sup_eq] using hzero
          · let J : Ideal R := Ideal.ofList xs
            let products : List R := xs.map fun y ↦ x * y
            have hInfRadical :
                (Ideal.span {x} ⊓ J).radical =
                  (Ideal.ofList products).radical := by
              calc
                (Ideal.span {x} ⊓ J).radical =
                    (Ideal.span {x}).radical ⊓ J.radical :=
                  Ideal.radical_inf _ _
                _ = (Ideal.span {x} * J).radical :=
                  (Ideal.radical_mul _ _).symm
                _ = (Ideal.ofList products).radical := by
                  rw [span_singleton_mul_ofList]
            have hproductsLength : products.length < n := by
              simpa only [products, List.length_map] using htailLength
            have hInfProducts :
                IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology
                  (Ideal.ofList products) M (i - 1)) :=
              ih products.length hproductsLength products (i - 1) (by
                simp only [products, List.length_map, List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
                omega) rfl
            have hInf :
                IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology
                  (Ideal.span {x} ⊓ J) M (i - 1)) :=
              hInfProducts.of_iso
                (derivedLocalCohomologyIsoOfSameRadical
                  hInfRadical M (i - 1))
            have hPrincipal :
                IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (Ideal.span {x}) M i) :=
              derivedLocalCohomology_span_singleton_isZero_of_isSMulRegular
                x (IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero hx0) hxmem M i (by
                  simp only [List.length_cons] at hi
                  omega)
            have hTail :
                IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology J M i) := by
              dsimp only [J]
              exact ih xs.length htailLength xs i (by
                simp only [List.length_cons] at hi
                omega) rfl
            rw [Ideal.ofList_cons]
            exact derivedLocalCohomology_sup_isZero_of_mayerVietoris
              (Ideal.span {x}) J M (i - 1) i (by
                simp only [List.length_cons] at hi
                omega)
                hInf hPrincipal hTail
        · have hxunit : IsUnit x := by
            by_contra hxunit
            exact hxmem ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal x).2 hxunit)
          have htop : Ideal.ofList (x :: xs) = ⊤ := by
            rw [Ideal.ofList_cons,
              Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hxunit, top_sup_eq]
          rw [htop]
          exact derivedLocalCohomology_top_isZero M i

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localCohomology_isZero_of_subsingleton_ext_powers
statement:
theorem localCohomology_isZero_of_subsingleton_ext_powers
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ)
    (hExt : ∀ n : ℕ, Subsingleton
      (((_root_.Ext R (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj
        (op (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)))).obj M)) :
    IsZero ((localCohomology I i).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let F := localCohomology.diagram (localCohomology.idealPowersDiagram I) i
  let D := F ⋙ (evaluation (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M
  have hD : IsZero D := Functor.isZero D fun n ↦ by
    let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ unop (unop n))
    let : Subsingleton
        (((_root_.Ext R (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj (op N)).obj M) :=
      hExt (unop (unop n))
    change IsZero (((_root_.Ext R (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj (op N)).obj M)
    exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
  have hcolimit : IsZero (colimit D) :=
    (colimit.isColimit D).isZero_pt hD
  change IsZero ((colimit F).obj M)
  exact hcolimit.of_iso <| colimitObjIsoColimitCompEvaluation F M

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_add
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_add
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) (a b : R) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i (a + b) =
      derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a +
        derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i b
proof:
:= by
  apply colimit.hom_ext (F := derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
  rintro ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
  ext α
  let ι : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i →+ derivedLocalCohomology I M i :=
    (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i) (op (op n))).hom
  change CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i at α
  change
    derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i (a + b)
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
          (op (op n)) α) =
      derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a
          (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
            (op (op n)) α) +
        derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i b
          (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
            (op (op n)) α)
  exact (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i (a + b) n α).trans
    ((congrArg ι
      (add_smul a b α)).trans
        ((map_add ι
          (a • α) (b • α)).trans
            (congrArg₂ (fun x y : derivedLocalCohomology I M i => x + y)
              (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i a n α).symm
              (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i b n α).symm)))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_zero
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_zero
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply colimit.hom_ext (F := derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
  rintro ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
  ext α
  let ι : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i →+ derivedLocalCohomology I M i :=
    (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i) (op (op n))).hom
  change CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i at α
  change
    derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i 0
      (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
        (op (op n)) α) = 0
  exact (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i 0 n α).trans
    ((congrArg ι
      (zero_smul R α)).trans
        (map_zero ι))

theorem idealQuotientMayerVietorisHom_refl (I J : Ideal R) :

      𝟙 (idealQuotientMayerVietorisShortComplex I J)

  · change ModuleCat.ofHom (idealQuotientMapOfLE (le_refl (I ⊓ J))) =
      𝟙 (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ (I ⊓ J)))
    rw [idealQuotientMapOfLE_refl, ModuleCat.ofHom_id]
  · change ModuleCat.ofHom (idealQuotientMayerVietorisProductMap (le_refl I) (le_refl J)) =
      𝟙 (ModuleCat.of R ((R ⧸ I) × (R ⧸ J)))
    simp only [idealQuotientMayerVietorisProductMap, idealQuotientMapOfLE_refl,
      LinearMap.prodMap_id, ModuleCat.ofHom_id]
  · change ModuleCat.ofHom (idealQuotientMapOfLE (le_refl (I ⊔ J))) =

theorem idealQuotientMayerVietorisHom_comp
    {I₀ J₀ I₁ J₁ I₂ J₂ : Ideal R}
    (hI₀₁ : I₀ ≤ I₁) (hJ₀₁ : J₀ ≤ J₁)
    (hI₁₂ : I₁ ≤ I₂) (hJ₁₂ : J₁ ≤ J₂) :
    idealQuotientMayerVietorisHom hI₀₁ hJ₀₁ ≫
        idealQuotientMayerVietorisHom hI₁₂ hJ₁₂ =
      idealQuotientMayerVietorisHom (hI₀₁.trans hI₁₂)
        (hJ₀₁.trans hJ₁₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply ShortComplex.hom_ext
  · change ModuleCat.ofHom _ ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom _ = ModuleCat.ofHom _
    rw [← ModuleCat.ofHom_comp, idealQuotientMapOfLE_comp]
  · change ModuleCat.ofHom _ ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom _ = ModuleCat.ofHom _
    rw [← ModuleCat.ofHom_comp]
    apply congrArg ModuleCat.ofHom
    unfold idealQuotientMayerVietorisProductMap
    rw [LinearMap.prodMap_comp, idealQuotientMapOfLE_comp,
      idealQuotientMapOfLE_comp]
  · change ModuleCat.ofHom _ ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom _ = ModuleCat.ofHom _
    rw [← ModuleCat.ofHom_comp, idealQuotientMapOfLE_comp]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_completeLocalDomain_of_radical_ne
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_completeLocalDomain_of_radical_ne
    [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) (hIradical : I.radical ≠ maximalIdeal R)
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I (ModuleCat.of R R) (d + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, i, hi, hess, hEinj⟩ :=
    exists_module_injective_hull (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R))
  let : Module.Injective R E := hEinj
  obtain ⟨xs, hlen, hrad⟩ :=
    exists_ofList_radical_eq_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq (d + 1) hdim
  let C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ := cechLocalizationComplex xs
  let D : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ := linearDualComplex E C
  let eH (n : ℕ) : D.homology n ≃ₗ[R]
      (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) n →ₗ[R] E) :=
    (injectiveLinearDualComplexHomologyIso E C n).toLinearEquiv.trans
      (LinearEquiv.arrowCongr (cechRingMaximalLocalCohomologyLinearEquiv xs hrad n)
        (LinearEquiv.refl R E))
  have hzero (m : ℕ) : IsZero
      ((((tensorLeft (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ maximalIdealSaturatedPower I m))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj C).homology 0) := by
    let M : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ maximalIdealSaturatedPower I m)
    let e := cechMaximalLocalCohomologyLinearEquiv xs hrad M 0
    let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M 0) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
        (derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_saturatedPower_quotient_zero I m)
    apply ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
    exact ⟨fun z w => e.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  have hΓ : Function.Surjective ((idealPowerTorsionFunctor I).map (D.d 1 0)) :=
    idealPowerTorsion_dual_d_surjective_of_tensor_zero I (maximalIdealSaturatedPower I)
      (exists_maximalIdealSaturatedPower_le_pow I hI hIradical)
      (fun m => ⟨m, pow_le_maximalIdealSaturatedPower I m⟩) E C hzero
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hann⟩ := exists_ne_zero_annihilator_lower_linearMap_localCohomology
    i hi hess (ModuleCat.of R R) (d + 1) hdim.ge
  have hzabove : IsZero (D.X (d + 1 + 1)) := by
    have hC : IsZero (C.X (d + 1 + 1)) :=
      cechLocalizationComplex_isZero_X xs (d + 1 + 1) (by rw [hlen]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _)
    change IsZero (ModuleCat.of R (C.X (d + 1 + 1) ⟶ E))
    exact ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr ⟨fun f g => hC.eq_of_src f g⟩
  let Z : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (linearChainCycles D (d + 1))
  let T : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R
    (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) (d + 1) →ₗ[R] E)
  let eZ : Z ≃ₗ[R] T :=
    (linearChainTopHomologyIso D (d + 1) hzabove).symm.toLinearEquiv.trans (eH (d + 1))
  let : Module.Finite R T :=
    finite_linearMap_localCohomology_maximalIdeal i hi hess (ModuleCat.of R R) (d + 1)
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree R T := isTorsionFree_linearMap_topLocalCohomology E d hdim
  let : Nontrivial T := nontrivial_linearMap_topLocalCohomology i hi (d + 1) hdim
  let : Module.Finite R Z := Module.Finite.equiv eZ.symm
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree R Z :=
    Function.Injective.moduleIsTorsionFree eZ eZ.injective (fun r z => eZ.map_smul r z)
  let : Nontrivial Z := eZ.symm.injective.nontrivial
  let (j : ℕ) : Module.Injective R (D.X j) := by
    let : Module.Flat R (C.X j) := cechLocalizationComplex_flat_X xs j
    exact injective_linearDualComplex_X E C j
  have hZann (z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I Z (d + 1)) : a ^ d • z = 0 := by
    apply linearChainCycles_localCohomology_pow_smul_eq_zero I D hΓ a d
    intro j hj h
    apply (eH (j + 1)).injective
    rw [map_smul, map_zero]
    exact hann (j + 1) (Nat.add_lt_add_right hj 1) (eH (j + 1) h)
  have hZ : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I Z (d + 1)) :=
    derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_finite_torsionFree_annihilator
      I Z (d + 1) hdim (a ^ d) (pow_ne_zero d ha) hZann
  exact derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_ring_of_finite_torsionFree I Z (d + 1) hdim hZ

theorem isLocalHom_of_isIntegral_between_localRings
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.IsIntegral) : IsLocalHom f
proof:
:= by

    let : (maximalIdeal B).IsMaximal := maximalIdeal.isMaximal B
    exact Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal f hf
      (maximalIdeal B)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.preimage_puncturedSpectrumOpen_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem preimage_puncturedSpectrumOpen_of_isIntegral
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (hf : f.IsIntegral) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f) ⁻¹ᵁ puncturedSpectrumOpen A =
      puncturedSpectrumOpen B
proof:
:= by
  let : IsLocalHom f :=
    isLocalHom_of_isIntegral_between_localRings f hf
  let q : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
  have hqClosed : q (closedPoint (CommRingCat.of B)) =
      closedPoint (CommRingCat.of A) := Spec_closedPoint
  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
  apply Set.ext
  intro p
  change q p ∈ puncturedSpectrumOpen A ↔
    p ∈ puncturedSpectrumOpen B
  change q p ≠ closedPoint (CommRingCat.of A) ↔
    p ≠ closedPoint (CommRingCat.of B)
  constructor
  · intro hp hclosed
    exact hp (hclosed.symm ▸ hqClosed)
  · intro hp hclosed
    apply hp
    have hcomap : p.asIdeal.comap f = maximalIdeal A := by
      exact PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff.mp hclosed
    let : p.asIdeal.IsPrime := p.isPrime
    have hpMax : p.asIdeal.IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap f hf p.asIdeal <| by
        rw [hcomap]
        exact maximalIdeal.isMaximal A
    exact PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff.mpr <|
      (maximal_ideal_unique B).unique hpMax (maximalIdeal.isMaximal B)

statement:
private theorem puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquiv_apply_germ_source_forFiber
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (r : Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤)) :
    let X
proof:
:= Spec (.of R)
    let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
    let : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
      dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
    let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
    let : Algebra R X.functionField :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
    let : Nonempty (⊤ : U.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint U, by trivial⟩⟩
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquivOfPositiveDimension R hpos
        (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r) =
      U.germToFunctionField ⊤ (j.appTop r) := by
  intro X U j hU hj hIntegralU hXtop algebraR_X hUtop
  let hgen : j (genericPoint U) = genericPoint X :=
    genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion j
  change j.stalkMap (genericPoint U)
      ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hgen.symm)).hom
        (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r)) =
    U.germToFunctionField ⊤ (j.appTop r)
  simp only [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom]
  have htransport :
      X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
          (Inseparable.of_eq hgen.symm).ge
          (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial) r) =
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (j (genericPoint U)) (by trivial) r := by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun
      (CommRingCat.hom_ext_iff.mp
        (X.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes
          (show genericPoint X ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) by trivial)
          (Inseparable.of_eq hgen.symm).ge)) r
  rw [htransport]
  exact j.germ_stalkMap_apply (⊤ : X.Opens) (genericPoint U)
    (by trivial) r
