name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedSpace_connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiber_ofList
statement:
theorem connectedSpace_connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiber_ofList
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (xs : List R)
    (hI : Ideal.ofList xs ≤ maximalIdeal R)
    (hdim :
      ((((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    let hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
      have hbase : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
          (((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ xs.length + 2)
      exact hbase.trans hdim
    ConnectedSpace
      (connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiber R hpos W
        (Ideal.ofList xs) hI) := by
  intro hpos
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : Algebra R U.functionField :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let C : Type u := integralClosure R L
  let f : R →+* C := algebraMap R C
  let xsC : List C := xs.map f
  let J : Ideal C := (Ideal.ofList xs).map f
  let Q : Type u := C ⧸ J
  let : Module.Finite R C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_finite_of_positiveDimension
      R hpos W
  let : IsNoetherianRing C := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R C
  let : IsLocalRing C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isLocalRing (R := R) hpos W
  let : IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal C) C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal
      (R := R) hpos W
  let : IsLocalHom f :=
    Scheme.isLocalHom_of_isIntegral_between_localRings
      f (algebraMap_isIntegral_iff.mpr inferInstance)
  have hJ : J ≤ maximalIdeal C :=
    (Ideal.map_mono hI).trans (map_maximalIdeal_le f)
  have hJgen : J = Ideal.ofList xsC := by
    dsimp only [J, xsC, f]
    rw [Ideal.map_ofList]
  have hdimC :
      ((((xsC.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ringKrullDim C) := by
    rw [connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_ringKrullDim_eq
      (R := R) hpos W]
    simpa only [xsC, List.length_map] using hdim
  let : Nontrivial Q := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hJ
  let : IsLocalRing Q :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : ConnectedSpace (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum Q) :=
    connectedSpace_puncturedSpectrum_quotient_ofList_of_completeLocalDomain
      J hJ xsC hJgen hdimC
  let e :=
    connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiberIsoPuncturedSpectrumQuotient
      R hpos W (Ideal.ofList xs) hI
  exact e.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedSpace_connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiber_span_singleton
statement:
theorem connectedSpace_connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiber_span_singleton
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W]
    (x : R) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    let hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
      exact (by norm_num : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ (3 : ℕ∞)).trans hdim
    ConnectedSpace
      (connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiber R hpos W
        (Ideal.span {x})
        ((maximalIdeal R).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx)) := by
  intro hpos
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : Algebra R U.functionField :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let C : Type u := integralClosure R L
  let xC : C := algebraMap R C x
  let Q : Type u := C ⧸ Ideal.span {xC}
  let : Module.Finite R C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_finite_of_positiveDimension
      R hpos W
  let : IsNoetherianRing C := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R C
  let : IsLocalRing C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isLocalRing (R := R) hpos W
  let : IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal C) C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal
      (R := R) hpos W
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R C) :=
    Scheme.isLocalHom_of_isIntegral_between_localRings
      (algebraMap R C) (algebraMap_isIntegral_iff.mpr inferInstance)
  have hdimC : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C := by
    rw [connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_ringKrullDim_eq
      (R := R) hpos W]
    exact hdim
  have hxC : xC ∈ maximalIdeal C := by
    exact map_nonunit (algebraMap R C) x hx
  have hxC0 : xC ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hx0
    apply algebraMap_injective_of_field_isFractionRing
      (R := R) (S := C) U.functionField L
    simpa only [map_zero] using hzero
  have hJne : Ideal.span {xC} ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
      (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hxC
  let : Nontrivial Q := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hJne
  let : IsLocalRing Q :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {xC}))
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : ConnectedSpace (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum Q) :=
    connectedSpace_puncturedSpectrum_quotient_span_singleton_of_completeLocalDomain
      hdimC xC hxC hxC0
  let e :=
    connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiberIsoSpanSingleton
      R hpos W x hx
  exact e.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechHomologyZero_range_injective
statement:
private theorem cechHomologyZero_range_injective
    (xs : List R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] :
    LinearMap.range (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M).hom =
      Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs)
proof:
:= by
  let T := ModuleCat.of R (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs))
  let S := (CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj T
  let K := cechCoefficients xs M
  let e : HomotopyEquiv K S := cechInjectiveHomotopyEquiv xs M
  let b : K.homology 0 ⟶ M := cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M
  let h : T ≅ K.homology 0 :=
    (singleObjHomologySelfIso (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 T).symm ≪≫
      (e.toHomologyIso 0).symm
  have hinc : e.inv.f 0 ≫ (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs M).hom =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs)).subtype :=
    cechInjectiveHomotopyEquiv_inv_f_zero xs M
  have heval : h.hom ≫ b =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs)).subtype := by
    change (singleObjHomologySelfIso (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 T).inv ≫
      homologyMap e.inv 0 ≫ (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ K).inv ≫
        K.iCycles 0 ≫ (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs M).hom = _
    rw [CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀_inv_naturality_assoc, cyclesMap_i_assoc, hinc]
    change ((singleObjCyclesSelfIso (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 T).inv ≫
      (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ S).hom) ≫ (CochainComplex.isoHomologyπ₀ S).inv ≫
        S.iCycles 0 ≫ _ = _
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    calc
      _ = ((singleObjCyclesSelfIso (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 T).inv ≫ S.iCycles 0) ≫
          ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs)).subtype :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 T).inv ≫
          ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs)).subtype :=
        congrArg (fun f : T ⟶ S.X 0 => f ≫
          ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs)).subtype)
          (singleObjCyclesSelfIso_inv_iCycles (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 T)
      _ = _ := Category.id_comp _
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := h.toLinearEquiv.surjective w
    have he : b (h.hom t) = (t : M) := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom heval t
    change b (h.hom t) ∈ _
    exact he.symm ▸ t.property
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨h.hom ⟨z, hz⟩, ?_⟩
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom heval ⟨z, hz⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechHomologyZeroToModule_range
statement:
theorem cechHomologyZeroToModule_range (xs : List R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    LinearMap.range (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M).hom =
      Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs)
proof:
:= by
  let E : ModuleCat.{u} R := Injective.under M
  let u : M ⟶ E := Injective.ι M
  have hu : Function.Injective u :=
    (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective u).mp inferInstance
  let : Module.Injective R E :=
    (Module.injective_iff_injective_object R E).mpr
      (inferInstance : CategoryTheory.Injective E)
  let C := tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor (cechLocalizationComplex xs)
  let S := injectivePresentationShortComplex u.hom
  have hS : S.ShortExact := injectivePresentationShortComplex_shortExact u.hom hu
  let (n : ℕ) : Module.Flat R ((cechLocalizationComplex xs).X n) :=
    cechLocalizationComplex_flat_X xs n
  have hCS := tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor_shortExact (cechLocalizationComplex xs) hS
  have hexact : Function.Exact (homologyMap (C.map S.f) 0).hom
      (homologyMap (C.map S.g) 0).hom :=
    (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp (hCS.homology_exact₂ 0)
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    have hE : u ((cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M) w) ∈
        Ideal.primaryComponent E (Ideal.ofList xs) := by
      rw [← cechHomologyZero_range_injective xs E]
      exact ⟨homologyMap (C.map u) 0 w,
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (cechHomologyZeroToModule_naturality xs u) w⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := E)
      (I := Ideal.ofList xs) (u ((cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M) w))).mp hE
    apply (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := M) (I := Ideal.ofList xs) _).mpr
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff]
    intro a
    apply hu
    rw [map_smul, map_zero]
    exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (R := R) (M := E)
      (s := (((Ideal.ofList xs) ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R))
      (u ((cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M) w))).mp hn a
  · intro hz
    have hzE : u z ∈ LinearMap.range (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs E).hom := by
      rw [cechHomologyZero_range_injective xs E]
      exact Ideal.primaryComponent_map_mem (Ideal.ofList xs) u.hom ⟨z, hz⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hzE
    have hzero : homologyMap (C.map S.g) 0 w = 0 := by
      apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs S.X₃)).mp inferInstance
      calc
        (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs S.X₃) (homologyMap (C.map S.g) 0 w) =
            S.g ((cechHomologyZeroToModule xs E) w) :=
          ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (cechHomologyZeroToModule_naturality xs S.g) w
        _ = S.g (u z) := congrArg S.g hw
        _ = 0 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom S.zero z
        _ = (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs S.X₃) 0 :=
          (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs S.X₃).hom.map_zero.symm
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (hexact w).mp hzero
    refine ⟨v, hu ?_⟩
    calc
      u ((cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M) v) =
          (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs E) (homologyMap (C.map u) 0 v) :=
        (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (cechHomologyZeroToModule_naturality xs u) v).symm
      _ = (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs E) w := congrArg (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs E) hv
      _ = u z := hw

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv_eval
statement:
private theorem cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv_eval (xs : List R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (z : (cechCoefficients xs M).homology 0) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule (Ideal.ofList xs) M
      (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv xs M z) = (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M) z
proof:
:= by
  let e := derivedLocalCohomologyZeroEquivPrimaryComponent (Ideal.ofList xs) M
  calc
    derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule (Ideal.ofList xs) M
        (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv xs M z) =
      (e (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv xs M z) : M) :=
        (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroEquivPrimaryComponent_apply_val
          (Ideal.ofList xs) M _).symm
    _ = (cechHomologyZeroEquivPrimaryComponent xs M z : M) :=
      congrArg (fun t : Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs) => (t : M))
        (e.apply_symm_apply (cechHomologyZeroEquivPrimaryComponent xs M z))
    _ = (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs M) z := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv_secondMap
statement:
private theorem cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv_secondMap
    (xs : List R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv xs S.X₃).toLinearMap.comp
      (homologyMap ((tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor (cechLocalizationComplex xs)).map S.g) 0).hom =
      (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap (Ideal.ofList xs) hS 0).comp
        (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv xs S.X₂).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_injective (Ideal.ofList xs) S.X₃
  calc
    derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule (Ideal.ofList xs) S.X₃
        (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv xs S.X₃
          (homologyMap
            ((tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor (cechLocalizationComplex xs)).map S.g) 0 z)) =
      (cechHomologyZeroToModule xs S.X₃)
        (homologyMap
          ((tensorComplexCoefficientFunctor (cechLocalizationComplex xs)).map S.g) 0 z) :=
      cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv_eval xs S.X₃ _
    _ = S.g ((cechHomologyZeroToModule xs S.X₂) z) :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (cechHomologyZeroToModule_naturality xs S.g) z
    _ = S.g (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule (Ideal.ofList xs) S.X₂
        (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv xs S.X₂ z)) :=
      congrArg S.g (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv_eval xs S.X₂ z).symm
    _ = derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule (Ideal.ofList xs) S.X₃
        (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap (Ideal.ofList xs) hS 0
          (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv xs S.X₂ z)) :=
      (DFunLike.congr_fun (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_comp_secondMap
        (Ideal.ofList xs) hS) (cechLocalCohomologyZeroEquiv xs S.X₂ z)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechCoefficients_isZero_homology_succ
statement:
private theorem cechCoefficients_isZero_homology_succ
    (xs : List R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero ((cechCoefficients xs M).homology (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  IsZero.of_iso
    (isZero_single_obj_homology (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0
      (ModuleCat.of R (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs))) (n + 1) (by omega))
    ((cechInjectiveHomotopyEquiv xs M).toHomologyIso (n + 1))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.maximalIdeal_pow_quotient_artinian
statement:
private theorem maximalIdeal_pow_quotient_artinian (k : ℕ) :
    IsArtinianRing (C ⧸ maximalIdeal C ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
      infer_instance
  | succ k =>
      apply IsLocalRing.quotient_artinian_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing
      rw [← Ideal.radical_minimalPrimes,
        (maximalIdeal C).radical_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero k),
        (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).isPrime.isRadical.radical,
        Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_subsingleton_self]
      exact Set.mem_singleton (maximalIdeal C)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_eq_iInf_sup_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem exists_eq_iInf_sup_maximalIdeal_pow
    (J : ℕ → Ideal C) (hJ : Antitone J) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, J N ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ k =
      ⨅ n : ℕ, J n ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ k
proof:
:= by
  let : IsArtinianRing (C ⧸ maximalIdeal C ^ k) :=
    maximalIdeal_pow_quotient_artinian k
  let q : C →+* C ⧸ maximalIdeal C ^ k :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal C ^ k)
  let f : ℕ →o (Ideal (C ⧸ maximalIdeal C ^ k))ᵒᵈ :=
    { toFun := fun n => (J n).map q
      monotone' := fun _ _ h => Ideal.map_mono (hJ h) }
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := IsArtinian.monotone_stabilizes f
  have hstable (n : ℕ) (hn : N ≤ n) :
      J N ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ k = J n ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ k := by
    have heq : (J N).map q = (J n).map q := hN n hn
    have hcomap := congrArg (Ideal.comap q) heq
    simpa only [q, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
      ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker] using hcomap
  refine ⟨N, le_antisymm (le_iInf fun n => ?_) (iInf_le _ N)⟩
  calc
    J N ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ k = J (max N n) ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ k :=
      hstable (max N n) (le_max_left N n)
    _ ≤ J n ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ k :=
      sup_le_sup_right (hJ (le_max_right N n)) _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.mem_ideal_of_mem_sup_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_of_mem_sup_maximalIdeal_pow
    (J : Ideal C) (x : C)
    (hx : ∀ n : ℕ, x ∈ J ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ n) : x ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : Submodule.mkQ J x = 0 := by
    apply IsHausdorff.haus (inferInstance : IsHausdorff (maximalIdeal C) (C ⧸ J))
    intro n
    apply SModEq.zero.mpr
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp (hx n)
    have hb' : b ∈ ((maximalIdeal C ^ n) • ⊤ : Submodule C C) := by
      simpa only [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, mul_one] using hb
    have hmap := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := Submodule.mkQ J) hb'
    rw [Submodule.map_smul'', Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_mkQ] at hmap
    have ha0 : Submodule.mkQ J a = 0 := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero J).mpr ha
    rw [← hab, map_add, ha0, zero_add]
    exact hmap
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero J).mp hzero

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_le_maximalIdeal_pow_of_antitone_iInf_eq_bot
statement:
theorem exists_le_maximalIdeal_pow_of_antitone_iInf_eq_bot
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal C) C]
    (J : ℕ → Ideal C) (hJ : Antitone J)
    (hinf : (⨅ n : ℕ, J n) = ⊥) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, J N ≤ maximalIdeal C ^ k
proof:
:= by
  let L : ℕ → Ideal C := fun n => ⨅ r : ℕ, J r ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ n
  have hstep (n : ℕ) (x : C) (hx : x ∈ L n) :
      ∃ y : C, y ∈ L (n + 1) ∧ x - y ∈ maximalIdeal C ^ n := by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_eq_iInf_sup_maximalIdeal_pow J hJ (n + 1)
    have hxN : x ∈ J N ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ n := (Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp hx N
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hxN
    refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change a ∈ ⨅ r : ℕ, J r ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ (n + 1)
      rw [← hN]
      exact (show J N ≤ J N ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ (n + 1) from le_sup_left) ha
    · rw [← hab, add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact hb
  have hL (x : C) (hx : x ∈ L k) : x ∈ maximalIdeal C ^ k := by
    let a : (n : ℕ) → L (k + n) :=
      Nat.rec (motive := fun n => L (k + n))
        ⟨x, by simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using hx⟩
        (fun n y =>
          let h := hstep (k + n) y.1 y.2
          ⟨h.choose, by simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using h.choose_spec.1⟩)
    have ha0 : (a 0).1 = x := by rfl
    have haStep (n : ℕ) :
        (a n).1 - (a (n + 1)).1 ∈ maximalIdeal C ^ (k + n) := by
      change (a n).1 - (hstep (k + n) (a n).1 (a n).2).choose ∈
        maximalIdeal C ^ (k + n)
      exact (hstep (k + n) (a n).1 (a n).2).choose_spec.2
    have haPair (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) :
        (a i).1 - (a j).1 ∈ maximalIdeal C ^ (k + i) := by
      induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
      | base =>
          rw [sub_self]
          exact (maximalIdeal C ^ (k + i)).zero_mem
      | succ j hij ih =>
          have hstep' : (a j).1 - (a (j + 1)).1 ∈
              maximalIdeal C ^ (k + i) :=
            Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.add_le_add_left hij k) (haStep j)
          have hsum := (maximalIdeal C ^ (k + i)).add_mem ih hstep'
          simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel] using hsum
    have hcauchy {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≤ j) :
        (a i).1 ≡ (a j).1
          [SMOD ((maximalIdeal C ^ i) • ⊤ : Submodule C C)] := by
      apply SModEq.sub_mem.mpr
      have hdiff : (a i).1 - (a j).1 ∈ maximalIdeal C ^ i :=
        Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_add_left i k) (haPair i j hij)
      simpa only [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, mul_one] using hdiff
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IsPrecomplete.prec
      (inferInstance : IsPrecomplete (maximalIdeal C) C)
      (f := fun n => (a n).1) hcauchy
    have hzJ (r : ℕ) : z ∈ J r := by
      apply mem_ideal_of_mem_sup_maximalIdeal_pow (J r) z
      intro n
      have haIn : (a n).1 ∈ J r ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ (k + n) :=
        (Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp (a n).2 r
      have haIn' : (a n).1 ∈ J r ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ n :=
        (sup_le_sup_left (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_add_left n k)) (J r)) haIn
      have hdiff : z - (a n).1 ∈ maximalIdeal C ^ n := by
        have hdiff' := SModEq.sub_mem.mp (hz n).symm
        simpa only [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, mul_one] using hdiff'
      have hdiffSup : z - (a n).1 ∈ J r ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ n :=
        (le_sup_right : maximalIdeal C ^ n ≤ J r ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ n) hdiff
      have hsum := (J r ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ n).add_mem hdiffSup haIn'
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hsum
    have hz0 : z = 0 := by
      have hzinf : z ∈ ⨅ r : ℕ, J r := (Submodule.mem_iInf J).mpr hzJ
      simpa only [hinf, Submodule.mem_bot] using hzinf
    have hfirst : x - (a k).1 ∈ maximalIdeal C ^ k := by
      simpa only [ha0, Nat.add_zero] using haPair 0 k (Nat.zero_le k)
    have hlast : (a k).1 - z ∈ maximalIdeal C ^ k := by
      have hlast' := SModEq.sub_mem.mp (hz k)
      simpa only [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, mul_one] using hlast'
    have hsum := (maximalIdeal C ^ k).add_mem hfirst hlast
    simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel, hz0, sub_zero, sub_add_cancel] using hsum
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_eq_iInf_sup_maximalIdeal_pow J hJ k
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  apply hL x
  change x ∈ ⨅ n : ℕ, J n ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ k
  rw [← hN]
  exact (show J N ≤ J N ⊔ maximalIdeal C ^ k from le_sup_left) hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isArtinian_derivedLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isArtinian_derivedLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] (n : ℕ) :
    IsArtinian R (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M n)
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ (k : ℕ) (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Finite R N],
      IsArtinian R
        (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R N) k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        intro N _ _ _
        exact isArtinian_derivedLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal_zero (ModuleCat.of R N)
    | succ k ih =>
        intro N _ _ hN
        induction hN using IsNoetherianRing.induction_on_isQuotientEquivQuotientPrime R with
        | subsingleton N =>
            have hzero : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R)
                (ModuleCat.of R N) (k + 1)) :=
              derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_power_torsion
                (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R N)
                (fun z => ⟨0, fun a _ha => Subsingleton.elim (a • z) 0⟩) k
            let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R)
                (ModuleCat.of R N) (k + 1)) :=
              AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hzero
            infer_instance
        | quotient N p e =>
            by_cases hp : p.asIdeal = maximalIdeal R
            · have eres : N ≃ₗ[R] (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) := hp ▸ e
              have hpower : ∀ z : ModuleCat.of R N, ∃ t : ℕ,
                  ∀ a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ t, a • z = 0 := by
                intro z
                refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
                intro a ha
                apply Purity.maximalIdeal_smul_eq_zero_of_equiv_residueField eres a
                simpa only [pow_one] using ha
              have hzero := derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_power_torsion
                (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R N) hpower k
              let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R)
                  (ModuleCat.of R N) (k + 1)) :=
                AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hzero
              infer_instance
            · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxregular⟩ :=
                Purity.exists_regular_maximalIdeal_scalar_of_equiv_primeQuotient p e hp
              let Q : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R N
              let : Module.Finite R (ModuleCat.smulShortComplex Q x).X₃ := by
                change Module.Finite R (N ⧸ x • (⊤ : Submodule R N))
                infer_instance
              let : IsArtinian R (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R)
                  (ModuleCat.smulShortComplex Q x).X₃ k) :=
                ih (ModuleCat.smulShortComplex Q x).X₃
              exact Purity.isArtinian_derivedLocalCohomologyModule_succ_of_regular_smulQuotient
                Q x hx hxregular k
        | exact N₁ N₂ N₃ f g hf hg hfg h₁ h₃ =>
            let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
              ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero f g hfg.linearMap_comp_eq_zero
            have hS : S.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact S hfg hf hg
            let : IsArtinian R
                (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) S.X₁ (k + 1)) := h₁
            let : IsArtinian R
                (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) S.X₃ (k + 1)) := h₃
            exact isArtinian_of_range_eq_ker
              (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsFirstMap (maximalIdeal R) hS (k + 1))
              (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap (maximalIdeal R) hS (k + 1))
              (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficients_sameDegree_exact
                (maximalIdeal R) hS (k + 1)).linearMap_ker_eq.symm
  exact hall n M

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.principalLocalizationComplex_isZero_X
statement:
theorem principalLocalizationComplex_isZero_X (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    IsZero ((principalLocalizationComplex x M).X n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 2 := ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩
  change IsZero (ModuleCat.of R PUnit)
  exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.principalLocalizationComplex_ker_d_zero
statement:
theorem principalLocalizationComplex_ker_d_zero (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    LinearMap.ker ((principalLocalizationComplex x M).d 0 1).hom =
      Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:= by
  change LinearMap.ker (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers x) M) = _
  exact ker_localizedModule_mkLinearMap_powers M x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.principalLocalizationComplex_exactAt_succ
statement:
theorem principalLocalizationComplex_exactAt_succ
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M]
    (n : ℕ) : (principalLocalizationComplex x M).ExactAt (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    apply (HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ 0 1 2
      ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).prev_eq' rfl) ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).next_eq' rfl)).mpr
    rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_ker_sub_range]
    intro y _hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
      localizedModule_mkLinearMap_surjective_of_injective M (Submonoid.powers x) y
    exact ⟨z, hz⟩
  | succ n =>
    apply HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_isZero
    exact principalLocalizationComplex_isZero_X x M (n + 1 + 1) (by omega)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.principalLocalizationComplex_flat_X
statement:
theorem principalLocalizationComplex_flat_X (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    [Module.Flat R M] (n : ℕ) :
    Module.Flat R ((principalLocalizationComplex x M).X n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Flat R M)
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      exact Module.Flat.trans R (Localization (Submonoid.powers x))
        (LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers x) M)
    | succ n =>
      change Module.Flat R PUnit
      infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.preimage_puncturedSpectrumOpen_of_map_maximalIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem preimage_puncturedSpectrumOpen_of_map_maximalIdeal_eq
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom f]
    (hmax : (maximalIdeal R).map f = maximalIdeal S) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f) ⁻¹ᵁ puncturedSpectrumOpen R =
      puncturedSpectrumOpen S
proof:
:= by
  let q : Spec (.of S) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
  have hqClosed :
      q (closedPoint (CommRingCat.of S)) =
        closedPoint (CommRingCat.of R) := by
    exact Spec_closedPoint
  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
  apply Set.ext
  intro x
  change q x ∈ puncturedSpectrumOpen R ↔
    x ∈ puncturedSpectrumOpen S
  constructor
  · intro hx
    apply (mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff S x).2
    intro hclosed
    exact ((mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff R (q x)).1 hx) <| by
      rw [hclosed]
      exact hqClosed
  · intro hx
    apply (mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff R (q x)).2
    intro hclosed
    apply ((mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff S x).1 hx)
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal x.2.1
    · change maximalIdeal S ≤ x.1
      rw [← hmax, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
      have hcomap := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hclosed
      change x.1.comap f = maximalIdeal R at hcomap
      exact hcomap.ge

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumMorphismOfMapMaximalIdealEq_isPullback
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrumMorphismOfMapMaximalIdealEq_isPullback
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom f]
    (hmax : (maximalIdeal R).map f = maximalIdeal S) :
    IsPullback
      (puncturedSpectrumMorphismOfMapMaximalIdealEq f hmax)
      (puncturedSpectrumInclusion S)
      (puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
proof:

  let : IsOpenImmersion (puncturedSpectrumInclusion S) := by

        f hmax).symm
  · simpa only [puncturedSpectrumInclusion, Opens.opensRange_ι] using
      preimage_puncturedSpectrumOpen_of_map_maximalIdeal_eq f hmax

    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyModuleScalarQuotientEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyModuleScalarQuotientEquiv_apply_mk
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ)
    (x : R) (hx : IsSMulRegular M x)
    (hzero : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M (n + 1)))
    (z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I M n) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyModuleScalarQuotientEquiv I M n x hx hzero
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) =
      derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap I hx.smulShortComplex_shortExact n z
proof:
:= by
  let g : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I M n →ₗ[R]
      derivedLocalCohomologyModule I (ModuleCat.smulShortComplex M x).X₃ n :=
    derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap
      I hx.smulShortComplex_shortExact n
  have hepi : Epi (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap
      I hx.smulShortComplex_shortExact n) :=
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap_epi_of_next_first_isZero
      I hx.smulShortComplex_shortExact n hzero
  have hg : Function.Surjective g :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp hepi
  change (g.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hg) (Submodule.Quotient.mk z) = g z
  exact g.quotKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk hg z

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_succ_of_finite_of_regular
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_succ_of_finite_of_regular
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : Module.supportDim R M = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (x : R) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hreg : IsSMulRegular M x)
    [Module.Finite R (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (d + 1))] :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R) M (d + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ModuleCat.{u} R := (M.smulShortComplex x).X₃
  let : Module.Finite R Q := by
    change Module.Finite R (M ⧸ x • (⊤ : Submodule R M))
    infer_instance
  have hdrop : Module.supportDim R Q + 1 = Module.supportDim R M :=
    Module.supportDim_quotSMulTop_succ_eq_supportDim hreg hx
  have hdimQ : Module.supportDim R Q < ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    by_contra h
    have hle : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤
        ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      calc
        ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ Module.supportDim R Q + 1 :=
          by simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right (le_of_not_gt h) 1
        _ = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := hdrop.trans hdim
    have hle' : ((d + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hle
    have hlt : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) <
        ((d + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self (d + 1)))
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hle') hlt
  have hQzero : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R) Q (d + 1)) :=
    derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_of_supportDim_lt Q (d + 1) hdimQ
  have hepi : Epi (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap (maximalIdeal R)
      hreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact (d + 1)) :=
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_epi_of_third_isZero
      (maximalIdeal R) hreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact (d + 1) hQzero
  rw [derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_smulShortComplex
    (maximalIdeal R) M (d + 1) x hreg] at hepi
  let H : ModuleCat.{u} R := derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (d + 1)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (fun z : H => x • z) :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp hepi
  have hsmul : (⊤ : Submodule R H) ≤ maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R H) := by
    intro z _hz
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hsurj z
    rw [← hw]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul hx Submodule.mem_top
  have htop : (⊤ : Submodule R H) = ⊥ :=
    Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
      (maximalIdeal R) (⊤ : Submodule R H) Module.Finite.fg_top hsmul
      (jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal (⊥ : Ideal R) bot_ne_top).symm.le
  have hz : ∀ z : H, z = 0 := by
    intro z
    have hmem : z ∈ (⊤ : Submodule R H) := Submodule.mem_top
    rw [htop] at hmem
    exact hmem
  apply AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
  exact ⟨fun z w => (hz z).trans (hz w).symm⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.supportDim_le_zero_of_maximalIdeal_pow_le_annihilator
statement:
private theorem supportDim_le_zero_of_maximalIdeal_pow_le_annihilator
    (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Finite R N]
    (k : ℕ) (hk : maximalIdeal R ^ k ≤ Module.annihilator R N) :
    Module.supportDim R N ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed (p : Module.support R N) : (p : PrimeSpectrum R) = closedPoint R := by
    apply le_antisymm le_top
    change maximalIdeal R ≤ p.val.asIdeal
    intro a ha
    apply p.val.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem k
    exact (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp p.property)
      (hk (Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha k))
  let : Subsingleton (Module.support R N) :=
    ⟨fun p q => Subtype.ext ((hclosed p).trans (hclosed q).symm)⟩
  exact Order.krullDim_nonpos_of_subsingleton

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.supportDim_linearMap_localCohomology_zero_le_zero
statement:
private theorem supportDim_linearMap_localCohomology_zero_le_zero
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] :
    Module.supportDim R
      (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M 0 →ₗ[R] E) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  let H := derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M 0
  let : IsNoetherian R H :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
      (isFiniteLength_derivedLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal_zero M)).1
  let : Module.Finite R (H →ₗ[R] E) :=
    finite_linearMap_localCohomology_maximalIdeal i hi hess M 0
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_ideal_pow_le_annihilator_of_finite (maximalIdeal R)
    (derivedLocalCohomologyModule_exists_idealPower_smul_eq_zero (maximalIdeal R) M 0)
  apply supportDim_le_zero_of_maximalIdeal_pow_le_annihilator (H →ₗ[R] E) k
  intro a ha
  apply Module.mem_annihilator.mpr
  intro f
  ext z
  change a • f z = 0
  rw [← f.map_smul, Module.mem_annihilator.mp (hk ha) z, map_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.supportDim_linearMap_localCohomology_maximalIdeal_le
statement:
theorem supportDim_linearMap_localCohomology_maximalIdeal_le
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] (n : ℕ) :
    Module.supportDim R
      (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M n →ₗ[R] E) ≤
        (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing M with
  | zero =>
      exact supportDim_linearMap_localCohomology_zero_le_zero i hi hess M
  | succ n ih =>
      let Q : ModuleCat.{u} R :=
        ModuleCat.of R (M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M (maximalIdeal R))
      let : Module.Finite R Q := by
        change Module.Finite R (M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M (maximalIdeal R))
        infer_instance
      let eT := derivedLocalCohomologyModuleEquiv_succ_quotient_primaryComponent
        (maximalIdeal R) M n
      have heq := Module.supportDim_eq_of_equiv (LinearEquiv.congrLeft E R eT)
      rw [heq]
      let : IsArtinian R (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q n) :=
        isArtinian_derivedLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal Q n
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hreg, _⟩ :=
        exists_regular_mem_maximalIdeal_finiteLength_quotient Q
          (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q n)
          (maximalIdeal_not_mem_associatedPrimes_quotient_primaryComponent
            (R := R) (M := M))
      let W : ModuleCat.{u} R := (Q.smulShortComplex x).X₃
      let : Module.Finite R W := by
        change Module.Finite R (Q ⧸ x • (⊤ : Submodule R Q))
        infer_instance
      let N := derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q (n + 1) →ₗ[R] E
      let : Module.Finite R N :=
        finite_linearMap_localCohomology_maximalIdeal i hi hess Q (n + 1)
      let δ := derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsConnectingMap
        (maximalIdeal R) hreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact n
      have hexact := derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficients_afterConnecting_exact
        (maximalIdeal R) hreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact n
      rw [derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsFirstMap_smulShortComplex
        (maximalIdeal R) Q (n + 1) x hreg] at hexact
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_injective_dual_scalarQuotient_of_exact
        (E := E) δ x hexact
      calc
        Module.supportDim R N ≤
            Module.supportDim R (N ⧸ x • (⊤ : Submodule R N)) + 1 :=
          Module.supportDim_le_supportDim_quotSMulTop_succ hx
        _ ≤ Module.supportDim R
            (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) W n →ₗ[R] E) + 1 :=
          add_le_add (Module.supportDim_le_of_injective f hf) (le_refl 1)
        _ ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 := add_le_add (ih W) (le_refl 1)
        _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_ne_zero_annihilator_linearMap_localCohomology_of_lt_dim
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_annihilator_linearMap_localCohomology_of_lt_dim
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] (n : ℕ)
    (hn : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ a : R, a ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ f :
      derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M n →ₗ[R] E, a • f = 0
proof:
:= by
  let N := derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M n →ₗ[R] E
  let : Module.Finite R N :=
    finite_linearMap_localCohomology_maximalIdeal i hi hess M n
  have hdim : Module.supportDim R N < ringKrullDim R :=
    (supportDim_linearMap_localCohomology_maximalIdeal_le i hi hess M n).trans_lt hn
  have hann : Module.annihilator R N ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    rw [Module.supportDim_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient_annihilator, h,
      ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.quotientBot R)] at hdim
    exact lt_irrefl _ hdim
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩ := (Module.annihilator R N).ne_bot_iff.mp hann
  exact ⟨a, ha0, Module.mem_annihilator.mp ha⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_ne_zero_annihilator_lower_linearMap_localCohomology
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_annihilator_lower_linearMap_localCohomology
    [IsDomain R]
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ a : R, a ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ n < d, ∀ f :
      derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M n →ₗ[R] E, a • f = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, fun n hn => False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero n hn)⟩
  | succ d ih =>
      have hd : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim R :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self d) hdim
      obtain ⟨a, ha, haann⟩ := ih (le_of_lt hd)
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hbann⟩ :=
        exists_ne_zero_annihilator_linearMap_localCohomology_of_lt_dim
          i hi hess M d hd
      refine ⟨a * b, mul_ne_zero ha hb, ?_⟩
      intro n hn f
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hn with hn | rfl
      · rw [mul_comm, mul_smul, haann n hn f, smul_zero]
      · rw [mul_smul, hbann f, smul_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_ker_pow_lt_top_range_pow_lt_top
statement:
theorem exists_ker_pow_lt_top_range_pow_lt_top
    [IsArtinian R M] (f : Module.End R M)
    (hsurj : ¬ Function.Surjective f) (hnil : ¬ IsNilpotent f) :
    ∃ n : ℕ,
      LinearMap.ker (f ^ n) < ⊤ ∧
        LinearMap.range (f ^ n) < ⊤ ∧
          LinearMap.ker (f ^ n) ⊔ LinearMap.range (f ^ n) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp
    (LinearMap.eventually_codisjoint_ker_pow_range_pow f)
  refine ⟨n + 1, ?_, ?_, codisjoint_iff.mp (hn (n + 1) (Nat.le_succ n))⟩
  · apply lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr
    intro hker
    exact hnil ⟨n + 1, LinearMap.ker_eq_top.mp hker⟩
  · apply lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr
    intro hrange
    have hpow : Function.Surjective (f ^ (n + 1)) :=
      LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp hrange
    apply hsurj
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hpow y
    refine ⟨(f ^ n) x, ?_⟩
    simpa only [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply] using hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_finset_secondarySubmodules_sup_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_finset_secondarySubmodules_sup_eq_top [IsArtinian R M] :
    ∃ s : Finset (Submodule R M),
      (∀ N ∈ s, IsSecondaryModule R N) ∧ s.sup id = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine IsArtinian.induction
    (P := fun N : Submodule R M ↦
      ∃ s : Finset (Submodule R M),
        (∀ Q ∈ s, IsSecondaryModule R Q) ∧ s.sup id = N) ?_ ⊤
  intro N ih
  by_cases hN : N = ⊥
  · refine ⟨∅, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro Q hQ
      exact False.elim (Finset.notMem_empty Q hQ)
    · simpa only [Finset.sup_empty] using hN.symm
  by_cases hsecondary : IsSecondaryModule R N
  · refine ⟨{N}, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro Q hQ
      have hQN : Q = N := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hQ
      exact hQN.symm ▸ hsecondary
    · exact Finset.sup_singleton
  let : Nontrivial N := Submodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot.mpr hN
  have hfail : ¬ ∀ r : R,
      Function.Surjective (fun x : N ↦ r • x) ∨
        ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : N, r ^ n • x = 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hsecondary ⟨inferInstance, h⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := not_forall.mp hfail
  obtain ⟨hrsurj, hrnil⟩ := not_or.mp hr
  let f : Module.End R N := r • (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[R] N)
  have hpow : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : N), (f ^ n) x = r ^ n • x := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro x
        simp only [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, one_smul]
    | succ n ihpow =>
        intro x
        calc
          (f ^ (n + 1)) x = f ((f ^ n) x) := by
            rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
          _ = r • (r ^ n • x) := by
            change r • ((f ^ n) x) = r • (r ^ n • x)
            exact congrArg (fun z : N ↦ r • z) (ihpow x)
          _ = r ^ (n + 1) • x := by
            rw [pow_succ', mul_smul]
  have hfsurj : ¬ Function.Surjective f := by
    intro hf
    apply hrsurj
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf y
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hfnil : ¬ IsNilpotent f := by
    rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    apply hrnil
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    intro x
    rw [← hpow n x, hn, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨n, hker, hrange, hsum⟩ :=
    exists_ker_pow_lt_top_range_pow_lt_top f hfsurj hfnil
  let K : Submodule R M := (LinearMap.ker (f ^ n)).map N.subtype
  let L : Submodule R M := (LinearMap.range (f ^ n)).map N.subtype
  have hK : K < N := by
    have h := (Submodule.map_strictMono_of_injective N.subtype_injective) hker
    simpa only [Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype] using h
  have hL : L < N := by
    have h := (Submodule.map_strictMono_of_injective N.subtype_injective) hrange
    simpa only [Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype] using h
  have hKL : K ⊔ L = N := by
    change (LinearMap.ker (f ^ n)).map N.subtype ⊔
      (LinearMap.range (f ^ n)).map N.subtype = N
    rw [← Submodule.map_sup, hsum, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsup_s⟩ := ih K hK
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hsup_t⟩ := ih L hL
  refine ⟨s ∪ t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro Q hQ
    obtain hQs | hQt := Finset.mem_union.mp hQ
    · exact hs Q hQs
    · exact ht Q hQt
  · rw [Finset.sup_union, hsup_s, hsup_t, hKL]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_quotient_of_fullyFaithful
statement:
theorem hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_quotient_of_fullyFaithful
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    letI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI)
    letI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity (R ⧸ I) →
      (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism
          R I hI)).FullyFaithful →
      AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity R := by
  let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
      (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI)
  let : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro hquotient hlefschetz
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.hasPuncturedPurity_iff] at hquotient ⊢
  intro W
  let j := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let jI :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion (R ⧸ I)
  let q := AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
  let g := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism
    R I hI
  let Fj := AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback j
  let FjI := AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback jI
  let Fq := AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback q
  let Fg := AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback g
  let WI := Fg.obj W
  obtain ⟨ZI, ⟨eZI⟩⟩ := hquotient WI
  let : Fq.IsEquivalence := by
    dsimp only [Fq, q]
    exact finiteEtale_pullback_isEquivalence_of_complete_quotient I hI
  obtain ⟨Z, ⟨eZ⟩⟩ :=
    (inferInstance : Fq.EssSurj).mem_essImage ZI
  let eSquare : Fg.obj (Fj.obj Z) ≅ FjI.obj (Fq.obj Z) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumQuotientPullbackIso
      R I hI).app Z
  let eRestricted : Fg.obj (Fj.obj Z) ≅ Fg.obj W :=
    eSquare ≪≫ FjI.mapIso eZ ≪≫ eZI
  refine ⟨Z, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact hlefschetz.preimageIso eRestricted

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_quotient_of_preserves_connected
statement:
theorem hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_quotient_of_preserves_connected
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    letI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI)
    letI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ConnectedSpace (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) →
      ConnectedSpace
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (R ⧸ I)) →
      AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity (R ⧸ I) →
      (∀ W : AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R),
        CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected W →
          CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected
            ((AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback
              (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism
                R I hI)).obj W)) →
      AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity R := by
  let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
      (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI)
  let : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro hconnectedR hconnectedQuotient hpurity hpreserves
  let : ConnectedSpace
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) := hconnectedR
  let : ConnectedSpace
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (R ⧸ I)) :=
    hconnectedQuotient
  let g := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism
    R I hI
  have hfullyFaithful : Nonempty
      (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback g).FullyFaithful :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_fullyFaithful_of_preserves_connected
      g hpreserves
  exact hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_quotient_of_fullyFaithful
    I hI hpurity hfullyFaithful.some

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isEssentialSubmodule_torsionBySet_of_idealPower_torsion
statement:
theorem isEssentialSubmodule_torsionBySet_of_idealPower_torsion
    (I : Ideal R)
    (hM : ∀ z : M, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0) :
    IsEssentialSubmodule (Submodule.torsionBySet R M I)
proof:
:= by
  intro L hL
  have hzero : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : M), z ∈ L →
      (∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0) → z = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro z _hz hn
        have hone : (1 : R) ∈ I ^ 0 := by
          rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
          exact Submodule.mem_top
        simpa only [one_smul] using hn 1 hone
    | succ n ih =>
        intro z hz hn
        have hzSocle : z ∈ Submodule.torsionBySet R M I := by
          apply (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (I : Set R) z).mpr
          intro a
          apply ih ((a : R) • z) (L.smul_mem (a : R) hz)
          intro b hb
          rw [smul_smul]
          apply hn
          rw [pow_succ]
          exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hb a.property
        exact (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hL) z hzSocle hz
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hM z
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mpr (hzero n z hz hn)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isEssentialSubmodule_torsionBySet_maximalIdeal_of_power_torsion
statement:
theorem isEssentialSubmodule_torsionBySet_maximalIdeal_of_power_torsion
    [IsLocalRing R]
    (hM : ∀ z : M, ∃ n : ℕ,
      ∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ n, a • z = 0) :
    IsEssentialSubmodule
      (Submodule.torsionBySet R M (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))
proof:
:=
  isEssentialSubmodule_torsionBySet_of_idealPower_torsion
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) hM

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_ι_apply
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_ι_apply
    (I : Ideal R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (i n : ℕ)
    (α : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) S.X₁ i) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap I hS i
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₁ i)
          (op (op n)) α) =
      colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₂ i)
        (op (op n))
        (α.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.f) (add_zero i))
proof:
:= by
  let T : ShortComplex ((ℕᵒᵖ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsPowersAdjacentShortComplex
      I hS i (i + 1) rfl 0 (by omega)
  
  
  
  have h :
      colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₁ i)
          (op (op n)) ≫
        derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap I hS i =
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.f).postcomp
            (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) (add_zero i)) ≫
        colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₂ i)
          (op (op n)) :=
    colimit.ι_map T.f (op (op n))
  exact congrArg
    (fun f :
        (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₁ i).obj (op (op n)) ⟶
          derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₂ i ↦ f α) h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_smulShortComplex
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_smulShortComplex
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ)
    (x : R) (hx : IsSMulRegular M x) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap I
        hx.smulShortComplex_shortExact i =
      derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i x
proof:
:= by
  apply colimit.hom_ext (F := derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
  rintro ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
  ext α
  change
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap I
        hx.smulShortComplex_shortExact i
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
          (op (op n)) α) =
      derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i x
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
          (op (op n)) α)
  have hfirst :
      derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap I
          hx.smulShortComplex_shortExact i
          (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
            (op (op n)) α) =
        colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
          (op (op n))
          (α.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (M.smulShortComplex x).f)
            (add_zero i)) := by
    exact derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_ι_apply
      I hx.smulShortComplex_shortExact i n α
  change CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i at α
  refine hfirst.trans ((congrArg
    (fun β : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i =>
      colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i) (op (op n)) β)
    ?_).trans (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i x n α).symm)
  rw [ModuleCat.smulShortComplex_f_eq_smul_id]
  exact (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.smul_eq_comp_mk₀ α x).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.smulShortComplex_smul_id_third_eq_zero
statement:
theorem smulShortComplex_smul_id_third_eq_zero
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (x : R) :
    x • 𝟙 (M.smulShortComplex x).X₃ = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  induction q using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | _ m =>
      change
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk (x • m) :
          M ⧸ (x • (⊤ : Submodule R M))) = 0
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr
        (Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul m x (⊤ : Submodule R M)
          (Submodule.mem_top))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_maximalIdeal_epi_succ
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_maximalIdeal_epi_succ
    [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (x : R) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hxmem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) :
    Epi (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap
      (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) (d + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  let hxreg : IsSMulRegular (ModuleCat.of R R) x :=
    by
      change IsSMulRegular R x
      exact IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero hx0
  have hquotient :
      IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R)
        ((ModuleCat.of R R).smulShortComplex x).X₃ (d + 1)) :=
    derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_succ_of_smul_id_eq_zero
      d hdim x hx0 hxmem ((ModuleCat.of R R).smulShortComplex x).X₃
      (smulShortComplex_smul_id_third_eq_zero (ModuleCat.of R R) x)
  have hepi :
      Epi (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap (maximalIdeal R)
        hxreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact (d + 1)) :=
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_epi_of_third_isZero
      (maximalIdeal R) hxreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact (d + 1) hquotient
  rw [derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_smulShortComplex
    (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) (d + 1) x hxreg] at hepi
  exact hepi

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_maximalIdeal_surjective_succ
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_maximalIdeal_surjective_succ
    [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (x : R) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hxmem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) :
    Function.Surjective (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap
      (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) (d + 1) x)
proof:
:=
  (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp
    (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_maximalIdeal_epi_succ
      d hdim x hx0 hxmem)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_injective_dual_scalarQuotient_of_exact
statement:
theorem exists_injective_dual_scalarQuotient_of_exact
    (δ : A →ₗ[R] B) (x : R)
    (hex : Function.Exact δ (x • (LinearMap.id : B →ₗ[R] B))) :
    ∃ f : ((B →ₗ[R] E) ⧸ x • (⊤ : Submodule R (B →ₗ[R] E))) →ₗ[R]
        (A →ₗ[R] E), Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  let q : B →ₗ[R] B := x • LinearMap.id
  let pre : (B →ₗ[R] E) →ₗ[R] (A →ₗ[R] E) := LinearMap.lcomp R E δ
  let T : Submodule R (B →ₗ[R] E) := x • ⊤
  have hker : LinearMap.ker pre = T := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro φ hφ
      have hφzero : pre φ = 0 := hφ
      have hqφ : LinearMap.ker q ≤ LinearMap.ker φ := by
        intro b hb
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (hex b).mp hb
        rw [← ha]
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun hφzero a
      let g : LinearMap.range q →ₗ[R] E :=
        ((LinearMap.ker q).liftQ φ hqφ).comp q.quotKerEquivRange.symm.toLinearMap
      obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := Module.Injective.out
        (LinearMap.range q).subtype (LinearMap.range q).subtype_injective g
      have hψb (b : B) : ψ (q b) = φ b := by
        have h := hψ ⟨q b, LinearMap.mem_range_self q b⟩
        change ψ (q b) = (LinearMap.ker q).liftQ φ hqφ
          (q.quotKerEquivRange.symm ⟨q b, LinearMap.mem_range_self q b⟩) at h
        rw [LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange_symm_apply_image] at h
        exact h
      apply (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists φ x ⊤).mpr
      refine ⟨ψ, Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
      ext b
      change x • ψ b = φ b
      rw [← map_smul]
      exact hψb b
    · intro φ hφ
      obtain ⟨ψ, _hψ, rfl⟩ :=
        (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists φ x ⊤).mp hφ
      change pre (x • ψ) = 0
      ext a
      change x • ψ (δ a) = 0
      rw [← map_smul]
      have hxδ : x • δ a = 0 := hex.apply_apply_eq_zero a
      rw [hxδ, map_zero]
  refine ⟨T.liftQ pre hker.symm.le, ?_⟩
  exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    (Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot T pre hker.symm.le hker.le)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.topLocalCohomology_nonzero_and_notFinite
statement:
private theorem topLocalCohomology_nonzero_and_notFinite
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : Module.supportDim R M = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    (¬ IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R) M d)) ∧
      (d ≠ 0 → ¬ Module.Finite R
        (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M d))
proof:
:= by
  induction d generalizing M with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_not_isZero_of_supportDim_eq_zero M hdim, ?_⟩
      intro hne
      exact False.elim (hne rfl)
  | succ d ih =>
      let T : Submodule R M := Ideal.primaryComponent M (maximalIdeal R)
      let Q : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (M ⧸ T)
      let : Module.Finite R Q := by
        change Module.Finite R (M ⧸ T)
        infer_instance
      have hpos : 0 < Module.supportDim R M := by
        rw [hdim]
        exact WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ d))
      have hdimQ : Module.supportDim R Q = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        (Purity.supportDim_quotient_primaryComponent_maximalIdeal_eq_of_pos hpos).trans hdim
      let eT : derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (d + 1) ≃ₗ[R]
          derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q (d + 1) :=
        derivedLocalCohomologyModuleEquiv_succ_quotient_primaryComponent
          (maximalIdeal R) M d
      let : IsArtinian R (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q d) :=
        isArtinian_derivedLocalCohomologyModule_maximalIdeal Q d
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hreg, hlength⟩ :=
        Purity.exists_regular_mem_maximalIdeal_finiteLength_quotient Q
          (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q d)
          (Purity.maximalIdeal_not_mem_associatedPrimes_quotient_primaryComponent
            (R := R) (M := M))
      let W : ModuleCat.{u} R := (Q.smulShortComplex x).X₃
      let : Module.Finite R W := by
        change Module.Finite R (Q ⧸ x • (⊤ : Submodule R Q))
        infer_instance
      have hdimW : Module.supportDim R W = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        apply ENat.WithBot.add_one_cancel.mp
        calc
          Module.supportDim R W + 1 = Module.supportDim R Q :=
            Module.supportDim_quotSMulTop_succ_eq_supportDim hreg hx
          _ = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := hdimQ
          _ = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      have hW := ih W hdimW
      have hQnonzero : ¬ IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R) Q (d + 1)) := by
        intro hzero
        let e : (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q d ⧸
            x • (⊤ : Submodule R (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q d))) ≃ₗ[R]
              derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) W d :=
          derivedLocalCohomologyModuleScalarQuotientEquiv (maximalIdeal R) Q d x hreg hzero
        by_cases hd : d = 0
        · subst d
          let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q 0) :=
            AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
              (derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_zero_quotient_primaryComponent M)
          apply hW.1
          apply AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
          exact ⟨fun z w => e.symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
        · have hWlength : IsFiniteLength R
              (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) W d) :=
            hlength.of_surjective (f := e.toLinearMap) e.surjective
          let : IsNoetherian R
              (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) W d) :=
            (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hWlength).1
          exact hW.2 hd inferInstance
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hzero
        let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (d + 1)) :=
          AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hzero
        apply hQnonzero
        apply AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
        exact ⟨fun z w => eT.symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
      · intro _hd hfinite
        let : Module.Finite R
            (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (d + 1)) := hfinite
        let : Module.Finite R
            (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) Q (d + 1)) :=
          Module.Finite.of_surjective eT.toLinearMap eT.surjective
        exact hQnonzero
          (derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_succ_of_finite_of_regular
            Q d hdimQ x hx hreg)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.singleTensorComplexIso_hom_f_zero
statement:
theorem singleTensorComplexIso_hom_f_zero (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) :
    (singleTensorComplexIso M K).hom.f 0 =
      (tensorComplexZeroIso ((CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M) K).hom
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ((singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 M).inv ▷ K.X 0) ≫
        ιTensorObj ((CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M) K 0 0 0 rfl :=
      singleTensorComplexIso_hom_f M K 0
    _ = _ := by
      change (𝟙 M ▷ K.X 0) ≫
        ιTensorObj ((CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M) K 0 0 0 rfl = _
      rw [id_whiskerRight]
      exact Category.id_comp _

theorem singleTensorComplexIso_inv_f_zero (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)

proof:
:= by

      (singleTensorComplexIso M K)) =
      tensorComplexZeroIso ((CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M) K :=
    Iso.ext (singleTensorComplexIso_hom_f_zero M K)
