name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.tensorComplexZeroIso_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem tensorComplexZeroIso_hom_naturality
    {K L K' L' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ} (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L') :
    (tensorComplexZeroIso K L).hom ≫ (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f g).f 0 =
      (f.f 0 ⊗ₘ g.f 0) ≫ (tensorComplexZeroIso K' L').hom
proof:
:= by
  have h : (tensorComplexZeroIso K L).hom ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f g).f 0 =
      (f.f 0 ▷ L.X 0) ≫ (K'.X 0 ◁ g.f 0) ≫ (tensorComplexZeroIso K' L').hom :=
    ι_mapBifunctorMap f g (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R))
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 0 0 rfl
  refine h.trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_)
  exact congrArg
    (fun k : K.X 0 ⊗ L.X 0 ⟶ K'.X 0 ⊗ L'.X 0 =>
      k ≫ (tensorComplexZeroIso K' L').hom) (tensorHom_def (f.f 0) (g.f 0)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.tensorComplexZeroIso_inv_naturality
statement:
theorem tensorComplexZeroIso_inv_naturality
    {K L K' L' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ} (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L') :
    (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f g).f 0 ≫ (tensorComplexZeroIso K' L').inv =
      (tensorComplexZeroIso K L).inv ≫ (f.f 0 ⊗ₘ g.f 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (tensorComplexZeroIso K L).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, tensorComplexZeroIso_hom_naturality,
    Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id,
    ← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.tensorComplexZeroIso_associator_hom
statement:
theorem tensorComplexZeroIso_associator_hom
    (K L B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) :
    ((tensorComplexZeroIso K L).hom ▷ B.X 0) ≫
      (tensorComplexZeroIso (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K L) B).hom ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.associator K L B).hom.f 0 =
    (α_ (K.X 0) (L.X 0) (B.X 0)).hom ≫
      (K.X 0 ◁ (tensorComplexZeroIso L B).hom) ≫
      (tensorComplexZeroIso K (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj L B)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := ι_mapBifunctorAssociatorX_hom
    (curriedAssociatorNatIso (ModuleCat.{u} R)) K L B
    (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 0 0 0 rfl
  rw [mapBifunctor₁₂.ι_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 0 0 0 0 0 rfl rfl,
    mapBifunctor₂₃.ι_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 0 0 0 0 0 rfl rfl] at h
  have h' : (((tensorComplexZeroIso K L).hom ▷ B.X 0) ≫
      (tensorComplexZeroIso (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K L) B).hom) ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.associator K L B).hom.f 0 =
    (α_ (K.X 0) (L.X 0) (B.X 0)).hom ≫
      (K.X 0 ◁ (tensorComplexZeroIso L B).hom) ≫
      (tensorComplexZeroIso K (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj L B)).hom := h
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans h'

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.tensorComplexZeroIso_associator_hom_normalized
statement:
private theorem tensorComplexZeroIso_associator_hom_normalized
    (K L B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) :
    (tensorComplexZeroIso (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K L) B).hom ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.associator K L B).hom.f 0 ≫
      (tensorComplexZeroIso K (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj L B)).inv =
    ((tensorComplexZeroIso K L).inv ▷ B.X 0) ≫
      (α_ (K.X 0) (L.X 0) (B.X 0)).hom ≫
      (K.X 0 ◁ (tensorComplexZeroIso L B).hom)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi ((tensorComplexZeroIso K L).hom ▷ B.X 0)).mp
  have h := congrArg
    (fun k => k ≫ (tensorComplexZeroIso K (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj L B)).inv)
    (tensorComplexZeroIso_associator_hom K L B)
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] at h
  rw [h, ← comp_whiskerRight_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, id_whiskerRight, Category.id_comp]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.tensorComplexZeroIso_tensor_associator
statement:
private theorem tensorComplexZeroIso_tensor_associator
    (K K' L B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ)
    (f : K ⟶ HomologicalComplex.tensorObj K' L) :
    (tensorComplexZeroIso K B).hom ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f (𝟙 B)).f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.associator K' L B).hom.f 0 ≫
      (tensorComplexZeroIso K' (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj L B)).inv =
    (f.f 0 ▷ B.X 0) ≫ ((tensorComplexZeroIso K' L).inv ▷ B.X 0) ≫
      (α_ (K'.X 0) (L.X 0) (B.X 0)).hom ≫
      (K'.X 0 ◁ (tensorComplexZeroIso L B).hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, tensorComplexZeroIso_hom_naturality]
  rw [HomologicalComplex.id_f, tensorHom_id, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
    tensorComplexZeroIso_associator_hom_normalized]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.zeroTensorModuleCompatibility
statement:
private theorem zeroTensorModuleCompatibility
    (M T B Y Z : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : T ⟶ M) (f : T ⟶ Y)
    (u : M ⊗ ModuleCat.of R R ≅ Y) (v : ModuleCat.of R R ⊗ B ≅ Z)
    (b : B ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R) (hf : f = i ≫ (ρ_ M).inv ≫ u.hom) :
    ((f ▷ B) ≫ (u.inv ▷ B) ≫ (α_ M (ModuleCat.of R R) B).hom ≫ (M ◁ v.hom)) ≫
      ((M ◁ (v.inv ≫ (ModuleCat.of R R ◁ b) ≫ (λ_ (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom)) ≫
        (ρ_ M).hom) = ((T ◁ b) ≫ (ρ_ T).hom) ≫ i
proof:
:= by
  have hh : f ≫ u.inv = i ≫ (ρ_ M).inv := by
    rw [hf]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [← comp_whiskerRight_assoc, hh]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have hu : ((ρ_ M).inv ▷ B) ≫ (α_ M (ModuleCat.of R R) B).hom ≫
      (M ◁ ((ModuleCat.of R R ◁ b) ≫ (λ_ (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom)) ≫
      (ρ_ M).hom = (M ◁ b) ≫ (ρ_ M).hom := by
    rw [whiskerLeft_comp]
    monoidal
  rw [comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc, hu]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← whisker_exchange, Category.assoc]
  change (T ◁ b) ≫ (i ▷ (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R))) ≫ (ρ_ M).hom =
    ((T ◁ b) ≫ (ρ_ T).hom) ≫ i
  rw [rightUnitor_naturality]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechPrincipalTensor_zero
statement:
private theorem cechPrincipalTensor_zero (x : R) (xs : List R) (M T : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : T ⟶ M)
    (f : (CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj T ⟶
      HomologicalComplex.tensorObj ((CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M)
        (principalLocalizationComplex x (ModuleCat.of R R)))
    (hf : f.f 0 = i ≫ (ρ_ M).inv ≫
      (tensorComplexZeroIso ((CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M)
        (principalLocalizationComplex x (ModuleCat.of R R))).hom) :
    (singleTensorComplexIso T (cechLocalizationComplex xs)).hom.f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f (𝟙 (cechLocalizationComplex xs))).f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.associator
        ((CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M)
        (principalLocalizationComplex x (ModuleCat.of R R))
        (cechLocalizationComplex xs)).hom.f 0 ≫
      (singleTensorComplexIso M (cechLocalizationComplex (x :: xs))).inv.f 0 ≫
      (cechCoefficientZeroIso (x :: xs) M).hom =
    (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs T).hom ≫ i
proof:
:= by
  let A := principalLocalizationComplex x (ModuleCat.of R R)
  let B := cechLocalizationComplex xs
  let S := (CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M
  let U := (CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj T
  let u : M ⊗ ModuleCat.of R R ≅ (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj S A).X 0 :=
    tensorComplexZeroIso S A
  let v : ModuleCat.of R R ⊗ B.X 0 ≅ (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj A B).X 0 :=
    tensorComplexZeroIso A B
  let j : T ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj S A).X 0 := f.f 0
  let a : T ⊗ B.X 0 ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj U B).X 0 :=
    (singleTensorComplexIso T B).hom.f 0
  let k : (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj S (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj A B)).X 0 ⟶
      M ⊗ (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj A B).X 0 :=
    (singleTensorComplexIso M (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj A B)).inv.f 0
  have hs : a = (tensorComplexZeroIso U B).hom :=
    singleTensorComplexIso_hom_f_zero T B
  have ht : k = (tensorComplexZeroIso S (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj A B)).inv :=
    singleTensorComplexIso_inv_f_zero M (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj A B)
  have h := tensorComplexZeroIso_tensor_associator U S A B f
  have h' : a ≫ (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f (𝟙 B)).f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.associator S A B).hom.f 0 ≫ k =
      (j ▷ B.X 0) ≫ (u.inv ▷ B.X 0) ≫
      (α_ M (ModuleCat.of R R) (B.X 0)).hom ≫ (M ◁ v.hom) := by
    calc
      _ = (tensorComplexZeroIso U B).hom ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f (𝟙 B)).f 0 ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.associator S A B).hom.f 0 ≫
          (tensorComplexZeroIso S (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj A B)).inv := by
        exact congrArg₂ (fun a' k' => a' ≫ (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f (𝟙 B)).f 0 ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.associator S A B).hom.f 0 ≫ k') hs ht
      _ = _ := h
  let c : M ⊗ (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj A B).X 0 ⟶ M :=
    (cechCoefficientZeroIso (x :: xs) M).hom
  have h'' := congrArg (fun l => l ≫ c) h'
  have hnorm : ((j ▷ B.X 0) ≫ (u.inv ▷ B.X 0) ≫
      (α_ M (ModuleCat.of R R) (B.X 0)).hom ≫ (M ◁ v.hom)) ≫ c =
      (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs T).hom ≫ i :=
    zeroTensorModuleCompatibility M T (B.X 0) _ _ i j u v
      (cechLocalizationZeroIso xs).hom hf
  have hout := h''.trans hnorm
  have he : a ≫ (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f (𝟙 B)).f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.associator S A B).hom.f 0 ≫ k ≫ c =
      (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs T).hom ≫ i := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using hout
  exact he

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechInjectiveHomotopyEquiv_inv_f_zero
statement:
theorem cechInjectiveHomotopyEquiv_inv_f_zero [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (xs : List R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] :
    (cechInjectiveHomotopyEquiv xs M).inv.f 0 ≫
      (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs M).hom =
    ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList xs)).subtype
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing M with
  | nil =>
      let T := ModuleCat.of R (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList ([] : List R)))
      let i : T ⟶ M :=
        ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList ([] : List R))).subtype
      let f : T ⟶ M ⊗ 𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R) := (cechInjectiveHomotopyEquiv [] M).inv.f 0
      let c : M ⊗ 𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⟶ M := (cechCoefficientZeroIso [] M).hom
      have hf : f = i ≫ (ρ_ M).inv := by
        have h : f = (cechNilTorsionIso M).inv ≫ (ρ_ M).inv :=
          cechNilHomotopyEquiv_inv_f_zero M T (cechNilTorsionIso M)
        exact h.trans (congrArg (fun k : T ⟶ M => k ≫ (ρ_ M).inv)
          (cechNilTorsionIso_inv M))
      have hc : c = (ρ_ M).hom := by
        change (M ◁ 𝟙 (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R))) ≫ (ρ_ M).hom = _
        rw [whiskerLeft_id, Category.id_comp]
      change f ≫ c = i
      rw [hf, hc]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      let A := principalLocalizationComplex x (ModuleCat.of R R)
      let B := cechLocalizationComplex xs
      let S := (CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj M
      let T := ModuleCat.of R (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.span {x}))
      let U := (CochainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj T
      let : Module.Injective R T := moduleInjective_primaryComponent (Ideal.span {x}) M
      let i : T ⟶ M := ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.span {x})).subtype
      let q : Ideal.primaryComponent T (Ideal.ofList xs) ≃ₗ[R]
          Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList (x :: xs)) :=
        (primaryComponentIteratedLinearEquiv M (Ideal.span {x}) (Ideal.ofList xs)).trans
          (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (congrArg
            (fun I : Ideal R => Ideal.primaryComponent M I) (Ideal.ofList_cons x xs).symm))
      let f : U ⟶ HomologicalComplex.tensorObj S A :=
        (principalLocalizationHomotopyEquiv x M).hom ≫
          (principalLocalizationTensorCoefficientsIso x M).inv ≫ (singleTensorComplexIso M A).hom
      have hf : f.f 0 = i ≫ (ρ_ M).inv ≫ (tensorComplexZeroIso S A).hom := by
        exact congrArg₂ (fun (a : T ⟶ M)
          (b : M ⊗ ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj S A).X 0) =>
            a ≫ (ρ_ M).inv ≫ b)
          (principalLocalizationHomotopyEquiv_hom_f_zero x M)
          (singleTensorComplexIso_hom_f_zero M A)
      let W := ModuleCat.of R (Ideal.primaryComponent T (Ideal.ofList xs))
      let Q := ModuleCat.of R (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList (x :: xs)))
      let r : W ⟶ T ⊗ B.X 0 := (cechInjectiveHomotopyEquiv xs T).inv.f 0
      let c : T ⊗ B.X 0 ⟶ T := (cechCoefficientZeroIso xs T).hom
      let j : W ⟶ T := ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent T (Ideal.ofList xs)).subtype
      let k : Q ⟶ W := q.toModuleIso.inv
      let s : Q ⟶ M := ModuleCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList (x :: xs))).subtype
      let l : T ⊗ B.X 0 ⟶ M :=
        (singleTensorComplexIso T B).hom.f 0 ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.tensorHom f (𝟙 B)).f 0 ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.associator S A B).hom.f 0 ≫
          (singleTensorComplexIso M (cechLocalizationComplex (x :: xs))).inv.f 0 ≫
          (cechCoefficientZeroIso (x :: xs) M).hom
      have hl : l = c ≫ i := cechPrincipalTensor_zero x xs M T i f hf
      have hr : r ≫ c = j := ih T
      have hq : k ≫ j ≫ i = s := by
        have hval (w : Ideal.primaryComponent T (Ideal.ofList xs)) :
            (q w : M) = ((w : T) : M) := by
          dsimp only [q, LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
          rw [LinearEquiv.coe_ofEq_apply]
          exact primaryComponentIteratedLinearEquiv_apply_val M (Ideal.span {x}) (Ideal.ofList xs) w
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro z
        change (((q.symm z : Ideal.primaryComponent T (Ideal.ofList xs)) : T) : M) = (z : M)
        exact (hval (q.symm z)).symm.trans
          (congrArg (fun w : Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.ofList (x :: xs)) => (w : M))
            (q.apply_symm_apply z))
      have hout : k ≫ r ≫ l = s := by
        rw [hl, ← Category.assoc r c i, hr, hq]
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro z
      let w : Q := z
      change l (r (k w)) = s w
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hout w

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap_ι_apply
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap_ι_apply
    (I : Ideal R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (i n : ℕ)
    (α : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) S.X₂ i) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap I hS i
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₂ i)
          (op (op n)) α) =
      colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₃ i)
        (op (op n))
        (α.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g) (add_zero i))
proof:
:= by
  let T : ShortComplex ((ℕᵒᵖ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsPowersAdjacentShortComplex
      I hS i (i + 1) rfl 0 (by omega)
  have h :
      colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₂ i)
          (op (op n)) ≫
        derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap I hS i =
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g).postcomp
            (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) (add_zero i)) ≫
        colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₃ i)
          (op (op n)) :=
    colimit.ι_map T.g (op (op n))
  exact congrArg
    (fun f :
        (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₂ i).obj (op (op n)) ⟶
          derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₃ i ↦ f α) h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsConnectingMap_ι_apply
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsConnectingMap_ι_apply
    (I : Ideal R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (i n : ℕ)
    (α : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) S.X₃ i) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS i
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₃ i)
          (op (op n)) α) =
      colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₁ (i + 1))
        (op (op n)) (α.comp hS.extClass rfl)
proof:
:= by
  let T : ShortComplex ((ℕᵒᵖ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsPowersAdjacentShortComplex
      I hS i (i + 1) rfl 1 (by omega)
  have h :
      colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₃ i)
          (op (op n)) ≫
        derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS i =
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          (hS.extClass.postcomp (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) rfl) ≫
        colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₁ (i + 1))
          (op (op n)) :=
    colimit.ι_map T.g (op (op n))
  exact congrArg
    (fun f :
        (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₃ i).obj (op (op n)) ⟶
          derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₁ (i + 1) ↦ f α) h

statement:

proof:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.length_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull_of_simple
statement:
private theorem length_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull_of_simple
    (i : (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [IsSimpleModule R M] :
    Module.length R (M →ₗ[R] E) = Module.length R M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    (isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal (R := R) (M := M)).mp inferInstance
  obtain rfl := IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hJ
  let : IsSimpleModule R (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
    IsSimpleModule.congr e.symm
  calc
    Module.length R (M →ₗ[R] E) =
        Module.length R ((R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) :=
      (LinearEquiv.congrLeft E R e).length_eq
    _ = Module.length R (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
      (residueFieldHullHomEquiv i hi hess).length_eq
    _ = 1 := Module.length_eq_one R (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    _ = Module.length R M := (Module.length_eq_one R M).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.length_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull_of_finiteLength
statement:
theorem length_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull_of_finiteLength
    [Module.Injective R E]
    (i : (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    Module.length R (M →ₗ[R] E) = Module.length R M
proof:
:= by
  induction hM with
  | of_subsingleton =>
      rw [Module.length_eq_zero, Module.length_eq_zero]
  | @of_simple_quotient M _ _ N _ hN ih =>
      have hdual : Module.length R (M →ₗ[R] E) =
          Module.length R ((M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] E) + Module.length R (N →ₗ[R] E) :=
        Module.length_eq_add_of_exact
          (LinearMap.lcomp R E N.mkQ) (LinearMap.lcomp R E N.subtype)
          (LinearMap.lcomp_injective_of_surjective N.mkQ N.mkQ_surjective)
          (injective_dualRestriction_surjective N)
          (LinearMap.exact_lcomp_of_exact_of_surjective E
            (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ N) N.mkQ_surjective)
      have horiginal : Module.length R M = Module.length R N + Module.length R (M ⧸ N) :=
        Module.length_eq_add_of_exact N.subtype N.mkQ N.subtype_injective
          N.mkQ_surjective (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ N)
      calc
        Module.length R (M →ₗ[R] E) =
            Module.length R ((M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] E) + Module.length R (N →ₗ[R] E) := hdual
        _ = Module.length R (M ⧸ N) + Module.length R N := by
          rw [length_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull_of_simple i hi hess, ih]
        _ = Module.length R M := by
          rw [add_comm]
          exact horiginal.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isFiniteLength_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull
    [Module.Injective R E]
    (i : (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    IsFiniteLength R (M →ₗ[R] E)
proof:
:= by
  apply Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp
  rw [length_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull_of_finiteLength i hi hess hM]
  exact Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr hM

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.bijective_residueFieldHullEvaluation_of_finiteLength
statement:
theorem bijective_residueFieldHullEvaluation_of_finiteLength
    [Module.Injective R E]
    (i : (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    Function.Bijective (residueFieldHullEvaluation R E M)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (residueFieldHullEvaluation R E M) :=
    injective_eval_to_injective_residueField i hi M
  refine ⟨hinj, ?_⟩
  have hdual : IsFiniteLength R (M →ₗ[R] E) :=
    isFiniteLength_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull i hi hess hM
  have hdouble : IsFiniteLength R ((M →ₗ[R] E) →ₗ[R] E) :=
    isFiniteLength_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull i hi hess hdual
  let : IsNoetherian R ((M →ₗ[R] E) →ₗ[R] E) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hdouble).1
  let : IsArtinian R ((M →ₗ[R] E) →ₗ[R] E) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hdouble).2
  apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
  by_contra hproper
  have hlt : Module.length R (LinearMap.range (residueFieldHullEvaluation R E M)) <
      Module.length R ((M →ₗ[R] E) →ₗ[R] E) :=
    Submodule.length_lt hproper
  have hrange : Module.length R M =
      Module.length R (LinearMap.range (residueFieldHullEvaluation R E M)) :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofInjective (residueFieldHullEvaluation R E M) hinj).length_eq
  have hlength : Module.length R ((M →ₗ[R] E) →ₗ[R] E) = Module.length R M :=
    (length_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull_of_finiteLength i hi hess hdual).trans
      (length_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull_of_finiteLength i hi hess hM)
  rw [← hrange, hlength] at hlt
  exact (lt_irrefl (Module.length R M)) hlt

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_ofList_cons_isZero_of_smul_id_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_ofList_cons_isZero_of_smul_id_eq_zero
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (x : R) (xs : List R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (hx : x • 𝟙 M = 0) (i : ℕ) (hi : xs.length < i) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (Ideal.ofList (x :: xs)) M i)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : R) (zs : List R),
      zs.length = n → z • 𝟙 M = 0 →
      ∀ (j : ℕ), zs.length < j →
        IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (Ideal.ofList (z :: zs)) M j) by
    exact h xs.length x xs rfl hx i hi
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro z zs hlen hz j hj
    cases zs with
    | nil =>
        by_cases hjOne : j = 1
        · subst j
          simpa only [Ideal.ofList_singleton] using
            derivedLocalCohomology_span_singleton_isZero_one_of_smul_id_eq_zero
              z M hz
        · exact derivedLocalCohomology_ofList_isZero_of_isDomain
            [z] M j (by
              simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hj ⊢
              omega)
    | cons y ys =>
        have hysLength : ys.length < n := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen
          omega
        have hjTwo : 2 ≤ j := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hj
          omega
        let J : Ideal R := Ideal.ofList (z :: ys)
        let products : List R := ys.map fun a ↦ y * a
        have hproductsLength : products.length < n := by
          simpa only [products, List.length_map] using hysLength
        have hyz : (y * z) • 𝟙 M = 0 := by
          have h := congrArg (fun f : M ⟶ M ↦ y • f) hz
          simpa only [smul_smul, smul_zero] using h
        have hProduct :
            IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology
              (Ideal.ofList ((y * z) :: products)) M (j - 1)) :=
          ih products.length hproductsLength (y * z) products rfl hyz
            (j - 1) (by
              simp only [products, List.length_map, List.length_cons] at hj ⊢
              omega)
        have hInfRadical :
            (Ideal.span {y} ⊓ J).radical =
              (Ideal.ofList ((y * z) :: products)).radical := by
          calc
            (Ideal.span {y} ⊓ J).radical =
                (Ideal.span {y}).radical ⊓ J.radical :=
              Ideal.radical_inf (Ideal.span {y}) J
            _ = (Ideal.span {y} * J).radical :=
              (Ideal.radical_mul (Ideal.span {y}) J).symm
            _ = (Ideal.ofList ((y * z) :: products)).radical :=
              congrArg Ideal.radical (span_singleton_mul_ofList y (z :: ys))
        have hInf :
            IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology
              (Ideal.span {y} ⊓ J) M (j - 1)) :=
          hProduct.of_iso
            (derivedLocalCohomologyIsoOfSameRadical hInfRadical M (j - 1))
        have hPrincipal :
            IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (Ideal.span {y}) M j) := by
          have h := derivedLocalCohomology_ofList_isZero_of_isDomain
            [y] M j (by
              simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
              omega)
          simpa only [Ideal.ofList_singleton] using h
        have hTail : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology J M j) :=
          ih ys.length hysLength z ys rfl hz j (by
            simp only [List.length_cons] at hj
            omega)
        have hSupport :
            Ideal.ofList (z :: y :: ys) = Ideal.span {y} ⊔ J := by
          change Ideal.ofList (z :: y :: ys) =
            Ideal.span {y} ⊔ Ideal.ofList (z :: ys)
          simp only [Ideal.ofList_cons]
          exact sup_left_comm (Ideal.span {z}) (Ideal.span {y}) (Ideal.ofList ys)
        rw [hSupport]
        exact derivedLocalCohomology_sup_isZero_of_mayerVietoris
          (Ideal.span {y}) J M (j - 1) j (by omega) hInf hPrincipal hTail

theorem exactComposableArrowsDiagramAdjacentShortComplex_exact
    (Q : D ⥤ ComposableArrows C n) (hQ : ∀ d, (Q.obj d).Exact)

proof:
:= by
  let E : D → ((D ⥤ C) ⥤ C) := fun d => (evaluation D C).obj d
  have hE : JointlyReflectIsomorphisms E :=

        (NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app f).2 (fun d => by
          change IsIso ((E d).map f)
          infer_instance) }
  rw [hE.exact_iff]
  intro d
  exact (hQ d).exact k hk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.preimage_puncturedSpectrumOpen_quotient
statement:
theorem preimage_puncturedSpectrumOpen_quotient
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    letI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (quotientIdeal_ne_top R I hI)
    letI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) ⁻¹ᵁ
        puncturedSpectrumOpen R =
      puncturedSpectrumOpen (R ⧸ I) := by
  let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (quotientIdeal_ne_top R I hI)
  let : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let q : Spec (.of (R ⧸ I)) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
  let : IsClosedImmersion q := by
    dsimp only [q]
    exact IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hqClosed :
      q (closedPoint (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ I))) =
        closedPoint (CommRingCat.of R) := by
    exact Spec_closedPoint
  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
  apply Set.ext
  intro x
  change q x ∈ puncturedSpectrumOpen R ↔
    x ∈ puncturedSpectrumOpen (R ⧸ I)
  constructor
  · intro hx
    apply (mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff (R ⧸ I) x).2
    intro hclosed
    have hx' : q x ≠ closedPoint (CommRingCat.of R) :=
      (mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff R (q x)).1 hx
    apply hx'
    rw [hclosed]
    exact hqClosed
  · intro hx
    apply (mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff R (q x)).2
    intro hclosed
    have hx' : x ≠ closedPoint (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ I)) :=
      (mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff (R ⧸ I) x).1 hx
    apply hx'
    apply q.isEmbedding.injective
    rw [hclosed]
    exact hqClosed.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism_comp_inclusion
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism_comp_inclusion
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    letI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (quotientIdeal_ne_top R I hI)
    letI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism R I hI ≫
        puncturedSpectrumInclusion R =
      puncturedSpectrumInclusion (R ⧸ I) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) := by
  let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (quotientIdeal_ne_top R I hI)
  let : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsOpenImmersion (puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
    dsimp only [puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  unfold puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism
  exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism_isPullback
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism_isPullback
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    letI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (quotientIdeal_ne_top R I hI)
    letI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    IsPullback
      (puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism R I hI)
      (puncturedSpectrumInclusion (R ⧸ I))
      (puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) := by
  let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (quotientIdeal_ne_top R I hI)
  let : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsOpenImmersion (puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
    dsimp only [puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsOpenImmersion (puncturedSpectrumInclusion (R ⧸ I)) := by
    dsimp only [puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact (puncturedSpectrumQuotientMorphism_comp_inclusion R I hI).symm
  · simpa only [puncturedSpectrumInclusion, Opens.opensRange_ι] using
      preimage_puncturedSpectrumOpen_quotient R I hI

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.maximalIdeal_smul_eq_zero_of_equiv_residueField
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_smul_eq_zero_of_equiv_residueField
    (e : N ≃ₗ[R] (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R))
    (a : R) (ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal R) (z : N) : a • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply e.injective
  rw [map_smul, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (e z)
  rw [← hb]
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal R) (a * b) = 0
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    ((maximalIdeal R).mul_mem_right b ha)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_regular_maximalIdeal_scalar_of_equiv_primeQuotient
statement:
theorem exists_regular_maximalIdeal_scalar_of_equiv_primeQuotient
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) (e : N ≃ₗ[R] (R ⧸ p.asIdeal))
    (hp : p.asIdeal ≠ maximalIdeal R) :
    ∃ x : R, x ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ IsSMulRegular N x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp_le : p.asIdeal ≤ maximalIdeal R := le_maximalIdeal p.isPrime.ne_top
  have hex : ∃ x : R, x ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ x ∉ p.asIdeal := by
    by_contra h
    apply hp
    apply le_antisymm hp_le
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxp
    exact h ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩ := hex
  have hregular : IsSMulRegular (R ⧸ p.asIdeal) x := by
    apply (isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem p.asIdeal x).mpr
    intro a ha
    change x * a ∈ p.asIdeal at ha
    exact (p.isPrime.mem_or_mem ha).resolve_left hxp
  exact ⟨x, hx, (e.isSMulRegular_congr x).mpr hregular⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.primaryComponent_ideal_sup
statement:
theorem primaryComponent_ideal_sup (I J : Ideal R) :
    Ideal.primaryComponent M (I ⊔ J) =
      Ideal.primaryComponent M I ⊓ Ideal.primaryComponent M J
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [Submodule.mem_inf, Ideal.primaryComponent_mem,
    Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff, SetLike.coe_sort_coe, Subtype.forall]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨⟨n, fun a ha => hn a
      ((show I ^ n ≤ (I ⊔ J) ^ n from pow_le_pow_left' le_sup_left n) ha)⟩,
      ⟨n, fun a ha => hn a
        ((show J ^ n ≤ (I ⊔ J) ^ n from pow_le_pow_left' le_sup_right n) ha)⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, ⟨m, hm⟩⟩
    refine ⟨n + m, ?_⟩
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp
      ((Ideal.sup_pow_add_le_pow_sup_pow (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) (m := m)) hc)
    calc
      c • y = (a + b) • y := congrArg (fun r : R => r • y) hab.symm
      _ = a • y + b • y := add_smul a b y
      _ = 0 := by rw [hn a ha, hm b hb, add_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.primaryComponent_submodule
statement:
private theorem primaryComponent_submodule (N : Submodule R M) (J : Ideal R) :
    Ideal.primaryComponent N J = (Ideal.primaryComponent M J).comap N.subtype
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change (z ∈ Ideal.primaryComponent N J) ↔
    ((z : M) ∈ Ideal.primaryComponent M J)
  simp only [Ideal.primaryComponent_mem, Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff,
    SetLike.coe_sort_coe, Subtype.forall]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨n, fun a ha => congrArg (fun t : N => (t : M)) (hn a ha)⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨n, fun a ha => Subtype.ext (hn a ha)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.primaryComponent_iterated_eq_comap
proof:
:= by
  rw [primaryComponent_submodule]
  ext z
  change ((z : M) ∈ Ideal.primaryComponent M J) ↔
    ((z : M) ∈ Ideal.primaryComponent M (I ⊔ J))
  rw [primaryComponent_ideal_sup]
  exact ⟨fun h => ⟨z.property, h⟩, fun h => h.2⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.primaryComponentIteratedLinearEquiv_apply_val

theorem primaryComponentIteratedLinearEquiv_apply_val (I J : Ideal R)
    (z : Ideal.primaryComponent (Ideal.primaryComponent M I) J) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_of_radical_eq
statement:
theorem exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_of_radical_eq
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    {I : Ideal C} (hI : I.radical = maximalIdeal C) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (maximalIdeal C) ^ n ≤ I
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_product_pow_le_of_inf_eq_radical
statement:
theorem exists_product_pow_le_of_inf_eq_radical
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_radical_completeIntersectionPowerData_of_not_connectedSpace
statement:
theorem exists_radical_completeIntersectionPowerData_of_not_connectedSpace
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ¬ ConnectedSpace
        (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) →
      ∃ a b : Ideal C, ∃ n k : ℕ,
        Ideal.span {x} ≤ a ∧ Ideal.span {x} ≤ b ∧
        a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
        a ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ b ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
        a.IsRadical ∧ b.IsRadical ∧
        a ⊓ b = (Ideal.span {x}).radical ∧
        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C ∧
        (maximalIdeal C) ^ n ≤ a ⊔ b ∧
        (a * b) ^ k ≤ Ideal.span {x} := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro hnot
  obtain ⟨a, b, hxa, hxb, ha, hb, ham, hbm, haRadical, hbRadical,
      hinf, hsup⟩ :=
    exists_radical_nonmaximal_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_not_connectedSpace
      hdim x hx hnot
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_of_radical_eq hsup
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_product_pow_le_of_inf_eq_radical hinf
  exact
    ⟨a, b, n, k, hxa, hxb, ha, hb, ham, hbm, haRadical, hbRadical,
      hinf, hsup, hn, hk⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedSpace_spec_quotient_map_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
statement:
theorem connectedSpace_spec_quotient_map_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra R C]
    [Module.Finite R C] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    ConnectedSpace
      (Spec (.of (C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R C))))
proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal C := I.map (algebraMap R C)
  let Q := C ⧸ J
  let q : C →+* Q := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  let : IsAdicComplete I R :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isAdicComplete_of_le_maximalIdeal
      (M := R) I hI
  let : HenselianRing C J :=
    (open _root_.ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField in
      henselianRing_map_algebraMap_of_moduleFinite_of_isAdicComplete)
  have hJne : J ≠ ⊤ := by
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal C
    apply ne_top_of_le_ne_top hM.ne_top
    exact (HenselianRing.jac (R := C) (I := J)).trans
      (sInf_le ⟨bot_le, hM⟩)
  let : Nontrivial Q := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hJne
  have hker : RingHom.ker q = J := Ideal.mk_ker
  let : HenselianRing C (RingHom.ker q) := by
    rw [hker]
    infer_instance
  rw [connectedSpace_iff_clopen]
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.isClopen_iff.mp hs
  obtain ⟨e', he', he'map⟩ :=
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_idempotent_lift_of_surjective_henselianRing_ker
      q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective e he
  have he_cases : e = 0 ∨ e = 1 := by
    rcases IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp he' with he' | he'
    · left
      rw [← he'map, he', map_zero]
    · right
      rw [← he'map, he', map_one]
  rcases he_cases with rfl | rfl
  · left
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_zero]
    rfl
  · right
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_one]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedSpace_pullback_spec_quotient_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
statement:
theorem connectedSpace_pullback_spec_quotient_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra R C]
    [Module.Finite R C] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    ConnectedSpace
      ((Limits.pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I))))) : Scheme.{u})
proof:
:= by
  let Q := C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R C)
  let eRing : Q ≃+* C ⊗[R] (R ⧸ I) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot C I).toRingEquiv
  let eScheme :
      Limits.pullback
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C)))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I)))) ≅
        Spec (.of Q) :=
    pullbackSpecIso R C (R ⧸ I) ≪≫
      Scheme.Spec.mapIso eRing.toCommRingCatIso.op
  let : ConnectedSpace (Spec (.of Q)) :=
    connectedSpace_spec_quotient_map_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
      R I hI
  exact eScheme.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedSpace_normalizationClosedFiber_of_isFinite_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem connectedSpace_normalizationClosedFiber_of_isFinite_of_isIntegral
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (z : Z ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [IsFinite z] [IsIntegral Z]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    ConnectedSpace
      ((Limits.pullback z
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) : Scheme.{u})
proof:
:= by
  let : IsAffine Z := isAffine_of_isAffineHom z
  let C : Type u := Γ(Z, ⊤)
  let phi : R →+* C :=
    z.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom
  let : Algebra R C := phi.toAlgebra
  have hzApp : z.appTop.hom.Finite := by
    have hz : IsFinite z := inferInstance
    rw [HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := (@IsFinite : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}))
        (Q := affineAnd RingHom.Finite)] at hz
    exact hz.2
  have hphi : phi.Finite := by
    exact RingHom.Finite.comp hzApp
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.finite
  let : Module.Finite R C := by
    change phi.Finite
    exact hphi
  let e : Z ≅ Spec (.of C) := Z.isoSpec
  have he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi) = z := by
    have hphiCat : CommRingCat.ofHom phi =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ z.appTop := by
      ext r
      rfl
    have hSpec :
        Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ z.appTop) =
          Spec.map z.appTop ≫
            Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv :=
      Spec.map_comp _ _
    rw [hphiCat, hSpec]
    change Z.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map z.appTop ≫
        Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv = z
    rw [Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality_assoc]
    rw [Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, Spec.map_id,
      Category.comp_id]
  let eFiber :
      Limits.pullback z
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) ≅
        Limits.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) :=
    pullbackIsoOfIsoOver e z (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) he
  let : ConnectedSpace
      ((Limits.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) : Scheme.{u}) := by
    change ConnectedSpace
      ((Limits.pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I))))) : Scheme.{u})
    exact
      connectedSpace_pullback_spec_quotient_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
        R I hI
  exact eFiber.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquiv_apply_germ_source
statement:
private theorem puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquiv_apply_germ_source
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (r : Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤)) :
    let X
proof:
:= Spec (.of R)
    let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion j := by
      dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
    letI : Algebra R X.functionField :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : U.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint U, by trivial⟩⟩
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquivOfPositiveDimension R hpos
        (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r) =
      U.germToFunctionField ⊤ (j.appTop r) := by
  dsimp only
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  let : Algebra R X.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : U.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint U, by trivial⟩⟩
  let hgen : j (genericPoint U) = genericPoint X :=
    genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion j
  change j.stalkMap (genericPoint U)
      ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hgen.symm)).hom
        (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r)) =
    U.germToFunctionField ⊤ (j.appTop r)
  simp only [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom]
  have htransport :
      X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
          (Inseparable.of_eq hgen.symm).ge
          (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial) r) =
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (j (genericPoint U)) (by trivial) r := by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun
      (CommRingCat.hom_ext_iff.mp
        (X.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes
          (show genericPoint X ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) by trivial)
          (Inseparable.of_eq hgen.symm).ge)) r
  rw [htransport]
  exact j.germ_stalkMap_apply (⊤ : X.Opens) (genericPoint U)
    (by trivial) r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.specFunctionField_algebraMap_ΓSpecIso_hom_source
statement:
private theorem specFunctionField_algebraMap_ΓSpecIso_hom_source
    (r : Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤)) :
    let X
proof:
:= Spec (.of R)
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
    letI : Algebra R X.functionField :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
    algebraMap R X.functionField ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).hom r) =
      X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r := by
  dsimp only
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  let : Algebra R X.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
  change X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial)
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).hom r)) =
    X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r
  change X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial)
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).hom r)) =
    X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial) r
  exact congrArg (fun s ↦
    X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial) s)
      (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)) r)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCoverGenericNormalization_isFinite
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCoverGenericNormalization_isFinite
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    let j : U ⟶ Spec (.of R) := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion j := by
      dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
    IsFinite (connectedCoverGenericComposite W ≫ j).fromNormalization := by
  dsimp only
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : IsNormalIntegral U := inferInstance
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian U := inferInstance
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : U.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint U, by trivial⟩⟩
  let : Algebra R X.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
  let K : Type u := U.functionField
  let : Algebra R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R L :=
    ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap R K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
  let f : Spec (.of L) ⟶ U := connectedCoverGenericComposite W
  let g : Spec (.of L) ⟶ X := f ≫ j
  let : QuasiCompact g := inferInstance
  let : QuasiSeparated g := inferInstance
  let A : Type u := Γ(X, ⊤)
  let S : Type u := Γ(Spec (.of L), g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : X.Opens))
  let : Algebra A S := g.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  let eBase : A ≃+* R :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let eAmbientCat : CommRingCat.of S ≅ CommRingCat.of L := by
    change Γ(Spec (.of L), f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : U.Opens)) ≅ .of L
    exact connectedCoverGenericCompositeSectionsIso W
  let eAmbient : S ≃+* L := eAmbientCat.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hCompat :
      eAmbient.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A S) =
        (algebraMap R L).comp eBase.toRingHom := by
    ext a
    change eAmbient (g.appTop a) = algebraMap R L (eBase a)
    change (connectedCoverGenericCompositeSectionsIso W).hom
        (f.appTop (j.appTop a)) = algebraMap R L (eBase a)
    rw [connectedCoverGenericCompositeSectionsIso_hom_appTop]
    change algebraMap K L (U.germToFunctionField ⊤ (j.appTop a)) =
      algebraMap K L (algebraMap R K (eBase a))
    congr 1
    rw [← puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquiv_apply_germ_source R hpos a]
    change (puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquivOfPositiveDimension R hpos)
        (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ a) =
      (puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquivOfPositiveDimension R hpos)
        (algebraMap R X.functionField (eBase a))
    congr 1
    exact (specFunctionField_algebraMap_ΓSpecIso_hom_source R a).symm
  let C : Type u := integralClosure A S
  let CR : Type u := integralClosure R L
  let : Module.Finite R CR :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_finite_of_positiveDimension
      R hpos W
  let : Algebra A CR :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosureBaseRingAlgebra eBase
  let eC : C ≃ₐ[A] CR :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosureAlgEquivOfBaseAndAmbientEquiv
      eBase eAmbient hCompat
  let : Algebra A R := eBase.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A R CR := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : Module.Finite A R := eBase.finite
  let : Module.Finite A CR := Module.Finite.trans R CR
  let : Module.Finite A C := Module.Finite.equiv eC.symm.toLinearEquiv
  have hfiniteC : (algebraMap A C).Finite := by
    change Module.Finite A C
    infer_instance
  have hApp : g.fromNormalization.appTop.hom.Finite := by
    change (g.fromNormalization.app (⊤ : X.Opens)).hom.Finite
    rw [g.fromNormalization_app (isAffineOpen_top X)]
    exact RingHom.Finite.comp
      (g.normalizationObjIso (isAffineOpen_top X)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.finite
      hfiniteC
  rw [HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := (@IsFinite : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}))
        (Q := affineAnd RingHom.Finite)]
  exact ⟨isAffine_of_isAffineHom g.fromNormalization, hApp⟩

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCover_localIntegralClosure_etale
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCover_localIntegralClosure_etale
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W]
    (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime] (hq : q.height = 1) :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    let : IsIntegrallyClosed R :=
      (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity in
        isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two hdim)
    let : Nonempty U := puncturedSpectrum_nonempty R hdim
    let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
      dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    let : IsIntegral U :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
    let : IsNormalIntegral U := inferInstance
    let : IsLocallyNoetherian U := inferInstance
    let : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebra R hdim
    let : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing R hdim
    let : IsIntegral W.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    let : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    let : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
    let : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    let : FiniteDimensional U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
    let : Algebra.IsSeparable U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra
        (K := U.functionField) (L := W.left.functionField) q
    Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime q) W.left.functionField) := by
  intro U hClosed hU hj hIntegralU hNormalU hNoetherianU algebraR_U
    hFractionU hIntegralW algebraU_W algebraR_W tower hFinite hSeparable algebraQ_W
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let : Algebra R X.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
  let K : Type u := U.functionField
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let : IsScalarTower R (Localization.AtPrime q) L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) q
  have hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height = (2 : ℕ∞) := by
    have hcast :
        (((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim, hdim]
    exact WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hcast
  have hqmax : q ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    intro h
    subst q
    rw [hmax] at hq
    norm_num at hq
  let p : PrimeSpectrum R := ⟨q, inferInstance⟩
  have hp : p ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint (CommRingCat.of R) := by
    intro h
    apply hqmax
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h
  let x : U :=
    ⟨p, (Scheme.mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff R p).2 hp⟩
  let stalkAlg : Algebra (U.presheaf.stalk x) L :=
    U.stalkExtensionAlgebra x L
  have hstalk : Algebra.Etale (U.presheaf.stalk x)
      (integralClosure (U.presheaf.stalk x) L) :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_functionField_etale_on_stalk_of_finiteEtale_isConnected
      W x
  let eCat : U.presheaf.stalk x ≅
      CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
    (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R).stalkIso x ≪≫
      Spec.stalkIso (.of R) p
  let e : Localization.AtPrime q ≃+* U.presheaf.stalk x :=
    eCat.symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have he : (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk x) L).comp e.toRingHom =
      algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) L := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext q.primeCompl
    ext r
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (Localization.AtPrime q) L r]
    change algebraMap K L
        (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk x) K
          (e (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) r))) =
      algebraMap K L (algebraMap R K r)
    congr 1
    change algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk x) K
        (((Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R).stalkIso x).inv
          ((Spec.stalkIso (.of R) p).inv
            (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) r))) =
      algebraMap R K r
    rw [Scheme.Opens.stalkIso_inv]
    let j : U ⟶ Spec (.of R) := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
    let hg := (genericPoint_spec U).specializes (show x ∈ Set.univ by trivial)
    change U.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hg
        (j.stalkMap x
          ((Spec.stalkIso (.of R) p).inv
            (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) r))) =
      (puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquiv R hdim)
        (algebraMap R (Spec (.of R)).functionField r)
    refine (j.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply
      (genericPoint U) x hg
      ((Spec.stalkIso (.of R) p).inv
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) r))).symm.trans ?_
    have hspec :
        (Spec.stalkIso (.of R) p).inv
            (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) r) =
          (Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r) := by
      have hRing :
          (Spec.stalkIso (.of R) p).inv.hom.comp
              (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q)) =
            ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial).hom.comp
              (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv.hom :=
        CommRingCat.hom_ext_iff.mp
          (Spec.algebraMap_stalkIso_inv (R := CommRingCat.of R) p)
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hRing r
    rw [hspec]
    change j.stalkMap (genericPoint U)
        ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalkSpecializes
          (j.base.hom.map_specializes hg)
          ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (j x) trivial
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r))) =
      (puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquiv R hdim)
        (algebraMap R (Spec (.of R)).functionField r)
    have hgerm := DFunLike.congr_fun
      (CommRingCat.hom_ext_iff.mp
        ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes
          (show j x ∈ (⊤ : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) by trivial)
          (j.base.hom.map_specializes hg)))
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)
    have hgerm' :
        (Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalkSpecializes
            (j.base.hom.map_specializes hg)
            ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (j x) trivial
              ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)) =
          (Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (j (genericPoint U)) trivial
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r) := by
      change (CommRingCat.Hom.hom
          ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (j x) trivial ≫
            (Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalkSpecializes
              (j.base.hom.map_specializes hg)))
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r) = _
      exact hgerm
    rw [hgerm']
    let : Nonempty (⊤ : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint (Spec (.of R)), trivial⟩⟩
    let hgen : j (genericPoint U) = genericPoint (Spec (.of R)) :=
      genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion j
    change j.stalkMap (genericPoint U)
        ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (j (genericPoint U)) trivial
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)) =
      (puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquiv R hdim)
        ((Spec (.of R)).germToFunctionField ⊤
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r))
    change j.stalkMap (genericPoint U)
        ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (j (genericPoint U)) trivial
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)) =
      j.stalkMap (genericPoint U)
        ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalkSpecializes
          (Inseparable.of_eq hgen.symm).ge
          ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤
            (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) trivial
            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)))
    congr 1
    have hgeneric := DFunLike.congr_fun
      (CommRingCat.hom_ext_iff.mp
        ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes
          (show genericPoint (Spec (.of R)) ∈
            (⊤ : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) by trivial)
          (Inseparable.of_eq hgen.symm).ge))
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)
    symm
    change (CommRingCat.Hom.hom
        ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.germ ⊤
            (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) trivial ≫
          (Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalkSpecializes
            (Inseparable.of_eq hgen.symm).ge))
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r) = _
    exact hgeneric
  exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_etale_of_baseRingEquiv
    e he hstalk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_etale
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_etale
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    let : IsIntegrallyClosed R :=
      (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity in
        isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two hdim)
    let : Nonempty U := puncturedSpectrum_nonempty R hdim
    let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
      dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    let : IsIntegral U :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
    let : IsNormalIntegral U := inferInstance
    let : IsLocallyNoetherian U := inferInstance
    let : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebra R hdim
    let : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing R hdim
    let : IsIntegral W.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    let : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    let : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
    let : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    let : FiniteDimensional U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
    let : Algebra.IsSeparable U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R W.left.functionField) := by
  intro U hClosed hU hj hIntegralU hNormalU hNoetherianU algebraR_U
    hFractionU hIntegralW algebraU_W algebraR_W tower hFinite hSeparable
  let K : Type u := U.functionField
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  apply
    (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity in
      integralClosure_etale_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two (K := K) hdim)
  intro q _ hq
  exact
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_integralClosure_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
      (K := K) (L := L) q
      (connectedPuncturedCover_localIntegralClosure_etale R hdim W q hq)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
statement:
theorem exists_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},
      IsOpen A₀ → IsOpen B₀ →
      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →
      Disjoint A₀ B₀ → A₀.Nonempty → B₀.Nonempty →
      ∃ a b : Ideal C,
        Ideal.span {x} ≤ a ∧ Ideal.span {x} ≤ b ∧
        a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
        a ⊓ b = (Ideal.span {x}).radical ∧
        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  let I : Ideal C := Ideal.span {x}
  let D := C ⧸ I
  let q : C →+* D := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hinf, hradical⟩ :=
    exists_proper_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
      hdim x hx hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  let A : Ideal C := a.comap q
  let B : Ideal C := b.comap q
  have hIA : I ≤ A := by
    rw [← Ideal.mk_ker (I := I), RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  have hIB : I ≤ B := by
    rw [← Ideal.mk_ker (I := I), RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  have hA : A ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.comap_ne_top q ha
  have hB : B ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.comap_ne_top q hb
  have hABinf : A ⊓ B = I.radical := by
    calc
      A ⊓ B = Ideal.comap q (a ⊓ b) := (Ideal.comap_inf q a b).symm
      _ = Ideal.comap q (nilradical D) := by rw [hinf]
      _ = Ideal.comap q (Ideal.radical ⊥) := rfl
      _ = Ideal.radical (Ideal.comap q ⊥) := Ideal.comap_radical q ⊥
      _ = I.radical := by
        rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
  have hcomapSup : Ideal.comap q (a ⊔ b) = A ⊔ B := by
    calc
      Ideal.comap q (a ⊔ b) =
          Ideal.comap q ((A ⊔ B).map q) := by
        congr 1
        dsimp only [A, B]
        exact (Ideal.map_sup_comap_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a b).symm
      _ = (A ⊔ B) ⊔ Ideal.comap q ⊥ :=
        Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (A ⊔ B)
      _ = A ⊔ B := by
        rw [sup_eq_left]
        exact (Ideal.comap_mono bot_le).trans le_sup_left
  have hABradical : (A ⊔ B).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
    have h := congrArg (Ideal.comap q) hradical
    rw [Ideal.comap_radical, hcomapSup,
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q] at h
    exact h
  exact ⟨A, B, hIA, hIB, hA, hB, hABinf, hABradical⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_radical_nonmaximal_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
statement:
theorem exists_radical_nonmaximal_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},
      IsOpen A₀ → IsOpen B₀ →
      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →
      Disjoint A₀ B₀ → A₀.Nonempty → B₀.Nonempty →
      ∃ a b : Ideal C,
        Ideal.span {x} ≤ a ∧ Ideal.span {x} ≤ b ∧
        a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
        a ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ b ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
        a.IsRadical ∧ b.IsRadical ∧
        a ⊓ b = (Ideal.span {x}).radical ∧
        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  let I : Ideal C := Ideal.span {x}
  let D := C ⧸ I
  let q : C →+* D := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hamax, hbmax, haRadical, hbRadical,
      hinf, hradical⟩ :=
    exists_radical_nonmaximal_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
      hdim x hx hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  let A : Ideal C := a.comap q
  let B : Ideal C := b.comap q
  have hIA : I ≤ A := by
    rw [← Ideal.mk_ker (I := I), RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  have hIB : I ≤ B := by
    rw [← Ideal.mk_ker (I := I), RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  have hA : A ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.comap_ne_top q ha
  have hB : B ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.comap_ne_top q hb
  have hAmax : A ≠ maximalIdeal C := by
    intro h
    apply hamax
    calc
      a = A.map q :=
        (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a).symm
      _ = (maximalIdeal C).map q := congrArg (Ideal.map q) h
      _ = maximalIdeal D :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hBmax : B ≠ maximalIdeal C := by
    intro h
    apply hbmax
    calc
      b = B.map q :=
        (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b).symm
      _ = (maximalIdeal C).map q := congrArg (Ideal.map q) h
      _ = maximalIdeal D :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hARadical : A.IsRadical := by
    dsimp only [A]
    exact haRadical.comap q
  have hBRadical : B.IsRadical := by
    dsimp only [B]
    exact hbRadical.comap q
  have hABinf : A ⊓ B = I.radical := by
    calc
      A ⊓ B = Ideal.comap q (a ⊓ b) := (Ideal.comap_inf q a b).symm
      _ = Ideal.comap q (nilradical D) := by rw [hinf]
      _ = Ideal.comap q (Ideal.radical ⊥) := rfl
      _ = Ideal.radical (Ideal.comap q ⊥) := Ideal.comap_radical q ⊥
      _ = I.radical := by
        rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
  have hcomapSup : Ideal.comap q (a ⊔ b) = A ⊔ B := by
    calc
      Ideal.comap q (a ⊔ b) =
          Ideal.comap q ((A ⊔ B).map q) := by
        congr 1
        dsimp only [A, B]
        exact (Ideal.map_sup_comap_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a b).symm
      _ = (A ⊔ B) ⊔ Ideal.comap q ⊥ :=
        Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (A ⊔ B)
      _ = A ⊔ B := by
        rw [sup_eq_left]
        exact (Ideal.comap_mono bot_le).trans le_sup_left
  have hABradical : (A ⊔ B).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
    have h := congrArg (Ideal.comap q) hradical
    rw [Ideal.comap_radical, hcomapSup,
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q] at h
    exact h
  exact
    ⟨A, B, hIA, hIB, hA, hB, hAmax, hBmax, hARadical, hBRadical,
      hABinf, hABradical⟩

        a ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ b ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
