name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.irreducibleComponent_inter_subset_partition_side
statement:
theorem irreducibleComponent_inter_subset_partition_side
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X)
    {U A B : Set X} (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hcover : A ∪ B = U) (hdisjoint : Disjoint A B) :
    Z ∩ U ⊆ A ∨ Z ∩ U ⊆ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hleft : Z ∩ U ⊆ A
  · exact Or.inl hleft
  · right
    obtain ⟨y, hyZU, hyA⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hleft
    have hyB : y ∈ B := by
      have hyAB : y ∈ A ∪ B := hcover.symm ▸ hyZU.2
      exact hyAB.resolve_left hyA
    intro z hzZU
    by_contra hzB
    have hzA : z ∈ A := by
      have hzAB : z ∈ A ∪ B := hcover.symm ▸ hzZU.2
      exact hzAB.resolve_right hzB
    obtain ⟨w, hwZ, hwAB⟩ :=
      hZ.1.2 A B hA hB ⟨z, hzZU.1, hzA⟩ ⟨y, hyZU.1, hyB⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hwAB.1 hwAB.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.inter_subset_compl_of_component_partition_sides
statement:
theorem inter_subset_compl_of_component_partition_sides
    {X : Type u} {Z W U A B : Set X}
    (hZ : Z ∩ U ⊆ A) (hW : W ∩ U ⊆ B)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint A B) :
    Z ∩ W ⊆ Uᶜ
proof:
:= by
  intro z hzZW hzU
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
    (hZ ⟨hzZW.1, hzU⟩) (hW ⟨hzZW.2, hzU⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.minimalPrime_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem minimalPrime_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (P : Ideal C) (hP : P ∈ (Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes) :
    P ≠ maximalIdeal C
proof:
:= by
  intro hPmax
  have hheight : P.height ≤ 1 :=
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes
      (Ideal.span {x}) P hP
  have hdim' : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hPmax, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]
    exact hdim
  have : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    hdim'.trans (WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr hheight)
  norm_num at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C)
    (Q : Ideal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))
    (hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    Q ≠ maximalIdeal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
  let I : Ideal C := Ideal.span {x}
  let q : C →+* C ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal C :=
    (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : Nontrivial (C ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hIle
  let : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hcomap : Q.comap q ∈ I.minimalPrimes := by
    have hQ' : Q ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (C ⧸ I)).minimalPrimes := hQ
    have := Ideal.minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hQ'
    simpa only [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, q, Ideal.mk_ker] using this
  intro hQmax
  apply minimalPrime_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal hdim x (Q.comap q) hcomap
  rw [hQmax]
  exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.irreducibleComponent_quotient_span_singleton_inter_puncture_nonempty
statement:
theorem irreducibleComponent_quotient_span_singleton_inter_puncture_nonempty
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C)
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})))
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (Z ∩ ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
      Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})))).Nonempty := by
  let B := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial B :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing B :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let Q : Ideal B := PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z
  have hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes B := by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_irreducibleComponents B]
    exact ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQ.isPrime
  let q : PrimeSpectrum B := ⟨Q, inferInstance⟩
  have hqZ : q ∈ Z := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed Z := isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ
    have hzero : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q = Z := by
      change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z) = Z
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
        hclosed.closure_eq]
    rw [← hzero]
    exact show Q ≤ q.asIdeal from le_rfl
  have hqne : q ≠ closedPoint B := by
    intro hq
    apply minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal hdim x hx Q hQ
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hq
  refine ⟨q, hqZ, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hqne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.hasPuncturedPurity_iff
statement:
theorem hasPuncturedPurity_iff
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] :
    HasPuncturedPurity R ↔
      ∀ Y : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R),
        ∃ X : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of R)),
          Nonempty
            ((pullback (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)).obj X ≅ Y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h Y
    exact h.mem_essImage Y
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun Y ↦ h Y⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_surjective_puncturedSpectrum
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_surjective_puncturedSpectrum
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (hdim : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) :
    Function.Surjective
      (fundamentalGroupHom (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) xi)
proof:
:= by
  let j := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : Nonempty (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hdim
  exact fundamentalGroupHom_surjective_of_isOpenImmersion j xi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom_bijective_puncturedSpectrum_of_hasPuncturedPurity
statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupHom_bijective_puncturedSpectrum_of_hasPuncturedPurity
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (hdim : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (hpurity : HasPuncturedPurity R)
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fundamentalGroupHom (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) xi)
proof:
:= by
  let j := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : Nonempty (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hdim
  let : IsIntegral (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : ConnectedSpace (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) := inferInstance
  let : (pullback j).EssSurj := hpurity
  constructor
  · exact fundamentalGroupHom_injective_of_pullback_essSurj j xi
  · exact fundamentalGroupHom_surjective_puncturedSpectrum R hdim xi

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.quotient_linearMap_range_le_torsionBySet
statement:
private theorem quotient_linearMap_range_le_torsionBySet
    (I : Ideal R) (f : (R ⧸ I) →ₗ[R] E) :
    LinearMap.range f ≤ Submodule.torsionBySet R E I
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hz
  apply (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (I : Set R) (f q)).mpr
  intro a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
  rw [← f.map_smul]
  have hquot : (a : R) • Ideal.Quotient.mk I b = 0 := by
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk I ((a : R) * b) = 0
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (I.mul_mem_right b a.property)
  rw [hquot, map_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet_apply
statement:
theorem quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet_apply
    (I : Ideal R) (f : (R ⧸ I) →ₗ[R] E) :
    (quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet (R := R) (E := E) I f : E) =
      f (Ideal.Quotient.mk I 1)
proof: := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet_symm_apply_mk
statement:
theorem quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet_symm_apply_mk
    (I : Ideal R) (z : Submodule.torsionBySet R E I) (a : R) :
    (quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet (R := R) (E := E) I).symm z
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) = a • (z : E)
proof: := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.torsionBySet_maximalIdeal_eq_range
statement:
theorem torsionBySet_maximalIdeal_eq_range
    (i : (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E)
    (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i)) :
    Submodule.torsionBySet R E (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) =
      LinearMap.range i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm ?_
    (quotient_linearMap_range_le_torsionBySet (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) i)
  intro z hz
  have hzAnn : ∀ a : R, a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R → a • z = (0 : E) := by
    intro a ha
    exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (R := R) (M := E)
      (s := ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R : Ideal R) : Set R)) z).mp hz ⟨a, ha⟩
  by_contra hzRange
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint (LinearMap.range i) (Submodule.span R {z}) := by
    apply (Submodule.disjoint_span_singleton'' (R := R) (M := E)
      (s := LinearMap.range i) (x := z)).mpr
    intro a hwRange
    by_cases ha : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
    · exact hzAnn a ha
    · have haUnit : IsUnit a := by
        by_contra haNotUnit
        exact ha ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal a).mpr haNotUnit)
      obtain ⟨unit, rfl⟩ := haUnit
      have hzIn : z ∈ LinearMap.range i := by
        have hmul := (LinearMap.range i).smul_mem (↑unit⁻¹ : R) hwRange
        simpa only [smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul] using hmul
      exact False.elim (hzRange hzIn)
  have hspan : Submodule.span R {z} = ⊥ :=
    hess (Submodule.span R {z}) hdisjoint
  have hzSpan : z ∈ Submodule.span R {z} := Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self z
  rw [hspan] at hzSpan
  have hzZero : z = 0 := (Submodule.mem_bot R).mp hzSpan
  apply hzRange
  rw [hzZero]
  exact (LinearMap.range i).zero_mem

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.idealPowerTorsionFunctor_map_surjective_of_quotient_lifting
statement:
theorem idealPowerTorsionFunctor_map_surjective_of_quotient_lifting
    (I : Ideal R) (J : ℕ → Ideal R)
    (hJI : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, J m ≤ I ^ n)
    (hIJ : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, I ^ n ≤ J m)
    {A B : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (hlift : ∀ m : ℕ, Function.Surjective
      (fun g : (R ⧸ J m) →ₗ[R] A => f.hom.comp g)) :
    Function.Surjective ((idealPowerTorsionFunctor I).map f)
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Surjective (Ideal.primaryComponent.map I f.hom)
  intro z
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := B) (I := I) (z : B)).mp z.property
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hJI n
  let zMap : R →ₗ[R] B := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R B (z : B)
  have hzMap : J m ≤ LinearMap.ker zMap := by
    intro a ha
    change a • (z : B) = 0
    exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff ((I ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) (z : B)).mp hn
      ⟨a, hm ha⟩
  let qz : (R ⧸ J m) →ₗ[R] B := (J m).liftQ zMap hzMap
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hlift m qz
  let y : A := g ((J m).mkQ 1)
  have hy : y ∈ Ideal.primaryComponent A I := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hIJ m
    apply (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := A) (I := I) y).mpr
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    apply (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff ((I ^ k : Ideal R) : Set R) y).mpr
    intro a
    have hq : (a : R) • (J m).mkQ 1 = 0 := by
      rw [← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (J m)).mpr (hk a.property)
    change (a : R) • g ((J m).mkQ 1) = 0
    rw [← g.map_smul, hq, map_zero]
  refine ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change f.hom y = (z : B)
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hg ((J m).mkQ 1)
  change f.hom y = (1 : R) • (z : B) at h
  simpa only [one_smul] using h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isFiniteLength_torsionBySet_maximalIdeal_of_artinian
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_torsionBySet_maximalIdeal_of_artinian
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [IsArtinian R (Submodule.torsionBySet R M (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))] :
    IsFiniteLength R (Submodule.torsionBySet R M (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_quotientPowers_hasProjectiveDimensionLT
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_quotientPowers_hasProjectiveDimensionLT
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (d i : ℕ) (hdi : d ≤ i)
    (hpd : ∀ n : ℕ,
      HasProjectiveDimensionLT (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) d) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M i)
proof:
:= by
  apply derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_subsingleton_ext_powers
  intro n
  let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)
  let : HasProjectiveDimensionLT N d := hpd n
  exact HasProjectiveDimensionLT.subsingleton N d i hdi M

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_span_singleton_isZero_of_isSMulRegular
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_span_singleton_isZero_of_isSMulRegular
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (x : R) (hxreg : IsSMulRegular R x)
    (hxmem : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) (hi : 2 ≤ i) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (Ideal.span {x}) M i)
proof:
:= by
  apply derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_quotientPowers_hasProjectiveDimensionLT
    (Ideal.span {x}) M 2 i hi
  intro n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
    let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ (⊤ : Ideal R))
    have hN : IsZero N := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton N
    let : HasProjectiveDimensionLT N 0 :=
      hN.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge N 0 2 (by omega)
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    exact quotient_span_singleton_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_two
      (x ^ (n + 1)) (hxreg.pow (n + 1))
      ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).pow_mem_of_mem hxmem
        (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isFiniteLength_quotient_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_quotient_maximalIdeal_pow (n : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteLength R (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have hart : IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R ^ n) := by
    cases n with
    | zero =>
        rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]
        infer_instance
    | succ n =>
        apply IsLocalRing.quotient_artinian_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing
        rw [← Ideal.radical_minimalPrimes,
          (maximalIdeal R).radical_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero n),
          (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).isPrime.isRadical.radical,
          Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_subsingleton_self]
        exact Set.mem_singleton (maximalIdeal R)
  let : IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R ^ n) := hart
  have hartR : IsArtinian R (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R ^ n) :=
    isArtinian_of_surjective_algebraMap
      (R := R ⧸ maximalIdeal R ^ n) (S := R) (M := R ⧸ maximalIdeal R ^ n)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  exact isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr ⟨inferInstance, hartR⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechLocalizationComplex_isZero_X
statement:
theorem cechLocalizationComplex_isZero_X (xs : List R) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : xs.length < n) : IsZero ((cechLocalizationComplex xs).X n)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing n with
  | nil =>
    exact HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
      0 (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R)) n (by simpa only [List.length_nil] using hn.ne')
  | cons x xs ih =>
    apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
    apply HomologicalComplex₂.total.hom_ext
    intro i j hij
    have hij' : i + j = n := hij
    have hz : IsZero ((principalLocalizationComplex x (ModuleCat.of R R)).X i ⊗
        (cechLocalizationComplex xs).X j) := by
      by_cases hi : 1 < i
      · exact (tensorRight ((cechLocalizationComplex xs).X j)).map_isZero
          (principalLocalizationComplex_isZero_X x (ModuleCat.of R R) i hi)
      · exact (tensorLeft ((principalLocalizationComplex x (ModuleCat.of R R)).X i)).map_isZero
          (ih j (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hn; omega))
    exact hz.eq_of_src _ _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.flat_finite_coproduct
statement:
private theorem flat_finite_coproduct {ι : Type} [Finite ι]
    (M : ι → ModuleCat.{u} R) (hM : ∀ i, Module.Flat R (M i)) :
    Module.Flat R (∐ M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
proof:
:= by
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let : ∀ i, Module.Flat R (M i) := hM
  let e : (∐ M : ModuleCat.{u} R) ≅ ModuleCat.of R (∀ i, M i) :=
    (biproduct.isoCoproduct M).symm ≪≫ ModuleCat.biproductIsoPi M
  let : Module.Flat R (∀ i, M i) :=
    Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (DFinsupp.linearEquivFunOnFintype (R := R) (M := fun i => M i)).symm
  exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv e.toLinearEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.cechLocalizationComplex_flat_X
statement:
theorem cechLocalizationComplex_flat_X (xs : List R) (n : ℕ) :
    Module.Flat R ((cechLocalizationComplex xs).X n)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing n with
  | nil =>
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv
        (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXIsoOfEq (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
          0 (𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R)) 0 rfl).toLinearEquiv
    · have hz := cechLocalizationComplex_isZero_X ([] : List R) n (by
        simp only [List.length_nil]
        exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
      let : Subsingleton ((cechLocalizationComplex ([] : List R)).X n) :=
        ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz
      infer_instance
  | cons x xs ih =>
    let A := (principalLocalizationComplex x (ModuleCat.of R R)).X
    let B := (cechLocalizationComplex xs).X
    let J := {p : ℕ × ℕ // p.1 + p.2 = n}
    let f : J → Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) := fun p =>
      (⟨p.1.1, by have hp := p.2; omega⟩, ⟨p.1.2, by have hp := p.2; omega⟩)
    have hf : Function.Injective f := by
      intro p q hpq
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Prod.ext (congrArg (fun z => z.1.val) hpq) (congrArg (fun z => z.2.val) hpq)
    let : Finite J := Finite.of_injective f hf
    change Module.Flat R (∐ (fun p : J => A p.1.1 ⊗ B p.1.2) : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    apply flat_finite_coproduct
    intro p
    let : Module.Flat R (A p.1.1) :=
      principalLocalizationComplex_flat_X x (ModuleCat.of R R) p.1.1
    let : Module.Flat R (B p.1.2) := ih p.1.2
    change Module.Flat R ((A p.1.1) ⊗[R] (B p.1.2))
    infer_instance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.extToTorsionCocycleQuotient_extMk
statement:
private theorem extToTorsionCocycleQuotient_extMk
    (I : Ideal R) (J : InjectiveResolution M) (n k : ℕ)
    (f : ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ k) ⟶ J.cocomplex.X (n + 1))
    (hf : f ≫ J.cocomplex.d (n + 1) (n + 2) = 0) :
    extToTorsionCocycleQuotient I J n k (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (quotientCyclesToPowerTorsionCycles I J n k ⟨f, hf⟩)
proof:
:= by
  change quotientCocyclesToTorsionCocycleQuotient I J n k
    ((injectiveResolutionCocycleQuotientEquivExtSucc J
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ k)) n).symm
        (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf)) = _
  rw [injectiveResolutionCocycleQuotientEquivExtSucc_symm_extMk]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotientAddHom_ι
statement:
private theorem localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotientAddHom_ι
    (I : Ideal R) (J : InjectiveResolution M) (n k : ℕ)
    (α : Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ k)) M (n + 1)) :
    localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotientAddHom I J n
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M (n + 1)) (op (op k)) α) =
      extToTorsionCocycleQuotient I J n k α
proof:
:=
  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (colimit.ι_desc (torsionCocycleQuotientCocone I J n) (op (op k))) α

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotient_surjective
statement:
private theorem localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotient_surjective
    (I : Ideal R) (J : InjectiveResolution M) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotient I J n)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (LinearMap.range (torsionShortComplex I J n).moduleCatToCycles) z
  let z₀ : Ideal.primaryComponent (J.cocomplex.X (n + 1)) I := z.1
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := J.cocomplex.X (n + 1))
    (I := I) (z₀ : J.cocomplex.X (n + 1))).mp z₀.property
  let zk : Submodule.torsionBySet R (J.cocomplex.X (n + 1))
      ((I ^ k : Ideal R) : Set R) := ⟨z₀, hk⟩
  let f : ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ k) ⟶ J.cocomplex.X (n + 1) :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom ((quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet (I ^ k)).symm zk)
  have hf : f ≫ J.cocomplex.d (n + 1) (n + 2) = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro q
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
    change J.cocomplex.d (n + 1) (n + 2)
      ((quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet (I ^ k)).symm zk (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ k) a)) = 0
    rw [quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet_symm_apply_mk, map_smul]
    have hz : J.cocomplex.d (n + 1) (n + 2) (z₀ : J.cocomplex.X (n + 1)) = 0 :=
      congr_arg Subtype.val z.2
    rw [hz, smul_zero]
  refine ⟨derivedLocalCohomologyModuleι I M (n + 1) k
    (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf), ?_⟩
  change localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotientAddHom I J n
    (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M (n + 1)) (op (op k))
      (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf)) = Submodule.Quotient.mk z
  refine (localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotientAddHom_ι I J n k
    (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf)).trans
      ((extToTorsionCocycleQuotient_extMk I J n k f hf).trans ?_)
  apply congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet (I ^ k)).symm zk
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ k) 1) = (z₀ : J.cocomplex.X (n + 1))
  rw [quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet_symm_apply_mk, one_smul]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotient_injective
statement:
private theorem localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotient_injective
    (I : Ideal R) (J : InjectiveResolution M) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotient I J n)
proof:
:= by
  let : PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    preservesSmallestFilteredColimits_of_preservesFilteredColimits _
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨k, α, hα⟩ :=
    Concrete.colimit_exists_rep (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M (n + 1)) z
  rcases k with ⟨⟨k⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := J.extMk_surjective α (n + 2) (by omega)
  rw [← hα] at hz
  change localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotientAddHom I J n
    (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M (n + 1)) (op (op k))
      (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf)) = 0 at hz
  change ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ k) ⟶ J.cocomplex.X (n + 1) at f
  have hzero := (extToTorsionCocycleQuotient_extMk I J n k f hf).symm.trans
    ((localCohomologyToTorsionCocycleQuotientAddHom_ι I J n k
      (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf)).symm.trans hz)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hzero
  let y₀ : Ideal.primaryComponent (J.cocomplex.X n) I := y
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := J.cocomplex.X n)
    (I := I) (y₀ : J.cocomplex.X n)).mp y₀.property
  let p : ℕ := max k l
  let t : op (op k) ⟶ op (op p) := (homOfLE (Nat.le_max_left k l)).op.op
  let q : ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ p) ⟶ ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ k) :=
    (localCohomology.ringModIdeals (localCohomology.idealPowersDiagram I)).map t.unop
  have hyp : (y₀ : J.cocomplex.X n) ∈ Submodule.torsionBySet R (J.cocomplex.X n)
      ((I ^ p : Ideal R) : Set R) := by
    apply (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff ((I ^ p : Ideal R) : Set R)
      (y₀ : J.cocomplex.X n)).mpr
    intro a
    exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff ((I ^ l : Ideal R) : Set R)
      (y₀ : J.cocomplex.X n)).mp hl
      ⟨a, Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_max_right k l) a.property⟩
  let yp : Submodule.torsionBySet R (J.cocomplex.X n) ((I ^ p : Ideal R) : Set R) :=
    ⟨y₀, hyp⟩
  let g : ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ p) ⟶ J.cocomplex.X n :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom ((quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet (I ^ p : Ideal R)).symm yp)
  have hboundary : J.cocomplex.d n (n + 1) (y₀ : J.cocomplex.X n) =
      f (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ k) 1) :=
    congr_arg
      (fun c : LinearMap.ker (torsionShortComplex I J n).g.hom =>
        ((show Ideal.primaryComponent (J.cocomplex.X (n + 1)) I from c.1) :
          J.cocomplex.X (n + 1))) hy
  have hg : g ≫ J.cocomplex.d n (n + 1) = q ≫ f := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro b
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
    change J.cocomplex.d n (n + 1)
        ((quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet (I ^ p)).symm yp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ p) a)) =
      f (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ k) a)
    rw [quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet_symm_apply_mk, map_smul, hboundary,
      ← f.hom.map_smul]
    congr 1
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ k) (a * 1) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ k) a
    rw [mul_one]
  have htransition : (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M (n + 1)).map t
      (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf) = 0 := by
    change (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ q).comp (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf)
      (zero_add (n + 1)) = 0
    exact (J.mk₀_comp_extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf q).trans
      ((J.extMk_eq_zero_iff (q ≫ f) (n + 2) (by omega)
        (by
            exact (Category.assoc q f (J.cocomplex.d (n + 1) (n + 2))).trans
              ((congrArg (fun k => q ≫ k) hf).trans (Limits.comp_zero))) n rfl).mpr ⟨g, hg⟩)
  have hι := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (colimit.w (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M (n + 1)) t)
      (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf)
  change colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M (n + 1)) (op (op p))
      ((derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M (n + 1)).map t
        (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf)) =
    colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M (n + 1)) (op (op k))
      (J.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf) at hι
  rw [htransition, map_zero, hα] at hι
  exact hι.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyModule_smul_eq_zero_of_coefficients
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyModule_smul_eq_zero_of_coefficients
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ) (a : R)
    (ha : ∀ m : M, a • m = 0)
    (z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I M n) : a • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have haid : a • 𝟙 M = 0 := by
    ext m
    exact ha m
  let : PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    preservesSmallestFilteredColimits_of_preservesFilteredColimits _
  obtain ⟨k, α, hα⟩ :=
    Concrete.colimit_exists_rep (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M n) z
  rcases k with ⟨⟨s⟩⟩
  let α' : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ s)) M n := α
  have hαzero : a • α' = 0 := by
    rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.smul_eq_comp_mk₀, haid,
      CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_zero, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_zero]
  have hrep : derivedLocalCohomologyModuleι I M n s α' = z := hα
  rw [← hrep, ← (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleι I M n s).map_smul a α',
    hαzero, map_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyModule_mul_smul_eq_zero_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyModule_mul_smul_eq_zero_of_shortExact
    (I : Ideal R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (n : ℕ) (a b : R) (ha : ∀ m : S.X₃, a • m = 0)
    (hb : ∀ w : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I S.X₂ (n + 1), b • w = 0)
    (z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I S.X₁ (n + 1)) :
    (a * b) • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsFirstMap I hS (n + 1)
  let δ := derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS n
  have hf : f (b • z) = 0 := by
    rw [map_smul]
    exact hb (f z)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
    (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficients_afterConnecting_exact I hS n
      (b • z)).mp hf
  calc
    (a * b) • z = a • (b • z) := mul_smul a b z
    _ = a • δ w := congrArg (fun v => a • v) hw.symm
    _ = δ (a • w) := (map_smul δ a w).symm
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [derivedLocalCohomologyModule_smul_eq_zero_of_coefficients I S.X₃ n a ha,
        map_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyModule_smul_eq_zero_of_injective_middle
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyModule_smul_eq_zero_of_injective_middle
    (I : Ideal R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [Module.Injective R S.X₂] (n : ℕ) (a : R)
    (ha : ∀ w : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I S.X₃ n, a • w = 0)
    (z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I S.X₁ (n + 1)) : a • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  let δ := derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS n
  let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule I S.X₂ (n + 1)) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_injective I S.X₂ n)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
    (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficients_afterConnecting_exact I hS n z).mp
      (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  calc
    a • z = a • δ w := congrArg (fun v => a • v) hw.symm
    _ = δ (a • w) := (map_smul δ a w).symm
    _ = 0 := by rw [ha w, map_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_finite_torsionFree
statement:
theorem exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_finite_torsionFree
    (z : M) (hz : z ≠ 0) : ∃ f : M →ₗ[R] R, f z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V := LocalizedModule R⁰ M
  let loc : M →ₗ[R] V := LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap R⁰ M
  have hloc : Function.Injective loc := by
    apply (IsLocalizedModule.injective_iff_isRegular R⁰ loc).2
    intro c
    exact IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero (nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero c)
  have hlocz : loc z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hz (hloc (h.trans (map_zero loc).symm))
  let : IsScalarTower R (FractionRing R) V :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun a w => by
      induction w using LocalizedModule.induction_on with
      | h m s =>
        rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, LocalizedModule.mk_smul_mk,
          one_mul, LocalizedModule.smul'_mk]
  obtain ⟨g, hgz, _⟩ := Submodule.exists_le_ker_of_notMem
    (p := (⊥ : Submodule (FractionRing R) V))
    (v := loc z) (show loc z ∉ (⊥ : Submodule (FractionRing R) V) from hlocz)
  obtain ⟨n, s, hs⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := R) (M := M)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples_of_finite R⁰
    (fun j : Fin n => g (loc (s j)))
  let h : M →ₗ[R] FractionRing R :=
    (c : R) • ((g.restrictScalars R).comp loc)
  let alg : R →ₗ[R] FractionRing R := Algebra.linearMap R (FractionRing R)
  have hspan : (⊤ : Submodule R M) ≤ (LinearMap.range alg).comap h := by
    rw [← hs]
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro w ⟨j, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hc j
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  have hall : ∀ w : M, h w ∈ LinearMap.range alg :=
    fun w => hspan (Submodule.mem_top : w ∈ (⊤ : Submodule R M))
  let e : R ≃ₗ[R] LinearMap.range alg :=
    LinearEquiv.ofInjective alg (IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R))
  let f : M →ₗ[R] R :=
    e.symm.toLinearMap.comp (h.codRestrict (LinearMap.range alg) hall)
  have hf : alg (f z) = h z :=
    LinearEquiv.ofInjective_symm_apply alg
      (h := IsFractionRing.injective R (FractionRing R)) ⟨h z, hall z⟩
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  intro hfz
  have hhz : h z = 0 := by rw [← hf, hfz, map_zero]
  have hcz : c • g (loc z) = c • (0 : FractionRing R) := by
    change (c : R) • g (loc z) = (c : R) • (0 : FractionRing R)
    rw [smul_zero]
    exact hhz
  exact hgz ((IsLocalization.smul_bijective (FractionRing R) c).injective hcz)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_ne_zero_linearMap_of_finite_torsionFree
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_linearMap_of_finite_torsionFree [Nontrivial M] :
    ∃ f : M →ₗ[R] R, f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_finite_torsionFree (R := R) z hz
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  intro h
  apply hf
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.height_le_length_of_mem_minimalPrimes_ofList
statement:
theorem height_le_length_of_mem_minimalPrimes_ofList
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (xs : List C) (P : Ideal C)
    (hP : P ∈ (Ideal.ofList xs).minimalPrimes) :
    P.height ≤ xs.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hheight :=
    Ideal.height_le_ncard_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span xs.finite_toSet (p := P)
      (by simpa only [Ideal.ofList] using hP)
  calc
    P.height ≤ Set.ncard {x : C | x ∈ xs} := hheight
    _ = xs.toFinset.card := by
      rw [show {x : C | x ∈ xs} = (xs.toFinset : Set C) by
        ext x
        exact List.mem_toFinset.symm,
        Set.ncard_coe_finset]
    _ ≤ xs.length := by exact_mod_cast List.toFinset_card_le xs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.minimalPrime_ofList_ne_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem minimalPrime_ofList_ne_maximalIdeal
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (xs : List C)
    (hdim :
      ((((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C))
    (P : Ideal C) (hP : P ∈ (Ideal.ofList xs).minimalPrimes) :
    P ≠ maximalIdeal C
proof:
:= by
  intro hPmax
  have hheight : P.height ≤ xs.length :=
    height_le_length_of_mem_minimalPrimes_ofList xs P hP
  have hdim' :
      ((((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) := by
    rw [hPmax, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]
    exact hdim
  have hbad : ((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ (xs.length : ℕ∞) :=
    WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp <| hdim'.trans <| WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr hheight
  have : xs.length + 2 ≤ xs.length := by exact_mod_cast hbad
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.minimalPrime_quotient_ofList_ne_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem minimalPrime_quotient_ofList_ne_maximalIdeal
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (I : Ideal C) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal C)
    (xs : List C) (hxs : I = Ideal.ofList xs)
    (hdim :
      ((((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C))
    (Q : Ideal (C ⧸ I)) (hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes (C ⧸ I)) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hI
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    Q ≠ maximalIdeal (C ⧸ I) := by
  let q : C →+* C ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  let : Nontrivial (C ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hI
  let : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hcomap : Q.comap q ∈ I.minimalPrimes := by
    have hQ' : Q ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (C ⧸ I)).minimalPrimes := hQ
    have h := Ideal.minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hQ'
    simpa only [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, q, Ideal.mk_ker] using h
  have hcomap' : Q.comap q ∈ (Ideal.ofList xs).minimalPrimes := by
    simpa only [← hxs] using hcomap
  intro hQmax
  apply minimalPrime_ofList_ne_maximalIdeal xs hdim (Q.comap q) hcomap'
  rw [hQmax]
  exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.irreducibleComponent_quotient_ofList_inter_puncture_nonempty
statement:
theorem irreducibleComponent_quotient_ofList_inter_puncture_nonempty
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (I : Ideal C) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal C)
    (xs : List C) (hxs : I = Ideal.ofList xs)
    (hdim :
      ((((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C))
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ I)))
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ I))) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hI
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (Z ∩ ({closedPoint (C ⧸ I)}ᶜ :
      Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ I)))).Nonempty := by
  let D := C ⧸ I
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hI
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let Q : Ideal D := PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z
  have hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes D := by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_irreducibleComponents D]
    exact ⟨Z, hZ, rfl⟩
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQ.isPrime
  let q : PrimeSpectrum D := ⟨Q, inferInstance⟩
  have hqZ : q ∈ Z := by
    have hclosed : IsClosed Z := isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ
    have hzero : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q = Z := by
      change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z) = Z
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
        hclosed.closure_eq]
    rw [← hzero]
    exact show Q ≤ q.asIdeal from le_rfl
  have hqne : q ≠ closedPoint D := by
    intro hq
    apply minimalPrime_quotient_ofList_ne_maximalIdeal
      I hI xs hxs hdim Q hQ
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hq
  refine ⟨q, hqZ, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hqne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition_of_components_meet
statement:
theorem exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition_of_components_meet
    {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [IsLocalRing D] [IsNoetherianRing D]
    (hcomponents : ∀ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum D),
      (Z ∩ ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))).Nonempty)
    {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D)}
    (hAopen : IsOpen A₀) (hBopen : IsOpen B₀)
    (hcover : A₀ ∪ B₀ =
      ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D)))
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint A₀ B₀)
    (hAnonempty : A₀.Nonempty) (hBnonempty : B₀.Nonempty) :
    ∃ S T : Set (Ideal D),
      S.Nonempty ∧ T.Nonempty ∧ S.Finite ∧ T.Finite ∧
      S ∪ T = minimalPrimes D ∧ Disjoint S T ∧
      ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
          ({closedPoint D} : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set (PrimeSpectrum D) := {closedPoint D}ᶜ
  let S : Set (Ideal D) :=
    {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes D ∧ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U ⊆ A₀}
  let T : Set (Ideal D) :=
    {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes D ∧ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U ⊆ B₀}
  have hcomponent (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) :
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∈
        irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum D) := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents]
    simpa only [hP.isPrime.isRadical.radical] using hP
  have hcomponentMeets (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) :
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U).Nonempty := by
    exact hcomponents (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) (hcomponent P hP)
  have hside (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) :
      P ∈ S ∨ P ∈ T := by
    have hsides := irreducibleComponent_inter_subset_partition_side
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) (hcomponent P hP)
      hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint
    exact hsides.imp (fun h ↦ ⟨hP, h⟩) (fun h ↦ ⟨hP, h⟩)
  have hSnonempty : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a, haA⟩ := hAnonempty
    have haU : a ∈ U := by
      change a ∈ ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))
      rw [← hcover]
      exact Or.inl haA
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPa⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := a.asIdeal) bot_le
    rcases hside P hP with hPS | hPT
    · exact ⟨P, hPS⟩
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint haA (hPT.2 ⟨hPa, haU⟩)
  have hTnonempty : T.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBnonempty
    have hbU : b ∈ U := by
      change b ∈ ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))
      rw [← hcover]
      exact Or.inr hbB
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQb⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := b.asIdeal) bot_le
    rcases hside Q hQ with hQS | hQT
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint (hQS.2 ⟨hQb, hbU⟩) hbB
    · exact ⟨Q, hQT⟩
  have hSfinite : S.Finite :=
    (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing D).subset fun _ h ↦ h.1
  have hTfinite : T.Finite :=
    (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing D).subset fun _ h ↦ h.1
  have hSTcover : S ∪ T = minimalPrimes D := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact fun _ h ↦ h.elim (fun h ↦ h.1) (fun h ↦ h.1)
    · intro P hP
      exact hside P hP
  have hSTdisjoint : Disjoint S T := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro P hPS hPT
    obtain ⟨p, hpPU⟩ := hcomponentMeets P hPS.1
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint (hPS.2 hpPU) (hPT.2 hpPU)
  refine ⟨S, T, hSnonempty, hTnonempty, hSfinite, hTfinite,
    hSTcover, hSTdisjoint, ?_⟩
  intro P hPS Q hQT p hp
  have hpNotU : p ∉ U := by
    intro hpU
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
      (hPS.2 ⟨hp.1, hpU⟩) (hQT.2 ⟨hp.2, hpU⟩)
  simpa only [U, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_not]
    using hpNotU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_radical_nonmaximal_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition_of_components_meet
statement:
theorem
exists_radical_nonmaximal_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition_of_components_meet
    {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [IsLocalRing D] [IsNoetherianRing D]
    (hcomponents : ∀ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum D),
      (Z ∩ ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))).Nonempty)
    {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D)}
    (hAopen : IsOpen A₀) (hBopen : IsOpen B₀)
    (hcover : A₀ ∪ B₀ =
      ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D)))
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint A₀ B₀)
    (hAnonempty : A₀.Nonempty) (hBnonempty : B₀.Nonempty) :
    ∃ a b : Ideal D,
      a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
      a ≠ maximalIdeal D ∧ b ≠ maximalIdeal D ∧
      a.IsRadical ∧ b.IsRadical ∧
      a ⊓ b = nilradical D ∧
      (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, T, hSnonempty, hTnonempty, _hSfinite, _hTfinite,
      hSTcover, _hSTdisjoint, hcross⟩ :=
    exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition_of_components_meet
      hcomponents hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  have hSsub : S ⊆ (⊥ : Ideal D).minimalPrimes := by
    intro P hPS
    change P ∈ minimalPrimes D
    rw [← hSTcover]
    exact Or.inl hPS
  have hTsub : T ⊆ (⊥ : Ideal D).minimalPrimes := by
    intro Q hQT
    change Q ∈ minimalPrimes D
    rw [← hSTcover]
    exact Or.inr hQT
  have hradical : (sInf S ⊔ sInf T).radical = maximalIdeal D :=
    radical_sup_sInf_eq_maximalIdeal_of_minimalPrime_cross_zeroLocus
      (⊥ : Ideal D) hSsub hTsub hSnonempty hTnonempty hcross
  have hinf : sInf S ⊓ sInf T = nilradical D := by
    rw [← sInf_union, hSTcover, Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨P, hPS⟩ := hSnonempty
  obtain ⟨Q, hQT⟩ := hTnonempty
  have hPne : P ≠ maximalIdeal D := by
    obtain ⟨p, hpP, hpne⟩ := hcomponents
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) (by
        rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents]
        simpa only [(hSsub hPS).isPrime.isRadical.radical] using hSsub hPS)
    intro hPmax
    apply hpne
    have hpClosed : p = closedPoint D := by
      apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal p.2.ne_top
      · change maximalIdeal D ≤ p.asIdeal
        exact hPmax ▸ hpP
    simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hpClosed
  have hQne : Q ≠ maximalIdeal D := by
    obtain ⟨q, hqQ, hqne⟩ := hcomponents
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q) (by
        rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents]
        simpa only [(hTsub hQT).isPrime.isRadical.radical] using hTsub hQT)
    intro hQmax
    apply hqne
    have hqClosed : q = closedPoint D := by
      apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal q.2.ne_top
      · change maximalIdeal D ≤ q.asIdeal
        exact hQmax ▸ hqQ
    simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hqClosed
  have ha : sInf S ≠ ⊤ := by

    ¬ ConnectedSpace (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum D) →
      ∃ a b : Ideal D,

        a ≠ maximalIdeal D ∧ b ≠ maximalIdeal D ∧
        a.IsRadical ∧ b.IsRadical ∧
        a ⊓ b = nilradical D ∧
        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal D
proof:

    obtain ⟨P, hP, _⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := maximalIdeal D) bot_le

        irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum D) := by
      rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents]
      simpa only [hP.isPrime.isRadical.radical] using hP
    obtain ⟨p, _hpComponent, hpPuncture⟩ :=
      hcomponents (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) hcomponent
    refine ⟨⟨p, ?_⟩⟩
    exact (Scheme.mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff D p).2 <| by
      simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        using hpPuncture

      ∃ A : Set U, IsClopen A ∧ A ≠ ∅ ∧ A ≠ Set.univ := by

    apply hnot

    refine ⟨hU_nonempty, ?_⟩

    · right
      by_contra hAu
      exact hex ⟨A, hA, hAe, hAu⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hAclopen, hAne, hAuniv⟩ := hnontrivialClopen
  let B : Set U := Aᶜ
  let A₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D) := Subtype.val '' A
  let B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D) := Subtype.val '' B
  have hAopen : IsOpen A₀ := by
    exact U.isOpen.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.isOpen_iff_image_isOpen.mp
      hAclopen.isOpen
  have hBopen : IsOpen B₀ := by
    exact U.isOpen.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.isOpen_iff_image_isOpen.mp
      hAclopen.compl.isOpen
  have hcover : A₀ ∪ B₀ =
      ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D)) := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ | ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)
      · exact a.property
      · exact b.property
    · intro hp
      have hpU : p ∈ U := by
        exact (Scheme.mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff D p).2 <| by
          simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hp
      let pU : U := ⟨p, hpU⟩
      by_cases hpA : pU ∈ A
      · exact Or.inl ⟨pU, hpA, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨pU, hpA, rfl⟩
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint A₀ B₀ := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro p hpA hpB
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hpA
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := hpB
    have hab' : a = b := Subtype.ext hab.symm
    exact hb (hab' ▸ ha)
  have hAnonempty : A₀.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hAne
    exact ⟨a.1, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩⟩
  have hBnonempty : B₀.Nonempty := by
    have hB : B.Nonempty := by
      dsimp only [B]
      exact Set.nonempty_compl.mpr hAuniv
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hB
    exact ⟨b.1, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩⟩

statement:
theorem
exists_radical_nonmaximal_ambient_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_not_connectedSpace_quotient_ofList
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (I : Ideal C) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal C)
    (xs : List C) (hxs : I = Ideal.ofList xs)
    (hdim :
      ((((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ I)
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hI
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ¬ ConnectedSpace (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (C ⧸ I)) →
      ∃ a b : Ideal C,
        I ≤ a ∧ I ≤ b ∧
        a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
        a ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ b ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
        a.IsRadical ∧ b.IsRadical ∧
        a ⊓ b = I.radical ∧
        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
  let D := C ⧸ I
  let q : C →+* D := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top hI
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro hnot
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hamax, hbmax, haRadical, hbRadical,
      hinf, hradical⟩ :=
    exists_radical_nonmaximal_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_not_connectedSpace_quotient_ofList
      I hI xs hxs hdim hnot
  let A : Ideal C := a.comap q
  let B : Ideal C := b.comap q
  have hIA : I ≤ A := by
    rw [← Ideal.mk_ker (I := I), RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  have hIB : I ≤ B := by
    rw [← Ideal.mk_ker (I := I), RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
  have hA : A ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.comap_ne_top q ha
  have hB : B ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.comap_ne_top q hb
  have hAmax : A ≠ maximalIdeal C := by
    intro h
    apply hamax
    calc
      a = A.map q :=
        (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a).symm
      _ = (maximalIdeal C).map q := congrArg (Ideal.map q) h
      _ = maximalIdeal D :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hBmax : B ≠ maximalIdeal C := by
    intro h
    apply hbmax
    calc
      b = B.map q :=
        (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b).symm
      _ = (maximalIdeal C).map q := congrArg (Ideal.map q) h
      _ = maximalIdeal D :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hARadical : A.IsRadical := haRadical.comap q
  have hBRadical : B.IsRadical := hbRadical.comap q
  have hABinf : A ⊓ B = I.radical := by
    calc
      A ⊓ B = Ideal.comap q (a ⊓ b) := (Ideal.comap_inf q a b).symm
      _ = Ideal.comap q (nilradical D) := by rw [hinf]
      _ = Ideal.comap q (Ideal.radical ⊥) := rfl
      _ = Ideal.radical (Ideal.comap q ⊥) := Ideal.comap_radical q ⊥
      _ = I.radical := by
        rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
  have hcomapSup : Ideal.comap q (a ⊔ b) = A ⊔ B := by
    calc
      Ideal.comap q (a ⊔ b) =
          Ideal.comap q ((A ⊔ B).map q) := by
        congr 1
        dsimp only [A, B]
        exact (Ideal.map_sup_comap_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a b).symm
      _ = (A ⊔ B) ⊔ Ideal.comap q ⊥ :=
        Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (A ⊔ B)
      _ = A ⊔ B := by
        rw [sup_eq_left]
        exact (Ideal.comap_mono bot_le).trans le_sup_left
  have hABradical : (A ⊔ B).radical = maximalIdeal C := by
    have h := congrArg (Ideal.comap q) hradical
    rw [Ideal.comap_radical, hcomapSup,
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q] at h
    exact h
  exact ⟨A, B, hIA, hIB, hA, hB, hAmax, hBmax,
    hARadical, hBRadical, hABinf, hABradical⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_ring_of_finite_torsionFree
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_ring_of_finite_torsionFree
    (I : Ideal R) (K : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    [Module.Finite R K] [Module.IsTorsionFree R K] [Nontrivial K]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hK : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I K d)) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I (ModuleCat.of R R) d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : K)
  obtain ⟨f, hfz⟩ :=
    Purity.exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_finite_torsionFree
      (R := R) (M := K) z hz
  let J : Ideal R := LinearMap.range f
  let g : K →ₗ[R] J := f.rangeRestrict
  let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
    ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero (LinearMap.ker g).subtype g
      g.exact_subtype_ker_map.linearMap_comp_eq_zero
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact S g.exact_subtype_ker_map
      (Submodule.subtype_injective (LinearMap.ker g)) f.surjective_rangeRestrict
  have hdlt : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) < ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self d))
  have hkerdim : Module.supportDim R S.X₁ < ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    have hle := Module.supportDim_le_ringKrullDim R S.X₁
    rw [hdim] at hle
    exact hle.trans_lt hdlt
  have hkerzero : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₁ (d + 1)) :=
    derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_supportDim_lt I S.X₁ (d + 1) hkerdim
  have hJzero : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I (ModuleCat.of R J) d) :=
    (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficients_beforeConnecting_exact I hS d).isZero_X₂
      (hK.eq_of_src _ _) (hkerzero.eq_of_tgt _ _)
  have hquotientdim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) < (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    have hle : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) + 1 ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← hdim]
      apply ringKrullDim_succ_le_of_surjective
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hfz)
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (LinearMap.mem_range_self f z)
    by_contra h
    have hleft : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ J) + 1 := by
      simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right (le_of_not_gt h) 1
    have hbad : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      hleft.trans hle
    exact (not_le_of_gt hdlt)
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hbad)
  let T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
    ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero J.subtype J.mkQ
      (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ J).linearMap_comp_eq_zero
  have hT : T.ShortExact :=
    ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact T (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ J)
      J.subtype_injective J.mkQ_surjective
  have hQzero : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I T.X₃ d) :=
    derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_supportDim_lt I T.X₃ d
      (by
        change Module.supportDim R (R ⧸ J) < (d : WithBot ℕ∞)
        rw [Module.supportDim_quotient_eq_ringKrullDim]
        exact hquotientdim)
  exact (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficients_sameDegree_exact I hT d).isZero_X₂
    (hJzero.eq_of_src _ _) (hQzero.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_smul_eq_of_completeLocal_residueFieldHull
statement:
theorem exists_smul_eq_of_completeLocal_residueFieldHull
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i)) (f : E →ₗ[R] E) :
    ∃ a : R, ∀ z : E, f z = a • z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose r hr using fun n : ℕ =>
    exists_smul_eq_on_torsionBySet_of_finiteLength_quotient i hi hess
      (maximalIdeal R ^ n) (isFiniteLength_quotient_maximalIdeal_pow n) f
  have hcompat {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) : r m - r n ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ m := by
    apply sub_mem_ideal_of_smul_eq_zero_on_torsionBySet i hi
      (maximalIdeal R ^ m) (r m) (r n)
    intro z hz
    have hzn : ∀ a : R, a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ n → a • z = 0 := by
      intro a ha
      exact hz a (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hmn ha)
    rw [sub_smul, ← hr m z hz, ← hr n z hzn, sub_self]
  have hcauchy {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
      r m ≡ r n [SMOD ((maximalIdeal R ^ m) • ⊤ : Submodule R R)] := by
    apply SModEq.sub_mem.mpr
    simpa only [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] using hcompat hmn
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsPrecomplete.prec
    (inferInstance : IsPrecomplete (maximalIdeal R) R) (f := r) hcauchy
  have hdiff (n : ℕ) : r n - a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ n := by
    have h := SModEq.sub_mem.mp (ha n)
    simpa only [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top] using h
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  intro z
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
    exists_maximalIdeal_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_essential_residueField_range i hess z
  calc
    f z = r n • z := hr n z hn
    _ = a • z := by
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      rw [← sub_smul]
      exact hn (r n - a) (hdiff n)
