name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.primaryComponent_le_of_pow_le
statement:
private theorem primaryComponent_le_of_pow_le
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) {I J : Ideal R} {k : ℕ} (hk : J ^ k ≤ I) :
    Ideal.primaryComponent M I ≤ Ideal.primaryComponent M J
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := M) (I := I) z).mp hz
  apply (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := M) (I := J) z).mpr
  refine ⟨k * n, ?_⟩
  apply (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff ((J ^ (k * n) : Ideal R) : Set R) z).mpr
  intro a
  have hle : J ^ (k * n) ≤ I ^ n := by
    rw [pow_mul]
    exact pow_le_pow_left' hk n
  exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff ((I ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) z).mp hn
    ⟨a, hle a.property⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.primaryComponent_eq_of_sameRadical
statement:
theorem primaryComponent_eq_of_sameRadical
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) {I J : Ideal R} (hIJ : I.radical = J.radical) :
    Ideal.primaryComponent M I = Ideal.primaryComponent M J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg
    (show J ≤ I.radical by rw [hIJ]; exact Ideal.le_radical)
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian J)
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg
    (show I ≤ J.radical by rw [← hIJ]; exact Ideal.le_radical)
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian I)
  exact le_antisymm (primaryComponent_le_of_pow_le M hk)
    (primaryComponent_le_of_pow_le M hl)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.submoduleEqualityIso_naturality
statement:
private theorem submoduleEqualityIso_naturality
    (M N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (A B : Submodule R M) (C D : Submodule R N)
    (hAB : A = B) (hCD : C = D) (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hAC : ∀ z : A, f z ∈ C) (hBD : ∀ z : B, f z ∈ D) :
    ModuleCat.ofHom ((f.domRestrict A).codRestrict C hAC) ≫
        (submoduleEqualityIso N C D hCD).hom =
      (submoduleEqualityIso M A B hAB).hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom ((f.domRestrict B).codRestrict D hBD)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExt_quotient_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivedExt_quotient_smul_eq_zero
    (J : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ)
    (a : R) (ha : a ∈ J)
    (α : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ J)) M i) :
    a • α = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : a • 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ J)) = 0 := by
    ext
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_smul, ModuleCat.hom_id,
      ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      LinearMap.zero_apply]
    calc
      a • (Submodule.mkQ J) 1 =
          (Submodule.mkQ J) (a • (1 : R)) :=
        (map_smul (Submodule.mkQ J) a (1 : R)).symm
      _ = 0 := by
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk] using
          (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr ha : Ideal.Quotient.mk J a = 0)
  calc
    a • α =
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀
          (a • 𝟙 (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ J)))).comp α (zero_add i) := by
      rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_smul,
        CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.smul_comp,
        CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_id_comp]
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [h, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_zero,
        CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.zero_comp]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) (a : R) (n : ℕ)
    (α : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
          (op (op n)) α) =
      colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
        (op (op n)) (a • α)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    congrArg
      (fun f :
          (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i).obj (op (op n)) ⟶
            derivedLocalCohomology I M i ↦ f α)
      (colimit.ι_map
        (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersScalarMap I M i a) (op (op n)))
  exact h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_exists_idealPower_scalarMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_exists_idealPower_scalarMap_eq_zero
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ)
    (z : derivedLocalCohomology I M i) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : R, a ∈ I ^ n →
      derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a z = 0
proof:
:= by
  let : PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0}
      (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    preservesSmallestFilteredColimits_of_preservesFilteredColimits _
  obtain ⟨k, α, hα⟩ :=
    Concrete.colimit_exists_rep (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i) z
  rcases k with ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  rw [← hα]
  let ι : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i →+ derivedLocalCohomology I M i :=
    (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i) (op (op n))).hom
  change CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i at α
  exact (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i a n α).trans
    ((congrArg ι
      (derivedExt_quotient_smul_eq_zero (I ^ n) M i a ha α)).trans
        (map_zero ι))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_exists_pow_scalarMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_exists_pow_scalarMap_eq_zero
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ)
    (a : R) (ha : a ∈ I) (z : derivedLocalCohomology I M i) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i (a ^ n) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
    derivedLocalCohomology_exists_idealPower_scalarMap_eq_zero I M i z
  exact ⟨n, hn (a ^ n) (Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha n)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_one
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_one
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i 1 =
      𝟙 (derivedLocalCohomology I M i)
proof:
:= by
  apply colimit.hom_ext (F := derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
  rintro ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
  ext α
  let ι : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i →+ derivedLocalCohomology I M i :=
    (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i) (op (op n))).hom
  change CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i at α
  change
    derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i 1
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
          (op (op n)) α) =
      colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i) (op (op n)) α
  exact (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i 1 n α).trans
    (congrArg ι
      (one_smul R α))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_mul
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_mul
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) (a b : R) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i (a * b) =
      derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i b ≫
        derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a
proof:
:= by
  apply colimit.hom_ext (F := derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
  rintro ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
  ext α
  let ι : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i →+ derivedLocalCohomology I M i :=
    (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i) (op (op n))).hom
  change CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i at α
  change
    derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i (a * b)
        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
          (op (op n)) α) =
      derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a
        (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i b
          (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
            (op (op n)) α))
  exact (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i (a * b) n α).trans
    ((congrArg ι
      (smul_smul a b α).symm).trans
        ((derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i a n (b • α)).symm.trans
          (congrArg (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a)
            (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_ι_apply I M i b n α).symm)))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_scalarMap_injective
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_scalarMap_injective
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ)
    (a : R) (ha : a ∈ I)
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (ConcreteCategory.hom (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a))) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M i)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ z : derivedLocalCohomology I M i,
      derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i (a ^ n) z = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro z hz
        rw [pow_zero, derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_one] at hz
        exact hz
    | succ n ih =>
        intro z hz
        rw [pow_succ, derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap_mul] at hz
        change
          derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i (a ^ n)
            (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a z) = 0 at hz
        apply hinj
        exact (ih (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a z) hz).trans
          (map_zero (ConcreteCategory.hom
            (derivedLocalCohomologyScalarMap I M i a))).symm
  have hz : ∀ z : derivedLocalCohomology I M i, z = 0 := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
      derivedLocalCohomology_exists_pow_scalarMap_eq_zero I M i a ha z
    exact hpow n z hn
  exact AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
    ⟨fun z w ↦ (hz z).trans (hz w).symm⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_maximalIdeal_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_essential_residueField_range
statement:
theorem exists_maximalIdeal_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_essential_residueField_range
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (i : R ⧸ maximalIdeal R →ₗ[R] E)
    (hi : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i)) (z : E) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : R, a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ n → a • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_ideal_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_essential_submodule
    (maximalIdeal R) (LinearMap.range i) hi ?_ z
  intro w
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  rw [pow_one] at ha
  apply Subtype.ext
  change a • (w : E) = 0
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := w.property
  have haq : a • q = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal R) (a * r) = 0
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
      ((maximalIdeal R).mul_mem_right r ha)
  rw [← hq, ← map_smul, haq, map_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_saturatedPower_quotient_zero
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_saturatedPower_quotient_zero
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R)
      (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ maximalIdealSaturatedPower I n)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  let M : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ maximalIdealSaturatedPower I n)
  let e₀ := derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule (maximalIdeal R) M
  let e : M ≃ₗ[R]
      ((R ⧸ I ^ n) ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent (R ⧸ I ^ n) (maximalIdeal R)) :=
    maximalIdealSaturationQuotientEquiv (I ^ n)
  have hEval (z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M 0) : e₀ z = 0 := by
    apply e.injective
    rw [map_zero]
    apply eq_zero_of_idealPower_torsion_quotient_primaryComponent (maximalIdeal R)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (mem_range_derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_iff
      (maximalIdeal R) M (e₀ z)).mp (LinearMap.mem_range_self e₀ z)
    refine ⟨k, fun a ha => ?_⟩
    rw [← map_smul, hk a ha, map_zero]
  apply AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
  refine ⟨fun z w => ?_⟩
  exact (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_injective (maximalIdeal R) M)
    ((hEval z).trans (hEval w).symm)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.tensorLocalizedRingEquiv_mk
statement:
private theorem tensorLocalizedRingEquiv_mk (S : Submonoid R)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (m : M) (r : R) :
    tensorLocalizedRingEquiv S M
      (m ⊗ₜ[R] LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S R r) =
        LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S M (r • m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tensorLocalizedRingEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    TensorProduct.congr_tmul, LinearEquiv.refl_apply,
    IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv_apply, TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
    LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_apply]
  change (LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct S M).symm
    (algebraMap R (Localization S) r ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S M (r • m)
  change (LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct S M).symm
    (Localization.mk r (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S M (r • m)
  rw [LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct_symm_apply_tmul]
  exact ((LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S M).map_smul r m).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.injectivePresentationShortComplex_shortExact
statement:
theorem injectivePresentationShortComplex_shortExact
    {M E : ModuleCat.{u} R} (i : M →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i) :
    (injectivePresentationShortComplex i).ShortExact
proof:
:=
  ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact (injectivePresentationShortComplex i)
    i.exact_map_mkQ_range hi (Submodule.mkQ_surjective (LinearMap.range i))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_idealPowerTorsion_injective_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_idealPowerTorsion_injective_presentation
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (hM : ∀ z : M, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0) :
    ∃ (E : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : M →ₗ[R] E),
      Function.Injective i ∧ Module.Injective R E ∧
        (∀ z : E, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0) ∧
        (∀ z : E ⧸ LinearMap.range i,
          ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, i, hi, hess, hEinj⟩ := exists_module_injective_hull M
  have hRange : ∀ z : LinearMap.range i,
      ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0 := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := z.property
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hM w
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    apply Subtype.ext
    change a • (z : E) = 0
    simpa only [map_smul, map_zero, hw] using congrArg i (hn a ha)
  have hE : ∀ z : E, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0 :=
    exists_ideal_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_essential_submodule
      I (LinearMap.range i) hess hRange
  refine ⟨E, i, hi, hEinj, hE, ?_⟩
  intro z
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (LinearMap.range i).mkQ_surjective z
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hE w
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  simpa only [map_smul, map_zero] using
    congrArg (Submodule.mkQ (LinearMap.range i)) (hn a ha)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyModule_smul_surjective_of_finite_torsionFree
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyModule_smul_surjective_of_finite_torsionFree
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    [Module.Finite R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fun z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I M d => a • z)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsSMulRegular M a := IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero ha
  let : Module.Finite R (M.smulShortComplex a).X₃ := by
    change Module.Finite R (M ⧸ (a • (⊤ : Submodule R M)))
    infer_instance
  have hdimQ : Module.supportDim R (M.smulShortComplex a).X₃ < (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    have hle : Module.supportDim R (M.smulShortComplex a).X₃ + 1 ≤
        (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ Module.supportDim R M :=
          Module.supportDim_quotSMulTop_succ_le_of_notMem_minimalPrimes
            (fun _ hp => hreg.notMem_of_mem_minimalPrimes hp)
        _ ≤ ringKrullDim R := Module.supportDim_le_ringKrullDim R M
        _ = _ := hdim
    by_contra h
    have hleft : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤
        Module.supportDim R (M.smulShortComplex a).X₃ + 1 :=
      by simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right (le_of_not_gt h) 1
    have hbad : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := hleft.trans hle
    have hlt : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) < ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self d))
    exact (not_le_of_gt hlt)
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hbad)
  have hz : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I (M.smulShortComplex a).X₃ d) :=
    derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_supportDim_lt I _ d hdimQ
  have hsurj := (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp
    (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_epi_of_third_isZero
      I hreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact d hz)
  rw [derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_smulShortComplex I M d a hreg] at hsurj
  exact hsurj

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_finite_torsionFree_annihilator
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_finite_torsionFree_annihilator
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    [Module.Finite R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hann : ∀ z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I M d, a • z = 0) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M d)
proof:
:= by
  apply AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
  have hz : ∀ z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I M d, z = 0 := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
      derivedLocalCohomologyModule_smul_surjective_of_finite_torsionFree I M d hdim a ha z
    exact hw.symm.trans (hann w)
  exact ⟨fun z w => (hz z).trans (hz w).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isLocalRing_of_isArtinianRing_of_connectedSpace_spec
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_of_isArtinianRing_of_connectedSpace_spec
    (Q : Type u) [CommRing Q] [IsArtinianRing Q] [Nontrivial Q]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum Q)] :
    IsLocalRing Q
proof:
:= by
  have hsubsingleton : Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum Q) := by
    constructor
    intro p q
    have hclopen : IsClopen ({p} : Set (PrimeSpectrum Q)) :=
      isClopen_discrete {p}
    rcases (connectedSpace_iff_clopen.mp
      (show ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum Q) from inferInstance)).2
        {p} hclopen with hempty | huniv
    · exact False.elim (Set.singleton_ne_empty p hempty)
    · have hqp : q ∈ ({p} : Set (PrimeSpectrum Q)) := by
        rw [huniv]
        trivial
      exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hqp).symm
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal Q
  apply IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal
  refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩
  intro N hN
  let p : PrimeSpectrum Q := ⟨M, hM.isPrime⟩
  let q : PrimeSpectrum Q := ⟨N, hN.isPrime⟩
  exact (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal
    (@Subsingleton.elim (PrimeSpectrum Q) hsubsingleton p q)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isLocalRing_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
    {R C : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra R C] [Module.Finite R C] :
    IsLocalRing C
proof:
:= by
  let m : Ideal R := maximalIdeal R
  let J : Ideal C := m.map (algebraMap R C)
  let Q := C ⧸ J
  let q : C →+* Q := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  have hJjac : J ≤ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal C) :=
    (open _root_.ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField in
      ideal_map_le_jacobson_bot_of_le_jacobson_bot_of_moduleFinite
        (R := R) (S := C) (I := m))
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R))
  have hJne : J ≠ ⊤ := by
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal C
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top hM.ne_top <|
      hJjac.trans (sInf_le ⟨bot_le, hM⟩)
  let : Nontrivial Q := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hJne
  let : ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum Q) := by
    change ConnectedSpace (Spec (.of Q))
    exact
      connectedSpace_spec_quotient_map_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
        R m le_rfl
  let k := R ⧸ m
  let : Field k := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  let : Module.Finite R Q :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J).toLinearMap
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective R J)
  let : Module.Finite k Q :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R k Q
  let : IsArtinianRing Q := IsArtinianRing.of_finite k Q
  let : IsLocalRing Q :=
    isLocalRing_of_isArtinianRing_of_connectedSpace_spec Q
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal C
  apply IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal
  refine ⟨M, hM, ?_⟩
  intro N hN
  have hJM : J ≤ M := hJjac.trans (sInf_le ⟨bot_le, hM⟩)
  have hJN : J ≤ N := hJjac.trans (sInf_le ⟨bot_le, hN⟩)
  have hqker : RingHom.ker q = J := Ideal.mk_ker
  have hkerM : RingHom.ker q ≤ M := by
    rw [hqker]
    exact hJM
  have hkerN : RingHom.ker q ≤ N := by
    rw [hqker]
    exact hJN
  let : M.IsMaximal := hM
  let : N.IsMaximal := hN
  have hmapM : (M.map q).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.IsMaximal.map_of_surjective_of_ker_le
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hkerM
  have hmapN : (N.map q).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.IsMaximal.map_of_surjective_of_ker_le
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hkerN
  have hmaps : M.map q = N.map q :=
    (IsLocalRing.maximal_ideal_unique Q).unique hmapM hmapN
  have hcomapM : (M.map q).comap q = M := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
      ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, sup_eq_left.mpr hkerM]
  have hcomapN : (N.map q).comap q = N := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
      ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, sup_eq_left.mpr hkerN]
  rw [← hcomapM, ← hcomapN, hmaps]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.ringKrullDim_eq_of_finiteIntegralDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_eq_of_finiteIntegralDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
    {R C : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra R C] [Module.Finite R C]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] [FaithfulSMul R C] :
    ringKrullDim C = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  let : IsLocalRing C :=
    isLocalRing_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete (R := R) (C := C)
  have hcomap :
      (maximalIdeal C).comap (algebraMap R C) = maximalIdeal R := by
    have hmax :
        ((maximalIdeal C).comap (algebraMap R C)).IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R C)
        (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) (maximalIdeal C)
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximal_ideal_unique R).unique hmax
      (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R)
  have hmap :
      (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R C) ≤ maximalIdeal C := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, hcomap]
  calc
    ringKrullDim C =
        (((maximalIdeal C).height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim (R := C)).symm
    _ = ringKrullDim R :=
      prime_height_eq_ringKrullDim_of_map_maximalIdeal_le
        (R := R) (C := C) (maximalIdeal C) hmap

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isLocalRing
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
      dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
    letI : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsIntegral W.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    letI : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    IsLocalRing (integralClosure R W.left.functionField) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
    dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
  let K : Type u := U.functionField
  let : Algebra R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R L :=
    ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap R K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let C := integralClosure R L
  let : Module.Finite R C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_finite_of_positiveDimension
      R hpos W
  exact isLocalRing_of_finiteDomain_of_maximalAdicComplete
    (R := R) (C := C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_ringKrullDim_eq
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_ringKrullDim_eq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
      dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
    letI : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsIntegral W.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    letI : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    ringKrullDim (integralClosure R W.left.functionField) =
      ringKrullDim R := by
  dsimp only
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by

  let : Module.Finite R C :=

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_ideal_pow_le_annihilator_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_ideal_pow_le_annihilator_of_finite
    [Module.Finite R M] (I : Ideal R)
    (hM : ∀ z : M, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, I ^ n ≤ Module.annihilator R M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose n hn using hM
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (show (⊤ : Submodule R M).FG from Module.Finite.fg_top)
  refine ⟨s.sup n, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  apply Module.mem_annihilator.mpr
  intro z
  have hspan : Submodule.span R (s : Set M) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (a • (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M)) := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro y hy
    change a • y = 0
    exact hn y a (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Finset.le_sup hy) ha)
  rw [hs] at hspan
  exact hspan (Submodule.mem_top : z ∈ (⊤ : Submodule R M))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isFiniteLength_of_finite_of_maximalIdealPower_torsion
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_of_finite_of_maximalIdealPower_torsion
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R M]
    (hM : ∀ z : M, ∃ n : ℕ,
      ∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ n, a • z = 0) :
    IsFiniteLength R M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
    exists_ideal_pow_le_annihilator_of_finite (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) hM
  let I : Ideal R := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ n
  let : IsArtinian R (R ⧸ I) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
      (isFiniteLength_quotient_maximalIdeal_pow (R := R) n)).2
  let : IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    isArtinian_of_tower R (inferInstance : IsArtinian R (R ⧸ I))
  have hT : Module.IsTorsionBySet R M I :=
    (Module.isTorsionBySet_iff_subset_annihilator R M).mpr hn
  let : Module (R ⧸ I) M := hT.module
  let : Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) M :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective hT.semilinearMap Function.surjective_id
  have hart : IsArtinian R M :=
    (LinearMap.isArtinian_iff_of_bijective
      hT.semilinearMap Function.bijective_id).mpr
      (inferInstance : IsArtinian (R ⧸ I) M)
  exact isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr ⟨inferInstance, hart⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_injective
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_injective
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let : CategoryTheory.Injective M :=
    Module.injective_object_of_injective_module R M
  apply derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_subsingleton_ext_powers
  intro k
  exact CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.subsingleton_of_injective
    (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ k)) M n

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_power_torsion
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_power_torsion
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (hM : ∀ z : M, ∃ k : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ k, a • z = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing M with
  | zero =>
      obtain ⟨E, i, hi, hEinj, hE, _hQ⟩ :=
        Purity.exists_idealPowerTorsion_injective_presentation I M hM
      let : Module.Injective R E := hEinj
      let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
        Purity.injectivePresentationShortComplex i
      have hS : S.ShortExact :=
        Purity.injectivePresentationShortComplex_shortExact i hi
      let : Epi (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap I hS 0) :=
        derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap_epi_zero_of_power_torsion I hS hE
      let : Epi (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS 0) :=
        (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficients_afterConnecting_exact I hS 0).epi_f
          ((derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_injective I E 0).eq_of_tgt _ _)
      have hzero : derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS 0 = 0 :=
        zero_of_epi_comp (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap I hS 0)
          (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap_comp_connectingMap I hS 0)
      change IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₁ (0 + 1))
      exact IsZero.of_epi_eq_zero
        (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS 0) hzero
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨E, i, hi, hEinj, _hE, hQ⟩ :=
        Purity.exists_idealPowerTorsion_injective_presentation I M hM
      let : Module.Injective R E := hEinj
      let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
        Purity.injectivePresentationShortComplex i
      have hS : S.ShortExact :=
        Purity.injectivePresentationShortComplex_shortExact i hi
      have hQzero : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₃ (n + 1)) :=
        ih S.X₃ hQ
      let : Epi (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS (n + 1)) :=
        (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficients_afterConnecting_exact I hS (n + 1)).epi_f
          ((derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_injective I E (n + 1)).eq_of_tgt _ _)
      change IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₁ ((n + 1) + 1))
      exact IsZero.of_epi
        (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsConnectingMap I hS (n + 1)) hQzero

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.localizedModule_mkLinearMap_surjective_of_injective
statement:
theorem localizedModule_mkLinearMap_surjective_of_injective
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Injective R E] (S : Submonoid R) :
    Function.Surjective (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S E)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨⟨y, s⟩, rfl⟩ :=
    IsLocalizedModule.mk'_surjective S (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S E) z
  change ∃ a, LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S E a =
    IsLocalizedModule.mk' (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap S E) y s
  rw [← IsLocalizedModule.mk_eq_mk']
  let e : Module.End R R := LinearMap.lsmul R R (s : R)
  have he (n : ℕ) (a : R) : (e ^ n) a = (s : R) ^ n * a := by
    induction n generalizing a with
    | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, one_mul]
    | succ n hn =>
      rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hn, pow_succ]
      change (s : R) ^ n * ((s : R) * a) = _
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
  obtain ⟨n, hn : ∀ m, n ≤ m →
      LinearMap.ker (e ^ n) = LinearMap.ker (e ^ m)⟩ :=
    monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr
      (inferInstance : IsNoetherian R R) e.iterateKer
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (e ^ (n + 1)) ≤ LinearMap.ker (e ^ n) := by
    rw [hn (n + 1) (Nat.le_succ n)]
  let v : R →ₗ[R] E := (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R E y).comp (e ^ n)
  have hkv : LinearMap.ker (e ^ (n + 1)) ≤ LinearMap.ker v := by
    intro a ha
    change (e ^ n) a • y = 0
    rw [show (e ^ n) a = 0 from hker ha, zero_smul]
  let q : LinearMap.range (e ^ (n + 1)) →ₗ[R] E :=
    ((LinearMap.ker (e ^ (n + 1))).liftQ v hkv).comp
      (e ^ (n + 1)).quotKerEquivRange.symm.toLinearMap
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property R E
    (LinearMap.range (e ^ (n + 1))) R
    (LinearMap.range (e ^ (n + 1))).subtype Subtype.val_injective q
  have hdivide : (s : R) ^ (n + 1) • g 1 = (s : R) ^ n • y := by
    have hmem : (e ^ (n + 1)) 1 ∈ LinearMap.range (e ^ (n + 1)) :=
      LinearMap.mem_range_self (e ^ (n + 1)) 1
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hg
      ⟨(e ^ (n + 1)) 1, hmem⟩
    change g ((e ^ (n + 1)) 1) = q ⟨(e ^ (n + 1)) 1, hmem⟩ at h
    change g ((e ^ (n + 1)) 1) =
      (LinearMap.ker (e ^ (n + 1))).liftQ v hkv
        ((e ^ (n + 1)).quotKerEquivRange.symm
          ⟨(e ^ (n + 1)) 1, hmem⟩) at h
    have hquot := LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange_symm_apply_image
      (e ^ (n + 1)) 1 hmem
    rw [hquot] at h
    change g ((e ^ (n + 1)) 1) = (e ^ n) 1 • y at h
    rw [he, he, mul_one, mul_one] at h
    calc
      (s : R) ^ (n + 1) • g 1 = g ((s : R) ^ (n + 1) • (1 : R)) :=
        (g.map_smul _ _).symm
      _ = g ((s : R) ^ (n + 1)) := by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      _ = (s : R) ^ n • y := h
  refine ⟨g 1, ?_⟩
  apply LocalizedModule.mk_eq.mpr
  refine ⟨s ^ n, ?_⟩
  change (s : R) ^ n • ((s : R) • g 1) = (s : R) ^ n • ((1 : R) • y)
  rw [one_smul, ← mul_smul, ← pow_succ]
  exact hdivide

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.ker_localizedModule_mkLinearMap_powers
statement:
theorem ker_localizedModule_mkLinearMap_powers (x : R) :
    LinearMap.ker (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers x) E) =
      Ideal.primaryComponent E (Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [LocalizedModule.mem_ker_mkLinearMap_iff, Ideal.primaryComponent_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hy⟩
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff]
    intro b
    have hb : (b : R) ∈ Ideal.span {x ^ n} := by
      rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
      exact b.property
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hb
    rw [← hc, mul_smul, hy, smul_zero]
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨x ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff
      (((Ideal.span {x}) ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) y).mp hn
      ⟨x ^ n, by
        rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
        exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (x ^ n)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.surjective_pow_smul_of_surjective_smul
statement:
private theorem surjective_pow_smul_of_surjective_smul
    (r : R) (hr : Function.Surjective (fun z : M => r • z)) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (fun z : M => r ^ n • z)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro z
      exact ⟨z, by simp only [pow_zero, one_smul]⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro z
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hr z
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ih w
      exact ⟨v, by simpa only [pow_succ', mul_smul, hv] using hw⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.IsSecondaryModule.surjective_smul_iff
statement:
theorem IsSecondaryModule.surjective_smul_iff
    (hM : IsSecondaryModule R M) (r : R) :
    Function.Surjective (fun z : M => r • z) ↔
      r ∉ (Module.annihilator R M).radical
proof:
:= by
  let : Nontrivial M := hM.1
  constructor
  · intro hr hmem
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hmem
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := surjective_pow_smul_of_surjective_smul r hr n z
    exact hz (hw.symm.trans (Module.mem_annihilator.mp hn w))
  · intro hr
    rcases hM.2 r with hsurj | ⟨n, hn⟩
    · exact hsurj
    · exact False.elim (hr ⟨n, Module.mem_annihilator.mpr hn⟩)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.IsSecondaryModule.radical_annihilator_isPrime
statement:
theorem IsSecondaryModule.radical_annihilator_isPrime
    (hM : IsSecondaryModule R M) :
    (Module.annihilator R M).radical.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  let : Nontrivial M := hM.1
  apply Ideal.isPrime_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro htop
    have hann : Module.annihilator R M = ⊤ := Ideal.radical_eq_top.mp htop
    have hsub : Subsingleton M := Module.annihilator_eq_top_iff.mp hann
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
    exact hz (hsub.elim z 0)
  · intro a b hab
    by_cases ha : a ∈ (Module.annihilator R M).radical
    · exact Or.inl ha
    · right
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hab
      refine ⟨n, Module.mem_annihilator.mpr ?_⟩
      intro z
      have hsurj : Function.Surjective (fun w : M => a • w) :=
        (hM.surjective_smul_iff a).mpr ha
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := surjective_pow_smul_of_surjective_smul a hsurj n z
      rw [← hw, smul_comm]
      simpa only [mul_pow, mul_smul] using Module.mem_annihilator.mp hn w

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.finite_of_artinian_of_radical_annihilator_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
private theorem finite_of_artinian_of_radical_annihilator_eq_maximalIdeal
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [IsArtinian R M]
    (hAnn : (Module.annihilator R M).radical = maximalIdeal R) :
    Module.Finite R M
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal R := Module.annihilator R M
  let : IsArtinianRing (R ⧸ I) := by
    apply IsLocalRing.quotient_artinian_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing
    rw [← Ideal.radical_minimalPrimes, hAnn,
      Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_subsingleton_self]
    exact Set.mem_singleton (maximalIdeal R)
  have hT : Module.IsTorsionBySet R M I := Module.isTorsionBySet_annihilator R M
  let : Module (R ⧸ I) M := hT.module
  let : IsArtinian (R ⧸ I) M :=
    (LinearMap.isArtinian_iff_of_bijective
      hT.semilinearMap Function.bijective_id).mp (inferInstance : IsArtinian R M)
  have hfin : Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) M :=
    ((IsArtinianRing.tfae (R ⧸ I) M).out 3 1).mp
      (inferInstance : IsArtinian (R ⧸ I) M)
  exact (LinearMap.finite_iff_of_bijective
    hT.semilinearMap Function.bijective_id).mpr hfin

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_mem_maximalIdeal_avoiding_finite_primes
statement:
private theorem exists_mem_maximalIdeal_avoiding_finite_primes
    (s : Finset (Ideal R))
    (hs : ∀ P : Ideal R, P ∈ s → P.IsPrime ∧ P ≠ maximalIdeal R) :
    ∃ x : R, x ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ ∀ P : Ideal R, P ∈ s → x ∉ P
proof:
:= by
  have hnot : ¬ ((maximalIdeal R : Ideal R) : Set R) ⊆
      ⋃ P ∈ (s : Set (Ideal R)), (P : Set R) := by
    intro hsubset
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hmP⟩ :=
      (Ideal.subset_union_prime (s := s) (f := fun P : Ideal R => P)
        (⊥ : Ideal R) (⊥ : Ideal R) (fun P hP _ _ => (hs P hP).1)).mp hsubset
    exact (hs P hP).2
      (le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (hs P hP).1.ne_top) hmP)
  obtain ⟨x, hxm, hx⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hnot
  refine ⟨x, hxm, ?_⟩
  intro P hP hxP
  exact hx (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨P, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hP, hxP⟩⟩)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_mem_maximalIdeal_avoiding_primes_finiteLength_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_mem_maximalIdeal_avoiding_primes_finiteLength_quotient
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [IsArtinian R M]
    (t : Finset (Ideal R))
    (ht : ∀ P : Ideal R, P ∈ t → P.IsPrime ∧ P ≠ maximalIdeal R) :
    ∃ x : R, x ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧
      (∀ P : Ideal R, P ∈ t → x ∉ P) ∧
      IsFiniteLength R (M ⧸ (x • (⊤ : Submodule R M)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsum⟩ := exists_finset_secondarySubmodules_sup_eq_top (R := R) (M := M)
  let primes : Finset (Ideal R) :=
    s.image (fun N : Submodule R M => (Module.annihilator R N).radical)
  let avoid : Finset (Ideal R) := t ∪ primes.filter (fun P => P ≠ maximalIdeal R)
  have havoid (P : Ideal R) (hP : P ∈ avoid) :
      P.IsPrime ∧ P ≠ maximalIdeal R := by
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hP with hPt | hPs
    · exact ht P hPt
    · obtain ⟨hPimage, hPne⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hPs
      obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hPimage
      exact ⟨(hs N hN).radical_annihilator_isPrime, hPne⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxm, hx⟩ := exists_mem_maximalIdeal_avoiding_finite_primes avoid havoid
  refine ⟨x, hxm, fun P hP => hx P (Finset.mem_union_left _ hP), ?_⟩
  let q : M →ₗ[R] M ⧸ (x • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) :=
    Submodule.mkQ (x • (⊤ : Submodule R M))
  have hfg (N : Submodule R M) (hN : N ∈ s) : (N.map q).FG := by
    by_cases hAnn : (Module.annihilator R N).radical = maximalIdeal R
    · have hfinite : Module.Finite R N :=
        finite_of_artinian_of_radical_annihilator_eq_maximalIdeal N hAnn
      exact (Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp hfinite).map q
    · have hxAnn : x ∉ (Module.annihilator R N).radical := by
        apply hx
        apply Finset.mem_union_right t
        apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩, hAnn⟩
      have hsurj : Function.Surjective (fun z : N => x • z) :=
        ((hs N hN).surjective_smul_iff x).mpr hxAnn
      have hzero : N.map q = ⊥ := by
        apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hz
        obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj ⟨w, hw⟩
        have hv' : x • (v : M) = w := congrArg Subtype.val hv
        have hw' : w ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule R M) := by
          rw [← hv']
          exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul (v : M) x
            (⊤ : Submodule R M) Submodule.mem_top
        exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mpr
          ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (x • (⊤ : Submodule R M))).mpr hw')
      rw [hzero]
      exact Submodule.fg_bot
  have hfgSum := Submodule.fg_finset_sup s (fun N : Submodule R M => N.map q) hfg
  have hsumMap : s.sup (fun N : Submodule R M => N.map q) = ⊤ := by
    calc
      s.sup (fun N : Submodule R M => N.map q) = (s.sup id).map q := by
        simp only [Finset.sup_eq_iSup, Submodule.map_iSup, id_eq]
      _ = ⊤ := by
        rw [hsum, Submodule.map_top]
        exact Submodule.range_mkQ (x • (⊤ : Submodule R M))
  let : Module.Finite R (M ⧸ (x • (⊤ : Submodule R M))) :=
    Module.Finite.of_fg_top (hsumMap ▸ hfgSum)
  exact isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_normalization_of_principal_factorization
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_normalization_of_principal_factorization
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (d : R)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.Away d A]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsFinite g]
    (hnormal : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], d ∈ p →
      IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p))
    (hlocal : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd
        (g ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))).fromNormalization
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))))) :
    IsFiniteEtale
      (g ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  let : IsAffine Y := isAffine_of_isAffineHom g
  let B := Γ(Y, ⊤)
  let e : Y ≅ Spec B := Y.isoSpec
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Spec.map_surjective (e.inv ≫ g)
  let : Algebra A B := φ.hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra R B := ((algebraMap A B).comp (algebraMap R A)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R A B := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hgSpec : IsFinite (Spec.map φ) := hφ.symm ▸ (inferInstance : IsFinite (e.inv ≫ g))
  let : Module.Finite A B := (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff φ).mp hgSpec
  let f := g ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
  let fB := affineStructureMap R B
  have hfB : fB = Spec.map φ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) := by
    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  have hfg : e.hom ≫ fB = f := by
    rw [hfB, hφ, ← Category.assoc, e.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  let en := Inertia.normalizationSourceIso f fB e hfg
  have hen : en.hom ≫ fB.fromNormalization = f.fromNormalization :=
    Inertia.normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization f fB e hfg
  have hBlocal (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
      Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
          (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R B) ∧
        Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
          (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R B) := by
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))
    let l := pullback.map f.fromNormalization b fB.fromNormalization b
      en.hom (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) ((Category.comp_id _).trans hen.symm)
      ((Category.comp_id b).trans (Category.id_comp b).symm)
    have hl : l ≫ pullback.snd fB.fromNormalization b =
        pullback.snd f.fromNormalization b :=
      (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _)
    have hcomp : IsFiniteEtale (l ≫ pullback.snd fB.fromNormalization b) :=
      hl.symm ▸ hlocal p
    let : IsFinite (l ≫ pullback.snd fB.fromNormalization b) := hcomp.toIsFinite
    let : Etale (l ≫ pullback.snd fB.fromNormalization b) := hcomp.toEtale
    have hBinv : IsFiniteEtale (inv l ≫ (l ≫ pullback.snd fB.fromNormalization b)) := ⟨⟩
    have hB : IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd fB.fromNormalization b) :=
      IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc l (pullback.snd fB.fromNormalization b) ▸ hBinv
    exact finite_etale_tensor_integralClosure_of_normalization_baseChange
      R B (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) hB
  have hB := SchemeTheory.finite_etale_integralClosure_of_local_finite_etale
    d A B hnormal hBlocal
  let : IsFiniteEtale fB.fromNormalization :=
    (isFiniteEtale_specNormalization_iff R B).mpr hB
  have hcomp : IsFiniteEtale (en.hom ≫ fB.fromNormalization) :=
    ⟨⟩
  exact hen ▸ hcomp

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.injective_linearDualComplex_X
statement:
theorem injective_linearDualComplex_X
    (E : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R E]
    {ι : Type v} {c : ComplexShape ι}
    (K : HomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) c) (j : ι)
    [Module.Flat R (K.X j)] :
    Module.Injective R ((linearDualComplex E K).X j)
proof:
:= by
  let e : (K.X j ⟶ E) ≃ₗ[R] (K.X j →ₗ[R] E) :=
    ModuleCat.homLinearEquiv
  have h : Module.Injective R (K.X j →ₗ[R] E) :=
    injective_linearMap_of_flat (K.X j) E
  exact Module.Baer.injective
    (Module.Baer.of_equiv e.symm (Module.Baer.of_injective h))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_sup_isZero_of_mayerVietoris
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_sup_isZero_of_mayerVietoris
    (I J : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : 1 + n₀ = n₁)
    (hInf : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (I ⊓ J) M n₀))
    (hI : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M n₁))
    (hJ : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology J M n₁)) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (I ⊔ J) M n₁)
proof:
:= by
  let S :=
    idealQuotientMayerVietorisDerivedExtPowersAdjacentColimitShortComplex
      I J M n₀ n₁ h 2 (by omega)
  have hS : S.Exact :=
    idealQuotientMayerVietorisDerivedExtPowersAdjacentColimitShortComplex_exact
      I J M n₀ n₁ h 2 (by omega)
  have hX₁ : IsZero S.X₁ := by
    change IsZero
      (colimit
        (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDerivedExtPowersDiagram
            I J M n₀ n₁ h ⋙
          (evaluation (Fin 6) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj ⟨2, by omega⟩))
    exact hInf.of_iso
      (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDerivedExtPowersInfColimitIso
        I J M n₀ n₁ h)
  have hX₃ : IsZero S.X₃ := by
    change IsZero
      (colimit
        (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDerivedExtPowersDiagram
            I J M n₀ n₁ h ⋙
          (evaluation (Fin 6) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj ⟨4, by omega⟩))
    exact
      idealQuotientMayerVietorisDerivedExtPowersMiddleColimit_isZero
        I J M n₀ n₁ h hI hJ
  have hX₂ : IsZero S.X₂ := hS.isZero_of_both_isZero hX₁ hX₃
  exact
    (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDerivedExtPowersSupColimitIso
      I J M n₀ n₁ h).isZero_iff.mp hX₂

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_regularLocal_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_regularLocal_quotient_span_singleton
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (x : R) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    let I : Ideal R
proof:
:= Ideal.span {x}
    letI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top
          ((maximalIdeal R).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx))
    letI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity (R ⧸ I) →
      AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity R := by
  dsimp only
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {x}
  have hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R :=
    (maximalIdeal R).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI
  let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro hquotient
  have hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R :=
    (by norm_num : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ (3 : ℕ∞)).trans hdim
  have hconnectedR : ConnectedSpace
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) := by
    let U := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    let j : U ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of R) :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
    let : Nonempty U :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim
        R hpos
    let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
      dsimp only [j, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
    infer_instance
  have hconnectedQuotient : ConnectedSpace
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (R ⧸ I)) := by
    exact
      (open _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale in
        connectedSpace_puncturedSpectrum_quotient_span_singleton_of_completeLocalDomain
          hdim x hx hx0)
  apply hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_quotient_of_preserves_connected
    I hI hconnectedR hconnectedQuotient hquotient
  intro W hW
  let : IsConnected W := hW
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCoverQuotientRestriction_isConnected_iff
    R hpos W I hI]
  exact
    (open _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale in
      connectedSpace_connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiber_span_singleton
        R hdim W x hx hx0)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_regularSystem_prefix_two
statement:
theorem hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_regularSystem_prefix_two
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (xs : List R) (y z : R)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R (xs ++ [y, z]))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (xs ++ [y, z]) = maximalIdeal R) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity R
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain R :=
    Kummer.isDomain_of_regularSystem (xs ++ [y, z]) hreg hgen
  let : IsRegularLocalRing R :=
    Kummer.isRegularLocalRing_of_regularSystem (xs ++ [y, z]) hreg hgen
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.ofList xs
  let Q : Type u := R ⧸ I
  have hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    calc
      I ≤ Ideal.ofList (xs ++ [y, z]) := by
        rw [Ideal.ofList_append]
        exact le_sup_left
      _ = maximalIdeal R := hgen
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI
  let : Nontrivial Q := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing Q :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing Q :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R Q (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hgeometry :
      IsDomain Q ∧ IsRegularLocalRing Q ∧
        ringKrullDim Q = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    simpa only [I, Q] using
      (Kummer.quotientPrefix_geometry_dimension_two_of_regularSystem
        xs y z hreg hgen)
  let : IsDomain Q := hgeometry.1
  let : IsRegularLocalRing Q := hgeometry.2.1
  have hdimQ : ringKrullDim Q = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    hgeometry.2.2
  have hdimEq :
      ((((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ringKrullDim R) := by
    have hfullDim := Kummer.regularSystem_length_eq_ringKrullDim
      (xs ++ [y, z]) hreg hgen
    simpa using hfullDim
  have hdim :
      ((((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ringKrullDim R) := hdimEq.le
  have hbase : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      (((xs.length + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ xs.length + 2)
  have hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R :=
    hbase.trans hdim
  have hconnectedR : ConnectedSpace
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) := by
    let U := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    let j : U ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of R) :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
    let : Nonempty U :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim
        R hpos
    let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
      dsimp only [j, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
    infer_instance
  have hconnectedQ : ConnectedSpace
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum Q) := by
    let U := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum Q
    let j : U ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of Q) :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion Q
    have hposQ : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim Q := by
      rw [hdimQ]
      norm_num
    let : Nonempty U :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim
        Q hposQ
    let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
      dsimp only [j, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
    infer_instance
  have hpurityQ :
      AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity Q :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.hasPuncturedPurity_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      Q hdimQ
  apply hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_quotient_of_preserves_connected
    I hI hconnectedR hconnectedQ hpurityQ
  intro W hW
  let : IsConnected W := hW
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCoverQuotientRestriction_isConnected_iff
    R hpos W I hI]
  exact
    (open _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale in
      connectedSpace_connectedPuncturedCoverNormalizationPuncturedFiber_ofList
        R xs hI hdim W)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_regularSystem_of_two_le_length
statement:
theorem hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_regularSystem_of_two_le_length
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (ps : List R) (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R ps)
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList ps = maximalIdeal R)
    (hlen : 2 ≤ ps.length) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨xs, y, z, rfl⟩ : ∃ (xs : List R) (y z : R),
      ps = xs ++ [y, z] := by
    induction ps using List.reverseRecOn with
    | nil => exact (Nat.not_succ_le_zero 1 hlen).elim
    | append_singleton l z =>
        induction l using List.reverseRecOn with
        | nil => exact (Nat.not_succ_le_self 1 hlen).elim
        | append_singleton xs y =>
            exact ⟨xs, y, z, List.append_assoc xs [y] [z]⟩
  exact hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_regularSystem_prefix_two
    xs y z hreg hgen

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.moduleInjective_primaryComponent
statement:
theorem moduleInjective_primaryComponent (I : Ideal R)
    (E : Type u) [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] [Module.Injective R E] :
    Module.Injective R (Ideal.primaryComponent E I)
proof:
:= by
  let T : Submodule R E := Ideal.primaryComponent E I
  have hT : ∀ z : T, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0 := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := E) (I := I) (z : E)).mp z.property
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    apply Subtype.ext
    change a • (z : E) = (0 : E)
    exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (R := R) (M := E)
      ((I ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) (z : E)).mp hn ⟨a, ha⟩
  obtain ⟨H, i, hi, hHinjective, hH, _hQ⟩ :=
    exists_idealPowerTorsion_injective_presentation I (ModuleCat.of R T) hT
  let : Module.Injective R H := hHinjective
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
    Module.Injective.extension_property R E T H i hi T.subtype
  have hgmem (z : H) : g z ∈ T := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hH z
    apply (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := E) (I := I) (g z)).mpr
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff]
    intro a
    simpa only [map_smul, map_zero] using congrArg g (hn (a : R) a.property)
  let p : H →ₗ[R] T := g.codRestrict T hgmem
  have hpi (z : T) : p (i z) = z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hg z
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro X Y _ _ _ _ f hf q
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ :=
    Module.Injective.extension_property R H X Y f hf (i.comp q)
  refine ⟨p.comp g', ?_⟩
  intro x
  change p (g' (f x)) = q x
  calc
    p (g' (f x)) = p (i (q x)) := by
      apply congrArg p
      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using LinearMap.congr_fun hg' x
    _ = q x := hpi (q x)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.primaryComponent_localization_comp_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem primaryComponent_localization_comp_eq_zero
    (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers x) M).comp
      (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.span {x})).subtype = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply (ker_localizedModule_mkLinearMap_powers M x).symm.le
  exact z.property

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.principalLocalizationSequence_shortExact
statement:
theorem principalLocalizationSequence_shortExact
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] :
    (principalLocalizationSequence x M).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact _ _
    (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.span {x})).subtype_injective
    (localizedModule_mkLinearMap_surjective_of_injective M (Submonoid.powers x))
  rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]
  change LinearMap.ker (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers x) M) =
    LinearMap.range (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.span {x})).subtype
  rw [Submodule.range_subtype, ker_localizedModule_mkLinearMap_powers]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.moduleInjective_localizedModule_powers
statement:
theorem moduleInjective_localizedModule_powers
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] :
    Module.Injective R (LocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers x) M)
proof:
:= by
  let S := principalLocalizationSequence x M
  let : Module.Injective R S.X₁ := moduleInjective_primaryComponent (Ideal.span {x}) M
  let : CategoryTheory.Injective S.X₁ := Module.injective_object_of_injective_module R S.X₁
  let : CategoryTheory.Injective S.X₂ := Module.injective_object_of_injective_module R M
  let s := (principalLocalizationSequence_shortExact x M).splittingOfInjective
  let h : Retract S.X₃ S.X₂ := ⟨s.s, S.g, s.s_g⟩
  let : CategoryTheory.Injective S.X₃ := h.injective
  exact Module.injective_module_of_injective_object R S.X₃

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.principalLocalizationInclusion_quasiIsoAt_zero
statement:
private theorem principalLocalizationInclusion_quasiIsoAt_zero
    (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    QuasiIsoAt (principalLocalizationInclusion x M) 0
proof:
:= by
  let C := principalLocalizationComplex x M
  let S := C.sc' 0 0 1
  let f := principalLocalizationInclusion x M
  apply (quasiIsoAt_iff' f 0 0 1
    CochainComplex.prev_nat_zero (CochainComplex.next ℕ 0)).mpr
  apply (ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_isIso_liftCycles _ rfl rfl ?_).mpr
  · let T : Submodule R S.X₂ := Ideal.primaryComponent S.X₂ (Ideal.span {x})
    have hT : T = LinearMap.ker S.g.hom :=
      (principalLocalizationComplex_ker_d_zero x M).symm
    let k : ModuleCat.of R T ⟶ S.X₂ := ModuleCat.ofHom T.subtype
    have hk : k ≫ S.g = 0 :=
      ModuleCat.hom_ext (primaryComponent_localization_comp_eq_zero x M)
    let e : ModuleCat.of R T ≅ S.cycles :=
      (LinearEquiv.ofEq T (LinearMap.ker S.g.hom) hT).toModuleIso ≪≫
        S.moduleCatCyclesIso.symm
    have he : S.liftCycles k hk = e.hom := by
      apply (cancel_mono S.iCycles).mp
      refine (S.liftCycles_i k hk).trans ?_
      symm
      change ((LinearEquiv.ofEq T (LinearMap.ker S.g.hom) hT).toModuleIso.hom ≫
        S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv) ≫ S.iCycles = k
      calc
        _ = (LinearEquiv.ofEq T (LinearMap.ker S.g.hom) hT).toModuleIso.hom ≫
            (S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv ≫ S.iCycles) := Category.assoc _ _ _
        _ = (LinearEquiv.ofEq T (LinearMap.ker S.g.hom) hT).toModuleIso.hom ≫
            S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.i := congrArg
              (fun g : S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K ⟶ S.X₂ =>
                (LinearEquiv.ofEq T (LinearMap.ker S.g.hom) hT).toModuleIso.hom ≫ g)
              S.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_iCycles
        _ = k := rfl
    change IsIso (S.liftCycles k hk)
    rw [he]
    infer_instance
  · exact C.shape 0 0 (by change ¬ ((0 : ℕ) + 1 = 0); omega)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.principalLocalizationInclusion_quasiIso
statement:
theorem principalLocalizationInclusion_quasiIso
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] :
    QuasiIso (principalLocalizationInclusion x M)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => exact principalLocalizationInclusion_quasiIsoAt_zero x M
  | succ n =>
      apply (quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt _ _ ?_).mpr
        (principalLocalizationComplex_exactAt_succ x M n)
      apply HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_isZero
      exact HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X _ _ _ _ (by omega)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.principalLocalizationHomotopyEquiv_hom
statement:
theorem principalLocalizationHomotopyEquiv_hom
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] :

proof:
:= by

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.principalLocalizationHomotopyEquiv_hom_f_zero
statement:
theorem principalLocalizationHomotopyEquiv_hom_f_zero
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R M] :
    (principalLocalizationHomotopyEquiv x M).hom.f 0 =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.span {x})).subtype
proof:
:= by
  exact (congrArg (fun f => f.f 0) (principalLocalizationHomotopyEquiv_hom x M)).trans
    (CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv_symm_apply_f_zero
      (C := principalLocalizationComplex x M)
      (X := ModuleCat.of R (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.span {x})))
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (Ideal.primaryComponent M (Ideal.span {x})).subtype)
      (ModuleCat.hom_ext (primaryComponent_localization_comp_eq_zero x M)))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.idealQuotientMapOfLE_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealQuotientMapOfLE_mk {I J : Ideal R} (h : I ≤ J) (r : R) :

proof:
