name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference_comp_diagonal
statement:
theorem idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference_comp_diagonal
    (I J : Ideal R) :
    (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference I J).comp
        (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDiagonal I J) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  induction z using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | _ r =>
      change (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ⊔ J)) r -
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ⊔ J)) r = 0
      exact sub_self _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.idealQuotientMayerVietorisDiagonal_injective
statement:
theorem idealQuotientMayerVietorisDiagonal_injective (I J : Ideal R) :
    Function.Injective (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDiagonal I J)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | _ r =>
    induction y using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | _ s =>
      apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq (I ⊓ J)).mpr
      have hI : r - s ∈ I := by
        have h := congrArg Prod.fst hxy
        exact (Submodule.Quotient.eq I).mp h
      have hJ : r - s ∈ J := by
        have h := congrArg Prod.snd hxy
        exact (Submodule.Quotient.eq J).mp h
      exact ⟨hI, hJ⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference_surjective
statement:
theorem idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference_surjective (I J : Ideal R) :
    Function.Surjective (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference I J)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  induction z using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | _ r =>
      refine ⟨(Submodule.Quotient.mk r, 0), ?_⟩
      change (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ⊔ J)) r - 0 =
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ⊔ J)) r
      exact sub_zero _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.idealQuotientMayerVietoris_functionExact
statement:
theorem idealQuotientMayerVietoris_functionExact (I J : Ideal R) :
    Function.Exact (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDiagonal I J)
      (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference I J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.exact_iff]
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
    induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | _ r =>
      induction y using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
      | _ s =>
        have hrs : r - s ∈ I ⊔ J :=
          Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hz
        rw [Submodule.mem_sup] at hrs
        obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hij⟩ := hrs
        refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk (r - i), ?_⟩
        change
          ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (r - i),
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) (r - i)) =
          ((Ideal.Quotient.mk I) r, (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) s)
        apply Prod.ext
        · apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq I).mpr
          have heq : (r - i) - r = -i := by abel
          rw [heq]
          exact I.neg_mem hi
        · apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq J).mpr
          have hri : r - i = s + j := by
            calc
              r - i = (r - s) + s - i := by abel
              _ = (i + j) + s - i := by rw [hij]
              _ = s + j := by abel
          rw [hri]
          simpa using hj
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    change
      idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference I J
          (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDiagonal I J w) = 0
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun
      (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference_comp_diagonal I J) w

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.idealQuotientMayerVietorisShortComplex_shortExact
statement:
theorem idealQuotientMayerVietorisShortComplex_shortExact (I J : Ideal R) :
    (idealQuotientMayerVietorisShortComplex I J).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  exact ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact _
    (idealQuotientMayerVietoris_functionExact I J)
    (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDiagonal_injective I J)
    (idealQuotientMayerVietorisDifference_surjective I J)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.idealQuotientMayerVietorisExtSequence_exact
statement:
theorem idealQuotientMayerVietorisExtSequence_exact
    (I J : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) :
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.contravariantSequence
      (idealQuotientMayerVietorisShortComplex_shortExact I J)
      M i (i + 1) (by omega)).Exact
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.contravariantSequence_exact
    (idealQuotientMayerVietorisShortComplex_shortExact I J)
    M i (i + 1) (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.ideal_height_radical_eq
statement:
theorem ideal_height_radical_eq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) :
    I.radical.height = I.height
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.radical.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes,
    I.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes, I.radical_minimalPrimes]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.ideal_height_eq_ringKrullDim_of_radical_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem ideal_height_eq_ringKrullDim_of_radical_eq_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I.radical = maximalIdeal R) :
    ((I.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ((I.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = I.radical.height := by
      rw [ideal_height_radical_eq]
    _ = (maximalIdeal R).height :=
      congrArg (fun J : Ideal R => ((J.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) hI
    _ = ringKrullDim R := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_height_one_minimalPrime_pair_of_not_connectedSpace
statement:
theorem exists_height_one_minimalPrime_pair_of_not_connectedSpace
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [IsLocalRing C]
    [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ¬ ConnectedSpace (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) →
      x ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ P Q : Ideal C,
          P ∈ (Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes ∧
          Q ∈ (Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes ∧
          P ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧ Q ≠ maximalIdeal C ∧
          P ≠ Q ∧ P.height = 1 ∧ Q.height = 1 ∧
          (P ⊔ Q).radical = maximalIdeal C ∧
          ((P ⊔ Q).height : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim C ∧
          (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ (P ⊔ Q).height := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro hnot
  obtain ⟨hx0, P, Q, hP, hQ, hPMax, hQMax, hPheight, hQheight,
      hPQ⟩ :=
    exists_height_le_one_minimalPrime_pair_of_not_connectedSpace
      hdim x hx hnot
  let : P.IsPrime := hP.isPrime
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQ.isPrime
  have hspanHeight : 1 ≤ (Ideal.span {x}).height :=
    Ideal.one_le_height_span_singleton_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx0)
  have hPheight' : P.height = 1 :=
    le_antisymm hPheight (hspanHeight.trans (Ideal.height_mono hP.le))
  have hQheight' : Q.height = 1 :=
    le_antisymm hQheight (hspanHeight.trans (Ideal.height_mono hQ.le))
  have hPneQ : P ≠ Q := by
    intro h
    apply hPMax
    subst Q
    simpa only [sup_idem, hP.isPrime.isRadical.radical] using hPQ
  have hSupHeight :
      (((P ⊔ Q).height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim C :=
    ideal_height_eq_ringKrullDim_of_radical_eq_maximalIdeal (P ⊔ Q) hPQ
  have hThree : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ (P ⊔ Q).height := by
    have hdim' := hdim
    rw [← hSupHeight] at hdim'
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp hdim'
  exact ⟨hx0, P, Q, hP, hQ, hPMax, hQMax, hPneQ,
    hPheight', hQheight', hPQ, hSupHeight, hThree⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.ideal_height_sup_le_two_of_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem ideal_height_sup_le_two_of_isPrincipal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (P Q : Ideal R) (hP : P.IsPrincipal) (hQ : Q.IsPrincipal)
    (hPQ : P ⊔ Q ≠ ⊤) :
    (P ⊔ Q).height ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hP
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hQ
  have hspan : P ⊔ Q = Ideal.span ({p, q} : Set R) := by
    rw [hp, hq, ← Ideal.span_union]
    congr 1
  rw [hspan] at hPQ ⊢
  refine (Ideal.height_le_spanFinrank _ hPQ).trans ?_
  refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_encard ({p, q} : Set R)).trans ?_
  calc
    ({p, q} : Set R).encard ≤ ({q} : Set R).encard + 1 :=
      Set.encard_insert_le {q} p
    _ = 2 := by norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.ideal_height_sup_le_two_of_height_one_of_uniqueFactorizationMonoid
statement:
theorem ideal_height_sup_le_two_of_height_one_of_uniqueFactorizationMonoid
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid R]
    (P Q : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime]
    (hP : P.height = 1) (hQ : Q.height = 1)
    (hPQ : P ⊔ Q ≠ ⊤) :
    (P ⊔ Q).height ≤ 2
proof:
:=
  ideal_height_sup_le_two_of_isPrincipal P Q
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.isPrincipal_of_height_eq_one hP)
    (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.isPrincipal_of_height_eq_one hQ) hPQ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedSpace_puncturedSpectrum_quotient_span_singleton_of_ufd
statement:
theorem connectedSpace_puncturedSpectrum_quotient_span_singleton_of_ufd
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [IsLocalRing C]
    [IsNoetherianRing C] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ConnectedSpace
      (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  by_contra hnot
  obtain ⟨_hx0, P, Q, _hP, _hQ, _hPMax, _hQMax, _hPneQ,
      hPheight, hQheight, hPQ, _hSupHeight, hThree⟩ :=
    exists_height_one_minimalPrime_pair_of_not_connectedSpace
      hdim x hx hnot
  let : P.IsPrime := _hP.isPrime
  let : Q.IsPrime := _hQ.isPrime
  have hProper : P ⊔ Q ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    apply (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top
    simp only [← hPQ, htop, Ideal.radical_top]
  have hTwo : (P ⊔ Q).height ≤ 2 :=
    ideal_height_sup_le_two_of_height_one_of_uniqueFactorizationMonoid
      P Q hPheight hQheight hProper
  have : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ 2 := hThree.trans hTwo
  norm_num at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_dimension_two
statement:
private theorem puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_dimension_two
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    Nonempty (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R
  rw [hdim]
  norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumInclusion_isOpenImmersion
statement:
private theorem puncturedSpectrumInclusion_isOpenImmersion :
    IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism_comp_inclusion
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism_comp_inclusion
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism R hdim ≫
        Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R =
      (Spec (.of R)).genericExtensionMorphism
        (Spec (.of R)).functionField
proof:
:= by
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : Nonempty U := puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_dimension_two R hdim
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := puncturedSpectrumInclusion_isOpenImmersion R
  let : IsIntegral X := inferInstance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  change IsOpenImmersion.lift j
      (X.genericExtensionMorphism X.functionField) _ ≫ j = _
  exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover_comp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover_comp
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) :
    puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover R hdim W ≫ W.hom =
      (puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W).hom ≫
        puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism R hdim
proof:
:= by
  exact pullback.condition

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism_denseRange
statement:
private theorem puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism_denseRange
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    DenseRange (puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism R hdim)
proof:
:= by
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let η := puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism R hdim
  let : Nonempty U := puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_dimension_two R hdim
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := puncturedSpectrumInclusion_isOpenImmersion R
  let : IsIntegral X := inferInstance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  have hη (x : Spec (.of X.functionField)) : η x = genericPoint U := by
    apply j.isEmbedding.injective
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism_comp_inclusion R hdim,
      Subsingleton.elim x
        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (CommRingCat.of X.functionField)),
      X.genericExtensionMorphism_apply_closedPoint,
      genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion j]
  have hrange : Set.range η = {genericPoint U} := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (hη x)
    · intro hy
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      subst y
      exact ⟨IsLocalRing.closedPoint (CommRingCat.of X.functionField), hη _⟩
  rw [denseRange_iff_closure_range, hrange, genericPoint_closure]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover_appTop_injective
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover_appTop_injective
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) :
    Function.Injective
      (puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover R hdim W).appTop.hom
proof:
:= by
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let η := puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism R hdim
  let G := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W
  let q : G.left ⟶ W.left := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover R hdim W
  let : Nonempty U := puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_dimension_two R hdim
  let : IsIntegral X := inferInstance
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) :=
    puncturedSpectrumInclusion_isOpenImmersion R
  let : IsIntegral U :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
  let : IsDominant η :=
    ⟨puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism_denseRange R hdim⟩
  let hstd : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant η :=
    IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isDominant η
  let : QuasiSeparatedSpace U := inferInstance
  let : QuasiCompact η := inferInstance
  let hflat : Flat W.hom :=
    Etale.iff_flat_and_formallyUnramified.mp W.prop.toEtale |>.1
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant q := by
    dsimp only [q, puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover]
    exact @IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.pullbackFst _ _ _
      W.hom η hstd (inferInstance : QuasiCompact η) hflat
  let : QuasiCompact q := by
    dsimp only [q, puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover]
    have hbase : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange (C := Scheme.{u})
        (fun {_ _} f => QuasiCompact f) := quasiCompact_isStableUnderBaseChange
    exact MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
      (P := fun {_ _ : Scheme.{u}} f => QuasiCompact f)
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback W.hom η).flip (inferInstance : QuasiCompact η)
  exact q.app_injective ⊤

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber_sections_etale
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber_sections_etale
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) :
    letI
proof:
:= puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberAlgebra R hdim W
    Algebra.Etale (Spec (.of R)).functionField
      Γ((puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W).left, ⊤) := by
  let K : Type u := (Spec (.of R)).functionField
  let G := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W
  let f : G.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) := G.hom
  let : Algebra K Γ(G.left, ⊤) :=
    puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberAlgebra R hdim W
  let : IsFiniteEtale f := G.prop
  let : IsFinite f := G.prop.toIsFinite
  let : IsAffineHom f := G.prop.toIsFinite.toIsAffineHom
  let : IsAffine G.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom f
  have hf : f.appTop.hom.Etale := by
    rw [← HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine
      (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale)]
    exact G.prop.toEtale
  change (f.appTop.hom.comp
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv.hom).Etale
  exact RingHom.Etale.respectsIso.right f.appTop.hom
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm hf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber_sections_decomposition
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber_sections_decomposition
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) :
    let K : Type u
proof:
:= (Spec (.of R)).functionField
    let C := Γ((puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W).left, ⊤)
    letI := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberAlgebra R hdim W
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I) (L : I → Type u)
      (_ : ∀ i, Field (L i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra K (L i))
      (_ : C ≃ₐ[K] ∀ i, L i),
      ∀ i, Module.Finite K (L i) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (L i) := by
  let K : Type u := (Spec (.of R)).functionField
  let G := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W
  let C := Γ(G.left, ⊤)
  let : Algebra K C := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberAlgebra R hdim W
  let : Algebra.Etale K C :=
    puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber_sections_etale R hdim W
  exact (Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod K C).mp inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.genericExtensionMorphism_appTop_eq_germ
statement:
private theorem genericExtensionMorphism_appTop_eq_germ :
    let X
proof:
:= Spec (.of R)
    let K : Type u := X.functionField
    letI : IsIntegral X := inferInstance
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
    (X.genericExtensionMorphism K).appTop.hom =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv.hom.comp
        (X.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom := by
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let K : Type u := X.functionField
  let : IsIntegral X := inferInstance
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  ext r
  let e : Γ(Spec (.of K), ⊤) ≃+* K :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  change (X.genericExtensionMorphism K).appTop.hom r =
    e.symm (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r)
  apply e.injective
  rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
  change e ((X.genericExtensionMorphism K).app ⊤ r) =
    X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r
  have h := X.genericExtensionSectionsIso_hom_app K ⊤ r
  change e ((X.genericExtensionMorphism K).app ⊤ r) =
    algebraMap K K (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r) at h
  simpa using h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover_appTop_comp
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover_appTop_comp
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) :
    let X
proof:
:= Spec (.of R)
    let K : Type u := X.functionField
    let G := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W
    let q := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover R hdim W
    let f := puncturedSpectrumCoverToSpec R W
    letI : IsIntegral X := inferInstance
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
    q.appTop.hom.comp f.appTop.hom =
      (G.hom.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv.hom).comp
        (X.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom := by
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let K : Type u := X.functionField
  let G := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W
  let η := puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism R hdim
  let q := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover R hdim W
  let f := puncturedSpectrumCoverToSpec R W
  let : IsIntegral X := inferInstance
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  dsimp only
  have hs : q ≫ f =
      (puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W).hom ≫
        X.genericExtensionMorphism K := by
    calc
      q ≫ f = (q ≫ W.hom) ≫ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R := by
        simp only [f, puncturedSpectrumCoverToSpec, Category.assoc]
      _ = ((puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W).hom ≫
          puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism R hdim) ≫
          Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R := by
        exact congrArg
          (fun t ↦ t ≫ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
          (puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover_comp R hdim W)
      _ = (puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W).hom ≫
          X.genericExtensionMorphism K := by
        exact congrArg
          (fun t ↦ (puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W).hom ≫ t)
          (puncturedSpectrumGenericMorphism_comp_inclusion R hdim)
  rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, hs]
  change (puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W).hom.appTop.hom.comp
      (X.genericExtensionMorphism K).appTop.hom = _
  rw [genericExtensionMorphism_appTop_eq_germ (R := R)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumNormalizationExtension_integralClosure_finite
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrumNormalizationExtension_integralClosure_finite
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) :
    let f
proof:
:= puncturedSpectrumCoverToSpec R W
    letI : Algebra Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤) :=
      f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    Module.Finite Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤)
      (integralClosure Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤)) := by
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let K : Type u := X.functionField
  let G := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber R hdim W
  let q := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover R hdim W
  let f := puncturedSpectrumCoverToSpec R W
  let A : Type u := Γ(X, ⊤)
  let B : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
  let C : Type u := Γ(G.left, ⊤)
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed R :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      hdim
  let : IsIntegral X := inferInstance
  let : IsNormalIntegral X := inferInstance
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian X := inferInstance
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  let : IsNoetherianRing A :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian
      (⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩ : X.affineOpens)
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed A :=
    IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top X)
  let : Algebra A K := (X.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom.toAlgebra
  let : IsFractionRing A K :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X ⊤
      (isAffineOpen_top X)
  let : Algebra A B := f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra K C := puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberAlgebra R hdim W
  let : Algebra A C :=
    ((algebraMap K C).comp (algebraMap A K)).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra B C := q.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A K C := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A B C := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    change (G.hom.appTop.hom.comp
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv.hom).comp
          (X.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom =
      q.appTop.hom.comp f.appTop.hom
    exact (puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover_appTop_comp R hdim W).symm)
  obtain ⟨I, hI, L, hLField, hLAlgebra, e, hL⟩ :=
    puncturedSpectrumGenericFiber_sections_decomposition R hdim W
  let : Finite I := hI
  let (i : I) : Field (L i) := hLField i
  let (i : I) : Algebra K (L i) := hLAlgebra i
  let (i : I) : Module.Finite K (L i) := (hL i).1
  let (i : I) : Algebra.IsSeparable K (L i) := (hL i).2
  let (i : I) : Algebra A (L i) :=
    ((algebraMap K (L i)).comp (algebraMap A K)).toAlgebra
  let (i : I) : IsScalarTower A K (L i) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : Algebra A (∀ i, L i) := Pi.algebra (R := A) I L
  let : Algebra K (∀ i, L i) := Pi.algebra (R := K) I L
  let : IsScalarTower A K (∀ i, L i) := inferInstance
  let eA : C ≃ₐ[A] (∀ i, L i) := e.restrictScalars A
  let qA : B →ₐ[A] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C
  let φ : B →ₐ[A] (∀ i, L i) := eA.toAlgHom.comp qA
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply puncturedSpectrumGenericFiberToCover_appTop_injective R hdim W
    have hq : algebraMap B C x = algebraMap B C y := eA.injective hxy
    change q.appTop.hom x = q.appTop.hom y at hq
    exact hq
  let φInt := φ.mapIntegralClosure
  have hφInt : Function.Injective φInt := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply hφ
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
  let (i : I) : Module.Finite A (integralClosure A (L i)) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite A K (L i) (integralClosure A (L i))
  let : Module.Finite A (∀ i, integralClosure A (L i)) := inferInstance
  let : Module.Finite A (integralClosure A (∀ i, L i)) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv
      (EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosurePiAlgEquiv L).symm.toLinearEquiv
  exact Module.Finite.of_injective φInt.toLinearMap hφInt

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumNormalizationExtensionHom_isFinite
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrumNormalizationExtensionHom_isFinite
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) :
    IsFinite (puncturedSpectrumNormalizationExtensionHom R W)
proof:
:= by
  apply (puncturedSpectrumNormalizationExtensionHom_isFinite_iff_appTop R W).2
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let f := puncturedSpectrumCoverToSpec R W
  let A : Type u := Γ(X, ⊤)
  let B : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian X := inferInstance
  let : IsFiniteEtale W.hom := W.prop
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) :=
    puncturedSpectrumInclusion_isOpenImmersion R
  let : QuasiCompact f := by
    dsimp only [f, puncturedSpectrumCoverToSpec]
    have hW : QuasiCompact W.hom := inferInstance
    have hj : QuasiCompact (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) :=
      inferInstance
    exact @quasiCompact_comp W.left (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) X
      W.hom (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) hW hj
  let : QuasiSeparated f := by
    dsimp only [f, puncturedSpectrumCoverToSpec]
    have hW : QuasiSeparated W.hom := inferInstance
    have hj : QuasiSeparated (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) :=
      inferInstance
    exact @quasiSeparated_comp W.left (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) X
      W.hom (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) hW hj
  let : Algebra A B := f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  have hfinite : Module.Finite A (integralClosure A B) :=
    puncturedSpectrumNormalizationExtension_integralClosure_finite R hdim W
  change (f.fromNormalization.app (⊤ : X.Opens)).hom.Finite
  rw [f.fromNormalization_app (isAffineOpen_top X)]
  exact RingHom.Finite.comp
    (f.normalizationObjIso (isAffineOpen_top X)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.finite
    (show (algebraMap A (integralClosure A B)).Finite from hfinite)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isEtaleAt_of_awayMap_etale
statement:
private theorem isEtaleAt_of_awayMap_etale
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (d : R) (h : (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap R B) d).Etale)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum B) (hdP : algebraMap R B d ∉ P.asIdeal) :
    Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((Localization.awayMap (algebraMap R B) d).comp
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away d))).Etale :=
    RingHom.Etale.stableUnderComposition _ _
      (RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr (Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway d)) h
  have heq : (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap R B) d).comp
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away d)) =
        algebraMap R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R B d)) := by
    ext r
    change IsLocalization.Away.map _ _ (algebraMap R B) d
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away d) r) = _
    rw [IsLocalization.Away.map, IsLocalization.map_eq,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B (Localization.Away (algebraMap R B d))]
  rw [heq] at hcomp
  let : Algebra.Etale R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R B d)) :=
    RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mp hcomp
  exact Algebra.basicOpen_subset_etaleLocus_iff.mpr
    (inferInstance : Algebra.FormallyEtale R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R B d))) hdP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAway_normalization_etale_of_regular_boundary
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleAway_normalization_etale_of_regular_boundary
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (d : R) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away d)))) [IsConnected Y]
    (hregular : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, d ∈ p.asIdeal →
      IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
    (hheightOne : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 → d ∈ p →
      Etale (pullback.snd
        ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.Away d)) from Y.hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away d)))).fromNormalization
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p)))))) :
    Etale ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.Away d)) from Y.hom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away d)))).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away d
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hd
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed S := isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S
    (Submonoid.powers d)
    (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd))
  let : IsIntegral Y.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsNormalIntegral Y.left := isNormalIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsAffine Y.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom)
  let f : Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))
  let K := (Spec (.of S)).functionField
  let L := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra R K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra d hd
  let : Algebra R L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra d hd Y
  have hAlg := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra_eq_affineMorphism d hd Y
  have hcompare : ∃ e : f.normalization ≅ Spec (.of (integralClosure R L)),
      e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L))) =
        f.fromNormalization := by
    change (letI : Algebra R L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra d hd Y
      ∃ e : f.normalization ≅ Spec (.of (integralClosure R L)),
        e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L))) =
          f.fromNormalization)
    rw [hAlg]
    exact ⟨affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R f,
      affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_hom_base R f⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hcompare
  let : IsFractionRing R K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing d hd
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower d hd Y
  let : FiniteDimensional K L := finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable K L := isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  have haway : (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)) d).Etale :=
    localization_away_integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale d hd Y
  have hEt : Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R L) := by
    apply SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_etale_of_regular_boundary (K := K)
      {p | d ∈ p.asIdeal} hregular
    · intro P hP
      exact isEtaleAt_of_awayMap_etale d haway P hP
    · intro p _ hp P _ _
      by_cases hdp : d ∈ p
      · let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p)))
        let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)))
        have hN : Etale (pullback.snd f.fromNormalization b) := hheightOne p hp hdp
        let l := pullback.map f.fromNormalization b g b e.hom (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
          ((Category.comp_id _).trans he.symm)
          ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)
        have hl : l ≫ pullback.snd g b = pullback.snd f.fromNormalization b :=
          (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _)
        have hG : Etale (pullback.snd g b) := by
          let : Etale (pullback.snd f.fromNormalization b) := hN
          have ht : Etale (inv l ≫ pullback.snd f.fromNormalization b) := inferInstance
          rw [← hl, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc] at ht
          exact ht
        apply SchemeTheory.isEtaleAt_of_spec_baseChange_atPrime R (integralClosure R L)
          ⟨p, inferInstance⟩ hG ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
        apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
        exact (Ideal.over_def P p).symm
      · apply isEtaleAt_of_awayMap_etale d haway ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
        intro hdP
        apply hdp
        have hdUnder : d ∈ P.under R := hdP
        rw [← Ideal.over_def P p] at hdUnder
        exact hdUnder
  have hSpec : Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)))) :=
    (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr (RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr hEt)
  have hcomp : Etale (e.hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)))) := inferInstance
  rw [he] at hcomp
  exact hcomp

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.singleTensorInto_out
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [singleTensorInto, singleTensorOut]
  rw [Category.assoc, ι_mapBifunctorDesc]
  dsimp only [singleTensorSummandOut]
  rw [dite_eq_left rfl]
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.XIsoOfEq, eqToIso_refl, Iso.refl_hom,
    MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, Category.comp_id,
    ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight]
  change ((singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 M).inv ≫
    (singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 M).hom) ▷ K.X n = 𝟙 _
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, id_whiskerRight]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.singleTensorOut_into
proof:
:= by
  apply mapBifunctor.hom_ext
  intro i j hij
  have hij' : i + j = n := hij
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    have hj : j = n := by omega
    subst j
    dsimp only [singleTensorOut]
    rw [← Category.assoc, ι_mapBifunctorDesc]
    dsimp only [singleTensorSummandOut, singleTensorInto]
    rw [dite_eq_left rfl]
    simp only [HomologicalComplex.XIsoOfEq, eqToIso_refl, Iso.refl_hom,
      MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, Category.comp_id]
    change ((singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 M).hom ▷ K.X n) ≫
      ((singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 M).inv ▷ K.X n) ≫
        ιTensorObj (coefficientSingle M) K 0 n n (zero_add n) =
      ιTensorObj (coefficientSingle M) K 0 n n (zero_add n)
    rw [← comp_whiskerRight_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, id_whiskerRight, Category.id_comp]
  · exact ((tensorRight (K.X j)).map_isZero
      (isZero_single_obj_X (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 M i hi)).eq_of_src _ _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.single_tensor_d₁
statement:
private theorem single_tensor_d₁ (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) (i j n : ℕ) :
    mapBifunctor.d₁ (coefficientSingle M) K (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} R))
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ) i j n = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel i ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).next i)
  · by_cases hn : ComplexShape.π (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ((ComplexShape.up ℕ).next i, j) = n
    · rw [mapBifunctor.d₁_eq _ _ _ _ hi _ _ hn, single_obj_d, Functor.map_zero,
        zero_app, zero_comp, smul_zero]
    · rw [mapBifunctor.d₁_eq_zero' _ _ _ _ hi _ _ hn]
  · rw [mapBifunctor.d₁_eq_zero _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hi]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.singleTensorInto_comm
statement:
private theorem singleTensorInto_comm (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) (i j : ℕ) :
    singleTensorInto M K i ≫ (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj (coefficientSingle M) K).d i j =
      ((tensorLeft M).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ) |>.obj K).d i j ≫
        singleTensorInto M K j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel i j
  · simp only [singleTensorInto, Category.assoc, mapBifunctor.d_eq,
      Preadditive.comp_add, mapBifunctor.ι_D₁, mapBifunctor.ι_D₂,
      single_tensor_d₁, comp_zero, zero_add]
    rw [mapBifunctor.d₂_eq _ _ _ _ _ hij _ (zero_add j)]
    change ((singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 M).inv ▷ K.X i) ≫
      ((1 : ℤ) • (((coefficientSingle M).X 0 ◁ K.d i j) ≫
        ιTensorObj (coefficientSingle M) K 0 j j (zero_add j))) =
      (M ◁ K.d i j) ≫ ((singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 M).inv ▷ K.X j) ≫
        ιTensorObj (coefficientSingle M) K 0 j j (zero_add j)
    rw [one_smul, ← whisker_exchange_assoc]
  · rw [HomologicalComplex.shape _ _ _ hij, comp_zero,
      HomologicalComplex.shape _ _ _ hij, zero_comp]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.singleTensorComplexIso_hom_f
statement:
theorem singleTensorComplexIso_hom_f (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    (singleTensorComplexIso M K).hom.f n =
      ((singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 M).inv ▷ K.X n) ≫
        ιTensorObj ((HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} R)
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0).obj M) K 0 n n (zero_add n)
proof: := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_module_injective_hull
statement:
theorem exists_module_injective_hull (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    ∃ (E : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : M →ₗ[R] E),
      Function.Injective i ∧ IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i) ∧
        Module.Injective R E
proof:
:= by
  let A : ModuleCat.{u} R := Injective.under M
  let j : M →ₗ[R] A := (Injective.ι M).hom
  have hj : Function.Injective j :=
    (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (Injective.ι M)).mp inferInstance
  let : Module.Injective R A :=
    (Module.injective_iff_injective_object R A).mpr
      (inferInstance : CategoryTheory.Injective A)
  let N : Submodule R A := LinearMap.range j
  obtain ⟨E, hNE, hNess, hEinj⟩ := exists_injective_essential_extension N
  let i : M →ₗ[R] E := j.codRestrict E (fun m => hNE (LinearMap.mem_range_self j m))
  have hi : Function.Injective i := by
    intro a b hab
    apply hj
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hab
  have hrange : LinearMap.range i = N.comap E.subtype := by
    ext e
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
      exact LinearMap.mem_range_self j m
    · intro he
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := he
      exact ⟨m, Subtype.ext hm⟩
  refine ⟨ModuleCat.of R E, i, hi, ?_, hEinj⟩
  rw [hrange]
  exact hNess

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isArtinian_of_completeLocal_finiteLength_essential_submodule
statement:
theorem isArtinian_of_completeLocal_finiteLength_essential_submodule
    (N : Submodule R M) (hN : IsEssentialSubmodule N) (hlen : IsFiniteLength R N) :
    IsArtinian R M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, i, hi, hess, hEinj⟩ :=
    exists_module_injective_hull (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R))
  let : Module.Injective R E := hEinj
  let : IsArtinian R E := isArtinian_of_completeLocal_residueFieldHull i hi hess
  exact isArtinian_of_finiteLength_essential_submodule i hi hess N hN hlen

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isArtinian_of_maximalIdealPower_torsion_of_artinian_scalarKernel
statement:
theorem isArtinian_of_maximalIdealPower_torsion_of_artinian_scalarKernel
    (x : R) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    [IsArtinian R (LinearMap.ker (x • (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M)))]
    (hM : ∀ z : M, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ n, a • z = 0) :

proof:
:= by

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_maximal_essential_extension
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_essential_extension (N : Submodule R M) :
    ∃ E : Submodule R M, N ≤ E ∧
      IsEssentialSubmodule (N.comap E.subtype) ∧
      ∀ S : Submodule R M, E ≤ S →
        IsEssentialSubmodule (N.comap S.subtype) → S = E
proof:
:= by
  let good : Set (Submodule R M) :=
    {S | N ≤ S ∧ ∀ L : Submodule R M, L ≤ S → Disjoint N L → L = ⊥}
  have hN : N ∈ good := by
    refine ⟨le_rfl, ?_⟩
    intro L hLN hdisj
    apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
    intro x hx
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mpr
      ((Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hdisj) x (hLN hx) hx)
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := zorn_le₀ good (by
    intro c hc hchain
    rcases c.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hempty | hnonempty
    · subst c
      refine ⟨N, hN, ?_⟩
      intro S hS
      exact False.elim hS
    · refine ⟨sSup c, ?_, fun S hS => le_sSup hS⟩
      constructor
      · obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hnonempty
        exact (hc hS).1.trans (le_sSup hS)
      · intro L hL hdisj
        apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩ :=
          (Submodule.mem_sSup_of_directed hnonempty hchain.directedOn).mp (hL hx)
        have hNS : Disjoint N (L ⊓ S) := hdisj.mono_right inf_le_left
        have hInt : L ⊓ S = ⊥ := (hc hS).2 (L ⊓ S) inf_le_right hNS
        have hxInt : x ∈ L ⊓ S := ⟨hx, hxS⟩
        rw [hInt] at hxInt
        exact hxInt)
  refine ⟨E, hE.prop.1,
    (isEssentialSubmodule_comap_subtype_iff N E hE.prop.1).mpr hE.prop.2, ?_⟩
  intro S hES hNS
  have hNSle : N ≤ S := hE.prop.1.trans hES
  have hS : S ∈ good :=
    ⟨hNSle, (isEssentialSubmodule_comap_subtype_iff N S hNSle).mp hNS⟩
  exact le_antisymm (hE.2 hS hES) hES

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isAdicComplete_map_of_moduleFinite_of_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_map_of_moduleFinite_of_le_maximalIdeal

    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]

    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isAdicComplete_of_le_maximalIdeal

    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.isAdicComplete_of_moduleFinite

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.integralClosure_faithfulSMul_of_fractionField
statement:
theorem integralClosure_faithfulSMul_of_fractionField
    {R K L : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field L] [Algebra R L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower R K L] :
    FaithfulSMul R (integralClosure R L)
proof:
:= by
  apply (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective
    R (integralClosure R L)).mpr
  intro x z hxz
  apply IsFractionRing.injective R K
  apply (algebraMap K L).injective
  have hxL := congrArg (fun c : integralClosure R L ↦ (c : L)) hxz
  change algebraMap R L x = algebraMap R L z at hxL
  calc
    algebraMap K L (algebraMap R K x) = algebraMap R L x :=
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L x).symm
    _ = algebraMap R L z := hxL
    _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap R K z) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.prime_height_eq_ringKrullDim_of_map_maximalIdeal_le
statement:
theorem prime_height_eq_ringKrullDim_of_map_maximalIdeal_le
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    [Algebra R C] [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] [FaithfulSMul R C]
    (P : Ideal C) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R C) ≤ P) :
    ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  have hm_le : maximalIdeal R ≤ P.under R := by
    rw [Ideal.under_def, ← Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact hP
  have hund_ne : P.under R ≠ ⊤ :=
    (inferInstance : (P.under R).IsPrime).ne_top
  have hund_le : P.under R ≤ maximalIdeal R := le_maximalIdeal hund_ne
  have hund : P.under R = maximalIdeal R := le_antisymm hund_le hm_le
  have hheight : P.height = (P.under R).height :=
    (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity in
      height_eq_height_under_of_faithfully_integral_over_integrallyClosed
        (R := R) (S := C) P)
  rw [hheight, hund, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.three_le_prime_height_of_map_maximalIdeal_le
statement:
theorem three_le_prime_height_of_map_maximalIdeal_le
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    [Algebra R C] [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] [FaithfulSMul R C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (P : Ideal C) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R C) ≤ P) :
    ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prime_height_eq_ringKrullDim_of_map_maximalIdeal_le P hP]
  exact hdim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isAdicComplete
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isAdicComplete
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
      dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
    letI : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsIntegral W.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    letI : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    IsAdicComplete
      (I.map (algebraMap R (integralClosure R W.left.functionField)))
      (integralClosure R W.left.functionField) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
    dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
  let K : Type u := U.functionField
  let : Algebra R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R L :=
    ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap R K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let C := integralClosure R L
  let : Module.Finite R C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_finite_of_positiveDimension
      R hpos W
  exact isAdicComplete_map_of_moduleFinite_of_le_maximalIdeal I hI

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_three_le_prime_height
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_three_le_prime_height
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R
        (show (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R from le_trans (by norm_num) hdim)
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
      dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
    letI : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R
        (show (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R from le_trans (by norm_num) hdim)
    letI : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R
        (show (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R from le_trans (by norm_num) hdim)
    letI : IsIntegral W.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    letI : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    ∀ (P : Ideal (integralClosure R W.left.functionField))
      [P.IsPrime],
      (maximalIdeal R).map
          (algebraMap R (integralClosure R W.left.functionField)) ≤ P →
        ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
          ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
  dsimp only
  have hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R :=
    le_trans (by norm_num) hdim
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
    dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
  let K : Type u := U.functionField
  let : Algebra R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R L :=
    ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap R K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let C := integralClosure R L
  let : FaithfulSMul R C :=
    integralClosure_faithfulSMul_of_fractionField (R := R) (K := K) (L := L)
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R C := integralClosure.AlgebraIsIntegral
  intro P _ hP
  exact three_le_prime_height_of_map_maximalIdeal_le hdim P hP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation_mk₀
statement:
private theorem derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation_mk₀
    (J : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (f : ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ J) ⟶ M) :
    derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation J M (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f) =
      f.hom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J 1)
proof:
:= by
  change (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.linearEquiv₀ (R := R)
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f)).hom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J 1) = _
  have h : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.linearEquiv₀ (R := R)
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f) = f :=
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).injective
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_linearEquiv₀_apply _)
  rw [h]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation_injective
statement:
private theorem derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation_injective
    (J : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :

:=

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation_exists_preimage
statement:
private theorem derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation_exists_preimage
    (J : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (z : M)
    (hz : z ∈ Submodule.torsionBySet R M (J : Set R)) :
    ∃ α : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ J)) M 0,
      derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation J M α = z
proof:
:= by
  let zJ : Submodule.torsionBySet R M (J : Set R) := ⟨z, hz⟩
  refine ⟨(derivedExtZeroQuotientTorsionEquiv J M).symm zJ, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    ((derivedExtZeroQuotientTorsionEquiv J M).apply_symm_apply zJ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyZeroEvaluation_ι
statement:
private theorem derivedLocalCohomologyZeroEvaluation_ι
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ)

        (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M 0) (op (op n)) α) =

:=

    (colimit.ι_desc (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroEvaluationCocone I M) (op (op n))) α

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_ι
statement:
private theorem derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_ι
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ)
    (α : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u} (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M 0) :
    derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I M (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleι I M 0 n α) =

:=

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_ι_mk₀
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_ι_mk₀
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.eq_zero_of_map_eq_of_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  calc
    y = f x := hy.symm
    _ = f 0 := congrArg (ConcreteCategory.hom f) hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_injective
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_injective (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    Function.Injective (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I M)
proof:
:= by
  let : PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    preservesSmallestFilteredColimits_of_preservesFilteredColimits _
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨k, α, hα⟩ :=
    Concrete.colimit_exists_rep (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M 0) z
  rcases k with ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
  have hrep : derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation (I ^ n) M α = 0 := by
    exact (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_ι I M n α).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I M) hα).trans hz)
  have hzero : α = 0 :=
    derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation_injective (I ^ n) M
      (hrep.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  exact eq_zero_of_map_eq_of_eq_zero
    (colimit.ι (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M 0) (op (op n))) hzero hα

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_exists_preimage
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_exists_preimage
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (z : M)
    (hz : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0) :
    ∃ α : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I M 0,
      derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I M α = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hz
  have hzmem : z ∈ Submodule.torsionBySet R M ((I ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) :=
    (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (R := R) (M := M)
      (s := ((I ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R)) z).mpr (fun a => hn a a.property)
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ :=
    derivedExtZeroQuotientEvaluation_exists_preimage (I ^ n) M z hzmem
  exact ⟨derivedLocalCohomologyModuleι I M 0 n α,
    (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_ι I M n α).trans hα⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.mem_range_derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_iff
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (z : M) :
    z ∈ LinearMap.range (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I M) ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨α, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
      derivedLocalCohomologyModule_exists_idealPower_smul_eq_zero I M 0 α
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    rw [← map_smul, hn a ha, map_zero]
  · exact derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_exists_preimage I M z

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_bijective_of_power_torsion
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_bijective_of_power_torsion
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (hM : ∀ z : M, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0) :
    Function.Bijective (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_injective I M,
    fun z => derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_exists_preimage I M z (hM z)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.colimit_ι_eq_zero_iff_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem colimit_ι_eq_zero_iff_eventually_zero
    {J : Type v} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (D : J ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) [HasColimit D]
    [PreservesColimit D (forget AddCommGrpCat)]
    (j : J) (x : D.obj j) :
    colimit.ι D j x = 0 ↔
      ∃ k : J, ∃ f : j ⟶ k, D.map f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' :
        colimit.ι D j x = colimit.ι D j (0 : D.obj j) := by
      simpa using hx
    obtain ⟨k, f, _g, hfg⟩ :=
      (Concrete.colimit_rep_eq_iff_exists D x (0 : D.obj j)).mp hx'
    exact ⟨k, f, by simpa using hfg⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, f, hf⟩
    have hx' :
        colimit.ι D j x = colimit.ι D j (0 : D.obj j) :=
      (Concrete.colimit_rep_eq_iff_exists D x (0 : D.obj j)).mpr
        ⟨k, f, f, by simpa using hf⟩
    simpa using hx'

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.colimit_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem colimit_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero
    {J : Type v} [SmallCategory J] (D : J ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    [HasColimit D]
    (hzero : ∀ j : J, ∀ x : D.obj j,
      ∃ k : J, ∃ f : j ⟶ k, D.map f x = 0) :
    IsZero (colimit D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply colimit.hom_ext
  intro j
  rw [Category.comp_id, comp_zero]
  ext x
  obtain ⟨k, f, hf⟩ := hzero j x
  change colimit.ι D j x = 0
  rw [← colimit.w D f]
  change colimit.ι D k (D.map f x) = 0
  rw [hf, map_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.colimit_isZero_iff_elementwise_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem colimit_isZero_iff_elementwise_eventually_zero
    {J : Type v} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (D : J ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) [HasColimit D]
    [PreservesColimit D (forget AddCommGrpCat)] :
    IsZero (colimit D) ↔
      ∀ j : J, ∀ x : D.obj j,
        ∃ k : J, ∃ f : j ⟶ k, D.map f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero j x
    apply (colimit_ι_eq_zero_iff_eventually_zero D j x).mp
    have hid : (𝟙 (colimit D)) = 0 := hzero.eq_of_src _ _
    change (𝟙 (colimit D)) (colimit.ι D j x) = 0
    rw [hid]
    rfl
  · exact colimit_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero D

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.colimit_isZero_of_eventually_zero_map
statement:
theorem colimit_isZero_of_eventually_zero_map
    {J : Type v} [SmallCategory J] (D : J ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    [HasColimit D]
    (hzero : ∀ j : J, ∃ k : J, ∃ f : j ⟶ k, D.map f = 0) :
    IsZero (colimit D)
proof:
:= by
  apply colimit_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero D
  intro j x
  obtain ⟨k, f, hf⟩ := hzero j
  refine ⟨k, f, ?_⟩
  rw [hf]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.colimit_natDoubleOp_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem colimit_natDoubleOp_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero
    (D : (ℕᵒᵖ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : D.obj (op (op n)),
      ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ hnm : n ≤ m,
        D.map (homOfLE hnm).op.op x = 0) :
    IsZero (colimit D)
proof:
:= by
  apply colimit_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero D
  rintro ⟨⟨n⟩⟩ x
  obtain ⟨m, hnm, hm⟩ := hzero n x
  exact ⟨op (op m), (homOfLE hnm).op.op, hm⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.colimit_natDoubleOp_isZero_of_eventually_zero_map
statement:
theorem colimit_natDoubleOp_isZero_of_eventually_zero_map
    (D : (ℕᵒᵖ)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ hnm : n ≤ m,
      D.map (homOfLE hnm).op.op = 0) :
    IsZero (colimit D)
proof:
:= by

  rintro ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hnm, hm⟩ := hzero n

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_eventually_zero_transition
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_eventually_zero_transition
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ hnm : n ≤ m,
      (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i).map
        (homOfLE hnm).op.op = 0) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M i)
proof:
:= by
  exact colimit_natDoubleOp_isZero_of_eventually_zero_map
    (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i) hzero

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero_transition
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero_transition
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∀ x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
        (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i,
      ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ hnm : n ≤ m,
        (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i).map
          (homOfLE hnm).op.op x = 0) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M i)
proof:
:= by
  apply colimit_natDoubleOp_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero
    (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)
  intro n x
  exact hzero n x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_iff_elementwise_eventually_zero_transition
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_iff_elementwise_eventually_zero_transition
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M i) ↔
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        ∀ x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
          (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i,
        ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ hnm : n ≤ m,
          (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i).map
            (homOfLE hnm).op.op x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero n x
    change IsZero
      (colimit (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)) at hzero
    let : PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0}
        (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
      preservesSmallestFilteredColimits_of_preservesFilteredColimits _
    obtain ⟨k, f, hf⟩ :=
      (colimit_isZero_iff_elementwise_eventually_zero
        (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i)).mp hzero
        (op (op n)) x
    rcases k with ⟨⟨m⟩⟩
    let hnm : n ≤ m := f.unop.unop.down.down
    refine ⟨m, hnm, ?_⟩
    have hf' : f = (homOfLE hnm).op.op := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [← hf']
    exact hf
  · exact
      derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_elementwise_eventually_zero_transition
        I M i

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_not_isZero_iff_exists_persistent_transition
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_not_isZero_iff_exists_persistent_transition
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) :
    ¬ IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M i) ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ,
        ∃ x : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}
          (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)) M i,
        ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ hnm : n ≤ m,
          (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I M i).map
            (homOfLE hnm).op.op x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [not_forall, not_exists] using
    not_congr
      (derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_iff_elementwise_eventually_zero_transition
        I M i)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_ofList_radical_eq_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq
statement:
theorem exists_ofList_radical_eq_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ xs : List R,
      xs.length = d ∧
      (Ideal.ofList xs).radical = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  let m : Ideal R := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  have hmHeight : m.height = (d : ℕ∞) := by
    apply WithBot.coe_injective
    exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim.trans hdim
  obtain ⟨J, hJm, hJrank, hJheight⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_spanRank_eq_and_height_eq m
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top
  have hJfg : (J : Submodule R R).FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian J
  have hJrank' := hJrank
  rw [Submodule.fg_iff_spanRank_eq_spanFinrank.mpr hJfg, hmHeight] at hJrank'
  have hJfinrank : J.spanFinrank = d := by
    exact_mod_cast hJrank'
  have hJradical : J.radical = m := by
    rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact sInf_le
        ⟨hJm, (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).isPrime⟩
    · refine le_sInf ?_
      intro P hP
      let : P.IsPrime := hP.2
      have hPm : P ≤ m := IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime P
      have hPheight : P.height = m.height := by
        apply le_antisymm (Ideal.height_mono hPm)
        calc
          m.height = J.height := hJheight.symm
          _ ≤ P.height := Ideal.height_mono hP.1
      have hPdim : ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R := by
        rw [hPheight]
        exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim
      have hPmax : P = m :=
        (Ideal.height_eq_ringKrullDim_iff (I := P)).mp hPdim
      exact hPmax.ge
  obtain ⟨s, hscard, hsJ⟩ :=
    Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank hJfg
  refine ⟨s.toList, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Finset.length_toList, hJfinrank] using hscard
  · have hofList : Ideal.ofList s.toList = J := by
      unfold Ideal.ofList
      simpa using hsJ
    rw [hofList, hJradical]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_derivedLocalCohomology_ofList_iso_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq
statement:
theorem exists_derivedLocalCohomology_ofList_iso_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    ∃ xs : List R,
      xs.length = d ∧
      (Ideal.ofList xs).radical = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∧
      Nonempty
        (derivedLocalCohomology (Ideal.ofList xs) M d ≅
          derivedLocalCohomology (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) M d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨xs, hlength, hradical⟩ :=
    exists_ofList_radical_eq_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq d hdim
  have hmaxRadical :
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).radical =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).isPrime.isRadical.radical
  refine ⟨xs, hlength, hradical, ?_⟩
  exact
    ⟨derivedLocalCohomologyIsoOfSameRadical
      (hradical.trans hmaxRadical.symm) M d⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_iff_radical
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_iff_radical
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherian R R]
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M i) ↔
      IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I.radical M i)
proof:
:=
  (derivedLocalCohomologyIsoOfSameRadical
    (Ideal.radical_idem I).symm M i).isZero_iff

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_prime_over_lt_maximalIdeal_of_radical_ne
statement:
theorem exists_prime_over_lt_maximalIdeal_of_radical_ne
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤)
    (hradical : I.radical ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    ∃ P : Ideal R,
      I ≤ P ∧ P.IsPrime ∧ P < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  have hmaxPrime : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).IsPrime :=
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).isPrime
  have hImax : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hI
  by_contra hexists
  have hall : ∀ P : Ideal R, I ≤ P → P.IsPrime →
      P = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    intro P hIP hP
    have hPmax : P ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime P
    exact le_antisymm hPmax <| by
      by_contra hnotle
      have hne : P ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
        intro heq
        exact hnotle heq.ge
      have hlt : P < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne hPmax hne
      exact hexists ⟨P, hIP, hP, hlt⟩
  apply hradical
  rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact sInf_le ⟨hImax, hmaxPrime⟩
  · refine le_sInf ?_
    intro P hP
    rw [hall P hP.1 hP.2]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.radical_ne_maximalIdeal_iff_exists_prime_over_lt
statement:
theorem radical_ne_maximalIdeal_iff_exists_prime_over_lt
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≠ ⊤) :
    I.radical ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ↔
      ∃ P : Ideal R,
        I ≤ P ∧ P.IsPrime ∧ P < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact exists_prime_over_lt_maximalIdeal_of_radical_ne I hI
  · rintro ⟨P, hIP, hP, hPmax⟩ hradical
    have hmaxP : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ≤ P := by
      rw [← hradical]
      exact hP.radical_le_iff.mpr hIP
    exact (not_le_of_gt hPmax) hmaxP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_annihilator_of_supportDim_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_annihilator_of_supportDim_eq_zero
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M]
    (hdim : Module.supportDim R M = 0) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, maximalIdeal R ^ k ≤ Module.annihilator R M
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Module.annihilator R M : Set R) =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (maximalIdeal R : Set R) := by
    rw [← Module.support_eq_zeroLocus]
    exact support_of_supportDim_eq_zero R M hdim
  have hrad : maximalIdeal R ≤ (Module.annihilator R M).radical :=
    (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_subset_zeroLocus_iff
      (Module.annihilator R M) (maximalIdeal R)).mp hsupp.le
  exact Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg hrad
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian (maximalIdeal R))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_not_isZero_of_supportDim_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_not_isZero_of_supportDim_eq_zero
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M]
    (hdim : Module.supportDim R M = 0) :
    ¬ IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R) M 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M 0) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz
  let e := derivedLocalCohomologyZeroEquivOfSupportDimEqZero M hdim
  let : Subsingleton M := ⟨fun z w => e.symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  have hbot : Module.supportDim R M = ⊥ := Module.supportDim_eq_bot_of_subsingleton R M
  rw [hdim] at hbot
  exact WithBot.coe_ne_bot hbot

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_finiteEtale_product_lift
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_product_lift
    {R B J : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Finite J]
    (D : J → Type u) [∀ j, CommRing (D j)] [∀ j, Algebra B (D j)]
    (hlift : ∀ j, ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra R C)
      (_ : Module.Finite R C) (_ : Algebra.Etale R C),
      Nonempty (B ⊗[R] C ≃ₐ[B] D j)) :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra R C)
      (_ : Module.Finite R C) (_ : Algebra.Etale R C),
      Nonempty (B ⊗[R] C ≃ₐ[B] ∀ j, D j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite J
  choose C hCcomm hCalgebra hCfinite hCetale hCequiv using hlift
  let (j : J) : CommRing (C j) := hCcomm j
  let (j : J) : Algebra R (C j) := hCalgebra j
  let (j : J) : Module.Finite R (C j) := hCfinite j
  let (j : J) : Algebra.Etale R (C j) := hCetale j
  refine ⟨∀ j, C j, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    inferInstance, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight R B B C).trans
    (AlgEquiv.piCongrRight fun j ↦ Classical.choice (hCequiv j))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_finiteEtale_lift_of_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_lift_of_quotient
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R)
    {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra (R ⧸ I) D]
    [Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) D] [Algebra.Etale (R ⧸ I) D] :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra R C)
      (_ : Module.Finite R C) (_ : Algebra.Etale R C),
      Nonempty (((R ⧸ I) ⊗[R] C) ≃ₐ[R ⧸ I] D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := R ⧸ I
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI
  let : Nontrivial B := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing B :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmaximal :
      (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R B) = maximalIdeal B :=
    IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal B) B := by
    rw [← hmaximal]
    exact isAdicComplete_map_maximalIdeal_quotient I
  obtain ⟨J, hJfin, hJdec, A, hAfield, hAalg, E, e, he, hmap,
      hfactors⟩ :=
    exists_closedFiber_fieldFactors_with_finiteEtale_localFactors
      (B := B) (D := D)
  let : Fintype J := hJfin
  let : DecidableEq J := hJdec
  have hlift (j : J) :
      ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra R C)
        (_ : Module.Finite R C) (_ : Algebra.Etale R C),
        Nonempty (B ⊗[R] C ≃ₐ[B] D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e j}) := by
    let : Module.Finite B (D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e j}) :=
      (hfactors j).1
    let : Algebra.Etale B (D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e j}) :=
      (hfactors j).2.1
    let : IsLocalRing (D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e j}) :=
      (hfactors j).2.2
    exact exists_finiteEtaleLocal_lift_of_quotient I hI
  obtain ⟨C, hCcomm, hCalgebra, hCfinite, hCetale, hCbase⟩ :=
    exists_finiteEtale_product_lift
      (R := R) (B := B)
      (fun j ↦ D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e j}) hlift
  exact ⟨C, hCcomm, hCalgebra, hCfinite, hCetale,
    hCbase.map fun φ ↦ φ.trans (he.quotientPiAlgEquiv (B := B)).symm⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_inf_pow_le_inf_pow
statement:
theorem exists_inf_pow_le_inf_pow (I J : Ideal R) [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (m : ℕ) : ∃ n : ℕ, I ^ n ⊓ J ^ n ≤ (I ⊓ J) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_inf_eq_pow_smul I (J ^ m)
  let n := k + m
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  have hnmk : n - k = m := by
    dsimp only [n]
    omega
  have hAR := hk n (by
    dsimp only [n]
    omega)
  have hJn : J ^ n ≤ J ^ m :=
    Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (by
      dsimp only [n]
      omega)
  calc
    I ^ n ⊓ J ^ n ≤ I ^ n ⊓ J ^ m := inf_le_inf le_rfl hJn
    _ = I ^ (n - k) * (I ^ k ⊓ J ^ m) := by
      simpa only [← Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hAR
    _ ≤ I ^ m * J ^ m := by
      rw [hnmk]
      exact mul_le_mul' le_rfl inf_le_right
    _ = (I * J) ^ m := (mul_pow I J m).symm
    _ ≤ (I ⊓ J) ^ m := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left' Ideal.mul_le_inf m

statement:
theorem connectedCoverGenericCompositeSectionsIso_hom_appTop
    (W : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected W] (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens)
proof:
:=
      ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X), by trivial⟩⟩
    letI : Algebra X.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    (connectedCoverGenericCompositeSectionsIso W).hom
          ((connectedCoverGenericComposite W).appTop r) =
        algebraMap X.functionField W.left.functionField
          (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r) := by
  dsimp only
  let : Algebra X.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X), by trivial⟩⟩
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : W.left.Opens) :=
    let y : W.left := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty W.left)
    ⟨⟨y, by trivial⟩⟩
  let hDense : DenseRange W.hom :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected W
  have hGeneric :
      (connectedCoverGenericCompositeSectionsIso W).hom
          ((connectedCoverGenericComposite W).appTop r) =
        W.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (W.hom.appTop r) := by
    change (W.left.genericExtensionSectionsIso W.left.functionField
        (⊤ : W.left.Opens)).hom
          ((W.left.genericExtensionMorphism W.left.functionField).app
            (⊤ : W.left.Opens) (W.hom.appTop r)) = _
    rw [W.left.genericExtensionSectionsIso_hom_app]
    exact Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply _
  rw [hGeneric]
  have hFieldMap :
      (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap X W.left W.hom inferInstance
        (EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W)
          hDense).comp (X.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom =
        (W.left.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom.comp W.hom.appTop.hom :=
    @Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField_top
      X W.left W.hom inferInstance
        (EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W)
          hDense
  have hMap := DFunLike.congr_fun hFieldMap r
  change (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap X W.left W.hom inferInstance
      (EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W)
        hDense) (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r) =
    W.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (W.hom.appTop r) at hMap
  change W.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (W.hom.appTop r) =
    (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap X W.left W.hom inferInstance
      (EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W)
        (EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected W))
          (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r)
  simpa only [hDense] using hMap.symm

statement:

theorem connectedCoverGenericMorphism_normalizationPullbackIso_fst

    (j : X ⟶ S) [Mono j] [Smooth j] [QuasiCompact j]
    [QuasiSeparated j] :
    connectedCoverGenericMorphism W ≫
        (connectedCoverGenericNormalizationPullbackIso W j).hom ≫
        Limits.pullback.fst
          (connectedCoverGenericComposite W ≫ j).fromNormalization j =
      (connectedCoverGenericComposite W ≫ j).toNormalization
proof:
:= by
  let f : Spec (.of W.left.functionField) ⟶ X :=
    connectedCoverGenericComposite W
  let g : Spec (.of W.left.functionField) ⟶ S := f ≫ j
  let p : Limits.pullback g j ⟶ X := Limits.pullback.snd g j
  let eSource : Spec (.of W.left.functionField) ≅ Limits.pullback g j :=
    monoFactorPullbackIso j f
  let hSource : eSource.hom ≫ p = f :=
    monoFactorPullbackIso_hom_snd j f
  let eNormalization : f.normalization ≅ p.normalization :=
    normalizationSourceIsoOfEq eSource p f hSource
  have hW :
      connectedCoverGenericMorphism W ≫
          (connectedCoverGenericNormalizationIso W).inv =
        f.toNormalization := by
    apply (cancel_mono (connectedCoverGenericNormalizationIso W).hom).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    symm
    let hIntegral : IsIntegralHom W.hom :=
      (IsFinite.iff_isIntegralHom_and_locallyOfFiniteType W.hom).mp
        W.prop.toIsFinite |>.1
    change f.toNormalization ≫ connectedCoverGenericNormalizationDesc W =
      connectedCoverGenericMorphism W
    exact @Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationDesc _ _
      f inferInstance inferInstance _
      (connectedCoverGenericMorphism W) W.hom hIntegral rfl
  have hfst : eSource.hom ≫ Limits.pullback.fst g j = 𝟙 _ :=
    (monoFactorIsPullback j f).isoPullback_hom_fst
  change connectedCoverGenericMorphism W ≫
      ((connectedCoverGenericNormalizationIso W).symm ≪≫
        eNormalization ≪≫ asIso (g.normalizationPullback j)).hom ≫
      Limits.pullback.fst g.fromNormalization j = g.toNormalization
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc (connectedCoverGenericMorphism W)
      (connectedCoverGenericNormalizationIso W).inv, hW]
  rw [toNormalization_normalizationSourceIsoOfEq_hom_assoc eSource p f hSource]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationPullback_fst]
  rw [← Category.assoc, hfst, Category.id_comp]

    (X Y : ModuleCat.{v} R)

    IsZero (((_root_.Ext R (ModuleCat.{v} R) 0).obj (op X)).obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  let P := CategoryTheory.projectiveResolution X
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ (P.isoExt 0 Y)
  rw [← HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology]
