      CochainComplex.prev_nat_zero (CochainComplex.next ℕ 0),
    ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
  intro f hf
  change (P.complex.X 0 ⟶ Y) at f
  change P.complex.d 1 0 ≫ f = 0 at hf
  change ∃ g : P.complex.X 0 ⟶ Y, P.complex.d 0 0 ≫ g = f
  let c := CokernelCofork.ofπ f hf
  let g : X ⟶ Y := P.isColimitCokernelCofork.desc c
  have hfac : P.π.f 0 ≫ g = f := P.isColimitCokernelCofork.fac c WalkingParallelPair.one
  have hHom : Subsingleton (X ⟶ Y) :=
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀.subsingleton_congr.mp hExt
  have hg : g = 0 := hHom.elim _ _
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rw [← hfac, hg]
  exact (Limits.comp_zero (f := P.π.f 0) (Z := Y)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.legacyExt_isZero_of_subsingleton_derivedExt_succ
statement:
theorem legacyExt_isZero_of_subsingleton_derivedExt_succ
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Small.{v} R]
    (X Y : ModuleCat.{v} R) (n : ℕ)
    (hExt : Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{v} X Y (n + 1))) :
    IsZero (((_root_.Ext R (ModuleCat.{v} R) (n + 1)).obj (op X)).obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  let P := CategoryTheory.projectiveResolution X
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ (P.isoExt (n + 1) Y)
  rw [← HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology]
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ n (n + 1) (n + 2)
      (CochainComplex.prev_nat_succ n) (CochainComplex.next ℕ (n + 1)),
    ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
  intro f hf
  change (P.complex.X (n + 1) ⟶ Y) at f
  change P.complex.d (n + 2) (n + 1) ≫ f = 0 at hf
  change ∃ g : P.complex.X n ⟶ Y, P.complex.d (n + 1) n ≫ g = f
  have hz : P.extMk f (n + 2) (by omega) hf = 0 :=
    hExt.elim _ _
  rw [P.extMk_eq_zero_iff f (n + 2) (by omega) hf n (by omega)] at hz
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hz
  exact ⟨g, hg⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.legacyExt_isZero_of_subsingleton_derivedExt
statement:
theorem legacyExt_isZero_of_subsingleton_derivedExt
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Small.{v} R]
    (X Y : ModuleCat.{v} R) (i : ℕ)
    (hExt : Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{v} X Y i)) :
    IsZero (((_root_.Ext R (ModuleCat.{v} R) i).obj (op X)).obj Y)
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | zero => exact legacyExt_isZero_of_subsingleton_derivedExt_zero X Y hExt
  | succ n => exact legacyExt_isZero_of_subsingleton_derivedExt_succ X Y n hExt

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.iInf_primeSymbolicPower_eq_bot
statement:
theorem iInf_primeSymbolicPower_eq_bot
    [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] :

proof:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_common_primeCompl_multiplier
statement:
private theorem exists_common_primeCompl_multiplier
    (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (I J : Ideal R) (hJfg : J.FG)
    (hJ : ∀ x : R, x ∈ J → ∃ s : R, s ∉ P ∧ s * x ∈ I) :
    ∃ s : R, s ∉ P ∧ ∀ x : R, x ∈ J → s * x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.fg_induction
    (motive := fun N _ ↦
      (∀ x : R, x ∈ N → ∃ s : R, s ∉ P ∧ s * x ∈ I) →
        ∃ s : R, s ∉ P ∧ ∀ x : R, x ∈ N → s * x ∈ I)
    ?_ ?_ J hJfg hJ
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsx⟩ := hx x (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self x)
    refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
    change s * (a * x) ∈ I
    simpa only [mul_left_comm] using I.mul_mem_left a hsx
  · intro J₁ J₂ _hJ₁ _hJ₂ ih₁ ih₂ h
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsJ⟩ := ih₁ (fun x hx ↦ h x ((le_sup_left : J₁ ≤ J₁ ⊔ J₂) hx))
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htJ⟩ := ih₂ (fun x hx ↦ h x ((le_sup_right : J₂ ≤ J₁ ⊔ J₂) hx))
    refine ⟨s * t, (inferInstance : P.IsPrime).mul_notMem hs ht, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hz
    rw [mul_add]
    apply I.add_mem
    · simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm] using I.mul_mem_left t (hsJ a ha)
    · simpa only [mul_assoc] using I.mul_mem_left s (htJ b hb)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_mul_primeSymbolicPower_mem_pow
statement:
theorem exists_mul_primeSymbolicPower_mem_pow
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : R, s ∉ P ∧
      ∀ x : R, x ∈ primeSymbolicPower P n → s * x ∈ P ^ n
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_common_primeCompl_multiplier P (P ^ n) (primeSymbolicPower P n)
    (IsNoetherian.noetherian (primeSymbolicPower P n))
  intro x hx
  exact (mem_primeSymbolicPower_iff P n x).mp hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_primeSymbolicPower_le_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem exists_primeSymbolicPower_le_maximalIdeal_pow
    [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R]
    (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, primeSymbolicPower P n ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ^ k
proof:
:=
  EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_le_maximalIdeal_pow_of_antitone_iInf_eq_bot
    (primeSymbolicPower P) (primeSymbolicPower_antitone P)
    (iInf_primeSymbolicPower_eq_bot P) k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_etale_of_hasPuncturedPurity
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_etale_of_hasPuncturedPurity
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsIntegral (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)]
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (hpurity : HasPuncturedPurity R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    let j : U ⟶ Spec (.of R) := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion j := by
      dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
    letI : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsIntegral W.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    letI : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R W.left.functionField) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let j : U ⟶ Spec (.of R) := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : Algebra R U.functionField :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let C := integralClosure R W.left.functionField
  let g : Spec (.of W.left.functionField) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    connectedCoverGenericComposite W ≫ j
  let z : g.normalization ⟶ Spec (.of R) := g.fromNormalization
  let e : g.normalization ≅ Spec (.of C) :=
    connectedPuncturedCoverGenericNormalizationIsoSpecIntegralClosure
      R hpos W
  have hz : IsFiniteEtale z :=
    connectedPuncturedCoverGenericNormalization_isFiniteEtale_of_hasPuncturedPurity
      R hpurity W
  have hcomp : IsFiniteEtale
      (e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C))) := by
    rw [connectedPuncturedCoverGenericNormalizationIsoSpecIntegralClosure_hom_fromSpec]
    exact hz
  let : MorphismProperty.RespectsIso
      (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) := by
    apply MorphismProperty.RespectsIso.mk
    · intro _ _ _ _ f hf
      let : IsFinite f := hf.toIsFinite
      let : Etale f := hf.toEtale
      exact ⟨⟩
    · intro _ _ _ _ f hf
      let : IsFinite f := hf.toIsFinite
      let : Etale f := hf.toEtale
      exact ⟨⟩
  have hSpec : IsFiniteEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C))) :=
    (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso
      (P := @IsFiniteEtale) e.hom _).mp hcomp
  rw [IsFiniteEtale.SpecMap_iff] at hSpec
  exact hSpec.toEtale

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.surjective_chain_d_zero_of_isZero_homology
statement:
private theorem surjective_chain_d_zero_of_isZero_homology
    (K : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) (h : IsZero (K.homology 0)) :
    Function.Surjective (K.d 1 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hex : (K.sc' 1 0 0).Exact :=
    (K.exactAt_iff' 1 0 0 (ChainComplex.prev ℕ 0) ChainComplex.next_nat_zero).mp
      ((K.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology 0).mpr h)
  intro z
  apply (K.sc' 1 0 0).moduleCat_exact_iff.mp hex z
  change K.d 0 0 z = 0
  rw [K.shape 0 0 (by decide)]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.idealPowerTorsion_dual_d_surjective_of_tensor_zero
statement:
theorem idealPowerTorsion_dual_d_surjective_of_tensor_zero
    (I : Ideal R) (J : ℕ → Ideal R)
    (hJI : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, J m ≤ I ^ n)
    (hIJ : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, I ^ n ≤ J m)
    (E : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Injective R E]
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ)
    (hzero : ∀ m : ℕ, IsZero
      ((((tensorLeft (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ J m))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj C).homology 0)) :
    Function.Surjective
      ((idealPowerTorsionFunctor I).map ((linearDualComplex E C).d 1 0))
proof:
:= by
  apply idealPowerTorsionFunctor_map_surjective_of_quotient_lifting I J hJI hIJ
  intro m
  let M : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ J m)
  let T := ((tensorLeft M).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj C
  let D := linearDualComplex E C
  let H := (((linearCoyoneda R (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (op M)).mapHomologicalComplex
    (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj D
  let : Subsingleton (T.homology 0) := ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp (hzero m)
  have hzLinear : IsZero (ModuleCat.of R (T.homology 0 →ₗ[R] E)) :=
    ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr inferInstance
  have hzDual : IsZero ((linearDualComplex E T).homology 0) :=
    hzLinear.of_iso (injectiveLinearDualComplexHomologyIso E T 0)
  have hzH : IsZero (H.homology 0) := hzDual.of_iso
    ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.down ℕ) 0).mapIso
      (tensorLinearDualComplexIso M E C))
  have hsurj := surjective_chain_d_zero_of_isZero_homology H hzH
  intro g
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hsurj (ModuleCat.ofHom g)
  refine ⟨f.hom, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (fun v : M ⟶ D.X 0 => v.hom) hf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_of_moduleFinite_of_integral_local
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_of_moduleFinite_of_integral_local
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v}
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [Algebra R C]
    [Module.Finite R C] [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] :
    IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal C) C
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal C := (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R C)
  let J : Ideal C := maximalIdeal C
  have hcompleteBase : IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) C :=
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.isAdicComplete_of_moduleFinite
      (I := maximalIdeal R) (M := C)
  let : IsAdicComplete I C :=
    (IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff
      (I := maximalIdeal R) (M := C) (S := C)).2 hcompleteBase
  let : IsNoetherianRing C := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R C
  have hIJ : I ≤ J := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    have hmax : ((maximalIdeal C).comap
        (algebraMap R C)).IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R C)
        (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) (maximalIdeal C)
    rw [(IsLocalRing.maximal_ideal_unique R).unique hmax
      (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R)]
  have hJradical : J ≤ I.radical := by
    rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf]
    refine le_sInf fun P hP ↦ ?_
    rcases hP with ⟨hIP, hPprime⟩
    let : P.IsPrime := hPprime
    have hbase_le : maximalIdeal R ≤ P.comap (algebraMap R C) :=
      (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).1 hIP
    have hcomap_ne_top : P.comap (algebraMap R C) ≠ ⊤ :=
      (show (P.comap (algebraMap R C)).IsPrime from inferInstance).ne_top
    have hcomap_maximal : (P.comap (algebraMap R C)).IsMaximal := by
      rw [← (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).eq_of_le hcomap_ne_top hbase_le]
      exact maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
    have hPmaximal : P.IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap
        (algebraMap R C) (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)
        P hcomap_maximal
    have hP : P = J := by
      simpa only [J] using IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hPmaximal
    rw [hP]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg hJradical
      J.fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  have hn' : J ^ (n + 1) ≤ I :=
    (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_add_right n 1)).trans hn
  exact isAdicComplete_of_le_of_pow_le
    I J (Nat.zero_lt_succ n) hIJ
      (by simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hn')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
      dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
    letI : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsIntegral W.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    letI : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    letI : Module.Finite R (integralClosure R W.left.functionField) :=
      connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_finite_of_positiveDimension
        R hpos W
    letI : IsLocalRing (integralClosure R W.left.functionField) :=
      connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isLocalRing
        (R := R) hpos W
    IsAdicComplete
      (maximalIdeal (integralClosure R W.left.functionField))
      (integralClosure R W.left.functionField) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
    dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
  let K : Type u := U.functionField
  let : Algebra R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R L :=
    ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap R K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let C := integralClosure R L
  let : Module.Finite R C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_finite_of_positiveDimension
      R hpos W
  let : IsLocalRing C :=
    connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_isLocalRing (R := R) hpos W
  exact
    isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_of_moduleFinite_of_integral_local
      (R := R) (C := C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumNormalizationExtensionHom_isIntegral
statement:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_supportDim_lt
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_supportDim_lt
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] (n : ℕ)
    (hdim : Module.supportDim R M < (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I M n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hI : I = ⊤
  · subst I
    exact derivedLocalCohomology_top_isZero M n
  have hIm : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := le_maximalIdeal hI
  have hall : ∀ (k : ℕ) (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Finite R N],
      Module.supportDim R N < (k : WithBot ℕ∞) →
        IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I (ModuleCat.of R N) k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
        intro N _ _ _ hdimN
        have hbot : Module.supportDim R N = ⊥ :=
          (WithBot.lt_zero_iff_eq_bot _).mp hdimN
        let : Subsingleton N :=
          (Module.supportDim_eq_bot_iff_subsingleton R N).mp hbot
        apply AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
        refine ⟨fun z w => ?_⟩
        exact (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_injective
          I (ModuleCat.of R N)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    | succ k ih =>
        intro N _ _ hN
        induction hN using IsNoetherianRing.induction_on_isQuotientEquivQuotientPrime R with
        | subsingleton N =>
            intro _hdimN
            exact derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_power_torsion
              I (ModuleCat.of R N)
              (fun z => ⟨0, fun a _ha => Subsingleton.elim (a • z) 0⟩) k
        | quotient N p e =>
            intro hdimN
            by_cases hp : I ≤ p.asIdeal
            · have hpower : ∀ z : ModuleCat.of R N, ∃ t : ℕ,
                  ∀ a ∈ I ^ t, a • z = 0 := by
                intro z
                refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
                intro a ha
                have hap : a ∈ p.asIdeal := hp (by simpa only [pow_one] using ha)
                apply e.injective
                rw [map_smul, map_zero]
                obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (e z)
                rw [← hb]
                change Ideal.Quotient.mk p.asIdeal (a * b) = 0
                exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (p.asIdeal.mul_mem_right b hap)
              exact derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_power_torsion
                I (ModuleCat.of R N) hpower k
            · have hex : ∃ x : R, x ∈ I ∧ x ∉ p.asIdeal := by
                by_contra h
                apply hp
                intro x hx
                by_contra hxp
                exact h ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩
              obtain ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩ := hex
              have hregular : IsSMulRegular (R ⧸ p.asIdeal) x := by
                apply (isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem p.asIdeal x).mpr
                intro a ha
                change x * a ∈ p.asIdeal at ha
                exact (p.isPrime.mem_or_mem ha).resolve_left hxp
              have hxregular : IsSMulRegular N x := (e.isSMulRegular_congr x).mpr hregular
              let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
                (ModuleCat.of R N).smulShortComplex x
              have hS : S.ShortExact :=
                hxregular.smulShortComplex_shortExact (M := ModuleCat.of R N)
              let : Module.Finite R S.X₃ := by
                change Module.Finite R (N ⧸ x • (⊤ : Submodule R N))
                infer_instance
              have hdrop : Module.supportDim R S.X₃ + 1 = Module.supportDim R N :=
                Module.supportDim_quotSMulTop_succ_eq_supportDim hxregular (hIm hx)
              have hdimQ : Module.supportDim R S.X₃ < (k : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
                by_contra h
                have hle : (k : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ Module.supportDim R S.X₃ + 1 :=
                  by simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right (le_of_not_gt h) 1
                rw [hdrop] at hle
                exact (not_lt_of_ge hle)
                  (by simpa only [Nat.cast_succ, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hdimN)
              have hQzero : IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₃ k) :=
                ih S.X₃ hdimQ
              have hmono : Mono
                  (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap I hS (k + 1)) :=
                derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_mono_of_previous_third_isZero
                  I hS k hQzero
              rw [derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsFirstMap_smulShortComplex
                I (ModuleCat.of R N) (k + 1) x hxregular] at hmono
              exact derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_scalarMap_injective
                I (ModuleCat.of R N) (k + 1) x hx
                ((AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp hmono)
        | exact N₁ N₂ N₃ f g hf hg hfg h₁ h₃ =>
            intro hdimN
            let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
              ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero f g hfg.linearMap_comp_eq_zero
            have hS : S.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact S hfg hf hg
            have hzero₁ : IsZero
                (derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₁ (k + 1)) :=
              h₁ ((Module.supportDim_le_of_injective f hf).trans_lt hdimN)
            have hzero₃ : IsZero
                (derivedLocalCohomology I S.X₃ (k + 1)) :=
              h₃ ((Module.supportDim_le_of_surjective g hg).trans_lt hdimN)
            exact (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficients_sameDegree_exact
              I hS (k + 1)).isZero_X₂
                (hzero₁.eq_of_src _ _) (hzero₃.eq_of_tgt _ _)
  exact hall n M hdim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_comp_secondMap
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_comp_secondMap
    (I : Ideal R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃).comp
        (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap I hS 0) =
      S.g.hom.comp (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₂)
proof:
:= by
  let : PreservesFilteredColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :=
    preservesSmallestFilteredColimits_of_preservesFilteredColimits _
  ext z
  obtain ⟨k, α, hα⟩ :=
    Concrete.colimit_exists_rep (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram I S.X₂ 0) z
  rcases k with ⟨⟨n⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).surjective α
  change (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n) ⟶ S.X₂) at f
  change derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃
      (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap I hS 0 z) =
    S.g.hom (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₂ z)
  rw [← hα]
  have hsecond := congrArg (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃)
    (derivedLocalCohomologyCoefficientsSecondMap_ι_apply I hS 0 n
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f))
  refine hsecond.trans ?_
  change derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃
      (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleι I S.X₃ 0 n
        ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).comp
          (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g) (add_zero 0))) =
    S.g.hom (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₂
      (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleι I S.X₂ 0 n (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f)))
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀,
    derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_ι_mk₀, derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_ι_mk₀]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap_surjective_zero_of_power_torsion
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap_surjective_zero_of_power_torsion
    (I : Ideal R) {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hT : ∀ z : S.X₂, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, a • z = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap I hS 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective S.g).mp hS.epi_g
    (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃ z)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_bijective_of_power_torsion I S.X₂ hT).surjective b
  refine ⟨y, (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_injective I S.X₃) ?_⟩
  calc
    derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃
        (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap I hS 0 y) =
      S.g.hom (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₂ y) :=
        DFunLike.congr_fun (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_comp_secondMap I hS) y
    _ = derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃ z := by rw [hy, hb]

statement:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.finite_linearMap_to_completeLocal_residueFieldHull_of_artinian
statement:
theorem finite_linearMap_to_completeLocal_residueFieldHull_of_artinian
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    {A : Type v} [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] [IsArtinian R A]
    (hA : ∀ z : A, ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ n, a • z = 0) :
    Module.Finite R (A →ₗ[R] E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N : Submodule R A := Submodule.torsionBySet R A (maximalIdeal R)
  have hN : IsEssentialSubmodule N :=
    isEssentialSubmodule_torsionBySet_maximalIdeal_of_power_torsion hA
  have hlength : IsFiniteLength R N :=
    isFiniteLength_torsionBySet_maximalIdeal_of_artinian A
  obtain ⟨n, j, hj⟩ := exists_injective_linearMap_pi_of_finiteLength i hi hess hlength
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property
    R (Fin n → E) N A N.subtype N.subtype_injective j
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint N (LinearMap.ker f) := by
    apply Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr
    intro z hzN hzf
    have hjz : j ⟨z, hzN⟩ = 0 := by
      rw [← hf]
      exact hzf
    have hz : (⟨z, hzN⟩ : N) = 0 := hj (hjz.trans j.map_zero.symm)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hz
  have hfinj : Function.Injective f := LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (hN _ hdisjoint)
  let generators : Fin n → (A →ₗ[R] E) :=
    fun k => (LinearMap.proj k).comp f
  have hspan : Submodule.span R (Set.range generators) = ⊤ := by
    apply le_antisymm le_top
    intro g _hg
    obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property
      R E A (Fin n → E) f hfinj g
    have hscalar (k : Fin n) : ∃ r : R, ∀ z : E,
        (g'.comp (LinearMap.single R (fun _ : Fin n => E) k)) z = r • z :=
      exists_smul_eq_of_completeLocal_residueFieldHull i hi hess
        (g'.comp (LinearMap.single R (fun _ : Fin n => E) k))
    let r : Fin n → R := fun k => Classical.choose (hscalar k)
    have hr (k : Fin n) (z : E) :
        (g'.comp (LinearMap.single R (fun _ : Fin n => E) k)) z = r k • z :=
      Classical.choose_spec (hscalar k) z
    have hgsum : g = ∑ k : Fin n, r k • generators k := by
      ext z
      rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
      calc
        g z = g' (f z) := (LinearMap.congr_fun hg' z).symm
        _ = g' (∑ k : Fin n, Pi.single k (f z k)) := by
          rw [Finset.univ_sum_single]
        _ = ∑ k : Fin n, g' (Pi.single k (f z k)) := map_sum g' _ _
        _ = ∑ k : Fin n, (r k • generators k) z := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _hk
          exact hr k (f z k)
    rw [hgsum]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro k _hk
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ (r k)
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self k))
  exact Module.Finite.of_fg_top
    (hspan ▸ Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range generators))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_finite_of_positiveDimension
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_finite_of_positiveDimension
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :
    let U
proof:
:= Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
    letI : Nonempty U :=
      Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
      dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
      infer_instance
    letI : IsIntegral U :=
      isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
    letI : Algebra R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsFractionRing R U.functionField :=
      puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
    letI : IsIntegral W.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
    letI : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
    letI : Algebra R W.left.functionField :=
      ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
        (algebraMap R U.functionField)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower R U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    letI : FiniteDimensional U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
    letI : Algebra.IsSeparable U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
    Module.Finite R (integralClosure R W.left.functionField) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R) := by
    dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
  let K : Type u := U.functionField
  let : Algebra R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale W
  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R L :=
    ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap R K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
  exact IsIntegralClosure.finite R K L (integralClosure R L)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.connectedPuncturedCoverIntegralClosureOver_hom_isFinite
statement:
theorem connectedPuncturedCoverIntegralClosureOver_hom_isFinite
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    (W : FiniteEtale (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R)) [IsConnected W] :

      (connectedPuncturedCoverIntegralClosureOverOfPositiveDimension
        R hpos W).hom
proof:
:= by
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim R hpos

    dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]

  let : IsIntegral U :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion R)
  let K : Type u := U.functionField
  let : Algebra R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension R hpos
  let : IsIntegral W.left :=

  let L : Type u := W.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra R L :=
    ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap R K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=

  let : Algebra.IsSeparable K L :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected W
  let C := integralClosure R L

  unfold connectedPuncturedCoverIntegralClosureOverOfPositiveDimension
  change IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C)))

statement:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.idealPowerTorsionComplex_d_apply
statement:
theorem idealPowerTorsionComplex_d_apply (I : Ideal R)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ) (p q : ℕ)
    (z : (idealPowerTorsionComplex I K).X p) :
    ((show Ideal.primaryComponent (K.X q) I from
        ((idealPowerTorsionComplex I K).d p q) z) : K.X q) =
      K.d p q ((show Ideal.primaryComponent (K.X p) I from z) : K.X p)
proof:

proof:

        (A →ₐ[R] S) → A →ₐ[R] S ⧸ I)
proof:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.torsionBySet_annihilator_eq_of_scalar_endomorphisms
statement:
theorem torsionBySet_annihilator_eq_of_scalar_endomorphisms
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hscalar : ∀ f : E →ₗ[R] E, ∃ r : R, ∀ z : E, f z = r • z)
    (N : Submodule R E) : Submodule.torsionBySet R E N.annihilator = N
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    by_contra hxN
    have hq : N.mkQ x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      exact hxN ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mp hzero)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
      exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_injective_residueField i hi (N.mkQ x) hq
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hscalar (g.comp N.mkQ)
    have hrN : r ∈ N.annihilator := by
      apply Submodule.mem_annihilator.mpr
      intro y hy
      rw [← hr y]
      change g (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) = 0
      rw [(Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mpr hy, map_zero]
    have hrx : r • x = 0 :=
      (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (N.annihilator : Set R) x).mp hx ⟨r, hrN⟩
    apply hg
    exact (hr x).trans hrx
  · intro x hx
    apply (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (N.annihilator : Set R) x).mpr
    intro r
    exact Submodule.mem_annihilator.mp r.property x hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isArtinian_of_injective_residueField_and_scalar_endomorphisms
statement:
theorem isArtinian_of_injective_residueField_and_scalar_endomorphisms
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hscalar : ∀ f : E →ₗ[R] E, ∃ r : R, ∀ z : E, f z = r • z) :
    IsArtinian R E
proof:
:= by
  let e : Submodule R E ↪o (Ideal R)ᵒᵈ :=
    OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff (fun N => OrderDual.toDual N.annihilator) (by
      intro N P
      change P.annihilator ≤ N.annihilator ↔ N ≤ P
      constructor
      · intro hNP x hx
        rw [← torsionBySet_annihilator_eq_of_scalar_endomorphisms i hi hscalar P]
        apply (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (P.annihilator : Set R) x).mpr
        intro r
        exact Submodule.mem_annihilator.mp (hNP r.property) x hx
      · exact Submodule.annihilator_mono)
  exact e.wellFoundedLT

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantMap_postcomp
statement:
theorem derivedExtContravariantMap_postcomp
    {X X' Y Y' : C} (f : X ⟶ X') (g : Y ⟶ Y') (n : ℕ) :
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ g).postcomp X' (add_zero n)) ≫
        derivedExtContravariantMap f Y' n =
      derivedExtContravariantMap f Y n ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ g).postcomp X (add_zero n))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  dsimp [derivedExtContravariantMap]
  change
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).comp
        (x.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ g) (add_zero n))
        (zero_add n) =
      ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).comp x (zero_add n)).comp
        (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ g) (add_zero n)
  symm
  apply CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc
  omega

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantMap_covariantConnecting
statement:
theorem derivedExtContravariantMap_covariantConnecting
    {X X' : C} {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (f : X ⟶ X') (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) :
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (hS.extClass.postcomp X' h) ≫
        derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₁ n₁ =
      derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₃ n₀ ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (hS.extClass.postcomp X h)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  dsimp [derivedExtContravariantMap]
  change
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).comp
        (x.comp hS.extClass h) (zero_add n₁) =
      ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).comp x (zero_add n₀)).comp
        hS.extClass h
  symm
  apply CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc
  omega

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtCovariantSequenceMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedExtCovariantSequenceMap_id
    {X : C} {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) :
    derivedExtCovariantSequenceMap hS (𝟙 X) n₀ n₁ h = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply ComposableArrows.hom_ext₅
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 X) S.X₁ n₀ = 𝟙 _
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_id
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 X) S.X₂ n₀ = 𝟙 _
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_id
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 X) S.X₃ n₀ = 𝟙 _
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_id
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 X) S.X₁ n₁ = 𝟙 _
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_id
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 X) S.X₂ n₁ = 𝟙 _
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_id
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 X) S.X₃ n₁ = 𝟙 _
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_id

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtCovariantSequenceMap_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem derivedExtCovariantSequenceMap_comp
    {X₁ X₂ X₃ : C} {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (f : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (g : X₂ ⟶ X₃)
    (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) :
    derivedExtCovariantSequenceMap hS g n₀ n₁ h ≫
        derivedExtCovariantSequenceMap hS f n₀ n₁ h =
      derivedExtCovariantSequenceMap hS (f ≫ g) n₀ n₁ h
proof:
:= by
  apply ComposableArrows.hom_ext₅
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g S.X₁ n₀ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₁ n₀ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f ≫ g) S.X₁ n₀
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_comp
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g S.X₂ n₀ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₂ n₀ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f ≫ g) S.X₂ n₀
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_comp
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g S.X₃ n₀ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₃ n₀ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f ≫ g) S.X₃ n₀
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_comp
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g S.X₁ n₁ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₁ n₁ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f ≫ g) S.X₁ n₁
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_comp
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g S.X₂ n₁ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₂ n₁ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f ≫ g) S.X₂ n₁
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_comp
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g S.X₃ n₁ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f S.X₃ n₁ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f ≫ g) S.X₃ n₁
    apply derivedExtContravariantMap_comp

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_injective_residueField
statement:
theorem exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_injective_residueField
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (x : M) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ f : M →ₗ[R] E, f x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let a : R →ₗ[R] M := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R M x
  have ha1 : a 1 = x := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply_one R M x
  have hkerproper : LinearMap.ker a ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    have hazero : a = 0 := LinearMap.ker_eq_top.mp h
    have hz : a 1 = 0 := DFunLike.congr_fun hazero 1
    exact hx (ha1.symm.trans hz)
  have hker : LinearMap.ker a ≤ maximalIdeal R := le_maximalIdeal hkerproper
  let g : LinearMap.range a →ₗ[R] E :=
    i.comp ((Submodule.factor hker).comp a.quotKerEquivRange.symm.toLinearMap)
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property R E (LinearMap.range a) M
    (LinearMap.range a).subtype (LinearMap.range a).injective_subtype g
  have hf1 : f (a 1) = i ((maximalIdeal R).mkQ 1) := by
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hf ⟨a 1, LinearMap.mem_range_self a 1⟩
    change f (a 1) = i (Submodule.factor hker
      (a.quotKerEquivRange.symm ⟨a 1, LinearMap.mem_range_self a 1⟩)) at h
    rw [LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange_symm_apply_image, Submodule.factor_mk] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  intro hfx
  have h10 : i (1 : R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) = i 0 := by
    rw [map_zero]
    change i ((maximalIdeal R).mkQ 1) = 0
    rw [← hf1, ha1, hfx]
  exact one_ne_zero (hi h10)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.injective_eval_to_injective_residueField
statement:
theorem injective_eval_to_injective_residueField
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    Function.Injective (residueFieldHullEvaluation R E M)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ :=
    exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_injective_residueField i hi (x - y) hne
  apply hf
  rw [map_sub]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (DFunLike.congr_fun hxy f)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isArtinian_derivedLocalCohomologyModule_succ_of_regular_smulQuotient
statement:
theorem isArtinian_derivedLocalCohomologyModule_succ_of_regular_smulQuotient
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (x : R) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (hxreg : IsSMulRegular M x) (n : ℕ)
    [IsArtinian R (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R)
      (ModuleCat.smulShortComplex M x).X₃ n)] :
    IsArtinian R (derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let δ : derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R)
      (ModuleCat.smulShortComplex M x).X₃ n →ₗ[R]
        derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1) :=
    derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsConnectingMap
      (maximalIdeal R) hxreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact n
  have hexact := derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficients_afterConnecting_exact
    (maximalIdeal R) hxreg.smulShortComplex_shortExact n
  rw [derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsFirstMap_smulShortComplex
    (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1) x hxreg] at hexact
  change Function.Exact δ
    (x • (LinearMap.id : derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1) →ₗ[R]
      derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1))) at hexact
  have hker : LinearMap.ker
      (x • (LinearMap.id : derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1) →ₗ[R]
        derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1))) =
        LinearMap.range δ := hexact.linearMap_ker_eq
  let : IsArtinian R (LinearMap.ker
      (x • (LinearMap.id : derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1) →ₗ[R]
        derivedLocalCohomologyModule (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1)))) := by
    rw [hker]
    exact isArtinian_range δ
  apply isArtinian_of_maximalIdealPower_torsion_of_artinian_scalarKernel x hx
  exact derivedLocalCohomologyModule_exists_idealPower_smul_eq_zero
    (maximalIdeal R) M (n + 1)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_maximal_disjoint_submodule
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_disjoint_submodule (N : Submodule R M) :
    ∃ P : Submodule R M, Disjoint N P ∧
      ∀ L : Submodule R M, Disjoint N L → P ≤ L → L = P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ :=
    zorn_le₀ {P : Submodule R M | Disjoint N P} (by
      intro c hc hchain
      rcases c.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hempty | hnonempty
      · subst c
        refine ⟨⊥, disjoint_bot_right, ?_⟩
        intro L hL
        exact False.elim hL
      · refine ⟨sSup c, ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr
          intro x hxN hxc
          obtain ⟨L, hLc, hxL⟩ :=
            (Submodule.mem_sSup_of_directed hnonempty hchain.directedOn).mp hxc
          exact (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp (hc hLc)) x hxN hxL
        · intro L hLc
          exact le_sSup hLc)
  refine ⟨P, hP.prop, ?_⟩
  intro L hL hPL
  exact le_antisymm (hP.eq_of_le hL hPL).ge hPL

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_disjoint_essential_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_essential_quotient (N : Submodule R M) :
    ∃ P : Submodule R M, Disjoint N P ∧
      IsEssentialSubmodule (N.map P.mkQ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hNP, hmax⟩ := exists_maximal_disjoint_submodule N
  refine ⟨P, hNP, ?_⟩
  intro L hL
  have hpre : Disjoint N (L.comap P.mkQ) := by
    apply Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr
    intro x hxN hxPre
    have hxMap : P.mkQ x ∈ N.map P.mkQ :=
      Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hxN, rfl⟩
    have hxZero : P.mkQ x = 0 :=
      (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hL) (P.mkQ x) hxMap
        (Submodule.mem_comap.mp hxPre)
    have hxP : x ∈ P := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero P).mp hxZero
    exact (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hNP) x hxN hxP
  have hpre_eq : L.comap P.mkQ = P :=
    hmax (L.comap P.mkQ) hpre (P.le_comap_mkQ L)
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := P.mkQ_surjective z
  have hxPre : x ∈ L.comap P.mkQ := Submodule.mem_comap.mpr hz
  have hxP : x ∈ P := by
    rw [← hpre_eq]
    exact hxPre
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mpr ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero P).mpr hxP)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_baseChange_essSurj_of_quotient
statement:

  obtain ⟨C, hCcomm, hCalgebra, hCfinite, hCetale, hbase⟩ :=
    exists_finiteEtale_lift_of_quotient I hI
      (D := D.obj)
  let : CommRing C := hCcomm
  let : Algebra R C := hCalgebra
  let : Module.Finite R C := hCfinite
  let : Algebra.Etale R C := hCetale
  let C' : CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{u} R :=
    CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.of R C
  exact ⟨C', ⟨CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.isoMk (Classical.choice hbase)⟩⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.linearChainCycleBoundary_zero_surjective
statement:
private theorem linearChainCycleBoundary_zero_surjective
    (I : Ideal R) (K : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ)
    (hΓ : Function.Surjective ((idealPowerTorsionFunctor I).map (K.d 1 0))) :
    Function.Surjective (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap I
      (linearChainCycleBoundarySequence_shortExact K 0) 0)
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Surjective (Ideal.primaryComponent.map I (K.d 1 0).hom) at hΓ
  let S := linearChainCycleBoundarySequence K 0
  let hS := linearChainCycleBoundarySequence_shortExact K 0
  let j : S.X₃ →ₗ[R] K.X 0 :=
    (linearChainCycles K 0).subtype.comp (linearChainBoundaries K 0).subtype
  let e₁ := derivedLocalCohomologyZeroEquivPrimaryComponent I S.X₂
  let e₃ := derivedLocalCohomologyZeroEquivPrimaryComponent I S.X₃
  intro z
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hΓ ((idealPowerTorsionFunctor I).map (ModuleCat.ofHom j) (e₃ z))
  let y := e₁.symm w
  refine ⟨y, (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_injective I S.X₃) ?_⟩
  have heval : derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₂ y = (w : K.X 1) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (e₁.apply_symm_apply w)
  have hlinear : (K.d 1 0) (w : K.X 1) = j (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃ z) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hw
  rw [show derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃
        (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficientsSecondMap I hS 0 y) =
      S.g.hom (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₂ y) from
        DFunLike.congr_fun (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule_comp_secondMap I hS) y]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (K.d 1 0) (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₂ y) =
    j (derivedLocalCohomologyZeroToModule I S.X₃ z)
  rw [heval]
  exact hlinear

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.linearChainCycles_localCohomology_one_eq_zero

    [Module.Injective R (K.X 1)]
    (hΓ : Function.Surjective ((idealPowerTorsionFunctor I).map (K.d 1 0)))

    z = 0
proof:
:= by
  let S := linearChainCycleBoundarySequence K 0
  let hS := linearChainCycleBoundarySequence_shortExact K 0
  let : Module.Injective R S.X₂ := by
    change Module.Injective R (K.X 1)
    infer_instance
  let : Subsingleton (derivedLocalCohomologyModule I S.X₂ 1) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_succ_of_injective I S.X₂ 0)

    (derivedLocalCohomologyModuleCoefficients_afterConnecting_exact I hS 0 z).mp

    I hS 0).apply_apply_eq_zero v

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.linearChainCycles_localCohomology_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem linearChainCycles_localCohomology_pow_smul_eq_zero
    (I : Ideal R) (K : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℕ)
    [∀ j : ℕ, Module.Injective R (K.X j)]
    (hΓ : Function.Surjective ((idealPowerTorsionFunctor I).map (K.d 1 0)))
    (a : R) (n : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ i : ℕ, i < n → ∀ h : K.homology (i + 1), a • h = 0)
    (z : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I
      (ModuleCat.of R (linearChainCycles K (n + 1))) (n + 1)) :
    a ^ n • z = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero, one_smul]
      exact linearChainCycles_localCohomology_one_eq_zero I K hΓ z
  | succ n ih =>
      have hZ : ∀ w : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I
          (ModuleCat.of R (linearChainCycles K (n + 1))) (n + 1), a ^ n • w = 0 :=
        fun w => ih (fun i hi => ha i (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hi)) w
      let T := linearChainBoundaryHomologySequence K (n + 1)
      let hT := linearChainBoundaryHomologySequence_shortExact K (n + 1)
      have hH : ∀ w : T.X₃, a • w = 0 := by
        intro w
        let e := linearChainHomologyIso K (n + 1)
        apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective e.inv).mp inferInstance
        change e.inv.hom (a • w) = e.inv.hom 0
        rw [map_smul, map_zero]
        exact ha n (Nat.lt_succ_self n) (e.inv w)
      have hB : ∀ w : derivedLocalCohomologyModule I T.X₁ (n + 1),
          a ^ (n + 1) • w = 0 := by
        intro w
        rw [pow_succ']
        exact derivedLocalCohomologyModule_mul_smul_eq_zero_of_shortExact
          I hT n a (a ^ n) hH hZ w
      let : Module.Injective R (linearChainCycleBoundarySequence K (n + 1)).X₂ := by
        change Module.Injective R (K.X (n + 1 + 1))
        infer_instance
      exact derivedLocalCohomologyModule_smul_eq_zero_of_injective_middle
        I (linearChainCycleBoundarySequence_shortExact K (n + 1))
        (n + 1) (a ^ (n + 1)) hB z

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_parameter_list_radical_eq_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq_succ
statement:
theorem exists_parameter_list_radical_eq_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq_succ
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (x : R) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hxmem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) :
    ∃ xs : List R, xs.length = d ∧
      (Ideal.ofList (x :: xs)).radical = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {x}
  let S := R ⧸ I
  let q : R →+* S := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal R :=
    (maximalIdeal R).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hxmem
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIle
  let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom q :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hdimSsucc : ringKrullDim S + 1 = ringKrullDim R :=
    ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim
      (IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero hx0) hxmem
  have hdimS : ringKrullDim S = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    apply ENat.WithBot.add_one_cancel.mp
    calc
      ringKrullDim S + 1 = ringKrullDim R := hdimSsucc
      _ = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := hdim
      _ = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 := by
        simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  obtain ⟨ys, hysLength, hysRadical⟩ :=
    exists_ofList_radical_eq_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq d hdimS
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  obtain ⟨xs, rfl⟩ := List.map_surjective_iff.mpr hq ys
  refine ⟨xs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [List.length_map] using hysLength
  · have hcomap : Ideal.comap q (Ideal.ofList (xs.map q)) =
        I ⊔ Ideal.ofList xs := by
      calc
        Ideal.comap q (Ideal.ofList (xs.map q)) =
            Ideal.comap q ((Ideal.ofList xs).map q) := by
              rw [Ideal.map_ofList]
        _ = Ideal.ofList xs ⊔ Ideal.comap q ⊥ :=
          Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective q hq (Ideal.ofList xs)
        _ = I ⊔ Ideal.ofList xs := by
          rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
          exact sup_comm _ _
    have hradical := congrArg (Ideal.comap q) hysRadical
    rw [Ideal.comap_radical, hcomap,
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap q] at hradical
    simpa only [Ideal.ofList_cons, I] using hradical

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_succ_of_smul_id_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivedLocalCohomology_maximalIdeal_isZero_succ_of_smul_id_eq_zero
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (x : R) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hxmem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hx : x • 𝟙 M = 0) :
    IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (maximalIdeal R) M (d + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨xs, hlength, hradical⟩ :=
    exists_parameter_list_radical_eq_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq_succ
      d hdim x hx0 hxmem
  have hOfList :
      IsZero (derivedLocalCohomology (Ideal.ofList (x :: xs)) M (d + 1)) :=
    derivedLocalCohomology_ofList_cons_isZero_of_smul_id_eq_zero
      x xs M hx (d + 1) (by omega)
  have hRadical :
      (Ideal.ofList (x :: xs)).radical = (maximalIdeal R).radical :=
    hradical.trans (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).isPrime.isRadical.radical.symm
  exact hOfList.of_iso
    (derivedLocalCohomologyIsoOfSameRadical hRadical M (d + 1)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_injective_linearMap_pi_of_finiteLength
statement:
theorem exists_injective_linearMap_pi_of_finiteLength
    (i : (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (hM : IsFiniteLength R M) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ j : M →ₗ[R] (Fin n → E), Function.Injective j
proof:
:= by
  have hdual : IsFiniteLength R (M →ₗ[R] E) :=
    isFiniteLength_linearMap_to_residueFieldHull i hi hess hM
  let : IsNoetherian R (M →ₗ[R] E) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hdual).1
  obtain ⟨n, s, hs⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := R) (M := M →ₗ[R] E)
  let j : M →ₗ[R] (Fin n → E) := LinearMap.pi s
  refine ⟨n, j, ?_⟩
  intro x y hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ :=
    exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_injective_residueField i hi (x - y) hne
  let ev : (M →ₗ[R] E) →ₗ[R] E := residueFieldHullEvaluation R E M (x - y)
  have hspan : Submodule.span R (Set.range s) ≤ LinearMap.ker ev := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro g ⟨k, rfl⟩
    change s k (x - y) = 0
    rw [map_sub]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (congrFun hxy k)
  rw [hs] at hspan
  have hzero : f ∈ LinearMap.ker ev := hspan (Submodule.mem_top : f ∈ ⊤)
  exact hf hzero

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isArtinian_of_finiteLength_essential_submodule
statement:
theorem isArtinian_of_finiteLength_essential_submodule
    [IsArtinian R E]
    (i : (R ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (N : Submodule R M) (hN : IsEssentialSubmodule N) (hlen : IsFiniteLength R N) :
    IsArtinian R M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, j, hj⟩ := exists_injective_linearMap_pi_of_finiteLength i hi hess hlen
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property
    R (Fin n → E) N M N.subtype N.subtype_injective j
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint N (LinearMap.ker f) := by
    apply Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr
    intro x hxN hxf
    have hjx : j ⟨x, hxN⟩ = 0 := by
      rw [← hf]
      exact hxf
    have hxzero : (⟨x, hxN⟩ : N) = 0 := hj (hjx.trans j.map_zero.symm)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hxzero
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp (hN _ hdisjoint)
  exact isArtinian_of_injective f hinj

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.principalIdealPower_succ_inclusion_comp_linear_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem principalIdealPower_succ_inclusion_comp_linear_eq_zero
    (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hx : x • 𝟙 M = 0)
    (n : ℕ)
    (b : ((Ideal.span {x}) ^ n : Ideal R) →ₗ[R] M) :
    b.comp (Submodule.inclusion
      (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ n))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change b (Submodule.inclusion
    (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ n)) z) = 0
  have hx_apply (m : M) : x • m = 0 := by
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp hx) m
    simpa using h
  have hzmem : (z : R) ∈ Ideal.span {x ^ (n + 1)} := by
    rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    exact z.property
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hzmem
  let y : ((Ideal.span {x}) ^ n : Ideal R) :=
    ⟨a * x ^ n, by
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩
  have hz : (z : R) = x • (y : R) := by
    change (z : R) = x * (a * x ^ n)
    rw [← ha]
    simp only [pow_succ]
    ring
  have hz' : Submodule.inclusion
      (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ n)) z = x • y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hz
  rw [hz']
  exact (b.map_smul x y).trans (hx_apply (b y))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.principalIdealPower_succ_inclusion_comp_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem principalIdealPower_succ_inclusion_comp_eq_zero
    (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hx : x • 𝟙 M = 0)
    (n : ℕ)
    (b : (principalIdealPowerQuotientShortComplex x n).X₁ ⟶ M) :
    (principalIdealPowerQuotientShortComplexSuccTransition x n).τ₁ ≫ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_span_singleton_succ_transition_one_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem derivedLocalCohomology_span_singleton_succ_transition_one_eq_zero
    (x : R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hx : x • 𝟙 M = 0)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (derivedLocalCohomologyPowersDiagram (Ideal.span {x}) M 1).map
      (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op.op = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext α
  let hSn := principalIdealPowerQuotientShortComplex_shortExact x n
  let hSsucc := principalIdealPowerQuotientShortComplex_shortExact x (n + 1)
  let t := principalIdealPowerQuotientShortComplexSuccTransition x n
  change
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ t.τ₃).comp α (zero_add 1) = 0
  let : Projective (principalIdealPowerQuotientShortComplex x n).X₂ := by
    change Projective (ModuleCat.of R R)
    infer_instance
  have hprojective :
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀
        (principalIdealPowerQuotientShortComplex x n).g).comp
          α (zero_add 1) = 0 :=
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_projective _
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ :=
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₃
      hSn M α hprojective (n₀ := 0) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀.symm.surjective β
  rw [← hβ]
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc _ _ _
    (zero_add 1) (add_zero 1) (by omega)]
  rw [← hSsucc.extClass_naturality hSn t]
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero]
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀_symm_apply]
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]
  rw [principalIdealPower_succ_inclusion_comp_eq_zero x M hx n b]
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_zero, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_zero]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedLocalCohomology_span_singleton_isZero_one_of_smul_id_eq_zero

proof:
:= by

  intro n
  exact ⟨n + 1, Nat.le_succ n,

theorem derivedLocalCohomology_isZero_of_subsingleton_ext_powers
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (i : ℕ)
    (hExt : ∀ n : ℕ, Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.{u}

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.injective_linearMap_of_flat
statement:
theorem injective_linearMap_of_flat
    (F E : Type u) [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] [Module.Flat R F]
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] [Module.Injective R E] :
    Module.Injective R (F →ₗ[R] E) where
  out X Y _ _ _ _ f hf g
proof:
:= by
    have hft : Function.Injective (f.rTensor F) :=
      Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap f hf
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.Injective.out (f.rTensor F) hft (TensorProduct.lift g)
    refine ⟨TensorProduct.curry h, ?_⟩
    intro x
    ext z
    simpa only [TensorProduct.curry_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
      TensorProduct.lift.tmul] using hh (x ⊗ₜ[R] z)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.support_primaryComponent_maximalIdeal_subset_closedPoint
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Module.mem_support_iff'.mp hp
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
    (Ideal.primaryComponent_mem (M := M) (I := maximalIdeal R) (z : M)).mp z.property
  apply Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  change maximalIdeal R ≤ p.asIdeal
  intro a ha
  by_contra hap
  have hapow : a ^ n ∉ p.asIdeal := fun h ↦ hap (p.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem n h)
  have haz : a ^ n • z = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change a ^ n • (z : M) = (0 : M)
    exact (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (R := R) (M := M)
      ((maximalIdeal R ^ n : Ideal R) : Set R) (z : M)).mp hn
      ⟨a ^ n, Ideal.pow_mem_pow ha n⟩
  exact hz (a ^ n) hapow haz

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.support_quotient_primaryComponent_maximalIdeal_eq_of_supportDim_pos
statement:
theorem support_quotient_primaryComponent_maximalIdeal_eq_of_supportDim_pos
    (hpos : 0 < Module.supportDim R M) :
    Module.support R (M ⧸ Ideal.primaryComponent M (maximalIdeal R)) =
      Module.support R M
proof:
:= by
  let T : Submodule R M := Ideal.primaryComponent M (maximalIdeal R)
  have hT : Module.support R T ⊆ {closedPoint R} :=
    support_primaryComponent_maximalIdeal_subset_closedPoint
  have hsupp : Module.support R M =
      Module.support R T ∪ Module.support R (M ⧸ T) :=
    Module.support_of_exact (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ T)
      T.subtype_injective T.mkQ_surjective
  obtain ⟨p, q, hpq⟩ := (Order.krullDim_pos_iff (α := Module.support R M)).mp hpos
  have hpTop : (p : PrimeSpectrum R) ≠ closedPoint R :=
    ne_of_lt ((show (p : PrimeSpectrum R) < (q : PrimeSpectrum R) from hpq).trans_le le_top)
  have hpQ : (p : PrimeSpectrum R) ∈ Module.support R (M ⧸ T) := by
    have hpUnion : (p : PrimeSpectrum R) ∈
        Module.support R T ∪ Module.support R (M ⧸ T) := by
      rw [← hsupp]
      exact p.property
    exact hpUnion.resolve_left (fun hpT ↦ hpTop (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hT hpT)))
  let : Nontrivial (M ⧸ T) :=
    (Module.nonempty_support_iff (R := R) (M := M ⧸ T)).mp ⟨p, hpQ⟩
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact Module.support_subset_of_surjective T.mkQ T.mkQ_surjective
  · intro p hp
    rw [hsupp] at hp
    rcases hp with hpT | hpQ
    · have hpEq : p = closedPoint R := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hT hpT)
      rw [hpEq]
      exact IsLocalRing.closedPoint_mem_support R (M ⧸ T)
    · exact hpQ

      Module.supportDim R M
proof:
:= by

  rw [support_quotient_primaryComponent_maximalIdeal_eq_of_supportDim_pos hpos]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition
statement:
theorem exists_minimalPrime_partition_of_open_puncture_partition
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},
      IsOpen A₀ → IsOpen B₀ →
      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →
      Disjoint A₀ B₀ → A₀.Nonempty → B₀.Nonempty →
      ∃ S T : Set (Ideal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})),
        S.Nonempty ∧ T.Nonempty ∧
        S.Finite ∧ T.Finite ∧
        S ∪ T = minimalPrimes (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧
        Disjoint S T ∧
        ∀ P ∈ S, ∀ Q ∈ T,
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus Q ⊆
            ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})} :
              Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  let U : Set (PrimeSpectrum D) := {closedPoint D}ᶜ
  let S : Set (Ideal D) :=
    {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes D ∧ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U ⊆ A₀}
  let T : Set (Ideal D) :=
    {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes D ∧ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U ⊆ B₀}
  have hcomponent (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) :
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum D) := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents]
    simpa only [(hP.isPrime.isRadical.radical)] using hP
  have hcomponentMeets (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) :
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P ∩ U).Nonempty := by
    exact irreducibleComponent_quotient_span_singleton_inter_puncture_nonempty
      hdim x hx (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) (hcomponent P hP)
  have hside (P : Ideal D) (hP : P ∈ minimalPrimes D) : P ∈ S ∨ P ∈ T := by
    have hsides := irreducibleComponent_inter_subset_partition_side
      (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus P) (hcomponent P hP)
      hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint
    exact hsides.imp (fun h ↦ ⟨hP, h⟩) (fun h ↦ ⟨hP, h⟩)
  have hSnonempty : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a, haA⟩ := hAnonempty
    have haU : a ∈ U := by
      change a ∈ ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))
      rw [← hcover]
      exact Or.inl haA
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPa⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := a.asIdeal) bot_le
    rcases hside P hP with hPS | hPT
    · exact ⟨P, hPS⟩
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint haA
        (hPT.2 ⟨hPa, haU⟩)
  have hTnonempty : T.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨b, hbB⟩ := hBnonempty
    have hbU : b ∈ U := by
      change b ∈ ({closedPoint D}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum D))
      rw [← hcover]
      exact Or.inr hbB
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQb⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal D))
        (J := b.asIdeal) bot_le
    rcases hside Q hQ with hQS | hQT
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
        (hQS.2 ⟨hQb, hbU⟩) hbB
    · exact ⟨Q, hQT⟩
  have hSfinite : S.Finite :=
    (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing D).subset fun _ h ↦ h.1
  have hTfinite : T.Finite :=
    (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing D).subset fun _ h ↦ h.1
  have hSTcover : S ∪ T = minimalPrimes D := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact fun _ h ↦ h.elim (fun h ↦ h.1) (fun h ↦ h.1)
    · intro P hP
      exact hside P hP
  have hSTdisjoint : Disjoint S T := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro P hPS hPT
    obtain ⟨p, hpPU⟩ := hcomponentMeets P hPS.1
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
      (hPS.2 hpPU) (hPT.2 hpPU)
  refine ⟨S, T, hSnonempty, hTnonempty, hSfinite, hTfinite,
    hSTcover, hSTdisjoint, ?_⟩
  intro P hPS Q hQT p hp
  have hpNotU : p ∉ U := by
    intro hpU
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint
      (hPS.2 ⟨hp.1, hpU⟩) (hQT.2 ⟨hp.2, hpU⟩)
  simpa only [U, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_not]
    using hpNotU

        a ⊓ b = nilradical (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧

    exact Or.inl hPS
  have hTsub : T ⊆ (⊥ : Ideal D).minimalPrimes := by

    exact Or.inr hQT

      (⊥ : Ideal D) hSsub hTsub hSnonempty hTnonempty hcross
  have hinf : sInf S ⊓ sInf T = nilradical D := by
    rw [← sInf_union, hSTcover, Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes]
    rfl
  exact ⟨sInf S, sInf T, hinf, hradical⟩

    rw [← sInf_union, hSTcover, Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨P, hPS⟩ := hSnonempty
  obtain ⟨Q, hQT⟩ := hTnonempty
  have hPne : P ≠ maximalIdeal D :=
    minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
      hdim x hx P (hSsub hPS)
  have hQne : Q ≠ maximalIdeal D :=
    minimalPrime_quotient_span_singleton_ne_maximalIdeal
      hdim x hx Q (hTsub hQT)
  have ha : sInf S ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro ha
    exact (hSsub hPS).isPrime.ne_top <| top_unique <| ha ▸ sInf_le hPS
  have hb : sInf T ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro hb
    exact (hTsub hQT).isPrime.ne_top <| top_unique <| hb ▸ sInf_le hQT
  have hamax : sInf S ≠ maximalIdeal D := by
    intro ha
    apply hPne
    exact le_antisymm (le_maximalIdeal (hSsub hPS).isPrime.ne_top)
      (ha ▸ sInf_le hPS)
  have hbmax : sInf T ≠ maximalIdeal D := by
    intro hb
    apply hQne
    exact le_antisymm (le_maximalIdeal (hTsub hQT).isPrime.ne_top)
      (hb ▸ sInf_le hQT)
  have haRadical : (sInf S).IsRadical := by
    rw [sInf_eq_iInf]
    apply Ideal.isRadical_iInf
    intro P
    apply Ideal.isRadical_iInf
    intro hPS
    exact (hSsub hPS).isPrime.isRadical
  have hbRadical : (sInf T).IsRadical := by
    rw [sInf_eq_iInf]
    apply Ideal.isRadical_iInf
    intro Q
    apply Ideal.isRadical_iInf
    intro hQT
    exact (hTsub hQT).isPrime.isRadical
  exact
    ⟨sInf S, sInf T, ha, hb, hamax, hbmax, haRadical, hbRadical,
      hinf, hradical⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.exists_nonmaximal_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
statement:
theorem exists_nonmaximal_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (hdim : ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C)
    (x : C) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal C) :
    letI : Nontrivial (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
          (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
    letI : IsLocalRing (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ∀ {A₀ B₀ : Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))},
      IsOpen A₀ → IsOpen B₀ →
      A₀ ∪ B₀ =
        ({closedPoint (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x})}ᶜ :
          Set (PrimeSpectrum (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}))) →
      Disjoint A₀ B₀ → A₀.Nonempty → B₀.Nonempty →
      ∃ a b : Ideal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}),
        a ≠ ⊤ ∧ b ≠ ⊤ ∧
        a ≠ maximalIdeal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧
        b ≠ maximalIdeal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧
        a ⊓ b = nilradical (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧
        (a ⊔ b).radical = maximalIdeal (C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let : Nontrivial D :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr <|
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal C).ne_top <|
        (maximalIdeal C).span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hx
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective'
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  intro A₀ B₀ hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hamax, hbmax, _haRadical, _hbRadical,
      hinf, hradical⟩ :=
    exists_radical_nonmaximal_componentIntersectionIdeals_of_open_puncture_partition
      hdim x hx hAopen hBopen hcover hdisjoint hAnonempty hBnonempty
  exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hamax, hbmax, hinf, hradical⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedExtContravariantMap_id (X Y : C) (n : ℕ) :
    derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 X) Y n = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  dsimp [derivedExtContravariantMap]
  exact CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_id_comp x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantMap_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem derivedExtContravariantMap_comp
    {X₁ X₂ X₃ : C} (f : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (g : X₂ ⟶ X₃)
    (Y : C) (n : ℕ) :
    derivedExtContravariantMap g Y n ≫
        derivedExtContravariantMap f Y n =
      derivedExtContravariantMap (f ≫ g) Y n
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  dsimp [derivedExtContravariantMap]
  change
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).comp
        ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ g).comp x (zero_add n))
        (zero_add n) =
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (f ≫ g)).comp x (zero_add n)
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantMap_square
statement:
theorem derivedExtContravariantMap_square
    {X₁ X₂ X₁' X₂' : C}
    (a : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (b : X₁' ⟶ X₂')
    (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ X₁') (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ X₂')
    (hsq : f₁ ≫ b = a ≫ f₂) (Y : C) (n : ℕ) :
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ b).precomp Y (zero_add n)) ≫
        derivedExtContravariantMap f₁ Y n =
      derivedExtContravariantMap f₂ Y n ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ a).precomp Y (zero_add n))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  dsimp [derivedExtContravariantMap]
  change
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f₁).comp
        ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ b).comp x (zero_add n))
        (zero_add n) =
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ a).comp
        ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f₂).comp x (zero_add n))
        (zero_add n)
  rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc]
  rw [hsq]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtConnectingMap_naturality
statement:
theorem derivedExtConnectingMap_naturality
    {S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex C}
    (h₁ : S₁.ShortExact) (h₂ : S₂.ShortExact) (f : S₁ ⟶ S₂)
    (Y : C) (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : 1 + n₀ = n₁) :
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (h₂.extClass.precomp Y h) ≫
        derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₃ Y n₁ =
      derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₁ Y n₀ ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (h₁.extClass.precomp Y h)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  dsimp [derivedExtContravariantMap]
  change
    (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f.τ₃).comp
        (h₂.extClass.comp x h) (zero_add n₁) =
      h₁.extClass.comp
        ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f.τ₁).comp x (zero_add n₀)) h
  calc
    _ = ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f.τ₃).comp h₂.extClass
          (zero_add 1)).comp x h := by
        symm
        apply CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc
        omega
    _ = (h₁.extClass.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f.τ₁)
          (add_zero 1)).comp x h := by
        rw [h₁.extClass_naturality h₂ f]
    _ = _ := by
        apply CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc
        omega

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap_id
    {S : ShortComplex C} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (Y : C) (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : 1 + n₀ = n₁) :
    derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap hS hS (𝟙 S) Y n₀ n₁ h = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply ComposableArrows.hom_ext₅
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 S.X₃) Y n₀ = 𝟙 _
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_id S.X₃ Y n₀
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 S.X₂) Y n₀ = 𝟙 _
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_id S.X₂ Y n₀
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 S.X₁) Y n₀ = 𝟙 _
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_id S.X₁ Y n₀
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 S.X₃) Y n₁ = 𝟙 _
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_id S.X₃ Y n₁
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 S.X₂) Y n₁ = 𝟙 _
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_id S.X₂ Y n₁
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap (𝟙 S.X₁) Y n₁ = 𝟙 _
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_id S.X₁ Y n₁

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap_comp
    {S₁ S₂ S₃ : ShortComplex C}
    (h₁ : S₁.ShortExact) (h₂ : S₂.ShortExact) (h₃ : S₃.ShortExact)
    (f : S₁ ⟶ S₂) (g : S₂ ⟶ S₃)
    (Y : C) (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : 1 + n₀ = n₁) :
    derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap h₂ h₃ g Y n₀ n₁ h ≫
        derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap h₁ h₂ f Y n₀ n₁ h =
      derivedExtContravariantSequenceMap h₁ h₃ (f ≫ g) Y n₀ n₁ h
proof:
:= by
  apply ComposableArrows.hom_ext₅
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g.τ₃ Y n₀ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₃ Y n₀ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f.τ₃ ≫ g.τ₃) Y n₀
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_comp f.τ₃ g.τ₃ Y n₀
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g.τ₂ Y n₀ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₂ Y n₀ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f.τ₂ ≫ g.τ₂) Y n₀
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_comp f.τ₂ g.τ₂ Y n₀
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g.τ₁ Y n₀ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₁ Y n₀ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f.τ₁ ≫ g.τ₁) Y n₀
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_comp f.τ₁ g.τ₁ Y n₀
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g.τ₃ Y n₁ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₃ Y n₁ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f.τ₃ ≫ g.τ₃) Y n₁
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_comp f.τ₃ g.τ₃ Y n₁
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g.τ₂ Y n₁ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₂ Y n₁ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f.τ₂ ≫ g.τ₂) Y n₁
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_comp f.τ₂ g.τ₂ Y n₁
  · change derivedExtContravariantMap g.τ₁ Y n₁ ≫
      derivedExtContravariantMap f.τ₁ Y n₁ =
        derivedExtContravariantMap (f.τ₁ ≫ g.τ₁) Y n₁
    exact derivedExtContravariantMap_comp f.τ₁ g.τ₁ Y n₁

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.derivedExtContravariantSequenceDiagram_obj_exact
statement:
theorem derivedExtContravariantSequenceDiagram_obj_exact
    (F : D ⥤ ShortComplex C) (hF : ∀ d, (F.obj d).ShortExact)
