name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.exists_smul_eq_on_torsionBySet_of_finiteLength_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_smul_eq_on_torsionBySet_of_finiteLength_quotient
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hess : IsEssentialSubmodule (LinearMap.range i))
    (J : Ideal R) (hJ : IsFiniteLength R (R ⧸ J)) (f : E →ₗ[R] E) :
    ∃ r : R, ∀ z : E, (∀ a : R, a ∈ J → a • z = 0) → f z = r • z
proof:
:= by
  let g : ((R ⧸ J) →ₗ[R] E) →ₗ[R] E :=
    f.comp (residueFieldHullEvaluation R E (R ⧸ J) (Ideal.Quotient.mk J 1))
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    (bijective_residueFieldHullEvaluation_of_finiteLength i hi hess hJ).surjective g
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hzJ : z ∈ Submodule.torsionBySet R E (J : Set R) :=
    (Submodule.mem_torsionBySet_iff (R := R) (M := E) (s := (J : Set R)) z).mpr
      (fun a => hz a a.property)
  let zJ : Submodule.torsionBySet R E (J : Set R) := ⟨z, hzJ⟩
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hq ((quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet J).symm zJ)
  change (quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet J).symm zJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J r) =
    f ((quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet J).symm zJ (Ideal.Quotient.mk J 1)) at h
  simpa only [quotientHomEquivTorsionBySet_symm_apply_mk, one_smul] using h.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.sub_mem_ideal_of_smul_eq_zero_on_torsionBySet
statement:
theorem sub_mem_ideal_of_smul_eq_zero_on_torsionBySet
    (i : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) →ₗ[R] E) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (J : Ideal R) (r s : R)
    (hrs : ∀ z : E, (∀ a : R, a ∈ J → a • z = 0) → (r - s) • z = 0) :
    r - s ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hq : Ideal.Quotient.mk J (r - s) ≠ 0 :=
    fun h => hnot (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
    exists_linearMap_apply_ne_zero_of_injective_residueField i hi
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (r - s)) hq
  apply hg
  have hz : ∀ a : R, a ∈ J → a • g (Ideal.Quotient.mk J 1) = 0 := by
    intro a ha
    have hquot : a • (Ideal.Quotient.mk J 1 : R ⧸ J) = 0 := by
      change Ideal.Quotient.mk J (a * 1) = 0
      rw [mul_one]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr ha
    exact (g.map_smul a (Ideal.Quotient.mk J 1)).symm.trans
      ((congrArg g hquot).trans g.map_zero)
  have hscalar : (r - s) • Ideal.Quotient.mk J 1 = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (r - s) := by
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk J ((r - s) * 1) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (r - s)
    rw [mul_one]
  rw [← hscalar, map_smul]
  exact hrs (g (Ideal.Quotient.mk J 1)) hz

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.specNormalizationIso_hom_structureMap
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem specNormalizationIso_hom_structureMap
    (R B : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] :
    (specNormalizationIso R B).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R B))) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  apply spec_toNormalization_hom_ext R B
  rw [← Category.assoc, toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom,
    ← Spec.map_comp, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_fromNormalization]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.integralClosureLocalization_isPushout
statement:
theorem integralClosureLocalization_isPushout :
    IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R B)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Rm))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosureLocalizationMap R B Rm Bm).toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Rm (integralClosure Rm Bm)))
proof:
:= by
  let C := integralClosure R B
  let Cm := integralClosure Rm Bm
  let ι : C →ₐ[R] Cm := integralClosureLocalizationMap R B Rm Bm
  let : Algebra C Cm := ι.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R C Cm :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r ↦ (ι.commutes r).symm
  let : IsScalarTower C Cm Bm :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C M) Cm :=
    IsLocalization.integralClosure (S := B) (Rf := Rm) (Sf := Bm) M
  let : Algebra.IsPushout R C Rm Cm :=
    Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization M Rm C Cm
  exact CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout R C Rm Cm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.toNormalization_affineNormalizationLocalizationMap
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem toNormalization_affineNormalizationLocalizationMap :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Rm Bm))).toNormalization ≫
        affineNormalizationLocalizationMap R B Rm Bm =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B Bm)) ≫
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (specNormalizationIso R B).hom).mp
  simp only [affineNormalizationLocalizationMap, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id,
    toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom_assoc,
    toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineNormalizationLocalization_isPullback
statement:
theorem affineNormalizationLocalization_isPullback :
    IsPullback
      (affineNormalizationLocalizationMap R B Rm Bm)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Rm Bm))).fromNormalization
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).fromNormalization
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Rm)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R B)))
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Rm))
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosureLocalizationMap R B Rm Bm).toRingHom)
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Rm (integralClosure Rm Bm)))
    (integralClosureLocalization_isPushout R B Rm Bm M)
  refine h.of_iso' (specNormalizationIso Rm Bm) (specNormalizationIso R B)
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [affineNormalizationLocalizationMap, Category.assoc,
      Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, specNormalizationIso_hom_structureMap]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, specNormalizationIso_hom_structureMap]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineNormalizationLocalizationIso_hom_fst
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineNormalizationLocalizationIso_hom_fst :
    (affineNormalizationLocalizationIso R B Rm Bm M).hom ≫
        pullback.fst
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).fromNormalization
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Rm))) =
      affineNormalizationLocalizationMap R B Rm Bm
proof:
:=
  (affineNormalizationLocalization_isPullback R B Rm Bm M).isoPullback_hom_fst

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineNormalizationLocalizationIso_hom_snd
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineNormalizationLocalizationIso_hom_snd :
    (affineNormalizationLocalizationIso R B Rm Bm M).hom ≫
        pullback.snd
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).fromNormalization
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Rm))) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Rm Bm))).fromNormalization

:=
  (affineNormalizationLocalization_isPullback R B Rm Bm M).isoPullback_hom_snd

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationMapOfSquare_endomorphism
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem normalizationMapOfSquare_endomorphism
    (τ : A ⟶ A) (hτ : τ ≫ f = f)
    (σ : B ⟶ B) (hσ : σ ≫ g = g)
    (he : τ ≫ a = a ≫ σ) :
    normalizationEndomorphism f τ hτ ≫ normalizationMapOfSquare f g a b h =
      normalizationMapOfSquare f g a b h ≫ normalizationEndomorphism g σ hσ
proof:
:= by
  let l : A ⟶ pullback g.fromNormalization b :=
    pullback.lift (a ≫ g.toNormalization) f (by
      rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_fromNormalization, h])
  have hl : f.toNormalization ≫ normalizationSquareLift f g a b h = l :=
    normalizationSquareLift_source f g a b h
  have hlift :
      normalizationEndomorphism f τ hτ ≫ normalizationSquareLift f g a b h =
        normalizationSquareLift f g a b h ≫
          pullbackEndomorphism g.fromNormalization b
            (normalizationEndomorphism g σ hσ)
            (normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization g σ hσ) := by
    apply Scheme.Hom.normalization.hom_ext f _ _
      (pullback.snd g.fromNormalization b)
    · rw [← Category.assoc, toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism,
        Category.assoc, hl, ← Category.assoc, hl]
      apply pullback.hom_ext
      · simp only [l, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst,
          pullbackEndomorphism_fst, pullback.lift_fst_assoc]
        rw [← Category.assoc, he, Category.assoc,
          toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism]
      · simp only [l, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_snd,
          pullbackEndomorphism_snd, hτ]
    · rw [Category.assoc, normalizationSquareLift_base,
        normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization]
    · rw [Category.assoc, pullbackEndomorphism_snd, normalizationSquareLift_base]
  dsimp only [normalizationMapOfSquare]
  rw [← Category.assoc, hlift, Category.assoc, pullbackEndomorphism_fst,
    ← Category.assoc]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.specNormalizationIso_hom_base
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem specNormalizationIso_hom_base
    (R B : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] :
    (specNormalizationIso R B).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R B))) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  apply spec_toNormalization_hom_ext R B
  rw [← Category.assoc, toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom,
    Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_fromNormalization, ← Spec.map_comp]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.integralClosure_etale_of_dvr_of_geometricInertia_trivial
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_dvr_of_geometricInertia_trivial
    (R K L : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower R K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (hfix : ∀ (z : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))) ⟶
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R L))).normalization),
      z ≫ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R L))).fromNormalization =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            ((algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
              (AlgebraicClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))).comp
                (IsLocalRing.residue R))) →
      ∀ σ : Gal(L/K),
        z ≫ affineNormalizationDeck R L (σ.restrictScalars R) = z → σ = 1) :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R L)
proof:
:= by
  let S := integralClosure R L
  let : Module.Finite R S := IsIntegralClosure.finite R K L S
  apply integralClosure_etale_of_dvr_of_inertia_eq_bot R K L
  let : MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) S := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction R K L S
  intro Q hQ hOver
  have : Q.IsMaximal := Ideal.IsMaximal.of_liesOver_isMaximal Q
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
  obtain ⟨φ, hker, hbase⟩ := SchemeTheory.exists_finite_residue_geometricPoint R S Q
  let z := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ (specNormalizationIso R L).inv
  have hz : z ≫ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R L))).fromNormalization =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (AlgebraicClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))).comp
            (IsLocalRing.residue R))) := by
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [← specNormalizationIso_hom_base R L, Category.assoc,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun f => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) hbase
  apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
  intro σ hσ
  apply hfix z hz σ
  apply (mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_affineNormalizationGeometricPoint
    R L φ (σ.restrictScalars R)).mp
  let : MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[R] L) S := integralClosureAutAction R L
  apply Ideal.mem_inertia.mpr
  intro b
  have hsmul : σ • b = (σ.restrictScalars R) • b := by
    change (galRestrict R K L S σ) b =
      (((integralClosureAutHom R L).comp (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom R)) σ) b
    exact congrArg (fun f : Gal(L/K) →* (S ≃ₐ[R] S) => f σ b)
      (galRestrict_integralClosure_eq R K L)
  rw [← hsmul, hker]
  exact Ideal.mem_inertia.mp hσ b

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_germToFunctionField
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_germToFunctionField
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] (sigma : Aut Y) :
    let : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    let : Nonempty (⊤ : Y.left.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Y.left), trivial⟩⟩
    ∀ a : Γ(Y.left, ⊤),
      finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y sigma (Y.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ a) =
        Y.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (sigma.hom.left.appTop a) := by
  intro hIntegral hAlgebra hTop a
  have h := sigma.hom.left.functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField_top
    sigma.hom.left.surjective.denseRange
  have ha := DFunLike.congr_fun h a
  have he := finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq_functionFieldMap Y sigma
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun he (Y.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ a)).trans ha

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_galoisComponent_normalizationPoint_fixed_lift
statement:
theorem exists_galoisComponent_normalizationPoint_fixed_lift
    {U V S : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral U] [IsNormalIntegral U]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian U] [ConnectedSpace V]
    (c : U ⟶ V) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (xi : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U) (W : FiniteEtale V) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (a : U ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact a] [QuasiSeparated a]
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω']
    (q : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶
      ((show ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W).left ⟶ U from
        ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W).hom) ≫ a).normalization) :
    let A
proof:
:= (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W
    let g : A.left ⟶ S := (show A.left ⟶ U from A.hom) ≫ a
    ∃ (Z : FiniteEtale U) (i : Z ⟶ A)
      (qZ : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ ((show Z.left ⟶ U from Z.hom) ≫ a).normalization)
      (z : (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).obj Z)
      (w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ c)).obj W)
      (hi : Mono i) (hZ : IsGalois Z)
      (hiz : (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).map i z =
        transportedPointOfCompIso (FiniteEtale.pullback c)
          (FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso c xi) W w),
      qZ ≫ ((show Z.left ⟶ U from Z.hom) ≫ a).fromNormalization =
        q ≫ g.fromNormalization ∧
      ∀ σ : Aut W,
        q ≫ normalizationEndomorphism g ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).left
          (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) (((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).w)) = q →
        ∃ τ : Aut Z,
          FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
            c xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi (MulOpposite.op τ) = MulOpposite.op σ ∧
          qZ ≫ normalizationEndomorphism ((show Z.left ⟶ U from Z.hom) ≫ a)
            τ.hom.left (by
              rw [← Category.assoc]
              exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) τ.hom.w) = qZ := by
  intro A g
  obtain ⟨Z, i, q₀, z, w, hi, hZ, hq₀, hiz⟩ :=
    exists_galoisNormalizationComponent_geometricPoint c xi W hW g q
  let : Mono i := hi
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let : IsIntegral Z.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  let gZ : Z.left ⟶ S := (show Z.left ⟶ U from Z.hom) ≫ a
  have he : (Iso.refl Z.left).hom ≫ gZ = i.left ≫ g := by
    have hiw : i.left ≫ (show A.left ⟶ U from A.hom) =
        (show Z.left ⟶ U from Z.hom) := i.w
    exact (Category.id_comp gZ).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k : Z.left ⟶ U => k ≫ a) hiw).symm.trans
        (Category.assoc i.left (show A.left ⟶ U from A.hom) a))
  let E : (i.left ≫ g).normalization ≅ gZ.normalization :=
    normalizationSourceIso (i.left ≫ g) gZ (Iso.refl Z.left) he
  refine ⟨Z, i, q₀ ≫ E.hom, z, w, hi, hZ, hiz, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Category.assoc, normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization, ← hq₀,
      Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    exact (Scheme.Hom.normalizationDesc_comp _ _ _ _).symm
  · intro σ hσfix
    have hσ : ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).left ≫ g = g := by
      dsimp only [g]
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) (((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).w)
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hquotient, hτfix⟩ :=
      FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_exists_normalized_fixed_lift
        c xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi g q₀ σ hσ (by rw [← Category.assoc, hq₀]; exact hσfix)
    have hτZ : τ.hom.left ≫ gZ = gZ := by
      dsimp only [gZ]
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) τ.hom.w
    have hτg : τ.hom.left ≫ (i.left ≫ g) = i.left ≫ g := by
      have ht := congrArg (fun k : Z ⟶ A => k.left) hτ
      change τ.hom.left ≫ i.left = i.left ≫ ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).left at ht
      rw [← Category.assoc, ht, Category.assoc, hσ]
    refine ⟨τ, hquotient, ?_⟩
    exact (normalizationSourceIso_fixes_iff (i.left ≫ g) gZ
      (Iso.refl Z.left) he q₀ τ.hom.left hτg τ.hom.left hτZ
      (by rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])).mpr hτfix

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_normalization
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_normalization
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) [QuasiCompact U.ι]
    (W : FiniteEtale U)
    [IsFiniteEtale (W.hom ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization] :
    ∃ V : FiniteEtale X, Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback U.ι).obj V ≅ W)
proof:
:= by
  let F : W.left ⟶ X := W.hom ≫ U.ι
  let g : W.left ⟶ U := W.hom
  let V : FiniteEtale X := FiniteEtale.mk F.fromNormalization
  have H : IsPullback (𝟙 W.left) g F U.ι :=
    IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso_mono ⟨Category.id_comp F⟩
  let e : pullback F U.ι ≅ W.left :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F U.ι).isoIsPullback _ _ H
  have he : e.hom ≫ g = pullback.snd F U.ι :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd W.left U
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F U.ι) H
  let en := normalizationSourceIso (pullback.snd F U.ι) g e he
  have hen : en.inv ≫ (pullback.snd F U.ι).fromNormalization = g.fromNormalization :=
    (Iso.inv_comp_eq en).mpr (normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization _ _ _ _).symm
  let eN : W.left ≅ pullback F.fromNormalization U.ι :=
    asIso g.toNormalization ≪≫ en.symm ≪≫ asIso (F.normalizationPullback U.ι)
  have heN : eN.hom ≫ pullback.snd F.fromNormalization U.ι = g := by
    change (g.toNormalization ≫ en.inv ≫ F.normalizationPullback U.ι) ≫
      pullback.snd F.fromNormalization U.ι = g
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd,
      hen, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_fromNormalization]
  refine ⟨V, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk eN.symm ((Iso.inv_comp_eq eN).mpr heN.symm)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.etale_fractionCover_normalization_of_geometricInertia_trivial
statement:
theorem etale_fractionCover_normalization_of_geometricInertia_trivial
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of K))) (hY : IsGalois Y)
    (hfix : ∀ (z : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))) ⟶
        ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))).normalization),
      z ≫ ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))).fromNormalization =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            ((algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
              (AlgebraicClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))).comp
                (IsLocalRing.residue R))) →
      ∀ τ : Aut Y,
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism
          ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) ≫
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) τ.hom.left
          (by
            have hw : τ.hom.left ≫ (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) =
                (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) := τ.hom.w
            exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
              (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) hw)) = z →
          τ = 1) :
    Etale (((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))).fromNormalization)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsNormalIntegral Y.left := isNormalIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsAffine Y.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom)
  let g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))
  let f : Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) ≫ g
  let F := (Spec (.of K)).functionField
  let L := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra F L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra R F := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R g
  let : Algebra R L := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R f
  let : IsScalarTower R F L := finiteEtaleMorphism_functionField_isScalarTower R g Y
  have : IsFractionRing R F := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra_isFractionRing R K
  have : FiniteDimensional F L := finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  have : _root_.IsGalois F L := isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Y hY
  let e := affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R f
  let eGal := finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMulEquiv Y hY
  have hEtale : Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R L) := by
    apply integralClosure_etale_of_dvr_of_geometricInertia_trivial R F L
    intro z hz σ hσ
    let ζ := z ≫ (specNormalizationIso R L).hom ≫ e.inv
    have hζ : ζ ≫ f.fromNormalization =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          ((algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
            (AlgebraicClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))).comp (IsLocalRing.residue R))) := by
      rw [← affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_hom_base R f]
      simp only [ζ, e, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
      exact (congrArg (fun k => z ≫ k) (specNormalizationIso_hom_base R L)).trans hz
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := eGal.surjective σ
    have hτσ : finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y τ.unop = σ :=
      (finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMulEquiv_apply Y hY τ).symm.trans hτ
    have hτf : τ.unop.hom.left ≫ f = f := by
      have hw : τ.unop.hom.left ≫ (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) =
          (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) := τ.unop.hom.w
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ g) hw)
    have hτfix : ζ ≫ normalizationEndomorphism f τ.unop.hom.left hτf = ζ := by
      apply (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_fixes_iff R f
        (show Y.left ≅ Y.left from
          (FiniteEtale.forget (Spec (.of K)) ⋙ Over.forget (Spec (.of K))).mapIso τ.unop)
        hτf ζ).mp
      rw [finiteEtaleMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq R g Y τ.unop, hτσ]
      have h := congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (specNormalizationIso R L).hom) hσ
      rw [Category.assoc, affineNormalizationDeck_specNormalizationIso_hom,
        ← Category.assoc] at h
      simpa only [ζ, e, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id] using h
    have hτone : τ.unop = 1 := hfix ζ hζ τ.unop hτfix
    calc
      σ = eGal τ := hτ.symm
      _ = eGal 1 := congrArg eGal (MulOpposite.unop_injective hτone)
      _ = 1 := map_one eGal
  have hSpec : Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)))) :=
    (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr
      ((RingHom.etale_algebraMap (R := R) (S := integralClosure R L)).mpr hEtale)
  change Etale f.fromNormalization
  rw [← affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_hom_base R f]
  infer_instance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.pullbackSquare_iso_intertwines
proof:
:= by
  apply H₂.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_fst, hp₁, hp₂,
      IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_fst_assoc]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd, hq₁, hq₂]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_boundaryAway_normalizationPoint
statement:
theorem exists_boundaryAway_normalizationPoint
    {X U T : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] (u : U)
    (P : Spec (U.presheaf.stalk u)) :
    let : P.asIdeal.IsPrime
proof:
:= P.isPrime
    ∀ {r : ℕ} (t : Fin 2 → Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
    (hb : ((I.comap f).stalkIdeal u).map
      (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =
        Ideal.span {EtaleFundamentalGroups.boundaryProduct t r})
    (W : FiniteEtale I.supportComplement)
    (z : T ⟶ ((show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) ≫
      I.supportComplement.ι).normalization)
    (y : T ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)))
    (_hzy : z ≫ ((show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) ≫
      I.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization =
        y ≫ Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo U u P.asIdeal ≫ f),
    let c := I.boundaryAwayToSupportComplement f u P t hb
    let A := (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W
    let a := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
        (Localization.Away (EtaleFundamentalGroups.boundaryProduct t r))))
    let g : A.left ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) :=
      (show A.left ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.Away
        (EtaleFundamentalGroups.boundaryProduct t r))) from A.hom) ≫ a
    ∃ q : T ⟶ g.normalization,
      q ≫ g.fromNormalization = y ∧
      ∀ σ : Aut W,
        q ≫ normalizationEndomorphism g ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).left
          (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) (((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).w)) = q ↔
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism
          ((show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) ≫ I.supportComplement.ι)
          σ.hom.left (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ I.supportComplement.ι) σ.hom.w) = z := by
  intro hP r t hb W z y hzy c A a g
  let h : Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) ⟶ U :=
    Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo U u P.asIdeal
  let F : W.left ⟶ X :=
    (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) ≫ I.supportComplement.ι
  let F₁ := pullback.snd F f
  let F₂ := pullback.snd F₁ h
  have Hcover : IsPullback
      (pullback.fst (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) c)
      g F (h ≫ f) :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback
      (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) c).paste_vert
      (I.isPullback_boundaryAwayToSupportComplement f u P t hb)
  have Htwo : IsPullback (pullback.fst F₁ h ≫ pullback.fst F f) F₂ F (h ≫ f) :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F₁ h).paste_horiz (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F f)
  let e : pullback F₁ h ≅ A.left := Htwo.isoIsPullback _ _ Hcover
  have he : e.hom ≫ g = F₂ := IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd W.left
    (Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))) Htwo Hcover
  have hzy' : z ≫ F.fromNormalization = y ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))) ≫
        U.fromSpecStalk u ≫ f := by
    simpa only [Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo, Category.assoc] using hzy
  obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀, hfix₀⟩ := exists_normalizationPoint_etaleChart_localizedStalk
    F f u P.asIdeal z y hzy'
  let E : F₂.normalization ≅ g.normalization := normalizationSourceIso F₂ g e he
  refine ⟨q₀ ≫ E.hom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Category.assoc q₀ E.hom g.fromNormalization).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k : F₂.normalization ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =>
        q₀ ≫ k) (normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization F₂ g e he)).trans hq₀)
  · intro σ
    have hσ : σ.hom.left ≫ F = F := by
      dsimp only [F]
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ I.supportComplement.ι) σ.hom.w
    let τ₁ := pullbackEndomorphism F f σ.hom.left hσ
    have hτ₁ : τ₁ ≫ F₁ = F₁ := pullbackEndomorphism_snd F f σ.hom.left hσ
    let τ₂ := pullbackEndomorphism F₁ h τ₁ hτ₁
    have hτ₂ : τ₂ ≫ F₂ = F₂ := pullbackEndomorphism_snd F₁ h τ₁ hτ₁
    let τ := ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).left
    have hτ : τ ≫ g = g := by
      dsimp only [g]
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) (((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).w)
    have hτfst : τ ≫
        pullback.fst (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) c =
        pullback.fst (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) c ≫
          σ.hom.left := by
      change pullback.lift _ _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = _
      exact pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
    have hτ₂fst : τ₂ ≫ (pullback.fst F₁ h ≫ pullback.fst F f) =
        (pullback.fst F₁ h ≫ pullback.fst F f) ≫ σ.hom.left := by
      calc
        τ₂ ≫ (pullback.fst F₁ h ≫ pullback.fst F f) =
            (τ₂ ≫ pullback.fst F₁ h) ≫ pullback.fst F f :=
          (Category.assoc τ₂ (pullback.fst F₁ h) (pullback.fst F f)).symm
        _ = (pullback.fst F₁ h ≫ τ₁) ≫ pullback.fst F f :=
          congrArg (fun k => k ≫ pullback.fst F f)
            (pullbackEndomorphism_fst F₁ h τ₁ hτ₁)
        _ = pullback.fst F₁ h ≫ (τ₁ ≫ pullback.fst F f) := Category.assoc _ _ _
        _ = pullback.fst F₁ h ≫ (pullback.fst F f ≫ σ.hom.left) :=
          congrArg (fun k => pullback.fst F₁ h ≫ k)
            (pullbackEndomorphism_fst F f σ.hom.left hσ)
        _ = (pullback.fst F₁ h ≫ pullback.fst F f) ≫ σ.hom.left :=
          (Category.assoc (pullback.fst F₁ h) (pullback.fst F f) σ.hom.left).symm
    have hcommute : τ₂ ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ τ :=
      pullbackSquare_iso_intertwines Htwo Hcover τ₂ τ σ.hom.left hτ₂fst hτ₂ hτfst hτ
    exact (normalizationSourceIso_fixes_iff F₂ g e he q₀ τ₂ hτ₂ τ hτ hcommute).trans
      (hfix₀ σ.hom.left hσ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra_isFractionRing
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]

proof:
:=
      affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K)))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.topologicalClosure_normalClosure_eq_iInf_openNormal
statement:
theorem topologicalClosure_normalClosure_eq_iInf_openNormal
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (s : Set G) :
    (Subgroup.normalClosure s).topologicalClosure =
      ⨅ (N : OpenNormalSubgroup G) (_hs : s ⊆ (N : Set G)), (N : Subgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_iInf
    intro N
    apply le_iInf
    intro hs
    exact Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal (Subgroup.normalClosure s)
      (Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal hs) N.toOpenSubgroup.isClosed
  · let K : Subgroup G := (Subgroup.normalClosure s).topologicalClosure
    let : K.Normal := Subgroup.is_normal_topologicalClosure (Subgroup.normalClosure s)
    let Kclosed : ClosedSubgroup G :=
      ⟨K, Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure (Subgroup.normalClosure s)⟩
    intro x hx
    apply ProCGroups.ProC.mem_closedSubgroup_of_forall_openNormal_sup Kclosed
    intro U
    let V : OpenNormalSubgroup G := ProCGroups.ProC.openNormalSubgroup_sup_normal K U
    have hsV : s ⊆ (V : Set G) := by
      intro y hy
      exact Subgroup.mem_sup_left
        (Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure (Subgroup.normalClosure s)
          (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure hy))
    exact Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp hx V) hsV

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.topologicalClosure_normalClosure_eq_iInf_galoisQuotient
statement:
theorem topologicalClosure_normalClosure_eq_iInf_galoisQuotient
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [GaloisCategory C]
    (F : C ⥤ FintypeCat) [FiberFunctor F]
    (s : Set (Aut F)) :
    (Subgroup.normalClosure s).topologicalClosure =
      ⨅ (A : C) (hA : IsGalois A) (a : F.obj A),
        letI : IsGalois A
proof:
:= hA
        ⨅ (_hs : s ⊆
          (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom
            F (Aut F) A a).ker),
          (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom
            F (Aut F) A a).ker := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_iInf
    intro A
    apply le_iInf
    intro hA
    let : IsGalois A := hA
    apply le_iInf
    intro a
    apply le_iInf
    intro hs
    apply Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal (Subgroup.normalClosure s)
      (Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal hs)
    rw [galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker]
    exact Subgroup.isClosed_of_isOpen _
      (stabilizer_isOpen (Aut F) a)
  · rw [topologicalClosure_normalClosure_eq_iInf_openNormal]
    apply le_iInf
    intro U
    apply le_iInf
    intro hsU g hg
    obtain ⟨A, hA, a, ha⟩ :=
      exists_galois_object_point_stabilizer_eq_any_universe F U
    let : IsGalois A := hA
    have hker :
        (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom
          F (Aut F) A a).ker = (U : Subgroup (Aut F)) :=
      (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom_ker
        F (Aut F) A a).trans ha
    have hs : s ⊆
        (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom
          F (Aut F) A a).ker := by
      rw [hker]
      exact hsU
    simp only [Subgroup.mem_iInf] at hg
    have hgker := hg A hA a hs
    rw [hker] at hgker
    exact hgker

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.ker_liesOver_of_specMap_comp
statement:
theorem ker_liesOver_of_specMap_comp
    {R B Ω : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Field Ω] [Algebra R B]
    (φ : B →+* Ω) (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hy : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)) = y) :

proof:
:= by

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_awayPoint_of_algebraEq
statement:
private theorem exists_awayPoint_of_algebraEq
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (f : R) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)))) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω]
    (z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶
      ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)) from Y.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)))).normalization) :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away f
    let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
    let : IsIntegrallyClosed S := isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S
      (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
    let : IsIntegral Y.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : Algebra (Spec (.of S)).functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    ∀ (a : Algebra R (Spec (.of S)).functionField) (b : Algebra R Y.left.functionField)
      (ha : a = affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))))
      (hb : b = affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R
        ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))),
    let : Algebra R (Spec (.of S)).functionField := a
    let : Algebra R Y.left.functionField := b
    let : IsScalarTower R (Spec (.of S)).functionField Y.left.functionField := by
      cases ha
      cases hb
      exact finiteEtaleMorphism_functionField_isScalarTower R
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) Y
    ∃ φ : integralClosure R Y.left.functionField →+* Ω,
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap R (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField))) =
        z ≫ ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).fromNormalization ∧
      ∀ σ : Aut Y,
        finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ ∈
          (RingHom.ker φ).inertia Gal(Y.left.functionField/(Spec (.of S)).functionField) ↔
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism
          ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) σ.hom.left
          (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg
              (fun k => k ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) σ.hom.w) = z := by
  intro S hDomain hNormal hIntegral hKL a b ha hb
  subst a
  subst b
  intro hRK hRL hTower
  have : IsNormalIntegral Y.left := isNormalIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let g : Spec (.of S) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hfix⟩ := exists_finiteEtaleMorphism_point_inertia_iff R g Y z
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap R (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField)))) hφ).trans
      ((Category.assoc z _ _).trans
        (congrArg (fun k => z ≫ k)
          (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_hom_base R
            ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫ g))))
  · intro σ
    have hsmul (b : integralClosure R Y.left.functionField) :
        (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ) • b =
        ((integralClosureAutHom R Y.left.functionField).comp
          (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom R)) (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ) b := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact integralClosure.coe_smul _ _
    have hmem :
        finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ ∈
          (RingHom.ker φ).inertia Gal(Y.left.functionField/(Spec (.of S)).functionField) ↔
        (let : MulSemiringAction Gal(Y.left.functionField/(Spec (.of S)).functionField)
            (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField) :=
          MulSemiringAction.compHom (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField)
            ((integralClosureAutHom R Y.left.functionField).comp (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom R))
         finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ ∈
          (RingHom.ker φ).inertia Gal(Y.left.functionField/(Spec (.of S)).functionField)) := by
      constructor
      · intro hσ
        apply Ideal.mem_inertia.mpr
        intro b
        exact (hsmul b ▸ Ideal.mem_inertia.mp hσ b)
      · intro hσ
        apply Ideal.mem_inertia.mpr
        intro b
        exact ((hsmul b).symm ▸ Ideal.mem_inertia.mp hσ b)
    exact hmem.trans (hfix σ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_finiteEtaleAway_normalizationPoint_inertia_iff
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtaleAway_normalizationPoint_inertia_iff
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (f : R) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)))) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω]
    (z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶
      ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)) from Y.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)))).normalization) :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away f
    let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
    let : IsIntegrallyClosed S := isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S
      (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
    let : IsIntegral Y.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : Algebra (Spec (.of S)).functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    let : Algebra R (Spec (.of S)).functionField :=
      localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
    let : Algebra R Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
    let : IsScalarTower R (Spec (.of S)).functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower f hf Y
    ∃ φ : integralClosure R Y.left.functionField →+* Ω,
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap R (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField))) =
        z ≫ ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).fromNormalization ∧
      ∀ σ : Aut Y,
        finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ ∈
          (RingHom.ker φ).inertia Gal(Y.left.functionField/(Spec (.of S)).functionField) ↔
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism
          ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) σ.hom.left
          (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg
              (fun k => k ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) σ.hom.w) = z := by
  intro S hDomain hNormal hIntegral hKL hRK hRL hTower
  exact exists_awayPoint_of_algebraEq R f hf Y z hRK hRL
    (affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra_specMap R S (algebraMap R S)).symm
    (finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra_eq_affineMorphism f hf Y)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_normalizationPoint_etaleChart_localizedStalk
statement:
theorem exists_normalizationPoint_etaleChart_localizedStalk
    {X Y U T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (g : U ⟶ Y) [Etale g] (u : U) (P : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) [P.IsPrime]
    (z : T ⟶ f.normalization)
    (y : T ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P)))
    (hzy : z ≫ f.fromNormalization =
      y ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P))) ≫ U.fromSpecStalk u ≫ g) :
    let h : Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P)) ⟶ U
proof:
:=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P))) ≫ U.fromSpecStalk u
    ∃ q : T ⟶ (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h).normalization,
      q ≫ (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h).fromNormalization = y ∧
      ∀ (σ : X ⟶ X) (hσ : σ ≫ f = f),
        q ≫ normalizationEndomorphism (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)
          (pullbackEndomorphism (pullback.snd f g) h
            (pullbackEndomorphism f g σ hσ) (pullbackEndomorphism_snd f g σ hσ))
          (pullbackEndomorphism_snd (pullback.snd f g) h
            (pullbackEndomorphism f g σ hσ) (pullbackEndomorphism_snd f g σ hσ)) = q ↔
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism f σ hσ = z := by
  intro h
  have hc : IsIso ((pullback.snd f g).normalizationPullback h) :=
    isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalkLocalization (pullback.snd f g) u P
  have hzy₁ : z ≫ f.fromNormalization = (y ≫ h) ≫ g := by
    simpa only [h, Category.assoc] using hzy
  let z₁ : T ⟶ (pullback.snd f g).normalization :=
    pullback.lift z (y ≫ h) hzy₁ ≫ inv (f.normalizationPullback g)
  have hz₁ : z₁ ≫ (pullback.snd f g).fromNormalization = y ≫ h := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd f g]
    simp only [z₁, Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc, pullback.lift_snd]
  let q : T ⟶ (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h).normalization :=
    pullback.lift z₁ y hz₁ ≫ inv ((pullback.snd f g).normalizationPullback h)
  refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd (pullback.snd f g) h]
    simp only [q, Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc, pullback.lift_snd]
  · intro σ hσ
    exact (normalizationPullback_fixes_point_iff (pullback.snd f g) h z₁ y hz₁
      (pullbackEndomorphism f g σ hσ) (pullbackEndomorphism_snd f g σ hσ)).trans
        (normalizationPullback_fixes_point_iff f g z (y ≫ h) hzy₁ σ hσ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.preimage_normalizationComponentInclusion_range
statement:
theorem preimage_normalizationComponentInclusion_range
    (f : W.left ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (i : Z ⟶ W) [Mono i] :
    f.toNormalization ⁻¹' Set.range (normalizationComponentInclusion f i) =
      Set.range i.left
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Z', j, ⟨hcoprod⟩⟩ :=
    PreGaloisCategory.monoInducesIsoOnDirectSummand i
  let F := FiniteEtale.forget U ⋙ Over.forget U
  have hscheme : IsColimit (BinaryCofan.mk i.left j.left) :=
    mapIsColimitOfPreservesOfIsColimit F i j hcoprod
  have hcomponents : IsCompl (Set.range i.left) (Set.range j.left) :=
    ((TopCat.binaryCofan_isColimit_iff _).mp
      ⟨mapIsColimitOfPreservesOfIsColimit Scheme.forgetToTop
        i.left j.left hscheme⟩).2.2
  let e : (i.left ≫ f).normalization ⨿ (j.left ≫ f).normalization ≅
      f.normalization := f.normalizationCoprodIso hscheme
  have hi : normalizationComponentInclusion f i = coprod.inl ≫ e.hom := by
    dsimp only [e, Scheme.Hom.normalizationCoprodIso]
    rw [coprod.inl_desc]
    rfl
  have hj : normalizationComponentInclusion f j = coprod.inr ≫ e.hom := by
    dsimp only [e, Scheme.Hom.normalizationCoprodIso]
    rw [coprod.inr_desc]
    rfl
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    have hw : w ∈ Set.range i.left ∪ Set.range j.left := by
      rw [show Set.range i.left ∪ Set.range j.left = Set.univ from
        hcomponents.sup_eq_top]
      exact Set.mem_univ w
    rcases hw with hw | ⟨w', rfl⟩
    · exact hw
    · exfalso
      have hjp := congrArg (fun q : Z'.left ⟶ f.normalization => q w')
        (toNormalization_normalizationComponentInclusion f j)
      simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at hjp
      have hij := hz.trans hjp.symm
      rw [hi, hj] at hij
      change e.hom ((coprod.inl : (i.left ≫ f).normalization ⟶
          (i.left ≫ f).normalization ⨿ (j.left ≫ f).normalization) z) =
        e.hom ((coprod.inr : (j.left ≫ f).normalization ⟶
          (i.left ≫ f).normalization ⨿ (j.left ≫ f).normalization)
            ((j.left ≫ f).toNormalization w')) at hij
      exact AlgebraicGeometry.inl_ne_inr _ _ z ((j.left ≫ f).toNormalization w')
        (e.hom.isOpenEmbedding.injective hij)
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(i.left ≫ f).toNormalization z, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun q : Z.left ⟶ f.normalization => q z)
      (toNormalization_normalizationComponentInclusion f i)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.range_comp_subset_of_fixes_normalized_component_geometricPoint
statement:
theorem range_comp_subset_of_fixes_normalized_component_geometricPoint
    (f : W.left ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (i : Z ⟶ W) [Mono i] [IsIntegral Z.left]
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega]
    (z : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ (i.left ≫ f).normalization)
    (sigma : W.left ⟶ W.left) (hsigma : sigma ≫ f = f)
    (hfix : z ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i ≫
        normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma =
      z ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i) :
    Set.range (i.left ≫ sigma) ⊆ Set.range i.left
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized :=
    normalizationComponentInclusion_range_comp_subset_of_fixes_geometricPoint
      f i z sigma hsigma hfix
  have hmap :
      (i.left ≫ f).toNormalization ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i ≫
          normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma =
        i.left ≫ sigma ≫ f.toNormalization := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, toNormalization_normalizationComponentInclusion,
      Category.assoc, toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism]
  rintro w ⟨a, rfl⟩
  rw [← preimage_normalizationComponentInclusion_range f i]
  change f.toNormalization ((i.left ≫ sigma) a) ∈
    Set.range (normalizationComponentInclusion f i)
  have h := hnormalized ⟨(i.left ≫ f).toNormalization a, rfl⟩
  have heval := congrArg (fun q : Z.left ⟶ f.normalization => q a) hmap
  exact heval ▸ h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_aut_component_lift_of_preserves_range
statement:
theorem exists_aut_component_lift_of_preserves_range
    (i : Z ⟶ W) [Mono i] [IsConnected Z]
    (sigma : Aut W)
    (hpreserve : Set.range (i.left ≫ sigma.hom.left) ⊆ Set.range i.left) :
    ∃ tau : Aut Z, tau.hom ≫ i = i ≫ sigma.hom
proof:
:= by
  let : IsOpenImmersion i.left := (FiniteEtale.mono_iff U Z W i).mp inferInstance |>.1
  let l : Z.left ⟶ Z.left :=
    IsOpenImmersion.lift i.left (i.left ≫ sigma.hom.left) hpreserve
  have hl : l ≫ i.left = i.left ≫ sigma.hom.left :=
    IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac i.left (i.left ≫ sigma.hom.left) hpreserve
  have hiw : i.left ≫ W.hom = Z.hom := i.w
  have hsigmaw : sigma.hom.left ≫ W.hom = W.hom := sigma.hom.w
  have hbase : l ≫ Z.hom = Z.hom := by
    calc
      l ≫ Z.hom = l ≫ i.left ≫ W.hom := by rw [hiw]
      _ = (i.left ≫ sigma.hom.left) ≫ W.hom := by rw [← Category.assoc, hl]
      _ = Z.hom := by rw [Category.assoc, hsigmaw, hiw]
  let t : Z ⟶ Z := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk l hbase
  have ht : t ≫ i = i ≫ sigma.hom :=
    MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext hl
  let : Mono t := by
    constructor
    intro T a b hab
    apply (cancel_mono i).mp
    have hsig : (a ≫ i) ≫ sigma.hom = (b ≫ i) ≫ sigma.hom := by
      calc
        (a ≫ i) ≫ sigma.hom = (a ≫ t) ≫ i := by
          rw [Category.assoc, ← ht, ← Category.assoc]
        _ = (b ≫ t) ≫ i := congrArg (fun q : T ⟶ Z => q ≫ i) hab
        _ = (b ≫ i) ≫ sigma.hom := by
          rw [Category.assoc, ht, ← Category.assoc]
    have hsigmaId : sigma.hom ≫ sigma.inv = 𝟙 W := sigma.hom_inv_id
    have hcancel := congrArg (fun q : T ⟶ W => q ≫ sigma.inv) hsig
    simpa only [Category.assoc, hsigmaId, Category.comp_id] using hcancel
  let : IsIso t := IsConnected.noTrivialComponent Z t (IsConnected.notInitial (X := Z))
  exact ⟨asIso t, ht⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationComponentInclusion_endomorphism
statement:
theorem normalizationComponentInclusion_endomorphism
    (f : W.left ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (i : Z ⟶ W)
    (sigma : W.left ⟶ W.left) (hsigma : sigma ≫ f = f)
    (tau : Z.left ⟶ Z.left) (htau : tau ≫ i.left = i.left ≫ sigma) :
    normalizationEndomorphism (i.left ≫ f) tau
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, htau, Category.assoc, hsigma]) ≫
      normalizationComponentInclusion f i =
    normalizationComponentInclusion f i ≫ normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Hom.normalization.hom_ext (i.left ≫ f)
    _ _ f.fromNormalization ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism_assoc,
      toNormalization_normalizationComponentInclusion_assoc,
      toNormalization_normalizationComponentInclusion,
      toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism]
    rw [← Category.assoc, htau, Category.assoc]
  · simp only [normalizationComponentInclusion, Category.assoc,
      Scheme.Hom.normalizationDesc_comp,
      normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization]
  · simp only [normalizationComponentInclusion, Category.assoc,
      normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization,
      Scheme.Hom.normalizationDesc_comp]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_aut_component_lift_of_fixes_normalized_geometricPoint
statement:
theorem exists_aut_component_lift_of_fixes_normalized_geometricPoint
    (f : W.left ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (i : Z ⟶ W) [Mono i] [IsConnected Z] [IsIntegral Z.left]
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega]
    (z : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ (i.left ≫ f).normalization)
    (sigma : Aut W) (hsigma : sigma.hom.left ≫ f = f)
    (hfix : z ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i ≫
        normalizationEndomorphism f sigma.hom.left hsigma =
      z ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i) :
    ∃ (tau : Aut Z) (htau : tau.hom ≫ i = i ≫ sigma.hom),
      z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism (i.left ≫ f) tau.hom.left (by
        have h := congrArg (fun q : Z ⟶ W => q.left) htau
        change tau.hom.left ≫ i.left = i.left ≫ sigma.hom.left at h
        rw [← Category.assoc, h, Category.assoc, hsigma]) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨tau, htau⟩ := exists_aut_component_lift_of_preserves_range i sigma
    (range_comp_subset_of_fixes_normalized_component_geometricPoint
      f i z sigma.hom.left hsigma hfix)
  refine ⟨tau, htau, ?_⟩
  have htauLeft : tau.hom.left ≫ i.left = i.left ≫ sigma.hom.left :=
    congrArg (fun q : Z ⟶ W => q.left) htau
  apply (cancel_mono (normalizationComponentInclusion f i)).mp
  rw [Category.assoc,
    normalizationComponentInclusion_endomorphism f i sigma.hom.left hsigma
      tau.hom.left htauLeft]
  exact hfix

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.fractionStalkPoint_mem_supportComplement
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.fractionStalkPoint_mem_supportComplement
    (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier) (x : X) [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    (y : Spec (.of (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)))) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)))) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x) y ∈
      I.supportComplement
proof:
:= by
  change X.fromSpecStalk x
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)))) y) ∉ I.support
  rw [I.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_iff_stalkIdeal_le]
  have hprime :
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)))) y).asIdeal = ⊥ := by
    have hy : y = (⊥ : PrimeSpectrum (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))) :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hy]
    change RingHom.ker
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))) = ⊥
    exact (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)))).mp
      (IsFractionRing.injective (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
  rw [hprime]
  intro hle
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hgen⟩ := hI.exists_regular_stalkIdeal_generator x
  have haI : a ∈ I.stalkIdeal x := by
    rw [hgen]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a
  exact ha.ne_zero (Ideal.mem_bot.mp (hle haI))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.etale_normalization_of_galoisComponents
statement:
theorem etale_normalization_of_galoisComponents
    {U V S : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace U] [ConnectedSpace V]
    (b : U ⟶ V) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (xi : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U) (W : FiniteEtale V) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (f : ((FiniteEtale.pullback b).obj W).left ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hcomponent : ∀ (w : (fiber (xi ≫ b)).obj W)
      (Z : FiniteEtale U) (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback b).obj W)
      (v : (fiber xi).obj Z),
      (fiber xi).map i v = transportedPointOfCompIso (FiniteEtale.pullback b)
        (pullbackFiberIso b xi) W w →
      IsGalois Z → Mono i → Etale (i.left ≫ f).fromNormalization) :
    Etale f.fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : ∀ x : f.normalization,
      ∃ (N : Scheme.{u}) (j : N ⟶ f.normalization),
        IsOpenImmersion j ∧ x ∈ Set.range j ∧ Etale (j ≫ f.fromNormalization) := by
    intro x
    let q := f.normalization.fromSpecResidueField x
    obtain ⟨Z, i, qZ, v, w, hi, hZ, hq, hv⟩ :=
      exists_galoisNormalizationComponent_geometricPoint b xi W hW f q
    let : Mono i := hi
    let j := normalizationComponentInclusion f i
    have hbase : j ≫ f.fromNormalization = (i.left ≫ f).fromNormalization :=
      Scheme.Hom.normalizationDesc_comp _ _ _ _
    refine ⟨(i.left ≫ f).normalization, j, inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
    · let t : Spec (f.normalization.residueField x) := Classical.choice inferInstance
      refine ⟨qZ t, ?_⟩
      exact (congrArg (fun k => k t) hq).trans
        (Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply x t)
    · rw [hbase]
      exact hcomponent w Z i v hv hZ hi
  choose N j hj hcover hEtale using hlocal
  let cover : f.normalization.OpenCover :=
    { I₀ := f.normalization
      X := N
      f := j
      mem₀ := by
        rw [Scheme.presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff]
        exact ⟨fun x => ⟨x, hcover x⟩, hj⟩ }
  exact IsZariskiLocalAtSource.of_openCover (P := @Etale) cover hEtale

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra_specMap
statement:
theorem affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra_specMap
    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    (f : R →+* S) :
    let : Algebra S (Spec (.of S)).functionField
proof:
:=
      AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of S)
    affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) =
      ((algebraMap S (Spec (.of S)).functionField).comp f).toAlgebra := by
  intro hSK
  apply Algebra.algebra_ext
  intro r
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : (Spec (.of S)).Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (Spec (.of S))), trivial⟩⟩
  change (Spec (.of S)).germToFunctionField ⊤
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)) =
    algebraMap S (Spec (.of S)).functionField (f r)
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) r
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv (f r) =
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r) at h
  rw [← h]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra_eq_affineMorphism
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra_eq_affineMorphism
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (f : R) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)))) [IsConnected Y] :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away f
    let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
    let : IsIntegrallyClosed S := isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S
      (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
    let : IsIntegral Y.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y =
      affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R
        ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) := by
  intro S hDomain hNormal hIntegral
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : (Spec (.of S)).Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (Spec (.of S))), trivial⟩⟩
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : Y.left.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Y.left), trivial⟩⟩
  apply Algebra.algebra_ext
  intro r
  change (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom).functionFieldMap
      (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y)
      ((Spec (.of S)).germToFunctionField ⊤
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv (algebraMap R S r))) =
    Y.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
      (((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).appTop
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r))
  have hGerm := DFunLike.congr_fun
    ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom).functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField_top
      (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y))
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv (algebraMap R S r))
  have hSections := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) r
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv (algebraMap R S r) =
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).appTop
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r) at hSections
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
  exact hGerm.trans (congrArg (fun a : Γ(Spec (.of S), ⊤) =>
    Y.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom).appTop a)) hSections)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_normalizationComponent_geometricPoint
statement:
theorem exists_normalizationComponent_geometricPoint
    (W : FiniteEtale U)
    (f : W.left ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega]
    (z : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ f.normalization) :
    ∃ (Z : FiniteEtale U) (i : Z ⟶ W)
      (q : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ (i.left ≫ f).normalization),
      Mono i ∧ IsConnected Z ∧ q ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, Z, i, hcol, hconnected, hfinite⟩ := has_decomp_connected_components W
  let : Finite ι := hfinite
  have hmono (j : ι) : Mono (i j) :=
    MonoCoprod.mono_inj _ (Cofan.mk W i) hcol j
  let F := (FiniteEtale.forget U ⋙ Over.forget U) ⋙ Scheme.forgetToTop
  have htop := isColimitOfPreserves F hcol
  have hcover (w : W.left) : ∃ (j : ι) (v : (Z j).left), (i j).left v = w := by
    obtain ⟨⟨j⟩, v, hv⟩ := Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep
      (Discrete.functor Z ⋙ F) htop w
    exact ⟨j, v, hv⟩
  let A : Set f.normalization := ⋃ j : ι, Set.range (normalizationComponentInclusion f (i j))
  have hclosed : IsClosed A := by
    apply isClosed_iUnion_of_finite
    intro j
    let : Mono (i j) := hmono j
    exact (isClopen_range_normalizationComponentInclusion f (i j)).1
  have hrange : Set.range f.toNormalization ⊆ A := by
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨j, v, rfl⟩ := hcover w
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨j, ((i j).left ≫ f).toNormalization v, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun k : (Z j).left ⟶ f.normalization => k v)
      (toNormalization_normalizationComponentInclusion f (i j))
  have hall : Set.univ ⊆ A := by
    rw [← f.toNormalization.denseRange.closure_range]
    exact closure_minimal hrange hclosed
  let omega : Spec (.of Omega) := Classical.choice inferInstance
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hall (Set.mem_univ (z omega)))
  let : Mono (i j) := hmono j
  have hzrange : Set.range z ⊆ Set.range (normalizationComponentInclusion f (i j)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    have ha : a = omega := Subsingleton.elim a omega
    rw [ha]
    exact hj
  let q := IsOpenImmersion.lift (normalizationComponentInclusion f (i j)) z hzrange
  exact ⟨Z j, i j, q, hmono j, hconnected j,
    IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (normalizationComponentInclusion f (i j)) z hzrange⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_galoisNormalizationComponent_geometricPoint
statement:
theorem exists_galoisNormalizationComponent_geometricPoint
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace Y]
    (b : U ⟶ Y) {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ U)
    (W : FiniteEtale Y) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (f : ((FiniteEtale.pullback b).obj W).left ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {Omega' : Type u} [Field Omega']
    (q : Spec (.of Omega') ⟶ f.normalization) :
    ∃ (Z : FiniteEtale U) (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback b).obj W)
      (qZ : Spec (.of Omega') ⟶ (i.left ≫ f).normalization)
      (z : (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).obj Z)
      (w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ b)).obj W),
      Mono i ∧ IsGalois Z ∧
        qZ ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i = q ∧
        (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).map i z =
          transportedPointOfCompIso (FiniteEtale.pullback b)
            (FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso b xi) W w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Z, i, qZ, hi, hZconnected, hqZ⟩ :=
    exists_normalizationComponent_geometricPoint ((FiniteEtale.pullback b).obj W) f q
  let : Mono i := hi
  let : IsConnected Z := hZconnected
  let F := FiniteEtale.fiber xi
  let z : F.obj Z := Classical.choice (nonempty_fiber_of_isConnected F Z)
  let w := (FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso b xi).hom.app W (F.map i z)
  have hiz : F.map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (FiniteEtale.pullback b)
        (FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso b xi) W w :=
    (FintypeCat.hom_inv_id_apply ((FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso b xi).app W)
      (F.map i z)).symm
  obtain ⟨Z', i', z', hiz', hZ', hi'⟩ :=
    FiniteEtale.exists_galoisComponent_pullback b xi W hW w
  let : IsGalois Z' := hZ'
  let : Mono i' := hi'
  obtain ⟨e, _he⟩ := connected_component_unique F z' z i' i (hiz'.trans hiz.symm)
  have hZGalois : IsGalois Z := by
    apply (isGalois_iff_pretransitive F Z).mpr
    constructor
    intro a c
    obtain ⟨sigma, hsigma⟩ := evaluation_aut_surjective_of_isGalois F Z'
      (F.map e.inv a) (F.map e.inv c)
    refine ⟨e.symm ≪≫ sigma ≪≫ e, ?_⟩
    change F.map ((e.inv ≫ sigma.hom) ≫ e.hom) a = c
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply]
    exact (congrArg (fun v : F.obj Z' => F.map e.hom v) hsigma).trans
      (FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply (F.mapIso e) c)
  exact ⟨Z, i, qZ, z, w, hi, hZGalois, hqZ, hiz⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotient_map_fundamentalGroupImage
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotient_map_fundamentalGroupImage
    {T U : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace U]
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
    (j : T ⟶ U) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ T)
    (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale U) (hY : IsGalois Y)
    (y : (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ j)).obj Y) :
    letI : IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    Subgroup.map
        (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom (xi ≫ j) Y hY y)
        (fundamentalGroupImageOfMorphism j xi) =
      (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism j xi Y hY y).range := by
  let : IsGalois Y := hY
  exact MonoidHom.map_range
    (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom (xi ≫ j) Y hY y)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom j xi).toMonoidHom

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism_ker
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism_ker
    {T U : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace U]
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
    (j : T ⟶ U) (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ T)
    (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale U) (hY : IsGalois Y)
    (y : (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ j)).obj Y) :
    letI : IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism j xi Y hY y).ker =
      MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)
        (transportedPointOfCompIso
          (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback j)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso j xi) Y y) := by
  let : IsGalois Y := hY
  let h :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.fundamentalGroupHom j xi).toMonoidHom
  let q := finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom (xi ≫ j) Y hY y
  calc
    (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism j xi Y hY y).ker =
        Subgroup.comap h q.ker := rfl
    _ = Subgroup.comap h (MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi ≫ j) y) := by
      rw [finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom_ker]
    _ = MulAction.stabilizer π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)
        (transportedPointOfCompIso
          (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback j)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso j xi) Y y) := by
      exact (stabilizer_transportedPointOfCompIso
        (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback j)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso j xi) Y y).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.integralClosureToFractionField_bijective
statement:
theorem integralClosureToFractionField_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R B L).mapIntegralClosure
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply IsFractionRing.injective B L
    exact congrArg (fun z : integralClosure R L => (z : L)) h
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.algebraMap_eq_of_integral
      (x.property.tower_top (A := B))
    have hb' : IsIntegral R (algebraMap B L b) := hb.symm ▸ x.property
    have hbInt : IsIntegral R b :=
      (isIntegral_algHom_iff (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R B L)
        (IsFractionRing.injective B L)).mp hb'
    exact ⟨⟨b, hbInt⟩, Subtype.ext hb⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv_mapIntegralClosure
statement:
theorem integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv_mapIntegralClosure
    (σ : B ≃ₐ[R] B) (b : integralClosure R B) :
    integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv R B L (σ.mapIntegralClosure b) =
      (IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv σ : L ≃ₐ[R] L).mapIntegralClosure
        (integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv R B L b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change algebraMap B L (σ (b : B)) =
    (IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv σ : L ≃ₐ[R] L)
      (algebraMap B L (b : B))
  exact (IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap σ (b : B)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.fractionField_toNormalization_affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem fractionField_toNormalization_affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B L)) ≫
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization ≫
        (affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso R B L).hom =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure R L).val.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B L)) ≫
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization ≫
    ((specNormalizationIso R B).hom ≫
      Spec.map (integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv R B L).toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.inv) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization,
    toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom,
    ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  exact congrArg (fun y : integralClosure R L => (y : L))
    ((integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv R B L).apply_symm_apply x)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso_hom_structureMap
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso_hom_structureMap :
    (affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso R B L).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L))) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  change ((specNormalizationIso R B).hom ≫
    Spec.map (integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv R B L).toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.inv) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L))) = _
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  have hcomp :
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)) ≫
        (integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv R B L).toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.inv =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R B)) := by
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro r
    exact (integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv R B L).symm.commutes r
  rw [hcomp, specNormalizationIso_hom_structureMap]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineNormalizationDeck_affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineNormalizationDeck_affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso
    (σ : B ≃ₐ[R] B) :
    affineNormalizationDeck R B σ ≫
        (affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso R B L).hom =
      (affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso R B L).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (((IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv σ :
            L ≃ₐ[R] L).toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure).toRingHom))
proof:
:= by
  let e := integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv R B L
  let τ : L ≃ₐ[R] L := IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv σ
  have hcomp :
      e.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.inv ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom ≫
        e.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.inv := by
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro x
    change σ.mapIntegralClosure (e.symm x) = e.symm (τ.mapIntegralClosure x)
    apply e.injective
    rw [integralClosureFractionFieldEquiv_mapIntegralClosure,
      AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change affineNormalizationDeck R B σ ≫
    ((specNormalizationIso R B).hom ≫ Spec.map e.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.inv) =
    ((specNormalizationIso R B).hom ≫ Spec.map e.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.inv) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom)
  rw [← Category.assoc, affineNormalizationDeck_specNormalizationIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, hcomp]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.integralClosure_etale_of_dvr_of_inertia_eq_bot
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_dvr_of_inertia_eq_bot
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra R L] [IsScalarTower R K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (hI : letI := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction R K L (integralClosure R L)
      ∀ (Q : Ideal (integralClosure R L)) [Q.IsPrime]
        [Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)], Q.inertia Gal(L/K) = ⊥) :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R L)
proof:
:= by
  let S := integralClosure R L
  let : Module.Finite R S := IsIntegralClosure.finite R K L S
  let : IsFractionRing S L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension R K L S
  let : MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) S := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction R K L S
  have : IsGaloisGroup Gal(L/K) R S := IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing Gal(L/K) R S K L
  have : Module.IsTorsionFree R L := Module.IsTorsionFree.trans_faithfulSMul R K L
  have : Module.IsTorsionFree R S := IsIntegralClosure.isTorsionFree R L
  apply etale_of_dvr_of_finite_torsionFree_of_isUnramifiedAt_all_maximalIdeals
  intro Q hQ
  have hUnder : (Q.under R).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R S)
      (fun x => Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) Q
  have : Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
    ⟨(IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hUnder).symm⟩
  exact isUnramifiedAt_of_inertia_eq_bot Gal(L/K) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) hI Q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_normalizationPoint_fixed_by_geometricStalk_finiteImage
statement:
theorem exists_normalizationPoint_fixed_by_geometricStalk_finiteImage
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    (x : X) [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (φ : X.presheaf.stalk x →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ]
    {Ξ : Type u} [Field Ξ] [IsSepClosed Ξ] :
    let S
proof:
:= geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
    let j := geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement D x φ
    ∀ (xi : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶ Spec (.of (FractionRing S)))
      (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
      (w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ j)).obj W),
    ∃ z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).normalization,
      z ≫ (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x ∧
      ∀ σ : (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ,
        σ ∈ (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism j xi W hW w).range →
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) σ.unop.hom.left
          (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) σ.unop.hom.w) = z := by
  intro S j xi W hW w
  let b : Spec (.of S) ⟶ X :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkStructureMap φ)) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x
  have hjb : j ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S (FractionRing S))) ≫ b := by
    exact (geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement_comp_ι D x φ).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k => k ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x)
        (Spec.map_comp (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkStructureMap φ))
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S (FractionRing S))))).trans
        (Category.assoc _ _ _))
  let ψ : S →+* Ω := (geometricStalkEvaluation (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).hom
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hfixed⟩ :=
    exists_normalizationPoint_fixed_by_strictHenselian_finiteImage S (FractionRing S)
      D.1.supportComplement.ι b j hjb ψ xi W hW w
  refine ⟨z, hz.trans ?_, hfixed⟩
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkStructureMap φ)) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun k => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x)
    (geometricStalkStructureMap_evaluation φ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineNormalizationDeck_specNormalizationIso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineNormalizationDeck_specNormalizationIso_hom
    (σ : B ≃ₐ[R] B) :
    affineNormalizationDeck R B σ ≫ (specNormalizationIso R B).hom =
      (specNormalizationIso R B).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  apply spec_toNormalization_hom_ext R B
  calc
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization ≫
        (affineNormalizationDeck R B σ ≫ (specNormalizationIso R B).hom) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom) ≫
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization) ≫
          (specNormalizationIso R B).hom := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, affineNormalizationDeck,
        Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationDesc]
    _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure R B).val.toRingHom) := by
      rw [Category.assoc, toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom]
    _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure R B).val.toRingHom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom) := by
      rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
      congr 1
    _ = (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization ≫
        ((specNormalizationIso R B).hom ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom)) := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_affineNormalizationGeometricPoint
statement:
theorem mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_affineNormalizationGeometricPoint
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω]
    (φ : integralClosure R B →+* Ω) (σ : B ≃ₐ[R] B) :
    letI : MulSemiringAction (B ≃ₐ[R] B) (integralClosure R B)
proof:
:=
      integralClosureAutAction R B
    σ ∈ (RingHom.ker φ).inertia (B ≃ₐ[R] B) ↔
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ (specNormalizationIso R B).inv) ≫
          affineNormalizationDeck R B σ =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ (specNormalizationIso R B).inv := by
  let : MulSemiringAction (B ≃ₐ[R] B) (integralClosure R B) :=
    integralClosureAutAction R B
  have haction : MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (B ≃ₐ[R] B)
      (integralClosure R B) σ = σ.toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro b
    rfl
  have hfix :
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ (specNormalizationIso R B).inv) ≫
          affineNormalizationDeck R B σ =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ (specNormalizationIso R B).inv) ↔
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (specNormalizationIso R B).hom]
    simp only [Category.assoc, affineNormalizationDeck_specNormalizationIso_hom,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hmem := mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_affineGeometricPoint
    (B ≃ₐ[R] B) φ σ
  rw [haction] at hmem
  exact hmem.trans hfix.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineNormalizationGeometricPointStabilizer_eq_idealInertia
statement:
theorem affineNormalizationGeometricPointStabilizer_eq_idealInertia
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] (φ : integralClosure R B →+* Ω) :
    letI : MulSemiringAction (B ≃ₐ[R] B) (integralClosure R B)
proof:
:=
      integralClosureAutAction R B
    affineNormalizationGeometricPointStabilizer R B φ =
      (RingHom.ker φ).inertia (B ≃ₐ[R] B) := by
  let : MulSemiringAction (B ≃ₐ[R] B) (integralClosure R B) :=
    integralClosureAutAction R B
  ext σ
  exact (mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_affineNormalizationGeometricPoint R B φ σ).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineNormalizationResidueGeometricPointStabilizer_eq_idealInertia
statement:
theorem affineNormalizationResidueGeometricPointStabilizer_eq_idealInertia
    (P : Ideal (integralClosure R B)) [P.IsPrime] :
    letI : MulSemiringAction (B ≃ₐ[R] B) (integralClosure R B)
proof:
:=
      integralClosureAutAction R B
    affineNormalizationGeometricPointStabilizer R B
        ((algebraMap P.ResidueField (AlgebraicClosure P.ResidueField)).comp
          (algebraMap (integralClosure R B) P.ResidueField)) =
      P.inertia (B ≃ₐ[R] B) := by
  let : MulSemiringAction (B ≃ₐ[R] B) (integralClosure R B) :=
    integralClosureAutAction R B
  rw [affineNormalizationGeometricPointStabilizer_eq_idealInertia,
    RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective (algebraMap (integralClosure R B) P.ResidueField)
      (algebraMap P.ResidueField (AlgebraicClosure P.ResidueField)).injective,
    Ideal.ker_algebraMap_residueField]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.toNormalization_normalizationComponentInclusion
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem toNormalization_normalizationComponentInclusion (i : Z ⟶ W) :
    (i.left ≫ f).toNormalization ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i =
      i.left ≫ f.toNormalization
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationDesc _ _ _ _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.isClopen_range_normalizationComponentInclusion
statement:
theorem isClopen_range_normalizationComponentInclusion
    (i : Z ⟶ W) [Mono i] :
    IsClopen (Set.range (normalizationComponentInclusion f i))
proof:
:=
