name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationComponentInclusion_range_comp_subset_of_fixed_point
statement:
theorem normalizationComponentInclusion_range_comp_subset_of_fixed_point
    (i : Z ⟶ W) [Mono i] [IsIntegral Z.left]
    (sigma : W.left ⟶ W.left) (hsigma : sigma ≫ f = f)
    (x : (i.left ≫ f).normalization)
    (hfix : normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma
      (normalizationComponentInclusion f i x) =
        normalizationComponentInclusion f i x) :
    Set.range (normalizationComponentInclusion f i ≫
      normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma) ⊆
        Set.range (normalizationComponentInclusion f i)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isPreconnected_range
    (normalizationComponentInclusion f i ≫
      normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma).continuous).subset_isClopen
      (isClopen_range_normalizationComponentInclusion f i)
  exact ⟨normalizationComponentInclusion f i x, ⟨x, hfix⟩, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationComponentInclusion_range_comp_subset_of_fixes_geometricPoint
statement:
theorem normalizationComponentInclusion_range_comp_subset_of_fixes_geometricPoint
    (i : Z ⟶ W) [Mono i] [IsIntegral Z.left]
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega]
    (z : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ (i.left ≫ f).normalization)
    (sigma : W.left ⟶ W.left) (hsigma : sigma ≫ f = f)
    (hfix : z ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i ≫
        normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma =
      z ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion f i) :
    Set.range (normalizationComponentInclusion f i ≫
      normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma) ⊆
        Set.range (normalizationComponentInclusion f i)
proof:
:= by
  let omega : Spec (.of Omega) := Classical.choice inferInstance
  apply normalizationComponentInclusion_range_comp_subset_of_fixed_point
    f i sigma hsigma (z omega)
  exact congrArg (fun g : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ f.normalization ↦ g omega) hfix

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.connected_of_connected_pullback
statement:
private theorem connected_of_connected_pullback
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace U] [ConnectedSpace X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (xi : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U) (V : FiniteEtale X)
    [IsConnected ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj V)] : IsConnected V
proof:
:= by
  let F := fiber (xi ≫ j)
  let F' := fiber xi
  let t := pullbackFiberIso j xi
  let : Nonempty (F.obj V) := ⟨(t.app V).hom
    (Classical.choice (nonempty_fiber_of_isConnected F' ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj V)))⟩
  let : MulAction.IsPretransitive (Aut F) (F.obj V) := ⟨by
    intro a b
    let a' : F'.obj ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj V) := (t.app V).inv a
    let b' : F'.obj ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj V) := (t.app V).inv b
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq (Aut F') a' b'
    refine ⟨fundamentalGroupHom j xi g, ?_⟩
    have h := (pullbackFiberIso_hom_fundamentalGroupHom_apply j xi g V
      ((t.app V).inv a)).symm.trans (congrArg (t.app V).hom hg)
    change (fundamentalGroupHom j xi g).hom.app V
      ((t.app V).hom ((t.app V).inv a)) = (t.app V).hom ((t.app V).inv b) at h
    change (fundamentalGroupHom j xi g).hom.app V a = b
    simpa only [FintypeCat.inv_hom_id_apply] using h⟩
  exact FiberFunctor.isConnected_of_isPretransitive F V

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.aut_eq_one_of_fixes_normalizationPoint_of_extension
statement:
theorem aut_eq_one_of_fixes_normalizationPoint_of_extension
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace U] [ConnectedSpace X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [QuasiCompact j] [QuasiSeparated j]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (xi : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ U)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (fundamentalGroupHom j xi))
    (W : FiniteEtale U) [IsConnected W]
    (V : FiniteEtale X) (e : (FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj V ≅ W)
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsSepClosed Ω']
    (z : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ ((show W.left ⟶ U from W.hom) ≫ j).normalization)
    (σ : Aut W)
    (hfix : z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism ((show W.left ⟶ U from W.hom) ≫ j)
      σ.hom.left (by rw [← Category.assoc]; exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ j) σ.hom.w) = z) :
    σ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let H := FiniteEtale.pullback j
  let : PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete PEmpty.{1}) H :=
    pullback_preservesLimitsOfShape_pempty j
  have hff : Nonempty H.FullyFaithful :=
    ((autHomOfCompIso_surjective_tfae (fiber (xi ≫ j)) (fiber xi) H
      (pullbackFiberIso j xi)).out 1 2).mp hsurj
  let ff : H.FullyFaithful := hff.some
  let eS : (H.obj V).left ≅ W.left :=
    ((FiniteEtale.forget U) ⋙ Over.forget U).mapIso e
  let : ConnectedSpace W.left := connectedSpace_left_of_isConnected W
  let : ConnectedSpace (H.obj V).left := eS.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance
  let : IsConnected (H.obj V) := isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left (H.obj V)
  let : IsConnected V := connected_of_connected_pullback j xi V
  let τ : Aut V := ff.preimageIso (e ≪≫ σ ≪≫ e.symm)
  have hτ : e.inv ≫ H.map τ.hom = σ.hom ≫ e.inv := by
    rw [show H.map τ.hom = (e ≪≫ σ ≪≫ e.symm).hom from ff.map_preimage _]
    change e.inv ≫ (e.hom ≫ σ.hom ≫ e.inv) = σ.hom ≫ e.inv
    exact e.inv_hom_id_assoc _
  let k : W.left ⟶ V.left := e.inv.left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom j
  have hk : k ≫ V.hom = (show W.left ⟶ U from W.hom) ≫ j := by
    have he : e.inv.left ≫ pullback.snd V.hom j = (show W.left ⟶ U from W.hom) := e.inv.w
    exact (Category.assoc e.inv.left (pullback.fst V.hom j) (show V.left ⟶ X from V.hom)).trans
      ((congrArg (fun t : (H.obj V).left ⟶ X => e.inv.left ≫ t)
        (pullback.condition (f := (show V.left ⟶ X from V.hom)) (g := j))).trans
        ((Category.assoc e.inv.left (pullback.snd V.hom j) j).symm.trans
          (congrArg (fun t : W.left ⟶ U => t ≫ j) he)))
  have hτk : σ.hom.left ≫ k = k ≫ τ.hom.left := by
    have he := congrArg (fun t : W ⟶ H.obj V => t.left) hτ
    change e.inv.left ≫ (H.map τ.hom).left = σ.hom.left ≫ e.inv.left at he
    have hp : (H.map τ.hom).left ≫ pullback.fst V.hom j =
        pullback.fst V.hom j ≫ τ.hom.left := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
    exact (Category.assoc σ.hom.left e.inv.left (pullback.fst V.hom j)).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun t : W.left ⟶ (H.obj V).left => t ≫ pullback.fst V.hom j) he.symm).trans
        ((Category.assoc e.inv.left (H.map τ.hom).left (pullback.fst V.hom j)).trans
          ((congrArg (fun t : (H.obj V).left ⟶ V.left => e.inv.left ≫ t) hp).trans
            (Category.assoc e.inv.left (pullback.fst V.hom j) τ.hom.left).symm)))
  let f : W.left ⟶ X := (show W.left ⟶ U from W.hom) ≫ j
  let c : f.normalization ⟶ V.left := f.normalizationDesc k V.hom hk.symm
  have hc : c ≫ V.hom = f.fromNormalization := Scheme.Hom.normalizationDesc_comp _ _ _ _
  have hσf : σ.hom.left ≫ f = f := by
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    exact congrArg (fun t => t ≫ j) σ.hom.w
  have hcomm : normalizationEndomorphism f σ.hom.left hσf ≫ c = c ≫ τ.hom.left := by
    apply Scheme.Hom.normalization.hom_ext f _ _ V.hom
    · rw [← Category.assoc, toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism,
        Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationDesc,
        ← Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationDesc, hτk]
    · rw [Category.assoc, hc, normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization]
    · have ht : τ.hom.left ≫ (show V.left ⟶ X from V.hom) = V.hom := τ.hom.w
      rw [Category.assoc, ht, hc]
  have hzc : (z ≫ c) ≫ τ.hom.left = z ≫ c := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hcomm, ← Category.assoc, hfix]
  let η : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ X := (z ≫ c) ≫ V.hom
  let v : Over.mk η ⟶ V.toComma := Over.homMk (z ≫ c) rfl
  have hτone : τ = 1 := by
    apply evaluation_aut_injective_of_isConnected (fiber η) V
      ((fiberObjEquivHom η V).symm v)
    change (fiber η).map τ.hom ((fiberObjEquivHom η V).symm v) =
      (fiber η).map (𝟙 V) ((fiberObjEquivHom η V).symm v)
    rw [fiberObjEquivHom_symm_naturality, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    change (fiberObjEquivHom η V).symm (v ≫ τ.hom.hom) = (fiberObjEquivHom η V).symm v
    apply congrArg (fiberObjEquivHom η V).symm
    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext hzc
  have hσe : σ.hom ≫ e.inv = e.inv := by
    rw [← hτ, hτone]
    change e.inv ≫ H.map (𝟙 V) = e.inv
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
  apply Aut.ext
  apply (cancel_mono e.inv).mp
  exact hσe.trans (Category.id_comp e.inv).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationPullback_endomorphism
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem normalizationPullback_endomorphism
    (σ : X ⟶ X) (hσ : σ ≫ f = f) :
    normalizationEndomorphism (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullbackEndomorphism f g σ hσ)
        (pullbackEndomorphism_snd f g σ hσ) ≫
      f.normalizationPullback g =
    f.normalizationPullback g ≫
      pullbackEndomorphism f.fromNormalization g
        (normalizationEndomorphism f σ hσ)
        (normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization f σ hσ)
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Hom.normalization.hom_ext (pullback.snd f g)
    _ _ (pullback.snd f.fromNormalization g) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · apply pullback.hom_ext
    · simp only [Category.assoc, toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism_assoc,
        toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism, pullbackEndomorphism_fst,
        pullbackEndomorphism_fst_assoc,
        Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationPullback_fst,
        Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationPullback_fst_assoc]
    · simp only [Category.assoc, pullbackEndomorphism_snd,
        Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd,
        normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization,
        Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_fromNormalization]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd,
      normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, pullbackEndomorphism_snd,
      Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationPullback_conjugates_endomorphism
statement:
theorem normalizationPullback_conjugates_endomorphism [IsIso (f.normalizationPullback g)]
    (σ : X ⟶ X) (hσ : σ ≫ f = f) :
    normalizationEndomorphism (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullbackEndomorphism f g σ hσ)
        (pullbackEndomorphism_snd f g σ hσ) =
      f.normalizationPullback g ≫
        pullbackEndomorphism f.fromNormalization g
          (normalizationEndomorphism f σ hσ)
          (normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization f σ hσ) ≫
        inv (f.normalizationPullback g)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (f.normalizationPullback g)).mp
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact normalizationPullback_endomorphism f g σ hσ

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationPullback_fixes_point_iff
statement:
theorem normalizationPullback_fixes_point_iff [IsIso (f.normalizationPullback g)]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (z : T ⟶ f.normalization) (y : T ⟶ Y)
    (hzy : z ≫ f.fromNormalization = y ≫ g)
    (σ : X ⟶ X) (hσ : σ ≫ f = f) :
    (pullback.lift z y hzy ≫ inv (f.normalizationPullback g)) ≫
        normalizationEndomorphism (pullback.snd f g)
          (pullbackEndomorphism f g σ hσ)
          (pullbackEndomorphism_snd f g σ hσ) =
      pullback.lift z y hzy ≫ inv (f.normalizationPullback g) ↔
    z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism f σ hσ = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (f.normalizationPullback g)]
  simp only [Category.assoc, normalizationPullback_endomorphism,
    IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hfst := congrArg
      (fun k ↦ k ≫ pullback.fst f.fromNormalization g) h
    simpa only [Category.assoc, pullbackEndomorphism_fst,
      pullback.lift_fst_assoc, pullback.lift_fst] using hfst
  · intro h
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · simp only [Category.assoc, pullbackEndomorphism_fst,
        pullback.lift_fst_assoc, pullback.lift_fst, h]
    · simp only [Category.assoc, pullbackEndomorphism_snd, pullback.lift_snd]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.image_le_ker_of_trivial_factorization
statement:
private theorem image_le_ker_of_trivial_factorization
    {T U S X : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : T ⟶ U) (i : U ⟶ X) (q : T ⟶ S) (b : S ⟶ X)
    (h : j ≫ i = q ≫ b)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ T) [Subsingleton π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ q)] :
    fundamentalGroupImageOfMorphism j point ≤
      (fundamentalGroupHom i (point ≫ j)).toMonoidHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
  change fundamentalGroupHom i (point ≫ j) (fundamentalGroupHom j point a) = 1
  have heta : (point ≫ q) ≫ b = (point ≫ j) ≫ i := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← h, ← Category.assoc]
  have he := fundamentalGroupHom_comp_conj_of_common_composite
    j i q b (j ≫ i) rfl h point ((point ≫ j) ≫ i) rfl heta a
  have hlocal : fundamentalGroupHom q point a = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hone {v w : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X} (e : v = w) :
      e ▸ (1 : π₁ᵉᵗ(v)) = (1 : π₁ᵉᵗ(w)) := by
    cases e
    rfl
  simpa only [hlocal, map_one, hone] using he

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.geometricStalkFractionField_image_le_boundaryKernel
statement:
theorem geometricStalkFractionField_image_le_boundaryKernel
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (x : X)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)] [IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (φ : X.presheaf.stalk x →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ]
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsSepClosed Ω']
    (point : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶
      Spec (.of (FractionRing (StrictHenselian.geometricStalk
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))))) :
    fundamentalGroupImageOfMorphism
        (StrictHenselian.geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement D x φ) point ≤
      (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι
        (point ≫ StrictHenselian.geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement D x φ)).toMonoidHom.ker
proof:
:=
    by
  let S := StrictHenselian.geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
  let j := StrictHenselian.geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement D x φ
  let q : Spec (.of (FractionRing S)) ⟶ Spec S :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S (FractionRing S)))
  let b : Spec S ⟶ X :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (StrictHenselian.geometricStalkStructureMap φ)) ≫
      X.fromSpecStalk x
  let : Subsingleton π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ q) :=
    StrictHenselian.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_geometricStalk
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) (point ≫ q)
  apply image_le_ker_of_trivial_factorization j D.1.supportComplement.ι q b _ point
  have hcomp := Spec.map_comp
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (StrictHenselian.geometricStalkStructureMap φ))
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S (FractionRing S)))
  exact (StrictHenselian.geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement_comp_ι D x φ).trans
    ((congrArg (fun k : Spec (.of (FractionRing S)) ⟶ Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) =>
      k ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x) hcomp).trans (Category.assoc _ _ _))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.isoSpec_affineMorphismAlgebra
statement:
theorem isoSpec_affineMorphismAlgebra (f : A ⟶ Spec (.of R)) :
    let : Algebra R Γ(A, ⊤)
proof:
:= affineMorphismAlgebra R f
    A.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(A, ⊤))) = f := by

  change A.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.appTop) = f
  rw [Spec.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality,

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineMorphismNormalizationIso_fixes_iff
statement:
theorem affineMorphismNormalizationIso_fixes_iff
    (f : A ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (sigma : A ≅ A) (hsigma : sigma.hom ≫ f = f)
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (z : T ⟶ f.normalization) :
    let : Algebra R Γ(A, ⊤)
proof:
:= affineMorphismAlgebra R f
    (z ≫ (affineMorphismNormalizationIso R f).hom) ≫
        affineNormalizationDeck R Γ(A, ⊤) (affineMorphismAlgEquiv R f sigma hsigma) =
      z ≫ (affineMorphismNormalizationIso R f).hom ↔
    z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism f sigma.hom hsigma = z := by
  intro hAlgebra
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(A, ⊤)))
  let tau := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    (affineMorphismAlgEquiv R f sigma hsigma).toRingHom)
  have htau : tau ≫ g = g := by
    dsimp only [tau, g]
    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    apply congrArg Spec.map
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro r
    exact (affineMorphismAlgEquiv R f sigma hsigma).commutes r
  have hcommute : sigma.hom ≫ A.isoSpec.hom = A.isoSpec.hom ≫ tau := by
    change sigma.hom ≫ A.isoSpec.hom = A.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map sigma.hom.appTop
    exact (Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality sigma.hom).symm
  exact normalizationSourceIso_fixes_iff f g A.isoSpec
    (isoSpec_affineMorphismAlgebra R f) z sigma.hom hsigma tau htau hcommute

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationSourceIso_hom_endomorphism
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem normalizationSourceIso_hom_endomorphism
    (sigma : A ⟶ A) (hsigma : sigma ≫ f = f)
    (tau : B ⟶ B) (htau : tau ≫ g = g)
    (hcommute : sigma ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ tau) :
    normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma ≫ (normalizationSourceIso f g e he).hom =
      (normalizationSourceIso f g e he).hom ≫ normalizationEndomorphism g tau htau
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Hom.normalization.hom_ext f _ _ g.fromNormalization ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism_assoc,
      toNormalization_normalizationSourceIso_hom_assoc,
      toNormalization_normalizationSourceIso_hom,
      toNormalization_normalizationEndomorphism]
    rw [← Category.assoc, hcommute, Category.assoc]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization,
      normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization,
      normalizationEndomorphism_fromNormalization]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.normalizationSourceIso_fixes_iff
statement:
theorem normalizationSourceIso_fixes_iff
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (z : T ⟶ f.normalization)
    (sigma : A ⟶ A) (hsigma : sigma ≫ f = f)
    (tau : B ⟶ B) (htau : tau ≫ g = g)
    (hcommute : sigma ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ tau) :
    (z ≫ (normalizationSourceIso f g e he).hom) ≫ normalizationEndomorphism g tau htau =
        z ≫ (normalizationSourceIso f g e he).hom ↔
      z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism f sigma hsigma = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (normalizationSourceIso f g e he).hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, normalizationSourceIso_hom_endomorphism f g e he
    sigma hsigma tau htau hcommute]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq_functionFieldMap
    (f : A ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (sigma : A ≅ A)
    (hsigma : sigma.hom ≫ f = f) :
    let : Algebra R A.functionField
proof:
:= affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R f
    (affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv R f sigma hsigma).toRingHom =
      sigma.hom.functionFieldMap sigma.hom.surjective.denseRange := by
  intro hRL
  let : Algebra R Γ(A, ⊤) := affineMorphismAlgebra R f
  let : Algebra Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField := topSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra A
  have : IsScalarTower R Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : A.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty A), trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsFractionRing Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen A ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top A)
  apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := Γ(A, ⊤))
  intro a
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (sigma.hom.functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField_top
    sigma.hom.surjective.denseRange) a
  exact (IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap
    (K := A.functionField) (L := A.functionField)
    (affineMorphismAlgEquiv R f sigma hsigma) a).trans h.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_hom_base
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_hom_base
    (f : A ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] :
    let : Algebra R A.functionField
proof:
:= affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R f
    (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R f).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R A.functionField))) =
      f.fromNormalization := by
  intro hRL
  let : Algebra R Γ(A, ⊤) := affineMorphismAlgebra R f
  let : Algebra Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField := topSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra A
  have : IsScalarTower R Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : A.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty A), trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsFractionRing Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen A ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top A)
  have : IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(A, ⊤) :=
    IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top A)
  dsimp only [affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso, Iso.trans_hom]
  rw [Category.assoc, affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso_hom_structureMap]
  exact normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization f
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(A, ⊤)))) A.isoSpec
    (isoSpec_affineMorphismAlgebra R f)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_fixes_iff
statement:
theorem affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_fixes_iff
    (f : A ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (sigma : A ≅ A) (hsigma : sigma.hom ≫ f = f)
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (z : T ⟶ f.normalization) :
    let : Algebra R A.functionField
proof:
:= affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R f
    (z ≫ (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R f).hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv R f sigma
            hsigma).toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom) =
      z ≫ (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R f).hom ↔
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism f sigma.hom hsigma = z := by
  intro hRL
  let : Algebra R Γ(A, ⊤) := affineMorphismAlgebra R f
  let : Algebra Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField := topSectionFunctionFieldAlgebra A
  have : IsScalarTower R Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : A.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty A), trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsFractionRing Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen A ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top A)
  have : IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(A, ⊤) :=
    IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top A)
  let zB := z ≫ (affineMorphismNormalizationIso R f).hom
  have hCoordinate := affineMorphismNormalizationIso_fixes_iff R f sigma hsigma z
  have hField :
      (zB ≫ (affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso R Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField).hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv R f sigma
              hsigma).toAlgHom.mapIntegralClosure.toRingHom) =
        zB ≫ (affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso R Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField).hom ↔
      zB ≫ affineNormalizationDeck R Γ(A, ⊤)
          (affineMorphismAlgEquiv R f sigma hsigma) = zB := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso R Γ(A, ⊤) A.functionField).hom]
    simp only [Category.assoc, affineNormalizationDeck_affineNormalizationFunctionFieldIso,
      affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv]
  have h := hField.trans hCoordinate
  simpa only [affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    zB, Category.assoc] using h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_affineMorphismFunctionField_point_inertia_iff
statement:
theorem exists_affineMorphismFunctionField_point_inertia_iff
    (f : A ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] (z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ f.normalization) :
    let : Algebra R A.functionField
proof:
:= affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R f
    ∃ φ : integralClosure R A.functionField →+* Ω,
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) =
          z ≫ (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R f).hom ∧
        ∀ (sigma : A ≅ A) (hsigma : sigma.hom ≫ f = f),
          let : MulSemiringAction (A.functionField ≃ₐ[R] A.functionField)
              (integralClosure R A.functionField) :=
            integralClosureAutAction R A.functionField
          affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv R f sigma hsigma ∈
              (RingHom.ker φ).inertia (A.functionField ≃ₐ[R] A.functionField) ↔
            z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism f sigma.hom hsigma = z := by
  intro hRL
  let φ := (Spec.preimage
    (z ≫ (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R f).hom)).hom
  have hφ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) =
      z ≫ (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R f).hom :=
    Spec.map_preimage _
  refine ⟨φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  intro sigma hsigma hAction
  have h := mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_affineGeometricPoint
    (A.functionField ≃ₐ[R] A.functionField) φ
    (affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv R f sigma hsigma)
  rw [hφ] at h
  exact h.trans (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_fixes_iff
    R f sigma hsigma z)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_affineGeometricPoint
statement:
theorem mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_affineGeometricPoint
    (G : Type v) [Group G]
    {B Ω : Type u} [CommRing B] [Field Ω] [MulSemiringAction G B]
    (φ : B →+* Ω) (σ : G) :
    σ ∈ (RingHom.ker φ).inertia G ↔
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G B σ)) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_inj]
  constructor
  · intro hσ
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro b
    exact (RingHom.sub_mem_ker_iff φ).mp (Ideal.mem_inertia.mp hσ b)
  · intro hσ
    apply Ideal.mem_inertia.mpr
    intro b
    apply (RingHom.sub_mem_ker_iff φ).mpr
    exact RingHom.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hσ) b

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_residueGeometricPoint
statement:
theorem mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_residueGeometricPoint
    (G : Type v) [Group G]
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [MulSemiringAction G B]
    (P : Ideal B) [P.IsPrime] (σ : G) :
    σ ∈ P.inertia G ↔
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((algebraMap P.ResidueField (AlgebraicClosure P.ResidueField)).comp
          (algebraMap B P.ResidueField))) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom G B σ)) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          ((algebraMap P.ResidueField (AlgebraicClosure P.ResidueField)).comp
            (algebraMap B P.ResidueField)))
proof:
:= by
  have hker :
      RingHom.ker
          ((algebraMap P.ResidueField (AlgebraicClosure P.ResidueField)).comp
            (algebraMap B P.ResidueField)) = P := by
    rw [RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective (algebraMap B P.ResidueField)
      (algebraMap P.ResidueField (AlgebraicClosure P.ResidueField)).injective,
      Ideal.ker_algebraMap_residueField]
  simpa only [hker] using
    (mem_idealInertia_iff_fixes_affineGeometricPoint G
      ((algebraMap P.ResidueField (AlgebraicClosure P.ResidueField)).comp
        (algebraMap B P.ResidueField)) σ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.fromSpec_appLE_self
statement:
private theorem fromSpec_appLE_self
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (h : (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) ≤ hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    hU.fromSpec.appLE U ⊤ h = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, hU.fromSpec_app_self, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  have heq : (eqToHom hU.fromSpec_preimage_self).op ≫ (homOfLE h).op =
      𝟙 (Opposite.op (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens)) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [heq, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.isIso_normalizationPullback_fromAffineLocalization
statement:
theorem isIso_normalizationPullback_fromAffineLocalization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {U : Y.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (S : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra Γ(Y, U) S]
    (M : Submonoid Γ(Y, U)) [IsLocalization M S] :
    IsIso (f.normalizationPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) S)) ≫ hU.fromSpec))
proof:
:= by
  let a : Γ(Y, U) ⟶ S := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) S)
  let l : Spec S ⟶ Spec Γ(Y, U) := Spec.map a
  let g : Spec S ⟶ Y := l ≫ hU.fromSpec
  have hlFlat : Flat l := by
    apply Flat.of_stalkMap
    intro x
    have : IsIso (l.stalkMap x) := isIso_stalkMap_SpecMap_of_isLocalization M x
    exact RingHom.Flat.of_bijective (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (l.stalkMap x))
  have hgFlat : Flat g := inferInstance
  have hTU : (⊤ : (Spec S).Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hU.fromSpec_preimage_self, Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
  have hR : (⊤ : (Spec Γ(Y, U)).Opens) ≤ hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    rw [hU.fromSpec_preimage_self]
  have hMap : g.appLE U ⊤ hTU = a ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).inv := by
    calc
      g.appLE U ⊤ hTU =
          hU.fromSpec.appLE U ⊤ hR ≫ l.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top :=
        (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE l hU.fromSpec U ⊤ ⊤ hR le_top).symm
      _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, U)).inv ≫ l.appTop := by
        rw [fromSpec_appLE_self hU hR]
        exact congrArg (fun k => (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, U)).inv ≫ k)
          l.app_eq_appLE.symm
      _ = a ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).inv := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality a).symm
  let : Algebra Γ(Y, U) Γ(Spec S, ⊤) := (g.appLE U ⊤ hTU).hom.toAlgebra
  let e : Γ(Spec S, ⊤) ≃ₐ[Γ(Y, U)] S :=
    { toRingEquiv := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro r
        have hcomp : g.appLE U ⊤ hTU ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).hom = a := by
          rw [hMap, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
        exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hcomp r }
  have hLoc : IsLocalization M Γ(Spec S, ⊤) :=
    (IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_algEquiv M e).mpr inferInstance
  exact isIso_normalizationPullback_of_affineLocalizationSections f g hU hTU M hLoc

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalk
statement:
theorem isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalk
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (y : Y) : IsIso (f.normalizationPullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y))
proof:
:= by
  let U := (Y.affineCover.f (Y.affineCover.idx y)).opensRange
  let hU : IsAffineOpen U := isAffineOpen_opensRange _
  let hy : y ∈ U := Y.affineCover.covers y
  let : Algebra Γ(Y, U) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    (Y.presheaf.germ U y hy).hom.toAlgebra
  have hLoc : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hy⟩).asIdeal :=
    hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨y, hy⟩
  rw [← hU.fromSpecStalk_eq_fromSpecStalk hy]
  exact isIso_normalizationPullback_fromAffineLocalization f hU
    (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hy⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalkLocalization
statement:
theorem isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalkLocalization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (y : Y) (P : Ideal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) [P.IsPrime] :
    IsIso (f.normalizationPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
        (Localization.AtPrime P))) ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk y))
proof:
:= by
  let U := (Y.affineCover.f (Y.affineCover.idx y)).opensRange
  let hU : IsAffineOpen U := isAffineOpen_opensRange _
  let hy : y ∈ U := Y.affineCover.covers y
  let : Algebra Γ(Y, U) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    (Y.presheaf.germ U y hy).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra Γ(Y, U) (Localization.AtPrime P) :=
    ((algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (Localization.AtPrime P)).comp
      (Y.presheaf.germ U y hy).hom).toAlgebra
  have : @IsScalarTower Γ(Y, U) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (Localization.AtPrime P)
      (@Algebra.toSMul Γ(Y, U) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) _ _ inferInstance)
      (@Algebra.toSMul (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (Localization.AtPrime P) _ _ inferInstance)
      (@Algebra.toSMul Γ(Y, U) (Localization.AtPrime P) _ _ inferInstance) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (R := Γ(Y, U)) (S := Y.presheaf.stalk y)
      (A := Localization.AtPrime P) rfl
  have hA : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hy⟩).asIdeal :=
    hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hLoc : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.AtPrime P)
      (P.comap (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) (Y.presheaf.stalk y))) :=
    IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hy⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P) P
  have hMap : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) (Localization.AtPrime P))) ≫ hU.fromSpec =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
        (Localization.AtPrime P))) ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk y := by
    rw [← hU.fromSpecStalk_eq_fromSpecStalk hy, IsAffineOpen.fromSpecStalk,
      ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [← hMap]
  exact isIso_normalizationPullback_fromAffineLocalization f hU
    (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime P))
    (P.comap (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) (Y.presheaf.stalk y))).primeCompl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_eq_of_equivariant
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_eq_of_equivariant
    (tau : Aut Z) (sigma : Aut W)
    (htau : tau.hom ≫ i = i ≫ (pullback f).map sigma.hom) :
    galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
        f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi (MulOpposite.op tau) =
      MulOpposite.op sigma
proof:
:= by
  let : Mono i := hi
  have hmem : (fiber xi).map ((pullback f).map sigma.hom)
      ((fiber xi).map i z) ∈ Set.range ((fiber xi).map i) := by
    refine ⟨(fiber xi).map tau.hom z, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun k : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj W => (fiber xi).map k z) htau
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp, FintypeCat.comp_apply] using h
  obtain ⟨tau', hphi, hequiv⟩ :=
    galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_exists_lift_of_mem_range
      f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi (MulOpposite.op sigma) hmem
  have heq : tau'.unop = tau := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact (cancel_mono i).mp (hequiv.trans htau.symm)
  have heqOp : tau' = MulOpposite.op tau :=
    MulOpposite.unop_injective heq
  exact (congrArg
    (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi)
    heqOp).symm.trans hphi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_exists_normalized_fixed_lift
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_exists_normalized_fixed_lift
    (g : ((pullback f).obj W).left ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g]
    [IsIntegral Z.left]
    {Omega' : Type u} [Field Omega']
    (q : Spec (.of Omega') ⟶ (i.left ≫ g).normalization)
    (sigma : Aut W)
    (hsigma : ((pullback f).map sigma.hom).left ≫ g = g)
    (hfix : q ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion g i ≫
        normalizationEndomorphism g ((pullback f).map sigma.hom).left hsigma =
      q ≫ normalizationComponentInclusion g i) :
    ∃ (tau : Aut Z)
      (htau : tau.hom ≫ i = i ≫ (pullback f).map sigma.hom),
      galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
          f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi (MulOpposite.op tau) =
        MulOpposite.op sigma ∧
      q ≫ normalizationEndomorphism (i.left ≫ g) tau.hom.left (by
        have h := congrArg (fun k : Z ⟶ (pullback f).obj W => k.left) htau
        change tau.hom.left ≫ i.left =
          i.left ≫ ((pullback f).map sigma.hom).left at h
        rw [← Category.assoc, h, Category.assoc, hsigma]) = q
proof:
:= by
  let : Mono i := hi
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  obtain ⟨tau, htau, hfixed⟩ :=
    exists_aut_component_lift_of_fixes_normalized_geometricPoint
      g i q ((pullback f).mapIso sigma) hsigma hfix
  exact ⟨tau, htau,
    galoisPullbackComponentQuotient_eq_of_equivariant
      f xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi tau sigma htau,
    hfixed⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_fractionStalk_normalizationPoint
statement:
theorem exists_fractionStalk_normalizationPoint
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ I.support)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)] [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    (W : FiniteEtale I.supportComplement)
    (z : T ⟶ ((show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) ≫
      I.supportComplement.ι).normalization)
    (y : T ⟶ Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (_hzy : z ≫ ((show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) ≫
      I.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization = y ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x) :
    let c
proof:
:= hI.fractionStalkToSupportComplement x
    let A := (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W
    let a := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))))
    let g : A.left ⟶ Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      (show A.left ⟶ Spec (.of (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))) from A.hom) ≫ a
    ∃ q : T ⟶ g.normalization,
      q ≫ g.fromNormalization = y ∧
      ∀ σ : Aut W,
        q ≫ normalizationEndomorphism g ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).left
          (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) (((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).w)) = q ↔
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism
          ((show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) ≫ I.supportComplement.ι)
          σ.hom.left (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ I.supportComplement.ι) σ.hom.w) = z := by
  intro c A a g
  let F : W.left ⟶ X :=
    (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) ≫ I.supportComplement.ι
  let b := X.fromSpecStalk x
  let F₁ := pullback.snd F b
  have : IsIso (F.normalizationPullback b) :=
    isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalk F x
  have Hcover : IsPullback
      (pullback.fst (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) c)
      g F b :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback
      (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) c).paste_vert
      (hI.isPullback_fractionStalkToSupportComplement x hx)
  have H₁ : IsPullback (pullback.fst F b) F₁ F b := IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b
  let e : pullback F b ≅ A.left := H₁.isoIsPullback _ _ Hcover
  have he : e.hom ≫ g = F₁ :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd W.left (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)) H₁ Hcover
  let q₀ : T ⟶ F₁.normalization :=
    pullback.lift z y _hzy ≫ inv (F.normalizationPullback b)
  have hq₀ : q₀ ≫ F₁.fromNormalization = y := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd F b]
    simp only [q₀, Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    exact pullback.lift_snd z y _hzy
  let E : F₁.normalization ≅ g.normalization := normalizationSourceIso F₁ g e he
  refine ⟨q₀ ≫ E.hom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Category.assoc q₀ E.hom g.fromNormalization).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k : F₁.normalization ⟶ Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) => q₀ ≫ k)
        (normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization F₁ g e he)).trans hq₀)
  · intro σ
    have hσ : σ.hom.left ≫ F = F := by
      dsimp only [F]
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ I.supportComplement.ι) σ.hom.w
    let τ₁ := pullbackEndomorphism F b σ.hom.left hσ
    have hτ₁ : τ₁ ≫ F₁ = F₁ := pullbackEndomorphism_snd F b σ.hom.left hσ
    let τ := ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).left
    have hτ : τ ≫ g = g := by
      dsimp only [g]
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) (((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).w)
    have hτfst : τ ≫
        pullback.fst (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) c =
        pullback.fst (show W.left ⟶ I.supportComplement.toScheme from W.hom) c ≫
          σ.hom.left := by
      change pullback.lift _ _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = _
      exact pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
    have hcommute : τ₁ ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ τ :=
      pullbackSquare_iso_intertwines H₁ Hcover τ₁ τ σ.hom.left
        (pullbackEndomorphism_fst F b σ.hom.left hσ) hτ₁ hτfst hτ
    exact (normalizationSourceIso_fixes_iff F₁ g e he q₀ τ₁ hτ₁ τ hτ hcommute).trans
      (normalizationPullback_fixes_point_iff F b z y _hzy σ.hom.left hσ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtale_normalization_stalk_of_mem_open
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_normalization_stalk_of_mem_open
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) [QuasiCompact U.ι]
    (W : FiniteEtale U) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization (X.fromSpecStalk x))
proof:
:= by
  let c := U.fromSpecStalkOfMem x hx
  let b := X.fromSpecStalk x
  let F := W.hom ≫ U.ι
  let g := pullback.snd W.hom c
  have Hc : IsPullback c (𝟙 _) U.ι b :=
    IsPullback.of_vert_isIso_mono ⟨by
      rw [Category.id_comp]
      exact U.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι x hx⟩
  have H : IsPullback (pullback.fst W.hom c) g F b := by
    simpa only [Category.comp_id] using (IsPullback.of_hasPullback W.hom c).paste_vert Hc
  let e := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b).isoIsPullback _ _ H
  have he : e.hom ≫ g = pullback.snd F b :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd W.left (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b) H
  let : IsFinite (pullback.snd F b) := by
    rw [← he]
    infer_instance
  let : Etale (pullback.snd F b) := by
    rw [← he]
    infer_instance
  let f := pullback.snd F b
  have hf : f.fromNormalization = inv f.toNormalization ≫ f := by
    exact (IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc f.toNormalization f.fromNormalization).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun k => inv f.toNormalization ≫ k)
        (Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_fromNormalization f))
  let : IsFinite f.fromNormalization := by
    rw [hf]
    infer_instance
  let : Etale f.fromNormalization := by
    rw [hf]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIso (F.normalizationPullback b) := isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalk F x
  have hb : pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b =
      inv (F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ f.fromNormalization := by
    exact (IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc (F.normalizationPullback b)
      (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b)).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun k => inv (F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ k)
          (Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd F b))
  change IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b)
  rw [hb]
  exact ⟨⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.isIso_normalizationPullback_restrict_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem isIso_normalizationPullback_restrict_of_isLocalization
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : T ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [Flat g]
    {U : S.Opens} {V : T.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hVU : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (M : Submonoid Γ(S, U)) :
    let : Algebra Γ(S, U) Γ(T, V)
proof:
:= (g.appLE U V hVU).hom.toAlgebra
    IsLocalization M Γ(T, V) →
      IsIso (morphismRestrict (f.normalizationPullback g)
        (pullback.snd f.fromNormalization g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) := by
  intro hRT hLoc
  let W := pullback.snd f.fromNormalization g ⁻¹ᵁ V
  apply (isIso_morphismRestrict_iff_isIso_app _ (U := W) (hV.preimage _)).mpr
  have hOpen : W =
      pullback.fst f.fromNormalization g ⁻¹ᵁ (f.fromNormalization ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓
        pullback.snd f.fromNormalization g ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
    dsimp only [W]
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, pullback.condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
      ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf, inf_eq_right.mpr hVU]
  have hNormSection := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_flat_right
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f.fromNormalization g) hVU le_rfl (UY := W)
    hOpen
    hU hV (hU.preimage f.fromNormalization).isCompact
    (hU.preimage f.fromNormalization).isQuasiSeparated
  rw [← isIso_comp_left_iff (pushoutSection (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f.fromNormalization g)
    hVU le_rfl (UY := W) hOpen),
    ← isIso_comp_left_iff (pushout.congrHom f.fromNormalization.app_eq_appLE rfl).hom]
  let : Algebra Γ(S, U) Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra Γ(T, V) Γ(pullback f g, pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    ((pullback.snd f g).app V).hom.toAlgebra
  let e := affinePullbackSectionsTensorEquiv f g hU hV hVU
  let ψ : Γ(T, V) ⊗[Γ(S, U)] integralClosure Γ(S, U) Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U) →ₐ[Γ(T, V)]
      integralClosure Γ(T, V) Γ(pullback f g, pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    e.mapIntegralClosure.toAlgHom.comp (TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure _ _ _)
  have hψ : Function.Bijective ψ := e.mapIntegralClosure.bijective.comp
    (TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure_bijective_of_isLocalization M)
  let j : Γ((pullback.snd f g).normalization, (pullback.snd f g).fromNormalization ⁻¹ᵁ V) ⟶
      Γ((pullback.snd f g).normalization, f.normalizationPullback g ⁻¹ᵁ W) :=
    (pullback.snd f g).normalization.presheaf.map (eqToHom
      (by simp only [W, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
        Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd])).op
  let φ : pushout (f.fromNormalization.app U) (g.appLE U V hVU) ⟶
      Γ((pullback.snd f g).normalization, f.normalizationPullback g ⁻¹ᵁ W) :=
    pushout.map _ _ (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap Γ(S, U) (integralClosure Γ(S, U) Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U))))
      (g.appLE U V hVU) (f.normalizationObjIso hU).hom (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
      (by rw [Scheme.Hom.fromNormalization_app _ hU];
          simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
      (by simp only [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]) ≫
    (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct Γ(S, U) Γ(T, V)
      (integralClosure Γ(S, U) Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U))).flip.isoPushout.inv ≫
    (RingEquiv.ofBijective ψ.toRingHom hψ).toCommRingCatIso.hom ≫
    ((pullback.snd f g).normalizationObjIso hV).inv ≫
    j
  convert! show IsIso φ by dsimp only [φ]; infer_instance using 1
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · dsimp only [φ]
    simp only [pushout.congrHom_hom,
      Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE, colimit.ι_desc_assoc, span_left, PushoutCocone.mk_pt,
      PushoutCocone.mk_ι_app, Category.id_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
      Category.assoc, IsPushout.inl_isoPushout_inv_assoc]
    apply (cancel_mono (inv j)).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    apply (cancel_mono ((pullback.snd f g).normalizationObjIso hV).hom).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    dsimp only [j]
    simp only [← Functor.map_inv, eqToHom_op, inv_eqToHom, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map_assoc]
    have : Mono (CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure Γ(T, V)
        Γ(pullback f g, pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V)).val.toRingHom) :=
      ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective
    rw [← cancel_mono (CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.val _).toRingHom)]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.normalizationObjIso_hom_val, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
      Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationPullback_fst]
    have H : pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ f ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, pullback.condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
      exact Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ hVU
    trans (f.normalizationObjIso hU).hom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom
        (integralClosure Γ(S, U) Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).val.toRingHom ≫ (pullback.fst f g).appLE _ _ H
    · rw [reassoc_of% Scheme.Hom.normalizationObjIso_hom_val, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
    · congr 1
      apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
      apply RingHom.ext
      intro x
      change (pullback.fst f g).appLE _ _ H x = _
      trans e (1 ⊗ₜ[Γ(S, U)] (x : Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U)))
      · exact (affinePullbackSectionsTensorEquiv_one_tmul f g hU hV hVU
          (x : Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U))).symm
      · rfl
  · dsimp only [φ]
    simp only [pushout.congrHom_hom,
      Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE, colimit.ι_desc_assoc, span_right, PushoutCocone.mk_pt,
      PushoutCocone.mk_ι_app, Category.id_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
      Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd, IsPushout.inr_isoPushout_inv_assoc]
    apply (cancel_mono (inv j)).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    apply (cancel_mono ((pullback.snd f g).normalizationObjIso hV).hom).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    dsimp only [j]
    simp only [← Functor.map_inv, eqToHom_op, inv_eqToHom, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map_assoc,
      ← Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE,
      Scheme.Hom.fromNormalization_app _ hV, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Category.comp_id]
    exact congrArg CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.comp_algebraMap.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.isIso_normalizationPullback_of_affineLocalizationSections
statement:
theorem isIso_normalizationPullback_of_affineLocalizationSections
    {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : T ⟶ S)

proof:
:= (g.appLE U ⊤ hTU).hom.toAlgebra
    IsLocalization M Γ(T, ⊤) → IsIso (f.normalizationPullback g) := by

    (P := .isomorphisms _) fun x ↦ ?_

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_finiteEtaleMorphism_normalizationPoint_inertia_iff
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtaleMorphism_normalizationPoint_inertia_iff
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [IsAffine X]
    (g : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω]
    (z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g).normalization) :
    let : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    let : Algebra R X.functionField := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R g
    let : Algebra R Y.left.functionField :=
      affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g)
    let : IsScalarTower R X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleMorphism_functionField_isScalarTower R g Y
    ∃ φ : integralClosure R Y.left.functionField →+* Ω,
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap R (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField))) =
        z ≫ ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g).fromNormalization ∧
      ∀ σ : Aut Y,
        finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ ∈
          (RingHom.ker φ).inertia Gal(Y.left.functionField/X.functionField) ↔
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g) σ.hom.left
          (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ g) σ.hom.w) = z := by
  intro hIntegral hKL hRK hRL hTower
  have : IsAffine Y.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom)
  have : IsNormalIntegral Y.left := isNormalIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hfix⟩ := exists_finiteEtaleMorphism_point_inertia_iff R g Y z
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap R (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField)))) hφ).trans
      ((Category.assoc z _ _).trans
        (congrArg (fun k => z ≫ k)
          (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_hom_base R
            ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g))))
  · intro σ
    have hsmul (b : integralClosure R Y.left.functionField) :
        (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ) • b =
        ((integralClosureAutHom R Y.left.functionField).comp
          (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom R)) (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ) b := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact integralClosure.coe_smul _ _
    have hmem :
        finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ ∈
          (RingHom.ker φ).inertia Gal(Y.left.functionField/X.functionField) ↔
        (let : MulSemiringAction Gal(Y.left.functionField/X.functionField)
            (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField) :=
          MulSemiringAction.compHom (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField)
            ((integralClosureAutHom R Y.left.functionField).comp (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom R))
         finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y σ ∈
          (RingHom.ker φ).inertia Gal(Y.left.functionField/X.functionField)) := by
      constructor
      · intro hσ
        apply Ideal.mem_inertia.mpr
        intro b
        exact (hsmul b ▸ Ideal.mem_inertia.mp hσ b)
      · intro hσ
        apply Ideal.mem_inertia.mpr
        intro b
        exact ((hsmul b).symm ▸ Ideal.mem_inertia.mp hσ b)
    exact hmem.trans (hfix σ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_normalizationPoint_fixed_by_strictHenselian_finiteImage
statement:
theorem exists_normalizationPoint_fixed_by_strictHenselian_finiteImage
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    [HenselianLocalRing R] [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace U]
    (u : U ⟶ X) [QuasiCompact u] [QuasiSeparated u]
    (b : Spec (.of R) ⟶ X) (j : Spec (.of K) ⟶ U)
    (hjb : j ≫ u = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K)) ≫ b)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (ψ : R →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom ψ]
    {Ξ : Type u} [Field Ξ] [IsSepClosed Ξ]
    (xi : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (W : FiniteEtale U) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ j)).obj W) :
    ∃ z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ (W.hom ≫ u).normalization,
      z ≫ (W.hom ≫ u).fromNormalization = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ b ∧
      ∀ σ : (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ,
        σ ∈ (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism j xi W hW w).range →
        z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism (W.hom ≫ u) σ.unop.hom.left
          (by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
            exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ u) σ.unop.hom.w) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Z, i, point, hiz, hZ, hi⟩ :=
    FiniteEtale.exists_galoisComponent_pullback j xi W hW w
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let : Mono i := hi
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))
  let f : Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ g
  let F : W.left ⟶ X := W.hom ≫ u
  let a : Z.left ⟶ W.left := i.left ≫ pullback.fst W.hom j
  have haW : a ≫ W.hom = (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ j := by
    have hiw : i.left ≫ pullback.snd W.hom j =
        (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) := i.w
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k => i.left ≫ k) (pullback.condition (f := W.hom) (g := j))).trans
        ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ j) hiw)))
  have ha : a ≫ F = f ≫ b := by
    change a ≫ (W.hom ≫ u) =
      ((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ g) ≫ b
    rw [← Category.assoc, haW, Category.assoc, hjb, ← Category.assoc]
  obtain ⟨q, hqbase, hqfixed⟩ :=
    exists_fractionCover_normalizationPoint_fixed_of_strictHenselian R K Z ψ
  let n : f.normalization ⟶ F.normalization := normalizationMapOfSquare f F a b ha
  let z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ F.normalization := q ≫ n
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (q ≫ n) ≫ F.fromNormalization = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ b
    rw [Category.assoc, normalizationMapOfSquare_base, ← Category.assoc, hqbase]
  · intro σ hσ
    let μ := FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
      j xi W hW w Z i point hiz hZ hi
    have hrange : μ.range = (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism j xi W hW w).range :=
      FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_range
        j xi W hW w Z i point hiz hZ hi
    obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := (show σ ∈ μ.range from hrange.symm ▸ hσ)
    have hτ : τ.unop.hom.left ≫ f = f := by
      have hw : τ.unop.hom.left ≫ (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) =
          (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) := τ.unop.hom.w
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ g) hw)
    have hμ : (μ τ).unop.hom.left ≫ F = F := by
      have hw : (μ τ).unop.hom.left ≫ W.hom = W.hom := (μ τ).unop.hom.w
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ u) hw)
    have he : τ.unop.hom.left ≫ a = a ≫ (μ τ).unop.hom.left := by
      have hiEquiv := congrArg
        (fun k : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj W => k.left)
        (FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_equivariant
          j xi W hW w Z i point hiz hZ hi τ)
      change τ.unop.hom.left ≫ i.left =
        i.left ≫ ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).map (μ τ).unop.hom).left at hiEquiv
      have hfst : ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).map (μ τ).unop.hom).left ≫
          pullback.fst W.hom j = pullback.fst W.hom j ≫ (μ τ).unop.hom.left :=
        pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
      change τ.unop.hom.left ≫ (i.left ≫ pullback.fst W.hom j) =
        (i.left ≫ pullback.fst W.hom j) ≫ (μ τ).unop.hom.left
      exact (Category.assoc τ.unop.hom.left i.left (pullback.fst W.hom j)).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun k => k ≫ pullback.fst W.hom j) hiEquiv).trans
          ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
            ((congrArg (fun k => i.left ≫ k) hfst).trans (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)))
    have hn : normalizationEndomorphism f τ.unop.hom.left hτ ≫ n =
        n ≫ normalizationEndomorphism F (μ τ).unop.hom.left hμ :=
      normalizationMapOfSquare_endomorphism f F a b ha
        τ.unop.hom.left hτ (μ τ).unop.hom.left hμ he
    change (q ≫ n) ≫ normalizationEndomorphism F (μ τ).unop.hom.left hμ = q ≫ n
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hn, ← Category.assoc, hqfixed τ.unop]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleMorphism_functionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleMorphism_functionField_isScalarTower
    (g : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] :
    let : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    let : Algebra R X.functionField := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R g
    let : Algebra R Y.left.functionField :=
      affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g)
    IsScalarTower R X.functionField Y.left.functionField := by
  intro hIntegral hKL hRK hRL
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X), trivial⟩⟩
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : Y.left.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Y.left), trivial⟩⟩
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro r
  change Y.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
      (((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)) =
    (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom).functionFieldMap (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y)
      (X.germToFunctionField ⊤ (g.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)))
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
    ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom).functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField_top
    (finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected Y))
      (g.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r))).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.finiteEtaleMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq
    (g : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y] (sigma : Aut Y) :
    let : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : IsAffine Y.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom)
    let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    let : Algebra R X.functionField := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R g
    let : Algebra R Y.left.functionField :=
      affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g)
    let : IsScalarTower R X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleMorphism_functionField_isScalarTower R g Y
    affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv R ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g)
        (show Y.left ≅ Y.left from (FiniteEtale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X).mapIso sigma)
        (by
          change sigma.hom.left ≫ ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g) = _
          have hw : sigma.hom.left ≫ (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) =
              (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) := sigma.hom.w
          rw [← Category.assoc, hw]) =
      (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y sigma).restrictScalars R := by
  intro hIntegral hAffine hKL hRK hRL hTower
  have h := (affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq_functionFieldMap R
    ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g)
    (show Y.left ≅ Y.left from (FiniteEtale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X).mapIso sigma)
    (by
          change sigma.hom.left ≫ ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g) = _
          have hw : sigma.hom.left ≫ (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) =
              (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) := sigma.hom.w
          rw [← Category.assoc, hw])).trans
      (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq_functionFieldMap Y sigma).symm
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  exact RingHom.congr_fun h x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_finiteEtaleMorphism_point_inertia_iff
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtaleMorphism_point_inertia_iff
    (g : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g]
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω]
    (z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g).normalization) :
    let : IsIntegral Y.left
proof:
:= isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : IsAffine Y.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom)
    let : IsNormalIntegral Y.left := isNormalIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    let : Algebra R X.functionField := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R g
    let : Algebra R Y.left.functionField :=
      affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g)
    let : IsScalarTower R X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleMorphism_functionField_isScalarTower R g Y
    let : MulSemiringAction Gal(Y.left.functionField/X.functionField)
        (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField) :=
      MulSemiringAction.compHom (integralClosure R Y.left.functionField)
        ((integralClosureAutHom R Y.left.functionField).comp (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom R))
    ∃ φ : integralClosure R Y.left.functionField →+* Ω,
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) =
          z ≫ (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R
            ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g)).hom ∧
        ∀ sigma : Aut Y,
          finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Y sigma ∈
              (RingHom.ker φ).inertia Gal(Y.left.functionField/X.functionField) ↔
            z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g) sigma.hom.left
              (by
                have hw : sigma.hom.left ≫ (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) =
                    (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) := sigma.hom.w
                rw [← Category.assoc, hw]) = z := by
  intro hIntegral hAffine hNormal hKL hRK hRL hTower hAction
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hfix⟩ :=
    exists_affineMorphismFunctionField_point_inertia_iff R ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g) z
  refine ⟨φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  intro sigma
  let e : Y.left ≅ Y.left := (FiniteEtale.forget X ⋙ Over.forget X).mapIso sigma
  have he : e.hom ≫ ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g) = (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g := by
    change sigma.hom.left ≫ ((show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) ≫ g) = _
    have hw : sigma.hom.left ≫ (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) =
        (show Y.left ⟶ X from Y.hom) := sigma.hom.w
    rw [← Category.assoc, hw]
  have h := hfix e he
  rw [finiteEtaleMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv_eq R g Y sigma] at h
  exact h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.exists_fractionCover_normalizationPoint_fixed_of_strictHenselian
statement:
theorem exists_fractionCover_normalizationPoint_fixed_of_strictHenselian
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    [HenselianLocalRing R] [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of K))) [IsConnected Y]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (ψ : R →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom ψ] :
    ∃ z : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))).normalization,
      z ≫ ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))).fromNormalization =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ∧
      ∀ σ : Aut Y, z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism
        ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) σ.hom.left
        (by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
          exact congrArg
            (fun k => k ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) σ.hom.w) = z
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegral Y.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsNormalIntegral Y.left := isNormalIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsAffine Y.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom)
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))
  let f : Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) ≫ g
  let F := (Spec (.of K)).functionField
  let L := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra F L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra R F := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R g
  let : Algebra R L := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R f
  let : IsScalarTower R F L := finiteEtaleMorphism_functionField_isScalarTower R g Y
  let : IsFractionRing R F := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra_isFractionRing R K
  let : FiniteDimensional F L := finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable F L := isSeparable_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : Module.Finite R (integralClosure R L) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite R F L (integralClosure R L)
  obtain ⟨φ, _hφlocal, hφbase, hφfixed⟩ :=
    SchemeTheory.exists_local_hom_finiteDomain_fixed_of_strictHenselian
      R (integralClosure R L) ψ
  let e := affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso R f
  let z := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ e.inv
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change z ≫ f.fromNormalization = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ)
    rw [← affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_hom_base R f]
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun k => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k)) hφbase
  · intro σ
    let s : Y.left ≅ Y.left :=
      (FiniteEtale.forget (Spec (.of K)) ⋙ Over.forget (Spec (.of K))).mapIso σ
    have hs : s.hom ≫ f = f := by
      have hw : σ.hom.left ≫ (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) =
          (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Y.hom) := σ.hom.w
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ g) hw)
    apply (affineMorphismFunctionFieldNormalizationIso_fixes_iff R f s hs z).mp
    have hfixed := hφfixed (affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgEquiv R f s hs).mapIntegralClosure
    have hz : z ≫ e.hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) := by
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
        ((congrArg (fun k => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ k)
          (Iso.inv_hom_id e)).trans (Category.comp_id _))
    rw [hz, ← Spec.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun k => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k)) hfixed

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.isPullback_fractionStalkToSupportComplement
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.isPullback_fractionStalkToSupportComplement
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.IdealSheafData}
    (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ I.support)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)] [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)] :
    IsPullback (hI.fractionStalkToSupportComplement x)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)))))
      I.supportComplement.ι (X.fromSpecStalk x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hgen⟩ := hI.exists_regular_stalkIdeal_generator x
  have hideal : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    apply (I.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_iff_stalkIdeal_le x
      (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.presheaf.stalk x))).mp
    rw [Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint]
    exact hx
  have hanu : ¬ IsUnit a := hideal (by
    rw [hgen]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a)
  let : IsLocalization.Away a (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    SchemeTheory.isLocalizationAway_fractionField_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
      (X.presheaf.stalk x) (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) a ha.ne_zero hanu
  let : IsOpenImmersion
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))))) :=
    IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization a
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact (hI.fractionStalkToSupportComplement_comp_ι x).symm
  · rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, I.fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement,
      hgen, PrimeSpectrum.idealComplement_span_singleton]
    apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
    exact (PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range
      (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) a).symm

    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPullback_localizationAwayToSupportComplement
statement:
theorem isPullback_localizationAwayToSupportComplement
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [P.IsPrime]
    (a : Localization.AtPrime P)
    (ha : (I.stalkIdeal x).map
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)) = Ideal.span {a}) :
    IsPullback (localizationAwayToSupportComplement I x P a ha)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.Away a))))
      I.supportComplement.ι (Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact (localizationAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι I x P a ha).symm
  · rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
