    exact localizationAtPrimeTo_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen I x P a ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPullback_boundaryAwayToSupportComplement
statement:
theorem isPullback_boundaryAwayToSupportComplement
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) (y : Y)
    (P : Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    let : P.asIdeal.IsPrime
proof:
:= P.isPrime
    ∀ {r : ℕ} (t : Fin 2 → Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
    (hboundary : ((I.comap f).stalkIdeal y).map
      (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =
        Ideal.span {EtaleFundamentalGroups.boundaryProduct t r}),
    IsPullback (boundaryAwayToSupportComplement I f y P t hboundary)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
        (Localization.Away (EtaleFundamentalGroups.boundaryProduct t r)))))
      I.supportComplement.ι (Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo Y y P.asIdeal ≫ f) := by
  intro hP r t hboundary
  exact (isPullback_localizationAwayToSupportComplement (I.comap f) y P.asIdeal
    (EtaleFundamentalGroups.boundaryProduct t r) hboundary).paste_horiz
      (isPullback_comapSupportComplementTo I f)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.residue_isGalois_and_ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_inertia_eq_bot
statement:
theorem residue_isGalois_and_ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_inertia_eq_bot
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    (hI : q.inertia G = ⊥) :
    letI
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
    IsGalois p.ResidueField q.ResidueField ∧ q.ramificationIdx R = 1 := by
  let := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
  have heq : (algebraMap (S ⧸ q) q.ResidueField).comp (algebraMap (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ q)) =
      (algebraMap p.ResidueField q.ResidueField).comp (algebraMap (R ⧸ p) p.ResidueField) := by
    ext x
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, ← Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  let : Algebra (R ⧸ p) q.ResidueField :=
    ((algebraMap (S ⧸ q) q.ResidueField).comp (algebraMap (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ q))).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ q) q.ResidueField := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower (R ⧸ p) p.ResidueField q.ResidueField := .of_algebraMap_eq' heq
  let rho := IsFractionRing.stabilizerHom G p q p.ResidueField q.ResidueField
  have hrho : Function.Bijective rho := by
    refine ⟨(MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff rho).mp ?_,
      IsFractionRing.stabilizerHom_surjective G p q p.ResidueField q.ResidueField⟩
    rw [IsFractionRing.ker_stabilizerHom]
    change (q.inertia G).subgroupOf (MulAction.stabilizer G q) = ⊥
    rw [hI]
    exact Subgroup.bot_subgroupOf _
  have hc : Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer G q) =
      Nat.card Gal(q.ResidueField/p.ResidueField) :=
    Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective rho hrho)
  have horbit : (p.primesOver S).ncard * Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer G q) = Nat.card G := by
    rw [← IsInvariant.orbit_eq_primesOver R S G p q]
    exact (Nat.card_prod _ _).symm.trans
      (Nat.card_congr (MulAction.orbitProdStabilizerEquivGroup G q))
  have hcount := Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ramificationIdxIn_mul_inertiaDegIn p S G
  rw [Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx p q G,
    Ideal.inertiaDegIn_eq_inertiaDeg p q G] at hcount
  have hpos : 0 < (p.primesOver S).ncard := by
    exact (Set.ncard_pos (Algebra.QuasiFinite.finite_primesOver p)).mpr
      ⟨q, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  have hd : q.ramificationIdx R * q.inertiaDeg R =
      Nat.card Gal(q.ResidueField/p.ResidueField) := by
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hpos
    exact hcount.trans (horbit.symm.trans (congrArg ((p.primesOver S).ncard * ·) hc))
  have hfpos : 0 < Module.finrank p.ResidueField q.ResidueField := by
    rw [← Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq p q]
    exact q.inertiaDeg_pos R
  have : Module.Finite p.ResidueField q.ResidueField := Module.finite_of_finrank_pos hfpos
  have hbound : Nat.card Gal(q.ResidueField/p.ResidueField) ≤
      Module.finrank p.ResidueField q.ResidueField :=
    (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective AlgEquiv.toAlgHom AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective).trans
      (card_algHom_le_finrank p.ResidueField q.ResidueField q.ResidueField)
  rw [Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq p q] at hd
  have hepos : 0 < q.ramificationIdx R := q.ramificationIdx_pos R
  have he : q.ramificationIdx R = 1 := by
    have hle : q.ramificationIdx R * Module.finrank p.ResidueField q.ResidueField ≤
        1 * Module.finrank p.ResidueField q.ResidueField := by
      rw [hd, one_mul]
      exact hbound
    have h := Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hle hfpos
    omega
  refine ⟨IsGalois.of_card_aut_eq_finrank _ _ ?_, he⟩
  rw [he, one_mul] at hd
  exact hd.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.isUnramifiedAt_of_inertia_eq_bot
statement:
theorem isUnramifiedAt_of_inertia_eq_bot
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (hI : ∀ (Q : Ideal S) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver p], Q.inertia G = ⊥)
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R q
proof:
:= by
  have hsep : Algebra.HasSeparableResidueFieldsAt R S p := by
    constructor
    intro Q hQ hQp
    let := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p Q
    have : IsGalois p.ResidueField Q.ResidueField :=
      (residue_isGalois_and_ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_inertia_eq_bot G p Q (hI Q)).1
    infer_instance
  have : Algebra.HasSeparableResidueFieldsAt R S (q.under R) := by
    simpa only [q.over_def p] using hsep
  exact (Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq_one_iff (q := q) (R := R)).mp
    (residue_isGalois_and_ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_inertia_eq_bot G p q (hI q)).2

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_monic_exists_representative
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_monic_exists_representative
    (p : (geometricStalk s)[X]) (hp : p.Monic) :
    ∃ (W : S.Etale) (t : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj W)
      (q : Γ(W.left, ⊤)[X]), q.Monic ∧ q.map (geometricStalkGerm s W t).hom = p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨W, t, z, hz⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_representatives s
    (fun i : Fin p.natDegree => p.coeff i)
  let q : Γ(W.left, ⊤)[X] := X ^ p.natDegree +
    ∑ i : Fin p.natDegree, C (z i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)
  refine ⟨W, t, q, monic_X_pow_add (degree_sum_fin_lt z), ?_⟩
  change (X ^ p.natDegree + ∑ i : Fin p.natDegree, C (z i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)).map
    (geometricStalkGerm s W t).hom = p
  simp only [Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X,
    Polynomial.map_sum, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C, hz]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
    (fun i : ℕ => C (p.coeff i) * X ^ i) p.natDegree]
  exact hp.as_sum.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_lift_simpleRoot
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_lift_simpleRoot (W : S.Etale)
    (t : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj W)
    (q : Γ(W.left, ⊤)[X]) (hq : q.Monic) (α : Ω)
    (hroot : (q.map (t.left.appTop ≫
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom).hom).eval α = 0)
    (hderivative : (q.derivative.map (t.left.appTop ≫
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom).hom).eval α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : geometricStalk s,
      (q.map (geometricStalkGerm s W t).hom).IsRoot a ∧
      geometricStalkEvaluation s a = α
proof:
:= by
  let R : CommRingCat.{u} := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
  let φ : R ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω :=
    t.left.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom
  let : Algebra R Ω := φ.hom.toAlgebra
  let P : StandardEtalePair R :=
    { f := q
      monic_f := hq
      g := q.derivative
      cond := ⟨1, 0, 1, by rw [mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, pow_one]⟩ }
  have hα : P.HasMap α := by
    constructor
    · change q.eval₂ φ.hom α = 0
      rw [eval₂_eq_eval_map]
      exact hroot
    · change IsUnit (q.derivative.eval₂ φ.hom α)
      rw [eval₂_eq_eval_map]
      exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hderivative
  let B : CommRingCat.{u} := .of P.Ring
  let base : R ⟶ B := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R P.Ring)
  let ψ : B ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω := CommRingCat.ofHom (P.lift α hα).toRingHom
  have hbaseψ : base ≫ ψ = φ := by
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    exact (P.lift α hα).comp_algebraMap
  have hpoint : t.left ≫ W.left.toSpecΓ = Spec.map ψ ≫ Spec.map base := by
    have hnatural : t.left ≫ W.left.toSpecΓ =
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)).toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map t.left.appTop :=
      Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality t.left
    have hφ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)).toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map t.left.appTop =
        Spec.map φ := by
      change (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)).toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map t.left.appTop =
        Spec.map (t.left.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom)
      rw [← SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_hom, ← Spec.map_comp]
    have hcomp : Spec.map φ = Spec.map ψ ≫ Spec.map base := by
      rw [← Spec.map_comp, hbaseψ]
    exact hnatural.trans (hφ.trans hcomp)
  have : Etale (Spec.map base) :=
    (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr
      (RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
  let V : Scheme.{u} := pullback W.left.toSpecΓ (Spec.map base)
  let j : V ⟶ W.left := pullback.fst W.left.toSpecΓ (Spec.map base)
  let k : V ⟶ Spec B := pullback.snd W.left.toSpecΓ (Spec.map base)
  let l : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ V := pullback.lift t.left (Spec.map ψ) hpoint
  have hlj : l ≫ j = t.left := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hlk : l ≫ k = Spec.map ψ := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  let T : S.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk (j ≫ W.hom)
  let f : T ⟶ W := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk j rfl
  let tT : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj T := Over.homMk l (by
    change l ≫ (j ≫ W.hom) = s
    rw [← Category.assoc, hlj]
    exact Over.w t)
  have htT : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.map f tT = t := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact hlj
  let h : B ⟶ Γ(V, ⊤) := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso B).inv ≫ k.appTop
  have hbase : base ≫ h = j.appTop := by
    change base ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso B).inv ≫ k.appTop = j.appTop
    rw [← Category.assoc, Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality, Category.assoc,
      ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫
      (pullback.snd W.left.toSpecΓ (Spec.map base) ≫ Spec.map base).appTop = j.appTop
    rw [← pullback.condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Scheme.toSpecΓ_appTop,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  let germ : Γ(V, ⊤) ⟶ geometricStalk s := geometricStalkGerm s T tT
  have hgerm : j.appTop ≫ germ = geometricStalkGerm s W t := by
    have heq := (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).toPresheafFiber_w f tT (etaleSections S)
    rw [htT] at heq
    exact heq
  have hgermEvaluation : germ ≫ geometricStalkEvaluation s =
      l.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom :=
    geometricStalkGerm_evaluation s T tT
  let e : B ⟶ geometricStalk s := h ≫ germ
  have he : e.hom.comp (algebraMap R P.Ring) =
      (geometricStalkGerm s W t).hom := by
    change (base ≫ e).hom = (geometricStalkGerm s W t).hom
    change (base ≫ (h ≫ germ)).hom = (geometricStalkGerm s W t).hom
    rw [← Category.assoc, hbase, hgerm]
  have heval : e ≫ geometricStalkEvaluation s = ψ := by
    change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso B).inv ≫ k.appTop ≫ germ) ≫
      geometricStalkEvaluation s = ψ
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hgermEvaluation]
    rw [← Category.assoc k.appTop, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, hlk,
      Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  refine ⟨e P.X, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (q.map (geometricStalkGerm s W t).hom).eval (e P.X) = 0
    rw [eval_map, ← he, ← Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
    have hPX : q.eval₂ (algebraMap R P.Ring) P.X = 0 := P.hasMap_X.1
    rw [hPX, map_zero]
  · exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom heval P.X).trans (P.lift_X α hα)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_exists_root_of_evaluation_simpleRoot
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_exists_root_of_evaluation_simpleRoot
    (p : (geometricStalk s)[X]) (hp : p.Monic) (α : Ω)
    (hroot : (p.map (geometricStalkEvaluation s).hom).eval α = 0)
    (hderivative : (p.derivative.map (geometricStalkEvaluation s).hom).eval α ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : geometricStalk s, p.IsRoot a ∧ geometricStalkEvaluation s a = α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, t, q, hq, hqp⟩ := geometricStalk_monic_exists_representative s p hp
  let φ : Γ(W.left, ⊤) ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω :=
    t.left.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom
  have hmap : q.map φ.hom = p.map (geometricStalkEvaluation s).hom := by
    rw [← hqp, Polynomial.map_map]
    exact congrArg (fun f : Γ(W.left, ⊤) ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω => q.map f.hom)
      (geometricStalkGerm_evaluation s W t).symm
  have hroot' : (q.map φ.hom).eval α = 0 := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact hroot
  have hderivative' : (q.derivative.map φ.hom).eval α ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← derivative_map, hmap, derivative_map]
    exact hderivative
  obtain ⟨a, ha, heval⟩ :=
    geometricStalk_lift_simpleRoot s W t q hq α hroot' hderivative'
  refine ⟨a, ?_, heval⟩
  rw [← hqp]
  exact ha

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_mem_maximalIdeal_iff (a : geometricStalk s) :
    a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (geometricStalk s) ↔
      geometricStalkEvaluation s a = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, geometricStalk_isUnit_iff]
  exact not_not

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.affineNeighborhood_structure_etale_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem affineNeighborhood_structure_etale_faithfullyFlat
    {R Ω : Type u} [CommRing R] [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (φ : R →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale)
    (v : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj V)
    [IsAffine V.left] :
    let β
proof:
:= ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom
    β.Etale ∧ β.FaithfullyFlat := by
  let β : R →+* Γ(V.left, ⊤) :=
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom
  let : IsAffine ((𝟭 Scheme).obj V.left) := inferInstanceAs (IsAffine V.left)
  let : IsAffine ((Functor.fromPUnit (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))).obj V.right) := by
    change IsAffine (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
    infer_instance
  have hβ : β.Etale := by
    change (V.hom.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom).Etale
    apply RingHom.Etale.stableUnderComposition
    · exact RingHom.Etale.of_bijective
        ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv).mp
          inferInstance)
    · exact HasRingHomProperty.appTop (P := @Etale) V.hom inferInstance
  refine ⟨hβ, ?_⟩
  let : Algebra R Γ(V.left, ⊤) := β.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra.Etale R Γ(V.left, ⊤) := hβ
  let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  let g : Γ(V.left, ⊤) →+* Ω :=
    (geometricStalkEvaluation s).hom.comp (geometricStalkGerm s V v).hom
  have hg : g.comp β = φ := by
    let γ : Γ(V.left, ⊤) →+* geometricStalk s := (geometricStalkGerm s V v).hom
    let ε : geometricStalk s →+* Ω := (geometricStalkEvaluation s).hom
    have hγ : γ.comp β = geometricStalkStructureMap φ :=
      geometricStalkGerm_comp_structure φ V v
    exact (RingHom.comp_assoc β γ ε).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k : R →+* geometricStalk s => ε.comp k) hγ).trans
        (geometricStalkStructureMap_evaluation φ))
  change Module.FaithfullyFlat R Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  refine ⟨fun m hm => ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map]
  intro htop
  have hker : m ≤ RingHom.ker (g.comp β) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, hg]
    by_contra hn
    have hu : IsUnit r := (inferInstance : IsLocalHom φ).map_nonunit r
      (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn)
    exact hm.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem m hr hu)
  have hle : Ideal.map β m ≤ RingHom.ker g := Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr hker
  have htop' : Ideal.map β m = ⊤ :=
    (Submodule.restrictScalars_eq_top_iff R _ _).mp htop
  rw [htop', top_le_iff] at hle
  exact RingHom.ker_ne_top g hle

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.normalization_stalk_etale_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed
statement:
theorem normalization_stalk_etale_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed
    {X : Scheme.{0}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ D.1.support)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)] [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (φ : X.presheaf.stalk x →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement)
    {Ω' : Type} [Field Ω'] [IsSepClosed Ω']
    (point : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ Spec (.of
      (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))))
    (hfixed : ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point))
      (w : (fiber (point ≫ geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement D x φ)).obj W),
      fundamentalGroupHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement D x φ) point g • w = w) :
    Etale (Limits.pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
      (X.fromSpecStalk x))
proof:
:= by
  let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let K := FractionRing R
  let c := D.2.fractionStalkToSupportComplement x
  let a := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))
  let j := geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement D x φ
  let l := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ))
  let V := (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W
  have hcomp : l ≫ c = j :=
    geometricStalkFractionFieldMap_comp_fractionStalkToSupportComplement D x φ
  let E : (FiniteEtale.pullback l).obj V ≅ (FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj W :=
    ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @IsFiniteEtale) (Q := ⊤) l c).app W).symm ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun k => (FiniteEtale.pullback k).obj W) hcomp)
  have hV : ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point)) (v : (fiber (point ≫ l)).obj V),
      fundamentalGroupHom l point g • v = v := by
    apply image_fixed_of_pullback_fiber_fixed l point V
    intro g v
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((fiber point).map E.hom)).injective
    exact (CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.mulAction_naturality (fiber point)
      g E.hom v).symm.trans
        (pullback_fiber_fixed_of_image_fixed j point W hfixed g ((fiber point).map E.hom v))
  let f : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := (show V.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from V.hom) ≫ a
  have hf : Etale f.fromNormalization :=
    etale_fractionCover_normalization_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed φ V point hV
  let F : W.left ⟶ X := W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι
  let b : Spec (.of R) ⟶ X := X.fromSpecStalk x
  have H : IsPullback (Limits.pullback.fst W.hom c) f F b :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback W.hom c).paste_vert
      (D.2.isPullback_fractionStalkToSupportComplement x hx)
  let e : Limits.pullback F b ≅ V.left :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b).isoIsPullback _ _ H
  have he : e.hom ≫ f = Limits.pullback.snd F b :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd W.left (Spec (.of R))
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b) H
  let en := normalizationSourceIso (Limits.pullback.snd F b) f e he
  have hPB : Etale (Limits.pullback.snd F b).fromNormalization := by
    have ht : Etale (en.hom ≫ f.fromNormalization) := inferInstance
    rw [normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization] at ht
    exact ht
  let : IsIso (F.normalizationPullback b) := isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalk F x
  have heq : Limits.pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b =
      inv (F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ (Limits.pullback.snd F b).fromNormalization := by
    exact (IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc (F.normalizationPullback b)
      (Limits.pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b)).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun k => inv (F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ k)
          (Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd F b))
  change Etale (Limits.pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b)
  rw [heq]
  infer_instance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.integralClosure_etale_of_normal_strictGeneric_tensor_split
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_normal_strictGeneric_tensor_split
    {R Ω B : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra (FractionRing R) B]
    [IsScalarTower R (FractionRing R) B] [Module.Finite (FractionRing R) B]
    (φ : R →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ] (ι : Type u) [Finite ι] :
    let : Algebra (FractionRing R)
        (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))
proof:
:=
      (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
    Nonempty ((FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⊗[FractionRing R] B)
      ≃ₐ[FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))]
        (ι → FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))) →
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R B) := by
  intro scalarAction he
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := he
  obtain ⟨V, v, hV, eV, -⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_affine_generic_split φ ι e
  have : IsAffine V.left := hV
  let S := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let : Algebra R S :=
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨hEtale, hFlat⟩ := affineNeighborhood_structure_etale_faithfullyFlat φ V v
  have : Algebra.Etale R S := hEtale
  have : Module.FaithfullyFlat R S := hFlat
  apply SchemeTheory.integralClosure_etale_of_generic_split_after_faithfullyFlat_etale R S B ι
  exact SchemeTheory.genericTensorSplitEquiv R (FractionRing R) S B ι
    (mkUnderTensorSplit (K := CommRingCat.of (FractionRing R))
      (A := FractionRing R ⊗[R] S) (B := B) ι eV)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_genericTensor_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_genericTensor_isFractionRing :
    let : Algebra R (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
proof:
:=
      (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
    let : Algebra (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
        (FractionRing R ⊗[R] geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    IsFractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
      (FractionRing R ⊗[R] geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) := by
  let A := geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
  let K := FractionRing R
  let : Algebra R A := (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
  let T := K ⊗[R] A
  let : Algebra A T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let M : Submonoid A := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid A R⁰
  have hM : M ≤ A⁰ := by
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    apply mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    change geometricStalkStructureMap φ r ≠ 0
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff _
      (geometricStalkStructureMap_injective_of_isDomain φ)).mpr
      (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hr)
  have : IsLocalization M T := IsLocalization.tensorRight (R := R) (S := A) (A := K) R⁰
  have : IsDomain T := IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors T hM
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral K T := geometricStalk_tensor_isIntegral φ K
  apply IsLocalization.of_le M A⁰ hM
  intro a ha
  exact (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := K) (algebraMap A T a)).isUnit
    (IsLocalization.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors T hM ha)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkStructureMap_evaluation
statement:
theorem geometricStalkStructureMap_evaluation :
    (geometricStalkEvaluation (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).hom.comp
      (geometricStalkStructureMap φ) = φ
proof:
:= by
  let s : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  let T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale :=
    Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
  let tT : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj T :=
    Over.homMk s (Category.comp_id _)
  change (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫
    geometricStalkGerm s T tT) ≫ geometricStalkEvaluation s).hom = φ
  apply congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
  calc
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ geometricStalkGerm s T tT) ≫
        geometricStalkEvaluation s =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫
        (geometricStalkGerm s T tT ≫ geometricStalkEvaluation s) :=
          Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ tT.left.appTop ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun h : Γ(T.left, ⊤) ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω =>
              (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ h)
            (geometricStalkGerm_evaluation s T tT)
    _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ s.appTop ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom := rfl
    _ = CommRingCat.ofHom φ := by
      change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).appTop ≫
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom = CommRingCat.ofHom φ
      rw [Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkStructureMap_evaluation_apply
statement:
theorem geometricStalkStructureMap_evaluation_apply (r : R) :
    geometricStalkEvaluation (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
      (geometricStalkStructureMap φ r) = φ r
proof:
:=
  RingHom.congr_fun (geometricStalkStructureMap_evaluation φ) r

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkGerm_comp_structure
statement:
theorem geometricStalkGerm_comp_structure
    (W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale)
    (t : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj W) :
    (geometricStalkGerm (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) W t).hom.comp
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ W.hom.appTop).hom) =
      geometricStalkStructureMap φ
proof:
:= by
  let T : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale :=
    Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
  let tT : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj T :=
    Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) (Category.comp_id _)
  let f : W ⟶ T := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk W.hom (Category.comp_id _)
  have ht : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.map f t = tT := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact Over.w t
  have h := (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).toPresheafFiber_w
    f t (etaleSections (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
  rw [ht] at h
  change W.hom.appTop ≫ geometricStalkGerm (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) W t =
    geometricStalkGerm (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) T tT at h
  change (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ W.hom.appTop) ≫
    geometricStalkGerm (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) W t).hom = _
  rw [Category.assoc, h]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.finiteEtale_spec_of_finite_etale_algebra

    (K B : Type u) [CommRing K] [CommRing B] [Algebra K B]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.integralClosure_etale_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed
    {R Ω : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (φ : R →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (FractionRing R) B]
    [IsScalarTower R (FractionRing R) B]
    [Module.Finite (FractionRing R) B] [Algebra.Etale (FractionRing R) B]
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsSepClosed Ω']
    (point : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶
      Spec (.of (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))))) :
    let : IsFiniteEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (FractionRing R) B)))
proof:
:=
      finiteEtale_spec_of_finite_etale_algebra (FractionRing R) B
    (∀ (g : Aut (fiber point))
      (w : (fiber (point ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)))).obj
        (mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (FractionRing R) B))))),
      fundamentalGroupHom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)))
        point g • w = w) →
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R B) := by
  intro finiteEtaleInstance hfixed
  let A := geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
  let : Algebra (FractionRing R) (FractionRing A) :=
    (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, e⟩ := exists_tensor_algEquiv_pi_of_image_fixed
    (FractionRing R) (FractionRing A) B point hfixed
  have : Finite ι := hι
  exact integralClosure_etale_of_normal_strictGeneric_tensor_split (B := B) φ ι e

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkFractionPullback_fiber_fixed
statement:
theorem geometricStalkFractionPullback_fiber_fixed
    {R Ω : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (φ : R →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (Z : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of R)))
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsSepClosed Ω']
    (point : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶
      Spec (.of (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))))) :
    let A
proof:
:= geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
    ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point))
      (w : (fiber point).obj ((pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (FractionRing A))) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkStructureMap φ)))).obj Z)),
      g • w = w := by
  intro A g w
  let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (FractionRing A)))
  let r := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkStructureMap φ))
  let E : (pullback (f ≫ r)).obj Z ≅ (pullback f).obj ((pullback r).obj Z) :=
    (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp (P := @IsFiniteEtale) (Q := ⊤) f r).app Z
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((fiber point).map E.hom)).injective
  rw [← CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.mulAction_naturality]
  apply pullback_fiber_fixed_of_image_fixed f point ((pullback r).obj Z)
  intro a z
  have : Subsingleton π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫ f) :=
    subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) (point ≫ f)
  rw [Subsingleton.elim (fundamentalGroupHom f point a) 1, one_smul]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkGerm_isUnit_of_mem_primeCompl
statement:
theorem geometricStalkGerm_isUnit_of_mem_primeCompl
    (a : (geometricNeighborhoodPrime s W t).asIdeal.primeCompl) :
    IsUnit (geometricStalkGerm s W t a)
proof:
:= by
  apply geometricStalk_isUnit_of_evaluation_ne_zero s
  have ha := a.property
  change (t.left.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom).hom (a : Γ(W.left, ⊤)) ≠ 0 at ha
  intro hzero
  apply ha
  exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (geometricStalkGerm_evaluation s W t) a).symm.trans hzero

theorem geometricStalkLocalizedGerm_comp :
    (geometricStalkLocalizedGerm s W t).comp

        (Localization.AtPrime (geometricNeighborhoodPrime s W t).asIdeal)) =

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkLocalizedGerm_apply
statement:
theorem geometricStalkLocalizedGerm_apply (a : Γ(W.left, ⊤)) :

        (Localization.AtPrime (geometricNeighborhoodPrime s W t).asIdeal) a) =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pointedEtaleNeighborhoods_initiallySmall
statement:
theorem pointedEtaleNeighborhoods_initiallySmall :
    InitiallySmall.{u} (Etale.forget S ⋙ coyoneda.obj (op (Over.mk s))).Elements
proof:
:=
  initiallySmall_of_essentiallySmall_weakly_initial_objectProperty
    (Functor.Elements.precomp (AffineEtale.Spec S)
      (Etale.forget S ⋙ coyoneda.obj (op (Over.mk s)))).essImage (fun x => by
    induction x with | @mk X x
    cases X with | _ Y f
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Over.homMk_surjective x
    dsimp at y hy
    obtain ⟨R, j, _, y', rfl⟩ : ∃ (R : CommRingCat) (j : Spec (.of R) ⟶ Y)
        (_ : IsOpenImmersion j) (y' : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of R)), y' ≫ j = y := by
      obtain ⟨R, j, _, hj, _⟩ := exists_affine_mem_range_and_range_subset
        (x := y.base default) (U := ⊤) (by trivial)
      refine ⟨R, j, inferInstance, _, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac j y ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
      rwa [Subsingleton.elim a default]
    exact ⟨_,
      ⟨Functor.elementsMk _ (AffineEtale.mk (j ≫ f)) (Over.homMk y'), ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩,
      ⟨⟨MorphismProperty.Over.homMk j rfl (by trivial), by cat_disch⟩⟩⟩)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_exists_unit_mul_baseLocal_uniformizer_pow
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_exists_unit_mul_baseLocal_uniformizer_pow
    (π : Localization.AtPrime (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal) (hπ : Irreducible π)
    (a : geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (u : (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))ˣ),
      (u : geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) *
        geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ π ^ n = a
proof:
:= by
  let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  let P := Localization.AtPrime (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal
  obtain ⟨W, t, z, hz⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_representative s a
  obtain ⟨V, v, j, hVaffine, hj⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_affine_refinement s W t
  let : IsAffine V.left := hVaffine
  let y : Γ(V.left, ⊤) := j.left.appTop z
  have hy : geometricStalkGerm s V v y = a := by
    have h := (Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber_w
      j v (etaleSections (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    have hjStrict : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).fiber.map j v = t := hj
    rw [hjStrict] at h
    exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h z).trans hz
  let β : R →+* Γ(V.left, ⊤) :=
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom
  let : Algebra R Γ(V.left, ⊤) := β.toAlgebra
  have hβ : β.Etale := by
    change (V.hom.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom).Etale
    apply RingHom.Etale.stableUnderComposition
    · exact RingHom.Etale.of_bijective
        ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv).mp
          inferInstance)
    · exact HasRingHomProperty.appTop (P := @Etale)
        (show V.left ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) from V.hom) inferInstance
  let : Algebra.Etale R Γ(V.left, ⊤) := hβ
  let B := Localization.AtPrime (geometricNeighborhoodPrime s V v).asIdeal
  let ψ : P →+* B := geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap φ V v
  let : Algebra P B := ψ.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower R P B :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r =>
      (geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap_apply φ V v r).symm
  have : IsLocalHom (algebraMap P B) :=
    geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap_isLocalHom φ V v
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType P B := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp R P B
  have : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R B :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.comp R Γ(V.left, ⊤) B
  have : Algebra.FormallyUnramified P B :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_restrictScalars R P B
  have : IsNoetherianRing B := Algebra.EssFiniteType.isNoetherianRing P B
  let θ : B →+* geometricStalk s := geometricStalkLocalizedGerm s V v
  have hθ : θ.comp (algebraMap P B) = geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ :=
    geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap_germ φ V v
  have hyB : algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) B y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply ha
    rw [← hy, ← geometricStalkLocalizedGerm_apply]
    change θ (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) B y) = 0
    rw [hzero, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨n, u, hu⟩ := exists_unit_mul_pow_of_principal_maximalIdeal (algebraMap P B π)
    (localUnramifiedOverDVR_maximalIdeal P B π hπ) (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) B y) hyB
  refine ⟨n, Units.map θ.toMonoidHom u, ?_⟩
  change θ (u : B) * geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ π ^ n = a
  have h := congrArg θ hu
  have hπMap : θ (algebraMap P B π) = geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ π :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun hθ π
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, hπMap] at h
  change θ (u : B) * geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ π ^ n =
    geometricStalkLocalizedGerm s V v (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) B y) at h
  rw [geometricStalkLocalizedGerm_apply, hy] at h
  exact h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_maximalIdeal_eq_span_baseLocal_uniformizer
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_maximalIdeal_eq_span_baseLocal_uniformizer
    (π : Localization.AtPrime (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    maximalIdeal (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) =
      Ideal.span {geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ π}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro a ha
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · rw [ha0]
      exact Ideal.zero_mem _
    obtain ⟨n, u, hu⟩ :=
      geometricStalk_exists_unit_mul_baseLocal_uniformizer_pow φ π hπ a ha0
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have hau : IsUnit a := by
        rw [← hu, pow_zero, mul_one]
        exact u.isUnit
      exact False.elim (ha hau)
    | succ n =>
      apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
      refine ⟨(u : geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) *
        geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ π ^ n, ?_⟩
      rw [← hu, pow_succ]
      ring
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro a ha
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
    subst a
    change ¬ IsUnit (geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ π)
    intro hunit
    exact hπ.not_isUnit
      (IsLocalHom.map_nonunit (f := geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ) π hunit)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_isDiscreteValuationRing_of_baseLocalization
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_isDiscreteValuationRing_of_baseLocalization :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
proof:
:= by
  let P := Localization.AtPrime (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible P
  have hne : geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ π ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hπ.ne_zero
    apply geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap_injective φ
    rw [hzero, map_zero]
  have hmax := geometricStalk_maximalIdeal_eq_span_baseLocal_uniformizer φ π hπ
  apply IsDiscreteValuationRing.ofHasUnitMulPowIrreducibleFactorization
  refine ⟨geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ π,
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal _ hne hmax, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨n, u, hu⟩ :=
    geometricStalk_exists_unit_mul_baseLocal_uniformizer_pow φ π hπ a ha
  refine ⟨n, u, ?_⟩
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact hu

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_tensor_isIntegral
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_tensor_isIntegral (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra R K] :
    let : Algebra R (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
proof:
:=
      (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsIntegral K (K ⊗[R] geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) := by
  let s : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  let A := geometricStalk s
  let : Algebra R A := (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
  change Algebra.IsIntegral K (K ⊗[R] A)
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_⟩
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul k a =>
    obtain ⟨W, t, z, hz⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_representative s a
    obtain ⟨V, v, j, hVaffine, hj⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_affine_refinement s W t
    have : IsAffine V.left := hVaffine
    let y : Γ(V.left, ⊤) := j.left.appTop z
    have hy : geometricStalkGerm s V v y = a := by
      have h := (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).toPresheafFiber_w
        j v (etaleSections (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
      rw [hj] at h
      exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h z).trans hz
    let S := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
    let β : R →+* S :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom
    let : Algebra R S := β.toAlgebra
    have hβ : β.Etale := by
      change (V.hom.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom).Etale
      apply RingHom.Etale.stableUnderComposition
      · exact RingHom.Etale.of_bijective
          ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv).mp
            inferInstance)
      · exact HasRingHomProperty.appTop (P := @Etale)
          (show V.left ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) from V.hom) inferInstance
    have : Algebra.Etale R S := hβ
    let γ : S →ₐ[R] A :=
      { __ := (geometricStalkGerm s V v).hom
        commutes' r := RingHom.congr_fun (geometricStalkGerm_comp_structure φ V v) r }
    have : Module.Finite K (K ⊗[R] S) :=
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free K (K ⊗[R] S)
    let e : (K ⊗[R] S) →ₐ[K] (K ⊗[R] A) :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id K K) γ
    have he : e (k ⊗ₜ[R] y) = k ⊗ₜ[R] a := by
      change k ⊗ₜ[R] geometricStalkGerm s V v y = k ⊗ₜ[R] a
      rw [hy]
    exact he ▸ (IsIntegral.of_finite K (k ⊗ₜ[R] y)).map e
  | add x y hx hy => exact hx.add hy

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_isField_of_injective
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_isField_of_injective [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) :
    IsField (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
proof:
:= by
  let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  let A := geometricStalk s
  let K := FractionRing R
  let : Algebra R A := (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
  have hm : ∀ r : nonZeroDivisors R, IsUnit (geometricStalkStructureMap φ r) := by
    intro r
    apply geometricStalk_isUnit_of_evaluation_ne_zero s
    rw [geometricStalkStructureMap_evaluation_apply]
    intro h
    exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp r.property)
      (hφ (h.trans (map_zero φ).symm))
  let f : K →+* A := IsLocalization.lift (S := K)
    (g := geometricStalkStructureMap φ) hm
  let : Algebra K A := f.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower R K A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r =>
    (RingHom.congr_fun (IsLocalization.lift_comp hm) r).symm
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral K (K ⊗[R] A) := geometricStalk_tensor_isIntegral φ K
  let e : (K ⊗[R] A) →ₐ[K] A :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R K A A (AlgHom.id R A)
  have he : Function.Surjective e := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[R] a, ?_⟩
    change (1 : K) • a = a
    exact one_smul K a
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral K A := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_surjective e he
  exact isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField' (R := K) (S := A) (Field.toIsField K)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.exists_unit_mul_pow_of_principal_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_unit_mul_pow_of_principal_maximalIdeal
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (π : A) (hπ : maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span {π})
    (x : A) (hx : x ≠ 0) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (u : Aˣ), (u : A) * π ^ n = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsep : (⨅ n : ℕ, maximalIdeal A ^ n) = ⊥ :=
    (maximalIdeal A).iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing (maximalIdeal.isMaximal A).ne_top
  have hnotall : ¬ ∀ n : ℕ, x ∈ maximalIdeal A ^ n := by
    intro h
    have hm : x ∈ (⨅ n : ℕ, maximalIdeal A ^ n) := (Submodule.mem_iInf _).mpr h
    rw [hsep, Ideal.mem_bot] at hm
    exact hx hm
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := not_forall.mp hnotall
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, x ∉ maximalIdeal A ^ (n + 1) := by
    refine ⟨m, fun h => hm ?_⟩
    exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_succ m) h
  let n : ℕ := Nat.find hex
  have hxn : x ∈ maximalIdeal A ^ n := by
    cases hn : n with
    | zero => rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]; trivial
    | succ k =>
      have hk : k < Nat.find hex := by
        change k < n
        rw [hn]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_self k
      have h := not_not.mp (Nat.find_min hex hk)
      simpa only [hn, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using h
  have hxnp : x ∉ maximalIdeal A ^ (n + 1) := Nat.find_spec hex
  rw [hπ, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hxn
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hxn
  have hπmem : π ∈ maximalIdeal A := by
    rw [hπ]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton π)
  have haunit : IsUnit a := by
    by_contra hnu
    have haM : a ∈ maximalIdeal A := hnu
    apply hxnp
    rw [ha, pow_succ]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hπmem n) haM
  refine ⟨n, haunit.unit, ?_⟩
  rw [haunit.unit_spec, mul_comm]
  exact ha.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.isDomain_of_principal_maximalIdeal_of_regular
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_principal_maximalIdeal_of_regular
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (π : A) (hπ : maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span {π}) (hreg : IsRegular π) :
    IsDomain A
proof:
:= by
  let : NoZeroDivisors A := ⟨by
    intro a b hab
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · exact Or.inl ha
    · right
      obtain ⟨n, u, hu⟩ := exists_unit_mul_pow_of_principal_maximalIdeal π hπ a ha
      have hregular : IsRegular a := hu ▸ u.isRegular.mul (hreg.pow n)
      apply hregular.left
      simpa only [mul_zero] using hab⟩
  exact NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain A

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.localUnramifiedOverDVR_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem localUnramifiedOverDVR_maximalIdeal (π : R) (hπ : Irreducible π) :
    maximalIdeal B = Ideal.span {algebraMap R B π}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal (R := R) (S := B),
    hπ.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.localUnramifiedOverDVR_isDomain
statement: theorem localUnramifiedOverDVR_isDomain : IsDomain B
proof:
:= by
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := Algebra.EssFiniteType.isNoetherianRing R B
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible R
  have hleft : IsLeftRegular (algebraMap R B π) := by
    have h := Module.Flat.isSMulRegular_of_isRegular (M := B) (IsRegular.of_ne_zero hπ.ne_zero)
    change Function.Injective (fun x : B => (algebraMap R B π) * x)
    simpa only [IsSMulRegular, Algebra.smul_def] using h
  have hreg : IsRegular (algebraMap R B π) :=
    (Commute.isRegular_iff (fun b => Commute.all _ b)).mpr hleft
  exact isDomain_of_principal_maximalIdeal_of_regular (algebraMap R B π)
    (localUnramifiedOverDVR_maximalIdeal R B π hπ) hreg

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.localUnramifiedOverDVR_isDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
theorem localUnramifiedOverDVR_isDiscreteValuationRing [IsDomain B] :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing B
proof:
:= by
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := Algebra.EssFiniteType.isNoetherianRing R B
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible R
  have hleft : IsLeftRegular (algebraMap R B π) := by
    have h := Module.Flat.isSMulRegular_of_isRegular (M := B) (IsRegular.of_ne_zero hπ.ne_zero)
    change Function.Injective (fun x : B => (algebraMap R B π) * x)
    simpa only [IsSMulRegular, Algebra.smul_def] using h
  have hreg : IsRegular (algebraMap R B π) :=
    (Commute.isRegular_iff (fun b => Commute.all _ b)).mpr hleft
  have hmax := localUnramifiedOverDVR_maximalIdeal R B π hπ
  apply IsDiscreteValuationRing.ofHasUnitMulPowIrreducibleFactorization
  refine ⟨algebraMap R B π,
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal _ hreg.ne_zero hmax, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, u, hu⟩ :=
    exists_unit_mul_pow_of_principal_maximalIdeal (algebraMap R B π) hmax x hx
  refine ⟨n, u, ?_⟩
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact hu

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm_naturality
statement:
theorem geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm_naturality
    {W V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale} (j : V ⟶ W)
    (v : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj V)
    (t : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj W)
    (hj : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.map j v = t) :
    geometricNeighborhoodGenericMap R j ≫ geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v =
      geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ W t
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : geometricNeighborhoodAlgebraMap R j ≫ geometricNeighborhoodGerm φ V v =
      geometricNeighborhoodGerm φ W t := by
    apply Under.UnderMorphism.ext
    change j.left.appTop ≫ geometricStalkGerm (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) V v =
      geometricStalkGerm (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) W t
    have h := (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).toPresheafFiber_w
      j v (etaleSections (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    rw [hj] at h
    exact h
  let e : (CommRingCat.tensorProd (CommRingCat.of R) (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing R))).obj
      (geometricStalkSmallAlgebraCocone φ).pt ≅
        Under.mk (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)) :=
    geometricStalkGenericFieldVertexIso φ
  change (CommRingCat.tensorProd (CommRingCat.of R) (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing R))).map
      (geometricNeighborhoodAlgebraMap R j) ≫
        ((CommRingCat.tensorProd (CommRingCat.of R) (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing R))).map
          (geometricNeighborhoodGerm φ V v) ≫ e.hom) =
    (CommRingCat.tensorProd (CommRingCat.of R) (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing R))).map
      (geometricNeighborhoodGerm φ W t) ≫ e.hom
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, hbase]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.scalarExtendUnderEquiv_squares
statement:
private theorem scalarExtendUnderEquiv_squares
    {K : CommRingCat.{u}} {B D : Type u} [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra K B] [Algebra K D]
    (E T F : Under K) (η : E ⟶ T) (σ : T ⟶ F) (μ : E ⟶ F)
    (hμ : η ≫ σ = μ) :
    ∀ (e : (E ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[E] (E ⊗[K] D))
      (q : (F ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[F] (F ⊗[K] D)),
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom μ) (AlgHom.id K D)).comp
          (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) = (q.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom μ) (AlgHom.id K B)) →
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom μ) (AlgHom.id K B)).comp
          (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) = (q.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom μ) (AlgHom.id K D)) →
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom σ) (AlgHom.id K D)).comp
          ((scalarExtendUnderEquiv E T η e).toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) =
        (q.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom σ) (AlgHom.id K B)) ∧
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom σ) (AlgHom.id K B)).comp
          ((scalarExtendUnderEquiv E T η e).symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) =
        (q.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom σ) (AlgHom.id K D))
proof:
:= by
  intro e q hf hi
  have hcomp : (CommRingCat.toAlgHom σ).comp (CommRingCat.toAlgHom η) =
      CommRingCat.toAlgHom μ := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.toAlgHom_comp, hμ]
  rw [← hcomp] at hf hi
  exact tensorScalarExtendAlgEquiv_squares (CommRingCat.toAlgHom η)
    (CommRingCat.toAlgHom σ) e q hf hi

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.exists_pointed_generic_equiv
statement:
private theorem exists_pointed_generic_equiv
    {B D : Type u} [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra (FractionRing R) B] [Algebra (FractionRing R) D]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (FractionRing R) B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (FractionRing R) D] :
    let : Algebra (FractionRing R)
        (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))
proof:
:=
      (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
    ∀ e : ((FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))) ⊗[FractionRing R] B)
      ≃ₐ[(FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))]
      ((FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))) ⊗[FractionRing R] D),
    ∃ (W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale)
      (t : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj W),
      let : Algebra (FractionRing R) (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W).right :=
        (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W).hom.hom.toAlgebra
      ∃ eW : ((geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W) ⊗[FractionRing R] B)
        ≃ₐ[(geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W)]
          ((geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W) ⊗[FractionRing R] D),
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
          (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ W t))
            (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) D)).comp
            (eW.toAlgHom.restrictScalars (FractionRing R)) =
          (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars (FractionRing R)).comp
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
              (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ W t))
            (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) B)) ∧
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
          (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ W t))
            (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) B)).comp
            (eW.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars (FractionRing R)) =
          (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars (FractionRing R)).comp
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
              (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ W t))
            (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) D)) := by
  intro scalarAction e
  obtain ⟨i, eᵢ, hforward, hinverse⟩ := exists_tensorProduct_algEquiv_stage_of_filteredColimit
    (geometricStalkSmallGenericAlgebraDiagram φ) (geometricStalkGenericFieldCocone φ)
      (geometricStalkGenericFieldCoconeIsColimit φ) e
  let j := (FinallySmall.fromFilteredFinalModel
    (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.Elementsᵒᵖ).obj i
  let W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale := j.unop.obj
  let t : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj W := j.unop.val
  refine ⟨W, t, ?_⟩
  intro stageAction
  exact ⟨eᵢ, hforward, hinverse⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_exists_affine_generic_tensorProduct_algEquiv
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_exists_affine_generic_tensorProduct_algEquiv
    {B D : Type u} [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra (FractionRing R) B] [Algebra (FractionRing R) D]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (FractionRing R) B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation (FractionRing R) D] :
    let : Algebra (FractionRing R)
        (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))
proof:
:=
      (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
    ∀ e : ((FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))) ⊗[FractionRing R] B)
      ≃ₐ[(FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))]
      ((FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))) ⊗[FractionRing R] D),
    ∃ (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale)
      (v : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj V),
      IsAffine V.left ∧
      let : Algebra (FractionRing R) (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V).right :=
        (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V).hom.hom.toAlgebra
      ∃ eV : ((geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) ⊗[FractionRing R] B)
        ≃ₐ[(geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V)]
          ((geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) ⊗[FractionRing R] D),
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
          (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v))
            (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) D)).comp
            (eV.toAlgHom.restrictScalars (FractionRing R)) =
          (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars (FractionRing R)).comp
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
              (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v))
            (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) B)) ∧
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
          (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v))
            (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) B)).comp
            (eV.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars (FractionRing R)) =
          (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars (FractionRing R)).comp
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
              (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v))
            (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) D)) := by
  intro scalarAction e
  obtain ⟨W, t, eW, hforward, hinverse⟩ := exists_pointed_generic_equiv φ e
  obtain ⟨V, v, j, hV, hj⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_affine_refinement
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) W t
  refine ⟨V, v, hV, ?_⟩
  intro stageAction
  exact ⟨scalarExtendUnderEquiv (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W)
      (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) (geometricNeighborhoodGenericMap R j) eW,
    scalarExtendUnderEquiv_squares (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R W)
      (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V)
      (Under.mk (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)))
      (geometricNeighborhoodGenericMap R j) (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v)
      (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ W t)
      (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm_naturality φ j v t hj)
      eW e hforward hinverse⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.piScalarRight_naturality
statement:
private theorem piScalarRight_naturality
    {K E F ι : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing E] [CommRing F]
    [Algebra K E] [Algebra K F] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (σ : E →ₐ[K] F) (x : E ⊗[K] (ι → K)) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight K F F ι
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K (ι → K)) x) =
      fun i => σ (Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight K E E ι x i)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul e f =>
    funext i
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight_tmul_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight_tmul_apply]
    exact (σ.toLinearMap.map_smul (f i) e).symm
  | add x y hx hy =>
    funext i
    simpa only [map_add, Pi.add_apply] using
      congrArg₂ (fun a b => a + b) (congrFun hx i) (congrFun hy i)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.exists_pi_equiv_of_tensor_squares
statement:
private theorem exists_pi_equiv_of_tensor_squares
    {K E F B ι : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing E] [CommRing F] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra K E] [Algebra K F] [Algebra K B] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (σ : E →ₐ[K] F) (eTensor : (E ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[E] (E ⊗[K] (ι → K)))
    (eSplit : (F ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[F] (ι → F))
    (hf : (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K (ι → K))).comp
        (eTensor.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) =
      ((eSplit.trans
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight K F F ι).symm).toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B)))
    (hi : (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B)).comp
        (eTensor.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) =
      ((eSplit.trans
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight K F F ι).symm).symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K (ι → K)))) :
    ∃ eProd : (E ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[E] (ι → E),
      (∀ x, (fun i => σ (eProd x i)) =
        eSplit (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B) x)) ∧
      (∀ y, Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B) (eProd.symm y) =
        eSplit.symm (fun i => σ (y i)))
proof:
:= by
  let ePi : (F ⊗[K] (ι → K)) ≃ₐ[F] (ι → F) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight K F F ι
  let ePiE : (E ⊗[K] (ι → K)) ≃ₐ[E] (ι → E) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight K E E ι
  refine ⟨eTensor.trans ePiE, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    change (fun i => σ (ePiE (eTensor x) i)) =
      eSplit (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B) x)
    calc
      (fun i => σ (ePiE (eTensor x) i)) =
        ePi (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K (ι → K)) (eTensor x)) :=
          (piScalarRight_naturality σ (eTensor x)).symm
      _ = ePi ((eSplit.trans ePi.symm)
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B) x)) :=
            congrArg ePi (AlgHom.congr_fun hf x)
      _ = eSplit (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B) x) :=
        ePi.apply_symm_apply _
  · intro y
    change Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B) (eTensor.symm (ePiE.symm y)) =
      eSplit.symm (fun i => σ (y i))
    calc
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B) (eTensor.symm (ePiE.symm y)) =
        (eSplit.trans ePi.symm).symm
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K (ι → K)) (ePiE.symm y)) :=
            AlgHom.congr_fun hi (ePiE.symm y)
      _ = eSplit.symm (fun i => σ (y i)) := by
        change eSplit.symm (ePi (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ
          (AlgHom.id K (ι → K)) (ePiE.symm y))) = eSplit.symm (fun i => σ (y i))
        apply congrArg eSplit.symm
        calc
          ePi (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K (ι → K)) (ePiE.symm y)) =
              fun i => σ (ePiE (ePiE.symm y) i) := piScalarRight_naturality σ _
          _ = fun i => σ (y i) := by rw [ePiE.apply_symm_apply]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_exists_affine_generic_split
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_exists_affine_generic_split
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra (FractionRing R) B]
    [Module.Finite (FractionRing R) B] (ι : Type u) [Finite ι] :
    let : Algebra (FractionRing R)
        (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))
proof:
:=
      (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
    ∀ e :
      (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) ⊗[FractionRing R] B)
        ≃ₐ[FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))]
          (ι → FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))),
    ∃ (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale)
      (v : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj V),
      IsAffine V.left ∧
      let : Algebra (FractionRing R) (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V).right :=
        (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V).hom.hom.toAlgebra
      ∃ eV : ((geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) ⊗[FractionRing R] B)
          ≃ₐ[geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V]
            (ι → geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V),
        (∀ x, (fun i => (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v))
              (eV x i)) = e (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
                (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v))
                (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) B) x)) ∧
        (∀ y, Algebra.TensorProduct.map
            (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v))
            (AlgHom.id (FractionRing R) B) (eV.symm y) =
          e.symm (fun i => (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v)) (y i))) := by
  intro scalarAction e
  classical
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let K := FractionRing R
  let F := FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
  have : Algebra.FinitePresentation K B := Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp inferInstance
  have : Algebra.FinitePresentation K (ι → K) :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp inferInstance
  let ePi : (F ⊗[K] (ι → K)) ≃ₐ[F] (ι → F) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight K F F ι
  obtain ⟨V, v, hV, eV, hf, hi⟩ :=
    geometricStalk_exists_affine_generic_tensorProduct_algEquiv φ (e.trans ePi.symm)
  refine ⟨V, v, hV, ?_⟩
  intro stageAction
  exact exists_pi_equiv_of_tensor_squares
    (show (geometricNeighborhoodGenericAlgebra R V) →ₐ[FractionRing R]
            FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) from
          CommRingCat.toAlgHom (geometricNeighborhoodGenericGerm φ V v)) eV e hf hi

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.fieldFromStalk_mem_complement
statement:
private theorem fieldFromStalk_mem_complement
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (x : X)
    {F : Type u} [Field F] (a : X.presheaf.stalk x →+* F)
    (ha : Function.Injective a) (y : Spec (.of F)) :
    X.fromSpecStalk x (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a) y) ∈ D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:= by
  intro hy
  have hle := (D.1.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_iff_stalkIdeal_le x
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom a) y)).mp hy
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hIt⟩ := D.2.exists_regular_stalkIdeal_generator x
  have htI : t ∈ D.1.stalkIdeal x := by
    rw [hIt]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self t
  have hat : a t ∈ y.asIdeal := hle htI
  have hybot : y.asIdeal = ⊥ :=
    congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (Subsingleton.elim y (⊥ : PrimeSpectrum F))
  rw [hybot, Ideal.mem_bot] at hat
  exact ht.left.ne_zero (ha (hat.trans (map_zero a).symm))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement_comp_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement_comp_ι
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (x : X)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)] [IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]

    geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement D x φ ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((algebraMap (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
          (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))).comp
            (geometricStalkStructureMap φ))) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x
proof:
:= by
  exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap_apply

theorem geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap_apply (r : R) :

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap_injective
statement:

proof:

    (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal.primeCompl
    (geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ)).mpr

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricNeighborhoodPrime_comap_structure
statement:
theorem geometricNeighborhoodPrime_comap_structure
    (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale)
    (v : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj V) :
    (geometricNeighborhoodPrime (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) V v).asIdeal.comap
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom) =
        (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let s := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  let β := ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom
  ext r
  change (v.left.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom) (β r) = 0 ↔
    φ r = 0
  have h₁ :
      geometricStalkEvaluation s (geometricStalkGerm s V v (β r)) =
        (v.left.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom) (β r) :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (geometricStalkGerm_evaluation s V v) (β r)
  have h₂ : geometricStalkGerm s V v (β r) = geometricStalkStructureMap φ r :=
    RingHom.congr_fun (geometricStalkGerm_comp_structure φ V v) r
  rw [← h₁, h₂, geometricStalkStructureMap_evaluation_apply]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap_apply
statement:
theorem geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap_apply
    (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale)
