    (r : R) :
    geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap φ V v
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal) r) =
    algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤)
      (Localization.AtPrime
        (geometricNeighborhoodPrime (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) V v).asIdeal)
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop) r)
proof:
:=
  Localization.localRingHom_to_map _ _ _ _ r

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap_germ
statement:
theorem geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap_germ
    (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etale)
    (v : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).fiber.obj V) :
    (geometricStalkLocalizedGerm (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) V v).comp
      (geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap φ V v) =
        geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal.primeCompl
  ext r
  change geometricStalkLocalizedGerm (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) V v
      (geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap φ V v
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal) r)) =
    geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap φ
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (geometricBasePrime φ).asIdeal) r)
  rw [geometricNeighborhoodBaseLocalizationMap_apply, geometricStalkLocalizedGerm_apply,
    geometricStalkBaseLocalizationMap_apply]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (geometricStalkGerm_comp_structure φ V v) r

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkFractionFieldMap_comp_fractionStalkToSupportComplement
statement:
theorem geometricStalkFractionFieldMap_comp_fractionStalkToSupportComplement
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (x : X)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)] [IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (φ : X.presheaf.stalk x →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ] :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)) ≫
        D.2.fractionStalkToSupportComplement x =
      geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement D x φ
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono D.1.supportComplement.ι).mp
  rw [Category.assoc, D.2.fractionStalkToSupportComplement_comp_ι,
    geometricStalkFractionFieldToComplement_comp_ι, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  exact geometricStalkFractionFieldMap_algebraMap φ a

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_exists_affine_refinement
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_exists_affine_refinement
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S) (W : S.Etale)
    (t : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj W) :
    ∃ (V : S.Etale) (v : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj V) (f : V ⟶ W),
      IsAffine V.left ∧ (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.map f v = t
proof:
:= by
  let tHom : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ W.left := t.left
  let p : W.left ⟶ S := W.hom
  obtain ⟨A, j, hj, hmem, _⟩ := Scheme.exists_affine_mem_range_and_range_subset
    (x := tHom default) (U := ⊤) (by trivial)
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := hj
  have hrange : Set.range tHom ⊆ Set.range j := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [Subsingleton.elim x default]
    exact hmem
  let l : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec A := IsOpenImmersion.lift j tHom hrange
  have hl : l ≫ j = tHom := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac j tHom hrange
  have hjp : Etale (j ≫ p) := by
    let : Etale p := W.prop
    exact Etale.etale_comp j p
  let V : S.Etale := MorphismProperty.Over.mk ⊤ (j ≫ p) hjp
  have hlp : l ≫ (j ≫ p) = s := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hl]
    exact Over.w t
  let v : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj V := by
    change Over.mk s ⟶ Over.mk (j ≫ p)
    exact Over.homMk l hlp
  let f : V ⟶ W := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (show V.left ⟶ W.left from j) rfl
  have hV : IsAffine V.left := by
    change IsAffine (Spec A)
    infer_instance
  refine ⟨V, v, f, hV, ?_⟩
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  exact hl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkStructureMap_flat
statement: theorem geometricStalkStructureMap_flat : (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).Flat
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  let : Algebra R (geometricStalk s) := (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
  change Module.Flat R (geometricStalk s)
  apply Module.Flat.of_forall_isTrivialRelation
  intro n c x hrel
  change ∑ i, geometricStalkStructureMap φ (c i) * x i = 0 at hrel
  obtain ⟨W, t, z, hz⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_representatives s x
  let βW : R →+* Γ(W.left, ⊤) :=
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ W.hom.appTop).hom
  have hcoeffW (r : R) : geometricStalkGerm s W t (βW r) =
      geometricStalkStructureMap φ r :=
    RingHom.congr_fun (geometricStalkGerm_comp_structure φ W t) r
  let u : Γ(W.left, ⊤) := ∑ i, βW (c i) * z i
  have hzero : geometricStalkGerm s W t u = geometricStalkGerm s W t 0 := by
    change geometricStalkGerm s W t (∑ i, βW (c i) * z i) = geometricStalkGerm s W t 0
    rw [map_sum, map_zero]
    simp only [map_mul, hcoeffW, hz]
    exact hrel
  obtain ⟨W₁, f, t₁, hf, hzero₁⟩ :=
    ((Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).toPresheafFiber_eq_iff'
      (P := etaleSections (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) W t u 0).mp hzero
  change f.left.appTop u = f.left.appTop 0 at hzero₁
  rw [map_zero] at hzero₁
  obtain ⟨V, v, g, hVaffine, hg⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_affine_refinement s W₁ t₁
  let : IsAffine V.left := hVaffine
  let j : V ⟶ W := g ≫ f
  have hj : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.map j v = t := by
    change (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.map (g ≫ f) v = t
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    change (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.map f
      ((Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.map g v) = t
    rw [hg, hf]
  let δ : Γ(W.left, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(V.left, ⊤) := j.left.appTop
  have hzeroV : δ u = 0 := by
    change (g.left ≫ f.left).appTop u = 0
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, CommRingCat.comp_apply, hzero₁, map_zero]
  let βV : R →+* Γ(V.left, ⊤) :=
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom
  have hbase : δ.hom.comp βW = βV := by
    change (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ W.hom.appTop) ≫
      j.left.appTop).hom = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom
    rw [Category.assoc, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    exact congrArg (fun k : V.left ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) =>
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ≫ k.appTop).hom)
      (MorphismProperty.Over.w j)
  have hcoeff (r : R) : δ (βW r) = βV r := RingHom.congr_fun hbase r
  have hrelV : ∑ i, βV (c i) * δ (z i) = 0 := by
    change δ (∑ i, βW (c i) * z i) = 0 at hzeroV
    simpa only [map_sum, map_mul, hcoeff] using hzeroV
  have hflatV : βV.Flat := by
    change (V.hom.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom).Flat
    exact (RingHom.Flat.of_bijective
      ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv).mp
        inferInstance)).comp
      (HasRingHomProperty.appTop (P := @Flat) (X := V.left)
        (Y := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) V.hom (inferInstanceAs (Flat V.hom)))
  let : Algebra R Γ(V.left, ⊤) := βV.toAlgebra
  let : Module.Flat R Γ(V.left, ⊤) := hflatV
  have hrelV' : ∑ i, c i • δ (z i) = 0 := hrelV
  obtain ⟨k, b, y, hzy, hc⟩ := Module.Flat.isTrivialRelation_of_sum_smul_eq_zero hrelV'
  have hgerm : δ ≫ geometricStalkGerm s V v = geometricStalkGerm s W t := by
    have h := (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).toPresheafFiber_w
      j v (etaleSections (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    rw [hj] at h
    exact h
  have hcoeffV (r : R) : geometricStalkGerm s V v (βV r) =
      geometricStalkStructureMap φ r :=
    RingHom.congr_fun (geometricStalkGerm_comp_structure φ V v) r
  refine ⟨k, b, (fun a => geometricStalkGerm s V v (y a)), ?_, hc⟩
  intro i
  have hzyi : δ (z i) = ∑ a, βV (b i a) * y a := hzy i
  change x i = ∑ a, geometricStalkStructureMap φ (b i a) * geometricStalkGerm s V v (y a)
  calc
    x i = geometricStalkGerm s V v (δ (z i)) :=
      ((ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hgerm (z i)).trans (hz i)).symm
    _ = geometricStalkGerm s V v (∑ a, βV (b i a) * y a) :=
      congrArg (geometricStalkGerm s V v) hzyi
    _ = ∑ a, geometricStalkStructureMap φ (b i a) * geometricStalkGerm s V v (y a) := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_mul, hcoeffV]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkStructureMap_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem geometricStalkStructureMap_faithfullyFlat [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalHom φ] :
    (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).FaithfullyFlat
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra R (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) :=
    (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
  let : Module.Flat R (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) :=
    geometricStalkStructureMap_flat φ
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))) := by
    change IsLocalHom (geometricStalkStructureMap φ)
    exact geometricStalkStructureMap_isLocalHom φ
  exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkStructureMap_injective
statement:
theorem geometricStalkStructureMap_injective [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalHom φ] :
    Function.Injective (geometricStalkStructureMap φ)
proof:
:=
  (geometricStalkStructureMap_faithfullyFlat φ).injective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkStructureMap_injective_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem geometricStalkStructureMap_injective_of_isDomain [IsDomain R] :
    Function.Injective (geometricStalkStructureMap φ)
proof:
:= by
  let A := geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
  let : Algebra R A := (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
  let : Module.Flat R A := geometricStalkStructureMap_flat φ
  intro a b hab
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  by_contra h
  have hm : geometricStalkStructureMap φ (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  have hrel : (a - b) • (1 : A) = (a - b) • (0 : A) := by
    change geometricStalkStructureMap φ (a - b) * 1 =
      geometricStalkStructureMap φ (a - b) * 0
    rw [hm]
    simp only [zero_mul]
  exact one_ne_zero
    (Module.Flat.isSMulRegular_of_nonZeroDivisors (M := A)
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr h) hrel)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.affineMorphismAlgebra_tower
statement:
private theorem affineMorphismAlgebra_tower
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing K] [Algebra R K]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) :
    let : Algebra K Γ(Y, ⊤)
proof:
:= affineMorphismAlgebra K h
    let : Algebra R Γ(Y, ⊤) := affineMorphismAlgebra R
      (h ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K)))
    IsScalarTower R K Γ(Y, ⊤) := by
  intro fieldAction baseAction
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro a
  change h.appTop ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))).appTop
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv a)) =
      h.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv (algebraMap R K a))
  exact congrArg h.appTop
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))) a).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.moduleFinite_affineMorphismAlgebra
proof:
:= affineMorphismAlgebra K h
    Module.Finite K Γ(Y, ⊤) := by
  intro sectionAction
  apply RingHom.finite_algebraMap.mp
  change (h.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv.hom).Finite
  exact h.finite_appTop.comp
    (RingHom.Finite.of_surjective _
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv).surjective)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.etale_normalization_of_affineMorphism_integralClosure
statement:
private theorem etale_normalization_of_affineMorphism_integralClosure
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) :
    let : Algebra R Γ(Y, ⊤)
proof:
:= affineMorphismAlgebra R f
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R Γ(Y, ⊤)) → Etale f.fromNormalization := by
  intro sectionAction hEt
  let n := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(Y, ⊤)))
  let eN : f.normalization ≅ n.normalization := affineMorphismNormalizationIso R f
  have heN : eN.hom ≫ n.fromNormalization = f.fromNormalization :=
    normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization f n Y.isoSpec
      (isoSpec_affineMorphismAlgebra R f)
  let eB := specNormalizationIso R Γ(Y, ⊤)
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R Γ(Y, ⊤))))
  have : Etale g := (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr
    (RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr hEt)
  have hcomp : Etale (eN.hom ≫ eB.hom ≫ g) := inferInstance
  have he : eN.hom ≫ eB.hom ≫ g = f.fromNormalization :=
    (congrArg (fun q => eN.hom ≫ q)
      (specNormalizationIso_hom_fromNormalization R Γ(Y, ⊤))).trans heN
  exact he ▸ hcomp

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.etale_fractionCover_normalization_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed
statement:
theorem etale_fractionCover_normalization_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed
    {R Ω : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (φ : R →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (V : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (FractionRing R))))
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsSepClosed Ω']
    (point : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶
      Spec (.of (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))))
    (hfixed : ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point))
      (w : (fiber (point ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)))).obj V),
      fundamentalGroupHom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)))
        point g • w = w) :
    Etale ((show V.left ⟶ Spec (.of (FractionRing R)) from V.hom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)))).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  let K := FractionRing R
  let h : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) := V.hom
  have : IsFiniteEtale h := V.2
  have : IsAffine V.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom h
  let B := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let r := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))
  let f : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := h ≫ r
  let : Algebra K B := affineMorphismAlgebra K h
  let : Algebra R B := affineMorphismAlgebra R f
  have : IsScalarTower R K B := affineMorphismAlgebra_tower R K h
  have : Module.Finite K B := moduleFinite_affineMorphismAlgebra K h
  have : Algebra.Etale K B := by
    apply RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mp
    change (h.appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv.hom).Etale
    apply RingHom.Etale.stableUnderComposition
    · exact RingHom.Etale.of_bijective
        (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv)
    · exact HasRingHomProperty.appTop (P := @Etale) h inferInstance
  have : IsFiniteEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))) :=
    IsFiniteEtale.SpecMap_iff.mpr (RingHom.finiteEtale_algebraMap_iff.mpr ⟨⟩)
  let W : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of K)) := mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B)))
  let E : V ≅ W := MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk V.left.isoSpec
    (isoSpec_affineMorphismAlgebra K h)
  have hEt : Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R B) := by
    apply integralClosure_etale_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed φ B point
    intro g w
    let F := fiber (point ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)))
    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (F.map E.inv)).injective
    exact (CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.mulAction_naturality F
      (fundamentalGroupHom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)))
        point g) E.inv w).symm.trans (hfixed g (F.map E.inv w))
  exact etale_normalization_of_affineMorphism_integralClosure R f hEt

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.isPullback_fractionCover_normalization
statement:
theorem isPullback_fractionCover_normalization
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    (V : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (FractionRing R)))) :
    IsPullback
      ((show V.left ⟶ Spec (.of (FractionRing R)) from V.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)))).toNormalization
      (show V.left ⟶ Spec (.of (FractionRing R)) from V.hom)
      ((show V.left ⟶ Spec (.of (FractionRing R)) from V.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)))).fromNormalization
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (FractionRing R))))
proof:
:= by
  let K := FractionRing R
  let h : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) := V.hom
  have : IsFiniteEtale h := V.2
  have : IsAffine V.left := isAffine_of_isAffineHom h
  let B := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let r := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))
  let f : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := h ≫ r
  let : Algebra K B := affineMorphismAlgebra K h
  let : Algebra R B := affineMorphismAlgebra R f
  have : IsScalarTower R K B := affineMorphismAlgebra_tower R K h
  have : Module.Finite K B := moduleFinite_affineMorphismAlgebra K h
  let n : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of R) := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))
  let E : f.normalization ≅ n.normalization := affineMorphismNormalizationIso R f
  have htop : f.toNormalization ≫ E.hom = V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫ n.toNormalization :=
    toNormalization_normalizationSourceIso_hom f n V.left.isoSpec
      (isoSpec_affineMorphismAlgebra R f)
  have hbase : E.hom ≫ n.fromNormalization = f.fromNormalization :=
    normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization f n V.left.isoSpec
      (isoSpec_affineMorphismAlgebra R f)
  have H : IsPullback n.toNormalization
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K B))) n.fromNormalization r :=
    isPullback_affineNormalization_generic R K B
  exact H.of_iso' V.left.isoSpec E (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    htop.symm
    ((isoSpec_affineMorphismAlgebra K h).trans (Category.comp_id h).symm)
    (hbase.trans (Category.comp_id f.fromNormalization).symm)
    (by simp only [r, K, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id])

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.fractionCover_normalization_finiteEtale_and_essImage_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed
statement:
theorem fractionCover_normalization_finiteEtale_and_essImage_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed
    {R Ω : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (φ : R →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (V : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (FractionRing R))))
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsSepClosed Ω']
    (point : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶
      Spec (.of (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))))
    (hfixed : ∀ (g : Aut (fiber point))
      (w : (fiber (point ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)))).obj V),
      fundamentalGroupHom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ)))
        point g • w = w) :
    IsFiniteEtale ((show V.left ⟶ Spec (.of (FractionRing R)) from V.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)))).fromNormalization ∧
      (FiniteEtale.pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (FractionRing R))))).essImage V
proof:
:= by
  let r := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (FractionRing R)))
  let f : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := V.hom ≫ r
  have : Etale f.fromNormalization :=
    etale_fractionCover_normalization_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed φ V point hfixed
  have : IsFinite f.fromNormalization :=
    (IsFinite.iff_isIntegralHom_and_locallyOfFiniteType f.fromNormalization).mpr
      ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  have hfinite : IsFiniteEtale f.fromNormalization := ⟨⟩
  refine ⟨hfinite, ?_⟩
  let Z : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of R)) := mk f.fromNormalization
  have H : IsPullback f.toNormalization
      (show V.left ⟶ Spec (.of (FractionRing R)) from V.hom) f.fromNormalization r :=
    isPullback_fractionCover_normalization R V
  let E : V ≅ (FiniteEtale.pullback r).obj Z :=
    MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk H.isoPullback H.isoPullback_hom_snd
  exact ⟨Z, ⟨E.symm⟩⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_eq_smallEtale_presheafFiber
statement:

proof:
:=

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkGerm_evaluation
statement:
theorem geometricStalkGerm_evaluation (W : S.Etale)
    (t : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj W) :
    geometricStalkGerm s W t ≫ geometricStalkEvaluation s =
      t.left.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberDesc _ _ W t

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_exists_representative
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_exists_representative (a : geometricStalk s) :
    ∃ (W : S.Etale) (t : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj W)
      (z : Γ(W.left, ⊤)), geometricStalkGerm s W t z = a
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective a

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_exists_representatives
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_exists_representatives {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (a : ι → geometricStalk s) :
    ∃ (W : S.Etale) (t : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj W)
      (z : ι → Γ(W.left, ⊤)), ∀ i, geometricStalkGerm s W t (z i) = a i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  choose W t z hz using fun i => geometricStalk_exists_representative s (a i)
  let F : Discrete ι ⥤ (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.Elements :=
    Discrete.functor fun i => (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.elementsMk (W i) (t i)
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := IsCofiltered.cone_nonempty F
  refine ⟨c.pt.obj, c.pt.val,
    (fun i => (etaleSections S).map (c.π.app ⟨i⟩).hom.op (z i)), ?_⟩
  intro i
  have h := (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).toPresheafFiber_w
    (c.π.app ⟨i⟩).hom c.pt.val (etaleSections S)
  have hval : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.map (c.π.app ⟨i⟩).hom c.pt.val =
      t i := (c.π.app ⟨i⟩).map_val
  simp only [hval] at h
  exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h (z i)).trans (hz i)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_isUnit_of_evaluation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_isUnit_of_evaluation_ne_zero
    (a : geometricStalk s) (ha : geometricStalkEvaluation s a ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, t, z, rfl⟩ := geometricStalk_exists_representative s a
  have heval := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (geometricStalkGerm_evaluation s W t) z
  have hvalue : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom (t.left.appTop z) ≠ 0 := by
    change (geometricStalkGerm s W t ≫ geometricStalkEvaluation s) z ≠ 0 at ha
    change (t.left.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom) z ≠ 0
    exact heval ▸ ha
  have hunitValue : IsUnit (t.left.appTop z) := by
    have hunit := (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hvalue).map
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).inv.hom
    change IsUnit (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Ω)).inv) (t.left.appTop z)) at hunit
    simpa only [Iso.hom_inv_id, CommRingCat.id_apply] using hunit
  let V : W.left.Opens := W.left.basicOpen z
  have hpointRange : Set.range t.left ⊆ Set.range V.ι := by
    apply Set.Subset.trans ?_ (Scheme.Opens.range_ι V).symm.subset
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    change y ∈ t.left ⁻¹ᵁ W.left.basicOpen z
    have hpreimage : t.left ⁻¹ᵁ W.left.basicOpen z =
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)).basicOpen (t.left.appTop z) :=
      Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top t.left z
    rw [hpreimage, (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)).basicOpen_of_isUnit hunitValue]
    trivial
  let l : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ V :=
    IsOpenImmersion.lift V.ι t.left hpointRange
  have hl : l ≫ V.ι = t.left :=
    IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac V.ι t.left hpointRange
  let T : S.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk (V.ι ≫ W.hom)
  let f : T ⟶ W := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk V.ι rfl
  let tV : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.obj T := Over.homMk l (by
    change l ≫ (V.ι ≫ W.hom) = s
    rw [← Category.assoc, hl]
    exact Over.w t)
  have htV : (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).fiber.map f tV = t := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact hl
  have hunitSection : IsUnit (V.ι.appTop z) := by
    apply RingedSpace.isUnit_of_isUnit_germ V.toScheme.toRingedSpace ⊤ (V.ι.appTop z)
    intro v _
    apply (V.toScheme.mem_basicOpen_top (V.ι.appTop z) v).mp
    rw [← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top]
    exact v.property
  have hgerm : geometricStalkGerm s T tV (V.ι.appTop z) =
      geometricStalkGerm s W t z := by
    have h := (Scheme.pointEtaleNeighborhoods s).toPresheafFiber_w f tV (etaleSections S)
    rw [htV] at h
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h z
  rw [← hgerm]
  exact hunitSection.map (geometricStalkGerm s T tV).hom

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalk_isUnit_iff
statement:
theorem geometricStalk_isUnit_iff (a : geometricStalk s) :
    IsUnit a ↔ geometricStalkEvaluation s a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    exact (ha.map (geometricStalkEvaluation s).hom).ne_zero
  · exact geometricStalk_isUnit_of_evaluation_ne_zero s a

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkFractionFieldMap_algebraMap
statement:
theorem geometricStalkFractionFieldMap_algebraMap (r : R) :
    geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ (algebraMap R (FractionRing R) r) =
      algebraMap (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
        (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))
        (geometricStalkStructureMap φ r)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.map_eq
    (nonZeroDivisors_le_comap_nonZeroDivisors_of_injective
      (geometricStalkStructureMap φ)
      (geometricStalkStructureMap_injective_of_isDomain φ)) r

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkGenericFieldEquiv_one_tmul
proof:
:=
      (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
    let : Algebra (FractionRing R)
        (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))) :=
      (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
    geometricStalkGenericFieldEquiv φ ((1 : FractionRing R) ⊗ₜ[R] a) =
      algebraMap (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
        (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))) a := by
  let A := geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
  let : Algebra R A := (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (FractionRing R) (FractionRing A) :=
    (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
  change geometricStalkFractionTensorEquiv φ
    (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] FractionRing R) a) = algebraMap A (FractionRing A) a
  exact (geometricStalkFractionTensorEquiv φ).commutes a

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkGenericFieldEquiv_tmul
proof:
:=
      (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
    let : Algebra (FractionRing R)
        (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))) :=
      (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
    geometricStalkGenericFieldEquiv φ (k ⊗ₜ[R] a) =
      geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ k *
        algebraMap (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
          (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))) a := by
  let A := geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
  let K := FractionRing R
  let : Algebra R A := (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra K (FractionRing A) := (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
  let e : (K ⊗[R] A) ≃ₐ[K] FractionRing A := geometricStalkGenericFieldEquiv φ
  calc
    e (k ⊗ₜ[R] a) = e ((k ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)) * ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] a)) := by
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
    _ = e (k ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)) * e ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] a) := map_mul e _ _
    _ = geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ k * algebraMap A (FractionRing A) a := by
      change e (algebraMap K (K ⊗[R] A) k) * e ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] a) = _
      rw [e.commutes]
      exact congrArg (fun z => geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ k * z)
        (geometricStalkGenericFieldEquiv_one_tmul φ a)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.geometricStalkGenericFieldCocone_tmul
statement:
theorem geometricStalkGenericFieldCocone_tmul (i : GeometricStalkAlgebraIndex φ)
    (k : FractionRing R) (z : (geometricStalkSmallAlgebraDiagram φ).obj i) :
    let : Algebra R ((geometricStalkSmallAlgebraDiagram φ).obj i).right
proof:
:=
      ((geometricStalkSmallAlgebraDiagram φ).obj i).hom.hom.toAlgebra
    ((geometricStalkGenericFieldCocone φ).ι.app i).right (k ⊗ₜ[R] z) =
      geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ k *
        algebraMap (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
          (FractionRing (geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))))
          (((geometricStalkSmallAlgebraCocone φ).ι.app i).right z) := by
  let : Algebra R ((geometricStalkSmallAlgebraDiagram φ).obj i).right :=
    ((geometricStalkSmallAlgebraDiagram φ).obj i).hom.hom.toAlgebra
  let A := geometricStalk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
  let : Algebra R A := (geometricStalkStructureMap φ).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (FractionRing R) (FractionRing A) :=
    (geometricStalkFractionFieldMap φ).toAlgebra
  change geometricStalkGenericFieldEquiv φ
    (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom (A := FractionRing R)
      (geometricStalkSmallAlgebraCocone φ) i (k ⊗ₜ[R] z)) = _
  rw [filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_tmul]
  exact geometricStalkGenericFieldEquiv_tmul φ k
    (CommRingCat.toAlgHom ((geometricStalkSmallAlgebraCocone φ).ι.app i) z)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.StrictHenselian.subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_of_strictHenselian
statement:
theorem subsingleton_fundamentalGroup_of_strictHenselian
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [HenselianLocalRing R]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of R)) : Subsingleton π₁ᵉᵗ(s)
proof:
:= by
  let : PreconnectedSpace (Spec (.of R)) := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    intro U V hU hV hcover hneU hneV
    rcases hcover (Set.mem_univ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) with h | h
    · obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := hneV
      exact ⟨v, trivial, (IsLocalRing.specializes_closedPoint v).mem_open hU h, hv⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, _, hu⟩ := hneU
      exact ⟨u, trivial, hu, (IsLocalRing.specializes_closedPoint u).mem_open hV h⟩
  let : ConnectedSpace (Spec (.of R)) := ⟨⟨IsLocalRing.closedPoint R⟩⟩
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  let r : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue R))
  let : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      ((@IsFinite : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) ⊓ (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})) :=
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.inf
  let : (pullback r).IsEquivalence := by
    have htransport (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
        (hP : P = (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}))
        (h : (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback P ⊤ r).IsEquivalence) :
        (pullback r).IsEquivalence := by
      subst P
      exact h
    exact htransport _ IsFiniteEtale.eq_inf.symm
      (pullback_isEquivalence_of_henselian (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))
  let e : π₁ᵉᵗ(ξ k k) ≃ₜ* π₁ᵉᵗ(ξ k k ≫ r) :=
    fundamentalGroupEquivOfPullbackEquivalence r (ξ k k)
  let : Subsingleton π₁ᵉᵗ(ξ k k) :=
    (absoluteGaloisToFiberAutMulEquiv k k inferInstance).symm.injective.subsingleton
  let : Subsingleton π₁ᵉᵗ(ξ k k ≫ r) := e.symm.injective.subsingleton
  obtain ⟨t⟩ := nonempty_fiber_iso s (ξ k k ≫ r)
  exact (fundamentalGroupIsoOfFiberIso s (ξ k k ≫ r) t).injective.subsingleton

theorem geometricStalk_exists_unit_mul_uniformizer_pow

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_normalizationInertia_coprime
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_normalizationInertia_coprime
    {A K L : Type u} {k : Type uk}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)]
    [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (hCharZero : ∀ j, j.1 < r →
      CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)))
    (hAwayBase : (Localization.awayMap
      (algebraMap A (integralClosure A L)) f).Etale)
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime]
    [Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A))]
    (phi : (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)) →+* k)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : p.Prime) :
    Nat.Coprime
      (Nat.card (Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K))) p
proof:
:= by
  let : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)) :=
    hCharZero i hi
  have hlocal : ∀ (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime],
      Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A) < P → P.height = 2 →
        IsUnit
          ((heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
              (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i : ℕ) :
            Localization.AtPrime P) := by
    intro P _ hstrict hheight
    have htiP : t i ∈ P :=
      hstrict.le (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (t i))
    exact
      splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisFullRootCover_selectedExponent_isUnit
        (K := K) (L := L) hNC i hi P hheight htiP
          hCharZero hAwayBase
  have hunit : IsUnit
      ((Q.ramificationIdx A : ℕ) :
        A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)) :=
    ramificationIdx_isUnit_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings_of_heightTwoSelectedBranchExponent
      (K := K) (L := L) hNC i hi Q hlocal
  exact
    normalizationInertia_coprime_of_ramificationIdx_isUnit
      (K := K) (L := L) (t i) (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi)
        Q hunit phi p hp

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.intermediateField_eq_adjoin_pow_finrank_of_pureRadical
statement:
theorem intermediateField_eq_adjoin_pow_finrank_of_pureRadical
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (α : L) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hpow : α ^ Module.finrank K L ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {α} = ⊤)
    (hroots : ∀ ζ : L, ζ ^ Module.finrank K L = 1 →
      ζ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (F : IntermediateField K L) :
    F = IntermediateField.adjoin K {α ^ Module.finrank F L}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hpow
  let e := Module.finrank K L
  let d := Module.finrank F L
  let N : F := (Algebra.norm F) α
  let ζ : L := algebraMap F L N / α ^ d
  have hpower : α ^ e = algebraMap K L c := by
    exact hc.symm
  have hN : N ≠ 0 := by
    exact Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hα
  have hmapN : algebraMap F L N ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero (algebraMap F L)).mpr hN
  have hαd : α ^ d ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero d hα
  have hnorm_pow : (algebraMap F L N) ^ e = (α ^ d) ^ e := by
    calc
      (algebraMap F L N) ^ e = algebraMap F L (N ^ e) := by rw [map_pow]
      _ = algebraMap F L ((Algebra.norm F) (α ^ e)) := by
        change algebraMap F L (((Algebra.norm F) α) ^ e) = _
        exact congrArg (algebraMap F L) (map_pow (Algebra.norm F) α e).symm
      _ = algebraMap F L ((Algebra.norm F) (algebraMap K L c)) := by
        rw [hpower]
      _ = algebraMap F L
          ((Algebra.norm F) (algebraMap F L (algebraMap K F c))) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K F L]
      _ = algebraMap F L ((algebraMap K F c) ^ d) := by
        rw [Algebra.norm_algebraMap]
      _ = (algebraMap K L c) ^ d := by
        rw [map_pow, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K F L]
      _ = (α ^ e) ^ d := by rw [hpower]
      _ = (α ^ d) ^ e := by
        rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hζpow : ζ ^ e = 1 := by
    dsimp only [ζ]
    rw [div_pow, hnorm_pow, div_self (pow_ne_zero e hαd)]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hroots ζ hζpow
  have hkL : algebraMap K L k ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hk]
    exact div_ne_zero hmapN hαd
  have hmul : algebraMap K L k * α ^ d = algebraMap F L N := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hαd).mp
    exact hk
  have hαd_eq : α ^ d = algebraMap F L (N / algebraMap K F k) := by
    calc
      α ^ d = algebraMap F L N / algebraMap K L k :=
        (eq_div_iff hkL).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hmul)
      _ = algebraMap F L N / algebraMap F L (algebraMap K F k) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K F L]
      _ = algebraMap F L (N / algebraMap K F k) := by
        exact (map_div₀ (algebraMap F L) N (algebraMap K F k)).symm
  have hαd_mem : α ^ d ∈ F := by
    rw [hαd_eq]
    exact (N / algebraMap K F k).property
  let M : IntermediateField K L := IntermediateField.adjoin K {α ^ d}
  have hMF : M ≤ F := by
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    simpa [M] using hαd_mem
  have hgenM : IntermediateField.adjoin M {α} = ⊤ :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top K hgen
  have hαintM : IsIntegral M α := IsIntegral.of_finite M α
  let β : M := ⟨α ^ d, by
    apply IntermediateField.subset_adjoin
    exact Set.mem_singleton _⟩
  have hroot : Polynomial.aeval α (X ^ d - C β) = 0 := by
    simp [β]
  have hdvd : minpoly M α ∣ X ^ d - C β := minpoly.dvd M α hroot
  have hdpos : 0 < d := Module.finrank_pos
  have hdegree : (minpoly M α).natDegree ≤ d := by
    rw [← Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C (r := β) (n := d)]
    exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hdvd
      (Polynomial.X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero hdpos β)
  have hML : Module.finrank M L ≤ d := by
    have hfinrank : Module.finrank M L = (minpoly M α).natDegree := by
      have h := IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hαintM
      rw [hgenM] at h
      simpa only [IntermediateField.finrank_top'] using h
    rw [hfinrank]
    exact hdegree
  have heq : Module.finrank M L = Module.finrank F L := by
    apply Nat.le_antisymm
    · simpa only [d] using hML
    · exact IntermediateField.finrank_le_of_le_left hMF
  symm
  exact IntermediateField.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq' hMF heq

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_intermediateField_eq_adjoin_pow_of_pureRadical
statement:
theorem exists_intermediateField_eq_adjoin_pow_of_pureRadical
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (α : L) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hpow : α ^ Module.finrank K L ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {α} = ⊤)
    (hroots : ∀ ζ : L, ζ ^ Module.finrank K L = 1 →
      ζ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (F : IntermediateField K L) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, d ∣ Module.finrank K L ∧
      F = IntermediateField.adjoin K {α ^ d}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Module.finrank F L, ?_,
    intermediateField_eq_adjoin_pow_finrank_of_pureRadical
      α hα hpow hgen hroots F⟩
  refine ⟨Module.finrank K F, ?_⟩
  rw [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank K F L, Nat.mul_comm]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponent_adjoin_root_eq_top
statement:
theorem pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponent_adjoin_root_eq_top
    {V : Type uV} {K : Type uK} {F : Type uF} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Field F] [Field L]
    [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Algebra K F] [Algebra K L]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (varpi : V) (hvarpi : Prime varpi)
    [Algebra (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [IsFractionRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [Algebra V F]
    [IsScalarTower V (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [IsScalarTower V K F]
    (m : Ideal (F ⊗[K] L)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    letI : Algebra L (GenericTensorFieldComponent m)
proof:
:=
      genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
    IntermediateField.adjoin L
        ({pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot
            (N := N) varpi m} :
          Set (GenericTensorFieldComponent m)) = ⊤ := by
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
  let P := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let rootRn : Rn := AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C varpi)
  let rootF : F := algebraMap Rn F rootRn
  let rootP : P :=
    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot (N := N) varpi m
  let iF : F →ₐ[K] P := genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m
  let iL : L →ₐ[K] P := genericTensorFieldComponentRight m
  let : Algebra L P := genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
  let : IsScalarTower K L P :=
    genericTensorFieldComponent_right_isScalarTower m
  let : IsScalarTower K F P :=
    genericTensorFieldComponent_isScalarTower m
  let : IsDomain Rn :=
    isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN varpi hvarpi
  let : Module.Finite V Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpi hN.ne').finite_adjoinRoot
  have hrootPow : rootP ^ N =
      algebraMap K P (algebraMap V K varpi) := by
    have hrootRn : rootRn ^ N = algebraMap V Rn varpi := by
      simpa only [rootRn, Rn, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq] using
        adjoinRoot_root_pow N varpi
    change (algebraMap F P (algebraMap Rn F rootRn)) ^ N = _
    calc
      _ = algebraMap F P ((algebraMap Rn F rootRn) ^ N) := by
        exact (map_pow (algebraMap F P)
          (algebraMap Rn F rootRn) N).symm
      _ = algebraMap F P (algebraMap Rn F (rootRn ^ N)) := by
        exact congrArg (algebraMap F P)
          (map_pow (algebraMap Rn F) rootRn N).symm
      _ = algebraMap F P (algebraMap Rn F
          (algebraMap V Rn varpi)) := by rw [hrootRn]
      _ = algebraMap K P (algebraMap V K varpi) := by
        rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V Rn F,
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V K F,
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K F P]
  let eFinite : (K ⊗[V] Rn) ≃ₐ[K] F :=
    finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv
      (R := V) (C := Rn) (K := K) (E := F)
  let ePure : (K ⊗[V] Rn) ≃ₐ[K]
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({rootP} : Set P) :=
    pureRadicalGenericFiberAlgEquiv
      hN varpi hvarpi rootP hrootPow
  let eF : F ≃ₐ[K] IntermediateField.adjoin K ({rootP} : Set P) :=
    eFinite.symm.trans ePure
  have hfiniteRoot :
      eFinite (1 ⊗ₜ[V] rootRn) = rootF := by
    simp [eFinite, rootF]
  have heFRoot : eF rootF =
      IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K rootP := by
    calc
      eF rootF = ePure (eFinite.symm rootF) := rfl
      _ = ePure (eFinite.symm (eFinite (1 ⊗ₜ[V] rootRn))) := by
        rw [hfiniteRoot]
      _ = ePure (1 ⊗ₜ[V] rootRn) := by
        rw [eFinite.symm_apply_apply]
      _ = IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K rootP :=
        pureRadicalGenericFiberAlgEquiv_tmul_root
          hN varpi hvarpi rootP hrootPow
  have hgenF : IntermediateField.adjoin K ({rootF} : Set F) = ⊤ := by
    apply (IntermediateField.map_injective eF.toAlgHom)
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_map, Set.image_singleton]
    change IntermediateField.adjoin K ({eF rootF} :
        Set (IntermediateField.adjoin K ({rootP} : Set P))) =
      IntermediateField.map eF.toAlgHom ⊤
    rw [heFRoot, ← AlgHom.fieldRange_eq_map, eF.fieldRange_eq_top]
    let Eroot := IntermediateField.adjoin K ({rootP} : Set P)
    change IntermediateField.adjoin K
      ({IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K rootP} : Set Eroot) = ⊤
    apply (IntermediateField.lift_injective Eroot)
    rw [IntermediateField.lift_adjoin_simple, IntermediateField.lift_top]
    rfl
  let E : IntermediateField L P :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin L ({rootP} : Set P)
  have hleft : iF.fieldRange ≤ E.restrictScalars K := by
    have hiFRoot : iF rootF = rootP := rfl
    rw [iF.fieldRange_eq_map, ← hgenF,
      IntermediateField.adjoin_map, Set.image_singleton, hiFRoot,
      IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro x rfl
    exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin L ({rootP} : Set P)
      (Set.mem_singleton rootP)
  have hright : iL.fieldRange ≤ E.restrictScalars K := by
    rintro y ⟨z, rfl⟩
    change algebraMap L P z ∈ E
    exact E.algebraMap_mem z
  have hsup : iF.fieldRange ⊔ iL.fieldRange = ⊤ :=
    genericTensorFieldComponent_fieldRange_sup_eq_top m
  apply top_unique
  intro z _
  have hz : z ∈ iF.fieldRange ⊔ iL.fieldRange := by
    rw [hsup]
    trivial
  exact (sup_le hleft hright) hz

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_add_pow_sub_pow_eq_linear_add_sq_mul
statement:
private theorem exists_add_pow_sub_pow_eq_linear_add_sq_mul
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (x y : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ q : R,
      (x + y) ^ n - x ^ n =
        (n : R) * x ^ (n - 1) * y + y ^ 2 * q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn.ne'
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨0, by ring⟩
  | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := ih (Nat.succ_pos k)
      refine ⟨((k + 1 : ℕ) : R) * x ^ k + q * (x + y), ?_⟩
      rw [pow_succ (x + y) (k + 1), pow_succ x (k + 1)]
      rw [show
        (x + y) ^ (k + 1) * (x + y) - x ^ (k + 1) * x =
          ((x + y) ^ (k + 1) - x ^ (k + 1)) * (x + y) +
            x ^ (k + 1) * y by ring]
      rw [hq]
      push_cast
      ring

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_dvr_pureRadical
statement:
theorem rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_dvr_pureRadical
    {V : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra V L] [IsScalarTower V K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hnUnit : IsUnit (n : V))
    (pi : V) (hpi : Prime pi)
    (alpha : L)
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = n)
    (halphaPow : alpha ^ n = algebraMap K L (algebraMap V K pi))
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {alpha} = ⊤)
    (zeta : L) (hzetaPow : zeta ^ n = 1) :
    zeta ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L)
proof:
:= by
  let p : V[X] := X ^ n - C pi
  let R := AdjoinRoot p
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := hn.ne'
  have hpMonic : p.Monic := monic_X_pow_sub_C pi hn0
  have hpIrreducibleMap :
      Irreducible (p.map (algebraMap V K)) := by
    simpa [p] using
      irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_fractionRing_of_prime hpi hn
  have hpIrreducible : Irreducible p :=
    (hpMonic.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map).2
      hpIrreducibleMap
  have hpPrime : Prime p := hpIrreducible.prime
  let : IsDomain R := AdjoinRoot.isDomain_of_prime hpPrime
  have hpiMem : pi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V := by
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hpi.not_isUnit
  let : IsLocalRing R :=
    isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn hpiMem
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V R :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn pi
  let phi : R →ₐ[V] L :=
    pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField pi alpha halphaPow
  let : Algebra R L := phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower V R L :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (phi.commutes a).symm
  let : IsFractionRing R L :=
    isFractionRing_adjoinRoot_of_pureRadical
      hn pi alpha hdegree halphaPow hgen
  have hpiNe : pi ≠ 0 := hpi.ne_zero
  have hpiIrreducible : Irreducible pi := hpi.irreducible
  have hmaxV :
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span {pi} :=
    hpiIrreducible.maximalIdeal_eq
  have hmaxR :
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R =
        Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root p} := by
    rw [maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn hpiMem]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply sup_le
      · rw [hmaxV, Ideal.map_span]
        simp only [Set.image_singleton]
        rw [show AdjoinRoot.of p pi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ n by
          simpa [p] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow n pi).symm]
        rw [Ideal.span_le]
        rintro _ (rfl : _ = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ n)
        exact Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem (Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root p})
          (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) n hn
      · exact le_rfl
    · exact le_sup_right
  have hrootNe : AdjoinRoot.root p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hroot
    have hmapPiNe : algebraMap V R pi ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hpiNe
      apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective V R
      simpa using hzero
    apply hmapPiNe
    rw [show algebraMap V R pi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ n by
      change AdjoinRoot.of p pi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ n
      simpa [p] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow n pi).symm,
      hroot, zero_pow hn0]
  have hRNotField : ¬ IsField R := by
    intro hfield
    have hbot : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R = ⊥ :=
      IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hfield
    have : AdjoinRoot.root p ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R) := by
      rw [← hbot, hmaxR]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    exact hrootNe (by simpa using this)
  have hprincipal :
      Submodule.IsPrincipal (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) := by
    exact ⟨AdjoinRoot.root p, hmaxR⟩
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing R :=
    ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE R hRNotField).out 5 1).mp hprincipal
  let : Module.Finite V R := hpMonic.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral V R := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite V R
  let coeffZero : R →ₗ[V] V :=
    (Polynomial.lcoeff V 0).comp (AdjoinRoot.modByMonicHom hpMonic)
  have hresidueCoeff (z : R) :
      IsLocalRing.residue R z =
        IsLocalRing.residue R (algebraMap V R (coeffZero z)) := by
    have hrootMem :
        AdjoinRoot.root p ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
      rw [hmaxR]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    have hrootResidue :
        IsLocalRing.residue R (AdjoinRoot.root p) = 0 :=
      (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 hrootMem
    let q : V[X] := AdjoinRoot.modByMonicHom hpMonic z
    have hzMk : AdjoinRoot.mk p q = z :=
      AdjoinRoot.mk_leftInverse hpMonic z
    change IsLocalRing.residue R z =
      IsLocalRing.residue R (algebraMap V R (q.coeff 0))
    rw [← hzMk]
    change IsLocalRing.residue R (AdjoinRoot.mk p q) =
      IsLocalRing.residue R (AdjoinRoot.of p (q.coeff 0))
    calc
      IsLocalRing.residue R (AdjoinRoot.mk p q) =
          IsLocalRing.residue R
            (AdjoinRoot.mk p (X * q.divX + C (q.coeff 0))) := by
        rw [Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add]
      _ = IsLocalRing.residue R (AdjoinRoot.of p (q.coeff 0)) := by
        rw [map_add, map_mul, AdjoinRoot.mk_X, AdjoinRoot.mk_C,
          map_add, map_mul, hrootResidue, zero_mul, zero_add]
  have hcoeffZero_algebraMap (a : V) :
      coeffZero (algebraMap V R a) = a := by
    change
      (AdjoinRoot.modByMonicHom hpMonic (AdjoinRoot.of p a)).coeff 0 = a
    rw [show AdjoinRoot.of p a = AdjoinRoot.mk p (C a) by rfl,
      AdjoinRoot.modByMonicHom_mk,
      (modByMonic_eq_self_iff hpMonic).2]
    · exact Polynomial.coeff_C_zero
    · rw [degree_X_pow_sub_C hn pi]
      exact degree_C_lt.trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  have hcoeffZero_smul (a : V) (z : R) :
      coeffZero (algebraMap V R a * z) = a * coeffZero z := by
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using coeffZero.map_smul a z
  have hcoeffZeroUnit {z : R} (hz : IsUnit z) :
      IsUnit (coeffZero z) := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit]
    intro hzero
    have hzResidueNe : IsLocalRing.residue R z ≠ 0 :=
      (IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit z).2 hz
    apply hzResidueNe
    rw [hresidueCoeff z, ← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
      hzero, map_zero]
  have hrootIrreducible : Irreducible (AdjoinRoot.root p) :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
      (AdjoinRoot.root p) hrootNe hmaxR
  have hzetaIntegral : IsIntegral V zeta := by
    refine ⟨X ^ n - C 1, monic_X_pow_sub_C 1 hn0, ?_⟩
    simp [hzetaPow]
  let b : R := IsIntegralClosure.mk' R zeta hzetaIntegral
  have hbL : algebraMap R L b = zeta :=
    IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_mk' R zeta hzetaIntegral
  have hbPow : b ^ n = 1 := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective R L
    rw [map_pow, hbL, hzetaPow, map_one]
  have hbUnit : IsUnit b := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_exists_inv]
    refine ⟨b ^ (n - 1), ?_⟩
    rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hn, hbPow]
  let a : V := coeffZero b
  have haUnit : IsUnit a := hcoeffZeroUnit hbUnit
  let d : R := b - algebraMap V R a
  have hcoeffD : coeffZero d = 0 := by
    simp [d, a, hcoeffZero_algebraMap]
  by_cases hd : d = 0
  · refine ⟨algebraMap V K a, ?_⟩
    have hbEq : b = algebraMap V R a := by
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      simpa only [d] using hd
    calc
      algebraMap K L (algebraMap V K a) = algebraMap V L a :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V K L a).symm
      _ = algebraMap R L (algebraMap V R a) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V R L]
      _ = algebraMap R L b := by rw [hbEq]
      _ = zeta := hbL
  · obtain ⟨s, ud, hdFactor⟩ :=
      IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible
        hd hrootIrreducible
    have hsPos : 0 < s := by
      apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      intro hs
      have hdUnit : IsUnit d := by
        rw [hdFactor, hs, pow_zero, mul_one]
        exact ud.isUnit
      exact (hcoeffZeroUnit hdUnit).ne_zero hcoeffD
    have hsNotDvd : ¬ n ∣ s := by
      rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
      have hrootPow :
          AdjoinRoot.root p ^ n = algebraMap V R pi := by
        change AdjoinRoot.root p ^ n = AdjoinRoot.of p pi
        simpa [p] using adjoinRoot_root_pow n pi
      have hdFactor' :
          d = algebraMap V R (pi ^ q) * (ud : R) := by
        rw [hdFactor, pow_mul, hrootPow, map_pow]
        ring
      apply (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero q hpiNe)
        (hcoeffZeroUnit ud.isUnit).ne_zero)
      rw [← hcoeffZero_smul, ← hdFactor', hcoeffD]
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
      exists_add_pow_sub_pow_eq_linear_add_sq_mul
        (algebraMap V R a) d n hn
    have hbDecomp : algebraMap V R a + d = b := by
      simp [d]
    have hleadUnit : IsUnit
        ((n : R) * (algebraMap V R a) ^ (n - 1) * (ud : R)) :=
      ((hnUnit.map (algebraMap V R)).mul
        ((haUnit.map (algebraMap V R)).pow (n - 1))).mul ud.isUnit
    let leadUnit : Rˣ := hleadUnit.unit
    have hlead :
        (n : R) * (algebraMap V R a) ^ (n - 1) * d =
          (leadUnit : R) * AdjoinRoot.root p ^ s := by
      rw [hdFactor]
      rw [show (leadUnit : R) =
          (n : R) * (algebraMap V R a) ^ (n - 1) * (ud : R) by
        exact hleadUnit.unit_spec]
      ring
    have hleftBase :
        (algebraMap V R a + d) ^ n - (algebraMap V R a) ^ n =
          algebraMap V R (1 - a ^ n) := by
      rw [hbDecomp, hbPow, map_sub, map_one, map_pow]
    have hqTermValGt :
        IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R
              ((leadUnit : R) * AdjoinRoot.root p ^ s) <
          IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (d ^ 2 * q) := by
      rw [IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_def' leadUnit hrootIrreducible s]
      by_cases hqZero : q = 0
      · rw [hqZero, mul_zero, IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_zero]
        exact ENat.natCast_lt_top s
      · obtain ⟨k, uq, hqFactor⟩ :=
          IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible
            hqZero hrootIrreducible
        let remainderUnit : Rˣ := ud ^ 2 * uq
        have hrem :
            d ^ 2 * q =
              (remainderUnit : R) * AdjoinRoot.root p ^ (2 * s + k) := by
          rw [hdFactor, hqFactor]
          change
            ((ud : R) * AdjoinRoot.root p ^ s) ^ 2 *
                ((uq : R) * AdjoinRoot.root p ^ k) =
              ((ud : R) ^ 2 * (uq : R)) *
                AdjoinRoot.root p ^ (2 * s + k)
          simp only [mul_pow, pow_add, pow_mul]
          ring
        rw [hrem,
          IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_def' remainderUnit
            hrootIrreducible (2 * s + k)]
        exact_mod_cast (by omega : s < 2 * s + k)
    have hleftVal :
        IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R
            ((algebraMap V R a + d) ^ n -
              (algebraMap V R a) ^ n) = s := by
      rw [hq, hlead]
      calc
        IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R
            ((leadUnit : R) * AdjoinRoot.root p ^ s + d ^ 2 * q) =
            IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R
              ((leadUnit : R) * AdjoinRoot.root p ^ s) :=
          (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R).map_add_eq_of_lt_left
            hqTermValGt
        _ = s := IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_def'
          leadUnit hrootIrreducible s
    have hbaseNe : 1 - a ^ n ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      rw [hleftBase, hzero, map_zero,
        IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_zero] at hleftVal
      exact (ENat.natCast_ne_top s) hleftVal.symm
    obtain ⟨k, uk, hkFactor⟩ :=
      IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible
        hbaseNe hpiIrreducible
    let baseUnit : Rˣ := Units.map (algebraMap V R) uk
    have hbaseFactor :
        algebraMap V R (1 - a ^ n) =
          (baseUnit : R) * AdjoinRoot.root p ^ (n * k) := by
      rw [hkFactor, map_mul, map_pow]
      simp only [baseUnit, Units.coe_map]
      rw [show algebraMap V R pi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ n by
        change AdjoinRoot.of p pi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ n
        simpa [p] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow n pi).symm,
        pow_mul]
      rfl
    have hsEq : s = n * k := by
      have := hleftVal
      rw [hleftBase, hbaseFactor,
        IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_def' baseUnit
          hrootIrreducible (n * k)] at this
      exact (ENat.natCast_inj.mp this).symm
    exact (hsNotDvd ⟨k, hsEq⟩).elim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_henselian_of_residue_bijective
statement:
theorem rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_henselian_of_residue_bijective
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} {K : Type w} {L : Type x}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [HenselianLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A K] [Algebra B L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsFractionRing B L] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral A B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)]
    {n : ℕ} (hnUnit : IsUnit (n : A))
    (hresidue : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)))
    (ζ : L) (hζpow : ζ ^ n = 1) :
    ζ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := by
    intro hn
    subst n
    rw [Nat.cast_zero] at hnUnit
    exact not_isUnit_zero hnUnit
  let f : A[X] := X ^ n - C 1
  have hfMonic : f.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C 1 hn
  have hζIntegral : IsIntegral A ζ := by
    refine ⟨f, hfMonic, ?_⟩
    simp [f, hζpow]
  let b : B := IsIntegralClosure.mk' B ζ hζIntegral
  have hbL : algebraMap B L b = ζ := by
    exact IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_mk' B ζ hζIntegral
  have hbpow : b ^ n = 1 := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective B L
    rw [map_pow, hbL, hζpow, map_one]
  let residueMap := IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ :=
    hresidue.2 (IsLocalRing.residue B b)
  have ha₀pow : a₀ ^ n = 1 := by
    apply hresidue.1
    calc
      residueMap (a₀ ^ n) = residueMap a₀ ^ n := map_pow _ _ _
      _ = IsLocalRing.residue B b ^ n := by rw [ha₀]
      _ = IsLocalRing.residue B (b ^ n) := (map_pow _ _ _).symm
      _ = 1 := by rw [hbpow, map_one]
      _ = residueMap 1 := (map_one _).symm
  have ha₀ne : a₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha₀zero
    rw [ha₀zero, zero_pow hn] at ha₀pow
    exact zero_ne_one ha₀pow
  have hnResidue : (n : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using
      (IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (n : A)).2 hnUnit
  have hfRootResidue : Polynomial.aeval a₀ f = 0 := by
    simp [f, ha₀pow]
  have hfDerivativeResidue : Polynomial.aeval a₀ f.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [f, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow] using
      mul_ne_zero hnResidue (pow_ne_zero (n - 1) ha₀ne)
  have hHensel := ((HenselianLocalRing.TFAE A).out 1 2).mp
    (inferInstance : HenselianLocalRing A)
  obtain ⟨a, haRoot, haResidue⟩ :=
    hHensel f hfMonic a₀ hfRootResidue hfDerivativeResidue
  have hbUnit : IsUnit b := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_exists_inv]
    refine ⟨b ^ (n - 1), ?_⟩
    rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn), hbpow]
  have hresidueB :
      IsLocalRing.residue B (algebraMap A B a) =
        IsLocalRing.residue B b := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue, haResidue, ha₀]
  have hnotUnit : ¬ IsUnit (b - algebraMap A B a) := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit]
    simp [hresidueB]
  have hbRoot : (f.map (algebraMap A B)).eval b = 0 := by
    simp [f, hbpow]
  have hmapRoot :
      (f.map (algebraMap A B)).eval (algebraMap A B a) = 0 := by
    simpa [Polynomial.eval_map] using
      congrArg (algebraMap A B) (Polynomial.IsRoot.def.mp haRoot)
  have hbDerivativeUnit :
      IsUnit ((f.map (algebraMap A B)).derivative.eval b) := by
    simpa [f, Polynomial.derivative_map, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow] using
      (hnUnit.map (algebraMap A B)).mul (hbUnit.pow (n - 1))
  have hbEq : b = algebraMap A B a := by
    exact IsLocalRing.eq_of_eval_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_sub
      hbRoot hmapRoot hnotUnit hbDerivativeUnit
  refine ⟨algebraMap A K a, ?_⟩
  calc
    algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K a) = algebraMap A L a :=
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L a).symm
    _ = algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a) := by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L]
    _ = algebraMap B L b := by rw [hbEq]
    _ = ζ := hbL

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_intermediateField_eq_adjoin_pow_of_henselian_pureRadical
statement:
theorem exists_intermediateField_eq_adjoin_pow_of_henselian_pureRadical
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} {K : Type w} {L : Type x}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [HenselianLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A K] [Algebra B L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsFractionRing B L] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral A B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (α : L) (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hpow : α ^ Module.finrank K L ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {α} = ⊤)
    (hdegreeUnit : IsUnit (Module.finrank K L : A))
    (hresidue : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)))
    (F : IntermediateField K L) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, d ∣ Module.finrank K L ∧
      F = IntermediateField.adjoin K {α ^ d}
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_intermediateField_eq_adjoin_pow_of_pureRadical
    α hα hpow hgen
  intro ζ hζpow
  exact rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_henselian_of_residue_bijective
    hdegreeUnit hresidue ζ hζpow

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField_root
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {F : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [Field K] [Field F]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra K F] [Algebra A F] [IsScalarTower A K F]
    {m : ℕ} (t : A) (β : F)
    (hβpow : β ^ m = algebraMap K F (algebraMap A K t)) :
    pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField t β hβpow
      (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ m - C t)) = β
proof:
:= by
  simp [pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isFractionRing_adjoinRoot_of_pureRadical
statement:
theorem isFractionRing_adjoinRoot_of_pureRadical
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {F : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Field K] [Field F]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K F] [Algebra A F] [IsScalarTower A K F]
    [FiniteDimensional K F]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : A) (β : F)
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K F = m)
    (hβpow : β ^ m = algebraMap K F (algebraMap A K t))
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {β} = ⊤) :
    let φ
proof:
:= pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField t β hβpow
    letI : Algebra (AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C t)) F :=
      φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    IsFractionRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C t)) F := by
  let p : A[X] := X ^ m - C t
  let R := AdjoinRoot p
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := hm.ne'
  have hpMonic : p.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C t hm0
  have hβintK : IsIntegral K β := IsIntegral.of_finite K β
  have hminDegree : (minpoly K β).natDegree = m := by
    have h := IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hβintK
    rw [hgen] at h
    calc
      (minpoly K β).natDegree = Module.finrank K F := by
        simpa only [IntermediateField.finrank_top'] using h.symm
      _ = m := hdegree
  have hpMapRoot :
      Polynomial.aeval β (p.map (algebraMap A K)) = 0 := by
    simp [p, hβpow]
  have hminDvd : minpoly K β ∣ p.map (algebraMap A K) :=
    minpoly.dvd K β hpMapRoot
  have hpMapEq : p.map (algebraMap A K) = minpoly K β := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
      (minpoly.monic hβintK) (hpMonic.map (algebraMap A K)) hminDvd
    have hpMapDegree : (p.map (algebraMap A K)).natDegree = m := by
      simp [p]
    rw [hpMapDegree, hminDegree]
  let φ : R →ₐ[A] F :=
    pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField t β hβpow
  have hφInjective : Function.Injective φ := by
    rw [RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot]
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro z hz
      have hzmap : φ z = 0 := RingHom.mem_ker.mp hz
      have hz0 : z = 0 := by
        induction z using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
        | _ q =>
            change q.eval₂ (Algebra.ofId A F) β = 0 at hzmap
            rw [AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero]
            apply (Polynomial.map_dvd_map (algebraMap A K)
              (IsFractionRing.injective A K) hpMonic).mp
            rw [hpMapEq]
            apply minpoly.dvd K β
            rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_map,
              ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A K F]
            exact hzmap
      simpa only [Ideal.mem_bot] using hz0
    · exact bot_le
  let : Algebra R F := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A R F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (φ.commutes a).symm
  have hRF : Function.Injective (algebraMap R F) := by
    exact hφInjective
  let : IsDomain R := hRF.isDomain _
  let : FaithfulSMul R F :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R F).mpr hRF
  have hAR : Function.Injective (algebraMap A R) := by
    intro a b hab
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    apply (algebraMap K F).injective
    calc
      algebraMap K F (algebraMap A K a) = algebraMap A F a :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K F a).symm
      _ = algebraMap R F (algebraMap A R a) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A R F a
      _ = algebraMap R F (algebraMap A R b) := by rw [hab]
      _ = algebraMap A F b :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A R F b).symm
      _ = algebraMap K F (algebraMap A K b) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K F b
  let fractionSubfield : Subfield F :=
    { carrier := {z | ∃ x y : R, y ≠ 0 ∧
          z = algebraMap R F x / algebraMap R F y}
      zero_mem' := ⟨0, 1, one_ne_zero, by simp only [map_zero, map_one, div_one]⟩
      one_mem' := ⟨1, 1, one_ne_zero, by simp only [map_one, div_one]⟩
      add_mem' := by
        rintro z w ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ ⟨c, d, hd, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨a * d + c * b, b * d, mul_ne_zero hb hd, ?_⟩
        rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul]
        calc
          algebraMap R F a / algebraMap R F b +
              algebraMap R F c / algebraMap R F d =
              (algebraMap R F a * algebraMap R F d +
                algebraMap R F b * algebraMap R F c) /
                (algebraMap R F b * algebraMap R F d) :=
            div_add_div _ _
              ((map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap R F) hRF).2 hb)
              ((map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap R F) hRF).2 hd)
          _ = (algebraMap R F a * algebraMap R F d +
                algebraMap R F c * algebraMap R F b) /
                (algebraMap R F b * algebraMap R F d) := by ring
      neg_mem' := by
        rintro z ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨-a, b, hb, by rw [map_neg, neg_div]⟩
      mul_mem' := by
        rintro z w ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ ⟨c, d, hd, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨a * c, b * d, mul_ne_zero hb hd, ?_⟩
        rw [map_mul, map_mul]
        exact div_mul_div_comm _ _ _ _
      inv_mem' := by
        rintro z ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩
        by_cases ha : a = 0
        · exact ⟨0, 1, one_ne_zero, by simp [ha]⟩
        · refine ⟨b, a, ha, ?_⟩
          rw [inv_div]
          }
  have hKmem (k : K) : algebraMap K F k ∈ fractionSubfield := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hk⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective A k
    refine ⟨algebraMap A R a, algebraMap A R b,
      (map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap A R) hAR).2 ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb
    · calc
        algebraMap K F k =
            algebraMap K F
              (algebraMap A K a / algebraMap A K b) := by rw [hk]
        _ = algebraMap A F a / algebraMap A F b := by
          rw [map_div₀, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K F,
            IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K F]
        _ = algebraMap R F (algebraMap A R a) /
            algebraMap R F (algebraMap A R b) := by
          rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A R F,
            IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A R F]
  have hβmem : β ∈ fractionSubfield := by
    refine ⟨AdjoinRoot.root p, 1, one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
    change β = φ (AdjoinRoot.root p) / φ 1
    rw [map_one, div_one]
    exact (pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField_root t β hβpow).symm
  let E : IntermediateField K F :=
    fractionSubfield.toIntermediateField hKmem
  have hEtop : E = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hgen, IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz]
    exact hβmem
  have hsurjective : ∀ z : F, ∃ x y : R,
      z = algebraMap R F x / algebraMap R F y := by
    intro z
    have hz : z ∈ E := by rw [hEtop]; trivial
    change z ∈ fractionSubfield at hz
    obtain ⟨x, y, _hy, hxy⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨x, y, hxy⟩
  exact IsFractionRing.of_field R F hsurjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_adjoinRoot_algEquiv_integralClosure_of_pureRadical
statement:
theorem exists_adjoinRoot_algEquiv_integralClosure_of_pureRadical
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {F : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Field K] [Field F]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K F] [Algebra A F] [IsScalarTower A K F]
    [FiniteDimensional K F]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : A) (β : F)
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K F = m)
    (hβpow : β ^ m = algebraMap K F (algebraMap A K t))
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {β} = ⊤)
    [IsIntegrallyClosed (AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C t))] :
    ∃ e : AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C t) ≃ₐ[A] integralClosure A F,
      algebraMap (integralClosure A F) F
        (e (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ m - C t))) = β
proof:
:= by
  let p : A[X] := X ^ m - C t
  let R := AdjoinRoot p
  let φ : R →ₐ[A] F :=
    pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField t β hβpow
  let : Algebra R F := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsFractionRing R F :=
    isFractionRing_adjoinRoot_of_pureRadical
      hm t β hdegree hβpow hgen
  let : IsDomain R := (IsFractionRing.injective R F).isDomain _
  let : IsScalarTower A R F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (φ.commutes a).symm
  have hpMonic : p.Monic :=
    Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C t hm.ne'
  let : Module.Finite A R := hpMonic.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A R := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A R
  let e : R ≃ₐ[A] integralClosure A F :=
    IsIntegralClosure.equiv A R F (integralClosure A F)
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  rw [IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_equiv]
  change φ (AdjoinRoot.root p) = β
  exact pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField_root t β hβpow

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_intermediateField_generator_pow_eq_of_pureRadical
statement:
theorem exists_intermediateField_generator_pow_eq_of_pureRadical
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (α : L) (hα : α ≠ 0) (π : K)
    (hpow : α ^ Module.finrank K L = algebraMap K L π)
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {α} = ⊤)
    (hroots : ∀ ζ : L, ζ ^ Module.finrank K L = 1 →
      ζ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (F : IntermediateField K L) :
    ∃ β : F,
      (β : L) = α ^ Module.finrank F L ∧
        β ^ Module.finrank K F = algebraMap K F π ∧
          IntermediateField.adjoin K ({(β : L)} : Set L) = F ∧
            Module.finrank K F * Module.finrank F L =
              Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  let d := Module.finrank F L
  have hclass :
      F = IntermediateField.adjoin K
        {α ^ d} := by
    simpa only [d] using
      intermediateField_eq_adjoin_pow_finrank_of_pureRadical
        α hα ⟨π, hpow.symm⟩ hgen hroots F
  have hmem : α ^ d ∈ F := by
    rw [hclass]
    exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
  let β : F := ⟨α ^ d, hmem⟩
  refine ⟨β, by rfl, ?_, ?_, Module.finrank_mul_finrank K F L⟩
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change (α ^ d) ^ Module.finrank K F =
      algebraMap K L π
    calc
      (α ^ d) ^ Module.finrank K F =
          α ^ (d * Module.finrank K F) := by
        rw [pow_mul]
      _ = α ^ (Module.finrank K F * d) := by
        rw [Nat.mul_comm]
      _ = α ^ Module.finrank K L := by
        dsimp only [d]
        rw [Module.finrank_mul_finrank K F L]
      _ = algebraMap K L π := hpow
  · simpa only [β, d] using hclass.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_intermediateField_generator_pow_eq_of_henselian_pureRadical
statement:
theorem exists_intermediateField_generator_pow_eq_of_henselian_pureRadical
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} {K : Type w} {L : Type x}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [HenselianLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A K] [Algebra B L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [IsFractionRing B L] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral A B] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B)]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (α : L) (hα : α ≠ 0) (π : K)
    (hpow : α ^ Module.finrank K L = algebraMap K L π)
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {α} = ⊤)
    (hdegreeUnit : IsUnit (Module.finrank K L : A))
    (hresidue : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)))
    (F : IntermediateField K L) :
    ∃ β : F,
      (β : L) = α ^ Module.finrank F L ∧
        β ^ Module.finrank K F = algebraMap K F π ∧
          IntermediateField.adjoin K ({(β : L)} : Set L) = F ∧
            Module.finrank K F * Module.finrank F L =
              Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_intermediateField_generator_pow_eq_of_pureRadical
    α hα π hpow hgen
  intro ζ hζpow
  exact rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_henselian_of_residue_bijective
    hdegreeUnit hresidue ζ hζpow

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_primeParameter_pureRadical
statement:
theorem rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_primeParameter_pureRadical
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    {t : A} (ht : Prime t)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t}))
    (alpha : L)
    (halphaPow : alpha ^ Module.finrank K L =
      algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K t))
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {alpha} = ⊤)
    (zeta : L) (hzetaPow : zeta ^ Module.finrank K L = 1) :
    zeta ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L)
proof:
:= by
  let P : Ideal A := Ideal.span {t}
  let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ht
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let pi : V := algebraMap A V t
  have hAVInjective : Function.Injective (algebraMap A V) :=
    IsLocalization.injective V P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  have hpiNe : pi ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply ht.ne_zero
    apply hAVInjective
    simpa [pi] using hzero
  have hmaxV :
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span {pi} := by
    calc
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V =
          Ideal.map (algebraMap A V) P :=
        (Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal).symm
      _ = Ideal.span {pi} := by
        simp [P, pi, Ideal.map_span]
  have hVNotField : ¬ IsField V := by
    intro hfield
    have hbot : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = ⊥ :=
      IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hfield
    have : pi ∈ (⊥ : Ideal V) := by
      rw [← hbot, hmaxV]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    exact hpiNe (by simpa using this)
  have hprincipal :
      Submodule.IsPrincipal (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) :=
    ⟨pi, hmaxV⟩
  let : IsNoetherianRing V :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing P.primeCompl V inferInstance
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE V hVNotField).out 5 1).mp hprincipal
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : IsScalarTower A V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower (K := K) P
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : CharZero (A ⧸ P) := hCharZero
  let n := Module.finrank K L
  have hn : 0 < n := Module.finrank_pos
  have hnNotMem : (n : A) ∉ P := by
    intro hnMem
    have hnZero : (n : A ⧸ P) = 0 :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hnMem
    exact (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne') hnZero
  have hnUnit : IsUnit (n : V) := by
    simpa using
      (IsLocalization.map_units V
        (⟨(n : A), hnNotMem⟩ : P.primeCompl))
  have hpiPrime : Prime pi := by
    apply irreducible_iff_prime.mp
    exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
      pi hpiNe hmaxV
  have halphaPowV :
      alpha ^ n = algebraMap K L (algebraMap V K pi) := by
    rw [show algebraMap V K pi = algebraMap A K t by
      exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A V K t).symm]
    exact halphaPow
  exact rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_dvr_pureRadical
    (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
    hn hnUnit pi hpiPrime alpha rfl halphaPowV hgen zeta hzetaPow

theorem pureRadicalGenericFiberAlgEquiv_tmul_root
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {Omega : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
