name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRoot_ringHom_eq_of_comp_subtype_eq
statement:
private theorem adjoinRoot_ringHom_eq_of_comp_subtype_eq
    {A : Type u} {E Omega : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing E] [CommRing Omega]
    (p : A[X]) (i : E →+* Omega) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (f g : AdjoinRoot p →+* E)
    (hcoeff : ∀ z : A,
      i (f (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot p) z)) =
        i (g (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot p) z)))
    (hroot : i (f (AdjoinRoot.root p)) = i (g (AdjoinRoot.root p))) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext
  · apply RingHom.ext
    intro z
    apply hi
    simpa [AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq] using hcoeff z
  · exact hi hroot

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.higherRoot_genericMaps_comp_eq
statement:
theorem higherRoot_genericMaps_comp_eq
    {A K : Type u} {Omega : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [Field K] [Field Omega] [Algebra K Omega]
    (F : IntermediateField K Omega) (K' : IntermediateField F Omega)
    {e N : ℕ} (a : A) (hdiv : e ∣ N)
    (fN : AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C a) →+* K')
    (fE : AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C a) →+* F)
    (hcoeff : ∀ z : A,
      ((fN (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C a)) z) : K') : Omega) =
        ((algebraMap F K'
          (fE (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C a)) z)) : K') : Omega))
    (beta alpha : Omega)
    (hNroot : ((fN (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C a)) : K') : Omega) = beta)
    (hEroot : ((fE (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C a)) : F) : Omega) = alpha)
    (halpha : beta ^ (N / e) = alpha) :
    fN.comp (adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd hdiv a).toRingHom =
      (algebraMap F K').comp fE
proof:
:= by
  apply adjoinRoot_ringHom_eq_of_comp_subtype_eq
    (p := X ^ e - C a) (i := K'.toSubfield.subtype)
    (hi := K'.toSubfield.subtype.injective)
  · intro z
    change ((fN ((adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd hdiv a)
        (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C a)) z)) : K') : Omega) =
      ((algebraMap F K'
        (fE (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C a)) z)) : K') : Omega)
    rw [(adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd hdiv a).commutes]
    exact hcoeff z
  · change ((fN ((adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd hdiv a)
        (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C a))) : K') : Omega) =
      ((algebraMap F K' (fE (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C a))) : K') : Omega)
    rw [adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd_root, map_pow]
    exact intermediateField_coe_pow_eq_algebraMap_of_eq
      (K := K) (Omega := Omega) F K'
      (fN (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C a)))
      (fE (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C a)))
      (N / e) beta hNroot (hEroot.trans halpha.symm)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.unitFactor_genericMaps_comp_eq
statement:
private theorem unitFactor_genericMaps_comp_eq
    {A : Type u} {W F E Omega : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing W] [CommRing F] [CommRing E] [CommRing Omega]
    {e : ℕ} (a : A) (pi : W) (q : W[X])
    (radicalMap : AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C a) →+* AdjoinRoot q)
    (fCq : AdjoinRoot q →+* E)
    (fRe : AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C a) →+* F)
    (j : F →+* E) (i : E →+* Omega) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hcoeff : ∀ z : A,
      i (fCq (radicalMap (algebraMap A
        (AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C a)) z))) =
      i (j (fRe (algebraMap A
        (AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C a)) z))))
    (delta alpha piOmega : Omega)
    (hRadicalRoot :
      radicalMap (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C a)) =
        AdjoinRoot.root q * algebraMap W (AdjoinRoot q) pi)
    (hCqRoot : i (fCq (AdjoinRoot.root q)) = delta)
    (hCqCoeff : i (fCq (algebraMap W (AdjoinRoot q) pi)) = piOmega)
    (hReRoot :
      i (j (fRe (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C a)))) = alpha)
    (halpha : alpha = delta * piOmega) :
    fCq.comp radicalMap = j.comp fRe
proof:
:= by
  apply adjoinRoot_ringHom_eq_of_comp_subtype_eq
    (p := X ^ e - C a) (i := i) (hi := hi)
  · exact hcoeff
  · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [hRadicalRoot]
    simp only [map_mul]
    rw [hCqRoot, hCqCoeff, hReRoot]
    exact halpha.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.higherRadicalActualCompositumField_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem higherRadicalActualCompositumField_restrictScalars
    {K : Type u} {L Omega : Type v}
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field Omega]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L Omega] [Algebra K Omega]
    [IsScalarTower K L Omega]
    (e N : ℕ) (beta : Omega) :
    (higherRadicalActualCompositumField
        (K := K) (L := L) e N beta).restrictScalars K =
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L Omega).fieldRange ⊔
        IntermediateField.adjoin K ({beta} : Set Omega)
proof:
:= by
  rw [higherRadicalActualCompositumField,
    ← IntermediateField.restrictScalars_sup,
    targetCompositumOverLowerRadical_restrictScalars,
    higherRadicalFieldOverLower_restrictScalars]
  have hlower :
      lowerRadicalField (K := K) e N beta ≤
        IntermediateField.adjoin K ({beta} : Set Omega) := by
    rw [lowerRadicalField, IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz]
    exact
      (IntermediateField.adjoin K ({beta} : Set Omega)).toSubfield.pow_mem
        (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K ({beta} : Set Omega)
          (Set.mem_singleton beta)) (N / e)
  rw [sup_assoc, sup_eq_right.mpr hlower]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteDimensional_of_finite_valuationSubrings
statement:
private theorem finiteDimensional_of_finite_valuationSubrings
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring] :
    FiniteDimensional K L
proof:
:= by
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let W := target.valuationSubring
  let : IsFractionRing V K := base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsFractionRing W L := target.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let eWL : (K ⊗[V] W) ≃ₐ[K] L := finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv
  let : Module.Finite K (K ⊗[V] W) :=
    Module.Finite.base_change V K W
  exact Module.Finite.equiv eWL.toLinearEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteDimensional_targetCompositumOverLowerRadical
statement:
private theorem finiteDimensional_targetCompositumOverLowerRadical
    {K : Type u} {L Omega : Type v}
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field Omega]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L Omega] [Algebra K Omega]
    [IsScalarTower K L Omega] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (e N : ℕ) (beta : Omega) :
    let F
proof:
:= lowerRadicalField (K := K) e N beta
    let E := targetCompositumOverLowerRadical
      (K := K) (L := L) e N beta
    FiniteDimensional F E := by
  let F := lowerRadicalField (K := K) e N beta
  let Limage : IntermediateField K Omega :=
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L Omega).fieldRange
  let E := targetCompositumOverLowerRadical
    (K := K) (L := L) e N beta
  let : FiniteDimensional K Limage :=
    Module.Finite.equiv
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L Omega).equivFieldRange.toLinearEquiv
  let eSupE : (Limage ⊔ F : IntermediateField K Omega) ≃ₐ[F] E :=
    { toFun := fun z ↦ ⟨z.1, z.2⟩
      invFun := fun z ↦ ⟨z.1, z.2⟩
      left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      map_mul' _ _ := rfl
      map_add' _ _ := rfl
      commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let : FiniteDimensional F
      (Limage ⊔ F : IntermediateField K Omega) :=
    DiscreteValuationField.FieldCompositum.finiteDimensional_sup_over_right_of_left
      Limage F
  exact Module.Finite.equiv eSupE.toLinearEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.higherRadicalUnitFactorData
statement:
theorem higherRadicalUnitFactorData
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    (pi : target.valuationSubring)
    (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
    (hpi : target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L))
    (hdecomp :
      integerMap base target varpi =
        (unit : target.valuationSubring) *
          pi ^ ramificationIndex base target)
    (N : ℕ) (hdiv : ramificationIndex base target ∣ N)
    (beta : AlgebraicClosure L)
    (hbetaPow :
      beta ^ N = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K)) :
    Nonempty (HigherRadicalUnitFactorData
      base target varpi pi N beta)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨delta, q, unitFactorEquiv, radicalToUnitFactor,
      _hdeltaPow, halpha, hqMonic, hqMap, hqEtale, hqFinite,
      hCompositum, hUnitFactorRoot, hRadicalRoot,
      hRadicalEtale, _hHigherEtale, _hHigherFinite⟩ :=
    exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_etale_over_higherUniformizerRoot
      base target varpi hvarpi pi unit hpi hdecomp N hdiv beta hbetaPow
  exact ⟨
    { delta := delta
      q := q
      unitFactorEquiv := unitFactorEquiv
      radicalToUnitFactor := radicalToUnitFactor
      alpha_eq := halpha
      q_monic := hqMonic
      q_map := hqMap
      q_etale := hqEtale
      q_finite := hqFinite
      compositum_eq := hCompositum
      unitFactor_root := hUnitFactorRoot
      radical_root := hRadicalRoot
      radical_etale := hRadicalEtale }⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.higherRadicalActualFactorData_of_unitFactorData
statement:
theorem higherRadicalActualFactorData_of_unitFactorData
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    (pi : target.valuationSubring)
    (N : ℕ) (hdiv : ramificationIndex base target ∣ N)
    (beta : AlgebraicClosure L)
    (hbetaPow :
      beta ^ N = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K))
    (factor : HigherRadicalUnitFactorData base target varpi pi N beta) :
    Nonempty (HigherRadicalActualFactorData base target varpi N beta)
proof:
:= by
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let W := target.valuationSubring
  let e := ramificationIndex base target
  let alpha : AlgebraicClosure L := beta ^ (N / e)
  let Rₑ := AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C varpi)
  let Rₙ := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
  have he_ne : e ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [e, ramificationIndex] using
      (Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_ne_bot base target)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal W).isPrime
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_le base target))
  have he : 0 < e := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero he_ne
  have halphaPow :
      alpha ^ e = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) := by
    rw [show alpha ^ e = beta ^ ((N / e) * e) by
      simp only [alpha, pow_mul]]
    rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hdiv, hbetaPow]
  let : IsFractionRing V K := base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsFractionRing W L := target.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed V := base.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed W := target.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  have hvarpi_ne : varpi ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hvarpi.ne_zero
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hzero
  have hvarpiPrime : Prime varpi := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hvarpi_ne).mp
    rw [← Valuation.IsUniformizer.is_generator hvarpi]
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal V).isPrime
  have hN : 0 < N := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hN0 ↦ by
    apply hvarpiPrime.not_isUnit
    have hvarpi_one : varpi = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L)).injective
      rw [← hbetaPow, hN0, pow_zero]
      exact (map_one (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L))).symm
    rw [hvarpi_one]
    exact isUnit_one
  let F : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure L) :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))
  let E : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure L) :=
    targetCompositumOverLowerRadical (K := K) (L := L) e N beta
  let Kₙ : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure L) :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin K ({beta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))
  let K' : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure L) :=
    higherRadicalFieldOverLower (K := K) e N beta
  let M : IntermediateField F (AlgebraicClosure L) :=
    higherRadicalActualCompositumField
      (K := K) (L := L) e N beta
  let q := factor.q
  let Cq := AdjoinRoot q
  let : Algebra V F :=
    ((algebraMap K F).comp (algebraMap V K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower V K F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let eRₑ : (K ⊗[V] Rₑ) ≃ₐ[K] F := by
    simpa [Rₑ, F, alpha] using
      (pureRadicalGenericFiberAlgEquiv he varpi hvarpiPrime alpha halphaPow)
  let : IsDomain Rₑ :=
    isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime he varpi hvarpiPrime
  let : Algebra Rₑ F :=
    (genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₑ).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsFractionRing Rₑ F :=
    isFractionRing_of_genericFiberAlgEquiv eRₑ
  let radicalMap : Rₑ →ₐ[V] Cq := factor.radicalToUnitFactor
  let : Algebra Rₑ Cq := radicalMap.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra.Etale Rₑ Cq :=
    unitFactor_etale_over_uniformizerRadical base target varpi hvarpi
      factor.delta q factor.q_monic factor.q_map factor.q_etale
      factor.radicalToUnitFactor
  let : Module.Finite V Rₑ :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpi he_ne).finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Finite W Cq := factor.q_finite
  let : Module.Finite V Cq := Module.Finite.trans W Cq
  let : IsScalarTower V Rₑ Cq :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun z ↦
      (radicalMap.commutes z).symm
  let : Module.Finite Rₑ Cq :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite V Rₑ Cq
  let eGeneric : (F ⊗[Rₑ] Cq) ≃ₐ[F] E :=
    lowerUnitFactorGenericFiberAlgEquiv base target varpi pi N beta
      he hvarpiPrime halphaPow factor
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    finiteDimensional_of_finite_valuationSubrings base target
  let : FiniteDimensional F E :=
    finiteDimensional_targetCompositumOverLowerRadical e N beta
  let : Algebra K K' :=
    ((algebraMap F K').comp (algebraMap K F)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower K F K' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let eKₙ : Kₙ ≃ₐ[K] K' :=
    { toFun := fun z ↦ ⟨z.1, z.2⟩
      invFun := fun z ↦ ⟨z.1, z.2⟩
      left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      map_mul' _ _ := rfl
      map_add' _ _ := rfl
      commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let eRₙ : (K ⊗[V] Rₙ) ≃ₐ[K] K' :=
    (pureRadicalGenericFiberAlgEquiv hN varpi hvarpiPrime beta
      hbetaPow).trans eKₙ
  let : IsDomain Rₙ :=
    isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN varpi hvarpiPrime
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing Rₙ :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
      hN varpi hvarpiPrime
  let : Algebra Rₙ K' :=
    (genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₙ).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsFractionRing Rₙ K' :=
    isFractionRing_of_genericFiberAlgEquiv eRₙ
  let higherRootMap : Rₑ →ₐ[V] Rₙ :=
    adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd hdiv varpi
  let : Algebra Rₑ Rₙ := higherRootMap.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra Rₑ K' :=
    ((algebraMap F K').comp (algebraMap Rₑ F)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower Rₑ F K' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hRₙRoot :
      (((genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₙ)
          (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C varpi)) : K') :
        AlgebraicClosure L) = beta := by
    change (((pureRadicalGenericFiberAlgEquiv hN varpi hvarpiPrime beta
        hbetaPow) (1 ⊗ₜ[V] AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C varpi)) :
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({beta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))) :
        AlgebraicClosure L) = beta
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (pureRadicalGenericFiberAlgEquiv_tmul_root
        hN varpi hvarpiPrime beta hbetaPow)
  have hRₙBase (z : V) :
      (((genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₙ)
          (algebraMap V Rₙ z) : K') : AlgebraicClosure L) =
        algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (z : K) := by
    rw [(genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₙ).commutes]
    rfl
  have hRₑBaseK' (z : V) :
      ((algebraMap F K' ((genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₑ)
          (algebraMap V Rₑ z)) : K') : AlgebraicClosure L) =
        algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (z : K) := by
    rw [(genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₑ).commutes]
    rfl
  have hRₑRoot :
      (((genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₑ)
          (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C varpi)) : F) :
        AlgebraicClosure L) = alpha := by
    change (((pureRadicalGenericFiberAlgEquiv he varpi hvarpiPrime alpha
        halphaPow) (1 ⊗ₜ[V] AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C varpi)) :
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))) :
        AlgebraicClosure L) = alpha
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (pureRadicalGenericFiberAlgEquiv_tmul_root
        he varpi hvarpiPrime alpha halphaPow)
  have hTowerRₑRₙK' :
      (genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₙ).toRingHom.comp higherRootMap.toRingHom =
        (algebraMap F K').comp (genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₑ).toRingHom := by
    exact higherRoot_genericMaps_comp_eq
      (K := K) (Omega := AlgebraicClosure L) F K' varpi hdiv
      (genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₙ).toRingHom
      (genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₑ).toRingHom
      (fun z ↦ hRₙBase z |>.trans (hRₑBaseK' z).symm)
      beta alpha hRₙRoot hRₑRoot rfl
  let : IsScalarTower Rₑ Rₙ K' :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun z ↦ by
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hTowerRₑRₙK' z |>.symm
  let kToM : K' →ₐ[F] M :=
    IntermediateField.inclusion (show K' ≤ M from le_sup_right)
  let : Algebra K' M := kToM.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower V Rₙ K' :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun z ↦
      ((genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₙ).commutes z).symm
  let : IsScalarTower V K' M := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower V F K' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower V F M := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let phi : Rₙ →+* M :=
    kToM.toRingHom.comp (genericFiberRightAlgHom eRₙ).toRingHom
  let : Algebra Rₙ M := phi.toAlgebra
  have hPhiBase (z : V) :
      ((phi (algebraMap V Rₙ z) : M) : AlgebraicClosure L) =
        algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (z : K) := by
    simp only [phi, RingHom.comp_apply, kToM]
    exact hRₙBase z
  have hPhiRoot :
      ((phi (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C varpi)) : M) :
        AlgebraicClosure L) = beta := by
    simp only [phi, RingHom.comp_apply, kToM]
    exact hRₙRoot
  have hActualEtale : Algebra.Etale Rₙ (integralClosure Rₙ M) := by
    exact integralClosure_compositum_etale_of_finiteEtale_baseChange
      (A := Rₑ) (B := Rₙ) (T := Cq) E K' eGeneric
  exact ⟨
    { rootMap := phi
      commutes_coe := hPhiBase
      root_coe := hPhiRoot
      etale_normalization := hActualEtale }⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.higherRadicalActualFactorData
statement:
theorem higherRadicalActualFactorData
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    (pi : target.valuationSubring)
    (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
    (hpi : target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L))
    (hdecomp :
      integerMap base target varpi =
        (unit : target.valuationSubring) *
          pi ^ ramificationIndex base target)
    (N : ℕ) (hdiv : ramificationIndex base target ∣ N)
    (beta : AlgebraicClosure L)
    (hbetaPow :
      beta ^ N = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K)) :
    Nonempty (HigherRadicalActualFactorData base target varpi N beta)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨factor⟩ := higherRadicalUnitFactorData
    base target varpi hvarpi pi unit hpi hdecomp
      N hdiv beta hbetaPow
  exact higherRadicalActualFactorData_of_unitFactorData
    base target varpi hvarpi pi N hdiv beta hbetaPow
    factor

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_fieldRange_sup_adjoin_of_eq_mul
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_fieldRange_sup_adjoin_of_eq_mul
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} {Omega : Type w}
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field Omega]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L Omega] [Algebra K Omega]
    [IsScalarTower K L Omega]
    (delta alpha : Omega) (pi : L)
    (halpha : alpha = delta * algebraMap L Omega pi)
    (hpi : pi ≠ 0) :
    (IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set Omega)).restrictScalars K =
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L Omega).fieldRange ⊔
        IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega)
proof:
:= by
  let f : L →ₐ[K] Omega := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L Omega
  let Limage : IntermediateField K Omega := f.fieldRange
  let eL : L ≃ₐ[K] Limage := f.equivFieldRange
  have hmaps :
      algebraMap L Omega = (algebraMap Limage Omega) ∘ eL := by
    ext z
    rfl
  rw [IntermediateField.restrictScalars_adjoin_of_algEquiv eL hmaps]
  rw [IntermediateField.restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup]
  change Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({delta} : Set Omega) =
    Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply sup_le le_sup_left
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz]
    have hpiOmega : algebraMap L Omega pi ≠ 0 :=
      by simpa using (algebraMap L Omega).injective.ne hpi
    have htarget : algebraMap L Omega pi ∈
        Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega) := by
      exact
        (show Limage ≤
          Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega) from
            le_sup_left)
          (AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr ⟨pi, rfl⟩)
    have halphaMem : alpha ∈
        Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega) := by
      exact
        (show IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega) ≤
          Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega) from
            le_sup_right)
          (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega)
            (Set.mem_singleton alpha))
    have hdelta :
        delta = alpha * (algebraMap L Omega pi)⁻¹ := by
      rw [halpha, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpiOmega, mul_one]
    rw [hdelta]
    exact (Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega)).mul_mem
      halphaMem
      ((Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega)).inv_mem htarget)
  · apply sup_le le_sup_left
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz, halpha]
    exact (Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({delta} : Set Omega)).mul_mem
      ((show IntermediateField.adjoin K ({delta} : Set Omega) ≤
          Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({delta} : Set Omega) from
            le_sup_right)
        (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K ({delta} : Set Omega)
          (Set.mem_singleton delta)))
      ((show Limage ≤
          Limage ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({delta} : Set Omega) from
            le_sup_left)
        (AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr ⟨pi, rfl⟩))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_integralFactor_of_pow_eq_unit
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_integralFactor_of_pow_eq_unit
    {B : Type u} {L : Type v} {Omega : Type w}
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    [Field L] [Field Omega]
    [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra L Omega] [Algebra B Omega]
    [IsScalarTower B L Omega]
    {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (hnUnit : IsUnit (n : B))
    (unit : Bˣ) (delta : Omega)
    (hdelta : delta ^ n =
      algebraMap L Omega (algebraMap B L (unit : B))) :
    ∃ (q : B[X])
      (factorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (q.map (algebraMap B L)) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set Omega)),
      q.Monic ∧
        q.map (algebraMap B L) = minpoly L delta ∧
          q ∣ X ^ n - C (unit : B) ∧
            Algebra.Etale B (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
              Module.Finite B (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                factorEquiv (AdjoinRoot.root (q.map (algebraMap B L))) =
                  IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta
proof:
:= by
  let p : B[X] := X ^ n - C (unit : B)
  have hpMonic : p.Monic :=
    Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C (unit : B) hn.ne'
  have hdeltaIntegral : IsIntegral B delta := by
    refine ⟨p, hpMonic, ?_⟩
    simp [p, hdelta, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B L Omega]
  let q : B[X] := minpoly B delta
  have hqMonic : q.Monic := minpoly.monic hdeltaIntegral
  have hqMap : q.map (algebraMap B L) = minpoly L delta := by
    symm
    simpa [q] using
      (minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions'
        (R := B) (S := Omega) L hdeltaIntegral)
  have hpRoot : aeval delta p = 0 := by
    simp [p, hdelta, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B L Omega]
  have hpMapRoot :
      aeval delta (p.map (algebraMap B L)) = 0 := by
    simpa [aeval_map_algebraMap] using hpRoot
  have hqDvd : q ∣ p := by
    apply hpMonic.dvd_of_fraction_map_dvd_fraction_map (K := L) hqMonic
    rw [hqMap]
    exact minpoly.dvd L delta hpMapRoot
  have hqDvdOut := hqDvd
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hqDvd
  let A := AdjoinRoot q
  let x : A := AdjoinRoot.root q
  have hqRoot : aeval x q = 0 := by
    rw [AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, AdjoinRoot.mk_self]
  have hpRootA : aeval x p = 0 := by
    rw [hr, map_mul, hqRoot, zero_mul]
  have hxPow : x ^ n = algebraMap B A (unit : B) := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa [p, x, A] using hpRootA
  let unitA : Aˣ := Units.map (algebraMap B A) unit
  have hxUnit : IsUnit x := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_exists_inv]
    refine ⟨x ^ (n - 1) * ((unitA⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A), ?_⟩
    calc
      x * (x ^ (n - 1) * ((unitA⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A)) =
          x ^ n * ((unitA⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hn]
      _ = (unitA : A) * ((unitA⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) := by
        rw [hxPow]
        rfl
      _ = 1 := Units.mul_inv _
  have hpDerivativeUnit : IsUnit (aeval x p.derivative) := by
    simpa [p, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow] using
      (hnUnit.map (algebraMap B A)).mul (hxUnit.pow (n - 1))
  have hDerivativeFactor :
      aeval x p.derivative = aeval x q.derivative * aeval x r := by
    rw [hr, derivative_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, hqRoot,
      zero_mul, add_zero]
  have hqDerivativeDvd :
      aeval x q.derivative ∣ aeval x p.derivative :=
    ⟨aeval x r, hDerivativeFactor⟩
  have hqDerivativeUnit : IsUnit (aeval x q.derivative) := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_dvd_one]
    exact hqDerivativeDvd.trans
      (isUnit_iff_dvd_one.mp hpDerivativeUnit)
  have hFormal : Algebra.FormallyEtale B A :=
    formallyEtale_adjoinRoot_of_monic_of_isUnit_aeval_derivative
      hqMonic hqDerivativeUnit
  have hEtale : Algebra.Etale B A :=
    { formallyEtale := hFormal
      finitePresentation := inferInstance }
  have hFinite : Module.Finite B A := hqMonic.finite_adjoinRoot
  have hdeltaLIntegral : IsIntegral L delta :=
    hdeltaIntegral.tower_top
  let factorEquiv :
      AdjoinRoot (q.map (algebraMap B L)) ≃ₐ[L]
        IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set Omega) :=
    (AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq L (q.map (algebraMap B L))
      (minpoly L delta) hqMap).trans
      (IntermediateField.adjoinRootEquivAdjoin L hdeltaLIntegral)
  have hFactorRoot :
      factorEquiv (AdjoinRoot.root (q.map (algebraMap B L))) =
        IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta := by
    simp [factorEquiv, AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq_root,
      IntermediateField.adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_apply_root]
  exact ⟨q, factorEquiv, hqMonic, hqMap, hqDvdOut, hEtale,
    hFinite, hFactorRoot⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_for_prescribed_uniformizerRoot
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_for_prescribed_uniformizerRoot
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring) (pi : target.valuationSubring)
    (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
    (hpi : target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L))
    (hdecomp :
      integerMap base target varpi =
        (unit : target.valuationSubring) *
          pi ^ ramificationIndex base target)
    (alpha : AlgebraicClosure L)
    (halphaPow :
      alpha ^ ramificationIndex base target =
        algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K)) :
    ∃ (delta : AlgebraicClosure L) (q : target.valuationSubring[X])
      (unitFactorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L)) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)))
      (radicalToUnitFactor :
        AdjoinRoot
            (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi) →ₐ[base.valuationSubring]
          AdjoinRoot q),
      delta ^ ramificationIndex base target =
          algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) ∧
        alpha = delta * algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ∧
          q.Monic ∧
            q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L) = minpoly L delta ∧
              q ∣ X ^ ramificationIndex base target -
                C (unit : target.valuationSubring) ∧
                Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                  Module.Finite target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                    (IntermediateField.adjoin L
                        ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))).restrictScalars K =
                      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L
                          (AlgebraicClosure L)).fieldRange ⊔
                        IntermediateField.adjoin K
                          ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)) ∧
                      unitFactorEquiv
                          (AdjoinRoot.root
                            (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L))) =
                        IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta ∧
                        radicalToUnitFactor
                            (AdjoinRoot.root
                              (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) =
                          AdjoinRoot.root q *
                            algebraMap target.valuationSubring
                              (AdjoinRoot q) pi
proof:
:= by
  let e := ramificationIndex base target
  have he_ne : e ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [e, ramificationIndex] using
      (Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_ne_bot base target)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal target.valuationSubring).isPrime
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_le base target))
  have he : 0 < e := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero he_ne
  have heBase : IsUnit (e : base.valuationSubring) := by
    apply (base.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (e : base.valuationSubring)).mp
    simpa using (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr he_ne : (e : base.residueField) ≠ 0)
  have heTarget : IsUnit (e : target.valuationSubring) := by
    simpa using heBase.map (integerMap base target)
  have hdecompL :
      algebraMap K L (varpi : K) = (unit : L) * (pi : L) ^ e := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : target.valuationSubring ↦ (z : L)) hdecomp
    simpa [e] using h
  have hpiOmega : algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using
      (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L)).injective.ne hpi.ne_zero
  let delta : AlgebraicClosure L :=
    alpha * (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L))⁻¹
  have hdeltaPow :
      delta ^ e = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) := by
    calc
      delta ^ e =
          alpha ^ e *
            ((algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L))⁻¹) ^ e := by
        simp only [delta, mul_pow]
      _ = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) *
          (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ^ e)⁻¹ := by
        rw [halphaPow, inv_pow]
      _ = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L)
            (algebraMap K L (varpi : K)) *
          (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ^ e)⁻¹ := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K L (AlgebraicClosure L)]
      _ = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L)
            ((unit : L) * (pi : L) ^ e) *
          (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ^ e)⁻¹ := by
        rw [hdecompL]
      _ = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) *
          (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ^ e) *
          (algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ^ e)⁻¹ := by
        rw [map_mul, map_pow]
      _ = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero e hpiOmega), mul_one]
  have halpha :
      alpha = delta * algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) := by
    dsimp only [delta]
    rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hpiOmega, mul_one]
  let : IsFractionRing target.valuationSubring L :=
    target.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed target.valuationSubring :=
    target.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  obtain ⟨q, unitFactorEquiv, hqMonic, hqMap, hqDvd,
      hqEtale, hqFinite, hUnitFactorRoot⟩ :=
    exists_finiteEtale_integralFactor_of_pow_eq_unit
      (B := target.valuationSubring) (L := L)
      (Omega := AlgebraicClosure L) he heTarget unit delta (by
        simpa using hdeltaPow)
  let d : AdjoinRoot q := AdjoinRoot.root q
  have hqRoot : aeval d q = 0 := by
    rw [AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, AdjoinRoot.mk_self]
  have hUnitRoot :
      d ^ e =
        algebraMap target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q)
          (unit : target.valuationSubring) := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hqDvd
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    have hpRoot :
        aeval d
          (X ^ e - C (unit : target.valuationSubring)) = 0 := by
      rw [hr, map_mul, hqRoot, zero_mul]
    simpa [d] using hpRoot
  let rootInFactor : AdjoinRoot q :=
    d * algebraMap target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) pi
  have hRootInFactorPow :
      rootInFactor ^ e =
        algebraMap base.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) varpi := by
    calc
      rootInFactor ^ e =
          d ^ e *
            (algebraMap target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) pi) ^ e := by
        simp only [rootInFactor, mul_pow]
      _ = algebraMap target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q)
            (unit : target.valuationSubring) *
          algebraMap target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) (pi ^ e) := by
        rw [hUnitRoot, map_pow]
      _ = algebraMap target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q)
            ((unit : target.valuationSubring) * pi ^ e) := by
        rw [map_mul]
      _ = algebraMap target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q)
            (integerMap base target varpi) := by
        rw [hdecomp]
      _ = algebraMap base.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) varpi := by
        simpa [integerMap] using
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply base.valuationSubring
            target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) varpi).symm
  have hRootInFactor :
      aeval rootInFactor (X ^ e - C varpi) = 0 := by
    simp [hRootInFactorPow]
  let radicalToUnitFactor :
      AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C varpi) →ₐ[base.valuationSubring] AdjoinRoot q :=
    AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom (X ^ e - C varpi)
      (Algebra.ofId base.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q))
      rootInFactor hRootInFactor
  have hRadicalToUnitFactorRoot :
      radicalToUnitFactor (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C varpi)) =
        AdjoinRoot.root q *
          algebraMap target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) pi := by
    dsimp only [radicalToUnitFactor]
    calc
      _ = rootInFactor :=
        AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root (X ^ e - C varpi)
          (Algebra.ofId base.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q))
          rootInFactor hRootInFactor
      _ = _ := rfl
  have hCompositum :=
    restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_fieldRange_sup_adjoin_of_eq_mul
      (K := K) (L := L) (Omega := AlgebraicClosure L)
      delta alpha (pi : L) halpha hpi.ne_zero
  exact ⟨delta, q, unitFactorEquiv, radicalToUnitFactor,
    hdeltaPow, halpha, hqMonic,
    hqMap, hqDvd, hqEtale, hqFinite, hCompositum, hUnitFactorRoot,
    hRadicalToUnitFactorRoot⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_unitAbsorption_actualCompositum
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_unitAbsorption_actualCompositum
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField] :
    let n
proof:
:= ramificationIndex base target
    ∃ (varpi : base.valuationSubring) (pi : target.valuationSubring)
      (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
      (delta alpha : AlgebraicClosure L) (q : target.valuationSubring[X])
      (unitFactorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L)) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)))
      (radicalEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C (varpi : K)) ≃ₐ[K]
          IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))),
      base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K) ∧
        target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L) ∧
          integerMap base target varpi =
            (unit : target.valuationSubring) * pi ^ n ∧
            delta ^ n = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) ∧
              alpha = delta * algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ∧
                alpha ^ n =
                  algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) ∧
                  q.Monic ∧
                    q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L) =
                      minpoly L delta ∧
                      q ∣ X ^ n - C (unit : target.valuationSubring) ∧
                        Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                          Module.Finite target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                            (IntermediateField.adjoin L
                                ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))).restrictScalars K =
                              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L
                                  (AlgebraicClosure L)).fieldRange ⊔
                                IntermediateField.adjoin K
                                  ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)) ∧
                              unitFactorEquiv
                                  (AdjoinRoot.root
                                    (q.map
                                      (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L))) =
                                IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta ∧
                                radicalEquiv
                                    (AdjoinRoot.root
                                      (X ^ n - C (varpi : K))) =
                                  IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K alpha := by
  let n := ramificationIndex base target
  have hn_ne : n ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [n, ramificationIndex] using
      (Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_ne_bot base target)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal target.valuationSubring).isPrime
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_le base target))
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn_ne
  have hnBase : IsUnit (n : base.valuationSubring) := by
    apply (base.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (n : base.valuationSubring)).mp
    simpa using (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn_ne : (n : base.residueField) ≠ 0)
  have hnTarget : IsUnit (n : target.valuationSubring) := by
    simpa using hnBase.map (integerMap base target)
  obtain ⟨varpi, pi, unit, delta, alpha, factorEquiv, radicalEquiv,
      hvarpi, hpi, hvarpiPrime, hdecomp, hWholeEtale, hWholeFinite,
      hdelta, hMinpolyDvd, hdeltaSeparable, halpha, halphaPow,
      hFactorRoot, hRadicalRoot⟩ :=
    exists_finiteEtale_unitAbsorption_uniformizerRadical base target
  let : IsFractionRing target.valuationSubring L :=
    target.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed target.valuationSubring :=
    target.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  obtain ⟨q, unitFactorEquiv, hqMonic, hqMap, hqDvd,
      hqEtale, hqFinite, hUnitFactorRoot⟩ :=
    exists_finiteEtale_integralFactor_of_pow_eq_unit
      (B := target.valuationSubring) (L := L)
      (Omega := AlgebraicClosure L) hn hnTarget unit delta (by
        simpa using hdelta)
  have hCompositum :=
    restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_fieldRange_sup_adjoin_of_eq_mul
      (K := K) (L := L) (Omega := AlgebraicClosure L)
      delta alpha (pi : L) halpha hpi.ne_zero
  exact ⟨varpi, pi, unit, delta, alpha, q, unitFactorEquiv, radicalEquiv,
    hvarpi, hpi, hdecomp, hdelta, halpha, halphaPow, hqMonic, hqMap,
    hqDvd, hqEtale, hqFinite, hCompositum, hUnitFactorRoot,
    hRadicalRoot⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_unitAbsorption_uniformizerRadical
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_unitAbsorption_uniformizerRadical
    {K : Type u} {L : Type w} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) (target : DVF.{w, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField] :
    let n
proof:
:= ramificationIndex base target
    exists (varpi : base.valuationSubring) (pi : target.valuationSubring)
      (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
      (delta alpha : AlgebraicClosure L)
      (factorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (minpoly L delta) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)))
      (radicalEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C (varpi : K)) ≃ₐ[K]
          IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))),
      base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K) ∧
        target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L) ∧
          Prime varpi ∧
            integerMap base target varpi =
              (unit : target.valuationSubring) * pi ^ n ∧
              Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring
                (AdjoinRoot
                  (X ^ n - C (unit : target.valuationSubring))) ∧
                Module.Finite target.valuationSubring
                  (AdjoinRoot
                    (X ^ n - C (unit : target.valuationSubring))) ∧
                  delta ^ n = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) ∧
                    minpoly L delta ∣ X ^ n - C (unit : L) ∧
                      IsSeparable L delta ∧
                        alpha = delta * algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ∧
                          alpha ^ n =
                            algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) ∧
                            factorEquiv (AdjoinRoot.root (minpoly L delta)) =
                              IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta ∧
                              radicalEquiv
                                  (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C (varpi : K))) =
                                IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K alpha := by
  let n := ramificationIndex base target
  have hn_ne : n ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [n, ramificationIndex] using
      (Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_ne_bot base target)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal target.valuationSubring).isPrime
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_le base target))
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn_ne
  have hnBase : IsUnit (n : base.valuationSubring) := by
    apply (base.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (n : base.valuationSubring)).mp
    simpa using (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn_ne : (n : base.residueField) ≠ 0)
  have hnTarget : IsUnit (n : target.valuationSubring) := by
    simpa using hnBase.map (integerMap base target)
  obtain ⟨varpi, pi, unit, hvarpi, hpi, hdecomp⟩ :=
    exists_uniformizers_unit_mul_target_uniformizer_pow_eq_base_uniformizer_image
      base target
  let targetPolynomial : target.valuationSubring[X] :=
    X ^ n - C (unit : target.valuationSubring)
  have hFormal :
      Algebra.FormallyEtale target.valuationSubring
        (AdjoinRoot targetPolynomial) := by
    exact formallyEtale_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn hnTarget unit.isUnit
  have hEtale :
      Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring
        (AdjoinRoot targetPolynomial) :=
    { formallyEtale := hFormal
      finitePresentation := inferInstance }
  have hFinite :
      Module.Finite target.valuationSubring
        (AdjoinRoot targetPolynomial) :=
    (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C
      (unit : target.valuationSubring) hn.ne').finite_adjoinRoot
  let Omega := AlgebraicClosure L
  obtain ⟨delta, hdelta⟩ :=
    IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq
      (algebraMap L Omega (unit : L)) hn
  let fieldPolynomial : L[X] := X ^ n - C (unit : L)
  have hFieldRoot : aeval delta fieldPolynomial = 0 := by
    simp [fieldPolynomial, hdelta]
  have hMinpolyDvd : minpoly L delta ∣ fieldPolynomial :=
    minpoly.dvd L delta hFieldRoot
  have hnL : IsUnit (n : L) := by
    simpa using hnTarget.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L)
  have hunitL : IsUnit (unit : L) :=
    unit.isUnit.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L)
  have hFieldSeparable : fieldPolynomial.Separable := by
    exact Polynomial.separable_X_pow_sub_C (unit : L) hnL.ne_zero hunitL.ne_zero
  have hdeltaSeparable : IsSeparable L delta := by
    exact hFieldSeparable.of_dvd hMinpolyDvd
  have hdeltaIntegral : IsIntegral L delta :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral delta
  let factorEquiv :
      AdjoinRoot (minpoly L delta) ≃ₐ[L]
        IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set Omega) :=
    IntermediateField.adjoinRootEquivAdjoin L hdeltaIntegral
  have hvarpi_ne : varpi ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hvarpi.ne_zero
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hzero
  have hvarpiPrime : Prime varpi := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hvarpi_ne).mp
    exact (base.maximalIdeal_eq_span_uniformizer hvarpi).symm ▸
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal base.valuationSubring).isPrime
  have hdecompL :
      algebraMap K L (varpi : K) = (unit : L) * (pi : L) ^ n := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : target.valuationSubring ↦ (z : L)) hdecomp
    simpa using h
  let alpha : Omega :=
    delta * algebraMap L Omega (pi : L)
  have halphaPow :
      alpha ^ n = algebraMap K Omega (varpi : K) := by
    calc
      alpha ^ n =
          delta ^ n * (algebraMap L Omega (pi : L)) ^ n := by
        simp [alpha, mul_pow]
      _ = algebraMap L Omega (unit : L) *
          algebraMap L Omega ((pi : L) ^ n) := by
        rw [hdelta, map_pow]
      _ = algebraMap L Omega ((unit : L) * (pi : L) ^ n) := by
        rw [map_mul]
      _ = algebraMap L Omega (algebraMap K L (varpi : K)) := by
        rw [hdecompL]
      _ = algebraMap K Omega (varpi : K) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K L Omega]
  let : IsFractionRing base.valuationSubring K :=
    base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed base.valuationSubring :=
    base.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  let radicalPolynomial : K[X] := X ^ n - C (varpi : K)
  have hRadicalIrreducible : Irreducible radicalPolynomial := by
    exact irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_fractionRing_of_prime hvarpiPrime hn
  have hRadicalMonic : radicalPolynomial.Monic := by
    exact monic_X_pow_sub_C (varpi : K) hn.ne'
  have hRadicalRoot : aeval alpha radicalPolynomial = 0 := by
    simp [radicalPolynomial, halphaPow]
  have hRadicalMinpoly : radicalPolynomial = minpoly K alpha :=
    minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic
      hRadicalIrreducible hRadicalRoot hRadicalMonic
  have halphaIntegral : IsIntegral K alpha :=
    ⟨radicalPolynomial, hRadicalMonic, hRadicalRoot⟩
  let radicalEquiv :
      AdjoinRoot radicalPolynomial ≃ₐ[K]
        IntermediateField.adjoin K ({alpha} : Set Omega) :=
    (AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq K radicalPolynomial (minpoly K alpha)
      hRadicalMinpoly).trans
      (IntermediateField.adjoinRootEquivAdjoin K halphaIntegral)
  have hFactorRoot :
      factorEquiv (AdjoinRoot.root (minpoly L delta)) =
        IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta :=
    IntermediateField.adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_apply_root L hdeltaIntegral
  have hRadicalEquivRoot :
      radicalEquiv (AdjoinRoot.root radicalPolynomial) =
        IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen K alpha := by
    simp [radicalEquiv, AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq_root,
      IntermediateField.adjoinRootEquivAdjoin_apply_root]
  refine ⟨varpi, pi, unit, delta, alpha, factorEquiv, radicalEquiv,
    hvarpi, hpi, hvarpiPrime, hdecomp, ?_, ?_, hdelta, ?_,
    hdeltaSeparable, rfl, halphaPow, hFactorRoot, ?_⟩
  · simpa [targetPolynomial] using hEtale
  · simpa [targetPolynomial] using hFinite
  · simpa [fieldPolynomial] using hMinpolyDvd
  · simpa [radicalPolynomial] using hRadicalEquivRoot

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd_root
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {e N : ℕ} (hdiv : e ∣ N) (a : A) :
    adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd hdiv a
        (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ e - C a)) =
      AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C a) ^ (N / e)
proof:
:= by
  simp [adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
statement:
theorem isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
    {V : Type u} [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (varpi : V) (hvarpi : Prime varpi) :
    IsDomain (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi))
proof:
:= by
  let p : V[X] := X ^ N - C varpi
  let K := FractionRing V
  have hNne : N ≠ 0 := hN.ne'
  have hpMonic : p.Monic := monic_X_pow_sub_C varpi hNne
  have hpIrreducibleMap :
      Irreducible (p.map (algebraMap V K)) := by
    simpa [p] using
      irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_fractionRing_of_prime hvarpi hN
  have hpIrreducible : Irreducible p :=
    (hpMonic.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map).2
      hpIrreducibleMap
  exact AdjoinRoot.isDomain_of_prime hpIrreducible.prime

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isDiscreteValuationRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
    {V : Type u} [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (varpi : V) (hvarpi : Prime varpi) :
    letI : IsDomain (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi))
proof:
:=
      isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN varpi hvarpi
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) := by
  let p : V[X] := X ^ N - C varpi
  have hNne : N ≠ 0 := hN.ne'
  let : IsDomain (AdjoinRoot p) :=
    isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN varpi hvarpi
  have hvarpi_mem : varpi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V :=
    (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hvarpi.not_isUnit
  let : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot p) :=
    isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN hvarpi_mem
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V (AdjoinRoot p) :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN varpi
  have hmaxV :
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span {varpi} :=
    hvarpi.irreducible.maximalIdeal_eq
  have hmaxR :
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot p) =
        Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root p} := by
    rw [maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN hvarpi_mem]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply sup_le
      · rw [hmaxV, Ideal.map_span]
        simp only [Set.image_singleton]
        rw [show AdjoinRoot.of p varpi =
            AdjoinRoot.root p ^ N by
          simpa [p] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow N varpi).symm]
        rw [Ideal.span_le]
        rintro _ (rfl : _ = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ N)
        exact Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem (Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root p})
          (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) N hN
      · exact le_rfl
    · exact le_sup_right
  have hroot_ne : AdjoinRoot.root p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hroot
    apply hvarpi.ne_zero
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective V (AdjoinRoot p)
    rw [AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
    rw [show AdjoinRoot.of p varpi =
        AdjoinRoot.root p ^ N by
      simpa [p] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow N varpi).symm]
    simp [hroot, hNne]
  have hR_notField : ¬ IsField (AdjoinRoot p) := by
    intro hfield
    have hbot : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot p) = ⊥ :=
      IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hfield
    have : AdjoinRoot.root p ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (AdjoinRoot p)) := by
      rw [← hbot, hmaxR]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    exact hroot_ne (by simpa using this)
  have hprincipal :
      Submodule.IsPrincipal
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot p)) :=
    ⟨AdjoinRoot.root p, hmaxR⟩
  exact ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE
    (AdjoinRoot p) hR_notField).out 5 1).mp
    hprincipal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_etale_over_higherUniformizerRoot
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_etale_over_higherUniformizerRoot
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    (pi : target.valuationSubring)
    (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
    (hpi : target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L))
    (hdecomp :
      integerMap base target varpi =
        (unit : target.valuationSubring) *
          pi ^ ramificationIndex base target)
    (N : ℕ) (hdiv : ramificationIndex base target ∣ N)
    (beta : AlgebraicClosure L)
    (hbetaPow :
      beta ^ N = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K)) :
    ∃ (delta : AlgebraicClosure L) (q : target.valuationSubring[X])
      (unitFactorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L)) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)))
      (radicalToUnitFactor :
        AdjoinRoot
            (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi) →ₐ[base.valuationSubring]
          AdjoinRoot q),
      delta ^ ramificationIndex base target =
          algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) ∧
        beta ^ (N / ramificationIndex base target) =
          delta * algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ∧
          q.Monic ∧
            q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L) = minpoly L delta ∧
              Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                Module.Finite target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                  (IntermediateField.adjoin L
                      ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))).restrictScalars K =
                    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L
                        (AlgebraicClosure L)).fieldRange ⊔
                      IntermediateField.adjoin K
                        ({beta ^ (N / ramificationIndex base target)} :
                          Set (AlgebraicClosure L)) ∧
                    unitFactorEquiv
                        (AdjoinRoot.root
                          (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L))) =
                      IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta ∧
                      radicalToUnitFactor
                          (AdjoinRoot.root
                            (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) =
                        AdjoinRoot.root q *
                          algebraMap target.valuationSubring
                            (AdjoinRoot q) pi ∧
                        (letI : Algebra
                            (AdjoinRoot
                              (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi))
                            (AdjoinRoot q) :=
                          radicalToUnitFactor.toRingHom.toAlgebra
                         Algebra.Etale
                            (AdjoinRoot
                              (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi))
                            (AdjoinRoot q)) ∧
                        (let Rₑ := AdjoinRoot
                            (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)
                         let Rₙ := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
                         let Cq := AdjoinRoot q
                         let higherRootMap : Rₑ →ₐ[base.valuationSubring] Rₙ :=
                           adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd hdiv varpi
                         letI : Algebra Rₑ Rₙ :=
                           higherRootMap.toRingHom.toAlgebra
                         letI : Algebra Rₑ Cq :=
                           radicalToUnitFactor.toRingHom.toAlgebra
                         let Tₙ := Rₙ ⊗[Rₑ] Cq
                         (Algebra.Etale Rₙ Tₙ ∧
                           Module.Finite Rₙ Tₙ))
proof:
:= by
  let e := ramificationIndex base target
  have he_ne : e ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [e, ramificationIndex] using
      (Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_ne_bot base target)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal
          target.valuationSubring).isPrime
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_le base target))
  let alpha : AlgebraicClosure L := beta ^ (N / e)
  have halphaPow :
      alpha ^ e = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) := by
    rw [show alpha ^ e = beta ^ ((N / e) * e) by
      simp only [alpha, pow_mul]]
    rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hdiv, hbetaPow]
  obtain ⟨delta, q, unitFactorEquiv, radicalToUnitFactor,
      hdeltaPow, halpha, hqMonic, hqMap, _hqDvd, hqEtale, hqFinite,
      hCompositum, hUnitFactorRoot, hRadicalToUnitFactorRoot,
      hPureEtale⟩ :=
    exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_etale_over_prescribed_uniformizerRoot
      base target varpi hvarpi pi unit hpi hdecomp alpha halphaPow
  let Rₑ := AdjoinRoot (X ^ e - C varpi)
  let Rₙ := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
  let Cq := AdjoinRoot q
  let higherRootMap : Rₑ →ₐ[base.valuationSubring] Rₙ :=
    adjoinRootPowerMapOfDvd hdiv varpi
  let : Algebra Rₑ Rₙ := higherRootMap.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra Rₑ Cq := radicalToUnitFactor.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower base.valuationSubring Rₑ Cq :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun z =>
      (radicalToUnitFactor.commutes z).symm
  let : Module.Finite base.valuationSubring Rₑ :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpi he_ne).finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Finite target.valuationSubring Cq := hqFinite
  let : Module.Finite base.valuationSubring Cq :=
    Module.Finite.trans target.valuationSubring Cq
  let : Module.Finite Rₑ Cq :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite
      base.valuationSubring Rₑ Cq
  let : Algebra.Etale Rₑ Cq := hPureEtale
  have hHigherEtale : Algebra.Etale Rₙ (Rₙ ⊗[Rₑ] Cq) := by
    infer_instance
  have hHigherFinite : Module.Finite Rₙ (Rₙ ⊗[Rₑ] Cq) := by
    exact Module.Finite.base_change Rₑ Rₙ Cq
  exact ⟨delta, q, unitFactorEquiv, radicalToUnitFactor,
    hdeltaPow, halpha, hqMonic, hqMap, hqEtale, hqFinite,
    hCompositum, hUnitFactorRoot, hRadicalToUnitFactorRoot,
    hPureEtale, hHigherEtale, hHigherFinite⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.unitFactor_etale_over_uniformizerRadical
statement:
theorem unitFactor_etale_over_uniformizerRadical
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    (delta : AlgebraicClosure L)
    (q : target.valuationSubring[X])
    (hqMonic : q.Monic)
    (hqMap : q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L) = minpoly L delta)
    (hqEtale : Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q))
    (radicalToUnitFactor :
      AdjoinRoot
          (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi) →ₐ[base.valuationSubring]
        AdjoinRoot q) :
    letI : Algebra
        (AdjoinRoot (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi))
        (AdjoinRoot q)
proof:
:= radicalToUnitFactor.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.Etale
      (AdjoinRoot (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi))
      (AdjoinRoot q) := by
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let W := target.valuationSubring
  let e := ramificationIndex base target
  let p : V[X] := X ^ e - C varpi
  let R := AdjoinRoot p
  let Cq := AdjoinRoot q
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := base.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing W := target.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  let : IsFractionRing V K := base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsFractionRing W L := target.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed V := base.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed W := target.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  have he_ne : e ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [e, ramificationIndex] using
      (Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_ne_bot base target)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal W).isPrime
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_le base target))
  have he : 0 < e := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero he_ne
  have hmaxV :
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span {varpi} := by
    change IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal base.valuation.valuationSubring =
      Ideal.span {varpi}
    exact Valuation.IsUniformizer.is_generator hvarpi
  have hvarpi_ne : varpi ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hvarpi.ne_zero
    simp [hz]
  have hvarpiPrime : Prime varpi := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hvarpi_ne).mp
    rw [← hmaxV]
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal V).isPrime
  have hpMonic : p.Monic := monic_X_pow_sub_C varpi he_ne
  have hpIrreducibleMap :
      Irreducible (p.map (algebraMap V K)) := by
    simpa [p] using
      irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_fractionRing_of_prime hvarpiPrime he
  have hpIrreducible : Irreducible p :=
    (hpMonic.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map).2 hpIrreducibleMap
  have hpPrime : Prime p := hpIrreducible.prime
  let : IsDomain R := AdjoinRoot.isDomain_of_prime hpPrime
  have hvarpi_mem : varpi ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V :=
    base.uniformizer_mem_maximalIdeal hvarpi
  let : IsLocalRing R :=
    isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C he hvarpi_mem
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V R :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C he varpi
  let : Module.Finite V R := hpMonic.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : IsNoetherianRing R := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite V R
  have hmaxR :
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R =
        Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root p} := by
    rw [maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C he hvarpi_mem]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply sup_le
      · rw [hmaxV, Ideal.map_span]
        simp only [Set.image_singleton]
        rw [show AdjoinRoot.of p varpi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e by
          simpa [p] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow e varpi).symm]
        rw [Ideal.span_le]
        rintro _ (rfl : _ = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e)
        exact Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem (Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root p})
          (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _) e he
      · exact le_rfl
    · exact le_sup_right
  have hrootR_ne : AdjoinRoot.root p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hmapvarpi_ne : algebraMap V R varpi ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      apply hvarpi_ne
      apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective V R
      simpa using hzero
    apply hmapvarpi_ne
    rw [show algebraMap V R varpi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e by
      change AdjoinRoot.of p varpi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e
      simpa [p] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow e varpi).symm,
      hz, zero_pow he_ne]
  have hR_notField : ¬ IsField R := by
    intro hfield
    have hbot : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R = ⊥ :=
      IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hfield
    have : AdjoinRoot.root p ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R) := by
      rw [← hbot, hmaxR]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    exact hrootR_ne (by simpa using this)
  have hprincipal :
      Submodule.IsPrincipal (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) := by
    constructor
    refine ⟨AdjoinRoot.root p, ?_⟩
    exact hmaxR
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing R :=
    ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE R hR_notField).out 5 1).mp hprincipal
  have hqIrreducibleMap :
      Irreducible (q.map (algebraMap W L)) := by
    rw [hqMap]
    exact minpoly.irreducible (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral delta)
  have hqIrreducible : Irreducible q :=
    (hqMonic.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map).2 hqIrreducibleMap
  have hqPrime : Prime q := hqIrreducible.prime
  let : IsDomain Cq := AdjoinRoot.isDomain_of_prime hqPrime
  let : Algebra.Etale W Cq := hqEtale
  let : Module.Finite W Cq := hqMonic.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Algebra R Cq := radicalToUnitFactor.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower V R Cq :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun z ↦ (radicalToUnitFactor.commutes z).symm
  have hVCinjective : Function.Injective (algebraMap V Cq) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq V W Cq]
    have hqDegree : q.degree ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← degree_map_eq_of_injective (IsFractionRing.injective W L) q,
        hqMap]
      exact (minpoly.degree_pos (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral delta)).ne'
    exact (AdjoinRoot.of.injective_of_degree_ne_zero hqDegree).comp
      (integerMap_injective base target)
  have hradicalInjective :
      Function.Injective (algebraMap R Cq) := by
    rw [RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot]
    apply Ideal.eq_bot_of_under_eq_bot (R := V)
    rw [Ideal.under, RingHom.comap_ker]
    have hcomp :
        (algebraMap R Cq).comp (algebraMap V R) = algebraMap V Cq := by
      ext z
      exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V R Cq z).symm
    rw [hcomp, (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp hVCinjective]
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree R Cq :=
    Module.isTorsionFree_iff_algebraMap_injective.mpr hradicalInjective
  let : Module.Finite V Cq := Module.Finite.trans W Cq
  let : Module.Finite R Cq :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite V R Cq
  let : Module.Flat R Cq := inferInstance
  have hmapMaxR :
      Ideal.map (algebraMap V R) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) =
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ^ e := by
    rw [hmaxV, Ideal.map_span,
      hmaxR, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
    simp only [Set.image_singleton]
    rw [show algebraMap V R varpi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e by
      change AdjoinRoot.of p varpi = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e
      simpa [p] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow e varpi).symm]
  have hmaxV_ne : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot
    apply hvarpi_ne
    have : varpi ∈ (⊥ : Ideal V) := by
      rw [← hbot, hmaxV]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    simpa using this
  have hramR :
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).ramificationIdx V = e := by
    have hcomapMax :
        ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).comap (algebraMap V R)).IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap V R)
        (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    have hcomap :
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).comap (algebraMap V R) =
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V :=
      IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hcomapMax
    let : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).LiesOver
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) := ⟨hcomap.symm⟩
    rw [← Ideal.ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
      hmaxV_ne]
    apply Ideal.ramificationIdx'_spec
    · rw [hmapMaxR]
    · rw [hmapMaxR]
      intro hle
      have hmem :
          AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e ∈
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ^ (e + 1) := by
        apply hle
        rw [hmaxR, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
        exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
      rw [hmaxR, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
        Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hmem
      have hcancel : AdjoinRoot.root p * c = 1 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero e hrootR_ne)
        calc
          AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e * (AdjoinRoot.root p * c) =
              AdjoinRoot.root p ^ (e + 1) * c := by
            rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
          _ = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e := hc.symm
          _ = AdjoinRoot.root p ^ e * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      have hunit : IsUnit (AdjoinRoot.root p) :=
        isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨c, hcancel⟩
      have hspanTop :
          Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root p} : Set R) = ⊤ :=
        Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hunit
      exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top
        (hmaxR.trans hspanTop)
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree V W :=
    Module.isTorsionFree_iff_algebraMap_injective.mpr
      (integerMap_injective base target)
  let : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W).LiesOver
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) := ⟨by
    change IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal base.valuation.valuationSubring =
      Ideal.comap (integerMap base target)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal target.valuation.valuationSubring)
    exact (maximalIdeal_comap_integerMap_eq base target).symm⟩
  have hramVW :
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W).ramificationIdx V = e := by
    rw [← Ideal.ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W)
      hmaxV_ne]
    rfl
  apply etale_of_dvr_of_finite_torsionFree_of_isUnramifiedAt_all_maximalIdeals
  intro P hPmax
  let : P.IsPrime := hPmax.isPrime
  have hPWmax : (P.under W).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap W _)
      (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) P
  have hPW : P.under W = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hPWmax
  have hPRmax : (P.under R).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R _)
      (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) P
  have hPR : P.under R = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hPRmax
  have hleftTower := Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower
    (R := V) (P.under W) P
  have hrightTower := Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower
    (R := V) (P.under R) P
  have hP_over_V : P.ramificationIdx V = e := by
    rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq_one P W, mul_one, hPW] at hleftTower
    simpa [hramVW] using hleftTower
  have hP_over_R : P.ramificationIdx R = 1 := by
    rw [hPR, hramR] at hrightTower
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left he
    simpa [hP_over_V] using hrightTower.symm
  have hresidueMap : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap V R)) :=
    residueFieldMap_bijective_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C he hvarpi_mem
  let : CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) :=
    charZero_of_injective_ringHom hresidueMap.1
  let : IsLocalHom
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (P.under R))) :=
    ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (P.under R)))).out 5 1).mp (by
        change (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (Localization.AtPrime (P.under R))).under R =
            IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
        exact (Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal (I := P.under R)).trans hPR)
  let : CharZero (P.under R).ResidueField :=
    charZero_of_injective_ringHom
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (P.under R)))).injective
  let : PerfectField (P.under R).ResidueField := inferInstance
  exact (Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq_one_iff (q := P) (R := R)).1 hP_over_R

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_etale_over_prescribed_uniformizerRoot
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_etale_over_prescribed_uniformizerRoot
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} K) (target : DVF.{v, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    (pi : target.valuationSubring)
    (unit : target.valuationSubringˣ)
    (hpi : target.valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : L))
    (hdecomp :
      integerMap base target varpi =
        (unit : target.valuationSubring) *
          pi ^ ramificationIndex base target)
    (alpha : AlgebraicClosure L)
    (halphaPow :
      alpha ^ ramificationIndex base target =
        algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K)) :
    ∃ (delta : AlgebraicClosure L) (q : target.valuationSubring[X])
      (unitFactorEquiv :
        AdjoinRoot (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L)) ≃ₐ[L]
          IntermediateField.adjoin L ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)))
      (radicalToUnitFactor :
        AdjoinRoot
            (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi) →ₐ[base.valuationSubring]
          AdjoinRoot q),
      delta ^ ramificationIndex base target =
          algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (unit : L) ∧
        alpha = delta * algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (pi : L) ∧
          q.Monic ∧
            q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L) = minpoly L delta ∧
              q ∣ X ^ ramificationIndex base target -
                C (unit : target.valuationSubring) ∧
                Algebra.Etale target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                  Module.Finite target.valuationSubring (AdjoinRoot q) ∧
                    (IntermediateField.adjoin L
                        ({delta} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))).restrictScalars K =
                      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L
                          (AlgebraicClosure L)).fieldRange ⊔
                        IntermediateField.adjoin K
                          ({alpha} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L)) ∧
                      unitFactorEquiv
                          (AdjoinRoot.root
                            (q.map (algebraMap target.valuationSubring L))) =
                        IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen L delta ∧
                        radicalToUnitFactor
                            (AdjoinRoot.root
                              (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) =
                          AdjoinRoot.root q *
                            algebraMap target.valuationSubring
                              (AdjoinRoot q) pi ∧
                          (letI : Algebra
                              (AdjoinRoot
                                (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi))
                              (AdjoinRoot q) :=
                            radicalToUnitFactor.toRingHom.toAlgebra
                           Algebra.Etale
                              (AdjoinRoot
                                (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi))
                              (AdjoinRoot q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨delta, q, unitFactorEquiv, radicalToUnitFactor,
      hdeltaPow, halpha, hqMonic, hqMap, hqDvd, hqEtale, hqFinite,
      hCompositum, hUnitFactorRoot, hRadicalToUnitFactorRoot⟩ :=
    exists_finiteEtale_unitFactor_for_prescribed_uniformizerRoot
      base target varpi pi unit hpi hdecomp alpha halphaPow
  have hPureEtale :=
    unitFactor_etale_over_uniformizerRadical
      base target varpi hvarpi delta q hqMonic hqMap hqEtale
        radicalToUnitFactor
  exact ⟨delta, q, unitFactorEquiv, radicalToUnitFactor,
    hdeltaPow, halpha, hqMonic, hqMap, hqDvd, hqEtale, hqFinite,
    hCompositum, hUnitFactorRoot, hRadicalToUnitFactorRoot, hPureEtale⟩

theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_normalizationInertia_coprime_of_isIntegrallyClosed
    {A K L : Type u} {k : Type uk}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]

    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
