name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_finiteEtaleGaloisCover_quotientIdealInertia_coprime
statement:
theorem
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_finiteEtaleGaloisCover_quotientIdealInertia_coprime
    {A : Type u} {k : Type uk}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (hCharZero : ∀ j, j.1 < r →
      CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)))
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)))) :
    let hf
proof:
:= splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero hNC
    let S := Localization.Away f
    letI : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
      isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
    ∀ hY : IsGalois Y,
    letI : IsGalois Y := hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let K := (Spec (.of S)).functionField
    let L := Y.left.functionField
    letI : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra A K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
    letI : Algebra A L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
    letI : IsScalarTower A K L :=
      finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower f hf Y
    letI : IsFractionRing A K :=
      localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing f hf
    letI : FiniteDimensional K L :=
      finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
    letI : _root_.IsGalois K L :=
      isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Y hY
    ∀ {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
      (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ Spec (.of S))
      (y : (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).obj Y)
      (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) (_ : Q.IsPrime),
      Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)) →
      ∀ (_phi : (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)) →+* k)
        (p : ℕ) (_ : CharP k p), p.Prime →
        letI : IsFractionRing (integralClosure A L) L :=
          IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension
            A K L (integralClosure A L)
        letI : MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) (integralClosure A L) :=
          IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L (integralClosure A L)
        letI : MulSemiringAction (Aut Y)ᵐᵒᵖ (integralClosure A L) :=
          finiteEtaleGaloisCoverNormalizationAction
            Y hY A (integralClosure A L)
        Nat.Coprime
          (Nat.card
            (Subgroup.map
              (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom xi Y hY y)
              (Subgroup.comap
                (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom xi Y hY y)
                (Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia (Aut Y)ᵐᵒᵖ)))) p := by
  dsimp only
  intro hY
  have hf : f ≠ 0 :=
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero hNC
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
  let : IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let K : Type u := (Spec (.of S)).functionField
  let L : Type u := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra A K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
  let : Algebra A L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
  let : IsScalarTower A K L :=
    finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower f hf Y
  let : IsFractionRing A K :=
    localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing f hf
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : _root_.IsGalois K L :=
    isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Y hY
  intro Omega instField instSepClosed xi y Q hQprime hQLiesOver
    phi p hpChar hp
  let genericAction :
      MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) (integralClosure A L) := inferInstance
  let integralClosureAction :
      MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) (integralClosure A L) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L (integralClosure A L)
  have hcoprime :
      Nat.Coprime
        (Nat.card
          (letI := genericAction
           Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K))) p := by
    let : Q.IsPrime := hQprime
    let : Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)) := hQLiesOver
    let : CharP k p := hpChar
    let := genericAction
    exact
      splitStrictNormalCrossings_finiteEtaleGaloisCover_normalizationInertia_coprime
        hNC i hi hCharZero Y hY Q hQprime hQLiesOver phi p hpChar hp
  have hsmul : ∀ (sigma : Gal(L/K)) (x : integralClosure A L),
      (letI := genericAction; sigma • x) =
        (letI := integralClosureAction; sigma • x) := by
    intro sigma x
    apply Subtype.ext
    calc
      ((letI := genericAction; (sigma • x : integralClosure A L)) : L) =
          sigma • (x : L) := by
        let := genericAction
        exact integralClosure.coe_smul sigma x
      _ = sigma (x : L) := AlgEquiv.smul_def _ _
      _ = ((letI := integralClosureAction;
          (sigma • x : integralClosure A L)) : L) := by
        let := integralClosureAction
        exact (algebraMap_galRestrict_apply A sigma x).symm
  have haction :
      (letI := genericAction
       Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) =
        (letI := integralClosureAction
         Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) := by
    ext sigma
    change
      (∀ x : integralClosure A L,
        (letI := genericAction; sigma • x) - x ∈ Q) ↔
      (∀ x : integralClosure A L,
        (letI := integralClosureAction; sigma • x) - x ∈ Q)
    constructor
    · intro hsigma x
      rw [← hsmul sigma x]
      exact hsigma x
    · intro hsigma x
      rw [hsmul sigma x]
      exact hsigma x
  let : IsFractionRing (integralClosure A L) L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension
      A K L (integralClosure A L)
  let : MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosureAction
  let : MulSemiringAction (Aut Y)ᵐᵒᵖ (integralClosure A L) :=
    finiteEtaleGaloisCoverNormalizationAction
      Y hY A (integralClosure A L)
  rw [natCard_finiteEtaleGaloisCoverIdealInertia_image_eq
    xi Y hY y A (integralClosure A L) Q]
  rw [← haction]
  exact hcoprime

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r) : f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (hNC.2.2.2.2.1.ne_zero_iff).mpr
  rw [boundaryProduct]
  exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j hj ↦
    (hNC.2.2.2.1 j (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2).ne_zero

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_finiteEtaleGaloisCover_normalizationInertia_coprime
statement:
theorem
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_finiteEtaleGaloisCover_normalizationInertia_coprime
    {A : Type u} {k : Type uk}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (hCharZero : ∀ j, j.1 < r →
      CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)))
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)))) :
    let hf
proof:
:= splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero hNC
    let S := Localization.Away f
    letI : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
      isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
    ∀ hY : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y,
    letI : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y := hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let K := (Spec (.of S)).functionField
    let L := Y.left.functionField
    letI : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra A K :=
      localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
    letI : Algebra A L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
    letI : IsScalarTower A K L :=
      finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower f hf Y
    letI : IsFractionRing A K :=
      localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing f hf
    letI : FiniteDimensional K L :=
      finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
    letI : _root_.IsGalois K L :=
      isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Y hY
    ∀ (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) (_ : Q.IsPrime),
      Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)) →
      ∀ (_phi : (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)) →+* k)
        (p : ℕ) (_ : CharP k p), p.Prime →
        Nat.Coprime
          (Nat.card (Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K))) p := by
  dsimp only
  intro hY
  have hf : f ≠ 0 :=
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero hNC
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let X := Spec (.of S)
  let K : Type u := X.functionField
  let L : Type u := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra A K :=
    localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
  let : Algebra A L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
  let : IsScalarTower A K L :=
    finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower f hf Y
  let : IsFractionRing A K :=
    localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing f hf
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : _root_.IsGalois K L :=
    isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Y hY
  have hAway : (Localization.awayMap
      (algebraMap A (integralClosure A L)) f).Etale :=
    localization_away_integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale
      f hf Y
  intro Q hQprime hQLiesOver phi p hpChar hp
  exact
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_normalizationInertia_coprime_of_isIntegrallyClosed
      (K := K) (L := L) hNC i hi hCharZero hAway Q phi p hp

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.all_exponents_isUnit_of_formallyUnramified_boundaryIteratedRadical
statement:
theorem all_exponents_isUnit_of_formallyUnramified_boundaryIteratedRadical
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    {r : ℕ} (t : Fin r → R)
    [IsLocalization.Away
      (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)), t i) S]
    (ht : ∀ i, Prime (t i))
    (hCharZero : ∀ i, CharZero (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}))
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    [Algebra.FormallyUnramified S
      (iteratedRadical S r n (fun i ↦ algebraMap R S (t i)))] :
    ∀ i, IsUnit (n i : R)
proof:
:= by
  have hBoundary_ne :
      (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)), t i) ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ ↦ (ht i).ne_zero
  let : IsDomain S :=
    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hBoundary_ne
  have hnS : ∀ i, IsUnit (n i : S) :=
    all_exponents_isUnit_of_formallyUnramified_iteratedRadical
      (A := S) n (fun i ↦ algebraMap R S (t i)) hn
  intro i
  exact
    isUnit_natCast_of_isUnit_algebraMap_away_finsetProduct
      (R := R) (S := S) Finset.univ t
      (fun j _ ↦ ht j) (fun j _ ↦ hCharZero j) (hn i) (by
        simpa using hnS i)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.span_root_liesOver_span_radicand
statement:
theorem span_root_liesOver_span_radicand
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
    letI : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    letI : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
    q.LiesOver P := by
  dsimp only
  let P := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
  let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
  let q := Ideal.span
    ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
  let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
  let : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
    (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
  apply Ideal.LiesOver.mk
  symm
  ext x
  change algebraMap R D x ∈ q ↔ x ∈ P
  have hqker : q = RingHom.ker (adjoinRootToQuotient hN p) :=
    (ker_adjoinRootToQuotient hN p).symm
  rw [hqker]
  change adjoinRootToQuotient hN p (algebraMap R D x) = 0 ↔ x ∈ P
  simp [adjoinRootToQuotient, P, D,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra_root
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (N : ℕ) (p : R) (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    letI : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p))
    letI : Algebra D Rn :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
    algebraMap D Rn (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)) =
      AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p)) := by
  dsimp only
  let P := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
  let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let fR : R[X] := X ^ N - C p
  let fV : V[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p)
  let D := AdjoinRoot fR
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot fV
  let : Algebra D Rn :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
  have hmap : fR.map (algebraMap R V) = fV := by simp [fR, fV]
  change ((adjoinRootBaseChangeAlgEquiv fR).trans
      (AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq V _ _ hmap))
    (1 ⊗ₜ[R] AdjoinRoot.root fR) = AdjoinRoot.root fV
  rw [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, adjoinRootBaseChangeAlgEquiv_tmul_root,
    AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq_root]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra_base
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (N : ℕ) (p r : R) (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    letI : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p))
    letI : Algebra D Rn :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
    algebraMap D Rn (algebraMap R D r) =
      algebraMap V Rn (algebraMap R V r) := by
  dsimp only
  let P := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
  let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p))
  let eV := adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgEquiv R N p hp
  change eV (1 ⊗ₜ[R] algebraMap R D r) =
    algebraMap V Rn (algebraMap R V r)
  calc
    eV (1 ⊗ₜ[R] algebraMap R D r) =
        eV (algebraMap V (V ⊗[R] D) (algebraMap R V r)) := by
      congr 1
      exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul r).symm
    _ = _ := eV.commutes _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isLocalization_adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime
statement:
theorem isLocalization_adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
    letI : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    letI : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p))
    letI : Algebra D Rn :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
    letI : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
    IsLocalization q.primeCompl Rn := by
  dsimp only
  let P := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
  let fR : R[X] := X ^ N - C p
  let D := AdjoinRoot fR
  let q := Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root fR} : Set D)
  let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
  let : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
    (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
  let : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let pV : V := algebraMap R V p
  let fV : V[X] := X ^ N - C pV
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot fV
  let eV : (V ⊗[R] D) ≃ₐ[V] Rn :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgEquiv R N p hp
  let : Algebra D (V ⊗[R] D) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : Algebra D Rn :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
  let eD : (V ⊗[R] D) ≃ₐ[D] Rn :=
    { eV.toRingEquiv with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let M := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid D P.primeCompl
  have hTensor : IsLocalization M (V ⊗[R] D) := by
    infer_instance
  have hRnM : IsLocalization M Rn :=
    IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_algEquiv M eD
  have hpMem : pV ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V := by
    change algebraMap R V p ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
    rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal P]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R V)
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self p)
  let : IsLocalRing Rn :=
    isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN hpMem
  let J : Ideal D :=
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Rn).comap (algebraMap D Rn)
  have hrootMap : algebraMap D Rn (AdjoinRoot.root fR) =
      AdjoinRoot.root fV := by
    exact adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra_root N p hp
  have hbaseMap (r : R) : algebraMap D Rn (algebraMap R D r) =
      algebraMap V Rn (algebraMap R V r) := by
    exact adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra_base N p r hp
  have hqJ : q ≤ J := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ (rfl : _ = AdjoinRoot.root fR)
    change algebraMap D Rn (AdjoinRoot.root fR) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Rn
    rw [hrootMap]
    apply (inferInstance : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Rn).IsPrime).mem_of_pow_mem N
    rw [adjoinRoot_root_pow]
    rw [maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN hpMem]
    exact
      (show Ideal.map (AdjoinRoot.of fV) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) ≤
          localRootCoverClosedIdeal V N pV from le_sup_left)
        (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (AdjoinRoot.of fV) hpMem)
  have hJUnder : J.under R = P := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro r hr
      by_contra hrP
      have hrUnitV : IsUnit (algebraMap R V r) :=
        IsLocalization.map_units V (⟨r, hrP⟩ : P.primeCompl)
      have hrUnitRn : IsUnit (algebraMap V Rn (algebraMap R V r)) :=
        hrUnitV.map (algebraMap V Rn)
      have hnonmem : algebraMap D Rn (algebraMap R D r) ∉
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Rn := by
        rw [hbaseMap]
        exact IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr hrUnitRn
      exact hnonmem hr
    · rw [Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := q) (p := P)]
      exact Ideal.comap_mono hqJ
  have hJq : J = q := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · by_contra hnot
      have hne : q ≠ J := by
        intro heq
        exact hnot heq.ge
      have hlt : q < J := lt_of_le_of_ne hqJ hne
      have : Module.Finite R D :=
        (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C p hN.ne').finite_adjoinRoot
      have : Algebra.IsIntegral R D := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R D
      have hstrict :=
        Ideal.IsIntegral.under_lt_under (R := R) (A := D) hlt
      exact (ne_of_lt hstrict)
        ((Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := q) (p := P)).symm.trans
          hJUnder.symm)
    · exact hqJ
  have hMle : M ≤ q.primeCompl := by
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    change algebraMap R D r ∉ q
    intro hmem
    exact hr ((Ideal.mem_of_liesOver (P := q) (p := P) r).mpr hmem)
  have hCofinal : ∀ d ∈ q.primeCompl, ∃ m ∈ M, d ∣ m := by
    intro d hd
    have hdUnit : IsUnit (algebraMap D Rn d) := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
      intro hdMax
      have : d ∈ J := hdMax
      rw [hJq] at this
      exact hd this
    exact (IsLocalization.algebraMap_isUnit_iff (M := M)).mp hdUnit
  have hRnq : IsLocalization q.primeCompl Rn :=
    (IsLocalization.iff_of_le_of_exists_dvd (M := M)
      q.primeCompl hMle hCofinal).mp hRnM
  exact hRnq

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv_root
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
    letI : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    letI : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p))
    letI : Algebra D Rn :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
    letI : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
    letI : Algebra V (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P q
    adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv hN hp
        (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p))) =
      algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)) := by
  dsimp only
  let P := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
  let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
  let q := Ideal.span
    ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
  let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
  let : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
    (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p))
  let : Algebra D Rn :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
  let : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
  let : IsLocalization q.primeCompl Rn :=
    isLocalization_adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime hN hp
  let Dq := Localization.AtPrime q
  let eRoot : Rn ≃ₐ[D] Dq :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv q.primeCompl Rn Dq
  let : Algebra V Dq :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P q
  change eRoot (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R V p))) =
    algebraMap D Dq (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p))
  rw [← adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra_root N p hp]
  exact eRoot.commutes _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.formallyEtale_adjoinRoot_of_monic_of_isUnit_aeval_derivative
statement:
theorem formallyEtale_adjoinRoot_of_monic_of_isUnit_aeval_derivative
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {f : A[X]} (hf : f.Monic)
    (hDerivative : IsUnit (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f.derivative)) :
    Algebra.FormallyEtale A (AdjoinRoot f)
proof:
:= by
  have hmk : IsUnit (AdjoinRoot.mk f f.derivative) := by
    simpa only [AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq] using hDerivative
  let P : StandardEtalePair A :=
    { f := f
      monic_f := hf
      g := f.derivative
      cond := ⟨1, 0, 1, by rw [mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, pow_one]⟩ }
  have hP : IsUnit (AdjoinRoot.mk P.f P.g) := by
    change IsUnit (AdjoinRoot.mk f f.derivative)
    exact hmk
  let eUnit :
      AdjoinRoot P.f ≃ₐ[AdjoinRoot P.f]
        Localization.Away (AdjoinRoot.mk P.f P.g) :=
    IsLocalization.atUnit
      (AdjoinRoot P.f)
      (Localization.Away (AdjoinRoot.mk P.f P.g))
      (AdjoinRoot.mk P.f P.g) hP
  let e : P.Ring ≃ₐ[A] AdjoinRoot P.f :=
    P.equivAwayAdjoinRoot.trans (eUnit.symm.restrictScalars A)
  change Algebra.FormallyEtale A (AdjoinRoot P.f)
  exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_equiv e

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.formallyEtale_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem formallyEtale_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : A}
    (hnUnit : IsUnit (n : A)) (ha : IsUnit a) :
    Algebra.FormallyEtale A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))
proof:
:= by
  refine formallyEtale_adjoinRoot_of_monic_of_isUnit_aeval_derivative
    (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne') ?_
  rw [aeval_derivative_X_pow_sub_C]
  exact
    (hnUnit.map (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)))).mul
      ((isUnit_adjoinRoot_root_of_isUnit hn ha).pow (n - 1))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_notMem_span_singleton_sq
statement:
theorem prime_notMem_span_singleton_sq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {t : R} (ht : Prime t) :
    t ∉ (Ideal.span ({t} : Set R)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  intro h
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
  apply ht.not_isUnit
  rw [isUnit_iff_dvd_one]
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ ht.ne_zero
  simpa [pow_two, mul_assoc] using ha

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isEisensteinAt_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
statement:
theorem isEisensteinAt_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {t : R} (ht : Prime t)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    (X ^ n - C t).IsEisensteinAt (Ideal.span ({t} : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  refine (monic_X_pow_sub_C t hn.ne').isEisensteinAt_of_mem_of_notMem
    (Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ht).ne_top ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi
    rw [natDegree_X_pow_sub_C] at hi
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    by_cases hi₀ : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, hn.ne'.symm]
    · have hin : i ≠ n := Nat.ne_of_lt hi
      simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_C, hi₀, hin]
  · simpa [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, hn.ne'.symm, Ideal.neg_mem_iff] using
      prime_notMem_span_singleton_sq ht

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
statement:
theorem irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {t : R} (ht : Prime t)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Irreducible (X ^ n - C t)
proof:
:=
  (isEisensteinAt_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime ht hn).irreducible
    (Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ht)
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C t hn.ne').isPrimitive
    (by simpa using hn)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_fractionRing_of_prime
statement:
theorem irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_fractionRing_of_prime
    {R : Type u} {K : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] {t : R} (ht : Prime t)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Irreducible (X ^ n - C (algebraMap R K t))
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :
      Irreducible ((X ^ n - C t).map (algebraMap R K)) :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C t hn.ne').irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map.mp
      (irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime ht hn)
  simpa using hmap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_away_of_prime
statement:
theorem irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_away_of_prime
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {K : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] {t : R} [IsLocalization.Away t S]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] (ht : Prime t)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Irreducible (X ^ n - C (algebraMap R S t))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S ht.ne_zero
  have hpow : Submonoid.powers t ≤ nonZeroDivisors R :=
    Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht.ne_zero)
  let ι : S →+* K :=
    (Localization.mapToFractionRing K (Submonoid.powers t) S hpow).toRingHom
  have hι_injective : Function.Injective ι := by
    dsimp only [ι, Localization.mapToFractionRing]
    refine (IsLocalization.lift_injective_iff _).2 fun a b ↦ ?_
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ congrArg _ (IsLocalization.injective S hpow h),
      fun h ↦ congrArg _ (IsFractionRing.injective R K h)⟩
  have hι_comm (a : R) : ι (algebraMap R S a) = algebraMap R K a := by
    change
      (Localization.mapToFractionRing K (Submonoid.powers t) S hpow)
          (algebraMap R S a) = algebraMap R K a
    exact (Localization.mapToFractionRing K (Submonoid.powers t) S hpow).commutes a
  have hprimitive :
      (X ^ n - C (algebraMap R S t)).IsPrimitive :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C (algebraMap R S t) hn.ne').isPrimitive
  refine hprimitive.irreducible_of_irreducible_map_of_injective hι_injective ?_
  simpa [hι_comm] using irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_fractionRing_of_prime ht hn

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isUnit_aeval_derivative_of_formallyUnramified
statement:
theorem isUnit_aeval_derivative_of_formallyUnramified
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (f : R[X])
    [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R (AdjoinRoot f)] :
    IsUnit (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f.derivative)
proof:
:= by
  let d : AdjoinRoot f := aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f.derivative
  let I : Ideal (AdjoinRoot f) := Ideal.span {d}
  let q : AdjoinRoot f →ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot f ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I
  let L₀ : R[X] →ₗ[R] AdjoinRoot f ⧸ I :=
    q.toLinearMap.comp
      ((AdjoinRoot.mkₐ f).toLinearMap.comp Polynomial.derivative'.toLinearMap)
  have hL₀ : ∀ p : R[X],
      p ∈ (Ideal.span {f} : Ideal R[X]).restrictScalars R → L₀ p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hp
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk I
      (AdjoinRoot.mk f (derivative (f * g))) = 0
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    change AdjoinRoot.mk f (derivative (f * g)) ∈ I
    rw [Polynomial.derivative_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul,
      AdjoinRoot.mk_self, zero_mul, add_zero]
    apply I.mul_mem_right
    change AdjoinRoot.mk f f.derivative ∈ Ideal.span ({d} : Set (AdjoinRoot f))
    apply Ideal.subset_span
    change AdjoinRoot.mk f f.derivative =
      aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f.derivative
    exact (AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq _).symm
  have hL₀ker :
      (Ideal.span {f} : Ideal R[X]).restrictScalars R ≤ LinearMap.ker L₀ := by
    intro p hp
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (hL₀ p hp)
  let L : AdjoinRoot f →ₗ[R] AdjoinRoot f ⧸ I :=
    (Submodule.liftQ _ L₀ hL₀ker).comp
      (Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv R
        (Ideal.span {f} : Ideal R[X])).symm.toLinearMap
  have hL_mk (p : R[X]) :
      L (AdjoinRoot.mk f p) = q (AdjoinRoot.mk f p.derivative) := by
    change
      (Submodule.restrictScalars R (Ideal.span {f} : Ideal R[X])).liftQ L₀
          hL₀ker
          ((Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv R
            (Ideal.span {f} : Ideal R[X])).symm (Submodule.Quotient.mk p)) =
        q (AdjoinRoot.mk f p.derivative)
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv_symm_mk,
      Submodule.liftQ_apply]
    rfl
  let D : Derivation R (AdjoinRoot f) (AdjoinRoot f ⧸ I) :=
    Derivation.mk' L (by
      intro x y
      induction x using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
      | ih p =>
          induction y using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
          | ih g =>
              rw [← (AdjoinRoot.mk f).map_mul p g, hL_mk, hL_mk, hL_mk,
                Polynomial.derivative_mul]
              simp only [map_add, map_mul, Algebra.smul_def]
              ac_rfl)
  have hD_root : D (AdjoinRoot.root f) = 1 := by
    change L (AdjoinRoot.mk f X) = 1
    rw [hL_mk]
    simp [q]
  have hD_zero : D = 0 := by
    apply
      (KaehlerDifferential.linearMapEquivDerivation
        R (AdjoinRoot f)).symm.injective
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hx : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst x
    simp only [map_zero]
  have hOne : (1 : AdjoinRoot f ⧸ I) = 0 := by
    calc
      (1 : AdjoinRoot f ⧸ I) = D (AdjoinRoot.root f) := hD_root.symm
      _ = (0 : Derivation R (AdjoinRoot f) (AdjoinRoot f ⧸ I))
          (AdjoinRoot.root f) := Derivation.congr_fun hD_zero _
      _ = 0 := rfl
  change IsUnit d
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
  change I = ⊤
  exact Ideal.Quotient.zero_eq_one_iff.mp hOne.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_galoisComponent_pullbackSupportComplementCoverToBoundaryAway_quotientIdealInertia_coprime
statement:
theorem
  exists_galoisComponent_pullbackSupportComplementCoverToBoundaryAway_quotientIdealInertia_coprime
    [IsIntegral X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) {U : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) (u : U)
    (P : Spec (U.presheaf.stalk u)) :
    let : P.asIdeal.IsPrime
proof:
:= P.isPrime
    ∀ {r : ℕ}
    (t : Fin 2 → Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
    (hboundary :
      ((I.comap f).stalkIdeal u).map
          (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u)
            (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =
        Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r})
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
      (boundaryProduct t r) t r)
    (branch : Fin 2) (_hbranch : branch.1 < r)
    (_hCharZero : ∀ j : Fin 2, j.1 < r →
      CharZero
        (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal ⧸ Ideal.span {t j}))
    (hVdomain : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))
    (hVregular : IsRegularRing (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))
    (hVnormal : IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))
    {k : Type uk} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    (_phi :
      (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal ⧸ Ideal.span {t branch}) →+* k)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (_hp : p.Prime),
    letI : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) := hVdomain
    letI : IsRegularRing (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) := hVregular
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) := hVnormal
    let hf :=
      Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero
        hNC
    letI : IsDomain (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) :=
      IsLocalization.Away.isDomain
        (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) hf
    let j := localizationAwayToSupportComplement
      (I.comap f) u P.asIdeal (boundaryProduct t r) hboundary
    let g := comapSupportComplementTo I f
    letI : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement :=
      ⟨j (genericPoint
        (Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))⟩
    letI : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
      ⟨g (Classical.choice
        (inferInstance : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement))⟩
    ∀ (W : FiniteEtale I.supportComplement), IsGalois W →
      ∃ (Z : FiniteEtale
          (Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))
        (component : Z ⟶
          pullbackSupportComplementCoverToChartBoundaryAway
            I f u P t hboundary W)
        (_hZ : IsGalois Z),
        Mono component ∧
          GaloisCoverQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime
            hNC (Ideal.span {t branch}) Z p := by
  intro hPPrime r t hboundary hNC branch hbranch hCharZero
    hVdomain hVregular hVnormal k instCommRing instNontrivial phi p instCharP hp
  dsimp only
  let : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) := hVdomain
  let : IsRegularRing (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) := hVregular
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) := hVnormal
  let hf :=
    Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero
      hNC
  let : IsDomain (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain
      (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) hf
  let j := localizationAwayToSupportComplement
    (I.comap f) u P.asIdeal (boundaryProduct t r) hboundary
  let g := comapSupportComplementTo I f
  let : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement :=
    ⟨j (genericPoint
      (Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))⟩
  let : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
    ⟨g (Classical.choice
      (inferInstance : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement))⟩
  intro W hW
  obtain ⟨Z, component, hZ, hcomponent⟩ :=
    exists_galoisComponent_pullbackSupportComplementCoverToBoundaryAway
      I f u P t hboundary hNC hVdomain W hW
  refine ⟨Z, component, hZ, hcomponent, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [GaloisCoverQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime]
  intro hZ' Omega instField instSepClosed xi z Q hQprime hQbranch
  exact
    Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_finiteEtaleGaloisCover_quotientIdealInertia_coprime
      hNC branch hbranch hCharZero Z hZ' xi z Q hQprime hQbranch
        phi p inferInstance hp

theorem IsNormalCrossingsAt.exists_etaleStrictChart_galoisComponent_quotientIdealInertia_coprime

proof:

                  letI : IsDomain V := hVdomain

                      (boundaryProduct t r) hboundary
                  let g := comapSupportComplementTo I f
                  letI : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement :=
                    ⟨j (genericPoint
                      (Spec (.of
                        (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))⟩
                  letI : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
                    ⟨g (Classical.choice
                      (inferInstance :
                        Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement))⟩
                  ∀ (W : FiniteEtale I.supportComplement), IsGalois W →
                    ∃ (Z : FiniteEtale
                        (Spec (.of
                          (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))
                      (component : Z ⟶

                          I f u P t hboundary W)
                      (_hZ : IsGalois Z),
                      Mono component ∧
                        GaloisCoverQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime
                          hNC qV Z p := by
  obtain ⟨U, f, u, hf, hfu, hstrict⟩ := hI
  refine ⟨U, f, u, hf, hfu, hstrict, ?_⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossings.exists_arithmeticLocalSplitChart_galoisCover_quotientIdealInertia_coprime
statement:
theorem
  IsStrictNormalCrossings.exists_arithmeticLocalSplitChart_galoisCover_quotientIdealInertia_coprime
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.IdealSheafData} {x : X}
    (hI : I.IsStrictNormalCrossings)
    (hCharZero : I.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt x)
    (q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqheight : q.height = 1)
    (hIq : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ q)
    {k : Type uk} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    (phi : (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q) →+* k)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : p.Prime) :
    let A
proof:
:= X.presheaf.stalk x
    ∃ P : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec A,
      q < P.asIdeal ∧ P.asIdeal.height = 2 ∧
        let : P.asIdeal.IsPrime := P.isPrime
        let V := Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal
        let qV := q.map (algebraMap A V)
        ∃ (r : ℕ) (t : Fin 2 → V) (i : Fin 2)
          (hVdomain : IsDomain V) (hVregular : IsRegularRing V)
          (hVnormal : IsIntegrallyClosed V)
          (_hboundary : (I.stalkIdeal x).map (algebraMap A V) =
            Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r})
          (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
            (boundaryProduct t r) t r)
          (_hi : i.1 < r)
          (_hqi : qV = Ideal.span {t i})
          (_hlocalizedCharZero : ∀ j : Fin 2, j.1 < r →
            CharZero (V ⧸ Ideal.span {t j}))
          (_hpV : CharP (V ⧸ maximalIdeal V) p),
            letI : IsDomain V := hVdomain
            letI : IsRegularRing V := hVregular
            letI : IsIntegrallyClosed V := hVnormal
            PointedGaloisQuotientInertiaCoprime hNC qV p := by
  intro A
  obtain ⟨P, hPprime, hqP, hPheight, r, t, i, hVdomain,
      hVregular, hboundary, hNC, hi, hqi, hlocalizedCharZero, hpV⟩ :=
    hI.exists_heightTwo_localSplitChart_of_branch_residueCharacteristic
      hCharZero q hqheight hIq phi p hp
  let Pspec : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec A := ⟨P, hPprime⟩
  refine ⟨Pspec, ?_⟩
  change q < P ∧ P.height = 2 ∧ _
  refine ⟨hqP, hPheight, ?_⟩
  intro hPPrime V qV
  let : IsRegularLocalRing V :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_isRegularRing_of_isLocalRing V
  have hdimV : ringKrullDim V = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim V = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P V
      _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hPheight
  have hVnormal : IsIntegrallyClosed V :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      hdimV
  refine ⟨r, t, i, hVdomain, hVregular,
    hVnormal, hboundary, hNC, hi, hqi, hlocalizedCharZero, hpV, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [PointedGaloisQuotientInertiaCoprime]
  intro Y
  let hquotient :=
    Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_finiteEtaleGaloisCover_quotientIdealInertia_coprime
      (A := V) (k := V ⧸ maximalIdeal V)
      hNC i hi hlocalizedCharZero Y
  let f := boundaryProduct t r
  have hf : f ≠ 0 :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero
      hNC
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
  intro hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let K : Type u := (Spec (.of S)).functionField
  let L : Type u := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra V K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
  let : Algebra V L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower f hf Y
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing f hf
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Y
  let : _root_.IsGalois K L :=
    isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Y hY
  intro Omega instField instSepClosed xi y Q hQprime hQq
  have hQbranch : Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({t i} : Set V)) := by
    rw [← hqi]
    exact hQq
  let phiV : (V ⧸ Ideal.span ({t i} : Set V)) →+*
      (V ⧸ maximalIdeal V) :=
    (localizationAtPrimeBranchQuotientToResidue q P hqP.le).comp
      (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hqi.symm).toRingHom
  exact hquotient hY xi y Q hQprime hQbranch phiV p hpV hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SpecMap_genericPoint_of_injective
statement:
private theorem SpecMap_genericPoint_of_injective
    {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S]
    (φ : R ⟶ S) (hφ : Function.Injective φ) :
    Spec.map φ (genericPoint (Spec S)) = genericPoint (Spec R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine, genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine]
  apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
  change Ideal.comap φ.hom ⊥ = ⊥
  exact Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective φ.hom hφ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.fromSpecStalk_genericPoint_eq
statement:
private theorem Scheme.fromSpecStalk_genericPoint_eq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] (x : X) :
    X.fromSpecStalk x (genericPoint (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))) =
      genericPoint X
proof:
:= by
  let h := genericPoint_specializes x
  let K := X.functionField
  have hK : genericPoint (Spec K) = IsLocalRing.closedPoint K := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    rw [genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine]
    exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot.symm
  have hmap : Spec.map (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h)
      (genericPoint (Spec K)) =
      genericPoint (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
    apply SpecMap_genericPoint_of_injective
    change Function.Injective
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)
    exact IsFractionRing.injective (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
  have hcomp := X.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk h
  have happ := congrArg (fun g ↦ g (genericPoint (Spec K))) hcomp
  change X.fromSpecStalk x
      (Spec.map (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h) (genericPoint (Spec K))) =
    X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) (genericPoint (Spec K)) at happ
  rw [hmap, hK, X.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint] at happ
  exact happ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.localizationAwayToAmbient_isDominant
statement:
theorem localizationAwayToAmbient_isDominant
    [IsIntegral X] (x : X)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [P.IsPrime]
    (f : Localization.AtPrime P) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    IsDominant
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.Away f))) ≫
        Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P)
proof:
:= by
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let : IsDomain V := inferInstance
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  have hAV : Function.Injective (algebraMap A V) :=
    IsLocalization.injective (M := P.primeCompl) V (by
      intro a ha
      change a ∉ P at ha
      exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by
        intro ha0
        exact ha (ha0 ▸ P.zero_mem)))
  have hVS : Function.Injective (algebraMap V S) :=
    IsLocalization.injective (M := Submonoid.powers f) S
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
  have hgenericVS :
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap V S))
          (genericPoint (Spec (.of S))) =
        genericPoint (Spec (.of V)) :=
    SpecMap_genericPoint_of_injective _ hVS
  have hgenericAV :
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A V))
          (genericPoint (Spec (.of V))) =
        genericPoint (Spec A) :=
    SpecMap_genericPoint_of_injective _ hAV
  have hgeneric :
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap V S)) ≫
          Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P)
        (genericPoint (Spec (.of S))) = genericPoint X := by
    change X.fromSpecStalk x
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A V))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap V S))
          (genericPoint (Spec (.of S))))) = genericPoint X
    rw [hgenericVS, hgenericAV, Scheme.fromSpecStalk_genericPoint_eq]
  constructor
  rw [DenseRange, dense_iff_closure_eq]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact Set.subset_univ _
  · rw [← (genericPoint_spec X).def]
    apply closure_mono
    rintro _ rfl
    exact ⟨genericPoint (Spec (.of S)), hgeneric⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.localizationAwayToSupportComplement_isPreimmersion
statement:
theorem localizationAwayToSupportComplement_isPreimmersion
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [P.IsPrime]
    (f : Localization.AtPrime P)
    (hboundary :
      (I.stalkIdeal x).map
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)) =
        Ideal.span {f}) :
    IsPreimmersion
      (localizationAwayToSupportComplement I x P f hboundary)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsPreimmersion.comp_iff
    (localizationAwayToSupportComplement I x P f hboundary)
    I.supportComplement.ι]
  rw [localizationAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι]
  rw [Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo]
  let : IsPreimmersion
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.Away f)))) :=
    IsPreimmersion.of_isLocalization
      (R := Localization.AtPrime P) (S := Localization.Away f)
      (Submonoid.powers f)
  let : IsPreimmersion
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)))) :=
    IsPreimmersion.of_isLocalization
      (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) (S := Localization.AtPrime P)
      P.primeCompl
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.localizationAwayToSupportComplement_isDominant
statement:
theorem localizationAwayToSupportComplement_isDominant
    [IsIntegral X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [P.IsPrime]

      (I.stalkIdeal x).map
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)) =
        Ideal.span {f}) :
    IsDominant
      (localizationAwayToSupportComplement I x P f hboundary)
proof:
:= by
  let j := localizationAwayToSupportComplement I x P f hboundary
  let : IsDominant (j ≫ I.supportComplement.ι) := by
    rw [localizationAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι]
    exact localizationAwayToAmbient_isDominant x P f hf
  exact IsDominant.of_comp_of_isOpenImmersion j I.supportComplement.ι

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.boundaryProduct_ne_zero_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings
statement:
private theorem boundaryProduct_ne_zero_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings
    {V : Type u} [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsLocalRing V]
    {r : ℕ} {t : Fin 2 → V}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
      (boundaryProduct t r) t r) :
    boundaryProduct t r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (hNC.2.2.2.2.1.ne_zero_iff).mpr
  rw [boundaryProduct]
  exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j hj ↦
    (hNC.2.2.2.1 j (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2).ne_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.localizationAwayToSupportComplement_pullback_isGalois
statement:
theorem localizationAwayToSupportComplement_pullback_isGalois
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [P.IsPrime]
    (f : Localization.AtPrime P) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hboundary :
      (I.stalkIdeal x).map
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)) =
        Ideal.span {f})
    [Nonempty I.supportComplement]
    [IsDomain (Localization.Away f)]
    (W : FiniteEtale I.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W) :
    IsGalois ((FiniteEtale.pullback
      (localizationAwayToSupportComplement I x P f hboundary)).obj W)
proof:
:= by
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let j := localizationAwayToSupportComplement I x P f hboundary
  let : IsDomain V := inferInstance
  let : IsIntegral I.supportComplement :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion I.supportComplement.ι
  let : IsNormalIntegral I.supportComplement := inferInstance
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian I.supportComplement := inferInstance
  let : IsPreimmersion j :=
    localizationAwayToSupportComplement_isPreimmersion
      I x P f hboundary
  let : IsDominant j :=
    localizationAwayToSupportComplement_isDominant
      I x P f hf hboundary
  let : QuasiCompact j :=
    localizationAwayToSupportComplement_quasiCompact
      I x P f hboundary
  exact FiniteEtale.pullback_obj_isGalois_of_isPreimmersion_of_isDominant
    j W hW

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.localizationAwayToSupportComplement_pullback_isGalois_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem localizationAwayToSupportComplement_pullback_isGalois_of_ne_zero
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [P.IsPrime]
    (f : Localization.AtPrime P) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hboundary :
      (I.stalkIdeal x).map
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)) =
        Ideal.span {f}) :
    letI : IsDomain (Localization.Away f)
proof:
:=
      IsLocalization.Away.isDomain (Localization.Away f) hf
    letI : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
      supportComplement_nonempty_of_localizationAway
        I x P f hf hboundary
    ∀ (W : FiniteEtale I.supportComplement), IsGalois W →
      IsGalois ((FiniteEtale.pullback
        (localizationAwayToSupportComplement I x P f hboundary)).obj W) := by
  let : IsDomain (Localization.Away f) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain (Localization.Away f) hf
  let : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
    supportComplement_nonempty_of_localizationAway
      I x P f hf hboundary
  intro W hW
  exact localizationAwayToSupportComplement_pullback_isGalois
    I x P f hf hboundary W hW

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.pullbackSupportComplementCoverToBoundaryAway_isGalois
statement:
theorem pullbackSupportComplementCoverToBoundaryAway_isGalois
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)) {r : ℕ}
    (t : Fin 2 → Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
    (hboundary :
      (I.stalkIdeal x).map
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
            (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =
        Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r})
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
      (boundaryProduct t r) t r) :
    let hf
proof:
:= boundaryProduct_ne_zero_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings hNC
    letI : IsDomain (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) :=
      IsLocalization.Away.isDomain
        (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) hf
    letI : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
      supportComplement_nonempty_of_localizationAway
        I x P.asIdeal (boundaryProduct t r) hf hboundary
    ∀ (W : FiniteEtale I.supportComplement), IsGalois W →
      IsGalois
        (pullbackSupportComplementCoverToBoundaryAway
          I x P t hboundary W) := by
  dsimp only
  let hf := boundaryProduct_ne_zero_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings hNC
  let : IsDomain (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) :=
    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain
      (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) hf
  let : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
    supportComplement_nonempty_of_localizationAway
      I x P.asIdeal (boundaryProduct t r) hf hboundary
  intro W hW
  exact localizationAwayToSupportComplement_pullback_isGalois
    I x P.asIdeal (boundaryProduct t r) hf hboundary W hW

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.exists_heightTwoPrime_of_branch_nonunit_natCast
statement:
theorem IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.exists_heightTwoPrime_of_branch_nonunit_natCast
    (hI : I.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt x)
    (q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqheight : q.height = 1)
    (hIq : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ q)
    (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e)
    [CharZero (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q)]
    (he_nonunit : ¬ IsUnit (e : X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q)) :
    ∃ (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (_ : P.IsPrime),
      q < P ∧ P.height = 2 ∧
        ¬ IsUnit
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)
            (e : X.presheaf.stalk x))
proof:
:= by
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let hregular : IsRegularLocalRing A := hI.1
  let : IsLocalRing A := hregular.toIsLocalRing
  let : IsNoetherianRing A := hregular.toIsNoetherian
  obtain ⟨d, r, t, _hrpos, _hr, _hparams, hideal, hdomain,
      hprime, _hquotient⟩ := hI.localParameterGeometry
  let : IsDomain A := hdomain
  have hprod : boundaryProduct t r ∈ q := by
    apply hIq
    rw [hideal]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hq⟩ :=
    exists_activeBranch_eq_of_heightOnePrime_mem_boundaryProduct
      hprime q hqheight hprod
  subst q
  obtain ⟨P, hPprime, _hPminimal, hbranchP, hPheight, heP⟩ :=
    exists_heightTwo_prime_of_nonunit_natCast_mod_prime
      (t i) (hprime i hi) e he he_nonunit
  exact ⟨P, hPprime, hbranchP, hPheight, heP⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.exists_heightTwoPrime_of_branch_residueCharacteristic
statement:
theorem IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.exists_heightTwoPrime_of_branch_residueCharacteristic
    (hI : I.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt x)
    (q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqheight : q.height = 1)
    (hIq : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ q)
    {k : Type uk} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    (phi : (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q) →+* k)
    (p : ℕ) [CharZero (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q)]
    [CharP k p] (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∃ (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (_ : P.IsPrime),
      q < P ∧ P.height = 2 ∧
        ¬ IsUnit
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)
            (p : X.presheaf.stalk x))
proof:
:= by
  have hp_nonunit :
      ¬ IsUnit (p : X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q) := by
    intro hp_unit
    have hp_image : IsUnit (phi (p : X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q)) :=
      hp_unit.map phi
    exact not_isUnit_zero (M₀ := k) (by
      simpa only [map_natCast, CharP.cast_eq_zero] using hp_image)
  exact hI.exists_heightTwoPrime_of_branch_nonunit_natCast
    q hqheight hIq p hp.pos hp_nonunit

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossings.exists_heightTwoPrime_of_branch_residueCharacteristic
statement:
theorem IsStrictNormalCrossings.exists_heightTwoPrime_of_branch_residueCharacteristic
    (hI : I.IsStrictNormalCrossings)
    (q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqheight : q.height = 1)
    (hIq : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ q)
    {k : Type uk} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    (phi : (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q) →+* k)
    (p : ℕ) [CharZero (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q)]
    [CharP k p] (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∃ (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (_ : P.IsPrime),
      q < P ∧ P.height = 2 ∧
        ¬ IsUnit
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)
            (p : X.presheaf.stalk x))
proof:
:= by
  have hxI : x ∈ I.support := by
    rw [← X.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint (x := x)]
    apply I.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_of_stalkIdeal_le
    exact hIq.trans
      (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).ne_top)
  exact (hI x hxI).exists_heightTwoPrime_of_branch_residueCharacteristic
    q hqheight hIq phi p hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossings.exists_localSplitChart_with_boundaryIdeal
statement:
theorem IsStrictNormalCrossings.exists_localSplitChart_with_boundaryIdeal
    (hI : I.IsStrictNormalCrossings)
    (P : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hPheight : P.asIdeal.height = 2)
    (hIP : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ P.asIdeal) :
    letI : P.asIdeal.IsPrime
proof:
:= P.isPrime
    let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (t : Fin 2 → V),
      IsDomain V ∧ IsRegularRing V ∧
        (I.stalkIdeal x).map (algebraMap A V) =
          Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r} ∧
        IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt (boundaryProduct t r) t r := by
  let : P.asIdeal.IsPrime := P.isPrime
  dsimp only
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal
  obtain ⟨r, s, hdomainY, hregularY, hideal, hNC⟩ :=
    hI.localSplitChart_at_fromSpecStalk_of_height_two_of_stalkIdeal_le
      P hPheight hIP
  let e := X.stalkFromSpecStalkEquivLocalization x P
  let t : Fin 2 → V :=
    (e : X.presheaf.stalk (X.fromSpecStalk x P) → V) ∘ s
  let : IsDomain
      (X.presheaf.stalk (X.fromSpecStalk x P)) := hdomainY
  let : IsRegularRing
      (X.presheaf.stalk (X.fromSpecStalk x P)) := hregularY
  have hdomainV : IsDomain V :=
    e.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain
      (X.presheaf.stalk (X.fromSpecStalk x P))
  let : IsDomain V := hdomainV
  have hregularV : IsRegularRing V := IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv e
  have hboundary :
      (I.stalkIdeal x).map (algebraMap A V) =
        Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r} := by
    rw [← I.map_stalkIdeal_stalkFromSpecStalkEquivLocalization x P,
      hideal, Ideal.map_span]
    simp only [Set.image_singleton, boundaryProduct, map_prod]
    change Ideal.span (Set.singleton (boundaryProduct
      ((e : X.presheaf.stalk (X.fromSpecStalk x P) → V) ∘ s) r)) =
      Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r}
    rfl
  have hNCV :
      IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt (boundaryProduct t r) t r := by
    simpa only [t, Function.comp_apply, boundaryProduct, map_prod] using
      hNC.map_ringEquiv e
  exact ⟨r, t, hdomainV, hregularV, hboundary, hNCV⟩

name: Ideal.height_comap_eq_one_of_flat_of_quasiFinite
statement:
private theorem Ideal.height_comap_eq_one_of_flat_of_quasiFinite
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    (hflat : f.Flat) (hqf : f.QuasiFinite)
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] (hq : q.height = 1) :
    (q.comap f).height = 1
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  let : Module.Flat R S := hflat
  let : Algebra.QuasiFinite R S := hqf
  let p : Ideal R := q.comap f
  let : p.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap f
  let : q.LiesOver p := ⟨rfl⟩
  have hheight :=
    Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown p q
  have hp_le_q : p.height ≤ q.height := by
    rw [hheight]
    exact le_add_right (le_refl _)
  have hp_le_one : p.height ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [hq] using hp_le_q
  rcases Order.le_one_iff.mp hp_le_one with hp | hp
  · have hpmin : p ∈ minimalPrimes R :=
      Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff.mp hp
    rw [minimalPrimes_eq_minimals] at hpmin
    have hqmin : q ∈ minimalPrimes S := by
      rw [minimalPrimes_eq_minimals]
      refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
      intro Q hQ hQq
      let : Q.IsPrime := hQ
      have hunder_le : Q.under R ≤ p :=
        Ideal.comap_mono hQq
      have hunder_eq : Q.under R = p :=
        le_antisymm hunder_le (hpmin.2 inferInstance hunder_le)
      have hQeq : Q = q :=
        Algebra.QuasiFinite.eq_of_le_of_under_eq
          (R := R) Q q hQq hunder_eq
      exact hQeq.ge
    have hqzero : q.height = 0 :=
      Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff.mpr hqmin
    exact (one_ne_zero (hq.symm.trans hqzero)).elim
  · exact hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt.comap_of_etale
statement:
theorem HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt.comap_of_etale
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {I : X.IdealSheafData} (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y)
    (hI : I.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt (f y)) :
    (I.comap f).HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt y
proof:
:= by
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian Y :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
  intro q hqPrime hqheight hIq
  let : q.IsPrime := hqPrime
  let φ : X.presheaf.stalk (f y) →+* Y.presheaf.stalk y :=
    (f.stalkMap y).hom
  let p : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) := q.comap φ
  let : p.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap φ
  have hφqf : φ.QuasiFinite := by
    let : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
      φ.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra.EssFiniteType
        (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap f y
    let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified
        (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
      FormallyUnramified.stalkMap f y
    change Algebra.QuasiFinite
      (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
    exact inferInstance
  have hpheight : p.height = 1 :=
    Ideal.height_comap_eq_one_of_flat_of_quasiFinite
      φ q (Flat.stalkMap f y) hφqf hqheight
  let qSpec : Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := ⟨q, hqPrime⟩
  let pSpec : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) := ⟨p, inferInstance⟩
  have hpoint :
      X.fromSpecStalk (f y) pSpec = f (Y.fromSpecStalk y qSpec) := by
    change
      (Spec.map (f.stalkMap y) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk (f y)) qSpec =
        (Y.fromSpecStalk y ≫ f) qSpec
    exact congrArg (fun g ↦ g qSpec)
      (Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk f)
  have hySupport :
      Y.fromSpecStalk y qSpec ∈ (I.comap f).support :=
    ((I.comap f).mem_support_fromSpecStalk_iff_stalkIdeal_le y qSpec).2 hIq
  have hpSupport : X.fromSpecStalk (f y) pSpec ∈ I.support := by
    rw [hpoint]
    rw [support_comap] at hySupport
    exact hySupport
  have hIp : I.stalkIdeal (f y) ≤ p :=
    (I.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_iff_stalkIdeal_le (f y) pSpec).1 hpSupport
  let : CharZero (X.presheaf.stalk (f y) ⧸ p) :=
    hI p inferInstance hpheight hIp
  exact charZero_of_injective_ringHom
    (Ideal.quotientMap_injective (I := q) (f := φ))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.galoisPullbackComponent_mappedQuotientIdealInertia_coprime
statement:
theorem galoisPullbackComponent_mappedQuotientIdealInertia_coprime
    {V : Type u} [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsLocalRing V]
    [IsRegularRing V] [IsIntegrallyClosed V]
    {r : ℕ} {t : Fin 2 → V}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
      (boundaryProduct t r) t r)
    (qV : Ideal V) (p : ℕ)
    {U : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace U]
    (c : Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r))) ⟶ U)
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶
      Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r))))
    (W : FiniteEtale U)
    (hW : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois W)
    (w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ c)).obj W)
    (Z : FiniteEtale
      (Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))
    (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W)
    (z : (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiz : (FiniteEtale.fiber xi).map i z =
      transportedPointOfCompIso
        (FiniteEtale.pullback c) (FiniteEtale.pullbackFiberIso c xi) W w)
    (hi : Mono i) :
    let f
proof:
:= boundaryProduct t r
    let hf :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero
        hNC
    let S := Localization.Away f
    letI : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
      isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
    ∀ (hZ : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Z),
    letI : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Z := hZ
    letI : IsIntegral Z.left :=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
    let K := (Spec (.of S)).functionField
    let L := Z.left.functionField
    letI : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Z
    letI : Algebra V K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
    letI : Algebra V L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Z
    letI : IsScalarTower V K L :=
      finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower f hf Z
    letI : IsFractionRing V K :=
      localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing f hf
    letI : FiniteDimensional K L :=
      finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Z
    letI : _root_.IsGalois K L :=
      isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Z hZ
    let B := integralClosure V L
    letI : IsFractionRing B L :=
      IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension V K L B
    letI : MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) B :=
      IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction V K L B
    letI : MulSemiringAction (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ B :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverNormalizationAction
        Z hZ V B
    GaloisCoverQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime hNC qV Z p →
    ∀ (Q : Ideal B) (_ : Q.IsPrime), Q.LiesOver qV →
      let qZ := finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom xi Z hZ z
      let H := Subgroup.map qZ
        (Subgroup.comap qZ (Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ))
      Nat.Coprime
        (Nat.card (H.map
          (FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom
            c xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi))) p := by
  dsimp only
  let f := boundaryProduct t r
  have hf : f ≠ 0 :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero
      hNC
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
  intro hZ
  let : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Z := hZ
  let : IsIntegral Z.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  let K := (Spec (.of S)).functionField
  let L := Z.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Z
  let : Algebra V K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
  let : Algebra V L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Z
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower f hf Z
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing f hf
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Z
  let : _root_.IsGalois K L :=
    isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Z hZ
  let B := integralClosure V L
  let : IsFractionRing B L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension V K L B
  let : MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) B :=
    IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction V K L B
  let : MulSemiringAction (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ B :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteEtaleGaloisCoverNormalizationAction
      Z hZ V B
  intro hLocal Q hQprime hQ
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQprime
  let qZ := finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientMonoidHom xi Z hZ z
  let H := Subgroup.map qZ
    (Subgroup.comap qZ (Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ))
  have hH : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card H) p := by
    exact hLocal hZ xi z Q inferInstance hQ
  exact
    (FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_map_coprime_iff
      c xi W hW w Z i z hiz hZ hi H p).2 hH

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_galoisComponent_pullbackSupportComplementCoverToBoundaryAway
statement:
theorem exists_galoisComponent_pullbackSupportComplementCoverToBoundaryAway
    [IsIntegral X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) (y : Y)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) {r : ℕ}
    (t : Fin 2 → Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
    (hboundary :
      ((I.comap f).stalkIdeal y).map
          (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
            (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =
        Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r})
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
      (boundaryProduct t r) t r)
    (hVdomain : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) :
    letI : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
proof:
:= hVdomain
    let hf := boundaryProduct_ne_zero_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings hNC
    letI : IsDomain (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) :=
      IsLocalization.Away.isDomain
        (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) hf
    let j := localizationAwayToSupportComplement
      (I.comap f) y P.asIdeal (boundaryProduct t r) hboundary
    let g := comapSupportComplementTo I f
    letI : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement :=
      ⟨j (genericPoint
        (Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))⟩
    letI : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
      ⟨g (Classical.choice
        (inferInstance : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement))⟩
    ∀ (W : FiniteEtale I.supportComplement), IsGalois W →
      ∃ (Z : FiniteEtale
          (Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))
        (i : Z ⟶ pullbackSupportComplementCoverToChartBoundaryAway
          I f y P t hboundary W),
        IsGalois Z ∧ Mono i := by
  dsimp only
  let S := Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)
  have hf : boundaryProduct t r ≠ 0 :=
    boundaryProduct_ne_zero_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings hNC
  let : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) := hVdomain
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  let j := localizationAwayToSupportComplement
    (I.comap f) y P.asIdeal (boundaryProduct t r) hboundary
  let g := comapSupportComplementTo I f
  let c := boundaryAwayToSupportComplement I f y P t hboundary
  let : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement :=
    ⟨j (genericPoint (Spec (.of S)))⟩
  let : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
    ⟨g (Classical.choice
      (inferInstance : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement))⟩
  let : IsIntegral I.supportComplement :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion I.supportComplement.ι
  intro W hW
  let s : Spec (.of S) := genericPoint (Spec (.of S))
  let Omega := AlgebraicClosure ((Spec (.of S)).residueField s)
  let xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ Spec (.of S) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap ((Spec (.of S)).residueField s) Omega)) ≫
      (Spec (.of S)).fromSpecResidueField s
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  let w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ c)).obj W :=
    Classical.choice
      (nonempty_fiber_of_isConnected (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ c)) W)
  obtain ⟨Z, i, _, _, hZ, hi⟩ :=
    FiniteEtale.exists_galoisComponent_pullback c xi W hW w
  let e := boundaryAwayPullbackCompIso I f y P t hboundary W
  let i' : Z ⟶ pullbackSupportComplementCoverToChartBoundaryAway
      I f y P t hboundary W := i ≫ e.hom
  have hi' : Mono i' := by
    dsimp only [i']
    infer_instance
  exact ⟨Z, i', hZ, hi'⟩
