statement:
theorem IsNormalCrossingsAt.exists_etaleStrictChart_galoisComponent_boundaryAway
    [IsIntegral X]
    {I : X.IdealSheafData} {x : X}
    (hI : I.IsNormalCrossingsAt x) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ X) (u : U),
      Etale f ∧ f u = x ∧ (I.comap f).IsStrictNormalCrossings ∧
        ∀ (P : PrimeSpectrum (U.presheaf.stalk u)) {r : ℕ}
          (t : Fin 2 → Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
          (hboundary :
            ((I.comap f).stalkIdeal u).map
                (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u)
                  (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =
              Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r})
          (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
            (boundaryProduct t r) t r)
          (hVdomain : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)),
          letI : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
proof:
:= hVdomain
          let hf := boundaryProduct_ne_zero_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings hNC
          letI : IsDomain (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) :=
            IsLocalization.Away.isDomain
              (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)) hf
          let j := localizationAwayToSupportComplement
            (I.comap f) u P.asIdeal (boundaryProduct t r) hboundary
          let g := comapSupportComplementTo I f
          letI : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement :=
            ⟨j (genericPoint
              (Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))⟩
          letI : Nonempty I.supportComplement :=
            ⟨g (Classical.choice
              (inferInstance : Nonempty (I.comap f).supportComplement))⟩
          ∀ (W : FiniteEtale I.supportComplement), IsGalois W →
            ∃ (Z : FiniteEtale
                (Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r)))))
              (i : Z ⟶ pullbackSupportComplementCoverToChartBoundaryAway
                I f u P t hboundary W),
              IsGalois Z ∧ Mono i := by
  obtain ⟨U, f, u, hf, hfu, hstrict⟩ := hI
  refine ⟨U, f, u, hf, hfu, hstrict, ?_⟩
  intro P r t hboundary hNC hVdomain
  exact exists_galoisComponent_pullbackSupportComplementCoverToBoundaryAway
    I f u P t hboundary hNC hVdomain

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localizedNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_isUnit_of_heightTwoSelectedBranchExponent
statement:
theorem
    localizedNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_isUnit_of_heightTwoSelectedBranchExponent
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime]
    [Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A))]
    (hunit : IsUnit
      ((heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i : ℕ) :
        Localization.AtPrime P)) :
    letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L
proof:
:=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
    let q := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
    IsUnit
      ((q.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime P) : ℕ) :
        Localization.AtPrime P) := by
  dsimp only
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  have hQP : Q.under A ≤ P := by
    rw [← Q.over_def (Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A))]
    exact P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htiP
  let q := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  have hramLocal : q.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime P) =
      Q.ramificationIdx A :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_of_under_le
      (K := K) (L := L) P Q hQP
  have hramBranch : Q.ramificationIdx A =
      heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
        (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i := by
    exact
      normalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisIndex
        (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i hi Q
  rw [hramLocal, hramBranch]
  exact hunit

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.boundaryProduct_eq_initialParameterProduct
statement:
theorem boundaryProduct_eq_initialParameterProduct
    {R : Type u} [CommMonoid R] {d r : ℕ}
    (t : Fin d → R) (hr : r ≤ d) :
    boundaryProduct t r =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.initialParameterProduct t r hr
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold boundaryProduct boundaryIndices
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.initialParameterProduct
  let s : Finset (Fin d) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin d ↦ i.val < r)
  change s.prod t =
    Finset.univ.prod (fun i ↦ t (Fin.castLE hr i))
  let e := fun (i : Fin d) (hi : i ∈ s) ↦
    (⟨i.val, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩ : Fin r)
  refine Finset.prod_bij e ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp [e]
  · intro a₁ _ a₂ _ h
    apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : Fin r ↦ z.val) h
  · intro b _
    refine ⟨Fin.castLE hr b, by simp [s], ?_⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  · intro a _
    congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.localParameterGeometry
statement:
theorem IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.localParameterGeometry
    (hI : I.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt x) :
    ∃ (d r : ℕ) (t : Fin d → X.presheaf.stalk x),
      0 < r ∧ ∃ (_hr : r ≤ d),
        EtaleFundamentalGroups.IsRegularSystemOfParameters t ∧
          I.stalkIdeal x =
            Ideal.span {EtaleFundamentalGroups.boundaryProduct t r} ∧
          IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin d, i.val < r → Prime (t i)) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin d, i.val < r →
            IsDomain
                (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}) ∧
              IsRegularLocalRing
                (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}))
proof:
:= by
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let hregular : IsRegularLocalRing A := hI.1
  let : IsLocalRing A := hregular.toIsLocalRing
  let : IsNoetherianRing A := hregular.toIsNoetherian
  obtain ⟨d, r, t, hrpos, hr, hparams, hideal⟩ := hI.2
  have hparams' :
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.IsRegularSystemOfParameters t := hparams
  have hdomain : IsDomain A :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isDomain_of_regularSystem
      (List.ofFn t) hparams.1 hparams.2
  refine ⟨d, r, t, hrpos, hr, hparams', ?_, hdomain, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [EtaleFundamentalGroups.boundaryProduct_eq_initialParameterProduct
      t hr]
    exact hideal
  · intro i _
    exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem
      hparams.1 hparams.2 (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · intro i _
    exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.quotient_geometry_of_mem_regularSystem
      hparams.1 hparams.2 (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.localSplitChart_of_dimension_two
statement:
theorem IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.localSplitChart_of_dimension_two
    (hI : I.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt x)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) =
      ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (t : Fin 2 → X.presheaf.stalk x),
      IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
        IsRegularRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
        I.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r} ∧
        EtaleFundamentalGroups.IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
          (boundaryProduct t r) t r
proof:
:= by
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let hregular : IsRegularLocalRing A := hI.1
  let : IsLocalRing A := hregular.toIsLocalRing
  let : IsNoetherianRing A := hregular.toIsNoetherian
  obtain ⟨d, r, t, hrpos, hr, hparams, hideal⟩ := hI.2
  have hdimParameters :
      ((d : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim A := by
    have hdimRegular :=
      ringKrullDim_add_length_eq_ringKrullDim_of_isRegular
        (List.ofFn t) hparams.1
    rw [hparams.2] at hdimRegular
    let : Field (A ⧸ maximalIdeal A) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.field (maximalIdeal A)
    have hfieldDim : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ maximalIdeal A) = 0 :=
      ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field _
    rw [hfieldDim, zero_add, List.length_ofFn] at hdimRegular
    exact hdimRegular
  have hd : d = 2 := by
    have hd' : (d : ℕ∞) = (2 : ℕ∞) := by
      apply WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp
      exact hdimParameters.trans hdim
    exact_mod_cast hd'
  subst d
  have hdomain : IsDomain A :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isDomain_of_regularSystem
      (List.ofFn t) hparams.1 hparams.2
  let : IsDomain A := hdomain
  have hregularRing : IsRegularRing A :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      hdim
  have hbranches : ∀ i : Fin 2, i.val < r →
      IsRegularRing (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}) := by
    intro i hi
    have hgeometry :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.quotient_geometry_of_mem_regularSystem
        hparams.1 hparams.2 (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    let : IsDomain (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}) := hgeometry.1
    let : IsRegularLocalRing (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}) := hgeometry.2
    have htiMem : t i ∈ maximalIdeal A := by
      rw [← hparams.2]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    have htiPrime : Prime (t i) :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem
        hparams.1 hparams.2 (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    have htiRegular : IsSMulRegular A (t i) := by
      apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
      intro a ha
      have hmul : t i * a = 0 := by
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using ha
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left htiPrime.ne_zero
    have hdimQuotSucc :
        ringKrullDim (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}) + 1 = ringKrullDim A :=
      ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim
        htiRegular htiMem
    have hdimQuot :
        ringKrullDim (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}) =
          ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hdim] at hdimQuotSucc
      have htwo : ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 := by norm_num
      exact ENat.WithBot.add_one_cancel.mp (hdimQuotSucc.trans htwo)
    exact
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_one
        hdimQuot
  have hprimes : ∀ i : Fin 2, i.val < r → Prime (t i) := by
    intro i _
    exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem
      hparams.1 hparams.2 (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨r, t, hdomain, hregularRing, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [boundaryProduct_eq_initialParameterProduct t hr]
    exact hideal
  · exact ⟨hrpos, hr, hparams, hprimes,
      Associated.refl (boundaryProduct t r), hbranches⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_pullbackComponentMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime
statement:
private theorem exists_pullbackComponentMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime
    {V : Type u} [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsLocalRing V]
    [IsRegularRing V] [IsIntegrallyClosed V]
    {r : ℕ} {t : Fin 2 → V}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt (boundaryProduct t r) t r)
    (qV : Ideal V) (p : ℕ)
    {U : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace U]
    (c : Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r))) ⟶ U)
    {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega] [IsSepClosed Omega]
    (xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶
      Spec (.of (Localization.Away (boundaryProduct t r))))
    (W : FiniteEtale U) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ c)).obj W)
    (hLocal : PointedGaloisQuotientInertiaCoprime hNC qV p) :
    PullbackComponentMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime hNC qV p c xi W hW w
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [PullbackComponentMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime]
  let boundary := boundaryProduct t r
  have hboundary_ne : boundary ≠ 0 :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero
      hNC
  let Away := Localization.Away boundary
  let : IsDomain Away :=
    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain Away hboundary_ne
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed Away :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization Away
      (Submonoid.powers boundary)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hboundary_ne))
  obtain ⟨Z, i, z, hiz, hZ, hi⟩ :=
    FiniteEtale.exists_galoisComponent_pullback c xi W hW w
  refine ⟨Z, i, z, hiz, hZ, hi, ?_⟩
  exact IdealSheafData.galoisPullbackComponent_mappedQuotientIdealInertia_coprime
    hNC qV p c xi W hW w Z i z hiz hi hZ (hLocal Z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.localChartMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime_of_pointed
statement:
private theorem localChartMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime_of_pointed
    {X U : Scheme.{u}}
    {I : X.IdealSheafData} [ConnectedSpace I.supportComplement]
    (f : U ⟶ X) (u : U)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (U.presheaf.stalk u))
    (r : ℕ) (t : Fin 2 → Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
    (hVdomain : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))
    (hVregular : IsRegularRing (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))
    (hVnormal : IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))
    (hboundary :
      ((I.comap f).stalkIdeal u).map
          (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =
        Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r})
    (hLocalNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
      (boundaryProduct t r) t r)
    (qV : Ideal (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) (p : ℕ)
    (hLocal :
      let V := Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal
      letI : IsDomain V := hVdomain
      letI : IsRegularRing V := hVregular
      letI : IsIntegrallyClosed V := hVnormal
      PointedGaloisQuotientInertiaCoprime hLocalNC qV p) :
    LocalChartMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime I f u P r t hVdomain
      hVregular hVnormal hboundary hLocalNC qV p
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [LocalChartMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime]
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal
  let : IsDomain V := hVdomain
  let : IsRegularRing V := hVregular
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed V := hVnormal
  let boundary := boundaryProduct t r
  have hboundary_ne : boundary ≠ 0 :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_boundaryEquation_ne_zero
      hLocalNC
  let Away := Localization.Away boundary
  let : IsDomain Away :=
    IsLocalization.Away.isDomain Away hboundary_ne
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed Away :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization Away
      (Submonoid.powers boundary)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hboundary_ne))
  let c := IdealSheafData.boundaryAwayToSupportComplement
    I f u P t hboundary
  intro W hW
  let s := genericPoint (Spec (.of Away))
  let Omega := AlgebraicClosure ((Spec (.of Away)).residueField s)
  let xi : Spec (.of Omega) ⟶ Spec (.of Away) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap ((Spec (.of Away)).residueField s) Omega)) ≫
      (Spec (.of Away)).fromSpecResidueField s
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  let w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ c)).obj W :=
    Classical.choice
      (nonempty_fiber_of_isConnected (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ c)) W)
  exact exists_pullbackComponentMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime
    hLocalNC qV p c xi W hW w hLocal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.hasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime_of_localChart
statement:
private theorem hasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime_of_localChart
    {X U : Scheme.{u}}
    {I : X.IdealSheafData} [ConnectedSpace I.supportComplement]
    (f : U ⟶ X) (u : U)
    (q : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) (p : ℕ)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (U.presheaf.stalk u))
    (hqP : q < P.asIdeal) (hPheight : P.asIdeal.height = 2)
    (r : ℕ) (t : Fin 2 → Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) (branch : Fin 2)
    (hVdomain : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))
    (hVregular : IsRegularRing (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))
    (hVnormal : IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))
    (hboundary :
      ((I.comap f).stalkIdeal u).map
          (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =
        Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r})
    (hLocalNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt
      (boundaryProduct t r) t r)
    (hbranch : branch.1 < r)
    (hqV : q.map
      (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) =
        Ideal.span {t branch})
    (hlocalizedCharZero : ∀ j : Fin 2, j.1 < r →
      CharZero (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal ⧸ Ideal.span {t j}))
    (hpV : CharP
      (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal ⧸ maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)) p)
    (hLocal :
      let V := Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal
      let qV := q.map (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) V)
      letI : IsDomain V := hVdomain
      letI : IsRegularRing V := hVregular
      letI : IsIntegrallyClosed V := hVnormal
      PointedGaloisQuotientInertiaCoprime hLocalNC qV p) :
    I.HasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime f u q p
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [HasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime]
  refine ⟨P, hqP, hPheight, r, t, branch, hVdomain, hVregular,
    hVnormal, hboundary, hLocalNC, hbranch, hqV,
    hlocalizedCharZero, hpV, ?_⟩
  exact localChartMappedQuotientInertiaCoprime_of_pointed
    f u P r t hVdomain hVregular hVnormal hboundary hLocalNC
      (q.map (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u)
        (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal))) p hLocal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossings.hasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime
statement:
theorem IsStrictNormalCrossings.hasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime
    {X U : Scheme.{u}}
    {I : X.IdealSheafData} [ConnectedSpace I.supportComplement]
    (f : U ⟶ X) (u : U)
    (hstrict : (I.comap f).IsStrictNormalCrossings)
    (hCharZero : (I.comap f).HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt u)
    (q : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqheight : q.height = 1)
    (hIq : (I.comap f).stalkIdeal u ≤ q)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP (U.residueField u) p] (hp : p.Prime) :
    I.HasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime f u q p
proof:
:= by
  have hqMax : q ≤ maximalIdeal (U.presheaf.stalk u) :=
    IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).ne_top
  let phi : (U.presheaf.stalk u ⧸ q) →+* U.residueField u :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift q (U.residue u).hom (by
      intro a ha
      change IsLocalRing.residue (U.presheaf.stalk u) a = 0
      rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]
      exact hqMax ha)
  obtain ⟨P, hqP, hPheight, r, t, branch, hVdomain, hVregular,
      hVnormal, hboundary, hLocalNC, hbranch, hqV,
      hlocalizedCharZero, hpV, hLocal⟩ :=
    hstrict.exists_arithmeticLocalSplitChart_galoisCover_quotientIdealInertia_coprime
      hCharZero q hqheight hIq phi p hp
  exact hasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime_of_localChart
    f u q p P hqP hPheight r t branch hVdomain hVregular hVnormal
      hboundary hLocalNC hbranch hqV hlocalizedCharZero hpV hLocal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.ComponentsThroughPointAreHorizontal.exists_etaleStrictChart_component_mappedQuotientIdealInertia_coprime
statement:
theorem exists_etaleStrictChart_component_mappedQuotientIdealInertia_coprime
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    (structural : X ⟶ S)
    (Z : Set D.1.subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents D.1.subscheme)
    (z : D.1.subscheme) (hz : z ∈ Z)
    (hD : D.ComponentsThroughPointAreHorizontal structural z)
    [CharZero (S.residueField (genericPoint S))]
    (hNC : D.1.IsNormalCrossingsAt (D.1.subschemeι z))
    (p : ℕ) [CharP (X.residueField (D.1.subschemeι z)) p]
    (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ X) (u : U)
      (hfu : f u = D.1.subschemeι z),
      Etale f ∧ (D.1.comap f).IsStrictNormalCrossings ∧
        (D.1.comap f).HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt u ∧
          let branchPrime : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk (f u))
proof:
:=
            hfu.symm ▸ (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal
          ∃ (q : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) (_hqPrime : q.IsPrime),
            q.height = 1 ∧ (D.1.comap f).stalkIdeal u ≤ q ∧
              q.comap (f.stalkMap u).hom = branchPrime ∧
                D.1.HasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime f u q p := by
  obtain ⟨U, f, u, hfu, hf, hstrict, hCharZero,
      q, hqPrime, hqheight, hIq, hqcomap⟩ :=
    hD.exists_etaleStrictChart_componentBranch
      D structural Z hZ z hz hNC
  let : Etale f := hf
  let : q.IsPrime := hqPrime
  have hresidueChar : ringChar (U.residueField u) = p := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.ringChar_residueField_eq f u, hfu]
    exact ringChar.eq (X.residueField (D.1.subschemeι z)) p
  let : CharP (U.residueField u) p := ringChar.of_eq hresidueChar
  refine ⟨U, f, u, hfu, hf, hstrict, hCharZero,
    q, hqPrime, hqheight, hIq, hqcomap, ?_⟩
  exact hstrict.hasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime
    f u hCharZero q hqheight hIq p hp

name: Ideal.height_eq_height_comap_of_flat_of_quasiFinite
statement:
private theorem Ideal.height_eq_height_comap_of_flat_of_quasiFinite
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    (hflat : f.Flat) (hqf : f.QuasiFinite)
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] :
    q.height = (q.comap f).height
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  let : Module.Flat R S := hflat
  let : Algebra.QuasiFinite R S := hqf
  let p : Ideal R := q.comap f
  let : p.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap f
  let : q.LiesOver p := ⟨rfl⟩
  let π : S →+* S ⧸ p.map (algebraMap R S) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (p.map (algebraMap R S))
  let qbar : Ideal (S ⧸ p.map (algebraMap R S)) := q.map π
  have hpmap_le_q : p.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ q := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact le_rfl
  let : qbar.IsPrime := by
    apply Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    change RingHom.ker π ≤ q
    dsimp only [π]
    rw [Ideal.mk_ker]
    exact hpmap_le_q
  have hqbar_min : qbar ∈ minimalPrimes (S ⧸ p.map (algebraMap R S)) := by
    rw [minimalPrimes_eq_minimals]
    refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
    intro J hJ hJq
    let : J.IsPrime := hJ
    let Q : Ideal S := J.comap π
    let : Q.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap π
    have hqbar_comap : qbar.comap π = q := by
      rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective π Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
      exact sup_eq_left.mpr <| by
        change RingHom.ker π ≤ q
        dsimp only [π]
        rw [Ideal.mk_ker]
        exact hpmap_le_q
    have hQq : Q ≤ q := by
      change J.comap π ≤ q
      rw [← hqbar_comap]
      exact Ideal.comap_mono hJq
    have hp_le_underQ : p ≤ Q.under R := by
      intro x hx
      change f x ∈ Q
      change π (f x) ∈ J
      have hxf : f x ∈ p.map (algebraMap R S) :=
        Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R S) hx
      have hzero : π (f x) = 0 := by
        dsimp only [π]
        rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
        exact hxf
      rw [hzero]
      exact J.zero_mem
    have hunderQ_le : Q.under R ≤ p := by
      exact (Ideal.comap_mono hQq).trans_eq rfl
    have hunderQ : Q.under R = p := le_antisymm hunderQ_le hp_le_underQ
    have hQeq : Q = q :=
      Algebra.QuasiFinite.eq_of_le_of_under_eq
        (R := R) Q q hQq hunderQ
    have hEq : qbar = J := by
      calc
        qbar = q.map π := rfl
        _ = Q.map π := congrArg (fun K : Ideal S ↦ K.map π) hQeq.symm
        _ = J := Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective π
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective J
    exact hEq.le
  have hqbar_height : qbar.height = 0 :=
    Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff.mpr hqbar_min
  calc
    q.height = p.height + qbar.height :=
      Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown p q
    _ = p.height := by rw [hqbar_height, add_zero]
    _ = (q.comap f).height := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.ComponentsThroughPointAreHorizontal.hasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt
statement:
theorem ComponentsThroughPointAreHorizontal.hasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (structural : X ⟶ S)
    {z : D.1.subscheme}
    (hD : D.ComponentsThroughPointAreHorizontal structural z)
    [CharZero (S.residueField (genericPoint S))] :
    D.1.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt (D.1.subschemeι z)
proof:
:= by
  let I : X.IdealSheafData := D.1
  dsimp only [Scheme.IdealSheafData.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt]
  intro q hqPrime hqHeight hIq
  let : q.IsPrime := hqPrime
  let qSpec : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι z)) := ⟨q, hqPrime⟩
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hgeneric⟩ :=
    D.2.exists_componentGenericPoint_eq_fromSpecStalk
      (I.subschemeι z) qSpec hqHeight hIq
  have hfromSpec :
      X.fromSpecStalk (I.subschemeι z) qSpec ⤳ I.subschemeι z := by
    have hmem : X.fromSpecStalk (I.subschemeι z) qSpec ∈
        Set.range (X.fromSpecStalk (I.subschemeι z)) := ⟨qSpec, rfl⟩
    rw [Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hgenericSpecializes :
      I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ ⤳ I.subschemeι z := by
    rw [hgeneric]
    exact hfromSpec
  have hzZ : z ∈ Z := by
    apply (genericPoints.isGenericPoint_ofComponent
      (⟨Z, hZ⟩ : irreducibleComponents I.subscheme)).specializes_iff_mem.mp
    apply I.subschemeι.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp
    rw [← I.componentGenericPoint_eq Z hZ]
    exact hgenericSpecializes
  let eta := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  have hetaBase : structural eta = genericPoint S := by
    exact I.componentToBase_genericPoint structural Z hZ (hD Z hZ hzZ)
  let eBase : S.residueField (genericPoint S) ≃+*
      S.residueField (structural eta) :=
    (S.residueFieldCongr hetaBase.symm).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let phi : S.residueField (genericPoint S) →+* X.residueField eta :=
    (structural.residueFieldMap eta).hom.comp eBase.toRingHom
  let : CharZero (X.residueField eta) :=
    charZero_of_injective_ringHom phi.injective
  let ePoint : X.residueField eta ≃+*
      X.residueField (X.fromSpecStalk (I.subschemeι z) qSpec) :=
    (X.residueFieldCongr hgeneric).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let e : X.residueField eta ≃+* q.ResidueField :=
    ePoint.trans (X.residueFieldFromSpecStalkEquiv (I.subschemeι z) qSpec)
  let : CharZero q.ResidueField := e.symm.toRingHom.charZero
  exact (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι z) ⧸ q)
    q.ResidueField).charZero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_etaleHeightOnePrime_liesOver
statement:
theorem exists_etaleHeightOnePrime_liesOver
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y)
    (p : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))) [p.IsPrime]
    (hpheight : p.height = 1) (hIp : I.stalkIdeal (f y) ≤ p) :
    ∃ (q : Ideal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) (_hqPrime : q.IsPrime),
      q.height = 1 ∧ (I.comap f).stalkIdeal y ≤ q ∧
        q.comap (f.stalkMap y).hom = p
proof:
:= by
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian Y :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f
  let φ : X.presheaf.stalk (f y) →+* Y.presheaf.stalk y :=
    (f.stalkMap y).hom
  let : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    φ.toAlgebra
  let : IsLocalHom φ := by
    dsimp only [φ]
    infer_instance
  let : Module.Flat (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    Flat.stalkMap f y
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat
      (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  obtain ⟨q, hqPrime, hqOver⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_isPrime_liesOver_of_faithfullyFlat
      (B := Y.presheaf.stalk y) p
  let : q.IsPrime := hqPrime
  have hqcomap : q.comap φ = p := hqOver.over.symm
  have hφqf : φ.QuasiFinite := by
    let : Algebra.EssFiniteType
        (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap f y
    let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified
        (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) :=
      FormallyUnramified.stalkMap f y
    change Algebra.QuasiFinite
      (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
    exact inferInstance
  have hqheight : q.height = 1 := by
    rw [Ideal.height_eq_height_comap_of_flat_of_quasiFinite
      φ q (Flat.stalkMap f y) hφqf, hqcomap, hpheight]
  let qSpec : Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := ⟨q, hqPrime⟩
  let pSpec : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) := ⟨p, inferInstance⟩
  have hpoint :
      X.fromSpecStalk (f y) pSpec = f (Y.fromSpecStalk y qSpec) := by
    have hSpecMap : Spec.map (f.stalkMap y) qSpec = pSpec := by
      apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
      exact hqcomap
    rw [← hSpecMap]
    change
      (Spec.map (f.stalkMap y) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk (f y)) qSpec =
        (Y.fromSpecStalk y ≫ f) qSpec
    exact congrArg (fun g ↦ g qSpec)
      (Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk f)
  have hpSupport : X.fromSpecStalk (f y) pSpec ∈ I.support :=
    (I.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_iff_stalkIdeal_le (f y) pSpec).2 hIp
  have hqSupport :
      Y.fromSpecStalk y qSpec ∈ (I.comap f).support := by
    rw [support_comap]
    change f (Y.fromSpecStalk y qSpec) ∈ I.support
    rw [← hpoint]
    exact hpSupport
  have hIq : (I.comap f).stalkIdeal y ≤ q :=
    ((I.comap f).mem_support_fromSpecStalk_iff_stalkIdeal_le y qSpec).1
      hqSupport
  exact ⟨q, hqPrime, hqheight, hIq, hqcomap⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_etaleHeightOnePrime_over_componentBranchPrimeAt
statement:
theorem exists_etaleHeightOnePrime_over_componentBranchPrimeAt
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X)
    (Z : Set D.1.subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents D.1.subscheme)
    (z : D.1.subscheme) (hz : z ∈ Z)
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y)
    (hfy : f y = D.1.subschemeι z) :
    let p : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
proof:
:=
      hfy.symm ▸ (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal
    ∃ (q : Ideal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) (_hqPrime : q.IsPrime),
      q.height = 1 ∧ (D.1.comap f).stalkIdeal y ≤ q ∧
        q.comap (f.stalkMap y).hom = p := by
  dsimp only
  let e : D.1.subschemeι z = f y := hfy.symm
  let p : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) :=
    e ▸ (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal
  have hbranchPrime :
      (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal.IsPrime :=
    (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).isPrime
  have hpPrime : p.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_transport_stalk e
    (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal hbranchPrime
  let : p.IsPrime := hpPrime
  have hpheight : p.height = 1 := by
    rw [Ideal.height_transport_stalk e]
    exact D.2.componentBranchPrimeAt_height_eq_one Z hZ z hz
  have hIp : D.1.stalkIdeal (f y) ≤ p := by
    exact D.1.stalkIdeal_le_transport e
      (D.1.stalkIdeal_le_componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz)
  exact @Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_etaleHeightOnePrime_liesOver
    X Y inferInstance D.1 f inferInstance y p hpPrime hpheight hIp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.ComponentsThroughPointAreHorizontal.exists_etaleStrictChart_componentBranch
statement:
theorem ComponentsThroughPointAreHorizontal.exists_etaleStrictChart_componentBranch
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (structural : X ⟶ S)
    (Z : Set D.1.subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents D.1.subscheme)
    (z : D.1.subscheme) (hz : z ∈ Z)
    (hD : D.ComponentsThroughPointAreHorizontal structural z)
    [CharZero (S.residueField (genericPoint S))]
    (hNC : D.1.IsNormalCrossingsAt (D.1.subschemeι z)) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ X) (u : U)
      (hfu : f u = D.1.subschemeι z),
      Etale f ∧ (D.1.comap f).IsStrictNormalCrossings ∧
        (D.1.comap f).HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt u ∧
          let p : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk (f u))
proof:
:=
            hfu.symm ▸ (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal
          ∃ (q : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) (_hqPrime : q.IsPrime),
            q.height = 1 ∧ (D.1.comap f).stalkIdeal u ≤ q ∧
              q.comap (f.stalkMap u).hom = p := by
  obtain ⟨U, f, u, hf, hfu, hstrict⟩ := hNC
  let : Etale f := hf
  refine ⟨U, f, u, hfu, hf, hstrict, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt.comap_of_etale
      f u
    simpa only [hfu] using
      hD.hasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt D structural
  · exact D.exists_etaleHeightOnePrime_over_componentBranchPrimeAt
      Z hZ z hz f u hfu

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossings.exists_heightTwo_localSplitChart_of_branch_residueCharacteristic
statement:
theorem IsStrictNormalCrossings.exists_heightTwo_localSplitChart_of_branch_residueCharacteristic
    (hI : I.IsStrictNormalCrossings)
    (hCharZero : I.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt x)
    (q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqheight : q.height = 1)
    (hIq : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ q)
    {k : Type uk} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    (phi : (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q) →+* k)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : p.Prime) :
    let A
proof:
:= X.presheaf.stalk x
    ∃ (P : Ideal A) (_hPprime : P.IsPrime),
      q < P ∧ P.height = 2 ∧
        let V := Localization.AtPrime P
        ∃ (r : ℕ) (t : Fin 2 → V) (i : Fin 2)
          (_hVdomain : IsDomain V) (_hVregular : IsRegularRing V),
          (I.stalkIdeal x).map (algebraMap A V) =
              Ideal.span {boundaryProduct t r} ∧
            IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt (boundaryProduct t r) t r ∧
              i.1 < r ∧
                q.map (algebraMap A V) = Ideal.span {t i} ∧
                  (∀ j : Fin 2, j.1 < r →
                    CharZero (V ⧸ Ideal.span {t j})) ∧
                    CharP (V ⧸ maximalIdeal V) p := by
  dsimp only
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let : CharZero (A ⧸ q) :=
    hCharZero q inferInstance hqheight hIq
  obtain ⟨P, hPprime, hqP, hPheight, hp_nonunit⟩ :=
    hI.exists_heightTwoPrime_of_branch_residueCharacteristic
      q hqheight hIq phi p hp
  let : P.IsPrime := hPprime
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  obtain ⟨r, t, hVdomain, hVregular, hboundary, hNC⟩ :=
    hI.exists_localSplitChart_with_boundaryIdeal
      (x := x) (P := ⟨P, hPprime⟩) hPheight (hIq.trans hqP.le)
  let : IsDomain V := hVdomain
  let qV := q.map (algebraMap A V)
  let : qV.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hqP.le
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint ((P.primeCompl : Submonoid A) : Set A) (q : Set A) :=
    Set.disjoint_compl_left_iff_subset.mpr hqP.le
  have hqVheight : qV.height = 1 := by
    rw [IsLocalization.height_map_of_disjoint P.primeCompl q hdisjoint]
    exact hqheight
  have hprod : boundaryProduct t r ∈ qV := by
    apply (Ideal.map_mono hIq)
    rw [hboundary]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hqi⟩ :=
    exists_activeBranch_eq_of_heightOnePrime_mem_boundaryProduct
      hNC.2.2.2.1 qV hqVheight hprod
  have hlocalizedCharZero : ∀ j : Fin 2, j.1 < r →
      CharZero (V ⧸ Ideal.span {t j}) := by
    intro j hj
    let qj : Ideal V := Ideal.span {t j}
    let : qj.IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj)
    have hqjheight : qj.height = 1 := by
      exact Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr
          (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj).ne_zero)
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj).not_isUnit
    have hprodj : boundaryProduct t r ∈ qj := by
      rw [boundaryProduct, Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff]
      refine ⟨j, ?_, Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _⟩
      simp only [boundaryIndices, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
        true_and]
      exact hj
    have hmapI_qj : (I.stalkIdeal x).map (algebraMap A V) ≤ qj := by
      rw [hboundary]
      exact Ideal.span_le.mpr fun a ha ↦ by
        simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using ha ▸ hprodj
    have hIunder : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ qj.under A := by
      exact (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).mp hmapI_qj
    have hqunderHeight : (qj.under A).height = 1 := by
      rw [IsLocalization.height_under P.primeCompl qj]
      exact hqjheight
    let : CharZero (A ⧸ qj.under A) :=
      hCharZero (qj.under A) inferInstance hqunderHeight hIunder
    exact charZero_of_injective_algebraMap
      (Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_injective (R := A) (A := V) (I := qj))
  have hpChar : CharP (V ⧸ maximalIdeal V) p :=
    charP_localizationAtPrime_residue_of_natCast_nonunit P p hp hp_nonunit
  exact ⟨P, hPprime, hqP, hPheight, r, t, i, hVdomain, hVregular,
    hboundary, hNC, hi, hqi, hlocalizedCharZero, hpChar⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_or_isUnit_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime
statement:
theorem prime_or_isUnit_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] {t : A} (ht : Prime t) :
    Prime (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) t) ∨
      IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htP : t ∈ P
  · left
    have htNe : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) t ≠ 0 := by
      intro htZero
      exact ht.ne_zero
        ((IsLocalization.injective (Localization.AtPrime P)
          P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors) (by
            simpa only [map_zero] using htZero))
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime htNe).mp
    let : (Ideal.span ({t} : Set A)).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ht
    have hmapPrime :
        ((Ideal.span ({t} : Set A)).map
          (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P))).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P
        (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htP)
    simpa only [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] using hmapPrime
  · right
    exact
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff
        (Localization.AtPrime P) P t).mpr htP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.charZero_quotient_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime
statement:
theorem charZero_quotient_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] {t : A} (ht : Prime t)
    (htP : t ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t})) :
    CharZero
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸
        Ideal.span {algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) t})
proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal A := Ideal.span {t}
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let I : Ideal V := J.map (algebraMap A V)
  let : J.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ht
  have hJP : J ≤ P := by
    exact P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htP
  have hunder : I.under A = J := by
    exact Ideal.under_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hJP
  let : CharZero (A ⧸ I.under A) := by
    rw [hunder]
    exact hCharZero
  have htarget : CharZero (V ⧸ I) :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap
      (Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_injective (R := A) (A := V) (I := I))
  have hI : I = Ideal.span {algebraMap A V t} := by
    simp [I, J, Ideal.map_span]
  rw [← hI]
  exact htarget

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadicalCompletion
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadicalCompletion
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) :
    let Ahat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
    let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
    letI : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
    Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat := by
  dsimp only
  let Ahat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
    (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A Ahat :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let : Algebra B (Ahat ⊗[A] B) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
  let eComm : (B ⊗[A] Ahat) ≃ₐ[B] (Ahat ⊗[A] B) :=
    { toRingEquiv := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm A B Ahat).toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro b
        change Algebra.TensorProduct.comm A B Ahat
            (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : Ahat)) =
          ((1 : Ahat) ⊗ₜ[A] b)
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul] }
  let e : (B ⊗[A] Ahat) ≃ₐ[B] Bhat :=
    eComm.trans (iteratedRadicalCompletionRightAlgEquiv n a)
  exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
    (R := B) (M := B ⊗[A] Ahat) e.symm.toLinearEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalCompletion_algebraMap_comp_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedRadicalCompletion_algebraMap_comp_apply
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (x : A) :
    let Ahat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
    let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
    letI : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
    algebraMap B Bhat (algebraMap A B x) =
      algebraMap Ahat Bhat (algebraMap A Ahat x) := by
  dsimp only
  let Ahat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
    (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
  let e : Ahat ⊗[A] B ≃ₐ[Ahat] Bhat :=
    iteratedRadicalCompletionBaseChangeAlgEquiv n a
  let : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
  change e (1 ⊗ₜ[A] algebraMap A B x) =
    algebraMap Ahat Bhat (algebraMap A Ahat x)
  rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul]
  exact e.commutes (algebraMap A Ahat x)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadicalCompletion
statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadicalCompletion
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let Ahat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
    let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
    let haHat : ∀ i, algebraMap A Ahat (a i) ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Ahat := fun i ↦ by
      rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap A Ahat) (ha i)
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    letI : IsLocalRing Bhat :=
      isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n _ hn haHat
    letI : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat :=
      faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadicalCompletion n a
    Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap B Bhat)) := by
  dsimp only
  let Ahat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
    (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
  have haHat : ∀ i, algebraMap A Ahat (a i) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Ahat := fun i ↦ by
    rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap A Ahat) (ha i)
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : IsLocalRing Bhat :=
    isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n _ hn haHat
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat Ahat Bhat :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n _ hn
  let : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadicalCompletion n a
  have hdiagram (y : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) :
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap B Bhat)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B) y) =
        IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap Ahat Bhat)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A Ahat) y) := by
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
    simp only [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
    exact congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue Bhat)
      (iteratedRadicalCompletion_algebraMap_comp_apply n a t)
  constructor
  · exact (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap B Bhat)).injective
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
      (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n
        (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i)) hn haHat).2 z
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
      (AdicCompletion.residueField_map_bijective A).2 x
    refine ⟨IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B) y, ?_⟩
    calc
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap B Bhat)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B) y) =
          IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap Ahat Bhat)
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A Ahat) y) :=
        hdiagram y
      _ = IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap Ahat Bhat) x := by
        rw [hy]
      _ = z := hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalIdeal_map_iteratedRadicalCompletion
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_map_iteratedRadicalCompletion
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let Ahat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
    let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
    let haHat : ∀ i, algebraMap A Ahat (a i) ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Ahat := fun i ↦ by
      rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap A Ahat) (ha i)
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    letI : IsLocalRing Bhat :=
      isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n _ hn haHat
    letI : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B Bhat) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Bhat := by
  dsimp only
  let Ahat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
    (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
  let T := Ahat ⊗[A] B
  have haHat : ∀ i, algebraMap A Ahat (a i) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Ahat := fun i ↦ by
    rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap A Ahat) (ha i)
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : IsLocalRing Bhat :=
    isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n _ hn haHat
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A Ahat :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let : Algebra B T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
  let e : T ≃ₐ[B] Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionRightAlgEquiv n a
  let q := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B
  let qT := q.map (algebraMap B T)
  have hqTmax : qT.IsMaximal :=
    tensorProduct_map_isMaximal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
      (R := A) (R' := Ahat) (S := B) q
      AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map.symm
      (AdicCompletion.residueField_map_bijective A)
  let : qT.IsMaximal := hqTmax
  have hmapMax : (qT.map e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).IsMaximal :=
    hqTmax.map_bijective e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom e.bijective
  have hmap : qT.map e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      q.map (algebraMap B Bhat) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_map]
    congr 1
  rw [hmap] at hmapMax
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmapMax

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteEtale_closedPrime_iteratedRadicalCompletion
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_closedPrime_iteratedRadicalCompletion
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let Ahat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
    let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
    let haHat : ∀ i, algebraMap A Ahat (a i) ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Ahat := fun i ↦ by
      rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap A Ahat) (ha i)
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    letI : IsLocalRing Bhat :=
      isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n _ hn haHat
    letI : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
    ∀ {E : Type u} [CommRing E] [Algebra B E]
      [Module.Finite B E] [Algebra.Etale B E],
      ∀ (q : Ideal E) [q.IsPrime]
        [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)],
        let Ehat := Bhat ⊗[B] E
        letI : Algebra Bhat Ehat := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
        letI : Algebra E Ehat := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
        let qhat := q.map (algebraMap E Ehat)
        qhat.IsMaximal ∧
          qhat.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Bhat) ∧
          Module.Finite Bhat Ehat ∧ Algebra.Etale Bhat Ehat := by
  dsimp only
  intro E _ _ _ _ q _ _
  let Ahat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let Bhat := iteratedRadical Ahat r n
    (fun i ↦ algebraMap A Ahat (a i))
  have haHat : ∀ i, algebraMap A Ahat (a i) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Ahat := fun i ↦ by
    rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap A Ahat) (ha i)
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : IsLocalRing Bhat :=
    isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n _ hn haHat
  let : Algebra B Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadicalCompletion n a
  let Ehat := Bhat ⊗[B] E
  have hqmax : q.IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under (R := B) q <| by
        rw [← q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)]
        exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal B
  let : q.IsMaximal := hqmax
  let : Algebra Bhat Ehat := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : Algebra E Ehat := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let qhat := q.map (algebraMap E Ehat)
  have hgeom : qhat.IsMaximal ∧
      qhat.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Bhat) :=
    tensorProduct_map_liesOver_maximalIdeal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
      (R := B) (R' := Bhat) (S := E) q
      (maximalIdeal_map_iteratedRadicalCompletion n a hn ha)
      (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadicalCompletion n a hn ha)
  exact ⟨hgeom.1, hgeom.2, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finite_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem finite_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) :
    Module.Finite A (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      change Module.Finite A A
      infer_instance
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      let : Module.Finite A T :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc)
      let : Module.Finite T (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C
          (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
          (hn (Fin.last r)).ne').finite_adjoinRoot
      change Module.Finite A (AdjoinRoot f)
      exact Module.Finite.trans T (AdjoinRoot f)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.free_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem free_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) :
    Module.Free A (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      change Module.Free A A
      infer_instance
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      let : Module.Free A T :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc)
      let : Module.Free T (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C
          (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
          (hn (Fin.last r)).ne').free_adjoinRoot
      change Module.Free A (AdjoinRoot f)
      exact Module.Free.trans (R := A) (S := T) (M := AdjoinRoot f)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Nontrivial A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) :
    Module.FaithfullyFlat A (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      change Module.FaithfullyFlat A A
      infer_instance
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A T :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) (fun i => hn i.castSucc)
      let : Nontrivial T :=
        (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective A T).nontrivial
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat T (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
          (hn (Fin.last r)) (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      change Module.FaithfullyFlat A (AdjoinRoot f)
      exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans A T (AdjoinRoot f)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.all_exponents_isUnit_of_formallyUnramified_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem all_exponents_isUnit_of_formallyUnramified_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Nontrivial A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    [hFU : Algebra.FormallyUnramified A (iteratedRadical A r n a)] :
    ∀ i, IsUnit (n i : A)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      intro i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      change Algebra.FormallyUnramified A (AdjoinRoot f) at hFU
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A T :=
        faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) (fun i => hn i.castSucc)
      let : Nontrivial T :=
        (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective A T).nontrivial
      have hnLast : IsUnit (n (Fin.last r) : A) :=
        isUnit_natCast_of_formallyUnramified_relativeRadical
          (A := A) (T := T) (a := algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
          (n := n (Fin.last r)) (hn (Fin.last r))
      have hPrefix : Algebra.FormallyUnramified A T :=
        formallyUnramified_prefix_of_formallyUnramified_relativeRadical
          (A := A) (T := T) (a := algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
          (n := n (Fin.last r)) (hn (Fin.last r))
      let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified A T := hPrefix
      have hInit : ∀ i : Fin r, IsUnit (n i.castSucc : A) :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i => hn i.castSucc)
      intro i
      exact Fin.lastCases hnLast hInit i

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRoot_root_pow
statement:
theorem adjoinRoot_root_pow
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)) ^ n =
      AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root, eval₂_sub, eval₂_C, eval₂_pow, eval₂_X]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isUnit_adjoinRoot_root_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem isUnit_adjoinRoot_root_of_isUnit
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : A}
    (ha : IsUnit a) :
    IsUnit (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a))
proof:
:= by
  refine (isUnit_pow_iff hn.ne').mp ?_
  rw [adjoinRoot_root_pow]
  exact ha.map (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.aeval_derivative_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem aeval_derivative_X_pow_sub_C
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (n : ℕ) (a : A) :
    aeval (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)) (X ^ n - C a).derivative =
      algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)) (n : A) *
        AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Polynomial.derivative_X_pow]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Nontrivial A] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (a : A) :
    Module.FaithfullyFlat A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))
proof:
:= by
  let : Nontrivial (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (by
      intro htop
      have h : IsUnit (X ^ n - C a) :=
        Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mp htop
      apply hn.ne'
      rw [← @Polynomial.natDegree_one A,
        ← (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne').eq_one_of_isUnit h,
        Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C])
  let : Module.Free A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)) :=
    (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne').free_adjoinRoot
  infer_instance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isUnit_algebraMap_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_algebraMap_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_iff
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Nontrivial A] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (a b : A) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)) b) ↔ IsUnit b
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)) :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
  exact isUnit_map_iff (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))) b

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isUnit_aeval_derivative_iff_isUnit_natCast
statement:
theorem isUnit_aeval_derivative_iff_isUnit_natCast
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Nontrivial A] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {a : A} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    IsUnit (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a))
      (X ^ n - C a).derivative) ↔ IsUnit (n : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_derivative_X_pow_sub_C]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hmap :
        IsUnit (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)) (n : A)) :=
      ((Commute.all _ _).isUnit_mul_iff.mp h).1
    exact (isUnit_algebraMap_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_iff hn a (n : A)).mp hmap
  · intro h
    exact
      ((isUnit_algebraMap_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_iff hn a (n : A)).mpr h).mul
        ((isUnit_adjoinRoot_root_of_isUnit hn ha).pow (n - 1))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isUnit_aeval_derivative_iff_isUnit_algebraMap_natCast_away
statement:
theorem isUnit_aeval_derivative_iff_isUnit_algebraMap_natCast_away
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] {t : R} [IsLocalization.Away t S]
    (ht : Prime t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsUnit (aeval
      (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C (algebraMap R S t)))
      (X ^ n - C (algebraMap R S t)).derivative) ↔
      IsUnit (algebraMap R S (n : R))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S ht.ne_zero
  simpa using
    (isUnit_aeval_derivative_iff_isUnit_natCast
      (A := S) (a := algebraMap R S t) hn
      (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit t))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isUnit_natCast_of_formallyUnramified_relativeRadical
statement:
theorem isUnit_natCast_of_formallyUnramified_relativeRadical
    {A : Type u} {T : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing T] [Algebra A T]
    [Nontrivial T] [Module.FaithfullyFlat A T]
    {a : T} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    [Algebra.FormallyUnramified A
      (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))] :
    IsUnit (n : A)
proof:
:= by
  let f : T[X] := X ^ n - C a
  have hDerivative :
      IsUnit (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f.derivative) := by
    let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified T (AdjoinRoot f) :=
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_restrictScalars A T (AdjoinRoot f)
    exact isUnit_aeval_derivative_of_formallyUnramified f
  have hnT : IsUnit (n : T) := by
    rw [aeval_derivative_X_pow_sub_C] at hDerivative
    have hMap :
        IsUnit (algebraMap T (AdjoinRoot f) (n : T)) :=
      ((Commute.all _ _).isUnit_mul_iff.mp hDerivative).1
    exact
      (isUnit_algebraMap_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_iff
        (A := T) (a := a) hn (n : T)).mp hMap
  exact (isUnit_map_iff (algebraMap A T) (n : A)).mp (by
    simpa using hnT)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.formallyUnramified_prefix_of_formallyUnramified_relativeRadical
statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_prefix_of_formallyUnramified_relativeRadical
    {A : Type u} {T : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing T] [Algebra A T]
    [Nontrivial T]
    {a : T} {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    [Algebra.FormallyUnramified A
      (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))] :
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified A T
proof:
:= by
  let f : T[X] := X ^ n - C a
  have hDerivative :
      IsUnit (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f.derivative) := by
    let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified T (AdjoinRoot f) :=
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_restrictScalars A T (AdjoinRoot f)
    exact isUnit_aeval_derivative_of_formallyUnramified f
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale T (AdjoinRoot f) :=
    formallyEtale_adjoinRoot_of_monic_of_isUnit_aeval_derivative
      (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne') hDerivative
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat T (AdjoinRoot f) :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
  exact
    formallyUnramified_of_formallyEtale_faithfullyFlat
      (R := A) (S := T) (T := AdjoinRoot f)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.not_dvd_natCast_of_charZero_quotient
statement:
theorem not_dvd_natCast_of_charZero_quotient
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {t : R}
    [CharZero (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t})] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ¬ t ∣ (n : R)
proof:
:= by
  intro htdvd
  have hmem : (n : R) ∈ Ideal.span {t} :=
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr htdvd
  have hz : (n : R ⧸ Ideal.span {t}) = 0 := by
    simpa using (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem)
  exact (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne') hz

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isUnit_of_isUnit_algebraMap_away_of_prime_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_isUnit_algebraMap_away_of_prime_of_not_dvd
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] {t a : R} [IsLocalization.Away t S]
    (ht : Prime t) (hta : ¬ t ∣ a)
    (ha : IsUnit (algebraMap R S a)) : IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, ham⟩ :=
    (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit_iff t).mp ha
  obtain ⟨i, -, hai⟩ := (dvd_prime_pow ht m).mp ham
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    exact associated_one_iff_isUnit.mp (by simpa using hai)
  · exact (hta ((dvd_pow_self t hi).trans hai.symm.dvd)).elim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.natCast_not_isUnit_algebraMap_away_of_dvd_char
statement:
theorem natCast_not_isUnit_algebraMap_away_of_dvd_char
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {k : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k] {t : R} [IsLocalization.Away t S]
    (ht : Prime t) [CharZero (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t})]
    (φ : R →+* k) (p n : ℕ) [CharP k p]
    (hn : 0 < n) (hpn : p ∣ n) :
    ¬ IsUnit (algebraMap R S (n : R))
proof:
:= by
  intro hnS
  have hnR :=
    isUnit_of_isUnit_algebraMap_away_of_prime_of_not_dvd
      ht (a := (n : R))
      (not_dvd_natCast_of_charZero_quotient n hn) hnS
  have hnk : IsUnit (n : k) := by
    simpa using hnR.map φ
  exact hnk.ne_zero ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff k p n).mpr hpn)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.formallyUnramified_of_formallyEtale_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_of_formallyEtale_faithfullyFlat
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} {T : Type uT}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R T] [Algebra.FormallyEtale S T]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat S T] :
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S
proof:
:= by
  let : Subsingleton (T ⊗[S] Ω[S⁄R]) :=
    (KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale R S T).toEquiv.injective.subsingleton
  exact
    ⟨Module.FaithfullyFlat.lTensor_reflects_triviality S T Ω[S⁄R]⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.dvd_left_of_dvd_mul_finsetProduct_of_primes_of_not_dvd
statement:
private theorem dvd_left_of_dvd_mul_finsetProduct_of_primes_of_not_dvd
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → R) {a b : R}
    (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (t i))
    (hta : ∀ i ∈ s, ¬ t i ∣ a)
    (h : a ∣ b * ∏ i ∈ s, t i) :
    a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simpa using h
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      apply ih
      · intro j hj
        exact ht j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
      · intro j hj
        exact hta j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
      · exact
          ((ht i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)).left_dvd_or_dvd_right_of_dvd_mul
            (by
              simpa [Finset.prod_insert hi, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
                using h)).resolve_left
            (hta i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isUnit_of_isUnit_algebraMap_away_finsetProduct_of_primes_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_isUnit_algebraMap_away_finsetProduct_of_primes_of_not_dvd
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → R)
    [IsLocalization.Away (∏ i ∈ s, t i) S]
    {a : R} (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (t i))
    (hta : ∀ i ∈ s, ¬ t i ∣ a)
    (ha : IsUnit (algebraMap R S a)) :
    IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, ham⟩ :=
    (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit_iff (∏ i ∈ s, t i)).mp ha
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      exact isUnit_of_dvd_one (by simpa using ham)
  | succ m ih =>
      apply ih
      exact
        dvd_left_of_dvd_mul_finsetProduct_of_primes_of_not_dvd
          s t ht hta (b := (∏ i ∈ s, t i) ^ m) (by
            simpa [pow_succ] using ham)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isUnit_natCast_of_isUnit_algebraMap_away_finsetProduct
statement:
theorem isUnit_natCast_of_isUnit_algebraMap_away_finsetProduct
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → R)

    (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, Prime (t i))

    (hnS : IsUnit (algebraMap R S (n : R))) :

proof:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_unit_mul_target_uniformizer_pow_eq_base_uniformizer_image_of_dvf
statement:
theorem exists_unit_mul_target_uniformizer_pow_eq_base_uniformizer_image_of_dvf
    {K : Type u} {L : Type w} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) (target : DVF.{w, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    {ϖ : base.valuationSubring} {π : target.valuationSubring}
    (hϖ : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (ϖ : K))
    (hπ : target.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : L)) :
    ∃ u : target.valuationSubringˣ,
      integerMap base target ϖ =
        (u : target.valuationSubring) *
          π ^ ramificationIndex base target
proof:
:= by
  have hpow_not_le (n : ℕ) :
      ¬ target.maximalIdeal ^ n ≤ target.maximalIdeal ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro hle
    have hπpow_mem : π ^ n ∈ target.maximalIdeal ^ n := by
      rw [target.maximalIdeal_pow_eq_span_uniformizer_pow hπ n]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (π ^ n)
    exact target.uniformizer_pow_not_mem_maximalIdeal_pow_succ hπ n
      (hle hπpow_mem)
  have hmap :
      Ideal.map (integerMap base target) base.maximalIdeal =
        target.maximalIdeal ^ ramificationIndex base target := by
    rcases target.nonzero_ideal_eq_maximalIdeal_pow
        (Ideal.map (integerMap base target) base.maximalIdeal)
        (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_ne_bot base target) with
      ⟨n, hn⟩
    have hle :
        Ideal.map (integerMap base target) base.maximalIdeal ≤
          target.maximalIdeal ^ n := by
      rw [hn]
    have hnot :
        ¬ Ideal.map (integerMap base target) base.maximalIdeal ≤
          target.maximalIdeal ^ (n + 1) := by
      intro hle_succ
      exact hpow_not_le n (by simpa [hn] using hle_succ)
    have he : ramificationIndex base target = n := by
      simpa [ramificationIndex, integerMap] using
        (Ideal.ramificationIdx'_spec
          (p := base.maximalIdeal) (P := target.maximalIdeal) hle hnot)
    rw [he]
    exact hn
  have hspan :
      Ideal.span ({integerMap base target ϖ} :
          Set target.valuationSubring) =
        target.maximalIdeal ^ ramificationIndex base target := by
    have hbase :
        Ideal.span ({ϖ} : Set base.valuationSubring) =
          base.maximalIdeal := by
      rw [show ({ϖ} : Set base.valuationSubring) = Set.singleton ϖ by
        ext z
        rfl]
      exact (base.maximalIdeal_eq_span_uniformizer hϖ).symm
    calc
      Ideal.span ({integerMap base target ϖ} :
          Set target.valuationSubring) =
          Ideal.map (integerMap base target)
            (Ideal.span ({ϖ} : Set base.valuationSubring)) := by
        simp [Ideal.map_span]
      _ = Ideal.map (integerMap base target) base.maximalIdeal := by
        exact congrArg (Ideal.map (integerMap base target)) hbase
      _ = target.maximalIdeal ^ ramificationIndex base target := hmap
  have hx_mem :
      integerMap base target ϖ ∈
        target.maximalIdeal ^ ramificationIndex base target := by
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (integerMap base target ϖ)
  rcases
      (target.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_uniformizer_pow_dvd hπ
        (ramificationIndex base target)).1 hx_mem with
    ⟨u, hu⟩
  have hu_unit : IsUnit u := by
    by_contra hnot_unit
    have hu_mem : u ∈ target.maximalIdeal := by
      by_contra hnot_mem
      exact hnot_unit ((IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal (x := u)).1 hnot_mem)
    have hπpow_mem :
        π ^ ramificationIndex base target ∈
          target.maximalIdeal ^ ramificationIndex base target := by
      rw [target.maximalIdeal_pow_eq_span_uniformizer_pow hπ
        (ramificationIndex base target)]
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self
        (π ^ ramificationIndex base target)
    have hx_deep :
        integerMap base target ϖ ∈
          target.maximalIdeal ^ (ramificationIndex base target + 1) := by
      rw [hu]
      have hmul :
          π ^ ramificationIndex base target * u ∈
            target.maximalIdeal ^ ramificationIndex base target *
              target.maximalIdeal :=
        Ideal.mul_mem_mul hπpow_mem hu_mem
      simpa [pow_succ] using hmul
    have hspan_le :
        Ideal.span ({integerMap base target ϖ} :
            Set target.valuationSubring) ≤
          target.maximalIdeal ^ (ramificationIndex base target + 1) := by
      rw [Ideal.span_le]
      intro y hy
      have hy_eq : y = integerMap base target ϖ := by
        simpa using hy
      simpa [hy_eq] using hx_deep
    exact hpow_not_le (ramificationIndex base target)
      (by simpa [hspan] using hspan_le)
  rcases hu_unit with ⟨uunit, huunit⟩
  refine ⟨uunit, ?_⟩
  simpa [huunit, mul_comm] using hu

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_uniformizers_unit_mul_target_uniformizer_pow_eq_base_uniformizer_image
statement:
theorem exists_uniformizers_unit_mul_target_uniformizer_pow_eq_base_uniformizer_image
    {K : Type u} {L : Type w} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) (target : DVF.{w, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation] :
    ∃ (ϖ : base.valuationSubring) (π : target.valuationSubring)
        (u : target.valuationSubringˣ),
      base.valuation.IsUniformizer (ϖ : K) ∧
        target.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : L) ∧
          integerMap base target ϖ =
            (u : target.valuationSubring) *
              π ^ ramificationIndex base target
proof:
:= by
  rcases base.exists_uniformizer with ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩
  rcases target.exists_uniformizer with ⟨π, hπ⟩
  rcases
      exists_unit_mul_target_uniformizer_pow_eq_base_uniformizer_image_of_dvf
        base target hϖ hπ with
    ⟨u, hu⟩
  exact ⟨ϖ, π, u, hϖ, hπ, hu⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.ramificationIndex_pos_of_moduleFinite
statement:
theorem ramificationIndex_pos_of_moduleFinite
    {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{uK, uV} K) (target : DVF.{uL, uW} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring] :
    0 < ramificationIndex base target
proof:
:= by
  let W := target.valuationSubring
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  simpa [ramificationIndex] using
    (Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
      (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_ne_bot base target)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal W).isPrime
      (maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_le base target))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.dvfUniformizer_prime
statement:
theorem dvfUniformizer_prime
    {K : Type uK} [Field K]
    (base : DVF.{uK, uV} K)

    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K)) :
    Prime varpi
proof:

  have hvarpi_ne : varpi ≠ 0 := by

    apply hvarpi.ne_zero
