name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fixedTensorComponentEmbeddedRoot_pow
statement:
theorem fixedTensorComponentEmbeddedRoot_pow
    {K : Type uK} {F : Type uF} {L : Type uL}
    [Field K] [Field F] [Field L]
    [Algebra K F] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{uK, uV} K)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpiPrime : Prime varpi)
    [Algebra (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [IsFractionRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [Algebra base.valuationSubring F]
    [IsScalarTower base.valuationSubring
      (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [IsScalarTower base.valuationSubring K F]
    (m : Ideal (F ⊗[K] L)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    let P
proof:
:= GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    letI : Algebra L P := genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
    let rootP := pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot
      (N := N) varpi m
    let j := pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentEmbedding
      hN varpi hvarpiPrime m
    let beta : AlgebraicClosure L := j rootP
    beta ^ N = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) := by
  dsimp only
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let P := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    base.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  let : IsFractionRing V K := base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : FiniteDimensional K F :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finiteDimensional hN varpi hvarpiPrime
  let : Algebra L P := genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
  let : IsScalarTower K L P :=
    genericTensorFieldComponent_right_isScalarTower m
  let : FiniteDimensional L P :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentFiniteDimensionalOverRight m
  let rootP : P :=
    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot
      (N := N) varpi m
  let j : P →ₐ[L] AlgebraicClosure L :=
    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentEmbedding
      hN varpi hvarpiPrime m
  let beta : AlgebraicClosure L := j rootP
  let : SMul V P :=
    (pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentBaseAlgebra
      (N := N) varpi m).toSMul
  let : Algebra V P :=
    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentBaseAlgebra
      (N := N) varpi m
  have hrootP : rootP ^ N = algebraMap V P varpi :=
    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot_pow
      (K := K) varpi m
  calc
    beta ^ N = j (rootP ^ N) := (map_pow j rootP N).symm
    _ = j (algebraMap V P varpi) := by rw [hrootP]
    _ = j (algebraMap K P (varpi : K)) := rfl
    _ = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) :=
      (j.restrictScalars K).commutes (varpi : K)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fixedTensorComponentEmbeddedRoot_lowerPow
statement:
theorem fixedTensorComponentEmbeddedRoot_lowerPow
    {K : Type uK} {F : Type uF} {L : Type uL}
    [Field K] [Field F] [Field L]
    [Algebra K F] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{uK, uV} K) (target : DVF.{uL, uW} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpiPrime : Prime varpi)
    (hdiv : ramificationIndex base target ∣ N)
    [Algebra (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [IsFractionRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [Algebra base.valuationSubring F]
    [IsScalarTower base.valuationSubring
      (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [IsScalarTower base.valuationSubring K F]
    (m : Ideal (F ⊗[K] L)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    let P
proof:
:= GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    letI : Algebra L P := genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
    let rootP := pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot
      (N := N) varpi m
    let j := pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentEmbedding
      hN varpi hvarpiPrime m
    let beta : AlgebraicClosure L := j rootP
    (beta ^ (N / ramificationIndex base target)) ^
        ramificationIndex base target =
      algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) := by
  dsimp only
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let P := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    base.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  let : IsFractionRing V K := base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : FiniteDimensional K F :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finiteDimensional hN varpi hvarpiPrime
  let : Algebra L P := genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
  let : IsScalarTower K L P :=
    genericTensorFieldComponent_right_isScalarTower m
  let : FiniteDimensional L P :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentFiniteDimensionalOverRight m
  let rootP : P :=
    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot
      (N := N) varpi m
  let j : P →ₐ[L] AlgebraicClosure L :=
    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentEmbedding
      hN varpi hvarpiPrime m
  let beta : AlgebraicClosure L := j rootP
  let : SMul V P :=
    (pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentBaseAlgebra
      (N := N) varpi m).toSMul
  let : Algebra V P :=
    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentBaseAlgebra
      (N := N) varpi m
  have hbetaPow : beta ^ N =
      algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) :=
    fixedTensorComponentEmbeddedRoot_pow base hN varpi hvarpiPrime m
  rw [show (beta ^ (N / ramificationIndex base target)) ^
      ramificationIndex base target =
        beta ^ ((N / ramificationIndex base target) *
          ramificationIndex base target) by simp only [pow_mul]]
  rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hdiv, hbetaPow]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding_fieldRange
statement:
private theorem tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding_fieldRange
    {L : Type uL} {P : Type uP} [Field L] [Field P]
    [Algebra L P] [FiniteDimensional L P]
    (r : P)
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin L ({r} : Set P) = ⊤) :
    let j : P →ₐ[L] AlgebraicClosure L
proof:
:=
      tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding
    j.fieldRange = IntermediateField.adjoin L ({j r} : Set _) := by
  let j : P →ₐ[L] AlgebraicClosure L :=
    tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding
  calc
    j.fieldRange = (⊤ : IntermediateField L P).map j :=
      j.fieldRange_eq_map
    _ = (IntermediateField.adjoin L ({r} : Set P)).map j := by
      rw [hgen]
    _ = IntermediateField.adjoin L (j '' ({r} : Set P)) :=
      IntermediateField.adjoin_map L ({r} : Set P) j
    _ = IntermediateField.adjoin L ({j r} : Set _) := by
      rw [Set.image_singleton]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.higherRadicalActualCompositumField_restrictScalars_eq_fieldRange
statement:
private theorem higherRadicalActualCompositumField_restrictScalars_eq_fieldRange
    {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL} {P : Type uP}
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field P]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L P] [Algebra K P]
    [IsScalarTower K L P] [FiniteDimensional L P]
    (e N : ℕ) (r : P)
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin L ({r} : Set P) = ⊤) :
    let j : P →ₐ[L] AlgebraicClosure L
proof:
:=
      tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding
    let gamma : AlgebraicClosure L := j r
    let M := higherRadicalActualCompositumField
      (K := K) (L := L) e N gamma
    M.restrictScalars K = (j.restrictScalars K).fieldRange := by
  dsimp only
  let j : P →ₐ[L] AlgebraicClosure L :=
    tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding
  let jK : P →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure L := j.restrictScalars K
  let gamma : AlgebraicClosure L := j r
  let Limage : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure L) :=
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L (AlgebraicClosure L)).fieldRange
  let G : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure L) :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin K ({gamma} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))
  let S : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure L) := Limage ⊔ G
  have hLimage : Limage ≤ jK.fieldRange := by
    rintro z ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨algebraMap L P x, ?_⟩
    change j (algebraMap L P x) = algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) x
    exact j.commutes x
  have hG : G ≤ jK.fieldRange := by
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz]
    exact ⟨r, rfl⟩
  have hforward : jK.fieldRange ≤ S := by
    rintro z ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change j x ∈ S
    have hx : x ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin L ({r} : Set P) := by
      rw [hgen]
      trivial
    exact IntermediateField.adjoin_induction
      (F := L) (s := ({r} : Set P))
      (p := fun y hy ↦ j y ∈ S)
      (fun y hy ↦ by
        rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy]
        exact (show G ≤ S from le_sup_right)
          (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K
            ({gamma} : Set (AlgebraicClosure L))
            (Set.mem_singleton gamma)))
      (fun y ↦ by
        rw [j.commutes]
        exact (show Limage ≤ S from le_sup_left) ⟨y, rfl⟩)
      (fun x y hx hy hxS hyS ↦ by
        simpa only [map_add] using S.add_mem hxS hyS)
      (fun x hx hxS ↦ by
        simpa only [map_inv₀] using S.inv_mem hxS)
      (fun x y hx hy hxS hyS ↦ by
        simpa only [map_mul] using S.mul_mem hxS hyS)
      hx
  have hS : jK.fieldRange = S :=
    le_antisymm hforward (sup_le hLimage hG)
  rw [higherRadicalActualCompositumField_restrictScalars]
  exact hS.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding_comp_equiv_apply
statement:
private theorem tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding_comp_equiv_apply
    {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL} {P : Type uP}
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field P]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L P] [Algebra K P]
    [IsScalarTower K L P] [FiniteDimensional L P]
    (e N : ℕ) (r : P)
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin L ({r} : Set P) = ⊤)
    (z : higherRadicalActualCompositumField
      (K := K) (L := L) e N
        (tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding r)) :
    tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding
        (higherRadicalActualCompositumFieldTensorComponentAlgEquivOfAdjoinEqTop
          e N r hgen z) =
      (z : AlgebraicClosure L)
proof:
:= by
  let j : P →ₐ[L] AlgebraicClosure L :=
    tensorComponentAlgebraicClosureEmbedding
  let jK : P →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure L := j.restrictScalars K
  let gamma : AlgebraicClosure L := j r
  let M := higherRadicalActualCompositumField
    (K := K) (L := L) e N gamma
  have hM : M.restrictScalars K = jK.fieldRange :=
    higherRadicalActualCompositumField_restrictScalars_eq_fieldRange
      e N r hgen
  let y : jK.fieldRange := ⟨(z : AlgebraicClosure L), by
    rw [← hM]
    exact z.2⟩
  change jK (jK.equivFieldRange.symm y) = (z : AlgebraicClosure L)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (jK.equivFieldRange.apply_symm_apply y)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentBase_isScalarTower
statement:

    {N : ℕ} (varpi : V)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot_pow
statement:
theorem pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot_pow
    {N : ℕ} (varpi : V)
    [Algebra (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [Algebra V F]
    [IsScalarTower V (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]

    (base : CompleteDVF.{uK, uV} K)

    [Algebra (AdjoinRoot (X ^ D.factorial - C varpi)) F]
    [IsFractionRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ D.factorial - C varpi)) F]
    [Algebra base.valuationSubring F]
    [IsScalarTower base.valuationSubring
      (AdjoinRoot (X ^ D.factorial - C varpi)) F]

proof:
:= AdjoinRoot (X ^ D.factorial - C varpi)
    let P := GenericTensorFieldComponent m

      pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRootAlgebra
        (K := K) varpi m

  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)

  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    base.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  have hN : 0 < N := Nat.factorial_pos D
  have hvarpi_ne : varpi ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hvarpi.ne_zero
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hzero
  have hvarpiPrime : Prime varpi := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hvarpi_ne).mp
    rw [← Valuation.IsUniformizer.is_generator hvarpi]
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal V).isPrime
  let : FiniteDimensional K F :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finiteDimensional hN varpi hvarpiPrime

    genericTensorFieldComponent_right_isScalarTower m
  let : FiniteDimensional L P :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentFiniteDimensionalOverRight m

    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentRoot
      (N := N) varpi m

      (N := N) varpi m

    pureRadicalFractionFieldGenericTensorComponentBase_isScalarTower

    exists_higherRadicalActualFactorData_factorial_of_completeBase_of_root

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.pureRadicalFractionField_finrank_eq_exponent
statement:
theorem pureRadicalFractionField_finrank_eq_exponent
    {V : Type uK} {K : Type uK} {F : Type uFroot}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Field F]
    [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Algebra K F]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (varpi : V) (hvarpi : Prime varpi)
    [Algebra (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [IsFractionRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [Algebra V F]
    [IsScalarTower V (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)) F]
    [IsScalarTower V K F] :
    Module.finrank K F = N
proof:
:= by
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
  let : IsDomain Rn :=
    isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN varpi hvarpi
  let : Module.Free V Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpi hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Finite V Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpi hN.ne').finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Finite K (K ⊗[V] Rn) :=
    Module.Finite.base_change V K Rn
  let eFinite : (K ⊗[V] Rn) ≃ₐ[K] F :=
    finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv
      (R := V) (C := Rn) (K := K) (E := F)
  calc
    Module.finrank K F = Module.finrank K (K ⊗[V] Rn) :=
      eFinite.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm
    _ = Module.finrank V Rn := Module.finrank_baseChange
    _ = (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis'
          (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpi hN.ne')).dim := by
      simpa only [Rn] using
        (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis'
          (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpi hN.ne')).finrank
    _ = (X ^ N - C varpi).natDegree := rfl
    _ = N := Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C

theorem ramificationIndex_le_finrank_of_moduleFinite

        ramificationIndex base target * residueDegree base target :=
      Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hInertia

    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    [Algebra K Froot]
    [Algebra
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) Froot]
    [IsFractionRing
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) Froot]
    [Algebra base.valuationSubring Froot]
    [IsScalarTower base.valuationSubring
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) Froot]
    [IsScalarTower base.valuationSubring K Froot]
    [HenselianLocalRing
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi))]
    [IsSepClosed
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
        (AdjoinRoot
          (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)))]
    [Algebra
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) D]
    [Module.Finite
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) D]
    [Algebra.Etale
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) D]
    (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        (AdjoinRoot
          (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)))]
    (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (AdjoinRoot
            (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi))) →
      Q = q)
    [Algebra D P] [IsFractionRing D P]
    [Algebra
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) P]
    [IsScalarTower
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) D P]
    [Algebra Froot P]
    [IsScalarTower
      (AdjoinRoot
        (X ^ ramificationIndex base target - C varpi)) Froot P]
    [Algebra K P] [Algebra Omega P]
    [IsScalarTower K Froot P] [IsScalarTower K Omega P] :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap Omega P)
proof:
:= by
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let e := ramificationIndex base target
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    base.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  let : IsFractionRing V K := base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  have he : 0 < e := ramificationIndex_pos_of_moduleFinite base target
  have hvarpiPrime : Prime varpi := dvfUniformizer_prime base varpi hvarpi
  let : FiniteDimensional K Omega :=
    finiteDimensional_of_finite_valuationSubrings_degreeSandwich base target
  let : FiniteDimensional K Froot :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finiteDimensional he varpi hvarpiPrime
  have hFrootDegree : Module.finrank K Froot = e :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finrank_eq_exponent he varpi hvarpiPrime
  let splitEquiv : Froot ≃ₐ[Froot] P :=
    strictHenselianChosenFactorFractionFieldAlgEquiv_universe q hunique
  let : FiniteDimensional Froot P :=
    Module.Finite.equiv splitEquiv.toLinearEquiv
  let : FiniteDimensional K P := Module.Finite.trans Froot P
  have hFactorDegree : Module.finrank Froot P = 1 := by
    rw [← splitEquiv.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_self]
  have hPdegree : Module.finrank K P = e := by
    have hTower := Module.finrank_mul_finrank K Froot P
    rw [hFactorDegree, mul_one, hFrootDegree] at hTower
    exact hTower.symm
  let i : Omega →ₗ[K] P :=
    (Algebra.linearMap Omega P).restrictScalars K
  have hi : Function.Injective i := (algebraMap Omega P).injective
  have hOmegaLeP : Module.finrank K Omega ≤ Module.finrank K P :=
    i.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hi
  have hRamLeOmega : e ≤ Module.finrank K Omega :=
    ramificationIndex_le_finrank_of_moduleFinite base target
  have hFinrankEq : Module.finrank K Omega = Module.finrank K P := by
    omega
  have hiSurjective : Function.Surjective i :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank
      hFinrankEq).mp hi
  refine ⟨(algebraMap Omega P).injective, ?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hiSurjective y
  exact ⟨x, hx⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.awayMap_formallyUnramified_of_normalization_etale
statement:
private theorem awayMap_formallyUnramified_of_normalization_etale
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {F : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field F] [Algebra K F] [Algebra A F] [IsScalarTower A K F]
    [FiniteDimensional K F]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {t y : A}
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A [t, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [t, y] = maximalIdeal A)
    (β : F) (hdegree : Module.finrank K F = m)
    (hβpow : β ^ m = algebraMap K F (algebraMap A K t))
    (hβgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {β} = ⊤)
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A F)]
    (hEtale : RingHom.Etale
      (R := Localization.Away t)
      (S := Localization.Away (algebraMap A (integralClosure A F) t))
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap A (integralClosure A F)) t)) :
    RingHom.FormallyUnramified
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C t))) t)
proof:
:= by
  let p : A[X] := X ^ m - C t
  let B := AdjoinRoot p
  let φ : B →ₐ[A] F :=
    pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField t β hβpow
  let : Algebra B F := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (φ.commutes a).symm
  let : IsFractionRing B F :=
    isFractionRing_adjoinRoot_of_pureRadical
      hm t β hdegree hβpow hβgen
  let : IsDomain B := (IsFractionRing.injective B F).isDomain _
  have hpMonic : p.Monic :=
    Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C t hm.ne'
  let : Module.Finite A B := hpMonic.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : IsRegularLocalRing B :=
    isRegularLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_regular_parameters
      hm hreg hgen
  have hdimB : ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    simpa [B, p] using
      (localRootCoverParameterList_length_eq_ringKrullDim
        (R := A) (n := m) (a := t) (rs := [y]) hm hreg hgen)
  let D := integralClosure A F
  let ψ : B →ₐ[A] D := IsIntegralClosure.lift A D F
  let : Algebra B D := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B D :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (ψ.commutes a).symm
  let : IsScalarTower B D F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun b ↦
      (IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_lift A D F b).symm
  let : IsIntegralClosure D B F :=
    IsIntegralClosure.tower_top (R := A) (A := B) (B := F) (C := D)
  let : Module.Finite B D :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite A B D
  let E := integralClosure B F
  let e : E ≃ₐ[B] D := IsIntegralClosure.equiv B E F D
  let : Module.Finite B E :=
    Module.Finite.equiv e.symm.toLinearEquiv
  let : Module.Free B E :=
    (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity in
      integralClosure_free_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
        (A := B) (K := F) (L := F) hdimB)
  let : Module.Free B D := Module.Free.of_equiv e.toLinearEquiv
  let b : B := algebraMap A B t
  let S := Localization.Away t
  let Bs := Localization.Away b
  let Ds := Localization.Away (algebraMap A D t)
  let f : S →+* Bs := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) t
  let mapBDs : B →+* Ds :=
    (algebraMap D Ds).comp (algebraMap B D)
  have hbUnit : IsUnit (mapBDs b) := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap D Ds (ψ (algebraMap A B t)))
    rw [ψ.commutes]
    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _
  let g : Bs →+* Ds := Localization.awayLift mapBDs b hbUnit
  let : Algebra S Bs := f.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A S Bs :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ by
      change algebraMap A Bs a = f (algebraMap A S a)
      rw [show f (algebraMap A S a) =
        algebraMap B Bs (algebraMap A B a) by
          simp [f, S, Bs, b, IsLocalization.Away.map]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B Bs a
  let : Algebra Bs Ds := g.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower B Bs Ds :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun z ↦ by
      change algebraMap B Ds z = g (algebraMap B Bs z)
      rw [show g (algebraMap B Bs z) = mapBDs z by simp [g]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B D Ds z
  have hcomp : g.comp f =
      Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) t := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers t)
    ext a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    calc
      g (f (algebraMap A S a)) =
          g (algebraMap B Bs (algebraMap A B a)) := by
        rw [show f (algebraMap A S a) =
          algebraMap B Bs (algebraMap A B a) by
            simp [f, S, Bs, b, IsLocalization.Away.map]]
      _ = mapBDs (algebraMap A B a) := by simp [g]
      _ = algebraMap D Ds (ψ (algebraMap A B a)) := rfl
      _ = algebraMap D Ds (algebraMap A D a) := by rw [ψ.commutes]
      _ = Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) t
          (algebraMap A S a) := by
        simp [S, Ds, IsLocalization.Away.map]
  have hEtaleComp : RingHom.Etale (g.comp f) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hEtale
  let : Algebra S Ds := (g.comp f).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower S Bs Ds :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : Algebra.Etale S Ds := hEtaleComp.toAlgebra
  have hbD : algebraMap B D b = algebraMap A D t := by
    exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B D t).symm
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid D (Submonoid.powers b)) Ds := by
    change IsLocalization
      ((Submonoid.powers b).map (algebraMap B D)) Ds
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers, hbD]
    infer_instance
  let basisD := Module.Free.chooseBasis B D
  let basisDs :=
    basisD.localizationLocalization Bs (Submonoid.powers b) Ds
  let : Module.Free Bs Ds := Module.Free.of_basis basisDs
  let : Module.Finite Bs Ds := Module.Finite.of_basis basisDs
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified Bs Ds :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_restrictScalars S Bs Ds
  let : Module.FinitePresentation Bs Ds :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite Bs Ds
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation Bs Ds :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation Bs Ds
  let : Algebra.Etale Bs Ds :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale Bs Ds := inferInstance
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 :=
    (_root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.regular_pair_nonzero_and_isRelPrime
      hreg).1
  have htD : algebraMap A D t ≠ 0 := by
    intro htD
    apply ht0
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    apply (algebraMap K F).injective
    calc
      algebraMap K F (algebraMap A K t) = algebraMap A F t :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K F t).symm
      _ = algebraMap D F (algebraMap A D t) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A D F t
      _ = 0 := by rw [htD, map_zero]
      _ = algebraMap K F (algebraMap A K 0) := by rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  let : IsDomain Ds := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain Ds htD
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat Bs Ds := inferInstance
  have hFU : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S Bs :=
    formallyUnramified_of_formallyEtale_faithfullyFlat
      (R := S) (S := Bs) (T := Ds)
  change @Algebra.FormallyUnramified S Bs _ _ f.toAlgebra
  exact hFU

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.awayMap_formallyUnramified_of_embedded_normalization_etale
statement:
private theorem awayMap_formallyUnramified_of_embedded_normalization_etale
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {F : Type w} {M : Type z}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field F] [Algebra K F] [Algebra A F] [IsScalarTower A K F]
    [FiniteDimensional K F]
    [Field M] [Algebra K M] [Algebra A M] [IsScalarTower A K M]
    [Algebra F M] [IsScalarTower K F M] [IsScalarTower A F M]
    [FiniteDimensional F M] [Algebra.IsSeparable F M]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {t y : A}
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A [t, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [t, y] = maximalIdeal A)
    (β : F) (hdegree : Module.finrank K F = m)
    (hβpow : β ^ m = algebraMap K F (algebraMap A K t))
    (hβgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {β} = ⊤)
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A M)]
    (hEtale : RingHom.Etale
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap A (integralClosure A M)) t)) :
    RingHom.FormallyUnramified
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C t))) t)
proof:
:= by
  let p : A[X] := X ^ m - C t
  let B := AdjoinRoot p
  let φ : B →ₐ[A] F :=
    pureRadicalAdjoinRootToField t β hβpow
  let : Algebra B F := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (φ.commutes a).symm
  let : IsFractionRing B F :=
    isFractionRing_adjoinRoot_of_pureRadical
      hm t β hdegree hβpow hβgen
  let φM : B →ₐ[A] M :=
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A F M).comp φ
  let : Algebra B M := φM.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B M :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (φM.commutes a).symm
  let : IsScalarTower B F M :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsDomain B := (IsFractionRing.injective B F).isDomain _
  have hpMonic : p.Monic :=
    Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C t hm.ne'
  let : Module.Finite A B := hpMonic.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : IsRegularLocalRing B :=
    isRegularLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_regular_parameters
      hm hreg hgen
  have hdimB : ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    simpa [B, p] using
      (localRootCoverParameterList_length_eq_ringKrullDim
        (R := A) (n := m) (a := t) (rs := [y]) hm hreg hgen)
  let D := integralClosure A M
  let ψ : B →ₐ[A] D := IsIntegralClosure.lift A D M
  let : Algebra B D := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B D :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (ψ.commutes a).symm
  let : IsScalarTower B D M :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun b ↦
      (IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_lift A D M b).symm
  let : IsIntegralClosure D B M :=
    IsIntegralClosure.tower_top (R := A) (A := B) (B := M) (C := D)
  let : Module.Finite B D :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite A B D
  let E := integralClosure B M
  let e : E ≃ₐ[B] D := IsIntegralClosure.equiv B E M D
  let : Module.Finite B E :=
    Module.Finite.equiv e.symm.toLinearEquiv
  let : Module.Free B E :=
    (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity in
      integralClosure_free_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
        (A := B) (K := F) (L := M) hdimB)
  let : Module.Free B D := Module.Free.of_equiv e.toLinearEquiv
  let b : B := algebraMap A B t
  let S := Localization.Away t
  let Bs := Localization.Away b
  let Ds := Localization.Away (algebraMap A D t)
  let f : S →+* Bs := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) t
  let mapBDs : B →+* Ds :=
    (algebraMap D Ds).comp (algebraMap B D)
  have hbUnit : IsUnit (mapBDs b) := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap D Ds (ψ (algebraMap A B t)))
    rw [ψ.commutes]
    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _
  let g : Bs →+* Ds := Localization.awayLift mapBDs b hbUnit
  let : Algebra S Bs := f.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A S Bs :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ by
      change algebraMap A Bs a = f (algebraMap A S a)
      rw [show f (algebraMap A S a) =
        algebraMap B Bs (algebraMap A B a) by
          simp [f, S, Bs, b, IsLocalization.Away.map]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B Bs a
  let : Algebra Bs Ds := g.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower B Bs Ds :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun q ↦ by
      change algebraMap B Ds q = g (algebraMap B Bs q)
      rw [show g (algebraMap B Bs q) = mapBDs q by simp [g]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B D Ds q
  have hcomp : g.comp f =
      Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) t := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers t)
    ext a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    calc
      g (f (algebraMap A S a)) =
          g (algebraMap B Bs (algebraMap A B a)) := by
        rw [show f (algebraMap A S a) =
          algebraMap B Bs (algebraMap A B a) by
            simp [f, S, Bs, b, IsLocalization.Away.map]]
      _ = mapBDs (algebraMap A B a) := by simp [g]
      _ = algebraMap D Ds (ψ (algebraMap A B a)) := rfl
      _ = algebraMap D Ds (algebraMap A D a) := by rw [ψ.commutes]
      _ = Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) t
          (algebraMap A S a) := by
        simp [S, Ds, IsLocalization.Away.map]
  have hEtaleComp : RingHom.Etale (g.comp f) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hEtale
  let : Algebra S Ds := (g.comp f).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower S Bs Ds :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : Algebra.Etale S Ds := hEtaleComp.toAlgebra
  have hbD : algebraMap B D b = algebraMap A D t := by
    exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B D t).symm
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid D (Submonoid.powers b)) Ds := by
    change IsLocalization
      ((Submonoid.powers b).map (algebraMap B D)) Ds
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers, hbD]
    infer_instance
  let basisD := Module.Free.chooseBasis B D
  let basisDs :=
    basisD.localizationLocalization Bs (Submonoid.powers b) Ds
  let : Module.Free Bs Ds := Module.Free.of_basis basisDs
  let : Module.Finite Bs Ds := Module.Finite.of_basis basisDs
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified Bs Ds :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_restrictScalars S Bs Ds
  let : Module.FinitePresentation Bs Ds :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite Bs Ds
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation Bs Ds :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation Bs Ds
  let : Algebra.Etale Bs Ds :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale Bs Ds := inferInstance
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 :=
    (_root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.regular_pair_nonzero_and_isRelPrime
      hreg).1
  have htD : algebraMap A D t ≠ 0 := by
    intro htD
    apply ht0
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    apply (algebraMap K M).injective
    calc
      algebraMap K M (algebraMap A K t) = algebraMap A M t :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K M t).symm
      _ = algebraMap D M (algebraMap A D t) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A D M t
      _ = 0 := by rw [htD, map_zero]
      _ = algebraMap K M (algebraMap A K 0) := by rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  let : IsDomain Ds := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain Ds htD
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat Bs Ds := inferInstance
  have hFU : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S Bs :=
    formallyUnramified_of_formallyEtale_faithfullyFlat
      (R := S) (S := Bs) (T := Ds)
  change @Algebra.FormallyUnramified S Bs _ _ f.toAlgebra
  exact hFU

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.selectedIntermediateRootExponent_isUnit_mod
statement:
theorem selectedIntermediateRootExponent_isUnit_mod
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    {t y : A}
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A [t, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [t, y] = maximalIdeal A)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t}))
    (α : L)
    (hpow : α ^ Module.finrank K L =
      algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K t))
    (hαgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {α} = ⊤)
    (F : IntermediateField K L)
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A F)]
    (hEtale : RingHom.Etale
      (R := Localization.Away t)
      (S := Localization.Away (algebraMap A (integralClosure A F) t))
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap A (integralClosure A F)) t)) :
    IsUnit (Module.finrank K F : A ⧸ Ideal.span {t})
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain A := isDomain_of_regularSystem [t, y] hreg hgen
  have ht : Prime t :=
    prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen List.mem_cons_self
  have hα : α ≠ 0 := by
    intro hα
    apply ht.ne_zero
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    apply (algebraMap K L).injective
    rw [← hpow, hα, zero_pow (Module.finrank_pos.ne')]
    rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  let m := Module.finrank K F
  have hm : 0 < m := Module.finrank_pos
  have hroots : ∀ ζ : L, ζ ^ Module.finrank K L = 1 →
      ζ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L) := fun ζ hζ ↦
    rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_primeParameter_pureRadical
      ht hCharZero α hpow hαgen ζ hζ
  obtain ⟨β, _hβval, hβpow, hβgenL, _hdegreeTower⟩ :=
    exists_intermediateField_generator_pow_eq_of_pureRadical
      α hα (algebraMap A K t) hpow hαgen hroots F
  have hβgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K ({β} : Set F) = ⊤ := by
    apply IntermediateField.lift_injective F
    simpa only [IntermediateField.lift_adjoin_simple,
      IntermediateField.lift_top] using hβgenL
  let p : A[X] := X ^ m - C t
  let B := AdjoinRoot p
  let b : B := algebraMap A B t
  let S := Localization.Away t
  let Bs := Localization.Away b
  let f : S →+* Bs := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) t
  have hFU : RingHom.FormallyUnramified f := by
    simpa [f, S, Bs, b, B, p] using
      (awayMap_formallyUnramified_of_normalization_etale
        (A := A) (K := K) (F := F) hm hreg hgen β rfl
          hβpow hβgen hEtale)
  let : Algebra S Bs := f.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S Bs :=
    hFU
  let : IsScalarTower A S Bs :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ by
      change algebraMap A Bs a = f (algebraMap A S a)
      rw [show f (algebraMap A S a) =
        algebraMap B Bs (algebraMap A B a) by
          simp [f, S, Bs, b, IsLocalization.Away.map]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B Bs a
  let n₁ : Fin 1 → ℕ := fun _ ↦ m
  let a₁ : Fin 1 → A := fun _ ↦ t
  let a₁S : Fin 1 → S := fun _ ↦ algebraMap A S t
  let IR := iteratedRadical S 1 n₁ a₁S
  let eLoc : S ⊗[A] B ≃ₐ[S] Bs := by
    let Tloc := Localization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (Submonoid.powers t))
    letI : IsLocalization
        (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (Submonoid.powers t)) Bs := by
      change IsLocalization
        ((Submonoid.powers t).map (algebraMap A B)) Bs
      rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
      change IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers b) Bs
      infer_instance
    let eB : Tloc ≃ₐ[B] Bs :=
      IsLocalization.algEquiv
        (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (Submonoid.powers t)) Tloc Bs
    let eS : Tloc ≃ₐ[S] Bs :=
      { eB.toRingEquiv with
        commutes' := fun s ↦ by
          have hmaps : eB.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap S Tloc) =
              algebraMap S Bs := by
            apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers t)
            ext a
            change eB (algebraMap S Tloc (algebraMap A S a)) =
              algebraMap S Bs (algebraMap A S a)
            rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S Tloc,
              ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S Bs,
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B Tloc,
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B Bs,
              eB.commutes]
          exact RingHom.congr_fun hmaps s }
    exact (Localization.tensorRightAlgEquiv
      (Submonoid.powers t) B).trans eS
  let eBaseChange : S ⊗[A] B ≃ₐ[S] IR := by
    let e₀ := oneRootBaseChangeAlgEquiv (A := A) (S := S) m t
    let e₁ := oneIteratedRadicalAlgEquiv S m (algebraMap A S t)
    exact (show S ⊗[A] B ≃ₐ[S]
        AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C (algebraMap A S t)) by
          simpa [B, p] using e₀).trans
      (show AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C (algebraMap A S t)) ≃ₐ[S] IR by
        simpa [IR, n₁, a₁S] using e₁.symm)
  let eRoot : Bs ≃ₐ[S] IR := eLoc.symm.trans eBaseChange
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S IR :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_equiv eRoot
  let : IsLocalization.Away
      (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)), a₁ i) S := by
    simpa [a₁, S] using
      (inferInstance : IsLocalization.Away t S)
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S
      (iteratedRadical S 1 n₁
        (fun i ↦ algebraMap A S (a₁ i))) := by
    simpa [IR, a₁S, a₁] using
      (inferInstance : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S IR)
  have hmUnitA : IsUnit (m : A) := by
    have hall :=
      all_exponents_isUnit_of_formallyUnramified_boundaryIteratedRadical
        (R := A) (S := S) (r := 1) (t := a₁)
        (fun _ ↦ by simpa [a₁] using ht)
        (fun _ ↦ by simpa [a₁] using hCharZero)
        n₁ (fun _ ↦ by simpa [n₁] using hm)
    simpa [n₁] using hall (0 : Fin 1)
  simpa [m] using
    hmUnitA.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t} : Set A)))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.selectedIntermediateRootExponent_isUnit_mod_of_embedded_normalization_etale
statement:
theorem selectedIntermediateRootExponent_isUnit_mod_of_embedded_normalization_etale
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w} {M : Type z}
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Field M] [Algebra K M] [Algebra A M] [IsScalarTower A K M]
    {t y : A}
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A [t, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [t, y] = maximalIdeal A)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t} : Set A)))
    (α : L)
    (hpow : α ^ Module.finrank K L =
      algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K t))
    (hαgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K {α} = ⊤)
    (F : IntermediateField K L)
    [Algebra F M] [IsScalarTower K F M] [IsScalarTower A F M]
    [FiniteDimensional F M] [Algebra.IsSeparable F M]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A M)]
    (hEtale : RingHom.Etale
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap A (integralClosure A M)) t)) :
    IsUnit (Module.finrank K F : A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t} : Set A))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain A := isDomain_of_regularSystem [t, y] hreg hgen
  have ht : Prime t :=
    prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen List.mem_cons_self
  have hα : α ≠ 0 := by
    intro hα
    apply ht.ne_zero
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    apply (algebraMap K L).injective
    rw [← hpow, hα, zero_pow (Module.finrank_pos.ne')]
    rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  let m := Module.finrank K F
  have hm : 0 < m := Module.finrank_pos
  have hroots : ∀ ζ : L, ζ ^ Module.finrank K L = 1 →
      ζ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L) := fun ζ hζ ↦
    rootOfUnity_mem_fractionBase_of_primeParameter_pureRadical
      ht hCharZero α hpow hαgen ζ hζ
  obtain ⟨β, _hβval, hβpow, hβgenL, _hdegreeTower⟩ :=
    exists_intermediateField_generator_pow_eq_of_pureRadical
      α hα (algebraMap A K t) hpow hαgen hroots F
  have hβgen : IntermediateField.adjoin K ({β} : Set F) = ⊤ := by
    apply IntermediateField.lift_injective F
    simpa only [IntermediateField.lift_adjoin_simple,
      IntermediateField.lift_top] using hβgenL
  let p : A[X] := X ^ m - C t
  let B := AdjoinRoot p
  let b : B := algebraMap A B t
  let S := Localization.Away t
  let Bs := Localization.Away b
  let f : S →+* Bs := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) t
  have hFU : RingHom.FormallyUnramified f := by
    simpa [f, S, Bs, b, B, p] using
      (awayMap_formallyUnramified_of_embedded_normalization_etale
        (A := A) (K := K) (F := F) (M := M) hm hreg hgen β rfl
          hβpow hβgen hEtale)
  let : Algebra S Bs := f.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S Bs := hFU
  let : IsScalarTower A S Bs :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ by
      change algebraMap A Bs a = f (algebraMap A S a)
      rw [show f (algebraMap A S a) =
        algebraMap B Bs (algebraMap A B a) by
          simp [f, S, Bs, b, IsLocalization.Away.map]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B Bs a
  let n₁ : Fin 1 → ℕ := fun _ ↦ m
  let a₁ : Fin 1 → A := fun _ ↦ t
  let a₁S : Fin 1 → S := fun _ ↦ algebraMap A S t
  let IR := iteratedRadical S 1 n₁ a₁S
  let eLoc : S ⊗[A] B ≃ₐ[S] Bs := by
    let Tloc := Localization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (Submonoid.powers t))
    letI : IsLocalization
        (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (Submonoid.powers t)) Bs := by
      change IsLocalization
        ((Submonoid.powers t).map (algebraMap A B)) Bs
      rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
      change IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers b) Bs
      infer_instance
    let eB : Tloc ≃ₐ[B] Bs :=
      IsLocalization.algEquiv
        (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (Submonoid.powers t)) Tloc Bs
    let eS : Tloc ≃ₐ[S] Bs :=
      { eB.toRingEquiv with
        commutes' := fun s ↦ by
          have hmaps : eB.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap S Tloc) =
              algebraMap S Bs := by
            apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers t)
            ext a
            change eB (algebraMap S Tloc (algebraMap A S a)) =
              algebraMap S Bs (algebraMap A S a)
            rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S Tloc,
              ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S Bs,
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B Tloc,
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B Bs,
              eB.commutes]
          exact RingHom.congr_fun hmaps s }
    exact (Localization.tensorRightAlgEquiv
      (Submonoid.powers t) B).trans eS
  let eBaseChange : S ⊗[A] B ≃ₐ[S] IR := by
    let e₀ := oneRootBaseChangeAlgEquiv (A := A) (S := S) m t
    let e₁ := oneIteratedRadicalAlgEquiv S m (algebraMap A S t)
    exact (show S ⊗[A] B ≃ₐ[S]
        AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C (algebraMap A S t)) by
          simpa [B, p] using e₀).trans
      (show AdjoinRoot (X ^ m - C (algebraMap A S t)) ≃ₐ[S] IR by
        simpa [IR, n₁, a₁S] using e₁.symm)
  let eRoot : Bs ≃ₐ[S] IR := eLoc.symm.trans eBaseChange
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S IR :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_equiv eRoot
  let : IsLocalization.Away
      (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)), a₁ i) S := by
    simpa [a₁, S] using
      (inferInstance : IsLocalization.Away t S)
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S
      (iteratedRadical S 1 n₁
        (fun i ↦ algebraMap A S (a₁ i))) := by
    simpa [IR, a₁S, a₁] using
      (inferInstance : Algebra.FormallyUnramified S IR)
  have hmUnitA : IsUnit (m : A) := by
    have hall :=
      all_exponents_isUnit_of_formallyUnramified_boundaryIteratedRadical
        (R := A) (S := S) (r := 1) (t := a₁)
        (fun _ ↦ by simpa [a₁] using ht)
        (fun _ ↦ by simpa [a₁] using hCharZero)
        n₁ (fun _ ↦ by simpa [n₁] using hm)
    simpa [n₁] using hall (0 : Fin 1)
  simpa [m] using
    hmUnitA.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({t} : Set A)))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDomain
statement:
theorem adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDomain
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularRing R]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
    let _ : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    let _ : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
    let _ : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let _ : Algebra V (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P q
    IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q) := by
  intro P D q hP hq hLiesOver V algVW
  have hDvrV : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtSpan_of_prime R p hp
  let pV : V := algebraMap R V p
  have hmaxV : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span ({pV} : Set V) :=
    localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span P p rfl
  have hpVne : pV ≠ 0 := by
    intro hpVzero
    apply hp.ne_zero
    exact (IsLocalization.injective V P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors)
      (by simpa only [map_zero] using hpVzero)
  have hpV : Prime pV :=
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal pV hpVne hmaxV).prime
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C pV)
  have hDomainRn : IsDomain Rn :=
    isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN pV hpV
  let algDRn : Algebra D Rn := adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
  let eLocal : Rn ≃ₐ[V] Localization.AtPrime q :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv hN hp
  exact eLocal.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain Rn

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
theorem adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDiscreteValuationRing
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularRing R]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
    let _ : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    let _ : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
    let _ : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let _ : Algebra V (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P q
    let _ : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDomain hN hp
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime q) := by
  intro P D q hP hq hLiesOver V algVW hDomainW
  have hDvrV : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtSpan_of_prime R p hp
  let pV : V := algebraMap R V p
  have hmaxV : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span ({pV} : Set V) :=
    localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span P p rfl
  have hpVne : pV ≠ 0 := by
    intro hpVzero
    apply hp.ne_zero
    exact (IsLocalization.injective V P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors)
      (by simpa only [map_zero] using hpVzero)
  have hpV : Prime pV :=
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal pV hpVne hmaxV).prime
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C pV)
  have hDomainRn : IsDomain Rn :=
    isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN pV hpV
  have hDvrRn : IsDiscreteValuationRing Rn :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN pV hpV
  let algDRn : Algebra D Rn := adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
  let eLocal : Rn ≃ₐ[V] Localization.AtPrime q :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv hN hp
  exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.RingEquivClass.isDiscreteValuationRing eLocal.toRingEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_maximalIdeal_map_eq_pow
statement:
theorem adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_maximalIdeal_map_eq_pow
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularRing R]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
    let _ : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    let _ : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
    let _ : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let W := Localization.AtPrime q
    let _ : Algebra V W :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P q
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).map (algebraMap V W) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W ^ N := by
  intro P D q hP hq hLiesOver V W algVW
  let fR : R[X] := X ^ N - C p
  let rootR := AdjoinRoot.root fR
  let pV : V := algebraMap R V p
  let fV : V[X] := X ^ N - C pV
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot fV
  let : Algebra D Rn :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationBaseChangeAlgebra R N p hp
  let eLocal : Rn ≃ₐ[V] W :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv hN hp
  let rootV := AdjoinRoot.root fV
  let rootW : W := algebraMap D W rootR
  have hmaxV : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V =
      Ideal.span ({pV} : Set V) :=
    localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span P p rfl
  have hmaxW : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W =
      Ideal.span ({rootW} : Set W) :=
    localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span q rootR rfl
  have hroot : eLocal rootV = rootW := by
    simpa only [fR, D, rootR, pV, fV, Rn, W, rootV, rootW] using
      adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv_root hN hp
  have hrootPow : rootV ^ N = algebraMap V Rn pV := by
    rw [AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
    simpa only [fV, rootV] using adjoinRoot_root_pow N pV
  have hpMap : algebraMap V W pV = rootW ^ N := by
    calc
      algebraMap V W pV = eLocal (algebraMap V Rn pV) :=
        (eLocal.commutes pV).symm
      _ = eLocal (rootV ^ N) := by rw [hrootPow]
      _ = rootW ^ N := by rw [map_pow, hroot]
  calc
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).map (algebraMap V W) =
        (Ideal.span ({pV} : Set V)).map (algebraMap V W) := by
      rw [hmaxV]
    _ = Ideal.span ({algebraMap V W pV} : Set W) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    _ = Ideal.span ({rootW ^ N} : Set W) := by rw [hpMap]
    _ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W ^ N := by
      rw [hmaxW, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]

statement:
