name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeCompletion_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeCompletion_faithfullyFlat
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularRing R]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
    let _ : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    let _ : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let _ : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtSpan_of_prime
        R p hp
    let K := FractionRing V
    let Vhat := standardDVFCompletionValuationSubring V K
    let _ : Algebra V Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    let pV := algebraMap R V p
    let pHat := standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pV
    let Rhat := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C pHat)
    let _ : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
    let _ : Algebra V (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P q
    let _ : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) Rhat :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeCompletionAlgebra hN hp
    Module.FaithfullyFlat (Localization.AtPrime q) Rhat := by
  intro P D q hP hq V hDvrV K Vhat algVVhat pV pHat Rhat hLiesOver algVW algWRhat
  let T := Vhat ⊗[V] Localization.AtPrime q
  let T' := Localization.AtPrime q ⊗[V] Vhat
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let eComm : T ≃ₐ[Localization.AtPrime q] T' :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := Localization.AtPrime q)
      (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm V Vhat
        (Localization.AtPrime q)).toRingEquiv)
      (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat (Localization.AtPrime q) T :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
      (R := Localization.AtPrime q) (M := T') eComm.toLinearEquiv
  let eCompletion :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeCompletionAlgEquiv hN hp
  let eRoot : T ≃ₐ[Localization.AtPrime q] Rhat :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := Localization.AtPrime q)
      (f := eCompletion.toRingEquiv) (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
    (R := Localization.AtPrime q) (M := T) eRoot.symm.toLinearEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.integralClosure_standardDVRCompletionFactorialRoot_originalTensorProduct_etale
statement:
theorem
    integralClosure_standardDVRCompletionFactorialRoot_originalTensorProduct_etale
    (V : Type uR) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    (pi : V)
    (hpi : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span ({pi} : Set V))
    (hCharZero : CharZero (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V))
    {K₀ : Type uK₀} {L : Type uL}
    [Field K₀] [Field L]
    [Algebra K₀ (standardDVFCompletionField V K)] [Algebra K₀ L]
    [FiniteDimensional K₀ L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K₀ L]
    (D : ℕ) (hdegree : Module.finrank K₀ L ≤ D) :
    let H
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
    let Khat := standardDVFCompletionField V K
    let varpi := standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi
    let _ : IsFractionRing Vhat Khat :=
      H.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
    let _ : IsIntegrallyClosed Vhat :=
      H.toDVF.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
    let N := D.factorial
    let Rhat := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
    let _ : IsDomain Rhat :=
      completeDVFFactorialRootRing_isDomain H varpi
        (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement_isUniformizer
          V K pi hpi) D
    let Fhat := FractionRing Rhat
    let _ : Algebra Khat Fhat :=
      completeDVFFactorialRootFractionFieldAlgebra H varpi
        (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement_isUniformizer
          V K pi hpi) D
    let _ : IsScalarTower Vhat Khat Fhat :=
      completeDVFFactorialRootFractionField_isScalarTower H varpi
        (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement_isUniformizer
          V K pi hpi) D
    let _ : Algebra K₀ Fhat :=
      ((algebraMap Khat Fhat).comp (algebraMap K₀ Khat)).toAlgebra
    let _ : IsScalarTower K₀ Khat Fhat :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    let G := Fhat ⊗[K₀] L
    let _ : Algebra Rhat G :=
      genericTensorProductLeftScalarAlgebra
        (R := Rhat) (K := K₀) (F := Fhat) (L := L)
    Algebra.Etale Rhat (integralClosure Rhat G) := by
  intro H Vhat Khat varpi hFractionVhat hClosedVhat N Rhat hDomainRhat Fhat algKhatFhat
    hTowerVhatKhatFhat algK₀Fhat hTowerK₀KhatFhat G algRhatG
  have hvarpi : H.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : Khat) :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement_isUniformizer V K pi hpi
  have hResidueCharZero : CharZero H.residueField :=
    charZero_standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_residueField V K hCharZero
  exact integralClosure_completeDVFFactorialRoot_originalTensorProduct_etale
    H varpi hvarpi D hdegree

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootToQuotient_surjective
statement:
theorem adjoinRootToQuotient_surjective
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a : R) :
    Function.Surjective (adjoinRootToQuotient hn a)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  exact ⟨AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a) r, by
    simp [adjoinRootToQuotient]⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.ker_adjoinRootToQuotient
statement:
theorem ker_adjoinRootToQuotient
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a : R) :
    RingHom.ker (adjoinRootToQuotient hn a) =
      Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)} :
        Set (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)))
proof:
:= by
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {a}
  change RingHom.ker (adjoinRootToQuotient hn a) =
    Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f))
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    induction z using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
    | _ p =>
        have hcoeffI : p.coeff 0 ∈ I := by
          apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
          simpa [adjoinRootToQuotient, I, Polynomial.eval₂_at_zero] using hz
        have hmapI : I.map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ≤
            Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f)) := by
          change (Ideal.span {a}).map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ≤
            Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f))
          rw [Ideal.map_span]
          apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
          intro z hz
          simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
          obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hz
          subst b
          rw [show AdjoinRoot.of f a = AdjoinRoot.root f ^ n by
            simpa [f] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow n a).symm]
          exact Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem
            (Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f)))
            (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (AdjoinRoot.root f)) n hn
        rw [← Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add p, map_add, map_mul,
          AdjoinRoot.mk_X]
        apply Ideal.add_mem
        · exact (Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f))).mul_mem_right
            (AdjoinRoot.mk f p.divX)
            (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (AdjoinRoot.root f))
        · exact hmapI (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (AdjoinRoot.of f) hcoeffI)
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    change adjoinRootToQuotient hn a (AdjoinRoot.root f) = 0
    simp [adjoinRootToQuotient, f]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.adjoinRootQuotientRootEquiv_mk_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjoinRootQuotientRootEquiv_mk_of
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (a r : R) :
    adjoinRootQuotientRootEquiv hn a
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)} :
            Set (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))))
          (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a) r)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjoinRootQuotientRootEquiv, RingEquiv.trans_apply,
    Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk,
    RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk]
  simp [adjoinRootToQuotient]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime
statement:
theorem prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : R} (ha : Prime a) :
    Prime (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a))
proof:
:= by
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {a}
  let S := R ⧸ I
  have hIprime : I.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ha
  let : I.IsPrime := hIprime
  let : IsDomain S := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain I
  have heval : f.eval₂ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (0 : S) = 0 := by
    simp [f, I, hn.ne']
  let φ : AdjoinRoot f →+* S :=
    AdjoinRoot.lift (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) 0 heval
  have hker : RingHom.ker φ =
      Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f)) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro z hz
      induction z using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
      | _ p =>
          have hcoeffI : p.coeff 0 ∈ I := by
            apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
            simpa [φ, Polynomial.eval₂_at_zero] using hz
          have hmapI : I.map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ≤
              Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f)) := by
            change (Ideal.span {a}).map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ≤
              Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f))
            rw [Ideal.map_span]
            apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
            intro z hz
            simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
            obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hz
            subst b
            rw [show AdjoinRoot.of f a =
                AdjoinRoot.root f ^ n by
              simpa [f] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow n a).symm]
            exact Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem
              (Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f)))
              (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (AdjoinRoot.root f)) n hn
          rw [← Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add p, map_add, map_mul,
            AdjoinRoot.mk_X]
          apply Ideal.add_mem
          · exact (Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f))).mul_mem_right
              (AdjoinRoot.mk f p.divX)
              (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (AdjoinRoot.root f))
          · exact hmapI (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (AdjoinRoot.of f) hcoeffI)
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      subst z
      change φ (AdjoinRoot.root f) = 0
      simp [φ]
  have hspanPrime :
      (Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set (AdjoinRoot f))).IsPrime := by
    rw [← hker, RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    infer_instance
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R (AdjoinRoot f) := by
    simpa [f] using faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
  have hrootNe : AdjoinRoot.root f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hroot
    apply ha.ne_zero
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R (AdjoinRoot f)
    have hmapa : algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot f) a = 0 := by
      rw [AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
      rw [show AdjoinRoot.of f a = AdjoinRoot.root f ^ n by
        simpa [f] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow n a).symm]
      simp [hroot, hn.ne']
    simpa only [map_zero] using hmapa
  apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hrootNe).mp
  simpa [f] using hspanPrime

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.integralClosure_selectedRootPrime_genericTensorTowerComponent_etale_of_ramification_dvd
statement:
theorem integralClosure_selectedRootPrime_genericTensorTowerComponent_etale_of_ramification_dvd
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} [hp : Fact (Prime p)]
    {C : Type uC} [CommRing C] [IsDedekindDomain C]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C]
    [Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C]
    {L : Type uL} [Field L] [Algebra C L] [IsFractionRing C L]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) L]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C L]
    [Algebra (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime
      (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))) L]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))
      (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))) L]
    [FiniteDimensional
      (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))) L]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable
      (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))) L]
    (hdiv : ∀ Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))).primesOver C,
      Q.1.ramificationIdx
        (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) ∣ N)
    (hCharZero : CharZero
      (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)) ⧸
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))))) :
    let : IsRegularRing R
proof:
:=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two hdim
    let P := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - Polynomial.C p)} : Set D)
    let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp.out
    let : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp.out)
    let : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp.out
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtSpan_of_prime
        R p hp.out
    let K := FractionRing V
    let pV := algebraMap R V p
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C pV)
    let W := Localization.AtPrime q
    let : Algebra V W := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P q
    let : IsDomain W := adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDomain hN hp.out
    let : IsDiscreteValuationRing W :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDiscreteValuationRing hN hp.out
    let eLocal : Rn ≃ₐ[V] W :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv hN hp.out
    let : Module.Free V Rn :=
      (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C pV hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
    let : Module.Free V W := Module.Free.of_equiv eLocal.toLinearEquiv
    let Kroot := FractionRing W
    let : FaithfulSMul V W := inferInstance
    let : FaithfulSMul V Kroot := FaithfulSMul.trans V W Kroot
    let : Algebra K Kroot := FractionRing.liftAlgebra V Kroot
    ∀ {K₁ : Type uK₁} [Field K₁]
      [Algebra K K₁] [Algebra K₁ L] [IsScalarTower K K₁ L]
      {B : Type uB} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
      [Algebra W B]
      {K' : Type uK'} [Field K'] [Algebra B K'] [IsFractionRing B K']
      [Algebra W K'] [IsScalarTower W B K']
      [Algebra Kroot K'] [IsScalarTower W Kroot K']
      [Algebra K₁ K'] [Algebra K K'] [IsScalarTower K K₁ K']
      [IsScalarTower K Kroot K']
      [FiniteDimensional Kroot K'],
      ∀ (m : Ideal (K' ⊗[K₁] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
        let : m.IsMaximal := hm
        let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
        let : Algebra B M :=
          genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := B) m
        Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure B M) := by
  classical
  intro hRegular P D q hP hq hqP V hV K pV Rn W aVW hDomainW hDvrW eLocal
    hFreeRn hFreeW Kroot hFaithVW hFaithVKroot aKKroot
  let : IsScalarTower V K Kroot :=
    FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra V Kroot
  intro K₁ hFieldK₁ aKK₁ aK₁L hKK₁L B hRingB hDomainB hNormalB aWB
    K' hFieldK' aBK' hFracBK' aWK' hWBK' aKrootK' hWKrootK'
    aK₁K' aKK' hKK₁K' hKKrootK' hFiniteKrootK' m hm hmInstance M bMAlgebra
  let m₀ := genericTensorRestrictBaseIdeal
    (K₀ := K) (K₁ := K₁) (F := K') (L := L) m
  let : m₀.IsMaximal :=
    genericTensorRestrictBaseIdeal_isMaximal
      (K₀ := K) (K₁ := K₁) (F := K') (L := L) m
  let n := genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal
    (K := K) (F := Kroot) (F' := K') (L := L) m₀
  let : n.IsMaximal :=
    genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal_isMaximal
      (K := K) (F := Kroot) (F' := K') (L := L) m₀
  let E := GenericTensorFieldComponent n
  let wEAlgebra : Algebra W E :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := W) n
  let : SMul W E := wEAlgebra.toSMul
  let : Module W E := wEAlgebra.toModule
  let : IsScalarTower W Kroot E :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let T := integralClosure W E
  let : IsFractionRing T E :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension W Kroot E T
  let : Module.Finite W T :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite W Kroot E T
  let : Algebra.Etale W T :=
    integralClosure_selectedRootPrime_genericTensorComponent_etale_of_ramification_dvd
      hdim hN hdiv hCharZero n inferInstance
  let m₂ := genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal
    (K := K) (F := Kroot) (F' := K') (L := L) m₀
  let : m₂.IsMaximal :=
    genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal_isMaximal
      (K := K) (F := Kroot) (F' := K') (L := L) m₀
  let M₂ := GenericTensorFieldComponent m₂
  let : Algebra B M₂ := Ideal.instAlgebraQuotient B m₂
  have hEtale₂ : Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure B M₂) := by
    dsimp only [M₂]
    simpa only using
      integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_finiteEtale_baseChange
        (A := W) (B := B) (T := T) (F := Kroot) (E := E) (K := K') m₂
  let M₀ := GenericTensorFieldComponent m₀
  let : Algebra B M₀ := Ideal.instAlgebraQuotient B m₀
  let eTower : M₂ ≃ₐ[K'] M₀ :=
    genericTensorTowerSecondComponentAlgEquiv
      (K := K) (F := Kroot) (F' := K') (L := L) m₀
  let eTowerB : M₂ ≃ₐ[B] M₀ :=
    { toRingEquiv := eTower.toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro x
        change eTower (algebraMap K' M₂ (algebraMap B K' x)) =
          algebraMap K' M₀ (algebraMap B K' x)
        exact eTower.commutes (algebraMap B K' x) }
  have hEtale₀ : Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure B M₀) :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eTowerB.mapIntegralClosure
  let eRestrict : M₀ ≃ₐ[K'] M :=
    genericTensorRestrictBaseComponentAlgEquiv
      (K₀ := K) (K₁ := K₁) (F := K') (L := L) m
  let eRestrictB : M₀ ≃ₐ[B] M :=
    { toRingEquiv := eRestrict.toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro x
        change eRestrict (algebraMap K' M₀ (algebraMap B K' x)) =
          algebraMap K' M (algebraMap B K' x)
        exact eRestrict.commutes (algebraMap B K' x) }
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eRestrictB.mapIntegralClosure

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.selectedRootCompletion_algebraMap
statement:
private theorem selectedRootCompletion_algebraMap
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularRing R]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} (hp : Prime p) :
    let P
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)} : Set D)
    let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    let : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp)
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtSpan_of_prime
        R p hp
    let K := FractionRing V
    let Vhat := standardDVFCompletionValuationSubring V K
    let : Algebra V Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    let pV := algebraMap R V p
    let pHat := standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pV
    let Rhat := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C pHat)
    let : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
    let : Algebra V (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P q
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) Rhat :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeCompletionAlgebra hN hp
    ∀ w : Localization.AtPrime q,
      adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeCompletionAlgEquiv hN hp
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
            Localization.AtPrime q →ₐ[V] Vhat ⊗[V] Localization.AtPrime q) w) =
        algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) Rhat w := by
  intro P D q hP hq V hV K Vhat aVVhat pV pHat Rhat hqP aVW aWRhat w
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.integralClosure_etale_of_completedFactors
statement:
private theorem integralClosure_etale_of_completedFactors
    (W : Type uR) (K : Type uC) (M : Type uL)
    [CommRing W] [IsDomain W] [IsDiscreteValuationRing W]
    [Field K] [Algebra W K] [IsFractionRing W K]
    [Field M] [Algebra K M] [Algebra W M] [IsScalarTower W K M]
    [FiniteDimensional K M] [Algebra.IsSeparable K M]
    (hlocal :
      let Croot := integralClosure W M
      ∀ [IsFractionRing Croot M] [IsDedekindDomain Croot]
        [Module.IsTorsionFree W Croot] [Module.Finite W Croot],
      let pRoot := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W
      let Hw := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF W K
      let What := Hw.valuationSubring
      let Aroot := fun Q : pRoot.primesOver Croot =>
        completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := M) Q
      let : Algebra W What := standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra W K
      let : ∀ Q, Algebra What (Aroot Q) := fun Q =>
        completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
          (V := W) (C := Croot) (K := K) (L := M) Q
      ∀ Q, Algebra.Etale What (Aroot Q)) :
    Algebra.Etale W (integralClosure W M)
proof:
:= by
  let Croot := integralClosure W M
  let : IsFractionRing Croot M :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension W K M Croot
  let : IsDedekindDomain Croot :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain W K M Croot
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree W M := by
    let : Module.IsTorsionFree K M :=
      DivisionSemiring.to_moduleIsTorsionFree (𝕜 := K) (M := M)
    exact Module.IsTorsionFree.trans_faithfulSMul W K M
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree W Croot := IsIntegralClosure.isTorsionFree W M
  let : Module.Finite W Croot := IsIntegralClosure.finite W K M Croot
  exact etale_of_completedPrimeValuationSubring_etale
    (V := W) (C := Croot) (K := K) (L := M) hlocal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.integralClosure_etale_of_completedTensorTransport
statement:
private theorem integralClosure_etale_of_completedTensorTransport
    (W : Type uR) (K : Type uC) (M : Type uL)
    (Rhat : Type uB) (Fhat : Type uF)
    [CommRing W] [IsDomain W] [IsDiscreteValuationRing W]
    [Field K] [Algebra W K] [IsFractionRing W K]
    [Field M] [Algebra K M] [Algebra W M] [IsScalarTower W K M]
    [FiniteDimensional K M] [Algebra.IsSeparable K M]
    [CommRing Rhat] [Algebra W Rhat]
    [Field Fhat] [Algebra Rhat Fhat] [IsFractionRing Rhat Fhat]
    [Algebra W Fhat] [IsScalarTower W Rhat Fhat]
    [Algebra K Fhat] [IsScalarTower W K Fhat]
    (eBase :
      let Hw := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF W K
      let What := Hw.valuationSubring
      let : Algebra W What := standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra W K
      What ≃ₐ[W] Rhat)
    (hlocal : ∀ (qF : Ideal (Fhat ⊗[K] M)) [qF.IsMaximal],
      let : Algebra Rhat (GenericTensorFieldComponent qF) :=
        genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Rhat) qF
      Algebra.Etale Rhat (integralClosure Rhat (GenericTensorFieldComponent qF))) :
    Algebra.Etale W (integralClosure W M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply integralClosure_etale_of_completedFactors W K M
  intro Croot hCrootFraction hCrootDedekind hCrootTorsion hCrootFinite
    pRoot Hw What Aroot wWhatAlgebra completedAlgebras Qroot
  let Lhat := standardDVFCompletionField W K
  let : IsLocalHom (R := W) (S := What) (F := W →+* What)
      (algebraMap W What) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom W K
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat W What :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat (V := W) (K := K)
  let kLhatAlgebra : Algebra K Lhat := standardDVFCompletionAlgebra W K
  let wLhatAlgebra : Algebra W Lhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := W) (K := K)
  let : SMul K Lhat := kLhatAlgebra.toSMul
  let : Module K Lhat := kLhatAlgebra.toModule
  let : SMul W Lhat := wLhatAlgebra.toSMul
  let : Module W Lhat := wLhatAlgebra.toModule
  let : IsScalarTower W K Lhat :=
    standardDVFCompletion_isScalarTower (V := W) (K := K)
  let whatLhatAlgebra : Algebra What Lhat :=
    Algebra.ofSubsemiring Hw.valuation.valuationSubring
  let : SMul What Lhat := whatLhatAlgebra.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower W What Lhat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower (V := W) (K := K)
  let hmaxW : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W).map (algebraMap W What) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal What :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq W K
  let hresW : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap W What)) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective W K
  let qstd : Ideal (Lhat ⊗[K] M) := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
    (R := W) (R' := What) (C := Croot) (K := K) (L := M)
    (K' := Lhat) hmaxW hresW Qroot.1
  let : qstd.IsMaximal :=
    completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := W) (R' := What) (C := Croot) (K := K) (L := M)
      (K' := Lhat) hmaxW hresW Qroot.1
  let hFrac : IsFractionRing What Lhat :=
    Hw.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let eField : Lhat ≃ₐ[K] Fhat :=
    IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv K Lhat Fhat eBase
  let : IsScalarTower K K Lhat :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsScalarTower K K Fhat :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let eTensor : (Lhat ⊗[K] M) ≃ₐ[K] (Fhat ⊗[K] M) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.congr eField (AlgEquiv.refl : M ≃ₐ[K] M)
  let qF : Ideal (Fhat ⊗[K] M) := qstd.map eTensor.toRingEquiv
  let : qF.IsMaximal :=
    (inferInstance : qstd.IsMaximal).map_bijective
      (f := eTensor.toRingEquiv) eTensor.bijective
  let eQuot : GenericTensorFieldComponent qstd ≃ₐ[K]
      GenericTensorFieldComponent qF :=
    Ideal.quotientEquivAlg qstd qF eTensor rfl
  let Pstd := GenericTensorFieldComponent qstd
  let PqF := GenericTensorFieldComponent qF
  let : Algebra Rhat PqF :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Rhat) qF
  have hRoot : Algebra.Etale Rhat (integralClosure Rhat PqF) := hlocal qF
  have heQuot (z : Lhat) :
      eQuot (algebraMap Lhat Pstd z) =
        algebraMap Fhat PqF (eField z) := by
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk qF
        (eTensor ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
          Lhat →ₐ[K] Lhat ⊗[K] M) z)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk qF
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
          Fhat →ₐ[K] Fhat ⊗[K] M) (eField z))
    apply congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk qF)
    change (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr eField
        (AlgEquiv.refl : M ≃ₐ[K] M)) (z ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : M)) =
      eField z ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : M)
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul
      (eField : Lhat →ₐ[K] Fhat) (AlgHom.id K M) z 1
  have hcompat : eQuot.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap What Pstd) =
      (algebraMap Rhat PqF).comp eBase.toRingEquiv.toRingHom := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro x
    change eQuot (algebraMap What Pstd x) = algebraMap Rhat PqF (eBase x)
    calc
      eQuot (algebraMap What Pstd x) =
          algebraMap Fhat PqF (eField (algebraMap What Lhat x)) :=
        heQuot (algebraMap What Lhat x)
      _ = algebraMap Fhat PqF (algebraMap Rhat Fhat (eBase x)) :=
        congrArg (algebraMap Fhat PqF)
          (IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap K Lhat Fhat eBase x)
      _ = algebraMap Rhat PqF (eBase x) := rfl
  have hStd : Algebra.Etale What (integralClosure What Pstd) :=
    integralClosure_etale_of_baseAndAmbientEquiv
      eBase.toRingEquiv eQuot.toRingEquiv hcompat hRoot
  let eChosen : integralClosure What Pstd ≃ₐ[What] Aroot Qroot :=
    completedGenericTensorChosenIntegralClosureAlgEquiv
      (V := W) (C := Croot) (K := K) (L := M) Qroot
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eChosen

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.integralClosure_selectedRootPrime_genericTensorComponent_etale_of_ramification_dvd
statement:
theorem integralClosure_selectedRootPrime_genericTensorComponent_etale_of_ramification_dvd
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {p : R} [hp : Fact (Prime p)]
    {C : Type uC} [CommRing C] [IsDedekindDomain C]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C]
    [Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C]
    {L : Type uL} [Field L] [Algebra C L] [IsFractionRing C L]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) L]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) C L]
    [Algebra (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime
      (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))) L]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))
      (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))) L]
    [FiniteDimensional
      (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))) L]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable
      (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))) L]
    (hdiv : ∀ Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))).primesOver C,
      Q.1.ramificationIdx
        (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))) ∣ N)
    (hCharZero : CharZero
      (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)) ⧸
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (Localization.AtPrime (Ideal.span ({p} : Set R))))) :
    let : IsRegularRing R
proof:
:=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two hdim
    let P := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C p)
    let q := Ideal.span
      ({AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - Polynomial.C p)} : Set D)
    let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp.out
    let : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hN hp.out)
    let : q.LiesOver P := span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp.out
    let V := Localization.AtPrime P
    let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtSpan_of_prime
        R p hp.out
    let K := FractionRing V
    let pV := algebraMap R V p
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C pV)
    let W := Localization.AtPrime q
    let : Algebra V W := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P q
    let : IsDomain W := adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDomain hN hp.out
    let : IsDiscreteValuationRing W :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDiscreteValuationRing hN hp.out
    let eLocal : Rn ≃ₐ[V] W :=
      adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv hN hp.out
    let : Module.Free V Rn :=
      (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C pV hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
    let : Module.Free V W := Module.Free.of_equiv eLocal.toLinearEquiv
    let Kroot := FractionRing W
    let : FaithfulSMul V W := inferInstance
    let : FaithfulSMul V Kroot := FaithfulSMul.trans V W Kroot
    let : Algebra K Kroot := FractionRing.liftAlgebra V Kroot
    ∀ (m : Ideal (Kroot ⊗[K] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
      let : m.IsMaximal := hm
      let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
      let : Algebra W M :=
        genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := W) m
      Algebra.Etale W (integralClosure W M) := by
  classical
  intro hRegular P D q hP hq hqP V hV K pV Rn W aVW hDomainW hDvrW eLocal
    hFreeRn hFreeW Kroot hFaithVW hFaithVKroot aKKroot
  let : IsScalarTower V K Kroot :=
    FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra V Kroot
  intro m hm hmInstance M wMAlgebra
  let : SMul W M := wMAlgebra.toSMul
  let : Module W M := wMAlgebra.toModule
  let : IsScalarTower W Kroot M :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
  let Khat := standardDVFCompletionField V K
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V Vhat) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let kKhatAlgebra : Algebra K Khat := standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let vKhatAlgebra : Algebra V Khat :=
    standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)
  let : SMul K Khat := kKhatAlgebra.toSMul
  let : Module K Khat := kKhatAlgebra.toModule
  let : SMul V Khat :=
    vKhatAlgebra.toSMul
  let : Module V Khat :=
    vKhatAlgebra.toModule
  let : IsScalarTower V K Khat :=
    standardDVFCompletion_isScalarTower (V := V) (K := K)
  let : SMul Vhat Khat :=
    (Algebra.ofSubsemiring H.valuation.valuationSubring).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower V Vhat Khat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower
      (V := V) (K := K)
  have hpiV : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V =
      Ideal.span ({pV} : Set V) :=
    localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span P p rfl
  let pHat := standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pV
  have hpHat : H.valuation.IsUniformizer (pHat : Khat) :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement_isUniformizer
      V K pV hpiV
  let Rhat := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C pHat)
  let : IsDomain Rhat :=
    completeDVFRootRing_isDomain H pHat hpHat N hN
  let Fhat := FractionRing Rhat
  let khatFhatAlgebra : Algebra Khat Fhat :=
    completeDVFRootFractionFieldAlgebra H pHat hpHat N hN
  let : SMul Khat Fhat := khatFhatAlgebra.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower Vhat Khat Fhat :=
    completeDVFRootFractionField_isScalarTower H pHat hpHat N hN
  let kFhatAlgebra : Algebra K Fhat :=
    ((algebraMap Khat Fhat).comp (algebraMap K Khat)).toAlgebra
  let : SMul K Fhat := kFhatAlgebra.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower K Khat Fhat :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (R := K) (S := Khat) (A := Fhat)
      (fun _x : K => rfl)
  let : FiniteDimensional Khat Fhat :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finiteDimensional hN pHat
      (completeDVFUniformizer_prime H pHat hpHat)
  let : Algebra W Rhat :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeCompletionAlgebra hN hp.out
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat W Rhat :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeCompletion_faithfullyFlat hN hp.out
  let : FaithfulSMul W Rhat :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
  let : FaithfulSMul W Fhat := FaithfulSMul.trans W Rhat Fhat
  let krootFhatAlgebra : Algebra Kroot Fhat := FractionRing.liftAlgebra W Fhat
  let : SMul Kroot Fhat := krootFhatAlgebra.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower W Kroot Fhat :=
    FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra W Fhat
  let : IsScalarTower K Kroot Fhat := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    have hMaps : algebraMap K Fhat =
        (algebraMap Kroot Fhat).comp (algebraMap K Kroot) := by
      apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := V)
      intro v
      change algebraMap Khat Fhat
          (algebraMap K Khat (algebraMap V K v)) =
        algebraMap Kroot Fhat
          (algebraMap K Kroot (algebraMap V K v))
      have hLeft :
          algebraMap Khat Fhat (algebraMap K Khat (algebraMap V K v)) =
            algebraMap Rhat Fhat
              (algebraMap Vhat Rhat (algebraMap V Vhat v)) := by
        calc
          _ = algebraMap Khat Fhat (algebraMap V Khat v) :=
            congrArg (algebraMap Khat Fhat)
              (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V K Khat v).symm
          _ = algebraMap Khat Fhat
                (algebraMap Vhat Khat (algebraMap V Vhat v)) :=
            congrArg (algebraMap Khat Fhat)
              (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V Vhat Khat v)
          _ = algebraMap Vhat Fhat (algebraMap V Vhat v) :=
            (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Vhat Khat Fhat _).symm
          _ = algebraMap Rhat Fhat
                (algebraMap Vhat Rhat (algebraMap V Vhat v)) :=
            IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Vhat Rhat Fhat _
      have hRight :
          algebraMap Kroot Fhat (algebraMap K Kroot (algebraMap V K v)) =
            algebraMap Rhat Fhat
              (algebraMap W Rhat (algebraMap V W v)) := by
        calc
          _ = algebraMap Kroot Fhat (algebraMap V Kroot v) :=
            congrArg (algebraMap Kroot Fhat)
              (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V K Kroot v).symm
          _ = algebraMap Kroot Fhat
                (algebraMap W Kroot (algebraMap V W v)) :=
            congrArg (algebraMap Kroot Fhat)
              (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V W Kroot v)
          _ = algebraMap W Fhat (algebraMap V W v) :=
            (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply W Kroot Fhat _).symm
          _ = algebraMap Rhat Fhat
                (algebraMap W Rhat (algebraMap V W v)) :=
            IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply W Rhat Fhat _
      let T := Vhat ⊗[V] W
      let inLeft : Vhat →ₐ[V] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
      let inRight : W →ₐ[V] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
      let eCompletion : T ≃ₐ[Vhat] Rhat :=
        adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeCompletionAlgEquiv hN hp.out
      have hVRhat :
          algebraMap Vhat Rhat (algebraMap V Vhat v) =
            algebraMap W Rhat (algebraMap V W v) := by
        calc
          algebraMap Vhat Rhat (algebraMap V Vhat v) =
              eCompletion (inLeft (algebraMap V Vhat v)) :=
            (eCompletion.commutes _).symm
          _ = eCompletion (inRight (algebraMap V W v)) :=
            congrArg eCompletion ((inLeft.commutes v).trans (inRight.commutes v).symm)
          _ = algebraMap W Rhat (algebraMap V W v) :=
            selectedRootCompletion_algebraMap (R := R) hN hp.out (algebraMap V W v)
      exact hLeft.trans ((congrArg (algebraMap Rhat Fhat) hVRhat).trans hRight.symm)
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hMaps x
  apply integralClosure_etale_of_completedTensorTransport W Kroot M Rhat Fhat
    (adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeStandardCompletionAlgEquiv hN hp.out)
  intro qF hqF rhatPqFAlgebra
  let n : Ideal (Fhat ⊗[K] L) := genericTensorRefineChosenComponentIdeal
    (K₀ := K) (K₁ := Kroot) (F := Fhat) (L := L) m qF
  let : n.IsMaximal :=
    genericTensorRefineChosenComponentIdeal_isMaximal
      (K₀ := K) (K₁ := Kroot) (F := Fhat) (L := L) m qF
  let Pn := GenericTensorFieldComponent n
  let : Algebra Rhat Pn :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Rhat) n
  have hRoot : Algebra.Etale Rhat (integralClosure Rhat Pn) := by
    exact
      integralClosure_completedRootTensorComponent_etale_of_ramification_dvd
        (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
        pV hpiV N hN hdiv hCharZero n inferInstance
  let eNormalization : integralClosure Rhat Pn ≃ₐ[Rhat]
      integralClosure Rhat (GenericTensorFieldComponent qF) :=
    genericTensorRefineChosenComponentIntegralClosureAlgEquiv
      (B := Rhat) (K₀ := K) (K₁ := Kroot) (F := Fhat) (L := L) m qF
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eNormalization

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap_tmul
    (m : Ideal (K₁ ⊗[K₀] L)) [m.IsMaximal]
    (x : F) (y : L) :
    genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap m (x ⊗ₜ[K₀] y) =
      x ⊗ₜ[K₁]
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk m
          ((1 : K₁) ⊗ₜ[K₀] y))
proof:
:= by
  simp [genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap_surjective
statement:
theorem genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap_surjective
    (m : Ideal (K₁ ⊗[K₀] L)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    Function.Surjective
      (genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap
        (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁) (F := F) (L := L) m)
proof:
:= by
  let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
      obtain ⟨y₀, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
      induction y₀ using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul c l =>
          refine ⟨(x * algebraMap K₁ F c) ⊗ₜ[K₀] l, ?_⟩
          rw [genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap_tmul
            (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁)]
          rw [mul_comm x]
          rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
          congr 1
          change c • (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K₁ m) ((1 : K₁) ⊗ₜ[K₀] l) =
            (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K₁ m) (c ⊗ₜ[K₀] l)
          rw [← map_smul]
          congr 1
          simp [Algebra.smul_def,
            Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
      | add y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ =>
          obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩ := hy₁
          obtain ⟨z₂, hz₂⟩ := hy₂
          refine ⟨z₁ + z₂, ?_⟩
          simp only [map_add, hz₁, hz₂,
            map_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  | add z₁ z₂ hz₁ hz₂ =>
      obtain ⟨w₁, rfl⟩ := hz₁
      obtain ⟨w₂, rfl⟩ := hz₂
      exact ⟨w₁ + w₂, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.genericTensorRefineChosenComponentIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem genericTensorRefineChosenComponentIdeal_isMaximal
    (m : Ideal (K₁ ⊗[K₀] L)) [m.IsMaximal]
    (q : Ideal (F ⊗[K₁] GenericTensorFieldComponent m))
    [q.IsMaximal] :
    (genericTensorRefineChosenComponentIdeal m q).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  let g : (F ⊗[K₀] L) →ₐ[F]
      GenericTensorFieldComponent q :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ F q).comp
      (genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap
        (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁) (F := F) (L := L) m)
  have hg : Function.Surjective g :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp
      (genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap_surjective
        (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁) (F := F) (L := L) m)
  exact RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective g hg

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.genericTensorRefineChosenComponentIdeal_tower_second
statement:
theorem genericTensorRefineChosenComponentIdeal_tower_second
    [FiniteDimensional K₁ F]
    (m : Ideal (F ⊗[K₀] L)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    let n
proof:
:= genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal
      (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
    letI : n.IsMaximal :=
      genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal_isMaximal
        (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
    let q := genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal
      (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
    letI : q.IsMaximal :=
      genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal_isMaximal
        (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
    genericTensorRefineChosenComponentIdeal
      (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁) (F := F) (L := L) n q = m := by
  dsimp only
  let n := genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal
    (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
  let : n.IsMaximal :=
    genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal_isMaximal
      (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
  let q := genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal
    (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
  let : q.IsMaximal :=
    genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal_isMaximal
      (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
  have hcomp (z : F ⊗[K₀] L) :
      genericTensorTowerSecondComponentMap
          (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
          (genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap
            (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁) (F := F) (L := L) n z) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk m z := by
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul x y =>
        rw [genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap_tmul]
        change genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m x *
            genericTensorTowerIntermediateComponentMap
              (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk n ((1 : K₁) ⊗ₜ[K₀] y)) =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk m (x ⊗ₜ[K₀] y)
        rw [genericTensorTowerIntermediateComponentMap_mk]
        rw [genericTensorFieldComponentLeft_apply]
        rw [← map_mul]
        congr 1
        simp [genericTensorTowerMap]
    | add x y hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
  ext z
  change
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ F q)
        (genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap
          (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁) (F := F) (L := L) n z) = 0 ↔
      z ∈ m
  change
    Ideal.Quotient.mk q
        (genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap
          (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁) (F := F) (L := L) n z) = 0 ↔
      z ∈ m
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  change
    genericTensorTowerSecondComponentMap
        (K := K₀) (F := K₁) (F' := F) (L := L) m
        (genericTensorRefineChosenComponentMap
          (K₀ := K₀) (K₁ := K₁) (F := F) (L := L) n z) = 0 ↔
      z ∈ m
  rw [hcomp]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem
statement:
private theorem prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem
    {A : Type uA} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] {t : A} (ht : Prime t) (htP : t ∈ P) :
    Prime (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) t)
proof:
:= by
  rcases prime_or_isUnit_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime P ht with
    hprime | hunit
  · exact hprime
  · have htCompl : t ∈ P.primeCompl :=
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff
        (Localization.AtPrime P) P t).mp hunit
    exact (htCompl htP).elim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_dvd_splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisIndex_at_largerPrime
statement:
theorem
    localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_dvd_splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisIndex_at_largerPrime
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (j : Fin d) (hj : j.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (htjP : t j ∈ P) :
    let p₀
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)
    letI : p₀.IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj)
    let R := Localization.AtPrime P
    letI : Algebra R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    letI : Algebra R L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI : IsScalarTower R K L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI : IsFractionRing R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
    let pR := p₀.map (algebraMap A R)
    letI : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P
      (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htjP)
    let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
    letI : Algebra V K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
    letI : Algebra V L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) pR
    letI : IsScalarTower V K L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) pR
    let C := integralClosure V L
    ∀ Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C,
      Q.1.ramificationIdx V ∣
        splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j := by
  dsimp only
  let p₀ := Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)
  let : p₀.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj)
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : Algebra R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : Algebra R L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower R K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
  let pR := p₀.map (algebraMap A R)
  let : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P
    (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htjP)
  let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) pR
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) pR
  let C := integralClosure V L
  have hp₀ : p₀.height = 1 :=
    Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj).ne_zero)
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj).not_isUnit
  have hp₀P : p₀ ≤ P := P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htjP
  intro Q
  rw [localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_galoisBranchIndex_at_largerPrime
    (K := K) (L := L) p₀ P hp₀ hp₀P Q]
  rw [splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_eq
    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j hj]
  exact dvd_rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.charZero_twiceLocalized_splitStrictNormalCrossingsBranchResidue
statement:
theorem
    charZero_twiceLocalized_splitStrictNormalCrossingsBranchResidue
    {A : Type uA} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (j : Fin d) (hj : j.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (htjP : t j ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A))) :
    let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
    let p := algebraMap A R (t j)
    let hp : Prime p :=
      prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem P
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj) htjP
    let pR := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    letI : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
    CharZero (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) := by
  dsimp only
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let p : R := algebraMap A R (t j)

    prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem P
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj) htjP
  let pR := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
  let : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
  let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
  let : CharZero (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)) :=
    charZero_quotient_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime P
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj) htjP hCharZero
  let pV : V := algebraMap R V p
  let : CharZero (V ⧸ Ideal.span ({pV} : Set V)) :=
    charZero_quotient_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime pR hp
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self p) inferInstance
  have hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V =
      Ideal.span ({pV} : Set V) :=
    localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span pR p rfl
  rw [hmax]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.chosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
statement:
private theorem chosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
    {V : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {F : Type uD}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Field F] [Algebra V F] [FaithfulSMul V F] :
    letI : Algebra K F
proof:
:=
      chosenFractionFieldToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (F := F)
    IsScalarTower V K F := by
  let : Algebra K F :=
    chosenFractionFieldToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (F := F)
  let : Algebra (FractionRing V) F := FractionRing.liftAlgebra V F
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro x
  change algebraMap V F x =
    algebraMap (FractionRing V) F
      ((FractionRing.algEquiv V K).symm (algebraMap V K x))
  rw [← (FractionRing.algEquiv V K).commutes x,
    (FractionRing.algEquiv V K).symm_apply_apply]
  exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V (FractionRing V) F x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisSingleRootCover_geometry
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisSingleRootCover_geometry
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (j : Fin d) (hj : j.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htjP : t j ∈ P) :
    let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
    let p := algebraMap A R (t j)
    let N := splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j
    let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C p
    let S := AdjoinRoot g
    IsRegularLocalRing S ∧ IsDomain S ∧
      ringKrullDim S = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      Prime (AdjoinRoot.root g) ∧
      IsDomain (S ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root g} : Set S)) ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing
        (S ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root g} : Set S)) := by
  dsimp only
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let p : R := algebraMap A R (t j)
  have hp : Prime p :=
    prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem_active P
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj) htjP
  have hdimR : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim R = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P R
      _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hP
  obtain ⟨z, hreg, hgen⟩ :=
    exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings
      hNC j hj P hP htjP
  have hquot : IsRegularLocalRing
      (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)) :=
    (quotient_geometry_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen (p := p)
      (by simp [p, R])).2
  exact heightTwoPrimeRootCover_geometry
    (splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j) hp hquot hdimR

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
statement:
theorem
    integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (j : Fin d) (hj : j.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htjP : t j ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A))) :
    let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
    let p := algebraMap A R (t j)
    let N := splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j
    let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C p
    let S := AdjoinRoot g
    let qS := Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root g} : Set S)
    let hgeometryS :=
      splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisSingleRootCover_geometry
        (K := K) (L := L) hNC j hj P hP htjP
    letI : IsRegularLocalRing S := hgeometryS.1
    letI : IsDomain S := hgeometryS.2.1
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
      SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
        hgeometryS.2.2.1
    letI : qS.IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hgeometryS.2.2.2.1
    let pR := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let hp : Prime p :=
      prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem_active P
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj) htjP
    letI : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    letI : qS.LiesOver pR :=
      span_root_liesOver_span_radicand
        (splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j) hp
    let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
    let W := Localization.AtPrime qS
    letI : Algebra V W := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver pR qS
    letI : Module.Free R S :=
      (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C p
        (splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j).ne').free_adjoinRoot
    letI : FaithfulSMul R S := inferInstance
    letI : Algebra R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    letI : IsFractionRing R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
    letI : Algebra V K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
    letI : IsFractionRing V K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) pR
    ∀ {D : Type uD} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsIntegrallyClosed D]
      [Algebra R D] [Algebra S D] [IsScalarTower R S D]
      [FaithfulSMul S D] [Module.Finite S D]
      (qD : Ideal D) [qD.IsPrime] [qD.LiesOver qS],
      let F := FractionRing D
      letI : FaithfulSMul R D := FaithfulSMul.trans R S D
      letI : FaithfulSMul R F := FaithfulSMul.trans R D F
      letI : Algebra K F :=
        chosenFractionFieldToExtensionAlgebra (V := R) (K := K) (F := F)
      letI : IsScalarTower R K F :=
        chosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
          (V := R) (K := K) (F := F)
      ∀ (m : Ideal (F ⊗[K] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
        letI : m.IsMaximal := hm
        let B := Localization.AtPrime qD
        let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
        letI : Algebra B M :=
          genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := B) m
        Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure B M) := by
  dsimp only
  classical
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : IsRegularLocalRing R := inferInstance
  have hdimR : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim R = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P R
      _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hP
  let : IsRegularRing R :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two hdimR
  let p : R := algebraMap A R (t j)
  have hp : Prime p :=
    prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem_active P
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj) htjP
  let : Fact (Prime p) := ⟨hp⟩
  let N := splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j
  have hN : 0 < N :=
    splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j
  let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C p
  let S := AdjoinRoot g
  let qS := Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root g} : Set S)
  have hgeometryS :=
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisSingleRootCover_geometry
      (K := K) (L := L) hNC j hj P hP htjP
  let : IsRegularLocalRing S := hgeometryS.1
  let : IsDomain S := hgeometryS.2.1
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      hgeometryS.2.2.1
  let : qS.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hgeometryS.2.2.2.1
  let pR := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
  let : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
  let : qS.LiesOver pR :=
    span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hp
  let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
  let W := Localization.AtPrime qS
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtSpan_of_prime
      R p hp
  let : Algebra V W := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver pR qS
  let : IsDomain W :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrime_isDomain hN hp
  let pV : V := algebraMap R V p
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C pV)
  let eLocal : Rn ≃ₐ[V] W :=
    adjoinRootLocalizationAtRootPrimeAlgEquiv hN hp
  let : Module.Free V Rn :=
    (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C pV hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Free V W := Module.Free.of_equiv eLocal.toLinearEquiv
  let K₀ := FractionRing V
  let Kroot := FractionRing W
  let : FaithfulSMul V W := inferInstance
  let : FaithfulSMul V Kroot := FaithfulSMul.trans V W Kroot
  let : Algebra K₀ Kroot := FractionRing.liftAlgebra V Kroot
  let : IsScalarTower V K₀ Kroot :=
    FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra V Kroot
  let : Algebra R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : Algebra R L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower R K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) pR
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) pR
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) pR
  let Cnorm := integralClosure V L
  let : IsFractionRing Cnorm L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension V K L Cnorm
  let : IsDedekindDomain Cnorm :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain V K L Cnorm
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree V L :=
    Module.IsTorsionFree.trans_faithfulSMul V K L
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree V Cnorm := by
    exact IsIntegralClosure.isTorsionFree V (A := Cnorm) L
  let : Module.Finite V Cnorm :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite V K L Cnorm
  let : Algebra K₀ K := FractionRing.liftAlgebra V K
  let : IsScalarTower V K₀ K :=
    FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra K₀ L :=
    fractionRingToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  let : IsScalarTower K₀ K L :=
    fractionRingToChosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  let : IsScalarTower V K₀ L :=
    fractionRingToExtension_isScalarTower (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  let : FiniteDimensional K₀ L :=
    fractionRingToExtension_finiteDimensional
      (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable K₀ L :=
    fractionRingToExtension_isSeparable (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  have hbranch :=
    localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_dvd_splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisIndex_at_largerPrime
      (K := K) (L := L) hNC j hj P htjP
  have hdiv : ∀ Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver Cnorm,
      Q.1.ramificationIdx V ∣ N := by
    let p₀ := Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)
    let : p₀.IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj)
    have hp₀P : p₀ ≤ P := P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htjP
    let IMap : PrimeSpectrum R :=
      ⟨p₀.map (algebraMap A R),
        Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hp₀P⟩
    let ISpan : PrimeSpectrum R := ⟨pR, inferInstance⟩
    have hI : IMap = ISpan := by
      apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
      dsimp only [IMap, ISpan, p₀, pR, p]
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    have hsource :
        localNormalizationRamificationDividesAtPrimeSpectrum
          (K := K) (L := L) IMap N := by
      simpa only [localNormalizationRamificationDividesAtPrimeSpectrum,
        IMap, p₀, R] using
        hbranch
    rw [hI] at hsource
    simpa only [localNormalizationRamificationDividesAtPrimeSpectrum,
      ISpan, V, Cnorm] using hsource
  have hCharZeroV : CharZero (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) := by
    simpa only [R, p, pR, V] using
      (charZero_twiceLocalized_splitStrictNormalCrossingsBranchResidue
        hNC j hj P htjP hCharZero)
  intro D _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ qD _ _
  let F := FractionRing D
  let : Module.Free R S :=
    (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C p hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
  let : FaithfulSMul R S := inferInstance
  let : FaithfulSMul R D := FaithfulSMul.trans R S D
  let : FaithfulSMul R F := FaithfulSMul.trans R D F
  let : Algebra K F :=
    chosenFractionFieldToExtensionAlgebra (V := R) (K := K) (F := F)
  let : IsScalarTower R K F :=
    chosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (V := R) (K := K) (F := F)
  let : Algebra V F :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra
      (A := R) (K := K) (L := F) pR
  let : IsScalarTower V K F :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (A := R) (K := K) (L := F) pR
  let : IsScalarTower R V F :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
      (A := R) (K := K) (L := F) pR
  let : IsScalarTower R S F := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    change algebraMap R F x =
      algebraMap D F (algebraMap S D (algebraMap R S x))
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S D]
    rfl
  let : Algebra (FractionRing S) F :=
    finiteExtensionFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D)
  let : IsScalarTower S (FractionRing S) F :=
    FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra S F
  let : Algebra W F :=
    finiteExtensionAtPrimeToFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) qS
  let : IsScalarTower S W F :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
      (A := S) (K := FractionRing S) (L := F) qS
  let : IsScalarTower R W F := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    calc
      algebraMap R F x = algebraMap S F (algebraMap R S x) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S F x
      _ = algebraMap W F (algebraMap S W (algebraMap R S x)) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S W F (algebraMap R S x)
      _ = algebraMap W F (algebraMap R W x) := by
        rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S W]
  let : IsScalarTower V W F := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext pR.primeCompl
    ext x
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R V F,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R V W,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R W F]
  let : Algebra K₀ F :=
    fractionRingToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (L := F)
  let : IsScalarTower K₀ K F :=
    fractionRingToChosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (V := V) (K := K) (L := F)
  let : IsScalarTower V K₀ F :=
    fractionRingToExtension_isScalarTower (V := V) (K := K) (L := F)
  let : Algebra Kroot F :=
    finiteExtensionAtPrimeFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) qS
  let : IsScalarTower W Kroot F :=
    finiteExtensionAtPrime_literalFractionRingTower
      (S := S) (D := D) qS
  let : IsScalarTower V Kroot F := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    change algebraMap V F x =
      algebraMap Kroot F (algebraMap V Kroot x)
    calc
      algebraMap V F x = algebraMap W F (algebraMap V W x) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V W F x
      _ = algebraMap Kroot F (algebraMap W Kroot (algebraMap V W x)) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply W Kroot F (algebraMap V W x)
      _ = algebraMap Kroot F (algebraMap V Kroot x) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V W Kroot]
  let : IsScalarTower K₀ Kroot F := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (nonZeroDivisors V)
    ext x
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V K₀ F,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V K₀ Kroot,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V Kroot F]
  let : FiniteDimensional Kroot F :=
    finiteExtensionAtPrime_fractionRing_finiteDimensional
      (S := S) (D := D) qS
  let B := Localization.AtPrime qD
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed B :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization B qD.primeCompl
      qD.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  let : Algebra W B := finiteLiesOverLocalizationAlgebra qS qD
  let : Algebra B F :=
    finiteLiesOverLocalizationToFractionRingAlgebra qD
  let : IsFractionRing B F :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := F) qD
  let : IsScalarTower W B F :=
    finiteLiesOverLocalization_fractionRingTower qS qD
  intro m hm
  exact
    integralClosure_selectedRootPrime_genericTensorTowerComponent_etale_of_ramification_dvd
      (R := R) (N := N) (p := p) hdimR hN
      (C := Cnorm) (L := L) hdiv hCharZeroV
      (K₁ := K) (B := B) (K' := F) m hm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_fullRootCover_heightOnePrime_contraction_trichotomy
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_fullRootCover_heightOnePrime_contraction_trichotomy
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (e : Fin d → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, 0 < e k)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),
      let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a : Fin d → R :=
        heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
      let D := AdjoinRoot F
      (IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
        Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
        IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B))) ∧
      (∀ k, 0 < n k) ∧
      ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      (IsRegularLocalRing D ∧ IsDomain D ∧
        ringKrullDim D = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        Prime (AdjoinRoot.root F) ∧
        IsDomain (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D))) ∧
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime], q.height = 1 →
        let qB := q.under B
        qB.IsPrime ∧ qB.height = 1 ∧
          (qB = Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B) ∨
            (∃ k : Fin d,
              (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r ∧
              t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P ∧
              n k = e (σ k) ∧
              Prime (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k) ∧
              qB = Ideal.span
                ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B)) ∨
            Disjoint
              (((Submonoid.powers
                (algebraMap R B (algebraMap A R f)) : Submonoid B) : Set B))
              (qB : Set B)) := by
  classical
  rcases
      splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_conditionalRootCover_heightOnePrime_trichotomy
        hNC i hi P hP htiP e he with
    ⟨σ, hgeometryB, hn, hdimB, htrichotomyB⟩
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
  let a : Fin d → R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
  let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
  let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let D := AdjoinRoot F
  let : IsRegularLocalRing B := hgeometryB.1
  let : IsDomain B := hgeometryB.2.1
  have hintegrallyClosedB : IsIntegrallyClosed B :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      hdimB
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed B := hintegrallyClosedB
  have hgeometryD :
      IsRegularLocalRing D ∧ IsDomain D ∧
        ringKrullDim D = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        Prime (AdjoinRoot.root F) ∧
        IsDomain (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D)) := by
    simpa only [D, F] using
      (heightTwoPrimeRootCover_geometry hN hgeometryB.2.2.1
        hgeometryB.2.2.2.2 hdimB)
  let : IsRegularLocalRing D := hgeometryD.1
  let : IsDomain D := hgeometryD.2.1
  have hmonicF : F.Monic := by
    simpa only [F] using
      (monic_X_pow_sub_C (algebraMap R B y) hN.ne')
  let : Module.Finite B D := by
    simpa only [D] using hmonicF.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral B D := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite B D
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D := by
    simpa only [D, F] using
      (faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN (algebraMap R B y))
  refine ⟨σ, hgeometryB, hn, hdimB, hgeometryD, ?_⟩
  intro q _ hqHeight
  have hqUnderHeight : (q.under B).height = 1 := by
    rw [← SpecialLocalPurity.height_eq_height_under_of_faithfully_integral_over_integrallyClosed
      q]
    exact hqHeight
  have hqUnderPrime : (q.under B).IsPrime := inferInstance
  exact ⟨hqUnderPrime, hqUnderHeight,
    htrichotomyB (q.under B) hqUnderHeight⟩

statement:
theorem
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisFullRootCover_heightOnePrime_contraction_trichotomy
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P) :
    let e
proof:
:= heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    let N := heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),
      let R := Localization.AtPrime P
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a : Fin d → R :=
        heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
      let D := AdjoinRoot F
      (IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
        Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
        IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B))) ∧
      (∀ k, 0 < n k) ∧
      ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      (IsRegularLocalRing D ∧ IsDomain D ∧
        ringKrullDim D = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        Prime (AdjoinRoot.root F) ∧
        IsDomain (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D))) ∧
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime], q.height = 1 →
        let qB := q.under B
        qB.IsPrime ∧ qB.height = 1 ∧
          (qB = Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B) ∨
            (∃ k : Fin d,
              (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r ∧
              t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P ∧
              n k = e (σ k) ∧
              Prime (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k) ∧
              qB = Ideal.span
                ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B)) ∨
            Disjoint
              (((Submonoid.powers
                (algebraMap R B (algebraMap A R f)) : Submonoid B) : Set B))
              (qB : Set B)) := by
  dsimp only
  exact
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_fullRootCover_heightOnePrime_contraction_trichotomy
      hNC i hi P hP htiP
        (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i)
        (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i)
        (heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i)
        (heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i)

proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal S := I.map (algebraMap R S)
  have hunder : J.under R = I := by
    exact Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat (B := S) I
  let : CharZero (R ⧸ J.under R) := by
    rw [hunder]

  have htarget : CharZero (S ⧸ J) :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap
      (Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_injective (R := R) (A := S) (I := J))
