theorem charZero_quotient_iteratedRadicalRoot
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin s → ℕ) (a : Fin s → A)
    (hn : ∀ j, 0 < n j)
    [IsDomain (iteratedRadical A s n a)]
    (k : Fin s) (haPrime : Prime (a k))
    (hrootPrime : Prime (iteratedRadicalRoot A n a k))
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({a k} : Set A))) :
    CharZero
      (iteratedRadical A s n a ⧸
        Ideal.span
          ({iteratedRadicalRoot A n a k} :
            Set (iteratedRadical A s n a)))
proof:
:= by
  let B := iteratedRadical A s n a
  let root : B := iteratedRadicalRoot A n a k
  let Q : Ideal B := Ideal.span {root}
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite A B
  let : Q.IsPrime := by
    exact Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hrootPrime
  have hqHeight : Q.height = 1 := by
    exact Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hrootPrime.ne_zero)
      hrootPrime.not_isUnit
  have hrootMem : iteratedRadicalRoot A n a k ∈ Q := by
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  have hunder : Q.under A = Ideal.span ({a k} : Set A) := by
    exact under_eq_span_radicand_of_height_eq_one_of_iteratedRadicalRoot_mem
      n a hn Q hqHeight k haPrime hrootMem
  have hCharUnder : CharZero (A ⧸ Q.under A) := by
    rw [hunder]
    exact hCharZero
  have htarget : CharZero (B ⧸ Q) :=
    charZero_quotient_of_charZero_under Q hCharUnder
  simpa only [B, Q, root] using htarget

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_fullRootCover_heightOnePrime_trichotomy_charZero
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_fullRootCover_heightOnePrime_trichotomy_charZero
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (hCharZero : ∀ j : Fin (d + 1), j.1 < r →
      CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)))
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (e : Fin d → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, 0 < e k)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),
      let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a : Fin d → R :=
        heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
      let D := AdjoinRoot F
      (IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
        Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
        IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B))) ∧
      (∀ k, 0 < n k) ∧
      ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      CharZero (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
      (IsRegularLocalRing D ∧ IsDomain D ∧
        ringKrullDim D = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        Prime (AdjoinRoot.root F) ∧
        IsDomain (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D))) ∧
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime], q.height = 1 →
        (q.under B).IsPrime ∧ (q.under B).height = 1 ∧
          ((q = Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D) ∧
              CharZero (D ⧸ q) ∧
              CharZero
                (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
                  maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))) ∨
            (∃ k : Fin d,
              (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r ∧
              t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P ∧
              n k = e (σ k) ∧
              Prime (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k) ∧
              CharZero
                (B ⧸ Ideal.span
                  ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B)) ∧
              q.under B = Ideal.span
                ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B) ∧
              CharZero (D ⧸ q) ∧
              CharZero
                (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
                  maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))) ∨
            Disjoint
              (((Submonoid.powers
                (algebraMap R B (algebraMap A R f)) : Submonoid B) : Set B))
              (q.under B : Set B)) := by
  classical
  rcases
      splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_fullRootCover_heightOnePrime_contraction_trichotomy
        hNC i hi P hP htiP e he N hN with
    ⟨σ, hgeometryB, hn, hdimB, hgeometryD, htrichotomy⟩
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
  let a : Fin d → R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
  let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
  let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let D := AdjoinRoot F
  let : IsDomain B := hgeometryB.2.1
  let : IsDomain D := hgeometryD.2.1
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B := faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  have hCharSelectedR :
      CharZero (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)) := by
    simpa only [R, y] using
      (charZero_quotient_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime P
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi) htiP (hCharZero i hi))
  have hCharSelectedB :
      CharZero (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) := by
    have hmap := charZero_quotient_map_of_faithfullyFlat
      (S := B) (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)) hCharSelectedR
    have hmapIdeal :
        (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)).map (algebraMap R B) =
          Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B) := by
      simp [Ideal.map_span]
    rw [← hmapIdeal]
    exact hmap
  refine ⟨σ, hgeometryB, hn, hdimB, hCharSelectedB, hgeometryD, ?_⟩
  intro q _ hqHeight
  rcases htrichotomy q hqHeight with
    ⟨hqUnderPrime, hqUnderHeight, hselected | hother | haway⟩
  · have hqEq : q = Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D) := by
      simpa only [F, D] using
        (heightOnePrime_eq_span_root_of_under_eq_span_radicand
          hgeometryD.2.2.2.1 q hqHeight hselected)
    have hCharUnder : CharZero (B ⧸ q.under B) := by
      rw [hselected]
      exact hCharSelectedB
    have hCharQ : CharZero (D ⧸ q) :=
      charZero_quotient_of_charZero_under q hCharUnder
    have hCharLocal :
        CharZero
          (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
            maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) :=
      charZero_localizationAtPrime_quotient_maximalIdeal q hCharQ
    exact ⟨hqUnderPrime, hqUnderHeight,
      Or.inl ⟨hqEq, hCharQ, hCharLocal⟩⟩
  · rcases hother with
      ⟨k, hkActive, htkP, hnk, hrootPrime, hunder⟩
    let j : Fin (d + 1) := i.succAbove (σ k)
    have htPrime : Prime (t j) := hNC.2.2.2.1 j hkActive
    have haPrime : Prime (a k) := by
      rcases prime_or_isUnit_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime P htPrime with
        hprime | hunit
      · change Prime (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t j))
        exact hprime
      · have htCompl : t j ∈ P.primeCompl :=
          (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff
            (Localization.AtPrime P) P (t j)).mp hunit
        exact (htCompl htkP).elim
    have hCharRadicandR :
        CharZero (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({a k} : Set R)) := by
      change CharZero
        (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸
          Ideal.span
            ({algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t j)} :
              Set (Localization.AtPrime P)))
      exact charZero_quotient_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime P
        htPrime htkP (hCharZero j hkActive)
    have hCharRootB :
        CharZero
          (B ⧸ Ideal.span
            ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B)) :=
      charZero_quotient_iteratedRadicalRoot n a hn k haPrime
        hrootPrime hCharRadicandR
    have hCharUnder : CharZero (B ⧸ q.under B) := by
      rw [hunder]
      exact hCharRootB
    have hCharQ : CharZero (D ⧸ q) :=
      charZero_quotient_of_charZero_under q hCharUnder
    have hCharLocal :
        CharZero
          (Localization.AtPrime q ⧸
            maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) :=
      charZero_localizationAtPrime_quotient_maximalIdeal q hCharQ
    exact ⟨hqUnderPrime, hqUnderHeight, Or.inr (Or.inl
      ⟨k, hkActive, htkP, hnk, hrootPrime, hCharRootB, hunder,
        hCharQ, hCharLocal⟩)⟩
  · exact ⟨hqUnderPrime, hqUnderHeight, Or.inr (Or.inr haway)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fullRootCover_actualRoot_prime_of_regular_pair
statement:
theorem fullRootCover_actualRoot_prime_of_regular_pair
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 1) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1)
    (hnk : 0 < n k) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [y, a k])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, a k] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    Prime
      (algebraMap B (AdjoinRoot F)
        (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k)) := by
  dsimp only
  let n₁ : Fin 1 → ℕ := fun _ ↦ N
  let a₁ : Fin 1 → R := fun _ ↦ y
  let Y := iteratedRadical R 1 n₁ a₁
  let py : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
  let Yroot := AdjoinRoot py
  have hgeometryY :=
    oneRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry hN hreg hgen
  have hother₁ : ∀ l : Fin 1, l ≠ (0 : Fin 1) → n₁ l = 1 := by
    intro l hl
    exact (hl (Subsingleton.elim l 0)).elim
  let eY : Y ≃ₐ[R] Yroot :=
    iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv n₁ a₁ 0 hother₁
  have hdomainY : IsDomain Y := by
    simpa only [Y, n₁, a₁] using hgeometryY.2.1
  let : IsDomain Y := hdomainY
  let : IsDomain Yroot := eY.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain Y
  have haPrimeY : Prime (algebraMap R Yroot (a k)) := by
    rw [← eY.commutes]
    apply (MulEquiv.prime_iff eY).mpr
    simpa only [Y, n₁, a₁] using hgeometryY.2.2.1
  let B := iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let G : Yroot[X] := X ^ n k - C (algebraMap R Yroot (a k))
  have hrootPrime : Prime (AdjoinRoot.root G) := by
    exact prime_adjoinRoot_root_of_prime hnk haPrimeY
  let eD : AdjoinRoot F ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot G :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootLastAlgEquiv n a k hother N y
  apply (MulEquiv.prime_iff eD).mp
  rw [fullRootCoverActualRootLastAlgEquiv_algebraMap_root]
  exact hrootPrime

statement:
theorem heightOnePrime_eq_span_fullRootCover_actualRoot_of_regular_pair
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 1) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1)
    (hnk : 0 < n k) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [y, a k])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, a k] = maximalIdeal R) :

proof:
:= iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let D := AdjoinRoot F
    ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime] [IsDomain D], q.height = 1 →
      q.under B = Ideal.span
        ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B) →
      q = Ideal.span
        ({algebraMap B D (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k)} : Set D) := by
  dsimp only
  intro q _ _ hqHeight hunder
  have hrootPrime :=
    fullRootCover_actualRoot_prime_of_regular_pair
      n a k hother hnk hN hreg hgen
  have hrootMem :
      algebraMap (iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a)
          (AdjoinRoot
            (X ^ N - C
              (algebraMap R (iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a) y)))
          (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k) ∈ q := by
    change iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k ∈
      q.under (iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a)
    rw [hunder]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  exact q.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one
    hqHeight hrootMem hrootPrime

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fullRootCoverActualRootLastAlgEquiv_map_actualRoot_span
statement:
theorem fullRootCoverActualRootLastAlgEquiv_map_actualRoot_span
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 1) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (y : R) :

proof:
:= iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let py : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
    let Yroot := AdjoinRoot py
    let G : Yroot[X] := X ^ n k - C (algebraMap R Yroot (a k))
    (Ideal.span
      ({(algebraMap B (AdjoinRoot F)
        (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k))} : Set (AdjoinRoot F))).map
        (fullRootCoverActualRootLastAlgEquiv
          n a k hother N y).toRingEquiv =
      Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root G} : Set (AdjoinRoot G)) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [Ideal.map_span]
  simp only [Set.image_singleton]
  let eD := fullRootCoverActualRootLastAlgEquiv n a k hother N y
  change Ideal.span
      ({(eD
        (algebraMap (iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a)
          (AdjoinRoot
            (X ^ N - C
              (algebraMap R (iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a) y)))
          (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k)))} :
        Set (AdjoinRoot
          (X ^ n k - C

proof:
:= X ^ N - C y
    let Yroot := AdjoinRoot py

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisFullRootCover_actualRoot_prime
statement:
theorem
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisFullRootCover_actualRoot_prime
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {s r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (s + 2) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (s + 2))
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s + 1))) (k : Fin (s + 1))
    (hkActive : (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r)
    (htkP : t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P) :
    let e
proof:
:= heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    let N := heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    let R := Localization.AtPrime P
    let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
    let a : Fin (s + 1) → R :=
      heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
    let B := iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    Prime
      (algebraMap B (AdjoinRoot F)
        (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k)) := by
  dsimp only
  classical
  let e := heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
  let N := heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
  let a : Fin (s + 1) → R :=
    heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
  let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
  let j : Fin (s + 2) := i.succAbove (σ k)
  have hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1 :=
    heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_eq_one_of_ne_actual
      hNC i P hP htiP e σ k hkActive htkP
  have hnk : 0 < n k := by
    change 0 < if (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r ∧
      t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P then e (σ k) else 1
    rw [ite_eq_left ⟨hkActive, htkP⟩]
    exact heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i (σ k)
  have hN : 0 < N :=
    heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
  have hij : i ≠ j := (Fin.succAbove_ne i (σ k)).symm
  have hpair :=
    regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_two_splitStrictNormalCrossingsParameters
      hNC i j hij P hP htiP htkP
  have hreg : IsRegular R [y, a k] := by
    simpa only [R, y, a, heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand, j] using
      hpair.1
  have hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, a k] = maximalIdeal R := by
    simpa only [R, y, a, heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand, j] using
      hpair.2
  exact fullRootCover_actualRoot_prime_of_regular_pair
    n a k hother hnk hN hreg hgen

statement:

          (AdjoinRoot
            (X ^ (heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
                    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i) -
              C (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P)
                (iteratedRadical (Localization.AtPrime P) (s + 1)
                  (heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P
                    (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
                      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i) σ)
                  (heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ))
                (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t i)))))
          (iteratedRadicalRoot (Localization.AtPrime P)
            (heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P
              (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
                (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i) σ)
            (heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ) k) ∈ q := by

        (heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ) k ∈

        (iteratedRadical (Localization.AtPrime P) (s + 1)

            (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
              (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i) σ)

private theorem restrictScalars_trans_algebraMap
    {R T U V : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing T] [CommRing U] [CommRing V]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv_apply_step
statement:
private theorem iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv_apply_step
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {r : ℕ}
    (n : Fin (r + 2) → ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 2) → R)
    (htail : ∀ i : Fin (r + 1), n i.succ = 1)
    (htailInit : ∀ i : Fin r, (Fin.init n) i.succ = 1)
    (z : iteratedRadical R (r + 1) (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)) :
    iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv n a htail
      (AdjoinRoot.of
        (X ^ n (Fin.last (r + 1)) -
          C (algebraMap R
            (iteratedRadical R (r + 1) (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a))
              (a (Fin.last (r + 1))))) z) =
        iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) htailInit z
proof:
:= by
  let T : CommAlgCat R :=
    iteratedRadical R (r + 1) (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
  let c : T := algebraMap R T (a (Fin.last (r + 1)))
  let f : T[X] := X ^ n (Fin.last (r + 1)) - C c
  have hlast : n (Fin.last (r + 1)) = 1 := by
    simpa only [Fin.succ_last] using htail (Fin.last r)
  have hf : f = X ^ 1 - C c := by
    simp only [f, hlast]
  let eT : AdjoinRoot f ≃ₐ[T] T :=
    (AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq T f (X ^ 1 - C c) hf).trans
      (adjoinRootOneAlgEquiv c)
  change ((eT.restrictScalars R).trans
    (iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) htailInit))
      (algebraMap T (AdjoinRoot f) z) = _
  exact restrictScalars_trans_algebraMap eT
    (iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) htailInit) z

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv_apply_root_zero
statement:
private theorem iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv_apply_root_zero
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] :
    {r : ℕ} → (n : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ) → (a : Fin (r + 1) → R) →
      (htail : ∀ i : Fin r, n i.succ = 1) →
      iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv n a htail
          (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a 0) =
        iteratedRadicalRoot R (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ n 0) (fun _ ↦ a 0) 0
  | 0, n, a, htail => by
      rfl
  | r + 1, n, a, htail => by
      let nInit : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ
proof:
:= Fin.init n
      let aInit : Fin (r + 1) → R := Fin.init a
      let T : CommAlgCat R := iteratedRadical R (r + 1) nInit aInit
      let f : T[X] := X ^ n (Fin.last (r + 1)) -
        C (algebraMap R T (a (Fin.last (r + 1))))
      have htailInit : ∀ i : Fin r, (Fin.init n) i.succ = 1 := by
        intro i
        change n i.succ.castSucc = 1
        convert htail i.castSucc using 1
        apply congrArg n
        ext
        rfl
      have hrootStep :
          iteratedRadicalRoot R n a 0 =
            algebraMap T (AdjoinRoot f)
              (iteratedRadicalRoot R nInit aInit 0) := by
        change iteratedRadicalRoot R n a
            ((0 : Fin (r + 1)).castSucc) = _
        exact iteratedRadicalRoot_castSucc n a (0 : Fin (r + 1))
      rw [hrootStep]
      exact (iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv_apply_step n a htail htailInit
        (iteratedRadicalRoot R nInit aInit 0)).trans
          (iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv_apply_root_zero nInit aInit htailInit)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_conditionalRootCover_heightOnePrime_trichotomy
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_conditionalRootCover_heightOnePrime_trichotomy
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (e : Fin d → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, 0 < e k) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),
      let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a : Fin d → R :=
        heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      (IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧ Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
        IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B))) ∧
      (∀ k, 0 < n k) ∧
      ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      ∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime], q.height = 1 →
        q = Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B) ∨
          (∃ k : Fin d,
            (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r ∧
            t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P ∧
            n k = e (σ k) ∧
            Prime (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k) ∧
            q = Ideal.span ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B)) ∨
          Disjoint
            (((Submonoid.powers
              (algebraMap R B (algebraMap A R f)) : Submonoid B) : Set B))
            (q : Set B) := by
  classical
  rcases splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_branchSupport
      hNC i P hP htiP with hsolo | htwo
  · let σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d) := Equiv.refl _
    let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
    let a := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
    have hall : ∀ k, n k = 1 := by
      intro k
      rw [show n k = if (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r ∧
          t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P then e (σ k) else 1 by rfl]
      rw [ite_eq_right]
      intro hk
      exact Fin.succAbove_ne i (σ k)
        (hsolo (i.succAbove (σ k)) hk.1 hk.2)
    obtain ⟨z, hreg, hgen⟩ :=
      exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings
        hNC i hi P hP htiP
    have hgeometry :=
      allOneRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry n a hall hreg hgen
    have hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k := fun k ↦ by simp [hall k]
    let R := Localization.AtPrime P
    let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
    let coverEquiv : B ≃ₐ[R] R :=
      iteratedRadicalAllOneAlgEquiv n a hall
    have hdimR : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      calc
        ringKrullDim R = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
          IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P R
        _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
          congrArg (fun m : ℕ∞ ↦ (m : WithBot ℕ∞)) hP
    have hdimB : ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      (ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv coverEquiv.toRingEquiv).trans hdimR
    refine ⟨σ, hgeometry, hn, hdimB, ?_⟩
    let : IsDomain
        (iteratedRadical (Localization.AtPrime P) d n a) :=
      hgeometry.2.1
    intro q _ hqheight
    rcases splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_localizedBoundary_associated
        hNC i hi P hP htiP with hboundary | hboundary
    · have hboundaryB :=
        hboundary.map
          (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P)
            (iteratedRadical (Localization.AtPrime P) d n a))
      rcases heightOnePrime_eq_span_or_disjoint_powers_of_associated
          hgeometry.2.2.1 hboundaryB q hqheight with hselected | haway
      · exact Or.inl hselected
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr haway)
    · obtain ⟨j, hj, hji, htjP, _⟩ := hboundary
      exact (hji (hsolo j hj htjP)).elim
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, hji, htjP, hsupport⟩ := htwo
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hji
    cases d with
    | zero => exact Fin.elim0 k₀
    | succ d =>
      let σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1)) := Equiv.swap 0 k₀
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let R := Localization.AtPrime P
      let B := iteratedRadical R (d + 1) n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      have hσzero : σ 0 = k₀ := by simp [σ]
      have hindexZero : i.succAbove (σ 0) = j := by
        rw [hσzero]
        exact hk₀
      have hnZero : n 0 = e k₀ := by
        change (if (i.succAbove (σ 0)).1 < r ∧
            t (i.succAbove (σ 0)) ∈ P then e (σ 0) else 1) = e k₀
        rw [hσzero, hk₀, ite_eq_left ⟨hj, htjP⟩]
      have hnZeroPos : 0 < n 0 := by
        rw [hnZero]
        exact he k₀
      have htail : ∀ k : Fin d, n k.succ = 1 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : (i.succAbove (σ k.succ)).1 < r ∧
            t (i.succAbove (σ k.succ)) ∈ P
        · exfalso
          rcases hsupport (i.succAbove (σ k.succ)) hk.1 hk.2 with hik | hjk
          · exact Fin.succAbove_ne i (σ k.succ) hik
          · have hσk : σ k.succ = k₀ := by
              apply Fin.succAbove_right_injective
              exact hjk.trans hk₀.symm
            have hkzero : k.succ = (0 : Fin (d + 1)) :=
              σ.injective (hσk.trans hσzero.symm)
            exact Fin.succ_ne_zero k hkzero
        · simp [n, heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent, hk]
      have haZero : a 0 = algebraMap A R (t j) := by
        simp [a, heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand, R, hindexZero]
      have hpair :=
        regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_two_splitStrictNormalCrossingsParameters
          hNC j i hji P hP htjP htiP
      have hreg : IsRegular R [a 0, y] := by
        simpa [haZero, y, R] using hpair.1
      have hgen : Ideal.ofList [a 0, y] = maximalIdeal R := by
        simpa [haZero, y, R] using hpair.2
      have hgeometry :=
        oneRootWithTrivialTail_selectedDivisor_geometry
          n a htail hnZeroPos hreg hgen
      let n₁ : Fin 1 → ℕ := fun _ ↦ n 0
      let a₁ : Fin 1 → R := fun _ ↦ a 0
      let C := iteratedRadical R 1 n₁ a₁
      let tailEquiv : B ≃ₐ[R] C :=
        iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv n a htail
      have hregOne : IsRegular R (List.ofFn a₁ ++ [y]) := by
        change IsRegular R [a 0, y]
        exact hreg
      have hgenOne : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a₁ ++ [y]) =
          maximalIdeal R := by
        change Ideal.ofList [a 0, y] = maximalIdeal R
        exact hgen
      have hrootCPrime : Prime (iteratedRadicalRoot R n₁ a₁ 0) := by
        exact
          (iteratedRadicalRoot_geometry_of_regular_parameters
            n₁ a₁ [y] (fun _ ↦ hnZeroPos) hregOne hgenOne 0).1
      have hrootPrime : Prime (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a 0) := by
        apply (MulEquiv.prime_iff tailEquiv).mp
        rw [iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv_apply_root_zero]
        exact hrootCPrime
      have hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k := by
        intro k
        refine Fin.cases hnZeroPos (fun l ↦ ?_) k
        rw [htail]
        exact zero_lt_one
      have hdimC : ringKrullDim C = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        have hdim :=
          iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_length_eq_ringKrullDim
            n₁ a₁ [y] (fun _ ↦ hnZeroPos) hregOne hgenOne
        simpa [C, iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_length] using hdim
      have hdimB : ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        (ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv tailEquiv.toRingEquiv).trans hdimC
      refine ⟨σ, hgeometry, hn, hdimB, ?_⟩
      let : IsDomain B := hgeometry.2.1
      intro q _ hqheight
      rcases splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_localizedBoundary_associated
          hNC i hi P hP htiP with hboundary | hboundary
      · have hboundaryB := hboundary.map (algebraMap R B)
        rcases heightOnePrime_eq_span_or_disjoint_powers_of_associated
            hgeometry.2.2.1 hboundaryB q hqheight with hselected | haway
        · exact Or.inl hselected
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr haway)
      · obtain ⟨j', hj', hj'i, htj'P, hboundary⟩ := hboundary
        have hj'eq : j' = j := by
          rcases hsupport j' hj' htj'P with rfl | hj'eq
          · exact (hj'i rfl).elim
          · exact hj'eq
        subst j'
        have hboundaryB := hboundary.map (algebraMap R B)
        have hradicandRoot :
            algebraMap R B (algebraMap A R (t j)) =
              iteratedRadicalRoot R n a 0 ^ n 0 := by
          rw [← haZero, iteratedRadicalRoot_pow]
        rw [map_mul, hradicandRoot] at hboundaryB
        rcases
            heightOnePrime_eq_span_or_eq_span_or_disjoint_powers_of_associated_mul_pow
              hgeometry.2.2.1 hrootPrime hboundaryB q hqheight with
          hselected | hroot | haway
        · exact Or.inl hselected
        · right
          left
          refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_, ?_, hrootPrime, hroot⟩
          · simpa only [hindexZero] using hj
          · simpa only [hindexZero] using htjP
          · simpa only [hσzero] using hnZero
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr haway)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisIndex_at_largerPrime
statement:
theorem
    localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisIndex_at_largerPrime
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (j : Fin d) (hj : j.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (htjP : t j ∈ P) :
    let p₀
proof:
:= Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)
    letI : p₀.IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj)
    let R := Localization.AtPrime P
    letI : Algebra R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    letI : Algebra R L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI : IsScalarTower R K L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI : IsFractionRing R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
    let pR := p₀.map (algebraMap A R)
    letI : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P
      (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htjP)
    let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
    letI : Algebra V K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
    letI : Algebra V L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) pR
    letI : IsScalarTower V K L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) pR
    let C := integralClosure V L
    ∀ Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C,
      Q.1.ramificationIdx V =
        splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j := by
  dsimp only
  let p₀ := Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)
  let : p₀.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj)
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : Algebra R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : Algebra R L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower R K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
  let pR := p₀.map (algebraMap A R)
  let : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P
    (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htjP)
  let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) pR
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) pR
  let C := integralClosure V L
  have hp₀ : p₀.height = 1 :=
    Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj).ne_zero)
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj).not_isUnit
  have hp₀P : p₀ ≤ P := P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htjP
  intro Q
  rw [localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_galoisBranchIndex_at_largerPrime
    (K := K) (L := L) p₀ P hp₀ hp₀P Q]
  rw [splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_eq
    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j hj]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_completedChosenGenericComponent_completeDVF_ramificationIndex_eq
statement:
theorem exists_completedChosenGenericComponent_completeDVF_ramificationIndex_eq
    {V : Type uV} {C : Type uC} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CommRing C] [IsDedekindDomain C]

    [Module.IsTorsionFree V C] [Module.Finite V C]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Field L] [Algebra C L] [IsFractionRing C L]
    [Algebra V L] [IsScalarTower V C L]
    [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower V K L]
    (Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C)

proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K

    let Khat := standardDVFCompletionField V K

      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K

      (standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)).toSMul
    letI : IsScalarTower V K Khat :=
      standardDVFCompletion_isScalarTower (V := V) (K := K)
    letI : IsScalarTower V Vhat Khat :=
      standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower
        (V := V) (K := K)
    let hmax := standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K
    let hres := standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective V K
    let m := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
      (R := V) (R' := Vhat) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := Khat)
