name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadical_etale_of_exponents_radicands_isUnit
statement:
theorem iteratedRadical_etale_of_exponents_radicands_isUnit
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hnUnit : ∀ i, IsUnit (n i : A))
    (haUnit : ∀ i, IsUnit (a i)) :
    Algebra.Etale A (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      change Algebra.Etale A A
      infer_instance
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      have hPrefix : Algebra.Etale A T :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc)
          (fun i ↦ hnUnit i.castSucc)
          (fun i ↦ haUnit i.castSucc)
      let : Algebra.Etale A T := hPrefix
      have hnLast : IsUnit (n (Fin.last r) : T) := by
        simpa using
          (hnUnit (Fin.last r)).map (algebraMap A T)
      have haLast :
          IsUnit (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r))) :=
        (haUnit (Fin.last r)).map (algebraMap A T)
      have hFormal : Algebra.FormallyEtale T (AdjoinRoot f) := by
        exact formallyEtale_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
          (hn (Fin.last r)) hnLast haLast
      let : Algebra.Etale T (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        { formallyEtale := hFormal
          finitePresentation := inferInstance }
      change Algebra.Etale A (AdjoinRoot f)
      exact Algebra.Etale.comp A T (AdjoinRoot f)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand_isUnit_at_selectedBranch
statement:
theorem heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand_isUnit_at_selectedBranch
    {A : Type uA} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P) (sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) :
    let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
    let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
    let hy : Prime y :=
      prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem P
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi) htiP
    let pR := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)
    letI : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hy
    let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
    ∀ k,
      IsUnit (algebraMap R V
        (heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P sigma k)) := by
  dsimp only
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
  have hy : Prime y :=
    prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem P
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi) htiP
  let pR := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)
  let : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hy
  let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
  intro k
  let j : Fin (d + 1) := i.succAbove (sigma k)
  let aR : R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P sigma k
  by_cases htjP : t j ∈ P
  · have hij : i ≠ j := (Fin.succAbove_ne i (sigma k)).symm
    have hregular : IsRegular R [y, aR] := by
      simpa only [R, y, aR, j,
        heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand] using
        (regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_two_splitStrictNormalCrossingsParameters
          hNC i j hij P hP htiP htjP).1
    have hrel : IsRelPrime y aR :=
      (SpecialLocalPurity.regular_pair_nonzero_and_isRelPrime
        hregular).2.2
    have hyMem : y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff R P (t i)).mpr htiP
    have haNot : aR ∉ pR := by
      intro ha
      have hyDvd : y ∣ aR := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp ha
      have hyUnit : IsUnit y := hrel.isUnit_of_dvd hyDvd
      exact ((IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal).mpr hyUnit) hyMem
    exact
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff V pR aR).mpr haNot
  · have haRUnit : IsUnit aR := by
      change IsUnit (algebraMap A R (t j))
      exact
        (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff R P (t j)).mpr htjP
    exact haRUnit.map (algebraMap R V)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_isUnit_at_selectedBranch
statement:
theorem heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_isUnit_at_selectedBranch
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)))
    (sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) :
    let e
proof:
:= heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e sigma
    let R := Localization.AtPrime P
    let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
    let hy : Prime y :=
      prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem P
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi) htiP
    let pR := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)
    letI : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hy
    let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
    ∀ k, IsUnit (n k : V) := by
  dsimp only
  let e := heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
  let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e sigma
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
  have hy : Prime y :=
    prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem P
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi) htiP
  let pR := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)
  let : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hy
  let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
  let : CharZero (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) := by
    simpa only [R, y, pR, V] using
      (charZero_twiceLocalized_splitStrictNormalCrossingsBranchResidue
        hNC i hi P htiP hCharZero)
  have hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : (i.succAbove (sigma k)).1 < r ∧
        t (i.succAbove (sigma k)) ∈ P
    · simpa [n, e, heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent, hk] using
        (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i (sigma k))
    · simp [n, heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent, hk]
  intro k
  apply (IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (n k : V)).mp
  change ((n k : ℕ) :
    (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)) ≠ 0
  exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (hn k))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.heightTwoGaloisOtherRootPrefix_finiteEtale_at_selectedBranch
statement:
theorem heightTwoGaloisOtherRootPrefix_finiteEtale_at_selectedBranch
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)))
    (sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin d)) :
    let e
proof:
:= heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e sigma
    let R := Localization.AtPrime P
    letI : Algebra R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    letI : Algebra R L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI : IsScalarTower R K L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI : IsFractionRing R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
    let aR : Fin d → R :=
      heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P sigma
    let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
    let hy : Prime y :=
      prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem P
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi) htiP
    let pR := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)
    letI : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hy
    let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
    let aV : Fin d → V := fun k ↦ algebraMap R V (aR k)
    let E := iteratedRadical V d n aV
    Module.Finite V E ∧
      Module.FaithfullyFlat V E ∧ Algebra.Etale V E := by
  dsimp only
  let e := heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
  let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e sigma
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : Algebra R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : Algebra R L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower R K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
  let aR : Fin d → R :=
    heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P sigma
  let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
  have hy : Prime y :=
    prime_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_mem P
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi) htiP
  let pR := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)
  let : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hy
  let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
  let aV : Fin d → V := fun k ↦ algebraMap R V (aR k)
  let E := iteratedRadical V d n aV
  have hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : (i.succAbove (sigma k)).1 < r ∧
        t (i.succAbove (sigma k)) ∈ P
    · simpa [n, e, heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent, hk] using
        (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i (sigma k))
    · simp [n, heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent, hk]
  have hnUnit : ∀ k, IsUnit (n k : V) := by
    simpa only [e, n, R, y, pR, V] using
      (heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_isUnit_at_selectedBranch
        (K := K) (L := L) hNC i hi P htiP hCharZero sigma)
  have haUnit : ∀ k, IsUnit (aV k) := by
    simpa only [R, aR, y, pR, V, aV] using
      (heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand_isUnit_at_selectedBranch
        hNC i hi P hP htiP sigma)
  have hFinite : Module.Finite V E :=
    finite_iteratedRadical n aV hn
  have hFaithful : Module.FaithfullyFlat V E :=

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_tensorProduct_prime_over_right_ramificationIdx_eq_of_etale
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_prime_over_right_ramificationIdx_eq_of_etale
    {R B E : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing E]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R E]
    [Algebra.Etale R E] [Module.FaithfullyFlat R E]
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime] :
    ∃ Q : Ideal (E ⊗[R] B),
      Q.IsPrime ∧
        Q.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q ∧
          Q.ramificationIdx E = q.ramificationIdx R
proof:
:= by
  let T := E ⊗[R] B
  let T' := B ⊗[R] E
  let : Algebra B T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : Algebra B T' := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B T' := inferInstance
  let e : T' ≃ₐ[B] T :=
    { toRingEquiv := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R B E).toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro b
        rfl }
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B T :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv B T' e.symm.toLinearEquiv
  obtain ⟨Q, hQPrime, hQOver⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_isPrime_liesOver_of_faithfullyFlat (B := T) q
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQPrime
  have hQ :
      Q.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q := by
    change Q.comap (algebraMap B T) = q
    exact hQOver.over.symm
  refine ⟨Q, hQPrime, hQ, ?_⟩
  exact ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_eq_of_etale q Q hQ

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_conditionalRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_conditionalRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (e : Fin d → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, 0 < e k) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),
      let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a : Fin d → R :=
        heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧ Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
        IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) := by
  classical
  rcases splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_branchSupport
      hNC i P hP htiP with hsolo | htwo
  · let σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d) := Equiv.refl _
    let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
    let a := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
    have hall : ∀ k, n k = 1 := by
      intro k
      rw [show n k = if (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r ∧
          t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P then e (σ k) else 1 by rfl]
      rw [ite_eq_right]
      intro hk
      exact Fin.succAbove_ne i (σ k)
        (hsolo (i.succAbove (σ k)) hk.1 hk.2)
    obtain ⟨z, hreg, hgen⟩ :=
      exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings
        hNC i hi P hP htiP
    have hgeometry :=
      allOneRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry n a hall hreg hgen
    refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
    simpa only [n, a] using hgeometry
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, hji, htjP, hsupport⟩ := htwo
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hji
    cases d with
    | zero => exact Fin.elim0 k₀
    | succ d =>
      let σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (d + 1)) := Equiv.swap 0 k₀
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let y : Localization.AtPrime P :=
        algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t i)
      have hσzero : σ 0 = k₀ := by simp [σ]
      have hindexZero : i.succAbove (σ 0) = j := by
        rw [hσzero]
        exact hk₀
      have hnZero : n 0 = e k₀ := by
        change (if (i.succAbove (σ 0)).1 < r ∧
            t (i.succAbove (σ 0)) ∈ P then e (σ 0) else 1) = e k₀
        rw [hσzero, hk₀, ite_eq_left ⟨hj, htjP⟩]
      have hnZeroPos : 0 < n 0 := by
        rw [hnZero]
        exact he k₀
      have htail : ∀ k : Fin d, n k.succ = 1 := by
        intro k
        by_cases hk : (i.succAbove (σ k.succ)).1 < r ∧
            t (i.succAbove (σ k.succ)) ∈ P
        · exfalso
          rcases hsupport (i.succAbove (σ k.succ)) hk.1 hk.2 with hik | hjk
          · exact Fin.succAbove_ne i (σ k.succ) hik
          · have hσk : σ k.succ = k₀ := by
              apply Fin.succAbove_right_injective
              exact hjk.trans hk₀.symm
            have hkzero : k.succ = (0 : Fin (d + 1)) :=
              σ.injective (hσk.trans hσzero.symm)
            exact Fin.succ_ne_zero k hkzero
        · simp [n, heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent, hk]
      have haZero :
          a 0 = algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t j) := by
        simp [a, heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand, hindexZero]
      have hpair :=
        regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_two_splitStrictNormalCrossingsParameters
          hNC j i hji P hP htjP htiP
      have hreg : IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime P) [a 0, y] := by
        simpa [haZero, y] using hpair.1
      have hgen : Ideal.ofList [a 0, y] =
          maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P) := by
        simpa [haZero, y] using hpair.2
      have hgeometry :=
        oneRootWithTrivialTail_selectedDivisor_geometry
          n a htail hnZeroPos hreg hgen
      refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
      simpa only [n, a, y] using hgeometry

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localization_integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisConditionalActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
statement:
theorem
  localization_integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisConditionalActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {s r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (s + 2) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (s + 2))
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s + 1)))
    (k : Fin (s + 1))
    (hkActive : (i.succAbove (sigma k)).1 < r)
    (htkP : t (i.succAbove (sigma k)) ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : CharZero
      (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t (i.succAbove (sigma k))} : Set A))) :
    let e
proof:
:= heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    let R := Localization.AtPrime P
    let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e sigma
    let a : Fin (s + 1) → R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P sigma
    let g : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
    let S := AdjoinRoot g
    let qS := Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root g} : Set S)
    letI : Algebra R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    letI : IsFractionRing R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
    ∀ {D : Type uA} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsIntegrallyClosed D]
      [Algebra R D] [Algebra S D] [IsScalarTower R S D]
      [FaithfulSMul S D] [Module.Finite S D] [FaithfulSMul R D]
      (qD : Ideal D) [qD.IsPrime], qD.under S = qS →
      let F := FractionRing D
      letI : FaithfulSMul R F := FaithfulSMul.trans R D F
      letI : Algebra K F :=
        chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulFieldAlgebra (R := R) (K := K) (F := F)
      letI : IsScalarTower R K F :=
        chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulField_isScalarTower
          (R := R) (K := K) (F := F)
      ∀ (m : Ideal (F ⊗[K] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
        letI : m.IsMaximal := hm
        let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
        letI : Algebra D M :=
          genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
        letI : SMul D M :=
          (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m).toSMul
        letI : IsScalarTower D F M :=
          IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
        let Q := Localization.AtPrime qD
        letI : Algebra Q F :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := F) qD
        letI : IsFractionRing Q F :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := F) qD
        letI : Algebra Q M :=
          localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := F) (L := M) qD
        letI : SMul Q M :=
          (localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := F) (L := M) qD).toSMul
        letI : IsScalarTower Q F M :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
            (K := F) (L := M) qD
        letI : IsScalarTower D Q M :=
          localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
            (K := F) (L := M) qD
        letI := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) qD
        Algebra.Etale Q
          (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
            (integralClosure D M) qD.primeCompl)) := by
  dsimp only
  let e := heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e sigma
  let a : Fin (s + 1) → R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P sigma
  let j : Fin (s + 2) := i.succAbove (sigma k)
  have hnkEq : n k =
      splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
        (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j := by
    simp [n, e, j, heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent,
      heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex, hkActive, htkP]
  have hakEq : a k = algebraMap A R (t j) := by
    rfl
  dsimp only [n, e, j] at hnkEq
  dsimp only [a, j] at hakEq
  rw [hnkEq, hakEq]
  intro D _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ qD _ hunder
  let g : R[X] :=
    X ^ splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j - C (algebraMap A R (t j))
  let S := AdjoinRoot g
  let qS := Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root g} : Set S)
  have hgeometryS :=
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisSingleRootCover_geometry
      (K := K) (L := L) hNC j hkActive P hP htkP
  let : IsRegularLocalRing S := hgeometryS.1
  let : IsDomain S := hgeometryS.2.1
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      hgeometryS.2.2.1
  let : qS.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hgeometryS.2.2.2.1
  let : qD.LiesOver qS := ⟨hunder.symm⟩
  exact
    localization_integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
      (K := K) (L := L) hNC j hkActive P hP htkP hCharZero
        (D := D) qD

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulField_isScalarTower
    {R : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {F : Type uA}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field F] [Algebra R F] [FaithfulSMul R F] :
    letI : Algebra K F
proof:
:=
      chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulFieldAlgebra (R := R) (K := K) (F := F)
    IsScalarTower R K F := by
  let : Algebra K F :=
    chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulFieldAlgebra (R := R) (K := K) (F := F)
  let : Algebra (FractionRing R) F := FractionRing.liftAlgebra R F
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro x
  change algebraMap R F x =
    algebraMap (FractionRing R) F
      ((FractionRing.algEquiv R K).symm (algebraMap R K x))
  rw [← (FractionRing.algEquiv R K).commutes x,
    (FractionRing.algEquiv R K).symm_apply_apply]
  exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (FractionRing R) F x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localization_integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
statement:
theorem
    localization_integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (j : Fin d) (hj : j.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htjP : t j ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A))) :
    let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
    let p := algebraMap A R (t j)
    let N := splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j
    let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C p
    let S := AdjoinRoot g
    let qS := Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root g} : Set S)
    let hgeometryS :=
      splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisSingleRootCover_geometry
        (K := K) (L := L) hNC j hj P hP htjP
    letI : IsRegularLocalRing S := hgeometryS.1
    letI : IsDomain S := hgeometryS.2.1
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
      SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
        hgeometryS.2.2.1
    letI : qS.IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hgeometryS.2.2.2.1
    let pR := Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)
    let hp : Prime p := by
      rcases prime_or_isUnit_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime P
          (hNC.2.2.2.1 j hj) with hprime | hunit
      · exact hprime
      · have htCompl : t j ∈ P.primeCompl :=
          (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff
            (Localization.AtPrime P) P (t j)).mp hunit
        exact (htCompl htjP).elim
    letI : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hp
    letI : qS.LiesOver pR :=
      span_root_liesOver_span_radicand
        (splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j) hp
    let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
    let W := Localization.AtPrime qS
    letI : Algebra V W := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver pR qS
    letI : Module.Free R S :=
      (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C p
        (splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
          (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j).ne').free_adjoinRoot
    letI : FaithfulSMul R S := inferInstance
    letI : Algebra R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    letI : IsFractionRing R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
    letI : Algebra V K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
    letI : IsFractionRing V K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) pR
    ∀ {D : Type uA} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsIntegrallyClosed D]
      [Algebra R D] [Algebra S D] [IsScalarTower R S D]
      [FaithfulSMul S D] [Module.Finite S D]
      (qD : Ideal D) [qD.IsPrime] [qD.LiesOver qS],
      let F := FractionRing D
      letI : FaithfulSMul R D := FaithfulSMul.trans R S D
      letI : FaithfulSMul R F := FaithfulSMul.trans R D F
      letI : Algebra K F :=
        chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulFieldAlgebra (R := R) (K := K) (F := F)
      letI : IsScalarTower R K F :=
        chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulField_isScalarTower
          (R := R) (K := K) (F := F)
      ∀ (m : Ideal (F ⊗[K] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
        letI : m.IsMaximal := hm
        let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
        letI : Algebra D M :=
          genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
        letI : SMul D M :=
          (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m).toSMul
        letI : IsScalarTower D F M :=
          IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
        let Q := Localization.AtPrime qD
        letI : Algebra Q F :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := F) qD
        letI : IsFractionRing Q F :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := F) qD
        letI : Algebra Q M :=
          localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := F) (L := M) qD
        letI : SMul Q M :=
          (localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := F) (L := M) qD).toSMul
        letI : IsScalarTower Q F M :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
            (K := F) (L := M) qD
        letI : IsScalarTower D Q M :=
          localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
            (K := F) (L := M) qD
        letI := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) qD
        Algebra.Etale Q
          (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
            (integralClosure D M) qD.primeCompl)) := by
  dsimp only
  intro D _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ qD _ _
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let p : R := algebraMap A R (t j)
  let N := splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
    (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j
  have hN : 0 < N :=
    splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j
  let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C p
  let S := AdjoinRoot g
  let F := FractionRing D
  have hgeometryS :=
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisSingleRootCover_geometry
      (K := K) (L := L) hNC j hj P hP htjP
  let : IsRegularLocalRing S := hgeometryS.1
  let : IsDomain S := hgeometryS.2.1
  let : Module.Free R S :=
    (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C p hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
  let : FaithfulSMul R S := inferInstance
  let : Algebra R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
  let : FaithfulSMul R D := FaithfulSMul.trans R S D
  let : FaithfulSMul R F := FaithfulSMul.trans R D F
  let : Algebra K F :=
    chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulFieldAlgebra (R := R) (K := K) (F := F)
  let : IsScalarTower R K F :=
    chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulField_isScalarTower
      (R := R) (K := K) (F := F)
  intro m hm
  let : m.IsMaximal := hm
  let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let : Algebra D M :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
  let : SMul D M :=
    (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower D F M :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let Q := Localization.AtPrime qD
  let : Algebra Q F :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := F) qD
  let : IsFractionRing Q F :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := F) qD
  let : Algebra Q M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := F) (L := M) qD
  let : SMul Q M :=
    (localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := F) (L := M) qD).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower Q F M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := F) (L := M) qD
  let : IsScalarTower D Q M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := F) (L := M) qD
  let : Algebra (integralClosure D M) (integralClosure Q M) :=
    integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) qD
  have hlocal :=
    integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
      (K := K) (L := L) hNC j hj P hP htjP hCharZero
        (D := D) qD m hm
  have hQAlgebra :
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Q) m =
        localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := F) (L := M) qD := by
    apply Algebra.algebra_ext _ _
    intro x
    rfl
  dsimp only at hlocal
  rw [hQAlgebra] at hlocal
  exact localization_integralClosure_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
    (A := D) (K := F) (L := M) qD hlocal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_away_integralClosure_etale_of_basePrime_localizations
statement:
theorem localization_away_integralClosure_etale_of_basePrime_localizations
    {D : Type uD} {F : Type uF} {M : Type uM}
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsNoetherianRing D]
    [Field F] [Algebra D F] [IsFractionRing D F]
    [Field M] [Algebra F M] [Algebra D M] [IsScalarTower D F M]
    [Module.Finite D (integralClosure D M)]
    (y : D)
    (hlocal : ∀ (q : Ideal D), [q.IsPrime] → y ∉ q →
      letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra
        (K := F) (L := M) q
      letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := F) (L := M) q
      letI := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) q
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
          (integralClosure D M) q.primeCompl))) :
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap D (integralClosure D M)) y).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let C := integralClosure D M
  let : Module.FinitePresentation D C :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite D C
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation D C :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation D C
  let S := Localization.Away y
  let yC : C := algebraMap D C y
  let T := Localization.Away yC
  let mapST : S →+* T := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap D C) y
  have hDT : Algebra.Etale D T := by
    apply Algebra.basicOpen_subset_etaleLocus_iff_etale.mp
    intro Q hQ
    let q := Q.asIdeal.under D
    let : q.IsPrime := inferInstance
    let : Q.asIdeal.LiesOver q := inferInstance
    have hyq : y ∉ q := by
      exact (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen _ _).mp hQ
    let V := Localization.AtPrime q
    let : Algebra V M :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := F) (L := M) q
    let : IsScalarTower D V M :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := F) (L := M) q
    let Cp := integralClosure V M
    let : Algebra C Cp := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) q
    let Cq := Localization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C q.primeCompl)
    let : Algebra.Etale V Cq := hlocal q hyq
    let eBase : Cq ≃ₐ[V] Cp :=
      localizationIntegralClosureAtPrimeAlgEquiv
        (K := F) (L := M) q
    let : Algebra.Etale V Cp := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eBase
    let qlocal := localizedNormalizationPrime
      (K := F) (L := M) q Q.asIdeal
    let : qlocal.IsMaximal :=
      localizedNormalizationPrime_isMaximal
        (K := F) (L := M) q Q.asIdeal
    let : Algebra.FormallyEtale Cp (Localization.AtPrime qlocal) :=
      Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization qlocal.primeCompl
    let : Algebra.FormallyEtale V (Localization.AtPrime qlocal) :=
      Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp V Cp (Localization.AtPrime qlocal)
    let : Algebra V (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver q Q.asIdeal
    let ePrime : Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal ≃ₐ[V]
        Localization.AtPrime qlocal :=
      integralClosurePrimeLocalizationAlgEquiv
        (K := F) (L := M) q Q.asIdeal
    let : Algebra.FormallyEtale V (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) :=
      Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_equiv
        (R := V) (A := Localization.AtPrime qlocal)
        (B := Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) ePrime.symm
    let : Algebra.FormallyEtale D V :=
      Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization q.primeCompl
    change Algebra.FormallyEtale D (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal)
    exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp D V (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal)
  let : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower D C T := inferInstance
  let : IsScalarTower D S T := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro z
    change algebraMap D T z = mapST (algebraMap D S z)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D C T]
    simp [mapST, S, T, yC, IsLocalization.Away.map]
  let : Algebra.Etale D S := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway y
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars D S T

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisConditionalPrefix_fixedComponent_selectedAway_etale_rich
statement:
theorem
 splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisConditionalPrefix_fixedComponent_selectedAway_etale_rich
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : ∀ j, j.1 < r →
      CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)))
    (hAway : (Localization.awayMap
      (algebraMap A (integralClosure A L)) f).Etale) :
    let e
proof:
:= heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),
      let R := Localization.AtPrime P
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a : Fin d → R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      let yB : B := algebraMap R B y
      ∃ hgeometryB : IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
          ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧ Prime yB ∧
          IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({yB} : Set B)) ∧
          IsRegularLocalRing (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({yB} : Set B)),
        let : IsRegularLocalRing B := hgeometryB.1
        let : IsDomain B := hgeometryB.2.1
        let : IsIntegrallyClosed B :=
          SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
            hgeometryB.2.2.1
        let hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k :=
          heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_pos_of_pos t i r P e
            (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
              (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i) σ
        let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
          faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
        let : FaithfulSMul R B := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
        let : Algebra R K :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
        let : IsFractionRing R K :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
        let K' := FractionRing B
        let : FaithfulSMul R K' := FaithfulSMul.trans R B K'
        let : Algebra K K' :=
          chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulFieldAlgebra
            (R := R) (K := K) (F := K')
        ∀ (m : Ideal (K' ⊗[K] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
          let : m.IsMaximal := hm
          let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
          let bMAlgebra : Algebra B M :=
            genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := B) m
          let : SMul B M := bMAlgebra.toSMul
          let : IsScalarTower B K' M :=
            IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
          (Localization.awayMap
            (algebraMap B (integralClosure B M)) yB).Etale := by
  classical
  intro e
  have he : ∀ k, 0 < e k :=
    heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
  rcases
      splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_conditionalRootCover_heightOnePrime_trichotomy
        hNC i hi P hP htiP e he with
    ⟨σ, hgeometry, hnSource, hdimB, htrichotomy⟩
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  intro R n a B y yB
  refine ⟨⟨hgeometry.1, hgeometry.2.1, hdimB,
    hgeometry.2.2.1, hgeometry.2.2.2.1, hgeometry.2.2.2.2⟩, ?_⟩
  intro hRegularB hDomainB hNormalB hn hFlatRB hFaithRB aRK hFracRK K' hFaithRK' aKK'
  let : IsScalarTower A R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower (K := K) P
  let : IsScalarTower R K K' :=
    chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulField_isScalarTower
      (R := R) (K := K) (F := K')
  let canonicalAB : Algebra A B :=
    ((algebraMap R B).comp (algebraMap A R)).toAlgebra
  let : SMul A B := canonicalAB.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower A R B := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower R B K' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let canonicalAK' : Algebra A K' :=
    ((algebraMap K K').comp (algebraMap A K)).toAlgebra
  let : SMul A K' := canonicalAK'.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower A K K' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A B K' := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    calc
      algebraMap A K' x = algebraMap K K' (algebraMap A K x) := rfl
      _ = algebraMap K K' (algebraMap R K (algebraMap A R x)) := by
        rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A R K]
      _ = algebraMap R K' (algebraMap A R x) :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K K' _).symm
      _ = algebraMap B K' (algebraMap R B (algebraMap A R x)) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B K' _
      _ = algebraMap B K' (algebraMap A B x) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A R B]
  let Cnorm := integralClosure A L
  let : IsFractionRing Cnorm L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension A K L Cnorm
  let : FaithfulSMul A Cnorm :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective A Cnorm).mpr fun x z hxz ↦ by
      have hL := congrArg (fun c : Cnorm ↦ (c : L)) hxz
      change algebraMap A L x = algebraMap A L z at hL
      apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
      apply (algebraMap K L).injective
      simpa only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L] using hL
  have hf : f ≠ 0 :=
    (hNC.2.2.2.2.1.ne_zero_iff).mpr <| by
      rw [boundaryProduct]
      exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun j hj ↦
        (hNC.2.2.2.1 j (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2).ne_zero
  let hAwayTheorem :=
    localization_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_awayMap
      (A := A) (C := Cnorm) (D := B)
      (F := K) (E := L) (K := K') f hf hAway
  intro m hm hmInstance M bMAlgebra smulBM towerBKM
  let : Module.Finite B (integralClosure B M) :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_finite_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      (K := K') hdimB
  have hfB : algebraMap A B f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hfBzero
    apply hf
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    apply (algebraMap K K').injective
    calc
      algebraMap K K' (algebraMap A K f) = algebraMap A K' f :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K K' f).symm
      _ = algebraMap B K' (algebraMap A B f) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B K' f
      _ = 0 := by rw [hfBzero, map_zero]
      _ = algebraMap K K' (algebraMap A K 0) := by rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  apply localization_away_integralClosure_etale_of_basePrime_localizations
    (D := B) (F := K') (M := M) yB
  intro q hqPrime hyq
  let Q := Localization.AtPrime q
  let : Algebra Q K' :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K') q
  let : IsFractionRing Q K' :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K') q
  let qMAlgebra : Algebra Q M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K') (L := M) q
  let : SMul Q M := qMAlgebra.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower Q K' M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K') (L := M) q
  let : IsScalarTower B Q M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K') (L := M) q
  let : Algebra (integralClosure B M) (integralClosure Q M) :=
    integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) q
  have hcomplement
      (hdisj : Disjoint
        (((Submonoid.powers (algebraMap A B f) : Submonoid B) : Set B))
        (q : Set B)) :
      Algebra.Etale Q
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
          (integralClosure B M) q.primeCompl)) := by
    have htest := hAwayTheorem q hdisj m
    dsimp only at htest
    exact htest
  by_cases hqzero : q = ⊥
  · apply hcomplement
    rw [Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime]
    rw [hqzero, Ideal.mem_bot]
    exact hfB
  have hqMaxNe : q ≠ maximalIdeal B := by
    intro hqMax
    apply hyq
    rw [hqMax]
    exact (mem_maximalIdeal yB).mpr
      (mem_nonunits_iff.mpr hgeometry.2.2.1.not_isUnit)
  have hqLt : q < maximalIdeal B :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime q) hqMaxNe
  have hMaxHeight : (maximalIdeal B).height = (2 : ℕ∞) := by
    have hcast :
        (((maximalIdeal B).height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim, hdimB]
    exact WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hcast
  have hqHeightLt : q.height < (2 : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← hMaxHeight]
    exact Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime hqLt
  have hqHeightLe : q.height ≤ (1 : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← ENat.lt_add_one_iff ENat.one_ne_top, one_add_one_eq_two]
    exact hqHeightLt
  have hqHeightPos : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ q.height :=
    Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
      (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.not.mpr hqzero)
  have hqHeight : q.height = 1 := le_antisymm hqHeightLe hqHeightPos
  have htriAtQ := htrichotomy q hqHeight
  rcases htriAtQ with
    hselected | hactive | hboundary
  · exfalso
    apply hyq
    rw [hselected]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self yB
  · rcases hactive with
      ⟨k, hkActive, htkP, -, -, hq⟩
    cases d with
    | zero => exact Fin.elim0 k
    | succ s =>
      have hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1 :=
        heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_eq_one_of_ne_actual
          hNC i P hP htiP e σ k hkActive htkP
      let g : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
      let Xroot := AdjoinRoot g
      let qroot := Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root g} : Set Xroot)
      let singleEquiv : B ≃ₐ[R] Xroot :=
        iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv n a k hother
      let : Algebra Xroot B := singleEquiv.symm.toRingHom.toAlgebra
      let : IsScalarTower R Xroot B := by
        apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
        intro z
        change algebraMap R B z = singleEquiv.symm (algebraMap R Xroot z)
        rw [← singleEquiv.commutes z, singleEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      let : Module.Finite Xroot B :=
        Module.Finite.of_surjective (Algebra.ofId Xroot B).toLinearMap
          singleEquiv.symm.surjective
      let : FaithfulSMul Xroot B :=
        (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective Xroot B).mpr
          singleEquiv.symm.injective
      have hroot : singleEquiv.symm (AdjoinRoot.root g) =
          iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k := by
        apply singleEquiv.injective
        rw [singleEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact (iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv_apply_root
          n a k hother).symm
      have hmap : qroot.map singleEquiv.symm.toRingHom =
          Ideal.span ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B) := by
        rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
        change Ideal.span ({singleEquiv.symm (AdjoinRoot.root g)} : Set B) = _
        rw [hroot]
      have hunder : q.under Xroot = qroot := by
        rw [Ideal.under_def, hq, ← hmap]
        change Ideal.comap singleEquiv.symm.toRingHom
            (Ideal.map singleEquiv.symm.toRingHom qroot) = qroot
        exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ singleEquiv.symm.bijective
      exact (
  localization_integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisConditionalActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
        (K := K) (L := L) hNC i P hP σ k hkActive htkP
          (hCharZero (i.succAbove (σ k)) hkActive)
          (D := B) q hunder m hm)
  · apply hcomplement
    simpa only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A R B] using hboundary

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisConditionalPrefix_fixedComponent_selectedAway_etale
statement:
theorem
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisConditionalPrefix_fixedComponent_selectedAway_etale
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : ∀ j, j.1 < r →
      CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)))
    (hAway : (Localization.awayMap
      (algebraMap A (integralClosure A L)) f).Etale) :
    let e
proof:
:= heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),
      let R := Localization.AtPrime P
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a : Fin d → R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      let yB : B := algebraMap R B y
      ∃ hgeometryB : IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
          ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧ Prime yB,
        letI : IsRegularLocalRing B := hgeometryB.1
        letI : IsDomain B := hgeometryB.2.1
        letI : IsIntegrallyClosed B :=
          SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
            hgeometryB.2.2.1
        let hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k :=
          heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_pos_of_pos t i r P e
            (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
              (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i) σ
        letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
          faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
        letI : FaithfulSMul R B := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
        letI : Algebra R K :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
        letI : IsFractionRing R K :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
        let K' := FractionRing B
        letI : FaithfulSMul R K' := FaithfulSMul.trans R B K'
        letI : Algebra K K' :=
          chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulFieldAlgebra
            (R := R) (K := K) (F := K')
        ∀ (m : Ideal (K' ⊗[K] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
          letI : m.IsMaximal := hm
          let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
          letI : Algebra B M :=
            genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := B) m
          letI : SMul B M :=
            (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := B) m).toSMul
          letI : IsScalarTower B K' M :=
            IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
          (Localization.awayMap
            (algebraMap B (integralClosure B M)) yB).Etale := by
  rcases (
 splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisConditionalPrefix_fixedComponent_selectedAway_etale_rich
    (K := K) (L := L) hNC i hi P hP htiP hCharZero hAway) with
    ⟨σ, hgeometryB, hcomponents⟩
  refine ⟨σ, ⟨hgeometryB.1, hgeometryB.2.1, hgeometryB.2.2.1,
    hgeometryB.2.2.2.1⟩, ?_⟩
  simpa only using hcomponents

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fractionFieldTower_isScalarTower_of_common_base
statement:
private theorem fractionFieldTower_isScalarTower_of_common_base
    {R B D : Type uA} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra R B]
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [Algebra B D] [Algebra R D]
    [IsScalarTower R B D]
    [Field K] [algRK : Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [algKKB : Algebra K (FractionRing B)]
    [towerR_K_KB : IsScalarTower R K (FractionRing B)]
    [algKKD : Algebra K (FractionRing D)]
    [towerR_K_KD : IsScalarTower R K (FractionRing D)]
    [algKBKD : Algebra (FractionRing B) (FractionRing D)]
    [towerR_KB_KD : IsScalarTower R (FractionRing B) (FractionRing D)] :
    IsScalarTower K (FractionRing B) (FractionRing D)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro x
  have hmaps :
      algebraMap K (FractionRing D) =
        (algebraMap (FractionRing B) (FractionRing D)).comp
          (algebraMap K (FractionRing B)) := by
    apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := R)
    intro z
    calc
      algebraMap K (FractionRing D) (algebraMap R K z) =
          algebraMap R (FractionRing D) z :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K (FractionRing D) z).symm
      _ = algebraMap (FractionRing B) (FractionRing D)
            (algebraMap R (FractionRing B) z) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (FractionRing B) (FractionRing D) z
      _ = algebraMap (FractionRing B) (FractionRing D)
            (algebraMap K (FractionRing B) (algebraMap R K z)) := by
        exact congrArg (algebraMap (FractionRing B) (FractionRing D))
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K (FractionRing B) z)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localization_etale_of_baseAlgEquiv
statement:
private theorem localization_etale_of_baseAlgEquiv
    {R S T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T]
    (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime] (e : S ≃ₐ[R] T)
    (hEtale : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T q.primeCompl))) :
    Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S q.primeCompl))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisPrefix_selectedAway_fullRoot_fixedComponent_etale
statement:
theorem
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisPrefix_selectedAway_fullRoot_fixedComponent_etale
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1)) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : ∀ j, j.1 < r →
      CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t j} : Set A)))
    (hAway : (Localization.awayMap
      (algebraMap A (integralClosure A L)) f).Etale) :
    let e
proof:
:= heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    let N := heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),
      let R := Localization.AtPrime P
      let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
      let a : Fin d → R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      let yB : B := algebraMap R B y
      let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C yB
      let D := AdjoinRoot F
      ∃ hgeometryB : IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
          ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧ Prime yB ∧
          IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({yB} : Set B)) ∧
          IsRegularLocalRing (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({yB} : Set B)),
        ∃ hgeometryD : IsRegularLocalRing D ∧ IsDomain D ∧
            ringKrullDim D = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
            Prime (AdjoinRoot.root F),
          let : IsRegularLocalRing B := hgeometryB.1
          let : IsDomain B := hgeometryB.2.1
          let : IsIntegrallyClosed B :=
            SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
              hgeometryB.2.2.1
          let : IsRegularLocalRing D := hgeometryD.1
          let : IsDomain D := hgeometryD.2.1
          let : IsIntegrallyClosed D :=
            SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
              hgeometryD.2.2.1
          let hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k :=
            heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_pos_of_pos t i r P e
              (heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
                (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i) σ
          let hN : 0 < N :=
            heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
              (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
          let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
            faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
          let : FaithfulSMul R B := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
          let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
            faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN yB
          let : FaithfulSMul B D := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
          let : FaithfulSMul R D := FaithfulSMul.trans R B D
          let : Algebra R K :=
            localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
          let : IsFractionRing R K :=
            localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
          let KB := FractionRing B
          let KD := FractionRing D
          let : FaithfulSMul R KB := FaithfulSMul.trans R B KB
          let : FaithfulSMul R KD := FaithfulSMul.trans R D KD
          let : FaithfulSMul B KD := FaithfulSMul.trans B D KD
          let : Algebra K KB :=
            chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulFieldAlgebra
              (R := R) (K := K) (F := KB)
          let : Algebra K KD :=
            galoisFullRootCoverFractionFieldAlgebra n a hn N hN y
          let : Algebra KB KD := FractionRing.liftAlgebra B KD
          ∃ hTower : IsScalarTower K KB KD,
            let : IsScalarTower K KB KD := hTower
            ∃ hFin : FiniteDimensional KB KD,
              let : FiniteDimensional KB KD := hFin
              ∀ (m : Ideal (KD ⊗[K] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
                let : m.IsMaximal := hm
                let n₀ := genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal
                  (K := K) (F := KB) (F' := KD) (L := L) m
                let : n₀.IsMaximal :=
                  genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal_isMaximal
                    (K := K) (F := KB) (F' := KD) (L := L) m
                let M₀ := GenericTensorFieldComponent n₀
                let bM0Algebra : Algebra B M₀ :=
                  genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := B) n₀
                let : SMul B M₀ := bM0Algebra.toSMul
                let : IsScalarTower B KB M₀ :=
                  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
                let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
                let dMAlgebra : Algebra D M :=
                  genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
                let : SMul D M := dMAlgebra.toSMul
                let : IsScalarTower D KD M :=
                  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
                (Localization.awayMap
                    (algebraMap B (integralClosure B M₀)) yB).Etale ∧
                  Module.Finite D (integralClosure D M) ∧
                    Algebra.Etale D (integralClosure D M) := by
  classical
  intro e N
  rcases (
 splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisConditionalPrefix_fixedComponent_selectedAway_etale_rich
    (K := K) (L := L) hNC i hi P hP htiP hCharZero hAway) with
    ⟨σ, hgeometryB, hprefix⟩
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  intro R n a B y yB F D
  refine ⟨hgeometryB, ?_⟩
  have hgeometryD :
      IsRegularLocalRing D ∧ IsDomain D ∧
        ringKrullDim D = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        Prime (AdjoinRoot.root F) := by
    let : IsRegularLocalRing B := hgeometryB.1
    let : IsDomain B := hgeometryB.2.1
    have hfull := heightTwoPrimeRootCover_geometry
      (heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
        (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i)
      hgeometryB.2.2.2.1 hgeometryB.2.2.2.2.2 hgeometryB.2.2.1
    exact ⟨hfull.1, hfull.2.1, hfull.2.2.1, hfull.2.2.2.1⟩
  refine ⟨hgeometryD, ?_⟩
  intro hRegularB hDomainB hNormalB hRegularD hDomainD hNormalD hn hN
    hFlatRB hFaithRB hFlatBD hFaithBD hFaithRD aRK hFracRK KB KD
    hFaithRKB hFaithRKD hFaithBKD aKKB aKKD aKBKD
  let : IsScalarTower A R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower (K := K) P
  let : IsScalarTower R K KB :=
    chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulField_isScalarTower
      (R := R) (K := K) (F := KB)
  let : IsScalarTower R K KD :=
    galoisFullRootCoverFractionField_isScalarTower n a hn N hN y
  let : IsScalarTower R B KB := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower R B D := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower B D KD := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower R D KD := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower R B KD := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower B KB KD :=
    FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra B KD
  let : IsScalarTower R KB KD := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro z
    calc
      algebraMap R KD z = algebraMap B KD (algebraMap R B z) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B KD z
      _ = algebraMap KB KD (algebraMap B KB (algebraMap R B z)) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B KB KD _
      _ = algebraMap KB KD (algebraMap R KB z) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B KB]
  refine ⟨fractionFieldTower_isScalarTower_of_common_base
    (R := R) (B := B) (D := D) (K := K), ?_⟩
  intro hTower
  let : Module.Finite B D := by
    simpa only [D, F] using
      (monic_X_pow_sub_C yB hN.ne').finite_adjoinRoot
  let eGeneric : (KB ⊗[B] D) ≃ₐ[KB] KD :=
    finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv
      (R := B) (C := D) (K := KB) (E := KD)
  let : Module.Finite KB (KB ⊗[B] D) :=
    Module.Finite.base_change B KB D
  refine ⟨Module.Finite.equiv eGeneric.toLinearEquiv, ?_⟩
  intro hFin m hm hMaxM n₀ hMaxn M₀ bM0Algebra smulBM0 towerBKBM0
    M dMAlgebra smulDM towerDKDM
  have hAwayPrefix :
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap B (integralClosure B M₀)) yB).Etale :=
    hprefix n₀ inferInstance
  have hfiniteM : Module.Finite D (integralClosure D M) :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_finite_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      (K := KD) hgeometryD.2.2.1
  refine ⟨hAwayPrefix, hfiniteM, ?_⟩
  apply
    SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_etale_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      (A := D) (K := KD) (L := M) hgeometryD.2.2.1
  intro q hqPrime hqHeight
  rcases
      heightOnePrime_eq_span_or_disjoint_powers_of_associated
        hgeometryD.2.2.2 (Associated.refl (AdjoinRoot.root F)) q hqHeight with
    hselected | hrootAway
  · exact
      localization_integralClosure_galoisFullRootCover_selectedBranch_fixedComponent_etale
        (K := K) (L := L) hNC i hi P hP htiP (hCharZero i hi) σ
          hn ⟨hgeometryD.1, hgeometryD.2.1, hgeometryD.2.2.1⟩
          m hm q hqHeight hselected
  · have hrootNot : AdjoinRoot.root F ∉ q := by
      exact (Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime _).mp hrootAway
    have hyD : algebraMap B D yB ∉ q := by
      intro hyq
      apply hrootNot
      apply (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).mem_of_pow_mem N
      rw [adjoinRoot_root_pow]
      simpa only [F, D, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq] using hyq
    have hyDisjoint :
        Disjoint
          (((Submonoid.powers (algebraMap B D yB) : Submonoid D) : Set D))
          (q : Set D) := by
      rw [Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime]
      exact hyD
    let C₀ := integralClosure B M₀
    let : Module.Finite B C₀ :=
      SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_finite_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
        (K := KB) hgeometryB.2.2.1
    let : IsFractionRing C₀ M₀ :=
      IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension B KB M₀ C₀
    let : FaithfulSMul B C₀ :=
      (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective B C₀).mpr fun x z hxz ↦ by
        have hM₀ := congrArg (fun c : C₀ ↦ (c : M₀)) hxz
        change algebraMap B M₀ x = algebraMap B M₀ z at hM₀
        apply IsFractionRing.injective B KB
        apply (algebraMap KB M₀).injective
        simpa only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B KB M₀] using hM₀
    let q₂ := genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal
      (K := K) (F := KB) (F' := KD) (L := L) m
    let : q₂.IsMaximal :=
      genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal_isMaximal
        (K := K) (F := KB) (F' := KD) (L := L) m
    let M₂ := GenericTensorFieldComponent q₂
    let dM2Algebra : Algebra D M₂ :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) q₂
    let : SMul D M₂ := dM2Algebra.toSMul
    let : IsScalarTower D KD M₂ :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    have hlocal₂ :=
      localization_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_awayMap
        (A := B) (C := C₀) (D := D)
        (F := KB) (E := M₀) (K := KD)
        yB hgeometryB.2.2.2.1.ne_zero hAwayPrefix q hyDisjoint q₂
    let CM := integralClosure D M
    let CM₂ := integralClosure D M₂
    let eIC : CM ≃ₐ[D] CM₂ :=
      genericTensorTowerFinalComponentIntegralClosureAlgEquiv
        (B := D) (K := K) (F := KB) (F' := KD) (L := L) m
    exact localization_etale_of_baseAlgEquiv (R := D) (S := CM) (T := CM₂)
      q eIC hlocal₂

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.galoisFullRootCoverFractionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem galoisFullRootCoverFractionField_isScalarTower
    {R : Type uA} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    {d : ℕ} (n : Fin d → ℕ) (a : Fin d → R)
    (hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (y : R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R d n a
    let D := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y))
    ∀ [IsDomain D],
      letI : Algebra K (FractionRing D) :=
        galoisFullRootCoverFractionFieldAlgebra n a hn N hN y
      IsScalarTower R K (FractionRing D) := by
  dsimp only
  intro _
  let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let D := AdjoinRoot F
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : FaithfulSMul R B := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
  let : Nontrivial B :=
    (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R B).nontrivial
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN (algebraMap R B y)
  let : FaithfulSMul B D := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
  let : FaithfulSMul R D := FaithfulSMul.trans R B D

    FaithfulSMul.trans R D (FractionRing D)
