            chosenFractionFieldToFaithfulFieldAlgebra
              (R := R) (K := K) (F := KB)
          let : Algebra K KD :=
            galoisFullRootCoverFractionFieldAlgebra n a hn N hN y
          let : Algebra KB KD := FractionRing.liftAlgebra B KD
          ∃ hTower : IsScalarTower K KB KD,
            let : IsScalarTower K KB KD := hTower
            ∃ hFin : FiniteDimensional KB KD,
              let : FiniteDimensional KB KD := hFin
              let m := genericTensorMaximalIdeal
                (K := K) (K' := KD) (L := L)
              let : m.IsMaximal := genericTensorMaximalIdeal_isMaximal
              let n₀ := genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal
                (K := K) (F := KB) (F' := KD) (L := L) m
              let : n₀.IsMaximal :=
                genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal_isMaximal
                  (K := K) (F := KB) (F' := KD) (L := L) m
              let M₀ := GenericTensorFieldComponent n₀
              let : Algebra B M₀ :=
                genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := B) n₀
              let : SMul B M₀ :=
                (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra
                  (R := B) n₀).toSMul
              let : IsScalarTower B KB M₀ :=
                IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
              let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
              let : Algebra D M :=
                genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
              let : Algebra B M :=
                genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := B) m
              let : SMul D M :=
                (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra
                  (R := D) m).toSMul
              let : SMul B M :=
                (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra
                  (R := B) m).toSMul
              let : IsScalarTower B D M :=
                IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
              let : IsScalarTower D KD M :=
                IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
              let pR := (Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)).map
                (algebraMap A R)
              let qB := Ideal.span ({yB} : Set B)
              let qD := Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D)
              let : pR.IsPrime := by
                let : (Ideal.span ({t i} : Set A)).IsPrime :=
                  Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
                    (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi)
                exact Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P
                  (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htiP)
              let : qB.IsPrime :=
                Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hgeometryB.2.2.2.1
              let : qD.IsPrime :=
                Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hgeometryD.2.2.2
              let : qB.LiesOver pR := by
                constructor
                simpa only [pR, qB, yB, y, Ideal.map_span,
                  Ideal.map_map, Set.image_singleton,
                  RingHom.comp_apply] using
                  (Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat
                    (B := B) pR).symm
              let : qD.LiesOver qB :=
                span_root_liesOver_span_radicand hN hgeometryB.2.2.2.1
              let : qD.LiesOver pR := Ideal.LiesOver.trans qD qB pR
              let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
              let W := Localization.AtPrime qD
              let : Algebra V W :=
                Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver pR qD
              let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V W) := inferInstance
              let : Algebra V K :=
                localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
              let : Algebra V L :=
                localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra
                  (K := K) (L := L) pR
              let : Algebra W KD :=
                localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := KD) qD
              let : Algebra W M :=
                localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra
                  (K := KD) (L := M) qD
              let : Algebra L M := genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
              let : Algebra V M :=
                ((algebraMap W M).comp (algebraMap V W)).toAlgebra
              let Csel := integralClosure V L
              let Cpost := integralClosure W M
              let Cglobal := integralClosure D M
              let : Algebra B Cglobal :=
                ((algebraMap D Cglobal).comp (algebraMap B D)).toAlgebra
              let : Algebra V Cpost :=
                ((algebraMap W Cpost).comp (algebraMap V W)).toAlgebra
              ∃ qPost : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W).primesOver Cpost,
                ∃ qGlobal p : Ideal Cglobal,
                  qGlobal.IsPrime ∧ qGlobal.LiesOver qD ∧
                    localizedNormalizationPrime
                        (K := KD) (L := M) qD qGlobal = qPost.1 ∧
                    qGlobal.ramificationIdx D =
                      qPost.1.ramificationIdx W ∧
                    qGlobal.ramificationIdx B = N ∧
                    qGlobal ≤ p ∧ p.IsMaximal ∧
                    p.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D) ∧
                    let qPrefix :=
                      genericTensorTowerIntermediateNormalizationPrime
                        (A := B) (B := D) (K := K) (F := KB)
                        (F' := KD) (L := L) m qGlobal
                    let qClosed :=
                      genericTensorTowerIntermediateNormalizationPrime
                        (A := B) (B := D) (K := K) (F := KB)
                        (F' := KD) (L := L) m p
                    qGlobal.comap
                        (genericTensorTowerIntermediateNormalizationRingHom
                          (A := B) (B := D) (K := K) (F := KB)
                          (F' := KD) (L := L) m) = qPrefix ∧
                      qPrefix.IsPrime ∧ qPrefix.LiesOver qB ∧
                      qPrefix.ramificationIdx B = N ∧
                      qPrefix ≤ qClosed ∧ qClosed.IsMaximal ∧
                      qClosed.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) ∧
                      ∃ φ : Csel →ₐ[V] Cpost,
                        ∃ Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver Csel,
                          qPost.1.comap φ.toRingHom = Q.1 ∧
                            (∀ z : Csel,
                              (((φ z : Cpost) : M)) =
                                algebraMap L M (z : L)) ∧
                            Ideal.ramificationIdx (S := Csel) Q.1 V = N ∧
                            (Localization.awayMap
                              (algebraMap B (integralClosure B M₀)) yB).Etale ∧
                            Module.Finite D (integralClosure D M) ∧
                              Algebra.Etale D (integralClosure D M) := by
  exact galoisFullRootCover_selectedComponent_exactPrimeSource_constructed
    (K := K) (L := L) hNC i hi P hP htiP hCharZero hAway

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localization_integralClosure_galoisFullRootCover_actualRootFirst_fixedComponent_etale
statement:
theorem
    localization_integralClosure_galoisFullRootCover_actualRootFirst_fixedComponent_etale
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {s r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (s + 2) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (s + 2))
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (sigma : Equiv.Perm (Fin (s + 1)))
    (k : Fin (s + 1))
    (hkActive : (i.succAbove (sigma k)).1 < r)
    (htkP : t (i.succAbove (sigma k)) ∈ P)
    (hCharZero : CharZero
      (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({t (i.succAbove (sigma k))} : Set A))) :
    let e
proof:
:= heightTwoOtherBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    let N := heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
    let R := Localization.AtPrime P
    let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e sigma
    let a : Fin (s + 1) → R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P sigma
    let B := iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let D := AdjoinRoot F
    ∀ (hn : ∀ l, 0 < n l) [IsDomain D] [IsIntegrallyClosed D]
      (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime], q.height = 1 →
      q.under B = Ideal.span
        ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B) →
      let : Algebra R K :=
        localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
      let : IsFractionRing R K :=
        localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
      let K' := FractionRing D
      let : Algebra K K' :=
        galoisFullRootCoverFractionFieldAlgebra n a hn N
          (heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
            (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i) y
      ∀ (m : Ideal (K' ⊗[K] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
        let : m.IsMaximal := hm
        let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
        let : Algebra D M :=
          genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
        let : SMul D M :=
          (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m).toSMul
        let : IsScalarTower D K' M :=
          IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
        let Q := Localization.AtPrime q
        let : Algebra Q K' :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K') q
        let : IsFractionRing Q K' :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K') q
        let : Algebra Q M :=
          localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K') (L := M) q
        let : SMul Q M :=
          (localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K') (L := M) q).toSMul
        let : IsScalarTower Q K' M :=
          localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
            (K := K') (L := M) q
        let : IsScalarTower D Q M :=
          localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
            (K := K') (L := M) q
        let : Algebra (integralClosure D M) (integralClosure Q M) :=
          integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) q
        Algebra.Etale Q
          (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
            (integralClosure D M) q.primeCompl)) := by
  intro e N R n a B y F D hn hDomainD hIntegrallyClosedD
    q hqPrime hqHeight hunderB aRK hFracRK K' aKK'
  have hN : 0 < N :=
    heightTwoSelectedBranchGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC i
  have hqEq : q = Ideal.span
      ({algebraMap B D (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k)} : Set D) :=
    splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_galoisFullRootCover_heightOnePrime_eq_span_actualRoot
      (A := A) (K := K) (L := L) hNC i P hP htiP
        sigma k hkActive htkP q hqHeight hunderB
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B := faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : FaithfulSMul R B := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
  let : Nontrivial B :=
    (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R B).nontrivial
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN (algebraMap R B y)
  let : FaithfulSMul B D := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
  let : FaithfulSMul R D := FaithfulSMul.trans R B D
  let : FaithfulSMul R K' := FaithfulSMul.trans R D K'
  let : IsScalarTower R K K' :=
    galoisFullRootCoverFractionField_isScalarTower n a hn N hN y
  have hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1 :=
    heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_eq_one_of_ne_actual
      hNC i P hP htiP e sigma k hkActive htkP
  have hnk : 0 < n k := hn k
  let gx : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
  let Xroot := AdjoinRoot gx
  let qx := Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root gx} : Set Xroot)
  let : Algebra Xroot D :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgebra n a k hother N y
  let : Module.Finite Xroot D :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirst_moduleFinite n a k hother N hN y
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat Xroot D :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirst_faithfullyFlat
      n a k hother hnk N hN y
  let : FaithfulSMul Xroot D := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
  let : IsScalarTower R Xroot D :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirst_isScalarTower n a k hother N y
  have hunder : q.under Xroot = qx := by
    rw [hqEq]
    exact fullRootCoverActualRootFirst_under_eq_span_root
      n a k hother hnk N hN y
  exact (
  localization_integralClosure_strictNormalCrossingsGaloisConditionalActiveRoot_fixedComponent_etale
    (K := K) (L := L) hNC i P hP sigma k hkActive htkP hCharZero
      (D := D) q hunder)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_adjoinRootOneAlgEquiv_preserving
statement:
private theorem exists_adjoinRootOneAlgEquiv_preserving
    {R T U : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing T] [CommRing U]
    [Algebra R T] [Algebra R U]
    (f : T[X]) (c : T) (hf : f = X ^ 1 - C c)
    (g : T ≃ₐ[R] U) (z : T) (w : U) (hz : g z = w) :
    ∃ e : AdjoinRoot f ≃ₐ[R] U, e (AdjoinRoot.of f z) = w
proof:
:= by
  let eT : AdjoinRoot f ≃ₐ[T] T :=
    (AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq T f (X ^ 1 - C c) hf).trans
      (adjoinRootOneAlgEquiv c)
  refine ⟨(eT.restrictScalars R).trans g, ?_⟩
  change g (eT (AdjoinRoot.of f z)) = w
  exact (congrArg g (eT.commutes z)).trans hz

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_iteratedRadicalSingleRoot_oneLastStep
statement:
private theorem exists_iteratedRadicalSingleRoot_oneLastStep
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {s : ℕ}
    (n : Fin (s + 2) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 2) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hlast : n (Fin.last (s + 1)) = 1)
    (hInit : ∃ e : iteratedRadical R (s + 1) (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) ≃ₐ[R]
        AdjoinRoot (X ^ n k.castSucc - C (a k.castSucc)),
      e (iteratedRadicalRoot R (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) k) =
        AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n k.castSucc - C (a k.castSucc))) :
    ∃ e : iteratedRadical R (s + 2) n a ≃ₐ[R]
        AdjoinRoot (X ^ n k.castSucc - C (a k.castSucc)),
      e (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k.castSucc) =
        AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n k.castSucc - C (a k.castSucc))
proof:
:= by
  let T : CommAlgCat R :=
    iteratedRadical R (s + 1) (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
  let f : T[X] := X ^ n (Fin.last (s + 1)) -
    C (algebraMap R T (a (Fin.last (s + 1))))
  let g : R[X] := X ^ n k.castSucc - C (a k.castSucc)
  obtain ⟨eInit, heInit⟩ := hInit
  have hf : f = X ^ 1 - C (algebraMap R T (a (Fin.last (s + 1)))) := by
    simp only [f, hlast]
  rw [iteratedRadicalRoot_castSucc]
  change ∃ e : AdjoinRoot f ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot g,
    e (AdjoinRoot.of f
      (iteratedRadicalRoot R (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) k)) = AdjoinRoot.root g
  exact exists_adjoinRootOneAlgEquiv_preserving f
    (algebraMap R T (a (Fin.last (s + 1)))) hf eInit
    (iteratedRadicalRoot R (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) k)
    (AdjoinRoot.root g) heInit

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv
statement:
private theorem exists_iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] :
    {s : ℕ} → (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) → (a : Fin (s + 1) → R) →
      (k : Fin (s + 1)) → (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1) →
      ∃ e : iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a ≃ₐ[R]
          AdjoinRoot (X ^ n k - C (a k)),
        e (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k) =
          AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n k - C (a k))
  | 0, n, a, k, _ => by
      have hk : k = Fin.last 0
proof:
:= by
        simpa using Fin.eq_zero k
      subst k
      let T : CommAlgCat R :=
        iteratedRadical R 0 (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last 0) - C (algebraMap R T (a (Fin.last 0)))
      let g : R[X] := X ^ n (Fin.last 0) - C (a (Fin.last 0))
      let ePrefix : T ≃ₐ[R] R :=
        iteratedRadicalAllOneAlgEquiv
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) (fun l ↦ Fin.elim0 l)
      have hfg : f.map ePrefix.toRingHom = g := by
        ext m
        simp [f, g, ePrefix]
      let e : AdjoinRoot f ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot g :=
        AdjoinRoot.mapAlgEquiv ePrefix f g (Associated.of_eq hfg)
      simp only [iteratedRadicalRoot_last]
      change ∃ e : AdjoinRoot f ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot g,
        e (AdjoinRoot.root f) = AdjoinRoot.root g
      refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
      simp [e]
  | s + 1, n, a, k, hother => by
      let nInit : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ := Fin.init n
      let aInit : Fin (s + 1) → R := Fin.init a
      let T : CommAlgCat R := iteratedRadical R (s + 1) nInit aInit
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last (s + 1)) -
          C (algebraMap R T (a (Fin.last (s + 1))))
      revert hother
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun kInit ↦ ?_) k
      · intro hother
        have hprefix : ∀ l : Fin (s + 1), nInit l = 1 := by
          intro l
          exact hother l.castSucc (Fin.castSucc_ne_last l)
        let ePrefix : T ≃ₐ[R] R :=
          iteratedRadicalAllOneAlgEquiv nInit aInit hprefix
        let g : R[X] :=
          X ^ n (Fin.last (s + 1)) - C (a (Fin.last (s + 1)))
        have hfg : f.map ePrefix.toRingHom = g := by
          ext m
          simp [f, g, ePrefix]
        let e : AdjoinRoot f ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot g :=
          AdjoinRoot.mapAlgEquiv ePrefix f g (Associated.of_eq hfg)
        simp only [iteratedRadicalRoot_last]
        change ∃ e : AdjoinRoot f ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot g,
          e (AdjoinRoot.root f) = AdjoinRoot.root g
        refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
        simp [e]
      · intro hother
        have hlast : n (Fin.last (s + 1)) = 1 := by
          exact hother _ (Fin.castSucc_ne_last kInit).symm
        have hotherInit : ∀ l, l ≠ kInit → nInit l = 1 := by
          intro l hl
          exact hother l.castSucc (by
            intro h
            exact hl (Fin.castSucc_injective _ h))
        exact exists_iteratedRadicalSingleRoot_oneLastStep n a kInit hlast
          (exists_iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv nInit aInit kInit hotherInit)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv_apply_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv_apply_root
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 1) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1) :
    iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv n a k hother
        (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k) =
      AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n k - C (a k))
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv n a k hother)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_twoRootSwapAlgEquiv
statement:
private theorem exists_twoRootSwapAlgEquiv
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (m n : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    let px : R[X]
proof:
:= X ^ m - C x
    let py : R[X] := X ^ n - C y
    let Xroot := AdjoinRoot px
    let Yroot := AdjoinRoot py
    let fy : Xroot[X] := X ^ n - C (algebraMap R Xroot y)
    let gx : Yroot[X] := X ^ m - C (algebraMap R Yroot x)
    ∃ e : AdjoinRoot fy ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot gx,
      e (algebraMap Xroot (AdjoinRoot fy) (AdjoinRoot.root px)) =
          AdjoinRoot.root gx ∧
        e (AdjoinRoot.root fy) =
          algebraMap Yroot (AdjoinRoot gx) (AdjoinRoot.root py) := by
  dsimp only
  let px : R[X] := X ^ m - C x
  let py : R[X] := X ^ n - C y
  let Xroot := AdjoinRoot px
  let Yroot := AdjoinRoot py
  let fy : Xroot[X] := X ^ n - C (algebraMap R Xroot y)
  let gx : Yroot[X] := X ^ m - C (algebraMap R Yroot x)
  let Dxy := AdjoinRoot fy
  let Dyx := AdjoinRoot gx
  have hxRoot : px.eval₂ (Algebra.ofId R Dyx) (AdjoinRoot.root gx) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [px]
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
    rw [adjoinRoot_root_pow]
    change algebraMap Yroot Dyx (algebraMap R Yroot x) -
      algebraMap R Dyx x = 0
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Yroot Dyx x]
    exact sub_self _
  let mapX : Xroot →ₐ[R] Dyx :=
    AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom px (Algebra.ofId R Dyx)
      (AdjoinRoot.root gx) hxRoot
  have hyRoot : fy.eval₂ mapX
      (algebraMap Yroot Dyx (AdjoinRoot.root py)) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [fy]
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
    change (algebraMap Yroot Dyx (AdjoinRoot.root py)) ^ n -
      mapX (algebraMap R Xroot y) = 0
    rw [mapX.commutes]
    rw [← map_pow, adjoinRoot_root_pow]
    change algebraMap Yroot Dyx (algebraMap R Yroot y) -
      algebraMap R Dyx y = 0
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Yroot Dyx y]
    exact sub_self _
  let forward : Dxy →ₐ[R] Dyx :=
    AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom fy mapX
      (algebraMap Yroot Dyx (AdjoinRoot.root py)) hyRoot
  have hyRoot' : py.eval₂ (Algebra.ofId R Dxy) (AdjoinRoot.root fy) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [py]
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
    rw [adjoinRoot_root_pow]
    change algebraMap Xroot Dxy (algebraMap R Xroot y) -
      algebraMap R Dxy y = 0
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Xroot Dxy y]
    exact sub_self _
  let mapY : Yroot →ₐ[R] Dxy :=
    AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom py (Algebra.ofId R Dxy)
      (AdjoinRoot.root fy) hyRoot'
  have hxRoot' : gx.eval₂ mapY
      (algebraMap Xroot Dxy (AdjoinRoot.root px)) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [gx]
    rw [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
    change (algebraMap Xroot Dxy (AdjoinRoot.root px)) ^ m -
      mapY (algebraMap R Yroot x) = 0
    rw [mapY.commutes]
    rw [← map_pow, adjoinRoot_root_pow]
    change algebraMap Xroot Dxy (algebraMap R Xroot x) -
      algebraMap R Dxy x = 0
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Xroot Dxy x]
    exact sub_self _
  let backward : Dyx →ₐ[R] Dxy :=
    AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom gx mapY
      (algebraMap Xroot Dxy (AdjoinRoot.root px)) hxRoot'
  have hmapXRoot : mapX (AdjoinRoot.root px) = AdjoinRoot.root gx := by
    exact AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root px (Algebra.ofId R Dyx)
      (AdjoinRoot.root gx) hxRoot
  have hmapYRoot : mapY (AdjoinRoot.root py) = AdjoinRoot.root fy := by
    exact AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root py (Algebra.ofId R Dxy)
      (AdjoinRoot.root fy) hyRoot'
  have hforwardOf (z : Xroot) :
      forward (algebraMap Xroot Dxy z) = mapX z := by
    change forward (AdjoinRoot.of fy z) = mapX z
    exact AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_of fy mapX
      (algebraMap Yroot Dyx (AdjoinRoot.root py)) hyRoot z
  have hforwardRoot : forward (AdjoinRoot.root fy) =
      algebraMap Yroot Dyx (AdjoinRoot.root py) := by
    exact AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root fy mapX
      (algebraMap Yroot Dyx (AdjoinRoot.root py)) hyRoot
  have hbackwardOf (z : Yroot) :
      backward (algebraMap Yroot Dyx z) = mapY z := by
    change backward (AdjoinRoot.of gx z) = mapY z
    exact AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_of gx mapY
      (algebraMap Xroot Dxy (AdjoinRoot.root px)) hxRoot' z
  have hbackwardRoot : backward (AdjoinRoot.root gx) =
      algebraMap Xroot Dxy (AdjoinRoot.root px) := by
    exact AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root gx mapY
      (algebraMap Xroot Dxy (AdjoinRoot.root px)) hxRoot'
  let e : Dxy ≃ₐ[R] Dyx :=
    AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom forward backward
      (by
        apply AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext'
        · apply AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext
          change forward
              (backward (algebraMap Yroot Dyx (AdjoinRoot.root py))) =
            algebraMap Yroot Dyx (AdjoinRoot.root py)
          rw [hbackwardOf, hmapYRoot, hforwardRoot]
        · change forward (backward (AdjoinRoot.root gx)) =
            AdjoinRoot.root gx
          rw [hbackwardRoot, hforwardOf, hmapXRoot])
      (by
        apply AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext'
        · apply AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext
          change backward
              (forward (algebraMap Xroot Dxy (AdjoinRoot.root px))) =
            algebraMap Xroot Dxy (AdjoinRoot.root px)
          rw [hforwardOf, hmapXRoot, hbackwardRoot]
        · change backward (forward (AdjoinRoot.root fy)) =
            AdjoinRoot.root fy
          rw [hforwardRoot, hbackwardOf, hmapYRoot])
  refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change forward
        (algebraMap Xroot Dxy (AdjoinRoot.root px)) =
      AdjoinRoot.root gx
    rw [hforwardOf, hmapXRoot]
  · change forward (AdjoinRoot.root fy) =
      algebraMap Yroot Dyx (AdjoinRoot.root py)
    exact hforwardRoot

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_eq_one_of_ne_actual
statement:
theorem heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent_eq_one_of_ne_actual
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin (d + 1) → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin (d + 1))
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P)
    (e : Fin d → ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d))
    (k : Fin d)
    (hkActive : (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r)
    (htkP : t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P) :
    ∀ l, l ≠ k →
      heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ l = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro l hl
  change
    (if (i.succAbove (σ l)).1 < r ∧
        t (i.succAbove (σ l)) ∈ P then e (σ l) else 1) = 1
  rw [ite_eq_right]
  intro hlActual
  rcases splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_branchSupport
      hNC i P hP htiP with hsolo | htwo
  · have hkEq : i.succAbove (σ k) = i :=
      hsolo _ hkActive htkP
    exact Fin.succAbove_ne i (σ k) hkEq
  · obtain ⟨j, _hjActive, _hji, _htjP, hsupport⟩ := htwo
    have hkEq : i.succAbove (σ k) = j := by
      rcases hsupport _ hkActive htkP with hkEqI | hkEqJ
      · exact (Fin.succAbove_ne i (σ k) hkEqI).elim
      · exact hkEqJ
    have hlEq : i.succAbove (σ l) = j := by
      rcases hsupport _ hlActual.1 hlActual.2 with hlEqI | hlEqJ
      · exact (Fin.succAbove_ne i (σ l) hlEqI).elim
      · exact hlEqJ
    apply hl
    apply σ.injective
    apply Fin.succAbove_right_injective
    exact hlEq.trans hkEq.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_fullRootCoverActualRootLastAlgEquiv
statement:
private theorem exists_fullRootCoverActualRootLastAlgEquiv
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 1) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (y : R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let py : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
    let Yroot := AdjoinRoot py
    let G : Yroot[X] :=
      X ^ n k - C (algebraMap R Yroot (a k))
    ∃ e : AdjoinRoot F ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot G,
      e (algebraMap B (AdjoinRoot F)
            (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k)) =
          AdjoinRoot.root G ∧
        e (AdjoinRoot.root F) =
          algebraMap Yroot (AdjoinRoot G) (AdjoinRoot.root py) := by
  dsimp only
  let B := iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
  let px : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
  let Xroot := AdjoinRoot px
  let eB : B ≃ₐ[R] Xroot :=
    iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv n a k hother
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let F' : Xroot[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R Xroot y)
  let py : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
  let Yroot := AdjoinRoot py
  let G : Yroot[X] := X ^ n k - C (algebraMap R Yroot (a k))
  have hF : F.map eB.toRingHom = F' := by
    dsimp only [F, F']
    rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C]
    exact congrArg (fun z : Xroot ↦ (X : Xroot[X]) ^ N - C z) (eB.commutes y)
  let eFull : AdjoinRoot F ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot F' :=
    AdjoinRoot.mapAlgEquiv eB F F' (Associated.of_eq hF)
  let eSwap : AdjoinRoot F' ≃ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot G :=
    twoRootSwapAlgEquiv (n k) N (a k) y
  have heFullOf (z : B) :
      eFull (algebraMap B (AdjoinRoot F) z) =
        algebraMap Xroot (AdjoinRoot F') (eB z) := by
    change eFull (AdjoinRoot.of F z) = AdjoinRoot.of F' (eB z)
    simp [eFull]
  have heFullRoot : eFull (AdjoinRoot.root F) =
      AdjoinRoot.root F' := by
    simp [eFull]
  refine ⟨eFull.trans eSwap, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change eSwap
        (eFull (algebraMap B (AdjoinRoot F)
          (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k))) = AdjoinRoot.root G
    rw [heFullOf, iteratedRadicalSingleRootAlgEquiv_apply_root]
    exact twoRootSwapAlgEquiv_algebraMap_root (n k) N (a k) y
  · change eSwap (eFull (AdjoinRoot.root F)) =
      algebraMap Yroot (AdjoinRoot G) (AdjoinRoot.root py)
    rw [heFullRoot]
    exact twoRootSwapAlgEquiv_root (n k) N (a k) y

statement:
theorem fullRootCoverActualRootFirst_moduleFinite
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 1) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (y : R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let D := AdjoinRoot F
    let px : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
    let Xroot := AdjoinRoot px
    letI : Algebra Xroot D :=
      fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgebra n a k hother N y
    Module.Finite Xroot D := by
  dsimp only
  let B := iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let D := AdjoinRoot F
  let px : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
  let Xroot := AdjoinRoot px
  let fy : Xroot[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R Xroot y)
  let Dxy := AdjoinRoot fy
  let : Algebra Xroot D :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgebra n a k hother N y
  let : Module.Finite Xroot Dxy := by
    simpa only [Dxy, fy] using
      (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C
        (algebraMap R Xroot y) hN.ne').finite_adjoinRoot
  let eRing : D ≃ₐ[R] Dxy :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgEquiv n a k hother N y
  let e : D ≃ₐ[Xroot] Dxy :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := eRing.toRingEquiv) (fun x ↦ by
      change eRing (eRing.symm (algebraMap Xroot Dxy x)) =
        algebraMap Xroot Dxy x
      exact eRing.apply_symm_apply _)
  exact Module.Finite.equiv e.symm.toLinearEquiv

theorem fullRootCoverSelectedRootAlgebra_map_root
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {d : ℕ} (n : Fin d → ℕ) (a : Fin d → R)
    (N : ℕ) (y : R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R d n a
    let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
    let S := AdjoinRoot g
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let D := AdjoinRoot F
    letI : Algebra S D := fullRootCoverSelectedRootAlgebra n a N y
    algebraMap S D (AdjoinRoot.root g) = AdjoinRoot.root F := by
  dsimp only
  let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
  let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
  let S := AdjoinRoot g
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let D := AdjoinRoot F
  have hg : g.map (algebraMap R B) = F := by
    simp [g, F]
  let : Algebra S D := fullRootCoverSelectedRootAlgebra n a N y
  change ((adjoinRootBaseChangeAlgEquiv g).trans
      (AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq B _ _ hg))
        ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] AdjoinRoot.root g) = AdjoinRoot.root F

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fullRootCoverSelectedRoot_moduleFinite
statement:
theorem fullRootCoverSelectedRoot_moduleFinite
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {d : ℕ} (n : Fin d → ℕ) (a : Fin d → R)
    (hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k) (N : ℕ) (y : R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R d n a
    let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
    let S := AdjoinRoot g
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let D := AdjoinRoot F
    letI : Algebra S D := fullRootCoverSelectedRootAlgebra n a N y
    Module.Finite S D := by
  dsimp only
  let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
  let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
  let S := AdjoinRoot g
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let D := AdjoinRoot F
  have hg : g.map (algebraMap R B) = F := by
    simp [g, F]
  let : Module.Finite R B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let T := S ⊗[R] B
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : Module.Finite S T := Module.Finite.base_change R S B
  let eBase : (B ⊗[R] S) ≃ₐ[B] D :=
    (adjoinRootBaseChangeAlgEquiv g).trans
      (AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq B _ _ hg)
  let eRing : T ≃+* D :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R S B).toRingEquiv.trans eBase.toRingEquiv
  let : Algebra S D := fullRootCoverSelectedRootAlgebra n a N y
  let e : T ≃ₐ[S] D := AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := S) (f := eRing) (fun x ↦ by
    change eBase ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] x) = algebraMap S D x
    rfl)
  exact Module.Finite.equiv e.toLinearEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fullRootCoverSelectedRoot_under_eq_span_root
statement:
theorem fullRootCoverSelectedRoot_under_eq_span_root
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {d : ℕ} (n : Fin d → ℕ) (a : Fin d → R)
    (hn : ∀ k, 0 < n k) (N : ℕ) (y : R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R d n a
    let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
    let S := AdjoinRoot g
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let D := AdjoinRoot F
    letI : Algebra S D := fullRootCoverSelectedRootAlgebra n a N y
    ∀ [IsDomain S] [IsIntegrallyClosed S] [IsDomain D]
      (_hroot : Prime (AdjoinRoot.root g))
      (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime], q.height = 1 →
      q = Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D) →
      q.under S = Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root g} : Set S) := by
  dsimp only
  intro _ _ _ hroot q _ hqHeight hq
  let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
  let g : R[X] := X ^ N - C y
  let S := AdjoinRoot g
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let D := AdjoinRoot F
  let : Algebra S D := fullRootCoverSelectedRootAlgebra n a N y
  let : Module.Finite S D :=
    fullRootCoverSelectedRoot_moduleFinite n a hn N y
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral S D := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite S D
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat S D :=
    fullRootCoverSelectedRoot_faithfullyFlat n a hn N y
  let : FaithfulSMul S D := Module.FaithfullyFlat.faithfulSMul
  have hUnderHeight : (q.under S).height = 1 := by
    rw [← SpecialLocalPurity.height_eq_height_under_of_faithfully_integral_over_integrallyClosed q]
    exact hqHeight
  have hrootMem : AdjoinRoot.root g ∈ q.under S := by
    change algebraMap S D (AdjoinRoot.root g) ∈ q
    rw [fullRootCoverSelectedRootAlgebra_map_root]
    rw [hq]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  exact (q.under S).eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one
    hUnderHeight hrootMem hroot

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgEquiv_algebraMap_actualRoot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgEquiv_algebraMap_actualRoot
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 1) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (y : R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)

    let fy : Xroot[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R Xroot y)

        (algebraMap B (AdjoinRoot F)
          (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k)) =
      algebraMap Xroot (AdjoinRoot fy) (AdjoinRoot.root px) := by
  dsimp only

          (AdjoinRoot
            (X ^ N - C (algebraMap R
              (iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a) y)))
          (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k))) = _
  rw [fullRootCoverActualRootLastAlgEquiv_algebraMap_root]
  rw [← twoRootSwapAlgEquiv_algebraMap_root]
  exact eSwap.symm_apply_apply _

  rw [← twoRootSwapAlgEquiv_root]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgebra_map_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgebra_map_root
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 1) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (y : R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let px : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
    let Xroot := AdjoinRoot px
    letI : Algebra Xroot (AdjoinRoot F) :=
      fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgebra n a k hother N y
    algebraMap Xroot (AdjoinRoot F) (AdjoinRoot.root px) =
      algebraMap B (AdjoinRoot F) (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k) := by
  dsimp only
  let B := iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let px : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
  let Xroot := AdjoinRoot px
  let fy : Xroot[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R Xroot y)
  let e := fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgEquiv n a k hother N y
  let : Algebra Xroot (AdjoinRoot F) :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgebra n a k hother N y
  apply e.injective
  change e (e.symm (algebraMap Xroot (AdjoinRoot fy)
      (AdjoinRoot.root px))) =
    e (algebraMap B (AdjoinRoot F) (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k))
  rw [e.apply_symm_apply,
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgEquiv_algebraMap_actualRoot]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fullRootCoverActualRootFirst_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem fullRootCoverActualRootFirst_isScalarTower
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {s : ℕ} (n : Fin (s + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (s + 1) → R)
    (k : Fin (s + 1)) (hother : ∀ l, l ≠ k → n l = 1)
    (N : ℕ) (y : R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
    let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
    let D := AdjoinRoot F
    let gx : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
    let Xroot := AdjoinRoot gx
    letI : Algebra Xroot D :=
      fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgebra n a k hother N y
    IsScalarTower R Xroot D := by
  dsimp only
  let B := iteratedRadical R (s + 1) n a
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let D := AdjoinRoot F
  let gx : R[X] := X ^ n k - C (a k)
  let Xroot := AdjoinRoot gx
  let fy : Xroot[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R Xroot y)
  let Dxy := AdjoinRoot fy
  let : Algebra Xroot D :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgebra n a k hother N y
  let eD : D ≃ₐ[R] Dxy :=
    fullRootCoverActualRootFirstAlgEquiv n a k hother N y
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro x
  change algebraMap R D x =
    eD.symm (algebraMap Xroot Dxy (algebraMap R Xroot x))
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Xroot Dxy]
  rw [← eD.commutes]
  exact (eD.symm_apply_apply _).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isSepClosed_of_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem isSepClosed_of_ringEquiv
    {k l : Type u} [Field k] [Field l] [IsSepClosed k]
    (e : k ≃+* l) : IsSepClosed l
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro p hp
  have hp' : (p.map e.symm.toRingHom).Separable :=
    hp.map (f := e.symm.toRingHom)
  have hsplit : (p.map e.symm.toRingHom).Splits :=
    IsSepClosed.splits_of_separable _ hp'
  simpa only [Polynomial.map_map, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    RingEquiv.comp_symm, Polynomial.map_id] using hsplit.map e.toRingHom

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.residueFieldMap_bijective_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_bijective_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : R} (ha : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    let B
proof:
:= AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
      faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
    Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R B)) := by
  dsimp only
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
  let B := AdjoinRoot f
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
  constructor
  · exact (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R B)).injective
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
    induction b using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
    | _ p =>
        refine ⟨IsLocalRing.residue R (p.coeff 0), ?_⟩
        rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
        have hroot :
            AdjoinRoot.root f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B := by
          rw [maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha]
          exact
            (show Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root f} ≤
                localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a from le_sup_right)
              (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (AdjoinRoot.root f))
        have hroot_residue :
            IsLocalRing.residue B (AdjoinRoot.root f) = 0 :=
          (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).2 hroot
        change IsLocalRing.residue B (AdjoinRoot.of f (p.coeff 0)) =
          IsLocalRing.residue B (AdjoinRoot.mk f p)
        symm
        calc
          IsLocalRing.residue B (AdjoinRoot.mk f p) =
              IsLocalRing.residue B
                (AdjoinRoot.mk f
                  (X * p.divX + C (p.coeff 0))) := by
            rw [Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add]
          _ = IsLocalRing.residue B
              (AdjoinRoot.of f (p.coeff 0)) := by
            rw [map_add, map_mul, AdjoinRoot.mk_X, AdjoinRoot.mk_C,
              map_add, map_mul, hroot_residue, zero_mul, zero_add]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [hA : IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
      faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
    Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)) := by
  dsimp only
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      simp only [iteratedRadical]
      constructor
      · exact (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A A)).injective
      · intro y
        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := @IsLocalRing.residue_surjective A _ hA y
        refine ⟨@IsLocalRing.residue A _ hA x, ?_⟩
        rfl
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let : IsLocalRing T :=
        isLocalRing_iteratedRadical
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ ha i.castSucc)
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A T :=
        faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc)
      have haLast :
          algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T :=
        algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ ha i.castSucc)
          (ha (Fin.last r))
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      let B := AdjoinRoot f
      let : IsLocalRing B :=
        isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C (hn (Fin.last r)) haLast
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat T B :=
        faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
          (hn (Fin.last r)) (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
        Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans A T B
      have hinit : Function.Bijective
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A T)) :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ ha i.castSucc)
      have hlast : Function.Bijective
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap T B)) :=
        residueFieldMap_bijective_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
          (hn (Fin.last r)) haLast
      change Function.Bijective
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B))
      constructor
      · exact (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)).injective
      · intro z
        obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hlast.2 z
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hinit.2 y
        refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨x₀, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective x
        calc
          IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)
              (IsLocalRing.residue A x₀) =
              IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap T B)
                (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A T)
                  (IsLocalRing.residue A x₀)) := by
            rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
              IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
              IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A T B]
          _ = IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap T B) y := by rw [hx]
          _ = z := hy

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isSepClosed_residueField_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem isSepClosed_residueField_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : R} (ha : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    let B
proof:
:= AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
      faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
    IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) := by
  dsimp only
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
  let B := AdjoinRoot f
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
  let e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R ≃+*
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField B :=
    RingEquiv.ofBijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R B))
      (residueFieldMap_bijective_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha)
  exact isSepClosed_of_ringEquiv e

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isSepClosed_residueField_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem isSepClosed_residueField_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)

proof:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localRootCoverClosedIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem localRootCoverClosedIdeal_isMaximal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {a : R} (ha : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    (localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
  let B := AdjoinRoot f
  have hf : f.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne'
  let : Nontrivial B :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (by
      intro htop
      have hunit : IsUnit f := Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mp htop
      apply hn.ne'
      rw [← @Polynomial.natDegree_one R,
        ← hf.eq_one_of_isUnit hunit, Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C])
  have hEval : Polynomial.eval₂ (IsLocalRing.residue R) 0 f = 0 := by
    simp only [f, Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_pow,
      Polynomial.eval₂_X, zero_pow hn.ne', Polynomial.eval₂_C,
      (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff a).mpr ha, sub_zero]
  let q : B →+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField R :=
    AdjoinRoot.lift (IsLocalRing.residue R) 0 hEval
  have hq_surjective : Function.Surjective q := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective x
    exact ⟨AdjoinRoot.of f r, AdjoinRoot.lift_of hEval⟩
  have hq_ker : RingHom.ker q = localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x hx
      induction x using AdjoinRoot.induction_on with
      | _ p =>
          have hcoeff : p.coeff 0 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
            rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hx
            change
              (AdjoinRoot.lift (IsLocalRing.residue R) 0 hEval)
                  (AdjoinRoot.mk f p) = 0 at hx
            rw [AdjoinRoot.lift_mk] at hx
            simpa only [Polynomial.eval₂_at_zero, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff] using hx
          rw [← Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add p, map_add, map_mul,
            AdjoinRoot.mk_X, AdjoinRoot.mk_C]
          have hrootIn :
              AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a) ∈
                localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a :=
            (show Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)} ≤
                localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a from le_sup_right)
              (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self
                (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)))
          have hbaseIn :
              AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a) (p.coeff 0) ∈
                localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a :=
            (show Ideal.map (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a))
                  (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ≤
                localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a from le_sup_left)
              (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a)) hcoeff)
          apply Ideal.add_mem
          · exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hrootIn
          · exact hbaseIn
    · apply sup_le
      · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
        intro r hr
        rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker]
        change
          (AdjoinRoot.lift (IsLocalRing.residue R) 0 hEval)
              (AdjoinRoot.of f r) = 0
        rw [AdjoinRoot.lift_of hEval, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]
        exact hr
      · rw [Ideal.span_le]
        rintro x (rfl : x = AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a))
        change q (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)) = 0
        exact AdjoinRoot.lift_root hEval
  rw [← hq_ker]
  exact RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective q hq_surjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {a : R} (ha : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))
proof:
:= by
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
  let B := AdjoinRoot f
  have hf : f.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne'
  let : Module.Finite R B := hf.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R B
  refine IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal
    ⟨localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a,
      localRootCoverClosedIdeal_isMaximal hn ha, ?_⟩
  intro M hM
  let : M.IsMaximal := hM
  have hcomapMax :
      (M.comap (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a))).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal
      (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a)) (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := R) x) M
  have hcomap :
      M.comap (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a)) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hcomapMax
  have hbase :
      Ideal.map (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a))
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ≤ M := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, hcomap]
  have hrootPow :
      AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a) ^ n ∈ M := by
    rw [adjoinRoot_root_pow]
    exact hbase (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a)) ha)
  have hroot : AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a) ∈ M :=
    hM.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem n hrootPow
  have hclosed_le : localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a ≤ M := by
    apply sup_le hbase
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    simpa only [Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  exact ((localRootCoverClosedIdeal_isMaximal hn ha).eq_of_le hM.ne_top hclosed_le).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {a : R} (ha : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    [IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))] :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)) =
      localRootCoverClosedIdeal R n a
proof:
:= by
  exact (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (localRootCoverClosedIdeal_isMaximal hn ha)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalIdeal_fg_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_fg_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).FG := by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      change (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG
      exact hmax
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      let : IsLocalRing T :=
        isLocalRing_iteratedRadical
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ ha i.castSucc)
      have hmaxT : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T).FG :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ ha i.castSucc)
      have haLast :
          algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T :=
        algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ ha i.castSucc)
          (ha (Fin.last r))
      let : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C (hn (Fin.last r)) haLast
      change (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot f)).FG
      rw [maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
        (hn (Fin.last r)) haLast]
      exact Submodule.FG.sup
        (hmaxT.map (AdjoinRoot.of f))
        (Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_singleton (AdjoinRoot.root f)))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B := by
  dsimp only
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.Free A B := free_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let I : Ideal B :=
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A B)
  let J : Ideal B := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B
  have hcompleteBase :
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) B :=
    isAdicComplete_of_moduleFinite_of_moduleFree
      (I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (M := B)
  let : IsAdicComplete I B :=
    (isAdicComplete_map_algebraMap_iff
      (R := A) (S := B) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)).2 hcompleteBase
  have hIJ : I ≤ J := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro x hx
    exact algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical n a hn ha hx
  have hJradical : J ≤ I.radical := by
    rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf]
    refine le_sInf fun P hP ↦ ?_
    rcases hP with ⟨hIP, hPprime⟩
    let : P.IsPrime := hPprime
    have hbase_le : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ≤
        P.comap (algebraMap A B) :=
      (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).1 hIP
    have hcomap_ne_top : P.comap (algebraMap A B) ≠ ⊤ :=
      (show (P.comap (algebraMap A B)).IsPrime from inferInstance).ne_top
    have hcomap_eq : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A =
        P.comap (algebraMap A B) :=
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A).eq_of_le
        hcomap_ne_top hbase_le
    have hcomap_maximal :
        (P.comap (algebraMap A B)).IsMaximal := by
      rw [← hcomap_eq]
      exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A
    have hPmaximal : P.IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under
        (R := A) (S := B) P hcomap_maximal
    have hP_eq : P = J := IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hPmaximal
    rw [hP_eq]
  have hJfg : J.FG :=
    maximalIdeal_fg_iteratedRadical hmax n a hn ha
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg hJradical hJfg
  have hk' : J ^ (k + 1) ≤ I :=
    (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.le_add_right k 1)).trans hk
  exact isAdicComplete_of_le_of_pow_le
    I J (Nat.zero_lt_succ k) hIJ (by simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hk')

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B := by
  exact isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing n a hn ha

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.henselianLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_isAdicComplete_of_fg
statement:
theorem henselianLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_isAdicComplete_of_fg
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    HenselianLocalRing B := by
  dsimp only
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
    isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg hmax n a hn ha

  refine
    { is_henselian := ?_ }

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.henselianLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_isAdicComplete
statement:
theorem henselianLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_isAdicComplete
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_iteratedRadical_of_fg
statement:
theorem algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_iteratedRadical_of_fg
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    ∀ {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra B S]
      [Module.Finite B S] [Algebra.Etale B S],
      ∀ (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
        [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)],
        (∀ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime →
          Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) → Q = q) →
        Function.Bijective (algebraMap B S) := by
  dsimp only
  intro S _ _ _ _ q _ _ hunique
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : HenselianLocalRing B :=
    henselianLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_isAdicComplete_of_fg
      hmax n a hn ha
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) :=
    isSepClosed_residueField_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  exact
    algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_maximal_of_strictHenselian
      q hunique

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]

      [Module.Finite B S] [Algebra.Etale B S],
      ∀ (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.algebraMap_bijective_adjoinRootOne
statement:
theorem algebraMap_bijective_adjoinRootOne
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (a : R) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot (X ^ 1 - C a)))
proof:
:= by
  let e := adjoinRootOneAlgEquiv a
  have he : (e.symm : R → AdjoinRoot (X ^ 1 - C a)) =
      algebraMap R (AdjoinRoot (X ^ 1 - C a)) := by
    funext x
    exact e.symm.commutes x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_mem_or_eq_one
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_mem_or_eq_one
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : R}
    (hstage : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∨ n = 1) :
    IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hstage with ha | rfl
  · exact isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha
  · exact (adjoinRootOneAlgEquiv a).symm.toRingEquiv.isLocalRing

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_and_map_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_or_eq_one
statement:
private theorem exists_isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_and_map_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_or_eq_one
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hstage : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ∨ n i = 1) :
    ∃ hlocal : IsLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a),
      ∀ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A,
        algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) x ∈
          @IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (iteratedRadical A r n a) _ hlocal
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      change ∃ hlocal : IsLocalRing A,
        ∀ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A,
          algebraMap A A x ∈ @IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A _ hlocal
      refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      simpa using hx
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      obtain ⟨hT, hmapT⟩ :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ hstage i.castSucc)
      let : IsLocalRing T := hT
      have hstageLast :
          algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T ∨
            n (Fin.last r) = 1 := by
        rcases hstage (Fin.last r) with ha | heq
        · exact Or.inl (hmapT _ ha)
        · exact Or.inr heq
      have hB : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_mem_or_eq_one
          (hn (Fin.last r)) hstageLast
      refine ⟨hB, ?_⟩
      let : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot f) := hB
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat T (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
          (hn (Fin.last r)) (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      intro x hx
      change algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot f) x ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot f)
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A T (AdjoinRoot f)]
      exact map_nonunit (algebraMap T (AdjoinRoot f)) _ (hmapT x hx)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_mem_or_eq_one
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_mem_or_eq_one
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hstage : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ∨ n i = 1) :
    IsLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:=
  (exists_isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_and_map_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_or_eq_one
    n a hn hstage).choose

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_mem_or_eq_one
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_mem_or_eq_one
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hstage : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ∨ n i = 1)
    [IsLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a)]
    {x : A} (hx : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) x ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    (exists_isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_and_map_mem_maximalIdeal_of_mem_or_eq_one
      n a hn hstage).choose_spec x hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.residueFieldMap_bijective_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_mem_or_eq_one
statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_bijective_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_mem_or_eq_one
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : R}
    (hstage : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∨ n = 1) :
    let B
proof:
:= AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)
    letI : IsLocalRing B :=
      isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_mem_or_eq_one hn hstage
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
      faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
    Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R B)) := by
  dsimp only
  rcases hstage with ha | hOne
  · simpa using residueFieldMap_bijective_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha
  · subst n
    let B := AdjoinRoot (X ^ 1 - C a)
    let : IsLocalRing B :=
      isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_mem_or_eq_one Nat.one_pos (Or.inr rfl)
    let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
      faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C Nat.one_pos a
    constructor
    · exact (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R B)).injective
    · intro y
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (algebraMap_bijective_adjoinRootOne a).2 b
      exact ⟨IsLocalRing.residue R x, IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue _ x⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical_of_mem_or_eq_one
statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical_of_mem_or_eq_one
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [hA : IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hstage : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ∨ n i = 1) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B :=
      isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_mem_or_eq_one n a hn hstage
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
      faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
    Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)) := by
  dsimp only
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      simp only [iteratedRadical]
      constructor
      · exact (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A A)).injective
      · intro y
        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := @IsLocalRing.residue_surjective A _ hA y
        exact ⟨@IsLocalRing.residue A _ hA x, rfl⟩
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let : IsLocalRing T :=
        isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_mem_or_eq_one
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ hstage i.castSucc)
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A T :=
        faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc)
      have hstageLast :
          algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T ∨
            n (Fin.last r) = 1 := by
        rcases hstage (Fin.last r) with ha | heq
        · exact Or.inl
            (algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_mem_or_eq_one
              (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
              (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ hstage i.castSucc) ha)
        · exact Or.inr heq
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      let B := AdjoinRoot f
      let : IsLocalRing B :=
        isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_mem_or_eq_one
          (hn (Fin.last r)) hstageLast
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat T B :=
        faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C
          (hn (Fin.last r)) (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
        Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans A T B
      have hinit : Function.Bijective
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A T)) :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ hstage i.castSucc)
      have hlast : Function.Bijective
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap T B)) :=
        residueFieldMap_bijective_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_mem_or_eq_one
          (hn (Fin.last r)) hstageLast
      change Function.Bijective
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B))
      constructor
      · exact (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)).injective
      · intro z
        obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hlast.2 z
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hinit.2 y
        refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨x₀, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective x
        calc
          IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A B)
              (IsLocalRing.residue A x₀) =
              IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap T B)
                (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap A T)
                  (IsLocalRing.residue A x₀)) := by
            rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
              IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
              IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A T B]
          _ = IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap T B) y := by rw [hx]
          _ = z := hy

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalRoot_last
statement:
theorem iteratedRadicalRoot_last {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ}
    (n : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A) :
    iteratedRadicalRoot A n a (Fin.last r) =
      AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n (Fin.last r) -
        C (algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)) (a (Fin.last r))))
proof:
:= by
  let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A := iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
  let p : T[X] := X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
  change Fin.lastCases (motive := fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => AdjoinRoot p)
    (AdjoinRoot.root p)
    (fun k => AdjoinRoot.of p (iteratedRadicalRoot A (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) k))
    (Fin.last r) = AdjoinRoot.root p
  exact Fin.lastCases_last

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalRoot_castSucc
statement:
theorem iteratedRadicalRoot_castSucc {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ}
    (n : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A) (j : Fin r) :
    iteratedRadicalRoot A n a j.castSucc =
      AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n (Fin.last r) -
        C (algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)) (a (Fin.last r))))
        (iteratedRadicalRoot A (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) j)
proof:
:= by
  let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A := iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
  let p : T[X] := X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
  change Fin.lastCases (motive := fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => AdjoinRoot p)
    (AdjoinRoot.root p)
    (fun k => AdjoinRoot.of p (iteratedRadicalRoot A (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) k))
    (j.castSucc) = AdjoinRoot.of p (iteratedRadicalRoot A (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) j)
  exact Fin.lastCases_castSucc j

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalRoot_pow
statement:
theorem iteratedRadicalRoot_pow
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (i : Fin r) :
    iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i ^ n i =
      algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) (a i)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i
      · rw [iteratedRadicalRoot_last]
        change AdjoinRoot.root f ^ n (Fin.last r) =
          algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot f) (a (Fin.last r))
        rw [show f = X ^ n (Fin.last r) -
            C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r))) by rfl,
          adjoinRoot_root_pow]
        rfl
      · rw [iteratedRadicalRoot_castSucc]
        change AdjoinRoot.of f
            (iteratedRadicalRoot A (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) j) ^
              n j.castSucc =
          algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot f) (a j.castSucc)
        rw [show n j.castSucc = Fin.init n j by rfl]
        rw [← map_pow, ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) j]
        rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.algebraMap_prod_radicands_eq_prod_iteratedRadicalRoot_pow
statement:
theorem algebraMap_prod_radicands_eq_prod_iteratedRadicalRoot_pow
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) :
    algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) (∏ i, a i) =
      ∏ i, iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i ^ n i
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦
    (iteratedRadicalRoot_pow n a i).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.disjoint_powers_prod_radicands_of_iteratedRadicalRoots_not_mem
statement:
theorem disjoint_powers_prod_radicands_of_iteratedRadicalRoots_not_mem
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (q : Ideal (iteratedRadical A r n a)) [q.IsPrime]
    (havoid : ∀ i, iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i ∉ q) :
    Disjoint
      ((Submonoid.powers
        (algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) (∏ i, a i)) :
          Submonoid (iteratedRadical A r n a)) :
        Set (iteratedRadical A r n a))
      (q : Set (iteratedRadical A r n a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime]
  rw [algebraMap_prod_radicands_eq_prod_iteratedRadicalRoot_pow]
  rw [Ideal.IsPrime.prod_mem_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_exists]
  intro i hpow
  exact havoid i ((inferInstance : q.IsPrime).mem_of_pow_mem (n i) hpow)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.map_to_away_prod_radicands_isPrime_of_iteratedRadicalRoots_not_mem
statement:
theorem map_to_away_prod_radicands_isPrime_of_iteratedRadicalRoots_not_mem
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (q : Ideal (iteratedRadical A r n a)) [q.IsPrime]
    (havoid : ∀ i, iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i ∉ q) :
    (q.map (algebraMap (iteratedRadical A r n a)
      (Localization.Away
        (algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) (∏ i, a i))))).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  exact IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint
    (Submonoid.powers
      (algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) (∏ i, a i)))
    (Localization.Away
      (algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) (∏ i, a i)))
    q inferInstance
    (disjoint_powers_prod_radicands_of_iteratedRadicalRoots_not_mem
      n a q havoid)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.under_eq_span_radicand_of_height_eq_one_of_iteratedRadicalRoot_mem
statement:
theorem under_eq_span_radicand_of_height_eq_one_of_iteratedRadicalRoot_mem
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (q : Ideal (iteratedRadical A r n a)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqheight : q.height = 1) (i : Fin r)
    (hai : Prime (a i))
    (hroot : iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i ∈ q) :
    q.under A = Ideal.span {a i}
proof:
:= by
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let p : Ideal A := q.under A
  let branch : Ideal A := Ideal.span {a i}
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B := faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite A B
  let : branch.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hai
  have hradicand_q : algebraMap A B (a i) ∈ q := by
    rw [← iteratedRadicalRoot_pow n a i]
    exact Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem q hroot (n i) (hn i)
  have hbranch_le : branch ≤ p := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst x
    exact hradicand_q
  have hbranch_height : branch.height = 1 := by
    exact Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hai.ne_zero)
      hai.not_isUnit
  have hp_height_le : p.height ≤ q.height := by
    rw [Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown p q]
    exact le_add_right (le_refl p.height)
  have hp_height_le_branch : p.height ≤ branch.height := by
    rw [hbranch_height, ← hqheight]
    exact hp_height_le
  exact (branch.eq_of_le_of_height_le hbranch_le hp_height_le_branch).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exponent_dvd_ramificationIdx_of_height_eq_one_of_iteratedRadicalRoot_mem
statement:
theorem exponent_dvd_ramificationIdx_of_height_eq_one_of_iteratedRadicalRoot_mem
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (q : Ideal (iteratedRadical A r n a)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqheight : q.height = 1) (i : Fin r)
    (hai : Prime (a i))
    (hroot : iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i ∈ q) :
    n i ∣ q.ramificationIdx A
proof:
:= by
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B := faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let Sq := Localization.AtPrime q
  have hunder : q.under A = Ideal.span {a i} :=
    under_eq_span_radicand_of_height_eq_one_of_iteratedRadicalRoot_mem
      n a hn q hqheight i hai hroot
  let z : B := iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i
  let zq : Sq := algebraMap B Sq z
  have hmap_radicand_regular :
      algebraMap A B (a i) ∈ nonZeroDivisors B := by
    rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left]
    intro x hx
    have hregular : IsSMulRegular B (a i) :=
      Module.Flat.isSMulRegular_of_nonZeroDivisors
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hai.ne_zero)
    apply hregular
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, map_zero, mul_zero] using hx
  have hz_regular : z ∈ nonZeroDivisors B := by
    rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left]
    intro x hzx
    have hpowx : z ^ n i * x = 0 := by
      rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hn i).ne'),
        pow_succ, mul_assoc, hzx, mul_zero]
    apply (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left.mp hmap_radicand_regular) x
    rw [← iteratedRadicalRoot_pow n a i]
    exact hpowx
  have hzq_regular : zq ∈ nonZeroDivisors Sq :=
    IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap q.primeCompl Sq hz_regular
  have hzpow : zq ^ n i = algebraMap A Sq (a i) := by
    calc
      zq ^ n i = algebraMap B Sq (z ^ n i) := (map_pow _ z (n i)).symm
      _ = algebraMap B Sq (algebraMap A B (a i)) := by
        rw [iteratedRadicalRoot_pow n a i]
      _ = algebraMap A Sq (a i) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B Sq (a i)
  have hmap_under :
      (q.under A).map (algebraMap A Sq) = Ideal.span {zq ^ n i} := by
    rw [hunder, Ideal.map_span]
    simp only [Set.image_singleton]
    rw [hzpow]
  rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_def, hmap_under]
  change n i ∣ (Ring.ord Sq (zq ^ n i)).toNat
  rw [Ring.ord_pow hzq_regular, nsmul_eq_mul, ENat.toNat_mul,
    ENat.toNat_natCast]
  exact dvd_mul_right (n i) (Ring.ord Sq zq).toNat

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.heightOnePrime_away_or_exists_branch_under_eq_and_exponent_dvd
statement:
theorem heightOnePrime_away_or_exists_branch_under_eq_and_exponent_dvd
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (ha : ∀ i, Prime (a i))
    (q : Ideal (iteratedRadical A r n a)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqheight : q.height = 1) :
    Disjoint
        ((Submonoid.powers
          (algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) (∏ i, a i)) :
            Submonoid (iteratedRadical A r n a)) :
          Set (iteratedRadical A r n a))
        (q : Set (iteratedRadical A r n a)) ∨
      ∃ i,
        q.under A = Ideal.span {a i} ∧
          n i ∣ q.ramificationIdx A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases havoid : ∀ i, iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i ∉ q
  · exact Or.inl
      (disjoint_powers_prod_radicands_of_iteratedRadicalRoots_not_mem
        n a q havoid)
  · simp only [not_forall, not_not] at havoid
    obtain ⟨i, hroot⟩ := havoid
    exact Or.inr ⟨i,
      under_eq_span_radicand_of_height_eq_one_of_iteratedRadicalRoot_mem
        n a hn q hqheight i (ha i) hroot,
      exponent_dvd_ramificationIdx_of_height_eq_one_of_iteratedRadicalRoot_mem
        n a hn q hqheight i (ha i) hroot⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_and_map_mem_maximalIdeal
statement:
private theorem exists_isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_and_map_mem_maximalIdeal
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    ∃ hlocal : IsLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a),
      ∀ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A,
        algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) x ∈
          @IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (iteratedRadical A r n a) _ hlocal
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      change ∃ hlocal : IsLocalRing A,
        ∀ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A,
          algebraMap A A x ∈ @IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A _ hlocal
      refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      simpa using hx
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      obtain ⟨hT, hmapT⟩ :=
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
          (fun i ↦ hn i.castSucc) (fun i ↦ ha i.castSucc)
      let : IsLocalRing T := hT
      have haLast :
          algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T :=
        hmapT (a (Fin.last r)) (ha (Fin.last r))
      have hB : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C (hn (Fin.last r)) haLast
      refine ⟨hB, ?_⟩
      let : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot f) := hB
      intro x hx
      change algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot f) x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot f)
      rw [maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C (hn (Fin.last r)) haLast]
      refine (show Ideal.map (AdjoinRoot.of f) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T) ≤
        localRootCoverClosedIdeal T (n (Fin.last r))
          (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r))) from le_sup_left) ?_
      have hxT : algebraMap A T x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T := hmapT x hx
      have hmem :
          AdjoinRoot.of f (algebraMap A T x) ∈
            Ideal.map (AdjoinRoot.of f) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T) :=
        Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (AdjoinRoot.of f) hxT
