      simpa [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A T (AdjoinRoot f)] using hmem

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isLocalRing_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    IsLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:=
  (exists_isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_and_map_mem_maximalIdeal n a hn ha).choose

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    [IsLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a)]
    {x : A} (hx : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) x ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    (exists_isLocalRing_iteratedRadical_and_map_mem_maximalIdeal n a hn ha).choose_spec x hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localRootCover_regularSystem_geometry
statement:
theorem localRootCover_regularSystem_geometry
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : R} {rs : List R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R (a :: rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (a :: rs) = maximalIdeal R) :
    let B
proof:
:= AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)
    let bs := localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs
    let _ : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn (by
      rw [← hgen]
      exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self)
    IsNoetherianRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
      IsRegular B bs ∧ Ideal.ofList bs = maximalIdeal B ∧
      ∀ p ∈ bs, Prime p := by
  intro B bs localB
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
  have haMem : a ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  have hf : f.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne'
  let : Module.Finite R B := hf.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R B
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B := by
    simpa [f] using faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
  have haRegR : IsSMulRegular R a :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff R a rs).mp hreg).1
  have haTensor :
      @IsSMulRegular R (TensorProduct R B R) _ a := haRegR.lTensor B
  have haRegB : @IsSMulRegular R B _ a :=
    ((TensorProduct.rid R B).isSMulRegular_congr a).mp haTensor
  have hrootReg : IsSMulRegular B (AdjoinRoot.root f) := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro z hz
    apply haRegB.right_eq_zero_of_smul
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq]
    rw [show AdjoinRoot.of f a = AdjoinRoot.root f ^ n by
      simpa [f] using (adjoinRoot_root_pow n a).symm]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn.ne'
    have hz' : AdjoinRoot.root f * z = 0 := by
      exact hz
    calc
      (AdjoinRoot.root f : B) ^ n * z =
          (AdjoinRoot.root f : B) ^ (k + 1) * z :=
        congrArg (fun m : ℕ ↦ (AdjoinRoot.root f : B) ^ m * z) hk
      _ = (AdjoinRoot.root f : B) ^ k * ((AdjoinRoot.root f : B) * z) :=
        congrArg (fun t : B ↦ t * z) (pow_succ (AdjoinRoot.root f : B) k) |>.trans
          (mul_assoc _ _ _)
      _ = 0 := by rw [hz', mul_zero]
  let Iroot : Ideal B := Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root f}
  let Ia : Ideal R := Ideal.span {a}
  let QB := B ⧸ Iroot
  let QA := R ⧸ Ia
  have hrootMem : AdjoinRoot.root f ∈ maximalIdeal B := by
    have hmem : AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a) ∈
        Ideal.ofList (localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs) := by
      rw [localRootCoverParameterList, Ideal.ofList_cons]
      exact (show Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)} ≤
          Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)} ⊔
            Ideal.ofList (rs.map (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a))) from le_sup_left)
        (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
    rw [ideal_ofList_localRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal hn hgen] at hmem
    simpa [f, B] using hmem
  have hIrootLe : Iroot ≤ maximalIdeal B := by
    change Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root f} ≤ maximalIdeal B
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    exact hrootMem
  have hIrootNe : Iroot ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal B).ne_top hIrootLe
  let : Nontrivial QB := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIrootNe
  have haMem' : a ∈ maximalIdeal R := haMem
  have hIaLe : Ia ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    change Ideal.span {a} ≤ maximalIdeal R
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    exact haMem'
  have hIaNe : Ia ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIaLe
  let : Nontrivial QA := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIaNe
  let : IsLocalRing QA :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ia)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing QA :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R QA (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ia)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hquot := regularSystem_quotientHead hreg hgen
  have hregQA : IsRegular QA (rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ia)) := by
    simpa [Ia, QA] using hquot.1
  let eRing : QB ≃+* QA := by
    simpa [B, QB, QA, Iroot, Ia, f] using
      (adjoinRootQuotientRootEquiv hn a)
  have eRing_mk_of (r : R) :
      eRing (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iroot (AdjoinRoot.of f r)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk Ia r := by
    simp [eRing, B, QB, QA, Iroot, Ia, f]
  have hmap :
      (((rs.map (AdjoinRoot.of f)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iroot)).map
        (eRing : QB →+* QA)) =
        rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ia) := by
    simp only [List.map_map]
    apply congrArg (fun g => rs.map g)
    funext r
    exact eRing_mk_of r
  have hregQB : IsRegular QB
      ((rs.map (AdjoinRoot.of f)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iroot)) := by
    apply (eRing.toSemilinearEquiv.isRegular_congr'
      ((rs.map (AdjoinRoot.of f)).map
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iroot))).mpr
    rw [hmap]
    exact hregQA
  let eMod : QuotSMulTop (AdjoinRoot.root f) B ≃ₗ[QB] QB :=
    ((QuotSMulTop.equivQuotTensor (AdjoinRoot.root f) B).extendScalarsOfSurjective
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).trans
        ((TensorProduct.rid B QB).extendScalarsOfSurjective
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)
  have hregQ : IsRegular (QuotSMulTop (AdjoinRoot.root f) B)
      ((rs.map (AdjoinRoot.of f)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iroot)) :=
    (eMod.isRegular_congr _).mpr hregQB
  have hregB : IsRegular B (localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs) := by
    rw [localRootCoverParameterList]
    exact (isRegular_cons_iff' B (AdjoinRoot.root f)
      (rs.map (AdjoinRoot.of f))).mpr ⟨hrootReg, by
        simpa [Iroot, B] using hregQ⟩
  have hgenB : Ideal.ofList (localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs) =
      maximalIdeal B := by
    simpa [B, f] using
      (ideal_ofList_localRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal hn hgen)
  have hdomainB : IsDomain B :=
    isDomain_of_regularSystem (localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs)
      hregB hgenB
  let : IsDomain B := hdomainB
  refine ⟨inferInstance, hdomainB, hregB, hgenB, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  exact prime_of_mem_regularSystem hregB hgenB hp

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.ideal_ofList_eq_of_perm
statement:
private theorem ideal_ofList_eq_of_perm
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {xs ys : List R} (h : xs.Perm ys) :
    Ideal.ofList xs = Ideal.ofList ys
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg Ideal.span
  ext x
  exact h.mem_iff

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.constructionList_cons
statement:
private theorem constructionList_cons
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (x : A) (rs : List A) :
    iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a (x :: rs) =
      algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) x ::
        iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      change x :: rs = algebraMap A A x :: rs
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      change
        (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A
            (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) (x :: rs)).map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ++
              [AdjoinRoot.root f] =
          algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot f) x ::
            (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A
              (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) rs).map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ++
                [AdjoinRoot.root f]
      rw [ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a), List.map_cons]
      congr 1

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedConstructionList_regularSystem
statement:
private theorem iteratedConstructionList_regularSystem
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hreg : IsRegular A (List.ofFn a ++ rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A)
    [IsLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a)]
    [IsNoetherianRing (iteratedRadical A r n a)] :
    IsRegular (iteratedRadical A r n a)
        (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs) ∧
      Ideal.ofList (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs) =
        maximalIdeal (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing rs with
  | zero =>
      let B := iteratedRadical A 0 n a
      have hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap A B) := by
        change Function.Bijective (algebraMap A A)
        constructor
        · intro x y hxy
          simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply] using hxy
        · intro y
          exact ⟨y, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply y⟩
      let e : A ≃+* B := RingEquiv.ofBijective (algebraMap A B) hbij
      have he_apply (x : A) : e x = x := by
        change (algebraMap A A) x = x
        exact Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply x
      have hlist : rs.map e =
          iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs := by
        change rs.map e = rs
        clear hgen hreg
        induction rs with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons x xs ihRs =>
            simp only [List.map_cons]
            rw [he_apply x, ihRs]
            rfl
      have hregMap : IsRegular B (rs.map (e : A →+* B)) :=
        (e.toSemilinearEquiv.isRegular_congr' rs).mp (by simpa using hreg)
      constructor
      · simpa [hlist] using hregMap
      · have hgen' : Ideal.ofList rs = maximalIdeal A := by simpa using hgen
        calc
          Ideal.ofList (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs) =
              Ideal.map e (Ideal.ofList rs) := by
            rw [← hlist]
            exact (Ideal.map_ofList (e : A →+* B) rs).symm
          _ = Ideal.map e (maximalIdeal A) := congrArg (Ideal.map e) hgen'
          _ = maximalIdeal B := IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e
  | succ r ih =>
      let nInit : Fin r → ℕ := Fin.init n
      let aInit : Fin r → A := Fin.init a
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A := iteratedRadical A r nInit aInit
      let aLastT : T := algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r))
      let f : T[X] := X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C aLastT
      have hnInit : ∀ i, 0 < nInit i := fun i => hn i.castSucc
      have hregInit :
          IsRegular A (List.ofFn aInit ++ a (Fin.last r) :: rs) := by
        change IsRegular A
          (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin r => a i.castSucc) ++
            a (Fin.last r) :: rs)
        rw [List.ofFn_succ'] at hreg
        simpa only [List.concat_eq_append, List.append_assoc,
          List.singleton_append] using hreg
      have hgenInit :
          Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn aInit ++ a (Fin.last r) :: rs) =
            maximalIdeal A := by
        change Ideal.ofList
          (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin r => a i.castSucc) ++
            a (Fin.last r) :: rs) = maximalIdeal A
        rw [List.ofFn_succ'] at hgen
        simpa only [List.concat_eq_append, List.append_assoc,
          List.singleton_append] using hgen
      have haInit : ∀ i, aInit i ∈ maximalIdeal A := by
        intro i
        rw [← hgenInit]
        exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp [aInit])
      let : IsLocalRing T :=
        isLocalRing_iteratedRadical nInit aInit hnInit haInit
      let : Module.Finite A T :=
        finite_iteratedRadical nInit aInit hnInit
      let : IsNoetherianRing T := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite A T
      have hT := ih nInit aInit (a (Fin.last r) :: rs) hnInit hregInit hgenInit
      have hregT : IsRegular T
          (aLastT ::
            iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs) := by
        rw [constructionList_cons] at hT
        simpa [aLastT] using hT.1
      have hgenT : Ideal.ofList
          (aLastT ::
            iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs) =
          maximalIdeal T := by
        rw [constructionList_cons] at hT
        simpa [aLastT] using hT.2
      have haLastT : aLastT ∈ maximalIdeal T := by
        rw [← hgenT]
        exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
      let : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C (hn (Fin.last r)) haLastT
      have hf : f.Monic :=
        Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C aLastT (hn (Fin.last r)).ne'
      let : Module.Finite T (AdjoinRoot f) := hf.finite_adjoinRoot
      let : IsNoetherianRing (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        IsNoetherianRing.of_finite T (AdjoinRoot f)
      have hstep := localRootCover_regularSystem_geometry
        (R := T) (n := n (Fin.last r)) (a := aLastT)
        (rs := iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs)
        (hn (Fin.last r)) hregT hgenT
      have hregStep : IsRegular (AdjoinRoot f)
          (localRootCoverParameterList T (n (Fin.last r)) aLastT
            (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs)) := by
        simpa [f] using hstep.2.2.1
      have hgenStep : Ideal.ofList
          (localRootCoverParameterList T (n (Fin.last r)) aLastT
            (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs)) =
          maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot f) := by
        simpa [f] using hstep.2.2.2.1
      let cs := (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs).map
        (AdjoinRoot.of f)
      have hperm :
          (localRootCoverParameterList T (n (Fin.last r)) aLastT
              (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs)).Perm
            (cs ++ [AdjoinRoot.root f]) := by
        change (AdjoinRoot.root f :: cs).Perm (cs ++ [AdjoinRoot.root f])
        simpa only [List.singleton_append] using
          (List.perm_append_comm :
            ([AdjoinRoot.root f] ++ cs).Perm (cs ++ [AdjoinRoot.root f]))
      constructor
      · exact IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hregStep hperm
      · exact (ideal_ofList_eq_of_perm hperm).symm.trans hgenStep

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_regularSystem
statement:
theorem iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_regularSystem
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hreg : IsRegular A (List.ofFn a ++ rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    let bs := iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs
    let _ : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn (fun i => by
      rw [← hgen]
      exact Ideal.subset_span
        (List.mem_append_left rs (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
    IsRegular B bs ∧ Ideal.ofList bs = maximalIdeal B := by
  intro B bs localB
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite A B
  have hconstruction :=
    iteratedConstructionList_regularSystem n a rs hn hreg hgen
  have hperm :
      (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs).Perm
        (iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs) := by
    exact (List.reverse_perm
      (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs)).symm
  exact ⟨IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hconstruction.1 hperm,
    (ideal_ofList_eq_of_perm hperm).symm.trans hconstruction.2⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalRoot_mem_parameterList
statement:
theorem iteratedRadicalRoot_mem_parameterList
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ}
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A) (i : Fin r) :
    iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i ∈
      iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList]
  simp only [List.mem_reverse]
  induction r with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp only [iteratedRadicalRoot_last]
        change AdjoinRoot.root f ∈
          (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A
            (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) rs).map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ++
              [AdjoinRoot.root f]
        exact List.mem_append_right _
          (List.mem_singleton_self (AdjoinRoot.root f))
      · simp only [iteratedRadicalRoot_castSucc]
        change AdjoinRoot.of f
            (iteratedRadicalRoot A (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) j) ∈
          (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A
            (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) rs).map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ++
              [AdjoinRoot.root f]
        exact List.mem_append_left _
          (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) j, rfl⟩)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.algebraMap_mem_iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ}
    (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    {x : A} (hx : x ∈ rs) :
    algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) x ∈
      iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList]
  simp only [List.mem_reverse]
  induction rs with
  | nil => cases hx
  | cons y ys ih =>
      rw [constructionList_cons]
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx ⊢
      rcases hx with hxy | hx
      · left
        rw [hxy]
      · exact Or.inr (ih hx)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadical_regularSystem_geometry
statement:
theorem iteratedRadical_regularSystem_geometry
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hreg : IsRegular A (List.ofFn a ++ rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    let bs := iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs
    let _ : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn (fun i => by
      rw [← hgen]
      exact Ideal.subset_span
        (List.mem_append_left rs (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
    IsNoetherianRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧ IsRegularLocalRing B ∧
      IsRegular B bs ∧ Ideal.ofList bs = maximalIdeal B ∧
      (∀ p ∈ bs, Prime p) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ bs,
        IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span {p}) ∧
          IsRegularLocalRing (B ⧸ Ideal.span {p})) := by
  intro B bs localB
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite A B
  have hsystem := iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_regularSystem
    n a rs hn hreg hgen
  have hdomain : IsDomain B :=
    isDomain_of_regularSystem _ hsystem.1 hsystem.2
  let : IsDomain B := hdomain
  have hregularLocal : IsRegularLocalRing B :=
    isRegularLocalRing_of_regularSystem _ hsystem.1 hsystem.2
  refine ⟨inferInstance, hdomain, hregularLocal, hsystem.1, hsystem.2,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    exact prime_of_mem_regularSystem hsystem.1 hsystem.2 hp
  · intro p hp
    exact quotient_geometry_of_mem_regularSystem hsystem.1 hsystem.2 hp

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isDomain_iteratedRadical_of_regular_parameters
statement:
theorem isDomain_iteratedRadical_of_regular_parameters
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hreg : IsRegular A (List.ofFn a ++ rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    IsDomain (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  exact (iteratedRadical_regularSystem_geometry n a rs hn hreg hgen).2.1

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalRoot_geometry_of_regular_parameters
statement:
theorem iteratedRadicalRoot_geometry_of_regular_parameters
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hreg : IsRegular A (List.ofFn a ++ rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    let _ : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn (fun i => by
      rw [← hgen]
      exact Ideal.subset_span
        (List.mem_append_left rs (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
    ∀ i,
      Prime (iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i) ∧
        IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span {iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i}) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (B ⧸ Ideal.span {iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i}) := by
  intro B localB
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hprime, hquot⟩ :=
    iteratedRadical_regularSystem_geometry n a rs hn hreg hgen
  intro i
  have hi := iteratedRadicalRoot_mem_parameterList n a rs i
  exact ⟨hprime _ hi, (hquot _ hi).1, (hquot _ hi).2⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalMappedRadicand_geometry_of_exponent_one
statement:
theorem iteratedRadicalMappedRadicand_geometry_of_exponent_one
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hreg : IsRegular A (List.ofFn a ++ rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A)
    (i : Fin r) (hi : n i = 1) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    let _ : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn (fun j => by
      rw [← hgen]
      exact Ideal.subset_span
        (List.mem_append_left rs (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨j, rfl⟩)))
    Prime (algebraMap A B (a i)) ∧
      IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap A B (a i)}) ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing (B ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap A B (a i)}) := by
  intro B localB
  have hroot :=
    iteratedRadicalRoot_geometry_of_regular_parameters n a rs hn hreg hgen i
  have heq : iteratedRadicalRoot A n a i = algebraMap A B (a i) := by
    have hpow := iteratedRadicalRoot_pow n a i
    rw [hi] at hpow
    simpa using hpow
  rw [← heq]
  exact hroot

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedRadicalRemainingParameter_geometry
statement:
theorem iteratedRadicalRemainingParameter_geometry
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hreg : IsRegular A (List.ofFn a ++ rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    let _ : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn (fun i => by
      rw [← hgen]
      exact Ideal.subset_span
        (List.mem_append_left rs (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
    ∀ x ∈ rs,
      Prime (algebraMap A B x) ∧
        IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap A B x}) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing (B ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap A B x}) := by
  intro B localB
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hprime, hquot⟩ :=
    iteratedRadical_regularSystem_geometry n a rs hn hreg hgen
  intro x hx
  have hx' := algebraMap_mem_iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList n a rs hx
  exact ⟨hprime _ hx', (hquot _ hx').1, (hquot _ hx').2⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.IntegralDimension.exists_lift_ltSeries
statement:
private theorem exists_lift_ltSeries
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Nontrivial R] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] [FaithfulSMul R S]
    (p : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R)) :
    ∃ q : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum S),
      q.length = p.length ∧
        q.last.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S) = p.last.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  refine RelSeries.inductionOn'
    (motive := fun p : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R) ↦
      ∃ q : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum S),
        q.length = p.length ∧
          q.last.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S) = p.last.asIdeal)
    ?_ ?_ p
  · intro P
    let Q : P.asIdeal.primesOver S := Classical.choice inferInstance
    let q : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum S) :=
      RelSeries.singleton (r := {xy : PrimeSpectrum S × PrimeSpectrum S | xy.1 < xy.2})
        ⟨Q.1, Q.2.1⟩
    refine ⟨q, rfl, ?_⟩
    exact Q.2.2.over.symm
  · intro p P hp ⟨q, hlen, hlast⟩
    change p.last < P at hp
    have hcomap_le :
        q.last.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S) ≤ P.asIdeal := by
      rw [hlast]
      exact hp.le
    obtain ⟨Q, hqQ, hQprime, hQcomap⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime
        P.asIdeal q.last.asIdeal hcomap_le
    let Q' : PrimeSpectrum S := ⟨Q, hQprime⟩
    have hne : q.last ≠ Q' := by
      intro heq
      apply hp.ne
      apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
      rw [← hlast, ← hQcomap]
      exact congrArg (fun I : Ideal S ↦ I.comap (algebraMap R S))
        (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal heq)
    have hlt : q.last < Q' := lt_of_le_of_ne hqQ hne
    refine ⟨q.snoc Q' hlt, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using hlen
    · simpa [Q'] using hQcomap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.IntegralDimension.ringKrullDim_le_of_faithfully_integral
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_le_of_faithfully_integral
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Nontrivial R] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] :
    ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim S
proof:
:= by
  let : Nontrivial S := (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R S).nontrivial
  rw [ringKrullDim, ringKrullDim, Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_length,
    Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_length]
  apply WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr
  refine iSup_le fun p ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨q, hlen, -⟩ := exists_lift_ltSeries (R := R) (S := S) p
  rw [← hlen]
  exact le_iSup (fun q : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum S) ↦
    (q.length : ℕ∞)) q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localRootCoverParameterList_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem localRootCoverParameterList_length
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (a : R) (rs : List R) :
    (localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs).length = (a :: rs).length
proof:
:= by
  simp [localRootCoverParameterList]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.ideal_ofList_localRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem ideal_ofList_localRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {a : R} {rs : List R}
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (a :: rs) = maximalIdeal R) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))
proof:
:=
      isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn (by
        rw [← hgen, Ideal.ofList_cons]
        exact (show Ideal.span {a} ≤ Ideal.span {a} ⊔ Ideal.ofList rs from le_sup_left)
          (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a))
    Ideal.ofList (localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs) =
      maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)) := by
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
  let B := AdjoinRoot f
  have ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen, Ideal.ofList_cons]
    exact (show Ideal.span {a} ≤ Ideal.span {a} ⊔ Ideal.ofList rs from le_sup_left)
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a)
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha
  rw [maximalIdeal_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [localRootCoverParameterList, Ideal.ofList_cons]
    apply sup_le
    · exact le_sup_right
    · refine le_trans ?_ le_sup_left
      rw [← Ideal.map_ofList]
      apply Ideal.map_mono
      rw [← hgen, Ideal.ofList_cons]
      exact le_sup_right
  · apply sup_le
    · rw [← hgen, Ideal.map_ofList, List.map_cons, Ideal.ofList_cons]
      apply sup_le
      · rw [Ideal.span_le]
        rintro x (rfl : x = AdjoinRoot.of f a)
        rw [← adjoinRoot_root_pow n a]
        exact Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem _ (by
          rw [localRootCoverParameterList, Ideal.ofList_cons]
          exact (show Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)} ≤
              Ideal.span {AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n - C a)} ⊔
                Ideal.ofList (rs.map (AdjoinRoot.of (X ^ n - C a))) from le_sup_left)
            (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)) n hn
      · rw [localRootCoverParameterList, Ideal.ofList_cons]
        exact le_sup_right
    · rw [localRootCoverParameterList, Ideal.ofList_cons]
      exact le_sup_left

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.spanFinrank_ofList_le_length
statement:
private theorem spanFinrank_ofList_le_length
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (l : List R) :
    (Ideal.ofList l).spanFinrank ≤ l.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite l.finite_toSet).trans ?_
  rw [show {x : R | x ∈ l} = (l.toFinset : Set R) by
    ext x
    exact List.mem_toFinset.symm,
    Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  exact List.toFinset_card_le l

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.parameter_length_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
private theorem parameter_length_eq_ringKrullDim
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {a : R} {rs : List R}
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R (a :: rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (a :: rs) = maximalIdeal R) :
    ((a :: rs).length : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_add_length_eq_ringKrullDim_of_isRegular
    (a :: rs) hreg
  rw [hgen] at hdim
  let : Field (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.field (maximalIdeal R)
  have hfieldDim :
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) = 0 :=
    ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field _
  rw [hfieldDim, zero_add] at hdim
  simpa using hdim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isRegularLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_regular_parameters
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_regular_parameters
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : R} {rs : List R}
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R (a :: rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (a :: rs) = maximalIdeal R) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a))
proof:
:= by
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
  let B := AdjoinRoot f
  have ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen, Ideal.ofList_cons]
    exact (show Ideal.span {a} ≤ Ideal.span {a} ⊔ Ideal.ofList rs from le_sup_left)
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a)
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha
  have hf : f.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne'
  let : Module.Finite R B := hf.finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R B
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
    faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R B
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  have hparams :
      Ideal.ofList (localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs) = maximalIdeal B :=
    ideal_ofList_localRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal hn hgen
  have hspan :
      (maximalIdeal B).spanFinrank ≤
        (localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs).length := by
    rw [← hparams]
    exact spanFinrank_ofList_le_length _
  have hdimR : ((a :: rs).length : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R :=
    parameter_length_eq_ringKrullDim hreg hgen
  calc
    ((maximalIdeal B).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ((localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs).length : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      by exact_mod_cast hspan
    _ = ((a :: rs).length : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [localRootCoverParameterList_length]
    _ = ringKrullDim R := hdimR
    _ ≤ ringKrullDim B :=
      IntegralDimension.ringKrullDim_le_of_faithfully_integral

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localRootCoverParameterList_length_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem localRootCoverParameterList_length_eq_ringKrullDim
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {a : R} {rs : List R}
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R (a :: rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (a :: rs) = maximalIdeal R) :
    ringKrullDim (AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)) =
      ((localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs).length : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  let B := AdjoinRoot (X ^ n - C a)
  have ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen, Ideal.ofList_cons]
    exact (show Ideal.span {a} ≤ Ideal.span {a} ⊔ Ideal.ofList rs from le_sup_left)
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a)
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn ha
  let : IsRegularLocalRing B :=
    isRegularLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_regular_parameters hn hreg hgen
  rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact_mod_cast (show (maximalIdeal B).spanFinrank ≤
        (localRootCoverParameterList R n a rs).length by
      rw [← ideal_ofList_localRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal hn hgen]
      exact spanFinrank_ofList_le_length _)
  · rw [localRootCoverParameterList_length]
    have hdim : ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim B := by
      let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C a
      have hf : f.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C a hn.ne'
      let : Module.Finite R B := hf.finite_adjoinRoot
      let : Algebra.IsIntegral R B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R B
      let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
        faithfullyFlat_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn a
      exact IntegralDimension.ringKrullDim_le_of_faithfully_integral
    have hBspan : ((maximalIdeal B).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim B :=
      IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
    rw [← hBspan] at hdim
    exact (parameter_length_eq_ringKrullDim hreg hgen).le.trans hdim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedLocalRootCoverRoots_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iteratedLocalRootCoverRoots_length
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) :
    (iteratedLocalRootCoverRoots A r n a).length = r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [iteratedLocalRootCoverRoots]
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      change ((iteratedLocalRootCoverRoots A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)).map
        (AdjoinRoot.of f) ++ [AdjoinRoot.root f]).length = r + 1
      rw [List.length_append, List.length_map,
        ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)]
      rw [List.length_singleton]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_length
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (rs : List A) :
    (iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs).length =
      (List.ofFn a ++ rs).length
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      rw [iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList, List.length_reverse]
      rw [iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList]
      rfl
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      change (((iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A
          (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) rs).map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ++
        [AdjoinRoot.root f]).reverse).length = (List.ofFn a ++ rs).length
      rw [List.length_reverse, List.length_append, List.length_map]
      have hlen := ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      rw [iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList, List.length_reverse] at hlen
      rw [hlen]
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn, List.length_singleton]
      omega

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.ideal_ofList_move_middle_to_front
statement:
private theorem ideal_ofList_move_middle_to_front
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (xs ys : List R) (x : R) :
    Ideal.ofList (xs ++ x :: ys) = Ideal.ofList (x :: xs ++ ys)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ideal.ofList_append, Ideal.ofList_cons]
  ac_rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.radicands_mem_maximalIdeal
statement:
private theorem radicands_mem_maximalIdeal
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} {a : Fin r → A} {rs : List A}
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    ∀ i, a i ∈ maximalIdeal A
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [← hgen]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_append_left rs (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList_cons
statement:
private theorem iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList_cons
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (x : A) (rs : List A) :
    iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a (x :: rs) =
      algebraMap A (iteratedRadical A r n a) x ::
        iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      change x :: rs = algebraMap A A x :: rs
      rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
  | succ r ih =>
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A :=
        iteratedRadical A r (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a)
      let f : T[X] :=
        X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C (algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r)))
      change
        (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A
            (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) (x :: rs)).map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ++
              [AdjoinRoot.root f] =
          algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot f) x ::
            (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A
              (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a) rs).map (AdjoinRoot.of f) ++
                [AdjoinRoot.root f]
      rw [ih (Fin.init n) (Fin.init a), List.map_cons]
      congr 1

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.ideal_ofList_iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
private theorem ideal_ofList_iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList_eq_maximalIdeal
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    [IsLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a)]
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    Ideal.ofList (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs) =
      maximalIdeal (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing rs with
  | zero =>
      let B := iteratedRadical A 0 n a
      have hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap A B) := by
        change Function.Bijective (algebraMap A A)
        constructor
        · intro x y hxy
          simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply] using hxy
        · intro y
          exact ⟨y, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply y⟩
      let e : A ≃+* B := RingEquiv.ofBijective (algebraMap A B) hbij
      have he_apply (x : A) : e x = x := by
        change (algebraMap A A) x = x
        exact Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply x
      have hlist : rs.map e = iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs := by
        change rs.map e = rs
        clear hgen
        induction rs with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons x xs ih =>
            simp only [List.map_cons]
            rw [he_apply x, ih]
            rfl
      have hgen' : Ideal.ofList rs = maximalIdeal A := by
        simpa using hgen
      calc
        Ideal.ofList (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs) =
            Ideal.map e (Ideal.ofList rs) := by
          rw [← hlist]
          exact (Ideal.map_ofList (e : A →+* B) rs).symm
        _ = Ideal.map e (maximalIdeal A) := congrArg (Ideal.map e) hgen'
        _ = maximalIdeal B := IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e
  | succ r ih =>
      let nInit : Fin r → ℕ := Fin.init n
      let aInit : Fin r → A := Fin.init a
      let T : CommAlgCat.{u} A := iteratedRadical A r nInit aInit
      let aLastT : T := algebraMap A T (a (Fin.last r))
      let f : T[X] := X ^ n (Fin.last r) - C aLastT
      have hnInit : ∀ i, 0 < nInit i := fun i => hn i.castSucc
      have hgenInit :
          Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn aInit ++ a (Fin.last r) :: rs) =
            maximalIdeal A := by
        change Ideal.ofList
            (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin r => a i.castSucc) ++
              a (Fin.last r) :: rs) = maximalIdeal A
        rw [List.ofFn_succ'] at hgen
        simpa only [List.concat_eq_append, List.append_assoc,
          List.singleton_append] using hgen
      have haInit : ∀ i, aInit i ∈ maximalIdeal A :=
        radicands_mem_maximalIdeal hgenInit
      let : IsLocalRing T :=
        isLocalRing_iteratedRadical nInit aInit hnInit haInit
      have hgenTWithLast :
          Ideal.ofList
              (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit
                (a (Fin.last r) :: rs)) =
            maximalIdeal T :=
        ih (rs := a (Fin.last r) :: rs) nInit aInit hnInit hgenInit
      have haLast : a (Fin.last r) ∈ maximalIdeal A :=
        radicands_mem_maximalIdeal hgen (Fin.last r)
      have hLastT : aLastT ∈ maximalIdeal T :=
        algebraMap_mem_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical
          nInit aInit hnInit haInit haLast
      let : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot f) :=
        isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C (hn (Fin.last r)) hLastT
      have hgenT :
          Ideal.ofList
              (aLastT :: iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs) =
            maximalIdeal T := by
        rw [iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList_cons] at hgenTWithLast
        simpa [aLastT] using hgenTWithLast
      have hstep :
          Ideal.ofList
              (localRootCoverParameterList T (n (Fin.last r)) aLastT
                (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs)) =
            maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot f) := by
        simpa [f] using
          ideal_ofList_localRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal
            (R := T) (n := n (Fin.last r)) (a := aLastT)
              (rs := iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs)
              (hn (Fin.last r)) hgenT
      change Ideal.ofList
          ((iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs).map
              (AdjoinRoot.of f) ++ [AdjoinRoot.root f]) =
        maximalIdeal (AdjoinRoot f)
      rw [ideal_ofList_move_middle_to_front
        ((iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A nInit aInit rs).map
          (AdjoinRoot.of f)) [] (AdjoinRoot.root f)]
      simpa [localRootCoverParameterList] using hstep

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.ideal_ofList_iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem ideal_ofList_iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    [IsLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a)]
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    Ideal.ofList (iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs) =
      maximalIdeal (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList]
  rw [ideal_ofList_eq_of_perm
    (List.reverse_perm (iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList A n a rs))]
  exact ideal_ofList_iteratedLocalRootCoverConstructionList_eq_maximalIdeal
    n a rs hn hgen

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isRegularLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_regular_parameters
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_regular_parameters
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A (List.ofFn a ++ rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (iteratedRadical A r n a)
proof:
:= by
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ maximalIdeal A := radicands_mem_maximalIdeal hgen
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B := faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite A B
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  have hparams :
      Ideal.ofList (iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs) =
        maximalIdeal B :=
    ideal_ofList_iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal
      n a rs hn hgen
  have hspan :
      (maximalIdeal B).spanFinrank ≤
        (iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs).length := by
    rw [← hparams]
    exact spanFinrank_ofList_le_length _
  have hdimA :
      ((List.ofFn a ++ rs).length : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim A :=
    parameter_length_eq_ringKrullDim hreg hgen
  calc
    ((maximalIdeal B).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ((iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs).length : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      by exact_mod_cast hspan
    _ = ((List.ofFn a ++ rs).length : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_length]
    _ = ringKrullDim A := hdimA
    _ ≤ ringKrullDim B :=
      IntegralDimension.ringKrullDim_le_of_faithfully_integral

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_length_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_length_eq_ringKrullDim
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (rs : List A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A (List.ofFn a ++ rs))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn a ++ rs) = maximalIdeal A) :
    ringKrullDim (iteratedRadical A r n a) =
      ((iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs).length : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ maximalIdeal A := radicands_mem_maximalIdeal hgen
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : IsRegularLocalRing B :=
    isRegularLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_regular_parameters n a rs hn hreg hgen
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B := faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact_mod_cast (show (maximalIdeal B).spanFinrank ≤
        (iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList A n a rs).length by
      rw [← ideal_ofList_iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_eq_maximalIdeal
        n a rs hn hgen]
      exact spanFinrank_ofList_le_length _)
  · rw [iteratedLocalRootCoverParameterList_length]
    have hdim : ringKrullDim A ≤ ringKrullDim B :=
      IntegralDimension.ringKrullDim_le_of_faithfully_integral
    have hBspan :
        ((maximalIdeal B).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim B :=
      IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
    rw [← hBspan] at hdim
    exact (parameter_length_eq_ringKrullDim hreg hgen).le.trans hdim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.regular_quotient_parameter_of_regular_pair
statement:
theorem regular_quotient_parameter_of_regular_pair
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let I : Ideal R
proof:
:= Ideal.span {y}
    let S := R ⧸ I
    IsRegular S [Ideal.Quotient.mk I x] ∧
      Ideal.ofList [Ideal.Quotient.mk I x] =
        (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
  dsimp only
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {y}
  let S := R ⧸ I
  have hyMem : y ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_cons_of_mem x List.mem_cons_self)
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    change y ∈ maximalIdeal R
    exact hyMem
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIle
  let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hregYX : IsRegular R [y, x] :=
    IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hreg (List.Perm.swap x y []).symm
  have hspan_smul : y • (⊤ : Submodule R R) = (I : Submodule R R) := by
    rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]
    change I • (⊤ : Submodule R R) = (I : Submodule R R)
    rw [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]
  have hxregQ : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop y R) x :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff (QuotSMulTop y R) x []).mp
      ((isRegular_cons_iff R y [x]).mp hregYX).2).1
  have hxregS : IsSMulRegular S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    have hxmemI : x * r ∈ I := by
      apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
      simpa only [map_mul, smul_eq_mul] using hz
    have hxmem : x • r ∈ y • (⊤ : Submodule R R) := by
      rw [hspan_smul]
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hxmemI
    have hrmem : r ∈ y • (⊤ : Submodule R R) :=
      (isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem
        (y • (⊤ : Submodule R R)) x).mp hxregQ r hxmem
    rw [hspan_smul] at hrmem
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hrmem
  have hregS : IsRegular S [Ideal.Quotient.mk I x] := by
    have hxmem : Ideal.Quotient.mk I x ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
        ← hgen, Ideal.map_ofList]
      apply Ideal.subset_span
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
        List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
      exact Or.inl rfl
    exact IsRegular.of_isWeaklyRegular_of_mem_maximalIdeal
      (L := S) (by
        intro z hz
        simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hz
        subst z
        exact hxmem)
      ((isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x)).mpr hxregS)
  have hgenS : Ideal.ofList [Ideal.Quotient.mk I x] =
      (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
    rw [← hgen, Ideal.map_ofList]
    simp [I]
  exact ⟨hregS, hgenS⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isDomain_of_prime_regular_element
statement:
private theorem isDomain_of_prime_regular_element
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {p : R} (hp : Prime p) (hpreg : IsSMulRegular R p) : IsDomain R
proof:
:= by
  have hbot : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := by
    rw [Ideal.isPrime_iff]
    refine ⟨bot_ne_top, ?_⟩
    intro a b hab
    simp only [Ideal.mem_bot] at hab ⊢
    by_contra hzero
    push Not at hzero
    obtain ⟨k, hak⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ k := by
      by_contra hall
      push Not at hall
      have haInf : a ∈ ⨅ k : ℕ, maximalIdeal R ^ k := Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr hall
      rw [Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing
        (maximalIdeal R) (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top] at haInf
      exact hzero.1 (Ideal.mem_bot.mp haInf)
    obtain ⟨l, hbl⟩ : ∃ l : ℕ, b ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ l := by
      by_contra hall
      push Not at hall
      have hbInf : b ∈ ⨅ l : ℕ, maximalIdeal R ^ l := Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr hall
      rw [Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing
        (maximalIdeal R) (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top] at hbInf
      exact hzero.2 (Ideal.mem_bot.mp hbInf)
    have hpMem : p ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
      rw [mem_maximalIdeal]
      exact hp.not_isUnit
    have hpow : ∀ k l : ℕ, ∀ a b : R, a * b = 0 →
        p ^ k ∣ a ∨ p ^ l ∣ b := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          intro l a b hab
          exact Or.inl (by rw [pow_zero]; exact one_dvd a)
      | succ k ihK =>
          intro l
          induction l with
          | zero =>
              intro a b hab
              exact Or.inr (by rw [pow_zero]; exact one_dvd b)
          | succ l ihL =>
              intro a b hab
              have hpProd : p ∣ a * b := by rw [hab]; exact dvd_zero p
              rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hpProd with hpa | hpb
              · obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := hpa
                have hab' : a' * b = 0 := by
                  apply hpreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul
                  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc] using hab
                rcases ihK (l + 1) a' b hab' with ha' | hb'
                · left
                  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ha'
                  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
                  rw [hc, pow_succ]
                  ac_rfl
                · exact Or.inr hb'
              · obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hpb
                have hab' : a * b' = 0 := by
                  apply hpreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul
                  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hab
                rcases ihL a b' hab' with ha' | hb'
                · exact Or.inl ha'
                · right
                  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hb'
                  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
                  rw [hc, pow_succ]
                  ac_rfl
    rcases hpow k l a b hab with ha | hb
    · apply hak
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
      exact (maximalIdeal R ^ k).mul_mem_right c
        (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hpMem k)
    · apply hbl
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hb
      exact (maximalIdeal R ^ l).mul_mem_right c
        (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hpMem l)
  let : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := hbot
  exact IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime R

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.oneRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry
statement:
theorem oneRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let n₁ : Fin 1 → ℕ
proof:
:= fun _ ↦ n
    let a₁ : Fin 1 → R := fun _ ↦ x
    let B := iteratedRadical R 1 n₁ a₁
    IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
      Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
      IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing
        (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) := by
  dsimp only
  let n₁ : Fin 1 → ℕ := fun _ ↦ n
  let a₁ : Fin 1 → R := fun _ ↦ x
  let B := iteratedRadical R 1 n₁ a₁
  have hn₁ : ∀ i, 0 < n₁ i := fun _ ↦ hn
  have hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  have ha₁Mem : ∀ i, a₁ i ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun _ ↦ hxMem
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n₁ a₁ hn₁ ha₁Mem
  have hregB : IsRegularLocalRing B := by
    apply isRegularLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_regular_parameters
      n₁ a₁ [y] hn₁
    · simpa [a₁] using hreg
    · simpa [a₁] using hgen
  let : IsRegularLocalRing B := hregB
  let : Module.Finite R B := finite_iteratedRadical n₁ a₁ hn₁
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n₁ a₁ hn₁
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {y}
  have hyMem : y ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_cons_of_mem x List.mem_cons_self)
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    change y ∈ maximalIdeal R
    exact hyMem
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIle
  let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R (R ⧸ I) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hS := regular_quotient_parameter_of_regular_pair hreg hgen
  have hregS : IsRegular (R ⧸ I) [algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x] := by
    simpa [I, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq] using hS.1
  have hgenS : Ideal.ofList [algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x] =
      maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList [algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x] =
          (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
        simpa [I, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq] using hS.2
      _ = maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hxSNe : algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x ≠ 0 := by
    have hxreg : IsSMulRegular (R ⧸ I) (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x) :=
      ((isRegular_cons_iff (R ⧸ I) (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x) []).mp hregS).1
    intro hx
    have hxzero : algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x • (1 : R ⧸ I) = 0 := by
      rw [hx]
      exact zero_smul (R ⧸ I) 1
    have hone : (1 : R ⧸ I) = 0 := hxreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul hxzero
    exact one_ne_zero hone
  have hspanS : Ideal.span ({algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x} : Set (R ⧸ I)) =
      maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) := by
    simpa using hgenS
  have hxSPrime : Prime (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x) := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hxSNe).mp
    rw [hspanS]
    exact inferInstance
  have hdomainS : IsDomain (R ⧸ I) :=
    isDomain_of_prime_regular_element hxSPrime
      (((isRegular_cons_iff (R ⧸ I)
        (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x) []).mp hregS).1)
  let : IsDomain (R ⧸ I) := hdomainS
  have hmaxPrincipal : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)).IsPrincipal :=
    ⟨algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) x, hspanS.symm⟩
  let : IsPrincipalIdealRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    ((tfae_of_isNoetherianRing_of_isLocalRing_of_isDomain (R ⧸ I)).out 5 1).mp
      hmaxPrincipal
  let D := iteratedRadical (R ⧸ I) 1 n₁
    (fun i ↦ algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) (a₁ i))
  have hregD : IsRegularLocalRing D := by
    apply isRegularLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_regular_parameters
      n₁ (fun i ↦ algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) (a₁ i)) [] hn₁
    · simpa [a₁] using hregS
    · simpa [a₁] using hgenS
  let : IsRegularLocalRing D := hregD
  have hdomainD : IsDomain D := by
    let q : (R ⧸ I)[X] :=
      X ^ n - Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x)
    have hqPrime : Prime q := by
      exact (irreducible_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime
        (by simpa [Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq] using hxSPrime) hn).prime
    have hcoeff :
        algebraMap (R ⧸ I)
            (iteratedRadical (R ⧸ I) 0 (Fin.init n₁)
              (Fin.init fun i ↦ algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) (a₁ i)))
            (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) (a₁ (Fin.last 0))) =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk I x := by
      change algebraMap (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk I x
      exact Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply _
    let qD : (R ⧸ I)[X] :=
      X ^ n₁ (Fin.last 0) -
        Polynomial.C
          (algebraMap (R ⧸ I)
            (iteratedRadical (R ⧸ I) 0 (Fin.init n₁)
              (Fin.init fun i ↦ algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) (a₁ i)))
            (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I) (a₁ (Fin.last 0))))
    have hqD : qD = q := by
      dsimp only [qD]
      rw [hcoeff]
      simp [q, n₁]
      rfl
    let eqv : D ≃ₐ[R ⧸ I] AdjoinRoot q :=
      AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq (R ⧸ I) qD q hqD
    let : IsDomain (AdjoinRoot q) := AdjoinRoot.isDomain_of_prime hqPrime
    exact eqv.toMulEquiv.isDomain (AdjoinRoot q)
  let : IsDomain D := hdomainD
  let J : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  let e : (B ⧸ J) ≃ₐ[R ⧸ I] D :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor B I).trans
      (iteratedRadicalBaseChangeAlgEquiv n₁ a₁)
  have hdomainBJ : IsDomain (B ⧸ J) := e.toMulEquiv.isDomain D
  let : IsDomain (B ⧸ J) := hdomainBJ
  have hJprime : J.IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime J).mp inferInstance
  have hJspan : J = Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B) := by
    simp [J, I, Ideal.map_span]
  have hregYX : IsRegular R [y, x] :=
    IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hreg (List.Perm.swap x y []).symm
  have hyregR : IsSMulRegular R y :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff R y [x]).mp hregYX).1
  have hyNe : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hyzero
    have hone : (1 : R) = 0 := by
      apply hyregR.right_eq_zero_of_smul
      simp only [hyzero, zero_smul]
    exact one_ne_zero hone
  have hyBNe : algebraMap R B y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hyNe
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R B
    simpa using hzero
  have hyBPrime : Prime (algebraMap R B y) := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hyBNe).mp
    rw [← hJspan]
    exact hJprime
  have hyregTensor : @IsSMulRegular R (TensorProduct R (↑B) R) _ y :=
    hyregR.lTensor B
  have hyregBR : @IsSMulRegular R (↑B) _ y :=
    ((TensorProduct.rid R B).isSMulRegular_congr y).mp hyregTensor
  have hyregB : @IsSMulRegular (↑B) (↑B) _ (algebraMap R B y) := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro z hz
    apply hyregBR.right_eq_zero_of_smul
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply] using hz
  have hdomainB : IsDomain B :=
    isDomain_of_prime_regular_element (R := B)
      (p := algebraMap R B y) hyBPrime hyregB
  have hregBJ : IsRegularLocalRing (B ⧸ J) :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e.symm.toRingEquiv
  have hdomainBspan : IsDomain
      (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) := by
    rw [← hJspan]
    exact hdomainBJ
  have hregBspan : IsRegularLocalRing
      (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) := by
    rw [← hJspan]
    exact hregBJ
  exact ⟨hregB, hdomainB, hyBPrime, hdomainBspan, hregBspan⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.selectedDivisorGeometry_of_algEquiv
statement:
private theorem selectedDivisorGeometry_of_algEquiv
    {R B C : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C]
    (e : B ≃ₐ[R] C) {y : R}
    (hC : IsRegularLocalRing C ∧ IsDomain C ∧
      Prime (algebraMap R C y) ∧
      IsDomain (C ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R C y} : Set C)) ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing
        (C ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R C y} : Set C))) :
    IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
      Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
      IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing
        (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hC with ⟨hregC, hdomainC, hyCPrime, hdomainCQ, hregCQ⟩
  let : IsRegularLocalRing C := hregC
  let : IsDomain C := hdomainC
  let IC : Ideal C := Ideal.span ({algebraMap R C y} : Set C)
  let IB : Ideal B := Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)
  have hIC : IC = IB.map (e : B →+* C) := by
    simp [IC, IB, Ideal.map_span]
  let eQ : (B ⧸ IB) ≃+* (C ⧸ IC) :=
    Ideal.quotientEquiv IB IC e.toRingEquiv hIC
  have hdomainCQ' : IsDomain (C ⧸ IC) := by
    simpa [IC] using hdomainCQ
  let : IsDomain (C ⧸ IC) := hdomainCQ'
  have hregCQ' : IsRegularLocalRing (C ⧸ IC) := by
    simpa [IC] using hregCQ
  let : IsRegularLocalRing (C ⧸ IC) := hregCQ'
  have hregB : IsRegularLocalRing B :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e.symm.toRingEquiv
  have hdomainB : IsDomain B := e.toMulEquiv.isDomain C
  have hdomainBQ : IsDomain (B ⧸ IB) :=
    eQ.toMulEquiv.isDomain (C ⧸ IC)
  let : IsDomain (B ⧸ IB) := hdomainBQ
  have hIBprime : IB.IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime IB).mp inferInstance
  have hyBNe : algebraMap R B y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hyzero
    apply hyCPrime.ne_zero
    rw [← e.commutes y, hyzero, map_zero]
  have hyBPrime : Prime (algebraMap R B y) := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hyBNe).mp
    exact hIBprime
  have hregBQ : IsRegularLocalRing (B ⧸ IB) :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv eQ.symm
  simpa [IB] using
    (show IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
        Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧ IsDomain (B ⧸ IB) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing (B ⧸ IB) from
      ⟨hregB, hdomainB, hyBPrime, hdomainBQ, hregBQ⟩)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.allOneRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry
statement:
theorem allOneRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → R)
    (hall : ∀ i, n i = 1) {y z : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [y, z])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, z] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R r n a
    IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
      Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
      IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing
        (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) := by
  dsimp only
  let e : iteratedRadical R r n a ≃ₐ[R] R :=
    iteratedRadicalAllOneAlgEquiv n a hall
  apply selectedDivisorGeometry_of_algEquiv e
  have hregR : IsRegularLocalRing R :=
    isRegularLocalRing_of_regularSystem [y, z] hreg hgen
  have hyPrime : Prime y :=
    prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen List.mem_cons_self
  have hyQuotient :=
    quotient_geometry_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen (p := y) List.mem_cons_self
  simpa using
    (show IsRegularLocalRing R ∧ IsDomain R ∧ Prime y ∧
        IsDomain (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)) from
      ⟨hregR, inferInstance, hyPrime, hyQuotient.1, hyQuotient.2⟩)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.oneRootWithTrivialTail_selectedDivisor_geometry
statement:
theorem oneRootWithTrivialTail_selectedDivisor_geometry
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → R)
    (htail : ∀ i : Fin r, n i.succ = 1)
    (hn : 0 < n 0) {y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [a 0, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [a 0, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical R (r + 1) n a
    IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
      Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
      IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing
        (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) := by
  dsimp only
  let C := iteratedRadical R 1 (fun _ ↦ n 0) (fun _ ↦ a 0)
  let e : iteratedRadical R (r + 1) n a ≃ₐ[R] C :=
    iteratedRadicalTailOneAlgEquiv n a htail
  apply selectedDivisorGeometry_of_algEquiv e
  exact oneRootCover_selectedDivisor_geometry hn hreg hgen

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_maximalAdicCompletion_oneRoot_finiteEtaleChosenFactor
statement:
theorem exists_maximalAdicCompletion_oneRoot_finiteEtaleChosenFactor
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) {y z : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [y, z])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, z] = maximalIdeal R)
    {E : Type uE} [CommRing E]
    [Algebra
      (iteratedRadical R 1 (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ N) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ y)) E]
    [Module.Finite
      (iteratedRadical R 1 (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ N) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ y)) E]
    [Algebra.Etale
      (iteratedRadical R 1 (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ N) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ y)) E]
    (p : Ideal E) [p.IsMaximal] :
    let n : Fin 1 → ℕ
proof:
:= fun _ ↦ N
    let a : Fin 1 → R := fun _ ↦ y
    let B₀ := iteratedRadical R 1 n a
    let A := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
    let aHat : Fin 1 → A := fun i ↦ algebraMap R A (a i)
    let Bhat := iteratedRadical A 1 n aHat
    let hy : y ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
      rw [← hgen]
      exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
    let ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun _ ↦ hy
    let haHat : ∀ i, aHat i ∈ maximalIdeal A := fun i ↦ by
      rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R A) (ha i)
    letI : IsLocalRing B₀ := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a
      (fun _ ↦ hN) ha
    letI : IsLocalRing Bhat := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n aHat
      (fun _ ↦ hN) haHat
    letI : Algebra R E := oneRootFiniteEtaleBaseAlgebra
      (R := R) (N := N) (y := y) (E := E)
    let T := A ⊗[R] E
    letI : Algebra E T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Bhat T :=
      maximalAdicCompletionOneRootTensorAlgebra
        (R := R) (N := N) (y := y) (E := E)
    let P := p.map (algebraMap E T)
    ∃ hPMax : P.IsMaximal,
      letI : P.IsPrime := hPMax.isPrime
      ∃ hPOver : P.LiesOver (maximalIdeal Bhat),
        letI : P.LiesOver (maximalIdeal Bhat) := hPOver
        let Dp := Localization.AtPrime P
        letI : Algebra Bhat Dp := inferInstance
        Module.Finite Bhat Dp ∧
          Algebra.Etale Bhat Dp ∧
          IsLocalHom (algebraMap Bhat Dp) ∧
          (∀ Q : Ideal Dp, Q.IsPrime →
            Q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal Bhat) →
            Q = maximalIdeal Dp) := by
  dsimp only
  let n : Fin 1 → ℕ := fun _ ↦ N
  let a : Fin 1 → R := fun _ ↦ y
  let B₀ := iteratedRadical R 1 n a
  let A := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let aHat : Fin 1 → A := fun i ↦ algebraMap R A (a i)
  let Bhat := iteratedRadical A 1 n aHat
  have hy : y ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun _ ↦ hy
  have haHat : ∀ i, aHat i ∈ maximalIdeal A := fun i ↦ by
    rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R A) (ha i)
  let : IsLocalRing B₀ :=
    isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN) ha
  let : IsLocalRing Bhat :=
    isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n aHat (fun _ ↦ hN) haHat
  let : Algebra R E := oneRootFiniteEtaleBaseAlgebra
    (R := R) (N := N) (y := y) (E := E)
  let : IsScalarTower R B₀ E :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral B₀ E := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite B₀ E
  let : Module.Finite R B₀ :=
    finite_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R B₀ := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R B₀
  have hB₀UnderMaximal : ((maximalIdeal B₀).under R).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R B₀)
      (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) (maximalIdeal B₀)
  let : (maximalIdeal B₀).LiesOver (maximalIdeal R) :=
    ⟨(IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hB₀UnderMaximal).symm⟩
  have hpUnderMaximal : (p.under B₀).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap B₀ E)
      (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) p
  let : p.LiesOver (maximalIdeal B₀) :=
    ⟨(IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hpUnderMaximal).symm⟩
  let : p.LiesOver (maximalIdeal R) :=
    Ideal.LiesOver.trans p (maximalIdeal B₀) (maximalIdeal R)
  let T := A ⊗[R] E
  let : Algebra A T := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : Algebra E T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let P := p.map (algebraMap E T)
  have hPGeometry :=
    adicCompletion_tensorProduct_map_liesOver_maximalIdeal
      (R := R) (S := E) p
  have hPMax : P.IsMaximal := by
    simpa only [A, T, P] using hPGeometry.1
  let : P.IsMaximal := hPMax
  let : P.IsPrime := hPMax.isPrime
  let : Algebra B₀ Bhat := iteratedRadicalCompletionAlgebra n a
  let : Algebra Bhat T :=
    maximalAdicCompletionOneRootTensorAlgebra
      (R := R) (N := N) (y := y) (E := E)
  let Ehat := Bhat ⊗[B₀] E
  let : Algebra Bhat Ehat := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let eTensor : Ehat ≃ₐ[Bhat] T :=
    maximalAdicCompletionOneRootTensorAlgEquiv
  let : Module.Finite Bhat Ehat := inferInstance
  let : Algebra.Etale Bhat Ehat := inferInstance
  let : Module.Finite Bhat T :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eTensor.toLinearMap eTensor.surjective
  let : Algebra.Etale Bhat T := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eTensor
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral Bhat T := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite Bhat T
  have hPUnderMaximal : (P.under Bhat).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap Bhat T)
      (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) P
  have hPOver : P.LiesOver (maximalIdeal Bhat) :=
    ⟨(IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hPUnderMaximal).symm⟩
  let : P.LiesOver (maximalIdeal Bhat) := hPOver
  let : IsNoetherianRing A :=
    maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing_of_regularPair hreg hgen
  let : HenselianLocalRing Bhat :=
    henselianLocalRing_iteratedRadical_of_isAdicComplete
      n aHat (fun _ ↦ hN) haHat
  let Dp := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : Algebra T Dp := inferInstance
  let : Algebra Bhat Dp := inferInstance
  let : IsScalarTower Bhat T Dp := inferInstance
  let : Module.Finite Bhat Dp :=
    moduleFinite_localizationAtPrime_of_henselian_of_etale
      (R := Bhat) (S := T) P
  let : Algebra.Etale Bhat Dp :=
    etale_localizationAtPrime_of_henselian_of_etale
      (R := Bhat) (S := T) P
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap Bhat Dp) :=
    isLocalHom_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_liesOver_maximalIdeal
      (R := Bhat) (S := T) P
  have hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal Dp, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal Bhat) → Q = maximalIdeal Dp := by
    intro Q hQPrime hQOver
    let : Q.IsPrime := hQPrime
    let : Q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal Bhat) := hQOver
    let : Algebra.IsIntegral Bhat Dp :=
      Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite Bhat Dp
    have hQMaximal : Q.IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under (R := Bhat) (S := Dp) Q <| by
          rw [← Q.over_def (maximalIdeal Bhat)]
          exact maximalIdeal.isMaximal Bhat
    exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hQMaximal
  refine ⟨hPMax, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨hPOver, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, hunique⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.MvPowerSeriesFinite.splitIndex_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
private lemma splitIndex_symm_apply (n : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (splitIndex (σ := σ)).symm (n, d) =
      (Finsupp.single () n).sumElim d
proof: := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.MvPowerSeriesFinite.splitIndex_apply_sumElim
proof:
:= by
  rw [← splitIndex_symm_apply]
  exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.MvPowerSeriesFinite.coeff_coeff_curryFun
statement:
@[simp]
private lemma coeff_coeff_curryFun [Semiring R]
    (p : MvPowerSeries (Unit ⊕ σ) R) (n : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (PowerSeries.coeff n (curryFun p)) =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff ((Finsupp.single () n).sumElim d) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply, MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
  have hcoeff : PowerSeries.coeff n (curryFun p) =
      (fun e : σ →₀ ℕ ↦ p ((splitIndex (σ := σ)).symm (n, e)) :
        MvPowerSeries σ R) := by
    unfold curryFun
    exact PowerSeries.coeff_mk n _
  calc
    (PowerSeries.coeff n (curryFun p)) d =
        p ((splitIndex (σ := σ)).symm (n, d)) :=
      congrArg (fun q : MvPowerSeries σ R ↦ q d) hcoeff
    _ = p ((Finsupp.single () n).sumElim d) :=
      congrArg p (splitIndex_symm_apply n d)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.MvPowerSeriesFinite.coeff_uncurryFun
statement:
@[simp]
private lemma coeff_uncurryFun [Semiring R]
    (p : PowerSeries (MvPowerSeries σ R)) (d : Unit ⊕ σ →₀ ℕ) :
    MvPowerSeries.coeff d (uncurryFun p) =
      MvPowerSeries.coeff ((splitIndex (σ := σ) d).2)
        (PowerSeries.coeff ((splitIndex (σ := σ) d).1) p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply, MvPowerSeries.coeff_apply]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.MvPowerSeriesFinite.curryFun_mul
statement:
private lemma curryFun_mul [CommSemiring R]
    (p q : MvPowerSeries (Unit ⊕ σ) R) :
    curryFun (p * q) = curryFun p * curryFun q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsumElim : Function.Injective
      (fun x : (Unit →₀ ℕ) × (σ →₀ ℕ) ↦ x.1.sumElim x.2) := by
    intro a b h
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply Finsupp.ext
      intro i
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun h (Sum.inl i)
    · apply Finsupp.ext
      intro i
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun h (Sum.inr i)
  have hcombine : Function.Injective
      (fun x : ((Unit →₀ ℕ) × (Unit →₀ ℕ)) ×
          ((σ →₀ ℕ) × (σ →₀ ℕ)) ↦
        (x.1.1.sumElim x.2.1, x.1.2.sumElim x.2.2)) := by
    rintro ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨c, d⟩⟩ ⟨⟨a', b'⟩, ⟨c', d'⟩⟩ h
    have hac : (a, c) = (a', c') :=
      hsumElim (congr_arg Prod.fst h)
    have hbd : (b, d) = (b', d') :=
      hsumElim (congr_arg Prod.snd h)
    have ha : a = a' := congr_arg Prod.fst hac
    have hc : c = c' := congr_arg Prod.snd hac
    have hb : b = b' := congr_arg Prod.fst hbd
    have hd : d = d' := congr_arg Prod.snd hbd
    cases ha
    cases hb
    cases hc
    cases hd
    rfl
  apply PowerSeries.ext
  intro n
  apply MvPowerSeries.ext
  intro d
  rw [coeff_coeff_curryFun, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, map_sum]
  simp_rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  rw [← Finsupp.image_sumElim_product_antidiagonal]
  rw [Finset.sum_image hcombine.injOn]
  rw [Finset.sum_product]
  rw [Finsupp.antidiagonal_single, Finset.sum_map]
  simp_rw [coeff_coeff_curryFun]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isNoetherianRing_mvPowerSeries_fin
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_mvPowerSeries_fin
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    IsNoetherianRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) R)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R
        (MvPowerSeries (Fin 0) R) MvPowerSeries.C
        MvPowerSeries.C_surjective
  | succ n ih =>
      let : IsNoetherianRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) R) := ih
      let eIndex : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Unit ⊕ Fin n :=
        (finSuccEquiv n).trans
          ((Equiv.optionEquivSumPUnit.{0} (Fin n)).trans
            (Equiv.sumComm _ _))
      let e : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + 1)) R ≃+*
          PowerSeries (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) R) :=
        (MvPowerSeries.renameEquiv R eIndex).toRingEquiv.trans
          MvPowerSeriesFinite.sumUnitEquivPowerSeries
      exact isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv
        (PowerSeries (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) R)) e.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isNoetherianRing_mvPowerSeries_finite
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_mvPowerSeries_finite
    {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Finite σ] :
    IsNoetherianRing (MvPowerSeries σ R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin σ
  let : IsNoetherianRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) R) :=
    isNoetherianRing_mvPowerSeries_fin R n
  exact isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv
    (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) R)
    (MvPowerSeries.renameEquiv R e.symm).toRingEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing_of_generators
statement:
theorem maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing_of_generators
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] (t : ι → B)
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range t) = maximalIdeal B) :
    IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B)
proof:
:= by
  rcases mvPowerSeries_surjective_maximalAdicCompletion_of_generators
      t hgen with ⟨f, hf⟩
  exact isNoetherianRing_of_surjective
    (MvPowerSeries ι B) (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) f hf

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing
statement:
theorem maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B] :
    IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B)
proof:
:= by
  let ι := (maximalIdeal B).generators
  let : Finite ι :=
    Set.finite_coe_iff.mpr
      (Submodule.FG.finite_generators
        ((maximalIdeal B).fg_of_isNoetherianRing :
          (maximalIdeal B : Submodule B B).FG))
  let t : ι → B := fun i ↦ i.1
  have hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range t) = maximalIdeal B := by
    calc
      Ideal.span (Set.range t) =
          Ideal.span ((maximalIdeal B).generators) := by
        congr 1
        ext x
        simp [t, ι]
      _ = maximalIdeal B := (maximalIdeal B).span_generators
  exact maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing_of_generators t hgen

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.IsHausdorff.of_le_ideal
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun z hz ↦ IsHausdorff.haus (I := J) inferInstance z fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  exact SModEq.mono
    (Submodule.smul_mono
      (pow_le_pow_left' hIJ n) (le_refl (⊤ : Submodule R R)))
    (hz n)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.iteratedPowerSeries_surjective_maximalAdicCompletion_of_regularPair
statement:
theorem iteratedPowerSeries_surjective_maximalAdicCompletion_of_regularPair
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    {x y : B}
    (hreg : IsRegular B [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal B) :
    ∃ f : PowerSeries (PowerSeries B) →+*
        AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B,
      Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Bhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B
  let xhat : Bhat := algebraMap B Bhat x
  let yhat : Bhat := algebraMap B Bhat y
  have hgeometry := maximalAdicCompletion_regularPair_geometry hreg hgen
  let : IsDomain Bhat := hgeometry.1
  have hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal B := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  have hyMem : y ∈ maximalIdeal B := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_cons_of_mem x List.mem_cons_self)
  have hxhatMem : xhat ∈ maximalIdeal Bhat := by
    rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap B Bhat) hxMem
  have hyhatMem : yhat ∈ maximalIdeal Bhat := by
