    rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap B Bhat) hyMem
  let : WithIdeal B := ⟨⊥⟩
  let : WithIdeal Bhat := ⟨maximalIdeal Bhat⟩
  have hCompleteHat :
      IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal Bhat) Bhat := inferInstance
  have hAdicHat : IsAdic (maximalIdeal Bhat) := rfl
  let : CompleteSpace Bhat :=
    (hAdicHat.isAdicComplete_iff.mp hCompleteHat).1
  let : T2Space Bhat :=
    (hAdicHat.isAdicComplete_iff.mp hCompleteHat).2
  let coeffMap : B →+* Bhat := algebraMap B Bhat
  have hcoeffMap :
      Ideal.map coeffMap (⊥ : Ideal B) ≤ maximalIdeal Bhat := by
    rw [Ideal.map_bot]
    exact bot_le
  have hcontinuousAlgebraMap :
      Continuous coeffMap :=
    (WithIdeal.uniformContinuous_of_map_le
      (f := coeffMap) hcoeffMap).continuous
  have hxEval : PowerSeries.HasEval xhat :=
    WithIdeal.isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_mem hxhatMem
  have hyEval : PowerSeries.HasEval yhat :=
    WithIdeal.isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_mem hyhatMem
  let fInner : PowerSeries B →+* Bhat :=
    PowerSeries.eval₂Hom hcontinuousAlgebraMap hxEval
  have hfInnerC (b : B) : fInner (PowerSeries.C b) = algebraMap B Bhat b := by
    simpa only [fInner, coeffMap, PowerSeries.coe_eval₂Hom] using
      PowerSeries.eval₂_C (R := B) (S := Bhat)
        (φ := coeffMap) (a := xhat) b
  have hfInnerX : fInner PowerSeries.X = xhat := by
    simpa only [fInner, PowerSeries.coe_eval₂Hom] using
      PowerSeries.eval₂_X (R := B) (S := Bhat)
        (φ := coeffMap) (a := xhat)
  have hfInnerContinuous : Continuous fInner := by
    simpa only [fInner, PowerSeries.coe_eval₂Hom] using
      PowerSeries.continuous_eval₂ hcontinuousAlgebraMap hxEval
  let f : PowerSeries (PowerSeries B) →+* Bhat :=
    PowerSeries.eval₂Hom hfInnerContinuous hyEval
  have hfC (a : PowerSeries B) : f (PowerSeries.C a) = fInner a := by
    simpa only [f, PowerSeries.coe_eval₂Hom] using
      PowerSeries.eval₂_C (R := PowerSeries B) (S := Bhat)
        (φ := fInner) (a := yhat) a
  have hfX : f PowerSeries.X = yhat := by
    simpa only [f, PowerSeries.coe_eval₂Hom] using
      PowerSeries.eval₂_X (R := PowerSeries B) (S := Bhat)
        (φ := fInner) (a := yhat)
  let IInner : Ideal (PowerSeries B) := Ideal.span {PowerSeries.X}
  let IOuter : Ideal (PowerSeries (PowerSeries B)) :=
    Ideal.span {PowerSeries.X}
  let Iy : Ideal Bhat := Ideal.span {yhat}
  let Q := Bhat ⧸ Iy
  let qy : Bhat →+* Q := Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy
  let fInnerQ : PowerSeries B →+* Q := qy.comp fInner
  let : IsDomain Q :=
    completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDomain hreg hgen
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing Q := by
    exact completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDVR hreg hgen
  have hmapInner :
      IInner.map fInnerQ = Ideal.span {qy xhat} := by
    change (Ideal.span {PowerSeries.X}).map fInnerQ =
      Ideal.span {qy xhat}
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    have hx : fInnerQ PowerSeries.X = qy xhat := by
      change qy (fInner PowerSeries.X) = qy xhat
      rw [hfInnerX]
    rw [hx]
  have hmapOuter : IOuter.map f = Iy := by
    change (Ideal.span {PowerSeries.X}).map f = Ideal.span {yhat}
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, hfX]
  have hmaxQ : maximalIdeal Q = Ideal.span {qy xhat} := by
    exact completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_maximalIdeal_eq
      hreg hgen
  have hmapInnerMax : IInner.map fInnerQ = maximalIdeal Q :=
    hmapInner.trans hmaxQ.symm
  have hresidueSurj : Function.Surjective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (IInner.map fInnerQ)).comp fInnerQ) := by
    rw [hmapInnerMax]
    have hsource : Function.Surjective
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal Q)).comp
          (qy.comp (algebraMap B Bhat))) :=
      completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_residue_surjective
        hreg hgen
    intro z
    rcases hsource z with ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine ⟨PowerSeries.C b, ?_⟩
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply, fInnerQ, hfInnerC] using hb
  let : IsHausdorff (IInner.map fInnerQ) Q := by
    rw [hmapInnerMax]
    infer_instance
  have hInnerSurj : Function.Surjective fInnerQ :=
    surjective_of_mk_map_comp_surjective fInnerQ hresidueSurj
  have hOuterResidueSurj : Function.Surjective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (IOuter.map f)).comp f) := by
    intro z
    rcases Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z with ⟨bhat, rfl⟩
    rcases hInnerSurj (qy bhat) with ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨PowerSeries.C a, ?_⟩
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, hfC]
    rw [hmapOuter]
    change qy (fInner a) = qy bhat
    change qy (fInner a) = qy bhat at ha
    exact ha
  have hIyLe : Iy ≤ maximalIdeal Bhat := by
    change Ideal.span {yhat} ≤ maximalIdeal Bhat
    exact Ideal.span_le.2 (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hyhatMem)
  let : IsHausdorff (IOuter.map f) Bhat := by
    rw [hmapOuter]
    exact IsHausdorff.of_le_ideal hIyLe
  have hfSurj : Function.Surjective f :=
    surjective_of_mk_map_comp_surjective f hOuterResidueSurj
  exact ⟨f, hfSurj⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing_of_regularPair
statement:
theorem maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing_of_regularPair
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    {x y : B}
    (hreg : IsRegular B [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal B) :
    IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B)
proof:
:= by
  rcases iteratedPowerSeries_surjective_maximalAdicCompletion_of_regularPair
      hreg hgen with ⟨f, hf⟩
  exact isNoetherianRing_of_surjective
    (PowerSeries (PowerSeries B))
    (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) f hf

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.mvPowerSeries_surjective_maximalAdicCompletion_of_generators
statement:
theorem mvPowerSeries_surjective_maximalAdicCompletion_of_generators
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    {ι : Type v} [Finite ι]
    (t : ι → B)
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range t) = maximalIdeal B) :
    ∃ f : MvPowerSeries ι B →+*
        AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B,
      Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Bhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B
  let that : ι → Bhat := fun i ↦ algebraMap B Bhat (t i)
  have htMem (i : ι) : t i ∈ maximalIdeal B := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)
  have hthatMem (i : ι) : that i ∈ maximalIdeal Bhat := by
    rw [AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap B Bhat) (htMem i)
  let : WithIdeal B := ⟨⊥⟩
  let : WithIdeal Bhat := ⟨maximalIdeal Bhat⟩
  have hCompleteHat :
      IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal Bhat) Bhat := inferInstance
  have hAdicHat : IsAdic (maximalIdeal Bhat) := rfl
  let : CompleteSpace Bhat :=
    (hAdicHat.isAdicComplete_iff.mp hCompleteHat).1
  let : T2Space Bhat :=
    (hAdicHat.isAdicComplete_iff.mp hCompleteHat).2
  let coeffMap : B →+* Bhat := algebraMap B Bhat
  have hcoeffMap :
      Ideal.map coeffMap (⊥ : Ideal B) ≤ maximalIdeal Bhat := by
    rw [Ideal.map_bot]
    exact bot_le
  have hcontinuousAlgebraMap : Continuous coeffMap :=
    (WithIdeal.uniformContinuous_of_map_le
      (f := coeffMap) hcoeffMap).continuous
  have hEval : MvPowerSeries.HasEval that :=
    { hpow := fun i ↦
        WithIdeal.isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_mem (hthatMem i)
      tendsto_zero := by
        rw [Filter.cofinite_eq_bot]
        exact Filter.tendsto_bot }
  let f : MvPowerSeries ι B →+* Bhat :=
    MvPowerSeries.eval₂Hom hcontinuousAlgebraMap hEval
  have hfC (b : B) :
      f (MvPowerSeries.C b) = algebraMap B Bhat b := by
    simpa only [f, coeffMap, MvPowerSeries.coe_eval₂Hom] using
      MvPowerSeries.eval₂_C (φ := coeffMap) (a := that) b
  have hfX (i : ι) : f (MvPowerSeries.X i) = that i := by
    simpa only [f, MvPowerSeries.coe_eval₂Hom] using
      MvPowerSeries.eval₂_X (φ := coeffMap) (a := that) i
  let Ivars : Ideal (MvPowerSeries ι B) :=
    Ideal.span (Set.range MvPowerSeries.X)
  have hmap : Ivars.map f = maximalIdeal Bhat := by
    calc
      Ivars.map f = Ideal.span (f '' Set.range MvPowerSeries.X) := by
        change (Ideal.span (Set.range MvPowerSeries.X)).map f = _
        rw [Ideal.map_span]
      _ = Ideal.span (Set.range that) := by
        congr 1
        ext z
        simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_range]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨i, (hfX i).symm⟩
        · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨MvPowerSeries.X i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hfX i⟩
      _ = (Ideal.span (Set.range t)).map (algebraMap B Bhat) := by
        rw [Ideal.map_span]
        congr 1
        ext z
        simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_range, that]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨t i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
      _ = (maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B Bhat) := by rw [hgen]
      _ = maximalIdeal Bhat := AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map.symm
  have hbaseResidue : Function.Surjective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal Bhat)).comp
        (algebraMap B Bhat)) := by
    have hresidue : Function.Surjective
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap B Bhat)) :=
      (AdicCompletion.residueField_map_bijective B).2
    intro z
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hresidue z
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective w
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    change IsLocalRing.residue Bhat (algebraMap B Bhat b) = z
    rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue, hb]
    exact hw
  have hresidueSurj : Function.Surjective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ivars.map f)).comp f) := by
    rw [hmap]
    intro z
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hbaseResidue z
    refine ⟨MvPowerSeries.C b, ?_⟩
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply, hfC] using hb
  let : IsHausdorff (Ivars.map f) Bhat := by
    rw [hmap]
    infer_instance
  have hfSurj : Function.Surjective f :=
    surjective_of_mk_map_comp_surjective f hresidueSurj
  exact ⟨f, hfSurj⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.mvPowerSeries_fin_surjective_maximalAdicCompletion_of_generators
statement:
theorem mvPowerSeries_fin_surjective_maximalAdicCompletion_of_generators
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (n : ℕ) (t : Fin n → B)
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range t) = maximalIdeal B) :
    ∃ f : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) B →+*
        AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B,
      Function.Surjective f
proof:
:=
  mvPowerSeries_surjective_maximalAdicCompletion_of_generators t hgen

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_tmul_left_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_tmul_left_coe
    {R T F P : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
    [Field F] [Algebra R F]
    [Field P] [Algebra F P]
    (E K' : IntermediateField F P)
    [Algebra R K'] [IsScalarTower R F K']
    (eGeneric : (F ⊗[R] T) ≃ₐ[F] E) (x : K') :
    (((actualCompositumGenericComponentMap E K' eGeneric)
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : T)) :
          (E ⊔ K' : IntermediateField F P)) : P) = x
proof:
:= by
  change
    (((actualCompositumGenericComponentMap E K' eGeneric)
        (algebraMap K' (K' ⊗[R] T) x) :
          (E ⊔ K' : IntermediateField F P)) : P) = x
  rw [(actualCompositumGenericComponentMap E K' eGeneric).commutes]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fractionFieldTower_of_common_integral_base
statement:
theorem fractionFieldTower_of_common_integral_base
    {A : Type uA} {C : Type uB} {F : Type uF} {KC : Type uF'}
    {P : Type uP}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra A C]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F] [IsFractionRing A F]
    [Field KC] [Algebra C KC] [IsFractionRing C KC]
    [Algebra A KC] [IsScalarTower A C KC]
    [Algebra F KC] [IsScalarTower A F KC]
    [Field P] [Algebra A P] [Algebra C P] [IsScalarTower A C P]
    [Algebra F P] [IsScalarTower A F P]
    [Algebra KC P] [IsScalarTower C KC P] :
    IsScalarTower F KC P
proof:
:= by
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro x
  have hmaps :
      (algebraMap KC P).comp (algebraMap F KC) = algebraMap F P := by
    apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := A)
    intro a
    calc
      algebraMap KC P (algebraMap F KC (algebraMap A F a)) =
          algebraMap KC P (algebraMap A KC a) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F KC]
      _ = algebraMap KC P (algebraMap C KC (algebraMap A C a)) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C KC]
      _ = algebraMap C P (algebraMap A C a) :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C KC P _).symm
      _ = algebraMap A P a :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C P a).symm
      _ = algebraMap F P (algebraMap A F a) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F P a
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps x).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.oneIteratedRadicalIsDomain_of_regularPair
statement:
theorem oneIteratedRadicalIsDomain_of_regularPair
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (y z : A) (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A [y, z])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, z] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    let n : Fin 1 → ℕ
proof:
:= fun _ ↦ N
    let a : Fin 1 → A := fun _ ↦ y
    IsDomain (iteratedRadical A 1 n a) := by
  dsimp only
  let : IsDomain A := isDomain_of_regularSystem [y, z] hreg hgen
  have hymax : y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C y)
  let : IsLocalRing Rn :=
    isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN hymax
  let : IsDomain Rn := by
    simpa only [Rn] using
      (localRootCover_regularSystem_geometry hN hreg hgen).2.1
  let e := oneIteratedRadicalAlgEquiv A N y
  exact e.toMulEquiv.isDomain Rn

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteEtaleResidueLift_pair_adjoinRoot_isDomain_of_regularPair
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleResidueLift_pair_adjoinRoot_isDomain_of_regularPair
    {A l : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    [Field l] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    (y z : A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A [y, z])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, z] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    let C₁
proof:
:= FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
    letI : IsDomain C₁ :=
      finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain_of_regularSystem hreg hgen
    IsDomain
      (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C (algebraMap A C₁ y))) := by
  dsimp only
  let C₁ := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let yC := algebraMap A C₁ y
  let zC := algebraMap A C₁ z
  let : IsLocalRing C₁ := isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Module.Finite A C₁ := moduleFinite_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Algebra.Etale A C₁ := etale_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A C₁ := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A C₁
  let : FaithfulSMul A C₁ := faithfulSMul_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C₁) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A C₁
  let : IsNoetherianRing C₁ := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite A C₁
  let : IsDomain C₁ :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain_of_regularSystem hreg hgen
  have hgeometry :=
    finiteEtale_regularSystem_geometry
      (A := A) (C := C₁) (ps := [y, z]) hreg hgen
  have hregC : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular C₁ [yC, zC] := by
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, yC, zC] using
      hgeometry.2.2.1
  have hgenC : Ideal.ofList [yC, zC] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C₁ := by
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, yC, zC] using
      hgeometry.2.2.2.1
  have hymax : yC ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C₁ := by
    rw [← hgenC]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  let : IsLocalRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C yC)) :=
    isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN hymax
  exact (localRootCover_regularSystem_geometry hN hregC hgenC).2.1

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_finiteEtaleResidueLift_isDomain_isDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtaleResidueLift_isDomain_isDiscreteValuationRing
    {A l : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    [Field l] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l] :
    let C
proof:
:= FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
    ∃ hdomainC : IsDomain C,
      letI : IsDomain C := hdomainC
      IsDiscreteValuationRing C := by
  dsimp only
  let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : IsLocalRing C := isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Module.Finite A C := moduleFinite_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A C := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A C
  let : FaithfulSMul A C := faithfulSMul_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A C
  let : Algebra.Etale A C := etale_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  exact isDiscreteValuationRing_of_etale_of_isLocalHom (V := A) (C := C)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain
    {A l : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    [Field l] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l] :
    IsDomain (FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l)
proof:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDiscreteValuationRing
    {A l : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    [Field l] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l] :
    letI : IsDomain (FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l)
proof:
:=
      finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain (A := A) (l := l)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteEtaleResidueLift_algebraMap_prime
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleResidueLift_algebraMap_prime
    {A l : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    [Field l] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Module.Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) l]
    (varpi : A) (hvarpi : Prime varpi) :
    let C
proof:
:= FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
    letI : IsDomain C := finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain (A := A) (l := l)
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing C :=
      finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDiscreteValuationRing (A := A) (l := l)
    Prime (algebraMap A C varpi) := by
  dsimp only
  let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : IsDomain C := finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain (A := A) (l := l)
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing C :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDiscreteValuationRing (A := A) (l := l)
  let : IsLocalRing C := isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Module.Finite A C := moduleFinite_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : FaithfulSMul A C := faithfulSMul_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A C := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A C
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A C
  let : Algebra.Etale A C := etale_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  have hmaxC : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C =
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap A C varpi} : Set C) := by
    calc
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C =
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A C) :=
        Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal.symm
      _ = (Ideal.span ({varpi} : Set A)).map (algebraMap A C) := by
        rw [hvarpi.irreducible.maximalIdeal_eq]
      _ = Ideal.span ({algebraMap A C varpi} : Set C) := by
        rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  have hvarpiCne : algebraMap A C varpi ≠ 0 :=
    by
      simpa only [map_zero] using
        (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective A C).ne hvarpi.ne_zero
  exact
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
      (algebraMap A C varpi) hvarpiCne hmaxC).prime

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul
statement:
theorem fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul
    {C R D : Type u}
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra C R] [FaithfulSMul C R]
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [Algebra C D]
    (e : R ≃ₐ[C] D) :
    let hBase : Algebra C (FractionRing D)
proof:
:=
      fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv e
    @FaithfulSMul C (FractionRing D) hBase.toSMul := by
  intro hBase
  apply (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective C (FractionRing D)).mpr
  have hCD : Function.Injective (algebraMap C D) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective C R
    apply e.injective
    simpa only [e.commutes] using hxy
  change Function.Injective
    ((algebraMap D (FractionRing D)).comp (algebraMap C D))
  exact (IsFractionRing.injective D (FractionRing D)).comp hCD

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower
    {C R D : Type u}
    [CommRing C] [CommRing R]
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D]
    [Algebra C R] [Algebra C D]
    (e : R ≃ₐ[C] D) :
    let hBase : Algebra C (FractionRing D)
proof:
:=
      fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv e
    @IsScalarTower C D (FractionRing D)
      (inferInstance : Algebra C D).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra D (FractionRing D)).toSMul hBase.toSMul := by
  intro hBase
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower
    {C R D : Type u}
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra C R] [FaithfulSMul C R]
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [Algebra C D]
    (e : R ≃ₐ[C] D) :
    let hBase : Algebra C (FractionRing D)
proof:
:=
      fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv e
    let hFraction : Algebra (FractionRing C) (FractionRing D) :=
      fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv e
    @IsScalarTower C (FractionRing C) (FractionRing D)
      (inferInstance : Algebra C (FractionRing C)).toSMul
      hFraction.toSMul hBase.toSMul := by
  intro hBase hFraction
  let : SMul C (FractionRing D) := hBase.toSMul
  let hFaithful : FaithfulSMul C (FractionRing D) :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul e
  exact FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra C (FractionRing D)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_completeChosenFactor_oneRoot_fractionRing_finrank_eq_exponent
statement:
theorem exists_completeChosenFactor_oneRoot_fractionRing_finrank_eq_exponent
    {A : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (varpi : A) (hvarpi : Prime varpi) :
    let n : Fin 1 → ℕ
proof:
:= fun _ ↦ N
    let a : Fin 1 → A := fun _ ↦ varpi
    let B := iteratedRadical A 1 n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a
      (fun _ ↦ hN)
      (fun _ ↦ (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal varpi).mpr hvarpi.not_isUnit)
    ∀ {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra B D]
      [Algebra A D] [IsScalarTower A B D]
      [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D],
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
        [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)],
        ∀ (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
          Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) → Q = q),
          letI : Module.Finite A B :=
            finite_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
            faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
          letI : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
            Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
          letI : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
            isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg
              hmax n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
                (fun _ ↦
                  (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal varpi).mpr hvarpi.not_isUnit)
          letI : IsLocalRing D :=
            isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
            isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
            faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
            rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
            infer_instance
          let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
          let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
          let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
          let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
            AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
              (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a
                (fun _ ↦ hN)
                (fun _ ↦
                  (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal varpi).mpr hvarpi.not_isUnit))
          letI : Module.Finite k kB :=
            Module.Finite.of_surjective
              eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
          letI : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
            AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k l :=
            Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
          let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
          letI : IsDomain C :=
            finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain (A := A) (l := l)
          letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing C :=
            finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDiscreteValuationRing (A := A) (l := l)
          ∃ eTensor : (B ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[B] D,
            letI : Algebra C D := tensorChosenFactorRightAlgebra eTensor
            let varpiC := algebraMap A C varpi
            let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C varpiC)
            let eRoot : Rn ≃ₐ[C] D :=
              oneRootChosenFactorAlgEquiv N varpi eTensor
            letI : IsDomain Rn :=
              isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN varpiC
                (finiteEtaleResidueLift_algebraMap_prime
                  (A := A) (l := l) varpi hvarpi)
            letI : IsDomain D := eRoot.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain Rn
            letI : Module.Free C Rn :=
              (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpiC hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
            letI : FaithfulSMul C Rn := inferInstance
            letI : Algebra C (FractionRing D) :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
            letI : Algebra (FractionRing C) (FractionRing D) :=
              fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
            Module.finrank (FractionRing C) (FractionRing D) = N := by
  dsimp only
  intro D _ _ _ _ _ _ q _ _ hunique
  let n : Fin 1 → ℕ := fun _ ↦ N
  let a : Fin 1 → A := fun _ ↦ varpi
  have hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i := fun _ ↦ hN
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A :=
    fun _ ↦ (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal varpi).mpr hvarpi.not_isUnit
  let B := iteratedRadical A 1 n a
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B := faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
  let : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
    isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg hmax n a hn ha
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
    isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
    faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
    infer_instance
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
  let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
  let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
  let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
      (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a hn ha)
  let : Module.Finite k kB :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
  let : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
    AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k l := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
  let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : IsDomain C :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain (A := A) (l := l)
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing C :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDiscreteValuationRing (A := A) (l := l)
  let eTensor := Classical.choose
    (exists_iteratedRadicalChosenFactorAlgEquiv_of_fg
      hmax n a hn ha (D := D) q hunique)
  refine ⟨eTensor, ?_⟩
  let : Algebra C D := tensorChosenFactorRightAlgebra eTensor
  let varpiC := algebraMap A C varpi
  have hvarpiC : Prime varpiC :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLift_algebraMap_prime
      (A := A) (l := l) varpi hvarpi
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C varpiC)
  let eRoot : Rn ≃ₐ[C] D :=
    oneRootChosenFactorAlgEquiv N varpi eTensor
  let : IsDomain Rn :=
    isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN varpiC hvarpiC
  let : IsDomain D := eRoot.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain Rn
  let : Module.Free C Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpiC hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
  let : FaithfulSMul C Rn := inferInstance
  let KD := FractionRing D
  let KC := FractionRing C
  let Froot := FractionRing Rn
  let : Algebra C KD := fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
  let : SMul C KD := (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul
  let : @FaithfulSMul C KD
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul eRoot
  let : @IsScalarTower C D KD
      (inferInstance : Algebra C D).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra D KD).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
  let : Algebra KC KD := fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
  let : SMul KC KD := (fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower C KC KD :=
    fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
  let eRefl : Rn ≃ₐ[C] Rn := AlgEquiv.refl
  let : Algebra C Froot :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl
  let : SMul C Froot :=
    (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul
  let : @FaithfulSMul C Froot
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul eRefl
  let : @IsScalarTower C Rn Froot
      (inferInstance : Algebra C Rn).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra Rn Froot).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRefl
  let : Algebra KC Froot := fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl
  let : SMul KC Froot := (fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower C KC Froot :=
    fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRefl
  let eFrac : Froot ≃ₐ[KC] KD :=
    IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv KC Froot KD eRoot
  have hRootDegree : Module.finrank KC Froot = N :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finrank_eq_exponent
      (V := C) (K := KC) (F := Froot) hN varpiC hvarpiC
  calc
    Module.finrank KC KD = Module.finrank KC Froot :=
      eFrac.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm
    _ = N := hRootDegree

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.finiteDimensional_of_finite_valuationSubrings_exactChosen
statement:
private theorem finiteDimensional_of_finite_valuationSubrings_exactChosen
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) (target : DVF.{u, w} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring] :
    FiniteDimensional K L
proof:
:= by
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let W := target.valuationSubring
  let : IsFractionRing V K := base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsFractionRing W L := target.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let eGeneric : (K ⊗[V] W) ≃ₐ[K] L := finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv
  let : Module.Finite K (K ⊗[V] W) :=
    Module.Finite.base_change V K W
  exact Module.Finite.equiv eGeneric.toLinearEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_completeChosenFactor_oneRoot_rightAlgebraMap_bijective_of_exactRamification
statement:
theorem
    exists_completeChosenFactor_oneRoot_rightAlgebraMap_bijective_of_exactRamification
    {A : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (varpi : A) (hvarpi : Prime varpi) :
    let n : Fin 1 → ℕ
proof:
:= fun _ ↦ N
    let a : Fin 1 → A := fun _ ↦ varpi
    let B := iteratedRadical A 1 n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a
      (fun _ ↦ hN)
      (fun _ ↦ (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal varpi).mpr hvarpi.not_isUnit)
    ∀ {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra B D]
      [Algebra A D] [IsScalarTower A B D]
      [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D],
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
        [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)],
        ∀ (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
          Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) → Q = q),
          letI : Module.Finite A B :=
            finite_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
            faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
          letI : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
            Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
          letI : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
            isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg
              hmax n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
                (fun _ ↦
                  (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal varpi).mpr hvarpi.not_isUnit)
          letI : IsLocalRing D :=
            isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
            isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
            faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
            rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
            infer_instance
          let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
          let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
          let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
          let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
            AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
              (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a
                (fun _ ↦ hN)
                (fun _ ↦
                  (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal varpi).mpr hvarpi.not_isUnit))
          letI : Module.Finite k kB :=
            Module.Finite.of_surjective
              eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
          letI : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
            AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k l :=
            Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
          let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
          letI : IsDomain C :=
            finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain (A := A) (l := l)
          letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing C :=
            finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDiscreteValuationRing (A := A) (l := l)
          ∃ eTensor : (B ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[B] D,
            letI : Algebra C D := tensorChosenFactorRightAlgebra eTensor
            let varpiC := algebraMap A C varpi
            let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C varpiC)
            let eRoot : Rn ≃ₐ[C] D :=
              oneRootChosenFactorAlgEquiv N varpi eTensor
            letI : IsDomain Rn :=
              isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN varpiC
                (finiteEtaleResidueLift_algebraMap_prime
                  (A := A) (l := l) varpi hvarpi)
            letI : IsDomain D := eRoot.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain Rn
            letI : Module.Free C Rn :=
              (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpiC hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
            letI : FaithfulSMul C Rn := inferInstance
            let P := FractionRing D
            let KC := FractionRing C
            let eRefl : Rn ≃ₐ[C] Rn := AlgEquiv.refl
            let Froot := FractionRing Rn
            letI : Algebra C P :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
            letI : @FaithfulSMul C P
                (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul eRoot
            letI : @IsScalarTower C D P
                (inferInstance : Algebra C D).toSMul
                (inferInstance : Algebra D P).toSMul
                (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
            letI : Algebra KC P := fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
            letI : @IsScalarTower C KC P
                (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
                (fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul
                (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
              fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
            letI : Algebra C Froot :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl
            letI : @FaithfulSMul C Froot
                (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul eRefl
            letI : @IsScalarTower C Rn Froot
                (inferInstance : Algebra C Rn).toSMul
                (inferInstance : Algebra Rn Froot).toSMul
                (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRefl
            letI : Algebra KC Froot :=
              fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl
            letI : @IsScalarTower C KC Froot
                (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
                (fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul
                (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul :=
              fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRefl
            ∀ {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega]
              [Algebra KC Omega] [Algebra Omega P]
              [IsScalarTower KC Omega P],
              ∀ (base : DVF.{u, v} KC) (target : DVF.{u, w} Omega)
                [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
                [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring
                  target.valuationSubring],
                ramificationIndex base target = N →
                  Function.Bijective (algebraMap Omega P) := by
  dsimp only
  intro D _ _ _ _ _ _ q _ _ hunique
  let n : Fin 1 → ℕ := fun _ ↦ N
  let a : Fin 1 → A := fun _ ↦ varpi
  have hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i := fun _ ↦ hN
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A :=
    fun _ ↦ (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal varpi).mpr hvarpi.not_isUnit
  let B := iteratedRadical A 1 n a
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
  let : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
    isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg hmax n a hn ha
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
    isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
    faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
    infer_instance
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
  let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
  let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
  let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
      (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a hn ha)
  let : Module.Finite k kB :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
  let : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
    AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k l := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
  let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : IsDomain C :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain (A := A) (l := l)
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing C :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDiscreteValuationRing (A := A) (l := l)
  let hExists :=
    exists_completeChosenFactor_oneRoot_fractionRing_finrank_eq_exponent
      hmax N hN varpi hvarpi (D := D) q hunique
  let eTensor := Classical.choose hExists
  refine ⟨eTensor, ?_⟩
  let : Algebra C D := tensorChosenFactorRightAlgebra eTensor
  let varpiC := algebraMap A C varpi
  have hvarpiC : Prime varpiC :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLift_algebraMap_prime
      (A := A) (l := l) varpi hvarpi
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C varpiC)
  let eRoot : Rn ≃ₐ[C] D :=
    oneRootChosenFactorAlgEquiv N varpi eTensor
  let : IsDomain Rn :=
    isDomain_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C_of_prime hN varpiC hvarpiC
  let : IsDomain D := eRoot.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain Rn
  let : Module.Free C Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C varpiC hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
  let : FaithfulSMul C Rn := inferInstance
  let P := FractionRing D
  let KC := FractionRing C
  let eRefl : Rn ≃ₐ[C] Rn := AlgEquiv.refl
  let Froot := FractionRing Rn
  let : Algebra C P := fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
  let : @FaithfulSMul C P
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul eRoot
  let : @IsScalarTower C D P
      (inferInstance : Algebra C D).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra D P).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
  let : Algebra KC P := fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
  let : @IsScalarTower C KC P
      (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
      (fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
  let : Algebra C Froot :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl
  let : @FaithfulSMul C Froot
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul eRefl
  let : @IsScalarTower C Rn Froot
      (inferInstance : Algebra C Rn).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra Rn Froot).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRefl
  let : Algebra KC Froot := fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl
  let : @IsScalarTower C KC Froot
      (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
      (fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRefl).toSMul :=
    fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRefl
  let eFrac : Froot ≃ₐ[KC] P :=
    IsFractionRing.fieldEquivOfAlgEquiv KC Froot P eRoot
  let : FiniteDimensional KC Froot :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finiteDimensional hN varpiC hvarpiC
  let : FiniteDimensional KC P :=
    Module.Finite.equiv eFrac.toLinearEquiv
  intro Omega _ _ _ _ base target _ _ hExact
  let : FiniteDimensional KC Omega :=
    finiteDimensional_of_finite_valuationSubrings_exactChosen base target
  let i : Omega →ₗ[KC] P :=
    (Algebra.linearMap Omega P).restrictScalars KC
  have hi : Function.Injective i := (algebraMap Omega P).injective
  have hOmegaLeP : Module.finrank KC Omega ≤ Module.finrank KC P :=
    i.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hi
  have hRamLeOmega : N ≤ Module.finrank KC Omega := by
    rw [← hExact]
    exact ramificationIndex_le_finrank_of_moduleFinite base target
  have hFinrankEq : Module.finrank KC Omega = Module.finrank KC P := by
    have hP : Module.finrank KC P = N := by
      simpa only [P, KC] using Classical.choose_spec hExists
    omega
  have hiSurjective : Function.Surjective i :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank
      hFinrankEq).mp hi
  refine ⟨(algebraMap Omega P).injective, ?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hiSurjective y
  exact ⟨x, hx⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.regularPair_fractionFieldTower_of_finiteEtale_commonTarget
statement:
theorem regularPair_fractionFieldTower_of_finiteEtale_commonTarget
    {A C F KC P : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [Algebra A C]
    [Module.Finite A C] [Algebra.Etale A C]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F] [IsFractionRing A F]
    [Field KC] [Algebra C KC] [IsFractionRing C KC]
    [Algebra A KC] [IsScalarTower A C KC]
    [Algebra F KC] [IsScalarTower A F KC]
    [Field P] [Algebra A P] [Algebra C P]
    [IsScalarTower A C P]
    [Algebra F P] [IsScalarTower A F P]
    [Algebra KC P] [IsScalarTower C KC P]
    (y z : A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A [y, z])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, z] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    IsScalarTower F KC P
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain A := isDomain_of_regularSystem [y, z] hreg hgen
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A C := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A C
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A C
  have hgeometryC :=
    finiteEtale_regularSystem_geometry
      (A := A) (C := C) (ps := [y, z]) hreg hgen
  let : IsDomain C := hgeometryC.2.1
  exact fractionFieldTower_of_common_integral_base
    (A := A) (C := C) (F := F) (KC := KC) (P := P)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completeRegularPair_prefixEmbedding_actualCompositum_boundaryAway
statement:
theorem
    completeRegularPair_prefixEmbedding_actualCompositum_boundaryAway
    {A C F KC M P : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [Algebra A C]
    [Module.Finite A C] [Algebra.Etale A C]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F] [IsFractionRing A F]
    [Field KC] [Algebra C KC] [IsFractionRing C KC]
    [Algebra A KC] [IsScalarTower A C KC]
    [Algebra F KC] [IsScalarTower A F KC]
    [Field M] [Algebra A M] [Algebra F M]
    [IsScalarTower A F M] [FiniteDimensional F M]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable F M]
    [Field P] [Algebra A P] [Algebra C P]
    [IsScalarTower A C P]
    [Algebra F P] [IsScalarTower A F P]
    [Algebra KC P] [IsScalarTower C KC P]
    (y z : A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A [y, z])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, z] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (fPrefix : M →ₐ[F] P)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap A (integralClosure A M)) y).Etale) :
    let hTowerFKCP : IsScalarTower F KC P
proof:
:=
      regularPair_fractionFieldTower_of_finiteEtale_commonTarget
        (A := A) (C := C) (F := F) (KC := KC) (P := P)
        y z hreg hgen
    letI : IsScalarTower F KC P := hTowerFKCP
    let fKC : KC →ₐ[F] P := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F KC P
    let Eimage : IntermediateField F P := fPrefix.fieldRange
    let Kimage : IntermediateField F P := fKC.fieldRange
    let hfiniteEimage : FiniteDimensional F Eimage :=
      fPrefix.toLinearMap.finiteDimensional_range
    letI : FiniteDimensional F Eimage := hfiniteEimage
    let eGeneric : (F ⊗[F] M) ≃ₐ[F] Eimage :=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid F M).trans fPrefix.equivFieldRange
    let mActual := actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal
      (A := F) (T := M) (F := F) (Omega := P)
      Eimage Kimage eGeneric
    let hmActual : mActual.IsMaximal :=
      actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal_isMaximal
        Eimage Kimage eGeneric
    let eKC : KC ≃ₐ[F] Kimage := fKC.equivFieldRange
    let eTensorKC : (KC ⊗[F] M) ≃ₐ[F] (Kimage ⊗[F] M) :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.congr eKC (AlgEquiv.refl : M ≃ₐ[F] M)
    let mKC := mActual.comap eTensorKC.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
    let hmKC : mKC.IsMaximal :=
      hmActual.comap_bijective eTensorKC.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
        eTensorKC.bijective
    letI : mKC.IsMaximal := hmKC
    let Omega := GenericTensorFieldComponent mKC
    letI : Algebra C Omega :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := C) mKC
    ∃ omegaToP : Omega →ₐ[KC] P,
      Function.Injective omegaToP ∧
        (∀ x : KC,
          omegaToP (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft mKC x) =
            algebraMap KC P x) ∧
        (∀ c : C,
          omegaToP
              (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft mKC
                (algebraMap C KC c)) =
            algebraMap C P c) ∧
        (∀ x : M,
          omegaToP (genericTensorFieldComponentRight mKC x) =
            fPrefix x) ∧
        letI : Algebra Omega P := omegaToP.toRingHom.toAlgebra
        IsScalarTower KC Omega P ∧
          (Localization.awayMap
            (algebraMap C (integralClosure C Omega))
            (algebraMap A C y)).Etale := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let : IsDomain A := isDomain_of_regularSystem [y, z] hreg hgen
  let : IsRegularLocalRing A :=
    isRegularLocalRing_of_regularSystem [y, z] hreg hgen
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A C := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A C
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A C
  have hgeometryC :=
    finiteEtale_regularSystem_geometry
      (A := A) (C := C) (ps := [y, z]) hreg hgen
  let : IsNoetherianRing C := hgeometryC.1
  let : IsDomain C := hgeometryC.2.1
  let yC := algebraMap A C y
  let zC := algebraMap A C z
  have hregC : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular C [yC, zC] := by
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, yC, zC] using
      hgeometryC.2.2.1
  have hgenC : Ideal.ofList [yC, zC] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C := by
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, yC, zC] using
      hgeometryC.2.2.2.1
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed C :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
      C yC zC hregC hgenC
  let : IsScalarTower F KC P :=
    regularPair_fractionFieldTower_of_finiteEtale_commonTarget
      (A := A) (C := C) (F := F) (KC := KC) (P := P)
      y z hreg hgen
  let fKC : KC →ₐ[F] P := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F KC P
  let Eimage : IntermediateField F P := fPrefix.fieldRange
  let Kimage : IntermediateField F P := fKC.fieldRange
  let : FiniteDimensional F Eimage :=
    fPrefix.toLinearMap.finiteDimensional_range
  let eGeneric : (F ⊗[F] M) ≃ₐ[F] Eimage :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid F M).trans fPrefix.equivFieldRange
  let mActual := actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal
    (A := F) (T := M) (F := F) (Omega := P)
    Eimage Kimage eGeneric
  let : mActual.IsMaximal :=
    actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal_isMaximal
      Eimage Kimage eGeneric
  let eKC : KC ≃ₐ[F] Kimage := fKC.equivFieldRange
  let eTensorKC : (KC ⊗[F] M) ≃ₐ[F] (Kimage ⊗[F] M) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.congr eKC (AlgEquiv.refl : M ≃ₐ[F] M)
  let mKC := mActual.comap eTensorKC.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  let : mKC.IsMaximal :=
    (inferInstance : mActual.IsMaximal).comap_bijective
      eTensorKC.toRingEquiv.toRingHom eTensorKC.bijective
  let Omega := GenericTensorFieldComponent mKC
  let : Algebra C Omega :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := C) mKC
  let C₀ := integralClosure A M
  let : Module.Finite A C₀ :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_finite_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      (K := F) hdim
  let : IsFractionRing C₀ M :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension A F M C₀
  let : FaithfulSMul A C₀ :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective A C₀).mpr fun x w hxw ↦ by
      apply (IsFractionRing.injective A F)
      apply (algebraMap F M).injective
      have hxM := congrArg (fun c : C₀ ↦ (c : M)) hxw
      change algebraMap A M x = algebraMap A M w at hxM
      calc
        algebraMap F M (algebraMap A F x) = algebraMap A M x :=
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F M x).symm
        _ = algebraMap A M w := hxM
        _ = algebraMap F M (algebraMap A F w) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F M w
  have hyne : y ≠ 0 :=
    (prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen List.mem_cons_self).ne_zero
  have hAwayOmega :
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap C (integralClosure C Omega)) yC).Etale := by
    simpa only [yC, C₀, Omega] using
      (localization_away_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_awayMap
        (A := A) (C := C₀) (D := C)
        (F := F) (E := M) (K := KC)
        y hyne hAway mKC)
  have hmMap :
      mActual = mKC.map eTensorKC.toRingEquiv.toRingHom := by
    exact (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective
      eTensorKC.toRingEquiv.toRingHom eTensorKC.surjective mActual).symm
  let eComponent : Omega ≃ₐ[F]
      GenericTensorFieldComponent mActual :=
    Ideal.quotientEquivAlg mKC mActual eTensorKC hmMap
  let eActualF : GenericTensorFieldComponent mActual ≃ₐ[F]
      (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P) :=
    (actualCompositumGenericComponentAlgEquiv
      Eimage Kimage eGeneric).restrictScalars F
  let eAmbientF : Omega ≃ₐ[F]
      (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P) :=
    eComponent.trans eActualF
  let ambientInclusion :
      (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P) →ₐ[F] P :=
    (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P).val
  let omegaToPF : Omega →ₐ[F] P :=
    ambientInclusion.comp eAmbientF.toAlgHom
  let omegaToP : Omega →ₐ[KC] P :=
    { omegaToPF.toRingHom with
      commutes' := by
        intro x
        change omegaToPF (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft mKC x) =
          algebraMap KC P x
        change
          (((actualCompositumGenericComponentAlgEquiv
              Eimage Kimage eGeneric)
            (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg mKC mActual eTensorKC hmMap
              (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft mKC x)) :
                (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P)) : P) =
            algebraMap KC P x
        rw [genericTensorFieldComponentLeft_apply,
          Ideal.quotientEquivAlg_mk mActual eTensorKC hmMap,
          actualCompositumGenericComponentAlgEquiv_mk]
        change
          (((actualCompositumGenericComponentMap Eimage Kimage eGeneric)
            (eTensorKC
              ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
                KC →ₐ[F] KC ⊗[F] M) x)) :
              (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P)) : P) =
            algebraMap KC P x
        rw [show eTensorKC
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
              KC →ₐ[F] KC ⊗[F] M) x) =
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
                Kimage →ₐ[F] Kimage ⊗[F] M) (eKC x) by
          change eTensorKC (x ⊗ₜ[F] (1 : M)) =
            eKC x ⊗ₜ[F] (1 : M)
          simp [eTensorKC]]
        change
          (((actualCompositumGenericComponentMap Eimage Kimage eGeneric)
              ((eKC x) ⊗ₜ[F] (1 : M)) :
                (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P)) : P) =
            algebraMap KC P x
        rw [actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_tmul_left_coe]
        rfl }
  have hLeftCoordinate (x : KC) :
      omegaToP (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft mKC x) =
        algebraMap KC P x :=
    omegaToP.commutes x
  have hBaseCoordinate (c : C) :
      omegaToP
          (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft mKC
            (algebraMap C KC c)) =
        algebraMap C P c := by
    rw [hLeftCoordinate]
    exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C KC P c).symm
  have hRightCoordinate (x : M) :
      omegaToP (genericTensorFieldComponentRight mKC x) =
        fPrefix x := by
    change
      (((actualCompositumGenericComponentAlgEquiv
            Eimage Kimage eGeneric)
          (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg mKC mActual eTensorKC hmMap
            (genericTensorFieldComponentRight mKC x)) :
              (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P)) : P) =
        fPrefix x
    rw [genericTensorFieldComponentRight_apply,
      Ideal.quotientEquivAlg_mk mActual eTensorKC hmMap,
      actualCompositumGenericComponentAlgEquiv_mk]
    change
      (((actualCompositumGenericComponentMap Eimage Kimage eGeneric)
          (eTensorKC
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
              M →ₐ[F] KC ⊗[F] M) x)) :
            (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P)) : P) =
        fPrefix x
    rw [show eTensorKC
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          M →ₐ[F] KC ⊗[F] M) x) =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
            M →ₐ[F] Kimage ⊗[F] M) x by
      change eTensorKC ((1 : KC) ⊗ₜ[F] x) =
        (1 : Kimage) ⊗ₜ[F] x
      simp [eTensorKC]]
    change
      (((actualCompositumGenericComponentMap Eimage Kimage eGeneric)
          ((1 : Kimage) ⊗ₜ[F] x) :
            (Eimage ⊔ Kimage : IntermediateField F P)) : P) =
        fPrefix x
    rw [actualCompositumGenericComponentMap_tmul_right_coe]
    simpa only [eGeneric, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.lid_tmul, one_smul]
      using AlgHom.equivFieldRange_apply_coe (f := fPrefix) x
  let : Algebra Omega P := omegaToP.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hTowerOmega : IsScalarTower KC Omega P := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    exact (omegaToP.commutes x).symm
  exact ⟨omegaToP, omegaToP.injective, hLeftCoordinate,
    hBaseCoordinate, hRightCoordinate, hTowerOmega, hAwayOmega⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completionQuotientSecondRegularParameter_isDomain
statement:
private theorem completionQuotientSecondRegularParameter_isDomain
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let Rhat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
    let I := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)
    IsDomain (Rhat ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R Rhat)) := by
  dsimp only
  let Rhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)
  have hgeometry := maximalAdicCompletion_regularPair_geometry hreg hgen
  let : IsDomain Rhat := hgeometry.1
  have hIPrime :
      (I.map (algebraMap R Rhat)).IsPrime := by
    simp only [I, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    exact Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hgeometry.2.2.2.2
  let : (I.map (algebraMap R Rhat)).IsPrime := hIPrime
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime
    (I.map (algebraMap R Rhat))).mpr inferInstance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completionQuotientSecondRegularParameter_isDVR
statement:
theorem completionQuotientSecondRegularParameter_isDVR
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let Rhat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
    let I := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)
    @IsDiscreteValuationRing
      (Rhat ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R Rhat)) inferInstance
      (completionQuotientSecondRegularParameter_isDomain hreg hgen) := by
  have hregSwap : IsRegular R [y, x] :=
    IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hreg (List.Perm.swap x y []).symm
  have hgenSwap : Ideal.ofList [y, x] = maximalIdeal R := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList [y, x] = Ideal.ofList [x, y] := by
        apply congrArg Ideal.span
        ext z
        simp [or_comm]
      _ = maximalIdeal R := hgen
  exact completionQuotientFirstRegularParameter_isDVR hregSwap hgenSwap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDomain
statement:
theorem completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDomain
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])

proof:
:= AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
    let yhat := algebraMap R Rhat y

  let Rhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDVR
statement:
theorem completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDVR
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let Rhat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
    let yhat := algebraMap R Rhat y
    @IsDiscreteValuationRing
      (Rhat ⧸ Ideal.span ({yhat} : Set Rhat)) inferInstance
      (completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDomain hreg hgen) := by
  dsimp only
  let Rhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let yhat : Rhat := algebraMap R Rhat y
  let Iy : Ideal Rhat := Ideal.span ({yhat} : Set Rhat)
  let : IsDomain (Rhat ⧸ Iy) :=
    completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDomain hreg hgen
  have hDVR := completionQuotientSecondRegularParameter_isDVR hreg hgen
  let Imap : Ideal Rhat :=
    (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)).map (algebraMap R Rhat)
  have hImap : Imap = Iy := by
    simp only [Imap, Iy, yhat, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  let eI : (Rhat ⧸ Imap) ≃+* (Rhat ⧸ Iy) := RingEquiv.cast hImap
  let : IsDomain (Rhat ⧸ Imap) :=
    eI.toMulEquiv.isDomain (Rhat ⧸ Iy)
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing (Rhat ⧸ Imap) := by
    exact hDVR
  exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.RingEquivClass.isDiscreteValuationRing eI

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_maximalIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_maximalIdeal_eq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let Rhat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
    let xhat := algebraMap R Rhat x
    let yhat := algebraMap R Rhat y
    let Iy := Ideal.span ({yhat} : Set Rhat)
    let Q := Rhat ⧸ Iy
    letI : IsDomain Q :=
      completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDomain hreg hgen
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing Q :=
      completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDVR hreg hgen
    maximalIdeal Q =
      Ideal.span ({Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy xhat} : Set Q) := by
  dsimp only
  let Rhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let xhat : Rhat := algebraMap R Rhat x
  let yhat : Rhat := algebraMap R Rhat y
  let Iy : Ideal Rhat := Ideal.span ({yhat} : Set Rhat)
  let Q := Rhat ⧸ Iy
  let : IsDomain Q :=
    completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDomain hreg hgen
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing Q :=
    completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDVR hreg hgen
  have hgeometry := maximalAdicCompletion_regularPair_geometry hreg hgen
  have hmaxMap :
      (maximalIdeal Rhat).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy) =
        maximalIdeal Q :=
    IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hyzero : Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy yhat = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self yhat)
  calc
    maximalIdeal Q =
        (maximalIdeal Rhat).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy) := hmaxMap.symm
    _ = (Ideal.ofList [xhat, yhat]).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy) := by
      rw [hgeometry.2.2.1]
    _ = Ideal.ofList
        [Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy xhat, Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy yhat] := by
      exact Ideal.map_ofList (Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy) [xhat, yhat]
    _ = Ideal.span ({Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy xhat} : Set Q) := by
      rw [hyzero]
      rw [Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_nil,
        sup_bot_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_zero, sup_bot_eq]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_residue_surjective
statement:
theorem completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_residue_surjective
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let Rhat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
    let yhat := algebraMap R Rhat y
    let Iy := Ideal.span ({yhat} : Set Rhat)
    let Q := Rhat ⧸ Iy
    letI : IsDomain Q :=
      completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDomain hreg hgen
    letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing Q :=
      completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDVR hreg hgen
    Function.Surjective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal Q)).comp
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy).comp (algebraMap R Rhat))) := by
  dsimp only
  let Rhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let yhat : Rhat := algebraMap R Rhat y
  let Iy : Ideal Rhat := Ideal.span ({yhat} : Set Rhat)
  let Q := Rhat ⧸ Iy
  let qmap : Rhat →+* Q := Ideal.Quotient.mk Iy
  let f : R →+* Q := qmap.comp (algebraMap R Rhat)
  let : IsDomain Q :=
    completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDomain hreg hgen
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing Q :=
    completedRegularPair_secondParameterQuotient_isDVR hreg hgen
  let : IsLocalHom qmap :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective qmap Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hquotientResidue :
      Function.Surjective
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map qmap) := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective z
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
    refine ⟨IsLocalRing.residue Rhat a, ?_⟩
    exact IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue qmap a
  have hsourceResidue :
      Function.Surjective
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map f) := by
    have hcomp := hquotientResidue.comp
      (AdicCompletion.residueField_map_bijective R).2
    simpa only [f, qmap, IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_comp,
      RingHom.coe_comp] using hcomp
  intro z
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hsourceResidue z
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective w
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  change IsLocalRing.residue Q (f r) = z
  rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue, hr]
  exact hw

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.integralClosure_completeDVFFactorialRoot_originalTensorProduct_etale
statement:
theorem integralClosure_completeDVFFactorialRoot_originalTensorProduct_etale
    {K₀ : Type uK₀} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [Field K₀] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra K₀ K] [Algebra K₀ L]
    [FiniteDimensional K₀ L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K₀ L]
    (base : CompleteDVF.{uK, uV} K)
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    (D : ℕ) (hdegree : Module.finrank K₀ L ≤ D) :
    let V
proof:
:= base.valuationSubring
    letI : IsFractionRing V K :=
      base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed V :=
      base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
    let N := D.factorial
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
    letI : IsDomain Rn :=
      completeDVFFactorialRootRing_isDomain base varpi hvarpi D
    let F := FractionRing Rn
    letI : Algebra K F :=
      completeDVFFactorialRootFractionFieldAlgebra base varpi hvarpi D
    letI : IsScalarTower V K F :=
      completeDVFFactorialRootFractionField_isScalarTower
        base varpi hvarpi D
    letI : Algebra K₀ F :=
      ((algebraMap K F).comp (algebraMap K₀ K)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower K₀ K F :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    let G := F ⊗[K₀] L
    letI : Algebra Rn G :=
      genericTensorProductLeftScalarAlgebra
        (R := Rn) (K := K₀) (F := F) (L := L)
    Algebra.Etale Rn (integralClosure Rn G) := by
  dsimp only
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let N := D.factorial
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed V :=
    base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  let : IsDomain Rn :=
    completeDVFFactorialRootRing_isDomain base varpi hvarpi D
  let F := FractionRing Rn
  let : Algebra K F :=
    completeDVFFactorialRootFractionFieldAlgebra base varpi hvarpi D
  let : IsScalarTower V K F :=
    completeDVFFactorialRootFractionField_isScalarTower
      base varpi hvarpi D
  let : Algebra K₀ F :=
    ((algebraMap K F).comp (algebraMap K₀ K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower K₀ K F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let G := F ⊗[K₀] L
  let : Algebra Rn G :=
    genericTensorProductLeftScalarAlgebra
      (R := Rn) (K := K₀) (F := F) (L := L)
  apply integralClosure_genericTensorProduct_etale
  intro m hm
  let : m.IsMaximal := hm
  exact
    integralClosure_completeDVFFactorialRoot_fixedTensorComponent_etale
      base varpi hvarpi D hdegree m hm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.integralClosure_completeDVFFactorialRoot_fixedTensorComponent_etale
statement:
theorem integralClosure_completeDVFFactorialRoot_fixedTensorComponent_etale
    {K₀ : Type uK₀} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [Field K₀] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra K₀ K] [Algebra K₀ L]
    [FiniteDimensional K₀ L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K₀ L]
    (base : CompleteDVF.{uK, uV} K)
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    (D : ℕ) (hdegree : Module.finrank K₀ L ≤ D) :
    let V
proof:
:= base.valuationSubring
    letI : IsFractionRing V K :=
      base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed V :=
      base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
    let N := D.factorial
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
    letI : IsDomain Rn :=
      completeDVFFactorialRootRing_isDomain base varpi hvarpi D
    let F := FractionRing Rn
    letI : Algebra K F :=
      completeDVFFactorialRootFractionFieldAlgebra base varpi hvarpi D
    letI : IsScalarTower V K F :=
      completeDVFFactorialRootFractionField_isScalarTower
        base varpi hvarpi D
    letI : Algebra K₀ F :=
      ((algebraMap K F).comp (algebraMap K₀ K)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower K₀ K F :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    ∀ (m : Ideal (F ⊗[K₀] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
      letI : m.IsMaximal := hm
      let P := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
      letI : Algebra Rn P :=
        genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Rn) m
      Algebra.Etale Rn (integralClosure Rn P) := by
  dsimp only
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let N := D.factorial
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed V :=
    base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  let : IsDomain Rn :=
    completeDVFFactorialRootRing_isDomain base varpi hvarpi D
  let F := FractionRing Rn
  let : Algebra K F :=
    completeDVFFactorialRootFractionFieldAlgebra base varpi hvarpi D
  let : IsScalarTower V K F :=
    completeDVFFactorialRootFractionField_isScalarTower
      base varpi hvarpi D
  let : Algebra K₀ F :=
    ((algebraMap K F).comp (algebraMap K₀ K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower K₀ K F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : FiniteDimensional K F :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finiteDimensional
      (Nat.factorial_pos D) varpi
        (completeDVFUniformizer_prime base varpi hvarpi)
  intro m hm
  let : m.IsMaximal := hm
  let n := genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal
    (K := K₀) (F := K) (F' := F) (L := L) m
  let : n.IsMaximal :=
    genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal_isMaximal
      (K := K₀) (F := K) (F' := F) (L := L) m
  let L₀ := GenericTensorFieldComponent n
  let m₂ := genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal
    (K := K₀) (F := K) (F' := F) (L := L) m
  let : m₂.IsMaximal :=
    genericTensorTowerSecondIdeal_isMaximal

              (unit : target.valuationSubring) * pi ^ e ∧
            beta ^ D.factorial =
              algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure L) (varpi : K) ∧
            Nonempty
              (HigherRadicalActualFactorData
                base.toDVF target.toDVF varpi D.factorial beta) := by
  obtain ⟨target, hExt, hIntegralClosure, hFundamental⟩ :=
    exists_integralClosure_standard_fundamental_identity
      (K := K) (L := L) base

    base.toDVF target.toDVF varpi hvarpi pi unit hpi hdecomp
    D.factorial hdiv beta hbeta

    (hpi : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span ({pi} : Set V))
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hdiv : ∀ Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C,
      Q.1.ramificationIdx V ∣ N)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)) :

proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
    let Khat := standardDVFCompletionField V K
    letI : Algebra K Khat := standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K

      standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi

      completeDVFRootFractionFieldAlgebra H varpiHat

          V K pi hpi) N hN

      letI : m.IsMaximal := hm
      let P := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
      letI : Algebra Rn P :=
        genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Rn) m
      Algebra.Etale Rn (integralClosure Rn P) := by

  let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
  let Khat := standardDVFCompletionField V K

    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V Vhat) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=

proof:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.oneRoot_fractionRing_finrank_eq_exponent_of_prime
statement:
theorem oneRoot_fractionRing_finrank_eq_exponent_of_prime
    {A K F : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Field K] [Field F]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K F]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (y : A) (hy : Prime y)
    [Algebra (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C y)) F]
    [IsFractionRing (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C y)) F]
    [Algebra A F]
    [IsScalarTower A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C y)) F]
    [IsScalarTower A K F] :
    Module.finrank K F = N
proof:
:= by
  have _hy : y ≠ 0 := hy.ne_zero
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C y)
  let : IsDomain Rn :=
    (IsFractionRing.injective Rn F).isDomain (algebraMap Rn F)
  let : Module.Free A Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C y hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Finite A Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C y hN.ne').finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Finite K (K ⊗[A] Rn) :=
    Module.Finite.base_change A K Rn
  let eFinite : (K ⊗[A] Rn) ≃ₐ[K] F :=
    finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv
      (R := A) (C := Rn) (K := K) (E := F)
  calc
    Module.finrank K F = Module.finrank K (K ⊗[A] Rn) :=
      eFinite.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm
    _ = Module.finrank A Rn := Module.finrank_baseChange
    _ = (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis'
          (monic_X_pow_sub_C y hN.ne')).dim := by
      simpa only [Rn] using
        (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis'
          (monic_X_pow_sub_C y hN.ne')).finrank
    _ = (X ^ N - Polynomial.C y).natDegree := rfl
    _ = N := Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C

statement:
private theorem rootCoordinate_fractionRing_finiteDimensional_finrank
    {C D : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [Algebra C D]
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (yC : C)
    [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC))]
    [Module.Free C (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC))]
    [FaithfulSMul C (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC))]
    (eRoot : AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC) ≃ₐ[C] D) :
    letI : Algebra C (FractionRing D)
proof:
:=
      fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
    letI : Algebra (FractionRing C) (FractionRing D) :=
      fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
    FiniteDimensional (FractionRing C) (FractionRing D) ∧
      Module.finrank (FractionRing C) (FractionRing D) = N := by
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC)
  let : Module.Finite C Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C yC hN.ne').finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Free C D := Module.Free.of_equiv eRoot.toLinearEquiv
  let : Module.Finite C D := Module.Finite.equiv eRoot.toLinearEquiv
  let KC := FractionRing C
  let P := FractionRing D
  let : Algebra C P := fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
  let : @FaithfulSMul C P
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul eRoot
  let : @IsScalarTower C D P
      (inferInstance : Algebra C D).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra D P).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
  let : Algebra KC P := fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
  let : @IsScalarTower C KC P
      (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
      (fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
  let : Module.Finite KC (KC ⊗[C] D) := Module.Finite.base_change C KC D
  let eGeneric : (KC ⊗[C] D) ≃ₐ[KC] P :=
    finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv (R := C) (C := D) (K := KC) (E := P)
  refine ⟨Module.Finite.equiv eGeneric.toLinearEquiv, ?_⟩
  calc
    Module.finrank KC P = Module.finrank KC (KC ⊗[C] D) :=
      eGeneric.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm
    _ = Module.finrank C D := Module.finrank_baseChange
    _ = Module.finrank C Rn := eRoot.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm
    _ = (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' (monic_X_pow_sub_C yC hN.ne')).dim := by
      exact (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' (monic_X_pow_sub_C yC hN.ne')).finrank
    _ = (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC).natDegree := rfl
    _ = N := Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_completeRegularLocalChosenFactor_oneRoot_fractionRing_finrank_eq_exponent
statement:
theorem
    exists_completeRegularLocalChosenFactor_oneRoot_fractionRing_finrank_eq_exponent
    {A : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]

    {ps : List A}

    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (y : A) (hy : y ∈ ps) :

proof:
:= fun _ ↦ N
    let a : Fin 1 → A := fun _ ↦ y

      rw [← hgen]

    ∀ {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra B D]
      [Algebra A D] [IsScalarTower A B D]
      [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D],
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
        [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)],
        ∀ (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
          Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) → Q = q),
          letI : Module.Finite A B :=
            finite_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
            faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
          letI : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
            Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
          letI : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
            isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg
