      ringKrullDim (C ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C) = 0 :=
    ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field _
  rw [hfieldDim, zero_add] at hdimAux
  have hdimC :
      ringKrullDim C = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    norm_num [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hdimAux
    exact hdimAux.symm
  intro K₀ L₀ _ _ _ _ _ _ m hm
  let : m.IsMaximal := hm
  intro Omega cOmegaAlgebra hCOmegaTower _ _ pC
  let : pC.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hyC
  intro Q _ _ hExact
  have hpCHeight : pC.height = 1 :=
    Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hyC.ne_zero) hyC.not_isUnit
  let : IsRegularRing C :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two hdimC
  let pA := Ideal.span ({y} : Set A)
  have hpMap : pA.map (algebraMap A C) = pC := by
    simp only [pA, pC, yC, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  have hCharCMap :
      CharZero (C ⧸ pA.map (algebraMap A C)) := by
    let J := pA.map (algebraMap A C)
    have hUnder : J.under A = pA :=
      Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat (B := C) pA
    let : CharZero (A ⧸ J.under A) := by
      rw [hUnder]
      exact hCharZero
    exact charZero_of_injective_algebraMap
      (Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_injective (R := A) (A := C) (I := J))
  let : CharZero (C ⧸ pC) :=
    (congrArg (fun J : Ideal C => CharZero (C ⧸ J)) hpMap).mp hCharCMap
  let : FiniteDimensional KC Omega :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentFiniteDimensional (K := K₀) (K' := KC) (L := L₀) m
  let : IsGalois KC Omega :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentIsGalois (K := K₀) (K' := KC) (L := L₀) m
  have hRamDiv : N ∣ Module.finrank KC Omega := by
    have hRam : Q.ramificationIdx C ∣ Module.finrank KC Omega :=
      normalization_ramificationIdx_dvd_finrank_of_charZero
        (A := C) (K := KC) (L := Omega) pC hpCHeight Q
    exact
      (congrArg (fun e => e ∣ Module.finrank KC Omega) hExact).mp hRam
  let i : Omega →ₗ[KC] P :=
    (Algebra.linearMap Omega P).restrictScalars KC
  have hi : Function.Injective i := (algebraMap Omega P).injective
  have hOmegaLeP : Module.finrank KC Omega ≤ Module.finrank KC P :=
    i.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hi
  have hRamLeOmega : N ≤ Module.finrank KC Omega :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd Module.finrank_pos hRamDiv
  have hFinrankEq : Module.finrank KC Omega = Module.finrank KC P := by
    have hP : Module.finrank KC P = N := by
      simpa only [P, KC] using hDegree
    omega
  have hiSurjective : Function.Surjective i :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank
      hFinrankEq).mp hi
  refine ⟨(algebraMap Omega P).injective, ?_⟩
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hiSurjective z
  exact ⟨x, hx⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.compositeAlgebra_toSMul_isScalarTower_exponentUnit
statement:
private theorem compositeAlgebra_toSMul_isScalarTower_exponentUnit
    {C K E : Type u}
    [CommRing C] [CommRing K] [CommRing E]
    [Algebra C K] [Algebra K E] :
    @IsScalarTower C K E
      (inferInstance : Algebra C K).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra K E).toSMul
      (((algebraMap K E).comp (algebraMap C K)).toAlgebra).toSMul
proof:
:= by
  refine @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq C K E
    _ _ _ (inferInstance : Algebra C K)
      (inferInstance : Algebra K E)
      ((algebraMap K E).comp (algebraMap C K)).toAlgebra ?_
  intro x
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localization_awayMap_etale_of_etale_base_and_away_extension
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_etale_of_etale_base_and_away_extension
    {A C D : Type*}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra A C] [Algebra C D] [Algebra.Etale A C]
    (f : A)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap C D) (algebraMap A C f)).Etale) :
    (Localization.awayMap
      ((algebraMap C D).comp (algebraMap A C)) f).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let fC : C := algebraMap A C f
  let fD : D := algebraMap C D fC
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let T := Localization.Away fC
  let U := Localization.Away fD
  let mapST : S →+* T :=
    Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A C) f
  let mapTU : T →+* U :=
    Localization.awayMap (algebraMap C D) fC
  let mapSU : S →+* U :=
    Localization.awayMap
      ((algebraMap C D).comp (algebraMap A C)) f
  let : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra T U := mapTU.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra S U := mapSU.toAlgebra
  have hcomp : mapTU.comp mapST = mapSU := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers f)
    ext a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    calc
      mapTU (mapST (algebraMap A S a)) =
          mapTU (algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C a)) := by
        rw [show mapST (algebraMap A S a) =
            algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C a) by
          change IsLocalization.map T (algebraMap A C) _
              (algebraMap A S a) = algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C a)
          exact IsLocalization.map_eq _ a]
      _ = algebraMap D U (algebraMap C D (algebraMap A C a)) := by
        change IsLocalization.map U (algebraMap C D) _
            (algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C a)) = _
        exact IsLocalization.map_eq _ (algebraMap A C a)
      _ = mapSU (algebraMap A S a) := by
        change algebraMap D U
            (((algebraMap C D).comp (algebraMap A C)) a) =
          IsLocalization.map U
            ((algebraMap C D).comp (algebraMap A C)) _
              (algebraMap A S a)
        exact (IsLocalization.map_eq _ a).symm
  let : IsScalarTower S T U :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦
      (DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp x).symm
  have hST : Algebra.Etale S T := by
    let : IsScalarTower A C T := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    let : IsScalarTower A S T := by
      apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
      intro a
      change algebraMap A T a = mapST (algebraMap A S a)
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C T]
      change algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C a) =
        IsLocalization.map T (algebraMap A C) _ (algebraMap A S a)
      exact (IsLocalization.map_eq _ a).symm
    let : Algebra.Etale A S := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway f
    let : Algebra.Etale C T := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway fC
    let : Algebra.Etale A T := Algebra.Etale.comp A C T
    exact Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars A S T
  let : Algebra.Etale S T := hST
  let : Algebra.Etale T U := by
    simpa only [mapTU, fC, fD, T, U] using hAway.toAlgebra
  exact (show Algebra.Etale S U from Algebra.Etale.comp S T U)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_completeRegularPairChosenFactor_oneRoot_exponent_isUnit_of_prefixNormalizationAway
statement:
theorem
    exists_completeRegularPairChosenFactor_oneRoot_exponent_isUnit_of_prefixNormalizationAway
    {A : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (y z : A)
    (hreg : IsRegular A [y, z])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, z] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hCharZero : CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({y} : Set A))) :
    let n : Fin 1 → ℕ
proof:
:= fun _ ↦ N
    let a : Fin 1 → A := fun _ ↦ y
    let B := iteratedRadical A 1 n a
    let hymax : y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
      rw [← hgen]
      exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
    letI : IsDomain A := isDomain_of_regularSystem [y, z] hreg hgen
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a
      (fun _ ↦ hN) (fun _ ↦ hymax)
    ∀ {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra B D]
      [Algebra A D] [IsScalarTower A B D]
      [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D],
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
        [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)],
        ∀ (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
          Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) → Q = q),
          letI : Module.Finite A B :=
            finite_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
            faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
          letI : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
            Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
          letI : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
            isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg
              (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
              n a (fun _ ↦ hN) (fun _ ↦ hymax)
          letI : IsLocalRing D :=
            isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
            isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
            faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
            rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
            infer_instance
          let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
          let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
          let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
          let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
            AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
              (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a
                (fun _ ↦ hN) (fun _ ↦ hymax))
          letI : Module.Finite k kB :=
            Module.Finite.of_surjective
              eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
          letI : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
            AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k l :=
            Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
          let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
          letI : IsDomain C :=
            finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain_of_regularSystem hreg hgen
          ∃ eTensor : (B ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[B] D,
            letI : Algebra C D := tensorChosenFactorRightAlgebra eTensor
            let yC := algebraMap A C y
            let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC)
            let eRoot : Rn ≃ₐ[C] D :=
              oneRootChosenFactorAlgEquiv N y eTensor
            letI : IsDomain Rn :=
              finiteEtaleResidueLift_adjoinRoot_isDomain_of_mem_regularSystem
                hreg hgen hN y List.mem_cons_self
            letI : IsDomain D := eRoot.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain Rn
            letI : Module.Free C Rn :=
              (monic_X_pow_sub_C yC hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
            letI : FaithfulSMul C Rn := inferInstance
            let P := FractionRing D
            let KC := FractionRing C
            letI : Algebra C P :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
            letI : @FaithfulSMul C P
                (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul eRoot
            letI : @IsScalarTower C D P
                (inferInstance : Algebra C D).toSMul
                (inferInstance : Algebra D P).toSMul
                (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
              fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
            letI : Algebra KC P := fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
            letI : @IsScalarTower C KC P
                (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
                (fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul
                (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
              fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
            ∀ {Omega : Type u} [Field Omega]
              [Algebra KC Omega] [Algebra Omega P]
              [IsScalarTower KC Omega P],
              ∀ (base : DVF.{u, v} KC) (target : DVF.{u, w} Omega)
                [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
                [Module.Finite base.valuationSubring
                  target.valuationSubring],
                ramificationIndex base target = N →
                  letI : Algebra C Omega :=
                    ((algebraMap KC Omega).comp (algebraMap C KC)).toAlgebra
                  letI : @IsScalarTower C KC Omega
                      (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
                      (inferInstance : Algebra KC Omega).toSMul
                      (((algebraMap KC Omega).comp
                        (algebraMap C KC)).toAlgebra).toSMul :=
                    compositeAlgebra_toSMul_isScalarTower_exponentUnit
                  letI : @IsScalarTower C Omega P
                      (((algebraMap KC Omega).comp
                        (algebraMap C KC)).toAlgebra).toSMul
                      (inferInstance : Algebra Omega P).toSMul
                      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
                    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ by
                      change algebraMap C P x = algebraMap Omega P
                        (algebraMap KC Omega (algebraMap C KC x))
                      calc
                        algebraMap C P x =
                            algebraMap KC P (algebraMap C KC x) :=
                          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C KC P x
                        _ = algebraMap Omega P
                            (algebraMap KC Omega (algebraMap C KC x)) :=
                          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply KC Omega P _
                  (Localization.awayMap
                    (algebraMap C (integralClosure C Omega)) yC).Etale →
                    IsUnit (N : A) := by
  intro n a B hymax D _ _ _ _ _ _ q _ _ hunique k kB l eResidue C
  let : IsDomain A := isDomain_of_regularSystem [y, z] hreg hgen
  have hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i := fun _ ↦ hN
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := fun _ ↦ hymax
  let : IsLocalRing B :=
    isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN) (fun _ ↦ hymax)
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a (fun _ ↦ hN)
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) := Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
  let : IsLocalRing D := isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
    isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
    infer_instance
  let : Module.Finite k kB :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
  let : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB := AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k l := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
  let : IsDomain C :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLiftIsDomain_of_regularSystem hreg hgen
  have hChosenComparison :=
    exists_completeRegularLocalChosenFactor_oneRoot_rightAlgebraMap_bijective_of_exactRamification
      hreg hgen N hN y (by exact List.mem_cons_self) (D := D) q hunique
  let eTensor : (B ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[B] D := Classical.choose hChosenComparison
  refine ⟨eTensor, ?_⟩
  let : IsLocalRing C := isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Module.Finite A C := moduleFinite_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : FaithfulSMul A C := faithfulSMul_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Algebra.Etale A C := etale_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A C := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A C
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A C
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A C :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let : Algebra C D := tensorChosenFactorRightAlgebra eTensor
  let : IsScalarTower A C D :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ by
      calc
        algebraMap A D x = algebraMap B D (algebraMap A B x) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B D x
        _ = eTensor (algebraMap B (B ⊗[A] C) (algebraMap A B x)) :=
          (eTensor.commutes (algebraMap A B x)).symm
        _ = eTensor
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (algebraMap A C x)) := by
          congr 1
          exact DFunLike.congr_fun
            Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_comp_algebraMap x
        _ = algebraMap C D (algebraMap A C x) := rfl
  intro yC Rn eRoot P KC
  let zC := algebraMap A C z
  let : IsDomain Rn :=
    finiteEtaleResidueLift_adjoinRoot_isDomain_of_mem_regularSystem
      hreg hgen hN y List.mem_cons_self
  let : IsDomain D := eRoot.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain Rn
  let : Module.Free C Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C yC hN.ne').free_adjoinRoot
  let : FaithfulSMul C Rn := inferInstance
  let : Algebra C P := fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
  let : @FaithfulSMul C P
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_faithfulSMul eRoot
  let : @IsScalarTower C D P
      (inferInstance : Algebra C D).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra D P).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
  let : Algebra KC P := fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot
  let : @IsScalarTower C KC P
      (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
      (fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    fractionRingAlgebraOfAlgEquiv_isScalarTower eRoot
  have hgeometryC :=
    finiteEtale_regularSystem_geometry
      (A := A) (C := C) (ps := [y, z]) hreg hgen
  let : IsNoetherianRing C := hgeometryC.1
  have hregC : IsRegular C [yC, zC] := by
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, yC, zC] using
      hgeometryC.2.2.1
  have hgenC : Ideal.ofList [yC, zC] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C := by
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, yC, zC] using
      hgeometryC.2.2.2.1
  have hyCmax : yC ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C := by
    rw [← hgenC]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by exact List.mem_cons_self)
  let : IsLocalRing Rn := by
    simpa only [Rn] using
      isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hN hyCmax
  have hgeometryRn :=
    localRootCover_regularSystem_geometry
      (R := C) (a := yC) (rs := [zC]) hN hregC hgenC
  let : IsNoetherianRing Rn := by
    simpa only [Rn] using hgeometryRn.1
  have hregRn : IsRegular Rn
      [AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC), algebraMap C Rn zC] := by
    simpa only [Rn, localRootCoverParameterList,
      List.map_cons, List.map_nil, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq] using
        hgeometryRn.2.2.1
  have hgenRn : Ideal.ofList
      [AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC), algebraMap C Rn zC] =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Rn := by
    simpa only [Rn, localRootCoverParameterList,
      List.map_cons, List.map_nil, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq] using
        hgeometryRn.2.2.2.1
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed Rn :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
      Rn (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - Polynomial.C yC))
        (algebraMap C Rn zC) hregRn hgenRn
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed D := IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv eRoot.toRingEquiv
  let : Module.Finite C Rn :=
    (monic_X_pow_sub_C yC hN.ne').finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Finite C D := Module.Finite.equiv eRoot.toLinearEquiv
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral C D := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite C D
  let : IsIntegralClosure D C P :=
    IsIntegralClosure.of_isIntegrallyClosed D C P
  intro Omega _ _ _ _ base target _ _ hExact
  let : Algebra C Omega :=
    ((algebraMap KC Omega).comp (algebraMap C KC)).toAlgebra
  let : @IsScalarTower C KC Omega
      (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra KC Omega).toSMul
      (((algebraMap KC Omega).comp
        (algebraMap C KC)).toAlgebra).toSMul :=
    compositeAlgebra_toSMul_isScalarTower_exponentUnit
  let : @IsScalarTower C Omega P
      (((algebraMap KC Omega).comp
        (algebraMap C KC)).toAlgebra).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra Omega P).toSMul
      (fractionRingTargetBaseAlgebraOfAlgEquiv eRoot).toSMul :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ by
      change algebraMap C P x = algebraMap Omega P
        (algebraMap KC Omega (algebraMap C KC x))
      calc
        algebraMap C P x = algebraMap KC P (algebraMap C KC x) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C KC P x
        _ = algebraMap Omega P
            (algebraMap KC Omega (algebraMap C KC x)) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply KC Omega P _
  intro hAwayOmega
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap Omega P) :=
    Classical.choose_spec hChosenComparison base target hExact
  have hAwayP : RingHom.Etale
      (R := Localization.Away yC)
      (S := Localization.Away
        (algebraMap C (integralClosure C P) yC))
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap C (integralClosure C P)) yC) := by
    exact integralClosure_boundaryAway_of_bijective_fieldTower_algebraMap
      (A := C) (L := Omega) (P := P) hbij yC hAwayOmega
  let chosenEquiv : integralClosure C P ≃ₐ[C] D :=
    IsIntegralClosure.equiv C (integralClosure C P) P D
  have hAwayCD :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap C D) yC).Etale :=
    localization_awayMap_etale_of_algEquiv chosenEquiv yC hAwayP
  have hAwayComposite :=
    localization_awayMap_etale_of_etale_base_and_away_extension
      (A := A) (C := C) (D := D) y hAwayCD
  have hAwayAD :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) y).Etale := by
    have hMap : algebraMap A D =
        (algebraMap C D).comp (algebraMap A C) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A C D
    rw [hMap]
    exact hAwayComposite
  have hyPrime : Prime y :=
    prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen (by exact List.mem_cons_self)
  have hAwayProduct :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) (∏ i, a i)).Etale := by
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_one a]
    exact hAwayAD
  have hUnit :=
    all_exponents_isUnit_of_completeChosenFactor
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
      n a hn ha (fun _ ↦ hyPrime) (fun _ ↦ hCharZero)
      (D := D) q hunique hAwayProduct (0 : Fin 1)
  simpa only [n] using hUnit

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completeRegularPairChosenFactor_oneRoot_exponent_isUnit_of_exactNormalizationPrime
statement:
private theorem
    completeRegularPairChosenFactor_oneRoot_exponent_isUnit_of_exactNormalizationPrime
    {A : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (y z : A)

    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Rn) m
  let eF : P₂ ≃ₐ[F] P :=
    genericTensorTowerSecondComponentAlgEquiv
      (K := K₀) (F := K) (F' := F) (L := L) m
  let e : P₂ ≃ₐ[Rn] P :=
    { toRingEquiv := eF.toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro x
        change eF (algebraMap F P₂ (algebraMap Rn F x)) =
          algebraMap F P (algebraMap Rn F x)
        exact eF.commutes (algebraMap Rn F x) }
  let eIC : integralClosure Rn P₂ ≃ₐ[Rn] integralClosure Rn P :=
    e.mapIntegralClosure
  let : Algebra.Etale Rn (integralClosure Rn P₂) := hEtale₂
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eIC

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.integralClosure_completeDVFRoot_fixedTensorComponent_etale_of_completeTarget
statement:
theorem integralClosure_completeDVFRoot_fixedTensorComponent_etale_of_completeTarget
    {K₀ : Type uK₀} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [Field K₀] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra K₀ K] [Algebra K₀ L]
    (base : CompleteDVF.{uK, uV} K)
    [CharZero base.residueField]
    (varpi : base.valuationSubring)
    (hvarpi : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (varpi : K))
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    let V
proof:
:= base.valuationSubring
    letI : IsFractionRing V K :=
      base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed V :=
      base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
    letI : IsDomain Rn :=
      completeDVFRootRing_isDomain base varpi hvarpi N hN
    let F := FractionRing Rn
    letI : Algebra K F :=
      completeDVFRootFractionFieldAlgebra base varpi hvarpi N hN
    letI : IsScalarTower V K F :=
      completeDVFRootFractionField_isScalarTower
        base varpi hvarpi N hN
    letI : Algebra K₀ F :=
      ((algebraMap K F).comp (algebraMap K₀ K)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower K₀ K F :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    letI : FiniteDimensional K F :=
      pureRadicalFractionField_finiteDimensional
        hN varpi (completeDVFUniformizer_prime base varpi hvarpi)
    ∀ (m : Ideal (F ⊗[K₀] L)) (hm : m.IsMaximal),
      letI : m.IsMaximal := hm
      let n := genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal
        (K := K₀) (F := K) (F' := F) (L := L) m
      letI : n.IsMaximal :=
        genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal_isMaximal
          (K := K₀) (F := K) (F' := F) (L := L) m
      let L₀ := GenericTensorFieldComponent n
      ∀ (target : CompleteDVF.{max uK uL, uW} L₀),
        [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation] →
        [Module.Finite V target.valuationSubring] →
        ramificationIndex base.toDVF target.toDVF ∣ N →
        let P := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
        letI : Algebra Rn P :=
          genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Rn) m
        Algebra.Etale Rn (integralClosure Rn P) := by
  dsimp only
  let V := base.valuationSubring
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C varpi)
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed V :=
    base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isIntegrallyClosed
  let : IsDomain Rn :=
    completeDVFRootRing_isDomain base varpi hvarpi N hN
  let F := FractionRing Rn
  let : Algebra K F :=
    completeDVFRootFractionFieldAlgebra base varpi hvarpi N hN
  let : IsScalarTower V K F :=
    completeDVFRootFractionField_isScalarTower
      base varpi hvarpi N hN
  let : Algebra K₀ F :=
    ((algebraMap K F).comp (algebraMap K₀ K)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower K₀ K F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : FiniteDimensional K F :=
    pureRadicalFractionField_finiteDimensional
      hN varpi (completeDVFUniformizer_prime base varpi hvarpi)
  intro m hm target hExt hfinite hdiv
  exact
    integralClosure_pureRadicalFractionField_fixedTensorComponent_etale_of_completeTarget
      base varpi hvarpi N hN m hm target hdiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.all_exponents_isUnit_of_iteratedRadical_chosenFactorCoordinates
statement:
theorem all_exponents_isUnit_of_iteratedRadical_chosenFactorCoordinates
    {A C D : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] [Module.FaithfullyFlat A C]
    [CommRing D] [Algebra A D] [Algebra C D] [IsScalarTower A C D]
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (haPrime : ∀ i, Prime (a i))
    (hCharZero : ∀ i, CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a i}))
    (e : iteratedRadical C r n (fun i ↦ algebraMap A C (a i)) ≃ₐ[C] D)
    (hAway : (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D)
      (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)), a i)).Etale) :
    ∀ i, IsUnit (n i : A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let fA : A := ∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)), a i
  let fC : C := algebraMap A C fA
  let fD : D := algebraMap A D fA
  let R := iteratedRadical C r n (fun i ↦ algebraMap A C (a i))
  let fR : R := algebraMap C R fC
  let S := Localization.Away fA
  let MC := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C (Submonoid.powers fA)
  let T := Localization MC
  let U := Localization.Away fD
  let MR := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid R MC
  let Rₛ := Localization MR
  have hMC : MC = Submonoid.powers fC := by
    simp only [MC, fC, Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid_powers]
  have hMR : MR = Submonoid.powers fR := by
    simp only [MR, hMC, fR, Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid_powers]
  let : IsLocalization.Away fC T := by
    change IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers fC) T
    simpa only [fC, ← Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid_powers] using
      (inferInstance : IsLocalization MC T)
  let : IsLocalization.Away fR Rₛ := by
    change IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers fR) Rₛ
    rw [← hMR]
    exact
      (inferInstance : IsLocalization MR Rₛ)
  let mapST : S →+* T :=
    IsLocalization.Away.map S T (algebraMap A C) fA
  let mapCU : C →+* U := algebraMap C U
  have hCU : IsUnit (mapCU fC) := by
    have hACD : algebraMap C D fC = fD := by
      simpa [fC, fD] using
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C D fA).symm
    rw [show mapCU fC = algebraMap D U (algebraMap C D fC) by
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C D U fC]
    rw [hACD]
    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _
  let mapTU : T →+* U := IsLocalization.Away.lift fC hCU
  let mapSU : S →+* U := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) fA
  let : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra T U := mapTU.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra S U := mapSU.toAlgebra
  have hSTU : mapTU.comp mapST = mapSU := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers fA)
    ext x
    change mapTU (mapST (algebraMap A S x)) =
      mapSU (algebraMap A S x)
    rw [show mapST (algebraMap A S x) =
        algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C x) by
      change IsLocalization.map T (algebraMap A C) _
        (algebraMap A S x) = algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C x)
      exact IsLocalization.map_eq _ x]
    rw [show mapTU (algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C x)) =
        mapCU (algebraMap A C x) by simp [mapTU]]
    rw [show mapSU (algebraMap A S x) = algebraMap A U x by
      change IsLocalization.map U (algebraMap A D) _
        (algebraMap A S x) = algebraMap D U (algebraMap A D x)
      exact IsLocalization.map_eq _ x]
    exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C U x).symm
  let : IsScalarTower S T U :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' hSTU.symm
  let : Algebra.Etale S U := hAway.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified T U :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_restrictScalars S T U
  let mapCRₛ : C →+* Rₛ := algebraMap C Rₛ
  have hCRₛ : IsUnit (mapCRₛ fC) := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap R Rₛ fR)
    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _
  let mapTRₛ : T →+* Rₛ := IsLocalization.Away.lift fC hCRₛ
  have hmapTRₛ : mapTRₛ = algebraMap T Rₛ := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers fC)
    ext x
    change mapTRₛ (algebraMap C T x) =
      algebraMap T Rₛ (algebraMap C T x)
    rw [show mapTRₛ (algebraMap C T x) = mapCRₛ x by
      simp [mapTRₛ]]
    exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C T Rₛ x
  have hmapPowers :
      Submonoid.map e (Submonoid.powers fR) = Submonoid.powers fD := by
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
    congr 1
    simpa [fR, fC, fD] using
      (e.commutes (algebraMap A C fA)).trans
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C D fA).symm
  let eLocC : Rₛ ≃ₐ[C] U :=
    IsLocalization.algEquivOfAlgEquiv Rₛ U e hmapPowers
  have hLocComm : eLocC.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap T Rₛ) = mapTU := by
    rw [← hmapTRₛ]
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers fC)
    ext x
    simp [eLocC, mapTRₛ, mapTU, mapCRₛ, mapCU]
  let eLocT : Rₛ ≃ₐ[T] U :=
    { toRingEquiv := eLocC.toRingEquiv
      commutes' := fun x ↦ DFunLike.congr_fun hLocComm x }
  let rootT :=
    iteratedRadical T r n
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C (a i)))
  let eBase : T ⊗[C] R ≃ₐ[T] rootT :=
    iteratedRadicalBaseChangeAlgEquiv n
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap A C (a i))
  let eTensorLoc : T ⊗[C] R ≃ₐ[T] Rₛ :=
    Localization.tensorRightAlgEquiv MC R
  let eRootLoc : rootT ≃ₐ[T] Rₛ := eBase.symm.trans eTensorLoc
  let eRootU : rootT ≃ₐ[T] U := eRootLoc.trans eLocT
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified T rootT :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_equiv eRootU.symm
  have hfA : fA ≠ 0 := by
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ ↦ (haPrime i).ne_zero
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hfA
  let eST : S ⊗[A] C ≃ₐ[S] T := by
    exact Localization.tensorRightAlgEquiv (Submonoid.powers fA) C
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat S T :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
      (R := S) (M := S ⊗[A] C) eST.symm.toLinearEquiv
  let : Nontrivial T :=
    (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective S T).nontrivial
  have hnT : ∀ i, IsUnit (n i : T) :=
    all_exponents_isUnit_of_formallyUnramified_iteratedRadical
      (A := T) n
        (fun i ↦ algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C (a i))) hn
  have hnS : ∀ i, IsUnit (n i : S) := by
    intro i
    apply (isUnit_map_iff (algebraMap S T) (n i : S)).mp
    simpa using hnT i
  intro i
  exact isUnit_natCast_of_isUnit_algebraMap_away_finsetProduct
    (R := A) (S := S) Finset.univ a
    (fun j _ ↦ haPrime j) (fun j _ ↦ hCharZero j)
    (hn i) (by simpa using hnS i)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.all_exponents_isUnit_of_completeChosenFactor
statement:
theorem all_exponents_isUnit_of_completeChosenFactor
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (haMax : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (haPrime : ∀ i, Prime (a i))
    (hCharZero : ∀ i, CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a i})) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn haMax
    ∀ {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra B D]
      [Algebra A D] [IsScalarTower A B D]
      [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D],
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
        [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)],
        (∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
          Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) → Q = q) →
        (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D)
          (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)), a i)).Etale →
        ∀ i, IsUnit (n i : A) := by
  dsimp only
  intro D _ _ _ _ _ _ q _ _ hunique hAway
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn haMax
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
    isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
    faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
    infer_instance
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
  let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
  let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
  let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
      (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a hn haMax)
  let : Module.Finite k kB :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
  let : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
    AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k l := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
  let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
  obtain ⟨eTensor, heCoord⟩ :=
    exists_iteratedRadicalChosenFactorAlgEquiv_of_fg
      hmax n a hn haMax (D := D) q hunique
  let : IsLocalRing C := isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Module.Finite A C := moduleFinite_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : FaithfulSMul A C := faithfulSMul_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A C := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A C
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A C
  let : Algebra.Etale A C := etale_finiteEtaleResidueLift A l
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A C :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let : Algebra C D := tensorChosenFactorRightAlgebra eTensor
  let : IsScalarTower A C D :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ by
      calc
        algebraMap A D x = algebraMap B D (algebraMap A B x) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B D x
        _ = eTensor (algebraMap B (B ⊗[A] C) (algebraMap A B x)) :=
          (eTensor.commutes (algebraMap A B x)).symm
        _ = eTensor
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (algebraMap A C x)) := by
          congr 1
          exact DFunLike.congr_fun
            Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom_comp_algebraMap x
        _ = algebraMap C D (algebraMap A C x) := rfl
  obtain ⟨eCoord⟩ := heCoord
  exact all_exponents_isUnit_of_iteratedRadical_chosenFactorCoordinates
    n a hn haPrime hCharZero eCoord hAway

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completeRegularPair_prefixEmbedding_actualCompositum_exactPrime_boundaryAway
statement:
theorem
    completeRegularPair_prefixEmbedding_actualCompositum_exactPrime_boundaryAway
    {A C F KC M P : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing C] [IsLocalRing C] [Algebra A C]
    [Module.Finite A C] [Algebra.Etale A C] [FaithfulSMul A C]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F] [IsFractionRing A F]
    [Field KC] [Algebra C KC] [IsFractionRing C KC]
    [Algebra A KC] [IsScalarTower A C KC]
    [Algebra F KC] [IsScalarTower A F KC]
    [Field M] [Algebra A M] [Algebra F M]
    [IsScalarTower A F M] [FiniteDimensional F M]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable F M]
    [Field P] [Algebra A P] [Algebra C P]
    [IsScalarTower A C P]
    [Algebra F P] [IsScalarTower A F P]
    [Algebra KC P] [IsScalarTower C KC P]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A M)]
    (y z : A)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular A [y, z])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, z] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (N : ℕ)
    (fPrefix : M →ₐ[F] P)
    (q : Ideal (integralClosure A M))
    (hqPrime : q.IsPrime)
    (hqOver : q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({y} : Set A)))
    (hqExact : q.ramificationIdx A = N)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap A (integralClosure A M)) y).Etale) :
    ∃ (mKC : Ideal (KC ⊗[F] M)) (hmKC : mKC.IsMaximal),
      letI : mKC.IsMaximal
proof:
:= hmKC
      let Omega := GenericTensorFieldComponent mKC
      let cOmegaAlgebra : Algebra C Omega :=
        ((algebraMap KC Omega).comp (algebraMap C KC)).toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra C Omega := cOmegaAlgebra
      ∃ omegaToP : Omega →ₐ[KC] P,
        letI : Algebra Omega P := omegaToP.toRingHom.toAlgebra
        @IsScalarTower C KC Omega
            (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
            (inferInstance : Algebra KC Omega).toSMul
            cOmegaAlgebra.toSMul ∧
          IsScalarTower KC Omega P ∧
            (Localization.awayMap
              (algebraMap C (integralClosure C Omega))
              (algebraMap A C y)).Etale ∧
            ∃ Q : Ideal (integralClosure C Omega),
              Q.IsPrime ∧
                Q.LiesOver
                  (Ideal.span ({algebraMap A C y} : Set C)) ∧
                Q.ramificationIdx C = N := by
  classical
  let : IsDomain A := isDomain_of_regularSystem [y, z] hreg hgen
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A C := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A C
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A C) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A C
  have hgeometryC :=
    finiteEtale_regularSystem_geometry
      (A := A) (C := C) (ps := [y, z]) hreg hgen
  let : IsDomain C := hgeometryC.2.1
  let yC := algebraMap A C y
  have hyC : Prime yC := by
    apply hgeometryC.2.2.2.2.2.1 yC
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, List.mem_cons_self, rfl⟩
  have hpC : (Ideal.span ({yC} : Set C)).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hyC
  let : q.IsPrime := hqPrime
  let : q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({y} : Set A)) := hqOver
  let : IsScalarTower F KC P :=
    regularPair_fractionFieldTower_of_finiteEtale_commonTarget
      (A := A) (C := C) (F := F) (KC := KC) (P := P)
      y z hreg hgen
  let fKC : KC →ₐ[F] P := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F KC P
  let Eimage : IntermediateField F P := fPrefix.fieldRange
  let Kimage : IntermediateField F P := fKC.fieldRange
  let : FiniteDimensional F Eimage :=
    fPrefix.toLinearMap.finiteDimensional_range
  let eGeneric :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid F M).trans fPrefix.equivFieldRange
  let mActual := actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal
    (A := F) (T := M) (F := F) (Omega := P)
    Eimage Kimage eGeneric
  let : mActual.IsMaximal :=
    actualCompositumGenericComponentIdeal_isMaximal
      Eimage Kimage eGeneric
  let eKC := fKC.equivFieldRange
  let eTensorKC :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.congr eKC (AlgEquiv.refl : M ≃ₐ[F] M)
  let mKC := mActual.comap eTensorKC.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  let : mKC.IsMaximal :=
    (inferInstance : mActual.IsMaximal).comap_bijective
      eTensorKC.toRingEquiv.toRingHom eTensorKC.bijective
  let Omega := GenericTensorFieldComponent mKC
  let cOmegaAlgebra : Algebra C Omega :=
    ((algebraMap KC Omega).comp (algebraMap C KC)).toAlgebra
  have hCOmegaAlgebra :
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := C) mKC =
        cOmegaAlgebra := by
    apply Algebra.algebra_ext _ _
    intro c
    rfl
  let : Algebra C Omega := cOmegaAlgebra
  obtain ⟨omegaToP, _, _, _, _, hBoundaryTail⟩ :=
    completeRegularPair_prefixEmbedding_actualCompositum_boundaryAway
      (A := A) (C := C) (F := F) (KC := KC)
      (M := M) (P := P) y z hreg hgen hdim fPrefix hAway
  rw [hCOmegaAlgebra] at hBoundaryTail
  let : Algebra Omega P := omegaToP.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hBoundaryTail' :
      IsScalarTower KC Omega P ∧
        (Localization.awayMap
          (algebraMap C (integralClosure C Omega)) yC).Etale := by
    simpa only [Omega, mKC, mActual, eTensorKC, eKC,
      eGeneric, Eimage, Kimage, fKC] using hBoundaryTail
  have hTowerOmega : IsScalarTower KC Omega P := hBoundaryTail'.1
  let : IsScalarTower KC Omega P := hTowerOmega
  have hAwayOmega := hBoundaryTail'.2
  have hPrimeData :=
    exists_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_prime_liesOver_span_ramificationIdx_eq
      (A := A) (C := C) (F := F) (KC := KC) (M := M)
      y mKC q hpC
  rw [hCOmegaAlgebra] at hPrimeData
  obtain ⟨Q, hQPrime, hQOver, hQRamification⟩ := hPrimeData
  have hTowerCKCOmega : @IsScalarTower C KC Omega
      (inferInstance : Algebra C KC).toSMul
      (inferInstance : Algebra KC Omega).toSMul
      cOmegaAlgebra.toSMul := by
    refine @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq C KC Omega
      _ _ _ (inferInstance : Algebra C KC)
        (inferInstance : Algebra KC Omega) cOmegaAlgebra ?_
    intro x
    rfl
  refine ⟨mKC, inferInstance, omegaToP, hTowerCKCOmega,
    hTowerOmega, hAwayOmega, Q, hQPrime, hQOver, ?_⟩
  exact hQRamification.trans hqExact

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.genericTensorTowerFinalComponentIntegralClosurePrime_isPrime
statement:
theorem genericTensorTowerFinalComponentIntegralClosurePrime_isPrime
    [FiniteDimensional F F']
    (m : Ideal (F' ⊗[K] L)) [m.IsMaximal]
    (p :
      let Pm := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
      letI : Algebra B Pm :=
        genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := B) m
      Ideal (integralClosure B Pm))
    [p.IsPrime] :
    let n
proof:
:= genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal

theorem heightOnePrime_eq_span_root_of_under_eq_span_radicand
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] {N : ℕ} {p : B}
    [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p))]
    (hrootPrime : Prime (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p)))
    (q : Ideal (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p))) [q.IsPrime]
    (hqHeight : q.height = 1)
    (hunder : q.under B = Ideal.span ({p} : Set B)) :
    q = Ideal.span

        Set (AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C p)))
proof:
:= by

    change p ∈ q.under B

  have hrootPowMem : AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p) ^ N ∈ q := by
    rw [adjoinRoot_root_pow]
    simpa only [AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq] using hpMem
  have hrootMem : AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C p) ∈ q :=
    (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).mem_of_pow_mem N hrootPowMem
  exact q.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one hqHeight hrootMem hrootPrime

    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin d),

proof:

      let a : Fin d → R :=
        heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
      let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
      let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
      let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
      let D := AdjoinRoot F
      (IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
        Prime (algebraMap R B y) ∧
        IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R B y} : Set B))) ∧
      (∀ k, 0 < n k) ∧
      ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      (IsRegularLocalRing D ∧ IsDomain D ∧
        ringKrullDim D = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        Prime (AdjoinRoot.root F) ∧
        IsDomain (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D)) ∧
        IsRegularLocalRing
          (D ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D))) ∧
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime], q.height = 1 →
        (q.under B).IsPrime ∧ (q.under B).height = 1 ∧
          (q = Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root F} : Set D) ∨
            (∃ k : Fin d,
              (i.succAbove (σ k)).1 < r ∧
              t (i.succAbove (σ k)) ∈ P ∧
              n k = e (σ k) ∧
              Prime (iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k) ∧
              q.under B = Ideal.span
                ({iteratedRadicalRoot R n a k} : Set B)) ∨
            Disjoint
              (((Submonoid.powers
                (algebraMap R B (algebraMap A R f)) : Submonoid B) : Set B))
              (q.under B : Set B)) := by
  classical
  rcases
      splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_fullRootCover_heightOnePrime_contraction_trichotomy
        hNC i hi P hP htiP e he N hN with
    ⟨σ, hgeometryB, hn, hdimB, hgeometryD, htrichotomy⟩
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let n := heightTwoConditionalOtherExponent t i r P e σ
  let a : Fin d → R := heightTwoConditionalOtherRadicand t i P σ
  let B := iteratedRadical R d n a
  let y : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
  let F : B[X] := X ^ N - C (algebraMap R B y)
  let D := AdjoinRoot F
  let : IsDomain B := hgeometryB.2.1
  let : IsDomain D := hgeometryD.2.1
  refine ⟨σ, hgeometryB, hn, hdimB, hgeometryD, ?_⟩
  intro q _ hqHeight
  rcases htrichotomy q hqHeight with
    ⟨hqUnderPrime, hqUnderHeight, hselected | hother | haway⟩
  · refine ⟨hqUnderPrime, hqUnderHeight, Or.inl ?_⟩
    simpa only [F, D] using
      (heightOnePrime_eq_span_root_of_under_eq_span_radicand
        hgeometryD.2.2.2.1 q hqHeight hselected)
  · exact ⟨hqUnderPrime, hqUnderHeight, Or.inr (Or.inl hother)⟩
  · exact ⟨hqUnderPrime, hqUnderHeight, Or.inr (Or.inr haway)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span
statement:
theorem localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_eq_span
    {R : Type uV} [CommRing R]

    (hq : q = Ideal.span ({pi} : Set R)) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q) =
      Ideal.span
        ({algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) pi} :
          Set (Localization.AtPrime q))

        Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q)) q :=

        (Localization.AtPrime q)).symm
    _ = Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q))

    _ = Ideal.span
        ({algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) pi} :

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement_isUniformizer
statement:
theorem standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement_isUniformizer
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    (pi : V)
    (hpi : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V = Ideal.span ({pi} : Set V)) :
    let H
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    H.valuation.IsUniformizer
      (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi :
        standardDVFCompletionField V K) := by
  dsimp only
  let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let Vhat := H.valuationSubring

  let piHat : Vhat :=

        (standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K).symm
      _ = Ideal.map (algebraMap V Vhat) (Ideal.span ({pi} : Set V)) := by
        rw [hpi]
      _ = Ideal.span ({piHat} : Set Vhat) := by

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_heightOneLocalizationElement_with_completed_uniformizer
statement:
theorem
    exists_heightOneLocalizationElement_with_completed_uniformizer
    {D : Type uV} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsRegularLocalRing D]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim D = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime] (hqHeight : q.height = 1) :
    let V
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime q
    ∃ hV : IsDiscreteValuationRing V,
      letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := hV
      let K := FractionRing V
      ∃ pi : V,
        (standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K).valuation.IsUniformizer
          (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi :
            standardDVFCompletionField V K) := by
  dsimp only
  let V := Localization.AtPrime q
  let hV : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups in
      isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
        hdim q hqHeight)
  refine ⟨hV, ?_⟩
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := hV
  let K := FractionRing V
  obtain ⟨pi, hpi⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible V

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.standardDVRRootCompletionAlgEquiv_tmul_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem standardDVRRootCompletionAlgEquiv_tmul_root
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    (N : ℕ) (pi : V) :
    let Vhat
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionValuationSubring V K
    letI : Algebra V Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    standardDVRRootCompletionAlgEquiv V K N pi
        (1 ⊗ₜ[V] AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C pi)) =
      AdjoinRoot.root
        (X ^ N - C (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi)) := by
  dsimp only
  let Vhat := standardDVFCompletionValuationSubring V K
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let p : V[X] := X ^ N - C pi
  let pHat : Vhat[X] :=
    X ^ N - C (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi)
  change ((adjoinRootBaseChangeAlgEquiv p).trans
      (AdjoinRoot.algEquivOfEq Vhat _ _ _))
        (1 ⊗ₜ[V] AdjoinRoot.root p) = AdjoinRoot.root pHat
  rw [AlgEquiv.trans_apply, adjoinRootBaseChangeAlgEquiv_tmul_root,

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.standardDVRRootCompletionAlgebra_map_root
statement:
@[simp]
theorem standardDVRRootCompletionAlgebra_map_root
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]

proof:

    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C pi)

      (X ^ N - C (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi))

      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K

    algebraMap Rn Rhat (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ N - C pi)) =
      AdjoinRoot.root
        (X ^ N - C (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi)) := by
  dsimp only

  change standardDVRRootCompletionAlgEquiv V K N pi

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.standardDVRRootCompletion_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem standardDVRRootCompletion_faithfullyFlat
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    (N : ℕ) (pi : V) :
    let Vhat
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionValuationSubring V K
    let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C pi)
    let Rhat := AdjoinRoot
      (X ^ N - C (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi))
    letI : Algebra V Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    letI : Algebra Rn Rhat :=
      standardDVRRootCompletionAlgebra V K N pi
    Module.FaithfullyFlat Rn Rhat := by
  dsimp only
  let Vhat := standardDVFCompletionValuationSubring V K
  let Rn := AdjoinRoot (X ^ N - C pi)
  let Rhat := AdjoinRoot
    (X ^ N - C (standardDVRCompletionValuationSubringElement V K pi))
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let T := Vhat ⊗[V] Rn
  let T' := Rn ⊗[V] Vhat
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let : Algebra Rn T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : Algebra Rn Rhat :=
    standardDVRRootCompletionAlgebra V K N pi
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat Rn T' := inferInstance
  let eComm : T ≃ₐ[Rn] T' :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (R := Rn)
      (f := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm V Vhat Rn).toRingEquiv)
      (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat Rn T :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
      (R := Rn) (M := T') eComm.toLinearEquiv
  let eRoot : T ≃ₐ[Rn] Rhat :=
    standardDVRRootCompletionAlgEquivOverRoot V K N pi
  exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
    (R := Rn) (M := T) eRoot.symm.toLinearEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completionQuotientFirstRegularParameter_isDomain
statement:
private theorem completionQuotientFirstRegularParameter_isDomain
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    let Rhat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
    let I := Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)
    IsDomain (Rhat ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R Rhat)) := by
  dsimp only
  let Rhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)
  have hIPrime :
      (I.map (algebraMap R Rhat)).IsPrime := by

      (prime_first_maximalAdicCompletion_of_regularPair hreg hgen)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.quotientFirstRegularParameter_isDVR
statement:
private theorem quotientFirstRegularParameter_isDVR
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] [IsLocalRing T] [IsNoetherianRing T]
    {a b : T}
    (hreg : IsRegular T [a, b])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [a, b] = maximalIdeal T)
    [IsDomain (T ⧸ Ideal.span ({a} : Set T))] :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (T ⧸ Ideal.span ({a} : Set T))
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal T := Ideal.span ({a} : Set T)
  let S := T ⧸ I
  let : I.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen List.mem_cons_self)
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective T S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hquot := regularSystem_quotientHead hreg hgen
  have hregS : IsRegular S [Ideal.Quotient.mk I b] := by
    simpa only [I, S, List.map_cons, List.map_nil] using hquot.1
  have hgenS : Ideal.ofList [Ideal.Quotient.mk I b] = maximalIdeal S := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList [Ideal.Quotient.mk I b] =
          (maximalIdeal T).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
        simpa only [I, S, List.map_cons, List.map_nil] using hquot.2
      _ = maximalIdeal S :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hbPrime : Prime (Ideal.Quotient.mk I b) :=
    prime_of_mem_regularSystem hregS hgenS List.mem_cons_self
  have hSNotField : ¬ IsField S := by
    intro hfield
    have hmaxBot : maximalIdeal S = ⊥ :=
      IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hfield
    have hbMem : Ideal.Quotient.mk I b ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
      rw [← hgenS]
      exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
    have hbZero : Ideal.Quotient.mk I b = 0 := by
      rw [hmaxBot] at hbMem
      simpa using hbMem
    exact hbPrime.ne_zero hbZero
  have hprincipal : Submodule.IsPrincipal (maximalIdeal S) := by
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk I b, ?_⟩
    simpa using hgenS.symm
  exact ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE S hSNotField).out 5 1).mp
    hprincipal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_of_dvr_isDomain

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_of_dvr_isDVR
statement:
private theorem maximalAdicCompletion_of_dvr_isDVR
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] [IsDomain T]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.mappedQuotientCompletion_isDomain
statement:
private theorem mappedQuotientCompletion_isDomain
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] [IsLocalRing T] [IsNoetherianRing T]
    (I : Ideal T)
    (hSourceDomain : IsDomain (T ⧸ I))
    (hSourceDVR :
      @IsDiscreteValuationRing (T ⧸ I) inferInstance hSourceDomain) :
    IsDomain
      (AdicCompletion
        ((maximalIdeal T).map (algebraMap T (T ⧸ I))) (T ⧸ I))
proof:
:= by
  let S := T ⧸ I
  let mT := maximalIdeal T
  let mS := mT.map (algebraMap T S)
  let : IsDomain S := hSourceDomain
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing S := hSourceDVR
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective T S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmS : mS = maximalIdeal S :=
    IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  change IsDomain (AdicCompletion mS S)
  exact hmS.symm ▸ maximalAdicCompletion_of_dvr_isDomain (T := S)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.mappedQuotientCompletion_isDVR
statement:
private theorem mappedQuotientCompletion_isDVR
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] [IsLocalRing T] [IsNoetherianRing T]
    (I : Ideal T)
    (hSourceDomain : IsDomain (T ⧸ I))
    (hSourceDVR :
      @IsDiscreteValuationRing (T ⧸ I) inferInstance hSourceDomain)
    (hMappedDomain : IsDomain
      (AdicCompletion
        ((maximalIdeal T).map (algebraMap T (T ⧸ I))) (T ⧸ I))) :
    @IsDiscreteValuationRing
      (AdicCompletion
        ((maximalIdeal T).map (algebraMap T (T ⧸ I))) (T ⧸ I))
      inferInstance hMappedDomain
proof:
:= by
  let S := T ⧸ I
  let mT := maximalIdeal T
  let mS := mT.map (algebraMap T S)
  let : IsDomain S := hSourceDomain
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing S := hSourceDVR
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective T S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmS : mS = maximalIdeal S :=
    IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hBundle :
      ∃ h : IsDomain (AdicCompletion mS S),
        @IsDiscreteValuationRing
          (AdicCompletion mS S) inferInstance h := by
    rw [hmS]
    exact ⟨maximalAdicCompletion_of_dvr_isDomain (T := S),
      maximalAdicCompletion_of_dvr_isDVR (T := S)⟩
  obtain ⟨_, hDVR⟩ := hBundle
  exact hDVR

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completionQuotient_isDVR_of_quotientDVR
statement:
private theorem completionQuotient_isDVR_of_quotientDVR
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] [IsLocalRing T] [IsNoetherianRing T]
    (I : Ideal T)
    (hSourceDomain : IsDomain (T ⧸ I))
    (hSourceDVR :
      @IsDiscreteValuationRing (T ⧸ I) inferInstance hSourceDomain)
    (hTargetDomain : IsDomain
      (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal T) T ⧸
        I.map (algebraMap T (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal T) T)))) :
    @IsDiscreteValuationRing
      (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal T) T ⧸
        I.map (algebraMap T (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal T) T)))
      inferInstance hTargetDomain
proof:
:= by
  have hMappedDomain :=
    mappedQuotientCompletion_isDomain I hSourceDomain hSourceDVR
  have hMappedDVR :=
    mappedQuotientCompletion_isDVR I hSourceDomain hSourceDVR hMappedDomain
  let : IsDomain
      (AdicCompletion
        ((maximalIdeal T).map (algebraMap T (T ⧸ I))) (T ⧸ I)) :=
    hMappedDomain
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing
      (AdicCompletion
        ((maximalIdeal T).map (algebraMap T (T ⧸ I))) (T ⧸ I)) :=
    hMappedDVR
  let : IsDomain
      (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal T) T ⧸
        I.map (algebraMap T (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal T) T))) :=
    hTargetDomain
  exact
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.RingEquivClass.isDiscreteValuationRing
      (completionQuotientRingEquiv I)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.completionQuotientFirstRegularParameter_isDVR_aux
statement:

proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)
  let S := R ⧸ I
  let mR := maximalIdeal R
  let : I.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime
      (prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen List.mem_cons_self)
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)

  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=

  have hregS : IsRegular S [Ideal.Quotient.mk I y] := by
