name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_prime_eq_mapped_span_first_of_under_eq
statement:
theorem maximalAdicCompletion_prime_eq_mapped_span_first_of_under_eq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R)
    (q : Ideal (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hunder : q.under R = Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)) :
    q = Ideal.span
      ({algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) x} :
        Set (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Rhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let xhat : Rhat := algebraMap R Rhat x
  have hgeometry := maximalAdicCompletion_regularPair_geometry hreg hgen
  let : IsDomain Rhat := hgeometry.1
  have hxq : Ideal.span ({xhat} : Set Rhat) ≤ q := by
    apply q.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr
    change x ∈ q.under R
    rw [hunder]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x
  have hxNotMax : Ideal.span ({x} : Set R) ≠ maximalIdeal R := by
    let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)
    let S := R ⧸ I
    have hxPrime : Prime x :=
      prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen List.mem_cons_self
    let : I.IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hxPrime
    have hquot := regularSystem_quotientHead hreg hgen
    have hregS : IsRegular S [Ideal.Quotient.mk I y] := by
      simpa only [I, S, List.map_cons, List.map_nil] using hquot.1
    have hyRegular : IsSMulRegular S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I y) :=
      ((isRegular_cons_iff S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I y) []).mp hregS).1
    have hyNonzero : Ideal.Quotient.mk I y ≠ 0 := by
      intro hyzero
      apply (IsSMulRegular.not_zero :
        ¬ IsSMulRegular S (0 : S))
      simpa only [hyzero] using hyRegular
    intro hmax
    have hyMem : y ∈ I := by
      change y ∈ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)
      rw [hmax]
      rw [← hgen]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_cons_of_mem x List.mem_cons_self)
    exact hyNonzero (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hyMem)
  have hqNotMax : q ≠ maximalIdeal Rhat := by
    intro hqmax
    have hqUnderMax : q.under R = maximalIdeal R := by
      rw [hqmax]
      exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (algebraMap R Rhat)
    exact hxNotMax (hunder.symm.trans hqUnderMax)
  let Ihat : Ideal Rhat := Ideal.span ({xhat} : Set Rhat)
  let : Ihat.IsPrime := by
    exact Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime <| by
      simpa only [Rhat, xhat] using hgeometry.2.2.2.1
  let : IsDomain (Rhat ⧸ Ihat) :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime Ihat).mpr inferInstance
  have hmapI :
      (Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)).map (algebraMap R Rhat) = Ihat := by
    simp only [Ihat, xhat, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing (Rhat ⧸ Ihat) := by
    have hDVR := completionQuotientFirstRegularParameter_isDVR hreg hgen
    dsimp only at hDVR
    let eI :
        (Rhat ⧸ (Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)).map (algebraMap R Rhat))
          ≃+* (Rhat ⧸ Ihat) :=
      RingEquiv.cast hmapI
    let : IsDomain
        (Rhat ⧸ (Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)).map
          (algebraMap R Rhat)) :=
      eI.toMulEquiv.isDomain (Rhat ⧸ Ihat)
    let : IsDiscreteValuationRing
        (Rhat ⧸ (Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)).map
          (algebraMap R Rhat)) := by
      exact hDVR
    exact
      IsDiscreteValuationRing.RingEquivClass.isDiscreteValuationRing eI
  by_cases hqI : q = Ihat
  · simpa only [Ihat, Rhat, xhat] using hqI
  · let qbar : Ideal (Rhat ⧸ Ihat) :=
      q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat)
    have hker : RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat) ≤ q := by
      simpa only [Ideal.mk_ker, Ihat] using hxq
    have hqbarPrime : qbar.IsPrime :=
      Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hker
    have hqbarNe : qbar ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro hzero
      have hqLeI : q ≤ Ihat := by
        have hqLeKer : q ≤ RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat) :=
          (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat)).mp hzero
        simpa only [Ideal.mk_ker] using hqLeKer
      exact hqI (le_antisymm hqLeI hxq)
    have hqbarMax : qbar.IsMaximal :=
      hqbarPrime.isMaximal hqbarNe
    let : qbar.IsMaximal := hqbarMax
    have hcomapMax :
        (qbar.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat)).IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    have hcomap : qbar.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat) = q := by
      calc
        qbar.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat) =
            q ⊔ RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat) := by
          exact Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk Ihat) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
        _ = q := sup_eq_left.mpr hker
    have hqMax : q.IsMaximal := by
      simpa only [hcomap] using hcomapMax
    exact (hqNotMax (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hqMax)).elim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_not_mem_maximalIdeal_sq_of_regular_quotient_dimension_two
statement:
theorem prime_not_mem_maximalIdeal_sq_of_regular_quotient_dimension_two
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    {p : R} (hp : Prime p)
    (hquot : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    p ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {p}
  let S := R ⧸ I
  let : IsRegularLocalRing S := by
    simpa only [S, I] using hquot
  have hpMem : p ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [mem_maximalIdeal]
    exact hp.not_isUnit
  have hpRegular : IsSMulRegular R p := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro a ha
    have hpa : p * a = 0 := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using ha
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hpa).resolve_left hp.ne_zero
  have hdimSsucc : ringKrullDim S + 1 = ringKrullDim R := by
    simpa only [S, I] using
      ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim
        hpRegular hpMem
  have hdimS : ringKrullDim S = ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hdim] at hdimSsucc
    have htwo : ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 := by
      norm_num
    exact ENat.WithBot.add_one_cancel.mp (hdimSsucc.trans htwo)
  have hspanRankS : (maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank = 1 := by
    have hregularDimension :=
      IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := S)
    rw [hdimS] at hregularDimension
    exact ENat.natCast_inj.mp (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hregularDimension)
  have hprincipalS : (maximalIdeal S).IsPrincipal :=
    (Submodule.spanFinrank_eq_one_iff (maximalIdeal S)).mp hspanRankS |>.1
  obtain ⟨zbar, hzbar⟩ := hprincipalS
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective zbar
  have hmaxS : maximalIdeal S = Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk I z} := by
    simpa only [hz] using hzbar
  let : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hspanR : Ideal.span {p, z} = maximalIdeal R := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro a ha
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
      rcases ha with ha | ha
      · rw [ha]
        exact hpMem
      · have hzS : Ideal.Quotient.mk I z ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
          rw [hmaxS]
          exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
        rw [ha]
        exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ▸ hzS
    · intro a ha
      have haS : Ideal.Quotient.mk I a ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
        exact (IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective) ▸
            Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ha
      rw [hmaxS, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at haS
      obtain ⟨cS, hcS⟩ := haS
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective cS
      have hac : a - c * z ∈ I := by
        apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
        simp only [map_sub, map_mul, hc, mul_comm, hcS, sub_self]
      have hIle : I ≤ Ideal.span {p, z} := by
        change Ideal.span {p} ≤ Ideal.span {p, z}
        exact Ideal.span_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Set.mem_insert _ _))
      have hcz : c * z ∈ Ideal.span {p, z} :=
        (Ideal.span {p, z}).mul_mem_left c
          (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
      have := (Ideal.span {p, z}).add_mem (hIle hac) hcz
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using this
  intro hpSq
  let m : Ideal R := maximalIdeal R
  have hzMem : z ∈ m := by
    change z ∈ maximalIdeal R
    rw [← hspanR]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _))
  let p' : m := ⟨p, by simpa only [m] using hpMem⟩
  let z' : m := ⟨z, hzMem⟩
  have hpCot : m.toCotangent p' = 0 := by
    apply (m.toCotangent_eq_zero p').mpr
    simpa only [m, p'] using hpSq
  have hmapSpan :
      (Submodule.span R ({p', z'} : Set m)).map m.subtype = m := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span]
    change Ideal.span (m.subtype '' ({p', z'} : Set m)) = m
    rw [show m.subtype '' ({p', z'} : Set m) = ({p, z} : Set R) by
      ext a
      simp [p', z', eq_comm]]
    simpa only [m] using hspanR
  have hsubtypeSpan : Submodule.span R ({p', z'} : Set m) = ⊤ := by
    apply (Submodule.map_injective_of_injective m.subtype_injective)
    rw [hmapSpan, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  have hspanCot :
      Submodule.span (ResidueField R)
          (m.toCotangent '' ({p', z'} : Set m)) = ⊤ :=
    (CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff (R := R)).mpr hsubtypeSpan
  have hspanCot' :
      Submodule.span (ResidueField R)
          ({m.toCotangent z'} : Set (CotangentSpace R)) = ⊤ := by
    simpa only [Set.image_pair, hpCot,
      Submodule.span_insert_zero] using hspanCot
  have hfinle : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← finrank_top (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R), ← hspanCot']
    simpa using (finrank_span_le_card
      (R := ResidueField R)
      ({m.toCotangent z'} : Set (CotangentSpace R)))
  have hfinR : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 2 := by
    have hregularDimension :=
      (IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace R).mp inferInstance
    rw [hdim] at hregularDimension
    exact ENat.natCast_inj.mp (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hregularDimension)
  omega

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_regular_pair_of_prime_regular_quotient_dimension_two
statement:
theorem exists_regular_pair_of_prime_regular_quotient_dimension_two
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    {p : R} (hp : Prime p)
    (hquot : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ z : R, IsRegular R [p, z] ∧
      Ideal.ofList [p, z] = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 2 := by
    have hregularDimension :=
      (IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace R).mp inferInstance
    rw [hdim] at hregularDimension
    exact ENat.natCast_inj.mp (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hregularDimension)
  have hpMem : p ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [mem_maximalIdeal]
    exact hp.not_isUnit
  exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two
    hfin hp hpMem
      (prime_not_mem_maximalIdeal_sq_of_regular_quotient_dimension_two
        hp hquot hdim)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.heightTwoPrimeRootCover_geometry
statement:
theorem heightTwoPrimeRootCover_geometry
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {p : R} (hp : Prime p)
    (hquot : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({p} : Set R)))
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    let f : R[X]
proof:
:= X ^ n - C p
    let B := AdjoinRoot f
    IsRegularLocalRing B ∧ IsDomain B ∧
      ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      Prime (AdjoinRoot.root f) ∧
      IsDomain (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set B)) ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing
        (B ⧸ Ideal.span ({AdjoinRoot.root f} : Set B)) := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨z, hreg, hgen⟩ :=
    exists_regular_pair_of_prime_regular_quotient_dimension_two hp hquot hdim
  let f : R[X] := X ^ n - C p
  let B := AdjoinRoot f
  have hpMem : p ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [mem_maximalIdeal]
    exact hp.not_isUnit
  let : IsLocalRing B := by
    simpa only [B, f] using isLocalRing_adjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hn hpMem
  have hgeometry := localRootCover_regularSystem_geometry hn hreg hgen
  have hnoetherianB : IsNoetherianRing B := by
    simpa only [B, f] using hgeometry.1
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := hnoetherianB
  have hdomainB : IsDomain B := by
    simpa only [B, f] using hgeometry.2.1
  let : IsDomain B := hdomainB
  have hregB : IsRegular B (localRootCoverParameterList R n p [z]) := by
    simpa only [B, f] using hgeometry.2.2.1
  have hgenB : Ideal.ofList (localRootCoverParameterList R n p [z]) =
      maximalIdeal B := by
    simpa only [B, f] using hgeometry.2.2.2.1
  have hregularLocalB : IsRegularLocalRing B :=
    isRegularLocalRing_of_regularSystem _ hregB hgenB
  let : IsRegularLocalRing B := hregularLocalB
  have hdimB : ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim B =
          ((localRootCoverParameterList R n p [z]).length : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        simpa only [B, f] using
          (localRootCoverParameterList_length_eq_ringKrullDim hn hreg hgen)
      _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        norm_num [localRootCoverParameterList]
  have hrootMem : AdjoinRoot.root f ∈
      localRootCoverParameterList R n p [z] := by
    simp only [f, localRootCoverParameterList, List.mem_cons, true_or]
  have hrootPrime : Prime (AdjoinRoot.root f) := by
    exact prime_of_mem_regularSystem hregB hgenB hrootMem
  have hrootQuotient :=
    quotient_geometry_of_mem_regularSystem hregB hgenB hrootMem
  exact ⟨hregularLocalB, hdomainB, hdimB, hrootPrime,
    hrootQuotient.1, hrootQuotient.2⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isDomain_of_prime_isSMulRegular_of_isHausdorff_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_prime_isSMulRegular_of_isHausdorff_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsHausdorff (maximalIdeal R) R]
    {p : R} (hp : Prime p) (hpreg : IsSMulRegular R p) : IsDomain R
proof:
:= by
  have hnotPow (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
      ∃ k : ℕ, a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ k := by
    by_contra hall
    push Not at hall
    apply ha
    exact IsHausdorff.haus (I := maximalIdeal R) inferInstance a fun n ↦ by
      exact SModEq.zero.2 <| by
        simpa [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map] using hall n
  have hbot : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := by
    rw [Ideal.isPrime_iff]
    refine ⟨bot_ne_top, ?_⟩
    intro a b hab
    simp only [Ideal.mem_bot] at hab ⊢
    by_contra hzero
    push Not at hzero
    obtain ⟨k, hak⟩ := hnotPow a hzero.1
    obtain ⟨l, hbl⟩ := hnotPow b hzero.2
    have hpMem : p ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
      rw [mem_maximalIdeal]
      exact hp.not_isUnit
    have hpow : ∀ k l : ℕ, ∀ a b : R, a * b = 0 →
        p ^ k ∣ a ∨ p ^ l ∣ b := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          intro l a b hab
          exact Or.inl (by rw [pow_zero]; exact one_dvd _)
      | succ k ihK =>
          intro l
          induction l with
          | zero =>
              intro a b hab
              exact Or.inr (by rw [pow_zero]; exact one_dvd _)
          | succ l ihL =>
              intro a b hab
              have hpProd : p ∣ a * b := by rw [hab]; exact dvd_zero p
              rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hpProd with hpa | hpb
              · obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := hpa
                have hab' : a' * b = 0 := by
                  apply hpreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul
                  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc] using hab
                rcases ihK (l + 1) a' b hab' with ha' | hb'
                · left
                  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ha'
                  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
                  rw [hc, pow_succ]
                  ac_rfl
                · exact Or.inr hb'
              · obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hpb
                have hab' : a * b' = 0 := by
                  apply hpreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul
                  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
                    mul_assoc] using hab
                rcases ihL a b' hab' with ha' | hb'
                · exact Or.inl ha'
                · right
                  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hb'
                  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
                  rw [hc, pow_succ]
                  ac_rfl
    rcases hpow k l a b hab with ha | hb
    · apply hak
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
      exact (maximalIdeal R ^ k).mul_mem_right c
        (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hpMem k)
    · apply hbl
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hb
      exact (maximalIdeal R ^ l).mul_mem_right c
        (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hpMem l)
  let : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := hbot
  exact IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime R

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_mappedIdeal_isPrime_of_quotientDVR
statement:
theorem maximalAdicCompletion_mappedIdeal_isPrime_of_quotientDVR
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (I : Ideal B) [I.IsPrime]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (B ⧸ I)] :
    (I.map (algebraMap B
      (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B))).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  let Bhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B
  let S := B ⧸ I
  let mB := maximalIdeal B
  let mS := mB.map (algebraMap B S)
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective B S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : Module.Finite B S :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ B I).toLinearMap
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective B I)
  have hmS : mS = maximalIdeal S := by
    exact IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let K := FractionRing S
  have hDVRCompletion :
      IsDomain (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal S) S) := by
    let Vhat := (standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF S K).valuationSubring
    let : Algebra S Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra S K
    let e : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal S) S ≃+* Vhat :=
      (standardDVRAdicCompletionEquivCompletionValuationSubring S K).toRingEquiv
    exact e.toMulEquiv.isDomain
      (standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF S K).valuationSubring
  have hMappedCompletion :
      IsDomain (AdicCompletion mS S) := by
    rw [hmS]
    exact hDVRCompletion
  let : Algebra Bhat (AdicCompletion mS S) :=
    mappedIdealCompletionAlgebraOverCompletedBase mB
  let : IsScalarTower B Bhat (AdicCompletion mS S) :=
    mappedIdealCompletionIsScalarTower mB
  let eQuotient :
      (Bhat ⧸ I.map (algebraMap B Bhat)) ≃+*
        AdicCompletion mS S :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot Bhat I).toRingEquiv.trans
      (tensorProductMappedIdealCompletionAlgEquiv mB).toRingEquiv
  let : IsDomain (AdicCompletion mS S) := hMappedCompletion
  let : IsDomain (Bhat ⧸ I.map (algebraMap B Bhat)) :=
    eQuotient.toMulEquiv.isDomain (AdicCompletion mS S)
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime
    (I.map (algebraMap B Bhat))).mp inferInstance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_first_maximalAdicCompletion_of_regularPair
statement:
theorem prime_first_maximalAdicCompletion_of_regularPair
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    {x y : B}
    (hreg : IsRegular B [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal B) :
    Prime (algebraMap B (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B) x)
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal B := Ideal.span {x}
  let S := B ⧸ I
  let Bhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B
  have hxPrime : Prime x :=
    prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen List.mem_cons_self
  let : I.IsPrime := by
    exact Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hxPrime
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective B S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hquot := regularSystem_quotientHead hreg hgen
  have hregS : IsRegular S [Ideal.Quotient.mk I y] := by
    simpa only [I, S, List.map_cons, List.map_nil] using hquot.1
  have hgenS : Ideal.ofList [Ideal.Quotient.mk I y] = maximalIdeal S := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList [Ideal.Quotient.mk I y] =
          (maximalIdeal B).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
        simpa only [I, S, List.map_cons, List.map_nil] using hquot.2
      _ = maximalIdeal S :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hdomainS : IsDomain S :=
    isDomain_of_regularSystem [Ideal.Quotient.mk I y] hregS hgenS
  let : IsDomain S := hdomainS
  have hyPrime : Prime (Ideal.Quotient.mk I y) :=
    prime_of_mem_regularSystem hregS hgenS List.mem_cons_self
  have hSNotField : ¬ IsField S := by
    intro hfield
    have hmaxBot : maximalIdeal S = ⊥ :=
      IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hfield
    have hyMem : Ideal.Quotient.mk I y ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
      rw [← hgenS]
      exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
    have hyZero : Ideal.Quotient.mk I y = 0 := by
      rw [hmaxBot] at hyMem
      simpa using hyMem
    exact hyPrime.ne_zero hyZero
  have hprincipal : Submodule.IsPrincipal (maximalIdeal S) := by
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk I y, ?_⟩
    simpa using hgenS.symm
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing S :=
    ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE S hSNotField).out 5 1).mp hprincipal
  have hmapPrime :
      (I.map (algebraMap B Bhat)).IsPrime :=
    maximalAdicCompletion_mappedIdeal_isPrime_of_quotientDVR I
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  have hxHatNe : algebraMap B Bhat x ≠ 0 :=
    (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective B Bhat).ne hxPrime.ne_zero
  apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hxHatNe).mp
  simpa [I, Ideal.map_span] using hmapPrime

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_regularPair_geometry
statement:
theorem maximalAdicCompletion_regularPair_geometry
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    {x y : B}
    (hreg : IsRegular B [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal B) :
    let Bhat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B
    IsDomain Bhat ∧
      IsRegular Bhat [algebraMap B Bhat x, algebraMap B Bhat y] ∧
      Ideal.ofList [algebraMap B Bhat x, algebraMap B Bhat y] =
        maximalIdeal Bhat ∧
      Prime (algebraMap B Bhat x) ∧
      Prime (algebraMap B Bhat y) := by
  dsimp only
  let Bhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  have hregHat :
      IsRegular Bhat [algebraMap B Bhat x, algebraMap B Bhat y] := by
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil] using
      hreg.of_faithfullyFlat (S := Bhat)
  have hgenHat :
      Ideal.ofList [algebraMap B Bhat x, algebraMap B Bhat y] =
        maximalIdeal Bhat := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList [algebraMap B Bhat x, algebraMap B Bhat y] =
          (Ideal.ofList [x, y]).map (algebraMap B Bhat) := by
        simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil] using
          (Ideal.map_ofList (algebraMap B Bhat) [x, y]).symm
      _ = (maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B Bhat) := by rw [hgen]
      _ = maximalIdeal Bhat :=
        (AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map (R := B)).symm
  have hxPrime : Prime (algebraMap B Bhat x) :=
    prime_first_maximalAdicCompletion_of_regularPair hreg hgen
  have hregSwap : IsRegular B [y, x] := by
    exact IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hreg
      (List.Perm.swap x y []).symm
  have hgenSwap : Ideal.ofList [y, x] = maximalIdeal B := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList [y, x] = Ideal.ofList [x, y] := by
        apply congrArg Ideal.span
        ext z
        simp [or_comm]
      _ = maximalIdeal B := hgen
  have hyPrime : Prime (algebraMap B Bhat y) :=
    prime_first_maximalAdicCompletion_of_regularPair hregSwap hgenSwap
  have hxRegular : IsSMulRegular Bhat (algebraMap B Bhat x) :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff Bhat (algebraMap B Bhat x)
      [algebraMap B Bhat y]).mp hregHat).1
  have hdomain : IsDomain Bhat :=
    isDomain_of_prime_isSMulRegular_of_isHausdorff_maximalIdeal
      hxPrime hxRegular
  exact ⟨hdomain, hregHat, hgenHat, hxPrime, hyPrime⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.charZero_quotient_mappedIdeal_maximalAdicCompletion
statement:
theorem charZero_quotient_mappedIdeal_maximalAdicCompletion
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (I : Ideal B) (hCharZero : CharZero (B ⧸ I)) :
    CharZero
      (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B ⧸
        I.map (algebraMap B
          (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B)))
proof:
:= by
  let Bhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal B) B
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let J : Ideal Bhat := I.map (algebraMap B Bhat)
  have hunder : J.comap (algebraMap B Bhat) = I :=
    Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat
      (A := B) (B := Bhat) I
  let : CharZero (B ⧸ J.comap (algebraMap B Bhat)) := by
    rw [hunder]
    exact hCharZero
  have htarget : CharZero (Bhat ⧸ J) :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap
      (Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_injective
        (R := B) (A := Bhat) (I := J))
  simpa only [J] using htarget

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.associated_fintypeProduct_maximalAdicCompletion
statement:
theorem associated_fintypeProduct_maximalAdicCompletion
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.normalizationInertia_coprime_of_ramificationIdx_isUnit
statement:
theorem normalizationInertia_coprime_of_ramificationIdx_isUnit
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL} {k : Type uk}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    (t : A) (ht : Prime t)
    [CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t})]
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime]
    [Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {t})]
    (hunit : IsUnit
      ((Q.ramificationIdx A : ℕ) : A ⧸ Ideal.span {t}))
    (phi : (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t}) →+* k)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : p.Prime) :
    Nat.Coprime
      (Nat.card (Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K))) p
proof:
:= by
  let P := Ideal.span {t}
  let : P.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ht
  have hPheight : P.height = 1 :=
    Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht.ne_zero) ht.not_isUnit
  have hcard : Nat.card (Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) =
      Q.ramificationIdx A := by
    rw [normalizationInertia_eq_localizedNormalizationInertia
      (K := K) (L := L) P Q]
    exact localizedNormalizationInertia_card_eq_ramificationIdx
      (K := K) (L := L) P hPheight Q
  have hunit_k : IsUnit ((Q.ramificationIdx A : ℕ) : k) := by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hunit.map phi
  rw [hcard]
  exact natCoprime_of_isUnit_natCast_of_charP
    p (Q.ramificationIdx A) hp hunit_k

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.normalizationInertia_eq_localizedNormalizationInertia_of_under_le
statement:
theorem normalizationInertia_eq_localizedNormalizationInertia_of_under_le
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime]
    (hQP : Q.under A ≤ P) :
    Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K) =
      localizedNormalizationInertia (K := K) (L := L) P Q
proof:
:= by
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let B := integralClosure A L
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : SMulCommClass Gal(L/K) V L :=
    localizationAtPrime_galois_smulCommClass (K := K) (L := L) P
  let Bp := integralClosure V L
  let := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  let M := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B P.primeCompl
  let : IsLocalization M Bp :=
    isLocalization_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let Qp := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  have hdisj : Disjoint (M : Set B) (Q : Set B) := by
    exact Set.disjoint_image_left.mpr
      (Set.disjoint_compl_left_iff_subset.mpr hQP)
  have hunder : (Q.map (algebraMap B Bp)).under B = Q :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint M Bp inferInstance hdisj
  have hmap_smul (sigma : Gal(L/K)) (b : B) :
      algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b) = sigma • algebraMap B Bp b := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  change Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K) =
    Qp.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)
  ext sigma
  change
    (forall b : B, sigma • b - b ∈ Q) ↔
      (forall z : Bp, sigma • z - z ∈ Qp)
  constructor
  · intro hsigma z
    obtain ⟨⟨b, s⟩, hz⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M z
    have hs_fixed_B : sigma • (s : B) = (s : B) := by
      obtain ⟨a, _ha, ha⟩ := s.property
      rw [← ha]
      exact smul_algebraMap sigma a
    have hs_fixed :
        sigma • algebraMap B Bp (s : B) = algebraMap B Bp (s : B) := by
      rw [← hmap_smul, hs_fixed_B]
    have hsigma_z :
        (sigma • z) * algebraMap B Bp (s : B) =
          algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b) := by
      calc
        (sigma • z) * algebraMap B Bp (s : B) =
            (sigma • z) * (sigma • algebraMap B Bp (s : B)) := by
              rw [hs_fixed]
        _ = sigma • (z * algebraMap B Bp (s : B)) := by
              exact (smul_mul' sigma z (algebraMap B Bp (s : B))).symm
        _ = sigma • algebraMap B Bp b := congrArg (sigma • ·) hz
        _ = algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b) := (hmap_smul sigma b).symm
    rw [← Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem Qp (IsLocalization.map_units Bp s)]
    have heq :
        algebraMap B Bp (s : B) * (sigma • z - z) =
          algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b - b) := by
      calc
        algebraMap B Bp (s : B) * (sigma • z - z) =
            (sigma • z) * algebraMap B Bp (s : B) -
              z * algebraMap B Bp (s : B) := by ring
        _ = algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b) - algebraMap B Bp b := by
              rw [hsigma_z, hz]
        _ = algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b - b) := by rw [map_sub]
    rw [heq]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap B Bp) (hsigma b)
  · intro hsigma b
    have hmem : algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b - b) ∈ Qp := by
      rw [map_sub, hmap_smul]
      exact hsigma (algebraMap B Bp b)
    change sigma • b - b ∈ Q
    rw [← hunder]
    exact hmem

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.normalizationInertia_eq_localizedNormalizationInertia
statement:
theorem normalizationInertia_eq_localizedNormalizationInertia
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver P] :
    Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K) =
      localizedNormalizationInertia (K := K) (L := L) P Q
proof:
:= by
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let B := integralClosure A L
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : SMulCommClass Gal(L/K) V L :=
    localizationAtPrime_galois_smulCommClass (K := K) (L := L) P
  let Bp := integralClosure V L
  let := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  let M := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B P.primeCompl
  let : IsLocalization M Bp :=
    isLocalization_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let Qp := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  have hdisj : Disjoint (M : Set B) (Q : Set B) := by
    exact Set.disjoint_image_left.mpr
      (Set.disjoint_compl_left_iff_subset.mpr
        (show Q.under A ≤ P by rw [Q.over_def P]))
  have hunder : (Q.map (algebraMap B Bp)).under B = Q :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint M Bp inferInstance hdisj
  have hmap_smul (sigma : Gal(L/K)) (b : B) :
      algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b) = sigma • algebraMap B Bp b := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  change Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K) =
    Qp.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)
  ext sigma
  change
    (forall b : B, sigma • b - b ∈ Q) ↔
      (forall x : Bp, sigma • x - x ∈ Qp)
  constructor
  · intro hsigma x
    obtain ⟨⟨b, s⟩, hx⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M x
    have hs_fixed_B : sigma • (s : B) = (s : B) := by
      obtain ⟨a, _ha, ha⟩ := s.property
      rw [← ha]
      exact smul_algebraMap sigma a
    have hs_fixed :
        sigma • algebraMap B Bp (s : B) = algebraMap B Bp (s : B) := by
      rw [← hmap_smul, hs_fixed_B]
    have hsigma_x :
        (sigma • x) * algebraMap B Bp (s : B) =
          algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b) := by
      calc
        (sigma • x) * algebraMap B Bp (s : B) =
            (sigma • x) * (sigma • algebraMap B Bp (s : B)) := by
              rw [hs_fixed]
        _ = sigma • (x * algebraMap B Bp (s : B)) := by
              exact (smul_mul' sigma x (algebraMap B Bp (s : B))).symm
        _ = sigma • algebraMap B Bp b := congrArg (sigma • ·) hx
        _ = algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b) := (hmap_smul sigma b).symm
    rw [← Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem Qp (IsLocalization.map_units Bp s)]
    have heq :
        algebraMap B Bp (s : B) * (sigma • x - x) =
          algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b - b) := by
      calc
        algebraMap B Bp (s : B) * (sigma • x - x) =
            (sigma • x) * algebraMap B Bp (s : B) -
              x * algebraMap B Bp (s : B) := by ring
        _ = algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b) - algebraMap B Bp b := by
              rw [hsigma_x, hx]
        _ = algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b - b) := by rw [map_sub]
    rw [heq]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap B Bp) (hsigma b)
  · intro hsigma b
    have hmem : algebraMap B Bp (sigma • b - b) ∈ Qp := by
      rw [map_sub, hmap_smul]
      exact hsigma (algebraMap B Bp b)
    change sigma • b - b ∈ Q
    rw [← hunder]
    exact hmem

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrime_galois_smulCommClass
statement:
theorem localizationAtPrime_galois_smulCommClass
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :
    letI
proof:
:= localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI := localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
    SMulCommClass Gal(L/K) (Localization.AtPrime P) L := by
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  refine ⟨fun σ v x ↦ ?_⟩
  change σ (algebraMap V L v * x) = algebraMap V L v * σ x
  rw [map_mul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V K L, AlgEquiv.commutes]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizedNormalizationResidue_isSeparable
statement:
theorem localizedNormalizationResidue_isSeparable
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver P]
    [CharZero (A ⧸ P)] :
    letI
proof:
:= localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI :
        (localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q).LiesOver
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) :=
      localizedNormalizationPrime_liesOver (K := K) (L := L) P Q
    Algebra.IsSeparable
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P))
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L ⧸
        localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q) := by
  let := localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let Qlocal := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  let : Qlocal.LiesOver
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_liesOver (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  let : Qlocal.IsMaximal :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_isMaximal (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  let : CharZero
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective
        (A ⧸ P)
        (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)))
  exact Algebra.IsSeparable.of_integral _ _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizedNormalizationInertia_card_eq_ramificationIdx
statement:
theorem localizedNormalizationInertia_card_eq_ramificationIdx
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 1)
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver P]
    [CharZero (A ⧸ P)] :
    Nat.card
        (localizedNormalizationInertia (K := K) (L := L) P Q) =
      Q.ramificationIdx A

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.natCoprime_of_isUnit_natCast_of_charP
statement:
theorem natCoprime_of_isUnit_natCast_of_charP
    {k : Type*} [CommRing k] [Nontrivial k]
    (p n : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : p.Prime)
    (hn : IsUnit (n : k)) : Nat.Coprime n p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.coprime_comm, hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd]
  intro hpn
  exact hn.ne_zero ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff k p n).mpr hpn)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.normalization_ramificationIdx_dvd_finrank_of_charZero
statement:
theorem normalization_ramificationIdx_dvd_finrank_of_charZero
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularRing A] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 1)
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver P]
    [CharZero (A ⧸ P)] :
    Q.ramificationIdx A ∣ Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv :
      Nat.card (localizedNormalizationInertia (K := K) (L := L) P Q) ∣
        Nat.card Gal(L/K) :=
    Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective
      (localizedNormalizationInertia (K := K) (L := L) P Q).subtype
      (localizedNormalizationInertia (K := K) (L := L) P Q).subtype_injective
  rw [localizedNormalizationInertia_card_eq_ramificationIdx
      (K := K) (L := L) P hP Q,
    IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank] at hdiv
  exact hdiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.productCoordinatePrime_ramificationIdx_eq
statement:
theorem productCoordinatePrime_ramificationIdx_eq (i : ι) :
    (productCoordinatePrime A i).ramificationIdx R =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i)).ramificationIdx R
proof:
:= by
  let S := ∀ j, A j
  let q := productCoordinatePrime A i
  let : Algebra S (A i) := productCoordinateAlgebra A i
  let : IsScalarTower R S (A i) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsLocalization q.primeCompl (A i) :=
    productCoordinate_isLocalization A i
  have hdisj : Disjoint (q.primeCompl : Set S) (q : Set S) := by
    exact disjoint_compl_left
  have hram := ramificationIdx_map_eq_of_isLocalization
    (R := R) (S := S) (R' := R) (S' := A i)
    (IsUnit.submonoid R) q.primeCompl q hdisj
  have hmap : q.map (algebraMap S (A i)) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i) := by
    change ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i)).comap
      (Pi.evalRingHom A i)).map (Pi.evalRingHom A i) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i)
    exact Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ (Pi.evalRingHom A i).surjective
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i))
  rw [hmap] at hram
  exact hram.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime_ramificationIdx_eq
statement:
theorem ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime_ramificationIdx_eq
    (e : U ≃+* (∀ j, B j)) (i : ι) :
    letI : Algebra U (B i)
proof:
:= ringEquivProductCoordinateAlgebra B i e
    letI : Algebra R (B i) :=
      ringEquivProductCoordinateBaseAlgebra (R := R) B i e
    (ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime B i e).ramificationIdx R =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (B i)).ramificationIdx R := by
  let q := ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime B i e
  let : Algebra U (B i) := ringEquivProductCoordinateAlgebra B i e
  let : Algebra R (B i) :=
    ringEquivProductCoordinateBaseAlgebra (R := R) B i e
  let : IsScalarTower R U (B i) :=
    ringEquivProductCoordinate_isScalarTower (R := R) B i e
  let : IsLocalization q.primeCompl (B i) :=
    ringEquivProductCoordinate_isLocalization B i e
  have hdisj : Disjoint (q.primeCompl : Set U) (q : Set U) :=
    disjoint_compl_left
  have hram := ramificationIdx_map_eq_of_isLocalization
    (R := R) (S := U) (R' := R) (S' := B i)
    (IsUnit.submonoid R) q.primeCompl q hdisj
  rw [ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime_map B i e] at hram
  exact hram.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isField_localization_of_fiber_prime
statement:
private theorem isField_localization_of_fiber_prime
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra R' A]
    (p' : Ideal R') [p'.IsPrime]
    (s : PrimeSpectrum (p'.Fiber A))
    (r : Ideal A) [r.IsPrime] [r.LiesOver p']
    (hrs : r = s.asIdeal.comap
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom)
    (hpA : p'.map (algebraMap R' A) = ⊥)
    (hFieldS : IsField (Localization.AtPrime s.asIdeal)) :
    IsField (Localization.AtPrime r)
proof:
:= by
  have hComapOver :
      (s.asIdeal.comap
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).LiesOver p' := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    change p' =
      (s.asIdeal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A).toRingHom).comap
          (algebraMap R' A)
    rw [← hrs]
    exact Ideal.over_def r p'
  let :
      (s.asIdeal.comap
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).LiesOver p' :=
    hComapOver
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p')
      (Localization.AtPrime
        (s.asIdeal.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A))) :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p'
      (s.asIdeal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A))
  let eFiber := Ideal.Fiber.localizationAlgEquivQuotient p' s.asIdeal
  have hpLocal : p'.map
      (algebraMap R'
        (Localization.AtPrime
          (s.asIdeal.comap
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A)))) = ⊥ := by
    calc
      p'.map
          (algebraMap R'
            (Localization.AtPrime
              (s.asIdeal.comap
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A)))) =
          (p'.map (algebraMap R' A)).map
            (algebraMap A
              (Localization.AtPrime
                (s.asIdeal.comap
                  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A)))) := by
        symm
        rw [Ideal.map_map,
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R' A
            (Localization.AtPrime
              (s.asIdeal.comap
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A)))]
      _ = ⊥ := by rw [hpA, Ideal.map_bot]
  let eLocal : Localization.AtPrime s.asIdeal
      ≃ₐ[Localization.AtPrime p']
        Localization.AtPrime
          (s.asIdeal.comap
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A)) :=
    eFiber.trans <|
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq
        (Localization.AtPrime p') hpLocal).trans <|
        AlgEquiv.quotientBot
          (Localization.AtPrime p')
          (Localization.AtPrime
            (s.asIdeal.comap
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A)))
  have hFieldComap : IsField
      (Localization.AtPrime
        (s.asIdeal.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A))) :=
    eLocal.symm.toMulEquiv.isField hFieldS
  let eIdeal :
      Localization.AtPrime
          (s.asIdeal.comap
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A))
        ≃ₐ[A] Localization.AtPrime r :=
    Localization.localAlgEquiv
      (s.asIdeal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] p'.Fiber A))
      r (AlgEquiv.refl : A ≃ₐ[A] A) hrs.symm
  exact eIdeal.symm.toMulEquiv.isField hFieldComap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.right_maximalIdeal_of_fiber_localization_isField
statement:
private theorem right_maximalIdeal_of_fiber_localization_isField
    {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [Algebra S T]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    (Q : Ideal T) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver q]
    (r : PrimeSpectrum (q.Fiber T))
    (hQr : Q = r.asIdeal.comap
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom)
    (hFieldR : IsField (Localization.AtPrime r.asIdeal)) :
    q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q)) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hComapOver :
      (r.asIdeal.comap
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).LiesOver q := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    change q =
      (r.asIdeal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T).toRingHom).comap
          (algebraMap S T)
    rw [← hQr]
    exact Ideal.over_def Q q
  let :
      (r.asIdeal.comap
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).LiesOver q :=
    hComapOver
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (Localization.AtPrime
        (r.asIdeal.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T))) :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver q
      (r.asIdeal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T))
  let eFiber := Ideal.Fiber.localizationAlgEquivQuotient q r.asIdeal
  have hFieldVerticalAtR :
      IsField
        (Localization.AtPrime
            (r.asIdeal.comap
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T)) ⧸
          q.map
            (algebraMap S
              (Localization.AtPrime
                (r.asIdeal.comap
                  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T))))) :=
    eFiber.symm.toMulEquiv.isField hFieldR
  let eIdeal : Localization.AtPrime Q ≃ₐ[T]
      Localization.AtPrime
        (r.asIdeal.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T)) :=
    Localization.localAlgEquiv Q
      (r.asIdeal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T))
      (AlgEquiv.refl : T ≃ₐ[T] T) hQr
  have hqMap :
      q.map
          (algebraMap S
            (Localization.AtPrime
              (r.asIdeal.comap
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T)))) =
        (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q))).map
          eIdeal.toRingEquiv.toRingHom := by
    rw [Ideal.map_map]
    congr 1
    ext x
    change algebraMap S
        (Localization.AtPrime
          (r.asIdeal.comap
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T))) x =
      eIdeal (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q) x)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S T (Localization.AtPrime Q),
      eIdeal.commutes,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S T
        (Localization.AtPrime
          (r.asIdeal.comap
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T)))]
  let eVerticalQuotient :
      (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸
          q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q))) ≃+*
        (Localization.AtPrime
            (r.asIdeal.comap
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T)) ⧸
          q.map
            (algebraMap S
              (Localization.AtPrime
                (r.asIdeal.comap
                  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T))))) :=
    Ideal.quotientEquiv
      (q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q)))
      (q.map
        (algebraMap S
          (Localization.AtPrime
            (r.asIdeal.comap
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] q.Fiber T)))))
      eIdeal.toRingEquiv hqMap
  have hFieldVerticalQuotient :
      IsField
        (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸
          q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q))) :=
    eVerticalQuotient.toMulEquiv.isField hFieldVerticalAtR
  have hqMax :
      (q.map (algebraMap S
        (Localization.AtPrime Q))).IsMaximal :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient _).mpr
      hFieldVerticalQuotient
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hqMax

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_localization_right_maximalIdeal_core
statement:
private theorem tensorProduct_localization_right_maximalIdeal_core
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Flat R R']
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    (p' : Ideal R')
    (Q : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver p']
    (hQq : Q.comap
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q)
    (hpmap : p.map (algebraMap R R') = p')
    [CharZero (R ⧸ p)] :
    q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q)) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)
proof:
:= by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let : Q.LiesOver q :=
    { over := by
        simpa [Ideal.under_def,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_eq_includeRight] using hQq.symm }
  have hQOverp : Q.LiesOver p := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q q p
  let : Q.LiesOver p := hQOverp
  have hp'Overp : p'.LiesOver p :=
    Ideal.LiesOver.tower_bot Q p' p
  let : p'.LiesOver p := hp'Overp
  let : p'.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_of_liesOver Q p'
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (Localization.AtPrime p') :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p p'
  let : CharZero p.ResidueField :=
    IsFractionRing.charZero_of_isFractionRing (R ⧸ p)
  let : PerfectField p.ResidueField := by infer_instance
  let : Module.Finite p.ResidueField q.ResidueField := by
    infer_instance
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable p.ResidueField q.ResidueField :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSeparable_of_perfectField
  let A := q.Fiber T
  let Qover : q.primesOver T := ⟨Q, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  let r : PrimeSpectrum A :=
    PrimeSpectrum.primesOverOrderIsoFiber S T q Qover
  have hQr :
      Q = r.asIdeal.comap
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom := by
    change (Q : Ideal T) = r.asIdeal.comap
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] A)
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.coe_primesOverOrderIsoFiber_symm_apply,
      OrderIso.symm_apply_apply]
  let rprimeToA : R' →+* A :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] A).toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : R' →ₐ[R] T).toRingHom
  let : Algebra R' A := rprimeToA.toAlgebra
  have hrOverp' : r.asIdeal.LiesOver p' := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    change p' = r.asIdeal.comap
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : T →ₐ[S] A).toRingHom.comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : R' →ₐ[R] T).toRingHom)
    rw [← Ideal.comap_comap, ← hQr]
    exact Ideal.over_def Q p'
  let : r.asIdeal.LiesOver p' := hrOverp'
  have hpA : p'.map (algebraMap R' A) = ⊥ := by
    rw [← hpmap, Ideal.map_map,
      Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker]
    intro x hx
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
    change (1 : q.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[S]
        ((algebraMap R R' x) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S)) = 0
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul]
    calc
      (1 : q.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[S]
          (1 ⊗ₜ[R] algebraMap R S x : T) =
          (1 : q.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[S]
            algebraMap S T (algebraMap R S x) := rfl
      _ = algebraMap S q.ResidueField (algebraMap R S x) ⊗ₜ[S]
          (1 : T) :=
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul
          (R := S) (A := q.ResidueField) (B := T)
          (algebraMap R S x)).symm
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mpr
          ((Ideal.mem_of_liesOver (P := q) (p := p) x).mp hx)]
        exact TensorProduct.zero_tmul _ _
  let B := p'.Fiber A
  let rover : p'.primesOver A :=
    ⟨r.asIdeal, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  let s : PrimeSpectrum B :=
    PrimeSpectrum.primesOverOrderIsoFiber R' A p' rover
  have hrs :
      r.asIdeal = s.asIdeal.comap
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom := by
    change r.asIdeal = s.asIdeal.comap
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[R'] B)
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.coe_primesOverOrderIsoFiber_symm_apply,
      OrderIso.symm_apply_apply]
  let AR := q.ResidueField ⊗[R] R'
  let eAq : A ≃ₐ[q.ResidueField] AR :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight R S R').symm).trans
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange
        R S q.ResidueField q.ResidueField R')
  let : Algebra R' AR := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let eAR' : A ≃ₐ[R'] AR :=
    { toRingEquiv := eAq.toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro x
        change eAq ((1 : q.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[S]
          ((x : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S))) =
            (1 : q.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[R] x
        simp only [eAq, AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
        change (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange
          R S q.ResidueField q.ResidueField R')
            ((1 : q.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[S]
              ((Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight R S R').symm
                ((x : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S)))) =
            (1 : q.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[R] x
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight_symm_tmul,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange_tmul, one_smul] }
  let H := p'.ResidueField
  let G := H ⊗[p.ResidueField] q.ResidueField
  let eB0 : B ≃ₐ[H] (H ⊗[R] q.ResidueField) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl eAR').trans <|
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight
          R R' q.ResidueField).symm).trans <|
        Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange
          R R' H H q.ResidueField
  let eResidue : p.Fiber q.ResidueField
      ≃ₐ[p.ResidueField] q.ResidueField :=
    residueFieldFiberAlgEquiv p q
  let eReduce : (H ⊗[R] q.ResidueField) ≃ₐ[H] G :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange
      R p.ResidueField H H q.ResidueField).symm.trans <|
      Algebra.TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl eResidue
  let eB : B ≃ₐ[H] G := eB0.trans eReduce
  let m : Ideal G := s.asIdeal.map eB.toRingEquiv
  let : m.IsPrime := by
    exact Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective eB.surjective fun x hx ↦ by
      have hx0 : x = 0 := eB.injective (hx.trans eB.map_zero.symm)
      subst x
      exact s.asIdeal.zero_mem
  have hsComap : s.asIdeal = m.comap eB.toRingHom := by
    symm
    exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective
      eB.toRingEquiv eB.bijective
  let eLocalB : Localization.AtPrime s.asIdeal
      ≃ₐ[H] Localization.AtPrime m :=
    Localization.localAlgEquiv s.asIdeal m eB hsComap
  have hFieldM : IsField (Localization.AtPrime m) :=
    isField_localizationAtPrime_finiteSeparableTensor m
  have hFieldS : IsField (Localization.AtPrime s.asIdeal) :=
    eLocalB.toMulEquiv.isField hFieldM
  have hFieldR : IsField (Localization.AtPrime r.asIdeal) :=
    isField_localization_of_fiber_prime p' s r.asIdeal hrs hpA hFieldS
  exact right_maximalIdeal_of_fiber_localization_isField
    q Q r hQr hFieldR

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Flat R R']
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    (p' : Ideal R')
    (Q : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver p']
    (hQq : Q.comap
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q)
    (hpmap : p.map (algebraMap R R') = p')
    [CharZero (R ⧸ p)] :
    Q.ramificationIdx R' = q.ramificationIdx R
proof:
:= by
  let : Q.LiesOver q :=
    { over := by
        simpa [Ideal.under_def,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_eq_includeRight] using hQq.symm }
  have hQOverp : Q.LiesOver p := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q q p
  let : Q.LiesOver p := hQOverp
  have hp'Overp : p'.LiesOver p :=
    Ideal.LiesOver.tower_bot Q p' p
  let : p'.LiesOver p := hp'Overp
  let : p'.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_of_liesOver Q p'
  have hqLocal :=
    tensorProduct_localization_right_maximalIdeal_core
      (p := p) (q := q) (p' := p') (Q := Q) hQq hpmap
  have hVertical : Q.ramificationIdx S = 1 := by
    rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq q Q, hqLocal,
      ENat.toNat_eq_iff_eq_natCast, Nat.cast_one,
      Module.length_eq_one_iff, isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom,
      ← Ideal.isMaximal_def, IsLocalRing.isMaximal_iff]
  let TQ := Localization.AtPrime Q
  have hSameBaseIdeal :
      p'.map (algebraMap R' TQ) =
        p.map (algebraMap R TQ) := by
    rw [← hpmap, Ideal.map_map,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R R' TQ]
  have hAcrossBase :
      Q.ramificationIdx R' = Q.ramificationIdx R := by
    rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq p' Q,
      Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq p Q, hSameBaseIdeal]
  calc
    Q.ramificationIdx R' = Q.ramificationIdx R := hAcrossBase
    _ = q.ramificationIdx R * Q.ramificationIdx S :=
      Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower q Q
    _ = q.ramificationIdx R := by rw [hVertical, mul_one]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_localization_right_maximalIdeal_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_localization_right_maximalIdeal_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Flat R R']
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    (p' : Ideal R')
    (Q : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver p']
    (hQq : Q.comap
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q)
    (hpmap : p.map (algebraMap R R') = p')
    [CharZero (R ⧸ p)] :
    q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q)) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)
proof:
:= by
  exact tensorProduct_localization_right_maximalIdeal_core
    (p := p) (q := q) (p' := p') (Q := Q) hQq hpmap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_localization_right_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_finite_flat_charZero
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_localization_right_maximalIdeal_eq_span_of_finite_flat_charZero
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Flat R R']
    (y : R)
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))]
    (Q : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [Q.IsPrime]
    [Q.LiesOver
      (Ideal.span ({algebraMap R R' y} : Set R'))]
    (hQq : Q.comap
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q)
    [CharZero (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))] :
    q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q)) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)
proof:
:= by
  let : (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_of_liesOver q (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))
  exact
    tensorProduct_localization_right_maximalIdeal_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero
      (p := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))
      (q := q)
      (p' := Ideal.span ({algebraMap R R' y} : Set R'))
      (Q := Q) hQq (by
        rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton])

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_span_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_span_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Flat R R']
    (y : R)
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))]
    (Q : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [Q.IsPrime]
    [Q.LiesOver
      (Ideal.span ({algebraMap R R' y} : Set R'))]
    (hQq : Q.comap
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q)
    [CharZero (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))] :
    Q.ramificationIdx R' = q.ramificationIdx R
proof:
:= by
  let : (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R)).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_of_liesOver q (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))
  exact ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero
    (p := Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))
    (q := q)
    (p' := Ideal.span ({algebraMap R R' y} : Set R'))
    (Q := Q) hQq (by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton])

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_span_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero_of_eq
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_span_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero_of_eq
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Flat R R']
    (y : R)
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))]
    (Q : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [Q.IsPrime]
    [Q.LiesOver
      (Ideal.span ({algebraMap R R' y} : Set R'))]
    (hQq : Q.comap
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q)
    [CharZero (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({y} : Set R))]
    {N : ℕ} (hq : q.ramificationIdx R = N) :
    Q.ramificationIdx R' = N
proof:
:= by
  rw [ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_span_eq_of_finite_flat_charZero
    (y := y) (q := q) (Q := Q) hQq, hq]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_isUnit_mod_prime_of_heightTwo_localizations
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_isUnit_mod_prime_of_heightTwo_localizations
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)]
    (t : A) (ht : Prime t)
    [CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t})]
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime]
    [Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {t})]
    (hlocal : ∀ (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
        (_hstrict : Ideal.span {t} < P) (_hheight : P.height = 2),
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
        localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
      letI : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
        localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
      let q := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
      IsUnit
        ((q.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime P) : ℕ) :
          Localization.AtPrime P)) :
    IsUnit
      ((Q.ramificationIdx A : ℕ) : A ⧸ Ideal.span {t})
proof:
:= by
  apply isUnit_natCast_mod_prime_of_heightTwo_localizations
    t ht (Q.ramificationIdx A) (Ideal.ramificationIdx_pos Q A)
  intro P hP hstrict hheight
  let : P.IsPrime := hP
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  have hQP : Q.under A ≤ P := by
    rw [← Q.over_def (Ideal.span {t})]
    exact hstrict.le
  let q := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  have hram : q.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime P) =
      Q.ramificationIdx A :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_of_under_le
      (K := K) (L := L) P Q hQP
  have hu := hlocal P hstrict hheight
  change IsUnit
    ((q.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime P) : ℕ) :
      Localization.AtPrime P) at hu
  rw [hram] at hu
  simpa only [map_natCast] using hu

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.height_eq_height_under_of_faithfully_integral_over_integrallyClosed
statement:
theorem height_eq_height_under_of_faithfully_integral_over_integrallyClosed
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsDomain S]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] [FaithfulSMul R S]
    (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] :
    P.height = (P.under R).height
proof:
:= by
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum S := ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
  let p : PrimeSpectrum R := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) Q
  change Q.asIdeal.height = p.asIdeal.height
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight, PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Order.height_le
    intro l hlast
    let l' : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R) :=
      l.map (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) (by
        intro x y hxy
        exact Ideal.IsIntegral.under_lt_under hxy)
    have hlast' : l'.last = p := by
      change PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) l.last = p
      rw [hlast]
    rw [← show l'.length = l.length by rfl]
    simpa [hlast'] using (Order.length_le_height_last (p := l'))
  · apply Order.height_le
    intro l hlast
    have hlastIdeal : l.last.asIdeal = P.under R := by
      simpa [p, Q, Ideal.under_def] using congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hlast
    let : P.LiesOver l.last.asIdeal := ⟨hlastIdeal⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hlen, hlastL, -⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingDown l P
    rw [← hlen]
    simpa [Q, hlastL] using (Order.length_le_height_last (p := L))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.contracted_height_eq_one
statement:
private theorem contracted_height_eq_one
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsDomain S]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] [FaithfulSMul R S]
    (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 1) :
    (P.under R).height = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← height_eq_height_under_of_faithfully_integral_over_integrallyClosed P]
  exact hP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.kaehlerDifferential_support_subset_height_ne_one_of_unramifiedAt_heightOne
statement:
theorem kaehlerDifferential_support_subset_height_ne_one_of_unramifiedAt_heightOne
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsDomain S]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S] [Module.IsTorsionFree R S]
    (hunramified :
      ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
        ∀ (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p],
          Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P) :
    Module.support S Ω[S⁄R] ⊆ {P | P.asIdeal.height ≠ 1}
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R S
  intro P hsupport hheight
  let : P.asIdeal.IsPrime := P.isPrime
  let p : Ideal R := P.asIdeal.under R
  let : p.IsPrime := inferInstance
  let : P.asIdeal.LiesOver p := inferInstance
  have hpHeight : p.height = 1 :=
    contracted_height_eq_one P.asIdeal hheight
  have hUnramified : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P.asIdeal :=
    hunramified p hpHeight P.asIdeal
  have hLocus : P ∈ Algebra.unramifiedLocus R S := hUnramified
  rw [Algebra.unramifiedLocus_eq_compl_support] at hLocus
  exact hLocus hsupport

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.nonEtaleCotangentSupport_subset_height_ne_one_of_isEtaleAt_heightOne
statement:
theorem nonEtaleCotangentSupport_subset_height_ne_one_of_isEtaleAt_heightOne
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsDomain S]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S] [Module.IsTorsionFree R S]
    (hetale :
      ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
        ∀ (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p],
          Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P) :
    Module.support S Ω[S⁄R] ∪ Module.support S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) ⊆
      {P | P.asIdeal.height ≠ 1}
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R S
  intro P hsupport hheight
  let : P.asIdeal.IsPrime := P.isPrime
  let p : Ideal R := P.asIdeal.under R
  let : p.IsPrime := inferInstance
  let : P.asIdeal.LiesOver p := inferInstance
  have hpHeight : p.height = 1 :=
    contracted_height_eq_one P.asIdeal hheight
  have hEtale : Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P.asIdeal :=
    hetale p hpHeight P.asIdeal
  have hLocus : P ∈ Algebra.etaleLocus R S := hEtale
  rw [Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_compl_support] at hLocus
  exact hsupport.elim hLocus.1 hLocus.2

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.mem_minimalPrimes_annihilator_of_minimal_mem_support
statement:
theorem mem_minimalPrimes_annihilator_of_minimal_mem_support
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] (P : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hP : Minimal (· ∈ Module.support R M) P) :
    P.asIdeal ∈ (Module.annihilator R M).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨P.isPrime, Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hP.1⟩, ?_⟩
  intro q hq hqP
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum R := ⟨q, hq.1⟩
  have hQSupport : Q ∈ Module.support R M :=
    Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mpr hq.2
  exact hP.2 hQSupport hqP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.mem_associatedPrimes_of_minimal_mem_support
statement:
theorem mem_associatedPrimes_of_minimal_mem_support
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R M] (P : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hP : Minimal (· ∈ Module.support R M) P) :
    P.asIdeal ∈ associatedPrimes R M
proof:
:=
  Module.associatedPrimes.minimalPrimes_annihilator_subset_associatedPrimes R M
    (mem_minimalPrimes_annihilator_of_minimal_mem_support P hP)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.exists_minimal_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_not_formallyEtale
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_not_formallyEtale
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S]
    (hne : ¬ Algebra.FormallyEtale R S) :
    ∃ P : PrimeSpectrum S,
      Minimal
        (· ∈ Module.support S Ω[S⁄R] ∪
          Module.support S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)) P
proof:
:= by
  let : IsNoetherianRing S := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R S
  let : Module.Finite S Ω[S⁄R] :=
    kaehlerDifferential_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
  let : Module.Finite S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) :=
    h1Cotangent_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
  let T :=
    Module.support S Ω[S⁄R] ∪
      Module.support S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)
  have hT : T.Nonempty := by
    by_contra hempty
    have hTempty : T = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hempty
    apply hne
    rw [← Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_univ_iff]
    rw [Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_compl_support]
    have hΩ : Module.support S Ω[S⁄R] = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro P hP
      have : P ∈ T := Or.inl hP
      rw [hTempty] at this
      exact Set.notMem_empty P this
    have hH1 : Module.support S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro P hP
      have : P ∈ T := Or.inr hP
      rw [hTempty] at this
      exact Set.notMem_empty P this
    rw [hΩ, hH1]
    rw [Set.compl_empty, Set.univ_inter]
  obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ := hT
  let IΩ := Module.annihilator S Ω[S⁄R]
  let IH1 := Module.annihilator S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)
  let J : Ideal S := IΩ ⊓ IH1
  have hJleP₀ : J ≤ P₀.asIdeal := by
    rcases hP₀ with hP₀ | hP₀
    · exact inf_le_left.trans
        (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hP₀)
    · exact inf_le_right.trans
        (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hP₀)
  have hJne : J ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top P₀.isPrime.ne_top hJleP₀
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := J.nonempty_minimalPrimes hJne
  let P : PrimeSpectrum S := ⟨p, hp.isPrime⟩
  have hIp : IΩ ≤ p ∨ IH1 ≤ p := by
    apply hp.isPrime.inf_le.mp
    simpa only [J] using hp.le
  have hPsupport : P ∈ T := by
    rcases hIp with hIp | hIp
    · exact Or.inl (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mpr hIp)
    · exact Or.inr (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mpr hIp)
  refine ⟨P, hPsupport, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQsupport hQP
  have hJQ : J ≤ Q.asIdeal := by
    rcases hQsupport with hQ | hQ
    · exact inf_le_left.trans
        (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hQ)
    · exact inf_le_right.trans
        (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hQ)
  exact hp.2 ⟨Q.isPrime, hJQ⟩ hQP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.isEtaleAt_of_lt_minimal_nonEtaleCotangentSupport
statement:
theorem isEtaleAt_of_lt_minimal_nonEtaleCotangentSupport
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S]
    (P : PrimeSpectrum S)
    (hP : Minimal
      (· ∈ Module.support S Ω[S⁄R] ∪
        Module.support S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)) P)
    (Q : PrimeSpectrum S) (hQP : Q < P) :
    Algebra.IsEtaleAt R Q.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  change Q ∈ Algebra.etaleLocus R S
  rw [Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_compl_support]
  constructor
  · intro hQ
    exact (not_le_of_gt hQP) (hP.2 (Or.inl hQ) hQP.le)
  · intro hQ
    exact (not_le_of_gt hQP) (hP.2 (Or.inr hQ) hQP.le)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.minimal_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_associated_and_height_ne_one
statement:
theorem minimal_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_associated_and_height_ne_one
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsDomain S]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S] [Module.IsTorsionFree R S]
    (hetale :
      ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
        ∀ (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p],
          Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum S)
    (hP : Minimal
      (· ∈ Module.support S Ω[S⁄R] ∪
        Module.support S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)) P) :
    P.asIdeal ∈ associatedPrimes S Ω[S⁄R] ∪
        associatedPrimes S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) ∧
      P.asIdeal.height ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  let : IsNoetherianRing S := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R S
  let : Module.Finite S Ω[S⁄R] :=
    kaehlerDifferential_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
  let : Module.Finite S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) :=
    h1Cotangent_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
  constructor
  · rcases hP.1 with hΩ | hH1
    · left
      apply mem_associatedPrimes_of_minimal_mem_support P
      exact ⟨hΩ, fun Q hQ hQP ↦ hP.2 (Or.inl hQ) hQP⟩
    · right
      apply mem_associatedPrimes_of_minimal_mem_support P
      exact ⟨hH1, fun Q hQ hQP ↦ hP.2 (Or.inr hQ) hQP⟩
  · exact
      nonEtaleCotangentSupport_subset_height_ne_one_of_isEtaleAt_heightOne hetale hP.1

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.exists_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_associated_and_height_ne_one_of_isEtaleAt_heightOne
statement:
theorem
    exists_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_associated_and_height_ne_one_of_isEtaleAt_heightOne
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsDomain S]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S] [Module.IsTorsionFree R S]
    (hetale :
      ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
        ∀ (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p],
          Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P)
    (hne : ¬ Algebra.FormallyEtale R S) :
    ∃ P : PrimeSpectrum S,
      P.asIdeal ∈ associatedPrimes S Ω[S⁄R] ∪
          associatedPrimes S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) ∧
        P.asIdeal.height ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ :=
    exists_minimal_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_not_formallyEtale hne
  exact ⟨P,
    minimal_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_associated_and_height_ne_one
      hetale P hP⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.image_comap_support_eq_support_of_finite
statement:
theorem image_comap_support_eq_support_of_finite
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {M : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M]
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Finite S M] :
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) '' Module.support S M =
      Module.support R M
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Finite R M := Module.Finite.trans (R := R) S M
  rw [Module.support_eq_zeroLocus, Module.support_eq_zeroLocus,
    ← Module.comap_annihilator (R₀ := R) (R := S) (M := M)]
  have hclosed : IsClosed
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) ''
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Module.annihilator S M)) :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isClosedMap_comap_of_isIntegral (algebraMap R S)
      (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := R) (A := S)) _
      (PrimeSpectrum.isClosed_zeroLocus _)
  calc
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) ''
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Module.annihilator S M) =
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) ''
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Module.annihilator S M)) :=
      hclosed.closure_eq.symm
    _ = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
        ((Module.annihilator S M).comap (algebraMap R S)) :=
      PrimeSpectrum.closure_image_comap_zeroLocus
        (algebraMap R S) (Module.annihilator S M)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.kaehlerDifferential_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
statement:
theorem kaehlerDifferential_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] :
    Module.Finite S Ω[S⁄R]

    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp inferInstance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.h1Cotangent_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
statement:
theorem h1Cotangent_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] :
    Module.Finite S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation R S :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp inferInstance
  let : IsNoetherianRing S := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R S
  let P := Algebra.Presentation.ofFinitePresentation R S
  let : Module.Finite S P.toExtension.Cotangent :=
    Algebra.Extension.Cotangent.finite P.fg_ker
  let : Module.Finite S P.toExtension.H1Cotangent :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective P.toExtension.h1Cotangentι
      P.toExtension.h1Cotangentι_injective
