name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.cotangent_minimalPrimes_subset_associatedPrimes_of_finite_over_noetherian
statement:
theorem cotangent_minimalPrimes_subset_associatedPrimes_of_finite_over_noetherian
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] :
    (Module.annihilator S Ω[S⁄R]).minimalPrimes ⊆
        associatedPrimes S Ω[S⁄R] ∧
      (Module.annihilator S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)).minimalPrimes ⊆
        associatedPrimes S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsNoetherianRing S := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R S
  let : Module.Finite S Ω[S⁄R] :=
    kaehlerDifferential_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
  let : Module.Finite S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) :=
    h1Cotangent_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
  exact
    ⟨Module.associatedPrimes.minimalPrimes_annihilator_subset_associatedPrimes S Ω[S⁄R],
      Module.associatedPrimes.minimalPrimes_annihilator_subset_associatedPrimes S
        (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.finiteNormalDomainAlgebra_etale_of_regular_boundary
statement:
theorem finiteNormalDomainAlgebra_etale_of_regular_boundary
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsIntegrallyClosed S]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S))
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
    (hregular : ∀ p ∈ Z, IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
    (hgeneric : Algebra.IsEtaleAt R (⊥ : Ideal S))
    (haway : ∀ P : PrimeSpectrum S,
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P ∉ Z → Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P.asIdeal)
    (hheightOne : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
      ∀ (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p], Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P) :
    Algebra.Etale R S
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R S
  have hformally : Algebra.FormallyEtale R S := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨p, hp, P, hPp, hP⟩ :=
      exists_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_not_formallyEtale hne
    have hpZ : p ∈ Z := by
      by_contra hpZ
      have hPaway : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P ∉ Z := by
        rwa [hPp]
      have hLocus : P ∈ Algebra.etaleLocus R S := haway P hPaway
      rw [Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_compl_support] at hLocus
      exact hP.elim hLocus.1 hLocus.2
    have hp0 := base_height_ne_zero_of_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_isEtaleAt_bot
      hgeneric p P hPp hP
    have hp1 := base_height_ne_one_of_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_isEtaleAt_heightOne
      hheightOne p P hPp hP
    have hheight : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ p.asIdeal.height := by
      by_contra htwo
      have hle : p.asIdeal.height ≤ 1 := ENat.lt_two_iff.mp (lt_of_not_ge htwo)
      rcases Order.le_one_iff.mp hle with hzero | hone
      · exact hp0 hzero
      · exact hp1 hone
    have hdim : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) := by
      rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height p.asIdeal
        (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)]
      exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr hheight
    let : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) := hregular p hpZ
    exact not_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_hasPuncturedPurity hinj p hp
      (le_trans (by norm_num : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ 2) hdim)
      (hasPuncturedPurity_of_isRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) hdim)
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale R S := hformally
  let : Module.FinitePresentation R S := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R S
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation R S := Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation R S
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_etale_of_regular_boundary
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_regular_boundary
    {R K L : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field L] [Algebra R L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower R K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
    (hregular : ∀ p ∈ Z, IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))
    (haway : ∀ P : PrimeSpectrum (integralClosure R L),
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)) P ∉ Z →
        Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P.asIdeal)
    (hheightOne : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
      ∀ (P : Ideal (integralClosure R L)) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p],
        Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P) :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R L)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Finite R (integralClosure R L) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite R K L (integralClosure R L)
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed (integralClosure R L) :=
    integralClosure.isIntegrallyClosedOfFiniteExtension K
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply IsFractionRing.injective R K
    apply (algebraMap K L).injective
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L]
    exact congrArg (fun z : integralClosure R L ↦ (z : L)) hxy
  exact finiteNormalDomainAlgebra_etale_of_regular_boundary hinj Z hregular
    (integralClosure_isEtaleAt_bot_of_finite_separable (R := R) (K := K) (L := L))
    haway hheightOne

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.specFunctionField_algebraMap_ΓSpecIso_hom
statement:
private theorem specFunctionField_algebraMap_ΓSpecIso_hom
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    (r : Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤)) :
    let X
proof:
:= Spec (.of R)
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
    letI : Algebra R X.functionField :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of R)
    algebraMap R X.functionField ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).hom r) =
      X.germToFunctionField ⊤ r := by
  dsimp only
  let X := Spec (.of R)
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  change X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial)
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).hom r)) =
    X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial) r
  exact congrArg (fun s ↦
    X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) (by trivial) s)
      (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)) r)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.puncturedRestriction_nonempty_of_injective
statement:
theorem puncturedRestriction_nonempty_of_injective
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra A B]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B))
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim A) :
    let f : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A)
proof:
:=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A) := by
  dsimp only
  let f : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
  let etaA : PrimeSpectrum A := ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩
  let etaB : PrimeSpectrum B := ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩
  have hmap : f etaB = etaA := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    change Ideal.comap (algebraMap A B) ⊥ = ⊥
    exact Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective (algebraMap A B) hinj
  have hmaximal : maximalIdeal A ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hmaximal
    have hdimZero : ringKrullDim A = 0 := by
      rw [← maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim, hmaximal,
        Ideal.height_bot]
      rfl
    rw [hdimZero] at hpos
    exact (not_le_of_gt (by norm_num : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < 1)) hpos
  have heta : etaA ∈ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A := by
    rw [Scheme.mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff]
    intro h
    apply hmaximal
    exact (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h).symm
  refine ⟨⟨etaB, ?_⟩⟩
  change f etaB ∈ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A
  rw [hmap]
  exact heta

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.puncturedRestriction_connectedSpace_of_injective
statement:
theorem puncturedRestriction_connectedSpace_of_injective
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra A B]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B))
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim A) :
    let f : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A)
proof:
:=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    ConnectedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A) := by
  dsimp only
  let f : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
  let V : (Spec (.of B)).Opens :=
    f ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A
  let : Nonempty V :=
    puncturedRestriction_nonempty_of_injective hinj hpos
  let : IsIntegral (V : Scheme) := inferInstance
  exact inferInstance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.puncturedRestriction_isFiniteEtale_of_isEtaleAt_away_from_closedPoint
statement:
theorem puncturedRestriction_isFiniteEtale_of_isEtaleAt_away_from_closedPoint
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B]
    (haway :
      ∀ Q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) Q ≠
          ⟨maximalIdeal A, inferInstance⟩ →
        Algebra.IsEtaleAt A Q.asIdeal) :
    let f : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A)
proof:
:=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
    IsFiniteEtale (f ∣_ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A) := by
  dsimp only
  let f : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
  let U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A
  have hf : IsFinite f := by
    rw [IsFinite.SpecMap_iff]
    change (algebraMap A B).Finite
    exact RingHom.finite_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
  have hwFinite : IsFinite (f ∣_ U) :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback
      (isPullback_morphismRestrict f U).flip hf
  let : IsFinite (f ∣_ U) := hwFinite
  have hwEtale : Etale (f ∣_ U) := by
    apply EtaleFundamentalGroups.etale_of_stalkMap_formallyEtale
    intro y
    let Q : PrimeSpectrum B := y.1
    have hQaway :
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) Q ≠
          ⟨maximalIdeal A, inferInstance⟩ := by
      have hy : f Q ∈ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A := y.2
      have hne : f Q ≠ closedPoint (CommRingCat.of A) :=
        (Scheme.mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff A (f Q)).mp hy
      change PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) Q ≠
        ⟨maximalIdeal A, inferInstance⟩ at hne
      exact hne
    have hEtale : Algebra.IsEtaleAt A Q.asIdeal := haway Q hQaway
    let q : Ideal A := Q.asIdeal.under A
    let : q.IsPrime := inferInstance
    let : Q.asIdeal.LiesOver q := inferInstance
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver q Q.asIdeal
    have hlocal : Algebra.FormallyEtale (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) := by
      let : Algebra.FormallyEtale A (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) :=
        hEtale
      exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.localization_base q.primeCompl
    have hSpec : (f.stalkMap Q).hom.FormallyEtale := by
      apply
        (EtaleFundamentalGroups.RingHom.FormallyEtale.respectsIso.arrow_mk_iso_iff
          (Scheme.arrowStalkMapSpecIso
            (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)) Q)).mpr
      change (Localization.localRingHom q Q.asIdeal
        (algebraMap A B) rfl).FormallyEtale
      exact hlocal
    exact
      (EtaleFundamentalGroups.RingHom.FormallyEtale.respectsIso.arrow_mk_iso_iff
        (morphismRestrictStalkMap f U y)).mpr hSpec
  let : Etale (f ∣_ U) := hwEtale
  exact ⟨⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.puncturedRestrictionFiniteEtale_isConnected
statement:
theorem puncturedRestrictionFiniteEtale_isConnected
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B]
    (haway :
      ∀ Q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) Q ≠
          ⟨maximalIdeal A, inferInstance⟩ →
        Algebra.IsEtaleAt A Q.asIdeal)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B))
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim A) :
    CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsConnected
      (puncturedRestrictionFiniteEtale haway)
proof:
:= by
  let f : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
  let : Nonempty (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum A) :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim A hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion A) := by
    dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum A) :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion A)
  let : ConnectedSpace (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum A) := inferInstance
  let : ConnectedSpace (puncturedRestrictionFiniteEtale haway).left := by
    change ConnectedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A)
    exact puncturedRestriction_connectedSpace_of_injective hinj hpos
  exact FiniteEtale.isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left
    (puncturedRestrictionFiniteEtale haway)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.finiteNormalDomainAlgebra_etale_of_hasPuncturedPurity_of_isEtaleAt_away_from_closedPoint
statement:
theorem finiteNormalDomainAlgebra_etale_of_hasPuncturedPurity_of_isEtaleAt_away_from_closedPoint
    {A B : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    [Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B]
    (hpos : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim A)
    (hpurity : AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity A)
    (haway :
      ∀ Q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) Q ≠
          ⟨maximalIdeal A, inferInstance⟩ →
        Algebra.IsEtaleAt A Q.asIdeal)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B)) :
    Algebra.Etale A B
proof:
:= by
  let X := Spec (.of A)
  let Y := Spec (.of B)
  let f : Y ⟶ X := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))
  let U := Scheme.puncturedSpectrum A
  let j : U ⟶ X := Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion A
  let V : Y.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A
  let w : (V : Scheme) ⟶ U :=
    f ∣_ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A
  let : Nonempty U :=
    Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim A hpos
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := by
    dsimp only [j, Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : IsIntegral U := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : IsNormalIntegral U := inferInstance
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian U := inferInstance
  let : Nonempty V :=
    puncturedRestriction_nonempty_of_injective hinj hpos
  let : IsIntegral (V : Scheme) := inferInstance
  let : IsFiniteEtale w :=
    puncturedRestriction_isFiniteEtale_of_isEtaleAt_away_from_closedPoint
      haway
  let W : FiniteEtale U := FiniteEtale.mk w
  let : ConnectedSpace W.left := by
    change ConnectedSpace V
    exact puncturedRestriction_connectedSpace_of_injective hinj hpos
  let : IsConnected W :=
    FiniteEtale.isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left W
  let : IsIntegral W.left := by
    change IsIntegral (V : Scheme)
    infer_instance
  let : Algebra A X.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of A)
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X, by trivial⟩⟩
  let : Nonempty (⊤ : Y.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint Y, by trivial⟩⟩
  let : Algebra A U.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldAlgebraOfPositiveDimension
      A hpos
  let : IsFractionRing A U.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumFunctionField_isFractionRing_of_positiveDimension
      A hpos
  let : Algebra U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra W
  let : Algebra A W.left.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap U.functionField W.left.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap A U.functionField)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A U.functionField W.left.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hIC : Algebra.Etale A
      (integralClosure A W.left.functionField) :=
    (open _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale in
      connectedPuncturedCover_integralClosure_etale_of_hasPuncturedPurity
        A hpos hpurity W)
  let i : W.left ⟶ Y := by
    change (V : Scheme) ⟶ Y
    exact V.ι
  let : IsOpenImmersion i := by
    change IsOpenImmersion V.ι
    infer_instance
  let hi : DenseRange i :=
    i.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.denseRange_of_isPreirreducibleSpace i
  let hf : DenseRange f := by
    change DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical,
      (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot (algebraMap A B)).mp hinj]
    exact bot_le
  let hj : DenseRange j :=
    j.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.denseRange_of_isPreirreducibleSpace j
  let hw : DenseRange W.hom :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_hom_denseRange_of_isConnected W
  let hUright : IsIntegral ((Functor.fromPUnit U).obj W.right) := by
    change IsIntegral U
    infer_instance
  let hWleft : IsIntegral ((Functor.id Scheme).obj W.left) := by
    change IsIntegral W.left
    infer_instance
  let : Algebra B Y.functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of B)
  let : Algebra B W.left.functionField :=
    i.functionFieldAlgebraOfIsOpenImmersionSpec (.of B)
  let : IsFractionRing B W.left.functionField :=
    i.functionField_isFractionRing_of_isOpenImmersionSpec (.of B)
  have hfieldSquare :
      (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap Y W.left i inferInstance
        inferInstance hi).comp
          (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap X Y f inferInstance
            inferInstance hf) =
        (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap
          ((Functor.fromPUnit U).obj W.right)
          ((Functor.id Scheme).obj W.left) W.hom hUright hWleft hw).comp
          (@Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap X U j inferInstance
            inferInstance hj) := by
    let hif : DenseRange (i ≫ f) := by
      change DenseRange (f.base ∘ i.base)
      exact hf.comp hi f.continuous
    let hwj : DenseRange (W.hom ≫ j) := by
      change DenseRange (j.base ∘ W.hom.base)
      exact hj.comp hw j.continuous
    have hsquare : W.hom ≫ j = i ≫ f := by
      change w ≫ j = V.ι ≫ f
      exact morphismRestrict_ι f (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen A)
    calc
      _ = (i ≫ f).functionFieldMap hif := by
        simpa only [hif] using
          Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_of_denseRange f hf i hi
      _ = (W.hom ≫ j).functionFieldMap hwj := by
        exact functionFieldMap_eq_of_eq _ _ hsquare.symm _ _
      _ = _ := by
        symm
        have hcomp :=
          Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_of_denseRange j hj W.hom hw
        exact hcomp.trans (functionFieldMap_eq_of_eq _ _ rfl _ _)
  have hpunc :
      (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquivOfPositiveDimension
        A hpos).toRingHom = j.functionFieldMap hj := by
    unfold AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquivOfPositiveDimension
    unfold Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap
    rw [eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr]
    · ext x
      rfl
    · exact (genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion j).symm
  have hspec :
      (f.functionFieldMap hf).comp (algebraMap A X.functionField) =
        (algebraMap B Y.functionField).comp (algebraMap A B) := by
    have htop := f.functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField_top hf
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    let rA : Γ(X, ⊤) := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv a
    let rB : Γ(Y, ⊤) := f.appTop rA
    have hmap := DFunLike.congr_fun htop rA
    have hA : X.germToFunctionField ⊤ rA =
        algebraMap A X.functionField a := by
      rw [← specFunctionField_algebraMap_ΓSpecIso_hom A rA]
      congr 1
      exact Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)) a
    have hB : Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ rB =
        algebraMap B Y.functionField (algebraMap A B a) := by
      rw [← specFunctionField_algebraMap_ΓSpecIso_hom B rB]
      congr 1
      change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of B)).hom (f.appTop rA) =
        algebraMap A B a
      rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality,
        CommRingCat.comp_apply]
      change algebraMap A B ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).hom rA) =
        algebraMap A B a
      rw [show (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).hom rA = a by
        exact Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)) a]
    change f.functionFieldMap hf (algebraMap A X.functionField a) =
      algebraMap B Y.functionField (algebraMap A B a)
    rw [← hA, ← hB]
    exact hmap
  let : IsScalarTower A B W.left.functionField := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro a
    change W.hom.functionFieldMap hw
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquivOfPositiveDimension
          A hpos) (algebraMap A X.functionField a)) =
      i.functionFieldRingEquivOfIsOpenImmersion
        (algebraMap B Y.functionField (algebraMap A B a))
    rw [Scheme.Hom.functionFieldRingEquivOfIsOpenImmersion_apply]
    have hs := DFunLike.congr_fun hspec a
    have hp := DFunLike.congr_fun hpunc (algebraMap A X.functionField a)
    have hsq := DFunLike.congr_fun hfieldSquare
      (algebraMap A X.functionField a)
    have hs' :
        f.functionFieldMap hf (algebraMap A X.functionField a) =
          algebraMap B Y.functionField (algebraMap A B a) := by
      simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hs
    have hp' :
        (AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.puncturedSpectrumFunctionFieldRingEquivOfPositiveDimension
          A hpos) (algebraMap A X.functionField a) =
          j.functionFieldMap hj (algebraMap A X.functionField a) := hp
    calc
      _ = W.hom.functionFieldMap hw
          (j.functionFieldMap hj (algebraMap A X.functionField a)) :=
        congrArg (W.hom.functionFieldMap hw) hp'
      _ = ((W.hom.functionFieldMap hw).comp (j.functionFieldMap hj))
          (algebraMap A X.functionField a) := rfl
      _ = ((i.functionFieldMap hi).comp (f.functionFieldMap hf))
          (algebraMap A X.functionField a) := hsq.symm
      _ = i.functionFieldMap hi
          (f.functionFieldMap hf (algebraMap A X.functionField a)) := rfl
      _ = i.functionFieldMap hi
          (algebraMap B Y.functionField (algebraMap A B a)) :=
        congrArg (i.functionFieldMap hi) hs'
      _ = _ := by rfl
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : IsIntegralClosure B A W.left.functionField := inferInstance
  let eB : B ≃ₐ[A] integralClosure A W.left.functionField :=
    IsIntegralClosure.equiv A B W.left.functionField
      (integralClosure A W.left.functionField)
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eB.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.localizedFiniteAlgebra_puncturedRestriction_isFiniteEtale_of_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport
statement:
theorem
localizedFiniteAlgebra_puncturedRestriction_isFiniteEtale_of_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.exists_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_not_formallyEtale
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_not_formallyEtale
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S]
    (hne : ¬ Algebra.FormallyEtale R S) :
    ∃ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      Minimal
        (· ∈ Module.support R Ω[S⁄R] ∪
          Module.support R (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)) p ∧
      ∃ P : PrimeSpectrum S,
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P = p ∧
        P ∈ Module.support S Ω[S⁄R] ∪
          Module.support S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsNoetherianRing S := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R S
  let : Module.Finite S Ω[S⁄R] :=
    kaehlerDifferential_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
  let : Module.Finite S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) :=
    h1Cotangent_finite_of_finite_over_noetherian
  let : Module.Finite R Ω[S⁄R] :=
    Module.Finite.trans (R := R) S Ω[S⁄R]
  let : Module.Finite R (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) :=
    Module.Finite.trans (R := R) S (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)
  let T :=
    Module.support R Ω[S⁄R] ∪
      Module.support R (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)
  obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ :=
    exists_minimal_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_not_formallyEtale hne
  have hp₀ : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P₀ ∈ T := by
    rcases hP₀.1 with hΩ | hH1
    · exact Or.inl (Module.support_subset_preimage_comap
        (R := R) (A := S) (M := Ω[S⁄R]) hΩ)
    · exact Or.inr (Module.support_subset_preimage_comap
        (R := R) (A := S) (M := Algebra.H1Cotangent R S) hH1)
  let IΩ := Module.annihilator R Ω[S⁄R]
  let IH1 := Module.annihilator R (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)
  let J : Ideal R := IΩ ⊓ IH1
  have hJle : J ≤ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P₀).asIdeal := by
    rcases hp₀ with hp₀ | hp₀
    · exact inf_le_left.trans (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hp₀)
    · exact inf_le_right.trans (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hp₀)
  have hJne : J ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P₀).isPrime.ne_top hJle
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := J.nonempty_minimalPrimes hJne
  let p : PrimeSpectrum R := ⟨q, hq.isPrime⟩
  have hIq : IΩ ≤ q ∨ IH1 ≤ q := by
    apply hq.isPrime.inf_le.mp
    simpa only [J] using hq.le
  have hpSupport : p ∈ T := by
    rcases hIq with hIq | hIq
    · exact Or.inl (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mpr hIq)
    · exact Or.inr (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mpr hIq)
  have hpMinimal : Minimal (· ∈ T) p := by
    refine ⟨hpSupport, ?_⟩
    intro q' hq'Support hq'p
    have hJq' : J ≤ q'.asIdeal := by
      rcases hq'Support with hq' | hq'
      · exact inf_le_left.trans (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hq')
      · exact inf_le_right.trans (Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mp hq')
    exact hq.2 ⟨q'.isPrime, hJq'⟩ hq'p
  refine ⟨p, hpMinimal, ?_⟩
  rcases hpSupport with hpΩ | hpH1
  · rw [← image_comap_support_eq_support_of_finite
      (R := R) (S := S) (M := Ω[S⁄R])] at hpΩ
    obtain ⟨P, hPΩ, hPp⟩ := hpΩ
    exact ⟨P, hPp, Or.inl hPΩ⟩
  · rw [← image_comap_support_eq_support_of_finite
      (R := R) (S := S) (M := Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)] at hpH1
    obtain ⟨P, hPH1, hPp⟩ := hpH1
    exact ⟨P, hPp, Or.inr hPH1⟩

statement:

    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.regular_pair_nonzero_and_isRelPrime
statement:
theorem regular_pair_nonzero_and_isRelPrime
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] {x y : A}
    (hregular : IsRegular A [x, y]) :
    x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ IsRelPrime x y
proof:
:= by
  have hpair := (isRegular_cons_iff A x [y]).mp hregular
  have hyRegular : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop x A) y :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff (QuotSMulTop x A) y []).mp hpair.2).1
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    exact one_ne_zero (hpair.1.right_eq_zero_of_smul (by simp [hx]))
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hy
    let : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop x A) := hpair.2.nontrivial
    apply not_subsingleton (QuotSMulTop x A)
    constructor
    intro a b
    have ha : a = 0 := hyRegular.right_eq_zero_of_smul (by simp [hy])
    have hb : b = 0 := hyRegular.right_eq_zero_of_smul (by simp [hy])
    exact ha.trans hb.symm
  refine ⟨hx, hy, ?_⟩
  intro d hdx hdy
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hdx
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hdy
  have hya : y • a ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule A A) := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨b, Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    calc
      x * b = (d * a) * b := by rw [ha]
      _ = (d * b) * a := by ac_rfl
      _ = y * a := by rw [← hb]
  have haMem : a ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule A A) :=
    (isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem
      (x • (⊤ : Submodule A A)) y).mp hyRegular a hya
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ :=
    (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).mp haMem
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hc
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha0
    apply hx
    rw [ha, ha0, mul_zero]
  have hdc : d * c = 1 := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha0
    calc
      a * (d * c) = (d * a) * c := by ac_rfl
      _ = x * c := by rw [← ha]
      _ = a := hc
      _ = a * 1 := (mul_one a).symm
  exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one c hdc

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_free_of_regular_pair
statement:
theorem integralClosure_free_of_regular_pair
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)]
    {x y : A} (hregular : IsRegular A [x, y])
    (hspan : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal A) :
    Module.Free A (integralClosure A L)
proof:
:= by
  let B := integralClosure A L
  obtain ⟨hx, -, -⟩ := regular_pair_nonzero_and_isRelPrime hregular
  have hxL : algebraMap A L x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hxL
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L] at hxL
    have hxK : algebraMap A K x = 0 := by
      apply (algebraMap K L).injective
      simpa using hxL
    apply hx
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    simpa using hxK
  have hxB : algebraMap A B x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hxB
    apply hxL
    simpa [B] using congrArg (fun b : B => (b : L)) hxB
  have hxRegularB : IsSMulRegular B x := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro b hb
    have hmul : algebraMap A B x * b = 0 := by
      simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using hb
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hxB
  have hyRegularB : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop x B) y :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSMulRegular_quotSMulTop_integralClosure_of_isRegular
      (K := K) hregular
  have hweak : IsWeaklyRegular B [x, y] := by
    apply (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff B x [y]).mpr
    refine ⟨hxRegularB, ?_⟩
    exact (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff (QuotSMulTop x B) y).mpr hyRegularB
  have hmem : ∀ r ∈ [x, y], r ∈ maximalIdeal A := by
    intro r hr
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simpa using hr)
  have hregularB : IsRegular B [x, y] :=
    IsRegular.of_isWeaklyRegular_of_mem_maximalIdeal (L := B) hmem hweak
  exact module_free_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal x y hregularB hspan

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_flat_of_regular_pair
statement:
theorem integralClosure_flat_of_regular_pair
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)]
    {x y : A} (hregular : IsRegular A [x, y])
    (hspan : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal A) :
    Module.Flat A (integralClosure A L)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Free A (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosure_free_of_regular_pair (K := K) hregular hspan
  infer_instance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_isEtaleAt_bot_of_finite_separable
statement:
theorem integralClosure_isEtaleAt_bot_of_finite_separable
    {R : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field L] [Algebra R L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower R K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] :
    Algebra.IsEtaleAt R (⊥ : Ideal (integralClosure R L))
proof:
:= by
  let C := integralClosure R L
  let q : Ideal C := ⊥
  let D := Localization.AtPrime q
  let : q.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_bot
  let : IsFractionRing C L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension R K L C
  let : IsFractionRing C D := by
    simpa [D, q, Ideal.primeCompl_bot] using
      (Localization.isLocalization (M := q.primeCompl))
  let eC : D ≃ₐ[C] L :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv (nonZeroDivisors C) D L
  let eR : D ≃ₐ[R] L := eC.restrictScalars R
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale R K :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization (nonZeroDivisors R)
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale K L :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable K L
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale R L :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp R K L
  exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_equiv eR.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.exists_minimal_integralClosure_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_codim_ge_two
statement:
theorem
    exists_minimal_integralClosure_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_codim_ge_two
    {R : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field L] [Algebra R L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower R K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [Module.Finite R (integralClosure R L)]
    (hetale :
      ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
        ∀ (P : Ideal (integralClosure R L)) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p],
          Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P)
    (hne : ¬ Algebra.FormallyEtale R (integralClosure R L)) :
    ∃ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      Minimal
        (· ∈ Module.support R Ω[(integralClosure R L)⁄R] ∪
          Module.support R
            (Algebra.H1Cotangent R (integralClosure R L))) p ∧
      p.asIdeal.height ≠ 0 ∧ p.asIdeal.height ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, P, hPp, hP⟩ :=
    exists_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_not_formallyEtale hne
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact
      base_height_ne_zero_of_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_isEtaleAt_bot
        (integralClosure_isEtaleAt_bot_of_finite_separable
          (R := R) (K := K) (L := L)) p P hPp hP
  · exact
      base_height_ne_one_of_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_of_isEtaleAt_heightOne
        hetale p P hPp hP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.exists_minimal_integralClosure_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_height_two_le
statement:
theorem
    exists_minimal_integralClosure_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_height_two_le
    {R : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field L] [Algebra R L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower R K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [Module.Finite R (integralClosure R L)]
    (hetale :
      ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
        ∀ (P : Ideal (integralClosure R L)) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p],
          Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P)
    (hne : ¬ Algebra.FormallyEtale R (integralClosure R L)) :
    ∃ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      Minimal
        (· ∈ Module.support R Ω[(integralClosure R L)⁄R] ∪
          Module.support R
            (Algebra.H1Cotangent R (integralClosure R L))) p ∧
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ p.asIdeal.height
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0, hp1⟩ :=
    exists_minimal_integralClosure_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport_codim_ge_two
      (R := R) (K := K) (L := L) hetale hne
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  by_contra htwo
  have hle : p.asIdeal.height ≤ 1 :=
    ENat.lt_two_iff.mp (lt_of_not_ge htwo)
  rcases Order.le_one_iff.mp hle with hzero | hone
  · exact hp0 hzero
  · exact hp1 hone

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.localizedFiniteAlgebra_isEtaleAt_away_from_closedPoint_of_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport
statement:
theorem
    localizedFiniteAlgebra_isEtaleAt_away_from_closedPoint_of_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hp : Minimal
      (· ∈ Module.support R Ω[S⁄R] ∪
        Module.support R (Algebra.H1Cotangent R S)) p)
    (Q : PrimeSpectrum
      (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl)))
    (hQ :
      PrimeSpectrum.comap
          (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
            (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl))) Q ≠
        ⟨IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal), inferInstance⟩) :
    Algebra.IsEtaleAt (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) Q.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let Rₚ := Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal
  let Sₚ := Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl)
  let q : PrimeSpectrum Rₚ :=
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap Rₚ Sₚ) Q
  let closed : PrimeSpectrum Rₚ :=
    ⟨IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Rₚ, inferInstance⟩
  have hqne : q ≠ closed := hQ
  have hqle : q ≤ closed :=
    IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal q.isPrime.ne_top
  have hqunder_le : q.asIdeal.under R ≤ p.asIdeal := by
    calc
      q.asIdeal.under R ≤
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Rₚ).under R := Ideal.comap_mono hqle
      _ = p.asIdeal := Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal
  have hqunder_ne : q.asIdeal.under R ≠ p.asIdeal := by
    intro h
    have hmax : q.asIdeal = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Rₚ :=
      Localization.AtPrime.eq_maximalIdeal_iff_under_eq.mp h
    exact hqne (PrimeSpectrum.ext hmax)
  have hqunder_lt : q.asIdeal.under R < p.asIdeal :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne hqunder_le hqunder_ne
  let P : PrimeSpectrum S :=
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap S Sₚ) Q
  have hP_lt : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P < p := by
    change (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P).asIdeal < p.asIdeal
    rw [show (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P).asIdeal =
        q.asIdeal.under R by
      ext r
      simp only [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]
      change algebraMap S Sₚ (algebraMap R S r) ∈ Q.asIdeal ↔
        algebraMap Rₚ Sₚ (algebraMap R Rₚ r) ∈ Q.asIdeal
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S Sₚ,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Rₚ Sₚ]]
    exact hqunder_lt
  have hEtale : Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P.asIdeal :=
    isEtaleAt_of_comap_lt_minimal_base_nonEtaleCotangentSupport p hp P hP_lt
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale R (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) := hEtale
  let e : Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal ≃ₐ[S] Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal :=
    IsLocalization.localizationLocalizationAtPrimeIsoLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl) Q.asIdeal
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale R (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_equiv (e.restrictScalars R)
  exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.localization_base p.asIdeal.primeCompl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.free_of_free_quotSMulTop
statement:
private theorem free_of_free_quotSMulTop
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.FinitePresentation R M] {x : R}
    (hx : x ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R).jacobson) (hregular : IsSMulRegular M x)
    (hfree : Module.Free (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)) :
    Module.Free R M
proof:
:=
  (Module.free_quotSMulTop_iff_free R M hx hregular).mp hfree

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.module_free_of_isSMulRegular_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem module_free_of_isSMulRegular_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (x : R) (hregular : IsSMulRegular M x)
    (hspan : Ideal.span {x} = maximalIdeal R) :
    Module.Free R M
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.FinitePresentation R M := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R M
  have hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x
  apply free_of_free_quotSMulTop (R := R) (M := M) (x := x)
    (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R) hxMem) hregular
  let : (Ideal.span {x}).IsMaximal := hspan ▸ maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
  let : Field (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  exact Module.Free.of_divisionRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.module_free_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem module_free_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (x y : R) (hregular : IsRegular M [x, y])
    (hspan : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    Module.Free R M
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.FinitePresentation R M := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R M
  have hxy := (isRegular_cons_iff' M x [y]).mp hregular
  have hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  let R₁ := R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let M₁ := QuotSMulTop x M
  let y₁ : R₁ := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}) y
  have hxSpan_ne_top : Ideal.span ({x} : Set R) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top
      ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hxMem)
  let : Nontrivial R₁ := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hxSpan_ne_top
  let : IsLocalRing R₁ :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing R₁ :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R R₁ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : Module.Finite R₁ M₁ := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R R₁ M₁
  have hyRegular : IsSMulRegular M₁ y₁ :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff M₁ y₁ []).mp hxy.2).1
  have hspan₁ : Ideal.span {y₁} = maximalIdeal R₁ := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
      ← hspan, Ideal.map_ofList]
    simp [y₁]
    rfl
  apply free_of_free_quotSMulTop (R := R) (M := M) (x := x)
    (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R) hxMem) hxy.1
  exact module_free_of_isSMulRegular_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal y₁ hyRegular hspan₁

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.restrict_punctured_finiteEtale_bijective
statement:
theorem restrict_punctured_finiteEtale_bijective
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : 2 ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [IsFiniteEtale p] :
    Function.Bijective (X.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (show p ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsAffine X := isAffine_of_isAffineHom p
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian p
  let : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, ⊤) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩
  let : NoetherianSpace X := noetherianSpace_of_isAffine (X := X)
  let c : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ Γ(X, ⊤) := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ p.appTop
  let : Algebra R Γ(X, ⊤) := c.hom.toAlgebra
  let : Module.Flat R Γ(X, ⊤) :=
    (RingHom.Flat.of_bijective
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv)).comp
      p.flat_appTop
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxmem, hymem, hx, hy, hxy⟩ :=
    exists_primePair_of_isRegularLocalRing R hdim
  have hbasic {r : R} (hr : r ∈ maximalIdeal R) :
      X.basicOpen (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) r) ≤
        p ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R := by
    change X.basicOpen (p.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r)) ≤ _
    rw [← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top, basicOpen_eq_of_affine]
    apply Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono p
    intro q hq
    apply (Scheme.mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff R q).mpr
    intro hqclosed
    subst q
    exact hq hr
  apply restrict_bijective_of_primePair X hx hy hxy
    (p ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R)
    (NoetherianSpace.isCompact _) ?_ (hbasic hxmem) (hbasic hymem)
  intro A B _ _ _ _ _ _
  exact NoetherianSpace.isCompact _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIso_punctured_finiteEtale_inclusion_appTop
statement:
theorem isIso_punctured_finiteEtale_inclusion_appTop
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : 2 ≤ ringKrullDim R)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [IsFiniteEtale p] :
    IsIso (p ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R).ι.appTop
proof:
:= by
  let V := p ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R
  have hcomp : V.ι.appTop ≫ V.topIso.hom =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op := by
    change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE
      (show V.ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op ≫
      X.presheaf.map (eqToHom V.ι_image_top.symm).op = _
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    congr 1
  have hbij := restrict_punctured_finiteEtale_bijective R hdim p
  let : IsIso (V.ι.appTop ≫ V.topIso.hom) := by
    rw [hcomp, ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    exact hbij
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right V.ι.appTop V.topIso.hom

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regularSystem_of_ringKrullDim_eq
statement:
theorem exists_regularSystem_of_ringKrullDim_eq :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R],
      ringKrullDim R = (n : WithBot ℕ∞) →
      ∃ ps : List R, IsRegular R ps ∧
        Ideal.ofList ps = maximalIdeal R ∧ ps.length = n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro R _ _ hdim
      have hrank : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = 0 := by
        have h := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
        rw [hdim] at h
        exact_mod_cast h
      have hm : maximalIdeal R = ⊥ :=
        (Submodule.spanFinrank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot
          (maximalIdeal R).fg_of_isNoetherianRing).mp hrank
      exact ⟨[], IsRegular.nil R R, Ideal.ofList_nil.trans hm.symm, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro R _ _ hdim
      let : IsDomain R := IsRegularLocalRing.isDomain R
      obtain ⟨x, hxm, hxsq, hregular, hdimQ⟩ :=
        exists_parameter_with_regularLocalRing_quotient_ringKrullDim_eq n hdim
      let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)
      let S := R ⧸ I
      let : IsRegularLocalRing S := hregular
      obtain ⟨ys, hys, hgen, hlen⟩ := ih S hdimQ
      let q : R →+* S := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
      let : IsLocalHom q := IsLocalHom.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      obtain ⟨rs, hrs⟩ : ∃ rs : List R, rs.map q = ys :=
        List.map_surjective_iff.mpr Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective ys
      have hxne : x ≠ 0 := by
        intro hx
        apply hxsq
        rw [hx]
        exact (maximalIdeal R ^ 2).zero_mem
      have hxreg : IsSMulRegular R x := by
        apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
        intro a ha
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp ha).resolve_left hxne
      let e : QuotSMulTop x R ≃ₗ[S] S :=
        ((QuotSMulTop.equivQuotTensor x R).extendScalarsOfSurjective
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).trans
            ((TensorProduct.rid R S).extendScalarsOfSurjective
              Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)
      have hqreg : IsRegular (QuotSMulTop x R) (rs.map q) := by
        apply (e.isRegular_congr (rs.map q)).mpr
        rw [hrs]
        exact hys
      have hregularRs : IsRegular R (x :: rs) := IsRegular.cons' hxreg hqreg
      have hqx : q x = 0 := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
        (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x)
      have hmap : (Ideal.ofList (x :: rs)).map q = maximalIdeal S := by
        rw [Ideal.map_ofList, List.map_cons, hqx, Ideal.ofList_cons,
          Ideal.span_singleton_zero, bot_sup_eq, hrs, hgen]
      have hker : RingHom.ker q ≤ Ideal.ofList (x :: rs) := by
        change RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ≤ Ideal.ofList (x :: rs)
        rw [Ideal.mk_ker]
        exact (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem (Ideal.ofList (x :: rs))).mpr
          (Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_cons_self (a := x) (l := rs)))
      have hgenerate : Ideal.ofList (x :: rs) = maximalIdeal R := by
        calc
          Ideal.ofList (x :: rs) = Ideal.ofList (x :: rs) ⊔ RingHom.ker q :=
            (sup_eq_left.mpr hker).symm
          _ = ((Ideal.ofList (x :: rs)).map q).comap q :=
            (Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective _).symm
          _ = maximalIdeal R := by
            rw [hmap, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]
      have hlength : (x :: rs).length = n + 1 := by
        have h := congrArg List.length hrs
        rw [List.length_map, hlen] at h
        exact congrArg (fun k : ℕ => k + 1) h
      exact ⟨x :: rs, hregularRs, hgenerate, hlength⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regularSystem_of_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem exists_regularSystem_of_isRegularLocalRing
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R] :
    ∃ ps : List R, IsRegular R ps ∧ Ideal.ofList ps = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ps, hreg, hgen, _⟩ := exists_regularSystem_of_ringKrullDim_eq
    (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank R
    (IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)).symm
  exact ⟨ps, hreg, hgen⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_isRegularLocalRing
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (hdim : 2 ≤ ringKrullDim R) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity R
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed R := SchemeTheory.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing R
  obtain ⟨ps, hreg, hgen, hlen⟩ := exists_regularSystem_of_ringKrullDim_eq
    (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank R
    (IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)).symm
  have hlength : 2 ≤ ps.length := by
    rw [hlen]
    have h := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
    rw [← h] at hdim
    exact_mod_cast hdim
  exact hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_regularSystem_of_two_le_length ps hreg hgen hlength

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.maximalAdicCompletion_faithfullyFlat

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.maximalAdicCompletion_ringKrullDim_eq_of_isNoetherianRing
statement:
theorem maximalAdicCompletion_ringKrullDim_eq_of_isNoetherianRing
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)] :
    ringKrullDim (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) =
      ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  let Rhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R Rhat :=
    maximalAdicCompletion_faithfullyFlat R
  let p : Ideal R := maximalIdeal R
  let P : Ideal Rhat := maximalIdeal Rhat
  let : P.LiesOver p := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (algebraMap R Rhat)).symm
  have hheight : P.height = p.height := by
    have h :=
      Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown p P
    have hmap : p.map (algebraMap R Rhat) = P := by
      exact AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map.symm
    rw [hmap, Ideal.map_quotient_self, Ideal.height_bot, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hheight' :
      (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) = (p.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hheight
  calc
    ringKrullDim Rhat = P.height :=
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim.symm
    _ = p.height := hheight'
    _ = ringKrullDim R :=
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim

    _ = ringKrullDim R :=
      IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
    _ = ringKrullDim (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) :=
      (maximalAdicCompletion_ringKrullDim_eq_of_isNoetherianRing R).symm
    _ ≤ ringKrullDim (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R) := le_rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etale_of_dedekind_of_finite_torsionFree_of_isUnramifiedAt_all_maximalIdeals
statement:
theorem etale_of_dedekind_of_finite_torsionFree_of_isUnramifiedAt_all_maximalIdeals
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsDedekindDomain R] [Algebra R S]
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.IsTorsionFree R S]
    (hunramified : ∀ (P : Ideal S), [P.IsMaximal] → Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P) :
    Algebra.Etale R S
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.FinitePresentation R S :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R S
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation R S :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation R S
  rw [← Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_univ_iff_etale]
  apply Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr
  intro p
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hpP⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal p.asIdeal p.isPrime.ne_top
  let : P.IsPrime := hP.isPrime
  let : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P := hunramified P
  let : Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P :=
    Algebra.IsEtaleAt.of_isUnramifiedAt_of_flat (R := R) (S := S) P
  let q : PrimeSpectrum S := ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
  have hq : q ∈ Algebra.etaleLocus R S := by
    change Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P
    infer_instance
  exact Algebra.isOpen_etaleLocus.stableUnderGeneralization
    ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes p q).mp hpP) hq
