name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_of_not_mem_maximalIdeal_sq
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_of_not_mem_maximalIdeal_sq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    {x : R} (hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (hxSq : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let m : Ideal R := maximalIdeal R
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)
  let S := R ⧸ I
  have hIle : I ≤ m := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst y
    change x ∈ maximalIdeal R
    exact hxMem
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIle
  let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let x' : m := ⟨x, by simpa only [m] using hxMem⟩
  have hxCot : m.toCotangent x' ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    exact hxSq (by
      simpa only [m, x'] using (m.toCotangent_eq_zero x').mp hzero)
  let hs : LinearIndepOn (ResidueField R) id {m.toCotangent x'} :=
    ((linearIndepOn_singleton_iff (ResidueField R)).mpr hxCot)
  let b := Module.Basis.extend hs
  let ι := hs.extend (Set.subset_univ {m.toCotangent x'})
  let ix : ι :=
    ⟨m.toCotangent x', hs.subset_extend _ (Set.mem_singleton _)⟩
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let restFinset : Finset ι := Finset.univ.erase ix
  let rest : Set ι := ↑restFinset
  let lift (i : ι) : m :=
    Classical.choose (m.toCotangent_surjective (b i))
  have hlift (i : ι) : m.toCotangent (lift i) = b i :=
    Classical.choose_spec (m.toCotangent_surjective (b i))
  have hbix : b ix = m.toCotangent x' := by
    simpa only [b, ix] using Module.Basis.extend_apply_self hs ix
  let lifts : Set m := lift '' rest
  have hcotangentImage :
      m.toCotangent '' (insert x' lifts) = Set.range b := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with rfl | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      · refine ⟨ix, ?_⟩
        exact hbix
      · refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
        exact (hlift i).symm
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      by_cases hi : i = ix
      · subst i
        refine ⟨x', Set.mem_insert _ _, ?_⟩
        exact hbix.symm
      · have hLiftMem : lift i ∈ lifts := by
          have hiRest : i ∈ rest := by
            change i ∈ Finset.univ.erase ix
            exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hi, Finset.mem_univ i⟩
          exact ⟨i, hiRest, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨lift i, Or.inr hLiftMem, hlift i⟩
  have hcotangentSpan :
      Submodule.span (ResidueField R)
          (m.toCotangent '' (insert x' lifts)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hcotangentImage]
    exact b.span_eq
  have hliftsSpan : Submodule.span R (insert x' lifts) = ⊤ :=
    (CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff (R := R)).mp hcotangentSpan
  let liftValues : Set R := m.subtype '' lifts
  have hspanR : Ideal.span (insert x liftValues) = m := by
    change Submodule.span R (insert x liftValues) = m
    calc
      Submodule.span R (insert x liftValues) =
          (Submodule.span R (insert x' lifts)).map m.subtype := by
        rw [Submodule.map_span]
        congr 1
        ext y
        simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_insert_iff, liftValues]
        constructor
        · rintro (rfl | ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩)
          · exact ⟨x', Or.inl rfl, rfl⟩
          · exact ⟨z, Or.inr hz, rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨z, rfl | hz, rfl⟩
          · exact Or.inl rfl
          · exact Or.inr ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      _ = (⊤ : Submodule R m).map m.subtype := by rw [hliftsSpan]
      _ = m := by rw [Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  let q : R →+* S := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hqx : q x = 0 := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x
  have hspanS : Ideal.span (q '' liftValues) = maximalIdeal S := by
    calc
      Ideal.span (q '' liftValues) =
          Ideal.span (insert (q x) (q '' liftValues)) := by simp only [hqx, Ideal.span_insert_zero]
      _ = Ideal.span (q '' (insert x liftValues)) := by rw [Set.image_insert_eq]
      _ = (Ideal.span (insert x liftValues)).map q := by
        rw [Ideal.map_span]
      _ = m.map q := by rw [hspanR]
      _ = maximalIdeal S :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective q
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hliftValuesFinite : liftValues.Finite := by
    exact (Set.toFinite rest).image lift |>.image m.subtype
  have hquotientGeneratorsFinite : (q '' liftValues).Finite :=
    hliftValuesFinite.image q
  have hspanFinrankS :
      (maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank ≤ rest.ncard := by
    rw [← hspanS]
    refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite
      hquotientGeneratorsFinite).trans ?_
    refine (Set.ncard_image_le (f := q) hliftValuesFinite).trans ?_
    refine (Set.ncard_image_le (f := m.subtype)
      ((Set.toFinite rest).image lift)).trans ?_
    exact Set.ncard_image_le (f := lift) (Set.toFinite rest)
  have hrestCard : rest.ncard + 1 = Fintype.card ι := by
    simpa only [rest, restFinset, Set.ncard_coe_finset,
      Finset.card_univ] using
      (Finset.card_erase_add_one (s := (Finset.univ : Finset ι))
        (a := ix) (Finset.mem_univ ix))
  have hindexCard : Fintype.card ι =
      Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) := by
    exact (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b).symm
  have hspanFinrankSucc :
      (maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank + 1 ≤ (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank := by
    calc
      (maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank + 1 ≤ rest.ncard + 1 :=
        Nat.add_le_add_right hspanFinrankS 1
      _ = Fintype.card ι := hrestCard
      _ = Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) := by
        exact hindexCard
      _ = (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank :=
        (spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace R).symm
  have hxNe : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    apply hxSq
    simp only [hx, zero_mem]
  have hxRegular : IsSMulRegular R x := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro a ha
    have hxa : x * a = 0 := by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using ha
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hxa).resolve_left hxNe
  have hdimSucc : ringKrullDim S + 1 = ringKrullDim R := by
    simpa only [S, I] using
      ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim
        hxRegular hxMem
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  apply (ENat.WithBot.add_le_add_natCast_right_iff (c := 1)).mp
  have hcast :
      (((maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    exact_mod_cast hspanFinrankSucc
  calc
    ((maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 =
        (((maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      norm_num
    _ ≤ ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) := hcast
    _ = ringKrullDim R := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
    _ = ringKrullDim S + 1 := hdimSucc.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_parameter_with_regularLocalRing_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_parameter_with_regularLocalRing_quotient
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ x : R, x ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  let m : Ideal R := maximalIdeal R
  have hfin :
      0 < Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) := by
    have hreg :=
      (IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace R).mp
        (inferInstance : IsRegularLocalRing R)
    rw [← hreg] at hdim
    exact_mod_cast hdim
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
    Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp hfin
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := m.toCotangent_surjective z
  let x : R := x'
  have hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := x'.property
  have hxSq : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 := by
    intro hxSquare
    apply hz
    rw [← hx']
    exact (m.toCotangent_eq_zero x').mpr (by
      simpa only [m, x] using hxSquare)
  exact ⟨x, hxMem, hxSq,
    isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_of_not_mem_maximalIdeal_sq
      hxMem hxSq⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_parameter_with_regularLocalRing_quotient_ringKrullDim_eq
statement:
theorem exists_parameter_with_regularLocalRing_quotient_ringKrullDim_eq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (n : ℕ)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ x : R, x ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)) ∧
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)) =
        (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hpositive : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R := by
    rw [hdim]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_left 1 n
  obtain ⟨x, hxMem, hxSq, hregularQuotient⟩ :=
    exists_parameter_with_regularLocalRing_quotient hpositive
  have hxNe : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    apply hxSq
    simp only [hx, zero_mem]
  have hxRegular : IsSMulRegular R x := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro a ha
    have hxa : x * a = 0 := by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using ha
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hxa).resolve_left hxNe
  have hdimSucc :
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)) + 1 =
        ringKrullDim R :=
    ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim
      hxRegular hxMem
  have hdimQuotient :
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)) =
        (n : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    apply ENat.WithBot.add_one_cancel.mp
    calc
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)) + 1 =
          ringKrullDim R := hdimSucc
      _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := hdim
      _ = (n : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 := by norm_num
  exact ⟨x, hxMem, hxSq, hregularQuotient, hdimQuotient⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_parameter_with_regularLocalRing_quotient_of_three_le_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem exists_parameter_with_regularLocalRing_quotient_of_three_le_ringKrullDim
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : (3 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ x : R, x ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 ∧
      IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)) ∧
      (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  let d : ℕ := (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank
  have hregularDimension : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R := by
    exact IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
  have hthree : 3 ≤ d := by
    rw [← hregularDimension] at hdim
    exact_mod_cast hdim
  let n : ℕ := d - 1
  have hd : d = n + 1 := by
    dsimp only [n]
    omega
  have hdimSuccessor :
      ringKrullDim R = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← hregularDimension, hd]
  obtain ⟨x, hxMem, hxSq, hregularQuotient, hdimQuotient⟩ :=
    exists_parameter_with_regularLocalRing_quotient_ringKrullDim_eq
      n hdimSuccessor
  have hn : 2 ≤ n := by
    dsimp only [n]
    omega
  refine ⟨x, hxMem, hxSq, hregularQuotient, ?_⟩
  rw [hdimQuotient]
  exact_mod_cast hn

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.hasPuncturedPurity_of_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem hasPuncturedPurity_of_isRegularLocalRing
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : 2 ≤ ringKrullDim R) : FiniteEtale.HasPuncturedPurity R
proof:
:= by
  let C := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let : IsRegularLocalRing C := maximalAdicCompletion_isRegularLocalRing R
  let : IsDomain C := IsRegularLocalRing.isDomain C
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R C := maximalAdicCompletion_faithfullyFlat R
  have hdimC : 2 ≤ ringKrullDim C := by
    rw [maximalAdicCompletion_ringKrullDim_eq R]
    exact hdim
  have hpure := hasPuncturedPurity_of_complete_isRegularLocalRing C hdimC
  apply (FiniteEtale.hasPuncturedPurity_iff R).mpr
  intro Y
  let f : Y.left ⟶ Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R := Y.hom
  let : IsFiniteEtale f := Y.prop
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C) := by
    dsimp only [Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion]
    infer_instance
  let : NoetherianSpace (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R) :=
    (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R).ι.isOpenEmbedding.isEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
  let g : Spec (.of C) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C))
  let h : Scheme.puncturedSpectrum C ⟶ Scheme.puncturedSpectrum R :=
    maximalAdicCompletionPuncturedSpectrumMorphism R
  have hg : Flat g ∧ Surjective g :=
    (flat_and_surjective_SpecMap_iff
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C))).mpr
      ((RingHom.faithfullyFlat_algebraMap_iff (R := R) (S := C)).mpr inferInstance)
  let : Flat g := hg.1
  let : Surjective g := hg.2
  let : CompactSpace Y.left :=
    (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace f).mp inferInstance
  obtain ⟨V, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_maximalAdicCompletion_extension_of_hasPuncturedPurity R hpure Y
  let p : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of C) := V.hom
  let : IsFiniteEtale p := V.prop
  let eY : pullback p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C) ≅
      pullback f h :=
    ((FiniteEtale.forget (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum C)) ⋙
      Over.forget (Scheme.puncturedSpectrum C)).mapIso e
  have heY : eY.inv ≫ pullback.snd p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C) =
      pullback.snd f h := e.inv.hom.w
  have hb : IsPullback (pullback.fst f h)
      (pullback.snd f h ≫ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C)
      (f ≫ (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R).ι) g :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f h).paste_vert
      (maximalAdicCompletionPuncturedSpectrumMorphism_isPullback R)
  let eP := hb.isoPullback
  let j : pullback (f ≫ (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R).ι) g ⟶ V.left :=
    eP.inv ≫ eY.inv ≫ pullback.fst p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C)
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := inferInstanceAs
    (IsOpenImmersion (eP.inv ≫ eY.inv ≫
      pullback.fst p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C)))
  let : IsIso (p ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen C).ι.appTop :=
    isIso_punctured_finiteEtale_inclusion_appTop C hdimC p
  let eOpen := pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen C)
  let : IsIso eY.inv.appTop := Scheme.Γ.map_isIso eY.inv.op
  let : IsIso eP.inv.appTop := Scheme.Γ.map_isIso eP.inv.op
  have heOpen : (pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict p
      (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen C)).hom ≫
        (p ⁻¹ᵁ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen C).ι =
      pullback.fst p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C) :=
    pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict_hom_ι p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen C)
  let : IsIso (pullback.fst p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C)).appTop := by
    rw [← heOpen, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    exact IsIso.comp_isIso'
      (isIso_punctured_finiteEtale_inclusion_appTop C hdimC p)
      (Scheme.Γ.map_isIso eOpen.hom.op)
  let : IsIso j.appTop := by
    dsimp only [j]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    infer_instance
  have hj : j ≫ p = pullback.snd
      (f ≫ (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R).ι) g := by
    calc
      j ≫ p = eP.inv ≫ eY.inv ≫
          (pullback.fst p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C) ≫ p) := by
        simp only [j, Category.assoc]
      _ = eP.inv ≫ eY.inv ≫
          (pullback.snd p (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C) ≫
            Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C) := by rw [pullback.condition]
      _ = eP.inv ≫
          (pullback.snd f h ≫ Scheme.puncturedSpectrumInclusion C) := by
        rw [← Category.assoc eY.inv, heY]
      _ = _ := hb.isoPullback_inv_snd
  obtain ⟨Z, ⟨eZ⟩⟩ := exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_flat_baseChange
    (Scheme.puncturedSpectrumOpen R) f g p j hj
  exact ⟨Z, ⟨eZ⟩⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Purity.isAdicComplete_of_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_of_le_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R)
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) M] :
    IsAdicComplete I M
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { toIsHausdorff :=
        IsHausdorff.of_le_jacobson I M
          (hI.trans (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R)))
      toIsPrecomplete := ?_ }
  refine ⟨fun f hf ↦ ?_⟩
  have hfMaximal :
      ∀ {m n : ℕ}, m ≤ n →
        f m ≡ f n
          [SMOD ((maximalIdeal R) ^ m • ⊤ : Submodule R M)] := by
    intro m n hmn
    exact SModEq.mono
      (Submodule.smul_mono (Ideal.pow_right_mono hI m) le_rfl)
      (hf hmn)
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ :=
    IsPrecomplete.prec
      (inferInstance : IsPrecomplete (maximalIdeal R) M) hfMaximal
  refine ⟨L, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  let N : Submodule R M := I ^ n • ⊤
  let Q := M ⧸ N
  let q : M →ₗ[R] Q := N.mkQ
  let : Module.Finite R Q := Module.Finite.quotient R N
  have hq : q (f n) = q L := by
    rw [IsHausdorff.eq_iff_smodEq (I := maximalIdeal R)]
    intro k
    let t := max n k
    have hnt : n ≤ t := Nat.le_max_left n k
    have hkt : k ≤ t := Nat.le_max_right n k
    have hfnft : q (f n) = q (f t) := by
      change Submodule.Quotient.mk (f n) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (f t)
      exact hf hnt
    rw [hfnft]
    have htail :
        f t ≡ L
          [SMOD ((maximalIdeal R) ^ k • ⊤ : Submodule R M)] :=
      SModEq.mono (Submodule.pow_smul_top_le (maximalIdeal R) M hkt) (hL t)
    have hmapped := htail.map q
    simpa only [q, Q, Submodule.map_smul'', Submodule.map_top,
      LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (Submodule.mkQ_surjective N)] using hmapped
  change Submodule.Quotient.mk (f n) = Submodule.Quotient.mk L
  exact hq

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.residueField_map_bijective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem residueField_map_bijective_of_surjective
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom f] (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Bijective (ResidueField.map f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(ResidueField.map f).injective, ?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective y
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hf s
  exact ⟨residue R r, ResidueField.map_residue f r⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocalHom_algebraMap_of_moduleFinite_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem isLocalHom_algebraMap_of_moduleFinite_of_isLocalRing
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] [Module.Finite R S] :
    IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R S
  have hcomapMaximal :
      ((maximalIdeal S).comap (algebraMap R S)).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R S)
      (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) (maximalIdeal S)
  have hcomap :
      (maximalIdeal S).comap (algebraMap R S) = maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hcomapMaximal
  exact ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE (algebraMap R S)).out 5 1).mp hcomap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_finiteEtaleLocal_lift_of_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtaleLocal_lift_of_quotient
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R)
    {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra (R ⧸ I) D]
    [IsLocalRing D] [Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) D]
    [Algebra.Etale (R ⧸ I) D] :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra R C)
      (_ : Module.Finite R C) (_ : Algebra.Etale R C),
      Nonempty (((R ⧸ I) ⊗[R] C) ≃ₐ[R ⧸ I] D)
proof:
:= by
  let B := R ⧸ I
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI
  let : Nontrivial B := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing B :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R B) :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : Algebra R D :=
    ((algebraMap B D).comp (algebraMap R B)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R B D :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
    isLocalHom_algebraMap_of_moduleFinite_of_isLocalRing
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R D) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R B D]
    infer_instance
  have hmaximal :
      (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R B) = maximalIdeal B :=
    IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal B) B := by
    rw [← hmaximal]
    exact isAdicComplete_map_maximalIdeal_quotient I
  have hresidue : Function.Bijective
      (ResidueField.map (algebraMap R B)) :=
    residueField_map_bijective_of_surjective
      (algebraMap R B) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  exact exists_finiteEtaleResidueLift_of_residue_bijective
    (R := R) (B := B) (D := D) hresidue

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isAdicComplete_map_maximalIdeal_quotient
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_map_maximalIdeal_quotient
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R] (I : Ideal R) :
    IsAdicComplete
      ((maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I))) (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomplete : IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) (R ⧸ I) :=
    isAdicComplete_of_moduleFinite (I := maximalIdeal R) (M := R ⧸ I)
  exact (IsAdicComplete.map_algebraMap_iff
    (S := R ⧸ I) (maximalIdeal R) (R ⧸ I)).2 hcomplete

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.henselianLocalRing_quotient_of_isAdicComplete
statement:
theorem henselianLocalRing_quotient_of_isAdicComplete
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) :
    HenselianLocalRing (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI
  let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmaximal :
      (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I)) =
        maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) := by
    exact IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)) (R ⧸ I) := by
    rw [← hmaximal]
    exact isAdicComplete_map_maximalIdeal_quotient I
  let : HenselianRing (R ⧸ I) (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)) :=
    inferInstance
  refine { is_henselian := ?_ }
  intro f hf x hx hderivative
  exact HenselianRing.is_henselian f hf x hx
    (hderivative.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I))))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.primePair_of_regularSystem_cons_cons
statement:
theorem primePair_of_regularSystem_cons_cons
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R} {ps : List R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R (x :: y :: ps))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (x :: y :: ps) = maximalIdeal R) :
    Prime x ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ x ∣ y
proof:
:= by
  have hx : Prime x := Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen
    (List.mem_cons_self (a := x) (l := y :: ps))
  have hy : Prime y := Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen
    (List.mem_cons_of_mem x (List.mem_cons_self (a := y) (l := ps)))
  refine ⟨hx, hy.ne_zero, ?_⟩
  intro hxy
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {x}
  let S := R ⧸ I
  have hI : I ≠ ⊤ := by
    change Ideal.span ({x} : Set R) ≠ ⊤
    intro htop
    exact hx.not_isUnit ((Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top (x := x)).mp htop)
  let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hI
  have hquot := (Kummer.regularSystem_quotientHead hreg hgen).1
  have hregular : IsSMulRegular S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I y) :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I y)
      (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).mp hquot).1
  have hyzero : Ideal.Quotient.mk I y = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr hxy)
  apply one_ne_zero (α := S)
  apply hregular.right_eq_zero_of_smul
  rw [hyzero, zero_smul]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_primePair_of_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem exists_primePair_of_isRegularLocalRing
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : 2 ≤ ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ x y : R, x ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ y ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧
      Prime x ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ x ∣ y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ps, hreg, hgen, hlen⟩ := exists_regularSystem_of_ringKrullDim_eq
    (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank R
    (IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)).symm
  have hlength : 2 ≤ ps.length := by
    rw [hlen]
    have h := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
    rw [← h] at hdim
    exact_mod_cast hdim
  cases ps with
  | nil => simp only [List.length_nil] at hlength; omega
  | cons x ps =>
      cases ps with
      | nil => simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hlength; omega
      | cons y ps =>
          refine ⟨x, y, ?_, ?_, primePair_of_regularSystem_cons_cons hreg hgen⟩
          · rw [← hgen]
            exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_cons_self (a := x) (l := y :: ps))
          · rw [← hgen]
            exact Ideal.subset_span
              (List.mem_cons_of_mem x (List.mem_cons_self (a := y) (l := ps)))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.exists_height_one_prime_containing_of_nonzero_nonunit
statement:
theorem exists_height_one_prime_containing_of_nonzero_nonunit
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {d : A} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hdu : ¬ IsUnit d) :
    ∃ p : Ideal A, p.IsPrime ∧ p.height = 1 ∧ d ∈ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpMin⟩ :=
    (Ideal.span ({d} : Set A)).nonempty_minimalPrimes (by simpa)
  have hpNe : p ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hp
    apply hd
    apply Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp
    exact bot_unique (hpMin.le.trans_eq hp)
  have hpHeight : p.height = 1 := by
    let : p.IsPrime := hpMin.isPrime
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes
        (Ideal.span ({d} : Set A)) p hpMin
    · exact (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
        (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.not.mpr hpNe))
  exact ⟨p, hpMin.isPrime, hpHeight,
    hpMin.le (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self d)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.isUnit_of_isUnit_localizationAtPrime_height_one
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_isUnit_localizationAtPrime_height_one
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {d : A} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hlocal : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
      IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p) d)) :
    IsUnit d
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hdu
  obtain ⟨p, hpPrime, hpHeight, hdMem⟩ :=
    exists_height_one_prime_containing_of_nonzero_nonunit hd hdu
  let : p.IsPrime := hpPrime
  have hdUnit := hlocal p hpHeight
  have hdLocalMem : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p) d ∈
      maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p) :=
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff
      (Localization.AtPrime p) p d).mpr hdMem
  have hdNotUnit : ¬ IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p) d) := by
    simpa only [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] using hdLocalMem
  exact hdNotUnit hdUnit

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.exists_height_one_prime_of_regular_pair
statement:
theorem exists_height_one_prime_of_regular_pair
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A]
    {x y : A} (hregular : IsRegular A [x, y])
    (hspan : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal A) :
    ∃ p : Ideal A, p.IsPrime ∧ p.height = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hxRegular : IsSMulRegular A x :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff A x [y]).mp hregular).1
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    exact one_ne_zero (hxRegular.right_eq_zero_of_smul (by simp [hx]))
  have hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal A := by
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  have hxNotUnit : ¬ IsUnit x := by
    simpa only [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] using hxMem
  obtain ⟨p, hpPrime, hpHeight, -⟩ :=
    exists_height_one_prime_containing_of_nonzero_nonunit hx hxNotUnit
  exact ⟨p, hpPrime, hpHeight⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.etale_of_exists_height_one_prime_of_etale_localizationAtPrime
statement:
theorem etale_of_exists_height_one_prime_of_etale_localizationAtPrime
    {A : Type u} {S : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra A S] [Module.Free A S] [Module.Finite A S]
    (hexists : ∃ p : Ideal A, p.IsPrime ∧ p.height = 1)
    (hlocal : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl))) :
    Algebra.Etale A S
proof:
:= by
  let ι := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex A S
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let : DecidableEq ι := Classical.decEq ι
  let b : Basis ι A S := Module.Free.chooseBasis A S
  let d : A := Algebra.discr A b
  have hdiscrLocal : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
      IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p) d) := by
    intro p _ hpHeight
    let Aₚ := Localization.AtPrime p
    let Sₚ := Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl)
    let : Algebra.Etale Aₚ Sₚ := hlocal p hpHeight
    let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified Aₚ Sₚ := inferInstance
    let bₚ : Basis ι Aₚ Sₚ :=
      b.localizationLocalization Aₚ p.primeCompl Sₚ
    have hunit : IsUnit (Algebra.discr Aₚ bₚ) :=
      (EtaleFundamentalGroups.formallyUnramified_iff_isUnit_discr bₚ).mp inferInstance
    rw [Algebra.discr_localizationLocalization A p.primeCompl Sₚ b] at hunit
    exact hunit
  obtain ⟨p, hpPrime, hpHeight⟩ := hexists
  let : p.IsPrime := hpPrime
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hd
    have hunit := hdiscrLocal p hpHeight
    rw [hd, map_zero] at hunit
    exact not_isUnit_zero hunit
  have hunit : IsUnit d :=
    isUnit_of_isUnit_localizationAtPrime_height_one hd hdiscrLocal
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified A S :=
    (EtaleFundamentalGroups.formallyUnramified_iff_isUnit_discr b).mpr hunit
  let : Module.FinitePresentation A S :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_projective A S
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation A S := inferInstance
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.etale_of_regular_pair_of_etale_localizationAtPrime
statement:
theorem etale_of_regular_pair_of_etale_localizationAtPrime
    {A : Type u} {S : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra A S] [Module.Free A S] [Module.Finite A S]
    {x y : A} (hregular : IsRegular A [x, y])
    (hspan : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal A)
    (hlocal : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime], p.height = 1 →
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl))) :
    Algebra.Etale A S
proof:
:= by
  apply etale_of_exists_height_one_prime_of_etale_localizationAtPrime
    (exists_height_one_prime_of_regular_pair hregular hspan)
  exact hlocal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_etale_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularLocalRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hlocal : ∀ (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime], q.height = 1 →
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
          (integralClosure A L) q.primeCompl))) :
    Algebra.Etale A (integralClosure A L)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosure_finite_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      (K := K) hdim
  let : Module.Free A (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosure_free_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      (K := K) hdim
  have hfin :
      Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (CotangentSpace A) = 2 := by
    have hreg :=
      (IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace A).mp inferInstance
    rw [hdim] at hreg
    exact ENat.natCast_inj.mp (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hreg)
  obtain ⟨x, y, hregular, hspan⟩ :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two_unconstrained

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.mappedIdealQuotientEquiv_transitionMap
statement:
private theorem mappedIdealQuotientEquiv_transitionMap
    (I : Ideal R) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (x : S ⧸ (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R S)) :
    AdicCompletion.transitionMap (I.map (algebraMap R S)) S hmn
        (mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n x) =
      mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I m
        (AdicCompletion.transitionMap I S hmn x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.mappedIdealQuotientEquiv_symm_transitionMap
statement:
private theorem mappedIdealQuotientEquiv_symm_transitionMap
    (I : Ideal R) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (x : S ⧸ (((I.map (algebraMap R S)) ^ n : Ideal S) • ⊤ : Submodule S S)) :
    AdicCompletion.transitionMap I S hmn
        ((mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n).symm x) =
      (mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I m).symm
        (AdicCompletion.transitionMap (I.map (algebraMap R S)) S hmn x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I m).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,

    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedBaseToMappedIdealCompletion_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem completedBaseToMappedIdealCompletion_algebraMap
    (I : Ideal R) (r : R) :
    completedBaseToMappedIdealCompletion (S := S) I
        (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion I R) r) =
      algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap R S)) S) r
proof:
:= by
  apply AdicCompletion.ext
  intro n
  change mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n
      ((Algebra.linearMap R S).reduceModIdeal (I ^ n)
        ((algebraMap R (AdicCompletion I R) r).val n)) =
    (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap R S)) S) r).val n
  rw [AdicCompletion.algebraMap_apply, AdicCompletion.algebraMap_apply]
  change mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n
      ((Algebra.linearMap R S).reduceModIdeal (I ^ n)
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk
          (p := (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R R)) r)) =
    Submodule.Quotient.mk
      (p := (((I.map (algebraMap R S)) ^ n : Ideal S) • ⊤ : Submodule S S))
      (algebraMap R S r)
  rw [LinearMap.reduceModIdeal_apply, mappedIdealQuotientEquiv_mk]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.mappedIdealCompletionLinearEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem mappedIdealCompletionLinearEquiv_smul
    (r : AdicCompletion I R) (x : AdicCompletion I S) :
    mappedIdealCompletionLinearEquiv I (r • x) =
      r • mappedIdealCompletionLinearEquiv I x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  apply AdicCompletion.ext
  intro n
  change mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n (r.val n • x.val n) =
    mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n
        ((Algebra.linearMap R S).reduceModIdeal (I ^ n) (r.val n)) *
      mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n (x.val n)
  induction r.val n, x.val n using Quotient.inductionOn₂' with
  | _ r x =>
    change mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk
          (p := (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R S)) (r • x)) =
      mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n
          ((Algebra.linearMap R S).reduceModIdeal (I ^ n)
            (Submodule.Quotient.mk
              (p := (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R R)) r)) *
        mappedIdealQuotientEquiv I n
          (Submodule.Quotient.mk
            (p := (I ^ n • ⊤ : Submodule R S)) x)
    rw [LinearMap.reduceModIdeal_apply, mappedIdealQuotientEquiv_mk,
      mappedIdealQuotientEquiv_mk, mappedIdealQuotientEquiv_mk]
    simp [Algebra.smul_def]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProductToMappedIdealCompletionAlgHom_apply

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteFree_apply
statement:
private theorem ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteFree_apply
    [Module.Free R₀ S₀] [Module.Finite R₀ S₀]
    (z : AdicCompletion I R₀ ⊗[R₀] S₀) :
    ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteFree I z =
      AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct I S₀ z
proof:
:= by
  let ι := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R₀ S₀
  let b : Module.Basis ι R₀ S₀ := Module.Free.chooseBasis R₀ S₀
  change (AdicCompletion.congr I b.equivFun).symm
      (AdicCompletion.ofTensorProductEquivOfPiFintype I ι
        (AlgebraTensorModule.congr
          (LinearEquiv.refl (AdicCompletion I R₀) (AdicCompletion I R₀))
          b.equivFun z)) =
    AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct I S₀ z
  apply (AdicCompletion.congr I b.equivFun).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct I (ι → R₀)
      (AlgebraTensorModule.map LinearMap.id b.equivFun z) =
    AdicCompletion.map I b.equivFun
      (AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct I S₀ z)
  exact congrArg (fun f => f z)
    (AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct_naturality I b.equivFun.toLinearMap).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ofTensorProduct_bijective_of_finite_free
statement:
theorem ofTensorProduct_bijective_of_finite_free
    [Module.Free R₀ S₀] [Module.Finite R₀ S₀] :
    Function.Bijective (AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct I S₀)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply (ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteFree I).injective
    simpa only [ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteFree_apply] using hxy
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteFree I).surjective y
    exact ⟨x, (ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteFree_apply I x).symm⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProductToMappedIdealCompletionAlgHom_bijective_of_finite_free

      (tensorProductToMappedIdealCompletionAlgHom (S := S₀) I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (⇑(tensorProductToMappedIdealCompletionAlgHom (S := S₀) I) :
      (AdicCompletion I R₀ ⊗[R₀] S₀) →
        AdicCompletion (I.map (algebraMap R₀ S₀)) S₀) =
      fun z ↦ mappedIdealCompletionLinearEquiv I
        (AdicCompletion.ofTensorProduct I S₀ z) by
    funext z
    exact tensorProductToMappedIdealCompletionAlgHom_apply I z]
  exact (mappedIdealCompletionLinearEquiv I).bijective.comp
    (ofTensorProduct_bijective_of_finite_free I)

proof:
:= by
  change tensorProductMappedIdealCompletionFreeAlgEquiv I
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight x) = _
  rw [tensorProductMappedIdealCompletionFreeAlgEquiv_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
    tensorProductToMappedIdealCompletionAlgHom_tmul]
  simp [AdicCompletion.algebraMap_apply]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.powerQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem powerQuotientEquiv_mk
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (e n : ℕ) (r : R) :
    powerQuotientEquiv I e n (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (e * n)) r) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I ^ e) ^ n) r
proof:
:= by
  exact Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk R (pow_mul I e n) r

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.powerQuotientEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem powerQuotientEquiv_symm_mk
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (e n : ℕ) (r : R) :
    (powerQuotientEquiv I e n).symm
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I ^ e) ^ n) r) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (e * n)) r
proof:
:= by
  change
    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R (pow_mul I e n)).symm
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I ^ e) ^ n) r) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (e * n)) r
  rw [Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_symm]
  exact Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk R (pow_mul I e n).symm r

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.factorPow_mk
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem factorPow_mk
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (r : R) :
    Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I hmn
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) r) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ m) r
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.powerQuotientEquiv_factorPow
statement:
private theorem powerQuotientEquiv_factorPow
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (e : ℕ)
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (x : R ⧸ I ^ (e * n)) :
    Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (I ^ e) hmn
        (powerQuotientEquiv I e n x) =
      powerQuotientEquiv I e m
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_left e hmn) x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' x ?_
  intro r
  change
    Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (I ^ e) hmn
        (powerQuotientEquiv I e n
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (e * n)) r)) =
      powerQuotientEquiv I e m
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I (Nat.mul_le_mul_left e hmn)
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (e * n)) r))
  simp only [powerQuotientEquiv_mk, factorPow_mk]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.powerCofinalityExtend_restrict
statement:
private theorem powerCofinalityExtend_restrict
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e)
    (x : adicQuotientInverseLimit I) :
    powerCofinalityExtend I e he (powerCofinalityRestrict I e x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply adicQuotientInverseLimit_ext I
  intro n
  change
    Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n he)
        ((powerQuotientEquiv I e n).symm
          (powerQuotientEquiv I e n
            (adicQuotientInverseLimit_eval I (e * n) x))) =
      adicQuotientInverseLimit_eval I n x
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact adicQuotientInverseLimit_eval_factorPow I
    (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n he) x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.powerCofinalityRestrict_extend
statement:
private theorem powerCofinalityRestrict_extend
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e)
    (x : adicQuotientInverseLimit (I ^ e)) :
    powerCofinalityRestrict I e (powerCofinalityExtend I e he x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply adicQuotientInverseLimit_ext (I ^ e)
  intro n
  change
    powerQuotientEquiv I e n
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I
          (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left (e * n) he)
          ((powerQuotientEquiv I e (e * n)).symm
            (adicQuotientInverseLimit_eval (I ^ e) (e * n) x))) =
      adicQuotientInverseLimit_eval (I ^ e) n x
  rw [← adicQuotientInverseLimit_eval_factorPow (I ^ e)
    (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n he) x]
  refine Quotient.inductionOn'
    (adicQuotientInverseLimit_eval (I ^ e) (e * n) x) ?_
  intro r
  change
    powerQuotientEquiv I e n
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I
          (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left (e * n) he)
          ((powerQuotientEquiv I e (e * n)).symm
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I ^ e) ^ (e * n)) r))) =
      Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (I ^ e)
        (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n he)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((I ^ e) ^ (e * n)) r)
  simp only [powerQuotientEquiv_symm_mk, factorPow_mk,
    powerQuotientEquiv_mk]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.adicCompletionPowerRingEquiv_eval
statement:
theorem adicCompletionPowerRingEquiv_eval
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e)
    (x : AdicCompletion (I ^ e) R) (n : ℕ) :
    AdicCompletion.evalₐ I n (adicCompletionPowerRingEquiv I e he x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left n he)
        ((powerQuotientEquiv I e n).symm
          (AdicCompletion.evalₐ (I ^ e) n x))
proof:
:= by
  change
    AdicCompletion.evalₐ I n
        (adicQuotientInverseLimit_toCompletion I
          (powerCofinalityExtend I e he
            (adicCompletion_toQuotientInverseLimit (I ^ e) x))) = _
  rw [adicQuotientInverseLimit_toCompletion_eval]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_map_isMaximal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_map_isMaximal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R']
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R R')]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R R']
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsMaximal]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R'))) :
    let T
proof:
:= R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    (q.map (algebraMap S T)).IsMaximal := by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R S T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat S T :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
      (R := S) (M := S ⊗[R] R')
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight R S R').symm.toLinearEquiv
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  let q' := q.map (algebraMap S T)
  let g : S →+* T ⧸ q' :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk q').comp (algebraMap S T)
  have hpq : p.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ q := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact (q.over_def p).le
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective g := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul r' s =>
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hres.2 (IsLocalRing.residue R' r')
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective k
        let d : R' := r' - algebraMap R R' r
        have hdzero : IsLocalRing.residue R' d = 0 := by
          rw [map_sub,
            ← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue
              (algebraMap R R') r,
            hr, hk, sub_self]
        have hdmax : d ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R' :=
          (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff d).mp hdzero
        have hdpmap : d ∈ p.map (algebraMap R R') := by
          rw [hmax]
          exact hdmax
        have hdT : algebraMap R' T d ∈ q' := by
          have hdT' : algebraMap R' T d ∈
              (p.map (algebraMap R R')).map (algebraMap R' T) :=
            Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R' T) hdpmap
          have hpT : p.map (algebraMap R T) ≤ q' := by
            calc
              p.map (algebraMap R T) =
                  (p.map (algebraMap R S)).map (algebraMap S T) := by
                rw [Ideal.map_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S T]
              _ ≤ q.map (algebraMap S T) := Ideal.map_mono hpq
              _ = q' := rfl
          apply hpT
          simpa only [Ideal.map_map,
            IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R R' T] using hdT'
        have hdiff :
            r' ⊗ₜ[R] s -
                (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap R S r * s) : T) ∈ q' := by
          have hmul : algebraMap R' T d * algebraMap S T s ∈ q' :=
            q'.mul_mem_right (algebraMap S T s) hdT
          have hfirst :
              algebraMap R' T r' * algebraMap S T s =
                (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s : T) := by
            rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply,
              Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
          have hsecond :
              algebraMap R' T (algebraMap R R' r) *
                  algebraMap S T s =
                (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap R S r * s) : T) := by
            rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R R' T,
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S T,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]
          simpa only [d, map_sub, sub_mul, hfirst, hsecond] using hmul
        refine ⟨algebraMap R S r * s, ?_⟩
        apply Ideal.Quotient.eq.2
        change algebraMap S T (algebraMap R S r * s) -
          (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s : T) ∈ q'
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply, ← neg_sub]
        exact q'.neg_mem hdiff
    | add x y hx hy =>
        obtain ⟨sx, hsx⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨sy, hsy⟩ := hy
        refine ⟨sx + sy, ?_⟩
        change g (sx + sy) = Ideal.Quotient.mk q' (x + y)
        rw [map_add, map_add, hsx, hsy]
  have hker : RingHom.ker g = q := by
    ext s
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk q' (algebraMap S T s) = 0 ↔ s ∈ q
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    simpa [q'] using
      (show s ∈ (q.map (algebraMap S T)).comap
          (algebraMap S T) ↔ s ∈ q by
        rw [Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat])
  let : Field (S ⧸ q) := Ideal.Quotient.field q
  have hfieldKer : IsField (S ⧸ RingHom.ker g) := by
    rw [hker]
    exact Field.toIsField (S ⧸ q)
  have hfieldQuot : IsField (T ⧸ q') :=
    (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj).symm.toMulEquiv.isField
      hfieldKer
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient q').2
    hfieldQuot

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_map_liesOver_maximalIdeal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_map_liesOver_maximalIdeal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R']
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R R')]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R R']
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsMaximal]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R'))) :
    let T
proof:
:= R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    let q' := q.map (algebraMap S T)
    q'.IsMaximal ∧ q'.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R') := by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R S T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let : Algebra R' T := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R R' T := inferInstance
  let q' := q.map (algebraMap S T)
  have hqmax : q'.IsMaximal :=
    tensorProduct_map_isMaximal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
      (R := R) (R' := R') q hmax hres
  have hunder :
      q'.under R' =
        (q.under R).map (algebraMap R R') :=
    Ideal.under_map_eq_map_under
      (P := q)
      (by
        rw [← q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R), hmax]
        exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R')
      hqmax.ne_top
  refine ⟨hqmax, ?_⟩
  apply Ideal.LiesOver.mk
  rw [hunder, ← q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R), hmax]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.adicCompletion_tensorProduct_map_liesOver_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_tensorProduct_map_liesOver_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Algebra R S]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsMaximal]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)] :
    let R'
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R
    let T := R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    let q' := q.map (algebraMap S T)
    q'.IsMaximal ∧ q'.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R') := by
  let R' := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R R' :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  exact
    tensorProduct_map_liesOver_maximalIdeal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
      (R' := R') q AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map.symm
      (AdicCompletion.residueField_map_bijective R)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.adicCompletion_finiteEtale_closedPrime
statement:
theorem adicCompletion_finiteEtale_closedPrime
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S] [Algebra.Etale R S]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsMaximal]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)] :
    let R'
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R
    let T := R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra R' T := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    let q' := q.map (algebraMap S T)
    q'.IsMaximal ∧ q'.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R') ∧
      Module.Finite R' T ∧ Algebra.Etale R' T := by
  let R' := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let : Algebra R' T := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  have hq := adicCompletion_tensorProduct_map_liesOver_maximalIdeal
    (R := R) (S := S) q
  exact ⟨hq.1, hq.2, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [Module.Finite R S]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) → Q = q) :
    IsLocalRing S
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R S
  have hq_maximal : q.IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under (R := R) q <| by
      rw [← q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
      exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
  refine IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal ⟨q, hq_maximal, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQ_maximal
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQ_maximal.isPrime
  have hQ_under_maximal : (Q.under R).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R S)
      (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) Q
  have hQ_over : Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
    { over := (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hQ_under_maximal).symm }
  exact hunique Q inferInstance hQ_over

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal
statement:
theorem isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [Module.Finite R S]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) → Q = q) :
    letI : IsLocalRing S
proof:
:=
      isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
    IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S) := by
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R S := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R S
  have hq_maximal : q.IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under (R := R) q <| by
      rw [← q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
      exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
  have hq_eq : q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hq_maximal
  have hcomap :
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).comap (algebraMap R S) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hq_eq]
    exact (q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)).symm
  exact ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE (algebraMap R S)).out 5 1).mp hcomap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal
statement:
theorem faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [Module.Finite R S] [Algebra.Etale R S]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) → Q = q) :
    letI : IsLocalRing S
proof:
:=
      isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
    Module.FaithfullyFlat R S := by
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S) :=
    isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_baseChange_finiteEtaleResidueLift_algEquiv_of_residue_bijective
statement:
theorem exists_baseChange_finiteEtaleResidueLift_algEquiv_of_residue_bijective
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra B D] [Algebra R D] [IsScalarTower R B D]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing B] [IsLocalRing D]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R B)] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D)]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R D)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B]
    [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D]
    [FiniteDimensional (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D)]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D)]
    (hresidue : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R B))) :
    Nonempty ((B ⊗[R]
      FiniteEtaleResidueLift R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D)) ≃ₐ[B] D)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
  let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
  let : FiniteDimensional k l := inferInstanceAs <|
    FiniteDimensional (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D)
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k l := inferInstanceAs <|
    Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D)
  let pb : PowerBasis k l := finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l
  let f : R[X] := finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l
  let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift R l
  let X := B ⊗[R] C
  let : Module.Free R C :=
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_monic R l).free_adjoinRoot
  let : Module.Finite R C := moduleFinite_finiteEtaleResidueLift R l
  let : IsLocalRing C := isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift R l
  let : FaithfulSMul R C := faithfulSMul_finiteEtaleResidueLift R l
  let : Algebra.Etale R C := etale_finiteEtaleResidueLift R l
  let : Module.Free B D := Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  let : HenselianLocalRing D :=
    henselianLocalRing_of_finiteEtale_local_of_isAdicComplete
      (R := B) (S := D)
  let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB) hresidue
  have hgen_kB : Algebra.adjoin kB {pb.gen} = ⊤ := by
    have hgen_k : Algebra.adjoin k {pb.gen} = ⊤ := pb.adjoin_gen_eq_top
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.range_eq_top]
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.range_eq_top]
      at hgen_k
    intro y
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hgen_k y
    refine ⟨p.map (algebraMap k kB), ?_⟩
    rw [← hp, Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
  let g : D[X] := f.map (algebraMap R D)
  have hg_monic : g.Monic :=
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_monic R l).map (algebraMap R D)
  have haeval_base_change (p : R[X]) :
      aeval pb.gen (p.map (algebraMap R D)) =
        aeval pb.gen (p.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) := by
    have hD : aeval pb.gen p =
        aeval pb.gen (p.map (algebraMap R D)) :=
      Polynomial.aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := l) (T := D)
        (by ext x; exact IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_residue x)
        p pb.gen
    have hk : aeval pb.gen p =
        aeval pb.gen (p.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) :=
      Polynomial.aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := l) (T := k)
        (by ext x; exact IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_residue x)
        p pb.gen
    exact hD.symm.trans hk
  have hroot_residue : aeval pb.gen g = 0 := by
    change aeval pb.gen (f.map (algebraMap R D)) = 0
    rw [haeval_base_change]
    have hfmap : f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) = minpoly k pb.gen := by
      simpa [f, pb, k, l] using finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_map R l
    rw [hfmap]
    exact minpoly.aeval k pb.gen
  have hderivative_residue : aeval pb.gen g.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    change aeval pb.gen (f.map (algebraMap R D)).derivative ≠ 0
    rw [Polynomial.derivative_map, haeval_base_change]
    have hmapDerivative :
        f.derivative.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
          (minpoly k pb.gen).derivative := by
      simpa [Polynomial.derivative_map, f, pb, k, l] using
        congrArg Polynomial.derivative
          (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_map R l)
    rw [hmapDerivative]
    exact
      (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable k pb.gen).aeval_derivative_ne_zero
        (minpoly.aeval k pb.gen)
  have h_hensel := ((HenselianLocalRing.TFAE D).out 1 2).mp
    (inferInstance : HenselianLocalRing D)
  obtain ⟨t, ht_root, ht_residue⟩ :=
    h_hensel g hg_monic pb.gen hroot_residue hderivative_residue
  have ht_gen : Algebra.adjoin B {t} = ⊤ :=
    (IsLocalRing.adjoin_residue_eq_top_iff_adjoin_eq_top t).1 <| by
      simpa [ht_residue] using hgen_kB
  have ht_root_R : aeval t f = 0 := by
    simpa [g, aeval_def] using ht_root
  let φC : C →ₐ[R] D :=
    AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom f (Algebra.ofId R D) t ht_root_R
  let φR : X →ₐ[R] D :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift
      ((Algebra.ofId B D).restrictScalars R) φC
      (fun _ _ ↦ .all _ _)
  let φ : X →ₐ[B] D :=
    { φR.toRingHom with
      commutes' := by
        intro b
        simp [φR, X] }
  have hφ_root : φ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] AdjoinRoot.root f) = t := by
    simpa [φ, φR, φC, X, C] using
      (AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root f (Algebra.ofId R D) t ht_root_R)
  have hφ_surjective : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rw [← AlgHom.range_eq_top]
    apply top_unique
    rw [← ht_gen]
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst x
    exact ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[R] AdjoinRoot.root f, hφ_root⟩
  have hkB_finrank : Module.finrank k kB = 1 := by
    rw [← eResidue.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq, Module.finrank_self]
  have hresidue_finrank : Module.finrank k l = Module.finrank kB l := by
    have h := Module.finrank_mul_finrank k kB l
    rw [hkB_finrank, one_mul] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hfinrank : Module.finrank B X = Module.finrank B D := by
    calc
      Module.finrank B X = Module.finrank R C :=
        Module.finrank_baseChange
      _ = f.natDegree :=
        (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis'
          (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_monic R l)).finrank
      _ = (minpoly k pb.gen).natDegree :=
        finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_natDegree R l
      _ = pb.dim := pb.natDegree_minpoly
      _ = Module.finrank k l := pb.finrank.symm
      _ = Module.finrank kB l := hresidue_finrank
      _ = Module.finrank B D :=
        (IsLocalRing.finrank_eq_finrank_residueField
          (R := B) (S := D)).symm
  exact ⟨AlgEquiv.ofBijective φ <|
    OrzechProperty.bijective_of_surjective_of_finrank_le
      φ.toLinearMap hφ_surjective hfinrank.le⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_finiteEtaleResidueLift_of_residue_bijective
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtaleResidueLift_of_residue_bijective
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra B D] [Algebra R D] [IsScalarTower R B D]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing B] [IsLocalRing D]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R B)] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D)]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R D)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B]
    [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D]
    (hresidue : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R B))) :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra R C)
      (_ : Module.Finite R C) (_ : Algebra.Etale R C),
      Nonempty ((B ⊗[R] C) ≃ₐ[B] D)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
  let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
  let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB) hresidue
  let : Module.Finite k kB :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
  let : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
    AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k l :=
    Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
  let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift R l
  let : Module.Finite R C := moduleFinite_finiteEtaleResidueLift R l
  let : Algebra.Etale R C := etale_finiteEtaleResidueLift R l
  refine ⟨C, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  exact exists_baseChange_finiteEtaleResidueLift_algEquiv_of_residue_bijective
    (R := R) (B := B) (D := D) hresidue

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_baseChange_finiteEtaleResidueLift_algEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_baseChange_finiteEtaleResidueLift_algEquiv
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra B D] [Algebra R D] [IsScalarTower R B D]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing B] [IsLocalRing D]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R B)] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D)]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R D)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B]
    [Module.Finite R B] [FaithfulSMul R B]
    [Module.Finite B D] [FaithfulSMul B D] [Algebra.Etale B D]
    [FiniteDimensional (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D)]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D)]
    (hresidue : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R B))) :
    Nonempty ((B ⊗[R]
      FiniteEtaleResidueLift R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D)) ≃ₐ[B] D)
proof:
:=
  exists_baseChange_finiteEtaleResidueLift_algEquiv_of_residue_bijective
    hresidue

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_baseChange_chosenFactorAlgEquiv_iteratedRadical_of_fg
statement:
theorem exists_baseChange_chosenFactorAlgEquiv_iteratedRadical_of_fg
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    ∀ {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra B D]
      [Algebra A D] [IsScalarTower A B D]
      [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D],
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
        [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)],
        ∀ (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
          Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) → Q = q),
          letI : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
            faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
          letI : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
            Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
          letI : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
            isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg
              hmax n a hn ha
          letI : IsLocalRing D :=
            isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
            isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
            faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
            rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
            infer_instance
          let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
          let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
          let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
          let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
            AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
              (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a hn ha)
          letI : Module.Finite k kB :=
            Module.Finite.of_surjective eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
          letI : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
            AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k l :=
            Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
          Nonempty ((B ⊗[A] FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l) ≃ₐ[B] D) := by
  dsimp only
  intro D _ _ _ _ _ _ q _ _ hunique
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
  let : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
    isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg hmax n a hn ha
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
    isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
    faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
    infer_instance
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
  let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
  let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
  let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
      (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a hn ha)
  let : Module.Finite k kB :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
  let : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
    AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k l := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
  exact exists_baseChange_finiteEtaleResidueLift_algEquiv
    (R := A) (B := B) (D := D)
    (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a hn ha)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.exists_iteratedRadicalChosenFactorAlgEquiv_of_fg
statement:
theorem exists_iteratedRadicalChosenFactorAlgEquiv_of_fg
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).FG)
    {r : ℕ} (n : Fin r → ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let B
proof:
:= iteratedRadical A r n a
    letI : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
    ∀ {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra B D]
      [Algebra A D] [IsScalarTower A B D]
      [Module.Finite B D] [Algebra.Etale B D],
      ∀ (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
        [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)],
        ∀ (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
          Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) → Q = q),
          letI : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
            faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
          letI : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
            Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
          letI : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
            isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg
              hmax n a hn ha
          letI : IsLocalRing D :=
            isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
            isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
            faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
          letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
            rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
            infer_instance
          let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
          let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
          let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
          let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
            AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
              (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a hn ha)
          letI : Module.Finite k kB :=
            Module.Finite.of_surjective eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
          letI : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
            AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
          letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k l :=
            Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
          let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
          ∃ e : (B ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[B] D,
            letI : Algebra C D := tensorChosenFactorRightAlgebra e
            Nonempty
              (iteratedRadical C r n (fun i ↦ algebraMap A C (a i)) ≃ₐ[C] D) := by
  dsimp only
  intro D _ _ _ _ _ _ q _ _ hunique
  let B := iteratedRadical A r n a
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_iteratedRadical n a hn ha
  let : Module.Finite A B := finite_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A B :=
    faithfullyFlat_iteratedRadical n a hn
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A B
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A B) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isLocalHom A B
  let : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B :=
    isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_iteratedRadical_of_fg hmax n a hn ha
  let : IsLocalRing D :=
    isLocalRing_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
    isLocalHom_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B D :=
    faithfullyFlat_of_unique_prime_over_maximal q hunique
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A D) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B D]
    infer_instance
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
  let kB := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
  let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField D
  let eResidue : k ≃ₐ[k] kB :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId k kB)
      (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a hn ha)
  let : Module.Finite k kB :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eResidue.toLinearMap eResidue.surjective
  let : Module.Finite k l := Module.Finite.trans kB l
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k kB :=
    AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable eResidue
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable k l := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans k kB l
  let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift A l
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_baseChange_finiteEtaleResidueLift_algEquiv
    (R := A) (B := B) (D := D)
    (residueFieldMap_bijective_iteratedRadical n a hn ha)
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  let : Algebra C D := tensorChosenFactorRightAlgebra e
  exact ⟨iteratedRadicalChosenFactorAlgEquiv n a e⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_of_finiteEtale_local
statement:
theorem isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_of_finiteEtale_local
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R]
    [Module.Finite R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] [Algebra.Etale R S] :
    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) S
proof:
:= by
  have hcomplete : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) S :=
    isAdicComplete_of_moduleFinite
      (I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (M := S)
  have hm :
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal
  rw [← hm]
  exact (isAdicComplete_map_algebraMap_iff
    (R := R) (S := S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)).2 hcomplete

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.henselianLocalRing_of_finiteEtale_of_isAdicComplete
statement:
theorem henselianLocalRing_of_finiteEtale_of_isAdicComplete
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R]
    [Module.Finite R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] [Algebra.Etale R S] :
    HenselianLocalRing S
proof:
:= by
  let : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) S :=
    isAdicComplete_maximalIdeal_of_finiteEtale_local (R := R) (S := S)

  refine { is_henselian := ?_ }
