name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_finiteEtaleLocalAlgEquivOfResidueAlgEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtaleLocalAlgEquivOfResidueAlgEquiv
    {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] [IsLocalRing T]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R]
    [Module.Finite R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] [Algebra.Etale R S]
    [Module.Finite R T] [FaithfulSMul R T] [Algebra.Etale R T]
    (e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField S ≃ₐ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField R]
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField T) :
    Nonempty (S ≃ₐ[R] T)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Free R S := Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  let : Module.Free R T := Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  let : HenselianLocalRing T :=
    henselianLocalRing_of_finiteEtale_of_isAdicComplete (R := R) (S := T)
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := IsLocalRing.exists_adjoin_eq_top (R := R) (S := S)
  let f : R[X] := minpoly R β
  let g : T[X] := f.map (algebraMap R T)
  let β₀ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField S := IsLocalRing.residue S β
  let a₀ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField T := e β₀
  have hf_monic : f.Monic :=
    minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral β)
  have hg_monic : g.Monic := hf_monic.map (algebraMap R T)
  have hf_residue : f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
      minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) β₀ := by
    simpa [f, β₀] using
      IsLocalRing.minpoly_map_residue (R := R) (S := S) hβ
  have hroot_β₀ : aeval β₀ (f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) = 0 := by
    rw [hf_residue]
    exact minpoly.aeval _ _
  have haeval_e (p : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)[X]) :
      aeval a₀ p = e (aeval β₀ p) := by
    have hmap := Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
      (R := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (S := IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
      (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (U := IsLocalRing.ResidueField T)
      (φ := RingHom.id (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
      (ψ := e.toRingHom)
      (by ext r; exact (e.commutes r).symm) p β₀
    simpa [a₀] using hmap.symm
  have haeval_base_change (p : R[X]) :
      aeval a₀ (p.map (algebraMap R T)) =
        aeval a₀ (p.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) := by
    have hT : aeval a₀ p =
        aeval a₀ (p.map (algebraMap R T)) :=
      Polynomial.aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := IsLocalRing.ResidueField T) (T := T)
        (by ext x; exact IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_residue x)
        p a₀
    have hk : aeval a₀ p =
        aeval a₀ (p.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) :=
      Polynomial.aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := IsLocalRing.ResidueField T)
        (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (by ext x; rfl) p a₀
    exact hT.symm.trans hk
  have hroot_a₀_base : aeval a₀ (f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) = 0 := by
    rw [haeval_e, hroot_β₀, map_zero]
  have hroot_a₀ : aeval a₀ g = 0 := by
    change aeval a₀ (f.map (algebraMap R T)) = 0
    rw [haeval_base_change]
    exact hroot_a₀_base
  have hf_derivative_residue :
      aeval β₀ (f.derivative.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) ≠ 0 := by
    have hderivative_map :
        f.derivative.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
          (minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) β₀).derivative := by
      simpa [derivative_map] using
        congrArg Polynomial.derivative hf_residue
    rw [hderivative_map]
    exact
      (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) β₀).aeval_derivative_ne_zero
          (minpoly.aeval _ _)
  have hg_derivative_residue : aeval a₀ g.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hf_derivative_residue
    apply e.injective
    rw [map_zero, ← haeval_e]
    change aeval a₀ (f.map (algebraMap R T)).derivative = 0 at hzero
    rw [derivative_map, haeval_base_change] at hzero
    exact hzero
  have h_hensel := ((HenselianLocalRing.TFAE T).out 1 2).mp
    (inferInstance : HenselianLocalRing T)
  obtain ⟨t, ht_root, ht_residue⟩ :=
    h_hensel g hg_monic a₀ hroot_a₀ hg_derivative_residue
  have hβ₀_gen : Algebra.adjoin (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) {β₀} = ⊤ :=
    (IsLocalRing.adjoin_residue_eq_top_iff_adjoin_eq_top β).2 hβ
  have ha₀_gen : Algebra.adjoin (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) {a₀} = ⊤ := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.range_eq_top] at hβ₀_gen ⊢
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := e.surjective y
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hβ₀_gen x
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    rw [← hp]
    exact haeval_e p
  have ht_gen : Algebra.adjoin R {t} = ⊤ :=
    (IsLocalRing.adjoin_residue_eq_top_iff_adjoin_eq_top t).1 <| by
      simpa [ht_residue] using ha₀_gen
  let hS : IsAdjoinRootMonic S f :=
    IsAdjoinRootMonic.mkOfAdjoinEqTop' hβ
  have ht_root' : aeval t f = 0 := by
    simpa [g, aeval_def] using ht_root
  let φ : S →ₐ[R] T := hS.liftHom t ht_root'
  have hφ_surjective : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.range_eq_top] at ht_gen
    intro y
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ht_gen y
    refine ⟨hS.map p, ?_⟩
    simpa [φ] using hp
  have hfinrank : Module.finrank R S = Module.finrank R T := by
    rw [IsLocalRing.finrank_eq_finrank_residueField (R := R) (S := S),
      IsLocalRing.finrank_eq_finrank_residueField (R := R) (S := T)]
    exact e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
  exact ⟨AlgEquiv.ofBijective φ <|
    OrzechProperty.bijective_of_surjective_of_finrank_le
      φ.toLinearMap hφ_surjective hfinrank.le⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_monic_residue_polynomial_lift
statement:
private theorem exists_monic_residue_polynomial_lift :
    ∃ f : R[X],
      f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
          minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
            (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).gen ∧
        f.natDegree =
          (minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
            (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).gen).natDegree ∧
        f.Monic
proof:
:= by
  let p := minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).gen
  have hp : p.Monic :=
    minpoly.monic (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).isIntegral_gen
  apply Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic
  · rw [Polynomial.mem_lifts]
    exact Polynomial.map_surjective _ IsLocalRing.residue_surjective p
  · exact hp

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_map
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_map :
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l).map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
      minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).gen
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_monic_residue_polynomial_lift R l)).1

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_natDegree
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_natDegree :

      (minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).gen).natDegree
proof:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleResidueLiftSpecialFiberRingEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteEtaleResidueLiftSpecialFiberRingEquiv_mk (g : R[X]) :
    finiteEtaleResidueLiftSpecialFiberRingEquiv R l
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal R l)
          (AdjoinRoot.mk (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l) g)) =
      AdjoinRoot.mk
        ((finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l).map
          (IsLocalRing.residue R))
        (g.map (IsLocalRing.residue R))
proof:
:=
  AdjoinRoot.quotAdjoinRootEquivQuotPolynomialQuot_mk_of
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l) g

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal_isMaximal :
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal R l).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  let q := (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l).map
    (IsLocalRing.residue R)
  let : Fact (Irreducible q) := ⟨by
    change Irreducible
      ((finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l).map
        (IsLocalRing.residue R))
    rw [finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_map]
    exact minpoly.irreducible
      (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).isIntegral_gen⟩
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient]
  exact
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftSpecialFiberRingEquiv R l).toMulEquiv.isField
      (Field.toIsField (AdjoinRoot q))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift :
    IsLocalRing (FiniteEtaleResidueLift R l)
proof:
:= by
  let C := FiniteEtaleResidueLift R l
  let I := finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal R l
  let : Module.Finite R C :=
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_monic R l).finite_adjoinRoot
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R C := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R C
  refine IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal
    ⟨I, finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal_isMaximal R l, ?_⟩
  intro M hM
  let : M.IsMaximal := hM
  have hcomapMaximal :
      (M.comap (algebraMap R C)).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R C)
      (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) M
  have hcomap :
      M.comap (algebraMap R C) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hcomapMaximal
  have hI_le : I ≤ M := by
    change finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal R l ≤ M
    rw [finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    simpa [C, AdjoinRoot.algebraMap_eq] using hcomap.ge
  exact
    ((finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal_isMaximal R l).eq_of_le
      hM.ne_top hI_le).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.maximalIdeal_finiteEtaleResidueLift
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_finiteEtaleResidueLift
    [IsLocalRing (FiniteEtaleResidueLift R l)] :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (FiniteEtaleResidueLift R l) =
      finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal R l
proof:
:=
  (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal_isMaximal R l)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isUnit_aeval_derivative_finiteEtaleResidueLift
statement:
theorem isUnit_aeval_derivative_finiteEtaleResidueLift :
    let C
proof:
:= FiniteEtaleResidueLift R l
    letI : IsLocalRing C := isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift R l
    IsUnit (aeval
      (AdjoinRoot.root (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l))
      (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l).derivative) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial R l
  let p := minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).gen
  let : IsLocalRing (FiniteEtaleResidueLift R l) :=
    isLocalRing_finiteEtaleResidueLift R l
  have hp_irreducible : Irreducible p :=
    minpoly.irreducible
      (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).isIntegral_gen
  have hp_separable : p.Separable :=
    Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable _
      (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPowerBasis R l).gen
  have hp_derivative_ne : p.derivative ≠ 0 :=
    (Polynomial.separable_iff_derivative_ne_zero hp_irreducible).1
      hp_separable
  let q := f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)
  have hq_monic : q.Monic :=
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_monic R l).map _
  have hq_derivative_ne : q.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    have hqp : q = p := by
      simpa [q, p, f] using finiteEtaleResidueLiftPolynomial_map R l
    rw [hqp]
    exact hp_derivative_ne
  have hqmk_ne : AdjoinRoot.mk q q.derivative ≠ 0 :=
    AdjoinRoot.mk_ne_zero_of_degree_lt hq_monic hq_derivative_ne
      (Polynomial.degree_derivative_lt hq_monic.ne_zero)
  apply (IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit _).1
  intro hzero
  have hxmax :
      aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f.derivative ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (FiniteEtaleResidueLift R l) :=
    (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero
  have hxclosed :
      aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f.derivative ∈
        finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal R l := by
    rw [← maximalIdeal_finiteEtaleResidueLift R l]
    exact hxmax
  have hquot :
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (finiteEtaleResidueLiftClosedIdeal R l)
          (aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f.derivative) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hxclosed
  have hmap := congrArg
    (finiteEtaleResidueLiftSpecialFiberRingEquiv R l) hquot
  apply hqmk_ne
  dsimp only [f] at hmap
  simp only [AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq,
    finiteEtaleResidueLiftSpecialFiberRingEquiv_mk, map_zero] at hmap
  dsimp only [q, f]
  rw [Polynomial.derivative_map]
  exact hmap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.under_eq_bot_of_localized_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
private theorem under_eq_bot_of_localized_nonZeroDivisors
    (R : Type*) (B : Type*) (S : Type*)
    [CommSemiring R] [IsDomain R]
    [instB : CommSemiring B] [instS : CommSemiring S]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra B S]
    [IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (nonZeroDivisors R)) S]
    (J : Ideal S) (hJ : J ≠ ⊤) : (J.under B).under R = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    by_contra hz0
    have hzM : algebraMap R B z ∈
        Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (nonZeroDivisors R) :=
      ⟨z, mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz0, rfl⟩
    have hzJ : algebraMap B S (algebraMap R B z) ∈ J := hz
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap B S (algebraMap R B z)) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units
        (M := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (nonZeroDivisors R)) S
        ⟨algebraMap R B z, hzM⟩
    exact hJ (J.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem hzJ hu)
  · exact bot_le

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.coordinate_prime_eq_of_maximal_comap
statement:
private theorem coordinate_prime_eq_of_maximal_comap
    {ι : Type*} (A : ι → Type*)
    [∀ j, CommRing (A j)] [∀ j, IsLocalRing (A j)]
    (P : Ideal (∀ j, A j)) (hP : P.IsMaximal)
    (i : ι) (q : PrimeSpectrum (A i))
    (hq : q.asIdeal.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A i) = P) :
    P = productCoordinatePrime A i
proof:
:= by
  have hMapped :
      (q.asIdeal.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A i)).map (Pi.evalRingHom A i) =
        q.asIdeal :=
    Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective (Pi.evalRingHom A i)
      (Pi.evalRingHom A i).surjective q.asIdeal
  have hComapMax : (q.asIdeal.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A i)).IsMaximal :=
    hq.symm ▸ hP
  have hOr := Ideal.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective
    (Pi.evalRingHom A i) (Pi.evalRingHom A i).surjective hComapMax
  have hMappedMax :=
    hOr.resolve_left (fun h => q.isPrime.ne_top (hMapped.symm.trans h))
  have hqmax : q.asIdeal.IsMaximal := hMapped ▸ hMappedMax
  have hqeq : q.asIdeal = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i) :=
    (IsLocalRing.isMaximal_iff (R := A i)).mp hqmax
  exact hq.symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun I : Ideal (A i) => I.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A i)) hqeq)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem exists_completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_eq
    :
    let H
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
    let Khat := standardDVFCompletionField V K
    letI : Algebra V Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V Vhat) :=
      standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
      standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
        (V := V) (K := K)
    letI : Algebra K Khat := standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
    letI : Algebra V Khat :=
      standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)
    letI : SMul K Khat := (standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K).toSMul
    letI : Module K Khat :=
      (standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K).toModule
    letI : SMul V Khat :=
      (standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)).toSMul
    letI : Module V Khat :=
      (standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)).toModule
    letI : IsScalarTower V K Khat :=
      standardDVFCompletion_isScalarTower (V := V) (K := K)
    letI : IsScalarTower V Vhat Khat :=
      standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower
        (V := V) (K := K)
    let G := Khat ⊗[K] L
    ∀ m : Ideal G, m.IsMaximal →
      ∃ Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C,
      let hmax := standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K
      let hres := standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective V K
      completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
        (R := V) (R' := Vhat) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := Khat)
        hmax hres Q.1 = m := by
  classical
  intro H Vhat Khat
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V Vhat) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let : Algebra K Khat := standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra V Khat :=
    standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)
  let : SMul K Khat := (standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K).toSMul
  let : Module K Khat :=
    (standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K).toModule
  let : SMul V Khat :=
    (standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)).toSMul
  let : Module V Khat :=
    (standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)).toModule
  let : IsScalarTower V K Khat :=
    standardDVFCompletion_isScalarTower (V := V) (K := K)
  let : IsScalarTower V Vhat Khat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower
      (V := V) (K := K)
  intro G m hm
  let : m.IsMaximal := hm
  let U := Vhat ⊗[V] C
  let G₀ := Khat ⊗[Vhat] U
  let : Algebra Vhat U := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : Algebra U G₀ := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower Vhat U G₀ :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let M : Submonoid U :=
    Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid U (nonZeroDivisors Vhat)
  let : IsLocalization M G₀ :=
    IsLocalization.tensorRight (R := Vhat) (S := U) (A := Khat)
      (nonZeroDivisors Vhat)
  let eOriginal : G₀ ≃ₐ[Khat] G := completedGenericFiberEquiv
    (R := V) (R' := Vhat) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := Khat)
  let m₀ : Ideal G₀ := m.comap eOriginal.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  let : m₀.IsMaximal :=
    (inferInstance : m.IsMaximal).comap_bijective
      eOriginal.toRingEquiv.toRingHom eOriginal.bijective
  let : m₀.IsPrime := by
    change (m.comap eOriginal.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).IsPrime
    exact (inferInstance : m.IsMaximal).isPrime.comap eOriginal.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  let N : Ideal U := genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m₀
  let : N.IsPrime := (inferInstance : m₀.IsPrime).comap
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : U →ₐ[Vhat] G₀).toRingHom
  have hNunder : N.under Vhat = ⊥ := by
    have hN_eq_under : N = m₀.under U := rfl
    exact (congrArg (fun I : Ideal U => I.under Vhat) hN_eq_under).trans
      (under_eq_bot_of_localized_nonZeroDivisors Vhat U G₀
        (instB := Algebra.TensorProduct.instCommSemiring (R := V) (A := Vhat) (B := C))
        (instS := Algebra.TensorProduct.instCommSemiring (R := Vhat) (A := Khat) (B := U))
        m₀ (inferInstance : m₀.IsPrime).ne_top)
  let : N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal Vhat) := ⟨hNunder.symm⟩
  let : Module.Finite Vhat U := Module.Finite.base_change V Vhat C
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral Vhat U := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite Vhat U
  have hNmax : N.under Vhat ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat := by
    rw [hNunder]
    exact bot_le
  obtain ⟨P, hNP, hPPrime, hPcomap⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat) N hNmax
  let : P.IsPrime := hPPrime
  let : P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat) :=
    (Ideal.liesOver_iff P (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat)).mpr hPcomap.symm
  let : P.IsMaximal := Ideal.IsMaximal.of_liesOver_isMaximal P
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat)
  let A := fun Q : p.primesOver C ↦
    completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q
  let : ∀ Q, Algebra Vhat (A Q) := fun Q ↦
    completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q
  let E := completedDVRIntegralExtensionLocalFactorsCompletionAlgEquiv
    (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
  let Pprod := P.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  let : Pprod.IsMaximal :=
    (inferInstance : P.IsMaximal).map_bijective
      E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom E.bijective
  let pSpec : PrimeSpectrum (∀ Q : p.primesOver C, A Q) :=
    ⟨Pprod, (inferInstance : Pprod.IsMaximal).isPrime⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, q, hq⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.exists_comap_evalRingHom_eq pSpec
  have hqcomap : q.asIdeal.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A Q) = Pprod :=
    congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hq
  have hPprod : Pprod = productCoordinatePrime A Q :=
    coordinate_prime_eq_of_maximal_comap A Pprod
      (inferInstance : Pprod.IsMaximal) Q q hqcomap
  let Nprod := N.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  let : Nprod.IsPrime := by
    apply Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective E.surjective
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : x = 0 := E.injective (hx.trans E.map_zero.symm)
    simp only [hx0, Ideal.zero_mem]
  have hNprodP : Nprod ≤ productCoordinatePrime A Q := by
    rw [← hPprod]
    exact Ideal.map_mono hNP
  have hNneP : N ≠ P := by
    intro hEq
    have : (⊥ : Ideal Vhat) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat := by
      calc
        (⊥ : Ideal Vhat) = N.under Vhat := hNunder.symm
        _ = P.under Vhat := by rw [hEq]
        _ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat :=
          (P.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat)).symm
    exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_a_field Vhat this.symm
  have hNprodNe : Nprod ≠ productCoordinatePrime A Q := by
    intro hEq
    exact hNneP (E.toRingEquiv.idealComapOrderIso.symm.injective
      (hEq.trans hPprod.symm))
  have hNprod : Nprod = RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom A Q) :=
    prime_eq_ker_coordinateEval_of_le_of_ne A Q Nprod hNprodP hNprodNe
  let hmax := standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K
  let hres := standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective V K
  let NQ := completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime
    (R := V) (R' := Vhat) hmax hres Q.1
  have hNQprod : NQ.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom A Q) :=
    (completedBaseChangeChosenPrimes_map_localFactors
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q).2
  have hNNQ : N = NQ := by
    calc
      N = (N.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).comap
          E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom :=
        (Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective
          E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom E.bijective).symm
      _ = (NQ.map E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).comap
          E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom :=
        congrArg (fun I ↦ I.comap E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
          (hNprod.trans hNQprod.symm)
      _ = NQ := Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective
        E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom E.bijective
  let mQ₀ : Ideal G₀ := completedBaseChangeChosenGenericIdeal
    (R := V) (R' := Vhat) (K' := Khat) hmax hres Q.1
  have hm₀under : m₀.under U = N := rfl
  have hmQ₀under : mQ₀.under U = NQ :=
    completedBaseChangeChosenGenericIdeal_comap
      (R := V) (R' := Vhat) (K' := Khat) hmax hres Q.1
  have hm₀mQ₀ : m₀ = mQ₀ := by
    apply (IsLocalization.orderEmbedding M G₀).injective
    change m₀.under U = mQ₀.under U
    exact hm₀under.trans (hNNQ.trans hmQ₀under.symm)
  refine ⟨Q, ?_⟩
  change mQ₀.map eOriginal.toRingEquiv.toRingHom = m
  calc
    mQ₀.map eOriginal.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
        m₀.map eOriginal.toRingEquiv.toRingHom := by rw [hm₀mQ₀]
    _ = m := Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective
      eOriginal.toRingEquiv.toRingHom eOriginal.surjective m

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat :
    let H
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra V H.valuationSubring :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    Module.FaithfullyFlat V H.valuationSubring := by
  let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra V H.valuationSubring :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree V H.valuationSubring :=
    Module.isTorsionFree_iff_algebraMap_injective.mpr (by
      intro x y hxy
      apply IsFractionRing.injective V K
      apply (standardDVFCompletionMap V K).injective
      calc
        standardDVFCompletionMap V K (algebraMap V K x) =
            ((algebraMap V H.valuationSubring x : H.valuationSubring) :
              standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
          (coe_standardDVRToCompletionValuationSubringMap V K x).symm
        _ = ((algebraMap V H.valuationSubring y : H.valuationSubring) :
              standardDVFCompletionField V K) := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
        _ = standardDVFCompletionMap V K (algebraMap V K y) :=
          coe_standardDVRToCompletionValuationSubringMap V K y)
  let : Module.Flat V H.valuationSubring := inferInstance
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V H.valuationSubring) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
  exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower :

    letI : SMul V Khat :=

    IsScalarTower V Vhat Khat := by
  dsimp only
  let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K

  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra K Khat := standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra V Khat :=
    standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)
  let : SMul V Khat :=
    (standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)).toSMul
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro x
  exact coe_standardDVRToCompletionValuationSubringMap V K x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra_isIntegral
statement:
theorem completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra_isIntegral
    (Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C) :
    let p
proof:
:= IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
    let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
    let A := fun Q' : p.primesOver C =>
      completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q'
    letI : Algebra V Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    letI : ∀ Q', Algebra Vhat (A Q') := fun Q' =>
      completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
        (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q'
    Algebra.IsIntegral Vhat (A Q) := by
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
  let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let U := Vhat ⊗[V] C
  let A := fun Q' : p.primesOver C =>
    completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q'
  let : Algebra Vhat U := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : ∀ Q', Algebra Vhat (A Q') := fun Q' =>
    completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q'
  let : Module.Finite Vhat U := Module.Finite.base_change V Vhat C
  let E := completedDVRIntegralExtensionLocalFactorsCompletionAlgEquiv
    (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
  let f : U →ₐ[Vhat] A Q := (Pi.evalAlgHom Vhat A Q).comp E.toAlgHom
  let : Module.Finite Vhat (A Q) :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective f.toLinearMap
      ((Pi.evalRingHom A Q).surjective.comp E.surjective)
  exact Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite Vhat (A Q)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal_map_tensorProductCongr
statement:
theorem genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal_map_tensorProductCongr
    (e : U₀ ≃ₐ[R₀] U₁) (m : Ideal (F ⊗[R₀] U₀)) :
    let eG
proof:
:= Algebra.TensorProduct.congr
      (AlgEquiv.refl : F ≃ₐ[R₀] F) e
    genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal (m.map eG.toRingEquiv.toRingHom) =
      (genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m).map e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom := by
  dsimp only
  let eG := Algebra.TensorProduct.congr
    (AlgEquiv.refl : F ≃ₐ[R₀] F) e
  unfold genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal
  change Ideal.comap
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : U₁ →ₐ[R₀] F ⊗[R₀] U₁)
      (Ideal.map eG.toRingEquiv.toRingHom m) =
    Ideal.map e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
      (Ideal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : U₀ →ₐ[R₀] F ⊗[R₀] U₀) m)
  have hm : Ideal.map eG.toRingEquiv.toRingHom m =
      Ideal.comap eG.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom m :=
    Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv eG.toRingEquiv
  have hn : Ideal.map e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
        (Ideal.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : U₀ →ₐ[R₀] F ⊗[R₀] U₀) m) =
      Ideal.comap e.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
        (Ideal.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : U₀ →ₐ[R₀] F ⊗[R₀] U₀) m) :=
    Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv e.toRingEquiv
  rw [hm, hn]
  ext y
  change eG.symm (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight y) ∈ m ↔
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (e.symm y) ∈ m
  rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_symm]
  simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    map_one]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedBaseChangeChosenPrimes_map_localFactors
statement:
theorem completedBaseChangeChosenPrimes_map_localFactors
    (Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C) :
    let H
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
    letI : Algebra V Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V Vhat) :=
      standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
      standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
        (V := V) (K := K)
    let hmax := standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K
    let hres := standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective V K
    let E := completedDVRIntegralExtensionLocalFactorsRingEquiv
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
    let A := fun Q' : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C =>
      completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q'
    let P := completedBaseChangeChosenPrime
      (R := V) (R' := Vhat) Q.1
    let N := completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime
      (R := V) (R' := Vhat) hmax hres Q.1
    P.map E.toRingHom = productCoordinatePrime A Q ∧
      N.map E.toRingHom = RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom A Q) := by
  classical
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
  let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
  let A := fun Q' : p.primesOver C =>
    completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q'
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V Vhat) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let U := Vhat ⊗[V] C
  let : Algebra C U := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let hmax := standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K
  let hres := standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective V K
  let E := completedDVRIntegralExtensionLocalFactorsRingEquiv
    (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
  let P := completedBaseChangeChosenPrime
    (R := V) (R' := Vhat) Q.1
  let N := completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime
    (R := V) (R' := Vhat) hmax hres Q.1
  have hcomponent :
      (Pi.evalRingHom A Q).comp
          (E.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap C U)) =
        completedPrimeMap (L := L) Q := by
    ext x
    have hx := completedDVRIntegralExtensionLocalFactorsRingEquiv_includeRight_apply
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) x Q
    dsimp only at hx
    have hRight : (algebraMap C U) x =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight x := rfl
    calc
      ((Pi.evalRingHom A Q).comp
          (E.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap C U))) x =
          E ((algebraMap C U) x) Q := rfl
      _ = E (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight x) Q :=
        congrArg (fun u : U ↦ E u Q) hRight
      _ = completedPrimeMap (L := L) Q x := hx
  have hgeom := completedBaseChangeChosenPrime_isMaximal_liesOver
    (R := V) (R' := Vhat) hmax hres Q.1
  have hP_le : P ≤ (productCoordinatePrime A Q).comap E.toRingHom := by
    change Q.1.map (algebraMap C U) ≤
      (productCoordinatePrime A Q).comap E.toRingHom
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro x hx
    change E (algebraMap C U x) Q ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A Q)
    change ((Pi.evalRingHom A Q).comp
      (E.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap C U))) x ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A Q)
    rw [hcomponent]
    change x ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A Q)).comap
      (completedPrimeMap (L := L) Q)
    rw [completedPrimeMap_comap_maximalIdeal]
    exact hx
  have hPcomap :
      P = (productCoordinatePrime A Q).comap E.toRingHom :=
    hgeom.1.eq_of_le
      (Ideal.comap_ne_top E.toRingHom
        (inferInstance : (productCoordinatePrime A Q).IsPrime).ne_top)
      hP_le
  have hPmap : P.map E.toRingHom = productCoordinatePrime A Q := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).2 hPcomap.le
    · intro y hy
      have hpre : E.symm y ∈ P := by
        rw [hPcomap]
        change E (E.symm y) ∈ productCoordinatePrime A Q
        simpa only [E.apply_symm_apply] using hy
      have himage : E (E.symm y) ∈ P.map E.toRingHom :=
        Ideal.mem_map_of_mem E.toRingHom hpre
      simpa only [E.apply_symm_apply] using himage
  have hNspec := completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime_spec
    (R := V) (R' := Vhat) hmax hres Q.1
  let : N.IsPrime := hNspec.2.1
  let : N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal Vhat) := hNspec.2.2
  let : P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat) := hgeom.2
  have hkerE : RingHom.ker E.toRingHom ≤ N := by
    have hker : RingHom.ker E.toRingHom = ⊥ :=
      (RingHom.ker_eq_bot_iff_eq_zero E.toRingHom).2 fun x hx =>
        E.injective (hx.trans E.toRingHom.map_zero.symm)
    rw [hker]
    exact bot_le
  let : (N.map E.toRingHom).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective E.surjective hkerE
  have hNP : N.map E.toRingHom ≤ productCoordinatePrime A Q := by
    rw [← hPmap]
    exact Ideal.map_mono hNspec.1
  have hNneP : N ≠ P := by
    intro hNP'
    have hbotmax : (⊥ : Ideal Vhat) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat := by
      calc
        (⊥ : Ideal Vhat) = N.under Vhat := N.over_def (⊥ : Ideal Vhat)
        _ = P.under Vhat := by rw [hNP']
        _ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat :=
          (P.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat)).symm
    have hmaxne : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Vhat ≠ ⊥ :=
      Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal Vhat)
        (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField Vhat)
    exact hmaxne hbotmax.symm
  have hNne : N.map E.toRingHom ≠ productCoordinatePrime A Q := by
    intro hmap
    apply hNneP
    apply (Ideal.relIsoOfBijective E.toRingHom E.bijective).symm.injective
    exact hmap.trans hPmap.symm
  exact ⟨hPmap,
    prime_eq_ker_coordinateEval_of_le_of_ne A Q
      (N.map E.toRingHom) hNP hNne⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedChosenComponentAlgHom_ker
statement:
theorem completedChosenComponentAlgHom_ker
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R')))
    (Q : Ideal C) [Q.IsMaximal]
    [Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)] :
    let m
proof:
:= completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
      hmax hres Q
    letI : m.IsMaximal := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
      hmax hres Q
    RingHom.ker
      (completedChosenComponentAlgHom
        (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
        (K' := K') m).toRingHom =
      completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime
        (R := R) (R' := R') hmax hres Q := by
  let m := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
    hmax hres Q
  let : m.IsMaximal := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_isMaximal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
    hmax hres Q
  let U := completedFiniteBaseChange (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C)
  let G := completedFiniteBaseChangeGenericFiber
    (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K' := K')
  let : Algebra U G := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let e := completedGenericFiberEquiv
    (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
  ext x
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk m (e (algebraMap U G x)) = 0 ↔
    x ∈ completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime
      (R := R) (R' := R') hmax hres Q
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  change x ∈ (m.comap e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).comap
      (algebraMap U G) ↔ _
  rw [completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_comap
    (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
    hmax hres Q]
  rw [completedBaseChangeChosenGenericIdeal_comap
    (R := R) (R' := R') (K' := K') hmax hres Q]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedChosenNormalizationAlgHom_ker
statement:
theorem completedChosenNormalizationAlgHom_ker
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R')))
    (Q : Ideal C) [Q.IsMaximal]
    [Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)] :
    let m
proof:
:= completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
      hmax hres Q
    letI : m.IsMaximal := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
      hmax hres Q
    RingHom.ker
      (completedChosenNormalizationAlgHom
        (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
        (K' := K') m).toRingHom =
      completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime
        (R := R) (R' := R') hmax hres Q := by
  let m := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
    hmax hres Q
  let : m.IsMaximal := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_isMaximal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
    hmax hres Q
  let j := completedChosenNormalizationAlgHom
    (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') m
  dsimp only
  change RingHom.ker j.toRingHom =
    completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime
      (R := R) (R' := R') hmax hres Q
  rw [← RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective j.toRingHom
    (f := (integralClosure R'
      (GenericTensorFieldComponent m)).val.toRingHom)
    Subtype.val_injective]
  change RingHom.ker
      (completedChosenComponentAlgHom
        (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
        (K' := K') m).toRingHom =
    completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime
      (R := R) (R' := R') hmax hres Q
  exact completedChosenComponentAlgHom_ker
    (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
    hmax hres Q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_completedChosenNormalizationPrime
statement:
theorem exists_completedChosenNormalizationPrime
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R')))
    (Q : Ideal C) [Q.IsMaximal]
    [Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)] :
    let U
proof:
:= completedFiniteBaseChange (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C)
    let P := completedBaseChangeChosenPrime (R := R) (R' := R') Q
    let m := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
      hmax hres Q
    letI : m.IsMaximal := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
      hmax hres Q
    let j := completedChosenNormalizationAlgHom
      (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') m
    letI : Algebra U
        (integralClosure R' (GenericTensorFieldComponent m)) :=
      j.toAlgebra
    ∃ q : Ideal (integralClosure R' (GenericTensorFieldComponent m)),
      q.IsMaximal ∧ q.LiesOver P := by
  let U := completedFiniteBaseChange (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C)
  let P := completedBaseChangeChosenPrime (R := R) (R' := R') Q
  let m := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
    hmax hres Q
  let : m.IsMaximal := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_isMaximal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
    hmax hres Q
  let IC := integralClosure R' (GenericTensorFieldComponent m)
  let j := completedChosenNormalizationAlgHom
    (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') m
  let : Algebra U IC := j.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R' U IC :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => j.commutes x |>.symm
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R' IC :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_algebra R'
      (GenericTensorFieldComponent m)
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral U IC :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.tower_top R'
  have hgeom := completedBaseChangeChosenPrime_isMaximal_liesOver
    (R := R) (R' := R') hmax hres Q
  let : P.IsMaximal := hgeom.1
  have hk : RingHom.ker (algebraMap U IC) ≤ P := by
    change RingHom.ker j.toRingHom ≤ P
    rw [completedChosenNormalizationAlgHom_ker
      (R := R) (R' := R') (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
      hmax hres Q]
    exact (completedBaseChangeChosenGenericPrime_spec
      (R := R) (R' := R') hmax hres Q).1
  obtain ⟨q, hqmax, hqcomap⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_maximal_of_isIntegral P hk
  exact ⟨q, hqmax, (Ideal.liesOver_iff q P).mpr hqcomap.symm⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedBaseChangeChosenPrime_isMaximal_liesOver
statement:
theorem completedBaseChangeChosenPrime_isMaximal_liesOver
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R')))

      (nonZeroDivisors R')

    (R := R) (R' := R') hmax hres Q

    rw [← hPmap, Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective E.toRingHom E.bijective]
  have hcoordinate :=

      ((IsUnit.submonoid S : Submonoid S) : Set S)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S : Set S) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxunit hxmax
    exact ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal x).mp hxmax) hxunit
  have hram := ramificationIdx_map_eq_of_isLocalization
    (R := R) (S := S) (R' := R) (S' := T)
    (IsUnit.submonoid R) (IsUnit.submonoid S)
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) hdisj
  have hmap : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).map (algebraMap S T) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T := by
    change (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).map e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T
    exact IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e.toRingEquiv
  rw [hmap] at hram
  exact hram.symm

    letI : IsLocalRing B := e.symm.toRingEquiv.isLocalRing
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx Vhat =
      Q.1.ramificationIdx V := by
  classical
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
  let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
  let Khat := standardDVFCompletionField V K
  let A := fun Q' : p.primesOver C =>
    completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q'
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V Vhat) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let : Algebra K Khat := standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra V Khat :=
    standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)
  let : SMul K Khat :=
    (standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K).toSMul
  let : SMul V Khat :=
    (standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower V K Khat :=
    standardDVFCompletion_isScalarTower (V := V) (K := K)
  let : IsScalarTower V Vhat Khat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let : ∀ Q', Algebra Vhat (A Q') := fun Q' =>
    completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q'
  let hmax := standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K
  let hres := standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective V K
  let m := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
    (R := V) (R' := Vhat) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := Khat)
    hmax hres Q.1
  let B := integralClosure Vhat (GenericTensorFieldComponent m)
  let e := completedGenericTensorChosenIntegralClosureAlgEquiv
    (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q
  let : IsLocalRing B := e.symm.toRingEquiv.isLocalRing
  calc
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).ramificationIdx Vhat =
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A Q)).ramificationIdx Vhat :=
      maximalIdeal_ramificationIdx_eq_of_algEquiv e
    _ = Q.1.ramificationIdx V :=
      completedPrimeValuationSubring_ramificationIdx_eq
        (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.faithfulSMul_of_component_fraction_equiv
statement:
private theorem faithfulSMul_of_component_fraction_equiv
    (R : Type*) (B : Type*) (K₁ : Type*) (F₁ : Type*) (L₁ : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing B]
    [Field K₁] [Field F₁] [Field L₁]
    [Algebra R K₁] [IsFractionRing R K₁]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra B F₁] [Algebra R F₁]
    [IsScalarTower R B F₁]
    [Algebra K₁ L₁] [Algebra R L₁] [IsScalarTower R K₁ L₁]
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[R] F₁) : FaithfulSMul R B
proof:
:= by
  refine (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R B).mpr ?_
  intro x y h
  apply IsFractionRing.injective R K₁
  apply (algebraMap K₁ L₁).injective
  apply e.injective
  calc
    e (algebraMap K₁ L₁ (algebraMap R K₁ x)) = algebraMap R F₁ x :=
      (congrArg e (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K₁ L₁ x).symm).trans (e.commutes x)
    _ = algebraMap B F₁ (algebraMap R B x) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B F₁ x
    _ = algebraMap B F₁ (algebraMap R B y) := congrArg (algebraMap B F₁) h
    _ = algebraMap R F₁ y := (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B F₁ y).symm
    _ = e (algebraMap K₁ L₁ (algebraMap R K₁ y)) :=
      ((congrArg e (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K₁ L₁ y).symm).trans
        (e.commutes y)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.inverse_component_equiv_commutes
statement:
private theorem inverse_component_equiv_commutes
    (R : Type*) (A : Type*) (S : Type*) (L₁ : Type*) (F₁ : Type*)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [CommRing L₁] [CommRing F₁]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra A F₁] [Algebra R F₁] [IsScalarTower R A F₁]
    [Algebra R L₁]
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[R] F₁) (r : S ≃+* A) (ι : S →+* L₁)
    (hr : ∀ x : S, algebraMap A F₁ (r x) = e (ι x)) (z : R) :
    ι (r.symm (algebraMap R A z)) = algebraMap R L₁ z
proof:
:= by
  apply e.injective
  calc
    e (ι (r.symm (algebraMap R A z))) =
        algebraMap A F₁ (r (r.symm (algebraMap R A z))) :=
      (hr (r.symm (algebraMap R A z))).symm
    _ = algebraMap A F₁ (algebraMap R A z) :=
      congrArg (algebraMap A F₁) (r.apply_symm_apply (algebraMap R A z))
    _ = algebraMap R F₁ z := (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A F₁ z).symm
    _ = e (algebraMap R L₁ z) := (e.commutes z).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.valuationRingEquiv_commutes_of_inverse_coe
statement:
private theorem valuationRingEquiv_commutes_of_inverse_coe
    (K₁ : Type*) (L₁ : Type*) (A₁ : Type*)
    [Field K₁] [Field L₁] [CommRing A₁] [Algebra K₁ L₁]
    (base : DVF K₁) (target : DVF L₁)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    [Algebra base.valuationSubring A₁]
    (r : target.valuationSubring ≃+* A₁)
    (hr : ∀ z : base.valuationSubring,
      ((r.symm (algebraMap base.valuationSubring A₁ z) :
        target.valuationSubring) : L₁) = algebraMap K₁ L₁ (z : K₁))
    (z : base.valuationSubring) :
    r (algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring z) =
      algebraMap base.valuationSubring A₁ z
proof:
:= by
  apply r.symm.injective
  refine (r.symm_apply_apply
    (algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring z)).trans ?_
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (integerMap_apply base target z).trans (hr z).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra_finite
statement:
theorem completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra_finite
    (Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C) :
    let H
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
    let A := completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q
    letI : Algebra V Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    letI : Algebra Vhat A :=
      completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
        (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q
    Module.Finite Vhat A := by
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
  let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
  let A := fun Q' : p.primesOver C =>
    completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q'
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let U := Vhat ⊗[V] C
  let : Algebra Vhat U := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : ∀ Q', Algebra Vhat (A Q') := fun Q' =>
    completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q'
  let : Module.Finite Vhat U := Module.Finite.base_change V Vhat C
  let E := completedDVRIntegralExtensionLocalFactorsCompletionAlgEquiv
    (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
  let f : U →ₐ[Vhat] A Q := (Pi.evalAlgHom Vhat A Q).comp E.toAlgHom
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective f.toLinearMap
    ((Pi.evalRingHom A Q).surjective.comp E.surjective)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_completedChosenGenericComponent_completeDVF
statement:
theorem exists_completedChosenGenericComponent_completeDVF
    (Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C) :
    let H
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
    let Khat := standardDVFCompletionField V K
    letI : Algebra V Vhat :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V Vhat) :=
      standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
      standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
        (V := V) (K := K)
    letI : Algebra K Khat := standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
    letI : Algebra V Khat :=
      standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)
    letI : SMul K Khat := (standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K).toSMul
    letI : SMul V Khat :=
      (standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)).toSMul
    letI : IsScalarTower V K Khat :=
      standardDVFCompletion_isScalarTower (V := V) (K := K)
    letI : IsScalarTower V Vhat Khat :=
      standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower
        (V := V) (K := K)
    let hmax := standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K
    let hres := standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective V K
    let m := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal
      (R := V) (R' := Vhat) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := Khat)
      hmax hres Q.1
    letI : m.IsMaximal := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := V) (R' := Vhat) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := Khat)
      hmax hres Q.1
    let L₀ := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    ∃ target : CompleteDVF.{_, 0} L₀,
      ∃ hExt : H.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation,
        letI : H.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation := hExt
        Module.Finite Vhat target.valuationSubring ∧
          ramificationIndex H.toDVF target.toDVF =
            Q.1.ramificationIdx V := by
  classical
  intro H Vhat Khat
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V Vhat) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let : Algebra K Khat := standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra V Khat :=
    standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)
  let : SMul K Khat := (standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K).toSMul
  let : SMul V Khat :=
    (standardDVFCompletionBaseAlgebra (V := V) (K := K)).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower V K Khat :=
    standardDVFCompletion_isScalarTower (V := V) (K := K)
  let : IsScalarTower V Vhat Khat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_isScalarTower
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let A := completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q
  let : Algebra Vhat A :=
    completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q
  let : Module.Finite Vhat A :=
    completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra_finite
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral Vhat A :=
    completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra_isIntegral
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q
  intro hmax hres m
  let : m.IsMaximal := completedGenericTensorChosenIdeal_isMaximal
    (R := V) (R' := Vhat) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := Khat)
    hmax hres Q.1
  intro L₀
  let F := FractionRing A
  let : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A := by
    dsimp only [A, completedPrimeValuationSubring]
    infer_instance
  let T₀ := standardCompleteDVFOfCompleteDVR A F
  let e : L₀ ≃ₐ[Vhat] F :=
    completedGenericTensorChosenComponentFractionRingAlgEquiv
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q
  have hVhat_coe (z : Vhat) :
      algebraMap Vhat Khat z = (z : Khat) := rfl
  let : FaithfulSMul Vhat A :=
    faithfulSMul_of_component_fraction_equiv Vhat A Khat F L₀ e
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap Vhat A) := inferInstance
  let target : CompleteDVF.{_, 0} L₀ :=
    { ValueGroup := T₀.ValueGroup
      valuation := T₀.valuation.comap (e.toRingEquiv : L₀ →+* F)
      instCompleteDiscrete :=
        Valuation.isCompleteDiscrete_comap_ringEquiv
          T₀.valuation e.toRingEquiv }
  let eComap : target.valuationSubring ≃+* T₀.valuationSubring :=
    Valuation.valuationSubringRingEquivOfComap T₀.valuation e.toRingEquiv
  let eA : A ≃+* T₀.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := A) (K := F)
  let r : target.valuationSubring ≃+* A := eComap.trans eA.symm
  have hr_coe (x : target.valuationSubring) :
      algebraMap A F (r x) = e (x : L₀) := by
    calc
      algebraMap A F (r x) = (eA (r x) : F) :=
        (dvr_equivValuationSubring_coe (L := F) A (r x)).symm
      _ = (eA (eA.symm (eComap x)) : F) :=
        congrArg (fun y : A => (eA y : F))
          (RingEquiv.trans_apply eComap eA.symm x)
      _ = (eComap x : F) :=
        congrArg (fun y : T₀.valuationSubring => (y : F))
          (eA.apply_symm_apply (eComap x))
      _ = e (x : L₀) :=
        Valuation.valuationSubringRingEquivOfComap_apply T₀.valuation e.toRingEquiv x
  let f : Vhat →+* target.valuationSubring :=
    r.symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Vhat A)
  let : IsLocalHom r.symm.toRingHom :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective r.symm.toRingHom r.symm.surjective
  let : IsLocalHom f :=
    RingHom.isLocalHom_comp r.symm.toRingHom (algebraMap Vhat A)
  have hf_coe (z : Vhat) :
      ((f z : target.valuationSubring) : L₀) =
        algebraMap Khat L₀ (z : Khat) := by
    change
      ((r.symm (algebraMap Vhat A z) : target.valuationSubring) : L₀) =
        algebraMap Khat L₀ (z : Khat)
    exact (inverse_component_equiv_commutes Vhat A target.valuationSubring L₀ F
      e r (ValuationSubring.subtype target.valuation.valuationSubring) hr_coe z).trans
        ((IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Vhat Khat L₀ z).trans
          (congrArg (algebraMap Khat L₀) (hVhat_coe z)))
  let hExt : H.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    valuation_hasExtension_of_local_valuationSubring_map
      H target f hf_coe
  refine ⟨target, hExt, ?_⟩
  let : H.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation := hExt
  let rAlg : target.valuationSubring ≃ₐ[Vhat] A :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := r)
      (valuationRingEquiv_commutes_of_inverse_coe Khat L₀ A
        H.toDVF target.toDVF r hf_coe)
  have hFiniteTarget : Module.Finite Vhat target.valuationSubring :=
    Module.Finite.equiv rAlg.symm.toLinearEquiv
  let : Module.Finite Vhat target.valuationSubring := hFiniteTarget
  refine ⟨hFiniteTarget, ?_⟩
  have htransport :=
    Ideal.ramificationIdx'_map_eq
      H.maximalIdeal target.maximalIdeal rAlg
  have hmap : Ideal.map rAlg target.maximalIdeal =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
    exact IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal rAlg.toRingEquiv
  rw [hmap] at htransport
  let : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).LiesOver H.maximalIdeal :=
    Ideal.LiesOver.mk
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (algebraMap Vhat A)).symm
  have hA :
      H.maximalIdeal.ramificationIdx' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) =
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).ramificationIdx Vhat :=
    Ideal.ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx
      H.maximalIdeal (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
        (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_a_field Vhat)
  change H.maximalIdeal.ramificationIdx' target.maximalIdeal =
    Q.1.ramificationIdx V
  calc
    H.maximalIdeal.ramificationIdx' target.maximalIdeal =
        H.maximalIdeal.ramificationIdx' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :=
      htransport.symm
    _ = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).ramificationIdx Vhat := hA
    _ = Q.1.ramificationIdx V := by
      exact completedPrimeValuationSubring_ramificationIdx_eq
        (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardCompleteDVFOfCompleteDVR_toDVF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem standardCompleteDVFOfCompleteDVR_toDVF
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) V] :
    (standardCompleteDVFOfCompleteDVR V K).toDVF =
      standardDVFOfDVR V K
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective
statement:
theorem standardDVFCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K] :
    let base
proof:
:= standardDVFOfDVR V K
    let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
      standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
    letI : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
      standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
    Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map
        (algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring)) := by
  dsimp only
  let v := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal V).valuation K
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
    standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
  constructor
  · exact RingHom.injective _
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective z
    let s : Set (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
      {x | (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
          (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).restrict (x - (y : _)) < 1}
    have hs : s ∈ nhds (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K) := by
      rw [Valued.mem_nhds]
      exact ⟨1, by simp [s]⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
      UniformSpace.Completion.denseRange_coe.mem_nhds hs
    have haClose :
        (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
          (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
            ((a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) - (y : _)) < 1 := by
      change (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).restrict
          ((a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) - (y : _)) < 1 at ha
      rw [Valuation.restrict_lt_iff_lt_embedding] at ha
      simpa using ha
    let xK : K := WithVal.equiv v a
    have hxK : v xK ≤ 1 := by
      have haHat :
          (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
            (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
              (a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [show (a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) =
          ((a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) - (y : _)) + y by ring]
        apply Valuation.map_add_le
        · exact haClose.le
        · exact y.property
      rw [Valued.valuedCompletion_apply] at haHat
      change (WithVal.valuation v) a ≤ 1 at haHat
      change v ((WithVal.equiv v) a) ≤ 1
      simpa [WithVal.equiv_apply, WithVal.valuation_apply_eq_ofVal] using haHat
    let x : base.valuationSubring := ⟨xK, hxK⟩
    refine ⟨IsLocalRing.residue base.valuationSubring x, ?_⟩
    rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal target.valuationSubring)
        ((algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring) x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal target.valuationSubring) y
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq]
    rw [Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_iff]
    change target.valuation
      (((algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring) x :
        target.valuationSubring) - y :
        standardDVFCompletionField V K) < 1
    have hmap :
        (((algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring) x :
          target.valuationSubring) : standardDVFCompletionField V K) =
          (a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) := by
      change algebraMap K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) (x : K) =
        (a : standardDVFCompletionField V K)
      rw [standardDVFCompletion_algebraMap_apply]
      rfl
    rw [standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_valuation]
    change (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
      (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
        (((algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring) x :
          target.valuationSubring) - y :
          standardDVFCompletionField V K) < 1
    rw [hmap]
    exact haClose

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.withValValuation_isRankOneDiscrete
statement:
private theorem withValValuation_isRankOneDiscrete
    {K : Type uK} {Γ : Type uΓ}
    [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ) [v.IsRankOneDiscrete] :
    (WithVal.valuation v).IsRankOneDiscrete where
  exists_generator_lt_one'
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator v, ?_,
      Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_lt_one v⟩
    change Subgroup.zpowers (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator v) =
      MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup (.ofClass (WithVal.valuation v))
    rw [Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_zpowers_eq_valueGroup v]
    rw [show WithVal.valuation v =
      (Valued.v : Valuation (WithVal v) Γ) by rfl]
    exact (WithVal.valueGroup_eq v).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.withValValuation_generator_eq
statement:
private theorem withValValuation_generator_eq
    {K : Type uK} {Γ : Type uΓ}
    [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ) [v.IsRankOneDiscrete] :
    letI : (WithVal.valuation v).IsRankOneDiscrete
proof:
:=
      withValValuation_isRankOneDiscrete v
    Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator (WithVal.valuation v) =
      Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator v := by
  let : (WithVal.valuation v).IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    withValValuation_isRankOneDiscrete v
  apply LinearOrderedCommGroup.Subgroup.genLTOne_unique_of_zpowers_eq
    (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_lt_one (WithVal.valuation v))
    (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_lt_one v)
  calc
    Subgroup.zpowers
        (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator (WithVal.valuation v)) =
        MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
          (.ofClass (WithVal.valuation v)) :=
      Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_zpowers_eq_valueGroup
        (WithVal.valuation v)
    _ = MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup (.ofClass v) := by
      rw [show WithVal.valuation v =
        (Valued.v : Valuation (WithVal v) Γ) by rfl]
      exact WithVal.valueGroup_eq v
    _ = Subgroup.zpowers
        (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator v) :=
      (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_zpowers_eq_valueGroup v).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completionValuation_valueGroup_eq
statement:
private theorem completionValuation_valueGroup_eq
    {K : Type uK} {Γ : Type uΓ}
    [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ) :
    MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
        (.ofClass (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ)) =
      MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup (.ofClass (WithVal.valuation v))
proof:
:= by
  ext γ
  constructor
  · intro hγ
    apply MonoidWithZeroHom.mem_valueGroup
    have himg :
        (γ : Γ) ∈
          Units.val '' (MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
            (.ofClass (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ))) :=
      ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
    rw [MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup_eq_range] at himg
    rcases himg with ⟨hγrange, _hγne⟩
    rcases hγrange with ⟨x, hx⟩
    rcases Valued.exists_coe_eq_v (K := WithVal v) (Γ₀ := Γ) x with
      ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact ⟨a, (hx.symm.trans ha).symm⟩
  · intro hγ
    apply MonoidWithZeroHom.mem_valueGroup
    have himg :
        (γ : Γ) ∈
          Units.val ''
            (MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
              (.ofClass (WithVal.valuation v))) :=
      ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
    rw [MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup_eq_range] at himg
    rcases himg with ⟨hγrange, _hγne⟩
    rcases hγrange with ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨(a : v.Completion), ?_⟩
    change
      (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ) (a : v.Completion) =
        (γ : Γ)
    rw [Valued.valuedCompletion_apply]
    exact ha

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completionValuation_isRankOneDiscrete
statement:
private theorem completionValuation_isRankOneDiscrete
    {K : Type uK} {Γ : Type uΓ}
    [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ)
    [(WithVal.valuation v).IsRankOneDiscrete] :
    (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ).IsRankOneDiscrete where
  exists_generator_lt_one'
proof:
:= by
    refine
      ⟨Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator (WithVal.valuation v), ?_,
        Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_lt_one
          (WithVal.valuation v)⟩
    change Subgroup.zpowers
      (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator (WithVal.valuation v)) =
        MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
          (.ofClass (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ))
    rw [completionValuation_valueGroup_eq v]
    exact
      Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_zpowers_eq_valueGroup
        (WithVal.valuation v)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completionValuation_generator_eq
statement:
private theorem completionValuation_generator_eq
    {K : Type uK} {Γ : Type uΓ}
    [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ)
    [(WithVal.valuation v).IsRankOneDiscrete] :
    letI : (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ).IsRankOneDiscrete
proof:
:=
      completionValuation_isRankOneDiscrete v
    Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator
        (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ) =
      Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator (WithVal.valuation v) := by
  let : (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ).IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    completionValuation_isRankOneDiscrete v
  apply LinearOrderedCommGroup.Subgroup.genLTOne_unique_of_zpowers_eq
    (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_lt_one
      (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ))
    (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_lt_one (WithVal.valuation v))
  calc
    Subgroup.zpowers
        (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator
          (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ)) =
        MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
          (.ofClass (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ)) :=
      Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_zpowers_eq_valueGroup
        (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion Γ)
    _ = MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
        (.ofClass (WithVal.valuation v)) :=
      completionValuation_valueGroup_eq v
    _ = Subgroup.zpowers
        (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator (WithVal.valuation v)) :=
      (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_zpowers_eq_valueGroup
        (WithVal.valuation v)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_valuation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_valuation
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K] :
    (standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K).valuation =
      (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFCompletion_algebraMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem standardDVFCompletion_algebraMap_apply
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    (x : K) :
    letI : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K)

      standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
