name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension
statement:
theorem standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K] :
    let base
proof:
:= standardDVFOfDVR V K
    let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
      standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
    base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation := by
  dsimp only
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let v := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal V).valuation K
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
    standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  change v.HasExtension target.valuation
  apply Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
  ext x
  change
    algebraMap K v.Completion x ∈ target.valuation.valuationSubring ↔
      x ∈ v.valuationSubring
  rw [Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff,
    Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff]
  rw [show target.valuation =
    (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) by
      exact standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_valuation V K]
  change
    (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
        (((WithVal.equiv v).symm x : WithVal v) : v.Completion) ≤ 1 ↔
      v x ≤ 1
  rw [Valued.valuedCompletion_apply]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFCompletionMap_isUniformizer
statement:
theorem standardDVFCompletionMap_isUniformizer
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    (pi : (standardDVFOfDVR V K).valuationSubring)
    (hpi : (standardDVFOfDVR V K).valuation.IsUniformizer (pi : K)) :
    (standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K).valuation.IsUniformizer
      (standardDVFCompletionMap V K (pi : K))
proof:
:= by
  let v := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal V).valuation K
  let : (WithVal.valuation v).IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    withValValuation_isRankOneDiscrete v
  let : (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion
      (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    completionValuation_isRankOneDiscrete v
  simp only [standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_valuation]
  change
    (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
        (((WithVal.equiv v).symm (pi : K) : WithVal v) : v.Completion) =
      Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator
        (Valued.v : Valuation v.Completion
          (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
  rw [Valued.valuedCompletion_apply,
    completionValuation_generator_eq v]
  change
    WithVal.valuation v ((WithVal.equiv v).symm (pi : K)) =
      Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator (WithVal.valuation v)
  rw [WithVal.valuation_apply_eq_ofVal,
    withValValuation_generator_eq v]
  change v.IsUniformizer (pi : K)
  simpa only [standardDVFOfDVR, v] using hpi

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq
statement:
theorem standardDVFCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K] :
    let base
proof:
:= standardDVFOfDVR V K
    let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
      standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
    letI : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
      standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
    Ideal.map
        (algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring)
        base.maximalIdeal =
      target.maximalIdeal := by
  dsimp only
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
    standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
  rcases base.exists_uniformizer with ⟨pi, hpi⟩
  let piHat : target.valuationSubring :=
    ValuedExtension.integerMap base target.toDVF pi
  have hpiHat : target.valuation.IsUniformizer
      (piHat : standardDVFCompletionField V K) := by
    change target.valuation.IsUniformizer
      (((ValuedExtension.integerMap base target.toDVF) pi :
        target.valuationSubring) : standardDVFCompletionField V K)
    rw [ValuedExtension.integerMap_apply,
      standardDVFCompletion_algebraMap_apply]
    exact standardDVFCompletionMap_isUniformizer V K pi hpi
  calc
    Ideal.map
          (algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring)
          base.maximalIdeal =
        Ideal.map
          (algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring)
          (Ideal.span ({pi} : Set base.valuationSubring)) := by
      exact congrArg
        (Ideal.map
          (algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring))
        (base.maximalIdeal_eq_span_uniformizer hpi)
    _ = Ideal.span ({piHat} : Set target.valuationSubring) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
      rfl
    _ = target.maximalIdeal :=
      (target.maximalIdeal_eq_span_uniformizer hpiHat).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFCompletion_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem standardDVFCompletion_faithfullyFlat
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K] :
    let base
proof:
:= standardDVFOfDVR V K
    let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
      standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
    letI : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
      standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
    Module.FaithfullyFlat
      base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring := by
  dsimp only
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
    standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
  have hinjective : Function.Injective
      (algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring) :=
    Valuation.HasExtension.algebraMap_injective
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree
      base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring :=
    Module.isTorsionFree_iff_algebraMap_injective.mpr hinjective
  let : Module.Flat base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring :=
    inferInstance
  exact Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.coe_standardDVRToCompletionValuationSubringMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_standardDVRToCompletionValuationSubringMap
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K] (x : V) :
    ((standardDVRToCompletionValuationSubringMap V K x :
        (standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K).valuationSubring) :
      standardDVFCompletionField V K) =
      standardDVFCompletionMap V K (algebraMap V K x)
proof:
:= by
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
    standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
  let e : V ≃+* base.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := V) (K := K)
  change algebraMap K (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
      ((e x : base.valuationSubring) : K) =
    standardDVFCompletionMap V K (algebraMap V K x)
  rw [standardDVFCompletion_algebraMap_apply]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq
statement:
theorem standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K] :
    let target
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra V target.valuationSubring :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    Ideal.map (algebraMap V target.valuationSubring)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) =
      target.maximalIdeal := by
  dsimp only
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
    standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
  let : Algebra V target.valuationSubring :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let e : V ≃+* base.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := V) (K := K)
  let g : base.valuationSubring →+* target.valuationSubring :=
    algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring
  calc
    Ideal.map (algebraMap V target.valuationSubring)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) =
        Ideal.map (g.comp e.toRingHom)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) := rfl
    _ = Ideal.map g
          (Ideal.map e.toRingHom (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)) := by
      exact (Ideal.map_map e.toRingHom g).symm
    _ = Ideal.map g base.maximalIdeal :=
      congrArg (Ideal.map g)
        (IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e)
    _ = target.maximalIdeal :=
      standardDVFCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom
statement:
theorem standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K] :
    let target
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra V target.valuationSubring :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    IsLocalHom (algebraMap V target.valuationSubring) := by
  dsimp only
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra V target.valuationSubring :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  have hmax : Ideal.map (algebraMap V target.valuationSubring)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) = target.maximalIdeal :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K
  exact ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE
    (algebraMap V target.valuationSubring)).out 3 1).mp hmax.le

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_pow_comap
statement:
theorem standardDVRToCompletion_maximalIdeal_pow_comap
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K] (n : ℕ) :
    let target
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra V target.valuationSubring :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    (target.maximalIdeal ^ n).comap
        (algebraMap V target.valuationSubring) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V ^ n := by
  dsimp only
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
    standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
  let : Algebra V target.valuationSubring :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat
      base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring :=
    standardDVFCompletion_faithfullyFlat V K
  let e : V ≃+* base.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := V) (K := K)
  let g : base.valuationSubring →+* target.valuationSubring :=
    algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring
  have hmap : Ideal.map g base.maximalIdeal = target.maximalIdeal :=
    standardDVFCompletion_maximalIdeal_map_eq V K
  have hemap :
      Ideal.map e.toRingHom (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) =
        base.maximalIdeal :=
    IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e
  calc
    (target.maximalIdeal ^ n).comap
          (algebraMap V target.valuationSubring) =
        ((Ideal.map g (base.maximalIdeal ^ n)).comap g).comap
          e.toRingHom := by
      rw [Ideal.comap_comap, Ideal.map_pow, hmap]
      rfl
    _ = (base.maximalIdeal ^ n).comap e.toRingHom := by
      rw [Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat]
    _ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V ^ n := by
      rw [← hemap, ← Ideal.map_pow]
      ext x
      change e x ∈
          Ideal.map e.toRingHom (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V ^ n) ↔
        x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V ^ n
      exact Ideal.apply_mem_of_equiv_iff

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRToCompletion_exists_approx_mod_maximalIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem standardDVRToCompletion_exists_approx_mod_maximalIdeal_pow
    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    (n : ℕ)
    (y : (standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K).valuationSubring) :
    let target
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra V target.valuationSubring :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    ∃ x : V,
      algebraMap V target.valuationSubring x - y ∈
        target.maximalIdeal ^ n := by
  dsimp only
  let v := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal V).valuation K
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let : Algebra K (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
    standardDVFCompletionAlgebra V K
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFCompletion_hasExtension V K
  let : Algebra V target.valuationSubring :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let e : V ≃+* base.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := V) (K := K)
  rcases base.exists_uniformizer with ⟨pi, hpi⟩
  let piHat : target.valuationSubring :=
    ValuedExtension.integerMap base target.toDVF pi
  have hpiHat : target.valuation.IsUniformizer
      (piHat : standardDVFCompletionField V K) := by
    change target.valuation.IsUniformizer
      (((ValuedExtension.integerMap base target.toDVF) pi :
        target.valuationSubring) : standardDVFCompletionField V K)
    rw [ValuedExtension.integerMap_apply,
      standardDVFCompletion_algebraMap_apply]
    exact standardDVFCompletionMap_isUniformizer V K pi hpi
  let radius : standardDVFCompletionField V K :=
    ((piHat ^ n : target.valuationSubring) :
      standardDVFCompletionField V K)
  have hradius_ne :
      (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) radius ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_valuation V K]
    change target.valuation
      ((piHat : standardDVFCompletionField V K) ^ n) ≠ 0
    rw [map_pow]
    exact pow_ne_zero n hpiHat.val_ne_zero
  have hrestrict_radius_ne :
      (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).restrict radius ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using hradius_ne
  let s : Set (standardDVFCompletionField V K) :=
    {z | (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
      (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
        (z - (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)) <
      (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) radius}
  have hs : s ∈ nhds (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K) := by
    rw [Valued.mem_nhds]
    refine ⟨Units.mk0
      ((Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).restrict radius)
      hrestrict_radius_ne, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    change (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).restrict
          (z - (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)) <
        (Units.mk0
          ((Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
            (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).restrict radius)
          hrestrict_radius_ne).1 at hz
    change (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
          (z - (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)) <
        (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
          (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) radius
    rw [Valuation.restrict_lt_iff_lt_embedding] at hz
    simpa using hz
  rcases UniformSpace.Completion.denseRange_coe.mem_nhds hs with
    ⟨a, ha⟩
  have ha_lt : (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
      (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
      ((a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) -
        (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)) <
      (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) radius := ha
  have hradius_le_one :
      (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) radius ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_valuation V K]
    change target.valuation
      ((piHat : standardDVFCompletionField V K) ^ n) ≤ 1
    rw [map_pow]
    exact pow_le_one₀ zero_le hpiHat.val_lt_one.le
  have ha_le : WithVal.valuation v a ≤ 1 := by
    have hy_le : (Valued.v : Valuation
        (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
        (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_valuation V K]
      exact y.2
    have hdiff_le_one : (Valued.v : Valuation
        (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
        ((a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) -
          (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)) ≤ 1 :=
      ha_lt.le.trans hradius_le_one
    have hsum_le : (Valued.v : Valuation
        (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
        (a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) ≤ 1 := by
      calc
        (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
            (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
              (a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) =
            (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
              (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
              (((a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) -
                  (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)) +
                (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)) := by
          ring_nf
        _ ≤ max
              ((Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
                (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
                ((a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) -
                  (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)))
              ((Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
                (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
                (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)) :=
          (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
            (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).map_add _ _
        _ ≤ 1 := max_le hdiff_le_one hy_le
    have hva : (Valued.v : Valuation (standardDVFCompletionField V K)
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
        ((a : WithVal v) : standardDVFCompletionField V K) =
        WithVal.valuation v a := by
      exact Valued.valuedCompletion_apply (x := a)
    simpa only [hva] using hsum_le
  let xK : K := WithVal.equiv v a
  have hxK : v xK ≤ 1 := by
    change v (WithVal.equiv v a) ≤ 1
    simpa [WithVal.equiv_apply,
      WithVal.valuation_apply_eq_ofVal] using ha_le
  let xBase : base.valuationSubring := ⟨xK, hxK⟩
  let x : V := e.symm xBase
  have hmap :
      (((algebraMap V target.valuationSubring x :
          target.valuationSubring) :
        standardDVFCompletionField V K)) =
        (a : standardDVFCompletionField V K) := by
    change
      ((standardDVRToCompletionValuationSubringMap V K x :
          target.valuationSubring) : standardDVFCompletionField V K) =
        (a : standardDVFCompletionField V K)
    rw [coe_standardDVRToCompletionValuationSubringMap]
    change standardDVFCompletionMap V K
        (algebraMap V K (e.symm xBase)) =
      (a : standardDVFCompletionField V K)
    have hxBase : algebraMap V K (e.symm xBase) =
        (xBase : K) := by
      change (((e (e.symm xBase) : base.valuationSubring) : K)) =
        (xBase : K)
      rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [hxBase]
    rfl
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  rw [Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_valuation_le_uniformizer_pow
    (val := target.valuation) (pi := piHat) (hpi := hpiHat) (n := n)]
  change target.valuation
      (((algebraMap V target.valuationSubring x :
          target.valuationSubring) : standardDVFCompletionField V K) -
        (y : standardDVFCompletionField V K)) ≤
    target.valuation
      ((piHat : standardDVFCompletionField V K) ^ n)
  rw [standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF_valuation, hmap]
  exact ha_lt.le

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRCompletionPowQuotientAlgHom_injective

    (V : Type uV) (K : Type uK)
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRCompletionPowQuotientAlgHom_surjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRCompletionPowQuotientAlgEquiv_factorPow

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.factorPow_evalₐ
statement:
private theorem factorPow_evalₐ
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (x : AdicCompletion I R) :
    Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I hmn (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I n x) =
      AdicCompletion.evalₐ I m x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I n x)
  have hn : AdicCompletion.eval I R n x =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n • ⊤ : Ideal R) a := by
    rw [← AdicCompletion.factor_evalₐ_eq_eval I x
      (by rw [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]), ← ha,
      Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk]
  have hm : AdicCompletion.eval I R m x =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ m • ⊤ : Ideal R) a := by
    calc
      AdicCompletion.eval I R m x =
          AdicCompletion.transitionMap I R hmn
            (AdicCompletion.eval I R n x) :=
        (AdicCompletion.transitionMap_comp_eval_apply I R hmn x).symm
      _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ m • ⊤ : Ideal R) a := by
        rw [hn]
        rfl
  calc
    Ideal.Quotient.factorPow I hmn (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I n x) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ m) a := by
      rw [← ha, Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk]
    _ = AdicCompletion.evalₐ I m x := by
      rw [← AdicCompletion.factor_eval_eq_evalₐ I x
        (by rw [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]), hm]
      rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective
statement:
theorem standardDVRToCompletion_residueFieldMap_bijective :
    let target
proof:
:= standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
    letI : Algebra V target.valuationSubring :=
      standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
    letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V target.valuationSubring) :=
      standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K

      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map
        (algebraMap V target.valuationSubring)) := by
  dsimp only
  let target := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K

  let : Algebra V T :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V T) :=
    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom V K
  constructor
  · exact RingHom.injective _
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective z
    let e₀ := standardDVRCompletionPowQuotientAlgEquiv V K 1
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := e₀.surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (target.maximalIdeal ^ 1) y)
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    refine ⟨IsLocalRing.residue V a, ?_⟩
    rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk target.maximalIdeal
        (algebraMap V T a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk target.maximalIdeal y

          (algebraMap V T a) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (target.maximalIdeal ^ 1) y := by
      simpa only [e₀,
        standardDVRCompletionPowQuotientAlgEquiv_apply_mk] using hx
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.mpr <| by
      simpa only [pow_one] using Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp hx'

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_map_maximalIdeal_isMaximal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_map_maximalIdeal_isMaximal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R'] [IsLocalRing S]
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R R')] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S)]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R R']
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R'))) :
    let T
proof:
:= R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).map (algebraMap S T)).IsMaximal := by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R S T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat S T :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
      (R := S) (M := S ⊗[R] R')
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight R S R').symm.toLinearEquiv
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  let q := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S
  let q' := q.map (algebraMap S T)
  let g : S →+* T ⧸ q' :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk q').comp (algebraMap S T)
  have hpq : p.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ q := by
    exact IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le (algebraMap R S)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective g := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul r' s =>
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hres.2 (IsLocalRing.residue R' r')
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective k
        let d : R' := r' - algebraMap R R' r
        have hdzero : IsLocalRing.residue R' d = 0 := by
          rw [map_sub,
            ← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue
              (algebraMap R R') r,
            hr, hk, sub_self]
        have hdmax : d ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R' :=
          (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff d).mp hdzero
        have hdpmap : d ∈ p.map (algebraMap R R') := by
          rw [hmax]
          exact hdmax
        have hdT : algebraMap R' T d ∈ q' := by
          have hdT' : algebraMap R' T d ∈
              (p.map (algebraMap R R')).map (algebraMap R' T) :=
            Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R' T) hdpmap
          have hpT : p.map (algebraMap R T) ≤ q' := by
            calc
              p.map (algebraMap R T) =
                  (p.map (algebraMap R S)).map (algebraMap S T) := by
                rw [Ideal.map_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S T]
              _ ≤ q.map (algebraMap S T) := Ideal.map_mono hpq
              _ = q' := rfl
          apply hpT
          simpa only [Ideal.map_map,
            IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R R' T] using hdT'
        have hdiff :
            r' ⊗ₜ[R] s -
                (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap R S r * s) : T) ∈ q' := by
          have hmul : algebraMap R' T d * algebraMap S T s ∈ q' :=
            q'.mul_mem_right (algebraMap S T s) hdT
          have hfirst :
              algebraMap R' T r' * algebraMap S T s =
                (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s : T) := by
            rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply,
              Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
          have hsecond :
              algebraMap R' T (algebraMap R R' r) *
                  algebraMap S T s =
                (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap R S r * s) : T) := by
            rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R R' T,
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S T,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply,
              Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul]
          simpa only [d, map_sub, sub_mul, hfirst, hsecond] using hmul
        refine ⟨algebraMap R S r * s, ?_⟩
        apply Ideal.Quotient.eq.2
        change algebraMap S T (algebraMap R S r * s) -
          (r' ⊗ₜ[R] s : T) ∈ q'
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply, ← neg_sub]
        exact q'.neg_mem hdiff
    | add x y hx hy =>
        obtain ⟨sx, hsx⟩ := hx
        obtain ⟨sy, hsy⟩ := hy
        refine ⟨sx + sy, ?_⟩
        change g (sx + sy) =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk q' (x + y)
        rw [map_add, map_add, hsx, hsy]
  have hker : RingHom.ker g = q := by
    ext s
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk q' (algebraMap S T s) = 0 ↔ s ∈ q
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    simpa [q'] using
      (show s ∈ (q.map (algebraMap S T)).comap
          (algebraMap S T) ↔ s ∈ q by
        rw [Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat])
  let : q.IsMaximal := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal S
  let : Field (S ⧸ q) := Ideal.Quotient.field q
  have hfieldKer : IsField (S ⧸ RingHom.ker g) := by
    rw [hker]
    exact Field.toIsField (S ⧸ q)
  have hfieldQuot : IsField (T ⧸ q') :=
    (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj).symm.toMulEquiv.isField
      hfieldKer
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient q').2
    hfieldQuot

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_map_maximalIdeal_liesOver_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_map_maximalIdeal_liesOver_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R'] [IsLocalRing S]
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R R')] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S)]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R R']
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R'))) :
    let T
proof:
:= R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    let q' := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).map (algebraMap S T)
    q'.IsMaximal ∧ q'.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R') := by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R S T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let : Algebra R' T := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R R' T := inferInstance
  let q := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S
  let q' := q.map (algebraMap S T)
  have hqmax : q'.IsMaximal :=
    tensorProduct_map_maximalIdeal_isMaximal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
      hmax hres
  have hunder :
      q'.under R' =
        (q.under R).map (algebraMap R R') :=
    Ideal.under_map_eq_map_under
      (P := q)
      (by
        have hqunder : q.under R = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
          simpa [q, Ideal.under_def] using
            IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (algebraMap R S)
        rw [hqunder, hmax]
        exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R')
      hqmax.ne_top
  refine ⟨hqmax, ?_⟩
  apply Ideal.LiesOver.mk
  rw [hunder]
  have hqunder : q.under R = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    simpa [q, Ideal.under_def] using
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (algebraMap R S)
  rw [hqunder, hmax]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_map_maximalIdeal_ramificationIdx_eq
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_map_maximalIdeal_ramificationIdx_eq
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R'] [IsLocalRing S]
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R R')] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S)]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R R'] [Module.Flat R S]
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R'))) :
    let T
proof:
:= R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).map (algebraMap S T)).ramificationIdx R' =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).ramificationIdx R := by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R S T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let : Algebra R' T := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R R' T := inferInstance
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat S T :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
      (R := S) (M := S ⊗[R] R')
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight R S R').symm.toLinearEquiv
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  let q := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S
  let p' := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R'
  let q' := q.map (algebraMap S T)
  let : q.IsPrime := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal S).isPrime
  let : q.LiesOver p :=
    Ideal.LiesOver.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (algebraMap R S)).symm
  have hgeom :=
    tensorProduct_map_maximalIdeal_liesOver_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) hmax hres
  let : q'.IsPrime := hgeom.1.isPrime
  let : q'.LiesOver p' := hgeom.2
  exact ramificationIdx_eq_of_flat_baseChange_mapped_primes
    p q p' q' hmax rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_retainedCompletedComponentTowerAlgHom
statement:
theorem exists_retainedCompletedComponentTowerAlgHom
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'}
    {S₀ : Type uS₀} {S₁ : Type uS₁}
    {K : Type uK} {K' : Type uK'}
    {L₀ : Type uL₀} {L₁ : Type uL₁}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [CommRing R'] [IsDomain R'] [Algebra R R']
    [CommRing S₀] [IsDomain S₀] [Algebra R S₀] [Module.Finite R S₀]
    [CommRing S₁] [IsDomain S₁] [Algebra R S₁] [Module.Finite R S₁]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field K'] [Algebra R' K'] [IsFractionRing R' K']
    [Field L₀] [Algebra S₀ L₀] [IsFractionRing S₀ L₀]
    [Algebra R L₀] [IsScalarTower R S₀ L₀]
    [Algebra K L₀] [IsScalarTower R K L₀]
    [Field L₁] [Algebra S₁ L₁] [IsFractionRing S₁ L₁]
    [Algebra R L₁] [IsScalarTower R S₁ L₁]
    [Algebra K L₁] [IsScalarTower R K L₁]
    [Algebra R K'] [IsScalarTower R R' K']
    [Algebra K K'] [IsScalarTower R K K']
    (g : S₀ →ₐ[R] S₁)
    (N : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S₁))
    [hNPrime : N.IsPrime] [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R')] :
    let fT
proof:
:= completedFiniteModelTowerAlgHom
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S₀ := S₀) (S₁ := S₁) g
    let N₀ := N.comap fT.toRingHom
    letI : N₀.IsPrime := hNPrime.comap fT.toRingHom
    let hN₀Over : N₀.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') := by
      refine ⟨?_⟩
      ext x
      change x ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R') ↔
        fT (algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] S₀) x) ∈ N
      have hleft :
          fT (algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] S₀) x) =
            algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] S₁) x := by
        exact fT.commutes x
      rw [hleft]
      exact N.mem_of_liesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') x
    letI : N₀.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') := hN₀Over
    let m₀ := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₀) (K := K) (L := L₀)
      (K' := K') N₀
    letI : m₀.IsMaximal :=
      retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
        (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₀) (K := K) (L := L₀)
        (K' := K') N₀
    let m₁ := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₁) (K := K) (L := L₁)
      (K' := K') N
    letI : m₁.IsMaximal :=
      retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
        (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₁) (K := K) (L := L₁)
        (K' := K') N
    ∃ f : GenericTensorFieldComponent m₀ →ₐ[K']
        GenericTensorFieldComponent m₁,
      Function.Injective f := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let T₀ := R' ⊗[R] S₀
  let T₁ := R' ⊗[R] S₁
  let fT := completedFiniteModelTowerAlgHom
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S₀ := S₀) (S₁ := S₁) g
  let N₀ := N.comap fT.toRingHom
  let : N₀.IsPrime := hNPrime.comap fT.toRingHom
  have hN₀Over : N₀.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    ext x
    change x ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R') ↔ fT (algebraMap R' T₀ x) ∈ N
    have hleft :
        fT (algebraMap R' T₀ x) = algebraMap R' T₁ x := by
      exact fT.commutes x
    rw [hleft]
    exact N.mem_of_liesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') x
  let : N₀.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') := hN₀Over
  let G₀ := retainedCompletedFiniteBaseChangeGenericFiber
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₀) (K' := K')
  let G₁ := retainedCompletedFiniteBaseChangeGenericFiber
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₁) (K' := K')
  let : Algebra T₀ G₀ := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : Algebra T₁ G₁ := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let fG : G₀ →ₐ[K'] G₁ :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id K' K') fT
  let n₀ := retainedCompletedGenericIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₀) (K' := K') N₀
  let n₁ := retainedCompletedGenericIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₁) (K' := K') N
  let hn₀Max : n₀.IsMaximal :=
    retainedCompletedGenericIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₀) (K' := K') N₀
  let hn₁Max : n₁.IsMaximal :=
    retainedCompletedGenericIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₁) (K' := K') N
  have hnle : n₀ ≤ n₁.comap fG.toRingHom := by
    change N₀.map (algebraMap T₀ G₀) ≤ n₁.comap fG.toRingHom
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro x hx
    change fG (algebraMap T₀ G₀ x) ∈ n₁
    have hxN : fT x ∈ N := hx
    have hxMap : algebraMap T₁ G₁ (fT x) ∈ n₁ :=
      Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap T₁ G₁) hxN
    have hsquare :
        fG (algebraMap T₀ G₀ x) = algebraMap T₁ G₁ (fT x) := by
      change fG ((1 : K') ⊗ₜ[R'] x) =
        (1 : K') ⊗ₜ[R'] fT x
      exact Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul
        (AlgHom.id K' K') fT (1 : K') x
    rwa [hsquare]
  have hncomap : n₁.comap fG.toRingHom = n₀ := by
    have h := hn₀Max.eq_of_le
      (hn₁Max.isPrime.comap fG.toRingHom).ne_top
      hnle
    exact h.symm
  let qG : (G₀ ⧸ n₀) →ₐ[K'] (G₁ ⧸ n₁) :=
    Ideal.quotientMapₐ n₁ fG hnle
  have hqG : Function.Injective qG := by
    exact Ideal.quotientMap_injective' (H := hnle)
      (show n₁.comap fG.toRingHom ≤ n₀ by rw [hncomap])
  let e₀ := retainedCompletedGenericFiberEquiv
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₀) (K := K) (L := L₀)
    (K' := K')
  let e₁ := retainedCompletedGenericFiberEquiv
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₁) (K := K) (L := L₁)
    (K' := K')
  let m₀ := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₀) (K := K) (L := L₀)
    (K' := K') N₀
  let m₁ := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₁) (K := K) (L := L₁)
    (K' := K') N
  let : m₀.IsMaximal :=
    retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₀) (K := K) (L := L₀)
      (K' := K') N₀
  let : m₁.IsMaximal :=
    retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S₁) (K := K) (L := L₁)
      (K' := K') N
  let eComp₀ : (G₀ ⧸ n₀) ≃ₐ[K'] GenericTensorFieldComponent m₀ :=
    Ideal.quotientEquivAlg n₀ m₀ e₀ rfl
  let eComp₁ : (G₁ ⧸ n₁) ≃ₐ[K'] GenericTensorFieldComponent m₁ :=
    Ideal.quotientEquivAlg n₁ m₁ e₁ rfl
  let f : GenericTensorFieldComponent m₀ →ₐ[K']
      GenericTensorFieldComponent m₁ :=
    eComp₁.toAlgHom.comp (qG.comp eComp₀.symm.toAlgHom)
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  exact eComp₁.injective.comp (hqG.comp eComp₀.symm.injective)

theorem

    [IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime Q)]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime Q)] :
    let T
proof:
:= R' ⊗[R] S
    let m := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    letI : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    let Omega := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    let r'OmegaAlgebra : Algebra R' Omega :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := R') m
    letI : Algebra R' Omega := r'OmegaAlgebra
    letI : SMul R' Omega := r'OmegaAlgebra.toSMul
    letI : IsScalarTower R' K' Omega :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    let IC := integralClosure R' Omega
    let jIC := retainedCompletedChosenNormalizationAlgHom
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    letI : Algebra T IC := jIC.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower R' T IC :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ (jIC.commutes x).symm
    ∀ (qhat : Ideal IC) [qhat.IsPrime] [qhat.LiesOver Q],
      let P := Q.under R'

      letI : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.over_under (A := R') Q

        Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q

        Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P qhat
      ∃ _ : W ≃ₐ[V] D,
        qhat.ramificationIdx R' = Q.ramificationIdx R' := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  intro qhat _ _
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S

    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N

    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N
  let jIC := retainedCompletedChosenNormalizationAlgHom
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N
  let : Algebra T Omega := j.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra T IC := jIC.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R' T IC :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ (jIC.commutes x).symm
  let P := Q.under R'
  let : P.IsPrime := inferInstance
  let : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.over_under (A := R') Q
  let : qhat.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans qhat Q P
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let W := Localization.AtPrime Q

      Q qhat (algebraMap T IC) Ideal.LiesOver.over
  let : Algebra W Omega :=
    retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalizationAlgebra
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N Q hNQ
  let : IsScalarTower T W Omega :=
    retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalization_isScalarTower

  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    fractionFields_finiteDimensional_of_moduleFinite

  let : IsScalarTower R' K' Omega := inferInstance

    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := Omega) qhat

  let : IsScalarTower T IC Omega :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsScalarTower T D Omega := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply T IC Omega,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply T IC D,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply IC D Omega]
  let : IsScalarTower T W D := inferInstance
  have hTowerHom :
      (algebraMap D Omega).comp (algebraMap W D) =
        algebraMap W Omega := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext Q.primeCompl
    ext x
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
      change algebraMap D Omega
          (algebraMap W D
            (algebraMap T W
              ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : R' →ₐ[R] T) x))) =
        algebraMap W Omega
          (algebraMap T W
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : R' →ₐ[R] T) x))
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply T W D,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply T D Omega,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply T W Omega]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
      change algebraMap D Omega
          (algebraMap W D
            (algebraMap T W
              ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[R] T) x))) =
        algebraMap W Omega
          (algebraMap T W
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[R] T) x))
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply T W D,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply T D Omega,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply T W Omega]
  let : IsScalarTower W D Omega :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' hTowerHom.symm
  have hWDInjective : Function.Injective (algebraMap W D) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply IsFractionRing.injective W Omega
    rw [← hTowerHom]
    exact congrArg (algebraMap D Omega) hxy
  have hWDSurjective : Function.Surjective (algebraMap W D) := by
    intro d
    by_cases hd : d = 0
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [map_zero, hd]
    let x : Omega := algebraMap D Omega d
    have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
      exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective D Omega)).2 hd
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ | ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
      ValuationRing.isInteger_or_isInteger (R := W) x
    · refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
      apply IsFractionRing.injective D Omega
      simpa only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply W D Omega] using hw
    · have hprodOmega :
          algebraMap D Omega (algebraMap W D w * d) =
            algebraMap D Omega 1 := by
        rw [map_mul, map_one,
          ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply W D Omega, hw]
        exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hx
      have hprodD : algebraMap W D w * d = 1 :=
        (IsFractionRing.injective D Omega) hprodOmega
      have hunitMap : IsUnit (algebraMap W D w) := by
        rw [isUnit_iff_exists_inv]
        exact ⟨d, hprodD⟩
      have hunitW : IsUnit w :=
        (isUnit_map_iff (algebraMap W D) w).mp hunitMap
      rcases hunitW with ⟨u, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨↑u⁻¹, ?_⟩
      calc
        algebraMap W D (↑u⁻¹) =
            algebraMap W D (↑u⁻¹) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ = algebraMap W D (↑u⁻¹) *
              (algebraMap W D (↑u) * d) := by rw [hprodD]
        _ = d := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, Units.inv_mul, map_one, one_mul]
  let eW : W ≃ₐ[W] D :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId W D)
      ⟨hWDInjective, hWDSurjective⟩
  let eV : W ≃ₐ[V] D := eW.restrictScalars V
  have hQDisjoint :
      Disjoint (Q.primeCompl : Set T) (Q : Set T) :=
    Set.disjoint_compl_left_iff_subset.mpr le_rfl
  have hQlocal := ramificationIdx_map_eq_of_isLocalization
    (R := R') (S := T) (R' := V) (S' := W)
    P.primeCompl Q.primeCompl Q hQDisjoint
  have hQmap : Q.map (algebraMap T W) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W :=
    Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal
  rw [hQmap] at hQlocal
  have hqhatDisjoint :
      Disjoint (qhat.primeCompl : Set IC) (qhat : Set IC) :=
    Set.disjoint_compl_left_iff_subset.mpr le_rfl
  have hqhatLocal := ramificationIdx_map_eq_of_isLocalization
    (R := R') (S := IC) (R' := V) (S' := D)
    P.primeCompl qhat.primeCompl qhat hqhatDisjoint
  have hqhatMap : qhat.map (algebraMap IC D) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D :=
    Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal
  rw [hqhatMap] at hqhatLocal
  refine ⟨eV, ?_⟩
  calc
    qhat.ramificationIdx R' =
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D).ramificationIdx V :=
      hqhatLocal.symm
    _ = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W).ramificationIdx V :=
      (maximalIdeal_ramificationIdx_eq_of_algEquiv eV).symm
    _ = Q.ramificationIdx R' := hQlocal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedFiniteModelTowerAlgHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem completedFiniteModelTowerAlgHom_tmul
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'}
    {S₀ : Type uS₀} {S₁ : Type uS₁}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S₀] [CommRing S₁]
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S₀] [Algebra R S₁]
    (g : S₀ →ₐ[R] S₁) (x : R') (s : S₀) :
    completedFiniteModelTowerAlgHom
        (R := R) (R' := R') (S₀ := S₀) (S₁ := S₁)
        g
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] s) =
      x ⊗ₜ[R] g s

:= by

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedFiniteModelTower_contract_primeChain
statement:
theorem completedFiniteModelTower_contract_primeChain
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'}
    {S₀ : Type uS₀} {S₁ : Type uS₁}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S₀] [CommRing S₁]
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S₀] [Algebra R S₁]
    (g : S₀ →ₐ[R] S₁)
    (q₀ : Ideal S₀) (q₁ : Ideal S₁)
    [q₀.IsPrime] [q₁.IsPrime]
    (hq₁q₀ : q₁.comap g.toRingHom = q₀)
    (N Q : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S₁))
    [hNPrime : N.IsPrime] [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R')]
    [hQPrime : Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver q₁]
    (hNQ : N ≤ Q) :
    let f
proof:
:= completedFiniteModelTowerAlgHom
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S₀ := S₀) (S₁ := S₁) g
    let N₀ := N.comap f.toRingHom
    let Q₀ := Q.comap f.toRingHom
    N₀ ≤ Q₀ ∧ N₀.IsPrime ∧ N₀.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') ∧
      Q₀.IsPrime ∧ Q₀.LiesOver q₀ := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let f := completedFiniteModelTowerAlgHom
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S₀ := S₀) (S₁ := S₁) g
  let N₀ := N.comap f.toRingHom
  let Q₀ := Q.comap f.toRingHom
  have hN₀Q₀ : N₀ ≤ Q₀ := Ideal.comap_mono hNQ
  have hN₀Prime : N₀.IsPrime :=
    hNPrime.comap f.toRingHom
  have hQ₀Prime : Q₀.IsPrime :=
    hQPrime.comap f.toRingHom
  let : N₀.IsPrime := hN₀Prime
  let : Q₀.IsPrime := hQ₀Prime
  have hN₀Over : N₀.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    ext x
    change x ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R') ↔
      f (algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] S₀) x) ∈ N
    have hleft :
        f (algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] S₀) x) =
          algebraMap R' (R' ⊗[R] S₁) x := by
      exact f.commutes x
    rw [hleft]
    exact N.mem_of_liesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') x
  have hQ₀Over : Q₀.LiesOver q₀ := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    ext s
    change s ∈ q₀ ↔ f (algebraMap S₀ (R' ⊗[R] S₀) s) ∈ Q
    have hright :
        f (algebraMap S₀ (R' ⊗[R] S₀) s) =
          algebraMap S₁ (R' ⊗[R] S₁) (g s) := by
      change f ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] s) =
        (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] g s
      simp [f, completedFiniteModelTowerAlgHom]
    rw [hright]
    rw [← hq₁q₀]
    exact Q.mem_of_liesOver q₁ (g s)
  exact ⟨hN₀Q₀, hN₀Prime, hN₀Over, hQ₀Prime, hQ₀Over⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.retainedCompletedPrefix_normalization_boundaryAway
statement:
theorem retainedCompletedPrefix_normalization_boundaryAway
    {B : Type uB} {K : Type uK} {M : Type uM}
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsRegularLocalRing B]
    [Field K] [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K]
    [Field M] [Algebra B M] [Algebra K M] [IsScalarTower B K M]
    [FiniteDimensional K M] [Algebra.IsSeparable K M]
    (y z : B) (hreg : IsRegular B [y, z])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [y, z] = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim B = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (N : Ideal
      ((AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B) ⊗[B]
        (integralClosure B M)))
    [N.IsPrime]
    [N.LiesOver
      (⊥ : Ideal (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B))]
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap B (integralClosure B M)) y).Etale) :
    let C
proof:
:= integralClosure B M
    let hCFinite : Module.Finite B C :=
      SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_finite_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
        (K := K) hdim
    letI : Module.Finite B C := hCFinite
    let hCFraction : IsFractionRing C M :=
      IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension B K M C
    letI : IsFractionRing C M := hCFraction
    let hCFaithful : FaithfulSMul B C :=
      (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective B C).mpr fun x w hxw ↦ by
        apply (IsFractionRing.injective B K)
        apply (algebraMap K M).injective
        have hxM := congrArg (fun c : C ↦ (c : M)) hxw
        change algebraMap B M x = algebraMap B M w at hxM
        calc
          algebraMap K M (algebraMap B K x) = algebraMap B M x :=
            (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B K M x).symm
          _ = algebraMap B M w := hxM
          _ = algebraMap K M (algebraMap B K w) :=
            IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B K M w
    letI : FaithfulSMul B C := hCFaithful
    let Bhat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B
    let hgeometry :=
      Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_regularPair_geometry hreg hgen
    let hBhatDomain : IsDomain Bhat := hgeometry.1
    letI : IsDomain Bhat := hBhatDomain
    let hBhatNoetherian : IsNoetherianRing Bhat :=
      Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing_of_regularPair hreg hgen
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Bhat := hBhatNoetherian
    let yhat := algebraMap B Bhat y
    let zhat := algebraMap B Bhat z
    let hregHat : IsRegular Bhat [yhat, zhat] := by
      simpa only [Bhat, yhat, zhat] using hgeometry.2.1
    let hgenHat : Ideal.ofList [yhat, zhat] =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Bhat := by
      simpa only [Bhat, yhat, zhat] using hgeometry.2.2.1
    let hBhatNormal : IsIntegrallyClosed Bhat :=
      SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
        Bhat yhat zhat hregHat hgenHat
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed Bhat := hBhatNormal
    let Khat := FractionRing Bhat
    let hBhatFaithfullyFlat : Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat :=
      Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
    letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat := hBhatFaithfullyFlat
    letI : FaithfulSMul B Khat := FaithfulSMul.trans B Bhat Khat
    letI : Algebra K Khat :=
      (IsFractionRing.lift
        (A := B) (K := K) (L := Khat)
        (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective B Khat)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower B K Khat :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun b x ↦ by
        rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def]
        change
          (IsFractionRing.lift
            (A := B) (K := K) (L := Khat)
            (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective B Khat))
              (algebraMap B K b) * x =
            algebraMap B Khat b * x
        rw [IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap]
    let m := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
      (R := B) (R' := Bhat) (S := C) (K := K) (L := M)
      (K' := Khat) N
    letI : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := B) (R' := Bhat) (S := C) (K := K) (L := M)
      (K' := Khat) N
    let Omega := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    letI : Algebra Bhat Omega :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Bhat) m
    letI : SMul Bhat Omega :=
      (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Bhat) m).toSMul
    letI : IsScalarTower Bhat Khat Omega :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    (Localization.awayMap
      (algebraMap Bhat (integralClosure Bhat Omega)) yhat).Etale := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let C := integralClosure B M
  let : Module.Finite B C :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.integralClosure_finite_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      (K := K) hdim
  let : IsFractionRing C M :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension B K M C
  let : FaithfulSMul B C :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective B C).mpr fun x w hxw ↦ by
      apply (IsFractionRing.injective B K)
      apply (algebraMap K M).injective
      have hxM := congrArg (fun c : C ↦ (c : M)) hxw
      change algebraMap B M x = algebraMap B M w at hxM
      calc
        algebraMap K M (algebraMap B K x) = algebraMap B M x :=
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B K M x).symm
        _ = algebraMap B M w := hxM
        _ = algebraMap K M (algebraMap B K w) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B K M w
  let Bhat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) B
  have hgeometry :=
    Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_regularPair_geometry hreg hgen
  let : IsDomain Bhat := hgeometry.1
  let : IsNoetherianRing Bhat :=
    Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_isNoetherianRing_of_regularPair hreg hgen
  let yhat : Bhat := algebraMap B Bhat y
  let zhat : Bhat := algebraMap B Bhat z
  have hregHat : IsRegular Bhat [yhat, zhat] := by
    simpa only [Bhat, yhat, zhat] using hgeometry.2.1
  have hgenHat : Ideal.ofList [yhat, zhat] =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Bhat := by
    simpa only [Bhat, yhat, zhat] using hgeometry.2.2.1
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed Bhat :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
      Bhat yhat zhat hregHat hgenHat
  let Khat := FractionRing Bhat
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat B Bhat :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let : FaithfulSMul B Khat := FaithfulSMul.trans B Bhat Khat
  let : Algebra K Khat :=
    (IsFractionRing.lift
      (A := B) (K := K) (L := Khat)
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective B Khat)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower B K Khat :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun b x ↦ by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def]
      change
        (IsFractionRing.lift
          (A := B) (K := K) (L := Khat)
          (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective B Khat))
            (algebraMap B K b) * x =
          algebraMap B Khat b * x
      rw [IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap]
  let m := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
    (R := B) (R' := Bhat) (S := C) (K := K) (L := M)
    (K' := Khat) N
  let : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
    (R := B) (R' := Bhat) (S := C) (K := K) (L := M)
    (K' := Khat) N
  let Omega := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let omegaAlgebra : Algebra Bhat Omega :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := Bhat) m
  let : SMul Bhat Omega := omegaAlgebra.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower Bhat Khat Omega :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hyne : y ≠ 0 :=
    (Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen (List.mem_cons_self)).ne_zero
  simpa only [Omega, yhat] using
    (localization_away_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_awayMap
      (A := B) (C := C) (D := Bhat)
      (F := K) (E := M) (K := Khat)
      y hyne hAway m)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_tensorProduct_prime_le_retainedClosedPrime
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_prime_le_retainedClosedPrime
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R']
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R R')]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R R']
    (q p : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [p.IsMaximal]
    [p.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hqp : q ≤ p)
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R'))) :
    let T
proof:
:= R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    let P := p.map (algebraMap S T)
    ∃ Q : Ideal T,
      Q ≤ P ∧ Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.LiesOver q ∧
        P.IsMaximal ∧ P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R') := by
  dsimp only
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R S T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat S T :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_linearEquiv
      (R := S) (M := S ⊗[R] R')
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight R S R').symm.toLinearEquiv
  let P := p.map (algebraMap S T)
  have hPGeometry :=
    tensorProduct_map_liesOver_maximalIdeal_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
      (R := R) (R' := R') p hmax hres
  let : P.IsPrime := hPGeometry.1.isPrime
  let : P.LiesOver p := by
    exact
      Ideal.LiesOver.mk
        (Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat
          (B := T) p).symm
  obtain ⟨Q, hQP, hQPrime, hQOver⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_le_liesOver_of_le
      (R := S) (S := T) (p := q) (q := p) P hqp
  exact ⟨Q, hQP, hQPrime, hQOver,
    hPGeometry.1, hPGeometry.2⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_tensorProduct_genericPrime_le_prime_le_retainedClosedPrime
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_genericPrime_le_prime_le_retainedClosedPrime
    {R : Type uR} {R' : Type uR'} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R'] [IsDomain R']
    [Algebra R R'] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R R')]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R R'] [Module.Flat R S]
    (q p : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [p.IsMaximal]
    [p.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hqp : q ≤ p)
    (hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R R') =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R')
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R R'))) :
    let T
proof:
:= R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    let P := p.map (algebraMap S T)
    ∃ N Q : Ideal T,
      N ≤ Q ∧ Q ≤ P ∧
        N.IsPrime ∧ N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') ∧
        Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.LiesOver q ∧
        P.IsMaximal ∧ P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R') := by
  dsimp only
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let : Algebra R' T := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R R' T := inferInstance
  let : IsScalarTower R S T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let : Module.Flat R' T := Module.Flat.baseChange R R' S
  obtain ⟨Q, hQP, hQPrime, hQOver, hPMax, hPOver⟩ :=
    exists_tensorProduct_prime_le_retainedClosedPrime
      (R := R) (R' := R') q p hqp hmax hres
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQPrime
  let qR' := Q.under R'
  let : qR'.IsPrime := hQPrime.comap (algebraMap R' T)
  let : Q.LiesOver qR' := Ideal.over_under (A := R') Q
  obtain ⟨N, hNQ, hNPrime, hNOver⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_le_liesOver_of_le
      (R := R') (S := T) (p := (⊥ : Ideal R'))
      (q := qR') Q bot_le
  exact ⟨N, Q, hNQ, hQP, hNPrime, hNOver,
    hQPrime, hQOver, hPMax, hPOver⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_adicCompletion_genericPrime_le_prime_le_retainedClosedPrime
statement:
theorem exists_adicCompletion_genericPrime_le_prime_le_retainedClosedPrime
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Flat R S]
    (q p : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [p.IsMaximal]
    [p.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hqp : q ≤ p)
    (hcompletionDomain :
      IsDomain (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R)) :
    let R'
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R
    let T := R' ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    let P := p.map (algebraMap S T)
    ∃ N Q : Ideal T,
      N ≤ Q ∧ Q ≤ P ∧
        N.IsPrime ∧ N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R') ∧
        Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.LiesOver q ∧
        P.IsMaximal ∧ P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R') := by
  dsimp only
  let R' := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R
  let : IsDomain R' := hcompletionDomain
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R R' :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  exact
    exists_tensorProduct_genericPrime_le_prime_le_retainedClosedPrime
      (R := R) (R' := R') q p hqp
      AdicCompletion.maximalIdeal_eq_map.symm
      (AdicCompletion.residueField_map_bijective R)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.retainedCompletedGenericPrime_disjoint
statement:
theorem retainedCompletedGenericPrime_disjoint
    (N : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [N.IsPrime]
    [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R')] :
    let T
proof:
:= R' ⊗[R] S
    Disjoint
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T (nonZeroDivisors R') : Set T)
      (N : Set T) := by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxM hxN
  rcases hxM with ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  have hrN : r ∈ N.under R' := hxN
  have hr0 : r = 0 := by
    have : r ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R') := by
      rw [N.over_def (⊥ : Ideal R')]
      exact hrN
    simpa only [Ideal.mem_bot] using this
  exact (nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero ⟨r, hr⟩) hr0

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.retainedCompletedGenericIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem retainedCompletedGenericIdeal_isMaximal
    (N : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [N.IsPrime]
    [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R')] :
    (retainedCompletedGenericIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K' := K') N).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let G := retainedCompletedFiniteBaseChangeGenericFiber
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K' := K')
  let m := retainedCompletedGenericIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K' := K') N
  let : Algebra T G := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T (nonZeroDivisors R')) G :=
    IsLocalization.tensorRight (R := R') (S := T) (A := K')
      (nonZeroDivisors R')
  have hmPrime : m.IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T (nonZeroDivisors R')) G N
      inferInstance
      (retainedCompletedGenericPrime_disjoint
        (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) N)
  let : m.IsPrime := hmPrime
  let : Module.Finite R' T := Module.Finite.base_change R R' S
  let : Module.Finite K' G := Module.Finite.base_change R' K' T
  apply Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under (R := K') m
  rw [Ideal.under_def]
  have hcomapPrime :
      (m.comap (algebraMap K' G)).IsPrime := hmPrime.comap _
  let : (m.comap (algebraMap K' G)).IsPrime := hcomapPrime
  rw [Ideal.eq_bot_of_prime (m.comap (algebraMap K' G))]
  exact Ideal.bot_isMaximal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_adicCompletion_genericPrime_le_regularBranch_le_retainedClosedPrime
statement:
theorem
    exists_adicCompletion_genericPrime_le_regularBranch_le_retainedClosedPrime
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.Flat R S]
    {x y : R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R [x, y])
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R)
    (q p : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [p.IsMaximal]
    [p.LiesOver (maximalIdeal R)]
    (hqp : q ≤ p)
    (hqUnder : q.under R = Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)) :
    let Rhat
proof:
:= AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
    let T := Rhat ⊗[R] S
    letI : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    let P := p.map (algebraMap S T)
    ∃ N Q : Ideal T,
      N ≤ Q ∧ Q ≤ P ∧
        N.IsPrime ∧ N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal Rhat) ∧
        Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.LiesOver q ∧
        Q.LiesOver
          (Ideal.span
            ({algebraMap R Rhat x} : Set Rhat)) ∧
        P.IsMaximal ∧ P.LiesOver (maximalIdeal Rhat) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let Rhat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R
  let T := Rhat ⊗[R] S
  let : Algebra Rhat T := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : Algebra S T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R Rhat T := inferInstance
  let : IsScalarTower R S T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let : IsDomain R :=
    Kummer.isDomain_of_regularSystem [x, y] hreg hgen
  have hgeometry :=
    Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_regularPair_geometry hreg hgen
  let : IsDomain Rhat := hgeometry.1
  obtain
      ⟨N, Q, hNQ, hQP, hNPrime, hNOver,
        hQPrime, hQOver, hPMax, hPOver⟩ :=
    exists_adicCompletion_genericPrime_le_prime_le_retainedClosedPrime
      (R := R) (S := S) q p hqp hgeometry.1
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQPrime
  let : Q.LiesOver q := hQOver
  have hbalanced (r : R) :
      algebraMap Rhat T (algebraMap R Rhat r) =
        algebraMap S T (algebraMap R S r) := by
    change
      (algebraMap R Rhat r) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S) =
        (1 : Rhat) ⊗ₜ[R] algebraMap R S r
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul r
  let qhat : Ideal Rhat := Q.under Rhat
  let : qhat.IsPrime := hQPrime.comap (algebraMap Rhat T)
  have hqhatUnder : qhat.under R = q.under R := by
    ext r
    change
      algebraMap Rhat T (algebraMap R Rhat r) ∈ Q ↔
        algebraMap R S r ∈ q
    rw [hbalanced r]
    exact (Q.mem_of_liesOver q (algebraMap R S r)).symm
  have hqhat :
      qhat = Ideal.span
        ({algebraMap R Rhat x} : Set Rhat) :=
    Kummer.maximalAdicCompletion_prime_eq_mapped_span_first_of_under_eq
      hreg hgen qhat (hqhatUnder.trans hqUnder)
  have hQBranch :
      Q.LiesOver
        (Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Rhat x} : Set Rhat)) :=
    ⟨hqhat.symm⟩
  exact ⟨N, Q, hNQ, hQP, hNPrime, hNOver,
    hQPrime, hQOver, hQBranch, hPMax, hPOver⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.retainedCompletedChosenComponentAlgHom_ker
statement:
theorem retainedCompletedChosenComponentAlgHom_ker
    (N : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [N.IsPrime]
    [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R')] :
    let m
proof:
:= retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    letI : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    letI : Algebra R' M :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := R') m
    RingHom.ker
        (retainedCompletedChosenComponentAlgHom
          (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
          (K' := K') N).toRingHom = N := by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let G₀ := retainedCompletedFiniteBaseChangeGenericFiber
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K' := K')
  let e := retainedCompletedGenericFiberEquiv
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
  let n₀ := retainedCompletedGenericIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K' := K') N
  let m := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N
  let : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
  let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let r'MAlgebra : Algebra R' M :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := R') m
  let : Algebra R' M := r'MAlgebra
  let : Algebra T G₀ := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let M : Submonoid T :=
    Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T (nonZeroDivisors R')
  let : IsLocalization M G₀ :=
    IsLocalization.tensorRight (R := R') (S := T) (A := K')
      (nonZeroDivisors R')
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint (M : Set T) (N : Set T) :=
    retainedCompletedGenericPrime_disjoint
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) N
  have hn₀Comap : n₀.comap (algebraMap T G₀) = N :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint
      M G₀ (inferInstance : N.IsPrime) hdisjoint
  have hmComap : m.comap e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom = n₀ := by
    exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective
      e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom e.toRingEquiv.bijective
  ext x
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk m (e (algebraMap T G₀ x)) = 0 ↔ x ∈ N
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  change x ∈ (m.comap e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).comap
      (algebraMap T G₀) ↔ x ∈ N
  rw [hmComap, hn₀Comap]

        (retainedCompletedChosenNormalizationAlgHom

  let m := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_retainedCompletedNormalizationPrimeChain
statement:
theorem exists_retainedCompletedNormalizationPrimeChain
    (N Q P : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S))
    [N.IsPrime] [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R')]
    [Q.IsPrime] [P.IsMaximal]
    (hNQ : N ≤ Q) (hQP : Q ≤ P) :
    HasRetainedCompletedNormalizationPrimeChain
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N Q P
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasRetainedCompletedNormalizationPrimeChain
  dsimp only
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let m := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N
  let : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
  let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let r'MAlgebra : Algebra R' M :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := R') m
  let : Algebra R' M := r'MAlgebra
  let IC := integralClosure R' M
  let j := retainedCompletedChosenNormalizationAlgHom
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N
  let : Algebra T IC := j.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R' T IC :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ (j.commutes x).symm
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R' IC :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_algebra R' M
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral T IC := Algebra.IsIntegral.tower_top R'
  have hkerQ : RingHom.ker (algebraMap T IC) ≤ Q := by
    change RingHom.ker j.toRingHom ≤ Q
    rw [retainedCompletedChosenNormalizationAlgHom_ker
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N]
    exact hNQ
  obtain ⟨q, -, hqPrime, hqComap⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral Q (⊥ : Ideal IC) hkerQ
  let : q.IsPrime := hqPrime
  have hqOver : q.LiesOver Q :=
    (Ideal.liesOver_iff q Q).mpr hqComap.symm
  have hqP : q.comap (algebraMap T IC) ≤ P := by
    change q.under T ≤ P
    rw [hqComap]
    exact hQP
  obtain ⟨p, hqp, hpPrime, hpComap⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime P q hqP
  let : p.IsPrime := hpPrime
  have hpMax : p.IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_under
      (R := T) (S := IC) p (hpComap.symm ▸ (inferInstance : P.IsMaximal))
  exact ⟨q, p, hqp, hqPrime, hqOver, hpMax,
    (Ideal.liesOver_iff p P).mpr hpComap.symm⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etale_of_completedPrimeValuationSubring_etale
statement:
theorem etale_of_completedPrimeValuationSubring_etale
    {V : Type uV} {C : Type uC}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CommRing C] [IsDedekindDomain C]
    [Algebra V C] [Algebra.IsIntegral V C]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree V C] [Module.Finite V C]
    {K : Type uK} [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    {L : Type uL} [Field L] [Algebra C L] [IsFractionRing C L]
    (hlocal :
      let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
      let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
      let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
      let A := fun Q : p.primesOver C =>
        completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q
      letI : Algebra V Vhat :=
        standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
      letI : ∀ Q, Algebra Vhat (A Q) := fun Q =>
        completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
          (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q
      ∀ Q, Algebra.Etale Vhat (A Q)) :
    Algebra.Etale V C
proof:
:= by
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
  let H := standardDVFCompletionCompleteDVF V K
  let Vhat := H.valuationSubring
  let A := fun Q : p.primesOver C =>
    completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q
  let : Algebra V Vhat :=
    standardDVFCompletionValuationSubringAlgebra V K
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V Vhat :=
    standardDVRCompletionValuationSubring_faithfullyFlat
      (V := V) (K := K)
  let U := Vhat ⊗[V] C
  let : Algebra Vhat U := Algebra.TensorProduct.leftAlgebra
  let : ∀ Q, Algebra Vhat (A Q) := fun Q =>
    completedPrimeValuationSubringCompletionAlgebra
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) Q
  let : ∀ Q, Algebra.Etale Vhat (A Q) := hlocal
  let E : U ≃ₐ[Vhat] ∀ Q, A Q :=
    completedDVRIntegralExtensionLocalFactorsCompletionAlgEquiv
      (V := V) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L)
  let : Algebra.Etale Vhat (∀ Q, A Q) := inferInstance
  let : Algebra.Etale Vhat U := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv E.symm
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_etale_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat Vhat

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completedPrimeMap_comap_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem completedPrimeMap_comap_maximalIdeal
    (Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C) :

      (completedPrimeValuationSubring (L := L) Q)).comap
        (completedPrimeMap (L := L) Q) = Q.1
proof:

    simpa [ne_eq, ← IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq] using
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField V)

    Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hp Q.1

    IsLocalization.AtPrime.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_dedekind_domain C hQ W

    standardDVRToCompletion_isLocalHom W L

      ((algebraMap W F).comp (algebraMap C W)) = Q.1

    (x : C) (Q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C) :

    standardDVRToCompletionValuationSubringMap
      (Localization.AtPrime Q.1) L
