theorem retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalization_isScalarTower
    (N Q : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [N.IsPrime]
    [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R')] [Q.IsPrime] (hNQ : N ≤ Q) :
    let m
proof:
:= retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    letI : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    let Ω := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    letI : Algebra R' Ω :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := R') m
    let j := retainedCompletedChosenComponentAlgHom
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    letI : Algebra (R' ⊗[R] S) Ω :=
      j.toAlgebra
    letI := retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalizationAlgebra
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N Q hNQ
    IsScalarTower (R' ⊗[R] S) (Localization.AtPrime Q)
      Ω := by
  dsimp only
  let m := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N
  let : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
  let Ω := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let r'ΩAlgebra : Algebra R' Ω :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := R') m
  let : Algebra R' Ω := r'ΩAlgebra
  let j := retainedCompletedChosenComponentAlgHom
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N
  let : Algebra (R' ⊗[R] S) (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) :=
    j.toAlgebra
  let := retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalizationAlgebra
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N Q hNQ
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
  rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  exact (IsLocalization.lift_comp _).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalization_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalization_isFractionRing
    (N Q : Ideal (R' ⊗[R] S)) [N.IsPrime]
    [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R')] [Q.IsPrime]
    [IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime Q)] (hNQ : N ≤ Q) :
    let m
proof:
:= retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    letI : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
    let Ω := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    letI : Algebra R' Ω :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := R') m
    letI := retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalizationAlgebra
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N Q hNQ
    IsFractionRing (Localization.AtPrime Q) Ω := by
  let T := R' ⊗[R] S
  let W := Localization.AtPrime Q
  let G₀ := retainedCompletedFiniteBaseChangeGenericFiber
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K' := K')
  let e := retainedCompletedGenericFiberEquiv
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L) (K' := K')
  let m := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N
  let Ω := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let : m.IsMaximal := retainedCompletedGenericTensorIdeal_isMaximal
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N
  let r'ΩAlgebra : Algebra R' Ω :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := R') m
  let : Algebra R' Ω := r'ΩAlgebra
  let j := retainedCompletedChosenComponentAlgHom
    (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
    (K' := K') N
  let : Algebra W Ω :=
    retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalizationAlgebra
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N Q hNQ
  let : Module.Finite R' T := Module.Finite.base_change R R' S
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R' T := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R' T
  have hNMapBot : N.map (algebraMap T W) = ⊥ :=
    prime_liesOver_bot_map_eq_bot_localizationAtPrime_of_isDomain
      (R := R') N Q hNQ
  have hjInjective : Function.Injective (algebraMap W Ω) := by
    refine (IsLocalization.lift_injective_iff _).2 ?_
    intro x y
    constructor
    · intro hxy
      have h := congrArg (algebraMap W Ω) hxy
      change IsLocalization.lift _ (algebraMap T W x) =
        IsLocalization.lift _ (algebraMap T W y) at h
      rw [IsLocalization.lift_eq _ x, IsLocalization.lift_eq _ y] at h
      exact h
    · intro hxy
      have hxyN : x - y ∈ N := by
        rw [← retainedCompletedChosenComponentAlgHom_ker
          (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
          (K' := K') N, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
        exact hxy
      have hxyMap :
          algebraMap T W (x - y) ∈ N.map (algebraMap T W) :=
        Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap T W) hxyN
      have hxyZero : algebraMap T W (x - y) = 0 := by
        rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← hNMapBot]
        exact hxyMap
      simpa only [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] using hxyZero
  let : FaithfulSMul W Ω :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective W Ω).mpr hjInjective
  let : Algebra T G₀ := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let M : Submonoid T :=
    Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T (nonZeroDivisors R')
  let : IsLocalization M G₀ :=
    IsLocalization.tensorRight (R := R') (S := T) (A := K')
      (nonZeroDivisors R')
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint (M : Set T) (N : Set T) :=
    retainedCompletedGenericPrime_disjoint
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) N
  apply IsFractionRing.of_field
  intro z
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  let t₀ : G₀ := e.symm t
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, ht⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M t₀
  have hsN : (s : T) ∉ N := by
    exact hdisjoint.notMem_of_mem_left s.2
  have hjs : j (s : T) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs
    apply hsN
    rw [← retainedCompletedChosenComponentAlgHom_ker
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N]
    change j (s : T) = 0
    exact hs
  have hsDenominator :
      algebraMap W Ω (algebraMap T W (s : T)) ≠ 0 := by
    change IsLocalization.lift _ (algebraMap T W (s : T)) ≠ 0
    rw [IsLocalization.lift_eq _ (s : T)]
    exact hjs
  refine ⟨algebraMap T W x, algebraMap T W (s : T), ?_⟩
  apply (eq_div_iff hsDenominator).2
  rw [
    retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalizationAlgebra_algebraMap
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N Q hNQ,
    retainedCompletedChosenComponentLocalizationAlgebra_algebraMap
      (R := R) (R' := R') (S := S) (K := K) (L := L)
      (K' := K') N Q hNQ]
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk m t *
      Ideal.Quotient.mk m (e (algebraMap T G₀ (s : T))) =
    Ideal.Quotient.mk m (e (algebraMap T G₀ x))
  have hImage :=
    congrArg (fun u : G₀ ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk m (e u)) ht
  simpa [t₀] using hImage

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericTensorTowerSecondComponentMap_surjective
statement:
theorem genericTensorTowerSecondComponentMap_surjective
    [FiniteDimensional F F'] (m : Ideal (F' ⊗[K] L)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    Function.Surjective
      (genericTensorTowerSecondComponentMap
        (K := K) (F := F) (F' := F') (L := L) m)
proof:
:= by
  let n := genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal
    (K := K) (F := F) (F' := F') (L := L) m
  let : n.IsMaximal :=
    genericTensorTowerIntermediateIdeal_isMaximal
      (K := K) (F := F) (F' := F') (L := L) m
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b =>
      refine ⟨a ⊗ₜ[F]
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk n
          ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ[K] b)), ?_⟩
      change genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m a *
          genericTensorTowerIntermediateComponentMap
            (K := K) (F := F) (F' := F') (L := L) m
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk n ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ[K] b)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk m (a ⊗ₜ[K] b)
      rw [genericTensorTowerIntermediateComponentMap_mk]
      rw [genericTensorFieldComponentLeft_apply]
      rw [← map_mul]
      congr 1
      simp [genericTensorTowerMap]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hy
      refine ⟨x' + y', ?_⟩
      rw [map_add, hx', hy', map_add]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericTensorFieldComponent_fieldRange_sup_eq_top
statement:
theorem genericTensorFieldComponent_fieldRange_sup_eq_top
    (m : Ideal (K' ⊗[K] L)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m).fieldRange ⊔
        (genericTensorFieldComponentRight m).fieldRange = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  refine TensorProduct.inductionOn z ?_ ?_
  · intro a b
    have ha : genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m a ∈
        (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m).fieldRange ⊔
          (genericTensorFieldComponentRight m).fieldRange :=
      (show (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m).fieldRange ≤
          (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m).fieldRange ⊔
            (genericTensorFieldComponentRight m).fieldRange from le_sup_left)
        ⟨a, rfl⟩
    have hb : genericTensorFieldComponentRight m b ∈
        (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m).fieldRange ⊔
          (genericTensorFieldComponentRight m).fieldRange :=
      (show (genericTensorFieldComponentRight m).fieldRange ≤
          (genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m).fieldRange ⊔
            (genericTensorFieldComponentRight m).fieldRange from le_sup_right)
        ⟨b, rfl⟩
    convert
      ((genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m).fieldRange ⊔
        (genericTensorFieldComponentRight m).fieldRange).mul_mem ha hb using 1
    all_goals
      simp [genericTensorFieldComponentLeft,
        genericTensorFieldComponentRight, ← map_mul]
  · intro x y hx hy
    simpa using
      ((genericTensorFieldComponentLeft m).fieldRange ⊔
        (genericTensorFieldComponentRight m).fieldRange).add_mem hx hy

theorem genericTensorFieldComponentFiniteDimensionalOverRight
    (m : Ideal (K' ⊗[K] L)) [m.IsMaximal]
    [FiniteDimensional K K'] :
    letI : Algebra L (GenericTensorFieldComponent m)
proof:
:=
      genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
    FiniteDimensional L (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) := by
  let : Algebra L (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
  let T := K' ⊗[K] L
  let : Algebra L T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let e : (L ⊗[K] K') ≃ₐ[L] T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight K L K'
  let : Module.Finite L (L ⊗[K] K') :=
    Module.Finite.base_change K L K'
  let : Module.Finite L T := Module.Finite.equiv e.toLinearEquiv
  let q : T →ₐ[L] GenericTensorFieldComponent m :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ L m
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective q.toLinearMap
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

      Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by

      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K' m).toLinearMap :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hle :
      Module.finrank K' (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) ≤
        Module.finrank K' (K' ⊗[K] L) :=
    LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective hsurjective
  simpa only [Module.finrank_baseChange] using hle

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorAlgHom_tmul
statement:
private theorem tensorAlgHom_tmul
    {K E B X : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing E] [CommRing B] [CommRing X]
    [Algebra K E] [Algebra K B] [Algebra E X]
    (f : (E ⊗[K] B) →ₐ[E] X) (e : E) (b : B) :
    f (e ⊗ₜ[K] b) = e • f ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[K] b)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    f (e ⊗ₜ[K] b) = f (e • ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[K] b)) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    _ = e • f ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[K] b) := f.toLinearMap.map_smul e _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorMap_smul
statement:
private theorem tensorMap_smul
    {K E T B : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing E] [CommRing T] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra K E] [Algebra K T] [Algebra K B]
    (η : E →ₐ[K] T) (e : E) (x : E ⊗[K] B) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K B) (e • x) =
      η e • Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K B) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, Algebra.smul_def]
  change Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K B) (e ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : B)) *
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K B) x =
    (η e ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : B)) * Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K B) x
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_tmul
statement:
theorem tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_tmul (η : E →ₐ[K] T)
    (f : (E ⊗[K] B) →ₐ[E] (E ⊗[K] D)) (t : T) (b : B) :
    tensorScalarExtendAlgHom η f (t ⊗ₜ[K] b) =
      t • Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K D) (f ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[K] b))
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul _ t b

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_map
statement:
theorem tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_map (η : E →ₐ[K] T)
    (f : (E ⊗[K] B) →ₐ[E] (E ⊗[K] D)) (x : E ⊗[K] B) :
    tensorScalarExtendAlgHom η f (Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K B) x) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K D) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul e b =>
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply, tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_tmul,
      tensorAlgHom_tmul f e b, tensorMap_smul]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_square
statement:
theorem tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_square
    {F : Type u} [CommRing F] [Algebra K F]
    (η : E →ₐ[K] T) (σ : T →ₐ[K] F)
    (f : (E ⊗[K] B) →ₐ[E] (E ⊗[K] D))
    (g : (F ⊗[K] B) →ₐ[F] (F ⊗[K] D))
    (h : (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ.comp η) (AlgHom.id K D)).comp
        (f.restrictScalars K) = (g.restrictScalars K).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ.comp η) (AlgHom.id K B))) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K D)).comp
        ((tensorScalarExtendAlgHom η f).restrictScalars K) =
      (g.restrictScalars K).comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B))
proof:
:= by
  apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext'
  intro t b
  have h₁ := AlgHom.congr_fun h ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[K] b)
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one, AlgHom.id_apply] at h₁
  change Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K D)
    (tensorScalarExtendAlgHom η f (t ⊗ₜ[K] b)) =
      g (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B) (t ⊗ₜ[K] b))
  rw [tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_tmul, tensorMap_smul,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply, tensorAlgHom_tmul g]
  apply congrArg (fun x => σ t • x)
  calc
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K D)
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map η (AlgHom.id K D) (f ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[K] b))) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ.comp η) (AlgHom.id K D)
        (f ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[K] b)) := by
          rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, ← Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp, AlgHom.id_comp]
    _ = g ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ[K] b) := h₁

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorScalarExtendAlgEquiv_squares
statement:
theorem tensorScalarExtendAlgEquiv_squares
    {F : Type u} [CommRing F] [Algebra K F]
    (η : E →ₐ[K] T) (σ : T →ₐ[K] F)
    (e : (E ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[E] (E ⊗[K] D))
    (q : (F ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[F] (F ⊗[K] D))
    (hf : (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ.comp η) (AlgHom.id K D)).comp
        (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) = (q.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ.comp η) (AlgHom.id K B)))
    (hi : (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ.comp η) (AlgHom.id K B)).comp
        (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) = (q.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ.comp η) (AlgHom.id K D))) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K D)).comp
        ((tensorScalarExtendAlgEquiv η e).toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) =
      (q.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B)) ∧
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K B)).comp
        ((tensorScalarExtendAlgEquiv η e).symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K) =
      (q.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars K).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map σ (AlgHom.id K D))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_square η σ e.toAlgHom q.toAlgHom hf,
    tensorScalarExtendAlgHom_square η σ e.symm.toAlgHom q.symm.toAlgHom hi⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_tensorProduct_algHom_stage_of_filteredColimit
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_algHom_stage_of_filteredColimit
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (f : (c.pt ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[c.pt] (c.pt ⊗[R] D)) :
    ∃ (i : J) (fᵢ : (F.obj i ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[F.obj i] (F.obj i ⊗[R] D)),
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D)).comp (fᵢ.restrictScalars R) =
        (f.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := B))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of R
  let D₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of D
  let tD : Under R₀ ⥤ Under D₀ := CommRingCat.tensorProd R₀ D₀
  let cD : Cocone (F ⋙ tD) := tD.mapCocone c
  let : PreservesColimit F tD :=
    preservesColimit_of_natIso F
      (CommRingCat.tensorProdIsoPushout R₀ D₀).symm
  have hcD : IsColimit cD := isColimitOfPreserves tD hc
  let fInf : B →ₐ[R] (D ⊗[R] c.pt) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R c.pt D).toAlgHom.comp
      ((f.restrictScalars R).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
  let fInfD : (D ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[D] (D ⊗[R] c.pt) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R D B (D ⊗[R] c.pt) fInf
  let DB : Under D₀ := CommRingCat.mkUnder D₀ (D ⊗[R] B)
  have hDBfp : DB.hom.hom.FinitePresentation := by
    change (algebraMap D (D ⊗[R] B)).FinitePresentation
    exact RingHom.finitePresentation_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
  let : IsFinitelyPresentable.{u} DB :=
    CommRingCat.isFinitelyPresentable_under D₀ DB hDBfp
  obtain ⟨i, fᵢD, hfᵢD⟩ :=
    IsFinitelyPresentable.exists_hom_of_isColimit hcD fInfD.toUnder
  let fiDCanonical : (D ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[D] (D ⊗[R] F.obj i) :=
    { __ := (CommRingCat.toAlgHom fᵢD).toRingHom
      commutes' := by
        intro d
        exact (CommRingCat.toAlgHom fᵢD).commutes d }
  have hfCanonical :
      (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c i (A := D)).comp
          fiDCanonical = fInfD := by
    apply AlgHom.ext
    intro z
    have hfi : fiDCanonical.toUnder = fᵢD := rfl
    have hleg :
        (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c i (A := D)).toUnder =
          cD.ι.app i := rfl
    have hcomp := hfᵢD
    rw [← hfi, ← hleg] at hcomp
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q.right z) hcomp
  let fiPrime : B →ₐ[R] (D ⊗[R] F.obj i) :=
    (AlgHom.liftEquiv R D B (D ⊗[R] F.obj i)).symm fiDCanonical
  let fᵢ : B →ₐ[R] (F.obj i ⊗[R] D) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R D (F.obj i)).toAlgHom.comp fiPrime
  have hfᵢ (b : B) :
      filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D) (fᵢ b) = f (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b) := by
    apply (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R c.pt D).injective
    calc
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R c.pt D)
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D) (fᵢ b)) =
          filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c i (A := D)
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj i) D) (fᵢ b)) :=
        (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_comm c i (fᵢ b)).symm
      _ = filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c i (A := D)
            (fiDCanonical (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) := by
        change filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c i (A := D)
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj i) D)
              ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R D (F.obj i)) (fiPrime b))) =
          filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c i (A := D)
            (fiDCanonical (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b))
        rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_symm, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
        rfl
      _ = fInfD (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b) :=
        congrArg (fun h ↦ h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) hfCanonical
      _ = (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R c.pt D) (f (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) := by
        simp only [fInfD, AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, one_smul, fInf,
          AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
          AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
  let φᵢ : (F.obj i ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[F.obj i] (F.obj i ⊗[R] D) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R (F.obj i) B (F.obj i ⊗[R] D) fᵢ
  refine ⟨i, φᵢ, ?_⟩
  apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
  · ext x
    change filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i
        (φᵢ (algebraMap (F.obj i) (F.obj i ⊗[R] B) x)) =
      f (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i
        (algebraMap (F.obj i) (F.obj i ⊗[R] B) x))
    rw [φᵢ.commutes]
    change CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app i) x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : D) =
      f (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app i) x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B))
    exact (f.commutes (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app i) x)).symm
  · ext b
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply, φᵢ,
      AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, one_smul, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
      filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom_tmul, map_one]
    exact hfᵢ b

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_stage_algHom_pair_of_filteredColimit
statement:
private theorem exists_stage_algHom_pair_of_filteredColimit
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R D]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (e : (c.pt ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[c.pt] (c.pt ⊗[R] D)) :
    ∃ (k : J)
      (fₖ : B →ₐ[R] (F.obj k ⊗[R] D))
      (gₖ : D →ₐ[R] (F.obj k ⊗[R] B)),
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := D)).comp
          ((AlgHom.liftEquiv R (F.obj k) B (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) fₖ).restrictScalars R) =
        (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := B)) ∧
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp
          ((AlgHom.liftEquiv R (F.obj k) D (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) gₖ).restrictScalars R) =
        (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := D))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, φᵢ, hfᵢ⟩ :=
    exists_tensorProduct_algHom_stage_of_filteredColimit F c hc e.toAlgHom
  obtain ⟨j, ψⱼ, hgⱼ⟩ :=
    exists_tensorProduct_algHom_stage_of_filteredColimit F c hc e.symm.toAlgHom
  let fᵢ : B →ₐ[R] (F.obj i ⊗[R] D) :=
    (φᵢ.restrictScalars R).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
  let gⱼ : D →ₐ[R] (F.obj j ⊗[R] B) :=
    (ψⱼ.restrictScalars R).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
  let k := IsFiltered.max i j
  let hik : i ⟶ k := IsFiltered.leftToMax i j
  let hjk : j ⟶ k := IsFiltered.rightToMax i j
  let fik : F.obj i →ₐ[R] F.obj k := CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map hik)
  let fjk : F.obj j →ₐ[R] F.obj k := CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map hjk)
  let fₖ : B →ₐ[R] (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fik (AlgHom.id R D)).comp fᵢ
  let gₖ : D →ₐ[R] (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fjk (AlgHom.id R B)).comp gⱼ
  have hleg {a b : J} (h : a ⟶ b) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] :
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c b (A := A)).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map h)) (AlgHom.id R A)) =
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c a (A := A) := by
    change (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app b))
        (AlgHom.id R A)).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map h)) (AlgHom.id R A)) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app a)) (AlgHom.id R A)
    rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp, AlgHom.id_comp,
      ← CommRingCat.toAlgHom_comp, c.w h]
  refine ⟨k, fₖ, gₖ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
    · ext x
      change filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k
          ((AlgHom.liftEquiv R (F.obj k) B (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) fₖ)
            (algebraMap (F.obj k) (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) x)) =
        e (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k
          (algebraMap (F.obj k) (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) x))
      rw [AlgHom.commutes]
      change CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : D) =
        e (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B))
      exact (e.commutes (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x)).symm
    · ext b
      have hf : filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D) (fᵢ b) =
          e (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b) := by
        simpa only [fᵢ, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom_tmul,
          map_one, AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_apply] using
          congrArg (fun h ↦ h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) hfᵢ
      have hnat := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (fᵢ b)) (hleg hik D)
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
        AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, one_smul, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom_tmul, map_one, AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_apply, fₖ]
      rw [show filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := D)
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map fik (AlgHom.id R D)) (fᵢ b)) =
          filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D) (fᵢ b) from hnat]
      exact hf
  · apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
    · ext x
      change filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k
          ((AlgHom.liftEquiv R (F.obj k) D (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) gₖ)
            (algebraMap (F.obj k) (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) x)) =
        e.symm (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k
          (algebraMap (F.obj k) (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) x))
      rw [AlgHom.commutes]
      change CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) =
        e.symm (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : D))
      exact (e.symm.commutes (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x)).symm
    · ext d
      have hg : filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c j (A := B) (gⱼ d) =
          e.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d) := by
        simpa only [gⱼ, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom_tmul,
          map_one, AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_apply] using
          congrArg (fun h ↦ h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) hgⱼ
      have hnat := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (gⱼ d)) (hleg hjk B)
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
        AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, one_smul, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom_tmul, map_one, AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_apply, gₖ]
      rw [show filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := B)
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map fjk (AlgHom.id R B)) (gⱼ d)) =
          filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c j (A := B) (gⱼ d) from hnat]
      exact hg

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.stage_comp_identity_at_colimit
statement:
private theorem stage_comp_identity_at_colimit
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (k : J)
    (e : (c.pt ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[c.pt] (c.pt ⊗[R] D))
    (φₖ : (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[F.obj k] (F.obj k ⊗[R] D))
    (ψₖ : (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[F.obj k] (F.obj k ⊗[R] B))
    (hφₖ :
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := D)).comp
          (φₖ.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := B)))
    (hψₖ :
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp
          (ψₖ.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := D))) :
    let compB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k)
proof:
:=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B).toAlgHom.comp
        (((ψₖ.comp φₖ).restrictScalars R).comp
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
    let idB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
    let compBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) compB
    let idBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) idB
    (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp compBB =
      (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp idBB := by
  let compB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B).toAlgHom.comp
      (((ψₖ.comp φₖ).restrictScalars R).comp
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
  let idB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
  let compBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) compB
  let idBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) idB
  change (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp compBB =
    (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp idBB
  apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext_ring
  ext b
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
    compBB, idBB, AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, one_smul,
    compB, idB, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
  change filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B)
        (ψₖ (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)))) =
    filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k (b ⊗ₜ[R] 1)
  nth_rewrite 2 [← Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
  rw [filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_comm,
    filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_comm]
  have hψ := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b))) hψₖ
  have hφ := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) hφₖ
  have hinner :
      filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (ψₖ (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b))) =
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b) := by
    calc
      filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (ψₖ (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b))) =
        ((filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k).comp
          (ψₖ.restrictScalars R)) (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) := rfl
      _ = ((e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k))
            (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) := hψ
      _ = e.symm (((filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k).comp
          (φₖ.restrictScalars R)) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) := rfl
      _ = e.symm (((e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k)) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) := by
            rw [hφ]
      _ = filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b) :=
        e.symm_apply_apply _
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R c.pt B z) hinner

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_baseChange_algHom_eq_stage
statement:
private theorem exists_baseChange_algHom_eq_stage
    {R B A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra B A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation B A]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c) (k : J)
    (f g : A →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k))
    (hfg : (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp f =
      (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp g) :
    ∃ (l : J) (hkl : k ⟶ l),
      f.toUnder ≫ (F ⋙ CommRingCat.tensorProd (CommRingCat.of R)
          (CommRingCat.of B)).map hkl =
        g.toUnder ≫ (F ⋙ CommRingCat.tensorProd (CommRingCat.of R)
          (CommRingCat.of B)).map hkl
proof:
:= by
  let R₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of R
  let B₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of B
  let tB : Under R₀ ⥤ Under B₀ := CommRingCat.tensorProd R₀ B₀
  let FB : J ⥤ Under B₀ := F ⋙ tB
  let cB : Cocone FB := tB.mapCocone c
  let : PreservesColimit F tB :=
    preservesColimit_of_natIso F
      (CommRingCat.tensorProdIsoPushout R₀ B₀).symm
  have hcB : IsColimit cB := isColimitOfPreserves tB hc
  let A₀ : Under B₀ := CommRingCat.mkUnder B₀ A
  have hAfp : A₀.hom.hom.FinitePresentation := by
    change (algebraMap B A).FinitePresentation
    exact RingHom.finitePresentation_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
  let : IsFinitelyPresentable.{u} A₀ :=
    CommRingCat.isFinitelyPresentable_under B₀ A₀ hAfp
  have hfgUnder : f.toUnder ≫ cB.ι.app k = g.toUnder ≫ cB.ι.app k := by
    apply CommRingCat.mkUnder_ext
    intro a
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q a) hfg
  exact exists_eq_of_preservesColimit_coyoneda_self (X := A₀) hcB
    f.toUnder g.toUnder hfgUnder

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_stage_comp_identity
statement:
private theorem exists_stage_comp_identity
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c) (k : J)
    (e : (c.pt ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[c.pt] (c.pt ⊗[R] D))
    (φₖ : (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[F.obj k] (F.obj k ⊗[R] D))
    (ψₖ : (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[F.obj k] (F.obj k ⊗[R] B))
    (hφₖ :
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := D)).comp
          (φₖ.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := B)))
    (hψₖ :
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp
          (ψₖ.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := D))) :
    let R₀ : CommRingCat.{u}
proof:
:= CommRingCat.of R
    let B₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of B
    let tB : Under R₀ ⥤ Under B₀ := CommRingCat.tensorProd R₀ B₀
    let FB : J ⥤ Under B₀ := F ⋙ tB
    let compB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B).toAlgHom.comp
        (((ψₖ.comp φₖ).restrictScalars R).comp
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
    let idB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
    let compBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) compB
    let idBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) idB
    ∃ (l : J) (hkl : k ⟶ l),
      compBB.toUnder ≫ FB.map hkl = idBB.toUnder ≫ FB.map hkl := by
  intro R₀ B₀ tB FB compB idB compBB idBB
  exact exists_baseChange_algHom_eq_stage (A := B ⊗[R] B) F c hc k compBB idBB
    (stage_comp_identity_at_colimit F c k e φₖ ψₖ hφₖ hψₖ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_common_stage_for_inverse_equations
statement:
private theorem exists_common_stage_for_inverse_equations
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R D]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c) (k : J)
    (e : (c.pt ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[c.pt] (c.pt ⊗[R] D))
    (φₖ : (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[F.obj k] (F.obj k ⊗[R] D))
    (ψₖ : (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[F.obj k] (F.obj k ⊗[R] B))
    (hφₖ :
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := D)).comp
          (φₖ.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := B)))
    (hψₖ :
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp
          (ψₖ.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (A := D))) :
    let R₀ : CommRingCat.{u}
proof:
:= CommRingCat.of R
    let B₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of B
    let D₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of D
    let tB : Under R₀ ⥤ Under B₀ := CommRingCat.tensorProd R₀ B₀
    let tD : Under R₀ ⥤ Under D₀ := CommRingCat.tensorProd R₀ D₀
    let FB : J ⥤ Under B₀ := F ⋙ tB
    let FD : J ⥤ Under D₀ := F ⋙ tD
    let compB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B).toAlgHom.comp
        (((ψₖ.comp φₖ).restrictScalars R).comp
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
    let idB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
    let compBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) compB
    let idBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) idB
    let compD : D →ₐ[R] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) D).toAlgHom.comp
        (((φₖ.comp ψₖ).restrictScalars R).comp
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
    let idD : D →ₐ[R] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
    let compDD : (D ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[D] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      AlgHom.liftEquiv R D D (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) compD
    let idDD : (D ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[D] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
      AlgHom.liftEquiv R D D (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) idD
    ∃ (m : J) (hkm' : k ⟶ m),
      compBB.toUnder ≫ FB.map hkm' = idBB.toUnder ≫ FB.map hkm' ∧
      compDD.toUnder ≫ FD.map hkm' = idDD.toUnder ≫ FD.map hkm' ∧
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c m (A := B)).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
            (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map hkm')) (AlgHom.id R B)) =
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k ∧
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c m (A := D)).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
            (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map hkm')) (AlgHom.id R D)) =
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k := by
  classical
  let R₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of R
  let B₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of B
  let D₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of D
  let tB : Under R₀ ⥤ Under B₀ := CommRingCat.tensorProd R₀ B₀
  let tD : Under R₀ ⥤ Under D₀ := CommRingCat.tensorProd R₀ D₀
  let FB : J ⥤ Under B₀ := F ⋙ tB
  let FD : J ⥤ Under D₀ := F ⋙ tD
  let compB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B).toAlgHom.comp
      (((ψₖ.comp φₖ).restrictScalars R).comp
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
  let idB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
  let compBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) compB
  let idBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) idB
  let compD : D →ₐ[R] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) D).toAlgHom.comp
      (((φₖ.comp ψₖ).restrictScalars R).comp
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
  let idD : D →ₐ[R] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
  let compDD : (D ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[D] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R D D (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) compD
  let idDD : (D ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[D] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R D D (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) idD
  obtain ⟨lB, hklB, hB⟩ :=
    exists_stage_comp_identity F c hc k e φₖ ψₖ hφₖ hψₖ
  obtain ⟨lD, hklD, hD⟩ :=
    exists_stage_comp_identity (B := D) (D := B)
      F c hc k e.symm ψₖ φₖ hψₖ hφₖ
  let l := IsFiltered.max lB lD
  let hlBl : lB ⟶ l := IsFiltered.leftToMax lB lD
  let hlDl : lD ⟶ l := IsFiltered.rightToMax lB lD
  let hkB : k ⟶ l := hklB ≫ hlBl
  let hkD : k ⟶ l := hklD ≫ hlDl
  let m := IsFiltered.coeq hkB hkD
  let hlm : l ⟶ m := IsFiltered.coeqHom hkB hkD
  have hkm : hkB ≫ hlm = hkD ≫ hlm :=
    IsFiltered.coeq_condition hkB hkD
  let hkm' : k ⟶ m := hkB ≫ hlm
  let fkm : F.obj k →ₐ[R] F.obj m := CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map hkm')
  have hclegApply (x : F.obj k) :
      CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app m) (fkm x) =
        CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ q.right x) (c.w hkm')
    change CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app m)
        (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map hkm') x) =
      CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x at h
    simpa only [fkm] using h
  have hcTensorB :
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c m (A := B)).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R B)) =
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k := by
    apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
    · ext x
      change CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app m) (fkm x) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) =
        CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)
      rw [hclegApply]
    · ext b
      simp [filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom]
  have hcTensorD :
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c m (A := D)).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R D)) =
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k := by
    apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
    · ext x
      change CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app m) (fkm x) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : D) =
        CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app k) x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : D)
      rw [hclegApply]
    · ext d
      simp [filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom]
  have hB_m :
      compBB.toUnder ≫ FB.map hkm' = idBB.toUnder ≫ FB.map hkm' := by
    have hpath : hkm' = hklB ≫ (hlBl ≫ hlm) := by
      simp only [hkm', hkB, Category.assoc]
    rw [hpath]
    have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ FB.map (hlBl ≫ hlm)) hB
    have hmap := FB.map_comp hklB (hlBl ≫ hlm)
    dsimp only [FB, tB, Functor.comp, CommRingCat.tensorProd] at hmap h ⊢
    simp only [Category.assoc] at h
    rw [← hmap] at h
    exact h
  have hD_m :
      compDD.toUnder ≫ FD.map hkm' = idDD.toUnder ≫ FD.map hkm' := by
    have hpath : hkm' = hklD ≫ (hlDl ≫ hlm) := by
      rw [show hkm' = hkD ≫ hlm from hkm]
      simp only [hkD, Category.assoc]
    rw [hpath]
    have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ FD.map (hlDl ≫ hlm)) hD
    have hmap := FD.map_comp hklD (hlDl ≫ hlm)
    dsimp only [FD, tD, Functor.comp, CommRingCat.tensorProd] at hmap h ⊢
    simp only [Category.assoc] at h
    rw [← hmap] at h
    exact h
  exact ⟨m, hkm', hB_m, hD_m, hcTensorB, hcTensorD⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_tensorProduct_algEquiv_stage_of_filteredColimit
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_algEquiv_stage_of_filteredColimit
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R D]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R D]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (e : (c.pt ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[c.pt] (c.pt ⊗[R] D)) :
    ∃ (i : J)
      (eᵢ : (F.obj i ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[F.obj i] (F.obj i ⊗[R] D)),
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D)).comp
          (eᵢ.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := B)) ∧
      (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := B)).comp
          (eᵢ.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R) =
        (e.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
          (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i (A := D))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of R
  let B₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of B
  let D₀ : CommRingCat.{u} := CommRingCat.of D
  let tB : Under R₀ ⥤ Under B₀ := CommRingCat.tensorProd R₀ B₀
  let tD : Under R₀ ⥤ Under D₀ := CommRingCat.tensorProd R₀ D₀
  let FB : J ⥤ Under B₀ := F ⋙ tB
  let FD : J ⥤ Under D₀ := F ⋙ tD
  obtain ⟨k, fₖ, gₖ, hφₖ, hψₖ⟩ :=
    exists_stage_algHom_pair_of_filteredColimit F c hc e
  let φₖ : (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[F.obj k] (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R (F.obj k) B (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) fₖ
  let ψₖ : (F.obj k ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[F.obj k] (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R (F.obj k) D (F.obj k ⊗[R] B) gₖ
  let compB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B).toAlgHom.comp
      (((ψₖ.comp φₖ).restrictScalars R).comp
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
  let idB : B →ₐ[R] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
  let compBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) compB
  let idBB : (B ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R B B (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) idB
  let compD : D →ₐ[R] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) D).toAlgHom.comp
      (((φₖ.comp ψₖ).restrictScalars R).comp
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight)
  let idD : D →ₐ[R] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
  let compDD : (D ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[D] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R D D (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) compD
  let idDD : (D ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[D] (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R D D (D ⊗[R] F.obj k) idD
  obtain ⟨m, hkm', hB_m, hD_m, hcTensorB, hcTensorD⟩ :=
    exists_common_stage_for_inverse_equations F c hc k e φₖ ψₖ hφₖ hψₖ
  let fkm : F.obj k →ₐ[R] F.obj m := CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map hkm')
  let fₘ : B →ₐ[R] (F.obj m ⊗[R] D) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R D)).comp fₖ
  let gₘ : D →ₐ[R] (F.obj m ⊗[R] B) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R B)).comp gₖ
  let φₘ : (F.obj m ⊗[R] B) →ₐ[F.obj m] (F.obj m ⊗[R] D) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R (F.obj m) B (F.obj m ⊗[R] D) fₘ
  let ψₘ : (F.obj m ⊗[R] D) →ₐ[F.obj m] (F.obj m ⊗[R] B) :=
    AlgHom.liftEquiv R (F.obj m) D (F.obj m ⊗[R] B) gₘ
  have hφBaseChange :
      (φₘ.restrictScalars R).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R B)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R D)).comp
          (φₖ.restrictScalars R) := by
    apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
    · ext x
      simp [φₘ, φₖ, Algebra.smul_def]
    · ext b
      simp [φₘ, φₖ, fₘ]
  have hψBaseChange :
      (ψₘ.restrictScalars R).comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R D)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R B)).comp
          (ψₖ.restrictScalars R) := by
    apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
    · ext x
      simp [ψₘ, ψₖ, Algebra.smul_def]
    · ext d
      simp [ψₘ, ψₖ, gₘ]
  have hleft : ψₘ.comp φₘ = AlgHom.id (F.obj m) _ := by
    apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext_ring
    ext b
    have hcoord := congrArg
      (fun h ↦ CommRingCat.toAlgHom h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) hB_m
    have hcoord' :
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id B B) fkm)
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B)
              (ψₖ (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)))) =
          (b ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj m) : B ⊗[R] F.obj m) := by
      calc
        _ = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id B B) fkm)
              (b ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj k)) := by
                change (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (FB.map hkm'))
                    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B)
                      (ψₖ (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)))) =
                  (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (FB.map hkm'))
                    (b ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj k))
                change (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (FB.map hkm'))
                    (compBB (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) =
                  (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (FB.map hkm'))
                    (idBB (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) at hcoord
                simpa only [AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_apply,
                  AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, one_smul,
                  AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
                  Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
                  Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
                  compBB, idBB, compB, idB] using hcoord
        _ = (b ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj m) : B ⊗[R] F.obj m) := by
              rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one]
              rfl
    have hφ := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) hφBaseChange
    have hψ := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b))) hψBaseChange
    have hstage :
        ψₘ (φₘ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R B))
            (ψₖ (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b))) := by
      calc
        ψₘ (φₘ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) =
            ψₘ ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R D))
              (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b))) := by
                congr 1
                simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply,
                  AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
                  Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one,
                  AlgHom.id_apply] using hφ
        _ = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R B))
              (ψₖ (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b))) := by
                simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply,
                  AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply] using hψ
    apply (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj m) B).injective
    calc
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj m) B)
          (ψₘ (φₘ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b))) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj m) B)
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R B))
            (ψₖ (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)))) := congrArg _ hstage
      _ = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id B B) fkm)
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B)
              (ψₖ (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)))) :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_comp_map_apply fkm (AlgHom.id R B) _
      _ = (b ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj m) : B ⊗[R] F.obj m) := hcoord'
      _ = (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj m) B)
            (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b) := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul R 1 b).symm
  have hright : φₘ.comp ψₘ = AlgHom.id (F.obj m) _ := by
    apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext_ring
    ext d
    have hcoord := congrArg
      (fun h ↦ CommRingCat.toAlgHom h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) hD_m
    have hcoord' :
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id D D) fkm)
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) D)
              (φₖ (ψₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)))) =
          (d ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj m) : D ⊗[R] F.obj m) := by
      calc
        _ = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id D D) fkm)
              (d ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj k)) := by
                change (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (FD.map hkm'))
                    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) D)
                      (φₖ (ψₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)))) =
                  (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (FD.map hkm'))
                    (d ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj k))
                change (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (FD.map hkm'))
                    (compDD (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) =
                  (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (FD.map hkm'))
                    (idDD (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) at hcoord
                simpa only [AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_apply,
                  AlgHom.liftEquiv_tmul, one_smul,
                  AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
                  Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
                  Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
                  compDD, idDD, compD, idD] using hcoord
        _ = (d ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj m) : D ⊗[R] F.obj m) := by
              rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one]
              rfl
    have hψ := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) hψBaseChange
    have hφ := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (ψₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d))) hφBaseChange
    have hstage :
        φₘ (ψₘ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R D))
            (φₖ (ψₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d))) := by
      calc
        φₘ (ψₘ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) =
            φₘ ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R B))
              (ψₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d))) := by
                congr 1
                simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply,
                  AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
                  Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one,
                  AlgHom.id_apply] using hψ
        _ = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R D))
              (φₖ (ψₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d))) := by
                simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply,
                  AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply] using hφ
    apply (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj m) D).injective
    calc
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj m) D)
          (φₘ (ψₘ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d))) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj m) D)
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map fkm (AlgHom.id R D))
            (φₖ (ψₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)))) := congrArg _ hstage
      _ = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id D D) fkm)
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) D)
              (φₖ (ψₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)))) :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_comp_map_apply fkm (AlgHom.id R D) _
      _ = (d ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : F.obj m) : D ⊗[R] F.obj m) := hcoord'
      _ = (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj m) D)
            (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d) := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul R 1 d).symm
  let eₘ : (F.obj m ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[F.obj m] (F.obj m ⊗[R] D) :=
    AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom φₘ ψₘ hright hleft
  refine ⟨m, eₘ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
    · ext x
      convert (e.commutes
        (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app m) x)).symm using 1 <;>
        simp [eₘ, φₘ, filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.smul_def]
    · ext b
      have hnat := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (fₖ b)) hcTensorD
      have hφ := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) hφₖ
      calc
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c m
              (eₘ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) =
            filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (fₖ b) := by
              simpa [eₘ, φₘ, fₘ] using hnat
        _ = filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k
              (φₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) := by simp [φₖ]
        _ = e (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k
              (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) := by
                convert hφ using 1 <;> rfl
        _ = e (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c m
              (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b)) := by
                simp [filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom]
  · apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
    · ext x
      convert (e.symm.commutes
        (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app m) x)).symm using 1 <;>
        simp [eₘ, ψₘ, filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.smul_def]
    · ext d
      have hnat := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (gₖ d)) hcTensorB
      have hψ := congrArg (fun h ↦ h (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) hψₖ
      calc
        filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c m
              (eₘ.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) =
            filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (gₖ d) := by
              simpa [eₘ, ψₘ, gₘ] using hnat
        _ = filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k
              (ψₖ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) := by simp [ψₖ]
        _ = e.symm (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k
              (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) := by
                convert hψ using 1 <;> rfl
        _ = e.symm (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c m
              (1 ⊗ₜ[R] d)) := by
                simp [filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_tensorProduct_family_eq_stage_of_filteredColimit
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_family_eq_stage_of_filteredColimit
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J]
    (F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R))
    (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c) (k : J)
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (x y : ι → (F.obj k ⊗[R] B))
    (hxy : ∀ a, filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (x a) =
      filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c k (y a)) :
    ∃ (l : J) (u : k ⟶ l), ∀ a,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map u)) (AlgHom.id R B) (x a) =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.map (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map u)) (AlgHom.id R B) (y a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let enum : Fin (Fintype.card ι) ≃ ι := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
  let f : MvPolynomial (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) B →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fun a => Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B (x (enum a)))
  let g : MvPolynomial (Fin (Fintype.card ι)) B →ₐ[B] (B ⊗[R] F.obj k) :=
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fun a => Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj k) B (y (enum a)))
  have hfg : (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp f =
      (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c k (A := B)).comp g := by
    apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
    intro a
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, f, g, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    rw [filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_comm, filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_comm,
      hxy (enum a)]
  obtain ⟨l, u, hu⟩ := exists_baseChange_algHom_eq_stage F c hc k f g hfg
  refine ⟨l, u, ?_⟩
  intro a
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun h => h.right (MvPolynomial.X (enum.symm a))) hu
  change Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id B B) (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map u))
      (f (MvPolynomial.X (enum.symm a))) =
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id B B) (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map u))
      (g (MvPolynomial.X (enum.symm a))) at hcoord
  simp only [f, g, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, enum.apply_symm_apply] at hcoord
  apply (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj l) B).injective
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_comp_map_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_comp_map_apply]
  exact hcoord

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_tmul
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]

statement:
theorem filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_toUnder
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_naturality
statement:
theorem filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_naturality
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J]
    {F : J ⥤ Under (CommRingCat.of R)} (c : Cocone F)
    {i j : J} (f : i ⟶ j) :
    (filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c j).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id A A)
          (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map f))) =
      filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c i
proof:
:= by
  apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext_ring
  ext x
  have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ q.right x) (c.w f)
  change CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app j)
      (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (F.map f) x) =
    CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app i) x at h
  exact congrArg (fun y ↦ (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] y) h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_comm
statement:
theorem filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom_comm
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]

    (z : F.obj i ⊗[R] A) :
    filteredBaseChangeCoconeLegAlgHom c i
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R (F.obj i) A) z) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R c.pt A)
        (filteredTensorToColimitAlgHom c i z)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_comp_map_apply
    (CommRingCat.toAlgHom (c.ι.app i)) (AlgHom.id R A) z).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.conductorIdeal_ne_bot_of_finite
statement:
private theorem conductorIdeal_ne_bot_of_finite
    (A : Type u) (K : Type v) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (S : Subalgebra A K) [Module.Finite A S] :
    conductorIdeal A K S ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, g, hg⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := A) (M := S)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
    IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples A⁰ Finset.univ
      (fun i ↦ (g i : K))
  let P : Submodule A S :=
    (1 : Submodule A K).comap ((s : A) • S.val.toLinearMap)
  have hgP : Set.range g ⊆ P := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change (s : A) • (g i : K) ∈ (1 : Submodule A K)
    rw [Submodule.mem_one]
    change ∃ a : A, algebraMap A K a = (s : A) • (g i : K)
    exact hs i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hP : P = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hg]
    exact Submodule.span_le.mpr hgP
  have hsI : (s : A) ∈ conductorIdeal A K S := by
    rw [conductorIdeal, Submodule.mem_colon]
    intro w hw
    let wS : S := ⟨w, hw⟩
    have hwP : wS ∈ P := by
      rw [hP]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    exact hwP
  have hsne : (s : A) ≠ 0 := mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp s.property
  intro hbot
  rw [hbot, Ideal.mem_bot] at hsI
  exact hsne hsI

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.conductorIdeal_isWeaklyRegular_pair
statement:
private theorem conductorIdeal_isWeaklyRegular_pair
    (A : Type u) (K : Type v) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (S : Subalgebra A K) {x y : A} (hregular : IsRegular A [x, y]) :
    IsWeaklyRegular (conductorIdeal A K S) [x, y]
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal A := conductorIdeal A K S
  have hpair := (isRegular_cons_iff A x [y]).mp hregular
  have hxRegular : IsSMulRegular A x := hpair.1
  have hyRegular : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop x A) y :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff (QuotSMulTop x A) y []).mp hpair.2).1
  have hxne : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    have hone : (1 : A) = 0 :=
      hxRegular.right_eq_zero_of_smul (by simp [hx])
    exact one_ne_zero hone
  have hxI : IsSMulRegular I x := hxRegular.submodule I x
  have hyI : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop x I) y := by
    rw [isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem]
    intro b hb
    rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists] at hb ⊢
    obtain ⟨c, -, hcb⟩ := hb
    have hybxc : y * (b : A) = x * (c : A) := by
      have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hcb.symm
      change y • (b : A) = x • (c : A) at hval
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hval
    have hybMem : y • (b : A) ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule A A) := by
      rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
      refine ⟨(c : A), Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hybxc.symm
    have hbMem : (b : A) ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule A A) :=
      (isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem
        (x • (⊤ : Submodule A A)) y).mp hyRegular (b : A) hybMem
    obtain ⟨d, -, hdb⟩ :=
      (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).mp hbMem
    have hxdb : x * d = (b : A) := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hdb
    have hxcd : x * (c : A) = x * (y * d) := by
      calc
        x * (c : A) = y * (b : A) := hybxc.symm
        _ = y * (x * d) := by rw [hxdb]
        _ = x * (y * d) := by ac_rfl
    have hcyd : (c : A) = y * d := mul_left_cancel₀ hxne hxcd
    have hdI : d ∈ I := by
      change d ∈ conductorIdeal A K S
      rw [conductorIdeal, Submodule.mem_colon]
      intro w hw
      have hbw :=
        (Submodule.mem_colon.mp b.property) w hw
      have hcw :=
        (Submodule.mem_colon.mp c.property) w hw
      rw [Submodule.mem_one] at hbw hcw ⊢
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hbw
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hcw
      have hypxq : y * p = x * q := by
        apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
        calc
          algebraMap A K (y * p) =
              algebraMap A K y * algebraMap A K p := by rw [map_mul]
          _ = algebraMap A K y * ((b : A) • w) := by rw [hp]
          _ = algebraMap A K (y * (b : A)) * w := by
            simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, mul_assoc]
          _ = algebraMap A K (x * (c : A)) * w := by rw [hybxc]
          _ = algebraMap A K x * ((c : A) • w) := by
            simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, mul_assoc]
          _ = algebraMap A K x * algebraMap A K q := by rw [hq]
          _ = algebraMap A K (x * q) := by rw [map_mul]
      have hypMem : y • p ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule A A) := by
        rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
        refine ⟨q, Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hypxq.symm
      have hpMem : p ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule A A) :=
        (isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem
          (x • (⊤ : Submodule A A)) y).mp hyRegular p hypMem
      obtain ⟨r, -, hrp⟩ :=
        (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).mp hpMem
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hrp
      refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
      have hxmap : algebraMap A K x ≠ 0 := by
        simpa only [map_zero] using (IsFractionRing.injective A K).ne hxne
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hxmap
      calc
        algebraMap A K x * algebraMap A K r =
            algebraMap A K (x * r) := by rw [map_mul]
        _ = algebraMap A K p := by rw [hrp]
        _ = (b : A) • w := hp
        _ = algebraMap A K x * ((d : A) • w) := by
          simp only [Algebra.smul_def, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, hxdb]
    let dI : I := ⟨d, hdI⟩
    refine ⟨dI, Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa only [SetLike.val_smul, smul_eq_mul] using hxdb
  apply (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff I x [y]).mpr
  refine ⟨hxI, ?_⟩
  exact (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff (QuotSMulTop x I) y).mpr hyI

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (x y : A) (hregular : IsRegular A [x, y])
    (hspan : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal A) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed A
proof:
:= by
  apply (isIntegrallyClosed_iff (FractionRing A)).mpr
  intro z hz
  let S : Subalgebra A (FractionRing A) := Algebra.adjoin A {z}
  let : Module.Finite A S :=
    Algebra.finite_adjoin_simple_of_isIntegral hz
  let I : Ideal A := conductorIdeal A (FractionRing A) S
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊥ :=
    conductorIdeal_ne_bot_of_finite A (FractionRing A) S
  let : Nontrivial I := Submodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot.mpr hIne
  let : Module.Finite A I := inferInstance
  have hweak : IsWeaklyRegular I [x, y] :=
    conductorIdeal_isWeaklyRegular_pair A (FractionRing A) S hregular
  have hmem : ∀ r ∈ [x, y], r ∈ maximalIdeal A := by
    intro r hr
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span hr
  have hregularI : IsRegular I [x, y] :=
    IsRegular.of_isWeaklyRegular_of_mem_maximalIdeal (L := I) hmem hweak
  let : Module.Free A I :=
    module_free_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
      x y hregularI hspan
  have hrank : Module.rank A I ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      Module.rank A I ≤ Module.rank A A := Submodule.rank_le I
      _ = 1 := Module.rank_self A
  let : I.IsPrincipal :=
    (Submodule.rank_le_one_iff_isPrincipal I).mp hrank
  let g : A := Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I
  have hgI : g ∈ I := Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator_mem I
  have hgne : g ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [Ne, ← Submodule.IsPrincipal.eq_bot_iff_generator_eq_zero]
  have hzS : z ∈ S := Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton z)
  have hgz := (Submodule.mem_colon.mp hgI) z hzS
  rw [Submodule.mem_one] at hgz
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hgz
  have hcI : c ∈ I := by
    change c ∈ conductorIdeal A (FractionRing A) S
    rw [conductorIdeal, Submodule.mem_colon]
    intro w hw
    have hgw :=
      (Submodule.mem_colon.mp hgI) (z * w) (S.mul_mem hzS hw)
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, hc]
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc] using hgw
  obtain ⟨a, hac⟩ :=
    (Submodule.IsPrincipal.mem_iff_eq_smul_generator I).mp hcI
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  have hgmap : algebraMap A (FractionRing A) g ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using
      (IsFractionRing.injective A (FractionRing A)).ne hgne
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hgmap
  calc
    algebraMap A (FractionRing A) g * algebraMap A (FractionRing A) a =
        algebraMap A (FractionRing A) (a • g) := by
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_comm]
    _ = algebraMap A (FractionRing A) c := by rw [hac]
    _ = algebraMap A (FractionRing A) g * z := by
      simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using hc

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.charZero_standardDVFOfDVR_residueField
statement:
theorem charZero_standardDVFOfDVR_residueField
    {V : Type uV} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    (hCharZero : CharZero (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)) :
    CharZero (standardDVFOfDVR V K).residueField
proof:
:= by
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let e : V ≃+* base.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := V) (K := K)
  have hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).map e.toRingHom =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal base.valuationSubring :=
    IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e
  let eResidue :
      (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) ≃+* base.residueField :=
    Ideal.quotientEquiv
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal base.valuationSubring) e hmax.symm
  let : CharZero (V ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) := hCharZero
  exact charZero_of_injective_ringHom eResidue.injective

statement:
theorem Hom.residueFieldMap_bijective_of_isClosedImmersion
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (z : Z) :
    Function.Bijective (i.residueFieldMap z)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (i.residueFieldMap z).hom.injective
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := i.stalkMap_surjective z b
    refine ⟨X.residue (i z) a, ?_⟩

      i.residueFieldMap z (X.residue (i z) a) =
          Z.residue z (i.stalkMap z a) := by
        simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
          congrArg (fun g ↦ g a) (residue_residueFieldMap i z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.geometricallyIntegral_specMap_transport_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem geometricallyIntegral_specMap_transport_ringEquiv
    {k R S : Type u} [Field k] [Field R] [Field S]
    [Algebra k R] (e : R ≃+* S)
    (h : GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R)))) :
    letI : Algebra k S
proof:
:=
      (e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k R)).toAlgebra
    GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S))) := by
  let : Algebra k S :=
    (e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k R)).toAlgebra
  let j : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) :=
    Scheme.Spec.mapIso e.toCommRingCatIso.op
  let : MorphismProperty.RespectsIso
      (@GeometricallyIntegral : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) := by
    rw [GeometricallyIntegral.eq_geometrically, geometrically_eq_universally]
    exact MorphismProperty.universally_respectsIso _
  have hj : GeometricallyIntegral
      (j.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R))) :=
    (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso
      (P := @GeometricallyIntegral) j.hom _).mpr h
  have hmap : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫
      e.toCommRingCatIso.hom.op.unop =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
    ext x
    rfl
  simpa only [j, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom,
    Scheme.Spec_map, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, hmap]
    using hj
