statement:
theorem exists_algebra_geometricallyIntegral_genericSourceResidue_of_genericFiber
    {C A S : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral C] [IsIntegral S]
    (i : C ⟶ A) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (f : C ⟶ S) (hη : f (genericPoint C) = genericPoint S)
    (hgeo : GeometricallyIntegral
      (f.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))) :
    let k
proof:
:= S.residueField (genericPoint S)
    ∃ hAlg : Algebra k (A.residueField (i (genericPoint C))),
      letI : Algebra k (A.residueField (i (genericPoint C))) := hAlg
      GeometricallyIntegral
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap k (A.residueField (i (genericPoint C)))))) := by
  let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
  let F := f.fiber (genericPoint S)
  let q := f.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)
  let : GeometricallyIntegral q := hgeo
  let : IsIntegral F :=
    GeometricallyIntegral.isIntegral_of_subsingleton q
  let : Algebra k F.functionField := q.functionFieldAlgebra
  let eF : C.residueField (genericPoint C) ≃+* F.functionField :=
    (f.genericFiberResidueFieldRingEquiv hη).trans
      (Scheme.functionFieldResidueFieldRingEquiv F).symm
  let e : A.residueField (i (genericPoint C)) ≃+* F.functionField :=
    (i.residueFieldRingEquivOfIsClosedImmersion
      (genericPoint C)).trans eF
  let hAlg : Algebra k (A.residueField (i (genericPoint C))) :=
    (e.symm.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k F.functionField)).toAlgebra
  refine ⟨hAlg, ?_⟩
  let : Algebra k (A.residueField (i (genericPoint C))) := hAlg
  exact i.geometricallyIntegral_genericSourceResidue_of_genericFiber
    f hη hgeo

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
    {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsRegularLocalRing D]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim D = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime] (hqHeight : q.height = 1) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime q)
proof:
:= by
  let V := Localization.AtPrime q
  have hintegrallyClosedD : IsIntegrallyClosed D :=
    SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
      hdim
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed D := hintegrallyClosedD
  let : IsNoetherianRing V :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing q.primeCompl V
      (inferInstance : IsNoetherianRing D)
  have hintegrallyClosedV : IsIntegrallyClosed V :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization V q.primeCompl
      q.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed V := hintegrallyClosedV
  have hqNe : q ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hq
    have hqZero : q.height = 0 :=
      Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.mpr hq
    rw [hqHeight] at hqZero
    norm_num at hqZero
  have hnotField : ¬ IsField V :=
    IsLocalization.AtPrime.not_isField D hqNe V
  have hdimV : ringKrullDim V = ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim V = (q.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height q V
      _ = ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hqHeight
  have hkrullDimLE : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 V := by
    rw [Ring.krullDimLE_iff, hdimV]
    exact le_rfl
  have hmaximalOfNonzeroPrime :
      ∀ (Q : Ideal V), Q ≠ ⊥ → Q.IsPrime → Q.IsMaximal :=
    (Ring.krullDimLE_one_iff_of_isPrime_bot.mp hkrullDimLE)
  have huniqueNonzeroPrime :
      ∃! Q : Ideal V, Q ≠ ⊥ ∧ Q.IsPrime := by
    refine ⟨maximalIdeal V, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.not.mp hnotField, inferInstance⟩
    · intro Q hQ
      exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal
        (hmaximalOfNonzeroPrime Q hQ.1 hQ.2)
  have hnormalUnique :
      IsIntegrallyClosed V ∧
        ∃! Q : Ideal V, Q ≠ ⊥ ∧ Q.IsPrime :=
    ⟨hintegrallyClosedV, huniqueNonzeroPrime⟩
  exact ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE V hnotField).out 1 4).mpr
    hnormalUnique

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.valuation_hasExtension_of_local_valuationSubring_map
statement:
private theorem valuation_hasExtension_of_local_valuationSubring_map
    {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (base : DVF.{uK, uV} K) (target : DVF.{uL, uW} L)
    (f : base.valuationSubring →+* target.valuationSubring)
    [IsLocalHom f]
    (hcoe : ∀ z : base.valuationSubring,
      ((f z : target.valuationSubring) : L) =
        algebraMap K L (z : K)) :
    base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
  ext z
  change
    algebraMap K L z ∈ target.valuation.valuationSubring ↔
      z ∈ base.valuation.valuationSubring
  constructor
  · intro hzTarget
    by_contra hzBase
    have hz_ne : z ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      subst z
      exact hzBase base.valuation.valuationSubring.zero_mem
    have hinvNonunit :
        z⁻¹ ∈ base.valuation.valuationSubring.nonunits :=
      (base.valuation.valuationSubring.inv_mem_nonunits_iff).2
        (Or.inr hzBase)
    let zinverse : base.valuationSubring :=
      ⟨z⁻¹, base.valuation.valuationSubring.nonunits_subset hinvNonunit⟩
    have hzinverseMaximal :
        zinverse ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal base.valuationSubring := by
      apply base.valuation.valuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mp
      exact hinvNonunit
    have hmapMaximal :
        f zinverse ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal target.valuationSubring :=
      map_nonunit f zinverse hzinverseMaximal
    let ztarget : target.valuationSubring :=
      ⟨algebraMap K L z, hzTarget⟩
    have hproduct : f zinverse * ztarget = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change
        ((f zinverse : target.valuationSubring) : L) *
            algebraMap K L z =
          1
      rw [hcoe]
      change algebraMap K L (z⁻¹) * algebraMap K L z = 1
      rw [← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hz_ne, map_one]
    have hone :
        (1 : target.valuationSubring) ∈
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal target.valuationSubring := by
      rw [← hproduct]
      exact
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal target.valuationSubring).mul_mem_right
          ztarget hmapMaximal
    exact
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal target.valuationSubring).isPrime.one_notMem
        hone
  · intro hzBase
    let zbase : base.valuationSubring := ⟨z, hzBase⟩
    have hzMap :
        ((f zbase : target.valuationSubring) : L) ∈
          target.valuation.valuationSubring :=
      (f zbase).property
    rwa [hcoe] at hzMap

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFOfDVR_hasExtension
statement:
theorem standardDVFOfDVR_hasExtension
    {V : Type uV} {W : Type uW} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CommRing W] [IsDomain W] [IsDiscreteValuationRing W]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Field L] [Algebra W L] [IsFractionRing W L]
    [Algebra K L]
    (f : V →+* W) [IsLocalHom f]
    (hcomm : (algebraMap W L).comp f =
      (algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap V K)) :
    (standardDVFOfDVR V K).valuation.HasExtension
      (standardDVFOfDVR W L).valuation
proof:
:= by
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFOfDVR W L
  let eV : V ≃+* base.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := V) (K := K)
  let eW : W ≃+* target.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := W) (K := L)
  let f' : base.valuationSubring →+* target.valuationSubring :=
    eW.toRingHom.comp (f.comp eV.symm.toRingHom)
  let : IsLocalHom eV.symm.toRingHom :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective eV.symm.toRingHom eV.symm.surjective
  let : IsLocalHom eW.toRingHom :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective eW.toRingHom eW.surjective
  let : IsLocalHom (f.comp eV.symm.toRingHom) :=
    RingHom.isLocalHom_comp f eV.symm.toRingHom
  let : IsLocalHom f' :=
    RingHom.isLocalHom_comp eW.toRingHom (f.comp eV.symm.toRingHom)
  apply valuation_hasExtension_of_local_valuationSubring_map base target f'
  intro z
  change
    (((eW (f (eV.symm z)) : target.valuationSubring) : L)) =
      algebraMap K L (z : K)
  change algebraMap W L (f (eV.symm z)) = algebraMap K L (z : K)
  have hzcomm := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomm (eV.symm z)
  change algebraMap W L (f (eV.symm z)) =
    algebraMap K L (algebraMap V K (eV.symm z)) at hzcomm
  rw [hzcomm]
  congr 1
  change
    (((eV (eV.symm z) : base.valuationSubring) : K)) = (z : K)
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx'_eq_of_map_eq
statement:
private theorem ramificationIdx'_eq_of_map_eq
    {R R' S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : R' →+* S)
    (p : Ideal R) (q : Ideal R') (P : Ideal S)
    (h : Ideal.map f p = Ideal.map g q) :
    letI : Algebra R S
proof:
:= f.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra R' S := g.toAlgebra
    Ideal.ramificationIdx' p P = Ideal.ramificationIdx' q P := by
  unfold Ideal.ramificationIdx'
  change sSup {n | Ideal.map f p ≤ P ^ n} =
    sSup {n | Ideal.map g q ≤ P ^ n}
  rw [h]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFOfDVR_ramificationIndex_eq_ramificationIdx
statement:
theorem standardDVFOfDVR_ramificationIndex_eq_ramificationIdx
    {V : Type uV} {W : Type uW} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CommRing W] [IsDomain W] [IsDiscreteValuationRing W]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Field L] [Algebra W L] [IsFractionRing W L]
    [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [Algebra V W] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap V W)]
    (hcomm : (algebraMap W L).comp (algebraMap V W) =
      (algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap V K)) :
    let base
proof:
:= standardDVFOfDVR V K
    let target := standardDVFOfDVR W L
    letI : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
      standardDVFOfDVR_hasExtension (algebraMap V W) hcomm
    ramificationIndex base target =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W).ramificationIdx V := by
  dsimp only
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFOfDVR W L
  let hExt : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFOfDVR_hasExtension (algebraMap V W) hcomm
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation := hExt
  let eV : V ≃+* base.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := V) (K := K)
  let eW : W ≃+* target.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := W) (K := L)
  let iCan : base.valuationSubring →+* target.valuationSubring :=
    algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring
  let g : V →+* target.valuationSubring := iCan.comp eV.toRingHom
  let : Algebra V target.valuationSubring := g.toAlgebra
  let eWAlg : W ≃ₐ[V] target.valuationSubring :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := eW) (by
      intro a
      apply Subtype.ext
      change algebraMap W L (algebraMap V W a) =
        algebraMap K L (algebraMap V K a)
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hcomm a)
  have htransport :=
    Ideal.ramificationIdx'_map_eq
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W) eWAlg
  change Ideal.ramificationIdx' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)
        (Ideal.map eW (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W)) =
      Ideal.ramificationIdx' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W) at htransport
  have hMaxW : Ideal.map eW (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W) =
      target.maximalIdeal :=
    map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv eW
  rw [hMaxW] at htransport
  have hMaxV : Ideal.map eV (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) =
      base.maximalIdeal :=
    map_maximalIdeal_ringEquiv eV
  have hMap : Ideal.map g (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) =
      Ideal.map iCan base.maximalIdeal := by
    calc
      Ideal.map g (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) =
          Ideal.map (iCan.comp eV.toRingHom)
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) := rfl
      _ = Ideal.map iCan
            (Ideal.map eV (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)) := by
            exact (Ideal.map_map eV.toRingHom iCan).symm
      _ = Ideal.map iCan base.maximalIdeal := by rw [hMaxV]
  have hOld :
      Ideal.ramificationIdx' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W) =
        ramificationIndex base target := by
    calc
      Ideal.ramificationIdx' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W) =
          Ideal.ramificationIdx' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)
            target.maximalIdeal := htransport.symm
      _ = Ideal.ramificationIdx' base.maximalIdeal target.maximalIdeal :=
        ramificationIdx'_eq_of_map_eq g iCan
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) base.maximalIdeal
          target.maximalIdeal hMap
      _ = ramificationIndex base target := rfl
  have hf : Function.Injective (algebraMap V W) := by
    intro a b hab
    apply IsFractionRing.injective V K
    apply (algebraMap K L).injective
    have ha := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomm a
    have hb := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomm b
    change algebraMap W L (algebraMap V W a) =
      algebraMap K L (algebraMap V K a) at ha
    change algebraMap W L (algebraMap V W b) =
      algebraMap K L (algebraMap V K b) at hb
    exact ha.symm.trans ((congrArg (algebraMap W L) hab).trans hb)
  have hMaxVNe : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V ≠ ⊥ := by
    simpa [ne_eq, ← IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq] using
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField V)
  have hMapMaxNe :
      Ideal.map (algebraMap V W) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) ≠ ⊥ :=
    (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective hf).not.mpr hMaxVNe
  let : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W).LiesOver
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) :=
    ⟨(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (algebraMap V W)).symm⟩
  let : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W).IsPrime :=
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal W).isPrime
  let : IsDedekindDomain W := inferInstance
  rw [← hOld]
  exact Ideal.ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx'
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W) hMapMaxNe

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    IsRegularRing R
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRegularRing_iff]
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpBot : p = ⊥
  · subst p
    let : Field (Localization.AtPrime (⊥ : Ideal R)) :=
      IsField.toField (by
        simp [isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq,
          ← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal])
    infer_instance
  by_cases hpMax : p = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  · subst p
    let e : R ≃ₐ[R]
        Localization.AtPrime (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
      IsLocalization.atUnits R
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).primeCompl
        (fun x ↦ by simpa using! fun a ↦ a)
    exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e.toRingEquiv
  · have hpLe : p ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime p
    have hpLt : p < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hpLe hpMax
    have hMaxHeight :
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height = (2 : ℕ∞) := by
      have hMaxHeightCast :
          (((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
            ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim, hdim]
      exact WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hMaxHeightCast
    have hpHeightLt : p.height < (2 : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← hMaxHeight]
      exact Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime hpLt
    have hpHeightLe : p.height ≤ (1 : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← ENat.lt_add_one_iff ENat.one_ne_top,
        one_add_one_eq_two]
      exact hpHeightLt
    have hpHeightPos : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ p.height :=
      Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
        (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.not.mpr hpBot)
    have hpHeight : p.height = 1 :=
      le_antisymm hpHeightLe hpHeightPos
    let : IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime p) :=
      isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
        hdim p hpHeight
    infer_instance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularLocalRing A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed A
proof:
:= by
  have hfin :
      Module.finrank (ResidueField A) (CotangentSpace A) = 2 := by
    have hreg :=
      (IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace A).mp inferInstance
    rw [hdim] at hreg
    exact ENat.natCast_inj.mp (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hreg)
  obtain ⟨x, y, hregular, hspan⟩ :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two_unconstrained
      hfin hdim
  exact
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegular_pair_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
      A x y hregular hspan

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.SpecialLocalPurity.isIntegrallyClosed_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_two
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_two
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularRing A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  apply isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_two
  calc
    ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime P) = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height
        P (Localization.AtPrime P)
    _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isUnit_natCast_mod_prime_of_heightTwo_localizations
statement:
theorem isUnit_natCast_mod_prime_of_heightTwo_localizations
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A]
    (t : A) (ht : Prime t) (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e)
    [CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t})]
    (hlocal : ∀ (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime],
      Ideal.span {t} < P → P.height = 2 →
        IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (e : A))) :
    IsUnit (e : A ⧸ Ideal.span {t})
proof:
:= by
  by_contra he_nonunit
  obtain ⟨P, hP, -, hstrict, hheight, he_local_nonunit⟩ :=
    exists_heightTwo_prime_of_nonunit_natCast_mod_prime
      t ht e he he_nonunit
  let : P.IsPrime := hP
  exact he_local_nonunit (hlocal P hstrict hheight)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSMulRegular_of_span_singleton_eq_maximalIdeal_of_not_krullDimLE_zero
statement:
private theorem isSMulRegular_of_span_singleton_eq_maximalIdeal_of_not_krullDimLE_zero
    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    {y : S} (hspan : Ideal.span {y} = maximalIdeal S)
    (hdim : ¬ Ring.KrullDimLE 0 S) :
    IsSMulRegular S y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
  intro a ha
  have hya : y * a = 0 := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using ha
  by_contra ha0
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, a ∉ maximalIdeal S ^ n := by
    by_contra hall
    push Not at hall
    have haInf : a ∈ ⨅ n : ℕ, maximalIdeal S ^ n :=
      Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr hall
    rw [Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing
      (maximalIdeal S) (maximalIdeal.isMaximal S).ne_top] at haInf
    exact ha0 (Ideal.mem_bot.mp haInf)
  let n := Nat.find hex
  have hn : a ∉ maximalIdeal S ^ n := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
    intro hn0
    apply hn
    simp [hn0]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn0
  have haPow : a ∈ maximalIdeal S ^ k := by
    by_contra hak
    have hnk : n ≤ k := Nat.find_min' hex hak
    omega
  have haDiv : y ^ k ∣ a := by
    rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← Ideal.span_singleton_pow, hspan]
    exact haPow
  obtain ⟨c, hac⟩ := haDiv
  have hc : c ∉ maximalIdeal S := by
    intro hc
    apply hn
    rw [hk, ← hspan, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    rw [← hspan, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hc
    obtain ⟨d, hcd⟩ := hc
    refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
    rw [hac, hcd, pow_succ]
    ac_rfl
  have hcUnit : IsUnit c := by
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal] at hc
    exact not_not.mp hc
  have hyPowMul : y ^ (k + 1) * c = 0 := by
    calc
      y ^ (k + 1) * c = y * (y ^ k * c) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        ac_rfl
      _ = 0 := by simpa only [hac] using hya
  have hyPow : y ^ (k + 1) = 0 := by
    apply hcUnit.mul_right_cancel
    simpa only [zero_mul] using hyPowMul
  have hyNil : IsNilpotent y := ⟨k + 1, hyPow⟩
  have hmax_le_nil : maximalIdeal S ≤ nilradical S := by
    rw [← hspan]
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    change IsNilpotent y
    exact hyNil
  have hnil : nilradical S = maximalIdeal S :=
    le_antisymm (nilradical_le_prime (maximalIdeal S)) hmax_le_nil
  have hnilMax : (nilradical S).IsMaximal :=
    hnil ▸ maximalIdeal.isMaximal S
  let : (nilradical S).IsMaximal := hnilMax
  exact hdim (Ring.KrullDimLE.of_isMaximal_nilradical S)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem isRegular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two_of_span_eq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x y : R}
    (hfin : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 2)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hspan : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R) :
    IsRegular R [x, y]
proof:
:= by
  have hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  have hyMem : y ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_cons_of_mem x List.mem_cons_self)
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    have hprincipal : (maximalIdeal R).IsPrincipal := by
      refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
      change maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {y}
      simpa [hx] using hspan.symm
    have hle :
        Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) ≤ 1 :=
      IsLocalRing.finrank_cotangentSpace_le_one_iff.mpr hprincipal
    omega
  have hxRegular : IsSMulRegular R x := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro a ha
    have hxa : x * a = 0 := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using ha
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hxa).resolve_left hx
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {x}
  let S := R ⧸ I
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    exact hxMem
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIle
  let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let ybar : S := Ideal.Quotient.mk I y
  have hspanS : Ideal.span {ybar} = maximalIdeal S := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
      ← hspan, Ideal.map_ofList]
    simp [I, ybar]
    rfl
  have hdimS : ¬ Ring.KrullDimLE 0 S := by
    intro hzero
    have hzero' : ringKrullDim S = 0 :=
      ringKrullDimZero_iff_ringKrullDim_eq_zero.mp hzero
    have hspanFin : I.spanFinrank = 1 := by
      change (Submodule.span R {x}).spanFinrank = 1
      exact Submodule.spanFinrank_singleton hx
    have hIJac : I ≤ Ring.jacobson R := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.ringJacobson_eq_maximalIdeal R]
      exact hIle
    have hle :=
      ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank I hIJac
    rw [hdim, hzero', hspanFin] at hle
    norm_num at hle
  have hyRegularS : IsSMulRegular S ybar :=
    isSMulRegular_of_span_singleton_eq_maximalIdeal_of_not_krullDimLE_zero
      hspanS hdimS
  have hyRegular : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop x R) y := by
    rw [isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem]
    intro a ha
    rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists] at ha ⊢
    obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := ha
    have hprod : y * a ∈ I := by
      change y * a ∈ Ideal.span {x}
      rw [show y * a = x * c by
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hc.symm]
      exact (Ideal.span {x}).mul_mem_right c
        (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x)
    have hzero : ybar * Ideal.Quotient.mk I a = 0 := by
      rw [← map_mul]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hprod
    have haZero : Ideal.Quotient.mk I a = 0 :=
      hyRegularS.right_eq_zero_of_smul (by
        simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hzero)
    have haMem : a ∈ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp haZero
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp haMem
    refine ⟨d, Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hd.symm
  have hweak : IsWeaklyRegular R [x, y] := by
    apply (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff R x [y]).mpr
    refine ⟨hxRegular, ?_⟩
    exact (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff (QuotSMulTop x R) y).mpr hyRegular
  have hmem : ∀ r ∈ [x, y], r ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro r hr
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hr
    rcases hr with rfl | rfl
    · exact hxMem
    · exact hyMem
  exact IsRegular.of_isWeaklyRegular_of_mem_maximalIdeal (L := R) hmem hweak

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two_unconstrained
statement:
theorem exists_regular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two_unconstrained
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (hfin : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 2)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ x y : R, IsRegular R [x, y] ∧
      Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let m : Ideal R := maximalIdeal R
  let b : Basis (Fin 2) (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) :=
    Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) hfin
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := m.toCotangent_surjective (b 0)
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := m.toCotangent_surjective (b 1)
  let x : R := x'
  let y : R := y'
  let v : Fin 2 → CotangentSpace R :=
    ![m.toCotangent x', m.toCotangent y']
  have hv : v = b := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [v] using hx'
    · simpa [v] using hy'
  have hvSpan :
      Submodule.span (ResidueField R) (Set.range v) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hv]
    exact b.span_eq
  have himage :
      m.toCotangent '' ({x', y'} : Set m) = Set.range v := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      Set.mem_range, v]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, rfl | rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i
      · exact ⟨x', Or.inl rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨y', Or.inr rfl, rfl⟩
  have hsubtypeSpan : Submodule.span R ({x', y'} : Set m) = ⊤ := by
    apply (CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff (R := R)).mp
    rw [himage]
    exact hvSpan
  have hmapSpan :
      (Submodule.span R ({x', y'} : Set m)).map m.subtype = m := by
    rw [hsubtypeSpan, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  have hspanSet : Ideal.span ({x, y} : Set R) = maximalIdeal R := by
    change Ideal.span ({x, y} : Set R) = m
    rw [← hmapSpan, Submodule.map_span]
    congr 1
    ext z
    simp [x, y]
  have hspan : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R := by
    change Ideal.span {r | r ∈ [x, y]} = maximalIdeal R
    rw [show {r | r ∈ [x, y]} = ({x, y} : Set R) by
      ext r
      exact List.mem_pair]
    exact hspanSet
  exact ⟨x, y,
    isRegular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two_of_span_eq
      hfin hdim hspan,
    hspan⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_two_unconstrained
statement:
theorem exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_two_unconstrained
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularRing A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2) :
    ∃ x y : Localization.AtPrime P,
      IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime P) [x, y] ∧
      Ideal.ofList [x, y] =
        maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  have hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim R = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P R
      _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hP
  have hfin :
      Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 2 := by
    have hreg :=
      (IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace R).mp inferInstance
    rw [hdim] at hreg
    exact ENat.natCast_inj.mp (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hreg)
  exact exists_regular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two_unconstrained
    hfin hdim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_ramificationIdx_eq
statement:
theorem localizationAtPrime_maximalIdeal_ramificationIdx_eq
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] (N : ℕ)
    (hRam : q.ramificationIdx R = N) :
    let p
proof:
:= q.under R
    letI : p.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.under R q
    letI : q.LiesOver p := ⟨rfl⟩
    let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p
    let Sq := Localization.AtPrime q
    letI : Algebra Rp Sq :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Sq).ramificationIdx Rp = N := by
  dsimp only
  let p := q.under R
  let : p.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.under R q
  let : q.LiesOver p := ⟨rfl⟩
  let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p
  let Sq := Localization.AtPrime q
  let : Algebra Rp Sq :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
  have hLocal :=
    ramificationIdx_map_eq_of_isLocalization
      (R := R) (S := S) (R' := Rp) (S' := Sq)
      p.primeCompl q.primeCompl q
      (show Disjoint (q.primeCompl : Set S) (q : Set S) from
        disjoint_compl_left)
  rw [Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal] at hLocal
  exact hLocal.trans hRam

statement:
theorem fractionFields_finiteDimensional_of_moduleFinite
    {V : Type uV} {W : Type uW} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}

    [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower V K L] :
    FiniteDimensional K L
proof:

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFOfDVR_valuationSubring_moduleFinite_of_moduleFinite
statement:
theorem standardDVFOfDVR_valuationSubring_moduleFinite_of_moduleFinite
    {V : Type uV} {W : Type uW} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CommRing W] [IsDomain W] [IsDiscreteValuationRing W]
    [Algebra V W] [Module.Finite V W]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Field L] [Algebra W L] [IsFractionRing W L]
    [Algebra V L] [IsScalarTower V W L]
    [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower V K L]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap V W)] :
    let base
proof:
:= standardDVFOfDVR V K
    let target := standardDVFOfDVR W L
    let hcomm :
        (algebraMap W L).comp (algebraMap V W) =
          (algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap V K) := by
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq V W L,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq V K L]
    letI : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
      standardDVFOfDVR_hasExtension (algebraMap V W) hcomm
    Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring := by
  dsimp only
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K
  let target := standardDVFOfDVR W L
  have hcomm :
      (algebraMap W L).comp (algebraMap V W) =
        (algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap V K) := by
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq V W L,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq V K L]
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFOfDVR_hasExtension (algebraMap V W) hcomm
  let eV : V ≃+* base.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := V) (K := K)
  let eW : W ≃+* target.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := W) (K := L)
  apply Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv eV eW
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  apply Subtype.ext
  change algebraMap K L (algebraMap V K z) =
    algebraMap W L (algebraMap V W z)
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun hcomm z).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.standardDVFOfDVR_finite_ramificationData_of_moduleFinite
statement:
theorem standardDVFOfDVR_finite_ramificationData_of_moduleFinite
    {V : Type uV} {W : Type uW} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]

    [Algebra V W] [Module.Finite V W]
    [Field K] [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Field L] [Algebra W L] [IsFractionRing W L]
    [Algebra V L] [IsScalarTower V W L]
    [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower V K L]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap V W)] :
    let base
proof:
:= standardDVFOfDVR V K
    let target := standardDVFOfDVR W L
    let hcomm :
        (algebraMap W L).comp (algebraMap V W) =
          (algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap V K) := by
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq V W L,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq V K L]
    letI : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
      standardDVFOfDVR_hasExtension (algebraMap V W) hcomm
    ∃ hFiniteDimensional : FiniteDimensional K L,
      letI : FiniteDimensional K L := hFiniteDimensional
      Module.Finite base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring ∧
        ramificationIndex base target =
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W).ramificationIdx V := by
  dsimp only
  let base := standardDVFOfDVR V K

      (algebraMap W L).comp (algebraMap V W) =
        (algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap V K) := by

  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    standardDVFOfDVR_hasExtension (algebraMap V W) hcomm
  let hFiniteDimensional : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    fractionFields_finiteDimensional_of_moduleFinite
      (V := V) (W := W) (K := K) (L := L)
  let : FiniteDimensional K L := hFiniteDimensional
  refine ⟨hFiniteDimensional, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact
      standardDVFOfDVR_valuationSubring_moduleFinite_of_moduleFinite
        (V := V) (W := W) (K := K) (L := L)

statement:
theorem standardDVFOfDVR_finite_ramificationData_eq_of_moduleFinite

proof:
:= standardDVFOfDVR V K

        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq V K L]
    letI : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
      standardDVFOfDVR_hasExtension (algebraMap V W) hcomm
    ∃ hFiniteDimensional : FiniteDimensional K L,

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_isDomain_isDiscreteValuationRing_of_flat_local_of_map_maximalIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem
    exists_isDomain_isDiscreteValuationRing_of_flat_local_of_map_maximalIdeal_eq
    {V : Type uV} {W : Type uW}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CommRing W] [Algebra V W] [IsLocalRing W] [IsNoetherianRing W]
    [Module.Flat V W] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap V W)]
    (hmax :
      (maximalIdeal V).map (algebraMap V W) = maximalIdeal W) :
    ∃ hdomainW : IsDomain W,
      letI : IsDomain W
proof:
:= hdomainW
      IsDiscreteValuationRing W := by
  obtain ⟨varpi, hvarpi⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_prime V
  have hvarpiRegular : IsSMulRegular V varpi := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro x hx
    change varpi * x = 0 at hx
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hx).resolve_left hvarpi.ne_zero
  have hregularV : IsRegular V [varpi] := by
    rw [isRegular_cons_iff]
    have hvarpiMem : varpi ∈ maximalIdeal V := by
      rw [mem_maximalIdeal]
      exact hvarpi.not_isUnit
    let : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop varpi V) :=
      nontrivial_quotSMulTop_of_mem_maximalIdeal V hvarpiMem
    exact ⟨hvarpiRegular, IsRegular.nil V _⟩
  have hgenerateV : Ideal.ofList [varpi] = maximalIdeal V := by
    rw [Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_nil, sup_bot_eq]
    exact hvarpi.irreducible.maximalIdeal_eq.symm
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V W :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  have hregularW : IsRegular W [algebraMap V W varpi] :=
    hregularV.of_faithfullyFlat
  have hgenerateW : Ideal.ofList [algebraMap V W varpi] =
      maximalIdeal W := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList [algebraMap V W varpi] =
          (Ideal.ofList [varpi]).map (algebraMap V W) := by
        simpa using
          (Ideal.map_ofList (algebraMap V W) [varpi]).symm
      _ = (maximalIdeal V).map (algebraMap V W) := by
        rw [hgenerateV]
      _ = maximalIdeal W := hmax
  have hdomainW : IsDomain W :=
    Kummer.isDomain_of_regularSystem
      [algebraMap V W varpi] hregularW hgenerateW
  let : IsDomain W := hdomainW
  have hvarpiImageNe : algebraMap V W varpi ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective V W).ne hvarpi.ne_zero
  have hmaximalNe : maximalIdeal W ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot
    apply hvarpiImageNe
    rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← hbot, ← hgenerateW]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_singleton_self _)
  have hnotField : ¬ IsField W :=
    IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.not.mpr hmaximalNe
  have hprincipal : (maximalIdeal W).IsPrincipal := by
    refine ⟨algebraMap V W varpi, ?_⟩
    simpa using hgenerateW.symm
  exact ⟨hdomainW,
    ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE W hnotField).out 5 1).mp hprincipal⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.prime_liesOver_bot_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem prime_liesOver_bot_mem_minimalPrimes
    {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra.IsIntegral R A]
    (N : Ideal A) [N.IsPrime] [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R)] :
    N ∈ minimalPrimes A
proof:
:= by
  have hmin :=
    Ideal.IsIntegral.mem_minimalPrimes_map_under (R := R) N
  have hUnder : N.under R = (⊥ : Ideal R) :=
    (N.over_def (⊥ : Ideal R)).symm
  rw [hUnder, Ideal.map_bot] at hmin
  exact hmin

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.minimalPrime_map_eq_bot_localizationAtPrime_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem minimalPrime_map_eq_bot_localizationAtPrime_of_isDomain
    {A : Type uA} [CommRing A]
    (N Q : Ideal A) [N.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime]
    [IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime Q)]
    (hNMinimal : N ∈ minimalPrimes A) (hNQ : N ≤ Q) :
    N.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hNMapMinimal :
      N.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q)) ∈
        minimalPrimes (Localization.AtPrime Q) := by
    have hMappedMinimal :
        N.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q)) ∈
          ((⊥ : Ideal A).map
            (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q))).minimalPrimes := by
      rw [IsLocalization.minimalPrimes_map Q.primeCompl
        (Localization.AtPrime Q) (⊥ : Ideal A)]
      change
        (N.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q))).under A ∈
          minimalPrimes A
      rw [Ideal.under_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime Q hNQ]
      exact hNMinimal
    simpa only [Ideal.map_bot] using hMappedMinimal
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact hNMapMinimal.2 ⟨inferInstance, bot_le⟩ bot_le
  · exact bot_le

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.prime_liesOver_bot_map_eq_bot_localizationAtPrime_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem prime_liesOver_bot_map_eq_bot_localizationAtPrime_of_isDomain
    {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra.IsIntegral R A]
    (N Q : Ideal A) [N.IsPrime] [N.LiesOver (⊥ : Ideal R)] [Q.IsPrime]
    [IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime Q)] (hNQ : N ≤ Q) :
    N.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime Q)) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  minimalPrime_map_eq_bot_localizationAtPrime_of_isDomain N Q
    (prime_liesOver_bot_mem_minimalPrimes (R := R) N) hNQ

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_normalizationPrime_over_largerPrime
statement:
theorem exists_normalizationPrime_over_largerPrime
    {A : Type uA} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [Field L] [Algebra A L]
    (p P : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] [P.IsPrime] (hpP : p ≤ P)
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver p] :
    ∃ N : Ideal (integralClosure A L),
      Q ≤ N ∧ N.IsPrime ∧ N.LiesOver P
proof:
:= by
  have hQP : Q.comap (algebraMap A (integralClosure A L)) ≤ P := by
    change Q.under A ≤ P
    rw [← Q.over_def p]
    exact hpP
  obtain ⟨N, hQN, hNPrime, hNComap⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime P Q hQP
  exact ⟨N, hQN, hNPrime, (Ideal.liesOver_iff N P).mpr hNComap.symm⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_normalizationPrimes_over_largerPrime_of_localized
statement:
theorem exists_normalizationPrimes_over_largerPrime_of_localized
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    (p P : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] [P.IsPrime] (hpP : p ≤ P) :
    letI
proof:
:= localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) p
    letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) p
    ∀ q : Ideal (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime p) L),
      q.IsPrime →
      q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p)) →
      ∃ Q N : Ideal (integralClosure A L),
        Q.IsPrime ∧ Q.LiesOver p ∧
        localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) p Q = q ∧
        Q.ramificationIdx A = q.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧
        Q ≤ N ∧ N.IsPrime ∧ N.LiesOver P := by
  let := localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) p
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime p) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) p
  intro q hq hqOver
  let Q := normalizationPrimeFromLocalization (K := K) (L := L) p q
  have hQPrime : Q.IsPrime :=
    normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_isPrime (K := K) (L := L) p q hq
  have hQOver : Q.LiesOver p :=
    normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_liesOver
      (K := K) (L := L) p q hq hqOver
  have hlocal : localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) p Q = q :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_normalizationPrimeFromLocalization
      (K := K) (L := L) p q hq
  have hram : Q.ramificationIdx A =
      q.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime p) :=
    (normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_ramificationIdx
      (K := K) (L := L) p q hq hqOver).symm
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQPrime
  let : Q.LiesOver p := hQOver
  obtain ⟨N, hQN, hNPrime, hNOver⟩ :=
    exists_normalizationPrime_over_largerPrime
      (L := L) p P hpP Q
  exact ⟨Q, N, hQPrime, hQOver, hlocal, hram, hQN, hNPrime, hNOver⟩

statement:
private theorem localizedNormalizationPrime_isPrime
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver P] :

  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P

      Algebra (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (integralClosure A L) P.primeCompl)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    isLocalization_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  change (Q.map (algebraMap (integralClosure A L)
    (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L))).IsPrime
  exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.isPrime_map_of_liesOver
    (integralClosure A L) P
    (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) Q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizedNormalizationPrime_liesOver
statement:
theorem localizedNormalizationPrime_liesOver
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver P] :
    (localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q).LiesOver
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P))
proof:
:= by
  let _hExtensionAlgebra : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  let hNormalizationAlgebra :
      Algebra (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (integralClosure A L) P.primeCompl)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    isLocalization_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (integralClosure A L)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦
      Subtype.ext <|
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (Localization.AtPrime P) L x
  change (Q.map (algebraMap (integralClosure A L)
    (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L))).LiesOver
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P))
  exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.liesOver_map_of_liesOver
    P (Localization.AtPrime P)
    (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) Q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizedNormalizationPrime_isMaximal

    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver P] :

  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  let hNormalizationAlgebra :
      Algebra (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (integralClosure A L) P.primeCompl)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    isLocalization_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (integralClosure A L)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_isPrime
statement:
theorem normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_isPrime
    :
    letI
proof:
:= localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
    ∀ q : Ideal (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L), q.IsPrime →
      (normalizationPrimeFromLocalization (K := K) (L := L) P q).IsPrime := by
  let := localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  let := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  intro q hq

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_liesOver
statement:
theorem normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_liesOver
    :
    letI
proof:
:= localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
    ∀ q : Ideal (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L),
      q.IsPrime →
      q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) →
      (normalizationPrimeFromLocalization (K := K) (L := L) P q).LiesOver P := by
  let := localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  let := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  intro q hq hqOver
  let : q.IsPrime := hq
  let : q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) := hqOver
  let : IsScalarTower A (integralClosure A L)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦
      Subtype.ext <| IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A
        (Localization.AtPrime P) L x
  let : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).LiesOver P :=
    inferInstance
  let : q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans q
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) P
  let : q.LiesOver
      (normalizationPrimeFromLocalization (K := K) (L := L) P q) := by
    change q.LiesOver
      (q.comap (algebraMap (integralClosure A L)
        (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L)))

  exact Ideal.LiesOver.tower_bot q
    (normalizationPrimeFromLocalization (K := K) (L := L) P q) P

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizedNormalizationPrime_normalizationPrimeFromLocalization
statement:

proof:

    ∀ q : Ideal (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L), q.IsPrime →

      (K := K) (L := L) P

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_ramificationIdx
statement:
theorem normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_ramificationIdx
    :
    letI
proof:
:= localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
    ∀ q : Ideal (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L),
      q.IsPrime →
      q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) →
      q.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime P) =
        (normalizationPrimeFromLocalization (K := K) (L := L) P q).ramificationIdx A := by
  let := localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  intro q hq hqOver
  let : q.IsPrime := hq
  let : q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) := hqOver
  let Q := normalizationPrimeFromLocalization (K := K) (L := L) P q
  let : Q.IsPrime :=
    normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_isPrime (K := K) (L := L) P q hq
  let : Q.LiesOver P :=
    normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_liesOver (K := K) (L := L) P q hq hqOver
  have hlocal : localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q = q :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_normalizationPrimeFromLocalization
      (K := K) (L := L) P q hq
  calc
    q.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime P) =
        (localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q).ramificationIdx
          (Localization.AtPrime P) := congrArg
            (fun I : Ideal (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) ↦
              I.ramificationIdx (Localization.AtPrime P)) hlocal.symm
    _ = Q.ramificationIdx A :=
      localizedNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx
        (K := K) (L := L) P Q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_map_eq_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_map_eq_of_isLocalization
    (M : Submonoid R) (T : Submonoid S)
    [IsLocalization M R'] [IsLocalization T S']
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    (hdisj : Disjoint (T : Set S) (q : Set S)) :
    (q.map (algebraMap S S')).ramificationIdx R' =
      q.ramificationIdx R
proof:
:= by
  let q' := q.map (algebraMap S S')
  let p := q.under R
  let p' := p.map (algebraMap R R')
  let : q'.IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint T S' q inferInstance hdisj
  let : q'.LiesOver p' :=
    IsLocalization.liesOver_of_isPrime_of_disjoint M T p hdisj
  let : q'.LiesOver q :=
    IsLocalization.liesOver_map_of_isPrime_disjoint T S' hdisj
  rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq p' q', Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq p q]
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) (Localization.AtPrime q') :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver q q'
  have hq'q : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.AtPrime q') q := by
    convert IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      T (Localization.AtPrime q') q'
    rw [← Ideal.under_def, ← Ideal.over_def q' q]
  let : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.AtPrime q') q := hq'q
  have hbij : Function.Bijective
      (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) (Localization.AtPrime q')) :=
    (Localization.algEquiv q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime q')).bijective
  have key : p.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q)) =
      (p'.map (algebraMap R' (Localization.AtPrime q'))).comap
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) (Localization.AtPrime q')) := by
    change p.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q)) =
      ((p.map (algebraMap R R')).map
        (algebraMap R' (Localization.AtPrime q'))).comap
          (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) (Localization.AtPrime q'))
    rw [p.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R R'
        (Localization.AtPrime q'),
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (Localization.AtPrime q'), ← p.map_map,
      Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ hbij]
  apply congrArg ENat.toNat
  calc
    _ = Order.coheight
        (p'.map (algebraMap R' (Localization.AtPrime q'))) :=
      Module.length_quotient
    _ = Order.coheight
          ((p'.map (algebraMap R' (Localization.AtPrime q'))).comap
            (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q)
              (Localization.AtPrime q'))) :=
      (Ideal.coheight_comap_of_surjective _ hbij.2
        (p'.map (algebraMap R' (Localization.AtPrime q')))).symm
    _ = Order.coheight
        (p.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q))) :=
      congrArg Order.coheight key.symm
    _ = _ := Module.length_quotient.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdxIn_eq_localPrime
statement:
private theorem ramificationIdxIn_eq_localPrime
    {V : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra V K] [IsFractionRing V K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra V L] [IsScalarTower V K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver (integralClosure V L)) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).ramificationIdxIn (integralClosure V L) =
      q.1.ramificationIdx V
proof:
:= by
  let S := integralClosure V L
  let : Module.Finite V S := IsIntegralClosure.finite V K L S
  let : IsFractionRing S L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension V K L S
  let : MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) S :=
    IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction V K L S
  let : IsGaloisGroup Gal(L/K) V S :=
    IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing Gal(L/K) V S K L
  change (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).ramificationIdxIn S =
    q.1.ramificationIdx V
  exact Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) q.1 Gal(L/K)

statement:
theorem localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_galoisBranchIndex
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] (hp : p.height = 1) :
    let V
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime p
    letI : Algebra V K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) p
    letI : Algebra V L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) p
    letI : IsScalarTower V K L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) p
    let S := integralClosure V L
    ∀ q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver S,
      q.1.ramificationIdx V =
        normalizationGaloisBranchRamificationIndex
          (K := K) (L := L) p := by
  dsimp only
  let V := Localization.AtPrime p
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) p
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) p
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) p
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) p
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_one A p hp
  intro q
  exact (ramificationIdxIn_eq_localPrime
    (V := V) (K := K) (L := L) q).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.normalizationGaloisBranchRamificationIndex_pos
statement:
theorem normalizationGaloisBranchRamificationIndex_pos
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] (hp : p.height = 1) :
    0 < normalizationGaloisBranchRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) p
proof:
:= by
  let V := Localization.AtPrime p
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) p
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) p
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) p
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) p
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_one A p hp
  let S := integralClosure V L
  let : Module.Finite V S := IsIntegralClosure.finite V K L S
  let : IsFractionRing S L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension V K L S
  let : MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) S :=
    IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction V K L S
  let : IsGaloisGroup Gal(L/K) V S :=
    IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing Gal(L/K) V S K L
  let : FaithfulSMul V S :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective V S).mpr fun x y hxy ↦ by
      apply IsFractionRing.injective V K
      apply (algebraMap K L).injective
      have hco : algebraMap V L x = algebraMap V L y := by
        change (algebraMap V S x : L) = (algebraMap V S y : L)
        exact congrArg (fun z : S ↦ (z : L)) hxy
      simpa only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V K L] using hco
  change 0 < (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).ramificationIdxIn S
  exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
    (Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_ne_zero Gal(L/K))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.normalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_galoisBranchIndex
statement:
theorem normalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_galoisBranchIndex
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]

    (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] (hp : p.height = 1)
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver p] :
    Q.ramificationIdx A =
      normalizationGaloisBranchRamificationIndex
        (K := K) (L := L) p
proof:
:= by
  let V := Localization.AtPrime p
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) p
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) p
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) p

    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) p
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_one A p hp
  let S := integralClosure V L
  let : Module.Finite V S := IsIntegralClosure.finite V K L S
  let q := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) p Q

  let : q.IsPrime := inferInstance
  let : q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_liesOver (K := K) (L := L) p Q
  let qOver : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver S :=
    ⟨q, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  rw [← localizedNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx
    (K := K) (L := L) p Q]
  exact localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_galoisBranchIndex
    (K := K) (L := L) p hp qOver

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex_pos
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : A} (t : Fin d → A)
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r) (j : Fin d) :
    0 < splitStrictNormalCrossingsGaloisRamificationIndex
      (K := K) (L := L) t hNC j
proof:

    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver p] :
    Q.ramificationIdx A ∣
      normalizationBranchRamificationProduct
        (K := K) (L := L) p hp
proof:
:= by
  let V := Localization.AtPrime p
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) p
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) p

    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) p
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) p
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing V :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_one A p hp
  let C := integralClosure V L
  let : Module.Finite V C :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite V K L C
  let q := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) p Q
  let : q.IsMaximal :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_isMaximal (K := K) (L := L) p Q
  let : q.IsPrime := inferInstance
  let : q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_liesOver (K := K) (L := L) p Q
  let qOver : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C :=
    ⟨q, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  have hdiv :=
    ramificationIdx_dvd_branchRamificationProduct
      (S := C) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) qOver
  change q.ramificationIdx V ∣
    branchRamificationProduct
      (S := C) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) at hdiv
  rw [localizedNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx
    (K := K) (L := L) p Q] at hdiv
  exact hdiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_etale_of_baseRingEquiv
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_baseRingEquiv
    (e : R ≃+* S)
    (h : (algebraMap S A).comp e.toRingHom = algebraMap R A)
    (hEtale : Algebra.Etale S (integralClosure S A)) :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R A)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra R (integralClosure S A) :=
    integralClosureBaseRingAlgebra e
  let : Algebra.Etale S (integralClosure S A) := hEtale
  let : Algebra R S := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let eAlg : R ≃ₐ[R] S :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e) fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : Algebra.Etale R S := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eAlg
  let : IsScalarTower R S (integralClosure S A) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure S A) :=
    Algebra.Etale.comp R S (integralClosure S A)
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv
    (integralClosureBaseRingAlgEquiv e h).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_etale_of_baseAndAmbientEquiv
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_baseAndAmbientEquiv
    (eBase : R ≃+* S) (eAmbient : A ≃+* B)

      (algebraMap S B).comp eBase.toRingHom)
    (hEtale : Algebra.Etale S (integralClosure S B)) :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R A)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra R B :=
    ((algebraMap S B).comp eBase.toRingHom).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra R (integralClosure S B) :=
    integralClosureBaseRingAlgebra eBase
  let : Algebra.Etale S (integralClosure S B) := hEtale
  let : Algebra R S := eBase.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let eBaseAlg : R ≃ₐ[R] S :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := eBase) fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : Algebra.Etale R S := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eBaseAlg
  let : IsScalarTower R S (integralClosure S B) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure S B) :=
    Algebra.Etale.comp R S (integralClosure S B)
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv
    (integralClosureAlgEquivOfBaseAndAmbientEquiv
      eBase eAmbient h).symm

proof:
:= by
  let fieldEquiv : L ≃ₐ[A] P :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A L P) hbij
  let normalizationEquiv : integralClosure A L ≃ₐ[A]
      integralClosure A P := fieldEquiv.mapIntegralClosure
