name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_integralClosure_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
statement:
theorem localization_integralClosure_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
    [IsScalarTower A K L]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :
    letI
proof:
:= localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
    Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime P)
        (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) →
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime P)
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
          (integralClosure A L) P.primeCompl)) := by
  let := localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  let := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  intro h
  let : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime P)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) := h
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv
    (localizationIntegralClosureAtPrimeAlgEquiv
      (K := K) (L := L) P).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocalization_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
statement:
theorem isLocalization_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L
proof:
:=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
    let : Algebra (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
      integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
    IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (integralClosure A L) P.primeCompl)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) := by
  intro algebraP_L hALocL algebraC_Cp
  let hAB : IsScalarTower A (integralClosure A L)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let hBL : IsScalarTower (integralClosure A L)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) L :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid L P.primeCompl) L :=
    IsLocalization.of_le_isUnit fun y hy ↦ by
      rcases hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      change IsUnit (algebraMap A L x)
      rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L,
        map_ne_zero_iff _ (algebraMap K L).injective,
        map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective A K)]
      exact fun h ↦ hx (h ▸ P.zero_mem)
  exact IsLocalization.integralClosure
    (R := A) (S := L) (Rf := Localization.AtPrime P) (Sf := L) P.primeCompl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.moduleFinite_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L
proof:
:=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) P
    Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime P)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) := by
  intro algebraP_L towerP_L
  let : Algebra (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (integralClosure A L) P.primeCompl)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    isLocalization_integralClosure_localizationAtPrime
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (integralClosure A L)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P)
      (integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime P) L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦
      Subtype.ext <|
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (Localization.AtPrime P) L x
  exact Module.Finite.of_isLocalization
    A (integralClosure A L) P.primeCompl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_awayMap_integralClosurePrime_etale_of_localized
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_integralClosurePrime_etale_of_localized
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver P]
    (f : Localization.AtPrime P)
    (hAway :
      let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
        localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
      let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
        localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
          (K := K) (L := L) P
      let q := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
      let : q.IsMaximal :=
        localizedNormalizationPrime_isMaximal (K := K) (L := L) P Q
      let : q.IsPrime := (inferInstance : q.IsMaximal).isPrime
      IsAwayMapEtale (R := Localization.AtPrime P)
        (D := Localization.AtPrime q) f) :
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L
proof:
:=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) P
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
    RingHom.Etale
      (R := Localization.Away f)
      (S := Localization.Away
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime Q) f))
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) f) := by
  intro algebraP_L towerP_L algebraP_Q
  let V := Localization.AtPrime P
  let q := localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  let : q.IsMaximal :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_isMaximal (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  let : q.IsPrime := (inferInstance : q.IsMaximal).isPrime
  let E : Localization.AtPrime Q ≃ₐ[V] Localization.AtPrime q :=
    integralClosurePrimeLocalizationAlgEquiv
      (K := K) (L := L) P Q
  exact localization_awayMap_etale_of_algEquiv E.symm f hAway

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosureLocalizationFractionRingAlgEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integralClosureLocalizationFractionRingAlgEquiv_algebraMap
    {B : Type uB} {K : Type uK} {M : Type uM}
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [Field K] [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K]
    [Field M] [Algebra B M] [Algebra K M]
    [IsScalarTower B K M] [FiniteDimensional K M]
    (q : Ideal (integralClosure B M)) [q.IsPrime]
    (x : Localization.AtPrime q) :
    let C
proof:
:= integralClosure B M
    letI : IsFractionRing C M :=
      IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension B K M C
    let D := Localization.AtPrime q
    letI : Algebra D M :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := M) q
    integralClosureLocalizationFractionRingAlgEquiv
        (B := B) (K := K) (M := M) q
        (algebraMap D (FractionRing D) x) =
      algebraMap D M x := by
  dsimp only
  let C := integralClosure B M
  let : IsFractionRing C M :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension B K M C
  let D := Localization.AtPrime q
  let : Algebra D M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := M) q
  exact
    (integralClosureLocalizationFractionRingAlgEquiv
      (B := B) (K := K) (M := M) q).commutes x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_awayMap_etale_of_finite_formallyEtale_extension
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_etale_of_finite_formallyEtale_extension
    {A : Type uA} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Algebra A C] [Algebra C D] [Algebra A D]
    [IsScalarTower A C D]
    [Module.Finite A D] [Algebra.FormallyEtale C D]
    (f : A)
    (hAway : (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A C) f).Etale) :
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) f).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let fC : C := algebraMap A C f
  let fD : D := algebraMap A D f
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let T := Localization.Away fC
  let U := Localization.Away fD
  let mapST : S →+* T := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A C) f
  let mapCDU : C →+* U := algebraMap C U
  have hfCUnit : IsUnit (mapCDU fC) := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap D U (algebraMap C D (algebraMap A C f)))
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C D f]
    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit fD
  let mapTU : T →+* U := Localization.awayLift mapCDU fC hfCUnit
  let mapSU : S →+* U := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) f
  let : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra T U := mapTU.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower C T U :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ by
      change mapCDU c = mapTU (algebraMap C T c)
      simp [mapTU]
  let : IsLocalization
      ((Submonoid.powers fC).map (algebraMap C D)) U := by
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers, show algebraMap C D fC = fD by
      exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C D f).symm]
    infer_instance
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale T U :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.localization_map
      (R := C) (S := D) (Rₘ := T) (Sₘ := U)
      (Submonoid.powers fC)
  have hcomp : mapTU.comp mapST = mapSU := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers f)
    ext a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    calc
      mapTU (mapST (algebraMap A S a)) =
          mapTU (algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C a)) := by
        rw [show mapST (algebraMap A S a) =
            algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C a) by
          simp [mapST, S, T, fC, IsLocalization.Away.map]]
      _ = mapCDU (algebraMap A C a) := by simp [mapTU]
      _ = algebraMap D U (algebraMap C D (algebraMap A C a)) := rfl
      _ = algebraMap D U (algebraMap A D a) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C D a]
      _ = mapSU (algebraMap A S a) := by
        simp [mapSU, S, U, fD, IsLocalization.Away.map]
  let : Algebra S U := mapSU.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower S T U :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦
      (DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp x).symm
  let : Algebra.Etale S T := hAway.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale S U :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp S T U
  let : IsScalarTower A S U :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ by
      change algebraMap A U a = mapSU (algebraMap A S a)
      rw [show mapSU (algebraMap A S a) =
          algebraMap D U (algebraMap A D a) by
        simp [mapSU, S, U, fD, IsLocalization.Away.map]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A D U a
  let : IsLocalization
      ((Submonoid.powers f).map (algebraMap A D)) U := by
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
    exact (inferInstance : IsLocalization.Away fD U)
  let : Module.Finite S U :=
    Module.Finite.of_isLocalization A D (Submonoid.powers f)
  let : Module.FinitePresentation S U :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite S U
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation S U :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation S U
  exact (show Algebra.Etale S U from
    { formallyEtale := inferInstance
      finitePresentation := inferInstance })

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_integralBase_chosenLocalization_finiteEtale_unique_away
statement:
theorem integralClosure_integralBase_chosenLocalization_finiteEtale_unique_away
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Field L]
    [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [HenselianLocalRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra B L] [IsScalarTower A B L]
    (hEtale : Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure B L))
    (f : A)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap A (integralClosure A L)) f).Etale) :
    let C
proof:
:= integralClosure A L
    letI : Algebra B C := integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower A B C :=
      integralClosureIntegralBase_isScalarTower
    ∀ (q : Ideal C) [q.IsPrime]
      [q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal B)],
      let D := Localization.AtPrime q
      Module.Finite B D ∧
        Algebra.Etale B D ∧
        (maximalIdeal D).LiesOver (maximalIdeal B) ∧
        (∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
          Q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal B) → Q = maximalIdeal D) ∧
        @Algebra.Etale
          (Localization.Away f)
          (Localization.Away
            (algebraMap A D f))
          _ _
          (Localization.awayMap
            (algebraMap A D) f).toAlgebra := by
  dsimp only
  let C := integralClosure A L
  let : Algebra B C := integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B C :=
    integralClosureIntegralBase_isScalarTower
  let : Algebra.Etale B C :=
    integralClosure_etale_of_integralBase hEtale
  intro q _ _
  let D := Localization.AtPrime q
                                                                         
                                                                        
  let : IsScalarTower A B D :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
      (R := A) (S := B) (A := D) fun a ↦ by
        calc
          algebraMap A D a = algebraMap C D (algebraMap A C a) :=
            IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C D a
          _ = algebraMap C D
              (algebraMap B C (algebraMap A B a)) := by
            rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B C a]
          _ = algebraMap B D (algebraMap A B a) :=
            (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B C D
              (algebraMap A B a)).symm
  let : IsNoetherianRing B := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite A B
  let : Module.Finite B D :=
    moduleFinite_localizationAtPrime_of_henselian_of_etale q
  have hEtaleD : Algebra.Etale B D := by
    let : Module.FinitePresentation B D :=
      Module.finitePresentation_of_finite B D
    let : Algebra.FinitePresentation B D :=
      Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation B D
    exact
      { formallyEtale := inferInstance
        finitePresentation := inferInstance }
  let : Algebra.Etale B D := hEtaleD
  let : Module.Finite A D := Module.Finite.trans B D
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap B D) :=
    isLocalHom_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_liesOver_maximalIdeal q
  have hclosedOver : (maximalIdeal D).LiesOver (maximalIdeal B) :=
    inferInstance
  have hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal B) → Q = maximalIdeal D := by
    intro Q hQPrime hQOver
    let : Q.IsPrime := hQPrime
    let : Q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal B) := hQOver
    let : Algebra.IsIntegral B D := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite B D
    have hQMaximal : Q.IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap (algebraMap B D)
        (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) Q <| by
          rw [← Ideal.under_def, ← Q.over_def (maximalIdeal B)]
          exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal B
    exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hQMaximal
  have hAwayD :=
    localization_awayMap_etale_of_finite_formallyEtale_extension
      (A := A) (C := C) (D := D) f hAway
  exact ⟨inferInstance, hEtaleD, hclosedOver, hunique, hAwayD⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_galoisBranchIndex_at_largerPrime
statement:
theorem localNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_galoisBranchIndex_at_largerPrime
    {A : Type uA} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (p P : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] [P.IsPrime]
    (hp : p.height = 1) (hpP : p ≤ P) :
    let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
    letI : Algebra R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    letI : Algebra R L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI : IsScalarTower R K L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) P
    letI : IsFractionRing R K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
    let pR := p.map (algebraMap A R)
    letI : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hpP
    let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
    letI : Algebra V K :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
    letI : Algebra V L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) pR
    letI : IsScalarTower V K L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := L) pR
    let C := integralClosure V L
    ∀ q : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).primesOver C,
      q.1.ramificationIdx V =
        normalizationGaloisBranchRamificationIndex
          (K := K) (L := L) p := by
  dsimp only
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : Algebra R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : Algebra R L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsScalarTower R K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) P
  let : IsFractionRing R K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) P
  let : IsScalarTower A R L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) (L := L) P
  let := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := L) P
  let pR := p.map (algebraMap A R)
  let : pR.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hpP
  let V := Localization.AtPrime pR
  let : Algebra V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) pR
  let : Algebra V L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) pR
  let : IsScalarTower V K L :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := L) pR
  let : IsFractionRing V K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) pR
  intro q
  let qV : Ideal (integralClosure V L) := q.1
  let : qV.IsPrime := by
    dsimp only [qV]
    infer_instance
  let : qV.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) := by
    dsimp only [qV]
    infer_instance
  let qR : Ideal (integralClosure R L) :=
    normalizationPrimeFromLocalization (K := K) (L := L) pR qV
  have hqRPrime : qR.IsPrime :=
    normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_isPrime
      (K := K) (L := L) pR qV inferInstance
  let : qR.IsPrime := hqRPrime
  have hqROver : qR.LiesOver pR :=
    normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_liesOver
      (K := K) (L := L) pR qV inferInstance inferInstance
  let : qR.LiesOver pR := hqROver
  let qA : Ideal (integralClosure A L) :=
    normalizationPrimeFromLocalization (K := K) (L := L) P qR
  have hqAPrime : qA.IsPrime :=
    normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_isPrime
      (K := K) (L := L) P qR inferInstance
  let : qA.IsPrime := hqAPrime
  have hpRUnder : pR.under A = p :=
    Ideal.under_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hpP
  have hqAEq : qA = qR.under (integralClosure A L) := by
    rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure R L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A R (integralClosure R L) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦
      Subtype.ext <| IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A R L x
  have hqAUnder : qA.under A = p := by
    rw [hqAEq]
    rw [Ideal.under_under, ← Ideal.under_under (B := R), ← hqROver.over,
      hpRUnder]
  have hqAP : qA.under A ≤ P := by
    rw [hqAUnder]
    exact hpP
  have hlocalA :
      localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P qA = qR :=
    localizedNormalizationPrime_normalizationPrimeFromLocalization
      (K := K) (L := L) P qR inferInstance
  have hqAOver : qA.LiesOver p := ⟨hqAUnder.symm⟩
  let : qA.LiesOver p := hqAOver
  change Ideal.ramificationIdx (S := integralClosure V L) qV
      (Localization.AtPrime pR) =
    normalizationGaloisBranchRamificationIndex (K := K) (L := L) p
  calc
    Ideal.ramificationIdx (S := integralClosure V L) qV
        (Localization.AtPrime pR) =
        (normalizationPrimeFromLocalization
          (K := K) (L := L) pR qV).ramificationIdx R :=
      normalizationPrimeFromLocalization_ramificationIdx
        (K := K) (L := L) pR qV inferInstance inferInstance
    _ = qR.ramificationIdx R := by rfl
    _ = (localizedNormalizationPrime (K := K) (L := L) P qA).ramificationIdx R :=
      congrArg (fun I : Ideal (integralClosure R L) ↦ I.ramificationIdx R)
        hlocalA.symm
    _ = qA.ramificationIdx A :=
      localizedNormalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_of_under_le
        (K := K) (L := L) P qA hqAP
    _ = normalizationGaloisBranchRamificationIndex
        (K := K) (L := L) p :=
      normalizationPrime_ramificationIdx_eq_galoisBranchIndex
        (K := K) (L := L) p hp qA

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (f : A) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away f
    let X := Spec (.of S)
    letI : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
    letI : Algebra A X.functionField :=
      localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
    IsFractionRing A X.functionField := by
  dsimp only
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  let K : Type u := (Spec (.of S)).functionField
  let : Algebra S K :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of S)
  let : Algebra A K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
  let : IsScalarTower A S K := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    rfl
  let : IsFractionRing S K :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.functionField_isFractionRing_of_affine (.of S)
  have hpow : Submonoid.powers f ≤ nonZeroDivisors A :=
    Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf)
  have hsub :
      IsLocalization.localizationLocalizationSubmodule
          (Submonoid.powers f) (nonZeroDivisors S) =
        nonZeroDivisors A := by
    ext x
    rw [IsLocalization.mem_localizationLocalizationSubmodule,
      mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, z, hxyz⟩ hx
      subst x
      have hy : (y : S) ≠ 0 := by
        exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp y.property
      have hz : algebraMap A S (z : A) ≠ 0 :=
        (IsLocalization.map_units S z).ne_zero
      exact (mul_ne_zero hy hz) (by simpa using hxyz.symm)
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨⟨algebraMap A S x, ?_⟩, 1, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero]
        simpa using (IsLocalization.injective S hpow).ne hx
      · simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, map_one, mul_one]
  have hloc :
      IsLocalization
        (IsLocalization.localizationLocalizationSubmodule
          (Submonoid.powers f) (nonZeroDivisors S)) K :=
    IsLocalization.localization_localization_isLocalization
      (Submonoid.powers f) (nonZeroDivisors S) K
  change IsLocalization (nonZeroDivisors A) K
  rw [← hsub]
  exact hloc

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleAway_functionField_isScalarTower
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (f : A) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)))) [IsConnected Y] :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away f
    let X := Spec (.of S)
    letI : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
      isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra A X.functionField :=
      localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
    letI : Algebra A Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
    IsScalarTower A X.functionField Y.left.functionField := by
  dsimp only
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let X := Spec (.of S)
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let K : Type u := X.functionField
  let L : Type u := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra S K :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of S)
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra A K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
  let : Algebra S L := finiteEtaleSpecFunctionFieldAlgebra (.of S) Y
  let : Algebra A L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
  let : IsScalarTower A S K := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    rfl
  let : IsScalarTower S K L :=
    finiteEtaleSpec_functionField_isScalarTower (.of S) Y
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro x
  calc
    algebraMap A L x = algebraMap S L (algebraMap A S x) := rfl
    _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap S K (algebraMap A S x)) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S K L (algebraMap A S x)
    _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K x) := by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S K]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_away_integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale
statement:
theorem localization_away_integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (f : A) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)))) [IsConnected Y] :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away f
    let X := Spec (.of S)
    letI : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
    letI : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
      isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : Algebra X.functionField Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
    letI : Algebra A X.functionField :=
      localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
    letI : Algebra A Y.left.functionField :=
      finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
    (Localization.awayMap
      (algebraMap A (integralClosure A Y.left.functionField)) f).Etale := by
  dsimp only
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let X := Spec (.of S)
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed S :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization S (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hf))
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let K : Type u := X.functionField
  let L : Type u := Y.left.functionField
  let : Algebra S K :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of S)
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Y
  let : Algebra A K := localizationAwaySpecFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf
  let coverSL : Algebra S L :=
    finiteEtaleSpecFunctionFieldAlgebra (.of S) Y
  let : Algebra S L := coverSL
  let : Algebra A L := finiteEtaleAwayFunctionFieldAlgebra f hf Y
  let : IsScalarTower A S K := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    rfl
  let : IsScalarTower S K L :=
    finiteEtaleSpec_functionField_isScalarTower (.of S) Y
  let : IsScalarTower A K L := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    calc
      algebraMap A L x = algebraMap S L (algebraMap A S x) := rfl
      _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap S K (algebraMap A S x)) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S K L (algebraMap A S x)
      _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K x) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S K]
  let : IsFractionRing S K :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.functionField_isFractionRing_of_affine (.of S)
  let : IsFractionRing A K :=
    localizationAwaySpecFunctionField_isFractionRing f hf
  have hSKL (z : S) :
      (@algebraMap S L _ _ coverSL) z =
        algebraMap K L (algebraMap S K z) :=
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S K L z
  have hAKL (x : A) :
      algebraMap A L x = algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K x) :=
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L x
  let canonicalSL : Algebra S L :=
    localizationAwayToExtensionAlgebra (A := A) (K := K) (L := L) f hf
  have hAlgebra : coverSL = canonicalSL := by
    have hmaps :
        (@algebraMap S L _ _ coverSL) =
          (@algebraMap S L _ _ canonicalSL) := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers f)
      apply DFunLike.ext _ _
      intro x
      calc
        (@algebraMap S L _ _ coverSL) (algebraMap A S x) =
            algebraMap K L (algebraMap S K (algebraMap A S x)) :=
          hSKL (algebraMap A S x)
        _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K x) := by
          rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S K]
        _ = algebraMap A L x :=
          (hAKL x).symm
        _ = (@algebraMap S L _ _ canonicalSL) (algebraMap A S x) := by
          change algebraMap A L x =
            (IsLocalization.Away.lift f _) (algebraMap A S x)
          rw [IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
    apply Algebra.algebra_ext
    intro z
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps z
  have hCover :=
    integralClosure_functionField_etale_of_finiteEtale_spec (.of S) Y
  have hCanonical :
      @Algebra.Etale S (@integralClosure S L _ _ canonicalSL) _ _
        (@integralClosure S L _ _ canonicalSL).algebra := by
    exact hAlgebra ▸ hCover
  let : Algebra S L := canonicalSL
  let : IsScalarTower A S L :=
    localizationAwayToExtension_isScalarTower (K := K) f hf
  exact localization_integralClosure_away_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
    (A := A) (K := K) (L := L) f hf hCanonical

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.galoisPullback_stability
statement:
theorem galoisPullback_stability
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (hD : D.SatisfiesResidueCharacteristicTwoBoundaryCondition p)
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y) :
    let D' : EffectiveCartierDivisor Y.left
proof:
:= D.comapFiniteEtale Y
    D'.IsReduced ∧
      D'.IsHorizontalOver (Y.hom ≫ p) ∧
        D'.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport ∧
          ∀ (Z : Set D'.1.subscheme)
            (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents D'.1.subscheme),
            GeometricallyIntegral
                ((D'.1.componentToBase (Y.hom ≫ p) Z hZ).fiberToSpecResidueField
                  (genericPoint S)) ∧
              ∃ y : D'.1.subscheme,
                y ∈ Z ∧
                  ringChar (Y.left.residueField (D'.1.subschemeι y)) = 2 ∧
                    D'.IsNormalCrossingsAt (D'.1.subschemeι y) := by
  let hfiniteEtale : IsFiniteEtale Y.hom := Y.prop
  let D' : EffectiveCartierDivisor Y.left := D.comapFiniteEtale Y
  have hreduced : D'.IsReduced := by
    change (D.1.comap Y.hom).IsReduced
    exact @IdealSheafData.IsReduced.comap_of_etale X Y.left D.1 hD.1 Y.hom
      hfiniteEtale.toEtale (inferInstance : IsLocallyNoetherian X)
  have hhorizontal : D'.IsHorizontalOver (Y.hom ≫ p) := by
    change ∀ (Z : Set (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme)
      (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme),
      DenseRange ((D.1.comap Y.hom).componentToBase (Y.hom ≫ p) Z hZ)
    exact @comap_components_denseRange_of_isHorizontalOver X Y.left S
      D p Y.hom hfiniteEtale hD.2.1
  obtain ⟨hregular, hcomponents⟩ :=
    D.galoisPullback_regularAlong_and_componentConclusions p hD Y hY
  refine ⟨hreduced, hhorizontal, hregular, ?_⟩
  intro Z hZ
  exact hcomponents Z hZ

statement:
theorem
    galoisPullback_component_exists_residueCharacteristicBranch_of_normalCrossingPoints
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (q : ℕ)
    (hD : D.HasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent q)
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y)
    (Z : Set (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme) :
    letI : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocallyNoetherian_left_finiteEtale Y
    let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
    ∃ (z : I.subscheme) (hz : z ∈ Z),
      let x₀ : Y.left := I.subschemeι z
      let branch := (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal
      Y.left.IsRegularAt x₀ ∧
        ringChar (Y.left.residueField x₀) = q ∧
          I.IsNormalCrossingsAt x₀ ∧
            branch.height = 1 ∧ I.stalkIdeal x₀ ≤ branch ∧
              branch ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.left.presheaf.stalk x₀) := by
  let : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocallyNoetherian_left_finiteEtale Y
  let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
  let D' : EffectiveCartierDivisor Y.left := D.comapFiniteEtale Y
  let hfiniteEtale : IsFiniteEtale Y.hom := Y.prop
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzChar, hzNC⟩ :=
    D.exists_normalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristic_on_comapComponent
      Y.hom q hD Z hZ
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_, hzChar, hzNC, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact IdealSheafData.IsNormalCrossingsAt.isRegularAt
      (X := Y.left) hzNC (I.range_subschemeι.le ⟨z, rfl⟩)
  · exact D'.2.componentBranchPrimeAt_height_eq_one Z hZ z hz
  · exact I.stalkIdeal_le_componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz
  · exact IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal
      (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).isPrime.ne_top

statement:
theorem galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_chart
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (hD : D.SatisfiesResidueCharacteristicTwoBoundaryCondition p)

    (Z : Set (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme) :
    let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData
proof:
:= D.1.comap Y.hom
    let C := I.subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ
    let x := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
    Y.left.IsRegularAt x ∧
      Order.coheight x = 1 ∧
        I.componentToBase (Y.hom ≫ p) Z hZ (genericPoint C) = genericPoint S ∧
          GeometricallyIntegral
            ((I.componentToBase (Y.hom ≫ p) Z hZ).fiberToSpecResidueField
              (genericPoint S)) ∧
            ∃ (U : Y.left.affineOpens) (_hx : x ∈ U.1) (f : Γ(Y.left, U.1)),
              IsRegular f ∧ I.ideal U = Ideal.span {f} := by
  let : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocallyNoetherian_left_finiteEtale Y
  let D' : EffectiveCartierDivisor Y.left := D.comapFiniteEtale Y
  have hstable := D.galoisPullback_stability p hD Y hY
  dsimp only at hstable
  let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
  let C := I.subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ
  let x := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  change Y.left.IsRegularAt x ∧
    Order.coheight x = 1 ∧
      I.componentToBase (Y.hom ≫ p) Z hZ (genericPoint C) = genericPoint S ∧
        GeometricallyIntegral
          ((I.componentToBase (Y.hom ≫ p) Z hZ).fiberToSpecResidueField
            (genericPoint S)) ∧
          ∃ (U : Y.left.affineOpens) (_hx : x ∈ U.1) (f : Γ(Y.left, U.1)),
            IsRegular f ∧ I.ideal U = Ideal.span {f}
  rcases hstable with ⟨_reduced, hhorizontal, hregular, hcomponents⟩
  refine ⟨hregular.isRegularAt_componentGenericPoint Z hZ,
    D'.2.coheight_componentGenericPoint_eq_one Z hZ, ?_,
      (hcomponents Z hZ).1, ?_⟩
  · exact I.componentToBase_genericPoint (Y.hom ≫ p) Z hZ
      (hhorizontal Z hZ)
  · exact D'.2.exists_affineChart_at_componentGenericPoint Z hZ

statement:
theorem componentGenericPoint_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra

    (Z : Set I.subscheme) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme)
    (hdominant : DenseRange (I.componentToBase p Z hZ))
    (hgeo : GeometricallyIntegral
      ((I.componentToBase p Z hZ).fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))) :
    ∃ hAlg : Algebra (S.residueField (genericPoint S))
        (X.residueField (I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ)),
      letI : Algebra (S.residueField (genericPoint S))
          (X.residueField (I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ))
proof:
:= hAlg
      GeometricallyIntegral
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (S.residueField (genericPoint S))
            (X.residueField (I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ))))) := by
  let C := I.subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ

    I.subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ ≫ I.subschemeι
  let f : C ⟶ S := I.componentToBase p Z hZ

    I.componentToBase_genericPoint p Z hZ hdominant

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.componentBranchPrime_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
statement:
theorem componentBranchPrime_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (Z : Set I.subscheme) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme)
    (hdominant : DenseRange (I.componentToBase p Z hZ))
    (hgeo : GeometricallyIntegral
      ((I.componentToBase p Z hZ).fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)))
    (z : I.subscheme) (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    letI : (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal.IsPrime
proof:
:=
      (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).isPrime
    ∃ hAlg : Algebra (S.residueField (genericPoint S))
        (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal.ResidueField,
      letI : Algebra (S.residueField (genericPoint S))
          (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal.ResidueField := hAlg
      GeometricallyIntegral
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (S.residueField (genericPoint S))
            (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal.ResidueField))) := by
  let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
  let x := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  let b := I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz
  let : b.asIdeal.IsPrime := b.isPrime
  obtain ⟨hAlg, hfield⟩ :=
    I.componentGenericPoint_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
      p Z hZ hdominant hgeo
  let : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := hAlg
  have hb : X.fromSpecStalk (I.subschemeι z) b = x :=
    I.fromSpecStalk_componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz
  let e : X.residueField x ≃+* b.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    (X.residueFieldCongr hb.symm).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.trans
      (X.residueFieldFromSpecStalkEquiv (I.subschemeι z) b)
  let hBranchAlg : Algebra k b.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    (e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k (X.residueField x))).toAlgebra
  refine ⟨hBranchAlg, ?_⟩
  exact GeometricallyIntegral.specMap_transport_ringEquiv e hfield

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.IsHorizontalOver.hasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt
statement:
theorem IsHorizontalOver.hasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (hD : D.IsHorizontalOver p)
    [CharZero (S.residueField (genericPoint S))]
    (x : X) : D.1.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt x
proof:
:= by
  let I : X.IdealSheafData := D.1
  dsimp only [Scheme.IdealSheafData.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt]
  intro q hqPrime hqHeight hIq
  let : q.IsPrime := hqPrime
  let qSpec : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) := ⟨q, hqPrime⟩
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hgeneric⟩ :=
    D.2.exists_componentGenericPoint_eq_fromSpecStalk
      x qSpec hqHeight hIq
  let eta := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  have hetaBase : p eta = genericPoint S := by
    have h := I.componentToBase_genericPoint p Z hZ (hD Z hZ)
    exact h
  let eBase : S.residueField (genericPoint S) ≃+*
      S.residueField (p eta) :=
    (S.residueFieldCongr hetaBase.symm).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let phi : S.residueField (genericPoint S) →+* X.residueField eta :=
    (p.residueFieldMap eta).hom.comp eBase.toRingHom
  let : CharZero (X.residueField eta) :=
    charZero_of_injective_ringHom phi.injective
  let ePoint : X.residueField eta ≃+*
      X.residueField (X.fromSpecStalk x qSpec) :=
    (X.residueFieldCongr hgeneric).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let e : X.residueField eta ≃+* q.ResidueField :=
    ePoint.trans (X.residueFieldFromSpecStalkEquiv x qSpec)
  let : CharZero q.ResidueField := e.symm.toRingHom.charZero
  exact (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q) q.ResidueField).charZero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.galoisPullback_hasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem galoisPullback_hasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt_of_ratEquiv
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (hD : D.SatisfiesResidueCharacteristicTwoBoundaryCondition p)
    (ek : S.residueField (genericPoint S) ≃+* ℚ)
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y)
    (x : Y.left) :
    letI : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocallyNoetherian_left_finiteEtale Y
    let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
    I.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt x := by
  let : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocallyNoetherian_left_finiteEtale Y
  let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
  let D' : EffectiveCartierDivisor Y.left := D.comapFiniteEtale Y
  dsimp only [Scheme.IdealSheafData.HasCharacteristicZeroBranchesAt]
  intro q hqPrime hqHeight hIq
  let : q.IsPrime := hqPrime
  let qSpec : Spec (Y.left.presheaf.stalk x) := ⟨q, hqPrime⟩
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hgeneric⟩ :=
    D'.2.exists_componentGenericPoint_eq_fromSpecStalk
      x qSpec hqHeight hIq
  let eta := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
  obtain ⟨hAlg, _hgeo⟩ :=
    D.galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
      p hD Y hY Z hZ
  let : Algebra k (Y.left.residueField eta) := hAlg
  let : CharZero k := ek.toRingHom.charZero
  let : CharZero (Y.left.residueField eta) :=
    Algebra.charZero_of_charZero k _
  let ePoint : Y.left.residueField eta ≃+*
      Y.left.residueField (Y.left.fromSpecStalk x qSpec) :=
    (Y.left.residueFieldCongr hgeneric).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let e : Y.left.residueField eta ≃+* q.ResidueField :=
    ePoint.trans (Y.left.residueFieldFromSpecStalkEquiv x qSpec)
  let : CharZero q.ResidueField := e.symm.toRingHom.charZero
  exact (algebraMap
    (Y.left.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q) q.ResidueField).charZero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.galoisPullback_componentBranchPrime_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
statement:
theorem
    galoisPullback_componentBranchPrime_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (hD : D.SatisfiesResidueCharacteristicTwoBoundaryCondition p)
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y)
    (Z : Set (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme)
    (z : (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme) (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    letI : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
    let q := (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal
    letI : q.IsPrime := (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).isPrime
    let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
    ∃ hAlg : Algebra k q.ResidueField,
      letI : Algebra k q.ResidueField := hAlg
      GeometricallyIntegral
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap k q.ResidueField))) := by
  let : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
  let x := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  let x₀ : Y.left := I.subschemeι z
  let b := I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz
  let q := b.asIdeal
  let : q.IsPrime := b.isPrime
  let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
  obtain ⟨hAlg, hgeo⟩ :=
    D.galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
      p hD Y hY Z hZ
  let : Algebra k (Y.left.residueField x) := hAlg
  have hb : Y.left.fromSpecStalk x₀ b = x := by
    exact I.fromSpecStalk_componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz
  let e₀ : Y.left.residueField x ≃+*
      Y.left.residueField (Y.left.fromSpecStalk x₀ b) :=
    (Y.left.residueFieldCongr hb.symm).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let e : Y.left.residueField x ≃+* q.ResidueField :=
    e₀.trans (Y.left.residueFieldFromSpecStalkEquiv x₀ b)
  let hAlgQ : Algebra k q.ResidueField :=
    (e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k (Y.left.residueField x))).toAlgebra
  refine ⟨hAlgQ, ?_⟩
  exact geometricallyIntegral_specMap_transport_ringEquiv' e hgeo

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.galoisPullback_componentLocalizedBranchPrime_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
statement:
theorem
    galoisPullback_componentLocalizedBranchPrime_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (hD : D.SatisfiesResidueCharacteristicTwoBoundaryCondition p)
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y)
    (Z : Set (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme)
    (z : (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme) (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    letI : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y
proof:
:= hY
    letI : IsIntegral Y.left :=
      EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
    let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
    let A : Type u := Y.left.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι z)
    let q : Ideal A := (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal
    letI : q.IsPrime := (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).isPrime
    ∀ (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hqP : q ≤ P),
      let qV := q.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P))
      letI : qV.IsPrime :=
        Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hqP
      let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
      ∃ hAlg : Algebra k qV.ResidueField,
        letI : Algebra k qV.ResidueField := hAlg
        GeometricallyIntegral
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap k qV.ResidueField))) := by
  let : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
  let A : Type u := Y.left.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι z)
  let q : Ideal A := (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal
  let : q.IsPrime := (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).isPrime
  dsimp only
  intro P hP hqP
  let : P.IsPrime := hP
  let qV := q.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P))
  let : qV.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hqP
  let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
  obtain ⟨hAlg, hgeo⟩ :=
    D.galoisPullback_componentBranchPrime_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
      p hD Y hY Z hZ z hz
  let : Algebra k q.ResidueField := hAlg
  let e : q.ResidueField ≃+* qV.ResidueField :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrimeMapResidueFieldRingEquiv
      A P q hqP
  let hAlgV : Algebra k qV.ResidueField :=
    (e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k q.ResidueField)).toAlgebra
  refine ⟨hAlgV, ?_⟩
  exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.geometricallyIntegral_localizationAtPrimeMapResidueField
    P q hqP hgeo

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
statement:
theorem
    galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (hD : D.SatisfiesResidueCharacteristicTwoBoundaryCondition p)
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y)
    (Z : Set (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme) :
    let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData
proof:
:= D.1.comap Y.hom
    let x := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
    let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
    ∃ hAlg : Algebra k (Y.left.residueField x),
      letI : Algebra k (Y.left.residueField x) := hAlg
      GeometricallyIntegral
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap k (Y.left.residueField x)))) := by
  let : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
  let C := I.subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ
  let x := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  let f : C ⟶ S := I.componentToBase (Y.hom ≫ p) Z hZ
  let i : C ⟶ Y.left :=
    I.subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ ≫ I.subschemeι
  have hchart :=
    D.galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_chart p hD Y hY Z hZ
  dsimp only at hchart
  rcases hchart with ⟨_hregular, _hheight, hη, hgeo, _hchart⟩
  change ∃ hAlg : Algebra (S.residueField (genericPoint S))
      (Y.left.residueField x),
    letI : Algebra (S.residueField (genericPoint S))
      (Y.left.residueField x) := hAlg
    GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (S.residueField (genericPoint S))
          (Y.left.residueField x))))
  have hex :=
    i.exists_algebra_geometricallyIntegral_genericSourceResidue_of_genericFiber
      f hη hgeo
  have hix : i (genericPoint C) = x := by
    rfl
  rw [← hix]
  exact hex

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_localResidueData
statement:
theorem galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_localResidueData
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral S]
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (hD : D.SatisfiesResidueCharacteristicTwoBoundaryCondition p)
    (Y : FiniteEtale X) (hY : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y)
    (Z : Set (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap Y.hom).subscheme) :
    let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData
proof:
:= D.1.comap Y.hom
    let x := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
    let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
    Y.left.IsRegularAt x ∧
      Order.coheight x = 1 ∧
        ∃ hAlg : Algebra k (Y.left.residueField x),
          letI : Algebra k (Y.left.residueField x) := hAlg
          GeometricallyIntegral
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (algebraMap k (Y.left.residueField x)))) := by
  let : CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.IsGalois Y := hY
  let : IsIntegral Y.left :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Y
  let I : Y.left.IdealSheafData := D.1.comap Y.hom
  let x := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  let k := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
  have hchart :=
    D.galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_chart p hD Y hY Z hZ
  dsimp only at hchart
  have hres :=
    D.galoisPullback_componentGenericPoint_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
      p hD Y hY Z hZ
  dsimp only at hres
  exact ⟨hchart.1, hchart.2.1, hres⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.quotient_artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_eq_zero
statement:
theorem quotient_artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_eq_zero
    (m : Ideal G) [m.IsMaximal] (M : MaximalSpectrum G)
    (hM : M ≠ (⟨m, inferInstance⟩ : MaximalSpectrum G)) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk M.asIdeal
        (artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M₀ : MaximalSpectrum G := ⟨m, inferInstance⟩
  let v : ∀ I : MaximalSpectrum G, G ⧸ I.asIdeal := Pi.single M₀ 1
  have hev : IsArtinianRing.equivPi G
      (artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m) = v := by
    change IsArtinianRing.equivPi G
      ((IsArtinianRing.equivPi G).symm v) = v
    exact (IsArtinianRing.equivPi G).apply_symm_apply v
  calc
    _ = IsArtinianRing.equivPi G
        (artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m) M :=
      (IsArtinianRing.equivPi_apply _ _ _).symm
    _ = v M := congrFun hev M
    _ = _ := by simp [v, M₀, hM]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.quotient_artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotient_artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent
    (m : Ideal G) [m.IsMaximal] :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk m (artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M₀ : MaximalSpectrum G := ⟨m, inferInstance⟩
  let v : ∀ I : MaximalSpectrum G, G ⧸ I.asIdeal := Pi.single M₀ 1
  have hev : IsArtinianRing.equivPi G
      (artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m) = v := by
    change IsArtinianRing.equivPi G
      ((IsArtinianRing.equivPi G).symm v) = v
    exact (IsArtinianRing.equivPi G).apply_symm_apply v
  calc
    _ = IsArtinianRing.equivPi G
        (artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m)
          (⟨m, inferInstance⟩ : MaximalSpectrum G) :=
      (IsArtinianRing.equivPi_apply _ _ _).symm
    _ = v M₀ := congrFun hev M₀
    _ = _ := by simp [v, M₀]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_isIdempotentElem
    (m : Ideal G) [m.IsMaximal] :
    IsIdempotentElem (artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (IsArtinianRing.equivPi G).injective
  ext M
  simp only [map_mul, IsArtinianRing.equivPi_apply]
  by_cases hM : M = (⟨m, inferInstance⟩ : MaximalSpectrum G)
  · subst M
    rw [quotient_artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent, one_mul]
  · rw [quotient_artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_eq_zero m M hM, zero_mul]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_mul_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_mul_eq_zero_iff
    (m : Ideal G) [m.IsMaximal] (x : G) :
    artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m * x = 0 ↔
      Ideal.Quotient.mk m x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hmap := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk m) h
    simpa using hmap
  · intro hx
    apply (IsArtinianRing.equivPi G).injective
    ext M
    simp only [map_mul, map_zero, IsArtinianRing.equivPi_apply]
    by_cases hM : M = (⟨m, inferInstance⟩ : MaximalSpectrum G)
    · subst M
      simpa using hx
    · rw [quotient_artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_eq_zero m M hM, zero_mul]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_integral_artinianElement_supported_at_component
statement:
theorem exists_integral_artinianElement_supported_at_component
    {R : Type uR} [CommRing R] [Algebra R G]
    (m : Ideal G) [m.IsMaximal]
    (x : G ⧸ m) (hx : IsIntegral R x) :
    ∃ y : G, IsIntegral R y ∧ Ideal.Quotient.mk m y = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  let e : G := artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m
  let y : G := e * z
  have hym : Ideal.Quotient.mk m y = x := by
    simp [y, e, hz]
  obtain ⟨p, hpMonic, hpx⟩ := hx
  have hyIntegral : IsIntegral R y := by
    let q : R[X] := X * p
    refine ⟨q, monic_X.mul hpMonic, ?_⟩
    apply (IsArtinianRing.equivPi G).injective
    ext M
    simp only [map_zero, IsArtinianRing.equivPi_apply]
    have hmap_aeval (w : G) (f : R[X]) :
        Ideal.Quotient.mk M.asIdeal (aeval w f) =
          aeval (Ideal.Quotient.mk M.asIdeal w) f := by
      simpa using
        (map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
          (R := R) (S := G) (T := R) (U := G ⧸ M.asIdeal)
          (φ := RingHom.id R)
          (ψ := Ideal.Quotient.mk M.asIdeal)
          (by ext r; rfl) f w)
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk M.asIdeal (aeval y q) = 0
    rw [hmap_aeval]
    by_cases hM : M = (⟨m, inferInstance⟩ : MaximalSpectrum G)
    · subst M
      rw [hym]
      change aeval x q = 0
      rw [show q = X * p by rfl, map_mul, aeval_X]
      change x * aeval x p = 0
      change aeval x p = 0 at hpx
      rw [hpx, mul_zero]
    · rw [show Ideal.Quotient.mk M.asIdeal y = 0 by
        simp [y, e,
          quotient_artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_eq_zero m M hM]]
      simp [q]
  exact ⟨y, hyIntegral, hym⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericFiberComponentToIntegralClosure_core
statement:
private theorem genericFiberComponentToIntegralClosure_core
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Module.Finite R T] [Algebra.Etale R T]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (m : Ideal (T ⊗[R] K)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    Function.Surjective (genericFiberComponentToIntegralClosure m) ∧
      Algebra.Etale R
        (integralClosure R (FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent m))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G := T ⊗[R] K
  let Ω := FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent m
  let : Algebra K G := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R K G := Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let commK : (K ⊗[R] T) ≃ₐ[K] G :=
    { toRingEquiv := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R K T).toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro k
        exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply k).symm }
  let : Algebra.Etale K G := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv commK
  let : Module.Finite K G :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective commK.toLinearMap commK.surjective
  let : IsArtinianRing G := isArtinian_of_tower K inferInstance
  let : IsReduced G :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field K G
  let : Field Ω := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R T := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite R T
  let D := integralClosure R Ω
  let gD : T →ₐ[R] D := genericFiberComponentToIntegralClosure m
  have hgD_surjective : Function.Surjective gD := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hyR, hym⟩ :=
      exists_integral_artinianElement_supported_at_component
        (R := R) m x.1 x.2
    have hyT : IsIntegral T y := hyR.tower_top
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
      exists_eq_includeLeft_of_isIntegral_genericFiber_of_smooth
        (R := R) (S := T) (K := K) y hyT
    refine ⟨t, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk m
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
        (R := R) (S := R) (A := T) (B := K) t) = x.1
    rw [ht, hym]
  let eG : G := artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent m
  have heG : IsIdempotentElem eG :=
    artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_isIdempotentElem m
  have heG_integral : IsIntegral T eG := by
    refine ⟨X * (X - C 1), monic_X.mul (monic_X_sub_C 1), ?_⟩
    change aeval eG (X * (X - C 1)) = 0
    rw [map_mul, aeval_X, map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, map_one]
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, heG.eq, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨eT, heT_image⟩ :=
    exists_eq_includeLeft_of_isIntegral_genericFiber_of_smooth
      (R := R) (S := T) (K := K) eG heG_integral
  have hincludeLeft_injective : Function.Injective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : T →ₐ[R] G) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_injective
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R K)
  have heT : IsIdempotentElem eT := by
    apply hincludeLeft_injective
    simpa only [map_mul, heT_image] using heG.eq
  let : Algebra T D := gD.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R T D :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' <| by
      ext r
      rfl
  have hgD_mul_iff (x y : T) :
      gD x = gD y ↔ eT * x = eT * y := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, Subtype.ext_iff]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk m
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : T →ₐ[R] G) (x - y)) = 0 ↔ _
    rw [← artinianSelectedComponentIdempotent_mul_eq_zero_iff m]
    change eG *
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : T →ₐ[R] G) (x - y)) = 0 ↔ _
    rw [← heT_image, ← map_mul]
    rw [show (0 : G) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : T →ₐ[R] G) 0 from
        (map_zero (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : T →ₐ[R] G)).symm]
    rw [hincludeLeft_injective.eq_iff]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  let : IsLocalization.Away eT D :=
    IsLocalization.away_of_isIdempotentElem_of_mul
      heT hgD_mul_iff hgD_surjective
  let : Algebra.Etale T D := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway eT
  exact ⟨hgD_surjective, Algebra.Etale.comp R T D⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.specMap_int_field_eq_genericPoint
statement:
theorem specMap_int_field_eq_genericPoint
    (K : Type) [Field K] [CharZero K] (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ K))) x =
      genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x = (⊥ : PrimeSpectrum K) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap ℤ K) x = _
  rw [hx, genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine]
  apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
  exact Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective (algebraMap ℤ K) Int.cast_injective

    GeometricallyIntegral
      (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ K))))
proof:
:= by
  let g : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ) :=

  apply (GeometricallyIntegral.iff_geometricallyIntegral_fiber (pullback.snd f g)).mpr

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.charZero_functionField_of_dominant_integers

theorem charZero_functionField_of_dominant_integers
    {X : Scheme.{0}} [IsIntegral X]

    CharZero X.functionField
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFractionRing ℤ (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).functionField := by
    convert! functionField_isFractionRing_of_affine (CommRingCat.of ℤ) using 1
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  let z : ℤ →+* X.functionField := (p.functionFieldMap p.denseRange).comp
    (algebraMap ℤ (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).functionField)

    ((p.functionFieldMap_injective p.denseRange).comp
      (IsFractionRing.injective ℤ (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).functionField))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.smooth_int_sections
statement:
private theorem smooth_int_sections
    {X : Scheme.{0}} (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)) [Smooth p]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : Algebra.Smooth ℤ Γ(X, U)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ Γ(X, U))) =
      hU.fromSpec ≫ p := specZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _
  have hsm : Smooth (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ Γ(X, U)))) := by
    rw [heq]
    infer_instance

    ((HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Smooth)).mp hsm)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_smooth_finite_scheme_cover
statement:
theorem numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_smooth_finite_scheme_cover
    {X Y : Scheme.{0}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Flat f] [Surjective f]
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)) [QuasiCompact p] [Surjective p]
    [Smooth (f ≫ p)] [CharZero Y.functionField] [CharZero X.functionField]
    (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [IsDomain (Y.functionField ⊗[ℚ] K)] (g : K →ₐ[ℚ] X.functionField) :
    Module.finrank ℚ K = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : CompactSpace Y := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace p
  choose U hU hxU htop using fun y : Y ↦
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := Y) (U := ⊤) (x := y) trivial
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun y : Y ↦ (U y : Set Y)) (fun y ↦ (U y).isOpen)
    (fun y _ ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨y, hxU y⟩)
  let B (i : s) : Type := Γ(Y, U i.1)
  let A (i : s) : Type := Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U i.1)
  have (i : s) : Nonempty (U i.1) := ⟨i.1, hxU i.1⟩
  have (i : s) : Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ U i.1) := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := f.surjective i.1
    exact ⟨x, show f x ∈ U i.1 by rw [hx]; exact hxU i.1⟩
  have (i : s) : IsDomain (B i) := inferInstance
  have (i : s) : IsDomain (A i) := inferInstance
  have (i : s) : IsIntegrallyClosed (A i) :=
    IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed (f ⁻¹ᵁ U i.1) ((hU i.1).preimage f)
  let (i : s) : Algebra (B i) (A i) := (f.app (U i.1)).hom.toAlgebra
  have (i : s) : Module.Finite (B i) (A i) := f.finite_app (U i.1) (hU i.1)
  have (i : s) : Module.Flat (B i) (A i) := by
    have hf := f.flat_appLE (hU i.1) ((hU i.1).preimage f) le_rfl
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] at hf
    exact hf
  have (i : s) : FaithfulSMul (B i) (A i) := inferInstance
  have (i : s) : Algebra.Smooth ℤ (A i) :=
    smooth_int_sections (f ≫ p) _ ((hU i.1).preimage f)
  have (i : s) : IsFractionRing (B i) Y.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen Y (U i.1) (hU i.1)
  have (i : s) : IsFractionRing (A i) X.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X (f ⁻¹ᵁ U i.1)
      ((hU i.1).preimage f)
  apply numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_smooth_finite_arithmetic_cover
    B A Y.functionField K X.functionField g
  intro q
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := p.surjective q
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hiy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hs (Set.mem_univ y))
  let j : s := ⟨i, hi⟩
  let r : PrimeSpectrum (B j) := (hU i).primeIdealOf ⟨y, hiy⟩
  refine ⟨j, r, ?_⟩
  have heq : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ (B j))) =
      (hU i).fromSpec ≫ p := specZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _
  change (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ (B j)))) r = q
  rw [heq]
  change p ((hU i).fromSpec ((hU i).primeIdealOf ⟨y, hiy⟩)) = q
  rw [(hU i).fromSpec_primeIdealOf]
  exact hy

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isField_tensor_algebraicClosure_of_smooth_finite_scheme_cover
statement:
theorem isField_tensor_algebraicClosure_of_smooth_finite_scheme_cover
    {X Y : Scheme.{0}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [IsNormalIntegral X]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Flat f] [Surjective f]
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)) [QuasiCompact p] [Surjective p]
    [Smooth (f ≫ p)] [CharZero Y.functionField] [CharZero X.functionField]
    [GeometricallyIntegral
      (p.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))))] :
    IsField (X.functionField ⊗[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Algebra.TensorProduct.isField_of_isSeparable_of_forall_isSeparable_mem_range
    ℚ X.functionField (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
  intro y hy
  let K : IntermediateField ℚ X.functionField := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {y}
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ K := IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional hy.isIntegral
  have : NumberField K := {}
  have : IsDomain (Y.functionField ⊗[ℚ] K) :=
    isDomain_functionField_ratTensor_of_arithmetic_genericFiber p K
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℚ K = 1 :=
    numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_smooth_finite_scheme_cover f p K K.val
  exact IntermediateField.mem_bot.mp
    (IntermediateField.finrank_adjoin_simple_eq_one_iff.mp hdim)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.algebraMap_ringOfIntegersToNormalDomain
statement:
theorem algebraMap_ringOfIntegersToNormalDomain
    (A K L : Type) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [Field K] [NumberField K] [Field L] [CharZero L]
    [Algebra A L] [IsFractionRing A L] (g : K →ₐ[ℚ] L) (z : 𝓞 K) :
    algebraMap A L (ringOfIntegersToNormalDomain A K L g z) = g (z : K)
proof:
:= by
  let a : A →ₐ[ℤ] L := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℤ A L
  let k : 𝓞 K →ₐ[ℤ] L :=
    (g.restrictScalars ℤ).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℤ (𝓞 K) K)
  let e : A ≃ₐ[ℤ] a.range :=
    AlgEquiv.ofInjective a (IsFractionRing.injective A L)
  change ((e (ringOfIntegersToNormalDomain A K L g z) : a.range) : L) = k z
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply _)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.arithmeticConstantsTensor_lift_injective
statement:
theorem arithmeticConstantsTensor_lift_injective
    {B F K L : Type} [CommRing B] [Field F] [CharZero F]
    [Field K] [NumberField K] [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (i : B →ₐ[ℤ] F) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (f : F →ₐ[ℚ] L) (g : K →ₐ[ℚ] L)
    [IsDomain (F ⊗[ℚ] K)] :
    Function.Injective (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift
      ((f.restrictScalars ℤ).comp i)
      ((g.restrictScalars ℤ).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℤ (𝓞 K) K))
      (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _))
proof:
:= by
  let j : 𝓞 K →ₐ[ℤ] K := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℤ (𝓞 K) K
  let m : B ⊗[ℤ] (𝓞 K) →ₐ[ℤ] F ⊗[ℤ] K :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map i j
  have hm : Function.Injective m := by
    exact TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat i.toLinearMap j.toLinearMap
      hi (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (𝓞 K) K)
  let e : F ⊗[ℚ] K ≃ₐ[ℚ] F ⊗[ℤ] K :=
    IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors ℤ) ℚ F K
  let h : F ⊗[ℚ] K →ₐ[ℚ] L :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f g (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)
  have hfield : IsField (F ⊗[ℚ] K) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.isField_of_isAlgebraic ℚ F K (.inr inferInstance)
  let : Field (F ⊗[ℚ] K) := hfield.toField
  have hh : Function.Injective h := h.injective
  have heq : (h.restrictScalars ℤ).comp ((e.symm.restrictScalars ℤ).toAlgHom.comp m) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ((f.restrictScalars ℤ).comp i)
        ((g.restrictScalars ℤ).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℤ (𝓞 K) K))
        (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _) := by
    ext b <;> rfl
  rw [← heq]
  exact hh.comp (e.symm.injective.comp hm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.denseRange_genericFiberι_of_isOpenMap
statement:
theorem denseRange_genericFiberι_of_isOpenMap
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) (hf : IsOpenMap f) :
    DenseRange (f.fiberι (genericPoint S))
proof:
:= by
  change Dense (Set.range (f.fiberι (genericPoint S)))
  rw [f.range_fiberι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.connectedSpace_of_geometricallyConnected_genericFiber
statement:
theorem connectedSpace_of_geometricallyConnected_genericFiber
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyOpen f]
    [GeometricallyConnected (f.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))] :
    ConnectedSpace X
proof:
:= by
  let : ConnectedSpace (f.fiber (genericPoint S)) :=
    GeometricallyConnected.connectedSpace_of_subsingleton
      (f.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))
  let : PreconnectedSpace X :=
    (denseRange_genericFiberι_of_isOpenMap f f.isOpenMap).preconnectedSpace
