  exact ⟨(inferInstance : Nonempty (f.fiber (genericPoint S))).map
    (f.fiberι (genericPoint S))⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.geometricallyIntegral_genericFiber_of_connected_finiteEtale_over_smooth_integers
statement:
theorem geometricallyIntegral_genericFiber_of_connected_finiteEtale_over_smooth_integers
    {E : Scheme} (p : E ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))
    [Smooth p] [QuasiCompact p] [Surjective p]
    [GeometricallyConnected
      (p.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))))]
    (T : FiniteEtale E) [ConnectedSpace T.left] :
    GeometricallyIntegral
      ((T.hom ≫ p).fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ), ⊤) :=
    Function.Injective.isDomain (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).hom.hom
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ), ⊤) :=
    IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian E := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian p
  let : ConnectedSpace E := p.connectedSpace_of_geometricallyConnected_genericFiber
  let : IsIntegral E := isIntegral_of_connected_of_isDomain_stalk E
    (fun x => (Smooth.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk p x).1)
  let f : T.left ⟶ E := T.hom
  let q : T.left ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ) := f ≫ p
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian T.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian q
  let : IsIntegral T.left := isIntegral_of_connected_of_isDomain_stalk T.left
    (fun x => (Smooth.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk q x).1)
  let : IsNormalIntegral T.left := IsNormalIntegral.of_stalks T.left
    (fun x => (Smooth.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk q x).2)
  let : Surjective f := IsFiniteEtale.surjective f
  let : CharZero E.functionField := charZero_functionField_of_dominant_integers p
  let : CharZero T.left.functionField := charZero_functionField_of_dominant_integers q
  let : Smooth (p.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)))) := by
    exact MorphismProperty.of_isPullback
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback p ((Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).fromSpecResidueField
        (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))))) (inferInstance : Smooth p)
  let : GeometricallyIntegral
      (p.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)))) :=
    Smooth.geometricallyIntegral_of_geometricallyConnected _
  exact geometricallyIntegral_arithmeticGenericFiber_of_functionField_tensor_isField q
    (isField_tensor_algebraicClosure_of_smooth_finite_scheme_cover f p)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.unramifiedAt_of_radical_specialFiber
statement:
private theorem unramifiedAt_of_radical_specialFiber
    {R S : Type} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Module.Finite R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsMaximal]
    [PerfectField p.ResidueField] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    (hred : (p.map (algebraMap R S)).IsRadical) :
    Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R q
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q
  apply (Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_map_eq R p q).mpr
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  let : Field (R ⧸ p) := Ideal.Quotient.field p
  have : Module.Finite (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ p.map (algebraMap R S)) :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R (R ⧸ p) _
  have : IsArtinianRing (S ⧸ p.map (algebraMap R S)) :=
    IsArtinianRing.of_finite (R ⧸ p) _
  have hle : p.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ q :=
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr (q.over_def p).le
  have hmin : q ∈ (p.map (algebraMap R S)).minimalPrimes := by
    have : (q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (p.map (algebraMap R S)))).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
        (by rw [Ideal.mk_ker]; exact hle)
    rw [Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_comap]
    exact ⟨q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (p.map (algebraMap R S))),
      IsArtinianRing.mem_minimalPrimes bot_le, Ideal.comap_map_mk hle⟩
  calc
    p.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q)) =
        (p.map (algebraMap R S)).map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime q)) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S (Localization.AtPrime q)]
    _ = (p.map (algebraMap R S)).radical.map
        (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime q)) := by rw [hred.radical]
    _ = ((p.map (algebraMap R S)).map
        (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime q))).radical :=
      IsLocalization.map_radical q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime q) _
    _ = q.map (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime q)) :=
      IsLocalization.AtPrime.radical_map_of_mem_minimalPrimes (Localization.AtPrime q) q
        (p.map (algebraMap R S)) hmin
    _ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ringOfIntegers_unramifiedAt_of_smooth_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegers_unramifiedAt_of_smooth_faithfullyFlat
    (K A : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra (𝓞 K) A] [Module.FaithfullyFlat (𝓞 K) A] [Algebra.Smooth ℤ A]
    (p : Ideal ℤ) [p.IsMaximal]
    (q : Ideal (𝓞 K)) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] :
    Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt ℤ q
proof:
:= by
  let : Field (ℤ ⧸ p) := Ideal.Quotient.field p
  have : IsReduced ((ℤ ⧸ p) ⊗[ℤ] A) :=
    Algebra.Smooth.isReduced_of_field (K := ℤ ⧸ p)
  have hredA : (p.map (algebraMap ℤ A)).IsRadical := by
    apply (Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced _).mpr
    exact isReduced_of_injective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor A p)
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor A p).injective
  have hredK : (p.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K))).IsRadical := by
    rw [← Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat
      (B := A) (p.map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K)))]
    apply Ideal.IsRadical.comap
    rw [Ideal.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
    exact hredA
  exact unramifiedAt_of_radical_specialFiber p q hredK

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_smooth_faithfullyFlat_ringOfIntegers
statement:
theorem numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_smooth_faithfullyFlat_ringOfIntegers
    (K A : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra (𝓞 K) A] [Module.FaithfullyFlat (𝓞 K) A] [Algebra.Smooth ℤ A] :
    Module.finrank ℚ K = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (NumberField.discr K) := by
    by_contra hnunit
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd⟩ := WfDvdMonoid.exists_irreducible_factor
      hnunit (NumberField.discr_ne_zero K)
    apply ((NumberField.not_dvd_discr_iff_forall_liesOver K (𝓞 K)
      (irreducible_iff_prime.mp hp)).mpr ?_) hpd
    intro q hq hqp
    have : q.IsMaximal := hq
    have : q.LiesOver (Ideal.span {p}) := hqp
    have hprime : Prime p := irreducible_iff_prime.mp hp
    have hspan : Ideal.span {p} ≠ (⊥ : Ideal ℤ) :=
      Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr hprime.ne_zero
    have : (Ideal.span {p}).IsPrime :=
      (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hprime.ne_zero).mpr hprime
    have : (Ideal.span {p}).IsMaximal :=
      Ring.HasFiniteQuotients.maximalOfPrime hspan
    exact ringOfIntegers_unramifiedAt_of_smooth_faithfullyFlat K A
      (Ideal.span {p}) q
  have habs : |NumberField.discr K| = 1 := Int.isUnit_iff_abs_eq.mp hunit
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℚ K := Module.finrank_pos
  by_contra hne
  have hgt : 1 < Module.finrank ℚ K := by omega
  have hbound := NumberField.abs_discr_gt_two (K := K) hgt
  omega

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_isDomain_of_connectedSpace_primeSpectrum
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_isDomain_of_connectedSpace_primeSpectrum
    {R : Type uR} {T : Type uT} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Module.Finite R T] [Algebra.Etale R T]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum T)] : IsDomain T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G := T ⊗[R] K
  have hincludeLeft : Function.Injective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : T →ₐ[R] G) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_injective
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R K)
  let : Nontrivial T :=
    PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.mp inferInstance
  let : Nontrivial G := Function.Injective.nontrivial hincludeLeft
  let M : MaximalSpectrum G :=
    Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (MaximalSpectrum G))
  let m : Ideal G := M.asIdeal
  let : m.IsMaximal := M.2
  let D := integralClosure R (FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent m)
  let g : T →ₐ[R] D := genericFiberComponentToIntegralClosure m
  have hg : Function.Surjective g :=
    genericFiberComponentToIntegralClosure_surjective m
  let : Algebra.Etale R D :=
    integralClosure_etale_genericFiberComponent m
  let : Algebra T D := g.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R T D :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' <| by
      ext r
      rfl
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale T D :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_restrictScalars (R := R)
  have hkerIdempotent : IsIdempotentElem (RingHom.ker g.toRingHom) :=
    (Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_of_surjective hg).mp inferInstance
  have hkerFG : (RingHom.ker g.toRingHom).FG :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.ker_fG_of_surjective g hg
  obtain ⟨e, he, hker⟩ :=
    ((RingHom.ker g.toRingHom).isIdempotentElem_iff_of_fg hkerFG).mp
      hkerIdempotent
  have he_zero_or_one : e = 0 ∨ e = 1 := by
    have hopen : IsClopen (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen e) :=
      PrimeSpectrum.isClopen_iff.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    rcases isClopen_iff.mp hopen with hopen | hopen
    · left
      have hbasic : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen e =
          PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (0 : T) := by
        apply SetLike.ext'
        rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_zero]
        simpa only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_bot] using hopen
      exact PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_injOn_isIdempotentElem he
        (show IsIdempotentElem (0 : T) by exact zero_mul 0)
        hbasic
    · right
      have hbasic : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen e =
          PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (1 : T) := by
        apply SetLike.ext'
        rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_one]
        simpa only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top] using hopen
      exact PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_injOn_isIdempotentElem he
        (show IsIdempotentElem (1 : T) by exact one_mul 1)
        hbasic
  have he_ne_one : e ≠ 1 := by
    intro heone
    have htop : RingHom.ker g.toRingHom = ⊤ := by
      rw [hker, heone]
      exact Ideal.span_singleton_one
    have hone : (1 : T) ∈ RingHom.ker g.toRingHom := by rw [htop]; exact Submodule.mem_top
    have hD : (1 : D) = 0 := by
      simpa only [RingHom.mem_ker, map_one] using hone
    exact one_ne_zero hD
  have hezero : e = 0 := he_zero_or_one.resolve_right he_ne_one
  have hkerbot : RingHom.ker g.toRingHom = ⊥ := by
    rw [hker, hezero]
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_zero
  have hginjective : Function.Injective g := by
    rw [RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot]
    exact hkerbot
  exact Function.Injective.isDomain g hginjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_isIntegrallyClosed_of_connectedSpace_primeSpectrum
statement:
theorem finiteEtale_isIntegrallyClosed_of_connectedSpace_primeSpectrum
    {R : Type uR} {T : Type uT} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Module.Finite R T] [Algebra.Etale R T]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum T)] : IsIntegrallyClosed T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G := T ⊗[R] K
  have hincludeLeft : Function.Injective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : T →ₐ[R] G) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_injective
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R K)
  let : Nontrivial T :=
    PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.mp inferInstance
  let : Nontrivial G := Function.Injective.nontrivial hincludeLeft
  let M : MaximalSpectrum G :=
    Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (MaximalSpectrum G))
  let m : Ideal G := M.asIdeal
  let : m.IsMaximal := M.2
  let L := FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent m
  let D := integralClosure R L
  let g : T →ₐ[R] D := genericFiberComponentToIntegralClosure m
  have hg : Function.Surjective g :=
    genericFiberComponentToIntegralClosure_surjective m
  let : Algebra.Etale R D :=
    integralClosure_etale_genericFiberComponent m
  let : Algebra T D := g.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R T D :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' <| by
      ext r
      rfl
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale T D :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_restrictScalars (R := R)
  have hkerIdempotent : IsIdempotentElem (RingHom.ker g.toRingHom) :=
    (Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_of_surjective hg).mp inferInstance
  have hkerFG : (RingHom.ker g.toRingHom).FG :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.ker_fG_of_surjective g hg
  obtain ⟨e, he, hker⟩ :=
    ((RingHom.ker g.toRingHom).isIdempotentElem_iff_of_fg hkerFG).mp
      hkerIdempotent
  have he_zero_or_one : e = 0 ∨ e = 1 := by
    have hopen : IsClopen (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen e) :=
      PrimeSpectrum.isClopen_iff.mpr ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    rcases isClopen_iff.mp hopen with hopen | hopen
    · left
      have hbasic : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen e =
          PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (0 : T) := by
        apply SetLike.ext'
        rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_zero]
        simpa only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_bot] using hopen
      exact PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_injOn_isIdempotentElem he
        (show IsIdempotentElem (0 : T) by exact zero_mul 0)
        hbasic
    · right
      have hbasic : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen e =
          PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (1 : T) := by
        apply SetLike.ext'
        rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_one]
        simpa only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top] using hopen
      exact PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_injOn_isIdempotentElem he
        (show IsIdempotentElem (1 : T) by exact one_mul 1)
        hbasic
  have he_ne_one : e ≠ 1 := by
    intro heone
    have htop : RingHom.ker g.toRingHom = ⊤ := by
      rw [hker, heone]
      exact Ideal.span_singleton_one
    have hone : (1 : T) ∈ RingHom.ker g.toRingHom := by rw [htop]; exact Submodule.mem_top
    have hD : (1 : D) = 0 := by
      simpa only [RingHom.mem_ker, map_one] using hone
    exact one_ne_zero hD
  have hezero : e = 0 := he_zero_or_one.resolve_right he_ne_one
  have hkerbot : RingHom.ker g.toRingHom = ⊥ := by
    rw [hker, hezero]
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_zero
  have hginjective : Function.Injective g := by
    rw [RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot]
    exact hkerbot
  let : Algebra K G := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R K G := Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let commK : (K ⊗[R] T) ≃ₐ[K] G :=
    { toRingEquiv := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R K T).toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro k
        exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply k).symm }
  let : Module.Finite K G :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective commK.toLinearMap commK.surjective
  let : Field L := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  let : Module.Finite K L :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K m).toLinearMap
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed D :=
    integralClosure.isIntegrallyClosedOfFiniteExtension (R := R) (L := L) K
  let eTD : T ≃+* D := RingEquiv.ofBijective g.toRingHom ⟨hginjective, hg⟩
  exact IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv eTD.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDomain_functionField_ratTensor_of_arithmetic_genericFiber
statement:
theorem isDomain_functionField_ratTensor_of_arithmetic_genericFiber
    {X : Scheme} [IsIntegral X] [CharZero X.functionField]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of ℤ))
    [GeometricallyIntegral
      (f.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint (Spec (.of ℤ))))]
    (K : Type) [Field K] [CharZero K] :
    IsDomain (X.functionField ⊗[ℚ] K)
proof:
:= by
  let x : X := genericPoint X
  let U : X.Opens := (X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x)).opensRange
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U :=
    isAffineOpen_opensRange (X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x))
  let : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, X.affineCover.covers x⟩⟩
  let B := Γ(X, U)
  let : IsFractionRing B X.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X U hU
  have : Module.IsTorsionFree ℤ B :=
    Module.IsTorsionFree.of_faithfulSMul B ℤ X.functionField
  have : Module.Flat ℤ B := inferInstance
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap B (B ⊗[ℤ] K)) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_injective (S := ℤ) (A := B)
      (Int.cast_injective (α := K))
  let : Nontrivial (B ⊗[ℤ] K) := hinj.nontrivial
  let i : Spec (.of B) ⟶ X := hU.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.ι
  let g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Spec (.of ℤ) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ K))
  have hi : i ≫ f = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ B)) :=
    specZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _
  let e : pullback (i ≫ f) g ≅ Spec (.of (B ⊗[ℤ] K)) := by
    rw [hi]
    exact pullbackSpecIso ℤ B K
  let j : pullback (i ≫ f) g ⟶ pullback f g :=
    pullback.map (i ≫ f) g f g i (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
      (Category.comp_id _).symm (by rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id])
  let : IsOpenImmersion i := inferInstance
  let : IsOpenImmersion j :=
    MorphismProperty.pullbackMap (P := @IsOpenImmersion)
      (inferInstance : IsOpenImmersion i)
      (inferInstance : IsOpenImmersion (𝟙 (Spec (.of K))))
      rfl (Category.id_comp g).symm
  let : Nonempty ↥(pullback (i ≫ f) g) :=
    ⟨e.inv (Nonempty.some (inferInstance : Nonempty (Spec (.of (B ⊗[ℤ] K)))))⟩
  let : GeometricallyIntegral (pullback.snd f g) :=
    geometricallyIntegral_pullback_of_arithmetic_genericFiber f K
  let : IsIntegral (pullback f g) :=
    GeometricallyIntegral.isIntegral_of_subsingleton (pullback.snd f g)
  let : IsIntegral (pullback (i ≫ f) g) := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j
  let : IsIntegral (Spec (.of (B ⊗[ℤ] K))) := IsIntegral.of_isIso e.hom
  let : IsDomain (B ⊗[ℤ] K) :=
    (affine_isIntegral_iff (.of (B ⊗[ℤ] K))).mp inferInstance
  exact Algebra.TensorProduct.isDomain_ratTensor_of_isFractionRing_intTensor
    (B := B) (F := X.functionField) (K := K)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_smooth_finite_arithmetic_cover
statement:
theorem numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_smooth_finite_arithmetic_cover
    {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (B A : ι → Type)
    [∀ i, CommRing (B i)] [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i, IsDomain (A i)]
    [∀ i, IsIntegrallyClosed (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra (B i) (A i)]
    [∀ i, FaithfulSMul (B i) (A i)] [∀ i, Module.Finite (B i) (A i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra.Smooth ℤ (A i)]
    (F K L : Type) [Field F] [CharZero F] [Field K] [NumberField K]
    [Field L] [CharZero L]
    [∀ i, Algebra (B i) F] [∀ i, IsFractionRing (B i) F]
    [∀ i, Algebra (A i) L] [∀ i, IsFractionRing (A i) L]
    [IsDomain (F ⊗[ℚ] K)] (g : K →ₐ[ℚ] L)
    (hcover : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum ℤ, ∃ (i : ι) (q : PrimeSpectrum (B i)),
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap ℤ (B i)) q = p) :
    Module.finrank ℚ K = 1
proof:
:= by
  let k (i : ι) : 𝓞 K →ₐ[ℤ] A i := ringOfIntegersToNormalDomain (A i) K L g
  let : ∀ i, Algebra (𝓞 K) (A i) := fun i ↦ (k i).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hinj (i : ι) : Function.Injective (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (A i)) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply g.injective
    have h := congrArg (algebraMap (A i) L) hxy
    change algebraMap (A i) L (k i x) = algebraMap (A i) L (k i y) at h
    rw [algebraMap_ringOfIntegersToNormalDomain,
      algebraMap_ringOfIntegersToNormalDomain] at h
    exact h
  have hcoverK : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum (𝓞 K),
      ∃ (i : ι) (q : PrimeSpectrum (A i)),
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (A i)) q = p := by
    intro p
    obtain ⟨i, q, hq⟩ := hcover (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K)) p)
    obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.exists_tensorProduct_of_comap_eq
      ℤ (B i) (𝓞 K) q p hq
    let h : B i ⊗[ℤ] (𝓞 K) →ₐ[B i] A i :=
      arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain (B i) (A i) K L g
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain_comap_surjective
      (B i) (A i) F K L g r
    refine ⟨i, s, ?_⟩
    have hcomp : h.toRingHom.comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := ℤ) (A := B i)).toRingHom =
        (k i).toRingHom := by
      ext z
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, h,
        arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul,
        map_one, one_mul]
      rfl
    calc
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (A i)) s =
          PrimeSpectrum.comap (h.toRingHom.comp
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := ℤ) (A := B i)).toRingHom) s := by
        rw [hcomp]
        rfl
      _ = PrimeSpectrum.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := ℤ) (A := B i)).toRingHom r := by
        rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp_apply, hs]
      _ = p := hr
  have : Module.FaithfullyFlat (𝓞 K) (∀ i, A i) :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.pi_of_dedekind_spectrum_cover (𝓞 K) A hinj hcoverK
  have hs : Algebra.Smooth ℤ (∀ i, A i) := ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  have : letI : Algebra ℤ (∀ i, A i) := Ring.toIntAlgebra _
      Algebra.Smooth ℤ (∀ i, A i) := by
    have hAlg : (inferInstance : Algebra ℤ (∀ i, A i)) = Ring.toIntAlgebra _ :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    exact hAlg ▸ hs
  exact numberField_finrank_eq_one_of_smooth_faithfullyFlat_ringOfIntegers K (∀ i, A i)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField_tmul (x : T) (y : K) :
    finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField (R := R) (T := T) (K := K) (L := L)
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      algebraMap T L x * algebraMap K L y
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField_surjective
statement:
theorem finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField_surjective
    [IsDomain R] [IsDomain T]
    [Module.Finite R T] [Algebra.Etale R T]
    [IsFractionRing R K] [IsFractionRing T L] :
    Function.Surjective
      (finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField
        (R := R) (T := T) (K := K) (L := L))
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, hxy⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective T z
  let G := T ⊗[R] K
  let : Algebra K G := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  have hRT : Function.Injective (algebraMap R T) := by
    intro a b hab
    apply IsFractionRing.injective R K
    apply (algebraMap K L).injective
    calc
      algebraMap K L (algebraMap R K a) = algebraMap R L a :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L a).symm
      _ = algebraMap T L (algebraMap R T a) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R T L a
      _ = algebraMap T L (algebraMap R T b) := congrArg (algebraMap T L) hab
      _ = algebraMap R L b :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R T L b).symm
      _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap R K b) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L b
  let : FaithfulSMul R T :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R T).mpr hRT
  let M : Submonoid T :=
    Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T (nonZeroDivisors R)
  have hM : M ≤ nonZeroDivisors T := by
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero]
    simpa using (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R T).ne
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp hr)
  let : IsDomain G :=
    IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors G hM
  let commK : (K ⊗[R] T) ≃ₐ[K] G :=
    { toRingEquiv := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R K T).toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro k
        exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply k).symm }
  let : Module.Finite K G :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective commK.toLinearMap commK.surjective
  let : IsArtinianRing G := isArtinian_of_tower K inferInstance
  let : Field G := (IsArtinianRing.isField_of_isDomain G).toField
  let iT : T →ₐ[R] T ⊗[R] K := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
  have hiT : Function.Injective iT :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_injective
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R K)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp hy
  have hiTy0 : iT y ≠ 0 := by simpa using hiT.ne hy0
  refine ⟨iT x / iT y, ?_⟩
  rw [map_div₀]
  simpa [iT, finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField] using hxy

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_etale_of_finiteEtale_fractionField
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_finiteEtale_fractionField
    [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [IsDomain T] [Module.Finite R T] [Algebra.Etale R T]
    [IsFractionRing R K] [IsFractionRing T L] :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R L)
proof:
:= by
  let f : (T ⊗[R] K) →ₐ[R] L :=
    finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField
      (R := R) (T := T) (K := K) (L := L)
  have hf : Function.Surjective f :=
    finiteEtaleGenericFiberToFractionField_surjective
      (R := R) (T := T) (K := K) (L := L)
  let m : Ideal (T ⊗[R] K) := RingHom.ker f
  let : m.IsMaximal := RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective f hf
  have hComponent : Algebra.Etale R
      (integralClosure R (FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent m)) :=
    integralClosure_etale_genericFiberComponent m
  let e : FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent m ≃ₐ[R] L := by
    simpa only [FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent, m] using
      (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (f := f) hf)
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv e.mapIntegralClosure

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain_injective
statement:
theorem arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain_injective
    [FaithfulSMul B A] [IsDomain (F ⊗[ℚ] K)]
    (g : K →ₐ[ℚ] L) :
    Function.Injective (arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain B A K L g)
proof:
:= by
  let a : A →ₐ[ℤ] L := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℤ A L
  let b : B →ₐ[ℤ] L := a.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℤ B A)
  have hb : Function.Injective b :=
    (IsFractionRing.injective A L).comp (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective B A)
  let f₀ : F →+* L := IsFractionRing.lift hb
  let f : F →ₐ[ℚ] L :=
    { f₀ with commutes' := fun q ↦ map_ratCast f₀ q }
  let i : B →ₐ[ℤ] F := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℤ B F
  have hi := arithmeticConstantsTensor_lift_injective
    (B := B) (F := F) (K := K) (L := L) i
    (IsFractionRing.injective B F) f g
  have heq : a.comp
      ((arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain B A K L g).restrictScalars ℤ) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ((f.restrictScalars ℤ).comp i)
        ((g.restrictScalars ℤ).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ℤ (𝓞 K) K))
        (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _) := by
    ext x
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, map_one, mul_one, Algebra.ofId_apply]
      change algebraMap A L (algebraMap B A x) =
        IsFractionRing.lift hb (algebraMap B F x)
      exact (IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap hb x).symm
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, map_one, one_mul]
      change algebraMap A L (ringOfIntegersToNormalDomain A K L g x) = g (x : K)
      exact algebraMap_ringOfIntegersToNormalDomain A K L g x
  rw [← heq] at hi
  intro x y hxy
  apply hi
  exact congrArg a hxy

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain_comap_surjective
statement:
theorem arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain_comap_surjective
    [FaithfulSMul B A] [Module.Finite B A]
    [IsDomain (F ⊗[ℚ] K)] (g : K →ₐ[ℚ] L) :
    Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap
      (arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain B A K L g).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  let C := B ⊗[ℤ] (𝓞 K)
  let h : C →ₐ[B] A := arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain B A K L g
  let : Algebra C A := h.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower B C A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' h.comp_algebraMap.symm
  have : Module.Finite C A := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite B C A
  have hh : h.toRingHom.IsIntegral := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral
  exact hh.comap_surjective
    (arithmeticConstantsTensorToNormalDomain_injective B A F K L g)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_isLocalHom
statement:
theorem
    isDiscreteValuationRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_isLocalHom
    {V : Type u} {C : Type v}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra V C] [IsLocalRing C]
    [IsNoetherianRing C] [Algebra.EssFiniteType V C] [Module.Flat V C]
    [Algebra.FormallyUnramified V C]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap V C)] :
    ∃ hdomainC : IsDomain C,
      letI : IsDomain C
proof:
:= hdomainC
      IsDiscreteValuationRing C := by
  obtain ⟨varpi, hvarpi⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_prime V
  have hvarpiRegular : IsSMulRegular V varpi := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro x hx
    change varpi * x = 0 at hx
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hx).resolve_left hvarpi.ne_zero
  have hregular : IsRegular V [varpi] := by
    rw [isRegular_cons_iff]
    have hvarpiMem : varpi ∈ maximalIdeal V := by
      rw [mem_maximalIdeal]
      exact hvarpi.not_isUnit
    let : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop varpi V) :=
      nontrivial_quotSMulTop_of_mem_maximalIdeal V hvarpiMem
    exact ⟨hvarpiRegular, IsRegular.nil V _⟩
  have hgenerate : Ideal.ofList [varpi] = maximalIdeal V := by
    rw [Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_nil, sup_bot_eq]
    exact hvarpi.irreducible.maximalIdeal_eq.symm
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat V C :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  have hregularC : IsRegular C [algebraMap V C varpi] :=
    hregular.of_faithfullyFlat
  have hgenerateC : Ideal.ofList [algebraMap V C varpi] =
      maximalIdeal C := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList [algebraMap V C varpi] =
          (Ideal.ofList [varpi]).map (algebraMap V C) := by
        simpa using
          (Ideal.map_ofList (algebraMap V C) [varpi]).symm
      _ = (maximalIdeal V).map (algebraMap V C) := by
        rw [hgenerate]
      _ = maximalIdeal C :=
        Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal
  have hdomainC : IsDomain C :=
    Kummer.isDomain_of_regularSystem
      [algebraMap V C varpi] hregularC hgenerateC
  let : IsDomain C := hdomainC
  have hvarpiImageNe : algebraMap V C varpi ≠ 0 :=
    by simpa using
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective V C).ne hvarpi.ne_zero
  have hmaximalNe : maximalIdeal C ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot
    apply hvarpiImageNe
    rw [← Ideal.mem_bot, ← hbot, ← hgenerateC]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_singleton_self _)
  have hnotField : ¬ IsField C :=
    IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.not.mpr hmaximalNe
  have hprincipal : (maximalIdeal C).IsPrincipal := by
    refine ⟨algebraMap V C varpi, ?_⟩
    simpa using hgenerateC.symm
  exact ⟨hdomainC,
    ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE C hnotField).out 5 1).mp hprincipal⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_etale_liesOver_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem
    exists_isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_etale_liesOver_maximalIdeal
    {V : Type u} {E : Type v}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CommRing E] [Algebra V E] [Algebra.Etale V E]
    (q : Ideal E) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)] :
    ∃ hdomain : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q),
      letI : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q)
proof:
:= hdomain
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime q) := by
  let C := Localization.AtPrime q
  let : IsNoetherianRing E :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing V E
  let baseAlgebra : Algebra V C :=
    ((algebraMap E C).comp (algebraMap V E)).toAlgebra
  let : SMul V C := baseAlgebra.toSMul
  let : Algebra V C := baseAlgebra
  let : Module V C := baseAlgebra.toModule
  let : IsScalarTower V E C :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : Algebra.EssFiniteType V C :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp V E C
  let : Module.Flat V E := inferInstance
  let : Module.Flat E C := IsLocalization.flat C q.primeCompl
  let : Module.Flat V C := Module.Flat.trans V E C
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified V C :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.comp V E C
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap V C) :=
    isLocalHom_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_liesOver_maximalIdeal
      (R := V) (S := E) q
  exact
    isDiscreteValuationRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_isLocalHom
      (V := V) (C := C)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_etale_of_isLocalHom
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_of_etale_of_isLocalHom
    {V : Type u} {C : Type v}
    [CommRing V] [IsDomain V] [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra V C] [IsLocalRing C]
    [Algebra.Etale V C] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap V C)] :
    ∃ hdomainC : IsDomain C,
      letI : IsDomain C
proof:
:= hdomainC
      IsDiscreteValuationRing C := by
  let : IsNoetherianRing C :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing V C
  exact
    isDiscreteValuationRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_isLocalHom
      (V := V) (C := C)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_finiteEtale_baseChange
statement:
theorem integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_finiteEtale_baseChange
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {T : Type uT}
    {F : Type uF} {E : Type uE} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsIntegrallyClosed B] [Algebra A B]
    [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [Algebra A T]
    [Module.Finite A T] [Algebra.Etale A T]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F] [IsFractionRing A F]
    [Field E] [Algebra T E] [IsFractionRing T E]
    [Algebra A E] [IsScalarTower A T E]
    [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower A F E]
    [Field K] [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K]
    [Algebra A K] [Algebra F K]
    [IsScalarTower A B K] [IsScalarTower A F K]
    (m : Ideal (K ⊗[F] E)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    let M
proof:
:= GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure B M) := by
  let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let : IsScalarTower B K M := inferInstance
  let eGeneric : (F ⊗[A] T) ≃ₐ[F] E :=
    finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv (R := A) (C := T) (K := F) (E := E)
  let eFactor : (K ⊗[A] T) ≃ₐ[K] (K ⊗[F] E) :=
    iteratedGenericFiberEquiv A F K T E eGeneric
  let quotient : (K ⊗[F] E) →ₐ[K] M :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K m
  let componentMap : (K ⊗[A] T) →ₐ[K] M :=
    quotient.comp eFactor.toAlgHom
  apply integralClosure_etale_of_surjective_reassociatedGenericFiber
    (A := A) (B := B) (T := T) (K := K) componentMap
  exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp eFactor.surjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_away_isUnit
statement:
theorem integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_away_isUnit
    {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {B : Type uB}
    {F : Type uF} {E : Type uE} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra R C] [FaithfulSMul R C]
    (f : R)
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R C f))]
    [Module.Finite (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R C f))]
    [Algebra.Etale (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R C f))]
    [Field F] [Algebra (Localization.Away f) F]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Algebra R F] [IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Field E] [Algebra (Localization.Away (algebraMap R C f)) E]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away (algebraMap R C f)) E]
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) E]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R C f)) E]
    [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower (Localization.Away f) F E]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    [Algebra R B]
    (hf : IsUnit (algebraMap R B f))
    [Field K] [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K]
    [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower R B K]
    [Algebra F K] [IsScalarTower R F K]
    (m : Ideal (K ⊗[F] E)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    Algebra.Etale B
      (integralClosure B (GenericTensorFieldComponent m))
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let T := Localization.Away (algebraMap R C f)
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, map_zero] at hf
    exact not_isUnit_zero hf
  have hfC0 : algebraMap R C f ≠ 0 :=
    by simpa using (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R C).ne hf0
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain (S := S) hf0
  let : IsDomain T := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain (S := T) hfC0
  let mapSB : S →+* B := IsLocalization.Away.lift f hf
  let : Algebra S B := mapSB.toAlgebra
  let mapSK : S →+* K :=
    (algebraMap F K).comp (algebraMap S F)
  let : Algebra S K := mapSK.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower S F K :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hmaps :
      (algebraMap B K).comp mapSB = mapSK := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers f)
    ext x
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [show mapSB (algebraMap R S x) = algebraMap R B x by
      exact IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq f hf x]
    change algebraMap B K (algebraMap R B x) =
      algebraMap F K (algebraMap S F (algebraMap R S x))
    calc
      algebraMap B K (algebraMap R B x) = algebraMap R K x :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R B K x).symm
      _ = algebraMap F K (algebraMap R F x) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R F K x
      _ = algebraMap F K (algebraMap S F (algebraMap R S x)) :=
        congrArg (algebraMap F K)
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S F x)
  let : IsScalarTower S B K :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' hmaps.symm
  exact
    integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_finiteEtale_baseChange
      (A := S) (B := B) (T := T) (F := F) (E := E) (K := K) m

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.selectedGenericFiberIdeal_isMaximal
statement:
theorem selectedGenericFiberIdeal_isMaximal
    {R : Type uA} {T : Type uT} {K : Type uK} {Ω : Type uΩ}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
    [CommRing K] [Algebra R K]
    [Field Ω] [Algebra R Ω]
    (f : (T ⊗[R] K) →ₐ[R] Ω) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (selectedGenericFiberIdeal f).IsMaximal
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective f hf

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_etale_of_surjective_genericFiber
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_surjective_genericFiber
    {R : Type uA} {T : Type uT} {K : Type uK} {Ω : Type uΩ}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Module.Finite R T] [Algebra.Etale R T]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field Ω] [Algebra R Ω]
    (f : (T ⊗[R] K) →ₐ[R] Ω) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R Ω)
proof:
:= by
  let m := selectedGenericFiberIdeal f
  let : m.IsMaximal := selectedGenericFiberIdeal_isMaximal f hf
  have hComponent : Algebra.Etale R
      (integralClosure R (FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent m)) :=
    integralClosure_etale_genericFiberComponent m
  let e : FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent m ≃ₐ[R] Ω :=
    selectedGenericFiberComponentEquiv f hf
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv e.mapIntegralClosure

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_etale_of_surjective_reassociatedGenericFiber
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_surjective_reassociatedGenericFiber
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {T : Type uT}
    {K : Type uK} {Ω : Type uΩ}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [CommRing T] [Algebra A T] [Module.Finite A T] [Algebra.Etale A T]
    [IsDomain B] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    [Field K] [Algebra B K] [IsFractionRing B K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A B K]
    [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [Algebra B Ω] [IsScalarTower B K Ω]
    (f : (K ⊗[A] T) →ₐ[K] Ω) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure B Ω)
proof:
:= by
  let S := B ⊗[A] T
  let : Module.Finite B S := Module.Finite.base_change A B T
  let : Algebra.Etale B S := Algebra.Etale.baseChange A T B
  let : Algebra K (S ⊗[B] K) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower B K (S ⊗[B] K) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let e : (S ⊗[B] K) ≃ₐ[K] (K ⊗[A] T) :=
    baseChangeGenericFiberEquiv A B T K
  let gK : (S ⊗[B] K) →ₐ[K] Ω := f.comp e.toAlgHom
  let gB : (S ⊗[B] K) →ₐ[B] Ω := gK.restrictScalars B
  apply integralClosure_etale_of_surjective_genericFiber
    (R := B) (T := S) (K := K) gB
  exact hf.comp e.surjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_compositum_etale_of_finiteEtale_baseChange
statement:
theorem integralClosure_compositum_etale_of_finiteEtale_baseChange
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {T : Type uT}
    {F : Type uF} {Ω : Type uΩ}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [CommRing T] [Algebra A T] [Module.Finite A T] [Algebra.Etale A T]
    [IsDomain B] [IsIntegrallyClosed B]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F]
    [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω]
    (E K' : IntermediateField F Ω)
    [Algebra B K'] [IsFractionRing B K']
    [Algebra A K'] [IsScalarTower A B K'] [IsScalarTower A F K']
    [FiniteDimensional F E]
    (eGeneric : (F ⊗[A] T) ≃ₐ[F] E) :
    let M
proof:
:= E ⊔ K'
    letI : Algebra B M :=
      ((algebraMap K' M).comp (algebraMap B K')).toAlgebra
    Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure B M) := by
  let M := E ⊔ K'
  let : Algebra B M :=
    ((algebraMap K' M).comp (algebraMap B K')).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower B K' M := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let eFactor : (K' ⊗[A] T) ≃ₐ[K'] (K' ⊗[F] E) :=
    iteratedGenericFiberEquiv A F K' T E eGeneric
  let product : (K' ⊗[F] E) →ₐ[K'] M :=
    supFlipProductMapRightAlgHom E K'
  let f : (K' ⊗[A] T) →ₐ[K'] M := product.comp eFactor.toAlgHom
  apply integralClosure_etale_of_surjective_reassociatedGenericFiber
    (A := A) (B := B) (T := T) (K := K') f
  exact (supFlipProductMapRightAlgHom_surjective E K').comp
    eFactor.surjective

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocalization_localizationAtPrime_of_primesOver_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem isLocalization_localizationAtPrime_of_primesOver_eq_singleton
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    {p : Ideal A} [p.IsPrime]
    {q : Ideal B} [q.IsPrime]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral A B]
    (hunique : p.primesOver B = {q}) :
    IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B p.primeCompl)
      (Localization.AtPrime q)
proof:
:= by
  have hqOver : q.LiesOver p := (hunique.ge rfl).2
  have hle :
      Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B p.primeCompl ≤ q.primeCompl := by
    rintro x ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    change algebraMap A B a ∉ q
    intro hmem
    exact ha <| by
      rw [hqOver.over]
      exact hmem
  have hdvd : ∀ x ∈ q.primeCompl,
      ∃ y ∈ Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B p.primeCompl, x ∣ y := by
    intro x hx
    change x ∉ q at hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_notMem_dvd_algebraMap_of_primesOver_eq_singleton
        hunique x hx
    exact ⟨algebraMap A B a, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hax⟩
  exact
    (IsLocalization.iff_of_le_of_exists_dvd
      (M := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B p.primeCompl)
      (S := Localization.AtPrime q) q.primeCompl hle hdvd).2
      (inferInstance :
        IsLocalization q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime q))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etaleChosenAway_boundaryAway
statement:
theorem etaleChosenAway_boundaryAway
    {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [CommRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing C]
    [Algebra R C] [Algebra R S]
    (f : R)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap R S) f).Etale)
    (e : C ⊗[R] S)
    (hfinite : Module.Finite C (Localization.Away e)) :
    (Localization.awayMap
      (algebraMap C (Localization.Away e))
      (algebraMap R C f)).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let T := C ⊗[R] S
  let D := Localization.Away e
  let fC : C := algebraMap R C f
  let : Module.Finite C D := hfinite
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale T D :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers e)
  have hTensor :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap C T) fC).Etale := by
    exact localization_awayMap_tensorProduct_etale
      (X := S) (Y := C) f hAway
  exact
    localization_awayMap_etale_of_finite_formallyEtale_extension
      (A := C) (C := T) (D := D) fC hTensor

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etaleChosenLocalFactor_pointed_boundaryAway
statement:
theorem etaleChosenLocalFactor_pointed_boundaryAway
    {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [CommRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing C]
    [Algebra R C] [Algebra R S]
    (f : R)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap R S) f).Etale)
    (P : Ideal C) [P.IsPrime]
    (e : C ⊗[R] S)
    (P' : Ideal (C ⊗[R] S))
    [P'.IsPrime] [P'.LiesOver P]
    (heP' : e ∉ P')
    (hfinite : Module.Finite C (Localization.Away e))
    (hunique : ∀ P'' : Ideal (C ⊗[R] S),
      P''.IsPrime → P''.LiesOver P → e ∉ P'' → P'' = P') :
    let Q
proof:
:= etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'
    letI : Q.IsPrime := etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime e P' heP'
    letI : Q.LiesOver P' := etaleChosenAwayPrime_liesOver e P' heP'
    letI : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P' P
    let Cₚ := Localization.AtPrime P
    let Dₚ := Localization.AtPrime Q
    letI : Algebra Cₚ Dₚ :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
    @Algebra.Etale
      (Localization.Away
        (algebraMap C Cₚ (algebraMap R C f)))
      (Localization.Away
        (algebraMap Cₚ Dₚ
          (algebraMap C Cₚ (algebraMap R C f))))
      _ _
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap Cₚ Dₚ)
        (algebraMap C Cₚ (algebraMap R C f))).toAlgebra := by
  dsimp only
  let T := C ⊗[R] S
  let D := Localization.Away e
  let Q : Ideal D := etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'
  let : Q.IsPrime := etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P' := etaleChosenAwayPrime_liesOver e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P' P
  let Cₚ := Localization.AtPrime P
  let Dₚ := Localization.AtPrime Q
  let fC : C := algebraMap R C f
  let : Module.Finite C D := hfinite
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral C D := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite C D
  let : Algebra Cₚ Dₚ :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
  have hQunique : P.primesOver D = {Q} :=
    etaleChosenAway_primesOver_eq_singleton
      P e P' heP' hunique
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid D P.primeCompl) Dₚ :=
    isLocalization_localizationAtPrime_of_primesOver_eq_singleton
      hQunique
  let : Algebra.IsPushout C D Cₚ Dₚ :=
    Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization P.primeCompl Cₚ D Dₚ
  have hD :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap C D) fC).Etale :=
    etaleChosenAway_boundaryAway f hAway e hfinite
  exact
    localization_awayMap_etale_of_isPushout
      (A := C) (B := D) (C := Cₚ) (D := Dₚ) fC hD

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_etale_factor_prime_le_ramificationIdx_eq
statement:
theorem exists_etale_factor_prime_le_ramificationIdx_eq
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.FiniteType R B]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] [Algebra.QuasiFiniteAt R q]
    (r : Ideal B) [r.IsPrime] (hrq : r ≤ q) :
    ∃ (C : Type u) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra R C) (_ : Algebra.Etale R C)
      (P : Ideal C) (_ : P.IsPrime) (_ : P.LiesOver p)
      (e : TensorProduct R C B) (_ : IsIdempotentElem e)
      (P' Q : Ideal (TensorProduct R C B))
      (_ : P'.IsPrime) (_ : P'.LiesOver P) (_ : Q.IsPrime),
        P'.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q ∧
        Q ≤ P' ∧
        Q.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = r ∧
        Q.ramificationIdx C = r.ramificationIdx R ∧
        e ∉ Q ∧
        e ∉ P' ∧
        Function.Bijective
          (Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p P (Algebra.ofId _ _) (P.over_def p)) ∧
        Module.Finite C (Localization.Away e) ∧
        ∀ P'' : Ideal (TensorProduct R C B),
          P''.IsPrime → P''.LiesOver P → e ∉ P'' → P'' = P'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, _, _, _, P, _, _, e, he, P', _, _, hP'q, heP', hres, hfinite, hunique⟩ :=
    Algebra.exists_etale_isIdempotentElem_forall_liesOver_eq p q
  let T := TensorProduct R C B
  let : Algebra B T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R B T := Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let commB : AlgEquiv B (TensorProduct R B C) T :=
    { toRingEquiv := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R B C).toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro b
        exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply b).symm }
  let : Algebra.Etale B T := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv commB
  have hP'_over_q : P'.LiesOver q :=
    { over := by
        simpa [Ideal.under_def,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_eq_includeRight] using hP'q.symm }
  let : P'.LiesOver q := hP'_over_q
  obtain ⟨Q, hQP', hQprime, hQover⟩ :=
    P'.exists_ideal_le_liesOver_of_le (p := r) (q := q) hrq
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQprime
  have hQr : Q.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = r := by
    simpa [Ideal.under_def,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_eq_includeRight] using hQover.over.symm
  have hram : Q.ramificationIdx C = r.ramificationIdx R :=
    ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_eq_of_etale r Q hQr
  have heQ : e ∉ Q := fun he ↦ heP' (hQP' he)
  exact ⟨C, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    P, inferInstance, inferInstance, e, he, P', Q,
    inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    hP'q, hQP', hQr, hram, heQ, heP', hres, hfinite, hunique⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_localizationAtPrime_pi_factor_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_localizationAtPrime_pi_factor_ringEquiv
    {I : Type uI} [Finite I]
    (A : I → Type uA) [∀ i, CommRing (A i)]
    (P : Ideal (∀ i, A i)) [P.IsPrime] :
    ∃ (i : I) (q : PrimeSpectrum (A i)),
      ∃ E : Localization.AtPrime P ≃+*
          Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal,
        ∀ x : ∀ i, A i,
          E (algebraMap (∀ i, A i) (Localization.AtPrime P) x) =
            algebraMap (A i) (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (x i)
proof:
:= by
  let p : PrimeSpectrum (∀ i, A i) := ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
  obtain ⟨i, q, hq⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.exists_comap_evalRingHom_eq p
  have hqIdeal :
      q.asIdeal.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A i) = P :=
    congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hq
  subst P
  let E :
      Localization.AtPrime
          (q.asIdeal.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A i)) ≃+*
        Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal :=
    RingEquiv.ofBijective
      (Localization.AtPrime.mapPiEvalRingHom q.asIdeal)
      (Localization.AtPrime.mapPiEvalRingHom_bijective q.asIdeal)
  refine ⟨i, q, E, ?_⟩
  intro x
  change Localization.AtPrime.mapPiEvalRingHom q.asIdeal
      (algebraMap (∀ i, A i)
        (Localization.AtPrime
          (q.asIdeal.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A i))) x) =
    algebraMap (A i) (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (x i)
  exact Localization.AtPrime.mapPiEvalRingHom_algebraMap_apply
    (R := A) (i := i) (I := q.asIdeal)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_localizationAtPrime_pi_factor_algEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_localizationAtPrime_pi_factor_algEquiv
    {R : Type uBase} [CommRing R]
    {I : Type uI} [Finite I]
    (A : I → Type uA) [∀ i, CommRing (A i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)]
    (P : Ideal (∀ i, A i)) [P.IsPrime] :
    ∃ (i : I) (q : PrimeSpectrum (A i)),
      Nonempty
        (Localization.AtPrime P ≃ₐ[R]
          Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, q, E, hE⟩ :=
    exists_localizationAtPrime_pi_factor_ringEquiv A P
  refine ⟨i, q, ⟨AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := E) fun r ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  simpa only [Pi.algebraMap_apply,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (∀ i, A i)
      (Localization.AtPrime P),
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (A i)
      (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)] using
    hE (algebraMap R (∀ i, A i) r)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_integralClosure_artinianComponent_localizationAtPrime_algEquiv
statement:
theorem
    exists_integralClosure_artinianComponent_localizationAtPrime_algEquiv
    {B : Type uB} {G : Type uG}
    [CommRing B] [CommRing G] [Algebra B G]
    [IsArtinianRing G] [IsReduced G]
    (P : Ideal (integralClosure B G)) [P.IsPrime] :
    ∃ (m : MaximalSpectrum G)
      (q : PrimeSpectrum (integralClosure B (G ⧸ m.asIdeal))),
      Nonempty
        (Localization.AtPrime P ≃ₐ[B]
          Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  let A := fun m : MaximalSpectrum G ↦ G ⧸ m.asIdeal
  let eIC : integralClosure B G ≃ₐ[B]
      (∀ m, integralClosure B (A m)) :=
    SchemeTheory.integralClosureFactorsEquiv B G
  let Pprod : Ideal (∀ m, integralClosure B (A m)) :=
    P.map eIC.toRingEquiv
  let : Pprod.IsPrime := by
    exact Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective eIC.surjective fun x hx ↦ by
      have hx0 : x = 0 := eIC.injective (hx.trans eIC.map_zero.symm)
      subst x
      exact P.zero_mem
  obtain ⟨m, q, ⟨Ecoord⟩⟩ :=
    exists_localizationAtPrime_pi_factor_algEquiv
      (R := B) (fun m ↦ integralClosure B (A m)) Pprod
  have hcomap : P = Pprod.comap eIC.toRingHom := by
    symm
    exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective eIC.toRingEquiv eIC.bijective
  let Eprod : Localization.AtPrime P ≃ₐ[B]
      Localization.AtPrime Pprod :=
    Localization.localAlgEquiv P Pprod eIC hcomap
  exact ⟨m, q, ⟨Eprod.trans Ecoord⟩⟩

statement:
theorem etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime

proof:
:= by
