name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etaleChosenAway_primesOver_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem etaleChosenAway_primesOver_eq_singleton
    (P : Ideal C) [P.IsPrime]
    (e : TensorProduct R C S)
    (P' : Ideal (TensorProduct R C S))
    [P'.IsPrime] [P'.LiesOver P]
    (heP' : e ∉ P')
    (hunique : ∀ P'' : Ideal (TensorProduct R C S),
      P''.IsPrime → P''.LiesOver P → e ∉ P'' → P'' = P') :
    P.primesOver (Localization.Away e) =
      {etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'}
proof:
:= by
  let T := TensorProduct R C S
  let D := Localization.Away e
  let Q : Ideal D := etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'
  let : Q.IsPrime := etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P' := etaleChosenAwayPrime_liesOver e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P' P
  ext J
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hJprime, hJover⟩
    let : J.IsPrime := hJprime
    let : J.LiesOver P := hJover
    let J₀ : Ideal T := J.comap (algebraMap T D)
    let : J₀.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.under T J
    let : J.LiesOver J₀ := ⟨rfl⟩
    let : J₀.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.tower_bot J J₀ P
    have heJ₀ : e ∉ J₀ := by
      intro heJ
      have heJD : algebraMap T D e ∈ J := heJ
      exact hJprime.ne_top
        (J.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem heJD
          (IsLocalization.map_units D ⟨e, Submonoid.mem_powers e⟩))
    have hJ₀ : J₀ = P' := hunique J₀ inferInstance inferInstance heJ₀
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    calc
      J = J₀.map (algebraMap T D) :=
        (IsLocalization.map_under (.powers e) D J).symm
      _ = P'.map (algebraMap T D) :=
        congrArg (Ideal.map (algebraMap T D)) hJ₀
      _ = Q := rfl
  · intro hJ
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hJ
    subst J
    exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.moduleFinite_etaleChosenAway_localizationAtPrime
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_etaleChosenAway_localizationAtPrime
    (P : Ideal C) [P.IsPrime]
    (e : TensorProduct R C S)
    (P' : Ideal (TensorProduct R C S))
    [P'.IsPrime] [P'.LiesOver P]
    (heP' : e ∉ P')
    (hfinite : Module.Finite C (Localization.Away e))
    (hunique : ∀ P'' : Ideal (TensorProduct R C S),
      P''.IsPrime → P''.LiesOver P → e ∉ P'' → P'' = P') :
    let Q
proof:
:= etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'
    letI : Q.IsPrime := etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime e P' heP'
    letI : Q.LiesOver P' := etaleChosenAwayPrime_liesOver e P' heP'
    letI : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P' P
    letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
    Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime Q) := by
  dsimp only
  let D := Localization.Away e
  let Q : Ideal D := etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'
  let : Module.Finite C D := hfinite
  let : Q.IsPrime := etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P' := etaleChosenAwayPrime_liesOver e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P' P
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
  exact Localization.finite_of_primesOver_eq_singleton
    (etaleChosenAway_primesOver_eq_singleton P e P' heP' hunique)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etaleChosenLocalFactorToIntegralClosureAlgHom_injective
statement:
theorem etaleChosenLocalFactorToIntegralClosureAlgHom_injective
    (P : Ideal C) [P.IsPrime]
    (e : TensorProduct R C S)
    (P' : Ideal (TensorProduct R C S))
    [P'.IsPrime] [P'.LiesOver P]
    (heP' : e ∉ P')
    (hfinite : Module.Finite C (Localization.Away e))
    (hunique : ∀ P'' : Ideal (TensorProduct R C S),
      P''.IsPrime → P''.LiesOver P → e ∉ P'' → P'' = P') :
    let Q
proof:
:= etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'
    letI : Q.IsPrime := etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime e P' heP'
    letI : Q.LiesOver P' := etaleChosenAwayPrime_liesOver e P' heP'
    letI : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P' P
    let Cₚ := Localization.AtPrime P
    let Dₚ := Localization.AtPrime Q
    letI : Algebra Cₚ Dₚ :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
    letI : Module.Finite Cₚ Dₚ :=
      moduleFinite_etaleChosenAway_localizationAtPrime
        P e P' heP' hfinite hunique
    let Ω := FractionRing Dₚ
    letI : Algebra Cₚ Ω :=
      ((algebraMap Dₚ Ω).comp (algebraMap Cₚ Dₚ)).toAlgebra
    Function.Injective
      (etaleChosenLocalFactorToIntegralClosureAlgHom
        P e P' heP' hfinite hunique) := by
  dsimp only
  let Q := etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'
  let : Q.IsPrime := etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P' := etaleChosenAwayPrime_liesOver e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P' P
  let Cₚ := Localization.AtPrime P
  let Dₚ := Localization.AtPrime Q
  let : Algebra Cₚ Dₚ :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
  let : Module.Finite Cₚ Dₚ :=
    moduleFinite_etaleChosenAway_localizationAtPrime
      P e P' heP' hfinite hunique
  let Ω := FractionRing Dₚ
  let : Algebra Cₚ Ω :=
    ((algebraMap Dₚ Ω).comp (algebraMap Cₚ Dₚ)).toAlgebra
  intro x y hxy
  apply IsFractionRing.injective Dₚ Ω
  have hxy' := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
  change algebraMap Dₚ Ω x = algebraMap Dₚ Ω y at hxy'
  exact hxy'

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etaleChosenPointedTensorPrime_isPrime
statement:
theorem etaleChosenPointedTensorPrime_isPrime
    (P : Ideal C) [P.IsPrime]
    (P' : Ideal (C ⊗[R] S)) [P'.IsPrime] [P'.LiesOver P] :
    (etaleChosenPointedTensorPrime
      (R := R) (S := S) P P').IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  let T := C ⊗[R] S
  let Cₚ := Localization.AtPrime P
  let BS := Cₚ ⊗[R] S
  let φ := etaleChosenPointedTensorBaseChangeAlgHom
    (R := R) (S := S) P
  let : Algebra T BS := φ.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower C T BS :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' φ.comp_algebraMap.symm
  let : IsScalarTower R T BS :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      ext r
      simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, φ])
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T P.primeCompl) BS := by
    exact IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct
      R S P.primeCompl Cₚ (by
        ext s
        change φ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] s) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R] s
        change (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
          (Algebra.ofId C Cₚ) (AlgHom.id R S))
            (1 ⊗ₜ[R] s) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R] s
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one]
        rfl)
  exact IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint
    (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T P.primeCompl) BS P'
    inferInstance (Ideal.disjoint_primeCompl_of_liesOver P' P)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etaleChosenPointedTensorPrime_comap
statement:
theorem etaleChosenPointedTensorPrime_comap
    (P : Ideal C) [P.IsPrime]
    (P' : Ideal (C ⊗[R] S)) [P'.IsPrime] [P'.LiesOver P] :
    (etaleChosenPointedTensorPrime
      (R := R) (S := S) P P').comap
        (etaleChosenPointedTensorBaseChangeAlgHom
          (R := R) (S := S) P).toRingHom = P'
proof:
:= by
  let T := C ⊗[R] S
  let Cₚ := Localization.AtPrime P
  let BS := Cₚ ⊗[R] S
  let φ := etaleChosenPointedTensorBaseChangeAlgHom
    (R := R) (S := S) P
  let PBS := etaleChosenPointedTensorPrime
    (R := R) (S := S) P P'
  let : Algebra T BS := φ.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower C T BS :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' φ.comp_algebraMap.symm
  let : IsScalarTower R T BS :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      ext r
      simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, φ])
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T P.primeCompl) BS := by
    exact IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct
      R S P.primeCompl Cₚ (by
        ext s
        change φ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] s) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R] s
        change (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
          (Algebra.ofId C Cₚ) (AlgHom.id R S))
            (1 ⊗ₜ[R] s) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R] s
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one]
        rfl)
  have hover := IsLocalization.liesOver_map_of_isPrime_disjoint
    (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T P.primeCompl) BS
    (Ideal.disjoint_primeCompl_of_liesOver P' P)
  exact hover.over.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_etaleChosenLocalFactor_finiteGenericFiberComponent_algEquiv
statement:
theorem
    exists_etaleChosenLocalFactor_finiteGenericFiberComponent_algEquiv
    [Algebra.Etale R C]
    (P : Ideal C) [P.IsPrime]
    (e : C ⊗[R] integralClosure R L)
    (P' : Ideal (C ⊗[R] integralClosure R L))
    [P'.IsPrime] [P'.LiesOver P]
    (heP' : e ∉ P') :
    let Cₚ
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
    let G := Cₚ ⊗[R] L
    let Q := etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'
    letI : Q.IsPrime := etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime e P' heP'
    letI : Q.LiesOver P' := etaleChosenAwayPrime_liesOver e P' heP'
    letI : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P' P
    letI : Algebra Cₚ (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
    ∃ (m : MaximalSpectrum G)
      (q : PrimeSpectrum
        (integralClosure Cₚ
          (FiniteEtaleGenericFiberComponent m.asIdeal))),
      Nonempty
        (Localization.AtPrime Q ≃ₐ[Cₚ]
          Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) := by
  dsimp only
  let Cₚ := Localization.AtPrime P
  let Sₙ := integralClosure R L
  let BS := Cₚ ⊗[R] Sₙ
  let G := Cₚ ⊗[R] L
  let Q := etaleChosenAwayPrime e P'
  let PBS := etaleChosenPointedTensorPrime
    (R := R) (S := Sₙ) P P'
  let : Q.IsPrime := etaleChosenAwayPrime_isPrime e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P' := etaleChosenAwayPrime_liesOver e P' heP'
  let : Q.LiesOver P := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P' P
  let : Algebra Cₚ (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
  let : PBS.IsPrime :=
    etaleChosenPointedTensorPrime_isPrime
      (R := R) (S := Sₙ) P P'
  let Epoint : BS ≃ₐ[Cₚ] integralClosure Cₚ G :=
    pointedSmoothNormalizationBaseChangeAlgEquiv
      (R := R) (C := C) (L := L) P
  let Pnorm : Ideal (integralClosure Cₚ G) :=
    PBS.map Epoint.toRingEquiv
  let : Pnorm.IsPrime := by
    exact Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Epoint.surjective fun x hx ↦ by
      have hx0 : x = 0 := Epoint.injective (hx.trans Epoint.map_zero.symm)
      subst x
      exact PBS.zero_mem
  have hcomap : PBS = Pnorm.comap Epoint.toRingHom := by
    symm
    exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective Epoint.toRingEquiv Epoint.bijective
  let Esmooth : Localization.AtPrime PBS ≃ₐ[Cₚ]
      Localization.AtPrime Pnorm :=
    Localization.localAlgEquiv PBS Pnorm Epoint hcomap
  let ETag : Localization.AtPrime Q ≃ₐ[Cₚ]
      Localization.AtPrime PBS :=
    etaleChosenAwayPointedBaseChangeLocalizationAtPrimeAlgEquiv
      (R := R) (S := Sₙ) P e P' heP'
  let Gleft := L ⊗[R] Cₚ
  let : Algebra L G := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let commL : Gleft ≃ₐ[L] G :=
    { toRingEquiv :=
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R L Cₚ).toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro l
        exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply l).symm }
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale R Cₚ := inferInstance
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale L Gleft := inferInstance
  let : Module.Finite L Gleft :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free L Gleft
  let : IsArtinianRing Gleft := IsArtinianRing.of_finite L Gleft
  let : IsArtinianRing G := commL.toRingEquiv.isArtinianRing
  let : Algebra.EssFiniteType L G :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_surjective commL.toAlgHom commL.surjective
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale L G :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_equiv commL
  let : IsReduced G :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field L G
  obtain ⟨m, q, ⟨Ecomponent⟩⟩ :=
    exists_integralClosure_artinianComponent_localizationAtPrime_algEquiv
      Pnorm
  exact ⟨m, q, ⟨(ETag.trans Esmooth).trans Ecomponent⟩⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_completeOrthogonalIdempotents_lift_of_surjective_henselianRing_ker
statement:
theorem exists_completeOrthogonalIdempotents_lift_of_surjective_henselianRing_ker
    {R S ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Fintype ι]
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    [HenselianRing R (RingHom.ker f)]
    (e : ι → S) (he : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e) :
    ∃ e' : ι → R, CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents e' ∧ f ∘ e' = e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose e' he'_idem he'_map using fun i ↦
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_idempotent_lift_of_surjective_henselianRing_ker
      f hf (e i) (he.idem i)
  have he'_ortho : Pairwise (e' · * e' · = 0) := by
    intro i j hij
    have hij_idem : IsIdempotentElem (e' i * e' j) := by
      rw [IsIdempotentElem]
      calc
        (e' i * e' j) * (e' i * e' j) = (e' i * e' i) * (e' j * e' j) := by
          ring
        _ = e' i * e' j := by rw [(he'_idem i).eq, (he'_idem j).eq]
    have hij_ker : e' i * e' j ∈ RingHom.ker f := by
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_mul, he'_map i, he'_map j]
      exact he.ortho hij
    have hij_jac : e' i * e' j ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R) :=
      HenselianRing.jac hij_ker
    have hunit : IsUnit (1 - e' i * e' j) := by
      apply Ideal.isUnit_of_sub_one_mem_jacobson_bot
      simpa only [sub_sub_cancel_left] using neg_mem hij_jac
    have hone : 1 - e' i * e' j = 1 :=
      (IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_one_of_isUnit hunit).mp hij_idem.one_sub
    exact sub_eq_self.mp hone
  let horth : OrthogonalIdempotents e' := ⟨he'_idem, he'_ortho⟩
  have hsum_idem : IsIdempotentElem (∑ i, e' i) := by
    simpa using horth.isIdempotentElem_sum (s := Finset.univ)
  have hsum_ker : (∑ i, e' i) - 1 ∈ RingHom.ker f := by
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, map_sum, map_one]
    simp only [he'_map, he.complete, sub_self]
  have hsum_jac : (∑ i, e' i) - 1 ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R) :=
    HenselianRing.jac hsum_ker
  have hsum_unit : IsUnit (∑ i, e' i) :=
    Ideal.isUnit_of_sub_one_mem_jacobson_bot _ hsum_jac
  have hsum : ∑ i, e' i = 1 :=
    (IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_one_of_isUnit hsum_unit).mp hsum_idem
  refine ⟨e', ⟨⟨he'_idem, he'_ortho⟩, hsum⟩, ?_⟩
  funext i
  exact he'_map i

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_prime_liesOver_span_ramificationIdx_eq
statement:
theorem
    exists_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_prime_liesOver_span_ramificationIdx_eq
    {A C F KC M : Type u}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra A C]
    [Module.Finite A C] [Algebra.Etale A C] [FaithfulSMul A C]
    [Field F] [Algebra A F] [IsFractionRing A F]
    [Field KC] [Algebra C KC] [IsFractionRing C KC]
    [Algebra A KC] [IsScalarTower A C KC]
    [Algebra F KC] [IsScalarTower A F KC]
    [Field M] [Algebra F M] [FiniteDimensional F M]
    [Algebra A M] [IsScalarTower A F M]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A M)]
    (y : A)
    (m : Ideal (KC ⊗[F] M)) [m.IsMaximal]
    (q : Ideal (integralClosure A M)) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({y} : Set A))]
    (hpC : (Ideal.span ({algebraMap A C y} : Set C)).IsPrime) :
    let Omega
proof:
:= GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    letI : Algebra C Omega :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := C) m
    ∃ Q : Ideal (integralClosure C Omega), Q.IsPrime ∧
      Q.LiesOver (Ideal.span ({algebraMap A C y} : Set C)) ∧
      Q.ramificationIdx C = q.ramificationIdx A := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let Omega := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let C0 := integralClosure A M
  let pA := Ideal.span ({y} : Set A)
  let pC := Ideal.span ({algebraMap A C y} : Set C)
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A C := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite A C
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A C := inferInstance
  let : pC.IsPrime := hpC
                                                                      
                                                                      
                                                                            
  let : Algebra C Omega :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := C) m
  let : SMul C Omega :=
    (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := C) m).toSMul
  let : Algebra M Omega := genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m
  let : SMul M Omega :=
    (genericTensorFieldComponentRightAlgebra m).toSMul
  let : Algebra A Omega :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := A) m
  let : SMul A Omega :=
    (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := A) m).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower F KC Omega :=
    genericTensorFieldComponent_isScalarTower m
  let : IsScalarTower F M Omega :=
    genericTensorFieldComponent_right_isScalarTower m
  let : IsScalarTower A C Omega := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext a
    change
      algebraMap KC Omega (algebraMap A KC a) =
        algebraMap KC Omega (algebraMap C KC (algebraMap A C a))
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C KC]
  let : IsScalarTower A M Omega := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro a
    change
      algebraMap KC Omega (algebraMap A KC a) =
        algebraMap M Omega (algebraMap A M a)
    calc
      algebraMap KC Omega (algebraMap A KC a) =
          algebraMap KC Omega (algebraMap F KC (algebraMap A F a)) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F KC]
      _ = algebraMap F Omega (algebraMap A F a) :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F KC Omega _).symm
      _ = algebraMap M Omega (algebraMap F M (algebraMap A F a)) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F M Omega _
      _ = algebraMap M Omega (algebraMap A M a) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F M]
                                                                         
                                                                   
                                                 
  let : Algebra M (KC ⊗[F] M) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let eGeneric : (F ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[F] KC :=
    finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv (R := A) (C := C) (K := F) (E := KC)
  let eFactor0 : (M ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[M] (M ⊗[F] KC) :=
    iteratedGenericFiberEquiv A F M C KC eGeneric
  let eComm : (M ⊗[F] KC) ≃ₐ[M] (KC ⊗[F] M) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight F M KC
  let eFactor : (M ⊗[A] C) ≃ₐ[M] (KC ⊗[F] M) :=
    eFactor0.trans eComm
  let quotient : (KC ⊗[F] M) →ₐ[M] Omega := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ M m
  let componentMap : (M ⊗[A] C) →ₐ[M] Omega :=
    quotient.comp eFactor.toAlgHom
  let : IsFractionRing C0 M :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension A F M C0
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed C0 :=
    integralClosure.isIntegrallyClosedOfFiniteExtension F
  let c0OmegaAlgebra : Algebra C0 Omega :=
    ((algebraMap M Omega).comp (algebraMap C0 M)).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra C0 Omega := c0OmegaAlgebra
  let : SMul C0 Omega := c0OmegaAlgebra.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower C0 M Omega := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A C0 Omega := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext a
    calc
      algebraMap A Omega a = algebraMap M Omega (algebraMap A M a) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A M Omega a
      _ = algebraMap M Omega (algebraMap C0 M (algebraMap A C0 a)) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C0 M]
      _ = algebraMap C0 Omega (algebraMap A C0 a) :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C0 M Omega _).symm
  have hEtale0 : Algebra.Etale C0 (integralClosure C0 Omega) := by
    apply integralClosure_etale_of_surjective_reassociatedGenericFiber
      (A := A) (B := C0) (T := C) (K := M) componentMap
    exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective.comp eFactor.surjective
                                                                      
                                                                       
                 
  let : Algebra C0 (integralClosure C Omega) :=
    integralClosureTwoIntegralBasesAlgebra
      (A := A) (B := C0) (C := C) (L := Omega)
  let eNorm :
      integralClosure C0 Omega ≃ₐ[C0] integralClosure C Omega :=
    integralClosureTwoIntegralBasesAlgEquiv
      (A := A) (B := C0) (C := C) (L := Omega)
  let : IsScalarTower C (integralClosure C Omega) Omega :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let : Algebra.Etale C0 (integralClosure C0 Omega) := hEtale0
  let : Algebra.Etale C0 (integralClosure C Omega) :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_equiv eNorm
  have hIntegral0 : Algebra.IsIntegral C0 (integralClosure C0 Omega) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_algebra C0 Omega
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral C0 (integralClosure C Omega) :=
    eNorm.isIntegral_iff.mp hIntegral0
  have hBaseAmbient (x : C0) :
      algebraMap (integralClosure C Omega) Omega
          (algebraMap C0 (integralClosure C Omega) x) =
        algebraMap C0 Omega x := by
    calc
      algebraMap (integralClosure C Omega) Omega
          (algebraMap C0 (integralClosure C Omega) x) =
          algebraMap (integralClosure C Omega) Omega
            (eNorm (algebraMap C0 (integralClosure C0 Omega) x)) := by
        rw [eNorm.commutes]
      _ = algebraMap (integralClosure C0 Omega) Omega
          (algebraMap C0 (integralClosure C0 Omega) x) :=
        algebraMap_integralClosureTwoIntegralBasesAlgEquiv
          (A := A) (B := C0) (C := C) (L := Omega) _
      _ = algebraMap C0 Omega x :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply
          C0 (integralClosure C0 Omega) Omega x).symm
  have hC0OmegaInjective : Function.Injective (algebraMap C0 Omega) := by
    intro x x' hxx'
    apply IsFractionRing.injective C0 M
    apply (algebraMap M Omega).injective
    change algebraMap C0 Omega x = algebraMap C0 Omega x'
    exact hxx'
  have hC0SInjective :
      Function.Injective (algebraMap C0 (integralClosure C Omega)) := by
    intro x x' hxx'
    apply hC0OmegaInjective
    rw [← hBaseAmbient x, ← hBaseAmbient x', hxx']
                                                                        
                                                                          
  let aSAlgebra : Algebra A (integralClosure C Omega) :=
    ((algebraMap C0 (integralClosure C Omega)).comp
      (algebraMap A C0)).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra A (integralClosure C Omega) := aSAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A C0 (integralClosure C Omega) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A C (integralClosure C Omega) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro a
    apply Subtype.ext
    change
      algebraMap (integralClosure C Omega) Omega
          (algebraMap A (integralClosure C Omega) a) =
        algebraMap (integralClosure C Omega) Omega
          (algebraMap C (integralClosure C Omega) (algebraMap A C a))
    calc
      algebraMap (integralClosure C Omega) Omega
          (algebraMap A (integralClosure C Omega) a) =
          algebraMap C0 Omega (algebraMap A C0 a) :=
        hBaseAmbient (algebraMap A C0 a)
      _ = algebraMap A Omega a :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C0 Omega a).symm
      _ = algebraMap C Omega (algebraMap A C a) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C Omega a
      _ = algebraMap (integralClosure C Omega) Omega
          (algebraMap C (integralClosure C Omega) (algebraMap A C a)) :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply
          C (integralClosure C Omega) Omega _).symm
                                                                         
                                                                           
                      
  obtain ⟨Q, -, hQPrime, hQComap⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral q
      (⊥ : Ideal (integralClosure C Omega)) (by
      rw [Ideal.under, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
        (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp hC0SInjective]
      exact bot_le)
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQPrime
  have hQOverq : Q.LiesOver q :=
    (Ideal.liesOver_iff Q q).mpr hQComap.symm
  let : Q.LiesOver q := hQOverq
  let P := Q.under C
  let : P.IsPrime := inferInstance
  let : Q.LiesOver P := inferInstance
  have hQOverpA : Q.LiesOver pA := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q q pA
  let : Q.LiesOver pA := hQOverpA
  have hPOverpA : P.LiesOver pA := Ideal.LiesOver.tower_bot Q P pA
  let : P.LiesOver pA := hPOverpA
  have hpCOverpA : pC.LiesOver pA := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [show pC = pA.map (algebraMap A C) by
      simp only [pA, pC, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]]
    exact
      (Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat
        (B := C) pA).symm
  let : pC.LiesOver pA := hpCOverpA
  have hpCLe : pC ≤ P := by
    apply P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr
    exact (Ideal.mem_of_liesOver P pA y).mp
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self y)
  have hpCEq : pC = P := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hpCLe with hlt | heq
    · have hUnderLt :=
        Ideal.IsIntegral.under_lt_under (R := A) (A := C) hlt
      change pC.under A < P.under A at hUnderLt
      rw [← pC.over_def pA, ← P.over_def pA] at hUnderLt
      exact (lt_irrefl pA hUnderLt).elim
    · exact heq
  have hQOverpC : Q.LiesOver pC := by
    rw [hpCEq]
    infer_instance
  refine ⟨Q, hQPrime, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Omega, pC] using hQOverpC
  exact ramificationIdx_eq_of_etale_square
    (R := A) (B := C0) (C := C)
      (S := integralClosure C Omega) q Q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_away_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_base_away
statement:
theorem
    localization_away_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_base_away
    {A : Type uA} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
    {F : Type uF} {E : Type uE} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra A C] [FaithfulSMul A C]
    (f : A)
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f))]
    [Module.Finite (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f))]
    [Algebra.Etale (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f))]
    [Field F] [Algebra (Localization.Away f) F]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Algebra A F] [IsScalarTower A (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Field E] [Algebra (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f)) E]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f)) E]
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) E]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f)) E]
    [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower (Localization.Away f) F E]
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsIntegrallyClosed D] [Algebra A D]
    [Field K] [Algebra D K] [IsFractionRing D K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A D K]
    [Algebra F K] [IsScalarTower A F K]
    (m : Ideal (K ⊗[F] E)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    let M
proof:
:= GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    letI : Algebra D M :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
    letI : SMul D M :=
      (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m).toSMul
    letI : IsScalarTower D K M :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap D (integralClosure D M))
      (algebraMap A D f)).Etale := by
  dsimp only
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let fD : D := algebraMap A D f
  have hfS : algebraMap A S f ≠ 0 := by
    let : Nontrivial S := (algebraMap S F).domain_nontrivial
    exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f).ne_zero
  have hfAF : algebraMap A F f ≠ 0 := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S F]
    simpa using (IsFractionRing.injective S F).ne hfS
  have hfAK : algebraMap A K f ≠ 0 := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F K]
    simpa using (algebraMap F K).injective.ne hfAF
  have hfD : fD ≠ 0 := by
    intro hfDzero
    apply hfAK
    calc
      algebraMap A K f = algebraMap D K (algebraMap A D f) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A D K f
      _ = algebraMap D K fD := by rfl
      _ = algebraMap D K 0 := congrArg (algebraMap D K) hfDzero
      _ = 0 := map_zero (algebraMap D K)
  let B := Localization.Away fD
  let : IsDomain B := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain B hfD
  let : Algebra B K :=
    localizationAwayToExtensionAlgebra
      (A := D) (K := K) (L := K) fD hfD
  let : IsScalarTower D B K :=
    localizationAwayToExtension_isScalarTower
      (A := D) (K := K) (L := K) fD hfD
  let : IsFractionRing B K :=
    IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isDomain_of_isLocalization
      (Submonoid.powers fD) B K
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed B :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization B (Submonoid.powers fD)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hfD))
  let : IsScalarTower A D B := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A B K := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    calc
      algebraMap A K x = algebraMap D K (algebraMap A D x) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A D K x
      _ = algebraMap B K (algebraMap D B (algebraMap A D x)) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D B K (algebraMap A D x)
      _ = algebraMap B K (algebraMap A B x) := rfl
  have hfB : IsUnit (algebraMap A B f) := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap D B fD)
    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit fD
  let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  have hlocalOld :=
    integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_away_isUnit
      (R := A) (C := C) (B := B) (F := F) (E := E) (K := K)
      f hfB m
  let : Algebra D M :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
  let : SMul D M :=
    (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower D K M :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let quotientBM : Algebra B M :=
    Ideal.instAlgebraQuotient B m
  let canonicalBM : Algebra B M :=
    localizationAwayToExtensionAlgebra
      (A := D) (K := K) (L := M) fD hfD
  have hAlgebra : quotientBM = canonicalBM := by
    have hmaps :
        @algebraMap B M _ _ quotientBM =
          @algebraMap B M _ _ canonicalBM := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers fD)
      apply DFunLike.ext _ _
      intro x
      change algebraMap K M (algebraMap B K (algebraMap D B x)) =
        (IsLocalization.Away.lift fD
          (show IsUnit (algebraMap D M fD) by
            rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D K M]
            exact (algebraMap K M).isUnit_map
              (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
                (by simpa using (IsFractionRing.injective D K).ne hfD))))
          (algebraMap D B x)
      rw [IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
      calc
        algebraMap K M (algebraMap B K (algebraMap D B x)) =
            algebraMap K M (algebraMap D K x) := by
          rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D B K]
        _ = algebraMap D M x :=
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D K M x).symm
    apply Algebra.algebra_ext
    intro z
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps z
  have hlocalCanonical :
      @Algebra.Etale B
        (@integralClosure B M _ _ canonicalBM)
        _ _
        (@integralClosure B M _ _ canonicalBM).algebra := by
    exact hAlgebra ▸ hlocalOld
  let : Algebra B M := canonicalBM
  let : SMul B M := canonicalBM.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower D B M := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    change algebraMap D M x =
      (IsLocalization.Away.lift fD _) (algebraMap D B x)
    rw [IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  exact localization_integralClosure_away_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
    (A := D) (K := K) (L := M) fD hfD hlocalCanonical

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_away_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_awayMap
statement:
theorem
    localization_away_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_awayMap
    {A : Type uA} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
    {F : Type uF} {E : Type uE} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra A C] [FaithfulSMul A C]
    [Module.Finite A C]
    (f : A) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    [Field F] [Algebra A F] [IsFractionRing A F]
    [Field E] [Algebra C E] [IsFractionRing C E]
    [Algebra A E] [IsScalarTower A C E]
    [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower A F E]
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsIntegrallyClosed D] [Algebra A D]
    [Field K] [Algebra D K] [IsFractionRing D K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A D K]
    [Algebra F K] [IsScalarTower A F K]
    (hAway : (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A C) f).Etale)
    (m : Ideal (K ⊗[F] E)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    let M
proof:
:= GenericTensorFieldComponent m
    letI : Algebra D M :=
      genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
    letI : SMul D M :=
      (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m).toSMul
    letI : IsScalarTower D K M :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap D (integralClosure D M))
      (algebraMap A D f)).Etale := by
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let fC : C := algebraMap A C f
  let T := Localization.Away fC
  have hfC : fC ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [fC] using (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective A C).ne hf
  let mapST : S →+* T := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A C) f
  let : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A C T := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A S T := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    change algebraMap A T x = mapST (algebraMap A S x)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C T]
    simp [mapST, S, T, fC, IsLocalization.Away.map]
  let : Module.Finite S T :=
    Module.Finite.of_isLocalization A C (Submonoid.powers f)
  let : Algebra.Etale S T := hAway.toAlgebra
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hf
  let : IsDomain T := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain T hfC
  let : Algebra S F :=
    localizationAwayToExtensionAlgebra
      (A := A) (K := F) (L := F) f hf
  let : IsScalarTower A S F :=
    localizationAwayToExtension_isScalarTower
      (A := A) (K := F) (L := F) f hf
  let : IsFractionRing S F :=
    IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isDomain_of_isLocalization
      (Submonoid.powers f) S F
  let : Algebra T E :=
    localizationAwayToExtensionAlgebra
      (A := C) (K := E) (L := E) fC hfC
  let : IsScalarTower C T E :=
    localizationAwayToExtension_isScalarTower
      (A := C) (K := E) (L := E) fC hfC
  let : IsFractionRing T E :=
    IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isDomain_of_isLocalization
      (Submonoid.powers fC) T E
  let : Algebra S E :=
    ((algebraMap T E).comp (algebraMap S T)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower S T E := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower S F E := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    have hmaps :
        (algebraMap F E).comp (algebraMap S F) = algebraMap S E := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers f)
      ext a
      change algebraMap F E (algebraMap S F (algebraMap A S a)) =
        algebraMap T E (mapST (algebraMap A S a))
      calc
        algebraMap F E (algebraMap S F (algebraMap A S a)) =
            algebraMap F E (algebraMap A F a) := by
          rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S F]
        _ = algebraMap A E a :=
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A F E a).symm
        _ = algebraMap C E (algebraMap A C a) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C E a
        _ = algebraMap T E (algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C a)) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C T E (algebraMap A C a)
        _ = algebraMap T E (mapST (algebraMap A S a)) := by
          congr 1
          calc
            algebraMap C T (algebraMap A C a) = algebraMap A T a :=
              (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C T a).symm
            _ = algebraMap S T (algebraMap A S a) :=
              IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S T a
            _ = mapST (algebraMap A S a) := rfl
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps x).symm
  exact
    localization_away_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_base_away
      (A := A) (C := C) (D := D) (F := F) (E := E) (K := K)
      f m

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.awayElement_ne_zero_of_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem awayElement_ne_zero_of_isFractionRing
    {D : Type uD} {F : Type uF}
    [CommRing D] (f : D)
    [Field F] [Algebra (Localization.Away f) F]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away f) F] :
    f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let : Nontrivial S := (algebraMap S F).domain_nontrivial
  intro hzero
  subst f
  have hu : IsUnit
      (algebraMap D (Localization.Away (0 : D)) (0 : D)) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.Away (0 : D))
      (⟨0, Submonoid.mem_powers 0⟩ : Submonoid.powers (0 : D))
  have : IsUnit (0 : Localization.Away (0 : D)) := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using hu
  exact not_isUnit_zero this

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.awayToFractionFieldRingHom_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem awayToFractionFieldRingHom_algebraMap
    {D : Type uD} {F : Type uF} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D]
    (f : D)
    [Field F] [Algebra (Localization.Away f) F]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Field K] [Algebra D K] [IsFractionRing D K]
    (x : D) :
    awayToFractionFieldRingHom (F := F) (K := K) f
        (algebraMap D (Localization.Away f) x) =
      algebraMap D K x
proof:
:= by
  unfold awayToFractionFieldRingHom
  apply IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.awayToFractionFieldRingHom_injective
statement:
theorem awayToFractionFieldRingHom_injective
    {D : Type uD} {F : Type uF} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D]
    (f : D)
    [Field F] [Algebra (Localization.Away f) F]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Field K] [Algebra D K] [IsFractionRing D K] :
    Function.Injective
      (awayToFractionFieldRingHom (F := F) (K := K) f)
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let mapSK : S →+* K :=
    awayToFractionFieldRingHom (F := F) (K := K) f
  rw [IsLocalization.injective_iff_map_algebraMap_eq
    (Submonoid.powers f) mapSK]
  intro x y
  constructor
  · intro hxy
    exact congrArg mapSK hxy
  · intro hxy
    have hxy' : algebraMap D K x = algebraMap D K y := by
      calc
        algebraMap D K x = mapSK (algebraMap D S x) := by
          symm
          exact awayToFractionFieldRingHom_algebraMap
            (F := F) (K := K) f x
        _ = mapSK (algebraMap D S y) := hxy
        _ = algebraMap D K y :=
          awayToFractionFieldRingHom_algebraMap
            (F := F) (K := K) f y
    exact congrArg (algebraMap D S)
      ((IsFractionRing.injective D K) hxy')

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.awayFractionFieldToFractionFieldAlgebra_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem awayFractionFieldToFractionFieldAlgebra_algebraMap
    {D : Type uD} {F : Type uF} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D]
    (f : D)
    [Field F] [Algebra (Localization.Away f) F]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Field K] [Algebra D K] [IsFractionRing D K]
    (x : Localization.Away f) :
    letI : Algebra F K
proof:
:=
      awayFractionFieldToFractionFieldAlgebra f
    algebraMap F K (algebraMap (Localization.Away f) F x) =
      awayToFractionFieldRingHom (F := F) (K := K) f x := by
  let : Algebra F K := awayFractionFieldToFractionFieldAlgebra f
  exact IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap
    (awayToFractionFieldRingHom_injective (F := F) (K := K) f) x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.awayFractionFieldToFractionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem awayFractionFieldToFractionField_isScalarTower
    {D : Type uD} {F : Type uF} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D]
    (f : D)
    [Field F] [Algebra (Localization.Away f) F]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Field K] [Algebra D K] [IsFractionRing D K] :
    letI : Algebra D F
proof:
:=
      ((algebraMap (Localization.Away f) F).comp
        (algebraMap D (Localization.Away f))).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra F K :=
      awayFractionFieldToFractionFieldAlgebra f
    IsScalarTower D F K := by
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let : Algebra D F :=
    ((algebraMap S F).comp (algebraMap D S)).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra F K := awayFractionFieldToFractionFieldAlgebra f
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro x
  change algebraMap D K x =
    algebraMap F K (algebraMap S F (algebraMap D S x))
  rw [awayFractionFieldToFractionFieldAlgebra_algebraMap,
    awayToFractionFieldRingHom_algebraMap]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isUnit_localizationAtPrime_of_disjoint_powers
statement:
theorem isUnit_localizationAtPrime_of_disjoint_powers
    {D : Type uD} [CommRing D]
    (f : D) (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
    (hdisj : Disjoint
      ((Submonoid.powers f : Submonoid D) : Set D) (q : Set D)) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime q) f)
proof:
:= by
  have hfq : f ∉ q := by
    rw [← Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime]
    exact hdisj
  exact IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.AtPrime q)
    (⟨f, hfq⟩ : q.primeCompl)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_away
statement:
theorem localization_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_away
    {D : Type uD} {C : Type uC} {F : Type uF}
    {E : Type uE} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsIntegrallyClosed D]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra D C] [FaithfulSMul D C]
    (f : D)
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap D C f))]
    [Module.Finite (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap D C f))]
    [Algebra.Etale (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap D C f))]
    [Field F] [Algebra (Localization.Away f) F]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Field E] [Algebra (Localization.Away (algebraMap D C f)) E]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away (algebraMap D C f)) E]
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) E]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap D C f)) E]
    [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower (Localization.Away f) F E]
    [Field K] [Algebra D K] [IsFractionRing D K]
    (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
    (hdisj : Disjoint
      ((Submonoid.powers f : Submonoid D) : Set D) (q : Set D)) :
    letI : Algebra D F
proof:
:=
      ((algebraMap (Localization.Away f) F).comp
        (algebraMap D (Localization.Away f))).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower D (Localization.Away f) F :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    letI : Algebra F K :=
      awayFractionFieldToFractionFieldAlgebra f
    letI : IsScalarTower D F K :=
      awayFractionFieldToFractionField_isScalarTower f
    ∀ (m : Ideal (K ⊗[F] E)), [m.IsMaximal] →
      let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
      letI : IsScalarTower F K M := genericTensorFieldComponent_isScalarTower m
      letI : IsScalarTower D K M := by
        apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
        intro x
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D F M,
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F K M,
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D F K]
      let canonicalBM : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) M :=
        localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := M) q
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) M := canonicalBM
      letI : SMul (Localization.AtPrime q) M := canonicalBM.toSMul
      letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := M) q
      letI := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) q
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
          (integralClosure D M) q.primeCompl)) := by
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let B := Localization.AtPrime q
  let : Algebra F K := awayFractionFieldToFractionFieldAlgebra f
  intro m _
  let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  let : Algebra D F :=
    ((algebraMap S F).comp (algebraMap D S)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower D S F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower D F K :=
    awayFractionFieldToFractionField_isScalarTower f
  let : IsScalarTower F K M := genericTensorFieldComponent_isScalarTower m
  let : IsScalarTower D K M := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D F M,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F K M,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D F K]
  let : Algebra B K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) q
  let : IsScalarTower D B K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower (K := K) q
  let : IsFractionRing B K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) q
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed B :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization B q.primeCompl
      q.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  have hf : IsUnit (algebraMap D B f) :=
    isUnit_localizationAtPrime_of_disjoint_powers f q hdisj
  have hlocalOld :=
    integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_away_isUnit
      (R := D) (C := C) (B := Localization.AtPrime q)
      (F := F) (E := E) (K := K)
      f hf m
  let quotientPrimeComponentAlgebra : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) :=
    Ideal.instAlgebraQuotient (Localization.AtPrime q) m
  let canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra
      (K := K) (L := GenericTensorFieldComponent m) q
  have hAlgebra : quotientPrimeComponentAlgebra =
      canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra := by
    apply Algebra.algebra_ext
    intro z
    rfl
  have hlocalCanonical :
      @Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (@integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime q)
          (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) _ _
          canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra)
        _ _
        (@integralClosure (Localization.AtPrime q)
          (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) _ _
          canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra).algebra := by
    exact hAlgebra ▸ hlocalOld
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) := canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra
  let : SMul (Localization.AtPrime q) (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) :=
    canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime q) K
      (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := GenericTensorFieldComponent m) q
  let : IsScalarTower D (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (GenericTensorFieldComponent m) :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := GenericTensorFieldComponent m) q
  let := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra
    (L := GenericTensorFieldComponent m) q
  exact localization_integralClosure_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
    (A := D) (K := K) (L := GenericTensorFieldComponent m) q
    hlocalCanonical

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_base_away
statement:
theorem
    localization_integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_base_away
    {A : Type uA} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
    {F : Type uF} {E : Type uE} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra A C] [FaithfulSMul A C]
    (f : A)
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f))]
    [Module.Finite (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f))]
    [Algebra.Etale (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f))]
    [Field F] [Algebra (Localization.Away f) F]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Algebra A F] [IsScalarTower A (Localization.Away f) F]
    [Field E] [Algebra (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f)) E]
    [IsFractionRing (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f)) E]
    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) E]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.Away f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f)) E]
    [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower (Localization.Away f) F E]
    [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [IsIntegrallyClosed D] [Algebra A D]
    [Field K] [Algebra D K] [IsFractionRing D K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A D K]
    [Algebra F K] [IsScalarTower A F K]
    (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
    (hdisj : Disjoint
      ((Submonoid.powers (algebraMap A D f) : Submonoid D) : Set D)
      (q : Set D)) :
    ∀ (m : Ideal (K ⊗[F] E)), [m.IsMaximal] →
      let M
proof:
:= GenericTensorFieldComponent m
      letI : Algebra D M :=
        genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
      letI : SMul D M :=
        (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m).toSMul
      letI : IsScalarTower D K M :=
        IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
      let canonicalBM : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) M :=
        localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := M) q
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) M := canonicalBM
      letI : SMul (Localization.AtPrime q) M := canonicalBM.toSMul
      letI := localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
        (K := K) (L := M) q
      letI := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) q
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
          (integralClosure D M) q.primeCompl)) := by
  classical
  let B := Localization.AtPrime q
  let : IsScalarTower A D B := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    rfl
  let : Algebra B K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) q
  let : IsScalarTower D B K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower (K := K) q
  let : IsFractionRing B K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing (K := K) q
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed B :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization B q.primeCompl
      q.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  let : IsScalarTower A B K := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    calc
      algebraMap A K x = algebraMap D K (algebraMap A D x) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A D K x
      _ = algebraMap B K (algebraMap D B (algebraMap A D x)) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D B K (algebraMap A D x)
      _ = algebraMap B K (algebraMap A B x) := rfl
  have hf : IsUnit (algebraMap A B f) := by
    change IsUnit (algebraMap D B (algebraMap A D f))
    exact isUnit_localizationAtPrime_of_disjoint_powers
      (algebraMap A D f) q hdisj
  intro m _
  let M := GenericTensorFieldComponent m
  have hlocalOld :=
    integralClosure_genericTensorFieldComponent_etale_of_away_isUnit
      (R := A) (C := C) (B := B) (F := F) (E := E) (K := K)
      f hf m
  let : Algebra D M :=
    genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m
  let : SMul D M :=
    (genericTensorFieldComponentLeftScalarAlgebra (R := D) m).toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower D K M :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let quotientPrimeComponentAlgebra : Algebra B M :=
    Ideal.instAlgebraQuotient B m
  let canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra : Algebra B M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := M) q
  have hAlgebra : quotientPrimeComponentAlgebra =
      canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra := by
    apply Algebra.algebra_ext
    intro z
    rfl
  have hlocalCanonical :
      @Algebra.Etale B
        (@integralClosure B M _ _ canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra)
        _ _
        (@integralClosure B M _ _ canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra).algebra := by
    exact hAlgebra ▸ hlocalOld
  let : Algebra B M := canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra
  let : SMul B M := canonicalPrimeComponentAlgebra.toSMul
  let : IsScalarTower B K M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := M) q
  let : IsScalarTower D B M :=
    localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
      (K := K) (L := M) q
  let := integralClosureLocalizationAlgebra (L := M) q
  exact localization_integralClosure_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
    (A := D) (K := K) (L := M) q hlocalCanonical

name: CategoryTheory.Aut.one_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma CategoryTheory.Aut.one_hom {C : Type*} [Category C] (X : C) :
    (1 : Aut X).hom = (1 : End X)
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.PreGaloisCategory.ker_toAut
statement: lemma ker_toAut : (toAut F G).ker = ⨅ (X : C) (x : F.obj X), MulAction.stabilizer G x
proof:
:= by
  ext g : 1
  simp [MonoidHom.mem_ker, Subgroup.mem_iInf, Aut.ext_iff, NatTrans.ext'_iff, funext_iff,
    FintypeCat.hom_ext_iff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.algEquiv_smul_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma algEquiv_smul_hom (g : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (x : Over.mk (ξ k K) ⟶ X.toComma) :
    (g • x).left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (g : K →+* K)) ≫ x.left
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.homEquivAlgHom_smul
statement:
lemma homEquivAlgHom_smul (X : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of k))) (g : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (x) :
    (homEquivAlgHom k K X) (g • x) = g • (homEquivAlgHom k K X x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homEquivAlgHom]
  dsimp only [Over.mk_left, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, algEquiv_smul_hom,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_app, TopologicalSpace.Opens.map_top, CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  change _ = (g : K →ₐ[k] K).comp _
  ext1 a
  dsimp only [AlgHom.coe_mk, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.coe_comp,
    AlgHom.coe_ofClass]
  change ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (g : K →+* K))).appTop ≫
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).hom).hom (x.left.appTop.hom a) = _
  rw [Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.eq_one_of_smul_eq
statement:
lemma eq_one_of_smul_eq [Algebra.IsSeparable k K] (g : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (H : ∀ (X : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of k))) (x : (Over.mk (ξ k K) ⟶ X.toComma)), g • x = x) :
    g = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  let L := IntermediateField.adjoin k {x}
  have : IsFiniteEtale (ξ k L) := by
    rw [IsFiniteEtale.SpecMap_iff, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.finiteEtale_algebraMap_iff]
    have : Algebra.IsIntegral k L := inferInstance
    let : Algebra.EssFiniteType k L := by
      rw [IntermediateField.essFiniteType_iff]
      exact IntermediateField.fg_adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_singleton x)
    let : Module.Finite k L :=
      Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
    have : Algebra.Etale k L :=
      ⟨.of_isSeparable k L, Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp inferInstance⟩
    constructor
  let X : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of k)) := FiniteEtale.mk (ξ k L)
  let y : Over.mk (ξ k K) ⟶ X.toComma := by
    refine Over.homMk
      (Spec.map <| CommRingCat.ofHom (R := L) (S := K) L.subtype) ?_
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (R := L) (S := K) L.subtype) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_injective.eq_iff]
    ext a
    rfl
  specialize H X y
  replace H := congrArg
    (fun z : Over.mk (ξ k K) ⟶ X.toComma ↦ z.left) H
  simp only [Subalgebra.toSubsemiring_subtype,
    IntermediateField.coe_type_toSubalgebra, algEquiv_smul_hom, y, X] at H
  change
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (R := K) (S := K) (g : K →+* K)) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (R := L) (S := K) L.val) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (R := L) (S := K) L.val) at H
  have Hring :
      CommRingCat.ofHom (R := L) (S := K) L.val ≫
          CommRingCat.ofHom (R := K) (S := K) (g : K →+* K) =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (R := L) (S := K) L.val := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    simpa only [Spec.map_comp] using H
  have Hval := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom Hring
    ⟨x, IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self k x⟩
  change g x = x at Hval
  simpa only [AlgEquiv.one_apply] using Hval

proof:

name: Normal.exists_ne_zero_isSplittingField
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_isSplittingField
    (F K : Type*) [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    [Normal F K] [FiniteDimensional F K] :
    ∃ f : Polynomial F, f ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.IsSplittingField F K f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hsplit⟩ := Normal.exists_isSplittingField F K
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, { splits' := ?_, adjoin_rootSet' := ?_ }⟩
    · rw [Polynomial.map_one]
      exact Polynomial.Splits.one
    · simpa only [Polynomial.rootSet_zero, Polynomial.rootSet_one] using
        hsplit.adjoin_rootSet'
  · exact ⟨f, hf, hsplit⟩

name: Valuation.pow_sub_ne_of_one_lt_of_not_pow
statement:
theorem pow_sub_ne_of_one_lt_of_not_pow
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Γ : Type v} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (w : Valuation K Γ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n)
    (a : K) (ha : 1 < w a) (hpow : ∀ y : K, w y ^ n ≠ w a) :
    ∀ x : K, x ^ n - x ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxt : w x ≤ 1
  · have hle : w (x ^ n - x) ≤ 1 :=
      w.map_sub_le (by rw [map_pow]; exact pow_le_one₀ zero_le hxt) hxt
    rw [hx] at hle
    exact (not_le_of_gt ha) hle
  · have hx1 : 1 < w x := lt_of_not_ge hxt
    have hlt : w x < w (x ^ n) := by
      rw [map_pow]
      simpa only [pow_one] using (pow_lt_pow_right₀ hx1 hn)
    have heq := w.map_sub_eq_of_lt_left hlt
    rw [map_pow, hx] at heq
    exact hpow x heq.symm

name: Valuation.pow_sub_ne_of_one_lt_of_log_not_dvd
statement:
theorem pow_sub_ne_of_one_lt_of_log_not_dvd
    {K : Type u} [Field K]
    (w : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n)
    (a : K) (ha : 1 < w a) (hdiv : ¬ (n : ℤ) ∣ WithZero.log (w a)) :
    ∀ x : K, x ^ n - x ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  apply w.pow_sub_ne_of_one_lt_of_not_pow n hn a ha
  intro y hy
  apply hdiv
  have h := congrArg WithZero.log hy
  rw [WithZero.log_pow, nsmul_eq_mul] at h
  exact ⟨WithZero.log (w y), h.symm⟩

name: Valuation.map_apply_eq_of_isEquiv_comap_of_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem map_apply_eq_of_isEquiv_comap_of_pow_eq_one
    (v : Valuation K Γ) (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (hτ : v.IsEquiv (v.comap τ.toRingHom))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hpow : τ ^ n = 1) (x : K) : v (τ x) = v x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · have hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, v ((τ ^ (k + 1)) x) < v ((τ ^ k) x) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simpa only [zero_add, pow_one, pow_zero, RingAut.one_apply] using hlt
      | succ k ih =>
        have h := hτ.lt_iff_lt.mp ih
        change v (τ ((τ ^ (k + 1)) x)) < v (τ ((τ ^ k) x)) at h
        simpa only [pow_succ', RingAut.mul_apply] using h
    have h := strictAnti_nat_of_succ_lt (f := fun k : ℕ => v ((τ ^ k) x)) hstep hn
    simp only [hpow, pow_zero, RingAut.one_apply, lt_self_iff_false] at h
  · have hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, v ((τ ^ k) x) < v ((τ ^ (k + 1)) x) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simpa only [zero_add, pow_one, pow_zero, RingAut.one_apply] using hgt
      | succ k ih =>
        have h := hτ.lt_iff_lt.mp ih
        change v (τ ((τ ^ k) x)) < v (τ ((τ ^ (k + 1)) x)) at h
        simpa only [pow_succ', RingAut.mul_apply] using h
    have h := strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ (f := fun k : ℕ => v ((τ ^ k) x)) hstep hn
    simp only [hpow, pow_zero, RingAut.one_apply, lt_self_iff_false] at h

name: Valuation.map_eq_one_and_sub_one_lt_one_of_prime_pow
statement:
theorem map_eq_one_and_sub_one_lt_one_of_prime_pow
    {K : Type u} {Γ : Type v} [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (s : ℕ) (y : K) (hy : v (y ^ (p ^ s) - 1) < 1) :
    v y = 1 ∧ v (y - 1) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : p ^ s ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero s (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  have hypow : v (y ^ (p ^ s)) = 1 := by
    have hsub : v (y ^ (p ^ s) - 1) < v (1 : K) := by
      rwa [map_one]
    simpa only [map_one] using v.map_eq_of_sub_lt hsub
  have hyval : v y = 1 :=
    (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (zero_le : 0 ≤ v y) hn).mp
      (by simpa only [map_pow] using hypow)
  let a : v.valuationSubring := ⟨y, by change v y ≤ 1; exact hyval.le⟩
  have hmax : a ^ (p ^ s) - 1 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring := by
    apply v.mem_maximalIdeal_iff.mpr
    change v (y ^ (p ^ s) - 1) < 1
    exact hy
  have hrespow : (IsLocalRing.residue v.valuationSubring a) ^ (p ^ s) = 1 := by
    have hz := (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).mpr hmax
    rwa [_root_.map_sub, _root_.map_pow, _root_.map_one, sub_eq_zero] at hz
  have hres : IsLocalRing.residue v.valuationSubring a = 1 := by
    simpa only [pow_one] using
      (ExpChar.pow_prime_pow_mul_eq_one_iff p s 1
        (IsLocalRing.residue v.valuationSubring a)).mp
        (by simpa only [mul_one] using hrespow)
  have hmax' : a - 1 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring := by
    apply (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).mp
    rw [_root_.map_sub, hres, _root_.map_one, sub_self]
  refine ⟨hyval, ?_⟩
  have hlt := v.mem_maximalIdeal_iff.mp hmax'
  change v (y - 1) < 1 at hlt
  exact hlt

name: ValuationTheory.Valuations.rankOneDiscreteValuationSubring_isAdic
statement:
theorem rankOneDiscreteValuationSubring_isAdic
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Gamma : Type v}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Gamma]
    [Valued K Gamma]
    [(Valued.v : Valuation K Gamma).IsRankOneDiscrete] :
    IsAdic
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        (Valued.v : Valuation K Gamma).valuationSubring)
proof:
:= by
  let val := (Valued.v : Valuation K Gamma)
  let : IsTopologicalRing val.valuationSubring :=
    Subring.instIsTopologicalRing val.valuationSubring.toSubring
  rcases Valuation.exists_isUniformizer_of_isCyclic_of_nontrivial val with
    ⟨pi, hpi⟩
  rw [isAdic_iff]
  constructor
  · intro n
    have h_radius_ne :
        val (((pi ^ n : val.valuationSubring) : K)) ≠ 0 := by
      change val ((pi : K) ^ n) ≠ 0
      rw [map_pow]
      exact pow_ne_zero n hpi.val_ne_zero
    have h_restrict_radius_ne :
        val.restrict (((pi ^ n : val.valuationSubring) : K)) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa using h_radius_ne
    have h_open_ball_restrict : IsOpen
        {x : K |
          val.restrict x ≤
            val.restrict (((pi ^ n : val.valuationSubring) : K))} :=
      Valued.isOpen_closedBall K h_restrict_radius_ne
    have h_open_ball : IsOpen
        {x : K |
          val x ≤ val (((pi ^ n : val.valuationSubring) : K))} := by
      simpa only [val.restrict_le_iff] using h_open_ball_restrict
    have h_preimage_open : IsOpen
        {x : val.valuationSubring |
          val (x : K) ≤ val (((pi ^ n : val.valuationSubring) : K))} :=
      h_open_ball.preimage continuous_subtype_val
    convert h_preimage_open using 1
    ext x
    exact
      (DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_valuation_le_uniformizer_pow
          (val := val) (pi := pi) hpi n)
  · intro s hs
    rcases
        (mem_nhds_subtype (val.valuationSubring : Set K)
          (0 : val.valuationSubring) s).1 hs with
      ⟨t, ht, hts⟩
    rcases (Valued.hasBasis_nhds_zero K Gamma).mem_iff.mp ht with
      ⟨gamma, _hgamma, hgamma_t⟩
    have : MulArchimedean val.ValueGroup₀ :=
      (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt val).symm.mulArchimedean
    have hpi_restrict : val.restrict (pi : K) < 1 :=
      val.restrict_lt_one_iff.mpr hpi.val_lt_one
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt₀ hpi_restrict gamma
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    apply hts
    apply hgamma_t
    change val.restrict (x : K) < gamma.1
    have hx_le :=
      (DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_pow_iff_valuation_le_uniformizer_pow
        (val := val) (pi := pi) hpi n).mp hx
    calc
      val.restrict (x : K) ≤ val.restrict (((pi ^ n : val.valuationSubring) : K)) :=
        val.restrict_le_iff.mpr hx_le
      _ = val.restrict (pi : K) ^ n := map_pow val.restrict (pi : K) n
      _ < gamma.1 := hn

name: ValuationTheory.Valuations.rankOneDiscreteValuationSubring_isAdicComplete
statement:
theorem rankOneDiscreteValuationSubring_isAdicComplete
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Gamma : Type v}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Gamma]
    [Valued K Gamma]
    [(Valued.v : Valuation K Gamma).IsRankOneDiscrete]
    [CompleteSpace K] :
    IsAdicComplete
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        (Valued.v : Valuation K Gamma).valuationSubring)

name: ValuationSubring.principalUnit_eq_one_of_pow_eq_one_of_residue_natCast_ne_zero
statement:
theorem principalUnit_eq_one_of_pow_eq_one_of_residue_natCast_ne_zero
    (A : ValuationSubring K) (x : A.principalUnitGroup)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ≠ 0)
    (hx : x ^ n = 1) : x = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let g : A.principalUnitGroup →* Aˣ :=
    (Units.map (IsLocalRing.residue A).toMonoidHom).ker.subtype.comp
      A.principalUnitGroupEquiv.toMonoidHom
  let a : A := (g x : A)
  have hred : IsLocalRing.residue A a = 1 :=
    congrArg (fun z : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)ˣ =>
      (z : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) (A.principalUnitGroupEquiv x).property
  have hpow : a ^ n = 1 := by
    have hgpow : (g x) ^ n = 1 := by rw [← map_pow, hx, map_one]
    exact congrArg (fun z : Aˣ => (z : A)) hgpow
  let S : A := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a ^ i
  have hSred : IsLocalRing.residue A S = (n : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) := by
    change IsLocalRing.residue A (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a ^ i) = _
    rw [map_sum]
    calc
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, IsLocalRing.residue A (a ^ i) =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (1 : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        rw [map_pow, hred, one_pow]
      _ = (n : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hSne : S ≠ 0 := by
    intro hS
    apply hn
    rw [hS, map_zero] at hSred
    exact hSred.symm
  have hprod : S * (a - 1) = 0 := by
    change (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a ^ i) * (a - 1) = 0
    rw [geom_sum_mul, hpow, sub_self]
  have ha : a = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left hSne)
  apply A.principalUnitGroupEquiv.injective
  rw [map_one]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Units.ext
  exact ha

name: ValuationSubring.isAlgClosed_residueField
statement:
theorem isAlgClosed_residueField
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (A : ValuationSubring Ω) :
    IsAlgClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsAlgClosed.of_exists_root
  intro p hp hirr
  have hlifts : p ∈ Polynomial.lifts (IsLocalRing.residue A) :=
    Polynomial.mem_lifts_of_surjective IsLocalRing.residue_surjective p
  obtain ⟨q, hqmap, hqdegree, hqmonic⟩ :=
    Polynomial.lifts_and_degree_eq_and_monic hlifts hp
  have hqdegree_ne_zero : q.degree ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hqdegree]
    exact ne_of_gt (Polynomial.degree_pos_of_irreducible hirr)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A Ω) := by
    intro a b hab
    exact Subtype.ext hab
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_aeval_eq_zero_of_injective
    Ω hinj q hqdegree_ne_zero
  have hxintegral : IsIntegral A x := ⟨q, hqmonic, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
    IsIntegrallyClosed.algebraMap_eq_of_integral (R := A) (K := Ω) hxintegral
  have hqa : q.eval a = 0 := by
    apply hinj
    rw [map_zero, ← Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval, ha]
    exact hx
  refine ⟨IsLocalRing.residue A a, ?_⟩
  rw [← hqmap, Polynomial.eval_map_apply, hqa, map_zero]

name: Valuation.linearIndependent_lifts_residue
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_lifts_residue {ι : Type*}
    (b : ι → w.valuationSubring)
    (hb : LinearIndependent (ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
      (fun i => residue w.valuationSubring (b i))) :
    LinearIndependent K (fun i => (b i : L))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply linearIndependent_iff'.2
  intro s g hg i hi
  by_contra hgi
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hmax⟩ := s.exists_max_image (fun i => v (g i)) ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hgj : g j ≠ 0 := by
    intro hj0
    have h := hmax i hi
    rw [hj0, map_zero, le_zero_iff] at h
    exact hgi (v.zero_iff.1 h)
  let c : s → v.valuationSubring := fun i =>
    ⟨g i / g j, by
      change v (g i / g j) ≤ 1
      rw [map_div₀, div_le_one₀ ((v.pos_iff).2 hgj)]
      exact hmax i i.2⟩
  have hsum : ∑ i : s, algebraMap v.valuationSubring w.valuationSubring (c i) * b i = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change w.valuationSubring.subtype (∑ i : s,
      algebraMap v.valuationSubring w.valuationSubring (c i) * b i) =
      w.valuationSubring.subtype 0
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero]
    change ∑ i : s, algebraMap K L (g i / g j) * (b i : L) = 0
    calc
      _ = (algebraMap K L (g j))⁻¹ * ∑ i : s, g i • (b i : L) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [map_div₀, Algebra.smul_def]
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_comm (algebraMap K L (g i))
          ((algebraMap K L (g j))⁻¹)]
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort s (fun i => g i • (b i : L)), hg, mul_zero]
  have hres : ∑ i : s, residue v.valuationSubring (c i) •
      residue w.valuationSubring (b i) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (residue w.valuationSubring) hsum
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul, map_zero] at h
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def,
      HasExtension.algebraMap_residue_eq_residue_algebraMap] using h
  have hbind : LinearIndependent (ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
      (fun i : s => residue w.valuationSubring (b i)) :=
    hb.comp (fun i : s => (i : ι)) Subtype.val_injective
  have hjres := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hbind
    (fun i => residue v.valuationSubring (c i)) hres ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hcj : c ⟨j, hj⟩ = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact div_self hgj
  rw [hcj, map_one] at hjres
  exact one_ne_zero hjres

name: Valuation.finiteDimensional_residueField
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_residueField [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    FiniteDimensional (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) (ResidueField w.valuationSubring)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace (ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
    (ResidueField w.valuationSubring)
  choose t ht using fun i => (residue_surjective (R := w.valuationSubring)) (b i)
  have hind : LinearIndependent (ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
      (fun i => residue w.valuationSubring (t i)) := by
    simpa only [ht] using b.linearIndependent
  have : Finite (Module.Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex (ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
      (ResidueField w.valuationSubring)) := (linearIndependent_lifts_residue v w t hind).finite
  exact b.finiteDimensional_of_finite

name: ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_comap_iff
statement:
theorem mem_nonunits_comap_iff (A : ValuationSubring L) (f : K →+* L) (x : K) :
    x ∈ (A.comap f).nonunits ↔ f x ∈ A.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_nonunits_iff_or, mem_nonunits_iff_or]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | hx)
    · exact Or.inl (map_zero f)
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa only [map_inv₀, mem_comap] using hx)
  · rintro (hx | hx)
    · exact Or.inl (f.injective (hx.trans (map_zero f).symm))
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa only [map_inv₀, mem_comap] using hx)

name: ValuationSubring.charZero_residueField_comap
statement:
theorem charZero_residueField_comap (A : ValuationSubring L) (f : K →+* L)
    [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)] :
    CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (A.comap f))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro m n hmn
  have hres : IsLocalRing.residue (A.comap f) (m : A.comap f) =
      IsLocalRing.residue (A.comap f) (n : A.comap f) := by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hmn
  have hmax : (m : A.comap f) - (n : A.comap f) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A.comap f) :=
    (ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ResidueField.residue_eq_residue_iff_sub_mem_maximalIdeal
        (m : A.comap f) (n : A.comap f)).mp hres
  have hnonunit : (m : K) - (n : K) ∈ (A.comap f).nonunits :=
    (A.comap f).coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mpr hmax
  have hnonunit' : f ((m : K) - (n : K)) ∈ A.nonunits :=
    (mem_nonunits_comap_iff A f ((m : K) - (n : K))).mp hnonunit
  rw [map_sub, map_natCast, map_natCast] at hnonunit'
  have hmax' : (m : A) - (n : A) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A :=
    A.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mp hnonunit'
  have hres' : IsLocalRing.residue A (m : A) = IsLocalRing.residue A (n : A) :=
    (ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ResidueField.residue_eq_residue_iff_sub_mem_maximalIdeal
      (m : A) (n : A)).mpr hmax'
  have hcast : (m : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) = (n : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) := by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hres'
  exact Nat.cast_injective hcast

name: ValuationTheory.exists_sq_eq_of_valuation_sub_one_lt_two_sq
statement:
theorem exists_sq_eq_of_valuation_sub_one_lt_two_sq
    {K Γ : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ)
    [HenselianRing v.valuationSubring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)]
    (a : K) (ha : v (a - 1) < v (2 : K) ^ 2) :
    ∃ b : K, b ^ 2 = a
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : 0 < v (2 : K) := lt_of_le_of_ne zero_le
    (Ne.symm ((Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mpr (by norm_num)))
  have hcval : v ((1 - a) / 4) < 1 := by
    rw [v.map_div, v.map_sub_swap, show (4 : K) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, map_pow]
    exact (div_lt_one₀ (pow_pos htwo 2)).mpr ha
  let c : v.valuationSubring := ⟨(1 - a) / 4, hcval.le⟩
  let f : Polynomial v.valuationSubring :=
    Polynomial.X ^ 2 + (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c)
  have hf : f.Monic := by
    apply Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add
    rw [Polynomial.degree_X_add_C]
    norm_num
  have hc : c ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring :=
    (v.mem_maximalIdeal_iff).mpr hcval
  have hroot : f.eval 0 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring := by
    simpa only [f, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_C, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), zero_add] using hc
  have hderiv : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)
      (f.derivative.eval 0)) := by
    norm_num [f, Polynomial.derivative_add, Polynomial.derivative_pow]
  obtain ⟨z, hz, _⟩ := HenselianRing.is_henselian f hf 0 hroot hderiv
  have hzeval : z ^ 2 + (z + c) = 0 := by
    simpa only [f, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_C] using Polynomial.IsRoot.def.mp hz
  have hz' := congrArg ((↑) : v.valuationSubring → K) hzeval
  change (z : K) ^ 2 + ((z : K) + (1 - a) / 4) = 0 at hz'
  refine ⟨1 + 2 * (z : K), ?_⟩
  field_simp at hz'
  linear_combination hz'

name: ValuationTheory.le_exp_neg_one_of_lt_one
statement:
private theorem le_exp_neg_one_of_lt_one
    {x : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)} (hx : x < 1) :
    x ≤ WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : x = 0
  · rw [hzero]
    exact zero_le
  · lift x to Multiplicative ℤ using hzero
    have hx' : x < 1 := WithZero.coe_lt_coe.mp hx
    apply WithZero.coe_le_coe.mpr
    change Multiplicative.toAdd x < 0 at hx'
    change Multiplicative.toAdd x ≤ -1
    omega

name: ValuationTheory.not_isSquare_of_valuation_sub_one_eq_exp_neg_one
statement:
theorem not_isSquare_of_valuation_sub_one_eq_exp_neg_one
    {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (h2 : v (2 : K) < 1)
    {a : K} (ha : v (a - 1) = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ)) :
    ¬ IsSquare a
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hpoly : y * y - 1 = (y - 1) ^ 2 + 2 * (y - 1) := by ring
  by_cases hy : v (y - 1) < 1
  · have hybound := le_exp_neg_one_of_lt_one hy
    have h2bound := le_exp_neg_one_of_lt_one h2
    have hsq : v ((y - 1) ^ 2) ≤ WithZero.exp (-2 : ℤ) := by
      rw [map_pow, pow_two]
      simpa only [← WithZero.exp_add, show (-1 : ℤ) + -1 = -2 by norm_num]
        using mul_le_mul' hybound hybound
    have hmul : v (2 * (y - 1)) ≤ WithZero.exp (-2 : ℤ) := by
      rw [map_mul]
      simpa only [← WithZero.exp_add, show (-1 : ℤ) + -1 = -2 by norm_num]
        using mul_le_mul' h2bound hybound
    have hle := (v.map_add ((y - 1) ^ 2) (2 * (y - 1))).trans (max_le hsq hmul)
    rw [← hpoly, ha] at hle
    have hle' := WithZero.coe_le_coe.mp hle
    change (-1 : ℤ) ≤ -2 at hle'
    omega
  · have hyone : 1 ≤ v (y - 1) := le_of_not_gt hy
    have hpos : 0 < v (y - 1) := zero_lt_one.trans_le hyone
    have hlt : v (2 * (y - 1)) < v ((y - 1) ^ 2) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, pow_two]
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (h2.trans_le hyone) hpos
    have heq : v (y * y - 1) = v (y - 1) * v (y - 1) := by
      rw [hpoly, v.map_add_eq_of_lt_left hlt, map_pow, pow_two]
    have hge : 1 ≤ v (y * y - 1) := by
      rw [heq]
      simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul' hyone hyone
    rw [ha] at hge
    have hge' := WithZero.coe_le_coe.mp hge
    change (0 : ℤ) ≤ -1 at hge'
    omega

name: ValuationTheory.exists_minimal_valuation_squareClass_difference
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_valuation_squareClass_difference
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [HenselianRing v.valuationSubring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)]
    (a : Kˣ) (hns : ¬ IsSquare (a : K)) :
    ∃ c : Kˣ, v (c : K) = 1 ∧
      ∀ d : Kˣ, v (d : K) = 1 →
        v ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1) ≤ v ((a : K) * (d : K) ^ 2 - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hns' (c : Kˣ) : ¬ IsSquare ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2) := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    apply hns
    refine ⟨y / (c : K), ?_⟩
    field_simp
    linear_combination hy
  have hbound (c : Kˣ) :
      v (2 : K) ^ 2 ≤ v ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1) := by
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hsmall
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_sq_eq_of_valuation_sub_one_lt_two_sq
      v ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2) hsmall
    apply hns' c
    exact ⟨b, by rw [← hb, pow_two]⟩
  have htwo : 0 < v (2 : K) := lt_of_le_of_ne zero_le
    (Ne.symm ((Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mpr (by norm_num)))
  have hne (c : Kˣ) : v ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt ((pow_pos htwo 2).trans_le (hbound c))
  have hlogbound (c : Kˣ) :
      2 * WithZero.log (v (2 : K)) ≤ WithZero.log (v ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1)) := by
    have h := hbound c
    rw [← WithZero.exp_log htwo.ne', pow_two, ← WithZero.exp_add,
      ← WithZero.exp_log (hne c)] at h
    have h' := WithZero.coe_le_coe.mp h
    change WithZero.log (v (2 : K)) + WithZero.log (v (2 : K)) ≤
      WithZero.log (v ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1)) at h'
    omega
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨c, hc, hcn⟩, hn⟩ := Int.exists_least_of_bdd
    (P := fun n => ∃ c : Kˣ, v (c : K) = 1 ∧
      WithZero.log (v ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1)) = n)
    (by
      refine ⟨2 * WithZero.log (v (2 : K)), ?_⟩
      rintro n ⟨c, _hc, rfl⟩
      exact hlogbound c)
    ⟨WithZero.log (v ((a : K) * ((1 : Kˣ) : K) ^ 2 - 1)), 1, v.map_one, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  intro d hd
  have hcd : WithZero.log (v ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1)) ≤
      WithZero.log (v ((a : K) * (d : K) ^ 2 - 1)) := by
    rw [hcn]
    exact hn _ ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
  have hvalues : WithZero.exp (WithZero.log (v ((a : K) * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1))) ≤
      WithZero.exp (WithZero.log (v ((a : K) * (d : K) ^ 2 - 1))) :=
    WithZero.coe_le_coe.mpr hcd
  simpa only [WithZero.exp_log (hne c), WithZero.exp_log (hne d)] using hvalues

name: ValuationTheory.one_sub_natCast_ne_zero_and_padicValInt_lt
statement:
theorem one_sub_natCast_ne_zero_and_padicValInt_lt
    (p a s : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (ha : a < p ^ (s + 1)) (ha1 : a ≠ 1) :
    1 - (a : ℤ) ≠ 0 ∧ padicValInt p (1 - (a : ℤ)) < s + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hne : 1 - (a : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hmodulus : 1 < p ^ (s + 1) :=
    one_lt_pow₀ (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt (Nat.succ_ne_zero s)
  have habs : (1 - (a : ℤ)).natAbs < p ^ (s + 1) := by
    rcases Int.natAbs_eq (1 - (a : ℤ)) with h | h <;> omega
  refine ⟨hne, ?_⟩
  by_contra hnot
  have hle : s + 1 ≤ padicValInt p (1 - (a : ℤ)) := not_lt.mp hnot
  have hdiv : (p : ℤ) ^ (s + 1) ∣ 1 - (a : ℤ) :=
    (padicValInt_dvd_iff (p := p) (s + 1) (1 - (a : ℤ))).mpr (Or.inr hle)
  have habs' : (1 - (a : ℤ)).natAbs < ((p : ℤ) ^ (s + 1)).natAbs := by
    simpa only [Int.natAbs_pow, Int.natAbs_natCast] using habs
  exact hne (Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_natAbs_lt_natAbs hdiv habs')

name: ValuationTheory.valuation_one_add_eq_one_of_one_sub_sq_value
statement:
private theorem valuation_one_add_eq_one_of_one_sub_sq_value
    {K Γ : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ) (b : K) (hb : v b ≤ 1)
    (hval : v (1 - b ^ 2) = 1) : v (1 + b) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hplus : v (1 + b) ≤ 1 := v.map_add_le (le_of_eq v.map_one) hb
  have hminus : v (1 - b) ≤ 1 := v.map_sub_le (le_of_eq v.map_one) hb
  apply le_antisymm hplus
  calc
    1 = v ((1 - b) * (1 + b)) := by
      rw [show (1 - b) * (1 + b) = 1 - b ^ 2 by ring, hval]
    _ = v (1 - b) * v (1 + b) := v.map_mul _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * v (1 + b) := mul_le_mul' hminus le_rfl
    _ = v (1 + b) := one_mul _

name: ValuationTheory.valuation_sub_one_eq_two_sq_of_minimal_squareClass
statement:
theorem valuation_sub_one_eq_two_sq_of_minimal_squareClass
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [HenselianRing v.valuationSubring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)]
    (h2 : v (2 : K) < 1) (a : K) (ha : v a = 1) (hns : ¬ IsSquare a)
    (hmin : ∀ c : Kˣ, v (c : K) = 1 →
      v (a - 1) ≤ v (a * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1))
    (hnorm : IsSquare (1 - a) ∨ IsSquare ((1 - a) / a)) :
    v (a - 1) = v (2 : K) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mp (by rw [ha]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have htwo : 0 < v (2 : K) := lt_of_le_of_ne zero_le
    (Ne.symm ((Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mpr (by norm_num)))
  have hbound : v (2 : K) ^ 2 ≤ v (a - 1) := by
