    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hsmall
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_sq_eq_of_valuation_sub_one_lt_two_sq v a hsmall
    exact hns ⟨b, by rw [← hb, pow_two]⟩
  have hle : v (a - 1) ≤ 1 := v.map_sub_le ha.le v.map_one.le
  by_contra hne
  have hbig : v (2 : K) ^ 2 < v (a - 1) := lt_of_le_of_ne hbound (fun h => hne h.symm)
  have hbetter (b : K) (hb : v b ^ 2 = v (a - 1)) :
      v (2 : K) * v b < v (a - 1) := by
    have hb2 : v (2 : K) < v b :=
      (pow_lt_pow_iff_left₀ zero_le zero_le (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)).mp
        (by simpa only [hb] using hbig)
    rw [← hb, pow_two]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hb2 (htwo.trans hb2)
  rcases hnorm with ⟨b, hb⟩ | ⟨b, hb⟩
  · rw [← pow_two] at hb
    have hbval : v b ^ 2 = v (a - 1) := by
      rw [← map_pow, ← hb, v.map_sub_swap]
    have hbone : v b ≤ 1 :=
      (pow_le_one_iff_of_nonneg zero_le (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)).mp (hbval.trans_le hle)
    have hminus : v (1 - b ^ 2) = 1 := by rw [← hb, sub_sub_cancel, ha]
    have hcval := valuation_one_add_eq_one_of_one_sub_sq_value v b hbone hminus
    have hc0 : 1 + b ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mp
      (by rw [hcval]; exact one_ne_zero)
    let c : Kˣ := Units.mk0 (1 + b) hc0
    have hcinv : v ((c⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) = 1 := by
      change v ((1 + b)⁻¹) = 1
      rw [map_inv₀, hcval, inv_one]
    have hformula : a * (((c⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K)) ^ 2 - 1 = -(2 * b) / (1 + b) := by
      change a * ((1 + b)⁻¹) ^ 2 - 1 = -(2 * b) / (1 + b)
      have haexpr : a = 1 - b ^ 2 := by linear_combination -hb
      rw [haexpr]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hsmall : v (a * (((c⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K)) ^ 2 - 1) < v (a - 1) := by
      rw [hformula, v.map_div, v.map_neg, v.map_mul, hcval, div_one]
      exact hbetter b hbval
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hmin c⁻¹ hcinv)) hsmall
  · rw [← pow_two] at hb
    have hbval : v b ^ 2 = v (a - 1) := by
      rw [← map_pow, ← hb, v.map_div, ha, div_one, v.map_sub_swap]
    have hbone : v b ≤ 1 :=
      (pow_le_one_iff_of_nonneg zero_le (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)).mp (hbval.trans_le hle)
    have hsum : 1 + b ^ 2 = a⁻¹ := by
      rw [← hb]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hsumval : v (1 + b ^ 2) = 1 := by rw [hsum, map_inv₀, ha, inv_one]
    have hminus : v (1 - b ^ 2) = 1 := by
      rw [show 1 - b ^ 2 = 2 - (1 + b ^ 2) by ring,
        v.map_sub_eq_of_lt_right (by rw [hsumval]; exact h2), hsumval]
    have hcval := valuation_one_add_eq_one_of_one_sub_sq_value v b hbone hminus
    have hc0 : 1 + b ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mp
      (by rw [hcval]; exact one_ne_zero)
    let c : Kˣ := Units.mk0 (1 + b) hc0
    have hformula : a * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1 = 2 * a * b := by
      change a * (1 + b) ^ 2 - 1 = 2 * a * b
      field_simp at hb
      linear_combination -hb
    have hsmall : v (a * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1) < v (a - 1) := by
      rw [hformula, v.map_mul, v.map_mul, ha, mul_one]
      exact hbetter b hbval
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hmin c hcval)) hsmall

name: ValuationTheory.exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses_of_boundary
statement:
theorem exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses_of_boundary
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (h2 : v (2 : K) < 1) (a π : K) (ha : v a = 1)
    (hπ : v π = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ))
    (heq : v (a - 1) = v (2 : K) ^ 2) :
    ∃ x y : K, ¬ IsSquare (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) ∧
      ¬ IsSquare ((x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) / a)
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mp (by rw [ha]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have htwone : v (2 : K) ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mpr (by norm_num)
  have hfour : v (4 : K) = v (2 : K) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : K) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, map_pow]
  let u : K := (a - 1) / 4
  have hu : v u = 1 := by
    change v ((a - 1) / 4) = 1
    rw [v.map_div, hfour, heq, div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 htwone)]
  have haexpr : a = 1 + 4 * u := by
    dsimp only [u]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hπpos : 0 < v π := lt_of_le_of_ne zero_le (Ne.symm (by
    rw [hπ]
    exact WithZero.exp_ne_zero))
  have hπsmall : v π < 1 := by
    rw [hπ]
    exact WithZero.coe_lt_coe.mpr (show (-1 : ℤ) < 0 by decide)
  have hπsq : v π ^ 2 < v π := by
    rw [pow_two]
    calc
      v π * v π < v π * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hπsmall hπpos
      _ = v π := mul_one _
  have htwopi : v (2 : K) ≤ v π := by
    rw [hπ]
    have hdisc {w : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)} (hw0 : w ≠ 0) (hwlt : w < 1) :
        w ≤ WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ) := by
      lift w to Multiplicative ℤ using hw0
      have hz : w < 1 := WithZero.coe_lt_coe.mp hwlt
      apply WithZero.coe_le_coe.mpr
      change Multiplicative.toAdd w < 0 at hz
      change Multiplicative.toAdd w ≤ -1
      omega
    exact hdisc htwone h2
  have h4small : v (4 : K) < v π := by
    rw [hfour]
    exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ zero_le htwopi 2).trans_lt hπsq
  have hupi : v (u * π ^ 2) < v π := by
    rw [v.map_mul, map_pow, hu, one_mul]
    exact hπsq
  have h4u : v (4 * u) < v π := by
    rw [v.map_mul, hu, mul_one]
    exact h4small
  let c : K := 1 + π - u * π ^ 2
  have hc : v (c - 1) = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ) := by
    rw [show c - 1 = π - u * π ^ 2 by dsimp only [c]; ring,
      v.map_sub_eq_of_lt_left hupi, hπ]
  have hca : v (c - a) = v π := by
    have hsmall : v (u * π ^ 2 + 4 * u) < v π := v.map_add_lt hupi h4u
    rw [show c - a = π - (u * π ^ 2 + 4 * u) by dsimp only [c]; rw [haexpr]; ring,
      v.map_sub_eq_of_lt_left hsmall]
  have hcdiv : v (c / a - 1) = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ) := by
    rw [show c / a - 1 = (c - a) / a by field_simp,
      v.map_div, hca, ha, div_one, hπ]
  have hformula : (1 + π / 2) ^ 2 - a * (π / 2) ^ 2 = c := by
    dsimp only [c, u]
    field_simp
    ring
  refine ⟨1 + π / 2, π / 2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hformula]
    exact not_isSquare_of_valuation_sub_one_eq_exp_neg_one v h2 hc
  · rw [hformula]
    exact not_isSquare_of_valuation_sub_one_eq_exp_neg_one v h2 hcdiv

name: ValuationTheory.exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses_of_unit
statement:
theorem exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses_of_unit
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [HenselianRing v.valuationSubring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)]
    (h2 : v (2 : K) < 1) (a π : K) (ha : v a = 1)
    (hπ : v π = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ)) (hns : ¬ IsSquare a) :
    ∃ x y : K, ¬ IsSquare (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) ∧
      ¬ IsSquare ((x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) / a)
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mp (by rw [ha]; exact one_ne_zero)
  let aunit : Kˣ := Units.mk0 a ha0
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hminimal⟩ := exists_minimal_valuation_squareClass_difference v aunit hns
  let a' : K := a * (c : K) ^ 2
  have hc0 : (c : K) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero c
  have ha' : v a' = 1 := by
    dsimp only [a']
    rw [v.map_mul, map_pow, ha, hc, one_pow, mul_one]
  have hns' : ¬ IsSquare a' := by
    intro hs
    apply hns
    have hdiv := hs.div (IsSquare.sq (c : K))
    have hcancel : a' / (c : K) ^ 2 = a := by
      dsimp only [a']
      exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ a (pow_ne_zero 2 hc0)
    exact hcancel ▸ hdiv
  have hmin' (d : Kˣ) (hd : v (d : K) = 1) :
      v (a' - 1) ≤ v (a' * (d : K) ^ 2 - 1) := by
    have hcd : v ((c * d : Kˣ) : K) = 1 := by
      rw [Units.val_mul, v.map_mul, hc, hd, mul_one]
    have hm := hminimal (c * d) hcd
    change v (a * (c : K) ^ 2 - 1) ≤ v (a * ((c : K) * (d : K)) ^ 2 - 1) at hm
    simpa only [mul_pow, mul_assoc, a'] using hm
  by_contra hnone
  have hnorm (x y : K) :
      IsSquare (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) ∨ IsSquare ((x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) / a) := by
    by_cases h : IsSquare (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · right
      by_contra hdiv
      exact hnone ⟨x, y, h, hdiv⟩
  have hnorm' (x y : K) :
      IsSquare (x ^ 2 - a' * y ^ 2) ∨ IsSquare ((x ^ 2 - a' * y ^ 2) / a') := by
    have heq : x ^ 2 - a * ((c : K) * y) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 - a' * y ^ 2 := by
      dsimp only [a']
      ring
    rcases hnorm x ((c : K) * y) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (heq ▸ h)
    · right
      rw [heq] at h
      have hd := h.div (IsSquare.sq (c : K))
      simpa only [div_div, a'] using hd
  have hnorm1 : IsSquare (1 - a') ∨ IsSquare ((1 - a') / a') := by
    simpa only [one_pow, mul_one] using hnorm' 1 1
  have hboundary := valuation_sub_one_eq_two_sq_of_minimal_squareClass
    v h2 a' ha' hns' hmin' hnorm1
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy⟩ := exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses_of_boundary
    v h2 a' π ha' hπ hboundary
  exact (hnorm' x y).elim hx hy

name: ValuationTheory.not_isSquare_of_valuation_eq_exp_odd
statement:
theorem not_isSquare_of_valuation_eq_exp_odd
    {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (a : K) (n : ℤ) (hn : Odd n) (ha : v a = WithZero.exp n) :
    ¬ IsSquare a
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
  have hb : v b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [v.map_mul, hz, zero_mul] at ha
    exact WithZero.exp_ne_zero ha.symm
  rw [v.map_mul, ← WithZero.exp_log hb, ← WithZero.exp_add] at ha
  have hlog := WithZero.exp_inj.mp ha
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hn
  omega

name: ValuationTheory.exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses_of_uniformizer_value
statement:
theorem exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses_of_uniformizer_value
    {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (h2 : v (2 : K) < 1) (a : K) (ha : v a = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ)) :
    ∃ x y : K, ¬ IsSquare (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) ∧
      ¬ IsSquare ((x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) / a)
proof:
:= by
  have ha1 : v a < 1 := by
    rw [ha]
    exact WithZero.coe_lt_coe.mpr (show (-1 : ℤ) < 0 by decide)
  have hdiff : v ((1 - a) - 1) = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ) := by
    rw [show (1 - a) - 1 = -a by ring, v.map_neg, ha]
  have hval : v (1 - a) = 1 := by
    rw [v.map_sub_eq_of_lt_left (by simpa only [v.map_one] using ha1), v.map_one]
  have hdiv : v ((1 - a) / a) = WithZero.exp (1 : ℤ) := by
    rw [v.map_div, hval, ha, one_div, ← WithZero.exp_neg]
    rfl
  refine ⟨1, 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [one_pow, mul_one]
    exact not_isSquare_of_valuation_sub_one_eq_exp_neg_one v h2 hdiff
  · simp only [one_pow, mul_one]
    exact not_isSquare_of_valuation_eq_exp_odd v ((1 - a) / a) 1 (by decide) hdiv

name: ValuationTheory.exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses
statement:
theorem exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [HenselianRing v.valuationSubring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)]
    (h2 : v (2 : K) < 1) (a π : K)
    (hπ : v π = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ)) (hns : ¬ IsSquare a) :
    ∃ x y : K, ¬ IsSquare (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) ∧
      ¬ IsSquare ((x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) / a)
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hns
    rw [hz]
    exact ⟨0, (zero_mul 0).symm⟩
  have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mp (by rw [hπ]; exact WithZero.exp_ne_zero)
  let k : ℤ := WithZero.log (v a)
  let n : ℤ := (k + 1) / 2
  let c : K := π ^ n
  let a' : K := a * c ^ 2
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero n hπ0
  have hc : v c = WithZero.exp (-n) := by
    dsimp only [c]
    rw [map_zpow₀, hπ, ← WithZero.exp_zsmul]
    congr 1
    simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, mul_neg, mul_one, Int.cast_id]
  have hak : v a = WithZero.exp k := (WithZero.exp_log ((Valuation.ne_zero_iff v).mpr ha0)).symm
  have ha' : v a' = WithZero.exp (k - 2 * n) := by
    dsimp only [a']
    rw [v.map_mul, map_pow, hak, hc, pow_two, ← WithZero.exp_add, ← WithZero.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hns' : ¬ IsSquare a' := by
    intro hs
    have hdiv := hs.div (IsSquare.sq c)
    have heq : a' / c ^ 2 = a := mul_div_cancel_right₀ a (pow_ne_zero 2 hc0)
    exact hns (heq ▸ hdiv)
  have hnormalized : k - 2 * n = 0 ∨ k - 2 * n = -1 := by
    dsimp only [n]
    omega
  have hnorm : ∃ x y : K, ¬ IsSquare (x ^ 2 - a' * y ^ 2) ∧
      ¬ IsSquare ((x ^ 2 - a' * y ^ 2) / a') := by
    rcases hnormalized with hu | hram
    · apply exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses_of_unit v h2 a' π _ hπ hns'
      rw [ha', hu, WithZero.exp_zero]
    · exact exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses_of_uniformizer_value v h2 a'
        (ha'.trans (congrArg WithZero.exp hram))
  obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy⟩ := hnorm
  have heq : x ^ 2 - a * (c * y) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 - a' * y ^ 2 := by
    dsimp only [a']
    ring
  refine ⟨x, c * y, heq.symm ▸ hx, ?_⟩
  intro hs
  apply hy
  rw [heq] at hs
  have hd := hs.div (IsSquare.sq c)
  simpa only [div_div, a'] using hd

name: Valuation.IsEquiv.isRankOneDiscrete
statement:
theorem IsEquiv.isRankOneDiscrete
    {K Γ Δ : Type*} [Field K]
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Δ]
    {v : Valuation K Γ} {w : Valuation K Δ} (h : v.IsEquiv w)
    [v.IsRankOneDiscrete] : w.IsRankOneDiscrete
proof:
:= by
  let e : v.valueGroup ≃* w.valueGroup :=
    WithZero.unitsWithZeroEquiv.symm.trans
      ((Units.mapEquiv h.orderMonoidIso.toMulEquiv).trans WithZero.unitsWithZeroEquiv)
  have : w.IsNontrivial := h.isNontrivial_iff.mp inferInstance
  have : IsCyclic w.valueGroup := isCyclic_of_surjective e.toMonoidHom e.surjective
  exact IsRankOneDiscrete.mk' w

name: FieldTheory.exists_discreteValuationSubring_prime_nonunit_of_fg
statement:
theorem exists_discreteValuationSubring_prime_nonunit_of_fg
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K] (hfg : Field.FG K) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ ∃ V : ValuationSubring K,
      IsDiscreteValuationRing V ∧ (p : K) ∈ V.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hAfinite, hAfrac⟩ := exists_finiteType_int_model K hfg
  have : Algebra.FiniteType ℤ A := hAfinite
  have : IsFractionRing A K := hAfrac
  have : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing ℤ A
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal A
  have : m.IsMaximal := hm
  let : Field (A ⧸ m) := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  have hQuotFinite : Algebra.FiniteType ℤ (A ⧸ m) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℤ m) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let p := ringChar (A ⧸ m)
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ringChar_ne_zero_of_finiteType_int (A ⧸ m) (hfin := hQuotFinite)
  have hp : p.Prime := (CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero (A ⧸ m) p).resolve_right hp0
  have hpA : (p : A) ∈ m := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    rw [map_natCast]
    exact CharP.cast_eq_zero (A ⧸ m) p
  let B := Localization.subalgebra.ofField K m.primeCompl m.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  have : IsLocalRing B := IsLocalization.AtPrime.isLocalRing B m
  have : IsNoetherianRing B :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing m.primeCompl B inferInstance
  have : IsFractionRing B K :=
    IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isDomain_of_isLocalization m.primeCompl B K
  have hpB : (p : B) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B := by
    have hmem := (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff B m (p : A)).mpr hpA
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hmem
  have hB : ¬ IsField B := by
    intro hfield
    have hbot := IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hfield
    have heq : (p : B) = 0 := by simpa only [hbot, Ideal.mem_bot] using hpB
    exact hp.ne_zero (Nat.cast_eq_zero.mp heq)
  obtain ⟨V, hV, _, hdom⟩ :=
    IsLocalRing.exists_valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing_dominates hB K
  refine ⟨p, hp, V, hV, ?_⟩
  simpa only [map_natCast] using (hdom (p : B)).mp hpB

name: FieldTheory.exists_mixedChar_DVF_of_fg
statement:
theorem exists_mixedChar_DVF_of_fg
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K] (hfg : Field.FG K) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ ∃ D : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.{u, 0} K,
      CharP D.residueField p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, V, hV, hpV⟩ := exists_discreteValuationSubring_prime_nonunit_of_fg K hfg
  have : IsDiscreteValuationRing V := hV
  let D : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.{u, 0} K :=
    { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)
      valuation := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal V).valuation K }
  let e : V ≃+* D.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := V) (K := K)
  have hnunit : ¬ IsUnit (p : V) := by
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal (p : V)).mp (V.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mp hpV)
  have hpD : (p : D.valuationSubring) ∈ D.maximalIdeal := by
    apply (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal (p : D.valuationSubring)).mpr
    intro hu
    apply hnunit
    have huV := hu.map e.symm.toMonoidHom
    change IsUnit (e.symm (p : D.valuationSubring)) at huV
    simpa only [map_natCast] using huV
  refine ⟨p, hp, D, (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero hp).mpr ?_⟩
  have hzero := (D.residue_eq_zero_iff (p : D.valuationSubring)).mpr hpD
  simpa only [map_natCast] using hzero

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.exists_normalized_valuation_with_uniformizer
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_valuation_with_uniformizer
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (base : DVF.{u, v} K) :
    ∃ w : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)),
      w.IsRankOneDiscrete ∧ w.valuationSubring = base.valuation.valuationSubring ∧
        ∃ π : K, w π = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsDiscreteValuationRing base.valuationSubring :=
    base.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  have : IsFractionRing base.valuationSubring K := base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  let w : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) :=
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal base.valuationSubring).valuation K
  refine ⟨w, IsDiscreteValuationRing.isRankOneDiscrete base.valuationSubring K, ?_, ?_⟩
  swap
  · exact IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_exists_uniformizer K
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal base.valuationSubring)
  have hmap : Subring.map (algebraMap base.valuationSubring K) ⊤ =
      w.valuationSubring.toSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.map_algebraMap_eq_valuationSubring
      (A := base.valuationSubring) (K := K)
  apply SetLike.ext
  intro x
  change x ∈ w.valuationSubring.toSubring ↔ x ∈ base.valuation.valuationSubring
  rw [← hmap]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, _hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact y.property
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, trivial, rfl⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.exists_normalized_valuation
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_valuation
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (base : DVF.{u, v} K) :
    ∃ w : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)),
      w.IsRankOneDiscrete ∧ w.valuationSubring = base.valuation.valuationSubring
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hring, _⟩ := base.exists_normalized_valuation_with_uniformizer
  exact ⟨w, hw, hring⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses
statement:
theorem exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) [CharP base.residueField 2]
    (a : K) (ha : ¬ IsSquare a) :
    ∃ x y : K, ¬ IsSquare (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) ∧
      ¬ IsSquare ((x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) / a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, _, hring, π, hπ⟩ := base.toDVF.exists_normalized_valuation_with_uniformizer
  let P : ValuationSubring K → Prop := fun V =>
    HenselianRing V (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)
  have hP : P base.valuation.valuationSubring := base.henselianRing
  have : HenselianRing w.valuationSubring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal w.valuationSubring) :=
    hring.symm ▸ hP
  let C : ValuationSubring K → Prop := fun V => CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) 2
  have hC : C base.valuation.valuationSubring := inferInstance
  have : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField w.valuationSubring) 2 := hring.symm ▸ hC
  exact ValuationTheory.exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses
    w (w.natCast_residueChar_lt_one 2) a π hπ ha

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.normal_cyclotomic_tower
statement:
theorem normal_cyclotomic_tower
    (F K E : Type*) [Field F] [Field K] [Field E]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra F E] [Algebra K E] [IsScalarTower F K E]
    [FiniteDimensional F K] [Normal F K]
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} K E] : Normal F E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hFK⟩ := Normal.exists_ne_zero_isSplittingField F K
  let g : F[X] := X ^ n - 1
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero (NeZero.pos n) (1 : F)
  have hKE : IsSplittingField K E (g.map (algebraMap F K)) := by
    simpa only [g, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X,
      Polynomial.map_one] using
      (IsCyclotomicExtension.isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_one (n := n) (K := K) (L := E))
  have hFE : IsSplittingField F E (f * g) :=
    Polynomial.IsSplittingField.mul (F := F) (K := K) (L := E) f g hf hg
  exact Normal.of_isSplittingField (F := F) (E := E) (f * g)

name: Valuation.exists_natCast_pow_mul_le_one
statement:
theorem exists_natCast_pow_mul_le_one
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (p : ℕ)
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] (b : K) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, v ((p : K) ^ n * b) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [hb, mul_zero, v.map_zero]
    exact zero_le_one
  · have hvb : v b ≠ 0 := v.ne_zero_iff.mpr hb
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt₀ (v.natCast_residueChar_lt_one p)
      (Units.mk0 (v b) hvb)⁻¹
    have hbound : v (p : K) ^ n < (v b)⁻¹ := hn
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [v.map_mul, v.map_pow]
    calc
      v (p : K) ^ n * v b ≤ (v b)⁻¹ * v b :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound.le zero_le
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hvb

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.artinSchreierInversePolynomial_natDegree_le
statement:
private theorem artinSchreierInversePolynomial_natDegree_le
    (π : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n).natDegree ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  refine (natDegree_sub_le (X ^ n + C π * X ^ (n - 1)) (C π)).trans ?_
  apply max_le
  · exact natDegree_add_le_of_degree_le (natDegree_X_pow_le n)
      ((natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le π (n - 1)).trans (Nat.sub_le n 1))
  · rw [natDegree_C]
    exact Nat.zero_le n

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.artinSchreierInversePolynomial_coeff_top
statement:
private theorem artinSchreierInversePolynomial_coeff_top
    (π : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n).coeff n = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hn)
  have hn1 : n ≠ n - 1 :=
    (Nat.sub_lt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hn) Nat.zero_lt_one).ne'
  simp only [artinSchreierInversePolynomial, coeff_sub, coeff_add,
    coeff_X_pow_self, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, ite_eq_right hn1, coeff_C,
    ite_eq_right hn0, add_zero, sub_zero]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.artinSchreierInversePolynomial_monic
statement:
theorem artinSchreierInversePolynomial_monic
    (π : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n).Monic
proof:
:=
  monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one n
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial_natDegree_le π n)
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial_coeff_top π n hn)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.artinSchreierInversePolynomial_natDegree
statement:
theorem artinSchreierInversePolynomial_natDegree [Nontrivial R]
    (π : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n).natDegree = n
proof:
:=
  natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial_natDegree_le π n)
    (by rw [artinSchreierInversePolynomial_coeff_top π n hn]; exact one_ne_zero)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.artinSchreierInversePolynomial_coeff_zero
statement:
private theorem artinSchreierInversePolynomial_coeff_zero
    (π : R) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n).coeff 0 = -π
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : 0 ≠ n := Nat.ne_of_lt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hn)
  have hn1 : 0 ≠ n - 1 := Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hn)
  simp only [artinSchreierInversePolynomial, coeff_sub, coeff_add,
    coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right hn0, coeff_C_mul_X_pow, ite_eq_right hn1,
    coeff_C_zero, zero_add, zero_sub]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.artinSchreierInversePolynomial_isEisensteinAt
statement:
theorem artinSchreierInversePolynomial_isEisensteinAt [IsDomain R]
    (π : R) (hπ : Prime π) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n).IsEisensteinAt
      (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R)).IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hπ.ne_zero).mpr hπ
  refine (artinSchreierInversePolynomial_monic π n hn).isEisensteinAt_of_mem_of_notMem
    hP.ne_top ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi
    rw [artinSchreierInversePolynomial_natDegree π n hn] at hi
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    have h₁ : π ∣ (if i = n - 1 then π else 0) := by
      split_ifs
      · exact dvd_rfl
      · exact dvd_zero π
    have h₂ : π ∣ (if i = 0 then π else 0) := by
      split_ifs
      · exact dvd_rfl
      · exact dvd_zero π
    simpa only [artinSchreierInversePolynomial, coeff_sub, coeff_add,
      coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right (Nat.ne_of_lt hi), zero_add,
      coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C] using dvd_sub h₁ h₂
  · rw [artinSchreierInversePolynomial_coeff_zero π n hn,
      Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, dvd_neg]
    intro hdiv
    have hbad : 2 ≤ 1 :=
      (pow_dvd_pow_iff (a := π) (n := 2) (m := 1)
        hπ.ne_zero hπ.not_isUnit).mp (by simpa only [pow_one] using hdiv)
    exact (by decide : ¬ (2 ≤ 1)) hbad

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.artinSchreierInversePolynomial_irreducible
statement:
theorem artinSchreierInversePolynomial_irreducible [IsDomain R]
    (π : R) (hπ : Prime π) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    Irreducible (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n)
proof:
:= by
  apply (artinSchreierInversePolynomial_isEisensteinAt π hπ n hn).irreducible
    ((Ideal.span_singleton_prime hπ.ne_zero).mpr hπ)
    (artinSchreierInversePolynomial_monic π n hn).isPrimitive
  rw [artinSchreierInversePolynomial_natDegree π n hn]
  exact lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hn

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.artinSchreierInversePolynomial_map_irreducible
statement:
theorem artinSchreierInversePolynomial_map_irreducible
    [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (π : R) (hπ : Prime π) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    Irreducible ((artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n).map (algebraMap R K))
proof:
:=
  (artinSchreierInversePolynomial_monic π n hn).irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map.mp
      (artinSchreierInversePolynomial_irreducible π hπ n hn)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.artinSchreier_eq_of_inversePolynomial_root
statement:
theorem artinSchreier_eq_of_inversePolynomial_root
    {K : Type v} {L : Type w} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (π : K) (hπ : π ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n)
    (β : L) (hβ : aeval β (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n) = 0) :
    (β⁻¹) ^ n - β⁻¹ = algebraMap K L (π⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hπL : algebraMap K L π ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hπ
    exact (algebraMap K L).injective
      (hzero.trans (map_zero (algebraMap K L)).symm)
  have hroot : β ^ n + algebraMap K L π * β ^ (n - 1) = algebraMap K L π := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    simpa only [artinSchreierInversePolynomial, map_sub, map_add,
      map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_C] using hβ
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hn)
  have hn1 : n - 1 ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hn)
  have hβ0 : β ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, zero_pow hn0, zero_pow hn1, mul_zero, add_zero] at hroot
    exact hπL hroot.symm
  have hpred : n - 1 + 1 = n := Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt hn)
  have hcancel : β ^ (n - 1) * (β⁻¹) ^ n = β⁻¹ := by
    calc
      β ^ (n - 1) * (β⁻¹) ^ n =
          β ^ (n - 1) * ((β⁻¹) ^ (n - 1) * β⁻¹) := by
        rw [← pow_succ, hpred]
      _ = β⁻¹ := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hβ0, one_pow, one_mul]
  have hlinear : 1 + algebraMap K L π * β⁻¹ =
      algebraMap K L π * (β⁻¹) ^ n := by
    calc
      1 + algebraMap K L π * β⁻¹ =
          (β ^ n + algebraMap K L π * β ^ (n - 1)) * (β⁻¹) ^ n := by
        rw [add_mul, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hβ0, one_pow,
          mul_assoc, hcancel]
      _ = algebraMap K L π * (β⁻¹) ^ n := by rw [hroot]
  rw [map_inv₀, ← one_div (algebraMap K L π)]
  apply (eq_div_iff hπL).mpr
  calc
    ((β⁻¹) ^ n - β⁻¹) * algebraMap K L π =
        algebraMap K L π * (β⁻¹) ^ n - algebraMap K L π * β⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [← hlinear, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_cyclotomic_intermediateField
statement:
theorem exists_cyclotomic_intermediateField
    (K Ω : Type*) [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω]
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : K)] :
    ∃ E : IntermediateField K Ω, IsCyclotomicExtension {n} K E
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := .of_neZero_natCast K
  have : NeZero (n : Ω) := by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using
      (‹NeZero (n : K)›.of_injective (algebraMap K Ω).injective)
  have : IsAlgClosed Ω := IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed K
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.exists_primitiveRoot Ω n
  exact ⟨IntermediateField.adjoin K {ζ},
    hζ.intermediateField_adjoin_isCyclotomicExtension K⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.mem_adjoin_of_isIntegral_of_minpoly_isEisensteinAt
statement:
theorem mem_adjoin_of_isIntegral_of_minpoly_isEisensteinAt
    (B : PowerBasis K L)
    (hE : (minpoly R B.gen).IsEisensteinAt (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))
    {z : L} (hz : IsIntegral R z) :
    z ∈ Algebra.adjoin R ({B.gen} : Set L)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hB : IsIntegral R B.gen := minpoly.ne_zero_iff.mp (by
    intro hzero
    apply hE.leading
    rw [hzero, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_zero]
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).zero_mem)
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible R
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := B.exists_eq_aeval' z
  let q : R[X] := IsLocalization.integerNormalization R⁰ f
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hq⟩ := IsLocalization.integerNormalization_spec R⁰ f
  have heval : Polynomial.aeval B.gen q = c • z := by
    calc
      Polynomial.aeval B.gen q =
          Polynomial.aeval B.gen (q.map (algebraMap R K)) :=
        Polynomial.aeval_eq_aeval_map
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R K L).symm q B.gen
      _ = Polynomial.aeval B.gen ((algebraMap R K c) • f) :=
        congrArg (Polynomial.aeval B.gen : K[X] →ₐ[K] L)
          (hq.trans (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul K c f).symm)
      _ = (algebraMap R K c) • Polynomial.aeval B.gen f :=
        map_smul (Polynomial.aeval B.gen : K[X] →ₐ[K] L) (algebraMap R K c) f
      _ = c • z := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul, ← hf]
  have hcz : c • z ∈ Algebra.adjoin R ({B.gen} : Set L) := by
    rw [← heval]
    exact Polynomial.aeval_mem_adjoin_singleton R B.gen
  obtain ⟨n, u, hu⟩ :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible
      (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hc) hπ
  have hpow : π ^ n • z ∈ Algebra.adjoin R ({B.gen} : Set L) := by
    have h := (Algebra.adjoin R ({B.gen} : Set L)).smul_mem hcz (↑(u⁻¹) : R)
    rw [hu, ← mul_smul, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul] at h
    exact h
  have hEπ : (minpoly R B.gen).IsEisensteinAt (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R)) := by
    rw [← hπ.maximalIdeal_eq]
    exact hE
  exact mem_adjoin_of_smul_prime_pow_smul_of_minpoly_isEisensteinAt
    (B := B) hπ.prime hB hz hpow hEπ

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.cyclotomicGalois_natCard_dvd_prime_sub_one
statement:
theorem cyclotomicGalois_natCard_dvd_prime_sub_one :
    Nat.card (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ∣ p - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hζ := IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K L
  calc
    Nat.card (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ∣ Nat.card (ZMod p)ˣ :=
      Subgroup.card_dvd_of_injective (hζ.autToPow K)
        (hζ.autToPow_injective K)
    _ = Fintype.card (ZMod p)ˣ := Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
    _ = Nat.totient p := ZMod.card_units_eq_totient p
    _ = p - 1 := Nat.totient_prime (Fact.out : p.Prime)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard
statement:
theorem prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard :
    p.Coprime (Nat.card (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  have hcoprime : p.Coprime (p - 1) :=
    (Nat.coprime_self_sub_right hp.one_le).mpr (Nat.coprime_one_right p)
  exact hcoprime.of_dvd_right
    (cyclotomicGalois_natCard_dvd_prime_sub_one K L p)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.rootsOfUnityReduction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rootsOfUnityReduction_apply (n : ℕ)
    (ζ : rootsOfUnity n F.valuationSubring) :
    ((rootsOfUnityReduction F n ζ : F.residueFieldˣ) : F.residueField) =
      F.residueMap ((ζ : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring)
proof: := rfl

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.rootPolynomial_derivative_isUnit
statement:
private theorem rootPolynomial_derivative_isUnit
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : F.residueField)] (a : F.valuationSubringˣ) :
    IsUnit (((Polynomial.X ^ n - 1 : Polynomial F.valuationSubring).derivative).eval
      (a : F.valuationSubring))
proof:
:= by
  have hn : IsUnit (n : F.valuationSubring) :=
    (F.toDVF.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (n : F.valuationSubring)).mp
      (by simpa only [map_natCast] using (NeZero.ne (n : F.residueField)))
  simpa only [Polynomial.derivative_sub, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow,
    Polynomial.derivative_one, sub_zero, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X] using hn.mul (a.isUnit.pow (n - 1))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.rootsOfUnityReduction_injective
statement:
theorem rootsOfUnityReduction_injective (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : F.residueField)] :
    Function.Injective (rootsOfUnityReduction F n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hres : F.residueMap ((y : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) =
      F.residueMap ((x : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) :=
    congrArg (fun z : rootsOfUnity n F.residueField =>
      ((z : F.residueFieldˣ) : F.residueField)) hxy.symm
  have heq := F.eq_of_isRoot_of_isRoot_of_residue_eq_of_derivative_isUnit
    ((mem_rootsOfUnity_iff_isRoot n (x : F.valuationSubringˣ)).mp x.property)
    ((mem_rootsOfUnity_iff_isRoot n (y : F.valuationSubringˣ)).mp y.property)
    hres (rootPolynomial_derivative_isUnit F n (x : F.valuationSubringˣ))
  exact rootsOfUnity.coe_injective heq.symm

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.rootsOfUnityReduction_surjective
statement:
theorem rootsOfUnityReduction_surjective (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : F.residueField)] :
    Function.Surjective (rootsOfUnityReduction F n)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := .of_neZero_natCast F.residueField
  intro y
  let f : Polynomial F.valuationSubring := Polynomial.X ^ n - 1
  have hf : f.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C 1 (NeZero.ne n)
  have hroot : (f.map F.residueMap).eval ((y : F.residueFieldˣ) : F.residueField) = 0 := by
    simpa only [f, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X,
      Polynomial.map_one, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_one, sub_eq_zero] using
      (mem_rootsOfUnity' n (y : F.residueFieldˣ)).mp y.property
  have hsimple : ((f.map F.residueMap).derivative).eval
      ((y : F.residueFieldˣ) : F.residueField) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [f, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X,
      Polynomial.map_one, Polynomial.derivative_sub, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow,
      Polynomial.derivative_one, sub_zero, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X] using
      mul_ne_zero (NeZero.ne (n : F.residueField))
        (pow_ne_zero (n - 1) (y : F.residueFieldˣ).ne_zero)
  obtain ⟨a, _q, haroot, hares, _⟩ :=
    F.exists_monic_linear_factor_lift_of_reduced_simple_root
      f hf ((y : F.residueFieldˣ) : F.residueField) hroot hsimple
  have hapow : a ^ n = 1 := by
    simpa only [f, Polynomial.IsRoot.def, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_one, sub_eq_zero] using haroot
  refine ⟨rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq a hapow, ?_⟩
  apply rootsOfUnity.coe_injective
  exact hares

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.rootsOfUnityReduction_bijective
statement:
theorem rootsOfUnityReduction_bijective (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : F.residueField)] :
    Function.Bijective (rootsOfUnityReduction F n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨rootsOfUnityReduction_injective F n, rootsOfUnityReduction_surjective F n⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.rootsOfUnityReductionEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rootsOfUnityReductionEquiv_apply (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : F.residueField)]
    (ζ : rootsOfUnity n F.valuationSubring) :
    rootsOfUnityReductionEquiv F n ζ = rootsOfUnityReduction F n ζ
proof: := rfl

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.rootsOfUnity_toField_bijective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply rootsOfUnity.coe_injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : rootsOfUnity n K => ((z : Kˣ) : K)) hxy
  · intro ζ
    have hpow : ((ζ : Kˣ) : K) ^ n = 1 :=
      (mem_rootsOfUnity' n (ζ : Kˣ)).mp ζ.property
    have hvalpow : D.valuation ((ζ : Kˣ) : K) ^ n = 1 := by
      rw [← map_pow, hpow, map_one]
    have hval : D.valuation ((ζ : Kˣ) : K) = 1 :=
      (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg zero_le (NeZero.ne n)).mp hvalpow
    let a : D.valuationSubring := ⟨((ζ : Kˣ) : K), hval.le⟩
    have hapow : a ^ n = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hpow
    refine ⟨rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq a hapow, ?_⟩
    apply rootsOfUnity.coe_injective
    rfl

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.fieldRootsOfUnityReductionEquiv_toField
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldRootsOfUnityReductionEquiv_toField
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : F.residueField)] (ζ : rootsOfUnity n F.valuationSubring) :
    fieldRootsOfUnityReductionEquiv F n
        (restrictRootsOfUnity (algebraMap F.valuationSubring K) n ζ) =
      rootsOfUnityReduction F n ζ
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := .of_neZero_natCast F.residueField
  change rootsOfUnityReductionEquiv F n
    ((rootsOfUnityFieldEquiv F.toDVF n).symm ((rootsOfUnityFieldEquiv F.toDVF n) ζ)) = _
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: Valuation.natCast_residueChar_lt_one
statement:
theorem natCast_residueChar_lt_one
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (p : ℕ)
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    v (p : K) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hres : IsLocalRing.residue v.valuationSubring (p : v.valuationSubring) = 0 := by
    rw [map_natCast, CharP.cast_eq_zero]
  have hmem := (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff (p : v.valuationSubring)).mp hres
  have hlt := (Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_iff (v := v)).mp hmem
  exact_mod_cast hlt

name: Valuation.log_natCast_residueChar_neg
statement:
theorem log_natCast_residueChar_neg [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    WithZero.log (v (p : K)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : v (p : K) ≠ 0 :=
    (v.ne_zero_iff).mpr (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero)
  have hlt := (WithZero.log_lt_log hne one_ne_zero).mpr (v.natCast_residueChar_lt_one p)
  simpa only [WithZero.log_one] using hlt

name: Valuation.residueRamificationIndex_intCast
statement:
theorem residueRamificationIndex_intCast [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) = -WithZero.log (v (p : K))
proof:
:=
  Int.toNat_of_nonneg (neg_pos.mpr (v.log_natCast_residueChar_neg p)).le

name: Valuation.residueRamificationIndex_pos
statement:
theorem residueRamificationIndex_pos [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    0 < v.residueRamificationIndex p
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : (0 : ℤ) < (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) := by
    rw [v.residueRamificationIndex_intCast p]
    exact neg_pos.mpr (v.log_natCast_residueChar_neg p)
  exact_mod_cast hpos

name: Valuation.natCast_residueChar_eq_exp_neg
statement:
theorem natCast_residueChar_eq_exp_neg [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    v (p : K) = WithZero.exp (-(v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [v.residueRamificationIndex_intCast p, neg_neg]
  exact (WithZero.exp_log
    ((v.ne_zero_iff).mpr (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero))).symm

name: Valuation.natCast_eq_exp_neg_ramificationIndex_mul_padicValNat
statement:
theorem natCast_eq_exp_neg_ramificationIndex_mul_padicValNat [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    v (n : K) =
      WithZero.exp (-((v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) * (padicValNat p n : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [v.natCast_eq_pow_padicValNat p n hn, v.natCast_residueChar_eq_exp_neg p,
    ← WithZero.exp_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_neg, mul_comm]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.exists_cyclic_kummer_extension_residueMap_surjective
statement:
theorem HenselianDVF.exists_cyclic_kummer_extension_residueMap_surjective
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K)
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ r) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L)
      (_ : FiniteDimensional K L) (target : HenselianDVF.{u, 0} L)
      (_ : base.toDVF.valuation.HasExtension target.toDVF.valuation),
      Module.finrank K L = r ∧ IsGalois K L ∧ IsCyclic (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ∧
      Function.Surjective (ValuedExtension.residueMap base.toDVF target.toDVF)
proof:
:= by
  let R : Type u := base.valuationSubring
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing R := base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  let : IsFractionRing R K := base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible R
  obtain ⟨L, _, _, scalarAlgebra, scalarTower, B, hdegree, hpower,
      hminpolyK, hminpolyRExisting, hGalois, hcyclic⟩ :=
    exists_cyclic_kummer_extension_of_prime_parameter R K π hπ.prime r ζ hζ
  clear hpower hminpolyRExisting scalarTower scalarAlgebra
  let : FiniteDimensional K L := B.finite
  let : IsGalois K L := hGalois
  let target : HenselianDVF.{u, 0} L :=
    FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF base
  let : base.toDVF.valuation.HasExtension target.toDVF.valuation :=
    FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF_hasExtension base
  let f : R[X] := X ^ r - C π
  have hfmap : f.map (algebraMap R K) = minpoly K B.gen := by
    rw [hminpolyK]
    simp only [f, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, map_X, map_C]
  have hrootK : aeval B.gen (f.map (algebraMap R K)) = 0 := by
    rw [hfmap]
    exact minpoly.aeval K B.gen
  have hrootR : aeval B.gen f = 0 :=
    (Polynomial.aeval_eq_aeval_map (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R K L).symm
      f B.gen).trans hrootK
  have hintegral : IsIntegral R B.gen :=
    ⟨f, monic_X_pow_sub_C π (Fact.out : r.Prime).ne_zero, hrootR⟩
  have hminpolyR : minpoly R B.gen = f := by
    apply Polynomial.map_injective (algebraMap R K) (IsFractionRing.injective R K)
    rw [← minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' K hintegral]
    exact hfmap.symm
  have hEisenstein : (minpoly base.valuationSubring B.gen).IsEisensteinAt
      base.maximalIdeal := by
    change (minpoly R B.gen).IsEisensteinAt (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    rw [hminpolyR, hπ.maximalIdeal_eq]
    exact X_pow_sub_C_isEisensteinAt_of_prime_parameter π hπ.prime r
      (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos
  have hresidue : Function.Surjective
      (ValuedExtension.residueMap base.toDVF target.toDVF) :=
    residueMap_surjective_of_minpoly_isEisensteinAt base target.toDVF B hEisenstein
  exact ⟨L, inferInstance, inferInstance, B.finite, target, inferInstance,
    hdegree, hGalois, hcyclic, hresidue⟩

name: Valuation.one_lt_boundedCyclotomicCoefficient
statement:
theorem one_lt_boundedCyclotomicCoefficient
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (p a s : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (ha : a < p ^ (s + 1)) (ha1 : a ≠ 1) :
    1 < v ((1 - (a : K)) / (p : K) ^ (s + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hz, ht⟩ :=
    ValuationTheory.one_sub_natCast_ne_zero_and_padicValInt_lt p a s ha ha1
  have hp : 0 < v (p : K) :=
    (v.pos_iff).mpr (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero)
  have hnum : v (1 - (a : K)) = v (p : K) ^ padicValInt p (1 - (a : ℤ)) := by
    simpa only [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast] using
      v.intCast_eq_pow_padicValInt p (1 - (a : ℤ)) hz
  rw [v.map_div, v.map_pow, hnum]
  exact (one_lt_div₀ (pow_pos hp (s + 1))).mpr
    (pow_lt_pow_right_of_lt_one₀ hp (v.natCast_residueChar_lt_one p) ht)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.residue_eq_zero_of_weaklyEisenstein_root
statement:
private theorem residue_eq_zero_of_weaklyEisenstein_root
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) (target : DVF.{w, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    (f : base.valuationSubring[X]) (hf : f.Monic)
    (hE : f.IsWeaklyEisensteinAt base.maximalIdeal)
    (a : target.valuationSubring)
    (ha : (f.map (ValuedExtension.integerMap base target)).IsRoot a) :
    target.residueMap a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpow :=
    (hE.map (ValuedExtension.integerMap base target)).pow_natDegree_le_of_root_of_monic_mem
      ha (hf.map (ValuedExtension.integerMap base target))
      (f.map (ValuedExtension.integerMap base target)).natDegree le_rfl
  apply (target.residue_eq_zero_iff a).mpr
  exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal target.valuationSubring).isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem
    (f.map (ValuedExtension.integerMap base target)).natDegree
    (ValuedExtension.maximalIdeal_map_integerMap_le base target hpow)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.residueMap_surjective_of_minpoly_isEisensteinAt
statement:
theorem residueMap_surjective_of_minpoly_isEisensteinAt
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (target : DVF.{w, x} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    (B : PowerBasis K L)
    (hE : (minpoly base.valuationSubring B.gen).IsEisensteinAt base.maximalIdeal) :
    Function.Surjective (ValuedExtension.residueMap base.toDVF target)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := B.finite
  have : IsDiscreteValuationRing base.valuationSubring :=
    base.toDVF.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  have hIC : target.valuation.valuationSubring.toSubring =
      (integralClosure base.valuationSubring L).toSubring := by
    have : base.valuation.valuationSubring.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
      ⟨(_root_.Valuation.isEquiv_valuation_valuationSubring base.valuation).symm.trans
        (_root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_isEquiv_comap
          (vR := base.valuation) (vA := target.valuation))⟩
    exact ValuationTheory.Henselian.valuationSubring_eq_integralClosure_of_henselianRing
      base.valuation.valuationSubring target.valuation
  have hIntegral (z : L) :
      z ∈ target.valuation.valuationSubring ↔ IsIntegral base.valuationSubring z := by
    change z ∈ target.valuation.valuationSubring.toSubring ↔ _
    rw [hIC]
    exact mem_integralClosure_iff base.valuationSubring L
  have hB : IsIntegral base.valuationSubring B.gen := minpoly.ne_zero_iff.mp (by
    intro hzero
    apply hE.leading
    rw [hzero, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_zero]
    exact base.maximalIdeal.zero_mem)
  let a : target.valuationSubring := ⟨B.gen, (hIntegral B.gen).mpr hB⟩
  have hEval (f : base.valuationSubring[X]) :
      (((f.map (ValuedExtension.integerMap base.toDVF target)).eval a :
          target.valuationSubring) : L) =
        Polynomial.aeval B.gen f := by
    change algebraMap target.valuationSubring L
      ((f.map (algebraMap base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring)).eval a) = _
    rw [Polynomial.eval_map_algebraMap]
    exact (Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom base.valuationSubring target.valuationSubring L) a f).symm
  have hroot :
      ((minpoly base.valuationSubring B.gen).map
        (ValuedExtension.integerMap base.toDVF target)).IsRoot a := by
    change ((minpoly base.valuationSubring B.gen).map
      (ValuedExtension.integerMap base.toDVF target)).eval a = 0
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((((minpoly base.valuationSubring B.gen).map
      (ValuedExtension.integerMap base.toDVF target)).eval a : target.valuationSubring) : L) = 0
    rw [hEval]
    exact minpoly.aeval base.valuationSubring B.gen
  have hred : target.residueMap a = 0 :=
    residue_eq_zero_of_weaklyEisenstein_root base.toDVF target
      (minpoly base.valuationSubring B.gen) (minpoly.monic hB)
      hE.isWeaklyEisensteinAt a hroot
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := target.residue_surjective y
  have hz : (z : L) ∈ Algebra.adjoin base.valuationSubring ({B.gen} : Set L) :=
    mem_adjoin_of_isIntegral_of_minpoly_isEisensteinAt B hE
      ((hIntegral (z : L)).mp z.property)
  rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval] at hz
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hz
  have hqEval : (q.map (ValuedExtension.integerMap base.toDVF target)).eval a = z := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hEval]
    exact hq
  refine ⟨base.toDVF.residueMap (q.coeff 0), ?_⟩
  rw [ValuedExtension.residueMap_residue]
  calc
    target.residueMap (ValuedExtension.integerMap base.toDVF target (q.coeff 0)) =
        ((q.map (ValuedExtension.integerMap base.toDVF target)).map target.residueMap).eval
          (target.residueMap a) := by
      rw [hred, ← Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero,
        Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_map]
    _ = target.residueMap ((q.map (ValuedExtension.integerMap base.toDVF target)).eval a) :=
      Polynomial.eval_map_apply target.residueMap a
    _ = target.residueMap z := congrArg target.residueMap hqEval

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.realAbsoluteValue_lt_iff
statement:
theorem realAbsoluteValue_lt_iff (D : DVF K) (x y : K) :
    D.realAbsoluteValue x < D.realAbsoluteValue y ↔ D.valuation x < D.valuation y
proof:
:= by
  change (↑(_root_.Valuation.RankOne.hom D.valuation (D.valuation.restrict x)) : ℝ) <
    ↑(_root_.Valuation.RankOne.hom D.valuation (D.valuation.restrict y)) ↔ _
  rw [NNReal.coe_lt_coe, (_root_.Valuation.RankOne.strictMono D.valuation).lt_iff_lt]
  exact D.valuation.restrict_lt_iff

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.realAbsoluteValue_isNontrivial
statement:
theorem realAbsoluteValue_isNontrivial (D : DVF K) :
    D.realAbsoluteValue.IsNontrivial
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := D.exists_uniformizer
  refine ⟨(π : K), hπ.ne_zero, ?_⟩
  have hlt := (D.realAbsoluteValue_lt_iff (π : K) 1).mpr
    (by rw [map_one]; exact hπ.val_lt_one)
  rw [map_one] at hlt
  exact hlt.ne

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.realAbsoluteValue_isEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem realAbsoluteValue_isEquiv_iff (D E : DVF K) :
    D.realAbsoluteValue.IsEquiv E.realAbsoluteValue ↔ D.valuation.IsEquiv E.valuation
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    exact le_iff_le_iff_lt_iff_lt.mpr
      ((D.realAbsoluteValue_lt_iff y x).symm.trans
        (h.lt_iff_lt.trans (E.realAbsoluteValue_lt_iff y x)))
  · intro h x y
    exact le_iff_le_iff_lt_iff_lt.mpr
      ((D.realAbsoluteValue_lt_iff y x).trans
        (h.lt_iff_lt.trans (E.realAbsoluteValue_lt_iff y x).symm))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.exists_forall_valuation_sub_lt
statement:
theorem exists_forall_valuation_sub_lt {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (D : ι → DVF K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (a b : ι → K) (hb : ∀ i, b i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x : K, ∀ i, (D i).valuation (x - a i) < (D i).valuation (b i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hε : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ι),
      ε ≤ (D i).realAbsoluteValue (b i) := by
    generalize (Finset.univ : Finset ι) = s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨1, zero_lt_one, fun i hi => (Finset.notMem_empty i hi).elim⟩
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      obtain ⟨ε, hpos, hε⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨min ε ((D i).realAbsoluteValue (b i)),
        lt_min hpos ((D i).realAbsoluteValue.pos (hb i)), ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj
      · exact min_le_right _ _
      · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (hε j hj)
  obtain ⟨ε, hpos, hε⟩ := hε
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := LubinTate.Valuations.absoluteValueApproximation
    (fun i => (D i).realAbsoluteValue)
    (fun i => (LubinTate.Valuations.not_trivialAbsoluteValue_iff_isNontrivial _).mpr
      (D i).realAbsoluteValue_isNontrivial)
    (fun i j hij h => hD hij ((realAbsoluteValue_isEquiv_iff (D i) (D j)).mp
      ((LubinTate.Valuations.equivalentAbsoluteValues_iff_isEquiv _ _).mp h))) a hpos
  refine ⟨x, fun i => ((D i).realAbsoluteValue_lt_iff _ _).mp ?_⟩
  exact (hx i).trans_le (hε i (Finset.mem_univ i))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.completeSpace_ofWithZeroValuation
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  let : v.RankOne :=
    _root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.rankOne v (e := 2) (by norm_num)
  let : NormedField K := Valued.toNormedField K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
  have hadic : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring) :=
    Valuations.rankOneDiscreteValuationSubring_isAdic
  have hring : CompleteSpace v.valuationSubring :=
    (hadic.isAdicComplete_iff.mp (isAdicComplete v)).1
  have hcomplete : IsComplete (v.valuationSubring : Set K) := by
    have h := (completeSpace_iff_isComplete_univ (α := v.valuationSubring)).mp hring
    rw [Subtype.isComplete_iff, Set.image_univ, Subtype.range_coe_subtype] at h
    exact h
  apply NormedField.completeSpace_iff_isComplete_closedBall.mpr
  rw [← Valued.toNormedField.setOfPred_mem_integer_eq_closedBall]
  exact hcomplete

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.torsion_le_unitGroup
statement:
private theorem torsion_le_unitGroup (D : DVF.{u, v} K) :
    CommGroup.torsion Kˣ ≤ D.valuation.valuationSubring.unitGroup
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hzn⟩ := hz.exists_pow_eq_one
  apply (_root_.Valuation.mem_unitGroup_iff (v := D.valuation) (x := z)).mpr
  have hpow : D.valuation (z : K) ^ n = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow]
    have hzpow : (z : K) ^ n = 1 :=
      congrArg (fun x : Kˣ => (x : K)) hzn
    rw [hzpow, map_one]
  exact (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg zero_le hn.ne').mp hpow

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.torsionReduction_injective
statement:
theorem torsionReduction_injective [CharZero F.residueField] :
    Function.Injective F.toDVF.torsionReduction
proof:
:= by
  apply F.toDVF.torsionReduction.ker_eq_bot_iff.mp
  apply bot_unique
  intro z hz
  change z = 1
  have hred : F.toDVF.torsionReduction z = 1 := hz
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hzn⟩ := z.property.exists_pow_eq_one
  have : NeZero (n : F.residueField) := ⟨Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne'⟩
  let i : CommGroup.torsion Kˣ →* F.valuation.valuationSubring.unitGroup :=
    Subgroup.inclusion (DVF.torsion_le_unitGroup F.toDVF)
  let g : CommGroup.torsion Kˣ →* F.valuationSubringˣ :=
    F.valuation.valuationSubring.unitGroupMulEquiv.toMonoidHom.comp i
  have hzpow : z ^ n = 1 := Subtype.ext hzn
  have hwpow : (g z) ^ n = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow, hzpow, map_one]
  let ζ : rootsOfUnity n F.valuationSubring :=
    ⟨g z, (mem_rootsOfUnity n (g z)).mpr hwpow⟩
  have hζred : rootsOfUnityReduction F n ζ = rootsOfUnityReduction F n 1 := by
    rw [map_one]
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun x : CommGroup.torsion F.residueFieldˣ =>
      (x : F.residueFieldˣ)) hred
  have hζ : ζ = 1 := rootsOfUnityReduction_injective F n hζred
  have hw : g z = 1 :=
    congrArg (fun x : rootsOfUnity n F.valuationSubring =>
      (x : F.valuationSubringˣ)) hζ
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Units.ext
  exact congrArg (fun x : F.valuationSubringˣ =>
    ((x : F.valuationSubring) : K)) hw

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion [CharZero F.residueField]
    [Finite (CommGroup.torsion F.residueFieldˣ)] :
    Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ)
proof:
:=
  Finite.of_injective F.toDVF.torsionReduction (torsionReduction_injective F)

name: Valuation.natCast_eq_pow_padicValNat
statement:
theorem natCast_eq_pow_padicValNat (v : Valuation K Γ₀)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    v (n : K) = v (p : K) ^ padicValNat p n
proof:
:= by
  let k : ℕ := padicValNat p n
  let a : ℕ := n / p ^ k
  have hfactor : p ^ k * a = n := Nat.mul_div_cancel' pow_padicValNat_dvd
  have ha : ¬ p ∣ a := by
    intro hpa
    apply pow_succ_padicValNat_not_dvd (p := p) hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hpa
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    calc
      n = p ^ k * a := hfactor.symm
      _ = p ^ k * (p * b) := by rw [hb]
      _ = p ^ (k + 1) * b := by rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]
  have haunit : IsUnit (a : v.valuationSubring) := by
    apply (IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (a : v.valuationSubring)).mp
    rw [map_natCast]
    exact (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p a).not.mpr ha
  have haval : v (a : K) = 1 := by
    have h := (Valuation.Integers.isUnit_iff_valuation_eq_one
      (Valuation.valuationSubring.integers (v := v))).mp haunit
    simpa only [map_natCast] using h
  have hcast : (n : K) = (p : K) ^ k * (a : K) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow] using
      congrArg (fun m : ℕ => (m : K)) hfactor.symm
  rw [hcast, v.map_mul, v.map_pow, haval, mul_one]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.valuation_natCast_eq_pow_padicValNat
statement:
theorem valuation_natCast_eq_pow_padicValNat (F : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP F.residueField p]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    F.valuation (n : K) = F.valuation (p : K) ^ padicValNat p n
proof:
:=
  F.valuation.natCast_eq_pow_padicValNat p n hn

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.valuation_algEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem valuation_algEquiv_eq [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (target : DVF.{w, z} L)
    [base.toDVF.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    (f : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : L) : target.valuation (f x) = target.valuation x
proof:
:= by
  let V : ValuationSubring K := base.toDVF.valuation.valuationSubring
  let W : ValuationSubring L := target.valuation.valuationSubring
  have hW : V.valuation.HasExtension W.valuation := by
    apply _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
    ext a
    change W.valuation (algebraMap K L a) ≤ 1 ↔ V.valuation a ≤ 1
    rw [ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff, ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff]
    exact _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_le_one_iff
      base.toDVF.valuation target.valuation a
  have huniq : ∀ W' : ValuationSubring L,
      V.valuation.HasExtension W'.valuation → W' = W := by
    intro W' hW'
    have : V.valuation.HasExtension W.valuation := hW
    have : V.valuation.HasExtension W'.valuation := hW'
    simpa only [ValuationSubring.valuationSubring_valuation] using
      ValuationTheory.Henselian.valuationSubring_eq_of_henselianRing
        V W'.valuation W.valuation
  have hval : W.valuation (f x) = W.valuation x :=
    AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.valuation_algEquiv_eq_of_unique_extension_of_finiteDimensional
      V W hW huniq f x
  exact (_root_.Valuation.isEquiv_valuation_valuationSubring target.valuation).eq_iff.mpr hval

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_nat_shift_pos_not_dvd
statement:
private theorem exists_nat_shift_pos_not_dvd
    (p d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hpd : ¬ p ∣ d) (m : ℤ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < m + (n : ℤ) * d ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ m + (n : ℤ) * d
proof:
:= by
  let n : ℕ := m.natAbs + 1
  have hn : (n : ℤ) = (m.natAbs : ℤ) + 1 := by
    simp only [n, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hm : -(m.natAbs : ℤ) ≤ m := by
    rw [← Int.abs_eq_natAbs]
    exact neg_abs_le m
  have hd' : (1 : ℤ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hnpos : 0 < (n : ℤ) := by omega
  have hpos : 0 < m + (n : ℤ) * d := by nlinarith
  by_cases hdiv : (p : ℤ) ∣ m + (n : ℤ) * d
  · refine ⟨n + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · push_cast
      nlinarith
    · intro hdiv'
      have h : (p : ℤ) ∣ (d : ℤ) := by
        convert dvd_sub hdiv' hdiv using 1
        push_cast
        ring
      exact hpd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp h)
  · exact ⟨n, hpos, hdiv⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.normalized_mul_not_pow_sub
statement:
private theorem normalized_mul_not_pow_sub
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v] (π : K) (hπ : v π = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 < p) (hpd : ¬ p ∣ Module.finrank K L) (a : L) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ b : K, ∀ y : L, y ^ p - y ≠ algebraMap K L b * a
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  let : v.RankOne := _root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.rankOne v (e := 2) (by norm_num)
  let : CompleteSpace K := ValuedExtension.completeSpace_of_completeDiscreteValuation v
  let w := ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L)
    (Γ := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
  have ha0 : w a ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero w).mpr ha
  obtain ⟨n, hnpos, hndiv⟩ := exists_nat_shift_pos_not_dvd p
    (Module.finrank K L) (Module.finrank_pos (R := K) (M := L)) hpd
      (WithZero.log (w a))
  let b : K := (π⁻¹) ^ n
  have hb : v b = WithZero.exp (n : ℤ) := by
    change v ((π⁻¹) ^ n) = _
    rw [map_pow, map_inv₀, hπ, ← WithZero.exp_neg]
    simp only [neg_neg, ← WithZero.exp_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hb0 : w (algebraMap K L b) ≠ 0 := by
    change ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L) (Γ := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
      (algebraMap K L b) ≠ 0
    rw [ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation_algebraMap]
    change v b ^ Module.finrank K L ≠ 0
    rw [hb]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ WithZero.exp_ne_zero
  have hlog : WithZero.log (w (algebraMap K L b * a)) =
      WithZero.log (w a) + (n : ℤ) * Module.finrank K L := by
    rw [map_mul, WithZero.log_mul hb0 ha0]
    change WithZero.log
      (ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L)
        (Γ := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) (algebraMap K L b)) + _ = _
    rw [ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation_algebraMap]
    change WithZero.log (v b ^ Module.finrank K L) + _ = _
    rw [hb, WithZero.log_pow, WithZero.log_exp]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  refine ⟨b, w.pow_sub_ne_of_one_lt_of_log_not_dvd p hp _ ?_ ?_⟩
  · have hnonzero : w (algebraMap K L b * a) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [map_mul]
      exact mul_ne_zero hb0 ha0
    rw [← WithZero.exp_log hnonzero, WithZero.one_lt_exp_iff, hlog]
    exact hnpos
  · rw [hlog]
    exact hndiv

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.exists_mul_not_pow_sub_of_not_dvd_finrank
statement:
theorem CompleteDVF.exists_mul_not_pow_sub_of_not_dvd_finrank
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (base : CompleteDVF K) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (hpd : ¬ p ∣ Module.finrank K L) (a : L) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ b : K, ∀ y : L, y ^ p - y ≠ algebraMap K L b * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hring, π, hπ⟩ :=
    base.toDVF.exists_normalized_valuation_with_uniformizer
  let : v.IsRankOneDiscrete := hv
  have hc : Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v := by
    refine { isRankOneDiscrete := hv, isAdicComplete := ?_ }
    let P : ValuationSubring K → Prop := fun A =>
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    exact hring.symm ▸ (show P base.valuation.valuationSubring from
      Valuation.isAdicComplete base.valuation)
  exact normalized_mul_not_pow_sub v π hπ p hp hpd a ha

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.exists_moved_pow_sub_class_of_not_dvd_finrank
statement:
theorem CompleteDVF.exists_moved_pow_sub_class_of_not_dvd_finrank
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (base : CompleteDVF K) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 < p)
    (hpd : ¬ p ∣ Module.finrank K L) (τ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (hτ : τ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ x : L, ∀ y : L, y ^ p - y ≠ τ x - x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : L, τ x ≠ x := by
    by_contra h
    apply hτ
    ext x
    exact not_not.mp (fun hx => h ⟨x, hx⟩)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := base.exists_mul_not_pow_sub_of_not_dvd_finrank
    p hp hpd (τ x - x) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hx)
  refine ⟨algebraMap K L b * x, ?_⟩
  intro y
  simpa only [map_mul, τ.commutes, mul_sub] using hb y

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.X_pow_sub_C_isEisensteinAt_of_prime_parameter
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_isEisensteinAt_of_prime_parameter
    (π : R) (hπ : Prime π) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (X ^ n - C π).IsEisensteinAt (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R))
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R)).IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hπ.ne_zero).mpr hπ
  refine (monic_X_pow_sub_C π hn.ne').isEisensteinAt_of_mem_of_notMem
    hP.ne_top ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi
    rw [natDegree_X_pow_sub_C] at hi
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    have hdiv : π ∣ (if i = 0 then π else 0) := by
      split_ifs
      · exact dvd_rfl
      · exact dvd_zero π
    simpa only [coeff_sub, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right (Nat.ne_of_lt hi),
      coeff_C, zero_sub, dvd_neg] using hdiv
  · rw [coeff_sub, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right (Nat.ne_of_lt hn),
      coeff_C_zero, zero_sub, Ideal.span_singleton_pow,
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton, dvd_neg]
    intro hdiv
    have hbad : 2 ≤ 1 :=
      (pow_dvd_pow_iff (a := π) (n := 2) (m := 1)
        hπ.ne_zero hπ.not_isUnit).mp (by simpa only [pow_one] using hdiv)
    exact (by decide : ¬ (2 ≤ 1)) hbad

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime_parameter
statement:
theorem X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime_parameter
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (π : R) (hπ : Prime π) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Irreducible (X ^ n - C (algebraMap R K π))
proof:
:= by
  have hmonic : (X ^ n - C π).Monic := monic_X_pow_sub_C π hn.ne'
  have hirr : Irreducible (X ^ n - C π) :=
    (X_pow_sub_C_isEisensteinAt_of_prime_parameter π hπ n hn).irreducible
      ((Ideal.span_singleton_prime hπ.ne_zero).mpr hπ) hmonic.isPrimitive
      (by rw [natDegree_X_pow_sub_C]; exact hn)
  have hmap : Irreducible ((X ^ n - C π).map (algebraMap R K)) :=
    hmonic.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map.mp hirr
  simpa only [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, map_X, map_C] using hmap

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.exists_complete_valuation_of_finite_separable_of_residueChar
statement:
theorem exists_complete_valuation_of_finite_separable_of_residueChar
    {F E : Type*} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
    [FiniteDimensional F E] [Algebra.IsSeparable F E]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF] (n : ℕ)
    [hres : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vF.valuationSubring) n] :
    ∃ vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)),
      Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE ∧ vF.HasExtension vE ∧
        CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) n
proof:
:= by
  let base : CompleteDVF F :=
    { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ), valuation := vF }
  obtain ⟨vE, hcomplete, hext⟩ :=
    exists_normalized_complete_valuation_of_finite_separable (L := E) base
  refine ⟨vE, hcomplete, hext, ?_⟩
  exact (Algebra.charP_iff (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vF.valuationSubring)
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) n).mp hres

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.normAbsoluteValue_complete
statement:
private theorem normAbsoluteValue_complete
    (K : Type u) [NormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] :
    IsCompleteForAbsoluteValue (NormedField.toAbsoluteValue K)
proof:
:= by
  apply (absoluteValueCompleteness_completeSpace_withAbs_iff_complete
    (NormedField.toAbsoluteValue K)).1
  let e : WithAbs (NormedField.toAbsoluteValue K) ≃ᵢ K :=
    { toEquiv := (WithAbs.equiv (NormedField.toAbsoluteValue K)).toEquiv
      isometry_toFun := by
        rw [isometry_iff_dist_eq]
        intro x y
        simp only [dist_eq_norm_sub, WithAbs.norm_eq_apply_ofAbs,
          WithAbs.ofAbs_sub]
        rfl }
  exact e.completeSpace

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.valuation_norm_add_le_max
statement:
theorem valuation_norm_add_le_max (x y : L) :
    (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K Γ) (Algebra.norm K (x + y)) ≤
      max (Valued.v (Algebra.norm K x)) (Valued.v (Algebra.norm K y))
proof:
:= by
  let : NontriviallyNormedField K := Valued.toNontriviallyNormedField K Γ
  let a : AbsoluteValue K ℝ := NormedField.toAbsoluteValue K
  have ha : a.IsNontrivial := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := NormedField.exists_one_lt_norm K
    refine ⟨z, ?_, ne_of_gt hz⟩
    exact norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hz))
  have hn : LubinTate.Valuations.NonarchimedeanAbsoluteValue a :=
    LubinTate.Valuations.nonarchimedean_of_strong_triangle a
      (Valued.isNonarchimedean_norm K Γ)
  have h := finiteNormExtension_finite_normFormulaValue_strong_triangle
    a (normAbsoluteValue_complete K) hn ha x y
  have hd : 0 < 1 / (Module.finrank K L : ℝ) :=
    one_div_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast Module.finrank_pos (R := K) (M := L))
  rw [le_max_iff] at h ⊢
  rcases h with hx | hy
  · left
    apply (Valued.toNormedField.norm_le_iff (L := K) (Γ₀ := Γ)).1
    exact (Real.rpow_le_rpow_iff
      (norm_nonneg (Algebra.norm K (x + y)))
      (norm_nonneg (Algebra.norm K x)) hd).1 hx
  · right
    apply (Valued.toNormedField.norm_le_iff (L := K) (Γ₀ := Γ)).1
    exact (Real.rpow_le_rpow_iff
      (norm_nonneg (Algebra.norm K (x + y)))
      (norm_nonneg (Algebra.norm K y)) hd).1 hy

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation_algebraMap
statement:
theorem finiteNormValuation_algebraMap (x : K) :
    finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L) (Γ := Γ) (algebraMap K L x) =
      (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K Γ) x ^ Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  change Valued.v (Algebra.norm K (algebraMap K L x)) = _
  rw [Algebra.norm_algebraMap, map_pow]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation_hasExtension
statement:
theorem finiteNormValuation_hasExtension :
    (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K Γ).HasExtension
      (finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L) (Γ := Γ))
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
  ext x
  change finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L) (Γ := Γ)
      (algebraMap K L x) ≤ 1 ↔ (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K Γ) x ≤ 1
  rw [finiteNormValuation_algebraMap]
  exact pow_le_one_iff_of_nonneg zero_le
    (Nat.ne_of_gt (Module.finrank_pos (R := K) (M := L)))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation_isNontrivial
statement:
theorem finiteNormValuation_isNontrivial :
    (finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L) (Γ := Γ)).IsNontrivial
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx1⟩ :=
    _root_.Valuation.RankOne.nontrivial (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K Γ)
  refine ⟨⟨algebraMap K L x, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [finiteNormValuation_algebraMap]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ hx0
  · rw [finiteNormValuation_algebraMap]
    exact fun h => hx1 ((pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg zero_le
      (Nat.ne_of_gt (Module.finrank_pos (R := K) (M := L)))).1 h)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation_isRankOneDiscrete
statement:
theorem finiteNormValuation_isRankOneDiscrete
    {K : Type u} {L : Type w} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))]
    [(Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).RankOne]
    [CompleteSpace K] :
    (finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L)
      (Γ := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).IsRankOneDiscrete
proof:
:= by
  let vL : _root_.Valuation L (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) :=
    finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L)
  let : vL.IsNontrivial := finiteNormValuation_isNontrivial
  let : IsCyclic (MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup (.ofClass vL)) :=
    Subgroup.isCyclic_of_le (show
      MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup (.ofClass vL) ≤ ⊤ from le_top)
  exact _root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.mk' vL

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.addVal_prime_eq_totient_nsmul
statement:
theorem addVal_prime_eq_totient_nsmul (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    {ζ : R} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (p : R) =
      Nat.totient (p ^ (n + 1)) • IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (ζ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  have : NeZero (p ^ (n + 1)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero (n + 1) hp.ne_zero⟩
  have hprod : (p : R) = ∏ ξ ∈ primitiveRoots (p ^ (n + 1)) R, (1 - ξ) := by
    rw [← Polynomial.eval_one_cyclotomic_prime_pow n,
      Polynomial.cyclotomic_eq_prod_X_sub_primitiveRoots hζ]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_prod, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_C]
  have hval (s : Finset R) :
      IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (∏ ξ ∈ s, (1 - ξ)) =
        ∑ ξ ∈ s, IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (1 - ξ) := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_empty, IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_one]
    | @insert ξ s hξ ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hξ, IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_mul, ih,
        Finset.sum_insert hξ]
  rw [hprod, hval]
  calc
    ∑ ξ ∈ primitiveRoots (p ^ (n + 1)) R,
        IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (1 - ξ) =
        ∑ ξ ∈ primitiveRoots (p ^ (n + 1)) R,
          IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (ζ - 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro ξ hξ
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hjcop, rfl⟩ :=
        hζ.isPrimitiveRoot_iff.mp (isPrimitiveRoot_of_mem_primitiveRoots hξ)
      rw [AddValuation.map_sub_swap]
      exact (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_eq_iff_associated
        (ζ ^ j - 1) (ζ - 1)).mpr
          (hζ.associated_sub_one_pow_sub_one_of_coprime hjcop).symm
    _ = Nat.totient (p ^ (n + 1)) • IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (ζ - 1) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, hζ.card_primitiveRoots]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primePower_totient_le_addVal
statement:
theorem primePower_totient_le_addVal (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) p]
    {ζ : R} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    (Nat.totient (p ^ (n + 1)) : ℕ∞) ≤ IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (p : R)
proof:
:= by
  have hres : IsLocalRing.residue R ζ = 1 := by
    have hpow : (IsLocalRing.residue R ζ) ^ (p ^ (n + 1) * 1) = 1 := by
      rw [mul_one, ← map_pow, hζ.pow_eq_one, map_one]
    simpa only [pow_one] using
      (ExpChar.pow_prime_pow_mul_eq_one_iff p (n + 1) 1
        (IsLocalRing.residue R ζ)).mp hpow
  have hpos : 1 ≤ IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (ζ - 1) := by
    apply Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hzero
    have hunit : IsUnit (ζ - 1) :=
      IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero
    apply (IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (ζ - 1)).mpr hunit
    rw [map_sub, hres, map_one, sub_self]
  rw [addVal_prime_eq_totient_nsmul p n hζ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (zero_le : (0 : ℕ∞) ≤ Nat.totient (p ^ (n + 1))) hpos

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion_mixedChar
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion_mixedChar
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K] (D : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP D.residueField p]
    [Finite (CommGroup.torsion D.residueFieldˣ)] :
    Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Set.Finite {z : K | ∃ n : ℕ, z ^ (p ^ n) = 1} :=
    D.finite_primePowerRoots p
  have : Finite {z : K | ∃ n : ℕ, z ^ (p ^ n) = 1} := hf.to_subtype
  let i : D.torsionReduction.ker → {z : K | ∃ n : ℕ, z ^ (p ^ n) = 1} :=
    fun z => ⟨(((z : CommGroup.torsion Kˣ) : Kˣ) : K), by
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := D.torsionReduction_ker_isPGroup p z
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      exact congrArg
        (fun a : D.torsionReduction.ker => (((a : CommGroup.torsion Kˣ) : Kˣ) : K)) hn⟩
  have hi : Function.Injective i := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Units.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : {z : K | ∃ n : ℕ, z ^ (p ^ n) = 1} => (z : K)) hab
  have : Finite D.torsionReduction.ker := Finite.of_injective i hi
  exact D.torsionReduction.finite_iff_finite_ker_range.mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion_charP
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion_charP
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (D : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    [Finite (CommGroup.torsion D.residueFieldˣ)] :
    Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  have : CharP D.residueField p :=
    (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : p.Prime)).mpr (by
      rw [← map_natCast D.residueMap p, CharP.cast_eq_zero D.valuationSubring p, map_zero])
  have hinj : Function.Injective D.torsionReduction := by
    apply D.torsionReduction.ker_eq_bot_iff.mp
    apply bot_unique
    intro z hz
    change z = 1
    let zker : D.torsionReduction.ker := ⟨z, hz⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := D.torsionReduction_ker_isPGroup p zker
    have hpow : ((z : Kˣ) : K) ^ (p ^ a) = 1 :=
      congrArg
        (fun b : D.torsionReduction.ker => (((b : CommGroup.torsion Kˣ) : Kˣ) : K)) ha
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Units.ext
    have heq := (ExpChar.pow_prime_pow_mul_eq_one_iff p a 1 (((z : Kˣ) : K))).mp
      (by simpa only [mul_one] using hpow)
    simpa only [pow_one, OneMemClass.coe_one, Units.val_one] using heq
  exact Finite.of_injective D.torsionReduction hinj

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.continuous_ringEquiv_of_preserves
statement:
theorem continuous_ringEquiv_of_preserves
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (f : K ≃+* K) (hval : ∀ x : K, v (f x) = v x) :
    @Continuous K K (Valued.mk' v).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
      (Valued.mk' v).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace f
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_zero f
  rw [(Valued.hasBasis_nhds_zero K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).tendsto_iff
    (Valued.hasBasis_nhds_zero K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))]
  intro γ _
  refine ⟨γ, trivial, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  change v.restrict (f x) < γ.val
  rw [v.restrict_inj.mpr (hval x)]
  exact hx

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.valuation_monic_eval_eq_of_coeff_lt
statement:
private theorem valuation_monic_eval_eq_of_coeff_lt
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Γ : Type v} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (w : _root_.Valuation K Γ) (f : K[X]) (hf : f.Monic)
    (B : Γ) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hcoeff : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1), w (f.coeff i) ≤ B)
    (x : K) (hx : B < w x) : w (f.eval x) = w x ^ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hx1 : 1 < w x := hB.trans_lt hx
  calc
    w (f.eval x) = w (f.coeff f.natDegree * x ^ f.natDegree) := by
      rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range]
      apply w.map_sum_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self _))
      intro i hi
      have hi' : i < f.natDegree := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_singleton] at hi
        omega
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, hf.leadingCoeff, one_mul, map_pow, map_mul, map_pow]
      calc
        w (f.coeff i) * w x ^ i < w x * w x ^ i :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ((hcoeff i (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))).trans_lt hx)
            (pow_pos (zero_lt_one.trans hx1) i)
        _ = w x ^ (i + 1) := (pow_succ' (w x) i).symm
        _ ≤ w x ^ f.natDegree := pow_le_pow_right₀ hx1.le (by omega)
    _ = w x ^ f.natDegree := by
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, hf.leadingCoeff, one_mul, map_pow]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.valuation_eval_le_of_coeff_le
statement:
private theorem valuation_eval_le_of_coeff_le
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Γ : Type v} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (w : _root_.Valuation K Γ) (f : K[X])
    (B : Γ) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hcoeff : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1), w (f.coeff i) ≤ B)
    (x : K) (hx : w x ≤ B) : w (f.eval x) ≤ B ^ (f.natDegree + 1)
proof:
:= by
