  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range]
  apply w.map_sum_le
  intro i hi
  have hi' : i ≤ f.natDegree := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  rw [map_mul, map_pow]
  calc
    w (f.coeff i) * w x ^ i ≤ B * B ^ i := mul_le_mul' (hcoeff i hi) (pow_le_pow_left₀ zero_le hx i)
    _ = B ^ (i + 1) := (pow_succ' B i).symm
    _ ≤ B ^ (f.natDegree + 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hB (Nat.succ_le_succ hi')

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_coefficient_bound
statement:
private theorem exists_coefficient_bound
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (w : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (f : K[X]) :
    ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1),
      w (f.coeff i) ≤ WithZero.exp (M : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let M : ℕ := (Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1)).sup (fun i => (WithZero.log (w (f.coeff i))).natAbs)
  refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  apply WithZero.le_exp_of_log_le
  exact Int.le_natAbs.trans
    (by exact_mod_cast Finset.le_sup (f := fun i => (WithZero.log (w (f.coeff i))).natAbs) hi)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.exists_sequence_sub_not_mem_polynomial_range
statement:
theorem DVF.exists_sequence_sub_not_mem_polynomial_range
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (D : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (f : K[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (hd : 1 < f.natDegree) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → K, ∀ i j : ℕ, i ≠ j → a i - a j ∉ Set.range f.eval
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, _hw, _hring, π, hπ⟩ := D.exists_normalized_valuation_with_uniformizer
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_coefficient_bound w f
  let B : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ) := WithZero.exp (M : ℤ)
  have hB : 1 ≤ B := WithZero.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (Int.natCast_nonneg M)
  let e (n : ℕ) : ℤ := (f.natDegree : ℤ) * ((M : ℤ) * (f.natDegree + 1) + n + 1) + 1
  let a (n : ℕ) : K := π ^ (-e n)
  have ha (n : ℕ) : w (a n) = WithZero.exp (e n) := by
    change w (π ^ (-e n)) = _
    rw [map_zpow₀, hπ, ← WithZero.exp_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    change (-e n) * (-1 : ℤ) = e n
    ring
  have he (n : ℕ) : (M : ℤ) * (f.natDegree + 1) < e n := by
    dsimp only [e]
    have hd' : (1 : ℤ) < f.natDegree := by exact_mod_cast hd
    have hM0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ M := Int.natCast_nonneg M
    have hn0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ n := Int.natCast_nonneg n
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ (M : ℤ) * (f.natDegree + 1) := mul_nonneg hM0 (by omega)
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd'.le ht0
    have hn := mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℤ) ≤ f.natDegree by omega) hn0
    nlinarith
  have hnot (n : ℕ) (x : K) (hx : w x = WithZero.exp (e n)) :
      x ∉ Set.range f.eval := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    change f.eval y = x at hy
    have hlarge : B ^ (f.natDegree + 1) < w (f.eval y) := by
      rw [hy, hx]
      change WithZero.exp (M : ℤ) ^ (f.natDegree + 1) < _
      rw [← WithZero.exp_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, WithZero.exp_lt_exp]
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_comm] using he n
    have hBy : B < w y := by
      by_contra hle
      exact (not_le_of_gt hlarge)
        (valuation_eval_le_of_coeff_le w f B hB hM y (le_of_not_gt hle))
    have hval : w y ^ f.natDegree = WithZero.exp (e n) :=
      (valuation_monic_eval_eq_of_coeff_lt w f hf B hB hM y hBy).symm.trans
        ((congrArg w hy).trans hx)
    have hlog := congrArg WithZero.log hval
    rw [WithZero.log_pow, WithZero.log_exp, nsmul_eq_mul] at hlog
    have hdiv : (f.natDegree : ℤ) ∣ e n := ⟨WithZero.log (w y), hlog.symm⟩
    have hdivone : (f.natDegree : ℤ) ∣ 1 := by
      have hmul : (f.natDegree : ℤ) ∣
          (f.natDegree : ℤ) * ((M : ℤ) * (f.natDegree + 1) + n + 1) := dvd_mul_right _ _
      have hsub := dvd_sub hdiv hmul
      convert hsub using 1
      dsimp only [e]
      ring
    have hnat : f.natDegree ∣ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hdivone
    exact (Nat.not_le_of_lt hd) (Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide : 0 < 1) hnat)
  have hmono : StrictMono (fun n : ℕ => w (a n)) := by
    intro i j hij
    change w (a i) < w (a j)
    rw [ha, ha, WithZero.exp_lt_exp]
    have hd0 : (0 : ℤ) < f.natDegree := by exact_mod_cast lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hd
    have hij' : (i : ℤ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hij
    dsimp only [e]
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  intro i j hij
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hgt
  · exact hnot j (a i - a j) ((w.map_sub_eq_of_lt_right (hmono hlt)).trans (ha j))
  · exact hnot i (a i - a j) ((w.map_sub_eq_of_lt_left (hmono hgt)).trans (ha i))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.infinite_quotient_range_of_monic_polynomial
statement:
theorem DVF.infinite_quotient_range_of_monic_polynomial
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (D : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (f : K[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (hd : 1 < f.natDegree)
    (F : K →+ K) (hF : ∀ x : K, F x = f.eval x) :
    Infinite (K ⧸ F.range)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := D.exists_sequence_sub_not_mem_polynomial_range f hf hd
  apply Infinite.of_injective (fun n : ℕ => QuotientAddGroup.mk' F.range (a n))
  intro i j hij
  by_contra hne
  apply ha i j hne
  have hmem : a i - a j ∈ F.range := QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mp hij
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨x, (hF x).symm.trans hx⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.infinite_artinSchreier_quotient
statement:
theorem DVF.infinite_artinSchreier_quotient
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (D : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] :
    Infinite (K ⧸ ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range)
proof:
:= by
  let f : K[X] := X ^ p - X
  have hdeg : f.natDegree = p := by
    apply (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt ?_).trans
      (Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow p)
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X, Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow]
    exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
  have hf : f.Monic := by
    apply (Polynomial.monic_X.pow p).sub_of_left
    rw [Polynomial.degree_X, Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
    exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
  apply D.infinite_quotient_range_of_monic_polynomial f hf
    (hdeg.symm ▸ (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt)
  intro x
  change x ^ p - x = f.eval x
  rw [show f = X ^ p - X from rfl, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow,
    Polynomial.eval_X]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.root_mem_valuationSubring
statement:
theorem DVF.root_mem_valuationSubring (F : DVF.{u, v} K)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {ζ : K} (hζ : ζ ^ n = 1) :
    ζ ∈ F.valuation.valuationSubring
proof:
:= by
  apply (F.mem_valuationSubring_iff ζ).mpr
  apply le_of_eq
  apply (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (show 0 ≤ F.valuation ζ from zero_le) hn).mp
  rw [← map_pow, hζ, map_one]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primePower_exponent_le_totient
statement:
theorem primePower_exponent_le_totient {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (n : ℕ) :
    n + 1 ≤ Nat.totient (p ^ (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ hp]
  exact (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_pow_self hp.one_lt)).trans
    (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hp.one_lt))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primePower_pow_eq_one_of_exists
statement:
theorem primePower_pow_eq_one_of_exists (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) p]
    {ζ : R} (hζ : ∃ n : ℕ, ζ ^ (p ^ n) = 1) :
    ζ ^ (p ^ (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (p : R)).toNat) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hζ
  obtain ⟨k, _hkn, hk⟩ :=
    (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp).mp (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hn)
  have hprim : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ k) := IsPrimitiveRoot.iff_orderOf.mpr hk
  have hkbound : k ≤ (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (p : R)).toNat := by
    cases k with
    | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
    | succ k =>
      have hfinite : IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (p : R) ≠ ⊤ :=
        fun h => hp.ne_zero (Nat.cast_eq_zero.mp
          (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_eq_top_iff.mp h))
      have hbound := ENat.toNat_le_toNat
        (primePower_totient_le_addVal p k hprim) hfinite
      rw [ENat.toNat_natCast] at hbound
      exact (primePower_exponent_le_totient hp k).trans hbound
  exact (hprim.pow_eq_one_iff_dvd _).mpr (Nat.pow_dvd_pow p hkbound)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.finite_primePowerRoots
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  apply (Polynomial.nthRootsFinset
    (p ^ (IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R (p : R)).toNat) (1 : R)).finite_toSet.subset
  intro ζ hζ
  exact (Polynomial.mem_nthRootsFinset (pow_pos hp.pos _) (1 : R)).mpr
    (primePower_pow_eq_one_of_exists p hζ)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.finite_primePowerRoots
proof:
:= by
  have : IsDiscreteValuationRing F.valuationSubring := F.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  have hfinite := ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.finite_primePowerRoots
    (R := F.valuationSubring) p
  apply (hfinite.image (fun ζ : F.valuationSubring => (ζ : K))).subset
  intro ζ hζ
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hζ
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  let x : F.valuationSubring := ⟨ζ, F.root_mem_valuationSubring (pow_ne_zero n hp.ne_zero) hn⟩
  refine ⟨x, ⟨n, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hn

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.cyclotomic_compositum_adjoin_range_eq_top
statement:
theorem cyclotomic_compositum_adjoin_range_eq_top
    (F K L E : Type*) [Field F] [Field K] [Field L] [Field E]
    [Algebra F L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra L E]
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} F L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} K E] :
    Algebra.adjoin L (Set.range (algebraMap K E)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := IsCyclotomicExtension.exists_isPrimitiveRoot F L
    (Set.mem_singleton n) (NeZero.ne n)
  have hgen : Algebra.adjoin K ({algebraMap L E ζ} : Set E) = ⊤ :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.adjoin_primitive_root_eq_top
      (hζ.map_of_injective (algebraMap L E).injective)
  let S : Subalgebra L E := Algebra.adjoin L (Set.range (algebraMap K E))
  let T : Subalgebra K E :=
    { S.toSubsemiring with
      algebraMap_mem' := fun k => Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨k, rfl⟩ }
  have hT : Algebra.adjoin K ({algebraMap L E ζ} : Set E) ≤ T := by
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    intro x hx
    have hxζ : x = algebraMap L E ζ := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
    rw [hxζ]
    exact S.algebraMap_mem ζ
  rw [hgen] at hT
  apply top_le_iff.mp
  intro x _hx
  exact hT (show x ∈ (⊤ : Subalgebra K E) from trivial)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.finrank_eq_of_coprime_of_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
private theorem finrank_eq_of_coprime_of_adjoin_eq_top
    (F L E : Type*) [Field F] [Field L] [Field E]
    [Algebra F L] [Algebra F E] [Algebra L E] [IsScalarTower F L E]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F L] (A : IntermediateField F E)
    (hcop : (Module.finrank F A).Coprime (Module.finrank F L))
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin L (A : Set E) = ⊤) :
    Module.finrank L E = Module.finrank F A
proof:
:= by
  have hdisjoint : A.LinearDisjoint L :=
    IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.of_finrank_coprime hcop
  have hdim := congrArg Cardinal.toNat
    hdisjoint.adjoin_rank_eq_rank_left_of_isAlgebraic_right
  change Module.finrank L (IntermediateField.adjoin L (A : Set E)) =
    Module.finrank F A at hdim
  have hgen' : IntermediateField.adjoin L (A : Set E) = ⊤ :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin_eq_top_of_algebra L (A : Set E) hgen
  rw [hgen', IntermediateField.finrank_top'] at hdim
  exact hdim

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.cyclotomic_compositum_finrank_eq_prime
statement:
theorem cyclotomic_compositum_finrank_eq_prime
    (F K L E : Type*) [Field F] [Field K] [Field L] [Field E]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra F L] [Algebra F E] [Algebra K E] [Algebra L E]
    [IsScalarTower F K E] [IsScalarTower F L E]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} F L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank F K = p) : Module.finrank L E = p
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional F L := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} F L
  have : IsGalois F L := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {p} F L
  let f : K →ₐ[F] E := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F K E
  let A : IntermediateField F E := f.fieldRange
  have hA : Module.finrank F A = p :=
    f.equivFieldRange.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm.trans hdegree
  have hcop : (Module.finrank F A).Coprime (Module.finrank F L) := by
    rw [hA]
    have hcard := prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard F L p
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank F L] at hcard
    exact hcard
  have hgen : Algebra.adjoin L (A : Set E) = ⊤ := by
    change Algebra.adjoin L (Set.range (algebraMap K E)) = ⊤
    exact cyclotomic_compositum_adjoin_range_eq_top F K L E p
  exact (finrank_eq_of_coprime_of_adjoin_eq_top F L E A hcop hgen).trans hA

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.exists_not_pow_sub
statement:
theorem DVF.exists_not_pow_sub
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (base : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    ∃ a : K, ∀ x : K, x ^ n - x ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  let R := base.valuationSubring
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing R := base.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  let : IsFractionRing R K := base.valuationSubring_isFractionRing
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible R
  let a : K := algebraMap R K π
  have ha : a ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap R K) (IsFractionRing.injective R K)).2 hπ.ne_zero
  refine ⟨a⁻¹, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_pow (by omega : n ≠ 0), sub_self] at hx
    exact (inv_ne_zero ha) hx.symm
  let f : K[X] := (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n).map (algebraMap R K)
  have hf : Irreducible f :=
    artinSchreierInversePolynomial_map_irreducible K π hπ.prime n hn
  apply hf.not_isRoot_of_natDegree_ne_one
    (by
      rw [show f.natDegree = n from
        (natDegree_map_eq_of_injective (IsFractionRing.injective R K)
          (artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n)).trans
          (artinSchreierInversePolynomial_natDegree π n hn)]
      omega) (x := x⁻¹)
  change f.eval (x⁻¹) = 0
  have hn1 : n - 1 + 1 = n := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)
  have hmul : a * (x ^ n - x) = 1 := by rw [hx, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha]
  have hpred : x * (x⁻¹) ^ n = (x⁻¹) ^ (n - 1) := by
    rw [← hn1, pow_succ]
    calc
      x * ((x⁻¹) ^ (n - 1) * x⁻¹) =
          (x * x⁻¹) * (x⁻¹) ^ (n - 1) := by ring
      _ = (x⁻¹) ^ (n - 1) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hx0, one_mul]
  have heq : a - a * (x⁻¹) ^ (n - 1) = (x⁻¹) ^ n := by
    calc
      a - a * (x⁻¹) ^ (n - 1) =
          (a * (x ^ n - x)) * (x⁻¹) ^ n := by
        rw [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx0,
          one_pow, mul_one, mul_assoc, hpred]
      _ = (x⁻¹) ^ n := by rw [hmul, one_mul]
  change ((artinSchreierInversePolynomial π n).map (algebraMap R K)).eval (x⁻¹) = 0
  simp only [artinSchreierInversePolynomial, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_add,
    Polynomial.map_pow, map_X, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, eval_sub, eval_add,
    eval_pow, eval_X, eval_mul, eval_C]
  change (x⁻¹) ^ n + a * (x⁻¹) ^ (n - 1) - a = 0
  rw [← heq]
  ring

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.cyclotomic_compositum_aut_commute
statement:
theorem cyclotomic_compositum_aut_commute
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} F L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} K E]
    (τ : E ≃ₐ[L] E) (δ : E ≃ₐ[K] E) :
    Commute τ.toRingEquiv δ.toRingEquiv
proof:
:= by
  have : Normal F L := (IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {n} F L).to_normal
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := IsCyclotomicExtension.exists_isPrimitiveRoot F L
    (Set.mem_singleton n) (NeZero.ne n)
  have hζE : IsPrimitiveRoot (algebraMap L E ζ) n :=
    hζ.map_of_injective (algebraMap L E).injective
  have hgen : Algebra.adjoin K ({algebraMap L E ζ} : Set E) = ⊤ :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.adjoin_primitive_root_eq_top hζE
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  change τ (δ x) = δ (τ x)
  have hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin K ({algebraMap L E ζ} : Set E) := by
    rw [hgen]
    trivial
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun y _hy => τ (δ y) = δ (τ y))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
  · intro y hy
    have hyζ : y = algebraMap L E ζ := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy
    subst y
    have hδL : algebraMap L E ((δ.restrictScalars F).restrictNormal L ζ) =
        δ (algebraMap L E ζ) :=
      (δ.restrictScalars F).restrictNormal_commutes L ζ
    rw [τ.commutes, ← hδL, τ.commutes]
  · intro k
    have hτK : algebraMap K E ((τ.restrictScalars F).restrictNormal K k) =
        τ (algebraMap K E k) :=
      (τ.restrictScalars F).restrictNormal_commutes K k
    rw [δ.commutes, ← hτK, δ.commutes]
  · intro y z _hy _hz hy hz
    simp only [map_add, hy, hz]
  · intro y z _hy _hz hy hz
    simp only [map_mul, hy, hz]

name: Valuation.intCast_eq_pow_padicValInt
statement:
theorem intCast_eq_pow_padicValInt (v : Valuation K Γ₀)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (z : ℤ) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    v (z : K) = v (p : K) ^ padicValInt p z
proof:
:= by
  have hsign : v (z : K) = v (z.natAbs : K) := by
    rcases Int.natAbs_eq z with h | h
    · simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using congrArg (fun t : ℤ => v (t : K)) h
    · simpa only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, v.map_neg] using
        congrArg (fun t : ℤ => v (t : K)) h
  exact hsign.trans (v.natCast_eq_pow_padicValNat p z.natAbs
    (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hz))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.restrictRestrict_algebraMap
proof:
:=
  (MulSemiringAction.toAlgAut (E ≃ₐ[L] E) F E σ).restrictNormal_commutes K x

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.autToPow_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom
statement:
theorem autToPow_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    {ζ : K} {η : E} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) (hη : IsPrimitiveRoot η n)
    (σ : E ≃ₐ[L] E) :
    hζ.autToPow F (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E σ) =
      hη.autToPow L σ
proof:
:= by
  have hroot : (algebraMap K E ζ) ^ n = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow, hζ.pow_eq_one, map_one]
  obtain ⟨i, -, himage⟩ := hη.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hroot
  have haction : (algebraMap K E ζ) ^ (hη.autToPow L σ : ZMod n).val =
      σ (algebraMap K E ζ) := by
    rw [← himage, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm i, pow_mul,
      hη.autToPow_spec L σ, map_pow]
  apply Units.ext
  apply ZMod.val_injective
  apply hζ.pow_inj (ZMod.val_lt _) (ZMod.val_lt _)
  apply (algebraMap K E).injective
  rw [hζ.autToPow_spec F (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E σ),
    restrictRestrict_algebraMap, map_pow]
  exact haction.symm

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.completeSpace_of_completeDiscreteValuation
statement:
theorem completeSpace_of_completeDiscreteValuation
    {F Γ : Type*} [Field F] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : _root_.Valuation F Γ) [Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v] :
    @CompleteSpace F (Valued.mk' v).toUniformSpace
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued F Γ := Valued.mk' v
  let : v.RankOne := _root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.rankOne v (e := 2) (by norm_num)
  let : NormedField F := Valued.toNormedField F Γ
  let w : _root_.Valuation F ℝ≥0 := NormedField.valuation
  have hring : v.valuationSubring = w.valuationSubring := by
    ext x
    change v x ≤ 1 ↔ ‖x‖₊ ≤ 1
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_one]
    exact (Valued.toNormedField.norm_le_one_iff).symm
  have : w.IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    ((_root_.Valuation.isEquiv_iff_valuationSubring _ _).mpr hring).isRankOneDiscrete
  have hadicComplete : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal w.valuationSubring)
      w.valuationSubring := by
    let P : ValuationSubring F → Prop := fun O => IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O
    exact hring ▸ (show P v.valuationSubring from Valuation.isAdicComplete v)
  let : Valued F ℝ≥0 := NormedField.toValued
  have hadic : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal w.valuationSubring) :=
    Valuations.rankOneDiscreteValuationSubring_isAdic (K := F) (Gamma := ℝ≥0)
  have hcomplete : CompleteSpace w.valuationSubring :=
    (hadic.isAdicComplete_iff.mp hadicComplete).1
  have hset : IsComplete (w.valuationSubring : Set F) := by
    have h := (completeSpace_iff_isComplete_univ (α := w.valuationSubring)).mp hcomplete
    rw [Subtype.isComplete_iff, Set.image_univ, Subtype.range_coe_subtype] at h
    exact h
  apply NormedField.completeSpace_iff_isComplete_closedBall.mpr
  have heq : (w.valuationSubring : Set F) = Metric.closedBall (0 : F) 1 := by
    ext x
    change ‖x‖₊ ≤ 1 ↔ dist x 0 ≤ 1
    rw [dist_zero_right, ← NNReal.coe_le_one]
    rfl
  exact heq ▸ hset

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation_isRankOneDiscrete_general
statement:
theorem finiteNormValuation_isRankOneDiscrete_general
    [(Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K Γ).IsRankOneDiscrete] :
    (finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L) (Γ := Γ)).IsRankOneDiscrete
proof:
:= by
  let vL : _root_.Valuation L Γ := finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L)
  have hle : vL.valueGroup ≤ (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K Γ).valueGroup := by
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
    intro γ hγ
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hγ
    exact MonoidWithZeroHom.mem_valueGroup _ ⟨Algebra.norm K x, hx⟩
  have : IsCyclic vL.valueGroup := Subgroup.isCyclic_of_le hle
  have : vL.IsNontrivial := finiteNormValuation_isNontrivial
  exact _root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.mk' vL

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation_isCompleteDiscrete
statement:
theorem finiteNormValuation_isCompleteDiscrete
    [(Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K Γ).IsRankOneDiscrete] :
    Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete
      (finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L) (Γ := Γ))
proof:
:= by
  let : NontriviallyNormedField K := Valued.toNontriviallyNormedField K Γ
  let a : AbsoluteValue K ℝ := NormedField.toAbsoluteValue K
  have ha : a.IsNontrivial := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := NormedField.exists_one_lt_norm K
    exact ⟨z, norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hz)), ne_of_gt hz⟩
  have hn : LubinTate.Valuations.NonarchimedeanAbsoluteValue a :=
    LubinTate.Valuations.nonarchimedean_of_strong_triangle a
      (Valued.isNonarchimedean_norm K Γ)
  let R := finiteNormExtension_nonarchimedean_finite_extension
    (L := L) a (normAbsoluteValue_complete K) hn ha
  let : NormedField L := AbsoluteValue.toNormedField R.extension
  have : CompleteSpace L := by
    change @CompleteSpace L (AbsoluteValue.toNormedField R.extension).toUniformSpace
    rw [← absoluteValue_uniformSpace_eq_toNormedField]
    exact R.complete_extension
  have : IsUltrametricDist L :=
    IsUltrametricDist.isUltrametricDist_of_forall_norm_add_le_max_norm
      (finiteNormExtension_finite_normFormulaValue_strong_triangle
        a (normAbsoluteValue_complete K) hn ha)
  let val : _root_.Valuation L Γ := finiteNormValuation (K := K) (L := L)
  have : val.IsRankOneDiscrete := finiteNormValuation_isRankOneDiscrete_general
  have heq : val.valuationSubring =
      (NormedField.valuation (K := L)).valuationSubring := by
    ext x
    change val x ≤ 1 ↔ ‖x‖₊ ≤ 1
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_one]
    change Valued.v (Algebra.norm K x) ≤ 1 ↔ R.extension x ≤ 1
    rw [R.norm_formula]
    change Valued.v (Algebra.norm K x) ≤ 1 ↔
      ‖Algebra.norm K x‖ ^ (1 / (Module.finrank K L : ℝ)) ≤ 1
    have hd : 0 < 1 / (Module.finrank K L : ℝ) := one_div_pos.mpr
      (by exact_mod_cast Module.finrank_pos (R := K) (M := L))
    have hr := Real.rpow_le_rpow_iff (norm_nonneg (Algebra.norm K x)) zero_le_one hd
    rw [Real.one_rpow] at hr
    exact (Valued.toNormedField.norm_le_one_iff).symm.trans hr.symm
  have hw : (NormedField.valuation (K := L)).IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    ((_root_.Valuation.isEquiv_iff_valuationSubring _ _).mpr heq).isRankOneDiscrete
  have hcomplete : IsAdicComplete
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (NormedField.valuation (K := L)).valuationSubring)
      (NormedField.valuation (K := L)).valuationSubring := by
    let : Valued L ℝ≥0 := NormedField.toValued
    exact Valuations.rankOneDiscreteValuationSubring_isAdicComplete (K := L) (Gamma := ℝ≥0)
  refine { isRankOneDiscrete := inferInstance, isAdicComplete := ?_ }
  let P : ValuationSubring L → Prop := fun O => IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal O) O
  exact heq.symm ▸ (show P (NormedField.valuation (K := L)).valuationSubring from hcomplete)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.finiteExtension_hasExtension
statement:
theorem finiteExtension_hasExtension (base : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    base.valuation.HasExtension (base.finiteExtension L).valuation
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K base.ValueGroup := Valued.mk' base.valuation
  let : base.valuation.RankOne :=
    _root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.rankOne base.valuation (e := 2) (by norm_num)
  have : CompleteSpace K :=
    ValuedExtension.completeSpace_of_completeDiscreteValuation base.valuation
  exact ValuedExtension.finiteNormValuation_hasExtension

name: AlgebraicCurves.Valuations.Proofs.IsLocalRing_exists_valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing_dominates.DvrDomination.dimensionLEOne_of_ringKrullDim_le_one
statement:
theorem dimensionLEOne_of_ringKrullDim_le_one (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    (h : ringKrullDim C ≤ 1) : Ring.DimensionLEOne C
proof:
:= by
  refine Ring.DimensionLEOne.mk (fun {p} hp0 hp => ?_)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hpm⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal p hp.ne_top
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : p < m := lt_of_le_of_ne hpm (fun h => hnot (h ▸ hm))
  have hbot : (⊥ : Ideal C) < p := bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr hp0
  have := hm.isPrime
  have h1 : (⊥ : Ideal C).height + 1 ≤ p.height := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hbot
  have h2 : p.height + 1 ≤ m.height := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt
  have h3 : (m.height : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C :=
    Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top hm.ne_top
  rw [Ideal.height_bot, zero_add] at h1
  have h4 : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ m.height := by
    calc (2 : ℕ∞) = 1 + 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ p.height + 1 := add_le_add h1 le_rfl
      _ ≤ m.height := h2
  have h5 : ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim C := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h4) h3
  have h6 : ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ 1 := le_trans h5 h
  exact absurd h6 (by decide)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Valuations.Proofs.IsLocalRing_exists_valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing_dominates.DvrDomination.exists_dvr_of_height_le_one
statement:
theorem exists_dvr_of_height_le_one (S : Subring K) [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsFractionRing S K]
    (P : Ideal S) [hP : P.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) (hP1 : P.height ≤ 1) :
    ∃ V : ValuationSubring K, IsDiscreteValuationRing ↥V ∧ S ≤ V.toSubring ∧
      ∀ s : S, s ∈ P ↔ (s : K) ∈ V.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set R₁ : Subring K := (LocalSubring.ofPrime S P).toSubring with hR₁
  have : IsLocalization.AtPrime (↥R₁) P :=
    LocalSubring.instAtPrimeSubtypeMemSubringToSubringOfPrime S P
  have : IsLocalRing ↥R₁ := (LocalSubring.ofPrime S P).isLocalRing
  have : IsNoetherianRing ↥R₁ := IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing P.primeCompl (↥R₁) inferInstance
  have : IsFractionRing (↥R₁) K :=
    IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isDomain_of_isLocalization P.primeCompl (↥R₁) K
  have hdim : ringKrullDim ↥R₁ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P (↥R₁)]
    exact_mod_cast hP1
  have hnf : ¬ IsField ↥R₁ := by
    intro hf
    have h1 : maximalIdeal ↥R₁ = ⊥ := (IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq).mp hf
    have h2 : Ideal.under (↥S) (maximalIdeal ↥R₁) = P :=
      IsLocalization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal (↥R₁) P
    rw [h1] at h2
    apply hP0
    rw [← h2]
    ext s
    simp only [Ideal.under, Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_bot]
    have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap (↥S) (↥R₁)) :=
      IsLocalization.injective (↥R₁) P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
    exact ⟨fun h => hinj (h.trans (map_zero _).symm), fun h => by rw [h, map_zero]⟩
  set C : Subalgebra (↥R₁) K := integralClosure (↥R₁) K with hC
  obtain ⟨hCnoeth, hCdim⟩ :=
    IsNoetherianRing.of_ringKrullDim_le_one_of_finiteDimensional_subalgebra hdim K K C
  have : IsNoetherianRing ↥C := hCnoeth
  have : IsFractionRing (↥C) K := integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension K K
  have : Ring.DimensionLEOne ↥C := dimensionLEOne_of_ringKrullDim_le_one (↥C) hCdim
  have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn (↥C) K := IsIntegrallyClosedIn.of_isIntegralClosure (↥R₁)
  have : IsIntegrallyClosed ↥C := (isIntegrallyClosed_iff_isIntegrallyClosedIn K).mpr inferInstance
  have : IsDedekindRing ↥C := IsDedekindRing.mk
  have : IsDedekindDomain ↥C := IsDedekindDomain.mk
  have hker : RingHom.ker (algebraMap (↥R₁) (↥C)) ≤ maximalIdeal ↥R₁ := by
    intro x hx
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hx
    have : x = 0 := FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (↥R₁) (↥C) (hx.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    rw [this]; exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨Q, hQmax, hQ⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_maximal_of_isIntegral (S := ↥C) (maximalIdeal ↥R₁) hker
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    apply hnf
    rw [IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq, ← hQ, h]
    ext x
    simp only [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_bot]
    exact ⟨fun hx => FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (↥R₁) (↥C) (hx.trans (map_zero _).symm),
      fun hx => by rw [hx, map_zero]⟩
  have : Q.IsPrime := hQmax.isPrime
  let w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum ↥C := ⟨Q, hQmax.isPrime, hQ0⟩
  have hlocV : IsLocalization.AtPrime (↥(w.valuationSubringAtPrime K)) w.asIdeal :=
    open IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum in
      instIsLocalizationPrimeComplAsIdealSubtypeMemValuationSubringValuationSubringAtPrime w
  refine ⟨w.valuationSubringAtPrime K, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_dedekind_domain
      (↥C) (P := w.asIdeal) hQ0 _
  · intro s hs
    have h1 : s ∈ R₁ := LocalSubring.le_ofPrime S P hs
    have h2 : (algebraMap (↥C) K) (algebraMap (↥R₁) (↥C) ⟨s, h1⟩) = s := by
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]; rfl
    rw [← h2, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (↥C) (↥(w.valuationSubringAtPrime K)) K]
    exact Subtype.mem _
  · intro s
    set V := w.valuationSubringAtPrime K with hV
    have : IsLocalization.AtPrime (↥V) w.asIdeal :=
      open IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum in
        instIsLocalizationPrimeComplAsIdealSubtypeMemValuationSubringValuationSubringAtPrime w
    have e1 : s ∈ P ↔ (algebraMap (↥S) (↥R₁) s) ∈ maximalIdeal ↥R₁ :=
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (↥R₁) P s).symm
    have e2 : (algebraMap (↥S) (↥R₁) s) ∈ maximalIdeal ↥R₁ ↔
        algebraMap (↥R₁) (↥C) (algebraMap (↥S) (↥R₁) s) ∈ w.asIdeal := by
      rw [← hQ, Ideal.mem_comap]
    have e3 : algebraMap (↥R₁) (↥C) (algebraMap (↥S) (↥R₁) s) ∈ w.asIdeal ↔
        algebraMap (↥C) (↥V) (algebraMap (↥R₁) (↥C) (algebraMap (↥S) (↥R₁) s)) ∈ maximalIdeal ↥V :=
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (↥V) w.asIdeal _).symm
    rw [e1, e2, e3, ValuationSubring.valuation_lt_one_iff, ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff]
    have k1 : ∀ c : ↥C, ((algebraMap (↥C) (↥V) c : ↥V) : K) = (c : K) := fun c =>
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (↥C) (↥V) K c).symm
    have k2 : ∀ r : ↥R₁, ((algebraMap (↥R₁) (↥C) r : ↥C) : K) = (r : K) := fun r => rfl
    have k3 : ∀ t : ↥S, ((algebraMap (↥S) (↥R₁) t : ↥R₁) : K) = (t : K) := fun t =>
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (↥S) (↥R₁) K t).symm
    rw [k1, k2, k3]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Valuations.Proofs.IsLocalRing_exists_valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing_dominates.DvrDomination.exists_subalgebra_prime_height_le_one
statement:
theorem exists_subalgebra_prime_height_le_one (hR : ¬ IsField R) :
    ∃ (S : Subalgebra R K) (P : Ideal ↥S) (_ : P.IsPrime),
      IsNoetherianRing ↥S ∧ P ≠ ⊥ ∧ P.height ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ r : R, r ∈ maximalIdeal R ↔ algebraMap R ↥S r ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R K) := IsFractionRing.injective R K
  obtain ⟨V₀, hV₀⟩ := (LocalSubring.range (algebraMap R K)).exists_le_valuationSubring
  obtain ⟨hle, hloc⟩ := LocalSubring.le_def.mp hV₀
  have hRV : ∀ r : R, algebraMap R K r ∈ V₀ := by
    intro r
    have : algebraMap R K r ∈ (LocalSubring.range (algebraMap R K)).toSubring := by
      rw [LocalSubring.range_toSubring]; exact ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact hle this
  have hrange : ∀ z : K, z ∈ (LocalSubring.range (algebraMap R K)).toSubring ↔
      z ∈ Set.range (algebraMap R K) := by
    intro z; rw [LocalSubring.range_toSubring]; rfl
  have hunitV : ∀ r : R, r ∉ maximalIdeal R → V₀.valuation (algebraMap R K r) = 1 := by
    intro r hr
    have hu : IsUnit r := by
      by_contra h; exact hr ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mpr h)
    have : IsUnit (⟨algebraMap R K r, hRV r⟩ : ↥V₀) :=
      hu.map ((algebraMap R K).codRestrict V₀ hRV)
    exact (V₀.valuation_eq_one_iff ⟨algebraMap R K r, hRV r⟩).mp this
  have hdomV : ∀ r : R, r ∈ maximalIdeal R → V₀.valuation (algebraMap R K r) < 1 := by
    intro r hr
    have hle1 : V₀.valuation (algebraMap R K r) ≤ 1 := (V₀.valuation_le_one_iff _).mpr (hRV r)
    rcases hle1.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
    · exact hlt
    exfalso
    have hmemA : algebraMap R K r ∈ (LocalSubring.range (algebraMap R K)).toSubring :=
      (hrange _).mpr ⟨r, rfl⟩
    have huV : IsUnit (Subring.inclusion hle ⟨algebraMap R K r, hmemA⟩) :=
      (V₀.valuation_eq_one_iff ⟨algebraMap R K r, hRV r⟩).mpr heq
    have huA :
        IsUnit (⟨algebraMap R K r, hmemA⟩ : ↥(LocalSubring.range (algebraMap R K)).toSubring) :=
      hloc.map_nonunit _ huV
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b, hab, hba⟩, ha⟩ := huA
    have ha' : (a : K) = algebraMap R K r := congrArg Subtype.val ha
    obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := (hrange _).mp b.2
    have hmul : algebraMap R K (r * r') = algebraMap R K 1 := by
      rw [map_mul, map_one, ← ha', hr']
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hab
    have hunit : IsUnit r := IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one r' (hinj hmul)
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hr hunit
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (IsNoetherian.noetherian (maximalIdeal R) : (maximalIdeal R).FG)
  have hsne : s.Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    rintro rfl
    apply hR
    rw [IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq, ← hs, Finset.coe_empty, Submodule.span_empty]
  obtain ⟨x, hxs, hxmax⟩ := s.exists_max_image (fun y => V₀.valuation (algebraMap R K y)) hsne
  have hsm : ∀ y ∈ s, y ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun y hy => hs ▸ Ideal.subset_span hy
  have hx0 : algebraMap R K x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨y, hys, hy0⟩ : ∃ y ∈ s, y ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hall
      push Not at hall
      apply hR
      rw [IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq, ← hs, Ideal.span_eq_bot]
      exact hall
    have := hxmax y hys
    rw [h0, map_zero] at this
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr hy0 ((Valuation.zero_iff _).mp (le_zero_iff.mp this))
  set T : Finset K := s.image (fun y => algebraMap R K y / algebraMap R K x) with hT
  set S : Subalgebra R K := Algebra.adjoin R (T : Set K) with hS
  have hSnoeth : IsNoetherianRing ↥S := by
    have : Algebra.FiniteType R ↥S :=
      (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType _).mp (Subalgebra.fg_adjoin_finset T)
    exact Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing R ↥S
  let V₀' : Subalgebra R K :=
    { V₀.toSubring with algebraMap_mem' := fun r => hRV r }
  have hSV : S ≤ V₀' := by
    rw [hS]
    refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
    intro t ht
    rw [hT, Finset.coe_image] at ht
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := ht
    change algebraMap R K y / algebraMap R K x ∈ V₀
    rw [← V₀.valuation_le_one_iff, map_div₀, div_le_one₀ (by
      rw [Valuation.pos_iff]; exact hx0)]
    exact hxmax y hy
  have hSV' : ∀ z : ↥S, (z : K) ∈ V₀ := fun z => hSV z.2
  let x' : ↥S := ⟨algebraMap R K x, Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem S x⟩
  have hx'0 : x' ≠ 0 := fun h => hx0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  let toV : ↥S →+* ↥V₀ :=
    { toFun := fun z => ⟨z, hSV' z⟩, map_one' := rfl, map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl,
      map_zero' := rfl, map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  let 𝔮 : Ideal ↥S := (maximalIdeal ↥V₀).comap toV
  have h𝔮 : 𝔮.IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime toV _
  have hx'𝔮 : x' ∈ 𝔮 := by
    change toV x' ∈ maximalIdeal ↥V₀
    rw [ValuationSubring.valuation_lt_one_iff]
    exact hdomV x (hsm x hxs)
  obtain ⟨P, hPmin, hP𝔮⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := Ideal.span {x'}) (J := 𝔮)
    ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hx'𝔮)
  have hPprime : P.IsPrime := hPmin.1.1
  have hxP : x' ∈ P := hPmin.1.2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x')
  refine ⟨S, P, hPprime, hSnoeth, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h; rw [h] at hxP; exact hx'0 ((Submodule.mem_bot _).mp hxP)
  · exact Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes (Ideal.span {x'}) P hPmin
  · intro r
    constructor
    · intro hr
      apply hPmin.1.2
      have hmap : Ideal.map (algebraMap R ↥S) (maximalIdeal R) ≤ Ideal.span {x'} := by
        rw [← hs, Ideal.map_span]
        refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
        rintro z ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
        refine ⟨⟨algebraMap R K y / algebraMap R K x, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rw [hS]; exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (by rw [hT, Finset.coe_image]; exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
        · apply Subtype.ext
          change algebraMap R K y / algebraMap R K x * algebraMap R K x = (algebraMap R ↥S y : K)
          rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx0]
          rfl
      exact hmap (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hr)
    · intro hr
      by_contra hnot
      have h1 := hunitV r hnot
      have h2 : toV (algebraMap R ↥S r) ∈ maximalIdeal ↥V₀ := hP𝔮 hr
      rw [ValuationSubring.valuation_lt_one_iff] at h2
      change V₀.valuation (algebraMap R K r) < 1 at h2
      rw [h1] at h2
      exact lt_irrefl _ h2

name: AlgebraicCurves.Valuations.Proofs.IsLocalRing_exists_valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing_dominates.DvrDomination.main
statement:
theorem main
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (hR : ¬ IsField R)
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] :
    ∃ V : ValuationSubring K, IsDiscreteValuationRing ↥V ∧
      (∀ r : R, algebraMap R K r ∈ V) ∧
      (∀ r : R, r ∈ maximalIdeal R ↔ algebraMap R K r ∈ V.nonunits)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, P, hP, hSn, hP0, hP1, hdom⟩ := exists_subalgebra_prime_height_le_one (K := K) hR
  have : IsNoetherianRing ↥S.toSubring := hSn
  have : FaithfulSMul (↥S.toSubring) K :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr Subtype.val_injective
  have : IsFractionRing (↥S.toSubring) K := by
    refine IsFractionRing.of_field (↥S.toSubring) K (fun z => ?_)
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := R) z
    exact ⟨⟨algebraMap R K a, S.algebraMap_mem a⟩, ⟨algebraMap R K b, S.algebraMap_mem b⟩, rfl⟩
  have : (show Ideal ↥S.toSubring from P).IsPrime := hP
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hSV, hPV⟩ := exists_dvr_of_height_le_one
    S.toSubring (show Ideal ↥S.toSubring from P) hP0 hP1
  refine ⟨V, hV, fun r => hSV (S.algebraMap_mem r), fun r => ?_⟩
  rw [hdom r]
  exact hPV ⟨algebraMap R K r, S.algebraMap_mem r⟩

name: IsLocalRing.exists_valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing_dominates
statement:
theorem _root_.IsLocalRing.exists_valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing_dominates
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (hR : ¬ IsField R)
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] :
    ∃ V : ValuationSubring K, IsDiscreteValuationRing ↥V ∧
      (∀ r : R, algebraMap R K r ∈ V) ∧
      (∀ r : R, r ∈ maximalIdeal R ↔ algebraMap R K r ∈ V.nonunits)
proof:
:=
  DvrDomination.main hR K

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.autToPow_unitsMap_prime_pow
statement:
theorem autToPow_unitsMap_prime_pow (p s : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    {ζ η : L} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (s + 1)))
    (hη : IsPrimitiveRoot η p) (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero s)) (hζ.autToPow K σ) =
      hη.autToPow K σ
proof:
:= by
  have hηpow : η ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) = 1 := by
    rw [pow_succ', pow_mul, hη.pow_eq_one, one_pow]
  obtain ⟨i, -, hpower⟩ := hζ.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hηpow
  have haction : η ^ (hζ.autToPow K σ : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))).val = σ η := by
    rw [← hpower, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm i, pow_mul,
      hζ.autToPow_spec K σ, map_pow]
  have heq :
      η ^ (hζ.autToPow K σ : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))).val =
        η ^ (hη.autToPow K σ : ZMod p).val :=
    haction.trans (hη.autToPow_spec K σ).symm
  have hmod := (hη.isOfFinOrder (NeZero.ne p)).pow_eq_pow_iff_modEq.mp heq
  rw [← hη.eq_orderOf] at hmod
  apply Units.ext
  rw [ZMod.unitsMap_val, ZMod.cast_eq_val]
  exact ((ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff
    (hζ.autToPow K σ : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))).val
    (hη.autToPow K σ : ZMod p).val p).mpr hmod).trans
      (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (hη.autToPow K σ : ZMod p))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.torsionReduction_ker_isPGroup
statement:
theorem torsionReduction_ker_isPGroup (D : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP D.residueField p] :
    IsPGroup p D.torsionReduction.ker
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let A : ValuationSubring K := D.valuation.valuationSubring
  let z : Kˣ := x.val.val
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hzn⟩ := x.val.property.exists_pow_eq_one
  have hzunit : z ∈ A.unitGroup := by
    apply (_root_.Valuation.mem_unitGroup_iff (v := D.valuation) (x := z)).mpr
    have hvalpow : D.valuation (z : K) ^ n = 1 := by
      rw [← map_pow]
      have hzpow : (z : K) ^ n = 1 :=
        congrArg (fun t : Kˣ => (t : K)) hzn
      rw [hzpow, map_one]
    exact (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg zero_le hn.ne').mp hvalpow
  let zA : A.unitGroup := ⟨z, hzunit⟩
  have hred : A.unitGroupToResidueFieldUnits zA = 1 :=
    congrArg (fun t : CommGroup.torsion D.residueFieldˣ => (t : D.residueFieldˣ))
      x.property
  have hzprincipal : z ∈ A.principalUnitGroup := by
    have hker : zA ∈ A.unitGroupToResidueFieldUnits.ker := hred
    rw [A.ker_unitGroupToResidueFieldUnits] at hker
    exact hker
  let w : A.principalUnitGroup := ⟨z, hzprincipal⟩
  have hwn : w ^ n = 1 := Subtype.ext hzn
  obtain ⟨a, m, hm, hfactor⟩ :=
    Nat.exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd hn.ne' p (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one
  have hmres : (m : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ≠ 0 :=
    (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) p m).not.mpr hm
  have hwprime : w ^ (p ^ a) = 1 :=
    A.principalUnit_eq_one_of_pow_eq_one_of_residue_natCast_ne_zero
      (w ^ (p ^ a)) m hmres (by rw [← pow_mul, ← hfactor]; exact hwn)
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun t : A.principalUnitGroup => (t : Kˣ)) hwprime

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.isCompleteDiscrete_of_valuationSubring_eq
statement:
private theorem isCompleteDiscrete_of_valuationSubring_eq
    {L Γ₁ Γ₂ : Type*} [Field L]
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₁] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₂]
    (v₁ : _root_.Valuation L Γ₁) (v₂ : _root_.Valuation L Γ₂)
    [Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v₁] [v₂.IsRankOneDiscrete]
    (h : v₁.valuationSubring = v₂.valuationSubring) :
    Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v₂
proof:
:= by
  refine { isRankOneDiscrete := inferInstance, isAdicComplete := ?_ }

    IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) V

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.exists_normalized_complete_valuation_of_finite_separable
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_complete_valuation_of_finite_separable
    {K : Type u} {L : Type w} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    (base : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K) :
    ∃ vL : _root_.Valuation L (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)),
      Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vL ∧ base.valuation.HasExtension vL
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨target, htarget, _⟩ :=
    exists_integralClosure_standard_fundamental_identity (L := L) base
  let : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation := htarget
  let normalized := FiniteExtensionLocalization.dvf (L := L) base.toDVF
  have : base.valuation.HasExtension normalized.valuation :=
    FiniteExtensionLocalization.dvf_hasExtension (L := L) base.toDVF
  have hequiv : target.valuation.IsEquiv normalized.valuation :=
    hasUniqueValuationExtension_of_finite_separable base target normalized.valuation
  have hsubring : target.valuation.valuationSubring =
      normalized.valuation.valuationSubring :=
    (_root_.Valuation.isEquiv_iff_valuationSubring
      target.valuation normalized.valuation).mp hequiv
  exact ⟨normalized.valuation,
    isCompleteDiscrete_of_valuationSubring_eq target.valuation normalized.valuation hsubring,
    this⟩

name: FieldTheory.exists_finiteType_int_model_le_valuationSubring
statement:
theorem exists_finiteType_int_model_le_valuationSubring
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hfg : Field.FG K)
    (V : ValuationSubring K) (y : K) (hy : y ∈ V) :
    ∃ A : Subalgebra ℤ K, Algebra.FiniteType ℤ A ∧ IsFractionRing A K ∧
      A.toSubring ≤ V.toSubring ∧ y ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hfg.finitely_generated
  let f : K → K := fun x => if x ∈ V then x else x⁻¹
  let t : Finset K := insert y (s.image f)
  have hft (x : K) (hx : x ∈ s) : f x ∈ t :=
    Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  have htV : ∀ x ∈ t, x ∈ V := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hy
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      dsimp only [f]
      split_ifs with hzV
      · exact hzV
      · exact (V.mem_or_inv_mem z).resolve_left hzV
  have hst : Subfield.closure (s : Set K) ≤ Subfield.closure (t : Set K) := by
    apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ Subfield.closure (t : Set K)
    have hfx : f x ∈ Subfield.closure (t : Set K) := Subfield.subset_closure (hft x hx)
    by_cases hxV : x ∈ V
    · simpa only [f, ite_eq_left hxV] using hfx
    · have hi := (Subfield.closure (t : Set K)).inv_mem hfx
      simpa only [f, ite_eq_right hxV, inv_inv] using hi
  have ht : Subfield.closure (t : Set K) = ⊤ := top_unique (hs ▸ hst)
  let A := Algebra.adjoin ℤ (t : Set K)
  have hA : A.toSubring = Subring.closure (t : Set K) :=
    congrArg Subalgebra.toSubring (Algebra.adjoin_int (t : Set K))
  refine ⟨A, (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType A).mp (Subalgebra.fg_adjoin_finset t), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply IsFractionRing.of_field A K
    intro z
    have hz : z ∈ Subfield.closure (t : Set K) := by rw [ht]; exact Subfield.mem_top z
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Subfield.mem_closure_iff.mp hz
    exact ⟨⟨a, by change a ∈ A.toSubring; rw [hA]; exact ha⟩,
      ⟨b, by change b ∈ A.toSubring; rw [hA]; exact hb⟩, hab.symm⟩
  · rw [hA]
    exact Subring.closure_le.mpr htV
  · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Finset.mem_insert_self y (s.image f))

name: FieldTheory.exists_discreteValuationSubring_inv_nonunit_of_not_integral
statement:
theorem exists_discreteValuationSubring_inv_nonunit_of_not_integral
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hfg : Field.FG K)
    (x : K) (hx : ¬ IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    ∃ W : ValuationSubring K, IsDiscreteValuationRing W ∧ x⁻¹ ∈ W.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hx isIntegral_zero
  have hxR : x ∉ (integralClosure ℤ K).toSubring := hx
  obtain ⟨V, _, hxV⟩ :=
    Subring.exists_le_valuationSubring_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn hxR
  have hxiV : x⁻¹ ∈ V.nonunits := V.inv_mem_nonunits_iff.mpr (Or.inr hxV)
  obtain ⟨A, hAfinite, hAfrac, hAV, hxiA⟩ :=
    exists_finiteType_int_model_le_valuationSubring K hfg V x⁻¹
      (V.nonunits_le hxiV)
  have : Algebra.FiniteType ℤ A := hAfinite
  have : IsFractionRing A K := hAfrac
  have : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing ℤ A
  let toV : A →+* V := Subring.inclusion hAV
  let P : Ideal A := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).comap toV
  have : P.IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime toV _
  let y : A := ⟨x⁻¹, hxiA⟩
  have hyP : y ∈ P := V.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mp hxiV
  let B := Localization.subalgebra.ofField K P.primeCompl P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  have : IsLocalRing B := IsLocalization.AtPrime.isLocalRing B P
  have : IsNoetherianRing B :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing P.primeCompl B inferInstance
  have : IsFractionRing B K :=
    IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isDomain_of_isLocalization P.primeCompl B K
  have hyB : algebraMap A B y ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B :=
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff B P y).mpr hyP
  have hyB0 : algebraMap A B y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have h := congrArg (algebraMap B K) hzero
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, map_zero] at h
    exact (inv_ne_zero hx0) h
  have hB : ¬ IsField B := by
    intro hfield
    have hbot := IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hfield
    exact hyB0 (by simpa only [hbot, Ideal.mem_bot] using hyB)
  obtain ⟨W, hW, _, hdom⟩ :=
    IsLocalRing.exists_valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing_dominates hB K
  refine ⟨W, hW, ?_⟩
  have h := (hdom (algebraMap A B y)).mp hyB
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply] at h
  exact h

name: FieldTheory.exists_DVF_detect_nonconstant
statement:
theorem exists_DVF_detect_nonconstant
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hfg : Field.FG K)
    (x : K) (hx : x ∉ algebraicClosure (⊥ : Subfield K) K) :
    ∃ D : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.{u, 0} K,
      D.valuation x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hxint : ¬ IsIntegral ℤ x := by
    intro h
    exact hx (mem_algebraicClosure_iff'.mpr h.tower_top)
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW⟩ :=
    exists_discreteValuationSubring_inv_nonunit_of_not_integral K hfg x hxint
  have : IsDiscreteValuationRing W := hW
  let D : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.{u, 0} K :=
    { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)
      valuation := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal W).valuation K }
  let e : W ≃+* D.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := W) (K := K)
  let y : W := ⟨x⁻¹, W.nonunits_le hxW⟩
  have hunit : ¬ IsUnit y :=
    (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal y).mp (W.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mp hxW)
  have henunit : e y ∈ D.maximalIdeal := by
    apply (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal (e y)).mpr
    intro h
    have hu := h.map e.symm.toMonoidHom
    change IsUnit (e.symm (e y)) at hu
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply] at hu
    exact hunit hu
  have hlt : D.valuation ((e y : D.valuationSubring) : K) < 1 :=
    (Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_iff (v := D.valuation)).mp henunit
  have hey : ((e y : D.valuationSubring) : K) = x⁻¹ := rfl
  rw [hey, map_inv₀] at hlt
  refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
  intro heq
  rw [heq, inv_one] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl _ hlt

name: FieldTheory.exists_moved_DVF_of_fg_posChar
statement:
theorem exists_moved_DVF_of_fg_posChar
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Infinite K] (hfg : Field.FG K)
    (hchar : ringChar K ≠ 0) (τ : K ≃+* K) (hne : τ ≠ 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hpow : τ ^ n = 1) :
    ∃ D : DVF.{u,0} K, ¬ D.valuation.IsEquiv (D.valuation.comap τ.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hno
  have hstable (D : DVF.{u,0} K) :
      D.valuation.IsEquiv (D.valuation.comap τ.toRingHom) :=
    not_not.mp (fun h => hno ⟨D, h⟩)
  let C : Subfield K := (algebraicClosure (⊥ : Subfield K) K).toSubfield
  have : Finite C := finite_constants_of_fg_posChar K hfg hchar
  have hC : C ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro heq
    have : Finite K := Finite.of_surjective C.subtype (by
      intro x
      exact ⟨⟨x, heq ▸ Subfield.mem_top x⟩, rfl⟩)
    exact not_finite K
  have hratio (x : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) : τ x / x ∈ C := by
    by_contra hc
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_DVF_detect_nonconstant K hfg (τ x / x) hc
    apply hD
    rw [map_div₀, Valuation.map_apply_eq_of_isEquiv_comap_of_pow_eq_one
      D.valuation τ (hstable D) n hn hpow]
    exact div_self ((map_ne_zero D.valuation).mpr hx)
  have heq := ringHom_eq_id_of_div_mem_subfield C hC τ.toRingHom hratio
  apply hne
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun heq x

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.primitiveRoots_prime_nonempty_of_residue
statement:
theorem primitiveRoots_prime_nonempty_of_residue
    [CharZero F.residueField] {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hres : (primitiveRoots p F.residueField).Nonempty) :
    (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hres
  have hprim := (mem_primitiveRoots hp.pos).mp hζ
  have : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  have : NeZero (p : F.residueField) := ⟨Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne_zero⟩
  let ξ : rootsOfUnity p F.residueField := rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq ζ hprim.pow_eq_one
  let η : rootsOfUnity p K := (F.fieldRootsOfUnityReductionEquiv p).symm ξ
  have hηpow : ((η : Kˣ) : K) ^ p = 1 :=
    (mem_rootsOfUnity' p (η : Kˣ)).mp η.property
  have hηne : ((η : Kˣ) : K) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hη : η = 1 := rootsOfUnity.coe_injective h
    have hξ : ξ = 1 := by
      rw [← (F.fieldRootsOfUnityReductionEquiv p).apply_symm_apply ξ]
      change F.fieldRootsOfUnityReductionEquiv p η = 1
      rw [hη, map_one]
    apply hprim.ne_one hp.one_lt
    exact congrArg (fun z : rootsOfUnity p F.residueField =>
      ((z : F.residueFieldˣ) : F.residueField)) hξ
  exact ⟨((η : Kˣ) : K), (mem_primitiveRoots hp.pos).mpr
    (isPrimitiveRoot_of_mem_nthRootsFinset hp
      ((Polynomial.mem_nthRootsFinset hp.pos 1).mpr hηpow) hηne)⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.finite_primaryComponent_of_finite_residuePrimaryComponent
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_of_finite_residuePrimaryComponent
    [CharZero F.residueField] {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    [Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent F.residueFieldˣ p)] :
    Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  let i : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p →* CommGroup.torsion Kˣ :=
    (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p).inclusion (by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent).mp hz
      exact (CommGroup.mem_torsion z).mpr
        (isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨p ^ n, pow_pos hp.pos n, hn⟩))
  let f : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p →* F.residueFieldˣ :=
    (CommGroup.torsion F.residueFieldˣ).subtype.comp (F.toDVF.torsionReduction.comp i)
  have hf (z : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p) :
      f z ∈ CommGroup.primaryComponent F.residueFieldˣ p := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent).mp z.property
    refine (CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent).mpr ⟨n, ?_⟩
    have hzn : z ^ (p ^ n) = 1 := Subtype.ext hn
    rw [← map_pow, hzn, map_one]
  let g := f.codRestrict (CommGroup.primaryComponent F.residueFieldˣ p) hf
  apply Finite.of_injective g
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hred : F.toDVF.torsionReduction (i a) = F.toDVF.torsionReduction (i b) :=
    Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : CommGroup.primaryComponent F.residueFieldˣ p =>
      (z : F.residueFieldˣ)) hab)
  exact congrArg (fun z : CommGroup.torsion Kˣ => (z : Kˣ))
    (F.torsionReduction_injective hred)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.finite_primePowerRoots_of_finite_residuePrimaryComponent
statement:
theorem finite_primePowerRoots_of_finite_residuePrimaryComponent
    [CharZero F.residueField] {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    [Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent F.residueFieldˣ p)] :
    Set.Finite {z : K | ∃ n : ℕ, z ^ (p ^ n) = 1}
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p) :=
    F.finite_primaryComponent_of_finite_residuePrimaryComponent hp
  let f : {z : K | ∃ n : ℕ, z ^ (p ^ n) = 1} → CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p :=
    fun z => ⟨Units.mk0 z.val (by
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := z.property
      intro hz
      rw [hz, zero_pow (pow_ne_zero n hp.ne_zero)] at hn
      exact zero_ne_one hn), by
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := z.property
        refine (CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent).mpr ⟨n, ?_⟩
        apply Units.ext
        exact hn⟩
  have : Finite {z : K | ∃ n : ℕ, z ^ (p ^ n) = 1} := Finite.of_injective f (by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p => ((z : Kˣ) : K)) hab)
  exact Set.toFinite _

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.continuous_algebraMap_of_hasExtension
statement:
theorem continuous_algebraMap_of_hasExtension
    (vK : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))

    [vK.IsRankOneDiscrete] [vL.IsRankOneDiscrete] [vK.HasExtension vL] :

      (Valued.mk' vL).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace (algebraMap K L)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_cyclic_kummer_extension_of_prime_parameter
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_kummer_extension_of_prime_parameter
    (R : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (π : R) (hπ : Prime π) (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime]
    (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ r) :
    ∃ (L : Type v) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L)
      (_ : Algebra R L) (_ : IsScalarTower R K L) (B : PowerBasis K L),
      Module.finrank K L = r ∧
      B.gen ^ r = algebraMap R L π ∧
      minpoly K B.gen = X ^ r - C (algebraMap R K π) ∧
      minpoly R B.gen = X ^ r - C π ∧
      IsGalois K L ∧ IsCyclic (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < r := (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos
  let f : K[X] := X ^ r - C (algebraMap R K π)
  have hmonic : f.Monic := monic_X_pow_sub_C (algebraMap R K π) hr.ne'
  have hirr : Irreducible f :=
    X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime_parameter K π hπ r hr
  let : Fact (Irreducible f) := ⟨hirr⟩
  let L : Type v := AdjoinRoot f
  let B : PowerBasis K L := AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hmonic.ne_zero
  let : FiniteDimensional K L := B.finite
  have hdegree : Module.finrank K L = r := by
    calc
      Module.finrank K L = B.dim := B.finrank
      _ = f.natDegree := by rfl
      _ = r := natDegree_X_pow_sub_C
  have hprimitive : (primitiveRoots r K).Nonempty :=
    ⟨ζ, (mem_primitiveRoots hr).mpr hζ⟩
  let : f.IsSplittingField K L :=
    isSplittingField_AdjoinRoot_X_pow_sub_C hprimitive hirr
  let : IsGalois K L :=
    isGalois_of_isSplittingField_X_pow_sub_C hprimitive hirr L
  have hcyclic : IsCyclic (L ≃ₐ[K] L) :=
    isCyclic_of_prime_card ((IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdegree)
  have hminpolyK : minpoly K B.gen = f :=
    AdjoinRoot.minpoly_powerBasis_gen_of_monic hmonic
  have hrootK : aeval B.gen f = 0 := by
    change aeval (AdjoinRoot.root f) f = 0
    rw [AdjoinRoot.aeval_eq, AdjoinRoot.mk_self]
  have hfmap : (X ^ r - C π).map (algebraMap R K) = f := by
    simp only [f, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, map_X, map_C]
  have hrootR : aeval B.gen (X ^ r - C π) = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_aeval_map (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R K L).symm,
      hfmap]
    exact hrootK
  have hintegral : IsIntegral R B.gen :=
    ⟨X ^ r - C π, monic_X_pow_sub_C π hr.ne', hrootR⟩
  have hminpolyR : minpoly R B.gen = X ^ r - C π := by
    apply Polynomial.map_injective (algebraMap R K) (IsFractionRing.injective R K)
    rw [← minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' K hintegral, hfmap]
    exact hminpolyK
  have hpower : B.gen ^ r = algebraMap R L π := by
    simpa only [map_sub, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_C, sub_eq_zero] using hrootR
  exact ⟨L, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    B, hdegree, hpower, hminpolyK, hminpolyR, inferInstance, hcyclic⟩

name: LubinTate.compatibleGroupFamiliesEval_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compatibleGroupFamiliesEval_apply
    {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] (G : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Group (G i)]

name: LubinTate.compatibleGroupFamilies_transition
statement:
theorem compatibleGroupFamilies_transition
    {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] (G : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (transition : ∀ {i j : ι}, i ≤ j → G j →* G i)
    (x : compatibleGroupFamilies G transition) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≤ j) :

      compatibleGroupFamiliesEval G transition i x

name: LubinTate.compatibleGroupFamilies_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem compatibleGroupFamilies_ext
    {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] (G : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Group (G i)]
    (transition : ∀ {i j : ι}, i ≤ j → G j →* G i)

      compatibleGroupFamiliesEval G transition i y) : x = y

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.surjective_pi_completion_powerClasses
statement:
theorem surjective_pi_completion_powerClasses
    (D : ι → DVF K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : K) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fun (u : Kˣ) (i : ι) =>
      (Units.map (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion).toMonoidHom u :
        (D i).valuation.Completionˣ ⧸
          (powMonoidHom n : (D i).valuation.Completionˣ →*
            (D i).valuation.Completionˣ).range))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro c
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with
  | inl h =>
    let := h
    exact ⟨1, funext (fun i => isEmptyElim i)⟩
  | inr h =>
    let := h
    let N (i : ι) : Subgroup (D i).valuation.Completionˣ :=
      (powMonoidHom n : (D i).valuation.Completionˣ →*
        (D i).valuation.Completionˣ).range
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Classical.axiomOfChoice
      (fun i => QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (N i) (c i))
    let U (i : ι) : Set (D i).valuation.Completionˣ :=
      {u | (a i)⁻¹ * u ∈ N i}
    have hN (i : ι) : IsOpen (N i : Set (D i).valuation.Completionˣ) := by
      have : Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete
          (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (D i).valuation.Completion (D i).ValueGroup) :=
        Valuation.completion_isCompleteDiscrete (D i).valuation
      have := Valuation.henselianRing
        (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (D i).valuation.Completion (D i).ValueGroup)
      apply isOpen_unit_pow_range (Γ := (D i).ValueGroup) n
      rw [← map_natCast (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion) n]
      exact (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion).injective.ne hn
    have hU (i : ι) : IsOpen (U i) :=
      (hN i).preimage (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)
    let V (i : ι) : Set (D i).valuation.Completion :=
      Units.val '' U i
    have hV (i : ι) : IsOpen (V i) :=
      IsOpenUnits.isOpenEmbedding_unitsVal.isOpenMap (U i) (hU i)
    have haU (i : ι) : a i ∈ U i := by
      change (a i)⁻¹ * a i ∈ N i
      rw [inv_mul_cancel]
      exact (N i).one_mem
    have hprodOpen : IsOpen (Set.univ.pi V) :=
      isOpen_set_pi Set.finite_univ (fun i _ => hV i)
    have hprodNonempty : (Set.univ.pi V).Nonempty :=
      ⟨fun i => (a i : (D i).valuation.Completion),
        fun i _ => ⟨a i, haU i, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (denseRange_pi_completion D hD).exists_mem_open
      hprodOpen hprodNonempty
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
      obtain ⟨b, _, hb⟩ := hx (Classical.arbitrary ι) (Set.mem_univ _)
      change (b : (D (Classical.arbitrary ι)).valuation.Completion) =
        algebraMap K (D (Classical.arbitrary ι)).valuation.Completion x at hb
      intro hxzero
      rw [hxzero, map_zero] at hb
      exact b.ne_zero hb
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 x hx0, funext (fun i => ?_)⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hbU, hb⟩ := hx i (Set.mem_univ i)
    have hunit : Units.map (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion).toMonoidHom
        (Units.mk0 x hx0) = b := Units.ext hb.symm
    change (Units.map (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion).toMonoidHom
      (Units.mk0 x hx0) : (D i).valuation.Completionˣ ⧸ N i) = c i
    rw [hunit]
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq.mpr hbU).symm.trans (ha i)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.withValRingEquiv_uniformContinuous
statement:
theorem withValRingEquiv_uniformContinuous (e : K ≃+* L)
    (he : source.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap e.toRingHom)) :
    UniformContinuous (WithVal.congr source.valuation target.valuation e)
proof:
:= by
  let v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal source.valuation) source.ValueGroup := Valued.v
  let w : _root_.Valuation (WithVal target.valuation) target.ValueGroup := Valued.v
  let f : WithVal source.valuation ≃+* WithVal target.valuation :=
    WithVal.congr source.valuation target.valuation e
  have : w.IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    Valuation.isRankOneDiscrete_comap_ringEquiv target.valuation
      (WithVal.equiv target.valuation)
  have : MulArchimedean w.ValueGroup₀ :=
    (_root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt w).symm.mulArchimedean
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := source.exists_uniformizer
  let p : WithVal source.valuation := WithVal.toVal source.valuation (π : K)
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    exact hπ.ne_zero (congrArg (WithVal.equiv source.valuation) hzero)
  have hfp : w.restrict (f p) < 1 := by
    apply w.restrict_lt_one_iff.mpr
    exact he.lt_one_iff_lt_one.mp hπ.val_lt_one
  change UniformContinuous f
  refine
    ((Valued.hasBasis_uniformity (WithVal source.valuation) source.ValueGroup).uniformContinuous_iff
      (Valued.hasBasis_uniformity (WithVal target.valuation) target.ValueGroup)).mpr ?_
  intro γ _
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt₀ hfp γ
  have hpn : v.restrict (p ^ n) ≠ 0 :=
    v.restrict.ne_zero_iff.mpr (pow_ne_zero n hp)
  let δ : (ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v))ˣ := Units.mk0 (v.restrict (p ^ n)) hpn
  refine ⟨δ, trivial, ?_⟩
  intro x y hxy
  have hsource : source.valuation ((WithVal.equiv source.valuation) (y - x)) <
      source.valuation ((WithVal.equiv source.valuation) (p ^ n)) :=
    v.restrict_lt_iff.mp hxy
  have htarget : w (f (y - x)) < w (f (p ^ n)) := he.lt_iff_lt.mp hsource
  change w.restrict (f y - f x) < (γ : w.ValueGroup₀)
  rw [← map_sub]
  calc
    w.restrict (f (y - x)) < w.restrict (f (p ^ n)) := w.restrict_lt_iff.mpr htarget
    _ = w.restrict (f p) ^ n := by rw [map_pow, map_pow]
    _ < γ := hn

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionRingEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem completionRingEquiv_algebraMap (e : K ≃+* L)
    (he : source.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap e.toRingHom)) (x : K) :
    completionRingEquiv source target e he (algebraMap K source.valuation.Completion x) =
      algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion (e x)
proof:
:= by
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.mapRingHom_coe
    (withValRingEquiv_uniformContinuous source target e he).continuous
    (WithVal.toVal source.valuation x)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionMap_continuous
statement: theorem completionMap_continuous : Continuous (completionMap base source)
proof:
:=
  UniformSpace.Completion.continuous_map

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionRingEquiv_comp_completionMap
statement:
theorem completionRingEquiv_comp_completionMap
    (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (hτ : source.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) :
    (completionRingEquiv source target τ.toRingEquiv hτ).toRingHom.comp
        (completionMap base source) = completionMap base target
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext'
  have he : Continuous (completionRingEquiv source target τ.toRingEquiv hτ) :=
    UniformSpace.Completion.continuous_map
  apply UniformSpace.Completion.ext (he.comp (completionMap_continuous base source))
    (completionMap_continuous base target)
  intro x
  change completionRingEquiv source target τ.toRingEquiv hτ
    (completionMap base source ((WithVal.equiv base.valuation x : K) : base.valuation.Completion)) =
      completionMap base target ((WithVal.equiv base.valuation x : K) : base.valuation.Completion)
  rw [completionMap_coe_base, completionMap_coe_base]
  change completionRingEquiv source target τ.toRingEquiv hτ
    (algebraMap L source.valuation.Completion (algebraMap K L (WithVal.equiv base.valuation x))) =
      algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion (algebraMap K L (WithVal.equiv base.valuation x))
  rw [completionRingEquiv_algebraMap]
  exact congrArg (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion)
    (τ.commutes (WithVal.equiv base.valuation x))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.adjoin_range_eq_top_of_isSepClosed
statement:
theorem adjoin_range_eq_top_of_isSepClosed
    {S E : Type*} [Field S] [Field E] [Algebra K S]
    [Algebra base.valuation.Completion E] [Algebra K E]
    [IsScalarTower K base.valuation.Completion E] [IsSepClosed S]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable base.valuation.Completion E] (i : S →ₐ[K] E) :
    Algebra.adjoin base.valuation.Completion (Set.range i) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  let F : IntermediateField base.valuation.Completion E :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin base.valuation.Completion ({x} : Set E)
  have : FiniteDimensional base.valuation.Completion F :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional
      (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable base.valuation.Completion x).isIntegral
  obtain ⟨γ, hγsep, hγgen, _⟩ := base.exists_completion_extension_generator F
  let U : Subalgebra base.valuation.Completion E :=
    Algebra.adjoin base.valuation.Completion (Set.range i)
  have hγEsep : IsSeparable K (γ : E) :=
    hγsep.map (F.val.restrictScalars K) Subtype.val_injective
  have hγmem : γ ∈ U.comap F.val := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mp
      (Completion.mem_fieldRange_of_isSeparable_of_isSepClosed i hγEsep)
    exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨s, hs⟩
  have htop : (⊤ : Subalgebra base.valuation.Completion F) ≤ U.comap F.val := by
    rw [← hγgen]
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    intro y hy
    exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy).symm ▸ hγmem
  exact htop (show (⟨x, IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self
    base.valuation.Completion x⟩ : F) ∈ (⊤ : Subalgebra base.valuation.Completion F) from trivial)

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.exists_algebraMap_eq_of_normal_of_approximable
statement:
private theorem exists_algebraMap_eq_of_normal_of_approximable
    {K L : Type*} [NormedField K] [NormedField L]
    [IsUltrametricDist K] [IsUltrametricDist L] [NormedAlgebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Normal K L]
    [HenselianRing (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring)]
    (a : L) (ha : IsSeparable K a)
    (happrox : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ k : K, ‖a - algebraMap K L k‖ < ε) :
    ∃ k : K, algebraMap K L k = a
proof:
:= by
  have hfixed (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) : σ a = a := by
    by_contra hne
    have hpos : 0 < ‖σ a - a‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := happrox ‖σ a - a‖ hpos
    have hnorm : ‖σ a - algebraMap K L k‖ = ‖a - algebraMap K L k‖ := by
      calc
        ‖σ a - algebraMap K L k‖ = ‖σ (a - algebraMap K L k)‖ := by
          rw [map_sub, σ.commutes]
        _ = ‖a - algebraMap K L k‖ :=
          norm_algEquiv_eq_of_henselianRing σ (a - algebraMap K L k)
    have hle : ‖σ a - a‖ ≤ ‖a - algebraMap K L k‖ := by
      calc
        ‖σ a - a‖ = ‖(σ a - algebraMap K L k) + (algebraMap K L k - a)‖ := by
          rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
        _ ≤ max ‖σ a - algebraMap K L k‖ ‖algebraMap K L k - a‖ :=
          IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max
            (σ a - algebraMap K L k) (algebraMap K L k - a)
        _ = ‖a - algebraMap K L k‖ := by rw [hnorm, norm_sub_rev, max_self]
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hk
  have hmem : a ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra K L) := by
    by_contra hnot
    obtain ⟨b, hne, hconj⟩ :=
      (notMem_iff_exists_ne_and_isConjRoot ha
        (Normal.splits (inferInstance : Normal K L) a)).mp hnot
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := isConjRoot_iff_exists_algEquiv.mp hconj
    exact hne (σ.injective ((hfixed σ).trans hσ.symm))
  exact Algebra.mem_bot.mp hmem

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.exists_algebraMap_eq_of_isAlgClosed_of_approximable
statement:
private theorem exists_algebraMap_eq_of_isAlgClosed_of_approximable
    {K Ω : Type*} [NormedField K] [NormedField Ω]
    [IsUltrametricDist K] [IsUltrametricDist Ω] [NormedAlgebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    [HenselianRing (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring)]
    (a : Ω) (ha : IsSeparable K a)
    (happrox : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ k : K, ‖a - algebraMap K Ω k‖ < ε) :
    ∃ k : K, algebraMap K Ω k = a
proof:
:= by
  let N : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.adjoin K ((minpoly K a).rootSet Ω)
  have hsplits : ((minpoly K a).map (algebraMap K Ω)).Splits := IsAlgClosed.splits _
  have : IsSplittingField K N (minpoly K a) :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin_rootSet_isSplittingField hsplits
  have : FiniteDimensional K N := IsSplittingField.finiteDimensional N (minpoly K a)
  have : Normal K N := Normal.of_isSplittingField (minpoly K a)
  have haN : a ∈ N := IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K ((minpoly K a).rootSet Ω)
    (mem_rootSet.mpr ⟨minpoly.ne_zero ha.isIntegral, minpoly.aeval K a⟩)
  let aN : N := ⟨a, haN⟩
  have haNsep : IsSeparable K aN :=
    (isSeparable_map_iff N.val N.val.injective).mp ha
  have happroxN : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ k : K, ‖aN - algebraMap K N k‖ < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := happrox ε hε
    exact ⟨k, hk⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_algebraMap_eq_of_normal_of_approximable aN haNsep happroxN
  exact ⟨k, congrArg (fun x : N => (x : Ω)) hk⟩

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.exists_algebraMap_eq_of_complete_of_approximable
statement:
private theorem exists_algebraMap_eq_of_complete_of_approximable
    {K D : Type*} [NormedField K] [NontriviallyNormedField D]
    [IsUltrametricDist K] [IsUltrametricDist D] [NormedAlgebra K D] [CompleteSpace D]
    [HenselianRing (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring)]
    (a : D) (ha : IsSeparable K a)
    (happrox : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ k : K, ‖a - algebraMap K D k‖ < ε) :
    ∃ k : K, algebraMap K D k = a
proof:
:= by
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure D
  let : NormedField Ω := spectralNorm.normedField D Ω
  let : NormedAlgebra D Ω := spectralNorm.normedAlgebra D Ω
  let : NormedAlgebra K Ω := NormedAlgebra.restrictScalars K D Ω
  have : IsScalarTower K D Ω := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun k : K => rfl)
  have : IsUltrametricDist Ω := IsUltrametricDist.of_normedAlgebra D
  let j : D →ₐ[K] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K D Ω
  have hasep : IsSeparable K (j a) := ha.map j j.injective
  have happroxΩ : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ k : K, ‖j a - algebraMap K Ω k‖ < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := happrox ε hε
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    have hnorm : ‖j a - algebraMap K Ω k‖ = ‖a - algebraMap K D k‖ := by
      change ‖algebraMap D Ω a - algebraMap K Ω k‖ = ‖a - algebraMap K D k‖
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K D Ω, ← map_sub, norm_algebraMap']
    rw [hnorm]
    exact hk
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
    exists_algebraMap_eq_of_isAlgClosed_of_approximable (j a) hasep happroxΩ
  refine ⟨k, j.injective ?_⟩
  exact (j.commutes k).trans hk

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.exists_completion_eq_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem exists_completion_eq_of_isSeparable
    {K : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField K] [IsUltrametricDist K]
    [HenselianRing (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring)]
    (a : UniformSpace.Completion K) (ha : IsSeparable K a) :
    ∃ k : K, (k : UniformSpace.Completion K) = a
proof:
:= by
  let D := UniformSpace.Completion K
  let : NontriviallyNormedField D :=
    { (inferInstance : NormedField D) with
      non_trivial := by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := NormedField.exists_one_lt_norm K
        exact ⟨(k : D), (UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe k).symm ▸ hk⟩ }
  have : IsUltrametricDist D := IsUltrametricDist.of_normedAlgebra K
  have happrox : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ k : K, ‖a - algebraMap K D k‖ < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (UniformSpace.Completion.denseRange_coe (α := K)).exists_dist_lt a hε
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    change ‖a - (k : D)‖ < ε
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hk
  exact exists_algebraMap_eq_of_complete_of_approximable a ha happrox

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.exists_isSeparable_generator_of_denseRange
statement:
theorem exists_isSeparable_generator_of_denseRange
    {K A E : Type*} [Field K] [NontriviallyNormedField A] [Field E]
    [CompleteSpace A] [IsUltrametricDist A]
    [Algebra K A] [Algebra A E] [Algebra K E] [IsScalarTower K A E]
    [FiniteDimensional A E] [Algebra.IsSeparable A E]
    (hd : DenseRange (algebraMap K A)) :
    ∃ γ : E, IsSeparable K γ ∧ Algebra.adjoin A ({γ} : Set E) = ⊤ ∧
      (minpoly K γ).natDegree = Module.finrank A E
proof:
:= by
  let pb : PowerBasis A E := Field.powerBasisOfFiniteOfSeparable A E
  let ι : E →ₐ[A] AlgebraicClosure A := IsAlgClosed.lift
  have hαsep : IsSeparable A (ι pb.gen) :=
    (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable A pb.gen).map ι ι.injective
  obtain ⟨β, hβsep, hβeq, hβdegree⟩ :=
    exists_isSeparable_adjoin_eq_of_denseRange hd (ι pb.gen) hαsep
  have hrange : A⟮ι pb.gen⟯ ≤ ι.fieldRange :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr ⟨pb.gen, rfl⟩
  have hβmem : β ∈ A⟮ι pb.gen⟯ := by
    rw [← hβeq]
    exact IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self A β
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mp (hrange hβmem)
  have hγsep : IsSeparable K γ := by
    apply (isSeparable_map_iff (ι.restrictScalars K) ι.injective).mp
    change IsSeparable K (ι γ)
    rw [hγ]
    exact hβsep
  have hpbtop : A⟮pb.gen⟯ = ⊤ :=
    (Field.primitive_element_iff_minpoly_natDegree_eq A pb.gen).mpr
      (pb.natDegree_minpoly.trans pb.finrank.symm)
  have hγtop : A⟮γ⟯ = ⊤ := by
    apply IntermediateField.map_injective ι
    calc
      (A⟮γ⟯).map ι = A⟮ι γ⟯ := by
        rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_map, Set.image_singleton]
      _ = A⟮ι pb.gen⟯ := by rw [hγ]; exact hβeq
      _ = (A⟮pb.gen⟯).map ι := by
        rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_map, Set.image_singleton]
      _ = (⊤ : IntermediateField A E).map ι := congrArg (IntermediateField.map ι) hpbtop
  have hgen : Algebra.adjoin A ({γ} : Set E) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubalgebra (F := A) ({γ} : Set E), hγtop]
    rfl
  refine ⟨γ, hγsep, hgen, ?_⟩
  calc
    (minpoly K γ).natDegree = (minpoly K (ι γ)).natDegree := by
      change (minpoly K γ).natDegree =
        (minpoly K ((ι.restrictScalars K) γ)).natDegree
      rw [minpoly.algHom_eq (ι.restrictScalars K) ι.injective]
    _ = (minpoly K β).natDegree := congrArg (fun x => (minpoly K x).natDegree) hγ
    _ = (minpoly A (ι pb.gen)).natDegree := hβdegree
    _ = (minpoly A pb.gen).natDegree := by rw [minpoly.algHom_eq ι ι.injective]
    _ = Module.finrank A E := pb.natDegree_minpoly.trans pb.finrank.symm

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem separableClosureAutEquiv_apply (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
    (s : SeparableClosure K) :
    (separableClosureAutEquiv K σ s : AlgebraicClosure K) = σ (s : AlgebraicClosure K)
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_apply (separableClosure K (AlgebraicClosure K)) σ s

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.continuous_separableClosureAutEquiv
statement: theorem continuous_separableClosureAutEquiv : Continuous (separableClosureAutEquiv K)
