:=
  InfiniteGalois.restrictNormalHom_continuous (separableClosure K (AlgebraicClosure K))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.separableClosedTensorHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem separableClosedTensorHom_tmul (i : S →ₐ[K] E)
    (a : base.valuation.Completion) (s : S) :
    base.separableClosedTensorHom i (a ⊗ₜ[K] s) =
      algebraMap base.valuation.Completion E a * i s
proof:
:=
  Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul (Algebra.ofId base.valuation.Completion E) i
    (fun b t => Commute.all (algebraMap base.valuation.Completion E b) (i t)) a s

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.separableClosedTensorHom_surjective
statement:
theorem separableClosedTensorHom_surjective [IsSepClosed S]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable base.valuation.Completion E] (i : S →ₐ[K] E) :
    Function.Surjective (base.separableClosedTensorHom i)
proof:
:= by
  apply (base.separableClosedTensorHom i).range_eq_top.mp
  apply top_unique
  rw [← base.adjoin_range_eq_top_of_isSepClosed i]
  apply Algebra.adjoin_le
  rintro x ⟨s, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[K] s, ?_⟩
  change base.separableClosedTensorHom i (1 ⊗ₜ[K] s) = i s
  rw [separableClosedTensorHom_tmul, map_one, one_mul]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.completionTensor_isField
statement:
theorem completionTensor_isField (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K)
    (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] :
    IsField (base.valuation.Completion ⊗[K] L)
proof:
:= by
  let pb : PowerBasis K L := Field.powerBasisOfFiniteOfSeparable K L
  let q : Polynomial base.valuation.Completion :=
    (minpoly K pb.gen).map (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion)
  have hq : Irreducible q := base.irreducible_map_completion
    (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable K pb.gen) (minpoly.irreducible pb.isIntegral_gen)
  have : Fact (Irreducible q) := ⟨hq⟩
  exact MulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField (AdjoinRoot q))
    (Completion.baseChangeEquivAdjoinRoot
      (A := base.valuation.Completion) pb).toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.completion_valueGroup_eq
statement:
private theorem completion_valueGroup_eq
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Γ : Type v} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (val : _root_.Valuation K Γ) :
    MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
        (.ofClass (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation val.Completion Γ)) =
      MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup (.ofClass val)
proof:
:= by
  change (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation val.Completion Γ).valueGroup = val.valueGroup
  rw [← WithVal.valueGroup_eq val]
  ext γ
  constructor
  · intro hγ
    apply MonoidWithZeroHom.mem_valueGroup
    have himg : (γ : Γ) ∈ Units.val ''
        MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
          (.ofClass (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation val.Completion Γ)) :=
      ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
    rw [MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup_eq_range] at himg
    obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, _⟩ := himg
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Valued.exists_coe_eq_v (K := WithVal val) (Γ₀ := Γ) x
    exact ⟨a, (hx.symm.trans ha).symm⟩
  · intro hγ
    apply MonoidWithZeroHom.mem_valueGroup
    have himg : (γ : Γ) ∈ Units.val ''
        MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
          (.ofClass (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal val) Γ)) :=
      ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩
    rw [MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup_eq_range] at himg
    obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, _⟩ := himg
    refine ⟨(a : val.Completion), ?_⟩
    change (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation val.Completion Γ)
      (a : val.Completion) = (γ : Γ)
    rw [Valued.valuedCompletion_apply]
    exact ha

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.completion_valuation_algebraMap
statement:
theorem completion_valuation_algebraMap
    (val : _root_.Valuation K Γ) (x : K) :

      (algebraMap K val.Completion x) = val x
proof:
:= by

    ((WithVal.toVal val x : WithVal val) : val.Completion) = val x
  exact Valued.valuedCompletion_apply (WithVal.toVal val x)

    (val : _root_.Valuation K Γ) [val.IsRankOneDiscrete] :

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.completion_hasExtension
statement:
theorem completion_hasExtension
    (val : _root_.Valuation K Γ) :
    val.HasExtension (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation val.Completion

proof:

        (algebraMap K val.Completion x) ≤
      (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation val.Completion Γ)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.surjective_pi_completion_artinSchreierClasses
statement:
theorem surjective_pi_completion_artinSchreierClasses
    (D : ι → DVF K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] :
    Function.Surjective (fun (x : K) (i : ι) =>
      (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion x :
        (D i).valuation.Completion ⧸
          ((frobenius (D i).valuation.Completion p).toAddMonoidHom -
            AddMonoidHom.id (D i).valuation.Completion).range))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro c
  let N (i : ι) : AddSubgroup (D i).valuation.Completion :=
    ((frobenius (D i).valuation.Completion p).toAddMonoidHom -
      AddMonoidHom.id (D i).valuation.Completion).range
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Classical.axiomOfChoice
    (fun i => QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective (N i) (c i))
  let U (i : ι) : Set (D i).valuation.Completion :=
    {x | -(a i) + x ∈ N i}
  have hN (i : ι) : IsOpen (N i : Set (D i).valuation.Completion) := by
    have : Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete
        (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (D i).valuation.Completion (D i).ValueGroup) :=
      Valuation.completion_isCompleteDiscrete (D i).valuation
    have := Valuation.henselianRing
      (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (D i).valuation.Completion (D i).ValueGroup)
    exact isOpen_artinSchreier_range (Γ := (D i).ValueGroup) p
  have hU (i : ι) : IsOpen (U i) :=
    (hN i).preimage (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have haU (i : ι) : a i ∈ U i := by
    change -(a i) + a i ∈ N i
    rw [neg_add_cancel]
    exact (N i).zero_mem
  have hprodOpen : IsOpen (Set.univ.pi U) :=
    isOpen_set_pi Set.finite_univ (fun i _ => hU i)
  have hprodNonempty : (Set.univ.pi U).Nonempty :=
    ⟨a, fun i _ => haU i⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (denseRange_pi_completion D hD).exists_mem_open
    hprodOpen hprodNonempty
  refine ⟨x, funext (fun i => ?_)⟩
  exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq.mpr (hx i (Set.mem_univ i))).symm.trans (ha i)

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.tensorProduct_lift_surjective_of_denseRange
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_lift_surjective_of_denseRange
    (g : L →ₐ[K] B) (hg : DenseRange g) :
    Function.Surjective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId A B) g
        (fun (a : A) (l : L) => Commute.all (algebraMap A B a) (g l)))
proof:
:= by
  let f : A ⊗[K] L →ₐ[A] B :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId A B) g
      (fun (a : A) (l : L) => Commute.all (algebraMap A B a) (g l))
  have hclosed : IsClosed (f.toLinearMap.range : Set B) :=
    Submodule.closed_of_finiteDimensional (𝕜 := A) f.toLinearMap.range
  have hrange : Set.range g ⊆ (f.toLinearMap.range : Set B) := by
    rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[K] l, ?_⟩
    change f (1 ⊗ₜ[K] l) = g l
    exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul (Algebra.ofId A B) g
      (fun (a : A) (l : L) => Commute.all (algebraMap A B a) (g l)) 1 l).trans
      (by rw [map_one, one_mul])
  change Function.Surjective f
  intro b
  exact closure_minimal hrange hclosed (hg b)

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.mem_fieldRange_of_isSeparable_of_isSepClosed
statement:
theorem mem_fieldRange_of_isSeparable_of_isSepClosed
    (i : S →ₐ[K] E) {x : E} (hx : IsSeparable K x) : x ∈ i.fieldRange
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra S E := i.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hxS : x ∈ separableClosure S E := IsSeparable.tower_top S hx
  have hbot : separableClosure S E = ⊥ :=
    IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isSepClosed_of_isSeparable (separableClosure S E)
  rw [hbot] at hxS
  exact AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr (IntermediateField.mem_bot.mp hxS)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.denseRange_pi_withVal
statement:
theorem denseRange_pi_withVal :
    DenseRange (fun x : K => fun i => WithVal.toVal (D i).valuation x)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  apply mem_closure_iff.mpr
  intro U hU ha
  have hUnhds := hU.mem_nhds ha
  rw [nhds_pi, Filter.mem_pi'] at hUnhds
  obtain ⟨I, V, hV, hVU⟩ := hUnhds
  have hradius (i : ι) : ∃ b : K, b ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x : K, (D i).valuation (x - WithVal.equiv (D i).valuation (a i)) <
          (D i).valuation b →
        WithVal.toVal (D i).valuation x ∈ V i := by
    let v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal (D i).valuation) (D i).ValueGroup := Valued.v
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := (Valued.mem_nhds (Γ₀ := (D i).ValueGroup)).mp (hV i)
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀.restrict₀_surjective
      (.ofClass v) (γ : v.ValueGroup₀)
    have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      subst b
      rw [map_zero] at hb
      exact (Units.ne_zero γ) hb.symm
    refine ⟨WithVal.equiv (D i).valuation b, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (map_ne_zero (WithVal.equiv (D i).valuation)).mpr hb0
    · intro x hx
      apply hγ
      change v.restrict
        (WithVal.toVal (D i).valuation x - a i) < (γ : v.ValueGroup₀)
      rw [← hb]
      apply v.restrict_lt_iff.mpr
      exact hx
  choose b hb hball using hradius
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_forall_valuation_sub_lt D hD
    (fun i => WithVal.equiv (D i).valuation (a i)) b hb
  exact ⟨fun i => WithVal.toVal (D i).valuation x,
    hVU (fun i _ => hball i x (hx i)), ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.denseRange_pi_completion
statement:
theorem denseRange_pi_completion :
    DenseRange (fun x : K => fun i =>
      algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion x)
proof:
:= by
  let f : (i : ι) → WithVal (D i).valuation → (D i).valuation.Completion :=
    fun _ => UniformSpace.Completion.coe'
  have hdense : DenseRange (Pi.map f) :=
    DenseRange.piMap (fun _ => UniformSpace.Completion.denseRange_coe)
  exact hdense.comp (denseRange_pi_withVal D hD)
    (continuous_pi (fun i =>
      (UniformSpace.Completion.continuous_coe
        (α := WithVal (D i).valuation)).comp (continuous_apply i)))

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.exists_isSeparable_adjoin_eq_of_denseRange
statement:
theorem exists_isSeparable_adjoin_eq_of_denseRange
    {K A : Type*} [Field K] [NontriviallyNormedField A]
    [CompleteSpace A] [IsUltrametricDist A] [Algebra K A]
    (hd : DenseRange (algebraMap K A)) (α : AlgebraicClosure A)
    (hα : IsSeparable A α) :
    ∃ β : AlgebraicClosure A, IsSeparable K β ∧ A⟮β⟯ = A⟮α⟯ ∧
      (minpoly K β).natDegree = (minpoly A α).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, β, hg, hdegree, hroot, hαβ⟩ :=
    exists_monic_root_with_adjoin_containment hd α hα
  have hrootA : aeval β (g.map (algebraMap K A)) = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact hroot
  have hβK : IsIntegral K β := ⟨g, hg, hroot⟩
  have hβA : IsIntegral A β :=
    ⟨g.map (algebraMap K A), hg.map (algebraMap K A), hrootA⟩
  have : FiniteDimensional A A⟮β⟯ := IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional hβA
  have hβdegree : (minpoly A β).natDegree ≤ (minpoly A α).natDegree := by
    calc
      (minpoly A β).natDegree ≤ (g.map (algebraMap K A)).natDegree :=
        Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd (minpoly.dvd A β hrootA)
          (hg.map (algebraMap K A)).ne_zero
      _ = g.natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_map (algebraMap K A)
      _ = (minpoly A α).natDegree := hdegree
  have heq : A⟮α⟯ = A⟮β⟯ := by
    apply IntermediateField.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le
      (IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr hαβ)
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hβA, IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hα.isIntegral]
    exact hβdegree
  have hβAsep : IsSeparable A β := by
    apply mem_separableClosure_iff.mp
    have hle : A⟮α⟯ ≤ separableClosure A (AlgebraicClosure A) :=
      IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr (mem_separableClosure_iff.mpr hα)
    apply hle
    rw [heq]
    exact IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self A β
  have hdegreeA : (minpoly A β).natDegree = (minpoly A α).natDegree := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hβA,
      ← IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hα.isIntegral, heq]
  have hgmap : g.map (algebraMap K A) = minpoly A β := by
    apply Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
      (minpoly.monic hβA) (hg.map (algebraMap K A)) (minpoly.dvd A β hrootA)
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_map, hdegree, hdegreeA]
  have hgsep : g.Separable := by
    apply (Polynomial.separable_map (algebraMap K A)).mp
    rw [hgmap]
    exact hβAsep
  have hminmap : (minpoly K β).map (algebraMap K A) = minpoly A β :=
    minpoly.map_algebraMap hβK ((Polynomial.mem_lifts (minpoly A β)).mpr ⟨g, hgmap⟩)
  refine ⟨β, hgsep.of_dvd (minpoly.dvd K β hroot), heq.symm, ?_⟩
  have hminDegree := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree hminmap
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_map] at hminDegree
  exact hminDegree.trans hdegreeA

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.completionAbsoluteGaloisEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem completionAbsoluteGaloisEquiv_apply
    (i : SeparableClosure K →ₐ[K] SeparableClosure base.valuation.Completion)
    (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K) (s : SeparableClosure K) :
    AlgEquiv.toAlgHom (base.completionAbsoluteGaloisEquiv i σ)
      (i s : AlgebraicClosure base.valuation.Completion) =
      (i (Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv K σ s) :
        AlgebraicClosure base.valuation.Completion)
proof:
:= by
  let r := Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv base.valuation.Completion
  change r.symm (base.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv i
    (Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K σ))
      (i s : AlgebraicClosure base.valuation.Completion) = _
  rw [← Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv_apply, r.apply_symm_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun x : SeparableClosure base.valuation.Completion =>
    (x : AlgebraicClosure base.valuation.Completion))
      (base.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv_apply i
        (Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K σ) s)

proof:
:= by

statement:
@[simp] theorem separableClosedTensorEquiv_tmul [IsSepClosed S]

:=

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.exists_completion_extension_generator
statement:
theorem exists_completion_extension_generator (base : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (E : Type w) [Field E] [Algebra base.valuation.Completion E]
    [Algebra K E] [IsScalarTower K base.valuation.Completion E]
    [FiniteDimensional base.valuation.Completion E]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable base.valuation.Completion E] :
    ∃ γ : E, IsSeparable K γ ∧
      Algebra.adjoin base.valuation.Completion ({γ} : Set E) = ⊤ ∧
      (minpoly K γ).natDegree = Module.finrank base.valuation.Completion E
proof:
:= by
  have : (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation)
      base.ValueGroup).IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    Valuation.isRankOneDiscrete_comap_ringEquiv base.valuation (WithVal.equiv base.valuation)
  let : (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup).RankOne :=
    _root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.rankOne
      (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup)
      (e := 2) (by norm_num)
  let : NontriviallyNormedField (WithVal base.valuation) :=
    Valued.toNontriviallyNormedField (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup
  let : NontriviallyNormedField base.valuation.Completion :=
    { (inferInstance : NormedField base.valuation.Completion) with
      non_trivial := by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := NormedField.exists_one_lt_norm (WithVal base.valuation)
        exact ⟨(k : base.valuation.Completion),
          (UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe k).symm ▸ hk⟩ }
  have : IsUltrametricDist base.valuation.Completion :=
    IsUltrametricDist.of_normedAlgebra (WithVal base.valuation)
  exact Completion.exists_isSeparable_generator_of_denseRange (E := E)
    (WithVal.denseRange_algebraMap_completion base.valuation)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.continuous_separableClosedAutEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem continuous_separableClosedAutEquiv_symm (i : S →ₐ[K] E) :
    Continuous (base.separableClosedAutEquiv i).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_one (base.separableClosedAutEquiv i).symm
  rw [Filter.Tendsto]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFU⟩ := (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff K S U).mp hU
  let pb : PowerBasis K F := Field.powerBasisOfFiniteOfSeparable K F
  have hH : (MulAction.stabilizer (E ≃ₐ[base.valuation.Completion] E)
      (i (pb.gen : S)) : Set (E ≃ₐ[base.valuation.Completion] E)) ∈ 𝓝 1 :=
    (stabilizer_isOpen_of_isIntegral (K := base.valuation.Completion)
      (i (pb.gen : S))).mem_nhds (Subgroup.one_mem _)
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset hH
  intro σ hσ
  apply hFU
  have hgen : (base.separableClosedAutEquiv i).symm σ (pb.gen : S) = (pb.gen : S) := by
    apply i.injective
    change i ((base.separableClosedAutEquiv i).symm σ (pb.gen : S)) = i (pb.gen : S)
    rw [separableClosedAutEquiv_symm_apply]
    exact MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp hσ
  have hhom : ((base.separableClosedAutEquiv i).symm σ).toAlgHom.comp F.val = F.val :=
    pb.algHom_ext hgen
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff F
    ((base.separableClosedAutEquiv i).symm σ)).mpr
  intro s hs
  exact congrArg (fun f : F →ₐ[K] S => f ⟨s, hs⟩) hhom

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.continuous_separableClosureAutEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem continuous_separableClosureAutEquiv_symm :
    Continuous (separableClosureAutEquiv K).symm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_one (separableClosureAutEquiv K).symm
  rw [Filter.Tendsto]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFU⟩ :=
    (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff K (AlgebraicClosure K) U).mp hU
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin (Module.finrank K F)) K F := Module.finBasis K F
  let q : ℕ := ringExpChar (SeparableClosure K)
  have : ExpChar (AlgebraicClosure K) q :=
    expChar_of_injective_ringHom
      (algebraMap (SeparableClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)).injective q
  have hpowers : ∀ j : Fin (Module.finrank K F),
      ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ y : SeparableClosure K,
        (y : AlgebraicClosure K) = (b j : AlgebraicClosure K) ^ (q ^ n) := by
    intro j
    exact IsPurelyInseparable.pow_mem (SeparableClosure K) q
      (b j : AlgebraicClosure K)
  choose n y hy using hpowers
  have hH : (⋂ j, (MulAction.stabilizer Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) (y j) :
      Set Gal(SeparableClosure K/K))) ∈ 𝓝 1 :=
    Filter.iInter_mem.mpr fun j =>
      (stabilizer_isOpen_of_isIntegral (K := K) (y j)).mem_nhds (Subgroup.one_mem _)
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset hH
  intro τ hτ
  apply hFU
  have hfixed : ∀ j : Fin (Module.finrank K F),
      (separableClosureAutEquiv K).symm τ (b j : AlgebraicClosure K) =
        (b j : AlgebraicClosure K) := by
    intro j
    apply iterateFrobenius_inj (AlgebraicClosure K) q (n j)
    change ((separableClosureAutEquiv K).symm τ (b j : AlgebraicClosure K)) ^
      (q ^ n j) = (b j : AlgebraicClosure K) ^ (q ^ n j)
    rw [← map_pow, ← hy j, ← separableClosureAutEquiv_apply, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact congrArg (fun z : SeparableClosure K => (z : AlgebraicClosure K))
      (MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp (Set.mem_iInter.mp hτ j))
  have hlin : (((separableClosureAutEquiv K).symm τ).toAlgHom.comp F.val).toLinearMap =
      F.val.toLinearMap := b.ext hfixed
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff F
    ((separableClosureAutEquiv K).symm τ)).mpr
  intro x hx
  exact congrArg (fun f : F →ₗ[K] AlgebraicClosure K => f ⟨x, hx⟩) hlin

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv_apply
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) (s : SeparableClosure K) :
    (separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K σ s : AlgebraicClosure K) =
      σ (s : AlgebraicClosure K)
proof:
:=
  separableClosureAutEquiv_apply K σ s

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completion_adjoin_range_eq_top
statement:
theorem completion_adjoin_range_eq_top [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    Algebra.adjoin base.valuation.Completion
      (Set.range (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let S := Algebra.adjoin base.valuation.Completion
    (Set.range (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion))
  apply top_le_iff.mp
  intro y hy
  clear hy
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := completionTensorHom_surjective base target y
  refine TensorProduct.inductionOn z ?_ ?_
  · intro a l
    rw [completionTensorHom_tmul]
    exact S.mul_mem (S.algebraMap_mem a) (Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨l, rfl⟩)
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [map_add]
    exact S.add_mem hx hy

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completion_isCyclotomicExtension
statement:
theorem completion_isCyclotomicExtension (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {n} K L] :
    IsCyclotomicExtension {n} base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {n} K L
  have : IsScalarTower K base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion :=
    completion_isScalarTower base target
  let S := Algebra.adjoin base.valuation.Completion
    {x : target.valuation.Completion | x ^ n = 1}
  apply (IsCyclotomicExtension.iff_singleton n _ _).mpr
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := IsCyclotomicExtension.exists_isPrimitiveRoot K L
      (Set.mem_singleton n) (NeZero.ne n)
    exact ⟨algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion ζ,
      hζ.map_of_injective (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion).injective⟩
  · intro y
    have hL (x : L) : algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion x ∈ S := by
      have hx := (IsCyclotomicExtension.iff_singleton n K L).mp
        (inferInstance : IsCyclotomicExtension {n} K L) |>.2 x
      induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
      | mem x hx =>
          apply Algebra.subset_adjoin
          change (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion x) ^ n = 1
          rw [← map_pow, hx, map_one]
      | algebraMap k =>
          change algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion (algebraMap K L k) ∈ S
          have hbase := completionMap_coe_base base target k
          change completionMap base target (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion k) =
            algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion (algebraMap K L k) at hbase
          rw [← hbase]
          exact S.algebraMap_mem (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion k)
      | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
          rw [map_add]
          exact S.add_mem hx hy
      | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
          rw [map_mul]
          exact S.mul_mem hx hy
    have hgen : Algebra.adjoin base.valuation.Completion
        (Set.range (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion)) ≤ S := by
      apply Algebra.adjoin_le
      rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact hL x
    rw [completion_adjoin_range_eq_top base target] at hgen
    exact hgen (show y ∈ (⊤ : Subalgebra base.valuation.Completion
      target.valuation.Completion) from trivial)

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.exists_pos_le_norm_sub_conjugate
statement:
private theorem exists_pos_le_norm_sub_conjugate
    {A Ω : Type*} [Field A] [NormedField Ω] [Algebra A Ω]
    (α : Ω) (hα : IsIntegral A α) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ α' : Ω, IsConjRoot A α α' → α ≠ α' →
      δ ≤ ‖α - α'‖
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set Ω := (minpoly A α).rootSet Ω \ {α}
  have hsfinite : s.Finite := ((minpoly A α).rootSet_finite Ω).sdiff
  have hclosed : IsClosed s := hsfinite.isClosed
  have hαmem : α ∈ sᶜ := fun h => h.2 rfl
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hclosed.isOpen_compl α hαmem
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro α' hconj hne
  apply le_of_not_gt
  intro hlt
  have hroot : α' ∈ (minpoly A α).rootSet Ω :=
    (isConjRoot_iff_mem_minpoly_rootSet hα).mp hconj
  have hmem : α' ∈ s := ⟨hroot, fun heq => hne heq.symm⟩
  apply (hball ?_) hmem
  simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hlt

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.exists_monic_root_with_adjoin_containment_of_normed
statement:
private theorem exists_monic_root_with_adjoin_containment_of_normed
    {K A Ω : Type*} [Field K] [NontriviallyNormedField A]
    [CompleteSpace A] [IsUltrametricDist A] [NormedField Ω]
    [Algebra K A] [NormedAlgebra A Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsScalarTower K A Ω]
    [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic A Ω]
    (hd : DenseRange (algebraMap K A)) (α : Ω) (hα : IsSeparable A α) :
    ∃ g : K[X], ∃ β : Ω, g.Monic ∧
      g.natDegree = (minpoly A α).natDegree ∧ g.aeval β = 0 ∧
        α ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin A ({β} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  let f : A[X] := minpoly A α
  have hfmonic : f.Monic := minpoly.monic hα.isIntegral
  have hfpos : 0 < f.natDegree := minpoly.natDegree_pos hα.isIntegral
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hdist⟩ := exists_pos_le_norm_sub_conjugate α hα.isIntegral
  let ε : ℝ := (δ / max ‖α‖ 1) ^ f.natDegree / (f.natDegree + 1)
  have hm : 0 < max ‖α‖ 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right ‖α‖ 1)
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < f.natDegree + 1 := by positivity
  have hε : 0 < ε := div_pos (pow_pos (div_pos hδ hm) f.natDegree) hn
  obtain ⟨g, hgmonic, hgdegree, hgcoeff⟩ :=
    exists_monic_and_natDegree_eq_and_norm_map_algebraMap_coeff_sub_lt hd hfmonic hε
  have hgmapdegree : (g.map (algebraMap K A)).natDegree = f.natDegree :=
    (hgmonic.natDegree_map (algebraMap K A)).trans hgdegree.symm
  obtain ⟨β, hβroot, hβdist⟩ := exists_aroots_norm_sub_lt_of_norm_coeff_sub_lt
    hε (minpoly.aeval A α) hfmonic (hgmonic.map (algebraMap K A)) hgmapdegree
    hgcoeff (IsAlgClosed.splits
      ((g.map (algebraMap K A)).map (algebraMap A Ω)))
  have hbound :
      ((f.natDegree + 1) * ε) ^ (f.natDegree : ℝ)⁻¹ * max ‖α‖ 1 = δ := by
    have hmul : (f.natDegree + 1) * ε = (δ / max ‖α‖ 1) ^ f.natDegree := by
      dsimp only [ε]
      field_simp
    rw [hmul, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt (div_pos hδ hm)),
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hfpos)), Real.rpow_one,
      div_mul_cancel₀ δ (ne_of_gt hm)]
  rw [hbound] at hβdist
  have hβmap : (g.map (algebraMap K A)).aeval β = 0 :=
    (mem_aroots.mp hβroot).2
  have hβ : g.aeval β = 0 := by
    rwa [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] at hβmap
  refine ⟨g, β, hgmonic, hgdegree.symm, hβ, ?_⟩
  exact IsKrasner.krasner hα
    (IsAlgClosed.splits ((minpoly A α).map (algebraMap A Ω)))
    ⟨g.map (algebraMap K A), hgmonic.map (algebraMap K A), hβmap⟩
    (fun α' hconj hne => hβdist.trans_le (hdist α' hconj hne))

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.exists_monic_root_with_adjoin_containment
statement:
theorem exists_monic_root_with_adjoin_containment
    {K A : Type*} [Field K] [NontriviallyNormedField A]
    [CompleteSpace A] [IsUltrametricDist A] [Algebra K A]
    (hd : DenseRange (algebraMap K A)) (α : AlgebraicClosure A)
    (hα : IsSeparable A α) :
    ∃ g : K[X], ∃ β : AlgebraicClosure A, g.Monic ∧
      g.natDegree = (minpoly A α).natDegree ∧ g.aeval β = 0 ∧
        α ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin A ({β} : Set (AlgebraicClosure A))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.withValMap_uniformContinuous
statement:
theorem withValMap_uniformContinuous :
    UniformContinuous (WithVal.map base.valuation target.valuation (algebraMap K L))
proof:
:= by
  let v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup := Valued.v
  let w : _root_.Valuation (WithVal target.valuation) target.ValueGroup := Valued.v
  let f : WithVal base.valuation →+* WithVal target.valuation :=
    WithVal.map base.valuation target.valuation (algebraMap K L)
  have : w.IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    Valuation.isRankOneDiscrete_comap_ringEquiv target.valuation (WithVal.equiv target.valuation)
  have : MulArchimedean w.ValueGroup₀ :=
    (_root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt w).symm.mulArchimedean
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := base.exists_uniformizer
  let p : WithVal base.valuation := WithVal.toVal base.valuation (π : K)
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hpzero
    exact hπ.ne_zero (congrArg (WithVal.equiv base.valuation) hpzero)
  have hfp : w.restrict (f p) < 1 := by
    apply w.restrict_lt_one_iff.mpr
    exact (_root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_lt_one_iff
      base.valuation target.valuation (π : K)).mpr hπ.val_lt_one
  change UniformContinuous f
  refine
    ((Valued.hasBasis_uniformity (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup).uniformContinuous_iff
    (Valued.hasBasis_uniformity (WithVal target.valuation) target.ValueGroup)).mpr ?_
  intro γ hγ
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt₀ hfp γ
  have hpn : v.restrict (p ^ n) ≠ 0 :=
    v.restrict.ne_zero_iff.mpr (pow_ne_zero n hp)
  let δ : (ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass v))ˣ := Units.mk0 (v.restrict (p ^ n)) hpn
  refine ⟨δ, trivial, ?_⟩
  intro x y hxy
  have hsource : base.valuation ((WithVal.equiv base.valuation) (y - x)) <
      base.valuation ((WithVal.equiv base.valuation) (p ^ n)) :=
    v.restrict_lt_iff.mp hxy
  have htarget : w (f (y - x)) < w (f (p ^ n)) :=
    (_root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_lt_iff base.valuation target.valuation
      ((WithVal.equiv base.valuation) (y - x))
      ((WithVal.equiv base.valuation) (p ^ n))).mpr hsource
  change w.restrict (f y - f x) < (γ : w.ValueGroup₀)
  rw [← map_sub]
  calc
    w.restrict (f (y - x)) < w.restrict (f (p ^ n)) := w.restrict_lt_iff.mpr htarget
    _ = w.restrict (f p) ^ n := by rw [map_pow, map_pow]
    _ < γ := hn

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionMap_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem completionMap_coe (x : WithVal base.valuation) :
    completionMap base target (x : base.valuation.Completion) =
      (WithVal.map base.valuation target.valuation (algebraMap K L) x :
        target.valuation.Completion)
proof:
:=
  UniformSpace.Completion.mapRingHom_coe
    (withValMap_uniformContinuous base target).continuous x

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionMap_coe_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem completionMap_coe_base (x : K) :
    completionMap base target (x : base.valuation.Completion) =
      (algebraMap K L x : target.valuation.Completion)
proof:
:=
  completionMap_coe base target (WithVal.toVal base.valuation x)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.extendSeparableClosedAut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendSeparableClosedAut_apply (i : S →ₐ[K] E)
    (σ : S ≃ₐ[K] S) (s : S) :
    base.extendSeparableClosedAut i σ (i s) = i (σ s)
proof:
:= by
  let e : base.valuation.Completion ⊗[K] S ≃ₐ[base.valuation.Completion] E :=
    base.separableClosedTensorEquiv i
  have he (t : S) : e (1 ⊗ₜ[K] t) = i t := by
    change base.separableClosedTensorEquiv i (1 ⊗ₜ[K] t) = i t
    rw [separableClosedTensorEquiv_tmul, map_one, one_mul]
  change e ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr
    (AlgEquiv.refl : base.valuation.Completion ≃ₐ[base.valuation.Completion]
      base.valuation.Completion) σ) (e.symm (i s))) = i (σ s)
  rw [← he s, e.symm_apply_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  exact he (σ s)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.extendSeparableClosedAut_mul
statement:
theorem extendSeparableClosedAut_mul (i : S →ₐ[K] E) (σ τ : S ≃ₐ[K] S) :
    base.extendSeparableClosedAut i (σ * τ) =
      base.extendSeparableClosedAut i σ * base.extendSeparableClosedAut i τ
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective
  apply AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (base.toDVF.adjoin_range_eq_top_of_isSepClosed i)
  rintro x ⟨s, rfl⟩
  change base.extendSeparableClosedAut i (σ * τ) (i s) =
    base.extendSeparableClosedAut i σ (base.extendSeparableClosedAut i τ (i s))
  rw [extendSeparableClosedAut_apply, extendSeparableClosedAut_apply,
    extendSeparableClosedAut_apply]
  rfl

name: WithVal.uniformContinuousConstSMul_algebra
statement:
theorem uniformContinuousConstSMul_algebra {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [Algebra R K] (v : Valuation K Γ) :
    UniformContinuousConstSMul R (WithVal v) where
  uniformContinuous_const_smul r
proof:
:= by
    have heq : (fun x : WithVal v => r • x) =
        (fun x => WithVal.toVal v (algebraMap R K r) * x) := by
      funext x
      apply WithVal.ofVal_injective v
      exact Algebra.smul_def r x.ofVal
    rw [heq]
    exact uniformContinuous_mul_left' _

name: WithVal.denseRange_algebraMap_completion
statement:
theorem denseRange_algebraMap_completion {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (v : Valuation R Γ) :
    DenseRange (algebraMap R v.Completion)
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : Set.range (algebraMap R v.Completion) =
      Set.range ((↑) : WithVal v → v.Completion) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨WithVal.toVal v k, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨WithVal.equiv v k, rfl⟩
  intro x
  rw [hrange]
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.denseRange_coe x

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.exists_finiteSubfield_tensor_lift
statement:
theorem exists_finiteSubfield_tensor_lift
    {K A L : Type*} [Field K] [CommRing A] [Field L]
    [Algebra K A] [Algebra K L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]
    (z : A ⊗[K] L) :
    ∃ F : IntermediateField K L, FiniteDimensional K F ∧
      ∃ w : A ⊗[K] F,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.map (R := K) (S := A) (AlgHom.id A A) F.val w = z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hz⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finset z
  let t : Finset L := s.image Prod.snd
  let F : IntermediateField K L := IntermediateField.adjoin K (t : Set L)
  have hfinite : FiniteDimensional K F :=
    IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin
      (fun l _ => Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral l)
  have hmem (p : s) : p.val.2 ∈ F :=
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K (t : Set L)
      (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨p.val, p.property, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨F, hfinite, ∑ p : s, p.val.1 ⊗ₜ[K] (⟨p.val.2, hmem p⟩ : F), ?_⟩
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply]
  change (∑ p : s, p.val.1 ⊗ₜ[K] p.val.2) = z
  exact (Finset.sum_coe_sort s (fun p : A × L => p.1 ⊗ₜ[K] p.2)).trans hz.symm

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.isSeparable_coeff_of_monic_dvd_map
statement:
theorem isSeparable_coeff_of_monic_dvd_map
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    {f : K[X]} (hf : f.Separable) {g : L[X]} (hg : g.Monic)
    (hdiv : g ∣ f.map (algebraMap K L)) (i : ℕ) :
    IsSeparable K (g.coeff i)
proof:
:= by
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure L
  let E : IntermediateField K Ω := separableClosure K Ω
  let q : Ω[X] := g.map (algebraMap L Ω)
  have hdivΩ : q ∣ f.map (algebraMap K Ω) := by
    have h := Polynomial.map_dvd (algebraMap L Ω) hdiv
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq K L Ω] at h
    exact h
  have hfΩ : f.map (algebraMap K Ω) ≠ 0 :=
    (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap K Ω).injective).mpr hf.ne_zero
  have hroots : ∀ a ∈ q.roots, a ∈ E.val.toRingHom.range := by
    intro a ha
    have hfa : a ∈ (f.map (algebraMap K Ω)).roots :=
      Multiset.mem_of_le (Polynomial.roots.le_of_dvd hfΩ hdivΩ) ha
    have hzero : aeval a f = 0 :=
      (Polynomial.mem_roots_map_of_injective
        (algebraMap K Ω).injective hf.ne_zero).mp hfa
    have hsep : IsSeparable K a := hf.of_dvd (minpoly.dvd K a hzero)
    exact ⟨⟨a, mem_separableClosure_iff.mpr hsep⟩, rfl⟩
  have hlifts : q ∈ Polynomial.lifts E.val.toRingHom :=
    (IsAlgClosed.splits q).mem_lift_of_roots_mem_range
      (hg.map (algebraMap L Ω)) E.val.toRingHom hroots
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts q).mp hlifts i
  have hcoeff : IsSeparable K (q.coeff i) := by
    rw [← hc]
    exact mem_separableClosure_iff.mp c.2
  let j : L →ₐ[K] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L Ω
  apply (isSeparable_map_iff j j.injective).mp
  change IsSeparable K (algebraMap L Ω (g.coeff i))
  simpa only [q, Polynomial.coeff_map] using hcoeff

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completion_isScalarTower
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro k a b
  change completionMap base target (k • a) * b = k • (completionMap base target a * b)
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun c => c * (completionMap base target a * b))
    (completionMap_coe_base base target k)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completion_continuousSMul
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  change Continuous (fun p : base.valuation.Completion × target.valuation.Completion =>
    completionMap base target p.1 * p.2)
  exact (UniformSpace.Completion.continuous_map.comp continuous_fst).mul continuous_snd

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionTensorHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem completionTensorHom_tmul (a : base.valuation.Completion) (l : L) :
    completionTensorHom base target (a ⊗ₜ[K] l) =
      completionMap base target a * (l : target.valuation.Completion)
proof:
:= by
  exact Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul (R := K) (S := K)
    (completionMapAlgHom base target) (toCompletionAlgHom (K := K) target)
    (fun b m => Commute.all (completionMap base target b)
      (toCompletionAlgHom (K := K) target m)) a l

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionTensorHom_surjective
statement:
theorem completionTensorHom_surjective [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    Function.Surjective (completionTensorHom base target)
proof:
:= by
  have : @IsScalarTower K base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion
      _ (completionAlgebra base target).toSMul _ :=
    completion_isScalarTower base target
  have : (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation)
      base.ValueGroup).IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    Valuation.isRankOneDiscrete_comap_ringEquiv base.valuation (WithVal.equiv base.valuation)
  let : (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup).RankOne :=
    _root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.rankOne
      (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup)
      (e := 2) (by norm_num)
  let : NontriviallyNormedField (WithVal base.valuation) :=
    Valued.toNontriviallyNormedField (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup
  let : NontriviallyNormedField base.valuation.Completion :=
    { (inferInstance : NormedField base.valuation.Completion) with
      non_trivial := by
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := NormedField.exists_one_lt_norm (WithVal base.valuation)
        exact ⟨(k : base.valuation.Completion),
          (UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe k).symm ▸ hk⟩ }
  have : @ContinuousSMul base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion
      (completionAlgebra base target).toSMul _ _ :=
    completion_continuousSMul base target
  have hdense : DenseRange (toCompletionAlgHom (K := K) target) := by
    change DenseRange (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion)
    exact WithVal.denseRange_algebraMap_completion target.valuation
  have honto := Completion.tensorProduct_lift_surjective_of_denseRange
    (A := base.valuation.Completion) (toCompletionAlgHom (K := K) target) hdense
  have heq : completionTensorHom base target =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (R := K) (S := base.valuation.Completion)
        (Algebra.ofId base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion)
        (toCompletionAlgHom (K := K) target)
        (fun a l => Commute.all (completionMap base target a)
          (toCompletionAlgHom (K := K) target l)) := by
    apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext'
    intro a l
    exact completionTensorHom_tmul base target a l
  exact heq.symm ▸ honto

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completion_finiteDimensional
proof:
:= by
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective (completionTensorHom base target).toLinearMap
    (completionTensorHom_surjective base target)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionTensorHom_injective
statement:
theorem completionTensorHom_injective [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [HenselianRing base.valuationSubring base.maximalIdeal] :
    Function.Injective (completionTensorHom base target)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionTensorEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem completionTensorEquiv_tmul [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [HenselianRing base.valuationSubring base.maximalIdeal]
    (a : base.valuation.Completion) (l : L) :
    completionTensorEquiv base target (a ⊗ₜ[K] l) =
      completionMap base target a * (l : target.valuation.Completion)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.finrank_completion
statement:
theorem finrank_completion [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [HenselianRing base.valuationSubring base.maximalIdeal] :
    @Module.finrank base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion _ _
      (completionAlgebra base target).toModule =
      Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (completionTensorEquiv base target).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]
  exact Module.finrank_baseChange

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionAlgEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem completionAlgEquiv_algebraMap (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (hτ : target.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom))
    (x : L) :
    completionAlgEquiv base target τ hτ (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion x) =
      algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion (τ x)
proof:
:=
  completionRingEquiv_algebraMap target target τ.toRingEquiv hτ x

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionAlgEquiv_injective
statement:
theorem completionAlgEquiv_injective
    (hstable : ∀ τ : Gal(L/K),
      target.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) :
    Function.Injective (fun τ => completionAlgEquiv base target τ (hstable τ))
proof:
:= by
  intro τ σ h
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion).injective
  exact (completionAlgEquiv_algebraMap base target τ (hstable τ) x).symm.trans
    ((DFunLike.congr_fun h (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion x)).trans
      (completionAlgEquiv_algebraMap base target σ (hstable σ) x))

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.finrank_completion_le
statement:
theorem finrank_completion_le [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    Module.finrank base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion ≤
      Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective
    (f := (completionTensorHom base target).toLinearMap)
    (completionTensorHom_surjective base target)
  exact h.trans_eq Module.finrank_baseChange

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.finrank_completion_eq_of_galois_stable
statement:
theorem finrank_completion_eq_of_galois_stable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (hstable : ∀ τ : Gal(L/K),
      target.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) :
    Module.finrank base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion =
      Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion :=
    completion_finiteDimensional base target
  apply le_antisymm (finrank_completion_le base target)
  calc
    Module.finrank K L = Nat.card Gal(L/K) := (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).symm
    _ ≤ Nat.card Gal(target.valuation.Completion/base.valuation.Completion) :=
      Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ (completionAlgEquiv_injective base target hstable)
    _ ≤ Module.finrank base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion := by
      rw [← Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
      exact AlgEquiv.card_le

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completion_isGalois_of_stable
statement:
theorem completion_isGalois_of_stable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (hstable : ∀ τ : Gal(L/K),
      target.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) :
    IsGalois base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion :=
    completion_finiteDimensional base target
  apply IsGalois.of_card_aut_eq_finrank
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
    exact AlgEquiv.card_le
  · rw [finrank_completion_eq_of_galois_stable base target hstable,
      ← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L]
    exact Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ (completionAlgEquiv_injective base target hstable)

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF.completionAlgEquiv_surjective
statement:
theorem completionAlgEquiv_surjective [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (hstable : ∀ τ : Gal(L/K),
      target.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) :
    Function.Surjective (fun τ => completionAlgEquiv base target τ (hstable τ))
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion :=
    completion_finiteDimensional base target
  have : IsGalois base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion :=
    completion_isGalois_of_stable base target hstable
  exact ((completionAlgEquiv_injective base target hstable).bijective_of_nat_card_le
    (by rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank, IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank,
      finrank_completion_eq_of_galois_stable base target hstable])).2

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.exists_completion_eq_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem exists_completion_eq_of_isSeparable (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K)
    (a : base.valuation.Completion) (ha : IsSeparable K a) :
    ∃ k : K, (k : base.valuation.Completion) = a
proof:
:= by
  have : (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation)
      base.ValueGroup).IsRankOneDiscrete :=
    Valuation.isRankOneDiscrete_comap_ringEquiv base.valuation (WithVal.equiv base.valuation)
  let : (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup).RankOne :=
    _root_.Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.rankOne
      (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup)
      (e := 2) (by norm_num)
  let : NontriviallyNormedField (WithVal base.valuation) :=
    Valued.toNontriviallyNormedField (WithVal base.valuation) base.ValueGroup
  have : HenselianRing
      (NormedField.valuation (K := WithVal base.valuation)).valuationSubring
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        (NormedField.valuation (K := WithVal base.valuation)).valuationSubring) :=
    Henselian.henselianRing_maximalIdeal_of_ringEquiv
      (base.toDVF.normedWithValValuationSubringEquiv).symm
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Henselian.exists_completion_eq_of_isSeparable a
    (ha.tower_top (WithVal base.valuation))
  exact ⟨WithVal.equiv base.valuation k, hk⟩

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.completionTensor_isField_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem completionTensor_isField_of_isSeparable (base : HenselianDVF K)
    (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] :
    IsField (base.valuation.Completion ⊗[K] L)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial (base.valuation.Completion ⊗[K] L) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_isDomain
      K base.valuation.Completion L (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion).injective
      (algebraMap K L).injective
  refine
    { exists_pair_ne := exists_pair_ne (base.valuation.Completion ⊗[K] L)
      mul_comm := fun x y => mul_comm x y
      mul_inv_cancel := ?_ }
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨F, hfinite, w, hw⟩ :=
    Completion.exists_finiteSubfield_tensor_lift (K := K)
      (A := base.valuation.Completion) z
  let m :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (R := K) (S := base.valuation.Completion)
      (A := base.valuation.Completion) (B := F) (C := base.valuation.Completion) (D := L)
      (AlgHom.id base.valuation.Completion base.valuation.Completion) F.val).toRingHom
  change m w = z at hw
  have hwne : w ≠ 0 := by
    intro hwzero
    exact hz (hw.symm.trans ((congrArg m hwzero).trans m.map_zero'))
  obtain ⟨w', hprod⟩ := (base.completionTensor_isField F).mul_inv_cancel hwne
  refine ⟨m w', ?_⟩
  rw [← hw]
  exact (m.map_mul' w w').symm.trans ((congrArg m hprod).trans m.map_one')

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.restrictionHom_apply
statement:
private theorem restrictionHom_apply
    (i : S →ₐ[K] E) (σ : E ≃ₐ[K] E) (s : S) :
    i (restrictionHom i σ s) = σ (i s)
proof:
:= by
  let y : i.fieldRange :=
    ⟨σ (i s), mem_fieldRange_of_isSeparable_of_isSepClosed i
      ((Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable K s).map
        (σ.toAlgHom.comp i) (σ.toAlgHom.comp i).injective)⟩
  change (i.equivFieldRange (i.equivFieldRange.symm y) : E) = (y : E)
  exact congrArg (fun z : i.fieldRange => (z : E))
    (i.equivFieldRange.apply_symm_apply y)

name: ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosedAutRestriction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem separableClosedAutRestriction_apply
    (i : S →ₐ[K] E) (σ : E ≃ₐ[K] E) (s : S) :
    i (separableClosedAutRestriction i σ s) = σ (i s)
proof:
:=
  restrictionHom_apply i σ s

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.exists_monic_factor_of_dvd_completion
statement:
theorem exists_monic_factor_of_dvd_completion (base : HenselianDVF K)
    {f : K[X]} (hf : f.Separable) {g : base.valuation.Completion[X]}
    (hg : g.Monic) (hdiv : g ∣ f.map (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion)) :
    ∃ g₀ : K[X], g₀.Monic ∧
      g₀.map (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion) = g ∧ g₀ ∣ f
proof:
:= by
  have hlifts : g ∈ lifts (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion) := by
    rw [lifts_iff_coeff_lifts]
    intro i
    exact base.exists_completion_eq_of_isSeparable (g.coeff i)
      (Completion.isSeparable_coeff_of_monic_dvd_map hf hg hdiv i)
  obtain ⟨g₀, hmap, _, hmonic⟩ := lifts_and_degree_eq_and_monic hlifts hg
  refine ⟨g₀, hmonic, hmap, ?_⟩
  apply (map_dvd_map' (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion)).mp
  rwa [hmap]

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.irreducible_map_completion
statement:
theorem irreducible_map_completion (base : HenselianDVF K)
    {f : K[X]} (hf : f.Separable) (hirr : Irreducible f) :
    Irreducible (f.map (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion))
proof:
:= by
  have hne : f.map (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion) ≠ 0 :=
    map_ne_zero hirr.ne_zero
  have hunit : ¬ IsUnit (f.map (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion)) :=
    (isUnit_map (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion)).not.mpr hirr.not_isUnit
  apply (irreducible_iff_lt_natDegree_lt hne hunit).mpr
  intro g hg hdegree hdiv
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀, hmap, hdiv₀⟩ :=
    base.exists_monic_factor_of_dvd_completion hf hg hdiv
  have hdegree₀ : g₀.natDegree ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 (f.natDegree / 2) := by
    rw [← hmap, natDegree_map, natDegree_map] at hdegree
    exact hdegree
  exact (irreducible_iff_lt_natDegree_lt hirr.ne_zero hirr.not_isUnit).mp
    hirr g₀ hg₀ hdegree₀ hdiv₀

name: AbsoluteValue.ostrowski_gelfandMazur_of_real_rpow
statement:
private theorem ostrowski_gelfandMazur_of_real_rpow
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ)
    (hcomplete : CompleteSpace (WithAbs v))
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hnorm : ∀ q : ℚ,
      ostrowski_restrictRatAbsoluteValue (K := K) v q =
        Rat.AbsoluteValue.real q ^ s) :
    let : Algebra ℝ (WithAbs v)
proof:
:=
      ostrowski_realAlgebra_of_real_rpow (K := K) v hcomplete s hs hnorm
    Nonempty (WithAbs v ≃ₐ[ℝ] ℝ) ∨
      Nonempty (WithAbs v ≃ₐ[ℝ] ℂ) := by
  intro realAlgebra
  exact ostrowski_gelfandMazur_of_real_rpow_scalar (WithAbs v) hs
    (ostrowski_realAlgebra_norm_algebraMap_of_real_rpow
      (K := K) v hcomplete s hs hnorm)

name: AbsoluteValue.ostrowski_realAlgEquiv_norm_eq_of_real_rpow
statement:
private theorem ostrowski_realAlgEquiv_norm_eq_of_real_rpow
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ)
    (hcomplete : CompleteSpace (WithAbs v))
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hnorm : ∀ q : ℚ,
      ostrowski_restrictRatAbsoluteValue (K := K) v q =
        Rat.AbsoluteValue.real q ^ s) :
    let : Algebra ℝ (WithAbs v)
proof:
:=
      ostrowski_realAlgebra_of_real_rpow (K := K) v hcomplete s hs hnorm
    ∀ (e : WithAbs v ≃ₐ[ℝ] ℝ) (x : WithAbs v),
      ‖x‖ = ‖e x‖ ^ s := by
  intro realAlgebra e x
  have hx : x = algebraMap ℝ (WithAbs v) (e x) := by
    calc
      x = e.symm (e x) := (e.symm_apply_apply x).symm
      _ = algebraMap ℝ (WithAbs v) (e x) := by
        simpa using (AlgEquiv.commutes e.symm (e x))
  rw [hx]
  simp only [AlgEquiv.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
  exact ostrowski_realAlgebra_norm_algebraMap_of_real_rpow
    (K := K) v hcomplete s hs hnorm (e x)

name: AbsoluteValue.ostrowski_realBranch_abs_eq_of_real_rpow
statement:
private theorem ostrowski_realBranch_abs_eq_of_real_rpow
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ)
    (hcomplete : CompleteSpace (WithAbs v))
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hnorm : ∀ q : ℚ,
      ostrowski_restrictRatAbsoluteValue (K := K) v q =
        Rat.AbsoluteValue.real q ^ s) :
    let : Algebra ℝ (WithAbs v)
proof:
:=
      ostrowski_realAlgebra_of_real_rpow (K := K) v hcomplete s hs hnorm
    ∀ (e : WithAbs v ≃ₐ[ℝ] ℝ) (x : K),
      v x = ‖e ((WithAbs.equiv v).symm x)‖ ^ s := by
  intro realAlgebra e x
  change ‖((WithAbs.equiv v).symm x : WithAbs v)‖ =
    ‖e ((WithAbs.equiv v).symm x)‖ ^ s
  exact ostrowski_realAlgEquiv_norm_eq_of_real_rpow
    (K := K) v hcomplete s hs hnorm e ((WithAbs.equiv v).symm x)

name: AbsoluteValue.ostrowski_complexAlgEquiv_norm_eq_of_real_rpow
statement:
private theorem ostrowski_complexAlgEquiv_norm_eq_of_real_rpow
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ)
    (hcomplete : CompleteSpace (WithAbs v))
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hnorm : ∀ q : ℚ,
      ostrowski_restrictRatAbsoluteValue (K := K) v q =
        Rat.AbsoluteValue.real q ^ s) :
    let : Algebra ℝ (WithAbs v)
proof:
:=
      ostrowski_realAlgebra_of_real_rpow (K := K) v hcomplete s hs hnorm
    ∀ (e : WithAbs v ≃ₐ[ℝ] ℂ) (x : WithAbs v),
      ‖x‖ = ‖e x‖ ^ s := by
  intro realAlgebra e x
  calc
    ‖x‖ = ‖e.symm (e x)‖ := congrArg norm (e.symm_apply_apply x).symm
    _ = ‖e x‖ ^ s :=
        AlgEquiv.norm_symm_apply_eq_norm_rpow hs
          (ostrowski_realAlgebra_norm_algebraMap_of_real_rpow
            (K := K) v hcomplete s hs hnorm) e (e x)

name: AbsoluteValue.ostrowski_complexBranch_abs_eq_of_real_rpow
statement:
private theorem ostrowski_complexBranch_abs_eq_of_real_rpow
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ)
    (hcomplete : CompleteSpace (WithAbs v))

      ostrowski_restrictRatAbsoluteValue (K := K) v q =

proof:
:=

    ∀ (e : WithAbs v ≃ₐ[ℝ] ℂ) (x : K),
      v x = ‖e ((WithAbs.equiv v).symm x)‖ ^ s := by

  change ‖((WithAbs.equiv v).symm x : WithAbs v)‖ =
