name: DiscreteValuationField.exists_root_of_henselianRing_of_simpleRoot_mod
statement:
theorem exists_root_of_henselianRing_of_simpleRoot_mod
    (f : Polynomial V) (a₀ : V)
    (hroot : f.eval a₀ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)
    (hsimple : IsUnit
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) (f.derivative.eval a₀))) :
    ∃ a : V, f.IsRoot a ∧ a - a₀ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
proof:
:= by
  let fbar : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) :=
    f.map (IsLocalRing.residue V)
  let abar : IsLocalRing.ResidueField V := IsLocalRing.residue V a₀
  let lbar : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) :=
    Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C abar
  let qbar : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) := fbar /ₘ lbar
  have hderivative : IsUnit (fbar.derivative.eval abar) :=
    derivative_isUnit_map_quotient_mk_of_simpleRoot_mod hsimple
  have hfbar : fbar ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, Polynomial.derivative_zero, Polynomial.eval_zero] at hderivative
    exact not_isUnit_zero hderivative
  have hresidual : fbar = lbar * qbar :=
    (residual_X_sub_C_mul_divByMonic_eq_map_of_eval_mem hroot).symm
  have hcoprime : IsCoprime lbar qbar :=
    isCoprime_residual_X_sub_C_divByMonic_of_simpleRoot_mod hsimple
  obtain ⟨G, H, hGdegree, _, hfactor, hGmap, _⟩ :=
    henselFactorization_of_henselianRing V hfbar hresidual hcoprime
  have hGdegreeOne : G.natDegree = 1 := by
    rw [hGdegree]
    exact Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C abar
  have hGcoeffOne : IsLocalRing.residue V (G.coeff 1) = 1 := by
    have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) =>
      p.coeff 1) hGmap
    simpa only [lbar, Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_sub,
      Polynomial.coeff_X_one, Polynomial.coeff_C_succ, sub_zero] using hcoeff
  have hGunit : IsUnit (G.coeff 1) :=
    isUnit_of_map_unit (IsLocalRing.residue V) (G.coeff 1)
      (hGcoeffOne.symm ▸ isUnit_one)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hGunit
  let a : V := -(↑u⁻¹ * G.coeff 0)
  have hGa : G.eval a = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.eq_X_add_C_of_natDegree_le_one hGdegreeOne.le,
      Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, ← hu]
    dsimp only [a]
    rw [mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, u.mul_inv, one_mul, neg_add_cancel]
  have haRoot : f.IsRoot a := by
    rw [hfactor, Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_mul, hGa, zero_mul]
  have hmapRoot :
      (G.map (IsLocalRing.residue V)).eval (IsLocalRing.residue V a) = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply, hGa, map_zero]
  have haresidue : IsLocalRing.residue V a = abar := by
    rw [hGmap] at hmapRoot
    simpa only [lbar, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_C, sub_eq_zero] using hmapRoot
  refine ⟨a, haRoot, ?_⟩
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  change IsLocalRing.residue V (a - a₀) = 0
  rw [map_sub, haresidue, sub_self]

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.henselianRing_map_of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem henselianRing_map_of_ringEquiv
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] :
    HenselianRing S (I.map (e : R →+* S)) where
  jac
proof:
:= by
    have hmap := Ideal.map_mono (f := (e : R →+* S))
      (show I ≤ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R) from HenselianRing.jac)
    rw [Ideal.map_jacobson_of_bijective e.bijective, Ideal.map_bot] at hmap
    exact hmap
  is_henselian := by
    intro f hf a₀ hroot hsimple
    have heval (p : Polynomial S) (x : S) :
        (p.map (e.symm : S →+* R)).eval (e.symm x) = e.symm (p.eval x) :=
      Polynomial.eval_map_apply (f := (e.symm : S →+* R)) (p := p) x
    have hrootR : (f.map (e.symm : S →+* R)).eval (e.symm a₀) ∈ I := by
      rw [heval]
      exact Ideal.symm_apply_mem_of_equiv_iff.mpr hroot
    have hsimpleR : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk I
        ((f.map (e.symm : S →+* R)).derivative.eval (e.symm a₀))) := by
      rw [Polynomial.derivative_map, heval]
      exact hsimple.map
        (Ideal.quotientEquiv I (I.map (e : R →+* S)) e rfl).symm.toRingHom
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hamem⟩ := HenselianRing.is_henselian
      (f.map (e.symm : S →+* R)) (hf.map (e.symm : S →+* R))
      (e.symm a₀) hrootR hsimpleR
    refine ⟨e a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change f.eval (e a) = 0
      apply e.symm.injective
      rw [map_zero, ← heval, e.symm_apply_apply]
      exact ha
    · have hmem : e (a - e.symm a₀) ∈ I.map (e : R →+* S) :=
        Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (e : R →+* S) hamem
      rwa [map_sub, e.apply_symm_apply] at hmem

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.henselianRing_maximalIdeal_of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem henselianRing_maximalIdeal_of_ringEquiv
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] (e : R ≃+* S)
    [HenselianRing R (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)] :
    HenselianRing S (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e]
  exact henselianRing_map_of_ringEquiv e (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.exists_finiteIntermediateField_lifting_residue_roots
statement:
theorem exists_finiteIntermediateField_lifting_residue_roots
    {K : Type u} {Ω : Type v} [Field K] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω]
    {Γ : Type w} {Δ : Type x}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Δ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ) (w : Valuation Ω Δ) [v.HasExtension w]
    [HenselianRing v.valuationSubring (maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)]
    [CharZero (ResidueField v.valuationSubring)]
    (E : Type t) [Field E] [Algebra (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) E] :
    ∃ F : IntermediateField K Ω, FiniteDimensional K F ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → (∃ ζ : E, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) →
        ∃ ζ : F, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : CharZero K := by
    refine ⟨fun m n h => ?_⟩
    apply Nat.cast_injective (R := ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
    have hv : (m : v.valuationSubring) = n := Subtype.ext h
    have hr := congrArg (residue v.valuationSubring) hv
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hr
  have : IsAlgClosed Ω := IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed K
  have : IsAlgClosure (ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
      (ResidueField w.valuationSubring) := henselianResidueExtension_isAlgClosure v w
  have : IsAlgClosed (ResidueField w.valuationSubring) :=
    IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed (ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
  have : CharZero (ResidueField w.valuationSubring) :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap
      (algebraMap (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) (ResidueField w.valuationSubring)).injective
  have hcanonical :
      v.valuationSubring.valuation.HasExtension w.valuationSubring.valuation := by
    apply Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
    ext a
    change w.valuationSubring.valuation (algebraMap K Ω a) ≤ 1 ↔
      v.valuationSubring.valuation a ≤ 1
    rw [ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff, ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff]
    exact Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_le_one_iff v w a
  have : HenselianRing w.valuationSubring (maximalIdeal w.valuationSubring) :=
    henselianRing_of_algebraic_extension v.valuationSubring w.valuationSubring
  let j : E →ₐ[ResidueField v.valuationSubring] ResidueField w.valuationSubring :=
    IsAlgClosed.lift
  have : FiniteDimensional (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) j.fieldRange :=
    Module.Finite.equiv j.equivFieldRange.toLinearEquiv
  let U : OpenSubgroup
      Gal(ResidueField w.valuationSubring / ResidueField v.valuationSubring) :=
    ⟨j.fieldRange.fixingSubgroup, IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_isOpen _⟩
  let H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := U.comap (henselianResidueAction v w)
    (henselianResidueAction_continuous v w)
  let F : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  have hfix : F.fixingSubgroup = (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField (⟨H.toSubgroup, H.isClosed⟩ : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  have hfd : FiniteDimensional K F := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite F).mp
    (by rw [hfix]; exact H.isOpen)
  refine ⟨F, hfd, ?_⟩
  intro n hn ⟨ζ, hζ⟩
  have : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  have : NeZero (n : ResidueField w.valuationSubring) := ⟨Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne'⟩
  let r : rootsOfUnity n (ResidueField w.valuationSubring) :=
    rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq (j ζ) (by rw [← map_pow, hζ.pow_eq_one, map_one])
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ValuationSubring.rootsOfUnityReduction_surjective w.valuationSubring n r
  let b : w.valuationSubring := ((a : w.valuationSubringˣ) : w.valuationSubring)
  have hbpow : b ^ n = 1 := (mem_rootsOfUnity' n (a : w.valuationSubringˣ)).mp a.property
  have hbres : residue w.valuationSubring b = j ζ :=
    congrArg (fun z : rootsOfUnity n (ResidueField w.valuationSubring) =>
      ((z : (ResidueField w.valuationSubring)ˣ) : ResidueField w.valuationSubring)) ha
  have hbfix : ∀ σ ∈ (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)), σ (b : Ω) = (b : Ω) := by
    intro σ hσ
    let g : decompositionGroup K w.valuationSubring := henselianGalToDecomposition v w σ
    let c : w.valuationSubring := g • b
    have hcpow : c ^ n = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (σ (b : Ω)) ^ n = 1
      rw [← map_pow, show (b : Ω) ^ n = 1 from
        congrArg (fun z : w.valuationSubring => (z : Ω)) hbpow, map_one]
    have hcres : residue w.valuationSubring c = residue w.valuationSubring b := by
      change henselianResidueAction v w σ (residue w.valuationSubring b) = _
      rw [hbres]
      exact (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff j.fieldRange _).mp hσ _ ⟨ζ, rfl⟩
    have hca : rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq c hcpow = a := by
      apply ValuationSubring.rootsOfUnityReduction_injective w.valuationSubring n
      apply rootsOfUnity.coe_injective
      exact hcres
    exact congrArg (fun z : rootsOfUnity n w.valuationSubring =>
      (((z : w.valuationSubringˣ) : w.valuationSubring) : Ω)) hca
  let η : F := ⟨(b : Ω), by
    intro σ
    exact hbfix σ σ.property⟩
  refine ⟨η, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : w.valuationSubring => (z : Ω)) hbpow
  · intro m hm
    apply hζ.dvd_of_pow_eq_one m
    apply j.injective
    change j (ζ ^ m) = j 1
    rw [map_pow, map_one, ← hbres, ← map_pow]
    have hbm : b ^ m = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg (fun z : F => (z : Ω)) hm
    rw [hbm, map_one]

name: ValuationTheory.exists_pow_sub_eq_of_valuation_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_pow_sub_eq_of_valuation_lt_one
    {K Γ : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ)
    [HenselianRing v.valuationSubring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] (a : K) (ha : v a < 1) :
    ∃ b : K, b ^ p - b = a
proof:
:= by
  let R := v.valuationSubring
  have : CharP R p := CharP.subring K p v.valuationSubring.toSubring
  let a₀ : R := ⟨a, ha.le⟩
  let f : R[X] := X ^ p - X - C a₀
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  have hroot : f.eval 0 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    have ha₀ : a₀ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := v.mem_maximalIdeal_iff.mpr ha
    simpa only [f, eval_sub, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C, zero_pow hp0, sub_zero,
      zero_sub] using (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).neg_mem ha₀
  have hderiv : f.derivative.eval 0 = -1 := by
    simp only [f, derivative_sub, derivative_pow, derivative_X, derivative_C,
      eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C, CharP.cast_eq_zero R p, zero_mul,
      eval_one, sub_zero, zero_sub]
  have hunit : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
      (f.derivative.eval 0)) := by
    rw [hderiv, map_neg, map_one]
    exact isUnit_one.neg
  obtain ⟨b, hb, _⟩ :=
    DiscreteValuationField.exists_root_of_henselianRing_of_simpleRoot_mod
      v.valuationSubring f 0 hroot hunit
  have hbeval : b ^ p - b - a₀ = 0 := by
    simpa only [f, eval_sub, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C] using Polynomial.IsRoot.def.mp hb
  refine ⟨(b : K), ?_⟩
  exact congrArg ((↑) : R → K) (sub_eq_zero.mp hbeval)

name: ValuationTheory.isOpen_artinSchreier_range
statement:
theorem isOpen_artinSchreier_range
    {K Γ : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] [Valued K Γ]
    [HenselianRing (Valued.v : Valuation K Γ).valuationSubring
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Valued.v : Valuation K Γ).valuationSubring)]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] :
    IsOpen (((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  let v : Valuation K Γ := Valued.v
  apply AddSubgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds (g := (0 : K))
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset ((Valued.isOpen_ball K (1 : v.ValueGroup₀)).mem_nhds ?_)
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_pow_sub_eq_of_valuation_lt_one v p a
      (v.restrict_lt_one_iff.mp ha)
    exact ⟨b, hb⟩
  · change v.restrict 0 < 1
    rw [map_zero]
    exact zero_lt_one

name: ValuationTheory.exists_binomial_quadratic_remainder
statement:
private theorem exists_binomial_quadratic_remainder
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ Q : R[X], ∀ t : R, (1 + t) ^ n = 1 + (n : R) * t + t ^ 2 * Q.eval t
proof:
:= by
  have hdiv : (X : R[X]) ^ 2 ∣ (1 + X) ^ n - 1 - C (n : R) * X := by
    apply X_pow_dvd_iff.mpr
    intro k hk
    have hcases : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 := by omega
    rcases hcases with rfl | rfl
    · simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_one_add_X_pow, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one,
        coeff_one_zero, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_zero, mul_zero, sub_self]
    · simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_one_add_X_pow, Nat.choose_one_right, coeff_one,
        ite_eq_right (by decide : ¬ (1 : ℕ) = 0),
        coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_one, mul_one, sub_zero, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hdiv
  refine ⟨Q, fun t => ?_⟩
  have ht := congrArg (fun f : R[X] => f.eval t) hQ
  simp only [eval_sub, eval_pow, eval_add, eval_one, eval_X, eval_mul, eval_C] at ht
  linear_combination ht

name: ValuationTheory.exists_pow_eq_of_valuation_sub_one_lt_natCast_sq
statement:
theorem exists_pow_eq_of_valuation_sub_one_lt_natCast_sq
    {K Γ : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (v : Valuation K Γ)
    [HenselianRing v.valuationSubring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : K) ≠ 0) (a : K)
    (ha : v (a - 1) < v (n : K) ^ 2) :
    ∃ b : K, b ^ n = a
proof:
:= by
  have hnpos : 0 < v (n : K) := (v.pos_iff).mpr hn
  have hcval : v ((1 - a) / (n : K) ^ 2) < 1 := by
    rw [v.map_div, map_pow, v.map_sub_swap]
    exact (div_lt_one₀ (pow_pos hnpos 2)).mpr ha
  let R := v.valuationSubring
  let c : R := ⟨(1 - a) / (n : K) ^ 2, hcval.le⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := exists_binomial_quadratic_remainder (R := R) n
  let f : R[X] := X + X ^ 2 * Q.comp (C (n : R) * X) + C c
  have hroot : f.eval 0 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    have hc : c ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := v.mem_maximalIdeal_iff.mpr hcval
    simpa only [f, eval_add, eval_X, eval_mul, eval_pow, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
      zero_mul, zero_add, eval_C] using hc
  have hderiv : f.derivative.eval 0 = 1 := by
    simp only [f, derivative_add, derivative_X, derivative_mul, derivative_pow,
      derivative_C, eval_add, eval_one, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C,
      show (2 - 1 : ℕ) = 1 by decide, pow_one, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero,
      zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)]
  have hunit : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
      (f.derivative.eval 0)) := by
    rw [hderiv, map_one]
    exact isUnit_one
  obtain ⟨z, hz, _⟩ :=
    DiscreteValuationField.exists_root_of_henselianRing_of_simpleRoot_mod
      v.valuationSubring f 0 hroot hunit
  have hzeval : z + z ^ 2 * Q.eval ((n : R) * z) + c = 0 := by
    simpa only [f, eval_add, eval_X, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_comp, eval_C] using
      Polynomial.IsRoot.def.mp hz
  have hzK := congrArg ((↑) : R → K) hzeval
  change (z : K) + (z : K) ^ 2 * ((Q.eval ((n : R) * z) : R) : K) +
    (1 - a) / (n : K) ^ 2 = 0 at hzK
  have hexpand := congrArg ((↑) : R → K) (hQ ((n : R) * z))
  change (1 + (n : K) * (z : K)) ^ n =
    1 + (n : K) * ((n : K) * (z : K)) +
      ((n : K) * (z : K)) ^ 2 * ((Q.eval ((n : R) * z) : R) : K) at hexpand
  refine ⟨1 + (n : K) * (z : K), ?_⟩
  rw [hexpand]
  field_simp [hn] at hzK
  linear_combination hzK

name: ValuationTheory.isOpen_unit_pow_range
statement:
theorem isOpen_unit_pow_range
    {K Γ : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ] [Valued K Γ]
    [HenselianRing (Valued.v : Valuation K Γ).valuationSubring
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Valued.v : Valuation K Γ).valuationSubring)]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : K) ≠ 0) :
    IsOpen ((powMonoidHom n : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range : Set Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  let v : Valuation K Γ := Valued.v
  have hn_nat : n ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    exact hn (by rw [hzero, Nat.cast_zero])
  let U : Set Kˣ := {u | v.restrict ((u : K) - 1) < v.restrict (n : K) ^ 2}
  have hU : IsOpen U :=
    (Valued.isOpen_ball K (v.restrict (n : K) ^ 2)).preimage
      (Units.continuous_val.sub continuous_const)
  have hmem : (1 : Kˣ) ∈ U := by
    change v.restrict ((1 : K) - 1) < v.restrict (n : K) ^ 2
    rw [sub_self, map_zero]
    exact pow_pos (v.restrict.pos_iff.mpr hn) 2
  apply Subgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds (g := (1 : Kˣ))
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset (hU.mem_nhds hmem)
  intro u hu
  have hclose : v ((u : K) - 1) < v (n : K) ^ 2 := by
    change v.restrict ((u : K) - 1) < v.restrict (n : K) ^ 2 at hu
    rw [← map_pow] at hu
    simpa only [map_pow] using v.restrict_lt_iff.mp hu
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_pow_eq_of_valuation_sub_one_lt_natCast_sq v n hn (u : K) hclose
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, zero_pow hn_nat] at hb
    exact u.ne_zero hb.symm
  refine ⟨Units.mk0 b hb0, ?_⟩
  exact Units.ext hb

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.henselianRing_of_algebraic_extension
statement:
theorem henselianRing_of_algebraic_extension :
    HenselianRing W (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal W)
proof:
:= by
  have hUnique :
      AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.HasUniqueAlgebraicValuationSubringExtensions W := by
    intro M _ _ _
    let : Algebra K M := ((algebraMap L M).comp (algebraMap K L)).toAlgebra
    let : IsScalarTower K L M := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun x => rfl)
    have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K M := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans K L M
    obtain ⟨B, _, _, _, hWB⟩ :=
      (open _root_.ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation in
        exists_extension_valuationSubring_with_hasExtension (L := M) W.valuation)
    have : W.valuation.HasExtension B.valuation := hWB
    have : V.valuation.HasExtension B.valuation :=
      ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.hasExtension_trans
        V.valuation W.valuation B.valuation
    refine ⟨B, hWB, ?_⟩
    intro C hWC
    have : W.valuation.HasExtension C.valuation := hWC
    have : V.valuation.HasExtension C.valuation :=
      ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.hasExtension_trans
        V.valuation W.valuation C.valuation
    simpa only [ValuationSubring.valuationSubring_valuation] using
      valuationSubring_eq_of_henselianRing V C.valuation B.valuation
  exact _root_.DiscreteValuationField.henselianRing_of_monicResidualCoprimeFactorLifting
    (open _root_.AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations in
      monicResidualCoprimeFactorLifting_of_unique_algebraic_extensions W hUnique)

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.normed_valuationSubring_hasExtension
statement:
private theorem normed_valuationSubring_hasExtension :
    (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring.valuation.HasExtension
      (NormedField.valuation (K := L)).valuationSubring.valuation where
  val_isEquiv_comap
proof:
:= by
    rw [Valuation.isEquiv_iff_val_le_one]
    intro x
    change (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring.valuation x ≤ 1 ↔
      (NormedField.valuation (K := L)).valuationSubring.valuation
        (algebraMap K L x) ≤ 1
    rw [ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff, ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff]
    change ‖x‖₊ ≤ 1 ↔ ‖algebraMap K L x‖₊ ≤ 1
    rw [nnnorm_algebraMap']

name: ValuationTheory.Henselian.norm_algEquiv_eq_of_henselianRing
statement:
theorem norm_algEquiv_eq_of_henselianRing [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [HenselianRing (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring)]
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : L) : ‖σ x‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  let V : ValuationSubring K := (NormedField.valuation (K := K)).valuationSubring
  let W : ValuationSubring L := (NormedField.valuation (K := L)).valuationSubring
  have hW : V.valuation.HasExtension W.valuation :=
    normed_valuationSubring_hasExtension (K := K) (L := L)
  have huniq : ∀ W' : ValuationSubring L,
      V.valuation.HasExtension W'.valuation → W' = W := by
    intro W' hW'
    have : V.valuation.HasExtension W.valuation := hW
    have : V.valuation.HasExtension W'.valuation := hW'
    simpa only [ValuationSubring.valuationSubring_valuation] using
      valuationSubring_eq_of_henselianRing V W'.valuation W.valuation
  have hval : W.valuation (σ x) = W.valuation x :=
    AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.valuation_algEquiv_eq_of_unique_extension_of_finiteDimensional
      V W hW huniq σ x
  have hnorm : ‖σ x‖₊ = ‖x‖₊ :=
    (Valuation.isEquiv_valuation_valuationSubring
      (NormedField.valuation (K := L))).eq_iff.mpr hval
  exact congrArg (fun r : NNReal => (r : ℝ)) hnorm

name: ValuationSubring.rootsOfUnityReduction_injective
statement:
theorem rootsOfUnityReduction_injective
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)] :
    Function.Injective (restrictRootsOfUnity (IsLocalRing.residue A) n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hres : IsLocalRing.residue A ((x : Aˣ) : A) =
      IsLocalRing.residue A ((y : Aˣ) : A) :=
    congrArg (fun z : rootsOfUnity n (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) =>
      ((z : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)ˣ) : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) hxy
  have hdiff : ¬ IsUnit (((x : Aˣ) : A) - ((y : Aˣ) : A)) := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit, map_sub, hres, sub_self]
    exact not_not_intro rfl
  have hn : IsUnit (n : A) :=
    (IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit (n : A)).mp
      (by simpa only [map_natCast] using NeZero.ne (n : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))
  have hder : IsUnit (((Polynomial.X ^ n - 1 : Polynomial A).derivative).eval
      ((x : Aˣ) : A)) := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.derivative_sub, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow,
      Polynomial.derivative_one, sub_zero, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X] using hn.mul ((x : Aˣ).isUnit.pow (n-1))
  have heq := IsLocalRing.eq_of_eval_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_sub
    ((mem_rootsOfUnity_iff_isRoot n (x : Aˣ)).mp x.property)
    ((mem_rootsOfUnity_iff_isRoot n (y : Aˣ)).mp y.property) hdiff hder
  exact rootsOfUnity.coe_injective heq

name: ValuationSubring.rootsOfUnityReduction_surjective
statement:
theorem rootsOfUnityReduction_surjective
    [HenselianRing A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)]
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)] :
    Function.Surjective (restrictRootsOfUnity (IsLocalRing.residue A) n)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := .of_neZero_natCast (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
  intro y
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective
    ((y : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)ˣ) : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
  let f : Polynomial A := Polynomial.X ^ n - 1
  have hroot : f.eval a₀ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    change IsLocalRing.residue A (f.eval a₀) = 0
    simp only [f, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_one, map_sub, map_pow, map_one, ha₀, sub_eq_zero]
    exact (mem_rootsOfUnity' n (y : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)ˣ)).mp y.property
  have hsimple : IsUnit
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (f.derivative.eval a₀)) := by
    change IsUnit (IsLocalRing.residue A (f.derivative.eval a₀))
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    simp only [f, Polynomial.derivative_sub, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow,
      Polynomial.derivative_one, sub_zero, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_natCast, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X, map_mul,
      map_natCast, map_pow, ha₀]
    exact mul_ne_zero (NeZero.ne (n : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))
      (pow_ne_zero (n-1) (y : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)ˣ).ne_zero)
  obtain ⟨a, haroot, ha⟩ := HenselianRing.is_henselian f
    (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C 1 (NeZero.ne n)) a₀ hroot hsimple
  have hapow : a ^ n = 1 := by
    simpa only [f, Polynomial.IsRoot.def, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_one, sub_eq_zero] using haroot
  refine ⟨rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq a hapow, ?_⟩
  apply rootsOfUnity.coe_injective
  have hared : IsLocalRing.residue A (a - a₀) = 0 :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem).mpr ha
  rw [map_sub, ha₀, sub_eq_zero] at hared
  exact hared

name: ValuationSubring.rootsOfUnity_toField_bijective
statement:
theorem rootsOfUnity_toField_bijective (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    Function.Bijective (restrictRootsOfUnity (algebraMap A K) n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply rootsOfUnity.coe_injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : rootsOfUnity n K => ((z : Kˣ) : K)) hxy
  · intro ζ
    have hpow : ((ζ : Kˣ) : K) ^ n = 1 :=
      (mem_rootsOfUnity' n (ζ : Kˣ)).mp ζ.property
    have hvalpow : A.valuation ((ζ : Kˣ) : K) ^ n = 1 := by
      rw [← map_pow, hpow, map_one]
    have hval : A.valuation ((ζ : Kˣ) : K) = 1 :=
      (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg zero_le (NeZero.ne n)).mp hvalpow
    let a : A := ⟨((ζ : Kˣ) : K), by
      exact (A.valuation_le_one_iff _).mp hval.le⟩
    have hapow : a ^ n = 1 := Subtype.ext hpow
    refine ⟨rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq a hapow, ?_⟩
    apply rootsOfUnity.coe_injective
    rfl

name: LubinTate.Valuations.absoluteValueApproximation_exists_coefficient_precision
statement:
theorem absoluteValueApproximation_exists_coefficient_precision
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (v : ι → AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (a : ι → K) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ i j, v i (a j) * η < δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let C : ℝ := ∑ i : ι, ∑ j : ι, v i (a j)
  have hC_nonneg : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => (v i).nonneg (a j)
  let η : ℝ := δ / (C + 1)
  have hC_add_pos : 0 < C + 1 := by linarith
  have hη_pos : 0 < η := by
    dsimp [η]
    exact div_pos hδ hC_add_pos
  have hC_mul_eta_lt : C * η < δ := by
    have hC_div_lt_one : C / (C + 1) < 1 := by
      exact (div_lt_one hC_add_pos).mpr (by linarith)
    calc
      C * η = δ * (C / (C + 1)) := by
        dsimp [η]
        ring
      _ < δ * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hC_div_lt_one hδ
      _ = δ := by ring
  refine ⟨η, hη_pos, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  have hcoeff_le_inner : v i (a j) ≤ ∑ k : ι, v i (a k) :=
    Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun k _ => (v i).nonneg (a k)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hinner_nonneg :
      ∀ k : ι, 0 ≤ ∑ l : ι, v k (a l) := by
    intro k
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => (v k).nonneg (a l)
  have hinner_le_C : (∑ l : ι, v i (a l)) ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun k _ => hinner_nonneg k) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hcoeff_le_C : v i (a j) ≤ C :=
    hcoeff_le_inner.trans hinner_le_C
  exact
    lt_of_le_of_lt
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff_le_C (le_of_lt hη_pos))
      hC_mul_eta_lt

name: LubinTate.Valuations.absoluteValueApproximation
statement:
theorem absoluteValueApproximation
    {K : Type*} [Field K] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (v : ι → AbsoluteValue K ℝ)
    (hnontrivial : ∀ i, ¬ TrivialAbsoluteValue (v i))
    (hinequiv : Pairwise fun i j => ¬ EquivalentAbsoluteValues (v i) (v j))
    (a : ι → K) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ x : K, ∀ i, v i (x - a i) < ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let δ : ℝ := ε / ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) + 1)
  have hcard_add_pos : 0 < (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    exact div_pos hε hcard_add_pos
  have hεδ : (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * δ < ε := by
    have hcard_div_lt_one :
        (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) + 1) < 1 := by
      exact (div_lt_one hcard_add_pos).mpr (by linarith)
    calc
      (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * δ =
          ε * ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) + 1)) := by
        dsimp [δ]
        ring
      _ < ε * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcard_div_lt_one hε
      _ = ε := by ring
  obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, hη⟩ :=
    absoluteValueApproximation_exists_coefficient_precision (v := v) (a := a) hδ_pos
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ :=
    absoluteValueApproximation_exists_bump_family
      (v := v) hnontrivial hinequiv (ε := η) hη_pos
  exact
    absoluteValueApproximation_from_weighted_bump_family
      (v := v) (a := a) (e := e) hεδ
      (fun i => by
        have hmul_le :
            v i (a i) * v i (e i - 1) ≤ v i (a i) * η :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt (he i).1) ((v i).nonneg (a i))
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hmul_le (hη i i))
      (fun i j hji => by
        have hsmall : v i (e j) < η := (he j).2 i (Ne.symm hji)
        have hmul_le :
            v i (a j) * v i (e j) ≤ v i (a j) * η :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hsmall) ((v i).nonneg (a j))
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hmul_le (hη i j))

name: AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.normFormula_finite_mem_valuationSubring_iff_isIntegral_of_henselFactorization
statement:
theorem normFormula_finite_mem_valuationSubring_iff_isIntegral_of_henselFactorization
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]

    (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (hnonarch : LubinTate.Valuations.NonarchimedeanAbsoluteValue v)

    x ∈ absoluteValueValuationSubring
        (normFormula_finite_normFormulaAbsoluteValue_of_henselFactorization
          (K := K) (L := L) v hnonarch hv)
        (normFormula_finite_normFormulaAbsoluteValue_of_henselFactorization_nonarchimedean
          (K := K) (L := L) v hnonarch hv) ↔
      IsIntegral
        (absoluteValueValuationSubring v hnonarch) x
proof:
:= by

    normFormula_finite_normFormulaAbsoluteValue_of_henselFactorization_apply]

  · exact
      normFormula_finiteExtensionNormFormulaValue_isIntegral_of_le_one_of_henselFactorization
        v hnonarch hv

name: AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.normFormula_finite_valuationSubring_eq_integralClosure_of_henselFactorization
statement:
theorem normFormula_finite_valuationSubring_eq_integralClosure_of_henselFactorization
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) (hnonarch : LubinTate.Valuations.NonarchimedeanAbsoluteValue v)

        (R := absoluteValueValuationSubring

name: AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.exponentialValuationRingMap_isLocalHom
statement:
theorem exponentialValuationRingMap_isLocalHom
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (v : LubinTate.Valuations.ExponentialValuation K)

proof:
:= by

      w (((exponentialValuationRingMap v w hExt) a :
