      D.valuation.valuationSubring.valuation a ≤ 1
    rw [_root_.ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff,
      _root_.ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff]
    exact _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_le_one_iff D.valuation z a
  obtain ⟨E, hEp, τ, hτ⟩ :=
    exists_finite_inertia_pGroup_of_prime_residue_trivial_extension D T z p hdeg hres
  obtain ⟨σ, hσc, hσ⟩ :=
    exists_ne_one_mem_center_of_finite_inertia_pGroup
      D.valuation.valuationSubring z.valuationSubring p hroots E hEp τ hτ
  let e : Gal(Ω/K) ≃* Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) :=
    AlgEquiv.autCongr (IsAlgClosure.equiv K Ω (AlgebraicClosure K))
  refine ⟨e σ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff] at hσc ⊢
    intro g
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := e.surjective g
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, hσc g]
  · intro h
    apply hσ
    apply e.injective
    exact h.trans e.map_one.symm

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_finite_inertia_pGroup_of_prime_residue_trivial_extension
statement:
theorem exists_finite_inertia_pGroup_of_prime_residue_trivial_extension
    {K L Ω : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra L Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsScalarTower K L Ω]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (D : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (T : HenselianDVF.{u, w} L)
    [D.valuation.HasExtension T.valuation]
    {Γ : Type t} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (z : Valuation Ω Γ) [T.valuation.HasExtension z]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = p)
    (hres : Function.Surjective (algebraMap D.residueField T.residueField)) :
    ∃ E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ω,
      IsPGroup p (inertiaGroup K (z.valuationSubring.comap E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom)) ∧
      ∃ τ : inertiaGroup K (z.valuationSubring.comap E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom),
        τ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcardL : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = p := (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdegree
  obtain ⟨σ, hσord⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' p (by rw [hcardL])
  have hσres : henselianResidueAction D.valuation T.valuation σ = 1 := by
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hres x
    exact (henselianResidueAction D.valuation T.valuation σ).commutes y
  let τ : inertiaGroup K T.valuation.valuationSubring :=
    ⟨henselianGalToDecomposition D.valuation T.valuation σ, congrArg AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv hσres⟩
  have hτ : τ ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hσ : σ = 1 := congrArg
      (fun x : inertiaGroup K T.valuation.valuationSubring =>
        inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) T.valuation.valuationSubring x) h
    rw [hσ, orderOf_one] at hσord
    exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one hσord.symm
  let j : L →ₐ[K] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L Ω
  let E₀ : IntermediateField K Ω := j.fieldRange
  have : FiniteDimensional K E₀ := Module.Finite.equiv j.equivFieldRange.toLinearEquiv
  have : IsGalois K E₀ := IsGalois.of_algEquiv j.equivFieldRange
  let E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ω := ⟨E₀⟩
  let e : E ≃ₐ[K] L := j.equivFieldRange.symm
  let B : _root_.ValuationSubring E := T.valuation.valuationSubring.comap e.toRingHom
  have hB : B = z.valuationSubring.comap E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom := by
    ext x
    change T.valuation (e x) ≤ 1 ↔ z (E.toIntermediateField.val x) ≤ 1
    have he : algebraMap L Ω (e x) = E.toIntermediateField.val x := by
      change j (j.equivFieldRange.symm x) = (x : Ω)
      exact congrArg (fun y : E₀ => (y : Ω)) (j.equivFieldRange.apply_symm_apply x)
    rw [← he]
    exact (_root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_le_one_iff T.valuation z (e x)).symm
  have hsquare : e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap K E) =
      (algebraMap K L).comp (RingHom.id K) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    exact e.commutes a
  let tE : inertiaGroup K B :=
    _root_.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.galoisPullback_inertiaGroupMap
      (RingHom.id K) e.toRingHom hsquare T.valuation.valuationSubring τ
  have htE : tE ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hτ
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := e.surjective x
    have heq := _root_.HilbertRamification.galoisPullback_galoisPullback_commutes
      (RingHom.id K) e.toRingHom hsquare
      (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) T.valuation.valuationSubring τ) y
    change e (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) B tE y) = σ (e y) at heq
    rw [h, map_one] at heq
    exact heq.symm
  have hcardE : Nat.card Gal(E/K) = p := by
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank]
    exact e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.trans hdegree
  have hPGal : IsPGroup p Gal(E/K) := IsPGroup.of_card (n := 1) (by rw [pow_one]; exact hcardE)
  have hPB : IsPGroup p (inertiaGroup K B) :=
    hPGal.of_injective (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) B)
      (fun a b h => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h))
  refine ⟨E, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hB]
    exact hPB
  · rw [← hB]
    exact ⟨tE, htE⟩

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.exists_primitiveRoot_residue_of_inertia_prime_order
statement:
theorem exists_primitiveRoot_residue_of_inertia_prime_order
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [Finite (inertiaGroup K A)]
    [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (σ : inertiaGroup K A)
    (hσ : σ ≠ 1) (hpow : σ ^ p = 1) :
    (primitiveRoots p (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have htop := valueTrivialInertiaGroup_eq_top_of_finite K A
  let s : valueTrivialInertiaGroup K A := ⟨σ, htop.symm ▸ Subgroup.mem_top σ⟩
  have hs : valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K A s ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hσ
    have hmem : σ ∈ ramificationGroup K A :=
      (valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom_mem_ker_iff K A s).mp h
    rw [ramificationGroup_eq_bot_of_residueCharZero K A] at hmem
    exact hmem
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K A s x ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    apply hs
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro x
    exact Classical.not_not.mp (not_exists.mp h x)
  let ζ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A := valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K A s x
  have hζpow : ζ ^ p = 1 := by
    have hsPow : s ^ p = 1 := Subtype.ext hpow
    have h := congrArg (fun f => (f x : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))
      (congrArg (valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K A) hsPow)
    simpa only [map_pow, map_one, MonoidHom.pow_apply, MonoidHom.one_apply,
      Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_one] using h
  have hζne : ζ ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hx
    exact Units.ext h
  exact ⟨ζ, (mem_primitiveRoots hp.pos).mpr (isPrimitiveRoot_of_mem_nthRootsFinset hp
    ((Polynomial.mem_nthRootsFinset hp.pos 1).mpr hζpow) hζne)⟩

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom_decomposition_arg
statement:
theorem valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom_decomposition_arg
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) (τ : valueTrivialInertiaGroup K A)
    (g : decompositionGroup K A) (hg : IsOfFinOrder g) (x : Lˣ) :
    valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom K A τ
      (Units.mapEquiv (g : Gal(L/K)).toMulEquiv x) =
      valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom K A τ x
proof:
:= by
  let q : Lˣ := automorphismUnitQuotient K A g x
  have hq : q ∈ A.unitGroup := by
    rw [A.mem_unitGroup_iff]
    simp only [q, automorphismUnitQuotient, Units.val_div_eq_div_val]
    change A.valuation ((g : Gal(L/K)) (x : L) / (x : L)) = 1
    rw [map_div₀, valuation_decomposition_apply_eq_of_isOfFinOrder K A g hg]
    exact div_self (A.valuation.ne_zero_iff.mpr x.ne_zero)
  have heq : Units.mapEquiv (g : Gal(L/K)).toMulEquiv x = q * x := by
    dsimp only [q, automorphismUnitQuotient]
    exact (div_mul_cancel _ _).symm
  rw [heq, map_mul,
    MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp (unitGroup_le_valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom_ker K A τ hq), one_mul]

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom_conj
statement:
theorem valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom_conj
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [Finite (inertiaGroup K A)]
    (g : decompositionGroup K A) (τ : inertiaGroup K A) (x : Lˣ) :
    let htop
proof:
:= valueTrivialInertiaGroup_eq_top_of_finite K A
    let s : valueTrivialInertiaGroup K A := ⟨τ, htop.symm ▸ Subgroup.mem_top τ⟩
    let t : valueTrivialInertiaGroup K A :=
      ⟨MulAut.conjNormal g τ, htop.symm ▸ Subgroup.mem_top _⟩
    (valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom K A t x : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) =
      residueAction K A g
        (valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom K A s
          (Units.mapEquiv (g : Gal(L/K)).symm.toMulEquiv x) : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom_apply, valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom_apply,
    _root_.ValuationSubring.coe_unitGroupToResidueFieldUnits_apply,
    _root_.ValuationSubring.coe_unitGroupToResidueFieldUnits_apply]
  change IsLocalRing.residue A _ = IsLocalRing.residue A (g • _)
  apply congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue A)
  apply Subtype.ext
  change _ = (g : Gal(L/K)) (_ : L)
  simp only [_root_.ValuationSubring.coe_unitGroupMulEquiv_apply,
    valueTrivialAutomorphismUnit_coe, automorphismUnitQuotient, Units.val_div_eq_div_val]
  change ((g : Gal(L/K)) (((τ : decompositionGroup K A) : Gal(L/K))
      ((g : Gal(L/K)).symm (x : L))) / (x : L)) =
    (g : Gal(L/K))
      ((((τ : decompositionGroup K A) : Gal(L/K)) ((g : Gal(L/K)).symm (x : L))) /
        ((g : Gal(L/K)).symm (x : L)))
  rw [map_div₀, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom_injective_of_residueCharZero
statement:
theorem valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom_injective_of_residueCharZero
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [Finite (inertiaGroup K A)]
    [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)] :
    Function.Injective (valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K A)
proof:
:= by
  apply (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff _).mp
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro s hs
  have hram := (valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom_mem_ker_iff K A s).mp hs
  rw [ramificationGroup_eq_bot_of_residueCharZero K A] at hram
  exact Subtype.ext hram

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.residueAction_fixes_pow_eq_one_of_primitiveRoot_of_henselianRing
statement:
theorem residueAction_fixes_pow_eq_one_of_primitiveRoot_of_henselianRing
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L)
    [HenselianRing A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)] (n : ℕ)
    [NeZero (n : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))]
    (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    (σ : decompositionGroup K A)
    (ξ : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) (hξ : ξ ^ n = 1) :
    residueAction K A σ ξ = ξ
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := .of_neZero_natCast (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
  let r : rootsOfUnity n (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) := rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := _root_.ValuationSubring.rootsOfUnityReduction_surjective A n r
  have hares : (IsLocalRing.residue A) ((a : Aˣ) : A) = ξ :=
    congrArg
      (fun b : rootsOfUnity n (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) =>
        ((b : ((IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))ˣ) : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))) ha
  have hapow : ((((a : Aˣ) : A) : L)) ^ n = 1 := by
    exact congrArg (fun b : A => (b : L))
      ((mem_rootsOfUnity' n (a : Aˣ)).mp a.property)
  obtain ⟨i, _hi, hai⟩ :=
    (hζ.map_of_injective (algebraMap K L).injective).eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hapow
  have hfixed : (σ : Gal(L/K))
      (((a : Aˣ) : A) : L) =
      (((a : Aˣ) : A) : L) := by
    rw [← hai, map_pow, (σ : Gal(L/K)).commutes]
  rw [← hares]
  change (IsLocalRing.residue A) (σ • ((a : Aˣ) : A)) =
    (IsLocalRing.residue A) ((a : Aˣ) : A)
  apply congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue A)
  exact Subtype.ext hfixed

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.inertia_commutes_of_primitiveRoot_of_henselianRing
statement:
theorem inertia_commutes_of_primitiveRoot_of_henselianRing [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L)
    [HenselianRing A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)] [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    (τ : inertiaGroup K A) (hτ : τ ^ n = 1)
    (g : decompositionGroup K A) :
    Commute g (τ : decompositionGroup K A)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero (n : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) := ⟨Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne'⟩
  have htop := valueTrivialInertiaGroup_eq_top_of_finite K A
  let s : valueTrivialInertiaGroup K A := ⟨τ, htop.symm ▸ Subgroup.mem_top τ⟩
  let t : valueTrivialInertiaGroup K A :=
    ⟨MulAut.conjNormal g τ, htop.symm ▸ Subgroup.mem_top _⟩
  have hsPow : s ^ n = 1 := Subtype.ext hτ
  have hresPow (x : Lˣ) :
      (valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom K A s x : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) ^ n = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f =>
      (f (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K A)
        (QuotientGroup.mk' A.unitGroup x)) : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)))
      (congrArg (valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K A) hsPow)
    simpa only [map_pow, map_one, MonoidHom.pow_apply, MonoidHom.one_apply,
      valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom_apply, valueModuloBaseToResidueUnits_mk_mk,
      Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_one] using h
  have hchar : valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K A t =
      valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K A s := by
    apply QuotientGroup.monoidHom_ext
    apply QuotientGroup.monoidHom_ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro x
    change valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom K A t x =
      valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom K A s x
    apply Units.ext
    rw [valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom_conj K A g τ x]
    have harg := valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom_decomposition_arg K A s g⁻¹
      (isOfFinOrder_of_finite g⁻¹) x
    change valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom K A s
      (Units.mapEquiv (g : Gal(L/K)).symm.toMulEquiv x) =
        valueTrivialInertiaResidueUnitHom K A s x at harg
    rw [harg]
    exact residueAction_fixes_pow_eq_one_of_primitiveRoot_of_henselianRing A n ζ hζ g _ (hresPow x)
  have hts : t = s := valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom_injective_of_residueCharZero K A hchar
  have hconj : g * (τ : decompositionGroup K A) * g⁻¹ =
      (τ : decompositionGroup K A) :=
    congrArg (fun a : valueTrivialInertiaGroup K A =>
      ((a : inertiaGroup K A) : decompositionGroup K A)) hts
  exact (mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul).mp hconj

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.residueAction_fixes_pow_eq_one_of_primitiveRoot
statement:
theorem residueAction_fixes_pow_eq_one_of_primitiveRoot
    (F : HenselianDVF.{v, w} L) (n : ℕ) [NeZero (n : F.residueField)]
    (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    (σ : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring)
    (ξ : F.residueField) (hξ : ξ ^ n = 1) :
    residueAction K F.valuation.valuationSubring σ ξ = ξ
proof:
:=
  residueAction_fixes_pow_eq_one_of_primitiveRoot_of_henselianRing
    F.valuation.valuationSubring n ζ hζ σ ξ hξ

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.inertia_commutes_of_primitiveRoot
statement:
theorem inertia_commutes_of_primitiveRoot [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (F : HenselianDVF.{v, w} L) [CharZero F.residueField]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (ζ : K) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    (τ : inertiaGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) (hτ : τ ^ n = 1)
    (g : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) :
    Commute g (τ : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring)
proof:
:=
  inertia_commutes_of_primitiveRoot_of_henselianRing
    F.valuation.valuationSubring n hn ζ hζ τ hτ g

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.commutator_isPGroup_of_henselian_separablyClosedResidue
statement:
theorem commutator_isPGroup_of_henselian_separablyClosedResidue
    [FiniteDimensional K L] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField w.valuationSubring) p] :
    IsPGroup p (commutator Gal(L/K))
proof:
:= by
  let A := w.valuationSubring
  let ι := henselianGalToInertia v w
  have htop := valueTrivialInertiaGroup_eq_top_of_finite K A
  let j : Gal(L/K) →* valueTrivialInertiaGroup K A :=
    { toFun := fun σ => ⟨ι σ, htop.symm ▸ Subgroup.mem_top (ι σ)⟩
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' _ _ := rfl }
  let χ := (valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K A).comp j
  have hker : commutator Gal(L/K) ≤ χ.ker := by
    rw [commutator_eq_closure, Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro a ⟨σ, τ, rfl⟩
    change χ ⁅σ, τ⁆ = 1
    rw [map_commutatorElement, commutatorElement_eq_one_iff_mul_comm]
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro a
    exact mul_comm _ _
  let f : commutator Gal(L/K) →* ramificationGroup K A :=
    { toFun := fun σ => ⟨ι σ,
        (valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom_mem_ker_iff K A (j σ)).mp (hker σ.property)⟩
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' _ _ := rfl }
  apply (ramificationGroup_isPGroup_of_residueChar K A p).of_injective f
  intro σ τ h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun a : ramificationGroup K A =>
    inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A (a : inertiaGroup K A)) h

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.galoisPullback_inertiaGroupMap_surjective_of_henselianRing
statement:
theorem galoisPullback_inertiaGroupMap_surjective_of_henselianRing
    [IsGalois K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring K)
    [HenselianRing V (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)]
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [V.valuation.HasExtension A.valuation]
    (E : IntermediateField K L) [Normal K E] :
    Function.Surjective
      (_root_.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.galoisPullback_inertiaGroupMap
        (RingHom.id K) E.val.toRingHom
        (by
          apply RingHom.ext
          intro a
          exact E.val.commutes a) A)
proof:
:= by
  intro τ
  let B : _root_.ValuationSubring E := A.comap E.val.toRingHom
  have hE : B.valuation.HasExtension A.valuation :=
    intermediateFieldComap_hasExtension A E
  let τ₀ : E ≃ₐ[K] E := inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) B τ
  let σ₀ : L ≃ₐ[K] L := τ₀.liftNormal L
  have hσ₀ : σ₀ ∈ decompositionGroup K A := by
    rw [decompositionGroup_eq_top_of_henselianRing V A]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top σ₀
  let σ : decompositionGroup K A := ⟨σ₀, hσ₀⟩
  let s : selectedResidueField A ≃+* selectedResidueField A := residueAction K A σ
  let f : B →+* A :=
    ValuationTheory.Valuations.valuationSubringMapOfHasExtension B A hE
  let r : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B →+* selectedResidueField A :=
    ValuationTheory.Valuations.residueFieldMapOfHasExtension B A hE
  have hr (b : B) : r (IsLocalRing.residue B b) = IsLocalRing.residue A (f b) :=
    AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.residueFieldMapOfHasExtension_residue B A hE b
  have hfixed (y : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) :
      s (r y) = r y := by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
    rw [← hb, hr]
    let σA : A ≃+* A := MulSemiringAction.toRingAut (decompositionGroup K A) A σ
    let τB : B ≃+* B :=
      MulSemiringAction.toRingAut (decompositionGroup K B) B τ.val
    change IsLocalRing.residue A (σA (f b)) = IsLocalRing.residue A (f b)
    have hi : σA (f b) = f (τB b) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change σ₀ (algebraMap E L (b : E)) = algebraMap E L (τ₀ (b : E))
      exact τ₀.liftNormal_commutes L (b : E)
    have hbres := congrArg
      (fun φ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField B ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField B =>
        φ (IsLocalRing.residue B b)) τ.property
    change IsLocalRing.residue B (τB b) = IsLocalRing.residue B b at hbres
    exact (congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue A) hi).trans
      ((hr (τB b)).symm.trans ((congrArg r hbres).trans (hr b)))
  let i : decompositionResidueField E A →+* selectedResidueField A :=
    algebraMap (decompositionResidueField E A) (selectedResidueField A)
  have hscalar (x : decompositionResidueField E A) : s (i x) = i x := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
      (decompositionResidue_scalar_range_eq_comap_residueMap_of_henselianRing V A E).le
        (Set.mem_range_self x)
    exact (congrArg s hy.symm).trans ((hfixed y).trans hy)
  let e : selectedResidueField A ≃ₐ[decompositionResidueField E A] selectedResidueField A :=
    { s with commutes' := hscalar }
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := decompositionGroupResidueAction_surjective (K := E) A e
  let ρK : decompositionGroup K A :=
    decompositionGroupRestrictScalars (K := K) (M := E) A ρ
  have hρKres : residueAction K A ρK = s := by
    apply RingEquiv.ext
    intro y
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
    rw [← ha]
    exact congrArg
      (fun φ : selectedResidueField A ≃ₐ[decompositionResidueField E A]
        selectedResidueField A => φ (IsLocalRing.residue A a)) hρ
  have hδ : σ * ρK⁻¹ ∈ inertiaGroup K A := by
    change residueAction K A (σ * ρK⁻¹) = 1
    rw [(residueAction K A).map_mul σ ρK⁻¹,
      map_inv (residueAction K A) ρK, hρKres, mul_inv_cancel]
  let δ : inertiaGroup K A := ⟨σ * ρK⁻¹, hδ⟩
  refine ⟨δ, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply E.val.injective
  have hsquare : E.val.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap K E) =
      (algebraMap K L).comp (RingHom.id K) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    exact E.val.commutes a
  change E.val.toRingHom
      ((_root_.HilbertRamification.galoisPullback_galoisPullback
        (RingHom.id K) E.val.toRingHom hsquare (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A δ)) x) =
    E.val.toRingHom (τ₀ x)
  rw [_root_.HilbertRamification.galoisPullback_galoisPullback_commutes]
  change σ₀ (ρ.val.symm (algebraMap E L x)) = algebraMap E L (τ₀ x)
  rw [ρ.val.symm.commutes x]
  exact τ₀.liftNormal_commutes L x

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.decompositionGroup_eq_top_of_henselianRing
statement:
theorem decompositionGroup_eq_top_of_henselianRing
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring K)
    [HenselianRing V (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)]
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [V.valuation.HasExtension A.valuation] :
    decompositionGroup K A = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hA : A.toSubring = (integralClosure V L).toSubring := by
    simpa only [_root_.ValuationSubring.valuationSubring_valuation] using
      ValuationTheory.Henselian.valuationSubring_eq_integralClosure_of_henselianRing
        V A.valuation
  have hmem (x : L) : x ∈ A ↔ IsIntegral V x := by
    change x ∈ A.toSubring ↔ IsIntegral V x
    rw [hA]
    exact mem_integralClosure_iff V L
  apply top_unique
  intro σ _hσ
  change σ • A = A
  apply SetLike.ext
  intro x
  rw [_root_.ValuationSubring.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  change σ⁻¹ x ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A
  rw [hmem, hmem]
  exact isIntegral_algEquiv ((σ⁻¹).restrictScalars V)

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.exists_comap_integer_of_decompositionFixedSubring_of_henselianRing
statement:
theorem exists_comap_integer_of_decompositionFixedSubring_of_henselianRing
    [IsGalois K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring K)
    [HenselianRing V (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)]
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [V.valuation.HasExtension A.valuation]
    (E : IntermediateField K L) (a : decompositionFixedSubring E A) :
    ∃ b : A.comap E.val.toRingHom, ((b : E) : L) = ((a : A) : L)
proof:
:= by
  have htop : decompositionGroup K A = ⊤ :=
    decompositionGroup_eq_top_of_henselianRing V A
  have hfixed : ∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[E] L, σ ((a : A) : L) = ((a : A) : L) := by
    intro σ
    have hσK : restrictAutomorphismScalars (K := K) (M := E) σ ∈
        decompositionGroup K A := by
      rw [htop]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top _
    have hσE : σ ∈ decompositionGroup E A :=
      (mem_decompositionGroup_restrictScalars_iff
        (K := K) (M := E) A σ).mp hσK
    exact congrArg (fun z : A => (z : L)) (a.property ⟨σ, hσE⟩)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
    (InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed
      (k := E) (K := L) ((a : A) : L)).mpr hfixed
  refine ⟨⟨b, ?_⟩, hb⟩
  change (b : L) ∈ A
  rw [show (b : L) = ((a : A) : L) from hb]
  exact (a : A).property

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.intermediateFieldComap_hasExtension
statement:
theorem intermediateFieldComap_hasExtension
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) (E : IntermediateField K L) :
    (A.comap E.val.toRingHom).valuation.HasExtension A.valuation
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
  ext x
  simp only [Subring.mem_comap, _root_.Valuation.mem_integer_iff,
    _root_.ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff, _root_.ValuationSubring.mem_comap]
  rfl

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.decompositionResidue_algebraMap_mk
statement:
private theorem decompositionResidue_algebraMap_mk
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) (E : IntermediateField K L)
    (a : decompositionFixedSubring E A) :
    algebraMap (decompositionResidueField E A) (selectedResidueField A)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (decompositionFixedMaximalIdeal E A) a) =
      IsLocalRing.residue A (a : A)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.quotientMap_mk

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.decompositionResidue_scalar_range_eq_comap_residueMap_of_henselianRing
statement:
theorem decompositionResidue_scalar_range_eq_comap_residueMap_of_henselianRing
    [IsGalois K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring K)
    [HenselianRing V (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)]
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [V.valuation.HasExtension A.valuation]
    (E : IntermediateField K L) :
    Set.range (algebraMap (decompositionResidueField E A) (selectedResidueField A)) =
      Set.range (ValuationTheory.Valuations.residueFieldMapOfHasExtension
        (A.comap E.val.toRingHom) A (intermediateFieldComap_hasExtension A E))
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.ext
  intro y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
      exists_comap_integer_of_decompositionFixedSubring_of_henselianRing V A E a
    refine ⟨IsLocalRing.residue (A.comap E.val.toRingHom) b, ?_⟩
    rw [AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.residueFieldMapOfHasExtension_residue,
      decompositionResidue_algebraMap_mk]
    apply congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue A)
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hb
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective x
    let a : A := ⟨((b : E) : L), b.property⟩
    have ha : a ∈ decompositionFixedSubring E A := by
      intro σ
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (σ : L ≃ₐ[E] L) (algebraMap E L (b : E)) =
        algebraMap E L (b : E)
      exact (σ : L ≃ₐ[E] L).commutes (b : E)
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk (decompositionFixedMaximalIdeal E A) ⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [decompositionResidue_algebraMap_mk,
      AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.residueFieldMapOfHasExtension_residue]
    apply congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue A)
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl

name: ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianDVF.topDerived_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass_of_separablyClosedResidue
statement:
theorem HenselianDVF.topDerived_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass_of_separablyClosedResidue
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP base.residueField p] [IsSepClosed base.residueField]
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p)
      (topDerivedTop Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) m)
proof:
:= by
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure K
  let D := topDerivedTop Gal(Ω/K) m
  intro W hW h1W
  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀, hW₀W⟩ :=
    (mem_nhds_subtype (D : Set Gal(Ω/K)) (1 : D) W).mp (hW.mem_nhds h1W)
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ :=
    (InfiniteGalois.krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff_of_isGalois
      (k := K) (K := Ω) W₀).mp hW₀
  let res : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* Gal(E/K) :=
    { toMonoidHom := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := K) (K₁ := Ω) E
      continuous_toFun := InfiniteGalois.restrictNormalHom_continuous E.toIntermediateField }
  let f : D →ₜ* Gal(E/K) :=
    { toMonoidHom := res.toMonoidHom.comp D.subtype
      continuous_toFun := res.continuous_toFun.comp continuous_subtype_val }
  let U : OpenNormalSubgroup D := ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.ker f
  refine ⟨U, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro σ hσ
    have hfix : (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) ∈ E.fixingSubgroup :=
      (FiniteGaloisIntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) E).mpr hσ
    exact hW₀W (hE hfix)
  · let target := FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF (L := E) base
    have : base.toDVF.valuation.HasExtension target.toDVF.valuation :=
      FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF_hasExtension base
    have : CharP target.residueField p :=
      (Algebra.charP_iff base.residueField target.residueField p).mp inferInstance
    have hP : IsPGroup p (commutator Gal(E/K)) :=
      commutator_isPGroup_of_henselian_separablyClosedResidue
        base.toDVF.valuation target.toDVF.valuation p
    have hle : f.toMonoidHom.range ≤ commutator Gal(E/K) := by
      rintro σ ⟨τ, rfl⟩
      have hτ := (topDerivedTop_le_comap (f := res) 1)
        (topDerivedTop_antitone hm τ.property)
      change res (τ : Gal(Ω/K)) ∈ topDerivedTop Gal(E/K) 1 at hτ
      rw [topDerivedTop_one_eq_topologicalCommutator,
        topologicalCommutator_eq_commutator_of_isClosed _ (isClosed_discrete _)] at hτ
      exact hτ
    change ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p (D ⧸ f.toMonoidHom.ker)
    exact (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p).mem_of_mulEquiv
      (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange f.toMonoidHom).symm
      ⟨inferInstance, hP.to_le hle⟩

name: HilbertRamification.decompositionGroupRestriction_mem_absoluteValueDecompositionGroup_restrictScalars_iff
statement:
theorem decompositionGroupRestriction_mem_absoluteValueDecompositionGroup_restrictScalars_iff
    (w : AbsoluteValue L ℝ) (σ : L ≃ₐ[M] L) :
    RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.restrictAutomorphismScalars (K := K) (M
      := M) σ ∈
        absoluteValueDecompositionGroup K w ↔
      σ ∈ absoluteValueDecompositionGroup M w
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: HilbertRamification.decompositionGroupRestriction_absoluteValueDecompositionGroup_range_eq_inf
statement:
theorem decompositionGroupRestriction_absoluteValueDecompositionGroup_range_eq_inf
    (w : AbsoluteValue L ℝ) :
    Subgroup.map
        (RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.restrictAutomorphismScalars (K :=
          K) (M := M))
        (absoluteValueDecompositionGroup M w) =
      absoluteValueDecompositionGroup K w ⊓
        (RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.restrictAutomorphismScalars
          (K := K) (M := M)).range
proof:
:= by
  ext σ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩
    exact
      ⟨(decompositionGroupRestriction_mem_absoluteValueDecompositionGroup_restrictScalars_iff
          (K := K) (M := M) w τ).mpr hτ,
        ⟨τ, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hσ, τ, rfl⟩
    exact
      ⟨τ,
        (decompositionGroupRestriction_mem_absoluteValueDecompositionGroup_restrictScalars_iff
          (K := K) (M := M) w τ).mp hσ,
        rfl⟩

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.henselianResidueAction_restrictNormal_eq_one
statement:
theorem henselianResidueAction_restrictNormal_eq_one
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (hσ : henselianResidueAction v z σ = 1) :
    henselianResidueAction v w (σ.restrictNormal L) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective x
  rw [henselianResidueAction_residue]
  change residue w.valuationSubring
      ((henselianGalToDecomposition v w (σ.restrictNormal L)) • a) =
    residue w.valuationSubring a
  apply (ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.residue_algebraMap_eq_iff_of_hasExtension
    w z _ a).mp
  have heq : algebraMap w.valuationSubring z.valuationSubring
      ((henselianGalToDecomposition v w (σ.restrictNormal L)) • a) =
      (henselianGalToDecomposition v z σ) •
        algebraMap w.valuationSubring z.valuationSubring a := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact σ.restrictNormal_commutes L (a : L)
  rw [heq]
  have h := congrArg (fun τ => τ (residue z.valuationSubring
    (algebraMap w.valuationSubring z.valuationSubring a))) hσ
  exact h

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.inertia_fixes_of_isOfFinOrder
statement:
theorem inertia_fixes_of_isOfFinOrder
    (σ : inertiaGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring)
    (ζ : L) (hζ : IsOfFinOrder ζ) :
    ((σ : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) ζ = ζ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hζpow⟩ := hζ.exists_pow_eq_one
  have : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  have : NeZero (n : F.residueField) := ⟨Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne'⟩
  have hvalpow : F.valuation ζ ^ n = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow, hζpow, map_one]
  have hval : F.valuation ζ = 1 :=
    (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg zero_le hn.ne').mp hvalpow
  let a : F.valuationSubring := ⟨ζ, hval.le⟩
  have hapow : a ^ n = 1 := Subtype.ext hζpow
  let ξ : rootsOfUnity n F.valuationSubring := rootsOfUnity.mkOfPowEq a hapow
  let e : F.valuationSubring ≃+* F.valuationSubring :=
    MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv
      (decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) F.valuationSubring
      (σ : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring)
  have hres : HenselianDVF.rootsOfUnityReduction F n
        (restrictRootsOfUnity e.toRingHom n ξ) =
      HenselianDVF.rootsOfUnityReduction F n ξ := by
    apply rootsOfUnity.coe_injective
    change F.residueMap (e a) = F.residueMap a
    calc
      F.residueMap (e a) =
          (σ : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) • F.residueMap a := by
        rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.residue_smul]
        rfl
      _ = F.residueMap a := by
        have hσ : residueAction K F.valuation.valuationSubring
            (σ : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) = 1 := σ.property
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun hσ (F.residueMap a)
  have heq : restrictRootsOfUnity e.toRingHom n ξ = ξ :=
    HenselianDVF.rootsOfUnityReduction_injective F n hres
  exact congrArg (fun x : rootsOfUnity n F.valuationSubring =>
    (((x : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : L)) heq

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.mem_inertiaField_of_isOfFinOrder
statement:
theorem mem_inertiaField_of_isOfFinOrder (ζ : L) (hζ : IsOfFinOrder ζ) :
    ζ ∈ inertiaField K F.valuation.valuationSubring
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_inertiaField_iff (K := K) F.valuation.valuationSubring ζ).mpr
  intro σ
  exact inertia_fixes_of_isOfFinOrder K F σ ζ hζ

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.unitGroupConjEquiv_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem unitGroupConjEquiv_coe
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) (τ : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
    (u : A.unitGroup) :
    (unitGroupConjEquiv (K := K) A τ u : Lˣ) =
      Units.mapEquiv τ.toMulEquiv (u : Lˣ)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [unitGroupConjEquiv,
    valuationSubringConjRingEquiv]

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.decompositionGroupConj_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem decompositionGroupConj_apply
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) (τ : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
    (σ : decompositionGroup K A) :
    decompositionGroupConj (K := K) A τ σ =
      ⟨τ * (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) * τ⁻¹, by
        change (τ * (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) * τ⁻¹) • (τ • A) = τ • A
        rw [mul_assoc, mul_smul, mul_smul, inv_smul_smul, σ.property]⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.decompositionGroupConjEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem decompositionGroupConjEquiv_apply
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) (τ : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
    (σ : decompositionGroup K A) :
    decompositionGroupConjEquiv (K := K) A τ σ =
      decompositionGroupConj (K := K) A τ σ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.canonical_hasExtension
statement:
private theorem canonical_hasExtension :
    v.valuationSubring.valuation.HasExtension w.valuationSubring.valuation
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
  ext a
  change w.valuationSubring.valuation (algebraMap K L a) ≤ 1 ↔
    v.valuationSubring.valuation a ≤ 1
  rw [_root_.ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff,
    _root_.ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff]
  exact _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_le_one_iff v w a

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.henselianResidueAction_residue
statement:
@[simp] theorem henselianResidueAction_residue (σ : Gal(L/K)) (x : w.valuationSubring) :
    henselianResidueAction v w σ (residue w.valuationSubring x) =
      residue w.valuationSubring ((henselianGalToDecomposition v w σ) • x)
proof: := rfl

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.decompositionResidue_scalar_range_subset_base
statement:
private theorem decompositionResidue_scalar_range_subset_base :
    Set.range (algebraMap (decompositionResidueField K w.valuationSubring)
      (ResidueField w.valuationSubring)) ⊆
      Set.range
        (algebraMap (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) (ResidueField w.valuationSubring))
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  have hfixed : ∀ σ : Gal(L/K), σ ((a : w.valuationSubring) : L) =
      ((a : w.valuationSubring) : L) := by
    intro σ
    exact congrArg (fun b : w.valuationSubring => (b : L))
      (a.property (henselianGalToDecomposition v w σ))
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed
    (k := K) ((a : w.valuationSubring) : L)).mpr hfixed
  have hbinteger : b ∈ v.valuationSubring := by
    apply (_root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_le_one_iff v w b).mp
    rw [hb]
    exact (a : w.valuationSubring).property
  refine ⟨residue v.valuationSubring ⟨b, hbinteger⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [_root_.Valuation.HasExtension.algebraMap_residue_eq_residue_algebraMap]
  change residue w.valuationSubring (algebraMap v.valuationSubring w.valuationSubring
    ⟨b, hbinteger⟩) = residue w.valuationSubring (a : w.valuationSubring)
  apply congrArg (residue w.valuationSubring)
  exact Subtype.ext hb

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.henselianResidueAction_surjective
statement: theorem henselianResidueAction_surjective : Function.Surjective (henselianResidueAction v w)
proof:
:= by
  intro τ
  let e : Gal(ResidueField w.valuationSubring / decompositionResidueField K w.valuationSubring) :=
    { τ.toRingEquiv with
      commutes' := by
        intro z
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := decompositionResidue_scalar_range_subset_base v w
          (Set.mem_range_self z)
        rw [← hx]
        exact τ.commutes x }
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := decompositionGroupResidueAction_surjective (K := K) w.valuationSubring e
  refine ⟨σ.val, ?_⟩
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro z
  exact congrArg (fun f : Gal(ResidueField w.valuationSubring /
    decompositionResidueField K w.valuationSubring) => f z) hσ

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.henselianResidueExtension_isIntegral
statement:
theorem henselianResidueExtension_isIntegral :
    Algebra.IsIntegral (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) (ResidueField w.valuationSubring)
proof:
:= by
  have := canonical_hasExtension v w
  have hring : w.valuationSubring.toSubring =
      (integralClosure v.valuationSubring L).toSubring := by
    simpa only [_root_.ValuationSubring.valuationSubring_valuation] using
      ValuationTheory.Henselian.valuationSubring_eq_integralClosure_of_henselianRing
        v.valuationSubring w.valuationSubring.valuation
  have : IsScalarTower v.valuationSubring (ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
      (ResidueField w.valuationSubring) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ => rfl)
  constructor
  intro z
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective z
  have ha : IsIntegral v.valuationSubring (a : L) := by
    apply (mem_integralClosure_iff v.valuationSubring L).mp
    change (a : L) ∈ (integralClosure v.valuationSubring L).toSubring
    rw [← hring]
    exact a.property
  have ha' : IsIntegral v.valuationSubring a :=
    IsIntegral.tower_bot (show Function.Injective
      (algebraMap w.valuationSubring L) from Subtype.val_injective) ha
  have hr : IsIntegral v.valuationSubring (residue w.valuationSubring a) :=
    ha'.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom v.valuationSubring w.valuationSubring
      (ResidueField w.valuationSubring))
  exact hr.tower_top

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.henselianResidueExtension_isAlgClosure
statement:
theorem henselianResidueExtension_isAlgClosure [IsAlgClosed L] :
    IsAlgClosure (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) (ResidueField w.valuationSubring)
proof:
:= by
  have := henselianResidueExtension_isIntegral v w
  exact ⟨_root_.ValuationSubring.isAlgClosed_residueField w.valuationSubring, inferInstance⟩

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.henselianResidueAction_continuous
statement: theorem henselianResidueAction_continuous : Continuous (henselianResidueAction v w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_one (henselianResidueAction v w)
  rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEU⟩ := (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff
    (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) (ResidueField w.valuationSubring) U).mp hU
  have : FiniteDimensional (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) E := hE
  let b := Module.finBasis (ResidueField v.valuationSubring) E
  choose a ha using fun i => residue_surjective (R := w.valuationSubring)
    ((b i : E) : ResidueField w.valuationSubring)
  let S : Set L := Set.range (fun i => (a i : L))
  have : Finite S := (Set.finite_range (fun i => (a i : L))).to_subtype
  let B : IntermediateField K L := IntermediateField.adjoin K S
  have : FiniteDimensional K B := IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin
    (fun x _hx => Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)
  apply (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff K L ((henselianResidueAction v w) ⁻¹' U)).mpr
  refine ⟨B, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  intro σ hσ
  apply hEU
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff E (henselianResidueAction v w σ)).mpr
  intro z hz
  have hlin : (henselianResidueAction v w σ).toLinearMap.comp E.val.toLinearMap =
      E.val.toLinearMap := by
    apply b.ext
    intro i
    change henselianResidueAction v w σ ((b i : E) : ResidueField w.valuationSubring) =
      ((b i : E) : ResidueField w.valuationSubring)
    rw [← ha i, henselianResidueAction_residue]
    apply congrArg (residue w.valuationSubring)
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff B σ).mp hσ (a i : L)
      (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K S (Set.mem_range_self i))
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hlin ⟨z, hz⟩

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.henselianResidueAction_ker
statement:
theorem henselianResidueAction_ker :
    (henselianResidueAction v w).ker =
      (inertiaGroup K w.valuationSubring).comap (henselianGalToDecomposition v w)
proof:
:= by
  ext σ
  change henselianResidueAction v w σ = 1 ↔
    residueAction K w.valuationSubring (henselianGalToDecomposition v w σ) = 1
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact congrArg AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv h
  · intro h
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro z
    exact congrArg (fun f : ResidueField w.valuationSubring ≃+*
      ResidueField w.valuationSubring => f z) h

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.henselianResidueAction_isOpenQuotientMap
statement:
theorem henselianResidueAction_isOpenQuotientMap :
    IsOpenQuotientMap (henselianResidueAction v w)
proof:
:= by
  have := henselianResidueExtension_isIntegral v w
  have : T2Space Gal(ResidueField w.valuationSubring / ResidueField v.valuationSubring) :=
    krullTopology_t2
  exact MonoidHom.isOpenQuotientMap_of_isQuotientMap
    (Topology.IsQuotientMap.of_surjective_continuous
      (henselianResidueAction_surjective v w) (henselianResidueAction_continuous v w))

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.finiteInertiaRestriction_coe
statement:
theorem finiteInertiaRestriction_coe
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) (E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K L)
    (σ : inertiaGroup K A) :
    inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) (A.comap E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom)
        (finiteInertiaRestriction A E σ) =
      AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := K) (K₁ := L) E
        (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsquare : E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap K E) =
      (algebraMap K L).comp (RingHom.id K) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    exact E.toIntermediateField.val.commutes a
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply E.toIntermediateField.val.injective
  calc
    _ = inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ (E.toIntermediateField.val x) :=
      _root_.HilbertRamification.galoisPullback_galoisPullback_commutes
        (RingHom.id K) E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom hsquare
        (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ) x
    _ = _ :=
      (AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ) E x).symm

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.finiteInertiaTransition_comp
statement:
theorem finiteInertiaTransition_comp
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L)
    (E F : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K L) (hEF : E ≤ F)
    (σ : inertiaGroup K A) :
    finiteInertiaTransition A E F hEF (finiteInertiaRestriction A F σ) =
      finiteInertiaRestriction A E σ
proof:
:= by
  let i : E →+* F := (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).toRingHom
  let B : _root_.ValuationSubring F := A.comap F.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom
  have hsquare : i.comp (algebraMap K E) =
      (algebraMap K F).comp (RingHom.id K) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    exact (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).commutes a
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply E.toIntermediateField.val.injective
  calc
    _ = F.toIntermediateField.val
        (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) B (finiteInertiaRestriction A F σ) (i x)) :=
      congrArg F.toIntermediateField.val
        (_root_.HilbertRamification.galoisPullback_galoisPullback_commutes
          (RingHom.id K) i hsquare
          (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) B (finiteInertiaRestriction A F σ)) x)
    _ = inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ (E.toIntermediateField.val x) := by
      rw [finiteInertiaRestriction_coe]
      exact AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ) F (i x)
    _ = _ := by
      have hcoe := congrArg (fun g : E ≃ₐ[K] E => E.toIntermediateField.val (g x))
        (finiteInertiaRestriction_coe A E σ)
      exact (AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes
        (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ) E x).symm.trans hcoe.symm

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.finiteInertiaTransition_surjective_of_henselianRing
statement:
theorem finiteInertiaTransition_surjective_of_henselianRing [IsGalois K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring K)
    [HenselianRing V (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)]
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [V.valuation.HasExtension A.valuation]
    (E F : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K L) (hEF : E ≤ F) :
    Function.Surjective (finiteInertiaTransition A E F hEF)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ :=
    galoisPullback_inertiaGroupMap_surjective_of_henselianRing V A E.toIntermediateField t
  exact ⟨finiteInertiaRestriction A F σ,
    (finiteInertiaTransition_comp A E F hEF σ).trans hσ⟩

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.exists_inertia_with_finite_central_restriction
statement:
theorem exists_inertia_with_finite_central_restriction
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring K)
    [HenselianRing V (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)]
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [V.valuation.HasExtension A.valuation]
    [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hroots : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ζ : K, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ n))
    (E F : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K L) (hEF : E ≤ F)
    (hE : IsPGroup p (inertiaGroup K (A.comap E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom)))
    (τ : inertiaGroup K (A.comap E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom)) :
    ∃ σ : inertiaGroup K A, finiteInertiaRestriction A E σ = τ ∧
      ∀ g : Gal(F/K), Commute g
        ((inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ).restrictNormal F)
proof:
:= by
  let B := A.comap F.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom
  have : V.valuation.HasExtension B.valuation := by
    apply _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
    ext a
    change B.valuation (algebraMap K F a) ≤ 1 ↔ V.valuation a ≤ 1
    rw [_root_.ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff,
      _root_.ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff]
    change (algebraMap K L a) ∈ A ↔ a ∈ V
    simpa only [_root_.ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff] using
      _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_le_one_iff V.valuation A.valuation a
  have : HenselianRing B (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) :=
    ValuationTheory.Henselian.henselianRing_of_algebraic_extension V B
  have : CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) :=
    _root_.ValuationSubring.charZero_residueField_comap A F.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom
  let f := finiteInertiaTransition A E F hEF
  have hf : Function.Surjective f :=
    finiteInertiaTransition_surjective_of_henselianRing V A E F hEF
  obtain ⟨t, ht, n, htn⟩ :=
    ProCGroups.exists_prime_power_order_lift_of_surjective p f hf hE τ
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hroots n
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ :=
    galoisPullback_inertiaGroupMap_surjective_of_henselianRing V A F.toIntermediateField t
  refine ⟨σ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← finiteInertiaTransition_comp A E F hEF σ, show finiteInertiaRestriction A F σ = t from hσ]
    exact ht
  · intro g
    let gD : decompositionGroup K B := ⟨g, by
      rw [decompositionGroup_eq_top_of_henselianRing V B]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top g⟩
    have hc := inertia_commutes_of_primitiveRoot_of_henselianRing
      B (p ^ n) (pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos n) ζ hζ t htn gD
    have hc' : Commute g (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) B t) :=
      congrArg (fun z : decompositionGroup K B => (z : Gal(F/K))) hc
    change Commute g (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := K) (K₁ := L) F
      (inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ))
    rw [← finiteInertiaRestriction_coe A F σ, show finiteInertiaRestriction A F σ = t from hσ]
    exact hc'

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.exists_ne_one_mem_center_of_finite_inertia_pGroup
statement:
theorem exists_ne_one_mem_center_of_finite_inertia_pGroup
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring K)
    [HenselianRing V (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V)]
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [V.valuation.HasExtension A.valuation]
    [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hroots : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ζ : K, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ n))
    (E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K L)
    (hE : IsPGroup p (inertiaGroup K (A.comap E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom)))
    (τ : inertiaGroup K (A.comap E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom)) (hτ : τ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ σ : Gal(L/K), σ ∈ Subgroup.center Gal(L/K) ∧ σ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  let M : OpenNormalSubgroup Gal(L/K) :=
    { toSubgroup := E.toIntermediateField.fixingSubgroup
      isOpen' := IntermediateField.fixingSubgroup_isOpen E.toIntermediateField }
  apply ProCGroups.ProfiniteGrp.exists_ne_one_mem_center_of_quotient_central_lifts M
  intro N
  let NF : IntermediateField K L :=
    IntermediateField.fixedField (N : Subgroup Gal(L/K))
  have hfix : NF.fixingSubgroup = (N : Subgroup Gal(L/K)) :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField
      (⟨N.toSubgroup, N.isClosed⟩ : ClosedSubgroup Gal(L/K))
  have : FiniteDimensional K NF := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite NF).mp
    (by rw [hfix]; exact N.isOpen)
  let NFg : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K L := ⟨NF⟩
  let F := NFg ⊔ E
  obtain ⟨σ, hσE, hσF⟩ :=
    exists_inertia_with_finite_central_restriction V A p hroots E F le_sup_right hE τ
  let s : Gal(L/K) := inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) A σ
  refine ⟨s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hs
    have hsE : AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := K) (K₁ := L) E s = 1 := by
      apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp
      rw [E.toIntermediateField.restrictNormalHom_ker]
      exact hs
    apply hτ
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    change inertiaGroupToAut (K := K) (A.comap E.toIntermediateField.val.toRingHom) τ = 1
    rw [← hσE, finiteInertiaRestriction_coe A E σ]
    exact hsE
  · intro g
    let c : Gal(L/K) := (g * s) * (s * g)⁻¹
    have hc : c.restrictNormal F = 1 := by
      change AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom (F := K) (K₁ := L) F ((g * s) * (s * g)⁻¹) = 1
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, map_mul, map_mul]
      exact mul_inv_eq_one.mpr (hσF (g.restrictNormal F)).eq
    rw [← hfix]
    apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff NF c).mpr
    intro x hx
    let xF : F := ⟨x, (show NFg ≤ F from le_sup_left) hx⟩
    calc
      c x = F.toIntermediateField.val ((c.restrictNormal F) xF) :=
        (AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes c F xF).symm
      _ = x := by rw [hc]; rfl

name: RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.exists_galoisAutomorphism_stabilizing_of_residueAutomorphism
statement:
theorem exists_galoisAutomorphism_stabilizing_of_residueAutomorphism
    (A : _root_.ValuationSubring L)
    (tau : selectedResidueField A ≃ₐ[decompositionResidueField K A]
      selectedResidueField A) :
    ∃ sigma : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
      ∃ hsigma : sigma ∈ decompositionGroup K A,
        decompositionGroupResidueAction (K := K) A ⟨sigma, hsigma⟩ = tau
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sigma, hsigma⟩ :=
    decompositionGroupResidueAction_surjective (K := K) A tau
  exact ⟨sigma, sigma.property, hsigma⟩

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.WithZeroValuationTopology.valuedMk_uniformSpace_eq_mrangeRestrict
statement:
theorem valuedMk_uniformSpace_eq_mrangeRestrict
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v] :
    (Valued.mk' v).toUniformSpace =
      (mrangeRestrictValued (completeDVF v)).toUniformSpace
proof:
:= by
  let w :=
    _root_.LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict
      (completeDVF v)
  have hequiv : v.IsEquiv w := by
    intro x y
    rw [← Subtype.coe_le_coe]
    rfl
  change (Valued.mk' v).toUniformSpace = (Valued.mk' w).toUniformSpace
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [le_iff_uniformContinuous_id]
    simpa using hequiv.symm.uniformContinuous
  · rw [le_iff_uniformContinuous_id]
    simpa using hequiv.uniformContinuous

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.roots_principalUnit_uniformizer_zpow_eq_iff_of_completeDVF
statement:
theorem roots_principalUnit_uniformizer_zpow_eq_iff_of_completeDVF
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (ζ η : residueRootsOfUnityGroup F)
    (p q : (higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1) (m n : ℤ) :
    valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (ζ : F.valuationSubringˣ) *
        valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (p : F.valuationSubringˣ) *
        (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) ^ m =
      valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (η : F.valuationSubringˣ) *
        valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (q : F.valuationSubringˣ) *
        (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) ^ n ↔
      ζ = η ∧ p = q ∧ m = n
proof:
:= by
  let V : MultiplicativeIntegerValuation Kˣ :=
    (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer F) hπ
  have hzero : V.zeroSubgroup = F.valuation.valuationSubring.unitGroup := by
    simpa [V] using
      (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_zeroSubgroup_eq_unitGroup F)
        hπ
  have hπV :
      V.IsUniformizer (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) := by
    simpa [V] using
      (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_isUniformizer F) hπ
  simpa [V] using
    roots_principalUnit_uniformizer_zpow_eq_iff_of_zeroSubgroup_eq_unitGroup
      (F := F) V hzero hπV ζ η p q m n

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (z : fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F) :
    ((multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer F) hπ).val
        (fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
          F hπ z) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd z.2
proof:
:= by
  let V : MultiplicativeIntegerValuation Kˣ :=
    (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer F) hπ
  have hzero :
      ∀ y : Kˣ, y ∈ V.zeroSubgroup ↔
        ∃ u : F.valuationSubringˣ,
          valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F u = y := by
    intro y
    exact
      mem_zeroSubgroup_iff_exists_valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom_eq
        (F := F) V
        (by
          simpa [V] using
            (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_zeroSubgroup_eq_unitGroup F) hπ)
        y
  have hπV :
      V.IsUniformizer (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) := by
    simpa [V] using
      (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_isUniformizer F) hπ
  have hunit :
      valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
            (z.1.1 : F.valuationSubringˣ) *
          valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
            (z.1.2 : F.valuationSubringˣ) ∈
        V.zeroSubgroup :=
    (hzero _).2
      ⟨(z.1.1 : F.valuationSubringˣ) * (z.1.2 : F.valuationSubringˣ), by
        rw [map_mul]⟩
  rw [fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF_apply]
  exact V.valuation_uniformizer_normal_form hπV hunit (Multiplicative.toAdd z.2)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.uniformizerValueExponent_fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uniformizerValueExponent_fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (x : Kˣ) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd
        ((fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
          F hπ).symm x).2 =
      (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    uniformizerValueExponent_fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer
      F hπ
      ((fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
        F hπ).symm x)
  simpa using h.symm

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm_snd
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (x : Kˣ) :
    ((fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
      F hπ).symm x).2 =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd ((uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x)
proof:
:= by
  let E :=
    fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
      F hπ
  have h :
      Multiplicative.toAdd ((E.symm x).2) =
        (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x := by
    simp [E]
  calc
    (E.symm x).2 = Multiplicative.ofAdd (Multiplicative.toAdd ((E.symm x).2)) := rfl
    _ = Multiplicative.ofAdd ((uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x) := by
      rw [h]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm_factors_mul_uniformizer_zpow
statement:
theorem fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm_factors_mul_uniformizer_zpow
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (x : Kˣ) :
    valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (((fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
            F hπ).symm x).1.1 : F.valuationSubringˣ) *
        valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (((fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
            F hπ).symm x).1.2 : F.valuationSubringˣ) *
        (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) ^ (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x =
      x
proof:
:= by
  let E :=
    fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
      F hπ
  have hexp :
      Multiplicative.toAdd ((E.symm x).2) =
        (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x := by
    simp [E]
  calc
    valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (((E.symm x).1.1 : F.valuationSubringˣ)) *
        valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (((E.symm x).1.2 : F.valuationSubringˣ)) *
        (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) ^ (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x =
        valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
            (((E.symm x).1.1 : F.valuationSubringˣ)) *
          valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
            (((E.symm x).1.2 : F.valuationSubringˣ)) *
          (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) ^ Multiplicative.toAdd ((E.symm x).2) := by
          rw [hexp]
    _ = E (E.symm x) := by
          rw [fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF_apply]
    _ = x := E.apply_symm_apply x

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm_unitPart_eq_mul_uniformizer_zpow_neg
statement:
theorem fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm_unitPart_eq_mul_uniformizer_zpow_neg
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (x : Kˣ) :
    valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (((fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
            F hπ).symm x).1.1 : F.valuationSubringˣ) *
        valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (((fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
            F hπ).symm x).1.2 : F.valuationSubringˣ) =
      x * (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) ^
        (-((uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x))
proof:
:= by
  let ϖ : Kˣ := Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero
  let u : Kˣ :=
    valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (((fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
            F hπ).symm x).1.1 : F.valuationSubringˣ) *
        valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (((fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
            F hπ).symm x).1.2 : F.valuationSubringˣ)
  have hux :
      u * ϖ ^ (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x = x := by
    simpa [u, ϖ] using
      fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm_factors_mul_uniformizer_zpow
        F hπ x
  calc
    u = u * 1 := (mul_one u).symm
    _ = u * (ϖ ^ (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x *
        ϖ ^ (-((uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x))) := by
          rw [← zpow_add, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero]
    _ = x * ϖ ^ (-((uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x)) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, hux]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_unitPart_mem_unitGroup
statement:
theorem fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_unitPart_mem_unitGroup
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (x : Kˣ) :
    x * (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) ^
        (-((uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x)) ∈
      F.valuation.valuationSubring.unitGroup
proof:
:= by
  let V : MultiplicativeIntegerValuation Kˣ :=
    (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer F) hπ
  have hzero :
      V.zeroSubgroup = F.valuation.valuationSubring.unitGroup := by
    simpa [V] using
      (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_zeroSubgroup_eq_unitGroup F) hπ
  have hπV :
      V.IsUniformizer (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) := by
    simpa [V] using
      (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_isUniformizer F) hπ
  have hmem :
      x * (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) ^
          (-((uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x)) ∈
        V.zeroSubgroup := by
    rw [V.mem_zeroSubgroup_iff, V.val_mul, V.val_uniformizer_zpow hπV]
    simp [V]
  simpa [hzero] using hmem

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom_fieldUnitUniformizerUnitPart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom_fieldUnitUniformizerUnitPart
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (x : Kˣ) :
    valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
        (fieldUnitUniformizerUnitPart F hπ x) =
      x * (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) ^
        (-((uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x))
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  simp [valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom, fieldUnitUniformizerUnitPart]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.uniformizerValueExponent_eq_of_mrangeRestrict_eq
statement:
theorem uniformizerValueExponent_eq_of_mrangeRestrict_eq
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    {x y : Kˣ}
    (hxy :
      (mrangeRestrict F) (y : K) = (mrangeRestrict F) (x : K)) :
    (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ y =
      (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x
proof:
:= by
  have hval : F.valuation (y : K) = F.valuation (x : K) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hxy
  apply ((uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_inj F) hπ).1
  calc
    (uniformizerValueUnit F) hπ ^ (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ y =
        (_root_.LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.fieldUnitValueUnit F) y := by
      rw [(uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_uniformizerValueExponent_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit F)]
    _ = (_root_.LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.fieldUnitValueUnit F) x := by
      ext
      simpa [CompleteDVF.fieldUnitValueUnit] using hval
    _ = (uniformizerValueUnit F) hπ ^ (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x := by
      rw [(uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_uniformizerValueExponent_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit F)]

name: LocalFieldTheory.finite_multiplicativeInt_nthPowerQuotient
statement:
theorem finite_multiplicativeInt_nthPowerQuotient
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Finite (Multiplicative ℤ ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : (Multiplicative ℤ) →* (Multiplicative
      ℤ)).range)
proof:
:= by
  rw [powMonoidHom_range_multiplicativeInt_eq_integerMultipleSubgroup]
  have hnabs : (n : ℤ).natAbs ≠ 0 := by simpa using hn
  let : NeZero (n : ℤ).natAbs := ⟨hnabs⟩
  exact Finite.of_equiv
    (Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℤ).natAbs))
    (valueModIntegerMultipleSubgroupEquivZMod (n : ℤ)).symm.toEquiv

name: LocalFieldTheory.card_multiplicativeInt_nthPowerQuotient
statement:
theorem card_multiplicativeInt_nthPowerQuotient
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    [Finite (Multiplicative ℤ ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : (Multiplicative ℤ) →* (Multiplicative ℤ)).range)]
      :
    Nat.card
        (Multiplicative ℤ ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : (Multiplicative ℤ) →* (Multiplicative ℤ)).range)
          = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr
    ((QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq
      (powMonoidHom_range_multiplicativeInt_eq_integerMultipleSubgroup n)).trans
        (valueModIntegerMultipleSubgroupEquivZMod (n : ℤ))).toEquiv]
  rw [Nat.card_congr
    (Multiplicative.toAdd :
      Multiplicative (ZMod ((n : ℤ).natAbs)) ≃ ZMod ((n : ℤ).natAbs))]
  have hnabs : (n : ℤ).natAbs ≠ 0 := by simpa using hn
  let : NeZero (n : ℤ).natAbs := ⟨hnabs⟩
  have hcard : Nat.card (ZMod ((n : ℤ).natAbs)) = (n : ℤ).natAbs :=
    Nat.card_zmod ((n : ℤ).natAbs)
  simpa only [Int.natAbs_natCast] using hcard

name: LocalFieldTheory.card_multiplicative_nthPowerQuotient_eq_nsmulAddSubgroup_index
statement:
theorem card_multiplicative_nthPowerQuotient_eq_nsmulAddSubgroup_index
    (n : ℕ)
    [Finite (Multiplicative A ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : (Multiplicative A) →* (Multiplicative A)).range)]
      :
    Nat.card (Multiplicative A ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : (Multiplicative A) →* (Multiplicative A)).range)
      =
      (nsmulAddSubgroup A n).index
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Subgroup.index_eq_card
    (H := (powMonoidHom n : (Multiplicative A) →* (Multiplicative A)).range)]
  rw [powMonoidHom_range_multiplicative_eq_nsmulAddSubgroup_toSubgroup]
  exact AddSubgroup.index_toSubgroup _

name: LocalFieldTheory.card_multiplicative_nthPowerQuotient_eq_additive_nsmulQuotient
statement:
theorem card_multiplicative_nthPowerQuotient_eq_additive_nsmulQuotient
    (n : ℕ)
    [Finite (Multiplicative A ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : (Multiplicative A) →* (Multiplicative A)).range)]
    [Finite (A ⧸ nsmulAddSubgroup A n)] :
    Nat.card (Multiplicative A ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : (Multiplicative A) →* (Multiplicative A)).range)
      =
      Nat.card (A ⧸ nsmulAddSubgroup A n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_multiplicative_nthPowerQuotient_eq_nsmulAddSubgroup_index]
  rw [AddSubgroup.index_eq_card]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Examples.Qp.toZModPow_teichmullerUnits_eq
statement:
theorem toZModPow_teichmullerUnits_eq
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (s : ℕ) (u : (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))ˣ)
    (hu : u ^ (p - 1) = 1) :
    Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)).toMonoidHom
      (teichmullerUnits p (ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero s)) u)) = u
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  have hcoprime : (p - 1).Coprime p :=
    ((Nat.coprime_self_sub_right hp.one_le).mpr (Nat.coprime_one_right p)).symm
  apply primePower_units_eq_of_pow_eq_one_of_reduction_eq p s (p - 1) hcoprime
      _ u ?_ hu ?_
  · rw [← map_pow, teichmullerUnits_pow, map_one]
  · rw [unitsMap_toZModPow, toZMod_teichmullerUnits]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom
statement:
theorem primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom
    (σ : E ≃ₐ[L] E) :
    primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter F K p
      (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E σ) =
      primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter L E p σ
proof:
:= by
  change Examples.Qp.teichmullerUnits p
      ((IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p F K).autToPow F
        (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E σ)) =
    Examples.Qp.teichmullerUnits p ((IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p L E).autToPow L σ)
  rw [autToPow_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom p
    (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p F K) (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p L E) σ]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_comp_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom
statement:
theorem primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_comp_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom :
    (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter F K p).comp
      (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E) =
      primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter L E p
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  exact primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E p σ

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primitiveRoot_autToPow_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem primitiveRoot_autToPow_restrictScalars
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ζ : E} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) (σ : E ≃ₐ[M] E) :
    hζ.autToPow F (σ.restrictScalars F) = hζ.autToPow M σ
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  apply ZMod.val_injective
  apply hζ.pow_inj (ZMod.val_lt _) (ZMod.val_lt _)
  rw [hζ.autToPow_spec F (σ.restrictScalars F), hζ.autToPow_spec M σ,
    AlgEquiv.restrictScalars_apply]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter_spec
statement:
theorem primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter_spec
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p) (σ : E ≃ₐ[F] E) :
    ζ ^ (PadicInt.toZMod (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ σ : ℤ_[p])).val =
      σ ζ
proof:
:= by
  have h : PadicInt.toZMod (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ σ : ℤ_[p]) =
      (hζ.autToPow F σ : ZMod p) :=
    congrArg (fun a : (ZMod p)ˣ => (a : ZMod p))
      (toZMod_teichmullerUnits p (hζ.autToPow F σ))
  rw [h]
  exact hζ.autToPow_spec F σ

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter_sub_natCast_eq_prime_mul
statement:
theorem exists_primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter_sub_natCast_eq_prime_mul
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p) (σ : E ≃ₐ[F] E)
    (a : ℕ) (ha : a < p) (hact : σ ζ = ζ ^ a) :
    ∃ c : ℤ_[p], (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ σ : ℤ_[p]) -
      (a : ℤ_[p]) = (p : ℤ_[p]) * c
proof:
:= by
  have hval :
      (PadicInt.toZMod (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ σ : ℤ_[p])).val = a :=
    hζ.pow_inj (ZMod.val_lt _) ha
      ((primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter_spec F p hζ σ).trans hact)
  have hmod : PadicInt.toZMod (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ σ : ℤ_[p]) =
      (a : ZMod p) := by
    rw [← hval]
    exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _).symm
  have hzero : PadicInt.toZMod
      ((primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ σ : ℤ_[p]) - (a : ℤ_[p])) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_natCast, hmod, sub_self]
  have hdiv : (p : ℤ_[p]) ∣
      (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ σ : ℤ_[p]) - (a : ℤ_[p]) := by
    rw [← Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p,
      ← PadicInt.ker_toZMod, RingHom.mem_ker]
    exact hzero
  exact hdiv

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter_comp_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter_comp_restrictScalars
    (F : Type u) {M : Type v} {E : Type w}
    [CommRing F] [CommRing M] [CommRing E] [IsDomain E]
    [Algebra F M] [Algebra F E] [Algebra M E] [IsScalarTower F M E]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] {ζ : E} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p) :
    (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ).comp
        (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom F : (E ≃ₐ[M] E) →* (E ≃ₐ[F] E)) =
      primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter M p hζ
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  change teichmullerUnits p (hζ.autToPow F (σ.restrictScalars F)) =
    teichmullerUnits p (hζ.autToPow M σ)
  rw [primitiveRoot_autToPow_restrictScalars F hζ σ]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.toZMod_comp_toZModPow
statement:
theorem toZMod_comp_toZModPow (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (s : ℕ) :
    (ZMod.castHom (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero s)) (ZMod p)).comp
      (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)) = PadicInt.toZMod
proof:
:= by
  apply ZMod.ringHom_eq_of_ker_eq
  rw [PadicInt.ker_toZMod, RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
    ← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot (R := ZMod p), IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.unitsMap_toZModPow
statement:
theorem unitsMap_toZModPow (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (s : ℕ) (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ) :
    ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero s))
      (Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)).toMonoidHom u) =
        Units.map PadicInt.toZMod.toMonoidHom u
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  exact congrArg (fun f : ℤ_[p] →+* ZMod p => f (u : ℤ_[p]))
    (toZMod_comp_toZModPow p s)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primePower_units_eq_of_pow_eq_one_of_reduction_eq
statement:
theorem primePower_units_eq_of_pow_eq_one_of_reduction_eq
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (s n : ℕ) (hn : n.Coprime p)
    (u v : (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))ˣ) (hu : u ^ n = 1) (hv : v ^ n = 1)
    (hred : ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero s)) u =
      ZMod.unitsMap (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero s)) v) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  have : Fact (1 < p ^ (s + 1)) := ⟨one_lt_pow₀ hp.one_lt (Nat.succ_ne_zero s)⟩
  have : IsLocalRing (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1))
      (ZMod.ringHom_surjective (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)))
  let f : Polynomial (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))) := Polynomial.X ^ n - 1
  have huroot : f.eval (u : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))ˣ => (z : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))) hu
    simpa only [f, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_one, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_one, sub_eq_zero] using h
  have hvroot : f.eval (v : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))ˣ => (z : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))) hv
    simpa only [f, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_one, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_one, sub_eq_zero] using h
  let r : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)) →+* ZMod p :=
    ZMod.castHom (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero s)) (ZMod p)
  have hreduction : r (u : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))) = r (v : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))) := by
    exact congrArg (fun z : (ZMod p)ˣ => (z : ZMod p)) hred
  have hsub : ¬ IsUnit ((u : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))) - (v : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))) := by
    intro hunit
    have h := hunit.map r
    rw [r.map_sub, hreduction, sub_self] at h
    exact not_isUnit_zero h
  have hnunit : IsUnit (n : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))) :=
    (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime n (p ^ (s + 1))).mpr (hn.pow_right (s + 1))
  have hderiv : IsUnit (f.derivative.eval (u : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))) := by
    simpa only [f, Polynomial.derivative_sub, Polynomial.derivative_X_pow,
      Polynomial.derivative_one, sub_zero, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X] using hnunit.mul (u.isUnit.pow (n - 1))
  exact Units.ext (IsLocalRing.eq_of_eval_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_sub huroot hvroot hsub hderiv)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_pow
statement:
theorem primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_pow (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K L p σ ^ (p - 1) = 1
proof:
:=
  teichmullerUnits_pow p ((IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K L).autToPow K σ)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.toZModPow_primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter
statement:
theorem toZModPow_primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter (s : ℕ)
    {ζ : L} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (s + 1))) (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)).toMonoidHom
      (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K L p σ) = hζ.autToPow K σ
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : σ ^ (p - 1) = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := cyclotomicGalois_natCard_dvd_prime_sub_one K L p
    rw [hm, pow_mul, pow_card_eq_one', one_pow]
  have hpower : hζ.autToPow K σ ^ (p - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow, hσ, map_one]
  change Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)).toMonoidHom
    (teichmullerUnits p ((IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K L).autToPow K σ)) =
      hζ.autToPow K σ
  rw [← autToPow_unitsMap_prime_pow p s hζ (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K L) σ]
  exact toZModPow_teichmullerUnits_eq p s (hζ.autToPow K σ) hpower

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_spec
statement:
theorem primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_spec (s : ℕ)
    {ζ : L} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (s + 1))) (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    ζ ^ (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)
      (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K L p σ : ℤ_[p])).val = σ ζ
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun u : (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))ˣ => (u : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))))
    (toZModPow_primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K L p s hζ σ)
  change PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)
    (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K L p σ : ℤ_[p]) =
      (hζ.autToPow K σ : ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))) at h
  rw [h]
  exact hζ.autToPow_spec K σ

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Examples.Qp.toZMod_valuationSubring_symm
statement:
private theorem toZMod_valuationSubring_symm
    (x : (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubring) :
    PadicInt.toZMod ((teichmullerIntegerEquiv p).symm x) =
      teichmullerResidueEquiv p ((padicCompleteDVF p).residueMap x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PadicInt.toZMod_eq_residueField_comp_residue]
  change PadicInt.residueField
      (IsLocalRing.residue ℤ_[p] ((teichmullerIntegerEquiv p).symm x)) =
    PadicInt.residueField
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map
        ((teichmullerIntegerEquiv p).symm : (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubring →+* ℤ_[p])
        (IsLocalRing.residue (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubring x))
  exact congrArg PadicInt.residueField
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue
      ((teichmullerIntegerEquiv p).symm : (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubring →+* ℤ_[p])
      x).symm

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Examples.Qp.toZMod_teichmullerUnits
statement:
@[simp] theorem toZMod_teichmullerUnits (u : (ZMod p)ˣ) :
    Units.map PadicInt.toZMod.toMonoidHom (teichmullerUnits p u) = u
proof:
:= by
  let r : residueRootsOfUnityGroup (padicCompleteDVF p) := teichmullerRoots p u
  have hr : residueUnitHom (padicCompleteDVF p)
      (r : (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubringˣ) =
      Units.map (teichmullerResidueEquiv p).symm.toMonoidHom u :=
    (residueRootsOfUnityEquivResidueFieldUnits (padicCompleteDVF p)).apply_symm_apply
