      (Units.map (teichmullerResidueEquiv p).symm.toMonoidHom u)
  apply Units.ext
  change PadicInt.toZMod ((teichmullerIntegerEquiv p).symm
    ((r : (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubringˣ) :
      (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubring)) = (u : ZMod p)
  rw [toZMod_valuationSubring_symm]
  have h := congrArg
    (fun z : (padicCompleteDVF p).residueFieldˣ => teichmullerResidueEquiv p z.val) hr
  change teichmullerResidueEquiv p ((padicCompleteDVF p).residueMap
    ((r : (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubringˣ) :
      (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubring)) =
    teichmullerResidueEquiv p ((teichmullerResidueEquiv p).symm (u : ZMod p)) at h
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Examples.Qp.teichmullerUnits_pow
statement:
theorem teichmullerUnits_pow (u : (ZMod p)ˣ) :
    teichmullerUnits p u ^ (p - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let r : residueRootsOfUnityGroup (padicCompleteDVF p) := teichmullerRoots p u
  have hr : (r : (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubringˣ) ^
      (Nat.card (padicCompleteDVF p).residueField - 1) = 1 :=
    (mem_rootsOfUnity (Nat.card (padicCompleteDVF p).residueField - 1)
      (r : (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubringˣ)).mp r.property
  rw [padicCompleteDVF_residueField_card p] at hr
  change Units.map (teichmullerIntegerEquiv p).symm.toMonoidHom
    (r : (padicCompleteDVF p).valuationSubringˣ) ^ (p - 1) = 1
  rw [← map_pow, hr, map_one]

name: AlgebraicNumberTheory.Valuations.henselianValuation_of_algebraic_extension
statement:
theorem henselianValuation_of_algebraic_extension
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]
    (v : LubinTate.Valuations.ExponentialValuation K)
    (w : LubinTate.Valuations.ExponentialValuation L)
    (hExt : ∀ a : K, w (algebraMap K L a) = v a)
    (hhens : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianValuationByFactorization
      (LubinTate.Valuations.exponentialValuationSubringAsValuationSubring v).valuation) :
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselianValuationByFactorization
      (LubinTate.Valuations.exponentialValuationSubringAsValuationSubring w).valuation
proof:
:= by
  let av := exponentialAssociatedAbsoluteValue v
  let aw := exponentialAssociatedAbsoluteValue w
  have hav : LubinTate.Valuations.AssociatedAbsoluteValue v (Real.exp 1) av :=
    exponentialAssociatedAbsoluteValue_associated v
  have haw : LubinTate.Valuations.AssociatedAbsoluteValue w (Real.exp 1) aw :=
    exponentialAssociatedAbsoluteValue_associated w
  have havNonarch : LubinTate.Valuations.NonarchimedeanAbsoluteValue av :=
    associatedAbsoluteValue_nonarchimedean v (Real.exp 1) av hav
  have hawNonarch : LubinTate.Valuations.NonarchimedeanAbsoluteValue aw :=
    associatedAbsoluteValue_nonarchimedean w (Real.exp 1) aw haw
  let Vv := LubinTate.Valuations.exponentialValuationSubringAsValuationSubring v
  let Wv := LubinTate.Valuations.exponentialValuationSubringAsValuationSubring w
  let Va := absoluteValueValuationSubring av havNonarch
  let Wa := absoluteValueValuationSubring aw hawNonarch
  have hV : Vv = Va :=
    associatedAbsoluteValue_valuationSubring_eq
      v (Real.exp 1) av havNonarch hav
  have hW : Wv = Wa :=
    associatedAbsoluteValue_valuationSubring_eq
      w (Real.exp 1) aw hawNonarch haw
  have habsExt : ∀ a : K, aw (algebraMap K L a) = av a :=
    associatedAbsoluteValue_extends
      v w hExt (Real.exp 1) av aw hav haw
  have hVaWa : Va.valuation.HasExtension Wa.valuation :=
    absoluteValueValuation_hasExtension_of_extends
      av aw havNonarch hawNonarch habsExt
  have hVvWv : Vv.valuation.HasExtension Wv.valuation := by
    rw [hV, hW]
    exact hVaWa
  let : Vv.valuation.HasExtension Wv.valuation := hVvWv
  have hUniqueV : HasUniqueAlgebraicValuationSubringExtensions Vv :=
    exponentialValuation_hasUniqueAlgebraicValuationSubringExtensions
      v hhens
  have hUniqueVW : HasUniqueValuationSubringExtension (L := L) Vv :=
    hUniqueV L
  have hUniqueW : HasUniqueAlgebraicValuationSubringExtensions Wv := by
    intro M _fieldM _algLM _algM
    let : Algebra K M :=
      ((algebraMap L M).comp (algebraMap K L)).toAlgebra
    let : IsScalarTower K L M :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (by intro; rfl)
    let : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K M := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans K L M
    obtain ⟨B, hVB, hBunique⟩ := hUniqueV M
    let : Vv.valuation.HasExtension B.valuation := hVB
    let vBL := B.valuation.comap (algebraMap L M)
    have hVvBL : Vv.valuation.HasExtension vBL :=
      DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.comap_to_middle_hasExtension_of_top_hasExtension
        Vv.valuation B.valuation
    let : Vv.valuation.HasExtension vBL := hVvBL
    have hVvRestrict :
        Vv.valuation.HasExtension vBL.valuationSubring.valuation := by
      apply _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
      ext a
      simp only [Subring.mem_comap, Valuation.mem_integer_iff,
        ValuationSubring.valuation_le_one_iff]
      rw [vBL.mem_valuationSubring_iff]
      rw [← Vv.valuationSubring_valuation]
      rw [Vv.valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff]
      exact _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_map_le_one_iff
        (vR := Vv.valuation) (vA := vBL) a
    let : Vv.valuation.HasExtension vBL.valuationSubring.valuation :=
      hVvRestrict
    have hrestrict : vBL.valuationSubring = Wv := by
      obtain ⟨W0, hVW0, hW0unique⟩ := hUniqueVW
      exact (hW0unique vBL.valuationSubring inferInstance).trans
        (hW0unique Wv inferInstance).symm
    have hWB : Wv.valuation.HasExtension B.valuation := by
      apply _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.ofComapInteger
      change vBL.valuationSubring.toSubring =
        Wv.valuation.valuationSubring.toSubring
      rw [ValuationSubring.valuationSubring_valuation]
      exact congrArg ValuationSubring.toSubring hrestrict
    refine ⟨B, hWB, ?_⟩
    intro C hWC
    let : Wv.valuation.HasExtension C.valuation := hWC
    let : Vv.valuation.HasExtension C.valuation :=
      ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.hasExtension_trans
        Vv.valuation Wv.valuation C.valuation
    exact hBunique C inferInstance
  change ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.HenselFactorizationProperty
    Wv.valuation.valuationSubring
  rw [ValuationSubring.valuationSubring_valuation]
  exact henselFactorization_of_unique_algebraic_valuationSubring_extensions
    Wv hUniqueW

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.padicIntQuotientMap_compatible

    {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring) h).comp
      (padicIntQuotientMap v p n) = padicIntQuotientMap v p m
proof:
:= by
  have hcast :
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring) h).comp
          (zmodToMaximalIdealQuotient v p n) =
        (zmodToMaximalIdealQuotient v p m).comp
          (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p h) (ZMod (p ^ m))) :=
    RingHom.ext_zmod _ _
  unfold padicIntQuotientMap

    PadicInt.zmod_cast_comp_toZModPow m n h]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_principalUnitLog_denominator_min_bound
statement:
theorem exists_principalUnitLog_denominator_min_bound
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) *
            (padicValNat p (m + 1) : ℤ) ≤
          ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) *
            (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ)) ∧
      ∀ u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
        ∀ hu : (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd ≠ 0,
          ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) *
              (padicValNat p (m + 1) : ℤ) ≤
            (ofWithZeroValuation v).val
              (Units.mk0 (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd hu)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_log_denominator_min p (v.residueRamificationIndex p)
  refine ⟨m, hm, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  let b : ℤ := ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) *
    (padicValNat p (m + 1) : ℤ)
  let x : K := principalUnitSubOneOfWithZeroValuation v u
  have hx : v x < 1 := principalUnitSubOne_val_lt_one_ofWithZeroValuation v u
  have hn : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 :=
    fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hpartial : ∀ N : ℕ,
      v (logOnePlusPartialSumField x hn N) ≤ WithZero.exp (-b) := by
    intro N
    apply v.map_sum_le
    intro n _
    refine (valuation_signedLogSeriesTermField_le_mixedChar v p x hx n).trans ?_
    exact WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_neg (hm n))
  have hlogbound :
      v (logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hn) ≤ WithZero.exp (-b) :=
    valuation_limit_le_of_tendsto_of_eventually_le v
      (tendsto_logOnePlusPartialSumField_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_of_lt_one
        (p := p) v (v.residueRamificationIndex p) x hn
        (fun n => v.natCast_eq_exp_neg_ramificationIndex_mul_padicValNat p
          (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)) hx
        (ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.completeSpace_ofWithZeroValuation v))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpartial)
  have hvalue : logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hn =
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd := rfl
  rw [hvalue] at hlogbound
  have hlog := (WithZero.log_le_iff_le_exp ((v.ne_zero_iff).mpr hu)).mpr hlogbound
  change b ≤ -WithZero.log (v (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd)
  omega

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue_apply
    (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A)
    (z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F) :
    fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue F φ c z =
      φ z.1.2 * Multiplicative.ofAdd (Multiplicative.toAdd z.2 • c)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue_root
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue_root
    (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A)
    (ζ : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.residueRootsOfUnityGroup F) :
    fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue F φ c
        ((ζ, 1), (1 : Multiplicative ℤ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change φ 1 * Multiplicative.ofAdd ((0 : ℤ) • c) = 1
  rw [φ.map_one, zero_smul]
  exact one_mul 1

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue_principal
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue_principal
    (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A)
    (u : (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1) :
    fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue F φ c
        (((1 : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.residueRootsOfUnityGroup F), u),
          (1 : Multiplicative ℤ)) = φ u
proof:
:= by
  change φ u * Multiplicative.ofAdd ((0 : ℤ) • c) = φ u
  rw [zero_smul]
  exact mul_one _

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue_uniformizer
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue_uniformizer
    (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A)
    (m : ℤ) :
    fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue F φ c
        (((1 : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.residueRootsOfUnityGroup F),
            (1 : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1)),
          Multiplicative.ofAdd m) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (m • c)
proof:
:= by
  change φ 1 * Multiplicative.ofAdd (m • c) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (m • c)
  rw [φ.map_one, one_mul]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_apply
    (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (d : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F ≃* Kˣ)
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A) (x : Kˣ) :
    fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue F d φ c x =
      φ (d.symm x).1.2 *
        Multiplicative.ofAdd (Multiplicative.toAdd (d.symm x).2 • c)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_apply_of_decomposition_eq
statement:
theorem fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_apply_of_decomposition_eq
    (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (d : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F ≃* Kˣ)
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A)
    (z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F)
    {x : Kˣ} (hx : d z = x) :
    fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue F d φ c x =
      φ z.1.2 * Multiplicative.ofAdd (Multiplicative.toAdd z.2 • c)
proof:
:= by
  subst x
  rw [fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_apply, d.symm_apply_apply]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_eq_of_principal_decomposition
statement:
theorem fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_eq_of_principal_decomposition
    (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (d : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F ≃* Kˣ)
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A)
    (u : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1) {x : Kˣ}
    (hx :
      d (((1 : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.residueRootsOfUnityGroup F), u),
          (1 : Multiplicative ℤ)) = x) :
    fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue F d φ c x = φ u
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_apply_of_decomposition_eq
      F d φ c
      (((1 : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.residueRootsOfUnityGroup F), u),
        (1 : Multiplicative ℤ)) hx

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_eq_of_completeDVF_principal
statement:
theorem fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_eq_of_completeDVF_principal
    (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A)
    (u : (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1) :
    fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue F
        (fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
          F hπ) φ c
        (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (u : F.valuationSubringˣ)) = φ u
proof:
:= by
  apply fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_eq_of_principal_decomposition
    (F := F)
    (d :=
      fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
        F hπ)
    (φ := φ) (c := c) (u := u)
  simp
    [fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF_apply]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.continuous_fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue
statement:
theorem continuous_fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue
    [TopologicalSpace K] (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    [IsTopologicalAddGroup A]
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A)
    (hφ : Continuous φ) :
    Continuous (fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue F φ c)
proof:
:= by
  have hprincipal :
      Continuous
        (fun z :
            CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F =>
          φ z.1.2) :=
    hφ.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst)
  have huniformizer :
      Continuous
        (fun z :
            CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F =>
          Multiplicative.ofAdd (Multiplicative.toAdd z.2 • c)) := by
    have hdisc :
        Continuous
          (fun m : Multiplicative ℤ =>
            Multiplicative.ofAdd (Multiplicative.toAdd m • c)) :=
      continuous_of_discreteTopology
    exact hdisc.comp continuous_snd
  exact hprincipal.mul huniformizer

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.continuous_fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue
statement:
theorem continuous_fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue
    [TopologicalSpace K] (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField]
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    [IsTopologicalAddGroup A]
    (d : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F ≃ₜ* Kˣ)
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative A) (c : A)
    (hφ : Continuous φ) :
    Continuous (fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue F d.toMulEquiv φ c)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    (continuous_fieldUnitDecompositionLogHomWithUniformizerValue F φ c hφ).comp
      d.symm.continuous

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_uniformizerLogValueKilling
statement:
theorem fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_uniformizerLogValueKilling
    (F : CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField] [CharZero K]
    (d : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.fieldUnitDecompositionFactors F ≃* Kˣ)
    (φ : (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative K) (a : Kˣ)
    (ha : Multiplicative.toAdd (d.symm a).2 ≠ 0) :
    fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue F d φ
        (uniformizerLogValueKilling F d φ a) a = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  change
    Multiplicative.toAdd (φ (d.symm a).1.2) +
        Multiplicative.toAdd (d.symm a).2 •
          uniformizerLogValueKilling F d φ a = 0
  rw [uniformizerLogValueKilling]
  simp [zsmul_eq_mul, ha]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.normalBasisCharacterEigenvector_eigen
statement:
theorem normalBasisCharacterEigenvector_eigen (χ : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Kˣ)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    σ (normalBasisCharacterEigenvector χ) =
      (χ σ : K) • normalBasisCharacterEigenvector χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold normalBasisCharacterEigenvector
  calc
    σ (∑ δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (((χ δ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) • IsGalois.normalBasis K L δ) =
        ∑ δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
          (((χ δ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) • IsGalois.normalBasis K L (σ * δ) := by
      rw [map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro δ hδ
      rw [map_smul, IsGalois.normalBasis_apply δ,
        IsGalois.normalBasis_apply (σ * δ), AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
    _ = ∑ δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
        (χ σ : K) • ((((χ (σ * δ))⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) •
          IsGalois.normalBasis K L (σ * δ)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro δ hδ
      rw [smul_smul, χ.map_mul σ δ, mul_inv_rev, Units.val_mul,
        mul_left_comm (χ σ : K), Units.mul_inv, mul_one]
    _ = ∑ δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
        (χ σ : K) • ((((χ δ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) • IsGalois.normalBasis K L δ) :=
      Function.Bijective.sum_comp (Group.mulLeft_bijective σ)
        (fun δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L =>
          (χ σ : K) • ((((χ δ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) • IsGalois.normalBasis K L δ))
    _ = (χ σ : K) •
        ∑ δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, (((χ δ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) • IsGalois.normalBasis K L δ :=
      Finset.smul_sum.symm

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.normalBasisCharacterEigenvector_ne_zero
statement:
theorem normalBasisCharacterEigenvector_ne_zero (χ : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Kˣ) :
    normalBasisCharacterEigenvector χ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoord : (IsGalois.normalBasis K L).repr
      (normalBasisCharacterEigenvector χ) 1 = (1 : K) := by
    have h := congrFun ((IsGalois.normalBasis K L).repr_sum_self
      (fun δ : L ≃ₐ[K] L => (((χ δ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K))) 1
    simpa only [normalBasisCharacterEigenvector, map_one, inv_one, Units.val_one] using h
  intro hzero
  rw [hzero, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] at hcoord
  exact zero_ne_one hcoord

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_nonzero_characterEigenvector
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_characterEigenvector (χ : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Kˣ) :
    ∃ b : L, b ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, σ b = (χ σ : K) • b
proof:
:=
  ⟨normalBasisCharacterEigenvector χ, normalBasisCharacterEigenvector_ne_zero χ,
    normalBasisCharacterEigenvector_eigen χ⟩

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.continuous_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar
statement:
theorem continuous_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    @Continuous ℤ_[p] K (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace ℤ_[p])
      (Valued.mk' v).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p)
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  have : IsTopologicalRing v.valuationSubring :=
    Subring.instIsTopologicalRing v.valuationSubring.toSubring
  have hadic : IsAdic (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring) :=
    ValuationTheory.Valuations.rankOneDiscreteValuationSubring_isAdic
  have hcontinuous : Continuous (padicIntToValuationSubringOfMixedChar v p) := by
    apply continuous_of_continuousAt_zero (padicIntToValuationSubringOfMixedChar v p)
    rw [ContinuousAt, map_zero, hadic.hasBasis_nhds_zero.tendsto_right_iff]
    intro n _
    have hkernel :
        ((RingHom.ker (PadicInt.toZModPow n : ℤ_[p] →+* ZMod (p ^ n)) :
          Ideal ℤ_[p]) : Set ℤ_[p]) ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℤ_[p]) :=
      (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.isOpen_ker_padicIntToZModPow p n).mem_nhds
        (RingHom.ker (PadicInt.toZModPow n)).zero_mem
    filter_upwards [hkernel] with a ha
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    rw [padicIntToValuationSubringOfMixedChar_mod_pow]
    change PadicInt.toZModPow n a = 0 at ha
    rw [ha, ZMod.cast_zero]
  exact continuous_subtype_val.comp hcontinuous

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.ringEquiv_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (f : K ≃+* K) (hval : ∀ x : K, v (f x) = v x) (a : ℤ_[p]) :
    f (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p a) = padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p a
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  have hmap : Continuous (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p) :=
    continuous_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p
  have hf : Continuous f :=
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.continuous_ringEquiv_of_preserves v f hval
  refine PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.induction_on a (isClosed_eq (hf.comp hmap) hmap) ?_
  intro n
  simp only [map_natCast]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.ringEquiv_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar_mul
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar_mul
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (f : K ≃+* K) (hval : ∀ x : K, v (f x) = v x) (a : ℤ_[p]) (x : K) :
    f (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p a * x) = padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p a * f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.map_mul, ringEquiv_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p f hval a]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.continuous_restrictedAutomorphism
statement:
private theorem continuous_restrictedAutomorphism [TopologicalSpace K]
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF K)
    (f : K ≃+* K)
    (hmem : ∀ z : K, z ∈ F.valuation.valuationSubring ↔ f z ∈ F.valuation.valuationSubring)
    (hf : Continuous f) (n : ℕ) : Continuous (equivOfPreserves F f hmem n)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Continuous (valuationSubringRingEquivOfPreserves F f hmem) :=
    continuous_induced_rng.2 (hf.comp continuous_subtype_val)
  apply continuous_induced_rng.2
  change Continuous fun z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F n =>
    Units.map (valuationSubringRingEquivOfPreserves F f hmem).toMonoidHom
      (z : F.valuationSubringˣ)
  exact (Units.continuous_map hr).comp continuous_subtype_val

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar_equivOfPreserves
statement:
theorem principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar_equivOfPreserves
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (f : K ≃+* K) (hval : ∀ x : K, v (f x) = v x)
    (a : ℤ_[p]) (x : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1) :
    equivOfPreserves (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) f
        (fun z => by change v z ≤ 1 ↔ v (f z) ≤ 1; rw [hval z]) 1
        (principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p a x) =
      principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p a
        (equivOfPreserves (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) f
          (fun z => by change v z ≤ 1 ↔ v (f z) ≤ 1; rw [hval z]) 1 x)
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  let F := completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v
  let e := equivOfPreserves F f
    (fun z => by change v z ≤ 1 ↔ v (f z) ≤ 1; rw [hval z]) 1
  let : Module ℤ_[p] (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1)) :=
    principalUnitPadicModuleOfMixedChar v p
  have : ContinuousSMul ℤ_[p] (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1)) :=
    principalUnitPadicContinuousSMul (K := K) p
      (hres := by change CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p; infer_instance)
  have hf : Continuous f :=
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.continuous_ringEquiv_of_preserves v f hval
  have he : Continuous e := continuous_restrictedAutomorphism F f
    (fun z => by change v z ≤ 1 ↔ v (f z) ≤ 1; rw [hval z]) hf 1
  have : T2Space (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1)) :=
    (principalUnitAdicContinuousAddEquiv (K := K)).toHomeomorph.t2Space
  have h := map_padicInt_smul_of_continuous e.toAdditive.toAddMonoidHom he a (Additive.ofMul x)
  exact congrArg Additive.toMul h

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.map_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar
statement:
theorem map_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar
    (vK : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (vL : _root_.Valuation L (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vK]
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vL]
    [vK.HasExtension vL]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vK.valuationSubring) p]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vL.valuationSubring) p]
    (a : ℤ_[p]) :
    algebraMap K L (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vK p a) =
      padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vL p a
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' vK
  let : Valued L (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' vL
  have hleft : Continuous (fun z : ℤ_[p] =>
      algebraMap K L (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vK p z)) :=
    (ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.continuous_algebraMap_of_hasExtension
      vK vL).comp (continuous_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vK p)
  have hclosed : IsClosed {z : ℤ_[p] |
      algebraMap K L (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vK p z) =
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vL p z} :=
    isClosed_eq hleft (continuous_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vL p)
  refine PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.induction_on a hclosed ?_
  intro n
  simp only [map_natCast]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector_repr
statement:
theorem normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector_repr (Δ : Subgroup Gal(L/K))
    (χ : Gal(L/K) →* Kˣ) (δ : Gal(L/K)) :
    (IsGalois.normalBasis K L).repr (normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ) δ =
      (Δ : Set Gal(L/K)).indicator (fun τ => (((χ τ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K)) δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact congrFun ((IsGalois.normalBasis K L).repr_sum_self
    ((Δ : Set Gal(L/K)).indicator (fun τ => (((χ τ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K)))) δ

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.map_normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector
statement:
private theorem map_normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector (Δ : Subgroup Gal(L/K))
    (χ : Gal(L/K) →* Kˣ) (σ : Gal(L/K)) :
    σ (normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ) =
      ∑ δ : Gal(L/K),
        (Δ : Set Gal(L/K)).indicator (fun τ => (((χ τ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K)) δ •
          IsGalois.normalBasis K L (σ * δ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro δ _hδ
  rw [map_smul, IsGalois.normalBasis_apply δ,
    IsGalois.normalBasis_apply (σ * δ), AlgEquiv.mul_apply]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector_eigen
statement:
theorem normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector_eigen (Δ : Subgroup Gal(L/K))
    (χ : Gal(L/K) →* Kˣ) (σ : Δ) :
    (σ : Gal(L/K)) (normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ) =
      (χ (σ : Gal(L/K)) : K) • normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : Gal(L/K) → K :=
    (Δ : Set Gal(L/K)).indicator (fun τ => (((χ τ)⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K))
  have hcoeff (δ : Gal(L/K)) :
      c δ = (χ (σ : Gal(L/K)) : K) * c ((σ : Gal(L/K)) * δ) := by
    by_cases hδ : δ ∈ Δ
    · have hσδ : (σ : Gal(L/K)) * δ ∈ Δ := Δ.mul_mem σ.property hδ
      dsimp only [c]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hδ, Set.indicator_of_mem hσδ]
      symm
      rw [χ.map_mul, mul_inv_rev, Units.val_mul,
        mul_left_comm (χ (σ : Gal(L/K)) : K), Units.mul_inv, mul_one]
    · have hσδ : (σ : Gal(L/K)) * δ ∉ Δ :=
        fun h => hδ ((Δ.mul_mem_cancel_left σ.property).mp h)
      dsimp only [c]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hδ, Set.indicator_of_notMem hσδ, mul_zero]
  calc
    (σ : Gal(L/K)) (normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ) =
        ∑ δ : Gal(L/K), c δ • IsGalois.normalBasis K L ((σ : Gal(L/K)) * δ) :=
      map_normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ (σ : Gal(L/K))
    _ = ∑ δ : Gal(L/K),
        (χ (σ : Gal(L/K)) : K) •
          (c ((σ : Gal(L/K)) * δ) •
            IsGalois.normalBasis K L ((σ : Gal(L/K)) * δ)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro δ _hδ
      rw [hcoeff δ, smul_smul]
    _ = ∑ δ : Gal(L/K),
        (χ (σ : Gal(L/K)) : K) • (c δ • IsGalois.normalBasis K L δ) :=
      Function.Bijective.sum_comp (Group.mulLeft_bijective (σ : Gal(L/K)))
        (fun δ : Gal(L/K) =>
          (χ (σ : Gal(L/K)) : K) • (c δ • IsGalois.normalBasis K L δ))
    _ = (χ (σ : Gal(L/K)) : K) • normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ :=
      Finset.smul_sum.symm

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector_not_eigen
statement:
theorem normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector_not_eigen (Δ : Subgroup Gal(L/K))
    (χ : Gal(L/K) →* Kˣ) (g : Gal(L/K)) (hg : g ∉ Δ) :
    g (normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ) ≠
      (χ g : K) • normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoord : (IsGalois.normalBasis K L).repr
      (normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ) 1 = (1 : K) := by
    rw [normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector_repr, Set.indicator_of_mem Δ.one_mem,
      map_one, inv_one, Units.val_one]
  have hmoved : (IsGalois.normalBasis K L).repr
      (g (normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ)) 1 = (0 : K) := by
    rw [map_normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector, map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro δ _hδ
    by_cases hδ : δ ∈ Δ
    · have hne : g * δ ≠ 1 := by
        intro h
        apply hg
        rw [mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv.mp h]
        exact Δ.inv_mem hδ
      rw [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self_apply,
        ite_eq_right hne, smul_zero]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hδ, zero_smul, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  intro h
  have hrepr := congrArg (fun x : L => (IsGalois.normalBasis K L).repr x 1) h
  rw [hmoved, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, hcoord, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hrepr
  exact (χ g).ne_zero hrepr.symm

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_nonzero_subgroupCharacterEigenvector_not_eigen
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_subgroupCharacterEigenvector_not_eigen
    (Δ : Subgroup Gal(L/K)) (χ : Gal(L/K) →* Kˣ)
    (g : Gal(L/K)) (hg : g ∉ Δ) :
    ∃ b : L, b ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ δ : Δ, (δ : Gal(L/K)) b = (χ (δ : Gal(L/K)) : K) • b) ∧
      g b ≠ (χ g : K) • b
proof:
:= by
  have hne := normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector_not_eigen Δ χ g hg
  refine ⟨normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector Δ χ, ?_,
    normalBasisSubgroupCharacterVector_eigen Δ χ, hne⟩
  intro hzero
  apply hne
  rw [hzero, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar_natCast
statement:
theorem principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar_natCast (n : ℕ)
    (x : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1) :
    principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p (n : ℤ_[p]) x = x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  let : Module ℤ_[p] (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
      (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1)) := principalUnitPadicModuleOfMixedChar v p
  change Additive.toMul ((n : ℤ_[p]) • Additive.ofMul x) = x ^ n
  rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  rfl

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.principalUnit_valuationTopology_eq_adic
statement:
theorem principalUnit_valuationTopology_eq_adic :
    (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace
      (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
        (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K
          (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))) 1))) =
      principalUnitAdicTopology (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation
        (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation
    (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
  let π : F.valuationSubring := chosenPrincipalUnitPadicUniformizer F
  have hmax : (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace F.valuationSubring) =
      F.maximalIdeal.adicTopology :=
    ValuationTheory.Valuations.rankOneDiscreteValuationSubring_isAdic
      (K := K) (Gamma := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
  have hideal : LubinTate.Valuations.uniformizerPowerIdeal π 1 = F.maximalIdeal := by
    rw [LubinTate.Valuations.uniformizerPowerIdeal, pow_one,
      ← F.maximalIdeal_eq_span_uniformizer (chosenPrincipalUnitPadicUniformizer_isUniformizer F)]
  let carrierTopology (t : TopologicalSpace F.valuationSubring) :
      TopologicalSpace (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1)) :=
    let : TopologicalSpace F.valuationSubring := t
    inferInstance
  change carrierTopology (inferInstance : TopologicalSpace F.valuationSubring) =
    carrierTopology (LubinTate.Valuations.uniformizerPowerIdeal π 1).adicTopology
  rw [hideal]
  exact congrArg carrierTopology hmax

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_pow_mul
statement:
theorem exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_pow_mul
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (b : K) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
      (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1),
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = (p : K) ^ n * b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := v.exists_natCast_pow_mul_le_one p b
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_sq_mul v p
    ⟨(p : K) ^ n * b, hn⟩
  refine ⟨n + 2, u, ?_⟩
  change (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd =
    (p : K) ^ 2 * ((p : K) ^ n * b) at hu
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.add_comm 2 n] at hu
  exact hu

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_pow_mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_pow_mul_ne_zero
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (b : K) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
      (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1),
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = (p : K) ^ n * b ∧
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, u, hu⟩ := exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_pow_mul v p b
  refine ⟨n, u, hu, ?_⟩
  rw [hu]
  exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero n
    (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero)) hb

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_principalUnitPadicPow_div_natCast_eq_pow
statement:
theorem exists_principalUnitPadicPow_div_natCast_eq_pow (a : ℤ_[p])
    (x : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1)
    (s : ℕ) :
    ∃ y : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
      principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p a x /
          x ^ (PadicInt.toZModPow s a).val = y ^ (p ^ s)
proof:
:= by
  let n : ℕ := (PadicInt.toZModPow s a).val
  have hker : a - (n : ℤ_[p]) ∈ RingHom.ker (PadicInt.toZModPow s) := by
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, map_natCast]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (PadicInt.toZModPow s a)).symm
  have hdiv : (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ s ∣ a - (n : ℤ_[p]) := by
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp
    rw [← PadicInt.ker_toZModPow]
    exact hker
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdiv
  let : Module ℤ_[p] (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
      (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1)) := principalUnitPadicModuleOfMixedChar v p
  refine ⟨principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p c x, ?_⟩
  change Additive.toMul (a • Additive.ofMul x) / x ^ n =
    Additive.toMul (c • Additive.ofMul x) ^ (p ^ s)
  have hsmul :
      a • Additive.ofMul x - (n : ℤ_[p]) • Additive.ofMul x =
        (p ^ s : ℕ) • (c • Additive.ofMul x) := by
    rw [← sub_smul, hc, mul_smul, ← Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  simpa only [toMul_sub, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul,
    toMul_nsmul, toMul_ofMul] using
    congrArg (Additive.toMul :
      Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
        (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1) →
      CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1) hsmul

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_fieldUnit_principalUnitPadicPow_div_natCast_eq_pow
statement:
theorem exists_fieldUnit_principalUnitPadicPow_div_natCast_eq_pow (a : ℤ_[p])
    (x : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1)
    (s : ℕ) :
    ∃ y : Kˣ,
      CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v)
          (principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p a x :
            (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ) /
        (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v)
          (x : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ)) ^
            (PadicInt.toZModPow s a).val = y ^ (p ^ s)
proof:
:= by
  let ι : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1 →* Kˣ :=
    (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v)).comp
      (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1).subtype
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_principalUnitPadicPow_div_natCast_eq_pow v p a x s
  refine ⟨ι y, ?_⟩
  change ι (principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p a x) /
    (ι x) ^ (PadicInt.toZModPow s a).val = (ι y) ^ (p ^ s)
  simpa only [_root_.map_div, _root_.map_pow] using congrArg ι hy

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.averageMap_ker_divisible_of_action_sub_divisible
statement:
theorem averageMap_ker_divisible_of_action_sub_divisible
    (ρ : Representation R Λ M) (c : R)
    (hdiv : ∀ (g : Λ) (x : M), ∃ y : M, ρ g x - x = c • y)
    (x : M) (hx : ρ.averageMap x = 0) :
    ∃ y : M, ρ.averageMap y = 0 ∧ c • y = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose z hz using fun g : Λ => hdiv g x
  have hsum : (∑ g : Λ, (ρ g x - x)) = c • ∑ g : Λ, z g := by
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun g _ => hz g)
  have havg : ρ.averageMap x - x =
      ⅟(Fintype.card Λ : R) • ∑ g : Λ, (ρ g x - x) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, smul_sub, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul R, smul_smul, invOf_mul_self, one_smul]
    apply congrArg (fun a : M => a - x)
    simp only [Representation.averageMap, GroupAlgebra.average, map_smul, map_sum,
      Representation.asAlgebraHom_of, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  let b : M := ⅟(Fintype.card Λ : R) • ∑ g : Λ, z g
  have hb : c • b = -x := by
    change c • (⅟(Fintype.card Λ : R) • ∑ g : Λ, z g) = -x
    rw [smul_comm c (⅟(Fintype.card Λ : R)), ← hsum, ← havg, hx, zero_sub]
  have hneg : c • (-b) = x := by
    rw [smul_neg, hb, neg_neg]
  refine ⟨-b - ρ.averageMap (-b), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_sub,
      ρ.averageMap_id (ρ.averageMap (-b)) (ρ.averageMap_invariant (-b)), sub_self]
  · rw [smul_sub, hneg, ← map_smul, hneg, hx, sub_zero]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_apply_toAdd
statement:
@[simp] theorem principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_apply_toAdd
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1) :
    (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd =
      principalUnitLogSeriesOfWithZeroValuation v u
        (fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))
proof: := rfl

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.continuous_principalUnitLogOfMixedChar
statement:
theorem continuous_principalUnitLogOfMixedChar
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    letI : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
proof:
:= Valued.mk' v
    Continuous (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p) :=
  continuous_principalUnitLogSeriesHomOfWithZeroValuationScaled (p := p) v
    (v.residueRamificationIndex p)
    (fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))
    (fun n => v.natCast_eq_exp_neg_ramificationIndex_mul_padicValNat p
      (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))
    (ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.completeSpace_ofWithZeroValuation v)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_padicPow
statement:
theorem principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_padicPow
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (a : ℤ_[p])
    (x : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1) :
    (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p (principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p a x)).toAdd =
      padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p a * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p x).toAdd
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  let : Module ℤ_[p] (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
      (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1)) := principalUnitPadicModuleOfMixedChar v p
  let : Algebra ℤ_[p] K := (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p).toAlgebra
  have : ContinuousSMul ℤ_[p] (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
      (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1)) :=
    principalUnitPadicContinuousSMul (K := K) p
      (hres := by change CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p; infer_instance)
  have : ContinuousSMul ℤ_[p] K := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    change Continuous fun z : ℤ_[p] × K => padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p z.1 * z.2
    exact ((continuous_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p).comp continuous_fst).mul continuous_snd
  have hlog : Continuous (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p).toAdditiveLeft :=
    continuous_principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p
  change (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p).toAdditiveLeft (a • Additive.ofMul x) =
    a • (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p).toAdditiveLeft (Additive.ofMul x)
  exact map_padicInt_smul_of_continuous (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p).toAdditiveLeft
    hlog a (Additive.ofMul x)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.inverseCharacterTwist_mem_invariants_iff
statement:
theorem inverseCharacterTwist_mem_invariants_iff
    (χ : Δ →* Rˣ) (ρ : Representation R Δ A) (a : A) :
    a ∈ (inverseCharacterTwist χ ρ).invariants ↔
      ∀ g : Δ, ρ g a = (χ g : R) • a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha g
    have h := congrArg (fun x : A => (χ g : R) • x) (ha g)
    change (χ g : R) • (((χ g)⁻¹ : Rˣ) • ρ g a) = (χ g : R) • a at h
    simpa only [Units.smul_def, smul_smul, Units.mul_inv, one_smul] using h
  · intro ha g
    change ((χ g)⁻¹ : Rˣ) • ρ g a = a
    rw [Units.smul_def, ha g, smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_equivOfPreserves
statement:
theorem principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_equivOfPreserves
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (f : K ≃+* K) (hval : ∀ x : K, v (f x) = v x)
    (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1) :
    (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p
      (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.equivOfPreserves
        (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) f
        (fun x => by change v x ≤ 1 ↔ v (f x) ≤ 1; rw [hval x]) 1 u)).toAdd =
      f (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd
proof:
:= by
  rw [principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_apply_toAdd, principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_apply_toAdd]
  simp only [principalUnitLogSeriesOfWithZeroValuation]
  rw [map_logOnePlusSeriesField_of_preserves v f hval]
  congr 1
  simp only [principalUnitSubOneOfWithZeroValuation,
    CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.equivOfPreserves_apply_coe,
    _root_.map_sub, _root_.map_one]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.principalUnitLogLinearMapOfMixedChar_apply

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.characterAverage_apply
statement:
theorem characterAverage_apply (χ : Δ →* Rˣ) (ρ : Representation R Δ A) (a : A) :
    characterAverage χ ρ a =
      ⅟(Fintype.card Δ : R) • ∑ g : Δ, (((χ g)⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) • ρ g a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [characterAverage, Representation.averageMap, GroupAlgebra.average,
    map_smul, map_sum, Representation.asAlgebraHom_of, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    LinearMap.sum_apply, inverseCharacterTwist, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.characterAverage_eigen
statement:
theorem characterAverage_eigen (χ : Δ →* Rˣ) (ρ : Representation R Δ A) (a : A)
    (g : Δ) :
    ρ g (characterAverage χ ρ a) = (χ g : R) • characterAverage χ ρ a
proof:
:=
  (inverseCharacterTwist_mem_invariants_iff χ ρ (characterAverage χ ρ a)).mp
    ((inverseCharacterTwist χ ρ).averageMap_invariant a) g

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.characterAverage_eq_self
statement:
theorem characterAverage_eq_self (χ : Δ →* Rˣ) (ρ : Representation R Δ A) (a : A)
    (ha : ∀ g : Δ, ρ g a = (χ g : R) • a) :
    characterAverage χ ρ a = a
proof:
:=
  (inverseCharacterTwist χ ρ).averageMap_id a
    ((inverseCharacterTwist_mem_invariants_iff χ ρ a).mpr ha)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.map_characterAverage
proof:
:= by
  rw [characterAverage_apply, characterAverage_apply]
  simp only [map_smul, map_sum, f.isIntertwining]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_eigen_preimage
statement:
theorem exists_eigen_preimage (χ : Δ →* Rˣ) {ρ : Representation R Δ A}
    {σ : Representation R Δ B} (f : Representation.IntertwiningMap ρ σ) (b : B)
    (hb : ∀ g : Δ, σ g b = (χ g : R) • b) (hrange : b ∈ Set.range f) :
    ∃ a : A, f a = b ∧ ∀ g : Δ, ρ g a = (χ g : R) • a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hrange
  refine ⟨characterAverage χ ρ a, ?_, characterAverage_eigen χ ρ a⟩
  rw [map_characterAverage, ha]
  exact characterAverage_eq_self χ σ b hb

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.valuation_signedLogSeriesTermField_le_mixedChar
statement:
theorem valuation_signedLogSeriesTermField_le_mixedChar
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (x : K) (hxv : v x < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    v (signedLogSeriesTermField x
        (fun k => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)) n) ≤
      WithZero.exp (-(((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp only [hx, signedLogSeriesTermField, logSeriesTermField,
      zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero n), zero_div, mul_zero, v.map_zero]
    exact zero_le
  have hxpos : 0 < (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 x hx) :=
    ofWithZeroValuation_val_mk0_pos_of_lt_one v hx hxv
  have hxone : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 x hx) := hxpos
  have hn : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  let t : Kˣ := Units.mk0 x hx ^ (n + 1) / Units.mk0 ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) hn
  have ht : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ) ≤
      (ofWithZeroValuation v).val t := by
    rw [show (ofWithZeroValuation v).val t =
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 x hx) -
        (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ) from
      ofWithZeroValuation_val_pow_div_natCast_scaled v (v.residueRamificationIndex p)
        (Units.mk0 x hx) hn
        (v.natCast_eq_exp_neg_ramificationIndex_mul_padicValNat p
          (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))]
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxone (Int.natCast_nonneg (n + 1))
    rw [mul_one] at hmul
    exact sub_le_sub_right hmul _
  have hlog : WithZero.log (v (t : K)) ≤
      -(((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ)) := by
    change ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) -
        (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ) ≤
      -WithZero.log (v (t : K)) at ht
    omega
  have hbound := WithZero.le_exp_of_log_le hlog
  rw [signedLogSeriesTermField, v.map_mul, v.map_pow, v.map_neg, v.map_one,
    one_pow, one_mul]
  simpa only [t, logSeriesTermField, Units.val_div_eq_div_val,
    Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_mk0] using hbound

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.summable_formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_logDegree_monomialValue_pair_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
statement:
theorem
  summable_formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_logDegree_monomialValue_pair_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
    [Algebra ℚ K]
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (e : ℕ) (x y : K)
    (hnK : ∀ n : ℕ, (((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0))
    (hnval : ∀ n : ℕ,
      v (((n + 1 : ℕ) : K)) =
        WithZero.exp (-((e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ))))
    (hvx : v x < (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (hvy : v y < (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (hcomplete :
      letI : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
      CompleteSpace K) :
    letI : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
proof:
:= Valued.mk' v
    Summable
      (fun qd : Sigma fun _ : ℕ => Fin 2 →₀ ℕ =>
        PowerSeries.coeff qd.1 (PowerSeries.log K) *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff qd.2
            ((formalLogOnePlusProductArgument K) ^ qd.1) *
          mvPowerSeriesMonomialValue
            (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then x else y) qd.2) := by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  let : CompleteSpace K := hcomplete
  have : NonarchimedeanRing K := nonarchimedeanRing_ofWithZeroValuation v
  let term : (Sigma fun _ : ℕ => Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) → K := fun qd =>
    PowerSeries.coeff qd.1 (PowerSeries.log K) *
      MvPowerSeries.coeff qd.2
        ((formalLogOnePlusProductArgument K) ^ qd.1) *
      mvPowerSeriesMonomialValue
        (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then x else y) qd.2
  change Summable term
  rw [NonarchimedeanAddGroup.summable_iff_tendsto_cofinite_zero]
  rw [tendsto_def]
  intro s hs
  have hrepr := Valued.mem_nhds_zero.mp hs
  let γ := Classical.choose hrepr
  have hγ := Classical.choose_spec hrepr
  have hball :
      {z : K |
        v z < MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀.embedding γ.1} ∈ nhds (0 : K) := by
    apply Valued.mem_nhds_zero.mpr
    exact ⟨γ, by
      intro z hz
      change Valued.v.restrict z < γ.1 at hz
      rw [Valuation.restrict_lt_iff_lt_embedding] at hz
      exact hz⟩
  have hxsum :=
    hasSum_powerSeries_log_eval_nat_logOnePlusSeriesField_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
      (v := v) (p := p) e x hnK hnval hvx hcomplete
  have hysum :=
    hasSum_powerSeries_log_eval_nat_logOnePlusSeriesField_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
      (v := v) (p := p) e y hnK hnval hvy hcomplete
  have hxzero :
      Tendsto
        (fun q : ℕ =>
          PowerSeries.coeff q (PowerSeries.log K) * x ^ q)
        atTop (nhds (0 : K)) := by
    have h := hxsum.summable.tendsto_cofinite_zero
    simpa [Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop] using h
  have hyzero :
      Tendsto
        (fun q : ℕ =>
          PowerSeries.coeff q (PowerSeries.log K) * y ^ q)
        atTop (nhds (0 : K)) := by
    have h := hysum.summable.tendsto_cofinite_zero
    simpa [Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop] using h
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ q : ℕ in atTop,
      v (PowerSeries.coeff q (PowerSeries.log K) * x ^ q) <
          MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀.embedding γ.1 ∧
      v (PowerSeries.coeff q (PowerSeries.log K) * y ^ q) <
          MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀.embedding γ.1 :=
    (hxzero.eventually hball).and (hyzero.eventually hball)
  have hexN := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hevent
  let N := Classical.choose hexN
  have hN := Classical.choose_spec hexN
  let P : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K :=
    formalLogOnePlusProductArgumentPolynomial K
  let E : Finset (Sigma fun _ : ℕ => Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :=
    (Finset.range N).sigma fun q => (P ^ q).support
  apply Filter.mem_cofinite.mpr
  apply E.finite_toSet.subset
  intro qd hbad
  by_contra hnotE
  have hgood : term qd ∈ s := by
    by_cases hqsmall : qd.1 < N
    · have hdnot : qd.2 ∉ (P ^ qd.1).support := by
        intro hd
        apply hnotE
        exact Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr hqsmall, hd⟩
      have hpoly : (P ^ qd.1).coeff qd.2 = 0 := by
        by_contra hp
        exact hdnot (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hp)
      have hcoeff :
          MvPowerSeries.coeff qd.2
              ((formalLogOnePlusProductArgument K) ^ qd.1) = 0 := by
        rw [formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_eq_coe_polynomial,
          ← MvPolynomial.coe_pow, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe]
        exact hpoly
      have htermzero : term qd = 0 := by simp [term, hcoeff]
      rw [htermzero]
      exact mem_of_mem_nhds hs
    · have hqN : N ≤ qd.1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt hqsmall
      have hcomp := hN qd.1 hqN
      apply hγ
      change Valued.v.restrict (term qd) < γ.1
      rw [Valuation.restrict_lt_iff_lt_embedding]
      have hbound :=
        valuation_formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_sigmaTerm_le_max
          (v := v) (p := p) e hnval hvx hvy qd.1 qd.2
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hbound (max_lt hcomp.1 hcomp.2)
  exact hbad hgood

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.hasSum_formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_logDegree_monomialValue_pair_sigma_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
statement:
theorem
hasSum_formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_logDegree_monomialValue_pair_sigma_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
    [Algebra ℚ K]
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (e : ℕ) (x y : K)
    (hnK : ∀ n : ℕ, (((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0))
    (hnval : ∀ n : ℕ,
      v (((n + 1 : ℕ) : K)) =
        WithZero.exp (-((e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ))))
    (hvx : v x < (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (hvy : v y < (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (hcomplete :
      letI : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
      CompleteSpace K) :
    letI : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
proof:
:= Valued.mk' v
    HasSum
      (fun qd : Sigma fun _ : ℕ => Fin 2 →₀ ℕ =>
        PowerSeries.coeff qd.1 (PowerSeries.log K) *
          MvPowerSeries.coeff qd.2
            ((formalLogOnePlusProductArgument K) ^ qd.1) *
          mvPowerSeriesMonomialValue
            (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then x else y) qd.2)
      (logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v (x + y + x * y) hnK) := by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  have harg :
      v (x + y + x * y) < (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) :=
    valuation_log_mul_argument_lt_one_of_lt_one v hvx hvy
  have houter :
      HasSum
        (fun q : ℕ =>
          PowerSeries.coeff q (PowerSeries.log K) *
            (x + y + x * y) ^ q)
        (logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v
          (x + y + x * y) hnK) :=
    hasSum_powerSeries_log_eval_nat_logOnePlusSeriesField_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
      (v := v) (p := p) e (x + y + x * y) hnK hnval harg hcomplete
  have hinner :
      ∀ q : ℕ,
        HasSum
          (fun d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ =>
            PowerSeries.coeff q (PowerSeries.log K) *
              MvPowerSeries.coeff d
                ((formalLogOnePlusProductArgument K) ^ q) *
              mvPowerSeriesMonomialValue
                (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then x else y) d)
          (PowerSeries.coeff q (PowerSeries.log K) *
            (x + y + x * y) ^ q) := by
    intro q
    exact
      hasSum_formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_pow_monomialValue_pair_mul_left
        K (PowerSeries.coeff q (PowerSeries.log K)) x y q
  have hsigma :=
    summable_formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_logDegree_monomialValue_pair_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
      (v := v) (p := p) e x y hnK hnval hvx hvy hcomplete
  exact HasSum.sigma_of_hasSum houter hinner hsigma

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.hasSum_formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_logSubst_monomialValue_pair_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
statement:
theorem
  hasSum_formalLogOnePlusProductArgument_logSubst_monomialValue_pair_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
    [Algebra ℚ K]
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (e : ℕ) (x y : K)
    (hnK : ∀ n : ℕ, (((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0))
    (hnval : ∀ n : ℕ,
      v (((n + 1 : ℕ) : K)) =
        WithZero.exp (-((e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ))))
    (hvx : v x < (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (hvy : v y < (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (hcomplete :

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_sq_mul
statement:
theorem exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_sq_mul
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (a : v.valuationSubring) :
    ∃ u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = (p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF K :=
    completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v
  let x : K := (p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K)
  let e : ℕ := v.residueRamificationIndex p
  have hnexp : ∀ n : ℕ, (n.factorial : K) ≠ 0 :=
    fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
  have hnlog : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 :=
    fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hvexp : ∀ n : ℕ, v (n.factorial : K) =
      WithZero.exp (-((e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p n.factorial : ℤ))) :=
    fun n => v.natCast_eq_exp_neg_ramificationIndex_mul_padicValNat p
      n.factorial (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
  have hvlog : ∀ n : ℕ, v ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) =
      WithZero.exp (-((e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ))) :=
    fun n => v.natCast_eq_exp_neg_ramificationIndex_mul_padicValNat p
      (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hcomplete : @CompleteSpace K (Valued.mk' v).toUniformSpace :=
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.completeSpace_ofWithZeroValuation v
  have hthreshold : ∀ hx : x ≠ 0,
      (e : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) <
        ((ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 x hx) : ℝ) :=
    fun hx => exp_threshold_natCast_sq_mul v p a hx
  have hxlt : v x < 1 :=
    valuation_lt_one_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_threshold_real
      (p := p) v e hthreshold
  have hexplt : v (expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnexp - 1) < 1 := by
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · rw [hx, expSeriesField_zero_ofWithZeroValuation, sub_self, v.map_zero]
      exact zero_lt_one
    · have hrat : (e : ℚ) / ((p : ℚ) - 1) <
          ((ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 x hx) : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hthreshold hx
      rw [valuation_expSeriesField_sub_one_eq_self_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_of_threshold
        (p := p) v e hx hnexp hvexp hrat hcomplete]
      exact hxlt
  let b : F.valuationSubring :=
    ⟨expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnexp - 1, hexplt.le⟩
  have hb : b ∈ F.maximalIdeal ^ 1 := by
    rw [pow_one, F.mem_maximalIdeal_iff]
    exact hexplt
  let u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1 :=
    CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.principalUnitOneAddOfMemPowSubgroup
      F (n := 1) le_rfl b hb
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  rw [principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_apply_toAdd, principalUnitLogSeriesOfWithZeroValuation]
  have harg : principalUnitSubOneOfWithZeroValuation v u =
      expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnexp - 1 := by
    simp only [principalUnitSubOneOfWithZeroValuation, u,
      CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.principalUnitOneAddOfMemPowSubgroup_val,
      CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.principalUnitOneAddOfMemPow_val,
      b]
    change (1 + (expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnexp - 1)) - 1 =
      expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnexp - 1
    exact add_sub_cancel_left 1 (expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnexp - 1)
  rw [harg]
  exact logOnePlusSeries_expSeries_sub_one_eq_self_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_of_threshold
    (p := p) v e x hnexp hvexp hnlog hvlog hthreshold hcomplete

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exp_threshold_natCast_sq_mul
statement:
theorem exp_threshold_natCast_sq_mul
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (a : v.valuationSubring) (hx : (p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K) ≠ 0) :
    (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) <
      ((ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 ((p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K)) hx) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hva : v (a : K) ≤ 1 := a.property
  have hvbound :
      v ((p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K)) ≤
        WithZero.exp (-(2 * (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ))) := by
    calc
      v ((p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K)) = v (p : K) ^ 2 * v (a : K) := by
        rw [v.map_mul, _root_.map_pow]
      _ ≤ v (p : K) ^ 2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hva zero_le
      _ = WithZero.exp (-(2 * (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ))) := by
        rw [mul_one, v.natCast_residueChar_eq_exp_neg p, pow_two, ← WithZero.exp_add]
        simp only [two_mul, neg_add]
  have hlog :=
    (WithZero.log_le_iff_le_exp ((v.ne_zero_iff).mpr hx)).mpr hvbound
  have hval :
      2 * (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) ≤
        (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 ((p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K)) hx) := by
    change 2 * (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) ≤
      -WithZero.log (v ((p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K)))
    linarith
  have hvalReal :
      2 * (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℝ) ≤
        ((ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 ((p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K)) hx) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hval
  have he : (0 : ℝ) < (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast v.residueRamificationIndex_pos p
  have hp : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le
  have hdiv : (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤
      (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℝ) := div_le_self he.le (by linarith)
  linarith

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.addSubgroup_eq_bot_of_principalUnitLog_image_of_p_divisible
statement:
theorem addSubgroup_eq_bot_of_principalUnitLog_image_of_p_divisible
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (J : AddSubgroup K)
    (hlog : (J : Set K) ⊆
      Set.range (fun u => (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd))
    (hdiv : ∀ x : K, x ∈ J → ∃ y : K, y ∈ J ∧ p • y = x) :
    J = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, _hm, hbound⟩ := exists_principalUnitLog_denominator_min_bound v p
  let d : ℤ := ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) *
    (padicValNat p (m + 1) : ℤ)
  let val : Kˣ → ℤ := (ofWithZeroValuation v).val
  have hlower (b : Kˣ) (hb : (b : K) ∈ J) : d ≤ val b := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hlog hb
    change (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = (b : K) at hu
    have hune : (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hu]
      exact b.ne_zero
    have hunit : Units.mk0 (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd hune = b :=
      Units.ext hu
    have h := hbound u hune
    rw [hunit] at h
    exact h
  rw [AddSubgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall]
  intro a ha
  by_contra hane
  obtain ⟨z, ⟨b, hb, hbz⟩, hz⟩ :=
    Int.exists_least_of_bdd
      (P := fun z => ∃ b : Kˣ, (b : K) ∈ J ∧ val b = z)
      (by
        refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
        rintro z ⟨b, hb, hbz⟩
        rw [← hbz]
        exact hlower b hb)
      ⟨val (Units.mk0 a hane), Units.mk0 a hane, ha, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hpy⟩ := hdiv (b : K) hb
  have hyne : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hyzero
    apply b.ne_zero
    rw [← hpy, hyzero, nsmul_zero]
  have hp : (p : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  have hproduct : Units.mk0 (p : K) hp * Units.mk0 y hyne = b := by
    apply Units.ext
    change (p : K) * y = (b : K)
    simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using hpy
  have hmin : val b ≤ val (Units.mk0 y hyne) := by
    rw [hbz]
    exact hz (val (Units.mk0 y hyne)) ⟨Units.mk0 y hyne, hy, rfl⟩
  have hval : val (Units.mk0 (p : K) hp) + val (Units.mk0 y hyne) = val b := by
    change (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 (p : K) hp) +
      (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 y hyne) = (ofWithZeroValuation v).val b
    rw [← (ofWithZeroValuation v).val_mul, hproduct]
  have hpval : 0 < val (Units.mk0 (p : K) hp) := by
    change 0 < -WithZero.log (v (p : K))
    exact neg_pos.mpr (v.log_natCast_residueChar_neg p)
  have hlt : val (Units.mk0 y hyne) < val b := by
    rw [← hval]
    exact lt_add_of_pos_left (val (Units.mk0 y hyne)) hpval
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hmin) hlt

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_unique_of_killing
statement:
theorem fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_unique_of_killing
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF K) [Finite F.residueField] [CharZero K]
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (φ : (higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1 →* Multiplicative K) (a : Kˣ)
    (ha : (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ a ≠ 0)
    (ψ : Kˣ →* Multiplicative K)
    (hψprincipal : ∀ u : (higherPrincipalUnitGroup F) 1,
      ψ (higherPrincipalUnitGroup.valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
          (u : F.valuationSubringˣ)) = φ u)
    (hψa : ψ a = 1) :
    ψ = fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue F
      (fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
        F hπ) φ
      (uniformizerLogValueKilling F
        (fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
          F hπ) φ a)
proof:
:= by
  let d :=
    fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
      F hπ
  let L := fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue F d φ
    (uniformizerLogValueKilling F d φ a)
  let ϖ : Kˣ := Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero
  let z := d.symm a
  let m : ℤ := Multiplicative.toAdd z.2
  have hm : m ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [m, z, d] using ha
  have hLa : L a = 1 := by
    exact fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_uniformizerLogValueKilling
      F d φ a hm
  have hψformula :
      Multiplicative.toAdd (ψ a) =
        Multiplicative.toAdd (φ z.1.2) +
          m • Multiplicative.toAdd (ψ ϖ) := by
    have hdecomp : d z = a := d.apply_symm_apply a
    rw [← hdecomp]
    rw [fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF_apply]
    rw [ψ.map_mul, ψ.map_mul, ψ.map_zpow]
    rw [toAdd_mul, toAdd_mul, toAdd_zpow]
    rw [monoidHom_toMultiplicative_residueRoot_eq_one (K := K) F ψ z.1.1]
    rw [hψprincipal z.1.2]
    simp [ϖ, m]
  have hLformula :
      Multiplicative.toAdd (L a) =
        Multiplicative.toAdd (φ z.1.2) +
          m • Multiplicative.toAdd (L ϖ) := by
    have hdecomp : d z = a := d.apply_symm_apply a
    rw [← hdecomp]
    rw [fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF_apply]
    rw [L.map_mul, L.map_mul, L.map_zpow]
    rw [toAdd_mul, toAdd_mul, toAdd_zpow]
    have hLprincipal :
        L (higherPrincipalUnitGroup.valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom F
            (z.1.2 : F.valuationSubringˣ)) = φ z.1.2 := by
      simpa [L, d] using
        fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_eq_of_completeDVF_principal
          F hπ φ (uniformizerLogValueKilling F d φ a) z.1.2
    rw [monoidHom_toMultiplicative_residueRoot_eq_one (K := K) F L z.1.1]
    rw [hLprincipal]
    simp [ϖ, m]
  have hpow :
      m • Multiplicative.toAdd (ψ ϖ) =
        m • Multiplicative.toAdd (L ϖ) := by
    rw [hψa] at hψformula
    rw [hLa] at hLformula
    simpa only [toAdd_one] using
      add_left_cancel (hψformula.symm.trans hLformula)
  have hϖ : ψ ϖ = L ϖ := by
    apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
    exact zsmul_right_injective hm hpow
  apply monoidHom_toMultiplicative_ext_of_agree_principalUnits_and_uniformizer
    F ((multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer F) hπ)
  · intro y
    exact
      higherPrincipalUnitGroup.mem_zeroSubgroup_iff_exists_valuationSubringUnitFieldUnitHom_eq
        (F := F) ((multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer F) hπ)
        ((multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_zeroSubgroup_eq_unitGroup F) hπ)
        y
  · exact (multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_isUniformizer F) hπ
  · intro u
    rw [hψprincipal u]
    simpa [L, d] using
      (fieldUnitLogHomWithUniformizerValue_eq_of_completeDVF_principal
        F hπ φ (uniformizerLogValueKilling F d φ a) u).symm
  · exact hϖ

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.continuous_fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm_ofWithZeroValuation
statement:
theorem continuous_fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_symm_ofWithZeroValuation
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    [Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring)]
    {π : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubring}
    (hπ : v.IsUniformizer (π : K)) :
    let F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u,
      0} K
proof:
:= completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v
    letI : Finite F.residueField := by
      change Finite (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring)
      infer_instance
    letI : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
    Continuous
      (fieldUnitsEquivRootsPrincipalUnitsUniformizer_of_completeDVF
        F hπ).symm := by
  let F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u,
    0} K := completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v
  let direct : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  let restricted : Valued K
      (MonoidHom.mrange v.toMonoidWithZeroHom) :=
    (_root_.LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrictValued F)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.binomial_coefficient_three
proof:
:= by
  have hp3 : 3 ≤ p := by have := hp.two_le; omega
  have hjp : j + 2 ≤ p := by omega
  by_cases h : j + 2 = p
  · rw [h, Nat.choose_self, one_mul]
    exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow p hp3
  · have hd := Nat.mul_dvd_mul (hp.dvd_choose_self (by omega : j + 2 ≠ 0)
      (by omega : j + 2 < p)) (Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : 2 ≤ j + 2))
    simpa only [pow_succ', pow_two] using hd

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.binomial_prime_relation
statement:
private theorem binomial_prime_relation {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (d : R)
    (hpow : (1 + p • d) ^ p = 1) :
    ∃ b : R, p ^ 2 • d = p ^ 3 • (d * b)
proof:
:= by
  let c (j : ℕ) : ℕ := (p.choose (j + 2) * p ^ (j + 2)) / p ^ 3
  let S : R := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p - 1), c j • d ^ (j + 1)
  have hc (j : ℕ) (hj : j ∈ Finset.range (p - 1)) :
      p.choose (j + 2) * p ^ (j + 2) = p ^ 3 * c j :=
    (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (binomial_coefficient_three p hp hp2 j
      (Finset.mem_range.mp hj))).symm
  have hterm (k : ℕ) :
      (p • d) ^ k * (1 : R) ^ (p - k) * (p.choose k : R) =
        (p.choose k * p ^ k) • d ^ k := by
    rw [one_pow, mul_one, smul_pow, nsmul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
    rw [mul_assoc, (Nat.cast_commute (p.choose k) (d ^ k)).eq.symm]
    rw [← mul_assoc, Nat.cast_comm]
  have hbin := (Commute.one_right (p • d)).add_pow p
  rw [add_comm (p • d) 1, hpow] at hbin
  simp only [hterm] at hbin
  have hcount : p + 1 = (p - 1 + 1) + 1 := by have := hp.two_le; omega
  rw [hcount, Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ'] at hbin
  simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.choose_one_right, pow_one, pow_zero,
    Nat.choose_zero_right, mul_one, one_smul] at hbin
  have hrest : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p - 1),
      (p.choose (j + 1 + 1) * p ^ (j + 1 + 1)) • d ^ (j + 1 + 1)) =
        p ^ 3 • (d * S) := by
    rw [show d * S = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p - 1), d * (c j • d ^ (j + 1)) from
      Finset.mul_sum .., nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [← nsmul_eq_mul, show j + 1 + 1 = j + 2 by omega, hc j hj, mul_smul]
    rw [mul_smul_comm, ← pow_succ', show j + 1 + 1 = j + 2 by omega]
  rw [hrest, ← pow_two p] at hbin
  refine ⟨-S, ?_⟩
  have hz : p ^ 3 • (d * S) + p ^ 2 • d = 0 := by
    exact add_right_cancel (hbin.symm.trans (zero_add (1 : R)).symm)
  rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hz, mul_neg, smul_neg]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.primeOrder_action_sub_divisible
statement:
theorem primeOrder_action_sub_divisible
    {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [IsAddTorsionFree M]
    (T : AddMonoid.End M) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2)
    (hT : T ^ p = 1)
    (hdiv : ∀ x : M, ∃ y : M, T x - x = p • y) :
    ∀ x : M, ∃ y : M, T x - x = p • (T y - y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d : AddMonoid.End M :=
    { toFun := fun x => Classical.choose (hdiv x)
      map_zero' := by
        apply nsmul_right_injective hp.ne_zero
        dsimp only
        rw [← Classical.choose_spec (hdiv 0), map_zero, sub_self, nsmul_zero]
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        apply nsmul_right_injective hp.ne_zero
        dsimp only
        rw [← Classical.choose_spec (hdiv (x + y)), nsmul_add,
          ← Classical.choose_spec (hdiv x), ← Classical.choose_spec (hdiv y), map_add]
        abel }
  have hd (x : M) : T x - x = p • d x := Classical.choose_spec (hdiv x)
  have hTd : T = 1 + p • d := by
    ext x
    change T x = x + p • d x
    rw [← hd x]
    abel
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := binomial_prime_relation p hp hp2 d (hTd ▸ hT)
  have hdb (x : M) : d x = p • d (b x) := by
    have hx := congrArg (fun f : AddMonoid.End M => f x) hb
    change p ^ 2 • d x = p ^ 3 • d (b x) at hx
    rw [show p ^ 3 = p ^ 2 * p by ring, mul_smul] at hx
    exact nsmul_right_injective (pow_ne_zero 2 hp.ne_zero) hx
  intro x
  exact ⟨b x, by rw [hd, hdb x, hd]⟩

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_int_lt_log_denominator_bound
statement:
theorem exists_int_lt_log_denominator_bound (p e : ℕ) :

proof:

      (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) -
        (e : ℝ) * Real.logb (p : ℝ) ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      (tendsto_nat_succ_mul_const_sub_const_mul_logb_atTop
        (p := p) (c := 1) (C := (e : ℝ)) zero_lt_one)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Filter.bddBelow_range_of_tendsto_atTop_atTop ht
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_int_lt c

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.exists_log_denominator_min
statement:
theorem exists_log_denominator_min (p e : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (m + 1) : ℤ) ≤
        ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℤ := fun n =>
    ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_int_lt_log_denominator_bound p e
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : b ≤ f n := by
    have hden : (e : ℝ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℝ) ≤
        (e : ℝ) * Real.logb (p : ℝ) ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (padicValNat_le_real_logb (p := p) (n + 1))
        (Nat.cast_nonneg e)
    have hreal : (b : ℝ) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) -
        (e : ℝ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℝ) :=
      (hb n).trans_le (sub_le_sub_left hden ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    change b ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ)
    exact_mod_cast hreal.le
  have hbounded : BddBelow (Set.range f) := by
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    rintro z ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact hbound n
  obtain ⟨z, ⟨m, hm⟩, hz⟩ :=
    Int.exists_least_of_bdd (P := fun z => z ∈ Set.range f)
      (by
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hbounded
        exact ⟨c, fun z hz => hc hz⟩)
      ⟨f 0, Set.mem_range_self 0⟩
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  intro n
  change f m ≤ f n
  rw [hm]
  exact hz (f n) (Set.mem_range_self n)
