statement:
theorem valuation_limit_le_of_tendsto_of_eventually_le
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    {γ : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)} {u : ℕ → K} {z : K}
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop (@nhds K (Valued.mk' v).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace z))
    (hsmall : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, v (u n) ≤ γ) : v z ≤ γ
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  by_contra hz
  have hγz : γ < v z := lt_of_not_ge hz
  have hvz : v z ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_le_of_lt zero_le hγz)
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => z - u n) atTop (𝓝 (0 : K)) := by
    have hc : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => z) atTop (𝓝 z) := tendsto_const_nhds
    simpa only [sub_self] using hc.sub hu
  have hball : {w : K | v w < v z} ∈ 𝓝 (0 : K) := by
    rw [Valued.mem_nhds_zero]
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 (v.restrict z) (v.restrict_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr hvz), ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    change v.restrict w < v.restrict z at hw
    exact v.restrict_lt_iff.mp hw
  have hdiff_small : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, v (z - u n) < v z := hdiff.eventually hball
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hdn⟩ := (hsmall.and hdiff_small).exists
  have hsub : v (z - u n) = v z := v.map_sub_eq_of_lt_left (hn.trans_lt hγz)
  rw [hsub] at hdn
  exact (lt_irrefl (v z)) hdn

statement:
theorem map_logOnePlusSeriesField_of_preserves
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (f : K ≃+* K) (hval : ∀ x : K, v (f x) = v x) (x : K) :
    f (logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x
        (fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))) =
      logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v (f x)
        (fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))
proof:
:= by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  have hf : Continuous f :=
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.continuous_ringEquiv_of_preserves v f hval
  have hsym : ∀ y : K, v (f.symm y) = v y := by
    intro y
    have h := hval (f.symm y)
    rw [f.apply_symm_apply] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hfsym : Continuous f.symm :=
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.continuous_ringEquiv_of_preserves
      v f.symm hsym
  have hn : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 :=
    fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  change f (∑' n : ℕ, signedLogSeriesTermField x hn n) =
    ∑' n : ℕ, signedLogSeriesTermField (f x) hn n
  rw [Function.LeftInverse.map_tsum (g := f)
    (fun n : ℕ => signedLogSeriesTermField x hn n) hf hfsym f.symm_apply_apply]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  simp only [signedLogSeriesTermField, logSeriesTermField, Units.val_mk0,
    _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_pow, _root_.map_neg, _root_.map_one,
    _root_.map_div₀, _root_.map_natCast]

  let F : CompleteDVF.{u, 0} K := completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v

      (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.mem_iff

    have hpow : F.maximalIdeal ^ 1 = F.maximalIdeal := by
      change F.maximalIdeal ^ (Nat.succ 0) = F.maximalIdeal

    (((u : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) - 1)).1 hu
  change v ((((u : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) - 1 :
    F.valuationSubring) : K) < (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) at hlt
  simpa [principalUnitSubOneOfWithZeroValuation, F] using hlt

      CompleteSpace K) :

proof:
:= Valued.mk' v
    HasSum
      (fun n : ℕ =>
        ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
          expSeriesTermField x hnK ij.1 *
            expSeriesTermField y hnK ij.2)
      (expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnK *
        expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v y hnK) := by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  have : NonarchimedeanRing K := nonarchimedeanRing_ofWithZeroValuation v
  have hxsum :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => expSeriesTermField x hnK n) :=
    summable_expSeriesTermField_ofWithZeroValuation_of_lt_exp_neg_one
      (v := v) (p := p) x hnK hnval hvx hcomplete
  have hysum :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => expSeriesTermField y hnK n) :=
    summable_expSeriesTermField_ofWithZeroValuation_of_lt_exp_neg_one
      (v := v) (p := p) y hnK hnval hvy hcomplete
  have hprod :
      Summable
        (fun ij : ℕ × ℕ =>
          expSeriesTermField x hnK ij.1 *
            expSeriesTermField y hnK ij.2) :=
    hxsum.mul_of_nonarchimedean hysum
  have hcauchy :
      Summable
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
            expSeriesTermField x hnK ij.1 *
              expSeriesTermField y hnK ij.2) :=
    summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul hprod
  have htsum :
      expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnK *
          expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v y hnK =
        ∑' n : ℕ,
          ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
            expSeriesTermField x hnK ij.1 *
              expSeriesTermField y hnK ij.2 := by
    simpa [expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation] using
      hxsum.tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal hysum hprod
  exact htsum.symm ▸ hcauchy.hasSum

      Summable (fun n : ℕ => expSeriesTermField x hnK n) :=
    summable_expSeriesTermField_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_of_threshold
      (v := v) (p := p) e x hnK hnval hxthreshold hcomplete
  have hysum :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => expSeriesTermField y hnK n) :=
    summable_expSeriesTermField_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_of_threshold
      (v := v) (p := p) e y hnK hnval hythreshold hcomplete
  have hprod :
      Summable
        (fun ij : ℕ × ℕ =>
          expSeriesTermField x hnK ij.1 *
            expSeriesTermField y hnK ij.2) :=
    hxsum.mul_of_nonarchimedean hysum
  have hcauchy :
      Summable
        (fun n : ℕ =>
          ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
            expSeriesTermField x hnK ij.1 *
              expSeriesTermField y hnK ij.2) :=
    summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul hprod
  have htsum :
      expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnK *
          expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v y hnK =
        ∑' n : ℕ,
          ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
            expSeriesTermField x hnK ij.1 *
              expSeriesTermField y hnK ij.2 := by
    simpa [expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation] using
      hxsum.tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal hysum hprod
  exact htsum.symm ▸ hcauchy.hasSum

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.exists_primePower_root_of_field_root
statement:
theorem exists_primePower_root_of_field_root
    (F : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [hres : CharP F.residueField p]
    (s : ℕ) (y : K) (u : higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1)
    (hy : y ^ (p ^ s) = (((u : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K)) :
    ∃ z : higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1,
      (((z : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K) = y ∧
      z ^ (p ^ s) = u
proof:
:= by
  have humem := (mem_iff F 1 (u : F.valuationSubringˣ)).mp u.property
  rw [pow_one, F.mem_maximalIdeal_iff] at humem
  have hypow : F.valuation (y ^ (p ^ s) - 1) < 1 := by
    rw [hy]
    exact humem
  have hylt := (F.valuation.map_eq_one_and_sub_one_lt_one_of_prime_pow p s y hypow).2
  let a : F.valuationSubring := ⟨y - 1, hylt.le⟩
  have ha : a ∈ F.maximalIdeal ^ 1 := by
    rw [pow_one, F.mem_maximalIdeal_iff]
    exact hylt
  let z : higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1 :=
    principalUnitOneAddOfMemPowSubgroup F (n := 1) le_rfl a ha
  have hz : (((z : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K) = y := by
    simp only [z, principalUnitOneAddOfMemPowSubgroup_val, principalUnitOneAddOfMemPow_val]
    change 1 + (y - 1) = y
    rw [← add_sub_assoc, add_sub_cancel_left]
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Units.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((((z : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K)) ^ (p ^ s) =
    (((u : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K)
  rw [hz]
  exact hy

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.equivOfPreserves_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem equivOfPreserves_apply_coe
    (e : K ≃+* K)
    (hmem : ∀ x : K, x ∈ F.valuation.valuationSubring ↔ e x ∈ F.valuation.valuationSubring)
    (n : ℕ) (a : higherPrincipalUnitGroup F n) :
    (((equivOfPreserves F e hmem n a : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K) =
      e (((a : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K)
proof:
:= by
  change (((valuationSubringUnitEquivOfPreserves F e hmem
    (a : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K) =
      e (((a : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K)
  rw [valuationSubringUnitEquivOfPreserves_apply]
  rfl

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.equivOfPreserves_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem equivOfPreserves_refl (n : ℕ) :
    equivOfPreserves F (RingEquiv.refl K) (fun _ => Iff.rfl) n =
      MulEquiv.refl (higherPrincipalUnitGroup F n)
proof:
:= by
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Units.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact equivOfPreserves_apply_coe F (RingEquiv.refl K) (fun _ => Iff.rfl) n a

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.equivOfPreserves_trans
statement:
theorem equivOfPreserves_trans
    (e f : K ≃+* K)
    (he : ∀ x : K, x ∈ F.valuation.valuationSubring ↔ e x ∈ F.valuation.valuationSubring)
    (hf : ∀ x : K, x ∈ F.valuation.valuationSubring ↔ f x ∈ F.valuation.valuationSubring)
    (n : ℕ) :
    equivOfPreserves F (e.trans f) (fun x => (he x).trans (hf (e x))) n =
      (equivOfPreserves F e he n).trans (equivOfPreserves F f hf n)
proof:
:= by
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Units.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [MulEquiv.trans_apply, equivOfPreserves_apply_coe, RingEquiv.trans_apply]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.PrincipalUnitProdiscreteLimit.coordinate_padic_smulOfResidueChar
statement:
theorem coordinate_padic_smulOfResidueChar (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ_[p])
    (x : PrincipalUnitProdiscreteLimit F) :
    coordinate F n ((padicModuleOfResidueChar F p).toSMul.smul a x) =
      (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.padicModule F p n).toSMul.smul
        a (coordinate F n x)
proof: := rfl

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.PrincipalUnitProdiscreteLimit.padicContinuousSMulOfResidueChar
proof:
:= by
  let : Module ℤ_[p] (PrincipalUnitProdiscreteLimit F) := padicModuleOfResidueChar F p
  let : (n : ℕ) → TopologicalSpace (Internal.principalUnitQuotientCarrier F n) :=
    fun n => ⊥
  let : (n : ℕ) → DiscreteTopology (Internal.principalUnitQuotientCarrier F n) :=
    fun n => ⟨rfl⟩
  have hcoordinates : Continuous (fun x : PrincipalUnitProdiscreteLimit F =>
      (Additive.toMul x.val).val) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp
      (show Continuous (fun x : PrincipalUnitProdiscreteLimit F => x.val) from
        continuous_induced_dom)
  have hc (n : ℕ) : Continuous (coordinate F n) :=
    (continuous_of_discreteTopology : Continuous
      (fun q : Internal.principalUnitQuotientCarrier F n =>
        DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.of F n (Additive.ofMul q))).comp
      ((continuous_apply n).comp hcoordinates)
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  apply continuous_induced_rng.2
  apply continuous_induced_rng.2
  apply continuous_pi
  intro n
  change Continuous (fun z : ℤ_[p] × PrincipalUnitProdiscreteLimit F =>
    Additive.toMul (coordinate F n
      ((padicModuleOfResidueChar F p).toSMul.smul z.1 z.2)).val)
  simp_rw [coordinate_padic_smulOfResidueChar]
  have hs : Continuous (fun z : ℤ_[p] × PrincipalUnitProdiscreteLimit F =>
      (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.padicModule F p n).toSMul.smul
        z.1 (coordinate F n z.2)) :=
    (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.padicContinuousSMul F p n).continuous_smul.comp
      (continuous_fst.prodMk ((hc n).comp continuous_snd))
  exact (continuous_of_discreteTopology : Continuous
    (fun q : DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n => Additive.toMul q.val)).comp hs

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.pow_prime_pow_mem
statement:
theorem pow_prime_pow_mem {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    {x : F.valuationSubringˣ} (hx : x ∈ higherPrincipalUnitGroup F r) (n : ℕ) :
    x ^ (p ^ n) ∈ higherPrincipalUnitGroup F (r + n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa only [pow_zero, pow_one, Nat.add_zero] using hx
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_mul]
    exact pow_mem_succ_of_residue_ringChar_eq F (Fact.out : p.Prime)
      (hr.trans (Nat.le_add_right r n))
      ((ringChar.eq_iff (R := F.residueField)).2 inferInstance) ih

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.Internal.principalUnitQuotientCarrier_pow_prime_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem Internal.principalUnitQuotientCarrier_pow_prime_pow_eq_one
    (n : ℕ) (x : Internal.principalUnitQuotientCarrier F n) :
    x ^ (p ^ n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases (toPrincipalUnitFiltration F).principalUnitSubquotientMk_surjective
      1 (n + 1) x with ⟨y, rfl⟩
  rw [← map_pow, (toPrincipalUnitFiltration F).principalUnitSubquotient_mk_eq_one_iff]
  change (y : F.valuationSubringˣ) ^ (p ^ n) ∈ higherPrincipalUnitGroup F (n + 1)
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm 1 n] using
    pow_prime_pow_mem F p (r := 1) (Nat.le_refl 1) y.property n

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.nsmul_prime_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.nsmul_prime_pow_eq_zero
    (n : ℕ) (x : DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n) : (p ^ n) • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.addEquiv F n).injective
  rw [map_nsmul, map_zero, DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.addEquiv_apply]
  change Additive.ofMul ((Additive.toMul x.val) ^ (p ^ n)) = Additive.ofMul 1
  rw [Internal.principalUnitQuotientCarrier_pow_prime_pow_eq_one F p]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.padic_smul_eq_val_nsmul
statement:
theorem padic_smul_eq_val_nsmul (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ_[p])
    (x : DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n) :
    (padicModule F p n).toSMul.smul a x = (PadicInt.toZModPow n a).val • x
proof:
:= by
  let : Module (ZMod (p ^ n)) (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n) := zmodModule F p n
  change PadicInt.toZModPow n a • x = (PadicInt.toZModPow n a).val • x
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul (ZMod (p ^ n)), ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.padicContinuousSMul
proof:
:= by
  let : Module ℤ_[p] (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n) := padicModule F p n
  let : TopologicalSpace (ZMod (p ^ n)) := ⊥
  let : DiscreteTopology (ZMod (p ^ n)) := ⟨rfl⟩
  have hred : Continuous fun z : ℤ_[p] × DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n =>
      PadicInt.toZModPow n z.1 :=
    (Internal.continuous_padicIntToZModPow p n).comp continuous_fst
  have hact : Continuous fun z : ZMod (p ^ n) × DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n =>
      z.1.val • z.2 := continuous_of_discreteTopology
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  exact (hact.comp (hred.prodMk continuous_snd)).congr
    (fun z => (padic_smul_eq_val_nsmul F p n z.1 z.2).symm)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient.transition_padic_smul
statement:
theorem transition_padic_smul {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (a : ℤ_[p])
    (x : DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n) :
    transition F hmn ((padicModule F p n).toSMul.smul a x) =
      (padicModule F p m).toSMul.smul a (transition F hmn x)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module ℤ_[p] (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n) := padicModule F p n
  let : Module ℤ_[p] (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F m) := padicModule F p m
  have : ContinuousSMul ℤ_[p] (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F n) := padicContinuousSMul F p n
  have : ContinuousSMul ℤ_[p] (DiscretePrincipalUnitQuotient F m) := padicContinuousSMul F p m
  exact map_padicInt_smul_of_continuous (transition F hmn) continuous_of_discreteTopology a x

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.exists_uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit
statement:
theorem exists_uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit
    (F : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (x : Kˣ) :
    ∃ n : ℤ,
      (uniformizerValueUnit F) hπ ^ n = (fieldUnitValueUnit F) x
proof:
:= by
  have hxmem :
      (fieldUnitValueUnit F) x ∈
        MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup
          (F.valuation : K →*₀ F.ValueGroup) := by
    exact
      MonoidWithZeroHom.mem_valueGroup
        (F.valuation : K →*₀ F.ValueGroup)
        (show (((fieldUnitValueUnit F) x : F.ValueGroup)) ∈
            Set.range F.valuation from
          ⟨(x : K), by simp [fieldUnitValueUnit]⟩)
  rw [hπ.zpowers_eq_valueGroup, Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff] at hxmem
  simpa [uniformizerValueUnit] using hxmem

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_inj
statement:
theorem uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_inj
    (F : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    {m n : ℤ} :
    (uniformizerValueUnit F) hπ ^ m =
        (uniformizerValueUnit F) hπ ^ n ↔
      m = n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hvalue :
        F.valuation (π : K) ^ m =
          F.valuation (π : K) ^ n := by
      simpa [uniformizerValueUnit, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val] using
        congrArg (fun γ : F.ValueGroupˣ => (γ : F.ValueGroup)) h
    exact
      (zpow_right_inj₀ hπ.val_pos (ne_of_lt hπ.val_lt_one)).1 hvalue
  · intro h
    rw [h]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_uniformizerValueExponent_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit
statement:
theorem uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_uniformizerValueExponent_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit
    (F : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (x : Kˣ) :
    (uniformizerValueUnit F) hπ ^
        (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x =
      (fieldUnitValueUnit F) x
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec
    ((exists_uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit F) hπ x)

theorem multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_val

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_isUniformizer
statement:
theorem multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_isUniformizer
    (F : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K)) :
    ((multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer F) hπ).IsUniformizer
      (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero)
proof:
:= by
  change (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ (Units.mk0 (π : K) hπ.ne_zero) = 1
  apply ((uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_inj F) hπ).1
  rw [(uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_uniformizerValueExponent_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit F)]
  ext
  simp [fieldUnitValueUnit, uniformizerValueUnit]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_zeroSubgroup_eq_unitGroup
statement:
theorem multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer_zeroSubgroup_eq_unitGroup
    (F : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K)) :
    ((multiplicativeIntegerValuationOfUniformizer F) hπ).zeroSubgroup =
      F.valuation.valuationSubring.unitGroup
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.mem_zeroSubgroup_iff,
    _root_.Valuation.mem_unitGroup_iff]
  change (uniformizerValueExponent F) hπ x = 0 ↔
    F.valuation (x : K) = 1
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hvalue :=
      (uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_uniformizerValueExponent_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit F) hπ x
    rw [hx, zpow_zero] at hvalue
    have hvalue' :=
      congrArg (fun γ : F.ValueGroupˣ => (γ : F.ValueGroup)) hvalue
    simpa [fieldUnitValueUnit] using hvalue'.symm
  · intro hx
    apply ((uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_inj F) hπ).1
    rw [(uniformizerValueUnit_zpow_uniformizerValueExponent_eq_fieldUnitValueUnit F)]
    ext
    simp [fieldUnitValueUnit, hx]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict_exists_uniformizer_pow_lt_unit
statement:
theorem mrangeRestrict_exists_uniformizer_pow_lt_unit
    (F : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    {π : F.valuationSubring} (hπ : F.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : K))
    (gamma :
      (MonoidHom.mrange F.valuation.toMonoidWithZeroHom)ˣ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ,
      (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F) (((π ^ N :
        F.valuationSubring) : K)) < gamma
proof:
:= by
  let Γ : Type v :=
    MonoidHom.mrange F.valuation.toMonoidWithZeroHom
  have hπ_ne :
      (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F) (π : K) ≠ (0 : Γ) := by
    intro hzero
    exact hπ.val_ne_zero (by
      simpa [Γ, CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict] using
        congrArg (fun z : Γ => (z : F.ValueGroup)) hzero)
  let delta : Γˣ := Units.mk0
    ((LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F) (π : K)) hπ_ne
  have hdelta_lt_one : delta < (1 : Γˣ) := by
    rw [← Units.val_lt_val]
    change (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F) (π : K) < (1 : Γ)
    rw [← Subtype.coe_lt_coe]
    simpa [Γ, CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict] using hπ.val_lt_one
  have : IsCyclic Γˣ := by
    simpa [Γ] using
      (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict_units_isCyclic F)
  have : MulArchimedean Γˣ :=
    WithZeroValuation.isCyclic_mulArchimedean Γˣ
  have hdelta_inv : (1 : Γˣ) < delta⁻¹ :=
    one_lt_inv'.2 hdelta_lt_one
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_lt_pow hdelta_inv gamma⁻¹
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  have hpow_lt : delta ^ N < gamma := by
    have hN' : gamma⁻¹ < (delta ^ N)⁻¹ := by
      simpa [inv_pow] using hN
    exact lt_of_inv_lt_inv hN'
  simpa [delta, Γ, _root_.Valuation.map_pow] using
    (show (((LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F) (π : K)) ^ N
      : Γ) < gamma from
      (Units.val_lt_val.2 hpow_lt))

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.coe_valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits_apply

        ((CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits base) a) =
      (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits target)
        (Units.map (integerMap base.toDVF target.toDVF).toMonoidHom a)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedExtension.base_uniformizer_image_val_eq_ramificationIndex
statement:
theorem base_uniformizer_image_val_eq_ramificationIndex
    (vL : MultiplicativeIntegerValuation Lˣ)
    (hunit :
      ∀ u : target.valuationSubringˣ,
        (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits target) u ∈ vL.zeroSubgroup)
    {ϖ : base.valuationSubring} {π : target.valuationSubring}
    (hϖ : base.valuation.IsUniformizer (ϖ : K))
    (hπ : target.valuation.IsUniformizer (π : L))
    (hπval : vL.val (Units.mk0 (π : L) hπ.ne_zero) = 1) :
    vL.val
        (baseUnitsMap (K := K) (L := L)
          (Units.mk0 (ϖ : K) hϖ.ne_zero)) =
      (ramificationIndex base.toDVF target.toDVF : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases
      (exists_unit_mul_target_uniformizer_pow_eq_base_uniformizer_image
        base target hϖ hπ) with
    ⟨u, hu⟩
  let ϖK : Kˣ := Units.mk0 (ϖ : K) hϖ.ne_zero
  let πL : Lˣ := Units.mk0 (π : L) hπ.ne_zero
  have hfield :
      algebraMap K L (ϖ : K) =
        ((u : target.valuationSubring) : L) *
          (π : L) ^ ramificationIndex base.toDVF target.toDVF := by
    calc
      algebraMap K L (ϖ : K) =
          ((integerMap base.toDVF target.toDVF ϖ :
              target.valuationSubring) : L) :=
        (integerMap_apply base.toDVF target.toDVF ϖ).symm
      _ = (((u : target.valuationSubring) *
            π ^ ramificationIndex base.toDVF target.toDVF :
            target.valuationSubring) : L) := by
        rw [hu]
      _ = ((u : target.valuationSubring) : L) *
          (π : L) ^ ramificationIndex base.toDVF target.toDVF := by
        exact (map_mul target.valuation.valuationSubring.subtype
          (u : target.valuationSubring) (π ^ ramificationIndex base.toDVF target.toDVF)).trans
            (congrArg (fun z : L => ((u : target.valuationSubring) : L) * z)
              (map_pow target.valuation.valuationSubring.subtype π _))
  have hbase :
      baseUnitsMap (K := K) (L := L) ϖK =
        (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits target) u *
          πL ^ ramificationIndex base.toDVF target.toDVF := by
    ext
    simpa [ϖK, πL,
      CompleteDVF.coe_valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits_apply] using hfield
  have hπLval : vL.val πL = 1 := by
    simpa [πL] using hπval
  change
    vL.val (baseUnitsMap (K := K) (L := L) ϖK) =
      (ramificationIndex base.toDVF target.toDVF : ℤ)
  rw [hbase, vL.val_mul,
    (vL.mem_zeroSubgroup_iff _).1 (hunit u), vL.val_pow, hπLval]
  ring

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict_isAdicComplete
statement:
theorem mrangeRestrict_isAdicComplete
    (F : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K) :
    IsAdicComplete
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F).valuationSubring)
      (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F).valuationSubring
proof:
:= by
  let e : F.valuationSubring ≃+*
    (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F).valuationSubring :=
    WithZeroValuation.valuationSubringEquivMrangeRestrict
      F.valuation
  let : Algebra F.valuationSubring
    (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F).valuationSubring :=
    e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let eLin :
      F.valuationSubring ≃ₗ[F.valuationSubring]
        (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F).valuationSubring :=
    { toFun := e
      invFun := e.symm
      left_inv := e.left_inv
      right_inv := e.right_inv
      map_add' := e.map_add
      map_smul' := by
        intro a x
        change e (a * x) =
          (algebraMap F.valuationSubring
            (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict
              F).valuationSubring a) * e x
        simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] }
  have hcompleteBase : IsAdicComplete F.maximalIdeal F.valuationSubring :=
    F.isAdicComplete
  let : IsAdicComplete F.maximalIdeal F.valuationSubring := hcompleteBase
  have hcompleteAsBase :
      IsAdicComplete F.maximalIdeal
        (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F).valuationSubring :=
    isAdicComplete_of_linearEquiv
      (M := F.valuationSubring)
      (N := (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F).valuationSubring)
      F.maximalIdeal eLin
  have hcompleteMap :
      IsAdicComplete
        (F.maximalIdeal.map
          (algebraMap F.valuationSubring
            (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict
            F).valuationSubring))
        (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F).valuationSubring :=
    (isAdicComplete_map_algebraMap_iff
      (I := F.maximalIdeal)
      (S := (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict
        F).valuationSubring)).2 hcompleteAsBase
  have hmap :
      F.maximalIdeal.map
          (algebraMap F.valuationSubring
            (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict
            F).valuationSubring) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict
          F).valuationSubring := by
    change
      F.maximalIdeal.map
          (e : F.valuationSubring →+*
            (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict
              F).valuationSubring) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.mrangeRestrict F).valuationSubring
    exact IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e
  simpa [hmap] using hcompleteMap

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ValuedNorm.zeroQuotientModuloResidueDegreeClass_closure_uniformizerClass_eq_top
statement:
theorem zeroQuotientModuloResidueDegreeClass_closure_uniformizerClass_eq_top
    {ϖG : G} (hϖG : vG.IsUniformizer ϖG) :
    Subgroup.closure
        (Set.singleton (QuotientGroup.mk' N.residueDegreeClassSubgroup
          (QuotientGroup.mk' vG.zeroSubgroup ϖG)) :
          Set ((G ⧸ vG.zeroSubgroup) ⧸ N.residueDegreeClassSubgroup)) =
      ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_top
  · intro q hq
    rcases N.zeroQuotientModuloResidueDegreeClass_generated_by_uniformizerClass
        hϖG q with ⟨n, hqpow⟩
    rw [hqpow]
    exact Subgroup.zpow_mem
      (Subgroup.closure
        (Set.singleton (QuotientGroup.mk' N.residueDegreeClassSubgroup
          (QuotientGroup.mk' vG.zeroSubgroup ϖG)) :
          Set ((G ⧸ vG.zeroSubgroup) ⧸ N.residueDegreeClassSubgroup)))
      (Subgroup.subset_closure (by rfl)) n

name: TopologicalSpace.exists_irreducibleComponent_image_eq_of_surjective
statement:
lemma exists_irreducibleComponent_image_eq_of_surjective
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [T0Space X] [QuasiSober X] [QuasiSober Y]
    {f : X → Y} (hfc : Continuous f) (hfclosed : IsClosedMap f)
    (hfgeneral : GeneralizingMap f) (hfsurj : Function.Surjective f)
    (W : Set Y) (hW : W ∈ irreducibleComponents Y) :
    ∃ Z : Set X, Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X ∧ f '' Z = W
proof:
:= by
  let η : genericPoints Y := genericPoints.ofComponent ⟨W, hW⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hfsurj η.1
  let Z : Set X := irreducibleComponent x
  have hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X :=
    irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents x
  obtain ⟨V, hV, himage⟩ :=
    exists_irreducibleComponent_image_eq hfc hfclosed hfgeneral Z hZ
  have hηV : η.1 ∈ V := by
    rw [← himage]
    exact ⟨x, mem_irreducibleComponent, hx⟩
  have hWV : W ⊆ V := by
    have hηW : IsGenericPoint η.1 W := by
      simpa only [η] using
        (genericPoints.isGenericPoint_ofComponent ⟨W, hW⟩)
    rw [← hηW.def]
    exact closure_minimal (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hηV)
      (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents V hV)
  have hVW : V ⊆ W := hW.2 hV.1 hWV
  exact ⟨Z, hZ, himage.trans (Set.Subset.antisymm hVW hWV)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_ι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_ι (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X)
    (W : Set Y) (hW : W ∈ irreducibleComponents Y)
    (himage : f '' Z = W) :
    X.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap f Z hZ W hW himage ≫
        Y.reducedIrreducibleComponentι W hW =
      X.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  unfold reducedIrreducibleComponentMap
  change _ ≫ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      ⟨W, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents W hW⟩).subschemeι =
    (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      ⟨Z, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ⟩).subschemeι ≫ f
  apply IdealSheafData.subschemeMap_subschemeι

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_surjective
statement:
lemma reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_surjective (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X)
    (W : Set Y) (hW : W ∈ irreducibleComponents Y)
    (himage : f '' Z = W) :
    Function.Surjective
      (X.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap f Z hZ W hW himage)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  have hyW : y.1 ∈ W := by
    change y.1 ∈ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      ⟨W, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents W hW⟩).support
    simpa only [IdealSheafData.coe_support_vanishingIdeal] using y.2
  have hyimage : y.1 ∈ f '' Z := by
    rw [himage]
    exact hyW
  obtain ⟨x, hxZ, hxy⟩ := hyimage
  let x' : X.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ := ⟨x, by
    change x ∈ (↑(IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
      ⟨Z, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ⟩).support : Set X)
    rw [IdealSheafData.coe_support_vanishingIdeal]
    exact hxZ⟩
  refine ⟨x', ?_⟩
  apply (Y.reducedIrreducibleComponentι W hW).isEmbedding.injective
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_ι,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  exact hxy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.comap_of_flat_of_isAffineHom
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.comap_of_flat_of_isAffineHom
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier)
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Flat f] [IsAffineHom f] :
    (I.comap f).IsEffectiveCartier
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨U, hfyU, a, ha, hIa⟩ := hI (f y)
  let V : Y.affineOpens := ⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage f⟩
  have hyV : y ∈ V.1 := hfyU
  let a' : Γ(Y, V.1) := (f.app U.1).hom a
  refine ⟨V, hyV, a', ?_, ?_⟩
  · let : Algebra Γ(X, U.1) Γ(Y, V.1) := (f.app U.1).hom.toAlgebra
    have hflat : (f.app U.1).hom.Flat := by
      simpa only [V, f.appLE_eq_app] using
        f.flat_appLE U.2 V.2 (show V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 from le_rfl)
    let : Module.Flat Γ(X, U.1) Γ(Y, V.1) := hflat
    have ha' := IsSMulRegular.of_flat (S := Γ(Y, V.1)) ha.left
    change IsSMulRegular Γ(Y, V.1) a' at ha'
    exact (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all a')).mpr ha'
  · rw [ideal_comap_preimage_of_isAffineHom I f U, hIa,
      Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: PrimeSpectrum.mem_idealComplement
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_idealComplement {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (J : Ideal R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :

proof:

name: PrimeSpectrum.preimage_idealComplement
statement:
theorem preimage_idealComplement {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (J : Ideal A) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f) ⁻¹ᵁ idealComplement J =
      idealComplement (J.map f)
proof:
:= by
  apply Opens.ext
  ext p
  change (¬ J ≤ Ideal.comap f p.asIdeal) ↔
    (¬ J.map f ≤ p.asIdeal)
  exact not_congr Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.symm

name: PrimeSpectrum.idealComplement_span_singleton

    idealComplement (Ideal.span {f}) = basicOpen f
proof:
:= by
  apply Opens.ext
  ext p
  change (¬ Ideal.span {f} ≤ p.asIdeal) ↔ f ∉ p.asIdeal
  simp only [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_finset_prod
statement:
lemma support_finset_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (I : ι → X.IdealSheafData) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, I i).support = s.sup (fun i => (I i).support)
proof:
:= by

  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      rw [Finset.prod_empty, one_eq_top, support_top, Finset.sup_empty]
  | insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, support_mul, Finset.sup_insert, ih]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_iff_stalkIdeal_le
statement:
theorem mem_support_fromSpecStalk_iff_stalkIdeal_le
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (p : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    X.fromSpecStalk x p ∈ I.support ↔ I.stalkIdeal x ≤ p.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    let f := X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x)
    let U := f.opensRange
    let hU : IsAffineOpen U := isAffineOpen_opensRange f
    let hx : x ∈ U := X.affineCover.covers x
    let q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) :=
      Spec.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx) p
    have hqU : hU.fromSpec q ∈ U := by
      change (hU.isoSpec.inv q).1 ∈ U
      exact (hU.isoSpec.inv q).2
    have heq : X.fromSpecStalk x p = hU.fromSpec q := by
      rw [← hU.fromSpecStalk_eq_fromSpecStalk hx]
      rfl
    have hqSupport : hU.fromSpec q ∈ I.support := by
      rwa [← heq]
    have hqZero : hU.fromSpec q ∈
        X.zeroLocus (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ : Set Γ(X, U)) :=
      (I.mem_support_iff_of_mem hqU).mp hqSupport
    have hq : q ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
        (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ : Set Γ(X, U)) := by
      exact (Set.ext_iff.mp
        (hU.fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus
          (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ : Set Γ(X, U))) q).mp hqZero
    rw [I.stalkIdeal_eq_map_ideal x ⟨U, hU⟩ hx,
      Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus] at hq
    exact hq
  · exact I.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_of_stalkIdeal_le x p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement

theorem fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.localizationAtPrimeTo_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen
statement:
theorem localizationAtPrimeTo_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [P.IsPrime]
    (f : Localization.AtPrime P)
    (hboundary :
      (I.stalkIdeal x).map
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)) =
        Ideal.span {f}) :
    Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P ⁻¹ᵁ I.supportComplement =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.localizationAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem localizationAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [P.IsPrime]
    (f : Localization.AtPrime P)
    (hboundary :
      (I.stalkIdeal x).map
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime P)) =
        Ideal.span {f}) :
    localizationAwayToSupportComplement I x P f hboundary ≫
        I.supportComplement.ι =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.Away f))) ≫
        Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P
proof:
:= by
  let V : (Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P))).Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f
  let b : V.toScheme ≅ Spec (.of (Localization.Away f)) :=
    basicOpenIsoSpecAway (R := .of (Localization.AtPrime P)) f
  let e : (Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P ⁻¹ᵁ
      I.supportComplement).toScheme ≅ V.toScheme :=
    (Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P))).isoOfEq
      (localizationAtPrimeTo_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen I x P f hboundary)
  have he : e.inv ≫ (Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P ⁻¹ᵁ
      I.supportComplement).ι = V.ι :=
    Scheme.isoOfEq_inv_ι _
      (localizationAtPrimeTo_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen I x P f hboundary)
  have hb : b.inv ≫ V.ι = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.Away f))) := by
    calc
      b.inv ≫ V.ι = b.inv ≫ (b.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.Away f)))) :=
        congrArg (fun k => b.inv ≫ k)
          (basicOpenIsoSpecAway_hom_SpecMap
            (R := .of (Localization.AtPrime P)) f).symm
      _ = _ := b.inv_hom_id_assoc _
  change ((b.inv ≫ e.inv) ≫
      (Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P ∣_ I.supportComplement)) ≫
        I.supportComplement.ι = _
  rw [Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι]
  calc
    (b.inv ≫ e.inv) ≫
        (Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P ⁻¹ᵁ I.supportComplement).ι ≫
          Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P =
      (b.inv ≫ (e.inv ≫
        (Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P ⁻¹ᵁ I.supportComplement).ι)) ≫
          Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (b.inv ≫ V.ι) ≫ Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P :=
      congrArg (fun k => (b.inv ≫ k) ≫ Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P) he
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun k => k ≫ Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x P) hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkIdeal
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkIdeal {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion f] (x : X) :
    RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap x).hom = f.ker.stalkIdeal (f x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, _⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := Y) (U := ⊤) (x := f x)
      (show f x ∈ (⊤ : Y.Opens) from trivial)
  let V : X.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ U
  have hV : IsAffineOpen V := hU.preimage f
  let A := Γ(Y, U)
  let B := Γ(X, V)
  let R := Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)
  let S := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let g : A →+* B := (f.app U).hom
  let p : Ideal A := (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨f x, hxU⟩).asIdeal
  let q : Ideal B := (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal
  have hp : p.IsPrime := (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨f x, hxU⟩).isPrime
  have hq : q.IsPrime := (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).isPrime
  let : Algebra A R := (Y.presheaf.germ U (f x) hxU).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra B S := (X.presheaf.germ V x hxU).hom.toAlgebra
  have : IsLocalization.AtPrime R p := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨f x, hxU⟩
  have : IsLocalization.AtPrime S q := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  have hpq : q.comap g = p := by
    simpa only [V, Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app, PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal,
      g, p, q] using
      congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal
        (IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE U hU V hV le_rfl hxU)
  have hmap : p.primeCompl.map g = q.primeCompl := by
    simpa only [hpq] using
      Ideal.map_primeCompl_comap_of_surjective g (f.app_surjective U hU) q
  let φ : R →+* S :=
    IsLocalization.map S g (hmap.symm ▸ p.primeCompl.le_comap_map)
  have hφ : φ = (f.stalkMap x).hom := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext p.primeCompl
    ext a
    change φ (algebraMap A R a) = f.stalkMap x (Y.presheaf.germ U (f x) hxU a)
    rw [IsLocalization.map_eq]
    exact (f.germ_stalkMap_apply U x hxU a).symm
  rw [← hφ, IsLocalization.ker_map S g hmap,
    f.ker.stalkIdeal_eq_map_ideal (f x) ⟨U, hU⟩ hxU, f.ker_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal_of_mem_support
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ Set.range I.subschemeι := by
    rw [I.range_subschemeι]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx'
  have hker : RingHom.ker (I.subschemeι.stalkMap z).hom =
      I.stalkIdeal (I.subschemeι z) := by
    rw [I.subschemeι.ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkIdeal z, I.ker_subschemeι]
  rw [← hker]
  exact IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (RingHom.ker_ne_top (I.subschemeι.stalkMap z).hom)

name: RingHom.isRegularLocalRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_essFiniteType
statement:
lemma isRegularLocalRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_essFiniteType
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) [IsLocalRing S] [IsLocalHom f]
    [IsRegularLocalRing R] (hflat : f.Flat)
    (hunramified : f.FormallyUnramified) (hfiniteType : f.EssFiniteType) :
    IsRegularLocalRing S
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f]
  let : Module.Flat R S := hflat
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S := hunramified
  let : Algebra.EssFiniteType R S := hfiniteType
  let : IsNoetherianRing S := Algebra.EssFiniteType.isNoetherianRing R S
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  have hdim : ringKrullDim R = ringKrullDim S := by
    have h := Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)
    rw [Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal] at h
    calc
      ringKrullDim R = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height :=
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim.symm
      _ = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).height := by
        have hh : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height =
            (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).height := by
          simpa only [Ideal.map_quotient_self, Ideal.height_bot, add_zero] using h.symm
        exact congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hh
      _ = ringKrullDim S := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim
  calc
    ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R S)).spanFinrank := by
      rw [Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal]
    _ ≤ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank :=
      by
        norm_cast
        exact Ideal.spanFinrank_map_le_of_fg _
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
    _ = ringKrullDim R := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
    _ = ringKrullDim S := hdim

name: RingHom.isRegularLocalRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_essFiniteType_of_target
statement:
lemma isRegularLocalRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_essFiniteType_of_target
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) [IsLocalRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing S] [IsLocalHom f]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (hflat : f.Flat)
    (hunramified : f.FormallyUnramified) (hfiniteType : f.EssFiniteType) :
    IsRegularLocalRing R
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f]
  let : Module.Flat R S := hflat
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R S :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S := hunramified
  let : Algebra.EssFiniteType R S := hfiniteType
  let mR := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  let mS := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S
  let : mS.IsMaximal := by
    dsimp [mS]
    infer_instance
  have hm : mR.map (algebraMap R S) = mS :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal
  let gR : mR.Cotangent →ₗ[R] mS.Cotangent :=
    Ideal.mapCotangent mR mS (Algebra.ofId R S) (by
      rw [← hm]
      exact Ideal.le_comap_map)
  let G : S ⊗[R] mR.Cotangent →ₗ[S] mS.Cotangent :=
    gR.liftBaseChange S
  have hG_inj : Function.Injective G := by
    let qR : mR.Cotangent →ₗ[R] R ⧸ mR ^ 2 :=
      mR.cotangentToQuotientSquare
    let qS : mS.Cotangent →ₗ[S] S ⧸ mS ^ 2 :=
      mS.cotangentToQuotientSquare
    let e₁ : S ⊗[R] (R ⧸ mR ^ 2) ≃ₐ[S]
        (S ⧸ (mR ^ 2).map (algebraMap R S)) :=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot S (mR ^ 2)).symm
    let e₂ : (S ⧸ (mR ^ 2).map (algebraMap R S)) ≃ₐ[S] (S ⧸ mS ^ 2) :=
      Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq S (by rw [Ideal.map_pow, hm])
    let e := e₁.trans e₂
    let H : S ⊗[R] mR.Cotangent →ₗ[S] S ⧸ mS ^ 2 :=
      e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor S S qR
    have hcomp : qS ∘ₗ G = H := by
      ext x
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mR.toCotangent_surjective x
      simp [qR, qS, G, gR, H, e, e₁, e₂, Algebra.smul_def]
      simpa [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply] using
        (e₂.commutes (algebraMap R S x)).symm
    suffices h : Function.Injective (qS ∘ₗ G) from .of_comp h
    rw [hcomp, LinearMap.coe_comp]
    exact e.injective.comp
      (Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := S) qR
        mR.cotangentToQuotientSquare_injective)
  have hG_surj : Function.Surjective G := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, rfl⟩ := mS.toCotangent_surjective z
    have hzmap : z ∈ mR.map (algebraMap R S) := by simpa [hm] using hz
    change z ∈ Submodule.span S ((algebraMap R S) '' (mR : Set R)) at hzmap
    let P : S → Prop := fun x ↦ ∀ hx : x ∈ mS,
      ∃ w, G w = mS.toCotangent ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hP : P z := by
      refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ ↦ P x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hzmap
      · intro x hx hxS
        obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hx
        refine ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[R] mR.toCotangent ⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
        simp [G, gR]
      · intro hzero
        refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
        have hz0 : (⟨0, hzero⟩ : mS) = 0 := Subtype.ext rfl
        rw [hz0, map_zero, map_zero]
      · intro x y hx hy ihx ihy hxy
        have hxS : x ∈ mS := by
          rw [← hm]
          exact hx
        have hyS : y ∈ mS := by
          rw [← hm]
          exact hy
        obtain ⟨wx, hwx⟩ := ihx hxS
        obtain ⟨wy, hwy⟩ := ihy hyS
        refine ⟨wx + wy, ?_⟩
        rw [map_add, hwx, hwy, ← map_add]
        congr 1
      · intro a x hx ihx hax
        have hxS : x ∈ mS := by
          rw [← hm]
          exact hx
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ihx hxS
        refine ⟨a • w, ?_⟩
        rw [map_smul, hw, ← map_smul]
        congr 1
    exact hP hz
  let e : S ⊗[R] mR.Cotangent ≃ₗ[S] mS.Cotangent :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective G ⟨hG_inj, hG_surj⟩
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  have hdim : ringKrullDim R = ringKrullDim S := by
    have h := Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown mR mS
    rw [hm] at h
    calc
      ringKrullDim R = mR.height :=
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim.symm
      _ = mS.height := by
        have hh : mR.height = mS.height := by
          simpa only [Ideal.map_quotient_self, Ideal.height_bot, add_zero] using h.symm
        exact congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hh
      _ = ringKrullDim S := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim
  rw [IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace]
  change (Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) mR.Cotangent : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ _
  have hlength : Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) mR.Cotangent =
      Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S) mS.Cotangent := by
    have hbase := IsLocalRing.length_baseChange R S mR.Cotangent
    have hfibre : Module.length S (S ⧸ mR.map (algebraMap R S)) = 1 := by
      rw [hm]
      apply Module.length_eq_one_iff.mpr
      exact (isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal).mpr
        ⟨mS, inferInstance, ⟨LinearEquiv.refl S (S ⧸ mS)⟩⟩
    rw [hfibre, mul_one] at hbase
    have hR : Module.length R mR.Cotangent =
        Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) mR.Cotangent := by
      rw [Module.length_eq_of_surjective IsLocalRing.residue_surjective,
        Module.length_eq_finrank]
    have hS : Module.length S mS.Cotangent =
        Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S) mS.Cotangent := by
      rw [Module.length_eq_of_surjective IsLocalRing.residue_surjective,
        Module.length_eq_finrank]
    rw [e.length_eq, hR, hS] at hbase
    exact_mod_cast hbase.symm
  rw [hlength, ← IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace,
    IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal, ← hdim]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsRegularAt.of_etale
statement:
lemma IsRegularAt.of_etale {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    (y : Y) (h : X.IsRegularAt (f y)) : Y.IsRegularAt y
proof:
:= by
  let : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) := h
  exact RingHom.isRegularLocalRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_essFiniteType
    (f.stalkMap y).hom (Flat.stalkMap f y) (FormallyUnramified.stalkMap f y)
      (LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap f y)

    X.IsRegularAt (f y)
proof:
:= by

  exact RingHom.isRegularLocalRing_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_essFiniteType_of_target
    (f.stalkMap y).hom (Flat.stalkMap f y) (FormallyUnramified.stalkMap f y)
      (LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap f y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport.comap_of_etale
statement:
lemma IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport.comap_of_etale
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    (hI : I.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport) :
    (I.comap f).IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  apply Scheme.IsRegularAt.of_etale f y
  apply hI (f y)
  simpa [support_comap] using hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsNormalCrossingsAt.isRegularAt
statement:
lemma IsNormalCrossingsAt.isRegularAt [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {I : X.IdealSheafData} {x : X} (hI : I.IsNormalCrossingsAt x)
    (hx : x ∈ I.support) : X.IsRegularAt x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, f, u, hf, hfu, hstrict⟩ := hI
  let : Etale f := hf
  rw [← hfu]
  apply Scheme.IsRegularAt.descend_of_etale f u
  apply (hstrict u ?_).1
  rw [support_comap]
  change f u ∈ I.support
  rw [hfu]
  exact hx

statement:
lemma IsNormalCrossings.isAmbientRegularAlongSupport [IsLocallyNoetherian X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsReduced.comap_of_etale
statement:
theorem IsReduced.comap_of_etale (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hI : I.IsReduced) (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] : (I.comap f).IsReduced
proof:
:= by
  let : AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced I.subscheme := hI.subscheme
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian I.subschemeι
  let g : pullback f I.subschemeι ⟶ I.subscheme :=
    pullback.snd f I.subschemeι
  let : Etale g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    infer_instance
  let : AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced (pullback f I.subschemeι) :=
    Etale.isReduced_of_isLocallyNoetherian g
  let : AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced (I.comap f).subscheme :=
    isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion (I.comapIso f).hom
  exact (I.comap f).isReduced_of_subscheme

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.range_reducedIrreducibleComponentι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_reducedIrreducibleComponentι :
    Set.range (X.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ) = Z
proof:
:= by
  let I := IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
    ⟨Z, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ⟩
  change Set.range I.subschemeι = Z
  calc
    Set.range I.subschemeι = I.support :=
      IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι I
    _ = Z := by
      ext x
      exact Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentι_genericPoint
statement:
theorem reducedIrreducibleComponentι_genericPoint :
    X.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ
        (genericPoint (X.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ)) =
      (genericPoints.ofComponent ⟨Z, hZ⟩).1
proof:
:= by
  let C := X.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ
  let i := X.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ
  have hgeneric : IsGenericPoint (i (genericPoint C)) Z := by
    have himage := (genericPoint_spec C).image i.continuous
    rw [Set.image_univ, show Set.range i = Z by
      simpa only [i] using range_reducedIrreducibleComponentι X Z hZ,
      (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ).closure_eq] at himage
    exact himage
  exact hgeneric.eq
    (genericPoints.isGenericPoint_ofComponent ⟨Z, hZ⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.componentGenericPoint_eq

theorem componentGenericPoint_eq (I : X.IdealSheafData)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.exists_affineChart_at_componentGenericPoint
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.exists_affineChart_at_componentGenericPoint
    {I : X.IdealSheafData} (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier)
    (Z : Set I.subscheme) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme) :
    ∃ (U : X.affineOpens)
      (_hx : I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ ∈ U.1) (f : Γ(X, U.1)),
      IsRegular f ∧ I.ideal U = Ideal.span {f}
proof:
:=
  hI (I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.coheight_componentGenericPoint_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.coheight_componentGenericPoint_eq_one
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {I : X.IdealSheafData} (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier)
    (Z : Set I.subscheme) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme) :
    Order.coheight (I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let η : I.subscheme := (genericPoints.ofComponent ⟨Z, hZ⟩).1
  let x : X := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, f, hf, hIf⟩ :=
    hI.exists_affineChart_at_componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  let A := Γ(X, U.1)
  let xU : U.1 := ⟨x, hxU⟩
  let : Nonempty U.1 := ⟨xU⟩
  let P : Ideal A := (U.2.primeIdealOf xU).asIdeal
  let j : I.glueDataObj U ⟶ I.subscheme := I.subschemeCover.f U
  let : IsOpenImmersion j := I.subschemeCover.map_prop U
  have hηZ : η ∈ Z :=
    (genericPoints.isGenericPoint_ofComponent ⟨Z, hZ⟩).mem
  have hηrange : η ∈ Set.range j := by
    change η ∈ j.opensRange
    rw [show j.opensRange = I.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 from
      I.opensRange_subschemeCover_map U]
    change I.subschemeι η ∈ U.1
    rw [← I.componentGenericPoint_eq Z hZ]
    exact hxU
  have hmeet : (Z ∩ Set.range j).Nonempty := ⟨η, hηZ, hηrange⟩
  have hW : j ⁻¹' Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (I.glueDataObj U) :=
    preimage_mem_irreducibleComponents hZ j.isOpenEmbedding hmeet
  let q : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ I.ideal U) :=
    (genericPoints.ofComponent ⟨j ⁻¹' Z, hW⟩).1
  have hqgeneric : IsGenericPoint q (j ⁻¹' Z) :=
    genericPoints.isGenericPoint_ofComponent ⟨j ⁻¹' Z, hW⟩
  have hjqgeneric : IsGenericPoint (j q) Z := by
    have himage := hqgeneric.image j.continuous
    have hclosure : closure (j '' (j ⁻¹' Z)) = Z :=
      closure_image_preimage_of_isPreirreducible j j.isOpenMap Z
        hqgeneric.isIrreducible.nonempty hZ.1.2
        (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ)
    exact hclosure ▸ himage
  have hjqη : j q = η :=
    hjqgeneric.eq
      (genericPoints.isGenericPoint_ofComponent ⟨Z, hZ⟩)
  have hqmin : q.asIdeal ∈ minimalPrimes (A ⧸ I.ideal U) := by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_singleton,
      PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes, hqgeneric.def]
    exact hW
  have hambient :
      (I.glueDataObjι U ≫ U.1.ι) q = x := by
    have hcover : (j ≫ I.subschemeι) q = x := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hjqη]
      exact (I.componentGenericPoint_eq Z hZ).symm
    exact (congrArg (fun k : I.glueDataObj U ⟶ X => k q)
      (I.subschemeCover_map_subschemeι U)).symm.trans hcover
  have hfromSpec :
      U.2.fromSpec
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U))) q) = x := by
    rw [I.glueDataObjι_ι U] at hambient
    exact hambient
  have hpoint :
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U))) q =
        U.2.primeIdealOf xU := by
    have : IsOpenImmersion U.2.fromSpec :=
      IsAffineOpen.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec U.2
    apply U.2.fromSpec.isEmbedding.injective
    rw [U.2.fromSpec_primeIdealOf]
    exact hfromSpec
  have hPq : P = q.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U)) := by
    change (U.2.primeIdealOf xU).asIdeal = _
    rw [← hpoint]
    rfl
  have hPmin : P ∈ (I.ideal U).minimalPrimes := by
    rw [Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_comap]
    exact ⟨q.asIdeal, hqmin, hPq.symm⟩
  let : IsNoetherianRing A :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  let : P.IsPrime := hPmin.isPrime
  have hPminf : P ∈ (Ideal.span {f}).minimalPrimes := by
    rw [← hIf]
    exact hPmin
  have hPheight_le : P.height ≤ 1 :=
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes
      (Ideal.span {f}) P hPminf
  have hfP : f ∈ P := by
    apply hPmin.le
    rw [hIf]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self f
  have hPheight : P.height = 1 := by
    apply le_antisymm hPheight_le
    apply Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hzero
    have hminimal : P ∈ minimalPrimes A :=
      Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero
    exact notMem_nonZeroDivisors_of_mem_mem_minimalPrimes hfP hminimal
      (isRegular_iff_mem_nonZeroDivisors.mp hf)
  let : Algebra Γ(X, U.1) (X.presheaf.stalk (xU : X)) :=
    X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk xU
  let : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk (xU : X))
      (U.2.primeIdealOf xU).asIdeal := U.2.isLocalization_stalk xU
  have hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) =
      ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    simpa only [xU, P, A] using
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height
        (U.2.primeIdealOf xU).asIdeal
        (X.presheaf.stalk (xU : X)))
  apply WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp
  calc
    ((Order.coheight x : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      (ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight x).symm
    _ = ((P.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := hdim
    _ = (((1 : ℕ∞)) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by rw [hPheight]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_isFiniteEtale
statement:
theorem reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_isFiniteEtale
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFiniteEtale f]
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X)
    (W : Set Y) (hW : W ∈ irreducibleComponents Y)
    (himage : f '' Z = W)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback f (Y.reducedIrreducibleComponentι W hW))]
    (hdom : ∀ x : (pullback f (Y.reducedIrreducibleComponentι W hW) : Scheme.{u}),
      IsDomain ((pullback f (Y.reducedIrreducibleComponentι W hW)).presheaf.stalk x)) :
    IsFiniteEtale (X.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap f Z hZ W hW himage)
proof:
:= by
  let iZ : X.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ ⟶ X :=
    X.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ
  let iW : Y.reducedIrreducibleComponent W hW ⟶ Y :=
    Y.reducedIrreducibleComponentι W hW
  let c : X.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ ⟶ Y.reducedIrreducibleComponent W hW :=
    X.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap f Z hZ W hW himage
  let P : Scheme.{u} := pullback f iW
  let p : P ⟶ X := pullback.fst f iW
  let q : P ⟶ Y.reducedIrreducibleComponent W hW := pullback.snd f iW
  let k : X.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ ⟶ P :=
    pullback.lift iZ c (reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_ι f Z hZ W hW himage).symm
  have hkp : k ≫ p = iZ := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hkq : k ≫ q = c := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  let : IsClosedImmersion (k ≫ p) := hkp.symm ▸ inferInstance
  let : IsClosedImmersion k := IsClosedImmersion.of_comp k p
  have hrange : p '' Set.range k = Z := by
    rw [← Set.range_comp]
    exact (congrArg (fun g : X.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ ⟶ X => Set.range g)
      hkp).trans (range_reducedIrreducibleComponentι X Z hZ)
  have hirred : Set.range k ∈ irreducibleComponents P := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Set.image_univ] using
        (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ
          (X.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ)).image k k.continuous.continuousOn
    · intro V hV hsub x hxV
      have hZV : Z ⊆ p '' V := by
        rw [← hrange]
        exact Set.image_mono hsub
      have hpV : p '' V ⊆ Z := hZ.2 (hV.image p p.continuous.continuousOn) hZV
      have hxZ : p x ∈ Z := hpV ⟨x, hxV, rfl⟩
      rw [← hrange] at hxZ
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hxZ
      exact p.isClosedEmbedding.injective hyx ▸ hy
  have hopen : IsOpen (Set.range k) :=
    isOpen_irreducibleComponent_of_isDomain_stalk P hdom (Set.range k) hirred
  let (x : P) : _root_.IsReduced (P.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    let : IsDomain (P.presheaf.stalk x) := hdom x
    infer_instance
  let : IsReduced P := isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk P
  let : IsOpenImmersion k := isOpenImmersion_of_isClosedImmersion_of_isOpen_range k hopen
  let : Etale c := by
    rw [← hkq]
    infer_instance
  change IsFiniteEtale c
  exact IsFiniteEtale.mk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsRegularSystemOfParameters.map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem IsRegularSystemOfParameters.map_ringEquiv
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] {d : ℕ} {t : Fin d → R}
    (h : IsRegularSystemOfParameters t) (e : R ≃+* S) :
    IsRegularSystemOfParameters (e ∘ t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular S ((List.ofFn t).map e) :=
      (e.toAddEquiv.isRegular_congr
        (List.forall₂_map_right_iff.mpr
          (List.forall₂_same.mpr fun a _ z ↦ e.map_mul a z))).mp h.1
    simpa only [List.map_ofFn] using hreg
  · calc
      Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn (e ∘ t)) =
          Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn ((e : R →+* S) ∘ t)) := rfl
      _ = Ideal.map (e : R →+* S) (Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn t)) := by
        simpa only [List.map_ofFn] using
          (Ideal.map_ofList (e : R →+* S) (List.ofFn t)).symm
      _ = Ideal.map (e : R →+* S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
        congrArg (Ideal.map (e : R →+* S)) h.2
      _ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S := IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentι_isFiniteEtale_of_smooth
statement:
theorem reducedIrreducibleComponentι_isFiniteEtale_of_smooth
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    [IsDomain Γ(S, ⊤)] [IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(S, ⊤)]
    (p : X ⟶ S) [Smooth p]
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X) :
    IsFiniteEtale (X.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ)
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_isFiniteEtale_of_smooth
statement:
theorem reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_isFiniteEtale_of_smooth
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    [IsDomain Γ(S, ⊤)] [IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(S, ⊤)]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFiniteEtale f] (p : Y ⟶ S)
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X)
    (W : Set Y) (hW : W ∈ irreducibleComponents Y)
    (himage : f '' Z = W)
    [Smooth (Y.reducedIrreducibleComponentι W hW ≫ p)] :
    IsFiniteEtale (X.reducedIrreducibleComponentMap f Z hZ W hW himage)
proof:
:= by
  let i : Y.reducedIrreducibleComponent W hW ⟶ Y :=
    Y.reducedIrreducibleComponentι W hW
  let P : Scheme.{u} := pullback f i
  let q : P ⟶ S := pullback.snd f i ≫ i ≫ p
  let : Smooth q := inferInstance
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian P := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian q
  exact reducedIrreducibleComponentMap_isFiniteEtale f Z hZ W hW himage
    (fun x => (Smooth.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk q x).1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.specializationPrime_height
statement:
theorem specializationPrime_height (hxy : x ⤳ y) :
    (specializationPrime hxy).asIdeal.height = Order.coheight x
proof:
:= by
  apply WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp
  calc
    (((specializationPrime hxy).asIdeal.height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ringKrullDim
          (X.presheaf.stalk
            (X.fromSpecStalk y (specializationPrime hxy))) :=
      (X.ringKrullDim_stalk_fromSpecStalk_eq_height y
        (specializationPrime hxy)).symm
    _ = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
      rw [fromSpecStalk_specializationPrime]
    _ = ((Order.coheight x : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.specializationPrime_asIdeal_eq_ker_residue

theorem specializationPrime_asIdeal_eq_ker_residue (hxy : x ⤳ y) :

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_le_specializationPrime_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_le_specializationPrime_of_mem_support
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (hxy : x ⤳ y) (hxI : x ∈ I.support) :
    I.stalkIdeal y ≤ (specializationPrime hxy).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hyU, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := X) (U := ⊤) (x := y) (by trivial)
  let V : X.affineOpens := ⟨U, hU⟩
  have hxU : x ∈ U := hxy.mem_open U.2 hyU
  rw [I.stalkIdeal_eq_map_ideal y V hyU,
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro a ha
  change
    X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hxy
        (X.presheaf.germ U y hyU a) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes]
  change
    X.presheaf.germ U x hxU a ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  intro haUnit
  have hxZero : x ∈ X.zeroLocus (I.ideal V : Set Γ(X, U)) :=
    (I.mem_support_iff_of_mem hxU).mp hxI
  have hnotBasic : x ∉ X.basicOpen a :=
    (X.mem_zeroLocus_iff (I.ideal V : Set Γ(X, U)) x).mp
      hxZero a ha
  exact hnotBasic ((X.mem_basicOpen a x hxU).mpr haUnit)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.componentBranchPrimeAt_height_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.componentBranchPrimeAt_height_eq_one
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier)
    (Z : Set I.subscheme) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme)
