name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.exists_componentGenericPoint_eq_fromSpecStalk
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.exists_componentGenericPoint_eq_fromSpecStalk
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier) (x : X)
    (q : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hqheight : q.asIdeal.height = 1)
    (hIq : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ q.asIdeal) :
    ∃ (Z : Set I.subscheme)
      (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme),
      I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ = X.fromSpecStalk x q
proof:
:= by
  let y : X := X.fromSpecStalk x q
  have hySupport : y ∈ I.support :=
    I.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_of_stalkIdeal_le x q hIq
  have hyRange : y ∈ Set.range I.subschemeι := by
    rw [I.range_subschemeι]
    exact hySupport
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hyRange
  let Z : Set I.subscheme := irreducibleComponent z
  have hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme :=
    irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents z
  refine ⟨Z, hZ, ?_⟩
  let eta : X := I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ
  have hetaSpecializes : eta ⤳ y := by
    have h := I.componentGenericPoint_specializes_subschemeι
      Z hZ z (show z ∈ Z from mem_irreducibleComponent)
    simpa only [eta, y, hz] using h
  have hetaCoheight : Order.coheight eta = 1 := by
    exact hI.coheight_componentGenericPoint_eq_one Z hZ
  have hyCoheight : Order.coheight y = 1 := by
    apply WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp
    calc
      ((Order.coheight y : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk y) :=
        (ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight y).symm
      _ = (q.asIdeal.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        X.ringKrullDim_stalk_fromSpecStalk_eq_height x q
      _ = ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hqheight
  have hyLeEta : y ≤ eta := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hetaSpecializes
  have hnotLt : ¬y < eta := by
    intro hyLt
    have hlt := Order.coheight_strictAnti hyLt (by simp [hetaCoheight])
    rw [hetaCoheight, hyCoheight] at hlt
    exact (lt_irrefl (1 : ℕ∞)) hlt
  have hetaLeY : eta ≤ y := by
    by_contra h
    exact hnotLt ⟨hyLeEta, h⟩
  have hySpecializesEta : y ⤳ eta :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hetaLeY
  exact (inseparable_iff_specializes_and.mpr
    ⟨hetaSpecializes, hySpecializesEta⟩).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.exists_componentBranchPrimeAt_eq
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.exists_componentBranchPrimeAt_eq
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier) (z : I.subscheme)
    (q : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι z)))
    (hqheight : q.asIdeal.height = 1)
    (hIq : I.stalkIdeal (I.subschemeι z) ≤ q.asIdeal) :
    ∃ (Z : Set I.subscheme)
      (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme)
      (hz : z ∈ Z),
      I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz = q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hgeneric⟩ :=
    hI.exists_componentGenericPoint_eq_fromSpecStalk
      (I.subschemeι z) q hqheight hIq
  have hfromSpec :
      X.fromSpecStalk (I.subschemeι z) q ⤳ I.subschemeι z := by
    have hmem : X.fromSpecStalk (I.subschemeι z) q ∈
        Set.range (X.fromSpecStalk (I.subschemeι z)) := ⟨q, rfl⟩
    rw [Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hgenericSpecializes :
      I.componentGenericPoint Z hZ ⤳ I.subschemeι z := by
    rw [hgeneric]
    exact hfromSpec
  have hz : z ∈ Z := by
    apply (genericPoints.isGenericPoint_ofComponent
      (⟨Z, hZ⟩ : irreducibleComponents I.subscheme)).specializes_iff_mem.mp
    apply I.subschemeι.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp
    rw [← I.componentGenericPoint_eq Z hZ]
    exact hgenericSpecializes
  refine ⟨Z, hZ, hz, ?_⟩
  apply (X.fromSpecStalk (I.subschemeι z)).isEmbedding.injective
  rw [I.fromSpecStalk_componentBranchPrimeAt, hgeneric]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_le_componentBranchPrimeAt
statement:
theorem stalkIdeal_le_componentBranchPrimeAt
    (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (Z : Set I.subscheme) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme)
    (z : I.subscheme) (hz : z ∈ Z) :
    I.stalkIdeal (I.subschemeι z) ≤
      (I.componentBranchPrimeAt Z hZ z hz).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  apply I.stalkIdeal_le_specializationPrime_of_mem_support
  exact I.componentGenericPoint_mem_support Z hZ

name: PrimeSpectrum.dense_basicOpen_of_isRegular
statement:
theorem dense_basicOpen_of_isRegular
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {f : R} (hf : IsRegular f) :
    Dense (basicOpen f : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)) :=
    IsLocalization.injective (Localization.Away f)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hf.mem_nonZeroDivisors)
  have hker : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)) = ⊥ :=
    (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f))).mp hinj
  have hdense : DenseRange (comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f))) := by
    apply (denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical _).2
    rw [hker]
    exact bot_le
  change Dense (Set.range (comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)))) at hdense
  rw [localization_away_comap_range (Localization.Away f) f] at hdense
  exact hdense

name: SchemeTheory.connectedSpace_open_of_dense_of_irreducible_boundary_neighborhoods
statement:
theorem connectedSpace_open_of_dense_of_irreducible_boundary_neighborhoods
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [ConnectedSpace X]
    (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hdense : Dense U)
    (hlocal : ∀ x ∉ U, ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsIrreducible V) :
    ConnectedSpace U
proof:
:= by
  apply isConnected_iff_connectedSpace.mp
  refine ⟨hdense.nonempty, ?_⟩
  intro A B hA hB hcover hUA hUB
  by_contra hdisjoint
  let S := U ∩ A
  let T := U ∩ B
  have hS : IsOpen S := hU.inter hA
  have hT : IsOpen T := hU.inter hB
  have hUT : U = S ∪ T := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases hcover hx with hxA | hxB
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hx, hxA⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, hxB⟩
    · intro hx
      exact hx.elim (fun h => h.1) (fun h => h.1)
  have hclosedCover : (univ : Set X) ⊆ closure S ∪ closure T := by
    intro x _
    have hx := hdense x
    rw [hUT, closure_union] at hx
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨x, _, hxS, hxT⟩ :=
    isPreconnected_closed_iff.mp isPreconnected_univ
      (closure S) (closure T) isClosed_closure isClosed_closure hclosedCover
      (by rcases hUA with ⟨a, ha⟩; exact ⟨a, mem_univ a, subset_closure ha⟩)
      (by rcases hUB with ⟨b, hb⟩; exact ⟨b, mem_univ b, subset_closure hb⟩)
  have no_common : ∀ z, z ∈ S → z ∈ T → False := by
    intro z hzS hzT
    exact hdisjoint ⟨z, hzS.1, hzS.2, hzT.2⟩
  by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
  · rcases hcover hxU with hxA | hxB
    · obtain ⟨z, hzS, hzT⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hxT S hS ⟨hxU, hxA⟩
      exact no_common z hzS hzT
    · obtain ⟨z, hzT, hzS⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hxS T hT ⟨hxU, hxB⟩
      exact no_common z hzS hzT
  · obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hirred⟩ := hlocal x hxU
    obtain ⟨z, _, hzS, hzT⟩ := hirred.2 S T hS hT
      (mem_closure_iff.mp hxS V hV hxV)
      (mem_closure_iff.mp hxT V hV hxV)
    exact no_common z hzS hzT

name: SchemeTheory.exists_irreducible_open_of_generizations_subset
statement:
private theorem exists_irreducible_open_of_generizations_subset
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [NoetherianSpace X] [QuasiSober X]
    (x : X) (S : Set X) (hS : IsIrreducible S)
    (hgen : ∀ y, y ⤳ x → y ∈ S) :
    ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsIrreducible V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hSZ⟩ := exists_mem_irreducibleComponents_subset_of_isIrreducible S hS
  have hunique : ∀ W ∈ irreducibleComponents X, x ∈ W → W = Z := by
    intro W hW hxW
    have hgeneric := hW.1.isGenericPoint_genericPoint
      (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents W hW)
    have hpoint : hW.1.genericPoint ∈ Z :=
      hSZ (hgen _ (hgeneric.specializes hxW))
    have hWZ : W ⊆ Z := by
      rw [← hW.1.closure_genericPoint (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents W hW)]
      exact closure_minimal (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hpoint)
        (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ)
    exact subset_antisymm hWZ (hW.2 hZ.1 hWZ)
  let V : Set X := (⋃₀ (irreducibleComponents X \ {Z}))ᶜ
  have hV : IsOpen V := by
    change IsOpen (⋃₀ (irreducibleComponents X \ {Z}))ᶜ
    rw [Set.sUnion_eq_biUnion, isOpen_compl_iff]
    exact TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents.sdiff.isClosed_biUnion
      fun W hW => isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents W hW.1
  have hxV : x ∈ V := by
    rintro ⟨W, hW, hxW⟩
    exact hW.2 (mem_singleton_iff.mpr (hunique W hW.1 hxW))
  refine ⟨V, hV, hxV, isIrreducible_iff_closure.mp ?_⟩
  have hclosure : closure V = Z :=
    closure_sUnion_irreducibleComponents_sdiff_singleton
      TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents Z hZ
  rw [hclosure]
  exact hZ.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.dense_supportComplement
statement:
theorem EffectiveCartierDivisor.dense_supportComplement
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) :
    Dense (D.1.supportComplement : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  apply dense_iff_inter_open.mpr
  intro V hV hVne
  obtain ⟨x, hxV⟩ := hVne
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, f, hf, hI⟩ := D.2 x
  have hxRange : x ∈ Set.range U.2.fromSpec := by
    rw [U.2.range_fromSpec]
    exact hxU
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hxRange
  have hpre : (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹' V).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
    change U.2.fromSpec p ∈ V
    rw [hp]
    exact hxV
  obtain ⟨q, hqV, hqf⟩ :=
    (PrimeSpectrum.dense_basicOpen_of_isRegular hf).inter_open_nonempty
      (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹' V) (hV.preimage U.2.fromSpec.continuous) hpre
  refine ⟨U.2.fromSpec q, hqV, ?_⟩
  change U.2.fromSpec q ∉ D.1.support
  intro hqD
  have hqU : U.2.fromSpec q ∈ U.1 := by
    change (U.2.isoSpec.inv q).1 ∈ U.1
    exact (U.2.isoSpec.inv q).2
  have hqZero := (D.1.mem_support_iff_of_mem (U := U) hqU).mp hqD
  have hzero : q ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (D.1.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U.1)) :=
    (Set.ext_iff.mp (U.2.fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus (D.1.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U.1))) q).mp
      hqZero
  rw [hI] at hzero
  exact hqf (hzero (Ideal.subset_span (mem_singleton f)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_isIrreducible_open_of_isDomain_stalk
statement:
theorem exists_isIrreducible_open_of_isDomain_stalk
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : X)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)] :
    ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsIrreducible V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, _⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := X) (U := ⊤) (x := x) (mem_univ x)
  let : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U, hU⟩
  let : NoetherianSpace U := noetherianSpace_of_isAffineOpen U hU
  let : QuasiSober U := U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSober
  let l : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) ⟶ U := U.fromSpecStalkOfMem x hxU
  have hS : IsIrreducible (Set.range l) := by
    simpa only [image_univ] using
      (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))).image
        l l.continuous.continuousOn
  have hgen : ∀ y : U, y ⤳ (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U) → y ∈ Set.range l := by
    intro y hy
    have hyX : (y : X) ⤳ x := hy.map U.ι.continuous
    have hyRange : (y : X) ∈ Set.range (X.fromSpecStalk x) := by
      rw [Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk]
      exact hyX
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hyRange
    refine ⟨q, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    exact (congrArg (fun f : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) ⟶ X => f q)
      (U.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι x hxU)).trans hq
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hirred⟩ :=
    SchemeTheory.exists_irreducible_open_of_generizations_subset
      (X := U) (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U) (Set.range l) hS hgen
  refine ⟨U.ι '' W, U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap W hW, ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, hxW, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  exact hirred.image U.ι U.ι.continuous.continuousOn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.connectedSpace_supportComplement_of_domain_stalks
statement:
theorem EffectiveCartierDivisor.connectedSpace_supportComplement_of_domain_stalks
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor)
    (hD : ∀ x ∈ D.1.support, IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeTheory.connectedSpace_open_of_dense_of_irreducible_boundary_neighborhoods
    (D.1.supportComplement : Set X) D.1.supportComplement.isOpen D.dense_supportComplement
  intro x hx
  have hxD : x ∈ D.1.support := not_not.mp hx
  let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) := hD x hxD
  exact exists_isIrreducible_open_of_isDomain_stalk x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_of_stalkIdeal_le
statement:
theorem mem_support_fromSpecStalk_of_stalkIdeal_le
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (p : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hp : I.stalkIdeal x ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    X.fromSpecStalk x p ∈ I.support
proof:
:= by
  let f := X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x)
  let U := f.opensRange
  let hU : IsAffineOpen U := isAffineOpen_opensRange f
  let hx : x ∈ U := X.affineCover.covers x
  let q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) :=
    Spec.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx) p
  have hq : q ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
      (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ : Set Γ(X, U)) := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus]
    intro a ha
    apply hp
    apply I.map_ideal_le_stalkIdeal x ⟨U, hU⟩ hx
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha
  have hq' : hU.fromSpec q ∈
      X.zeroLocus (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ : Set Γ(X, U)) := by
    exact (Set.ext_iff.mp
      (hU.fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus
        (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ : Set Γ(X, U))) q).mpr hq
  have hqU : hU.fromSpec q ∈ U := by
    change (hU.isoSpec.inv q).1 ∈ U
    exact (hU.isoSpec.inv q).2
  have hsupport : hU.fromSpec q ∈ I.support :=
    (I.mem_support_iff_of_mem hqU).mpr hq'
  have heq : X.fromSpecStalk x p = hU.fromSpec q := by
    rw [← hU.fromSpecStalk_eq_fromSpecStalk hx]
    rfl
  rwa [heq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_stalkIdeal_stalkFromSpecStalkEquivLocalization
statement:
theorem map_stalkIdeal_stalkFromSpecStalkEquivLocalization
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (p : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    (I.stalkIdeal (X.fromSpecStalk x p)).map
        (X.stalkFromSpecStalkEquivLocalization x p).toRingHom =
      (I.stalkIdeal x).map
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          (@Localization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) _
             (p : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)).asIdeal
             (PrimeSpectrum.isPrime (p : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)))))
proof:
:= by
  let f := X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x)
  let U := f.opensRange
  let hU : IsAffineOpen U := isAffineOpen_opensRange f
  let hx : x ∈ U := X.affineCover.covers x
  let q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) :=
    Spec.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx) p
  have hy : X.fromSpecStalk x p ∈ U := by
    rw [← hU.fromSpecStalk_eq_fromSpecStalk hx]
    change (hU.isoSpec.inv q).1 ∈ U
    exact (hU.isoSpec.inv q).2
  rw [stalkIdeal_eq_map_ideal I (X.fromSpecStalk x p) ⟨U, hU⟩ hy,
    stalkIdeal_eq_map_ideal I x ⟨U, hU⟩ hx,
    Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map]
  congr 1
  ext a
  change (Spec.stalkIso (X.presheaf.stalk x) p).hom
      ((X.fromSpecStalk x).stalkMap p
        (X.presheaf.germ U (X.fromSpecStalk x p) hy a)) = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  simp only [Scheme.fromSpecStalk_app hx, Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality_assoc,
    CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  erw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Spec.germ_stalkMapIso_hom,
    CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (X.presheaf.germ U x hx))
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv a)
  have hunit := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv_hom_id a
  simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply, CommRingCat.id_apply] at hnat hunit
  exact congrArg
    (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (@Localization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) _
        (p : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)).asIdeal
        (PrimeSpectrum.isPrime (p : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)))))
    (hnat.trans (congrArg (fun b : Γ(X, U) => X.presheaf.germ U x hx b) hunit))

lemma reducedIrreducibleComponentι_apply (X : Scheme.{u})

theorem HasSurjectiveComponentsOver.isHorizontalOver

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.HasSurjectiveComponentsOver.exists_point_on_component_over
statement:
theorem HasSurjectiveComponentsOver.exists_point_on_component_over
    {D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X} {structural : X ⟶ S}
    (hD : D.HasSurjectiveComponentsOver structural)
    (Z : Set D.1.subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents D.1.subscheme) (s : S) :
    ∃ x : D.1.subscheme,
      x ∈ Z ∧ structural (D.1.subschemeι x) = s
proof:
:= by
  let g := D.1.componentToBase structural Z hZ
  let : Surjective g := hD Z hZ
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := g.surjective s
  let x : D.1.subscheme :=
    D.1.subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ z
  refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← D.1.subscheme.range_reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ]
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
  · simpa only [g, IdealSheafData.componentToBase, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      x] using hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ringChar_residueField_integerPrimePoint
statement:
theorem ringChar_residueField_integerPrimePoint
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ringChar
        ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))).residueField
          (integerPrimePoint p hp)) = p
proof:
:= by
  let B := Spec (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))
  let q : B := integerPrimePoint p hp
  change PrimeSpectrum (ULift.{u} ℤ) at q
  let e : B.residueField q ≃+* q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    (Spec.residueFieldIso
      (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)) q).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let : Algebra (B.residueField q) q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rw [Algebra.ringChar_eq (B.residueField q) q.asIdeal.ResidueField]
  apply CharP.ringChar_of_prime_eq_zero hp
  have hp_mem : (p : ULift.{u} ℤ) ∈ q.asIdeal := by
    simp [q, integerPrimePoint]
  simpa only [map_natCast] using
    (Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mpr hp_mem)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.HasSurjectiveComponentsOverIntegers.hasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent
statement:
theorem
  HasSurjectiveComponentsOverIntegers.hasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent
    {D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X}
    (hD : D.HasSurjectiveComponentsOverIntegers)
    (hNC : D.IsNormalCrossings) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    D.HasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent p
proof:
:= by
  intro Z hZ
  let B := Spec (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))
  let s : B := Scheme.integerPrimePoint p hp
  obtain ⟨x, hxZ, hx⟩ :=
    HasSurjectiveComponentsOver.exists_point_on_component_over
      hD Z hZ s
  refine ⟨x, hxZ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · let : Algebra
        (B.residueField
          ((specULiftZIsTerminal.from X) (D.1.subschemeι x)))
        (X.residueField (D.1.subschemeι x)) :=
      ((specULiftZIsTerminal.from X).residueFieldMap
        (D.1.subschemeι x)).hom.toAlgebra
    calc
      ringChar (X.residueField (D.1.subschemeι x)) =
          ringChar (B.residueField
            ((specULiftZIsTerminal.from X) (D.1.subschemeι x))) :=
        (Algebra.ringChar_eq
          (B.residueField
            ((specULiftZIsTerminal.from X) (D.1.subschemeι x)))
          (X.residueField (D.1.subschemeι x))).symm
      _ = ringChar (B.residueField s) := by rw [hx]
      _ = p := Scheme.ringChar_residueField_integerPrimePoint p hp
  · apply hNC
    exact x.property

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.exists_regular_stalkIdeal_generator
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.exists_regular_stalkIdeal_generator
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.IdealSheafData} (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier)
    (x : X) :
    ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk x, IsRegular a ∧ I.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {a}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, f, hf, hIf⟩ := hI x
  let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let A := Γ(X, U.1)
  let a : R := X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU f
  let : Algebra A R := (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU).hom.toAlgebra
  let P : Ideal A := (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal
  let : P.IsPrime := (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).isPrime
  let : IsLocalization.AtPrime R P := U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  let : Module.Flat A R := IsLocalization.flat R P.primeCompl
  have hareg : IsSMulRegular R a := IsSMulRegular.of_flat (S := R) hf.left
  refine ⟨a, (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all a)).mpr hareg, ?_⟩
  change I.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU f}
  rw [I.stalkIdeal_eq_map_ideal x U hxU, hIf,
    Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsEffectiveCartier.isAmbientRegularAlongSupport_of_regular_subscheme
statement:
theorem IsEffectiveCartier.isAmbientRegularAlongSupport_of_regular_subscheme
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {I : X.IdealSheafData}
    (hI : I.IsEffectiveCartier)
    (hregular : ∀ z : I.subscheme,
      IsRegularLocalRing (I.subscheme.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    I.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ Set.range I.subschemeι := by
    rw [I.range_subschemeι]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx'
  let R := X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι z)
  have : IsRegularLocalRing (I.subscheme.presheaf.stalk z) := hregular z
  have : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ I.stalkIdeal (I.subschemeι z)) :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (I.subschemeStalkQuotientEquiv z).symm
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hIa⟩ := hI.exists_regular_stalkIdeal_generator (I.subschemeι z)
  have hquot : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) := by
    rw [← hIa]
    infer_instance
  have hamem : a ∈ maximalIdeal R :=
    I.stalkIdeal_le_maximalIdeal_of_mem_support (I.subschemeι z)
      (by rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← I.range_subschemeι]; exact Set.mem_range_self z) (by
        rw [hIa]
        exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a)
  exact SchemeTheory.isRegularLocalRing_of_quotient_span_singleton R a hamem ha.left

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.fromSpec_mem_support_iff_of_ideal_eq_span
statement:
theorem fromSpec_mem_support_iff_of_ideal_eq_span
    (p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U)) : hU.fromSpec p ∈ I.support ↔ d ∈ p.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hpU : hU.fromSpec p ∈ U := (hU.isoSpec.inv p).property
  rw [I.mem_support_iff_of_mem (U := ⟨U, hU⟩) hpU]
  have hzero := Set.ext_iff.mp (hU.fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus
    (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ : Set Γ(X, U))) p
  change hU.fromSpec p ∈ X.zeroLocus (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ : Set Γ(X, U)) ↔
    p ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I.ideal ⟨U, hU⟩ : Set Γ(X, U)) at hzero
  rw [hzero, hd, PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus, SetLike.coe_subset_coe,
    Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.fromSpec_preimage_supportComplement_of_ideal_eq_span
statement:
theorem fromSpec_preimage_supportComplement_of_ideal_eq_span :
    hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ I.supportComplement = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen d
proof:
:= by
  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
  ext p
  exact not_congr (fromSpec_mem_support_iff_of_ideal_eq_span I hU d hd p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.affineAway_range_subset_supportComplement
statement:
private theorem affineAway_range_subset_supportComplement :
    Set.range (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (Localization.Away d))) ≫ hU.fromSpec) ⊆
      Set.range I.supportComplement.ι
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (Localization.Away d))) p ∈
    hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ I.supportComplement
  rw [fromSpec_preimage_supportComplement_of_ideal_eq_span I hU d hd,
    ← Scheme.Hom.opensRange_localizationAway (R := Γ(X, U)) d]
  exact ⟨p, rfl⟩

statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPullback_affineAwayToSupportComplement
statement:
theorem isPullback_affineAwayToSupportComplement :
    IsPullback (affineAwayToSupportComplement I hU d hd)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (Localization.Away d))))
      I.supportComplement.ι hU.fromSpec
proof:

  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact (affineAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι I hU d hd).symm
  · rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen
statement:
theorem fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X) (d : X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (hd : I.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {d}) :
    X.fromSpecStalk x ⁻¹ᵁ I.supportComplement = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen d
proof:
:= by
  rw [fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement, hd,
    PrimeSpectrum.idealComplement_span_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem stalkAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X) (d : X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (hd : I.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {d}) :
    stalkAwayToSupportComplement I x d hd ≫ I.supportComplement.ι =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.Away d))) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkAwayToSupportComplement, Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, ← Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  change ((basicOpenIsoSpecAway (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) d).inv ≫
      ((Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).isoOfEq
        (fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen I x d hd)).inv) ≫
      (X.fromSpecStalk x ⁻¹ᵁ I.supportComplement).ι = _
  have hIso : ((Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).isoOfEq
      (fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen I x d hd)).inv ≫
        (X.fromSpecStalk x ⁻¹ᵁ I.supportComplement).ι =
      (show (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).Opens from PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen d).ι :=
    Scheme.isoOfEq_inv_ι (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen I x d hd)
  have hBasic : (basicOpenIsoSpecAway (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) d).inv ≫
      (show (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).Opens from PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen d).ι =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.Away d))) :=
    (Iso.inv_comp_eq (basicOpenIsoSpecAway (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) d)).mpr
      (basicOpenIsoSpecAway_hom_SpecMap (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) d).symm
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    ((congrArg (fun k => (basicOpenIsoSpecAway (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) d).inv ≫ k)
      hIso).trans hBasic)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPullback_stalkAwayToSupportComplement
statement:
theorem isPullback_stalkAwayToSupportComplement
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X) (d : X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (hd : I.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {d}) :
    IsPullback (stalkAwayToSupportComplement I x d hd)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.Away d))))
      I.supportComplement.ι (X.fromSpecStalk x)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact (stalkAwayToSupportComplement_comp_ι I x d hd).symm
  · rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_localizationAway (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) d]
    exact fromSpecStalk_preimage_supportComplement_eq_basicOpen I x d hd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.comap_components_denseRange_of_isHorizontalOver
statement:
theorem comap_components_denseRange_of_isHorizontalOver
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (p : X ⟶ S)
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFiniteEtale f] (hD : D.IsHorizontalOver p) :
    ∀ (Z : Set (D.1.comap f).subscheme)
      (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap f).subscheme),
      DenseRange ((D.1.comap f).componentToBase (f ≫ p) Z hZ)
proof:
:= by
  intro Z hZ
  obtain ⟨W, hW, himage⟩ :=
    D.1.exists_irreducibleComponent_image_comapSubschemeTo_eq f Z hZ
  apply Dense.mono (s₁ := Set.range (D.1.componentToBase p W hW))
  · rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    have hwW : w.1 ∈ W := by
      have hwSupport := w.2
      change w.1 ∈ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        ⟨W, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents W hW⟩).support at hwSupport
      change w.1 ∈ W at hwSupport
      exact hwSupport
    have hwImage : w.1 ∈ D.1.comapSubschemeTo f '' Z := by
      rw [himage]
      exact hwW
    obtain ⟨y, hyZ, hgy⟩ := hwImage
    let z : (D.1.comap f).subscheme.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ :=
      ⟨y, by
        change y ∈ (IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          ⟨Z, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ⟩).support
        change y ∈ Z
        exact hyZ⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    change p (f ((D.1.comap f).subschemeι y)) = p (D.1.subschemeι w.1)
    have hpoint : f ((D.1.comap f).subschemeι y) = D.1.subschemeι w.1 := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
        ← D.1.comapSubschemeTo_subschemeι]
      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
        congrArg D.1.subschemeι hgy
    rw [hpoint]
  · exact hD W hW

name: TopologicalSpace.mem_genericPoints_image_of_generalizingMap
statement:
lemma mem_genericPoints_image_of_generalizingMap
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [T0Space X] [QuasiSober Y] {f : X → Y} (hf : GeneralizingMap f)
    (x : genericPoints X) : f x.1 ∈ genericPoints Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [genericPoints]
  refine ⟨isIrreducible_singleton.closure, ?_⟩
  intro T hT hsub
  let y : Y := hT.genericPoint
  have hy : IsGenericPoint y (closure T) :=
    hT.isGenericPoint_genericPoint_closure
  have hfy : f x.1 ∈ closure {y} := by
    rw [hy.def]
    apply subset_closure
    exact hsub (subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton _))
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzy⟩ := hf (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hfy)
  have hclosure : closure {z} ⊆ closure {x.1} := by
    apply x.2.2 isIrreducible_singleton.closure
    exact closure_minimal
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hzx))
      isClosed_closure
  have hxz : x.1 ∈ closure {z} := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hzx
  have hzx' : z ∈ closure {x.1} :=
    hclosure (subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton _))
  have hz : z = x.1 := Inseparable.eq <|
    inseparable_iff_specializes_and.mpr
      ⟨hzx, specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hzx'⟩
  have hyfx : y = f x.1 := by
    rw [← hzy, hz]
  calc
    T ⊆ closure T := subset_closure
    _ = closure {y} := hy.def.symm
    _ = closure {f x.1} := by rw [hyfx]

name: TopologicalSpace.exists_irreducibleComponent_image_eq
statement:
lemma exists_irreducibleComponent_image_eq
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [T0Space X] [QuasiSober X] [QuasiSober Y]
    {f : X → Y} (hfc : Continuous f) (hfclosed : IsClosedMap f)
    (hfgeneral : GeneralizingMap f) (Z : Set X)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X) :
    ∃ W : Set Y, W ∈ irreducibleComponents Y ∧ f '' Z = W
proof:
:= by
  let η : genericPoints X := genericPoints.ofComponent ⟨Z, hZ⟩
  let W : Set Y := closure {f η.1}
  have hη : IsGenericPoint η.1 Z := genericPoints.isGenericPoint_ofComponent ⟨Z, hZ⟩
  refine ⟨W, mem_genericPoints_image_of_generalizingMap hfgeneral η, ?_⟩
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rw [← hη.def]
    simpa [W] using
      (image_closure_subset_closure_image (s := ({η.1} : Set X)) hfc)
  · apply closure_minimal
    · exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ⟨η.1, hη.mem, rfl⟩
    · exact hfclosed Z (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ)

name: CommRingCat.ker_inr_of_isPushout_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal B := (RingHom.ker f.hom).map g.hom
  let q : B →+* B ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  let lift : R ⧸ RingHom.ker f.hom →+* B ⧸ J :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift (RingHom.ker f.hom) (q.comp g.hom) (by
      intro r hr
      apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem g.hom hr)
  let e : R ⧸ RingHom.ker f.hom ≃+* A :=
    RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hf
  let a : A →+* B ⧸ J := lift.comp e.symm.toRingHom
  have hcomm : f ≫ ofHom a = g ≫ ofHom q := by
    ext r
    change lift (e.symm (f.hom r)) = q (g.hom r)
    rw [RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply]
    rfl
  let d : P ⟶ of (B ⧸ J) := h.desc (ofHom a) (ofHom q) hcomm
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    change x ∈ J
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change q x = 0
    have hd := congr($(h.inr_desc (ofHom a) (ofHom q) hcomm).hom x)
    simp only [hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, hom_ofHom] at hd
    rw [← hd]
    change d.hom (inr.hom x) = 0
    rw [show inr.hom x = 0 from hx]
    exact d.hom.map_zero
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro r hr
    change inr.hom (g.hom r) = 0
    have hw := congr($(h.w).hom r)
    simp only [hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at hw
    rw [← hw, show f.hom r = 0 from hr, map_zero]

name: RingHom.isRegularSystemOfParameters_map_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_essFiniteType
statement:
lemma isRegularSystemOfParameters_map_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_essFiniteType
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] [IsLocalHom f]
    (hflat : f.Flat) (hunramified : f.FormallyUnramified)
    (hfiniteType : f.EssFiniteType) {d : ℕ} (t : Fin d → R)
    (ht : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsRegularSystemOfParameters t) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsRegularSystemOfParameters (fun i ↦ f (t i))
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f]
  let : Module.Flat R S := hflat
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R S :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S := hunramified
  let : Algebra.EssFiniteType R S := hfiniteType
  change AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsRegularSystemOfParameters
    (fun i ↦ algebraMap R S (t i))
  have hlist : List.ofFn (fun i ↦ algebraMap R S (t i)) =
      (List.ofFn t).map (algebraMap R S) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    congr 1
  constructor
  · rw [hlist]
    exact ht.1.of_faithfullyFlat (S := S)
  · rw [hlist, ← Ideal.map_ofList, ht.2,
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.ringChar_residueField_eq
statement:
lemma Hom.ringChar_residueField_eq {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (y : Y) :
    ringChar (Y.residueField y) = ringChar (X.residueField (f y))
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (X.residueField (f y)) (Y.residueField y) :=
    (f.residueFieldMap y).hom.toAlgebra
  exact (Algebra.ringChar_eq (X.residueField (f y)) (Y.residueField y)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_map_ideal
statement:
lemma stalkIdeal_eq_map_ideal (I : X.IdealSheafData) (x : X)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (hxU : x ∈ U.1) :
    I.stalkIdeal x =
      (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun V ↦ iSup_le fun hxV ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWle⟩ :=
      exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := X) (U := U.1 ⊓ V.1)
        (x := x) ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
    let W' : X.affineOpens := ⟨W, hW⟩
    have hWU : W' ≤ U := fun z hz ↦ (hWle hz).1
    have hWV : W' ≤ V := fun z hz ↦ (hWle hz).2
    have hU := I.map_ideal hWU
    have hV := I.map_ideal hWV
    apply_fun Ideal.map (X.presheaf.germ W x hxW).hom at hU hV
    simp only [Ideal.map_map, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp] at hU hV
    simpa only [homOfLE_leOfHom, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res'] using
      (hV.trans hU.symm).le
  · exact I.map_ideal_le_stalkIdeal x U hxU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_affineOpens
statement:
lemma ideal_comap_of_affineOpens
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (V : Y.affineOpens) (hle : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) :
    (I.comap f).ideal V = (I.ideal U).map (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hle).hom
proof:
:= by
  let i := I.subschemeι
  let P := pullback f i
  let fst : P ⟶ Y := pullback.fst f i
  let snd : P ⟶ I.subscheme := pullback.snd f i
  let UX : I.subscheme.Opens := i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
  let UY : P.Opens := fst ⁻¹ᵁ V.1
  have H : IsPullback snd fst i f := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f i).flip
  have hUY : UY = snd ⁻¹ᵁ UX ⊓ fst ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      refine ⟨?_, hz⟩
      change i (snd z) ∈ U.1
      have hzU : f (fst z) ∈ U.1 := hle hz
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, H.w, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact hzU
    · exact fun hz => hz.2
  have hUYsnd : UY ≤ snd ⁻¹ᵁ UX := by
    rw [hUY]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hUX : IsAffineOpen UX := U.2.preimage i
  have : IsIso (pushoutSection H hle
      (show UX ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 from le_rfl) hUY) :=
    isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen H hle le_rfl hUY U.2 V.2 hUX
  have hpush : IsPushout (i.appLE U.1 UX le_rfl) (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hle)
      (snd.appLE UX UY hUYsnd) (fst.appLE V.1 UY le_rfl) :=
    (isIso_pushoutSection_iff H hle le_rfl hUY).mp inferInstance
  have hi : i.appLE U.1 UX le_rfl = i.app U.1 := i.appLE_eq_app
  have hfst : fst.appLE V.1 UY le_rfl = fst.app V.1 := fst.appLE_eq_app
  have hpush' : IsPushout (i.app U.1) (f.appLE U.1 V.1 hle)
      (snd.appLE UX UY hUYsnd) (fst.app V.1) := by
    rw [hi, hfst] at hpush
    exact hpush
  rw [comap, Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
  change RingHom.ker (fst.app V.1).hom = _
  rw [CommRingCat.ker_inr_of_isPushout_of_surjective hpush'
    (i.app_surjective U.1 U.2)]
  rw [I.ker_subschemeι_app U]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_preimage_of_isAffineHom
statement:
lemma ideal_comap_preimage_of_isAffineHom
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsAffineHom f]
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (I.comap f).ideal ⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage f⟩ =
      (I.ideal U).map (f.app U.1).hom
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] using
    ideal_comap_of_affineOpens I f U ⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage f⟩ le_rfl

      (I.stalkIdeal (f y)).map (f.stalkMap y).hom

  stalkIdeal_comap I f y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.comap_of_finiteEtale
statement:
lemma IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.comap_of_finiteEtale
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFiniteEtale f] (y : Y)
    (hI : I.IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt (f y)) :
    (I.comap f).IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hreg, d, r, t, hrpos, hrd, ht, hideal⟩ := hI
  refine ⟨Scheme.IsRegularAt.of_etale f y hreg, d, r,
    (fun j ↦ (f.stalkMap y).hom (t j)), hrpos, hrd, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact RingHom.isRegularSystemOfParameters_map_of_flat_of_formallyUnramified_of_essFiniteType
      (f.stalkMap y).hom (Flat.stalkMap f y) (FormallyUnramified.stalkMap f y)
        (LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap f y) t ht
  · rw [stalkIdeal_comap_of_isAffineHom I f y, hideal, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_singleton, initialParameterProduct_map]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsNormalCrossingsAt.comap_of_finiteEtale
statement:
lemma IsNormalCrossingsAt.comap_of_finiteEtale
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFiniteEtale f] (y : Y)
    (hI : I.IsNormalCrossingsAt (f y)) :
    (I.comap f).IsNormalCrossingsAt y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, g, u, hg, hgu, hstrict⟩ := hI
  let : Etale g := hg
  let P := pullback g f
  let fst : P ⟶ U := pullback.fst g f
  let snd : P ⟶ Y := pullback.snd g f
  let : IsFiniteEtale fst :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback
      (P := (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}))
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f).flip (show IsFiniteEtale f from inferInstance)
  let : Etale snd :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback
      (P := (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}))
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g f) (show Etale g from inferInstance)
  obtain ⟨v, hvfst, hvsnd⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback u y hgu
  refine ⟨P, snd, v, inferInstance, hvsnd, ?_⟩
  have hcomap : (I.comap f).comap snd = (I.comap g).comap fst := by
    rw [← I.comap_comp, ← I.comap_comp, pullback.condition]
  rw [hcomap]
  intro z hz
  apply IsStrictNormalCrossingsAt.comap_of_finiteEtale (I.comap g) fst z
  apply hstrict (fst z)
  rw [support_comap] at hz
  exact hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.comapSubschemeTo_subschemeι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma comapSubschemeTo_subschemeι (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    I.comapSubschemeTo f ≫ I.subschemeι = (I.comap f).subschemeι ≫ f
proof:
:= by

  exact (I.comap f).subschemeMap_subschemeι I f (I.le_map_comap f)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_irreducibleComponent_image_comapSubschemeTo_eq
statement:
lemma exists_irreducibleComponent_image_comapSubschemeTo_eq
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFiniteEtale f]
    (Z : Set (I.comap f).subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (I.comap f).subscheme) :
    ∃ W : Set I.subscheme,
      W ∈ irreducibleComponents I.subscheme ∧ I.comapSubschemeTo f '' Z = W
proof:
:= by
  let g := I.comapSubschemeTo f
  let : IsFiniteEtale g := inferInstance
  exact TopologicalSpace.exists_irreducibleComponent_image_eq
    g.continuous g.isClosedMap (Flat.generalizingMap g) Z hZ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_residueCharacteristicPoint_on_comapComponent
statement:
lemma exists_residueCharacteristicPoint_on_comapComponent
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFiniteEtale f]
    (q : ℕ) (hD : D.HasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent q)
    (Z : Set (D.1.comap f).subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap f).subscheme) :
    ∃ y : (D.1.comap f).subscheme,
      y ∈ Z ∧
        ringChar (Y.residueField ((D.1.comap f).subschemeι y)) = q ∧
          D.IsNormalCrossingsAt (f ((D.1.comap f).subschemeι y))
proof:
:= by
  let g := D.1.comapSubschemeTo f
  obtain ⟨W, hW, himage⟩ :=
    D.1.exists_irreducibleComponent_image_comapSubschemeTo_eq f Z hZ
  obtain ⟨x, hxW, hxchar, hxnc⟩ := hD W hW
  have hximage : x ∈ g '' Z := by
    rw [himage]
    exact hxW
  obtain ⟨y, hyZ, hgy⟩ := hximage
  change D.1.comapSubschemeTo f y = x at hgy
  have hpoint : f ((D.1.comap f).subschemeι y) = D.1.subschemeι x := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← D.1.comapSubschemeTo_subschemeι]
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hgy]
  refine ⟨y, hyZ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (f.ringChar_residueField_eq ((D.1.comap f).subschemeι y)).trans ?_
    rw [hpoint]
    exact hxchar
  · rw [hpoint]
    exact hxnc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_normalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristic_on_comapComponent
statement:
lemma exists_normalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristic_on_comapComponent
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFiniteEtale f]
    (q : ℕ) (hD : D.HasNormalCrossingPointOfResidueCharacteristicOnEachComponent q)
    (Z : Set (D.1.comap f).subscheme)
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (D.1.comap f).subscheme) :
    ∃ y : (D.1.comap f).subscheme,
      y ∈ Z ∧
        ringChar (Y.residueField ((D.1.comap f).subschemeι y)) = q ∧
          (D.1.comap f).IsNormalCrossingsAt ((D.1.comap f).subschemeι y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hyZ, hychar, hync⟩ :=
    D.exists_residueCharacteristicPoint_on_comapComponent f q hD Z hZ
  exact ⟨y, hyZ, hychar,
    IdealSheafData.IsNormalCrossingsAt.comap_of_finiteEtale D.1 f _ hync⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsReduced.subscheme
statement:
theorem IsReduced.subscheme (hI : I.IsReduced) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced I.subscheme
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ U, AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced
      (I.subschemeCover.openCover.X U) := fun U ↦ by
    change X.affineOpens at U
    have hradical : (I.ideal U).IsRadical := by
      rw [← Ideal.radical_eq_iff]
      have h := congrArg (fun J : X.IdealSheafData ↦ J.ideal U) hI
      simpa only [radical_ideal] using h
    let : _root_.IsReduced (Γ(X, U) ⧸ I.ideal U) :=
      (Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced (I.ideal U)).mp hradical
    change AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced (Spec (.of (Γ(X, U) ⧸ I.ideal U)))
    infer_instance
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced.of_openCover I.subscheme
    I.subschemeCover.openCover

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isReduced_of_subscheme
statement:
theorem isReduced_of_subscheme
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced I.subscheme] : I.IsReduced
proof:
:= by
  rw [IdealSheafData.IsReduced]
  ext U : 2
  apply Ideal.IsRadical.radical
  rw [Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced]
  let e := (I.subschemeObjIso U).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  exact isReduced_of_injective e.symm e.symm.injective

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isOpen_irreducibleComponent_of_isDomain_stalk
statement:
theorem isOpen_irreducibleComponent_of_isDomain_stalk
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hdom : ∀ x : X, IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X) : IsOpen Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro x hx
  let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) := hdom x
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hirred⟩ := exists_isIrreducible_open_of_isDomain_stalk x
  have hZV : Z ⊆ closure V :=
    (subset_closure_inter_of_isPreirreducible_of_isOpen hZ.1.2 hV
      ⟨x, hx, hxV⟩).trans (closure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
  have hVZ : closure V ⊆ Z := hZ.2 hirred.closure hZV
  exact ⟨V, subset_closure.trans hVZ, hV, hxV⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isOpenImmersion_of_isClosedImmersion_of_isOpen_range
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_of_isClosedImmersion_of_isOpen_range
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (hopen : IsOpen (Set.range f)) : IsOpenImmersion f
proof:
:= by
  let U : Y.Opens := ⟨Set.range f, hopen⟩
  have hrange : Set.range f ⊆ Set.range U.ι := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact Set.Subset.rfl
  let g : X ⟶ U := IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι f hrange
  have hcomp : g ≫ U.ι = f := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac U.ι f hrange
  let : IsClosedImmersion (g ≫ U.ι) := hcomp.symm ▸ inferInstance
  let : IsClosedImmersion g := IsClosedImmersion.of_comp g U.ι
  let : Surjective g := ⟨by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := y.2
    refine ⟨x, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    exact (congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y => k x) hcomp).trans hx⟩
  let : IsIso g := isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective g
  rw [← hcomp]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.reducedIrreducibleComponentι_isFiniteEtale
statement:
theorem reducedIrreducibleComponentι_isFiniteEtale
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hdom : ∀ x : X, IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (Z : Set X) (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X) :
    IsFiniteEtale (X.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ)
proof:
:= by
  let (x : X) : _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) := hdom x
    infer_instance
  let : IsReduced X := isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk X
  let i : X.reducedIrreducibleComponent Z hZ ⟶ X :=
    X.reducedIrreducibleComponentι Z hZ
  have hopen : IsOpen (Set.range i) := by
    rw [show Set.range i = Z from range_reducedIrreducibleComponentι X Z hZ]
    exact isOpen_irreducibleComponent_of_isDomain_stalk X hdom Z hZ
  let : IsOpenImmersion i := isOpenImmersion_of_isClosedImmersion_of_isOpen_range i hopen
  change IsFiniteEtale i
  exact IsFiniteEtale.mk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange
statement:
theorem map_genericPoint_of_denseRange
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y]
    (hf : DenseRange f) :
    f (genericPoint Y) = genericPoint X
proof:
:= by
  apply ((genericPoint_spec X).eq _).symm
  convert (genericPoint_spec Y).image f.continuous using 1
  simpa only [Set.image_univ] using hf.closure_range.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField_top
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField_top
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (hf : DenseRange f) :
    let _ : Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens)
proof:
:=
      ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X), by trivial⟩⟩
    let _ : Nonempty (⊤ : Y.Opens) :=
      ⟨⟨Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty Y), by trivial⟩⟩
    (functionFieldMap f hf).comp (X.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom =
      (Y.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom.comp f.appTop.hom := by
  intro nonemptyX nonemptyY
  let h : genericPoint X = f (genericPoint Y) :=
    (map_genericPoint_of_denseRange f hf).symm
  have hEq : eqToHom (show
      X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X) =
        X.presheaf.stalk (f (genericPoint Y)) by
      rw [map_genericPoint_of_denseRange f hf]) =
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h)).hom := by
    convert eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr X h
  unfold functionFieldMap
  rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  apply congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
  rw [hEq]
  simp only [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes]
  exact f.germ_stalkMap ⊤ (genericPoint Y) (by trivial)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.integral_pullback_algebraicClosure_of_functionField_tensor_isField
statement:
private theorem integral_pullback_algebraicClosure_of_functionField_tensor_isField
    {X : Scheme} [IsIntegral X] [CharZero X.functionField]
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))
    (h : IsField (X.functionField ⊗[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) :
    IsIntegral (pullback p
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)))))
proof:
:= by
  let F := X.functionField
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure ℚ
  let s : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ Ω))
  let j : Spec F ⟶ X := X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X)
  let : QuasiCompact j := ⟨fun U _ _ => (Set.toFinite (j ⁻¹' U)).isCompact⟩
  have hη : genericPoint X ∈ Set.range j := by
    rw [show Set.range j = {y | y ⤳ genericPoint X} from Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk]
    exact specializes_rfl
  let : IsDominant j := ⟨by
    rw [denseRange_iff_closure_range, ← Set.univ_subset_iff, ← (genericPoint_spec X).def]
    exact closure_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hη)⟩
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant j := IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isDominant j
  let : Module.Flat ℤ Ω := Module.Flat.trans ℤ ℚ Ω
  let : Flat s := by
    rw [Flat.SpecMap_iff]
    exact (RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff (R := ℤ) (S := Ω)).mpr inferInstance
  let P : Scheme := pullback p s
  let q : pullback j (pullback.fst p s) ⟶ P := pullback.snd j (pullback.fst p s)
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant q := inferInstance
  let : Field (F ⊗[ℚ] Ω) := h.toField
  let e : F ⊗[ℚ] Ω ≃ₐ[ℚ] F ⊗[ℤ] Ω :=
    IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors ℤ) ℚ F Ω
  let : IsDomain (F ⊗[ℤ] Ω) := e.toRingEquiv.symm.toMulEquiv.isDomain _
  let : IsIntegral (Spec (CommRingCat.of (F ⊗[ℤ] Ω))) := inferInstance
  have hjp : j ≫ p = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ F)) :=
    specZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _
  let : IsIntegral (pullback (j ≫ p) s) := by
    rw [hjp]
    exact IsIntegral.of_isIso (pullbackSpecIso ℤ F Ω).inv
  let : IsIntegral (pullback j (pullback.fst p s)) :=
    IsIntegral.of_isIso (pullbackRightPullbackFstIso p s j).inv
  let : IrreducibleSpace P := by
    rw [irreducibleSpace_def, Set.top_eq_univ, ← q.denseRange.closure_eq]
    simpa only [Set.image_univ] using
      ((IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ (pullback j (pullback.fst p s) : Scheme)).image
        q q.continuous.continuousOn).closure
  let : IsReduced P := IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.isReduced q
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.geometricallyIntegral_arithmeticGenericFiber_of_functionField_tensor_isField
statement:
theorem geometricallyIntegral_arithmeticGenericFiber_of_functionField_tensor_isField
    {X : Scheme} [IsIntegral X] [CharZero X.functionField]
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)) [Smooth p]
    (h : IsField (X.functionField ⊗[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) :
    GeometricallyIntegral
      (p.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))))
proof:
:= by
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure ℚ
  let S := Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)
  let κ := S.residueField (genericPoint S)
  let s : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ S :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℤ Ω))
  let P := pullback p s
  let g : P ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) := pullback.snd p s
  let : IsIntegral P := integral_pullback_algebraicClosure_of_functionField_tensor_isField p h
  let : GeometricallyIrreducible g :=
    GeometricallyIrreducible.of_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed g
  let : GeometricallyConnected g := by
    constructor
    intro K _ y Y fst snd hpb
    let : IrreducibleSpace Y :=
      GeometricallyIrreducible.geometrically_irreducibleSpace (f := g) y fst snd hpb
    infer_instance
  let : GeometricallyIntegral g := Smooth.geometricallyIntegral_of_geometricallyConnected g
  let : Algebra κ Ω :=
    ((algebraMap ℚ Ω).comp specZGenericResidueFieldEquivQ.toRingHom).toAlgebra
  let t : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec κ :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap κ Ω))
  let r : Spec κ ⟶ S := S.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)
  have htr : t ≫ r = s := specZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _
  let l : P ⟶ pullback p r :=
    pullback.lift (pullback.fst p s) (g ≫ t) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, htr]
      exact pullback.condition)
  have hpb : IsPullback l g (pullback.snd p r) t := by
    refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := pullback.fst p r) ?_
      (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _) (IsPullback.of_hasPullback p r)
    simpa only [l, pullback.lift_fst, htr] using
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback p s)
  exact GeometricallyIntegral.of_isPullback_of_geometricallyIntegral (κ := κ) (k := Ω)
    (p.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)) g l hpb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr'
statement:
private theorem eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr'
    {x x' : X} (h : x = x') :
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun z => X.presheaf.stalk z) h) =
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h)).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst x'
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom,
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : DenseRange f) (U : X.Opens)
    [Nonempty U] [Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)] :
    (f.functionFieldMap hf).comp (X.germToFunctionField U).hom =
      (Y.germToFunctionField (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom.comp (f.app U).hom
proof:
:= by
  let h : genericPoint X = f (genericPoint Y) := (f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hf).symm
  have hEq : eqToHom (show X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X) =
      X.presheaf.stalk (f (genericPoint Y)) by
        rw [f.map_genericPoint_of_denseRange hf]) =
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h)).hom :=
    eqToHom_stalk_eq_stalkCongr' h
  unfold functionFieldMap
  rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  apply congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
  rw [hEq]
  simp only [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes]
  exact f.germ_stalkMap U (genericPoint Y)
    (((genericPoint_spec Y).mem_open_set_iff (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).isOpen).mpr
      (by
        obtain ⟨y⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ U))
        exact ⟨y.val, Set.mem_univ y.val, y.property⟩))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_algebraMap_stalk
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_algebraMap_stalk
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : DenseRange f) (y : Y) (a : X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) :
    f.functionFieldMap hf (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) X.functionField a) =
      algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) Y.functionField (f.stalkMap y a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hy, aU, haU⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq a
  have : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨f y, hy⟩⟩
  have : Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := ⟨⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  rw [← haU, X.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField hy aU]
  have hgeneric := congrArg
    (fun q : Γ(X, U) →+* Y.functionField => q aU)
    (f.functionFieldMap_comp_germToFunctionField hf U)
  have hstalk := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.germ_stalkMap U y hy) aU
  change f.stalkMap y (X.presheaf.germ U (f y) hy aU) =
    Y.presheaf.germ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) y hy (f.app U aU) at hstalk
  rw [hstalk, Y.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField hy (f.app U aU)]
  exact hgeneric

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_mem_stalk_range_iff_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_mem_stalk_range_iff_of_isOpenImmersion
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] (hf : DenseRange f) (y : Y)
    (a : X.functionField) :
    f.functionFieldMap hf a ∈ (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) Y.functionField).range ↔
      a ∈ (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) X.functionField).range
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (f.stalkMap y)).2 b
    refine ⟨c, (f.functionFieldMap hf).injective ?_⟩
    rw [f.functionFieldMap_algebraMap_stalk hf y c, hc]
    exact hb
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine ⟨f.stalkMap y b, ?_⟩
    rw [← f.functionFieldMap_algebraMap_stalk hf y b, hb]

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.isDomain_of_isFractionRing_left
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_isFractionRing_left
    {k R K L : Type u}
    [Field k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra k R]
    [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower k R K]
    [IsFractionRing R K] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    [IsDomain (TensorProduct k R L)] :
    IsDomain (TensorProduct k K L)
proof:
:= by
  let map : TensorProduct k R L →ₐ[k] TensorProduct k K L :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R K) (AlgHom.id k L)
  let sourceTargetAlgebra :
      Algebra (TensorProduct k R L) (TensorProduct k K L) :=
    map.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let targetAlgebraR : Algebra R (TensorProduct k K L) := inferInstance
  let : Algebra (TensorProduct k R L) (TensorProduct k K L) :=
    sourceTargetAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R (TensorProduct k R L) (TensorProduct k K L) :=
    @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq R (TensorProduct k R L)
      (TensorProduct k K L) _ _ _
      (inferInstance : Algebra R (TensorProduct k R L))
      sourceTargetAlgebra targetAlgebraR fun x => by
        change (@algebraMap R (TensorProduct k K L) _ _ targetAlgebraR) x =
          map (x ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : L))
        simp [map, targetAlgebraR]
  have hMap :
      (algebraMap (TensorProduct k R L) (TensorProduct k K L)).comp
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom := by
    ext x
    change map ((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[k] x) = (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[k] x
    simp [map]
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (TensorProduct k R L) (nonZeroDivisors R))
      (TensorProduct k K L) :=
    IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct k L (nonZeroDivisors R) K hMap
  have hSub :
      Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (TensorProduct k R L) (nonZeroDivisors R) ≤
        nonZeroDivisors (TensorProduct k R L) := by
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ (nonZeroDivisors R).map
      (algebraMap R (TensorProduct k R L)) at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero]
    intro hx
    apply nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hr
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R (TensorProduct k R L)
    simpa using hx
  exact IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors
    (R := TensorProduct k R L)
    (M := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid
      (TensorProduct k R L) (nonZeroDivisors R))
    (TensorProduct k K L) hSub

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral.comp_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem GeometricallyIntegral.comp_of_isOpenImmersion
    {U X S : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S)
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [GeometricallyIntegral f] [Surjective (i ≫ f)] :
    GeometricallyIntegral (i ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  let : GeometricallyReduced (i ≫ f) :=
    GeometricallyReduced.comp_of_isOpenImmersion i f
  exact GeometricallyIntegral.of_geometricallyReduced_of_geometricallyIrreducible _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral.spec_of_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem GeometricallyIntegral.spec_of_isFractionRing
    {k R K : Type u}
    [Field k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra k R]
    [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra R K] [IsScalarTower k R K]
    [IsFractionRing R K]
    [GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R)))] :
    GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [GeometricallyIntegral.eq_geometrically, geometrically_iff_of_commRing]
  intro L _ _ Y fst snd h
  have hDomainR : IsDomain (TensorProduct k R L) := by
    let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R))
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))
    let : IsIntegral (pullback f g) :=
      GeometricallyIntegral.geometrically_isIntegral _ _ _ (.of_hasPullback _ _)
    let : IsIntegral (Spec (.of (TensorProduct k R L))) :=
      IsIntegral.of_isIso (pullbackSpecIso k R L).hom
    exact (affine_isIntegral_iff (.of (TensorProduct k R L))).mp inferInstance
  let : IsDomain (TensorProduct k R L) := hDomainR
  have hDomainK : IsDomain (TensorProduct k K L) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.isDomain_of_isFractionRing_left
      (k := k) (R := R) (K := K) (L := L)
  have hIntegralK : IsIntegral (Spec (.of (TensorProduct k K L))) :=
    (affine_isIntegral_iff (.of (TensorProduct k K L))).mpr hDomainK
  let : IsIntegral (Spec (.of (TensorProduct k K L))) := hIntegralK
  let : IsIntegral
      (pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))) :=
    IsIntegral.of_isIso (pullbackSpecIso k K L).inv
  exact IsIntegral.of_isIso h.isoPullback.inv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.hom_eq_isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap
statement:
private lemma hom_eq_isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Z]
    (p : Z ⟶ Spec (.of R)) :
    p = Z.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ p.appTop)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : Z.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map p.appTop =
      p ≫ (Spec (.of R)).isoSpec.hom :=
    Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality p
  have hcancel : (Spec (.of R)).isoSpec.hom ≫
      Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_hom, ← Spec.map_comp,
      Iso.inv_hom_id, Spec.map_id]
  calc
    p = p ≫ 𝟙 _ := (Category.comp_id _).symm
    _ = p ≫ ((Spec (.of R)).isoSpec.hom ≫
        Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv) :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ p ≫ q) hcancel.symm
    _ = (p ≫ (Spec (.of R)).isoSpec.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (Z.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map p.appTop) ≫
        Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv)
        hnat.symm
    _ = Z.isoSpec.hom ≫
        (Spec.map p.appTop ≫
          Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv) :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = Z.isoSpec.hom ≫
        Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ p.appTop) := by
      rw [Spec.map_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comp_open_eq_isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap_algebraMap
statement:
private lemma comp_open_eq_isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap_algebraMap
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    U.ι ≫ f = hU.isoSpec.hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (@algebraMap k Γ(X, U) _ _ (sectionAlgebra f U)))
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra k Γ(X, U) := sectionAlgebra f U
  let : IsAffine U := hU
  change U.ι ≫ f = hU.isoSpec.hom ≫
    Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
      (U.ι ≫ f).appTop ≫ U.topIso.hom)
  calc
    U.ι ≫ f = U.toScheme.isoSpec.hom ≫
        Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
          (U.ι ≫ f).appTop) :=
      hom_eq_isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap (U.ι ≫ f)
    _ = hU.isoSpec.hom ≫
        Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
          (U.ι ≫ f).appTop ≫ U.topIso.hom) := by
      change U.toScheme.isoSpec.hom ≫
          Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (U.ι ≫ f).appTop) =
        (U.toScheme.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map U.topIso.inv) ≫
          Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
            (U.ι ≫ f).appTop ≫ U.topIso.hom)
      rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, cancel_epi, Spec.map_inj]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comp_open_appTop_topIso
statement:
private lemma comp_open_appTop_topIso
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (U : X.Opens) :
    (U.ι ≫ f).appTop ≫ U.topIso.hom =
      f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (x := U.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) le_top).op ≫
      X.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top.symm).op = _
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.functionFieldAlgebra_eq_comp_sectionAlgebra
statement:
private lemma functionFieldAlgebra_eq_comp_sectionAlgebra
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace X]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] :
    @algebraMap k X.functionField _ _ f.functionFieldAlgebra =
      (@algebraMap Γ(X, U) X.functionField _ _
        (inferInstance : Algebra Γ(X, U) X.functionField)).comp
        (@algebraMap k Γ(X, U) _ _ (sectionAlgebra f U))
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra k Γ(X, U) := sectionAlgebra f U
  let : Algebra k X.functionField := f.functionFieldAlgebra
  ext a
  change X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) trivial
      (f.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv a)) =
    X.germToFunctionField U
      (U.topIso.hom ((U.ι ≫ f).appTop
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv a)))
  have hsection :
      U.topIso.hom ((U.ι ≫ f).appTop
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv a)) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
        (f.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv a)) := by
    simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (comp_open_appTop_topIso f U)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv a)
  rw [hsection]
  exact (X.presheaf.germ_res_apply
    (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top))
    (genericPoint X)
    (((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr
      (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty U)))
    (f.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv a))).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral.spec_functionField
statement:
theorem GeometricallyIntegral.spec_functionField
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [GeometricallyIntegral f] :
    GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (@algebraMap k X.functionField _ _ f.functionFieldAlgebra)))
proof:
:= by
  let x : X := Nonempty.some inferInstance
  let U : X.Opens := (X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x)).opensRange
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U :=
    isAffineOpen_opensRange (X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x))
  let : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, X.affineCover.covers x⟩⟩
  let : Algebra k Γ(X, U) := sectionAlgebra f U
  let : Algebra k X.functionField := f.functionFieldAlgebra
  let : Surjective (U.ι ≫ f) :=
    ⟨fun y ↦ ⟨Nonempty.some inferInstance, Subsingleton.elim _ y⟩⟩
  have hOpen : GeometricallyIntegral (U.ι ≫ f) :=
    GeometricallyIntegral.comp_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι f
  have hSpec : GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X, U)))) := by
    have hComp : GeometricallyIntegral
        (hU.isoSpec.hom ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X, U)))) := by
      rw [← comp_open_eq_isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap_algebraMap f U hU]
      exact hOpen
    let : MorphismProperty.RespectsIso
        (@GeometricallyIntegral : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) := by
      rw [GeometricallyIntegral.eq_geometrically, geometrically_eq_universally]
      exact MorphismProperty.universally_respectsIso _
    exact (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso
      (P := (@GeometricallyIntegral : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})) hU.isoSpec.hom _).mp hComp
  let : GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X, U)))) := hSpec
  let : IsFractionRing Γ(X, U) X.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X U hU
  let : IsScalarTower k Γ(X, U) X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      (functionFieldAlgebra_eq_comp_sectionAlgebra f U)
  exact GeometricallyIntegral.spec_of_isFractionRing
    (k := k) (R := Γ(X, U)) (K := X.functionField)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Geometry.Curves.Proofs.GeometricallyIntegral_of_isPullback_of_geometricallyIntegral.AlgebraicGeometry.flat_specMap_of_fields
statement:
private theorem flat_specMap_of_fields {K Ω : Type u} [Field K] [Field Ω] (φ : K →+* Ω) :
