name: AlgebraicCurves.Geometry.Curves.Proofs.GeometricallyIntegral_of_isPullback_of_geometricallyIntegral.AlgebraicGeometry.isReduced_of_flat_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  have hst : ∀ y : Y, _root_.IsReduced (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := π.surjective y
    let ψ := (π.stalkMap x).hom
    let := ψ.toAlgebra
    have : Module.Flat (Y.presheaf.stalk (π.base x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := Flat.stalkMap π x
    have : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (π.base x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom ψ)
    have : Module.FaithfullyFlat (Y.presheaf.stalk (π.base x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
    exact isReduced_of_injective (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (π.base x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _)
  exact isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk Y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral.of_isPullback_of_geometricallyIntegral
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral.of_isPullback_of_geometricallyIntegral
    {κ k : Type u} [Field κ] [Field k] [Algebra κ k]
    {C C' : Scheme.{u}} (c : C ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ))
    (c' : C' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : C' ⟶ C)
    (h : IsPullback g c' c (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap κ k))))
    [GeometricallyIntegral c'] :
    GeometricallyIntegral c
proof:
:= by
  have hc' : geometrically IsIntegral c' := by
    have := ‹GeometricallyIntegral c'›; rwa [GeometricallyIntegral.eq_geometrically] at this
  rw [GeometricallyIntegral.eq_geometrically,
    geometrically_iff_of_commRing_of_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
  intro K' _ _
  have : Nontrivial (K' ⊗[κ] k) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_flat_left
      (R := κ) K' k (algebraMap κ k).injective
  obtain ⟨𝔪, h𝔪⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal (K' ⊗[κ] k)
  let Ω : Type u := (K' ⊗[κ] k) ⧸ 𝔪
  let : Field Ω := Ideal.Quotient.field 𝔪
  let φK : K' →+* Ω := algebraMap K' Ω
  let φk : k →+* Ω := (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔪).comp
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := κ) (A := K') (B := k)).toRingHom
  have hφK : φK.comp (algebraMap κ K') = algebraMap κ Ω := (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq κ K' Ω).symm
  have hφk : φk.comp (algebraMap κ k) = algebraMap κ Ω := by
    ext a
    simp only [φk, RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
      AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, AlgHom.commutes]
    rfl
  let sK : Spec (CommRingCat.of K') ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap κ K'))
  let sk : Spec (CommRingCat.of k) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of κ) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap κ k))
  let sΩK : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K') := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φK)
  let sΩk : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φk)
  have hcomm : sΩk ≫ sk = sΩK ≫ sK := by
    simp only [sΩk, sk, sΩK, sK, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, hφK, hφk]
  have hint : IsIntegral (pullback c' sΩk) := pullback_of_geometrically hc' Ω sΩk
  let π : pullback c' sΩk ⟶ pullback c sK :=
    pullback.lift (pullback.fst c' sΩk ≫ g) (pullback.snd c' sΩk ≫ sΩK) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, h.w, ← Category.assoc, pullback.condition,
        Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hcomm])
  have hbig : IsPullback (pullback.fst c' sΩk ≫ g) (pullback.snd c' sΩk) c (sΩK ≫ sK) := by
    rw [← hcomm]; exact (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c' sΩk).paste_horiz h
  have hsq : IsPullback π (pullback.snd c' sΩk) (pullback.snd c sK) sΩK := by
    refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := pullback.fst c sK) ?_
      (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _) (IsPullback.of_hasPullback c sK)
    simpa only [π, pullback.lift_fst] using hbig
  have : Surjective π :=
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
      hsq.flip (surjective_specMap_of_fields φK)
  have : Flat π :=
    MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback hsq.flip (flat_specMap_of_fields φK)
  have : IrreducibleSpace ↥(pullback c sK) := π.surjective.irreducibleSpace π.continuous
  have : IsReduced (pullback c sK) := isReduced_of_flat_of_surjective π
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Over.hom_ext_of_isDominant_of_unramified
statement:
lemma Over.hom_ext_of_isDominant_of_unramified
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {X Y Z : Over S}
    [FormallyUnramified Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom]
    (f g : X ⟶ Y) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsDominant i.left]
    (h : i ≫ f = i ≫ g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  let l : Z ⟶ equalizer f g := equalizer.lift i h
  have hl : l.left ≫ (equalizer.ι f g).left = i.left :=
    congrArg (fun a : Z ⟶ X ↦ a.left) (equalizer.lift_ι i h)
  let : IsDominant (l.left ≫ (equalizer.ι f g).left) := hl.symm ▸ inferInstance
  let : IsDominant (equalizer.ι f g).left :=
    IsDominant.of_comp l.left (equalizer.ι f g).left
  let : Surjective (equalizer.ι f g).left :=
    surjective_of_isDominant_of_isClosed_range _
      (Scheme.Hom.isClosedEmbedding (equalizer.ι f g).left).isClosed_range
  let : IsIso (equalizer.ι f g).left :=
    (isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective (equalizer.ι f g).left).mpr
      ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  apply CategoryTheory.Over.OverMorphism.ext
  apply (cancel_epi (equalizer.ι f g).left).mp
  exact congrArg (fun a : equalizer f g ⟶ Y ↦ a.left) (equalizer.condition f g)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Geometry.Curves.Proofs.GeometricallyIrreducible_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed.IsAlgClosed.BaseChangeIrreducible.algebraMap_quotient_bijective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_quotient_bijective [IsAlgClosed K] {A : Type v} [CommRing A]
    [Algebra K A] [Algebra.FiniteType K A] (m : Ideal A) [m.IsMaximal] :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap K (A ⧸ m))
proof:
:= by
  let : Field (A ⧸ m) := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  have : Module.Finite K (A ⧸ m) := finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing K (A ⧸ m)
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral K (A ⧸ m) := inferInstance
  exact IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral

name: AlgebraicCurves.Geometry.Curves.Proofs.GeometricallyIrreducible_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed.IsAlgClosed.BaseChangeIrreducible.pointOfMaximal_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem pointOfMaximal_eq_zero_iff [IsAlgClosed K] {A : Type v} [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType K A] (m : Ideal A) [m.IsMaximal] (a : A) :
    pointOfMaximal K m a = 0 ↔ a ∈ m
proof:
:= by
  change (RingEquiv.ofBijective (algebraMap K (A ⧸ m))
    (algebraMap_quotient_bijective m)).symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk m a) = 0 ↔ a ∈ m
  rw [map_eq_zero_iff _ (RingEquiv.injective _), Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Geometry.Curves.Proofs.GeometricallyIrreducible_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed.IsAlgClosed.BaseChangeIrreducible.isDomain_tensorProduct_of_finiteType
statement:
theorem isDomain_tensorProduct_of_finiteType [IsAlgClosed K] (A : Type v) (B : Type w)
    [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra.FiniteType K A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra K B] [IsDomain B] :
    IsDomain (A ⊗[K] B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Nontrivial (A ⊗[K] B) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_isDomain K A B
      (algebraMap K A).injective (algebraMap K B).injective
  let bB := Module.Free.chooseBasis K B
  let 𝔅 := Algebra.TensorProduct.basis A bB
  let I : A ⊗[K] B → Ideal A := fun x => Ideal.span (Set.range (𝔅.repr x))
  have hI : ∀ x, I x = ⊥ → x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    apply 𝔅.repr.injective
    rw [map_zero]
    ext i
    exact (Ideal.span_eq_bot.mp hx) _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hpt : ∀ (x y : A ⊗[K] B), x * y = 0 →
      ∀ (m : Ideal A) [m.IsMaximal], I x ≤ m ∨ I y ≤ m := by
    intro x y hxy m _
    let φ : A →ₐ[K] K := pointOfMaximal K m
    let ψ : A ⊗[K] B →ₐ[K] B :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ((Algebra.ofId K B).comp φ) (AlgHom.id K B)
        (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)
    have hψ : ∀ (z : A ⊗[K] B) (i), bB.repr (ψ z) i = φ (𝔅.repr z i) := by
      intro z i
      induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul a b =>
        simp only [ψ, 𝔅, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, AlgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
          Algebra.ofId_apply, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, Algebra.TensorProduct.basis_repr_tmul,
          Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.mapRange_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, AlgHom.commutes]
        rw [← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
          RingHom.id_apply]
      | add z w hz hw => simp [map_add, hz, hw]
    have hker : ∀ z : A ⊗[K] B, ψ z = 0 → I z ≤ m := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← pointOfMaximal_eq_zero_iff (K := K), ← hψ, hz, map_zero,
        Finsupp.zero_apply]
    have h0 : ψ x * ψ y = 0 := by rw [← map_mul, hxy, map_zero]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (hker x h)
    · exact Or.inr (hker y h)
  have : IsJacobsonRing A := isJacobsonRing_of_finiteType (A := K) (B := A)
  refine @NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain _ _ _ ⟨fun {x y} hxy => ?_⟩
  have hle : I x * I y ≤ (⊥ : Ideal A) := by
    rw [← Ideal.radical_bot_of_isReduced, Ideal.radical_eq_jacobson]
    refine le_sInf ?_
    rintro J ⟨-, hJ⟩
    rcases hpt x y hxy J with h | h
    · exact Ideal.mul_le_left.trans h
    · exact Ideal.mul_le_right.trans h
  rcases (Ideal.mul_eq_bot.mp (le_bot_iff.mp hle)) with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (hI x h)
  · exact Or.inr (hI y h)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Geometry.Curves.Proofs.GeometricallyIrreducible_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed.IsAlgClosed.BaseChangeIrreducible.isDomain_tensorProduct_of_field
statement:
theorem isDomain_tensorProduct_of_field (F : Type v) (B : Type w) [Field F] [Algebra k F]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [IsDomain B] : IsDomain (F ⊗[k] B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Nontrivial (F ⊗[k] B) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_isDomain k F B
      (algebraMap k F).injective (algebraMap k B).injective
  refine @NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain _ _ _ ⟨fun {x y} hxy => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨sx, hx⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finset x
  obtain ⟨sy, hy⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finset y
  let A : Subalgebra k F := Algebra.adjoin k ↑(sx.image Prod.fst ∪ sy.image Prod.fst)
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k A :=
    A.fg_iff_finiteType.mp ⟨sx.image Prod.fst ∪ sy.image Prod.fst, rfl⟩
  let ι : A ⊗[k] B →ₐ[k] F ⊗[k] B := Algebra.TensorProduct.map A.val (AlgHom.id k B)
  have hι : Function.Injective ι := by
    have h : Function.Injective (A.val.toLinearMap.rTensor B) :=
      Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := B) A.val.toLinearMap
        Subtype.val_injective
    intro a b hab
    exact h hab
  have hlift : ∀ s : Finset (F × B), (∀ p ∈ s, p.1 ∈ A) →
      ∃ z : A ⊗[k] B, ι z = ∑ p ∈ s, p.1 ⊗ₜ[k] p.2 := by
    intro s hs
    refine ⟨∑ p ∈ s.attach, (⟨p.1.1, hs p.1 p.2⟩ : A) ⊗ₜ[k] p.1.2, ?_⟩
    rw [map_sum, ← Finset.sum_attach s]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    simp [ι]
  have hxA : ∀ p ∈ sx, p.1 ∈ A := fun p hp =>
    Algebra.subset_adjoin (Finset.mem_coe.mpr
      (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem Prod.fst hp)))
  have hyA : ∀ p ∈ sy, p.1 ∈ A := fun p hp =>
    Algebra.subset_adjoin (Finset.mem_coe.mpr
      (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem Prod.fst hp)))
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hlift sx hxA
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hlift sy hyA
  rw [← hx] at hx'
  rw [← hy] at hy'
  subst hx' hy'
  have : IsDomain (A ⊗[k] B) := isDomain_tensorProduct_of_finiteType (K := k) A B
  have hxy' : x' * y' = 0 := hι (by rw [map_mul, hxy, map_zero])
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hxy' with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [h, map_zero])
  · exact Or.inr (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: AlgebraicCurves.Geometry.Curves.Proofs.GeometricallyIrreducible_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed.IsAlgClosed.BaseChangeIrreducible.irreducibleSpace_fiber_fst
statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_fiber_fst (x : X) :
    IrreducibleSpace
      ↥((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).fiber x)
proof:
:= by
  set i : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) with hi
  let g := X.fromSpecResidueField x
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Spec.map_surjective (g ≫ f)
  algebraize [φ.hom]
  let e : (pullback.fst f i).fiber x ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (X.residueField x ⊗[k] K)) :=
    (pullbackSymmetry (pullback.fst f i) g) ≪≫ (pullbackRightPullbackFstIso f i g) ≪≫
      (pullback.congrHom hφ.symm rfl) ≪≫ pullbackSpecIso k (X.residueField x) K
  have : IsDomain (X.residueField x ⊗[k] K) :=
    isDomain_tensorProduct_of_field k (X.residueField x) K
  have : IrreducibleSpace ↥(Spec (CommRingCat.of (X.residueField x ⊗[k] K))) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IrreducibleSpace (PrimeSpectrum (X.residueField x ⊗[k] K)))
  exact e.hom.homeomorph.irreducibleSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance

name: AlgebraicCurves.Geometry.Curves.Proofs.GeometricallyIrreducible_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed.IsAlgClosed.BaseChangeIrreducible.irreducibleSpace_pullback
statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_pullback [IrreducibleSpace X] :
    IrreducibleSpace ↥(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
proof:
:= by
  set i : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) with hi
  have : Subsingleton ↥(Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
  have : IsIntegral (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := inferInstance
  have : Surjective i := ⟨fun _ => ⟨IsLocalRing.closedPoint K, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩
  have : Surjective (pullback.fst f i) := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← Set.range_eq_univ, Scheme.Pullback.range_fst]
    rw [Set.range_eq_univ.mpr i.surjective, Set.preimage_univ]
  have hopen : IsOpenMap (pullback.fst f i) := (pullback.fst f i).isOpenMap
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (pullback.fst f i) := (pullback.fst f i).surjective
  rw [irreducibleSpace_def, Set.top_eq_univ, ← Set.preimage_univ (f := (pullback.fst f i))]
  refine (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ X).preimage_of_isPreirreducible_fiber
    (pullback.fst f i) hopen (fun x => ?_) ?_
  · rw [← Scheme.Hom.range_fiberι, ← Set.image_univ]
    have := irreducibleSpace_fiber_fst f K x
    exact ((IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ _).image _
      ((pullback.fst f i).fiberι x).continuous.continuousOn).isPreirreducible
  · obtain ⟨x⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty X)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hsurj x
    exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ x, z, hz⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIrreducible.of_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIrreducible.of_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed {k :
    Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [IrreducibleSpace X] :
    GeometricallyIrreducible f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(geometrically_iff_of_commRing_of_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms
    (P := fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IrreducibleSpace Y)).mpr fun K _ _ => ?_⟩
  exact IsAlgClosed.BaseChangeIrreducible.irreducibleSpace_pullback f K

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.flat_fromSpecResidueField_genericPoint
statement:
lemma Scheme.flat_fromSpecResidueField_genericPoint
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral S] :
    Flat (S.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))
proof:
:= by
  apply Flat.of_stalkMap
  intro x
  have hx : S.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint S) x = genericPoint S := by
    simp [Scheme.fromSpecResidueField]
  let e : S.presheaf.stalk (S.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint S) x) ≃+*
      S.functionField :=
    RingEquiv.cast (congrArg (fun y ↦ S.presheaf.stalk y) hx)
  exact RingHom.Flat.of_isField
    (e.toMulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField S.functionField)) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral.of_comp_of_isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant
statement:
lemma GeometricallyIntegral.of_comp_of_isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant
    {k : CommRingCat.{u}} {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Spec k) (hk : IsField k)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant f]
    (h : GeometricallyIntegral (f ≫ g)) : GeometricallyIntegral g
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricallyIntegral_iff] at h ⊢
  intro K _ y P fst snd H
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := Spec.map_surjective y
  have hflat : Flat (Spec.map φ) := by
    rw [Flat.SpecMap_iff]
    exact RingHom.Flat.of_isField hk φ.hom
  let : Flat fst :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback H.flip hflat
  let Q := pullback f fst
  let q : Q ⟶ P := pullback.snd f fst
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant q := inferInstance
  let : QuasiCompact q := inferInstance
  have hQ : IsIntegral Q := by
    apply h (Spec.map φ) (pullback.fst f fst)
      (pullback.snd f fst ≫ snd)
    exact (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f fst).paste_vert H
  let : IsIntegral Q := hQ
  rw [isIntegral_iff_irreducibleSpace_and_isReduced]
  constructor
  · rw [irreducibleSpace_def]
    change IsIrreducible (Set.univ : Set P)
    rw [← q.denseRange.closure_eq]
    simpa only [Set.image_univ] using
      ((IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ Q).image q
        q.continuous.continuousOn).closure
  · exact IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.isReduced q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral.of_comp_of_isDominant
statement:
lemma GeometricallyIntegral.of_comp_of_isDominant
    {k : CommRingCat.{u}} {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Spec k) (hk : IsField k)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsDominant f] [IsReduced Y]
    (h : GeometricallyIntegral (f ≫ g)) : GeometricallyIntegral g
proof:
:= by
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant f :=
    IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isDominant f
  exact h.of_comp_of_isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant f g hk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral.genericFiber_of_comp_of_isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant
statement:
lemma GeometricallyIntegral.genericFiber_of_comp_of_isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral S]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant f]
    (h : GeometricallyIntegral
      ((f ≫ g).fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))) :
    GeometricallyIntegral
      (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))
proof:
:= by
  let r := S.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)
  let : Flat r := S.flat_fromSpecResidueField_genericPoint
  let q : pullback f (pullback.fst g r) ⟶ pullback g r :=
    pullback.snd f (pullback.fst g r)
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant q := inferInstance
  let : QuasiCompact q := inferInstance
  apply GeometricallyIntegral.of_comp_of_isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant
    q (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))
      (Field.toIsField (S.residueField (genericPoint S)))
  let e := pullbackRightPullbackFstIso g r f
  let : MorphismProperty.RespectsIso
      (@GeometricallyIntegral : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) := by
    rw [GeometricallyIntegral.eq_geometrically, geometrically_eq_universally]
    exact MorphismProperty.universally_respectsIso _
  have he : GeometricallyIntegral
      (e.hom ≫ (f ≫ g).fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S)) :=
    (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso
      (@GeometricallyIntegral : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      e.hom _).mpr h
  simpa only [Scheme.Hom.fiberToSpecResidueField, e, q, r,
    pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_hom_snd] using he

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral.genericFiber_of_comp_of_isDominant
statement:
lemma GeometricallyIntegral.genericFiber_of_comp_of_isDominant
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral S]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsDominant f] [IsReduced Y]
    (h : GeometricallyIntegral
      ((f ≫ g).fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))) :
    GeometricallyIntegral
      (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (genericPoint S))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant f :=
    IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isDominant f
  exact h.genericFiber_of_comp_of_isSchemeTheoreticallyDominant f g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.geometricallyIntegral_of_geometricallyConnected
statement:
theorem Smooth.geometricallyIntegral_of_geometricallyConnected
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Smooth f] [GeometricallyConnected f] :
    GeometricallyIntegral f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro K _ x P fst p h
  let : Smooth p := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback h inferInstance
  let : ConnectedSpace P :=
    GeometricallyConnected.geometrically_connectedSpace (f := f) x fst p h
  let : IsDomain Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) :=
    Function.Injective.isDomain (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).hom.hom
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) :=
    IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian P := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian p
  exact isIntegral_of_connected_of_isDomain_stalk P
    (fun z => (Smooth.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk p z).1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isIso_morphismRestrict_of_le_opensRange
statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.isIso_morphismRestrict_of_le_opensRange
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : U ≤ f.opensRange) : IsIso (f ∣_ U)
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpenImmersion (f ∣_ U) := by
    unfold morphismRestrict
    infer_instance
  have hsurj : Surjective (f ∣_ U) := ⟨by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hU y.property
    have hxU : f x ∈ U := hx.symm ▸ y.property
    refine ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (morphismRestrict_base_coe f U ⟨x, hxU⟩).trans hx⟩
  exact (isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective (f ∣_ U)).mpr ⟨hopen, hsurj⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.bijective_awayMap_of_basicOpen_le_opensRange
statement:
theorem bijective_awayMap_of_basicOpen_le_opensRange
    {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map f)]
    (r : R) (hr : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r ≤ (Spec.map f).opensRange) :
    Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap f.hom r)
proof:
:= by
  have hrestr : IsIso (Spec.map f ∣_ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r) :=
    (Spec.map f).isIso_morphismRestrict_of_le_opensRange _ hr
  have : IsIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Localization.awayMap f.hom r))) :=
    (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme)
      (SpecMapRestrictBasicOpenIso f r)).mp hrestr
  exact (isIso_SpecMap_iff
    (f := CommRingCat.ofHom (Localization.awayMap f.hom r))).mp inferInstance

name: CommRingCat.isPushout_quotientMap
statement:
theorem isPushout_quotientMap {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    IsPushout (ofHom f) (ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
      (ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map f)))
      (ofHom (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map f) f Ideal.le_comap_map))
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  let e := (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot S I).toRingEquiv
  refine (isPushout_tensorProduct R S (R ⧸ I)).of_iso'
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) e.toCommRingCatIso ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  · ext s
    rfl
  · apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro x
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    change (1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r) =
      f r ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : R ⧸ I)
    exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : (R ⧸ I) →ₐ[R]
      S ⊗[R] (R ⧸ I)).commutes r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_SpecMap_quotientMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_SpecMap_quotientMap {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map f))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map f) f Ideal.le_comap_map)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))
proof:
:=
  isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _ (CommRingCat.isPushout_quotientMap f I)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientMap
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientMap {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (I : Ideal R)
    [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))] :
    IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map f) f Ideal.le_comap_map)))
proof:
:=
  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsOpenImmersion)
    (isPullback_SpecMap_quotientMap f I) inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientMap_of_map_eq
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientMap_of_map_eq
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (I : Ideal R) (J : Ideal S) (hJ : I.map f = J)
    [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))] :
    IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.quotientMap J f (hJ ▸ Ideal.le_comap_map))))
proof:
:= by
  subst J
  exact isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientMap f I

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientBaseChange
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientBaseChange
    {R : Type v} {A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (I : Ideal R)
    [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom))] :
    IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (f.quotientBaseChange I).toRingHom))
proof:
:=
  isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientMap_of_map_eq f.toRingHom
    (I.map (algebraMap R A)) (I.map (algebraMap R B)) (f.map_extendedIdeal I)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.geometricallyReduced
statement:
theorem Etale.geometricallyReduced
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Etale f] :
    GeometricallyReduced f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro K _ y Z fst snd h
  let : Etale snd := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback h inferInstance
  let (i : Z.affineCover.I₀) : IsReduced (Z.affineCover.X i) := by
    let g : Z.affineCover.X i ⟶ Spec (.of K) := Z.affineCover.f i ≫ snd
    let R := Γ(Spec (.of K), ⊤)
    let T := Γ(Z.affineCover.X i, ⊤)
    let φ := g.appLE (⊤ : (Spec (.of K)).Opens) (⊤ : (Z.affineCover.X i).Opens)
      (fun _ _ ↦ trivial)
    have hφ : φ.hom.Etale := by
      have : Etale g := by dsimp [g]; infer_instance
      exact g.etale_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) (isAffineOpen_top _) (fun _ _ ↦ trivial)
    let : Field R :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.isField
        (Field.toIsField K)).toField
    let := φ.hom.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra.Etale R T := hφ.toAlgebra
    let : _root_.IsReduced T :=
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field R T
    exact isReduced_of_isAffine_isReduced (Z.affineCover.X i)
  exact IsReduced.of_openCover Z Z.affineCover

name: AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyReduced.comp_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
lemma GeometricallyReduced.comp_of_isOpenImmersion
    {U X S : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S)
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [GeometricallyReduced f] :
    GeometricallyReduced (i ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨geometrically_iff_of_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms.mpr ?_⟩
  intro K _ y
  let j : pullback (i ≫ f) y ⟶ pullback f y :=
    pullback.map (i ≫ f) y f y i (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
      (Category.comp_id (i ≫ f))
      ((Category.comp_id y).trans (Category.id_comp y).symm)
  have : IsOpenImmersion j :=
    MorphismProperty.pullbackMap (P := @IsOpenImmersion)
      (f := i ≫ f) (g := y) (f' := f) (g' := y)
      (inferInstance : IsOpenImmersion i)
      (inferInstance : IsOpenImmersion (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))))
      rfl (Category.id_comp y).symm
  have : IsReduced (pullback f y) :=
    GeometricallyReduced.geometrically_isReduced (f := f) y
      (pullback.fst f y) (pullback.snd f y) (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f y)
  exact isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.flat_finitePresentation_geometricallyReduced_of_comp_etale
statement:
lemma flat_finitePresentation_geometricallyReduced_of_comp_etale
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [Etale g] [Flat (f ≫ g)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ≫ g)]
    [GeometricallyReduced (f ≫ g)] :
    Flat f ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation f ∧ GeometricallyReduced f
proof:
:= by
  let graph : X ⟶ pullback (f ≫ g) g :=
    pullback.lift (𝟙 X) f ((Category.id_comp (f ≫ g)).trans rfl)
  have : IsOpenImmersion graph :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsOpenImmersion)
      (pullback_lift_diagonal_isPullback f g)
      (inferInstance : IsOpenImmersion (pullback.diagonal g))
  have hFactor : graph ≫ pullback.snd (f ≫ g) g = f :=
    pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hFlat : Flat (graph ≫ pullback.snd (f ≫ g) g) := inferInstance
  have hPresentation : LocallyOfFinitePresentation
      (graph ≫ pullback.snd (f ≫ g) g) := inferInstance
  have hReduced : GeometricallyReduced (graph ≫ pullback.snd (f ≫ g) g) :=
    GeometricallyReduced.comp_of_isOpenImmersion graph (pullback.snd (f ≫ g) g)
  exact ⟨hFactor ▸ hFlat, hFactor ▸ hPresentation, hFactor ▸ hReduced⟩

name: RingHom.FiniteEtale.of_isPushout
statement:
theorem of_isPushout
    {A B C D : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ C)
    (i : B ⟶ D) (j : C ⟶ D) (h : IsPushout f g i j)
    (hg : g.hom.FaithfullyFlat) (hj : j.hom.FiniteEtale) : f.hom.FiniteEtale
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra A B := f.hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra A C := g.hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra C D := j.hom.toAlgebra
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat A C := hg
  let : Algebra.FiniteEtale C D := hj
  let e₀ := (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A C B).isoPushout ≪≫
    h.flip.isoPushout.symm
  let e : C ⊗[A] B ≃ₐ[C] D :=
    { toRingEquiv := e₀.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
      commutes' c := by
        change (CommRingCat.ofHom Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom ≫ e₀.hom) c = j c
        congr 2
        simp only [e₀, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
          IsPushout.inl_isoPushout_hom_assoc, IsPushout.inl_isoPushout_inv] }
  let : Module.Finite C (C ⊗[A] B) := Module.Finite.equiv e.symm.toLinearEquiv
  let : Algebra.Etale C (C ⊗[A] B) := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv e.symm
  let : Algebra.Etale A B := Algebra.Etale.of_etale_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat C
  let : Module.Finite A B := Module.Finite.of_finite_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat C
  exact ⟨⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_open_affinization
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_open_affinization
    {S W : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [CompactSpace W]
    (U : S.Opens) (f : W ⟶ U) [IsFiniteEtale f]
    [IsOpenImmersion W.toSpecΓ]
    (h : (f ≫ U.ι).appTop.hom.FiniteEtale) :
    ∃ V : FiniteEtale S,
      Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback U.ι).obj V ≅ FiniteEtale.mk f)
proof:
:= by
  let p : Spec Γ(W, ⊤) ⟶ S := Spec.map (f ≫ U.ι).appTop ≫ S.isoSpec.inv
  let : IsFiniteEtale (Spec.map (f ≫ U.ι).appTop) :=
    IsFiniteEtale.SpecMap_iff.mpr h
  let : IsFiniteEtale S.isoSpec.inv := ⟨⟩
  let : IsFiniteEtale p := inferInstanceAs
    (IsFiniteEtale (Spec.map (f ≫ U.ι).appTop ≫ S.isoSpec.inv))
  have hcomm : W.toSpecΓ ≫ p = f ≫ U.ι := by
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality]
    change ((f ≫ U.ι) ≫ S.isoSpec.hom) ≫ S.isoSpec.inv = _
    rw [Category.assoc, S.isoSpec.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  let c : W ⟶ pullback p U.ι := pullback.lift W.toSpecΓ f hcomm
  have hc₁ : c ≫ pullback.fst p U.ι = W.toSpecΓ := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hc₂ : c ≫ pullback.snd p U.ι = f := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  let : IsOpenImmersion (c ≫ pullback.fst p U.ι) := hc₁.symm ▸ inferInstance
  let : IsOpenImmersion c := IsOpenImmersion.of_comp c (pullback.fst p U.ι)
  let : IsFinite (c ≫ pullback.snd p U.ι) := hc₂.symm ▸ inferInstance
  let : IsFinite c := IsFinite.of_comp c (pullback.snd p U.ι)
  let : QuasiCompact W.toSpecΓ := (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace W.toSpecΓ).mpr
    inferInstance
  let : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant W.toSpecΓ := ⟨W.ker_toSpecΓ⟩
  let : IsDominant (c ≫ pullback.fst p U.ι) := hc₁.symm ▸ inferInstance
  let : IsDominant c := IsDominant.of_comp_of_isOpenImmersion c (pullback.fst p U.ι)
  let : Surjective c := surjective_of_isDominant_of_isClosed_range c
    c.isClosedMap.isClosed_range
  let : IsIso c := (isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective c).mpr
    ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  let eC : W ≅ pullback p U.ι := asIso c
  refine ⟨FiniteEtale.mk p, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have e : FiniteEtale.mk f ≅ (FiniteEtale.pullback U.ι).obj (FiniteEtale.mk p) :=
    MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk (P := @IsFiniteEtale)
      (Q := (⊤ : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})) eC hc₂
  exact e.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_flat_baseChange
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_flat_baseChange
    {S T W V : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsAffine T] [CompactSpace W]
    (U : S.Opens) [QuasiCompact U.ι]
    (f : W ⟶ U) [IsFiniteEtale f]
    (g : T ⟶ S) [Flat g] [Surjective g]
    (p : V ⟶ T) [IsFiniteEtale p]
    (j : pullback (f ≫ U.ι) g ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsIso j.appTop]
    (hj : j ≫ p = pullback.snd (f ≫ U.ι) g) :
    ∃ Z : FiniteEtale S,
      Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback U.ι).obj Z ≅ FiniteEtale.mk f)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsAffine V := isAffine_of_isAffineHom p
  let : IsOpenImmersion
      ((pullback (f ≫ U.ι) g).toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map j.appTop) := by
    rw [← Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality]
    infer_instance
  let : IsOpenImmersion (pullback (f ≫ U.ι) g).toSpecΓ :=
    IsOpenImmersion.of_comp _ (Spec.map j.appTop)
  let : IsOpenImmersion W.toSpecΓ :=
    isOpenImmersion_toSpecΓ_of_flat_baseChange (f ≫ U.ι) g
  have hpΓ : p.appTop.hom.FiniteEtale :=
    ((HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @IsFiniteEtale)
      (Q := affineAnd RingHom.FiniteEtale) (f := p)).mp inferInstance).2
  let : IsFiniteEtale (Spec.map p.appTop) := IsFiniteEtale.SpecMap_iff.mpr hpΓ
  let : IsFiniteEtale (Spec.map j.appTop) := ⟨⟩
  have hsΓ : (pullback.snd (f ≫ U.ι) g).appTop.hom.FiniteEtale := by
    rw [← hj, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    apply IsFiniteEtale.SpecMap_iff.mp
    rw [Spec.map_comp]
    infer_instance
  exact exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_open_affinization U f
    (finiteEtale_appTop_of_flat_baseChange (f ≫ U.ι) g hsΓ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_specMap_isEquivalence_iff
statement:
theorem pullback_specMap_isEquivalence_iff :
    (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback
      ((@IsFinite : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) ⊓
        (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})) ⊤
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).IsEquivalence ↔
    (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange R S : CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{u} R ⥤
      CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{u} S).IsEquivalence
proof:
:= by
  let P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u} :=
    (@IsFinite : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) ⊓
      (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
  change (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback P ⊤
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).IsEquivalence ↔ _
  have hP : P = (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) :=
    IsFiniteEtale.eq_inf.symm
  have htransport (Q : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      [Q.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
      (hQ : Q = (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})) :
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback Q ⊤
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).IsEquivalence ↔
      (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange R S : CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{u} R ⥤
        CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{u} S).IsEquivalence := by
    subst Q
    let F := FiniteEtale.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
    constructor
    · intro h
      let : F.IsEquivalence := h
      let : F.op.IsEquivalence := F.asEquivalence.op.isEquivalence_functor
      let : ((affineEquivalence (.of R)).functor ⋙
          CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange R S).IsEquivalence :=
        Functor.isEquivalence_of_iso (affineEquivalenceCompBaseChangeIso R S).symm
      exact Functor.isEquivalence_of_comp_left (affineEquivalence (.of R)).functor
        (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange R S)
    · intro h
      let : (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange R S).IsEquivalence := h
      let : (F.op ⋙ (affineEquivalence (.of S)).functor).IsEquivalence :=
        Functor.isEquivalence_of_iso (affineEquivalenceCompBaseChangeIso R S)
      let : F.op.IsEquivalence := Functor.isEquivalence_of_comp_right
        F.op (affineEquivalence (.of S)).functor
      let : F.op.unop.IsEquivalence := F.op.asEquivalence.unop.isEquivalence_functor
      have hF : F.IsEquivalence := Functor.isEquivalence_of_iso F.opUnopIso
      exact hF
  exact htransport P hP

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.pullback_faithful_of_isDominant
statement:
lemma pullback_faithful_of_isDominant {T S : Scheme.{u}} (j : T ⟶ S) [IsDominant j] :
    (FiniteEtale.pullback j).Faithful where
  map_injective {A B} f g hfg
proof:
:= by
    let i : Over.mk (Limits.pullback.fst A.hom j ≫ A.hom) ⟶ A.toComma :=
      Over.homMk (Limits.pullback.fst A.hom j) rfl
    let : IsDominant i.left :=
      isDominant_pullback_fst_of_isOpenMap A.hom j A.hom.isOpenMap
    have hleft : ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).map f).left =
        ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).map g).left :=
      congrArg (fun k : (FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj A ⟶
        (FiniteEtale.pullback j).obj B ↦ k.left) hfg
    have hcomp : Limits.pullback.fst A.hom j ≫ f.left =
        Limits.pullback.fst A.hom j ≫ g.left := by
      have hf : Limits.pullback.fst A.hom j ≫ f.left =
          ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).map f).left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst B.hom j :=
        (Limits.pullback.lift_fst _ _ _).symm
      have hg : ((FiniteEtale.pullback j).map g).left ≫
          Limits.pullback.fst B.hom j =
          Limits.pullback.fst A.hom j ≫ g.left :=
        Limits.pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
      exact hf.trans ((congrArg (fun a ↦ a ≫ Limits.pullback.fst B.hom j) hleft).trans hg)
    have hOver : f.hom = g.hom :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Over.hom_ext_of_isDominant_of_unramified f.hom g.hom i
        (CategoryTheory.Over.OverMorphism.ext hcomp)
    apply MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext
    exact congrArg (fun a : A.toComma ⟶ B.toComma ↦ a.left) hOver

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.finiteNormalGenericDesc_isIso
statement:
theorem finiteNormalGenericDesc_isIso
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] :
    IsIso (finiteNormalGenericDesc f)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsIntegralHom f :=
    (IsFinite.iff_isIntegralHom_and_locallyOfFiniteType f).mp
      (inferInstance : IsFinite f) |>.1
  let : IsAffineHom f := (inferInstance : IsAffineHom f)
  let L : Type u := Y.functionField
  let : CommRing L :=
    CommRingCat.instCommRingObjForgetRingHomCarrier
  let q : Spec (.of L) ⟶ Y := (Y.genericExtensionMorphism Y.functionField)
  let genericComposite : Spec (.of L) ⟶ X := (Y.genericExtensionMorphism Y.functionField ≫ f)
  let d : genericComposite.normalization ⟶ Y :=
    finiteNormalGenericDesc f
  let : IsIntegralHom d := by
    apply (IsIntegralHom.comp_iff (f := d) (g := f)).mp
    rw [show d ≫ f = genericComposite.fromNormalization from
      finiteNormalGenericDesc_comp f]
    infer_instance
  let : IsAffineHom d := inferInstance
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_forall_exists_morphismRestrict
    (P := MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme.{u})
  intro y
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hyU, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := X) (U := ⊤)
      (x := f y) (by trivial)
  let V : Y.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ U
  have hyV : y ∈ V := hyU
  have hV : IsAffineOpen V :=
    @IsAffineOpen.preimage _ _ U hU f
      (inferInstance : IsAffineHom f)
  let : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨y, hyV⟩⟩
  refine ⟨V, hyV,
    (isIso_morphismRestrict_iff_isIso_app d hV).mpr ?_⟩
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  let A : Type u := Γ(X, U)
  let T : Type u := Γ(Y, V)
  let S : Type u := Γ(Spec (.of L), genericComposite ⁻¹ᵁ U)
  let : Algebra A T := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra T L := Y.affineExtensionAlgebra V L
  let : Algebra A L :=
    ((algebraMap T L).comp (algebraMap A T)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A T L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : Algebra A S := (genericComposite.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  let C : Type u := integralClosure A S
  have hpre : d ⁻¹ᵁ V = genericComposite.fromNormalization ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    dsimp only [d, V]
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
      finiteNormalGenericDesc_comp]
  let eN : Γ(genericComposite.normalization, d ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≅ .of C :=
    genericComposite.normalization.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso hpre.symm).op ≪≫
      genericComposite.normalizationObjIso hU
  have hqpre : q ⁻¹ᵁ V = genericComposite ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    dsimp only [q, genericComposite, V]
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
  cases hqpre
  let : Algebra T Γ(Spec (.of L), q ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    (q.app V).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra A Γ(Spec (.of L), q ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    ((algebraMap T Γ(Spec (.of L), q ⁻¹ᵁ V)).comp
      (algebraMap A T)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A T Γ(Spec (.of L), q ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let eS0 : Γ(Spec (.of L), q ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≃ₐ[T] L :=
    Y.genericExtensionSectionsAlgEquiv L V
  let eS : S ≃ₐ[A] L := by
    let eEq : S ≃ₐ[A] Γ(Spec (.of L), q ⁻¹ᵁ V) := by
      exact AlgEquiv.refl
    exact eEq.trans (eS0.restrictScalars A)
  let eC : C ≃ₐ[A] integralClosure A L := eS.mapIntegralClosure
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed T :=
    IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed V hV
  let : IsFractionRing T L :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen Y V hV
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A T := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    intro t
    exact ((inferInstance : IsIntegralHom f).isIntegral_app U hU) t
  let : IsIntegralClosure T A L := inferInstance
  let eT : T ≃ₐ[A] integralClosure A L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.equiv A T L (integralClosure A L)
  have hcomp :
      (d.app V ≫ eN.hom ≫ eC.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) =
        eT.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom := by
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    ext t
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
    change algebraMap (integralClosure A L) L
        (eC (eN.hom (d.app V t))) =
      algebraMap (integralClosure A L) L (eT t)
    rw [IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_equiv]
    change eS ((eN.hom (d.app V t) : C) : S) = algebraMap T L t
    have hdq : d.app V ≫ eN.hom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.val (integralClosure A S)).toRingHom =
          q.app V := by
      have hle : genericComposite ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤
          genericComposite.toNormalization ⁻¹ᵁ (genericComposite.fromNormalization ⁻¹ᵁ U) := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_fromNormalization]
      have hnorm : (genericComposite.normalizationObjIso hU).hom ≫
          CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Subalgebra.val (integralClosure A S)).toRingHom =
          genericComposite.toNormalization.appLE (genericComposite.fromNormalization ⁻¹ᵁ U)
            (genericComposite ⁻¹ᵁ U) hle := by
        simpa only [A, S] using genericComposite.normalizationObjIso_hom_val hU
      have hdle : genericComposite.fromNormalization ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ d ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
        rw [hpre]
      have htransport : d.app V ≫
          (genericComposite.normalization.presheaf.mapIso
            (eqToIso hpre.symm).op).hom =
          d.appLE V (genericComposite.fromNormalization ⁻¹ᵁ U) hdle := by
        rw [d.app_eq_appLE]
        exact d.appLE_map' hdle hpre.symm
      have hqd : genericComposite.toNormalization ≫ d = q := by
        exact toNormalization_finiteNormalGenericDesc f
      dsimp only [eN]
      simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
      rw [hnorm]
      rw [← Category.assoc, htransport,
        Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
      exact appLE_preimage_eq_app_of_eq
        (genericComposite.toNormalization ≫ d) q hqd V
    have hdq_t := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom t) hdq
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom,
      RingHom.comp_apply] at hdq_t
    change ((eN.hom (d.app V t) : C) : S) = q.app V t at hdq_t
    rw [hdq_t]
    exact Y.genericExtensionSectionsIso_hom_app L V t
  have : IsIso
      (d.app V ≫ eN.hom ≫ eC.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    infer_instance
  have : IsIso (eN.hom ≫ eC.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) :=
    inferInstance
  let : IsIso (d.app V) :=
    IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right (d.app V)
      (eN.hom ≫ eC.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom)
  exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _

    [Algebra X.functionField L] (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] :
    X.genericExtensionMorphism L ⁻¹ᵁ U = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  rintro y -
  change X.genericExtensionMorphism L y ∈ U
  rw [Subsingleton.elim y (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (CommRingCat.of L)),
    genericExtensionMorphism_apply_closedPoint]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.genericExtensionSectionsIso_hom_app
statement:
lemma genericExtensionSectionsIso_hom_app (L : Type u) [Field L]
    [Algebra X.functionField L] (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    (X.genericExtensionSectionsIso L U).hom
        ((X.genericExtensionMorphism L).app U r) =
      algebraMap X.functionField L (X.germToFunctionField U r)
proof:
:= by
  let hU : X.genericExtensionMorphism L
      (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (CommRingCat.of L)) ∈ U := by
    rw [genericExtensionMorphism_apply_closedPoint]
    exact ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr
      (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty U))
  have h₁ := Scheme.germ_stalkClosedPointTo
    (f := X.genericExtensionMorphism L) U hU
  have h₂ := Scheme.germ_stalkClosedPointTo_Spec_fromSpecStalk
    (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of L)
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap X.functionField L)) U hU
  have H : (X.genericExtensionMorphism L).app U ≫
      (X.genericExtensionSectionsIso L U).hom =
      X.germToFunctionField U ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap X.functionField L) := by
    calc
      _ = X.presheaf.germ U _ hU ≫
          Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (X.genericExtensionMorphism L) := by
        simpa [genericExtensionSectionsIso] using h₁.symm
      _ = _ := by
        unfold genericExtensionMorphism
        convert h₂ using 1
        all_goals rfl
  exact congrArg (fun q : Γ(X, U) ⟶ CommRingCat.of L ↦ q.hom r) H

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isFinite_fromNormalization_of_finite_integralClosure
statement:
private theorem isFinite_fromNormalization_of_finite_integralClosure
    (hfinite : ∀ (U : Z.Opens) (_hU : IsAffineOpen U),
      letI := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
      Module.Finite Γ(Z, U) (integralClosure Γ(Z, U) Γ(Y, f ⁻¹ᵁ U))) :
    IsFinite f.fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  refine { finite_app := ?_ }
  intro U hU
  let := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  rw [f.fromNormalization_app hU]
  exact RingHom.Finite.comp
    (f.normalizationObjIso hU).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.finite
    (show (algebraMap Γ(Z, U)
      (integralClosure Γ(Z, U) Γ(Y, f ⁻¹ᵁ U))).Finite from
      hfinite U hU)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isFinite_fromNormalization_genericExtension
statement:
theorem isFinite_fromNormalization_genericExtension
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [IsNormalIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra X.functionField L]
    [FiniteDimensional X.functionField L] [Algebra.IsSeparable X.functionField L] :
    IsFinite (X.genericExtensionMorphism L).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  apply isFinite_fromNormalization_of_finite_integralClosure
    (X.genericExtensionMorphism L)
  intro U hU
  let := ((X.genericExtensionMorphism L).app U).hom.toAlgebra
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty U with
  | inl hEmpty =>
      have hUbot : U = ⊥ := U.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot.mp fun hU =>
        let ⟨x, hx⟩ := hU
        hEmpty.false ⟨x, hx⟩
      subst U
      have : Subsingleton
          Γ(Spec (.of L), X.genericExtensionMorphism L ⁻¹ᵁ (⊥ : X.Opens)) := by
        simpa using (inferInstance : Subsingleton Γ(Spec (.of L), (⊥ : (Spec (.of L)).Opens)))
      apply Module.Finite.of_surjective
        (Algebra.linearMap Γ(X, (⊥ : X.Opens))
          (integralClosure Γ(X, (⊥ : X.Opens))
            Γ(Spec (.of L), X.genericExtensionMorphism L ⁻¹ᵁ (⊥ : X.Opens))))
      intro x
      exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  | inr hNonempty =>
      let : Nonempty U := hNonempty
      let : Algebra Γ(X, U) L := X.affineExtensionAlgebra U L
      let e := X.genericExtensionSectionsAlgEquiv L U
      let eInt := e.mapIntegralClosure
      have hL : Module.Finite Γ(X, U) (integralClosure Γ(X, U) L) :=
        X.affineIntegralClosure_finite ⟨U, hU⟩ L
      change (algebraMap Γ(X, U)
        (integralClosure Γ(X, U)
          Γ(Spec (.of L), X.genericExtensionMorphism L ⁻¹ᵁ U))).Finite
      rw [show algebraMap Γ(X, U)
          (integralClosure Γ(X, U)
            Γ(Spec (.of L), X.genericExtensionMorphism L ⁻¹ᵁ U)) =
          eInt.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
            (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (integralClosure Γ(X, U) L)) by
        ext r
        exact congrArg Subtype.val (eInt.symm.commutes r).symm]
      exact RingHom.Finite.comp eInt.symm.toRingEquiv.finite
        (show (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (integralClosure Γ(X, U) L)).Finite from hL)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specNormalizationIso_hom_fromNormalization
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem specNormalizationIso_hom_fromNormalization :
    (specNormalizationIso R T).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R T))) =
      (affineStructureMap R T).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  apply spec_toNormalization_hom_ext R T
  rw [← Category.assoc, toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom,
    ← Spec.map_comp, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_fromNormalization]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFiniteEtale_specNormalization_iff
statement:
theorem isFiniteEtale_specNormalization_iff :
    IsFiniteEtale (affineStructureMap R T).fromNormalization ↔
      Module.Finite R (integralClosure R T) ∧ Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R T)
proof:
:= by
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R T)))
  let e := specNormalizationIso R T
  have hg : g = e.inv ≫ (affineStructureMap R T).fromNormalization := by
    rw [← specNormalizationIso_hom_fromNormalization R T, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  constructor
  · intro h
    let : IsFinite (affineStructureMap R T).fromNormalization := h.toIsFinite
    let : Etale (affineStructureMap R T).fromNormalization := h.toEtale
    have hf : IsFinite g := by
      rw [hg]
      infer_instance
    have he : Etale g := by
      rw [hg]
      infer_instance
    exact ⟨RingHom.finite_algebraMap.mp (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff _ |>.mp hf),
      RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mp ((HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mp he)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hfinite, hetale⟩
    let : IsFinite g := (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff _).mpr (RingHom.finite_algebraMap.mpr hfinite)
    let : Etale g := (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr
      (RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr hetale)
    have hcomp : IsFiniteEtale (e.hom ≫ g) := ⟨⟩
    exact specNormalizationIso_hom_fromNormalization R T ▸ hcomp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finite_etale_tensor_integralClosure_of_normalization_baseChange
statement:
theorem finite_etale_tensor_integralClosure_of_normalization_baseChange
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (h : IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd (affineStructureMap R T).fromNormalization
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))))) :
    Module.Finite A (A ⊗[R] integralClosure R T) ∧
      Algebra.Etale A (A ⊗[R] integralClosure R T)
proof:
:= by
  let f := (affineStructureMap R T).fromNormalization
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R T)))
  let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
  let e := specNormalizationIso R T
  have he : f ≫ 𝟙 _ = e.hom ≫ g :=
    (Category.comp_id f).trans (specNormalizationIso_hom_fromNormalization R T).symm
  let l := pullback.map f b g b e.hom (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) he
    ((Category.comp_id b).trans (Category.id_comp b).symm)
  have hl : l ≫ pullback.snd g b = pullback.snd f b := by
    exact (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _)
  have hcomp : IsFiniteEtale (l ≫ pullback.snd g b) := hl.symm ▸ h
  let : IsFinite (l ≫ pullback.snd g b) := hcomp.toIsFinite
  let : Etale (l ≫ pullback.snd g b) := hcomp.toEtale
  have hginv : IsFiniteEtale (inv l ≫ (l ≫ pullback.snd g b)) := ⟨⟩
  have hg : IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd g b) :=
    IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc l (pullback.snd g b) ▸ hginv
  exact ⟨SchemeTheory.tensorProduct_finite_of_spec_baseChange R A
      (integralClosure R T) hg.toIsFinite,
    SchemeTheory.tensorProduct_etale_of_spec_baseChange R A
      (integralClosure R T) hg.toEtale⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsNormalIntegral.stalk_isIntegrallyClosed
statement:
theorem stalk_isIntegrallyClosed (x : X) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := X) (U := ⊤) (x := x) (by trivial)
  let : Nonempty U := ⟨x, hxU⟩
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(X, U) :=
    IsNormalIntegral.affine_isIntegrallyClosed U hU
  let : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    (X.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom.toAlgebra
  let : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal :=
    hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  exact isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization
    (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsNormalIntegral.of_stalks
statement:
theorem IsNormalIntegral.of_stalks
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X]
    (h : ∀ x : X, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    IsNormalIntegral X where
  isIntegrallyClosed U hU
proof:
:= by
    intro hUnonempty
    let : Nonempty U := hUnonempty
    apply IsIntegrallyClosed.of_isLocalization_maximal
      (fun P [_] ↦ Localization.AtPrime P)
    intro P hP
    let : P.IsMaximal := hP
    let : P.IsPrime := hP.isPrime
    let y : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) := ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
    let x : X := hU.fromSpec y
    have hxU : x ∈ U := (hU.isoSpec.inv y).2
    let : IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x) := h x
    let : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      (X.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom.toAlgebra
    let : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) P := by
      exact hU.isLocalization_stalk' y hxU
    let e : Localization.AtPrime P ≃ₐ[Γ(X, U)] X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      IsLocalization.algEquiv P.primeCompl
        (Localization.AtPrime P) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    exact IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv e.symm.toRingEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsNormalIntegral.of_isAffine
statement:
theorem IsNormalIntegral.of_isAffine
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [IsAffine X]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(X, ⊤)] :
    IsNormalIntegral X where
  isIntegrallyClosed U hU
proof:
:= by
    intro hUnonempty
    let : Nonempty U := hUnonempty
    apply IsIntegrallyClosed.of_isLocalization_maximal
      (fun P [_] ↦ Localization.AtPrime P)
    intro P hP
    let : P.IsMaximal := hP
    let : P.IsPrime := hP.isPrime
    let y : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) := ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
    let x : X := hU.fromSpec y
    have hxU : x ∈ U := (hU.isoSpec.inv y).2
    let xTop : (⊤ : X.Opens) := ⟨x, by trivial⟩
    let : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by trivial)).hom.toAlgebra
    let : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((isAffineOpen_top X).primeIdealOf xTop).asIdeal :=
      (isAffineOpen_top X).isLocalization_stalk xTop
    have hxNormal : IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization
        (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((isAffineOpen_top X).primeIdealOf xTop).asIdeal.primeCompl
        ((isAffineOpen_top X).primeIdealOf
          xTop).asIdeal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
    let : IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x) := hxNormal
    let : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      (X.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom.toAlgebra
    let : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) P := by
      exact hU.isLocalization_stalk' y hxU
    let e : Localization.AtPrime P ≃ₐ[Γ(X, U)] X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      IsLocalization.algEquiv P.primeCompl
        (Localization.AtPrime P) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    exact IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv e.symm.toRingEquiv

name: Algebra.exists_integralClosure_quotient_factor_and_awayMap_bijective
statement:
theorem exists_integralClosure_quotient_factor_and_awayMap_bijective
    {R B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra.FiniteType R B] [Algebra.QuasiFinite R B]
    (I : Ideal R) [Algebra (R ⧸ I) D] [Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) D]
    (p : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B) →ₐ[R ⧸ I] D)
    [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom p.toRingHom))] :
    let C
proof:
:= integralClosure R B
    let J := I.map (algebraMap R C)
    ∃ e : C ⧸ J, IsIdempotentElem e ∧
      ∃ E : (C ⧸ J) ≃ₐ[R ⧸ I] D × ((C ⧸ J) ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}),
        (∀ x, (E x).1 = p ((integralClosure R B).val.quotientBaseChange I x)) ∧
        (∀ x, (E x).2 = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) x) ∧
        ∃ g : C, Ideal.Quotient.mk J g = 1 - e ∧
          E (Ideal.Quotient.mk J g) = (1, 0) ∧
          Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap (integralClosure R B).val.toRingHom g) := by
  let : IsOpenImmersion
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure R B).val.toRingHom)) :=
    isOpenImmersion_spec_integralClosure R B
  exact (integralClosure R B).val.exists_quotient_factor_and_awayMap_bijective I p

proof:

  simp only [integralOpenNormalizationIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc,
    toNormalization_normalizationPullback_fst,
    IsPullback.isoPullback_hom_fst_assoc, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isOpenImmersion_toNormalization_integral_open
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_toNormalization_integral_open :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.range_toNormalization_integral_open
statement:
theorem range_toNormalization_integral_open :
    Set.range (p ≫ j).toNormalization =

    (Scheme.Pullback.range_fst (p ≫ j).fromNormalization j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.specNormalizationRingIso_hom_val
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma specNormalizationRingIso_hom_val :
    (specNormalizationRingIso R B).hom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure R B).val.toRingHom =
      (affineStructureMap R B).toNormalization.appTop ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let := (affineStructureMap R B).appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  have hval : (specIntegralClosureIso R B).hom ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure R B).val.toRingHom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)
        Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of B), ⊤)).val.toRingHom ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).hom := by
    ext x
    rfl
  let m : Γ((affineStructureMap R B).normalization, ⊤) ⟶
      CommRingCat.of (integralClosure Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)
        Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of B), ⊤)) :=
    ((affineStructureMap R B).normalizationObjIso
      (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))).hom
  change (m ≫ (specIntegralClosureIso R B).hom) ≫ _ = _
  rw [Category.assoc, hval, ← Category.assoc]
  have hnorm :
      m ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)
            Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of B), ⊤)).val.toRingHom =
        (affineStructureMap R B).toNormalization.appTop := by
    have h := Scheme.Hom.normalizationObjIso_hom_val (affineStructureMap R B)
      (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    have h' : m ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom
        (integralClosure Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)
          Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of B), ⊤)).val.toRingHom =
        (affineStructureMap R B).toNormalization.appTop ≫
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of B)).presheaf.map (𝟙 (Opposite.op ⊤)) := h
    exact h'.trans ((congrArg (fun k : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of B), ⊤) ⟶
        Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of B), ⊤) =>
          (affineStructureMap R B).toNormalization.appTop ≫ k)
      ((Spec (CommRingCat.of B)).presheaf.map_id (Opposite.op ⊤))).trans
        (Category.comp_id _))
  exact congrArg (fun k : Γ((affineStructureMap R B).normalization, ⊤) ⟶
    Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of B), ⊤) => k ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).hom) hnorm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization ≫
        (specNormalizationIso R B).hom =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure R B).val.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsAffine (affineStructureMap R B).normalization :=
    isAffine_of_isAffineHom (affineStructureMap R B).fromNormalization
  change (affineStructureMap R B).toNormalization ≫
    ((affineStructureMap R B).normalization.isoSpec.hom ≫
      Spec.map (specNormalizationRingIso R B).inv) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality,
    Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_hom, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp,
    Category.assoc, ← specNormalizationRingIso_hom_val, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.spec_toNormalization_hom_ext
statement:
theorem spec_toNormalization_hom_ext
    {T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T]
    {f g : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).normalization ⟶ T}
    (h : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization ≫ f =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).toNormalization ≫ g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  have hval (x : Γ((affineStructureMap R B).normalization, ⊤)) :
      ((specNormalizationRingIso R B).hom x : B) =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).hom
          ((affineStructureMap R B).toNormalization.appTop x) :=
    congrArg (fun k : Γ((affineStructureMap R B).normalization, ⊤) ⟶
      CommRingCat.of B ↦ k x) (specNormalizationRingIso_hom_val R B)
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (affineStructureMap R B).toNormalization.appTop.hom := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply (specNormalizationRingIso R B).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
    apply Subtype.val_injective
    change ((specNormalizationRingIso R B).hom x : B) =
      ((specNormalizationRingIso R B).hom y : B)
    rw [hval x, hval y, hxy]
  apply ext_of_isAffine
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  apply hinj
  have hΓ := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.appTop) h
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at hΓ
  exact congrArg (fun k : Γ(T, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of B), ⊤) ↦ k x) hΓ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_spec_integralClosure
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_spec_integralClosure
    [Algebra.FiniteType R B] [Algebra.QuasiFinite R B] :
    IsOpenImmersion
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (integralClosure R B).val.toRingHom))
proof:
:= by
  let : LocallyOfFiniteType (affineStructureMap R B) :=
    (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType)).mpr
      (RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
  let : LocallyQuasiFinite (affineStructureMap R B) :=
    (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyQuasiFinite)).mpr
      (RingHom.quasiFinite_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
  rw [← toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom R B]
  infer_instance

name: Algebra.exists_integral_idempotent_factor_of_etale_quotientSection
statement:
theorem exists_integral_idempotent_factor_of_etale_quotientSection
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.Etale R B]
    (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] (σ : B →ₐ[R] R ⧸ I) :
    ∃ e : B, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ σ e = 1 ∧
      Algebra.IsIntegral R (B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}) ∧
      Function.Surjective (algebraMap (R ⧸ I)
        ((B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}) ⧸
          I.map (algebraMap R (B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}))))
proof:
:= by
  let C := integralClosure R B
  let : CommRing C := inferInstance
  let J : Ideal C := I.map (algebraMap R C)
  let : CommRing (C ⧸ J) := inferInstance
  let qC : C →+* C ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  let f : C →ₐ[R] B := (integralClosure R B).val
  let p : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B) →ₐ[R ⧸ I] R ⧸ I :=
    AlgHom.quotientSection I σ
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom p.toRingHom)) :=
    AlgHom.isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientSection I σ
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀, E, hE₁, _, g, hg, hEg, hlocal⟩ :=
    exists_integralClosure_quotient_factor_and_awayMap_bijective I p
  have hgidem : IsIdempotentElem (qC g) := by
    rw [hg]
    exact he₀.one_sub
  have : Algebra.FiniteType R (Localization.Away g) := by
    let φ : Localization.Away g →ₐ[R] Localization.Away (f g) :=
      Localization.awayMapₐ f g
    let E' := AlgEquiv.ofBijective φ hlocal
    exact (inferInstance : Algebra.FiniteType R (Localization.Away (f g))).equiv E'.symm
  have hcyc : ∀ x : C ⧸ J, ∃ r : R, qC g * x = r • qC g := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (E x).1
    refine ⟨r, E.injective ?_⟩
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul (R ⧸ I) r (qC g),
      map_smul, map_mul, hEg]
    apply Prod.ext
    · change 1 * (E x).1 = Ideal.Quotient.mk I r * 1
      rw [one_mul, mul_one, hr]
    · change 0 * (E x).2 = (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r) • 0
      rw [zero_mul, smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨e, he, heq⟩ :=
    exists_idempotent_lift_of_integral_of_cyclic_quotient I g hgidem hcyc
  have hcyce : ∀ x : C ⧸ J, ∃ r : R, qC e * x = r • qC e := by
    rw [heq]
    exact hcyc
  have hunit : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) g) :=
    isUnit_quotient_one_sub_of_eq_mod_extendedIdeal I
      (HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := I)) g e heq.symm
  have hfactor := f.bijective_idempotentFactorMap_of_awayMap_bijective e he g hunit hlocal
  have hintegral : Algebra.IsIntegral R (B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - f e}) :=
    f.isIntegral_idempotentFactor_of_awayMap_bijective e he g hunit hlocal
  have hσg : σ (f g) = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Prod.fst hEg
    rw [hE₁] at h
    exact h
  have hσe : σ (f e) = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (p.comp (f.quotientBaseChange I)) heq
    change σ (f e) = σ (f g) at h
    exact h.trans hσg
  refine ⟨f e, he.map f, hσe, hintegral, ?_⟩
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}
  let F := B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - f e}
  let : CommRing D := inferInstance
  let : CommRing F := inferInstance
  let : CommRing (D ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R D)) := inferInstance
  let : CommRing (F ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R F)) := inferInstance
  let ψ : D →ₐ[R] F := f.idempotentFactorMap e
  have hscalar : Function.Surjective (algebraMap (R ⧸ I)
      (D ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R D))) :=
    surjective_algebraMap_quotient_idempotentFactor_of_cyclic I e hcyce
  intro y
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hfactor.surjective v
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hscalar (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R D)) w)
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (ψ.quotientBaseChange I) hr
  simpa only [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.quotientBaseChange_mk] using h

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosureToCompositumAlgHom_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integralClosureToCompositumAlgHom_coe
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {L : Type uL} {Ω : Type uO}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing L] [CommRing Ω]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A L] [Algebra A Ω]
    [Algebra B Ω] [IsScalarTower A B Ω]
    (f : L →ₐ[A] Ω) (x : integralClosure A L) :
    ((integralClosureToCompositumAlgHom f x : integralClosure B Ω) : Ω) =
      f (x : L)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosureToCompositumAlgHom_injective
statement:
theorem integralClosureToCompositumAlgHom_injective
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {L : Type uL} {Ω : Type uO}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing L] [CommRing Ω]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A L] [Algebra A Ω]
    [Algebra B Ω] [IsScalarTower A B Ω]
    (f : L →ₐ[A] Ω) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective
      (integralClosureToCompositumAlgHom
        (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) (Ω := Ω) f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply hf
  exact congrArg
    (fun z : integralClosure B Ω ↦ (z : Ω)) hxy

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosureToCompositum_isIntegral
statement:
theorem integralClosureToCompositum_isIntegral
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {L : Type uL} {Ω : Type uO}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing L] [CommRing Ω]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra A Ω]
    [Algebra B Ω] [IsScalarTower A B Ω]
    (f : L →ₐ[A] Ω) :
    letI
proof:
:= integralClosureToCompositumAlgebra
      (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) (Ω := Ω) f
    Algebra.IsIntegral (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure B Ω) := by
  let : Algebra (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure B Ω) :=
    integralClosureToCompositumAlgebra
      (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) (Ω := Ω) f
  let : IsScalarTower A (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure B Ω) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦
      (integralClosureToCompositumAlgHom
        (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) (Ω := Ω) f).commutes x |>.symm
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral B (integralClosure B Ω) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_algebra B Ω
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A (integralClosure B Ω) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.trans B
  exact Algebra.IsIntegral.tower_top A

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_integralClosureCompositum_prime_liesOver
statement:
theorem exists_integralClosureCompositum_prime_liesOver
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {L : Type uL} {Ω : Type uO}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing L] [CommRing Ω]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra A Ω]
    [Algebra B Ω] [IsScalarTower A B Ω]
    (f : L →ₐ[A] Ω) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (Q : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [Q.IsPrime] :
    letI
proof:
:= integralClosureToCompositumAlgebra
      (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) (Ω := Ω) f
    ∃ q : Ideal (integralClosure B Ω), q.IsPrime ∧ q.LiesOver Q := by
  let : Algebra (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure B Ω) :=
    integralClosureToCompositumAlgebra
      (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) (Ω := Ω) f
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure B Ω) :=
    integralClosureToCompositum_isIntegral
      (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) (Ω := Ω) f
  have hinjective : Function.Injective
      (algebraMap (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure B Ω)) :=
    integralClosureToCompositumAlgHom_injective
      (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) (Ω := Ω) f hf
  obtain ⟨q, -, hqPrime, hqComap⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral Q
      (⊥ : Ideal (integralClosure B Ω)) (by
        change RingHom.ker
          (algebraMap (integralClosure A L) (integralClosure B Ω)) ≤ Q
        rw [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp hinjective]
        exact bot_le)
  exact ⟨q, hqPrime, (Ideal.liesOver_iff q Q).mpr hqComap.symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_ringHom_formallyEtale_of_etale
statement:
private theorem stalkMap_ringHom_formallyEtale_of_etale
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y) :
    (f.stalkMap y).hom.FormallyEtale
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [(f.stalkMap y).hom]
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
      (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := by
    change (f.stalkMap y).hom.FormallyUnramified
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.FormallyUnramified.stalkMap f y
  let : Algebra.FormallySmooth (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
      (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := by
    change (f.stalkMap y).hom.FormallySmooth
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.mem_smoothLocus]
    rw [f.smoothLocus_eq_top]
    exact Set.mem_univ y
  exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_formallyUnramified_and_formallySmooth

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_formallyEtale_of_etale
statement:
theorem stalkMap_formallyEtale_of_etale
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y) :
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
proof:
:=
      (f.stalkMap y).hom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.FormallyEtale (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
      (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := by
  exact f.stalkMap_ringHom_formallyEtale_of_etale y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.stalkPrimeLocalization_ringHom_formallyEtale_of_etale
statement:
private theorem stalkPrimeLocalization_ringHom_formallyEtale_of_etale
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y)
    (P : Ideal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) [P.IsPrime] :
    ((algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (Localization.AtPrime P)).comp
      (f.stalkMap y).hom).FormallyEtale
proof:
:= by
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk (f y)
  let B := Y.presheaf.stalk y
  let C := Localization.AtPrime P
  have hAB : (f.stalkMap y).hom.FormallyEtale := by
    change @Algebra.FormallyEtale A B _ _ (f.stalkMap y).hom.toAlgebra
    exact f.stalkMap_formallyEtale_of_etale y
  have hBC : (algebraMap B C).FormallyEtale := by
    rw [RingHom.formallyEtale_algebraMap]
    exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization P.primeCompl
  change ((algebraMap B C).comp (f.stalkMap y).hom).FormallyEtale
  exact hAB.comp hBC

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.stalkPrimeLocalization_formallyEtale_of_etale
statement:
theorem stalkPrimeLocalization_formallyEtale_of_etale
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y)
    (P : Ideal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) [P.IsPrime] :
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:=
      f.stalkPrimeLocalizationAlgebra y P
    Algebra.FormallyEtale (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
      (Localization.AtPrime P) := by
  exact f.stalkPrimeLocalization_ringHom_formallyEtale_of_etale y P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.stalkPrimeLocalization_essFiniteType_of_etale
statement:
theorem stalkPrimeLocalization_essFiniteType_of_etale
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y)
    (P : Ideal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) [P.IsPrime] :
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:=
      f.stalkPrimeLocalizationAlgebra y P
    Algebra.EssFiniteType (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
      (Localization.AtPrime P) := by
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk (f y)
  let B := Y.presheaf.stalk y
  let C := Localization.AtPrime P
  have hAB : (f.stalkMap y).hom.EssFiniteType :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap f y
  have hBC : (algebraMap B C).EssFiniteType := by
    rw [RingHom.essFiniteType_algebraMap]
    exact Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization C P.primeCompl
  change ((algebraMap B C).comp (f.stalkMap y).hom).EssFiniteType
  exact hAB.comp hBC

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.stalkPrimeLocalization_etale_of_finitePresentation
statement:
theorem stalkPrimeLocalization_etale_of_finitePresentation
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [Etale f] (y : Y)
    (P : Ideal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) [P.IsPrime]
    (hfp :
      letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Localization.AtPrime P) :=
        f.stalkPrimeLocalizationAlgebra y P
      Algebra.FinitePresentation (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
        (Localization.AtPrime P)) :
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:=
      f.stalkPrimeLocalizationAlgebra y P
    Algebra.Etale (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
      (Localization.AtPrime P) := by
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk (f y)
  let B := Y.presheaf.stalk y
  let C := Localization.AtPrime P
  let phi := (algebraMap B C).comp (f.stalkMap y).hom
  change phi.Etale
  exact @Algebra.Etale.mk A C _ _ phi.toAlgebra
    (f.stalkPrimeLocalization_ringHom_formallyEtale_of_etale y P) hfp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (x : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    x ∈ puncturedSpectrumOpen R ↔ x ≠ closedPoint R
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ ({closedPoint R}ᶜ : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) ↔
    x ≠ closedPoint R
  exact Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem puncturedSpectrum_nonempty_of_one_le_ringKrullDim
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (hdim : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R) :
    Nonempty (puncturedSpectrum R)
proof:
:= by
  have hmaximal : maximalIdeal R ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hmaximal
    have hdimZero : ringKrullDim R = 0 := by
      rw [← maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim, hmaximal,
        Ideal.height_bot]
      rfl
    rw [hdimZero] at hdim
    exact (not_le_of_gt (by norm_num : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < 1)) hdim
  let η : PrimeSpectrum R := ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩
  have hη : η ≠ closedPoint R := by
    intro h
    apply hmaximal
    exact (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h).symm
  exact ⟨⟨η, (mem_puncturedSpectrumOpen_iff R η).2 hη⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIntegral_of_connected_of_isDomain_stalk
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_connected_of_isDomain_stalk
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [ConnectedSpace X]
    (hdom : ∀ x : X, IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)) : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty X)
  let Z : Set X := irreducibleComponent x
  have hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents X := irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents x
  have hclopen : IsClopen Z :=
    ⟨isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ,
      Scheme.isOpen_irreducibleComponent_of_isDomain_stalk X hdom Z hZ⟩
  have hZuniv : Z = Set.univ := hclopen.eq_univ hZ.1.1
  let : IrreducibleSpace X :=
    { isPreirreducible_univ := hZuniv ▸ hZ.1.2, toNonempty := ⟨x⟩ }
  let (x : X) : _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) := hdom x
    infer_instance
  let : IsReduced X := isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk X
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced X

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk
    {U S : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ S) [Smooth f]
    [IsAffine S] [IsDomain Γ(S, ⊤)] [IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(S, ⊤)] (y : U) :
    IsDomain (U.presheaf.stalk y) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (U.presheaf.stalk y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hyW, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := U) (x := y) (U := ⊤) trivial
  have hle : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := fun _ _ ↦ trivial
  let _ : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(U, W) := (f.appLE ⊤ W hle).hom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra.Smooth Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(U, W) := Smooth.smooth_appLE f (isAffineOpen_top S) hW hle
  let _ : Algebra Γ(U, W) (U.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk U.presheaf (⟨y, hyW⟩ : W)
  let _ : IsLocalization.AtPrime (U.presheaf.stalk y) (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal :=
    hW.isLocalization_stalk ⟨y, hyW⟩
  exact (open _root_.Algebra.Smooth in
    isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime
      Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(U, W)
      (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal (U.presheaf.stalk y))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.isRegularLocalRing_stalk
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.isRegularLocalRing_stalk
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)}
    [Smooth f] (x : X) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hxV, hle, hstd⟩ :=
    Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth (f := f) x
  have hfxU : f.base x ∈ U := hle hxV
  obtain rfl : U = ⊤ := top_le_iff.mp fun y _ => by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim y (f.base x)]; exact hfxU
  let e : k ≃+* Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of k), ⊤) :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let ψ : k →+* Γ(X, V) := (f.appLE ⊤ V hle).hom.comp e.toRingHom
  have hψ : ψ.IsStandardSmooth :=
    RingHom.isStandardSmooth_respectsIso.2 _ e hstd
  let : Algebra k Γ(X, V) := ψ.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k Γ(X, V) :=
    (RingHom.isStandardSmooth_algebraMap).mp hψ
  have hreg : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal) :=
    isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime_of_isStandardSmooth k Γ(X, V)
      (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal
  let : Algebra Γ(X, V) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV).hom.toAlgebra
  have := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal) (X.presheaf.stalk x)).toRingEquiv
