name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberι_genericPoint_eq_genericPoint
statement:
theorem Scheme.Hom.fiberι_genericPoint_eq_genericPoint
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hη : f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y)
    [IsIntegral (f.fiber (genericPoint Y))] :
    f.fiberι (genericPoint Y) (genericPoint (f.fiber (genericPoint Y))) =
      genericPoint X
proof:
:= by
  let E : Set X := f ⁻¹' {genericPoint Y}
  let a : E := ⟨genericPoint X, hη⟩
  have ha : IsGenericPoint a (Set.univ : Set E) := by
    rw [isGenericPoint_def]
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    rw [closure_subtype, Set.image_singleton]
    change (y : X) ∈ closure ({genericPoint X} : Set X)
    rw [genericPoint_spec X]
    trivial
  have hgeneric :=
    ha.image (f.fiberHomeo (genericPoint Y)).symm.continuous
  have hgeneric' : IsGenericPoint
      ((f.fiberHomeo (genericPoint Y)).symm a)
      (Set.univ : Set (f.fiber (genericPoint Y))) := by
    simpa only [Set.image_univ, EquivLike.range_eq_univ, closure_univ]
      using hgeneric
  have heq :
      (f.fiberHomeo (genericPoint Y)).symm a =
        genericPoint (f.fiber (genericPoint Y)) :=
    hgeneric'.eq (genericPoint_spec (f.fiber (genericPoint Y)))
  rw [← heq]
  exact f.fiberι_fiberHomeo_symm (genericPoint Y) a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSMulRegular_restrict_of_affine
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_restrict_of_affine
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens)
    (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hr : r ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    IsSMulRegular Γ(X, U)
      ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op) r)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
  intro s hs
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext X.sheaf U s 0
  intro p hp
  let htop := isAffineOpen_top X
  let : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) (X.presheaf.stalk p) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (U := ⊤) ⟨p, trivial⟩
  let : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk p)
      (htop.primeIdealOf ⟨p, trivial⟩).asIdeal :=
    htop.isLocalization_stalk ⟨p, trivial⟩
  have hrp : X.presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial r ∈
      nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk p) :=
    IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap
      (htop.primeIdealOf ⟨p, trivial⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk p) hr
  have hz : X.presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial r *
      X.presheaf.germ U p hp s = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ U p hp) hs
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, map_zero, X.presheaf.germ_res_apply] using h
  rw [map_zero]
  exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left.mp hrp _ hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrict_basicOpen_injective_of_affine
statement:
theorem restrict_basicOpen_injective_of_affine
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsCompact U.1) (hU' : IsQuasiSeparated U.1)
    (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hr : r ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    Function.Injective
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le
        ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op) r))).op)
proof:
:= by
  let rU : Γ(X, U) := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op) r
  let : IsLocalization.Away rU Γ(X, X.basicOpen rU) :=
    isLocalization_basicOpen_of_qcqs hU hU' rU
  have hregular : IsSMulRegular Γ(X, U) rU :=
    isSMulRegular_restrict_of_affine X U r hr
  have hmem : rU ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, U) :=
    mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left.mpr fun s hs =>
      hregular.right_eq_zero_of_smul hs
  exact IsLocalization.injective Γ(X, X.basicOpen rU)
    (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hmem)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_stalkMap_SpecMap_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem isIso_stalkMap_SpecMap_of_isLocalization
    {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (M : Submonoid R)
    [Algebra R S] [IsLocalization M S]
    (x : PrimeSpectrum S) :
    IsIso ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).stalkMap x)
proof:
:= by
  erw [← Scheme.localRingHom_comp_stalkIso,
    ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  dsimp
  let T := Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal
  let p := x.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)
  let : IsLocalization.AtPrime T p :=
    IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      M T x.asIdeal
  let e : Localization.AtPrime p ≃ₐ[R] T :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv p.primeCompl _ _
  have heq :
      Localization.localRingHom p x.asIdeal (algebraMap R S) rfl =
        e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext p.primeCompl
    ext r
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, Localization.localRingHom_to_map]
    change (algebraMap S T) ((algebraMap R S) r) =
      e ((algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p)) r)
    rw [e.commutes r]
    exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S T r).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Spec.stalkIso S x).inv).comp
      (e.bijective.comp
        (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
          (Spec.stalkIso R (x.comap (algebraMap R S))).hom))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.isIso_fromSpecStalk_stalkMap
statement:
theorem IsAffineOpen.isIso_fromSpecStalk_stalkMap
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (p : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    IsIso ((hU.fromSpecStalk hx).stalkMap p)
proof:
:= by
  erw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpecStalk, Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
  let : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom.toAlgebra
  let := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hlocal : IsIso
      ((Spec.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx)).stalkMap p) :=
    isIso_stalkMap_SpecMap_of_isLocalization
      (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl p
  have hopen : IsIso
      (hU.fromSpec.stalkMap ((Spec.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx)) p)) :=
    inferInstance
  exact @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _
    (hU.fromSpec.stalkMap ((Spec.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx)) p))
    ((Spec.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx)).stalkMap p) hopen hlocal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_stalkIsoLocalization_fromSpecStalk
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_stalkIsoLocalization_fromSpecStalk :
    Spec.map (hU.stalkIsoLocalization p).hom ≫ X.fromSpecStalk (hU.fromSpec p) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))) ≫
        hU.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsAffineOpen.stalkIsoLocalization, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Spec.map_comp,
    Category.assoc, Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk,
    ← Category.assoc, Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq, ← Spec.map_comp]
  have hbase : CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
        (Spec.stalkIso Γ(X, U) p).inv =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv ≫ (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial :=
    Spec.algebraMap_stalkIso_inv (R := Γ(X, U)) p
  have h : ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv ≫
      (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial) ≫ (Spec.stalkIso Γ(X, U) p).hom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) :=
    (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (Spec.stalkIso Γ(X, U) p).hom) hbase.symm).trans
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
        ((congrArg (fun k => CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫ k)
            (Iso.inv_hom_id (Spec.stalkIso Γ(X, U) p))).trans (Category.comp_id _)))
  exact congrArg (fun k => Spec.map k ≫ hU.fromSpec) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affinePullbackSectionsTensorEquiv_one_tmul
statement:
theorem affinePullbackSectionsTensorEquiv_one_tmul :
    let : Algebra Γ(S, U) Γ(T, V)
proof:
:= (g.appLE U V hVU).hom.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra Γ(S, U) Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra Γ(T, V) Γ(pullback f g, pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
      ((pullback.snd f g).app V).hom.toAlgebra
    ∀ x : Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U),
      affinePullbackSectionsTensorEquiv f g hU hV hVU (1 ⊗ₜ[Γ(S, U)] x) =
        (pullback.fst f g).appLE _ _ (by
          rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, pullback.condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
          exact Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ hVU) x := by
  intro hRT hRX hTP x
  have hOpen : pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V =
      pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, pullback.condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
      ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf, inf_eq_right.mpr hVU]
  have hSourceSection := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_flat_right
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g) hVU le_rfl (UY := pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    hOpen
    hU hV (f.isCompact_preimage hU.isCompact) (f.isQuasiSeparated_preimage hU.isQuasiSeparated)
  change (CommRingCat.ofHom Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom ≫
    ((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct Γ(S, U) Γ(T, V) Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).flip.isoPushout ≪≫
      (pushout.congrHom f.app_eq_appLE rfl ≪≫ asIso _)).hom) x = _
  congr 2
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,
    IsPushout.inl_isoPushout_hom_assoc, pushout.congrHom_hom,
    pushout.inl_desc_assoc, Category.id_comp, pushout.inl_desc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.fpqc_SpecMap_pullback_fst_appTop
proof:
:= by

    (isPushout_appTop_of_flat f g)
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_geometricPoint_of_isIso_stalkMap
statement:
private theorem exists_geometricPoint_of_isIso_stalkMap
    {X U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] (h : V ⟶ U) (v : V)
    [IsIso (h.stalkMap v)] (η : X) (hv : f (h v) = η)
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (a : X.residueField η ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω) :
    ∃ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ V,
      t (closedPoint Ω) = v ∧
      t ≫ h ≫ f = Spec.map a ≫ X.fromSpecResidueField η
proof:
:= by
  subst η
  let : Algebra (X.residueField (f (h v))) (U.residueField (h v)) :=
    (f.residueFieldMap (h v)).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (X.residueField (f (h v))) Ω := a.hom.toAlgebra
  let b : U.residueField (h v) →ₐ[X.residueField (f (h v))] Ω := IsAlgClosed.lift
  have hb : f.residueFieldMap (h v) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom b.toRingHom = a := by
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    exact b.comp_algebraMap
  let : IsIso (h.residueFieldMap v) :=
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv
      (asIso (h.stalkMap v)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).toCommRingCatIso.isIso_hom
  let c : V.residueField v ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω :=
    inv (h.residueFieldMap v) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom b.toRingHom
  have hc : h.residueFieldMap v ≫ c = CommRingCat.ofHom b.toRingHom := by
    exact IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _
  refine ⟨Spec.map c ≫ V.fromSpecResidueField v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact V.fromSpecResidueField_apply v _
  · calc
      (Spec.map c ≫ V.fromSpecResidueField v) ≫ h ≫ f =
          Spec.map c ≫ Spec.map (h.residueFieldMap v) ≫
            U.fromSpecResidueField (h v) ≫ f := by
        rw [Category.assoc, ← h.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField_assoc]
      _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom b.toRingHom) ≫
          U.fromSpecResidueField (h v) ≫ f := by
        rw [← Spec.map_comp_assoc, hc]
      _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom b.toRingHom) ≫
          Spec.map (f.residueFieldMap (h v)) ≫
            X.fromSpecResidueField (f (h v)) := by
        rw [← f.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField]
      _ = Spec.map a ≫ X.fromSpecResidueField (f (h v)) := by
        rw [← Spec.map_comp_assoc]
        exact congrArg (fun k : X.residueField (f (h v)) ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω =>
          Spec.map k ≫ X.fromSpecResidueField (f (h v))) hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_geometricPoint_localized_stalk
statement:
theorem exists_geometricPoint_localized_stalk
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] (u : U)
    (M : Submonoid (U.presheaf.stalk u)) (S : Type u) [CommRing S]
    [Algebra (U.presheaf.stalk u) S] [IsLocalization M S]
    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of S)) (η : X)
    (hq : f (U.fromSpecStalk u
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) S))) q)) = η)
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (a : X.residueField η ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω) :
    ∃ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of S),
      t (closedPoint Ω) = q ∧
      t ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) S)) ≫
        U.fromSpecStalk u ≫ f = Spec.map a ≫ X.fromSpecResidueField η
proof:
:= by
  let l : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶ Spec (U.presheaf.stalk u) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) S))
  let : IsIso (l.stalkMap q) := isIso_stalkMap_SpecMap_of_isLocalization M q
  let : IsIso ((U.fromSpecStalk u).stalkMap (l q)) :=
    U.isIso_fromSpecStalk_stalkMap u (l q)
  let : IsIso ((l ≫ U.fromSpecStalk u).stalkMap q) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
    exact ((asIso ((U.fromSpecStalk u).stalkMap (l q))) ≪≫
      asIso (l.stalkMap q)).isIso_hom
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hcomm⟩ := exists_geometricPoint_of_isIso_stalkMap
    f (l ≫ U.fromSpecStalk u) q η hq Ω a
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg (fun k : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶ X => t ≫ k)
    (Category.assoc l (U.fromSpecStalk u) f)).symm.trans hcomm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_geometricPoint_localized_chart_branch
statement:
theorem exists_geometricPoint_localized_chart_branch
    {X U : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] (u : U)
    (q : Spec (U.presheaf.stalk u)) (P : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) [P.IsPrime]
    (hqP : q.asIdeal ≤ P) (η : X) (hqη : f (U.fromSpecStalk u q) = η)
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (a : X.residueField η ⟶ CommRingCat.of Ω) :
    ∃ t : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime P)),
      (t (closedPoint Ω)).asIdeal =
        q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P)) ∧
      t ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P))) ≫
        U.fromSpecStalk u ≫ f = Spec.map a ≫ X.fromSpecResidueField η
proof:
:= by
  let : q.asIdeal.IsPrime := q.isPrime
  let Q : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime P)) :=
    ⟨q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P)),
      Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hqP⟩
  have hQ : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P)))) Q = q := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    exact Ideal.under_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P hqP
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hcomm⟩ := exists_geometricPoint_localized_stalk
    f u P.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P) Q η (by rw [hQ]; exact hqη) Ω a
  exact ⟨t, congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal ht, hcomm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPushout_appTop_of_flat
statement:
theorem isPushout_appTop_of_flat :
    IsPushout f.appTop g.appTop (pullback.fst f g).appTop
      (pullback.snd f g).appTop
proof:
:= by
  have hX : IsCompact (⊤ : X.Opens).1 :=
    f.isCompact_preimage (isAffineOpen_top S).isCompact
  have hX' : IsQuasiSeparated (⊤ : X.Opens).1 :=
    f.isQuasiSeparated_preimage (isAffineOpen_top S).isQuasiSeparated
  have hTop : (⊤ : (pullback f g).Opens) =
      pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_flat_right
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g) (show (⊤ : T.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ from le_top)
    (show (⊤ : X.Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ from le_top) hTop
    (isAffineOpen_top S) (isAffineOpen_top T) hX hX'
  have hp := (isIso_pushoutSection_iff (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g)
    (show (⊤ : T.Opens) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ from le_top)
    (show (⊤ : X.Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ from le_top) hTop).mp h
  have hf : f.appTop = f.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top := f.app_eq_appLE
  have hg : g.appTop = g.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top := g.app_eq_appLE
  have hl : (pullback.fst f g).appTop =
      (pullback.fst f g).appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top := (pullback.fst f g).app_eq_appLE
  have hr : (pullback.snd f g).appTop =
      (pullback.snd f g).appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top := (pullback.snd f g).app_eq_appLE
  rw [hf, hg, hl, hr]
  exact hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_toSpecΓ_of_flat
statement:
theorem isPullback_toSpecΓ_of_flat :
    IsPullback (pullback f g).toSpecΓ (pullback.fst f g)
      (Spec.map (pullback.fst f g).appTop) X.toSpecΓ
proof:
:= by
  have hSpec := isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout f.appTop g.appTop
    (pullback.fst f g).appTop (pullback.snd f g).appTop
    (isPushout_appTop_of_flat f g)
  have hOuter : IsPullback
      ((pullback f g).toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (pullback.snd f g).appTop)
      (pullback.fst f g) (Spec.map g.appTop) (X.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map f.appTop) := by
    refine (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g).flip.of_iso
      (Iso.refl _) T.isoSpec (Iso.refl _) S.isoSpec ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · change pullback.snd f g ≫ T.toSpecΓ =
        𝟙 _ ≫ ((pullback f g).toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (pullback.snd f g).appTop)
      rw [Category.id_comp]
      exact Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality (pullback.snd f g)
    · exact (Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm
    · exact Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality g
    · change f ≫ S.toSpecΓ = 𝟙 _ ≫ (X.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map f.appTop)
      rw [Category.id_comp]
      exact Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality f
  exact hOuter.of_right (Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality (pullback.fst f g)).symm hSpec.flip

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_restrict_eq_pow_mul_of_basicOpen_le
statement:
theorem exists_restrict_eq_pow_mul_of_basicOpen_le
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsCompact U.1) (hU' : IsQuasiSeparated U.1)
    (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hr : r ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, ⊤))
    (hRU : X.basicOpen r ≤ U) (s : Γ(X, U)) :
    ∃ (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ),
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op a =
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op r) ^ n * s
proof:
:= by
  let f : Γ(X, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X, U) := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
  let rU : Γ(X, U) := f r
  let D := X.basicOpen rU
  let j : Γ(X, U) ⟶ Γ(X, D) :=
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le rU)).op
  let k : Γ(X, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X, D) := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
  have hD : D = X.basicOpen r := by
    exact (X.basicOpen_res r (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op).trans
      (inf_eq_right.mpr hRU)
  let : Algebra Γ(X, ⊤) Γ(X, D) := k.hom.toAlgebra
  let : IsLocalization.Away r Γ(X, D) :=
    (isAffineOpen_top X).isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen r (homOfLE le_top) hD
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj r (j s)
  have hcomp : f ≫ j = k := by
    dsimp only [f, j, k]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  have hcomp_apply (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) : j (f a) = k a :=
    congrArg (fun t : Γ(X, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X, D) => t a) hcomp
  refine ⟨a, n, ?_⟩
  apply restrict_basicOpen_injective_of_affine X U hU hU' r hr
  change j (f a) = j (rU ^ n * s)
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, hcomp_apply, show j rU = k r from hcomp_apply r]
  exact ha.symm.trans (mul_comm _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrict_bijective_of_primePair
statement:
theorem restrict_bijective_of_primePair
    {R : Type v} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
    [Algebra R Γ(X, ⊤)] [Module.Flat R Γ(X, ⊤)]
    {x y : R} (hx : Prime x) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hxy : ¬x ∣ y)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact U.1) (hU' : IsQuasiSeparated U.1)
    (hxU : X.basicOpen (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) x) ≤ U)
    (hyU : X.basicOpen (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) y) ≤ U) :
    Function.Bijective (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op)
proof:
:= by
  let res : Γ(X, ⊤) →+* Γ(X, U) :=
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op).hom
  let : Algebra R Γ(X, U) := (res.comp (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤))).toAlgebra
  let f : Γ(X, ⊤) →ₐ[R] Γ(X, U) := { res with commutes' := fun _ => rfl }
  have hregular {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
      algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) r ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, ⊤) := by
    refine mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_left.mpr fun s hs => ?_
    apply (IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero hr : IsSMulRegular Γ(X, ⊤) r).right_eq_zero_of_smul
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using hs
  have hxf : IsSMulRegular Γ(X, U) x := by
    have h := isSMulRegular_restrict_of_affine X U
      (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) x) (hregular hx.ne_zero)
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro s hs
    exact h.right_eq_zero_of_smul hs
  have hfi : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b hab
    apply IsLocalization.injective Γ(X, X.basicOpen (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) x))
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (hregular hx.ne_zero))
    have h := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hxU).op) hab
    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hxU).op) (res a) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hxU).op) (res b) at h
    have hcomp : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op ≫
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hxU).op =
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show X.basicOpen (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) x) ≤ ⊤
          from le_top)).op := by
      rw [← Functor.map_comp]
      congr 1
    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op) a =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op) b
    simpa only [res, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, hcomp] using h
  have hpow {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0)
      (hrU : X.basicOpen (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) r) ≤ U) :
      ∀ s : Γ(X, U), ∃ (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ), f a = r ^ n • s := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨a, n, ha⟩ := exists_restrict_eq_pow_mul_of_basicOpen_le X U hU hU'
      (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) r) (hregular hr) hrU s
    refine ⟨a, n, ?_⟩
    change res a = (res (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤) r)) ^ n * s at ha
    change res a = algebraMap R Γ(X, U) (r ^ n) * s
    rw [map_pow]
    exact ha
  let F := FractionRing R
  let Ax := Localization.subalgebra.ofField F (Submonoid.powers x)
    (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx.ne_zero))
  let Ay := Localization.subalgebra.ofField F (Submonoid.powers y)
    (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy))
  have hfx : Function.Bijective (f.toLinearMap.rTensor Ax) := by
    let : Module.Flat R Ax := IsLocalization.flat Ax (Submonoid.powers x)
    exact ⟨Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap f.toLinearMap hfi,
      SchemeTheory.rTensor_surjective_of_pow_smul_mem_range Ax x f.toLinearMap
        (hpow hx.ne_zero hxU)⟩
  have hfy : Function.Bijective (f.toLinearMap.rTensor Ay) := by
    let : Module.Flat R Ay := IsLocalization.flat Ay (Submonoid.powers y)
    exact ⟨Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap f.toLinearMap hfi,
      SchemeTheory.rTensor_surjective_of_pow_smul_mem_range Ay y f.toLinearMap
        (hpow hy hyU)⟩
  exact SchemeTheory.linearMap_bijective_of_tensor_primeAwayPair F hx hy hxy hxf
    f.toLinearMap hfx hfy

name: AlgHom.exists_quotient_factor_and_awayMap_bijective
statement:
theorem exists_quotient_factor_and_awayMap_bijective
    {R A B D : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (I : Ideal R)
    [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom))]
    [Algebra (R ⧸ I) D] [Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) D]
    (p : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B) →ₐ[R ⧸ I] D)
    [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom p.toRingHom))] :
    ∃ e : A ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R A), IsIdempotentElem e ∧
      ∃ E : (A ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R A)) ≃ₐ[R ⧸ I]
          D × ((A ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R A)) ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}),
        (∀ x, (E x).1 = p (f.quotientBaseChange I x)) ∧
        (∀ x, (E x).2 = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) x) ∧
        ∃ g : A, Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R A)) g = 1 - e ∧
          E (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R A)) g) = (1, 0) ∧
          Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap f.toRingHom g)
proof:
:= by
  let JA : Ideal A := I.map (algebraMap R A)
  let JB : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  let h : A ⧸ JA →ₐ[R ⧸ I] D := p.comp (f.quotientBaseChange I)
  have : IsOpenImmersion
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (f.quotientBaseChange I).toRingHom)) :=
    isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientBaseChange f I
  have : IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom h.toRingHom)) := by
    change IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (f.quotientBaseChange I).toRingHom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom p.toRingHom))
    rw [Spec.map_comp]
    infer_instance
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective h := h.surjective_of_finite_of_isOpenImmersion
  obtain ⟨e, he, hker, E, hE₁, hE₂⟩ :=
    h.exists_prod_quotient_equiv_of_isOpenImmersion hsurj
  let U : Opens (PrimeSpectrum A) := (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)).opensRange
  have hrange : Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap h.toRingHom) =
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (1 - e) : Set (PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ JA))) := by
    rw [range_comap_of_surjective D h.toRingHom hsurj, hker,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_span, PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_eq_basicOpen_of_isIdempotentElem e he]
  have hU : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (1 - e) ≤ Opens.comap
      ⟨PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk JA),
        PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk JA)⟩ U := by
    intro x hx
    have hxrange : x ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap h.toRingHom) := by
      rw [hrange]
      exact hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hxrange
    change PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk JA) x ∈
      Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap f.toRingHom)
    refine ⟨PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk JB)
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap p.toRingHom y), ?_⟩
    rw [← hy]
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    apply Ideal.ext
    intro a
    change p (Ideal.Quotient.mk JB (f a)) ∈ y.asIdeal ↔
      h (Ideal.Quotient.mk JA a) ∈ y.asIdeal
    rfl
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgU⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.exists_lift_idempotent_basicOpen_le
    JA (1 - e) he.one_sub U hU
  have hezero : h e = 0 := by
    have heker : e ∈ RingHom.ker h.toRingHom := by
      rw [hker]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr rfl)
    exact heker
  refine ⟨e, he, E, hE₁, hE₂, g, hg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Prod.ext
    · rw [hE₁, hg, map_sub, map_one, hezero, sub_zero]
    · rw [hE₂, hg]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
        (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr rfl))
  · exact bijective_awayMap_of_basicOpen_le_opensRange
      (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) g hgU

name: AlgHom.map_extendedIdeal
statement:
theorem map_extendedIdeal (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map (algebraMap R A)).map f.toRingHom = I.map (algebraMap R B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_map]
  congr 1
  ext r
  exact f.commutes r

name: AlgHom.quotientBaseChange_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientBaseChange_mk (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (I : Ideal R) (a : A) :
    f.quotientBaseChange I (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R A)) a) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) (f a)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgHom.quotientBaseChange_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem quotientBaseChange_tensorProduct (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (I : Ideal R) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor B I).toAlgHom.comp
        (f.quotientBaseChange I) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)) f).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor A I).toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgHom.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  change (1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] f a =
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)) f ((1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] a)
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one]

name: LinearMap.exists_monic_aeval_eq_zero_map_eq_prod_of_residual_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_monic_aeval_eq_zero_map_eq_prod_of_residual_diagonal
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Fintype ι]
    (I : Ideal R) (f : Module.End R M) (v : ι → M)
    (hv : Submodule.span R (Set.range v) = ⊤) (d : ι → R)
    (hres : ∀ j, f (v j) - d j • v j ∈ I • (⊤ : Submodule R M)) :
    ∃ p : R[X], p.Monic ∧ aeval f p = 0 ∧
      p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) =
        ∏ j, (X - C (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (d j)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmem (j : ι) : f (v j) - d j • v j ∈
      LinearMap.range (Ideal.finsuppTotal ι M I v) := by
    rw [Ideal.range_finsuppTotal, hv]
    exact hres j
  choose c hc using hmem
  have hsum (j : ι) : ∑ i, (c j i : R) • v i = f (v j) - d j • v j := by
    simpa only [Ideal.finsuppTotal_apply_eq_of_fintype] using hc j
  let A : Matrix ι ι R :=
    Matrix.diagonal d + Matrix.of (fun i j => (c j i : R))
  have hA : A.Represents v f := by
    rw [Matrix.represents_iff']
    intro j
    change (∑ i, ((if i = j then d i else 0) + (c j i : R)) • v i) = f (v j)
    simp only [add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ite_smul, zero_smul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    rw [hsum j, add_sub_cancel]
  let A' : Matrix.isRepresentation R v := ⟨A, f, hA⟩
  have hEnd : Matrix.isRepresentation.toEnd R v hv A' = f :=
    Matrix.isRepresentation.eq_toEnd_of_represents R v hv A' hA
  have hchar : aeval f A.charpoly = 0 := by
    rw [← hEnd, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply,
      ← map_zero (Matrix.isRepresentation.toEnd R v hv)]
    congr 1
    ext1
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_subalgebra_coe, Matrix.aeval_self_charpoly, Subalgebra.coe_zero]
  have hAmap : A.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Ideal.Quotient.mk I (d i)) := by
    ext i j
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (Matrix.diagonal d i j + (c j i : R)) = _
    rw [map_add, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (c j i).property, add_zero]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp only [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq]
    · simp [hij]
  refine ⟨A.charpoly, A.charpoly_monic, hchar, ?_⟩
  rw [← Matrix.charpoly_map, hAmap, Matrix.charpoly_diagonal]

@[simp]
lemma _root_.AlgHom.equalizerRestrictScalars_apply [Algebra S A] [Algebra S B]
    [IsScalarTower R S A] [IsScalarTower R S B]
    (f g : A →ₐ[S] B) (x) :
    AlgHom.equalizerRestrictScalars R f g x = x

name: SchemeTheory.fractionFieldTensorSubalgebraHom_bijective
statement:
private theorem fractionFieldTensorSubalgebraHom_bijective (B : Subalgebra R K) :
    Function.Bijective (fractionFieldTensorSubalgebraHom R K B)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Flat R K := IsLocalization.flat K (nonZeroDivisors R)
  let e : K ⊗[R] K ≃ₐ[K] K := IsLocalization.algebraLid (nonZeroDivisors R) K K
  have hcomp (a : K ⊗[R] B) :
      e (B.val.toLinearMap.lTensor K a) = fractionFieldTensorSubalgebraHom R K B a := by
    induction a using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul k b => rfl
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    apply Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := K)
      B.val.toLinearMap Subtype.val_injective
    apply e.injective
    exact (hcomp a).trans (hab.trans (hcomp b).symm)
  · intro k
    refine ⟨k ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B), ?_⟩
    change k * ((1 : B) : K) = k
    exact mul_one k

name: SchemeTheory.fractionFieldTensorSubalgebraEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fractionFieldTensorSubalgebraEquiv_tmul
    (B : Subalgebra R K) (k : K) (b : B) :
    fractionFieldTensorSubalgebraEquiv R K B (k ⊗ₜ[R] b) = k * (b : K)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeTheory.trace_baseChange_lmul_subalgebra
statement:
theorem trace_baseChange_lmul_subalgebra (B : Subalgebra R K) (b : B) :
    LinearMap.trace K (K ⊗[R] B) ((Algebra.lmul R B b).baseChange K) = (b : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.baseChange_lmul]
  change Algebra.trace K (K ⊗[R] B) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b) = (b : K)
  rw [← Algebra.trace_eq_of_algEquiv (fractionFieldTensorSubalgebraEquiv R K B),
    fractionFieldTensorSubalgebraEquiv_tmul, one_mul, Algebra.trace_self_apply]

name: SchemeTheory.exists_finite_residue_geometricPoint
statement:
theorem exists_finite_residue_geometricPoint
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (B : Type v) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Module.Finite R B]
    (Q : Ideal B) [Q.IsMaximal] [Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)] :
    ∃ φ : B →+* AlgebraicClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R),
      RingHom.ker φ = Q ∧
      φ.comp (algebraMap R B) =
        (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (AlgebraicClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))).comp (IsLocalRing.residue R)
proof:
:= by
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure k
  let : Field (B ⧸ Q) := Ideal.Quotient.field Q
  let : Algebra k (B ⧸ Q) := Ideal.Quotient.algebraOfLiesOver Q (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
  have : IsScalarTower R k (B ⧸ Q) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.isScalarTower_of_liesOver R Q (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
  have : Module.Finite k (B ⧸ Q) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R k (B ⧸ Q)
  let e : (B ⧸ Q) →ₐ[k] Ω := IsAlgClosed.lift (R := k) (S := B ⧸ Q) (M := Ω)
  let φ : B →+* Ω := e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q)
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change RingHom.ker (e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q)) = Q
    rw [RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ e.injective]
    ext b
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem
  · apply RingHom.ext
    intro r
    change e (algebraMap B (B ⧸ Q) (algebraMap R B r)) =
      algebraMap k Ω (IsLocalRing.residue R r)
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R k (B ⧸ Q),
      e.commutes]
    rfl

name: SchemeTheory.genericTensorCancelRingEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem genericTensorCancelRingEquiv_tmul (k : K) (s : S) (b : B) :
    genericTensorCancelRingEquiv R K S B ((k ⊗ₜ[R] s) ⊗ₜ[K] b) =
      s ⊗ₜ[R] (k • b)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra S (K ⊗[R] S) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  change Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChangeAlg R S K (K ⊗[R] S) B
    ((k ⊗ₜ[R] s) ⊗ₜ[K] b) = s ⊗ₜ[R] (k • b)
  apply (Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChangeAlg R S K (K ⊗[R] S) B).symm.injective
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChangeAlg_symm_tmul]
  change ((k ⊗ₜ[R] s) ⊗ₜ[K] b) = ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] s) ⊗ₜ[K] (k • b)
  simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: SchemeTheory.genericTensorCancelRingEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
theorem genericTensorCancelRingEquiv_symm_tmul (s : S) (b : B) :
    (genericTensorCancelRingEquiv R K S B).symm (s ⊗ₜ[R] b) =
      ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] s) ⊗ₜ[K] b
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra S (K ⊗[R] S) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  exact Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChangeAlg_symm_tmul R S K (K ⊗[R] S) B s b

name: SchemeTheory.genericTensorSplitEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem genericTensorSplitEquiv_tmul (ι : Type v)
    (e : ((K ⊗[R] S) ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[K ⊗[R] S] (ι → K ⊗[R] S))
    (s : S) (b : B) (i : ι) :
    genericTensorSplitEquiv R K S B ι e (s ⊗ₜ[R] b) i =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R K S (e (((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] s) ⊗ₜ[K] b) i)
proof:
:= by
  change Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R K S
    (e ((genericTensorCancelRingEquiv R K S B).symm (s ⊗ₜ[R] b)) i) = _
  rw [genericTensorCancelRingEquiv_symm_tmul]

name: SchemeTheory.genericTensorSplitEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem genericTensorSplitEquiv_symm_apply (ι : Type v)
    (e : ((K ⊗[R] S) ⊗[K] B) ≃ₐ[K ⊗[R] S] (ι → K ⊗[R] S))
    (y : ι → S ⊗[R] K) :
    (genericTensorSplitEquiv R K S B ι e).symm y =
      genericTensorCancelRingEquiv R K S B
        (e.symm (fun i => Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R S K (y i)))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.FieldTheory.Proofs.Algebra_TensorProduct_isField_of_isSeparable_of_forall_isSeparable_mem_range.P2mSepClosedTensorField.natDegree_minpoly_eq
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_eq (hsc : ∀ y : F, IsSeparable k y → y ∈ (algebraMap k F).range)
    {β : M} (hβ : IsSeparable k β) :
    (minpoly F β).natDegree = (minpoly k β).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  set K₁ : IntermediateField k F := algebraicClosure k F with hK₁
  have : IsPurelyInseparable k K₁ := by
    rw [isPurelyInseparable_iff]
    intro x
    refine ⟨Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x, fun hx => ?_⟩
    have hx' : IsSeparable k (x : F) :=
      (isSeparable_map_iff K₁.val Subtype.val_injective).mpr hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hsc _ hx'
    refine ⟨c, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [← hc]
    rfl
  have h1 : (minpoly k β).map (algebraMap k K₁) = minpoly K₁ β :=
    minpoly.map_eq_of_isSeparable_of_isPurelyInseparable K₁ β hβ
  have hβi : IsIntegral k β := hβ.isIntegral
  have hβ1 : IsIntegral K₁ β := hβi.tower_top
  have hPm : (minpoly k β).Monic := minpoly.monic hβi
  have hQm : (minpoly F β).Monic := minpoly.monic hβi.tower_top
  have hdvd : minpoly F β ∣ (minpoly k β).map (algebraMap k F) :=
    minpoly.dvd_map_of_isScalarTower k F β
  have hlift : minpoly F β ∈ lifts (algebraMap K₁ F) := by
    rw [lifts_iff_coeff_lifts]
    intro n
    have h1 := integralClosure.mem_lifts_of_monic_of_dvd_map F hPm hQm hdvd
    rw [lifts_iff_coeff_lifts] at h1
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h1 n
    exact ⟨⟨(c : F), c.2⟩, hc⟩
  obtain ⟨Q₁, hQ₁, hdeg, hQ₁m⟩ := lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic hlift hQm
  have haeval : aeval β Q₁ = 0 := by
    rw [← aeval_map_algebraMap F β Q₁, hQ₁]
    exact minpoly.aeval F β
  have hd1 : (minpoly K₁ β).natDegree ≤ Q₁.natDegree :=
    natDegree_le_of_dvd (minpoly.dvd K₁ β haeval) hQ₁m.ne_zero
  have hd2 : (minpoly F β).natDegree ≤ (minpoly K₁ β).natDegree := by
    have := natDegree_le_of_dvd (minpoly.dvd_map_of_isScalarTower K₁ F β)
      ((minpoly.monic hβ1).map _).ne_zero
    rwa [natDegree_map] at this
  have h3 : (minpoly K₁ β).natDegree = (minpoly k β).natDegree := by
    rw [← h1, natDegree_map]
  omega

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.FieldTheory.Proofs.Algebra_TensorProduct_isField_of_isSeparable_of_forall_isSeparable_mem_range.P2mSepClosedTensorField.hsc_range
statement:
theorem hsc_range (hsc : ∀ y : F, IsSeparable k y → y ∈ (algebraMap k F).range)
    (y : fa.fieldRange) (hy : IsSeparable k y) : y ∈ (algebraMap k fa.fieldRange).range
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : IsSeparable k (fa.fieldRange.val y) :=
    (isSeparable_map_iff fa.fieldRange.val Subtype.val_injective).mpr hy
  obtain ⟨y, z, rfl⟩ := y
  have hz : IsSeparable k z := (isSeparable_map_iff fa fa.injective).mp h0
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hsc z hz
  refine ⟨c, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  change algebraMap k Ω c = fa z
  rw [← hc, fa.commutes]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.FieldTheory.Proofs.Algebra_TensorProduct_isField_of_isSeparable_of_forall_isSeparable_mem_range.P2mSepClosedTensorField.linearDisjoint_adjoin_singleton
statement:
theorem linearDisjoint_adjoin_singleton
    (hsc : ∀ y : F, IsSeparable k y → y ∈ (algebraMap k F).range)
    {x : Ω} (hx : IsSeparable k x) :
    fa.fieldRange.toSubalgebra.LinearDisjoint (Algebra.adjoin k {x})
proof:
:= by
  have hxi : IsIntegral k x := hx.isIntegral
  let pb := Algebra.adjoin.powerBasis hxi
  refine Subalgebra.LinearDisjoint.of_basis_right _ _ pb.basis ?_
  have hfam : ((Algebra.adjoin k {x}).val ∘ pb.basis : Fin pb.dim → Ω) =
      fun i : Fin pb.dim => x ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    funext i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, PowerBasis.coe_basis]
    rw [map_pow]
    congr 1
  rw [hfam]
  have hdim : pb.dim = (minpoly fa.fieldRange x).natDegree := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin.powerBasis_dim hxi,
      natDegree_minpoly_eq (k := k) (F := fa.fieldRange) (M := Ω) (hsc_range fa hsc) hx]
  have hli : LinearIndependent fa.fieldRange fun i : Fin (minpoly fa.fieldRange x).natDegree =>
      x ^ (i : ℕ) := linearIndependent_pow (K := fa.fieldRange) x
  rw [← hdim] at hli
  exact hli

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.FieldTheory.Proofs.Algebra_TensorProduct_isField_of_isSeparable_of_forall_isSeparable_mem_range.P2mSepClosedTensorField.exists_le_adjoin_singleton
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, s, hs⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := k) (M := B')
  have hpre : ∀ i, ∃ y : K, fb y = (s i : Ω) := fun i => hB' (s i).2
  choose y hy using hpre
  let S : Set K := Set.range y
  let K₀ : IntermediateField k K := IntermediateField.adjoin k S
  have : FiniteDimensional k K₀ :=
    IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin fun x _ => Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x
  have : Algebra.IsSeparable k K₀ := Algebra.isSeparable_tower_bot_of_isSeparable k K₀ K
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := Field.exists_primitive_element k K₀
  refine ⟨(α : K), ?_⟩
  have hK₀ : K₀ = k⟮(α : K)⟯ := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.lift_adjoin_simple k K₀ α, hα, IntermediateField.lift_top]
  have hβint : IsIntegral k (α : K) := Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _
  have hmem : ∀ i, (s i : Ω) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k {fb (α : K)} := by
    intro i
    have hyi : y i ∈ K₀ := IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k S ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [hK₀, ← IntermediateField.mem_toSubalgebra,
      IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic hβint.isAlgebraic] at hyi
    rw [← hy i, ← Set.image_singleton, Algebra.adjoin_image]
    exact Subalgebra.mem_map.mpr ⟨y i, hyi, rfl⟩
  intro t ht
  have ht' : (⟨t, ht⟩ : B') ∈ Submodule.span k (Set.range s) := by rw [hs]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  have himg : t ∈ (Submodule.span k (Set.range s)).map B'.val.toLinearMap :=
    ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, ht', rfl⟩
  rw [Submodule.map_span] at himg
  refine (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_ : Submodule.span k _ ≤
    Subalgebra.toSubmodule (Algebra.adjoin k {fb (α : K)})) himg
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact hmem i

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.FieldTheory.Proofs.Algebra_TensorProduct_isField_of_isSeparable_of_forall_isSeparable_mem_range.P2mSepClosedTensorField.linearDisjoint_range
statement:
theorem linearDisjoint_range [Algebra.IsSeparable k K]
    (hsc : ∀ y : F, IsSeparable k y → y ∈ (algebraMap k F).range) :
    fa.fieldRange.toSubalgebra.LinearDisjoint fb.range
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral k fb.range := by
    refine ⟨fun x => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨_, y, rfl⟩ := x
    exact (isIntegral_algHom_iff fb.range.val Subtype.val_injective).mp
      ((Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := k) y).map fb)
  refine Subalgebra.LinearDisjoint.of_linearDisjoint_finite_right _ _ fun B' hB' _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_le_adjoin_singleton fb B' hB'
  exact (linearDisjoint_adjoin_singleton fa hsc
    ((Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable k β).map fb fb.injective)).of_le_right_of_flat hβ

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.isField_of_isSeparable_of_forall_isSeparable_mem_range
statement:
theorem _root_.Algebra.TensorProduct.isField_of_isSeparable_of_forall_isSeparable_mem_range
    (k : Type u) (F : Type v) (K : Type w) [Field k] [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra k F]
    [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsSeparable k K]
    (hsc : ∀ y : F, IsSeparable k y → y ∈ (algebraMap k F).range) :
    IsField (F ⊗[k] K)
proof:
:= by
  apply IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.isField_of_forall
  intro Ω _ _ fa fb
  rw [IntermediateField.linearDisjoint_iff]
  have hr : (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (↥fb.fieldRange) Ω).range = fb.range := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨_, z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨fb z, z, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hr]
  exact linearDisjoint_range fa fb hsc

name: PrimeSpectrum.exists_tensorProduct_of_comap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_tensorProduct_of_comap_eq
    (R B C : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum B) (q : PrimeSpectrum C)
    (h : comap (algebraMap R B) p = comap (algebraMap R C) q) :
    ∃ r : PrimeSpectrum (B ⊗[R] C),
      comap (algebraMap B (B ⊗[R] C)) r = p ∧
        comap (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := B)).toRingHom r = q
proof:
:= by
  let f : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))
  let g : Spec (.of C) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R C))
  obtain ⟨z, hzB, hzC⟩ :=
    Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := f) (g := g) p q h
  refine ⟨(pullbackSpecIso R B C).hom z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (congrArg (fun k : pullback f g ⟶ Spec (.of B) ↦ k z)
      (pullbackSpecIso_hom_fst' R B C)).trans hzB
  · exact (congrArg (fun k : pullback f g ⟶ Spec (.of C) ↦ k z)
      (pullbackSpecIso_hom_snd R B C)).trans hzC

name: SchemeTheory.isLocalizationAway_fractionField_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
theorem isLocalizationAway_fractionField_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (a : R) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (ha : ¬ IsUnit a) :
    IsLocalization.Away a K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible R
  have hπa : π ∣ a := by
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp
    rw [← hπ.maximalIdeal_eq]
    exact ha
  have hcofinal : ∀ b ∈ nonZeroDivisors R,
      ∃ c ∈ Submonoid.powers a, b ∣ c := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.associated_pow_irreducible
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp hb) hπ
    exact ⟨a ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hn.dvd.trans (pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd hπa n)⟩
  exact (IsLocalization.iff_of_le_of_exists_dvd (S := K)
    (Submonoid.powers a) (nonZeroDivisors R)
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors ha0) hcofinal).mpr inferInstance

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.isDomain_of_isFractionRing_left_of_flat
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_isFractionRing_left_of_flat
    {R B F K : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra R B]
    [CommRing F] [Algebra R F] [Algebra B F] [IsScalarTower R B F]
    [IsFractionRing B F] [CommRing K] [Algebra R K]
    [Module.Flat R B] [IsDomain (B ⊗[R] K)]
    (hK : Function.Injective (algebraMap R K)) :
    IsDomain (F ⊗[R] K)
proof:
:= by
  let m : B ⊗[R] K →ₐ[R] F ⊗[R] K :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R B F) (AlgHom.id R K)
  let : Algebra (B ⊗[R] K) (F ⊗[R] K) := m.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower B (B ⊗[R] K) (F ⊗[R] K) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext b
    change algebraMap B F b ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : K) = m (b ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : K))
    simp only [m, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply,
      AlgHom.id_apply]
  have hmap : (algebraMap (B ⊗[R] K) (F ⊗[R] K)).comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom := by
    ext k
    change m ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] k) = (1 : F) ⊗ₜ[R] k
    simp only [m, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one, AlgHom.id_apply]
  let : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (B ⊗[R] K) (nonZeroDivisors B)) (F ⊗[R] K) :=
    IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct R K (nonZeroDivisors B) F hmap
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap B (B ⊗[R] K)) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_injective (S := R) (A := B) hK
  apply IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors
    (R := B ⊗[R] K)
    (M := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (B ⊗[R] K) (nonZeroDivisors B))
  rintro x ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero]
  intro hzero
  exact nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb (hinj (hzero.trans (map_zero _).symm))

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.isDomain_ratTensor_of_isFractionRing_intTensor
statement:
theorem isDomain_ratTensor_of_isFractionRing_intTensor
    {B F K : Type*} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Module.Flat ℤ B]
    [Field F] [CharZero F] [Algebra B F] [IsFractionRing B F]
    [Field K] [CharZero K] [IsDomain (B ⊗[ℤ] K)] :
    IsDomain (F ⊗[ℚ] K)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain (F ⊗[ℤ] K) :=
    isDomain_of_isFractionRing_left_of_flat
      (R := ℤ) (B := B) (F := F) (K := K) (Int.cast_injective (α := K))
  let e : F ⊗[ℚ] K ≃ₐ[ℚ] F ⊗[ℤ] K :=
    IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors ℤ) ℚ F K
  exact (MulEquiv.isDomain_iff e.toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv).mpr inferInstance

name: SchemeTheory.integralClosure_etale_of_split_localization_after_faithfullyFlat_etale
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_split_localization_after_faithfullyFlat_etale
    (R S B T : Type u) (ι : Type v)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing B] [CommRing T]
    [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R B] [Algebra S T]
    [Algebra.Etale R S] [Module.FaithfullyFlat R S] [Finite ι]
    (M : Submonoid S) (hM : M ≤ S⁰) [IsLocalization M T]
    (e : (S ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[S] (ι → T)) :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R B)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIntegrallyClosedIn S T :=
    isIntegrallyClosedIn_localization_of_normal_boundary M hM T
      (fun q _ _ => Algebra.Etale.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime
        R S q (Localization.AtPrime q))
  let eclosure : (S ⊗[R] integralClosure R B) ≃ₐ[S]
      integralClosure S (S ⊗[R] B) :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective (TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure R S B)
      TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure_bijective_of_smooth
  let esplit : (S ⊗[R] integralClosure R B) ≃ₐ[S] (ι → S) :=
    eclosure.trans (e.mapIntegralClosure.trans (integralClosureSplitProductEquiv S T ι))
  have : Algebra.Etale S (S ⊗[R] integralClosure R B) :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_equiv esplit.symm
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_etale_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat S

name: SchemeTheory.integralClosure_etale_of_split_after_faithfullyFlat_etale
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_split_after_faithfullyFlat_etale
    (R S B T : Type u) (ι : Type v)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing B] [CommRing T]
    [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R B] [Algebra S T]
    [Algebra.Etale R S] [Module.FaithfullyFlat R S] [Finite ι]
    (d : R) (hd : d ≠ 0) [IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R S d) T]
    (e : (S ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[S] (ι → T)) :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R B)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : IsLeftRegular (algebraMap R S d) := by
    change Function.Injective (fun x : S => algebraMap R S d * x)
    simpa only [IsSMulRegular, Algebra.smul_def] using
      (Module.Flat.isSMulRegular_of_isRegular (M := S) (IsRegular.of_ne_zero hd))
  have hdS : algebraMap R S d ∈ S⁰ := by
    have hr : IsRegular (algebraMap R S d) :=
      ⟨hleft, fun x y h => hleft ((mul_comm _ _).trans (h.trans (mul_comm _ _)))⟩
    exact hr.mem_nonZeroDivisors
  exact integralClosure_etale_of_split_localization_after_faithfullyFlat_etale
    R S B T ι (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R S d)) (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hdS) e

name: SchemeTheory.integralClosure_etale_of_generic_split_after_faithfullyFlat_etale
statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_generic_split_after_faithfullyFlat_etale
    (R S B : Type u) (ι : Type v)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing B] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra.Etale R S] [Module.FaithfullyFlat R S] [Finite ι]
    (e : (S ⊗[R] B) ≃ₐ[S] (ι → (S ⊗[R] FractionRing R))) :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R B)
proof:
:= by
  have hM : Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S R⁰ ≤ S⁰ := by
    rintro s ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    have hleft : IsLeftRegular (algebraMap R S r) := by
      change Function.Injective (fun x : S => algebraMap R S r * x)
      simpa only [IsSMulRegular, Algebra.smul_def] using
        (Module.Flat.isSMulRegular_of_nonZeroDivisors (M := S) hr)
    have hregular : IsRegular (algebraMap R S r) :=
      ⟨hleft, fun x y h => hleft ((mul_comm _ _).trans (h.trans (mul_comm _ _)))⟩
    exact hregular.mem_nonZeroDivisors
  exact integralClosure_etale_of_split_localization_after_faithfullyFlat_etale
    R S B (S ⊗[R] FractionRing R) ι (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S R⁰) hM e

name: Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobianLocalizationPresentation_dimension
statement:
lemma jacobianLocalizationPresentation_dimension [Finite ι] :

name: kmf2_fiber_input_of_standardSmooth_case
statement:
theorem kmf2_fiber_input_of_standardSmooth_case
    (hss : ∀ (k B : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing B] [Algebra k B],
        Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k B → ∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime],
          IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime q)) :
    SmoothFieldFiberRegularStalksInput.{u}
proof:
:= by
  intro k A _ _ _ hsm p hp
  have : Algebra.Smooth k A := hsm
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hstd⟩ := Algebra.IsSmoothAt.exists_notMem_isStandardSmooth k p
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Submonoid.powers f : Set A) (p : Set A) :=
    (Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime f).mpr hf
  have hq : (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f))).IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Localization.Away f) p hp hdisj
  have hcomap : (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f))).comap
      (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) = p :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Localization.Away f) hp hdisj
  have : IsRegularLocalRing
      (Localization.AtPrime (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)))) :=
    hss k (Localization.Away f) hstd (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)))
  have : IsLocalization p.primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)))) :=
    kmf2_fiber_isLocalization_primeCompl_congr hcomap _
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
    ((IsLocalization.algEquiv p.primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (Localization.AtPrime (p.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f))))).symm.toRingEquiv)

name: SmoothFieldFiberRegularStalks.eps_ne_zero
statement: theorem eps_ne_zero (K : Type*) [Field K] : (DualNumber.eps : DualNumber K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have h1 := congrArg TrivSqZeroExt.snd heq
  exact one_ne_zero h1

name: SmoothFieldFiberRegularStalks.nilradical_dualNumber_eq_span_eps
statement:
theorem nilradical_dualNumber_eq_span_eps (K : Type*) [Field K] :
    nilradical (DualNumber K) = Ideal.span {(DualNumber.eps : DualNumber K)}
proof:
:= by
  rcases DualNumber.ideal_trichotomy (nilradical (DualNumber K)) with h0 | h1 | h2
  · exfalso
    have hin : (DualNumber.eps : DualNumber K) ∈ nilradical (DualNumber K) :=
      mem_nilradical.mpr DualNumber.isNilpotent_eps
    rw [h0] at hin
    exact eps_ne_zero K (by simpa using hin)
  · exact h1
  · exfalso
    have hone : IsNilpotent (1 : DualNumber K) :=
      mem_nilradical.mp (h2 ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hone
    rw [one_pow] at hn
    exact one_ne_zero hn

name: SmoothFieldFiberRegularStalks.ringKrullDim_dualNumber_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_dualNumber_eq_zero (K : Type*) [Field K] :
    ringKrullDim (DualNumber K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : (nilradical (DualNumber K)).IsMaximal := by
    rw [nilradical_dualNumber_eq_span_eps K]
    exact DualNumber.isMaximal_span_singleton_eps
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (DualNumber K) :=
    Ring.KrullDimLE.of_isMaximal_nilradical (DualNumber K)
  exact ringKrullDimZero_iff_ringKrullDim_eq_zero.mp inferInstance

statement:

    ¬ IsRegularLocalRing (DualNumber K)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hspan := h.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
  rw [ringKrullDim_dualNumber_eq_zero K, spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_dualNumber_eq_one K]
    at hspan
  have h10 : (1 : ℕ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hspan
  exact one_ne_zero h10

name: SmoothFieldFiberRegularStalks.isField_of_isRegularLocalRing_of_krullDimLE_zero
statement:
theorem isField_of_isRegularLocalRing_of_krullDimLE_zero
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [Ring.KrullDimLE 0 R] [IsRegularLocalRing R] :
    IsField R
proof:
:= by
  have hspan := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
  rw [ringKrullDimZero_iff_ringKrullDim_eq_zero.mp ‹Ring.KrullDimLE 0 R›] at hspan
  have h0 : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hspan
  exact IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mpr
    ((Submodule.spanFinrank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).mp h0)

name: SmoothFieldFiberRegularStalks.not_isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime_dualNumber
statement:
theorem not_isRegularLocalRing_localization_atPrime_dualNumber (K : Type*) [Field K] :
    ¬ IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (maximalIdeal (DualNumber K)))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have : IsNoetherianRing (DualNumber K) := PrincipalIdealRing.isNoetherianRing
  have : (nilradical (DualNumber K)).IsMaximal := by
    rw [nilradical_dualNumber_eq_span_eps K]
    exact DualNumber.isMaximal_span_singleton_eps
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (DualNumber K) :=
    Ring.KrullDimLE.of_isMaximal_nilradical (DualNumber K)
  have : IsArtinianRing (DualNumber K) :=
    IsNoetherianRing.isArtinianRing_of_krullDimLE_zero
  have hf : IsField (Localization.AtPrime (maximalIdeal (DualNumber K))) :=
    isField_of_isRegularLocalRing_of_krullDimLE_zero
      (Localization.AtPrime (maximalIdeal (DualNumber K)))
  let := IsField.toField (R := Localization.AtPrime (maximalIdeal (DualNumber K))) hf
  have hz : algebraMap (DualNumber K)
      (Localization.AtPrime (maximalIdeal (DualNumber K))) DualNumber.eps = 0 :=
    (DualNumber.isNilpotent_eps.map (algebraMap (DualNumber K)
      (Localization.AtPrime (maximalIdeal (DualNumber K))))).eq_zero
  obtain ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, hm'⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff
    (maximalIdeal (DualNumber K)).primeCompl
    (Localization.AtPrime (maximalIdeal (DualNumber K))) DualNumber.eps).mp hz
  have hu : IsUnit m := by
    by_contra hnu
    exact hm ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal m).mpr hnu)
  exact eps_ne_zero K (hu.mul_right_eq_zero.mp hm')

name: Algebra.Etale.isReduced_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem Algebra.Etale.isReduced_of_isDomain
    {R B : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.Etale R B] :
    IsReduced B
proof:
:= by
  let K := FractionRing R
  have : Algebra.Etale K (TensorProduct R K B) := inferInstance
  have : IsReduced (TensorProduct R K B) := Algebra.Etale.isReduced_of_field (K := K)
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] TensorProduct R K B) := by
    have hRK : Function.Injective (Algebra.linearMap R K) := IsFractionRing.injective R K
    have hrT : Function.Injective (LinearMap.rTensor B (Algebra.linearMap R K)) :=
      Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (Algebra.linearMap R K) hRK
    intro b₁ b₂ hb
    have key : ∀ b : B, (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] _) b
        = LinearMap.rTensor B (Algebra.linearMap R K) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] b) := by
      intro b
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
        Algebra.linearMap_apply, map_one]
    rw [key, key] at hb
    simpa only [TensorProduct.lid_tmul, one_smul] using
      congrArg (TensorProduct.lid R B) (hrT hb)
  exact isReduced_of_injective
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] TensorProduct R K B) hinj

name: Algebra.Smooth.isReduced_of_field
statement:
theorem _root_.Algebra.Smooth.isReduced_of_field
    {K A : Type*} [Field K] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra.Smooth K A] :
    IsReduced A
proof:
:= by
  have hfp : Algebra.FinitePresentation K A := Algebra.Smooth.finitePresentation
  constructor
  intro a ha
  set J : Ideal A := (Ideal.span {a}).annihilator with hJ
  suffices h1 : (1 : A) ∈ J by
    have := (Submodule.mem_annihilator_span_singleton a 1).mp h1
    simpa only [one_smul] using this
  by_contra h1
  have hJne : J ≠ ⊤ := fun h => h1 (h ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hsub⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal J hJne
  have : m.IsPrime := hm.isPrime
  have hsa : Algebra.IsSmoothAt K m := by
    have : (⟨m, hm.isPrime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) ∈ Algebra.smoothLocus K A := by
      rw [(Algebra.smoothLocus_eq_univ_iff).mpr Algebra.Smooth.formallySmooth]
      exact Set.mem_univ _
    exact this
  have := hsa
  obtain ⟨f, hfm, n, _, hST, hse⟩ :=
    Algebra.IsSmoothAt.exists_isStandardEtale_mvPolynomial (R := K) (S := A) (p := m)
  have : Algebra.Etale (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (Localization.Away f) := inferInstance
  have hAf : IsReduced (Localization.Away f) :=
    Algebra.Etale.isReduced_of_isDomain (R := MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)
  have hzero : algebraMap A (Localization.Away f) a = 0 :=
    (ha.map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f))).eq_zero
  obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers f) _ a).mp hzero
  have hfk : f ^ k ∈ J := by
    rw [hJ, Submodule.mem_annihilator_span_singleton]
    rw [smul_eq_mul, hk]
  exact hfm (hm.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem k (hsub hfk))

name: Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_of_field
statement:
theorem _root_.Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_of_field
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    [Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k B] :
    ∃ n, Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n k B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, σ, hσ, hι, ⟨P⟩⟩ := (inferInstance : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth k B).out
  exact ⟨P.dimension, ⟨ι, σ, hσ, hι, P, rfl⟩⟩

name: AlgHom.surjective_of_finite_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem surjective_of_finite_of_isOpenImmersion
    {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Module.Finite R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B)
    [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom))] :
    Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  let φ : CommRingCat.of A ⟶ CommRingCat.of B := CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom
  let ρ : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ CommRingCat.of A := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)
  have hcomp : ρ ≫ φ = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B) := by
    ext r
    exact f.commutes r
  have : IsFinite (Spec.map φ ≫ Spec.map ρ) := by
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, hcomp]
    exact (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff _).mpr (RingHom.finite_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
  have : IsFinite (Spec.map φ) := IsFinite.of_comp (Spec.map φ) (Spec.map ρ)
  have : Mono φ.op :=
    (Functor.mono_map_iff_mono Scheme.Spec φ.op).mp
      (inferInstance : Mono (Spec.map φ))
  have : Epi φ := inferInstanceAs (Epi φ.op.unop)
  exact (RingHom.surjective_iff_epi_and_finite (f := φ)).mpr
    ⟨inferInstance, (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff φ).mp inferInstance⟩

name: AlgHom.idempotentFactorMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idempotentFactorMap_mk (f : C →ₐ[R] B) (e c : C) :
    f.idempotentFactorMap e (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) c) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - f e}) (f c)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgHom.bijective_idempotentFactorMap_of_awayMap_bijective
statement:
theorem bijective_idempotentFactorMap_of_awayMap_bijective
    (f : C →ₐ[R] B) (e : C) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (b : C)
    (hb : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) b))
    (hf : Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap f.toRingHom b)) :
    Function.Bijective (f.idempotentFactorMap e)
proof:
:= by
  let qC : C →+* C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e} := Ideal.Quotient.mk _
  let qB : B →+* B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - f e} := Ideal.Quotient.mk _
  let φ : C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e} →ₐ[R] B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - f e} :=
    f.idempotentFactorMap e
  have hqe : qC e = 1 := by
    have h : qC (1 - e) = 0 :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (1 - e))
    rw [map_sub, map_one, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hinj := (Localization.awayMap_injective_iff (f := f.toRingHom) (r := b)).mp hf.1
  have hsurj := (Localization.awayMap_surjective_iff (f := f.toRingHom) (r := b)).mp hf.2
  constructor
  · have hzero (x : C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}) (hx : φ x = 0) : x = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
      change qB (f c) = 0 at hx
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp
        (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hx)
      have hefc : f (e * c) = 0 := by
        rw [map_mul, ht, ← mul_assoc, (he.map f).mul_one_sub_self, zero_mul]
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hinj (e * c) hefc
      have hn' : (qC b) ^ n * qC c = 0 := by
        simpa only [map_mul, map_pow, map_zero, hqe, one_mul] using congrArg qC hn
      apply (hb.pow n).mul_left_cancel
      rw [mul_zero]
      exact hn'
    intro x y hxy
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply hzero
    rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    obtain ⟨c, n, hc⟩ := hsurj y
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (hb.pow n).exists_right_inv
    have hφqC (a : C) :
        φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) a) = qB (f a) := by
      rfl
    have hc' : φ (qC c) = (qB (f b)) ^ n * qB y := by
      change qB (f c) = (qB (f b)) ^ n * qB y
      change f c = f b ^ n * y at hc
      rw [hc, map_mul, map_pow]
    have hz' : (qB (f b)) ^ n * φ z = 1 := by
      calc
        (qB (f b)) ^ n * φ z =
            φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) b) ^ n * φ z := by
              rw [hφqC]
        _ = φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) b ^ n * z) := by
              rw [map_mul, map_pow]
        _ = φ 1 := congrArg φ hz
        _ = 1 := map_one φ
    refine ⟨qC c * z, ?_⟩
    change φ (qC c * z) = qB y
    rw [map_mul, hc']
    calc
      ((qB (f b)) ^ n * qB y) * φ z =
          ((qB (f b)) ^ n * φ z) * qB y := by ring
      _ = qB y := by rw [hz', one_mul]

name: AlgHom.isIntegral_idempotentFactor_of_awayMap_bijective
statement:
theorem isIntegral_idempotentFactor_of_awayMap_bijective
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] (f : C →ₐ[R] B)
    (e : C) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (b : C)
    (hb : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) b))
    (hf : Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap f.toRingHom b)) :
    Algebra.IsIntegral R (B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - f e})
proof:
:= by
  let ψ : C →ₐ[R] B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - f e} :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.span {1 - f e})).comp f
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (f.bijective_idempotentFactorMap_of_awayMap_bijective e he b hb hf).2 y
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
    exact ⟨c, hx⟩
  exact Algebra.IsIntegral.of_surjective ψ hψ

statement:

theorem idempotentFactorReductionEquivFst_mk_mk (I : Ideal R) (e : C)
    {D : Type w} {F : Type z} [CommRing D] [CommRing F]
