name: Module.FaithfullyFlat.pi_of_dedekind_spectrum_cover
statement:
theorem pi_of_dedekind_spectrum_cover
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] (A : ι → Type w)
    [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i, IsDomain (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)]
    (hinj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (algebraMap R (A i)))
    (hcover : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      ∃ (i : ι) (q : PrimeSpectrum (A i)),
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (A i)) q = p) :
    Module.FaithfullyFlat R (∀ i, A i)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i, Module.IsTorsionFree R (A i) := fun i ↦
    Module.isTorsionFree_iff_algebraMap_injective.mpr (hinj i)
  apply Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_comap_surjective
  intro p
  obtain ⟨i, q, hq⟩ := hcover p
  refine ⟨PrimeSpectrum.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A i) q, ?_⟩
  change PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (A i)) q = p
  exact hq

name: Algebra.exists_monic_annihilator_of_quotient_idempotent
statement:
theorem exists_monic_annihilator_of_quotient_idempotent
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Module.Finite R B] (I : Ideal R) (b : B)
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b)) :
    ∃ n ≥ 1, ∃ p : R[X], p.Monic ∧ aeval b p = 0 ∧
      p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = (X - 1) ^ n * X ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let J : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  have hbdef : b * b - b ∈ J := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hb.eq
  obtain ⟨n, u, hu⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.mp
    (Module.Finite.fg_top : (⊤ : Submodule R B).FG)
  let v : Fin n ⊕ Fin n → B := fun j ↦ match j with
    | .inl i => b * u i
    | .inr i => (1 - b) * u i
  let d : Fin n ⊕ Fin n → R := fun j ↦ match j with
    | .inl _ => 1
    | .inr _ => 0
  let N : Submodule R B := Submodule.span R (Set.range v)
  have hv : N = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    refine hu.ge.trans (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hleft : b * u i ∈ N := Submodule.subset_span ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩
    have hright : (1 - b) * u i ∈ N := Submodule.subset_span ⟨Sum.inr i, rfl⟩
    have heq : b * u i + (1 - b) * u i = u i := by ring
    exact heq ▸ N.add_mem hleft hright
  have hres (j : Fin n ⊕ Fin n) :
      Algebra.lmul R B b (v j) - d j • v j ∈ I • (⊤ : Submodule R B) := by
    rw [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map]
    cases j with
    | inl i =>
      change b * (b * u i) - (1 : R) • (b * u i) ∈ J
      rw [one_smul]
      have heq : b * (b * u i) - b * u i = (b * b - b) * u i := by ring
      rw [heq]
      exact J.mul_mem_right (u i) hbdef
    | inr i =>
      change b * ((1 - b) * u i) - (0 : R) • ((1 - b) * u i) ∈ J
      rw [zero_smul, sub_zero]
      have heq : b * ((1 - b) * u i) = -(b * b - b) * u i := by ring
      rw [heq]
      exact J.mul_mem_right (u i) (J.neg_mem hbdef)
  obtain ⟨p, hpmonic, hpEnd, hpmap⟩ :=
    LinearMap.exists_monic_aeval_eq_zero_map_eq_prod_of_residual_diagonal
      I (Algebra.lmul R B b) v hv d hres
  have hproot : aeval b p = 0 := by
    apply Algebra.lmul_injective (R := R) (A := B)
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (Algebra.lmul R B) b p, map_zero]
    exact hpEnd
  have hpmap' : p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = (X - 1) ^ n * X ^ n := by
    simpa only [Fintype.prod_sum_type, d, map_one, map_zero, Polynomial.C_1,
      Polynomial.C_0, sub_zero, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin] using hpmap
  have hmonic : (X - (1 : R[X])).Monic := by
    simpa only [Polynomial.C_1] using monic_X_sub_C (1 : R)
  refine ⟨n + 1, Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n), p * (X - 1) * X,
    (hpmonic.mul hmonic).mul monic_X, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [aeval_mul, hproot, zero_mul]
  · simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_sub,
      Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_one, hpmap', pow_succ]
    ring

name: Algebra.exists_idempotent_lift_of_coprime_polynomial_factors
statement:
theorem exists_idempotent_lift_of_coprime_polynomial_factors
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (I : Ideal R) (b : B)
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (g h : R[X]) (hcoprime : IsCoprime g h)
    (hzero : aeval b (g * h) = 0)
    (hg : g.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = (X - 1) ^ n)
    (hh : h.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = X ^ n) :
    ∃ e : B, IsIdempotentElem e ∧
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) e =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b
proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  let qR : R →+* R ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  let qB : B →+* B ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := hcoprime
  let u : B := aeval b s
  let v : B := aeval b t
  let G : B := aeval b g
  let H : B := aeval b h
  have hbez : u * G + v * H = 1 := by
    simpa only [aeval_add, aeval_mul, aeval_one] using congrArg (aeval b) hst
  have hGH : G * H = 0 := by
    simpa only [aeval_mul] using hzero
  have hcompl : 1 - v * H = u * G := by
    rw [← hbez]
    ring
  refine ⟨v * H, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply isIdempotentElem_iff_mul_one_sub_self.mpr
    calc
      (v * H) * (1 - v * H) = (v * H) * (u * G) := by rw [hcompl]
      _ = (u * v) * (G * H) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hGH, mul_zero]
  · have hcomp : (algebraMap (R ⧸ I) (B ⧸ J)).comp qR =
        qB.comp (algebraMap R B) :=
      Ideal.quotientMap_comp_mk
        (show I ≤ J.comap (algebraMap R B) from Ideal.le_comap_map)
    have hreduce (p : R[X]) : qB (aeval b p) = aeval (qB b) (p.map qR) :=
      Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map hcomp p b
    have hGbar : qB G = (qB b - 1) ^ n := by
      change qB (aeval b g) = (qB b - 1) ^ n
      rw [hreduce, hg, map_pow, aeval_sub, aeval_X, aeval_one]
    have hHbar : qB H = qB b := by
      change qB (aeval b h) = qB b
      rw [hreduce, hh, map_pow, aeval_X]
      exact hb.pow_eq (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hn))
    have hbG : qB b * qB G = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨m, hnm⟩ :=
        Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hn))
      have hbsub : qB b * (qB b - 1) = 0 := by
        rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hb.eq, sub_self]
      rw [hGbar, hnm, pow_succ', ← mul_assoc, hbsub, zero_mul]
    have hbezbar : qB u * qB G + qB v * qB b = 1 := by
      simpa only [map_add, map_mul, map_one, hHbar] using congrArg qB hbez
    have hmul : qB u * (qB b * qB G) + qB v * (qB b * qB b) = qB b := by
      calc
        qB u * (qB b * qB G) + qB v * (qB b * qB b) =
            qB b * (qB u * qB G + qB v * qB b) := by ring
        _ = qB b := by rw [hbezbar, mul_one]
    rw [hbG, hb.eq, mul_zero, zero_add] at hmul
    change qB (v * H) = qB b
    rw [map_mul, hHbar]
    exact hmul

name: PrimeSpectrum.exists_lift_idempotent_basicOpen_le
statement:
theorem exists_lift_idempotent_basicOpen_le {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (e : R ⧸ I) (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (U : Opens (PrimeSpectrum R))
    (hU : basicOpen e ≤ Opens.comap
      ⟨comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I), continuous_comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)⟩ U) :
    ∃ g : R, Ideal.Quotient.mk I g = e ∧ basicOpen g ≤ U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective e
  let J : Ideal R := vanishingIdeal ((U : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))ᶜ)
  have hJ : zeroLocus (J : Set R) = (U : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))ᶜ :=
    (zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure ((U : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))ᶜ)).trans
      U.isOpen.isClosed_compl.closure_eq
  have hradical : a ∈ (I ⊔ J).radical := by
    rw [← vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical]
    apply (mem_vanishingIdeal (zeroLocus ((I ⊔ J : Ideal R) : Set R)) a).mpr
    intro x hx
    have hIJx : I ⊔ J ≤ x.asIdeal :=
      (mem_zeroLocus x ((I ⊔ J : Ideal R) : Set R)).mp hx
    have hIx : I ≤ x.asIdeal := le_sup_left.trans hIJx
    have hJx : x ∈ zeroLocus (J : Set R) :=
      (mem_zeroLocus x (J : Set R)).mpr
        (show J ≤ x.asIdeal from le_sup_right.trans hIJx)
    rw [hJ] at hJx
    have hxRange : x ∈ Set.range (comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) := by
      rw [range_comap_of_surjective (R ⧸ I) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
      change RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ≤ x.asIdeal
      intro r hr
      exact hIx (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hr)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hxRange
    by_contra hax
    have hye : y ∈ basicOpen e := by
      rw [mem_basicOpen, ← ha]
      change a ∉ (comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) y).asIdeal
      rw [hy]
      exact hax
    have hyU : comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) y ∈ U := hU hye
    rw [hy] at hyU
    exact hJx hyU
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp hradical
  have hn' : a ^ (n + 1) ∈ I ⊔ J := by
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact (I ⊔ J).mul_mem_right a hn
  obtain ⟨b, hb, g, hg, hbg⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hn'
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I g = Ideal.Quotient.mk I b + Ideal.Quotient.mk I g := by
        rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hb, zero_add]
      _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (b + g) := (map_add (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) b g).symm
      _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (a ^ (n + 1)) := congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) hbg
      _ = e := by rw [map_pow, ha, he.pow_succ_eq n]
  · intro x hx
    by_contra hxU
    exact (mem_basicOpen g x).mp hx ((mem_vanishingIdeal
      ((U : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))ᶜ) g).mp hg x hxU)

name: AlgHom.exists_prod_quotient_equiv_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem exists_prod_quotient_equiv_of_isOpenImmersion
    {A R S : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra A R] [Algebra A S] (f : R →ₐ[A] S)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom))] :
    ∃ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e ∧ RingHom.ker f.toRingHom = Ideal.span {e} ∧
      ∃ E : R ≃ₐ[A] S × (R ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}),
        (∀ r : R, (E r).1 = f r) ∧
        (∀ r : R, (E r).2 = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he, hker⟩ :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_iff_of_surjective
      (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) hf).mp inferInstance
  have hker' : RingHom.ker f = Ideal.span {e} := by
    rw [← hker]
    congr 1
  have hsum : e + (1 - e) = 1 := by rw [add_comm, sub_add_cancel]
  let E₀ : R ≃ₐ[A] (R ⧸ Ideal.span {e}) × (R ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}) :=
    AlgEquiv.prodQuotientOfIsIdempotentElem A he he.one_sub hsum he.mul_one_sub_self
  let E₁ : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {e}) ≃ₐ[A] S :=
    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq A hker'.symm).trans
      (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (f := f) hf)
  let E : R ≃ₐ[A] S × (R ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}) :=
    E₀.trans (.prodCongr E₁ .refl)
  refine ⟨e, he, hker, E, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r
    change E₁ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {e}) r) = f r
    dsimp only [E₁, AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
    rw [Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk,
      Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk]
  · intro r
    rfl

name: IsIdempotentElem.eq_zero_of_mem_jacobson
statement:
private lemma eq_zero_of_mem_jacobson
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {e : R} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    (hmem : e ∈ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R)) : e = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (1 - e) := by
    apply Ideal.isUnit_of_sub_one_mem_jacobson_bot
    have heq : (1 - e) - 1 = -e := by ring
    rw [heq]
    exact (Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R)).neg_mem hmem
  apply hunit.mul_left_cancel
  rw [he.one_sub_mul_self, mul_zero]

name: IsIdempotentElem.eq_of_quotient_eq_of_le_jacobson
statement:
theorem eq_of_quotient_eq_of_le_jacobson
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥)
    {e f : R} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) (hf : IsIdempotentElem f)
    (hquot : Ideal.Quotient.mk J e = Ideal.Quotient.mk J f) : e = f
proof:
:= by
  have hcross (a c : R) (ha : IsIdempotentElem a) (hc : IsIdempotentElem c)
      (hac : Ideal.Quotient.mk J a = Ideal.Quotient.mk J c) : a * (1 - c) = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_mem_jacobson (ha.mul hc.one_sub)
    apply hJ
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    rw [map_mul, map_sub, map_one, hac]
    exact (hc.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)).mul_one_sub_self
  have hef := hcross e f he hf hquot
  have hfe := hcross f e hf he hquot.symm
  rw [mul_sub, mul_one, sub_eq_zero] at hef hfe
  exact hef.trans ((mul_comm e f).trans hfe.symm)

name: Algebra.exists_pow_mul_mem_map_of_awayMap_bijective
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mul_mem_map_of_awayMap_bijective
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (I : Ideal R) (b : A)
    (hf : Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap f.toRingHom b))
    {x : A} (hx : f x ∈ I.map (algebraMap R B)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, b ^ n * x ∈ I.map (algebraMap R A)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : Localization.Away b →ₐ[R] Localization.Away (f b) :=
    Localization.awayMapₐ f b
  have hφ : Function.Bijective φ := hf
  have hmap : (I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away b))).map φ.toRingHom =
      I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f b))) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_map]
    congr 1
    ext r
    exact φ.commutes r
  have hcomap : (I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f b)))).comap φ.toRingHom =
      I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away b)) := by
    rw [← hmap]
    exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective φ.toRingHom hφ
  have hlocB : algebraMap B (Localization.Away (f b)) (f x) ∈
      I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f b))) := by
    have hm := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap B (Localization.Away (f b))) hx
    rwa [Ideal.map_map,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R B (Localization.Away (f b))] at hm
  have hφx : φ (algebraMap A (Localization.Away b) x) =
      algebraMap B (Localization.Away (f b)) (f x) := by
    simp only [φ, Localization.awayMapₐ, IsLocalization.Away.mapₐ_apply,
      IsLocalization.Away.map, IsLocalization.map_eq]
    rfl
  have hlocA : algebraMap A (Localization.Away b) x ∈
      I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away b)) := by
    rw [← hcomap]
    change φ (algebraMap A (Localization.Away b) x) ∈
      I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f b)))
    rw [hφx]
    exact hlocB
  have hext : (I.map (algebraMap R A)).map (algebraMap A (Localization.Away b)) =
      I.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away b)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R A (Localization.Away b)]
  rw [← hext] at hlocA
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨n, rfl⟩, hn⟩ :=
    (IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Submonoid.powers b)
      (Localization.Away b) (I.map (algebraMap R A)) x).mp hlocA
  exact ⟨n, hn⟩

name: Algebra.cyclic_quotient_idempotent_of_awayMap_bijective
statement:
theorem cyclic_quotient_idempotent_of_awayMap_bijective
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (I : Ideal R) (b : A)
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R A)) b))
    (hf : Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap f.toRingHom b))
    (hcyc : ∀ x : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B), ∃ r : R,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) (f b) * x =
        r • Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) (f b)) :
    ∀ x : A ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R A), ∃ r : R,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R A)) b * x =
        r • Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R A)) b
proof:
:= by
  let qA : A →ₐ[R] A ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R A) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (I.map (algebraMap R A))
  let qB : B →ₐ[R] B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (I.map (algebraMap R B))
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcyc (qB (f x))
  have hmem : f (b * x - r • b) ∈ I.map (algebraMap R B) := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change qB (f (b * x - r • b)) = 0
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_smul]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hr
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_mul_mem_map_of_awayMap_bijective f I b hf hmem
  have hzero : qA (b ^ n * (b * x - r • b)) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hn
  have hb' : IsIdempotentElem (qA b) := hb
  have hm := congrArg (fun z ↦ qA b * z) hzero
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, mul_zero, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ', hb'.pow_succ_eq n] at hm
  have hmul : qA b * qA (b * x - r • b) = qA (b * x - r • b) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, hb'.eq, mul_smul_comm, hb'.eq]
  rw [hmul, map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, sub_eq_zero] at hm
  exact ⟨r, hm⟩

name: Algebra.surjective_algebraMap_quotient_idempotentFactor_of_cyclic
statement:
theorem surjective_algebraMap_quotient_idempotentFactor_of_cyclic
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    (I : Ideal R) (e : C)
    (hcyc : ∀ x : C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R C), ∃ r : R,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) e * x =
        r • Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) e) :
    Function.Surjective (algebraMap (R ⧸ I)
      ((C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}) ⧸
        I.map (algebraMap R (C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}))))
proof:
:= by
  let D := C ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}
  let J : Ideal D := I.map (algebraMap R D)
  let q : C →ₐ[R] D := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (Ideal.span {1 - e})
  let qC : C →ₐ[R] C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R C) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (I.map (algebraMap R C))
  let qD : D →ₐ[R] D ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J
  let φ : C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R C) →ₐ[R] D ⧸ J :=
    (q.quotientBaseChange I).restrictScalars R
  have hqe : q e = 1 := by
    have h : q (1 - e) = 0 := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (1 - e))
    rw [map_sub, map_one, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hφe : φ (qC e) = 1 := by
    change qD (q e) = 1
    rw [hqe, map_one]
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcyc (qC c)
  change qC e * qC c = r • qC e at hr
  have hr' : qD (q c) = r • (1 : D ⧸ J) := by
    have h := congrArg φ hr
    simp only [map_mul, map_smul, hφe, one_mul] at h
    change qD (q c) = r • (1 : D ⧸ J) at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk I r, ?_⟩
  change algebraMap R (D ⧸ J) r = qD (q c)
  exact (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one r).trans hr'.symm

name: Algebra.exists_finite_set_of_mem_map
statement:
private theorem exists_finite_set_of_mem_map
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    (I : Ideal R) {x : C} (hx : x ∈ I.map (algebraMap R C)) :
    ∃ T : Set C, T.Finite ∧ ∀ S : Subalgebra R C, T ⊆ S →
      ∃ y : S, (y : C) = x ∧ y ∈ I.map (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ Submodule.span C ((algebraMap R C) '' (I : Set R)) at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨∅, Set.finite_empty, ?_⟩
    intro S _
    exact ⟨algebraMap R S r, rfl, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap R S) hr⟩
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨∅, Set.finite_empty, ?_⟩
    intro S _
    exact ⟨0, rfl, (I.map (algebraMap R S)).zero_mem⟩
  | add x y _ _ ihx ihy =>
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTx⟩ := ihx
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hUy⟩ := ihy
    refine ⟨T ∪ U, hT.union hU, ?_⟩
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨xS, hxS, hxI⟩ := hTx S (fun z hz ↦ hS (Or.inl hz))
    obtain ⟨yS, hyS, hyI⟩ := hUy S (fun z hz ↦ hS (Or.inr hz))
    refine ⟨xS + yS, ?_, (I.map (algebraMap R S)).add_mem hxI hyI⟩
    change (xS : C) + (yS : C) = x + y
    rw [hxS, hyS]
  | smul c x _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTx⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨insert c T, hT.insert c, ?_⟩
    intro S hS
    obtain ⟨xS, hxS, hxI⟩ := hTx S (fun z hz ↦ hS (Set.mem_insert_of_mem c hz))
    let cS : S := ⟨c, hS (Set.mem_insert c T)⟩
    refine ⟨cS * xS, ?_, (I.map (algebraMap R S)).mul_mem_left cS hxI⟩
    change c * (xS : C) = c * x
    rw [hxS]

name: Algebra.exists_finite_subalgebra_quotient_idempotent
statement:
theorem exists_finite_subalgebra_quotient_idempotent
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] (I : Ideal R) (b : C)
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) b)) :
    ∃ S : Subalgebra R C, Module.Finite R S ∧ ∃ hbS : b ∈ S,
      IsIdempotentElem
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (⟨b, hbS⟩ : S))
proof:
:= by
  have hdef : b * b - b ∈ I.map (algebraMap R C) := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hb.eq
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hcoeff⟩ := exists_finite_set_of_mem_map I hdef
  let S : Subalgebra R C := Algebra.adjoin R (insert b T)
  have hfinite : Module.Finite R S :=
    Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral (hT.insert b)
      (fun x _ ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)
  have hbS : b ∈ S := Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert b T)
  have hTS : T ⊆ S := fun x hx ↦
    Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert_of_mem b hx)
  obtain ⟨xS, hxS, hxI⟩ := hcoeff S hTS
  let bS : S := ⟨b, hbS⟩
  have hdefS : bS * bS - bS ∈ I.map (algebraMap R S) := by
    have heq : bS * bS - bS = xS := Subtype.ext hxS.symm
    rw [heq]
    exact hxI
  refine ⟨S, hfinite, hbS, ?_⟩
  have heq := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hdefS
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, sub_eq_zero] at heq
  exact heq

name: Algebra.exists_finite_subalgebra_idempotent_awayMap_bijective
statement:
theorem exists_finite_subalgebra_idempotent_awayMap_bijective
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] (I : Ideal R) (b : C)
    [Algebra.FiniteType R (Localization.Away b)]
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) b)) :
    ∃ S : Subalgebra R C, Module.Finite R S ∧ ∃ hbS : b ∈ S,
      IsIdempotentElem
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R S)) (⟨b, hbS⟩ : S)) ∧
      Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap S.val.toRingHom ⟨b, hbS⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hdef : b * b - b ∈ I.map (algebraMap R C) := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hb.eq
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hcoeff⟩ := exists_finite_set_of_mem_map I hdef
  obtain ⟨S, hfinite, hTS, hbS, hbij⟩ :=
    exists_finite_subalgebra_awayMap_bijective_of_finiteType (R := R) b T hT
  obtain ⟨xS, hxS, hxI⟩ := hcoeff S hTS
  let bS : S := ⟨b, hbS⟩
  have hdefS : bS * bS - bS ∈ I.map (algebraMap R S) := by
    have heq : bS * bS - bS = xS := Subtype.ext hxS.symm
    rw [heq]
    exact hxI
  refine ⟨S, hfinite, hbS, ?_, hbij⟩
  have heq := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hdefS
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, sub_eq_zero] at heq
  exact heq

name: Algebra.exists_monic_annihilator_of_cyclic_quotient_idempotent
statement:
theorem exists_monic_annihilator_of_cyclic_quotient_idempotent
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Module.Finite R B] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥) (b : B)
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b))
    (hcyc : ∀ x : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B), ∃ r : R,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b * x =
        r • Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b) :
    ∃ d ≥ 1, ∃ p : R[X], p.Monic ∧ aeval b p = 0 ∧
      p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = (X - 1) * X ^ d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let J : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  let q : B →ₐ[R] B ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J
  have hbdef : b * b - b ∈ J := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change q (b * b - b) = 0
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hb.eq
  have hcycdef (x : B) : ∃ r : R, b * x - r • b ∈ J := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcyc (q x)
    change q b * q x = r • q b at hr
    refine ⟨r, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp ?_⟩
    change q (b * x - r • b) = 0
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_smul, hr, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (Module.Finite.fg_top : (⊤ : Submodule R B).FG)
  let v : Option s → B := fun j => match j with
    | none => b
    | some i => (1 - b) * (i : B)
  let d : Option s → R := fun j => match j with
    | none => 1
    | some _ => 0
  let N : Submodule R B := Submodule.span R (Set.range v)
  have hv : N = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    apply Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot Module.Finite.fg_top hI
    refine hs.ge.trans (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_)
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcycdef x
    have hbN : b ∈ N := Submodule.subset_span ⟨none, rfl⟩
    have hxN : (1 - b) * x ∈ N := Submodule.subset_span ⟨some ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    have hmain : r • b + (1 - b) * x ∈ N :=
      N.add_mem (N.smul_mem r hbN) hxN
    have hrem : b * x - r • b ∈ I • (⊤ : Submodule R B) := by
      rw [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map]
      exact hr
    have hmem := Submodule.add_mem_sup hmain hrem
    have heq : (r • b + (1 - b) * x) + (b * x - r • b) = x := by ring
    exact heq ▸ hmem
  have hres (j : Option s) :
      Algebra.lmul R B b (v j) - d j • v j ∈ I • (⊤ : Submodule R B) := by
    rw [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map]
    change b * v j - d j • v j ∈ J
    cases j with
    | none => simpa only [v, d, one_smul] using hbdef
    | some i =>
      change b * ((1 - b) * (i : B)) - (0 : R) • ((1 - b) * (i : B)) ∈ J
      rw [zero_smul, sub_zero]
      have heq : b * ((1 - b) * (i : B)) = -(b * b - b) * (i : B) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      exact J.mul_mem_right (i : B) (J.neg_mem hbdef)
  obtain ⟨p, hpmonic, hpEnd, hpmap⟩ :=
    LinearMap.exists_monic_aeval_eq_zero_map_eq_prod_of_residual_diagonal
      I (Algebra.lmul R B b) v hv d hres
  have hproot : aeval b p = 0 := by
    apply Algebra.lmul_injective (R := R) (A := B)
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (Algebra.lmul R B) b p, map_zero]
    exact hpEnd
  have hpmap' : p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = (X - 1) * X ^ Fintype.card s := by
    simpa only [Fintype.prod_option, d, map_one, map_zero, Polynomial.C_1,
      Polynomial.C_0, sub_zero, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ] using hpmap
  refine ⟨Fintype.card s + 1, Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _), p * X,
    hpmonic.mul monic_X, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [aeval_mul, hproot, zero_mul]
  · rw [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_X, hpmap', pow_succ, mul_assoc]

name: Algebra.isUnit_quotient_one_sub_of_eq_mod_extendedIdeal
statement:
theorem isUnit_quotient_one_sub_of_eq_mod_extendedIdeal
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥)
    (b e : C)
    (hbe : Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) b =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) e) :
    IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) b)
proof:
:= by
  let K : Ideal C := Ideal.span {1 - e}
  let q : C →ₐ[R] C ⧸ K := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R K
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral R (C ⧸ K) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.of_surjective q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have he : q e = 1 := by
    have h : q (1 - e) = 0 := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
      (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr rfl))
    rw [map_sub, map_one, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hmem : b - e ∈ I.map (algebraMap R C) := Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp hbe
  have hmap : q (b - e) ∈ I.map (algebraMap R (C ⧸ K)) := by
    rw [← q.map_extendedIdeal I]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem q.toRingHom hmem
  apply Ideal.isUnit_of_sub_one_mem_jacobson_bot
  apply Ideal.map_le_jacobson_bot_of_isIntegral hI
  change q b - 1 ∈ I.map (algebraMap R (C ⧸ K))
  simpa only [map_sub, he] using hmap

name: Algebra.exists_finite_subalgebra_awayMap_bijective_of_finiteType
statement:
theorem exists_finite_subalgebra_awayMap_bijective_of_finiteType
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] (b : C) [Algebra.FiniteType R (Localization.Away b)]
    (T : Set C) (hT : T.Finite) :
    ∃ S : Subalgebra R C, Module.Finite R S ∧ T ⊆ S ∧ ∃ hb : b ∈ S,
      Function.Bijective (Localization.awayMap S.val.toRingHom ⟨b, hb⟩)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Algebra.FiniteType.out (R := R) (A := Localization.Away b)
  have hfrac (z : Localization.Away b) : ∃ (a : C) (n : ℕ),
      IsLocalization.mk' (M := Submonoid.powers b) (Localization.Away b)
        a ⟨b ^ n, n, rfl⟩ = z := by
    obtain ⟨a, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩, ha⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (.powers b) z
    exact ⟨a, n, ha⟩
  choose a n ha using hfrac
  let S : Subalgebra R C :=
    Algebra.adjoin R (insert b (T ∪ a '' (s : Set (Localization.Away b))))
  have hfinite : Module.Finite R S :=
    Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral
      ((hT.union (s.finite_toSet.image a)).insert b)
      (fun x _ ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)
  have hTS : T ⊆ S := fun x hx ↦
    Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert_of_mem b (Or.inl hx))
  have hbS : b ∈ S := Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert b _)
  have haS (z : Localization.Away b) (hz : z ∈ s) : a z ∈ S :=
    Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert_of_mem b (Or.inr ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩))
  let bS : S := ⟨b, hbS⟩
  let φ : Localization.Away bS →ₐ[R] Localization.Away b :=
    Localization.awayMapₐ S.val bS
  have hpowers : Submonoid.powers bS ≤
      (Submonoid.powers b).comap (S.val : S →+* C) := by
    rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
  have hφ : φ.toRingHom =
      IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers bS)
        (S := Localization.Away bS) (P := C) (T := Submonoid.powers b)
        (Localization.Away b) S.val hpowers := by
    rfl
  have hsrange : (s : Set (Localization.Away b)) ⊆ φ.range := by
    intro z hz
    let den : Submonoid.powers bS := ⟨bS ^ n z, ⟨n z, rfl⟩⟩
    refine ⟨IsLocalization.mk' (M := Submonoid.powers bS)
      (Localization.Away bS) ⟨a z, haS z hz⟩
      den, ?_⟩
    rw [hφ, IsLocalization.map_mk']
    simpa [den] using ha z
  have htop : (⊤ : Subalgebra R (Localization.Away b)) ≤ φ.range := by
    rw [← hs]
    exact Algebra.adjoin_le_iff.mpr hsrange
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective φ := fun z ↦
    (φ.mem_range).mp (htop (show z ∈ (⊤ : Subalgebra R (Localization.Away b)) from trivial))
  refine ⟨S, hfinite, hTS, hbS, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨IsLocalization.map_injective_of_injective _ _ _ Subtype.val_injective, hsurj⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv_tmul
    {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {K : Type uK} {E : Type uE}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra R C] [Module.Finite R C]

    (x : K) (c : C) :
    finiteGenericFiberAlgEquiv
        (R := R) (C := C) (K := K) (E := E) (x ⊗ₜ[R] c) =
      algebraMap K E x * algebraMap C E c
proof:
:= by

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericFiberDVRProductComponentFractionRingEquiv_quotient_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem genericFiberDVRProductComponentFractionRingEquiv_quotient_mk
    (i : ι) (m : Ideal (K ⊗[R] (∀ j, A j))) [m.IsMaximal]
    (hNP : genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m ≤
      productCoordinatePrime A i)
    (hNne : genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m ≠
      productCoordinatePrime A i)
    (x : ∀ j, A j) :
    genericFiberDVRProductComponentFractionRingEquiv A i m hNP hNne
        (genericFiberComponentQuotientRingHom m
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m) x)) =
      algebraMap (A i) (FractionRing (A i)) (x i)
proof:
:= by
  let U := ∀ j, A j
  let G := K ⊗[R] U
  let N := genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m
  let Ω := G ⧸ m
  let f : U →+* A i := Pi.evalRingHom A i
  let : m.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime (inferInstance : m.IsMaximal)
  let : N.IsPrime := (inferInstance : m.IsPrime).comap
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : U →ₐ[R] G).toRingHom
  have hker : N = RingHom.ker f :=
    prime_eq_ker_coordinateEval_of_le_of_ne A i N hNP hNne
  let eN : (U ⧸ N) ≃+* A i :=
    (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq ℤ hker).toRingEquiv.trans
      (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective f.surjective)
  let : Field Ω := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  let : Algebra (U ⧸ N) Ω :=
    (genericFiberComponentQuotientRingHom m).toAlgebra
  let : IsFractionRing (U ⧸ N) Ω :=
    genericFiberComponentQuotient_isFractionRing m
  change IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv
      (K := Ω) (L := FractionRing (A i)) eN
      (algebraMap (U ⧸ N) Ω (Ideal.Quotient.mk N x)) = _
  rw [IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap]
  change algebraMap (A i) (FractionRing (A i)) (eN (Ideal.Quotient.mk N x)) = _
  congr 1

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericFiberComponentQuotient_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem genericFiberComponentQuotient_isFractionRing
    (m : Ideal (K ⊗[R] U)) [m.IsMaximal] :
    let N
proof:
:= genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m
    let Ω := ((K ⊗[R] U) ⧸ m)
    letI : Algebra (U ⧸ N) Ω :=
      (genericFiberComponentQuotientRingHom m).toAlgebra
    IsFractionRing (U ⧸ N) Ω := by
  let G := K ⊗[R] U
  let N := genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m
  let Ω := G ⧸ m
  let M : Submonoid U :=
    Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid U (nonZeroDivisors R)
  let : Algebra U G := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsLocalization M G :=
    IsLocalization.tensorRight (R := R) (S := U) (A := K)
      (nonZeroDivisors R)
  let : m.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime (inferInstance : m.IsMaximal)
  let : N.IsPrime := (inferInstance : m.IsPrime).comap
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : U →ₐ[R] G).toRingHom
  let : Field Ω := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  let : Algebra (U ⧸ N) Ω :=
    (genericFiberComponentQuotientRingHom m).toAlgebra
  let : FaithfulSMul (U ⧸ N) Ω :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective (U ⧸ N) Ω).mpr
      (genericFiberComponentQuotientRingHom_injective m)
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint (M : Set U) (N : Set U) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxM hxN
    have hxIdeal : algebraMap U G x ∈ m := hxN
    exact (inferInstance : m.IsPrime).ne_top
      (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem m hxIdeal
        (IsLocalization.map_units G ⟨x, hxM⟩))
  apply IsFractionRing.of_field
  intro z
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, ht⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M t
  refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk N x, Ideal.Quotient.mk N s, ?_⟩
  refine (eq_div_iff ?_).2 ?_
  · apply (map_ne_zero_iff _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (U ⧸ N) Ω)).2
    intro hs
    have hsN : (s : U) ∈ N := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hs
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint) s.property hsN
  · change Ideal.Quotient.mk m t * algebraMap U Ω s =
      algebraMap U Ω x
    simpa using congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk m) ht

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericFiberComponentFractionRingEquiv_quotient_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem genericFiberComponentFractionRingEquiv_quotient_mk
    (m : Ideal (K ⊗[R] U)) [m.IsMaximal] (x : U) :
    genericFiberComponentFractionRingEquiv m
        (genericFiberComponentQuotientRingHom m
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m) x)) =
      algebraMap (U ⧸ genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m)
        (FractionRing (U ⧸ genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m))
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m) x)
proof:
:= by
  let G := K ⊗[R] U
  let N := genericFiberComponentBaseIdeal m
  let Ω := G ⧸ m
  let : m.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.IsMaximal.isPrime (inferInstance : m.IsMaximal)
  let : N.IsPrime := (inferInstance : m.IsPrime).comap
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : U →ₐ[R] G).toRingHom
  let : Field Ω := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  let : Algebra (U ⧸ N) Ω :=
    (genericFiberComponentQuotientRingHom m).toAlgebra
  let : IsFractionRing (U ⧸ N) Ω :=
    genericFiberComponentQuotient_isFractionRing m
  change (FractionRing.algEquiv (A := U ⧸ N) Ω).symm
      (algebraMap (U ⧸ N) Ω (Ideal.Quotient.mk N x)) =
    algebraMap (U ⧸ N) (FractionRing (U ⧸ N))
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk N x)
  exact (FractionRing.algEquiv (A := U ⧸ N) Ω).symm.commutes _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.genericFiberRightAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem genericFiberRightAlgHom_apply
    {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {K : Type uK} {E : Type uE}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K]
    [Field E] [Algebra K E] [Algebra R E] [IsScalarTower R K E]
    (e : (K ⊗[R] C) ≃ₐ[K] E) (c : C) :

proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isFractionRing_of_genericFiberAlgEquiv
statement:
theorem isFractionRing_of_genericFiberAlgEquiv
    {R : Type uR} {C : Type uC} {K : Type uK} {E : Type uE}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Algebra R C]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    [Field E] [Algebra K E] [Algebra R E] [IsScalarTower R K E]
    (e : (K ⊗[R] C) ≃ₐ[K] E) :
    letI : Algebra C E
proof:
:=
      (genericFiberRightAlgHom e).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    IsFractionRing C E := by
  let M : Submonoid C :=
    Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C (nonZeroDivisors R)
  let T := K ⊗[R] C
  let f : C →ₐ[R] E := genericFiberRightAlgHom e
  let : Algebra C E := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hRE : Function.Injective (algebraMap R E) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R K E]
    exact (algebraMap K E).injective.comp
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R K)
  let : IsDomain R := hRE.isDomain _
  have hRC : Function.Injective (algebraMap R C) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply hRE
    calc
      algebraMap R E x = f (algebraMap R C x) := (f.commutes x).symm
      _ = f (algebraMap R C y) := by rw [hxy]
      _ = algebraMap R E y := f.commutes y
  have hM : M ≤ nonZeroDivisors C := by
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp hr
    rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h
    exact hr0 (hRC (by simpa using h))
  let : Algebra C T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsLocalization M T :=
    IsLocalization.tensorRight (R := R) (S := C) (A := K)
      (nonZeroDivisors R)
  let eC : T ≃ₐ[C] E :=
    { e with
      commutes' := fun c ↦ rfl }
  let : IsLocalization M E :=
    IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_algEquiv M eC
  let : FaithfulSMul C E :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective C E).mpr
      (IsLocalization.injective E hM)
  apply IsFractionRing.of_field
  intro z
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hz⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M z
  refine ⟨x, s, (eq_div_iff ?_).2 ?_⟩
  · exact (IsLocalization.map_units E s).ne_zero
  · simpa using hz

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteExtensionAtPrime_fractionRingTower
statement:
theorem finiteExtensionAtPrime_fractionRingTower
    (p : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] :
    letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S)
proof:
:=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := FractionRing S) p
    letI : Algebra (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D) :=
      finiteExtensionFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D)
    letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing D) :=
      finiteExtensionAtPrimeToFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) p
    IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S)
      (FractionRing D) := by
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S) :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := FractionRing S) p
  let : Algebra (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D) :=
    finiteExtensionFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D)
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing D) :=
    finiteExtensionAtPrimeToFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) p
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteExtensionAtPrime_literalFractionRingTower
statement:
theorem finiteExtensionAtPrime_literalFractionRingTower
    (p : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] :
    letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing D)
proof:
:=
      finiteExtensionAtPrimeToFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) p
    letI : Algebra (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime p))
        (FractionRing D) :=
      finiteExtensionAtPrimeFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) p
    IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime p)) (FractionRing D) := by
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S) :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := FractionRing S) p
  let : Algebra (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D) :=
    finiteExtensionFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D)
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing D) :=
    finiteExtensionAtPrimeToFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) p
  let : Algebra (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime p))
      (FractionRing D) :=
    finiteExtensionAtPrimeFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) p
  let : IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S)
      (FractionRing D) :=
    finiteExtensionAtPrime_fractionRingTower (S := S) (D := D) p
  exact fractionRingToExtension_isScalarTower
    (V := Localization.AtPrime p) (K := FractionRing S)
      (L := FractionRing D)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteExtensionAtPrime_fractionRing_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem finiteExtensionAtPrime_fractionRing_finiteDimensional
    (p : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] :

        (FractionRing D)
proof:
:=
      finiteExtensionAtPrimeFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) p
    FiniteDimensional (FractionRing (Localization.AtPrime p))
      (FractionRing D) := by
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S) :=

  let : SMul (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D) :=
    (finiteExtensionFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D)).toSMul
  let : Module (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D) :=
    (finiteExtensionFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D)).toModule

    infer_instance
  exact fractionRingToExtension_finiteDimensional
    (V := Localization.AtPrime p) (K := FractionRing S)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteLiesOverLocalization_fractionRingTower
statement:
theorem finiteLiesOverLocalization_fractionRingTower
    (p : Ideal S) (q : Ideal D) [p.IsPrime] [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] :
    letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)
proof:
:=
      finiteLiesOverLocalizationAlgebra p q
    letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) (FractionRing D) :=
      finiteLiesOverLocalizationToFractionRingAlgebra q
    letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing D) :=
      finiteExtensionAtPrimeToFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) p
    IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)
      (FractionRing D) := by
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q) :=
    finiteLiesOverLocalizationAlgebra p q
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) (FractionRing D) :=
    finiteLiesOverLocalizationToFractionRingAlgebra q
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing D) :=
    finiteExtensionAtPrimeToFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D) p
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S) :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := FractionRing S) p
  let : Algebra (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D) :=
    finiteExtensionFractionRingAlgebra (S := S) (D := D)
  let : IsScalarTower S (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (Localization.AtPrime q) := inferInstance
  let : IsScalarTower D (Localization.AtPrime q) (FractionRing D) :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower
      (K := FractionRing D) q
  let : IsScalarTower S (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S) :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower
      (K := FractionRing S) p
  let : IsScalarTower S (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D) :=
    FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra S (FractionRing D)
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext p.primeCompl
  ext x
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  change algebraMap (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D)
      (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S)
        (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime p) x)) =
    algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) (FractionRing D)
      (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime p) x))
  calc
    algebraMap (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D)
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (FractionRing S)
          (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime p) x)) =
        algebraMap (FractionRing S) (FractionRing D)
          (algebraMap S (FractionRing S) x) := by
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (FractionRing S)]
    _ = algebraMap S (FractionRing D) x :=
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S (FractionRing S)
        (FractionRing D) x).symm
    _ = algebraMap D (FractionRing D) (algebraMap S D x) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S D (FractionRing D) x
    _ = algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) (FractionRing D)
        (algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime q) (algebraMap S D x)) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply D (Localization.AtPrime q)
        (FractionRing D) (algebraMap S D x)
    _ = algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) (FractionRing D)
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)
          (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime p) x)) := by
      congr 1
      calc
        algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime q) (algebraMap S D x) =
            algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime q) x :=
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S D
            (Localization.AtPrime q) x).symm
        _ = algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)
            (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime p) x) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S (Localization.AtPrime p)
            (Localization.AtPrime q) x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrimeQuotientPowEquiv_factorPow
statement:
theorem localizationAtPrimeQuotientPowEquiv_factorPow
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (x : S ⧸ Q ^ n) :
    Ideal.Quotient.factorPow m_Q hmn
        (IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow Q S_Q n x) =
      IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow Q S_Q m
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow Q hmn x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ x =>
      change Ideal.Quotient.factorPow m_Q hmn
          (IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow Q S_Q n
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q ^ n) x)) =
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow Q S_Q m
          (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow Q hmn (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q ^ n) x))
      rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow_apply_mk,
        Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk,
        Ideal.Quotient.factor_mk,
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow_apply_mk]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrimeQuotientPowEquiv_symm_factorPow

        ((IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow Q S_Q n).symm x) =
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow Q S_Q m).symm
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow m_Q hmn x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow Q S_Q m).injective
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    ← localizationAtPrimeQuotientPowEquiv_factorPow Q hmn
      ((IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdealPow Q S_Q n).symm x),
    AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.completionToAtPrimeQuotientRingHom_compatible

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.quotientProdPowEquiv_mk

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.quotientProdPowEquiv_factorPow
statement:
private theorem quotientProdPowEquiv_factorPow
    (J : ι → Ideal R) (hJ : Pairwise (IsCoprime on J))
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (x : R ⧸ (∏ i, J i) ^ n) (i : ι) :
    Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (J i) hmn (quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ n x i) =
      quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ m
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (∏ i, J i) hmn x) i
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.quotientProdPowEquiv_symm_factorPow
statement:
private theorem quotientProdPowEquiv_symm_factorPow
    (J : ι → Ideal R) (hJ : Pairwise (IsCoprime on J))
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (x : ∀ i, R ⧸ J i ^ n) :
    Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (∏ i, J i) hmn
        ((quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ n).symm x) =
      (quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ m).symm
        (fun i => Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (J i) hmn (x i))
proof:
:= by
  apply (quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ m).injective
  funext i
  rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    ← quotientProdPowEquiv_factorPow J hJ hmn
      ((quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ n).symm x) i,
    RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.quotientProjectionRingHom_compatible
statement:
private theorem quotientProjectionRingHom_compatible
    (J : ι → Ideal R) (hJ : Pairwise (IsCoprime on J)) (i : ι) :
    ∀ {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n),
      (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (J i) hmn).comp
          (quotientProjectionRingHom J hJ i n) =
        quotientProjectionRingHom J hJ i m
proof:
:= by
  intro m n hmn
  ext x
  change Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (J i) hmn
      (quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ n
        (AdicCompletion.evalₐ (∏ j, J j) n x) i) =
    quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ m
      (AdicCompletion.evalₐ (∏ j, J j) m x) i
  rw [quotientProdPowEquiv_factorPow J hJ hmn,
    factorPow_evalₐ (∏ j, J j) hmn]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.quotientAssemblyRingHom_compatible
statement:
private theorem quotientAssemblyRingHom_compatible
    (J : ι → Ideal R) (hJ : Pairwise (IsCoprime on J)) :

      (Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (∏ i, J i) hmn).comp
          (quotientAssemblyRingHom J hJ n) =
        quotientAssemblyRingHom J hJ m
proof:
:= by
  intro m n hmn
  ext x
  change Ideal.Quotient.factorPow (∏ i, J i) hmn
      ((quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ n).symm
        (fun i => AdicCompletion.evalₐ (J i) n (x i))) =
    (quotientProdPowEquiv J hJ m).symm
      (fun i => AdicCompletion.evalₐ (J i) m (x i))
  rw [quotientProdPowEquiv_symm_factorPow J hJ hmn]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact factorPow_evalₐ (J i) hmn (x i)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily_apply
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B]
    (p : Ideal A) (Q : p.primesOver B) :
    integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily p Q =
      Q.1 ^ Q.1.ramificationIdx A
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily_pairwise
statement:
private theorem integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily_pairwise
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B]
    (p : Ideal A) [p.IsMaximal] :
    Pairwise (IsCoprime on integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily (B := B) p)
proof:
:= by
  intro Q Q' hQQ'
  exact (Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq.mpr
    (Ideal.IsMaximal.coprime_of_ne
      (Ideal.primesOver.isMaximal Q)
      (Ideal.primesOver.isMaximal Q')
      (Subtype.coe_injective.ne hQQ'))).pow

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralExtension_map_eq_prod_primePowerFamily
statement:
private theorem integralExtension_map_eq_prod_primePowerFamily
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B] [Module.IsTorsionFree A B]
    [Module.Finite A B]
    (p : Ideal A) [p.IsMaximal] (hp : p ≠ ⊥) :
    letI : Fintype (p.primesOver B)
proof:
:=
      integralExtensionPrimesOverFintype p
    p.map (algebraMap A B) =
      ∏ Q, integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily (B := B) p Q := by
  let : Fintype (p.primesOver B) :=
    integralExtensionPrimesOverFintype p
  rw [Ideal.map_algebraMap_eq_finsetProd_pow hp]
  simpa [integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily] using
    (Finset.prod_set_coe (s := p.primesOver B)
      (f := fun P => P ^ P.ramificationIdx A)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.adicCompletionIntegralExtensionEquivPi_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adicCompletionIntegralExtensionEquivPi_of
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B] [Module.IsTorsionFree A B]
    [Module.Finite A B] (p : Ideal A) [p.IsMaximal] (hp : p ≠ ⊥)
    (x : B) (Q : p.primesOver B) :
    adicCompletionIntegralExtensionEquivPi p hp
        (AdicCompletion.of (p.map (algebraMap A B)) B x) Q =
      AdicCompletion.of (Q.1 ^ Q.1.ramificationIdx A) B x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype (p.primesOver B) :=
    integralExtensionPrimesOverFintype p
  let J : p.primesOver B → Ideal B :=
    integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily p
  change (((adicCompletionIdealCongr
      (integralExtension_map_eq_prod_primePowerFamily p hp)).trans
        (adicCompletionProdEquivPi J
          (integralExtensionPrimePowerFamily_pairwise p)))
      (AdicCompletion.of (p.map (algebraMap A B)) B x)) Q = _
  rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply, adicCompletionIdealCongr_of]
  change adicCompletionProdEquivPi J _
      (AdicCompletion.of (∏ j, J j) B x) Q = _
  rw [adicCompletionProdEquivPi_of]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.length_le_depth

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.depth_of_subsingleton
statement:
lemma Module.depth_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] :
    Module.depth R M = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.depth, sSup_eq_top]
  rintro b hb
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hb.ne
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, exists_prop, ↓existsAndEq, and_true, Nat.cast_lt]
  refine ⟨List.replicate b.succ 0, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · refine  (Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_iff_Fin ..).mpr fun i ↦ ?_
    exact fun _ _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · intro r hr
    rw [List.eq_of_mem_replicate hr]
    exact zero_mem _
  · rw [List.length_replicate]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_self b

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.depth_of_isScalarTower

  refine sSup_le_sSup ?_
  rintro _ ⟨s, hs₁, hs₂, rfl⟩
  rw [← Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_map_algebraMap_iff S M s] at hs₁
  exact ⟨_, hs₁, by simpa, by rw [List.length_map]⟩

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.depth_le_krullDim_support
statement:
@[stacks 00LK]
lemma Module.depth_le_krullDim_support [Nontrivial M] [Module.Finite R M] :
    .some (Module.depth R M) ≤ Order.krullDim (Module.support R M)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Module.support R M) := by
    rwa [Set.nonempty_coe_sort, Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty,
      ne_eq, support_eq_empty_iff, not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial]
  cases h : Order.krullDim (Module.support R M) with
  | bot => simpa using Order.krullDim_nonneg.trans_eq h
  | coe n =>
  cases n with
  | top => exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  | coe n =>
  clear this
  simp only [WithBot.coe_le_coe, ge_iff_le]
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing M with
  | h n IH =>
    rw [depth, sSup_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨l, hl, hl', rfl⟩
    apply WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr ?_
    cases l with
    | nil => exact Nat.zero_le n
    | cons x l =>
    simp only [Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff] at hl
    have : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop x M) := by
      apply Submodule.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.2
      rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul, ne_comm]
      apply Submodule.top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator
      refine le_trans ?_ (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _)
      rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hl' _ List.mem_cons_self
    rw [Module.support_eq_zeroLocus, ← ringKrullDim_quotient] at h
    let f : (R ⧸ annihilator R M) ⧸ Ideal.span {(Ideal.Quotient.mk (annihilator R M)) x} →+*
        R ⧸ annihilator R (QuotSMulTop x M) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.lift _ (Ideal.quotientMap _ (.id R)
        (LinearMap.annihilator_le_of_surjective _ (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)))
        (show Ideal.span _ ≤ RingHom.ker _ by
          rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
          simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker]
          refine (Ideal.quotientMap_mk
            (J := annihilator R M) (I := annihilator R (QuotSMulTop x M))
            (f := RingHom.id R)
            (H := LinearMap.annihilator_le_of_surjective
              (Submodule.mkQ (x • (⊤ : Submodule R M)))
              (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)) (x := x)).trans ?_
          apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
          rw [Module.mem_annihilator]
          intro m
          obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
          rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
          exact ⟨m, trivial, rfl⟩)
    have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
      apply Ideal.Quotient.lift_surjective_of_surjective
      apply Ideal.Quotient.lift_surjective_of_surjective
      exact Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    have := ringKrullDim_quotient_succ_le_of_nonZeroDivisor (R := R ⧸ annihilator R M) (r := x) (by
      rw [← nonZeroDivisorsLeft_eq_nonZeroDivisors]
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
      simp only [← map_mul, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
        Module.mem_annihilator] at hz ⊢
      intro m
      apply hl.1
      simpa [smul_comm x, mul_smul] using hz m)
    rw [h] at this
    replace this := (add_le_add (ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective f hf) le_rfl).trans this
    cases h : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ annihilator R (QuotSMulTop x M)) with
    | bot =>
      have : Nontrivial (R ⧸ annihilator R (QuotSMulTop x M)) := by
        rw [Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff, ← Submodule.annihilator_top, ne_eq,
          Submodule.annihilator_eq_top_iff]
        exact top_ne_bot
      have := ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial.trans_eq h
      exact (WithBot.not_coe_le_bot (0 : ℕ∞) this).elim
    | coe m =>
    cases m with
    | top =>
      have : (⊤ : ℕ∞) ≤ (n : ℕ) := by
        apply WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp
        simp only [h] at this
        exact this
      cases (ENat.natCast_lt_top n).not_ge this
    | coe m =>
    rw [h] at this
    replace this : m + 1 ≤ n := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp (WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp this)
    replace IH := IH m (Nat.lt_of_succ_le this) (QuotSMulTop x M)
      (by rwa [Module.support_eq_zeroLocus, ← ringKrullDim_quotient])
    replace IH := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp
      ((Module.length_le_depth _ _ l hl.2 (by simp_all)).trans IH)
    · simp only [List.length_cons, ge_iff_le]
      linarith

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.depth_le_dim_annihilator
statement:
lemma Module.depth_le_dim_annihilator

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.isSMulRegular_iff_of_free
statement:
lemma isSMulRegular_iff_of_free {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Free R M] [Nontrivial M] {r : R} :
    IsSMulRegular M r ↔ IsSMulRegular R r
proof:
:= by
  let I := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M
  let b : Module.Basis I R M := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M
  constructor
  · intro H m n h
    have i : I := Nonempty.some inferInstance
    have := @H (m • b i) (n • b i) (by simp_all [← mul_smul])
    simpa using congr(b.repr $this i)
  · intro H m n h
    apply b.repr.injective
    ext i
    replace h := congr(b.repr $h i)
    simp only [map_smul] at h
    exact H h

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_of_subsingleton
statement:
lemma RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_of_subsingleton
    {R : Type*} (M : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Subsingleton R] (s : List R) : Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular M s
proof:
:=
  have : Subsingleton M := Module.subsingleton R M
  (isWeaklyRegular_iff_Fin ..).mpr fun _ _ _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_of_free_aux
statement:
lemma RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_of_free_aux
    {R : Type u} {M : Type max u v} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Free R M] [Nontrivial M] {s : List R} :
      Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular M s ↔ Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R s
proof:
:= by
  generalize hn : s.length = n
  induction n generalizing R M with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ n IH =>
    cases s with
    | nil => exact (Nat.succ_ne_zero n hn.symm).elim
    | cons x xs =>
    let e : QuotSMulTop x R ≃ₗ[R] R ⧸ Ideal.span {x} := Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _
      (by rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top])
    let e' := QuotSMulTop.equivQuotTensor x M
    rw [Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff, Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff,
      e.isWeaklyRegular_congr, e'.isWeaklyRegular_congr,
      ← isWeaklyRegular_map_algebraMap_iff (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}),
      ← isWeaklyRegular_map_algebraMap_iff (R := R) (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})]
    refine and_congr isSMulRegular_iff_of_free ?_
    cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
    · simp [RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_of_subsingleton]
    exact IH (by simp_all)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_of_free
statement:
lemma RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_of_free
    {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Free R M] [Nontrivial M] {s : List R} :
      Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular M s ↔ Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R s
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M
  have : Nontrivial R := Module.nontrivial R M
  rw [b.repr.isWeaklyRegular_congr, isWeaklyRegular_of_free_aux]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.depth_le_of_free
statement: lemma Module.depth_le_of_free [Module.Free R M] : Module.depth R R ≤ Module.depth R M
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial M
  · simp [Module.depth_of_subsingleton]
  apply sSup_le_sSup
  rintro _ ⟨s, hs, hs', rfl⟩
  refine ⟨s, Ws14Port.RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_of_free.mpr hs, hs', rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.faithfulSMul_of_depth_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
lemma Module.faithfulSMul_of_depth_eq_ringKrullDim [IsDomain R] [Nontrivial M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (H : ringKrullDim R < ⊤) (H' : .some (Module.depth R M) = ringKrullDim R) :
    FaithfulSMul R M
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial (R ⧸ annihilator R M) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.2
    (by rw [ne_eq, ← Submodule.annihilator_top, Submodule.annihilator_eq_top_iff]
        exact top_ne_bot)
  rw [← Module.annihilator_eq_bot]
  by_contra H''
  apply (le_refl ((.some (Module.depth R M)) : WithBot ℕ∞)).not_gt
  calc
    _ ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ annihilator R M) := Module.depth_le_dim_annihilator _ _
    _ < ringKrullDim R := by
      simp only [ringKrullDim, Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_length,
        WithBot.coe_lt_coe]
      rw [← ENat.add_one_le_iff, ENat.iSup_add, iSup_le_iff]
      · intro l
        let l' : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R) := (l.map
          (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)) ?_).cons ⊥ ?_
        · refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup _ l')
          change _ ≤ ((0 + l.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
          simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, le_refl]
        · intros I J
          change I < J → I.asIdeal.comap _ < J.asIdeal.comap _
          simp [lt_iff_le_not_ge, ← Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap,
            Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
        · refine (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr H'').trans_le ?_
          conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.mk_ker (I := annihilator R M), RingHom.ker]
          exact Ideal.comap_mono bot_le
      · rw [← lt_top_iff_ne_top]
        apply WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp
        rw [← Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_length, ← ringKrullDim]
        refine (ringKrullDim_quotient_le _).trans_lt H
    _ = .some (Module.depth R M) := H'.symm

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.PowerSeries.isSMulRegular_X

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.PowerSeries.quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_mk
statement:

lemma quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_mk (f : R⟦X⟧) :

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.PowerSeries.quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_smul
statement:
lemma quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_smul (r : R) (m : QuotSMulTop (X : R⟦X⟧) R⟦X⟧) :
    quotXSMulTopAddEquiv ((C r : R⟦X⟧) • m) = r • quotXSMulTopAddEquiv m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_mk, quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_mk,

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.PowerSeries.isWeaklyRegular_X_cons_map_C

lemma isWeaklyRegular_X_cons_map_C {s : List R} (hs : Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R s) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff]
  refine ⟨isSMulRegular_X, ?_⟩
  rw [AddEquiv.isWeaklyRegular_congr (e := quotXSMulTopAddEquiv)
    (bs := s) (List.forall₂_map_left_iff.mpr (List.forall₂_same.mpr
      fun r _ m ↦ quotXSMulTopAddEquiv_smul r m))]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.PowerSeries.le_depth_of_isWeaklyRegular
statement:
lemma le_depth_of_isWeaklyRegular {s : List R} (hs : Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R s)
    (hs' : ∀ r ∈ s, r ∈ maximalIdeal R) :
    (s.length : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ Module.depth R⟦X⟧ R⟦X⟧
proof:
:= by
  have key := Module.length_le_depth R⟦X⟧ R⟦X⟧ ((X : R⟦X⟧) :: s.map C)
    (isWeaklyRegular_X_cons_map_C hs) ?_
  · simpa [add_comm] using key
  · rintro r hr
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hr with rfl | hr
    · exact X_mem_maximalIdeal
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
      exact C_mem_maximalIdeal (hs' a ha)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.PowerSeries.natCast_succ_le_depth
statement:
lemma natCast_succ_le_depth {d : ℕ} (hd : (d : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth R R) :
    ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth R⟦X⟧ R⟦X⟧
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs', hlen⟩ : ∃ s : List R, Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R s ∧
      (∀ r ∈ s, r ∈ maximalIdeal R) ∧ d ≤ s.length := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with rfl | hd0
    · exact ⟨[], (Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_iff_Fin _ _).mpr (fun i ↦ i.elim0),
        (by intro r hr; cases hr), Nat.zero_le _⟩
    · have hlt : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) < Module.depth R R :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.cast_lt.mpr (Nat.sub_lt hd0 one_pos)) hd
      rw [Module.depth, lt_sSup_iff] at hlt
      obtain ⟨b, ⟨s, hs, hs', rfl⟩, hb⟩ := hlt
      refine ⟨s, hs, hs', ?_⟩
      have hlen' : (d - 1 : ℕ) < s.length := Nat.cast_lt.mp hb
      omega
  refine le_trans ?_ (le_depth_of_isWeaklyRegular R hs hs')
  have key : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((s.length + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
    Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.succ_le_succ hlen)
  simpa [Nat.cast_add] using key

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.PowerSeries.ringKrullDim_powerSeries
statement: lemma ringKrullDim_powerSeries : ringKrullDim R⟦X⟧ = ringKrullDim R + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim
    (R := R⟦X⟧) (x := X) isSMulRegular_X X_mem_maximalIdeal
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (quotSpanXEquiv (R := R))] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.IsLocalRing.IsCohenMacaulayOfDim.patching_hypotheses
statement:
lemma patching_hypotheses {Λ Rₒₒ : Type*} [CommRing Λ] [IsLocalRing Λ] [CommRing Rₒₒ]
    [IsLocalRing Rₒₒ] [IsNoetherianRing Rₒₒ]
    (hΛ : IsCohenMacaulayOfDim Λ d) (hR : IsCohenMacaulayOfDim Rₒₒ d) :
    ringKrullDim Rₒₒ < ⊤ ∧ .some (Module.depth Λ Λ) = ringKrullDim Rₒₒ

name: Module.depth_le_depth_of_ringEquiv
statement:
private lemma _root_.Module.depth_le_depth_of_ringEquiv {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] (e : R ≃+* S) :
    Module.depth R R ≤ Module.depth S S
proof:
:= by
  refine sSup_le_sSup ?_
  rintro _ ⟨s, hs, hs', rfl⟩
  refine ⟨s.map e, ?_, ?_, by rw [List.length_map]⟩
  · exact (AddEquiv.isWeaklyRegular_congr (e := e.toAddEquiv)
      (List.forall₂_map_right_iff.mpr (List.forall₂_same.mpr
        fun r _ x ↦ by simp [smul_eq_mul]))).mp hs
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hb
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
    intro hu
    exact mem_nonunits_iff.mp ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal a).mp (hs' a ha))
      (by simpa using hu.map e.symm.toRingHom)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.IsLocalRing.IsCohenMacaulayOfDim.of_ringEquiv
statement:
lemma of_ringEquiv {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] (e : R ≃+* S)
    (h : IsCohenMacaulayOfDim R d) : IsCohenMacaulayOfDim S d
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e).symm.trans h.1, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · exact (Module.depth_le_depth_of_ringEquiv e.symm).trans (le_of_eq h.2)
  · exact (le_of_eq h.2.symm).trans (Module.depth_le_depth_of_ringEquiv e)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.IsLocalRing.IsCohenMacaulayOfDim.of_field
statement: lemma of_field (K : Type*) [Field K] : IsCohenMacaulayOfDim K 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field K]; rfl, le_antisymm ?_ zero_le⟩
  have h := Module.depth_le_dim K K
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field K] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.IsLocalRing.IsCohenMacaulayOfDim.of_isDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
lemma of_isDiscreteValuationRing (𝓞 : Type*) [CommRing 𝓞] [IsDomain 𝓞]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing 𝓞] : IsCohenMacaulayOfDim 𝓞 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : ringKrullDim 𝓞 = 1 :=
    IsPrincipalIdealRing.ringKrullDim_eq_one 𝓞 (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField 𝓞)
  refine ⟨by exact_mod_cast hdim, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · have h := Module.depth_le_dim 𝓞 𝓞
    rw [hdim] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  · obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible 𝓞
    have hreg : Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular 𝓞 [π] := by
      rw [show [π] = π :: ([] : List 𝓞) from rfl, Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff]
      refine ⟨fun a b h ↦ mul_left_cancel₀ hπ.ne_zero ?_,
        (Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_iff_Fin _ _).mpr (fun i ↦ i.elim0)⟩
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using h
    have hmem : ∀ r ∈ [π], r ∈ maximalIdeal 𝓞 := by
      intro r hr
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hr
      subst hr
      rw [hπ.maximalIdeal_eq]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    simpa using Module.length_le_depth 𝓞 𝓞 [π] hreg hmem

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.PowerSeries.isCohenMacaulayOfDim_succ
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : ringKrullDim R⟦X⟧ = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_powerSeries, h.ringKrullDim_eq]
    push_cast
    rfl
  refine ⟨hdim, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · have hle := Module.depth_le_dim R⟦X⟧ R⟦X⟧
    rw [hdim] at hle
    exact_mod_cast hle
  · exact natCast_succ_le_depth R (le_of_eq h.depth_eq.symm)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.exists_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos
statement:
lemma Module.exists_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos (h : 0 < Module.depth R M) :
    ∃ x ∈ maximalIdeal R, IsSMulRegular M x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hpos⟩ := lt_sSup_iff.mp h
  obtain ⟨s, hreg, hmem, rfl⟩ := hb
  cases s with
  | nil => exact (lt_irrefl (0 : ℕ∞) hpos).elim
  | cons x rest =>
      rw [Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff] at hreg
      exact ⟨x, hmem x List.mem_cons_self, hreg.1⟩

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.depth_pos_of_isSMulRegular
statement:
lemma Module.depth_pos_of_isSMulRegular {x : R} (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (hreg : IsSMulRegular M x) : 0 < Module.depth R M
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Module.depth R M := by
    simpa using Module.length_le_depth R M [x]
      ((Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff M x).mpr hreg) (by simpa using hx)
  exact zero_lt_one.trans_le h1

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.depth_pos_iff_exists_isSMulRegular
statement:
lemma Module.depth_pos_iff_exists_isSMulRegular :
    0 < Module.depth R M ↔ ∃ x ∈ maximalIdeal R, IsSMulRegular M x
proof:
:=
  ⟨Module.exists_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos R M, fun ⟨_, hx, hreg⟩ =>
    Module.depth_pos_of_isSMulRegular R M hx hreg⟩

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.maximalIdeal_ne_bot_of_depth_pos
statement:
lemma Module.maximalIdeal_ne_bot_of_depth_pos [Nontrivial M] (h : 0 < Module.depth R M) :
    maximalIdeal R ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxm, hreg⟩ := Module.exists_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos R M h
  intro hbot
  rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at hxm
  subst hxm
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_pair_ne M
  exact hab (hreg ((zero_smul R a).trans (zero_smul R b).symm))

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_ne_bot_of_ringKrullDim_pos
statement:
lemma IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_ne_bot_of_ringKrullDim_pos (hdim : 0 < ringKrullDim R) :

proof:
:= by

  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField
    (IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mpr hbot)] at hdim

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.maximalIdeal_notMem_associatedPrimes_of_depth_pos
statement:
lemma Module.maximalIdeal_notMem_associatedPrimes_of_depth_pos [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (h : 0 < Module.depth R M) : maximalIdeal R ∉ associatedPrimes R M
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨x, hxm, hreg⟩ := Module.exists_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos R M h
  have hx_in : x ∈ ⋃ p ∈ associatedPrimes R M, (p : Set R) := Set.mem_biUnion hmem hxm
  rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_compl_regular R M] at hx_in
  exact hx_in hreg

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.IsLocalRing.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular_of_notMem_associatedPrimes
statement:
theorem IsLocalRing.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular_of_notMem_associatedPrimes
    (hR : maximalIdeal R ∉ associatedPrimes R R)
    (hM : maximalIdeal R ∉ associatedPrimes R M)
    (hbot : maximalIdeal R ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ x ∈ maximalIdeal R,
      x ∉ (maximalIdeal R) ^ 2 ∧ IsSMulRegular R x ∧ IsSMulRegular M x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : (insert ((maximalIdeal R) ^ 2)
      (associatedPrimes R R ∪ associatedPrimes R M)).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.insert _ ((associatedPrimes.finite R R).union (associatedPrimes.finite R M))
  have hnotle : ¬ ∃ I ∈ hfin.toFinset, maximalIdeal R ≤ I := by
    rintro ⟨I, hIs, hle⟩
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_union] at hIs
    rcases hIs with rfl | hI | hI
    · refine hbot (Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (maximalIdeal R)
        (maximalIdeal R) (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) ?_
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _))
      rwa [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← pow_two]
    · have heq : I = maximalIdeal R :=
        (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff.mp hI).isPrime.ne_top).antisymm
          hle
      exact hR (heq ▸ hI)
    · have heq : I = maximalIdeal R :=
        (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff.mp hI).isPrime.ne_top).antisymm
          hle
      exact hM (heq ▸ hI)
  have havoid : ¬ ((maximalIdeal R : Set R) ⊆
      ⋃ I ∈ (hfin.toFinset : Set (Ideal R)), (I : Set R)) := by
    intro hsub
    refine hnotle ((Ideal.subset_union_prime (s := hfin.toFinset) (f := fun I => I)
      ((maximalIdeal R) ^ 2) ((maximalIdeal R) ^ 2) ?_).mp hsub)
    intro I hIs hI₁ _
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_union] at hIs
    rcases hIs with rfl | hI | hI
    · exact absurd rfl hI₁
    · exact (AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff.mp hI).isPrime
    · exact (AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff.mp hI).isPrime
  rw [hfin.coe_toFinset] at havoid
  obtain ⟨x, hxm, hxout⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp havoid
  refine ⟨x, hxm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hx2
    exact hxout (Set.mem_biUnion (Set.mem_insert _ _) hx2)
  · have hxnot : x ∉ ⋃ p ∈ associatedPrimes R R, (p : Set R) := fun hx =>
      hxout (Set.biUnion_subset_biUnion_left (fun p hp =>
        Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_union_left _ hp)) hx)
    rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_compl_regular R R] at hxnot
    simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_not] using hxnot
  · have hxnot : x ∉ ⋃ p ∈ associatedPrimes R M, (p : Set R) := fun hx =>
      hxout (Set.biUnion_subset_biUnion_left (fun p hp =>
        Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_union_right _ hp)) hx)
    rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_compl_regular R M] at hxnot
    simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_not] using hxnot

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos
statement:
theorem Module.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (hR : 0 < Module.depth R R) (hM : 0 < Module.depth R M) :
    ∃ x ∈ maximalIdeal R,

proof:
:=
  IsLocalRing.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular_of_notMem_associatedPrimes R M
    (Module.maximalIdeal_notMem_associatedPrimes_of_depth_pos R R hR)
    (Module.maximalIdeal_notMem_associatedPrimes_of_depth_pos R M hM)
    (Module.maximalIdeal_ne_bot_of_depth_pos R R hR)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.IsLocalRing.IsCohenMacaulayOfDim.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular
statement:
theorem IsLocalRing.IsCohenMacaulayOfDim.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {d : ℕ}

    (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.Algebra.Proofs.Module_depth_quotSMulTop_succ_eq.Ws14Port.Module.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem Module.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos_of_isDomain
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsDomain R]
    (M : Type*) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (hM : 0 < Module.depth R M) (hdim : 0 < ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ x ∈ maximalIdeal R,
      x ∉ (maximalIdeal R) ^ 2 ∧ IsSMulRegular R x ∧ IsSMulRegular M x
proof:
:= by
  refine Module.exists_isSMulRegular_and_isSMulRegular_of_depth_pos R M ?_ hM
  obtain ⟨y, hym, hy0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).mp
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_ne_bot_of_ringKrullDim_pos R hdim)
  refine Module.depth_pos_of_isSMulRegular R R hym ?_
