name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.QuotSMulTop.free_self
statement: theorem free_self : Module.Free (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x R)
proof:
:= by
  set f : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) →ₗ[R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}] QuotSMulTop x R :=
    LinearMap.toSpanSingleton (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x R)
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (1 : R)) with hf_def
  have hf_apply : ∀ r : R,
      f (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}) r) = (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : QuotSMulTop x R) := by
    intro r
    rw [hf_def, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, mk_smul_mk, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective c
    rw [hf_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hc
    obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := hc
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro q
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ q
    exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r, hf_apply r⟩
  exact Module.Free.of_equiv (LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.QuotSMulTop.span_eq_top_of_span_quotientMk_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_eq_top_of_span_quotientMk_eq_top [Module.Finite R M]
    (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) {ι : Type*} (m : ι → M)
    (hspan : Submodule.span (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
      (Set.range fun i => (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m i) : QuotSMulTop x M)) = ⊤) :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range m) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Submodule.span R
      (Set.range fun i => (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m i) : QuotSMulTop x M)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← Submodule.restrictScalars_span R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
      hspan, Submodule.restrictScalars_top]
  have h2 : (Submodule.span R (Set.range m)).map
      (Submodule.mkQ (x • ⊤ : Submodule R M)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    exact h1
  rw [Submodule.map_mkQ_eq_top] at h2
  refine top_le_iff.mp (Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot Module.Finite.fg_top
    (span_le_jacobson_bot x hx) ?_)
  rw [Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul, sup_comm, h2]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.QuotSMulTop.linearIndependent_of_quotientMk_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_of_quotientMk_linearIndependent [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hreg : IsSMulRegular M x) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (m : ι → M)
    (hli : LinearIndependent (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
      (fun i => (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m i) : QuotSMulTop x M))) :
    LinearIndependent R m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hker_le : LinearMap.ker (Fintype.linearCombination R m) ≤
      Ideal.span {x} • LinearMap.ker (Fintype.linearCombination R m) := by
    intro a ha
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Fintype.linearCombination_apply] at ha
    have hcoeff : ∀ i, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}) (a i) = 0 := by
      have h0 : ∑ i, (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}) (a i)) •
          (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m i) : QuotSMulTop x M) = 0 := by
        have hterm : ∀ i, (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}) (a i)) •
            (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m i) : QuotSMulTop x M)
            = (Submodule.mkQ (x • ⊤ : Submodule R M)) (a i • m i) := fun i => rfl
        simp_rw [hterm, ← map_sum, ha, map_zero]
      exact Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hli _ h0
    have hdvd : ∀ i, x ∣ a i := fun i =>
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp (hcoeff i))
    choose c hc using hdvd
    have ha_eq : a = x • c := funext fun i => by
      rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; exact hc i
    have hc_ker : c ∈ LinearMap.ker (Fintype.linearCombination R m) := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      apply hreg
      change x • Fintype.linearCombination R m c = x • (0 : M)
      rw [smul_zero, ← map_smul, ← ha_eq]
      exact ha
    rw [ha_eq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x) hc_ker
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (Fintype.linearCombination R m) = ⊥ :=
    Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (Ideal.span {x}) _
      (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) hker_le (span_le_jacobson_bot x hx)
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg i
  have hg_ker : g ∈ LinearMap.ker (Fintype.linearCombination R m) := by
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
    exact hg
  rw [hker, Submodule.mem_bot] at hg_ker
  exact congrFun hg_ker i

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.QuotSMulTop.exists_basis_lift
statement:
theorem exists_basis_lift (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hreg : IsSMulRegular M x)
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)) :
    ∃ b' : Module.Basis ι R M,
      ∀ i, (Submodule.Quotient.mk (b' i) : QuotSMulTop x M) = b i
proof:
:= by
  choose m hm using fun i =>
    Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective (x • ⊤ : Submodule R M) (b i)
  have hmk_eq : (fun i => (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m i) : QuotSMulTop x M)) = ⇑b := funext hm
  have hli : LinearIndependent (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
      (fun i => (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m i) : QuotSMulTop x M)) := by
    rw [hmk_eq]; exact b.linearIndependent
  have hspan : Submodule.span (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
      (Set.range fun i => (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m i) : QuotSMulTop x M)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hmk_eq]; exact b.span_eq
  have hli' : LinearIndependent R m :=
    linearIndependent_of_quotientMk_linearIndependent x hx hreg m hli
  have hspan' : Submodule.span R (Set.range m) = ⊤ :=
    span_eq_top_of_span_quotientMk_eq_top x hx m hspan
  refine ⟨Module.Basis.mk hli' hspan'.ge, fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [Module.Basis.mk_apply]
  exact hm i

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.Module.free_of_quotSMulTop_free
statement:
theorem Module.free_of_quotSMulTop_free (x : R) (hx : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hreg : IsSMulRegular M x)
    (hfree : Module.Free (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)) :
    Module.Free R M
proof:
:= by
  let _ := hfree
  let _ := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)
  let _ : Fintype (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)) :=
    Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex.fintype _ _
  obtain ⟨b', -⟩ := QuotSMulTop.exists_basis_lift x hx hreg
    (Module.Free.chooseBasis (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M))
  exact Module.Free.of_basis b'

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.Module.free_of_quotSMulTop_free_of_regular_param
statement:

    (hx : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (_hx2 : x ∉ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ^ 2)
    (_hregR : IsSMulRegular R x) (hregM : IsSMulRegular M x)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.Module.finrank_quotSMulTop_eq
statement:
theorem Module.finrank_quotSMulTop_eq (x : R) (hx : x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hreg : IsSMulRegular M x)
    (hfree : Module.Free (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)) :
    Module.finrank (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M) = Module.finrank R M
proof:
:= by
  let _ := hfree
  let _ : Nontrivial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := QuotSMulTop.nontrivial_quotientRing x hx
  let _ := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)
  let _ : Fintype (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)) :=
    Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex.fintype _ _
  obtain ⟨b', -⟩ := QuotSMulTop.exists_basis_lift x hx hreg
    (Module.Free.chooseBasis (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M))
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b',
    Module.finrank_eq_card_basis
      (Module.Free.chooseBasis (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M))]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.isLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
private theorem isLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton [IsLocalRing R] {x : R}
    (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Ideal.span {x} ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top
      (top_le_iff.mp (h ▸ Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hx)))
  let _ : Nontrivial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hne
  exact IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun r m => by

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.moduleFinite_quotient_span_singleton

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.nontrivial_quotSMulTop_of_mem_maximalIdeal
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.2
  rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul, ne_comm]
  apply Submodule.top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator
  refine le_trans ?_ (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _)
  rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast
statement:
theorem exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsLocalRing R] : ∃ d : ℕ, ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ringKrullDim R ≠ ⊤ := ringKrullDim_ne_top
  have h2 : ringKrullDim R ≠ ⊥ := ringKrullDim_ne_bot
  cases hd : ringKrullDim R with
  | bot => exact absurd hd h2
  | coe d =>
    cases d with
    | top => exact absurd hd (by simpa using h1)
    | coe d => exact ⟨d, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.free_of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_zero

  let _ : Field R := (isField_of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_zero R hn).toField
  exact Module.Free.of_divisionRing R M

statement: theorem free_of_ringKrullDim_eq_zero (hdim : ringKrullDim R = 0) : Module.Free R M
proof:
:= by

  have h := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.exists_finite_span_eq_maximalIdeal_mem
statement:
theorem exists_finite_span_eq_maximalIdeal_mem [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hx2 : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    ∃ S : Set R, x ∈ S ∧ S.Finite ∧ S.ncard ≤ (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ∧
      Ideal.span S = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set ξ : CotangentSpace R := (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ⟨x, hx⟩ with hξdef
  have hξ0 : ξ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hξdef, ne_eq, Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero]
    exact hx2
  have hli : LinearIndepOn (ResidueField R) id ({ξ} : Set (CotangentSpace R)) := by
    refine LinearIndepOn.singleton' ?_
    intro r hr
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hr with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hξ0
  obtain ⟨B, hξB, hBfin, hBcard, hBspan⟩ :
      ∃ B : Set (CotangentSpace R), ξ ∈ B ∧ B.Finite ∧
        B.ncard = (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ∧
        Submodule.span (ResidueField R) B = ⊤ := by
    refine ⟨hli.extend (Set.subset_univ _),
      hli.subset_extend _ (Set.mem_singleton ξ), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · let _ : Finite (hli.extend (Set.subset_univ ({ξ} : Set (CotangentSpace R)))) :=
        Module.Finite.finite_basis (Module.Basis.extend hli)
      exact Set.toFinite _
    · let _ : Finite (hli.extend (Set.subset_univ ({ξ} : Set (CotangentSpace R)))) :=
        Module.Finite.finite_basis (Module.Basis.extend hli)
      let _ : Fintype (hli.extend (Set.subset_univ ({ξ} : Set (CotangentSpace R)))) :=
        Fintype.ofFinite _
      rw [IsLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace R,
        Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (Module.Basis.extend hli),
        ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    · have h1 := (Module.Basis.extend hli).span_eq
      rwa [Module.Basis.range_extend] at h1
  choose lift hlift using (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent_surjective
  set S₀ : Set ↥(maximalIdeal R) := insert ⟨x, hx⟩ (lift '' (B \ {ξ})) with hS₀def
  have himg : (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent '' S₀ = B := by
    rw [hS₀def, Set.image_insert_eq, ← hξdef, ← Set.image_comp]
    have hcomp : ((maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ∘ lift) '' (B \ {ξ}) = B \ {ξ} := by
      have : ∀ v ∈ B \ {ξ}, ((maximalIdeal R).toCotangent ∘ lift) v = id v :=
        fun v _ => hlift v
      rw [Set.image_congr this, Set.image_id]
    rw [hcomp, Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.insert_eq_self.mpr hξB]
  have hspanR : Submodule.span R S₀ = ⊤ := by
    apply IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff.mp
    rw [himg, hBspan]
  have hspan : Ideal.span ((↑) '' S₀ : Set R) = maximalIdeal R := by
    have hmap := congrArg (Submodule.map (maximalIdeal R).subtype) hspanR
    rwa [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype] at hmap
  refine ⟨(↑) '' S₀, ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, by rw [hS₀def]; exact Set.mem_insert _ _, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, hspan⟩
  · rw [hS₀def]
    exact (((hBfin.sdiff).image _).insert _).image _
  · have hfin₁ : (lift '' (B \ {ξ})).Finite := (hBfin.sdiff).image _
    have h1 : ((↑) '' S₀ : Set R).ncard ≤ S₀.ncard := by
      apply Set.ncard_image_le
      rw [hS₀def]; exact hfin₁.insert _
    have h2 : S₀.ncard ≤ (lift '' (B \ {ξ})).ncard + 1 := by
      rw [hS₀def]; exact Set.ncard_insert_le _ _
    have h3 : (lift '' (B \ {ξ})).ncard ≤ (B \ {ξ}).ncard :=
      Set.ncard_image_le hBfin.sdiff
    have h4 : (B \ {ξ}).ncard + 1 = B.ncard :=
      Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hξB hBfin
    omega

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton
    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hx2 : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2)
    (hxreg : IsSMulRegular R x) [IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})] :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧
      (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 =
        (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hxS, hSfin, hScard, hSspan⟩ :=
    exists_finite_span_eq_maximalIdeal_mem R hx hx2
  have hmax' : (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) =
      maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
    IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmkx : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) x = 0 := by
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hmap : (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) =
      Ideal.span ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) '' (S \ {x})) := by
    rw [← hSspan, Ideal.map_span]
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · subst hyx
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hmkx]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨y, ⟨hy, hyx⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_mono Set.sdiff_subset)
  have hsf_le : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 ≤
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank := by
    have h1 : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank ≤ (S \ {x}).ncard := by
      rw [← hmax', hmap]
      exact le_trans
        (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite ((hSfin.sdiff).image _))
        (Set.ncard_image_le hSfin.sdiff)
    have h2 : (S \ {x}).ncard + 1 = S.ncard :=
      Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hxS hSfin
    omega
  have hkrull : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ≤
      ((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal _
  have hdrop : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) + 1 = ringKrullDim R :=
    ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim hxreg hx
  have hregR : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
  have hsqueeze : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ≤
      (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 := by
    have hcalc : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hregR, ← hdrop]
      calc ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) + 1
          ≤ ((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 :=
            add_le_add hkrull le_rfl
        _ = (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
            push_cast
            ring
    exact_mod_cast hcalc
  have hkey : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 =
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank := by omega
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
  have hd1 : (d : ℕ) + 1 = (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 := by
    have hcast : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      have h5 : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) + 1 =
          (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        rw [hdrop, ← hregR]
        exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → WithBot ℕ∞) hkey.symm
      rw [hd] at h5
      rw [← h5]
      push_cast
      ring
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  refine ⟨IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le _ ?_, hkey⟩
  rw [hd]
  have : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank = d := by omega
  exact_mod_cast this.le

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.free_of_depth_eq_ringKrullDim_aux
statement:
theorem free_of_depth_eq_ringKrullDim_aux
    (hsel : JointRegularElementSelection.{u, v})
    (hdrop : DepthDropQuotient.{u, v})
    (hstep : QuotientInductionStep.{u, v}) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
      (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M],
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = n →
      .some (Module.depth R M) = ringKrullDim R → Module.Free R M
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro R _ _ M _ _ _ hn _
    exact free_of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_zero R M hn
  | succ n IH =>
    intro R _ _ M _ _ _ hn H
    have hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R), hn]
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial M with hM | hM
    · exact Module.Free.of_subsingleton R M
    have hdepth : Module.depth R M = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      have h1 : (.some (Module.depth R M) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        H.trans hdim
      exact_mod_cast h1
    have hdepth_pos : 0 < Module.depth R M := by
      rw [hdepth]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n
    have hdim_pos : 0 < ringKrullDim R := by
      rw [hdim]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n
    obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, hx_sq, hxR, hxM⟩ := hsel R M hdepth_pos hdim_pos
    let _ : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      isLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton hx_mem
    let _ : IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M) :=
      isScalarTower_quotient_span_singleton x
    let _ : Module.Finite (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M) :=
      moduleFinite_quotient_span_singleton x
    obtain ⟨hreg', hsf'⟩ := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton R hx_mem hx_sq hxR
    let _ := hreg'
    have hsf'n : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank = n := by
      rw [hn] at hsf'
      omega
    have hdd := hdrop R M x hx_mem hxR hxM
    have hdepth' : Module.depth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M) = (n : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hdepth] at hdd
      have hcast : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) = ((n : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hcast] at hdd
      exact WithTop.add_right_cancel ENat.one_ne_top hdd
    have hH' : (.some (Module.depth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
      rw [hdepth', ← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
        (R := R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}), hsf'n]
      rfl
    have hfree' : Module.Free (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M) :=
      IH (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x M) hsf'n hH'
    exact hstep R M x hx_mem hx_sq hxR hxM hfree'

statement:

    (hsel : JointRegularElementSelection.{u, v})
    (hdrop : DepthDropQuotient.{u, v})
    (hstep : QuotientInductionStep.{u, v})
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.maximalIdeal_notMem_minimalPrimes_of_ringKrullDim_pos
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_notMem_minimalPrimes_of_ringKrullDim_pos
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (hdim : 0 < ringKrullDim R) :
    maximalIdeal R ∉ minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hall : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, p.asIdeal = maximalIdeal R := fun p =>
    le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal p.isPrime.ne_top)
      (hmem.2 ⟨p.isPrime, bot_le⟩ (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal p.isPrime.ne_top))
  let _ : Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum R) :=
    ⟨fun p q => PrimeSpectrum.ext ((hall p).trans (hall q).symm)⟩
  have heq : ringKrullDim R = 0 := by
    rw [ringKrullDim]
    let _ : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum R) := ⟨⟨maximalIdeal R, inferInstance⟩⟩
    let _ : Unique (PrimeSpectrum R) := uniqueOfSubsingleton (Classical.arbitrary _)
    exact Order.krullDim_eq_zero_of_unique
  rw [heq] at hdim
  exact hdim.false

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.exists_parameter_notMem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem exists_parameter_notMem_minimalPrimes
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (hdim : 0 < ringKrullDim R) :
    ∃ x ∈ maximalIdeal R, x ∉ (maximalIdeal R) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes R, x ∉ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hbot : maximalIdeal R ≠ ⊥ :=
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_ne_bot_of_ringKrullDim_pos R hdim
  have hfin : (insert ((maximalIdeal R) ^ 2) (minimalPrimes R)).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.insert _ (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing R)
  have hnotle : ¬ ∃ I ∈ hfin.toFinset, maximalIdeal R ≤ I := by
    rintro ⟨I, hIs, hle⟩
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_insert_iff] at hIs
    rcases hIs with rfl | hI
    · refine hbot (Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (maximalIdeal R)
        (maximalIdeal R) (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) ?_
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _))
      rwa [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← pow_two]
    · have hp_prime : I.IsPrime := Ideal.IsMinimalPrime.isPrime hI
      have heq : I = maximalIdeal R :=
        (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hp_prime.ne_top).antisymm hle
      rw [heq] at hI
      exact maximalIdeal_notMem_minimalPrimes_of_ringKrullDim_pos R hdim hI
  have havoid : ¬ ((maximalIdeal R : Set R) ⊆
      ⋃ I ∈ (hfin.toFinset : Set (Ideal R)), (I : Set R)) := by
    intro hsub
    refine hnotle ((Ideal.subset_union_prime (s := hfin.toFinset) (f := fun I => I)
      ((maximalIdeal R) ^ 2) ((maximalIdeal R) ^ 2) ?_).mp hsub)
    intro I hIs hI₁ _
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_insert_iff] at hIs
    rcases hIs with rfl | hI
    · exact absurd rfl hI₁
    · exact Ideal.IsMinimalPrime.isPrime hI
  rw [hfin.coe_toFinset] at havoid
  obtain ⟨x, hxm, hxout⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp havoid
  refine ⟨x, hxm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hx2
    exact hxout (Set.mem_biUnion (Set.mem_insert _ _) hx2)
  · intro p hp hxp
    exact hxout (Set.mem_biUnion (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hp) hxp)

statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotSMulTop_succ_eq_of_forall_notMem_minimalPrimes
    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hxmin : ∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes R, x ∉ p) :
    ringKrullDim (QuotSMulTop x R) + 1 = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by

  refine Module.supportDim_quotSMulTop_succ_eq_of_notMem_minimalPrimes_of_mem_maximalIdeal
    ?_ hx

statement:

    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hxmin : ∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes R, x ∉ p) :

proof:
:= by
  have hkey : ringKrullDim (QuotSMulTop x R) + 1 = ringKrullDim R :=
    ringKrullDim_quotSMulTop_succ_eq_of_forall_notMem_minimalPrimes hx hxmin
  have hspan : Ideal.span {x} = x • (⊤ : Ideal R) := by
    simp [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]

  exact hkey

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_of_forall_notMem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_of_forall_notMem_minimalPrimes
    {x : R} (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hx2 : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2)
    (hxmin : ∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes R, x ∉ p) [IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})] :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ∧
      (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 =
        (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hxS, hSfin, hScard, hSspan⟩ :=
    exists_finite_span_eq_maximalIdeal_mem R hx hx2
  have hmax' : (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) =
      maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
    IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmkx : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) x = 0 := by
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hmap : (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) =
      Ideal.span ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) '' (S \ {x})) := by
    rw [← hSspan, Ideal.map_span]
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · subst hyx
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hmkx]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨y, ⟨hy, hyx⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_mono Set.sdiff_subset)
  have hsf_le : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 ≤
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank := by
    have h1 : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank ≤ (S \ {x}).ncard := by
      rw [← hmax', hmap]
      exact le_trans
        (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite ((hSfin.sdiff).image _))
        (Set.ncard_image_le hSfin.sdiff)
    have h2 : (S \ {x}).ncard + 1 = S.ncard :=
      Set.ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hxS hSfin
    omega
  have hkrull : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ≤
      ((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal _
  have hdrop : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) + 1 = ringKrullDim R :=
    ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_of_forall_notMem_minimalPrimes hx hxmin
  have hregR : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
  have hsqueeze : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ≤
      (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 := by
    have hcalc : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hregR, ← hdrop]
      calc ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) + 1
          ≤ ((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 :=
            add_le_add hkrull le_rfl
        _ = (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
            push_cast
            ring
    exact_mod_cast hcalc
  have hkey : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 =
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank := by omega
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_eq_natCast (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})
  have hd1 : (d : ℕ) + 1 = (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 := by
    have hcast : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      have h5 : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) + 1 =
          (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        rw [hdrop, ← hregR]
        exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → WithBot ℕ∞) hkey.symm
      rw [hd] at h5
      rw [← h5]
      push_cast
      ring
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  refine ⟨IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le _ ?_, hkey⟩
  rw [hd]
  have : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank = d := by omega
  exact_mod_cast this.le

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.No4PatchingCore.isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing_aux
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing_aux :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R],
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = n → IsDomain R
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro R _ _ hn
    have hbot : maximalIdeal R = ⊥ :=
      (Submodule.spanFinrank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot
        ((maximalIdeal R).fg_of_isNoetherianRing)).mp hn
    let _ : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := hbot ▸ (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).isPrime
    exact IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime R
  | succ n IH =>
    intro R _ _ hn
    have hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R), hn]
    have hdim_pos : 0 < ringKrullDim R := by
      rw [hdim]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n
    obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, hx_sq, hx_min⟩ := exists_parameter_notMem_minimalPrimes R hdim_pos
    let _ : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      isLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton hx_mem
    obtain ⟨hreg', hsf'⟩ :=
      isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton_of_forall_notMem_minimalPrimes R
        hx_mem hx_sq hx_min
    let _ := hreg'
    have hsf'n : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank = n := by
      rw [hn] at hsf'
      omega
    have hdom' : IsDomain (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := IH (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) hsf'n
    have hprime : (Ideal.span {x}).IsPrime := by
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime]
      exact hdom'
    let _ := hprime
    obtain ⟨p, hp_min, hp_le⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal R)) (J := Ideal.span {x}) bot_le
    have hp_prime : p.IsPrime := Ideal.IsMinimalPrime.isPrime hp_min
    have hxp : x ∉ p := hx_min p hp_min
    have hple : p ≤ (maximalIdeal R) • p := by
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨r, hrx⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hp_le ha)
      have hrp : r ∈ p := by
        have hmem : r * x ∈ p := by rw [hrx]; exact ha
        rcases hp_prime.mem_or_mem hmem with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h hxp
      rw [Ideal.smul_eq_mul, ← hrx, mul_comm r x]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx_mem hrp
    have hp_bot : p = ⊥ :=
      Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot (maximalIdeal R) p
        (IsNoetherian.noetherian p) hple (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _)
    let _ : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := hp_bot ▸ hp_prime
    exact IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime R

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.IsRegularLocalRing_depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim.Ws14Port.regCM_aux
statement:
theorem regCM_aux :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R],
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = d → Module.depth R R = (d : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro R _ _ h0
    have hfield := isField_of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_zero R h0
    let _ : Field R := hfield.toField
    exact_mod_cast Ws14Port.DepthZeroAssociatedPrime.gate_field_depth_eq_zero R
  | succ d ih =>
    intro R _ _ hsucc
    have hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R), hsucc]
    have hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim R := by
      rw [hdim]; exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos d
    have hdepth_pos : 0 < Module.depth R R :=
      depth_self_pos_of_isRegularLocalRing R hpos
    obtain ⟨x, hxm, hxm2, hxR, _⟩ :=
      jointRegularElementSelection_holds R R hdepth_pos hpos
    have hspan_ne : Ideal.span {x} ≠ (⊤ : Ideal R) :=
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top
        (Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hxm))
    let _ : Nontrivial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
      rw [← not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial, Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff]
      exact hspan_ne
    let _ : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    obtain ⟨hregQ, hsf⟩ := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_span_singleton R hxm hxm2 hxR
    have hsfQ : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank = d := by omega
    have hihQ := ih (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) hsfQ
    have hstep := Ws14Port.Module.depth_quotient_self_succ_eq (R := R) hxm hxR
    have heq : Module.depth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x R) =
        Module.depth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := by
      rw [Ws14Port.Module.depth_quotient_eq_depth (R := R) (Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x R),
          Ws14Port.Module.depth_quotient_eq_depth (R := R) (Ideal.span {x})
            (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})]
      exact Ws14Port.Module.depth_eq_of_linearEquiv
        (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (by
          rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul, Ideal.smul_eq_mul, Ideal.mul_top]))
    rw [heq, hihQ] at hstep
    rw [← hstep]; push_cast; ring

name: IsRegularLocalRing.depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem _root_.IsRegularLocalRing.depth_self_eq_ringKrullDim
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R] :
    (Module.depth R R : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  have h := regCM_aux (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank R rfl
  rw [h, ← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)]
  norm_cast

name: isSMulRegular_iff_of_free
statement:
theorem _root_.isSMulRegular_iff_of_free {R M : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Nontrivial M] {r : R} :
    IsSMulRegular M r ↔ IsSMulRegular R r
proof:
:= by
  let I := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M
  let b : Module.Basis I R M := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M
  constructor
  · intro H m n h
    have i : I := Nonempty.some inferInstance
    have := @H (m • b i) (n • b i) (by simp_all [← mul_smul])
    simpa using congr(b.repr $this i)
  · intro H m n h
    apply b.repr.injective
    ext i
    replace h := congr(b.repr $h i)
    simp only [map_smul] at h
    exact H h

name: SchemeTheory.maximalIdeal_spanFinrank_le_quotient_add_one
statement:
private theorem maximalIdeal_spanFinrank_le_quotient_add_one
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (x : R) [IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})] :
    (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ≤
      (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).spanFinrank + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  let f : R →+* S := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have : IsLocalHom f := IsLocalHom.of_surjective f hf
  let lift : S → R := Function.surjInv hf
  have hlift (s : S) : f (lift s) = s := Function.surjInv_eq hf s
  obtain ⟨s, hcard, hspan⟩ :=
    Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank
      (maximalIdeal S).fg_of_isNoetherianRing
  let t : Finset R := insert x (s.image lift)
  let J : Ideal R := Ideal.span (t : Set R)
  have hfx : f x = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton x))
  have himage : f '' (↑(s.image lift) : Set R) = (s : Set S) := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
      rw [hlift]
      exact hc
    · intro ha
      exact ⟨lift a, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, hlift a⟩
  have hmap : J.map f = maximalIdeal S := by
    dsimp only [J, t]
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Finset.coe_insert, Set.image_insert_eq, hfx, himage,
      Ideal.span_insert, Ideal.span_singleton_zero, bot_sup_eq]
    exact hspan
  have hker : RingHom.ker f ≤ J := by
    rw [show RingHom.ker f = Ideal.span {x} from Ideal.mk_ker]
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro a ha
    have ha' : a = x := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha
    subst a
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Finset.mem_insert_self x (s.image lift))
  have hJ : J = maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← maximalIdeal_comap f, ← hmap, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective f hf J]
    exact (sup_eq_left.mpr hker).symm
  rw [← hJ]
  calc
    J.spanFinrank ≤ (t : Set R).ncard :=
      Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite t.finite_toSet
    _ = t.card := Set.ncard_coe_finset t
    _ ≤ (s.image lift).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le x (s.image lift)
    _ ≤ s.card + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right (Finset.card_image_le) 1
    _ = (maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank + 1 := by rw [hcard]

name: SchemeTheory.isRegularLocalRing_of_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_of_quotient_span_singleton
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (x : R) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hregular : IsSMulRegular R x)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})] : IsRegularLocalRing R
proof:
:= by
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  rw [← ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim hregular hx,
    ← IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal]
  exact_mod_cast maximalIdeal_spanFinrank_le_quotient_add_one R x

name: Ideal.map_le_jacobson_bot_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem map_le_jacobson_bot_of_isIntegral {R : Type u} {S : Type v}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S]
    {I : Ideal R} (hI : I ≤ jacobson ⊥) :
    I.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ jacobson ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobson, le_sInf_iff]
  rintro J ⟨_, hJ⟩
  let : J.IsMaximal := hJ
  apply map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr

    isMaximal_under_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (R := R) J⟩)

name: SchemeTheory.exists_etale_away_of_isEtaleAt_fiber
statement:
theorem exists_etale_away_of_isEtaleAt_fiber
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra.IsIntegral R B] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hetale : ∀ P : PrimeSpectrum B,
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R B) P = p → Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P.asIdeal) :
    ∃ r : R, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧ Algebra.Etale R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R B r))
proof:
:= by
  let f := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R B)
  let Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum R) := f '' (Algebra.etaleLocus R B)ᶜ
  have hclosed : IsClosed Z :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isClosedMap_comap_of_isIntegral (algebraMap R B)
      (algebraMap_isIntegral_iff.mpr inferInstance)
      _ Algebra.isOpen_etaleLocus.isClosed_compl
  have hp : p ∈ Zᶜ := by
    rintro ⟨P, hP, hPp⟩
    exact hP (hetale P hPp)
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨_, ⟨r, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, hpr, hr⟩ :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hp hclosed.isOpen_compl
  refine ⟨r, hpr, Algebra.basicOpen_subset_etaleLocus_iff_etale.mp ?_⟩
  intro P hP
  by_contra hnot
  have hfp : f P ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r := hP
  exact (hr hfp) ⟨P, hnot, rfl⟩

name: SchemeTheory.exists_finset_span_eq_top_of_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem exists_finset_span_eq_top_of_isLocalizedModule
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (S : Submonoid R)
    (R' : Type v) [CommRing R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsLocalization S R']
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {M' : Type w'} [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M']
    [Module R' M'] [IsScalarTower R R' M']
    (f : M →ₗ[R] M') [IsLocalizedModule S f] [Module.Finite R' M'] :
    ∃ t : Finset M, Submodule.span R' (f '' (t : Set M)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Module.Finite.fg_top (R := R') (M := M')
  choose num hnum using fun z : t ↦ IsLocalizedModule.surj S f z.val
  let s : Finset M := t.attach.image fun z ↦ (num z).1
  refine ⟨s, top_unique ?_⟩
  rw [← ht]
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr fun z hz ↦ ?_
  let q : t := ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hmem : f ((num q).1) ∈ Submodule.span R' (f '' (s : Set M)) := by
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact ⟨(num q).1, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨q, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hden : IsUnit (algebraMap R R' (num q).2) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units R' (num q).2
  apply (Submodule.smul_mem_iff_of_isUnit _ hden).mp
  rw [algebraMap_smul]
  exact (hnum q).symm ▸ hmem

name: SchemeTheory.lTensor_subalgebra_bijective_of_span
statement:
theorem lTensor_subalgebra_bijective_of_span
    (A : Type w) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Module.Flat R A]
    (C : Subalgebra R B)
    (hC : Submodule.span A ((fun b : B ↦ (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] b) '' (C : Set B)) = ⊤) :
    Function.Bijective (Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor (S := A) A C.val)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change Function.Injective (C.val.toLinearMap.lTensor A)
    exact Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap C.val.toLinearMap
      Subtype.val_injective
  · apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hC]
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] (⟨b, hb⟩ : C), rfl⟩

name: SchemeTheory.exists_finite_subalgebra_two_localizations
statement:
theorem exists_finite_subalgebra_two_localizations
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R B]
    (S T : Submonoid R)
    (A : Type w) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization S A]
    (D : Type w') [CommRing D] [Algebra R D] [IsLocalization T D]
    [Module.Finite A (A ⊗[R] B)] [Module.Finite D (D ⊗[R] B)] :
    ∃ C : Subalgebra R B, Module.Finite R C ∧
      Function.Bijective (Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor (S := A) A C.val) ∧
      Function.Bijective (Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor (S := D) D C.val)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_finset_span_eq_top_of_isLocalizedModule S A
    (TensorProduct.mk R A B 1)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_finset_span_eq_top_of_isLocalizedModule T D
    (TensorProduct.mk R D B 1)
  let C : Subalgebra R B := Algebra.adjoin R ((s ∪ t : Finset B) : Set B)
  have hfinite : Module.Finite R C := Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral
    (s ∪ t).finite_toSet (fun b _ ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral b)
  refine ⟨C, hfinite, ?_, ?_⟩
  · let : Module.Flat R A := IsLocalization.flat A S
    apply lTensor_subalgebra_bijective_of_span A C
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hs]
    apply Submodule.span_mono
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨b, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Finset.mem_union_left t hb), rfl⟩
  · let : Module.Flat R D := IsLocalization.flat D T
    apply lTensor_subalgebra_bijective_of_span D C
    apply top_unique
    rw [← ht]
    apply Submodule.span_mono
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨b, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Finset.mem_union_right s hb), rfl⟩

name: SchemeTheory.exists_finite_normalization_model
statement:
theorem exists_finite_normalization_model
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (d : R)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.Away d A]
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra A T]
    [IsScalarTower R A T] [Module.Finite A T]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    [Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R T)] :
    ∃ C : Subalgebra R T, Module.Finite R C ∧
      IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R C d) T ∧
      Nonempty ((Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] C) ≃ₐ[Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal]
        (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R T))
proof:
:= by
  let B := integralClosure R T
  let P := Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal
  let : IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R B d) T :=
    integralClosure_isLocalization_away d A T
  let : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B (Submonoid.powers d)) T :=
    inferInstance
  let : Algebra.IsPushout R A B T :=
    (Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers d) A B T).symm
  let eBT : A ⊗[R] B ≃ₐ[A] T := Algebra.IsPushout.equiv R A B T
  let : Module.Finite A (A ⊗[R] B) :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eBT.symm.toLinearMap eBT.symm.surjective
  obtain ⟨D, hDfinite, hDp, hDd⟩ := exists_finite_subalgebra_two_localizations
    (B := B) p.asIdeal.primeCompl (Submonoid.powers d) P A
  let : Module.Finite R D := hDfinite
  let C : Subalgebra R T := D.map B.val
  let eDC : D ≃ₐ[R] C := D.equivMapOfInjective B.val Subtype.val_injective
  have hCfinite : Module.Finite R C :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective eDC.toLinearMap eDC.surjective
  let ep : P ⊗[R] C ≃ₐ[P] P ⊗[R] B :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl (R := P) (A₁ := P)) eDC.symm).trans
      (AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor (S := P) P D.val) hDp)
  let ed : A ⊗[R] C ≃ₐ[A] T :=
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl (R := A) (A₁ := A)) eDC.symm).trans
      (AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor (S := A) A D.val) hDd)).trans eBT
  have hval (c : C) : ((eDC.symm c : D) : B).val = c.val := by
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val (eDC.apply_symm_apply c)
    exact h
  have hed : ed.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap C (A ⊗[R] C)) = algebraMap C T := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro c
    change ed ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] c) = c.val
    change eBT ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] ((eDC.symm c : D) : B)) = c.val
    rw [Algebra.IsPushout.equiv_tmul, map_one, one_mul]
    exact hval c
  let : Algebra.IsPushout R A C T := Algebra.IsPushout.of_equiv ed hed
  have hloc : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C (Submonoid.powers d)) T :=
    (Algebra.isLocalization_iff_isPushout (Submonoid.powers d) A).mpr
      (Algebra.IsPushout.symm (inferInstance : Algebra.IsPushout R A C T))
  refine ⟨C, hCfinite, ?_, ⟨ep⟩⟩
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid, Submonoid.map_powers] using hloc

name: SchemeTheory.isIntegrallyClosedIn_away_of_normal_boundary
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosedIn_away_of_normal_boundary
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (d : R) (hd : d ∈ R⁰)
    (T : Type v) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [IsLocalization.Away d T]
    (hnormal : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsMaximal], d ∈ p →
      IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p)) :
    IsIntegrallyClosedIn R T
proof:
:= by
  apply isIntegrallyClosedIn_localization_of_normal_boundary
    (Submonoid.powers d) (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hd) T
  intro p hp hmeet
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hmeet
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff (s : R) d).mp s.property
  have hdmem : d ∈ p :=
    (inferInstance : p.IsPrime).mem_of_pow_mem n (hn.symm ▸ hs)
  exact hnormal p hdmem

name: SchemeTheory.integralClosure_eq_finite_subalgebra_of_normal_boundary
statement:
theorem integralClosure_eq_finite_subalgebra_of_normal_boundary
    {R : Type u} {T : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
    (C : Subalgebra R T) [Module.Finite R C]
    (d : C) [IsLocalization.Away d T]
    (hnormal : ∀ (p : Ideal C) [p.IsMaximal], d ∈ p →
      IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p)) :
    integralClosure R T = C
proof:
:= by
  have hd : d ∈ C⁰ := mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_injective
    (f := algebraMap C T) Subtype.val_injective
    (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := T) d).mem_nonZeroDivisors
  let : IsIntegrallyClosedIn C T :=
    isIntegrallyClosedIn_away_of_normal_boundary d hd T hnormal
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro t ht
    have htC : IsIntegral C t := (show IsIntegral R t from ht).tower_top
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosedIn.algebraMap_eq_of_integral htC
    exact hc ▸ c.property
  · intro t ht
    exact (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := R) (⟨t, ht⟩ : C)).map C.val

name: SchemeTheory.finite_etale_integralClosure_on_model_neighborhood
statement:
theorem finite_etale_integralClosure_on_model_neighborhood
    {R T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
    (C : Subalgebra R T) [Module.Finite R C]
    (d r : R) [IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R C d) T]
    [Algebra.Etale R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R C r))]
    (hnormal : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], d ∈ p →
      IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p)) :
    Module.Finite (Localization.Away r)
        (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] integralClosure R T) ∧
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.Away r)
        (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] integralClosure R T)
proof:
:= by
  let Rr := Localization.Away r
  let Cr := Localization.Away (algebraMap R C r)
  let Tr := Localization.Away (algebraMap R T r)
  let : Algebra Rr Cr := localizationAlgebra (Submonoid.powers r) C
  let : IsScalarTower R Rr Cr :=
    isScalarTower_localizationAlgebra (Submonoid.powers r) C
  let : Algebra Rr Tr := localizationAlgebra (Submonoid.powers r) T
  let : IsScalarTower R Rr Tr :=
    isScalarTower_localizationAlgebra (Submonoid.powers r) T
  let : IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap C T (algebraMap R C r)) Tr := by
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R C T]
    infer_instance
  let : Algebra Cr Tr :=
    localizationAlgebra (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R C r)) T
  let : IsScalarTower C Cr Tr :=
    isScalarTower_localizationAlgebra (Rₘ := Cr) (Sₘ := Tr)
      (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R C r)) T
  let : IsScalarTower Rr Cr Tr := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers r)
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    change algebraMap Rr Tr (algebraMap R Rr a) =
      algebraMap Cr Tr (algebraMap Rr Cr (algebraMap R Rr a))
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Rr Tr,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Rr Cr,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R C Cr,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C Cr Tr,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R C Tr]
  let : IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap C Cr (algebraMap R C d)) Tr :=
    IsLocalization.Away.commutes Cr T Tr (algebraMap R C r) (algebraMap R C d)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap Cr Tr) :=
    localizationAlgebra_injective Cr Tr Subtype.val_injective
  have hd : algebraMap C Cr (algebraMap R C d) ∈ Cr⁰ :=
    mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_injective hinj
      (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := Tr)
        (algebraMap C Cr (algebraMap R C d))).mem_nonZeroDivisors
  let : IsIntegrallyClosedIn Cr Tr :=
    isIntegrallyClosedIn_away_of_normal_boundary
      (algebraMap C Cr (algebraMap R C d)) hd Tr (by
        intro q hq hdq
        have hdp : d ∈ q.under R := hdq
        let : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R)) := (hnormal _ hdp).1
        let : IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R)) := (hnormal _ hdp).2
        exact isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_atPrime_of_etale R Cr q)
  let : Module.Finite Rr Cr := Module.Finite.of_isLocalization R C (Submonoid.powers r)
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral Rr Cr := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite Rr Cr
  let : IsIntegralClosure Cr Rr Tr := IsIntegralClosure.of_isIntegrallyClosedIn
  let : Algebra.Etale R Rr := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway r
  let : Algebra.Etale Rr Cr := Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars R Rr Cr
  let eC : Cr ≃ₐ[Rr] integralClosure Rr Tr :=
    IsIntegralClosure.equiv Rr Cr Tr (integralClosure Rr Tr)
  let : Algebra.IsPushout R Rr T Tr :=
    (Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers r) Rr T Tr).symm
  let eT : Rr ⊗[R] T ≃ₐ[Rr] Tr := Algebra.IsPushout.equiv R Rr T Tr
  let eI : Rr ⊗[R] integralClosure R T ≃ₐ[Rr] integralClosure Rr Tr :=
    (AlgEquiv.ofBijective (TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure R Rr T)
      (TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure_bijective_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers r))).trans
        eT.mapIntegralClosure
  let e : Cr ≃ₐ[Rr] Rr ⊗[R] integralClosure R T := eC.trans eI.symm
  exact ⟨Module.Finite.of_surjective e.toLinearMap e.surjective, Algebra.Etale.of_equiv e⟩

statement:

private theorem tensorProductFirstCounitOfSection_tmul
    (g : S →ₐ[R] R) (s t : S) (m : M) :
    tensorProductFirstCounitOfSection g ((s ⊗ₜ[R] t) ⊗ₜ[R] m) =

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_exact_of_section
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_exact_of_section (g : S →ₐ[R] R) :
    Function.Exact
      (TensorProduct.mk R S M 1)
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftSubRight R S).rTensor M)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨tensorProductCounitOfSection g x, ?_⟩
    have hcontract := congrArg (tensorProductFirstCounitOfSection g) hx
    rw [map_zero] at hcontract
    have hidentity : ∀ y : S ⊗[R] M,
        tensorProductFirstCounitOfSection g
            (((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftSubRight R S).rTensor M) y) =
          1 ⊗ₜ[R] tensorProductCounitOfSection g y - y := by
      intro y
      induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy, TensorProduct.tmul_add, sub_add_sub_comm]
      | tmul s m =>
          simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
            Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftSubRight_apply,
            TensorProduct.sub_tmul, map_sub,
            tensorProductFirstCounitOfSection_tmul,
            tensorProductCounitOfSection_tmul]
          rw [map_one, one_smul]
          congr 1
          rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
    rw [hidentity x] at hcontract
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hcontract
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
    simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftSubRight_apply]

@[simp]
private theorem tensorProductBaseChangeFirstMultiplication_tmul

        (a ⊗ₜ[R] ((s ⊗ₜ[R] t) ⊗ₜ[R] m)) =

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_exact_of_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_exact_of_faithfullyFlat
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R S] :
    Function.Exact
      (TensorProduct.mk R S M 1)
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftSubRight R S).rTensor M)
proof:
:= by
  apply Module.FaithfullyFlat.lTensor_reflects_exact R S
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨tensorProductBaseChangeCounit x, ?_⟩
    have hcontract := congrArg tensorProductBaseChangeFirstMultiplication hx
    rw [map_zero] at hcontract
    have hidentity : ∀ y : S ⊗[R] (S ⊗[R] M),
        tensorProductBaseChangeFirstMultiplication
            ((((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftSubRight R S).rTensor M).lTensor S) y) =
          ((TensorProduct.mk R S M 1).lTensor S)
              (tensorProductBaseChangeCounit y) - y := by
      intro y
      induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy, sub_add_sub_comm]
      | tmul a y =>
          induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
          | add x y hx hy =>
              simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
              rw [hx, hy]
              abel
          | tmul s m =>
              simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
                Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftSubRight_apply,
                TensorProduct.sub_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub,
                tensorProductBaseChangeFirstMultiplication_tmul,
                tensorProductBaseChangeCounit_tmul]
              simp only [TensorProduct.mk_apply, mul_one]
    rw [hidentity x] at hcontract
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hcontract
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
    | tmul s m =>
        simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftSubRight_apply]

name: SchemeTheory.exists_finite_etale_integralClosure_away
statement:
theorem exists_finite_etale_integralClosure_away
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (d : R)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.Away d A]
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra A T]
    [IsScalarTower R A T] [Module.Finite A T]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    [Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R T)]
    [Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R T)]
    (hnormal : ∀ (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime], d ∈ q →
      IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)) :
    ∃ r : R, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      Module.Finite (Localization.Away r)
        (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] integralClosure R T) ∧
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.Away r)
        (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] integralClosure R T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hCfinite, hCloc, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_finite_normalization_model d A T p
  let : Module.Finite R C := hCfinite
  let : IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R C d) T := hCloc
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation R C :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp inferInstance
  let : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] C) := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv e.symm
  have hlocal : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C p.asIdeal.primeCompl)) :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_equiv (Localization.tensorRightAlgEquiv p.asIdeal.primeCompl C)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hetale⟩ := exists_etale_away_of_isEtaleAt_fiber p
    (isEtaleAt_of_localizedAlgebra_etale p hlocal)
  let : Algebra.Etale R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R C r)) := hetale
  exact ⟨r, hr, finite_etale_integralClosure_on_model_neighborhood C d r hnormal⟩

name: SchemeTheory.finite_of_finite_tensor_neighborhoods
statement:
private theorem finite_of_finite_tensor_neighborhoods
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (h : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, ∃ r : R, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
      Module.Finite (Localization.Away r) (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] B)) :
    Module.Finite R B
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set R := {r | Module.Finite (Localization.Away r) (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] B)}
  have hspan : Ideal.span s = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hnot
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal (Ideal.span s) hnot
    let : p.IsMaximal := hp
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hfinite⟩ := h ⟨p, inferInstance⟩
    exact hr (hle (Ideal.subset_span hfinite))
  exact Module.Finite.of_localizationSpan' s hspan
    (Rₚ := fun r : s => Localization.Away r.val)
    (Mₚ := fun r : s => Localization.Away r.val ⊗[R] B)
    (fun r : s => TensorProduct.mk R (Localization.Away r.val) B 1)
    (fun r : s => r.property)

name: SchemeTheory.finite_etale_integralClosure_of_local_finite_etale
statement:
theorem finite_etale_integralClosure_of_local_finite_etale
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (d : R)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.Away d A]
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra A T]
    [IsScalarTower R A T] [Module.Finite A T]
    (hnormal : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], d ∈ p →
      IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p))
    (hlocal : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
      Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
          (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R T) ∧
        Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
          (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R T)) :
    Module.Finite R (integralClosure R T) ∧ Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R T)
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite : Module.Finite R (integralClosure R T) := by
    apply finite_of_finite_tensor_neighborhoods
    intro p
    let : Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R T) := (hlocal p).1
    let : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R T) := (hlocal p).2
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hfinite, _⟩ := exists_finite_etale_integralClosure_away d A T p hnormal
    exact ⟨r, hr, hfinite⟩
  let : Module.Finite R (integralClosure R T) := hfinite
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation R (integralClosure R T) :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp inferInstance
  refine ⟨hfinite, Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_univ_iff_etale.mp ?_⟩
  apply Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr
  intro Q
  let p : PrimeSpectrum R := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (integralClosure R T)) Q
  let : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
    (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal ⊗[R] integralClosure R T) := (hlocal p).2
  have hloc : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (integralClosure R T) p.asIdeal.primeCompl)) :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_equiv
      (Localization.tensorRightAlgEquiv p.asIdeal.primeCompl (integralClosure R T))
  exact isEtaleAt_of_localizedAlgebra_etale p hloc Q rfl

name: SchemeTheory.existsUnique_tensor_pair_of_inf_eq_bot
statement:
private theorem existsUnique_tensor_pair_of_inf_eq_bot
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {F : Type v} [CommRing F] [Algebra R F]
    [FaithfulSMul R F] (A B : Subalgebra R F) (hAB : A ⊓ B = ⊥)
    (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Flat R M]
    (a : M ⊗[R] A) (b : M ⊗[R] B)
    (hab : (A.val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) a = (B.val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) b) :
    ∃! m : M, m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A) = a ∧ m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) = b
proof:
:= by
  let d : R →ₗ[R] A × B := (Algebra.linearMap R A).prod (Algebra.linearMap R B)
  let e : A × B →ₗ[R] F :=
    A.val.toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.fst R A B) -
      B.val.toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.snd R A B)
  have hExact : Function.Exact d e := by
    intro z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have heq : (z.1 : F) = (z.2 : F) := sub_eq_zero.mp hz
      have hmem : (z.1 : F) ∈ A ⊓ B := ⟨z.1.2, heq.symm ▸ z.2.2⟩
      rw [hAB, Algebra.mem_bot] at hmem
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hmem
      refine ⟨r, Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hr) (Subtype.ext (hr.trans heq))⟩
    · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
      change algebraMap R F r - algebraMap R F r = 0
      exact sub_self _
  have hd : Function.Injective d := by
    intro r s hrs
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R F
    exact congrArg (fun z : A × B ↦ (z.1 : F)) hrs
  let t := TensorProduct.prodRight R R M A B
  let k : M →ₗ[R] (M ⊗[R] A) × (M ⊗[R] B) :=
    t.toLinearMap.comp ((d.lTensor M).comp (TensorProduct.rid R M).symm.toLinearMap)
  have hk (m : M) : k m = (m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A), m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) := by
    change (TensorProduct.prodRight R R M A B)
      (m ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap R A 1, algebraMap R B 1)) = _
    rw [map_one, map_one]
    exact TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul R R M A B m (1, 1)
  have hki : Function.Injective k :=
    t.injective.comp ((Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap d hd).comp
      (TensorProduct.rid R M).symm.injective)
  have he : e.lTensor M =
      ((A.val.toLinearMap.lTensor M).comp (LinearMap.fst R _ _) -
        (B.val.toLinearMap.lTensor M).comp (LinearMap.snd R _ _)).comp t.toLinearMap := by
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro m z
    simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, e, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.fst_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_sub,
      LinearEquiv.coe_coe, t, TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]
  let z : M ⊗[R] (A × B) := t.symm (a, b)
  have hz : e.lTensor M z = 0 := by
    rw [he]
    change (A.val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) (t z).1 -
      (B.val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) (t z).2 = 0
    rw [show t z = (a, b) from t.apply_symm_apply (a, b)]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hab
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (Module.Flat.lTensor_exact M hExact z).mp hz
  have hku : k ((TensorProduct.rid R M) u) = (a, b) := by
    change t ((d.lTensor M) ((TensorProduct.rid R M).symm
      ((TensorProduct.rid R M) u))) = (a, b)
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, hu]
    exact t.apply_symm_apply (a, b)
  refine ⟨(TensorProduct.rid R M) u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hk] at hku
    exact Prod.mk.inj hku
  · intro m hm
    apply hki
    rw [hk, hku, hm.1, hm.2]

name: SchemeTheory.existsUnique_tensor_primeAwayPair
statement:
theorem existsUnique_tensor_primeAwayPair
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    (F : Type v) [Field F] [Algebra R F] [IsFractionRing R F]
    {x y : R} (hx : Prime x) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hxy : ¬ x ∣ y)
    (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Flat R M]
    (a : M ⊗[R] Localization.subalgebra.ofField F (Submonoid.powers x)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx.ne_zero)))
    (b : M ⊗[R] Localization.subalgebra.ofField F (Submonoid.powers y)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy)))
    (hab :
      ((Localization.subalgebra.ofField F (Submonoid.powers x)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx.ne_zero))).val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) a =
      ((Localization.subalgebra.ofField F (Submonoid.powers y)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy))).val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) b) :
    ∃! m : M, m ⊗ₜ[R] 1 = a ∧ m ⊗ₜ[R] 1 = b
proof:
:= by
  apply existsUnique_tensor_pair_of_inf_eq_bot _ _ _ M a b hab
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.mem_bot_of_mem_localizationAway_pair_of_prime
      hx hy hxy z hz.1 hz.2
  · exact bot_le

name: SchemeTheory.tensor_primeAwayPair_ext
statement:
theorem tensor_primeAwayPair_ext
    (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Flat R M]
    {m n : M} (ha : m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ) = n ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ))
    (hb : m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aᵧ) = n ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aᵧ)) : m = n
proof:
:= by
  have hcompat :
      ((Aₓ).val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) (n ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ)) =
        ((Aᵧ).val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) (n ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aᵧ)) := by
    simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_one]
  exact (existsUnique_tensor_primeAwayPair F hx hy hxy M
    (n ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ)) (n ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aᵧ)) hcompat).unique
      ⟨ha, hb⟩ ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: SchemeTheory.existsUnique_linearMap_tensor_primeAwayPair
statement:
theorem existsUnique_linearMap_tensor_primeAwayPair
    (S : Type*) [Semiring S]
    (P : Type w') [AddCommGroup P] [Module S P]
    (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Flat R M]
    [Module S M] [SMulCommClass R S M]
    (fa : P →ₗ[S] M ⊗[R] Aₓ) (fb : P →ₗ[S] M ⊗[R] Aᵧ)
    (hab : ∀ p : P, ((Aₓ).val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) (fa p) =
      ((Aᵧ).val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) (fb p)) :
    ∃! f : P →ₗ[S] M, ∀ p : P,
      f p ⊗ₜ[R] 1 = fa p ∧ f p ⊗ₜ[R] 1 = fb p
proof:
:= by
  have hex (p : P) : ∃! m : M,
      m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ) = fa p ∧ m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aᵧ) = fb p :=
    existsUnique_tensor_primeAwayPair F hx hy hxy M (fa p) (fb p)
      (hab p)
  choose f hf using fun p => (hex p).exists
  let g : P →ₗ[S] M :=
    { toFun := f
      map_add' := by
        intro p q
        apply (hex (p + q)).unique (hf (p + q))
        constructor
        · rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, (hf p).1, (hf q).1, map_add]
        · rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, (hf p).2, (hf q).2, map_add]
      map_smul' := by
        intro r p
        apply (hex (r • p)).unique (hf (r • p))
        constructor
        · rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', (hf p).1, map_smul, RingHom.id_apply]
        · rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', (hf p).2, map_smul, RingHom.id_apply] }
  refine ⟨g, hf, ?_⟩
  intro g' hg'
  exact LinearMap.ext fun p => (hex p).unique (hg' p) (hf p)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Algebra_Etale_isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime.EtaleLocNormalAux.isIntegral_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_isIdempotentElem {T B : Type*} [CommRing T] [CommRing B] [Algebra T B]
    {e : B} (he : IsIdempotentElem e) : IsIntegral T e
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 1),
    Polynomial.monic_X.mul (Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C 1), ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C,
    map_one, mul_sub, mul_one, he.eq, sub_self]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Algebra_Etale_isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime.EtaleLocNormalAux.tensorMap_integralClosure_mem_bot
statement:
theorem tensorMap_integralClosure_mem_bot (y : S ⊗[R] (integralClosure R K)) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id S S) (integralClosure R K).val) y
      ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra S (S ⊗[R] K))
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul s k =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp
      ((mem_integralClosure_iff R K).mp k.2)
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, Algebra.mem_bot]
    refine ⟨r • s, ?_⟩
    calc algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] K) (r • s)
        = (r • s) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : K) := by
          rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
            RingHom.id_apply]
      _ = s ⊗ₜ[R] (r • (1 : K)) := TensorProduct.smul_tmul r s 1
      _ = s ⊗ₜ[R] (algebraMap R K r) := by rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
      _ = (AlgHom.id S S) s ⊗ₜ[R] ((integralClosure R K).val k) :=
        congrArg (fun z : K ↦ s ⊗ₜ[R] z) hr
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem ha hb

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Algebra_Etale_isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime.EtaleLocNormalAux.smooth_integrallyClosed_in_genericFibre
statement:
theorem smooth_integrallyClosed_in_genericFibre [Algebra.Smooth R S] :
    integralClosure S (S ⊗[R] K) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    (TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure_bijective_of_smooth (R := R) (S := S) (B := K)).2 ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hy' : (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id S S) (integralClosure R K).val) y = x := by
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val hy
    simpa only [TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure, AlgHom.coe_codRestrict] using h
  rw [← hy']
  exact tensorMap_integralClosure_mem_bot R K S y

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Algebra_Etale_isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime.EtaleLocNormalAux.exists_algebraMap_eq_of_isIntegral_genericFibre
statement:
theorem exists_algebraMap_eq_of_isIntegral_genericFibre [Algebra.Smooth R S]
    {x : S ⊗[R] K} (hx : IsIntegral S x) : ∃ s : S, algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] K) s = x
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : x ∈ integralClosure S (S ⊗[R] K) := (mem_integralClosure_iff S (S ⊗[R] K)).mpr hx
  rw [smooth_integrallyClosed_in_genericFibre R K S, Algebra.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Algebra_Etale_isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime.EtaleLocNormalAux.algebraMap_genericFibre_injective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_genericFibre_injective [Module.Flat R S] :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] K))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_injective (S := S) (A := S) (B := K)
    (IsFractionRing.injective R K)
  intro a b hab
  apply h
  simpa [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply] using hab

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Algebra_Etale_isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime.EtaleLocNormalAux.isIntegrallyClosed_of_integralClosure_eq_bot
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_of_integralClosure_eq_bot (T A : Type*) [CommRing T]
    [IsDomain T] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra T A] [FaithfulSMul T A]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed A] (h : integralClosure T A = ⊥) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed T
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Function.Injective (algebraMap T (FractionRing A)) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq T A (FractionRing A)]
    exact (IsFractionRing.injective A (FractionRing A)).comp
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective T A)
  have hg' : Function.Injective (Algebra.ofId T (FractionRing A)) := fun a b hab =>
    hg (by simpa [Algebra.ofId_apply] using hab)
  let φ : FractionRing T →ₐ[T] FractionRing A :=
    IsFractionRing.liftAlgHom (K := FractionRing T) hg'
  rw [isIntegrallyClosed_iff (FractionRing T)]
  intro x hx
  have h1 : IsIntegral T (φ x) := hx.map φ
  have h2 : IsIntegral A (φ x) := h1.tower_top
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp h2
  have h3 : IsIntegral T a := by
    refine IsIntegral.tower_bot (IsFractionRing.injective A (FractionRing A)) ?_
    rw [ha]
    exact h1
  have h4 : a ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra T A) := by
    rw [← h]
    exact (mem_integralClosure_iff T A).mpr h3
  rw [Algebra.mem_bot] at h4
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h4
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  have hφinj : Function.Injective φ := RingHom.injective (φ : FractionRing T →+* FractionRing A)
  apply hφinj
  rw [AlgHom.commutes, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply T A (FractionRing A), ht]
  exact ha

name: Algebra.Etale.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime
statement:
theorem _root_.Algebra.Etale.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime
    (P : Type u) [CommRing P] [IsDomain P] [IsIntegrallyClosed P]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra P A] [Algebra.Etale P A]
    (q : Ideal A) [q.IsPrime] (A_q : Type u) [CommRing A_q]
    [Algebra A A_q] [IsLocalization.AtPrime A_q q] :
    IsDomain A_q ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed A_q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hq : q.IsPrime := inferInstance
  let L := FractionRing P
  let B₀ := A ⊗[P] L
  obtain ⟨I, hI, F, hF, hFalg, e, -⟩ :=
    (Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod L (L ⊗[P] A)).mp inferInstance
  have : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let e₀ : B₀ ≃+* (Π j, F j) := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm P A L).toRingEquiv.trans e.toRingEquiv
  let θ : A →+* (Π j, F j) := e₀.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A B₀)
  have hθ : ∀ a, θ a = e₀ (algebraMap A B₀ a) := fun a => rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B₀) := algebraMap_genericFibre_injective P L A
  have hθinj : Function.Injective θ := e₀.injective.comp hinj
  have hIC : ∀ y : B₀, IsIntegral A y → ∃ a, algebraMap A B₀ a = y :=
    fun y hy => exists_algebraMap_eq_of_isIntegral_genericFibre P L A hy
  have hε : ∀ j : I, ∃ ε : A, θ ε = Pi.single j 1 := by
    intro j
    have hid : IsIdempotentElem (e₀.symm (Pi.single j 1) : B₀) := by
      have : IsIdempotentElem (Pi.single j (1 : F j) : Π j, F j) := by
        simp [IsIdempotentElem, ← Pi.single_mul]
      simpa [IsIdempotentElem, map_mul] using congrArg e₀.symm this.eq
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hIC _ (isIntegral_of_isIdempotentElem hid)
    exact ⟨a, by rw [hθ, ha, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]⟩
  choose ε hε using hε
  have hsum : ∑ j, ε j = 1 := by
    apply hθinj
    rw [map_sum, map_one]
    simp only [hε]
    exact Finset.univ_sum_single (1 : Π j, F j)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, ε i ∉ q := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : (1 : A) ∈ q := hsum ▸ q.sum_mem fun j _ => h j
    exact hq.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one q).mpr this)
  let ρ : A →+* F i := (Pi.evalRingHom F i).comp θ
  have hρ : ∀ a, ρ a = θ a i := fun a => rfl
  have hρε : ∀ a, θ (a * ε i) = Pi.single i (ρ a) := by
    intro a
    rw [map_mul, hε]
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj; simp [hρ]
    · simp [hj]
  have hker : ∀ a, ρ a = 0 → a * ε i = 0 := by
    intro a ha
    apply hθinj
    rw [hρε, ha, Pi.single_zero, map_zero]
  have hunit : ∀ s : q.primeCompl, IsUnit (ρ s) := by
    intro s
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h0
    have := hker s h0
    rcases hq.mem_or_mem (this ▸ q.zero_mem : (s : A) * ε i ∈ q) with h | h
    · exact s.2 h
    · exact hi h
  let ρ' : A_q →+* F i := IsLocalization.lift (M := q.primeCompl) hunit
  have hρ' : ∀ a, ρ' (algebraMap A A_q a) = ρ a := fun a => IsLocalization.lift_eq hunit a
  have hρ'inj : Function.Injective ρ' := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective q.primeCompl x
    rw [IsLocalization.lift_mk'] at hx
    have ha : ρ a = 0 := by simpa using hx
    rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨ε i, hi⟩, by simpa [mul_comm] using hker a ha⟩
  have hdom : IsDomain A_q := Function.Injective.isDomain ρ' hρ'inj
  refine ⟨hdom, ?_⟩
  let : Algebra A_q (F i) := ρ'.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra A (F i) := ρ.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower A A_q (F i) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (hρ' a).symm
  have : FaithfulSMul A_q (F i) := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective A_q (F i)).mpr hρ'inj
  refine isIntegrallyClosed_of_integralClosure_eq_bot A_q (F i) ?_
  refine le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro z hz
  rw [mem_integralClosure_iff] at hz
  obtain ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, hmz⟩ := IsIntegral.exists_multiple_integral_of_isLocalization q.primeCompl z hz
  set w : F i := (⟨m, hm⟩ : q.primeCompl) • z with hw
  obtain ⟨p, hpm, hpw⟩ := hmz
  let y : B₀ := e₀.symm (Pi.single i w)
  have hy : IsIntegral A y := by
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X * p, Polynomial.monic_X.mul hpm, ?_⟩
    apply e₀.injective
    rw [map_zero]
    change e₀.toRingHom (Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap A B₀) y (Polynomial.X * p)) = 0
    rw [Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
    have hy' : e₀.toRingHom y = Pi.single i w := e₀.apply_symm_apply _
    rw [hy']
    funext j
    change (Pi.evalRingHom F j)
      (Polynomial.eval₂ (e₀.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A B₀)) (Pi.single i w)
      (Polynomial.X * p)) = 0
    rw [Polynomial.hom_eval₂, Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_X]
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · rw [hj]
      have : ((Pi.evalRingHom F i).comp (e₀.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A B₀))) =
          algebraMap A (F i) := rfl
      rw [this, Pi.evalRingHom_apply, Pi.single_eq_same, hpw, mul_zero]
    · rw [Pi.evalRingHom_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, zero_mul]
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := hIC y hy
  have hρa₀ : ρ a₀ = w := by
    rw [hρ, hθ, ha₀]
    simp [y]
  rw [Algebra.mem_bot]
  refine ⟨IsLocalization.mk' A_q a₀ (⟨m, hm⟩ : q.primeCompl), ?_⟩
  change ρ' _ = z
  have hmu : w = ρ m * z := by rw [hw, Submonoid.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def]; rfl
  rw [IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec]
  change ρ a₀ = ρ m * z
  rw [hρa₀, hmu]

name: SchemeTheory.isEtaleAt_under_of_localizedAlgebra_etale
statement:
theorem isEtaleAt_under_of_localizedAlgebra_etale
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hEtale : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization
        (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl)))
    (Q : PrimeSpectrum
      (Localization
        (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl))) :
    Algebra.IsEtaleAt R
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap
        (algebraMap S
          (Localization
            (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl))) Q).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let A := Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal
  let B := Localization
    (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl)
  let P : PrimeSpectrum S :=
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap S B) Q
  let : Algebra.Etale A B := hEtale
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale A B := hEtale.formallyEtale
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale A (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) :=
    inferInstance
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale R A :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization p.asIdeal.primeCompl
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale R (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp R A (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal)
  let e : Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal ≃ₐ[S]
      Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal :=
    IsLocalization.localizationLocalizationAtPrimeIsoLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl) Q.asIdeal
  exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_equiv (e.restrictScalars R).symm

name: SchemeTheory.isEtaleAt_of_localizedAlgebra_etale
statement:
theorem isEtaleAt_of_localizedAlgebra_etale
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hEtale : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)
      (Localization
        (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl)))
    (P : PrimeSpectrum S)
    (hPp : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P = p) :
    Algebra.IsEtaleAt R P.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let M := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.asIdeal.primeCompl
  let B := Localization M
  have hdisj : Disjoint (M : Set S) (P.asIdeal : Set S) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro s hsM hsP
    change s ∈ Submonoid.map (algebraMap R S) p.asIdeal.primeCompl at hsM
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrs⟩ := hsM
    have hrP : r ∈
        (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) P).asIdeal := by
      change algebraMap R S r ∈ P.asIdeal
      rwa [hrs]
    rw [hPp] at hrP
    exact hr hrP
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum B :=
    ⟨Ideal.map (algebraMap S B) P.asIdeal,
      IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint
        M B P.asIdeal P.isPrime hdisj⟩
  have hunder : PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap S B) Q = P := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    exact IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint
      M B P.isPrime hdisj
  have hQ : Algebra.IsEtaleAt R
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap S B) Q).asIdeal :=
    isEtaleAt_under_of_localizedAlgebra_etale p hEtale Q
