  simpa only [hunder] using hQ

name: SchemeTheory.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_atPrime_of_etale
statement:
theorem isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_atPrime_of_etale
    (R C : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C] [Algebra.Etale R C]
    (q : Ideal C) [q.IsPrime]
    [IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime (q.under R))] :
    IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q)
proof:
:= by
  let p : Ideal R := q.under R
  let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p
  let M : Submonoid C := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C p.primeCompl
  let Cp := Localization M
  let : Algebra.IsPushout R Rp C Cp :=
    (Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization p.primeCompl Rp C Cp).symm
  let : Algebra.Etale Rp Cp :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_equiv (Algebra.IsPushout.equiv R Rp C Cp)
  let q' : Ideal Cp := q.map (algebraMap C Cp)
  let : q'.IsPrime := IsLocalization.AtPrime.isPrime_map_of_liesOver C p Cp q
  have hcontract : q'.under C = q :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint M Cp inferInstance
      (Ideal.disjoint_primeCompl_of_liesOver q p)
  have hn := Algebra.Etale.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime
    Rp Cp q' (Localization.AtPrime q')
  let : IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime q') := hn.1
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime q') := hn.2
  have hcompl : (q'.under C).primeCompl = q.primeCompl := by
    ext c
    change c ∉ q'.under C ↔ c ∉ q
    rw [hcontract]
  let : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.AtPrime q') q :=
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun N : Submonoid C => IsLocalization N (Localization.AtPrime q')) hcompl)
      (inferInstance : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Localization.AtPrime q') (q'.under C))
  let e : Localization.AtPrime q ≃ₐ[C] Localization.AtPrime q' :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime q) (Localization.AtPrime q')
  exact ⟨MulEquiv.isDomain (Localization.AtPrime q') e.toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv,
    IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv e.symm.toRingEquiv⟩

name: SchemeTheory.integralClosure_isLocalization
statement:
theorem integralClosure_isLocalization
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (M : Submonoid R)
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization M A]
    (T : Type w) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra A T]
    [IsScalarTower R A T] [Algebra.IsIntegral A T] :
    IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (integralClosure R T) M) T
proof:
:= by
  let C := integralClosure R T
  let E := integralClosure A T
  have hunit : Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T M ≤ IsUnit.submonoid T := by
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    change IsUnit (algebraMap R T r)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A T]
    exact (IsLocalization.map_units A (⟨r, hr⟩ : M)).map (algebraMap A T)
  have : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T M) T :=
    IsLocalization.of_le_isUnit hunit
  let inclusion : C →ₐ[R] E := Subalgebra.inclusion
    (show integralClosure R T ≤ (integralClosure A T).restrictScalars R from
      fun x hx => (show IsIntegral R x from hx).tower_top)
  let : Algebra C E := inclusion.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower R C E :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r => (inclusion.commutes r).symm
  have : IsScalarTower C E T := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
  have : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C M) E :=
    IsLocalization.integralClosure (R := R) (S := T) (Rf := A) (Sf := T) M
  let e : E ≃ₐ[C] T := AlgEquiv.ofBijective (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom C E T)
    ⟨fun x y h => Subtype.ext h,
      fun t => ⟨⟨t, Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := A) t⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  exact IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_algEquiv (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C M) e

name: SchemeTheory.integralClosure_isLocalization_away
statement:
theorem integralClosure_isLocalization_away
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (d : R)
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.Away d A]
    (T : Type w) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra A T]
    [IsScalarTower R A T] [Algebra.IsIntegral A T] :
    IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R (integralClosure R T) d) T
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [IsLocalization.Away, Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid_powers] using
    integralClosure_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers d) A T

name: SchemeTheory.isIntegrallyClosedIn_localization_of_normal_boundary
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosedIn_localization_of_normal_boundary
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (M : Submonoid R) (hM : M ≤ R⁰)
    (T : Type v) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [IsLocalization M T]
    (hnormal : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsMaximal], (∃ s : M, (s : R) ∈ p) →
      IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p)) :
    IsIntegrallyClosedIn R T
proof:
:= by
  refine isIntegrallyClosedIn_iff.mpr ⟨IsLocalization.injective T hM, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, ha⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M y
  have hdiv : (s : R) ∣ a := by
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp
    apply Ideal.mem_of_localization_maximal
    intro p hp
    let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    by_cases hsp : (s : R) ∈ p
    · have : IsDomain Rp := (hnormal p ⟨s, hsp⟩).1
      have : IsIntegrallyClosed Rp := (hnormal p ⟨s, hsp⟩).2
      let F := FractionRing Rp
      let g : T →ₐ[R] F := IsLocalization.liftAlgHom (M := M)
        (f := Algebra.ofId R F) (fun m => by
          apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
          change algebraMap R F (m : R) ≠ 0
          rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Rp F]
          exact IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
            (IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap p.primeCompl Rp (hM m.property)))
      have hyF : IsIntegral Rp (g y) := (hy.map g).tower_top
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.algebraMap_eq_of_integral hyF
      refine ⟨b, IsFractionRing.injective Rp F ?_⟩
      have hga : g y * algebraMap R F (s : R) = algebraMap R F a := by
        simpa only [map_mul, AlgHom.commutes] using congrArg g ha
      calc
        algebraMap Rp F (algebraMap R Rp a) = algebraMap R F a :=
          (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Rp F a).symm
        _ = g y * algebraMap R F (s : R) := hga.symm
        _ = algebraMap R F (s : R) * algebraMap Rp F b := by rw [hb, mul_comm]
        _ = algebraMap Rp F (algebraMap R Rp (s : R) * b) := by
          rw [map_mul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Rp F]
    · exact (IsLocalization.map_units Rp (⟨s, hsp⟩ : p.primeCompl)).dvd
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hdiv
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  apply (IsLocalization.map_units T s).mul_right_cancel
  calc
    algebraMap R T b * algebraMap R T (s : R) = algebraMap R T ((s : R) * b) := by
      rw [map_mul, mul_comm]
    _ = algebraMap R T a := congrArg (algebraMap R T) hb.symm
    _ = y * algebraMap R T (s : R) := ha.symm

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Algebra_Smooth_isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime.isIntegrallyClosed_mvPolynomial_fin
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_mvPolynomial_fin (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] :
    ∀ n : ℕ, IsIntegrallyClosed (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
  | 0 => IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv (MvPolynomial.isEmptyAlgEquiv R (Fin 0)).symm.toRingEquiv
  | n + 1 => by
      have
proof:
:= isIntegrallyClosed_mvPolynomial_fin R n
      exact IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n).symm.toRingEquiv

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Algebra_Smooth_isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime
statement:
theorem isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.Smooth R S]
    (p : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] (Sₚ : Type u) [CommRing Sₚ]
    [Algebra S Sₚ] [IsLocalization.AtPrime Sₚ p] :
    IsDomain Sₚ ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed Sₚ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : p.IsPrime := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hstd⟩ := Algebra.IsSmoothAt.exists_notMem_isStandardSmooth R p
  set Sf := Localization.Away f with hSf
  have : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R Sf := hstd
  obtain ⟨ι, σ, hσ, hι, ⟨Pr⟩⟩ := (inferInstance : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R Sf).out
  have : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension Pr.dimension R Sf := ⟨ι, σ, hσ, hι, Pr, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_etale_mvPolynomial Pr.dimension R Sf
  let : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin Pr.dimension) R) Sf := g.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.Etale (MvPolynomial (Fin Pr.dimension) R) Sf := hg
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Submonoid.powers f : Set S) (p : Set S) :=
    (Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime f).mpr hf
  set q : Ideal Sf := p.map (algebraMap S Sf) with hq
  have hqp : q.IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers f) Sf p hp hdisj
  have hcomap : q.comap (algebraMap S Sf) = p :=
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (Submonoid.powers f) Sf hp hdisj
  have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap S Sₚ f) := IsLocalization.map_units Sₚ (⟨f, hf⟩ : p.primeCompl)
  let : Algebra Sf Sₚ := (IsLocalization.Away.lift f hunit).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower S Sf Sₚ := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun s => by
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  have hle : Submonoid.powers f ≤ p.primeCompl := by
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact fun h => hf (hp.mem_of_pow_mem k h)
  have hloc : IsLocalization (p.primeCompl.map (algebraMap S Sf)) Sₚ :=
    IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_submonoid_le Sf Sₚ (Submonoid.powers f) p.primeCompl hle
  have : IsLocalization.AtPrime Sₚ q := by
    refine IsLocalization.of_le_of_exists_dvd
      (p.primeCompl.map (algebraMap S Sf)) q.primeCompl ?_ ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      change algebraMap S Sf s ∉ q
      intro h
      exact hs (by rw [← hcomap]; exact h)
    · intro n hn
      obtain ⟨⟨s, m⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers f) n
      have hm : (m : S) ∉ p := Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj m.2
      have hs : s ∉ p := by
        intro hs
        apply hn
        have hspec : IsLocalization.mk' Sf s m * algebraMap S Sf m = algebraMap S Sf s :=
          IsLocalization.mk'_spec Sf s m
        have hmem : algebraMap S Sf s ∈ q := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hs
        rw [← hspec] at hmem
        rcases hqp.mem_or_mem hmem with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (show (m : S) ∈ p by rw [← hcomap]; exact h) hm
      exact ⟨algebraMap S Sf s, ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩, algebraMap S Sf m,
        (IsLocalization.mk'_spec Sf s m).symm⟩
  have : IsIntegrallyClosed (MvPolynomial (Fin Pr.dimension) R) :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_mvPolynomial_fin R Pr.dimension
  exact Algebra.Etale.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization_atPrime
    (MvPolynomial (Fin Pr.dimension) R) Sf q Sₚ

name: SchemeTheory.tmul_one_injective_of_isTorsionFree
statement:
theorem tmul_one_injective_of_isTorsionFree
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (T : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization T A] (hT : T ≤ nonZeroDivisors R)
    (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] :
    Function.Injective (fun m : M => m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A))
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : Function.Injective (TensorProduct.mk R A M 1) := by
    apply (IsLocalizedModule.injective_iff_isRegular T _).mpr
    intro t
    exact IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp (hT t.2))
  intro m n hmn
  apply hleft
  change (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] m = (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] n
  have h := congrArg (TensorProduct.comm R M A) hmn
  simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h

name: SchemeTheory.rTensor_surjective_of_pow_smul_mem_range
statement:
theorem rTensor_surjective_of_pow_smul_mem_range
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (x : R) [IsLocalization.Away x A]
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {N : Type w'} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (h : ∀ n : N, ∃ (m : M) (k : ℕ), f m = x ^ k • n) :
    Function.Surjective (f.rTensor A)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨a' + b', map_add _ _ _⟩
  | tmul n a =>
      obtain ⟨m, k, hm⟩ := h n
      refine ⟨m ⊗ₜ[R] ((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf x : A) ^ k * a), ?_⟩
      rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, hm, TensorProduct.smul_tmul,
        Algebra.smul_def, map_pow, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow,
        IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, one_pow, one_mul]

name: SchemeTheory.linearMap_bijective_of_tensor_primeAwayPair
statement:
theorem linearMap_bijective_of_tensor_primeAwayPair
    {M : Type w} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Flat R M]
    {N : Type w'} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (hxN : IsSMulRegular N x)
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hfx : Function.Bijective (f.rTensor Aₓ))
    (hfy : Function.Bijective (f.rTensor Aᵧ)) : Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  have hiM : Function.Injective (fun m : M => m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ)) :=
    tmul_one_injective_of_isTorsionFree (Aₓ) (Submonoid.powers x)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx.ne_zero)) M
  have hiN : Function.Injective (fun n : N => n ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ)) := by
    have hleft : Function.Injective (TensorProduct.mk R (Aₓ) N 1) := by
      apply (IsLocalizedModule.injective_iff_isRegular (Submonoid.powers x) _).mpr
      rintro ⟨_, n, rfl⟩
      exact IsSMulRegular.pow n hxN
    intro m n hmn
    apply hleft
    change (1 : Aₓ) ⊗ₜ[R] m = (1 : Aₓ) ⊗ₜ[R] n
    have h := congrArg (TensorProduct.comm R N (Aₓ)) hmn
    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
  have hfi : Function.Injective f := by
    intro m n hmn
    apply hiM
    apply hfx.1
    simpa only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul] using congrArg (fun z : N => z ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ)) hmn
  refine ⟨hfi, ?_⟩
  intro n
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hfx.2 (n ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ))
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hfy.2 (n ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aᵧ))
  let : Module.Flat R F := IsLocalization.flat F (nonZeroDivisors R)
  have hcomm {T : Type v} [AddCommGroup T] [Module R T]
      (g : T →ₗ[R] F) (z : M ⊗[R] T) :
      (f.rTensor F) ((g.lTensor M) z) = (g.lTensor N) ((f.rTensor T) z) := by
    exact (LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor (M := M) f g) z).trans
      (LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor (M := M) f g) z).symm
  have hab : ((Aₓ).val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) a =
      ((Aᵧ).val.toLinearMap.lTensor M) b := by
    apply Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap f hfi
    rw [hcomm, hcomm, ha, hb]
    simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_one]
  obtain ⟨m, hm, _⟩ := existsUnique_tensor_primeAwayPair F hx hy hxy M a b hab
  refine ⟨m, hiN ?_⟩
  calc
    f m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : Aₓ) = (f.rTensor Aₓ) (m ⊗ₜ[R] 1) :=
      (LinearMap.rTensor_tmul (M := Aₓ) f (1 : Aₓ) m).symm
    _ = (f.rTensor Aₓ) a := congrArg (f.rTensor Aₓ) hm.1
    _ = n ⊗ₜ[R] 1 := ha

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtMappedPrime_map_primeCompl
statement:
theorem localizationAtMappedPrime_map_primeCompl
    (e : R ≃ₐ[A] S) (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] :
    Submonoid.map e P.primeCompl =
      (P.map e.toRingEquiv).primeCompl
proof:
:= by
  let Q := P.map e.toRingEquiv
  let : Q.IsPrime := inferInstance
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff.mpr fun hxe ↦
      hx ((Ideal.apply_mem_of_equiv_iff
        (f := e.toRingEquiv)).mp hxe)
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨e.symm y, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply y⟩
    exact Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff.mpr fun hx ↦ by
      apply hy
      rw [← e.apply_symm_apply y]
      exact (Ideal.apply_mem_of_equiv_iff
        (f := e.toRingEquiv)).mpr hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtMappedPrimeAlgEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem localizationAtMappedPrimeAlgEquiv_algebraMap
    (e : R ≃ₐ[A] S) (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] (x : R) :
    localizationAtMappedPrimeAlgEquiv e P
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P) x) =
      algebraMap S
        (Localization.AtPrime (P.map e.toRingEquiv)) (e x)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := P.map e.toRingEquiv
  let : Q.IsPrime := inferInstance
  exact IsLocalization.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_eq
    (H := localizationAtMappedPrime_map_primeCompl e P) x

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.mem_smulRange_iff
statement:
theorem mem_smulRange_iff {A : Type*} [CommRing A] {a : A} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    (x : M) : x ∈ smulRange a M ↔ ∃ y : M, a • y = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [smulRange, DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.smul_mem_smulRange
statement:
theorem smul_mem_smulRange {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (a : A) {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module A M]
    (x : M) : a • x ∈ smulRange a M
proof:
:=
  (mem_smulRange_iff (a := a) (a • x)).mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.le_of_forall_mul_le
statement:
theorem le_of_forall_mul_le {x y c : ℕ∞} (hy : y ≠ ⊤) (hc : c ≠ ⊤)
    (h : ∀ k : ℕ, (k : ℕ∞) * x ≤ (k : ℕ∞) * y + c) : x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro hx
    have h1 := h 1
    rw [hx, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, one_mul] at h1
    exact (WithTop.add_lt_top.mpr ⟨lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hy, lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hc⟩).ne
      (top_le_iff.mp h1)
  lift x to ℕ using hx
  lift y to ℕ using hy
  lift c to ℕ using hc
  by_contra hxy
  have hxy' : y + 1 ≤ x := by
    have : ¬ (x ≤ y) := fun h' => hxy (by exact_mod_cast h')
    omega
  have h2 := h (c + 1)
  have h3 : ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * (x : ℕ∞) ≤ ((c + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * (y : ℕ∞) + (c : ℕ∞) := h2
  have h4 : (c + 1) * x ≤ (c + 1) * y + c := by exact_mod_cast h3
  have h5 : (c + 1) * (y + 1) ≤ (c + 1) * x := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hxy'
  nlinarith

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.isArtinianRing_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem isArtinianRing_quotient_span_singleton {d : A} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    IsArtinianRing (A ⧸ Ideal.span {d})
proof:
:= by
  rw [isArtinianRing_iff_isNoetherianRing_krullDimLE_zero]
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  rw [Ring.krullDimLE_zero_iff]
  intro P hP
  set Q : Ideal A := P.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {d})) with hQdef
  have hQ : Q.IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime _ _
  have hdQ : d ∈ Q := by
    have h0 : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {d})) d = 0 :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton d))
    rw [hQdef, Ideal.mem_comap, h0]
    exact P.zero_mem
  have hQne : Q ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hdQ
    exact hd ((Submodule.mem_bot A).mp hdQ)
  have hQmax : Q.IsMaximal := hQ.isMaximal hQne
  have hPQ : P = Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {d})) := by
    rw [hQdef, Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
  rcases Ideal.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {d}))
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hQmax with h | h
  · exact absurd (hPQ ▸ h) hP.ne_top
  · exact hPQ ▸ h

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.length_ne_top_of_isTorsionBy
statement:
theorem length_ne_top_of_isTorsionBy {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    {d : A} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hM : ∀ m : M, d • m = 0) : Module.length A M ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hI : Module.IsTorsionBySet A M (Ideal.span {d} : Set A) := by
    rw [Module.isTorsionBySet_span_singleton_iff]
    intro m
    exact hM m
  let _ : Module (A ⧸ Ideal.span {d}) M := hI.module
  let _ : IsScalarTower A (A ⧸ Ideal.span {d}) M :=
    hI.isScalarTower (S := A)
  let _ := isArtinianRing_quotient_span_singleton hd
  let _ : Module.Finite (A ⧸ Ideal.span {d}) M := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite A _ _
  let _ : IsArtinian (A ⧸ Ideal.span {d}) M := inferInstance
  let _ : IsNoetherian (A ⧸ Ideal.span {d}) M := inferInstance
  rw [Module.length_eq_of_surjective (S := A) (R := A ⧸ Ideal.span {d})
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
  exact Module.length_ne_top

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.pow_smul_injective
statement:
theorem pow_smul_injective {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] {a : A}
    (hinj : ∀ m : M, a • m = 0 → m = 0) (k : ℕ) (m : M) (h : a ^ k • m = 0) : m = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing m with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, mul_smul] at h
      exact hinj m (ih (a • m) h)

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.smulRange_pow_succ_le
statement:
theorem smulRange_pow_succ_le {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (a : A) (k : ℕ) :
    smulRange (a ^ (k + 1)) M ≤ smulRange (a ^ k) M
proof:
:= by
  rintro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (mem_smulRange_iff x).mp hx
  exact (mem_smulRange_iff _).mpr ⟨a • y, by rw [pow_succ, mul_smul]⟩

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.length_quot_pow
statement:
theorem length_quot_pow {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (a : A)
    (hinj : ∀ m : M, a • m = 0 → m = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Module.length A (M ⧸ smulRange (a ^ k) M) = k * Module.length A (M ⧸ smulRange a M)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      have htop : smulRange ((a : A) ^ 0) M = ⊤ := by
        rw [eq_top_iff]
        rintro x -
        exact (mem_smulRange_iff x).mpr ⟨x, by rw [pow_zero, one_smul]⟩
      rw [htop, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
      exact Module.length_eq_zero
  | succ k ih =>
      set q1 : Submodule A M := smulRange a M
      set qk : Submodule A M := smulRange (a ^ k) M
      set qk1 : Submodule A M := smulRange (a ^ (k + 1)) M
      have hf_wd : q1 ≤ LinearMap.ker (qk1.mkQ ∘ₗ DistribSMul.toLinearMap A M (a ^ k)) := by
        rintro x hx
        obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (mem_smulRange_iff x).mp hx
        rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.comp_apply, DistribSMul.toLinearMap_apply,
          Submodule.mkQ_apply,
          Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
        exact (mem_smulRange_iff _).mpr ⟨y, by rw [← mul_smul, ← pow_succ]⟩
      set f : (M ⧸ q1) →ₗ[A] (M ⧸ qk1) :=
        q1.liftQ (qk1.mkQ ∘ₗ DistribSMul.toLinearMap A M (a ^ k)) hf_wd
      have hf_apply : ∀ m : M, f (Submodule.Quotient.mk m) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (a ^ k • m) := by
        intro m
        rfl
      have hg_wd : qk1 ≤ qk.comap (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[A] M) := by
        rw [Submodule.comap_id]
        exact smulRange_pow_succ_le a k
      set g : (M ⧸ qk1) →ₗ[A] (M ⧸ qk) := qk1.mapQ qk LinearMap.id hg_wd
      have hg_apply : ∀ m : M, g (Submodule.Quotient.mk m) = Submodule.Quotient.mk m := by
        intro m
        rfl
      have hf_inj : Function.Injective f := by
        rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff]
        intro x hx
        induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
        | H m =>
          rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hf_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx
          obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (mem_smulRange_iff _).mp hx
          rw [Submodule.mem_bot, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
          have h0 : a ^ k • (m - a • y) = 0 := by
            rw [smul_sub, ← hy, ← mul_smul, ← pow_succ, sub_self]
          have := pow_smul_injective hinj k _ h0
          rw [sub_eq_zero] at this
          rw [this]
          exact smul_mem_smulRange a y
      have hg_surj : Function.Surjective g := by
        intro x
        induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
        | H m => exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk m, hg_apply m⟩
      have hexact : Function.Exact f g := by
        intro x
        induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
        | H m =>
          rw [hg_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
          constructor
          · intro hm
            obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (mem_smulRange_iff _).mp hm
            exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk y, hf_apply y⟩
          · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
            induction z using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
            | H y =>
              rw [hf_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq] at hz
              have h1 : a ^ k • y - m ∈ qk := smulRange_pow_succ_le a k hz
              have h2 : a ^ k • y ∈ qk := smul_mem_smulRange _ y
              have := qk.sub_mem h2 h1
              rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this
      rw [Module.length_eq_add_of_exact f g hf_inj hg_surj hexact, ih, Nat.cast_succ, add_mul,
        one_mul,
        add_comm]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.length_quot_le
statement:
theorem length_quot_le {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (E : Submodule A M) (b : A) :
    Module.length A (M ⧸ smulRange b M) ≤
      Module.length A (E ⧸ smulRange b E) + Module.length A (M ⧸ E)
proof:
:= by
  set q : Submodule A M := smulRange b M
  set N' : Submodule A (M ⧸ q) := E.map q.mkQ
  have hsplit : Module.length A (M ⧸ q) = Module.length A N' + Module.length A ((M ⧸ q) ⧸ N') :=
    Module.length_eq_add_of_exact N'.subtype N'.mkQ (Submodule.injective_subtype N')
        (Submodule.mkQ_surjective N')
      (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ N')
  rw [hsplit]
  refine add_le_add ?_ ?_
  · have hcod : ∀ e : E, (q.mkQ ∘ₗ E.subtype) e ∈ N' := fun e => ⟨e, e.2, rfl⟩
    set g₀ : E →ₗ[A] N' := LinearMap.codRestrict N' (q.mkQ ∘ₗ E.subtype) hcod
    have hwd : smulRange b E ≤ LinearMap.ker g₀ := by
      rintro x hx
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (mem_smulRange_iff x).mp hx
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (q.mkQ ∘ₗ E.subtype) (b • y) = 0
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, map_smul, Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
        Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact smul_mem_smulRange b (y : M)
    refine Module.length_le_of_surjective ((smulRange b E).liftQ g₀ hwd) ?_
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨e, he⟩, rfl⟩
  · have hwd : E ≤ LinearMap.ker (N'.mkQ ∘ₗ q.mkQ) := by
      intro e he
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
        Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    refine Module.length_le_of_surjective (E.liftQ (N'.mkQ ∘ₗ q.mkQ) hwd) ?_
    intro x
    induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | H y =>
      induction y using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
      | H m => exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk m, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.length_quot_smulRange_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem length_quot_smulRange_eq_of_equiv {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N]
    (e : M ≃ₗ[A] N) (a : A) :
    Module.length A (M ⧸ smulRange a M) = Module.length A (N ⧸ smulRange a N)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Submodule.Quotient.equiv (smulRange a M) (smulRange a N) e ?_).length_eq
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (mem_smulRange_iff x).mp hx
    exact (mem_smulRange_iff _).mpr ⟨e y, (e.map_smul a y).symm⟩
  · rintro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (mem_smulRange_iff x).mp hx
    exact ⟨a • e.symm y, smul_mem_smulRange a _,
      (e.map_smul a (e.symm y)).trans
        (congrArg (fun z : N => a • z) (e.apply_symm_apply y))⟩

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.length_quot_le_of_fg
statement:
theorem length_quot_le_of_fg {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P]
    (htf : ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → ∀ p : P, a • p = 0 → p = 0)
    (E : Submodule A P) (hEd : ∀ p : P, ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ d • p ∈ E)
    {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (M₁ : Submodule A P) (hM₁ : M₁.FG) (hEM₁ : E ≤ M₁) :
    Module.length A (M₁ ⧸ smulRange a M₁) ≤ Module.length A (E ⧸ smulRange a E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set E' : Submodule A M₁ := E.comap M₁.subtype
  have eE : E' ≃ₗ[A] E := Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hEM₁
  let _ : Module.Finite A M₁ := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hM₁
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hM₁
  have hgen : ∀ g : P, ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ d • g ∈ E := hEd
  choose dg hdg0 hdgE using hgen
  set d : A := ∏ g ∈ s, dg g with hd_def
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun g _ => hdg0 g
  have hdmem : ∀ m ∈ M₁, d • m ∈ E := by
    intro m hm
    rw [← hs] at hm
    induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem g hg =>
        have : d = (∏ g' ∈ s.erase g, dg g') * dg g := by
          rw [hd_def, ← Finset.prod_erase_mul _ _ hg]
        rw [this, mul_smul]
        exact E.smul_mem _ (hdgE g)
    | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact E.zero_mem
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [smul_add]; exact E.add_mem hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx => rw [smul_comm]; exact E.smul_mem c hx
  have hc : Module.length A (M₁ ⧸ E') ≠ ⊤ := by
    apply length_ne_top_of_isTorsionBy hd0
    intro x
    induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | H m =>
      rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      change (M₁.subtype (d • m)) ∈ E
      rw [map_smul]
      exact hdmem _ m.2
  let _ : Module.Finite A E := Module.Finite.of_injective eE.symm.toLinearMap eE.symm.injective
  have hy : Module.length A (E ⧸ smulRange a E) ≠ ⊤ := by
    apply length_ne_top_of_isTorsionBy ha
    intro x
    induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | H e =>
      rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact smul_mem_smulRange a e
  have hinjM : ∀ m : M₁, a • m = 0 → m = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact htf a ha m (by exact_mod_cast congrArg Subtype.val hm)
  have hinjE : ∀ e : E', a • e = 0 → e = 0 := by
    intro e he
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hinjM e (by exact_mod_cast congrArg Subtype.val he)
  refine le_of_forall_mul_le hy hc fun k => ?_
  have hak : a ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero k ha
  calc (k : ℕ∞) * Module.length A (M₁ ⧸ smulRange a M₁)
        = Module.length A (M₁ ⧸ smulRange (a ^ k) M₁) := (length_quot_pow a hinjM k).symm
    _ ≤ Module.length A (E' ⧸ smulRange (a ^ k) E') + Module.length A (M₁ ⧸ E') :=
      length_quot_le E' (a ^ k)
    _ = (k : ℕ∞) * Module.length A (E' ⧸ smulRange a E') + Module.length A (M₁ ⧸ E') := by
          rw [length_quot_pow a hinjE k]
    _ = (k : ℕ∞) * Module.length A (E ⧸ smulRange a E) + Module.length A (M₁ ⧸ E') := by
          rw [length_quot_smulRange_eq_of_equiv eE a]

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.length_le_of_fg_quot
statement:
theorem length_le_of_fg_quot {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P]
    (htf : ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → ∀ p : P, a • p = 0 → p = 0)
    (E : Submodule A P) (hE : E.FG) (hEd : ∀ p : P, ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ d • p ∈ E)
    {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (N' : Submodule A (P ⧸ smulRange a P)) (hN' : N'.FG) :
    Module.length A N' ≤ Module.length A (E ⧸ smulRange a E)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hN'
  have hlift : ∀ x : P ⧸ smulRange a P, ∃ p : P, Submodule.Quotient.mk p = x :=
    fun x => Submodule.mkQ_surjective (smulRange a P) x
  choose lift hlift using hlift
  set M₁ : Submodule A P := E ⊔ Submodule.span A (lift '' (s : Set (P ⧸ smulRange a P)))
  have hM₁fg : M₁.FG := hE.sup (Submodule.fg_span ((s.finite_toSet).image lift))
  have hEM₁ : E ≤ M₁ := le_sup_left
  have hN'le : N' ≤ M₁.map (smulRange a P).mkQ := by
    rw [← hs, Submodule.span_le]
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨lift x, ?_, hlift x⟩
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
  have hcod : ∀ m : M₁, ((smulRange a P).mkQ ∘ₗ M₁.subtype) m ∈ M₁.map (smulRange a P).mkQ :=
    fun m => ⟨m, m.2, rfl⟩
  set g₀ : M₁ →ₗ[A] (M₁.map (smulRange a P).mkQ) :=
    LinearMap.codRestrict (M₁.map (smulRange a P).mkQ) ((smulRange a P).mkQ ∘ₗ M₁.subtype) hcod
  have hwd : smulRange a M₁ ≤ LinearMap.ker g₀ := by
    rintro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (mem_smulRange_iff x).mp hx
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((smulRange a P).mkQ ∘ₗ M₁.subtype) (a • y) = 0
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, map_smul, Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
      Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact smul_mem_smulRange a (y : P)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective ((smulRange a M₁).liftQ g₀ hwd) := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩
  calc Module.length A N'
        ≤ Module.length A (M₁.map (smulRange a P).mkQ) :=
          Module.length_le_of_injective (Submodule.inclusion hN'le)
            (Submodule.inclusion_injective hN'le)
    _ ≤ Module.length A (M₁ ⧸ smulRange a M₁) := Module.length_le_of_surjective _ hsurj
    _ ≤ Module.length A (E ⧸ smulRange a E) := length_quot_le_of_fg htf E hEd ha M₁ hM₁fg hEM₁

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.length_ne_top_of_forall_fg_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Set ℕ := {n : ℕ | ∃ N : Submodule A Q, N.FG ∧ Module.length A N = n} with hS
  have hS0 : (0 : ℕ) ∈ S := ⟨⊥, Submodule.fg_bot, by rw [Module.length_bot]; rfl⟩
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨0, hS0⟩
  have hbdd : BddAbove S := by
    refine ⟨y.toNat, ?_⟩
    rintro n ⟨N, hN, hn⟩
    have h1 : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ y := hn ▸ h N hN
    rw [← ENat.natCast_toNat hy] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀fg, hN₀⟩ := Nat.sSup_mem hSne hbdd
  set m : ℕ := sSup S
  have hmax : ∀ N : Submodule A Q, N.FG → Module.length A N ≤ m := by
    intro N hN
    have hne : Module.length A N ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top hy (h N hN)
    have hmem : (Module.length A N).toNat ∈ S := ⟨N, hN, (ENat.natCast_toNat hne).symm⟩
    have := le_csSup hbdd hmem
    rw [← ENat.natCast_toNat hne]
    exact_mod_cast this
  have htop : N₀ = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro q _
    by_contra hq
    set N₁ : Submodule A Q := N₀ ⊔ Submodule.span A {q}
    have hN₁fg : N₁.FG := hN₀fg.sup (Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_singleton q))
    have h01 : N₀ ≤ N₁ := le_sup_left
    have hlen1 : Module.length A N₁ = m := by
      apply le_antisymm (hmax N₁ hN₁fg)
      rw [← hN₀]
      exact Module.length_le_of_injective (Submodule.inclusion h01)
        (Submodule.inclusion_injective h01)
    have hfl : IsFiniteLength A N₁ := by
      rw [← Module.length_ne_top_iff, hlen1]
      exact ENat.natCast_ne_top m
    obtain ⟨hnoeth, hart⟩ := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfl
    set N₀' : Submodule A N₁ := N₀.comap N₁.subtype
    have hne : N₀' ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro h'
      have hq1 : q ∈ N₁ := Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self q)
      have : (⟨q, hq1⟩ : N₁) ∈ N₀' := by rw [h']; trivial
      exact hq this
    have hlt := Submodule.length_lt (R := A) (M := N₁) hne
    rw [(Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe h01).length_eq, hN₀, hlen1] at hlt
    exact lt_irrefl _ hlt
  rw [← Submodule.topEquiv.length_eq, ← htop, hN₀]
  exact ENat.natCast_ne_top m

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.core
statement:
theorem core {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P]
    (htf : ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → ∀ p : P, a • p = 0 → p = 0)
    (E : Submodule A P) (hE : E.FG) (hEd : ∀ p : P, ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ d • p ∈ E)
    {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Module.length A (P ⧸ smulRange a P) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Module.Finite A E := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hE
  have hy : Module.length A (E ⧸ smulRange a E) ≠ ⊤ := by
    apply length_ne_top_of_isTorsionBy ha
    intro x
    induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | H e =>
      rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact smul_mem_smulRange a e
  exact length_ne_top_of_forall_fg_le hy fun N hN => length_le_of_fg_quot htf E hE hEd ha N hN

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.exists_smul_mem_span
statement:
theorem exists_smul_mem_span {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Module A V]
    [IsScalarTower A K V]
    (S : Set V) {x : V} (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span K S) :
    ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ d • x ∈ Submodule.span A S
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, by rw [one_smul]; exact Submodule.subset_span hx⟩
  | zero => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, by rw [smul_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _⟩
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁, h₁⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂, h₂⟩ := hy
      refine ⟨d₁ * d₂, mul_ne_zero hd₁ hd₂, ?_⟩
      rw [smul_add, mul_comm d₁ d₂, mul_smul, mul_comm d₂ d₁, mul_smul]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h₁) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h₂)
  | smul c x _ hx =>
      obtain ⟨d, hd, h⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨n, m, hm, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := A) c
      have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hm
      have hmK : algebraMap A K m ≠ 0 := IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hm
      refine ⟨m * d, mul_ne_zero hm0 hd, ?_⟩
      have : (m * d) • ((algebraMap A K n / algebraMap A K m) • x) = n • (d • x) := by
        rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul K (m * d), smul_smul, map_mul, mul_assoc,
          mul_comm (algebraMap A K d),
          ← mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hmK, ← map_mul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul, mul_smul]
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ h

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.exists_lattice
statement:
theorem exists_lattice {V P : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [Module A V]
    [IsScalarTower A K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P]
    (f : P →ₗ[A] V) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    ∃ E : Submodule A P, E.FG ∧ ∀ p : P, ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ d • p ∈ E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set W : Submodule K V := Submodule.span K (Set.range f)
  let b := Module.finBasis K W
  have h1 : ∀ i, ∃ p : P, ∃ d : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ f p = d • ((b i : W) : V) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hmem⟩ := exists_smul_mem_span (A := A) (K := K) (Set.range f) (b i).2
    have hrange : Submodule.span A (Set.range f) = LinearMap.range f := by
      rw [← LinearMap.coe_range, Submodule.span_eq]
    rw [hrange] at hmem
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hmem
    exact ⟨p, d, hd, hp⟩
  choose p d hd hp using h1
  refine ⟨Submodule.span A (Set.range p), Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range p), fun x => ?_⟩
  have hW : W ≤ Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i => f (p i)) := by
    have hb : ∀ i, ((b i : W) : V) ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i => f (p i)) := by
      intro i
      have : ((b i : W) : V) = (algebraMap A K (d i))⁻¹ • f (p i) := by
        rw [hp i, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul K (d i), smul_smul,
          inv_mul_cancel₀ (IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
            (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (hd i))), one_smul]
      rw [this]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    intro w hw
    have hw' : (⟨w, hw⟩ : W) ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range b) := b.mem_span _
    have hwmap : W.subtype ⟨w, hw⟩ ∈ (Submodule.span K (Set.range b)).map W.subtype :=
      Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hw'
    have hmap : (Submodule.span K (Set.range b)).map W.subtype ≤
        Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i => f (p i)) := by
      rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact hb i
    exact hmap hwmap
  have hx : f x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i => f (p i)) :=
    hW (Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨d', hd', hmem'⟩ := exists_smul_mem_span (A := A) (K := K) _ hx
  have hspan : Submodule.span A (Set.range fun i => f (p i)) =
      (Submodule.span A (Set.range p)).map f := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hspan] at hmem'
  obtain ⟨e, he, hfe⟩ := hmem'
  refine ⟨d', hd', ?_⟩
  have : f (d' • x) = f e := by rw [map_smul, hfe]
  rw [hf this]
  exact he

name: AlgebraicCurves.Foundations.CommutativeAlgebra.Proofs.Subalgebra_isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite.KrullAkizukiLa.main
statement:
theorem main {A K L : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [Module.Finite K L]
    (B : Subalgebra A L) :
    IsNoetherianRing B ∧ Ring.DimensionLEOne B ∧
      ∀ J : Ideal B, J ≠ ⊥ → IsFiniteLength A (B ⧸ J)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : Ring.DimensionLEOne A :=
    ⟨fun {p} hp hP => Ring.krullDimLE_one_iff_of_noZeroDivisors.mp inferInstance p hp hP⟩
  have hAK : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K) := IsFractionRing.injective A K
  have hAL : Function.Injective (algebraMap A L) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A K L]
    exact (algebraMap K L).injective.comp hAK
  have hAB : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply hAL
    have := congrArg (fun b : B => (b : L)) hxy
    simpa using this
  have htf : ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → ∀ b : B, a • b = 0 → b = 0 := by
    intro a ha b hb
    rw [Algebra.smul_def] at hb
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_left ((map_ne_zero_iff _ hAB).mpr ha)
  obtain ⟨E, hEfg, hEd⟩ := exists_lattice (A := A) (K := K) (V := L) (B.val.toLinearMap)
    (fun x y h => Subtype.ext h)
  have hcore : ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → Module.length A (B ⧸ smulRange a B) ≠ ⊤ :=
    fun a ha => core htf E hEfg hEd ha
  have halgL : Algebra.IsAlgebraic A L := by
    let _ : Algebra.IsAlgebraic A K := IsLocalization.isAlgebraic K (nonZeroDivisors A)
    let _ : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite K L
    exact Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans A K L
  have hJ : ∀ J : Ideal B, J ≠ ⊥ → ∃ a : A, a ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap A B a ∈ J := by
    intro J hJne
    obtain ⟨b, hbJ, hb0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hJne
    have hb : IsAlgebraic A b :=
      (isAlgebraic_algHom_iff B.val (fun x y h => Subtype.ext h)).mp (halgL.isAlgebraic (b : L))
    have hne := Ideal.under_ne_bot_of_algebraic_mem hb0 hbJ hb
    obtain ⟨a, haJ, ha0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
    exact ⟨a, ha0, haJ⟩
  have h3 : ∀ J : Ideal B, J ≠ ⊥ → IsFiniteLength A (B ⧸ J) := by
    intro J hJne
    obtain ⟨a, ha, haJ⟩ := hJ J hJne
    have hle : smulRange a B ≤ (J.restrictScalars A).comap (LinearMap.id : B →ₗ[A] B) := by
      rintro x hx
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (mem_smulRange_iff x).mp hx
      change a • b ∈ J
      rw [Algebra.smul_def]
      exact J.mul_mem_right _ haJ
    set φ : (B ⧸ smulRange a B) →ₗ[A] (B ⧸ J) :=
      (Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv A J).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (smulRange a B).mapQ (J.restrictScalars A) LinearMap.id hle
    have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := by
      intro x
      induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
      | H b => exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk b, rfl⟩
    rw [← Module.length_ne_top_iff]
    exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hcore a ha) (Module.length_le_of_surjective φ hφ)
  have hI : ∀ {a : A}, a ≠ 0 → (Ideal.span {algebraMap A B a} : Ideal B) ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro a ha h
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] at h
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ hAB).mpr ha h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, h3⟩
  · rw [isNoetherianRing_iff, isNoetherian_def]
    intro J
    by_cases hJ0 : J = ⊥
    · rw [hJ0]; exact Submodule.fg_bot
    obtain ⟨a, ha, haJ⟩ := hJ J hJ0
    set I : Ideal B := Ideal.span {algebraMap A B a}
    have hIJ : I ≤ J := by
      rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact haJ
    let _ : IsNoetherian A (B ⧸ I) :=
      (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp (h3 I (hI ha))).1
    let _ : IsNoetherian B (B ⧸ I) := isNoetherian_of_tower A inferInstance
    apply Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_of_fg_inf_ker I.mkQ
    · exact IsNoetherian.noetherian _
    · rw [Submodule.ker_mkQ, inf_eq_right.mpr hIJ]
      exact ⟨{algebraMap A B a}, by simp [I]⟩
  · refine ⟨fun {p} hp0 hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hap⟩ := hJ p hp0
    set I : Ideal B := Ideal.span {algebraMap A B a}
    have hIp : I ≤ p := by
      rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hap
    let _ : IsArtinian A (B ⧸ I) := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp (h3 I (hI ha))).2
    let _ : IsArtinianRing (B ⧸ I) := isArtinian_of_tower A inferInstance
    have hker : RingHom.ker (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ≤ p := by
      rw [Ideal.mk_ker]
      exact hIp
    let _ : (p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hker
    have hmax : (p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsMaximal := IsArtinianRing.isMaximal_of_isPrime _
    have hcomap := Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (K := p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
    have heq : (p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = p := by
      rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, sup_eq_left]
      rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
      exact hker
    rwa [heq] at hcomap

name: Subalgebra.isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite
statement:
theorem _root_.Subalgebra.isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite
    {A K L : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [Module.Finite K L]
    (B : Subalgebra A L) :
    IsNoetherianRing B ∧ Ring.DimensionLEOne B ∧
      ∀ J : Ideal B, J ≠ ⊥ → IsFiniteLength A (B ⧸ J)
proof:
:=
  KrullAkizukiLa.main (K := K) B

name: IsNoetherianRing.of_ringKrullDim_le_one_of_finiteDimensional_subalgebra
statement:
theorem _root_.IsNoetherianRing.of_ringKrullDim_le_one_of_finiteDimensional_subalgebra
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (hR : ringKrullDim R ≤ 1)
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra R L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower R K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (B : Subalgebra R L) :
    IsNoetherianRing ↥B ∧ ringKrullDim ↥B ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 R := Ring.krullDimLE_iff.mpr hR
  obtain ⟨hN, hD, -⟩ :=
    Subalgebra.isNoetherianRing_and_dimensionLEOne_of_isFractionRing_of_finite (K := K) B
  have := hD
  exact ⟨hN, Ring.krullDimLE_iff.mp (inferInstance : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 ↥B)⟩

name: Algebra.exists_idempotent_lift_of_integral_of_cyclic_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_idempotent_lift_of_integral_of_cyclic_quotient
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R C] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] (b : C)
    [Algebra.FiniteType R (Localization.Away b)]
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) b))
    (hcyc : ∀ x : C ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R C), ∃ r : R,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) b * x =
        r • Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) b) :
    ∃ e : C, IsIdempotentElem e ∧
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) e =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hfinite, hbS, hbid, hbij⟩ :=
    exists_finite_subalgebra_idempotent_awayMap_bijective I b hb
  let : Module.Finite R S := hfinite
  let bS : S := ⟨b, hbS⟩
  have hcycS : ∀ x : S ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R S), ∃ r : R,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R S)) bS * x =
        r • Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R S)) bS :=
    cyclic_quotient_idempotent_of_awayMap_bijective S.val I bS hbid hbij hcyc
  obtain ⟨e, he, heq⟩ := exists_idempotent_lift_of_cyclic_quotient I bS hbid hcycS
  refine ⟨S.val e, he.map S.val, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (S.val.quotientBaseChange I) heq

name: Polynomial.exists_coprime_factorization_lift_of_henselian
statement:
theorem exists_coprime_factorization_lift_of_henselian
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I]
    {n : ℕ} (m k : ℕ) (hn : n = m + k) (p : MonicDegreeEq R n)
    (q₀ : MonicDegreeEq (R ⧸ I) m × MonicDegreeEq (R ⧸ I) k)
    (hprod : q₀.1.1 * q₀.2.1 = p.1.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
    (hcoprime : IsCoprime q₀.1.1 q₀.2.1) :
    ∃ q : MonicDegreeEq R m × MonicDegreeEq R k,
      q.1.1 * q.2.1 = p.1 ∧ IsCoprime q.1.1 q.2.1 ∧
        q.1.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = q₀.1 ∧
        q.2.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = q₀.2
proof:
:= by
  let U := UniversalCoprimeFactorizationRing m k hn p
  let σ : U →ₐ[R] R ⧸ I :=
    (UniversalCoprimeFactorizationRing.homEquiv (R ⧸ I) m k hn p).symm
      ⟨q₀, hprod, hcoprime⟩
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ :=
    (Algebra.Etale.bijective_comp_quotient_of_henselian (B := U) I).2 σ
  let q := UniversalCoprimeFactorizationRing.homEquiv R m k hn p τ
  have hreduce :
      (UniversalCoprimeFactorizationRing.homEquiv (R ⧸ I) m k hn p
        ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I).comp τ)).1 = q₀ := by
    rw [hτ]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      ((UniversalCoprimeFactorizationRing.homEquiv (R ⧸ I) m k hn p).apply_symm_apply
        ⟨q₀, hprod, hcoprime⟩)
  have hfst : q.1.1.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = q₀.1 :=
    (UniversalCoprimeFactorizationRing.homEquiv_comp_fst (S := R) m k hn p τ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I)).symm.trans (congrArg Prod.fst hreduce)
  have hsnd : q.1.2.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = q₀.2 :=
    (UniversalCoprimeFactorizationRing.homEquiv_comp_snd (S := R) m k hn p τ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I)).symm.trans (congrArg Prod.snd hreduce)
  refine ⟨q.1, ?_, q.2.2, hfst, hsnd⟩
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, Polynomial.map_id] using q.2.1

name: Algebra.exists_idempotent_lift_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_idempotent_lift_of_finite
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Module.Finite R B] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] (b : B)
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b)) :
    ∃ e : B, IsIdempotentElem e ∧
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) e =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial (R ⧸ I) with
  | inl h =>
    let : Subsingleton (R ⧸ I) := h
    let : Subsingleton (B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B)) :=
      Module.subsingleton (R ⧸ I) (B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B))
    exact ⟨0, by change (0 : B) * 0 = 0; exact zero_mul 0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  | inr h =>
    let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := h
    obtain ⟨n, hn, p, hp, hpb, hpmap⟩ :=
      exists_monic_annihilator_of_quotient_idempotent I b hb
    have hm₁ : ((X - 1) ^ n : (R ⧸ I)[X]).Monic := by
      simpa only [C_1] using (monic_X_sub_C (1 : R ⧸ I)).pow n
    have hm₂ : (X ^ n : (R ⧸ I)[X]).Monic := monic_X.pow n
    have hd₁ : ((X - 1) ^ n : (R ⧸ I)[X]).natDegree = n := by
      have hdeg : ((X - C (1 : R ⧸ I)) ^ n).natDegree = n := by
        rw [(monic_X_sub_C (1 : R ⧸ I)).natDegree_pow, natDegree_X_sub_C, mul_one]
      simpa only [C_1] using hdeg
    have hd₂ : (X ^ n : (R ⧸ I)[X]).natDegree = n := by rw [natDegree_X_pow]
    have hpdeg : p.natDegree = n + n := by
      rw [← hp.natDegree_map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I), hpmap,
        hm₁.natDegree_mul hm₂, hd₁, hd₂]
    let P : MonicDegreeEq R (n + n) := MonicDegreeEq.mk p hp hpdeg
    let q₀ : MonicDegreeEq (R ⧸ I) n × MonicDegreeEq (R ⧸ I) n :=
      ⟨MonicDegreeEq.mk ((X - 1) ^ n) hm₁ hd₁, MonicDegreeEq.mk (X ^ n) hm₂ hd₂⟩
    have hcoprime : IsCoprime ((X - 1) ^ n : (R ⧸ I)[X]) (X ^ n) := by
      have hbase : IsCoprime (X - 1 : (R ⧸ I)[X]) X := ⟨-1, 1, by ring⟩
      exact hbase.pow
    obtain ⟨q, hprod, hcop, hq₁, hq₂⟩ :=
      Polynomial.exists_coprime_factorization_lift_of_henselian I n n rfl P q₀
        hpmap.symm hcoprime
    apply exists_idempotent_lift_of_coprime_polynomial_factors I b hb n hn
      q.1.1 q.2.1 hcop
    · rw [hprod]
      exact hpb
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val hq₁
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val hq₂

name: Algebra.exists_idempotent_lift_of_cyclic_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_idempotent_lift_of_cyclic_quotient
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Module.Finite R B] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] (b : B)
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b))
    (hcyc : ∀ x : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B), ∃ r : R,
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b * x =
        r • Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b) :
    ∃ e : B, IsIdempotentElem e ∧
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) e =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b
proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  let qR : R →+* R ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  let qB : B →+* B ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  obtain ⟨d, hd, p, hpmonic, hproot, hpmap⟩ :=
    exists_monic_annihilator_of_cyclic_quotient_idempotent
      I (HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := I)) b hb hcyc
  have hpone : p.eval 1 ∈ I := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    rw [← eval_one_map, hpmap, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_one,
      sub_self, zero_mul]
  have hpderiv : qR (p.derivative.eval 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← eval_one_map, ← derivative_map, hpmap, derivative_mul]
    simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_one, sub_zero,
      eval_add, eval_mul, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_one, eval_pow, one_pow,
      sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero, one_mul]
  obtain ⟨a, hpa, hai⟩ := HenselianRing.is_henselian
    (R := R) (I := I) p hpmonic 1 hpone (by rw [hpderiv]; exact isUnit_one)
  have haq : qR a = 1 := by
    have h : qR (a - 1) = 0 := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hai
    simpa only [map_sub, map_one, sub_eq_zero] using h
  obtain ⟨q, hpq⟩ := (dvd_iff_isRoot (p := p) (a := a)).mpr hpa
  have hqmap : q.map qR = X ^ d := by
    have hregular : IsLeftRegular (X - (1 : (R ⧸ I)[X])) := by
      simpa only [C_1] using (monic_X_sub_C (1 : R ⧸ I)).isRegular.left
    apply hregular
    have h := congrArg (Polynomial.map qR) hpq
    rw [hpmap, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X,
      Polynomial.map_C, haq, C_1] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hcmap : qR (q.eval a) = 1 := by
    rw [← eval_map_apply, haq, hqmap, eval_pow, eval_X, one_pow]
  have hc : IsUnit (q.eval a) := by
    apply Ideal.isUnit_of_sub_one_mem_jacobson_bot
    apply HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := I)
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change qR (q.eval a - 1) = 0
    rw [map_sub, map_one, hcmap, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hc.exists_right_inv
  let t : B := aeval b q
  let c : B := algebraMap R B (q.eval a)
  let zB : B := algebraMap R B z
  have hbt : (b - algebraMap R B a) * t = 0 := by
    simpa only [hpq, aeval_mul, aeval_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C] using hproot
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (X_sub_C_dvd_sub_C_eval (p := q) (a := a))
  have htc : t - c = (b - algebraMap R B a) * aeval b w := by
    simpa only [aeval_sub, aeval_C, aeval_mul, aeval_X] using
      congrArg (aeval b) hw
  have ht : t * t = c * t := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    calc
      t * t - c * t = (t - c) * t := by ring
      _ = ((b - algebraMap R B a) * aeval b w) * t := by rw [htc]
      _ = ((b - algebraMap R B a) * t) * aeval b w := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hbt, zero_mul]
  have hzB : c * zB = 1 := by
    change algebraMap R B (q.eval a) * algebraMap R B z = 1
    rw [← map_mul, hz, map_one]
  refine ⟨zB * t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (zB * t) * (zB * t) = zB * t
    calc
      (zB * t) * (zB * t) = (zB * zB) * (t * t) := by ring
      _ = (zB * zB) * (c * t) := by rw [ht]
      _ = (c * zB) * (zB * t) := by ring
      _ = zB * t := by rw [hzB, one_mul]
  · have hcomp : (algebraMap (R ⧸ I) (B ⧸ J)).comp qR =
        qB.comp (algebraMap R B) :=
      Ideal.quotientMap_comp_mk
        (show I ≤ J.comap (algebraMap R B) from Ideal.le_comap_map)
    have htq : qB t = qB b := by
      calc
        qB t = aeval (qB b) (q.map qR) :=
          Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map hcomp q b
        _ = (qB b) ^ d := by rw [hqmap, map_pow, aeval_X]
        _ = qB b := hb.pow_eq (Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hd))
    have hzbar : qR z = 1 := by
      have h := congrArg qR hz
      simpa only [map_mul, map_one, hcmap, one_mul] using h
    have hzBbar : qB zB = 1 := by
      calc
        qB zB = algebraMap (R ⧸ I) (B ⧸ J) (qR z) :=
          (RingHom.congr_fun hcomp z).symm
        _ = 1 := by rw [hzbar, map_one]
    change qB (zB * t) = qB b
    rw [map_mul, hzBbar, one_mul, htq]

name: Algebra.exists_idempotent_lift_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem exists_idempotent_lift_of_isIntegral
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R B] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] (b : B)
    (hb : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b)) :
    ∃ e : B, IsIdempotentElem e ∧
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) e =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hfinite, hbS, hbid⟩ :=
    exists_finite_subalgebra_quotient_idempotent I b hb
  let : Module.Finite R S := hfinite
  obtain ⟨e, he, heq⟩ := exists_idempotent_lift_of_finite I (⟨b, hbS⟩ : S) hbid
  refine ⟨S.val e, he.map S.val, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (S.val.quotientBaseChange I) heq

name: Algebra.bijective_idempotents_quotient_of_henselian
statement:
theorem bijective_idempotents_quotient_of_henselian
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R B] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] :
    Function.Bijective (fun e : {e : B // IsIdempotentElem e} ↦
      (⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) e.1,
        e.2.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)))⟩ :
          {e : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B) // IsIdempotentElem e}))
proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  have hJ : J ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥ :=
    Ideal.map_le_jacobson_bot_of_isIntegral (HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := I))
  constructor
  · intro e f h
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact IsIdempotentElem.eq_of_quotient_eq_of_le_jacobson J hJ e.2 f.2
      (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    have hbid : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk J b) := by
      rw [hb]
      exact ha
    obtain ⟨e, he, heq⟩ := exists_idempotent_lift_of_isIntegral I b hbid
    exact ⟨⟨e, he⟩, Subtype.ext (heq.trans hb)⟩

name: SchemeTheory.isLocalRing_of_finite_domain_henselian
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_of_finite_domain_henselian
    (R : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing R] [HenselianLocalRing R]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra R B] [Module.Finite R B] :
    IsLocalRing B
proof:
:= by
  let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  let J : Ideal B := m.map (algebraMap R B)
  let k := R ⧸ m
  let Q := B ⧸ J
  have hJ : J ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥ :=
    Ideal.map_le_jacobson_bot_of_isIntegral (HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := m))
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal B
  have hJM : J ≤ M := hJ.trans (sInf_le ⟨bot_le, hM⟩)
  have hproper : J ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top hM.ne_top hJM
  let : Nontrivial Q := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hproper
  let : Field k := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  let : Module.Finite k Q := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R k Q
  let : IsArtinianRing Q := isArtinian_of_tower k inferInstance
  have hidempotent : ∀ a : Q, IsIdempotentElem a → a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    have hbId : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk J b) := hb.symm ▸ ha
    obtain ⟨e, he, heq⟩ := Algebra.exists_idempotent_lift_of_isIntegral m b hbId
    have hezero : e * (1 - e) = 0 := isIdempotentElem_iff_mul_one_sub_self.mp he
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hezero with he0 | he1
    · left
      exact (heq.trans hb).symm.trans (he0 ▸ map_zero (Ideal.Quotient.mk J))
    · right
      have heone : e = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp he1).symm
      exact (heq.trans hb).symm.trans (heone ▸ map_one (Ideal.Quotient.mk J))
  have hlocal : IsLocalRing Q := by
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal Q
    apply IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal
    refine ⟨P, hP, ?_⟩
    intro N hN
    by_contra hne
    let : P.IsMaximal := hP
    obtain ⟨a, haP, ha, haN⟩ := IsArtinianRing.exists_not_mem_forall_mem_of_ne P
    rcases hidempotent a ha with hzero | hone
    · exact haP (hzero ▸ P.zero_mem)
    · exact hN.ne_top (N.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem (haN N hN.isPrime hne)
        (hone ▸ isUnit_one))
  let : IsLocalRing Q := hlocal
  let : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) := isLocalHom_of_le_jacobson_bot J hJ
  exact (Ideal.Quotient.mk J).domain_isLocalRing

name: SchemeTheory.strictHenselian_finiteDomain_aut_fixes_closedPoint
statement:
theorem strictHenselian_finiteDomain_aut_fixes_closedPoint
    (R : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing R] [HenselianLocalRing R]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra R B] [Module.Finite R B]
    {Ω : Type w} [Field Ω] (φ : B →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (σ : B ≃ₐ[R] B) : φ.comp σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom = φ
proof:
:= by
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_of_finite_domain_henselian R B
  have hcontract : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).under R = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal
      (Ideal.isMaximal_under_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (R := R)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B))
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R B) :=
    ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE (algebraMap R B)).out 1 5).mpr hcontract
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
  have hσ : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapAlgEquiv' σ).toAlgHom = AlgHom.id k l :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  ext b
  change φ (σ b) = φ b
  have heq : IsLocalRing.residue B (σ b) = IsLocalRing.residue B b :=
    congrArg (fun f : l →ₐ[k] l => f (IsLocalRing.residue B b)) hσ
  have hpoint := congrArg (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.lift φ) heq
  simpa only [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.lift_residue_apply] using hpoint

name: SchemeTheory.exists_local_hom_finiteDomain_fixed_of_strictHenselian
statement:
theorem exists_local_hom_finiteDomain_fixed_of_strictHenselian
    (R : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing R] [HenselianLocalRing R]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra R B] [Module.Finite R B]
    {Ω : Type w} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (ψ : R →+* Ω) [IsLocalHom ψ] :
    ∃ φ : B →+* Ω, IsLocalHom φ ∧ φ.comp (algebraMap R B) = ψ ∧
      ∀ σ : B ≃ₐ[R] B, φ.comp σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom = φ
proof:
:= by
  let : IsLocalRing B := isLocalRing_of_finite_domain_henselian R B
  have hcontract : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).under R = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal
      (Ideal.isMaximal_under_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (R := R)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B))
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R B) :=
    ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE (algebraMap R B)).out 1 5).mpr hcontract
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R
  let l := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
  let : Algebra k Ω := (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.lift ψ).toAlgebra
  let e : l →ₐ[k] Ω := IsAlgClosed.lift (R := k) (S := l) (M := Ω)
  let φ : B →+* Ω := e.toRingHom.comp (IsLocalRing.residue B)
  let : IsLocalHom φ := inferInstance
  refine ⟨φ, inferInstance, ?_, fun σ =>
    strictHenselian_finiteDomain_aut_fixes_closedPoint R B φ σ⟩
  ext r
  change e (IsLocalRing.residue B (algebraMap R B r)) = ψ r
  rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_residue (R := R) (S := B), e.commutes]
  exact IsLocalRing.ResidueField.lift_residue_apply ψ r

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_isFractionRing_of_fractionField_algebraic
statement:
theorem integralClosure_isFractionRing_of_fractionField_algebraic
    (A : Type uA) (K : Type uK) (L : Type uL)
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L]
    [IsScalarTower A K L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] :
    IsFractionRing (integralClosure A L) L
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic A L :=
    (IsFractionRing.comap_isAlgebraic_iff (A := A) (K := K) (C := L)).mpr inferInstance
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A L) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A K L]
    exact (algebraMap K L).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective A K)
  exact integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_algebraic
    (A := A) (L := L) (fun a ha => hinj (ha.trans (map_zero (algebraMap A L)).symm))

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) K
proof:
:=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) K := by
  intro algebraP_K
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (IsLocalization.lift_comp _).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isFractionRing
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) K
proof:
:=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    IsFractionRing (Localization.AtPrime P) K := by
  intro algebraP_K
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower (K := K) P

    P.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P) K

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) K
proof:
:=
      localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L :=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime P) K L := by
  intro algebraP_K algebraP_L
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem localizationAtPrimeToExtension_isScalarTower
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] :
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) L
proof:
:=
      localizationAtPrimeToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) (L := L) P
    IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) L := by
  intro algebraP_L
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime P) K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionFieldAlgebra (K := K) P
  let : IsScalarTower A (Localization.AtPrime P) K :=
    localizationAtPrimeToFractionField_isScalarTower (K := K) P
  refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ ?_
  change algebraMap A L x =
    algebraMap K L
      (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime P) K
        (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) x))
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (Localization.AtPrime P) K,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.fractionRingToChosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem fractionRingToChosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower :
    letI : Algebra (FractionRing V) K
proof:
:= FractionRing.liftAlgebra V K
    letI : Algebra (FractionRing V) L :=
      fractionRingToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
    IsScalarTower (FractionRing V) K L := by
  let : Algebra (FractionRing V) K := FractionRing.liftAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra (FractionRing V) L :=
    fractionRingToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.fractionRingToExtension_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem fractionRingToExtension_isScalarTower :
    letI : Algebra (FractionRing V) L
proof:
:=
      fractionRingToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
    IsScalarTower V (FractionRing V) L := by
  let : Algebra (FractionRing V) K := FractionRing.liftAlgebra V K
  let : IsScalarTower V (FractionRing V) K :=
    FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra (FractionRing V) L :=
    fractionRingToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  let : IsScalarTower (FractionRing V) K L :=
    fractionRingToChosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ ?_
  change algebraMap V L x =
    algebraMap K L
      (algebraMap (FractionRing V) K
        (algebraMap V (FractionRing V) x))
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V (FractionRing V) K,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V K L]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.fractionRingToExtension_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem fractionRingToExtension_finiteDimensional :
    letI : Algebra (FractionRing V) L
proof:
:=
      fractionRingToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
    FiniteDimensional (FractionRing V) L := by
  let : Algebra (FractionRing V) K := FractionRing.liftAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra (FractionRing V) L :=
    fractionRingToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  let : IsScalarTower (FractionRing V) K L :=
    fractionRingToChosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
      (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)
  let e : FractionRing V ≃ₐ[FractionRing V] K :=
    fractionRingChosenFractionFieldAlgEquiv (V := V) (K := K)
  let : Module.Finite (FractionRing V) K :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective e.toLinearMap e.surjective
  exact Module.Finite.trans K L

statement:
theorem fractionRingToExtension_isSeparable :

proof:
:=
      fractionRingToExtensionAlgebra (V := V) (K := K) (L := L)

  let : Algebra (FractionRing V) K := FractionRing.liftAlgebra V K
  let : Algebra (FractionRing V) L :=

    fractionRingToChosenFractionFieldToExtension_isScalarTower
