  let : Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing V) K :=
    AlgEquiv.Algebra.isSeparable e
  exact Algebra.IsSeparable.trans (FractionRing V) K L

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.traceForm_surjective_iff_isUnit_discr
statement:
theorem traceForm_surjective_iff_isUnit_discr
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι R S) :
    Function.Surjective (Algebra.traceForm R S) ↔
      IsUnit (Algebra.discr R b)
proof:
:= by
  let M : Matrix ι ι R :=
    LinearMap.toMatrix b b.dualBasis (Algebra.traceForm R S)
  have hM : M = Algebra.traceMatrix R b := by
    ext i j
    simp [M, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Algebra.traceMatrix_apply,
      Algebra.traceForm_apply, mul_comm]
  have hsurj :
      Function.Surjective (Algebra.traceForm R S) ↔
        Function.Surjective M.mulVec := by
    constructor
    · intro h v
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h (b.dualBasis.equivFun.symm v)
      refine ⟨b.equivFun x, ?_⟩
      have hmatrix :=
        LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr b b.dualBasis
          (Algebra.traceForm R S) x
      calc
        M.mulVec (b.equivFun x) =
            b.dualBasis.equivFun ((Algebra.traceForm R S) x) := by
          simpa [M, Basis.equivFun_apply] using hmatrix
        _ = b.dualBasis.equivFun (b.dualBasis.equivFun.symm v) := by
          rw [hx]
        _ = v := b.dualBasis.equivFun.apply_symm_apply v
    · intro h y
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := h (b.dualBasis.equivFun y)
      refine ⟨b.equivFun.symm v, ?_⟩
      apply b.dualBasis.equivFun.injective
      have hmatrix :=
        LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr b b.dualBasis
          (Algebra.traceForm R S) (b.equivFun.symm v)
      have hmatrix' :
          M.mulVec v =
            b.dualBasis.equivFun
              ((Algebra.traceForm R S) (b.equivFun.symm v)) := by
        change
          M.mulVec (b.equivFun (b.equivFun.symm v)) =
            b.dualBasis.equivFun
              ((Algebra.traceForm R S) (b.equivFun.symm v)) at hmatrix
        simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hmatrix
      exact hmatrix'.symm.trans hv
  rw [hsurj, Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit,
    Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, Algebra.discr_def, hM]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.traceForm_injective_of_isUnit_discr
statement:
theorem traceForm_injective_of_isUnit_discr
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι R S) (hdisc : IsUnit (Algebra.discr R b)) :
    Function.Injective (Algebra.traceForm R S)
proof:
:= by
  let M : Matrix ι ι R :=
    LinearMap.toMatrix b b.dualBasis (Algebra.traceForm R S)
  have hM : M = Algebra.traceMatrix R b := by
    ext i j
    simp [M, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Algebra.traceMatrix_apply,
      Algebra.traceForm_apply, mul_comm]
  have hMunit : IsUnit M := by
    rw [Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, hM, ← Algebra.discr_def]
    exact hdisc
  intro x y hxy
  apply b.equivFun.injective
  apply Matrix.mulVec_injective_of_isUnit hMunit
  have hx :=
    LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr b b.dualBasis
      (Algebra.traceForm R S) x
  have hy :=
    LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr b b.dualBasis
      (Algebra.traceForm R S) y
  change M.mulVec (b.equivFun x) =
    b.dualBasis.equivFun ((Algebra.traceForm R S) x) at hx
  change M.mulVec (b.equivFun y) =
    b.dualBasis.equivFun ((Algebra.traceForm R S) y) at hy
  rw [hx, hy, hxy]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.traceForm_surjective_of_formallyUnramified
statement:
theorem traceForm_surjective_of_formallyUnramified
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [_root_.Finite ι]
    (b : Basis ι R S) (h : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S) :
    Function.Surjective (Algebra.traceForm R S)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Free R S := Module.Free.of_basis b
  let : Module.Finite R S := Module.Finite.of_basis b
  let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S := h
  let contraction (f : Module.Dual R S) : S ⊗[R] S →ₗ[R] S :=
    TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.lsmul R S).comp f)
  let twist (f : Module.Dual R S) : S →ₗ[R] Module.Dual R S :=
    (Algebra.lsmul R R S).toLinearMap.compr₂ f
  let tensorEnd (f : Module.Dual R S) : S ⊗[R] S →ₗ[R] Module.End R S :=
    (dualTensorHom R S S).comp
      (TensorProduct.map (twist f) (LinearMap.id (R := R) (M := S)))
  have htrace (f : Module.Dual R S) (q : S ⊗[R] S) :
      LinearMap.trace R S (tensorEnd f q) =
        f (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R q) := by
    induction q using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul x y =>
        rw [show tensorEnd f (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) = (twist f x).smulRight y by
          ext z
          simp [tensorEnd, twist]]
        rw [LinearMap.trace_smulRight]
        simp [twist]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  have hcontract_right (f : Module.Dual R S) (s : S) (q : S ⊗[R] S) :
      contraction f (((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] s) * q) = contraction f q * s := by
    induction q using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul x y =>
        simp [contraction, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_comm]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_mul]
  have hcontract_left (f : Module.Dual R S) (s : S) (q : S ⊗[R] S) :
      contraction f ((s ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S)) * q) = tensorEnd f q s := by
    induction q using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul x y =>
        simp [contraction, tensorEnd, twist, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
          mul_comm]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [mul_add, map_add, hx, hy, LinearMap.add_apply]
  have htensorEnd_eq_contraction_twist
      (f : Module.Dual R S) (q : S ⊗[R] S) (s : S) :
      tensorEnd f q s = contraction (twist f s) q := by
    induction q using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul x y =>
        simp [contraction, tensorEnd, twist, mul_comm]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
  let t : S ⊗[R] S := Algebra.FormallyUnramified.elem R S
  have hlsmul (f : Module.Dual R S) :
      Algebra.lmul R S (contraction f t) = tensorEnd f t := by
    ext s
    have hc := congrArg (contraction f)
      (Algebra.FormallyUnramified.one_tmul_mul_elem (R := R) (S := S) s)
    rw [hcontract_right, hcontract_left] at hc
    simpa [Algebra.coe_lmul_eq_mul] using hc
  have htrace_contraction (f : Module.Dual R S) :
      Algebra.trace R S (contraction f t) = f 1 := by
    rw [Algebra.trace_apply, hlsmul, htrace,
      show Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R t = 1 from
        Algebra.FormallyUnramified.lmul_elem (R := R) (S := S)]
  intro f
  refine ⟨contraction f t, ?_⟩
  ext s
  rw [Algebra.traceForm_apply]
  have hc := congrArg (contraction f)
    (Algebra.FormallyUnramified.one_tmul_mul_elem (R := R) (S := S) s)
  rw [hcontract_right, hcontract_left, htensorEnd_eq_contraction_twist] at hc
  rw [hc, htrace_contraction]
  simp [twist]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.formallyUnramified_of_traceForm_surjective
statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_of_traceForm_surjective
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [_root_.Finite ι]
    (b : Basis ι R S)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (Algebra.traceForm R S)) :
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let : Module.Finite R S := Module.Finite.of_basis b
  have hdisc : IsUnit (Algebra.discr R b) :=
    (traceForm_surjective_iff_isUnit_discr b).mp hsurj
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Algebra.traceForm R S) :=
    traceForm_injective_of_isUnit_discr b hdisc
  choose c hc using fun i : ι ↦ hsurj (b.coord i)
  have hdual (i : ι) (x : S) :
      Algebra.trace R S (c i * x) = b.repr x i := by
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (hc i) x
    simpa [Algebra.traceForm_apply, Basis.coord_apply] using h
  let t : S ⊗[R] S := ∑ i, c i ⊗ₜ[R] b i
  have ht_lmul : Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R t = 1 := by
    apply hinj
    ext x
    rw [Algebra.traceForm_apply, Algebra.traceForm_apply]
    simp only [t, map_sum, Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'_apply_tmul,
      Finset.sum_mul, one_mul]
    simp_rw [mul_assoc, hdual]
    rw [Algebra.trace_eq_matrix_trace b, Matrix.trace]
    simp_rw [Matrix.diag_apply, Algebra.leftMulMatrix_eq_repr_mul]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rw [mul_comm (b i) x]
  refine (Algebra.FormallyUnramified.iff_exists_tensorProduct).mpr
    ⟨t, ?_, ht_lmul⟩
  intro s
  rw [sub_mul, sub_eq_zero]
  apply (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b).injective
  ext j
  simp only [t, Finset.mul_sum, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    map_sum, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply]
  apply hinj
  ext x
  rw [Algebra.traceForm_apply, Algebra.traceForm_apply]
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
  simp_rw [one_mul,
    TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight_apply_tmul_apply]
  have hright (i : ι) :
      Algebra.trace R S ((s * c i) * x) = b.repr (s * x) i := by
    rw [mul_comm s (c i), mul_assoc, hdual]
  simp_rw [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hdual, hright]
  calc
    (∑ i, b.repr (s * b i) j • b.repr x i) =
        ∑ i, b.repr x i • b.repr (s * b i) j := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact mul_comm _ _
    _ = b.repr (s * x) j := by
      conv_rhs => rw [← b.sum_repr x]
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_sum, map_smul]
      simp only [Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply]
    _ = ∑ i, b.repr (b i) j • b.repr (s * x) i := by
      symm
      rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single j]
      · rw [Basis.repr_self_apply, ite_eq_left rfl, one_smul]
      · intro i hij
        simp [Basis.repr_self, hij]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.formallyUnramified_iff_isUnit_discr
statement:
theorem formallyUnramified_iff_isUnit_discr
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι R S) :
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S ↔ IsUnit (Algebra.discr R b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (traceForm_surjective_iff_isUnit_discr b).mp
      (traceForm_surjective_of_formallyUnramified b h)
  · intro h
    exact formallyUnramified_of_traceForm_surjective b
      ((traceForm_surjective_iff_isUnit_discr b).mpr h)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etale_iff_isUnit_discr
statement:
theorem etale_iff_isUnit_discr
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : Basis ι R S) :
    Algebra.Etale R S ↔ IsUnit (Algebra.discr R b)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Free R S := Module.Free.of_basis b
  let : Module.Finite R S := Module.Finite.of_basis b
  let : Module.FinitePresentation R S :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_projective R S
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation R S := inferInstance
  constructor
  · intro h
    let : Algebra.Etale R S := h
    exact (formallyUnramified_iff_isUnit_discr b).mp inferInstance
  · intro h
    let : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S :=
      (formallyUnramified_iff_isUnit_discr b).mpr h
    exact Algebra.Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_eq_of_formallyUnramified_flat_square
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_eq_of_formallyUnramified_flat_square
    {R : Type uR} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C]
    [Algebra B S] [Algebra C S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsScalarTower R B S] [IsScalarTower R C S]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType R C] [Algebra.FormallyUnramified R C]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType B S] [Algebra.FormallyUnramified B S]
    [Module.Flat B S]
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime]
    (Q : Ideal S) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver q] :
    Q.ramificationIdx C = q.ramificationIdx R
proof:
:= by
  let P := Q.under C
  let p := P.under R
  let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p
  let Cp := Localization.AtPrime P
  let SQ := Localization.AtPrime Q
  have hUnramified : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P := by
    exact
      (Algebra.formallyUnramified_iff_forall.mp
        (inferInstance : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R C))
          (PrimeSpectrum.mk P inferInstance)
  let : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P := hUnramified
  let : Algebra Rp Cp := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p P
  let : Algebra Cp SQ := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
  have hpMap :
      p.map (algebraMap R Cp) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Cp :=
    ((Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_map_eq R p P).mp hUnramified).2
  have hPMap :
      P.map (algebraMap C Cp) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Cp :=
    Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal
  have hSameIdeal :
      p.map (algebraMap R SQ) = P.map (algebraMap C SQ) := by
    calc
      p.map (algebraMap R SQ) =
          (p.map (algebraMap R Cp)).map (algebraMap Cp SQ) := by
        symm
        rw [Ideal.map_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R Cp SQ]
      _ = (P.map (algebraMap C Cp)).map (algebraMap Cp SQ) := by
        rw [hpMap, hPMap]
      _ = P.map (algebraMap C SQ) := by
        rw [Ideal.map_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq C Cp SQ]
  have hQOverP : Q.LiesOver p := Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P p
  let : Q.LiesOver p := hQOverP
  have hAcrossBase :
      Q.ramificationIdx C = Q.ramificationIdx R := by
    rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq P Q, Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq p Q,
      hSameIdeal]
  calc
    Q.ramificationIdx C = Q.ramificationIdx R := hAcrossBase
    _ = q.ramificationIdx R * Q.ramificationIdx B :=
      Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower q Q
    _ = q.ramificationIdx R := by
      rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq_one Q B, mul_one]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_eq_of_etale_square
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_eq_of_etale_square
    {R : Type uR} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C]
    [Algebra B S] [Algebra C S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsScalarTower R B S] [IsScalarTower R C S]
    [Algebra.Etale R C] [Algebra.Etale B S]
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime]
    (Q : Ideal S) [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver q] :
    Q.ramificationIdx C = q.ramificationIdx R
proof:
:= by
  exact ramificationIdx_eq_of_formallyUnramified_flat_square q Q

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_eq_of_etale
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_tensorProduct_eq_of_etale
    {R B C : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C] [Algebra.Etale R C]
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime]
    (Q : Ideal (TensorProduct R C B)) [Q.IsPrime]
    (hQ : Q.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = q) :
    Q.ramificationIdx C = q.ramificationIdx R
proof:
:= by
  let T := TensorProduct R C B
  let : Algebra B T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R B T := Algebra.TensorProduct.right_isScalarTower
  let commB : AlgEquiv B (TensorProduct R B C) T :=
    { toRingEquiv := (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R B C).toRingEquiv
      commutes' := by
        intro b
        exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.right_algebraMap_apply b).symm }
  let : Algebra.Etale B T := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv commB
  let : Q.LiesOver q :=
    { over := by
        simpa [Ideal.under_def,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_eq_includeRight] using hQ.symm }
  let P := Q.under C
  let p := P.under R
  let Rp := Localization.AtPrime p
  let Cp := Localization.AtPrime P
  let TQ := Localization.AtPrime Q
  have h_unramified : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P := by
    exact (Algebra.formallyUnramified_iff_forall.mp
      (inferInstance : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R C))
        (PrimeSpectrum.mk P inferInstance)
  let : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P := h_unramified
  let : Algebra Rp Cp := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p P
  let : Algebra Cp TQ := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
  have hp_map : p.map (algebraMap R Cp) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Cp :=
    ((Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_map_eq R p P).mp h_unramified).2
  have hP_map : P.map (algebraMap C Cp) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Cp :=
    Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal
  have h_same_ideal :
      p.map (algebraMap R TQ) = P.map (algebraMap C TQ) := by
    calc
      p.map (algebraMap R TQ) =
          (p.map (algebraMap R Cp)).map (algebraMap Cp TQ) := by
        symm
        rw [Ideal.map_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R Cp TQ]
      _ = (P.map (algebraMap C Cp)).map (algebraMap Cp TQ) := by
        rw [hp_map, hP_map]
      _ = P.map (algebraMap C TQ) := by
        rw [Ideal.map_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq C Cp TQ]
  have hQ_over_p : Q.LiesOver p := by
    exact Ideal.LiesOver.trans Q P p
  let : Q.LiesOver p := hQ_over_p
  have h_over_base : Q.ramificationIdx C = Q.ramificationIdx R := by
    rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq P Q, Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq p Q,
      h_same_ideal]
  calc
    Q.ramificationIdx C = Q.ramificationIdx R := h_over_base
    _ = q.ramificationIdx R * Q.ramificationIdx B :=
      Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower q Q
    _ = q.ramificationIdx R := by
      rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq_one Q B, mul_one]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_map_eq
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_map_eq
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (p : Ideal R) (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    (hmap : p.map (algebraMap R S) = q) :
    q.ramificationIdx R = 1
proof:
:= by
  let Sq := Localization.AtPrime q
  have hmap_local :
      p.map (algebraMap R Sq) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Sq := by
    calc
      p.map (algebraMap R Sq) =
          (p.map (algebraMap R S)).map (algebraMap S Sq) := by
        rw [Ideal.map_map, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S Sq]
      _ = q.map (algebraMap S Sq) := by rw [hmap]
      _ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Sq :=
        Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal
  rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq p q, hmap_local,
    ENat.toNat_eq_iff_eq_natCast, Nat.cast_one, Module.length_eq_one_iff,
    isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom, ← Ideal.isMaximal_def,
    IsLocalRing.isMaximal_iff]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ramificationIdx_eq_of_flat_baseChange_mapped_primes
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_eq_of_flat_baseChange_mapped_primes
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} {R' : Type uR'} {S' : Type uS'}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S']
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra S S'] [Algebra R' S']
    [Algebra R S'] [IsScalarTower R S S'] [IsScalarTower R R' S']
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R R'] [Module.FaithfullyFlat S S']
    [Module.Flat R' S']
    (p : Ideal R) (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    (p' : Ideal R') (q' : Ideal S') [q'.IsPrime] [q'.LiesOver p']
    (hpmap : p.map (algebraMap R R') = p')
    (hqmap : q.map (algebraMap S S') = q') :
    q'.ramificationIdx R' = q.ramificationIdx R
proof:
:= by
  have hp_over : p'.LiesOver p := by
    rw [← hpmap]
    exact
      { over :=
          (Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat
            (B := R') p).symm }
  have hq_over : q'.LiesOver q := by
    rw [← hqmap]
    exact
      { over :=
          (Ideal.comap_map_eq_self_of_faithfullyFlat
            (B := S') q).symm }
  let : p'.LiesOver p := hp_over
  let : q'.LiesOver q := hq_over
  let : p'.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_of_liesOver q' p'
  have hp_one : p'.ramificationIdx R = 1 :=
    ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_map_eq p p' hpmap
  have hq_one : q'.ramificationIdx S = 1 :=
    ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_map_eq q q' hqmap
  have hleft := Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower (R := R) q q'
  have hright := Ideal.ramificationIdx_tower (R := R) p' q'
  rw [hq_one, mul_one] at hleft
  rw [hp_one, one_mul] at hright
  exact hright.symm.trans hleft

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.geometricallyIntegral_specMap_transport_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem geometricallyIntegral_specMap_transport_ringEquiv
    {k R S : Type uL} [Field k] [Field R] [Field S]
    [Algebra k R] (e : R ≃+* S)
    (h : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R)))) :
    letI : Algebra k S
proof:
:=
      (e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k R)).toAlgebra
    AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S))) := by
  let : Algebra k S :=
    (e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k R)).toAlgebra
  let i : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ≅
      AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of R) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Spec.mapIso e.toCommRingCatIso.op
  have hi : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (i.hom ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R))) := by
    let : MorphismProperty.RespectsIso
        (@AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral :
          MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{uL}) :=
      MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.respectsIso
        (P := (@AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral :
          MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{uL}))
    exact (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso
      (C := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{uL})
      (P := (@AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral :
        MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{uL}))
      i.hom
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R)))).mpr h
  have hmap : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫
      e.toCommRingCatIso.hom.op.unop =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
    ext x
    rfl
  simpa only [i, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Spec_map,
    ← AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, hmap]
    using hi

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_basePrimeResidue_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem
    idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_basePrimeResidue_of_ratEquiv
    (k : Type uL) [Field k] (e : k ≃+* ℚ)
    {A : Type uL} {B : Type uB} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L]
    [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower A B L]
    [IsIntegralClosure B A L] [IsDedekindDomain B]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (P : Ideal B) [P.IsMaximal] (hP : P ≠ ⊥)
    [Algebra k (A ⧸ normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P)]
    (hgeo : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k
          (A ⧸ normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P))))) :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    ∀ sigma : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K),
      IsConj (sigma : Gal(L/K))
        ((sigma⁻¹ : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) : Gal(L/K)) := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  let p := normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P
  let V := idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP
  let F := decompositionResidueField K V
  let E := selectedResidueField V
  let : p.IsMaximal := normalizationIdealBasePrime_isMaximal
    (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) P
  let : CharZero k := e.toRingHom.charZero
  let : CharZero (A ⧸ p) :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap
      (algebraMap k (A ⧸ p)).injective
  let q : A ⧸ p ≃+* F :=
    normalizationBaseResidueEquivDecompositionResidueField
      (A := A) (B := B) (K := K) (L := L) (P := P) (hP := hP)
  let : Algebra k F :=
    (q.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k (A ⧸ p))).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra k E :=
    ((algebraMap F E).comp (algebraMap k F)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower k F E :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hgeoF : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k F))) :=
    geometricallyIntegral_specMap_transport_ringEquiv q hgeo
  exact
    idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_residue_of_ratEquiv
      k e (A := A) (B := B) (K := K) (L := L) P hP hgeoF

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.TameInertiaCyclicCore.character_evaluation_injective_of_isCyclic
statement:
private theorem character_evaluation_injective_of_isCyclic
    (X k : Type*) [Group X] [IsCyclic X] [Field k] :
    ∃ x : X, Function.Injective
      (((MonoidHom.eval : X →* (X →* kˣ) →* kˣ) x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := X)
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  intro chi psi heq
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro y
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hx y
  change chi (x ^ n) = psi (x ^ n)
  rw [map_zpow, map_zpow]
  change chi x = psi x at heq
  exact congrArg (fun z : kˣ ↦ z ^ n) heq

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.TameInertiaCyclicCore.inertiaGroup_isCyclic_of_card_coprime_ringExpChar
statement:
theorem inertiaGroup_isCyclic_of_card_coprime_ringExpChar
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L)
    [Finite (inertiaGroup K V)]
    (hvalue : valueTrivialInertiaGroup K V = ⊤)
    [IsCyclic
      ((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)]
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card (inertiaGroup K V))
      (ringExpChar (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V))) :
    IsCyclic (inertiaGroup K V)
proof:
:= by
  let k := IsLocalRing.ResidueField V
  let : Finite (ramificationGroup K V) :=
    Finite.of_injective (ramificationGroup K V).subtype
      Subtype.coe_injective
  have hramBot : ramificationGroup K V = ⊥ := by
    by_cases hchar : ringChar k = 0
    · let : CharZero k :=
        (CharP.ringChar_zero_iff_CharZero (R := k)).mp hchar
      exact
        TameInertiaRamification.ramificationGroup_eq_bot_of_residue_charZero
          K V
    · have hp : (ringChar k).Prime :=
        CharP.char_prime_of_ne_zero k hchar
      let : Fact (ringChar k).Prime := ⟨hp⟩
      have hramP : IsPGroup (ringChar k) (ramificationGroup K V) :=
        TameInertiaRamification.ramificationGroup_isPGroup_of_residue_charP
          K V (ringChar k)
      obtain ⟨n, hramCard⟩ := IsPGroup.iff_card.mp hramP
      have hramDvd : Nat.card (ramificationGroup K V) ∣
          Nat.card (inertiaGroup K V) :=
        Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card (ramificationGroup K V)
      have hcop' : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card (inertiaGroup K V))
          (ringChar k) := by
        simpa [k, ringExpChar,
          Nat.max_eq_left hp.one_lt.le] using hcop
      have hramOne : Nat.card (ramificationGroup K V) = 1 :=
        Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes (hcop'.pow_right n) hramDvd
          (hramCard ▸ dvd_rfl)
      exact (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_card (ramificationGroup K V)).2 hramOne
  let e : inertiaGroup K V ≃* valueTrivialInertiaGroup K V := {
    toFun sigma := ⟨sigma, by rw [hvalue]; trivial⟩
    invFun sigma := sigma
    left_inv _ := rfl
    right_inv _ := rfl
    map_mul' _ _ := rfl }
  let chi := (valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K V).comp e.toMonoidHom
  have hchiKerRam : chi.ker = ramificationGroup K V := by
    ext sigma
    change
      valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K V (e sigma) = 1 ↔
        sigma ∈ ramificationGroup K V
    rw [← MonoidHom.mem_ker,
      valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom_mem_ker_iff]
    rfl
  have hchiKer : chi.ker = ⊥ := by
    rw [hchiKerRam, hramBot]
  have hchi : Function.Injective chi := chi.ker_eq_bot_iff.mp hchiKer
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := character_evaluation_injective_of_isCyclic
    ((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)
  let ev :
      (((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V) →*
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)ˣ) →*
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)ˣ :=
    (MonoidHom.eval :
      ((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V) →*
        ((((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V) →*
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)ˣ) →*
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)ˣ)) x
  let rho : inertiaGroup K V →* IsLocalRing.ResidueField V :=
    (Units.coeHom (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)).comp (ev.comp chi)
  apply isCyclic_of_injective_ringHom rho
  exact Units.val_injective.comp (hx.comp hchi)

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.TameInertiaCyclicCore.valuationSubring_maximalIdeal_inertia_eq
statement:
theorem valuationSubring_maximalIdeal_inertia_eq
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).toAddSubgroup.inertia
        (decompositionGroup K V) = inertiaGroup K V
proof:
:= by
  ext sigma
  rw [← residueAction_ker (K := K) V, MonoidHom.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro hsigma
    apply RingEquiv.ext
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective x
    change sigma • (IsLocalRing.residue V a : IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) =
      IsLocalRing.residue V a
    rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.residue_smul]
    rw [(open _root_.ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ResidueField in
      residue_eq_residue_iff_sub_mem_maximalIdeal)]
    exact hsigma a
  · intro hsigma a
    change sigma • a - a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V
    rw [← (open _root_.ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.ResidueField in
      residue_eq_residue_iff_sub_mem_maximalIdeal)]
    have happ := congrArg
      (fun e : IsLocalRing.ResidueField V ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField V ↦
        e (IsLocalRing.residue V a)) hsigma
    change sigma • (IsLocalRing.residue V a : IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) =
      IsLocalRing.residue V a at happ
    rwa [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.residue_smul] at happ

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.TameInertiaRamification.residue_natCast_eq_zero_of_ramification_prime_order
statement:
private theorem residue_natCast_eq_zero_of_ramification_prime_order
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L)
    (ell : ℕ) (sigma : ramificationGroup K V)
    (hsigmaOrder : orderOf sigma = ell) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 1) :
    (ell : IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsigmaAut :
      (((sigma : inertiaGroup K V) : decompositionGroup K V) :
        L ≃ₐ[K] L) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hsigma
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact h
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := DFunLike.ne_iff.mp hsigmaAut
  let g : L ≃ₐ[K] L :=
    ((sigma : inertiaGroup K V) : decompositionGroup K V)
  let y : L := g x - x
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hx
  let yu : Lˣ := Units.mk0 y hy
  have hsigmaPow : sigma ^ ell = 1 := by
    rw [← hsigmaOrder]
    exact pow_orderOf_eq_one sigma
  have hgPow : g ^ ell = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun tau : ramificationGroup K V ↦
        (((tau : inertiaGroup K V) : decompositionGroup K V) :
          L ≃ₐ[K] L)) hsigmaPow
    simpa [g] using h
  let quotient (i : ℕ) : Lˣ :=
    automorphismUnitQuotient K V
      (((sigma ^ i : ramificationGroup K V) : inertiaGroup K V) :
        decompositionGroup K V) yu
  have hprincipal (i : ℕ) : quotient i ∈ V.principalUnitGroup :=
    (mem_ramificationGroup_iff K V
      ((sigma ^ i : ramificationGroup K V) : inertiaGroup K V)).mp
        (sigma ^ i).property yu
  let quotientUnit (i : ℕ) : V.unitGroup :=
    ⟨quotient i, V.principal_units_le_units (hprincipal i)⟩
  let quotientV (i : ℕ) : V :=
    (V.unitGroupMulEquiv (quotientUnit i) : Vˣ)
  have hquotientV_coe (i : ℕ) :
      (quotientV i : L) = (quotient i : L) := by
    rfl
  have hresidue (i : ℕ) :
      IsLocalRing.residue V (quotientV i) = 1 := by
    have hker : quotientUnit i ∈ V.unitGroupToResidueFieldUnits.ker := by
      rw [V.ker_unitGroupToResidueFieldUnits]
      exact hprincipal i
    have hunit := MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hker
    have hcoe := congrArg Units.val hunit
    change IsLocalRing.residue V
      (V.unitGroupMulEquiv (quotientUnit i) : V) = 1 at hcoe
    simpa only [quotientV] using hcoe
  have hsumField :
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, (quotient i : L) = 0 := by
    calc
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, (quotient i : L) =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, (g ^ i) y / y := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        simp only [quotient, automorphismUnitQuotient,
          Units.val_div_eq_div_val, Units.coe_mapEquiv, yu]
        rfl
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, (g ^ i) y) / y := by
        rw [Finset.sum_div]
      _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell,
          ((g ^ (i + 1)) x - (g ^ i) x)) / y := by
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _hi
        simp [y, map_sub, pow_succ, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
      _ = ((g ^ ell) x - (g ^ 0) x) / y := by
        congr 1
        exact Finset.sum_range_sub (fun i ↦ (g ^ i) x) ell
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [hgPow]
        simp only [pow_zero, sub_self, zero_div]
  have hsumV : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, quotientV i = 0 := by
    apply V.subtype_injective
    rw [map_sum, map_zero]
    change ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ell, (quotientV i : L) = 0
    simpa only [hquotientV_coe] using hsumField
  have hsumResidue := congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue V) hsumV
  simpa only [map_sum, map_zero, hresidue, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hsumResidue

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.TameInertiaRamification.ramificationGroup_eq_bot_of_residue_charZero
statement:
theorem ramificationGroup_eq_bot_of_residue_charZero
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)]
    [Finite (ramificationGroup K V)] :
    ramificationGroup K V = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_card (ramificationGroup K V)).2
  by_contra hcard
  obtain ⟨ell, hell, helldvd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hcard
  let : Fact ell.Prime := ⟨hell⟩
  obtain ⟨sigma, hsigmaOrder⟩ :=
    exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card'
      (G := ramificationGroup K V) ell helldvd
  have hsigmaOne : sigma = 1 := by
    by_contra hsigma
    have hellZero : (ell : IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) = 0 :=
      residue_natCast_eq_zero_of_ramification_prime_order
        K V ell sigma hsigmaOrder hsigma
    exact (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hell.ne_zero) hellZero
  have : ell = 1 := by
    rw [← hsigmaOrder, hsigmaOne, orderOf_one]
  exact hell.ne_one this

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.TameInertiaRamification.ramificationGroup_isPGroup_of_residue_charP
statement:
theorem ramificationGroup_isPGroup_of_residue_charP
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) (p : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) p]
    [Finite (ramificationGroup K V)] :
    IsPGroup p (ramificationGroup K V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsPGroup.iff_orderOf]
  intro sigma
  refine ⟨(orderOf sigma).primeFactorsList.length, ?_⟩
  apply Nat.eq_prime_pow_of_unique_prime_dvd (orderOf_pos sigma).ne'
  intro ell hell hellDvd
  let tau : ramificationGroup K V := sigma ^ (orderOf sigma / ell)
  have htauOrder : orderOf tau = ell := by
    exact orderOf_pow_orderOf_div (orderOf_pos sigma).ne' hellDvd
  by_contra hne
  have htauOne : tau = 1 := by
    by_contra htau
    have hellZero : (ell : IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) = 0 :=
      residue_natCast_eq_zero_of_ramification_prime_order
        K V ell tau htauOrder htau
    have hpDvd : p ∣ ell :=
      (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) p ell).mp
        hellZero
    have hpEq : p = ell := by
      rcases hell.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd p hpDvd with hpOne | hpEq
      · exact False.elim ((Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one hpOne)
      · exact hpEq
    exact hne hpEq.symm
  have : ell = 1 := by
    rw [← htauOrder, htauOne, orderOf_one]
  exact hell.ne_one this

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_residue_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_residue_of_ratEquiv
    (k : Type uL) [Field k] (e : k ≃+* ℚ)
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L]
    [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower A B L]
    [IsIntegralClosure B A L] [IsDedekindDomain B]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (P : Ideal B) [P.IsMaximal] (hP : P ≠ ⊥)
    [Algebra k (decompositionResidueField K
      (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))]
    [Algebra k (selectedResidueField
      (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))]
    [IsScalarTower k
      (decompositionResidueField K
        (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))
      (selectedResidueField
        (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))]
    (hgeo : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (decompositionResidueField K
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)))))) :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    ∀ sigma : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K),
      IsConj (sigma : Gal(L/K))
        ((sigma⁻¹ : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) : Gal(L/K)) := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  let V := idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP
  let : Finite Gal(L/K) := IsGaloisGroup.finite Gal(L/K) K L
  let : Finite (inertiaGroup K V) := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
    exists_inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_residueExtension_of_ratEquiv
      k e K V hgeo
  intro sigma
  let tau : inertiaGroup K V :=
    globalIdealInertiaToLocalInertia
      (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma
  have htau : inertiaConjugate K V g tau = tau⁻¹ := hg tau
  refine isConj_iff.mpr ⟨(g : Gal(L/K)), ?_⟩
  have hdecomp := congrArg Subtype.val htau
  have hgal := congrArg Subtype.val hdecomp
  simpa [inertiaConjugate, tau, globalIdealInertiaToLocalInertia,
    globalIdealInertiaToDecomposition] using hgal

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.geometricallyIntegral_specMap_transport_dvrResidueEquiv
statement:
private theorem geometricallyIntegral_specMap_transport_dvrResidueEquiv
    {k R S : Type uL} [Field k] [Field R] [Field S]
    [Algebra k R] (e : R ≃+* S)
    (h : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R)))) :
    letI : Algebra k S
proof:
:=
      (e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k R)).toAlgebra
    AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S))) := by
  let : Algebra k S :=
    (e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k R)).toAlgebra
  let i : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ≅
      AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of R) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Spec.mapIso e.toCommRingCatIso.op
  have hi : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (i.hom ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R))) := by
    let : MorphismProperty.RespectsIso
        (@AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral :
          MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{uL}) :=
      MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange.respectsIso
        (P := (@AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral :
          MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{uL}))
    exact (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso
      (C := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{uL})
      (P := (@AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral :
        MorphismProperty AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{uL}))
      i.hom
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R)))).mpr h
  have hmap : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫
      e.toCommRingCatIso.hom.op.unop =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
    ext x
    rfl
  simpa only [i, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Spec_map,
    ← AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, hmap]
    using hi

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.dvrNormalizationPrime_ne_bot
statement:
theorem dvrNormalizationPrime_ne_bot
    {A : Type uL} {B : Type uB} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [CommRing B] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra B L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A B] [Algebra A L]
    [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower A B L]
    [IsIntegralClosure B A L]
    (P : Ideal B) [P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)] : P ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree A L :=
    Module.IsTorsionFree.trans_faithfulSMul A K L
  have hAL : Function.Injective (algebraMap A L) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    apply (algebraMap K L).injective
    simpa only [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L] using hxy
  have hAB : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply hAL
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L, hxy]
  let : Nontrivial B :=
    hAB.nontrivial
  let : Module.IsTorsionFree A B :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isTorsionFree A L
  exact Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_a_field A) P

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_dvrResidue_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_dvrResidue_of_ratEquiv
    (k : Type uL) [Field k] (e : k ≃+* ℚ)
    {A : Type uL} {B : Type uB} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L]
    [IsScalarTower A K L] [IsScalarTower A B L]
    [IsIntegralClosure B A L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (P : Ideal B) [P.IsMaximal]
    [P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)]
    [Algebra k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (hgeo : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))))) :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    ∀ sigma : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K),
      IsConj (sigma : Gal(L/K))
        ((sigma⁻¹ : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) : Gal(L/K)) := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
  have hP : P ≠ ⊥ := dvrNormalizationPrime_ne_bot
    (A := A) (K := K) (L := L) P
  have hp : normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P = p :=
    (P.over_def p).symm
  let : (normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P).IsMaximal :=
    normalizationIdealBasePrime_isMaximal
      (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) P
  let q : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A ≃+*
      A ⧸ normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P :=
    Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hp.symm
  let : Algebra k (A ⧸ normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P) :=
    (q.toRingHom.comp
      (algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))).toAlgebra
  have hgeoBase : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k
          (A ⧸ normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P)))) :=
    geometricallyIntegral_specMap_transport_dvrResidueEquiv
      (R := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
      (S := A ⧸ normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P) q hgeo
  exact
    idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_basePrimeResidue_of_ratEquiv
      k e (A := A) (B := B) (K := K) (L := L) P hP hgeoBase

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_dvrNormalizationResidue_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem
    idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_dvrNormalizationResidue_of_ratEquiv
    (k : Type uL) [Field k] (e : k ≃+* ℚ)
    {A : Type uL} {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (P : Ideal (integralClosure A L)) [P.IsPrime]
    [P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)]
    [Algebra k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)]
    (hgeo : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))))) :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction
      A K L (integralClosure A L)
    ∀ sigma : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K),
      IsConj (sigma : Gal(L/K))
        ((sigma⁻¹ : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) : Gal(L/K)) := by
  let B := integralClosure A L
  let : IsFractionRing B L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension A K L B
  let : IsDedekindDomain B :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain A K L B
  let : P.IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.IsMaximal.of_liesOver_isMaximal P
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  exact
    idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_dvrResidue_of_ratEquiv
      k e (A := A) (B := B) (K := K) (L := L) P hgeo

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_intermediateFieldAlgEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_ratEquiv
statement:
private theorem
    exists_intermediateFieldAlgEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_ratEquiv
    {k : Type u} {F : Type v} {Omega : Type w}
    [Field k] [Field F] [Field Omega]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra F Omega] [Algebra k Omega]
    [IsScalarTower k F Omega] [IsSepClosure F Omega]
    (e : k ≃+* ℚ)
    (hdisjoint : (separableClosure k Omega).LinearDisjoint F)
    (M : IntermediateField F Omega) [Normal F M] :
    ∃ tau : M ≃ₐ[F] M,
      ∀ z : Mˣ, IsOfFinOrder z →
        Units.mapEquiv tau.toMulEquiv z = z⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let : CharZero k := e.toRingHom.charZero
  let : PerfectField k := PerfectField.ofCharZero
  obtain ⟨tauOmega, htauOmega⟩ :=
    exists_algEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_ratEquiv
      (F := F) (Omega := Omega) e hdisjoint
  let tau : M ≃ₐ[F] M := tauOmega.restrictNormal M
  refine ⟨tau, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  let mapUnits : Mˣ →* Omegaˣ := Units.map (algebraMap M Omega)
  let zOmega : Omegaˣ := mapUnits z
  have hzOmega : IsOfFinOrder zOmega := mapUnits.isOfFinOrder hz
  have hOmega := congrArg Units.val (htauOmega zOmega hzOmega)
  apply Units.ext
  apply (algebraMap M Omega).injective
  rw [Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  change algebraMap M Omega (tau (z : M)) =
    algebraMap M Omega ((z : M)⁻¹)
  rw [show algebraMap M Omega (tau (z : M)) =
      tauOmega (algebraMap M Omega (z : M)) by
    exact AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes tauOmega M (z : M)]
  simpa [zOmega, mapUnits] using hOmega

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_normalAlgEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem
    exists_normalAlgEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_ratEquiv
    {k : Type u} {F : Type v} {E : Type x} {Omega : Type w}
    [Field k] [Field F] [Field E] [Field Omega]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra F E] [Algebra F Omega] [Algebra k Omega]
    [IsScalarTower k F Omega] [IsSepClosure F Omega]
    [Normal F E] [Algebra.IsSeparable F E]
    (e : k ≃+* ℚ)
    (hdisjoint : (separableClosure k Omega).LinearDisjoint F) :
    ∃ tau : E ≃ₐ[F] E,
      ∀ z : Eˣ, IsOfFinOrder z →
        Units.mapEquiv tau.toMulEquiv z = z⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let : IsSepClosed Omega := IsSepClosure.sep_closed F
  let j : E →ₐ[F] Omega := IsSepClosed.lift
  let M : IntermediateField F Omega := j.fieldRange
  let eM : E ≃ₐ[F] M := AlgEquiv.ofInjective j j.injective
  let : Normal F M := Normal.of_algEquiv eM
  obtain ⟨tauM, htauM⟩ :=
    exists_intermediateFieldAlgEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_ratEquiv
      e hdisjoint M
  let tau : E ≃ₐ[F] E := eM.symm.autCongr tauM
  refine ⟨tau, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  let zM : Mˣ := Units.map eM.toMonoidHom z
  have hzM : IsOfFinOrder zM :=
    (Units.map eM.toMonoidHom).isOfFinOrder hz
  have hM := congrArg Units.val (htauM zM hzM)
  apply Units.ext
  apply eM.injective
  simpa [tau, zM, AlgEquiv.autCongr_apply] using hM

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.quotient_unitGroup_isCyclic_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
private theorem quotient_unitGroup_isCyclic_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
    {L : Type*} [Field L] (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L)
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing V] :
    IsCyclic (Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup)
proof:
:= by
  let v := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal V).valuation L
  let f : Lˣ →* (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))ˣ :=
    Units.map v.toMonoidWithZeroHom.toMonoidHom
  have hV : v.valuationSubring = V := by
    apply _root_.ValuationSubring.toSubring_injective
    rw [← IsDiscreteValuationRing.map_algebraMap_eq_valuationSubring
      (A := V) (K := L)]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, _ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, trivial, rfl⟩
  have hker : f.ker = V.unitGroup := by
    rw [← hV]
    ext x
    rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, v.mem_unitGroup_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact congrArg Units.val hx
    · intro hx
      apply Units.ext
      exact hx
  let e : Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup ≃* f.range :=
    (QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq hker.symm).trans
      (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange f)
  have : IsCyclic f.range := Subgroup.isCyclic_of_le le_top
  exact isCyclic_of_injective e.toMonoidHom e.injective

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.relativeValueClass_isCyclic_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
private theorem relativeValueClass_isCyclic_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V] :
    IsCyclic
      ((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsCyclic (Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) :=
    quotient_unitGroup_isCyclic_of_isDiscreteValuationRing V
  exact isCyclic_of_surjective
    (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V))
    (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _)

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.automorphismUnitQuotient_mk_mem_unitGroup_of_dvr
statement:
private theorem automorphismUnitQuotient_mk_mem_unitGroup_of_dvr
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    (sigma : decompositionGroup K V) (a : V) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    automorphismUnitQuotient K V sigma
        (Units.mk0 (a : L) (by
          change algebraMap V L a ≠ 0
          exact (map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap V L)
            (IsFractionRing.injective V L)).2 ha)) ∈
      V.unitGroup
proof:
:= by
  let eV : V ≃+* V :=
    MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv (decompositionGroup K V) V sigma
  have haL : (a : L) ≠ 0 := by
    change algebraMap V L a ≠ 0
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap V L)
      (IsFractionRing.injective V L)).2 ha
  obtain ⟨pi, hpi⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible V
  obtain ⟨n, han⟩ :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.associated_pow_irreducible ha hpi
  obtain ⟨ua, hua⟩ := han
  have hepi : Irreducible (eV pi) := hpi.map eV.toMulEquiv
  have hepiAssoc : Associated (eV pi) pi :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.associated_of_irreducible V hepi hpi
  have heaPow : Associated (eV a) ((eV pi) ^ n) := by
    refine ⟨Units.map eV.toMonoidHom ua, ?_⟩
    simpa using congrArg eV hua
  have hea : Associated (eV a) a :=
    (heaPow.trans hepiAssoc.pow_pow).trans
      (Associated.symm ⟨ua, hua⟩)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hea
  let aL : Lˣ := Units.mk0 (a : L) haL
  let uL : Lˣ := Units.map V.subtype.toMonoidHom u
  have huL : ((sigma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (a : L)) * (u : V) = (a : L) := by
    have hu' := congrArg (fun z : V => (z : L)) hu
    change ((sigma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) • (a : L)) * (u : V) = (a : L) at hu'
    simpa only [AlgEquiv.smul_def] using hu'
  have hquotVal : ((sigma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (a : L)) / (a : L) =
      ((u : V) : L)⁻¹ := by
    apply (mul_right_cancel₀ haL)
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ haL]
    symm
    calc
      ((u : V) : L)⁻¹ * (a : L) =
          ((u : V) : L)⁻¹ *
            (((sigma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (a : L)) * (u : V)) := by rw [huL]
      _ = (sigma : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (a : L) := by
        field_simp
  have hquot : automorphismUnitQuotient K V sigma aL = uL⁻¹ := by
    apply Units.ext
    simpa [automorphismUnitQuotient, aL, uL] using hquotVal
  rw [hquot]
  exact V.unitGroup.inv_mem
    (show uL ∈ V.unitGroup from
      (V.unitGroupMulEquiv.symm u).property)

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.automorphismUnitQuotient_mem_unitGroup_of_dvr
statement:
theorem automorphismUnitQuotient_mem_unitGroup_of_dvr
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    (sigma : decompositionGroup K V) (x : Lˣ) :
    automorphismUnitQuotient K V sigma x ∈ V.unitGroup
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := V) (x : L)
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha0
    have hx0 : (x : L) = 0 := by simpa [ha0] using hab.symm
    exact Units.ne_zero x hx0
  let aL : Lˣ := Units.mk0 (a : L) (by
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap V L)
      (IsFractionRing.injective V L)).2 ha)
  let bL : Lˣ := Units.mk0 (b : L) (by
    exact IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hb)
  have hx : x = aL / bL := by
    apply Units.ext
    rw [Units.val_div_eq_div_val]
    change (x : L) = (a : L) / (b : L)
    exact hab.symm
  rw [hx]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, automorphismUnitQuotient_mul_arg]
  have haUnit := automorphismUnitQuotient_mk_mem_unitGroup_of_dvr
    K V (sigma : decompositionGroup K V) a ha
  have hbne : b ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb
  have hbUnit := automorphismUnitQuotient_mk_mem_unitGroup_of_dvr
    K V (sigma : decompositionGroup K V) b hbne
  have hinv :
      automorphismUnitQuotient K V (sigma : decompositionGroup K V) bL⁻¹ =
        (automorphismUnitQuotient K V
          (sigma : decompositionGroup K V) bL)⁻¹ := by
    apply Units.ext
    simp [automorphismUnitQuotient, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  rw [hinv]
  exact V.unitGroup.mul_mem haUnit (V.unitGroup.inv_mem hbUnit)

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.valueTrivialInertiaGroup_eq_top_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
private theorem valueTrivialInertiaGroup_eq_top_of_isDiscreteValuationRing
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V] :
    valueTrivialInertiaGroup K V = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro sigma _hsigma x
  rw [valueDisplacementClass_eq_one_iff]
  exact automorphismUnitQuotient_mem_unitGroup_of_dvr K V
    (sigma : decompositionGroup K V) x

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.inertia_mem_valueTrivialInertiaGroup_of_dvr
statement:
theorem inertia_mem_valueTrivialInertiaGroup_of_dvr
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    (sigma : inertiaGroup K V) :
    sigma ∈ valueTrivialInertiaGroup K V
proof:
:= by
  rw [valueTrivialInertiaGroup_eq_top_of_isDiscreteValuationRing K V]
  exact Subgroup.mem_top sigma

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.inertiaGroup_isCyclic_of_card_coprime_ringExpChar_of_dvr
statement:
theorem inertiaGroup_isCyclic_of_card_coprime_ringExpChar_of_dvr
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Finite (inertiaGroup K V)]
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card (inertiaGroup K V))
      (ringExpChar (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V))) :

:= by

      ((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V) :=

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_rationalCyclotomicAutomorphism_inverting_torsionUnits
statement:
theorem exists_rationalCyclotomicAutomorphism_inverting_torsionUnits :
    ∃ sigma : rationalCyclotomicField ≃ₐ[ℚ] rationalCyclotomicField,
      ∀ z : rationalCyclotomicFieldˣ, IsOfFinOrder z →
        Units.mapEquiv sigma.toMulEquiv z = z⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sigma, hsigma⟩ :=
    rationalCyclotomicCharacter_surjective (-1 : ZHatˣ)
  refine ⟨sigma, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, hnpos, hzn⟩ := hz.exists_pow_eq_one
  let npos : ℕ+ := ⟨n, hnpos⟩
  have hnne : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hnpos
  have hzn' : (z : rationalCyclotomicField) ^ n = 1 :=
    congrArg Units.val hzn
  have hzmem :
      (z : rationalCyclotomicField) ∈ rationalCyclotomicLevel npos := by
    apply IntermediateField.subset_adjoin
    exact ⟨(npos : ℕ), Set.mem_singleton _, npos.ne_zero, by simpa [npos] using hzn'⟩
  let y : rationalCyclotomicLevel npos := ⟨(z : rationalCyclotomicField), hzmem⟩
  let a : (ZMod (npos : ℕ))ˣ :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.galEquivZMod (npos : ℕ)
      (rationalCyclotomicLevel npos)
      (sigma.restrictNormal (rationalCyclotomicLevel npos))
  have ha : a = -1 := by
    apply Units.ext
    let e := ZMod.equivPi (n := n) hnne
    apply e.injective
    funext q
    have hqPrime : q.1.Prime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors q.2
    let p : Nat.Primes := ⟨q.1, hqPrime⟩
    let : Fact p.1.Prime := ⟨p.2⟩
    let k := n.factorization q.1
    have hpow : p.1 ^ k ∣ n :=
      (hqPrime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hnne).2 le_rfl
    have hminusCoord :
        zHatUnitsContinuousMulEquivPrimeProduct (-1 : ZHatˣ) p = -1 := by
      apply Units.ext
      simp [zHatUnitsContinuousMulEquivPrimeProduct_coe_apply]
    have hpCoordinate :=
      congrArg
        (fun u : ZHatˣ => zHatUnitsContinuousMulEquivPrimeProduct u p)
        hsigma
    rw [hminusCoord] at hpCoordinate
    have hcharCoordinate :=
      zHatUnitsContinuousMulEquivPrimeProduct_rationalCyclotomicCharacter
        sigma p
    change
      zHatUnitsContinuousMulEquivPrimeProduct
          (rationalCyclotomicCharacter sigma) p =
        rationalCyclotomicCharacterPrimeProduct sigma p at hcharCoordinate
    rw [hcharCoordinate] at hpCoordinate
    have hpReduction :=
      congrArg (Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow k).toMonoidHom) hpCoordinate
    rw [rationalCyclotomicCharacterPrimeProduct_toZModPow_of_dvd
      sigma p k npos hpow] at hpReduction
    have hred :
        ZMod.unitsMap hpow a = ZMod.unitsMap hpow (-1) := by
      dsimp [a]
      have hpadicNeg :
          Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow k).toMonoidHom
              (-1 : ℤ_[p.1]ˣ) = -1 := by
        apply Units.ext
        change (PadicInt.toZModPow k) (-1) = -1
        rw [map_neg, map_one]
      have hunitsMapNeg :
          ZMod.unitsMap hpow (-1) = (-1 : (ZMod (p.1 ^ k))ˣ) := by
        apply Units.ext
        change ZMod.castHom hpow (ZMod (p.1 ^ k)) (-1) = -1
        rw [map_neg, map_one]
      calc
        _ = -1 := hpReduction.trans hpadicNeg
        _ = ZMod.unitsMap hpow (-1) := hunitsMapNeg.symm
    have heval (c : ZMod n) :
        e c q = ZMod.castHom hpow (ZMod (p.1 ^ k)) c := by
      change
        ((Pi.evalRingHom
            (fun r : n.primeFactors =>
              ZMod (r.1 ^ n.factorization r.1)) q).comp
          e.toRingHom) c =
            ZMod.castHom hpow (ZMod (p.1 ^ k)) c
      exact RingHom.congr_fun (Subsingleton.elim _ _) c
    exact (heval a.val).trans
      ((congrArg Units.val hred).trans
        (heval (-1 : (ZMod (npos : ℕ))ˣ).val).symm)
  have hyPow : y ^ n = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hzn'
  have hyAction :
      (sigma.restrictNormal (rationalCyclotomicLevel npos)) y =
        y ^ a.val.val := by
    exact IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.galEquivZMod_apply_of_pow_eq
      (npos : ℕ) (rationalCyclotomicLevel npos)
      (sigma.restrictNormal (rationalCyclotomicLevel npos)) hyPow
  have hval :
      ((-1 : (ZMod (npos : ℕ))ˣ) : ZMod (npos : ℕ)).val = n - 1 := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hnne
    change (-1 : ZMod m.succ).val = m
    exact ZMod.val_neg_one m
  have hpredMul :
      (z : rationalCyclotomicField) ^ (n - 1) * z = 1 := by
    calc
      (z : rationalCyclotomicField) ^ (n - 1) * z =
          (z : rationalCyclotomicField) ^ ((n - 1) + 1) := by
            rw [pow_succ]
      _ = (z : rationalCyclotomicField) ^ n := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hnne)]
      _ = 1 := hzn'
  apply Units.ext
  rw [Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  change sigma (z : rationalCyclotomicField) =
    (z : rationalCyclotomicField)⁻¹
  calc
    sigma (z : rationalCyclotomicField) =
        algebraMap (rationalCyclotomicLevel npos) rationalCyclotomicField
          ((sigma.restrictNormal (rationalCyclotomicLevel npos)) y) :=
      (AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes sigma
        (rationalCyclotomicLevel npos) y).symm
    _ = algebraMap (rationalCyclotomicLevel npos) rationalCyclotomicField
          (y ^ a.val.val) := by rw [hyAction]
    _ = (z : rationalCyclotomicField) ^ a.val.val := by
      rw [map_pow]
      rfl
    _ = (z : rationalCyclotomicField) ^ (n - 1) := by rw [ha, hval]
    _ = (z : rationalCyclotomicField)⁻¹ := by
      calc
        (z : rationalCyclotomicField) ^ (n - 1) =
            ((z : rationalCyclotomicField) ^ (n - 1) * z) *
              (z : rationalCyclotomicField)⁻¹ := by
                rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (Units.ne_zero z), mul_one]
        _ = (z : rationalCyclotomicField)⁻¹ := by rw [hpredMul, one_mul]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_rationalCyclotomicAutomorphism_inverting_torsion
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sigma, hsigma⟩ :=
    exists_rationalCyclotomicAutomorphism_inverting_torsionUnits
  refine ⟨sigma, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, hnpos, hzn⟩ := hz.exists_pow_eq_one
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, zero_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hnpos)] at hzn
    exact zero_ne_one hzn
  let u : rationalCyclotomicFieldˣ := Units.mk0 z hz0
  have hu : IsOfFinOrder u := by
    rw [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one]
    refine ⟨n, hnpos, ?_⟩
    apply Units.ext
    exact hzn
  have hinv := congrArg Units.val (hsigma u hu)
  rw [Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val] at hinv
  change sigma z = z⁻¹ at hinv
  exact hinv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_separableClosureRatAutomorphism_inverting_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_separableClosureRatAutomorphism_inverting_torsion :
    ∃ sigma : SeparableClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] SeparableClosure ℚ,
      ∀ z : SeparableClosure ℚ, IsOfFinOrder z → sigma z = z⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let : Normal ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ) := by
    let : IsSepClosure ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ) :=
      separableClosure.isSepClosure ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
    let hg : IsGalois ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ) := IsSepClosure.isGalois
    exact hg.to_normal
  obtain ⟨sigmaCyc, hsigmaCyc⟩ :=
    exists_rationalCyclotomicAutomorphism_inverting_torsion
  obtain ⟨sigma, hsigma⟩ :=
    (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective
      (F := ℚ) (K₁ := rationalCyclotomicField)
      (E := SeparableClosure ℚ)) sigmaCyc
  change sigma.restrictNormal rationalCyclotomicField = sigmaCyc at hsigma
  refine ⟨sigma, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, hnpos, hzn⟩ := hz.exists_pow_eq_one
  have hnne : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hnpos
  have hzmem : (z : SeparableClosure ℚ) ∈ rationalCyclotomicField := by
    apply IntermediateField.subset_adjoin
    exact ⟨n, Set.mem_univ n, hnne, hzn⟩
  let y : rationalCyclotomicField := ⟨z, hzmem⟩
  have hy : IsOfFinOrder y := by
    rw [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one]
    refine ⟨n, hnpos, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hzn
  have hcyc := hsigmaCyc y hy
  have hcomm :=
    AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes sigma rationalCyclotomicField y
  rw [hsigma] at hcomm
  calc
    sigma z = algebraMap rationalCyclotomicField (SeparableClosure ℚ)
        (sigmaCyc y) := hcomm.symm
    _ = algebraMap rationalCyclotomicField (SeparableClosure ℚ) y⁻¹ := by
      rw [hcyc]
    _ = z⁻¹ := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_separableClosureAutomorphism_inverting_torsion_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_separableClosureAutomorphism_inverting_torsion_of_ratEquiv
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [PerfectField k] (e : k ≃+* ℚ) :
    letI : Algebra k (SeparableClosure ℚ)
proof:
:=
      ((algebraMap ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ)).comp e.toRingHom).toAlgebra
    ∃ sigma : SeparableClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[k] SeparableClosure ℚ,
      ∀ z : SeparableClosure ℚ, IsOfFinOrder z → sigma z = z⁻¹ := by
  let : Algebra k (SeparableClosure ℚ) :=
    ((algebraMap ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ)).comp e.toRingHom).toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨sigmaQ, hsigmaQ⟩ :=
    exists_separableClosureRatAutomorphism_inverting_torsion
  refine ⟨AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := sigmaQ.toRingEquiv) ?_, hsigmaQ⟩
  intro x
  exact sigmaQ.commutes (e x)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_algEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_separableClosure_linearDisjoint
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_separableClosure_linearDisjoint
    {F : Type u} {Omega : Type v}
    [Field F] [Field Omega]
    [Algebra ℚ F] [Algebra F Omega] [Algebra ℚ Omega]
    [IsScalarTower ℚ F Omega] [IsSepClosure F Omega]
    (hdisjoint : (separableClosure ℚ Omega).LinearDisjoint F) :
    ∃ tau : Omega ≃ₐ[F] Omega,
      ∀ z : Omegaˣ, IsOfFinOrder z →
        Units.mapEquiv tau.toMulEquiv z = z⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra ℚ (separableClosure ℚ Omega) :=
    (separableClosure ℚ Omega).algebra'
  obtain ⟨sigmaSep, hsigmaSep⟩ :
      ∃ sigmaSep : separableClosure ℚ Omega ≃ₐ[ℚ] separableClosure ℚ Omega,
        ∀ x : separableClosure ℚ Omega, IsOfFinOrder x → sigmaSep x = x⁻¹ := by
    let : IsSepClosed Omega := IsSepClosure.sep_closed F
    obtain ⟨sigmaRat, hsigmaRat⟩ :=
      exists_separableClosureRatAutomorphism_inverting_torsion
    let e : SeparableClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] separableClosure ℚ Omega := by
      let : IsSepClosure ℚ (separableClosure ℚ Omega) :=
        separableClosure.isSepClosure ℚ Omega
      let : IsSepClosure ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ) :=
        separableClosure.isSepClosure ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
      exact IsSepClosure.equiv ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ) (separableClosure ℚ Omega)
    let sigmaSep :
        separableClosure ℚ Omega ≃ₐ[ℚ] separableClosure ℚ Omega :=
      AlgEquiv.autCongr e sigmaRat
    have hsigmaSep (x : separableClosure ℚ Omega) (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) :
        sigmaSep x = x⁻¹ := by
      let y : SeparableClosure ℚ := e.symm x
      have hy : IsOfFinOrder y :=
        e.symm.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom.isOfFinOrder hx
      change e (sigmaRat (e.symm x)) = x⁻¹
      rw [hsigmaRat y hy]
      simp [y]
    exact ⟨sigmaSep, hsigmaSep⟩
  obtain ⟨tau, htau⟩ :=
    (separableClosureRestriction_surjective_of_linearDisjoint
      (k := ℚ) (K := F) (Ω := Omega) hdisjoint) sigmaSep
  refine ⟨tau, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, hnpos, hzn⟩ := hz.exists_pow_eq_one
  have hnne : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hnpos
  have hzn' : (z : Omega) ^ n = 1 := congrArg Units.val hzn
  have hzIntegral : IsIntegral ℚ (z : Omega) := by
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C 1,
      Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C 1 hnne, ?_⟩
    simp [hzn']
  have hzSeparable : IsSeparable ℚ (z : Omega) :=
    PerfectField.separable_of_irreducible (minpoly.irreducible hzIntegral)
  let x : separableClosure ℚ Omega :=
    ⟨(z : Omega), mem_separableClosure_iff.mpr hzSeparable⟩
  have hx : IsOfFinOrder x := by
    rw [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one]
    refine ⟨n, hnpos, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hzn'
  have hres := congrArg (fun f => f x) htau
  have hresCoe := congrArg Subtype.val hres
  have hsepInv := hsigmaSep x hx
  apply Units.ext
  rw [Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  change tau (z : Omega) = (z : Omega)⁻¹
  calc
    tau (z : Omega) = (sigmaSep x : separableClosure ℚ Omega) := by
      exact hresCoe
    _ = (x⁻¹ : separableClosure ℚ Omega) := by rw [hsepInv]
    _ = (z : Omega)⁻¹ := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_algEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_ratEquiv
    {k : Type u} {F : Type v} {Omega : Type w}
    [Field k] [PerfectField k] [Field F] [Field Omega]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra F Omega] [Algebra k Omega]
    [IsScalarTower k F Omega] [IsSepClosure F Omega]
    (e : k ≃+* ℚ)

    ∃ tau : Omega ≃ₐ[F] Omega,
      ∀ z : Omegaˣ, IsOfFinOrder z →
        Units.mapEquiv tau.toMulEquiv z = z⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sigmaSep, hsigmaSep⟩ :
      ∃ sigmaSep : separableClosure k Omega ≃ₐ[k] separableClosure k Omega,
        ∀ x : separableClosure k Omega, IsOfFinOrder x → sigmaSep x = x⁻¹ := by
    let : IsSepClosed Omega := IsSepClosure.sep_closed F
    let : Algebra k (SeparableClosure ℚ) :=
      ((algebraMap ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ)).comp e.toRingHom).toAlgebra
    let : IsSepClosure k (SeparableClosure ℚ) := by
      have hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable k (SeparableClosure ℚ) := by
        let : IsSepClosure ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ) :=
          separableClosure.isSepClosure ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
        apply Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv e.symm
          (RingEquiv.refl (SeparableClosure ℚ))
        apply RingHom.ext
        intro q
        change algebraMap ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ) (e (e.symm q)) =
          algebraMap ℚ (SeparableClosure ℚ) q
        rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
      exact IsSepClosure.mk inferInstance hsep
    obtain ⟨sigmaRat, hsigmaRat⟩ :=
      exists_separableClosureAutomorphism_inverting_torsion_of_ratEquiv k e
    let ek : SeparableClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[k] separableClosure k Omega :=
      IsSepClosure.equiv k (SeparableClosure ℚ) (separableClosure k Omega)
    let sigmaSep :
        separableClosure k Omega ≃ₐ[k] separableClosure k Omega :=
      AlgEquiv.autCongr ek sigmaRat
    have hsigmaSep (x : separableClosure k Omega) (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) :
        sigmaSep x = x⁻¹ := by
      let y : SeparableClosure ℚ := ek.symm x
      have hy : IsOfFinOrder y :=
        ek.symm.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom.isOfFinOrder hx
      change ek (sigmaRat (ek.symm x)) = x⁻¹
      rw [hsigmaRat y hy]
      simp [y]
    exact ⟨sigmaSep, hsigmaSep⟩
  obtain ⟨tau, htau⟩ :=
    (separableClosureRestriction_surjective_of_linearDisjoint
      (k := k) (K := F) (Ω := Omega) hdisjoint) sigmaSep
  refine ⟨tau, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨n, hnpos, hzn⟩ := hz.exists_pow_eq_one
  have hnne : n ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt hnpos
  have hzn' : (z : Omega) ^ n = 1 := congrArg Units.val hzn
  have hzIntegral : IsIntegral k (z : Omega) := by
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C 1,
      Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C 1 hnne, ?_⟩
    simp [hzn']
  have hzSeparable : IsSeparable k (z : Omega) :=
    PerfectField.separable_of_irreducible (minpoly.irreducible hzIntegral)
  let x : separableClosure k Omega :=
    ⟨(z : Omega), mem_separableClosure_iff.mpr hzSeparable⟩
  have hx : IsOfFinOrder x := by
    rw [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one]
    refine ⟨n, hnpos, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hzn'
  have hres := congrArg (fun f => f x) htau
  have hresCoe := congrArg Subtype.val hres
  have hsepInv := hsigmaSep x hx
  apply Units.ext
  rw [Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  change tau (z : Omega) = (z : Omega)⁻¹
  calc
    tau (z : Omega) = (sigmaSep x : separableClosure k Omega) := by
      exact hresCoe
    _ = (x⁻¹ : separableClosure k Omega) := by rw [hsepInv]
    _ = (z : Omega)⁻¹ := rfl

  intro sigma

  change residueAction K V g' (z : selectedResidueField V) =
    (z : selectedResidueField V)⁻¹
  rw [haction]

  rw [Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val] at hinv

    let _ : IsScalarTower ℚ (decompositionResidueField K V)
        (selectedResidueField V) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun q =>
        (RingHom.map_rat_algebraMap
          (algebraMap (decompositionResidueField K V) (selectedResidueField V)) q).symm
    AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap ℚ (decompositionResidueField K V)))) →
    ∀ sigma : inertiaGroup K V,
      IsConj (sigma : decompositionGroup K V)
        ((sigma⁻¹ : inertiaGroup K V) : decompositionGroup K V) := by
  intro charZeroResidue rationalBase rationalResidue rationalTower hgeo
  apply inertia_isConj_inv_of_residue_linearDisjoint K V
  exact
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_geometricallyIntegral

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.dvrInertiaCharacter_conjugate_apply_mk_mk
statement:
theorem dvrInertiaCharacter_conjugate_apply_mk_mk
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    (g : decompositionGroup K V) (sigma : inertiaGroup K V) (x : Lˣ) :
    dvrInertiaCharacter K V (inertiaConjugate K V g sigma)
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
          (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup x)) =
      Units.mapEquiv (residueAction K V g).toMulEquiv
        (dvrInertiaCharacter K V sigma
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
            (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup
              (Units.mapEquiv
                (((g⁻¹ : decompositionGroup K V) : L ≃ₐ[K] L).toMulEquiv) x))))
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  change
    IsLocalRing.residue V
        (V.unitGroupMulEquiv
          (valueTrivialAutomorphismUnit K V
            (inertiaToValueTrivialOfDVR K V (inertiaConjugate K V g sigma)) x) : V) =
      g • (IsLocalRing.residue V
          (V.unitGroupMulEquiv
            (valueTrivialAutomorphismUnit K V
              (inertiaToValueTrivialOfDVR K V sigma)
              (Units.mapEquiv
                (((g⁻¹ : decompositionGroup K V) : L ≃ₐ[K] L).toMulEquiv) x)) : V))
  rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.residue_smul]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  have coe_smul (a : V) : ((g • a : V) : L) =
      (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (a : L) := rfl
  rw [coe_smul]
  simp [valueTrivialAutomorphismUnit,
    automorphismUnitQuotient, inertiaConjugate,
    inertiaToValueTrivialOfDVR, mul_assoc, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.dvrInertiaCharacter_mapEquiv_inv_argument
statement:
theorem dvrInertiaCharacter_mapEquiv_inv_argument
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    (g : decompositionGroup K V) (sigma : inertiaGroup K V) (x : Lˣ) :
    dvrInertiaCharacter K V sigma
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
          (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup
            (Units.mapEquiv
              (((g⁻¹ : decompositionGroup K V) : L ≃ₐ[K] L).toMulEquiv) x))) =
      dvrInertiaCharacter K V sigma
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
          (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup x))
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg (dvrInertiaCharacter K V sigma)
  apply congrArg (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V))
  apply QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem.mpr
  simpa only [automorphismUnitQuotient] using
    (automorphismUnitQuotient_mem_unitGroup_of_dvr K V
      (g⁻¹ : decompositionGroup K V) x)

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.dvrInertiaCharacter_conjugate_apply
statement:
theorem dvrInertiaCharacter_conjugate_apply
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    (g : decompositionGroup K V) (sigma : inertiaGroup K V) (x : Lˣ) :

        (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
          (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup x)) =
      Units.mapEquiv (residueAction K V g).toMulEquiv

          (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
            (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup x)))
proof:

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.dvrInertiaCharacter_injective_of_residue_charZero
statement:
theorem dvrInertiaCharacter_injective_of_residue_charZero
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)]

    Function.Injective (dvrInertiaCharacter K V)
proof:
:= by
  apply (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff (dvrInertiaCharacter K V)).mp
  have hram : ramificationGroup K V = ⊥ :=
    TameInertiaRamification.ramificationGroup_eq_bot_of_residue_charZero K V
  ext sigma
  change
    valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom K V
        (inertiaToValueTrivialOfDVR K V sigma) = 1 ↔ sigma = 1
  rw [← MonoidHom.mem_ker,
    valueTrivialInertiaCharacterHom_mem_ker_iff, hram]

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.dvrInertiaCharacter_value_isOfFinOrder
statement:
theorem dvrInertiaCharacter_value_isOfFinOrder
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Finite (inertiaGroup K V)]
    (sigma : inertiaGroup K V)
    (q : (Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V) :
    IsOfFinOrder (dvrInertiaCharacter K V sigma q)
proof:
:= by
  let ev :
      ((((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V) →*
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)ˣ) →*
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)ˣ) :=
    (MonoidHom.eval :
      ((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V) →*
        ((((Lˣ ⧸ V.unitGroup) ⧸ baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V) →*
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)ˣ) →*
            (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)ˣ)) q

    ((dvrInertiaCharacter K V).isOfFinOrder
      (isOfFinOrder_of_finite sigma))

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_character_inversion
statement:
theorem inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_character_inversion
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)]
    [Finite (inertiaGroup K V)]
    (g : decompositionGroup K V)
    (hinv : ∀ sigma : inertiaGroup K V,
      dvrInertiaCharacter K V (inertiaConjugate K V g sigma) =
        (dvrInertiaCharacter K V sigma)⁻¹)
    (sigma : inertiaGroup K V) :
    inertiaConjugate K V g sigma = sigma⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply dvrInertiaCharacter_injective_of_residue_charZero K V
  rw [hinv]
