name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_residue_inversion
statement:
theorem inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_residue_inversion
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)]
    [Finite (inertiaGroup K V)]
    (g : decompositionGroup K V)
    (hinv : ∀ (sigma : inertiaGroup K V) (x : Lˣ),
      Units.mapEquiv (residueAction K V g).toMulEquiv
          (dvrInertiaCharacter K V sigma
            (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
              (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup x))) =
        (dvrInertiaCharacter K V sigma
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
            (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup x)))⁻¹)
    (sigma : inertiaGroup K V) :
    inertiaConjugate K V g sigma = sigma⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_character_inversion K V g
  intro tau
  apply QuotientGroup.monoidHom_ext
  apply QuotientGroup.monoidHom_ext
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  change
    dvrInertiaCharacter K V (inertiaConjugate K V g tau)
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
          (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup x)) =
      (dvrInertiaCharacter K V tau
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (baseUnitValueClassSubgroup K V)
          (QuotientGroup.mk' V.unitGroup x)))⁻¹
  rw [dvrInertiaCharacter_conjugate_apply, hinv]

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_torsion_residue_inversion
statement:
theorem inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_torsion_residue_inversion
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [CharZero (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)]
    [Finite (inertiaGroup K V)]
    (g : decompositionGroup K V)
    (hinv : ∀ z : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)ˣ,
      IsOfFinOrder z →
        Units.mapEquiv (residueAction K V g).toMulEquiv z = z⁻¹)
    (sigma : inertiaGroup K V) :
    inertiaConjugate K V g sigma = sigma⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_residue_inversion K V g
  intro tau x
  apply hinv
  exact dvrInertiaCharacter_value_isOfFinOrder K V tau _

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.exists_inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_residueExtension_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem
    exists_inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_residueExtension_of_ratEquiv
    (k : Type v) [Field k] (e : k ≃+* ℚ)
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsGalois K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Finite (inertiaGroup K V)]
    [Algebra k (decompositionResidueField K V)]
    [Algebra k (selectedResidueField V)]
    [IsScalarTower k (decompositionResidueField K V)
      (selectedResidueField V)]
    (hgeo : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (decompositionResidueField K V))))) :
    ∃ g : decompositionGroup K V,
      ∀ sigma : inertiaGroup K V,
        inertiaConjugate K V g sigma = sigma⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let F := decompositionResidueField K V
  let E := selectedResidueField V
  let Omega := SeparableClosure F
  let : CharZero k := e.toRingHom.charZero
  let : CharZero F :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap k F).injective
  let : PerfectField F := PerfectField.ofCharZero
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable F E := inferInstance
  let : CharZero E :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F E).injective
  let : Algebra k Omega :=
    ((algebraMap F Omega).comp (algebraMap k F)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower k F Omega :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => rfl
  let : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k F))) := hgeo
  have hdisjoint : (separableClosure k Omega).LinearDisjoint F :=
    EtaleFundamentalGroups.separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_geometricallyIntegral
  obtain ⟨tau, htau⟩ :=
    (open _root_.EtaleFundamentalGroups in
      exists_normalAlgEquiv_inverting_torsionUnits_of_separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_ratEquiv
        (F := F) (E := E) (Omega := Omega) e hdisjoint)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hresidue⟩ :=
    exists_galoisAutomorphism_stabilizing_of_residueAutomorphism K V tau
  let g' : decompositionGroup K V := ⟨g, hg⟩
  refine ⟨g', ?_⟩
  intro sigma
  apply inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_torsion_residue_inversion K V g'
  intro z hz
  have haction :
      residueAction K V g' (z : selectedResidueField V) =
        tau (z : selectedResidueField V) := by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hresidue (z : selectedResidueField V)
  apply Units.ext
  rw [Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  change residueAction K V g' (z : selectedResidueField V) =
    (z : selectedResidueField V)⁻¹
  rw [haction]
  have hinv := congrArg Units.val (htau z hz)
  rw [Units.coe_mapEquiv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val] at hinv
  exact hinv

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.inertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_residueExtension_of_ratEquiv
statement:
theorem
    inertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_residueExtension_of_ratEquiv
    (k : Type v) [Field k] (e : k ≃+* ℚ)
    (K : Type u) {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsGalois K L]
    (V : _root_.ValuationSubring L) [IsDiscreteValuationRing V]
    [Finite (inertiaGroup K V)]
    [Algebra k (decompositionResidueField K V)]
    [Algebra k (selectedResidueField V)]
    [IsScalarTower k (decompositionResidueField K V)
      (selectedResidueField V)]
    (hgeo : AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyIntegral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (decompositionResidueField K V))))) :
    ∀ sigma : inertiaGroup K V,
      IsConj (sigma : decompositionGroup K V)
        ((sigma⁻¹ : inertiaGroup K V) : decompositionGroup K V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
    exists_inertiaConjugate_eq_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_residueExtension_of_ratEquiv
      k e K V hgeo
  intro sigma
  refine isConj_iff.mpr ⟨g, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (hg sigma)

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.normalizationGaloisSMulCommClass
statement:
theorem normalizationGaloisSMulCommClass :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    SMulCommClass Gal(L/K) A B := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  constructor
  intro sigma a b
  apply (IsFractionRing.injective B L)
  simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul,
    algebraMap_normalization_smul (A := A)]
  have ha : (sigma : Gal(L/K)) (algebraMap A L a) =
      algebraMap A L a := by
    calc
      (sigma : Gal(L/K)) (algebraMap A L a) =
          (sigma : Gal(L/K))
            (algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K a)) := by
        rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L]
      _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K a) :=
        (sigma : Gal(L/K)).commutes (algebraMap A K a)
      _ = algebraMap A L a :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L a).symm
  have haB : (sigma : Gal(L/K))
        (algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a)) =
      algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a) := by
    calc
      (sigma : Gal(L/K))
          (algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a)) =
        (sigma : Gal(L/K)) (algebraMap A L a) := by
          rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L]
      _ = algebraMap A L a := ha
      _ = algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a) :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L a
  rw [haB]

        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP) ↔
      b ∈ P
proof:
:= by

  let bS : S := algebraMap B S b
  have he := idealLocalizationEquiv_mem_maximalIdeal_iff B L P hP bS

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.globalDecomposition_maps_localization
statement:
private theorem globalDecomposition_maps_localization :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    ∀ (sigma : HilbertRamification.Dedekind.decompositionGroup P Gal(L/K))
      {x : L},
      x ∈ idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP →
      ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) x ∈
        idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  intro sigma x hx
  change x ∈ idealLocalizationSubalgebra B L P at hx
  change ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) x ∈
    idealLocalizationSubalgebra B L P
  rcases hx with ⟨a, s, hs, rfl⟩
  have hsigma : (sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s ∈ P.primeCompl := by
    intro hsigmaP
    have hsmul : (sigma : Gal(L/K))⁻¹ • ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s) ∈
        (sigma : Gal(L/K))⁻¹ • P :=
      Ideal.smul_mem_pointwise_smul
        (M := Gal(L/K)) (sigma : Gal(L/K))⁻¹
        ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s) P hsigmaP
    have hinvP : (sigma : Gal(L/K))⁻¹ • P = P := by
      calc
        (sigma : Gal(L/K))⁻¹ • P =
            (sigma : Gal(L/K))⁻¹ • ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • P) :=
          congrArg ((sigma : Gal(L/K))⁻¹ • ·) sigma.property.symm
        _ = P := inv_smul_smul _ _
    have hsP : s ∈ P := by
      simpa [hinvP] using hsmul
    exact hs hsP
  refine ⟨(sigma : Gal(L/K)) • a, (sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s,
    hsigma, ?_⟩
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv₀,
    algebraMap_normalization_smul (A := A)]

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.globalDecomposition_maps_localization_iff
statement:
private theorem globalDecomposition_maps_localization_iff :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    ∀ (sigma : HilbertRamification.Dedekind.decompositionGroup P Gal(L/K))
      (x : L),
      ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) x ∈
          idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP ↔
        x ∈ idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  intro sigma x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    let sigmaInv : HilbertRamification.Dedekind.decompositionGroup P Gal(L/K) :=
      sigma⁻¹
    have hinv := globalDecomposition_maps_localization
      (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigmaInv hx
    simpa [sigmaInv] using hinv
  · exact globalDecomposition_maps_localization
      (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.idealLocalizationResidueEquiv_residueAction
statement:
theorem idealLocalizationResidueEquiv_residueAction
    [IsGalois K L] :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    letI := normalizationGaloisSMulCommClass
      (A := A) (B := B) (K := K) (L := L)
    ∀ (sigma : HilbertRamification.Dedekind.decompositionGroup P Gal(L/K))
      (x : B ⧸ P),
    let p := P.comap (algebraMap A B)
    letI : P.LiesOver p := ⟨rfl⟩
    idealLocalizationResidueEquiv B L P hP
        (HilbertRamification.Dedekind.residueStabilizerHom
          p P Gal(L/K) sigma x) =
      RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.decompositionGroupResidueAction
          K
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)
          (globalIdealDecompositionToLocalDecomposition
            (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma)
          (idealLocalizationResidueEquiv B L P hP x) := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  let := normalizationGaloisSMulCommClass
    (A := A) (B := B) (K := K) (L := L)
  intro sigma x
  let p := P.comap (algebraMap A B)
  let : P.LiesOver p := ⟨rfl⟩
  dsimp only
  refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
  intro b
  change
    idealLocalizationResidueEquiv B L P hP
        (HilbertRamification.Dedekind.residueStabilizerHom
          (P.comap (algebraMap A B)) P Gal(L/K) sigma
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk P b)) =
      RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.decompositionGroupResidueAction
          K (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)
          (globalIdealDecompositionToLocalDecomposition
            (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma)
          (idealLocalizationResidueEquiv B L P hP
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk P b))
  rw [HilbertRamification.Dedekind.residueStabilizerHom_apply,
    idealLocalizationResidueEquiv_mk,
    idealLocalizationResidueEquiv_mk,
    RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring.decompositionGroupResidueAction_residue]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact algebraMap_normalization_smul (A := A) (sigma : Gal(L/K)) b

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.normalizationIdealBasePrime_isMaximal
statement:
theorem normalizationIdealBasePrime_isMaximal :
    (normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral A B :=
    ⟨fun b ↦ IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral A L b⟩
  exact Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap A B)
    (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) P

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.localDecomposition_fixes_normalizationBase
statement:
theorem localDecomposition_fixes_normalizationBase
    (sigma : decompositionGroup K
      (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))
    (a : A) :
    sigma • idealLocalizationRingHom (B := B) (L := L) P hP
        (algebraMap A B a) =
      idealLocalizationRingHom (B := B) (L := L) P hP
        (algebraMap A B a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
      (algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a)) =
    algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a)
  calc
    ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
        (algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a)) =
      ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (algebraMap A L a) := by
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L]
    _ = ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L)
        (algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K a)) := by
          rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L]
    _ = algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K a) :=
      (sigma : Gal(L/K)).commutes (algebraMap A K a)
    _ = algebraMap A L a :=
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L a).symm
    _ = algebraMap B L (algebraMap A B a) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B L a

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField_mk
    (a : A) :
    normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField
        (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P) a) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (decompositionFixedMaximalIdeal K
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))
        (normalizationBaseToDecompositionFixedSubring
          (A := A) (B := B) (K := K) (L := L)
          (P := P) (hP := hP) a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField]

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.decompositionResidueField_algebraMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem decompositionResidueField_algebraMap_mk
    (r : decompositionFixedSubring K
      (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)) :
    algebraMap
        (decompositionResidueField K
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))
        (selectedResidueField
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (decompositionFixedMaximalIdeal K
            (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)) r) =
      IsLocalRing.residue
        (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP) r
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.normalizationBaseResidue_decompositionResidueField_commutes
statement:
theorem normalizationBaseResidue_decompositionResidueField_commutes
    (x : A ⧸ normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P) :
    letI : P.LiesOver (normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P)
proof:
:= ⟨rfl⟩
    algebraMap
        (decompositionResidueField K
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))
        (selectedResidueField
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))
        (normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField
          (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) x) =
      idealLocalizationResidueEquiv B L P hP
        (algebraMap
          (A ⧸ normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P) (B ⧸ P) x) := by
  let : P.LiesOver (normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P) := ⟨rfl⟩
  refine Quotient.inductionOn x ?_
  intro a
  change
    algebraMap
        (decompositionResidueField K
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))
        (selectedResidueField
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))
        (normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField
          (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP)
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk
            (normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P) a)) =
      idealLocalizationResidueEquiv B L P hP
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk P (algebraMap A B a))
  rw [normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField_mk,
    decompositionResidueField_algebraMap_mk,
    idealLocalizationResidueEquiv_mk]
  rfl

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField_surjective
statement:
theorem normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField_surjective
    [FiniteDimensional K L]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [CharZero (A ⧸ normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P)] :
    Function.Surjective
      (normalizationBaseResidueToDecompositionResidueField
        (A := A) (B := B) (K := K) (L := L)
        (P := P) (hP := hP))
proof:
:= by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  let := normalizationGaloisSMulCommClass
    (A := A) (B := B) (K := K) (L := L)
  let p := normalizationIdealBasePrime (A := A) P
  let V := idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP
  let F := decompositionResidueField K V
  let E := selectedResidueField V
  let E₀ := B ⧸ P
  let e : E₀ ≃+* E := idealLocalizationResidueEquiv B L P hP
  let : p.IsMaximal := normalizationIdealBasePrime_isMaximal
    (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) P
  let : P.LiesOver p := ⟨rfl⟩
  let : Finite Gal(L/K) := IsGaloisGroup.finite Gal(L/K) K L
  let : Algebra.IsInvariant A B Gal(L/K) :=
    Algebra.isInvariant_of_isGalois A K L B
  let : Normal (A ⧸ p) E₀ :=
    HilbertRamification.Dedekind.dedekindRamification_residueExtension_normal
      p P Gal(L/K)
  let : Algebra.IsSeparable (A ⧸ p) E₀ := inferInstance
  let : IsGalois (A ⧸ p) E₀ :=
    HilbertRamification.Dedekind.dedekindRamification_residueExtension_isGalois
      p P Gal(L/K)
  intro x
  let y₀ : E₀ := e.symm (algebraMap F E x)
  have hfixed : ∀ tau : Gal(E₀/(A ⧸ p)), tau y₀ = y₀ := by
    intro tau
    obtain ⟨sigma, hsigma⟩ :=
      HilbertRamification.Dedekind.dedekindRamification_residueAction_surjective
        p P Gal(L/K) tau
    have hlocal :
        decompositionGroupResidueAction K V
            (globalIdealDecompositionToLocalDecomposition
              (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma)
            (algebraMap F E x) =
          algebraMap F E x :=
      (decompositionGroupResidueAction K V
        (globalIdealDecompositionToLocalDecomposition
          (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma)).commutes x
    apply e.injective
    rw [← hsigma,
      idealLocalizationResidueEquiv_residueAction
        (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma y₀]
    change decompositionGroupResidueAction K V
        (globalIdealDecompositionToLocalDecomposition
          (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma)
        (e y₀) = e y₀
    rw [show e y₀ = algebraMap F E x from e.apply_symm_apply _, hlocal]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
    (InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed y₀).mpr hfixed
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  apply (algebraMap F E).injective
  rw [normalizationBaseResidue_decompositionResidueField_commutes
    (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) z, hz]
  exact e.apply_symm_apply (algebraMap F E x)

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.idealLocalizationSubalgebra_dvr
statement:
private theorem idealLocalizationSubalgebra_dvr
    (P : Ideal B) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P ≠ ⊥) :

statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_idealLocalizationValuationSubring_iff
    (P : Ideal B) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P ≠ ⊥) (x : L) :

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.idealLocalizationEquiv_apply_coe

@[simp] theorem idealLocalizationEquiv_apply_coe

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.idealLocalizationEquiv_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem idealLocalizationEquiv_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
    (P : Ideal B) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P ≠ ⊥)
    (x : idealLocalizationSubalgebra B L P) :
    letI
proof:
:= idealLocalizationSubalgebra_dvr B L P hP
    idealLocalizationEquiv B L P hP x ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP) ↔
      x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        (idealLocalizationSubalgebra B L P) := by
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing (idealLocalizationSubalgebra B L P) :=
    idealLocalizationSubalgebra_dvr B L P hP
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal]
  exact not_congr
    (MulEquiv.isUnit_map
      (idealLocalizationEquiv B L P hP).toMulEquiv)

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.ringExpChar_idealLocalizationResidueField_eq
statement:
theorem ringExpChar_idealLocalizationResidueField_eq
    (P : Ideal B) [P.IsMaximal] (hP : P ≠ ⊥) :
    ringExpChar
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)) =
      ringExpChar (B ⧸ P)
proof:
:= by
  let e := idealLocalizationResidueEquiv B L P hP
  let : Algebra (B ⧸ P)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
        (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)) :=
    e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  unfold ringExpChar
  exact congrArg (fun n : ℕ ↦ max n 1)
    (Algebra.ringChar_eq (B ⧸ P)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
        (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP))).symm

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.algebraMap_normalization_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem algebraMap_normalization_smul
    (sigma : Gal(L/K)) (b : B) :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    algebraMap B L (sigma • b) = sigma (algebraMap B L b) := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  change algebraMap B L (galRestrict A K L B sigma b) =
    sigma (algebraMap B L b)
  exact algebraMap_galRestrict_apply A sigma b

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.globalInertia_maps_localization
statement:
private theorem globalInertia_maps_localization :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    ∀ (sigma : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) {x : L},
      x ∈ idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP →
      ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) x ∈
        idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  intro sigma x hx
  change x ∈ idealLocalizationSubalgebra B L P at hx
  change ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) x ∈
    idealLocalizationSubalgebra B L P
  rcases hx with ⟨a, s, hs, rfl⟩
  have hdelta : (sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s - s ∈ P := sigma.property s
  have hsigma : (sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s ∈ P.primeCompl := by
    intro hsigmaP
    have hsP : s ∈ P := by
      simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using P.sub_mem hsigmaP hdelta
    exact hs hsP
  refine ⟨(sigma : Gal(L/K)) • a, (sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s,
    hsigma, ?_⟩
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv₀,
    algebraMap_normalization_smul (A := A)]

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.globalInertia_maps_localization_iff
statement:
private theorem globalInertia_maps_localization_iff :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    ∀ (sigma : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) (x : L),
      ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) x ∈
          idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP ↔
        x ∈ idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  intro sigma x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hinv := globalInertia_maps_localization
      (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma⁻¹ hx
    simpa using hinv
  · exact globalInertia_maps_localization
      (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.globalIdealInertiaToDecomposition_mem_localIdealInertia
statement:
private theorem globalIdealInertiaToDecomposition_mem_localIdealInertia :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    ∀ sigma : P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K),
      globalIdealInertiaToDecomposition
          (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma ∈
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)).toAddSubgroup.inertia
            (decompositionGroup K
              (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)) := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  intro sigma x
  let S := idealLocalizationSubalgebra B L P
  let V := idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing S :=
    idealLocalizationSubalgebra_dvr B L P hP
  let e : S ≃+* V := idealLocalizationEquiv B L P hP
  let delta : decompositionGroup K V :=
    globalIdealInertiaToDecomposition
      (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP) sigma
  rcases x.property with ⟨a, s, hs, hx⟩
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro hszero
    apply hs
    simp [hszero]
  have hdeltaA : (sigma : Gal(L/K)) • a - a ∈ P := sigma.property a
  have hdeltaS : (sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s - s ∈ P := sigma.property s
  have hsigma : (sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s ∈ P.primeCompl := by
    intro hsigmaP
    have hsP : s ∈ P := by
      simpa only [sub_sub_cancel] using P.sub_mem hsigmaP hdeltaS
    exact hs hsP
  have hsL0 : algebraMap B L s ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (IsFractionRing.injective B L).ne hs0
  have hsigmaMapL0 :
      ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (algebraMap B L s) ≠ 0 :=
    by simpa only [map_zero] using
      ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L).injective.ne hsL0
  let ys : S := ⟨x, x.property⟩
  let sigmays : S := e.symm (delta • x)
  have hys : ys = IsLocalization.mk' S a ⟨s, hs⟩ := by
    rw [IsLocalization.eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq]
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (x : L) * algebraMap B L s = algebraMap B L a
    rw [hx]
    simp [hs0]
  have hsigmays : sigmays =
      IsLocalization.mk' S ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • a)
        ⟨(sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s, hsigma⟩ := by
    rw [IsLocalization.eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq]
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : L) *
        algebraMap B L ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s) =
      algebraMap B L ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • a)
    rw [algebraMap_normalization_smul (A := A),
      algebraMap_normalization_smul (A := A), hx, map_mul, map_inv₀]
    rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hsigmaMapL0, mul_one]
  have hnum :
      (sigma : Gal(L/K)) • a * s -
          a * ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s) ∈ P := by
    have h := P.sub_mem
      (P.mul_mem_right s hdeltaA)
      (P.mul_mem_left a hdeltaS)
    convert h using 1
    all_goals ring
  let den : P.primeCompl :=
    ⟨((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s) * s,
      P.primeCompl.mul_mem hsigma hs⟩
  have hfrac : IsLocalization.mk' S
        ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • a * s -
          a * ((sigma : Gal(L/K)) • s)) den ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S :=
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.mk'_mem_maximal_iff S P _ den).mpr hnum
  have hsub : sigmays - ys ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S := by
    rw [hsigmays, hys]
    rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_sub]
    exact hfrac
  have hlocal : e (sigmays - ys) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V :=
    (idealLocalizationEquiv_mem_maximalIdeal_iff B L P hP
      (sigmays - ys)).mpr hsub
  rw [map_sub] at hlocal
  have hesigma : e sigmays = delta • x := by
    exact e.apply_symm_apply (delta • x)
  have heys : e ys = x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  rwa [hesigma, heys] at hlocal

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.natCard_idealInertia_eq_localInertia
statement:
theorem natCard_idealInertia_eq_localInertia :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    Nat.card (P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) =
      Nat.card
        (inertiaGroup K
          (idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP)) := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  exact Nat.card_congr
    (idealInertiaLocalizationMulEquiv
      (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP)).toEquiv

name: TameAbhyankar.SGA1.idealInertia_isCyclic_of_card_coprime_ringExpChar
statement:
theorem idealInertia_isCyclic_of_card_coprime_ringExpChar
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (hcop :
      letI := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
      Nat.Coprime
        (Nat.card (P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)))
        (ringExpChar (B ⧸ P))) :
    letI
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
    IsCyclic (P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) := by
  let := IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction A K L B
  let V := idealLocalizationValuationSubring B L P hP0
  let : Finite (L ≃ₐ[K] L) := inferInstance
  let : Finite (inertiaGroup K V) := inferInstance
  have hcard :
      Nat.card (P.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K)) =
        Nat.card (inertiaGroup K V) :=
    natCard_idealInertia_eq_localInertia
      (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP0)
  have hchar :
      ringExpChar (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V) =
        ringExpChar (B ⧸ P) :=
    ringExpChar_idealLocalizationResidueField_eq B L P hP0
  have hcopLocal : Nat.Coprime
      (Nat.card (inertiaGroup K V))
      (ringExpChar (IsLocalRing.ResidueField V)) := by
    rw [← hcard, hchar]
    exact hcop
  have hlocal : IsCyclic (inertiaGroup K V) :=
    inertiaGroup_isCyclic_of_card_coprime_ringExpChar_of_dvr
      K V hcopLocal
  exact (idealInertiaLocalizationMulEquiv
    (A := A) (P := P) (hP := hP0)).isCyclic.mpr hlocal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Etale.exists_iso_sigmaSpec_with_point_labels
statement:
@[stacks 02GL "An étale scheme over a field is a disjoint union of spectra of finite separable \
field extensions."]
theorem exists_iso_sigmaSpec_with_point_labels (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) :
    ∃ (L : X.left → CommRingCat.{u})
      (a : ∀ x, CommRingCat.of K ⟶ L x)
      (e : (∐ fun x ↦ Spec (L x)) ≅ X.left),
      (∀ x, IsField (L x)) ∧
        (∀ x, letI := (a x).hom.toAlgebra
          Module.Finite K (L x) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (L x)) ∧
        e.hom ≫ X.hom = Sigma.desc (fun x ↦ Spec.map (a x)) ∧
        (∀ x, ∃ z : Spec (L x),
          e.hom (Sigma.ι (fun x ↦ Spec (L x)) x z) = x)
proof:
:= by
  let structureMap : X.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) := X.hom
  let : IsLocallyArtinian X.left := by
    rw [isLocallyArtinian_iff_openCover X.left.affineCover]
    intro i
    let Z := X.left.affineCover.X i
    let f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of K) := X.left.affineCover.f i ≫ structureMap
    have hf : AlgebraicGeometry.Etale f := inferInstance
    rw [HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale)] at hf
    let eK : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), ⊤) ≃+* K :=
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    algebraize [(f.appTop.hom.comp eK.symm.toRingHom)]
    have : Algebra.Etale K Γ(Z, ⊤) := by
      change (f.appTop.hom.comp eK.symm.toRingHom).Etale
      apply RingHom.Etale.respectsIso.2
      exact hf
    let : Module.Free K Γ(Z, ⊤) := Module.Free.of_divisionRing K Γ(Z, ⊤)
    have : Module.Finite K Γ(Z, ⊤) :=
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free (R := K) (S := Γ(Z, ⊤))
    have : IsArtinianRing Γ(Z, ⊤) := isArtinian_of_tower K inferInstance
    have : IsLocallyArtinian (Spec Γ(Z, ⊤)) :=
      Scheme.isLocallyArtinianScheme_Spec.mpr inferInstance
    exact IsLocallyArtinian.of_isImmersion Z.isoSpec.hom
  let : DiscreteTopology X.left := inferInstance
  let U (x : X.left) : X.left.Opens := ⟨{x}, isOpen_discrete _⟩
  have hU (x : X.left) : IsAffineOpen (U x) :=
    IsAffineOpen.of_subsingleton Set.subsingleton_singleton
  let Y (x : X.left) : Scheme.{u} := (U x).toScheme
  let (x : X.left) : IsAffine (Y x) := hU x
  let g (x : X.left) : Y x ⟶ Spec (.of K) := (U x).ι ≫ structureMap
  let L (x : X.left) : CommRingCat.{u} := Γ(Y x, ⊤)
  let a (x : X.left) : CommRingCat.of K ⟶ L x :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv ≫ (g x).appTop
  have hRingEtale (x : X.left) : (a x).hom.Etale := by
    have hf : AlgebraicGeometry.Etale (g x) := inferInstance
    rw [HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale)] at hf
    change ((g x).appTop.hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv.hom).Etale
    exact RingHom.Etale.respectsIso.right (g x).appTop.hom
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm hf
  have hField (x : X.left) : IsField (L x) := by
    let : Algebra K (L x) := (a x).hom.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra.Etale K (L x) := (hRingEtale x).toAlgebra
    let : _root_.IsReduced (L x) :=
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field K (L x)
    let : Subsingleton (Y x) := by
      change Subsingleton (U x)
      exact ⟨fun p q ↦ Subtype.ext (Set.subsingleton_singleton p.property q.property)⟩
    let y : Y x := ⟨x, by simp [U]⟩
    let : Nontrivial (L x) :=
      PrimeSpectrum.nontrivial ((Y x).isoSpec.hom y)
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.subsingleton_iff_isField_of_isReduced]
    constructor
    intro p q
    apply (Y x).isoSpec.hom.homeomorph.symm.injective
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hFiniteSep (x : X.left) :
      letI := (a x).hom.toAlgebra
      Module.Finite K (L x) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (L x) := by
    let : Algebra K (L x) := (a x).hom.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra.Etale K (L x) := (hRingEtale x).toAlgebra
    let : Field (L x) := (hField x).toField
    let : Module.Free K (L x) := Module.Free.of_divisionRing K (L x)
    exact ⟨Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free (R := K) (S := L x),
      Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isSeparable K (L x)⟩
  let d : (∐ fun x ↦ Y x) ⟶ X.left := Sigma.desc fun x ↦ (U x).ι
  let : IsOpenImmersion d := by
    dsimp [d]
    apply isOpenImmersion_sigmaDesc
    intro x y hxy
    refine Set.disjoint_iff_forall_ne.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩ _ ⟨q, rfl⟩ hpq
    apply hxy
    have hp : (U x).ι p = x := by
      change p.1 = x
      have hp_mem : p.1 ∈ ({x} : Set X.left) := by
        change p.1 ∈ (U x : Set X.left)
        exact p.property
      simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hp_mem
    have hq : (U y).ι q = y := by
      change q.1 = y
      have hq_mem : q.1 ∈ ({y} : Set X.left) := by
        change q.1 ∈ (U y : Set X.left)
        exact q.property
      simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hq_mem
    exact hp.symm.trans (hpq.trans hq)
  have hd_surj : Function.Surjective d := by
    intro z
    let p : Y z := ⟨z, by simp [U]⟩
    refine ⟨Sigma.ι (fun x ↦ Y x) z p, ?_⟩
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Sigma.ι_comp_desc]
    rfl
  have hd : d.opensRange = ⊤ := by
    apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange, TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top] using
      Set.range_eq_univ.mpr hd_surj
  let : IsIso d :=
    isIso_of_isOpenImmersion_of_opensRange_eq_top d hd
  let e : (∐ fun x ↦ Spec (L x)) ≅ X.left :=
    (Sigma.mapIso (fun x ↦ (Y x).isoSpec)).symm ≪≫ asIso d
  have he : e.hom ≫ X.hom = Sigma.desc (fun x ↦ Spec.map (a x)) := by
    change e.hom ≫ structureMap = Sigma.desc (fun x ↦ Spec.map (a x))
    apply Sigma.hom_ext
    intro x
    calc
      (Sigma.ι (fun x ↦ Spec (L x)) x ≫ e.hom) ≫ structureMap =
          (Y x).isoSpec.inv ≫ (U x).ι ≫ structureMap := by
        simp only [e, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
          Sigma.ι_mapIso_inv_assoc, asIso_hom, d, Sigma.ι_comp_desc_assoc]
      _ = Spec.map (a x) := by
        simpa only [g, a, Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv, ← Spec.map_comp] using
          (Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality (g x)).symm
      _ = Sigma.ι (fun x ↦ Spec (L x)) x ≫
          Sigma.desc (fun x ↦ Spec.map (a x)) :=
        (Sigma.ι_comp_desc (fun x ↦ Spec.map (a x)) x).symm
  have hePoint (x : X.left) :
      ∃ z : Spec (L x), e.hom (Sigma.ι (fun x ↦ Spec (L x)) x z) = x := by
    let : Field (L x) := (hField x).toField
    let : Subsingleton (Y x) := ⟨fun p q => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hp : p.1 = x := by
        have hp_mem : p.1 ∈ ({x} : Set X.left) := p.property
        exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp_mem
      have hq : q.1 = x := by
        have hq_mem : q.1 ∈ ({x} : Set X.left) := q.property
        exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hq_mem
      exact hp.trans hq.symm⟩
    let p : Y x := ⟨x, by
      change x ∈ ({x} : Set X.left)
      exact Set.mem_singleton x⟩
    refine ⟨(Y x).isoSpec.hom p, ?_⟩
    have hcomponent : Sigma.ι (fun x ↦ Spec (L x)) x ≫ e.hom =
        (Y x).isoSpec.inv ≫ (U x).ι := by
      simp only [e, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
        Sigma.ι_mapIso_inv_assoc, asIso_hom, d]
      rw [Sigma.ι_comp_desc]
    change (Sigma.ι (fun x ↦ Spec (L x)) x ≫ e.hom)
      ((Y x).isoSpec.hom p) = x
    rw [hcomponent]
    have hIso : (Y x).isoSpec.inv ((Y x).isoSpec.hom p) = p := by
      calc
        _ = ((Y x).isoSpec.hom ≫ (Y x).isoSpec.inv) p := rfl
        _ = p := by rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]; rfl
    change (U x).ι ((Y x).isoSpec.inv ((Y x).isoSpec.hom p)) = x
    rw [hIso]
    rfl
  exact ⟨L, a, e, hField, hFiniteSep, he, hePoint⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Etale.exists_iso_sigmaSpec
statement:
@[stacks 02GL "An étale scheme over a field is a disjoint union of spectra of finite separable \
field extensions."]
theorem exists_iso_sigmaSpec (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale) :
    ∃ (L : X.left → CommRingCat.{u})
      (a : ∀ x, CommRingCat.of K ⟶ L x)
      (e : (∐ fun x ↦ Spec (L x)) ≅ X.left),
      (∀ x, IsField (L x)) ∧
        (∀ x, letI := (a x).hom.toAlgebra
          Module.Finite K (L x) ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K (L x)) ∧
        e.hom ≫ X.hom = Sigma.desc (fun x ↦ Spec.map (a x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, a, e, hField, hFiniteSep, he, _⟩ :=
    exists_iso_sigmaSpec_with_point_labels K X
  exact ⟨L, a, e, hField, hFiniteSep, he⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_normal_noetherian_height_one
statement:
theorem
    isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_normal_noetherian_height_one
    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed S]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] (hqHeight : q.height = 1) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime q)
proof:
:= by
  let V := Localization.AtPrime q
  let : IsNoetherianRing V :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing q.primeCompl V inferInstance
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed V :=
    isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization
      V q.primeCompl q.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  have hqNe : q ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hq
    have hzero : q.height = 0 := Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.mpr hq
    rw [hqHeight] at hzero
    norm_num at hzero
  have hnotField : ¬ IsField V :=
    IsLocalization.AtPrime.not_isField S hqNe V
  have hdimV : ringKrullDim V = ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim V = (q.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height q V
      _ = ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hqHeight
  have hkrullDimLE : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 V := by
    rw [Ring.krullDimLE_iff, hdimV]
    exact le_rfl
  have hmaximalOfNonzeroPrime :
      ∀ (P : Ideal V), P ≠ ⊥ → P.IsPrime → P.IsMaximal :=
    Ring.krullDimLE_one_iff_of_isPrime_bot.mp hkrullDimLE
  have huniqueNonzeroPrime :
      ∃! P : Ideal V, P ≠ ⊥ ∧ P.IsPrime := by
    refine ⟨maximalIdeal V, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.not.mp hnotField, inferInstance⟩
    · intro P hP
      exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal
        (hmaximalOfNonzeroPrime P hP.1 hP.2)
  have hnormalUnique :
      IsIntegrallyClosed V ∧
        ∃! P : Ideal V, P ≠ ⊥ ∧ P.IsPrime :=
    ⟨inferInstance, huniqueNonzeroPrime⟩
  exact ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE V hnotField).out 1 4).mpr
    hnormalUnique

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_one
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_one
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 1) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeTheory.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_one
    (Localization.AtPrime P)
  calc
    ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime P) = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P (Localization.AtPrime P)
    _ = (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hP

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtSpan_of_prime
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtSpan_of_prime
    (t : A) (ht : Prime t) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing
      (@Localization.AtPrime A _ (Ideal.span {t})
        (Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ht))
proof:
:= by
  let : (Ideal.span {t}).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ht
  apply isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_one A
  exact Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht.ne_zero) ht.not_isUnit

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.heightOnePrime_eq_span_of_prime_mem
statement:
private theorem heightOnePrime_eq_span_of_prime_mem
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    {y : B} (hy : Prime y)
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime] (hqheight : q.height = 1)
    (hyq : y ∈ q) :
    q = Ideal.span {y}
proof:
:= by
  let branch : Ideal B := Ideal.span {y}
  let : branch.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hy
  have hbranchLe : branch ≤ q := q.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr hyq
  have hbranchNe : branch ≠ ⊥ := by
    simpa [branch, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hy.ne_zero
  let : q.FiniteHeight :=
    Ideal.finiteHeight_iff_lt.mpr (Or.inr (by simp [hqheight]))
  let : branch.FiniteHeight :=
    Ideal.finiteHeight_of_le hbranchLe (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).ne_top
  have hqHeightLe : q.height ≤ branch.height := by
    rw [hqheight]
    exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
      (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.not.mpr hbranchNe)
  exact (branch.eq_of_le_of_height_le hbranchLe hqHeightLe).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.heightOnePrime_eq_span_or_disjoint_powers_of_associated
statement:
theorem heightOnePrime_eq_span_or_disjoint_powers_of_associated
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    {f y : B} (hy : Prime y) (hfy : Associated f y)
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime] (hqheight : q.height = 1) :
    q = Ideal.span {y} ∨
      Disjoint ((Submonoid.powers f : Submonoid B) : Set B) (q : Set B)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyq : y ∈ q
  · exact Or.inl (heightOnePrime_eq_span_of_prime_mem hy q hqheight hyq)
  · right
    rw [Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime]
    exact fun hfq ↦ hyq ((Ideal.mem_iff_of_associated hfy).mp hfq)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.heightOnePrime_eq_span_or_eq_span_or_disjoint_powers_of_associated_mul_pow
statement:
theorem heightOnePrime_eq_span_or_eq_span_or_disjoint_powers_of_associated_mul_pow
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    {f y z : B} {n : ℕ}
    (hy : Prime y) (hz : Prime z) (hfy : Associated f (y * z ^ n))
    (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime] (hqheight : q.height = 1) :
    q = Ideal.span {y} ∨ q = Ideal.span {z} ∨
      Disjoint ((Submonoid.powers f : Submonoid B) : Set B) (q : Set B)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyq : y ∈ q
  · exact Or.inl (heightOnePrime_eq_span_of_prime_mem hy q hqheight hyq)
  · by_cases hzq : z ∈ q
    · exact Or.inr <| Or.inl
        (heightOnePrime_eq_span_of_prime_mem hz q hqheight hzq)
    · right
      right
      rw [Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime]
      intro hfq
      have hprod : y * z ^ n ∈ q :=
        (Ideal.mem_iff_of_associated hfy).mp hfq
      rcases (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).mem_or_mem hprod with hyq' | hzpow
      · exact hyq hyq'
      · exact hzq ((inferInstance : q.IsPrime).mem_of_pow_mem n hzpow)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_one
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_of_isRegularLocalRing_dimension_one
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    IsRegularRing R
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRegularRing_iff]
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpBot : p = ⊥
  · subst p
    let : Field (Localization.AtPrime (⊥ : Ideal R)) :=
      IsField.toField (by
        simp [isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq,
          ← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal])
    infer_instance
  · have hpLe : p ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime p
    have hMaxHeight :
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height = (1 : ℕ∞) := by
      have hMaxHeightCast :
          (((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
            ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim, hdim]
      exact WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hMaxHeightCast
    have hpHeightPos : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ p.height :=
      Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
        (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.not.mpr hpBot)
    have hpHeightLe : p.height ≤ (1 : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← hMaxHeight]
      exact Ideal.height_mono hpLe
    have hpHeight : p.height = (1 : ℕ∞) :=
      le_antisymm hpHeightLe hpHeightPos
    have hpMax : p = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
      by_contra hpNe
      have hpLt : p < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := lt_of_le_of_ne hpLe hpNe
      have := Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime hpLt
      rw [hpHeight, hMaxHeight] at this
      exact (lt_irrefl (1 : ℕ∞)) this
    subst p
    let e : R ≃ₐ[R]
        Localization.AtPrime (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
      IsLocalization.atUnits R
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).primeCompl
        (fun x ↦ by simpa using! fun a ↦ a)
    exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e.toRingEquiv

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isDomain_of_prime_isSMulRegular
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_prime_isSMulRegular
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {p : R} (hp : Prime p) (hpreg : IsSMulRegular R p) : IsDomain R
proof:
:= by
  have hbot : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := by
    rw [Ideal.isPrime_iff]
    refine ⟨bot_ne_top, ?_⟩
    intro a b hab
    simp only [Ideal.mem_bot] at hab ⊢
    by_contra hzero
    push Not at hzero
    obtain ⟨k, hak⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ k := by
      by_contra hall
      push Not at hall
      have haInf : a ∈ ⨅ k : ℕ, maximalIdeal R ^ k := Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr hall
      rw [Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing
        (maximalIdeal R) (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top] at haInf
      exact hzero.1 (Ideal.mem_bot.mp haInf)
    obtain ⟨l, hbl⟩ : ∃ l : ℕ, b ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ l := by
      by_contra hall
      push Not at hall
      have hbInf : b ∈ ⨅ l : ℕ, maximalIdeal R ^ l := Ideal.mem_iInf.mpr hall
      rw [Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing
        (maximalIdeal R) (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top] at hbInf
      exact hzero.2 (Ideal.mem_bot.mp hbInf)
    have hpMem : p ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
      rw [mem_maximalIdeal]
      exact hp.not_isUnit
    have hpow : ∀ k l : ℕ, ∀ a b : R, a * b = 0 →
        p ^ k ∣ a ∨ p ^ l ∣ b := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
          intro l a b hab
          exact Or.inl (by rw [pow_zero]; exact one_dvd a)
      | succ k ihK =>
          intro l
          induction l with
          | zero =>
              intro a b hab
              exact Or.inr (by rw [pow_zero]; exact one_dvd b)
          | succ l ihL =>
              intro a b hab
              have hpProd : p ∣ a * b := by rw [hab]; exact dvd_zero p
              rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hpProd with hpa | hpb
              · obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := hpa
                have hab' : a' * b = 0 := by
                  apply hpreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul
                  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc] using hab
                rcases ihK (l + 1) a' b hab' with ha' | hb'
                · left
                  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ha'
                  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
                  rw [hc, pow_succ]
                  ac_rfl
                · exact Or.inr hb'
              · obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hpb
                have hab' : a * b' = 0 := by
                  apply hpreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul
                  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hab
                rcases ihL a b' hab' with ha' | hb'
                · exact Or.inl ha'
                · right
                  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hb'
                  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
                  rw [hc, pow_succ]
                  ac_rfl
    rcases hpow k l a b hab with ha | hb
    · apply hak
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
      exact (maximalIdeal R ^ k).mul_mem_right c
        (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hpMem k)
    · apply hbl
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hb
      exact (maximalIdeal R ^ l).mul_mem_right c
        (Ideal.pow_mem_pow hpMem l)
  let : (⊥ : Ideal R).IsPrime := hbot
  exact IsDomain.of_bot_isPrime R

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.regularSystem_quotientHead
statement:
theorem regularSystem_quotientHead
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {p : R} {ps : List R}
    (hreg : IsRegular R (p :: ps))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (p :: ps) = maximalIdeal R) :
    let I : Ideal R
proof:
:= Ideal.span {p}
    let S := R ⧸ I
    IsRegular S (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) ∧
      Ideal.ofList (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) =
        (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
  dsimp only
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {p}
  let S := R ⧸ I
  have hpMem : p ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen]
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    change p ∈ maximalIdeal R
    exact hpMem
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIle
  let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hregQ : IsRegular (QuotSMulTop p R)
      (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff' R p ps).mp hreg).2
  let e : QuotSMulTop p R ≃ₗ[S] S :=
    ((QuotSMulTop.equivQuotTensor p R).extendScalarsOfSurjective
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).trans
        ((TensorProduct.rid R S).extendScalarsOfSurjective
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)
  have hregS : IsRegular S (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) :=
    (e.isRegular_congr _).mp hregQ
  have hgenS : Ideal.ofList (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) =
      (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
    rw [← hgen, Ideal.map_ofList]
    simp [I]
  exact ⟨hregS, hgenS⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.regularSystem_quotientPrefix
statement:
theorem regularSystem_quotientPrefix
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (xs ys : List R)
    (hreg : IsRegular R (xs ++ ys))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (xs ++ ys) = maximalIdeal R) :
    let I : Ideal R
proof:
:= Ideal.ofList xs
    let hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
      calc
        I ≤ Ideal.ofList (xs ++ ys) := by
          rw [Ideal.ofList_append]
          exact le_sup_left
        _ = maximalIdeal R := hgen
    let S := R ⧸ I
    letI : Nontrivial S :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI)
    letI : IsLocalRing S :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    IsRegular S (ys.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) ∧
      Ideal.ofList (ys.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) = maximalIdeal S := by
  dsimp only
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.ofList xs
  have hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    calc
      I ≤ Ideal.ofList (xs ++ ys) := by
        rw [Ideal.ofList_append]
        exact le_sup_left
      _ = maximalIdeal R := hgen
  let S := R ⧸ I
  let q : R →+* S := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI
  let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hweakQuotient :=
    ((isWeaklyRegular_append_iff' R xs ys).mp
      hreg.toIsWeaklyRegular).2
  have hsmulTop :
      Ideal.ofList xs • (⊤ : Ideal R) = I := by
    simp [I]
  let eAdd :
      (R ⧸ (Ideal.ofList xs • (⊤ : Ideal R))) ≃+ S :=
    (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq
      (Ideal.ofList xs • (⊤ : Ideal R)) I hsmulTop).toAddEquiv
  let e :
      (R ⧸ (Ideal.ofList xs • (⊤ : Ideal R))) ≃ₗ[S] S :=
    AddEquiv.toLinearEquiv (R := S) eAdd (by
      intro s z
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective s
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ :=
        Submodule.mkQ_surjective
          (Ideal.ofList xs • (⊤ : Ideal R)) z
      rfl)
  have hweakS : IsWeaklyRegular S (ys.map q) := by
    exact (e.isWeaklyRegular_congr _).mp hweakQuotient
  have hgenMap :
      Ideal.ofList ((xs ++ ys).map q) =
        (maximalIdeal R).map q := by
    rw [← Ideal.map_ofList, hgen]
  have hmapXs : Ideal.ofList (xs.map q) = ⊥ := by
    rw [← Ideal.map_ofList]
    exact Ideal.map_quotient_self I
  have hgenS : Ideal.ofList (ys.map q) = maximalIdeal S := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList (ys.map q) =
          Ideal.ofList (xs.map q) ⊔ Ideal.ofList (ys.map q) := by
        rw [hmapXs, bot_sup_eq]
      _ = Ideal.ofList ((xs ++ ys).map q) := by
        rw [List.map_append, Ideal.ofList_append]
      _ = (maximalIdeal R).map q := hgenMap
      _ = maximalIdeal S :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
          q Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hmem : ∀ r ∈ ys.map q, r ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
    intro r hr
    rw [← hgenS]
    exact Ideal.subset_span hr
  exact ⟨IsRegular.of_isWeaklyRegular_of_mem_maximalIdeal
      (L := S) hmem hweakS, hgenS⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isDomain_of_regularSystem
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_regularSystem
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (ps : List R) (hreg : IsRegular R ps)
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList ps = maximalIdeal R) : IsDomain R
proof:
:= by
  match ps with
  | [] =>
      have hmax : maximalIdeal R = ⊥ := by simpa using hgen.symm
      exact (IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mpr hmax).isDomain
  | p :: ps =>
      let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {p}
      let S := R ⧸ I
      have hpMem : p ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
        rw [← hgen]
        exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
      have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
        apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
        intro z hz
        simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
        subst z
        change p ∈ maximalIdeal R
        exact hpMem
      have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIle
      let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
      let : IsLocalRing S :=
        IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
        isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      have hquot := regularSystem_quotientHead hreg hgen
      have hregS : IsRegular S (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) := by
        simpa [I, S] using hquot.1
      have hgenS : Ideal.ofList (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) =
          maximalIdeal S := by
        calc
          Ideal.ofList (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) =
              (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
            simpa [I, S] using hquot.2
          _ = maximalIdeal S :=
            IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      have hdomainS : IsDomain S :=
        isDomain_of_regularSystem (R := S)
          (ps.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) hregS hgenS
      let : IsDomain S := hdomainS
      have hIprime : I.IsPrime :=
        (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime I).mp inferInstance
      have hpreg : IsSMulRegular R p :=
        ((isRegular_cons_iff R p ps).mp hreg).1
      have hpNe : p ≠ 0 := by
        intro hpzero
        have hone : (1 : R) = 0 := by
          apply hpreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul
          simp only [hpzero, zero_smul]
        exact one_ne_zero hone
      have hpPrime : Prime p := by
        apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hpNe).mp
        simpa [I] using hIprime
      exact isDomain_of_prime_isSMulRegular hpPrime hpreg

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.isRegularLocalRing_of_regularSystem
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_of_regularSystem
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (ps : List R) (hreg : IsRegular R ps)
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList ps = maximalIdeal R) : IsRegularLocalRing R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  have hspan : (Ideal.ofList ps).spanFinrank ≤ ps.length := by
    refine (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite ps.finite_toSet).trans ?_
    rw [show {x : R | x ∈ ps} = (ps.toFinset : Set R) by
      ext x
      exact List.mem_toFinset.symm,
      Set.ncard_coe_finset]
    exact List.toFinset_card_le ps
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_add_length_eq_ringKrullDim_of_isRegular ps hreg
  rw [hgen] at hdim
  let : Field (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.field (maximalIdeal R)
  have hfieldDim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) = 0 :=
    ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field _
  rw [hfieldDim, zero_add] at hdim
  rw [← hgen]
  change ((Ideal.ofList ps).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R
  calc
    ((Ideal.ofList ps).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        (ps.length : WithBot ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hspan
    _ = ringKrullDim R := by simpa using hdim

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.regularSystem_length_eq_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem regularSystem_length_eq_ringKrullDim
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.quotientPrefix_ringKrullDim_eq_length_of_regularSystem
statement:
theorem quotientPrefix_ringKrullDim_eq_length_of_regularSystem
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (xs ys : List R)
    (hreg : IsRegular R (xs ++ ys))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (xs ++ ys) = maximalIdeal R) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList xs) =
      ((ys.length : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.ofList xs
  let S := R ⧸ I
  have hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    calc
      I ≤ Ideal.ofList (xs ++ ys) := by
        rw [Ideal.ofList_append]
        exact le_sup_left
      _ = maximalIdeal R := hgen
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI

    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.quotientPrefix_geometry_dimension_two_of_regularSystem
statement:
theorem quotientPrefix_geometry_dimension_two_of_regularSystem
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (xs : List R) (y z : R)

      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList xs) =
        ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(quotientPrefix_geometry_of_regularSystem
    xs [y, z] hreg hgen).1, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨(quotientPrefix_geometry_of_regularSystem
    xs [y, z] hreg hgen).2, ?_⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem
statement:
theorem prime_of_mem_regularSystem
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {ps : List R} (hreg : IsRegular R ps)
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList ps = maximalIdeal R)
    {p : R} (hp : p ∈ ps) : Prime p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let qs := ps.erase p
  have hperm : ps.Perm (p :: qs) := List.perm_cons_erase hp
  have hreg' : IsRegular R (p :: qs) :=
    IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hreg hperm
  have hgen' : Ideal.ofList (p :: qs) = maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen]
    apply congrArg Ideal.span
    ext z
    exact hperm.mem_iff.symm
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {p}
  let S := R ⧸ I
  have hpMem : p ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hgen']
    exact Ideal.subset_span List.mem_cons_self
  have hIle : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    change p ∈ maximalIdeal R
    exact hpMem
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIle
  let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective R S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hquot := regularSystem_quotientHead hreg' hgen'
  have hdomainS : IsDomain S :=
    isDomain_of_regularSystem (qs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
      (by simpa [I, S] using hquot.1)
      (by
        calc
          Ideal.ofList (qs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) =
              (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
            simpa [I, S] using hquot.2
          _ = maximalIdeal S :=
            IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)
  let : IsDomain S := hdomainS
  have hIprime : I.IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime I).mp inferInstance
  have hpreg : IsSMulRegular R p :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff R p qs).mp hreg').1
  have hpNe : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hpzero
    have hone : (1 : R) = 0 := by
      apply hpreg.right_eq_zero_of_smul
      simp only [hpzero, zero_smul]
    exact one_ne_zero hone
  apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hpNe).mp
  simpa [I] using hIprime

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_heightTwo_prime_of_nonunit_natCast_mod_prime
statement:
theorem exists_heightTwo_prime_of_nonunit_natCast_mod_prime
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A]
    (t : A) (ht : Prime t) (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e)
    [CharZero (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t})]
    (he_nonunit : ¬ IsUnit (e : A ⧸ Ideal.span {t})) :
    ∃ (P : Ideal A) (_ : P.IsPrime),
      P ∈ (Ideal.span {t, (e : A)}).minimalPrimes ∧
      Ideal.span {t} < P ∧
      P.height = 2 ∧
      ¬ IsUnit
        (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (e : A))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he_notmem : (e : A) ∉ Ideal.span {t} := by
    intro he_mem
    have he_zero : (e : A ⧸ Ideal.span {t}) = 0 := by
      simpa using Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr he_mem
    exact (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr he.ne') he_zero
  have he_nonunit_A : ¬ IsUnit (e : A) := by
    intro he_unit
    exact he_nonunit (he_unit.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {t})))
  have hpair_le : Ideal.span {t, (e : A)} ≤ maximalIdeal A := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with hxt | hxe
    · subst x
      exact (mem_maximalIdeal t).mpr (mem_nonunits_iff.mpr ht.not_isUnit)
    · subst x
      exact (mem_maximalIdeal (e : A)).mpr (mem_nonunits_iff.mpr he_nonunit_A)
  obtain ⟨P, hPmin, -⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le hpair_le
  let : P.IsPrime := hPmin.isPrime
  let : (Ideal.span {t}).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime ht
  have htP : t ∈ P := hPmin.le (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert t {(e : A)}))
  have heP : (e : A) ∈ P :=
    hPmin.le (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem t (Set.mem_singleton _)))
  have hspan_le : Ideal.span {t} ≤ P := Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa)
  have hspan_lt : Ideal.span {t} < P :=
    hspan_le.lt_of_not_ge fun hPspan ↦ he_notmem (hPspan heP)
  have hspan_height : (Ideal.span {t}).height = 1 :=
    Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht.ne_zero) ht.not_isUnit
  have hheight_lower : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ P.height := by
    have := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hspan_lt
    simpa only [hspan_height, one_add_one_eq_two] using this
  have hte : t ≠ (e : A) := by
    intro hte
    apply he_notmem
    rw [← hte]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self t
  have hheight_upper : P.height ≤ (2 : ℕ∞) := by
    have h := Ideal.height_le_ncard_of_mem_minimalPrimes_span
      (s := {t, (e : A)}) (Set.toFinite _) hPmin
    simpa [hte] using h
  have hheight : P.height = 2 := le_antisymm hheight_upper hheight_lower
  have he_local_nonunit :
      ¬ IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (e : A)) := by
    rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (Localization.AtPrime P) P]
    simpa only [Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff, not_not] using heP
  exact ⟨P, inferInstance, hPmin, hspan_lt, hheight, he_local_nonunit⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two
statement:
theorem exists_regular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (hfin : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 2)
    {x : R} (hxPrime : Prime x) (hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (hxSq : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    ∃ y : R, IsRegular R [x, y] ∧
      Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let m : Ideal R := maximalIdeal R
  let x' : m := ⟨x, hxMem⟩
  have hxCot : m.toCotangent x' ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    exact hxSq ((m.toCotangent_eq_zero x').mp hx)
  have hdim : 1 < Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) := by
    omega
  obtain ⟨yCot, hxyCot⟩ :=
    exists_linearIndependent_pair_of_one_lt_finrank hdim hxCot
  obtain ⟨y', hyCot⟩ := m.toCotangent_surjective yCot
  let y : R := y'
  let v : Fin 2 → CotangentSpace R :=
    ![m.toCotangent x', m.toCotangent y']
  have hv : LinearIndependent (ResidueField R) v := by
    simpa only [v, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, hyCot] using hxyCot
  have hvSpan : Submodule.span (ResidueField R) (Set.range v) = ⊤ :=
    hv.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' (by simp [hfin])
  have himage :
      m.toCotangent '' ({x', y'} : Set m) = Set.range v := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      Set.mem_range, v]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, rfl | rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i
      · exact ⟨x', Or.inl rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨y', Or.inr rfl, rfl⟩
  have hsubtypeSpan : Submodule.span R ({x', y'} : Set m) = ⊤ := by
    apply (CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff (R := R)).mp
    rw [himage]
    exact hvSpan
  have hmapSpan :
      (Submodule.span R ({x', y'} : Set m)).map m.subtype = m := by
    rw [hsubtypeSpan, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  have hspanSet : Ideal.span ({x, y} : Set R) = maximalIdeal R := by
    change Ideal.span ({x, y} : Set R) = m
    rw [← hmapSpan, Submodule.map_span]
    congr 1
    ext z
    simp [x', y, eq_comm]
  have hspan : Ideal.ofList [x, y] = maximalIdeal R := by
    change Ideal.span {r | r ∈ [x, y]} = maximalIdeal R
    rw [show {r | r ∈ [x, y]} = ({x, y} : Set R) by ext r; exact List.mem_pair]
    exact hspanSet
  have hyNotMem : y ∉ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R) := by
    intro hy
    have hle : Ideal.span ({x, y} : Set R) ≤ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R) := by
      apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro z hz
      rcases hz with hzx | hzy
      · subst z
        exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x
      · subst z
        exact hy
    have hmaxPrincipal : (maximalIdeal R).IsPrincipal := by
      refine ⟨x, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
      · rw [← hspanSet]
        exact hle
      · exact Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hxMem)
    have hleOne :
        Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) ≤ 1 :=
      IsLocalRing.finrank_cotangentSpace_le_one_iff.mpr hmaxPrincipal
    omega
  have hxRegular : IsSMulRegular R x := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro a ha
    have hxa : x * a = 0 := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using ha
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hxa).resolve_left hxPrime.ne_zero
  have hyRegular : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop x R) y := by
    rw [isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem]
    intro a ha
    rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists] at ha ⊢
    obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := ha
    have hprod : y * a ∈ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R) := by
      rw [show y * a = x * c by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hc.symm]
      exact (Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)).mul_mem_right c
        (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x)
    have hspanPrime : (Ideal.span ({x} : Set R)).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime hxPrime
    have haMem : a ∈ Ideal.span ({x} : Set R) :=
      (hspanPrime.mem_or_mem hprod).resolve_left hyNotMem
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp haMem
    refine ⟨d, Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hd.symm
  have hweak : IsWeaklyRegular R [x, y] := by
    apply (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff R x [y]).mpr
    refine ⟨hxRegular, ?_⟩
    exact (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff (QuotSMulTop x R) y).mpr hyRegular
  have hmem : ∀ r ∈ [x, y], r ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro r hr
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simpa using hr)
  exact ⟨y,
    IsRegular.of_isWeaklyRegular_of_mem_maximalIdeal (L := R) hmem hweak,
    hspan⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_two
statement:
theorem exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_two
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsRegularRing A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    {t : A} (htPrime : Prime t) (htMem : t ∈ P)
    (htSq : algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) t ∉
      maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P) ^ 2) :
    ∃ y : Localization.AtPrime P,
      IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime P)
        [algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) t, y] ∧
      Ideal.ofList [algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) t, y] =
        maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  have hdim :
      Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 2 := by
    have hdim' :
        ((Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) : ℕ∞) :
            WithBot ℕ∞) = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      calc
        ((Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) : ℕ∞) :
            WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R :=
          (IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace R).mp inferInstance
        _ = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
          IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P R
        _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
          congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hP
    exact ENat.natCast_inj.mp (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hdim')
  have htLocalMem : algebraMap A R t ∈ maximalIdeal R :=
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff R P t).mpr htMem
  have htLocalNe : algebraMap A R t ≠ 0 := by
    intro htZero
    exact htPrime.ne_zero
      ((IsLocalization.injective R P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using htZero))
  have htSpanPrime :
      (Ideal.span ({t} : Set A)).map (algebraMap A R) |>.IsPrime := by
    let : (Ideal.span ({t} : Set A)).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime htPrime
    exact Ideal.isPrime_map_of_isLocalizationAtPrime P
      (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htMem)
  have htLocalPrime : Prime (algebraMap A R t) := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime htLocalNe).mp
    simpa only [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] using htSpanPrime
  exact exists_regular_pair_of_finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_two
    hdim htLocalPrime htLocalMem htSq

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.charP_localizationAtPrime_residue_of_natCast_nonunit
statement:
theorem charP_localizationAtPrime_residue_of_natCast_nonunit
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hp_nonunit :
      ¬ IsUnit
        (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (p : A))) :
    CharP
      (Localization.AtPrime P ⧸
        maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) p
proof:
:= by
  have hp_nonunit' : ¬ IsUnit (p : Localization.AtPrime P) := by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hp_nonunit
  rw [CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero hp,
    ← map_natCast (Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P))),
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact (mem_maximalIdeal _).2 (mem_nonunits_iff.2 hp_nonunit')

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.map_symm_primeCompl_eq
statement:
private theorem map_symm_primeCompl_eq
    [∀ j, IsLocalRing (A j)] (e : U ≃+* (∀ j, A j)) :
    Submonoid.map e.symm.toMonoidHom
        (productCoordinatePrime A i).primeCompl =
      (ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime A i e).primeCompl
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    change y ∉ productCoordinatePrime A i at hy
    change e (e.symm y) ∉ productCoordinatePrime A i
    simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hy
  · intro hx
    change e x ∉ productCoordinatePrime A i at hx
    refine ⟨e x, ?_, e.symm_apply_apply x⟩
    exact hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ringEquivProductCoordinate_isLocalization
statement:
theorem ringEquivProductCoordinate_isLocalization
    [∀ j, IsLocalRing (A j)] (e : U ≃+* (∀ j, A j)) :
    letI : Algebra U (A i)
proof:
:= ringEquivProductCoordinateAlgebra A i e
    IsLocalization (ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime A i e).primeCompl (A i) := by
  let : Algebra U (A i) := ringEquivProductCoordinateAlgebra A i e
  have hloc : IsLocalization
      (Submonoid.map e.symm.toMonoidHom
        (productCoordinatePrime A i).primeCompl) (A i) := by
    apply IsLocalization.of_surjective
      (productCoordinatePrime A i).primeCompl (A i)
      e.symm.toRingHom e.symm.surjective (RingHom.id (A i))
      Function.bijective_id.surjective
    · ext x
      change x i = e (e.symm x) i
      rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
    · intro x hx
      change x = 0 at hx
      subst x
      exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  rw [map_symm_primeCompl_eq A i e] at hloc
  exact hloc

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime_map
    [∀ j, IsLocalRing (A j)] (e : U ≃+* (∀ j, A j)) :
    letI : Algebra U (A i)
proof:
:= ringEquivProductCoordinateAlgebra A i e
    (ringEquivProductCoordinatePrime A i e).map
        (algebraMap U (A i)) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i) := by
  let : Algebra U (A i) := ringEquivProductCoordinateAlgebra A i e
  change Ideal.map ((Pi.evalRingHom A i).comp e.toRingHom)
      (Ideal.comap e.toRingHom
        (Ideal.comap (Pi.evalRingHom A i)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i)))) =
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i)
  rw [Ideal.comap_comap]
  have hf : Function.Surjective
      ((Pi.evalRingHom A i).comp e.toRingHom) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (Pi.evalRingHom A i).surjective y
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := e.surjective x
    exact ⟨z, hx⟩
  exact Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ hf _

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.prime_eq_ker_coordinateEval_of_le_of_ne
statement:
theorem prime_eq_ker_coordinateEval_of_le_of_ne
    (i : ι) (N : Ideal (∀ j, A j)) [N.IsPrime]
    (hNP : N ≤ productCoordinatePrime A i)
    (hNne : N ≠ productCoordinatePrime A i) :
    N = RingHom.ker (Pi.evalRingHom A i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := Pi.evalRingHom A i
  let e : ∀ j, A j := Pi.single i 1
  have heP : e ∉ productCoordinatePrime A i := by
    rw [mem_productCoordinatePrime]
    simp [e]
  have heN : e ∉ N := fun he ↦ heP (hNP he)
  have heMul : e * (1 - e) = 0 := by
    ext j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [e]
    · simp [e, hij]
  have honeSub : 1 - e ∈ N :=
    ((inferInstance : N.IsPrime).mem_or_mem_of_mul_eq_zero heMul).resolve_left heN
  have hker : RingHom.ker f ≤ N := by
    rw [show RingHom.ker f =
        Ideal.span ({1 - Pi.single i 1} : Set (∀ j, A j)) by
      exact ker_productCoordinateEval A i]
    apply Ideal.span_le.2
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst x
    exact honeSub
  let q := N.map f
  have hqprime : q.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective f.surjective hker
  have hcomap : q.comap f = N := by
    dsimp only [q]
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective f f.surjective]
    apply sup_eq_left.mpr
    change RingHom.ker f ≤ N
    exact hker
  by_cases hqzero : q = ⊥
  · calc
      N = q.comap f := hcomap.symm
      _ = (⊥ : Ideal (A i)).comap f := by rw [hqzero]
      _ = RingHom.ker f := rfl
  · have hqmax : q.IsMaximal := hqprime.isMaximal hqzero
    have hqeq : q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i) :=
      IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hqmax
    exfalso
    apply hNne
    calc
      N = q.comap f := hcomap.symm
      _ = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (A i)).comap f := by rw [hqeq]
      _ = productCoordinatePrime A i := rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.tensorProduct_integralClosure_eq_tmul_one
statement:
private theorem tensorProduct_integralClosure_eq_tmul_one
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (z : S ⊗[R] integralClosure R K) :
    ∃ s : S, z = s ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : integralClosure R K)
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.inductionOn z ?_ ?_
  · intro s x
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.algebraMap_eq_of_integral x.2
    have hx : x = algebraMap R (integralClosure R K) r := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hr.symm
    refine ⟨r • s, ?_⟩
    rw [hx]
    rw [show algebraMap R (integralClosure R K) r =
      r • (1 : integralClosure R K) by simp [Algebra.smul_def]]
    exact TensorProduct.tmul_smul
      (R := R) (R' := R) (M := S) (N := integralClosure R K)
      r s (1 : integralClosure R K)
  · rintro x y ⟨sx, hsx⟩ ⟨sy, hsy⟩
    refine ⟨sx + sy, ?_⟩
    rw [hsx, hsy]
    exact (TensorProduct.add_tmul sx sy (1 : integralClosure R K)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_eq_includeLeft_of_isIntegral_genericFiber_of_smooth
statement:
theorem exists_eq_includeLeft_of_isIntegral_genericFiber_of_smooth
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS} {K : Type uK}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.Smooth R S]
    [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (x : S ⊗[R] K) (hx : IsIntegral S x) :
    ∃ s : S,
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : S →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] K) s = x
proof:
:= by
  let hCompare :=
    TensorProduct.toIntegralClosure_bijective_of_smooth
      (R := R) (S := S) (B := K)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hCompare.2 ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ :=
    tensorProduct_integralClosure_eq_tmul_one
      (R := R) (S := S) (K := K) z
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hz

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosureGenericFiberAlgEquiv_tmul
