name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.specNormalizationIso_hom_base
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem specNormalizationIso_hom_base :
    (specNormalizationIso R L).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L))) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R L))).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  apply spec_toNormalization_hom_ext R L
  rw [← Category.assoc, toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom,
    ← Spec.map_comp, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_fromNormalization]
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isPullback_affineNormalization_generic
statement:
theorem isPullback_affineNormalization_generic :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R L))).toNormalization
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R L))).fromNormalization
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K)))
proof:
:= by
  exact (isPullback_spec_integralClosure_generic R K L).of_iso
    (Iso.refl _) (specNormalizationIso R L).symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (by
      rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Iso.symm_hom,
        Iso.comp_inv_eq, toNormalization_specNormalizationIso_hom]
      rfl)
    (by simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id])
    (by
      simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Iso.symm_hom,
        ← specNormalizationIso_hom_base R L, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc])
    (by simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id])

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_of_isIntegral_localizationAway_pair_of_prime
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_isIntegral_localizationAway_pair_of_prime
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]
    {x y : A} (hx : Prime x) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hxy : ¬ x ∣ y)
    (z : L)
    (hzx :
      let Aₓ := Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers x)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx.ne_zero))
      IsIntegral Aₓ z)
    (hzy :
      let Aᵧ := Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers y)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy))
      IsIntegral Aᵧ z) :
    IsIntegral A z
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff : ∀ i : ℕ, (minpoly K z).coeff i ∈ (algebraMap A K).range := by
    intro i
    apply Algebra.mem_bot.mp
    apply mem_bot_of_mem_localizationAway_pair_of_prime
      hx hy hxy (z := (minpoly K z).coeff i)
    · let Aₓ := Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers x)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx.ne_zero))
      let : IsIntegrallyClosed Aₓ :=
        isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization Aₓ (Submonoid.powers x)
          (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
            (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx.ne_zero))
      have hmin := minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' K hzx
      rw [hmin, Polynomial.coeff_map]
      exact Subtype.prop _
    · let Aᵧ := Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers y)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy))
      let : IsIntegrallyClosed Aᵧ :=
        isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization Aᵧ (Submonoid.powers y)
          (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
            (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy))
      have hmin := minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' K hzy
      rw [hmin, Polynomial.coeff_map]
      exact Subtype.prop _
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    (Polynomial.mem_map_range (algebraMap A K)).mpr hcoeff
  change q.map (algebraMap A K) = minpoly K z at hq
  have hqmonic : q.Monic := by
    apply ((IsFractionRing.injective A K).monic_map_iff).mpr
    rw [hq]
    exact minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral z)
  refine ⟨q, hqmonic, ?_⟩
  have hzmin := minpoly.aeval K z
  rw [← hq] at hzmin
  change Polynomial.aeval z q = 0
  simpa only [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] using hzmin

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.mem_bot_of_mem_localizationAway_pair_of_prime
statement:
theorem mem_bot_of_mem_localizationAway_pair_of_prime
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    {x y : A} (hx : Prime x) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hxy : ¬ x ∣ y)
    (z : K)
    (hzx : z ∈ Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers x)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx.ne_zero)))
    (hzy : z ∈ Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers y)
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy))) :
    z ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra A K)
proof:
:= by
  change ∃ (a s : A) (_ : s ∈ Submonoid.powers x),
    z = algebraMap A K a * (algebraMap A K s)⁻¹ at hzx
  obtain ⟨a, sx, hsx, hzx⟩ := hzx
  obtain ⟨n, hsn⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff sx x).mp hsx
  subst sx
  change ∃ (b s : A) (_ : s ∈ Submonoid.powers y),
    z = algebraMap A K b * (algebraMap A K s)⁻¹ at hzy
  obtain ⟨b, sy, hsy, hzy⟩ := hzy
  obtain ⟨m, hsm⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff sy y).mp hsy
  subst sy
  have hxpowK : algebraMap A K (x ^ n) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective A K)).mpr
      (pow_ne_zero n hx.ne_zero)
  have hypowK : algebraMap A K (y ^ m) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective A K)).mpr
      (pow_ne_zero m hy)
  have hfrac :
      algebraMap A K a / algebraMap A K (x ^ n) =
        algebraMap A K b / algebraMap A K (y ^ m) := by
    calc
      algebraMap A K a / algebraMap A K (x ^ n) = z := by
        simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hzx.symm
      _ = algebraMap A K b / algebraMap A K (y ^ m) := by
        simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hzy
  have hcrossK :
      algebraMap A K a * algebraMap A K (y ^ m) =
        algebraMap A K b * algebraMap A K (x ^ n) :=
    (div_eq_div_iff hxpowK hypowK).mp hfrac
  have hcrossA : a * y ^ m = b * x ^ n := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    simpa only [map_mul] using hcrossK
  have hpowdvd : x ^ n ∣ a * y ^ m := by
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hcrossA
  have hnotdvd : ¬ x ∣ y ^ m := fun h ↦ hxy (hx.dvd_of_dvd_pow h)
  obtain ⟨c, hac⟩ := hx.pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_right n hnotdvd hpowdvd
  rw [Algebra.mem_bot]
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  rw [hzx, hac, map_mul]
  calc
    algebraMap A K c = algebraMap A K c * 1 := by rw [mul_one]
    _ = algebraMap A K c *
        (algebraMap A K (x ^ n) * (algebraMap A K (x ^ n))⁻¹) := by
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hxpowK]
    _ = (algebraMap A K (x ^ n) * algebraMap A K c) *
        (algebraMap A K (x ^ n))⁻¹ := by
      ac_rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.algebraMap_integralClosureTwoIntegralBasesAlgEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_integralClosureTwoIntegralBasesAlgEquiv
    (x : integralClosure B L) :
    letI : Algebra B (integralClosure C L)
proof:
:=
      integralClosureTwoIntegralBasesAlgebra (A := A) (B := B) (C := C) (L := L)
    algebraMap (integralClosure C L) L
        (integralClosureTwoIntegralBasesAlgEquiv
          (A := A) (B := B) (C := C) (L := L) x) =
      algebraMap (integralClosure B L) L x := by
  let : Algebra B (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
  let : Algebra C (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
  let : Algebra B (integralClosure C L) :=
    integralClosureTwoIntegralBasesAlgebra (A := A) (B := B) (C := C) (L := L)
  let eB : integralClosure B L ≃ₐ[B] integralClosure A L :=
    integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgEquiv
  let eC : integralClosure C L ≃ₐ[C] integralClosure A L :=
    integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgEquiv
  have hC := algebraMap_integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgEquiv
    (A := A) (B := C) (L := L) (eC.symm (eB x))
  have hB := algebraMap_integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgEquiv
    (A := A) (B := B) (L := L) x
  change algebraMap (integralClosure C L) L (eC.symm (eB x)) =
    algebraMap (integralClosure B L) L x
  calc
    algebraMap (integralClosure C L) L (eC.symm (eB x)) =
        algebraMap (integralClosure A L) L
          (eC (eC.symm (eB x))) := by
      simpa [eC] using hC.symm
    _ = algebraMap (integralClosure A L) L (eB x) := by
      rw [eC.apply_symm_apply]
    _ = algebraMap (integralClosure B L) L x := by
      simpa [eB] using hB

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isIntegral_pi_iff
statement:
theorem isIntegral_pi_iff
    {R : Type uR} {I : Type uI} {A : I → Type uA}
    [CommRing R] [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)]
    [Finite I] (x : ∀ i, A i) :
    IsIntegral R x ↔ ∀ i, IsIntegral R (x i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx i
    exact hx.map (Pi.evalAlgHom R A i)
  · intro hx
    classical
    let := Fintype.ofFinite I
    choose p hpMonic hpRoot using hx
    have hprodMonic : (∏ i, p i).Monic := by
      simpa using
        (Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic Finset.univ p fun i _ => hpMonic i)
    refine ⟨∏ i, p i, hprodMonic, ?_⟩
    · apply funext
      intro i
      change (∏ j, p j).aeval x i = (0 : A i)
      rw [Polynomial.aeval_pi_apply₂]
      rw [map_prod]
      exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (hpRoot i)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosurePiAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integralClosurePiAlgEquiv_apply
    {R : Type uR} {I : Type uI} (A : I → Type uA)
    [CommRing R] [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)]
    [Finite I] (x : integralClosure R (∀ i, A i)) (i : I) :
    ((integralClosurePiAlgEquiv A x i : integralClosure R (A i)) : A i) =
      (x : ∀ i, A i) i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosure_pi_etale
statement:
theorem integralClosure_pi_etale
    {R : Type uR} {I : Type uI} (A : I → Type uA)
    [CommRing R] [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)]
    [Finite I]
    [∀ i, Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R (A i))] :
    Algebra.Etale R (integralClosure R (∀ i, A i))
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.Etale R (∀ i, integralClosure R (A i)) := inferInstance

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localizationAwayToExtension_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem localizationAwayToExtension_isScalarTower
    (f : A) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    letI : Algebra (Localization.Away f) L
proof:
:=
      localizationAwayToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) f hf
    IsScalarTower A (Localization.Away f) L := by
  let : Algebra (Localization.Away f) L :=
    localizationAwayToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) f hf
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    (IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp f _).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_integralClosure_away_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
statement:
theorem localization_integralClosure_away_etale_of_local_integralClosure_etale
    (f : A) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away f
    let C := integralClosure A L
    let T := Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f)
    letI : Algebra S L :=
      localizationAwayToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) f hf
    letI : Algebra S T :=
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A C) f).toAlgebra
    Algebra.Etale S (integralClosure S L) →
      Algebra.Etale S T := by
  dsimp only
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let C := integralClosure A L
  let T := Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f)
  let : Algebra S L :=
    localizationAwayToExtensionAlgebra (K := K) f hf
  let : Algebra S T :=
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A C) f).toAlgebra
  intro h
  let : Algebra.Etale S (integralClosure S L) := h
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv
    (localizationIntegralClosureAwayAlgEquiv
      (K := K) (L := L) f hf).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.integralClosureIntegralBase_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem integralClosureIntegralBase_isScalarTower :
    letI : Algebra B (integralClosure A L)
proof:
:=
      integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
    IsScalarTower A B (integralClosure A L) := by
  let : Algebra B (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦
    (IsIntegralClosure.lift A (integralClosure A L) L).commutes a |>.symm

statement:
theorem integralClosureIntegralBase_toAmbient_isScalarTower :

proof:
:=
      integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
    IsScalarTower B (integralClosure A L) L := by
  let : Algebra B (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun b ↦
    (IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_lift A (integralClosure A L) L b).symm

statement:
theorem moduleFinite_integralClosure_of_integralBase
    [Module.Finite B (integralClosure B L)] :

proof:
:=
      integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
    Module.Finite B (integralClosure A L) := by

  exact Module.Finite.equiv
    integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv

statement:
theorem integralClosure_etale_of_integralBase
    (hEtale : Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure B L)) :
    letI : Algebra B (integralClosure A L)
proof:
:=
      integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
    Algebra.Etale B (integralClosure A L) := by
  let : Algebra B (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.algebraMap_integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgEquiv
    (x : integralClosure B L) :
    letI : Algebra B (integralClosure A L)
proof:
:=
      integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
    algebraMap (integralClosure A L) L
        (integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgEquiv x) =
      algebraMap (integralClosure B L) L x := by
  let : Algebra B (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosureIntegralBaseAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B (integralClosure A L) :=
    integralClosureIntegralBase_isScalarTower
  let : IsScalarTower B (integralClosure A L) L :=
    integralClosureIntegralBase_toAmbient_isScalarTower
  let : IsIntegralClosure (integralClosure A L) B L :=
    IsIntegralClosure.tower_top (R := A) (A := B) (B := L)
      (C := integralClosure A L)
  exact IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_equiv B (integralClosure B L) L
    (integralClosure A L) x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.traceDual_one_finite
statement:
private theorem traceDual_one_finite :
    Module.Finite B (Submodule.traceDual A K (1 : Submodule B L))
proof:
:= by
  let J : Submodule B L := 1
  let I : Submodule B L := Submodule.traceDual A K J
  let f : B →ₗ[A] L := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L).toLinearMap
  let fJ : B →ₗ[A] J.restrictScalars A :=
    f.codRestrict (J.restrictScalars A) fun b ↦ by
      rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, Submodule.mem_one]
      exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
  have hfJ : Function.Surjective fJ := by
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, Submodule.mem_one] at hz
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨b, Subtype.ext hb⟩
  let : Module.Finite A (J.restrictScalars A) :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective fJ hfJ
  let : IsLocalizedModule A⁰ f :=
    (isLocalizedModule_iff_isLocalization
      (S := A⁰) (R := A) (A := B) (Aₛ := L)).mpr
        (IsIntegralClosure.isLocalization A K L B)
  have hspanLocalized :
      Submodule.span K (f '' (Set.univ : Set B)) = ⊤ :=
    span_eq_top_of_isLocalizedModule K A⁰ f Submodule.span_univ
  have hspan :
      Submodule.span K ((J.restrictScalars A : Submodule A L) : Set L) = ⊤ := by
    change Submodule.span K ((J : Submodule B L) : Set L) = ⊤
    change Submodule.span K (((1 : Submodule B L) : Set L)) = ⊤
    rw [Submodule.one_eq_range, LinearMap.coe_range]
    change Submodule.span K (Set.range fun b : B ↦ algebraMap B L b) = ⊤
    rw [Set.image_univ] at hspanLocalized
    change Submodule.span K (Set.range fun b : B ↦ algebraMap B L b) = ⊤ at hspanLocalized
    exact hspanLocalized
  let D : Submodule A L :=
    (Algebra.traceForm K L).dualSubmodule (J.restrictScalars A)
  have hDfinite : Module.Finite A D := by
    let : IsNoetherian A (Module.Dual A (J.restrictScalars A)) :=
      isNoetherian_linearMap A A (J.restrictScalars A)
    exact Module.Finite.of_injective
      ((Algebra.traceForm K L).dualSubmoduleToDual (J.restrictScalars A))
      ((Algebra.traceForm K L).dualSubmoduleToDual_injective
        (traceForm_nondegenerate K L) (J.restrictScalars A) hspan)
  let : Module.Finite A D := hDfinite
  have hID : I.restrictScalars A = D := rfl
  let : Module.Finite A (I.restrictScalars A) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (LinearEquiv.ofEq D (I.restrictScalars A) hID.symm)
  let : Module.Finite A I :=
    Module.Finite.equiv
      ((Submodule.restrictScalarsEquiv A B L I).restrictScalars A)
  exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite A B I

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.traceDual_one_ne_bot
statement:
private theorem traceDual_one_ne_bot :
    Submodule.traceDual A K (1 : Submodule B L) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, g, hg⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := A) (M := B)
  let t : Fin n → K := fun i ↦ Algebra.trace K L (algebraMap B L (g i))
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
    IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples A⁰ Finset.univ t
  let d : L := algebraMap A L (s : A)
  let ℓ : B →ₗ[A] K :=
    ((Algebra.traceForm K L d).restrictScalars A).comp
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L).toLinearMap
  let P : Submodule A B := (1 : Submodule A K).comap ℓ
  have hgP : Set.range g ⊆ P := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change ℓ (g i) ∈ (1 : Submodule A K)
    rw [Submodule.mem_one]
    have hi := hs i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    change ∃ a : A, algebraMap A K a = (s : A) • t i at hi
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hi
    refine ⟨a, ha.trans ?_⟩
    simp only [ℓ, t, d, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars,
      Algebra.traceForm_apply]
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    calc
      algebraMap A K (s : A) * Algebra.trace K L (algebraMap B L (g i)) =
          Algebra.trace K L
            (algebraMap A K (s : A) • algebraMap B L (g i)) := by
              simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply] using
                ((Algebra.trace K L).map_smul
                  (algebraMap A K (s : A)) (algebraMap B L (g i))).symm
      _ = Algebra.trace K L
          (algebraMap A L (s : A) *
            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L).toLinearMap (g i)) := by
              congr 1
              rw [Algebra.smul_def, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L]
              rfl
  have hP : P = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hg]
    exact Submodule.span_le.mpr hgP
  have hdmem : d ∈ Submodule.traceDual A K (1 : Submodule B L) := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_traceDual]
    intro z hz
    rw [Submodule.mem_one] at hz
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hz
    have hbP : b ∈ P := by rw [hP]; exact Submodule.mem_top
    change ℓ b ∈ (1 : Submodule A K) at hbP
    change Algebra.traceForm K L d
      ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L).toLinearMap b) ∈ (1 : Submodule A K) at hbP
    have htrace :
        Algebra.traceForm K L d (algebraMap B L b) ∈ (1 : Submodule A K) := by
      simpa only [AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply] using hbP
    exact Submodule.mem_one.mp htrace
  have hsne : (s : A) ≠ 0 := mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp s.property
  have hdne : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hd
    apply hsne
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    apply (algebraMap K L).injective
    simpa only [map_zero, d, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L] using hd
  intro hbot
  rw [hbot] at hdmem
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hdmem
  exact hdne hdmem

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.traceDual_traceDual_one_eq_one_of_finite
statement:
theorem traceDual_traceDual_one_eq_one_of_finite :
    Submodule.traceDual A K
      (Submodule.traceDual A K (1 : Submodule B L)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let I : Submodule B L := Submodule.traceDual A K (1 : Submodule B L)
  let : Module.Finite B I := traceDual_one_finite (A := A) (K := K) (L := L)
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊥ := traceDual_one_ne_bot (A := A) (K := K) (L := L)
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    have hstable : ∀ i ∈ I, z • i ∈ I := by
      intro i hi
      rw [Submodule.mem_traceDual]
      intro a ha
      rw [Submodule.mem_one] at ha
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := ha
      rw [Submodule.mem_traceDual] at hz
      have hri : r • (i : L) ∈ I := I.smul_mem r hi
      have htrace := hz (r • (i : L)) hri
      simpa only [Algebra.traceForm_apply, Algebra.smul_def,
        Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using htrace
    have hzIntegral : IsIntegral B z :=
      isIntegral_of_smul_mem_submodule I hIne
        (Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp inferInstance) z hstable
    rw [Submodule.mem_one]
    exact IsIntegrallyClosedIn.isIntegral_iff.mp hzIntegral
  · exact Submodule.le_traceDual_traceDual

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_integralClosure_factor_of_mul_eq_mul_of_isRegular
statement:
theorem exists_integralClosure_factor_of_mul_eq_mul_of_isRegular
    {x y : A} (hregular : IsRegular A [x, y])
    {b c : B}
    (hbc : algebraMap A B y * b = algebraMap A B x * c) :
    ∃ d : B, b = algebraMap A B x * d
proof:
:= by
  have hpair := (isRegular_cons_iff A x [y]).mp hregular
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hxzero
    exact one_ne_zero (hpair.1.right_eq_zero_of_smul (by simp [hxzero]))
  have hxK : algebraMap A K x ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (IsFractionRing.injective A K).ne hx
  have hxL : algebraMap A L x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L]
    simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap K L).injective.ne hxK
  have hyRegular : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop x A) y :=
    ((isRegular_cons_iff (QuotSMulTop x A) y []).mp hpair.2).1
  have hbcL : algebraMap A L y * (b : L) = algebraMap A L x * (c : L) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hbc
  let z : L := (b : L) / algebraMap A L x
  have hxz : algebraMap A L x * z = (b : L) := by
    dsimp [z]
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    calc
      algebraMap A L x * ((b : L) * (algebraMap A L x)⁻¹) =
          (b : L) * (algebraMap A L x * (algebraMap A L x)⁻¹) := by
            ac_rfl
      _ = (b : L) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hxL, mul_one]
  have hyz : algebraMap A L y * z = (c : L) := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hxL
    calc
      algebraMap A L x * (algebraMap A L y * z) =
          algebraMap A L y * (algebraMap A L x * z) := by ac_rfl
      _ = algebraMap A L y * (b : L) := by rw [hxz]
      _ = algebraMap A L x * (c : L) := hbcL
  let I : Submodule B L := Submodule.traceDual A K (1 : Submodule B L)
  have hzDual : z ∈ Submodule.traceDual A K I := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_traceDual]
    intro i hi
    let q : K := Algebra.traceForm K L z i
    have hbi : Algebra.traceForm K L i (b : L) ∈ (algebraMap A K).range := by
      rw [Submodule.mem_traceDual] at hi
      exact hi (b : L) (Submodule.mem_one.mpr ⟨b, rfl⟩)
    have hci : Algebra.traceForm K L i (c : L) ∈ (algebraMap A K).range := by
      rw [Submodule.mem_traceDual] at hi
      exact hi (c : L) (Submodule.mem_one.mpr ⟨c, rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hbi
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hci
    have hbx : (b : L) = algebraMap A K x • z := by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L]
      exact hxz.symm
    have hcy : (c : L) = algebraMap A K y • z := by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L]
      exact hyz.symm
    have huq : algebraMap A K u = algebraMap A K x * q := by
      calc
        algebraMap A K u = Algebra.traceForm K L i (b : L) := hu
        _ = Algebra.traceForm K L i (algebraMap A K x • z) := by rw [← hbx]
        _ = algebraMap A K x • Algebra.traceForm K L i z := by rw [map_smul]
        _ = algebraMap A K x * q := by
          simp only [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply, q,
            Algebra.traceForm_apply, mul_comm]
    have hvq : algebraMap A K v = algebraMap A K y * q := by
      calc
        algebraMap A K v = Algebra.traceForm K L i (c : L) := hv
        _ = Algebra.traceForm K L i (algebraMap A K y • z) := by rw [← hcy]
        _ = algebraMap A K y • Algebra.traceForm K L i z := by rw [map_smul]
        _ = algebraMap A K y * q := by
          simp only [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply, q,
            Algebra.traceForm_apply, mul_comm]
    have hyuxv : y * u = x * v := by
      apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, huq, hvq]
      simp only [mul_left_comm]
    have hyuMem : y • u ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule A A) := by
      rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
      refine ⟨v, Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hyuxv.symm
    have huMem : u ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule A A) :=
      (isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem
        (x • (⊤ : Submodule A A)) y).mp hyRegular u hyuMem
    obtain ⟨w, -, hwu⟩ :=
      (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).mp huMem
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hwu
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hxK
    calc
      algebraMap A K x * algebraMap A K w = algebraMap A K (x * w) := by rw [map_mul]
      _ = algebraMap A K u := by rw [hwu]
      _ = algebraMap A K x * q := huq
  have hzOne : z ∈ (1 : Submodule B L) := by
    rw [← traceDual_traceDual_one_eq_one_of_finite (A := A) (K := K) (L := L)]
    exact hzDual
  rw [Submodule.mem_one] at hzOne
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hzOne
  refine ⟨d, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  change (b : L) = algebraMap A L x * algebraMap B L d
  rw [hd]
  exact hxz.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_integralClosure_factor_of_mul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem exists_integralClosure_factor_of_mul_eq_mul
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]
    {x y : A} (hxPrime : Prime x) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hxy : IsRelPrime x y)
    {b c : integralClosure A L}
    (hbc : algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) y * b =
      algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) x * c) :
    ∃ d : integralClosure A L,
      b = algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) x * d
proof:
:= by
  have hmap_ne_zero : ∀ {a : A}, a ≠ 0 → algebraMap A L a ≠ 0 := by
    intro a ha hazero
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L] at hazero
    have hazeroK : algebraMap A K a = 0 := by
      apply (algebraMap K L).injective
      simpa using hazero
    apply ha
    apply IsFractionRing.injective A K
    simpa using hazeroK
  have hxL : algebraMap A L x ≠ 0 := hmap_ne_zero hx
  have hyL : algebraMap A L y ≠ 0 := hmap_ne_zero hy
  have hnotdvd : ¬ x ∣ y := by
    intro hdiv
    exact hxPrime.not_isUnit (hxy (dvd_refl x) hdiv)
  let z : L := (b : L) / algebraMap A L x
  have hz : IsIntegral A z := by
    apply isIntegral_of_isIntegral_localizationAway_pair_of_prime
      (K := K) hxPrime hy hnotdvd
    · let Aₓ := Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers x)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx))
      let : Algebra Aₓ L :=
        ((algebraMap K L).comp Aₓ.val).toAlgebra
      have hbase :
          (algebraMap Aₓ L).comp (algebraMap A Aₓ) =
            (RingHom.id L).comp (algebraMap A L) := by
        ext a
        change algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K a) = algebraMap A L a
        exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L a).symm
      let xinv : Aₓ :=
        ⟨(algebraMap A K x)⁻¹, by
          change ∃ (a s : A) (_ : s ∈ Submonoid.powers x),
            (algebraMap A K x)⁻¹ =
              algebraMap A K a * (algebraMap A K s)⁻¹
          exact ⟨1, x, Submonoid.mem_powers x, by rw [map_one, one_mul]⟩⟩
      have hbInt : IsIntegral Aₓ (b : L) :=
        b.2.map_of_comp_eq (algebraMap A Aₓ) (RingHom.id L) hbase
      have hlocal : IsIntegral Aₓ
          (algebraMap Aₓ L xinv * (b : L)) :=
        isIntegral_algebraMap.mul hbInt
      have hxinvL : algebraMap Aₓ L xinv = (algebraMap A L x)⁻¹ := by
        change algebraMap K L ((algebraMap A K x)⁻¹) =
          (algebraMap A L x)⁻¹
        rw [map_inv₀, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L]
      have hzx : z = algebraMap Aₓ L xinv * (b : L) := by
        rw [hxinvL]
        dsimp [z]
        simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
      rw [hzx]
      exact hlocal
    · let Aᵧ := Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers y)
        (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy))
      let : Algebra Aᵧ L :=
        ((algebraMap K L).comp Aᵧ.val).toAlgebra
      have hbase :
          (algebraMap Aᵧ L).comp (algebraMap A Aᵧ) =
            (RingHom.id L).comp (algebraMap A L) := by
        ext a
        change algebraMap K L (algebraMap A K a) = algebraMap A L a
        exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L a).symm
      let yinv : Aᵧ :=
        ⟨(algebraMap A K y)⁻¹, by
          change ∃ (a s : A) (_ : s ∈ Submonoid.powers y),
            (algebraMap A K y)⁻¹ =
              algebraMap A K a * (algebraMap A K s)⁻¹
          exact ⟨1, y, Submonoid.mem_powers y, by rw [map_one, one_mul]⟩⟩
      have hcInt : IsIntegral Aᵧ (c : L) :=
        c.2.map_of_comp_eq (algebraMap A Aᵧ) (RingHom.id L) hbase
      have hlocal : IsIntegral Aᵧ
          (algebraMap Aᵧ L yinv * (c : L)) :=
        isIntegral_algebraMap.mul hcInt
      have hyinvL : algebraMap Aᵧ L yinv = (algebraMap A L y)⁻¹ := by
        change algebraMap K L ((algebraMap A K y)⁻¹) =
          (algebraMap A L y)⁻¹
        rw [map_inv₀, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L]
      have hzy : z = algebraMap Aᵧ L yinv * (c : L) := by
        rw [hyinvL]
        dsimp [z]
        rw [show (algebraMap A L y)⁻¹ * (c : L) =
          (c : L) / algebraMap A L y by
            simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]]
        have hbcL : algebraMap A L y * (b : L) =
            algebraMap A L x * (c : L) := by
          exact congrArg Subtype.val hbc
        apply (div_eq_div_iff hxL hyL).2
        simpa [mul_comm] using hbcL
      rw [hzy]
      exact hlocal
  let d : integralClosure A L := ⟨z, hz⟩
  refine ⟨d, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  change (b : L) = algebraMap A L x * z
  dsimp [z]
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  symm
  calc
    algebraMap A L x * ((b : L) * (algebraMap A L x)⁻¹) =
        (b : L) * (algebraMap A L x * (algebraMap A L x)⁻¹) := by
          ac_rfl
    _ = (b : L) := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hxL, mul_one]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSMulRegular_quotSMulTop_integralClosure_of_isRelPrime
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_quotSMulTop_integralClosure_of_isRelPrime
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]
    {x y : A} (hxPrime : Prime x) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hxy : IsRelPrime x y) :
    IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop x (integralClosure A L)) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem]
  intro b hb
  rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists] at hb ⊢
  obtain ⟨c, -, hcb⟩ := hb
  have hbc : algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) y * b =
      algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) x * c := by
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using hcb.symm
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ :=
    exists_integralClosure_factor_of_mul_eq_mul
      (K := K) hxPrime hx hy hxy hbc
  refine ⟨d, Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using hd.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isSMulRegular_quotSMulTop_integralClosure_of_isRegular
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_quotSMulTop_integralClosure_of_isRegular
    {A : Type u} {K : Type v} {L : Type w}
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    [Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)]
    {x y : A} (hregular : IsRegular A [x, y]) :
    IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop x (integralClosure A L)) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSMulRegular_quotient_iff_mem_of_smul_mem]
  intro b hb
  rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists] at hb ⊢
  obtain ⟨c, -, hcb⟩ := hb
  have hbc : algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) y * b =
      algebraMap A (integralClosure A L) x * c := by
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using hcb.symm
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ :=
    exists_integralClosure_factor_of_mul_eq_mul_of_isRegular
      (K := K) hregular hbc
  refine ⟨d, Submodule.mem_top, ?_⟩
  simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using hd.symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etale_of_localization_awayMap_of_isUnit_image
statement:
theorem etale_of_localization_awayMap_of_isUnit_image
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (f : A) (hfB : IsUnit (algebraMap A B f))
    (hAway : (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f).Etale) :
    Algebra.Etale A B
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let fB : B := algebraMap A B f
  let T := Localization.Away fB
  let mapST : S →+* T := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f
  let : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B T := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A S T := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro a
    change algebraMap A T a = mapST (algebraMap A S a)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B T]
    simp [mapST, S, T, fB, IsLocalization.Away.map]
  let : Algebra.Etale S T := hAway.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra.Etale A S := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway f
  let : Algebra.Etale A T := Algebra.Etale.comp A S T
  let eTarget : T ≃ₐ[B] B :=
    (IsLocalization.atUnit B T fB hfB).symm
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_equiv (eTarget.restrictScalars A)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_awayMap_etale_of_etale_localizationsAtPrime
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_etale_of_etale_localizationsAtPrime
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation A B]
    (f : A)
    (hlocal : ∀ (Q : Ideal B), [Q.IsPrime] →
      algebraMap A B f ∉ Q →
      let p := Q.under A
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
        Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p Q
      Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q)) :
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let fB : B := algebraMap A B f
  let T := Localization.Away fB
  let mapST : S →+* T := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f
  have hAT : Algebra.Etale A T := by
    apply Algebra.basicOpen_subset_etaleLocus_iff_etale.mp
    intro Q hQ
    let p := Q.asIdeal.under A
    let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p Q.asIdeal
    let : Algebra.Etale (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal) :=
      hlocal Q.asIdeal ((PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen _ _).mp hQ)
    let : Algebra.FormallyEtale A (Localization.AtPrime p) :=
      Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization p.primeCompl
    change Algebra.FormallyEtale A (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal)
    exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp A (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal)
  let : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B T := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A S T := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro a
    change algebraMap A T a = mapST (algebraMap A S a)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B T]
    simp [mapST, S, T, fB, IsLocalization.Away.map]
  let : Algebra.Etale A S := Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway f
  let : Algebra.Etale A T := hAT
  exact Algebra.Etale.of_restrictScalars A S T

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_awayMap_etale_of_local_awayMapsAtPrime
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_etale_of_local_awayMapsAtPrime
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation A B]
    (f : A)
    (hlocal : ∀ (Q : Ideal B), [Q.IsPrime] →
      algebraMap A B f ∉ Q →
      let p := Q.under A
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
        Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p Q
      let fp : Localization.AtPrime p :=
        algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p) f
      (Localization.awayMap
        (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q))
        fp).Etale) :
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f).Etale
proof:
:= by
  apply localization_awayMap_etale_of_etale_localizationsAtPrime f
  intro Q _ hfQ
  let p := Q.under A
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
    Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p Q
  let fp : Localization.AtPrime p :=
    algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p) f
  apply etale_of_localization_awayMap_of_isUnit_image fp
  · have hunit :
        IsUnit (algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime Q)
          (algebraMap A B f)) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.AtPrime Q)
        (M := Q.primeCompl) ⟨algebraMap A B f, hfQ⟩
    have hEq :
        algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q) fp =
          algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime Q) (algebraMap A B f) := by
      dsimp only [fp]
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (Localization.AtPrime Q),
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B (Localization.AtPrime Q)]
    rw [hEq]
    exact hunit
  · exact hlocal Q hfQ

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ringHom_localization_awayMap_etale_of_local_awayMapsAtPrime
statement:
theorem ringHom_localization_awayMap_etale_of_local_awayMapsAtPrime
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (mapAB : A →+* B) (hfp : mapAB.FinitePresentation)
    (f : A)
    (hlocal :
      letI : Algebra A B := mapAB.toAlgebra
      ∀ (Q : Ideal B), [Q.IsPrime] →
        mapAB f ∉ Q →
        let p := Q.under A
        letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
          Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p Q
        let fp : Localization.AtPrime p :=
          algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p) f
        (Localization.awayMap
          (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q))
          fp).Etale) :
    (Localization.awayMap mapAB f).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra A B := mapAB.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation A B := hfp
  exact localization_awayMap_etale_of_local_awayMapsAtPrime f hlocal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_awayMap_etale_of_algEquiv
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_etale_of_algEquiv
    {A : Type uA} {D₀ : Type uD₀} {D₁ : Type uD₁}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing D₀] [CommRing D₁]
    [Algebra A D₀] [Algebra A D₁]
    (E : D₀ ≃ₐ[A] D₁) (f : A)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D₀) f).Etale) :
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D₁) f).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let dAlgebra : Algebra D₀ D₁ := E.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A D₀ D₁ :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
      E.toAlgHom.comp_algebraMap.symm
  let : Algebra.IsPushout A D₀ A D₁ :=
    Algebra.IsPushout.of_bijective_right D₀ D₁ E.bijective
  simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply] using
    (localization_awayMap_etale_of_isPushout
      (A := A) (B := D₀) (C := A) (D := D₁) f hAway)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_awayMap_etale_of_source_algEquiv
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_etale_of_source_algEquiv
    {A : Type uA} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD₀}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra A C] [Algebra A D] [Algebra C D] [IsScalarTower A C D]
    (E : A ≃ₐ[A] C) (f : A)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap C D) (algebraMap A C f)).Etale) :
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D) f).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra C A := E.symm.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower C A D := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    ext x
    change algebraMap C D x = algebraMap A D (E.symm x)
    have hE : algebraMap A C (E.symm x) = E (E.symm x) := by
      simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply] using
        (E.commutes (E.symm x)).symm
    calc
      algebraMap C D x =
          algebraMap C D (algebraMap A C (E.symm x)) :=
        congrArg (algebraMap C D) (hE.trans (E.apply_symm_apply x)).symm
      _ = algebraMap A D (E.symm x) :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C D (E.symm x)).symm
  let : Algebra.IsPushout C D A D :=
    Algebra.IsPushout.of_bijective_left A D E.symm.bijective
  have hBack := localization_awayMap_etale_of_isPushout
    (A := C) (B := D) (C := A) (D := D) (algebraMap A C f) hAway
  have hf : algebraMap C A (algebraMap A C f) = f := by
    change E.symm (algebraMap A C f) = f
    have hE : E f = algebraMap A C f := by
      simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply] using E.commutes f
    rw [← hE, E.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [hf] at hBack
  exact hBack

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_awayMap_etale_of_tower_algEquiv
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_etale_of_tower_algEquiv
    {A : Type uA} {C : Type uC}
    {D₀ : Type uD₀} {D₁ : Type uD₁}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [CommRing D₀] [CommRing D₁]
    [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra C D₀] [Algebra C D₁]
    [Algebra A D₀] [Algebra A D₁]
    [IsScalarTower A C D₀] [IsScalarTower A C D₁]
    (E : D₀ ≃ₐ[C] D₁) (f : A)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D₀) f).Etale) :
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A D₁) f).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let Ebase : D₀ ≃ₐ[A] D₁ := E.restrictScalars A
  exact localization_awayMap_etale_of_algEquiv Ebase f hAway

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_awayMap_etale_of_isPushout
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_etale_of_isPushout
    {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C]
    [Algebra A D] [Algebra B D] [Algebra C D]
    [IsScalarTower A B D] [IsScalarTower A C D]
    [Algebra.IsPushout A B C D]
    (f : A)
    (hAway :
      (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f).Etale) :
    (Localization.awayMap
      (algebraMap C D) (algebraMap A C f)).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let fB : B := algebraMap A B f
  let fC : C := algebraMap A C f
  let fD : D := algebraMap C D fC
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let T := Localization.Away fB
  let U := Localization.Away fC
  let V := Localization.Away fD
  let : IsScalarTower A B T := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let mapST : S →+* T :=
    Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f
  let : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A S T :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ by
      change algebraMap A T a = mapST (algebraMap A S a)
      rw [show mapST (algebraMap A S a) =
          algebraMap B T (algebraMap A B a) by
        simp only [mapST, T, fB, IsLocalization.Away.map, IsLocalization.map_eq]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B T a
  let : IsScalarTower A C U := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hlocU : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C (Submonoid.powers f)) U := by
    change IsLocalization
      ((Submonoid.powers f).map (algebraMap A C)) U
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
    exact Localization.isLocalization
  let mapSU : S →+* U :=
    Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A C) f
  let : Algebra S U := mapSU.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A S U :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ by
      change algebraMap A U a = mapSU (algebraMap A S a)
      rw [show mapSU (algebraMap A S a) =
          algebraMap C U (algebraMap A C a) by
        simp only [mapSU, U, fC, IsLocalization.Away.map, IsLocalization.map_eq]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C U a
  let : IsScalarTower B D V := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hfBD : algebraMap B D fB = fD := by
    calc
      algebraMap B D fB = algebraMap A D f :=
        (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B D f).symm
      _ = algebraMap C D fC :=
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C D f
      _ = fD := rfl
  have hlocVFromB : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid D (Submonoid.powers fB)) V := by
    change IsLocalization
      ((Submonoid.powers fB).map (algebraMap B D)) V
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers, hfBD]
    exact Localization.isLocalization
  let : Algebra T V :=
    localizationAlgebra (Submonoid.powers fB) D
  let : IsScalarTower B T V :=
    isScalarTower_localizationAlgebra
      (Submonoid.powers fB) D
  let : IsScalarTower C D V := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hlocVFromC : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid D (Submonoid.powers fC)) V := by
    change IsLocalization
      ((Submonoid.powers fC).map (algebraMap C D)) V
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
    change IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers fD) V
    exact Localization.isLocalization
  let mapUV : U →+* V :=
    Localization.awayMap (algebraMap C D) fC
  let : Algebra U V := mapUV.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower C U V :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ by
      change algebraMap C V c = mapUV (algebraMap C U c)
      rw [show mapUV (algebraMap C U c) =
          algebraMap D V (algebraMap C D c) by
        simp only [mapUV, V, fD, IsLocalization.Away.map, IsLocalization.map_eq]]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C D V c
  let : IsScalarTower A D V := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A T V :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ by
      calc
        algebraMap A V a = algebraMap D V (algebraMap A D a) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A D V a
        _ = algebraMap D V (algebraMap B D (algebraMap A B a)) := by
          rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B D]
        _ = algebraMap B V (algebraMap A B a) := by
          rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B D V]
        _ = algebraMap T V (algebraMap B T (algebraMap A B a)) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B T V (algebraMap A B a)
        _ = algebraMap T V (algebraMap A T a) := by
          rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B T]
  let : IsScalarTower A U V :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ by
      calc
        algebraMap A V a = algebraMap D V (algebraMap A D a) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A D V a
        _ = algebraMap D V (algebraMap C D (algebraMap A C a)) := by
          rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C D]
        _ = algebraMap C V (algebraMap A C a) := by
          rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C D V]
        _ = algebraMap U V (algebraMap C U (algebraMap A C a)) :=
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C U V (algebraMap A C a)
        _ = algebraMap U V (algebraMap A U a) := by
          rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A C U]
  let : Algebra S V :=
    ((algebraMap T V).comp (algebraMap S T)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower S T V := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A S V := IsScalarTower.to₁₂₄ A S T V
  let : IsScalarTower S U V := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers f)
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A S V, RingHom.comp_assoc,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A S U,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A U V]
  have hBLocalization : Algebra.IsPushout B T D V :=
    (Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization
      (Submonoid.powers fB) T D V).symm
  have hBig : Algebra.IsPushout A T C V :=
    (Algebra.IsPushout.comp_iff A B C D).2 hBLocalization
  have hCLocalization : Algebra.IsPushout A S C U :=
    (Algebra.isPushout_of_isLocalization
      (Submonoid.powers f) S C U).symm
  have hAwayPushout : Algebra.IsPushout S T U V :=
    (Algebra.IsPushout.comp_iff A S C U).1 hBig
  let e : U ⊗[S] T ≃ₐ[U] V :=
    Algebra.IsPushout.equiv (h := hAwayPushout.symm) S U T V
  have hST : Algebra.Etale S T := hAway.toAlgebra
  have hBaseChange : Algebra.Etale U (U ⊗[S] T) :=
    Algebra.Etale.baseChange (R := S) (A := T) (B := U)
  have hUV : Algebra.Etale U V := Algebra.Etale.of_equiv e
  change mapUV.Etale
  exact hUV

statement:
theorem etale_of_isEtaleAt_all_primeIdeals
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R S]
    (hlocal : ∀ (Q : Ideal S), [Q.IsPrime] → Algebra.IsEtaleAt R Q) :
    Algebra.Etale R S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_univ_iff_etale]
  apply Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr
  intro Q
  change Algebra.IsEtaleAt R Q.asIdeal
  exact hlocal Q.asIdeal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.etale_of_isEtaleAt_all_maximalIdeals
statement:
theorem etale_of_isEtaleAt_all_maximalIdeals
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R S]
    (hlocal : ∀ (Q : Ideal S), [Q.IsMaximal] → Algebra.IsEtaleAt R Q) :
    Algebra.Etale R S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Algebra.etaleLocus_eq_univ_iff_etale]
  apply Set.eq_univ_iff_forall.mpr
  intro q
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hqQ⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal q.asIdeal q.isPrime.ne_top
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQ.isPrime
  let Q' : PrimeSpectrum S := ⟨Q, inferInstance⟩
  have hQ' : Q' ∈ Algebra.etaleLocus R S := by
    change Algebra.IsEtaleAt R Q
    exact hlocal Q
  exact Algebra.isOpen_etaleLocus.stableUnderGeneralization
    ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes q Q').mp hqQ) hQ'

    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R S]
    (hlocal : ∀ (Q : Ideal S), [Q.IsPrime] →
      let p := Q.under R
      letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
        Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p Q
      Algebra.FormallyEtale (Localization.AtPrime p)
        (Localization.AtPrime Q)) :
    Algebra.Etale R S
proof:

  intro Q _
  let p := Q.under R
  let : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=

  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (Localization.AtPrime Q) := hlocal Q
  let : Algebra.FormallyEtale R (Localization.AtPrime p) :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization p.primeCompl
  exact Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp R (Localization.AtPrime p)
    (Localization.AtPrime Q)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localization_awayMap_etale_of_formallyEtale_localizationsAtPrime_all_maximalIdeals
statement:
theorem localization_awayMap_etale_of_formallyEtale_localizationsAtPrime_all_maximalIdeals
    {A : Type uR} {B : Type uS}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B]
    (f : A)
    (hlocal :
      let S := Localization.Away f
      let fB := algebraMap A B f
      let T := Localization.Away fB
      let mapST : S →+* T := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f
      letI : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
      ∀ (Q : Ideal T), [Q.IsMaximal] →
        let p := Q.under S
        letI : Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
          Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p Q
        Algebra.FormallyEtale (Localization.AtPrime p)
          (Localization.AtPrime Q)) :
    (Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f).Etale
proof:
:= by
  let S := Localization.Away f
  let fB : B := algebraMap A B f
  let T := Localization.Away fB
  let mapST : S →+* T := Localization.awayMap (algebraMap A B) f
  let : Algebra S T := mapST.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower A B T := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : IsScalarTower A S T := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro a
    change algebraMap A T a = mapST (algebraMap A S a)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B T]
    simp [mapST, S, T, fB, IsLocalization.Away.map]
  let : Module.Finite S T :=
    Module.Finite.of_isLocalization A B (Submonoid.powers f)
  let : Module.FinitePresentation S T :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite S T
  let : Algebra.FinitePresentation S T :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finitePresentation S T
  exact ringHom_etale_of_formallyEtale_localizationsAtPrime_all_maximalIdeals
    mapST (by
      change Algebra.FinitePresentation S T
      infer_instance) hlocal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isFiniteEtale_sigmaDesc_walkingPair
statement:
private lemma isFiniteEtale_sigmaDesc_walkingPair {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (Y : WalkingPair → Scheme.{u})
    (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ T) (hf : ∀ i, IsFiniteEtale (f i)) :
    IsFiniteEtale (Sigma.desc f)
proof:
:= by
  let b : Cofan Y := Cofan.mk (Y .left ⨿ Y .right) fun
    | .left => coprod.inl
    | .right => coprod.inr
  let hb : IsColimit b := Cofan.IsColimit.mk b
    (fun t => coprod.desc (t.inj .left) (t.inj .right))
    (by
      intro t j
      cases j
      · exact coprod.inl_desc _ _
      · exact coprod.inr_desc _ _)
    (by
      intro t m hm
      apply coprod.hom_ext
      · rw [coprod.inl_desc]
        exact hm .left
      · rw [coprod.inr_desc]
        exact hm .right)
  let hSigma : IsColimit (Sigma.cocone (Discrete.functor Y)) :=
    coproductIsCoproduct' (Discrete.functor Y)
  let e : (∐ Y) ≅ Y .left ⨿ Y .right :=
    hSigma.coconePointUniqueUpToIso hb
  have he_fac (j : WalkingPair) : Sigma.ι Y j ≫ e.hom = b.inj j := by
    dsimp only [e]
    exact IsColimit.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom hSigma hb ⟨j⟩
  have heq : Sigma.desc f = e.hom ≫ coprod.desc (f .left) (f .right) := by
    apply Sigma.hom_ext
    intro j
    cases j
    · rw [Sigma.ι_comp_desc]
      rw [← Category.assoc, he_fac]
      change f .left = coprod.inl ≫ coprod.desc (f .left) (f .right)
      exact (coprod.inl_desc _ _).symm
    · rw [Sigma.ι_comp_desc]
      rw [← Category.assoc, he_fac]
      change f .right = coprod.inr ≫ coprod.desc (f .left) (f .right)
      exact (coprod.inr_desc _ _).symm
  let : IsFiniteEtale (f .left) := hf .left
  let : IsFiniteEtale (f .right) := hf .right
  let : IsFinite (Sigma.desc f) := by
    rw [heq]
    infer_instance
  let : Etale (Sigma.desc f) :=
    IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc fun i => by
      let : IsFiniteEtale (f i) := hf i
      infer_instance
  exact .mk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isFiniteEtale_sigmaDesc_empty
statement:
private lemma isFiniteEtale_sigmaDesc_empty {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (Y : PEmpty.{v + 1} → Scheme.{u}) [Small.{u} PEmpty.{v + 1}]
    (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ T) :
    IsFiniteEtale (Sigma.desc f)
proof:
:= by
  let b : Cofan Y := Cofan.mk (∅ : Scheme.{u}) fun i => i.elim
  let hb : IsColimit b :=
    (isColimitEquivIsInitialOfIsEmpty Scheme b).symm emptyIsInitial
  let hSigma : IsColimit (Sigma.cocone (Discrete.functor Y)) :=
    coproductIsCoproduct' (Discrete.functor Y)
  let e : (∐ Y) ≅ (∅ : Scheme.{u}) :=
    hSigma.coconePointUniqueUpToIso hb
  have heq : Sigma.desc f = e.hom ≫ Scheme.emptyTo T := by
    apply Sigma.hom_ext
    intro i
    exact i.elim
  let : IsFinite (Sigma.desc f) := by
    rw [heq]
    infer_instance
  let : Etale (Sigma.desc f) :=
    IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc fun i => i.elim
  exact .mk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.tensorProductToResidueField_surjective_of_isArtinian
statement:

    (t : ↑(pullback f g))

proof:

    let : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (X.residueField T.x) :=
      (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hx).inv ≫
        f.residueFieldMap T.x).hom).toAlgebra
    let : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (Y.residueField T.y) :=

        g.residueFieldMap T.y).hom).toAlgebra
    Function.Surjective (tensorProductToResidueField t) := by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.Triplet.tensorInl_tensorIsoTensorProduct_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem tensorInl_tensorIsoTensorProduct_hom (T : Triplet f g) :
    letI : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (X.residueField T.x)
proof:
:=
      (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hx).inv ≫
        f.residueFieldMap T.x).hom).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (Y.residueField T.y) :=
      (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hy).inv ≫
        g.residueFieldMap T.y).hom).toAlgebra
    T.tensorInl ≫ (tensorIsoTensorProduct T).hom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom
        (R := S.residueField T.s) (A := X.residueField T.x)
        (B := Y.residueField T.y)) := by
  let : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (X.residueField T.x) :=
    (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hx).inv ≫
      f.residueFieldMap T.x).hom).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (Y.residueField T.y) :=
    (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hy).inv ≫
      g.residueFieldMap T.y).hom).toAlgebra
  exact IsPushout.inl_isoIsPushout_hom
    (X.residueField T.x) (Y.residueField T.y)
    (IsPushout.of_hasPushout _ _)
    (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct
      (S.residueField T.s) (X.residueField T.x)
      (Y.residueField T.y))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.Triplet.tensorInr_tensorIsoTensorProduct_hom

theorem tensorInr_tensorIsoTensorProduct_hom (T : Triplet f g) :

    letI : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (Y.residueField T.y) :=
