    T.tensorInr ≫ (tensorIsoTensorProduct T).hom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
        (R := S.residueField T.s) (A := X.residueField T.x)
        (B := Y.residueField T.y)).toRingHom) := by
  let : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (X.residueField T.x) :=
    (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hx).inv ≫
      f.residueFieldMap T.x).hom).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (S.residueField T.s) (Y.residueField T.y) :=
    (((S.residueFieldCongr T.hy).inv ≫
      g.residueFieldMap T.y).hom).toAlgebra
  exact IsPushout.inr_isoIsPushout_hom
    (X.residueField T.x) (Y.residueField T.y)
    (IsPushout.of_hasPushout _ _)
    (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct
      (S.residueField T.s) (X.residueField T.x)
      (Y.residueField T.y))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.ofPointTensor_SpecTensorTo_surjective
statement:
private theorem ofPointTensor_SpecTensorTo_surjective
    (T : Triplet f g) (p : Spec T.tensor)
    [IsArtinianRing T.tensor] :
    Function.Surjective (ofPointTensor (T.SpecTensorTo p))
proof:
:= by
  let : p.asIdeal.IsPrime := p.isPrime
  let : p.asIdeal.IsMaximal :=
    IsArtinianRing.isMaximal_of_isPrime p.asIdeal
  let e :=
    (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso T.tensor p).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let q : T.tensor ⟶ (Spec T.tensor).residueField p :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap T.tensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≫
      (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso T.tensor p).inv
  have hq : Function.Surjective q := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
      p.asIdeal.algebraMap_residueField_surjective (e z)
    refine ⟨a, e.injective ?_⟩
    change e (e.symm (algebraMap T.tensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField a)) = e z
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, ha]
  let c := (Triplet.tensorCongr (T.ofPoint_SpecTensorTo p).symm).hom
  let a := ofPointTensor (T.SpecTensorTo p)
  let r := Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap T.SpecTensorTo p
  have hmap : c ≫ a ≫ r = q := by
    rw [← Spec.map_inj]
    rw [Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_comp]
    change Spec.map r ≫ Spec.map a ≫ Spec.map c = Spec.map q
    rw [Triplet.Spec_ofPointTensor_SpecTensorTo]
    rw [← Scheme.Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField]
    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hq (r z)
  refine ⟨c x, r.hom.injective ?_⟩
  have hcx := DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hmap) x
  change r (a (c x)) = q x at hcx
  exact hcx.trans hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.ofPointTensor_surjective_of_isArtinian
statement:
theorem ofPointTensor_surjective_of_isArtinian
    (t : ↑(pullback f g))
    [IsArtinianRing (Triplet.ofPoint t).tensor] :
    Function.Surjective (ofPointTensor t)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ofPointTensor_SpecTensorTo_surjective
    (Triplet.ofPoint t) (SpecOfPoint t)
  rw [SpecTensorTo_SpecOfPoint] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.Triplet.tensor_isArtinian_of_finiteDimensional_left
statement:
theorem Triplet.tensor_isArtinian_of_finiteDimensional_left
    [FiniteDimensional (S.residueField T.s) (X.residueField T.x)] :
    IsArtinianRing T.tensor
proof:
:= by
  let E := X.residueField T.x ⊗[S.residueField T.s]
    Y.residueField T.y
  let : Algebra (Y.residueField T.y) E :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let : Module.Finite (Y.residueField T.y)
      (Y.residueField T.y ⊗[S.residueField T.s]
        X.residueField T.x) :=
    Module.Finite.base_change
      (S.residueField T.s) (Y.residueField T.y)
      (X.residueField T.x)
  let : Module.Finite (Y.residueField T.y) E :=
    Module.Finite.equiv
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight
        (S.residueField T.s) (Y.residueField T.y)
        (X.residueField T.x)).toLinearEquiv
  let : IsArtinianRing E := IsArtinianRing.of_finite
    (Y.residueField T.y) E
  exact
    (T.tensorIsoTensorProduct.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm).isArtinianRing

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.exists_idempotent_ker_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra A B := f.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R A B := .of_algebraMap_eq' f.comp_algebraMap.symm
  have hfe : Algebra.FormallyEtale A B :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_restrictScalars (R := R)
  have hker : IsIdempotentElem (RingHom.ker f.toRingHom) :=
    (Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_of_surjective (R := A) (S := B)
      (show Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B) from hf)).mp hfe
  exact (Ideal.isIdempotentElem_iff_of_fg _
    (Algebra.FinitePresentation.ker_fG_of_surjective f hf)).mp hker

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.exists_lift_section_of_finite_henselian_base
statement:
theorem exists_lift_section_of_finite_henselian_base
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} {C : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C] [Algebra B C] [IsScalarTower R B C]
    [Module.Finite R B] [Module.Finite B C] [Algebra.Etale B C]
    (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I]
    (σ : C →ₐ[B] B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B)) :
    ∃ g : C →ₐ[B] B,
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ B (I.map (algebraMap R B))).comp g = σ
proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  let K : Ideal C := J.map (algebraMap B C)
  let Q := B ⧸ J
  let C₀ := C ⧸ K
  have hK : K = I.map (algebraMap R C) := by
    dsimp [K, J]
    rw [Ideal.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R B C]
  let : Module.Finite R C := Module.Finite.trans B C
  let : Algebra.Etale Q C₀ :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_equiv (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor C J).symm
  let θ : C₀ →ₐ[Q] Q := AlgHom.quotientSection J σ
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hker⟩ := exists_idempotent_ker_of_surjective θ
    (AlgHom.quotientSection_surjective J σ)
  have hkθ : θ k = 0 := by
    change k ∈ RingHom.ker θ.toRingHom
    rw [hker]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self k
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (1 - k)
  have hbid : IsIdempotentElem (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R C)) b) := by
    rw [← hK, hb]
    exact hk.one_sub
  obtain ⟨e, he, heq⟩ := Algebra.exists_idempotent_lift_of_isIntegral I b hbid
  have hebar : Ideal.Quotient.mk K e = 1 - k := by
    have h : Ideal.Quotient.mk K e = Ideal.Quotient.mk K b := by
      rw [hK]
      exact heq
    exact h.trans hb
  have hσe : σ e = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg θ hebar
    change σ e = θ (1 - k) at h
    rw [map_sub, map_one, hkθ, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  let L : Ideal C := Ideal.span {1 - e}
  let D := C ⧸ L
  let q : C →ₐ[B] D := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ B L
  let : Algebra.Etale B D := Algebra.Etale.quotient_one_sub_of_isIdempotentElem e he
  have hσker : L ≤ RingHom.ker σ.toRingHom := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr
    change σ (1 - e) = 0
    rw [map_sub, map_one, hσe, sub_self]
  let σD : D →ₐ[B] Q := Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ L σ (fun c hc ↦ hσker hc)
  have heD : q e = 1 := by
    have h : q (1 - e) = 0 := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (1 - e))
    rw [map_sub, map_one, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  let τ : C₀ →ₐ[Q] D ⧸ J.map (algebraMap B D) := q.quotientBaseChange J
  have hkτ : τ k = 0 := by
    have hk' : k = 1 - Ideal.Quotient.mk K e := by
      rw [hebar, sub_sub_cancel]
    rw [hk', map_sub, map_one]
    change 1 - Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.map (algebraMap B D)) (q e) = 0
    rw [heD, map_one, sub_self]
  have hkerle : RingHom.ker θ.toRingHom ≤ RingHom.ker τ.toRingHom := by
    rw [hker]
    exact (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hkτ
  have hscalar : Function.Surjective
      (algebraMap Q (D ⧸ J.map (algebraMap B D))) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective d
    let x : C₀ := Ideal.Quotient.mk K c
    refine ⟨θ x, ?_⟩
    have hdiff : x - algebraMap Q C₀ (θ x) ∈ RingHom.ker θ.toRingHom := by
      change θ (x - algebraMap Q C₀ (θ x)) = 0
      rw [map_sub, θ.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply, sub_self]
    have h := hkerle hdiff
    change τ (x - algebraMap Q C₀ (θ x)) = 0 at h
    rw [map_sub, τ.commutes, sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hJ : J ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥ :=
    Ideal.map_le_jacobson_bot_of_isIntegral (HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := I))
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap B D) :=
    bijective_algebraMap_of_quotientSection J hJ σD hscalar
  let E : B ≃ₐ[B] D := AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId B D) hbij
  refine ⟨E.symm.toAlgHom.comp q, AlgHom.ext fun c ↦ ?_⟩
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk J (E.symm (q c)) = σ c
  have h := σD.commutes (E.symm (q c))
  have hE : algebraMap B D (E.symm (q c)) = q c := E.apply_symm_apply (q c)
  rw [hE] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.quotientBaseChange_surjective_of_henselian
statement:
theorem quotientBaseChange_surjective_of_henselian
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    [Module.Finite R A] [Algebra.Etale R A]
    [Module.Finite R B] [Algebra.Etale R B]
    (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] :
    Function.Surjective (fun f : A →ₐ[R] B ↦ f.quotientBaseChange I)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  let J : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  let φR : A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ J :=
    (φ.restrictScalars R).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (I.map (algebraMap R A)))
  let σ : B ⊗[R] A →ₐ[B] B ⧸ J :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId B (B ⧸ J)) φR (fun _ _ ↦ .all _ _)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_lift_section_of_finite_henselian_base I σ
  let f : A →ₐ[R] B := (g.restrictScalars R).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
  refine ⟨f, AlgHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk J (g ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] a)) =
    φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R A)) a)
  have h := AlgHom.congr_fun hg ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] a)
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk J (g ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] a)) = σ ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[R] a) at h
  simpa only [σ, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, map_one, one_mul, φR,
    AlgHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply,
    Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] using h

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.baseChange_surjective_of_henselian
statement:
theorem baseChange_surjective_of_henselian
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    [Module.Finite R A] [Algebra.Etale R A]
    [Module.Finite R B] [Algebra.Etale R B]
    (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] :
    Function.Surjective (fun f : A →ₐ[R] B ↦
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)) f)
proof:
:= by
  intro ψ
  let eA := Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor A I
  let eB := Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor B I
  let φ := eB.symm.toAlgHom.comp (ψ.comp eA.toAlgHom)
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := quotientBaseChange_surjective_of_henselian I φ
  refine ⟨f, AlgHom.ext fun t ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := eA.surjective t
  have h := AlgHom.congr_fun (f.quotientBaseChange_tensorProduct I) x
  change f.quotientBaseChange I = φ at hf
  rw [hf] at h
  change eB (φ x) =
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)) f) (eA x) at h
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)) f) (eA x) =
    ψ (eA x)
  calc
    _ = eB (φ x) := h.symm
    _ = eB (eB.symm (ψ (eA x))) := by
      simp only [φ, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_apply]
    _ = ψ (eA x) := eB.apply_symm_apply _

name: CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange_full_of_henselian
statement:
theorem baseChange_full_of_henselian
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] :
    (baseChange R (R ⧸ I) : CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{v} R ⥤
      CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)).Full where
  map_surjective {A B} φ
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Algebra.FiniteEtale.baseChange_surjective_of_henselian I φ.hom.hom
    refine ⟨FiniteEtale.ofHom f, ?_⟩
    apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
    apply CommAlgCat.Hom.ext
    exact hf

name: Algebra.Etale.bijective_comp_quotient_of_henselian
statement:
theorem bijective_comp_quotient_of_henselian
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.Etale R B]
    (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] :
    Function.Bijective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I).comp : (B →ₐ[R] R) → B →ₐ[R] R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Algebra.FormallyUnramified.comp_injective_of_le_jacobson I
    (HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := I)), ?_⟩
  intro σ
  obtain ⟨e, he, hσe, hintegral, hscalar⟩ :=
    Algebra.exists_integral_idempotent_factor_of_etale_quotientSection I σ
  let K : Ideal B := Ideal.span {1 - e}
  let F := B ⧸ K
  let q : B →ₐ[R] F := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R K
  let : Algebra.Etale R F := quotient_one_sub_of_isIdempotentElem e he
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R F := hintegral
  let : Module.Finite R F := Algebra.IsIntegral.finite
  have hker : K ≤ RingHom.ker σ.toRingHom := by
    apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    intro b hb
    rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb with rfl
    change σ (1 - e) = 0
    rw [map_sub, map_one, hσe, sub_self]
  let σF : F →ₐ[R] R ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ K σ (fun b hb ↦ hker hb)
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap R F) :=
    Algebra.FiniteEtale.bijective_algebraMap_of_quotientSection I
      (HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := I)) σF hscalar
  let E : R ≃ₐ[R] F := AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId R F) hbij
  refine ⟨E.symm.toAlgHom.comp q, ?_⟩
  apply AlgHom.ext
  intro b
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (E.symm (q b)) = σ b
  have h := σF.commutes (E.symm (q b))
  have hE : algebraMap R F (E.symm (q b)) = q b := E.apply_symm_apply (q b)
  rw [hE] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Algebra.exists_etale_isFiniteSplit
statement:
lemma exists_etale_isFiniteSplit [Module.Finite R A] [Algebra.Etale R A]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    ∃ (S : Type u) (_ : CommRing S) (_ : Algebra R S),
      Algebra.Etale R S ∧
      p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) ∧
      Algebra.IsFiniteSplit S (S ⊗[R] A)
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.FinitePresentation R A :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_finite_of_finitePresentation R A
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hn⟩ := Algebra.exists_cover_rankAtStalk_eq A p.asIdeal
  obtain ⟨p', hp'⟩ : p ∈ Set.range
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away r))) := by
    rwa [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range _ r]
  obtain ⟨S, _, _, _, _, _, hS⟩ :=
    Algebra.IsFiniteSplit.exists_tensorProduct_of_etale hn
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat (B := S) p'
  let : Algebra R S := Algebra.compHom S (algebraMap R (Localization.Away r))
  have : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away r) S := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  refine ⟨S, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    Algebra.Etale.comp R (Localization.Away r) S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away r) S, PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp]
    exact (congrArg (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (Localization.Away r))) hq).trans hp'
  · exact IsFiniteSplit.of_algEquiv
      (S := S ⊗[Localization.Away r] (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] A))
      (TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange R (Localization.Away r) S S A)

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.exists_lift_of_quotient_of_henselian
statement:
theorem exists_lift_of_quotient_of_henselian
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I]
    [Algebra (R ⧸ I) A] [Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) A] [Algebra.Etale (R ⧸ I) A] :
    ∃ B : CommAlgCat.{u} R, Module.Finite R B ∧ Algebra.Etale R B ∧
      Nonempty ((R ⧸ I) ⊗[R] B ≃ₐ[R ⧸ I] A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨α⟩⟩ := Algebra.Etale.exists_etale_lift_of_quotient (A := A) I
  let : Algebra.Etale R D := hD
  let JD : Ideal (D : Type u) := I.map (algebraMap R D)
  let p : @HasQuotient.Quotient (D : Type u) (Ideal (D : Type u)) inferInstance JD ≃ₐ[R ⧸ I] A :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor D I).trans α
  let : IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom p.toAlgHom.toRingHom)) := by
    let : CategoryTheory.IsIso (CommRingCat.ofHom p.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :=
      p.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.isIso_hom
    infer_instance
  let C := integralClosure R D
  let J : Ideal C := I.map (algebraMap R C)
  let qC : C →+* C ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mk J
  let qD : D →+* @HasQuotient.Quotient (D : Type u) (Ideal (D : Type u)) inferInstance JD :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R D))
  let f : C →ₐ[R] D := (integralClosure R D).val
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀, E, hE₁, _, g, hg, hEg, hlocal⟩ :=
    Algebra.exists_integralClosure_quotient_factor_and_awayMap_bijective I p.toAlgHom
  have hgidem : IsIdempotentElem (qC g) := by
    rw [hg]
    exact he₀.one_sub
  obtain ⟨e, he, heq⟩ := Algebra.exists_idempotent_lift_of_isIntegral I g hgidem
  have hunit : IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {1 - e}) g) :=
    Algebra.isUnit_quotient_one_sub_of_eq_mod_extendedIdeal I
      (HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := I)) g e heq.symm
  have hpg : p (qD (f g)) = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Prod.fst hEg
    rw [hE₁] at h
    exact h
  have hpe : p (qD (f e)) = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (p.toAlgHom.comp (f.quotientBaseChange I)) heq
    change p (qD (f e)) = p (qD (f g)) at h
    exact h.trans hpg
  have hfe : qD (f e) = 1 := by
    apply p.injective
    rw [map_one]
    exact hpe
  let F := D ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - f e}
  let : Algebra.Etale R F :=
    Algebra.Etale.quotient_one_sub_of_isIdempotentElem (f e) (he.map f)
  let : Algebra.IsIntegral R F :=
    f.isIntegral_idempotentFactor_of_awayMap_bijective e he g hunit hlocal
  let : Module.Finite R F := Algebra.IsIntegral.finite
  refine ⟨CommAlgCat.of R F, inferInstance, inferInstance, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor F I).symm.trans
    ((Algebra.idempotentFactorReductionEquivOfEqOne I (f e) hfe).trans p)

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.bijective_algebraMap_of_quotientSection
statement:
theorem bijective_algebraMap_of_quotientSection
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [Module.Finite R A] [Algebra.Etale R A]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥) (σ : A →ₐ[R] R ⧸ I)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective
      (algebraMap (R ⧸ I) (A ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R A)))) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R A)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := R ⧸ I
  let J := I.map (algebraMap R A)
  have hleft : Function.LeftInverse (AlgHom.quotientSection I σ)
      (algebraMap Q (A ⧸ J)) :=
    fun x ↦ (AlgHom.quotientSection I σ).commutes x
  have hquot : Function.Bijective (algebraMap Q (A ⧸ J)) :=
    ⟨hleft.injective, hsurj⟩
  apply bijective_of_baseChange_quotient I hI (Algebra.ofId R A)
  let eR : Q ⊗[R] R ≃ₐ[Q] Q := Algebra.TensorProduct.rid R Q Q
  let eA : (A ⧸ J) ≃ₐ[Q] Q ⊗[R] A :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor A I
  let M : Q ⊗[R] R →ₐ[Q] Q ⊗[R] A :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id Q Q) (Algebra.ofId R A)
  have hcomp : (fun x : Q ↦ M (eR.symm x)) =
      fun x : Q ↦ eA (algebraMap Q (A ⧸ J) x) := by
    funext x
    change Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id Q Q) (Algebra.ofId R A)
      (x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : R)) = eA (algebraMap Q (A ⧸ J) x)
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one]
    exact (eA.commutes x).symm
  apply (Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff (fun t ↦ M t) eR.symm.bijective).mp
  change Function.Bijective (fun x : Q ↦ M (eR.symm x))
  rw [hcomp]
  exact eA.bijective.comp hquot

name: Algebra.FormallyUnramified.comp_injective_of_le_jacobson
statement:
theorem comp_injective_of_le_jacobson [FormallyUnramified R A] [EssFiniteType R A]
    (J : Ideal B) (hJ : J ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥) :
    Function.Injective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J).comp : (A →ₐ[R] B) → A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ J)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g hfg
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htone⟩ :=
    (iff_exists_tensorProduct (R := R) (S := A)).mp inferInstance
  let q : B →ₐ[R] B ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J
  let φ : A ⊗[R] A →ₐ[R] B :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f g (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)
  have hpoint (a : A) : q (f a) = q (g a) := AlgHom.congr_fun hfg a
  have hqφ : q.comp φ = (q.comp f).comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R) := by
    apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext'
    intro a b
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, φ, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul'_apply_tmul, map_mul]
    rw [hpoint b]
  have hqt : q (φ t) = 1 := by
    calc
      q (φ t) = q (f (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R t)) := AlgHom.congr_fun hqφ t
      _ = 1 := by rw [htone, map_one, map_one]
  have hmem : φ t - 1 ∈ J := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change q (φ t - 1) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hqt, map_one, sub_self]
  have hunit : IsUnit (φ t) :=
    Ideal.isUnit_of_sub_one_mem_jacobson_bot (φ t) (hJ hmem)
  apply AlgHom.ext
  intro a
  have hmul : (g a - f a) * φ t = 0 := by
    simpa only [map_mul, map_sub, map_zero, φ, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul,
      map_one, one_mul, mul_one] using congrArg φ (ht a)
  have hzero : g a - f a = 0 :=
    hunit.mul_right_cancel (hmul.trans (zero_mul (φ t)).symm)
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero).symm

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.bijective_of_baseChange_quotient
statement:
theorem bijective_of_baseChange_quotient
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    [Module.Finite R A] [Algebra.Etale R A]
    [Module.Finite R B] [Algebra.Etale R B]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥) (f : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (hf : Function.Bijective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)) f)) :
    Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  let JA : Ideal A := I.map (algebraMap R A)
  let JB : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  let eA := Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor A I
  let eB := Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor B I
  have hquot (b : B) : ∃ a : A, Ideal.Quotient.mk JB (f a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk JB b := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hf.surjective ((1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] b)
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_surjective
      (R := R) (S := R ⧸ I) A Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective t
    refine ⟨a, eB.injective ?_⟩
    change (1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] f a = (1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] b
    exact ht
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    change Function.Surjective f.toLinearMap
    apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
    apply top_unique
    apply Submodule.le_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot Module.Finite.fg_top hI
    intro b _
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hquot b
    have hdiff : b - f a ∈ I • (⊤ : Submodule R B) := by
      rw [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq.mp ha.symm
    have hmem : f a + (b - f a) ∈
        LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap ⊔ I • (⊤ : Submodule R B) :=
      Submodule.add_mem_sup (show f a ∈ LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap from ⟨a, rfl⟩) hdiff
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hmem
  have hkerle : RingHom.ker f.toRingHom ≤ JA := by
    intro a ha
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    apply eA.injective
    change (1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] a = eA 0
    rw [map_zero]
    apply hf.injective
    change (1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] f a =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)) f 0
    rw [show f a = 0 from ha, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
  have hkerjac : RingHom.ker f.toRingHom ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥ :=
    hkerle.trans (Ideal.map_le_jacobson_bot_of_isIntegral hI)
  let : Algebra A B := f.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R A B := .of_algebraMap_eq' f.comp_algebraMap.symm
  have hfe : Algebra.FormallyEtale A B :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_restrictScalars (R := R)
  have hkeridem : IsIdempotentElem (RingHom.ker f.toRingHom) :=
    (Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_of_surjective (R := A) (S := B)
      (show Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B) from hsurj)).mp hfe
  have hkerbot : RingHom.ker f.toRingHom = ⊥ :=
    Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
      (RingHom.ker f.toRingHom) (RingHom.ker f.toRingHom)
      (Algebra.FinitePresentation.ker_fG_of_surjective f hsurj)
      (by rw [Ideal.smul_eq_mul]; exact hkeridem.ge) hkerjac
  exact ⟨(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot f.toRingHom).mpr hkerbot, hsurj⟩

name: Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp_bijective_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem comp_bijective_of_isNilpotent [FormallyEtale R A]
    (I : Ideal B) (hI : IsNilpotent I) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I).comp : (A →ₐ[R] B) → A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro f g h
    exact FormallyUnramified.lift_unique I hI f g h
  · exact FormallySmooth.exists_lift I hI

name: Algebra.FormallyEtale.existsUnique_lift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_lift [FormallyEtale R A]
    (I : Ideal B) (hI : IsNilpotent I) (g : A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ I) :
    ∃! f : A →ₐ[R] B, (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I).comp f = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (comp_bijective_of_isNilpotent I hI).surjective g
  refine ⟨f, hf, fun f' hf' ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (comp_bijective_of_isNilpotent I hI).injective (hf'.trans hf.symm)

name: Algebra.FormallyEtale.existsUnique_algEquiv_of_surjective
statement:
theorem existsUnique_algEquiv_of_surjective
    [FormallyEtale R A] [FormallyEtale R B]
    (qA : A →ₐ[R] C) (qB : B →ₐ[R] C)
    (hqA : Function.Surjective qA) (hqB : Function.Surjective qB)
    (hnA : IsNilpotent <| RingHom.ker (qA : A →+* C))
    (hnB : IsNilpotent <| RingHom.ker (qB : B →+* C)) :
    ∃! e : A ≃ₐ[R] B, qB.comp e.toAlgHom = qA
proof:
:= by
  let f : A →ₐ[R] B := FormallySmooth.liftOfSurjective qA qB hqB hnB
  let g : B →ₐ[R] A := FormallySmooth.liftOfSurjective qB qA hqA hnA
  have hf : qB.comp f = qA :=
    FormallySmooth.comp_liftOfSurjective qA qB hqB hnB
  have hg : qA.comp g = qB :=
    FormallySmooth.comp_liftOfSurjective qB qA hqA hnA
  have hfg : f.comp g = AlgHom.id R B := by
    apply FormallyUnramified.lift_unique' qB hnB
    ext b
    change qB (f (g b)) = qB b
    calc
      qB (f (g b)) = qA (g b) := by
        simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply] using AlgHom.congr_fun hf (g b)
      _ = qB b := AlgHom.congr_fun hg b
  have hgf : g.comp f = AlgHom.id R A := by
    apply FormallyUnramified.lift_unique' qA hnA
    ext a
    change qA (g (f a)) = qA a
    calc
      qA (g (f a)) = qB (f a) := by
        simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply] using AlgHom.congr_fun hg (f a)
      _ = qA a := AlgHom.congr_fun hf a
  let e : A ≃ₐ[R] B := AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom f g hfg hgf
  have he : qB.comp e.toAlgHom = qA := by
    change qB.comp f = qA
    exact hf
  refine ⟨e, he, fun e' he' ↦ ?_⟩
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun
    (FormallyUnramified.lift_unique' qB hnB e'.toAlgHom e.toAlgHom
      (he'.trans he.symm))

name: Algebra.Etale.quotient_one_sub_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem quotient_one_sub_of_isIdempotentElem
    {R : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra.Etale R B] (e : B) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    Algebra.Etale R (B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e})
proof:
:= by
  let : IsLocalization.Away e (B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}) :=
    IsLocalization.away_of_isIdempotentElem he
      (show RingHom.ker (algebraMap B (B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e})) =
        Ideal.span {1 - e} from Ideal.mk_ker)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : Algebra.Etale B (B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e}) :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway e
  exact Algebra.Etale.comp R B (B ⧸ Ideal.span {1 - e})

name: Algebra.Etale.tensorModel_jacobian
statement:
lemma tensorModel_jacobian :
    P.tensorModelOfHasCoeffsEquiv R₀
      (1 ⊗ₜ[R₀] (P.ofHasCoeffs R₀).jacobian) = P.jacobian
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype σ := Fintype.ofFinite σ
  have hm : (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R₀ R)).mapMatrix (P.ofHasCoeffs R₀).jacobiMatrix =
      P.jacobiMatrix := by
    funext i j
    simp only [RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply,
      PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobiMatrix_apply,
      PreSubmersivePresentation.ofHasCoeffs_map,
      PreSubmersivePresentation.ofHasCoeffs_relation,
      ← MvPolynomial.pderiv_map, Presentation.map_relationOfHasCoeffs]
  rw [PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobian_eq_jacobiMatrix_det]
  change P.tensorModelOfHasCoeffsEquiv R₀
    (1 ⊗ₜ[R₀] Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (P.ofHasCoeffs R₀).jacobiMatrix.det) = P.jacobian
  rw [Presentation.tensorModelOfHasCoeffsEquiv_tmul, map_one, one_mul,
    ← MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap R, RingHom.map_det, hm]
  exact (P.toGenerators.algebraMap_apply P.jacobiMatrix.det).symm.trans
    P.jacobian_eq_jacobiMatrix_det.symm

name: Algebra.Etale.exists_etale_lift_of_surjective
statement:
lemma exists_etale_lift_of_surjective (R₀ : Type u₀) [CommRing R₀]
    [Algebra R₀ R]
    (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R₀ R)) [Algebra.Etale R S] :
    ∃ (T : Type u₀) (_ : CommRing T) (_ : Algebra R₀ T),
      Algebra.Etale R₀ T ∧ Nonempty (R ⊗[R₀] T ≃ₐ[R] S)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra R₀ S := ((algebraMap R S).comp (algebraMap R₀ R)).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower R₀ R S := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 R S :=
    Algebra.Etale.iff_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_zero.mp inferInstance
  obtain ⟨I, J, _, _, Q, hQ⟩ :=
    IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.out (n := 0) (R := R) (S := S)
  have : Q.toPresentation.HasCoeffs R₀ := ⟨fun r _ => h r⟩
  let Q₀ := Q.toPreSubmersivePresentation.ofHasCoeffs R₀
  refine ⟨Localization.Away Q₀.jacobian, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobianLocalization_etale Q₀ ?_, ⟨tensorJacobianModelEquiv R₀ Q⟩⟩
  exact hQ

name: Algebra.Etale.exists_etale_lift_of_quotient
statement:
@[stacks 04D1]
theorem exists_etale_lift_of_quotient
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (I : Ideal R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ I) A] [Algebra.Etale (R ⧸ I) A] :
    ∃ C : CommAlgCat.{u} R, Algebra.Etale R C ∧
      Nonempty ((R ⧸ I) ⊗[R] C ≃ₐ[R ⧸ I] A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, _, _, hT, hEquiv⟩ :=
    exists_etale_lift_of_surjective (R := R ⧸ I) (S := A) R
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  exact ⟨CommAlgCat.of R T, hT, hEquiv⟩

name: CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange_isEquivalence_of_henselian
statement:
@[stacks 09ZL]
theorem baseChange_isEquivalence_of_henselian
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) [HenselianRing R I] :
    (baseChange R (R ⧸ I) : CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{u} R ⥤
      CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{u} (R ⧸ I)).IsEquivalence where
  faithful
proof:
:= baseChange_faithful_of_le_jacobson I (HenselianRing.jac (R := R) (I := I))
  full := baseChange_full_of_henselian I
  essSurj := {
    mem_essImage A := by
      obtain ⟨B, hfinite, hetale, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
        Algebra.FiniteEtale.exists_lift_of_quotient_of_henselian (A := A) I
      let : Module.Finite R B := hfinite
      let : Algebra.Etale R B := hetale
      exact ⟨FiniteEtale.of R B, ⟨FiniteEtale.isoMk e⟩⟩
  }

name: Algebra.FormallyUnramified.baseChange_injective_of_le_jacobson
statement:
theorem baseChange_injective_of_le_jacobson
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    [FormallyUnramified R A] [EssFiniteType R A] [Algebra.IsIntegral R B]
    (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥) :
    Function.Injective (fun f : A →ₐ[R] B ↦
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)) f)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g hfg
  apply comp_injective_of_le_jacobson (I.map (algebraMap R B))
    (Ideal.map_le_jacobson_bot_of_isIntegral hI)
  apply AlgHom.ext
  intro a
  let e := Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor B I
  apply e.injective
  change (1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] f a = (1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] g a
  simpa only [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one] using
    AlgHom.congr_fun hfg ((1 : R ⧸ I) ⊗ₜ[R] a)

name: CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange_faithful_of_le_jacobson
statement:
theorem baseChange_faithful_of_le_jacobson
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥) :
    (baseChange R (R ⧸ I) : CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{v} R ⥤
      CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)).Faithful where
  map_injective {A B} f g hfg
proof:
:= by
    apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
    apply CommAlgCat.Hom.ext
    apply Algebra.FormallyUnramified.baseChange_injective_of_le_jacobson I hI
    exact congrArg (fun k : (baseChange R (R ⧸ I)).obj A ⟶
      (baseChange R (R ⧸ I)).obj B ↦ k.hom.hom) hfg

name: CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.baseChange_reflectsIsomorphisms_of_le_jacobson
statement:
theorem baseChange_reflectsIsomorphisms_of_le_jacobson
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ Ideal.jacobson ⊥) :
    (baseChange R (R ⧸ I) : CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{v} R ⥤
      CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)).ReflectsIsomorphisms where
  reflects {A B} f _
proof:
:= by
    apply (ObjectProperty.isIso_hom_iff f).mp
    have hbij : Function.Bijective f.hom := by
      apply Algebra.FiniteEtale.bijective_of_baseChange_quotient I hI f.hom.hom
      exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((baseChange R (R ⧸ I)).map f).hom
    let e : A.obj ≃ₐ[R] B.obj := AlgEquiv.ofBijective f.hom.hom hbij
    let baseIso : A.obj ≅ B.obj := CommAlgCat.isoMk e
    let eIso : A ≅ B := ObjectProperty.isoMk _ baseIso
    have he : eIso.hom = f := by
      apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
      apply CommAlgCat.Hom.ext
      rfl
    rw [← he]
    infer_instance

name: AlgHom.isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_of_surjective_of_etale
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_of_surjective_of_etale
    {R : Type v} {A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.Etale R A] [Algebra.Etale R B]
    (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom))
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra A B := f.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower R A B := .of_algebraMap_eq' f.comp_algebraMap.symm
  have hfe : Algebra.FormallyEtale A B :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_restrictScalars (R := R)
  have hker : IsIdempotentElem (RingHom.ker f.toRingHom) :=
    (Algebra.FormallyEtale.iff_of_surjective (R := A) (S := B)
      (show Function.Surjective (algebraMap A B) from hf)).mp hfe
  exact (isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_iff_of_surjective
    (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) hf).mpr
      ((Ideal.isIdempotentElem_iff_of_fg _
        (Algebra.FinitePresentation.ker_fG_of_surjective f hf)).mp hker)

name: AlgHom.extendedIdeal_le_ker_quotientSection
statement:
lemma extendedIdeal_le_ker_quotientSection :
    I.map (algebraMap R B) ≤ RingHom.ker σ.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro r hr
  change σ (algebraMap R B r) = 0
  rw [σ.commutes]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hr

name: AlgHom.quotientSection_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientSection_mk (b : B) :
    quotientSection I σ (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap R B)) b) = σ b
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgHom.quotientSection_surjective
statement: theorem quotientSection_surjective : Function.Surjective (quotientSection I σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  exact ⟨algebraMap (R ⧸ I) (B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B)) x,
    (quotientSection I σ).commutes x⟩

name: AlgHom.isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientSection
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_quotientSection
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.Etale R B]
    (I : Ideal R) (σ : B →ₐ[R] R ⧸ I) :
    IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (quotientSection I σ).toRingHom))
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.Etale (R ⧸ I) (B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B)) :=
    Algebra.Etale.of_equiv (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor B I).symm
  exact (quotientSection I σ).isOpenImmersion_SpecMap_of_surjective_of_etale
    (quotientSection_surjective I σ)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.ideal_map_isNilpotent
statement:
private theorem ideal_map_isNilpotent
    {R B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    {I : Ideal R} (hI : IsNilpotent I) :
    IsNilpotent (I.map (algebraMap R B))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hI
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [← Ideal.map_pow, hn]
  simp only [Ideal.zero_eq_bot, Ideal.map_bot]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.baseChange_algHom_bijective_of_quotient_comp_bijective
statement:
theorem baseChange_algHom_bijective_of_quotient_comp_bijective
    {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (I : Ideal R)
    (hcomp : Function.Bijective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (I.map (algebraMap R B))).comp :
        (A →ₐ[R] B) → A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R B))) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun f : A →ₐ[R] B ↦
        Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)) f)
proof:
:= by
  let J : Ideal B := I.map (algebraMap R B)
  let eB := Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor B I
  let qB : B →ₐ[R] B ⧸ J := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J
  have hcomp' : Function.Bijective
      (qB.comp : (A →ₐ[R] B) → A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ J) := by
    simpa only [qB, J] using hcomp
  have heBqB :
      (eB.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp qB =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          B →ₐ[R] TensorProduct R (R ⧸ I) B) := by
    ext b
    rfl
  constructor
  · intro f g hfg
    apply hcomp'.1
    apply AlgHom.ext
    intro a
    apply eB.injective
    have h := AlgHom.congr_fun hfg (1 ⊗ₜ[R] a)
    calc
      eB (qB (f a)) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R] f a := AlgHom.congr_fun heBqB (f a)
      _ = 1 ⊗ₜ[R] g a := h
      _ = eB (qB (g a)) := (AlgHom.congr_fun heBqB (g a)).symm
  · intro f
    let qA : A →ₐ[R] TensorProduct R (R ⧸ I) A :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
    let gbar : A →ₐ[R] B ⧸ J :=
      (eB.symm.toAlgHom.restrictScalars R).comp
        ((f.restrictScalars R).comp qA)
    let g : A →ₐ[R] B := Classical.choose
      (hcomp'.2 gbar)
    have hg : qB.comp g = gbar := Classical.choose_spec
      (hcomp'.2 gbar)
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
    · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · apply AlgHom.ext
      intro a
      have hga := AlgHom.congr_fun hg a
      calc
        1 ⊗ₜ[R] g a = eB (qB (g a)) :=
          (AlgHom.congr_fun heBqB (g a)).symm
        _ = eB (gbar a) := congrArg eB hga
        _ = f (1 ⊗ₜ[R] a) := by simp [gbar, qA]

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.finiteEtale_baseChange_algHom_bijective_of_isNilpotent

theorem finiteEtale_baseChange_algHom_bijective_of_isNilpotent

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.algebraMap_bijective_of_henselian_of_isSepClosed_residue_of_finiteEtale_local_universe
statement:
theorem
    algebraMap_bijective_of_henselian_of_isSepClosed_residue_of_finiteEtale_local_universe
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [HenselianLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S]
    [Module.Finite R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] [Algebra.Etale R S]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)] :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := IsLocalRing.exists_adjoin_eq_top (R := R) (S := S)
  let f : R[X] := minpoly R β
  have hfMonic : f.Monic :=
    minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral β)
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ :=
    IsSepClosed.algebraMap_surjective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
      (IsLocalRing.residue S β)
  have hfRootResidue : aeval a₀ f = 0 := by
    apply (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)).injective
    rw [map_zero,
      Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (U := IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
        (φ := IsLocalRing.residue R)
        (ψ := algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)) rfl f a₀,
      ha₀]
    rw [show f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
        minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (IsLocalRing.residue S β) by
      simpa [f] using
        IsLocalRing.minpoly_map_residue (R := R) (S := S) hβ]
    exact minpoly.aeval _ _
  have hfDerivativeResidue : aeval a₀ f.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hmap := congrArg
      (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)) hzero
    rw [map_zero,
      Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (U := IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
        (φ := IsLocalRing.residue R)
        (ψ := algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)) rfl f.derivative a₀,
      ha₀] at hmap
    have hDerivativeMap :
        f.derivative.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
          (minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
            (IsLocalRing.residue S β)).derivative := by
      have hm :
          f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
            minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
              (IsLocalRing.residue S β) := by
        simpa [f] using
          IsLocalRing.minpoly_map_residue (R := R) (S := S) hβ
      simpa [Polynomial.derivative_map] using
        congrArg Polynomial.derivative hm
    rw [hDerivativeMap] at hmap
    exact
      (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (IsLocalRing.residue S β)).aeval_derivative_ne_zero
          (minpoly.aeval _ _) hmap
  have hHensel := ((HenselianLocalRing.TFAE R).out 1 2).mp
    (inferInstance : HenselianLocalRing R)
  obtain ⟨a, haRoot, haResidue⟩ :=
    hHensel f hfMonic a₀ hfRootResidue hfDerivativeResidue
  have hresidue :
      IsLocalRing.residue S (algebraMap R S a) =
        IsLocalRing.residue S β := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_residue, haResidue, ha₀]
  have hnotUnit : ¬ IsUnit (β - algebraMap R S a) := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit]
    simp [hresidue]
  have hβImage : β = algebraMap R S a := by
    let g : S[X] := f.map (algebraMap R S)
    apply IsLocalRing.eq_of_eval_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_sub
      (f := g) (a := β) (b := algebraMap R S a)
    · simpa [g, f, aeval_def] using minpoly.aeval R β
    · simpa [g, eval_map] using congrArg (algebraMap R S) haRoot
    · exact hnotUnit
    · simpa [g, Polynomial.derivative_map, aeval_def] using
        IsLocalRing.isUnit_aeval_derivative_minpoly_of_adjoin_eq_top
          (R := R) (S := S) hβ
  have htopEqBot : (⊤ : Subalgebra R S) = ⊥ := by
    rw [← hβ]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Algebra.adjoin_le
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      subst x
      rw [hβImage]
      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem ⊥ a
    · exact bot_le
  exact ⟨FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R S,
    Algebra.surjective_algebraMap_iff.mpr htopEqBot⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_maximal_of_strictHenselian_universe
statement:
theorem
    algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_maximal_of_strictHenselian_universe
    {R : Type uR} {S : Type uS}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [HenselianLocalRing R] [Module.Finite R S] [Algebra.Etale R S]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) → Q = q) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  have hqMaximal : q.IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap
      (algebraMap R S) (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) q <| by
        rw [← Ideal.under_def,
          ← q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
        exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal ⟨q, hqMaximal, by
      intro Q hQMaximal
      let : Q.IsPrime := hQMaximal.isPrime
      have hQUnderMaximal : (Q.under R).IsMaximal :=
        Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R S)
          (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) Q
      have hQOver : Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
        { over := (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hQUnderMaximal).symm }
      exact hunique Q inferInstance hQOver⟩
  have hqEq : q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hqMaximal
  have hcomap :
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).comap (algebraMap R S) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hqEq]
    change q.under R = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
    exact (q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)).symm
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S) :=
    ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE (algebraMap R S)).out 5 1).mp hcomap
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R S :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  exact
    algebraMap_bijective_of_henselian_of_isSepClosed_residue_of_finiteEtale_local_universe
      (R := R) (S := S)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.moduleFinite_localizationAtPrime_of_henselian_of_etale
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_localizationAtPrime_of_henselian_of_etale
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [HenselianLocalRing R] [Algebra.Etale R S]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)] :
    Module.Finite R (Localization.AtPrime q)
proof:
:= by
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  obtain ⟨C, _, _, _, P, _, _, e, he, P', _, _, hP'q, heP', hres, hfinite, hunique⟩ :=
    Algebra.exists_etale_isIdempotentElem_forall_liesOver_eq p q
  let B := TensorProduct R C S
  let D := Localization.Away e
  let Q : Ideal D := P'.map (algebraMap B D)
  have hdisj : Disjoint ((Submonoid.powers e : Submonoid B) : Set B) (P' : Set B) := by
    rw [Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime]
    exact heP'
  let : Q.IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint (.powers e) D P' inferInstance hdisj
  have hQoverP' : Q.LiesOver P' :=
    IsLocalization.liesOver_map_of_isPrime_disjoint (.powers e) D hdisj
  have hQunder : Q.comap (algebraMap B D) = P' := hQoverP'.over.symm
  let : Q.LiesOver P := .trans Q P' P
  have hQunique : P.primesOver D = {Q} := by
    ext J
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hJprime, hJover⟩
      let : J.IsPrime := hJprime
      let : J.LiesOver P := hJover
      let J₀ : Ideal B := J.comap (algebraMap B D)
      let : J₀.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.under B J
      let : J.LiesOver J₀ := ⟨rfl⟩
      let : J₀.LiesOver P := .tower_bot J J₀ P
      have heJ₀ : e ∉ J₀ := by
        intro heJ
        have heJD : algebraMap B D e ∈ J := heJ
        exact hJprime.ne_top
          (J.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem heJD
            (IsLocalization.map_units D ⟨e, Submonoid.mem_powers e⟩))
      have hJ₀ : J₀ = P' := hunique J₀ inferInstance inferInstance heJ₀
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      calc
        J = J₀.map (algebraMap B D) := (IsLocalization.map_under (.powers e) D J).symm
        _ = P'.map (algebraMap B D) := congrArg (Ideal.map (algebraMap B D)) hJ₀
        _ = Q := rfl
    · intro hJ
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hJ
      subst J
      exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  let Cₚ := Localization.AtPrime P
  let Dₚ := Localization.AtPrime Q
  let : Algebra Cₚ Dₚ := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver P Q
  let : IsScalarTower C Cₚ Dₚ := inferInstance
  let : Module.Finite Cₚ Dₚ :=
    Localization.finite_of_primesOver_eq_singleton hQunique
  let pointed : R ≃ₐ[R] Cₚ := henselianPointedEtaleLocalizationAlgEquiv P hres
  let : Module.Finite R Cₚ :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective pointed.toLinearMap pointed.surjective
  let : Module.Finite R Dₚ := Module.Finite.trans Cₚ Dₚ
  let BS := TensorProduct R Cₚ S
  let φ : B →ₐ[C] BS :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C Cₚ) (AlgHom.id R S)
  let : Algebra B BS := φ.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower C B BS := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' φ.comp_algebraMap.symm
  let : IsScalarTower R B BS := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    ext r
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, φ])
  let hBS : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B P.primeCompl) BS := by
    exact IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct R S P.primeCompl Cₚ (by
      ext
      change φ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] _) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R] _
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one, AlgHom.id_apply])
  let cancel : BS ≃ₐ[R] S :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr pointed.symm (AlgEquiv.refl)).trans
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid R S)
  let PBS : Ideal BS := P'.map (algebraMap B BS)
  have hPdisj :
      Disjoint ((Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B P.primeCompl : Submonoid B) : Set B)
        (P' : Set B) :=
    Ideal.disjoint_primeCompl_of_liesOver P' P
  let : PBS.IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B P.primeCompl) BS P' inferInstance hPdisj
  have hPBSoverP' : PBS.LiesOver P' :=
    IsLocalization.liesOver_map_of_isPrime_disjoint
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B P.primeCompl) BS hPdisj
  have hPBSunder : PBS.comap (algebraMap B BS) = P' := hPBSoverP'.over.symm
  have hcancel_right (s : S) :
      cancel (algebraMap B BS (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight s)) = s := by
    change (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid R S)
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr pointed.symm (AlgEquiv.refl))
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C Cₚ) (AlgHom.id R S))
          (1 ⊗ₜ[R] s))) = s
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one, AlgHom.id_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one,
      AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, AlgEquiv.coe_refl, id_eq,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lid_tmul, one_smul]
  have hcancel_symm_right (s : S) :
      cancel.symm s = algebraMap B BS (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight s) :=
    (cancel.eq_symm_apply.mpr (hcancel_right s)).symm
  have hPBScancel : PBS.map (cancel.toRingEquiv : BS →+* S) = q := by
    ext s
    rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv cancel.toRingEquiv]
    change cancel.symm s ∈ PBS ↔ s ∈ q
    rw [hcancel_symm_right]
    change Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight s ∈
      PBS.comap (algebraMap B BS) ↔ s ∈ q
    rw [hPBSunder]
    change s ∈ P'.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom ↔ s ∈ q
    rw [hP'q]
  have hPBScomap : PBS = q.comap cancel.toRingHom := by
    symm
    rw [← hPBScancel, Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv cancel.toRingEquiv]
    exact Ideal.comap_of_equiv cancel.toRingEquiv
  let BSₚ := Localization.AtPrime PBS
  let Sₚ := Localization.AtPrime q
  let cancelLocal : BSₚ ≃ₐ[R] Sₚ :=
    Localization.localAlgEquiv PBS q cancel hPBScomap
  let hDₚB : IsLocalization P'.primeCompl Dₚ := by
    have hloc := IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      (.powers e) Dₚ Q
    have hsub : (Q.comap (algebraMap B D)).primeCompl = P'.primeCompl := by
      ext x
      change (x ∉ Q.comap (algebraMap B D)) ↔ x ∉ P'
      rw [hQunder]
    exact hsub ▸ hloc
  let hBSₚB : IsLocalization P'.primeCompl BSₚ := by
    have hloc := IsLocalization.isLocalization_isLocalization_atPrime_isLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B P.primeCompl) BSₚ PBS
    have hsub : (PBS.comap (algebraMap B BS)).primeCompl = P'.primeCompl := by
      ext x
      change (x ∉ PBS.comap (algebraMap B BS)) ↔ x ∉ P'
      rw [hPBSunder]
    exact hsub ▸ hloc
  let localFactorEquiv : Dₚ ≃ₐ[B] BSₚ :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv P'.primeCompl Dₚ BSₚ
  let localFactorEquivR : Dₚ ≃ₐ[R] BSₚ := localFactorEquiv.restrictScalars R
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective
    (localFactorEquivR.trans cancelLocal).toLinearMap
    (localFactorEquivR.trans cancelLocal).surjective

statement:
