name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.isLocalHom_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_liesOver_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isLocalHom_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_liesOver_maximalIdeal
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing R] (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime]
    [P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)] :
    IsLocalHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P))
proof:
:= by
  apply ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE
    (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P))).out 1 5 rfl rfl).mpr
  change (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).under R =
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  rw [← Ideal.under_under (B := S), Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal]
  exact (P.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.localResidueFieldMap_bijective_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
statement:
theorem localResidueFieldMap_bijective_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsLocalRing R] (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime]
    [P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) P
        (Algebra.ofId R S) (P.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)))) :
    letI
proof:
:=
      isLocalHom_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_liesOver_maximalIdeal
        (R := R) (S := S) P
    Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P))) := by
  let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  let T := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R T) :=
    isLocalHom_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_liesOver_maximalIdeal
      (R := R) (S := S) P
  let e : R ≃ₐ[R] Localization.AtPrime m :=
    localizationAtMaximalIdealAlgEquiv R
  let f : Localization.AtPrime m →+* T :=
    Localization.localRingHom m P (algebraMap R S) (P.over_def m)
  have hcomp : f.comp e.toRingHom = algebraMap R T := by
    ext x
    change f (e x) = algebraMap R T x
    have hex : e x = algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime m) x := by
      simpa using e.commutes x
    rw [hex, Localization.localRingHom_to_map]
    exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S T x
  let : IsLocalHom e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom := by
    have h : IsLocalHom e.toRingEquiv := inferInstance
    exact ⟨h.map_nonunit⟩
  have he : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map e.toRingHom) :=
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e.toRingEquiv).bijective
  have hf : Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map f) := by
    change Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.ResidueField.map m P (algebraMap R S) (P.over_def m)) at hres
    exact hres
  have hmap :
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R T) =
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map f).comp
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map e.toRingHom) := by
    ext z
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective z
    rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
      RingHom.comp_apply, IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue,
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
    exact congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue T)
      (DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp x).symm
  rw [hmap]
  exact hf.comp he

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_bijective_of_henselian_of_etale_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_bijective_of_henselian_of_etale_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [HenselianLocalRing R] [Algebra.Etale R S]
    (P : Ideal S) [P.IsPrime]
    [P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) P
        (Algebra.ofId R S) (P.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)))) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P))
proof:
:= by
  let T := Localization.AtPrime P
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R T) :=
    isLocalHom_algebraMap_localizationAtPrime_of_liesOver_maximalIdeal
      (R := R) (S := S) P
  have hresLocal : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R T)) :=
    localResidueFieldMap_bijective_of_residueFieldMap_bijective
      (R := R) (S := S) P hres
  obtain ⟨s, hsP, hstd⟩ :=
    Algebra.IsEtaleAt.exists_isStandardEtale (R := R) P
  let C := Localization.Away s
  let : Algebra.IsStandardEtale R C := hstd
  let hsUnit : IsUnit ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S T) s) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units (M := P.primeCompl) T
      ⟨s, show s ∈ P.primeCompl from hsP⟩
  let j : C →ₐ[R] T :=
    IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom s
      (f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S T)
      hsUnit
  have j_algebraMap (z : S) :
      j (algebraMap S C z) = algebraMap S T z := by
    change IsLocalization.Away.lift s hsUnit (algebraMap S C z) = _
    calc
      _ = (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S T).toRingHom z :=
        IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (S := C) s hsUnit z
      _ = _ := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply R S T z
  let E : StandardEtalePresentation R C :=
    Algebra.IsStandardEtale.nonempty_standardEtalePresentation.some
  let beta : T := j E.x
  have hbeta : E.P.HasMap beta := E.hasMap.map j
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ :=
    hresLocal.surjective (IsLocalRing.residue T beta)
  have hf_root_residue : aeval a₀ E.f = 0 := by
    apply hresLocal.injective
    rw [map_zero]
    calc
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R T) (aeval a₀ E.f) =
          aeval (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R T) a₀)
            (E.f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) := by
        rw [Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
          (R := R) (S := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (U := IsLocalRing.ResidueField T)
          (φ := IsLocalRing.residue R)
          (ψ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R T)) rfl]
      _ = aeval (IsLocalRing.residue T beta)
          (E.f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) := by rw [ha₀]
      _ = IsLocalRing.residue T (aeval beta E.f) := by
        exact (Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
          (R := R) (S := T)
          (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (U := IsLocalRing.ResidueField T)
          (φ := IsLocalRing.residue R)
          (ψ := IsLocalRing.residue T) rfl E.f beta).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hbeta.1, map_zero]
  have hf_derivative_residue : aeval a₀ E.f.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hmap := congrArg
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R T)) hzero
    rw [map_zero,
      Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (U := IsLocalRing.ResidueField T)
        (φ := IsLocalRing.residue R)
        (ψ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (algebraMap R T)) rfl,
      ha₀] at hmap
    have hmap' :
        aeval (IsLocalRing.residue T beta)
            (E.f.derivative.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) =
          IsLocalRing.residue T (aeval beta E.f.derivative) :=
      (Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := T)
        (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (U := IsLocalRing.ResidueField T)
        (φ := IsLocalRing.residue R)
        (ψ := IsLocalRing.residue T) rfl E.f.derivative beta).symm
    rw [hmap'] at hmap
    exact ((IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit
      (aeval beta E.f.derivative)).mpr hbeta.isUnit_derivative_f) hmap
  have hHensel := ((HenselianLocalRing.TFAE R).out 1 2).mp
    (inferInstance : HenselianLocalRing R)
  obtain ⟨a, ha_root, ha_residue⟩ :=
    hHensel E.f E.monic_f a₀ hf_root_residue hf_derivative_residue
  have hresidue :
      IsLocalRing.residue T (algebraMap R T a) =
        IsLocalRing.residue T beta := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue, ha_residue, ha₀]
  have hnot_unit : ¬ IsUnit (beta - algebraMap R T a) := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit]
    simp [hresidue]
  have hbeta_image : beta = algebraMap R T a := by
    let g : T[X] := E.f.map (algebraMap R T)
    apply IsLocalRing.eq_of_eval_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_sub
      (f := g) (a := beta) (b := algebraMap R T a)
    · simpa [g, aeval_def] using hbeta.1
    · simpa [g, eval_map] using congrArg (algebraMap R T) ha_root
    · exact hnot_unit
    · simpa [g, derivative_map, aeval_def] using
        hbeta.isUnit_derivative_f
  have hg_unit : IsUnit (aeval a E.g) := by
    refine IsUnit.of_map (algebraMap R T) (aeval a E.g) ?_
    change IsUnit ((Algebra.ofId R T) (aeval a E.g))
    rw [← aeval_algHom_apply (Algebra.ofId R T) a E.g]
    change IsUnit (aeval (algebraMap R T a) E.g)
    rw [← hbeta_image]
    exact hbeta.2
  have haHasMap : E.P.HasMap a := ⟨ha_root, hg_unit⟩
  let sec : C →ₐ[R] R :=
    (E.P.lift a haHasMap).comp E.equivRing.toAlgHom
  have hj : j = (Algebra.ofId R T).comp sec := by
    apply E.hom_ext
    simp [sec, beta, hbeta_image]
  have hj_range (c : C) : ∃ r : R, algebraMap R T r = j c := by
    exact ⟨sec c, (DFunLike.congr_fun hj c).symm⟩
  have hsurjective : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R T) := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, y, rfl⟩ :=
      IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq P.primeCompl z
    obtain ⟨rx, hx⟩ := hj_range (algebraMap S C x)
    obtain ⟨ry, hy⟩ := hj_range (algebraMap S C y.1)
    have hx' : algebraMap R T rx = algebraMap S T x := by
      rw [j_algebraMap] at hx
      exact hx
    have hy' : algebraMap R T ry = algebraMap S T y.1 := by
      rw [j_algebraMap] at hy
      exact hy
    have hry : IsUnit ry := by
      apply IsUnit.of_map (algebraMap R T)
      rw [hy']
      exact IsLocalization.map_units T y
    let unitY : Rˣ := hry.unit
    have hunitY : (unitY : R) = ry := hry.unit_spec
    refine ⟨rx * (↑unitY⁻¹ : R), ?_⟩
    apply IsLocalization.eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq.mpr
    calc
      algebraMap R T (rx * (↑unitY⁻¹ : R)) *
          algebraMap S T y.1 =
          (algebraMap R T rx * algebraMap R T (↑unitY⁻¹ : R)) *
            algebraMap R T ry := by rw [map_mul, hy']
      _ = algebraMap R T rx := by
        rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← hunitY]
        rw [Units.inv_mul, map_one, mul_one]
      _ = algebraMap S T x := hx'
  let : Module.Flat R T := Module.Flat.trans R S T
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R T :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  exact ⟨FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R T, hsurjective⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.algebraMap_bijective_of_henselian_of_isSepClosed_residue_of_finiteEtale_local
statement:
theorem algebraMap_bijective_of_henselian_of_isSepClosed_residue_of_finiteEtale_local
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [HenselianLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S]
    [Module.Finite R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] [Algebra.Etale R S]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)] :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := IsLocalRing.exists_adjoin_eq_top (R := R) (S := S)
  let f : R[X] := minpoly R β
  have hf_monic : f.Monic := minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral β)
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ :=
    IsSepClosed.algebraMap_surjective
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
      (IsLocalRing.residue S β)
  have hf_root_residue : aeval a₀ f = 0 := by
    apply (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)).injective
    rw [map_zero,
      Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (U := IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
        (φ := IsLocalRing.residue R)
        (ψ := algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)) rfl f a₀,
      ha₀]
    rw [show f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
        minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.residue S β) by
      simpa [f] using IsLocalRing.minpoly_map_residue (R := R) (S := S) hβ]
    exact minpoly.aeval _ _
  have hf_derivative_residue : aeval a₀ f.derivative ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hmap := congr_arg
      (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)) hzero
    rw [map_zero,
      Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map
        (R := R) (S := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (T := IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
        (U := IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
        (φ := IsLocalRing.residue R)
        (ψ := algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)) rfl f.derivative a₀,
      ha₀] at hmap
    have hderivative_map :
        f.derivative.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
          (minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)
            (IsLocalRing.residue S β)).derivative := by
      have hm :
          f.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) =
            minpoly (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.residue S β) := by
        simpa [f] using IsLocalRing.minpoly_map_residue (R := R) (S := S) hβ
      simpa [derivative_map] using congr_arg Polynomial.derivative hm
    rw [hderivative_map] at hmap
    exact
      (Algebra.IsSeparable.isSeparable
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (IsLocalRing.residue S β)).aeval_derivative_ne_zero
          (minpoly.aeval _ _) hmap
  have h_hensel := ((HenselianLocalRing.TFAE R).out 1 2).mp
    (inferInstance : HenselianLocalRing R)
  obtain ⟨a, ha_root, ha_residue⟩ :=
    h_hensel f hf_monic a₀ hf_root_residue hf_derivative_residue
  have hresidue :
      IsLocalRing.residue S (algebraMap R S a) = IsLocalRing.residue S β := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_residue, ha_residue, ha₀]
  have hnot_unit : ¬ IsUnit (β - algebraMap R S a) := by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit]
    simp [hresidue]
  have hβ_image : β = algebraMap R S a := by
    let g : S[X] := f.map (algebraMap R S)
    apply IsLocalRing.eq_of_eval_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_sub
      (f := g) (a := β) (b := algebraMap R S a)
    · simpa [g, f, aeval_def] using minpoly.aeval R β
    · simpa [g, eval_map] using congr_arg (algebraMap R S) ha_root
    · exact hnot_unit
    · simpa [g, derivative_map, aeval_def] using
        IsLocalRing.isUnit_aeval_derivative_minpoly_of_adjoin_eq_top
          (R := R) (S := S) hβ
  have htop_eq_bot : (⊤ : Subalgebra R S) = ⊥ := by
    rw [← hβ]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Algebra.adjoin_le
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      subst x
      rw [hβ_image]
      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem ⊥ a
    · exact bot_le
  exact ⟨FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R S,
    Algebra.surjective_algebraMap_iff.mpr htop_eq_bot⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_maximal_of_strictHenselian
statement:
theorem algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_maximal_of_strictHenselian
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [HenselianLocalRing R] [Module.Finite R S] [Algebra.Etale R S]
    [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal S, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) → Q = q) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  have hq_maximal : q.IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap (algebraMap R S)
      (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) q <| by
      rw [← Ideal.under_def, ← q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
      exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R
  let : IsLocalRing S := IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal ⟨q, hq_maximal, by
    intro Q hQ_maximal
    let : Q.IsPrime := hQ_maximal.isPrime
    have hQ_under_maximal : (Q.under R).IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal (algebraMap R S)
        (fun x ↦ Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x) Q
    have hQ_over : Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
      { over := (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hQ_under_maximal).symm }
    exact hunique Q inferInstance hQ_over⟩
  have hq_eq : q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hq_maximal
  have hcomap :
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).comap (algebraMap R S) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← hq_eq]
    change q.under R = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
    exact (q.over_def (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)).symm
  let : IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S) :=
    ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE (algebraMap R S)).out 5 1).mp hcomap
  let : Module.FaithfullyFlat R S :=
    Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom
  exact
    algebraMap_bijective_of_henselian_of_isSepClosed_residue_of_finiteEtale_local
      (R := R) (S := S)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.algebraMap_bijective_away_of_unique_prime_over_maximal_of_strictHenselian
statement:
theorem algebraMap_bijective_away_of_unique_prime_over_maximal_of_strictHenselian
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [HenselianLocalRing R] [IsSepClosed (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R)]
    (e : A)
    [Module.Finite R (Localization.Away e)]
    [Algebra.Etale R (Localization.Away e)]
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime]
    [P.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)]
    (heP : e ∉ P)
    (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal A, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) → e ∉ Q → Q = P) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (Localization.Away e))
proof:
:= by
  let T := Localization.Away e
  have hdisjoint :
      Disjoint (Submonoid.powers e : Set A) (P : Set A) := by
    rw [Ideal.disjoint_powers_iff_notMem_of_isPrime]
    exact heP
  let q : Ideal T := P.map (algebraMap A T)
  have hq_prime : q.IsPrime :=
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint
      (Submonoid.powers e) T P inferInstance hdisjoint
  let : q.IsPrime := hq_prime
  have hq_over_P : q.LiesOver P :=
    IsLocalization.liesOver_map_of_isPrime_disjoint
      (Submonoid.powers e) T hdisjoint
  let : q.LiesOver P := hq_over_P
  have hq_over_closed : q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :=
    Ideal.LiesOver.trans q P (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
  let : q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) := hq_over_closed
  apply
    algebraMap_bijective_of_unique_prime_over_maximal_of_strictHenselian
      q
  intro Q hQ_prime hQ_over
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQ_prime
  let : Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) := hQ_over
  have hQ_under_prime : (Q.under A).IsPrime := inferInstance
  have hQ_under_over :
      (Q.under A).LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) := inferInstance
  have heQ : e ∉ Q.under A := by
    intro he
    exact
      (Ideal.notMem_of_isUnit Q
        (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := T) e)) he
  have h_under : Q.under A = P :=
    hunique (Q.under A) hQ_under_prime hQ_under_over heQ
  change Q = P.map (algebraMap A T)
  rw [← h_under]
  exact (IsLocalization.map_under (Submonoid.powers e) T Q).symm

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.strictHenselianChosenFactorFractionFieldAlgEquiv_universe_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem strictHenselianChosenFactorFractionFieldAlgEquiv_universe_apply
    (q : Ideal D) [q.IsPrime]
    [q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)]
    (hunique : ∀ Q : Ideal D, Q.IsPrime →
      Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) → Q = q)
    (x : Froot) :
    strictHenselianChosenFactorFractionFieldAlgEquiv_universe q hunique x =
      algebraMap Froot P x
proof:
:=
  (strictHenselianChosenFactorFractionFieldAlgEquiv_universe q hunique).commutes x

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_geometricallyIntegral
statement:
theorem separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_geometricallyIntegral
    [GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))] :
    (separableClosure k Ω).LinearDisjoint K
proof:
:= by
  let S := separableClosure k Ω
  have hField : IsField (TensorProduct k K S) := by
    let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S))
    let : IsIntegral (pullback f g) :=
      GeometricallyIntegral.geometrically_isIntegral _ _ _ (.of_hasPullback _ _)
    let : IsIntegral (Spec (.of (TensorProduct k K S))) :=
      IsIntegral.of_isIso (pullbackSpecIso k K S).hom
    have hDomain : IsDomain (TensorProduct k K S) :=
      (affine_isIntegral_iff (.of (TensorProduct k K S))).mp inferInstance
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.isField_of_isAlgebraic k K S (.inr inferInstance)
  let iK : K →ₐ[k] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K Ω
  have hLD : iK.fieldRange.LinearDisjoint S.val.fieldRange :=
    IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.of_isField' (K := Ω)
      hField iK S.val
  rw [IntermediateField.fieldRange_val] at hLD
  have hLD' : S.LinearDisjoint iK.fieldRange := hLD.symm
  rw [IntermediateField.linearDisjoint_iff'] at hLD'
  exact hLD'

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.separableClosureRestriction_surjective_of_geometricallyIntegral
statement:
theorem separableClosureRestriction_surjective_of_geometricallyIntegral
    [IsSepClosure K Ω]
    [GeometricallyIntegral
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))] :
    Function.Surjective
      (separableClosureRestriction (k := k) (K := K) (Ω := Ω))
proof:
:=
  separableClosureRestriction_surjective_of_linearDisjoint
    separableClosure_linearDisjoint_of_geometricallyIntegral

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.separableClosureRestriction_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem separableClosureRestriction_coe
    (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω) (x : separableClosure k Ω) :
    ((separableClosureRestriction (k := k) (K := K) (Ω := Ω) σ x :
      separableClosure k Ω) : Ω) = σ (x : Ω)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.separableClosureRestriction_surjective_of_linearDisjoint
statement:
theorem separableClosureRestriction_surjective_of_linearDisjoint
    [IsSepClosure K Ω]
    (h : (separableClosure k Ω).LinearDisjoint K) :
    Function.Surjective
      (separableClosureRestriction (k := k) (K := K) (Ω := Ω))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ
  let S := separableClosure k Ω
  let T := TensorProduct k K S
  let iK : K →ₐ[k] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K Ω
  have hField : IsField T := by
    have hDomain : IsDomain T := by
      apply IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.isDomain'
        (E := Ω) (fa := iK) (fb := S.val)
      rw [IntermediateField.fieldRange_val]
      have h' : S.LinearDisjoint iK.fieldRange := by
        rw [IntermediateField.linearDisjoint_iff']
        exact h
      exact h'.symm
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.isField_of_isAlgebraic k K S (.inr inferInstance)
  let : Field T := hField.toField
  let j : T →ₐ[K] Ω :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.productLeftAlgHom (Algebra.ofId K Ω) S.val
  let jσ : T →ₐ[K] Ω :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.productLeftAlgHom (Algebra.ofId K Ω)
      (S.val.comp σ.toAlgHom)
  let : Algebra T Ω := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower K T Ω :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (j.commutes x).symm
  have : Algebra.IsSeparable T Ω :=
    Algebra.isSeparable_tower_top_of_isSeparable K T Ω
  let : IsSepClosed Ω := IsSepClosure.sep_closed K
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ :=
    (IsSepClosed.surjective_domRestrict_of_isSeparable
      (K := K) T (M := Ω) (E := Ω)) jσ
  let e : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective f (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.algHom_bijective f)
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  ext x
  change e (x : Ω) = (σ x : Ω)
  have hx := DFunLike.congr_fun hf
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight x)
  change f (j (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight x)) =
    jσ (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight x) at hx
  change f ((Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId K Ω) S.val
    (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] x)) =
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId K Ω)
      (S.val.comp σ.toAlgHom) (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _)) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] x) at hx
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul] at hx
  simpa [e] using hx

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt.map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt.map_ringEquiv
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S]
    (e : R ≃+* S) {d r : ℕ} {f : R} {t : Fin d → R}
    (h : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r) :
    IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt (e f) (e ∘ t) r
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hrpos, hrd, hparams, hprime, hassoc, hbranch⟩
  refine ⟨hrpos, hrd, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IsRegularSystemOfParameters.map_ringEquiv hparams e
  · intro i hi
    change Prime (e (t i))
    exact (MulEquiv.prime_iff e.toMulEquiv).mpr (hprime i hi)
  · simpa [boundaryProduct] using hassoc.map e.toMonoidHom
  · intro i hi
    let : IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}) := hbranch i hi
    have hspan : Ideal.span {e (t i)} =
        (Ideal.span {t i}).map e := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv
      (Ideal.quotientEquiv (Ideal.span {t i})
        (Ideal.span {e (t i)}) e hspan)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_activeBranch_eq_of_heightOnePrime_mem_boundaryProduct
statement:
theorem exists_activeBranch_eq_of_heightOnePrime_mem_boundaryProduct
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {d r : ℕ} {t : Fin d → R}
    (hprime : ∀ i : Fin d, i.1 < r → Prime (t i))
    (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime] (hqheight : q.height = 1)
    (hprod : boundaryProduct t r ∈ q) :
    ∃ i : Fin d, i.1 < r ∧ q = Ideal.span ({t i} : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfactor : ∀ s : Finset (Fin d),
      (∏ i ∈ s, t i) ∈ q → ∃ i ∈ s, t i ∈ q := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
        simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.notMem_empty,
          false_and, exists_false, imp_false]
        exact (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).ne_top ∘ q.eq_top_iff_one.mpr
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hi]
        intro hmem
        rcases (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).mem_or_mem hmem with hit | hs
        · exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_insert_self i s, hit⟩
        · obtain ⟨j, hjs, hjq⟩ := ih hs
          exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hjs, hjq⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, htiq⟩ := hfactor (boundaryIndices d r) (by
    simpa only [boundaryProduct] using hprod)
  have hir : i.1 < r := by
    simpa only [boundaryIndices, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and] using hi
  exact ⟨i, hir,
    q.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one hqheight htiq
      (hprime i hir)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_activeBranch_eq_of_heightOnePrime_mem_boundary
statement:
theorem exists_activeBranch_eq_of_heightOnePrime_mem_boundary
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {d r : ℕ} {f : R} {t : Fin d → R}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime] (hqheight : q.height = 1)
    (hfq : f ∈ q) :
    ∃ i : Fin d, i.1 < r ∧ q = Ideal.span ({t i} : Set R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprod : boundaryProduct t r ∈ q :=
    (Ideal.mem_iff_of_associated hNC.2.2.2.2.1).mp hfq
  have hfactor : ∀ s : Finset (Fin d),
      (∏ i ∈ s, t i) ∈ q → ∃ i ∈ s, t i ∈ q := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
        simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.notMem_empty,
          false_and, exists_false, imp_false]
        exact (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).ne_top ∘ q.eq_top_iff_one.mpr
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
        rw [Finset.prod_insert hi]
        intro hmem
        rcases (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).mem_or_mem hmem with hit | hs
        · exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_insert_self i s, hit⟩
        · obtain ⟨j, hjs, hjq⟩ := ih hs
          exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hjs, hjq⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, htiq⟩ := hfactor (boundaryIndices d r) (by
    simpa only [boundaryProduct] using hprod)
  have hir : i.1 < r := by
    simpa only [boundaryIndices, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and] using hi
  exact ⟨i, hir,
    q.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one hqheight htiq
      (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hir)⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_two_splitStrictNormalCrossingsParameters
statement:
theorem regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_two_splitStrictNormalCrossingsParameters
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A] {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i j : Fin d) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P) (htjP : t j ∈ P) :
    IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime P)
        [algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t i),
          algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t j)] ∧
      Ideal.ofList
          [algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t i),
            algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t j)] =
        maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ps : List A := List.ofFn t
  let psAfterI : List A := ps.eraseIdx i.1
  let qs : List A := psAfterI.erase (t j)
  have hiIndex : i.1 < ps.length := by simp [ps]
  have hjIndex : j.1 < ps.length := by simp [ps]
  have hgetI : ps[i.1] = t i := by simp [ps]
  have hgetJ : ps[j.1] = t j := by simp [ps]
  have hjAfterI : t j ∈ psAfterI := by
    change t j ∈ ps.eraseIdx i.1
    rw [List.mem_eraseIdx_iff_getElem]
    exact ⟨j.1, hjIndex, fun h ↦ hij (Fin.ext h.symm), hgetJ⟩
  have hperm : List.Perm (t i :: t j :: qs) ps := by
    have hfirst : List.Perm (ps[i.1] :: psAfterI) ps := by
      simpa only [psAfterI] using List.getElem_cons_eraseIdx_perm hiIndex
    have hsecond : List.Perm (t i :: t j :: qs) (t i :: psAfterI) :=
      List.Perm.cons (t i) (List.perm_cons_erase hjAfterI).symm
    rw [hgetI] at hfirst
    exact hsecond.trans hfirst
  have hregPerm : IsRegular A (t i :: t j :: qs) :=
    IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hNC.2.2.1.1 (by
      simpa only [ps] using hperm.symm)
  have hgenPerm : Ideal.ofList (t i :: t j :: qs) = maximalIdeal A := by
    rw [← hNC.2.2.1.2]
    apply congrArg Ideal.span
    ext x
    exact hperm.mem_iff
  have hweakPair : IsWeaklyRegular A [t i, t j] := by
    apply ((isWeaklyRegular_append_iff A [t i, t j] qs).mp ?_).1
    simpa only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append] using
      hregPerm.toIsWeaklyRegular
  have hregularLocalized :
      IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime P)
        [algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t i),
          algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t j)] := by
    simpa using hweakPair.isRegular_of_isLocalization_of_mem
      (Localization.AtPrime P) P (by
        intro x hx
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
        rcases hx with rfl | rfl
        · exact htiP
        · exact htjP)
  let I : Ideal A := Ideal.span {t i}
  let Q : Ideal A := Ideal.ofList [t i, t j]
  have htiPrime : Prime (t i) :=
    Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem hNC.2.2.1.1 hNC.2.2.1.2
      (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hIprime : I.IsPrime := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime htiPrime.ne_zero).mpr
    exact htiPrime
  let : I.IsPrime := hIprime
  let S := A ⧸ I
  let : Nontrivial S := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIprime.ne_top
  let : IsLocalRing S :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let : IsNoetherianRing S :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_surjective A S (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hquot := Kummer.regularSystem_quotientHead hregPerm hgenPerm
  have hregS :
      IsRegular S ((t j :: qs).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) := by
    simpa only [I, S] using hquot.1
  have hgenS :
      Ideal.ofList ((t j :: qs).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) =
        maximalIdeal S := by
    calc
      Ideal.ofList ((t j :: qs).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) =
          (maximalIdeal A).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
        simpa only [I, S] using hquot.2
      _ = maximalIdeal S :=
        IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have htjBarPrime : Prime (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (t j)) :=
    Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem hregS hgenS
      (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨t j, List.mem_cons_self, rfl⟩)
  let J : Ideal S := Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk I (t j)}
  have hJprime : J.IsPrime := by
    apply (Ideal.span_singleton_prime htjBarPrime.ne_zero).mpr
    exact htjBarPrime
  let : J.IsPrime := hJprime
  have hmapQ : Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = J := by
    dsimp only [Q, J, I]
    rw [Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_nil, sup_bot_eq]
    rw [Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span]
    rw [Set.image_singleton, Set.image_singleton,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)),
      Ideal.span_singleton_zero, bot_sup_eq]
  have hIQ : I ≤ Q := by
    change Ideal.span {t i} ≤ Ideal.ofList [t i, t j]
    rw [Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_nil,
      sup_bot_eq]
    exact le_sup_left
  have hcomapJ : J.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = Q := by
    rw [← hmapQ, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
      Ideal.mk_ker, sup_eq_left]
    exact hIQ
  have hQprime : Q.IsPrime := by
    rw [← hcomapJ]
    exact Ideal.comap_isPrime (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) J
  let : Q.IsPrime := hQprime
  have htjNotI : t j ∉ I := by
    intro htjI
    exact htjBarPrime.ne_zero (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr htjI)
  have hIQlt : I < Q := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne hIQ ?_
    intro hIQeq
    apply htjNotI
    rw [hIQeq]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (List.mem_cons_of_mem (t i) List.mem_cons_self)
  have hIheight : I.height = 1 := by
    exact Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr htiPrime.ne_zero)
      htiPrime.not_isUnit
  have htwo_le_Q : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Q.height := by
    have hheight := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hIQlt
    rw [hIheight] at hheight
    simpa only [one_add_one_eq_two] using hheight
  have hQleP : Q ≤ P := by
    change Ideal.ofList [t i, t j] ≤ P
    rw [Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_cons, Ideal.ofList_nil,
      sup_bot_eq]
    exact sup_le
      (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htiP)
      (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htjP)
  have hPheight_le_Q : P.height ≤ Q.height := by
    rw [hP]
    exact htwo_le_Q
  have hQP : Q = P :=
    Ideal.eq_of_le_of_height_le (I := Q) (J := P) hQleP hPheight_le_Q
  refine ⟨hregularLocalized, ?_⟩
  calc
    Ideal.ofList
        [algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t i),
          algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t j)] =
        Q.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P)) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_ofList]
      rfl
    _ = P.map (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P)) := congrArg _ hQP
    _ = maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P) :=
      Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.primeCompl_map_quotient_eq
statement:
private theorem primeCompl_map_quotient_eq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {I P : Ideal R} [P.IsPrime] (hIP : I ≤ P) :
    P.primeCompl.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) =
      (quotientPrimeOfLe hIP).asIdeal.primeCompl
proof:
:= by
  apply Submonoid.ext
  intro y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ hy
    rcases (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).mp hy with ⟨z, hzP, hzx⟩
    have hxz : x - z ∈ I := by
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      rw [map_sub, hzx, sub_self]
    exact hx (by
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
        P.add_mem (hIP hxz) hzP)
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    have hxP : x ∉ P := by
      intro hx
      exact hy (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) hx)
    exact ⟨x, hxP, rfl⟩

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.regularParameter_not_mem_localized_maximalIdeal_sq
statement:
theorem regularParameter_not_mem_localized_maximalIdeal_sq
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A] {d : ℕ} (t : Fin d → A)
    (hreg : IsRegular A (List.ofFn t))
    (hgen : Ideal.ofList (List.ofFn t) = maximalIdeal A)
    (i : Fin d) (hBranch : IsRegularRing (A ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}))
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2) (htiP : t i ∈ P) :
    algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t i) ∉
      maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  let x : R := algebraMap A R (t i)
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {x}
  let B := A ⧸ Ideal.span {t i}
  let Q := quotientPrimeOfLe (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htiP)
  let S := R ⧸ I
  let : IsRegularRing B := hBranch
  have hxPrime : Prime (t i) :=
    Kummer.prime_of_mem_regularSystem hreg hgen
      (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hxMem : x ∈ maximalIdeal R :=
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff R P (t i)).mpr htiP
  have hxNe : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    exact hxPrime.ne_zero
      ((IsLocalization.injective R P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using hx))
  have hI : (Ideal.span {t i}).map (algebraMap A R) = I := by
    simp [I, x, Ideal.map_span]
  let e₀ := quotientLocalizationEquiv
    (R := A) (I := Ideal.span {t i}) (P := P)
    (P.span_singleton_le_iff_mem.mpr htiP)
  let e : Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal ≃+* S :=
    e₀.toRingEquiv.trans
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R hI).toRingEquiv
  have hregularS : IsRegularLocalRing S :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv e
  let : IsRegularLocalRing S := hregularS
  have hdimR : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim R = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P R
      _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hP
  have hxRegular : IsSMulRegular R x := by
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro a ha
    have hxa : x * a = 0 := by
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using ha
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hxa).resolve_left hxNe
  have hdimSsucc : ringKrullDim S + 1 = ringKrullDim R := by
    simpa only [S, I] using
      ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim hxRegular hxMem
  have hdimS : ringKrullDim S = ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hdimR] at hdimSsucc
    have htwo : ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 := by norm_num
    exact ENat.WithBot.add_one_cancel.mp (hdimSsucc.trans htwo)
  have hspanRankS : (maximalIdeal S).spanFinrank = 1 := by
    have h := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := S)
    rw [hdimS] at h
    exact ENat.natCast_inj.mp (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp h)
  have hprincipalS : (maximalIdeal S).IsPrincipal :=
    (Submodule.spanFinrank_eq_one_iff (maximalIdeal S)).mp hspanRankS |>.1
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hprincipalS
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  have hz' : maximalIdeal S = Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk I y} := by
    simpa only [hy] using hz
  let : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hspanR : Ideal.span {x, y} = maximalIdeal R := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro a ha
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
      rcases ha with ha | ha
      · rw [ha]
        change x ∈ maximalIdeal R
        exact hxMem
      · have hyS : Ideal.Quotient.mk I y ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
          rw [hz']
          exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
        have hyR : y ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
          rw [← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)]
          exact hyS
        rw [ha]
        change y ∈ maximalIdeal R
        exact hyR
    · intro a ha
      have haS : Ideal.Quotient.mk I a ∈ maximalIdeal S := by
        exact (IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective) ▸
            Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ha
      rw [hz', Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at haS
      obtain ⟨cS, hcS⟩ := haS
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective cS
      have hac : a - c * y ∈ I := by
        apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
        simp only [map_sub, map_mul, hc, mul_comm, hcS, sub_self]
      have hIle : I ≤ Ideal.span {x, y} := by
        change Ideal.span {x} ≤ Ideal.span {x, y}
        exact Ideal.span_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Set.mem_insert x {y}))
      have hcy : c * y ∈ Ideal.span {x, y} :=
        (Ideal.span {x, y}).mul_mem_left c
          (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem x (Set.mem_singleton y)))
      have := (Ideal.span {x, y}).add_mem (hIle hac) hcy
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using this
  intro hxSq
  let m : Ideal R := maximalIdeal R
  have hyMem : y ∈ m := by
    change y ∈ maximalIdeal R
    rw [← hspanR]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem x (Set.mem_singleton y))
  let x' : m := ⟨x, by simpa only [m] using hxMem⟩
  let y' : m := ⟨y, hyMem⟩
  have hxCot : m.toCotangent x' = 0 := by
    apply (m.toCotangent_eq_zero x').mpr
    simpa only [m, x'] using hxSq
  have hmapSpan :
      (Submodule.span R ({x', y'} : Set m)).map m.subtype = m := by
    rw [Submodule.map_span]
    change Ideal.span (m.subtype '' ({x', y'} : Set m)) = m
    rw [show m.subtype '' ({x', y'} : Set m) = ({x, y} : Set R) by
      ext z
      simp [x', y', eq_comm]]
    simpa only [m] using hspanR
  have hsubtypeSpan : Submodule.span R ({x', y'} : Set m) = ⊤ := by
    apply (Submodule.map_injective_of_injective m.subtype_injective)
    rw [hmapSpan, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]
  have hspanCot :
      Submodule.span (ResidueField R)
          (m.toCotangent '' ({x', y'} : Set m)) = ⊤ :=
    (CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff (R := R)).mpr hsubtypeSpan
  have hspanCot' :
      Submodule.span (ResidueField R)
          ({m.toCotangent y'} : Set (CotangentSpace R)) = ⊤ := by
    simpa only [Set.image_pair, hxCot,
      Submodule.span_insert_zero] using hspanCot
  have hfinle : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← finrank_top (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R), ← hspanCot']
    simpa using (finrank_span_le_card
      (R := ResidueField R)
      ({m.toCotangent y'} : Set (CotangentSpace R)))
  have hfinR : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 2 := by
    have hregR :=
      (IsRegularLocalRing.iff_finrank_cotangentSpace R).mp inferInstance
    rw [hdimR] at hregR
    exact ENat.natCast_inj.mp (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hregR)
  omega

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings
statement:
theorem exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_splitStrictNormalCrossings
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A] {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin d) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2) (htiP : t i ∈ P) :
    ∃ y : Localization.AtPrime P,
      IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime P)
        [algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t i), y] ∧
      Ideal.ofList [algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime P) (t i), y] =
        maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  have htSq := regularParameter_not_mem_localized_maximalIdeal_sq
    t hNC.2.2.1.1 hNC.2.2.1.2 i (hNC.2.2.2.2.2 i hi) P hP htiP
  exact exists_regular_pair_localizationAtPrime_of_height_eq_two
    P hP (hNC.2.2.2.1 i hi) htiP htSq

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_localizedBoundary_associated
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_localizedBoundary_associated
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A] {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin d) (hi : i.1 < r)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P) :
    let R
proof:
:= Localization.AtPrime P
    Associated (algebraMap A R f) (algebraMap A R (t i)) ∨
      ∃ j : Fin d, j.1 < r ∧ j ≠ i ∧ t j ∈ P ∧
        Associated (algebraMap A R f)
          (algebraMap A R (t i) * algebraMap A R (t j)) := by
  classical
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  have hBoundary :
      Associated (algebraMap A R f)
        (algebraMap A R (boundaryProduct t r)) :=
    hNC.2.2.2.2.1.map (algebraMap A R)
  rcases splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_branchSupport
      hNC i P hP htiP with hone | htwo
  · left
    refine hBoundary.trans ?_
    let g : Fin d → R := fun k ↦
      if k = i then algebraMap A R (t i) else 1
    have hprod :
        Associated
          (∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r, algebraMap A R (t k))
          (∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r, g k) := by
      apply Associated.prod
      intro k hk
      have hklt : k.1 < r := by
        simpa [boundaryIndices] using hk
      by_cases hki : k = i
      · subst k
        simp [g]
      · have htkP : t k ∉ P := by
          intro hmem
          exact hki (hone k hklt hmem)
        have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap A R (t k)) :=
          (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff R P (t k)).2 htkP
        rw [show g k = 1 by simp [g, hki]]
        exact associated_one_iff_isUnit.mpr hunit
    have hg :
        (∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r, g k) =
          algebraMap A R (t i) := by
      simp [g, boundaryIndices, hi]
    have hmap :
        algebraMap A R (boundaryProduct t r) =
          ∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r, algebraMap A R (t k) := by
      simp [boundaryProduct]
    rw [hmap]
    exact hprod.trans (Associated.of_eq hg)
  · obtain ⟨j, hj, hji, htjP, hsupport⟩ := htwo
    right
    refine ⟨j, hj, hji, htjP, hBoundary.trans ?_⟩
    let g : Fin d → R := fun k ↦
      if k = i then algebraMap A R (t i)
      else if k = j then algebraMap A R (t j)
      else 1
    have hprod :
        Associated
          (∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r, algebraMap A R (t k))
          (∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r, g k) := by
      apply Associated.prod
      intro k hk
      have hklt : k.1 < r := by
        simpa [boundaryIndices] using hk
      by_cases hki : k = i
      · subst k
        simp [g]
      · by_cases hkj : k = j
        · subst k
          simp [g, hji]
        · have htkP : t k ∉ P := by
            intro hmem
            rcases hsupport k hklt hmem with h | h
            · exact hki h
            · exact hkj h
          have hunit : IsUnit (algebraMap A R (t k)) :=
            (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff R P (t k)).2 htkP
          rw [show g k = 1 by simp [g, hki, hkj]]
          exact associated_one_iff_isUnit.mpr hunit
    have hg :
        (∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r, g k) =
          algebraMap A R (t i) * algebraMap A R (t j) := by
      have hiMem : i ∈ boundaryIndices d r := by
        simp [boundaryIndices, hi]
      have hjMem : j ∈ boundaryIndices d r := by
        simp [boundaryIndices, hj]
      have hgPoint (k : Fin d) :
          g k =
            (if k = i then algebraMap A R (t i) else 1) *
              (if k = j then algebraMap A R (t j) else 1) := by
        by_cases hki : k = i
        · subst k
          simp [g, Ne.symm hji]
        · by_cases hkj : k = j
          · subst k
            simp [g, hki]
          · simp [g, hki, hkj]
      calc
        (∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r, g k) =
            (∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r,
                if k = i then algebraMap A R (t i) else 1) *
              (∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r,
                if k = j then algebraMap A R (t j) else 1) := by
          simp_rw [hgPoint, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        _ = algebraMap A R (t i) * algebraMap A R (t j) := by
          rw [Finset.prod_ite_eq_of_mem' _ i _ hiMem,
            Finset.prod_ite_eq_of_mem' _ j _ hjMem]
    have hmap :
        algebraMap A R (boundaryProduct t r) =
          ∏ k ∈ boundaryIndices d r, algebraMap A R (t k) := by
      simp [boundaryProduct]
    rw [hmap]
    exact hprod.trans (Associated.of_eq hg)

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.eq_left_or_eq_right_of_three_parameters_mem_heightTwo
statement:
theorem eq_left_or_eq_right_of_three_parameters_mem_heightTwo
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A] {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i j : Fin d) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P) (htjP : t j ∈ P)
    (k : Fin d) (htkP : t k ∈ P) :
    k = i ∨ k = j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hk
  simp only [not_or] at hk
  have hidxNodup : [i, j, k].Nodup := by
    simp only [List.nodup_cons, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil,
      or_false, not_or, List.nodup_nil, and_true]
    exact ⟨⟨hij, fun hik ↦ hk.1 hik.symm⟩,
      ⟨fun hjk ↦ hk.2 hjk.symm, not_false⟩⟩
  have hidxSubset : [i, j, k] ⊆ List.finRange d := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil,
      or_false] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> exact List.mem_finRange _
  have hidxSubperm : [i, j, k] <+~ List.finRange d :=
    hidxNodup.subperm hidxSubset
  have hvalueSubperm :
      [t i, t j, t k] <+~ List.ofFn t := by
    obtain ⟨xs, hxsPerm, hxsSublist⟩ := hidxSubperm
    refine ⟨xs.map t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil] using hxsPerm.map t
    · simpa only [List.ofFn_eq_map] using hxsSublist.map t
  obtain ⟨ps, hpsPerm, hselectedSublist⟩ :=
    List.subperm_iff.mp hvalueSubperm
  obtain ⟨qs, hpsSelected⟩ := hselectedSublist.exists_perm_append
  have hperm : [t i, t j, t k] ++ qs ~ List.ofFn t :=
    hpsSelected.symm.trans hpsPerm
  have hregPerm : IsRegular A ([t i, t j, t k] ++ qs) :=
    IsLocalRing.isRegular_of_perm hNC.2.2.1.1 hperm.symm
  have hweakThree : IsWeaklyRegular A [t i, t j, t k] :=
    ((isWeaklyRegular_append_iff A [t i, t j, t k] qs).mp
      hregPerm.toIsWeaklyRegular).1
  let R := Localization.AtPrime P
  have hregularLocalized :
      IsRegular R
        [algebraMap A R (t i), algebraMap A R (t j),
          algebraMap A R (t k)] := by
    simpa only [R, List.map_cons, List.map_nil] using
      hweakThree.isRegular_of_isLocalization_of_mem R P (by
        intro x hx
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil,
          or_false] at hx
        rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact htiP
        · exact htjP
        · exact htkP)
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.ofList
    [algebraMap A R (t i), algebraMap A R (t j), algebraMap A R (t k)]
  have hIne : I ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro hI
    apply hregularLocalized.top_ne_smul
    simp [I, hI]
  let : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hIne
  have hdimension :=
    ringKrullDim_add_length_eq_ringKrullDim_of_isRegular
      [algebraMap A R (t i), algebraMap A R (t j), algebraMap A R (t k)]
      hregularLocalized
  norm_num [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hdimension
  have hdimR : ringKrullDim R = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim R = (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height P R
      _ = ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ∞ ↦ (n : WithBot ℕ∞)) hP
  have hthreeLe :
      ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R := by
    have hnonneg : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) :=
      ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial
    calc
      ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
          ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) + ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
        calc
          ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
              ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) + 0 :=
            (add_zero _).symm
          _ ≤ ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) +
              ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) :=
            add_le_add_right hnonneg _
          _ = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) +
              ((3 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := add_comm _ _
      _ = ringKrullDim R := by
        simpa [I] using hdimension
  rw [hdimR] at hthreeLe
  norm_num at hthreeLe

name: EtaleFundamentalGroups.splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_branchSupport
statement:
theorem splitStrictNormalCrossings_heightTwo_branchSupport
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsRegularRing A] {d r : ℕ} {f : A} {t : Fin d → A}
    (hNC : IsSplitStrictNormalCrossingsAt f t r)
    (i : Fin d)
    (P : Ideal A) [P.IsPrime] (hP : P.height = 2)
    (htiP : t i ∈ P) :
    (∀ j : Fin d, j.1 < r → t j ∈ P → j = i) ∨
      ∃ j : Fin d, j.1 < r ∧ j ≠ i ∧ t j ∈ P ∧
        ∀ k : Fin d, k.1 < r → t k ∈ P → k = i ∨ k = j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hsecond : ∃ j : Fin d, j.1 < r ∧ j ≠ i ∧ t j ∈ P
  · right
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hji, htjP⟩ := hsecond
    refine ⟨j, hj, hji, htjP, ?_⟩
    intro k _hk htkP
    exact eq_left_or_eq_right_of_three_parameters_mem_heightTwo
      hNC i j hji.symm P hP htiP htjP k htkP
  · left
    intro j hj htjP
    by_contra hji
    exact hsecond ⟨j, hj, hji, htjP⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteEtale.mono_iff
statement:
lemma mono_iff {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFiniteEtale f] :
    Mono f ↔ IsOpenImmersion f ∧ IsClosedImmersion f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf ↦ ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩, fun ⟨hfo, _⟩ ↦ inferInstance⟩
  · rw [IsClosedImmersion.iff_isFinite_and_mono]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.mono_iff
statement:
lemma mono_iff (f g : FiniteEtale X) (i : f ⟶ g) :
    Mono i ↔ IsOpenImmersion i.hom.left ∧ IsClosedImmersion i.hom.left
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsFiniteEtale.mono_iff]
  let G : FiniteEtale X ⥤ Over X := FiniteEtale.forget X
  let _ : CreatesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan G := by
    dsimp only [G, FiniteEtale.forget]
    exact MorphismProperty.Over.createsLimitsOfShape_walkingCospan
      (@IsFiniteEtale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) X
  have : PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan G := by
    infer_instance
  let F : FiniteEtale X ⥤ Scheme.{u} :=
    G ⋙ Over.forget X
  have : PreservesLimitsOfShape WalkingCospan F := inferInstance
  refine ⟨fun hi ↦ ?_, fun hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · change Mono (F.map i)
    exact @Functor.map_mono _ _ _ _ F inferInstance _ _ i hi
  · apply F.mono_of_mono_map (f := i)
    change Mono i.hom.left
    exact hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.finite_primeSpectrum_of_etale_field
statement:
private lemma finite_primeSpectrum_of_etale_field
    {K A B : Type u} [Field K] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (e : A ≃+* K) (g : A →+* B) (hg : g.Etale) :
    Finite (PrimeSpectrum B)
proof:
:= by
  let a : Algebra K B := (g.comp e.symm.toRingHom).toAlgebra
  have hEtale : Algebra.Etale K B := by
    change (g.comp e.symm.toRingHom).Etale
    exact RingHom.Etale.respectsIso.right g e.symm hg
  have hFinite : Module.Finite K B :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.finite_of_free K B
  have hArtinian : IsArtinianRing B := isArtinian_of_tower K inferInstance
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.finite_of_isEtale_of_isAffineHom
statement:
lemma finite_of_isEtale_of_isAffineHom (X : Scheme.{u}) {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)) [Etale f] [IsAffineHom f] :
    Finite X
proof:
:= by
  have hAffine : IsAffine X := isAffine_of_isAffineHom f
  have hEtale : Etale f := inferInstance
  rw [HasRingHomProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @Etale)] at hEtale
  have hSpectrum : Finite (PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, ⊤)) :=
    finite_primeSpectrum_of_etale_field
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of Ω)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv f.appTop.hom hEtale
  exact Finite.of_equiv (PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, ⊤))
    X.isoSpec.schemeIsoToHomeo.toEquiv.symm

  exact MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff (RingHom.toMorphismProperty RingHom.FiniteEtale)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.appLE_comp_algebraMap
statement:
lemma appLE_comp_algebraMap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [X.Over (Spec (.of R))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of R))] [f.IsOver (Spec (.of R))]
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (hUV : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    (f.appLE U V hUV).hom.comp (algebraMap R Γ(Y, U)) = algebraMap R Γ(X, V)
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  simp only [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, Iso.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv,
    RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_comp, RingHom.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply]
  have hover : f ≫ Y ↘ Spec (.of R) = X ↘ Spec (.of R) :=
    HomIsOver.comp_over
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
  rw [hover]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.appTop_left_comp_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma appTop_left_comp_algebraMap {X Y : FiniteEtale (Spec <| .of Ω)} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    f.left.appTop.hom.comp (algebraMap Ω Γ(Y.left, ⊤)) = algebraMap Ω Γ(X.left, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : f.left.IsOver (Spec (.of Ω)) := ⟨MorphismProperty.Over.w f⟩
  have hApp : f.left.appTop =
      f.left.appLE (⊤ : Y.left.Opens) (⊤ : X.left.Opens) le_rfl :=
    Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE f.left
  have hLE :
      (f.left.appLE (⊤ : Y.left.Opens) (⊤ : X.left.Opens) le_rfl).hom.comp
          (algebraMap Ω Γ(Y.left, ⊤)) = algebraMap Ω Γ(X.left, ⊤) :=
    appLE_comp_algebraMap f.left Ω
      (⊤ : Y.left.Opens) (⊤ : X.left.Opens) le_rfl
  exact (congrArg
    (fun k : Γ(Y.left, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X.left, ⊤) ↦
      k.hom.comp (algebraMap Ω Γ(Y.left, ⊤))) hApp).trans hLE

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.appTop_left_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma appTop_left_algebraMap {X Y : FiniteEtale (Spec <| .of Ω)} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : Ω) :
    f.left.appTop.hom (algebraMap Ω Γ(Y.left, ⊤) x) = algebraMap Ω Γ(X.left, ⊤) x
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (appTop_left_comp_algebraMap Ω f) x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap_algebraMap
statement:
private lemma isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap_algebraMap
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of R))] [IsAffine X] :
    X.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤))) =
      X ↘ Spec (.of R)
proof:
:= by
  have hApp : (X ↘ Spec (.of R)).appTop =
      (X ↘ Spec (.of R)).appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_rfl :=
    Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE (X ↘ Spec (.of R))
  change X.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫
        (X ↘ Spec (.of R)).appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_rfl) = X ↘ Spec (.of R)
  rw [← hApp, Spec.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality,
    Category.assoc, ← Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap_algEquiv
statement:
private lemma isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap_algEquiv
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of R))] [IsAffine X]
    (e : Γ(X, ⊤) ≃ₐ[R] A) :
    X.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) = X ↘ Spec (.of R)
proof:
:= by
  have hScalar : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom e.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(X, ⊤)) :=
    congrArg CommRingCat.ofHom (AlgHom.comp_algebraMap e.symm.toAlgHom)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, hScalar]
  exact isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap_algebraMap X

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteEtale.isoSpecFun_hom_SpecMap
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteEtale.isoSpecFun_hom_SpecMap [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of Ω))] [IsFiniteEtale (X ↘ Spec (.of Ω))] :
    (IsFiniteEtale.isoSpecFun Ω X).hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap Ω (X → Ω)) = X ↘ Spec (.of Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hAffine : IsAffine X := isAffine_of_isAffineHom (X ↘ Spec (.of Ω))
  let e : Γ(X, ⊤) ≃ₐ[Ω] (X → Ω) :=
    etaleFunctionsAlgEquiv Ω Γ(X, ⊤) X.isoSpec.schemeIsoToHomeo.toEquiv
  simpa only [e, IsFiniteEtale.isoSpecFun, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom,
    Scheme.Spec_map, Quiver.Hom.unop_op, Iso.symm_hom, RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_inv,
    AlgEquiv.symm_toRingEquiv, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, Category.assoc] using
    isoSpec_hom_comp_specMap_algEquiv X e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteEtale.isIso_of_isIso_snd
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteEtale.isIso_of_isIso_snd {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Z)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsFiniteEtale f] [PreconnectedSpace Z] [Nonempty Y]
    [IsIso (pullback.snd f g)] : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.isIso_iff_finrank_eq]
  obtain ⟨y⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›
  ext z
  rw [f.isLocallyConstant_finrank.apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace z (g.base y),
    ← Scheme.Hom.finrank_pullback_snd, Scheme.Hom.finrank_eq_one_of_isIso,
    Pi.one_apply, Pi.one_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteEtale.isIso_of_isIso_snd'
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteEtale.isIso_of_isIso_snd' {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Z)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsFiniteEtale f]
    [Finite (_root_.ConnectedComponents Z)]
    [∀ i : _root_.ConnectedComponents Z, Nonempty ↑(Limits.pullback g
      (Z.connectedComponents.f i))]
    [IsIso (pullback.snd f g)] : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  change MorphismProperty.isomorphisms _ _
  rw [IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.iff_of_openCover (P := MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme.{u})
    Z.connectedComponents]
  intro i
  change IsIso (Z.connectedComponents.pullbackHom f i)
  dsimp only [Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom]
  let c : Z.connectedComponents.X i ⟶ Z := Z.connectedComponents.f i
  let f' : Limits.pullback f c ⟶ Z.connectedComponents.X i := pullback.snd f c
  let g' : Limits.pullback g c ⟶ Z.connectedComponents.X i := pullback.snd g c
  have hFiniteBC : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (@IsFinite : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) := inferInstance
  have hEtaleBC : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange
      (@Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) := Etale.etale_isStableUnderBaseChange
  let _ : IsFiniteEtale f' := @IsFiniteEtale.mk _ _ _
    (hFiniteBC.of_isPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f c)
      (show IsFinite f from inferInstance))
    (hEtaleBC.of_isPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f c)
      (show Etale f from inferInstance))
  let a : Limits.pullback f' g' ⟶ Limits.pullback f (g' ≫ c) :=
    (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f c g').hom
  let b : Limits.pullback f (g' ≫ c) ⟶
      Limits.pullback f (pullback.fst g c ≫ g) :=
    (pullback.congrHom rfl pullback.condition.symm).hom
  let d : Limits.pullback f (pullback.fst g c ≫ g) ⟶
      Limits.pullback (pullback.snd f g ≫ g) c :=
    (pullbackAssoc f g g c).inv
  let m : Limits.pullback (pullback.snd f g ≫ g) c ⟶ Limits.pullback g c :=
    pullback.map (pullback.snd f g ≫ g) c g c
      (pullback.snd f g) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) rfl rfl
  let _ : IsIso a := (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f c g').isIso_hom
  let _ : IsIso b := (pullback.congrHom rfl pullback.condition.symm).isIso_hom
  let _ : IsIso d := (pullbackAssoc f g g c).isIso_inv
  let _ : IsIso m := by
    dsimp only [m]
    exact pullback.map_isIso (pullback.snd f g ≫ g) c g c
      (pullback.snd f g) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) rfl rfl
  have heq : pullback.snd f' g' = a ≫ b ≫ d ≫ m := by
    dsimp only [a, b, d, m, c, f', g']
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · simp only [Category.assoc, pullback.map, pullback.lift_fst,
        pullbackAssoc_inv_fst_snd, pullback.congrHom_hom,
        pullback.lift_snd_assoc, pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd_assoc,
        Category.comp_id]
    · simp only [Category.assoc, pullback.map, pullback.lift_snd,
        pullback.lift_snd_assoc, Category.comp_id, pullbackAssoc_inv_snd,
        pullback.congrHom_hom, pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd_assoc]
  let _ : IsIso (pullback.snd f' g') := by
    rw [heq]
    infer_instance
  change IsIso f'
  have hConnected : ConnectedSpace (Z.connectedComponents.X i) := by
    change ConnectedSpace (Z.connCompOpen i)
    apply isConnected_iff_connectedSpace.mp
    simp only [Scheme.connCompOpen, TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_mk]
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ConnectedComponents.surjective_coe i
    rw [connectedComponents_preimage_singleton]
    exact isConnected_connectedComponent
  let _ : PreconnectedSpace (Z.connectedComponents.X i) :=
    hConnected.toPreconnectedSpace
  have hNonemptyAll : ∀ j : _root_.ConnectedComponents Z,
      Nonempty ↑(Limits.pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) g
        (Z.connectedComponents.f j)) := by
    assumption
  let _ : Nonempty ↑(Limits.pullback g c) := by
    change Nonempty ↑(Limits.pullback g (Z.connectedComponents.f i))
    exact hNonemptyAll i
  exact IsFiniteEtale.isIso_of_isIso_snd f' g'

name: RingHom.Etale.iff_locally_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
statement:
theorem Etale.iff_locally_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) :
    f.Etale ↔ Locally (IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 0) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [etale_iff_formallyUnramified_and_smooth, smooth_iff_locally_isStandardSmooth]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨hr, hs⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have : Locally (fun f ↦ f.FormallyUnramified ∧ f.IsStandardSmooth) f := by
      obtain ⟨s, hs, H⟩ := hs
      refine ⟨s, hs, fun t ht ↦ ⟨?_, H t ht⟩⟩
      exact
        FormallyUnramified.propertyIsLocal.StableUnderCompositionWithLocalizationAwayTarget _ t _ hr
    refine locally_of_locally ?_ this
    intro R S _ _ f hf
    algebraize [f]
    have : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S := hf.1
    have : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R S := hf.2
    change Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 R S
    infer_instance
  · rw [← locally_iff_of_localizationSpanTarget FormallyUnramified.respectsIso
      FormallyUnramified.ofLocalizationSpanTarget]
    refine locally_of_locally ?_ h
    intro R S _ _ f hf
    algebraize [f]
    have : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 R S := hf
    change Algebra.FormallyUnramified R S
    infer_instance
  · refine locally_of_locally ?_ h
    intro R S _ _ f hf
    exact hf.isStandardSmooth

name: CommRingCat.Under.property_limit_of_hasFiniteProducts_of_hasEqualizers
statement:
lemma _root_.CommRingCat.Under.property_limit_of_hasFiniteProducts_of_hasEqualizers
    (hQi : RingHom.RespectsIso Q) (hQp : RingHom.HasFiniteProducts Q)
    (hQe : RingHom.HasEqualizers Q)
    {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (D : J ⥤ Under R) (h : ∀ j, Q (D.obj j).hom.hom) :
    Q (limit D).hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  have := CommRingCat.Under.hasFiniteLimits hQi hQp hQe
  let D' : J ⥤ (RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q).Under ⊤ R :=
    MorphismProperty.Comma.lift D h (by intros; trivial) (by intros; trivial)
  let A := limit D'
  have : CreatesFiniteLimits (Under.forget (RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q) ⊤ R) :=
    CommRingCat.Under.createsFiniteLimitsForget hQi hQp hQe R
  let e : (Under.forget _ _ R).obj A ≅ limit D :=
    preservesLimitIso (Under.forget (RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q) ⊤ R) D'
  have := CategoryTheory.Under.w e.hom
  let _ : IsIso e.hom.right := by
    change IsIso ((CategoryTheory.Under.forget R).map e.hom)
    exact Functor.map_isIso (CategoryTheory.Under.forget R) e.hom
  rw [← this, CommRingCat.hom_comp, hQi.cancel_right_isIso]
  exact A.prop

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appTop_bijective_of_isAffine
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appTop_bijective_of_isAffine
      {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] :
    Function.Bijective (fun (f : X ⟶ Y) ↦ f.appTop)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun f g (hfg : f.appTop = g.appTop) ↦ ?_, fun f ↦ ?_⟩
  · have (f : X ⟶ Y) : f = X.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map f.appTop ≫ Y.isoSpec.inv := by
      simp [Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality_assoc]
    rw [this f, this g, hfg]
  · let g : X ⟶ Spec Γ(Y, ⊤) :=
      (ΓSpec.adjunction.homEquiv X (Opposite.op Γ(Y, ⊤))) f.op
    use g ≫ Y.isoSpec.inv
    have hg : g.appTop = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).hom ≫ f :=
      ΓSpec_adjunction_homEquiv_eq f
    have hY :
        Y.isoSpec.inv.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [← Scheme.toSpecΓ_appTop, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop,
        Scheme.toSpecΓ_isoSpec_inv, Scheme.Hom.id_appTop]
    calc
      (g ≫ Y.isoSpec.inv).appTop = Y.isoSpec.inv.appTop ≫ g.appTop :=
        Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop _ _
      _ = Y.isoSpec.inv.appTop ≫
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).hom ≫ f) :=
        congrArg (fun k ↦ Y.isoSpec.inv.appTop ≫ k) hg
      _ = (Y.isoSpec.inv.appTop ≫
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y, ⊤)).hom) ≫ f :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ f := congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ f) hY
      _ = f := Category.id_comp _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineAnd.full_ΓProp
statement:
lemma full_ΓProp (hQi : RingHom.RespectsIso Q) {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] :
    (ΓProp P hQi S).Full where
  map_surjective
proof:
:= by
    intro ⟨X⟩ ⟨Y⟩ f
    let hXHom : IsAffineHom X.hom :=
      HasAffineProperty.affineAnd_le_isAffineHom P inferInstance _ X.prop
    let hYHom : IsAffineHom Y.hom :=
      HasAffineProperty.affineAnd_le_isAffineHom P inferInstance _ Y.prop
    let _ : IsAffine X.left :=
      @isAffine_of_isAffineHom X.left S X.hom hXHom inferInstance
    let _ : IsAffine Y.left :=
      @isAffine_of_isAffineHom Y.left S Y.hom hYHom inferInstance
    let _ : IsAffine ((Functor.fromPUnit S).obj X.right) :=
      inferInstanceAs (IsAffine S)
    let _ : IsAffine ((Functor.fromPUnit S).obj Y.right) :=
      inferInstanceAs (IsAffine S)
    let φ : Γ(X.left, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(Y.left, ⊤) := f.right
    obtain ⟨f', h⟩ :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appTop_bijective_of_isAffine.surjective φ
    have hw : X.hom.appTop ≫ φ = Y.hom.appTop := by
      change X.hom.appTop ≫ f.right = Y.hom.appTop
      ext s
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (MorphismProperty.Under.w f) s
    let g : Y ⟶ X := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk f' <| by
      apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appTop_bijective_of_isAffine.injective
      calc
        (f' ≫ X.hom).appTop = X.hom.appTop ≫ f'.appTop :=
          Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop _ _
        _ = X.hom.appTop ≫ φ :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ X.hom.appTop ≫ k) h
        _ = Y.hom.appTop := hw
    use g.op
    ext : 1
    change f'.appTop = φ
    exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineAnd.essSurj_ΓProp
statement:
lemma essSurj_ΓProp (hQi : RingHom.RespectsIso Q) {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] :
    (ΓProp P hQi S).EssSurj where
  mem_essImage R
proof:
:= by
    let X : P.Over ⊤ S := MorphismProperty.Over.mk ⊤ (Spec.map R.hom ≫ S.isoSpec.inv) <| by
      rw [P.cancel_right_of_respectsIso, HasAffineProperty.SpecMap_iff_of_affineAnd (P := P) _ hQi]
      · exact R.prop
      · infer_instance
    refine ⟨⟨X⟩, ⟨Under.isoMk (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _) ?_⟩⟩
    change (Spec.map R.hom ≫ S.isoSpec.inv).appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R.right).hom =
      R.hom
    let a : Γ(S, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(Spec Γ(S, ⊤), ⊤) :=
      S.isoSpec.inv.appTop
    let b : Γ(Spec Γ(S, ⊤), ⊤) ⟶ Γ(Spec R.right, ⊤) :=
      (Spec.map R.hom).appTop
    let c : Γ(Spec R.right, ⊤) ⟶ R.right :=
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R.right).hom
    let d : Γ(Spec Γ(S, ⊤), ⊤) ⟶ Γ(S, ⊤) :=
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(S, ⊤)).hom
    let r : Γ(S, ⊤) ⟶ R.right := R.hom
    have hS : a ≫ d = 𝟙 _ := by
      change S.isoSpec.inv.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(S, ⊤)).hom = 𝟙 _
      rw [← Scheme.toSpecΓ_appTop, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop,
        Scheme.toSpecΓ_isoSpec_inv, Scheme.Hom.id_appTop]
    have hcomp :
        (Spec.map R.hom ≫ S.isoSpec.inv).appTop = a ≫ b :=
      Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop _ _
    have hnat : b ≫ c = d ≫ r :=
      Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality R.hom
    calc
      (Spec.map R.hom ≫ S.isoSpec.inv).appTop ≫ c =
          (a ≫ b) ≫ c :=
        congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ c) hcomp
      _ = a ≫ (b ≫ c) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = a ≫ (d ≫ r) :=
        congrArg (fun k ↦ a ≫ k) hnat
      _ = (a ≫ d) ≫ r :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ r :=
        congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ r) hS
      _ = r := Category.id_comp _
