name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineAnd.preservesColimitsOfShape_pullback_iff_preservesLimitsOfShape
statement:
lemma preservesColimitsOfShape_pullback_iff_preservesLimitsOfShape (hQi : RingHom.RespectsIso Q)
    {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S) {J : Type*} [Category J]
    [(RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q).IsStableUnderCobaseChange] :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape J (Over.pullback P ⊤ (Spec.map f)) ↔
      PreservesLimitsOfShape Jᵒᵖ
        (MorphismProperty.Under.pushout (RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q) ⊤ f)
proof:
:= by
  let iso : (overSpecEquivUnder P hQi R).functor ⋙
      (Under.pushout (RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q) ⊤ f) ⋙
      (overSpecEquivUnder P hQi S).inverse ≅ (Over.pullback P ⊤ (Spec.map f)).op :=
    (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (overSpecEquivUnderCompPushoutIso P hQi f) _ ≪≫
      Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ (overSpecEquivUnder P hQi S).unitIso.symm ≪≫
      Functor.rightUnitor _
  let iso' : ((overSpecEquivUnder P hQi R).functor.rightOp ⋙
      (Under.pushout (RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q) ⊤ f).op ⋙
      (overSpecEquivUnder P hQi S).inverse.leftOp).op ≅ (Over.pullback P ⊤ (Spec.map f)).op :=
    iso
  let foo := NatIso.removeOp iso'
  let e' : _ ≅ (overSpecEquivUnder P (Q := Q) hQi R).inverse.leftOp ⋙
      (overSpecEquivUnder P (Q := Q) hQi R).functor.rightOp :=
   (NatIso.op <| (overSpecEquivUnder P (Q := Q) hQi R).counitIso)
  let e'' : _ ≅ (overSpecEquivUnder P hQi S).inverse.leftOp ⋙
      (overSpecEquivUnder P hQi S).functor.rightOp :=
   (NatIso.op <| (overSpecEquivUnder P hQi S).counitIso)
  let iso2 : (Under.pushout (RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q) ⊤ f).op ≅
      (overSpecEquivUnder P hQi R).inverse.leftOp ⋙ Over.pullback P ⊤ (Spec.map f) ⋙
      (overSpecEquivUnder P hQi S).functor.rightOp :=
    (Functor.rightUnitor _).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ e'' ≪≫
      (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Functor.leftUnitor _).symm _ ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Functor.isoWhiskerRight e' _) _ ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Functor.associator _ _ _) _ ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ foo.symm) _ ≪≫ Functor.associator _ _ _
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · convert preservesLimitsOfShape_of_op _ _
    convert preservesColimitsOfShape_of_natIso iso2.symm
    exact preservesColimitsOfShape_of_equiv (opOpEquivalence J).symm _
  · convert preservesColimitsOfShape_of_op _ _
    exact preservesLimitsOfShape_of_natIso iso

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocalAtTarget.iff_of_openCover_of_over
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocalAtTarget.iff_of_openCover_of_over
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over S] [Y.Over S]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver S] (𝒰 : S.OpenCover) :
    P f ↔ ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      P (pullback.map (X ↘ S) (𝒰.f i) (Y ↘ S) (𝒰.f i) f (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
        (by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact HomIsOver.comp_over.symm)
        (by rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]))
proof:
:= by
  let s : X ⟶ S := X ↘ S
  let t : Y ⟶ S := Y ↘ S
  have hover : f ≫ t = s := HomIsOver.comp_over
  let a (i : 𝒰.I₀) :
      pullback f (pullback.fst t (𝒰.f i)) ≅ pullback (f ≫ t) (𝒰.f i) :=
    pullbackRightPullbackFstIso t (𝒰.f i) f
  let c (i : 𝒰.I₀) : pullback (f ≫ t) (𝒰.f i) ≅ pullback s (𝒰.f i) :=
    pullback.congrHom hover rfl
  let m (i : 𝒰.I₀) : pullback s (𝒰.f i) ⟶ pullback t (𝒰.f i) :=
    pullback.map s (𝒰.f i) t (𝒰.f i) f (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
      (by simpa only [Category.comp_id] using hover.symm)
      (by rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
  have heq (i : 𝒰.I₀) :
      pullback.snd f (pullback.fst t (𝒰.f i)) =
        (a i).hom ≫ (c i).hom ≫ m i := by
    let u : 𝒰.X i ⟶ S := 𝒰.f i
    change pullback.snd f (pullback.fst t u) =
      (a i).hom ≫ (c i).hom ≫ m i
    have hm_fst : m i ≫ pullback.fst t u = pullback.fst s u ≫ f := by
      dsimp only [m, pullback.map, u]
      rw [pullback.lift_fst]
    have hm_snd : m i ≫ pullback.snd t u = pullback.snd s u := by
      dsimp only [m, pullback.map, u]
      rw [pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id]
    have hc_fst : (c i).hom ≫ pullback.fst s u = pullback.fst (f ≫ t) u := by
      dsimp only [c, pullback.congrHom, pullback.map, u]
      rw [asIso_hom, pullback.lift_fst, Category.comp_id]
    have hc_snd : (c i).hom ≫ pullback.snd s u = pullback.snd (f ≫ t) u := by
      dsimp only [c, pullback.congrHom, pullback.map, u]
      rw [asIso_hom, pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id]
    have ha_fst : (a i).hom ≫ pullback.fst (f ≫ t) u =
        pullback.fst f (pullback.fst t u) :=
      pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_hom_fst t u f
    have ha_snd : (a i).hom ≫ pullback.snd (f ≫ t) u =
        pullback.snd f (pullback.fst t u) ≫ pullback.snd t u :=
      pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_hom_snd t u f
    apply pullback.hom_ext
    · calc
        pullback.snd f (pullback.fst t u) ≫ pullback.fst t u =
            pullback.fst f (pullback.fst t u) ≫ f :=
          pullback.condition.symm
        _ = ((a i).hom ≫ pullback.fst (f ≫ t) u) ≫ f :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ f) ha_fst.symm
        _ = (a i).hom ≫ (pullback.fst (f ≫ t) u ≫ f) :=
          Category.assoc _ _ _
        _ = (a i).hom ≫ (((c i).hom ≫ pullback.fst s u) ≫ f) :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ (a i).hom ≫ (k ≫ f)) hc_fst.symm
        _ = (a i).hom ≫ ((c i).hom ≫ (pullback.fst s u ≫ f)) :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ (a i).hom ≫ k) (Category.assoc _ _ _)
        _ = (a i).hom ≫ ((c i).hom ≫ (m i ≫ pullback.fst t u)) :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ (a i).hom ≫ ((c i).hom ≫ k)) hm_fst.symm
        _ = ((a i).hom ≫ (c i).hom ≫ m i) ≫ pullback.fst t u := by
          simp only [Category.assoc]
    · calc
        pullback.snd f (pullback.fst t u) ≫ pullback.snd t u =
            (a i).hom ≫ pullback.snd (f ≫ t) u :=
          ha_snd.symm
        _ = (a i).hom ≫ ((c i).hom ≫ pullback.snd s u) :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ (a i).hom ≫ k) hc_snd.symm
        _ = (a i).hom ≫ ((c i).hom ≫ (m i ≫ pullback.snd t u)) :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ (a i).hom ≫ ((c i).hom ≫ k)) hm_snd.symm
        _ = ((a i).hom ≫ (c i).hom ≫ m i) ≫ pullback.snd t u := by
          simp only [Category.assoc]
  refine ⟨fun hf i ↦ ?_, fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  · let _ : IsOpenImmersion (pullback.fst t (𝒰.f i)) :=
      MorphismProperty.pullback_fst t (𝒰.f i) (𝒰.map_prop i)
    have hpb : P (pullback.snd f (pullback.fst t (𝒰.f i))) :=
      IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_isPullback (.of_hasPullback _ _) hf
    rw [heq i] at hpb
    let ha : IsIso (a i).hom := (a i).isIso_hom
    let hc : IsIso (c i).hom := (c i).isIso_hom
    exact (P.cancel_left_of_respectsIso (c i).hom (m i)).mp
      ((P.cancel_left_of_respectsIso (a i).hom ((c i).hom ≫ m i)).mp hpb)
  · rw [IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.iff_of_openCover (P := P) (𝒰.pullback₁ (Y ↘ S))]
    have hdirect : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
        P (pullback.snd f (pullback.fst t (𝒰.f i))) := by
      intro i
      let ha : IsIso (a i).hom := (a i).isIso_hom
      let hc : IsIso (c i).hom := (c i).isIso_hom
      have hm : P (m i) := by
        simpa only [m] using H i
      have hcomp : P ((a i).hom ≫ (c i).hom ≫ m i) :=
        (P.cancel_left_of_respectsIso (a i).hom ((c i).hom ≫ m i)).2
          ((P.cancel_left_of_respectsIso (c i).hom (m i)).2 hm)
      rw [heq i]
      exact hcomp
    simpa only [Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom,
      Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.pullback₁, PreZeroHypercover.pullback₁, t] using hdirect

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocalAtTarget.left_iff_of_openCover
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocalAtTarget.left_iff_of_openCover
    {S : Scheme.{u}} {X Y : W.Over Q S} {f : X ⟶ Y} (𝒰 : S.OpenCover) :
    P f.left ↔ ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      P ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback W Q (𝒰.f i)).map f).left
proof:
:=
  by
    let _ : Scheme.Hom.IsOver f.left S := ⟨by
      change f.left ≫ Y.hom = X.hom
      exact MorphismProperty.Over.w f⟩
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocalAtTarget.iff_of_openCover_of_over
      (P := P) (X := X.left) (Y := Y.left) (S := S) f.left 𝒰

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AffineAnd.preservesFiniteColimits_pullback
statement:
nonrec theorem preservesFiniteColimits_pullback (hQi : RingHom.RespectsIso Q)
    (hQp : RingHom.HasFiniteProducts Q) (hQe : RingHom.HasEqualizers Q)
    [(RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q).IsStableUnderCobaseChange]
    [∀ (R S : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : R ⟶ S), PreservesFiniteLimits
      (Under.pushout (RingHom.toMorphismProperty Q) ⊤ f)]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    PreservesFiniteColimits (Over.pullback P ⊤ f)
proof:
:= by
  have (S : Scheme.{u}) : HasFiniteColimits (P.Over ⊤ S) := hasFiniteColimits P hQi hQp hQe
  constructor
  intro J _ _
  constructor
  intro D
  suffices h : IsIso (colimit.post D (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback P ⊤ f)).left by
    have : IsIso (colimit.post D (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback P ⊤ f)) := by
      convert isIso_of_reflects_iso _ (Over.forget P ⊤ X ⋙ Over.forget X)
      exact h
    apply preservesColimit_of_isIso_post
  change isomorphisms Scheme.{u} _
  wlog H : (∃ R, Y = Spec R) ∧ ∃ S, X = Spec S generalizing X Y D f
  · let 𝒰X : X.OpenCover :=
      (Scheme.OpenCover.affineRefinement (Y.affineCover.pullback₁ f)).openCover
    rw [IsLocalAtTarget.left_iff_of_openCover (P := isomorphisms Scheme) 𝒰X]
    intro i
    let uᵢ : Y.affineCover.X i.1 ⟶ Y := Y.affineCover.f i.1
    let _ : IsAffine (𝒰X.X i) := by
      dsimp only [𝒰X]
      exact Scheme.isAffine_affineOpenCover X
        (Scheme.OpenCover.affineRefinement (Y.affineCover.pullback₁ f)) i
    let _ : IsOpenImmersion (𝒰X.f i) := 𝒰X.map_prop i
    let _ : IsAffine (Y.affineCover.X i.1) :=
      Scheme.isAffine_affineCover Y i.1
    let _ : IsOpenImmersion uᵢ := by
      dsimp only [uᵢ]
      exact Y.affineCover.map_prop i.1
    let _ : PreservesFiniteColimits (toAffine P X) :=
      preservesFiniteColimits_toAffine P hQi hQp hQe
    let _ : PreservesFiniteColimits (toAffine P Y) :=
      preservesFiniteColimits_toAffine P hQi hQp hQe
    let _ : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (toAffine P X) := inferInstance
    let _ : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (toAffine P Y) := inferInstance
    let _ : PreservesFiniteColimits (Affine.pullback (𝒰X.f i)) := inferInstance
    let _ : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (Affine.pullback (𝒰X.f i)) := inferInstance
    let _ : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (Over.pullback P ⊤ (𝒰X.f i)) :=
      preservesColimitsOfShape_pullback_of_toAffine P (𝒰X.f i)
    let _ : PreservesFiniteColimits (Affine.pullback uᵢ) := inferInstance
    let _ : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (Affine.pullback uᵢ) := inferInstance
    let _ : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (Over.pullback P ⊤ uᵢ) :=
      preservesColimitsOfShape_pullback_of_toAffine P uᵢ
    let r : 𝒰X.X i ⟶ pullback f uᵢ :=
      (Scheme.OpenCover.fromAffineRefinement
        (Y.affineCover.pullback₁ f)).h₀ i
    let q₀ := colimit.post (D ⋙ Over.pullback P ⊤ f)
      (Over.pullback P ⊤ (𝒰X.f i))
    let _ : IsIso q₀ := by
      dsimp only [q₀]
      infer_instance
    let _ : IsIso q₀.left := by
      change IsIso ((Over.forget P ⊤ _ ⋙ Over.forget _).map q₀)
      exact Functor.map_isIso _ q₀
    rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso
      (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme) q₀.left]
    dsimp only [q₀]
    erw [← MorphismProperty.Comma.comp_left]
    simp only [colimit.post_post]
    have heq : 𝒰X.f i = r ≫ pullback.fst f uᵢ := by
      change 𝒰X.f i = r ≫ (Y.affineCover.pullback₁ f).f i.fst
      exact (Scheme.OpenCover.fromAffineRefinement (Y.affineCover.pullback₁ f)).w₀ i |>.symm
    let aux : 𝒰X.X i ⟶ Y.affineCover.X i.fst :=
      r ≫ pullback.snd f uᵢ
    have hpb : pullback.fst f uᵢ ≫ f = pullback.snd f uᵢ ≫ uᵢ :=
      pullback.condition
    have hbase : 𝒰X.f i ≫ f = aux ≫ uᵢ := by
      calc
        𝒰X.f i ≫ f =
            (r ≫ pullback.fst f uᵢ) ≫ f :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ f) heq
        _ = r ≫ (pullback.fst f uᵢ ≫ f) :=
          Category.assoc _ _ _
        _ = r ≫ (pullback.snd f uᵢ ≫ uᵢ) :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ r ≫ k) hpb
        _ = (r ≫ pullback.snd f uᵢ) ≫ uᵢ :=
          (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = aux ≫ uᵢ := rfl
    let natiso :
        Over.pullback P ⊤ f ⋙ Over.pullback P ⊤ (𝒰X.f i) ≅
          Over.pullback P ⊤ uᵢ ⋙
            MorphismProperty.Over.pullback P ⊤
              aux :=
              
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp _ _).symm ≪≫
        MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackCongr hbase ≪≫
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp _ _)
    let e := colimit.arrowMkPostIsoOfIso D _ _ natiso
    let p := colimit.post D
      (Over.pullback P ⊤ f ⋙ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback P ⊤ (𝒰X.f i))
    have hp : IsIso p := by
      let F := Over.pullback P ⊤ uᵢ
      let G := Over.pullback P ⊤ aux
      let q₁ := colimit.post (D ⋙ F) G
      let q₂ := G.map (colimit.post D F)
      let q := colimit.post D (F ⋙ G)
      have hq₁Left : isomorphisms Scheme q₁.left := by
        dsimp only [q₁, F, G]
        exact this _ ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩
      let _ :
          IsIso ((Over.forget P ⊤ _ ⋙ Over.forget _).map q₁) := by
        change IsIso q₁.left
        simpa only [isomorphisms.iff] using hq₁Left
      let hq₁ : IsIso q₁ := by
        exact isIso_of_reflects_iso q₁ (Over.forget P ⊤ _ ⋙ Over.forget _)
      let _ : IsIso (colimit.post D F) := by
        dsimp only [F]
        infer_instance
      let hq₂ : IsIso q₂ := by
        dsimp only [q₂]
        infer_instance
      have hq : q₁ ≫ q₂ = q := by
        exact colimit.post_post D F G
      have hqComp : IsIso (q₁ ≫ q₂) :=
        @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ q₁ q₂ hq₁ hq₂
      let hqIso : IsIso q := hq ▸ hqComp
      change isomorphisms _ _
      apply ((isomorphisms _).arrow_mk_iso_iff e).2
      simp only [isomorphisms.iff]
      change IsIso q
      exact hqIso
    simp only [isomorphisms.iff]
    let forget := Over.forget P ⊤ (𝒰X.X i) ⋙ Over.forget (𝒰X.X i)
    let _ : IsIso p := hp
    change IsIso (forget.map p)
    exact Functor.map_isIso forget p
  obtain ⟨⟨R, rfl⟩, ⟨S, rfl⟩⟩ := H
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := Spec.map_surjective f
  have : PreservesColimitsOfShape J (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback P ⊤ (Spec.map φ)) := by
    rw [preservesColimitsOfShape_pullback_iff_preservesLimitsOfShape _ hQi]
    infer_instance
  simp only [isomorphisms.iff]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Cover.ColimitGluingData.pullbackGluedIso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma Scheme.Cover.ColimitGluingData.pullbackGluedIso_hom (i : 𝒰.I₀) :
    (d.pullbackGluedIso i).hom.left ≫ colimit.ι d.relativeGluingData.functor i =
      pullback.fst _ _
proof:
:= by
  let e :
      ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback P ⊤ (𝒰.f i)).obj d.glued).left ≅
        (d.cocone i).pt.left :=
    (MorphismProperty.Over.forget P ⊤ _ ⋙ Over.forget _).mapIso
      (d.pullbackGluedIso i)
  change e.hom ≫ colimit.ι d.relativeGluingData.functor i =
    pullback.fst d.glued.hom (𝒰.f i)
  rw [← d.pullbackGluedIso_inv_fst i]
  exact e.hom_inv_id_assoc (pullback.fst d.glued.hom (𝒰.f i))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Γ_isPushout
statement:
lemma Γ_isPushout {P : Scheme.{u}} {fst : P ⟶ X} {snd : P ⟶ Y} (h : IsPullback fst snd f g) :
    IsPushout (f.app ⊤) (g.app ⊤) (fst.app ⊤) (snd.app ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsAffine (pullback f g) := inferInstance
  let iso : P ≅ pullback f g := h.isoPullback
  have : IsAffine P := .of_isIso iso.hom
  let h' : IsPullback (AffineScheme.ofHom fst) (AffineScheme.ofHom snd)
      (AffineScheme.ofHom f) (AffineScheme.ofHom g) := by
    apply IsPullback.of_map (F := AffineScheme.forgetToScheme.{u}) (ObjectProperty.hom_ext _ h.w)
    exact h
  have h'' := AffineScheme.Γ.rightOp.map_isPullback h'
  have h2 := h''.unop
  exact h2.flip

statement:
lemma _root_.AlgHom.equalizerCongr_symm_apply {R A A' B B' : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [Semiring A] [Semiring A'] [Semiring B] [Semiring B']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R A'] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R B']
    (eA : A ≃ₐ[R] A') (eB : B ≃ₐ[R] B')
    {f g : A →ₐ[R] B} {f' g' : A' →ₐ[R] B'}
    (hf : eB.toAlgHom.comp f = f'.comp eA) (hg : eB.toAlgHom.comp g = g'.comp eA)
    (x : AlgHom.equalizer f' g') :

name: AlgHom.equalizerCancelBaseChange_tmul

@[simp]
lemma _root_.AlgHom.equalizerCancelBaseChange_tmul (f g : A →ₐ[R] B) (T : Type u) [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R T] (x : A) (hx : x ∈ AlgHom.equalizer f g) :
    ((AlgHom.equalizerCancelBaseChange S f g T)
      ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[T] (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x), by simp [show f x = g x from hx]⟩) =
        ⟨1 ⊗ₜ x, by simp [show f x = g x from hx]⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext : 1
  simp [AlgHom.equalizerCancelBaseChange, AlgHom.equalizerCongr_apply]

name: AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
lemma _root_.AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv_symm_apply
    {R : Type*} (S : Type*) [CommRing R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (T : Type*) [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (f g : A →ₐ[R] B) [Module.Flat R T]
    (x : A) (hx : x ∈ AlgHom.equalizer f g) :
    (f.tensorEqualizerEquiv S T g).symm ⟨1 ⊗ₜ x, by simp [show f x = g x from hx]⟩ =
      1 ⊗ₜ ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply (f.tensorEqualizerEquiv S T g).injective
  ext : 1
  simp only [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv_apply,
    AlgHom.coe_tensorEqualizer, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply,
    Subalgebra.coe_val]

name: Algebra.auxEquivRHS_symm_tmul
statement:
lemma auxEquivRHS_symm_tmul (f g : A →ₐ[R] B) (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
    [Module.Flat R T] (x : S) :
    (auxEquivRHS (S := S) f g T).symm (algebraMap (T ⊗[R] S) _ (1 ⊗ₜ x)) =
      1 ⊗ₜ algebraMap _ _ x
proof:
:= by
  apply (auxEquivRHS (S := S) f g T).injective
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply (f.equalizerCancelBaseChange S g T).injective
  change _ = (f.equalizerCancelBaseChange S g T)
    ((f.equalizerCancelBaseChange S g T).symm _)
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [AlgHom.equalizerCancelBaseChange_algebraMap, SubalgebraClass.coe_algebraMap,
    TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, AlgEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe,
    EquivLike.coe_coe, TensorProduct.congr_apply, AlgEquiv.refl_toAlgHom,
    TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    AlgHom.equalizerRestrictScalars_symm_apply, AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv_apply,
    AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgHom.equalizerRestrictScalars_apply]
  change
    (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A) =
      (TensorProduct.assoc R R T T S A).symm
        (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)))
  rw [TensorProduct.assoc_symm_tmul]

name: Algebra.auxEquivRHS_symm_tmul'
statement:
lemma auxEquivRHS_symm_tmul' (f g : A →ₐ[R] B) (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
    [Module.Flat R T] (x : AlgHom.equalizer f g) :
    (auxEquivRHS (S := S) f g T).symm ⟨1 ⊗ₜ (1 ⊗ₜ x), by simp [show f x = g x from x.2]⟩ =
      1 ⊗ₜ ⟨1 ⊗ₜ x, by simp [show f x = g x from x.2]⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply (auxEquivRHS (S := S) f g T).injective
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply (f.equalizerCancelBaseChange S g T).injective
  change _ = (f.equalizerCancelBaseChange S g T)
    ((f.equalizerCancelBaseChange S g T).symm _)
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [SetLike.coe_mem, AlgHom.equalizerCancelBaseChange_tmul, AlgEquiv.toEquiv_eq_coe,
    EquivLike.coe_coe, TensorProduct.congr_apply, AlgEquiv.refl_toAlgHom,
    TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    AlgHom.equalizerRestrictScalars_symm_apply, AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv_apply,
    AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgHom.equalizerRestrictScalars_apply]
  change
    (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S)) ⊗ₜ[R] (x : A) =
      (TensorProduct.assoc R R T T S A).symm
        (1 ⊗ₜ[R] ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] (x : A)))
  rw [TensorProduct.assoc_symm_tmul]

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tensorEqualizer_bijective_iff_tensorEqualizer_map_bijective
statement:
lemma TensorProduct.map_tensorEqualizer_bijective_iff_tensorEqualizer_map_bijective
    (f g : A →ₐ[R] B) (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Module.Flat R T] :
    Function.Bijective ⇑(TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id T T) (AlgHom.tensorEqualizer R S f g)) ↔
    Function.Bijective
            ((TensorProduct.map (.id T T) f).tensorEqualizer T (T ⊗[R] S)
                  (TensorProduct.map (.id T T) g))
proof:
:= by
  let eLHS : T ⊗[R] (S ⊗[R] f ≟ₐ g) ≃ₐ[T] (T ⊗[R] S) ⊗[T]
      ((T ⊗ₘ f) ≟ₐ (T ⊗ₘ g)) :=
    auxEquivLHS f g T
  let fTS :
      (T ⊗[R] S) ⊗[T] (T ⊗[R] A) →ₐ[T ⊗[R] S]
        (T ⊗[R] S) ⊗[T] (T ⊗[R] B) :=
    TensorProduct.map (.id (T ⊗[R] S) (T ⊗[R] S))
      (TensorProduct.map (.id T T) f)
  let gTS :
      (T ⊗[R] S) ⊗[T] (T ⊗[R] A) →ₐ[T ⊗[R] S]
        (T ⊗[R] S) ⊗[T] (T ⊗[R] B) :=
    TensorProduct.map (.id (T ⊗[R] S) (T ⊗[R] S))
      (TensorProduct.map (.id T T) g)
  let eRestrict :
      (TensorProduct.map (.id T (T ⊗[R] S)) (T ⊗ₘ f) ≟ₐ
          TensorProduct.map (.id T (T ⊗[R] S)) (T ⊗ₘ g)) ≃ₐ[T]
        (fTS ≟ₐ gTS) :=
    AlgHom.equalizerRestrictScalars T fTS gTS
  let eRHS : T ⊗[R] ((S ⊗ₘ f) ≟ₐ (S ⊗ₘ g)) ≃ₐ[T]
      (TensorProduct.map (.id T (T ⊗[R] S)) (T ⊗ₘ f) ≟ₐ
        TensorProduct.map (.id T (T ⊗[R] S)) (T ⊗ₘ g)) :=
    (auxEquivRHS f g T).trans eRestrict.symm
  have : IsScalarTower R T
      (T ⊗[R] ↥(TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R S) f ≟ₐ TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R S) g)) :=
    TensorProduct.isScalarTower_left
  let u := (TensorProduct.map (.id T T) f).tensorEqualizer T (T ⊗[R] S)
    (TensorProduct.map (.id T T) g)
  have heq : TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id T T) (AlgHom.tensorEqualizer R S f g) =
      eRHS.symm.toAlgHom.comp
        (((TensorProduct.map (.id T T) f).tensorEqualizer T (T ⊗[R] S)
            (TensorProduct.map (.id T T) g)).comp
          eLHS.toAlgHom) := by
    ext x
    · simp only [TensorProduct.map_restrictScalars_comp_includeRight, AlgHom.coe_comp,
        Function.comp_apply, TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
      change _ = eRHS.symm
        (((TensorProduct.map (.id T T) f).tensorEqualizer T (T ⊗[R] S)
          (TensorProduct.map (.id T T) g)) (eLHS (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (x ⊗ₜ[R] 1))))
      simp only [auxEquivLHS_one_tmul_one, eLHS]
      change 1 ⊗ₜ[R] (AlgHom.tensorEqualizer S S f g) (x ⊗ₜ 1) = eRHS.symm
        ((AlgHom.tensorEqualizer T (T ⊗[R] S)
          (TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id T T) f) (TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id T T) g))
          ((1 ⊗ₜ[R] x) ⊗ₜ[T] 1))
      rw [AlgHom.tensorEqualizer_tmul_one, AlgHom.tensorEqualizer_tmul_one']
      calc
        _ = (auxEquivRHS (S := S) f g T).symm
            (algebraMap (T ⊗[R] S) _ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x)) :=
          (auxEquivRHS_symm_tmul (S := S) f g T x).symm
        _ = _ := by
          dsimp [eRHS, eRestrict, fTS, gTS]
          congr 1
    · simp only [TensorProduct.map_restrictScalars_comp_includeRight, AlgHom.coe_comp,
        AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars', Function.comp_apply, TensorProduct.includeRight_apply,
        eLHS]
      change _ = eRHS.symm (u (eLHS (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x))))
      rw [auxEquivLHS_one_one_tmul]
      rw [AlgHom.tensorEqualizer_one_tmul, AlgHom.tensorEqualizer_one_tmul]
      calc
        _ = (auxEquivRHS (S := S) f g T).symm
            ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[T] (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x), by simp [show f x = g x from x.2]⟩ :=
          (auxEquivRHS_symm_tmul' (S := S) f g T x).symm
        _ = _ := by
          dsimp [eRHS, eRestrict, fTS, gTS]
          congr 1
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [heq] at H
    rw [← Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff _ eLHS.bijective]
    rw [← Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff' eRHS.symm.bijective]
    exact H
  · rw [heq]
    apply eRHS.symm.bijective.comp
    exact H.comp eLHS.bijective

name: RingHom.OfLocalizationSpan.of_exists_of_isPrime
statement:
lemma RingHom.OfLocalizationSpan.of_exists_of_isPrime
    (hP : RingHom.OfLocalizationSpan P)
    {R S : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (H : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], ∃ r ∉ p, P (Localization.awayMap f r)) :
    P f
proof:
:= by
  have := H
  choose u hu₁ hu₂ using this
  apply hP f (Set.range (fun p : PrimeSpectrum R ↦ u p.asIdeal))
  · rw [← PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff]
    rw [_root_.eq_top_iff]
    rintro p -
    simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.iSup_mk, TopologicalSpace.Opens.carrier_eq_coe,
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_compl]
    simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_mk, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_compl_iff,
      PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]
    use p
    apply hu₁
  · rintro ⟨p, ⟨p, rfl⟩⟩
    apply hu₂

name: IsUnit.tmul
statement:
lemma IsUnit.tmul {R S T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra R S] {s : S} {t : T} (hs : IsUnit s) (ht : IsUnit t) :
    IsUnit (s ⊗ₜ[R] t)
proof:

name: RingHom.OfLocalizationSpan.of_exists_of_isPrime'
statement:
lemma RingHom.OfLocalizationSpan.of_exists_of_isPrime'
    {P : ∀ {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S], (R →+* S) → Prop}
    (hP : RingHom.OfLocalizationSpan P)
    (hPi : RingHom.RespectsIso P)
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (H : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], ∃ r ∉ p,
      P (algebraMap (Localization.Away r) (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] S))) :
    P (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  apply hP.of_exists_of_isPrime
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hf⟩ := H p
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  have : IsLocalization.Away ((Algebra.ofId R S) r) (Localization.Away ((algebraMap R S) r)) :=
    inferInstanceAs <| IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R S r) _
  let u : Localization.Away r →ₐ[R] Localization.Away ((algebraMap R S) r) :=
    Localization.awayMapₐ (Algebra.ofId R S) r
  let v : S →ₐ[R] Localization.Away ((algebraMap R S) r) :=
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R S (Localization.Away ((algebraMap R S) r))
  let e₀ : S ⊗[R] Localization.Away r ≃ₐ[R] Localization.Away (algebraMap R S r) :=
    (IsLocalization.Away.tensorEquiv _ r (Localization.Away r)).restrictScalars R
  let e : Localization.Away r ⊗[R] S ≃+* Localization.Away (algebraMap R S r) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R _ _).trans e₀
  have : Localization.awayMap (algebraMap R S) r =
      e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap (Localization.Away r) (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] S)) := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers r)
    ext x
    simp [e, Localization.awayMap, IsLocalization.Away.map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul]
  rw [this]
  exact hPi.left _ _ hf

name: RingHom.OfLocalizationSpan.pi
statement:
lemma OfLocalizationSpan.pi (hP : OfLocalizationSpan P)
    (hPi : RespectsIso P)
    {ι : Type u} [_root_.Finite ι]
    (R : ι → Type u) (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (R i)]
    [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] (f : ∀ i, R i →+* S i)
    (hf : ∀ i, P (f i)) :
    P (RingHom.pi <| fun i ↦ (f i).comp <| Pi.evalRingHom R i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Ideal.span_single_eq_top R
  apply hP.ofIsLocalization hPi _ _ this
  rintro ⟨r, i, rfl⟩
  let i₁ : Algebra (∀ i, R i) (R i) := (Pi.evalRingHom R i).toAlgebra
  let i₂ : Algebra (∀ i, S i) (S i) := (Pi.evalRingHom S i).toAlgebra
  refine ⟨R i, S i, inferInstance, inferInstance, i₁, i₂, ?_, ?_, f i, ?_, hf i⟩
  · refine IsLocalization.away_of_isIdempotentElem ?_ (RingHom.ker_evalRingHom _ _)
      ((Pi.evalRingHom R i).surjective)
    simp [IsIdempotentElem, ← Pi.single_mul_left]
  · have : (RingHom.pi fun i ↦ (f i).comp <| Pi.evalRingHom R i)
        (Pi.single i 1) = Pi.single i 1 := by
      ext j
      simp only [Pi.single, RingHom.pi_apply, coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Pi.evalRingHom_apply,
        Function.update, Pi.zero_apply]
      by_cases h : j = i
      · subst h
        simp only [dite_true, map_one]
      · simp [h]
    change IsLocalization.Away
      ((RingHom.pi fun i ↦ (f i).comp <| Pi.evalRingHom R i) (Pi.single i 1)) (S i)
    rw [this]
    refine IsLocalization.away_of_isIdempotentElem ?_ (RingHom.ker_evalRingHom _ _)
      ((Pi.evalRingHom S i).surjective)
    simp [IsIdempotentElem, ← Pi.single_mul_left]
  · ext j x
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]

name: RingHom.CodescendsAlong.of_forall_flat
statement:
lemma CodescendsAlong.of_forall_flat {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (hPi : RespectsIso P) (hPl : OfLocalizationSpan P) (hP : CodescendsAlong P FaithfullyFlat)
    {ι : Type u} (T : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (T i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra R (T i)] [∀ i, Module.Flat R (T i)]
    (ho : ∀ i, IsOpen <| Set.range <| PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (T i)))
    (hunion : ⋃ i, Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (T i))) = Set.univ)
    (H : ∀ i, P (algebraMap (T i) (T i ⊗[R] S))) :
    P (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U (i : ι) : Set (PrimeSpectrum R) :=
    Set.range <| PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R (T i))
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover U (fun p ↦ ho _) (hunion ▸ le_rfl)
  let A : Type u := ∀ (p : t), T p.1
  have : Module.FaithfullyFlat R A := by
    apply Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_comap_surjective
    intro p
    obtain ⟨i, hi, q, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht (Set.mem_univ p))
    use (PrimeSpectrum.comap <| Pi.evalRingHom (fun p : t ↦ T p.1) ⟨i, hi⟩) q
    rfl
  apply hP.algebraMap_tensorProduct (R := R) (S := A) (T := S)
  · rwa [faithfullyFlat_algebraMap_iff]
  · let e : A ⊗[R] S ≃ₐ[R] ∀ i : t, T i.val ⊗[R] S :=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm ..).trans <|
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight R R S (fun i : t ↦ T i)).trans <|
          .piCongrRight fun i ↦ Algebra.TensorProduct.comm ..
    have : algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] S) = e.symm.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap A <| ∀ p : t, T p.1 ⊗[R] S) := by
      ext i x
      apply e.injective
      change e ((algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] S)) (Pi.single i x)) =
        e (e.symm ((algebraMap A (∀ p : t, T p.1 ⊗[R] S)) (Pi.single i x)))
      rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
      ext j
      rw [Pi.algebraMap_instAlgebraForall_apply]
      change
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R S (T j.val))
          (((Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight R R S (fun k : t ↦ T k.val))
            ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R A S)
              ((algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] S)) (Pi.single i x)))) j) =
          (algebraMap (T j.val) (T j.val ⊗[R] S))
            ((Pi.single i x : ∀ k : t, T k.val) j)
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply,
        Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
      exact (congrArg
        (fun z : ∀ k : t, S ⊗[R] T k.val =>
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R S (T j.val)) (z j))
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight_tmul R R S
          (fun k : t => T k.val) (1 : S)
          (Pi.single i x : ∀ k : t, T k.val))).trans
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul R (1 : S)
          ((Pi.single i x : ∀ k : t, T k.val) j))
    rw [this]
    apply hPi.1
    exact hPl.pi hPi _ _ _ (fun i ↦ H i.1)

name: RingHom.CodescendsAlong.of_forall_exists_flat
statement:
lemma CodescendsAlong.of_forall_exists_flat {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (hPi : RespectsIso P) (hPl : OfLocalizationSpan P)
    (hP : CodescendsAlong P FaithfullyFlat)
    (H : ∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum R), ∃ (T : Type u) (_ : CommRing T) (_ : Algebra R T),
      p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R T)) ∧ Module.Flat R T ∧
      IsOpen (Set.range <| PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R T)) ∧
      P (algebraMap T (T ⊗[R] S))) :
    P (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  choose T h1 h2 hmem _ ho hT using H
  exact hP.of_forall_flat _ hPi hPl T ho (Set.iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr fun p ↦ ⟨p, hmem p⟩) hT

name: RingHom.PrimeSpectrum.range_comap_tensorProduct
statement:
lemma PrimeSpectrum.range_comap_tensorProduct (R S T : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T] :
    Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap <| algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] T)) =
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) ⁻¹'
        (Set.range <| PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R T))
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    use PrimeSpectrum.comap Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom p
    have : (algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] T)).comp (algebraMap R S) =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R T) :=
      (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S (S ⊗[R] T)).symm.trans
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.comp_algebraMap.symm
    exact congr(PrimeSpectrum.comap $(this) p).symm
  · rintro ⟨q, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback
      (X := Spec <| .of S) (Y := Spec <| .of T) (S := Spec <| .of R)
        (f := Spec.map <| CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))
        (g := Spec.map <| CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R T)) p q hp.symm
    let e : pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R T))) ≅ Spec (.of <| S ⊗[R] T) :=
      pullbackSpecIso R S T
    use e.hom.base z
    rw [← hz.1, ← pullbackSpecIso_hom_fst]
    rfl

name: RingHom.CodescendsAlong.algHom_of_forall_exists_flat
statement:
lemma CodescendsAlong.algHom_of_forall_exists_flat {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (hPi : RespectsIso P) (hPl : OfLocalizationSpan P)
    (hP : CodescendsAlong P FaithfullyFlat)
    (f : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (H : ∀ (p : PrimeSpectrum R), ∃ (T : Type u) (_ : CommRing T) (_ : Algebra R T),
      p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R T)) ∧ Module.Flat R T ∧
      IsOpen (Set.range <| PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R T)) ∧
      P (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id T T) f).toRingHom) :
    P f.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f.toRingHom]
  apply hP.of_forall_exists_flat _ hPi hPl
  intro p
  obtain ⟨T, _, _, ⟨q, hq⟩, hflat, ho, hp⟩ :=
    H (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R A) p)
  have heq : Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] T))) =
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R A)) ⁻¹'
        (Set.range <| PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R T)) :=
    PrimeSpectrum.range_comap_tensorProduct R A T
  let e : T ⊗[R] B ≃ₐ[R] (A ⊗[R] T) ⊗[A] B :=
    .trans ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm _ _ _).restrictScalars R)
      (.trans
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange R A A B T).symm.restrictScalars R)
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm _ _ _).restrictScalars R))
  have hdiag' :
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R (A ⊗[R] T) ((A ⊗[R] T) ⊗[A] B) =
      (AlgHom.comp e.toAlgHom
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id T T) f).restrictScalars R)).comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm _ _ _).toAlgHom := by
    ext a
    · suffices h : (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : T)) ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B) = (1 ⊗ₜ[R] 1) ⊗ₜ[A] f a by
        simp [e, h]
      rw [← mul_one a, ← smul_eq_mul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.smul_tmul,
        Algebra.smul_def, mul_one, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
        AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, coe_coe]
    · simp [e]
  replace hdiag' := congr($(hdiag').toRingHom)
  simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom, AlgHom.comp_toRingHom] at hdiag'
  refine ⟨A ⊗[R] T, inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_, inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [heq]
    use q
  · rw [heq]
    exact ho.preimage (PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap _)
  · rw [hdiag']
    exact hPi.2 _ (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R A T).toRingEquiv (hPi.1 _ _ hp)

name: AlgHom.IsSplit.mk
statement:
lemma AlgHom.IsSplit.mk (f : A →ₐ[R] B) {E F : Type*} [_root_.Finite E] [_root_.Finite F]
    (eA : A ≃ₐ[R] (E → R)) (eB : B ≃ₐ[R] (F → R)) (σ : F → E)
    (h : eB.toAlgHom.comp f = (AlgHom.compRight R R σ).comp eA.toAlgHom) :
    f.IsSplit
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype E
  cases nonempty_fintype F
  let eE := Fintype.equivFin E
  let eF := Fintype.equivFin F
  refine ⟨Fintype.card E, Fintype.card F, eA.trans ?_, eB.trans ?_, eE ∘ σ ∘ eF.symm, ?_⟩
  · exact AlgEquiv.piCongrLeft R (fun _ ↦ R) eE
  · exact AlgEquiv.piCongrLeft R (fun _ ↦ R) eF
  · ext x
    apply eB.injective
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun h x
    simp only [coe_comp, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, Function.comp_apply] at this
    ext i
    simp [this, AlgHom.compRight]

name: AlgHom.compRight_apply'
statement:
lemma AlgHom.compRight_apply' {E F : Type*} (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (σ : E → F) (x : F → S) :
    AlgHom.compRight R S σ x = fun i ↦ x (σ i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgHom.IsSplit.tensorProductMap
statement:
lemma AlgHom.IsSplit.tensorProductMap {f : A →ₐ[R] B} (hf : f.IsSplit) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id S S) f).IsSplit
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, m, eA, eB, σ, hf⟩ := hf
  refine AlgHom.IsSplit.mk (E := Fin n) (F := Fin m) _
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr .refl eA).trans (Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight ..))
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.congr .refl eB).trans (Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight ..)) σ ?_
  ext a
  simp [hf]

name: AlgHom.IsSplit.iff_of_isScalarTower
statement:
lemma AlgHom.IsSplit.iff_of_isScalarTower
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T]
    [IsScalarTower R S T] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id T T) f).IsSplit ↔
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id T T)
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id S S) f)).IsSplit
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, m, eA, eB, σ, hf⟩
    refine AlgHom.IsSplit.mk (E := Fin n) (F := Fin m) _ ?_ ?_ σ ?_
    · exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange _ _ _ _ _).trans eA
    · exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange _ _ _ _ _).trans eB
    · ext a i
      have := DFunLike.congr_fun hf (1 ⊗ₜ a)
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, coe_id, id_eq, coe_comp,
        Function.comp_apply] at this
      simp [this]
  · rintro ⟨n, m, eA, eB, σ, hf⟩
    refine AlgHom.IsSplit.mk (E := Fin n) (F := Fin m) _ ?_ ?_ σ ?_
    · exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange _ _ _ _ _).symm.trans eA
    · exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange _ _ _ _ _).symm.trans eB
    · ext a i
      have := DFunLike.congr_fun hf (1 ⊗ₜ (1 ⊗ₜ a))
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, coe_id, id_eq, coe_comp,
        Function.comp_apply] at this
      simp [this]

name: Algebra.exists_isFiniteSplit
statement:
lemma exists_isFiniteSplit [Module.Finite R A] [Algebra.Etale R A]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    ∃ (S : Type u) (_ : CommRing S) (_ : Algebra R S),
      Module.Flat R S ∧
      IsOpenMap (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) ∧
      p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) ∧
      Algebra.IsFiniteSplit S (S ⊗[R] A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, _, _, _, hp, hS⟩ := exists_etale_isFiniteSplit (A := A) p
  exact ⟨S, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    PrimeSpectrum.isOpenMap_comap_of_hasGoingDown_of_finitePresentation, hp, hS⟩

name: Algebra.exists_isSplit
statement:
lemma exists_isSplit [Module.Finite R A] [Algebra.Etale R A]
    [Module.Finite R B] [Algebra.Etale R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    ∃ (S : Type u) (_ : CommRing S) (_ : Algebra R S),
      Module.Flat R S ∧
      IsOpenMap (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) ∧
      p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) ∧
      (TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id S S) f).IsSplit
proof:
:= by
  classical
  wlog hA : IsFiniteSplit R A
  · obtain ⟨S, _, _, _, ho₁, ⟨p, rfl⟩, hS⟩ := exists_isFiniteSplit p (A := A)
    obtain ⟨S', _, _, _, ho₂, ⟨q, rfl⟩, hS'⟩ := this (TensorProduct.map (.id S S) f) p hS
    let _ : Algebra R S' := Algebra.compHom S' (algebraMap R S)
    have : IsScalarTower R S S' := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    refine ⟨S', inferInstance, inferInstance, Module.Flat.trans R S S', ?_, ⟨q, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S S', PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp]
      exact ho₁.comp ho₂
    · rwa [AlgHom.IsSplit.iff_of_isScalarTower S]
  wlog hB : IsFiniteSplit R B
  · obtain ⟨S, _, _, _, ho₁, ⟨p, rfl⟩, hS⟩ := exists_isFiniteSplit p (A := B)
    obtain ⟨S', _, _, _, ho₂, ⟨q, rfl⟩, hS'⟩ := this
      (A := S ⊗[R] A) (B := S ⊗[R] B) (R := S)
      (TensorProduct.map (.id S S) f) p inferInstance hS
    let _ : Algebra R S' := Algebra.compHom S' (algebraMap R S)
    have : IsScalarTower R S S' := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    refine ⟨S', inferInstance, inferInstance, Module.Flat.trans R S S', ?_, ⟨q, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S S', PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp]
      exact ho₁.comp ho₂
    · rwa [AlgHom.IsSplit.iff_of_isScalarTower S]
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨eA⟩⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨m, ⟨eB⟩⟩ := hB
  let f' : (Fin n → R) →ₐ[R] Fin m → R := eB.toAlgHom.comp (f.comp eA.symm.toAlgHom)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, σ, hσ⟩ := AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_compRight'' f' p.asIdeal
  refine ⟨Localization.Away r, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
      ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_isOpenEmbedding _ r).isOpenMap
  · change p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap <| algebraMap R (Localization.Away r))
    rwa [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range _ r]
  · let e := TensorProduct.piScalarRight R (Localization.Away r) (Localization.Away r) (Fin m)
    apply AlgHom.IsSplit.mk (E := Fin n) (F := Fin m) _
      (TensorProduct.congr .refl eA |>.trans (TensorProduct.piScalarRight ..))
      (TensorProduct.congr .refl eB |>.trans (TensorProduct.piScalarRight ..)) σ
    ext a i : 3
    simpa [TensorProduct.piScalarRight_tmul, f', e] using
      congrFun (congr(e ($(hσ) (1 ⊗ₜ eA a)))) i

name: Algebra.tensorEqualizer_compRight_bijective
statement:
lemma tensorEqualizer_compRight_bijective {E F : Type*} [Finite E] [Finite F]
    (σ τ : E → F) :
    Function.Bijective ((AlgHom.compRight R R σ).tensorEqualizer S S (.compRight R R τ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype E
  cases nonempty_fintype F
  cases nonempty_fintype (Function.Coequalizer σ τ)
  set f : (F → R) →ₐ[R] E → R := AlgHom.compRight R R σ
  set g : (F → R) →ₐ[R] E → R := AlgHom.compRight R R τ
  let eL : S ⊗[R] (F → R) ≃ₐ[S] F → S :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight R S S F
  let eR : S ⊗[R] (E → R) ≃ₐ[S] E → S :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight R S S E
  let eq₂ : S ⊗[R] (Function.Coequalizer σ τ → R) ≃ₐ[S] Function.Coequalizer σ τ → S :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.piScalarRight R S S (Function.Coequalizer σ τ)
  let e₁ := AlgHom.equalizerCompRightEquiv R R σ τ
  let e₂ := AlgHom.equalizerCompRightEquiv S S σ τ
  let _ : AddCommMonoid ↥(f ≟ₐ g) := AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid
  let eq₁ : S ⊗[R] (f ≟ₐ g) ≃ₐ[S] S ⊗[R] (Function.Coequalizer σ τ → R) :=
    TensorProduct.congr AlgEquiv.refl e₁
  let eq₃ : ↥(TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id S S) f ≟ₐ TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id S S) g) ≃ₐ[S]
      (AlgHom.compRight S S σ) ≟ₐ (AlgHom.compRight S S τ) :=
    AlgHom.equalizerCongr eL eR (by ext; simp [eL, eR, f]) (by ext; simp [eL, eR, g])
  have : AlgHom.tensorEqualizer S S f g =
      AlgHom.comp (.comp (.comp eq₃.symm.toAlgHom e₂.symm.toAlgHom)
        eq₂.toAlgHom) eq₁.toAlgHom := by
    ext x
    apply (TensorProduct.piScalarRight R S S F).injective
    simp only [AlgHom.coe_comp, AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars', Function.comp_apply,
      TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, AlgHom.coe_tensorEqualizer, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
      AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, Subalgebra.coe_val, TensorProduct.piScalarRight_tmul, smul_def, mul_one,
      AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, TensorProduct.congr_apply, AlgEquiv.refl_toAlgHom,
      AlgHom.equalizerCongr_symm_apply, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, eq₃, eL, e₂, eq₂, eq₁, e₁]
    ext i
    rw [AlgHom.equalizerCompRightEquiv_symm_apply, AlgHom.equalizerCompRightEquiv_apply]
  rw [this]
  dsimp
  exact eq₃.symm.bijective.comp (e₂.symm.bijective.comp <| eq₂.bijective.comp eq₁.bijective)

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.map_bijective_of_bijective
statement:
lemma TensorProduct.map_bijective_of_bijective {R S A B C D : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S]
    [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra S A]
    [IsScalarTower R S A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B] [Semiring C] [Algebra R C] [Algebra S C]
    [IsScalarTower R S C] [Semiring D] [Algebra R D] {f : A →ₐ[S] C} {g : B →ₐ[R] D}
    (hf : Function.Bijective f) (hg : Function.Bijective g) :
    Function.Bijective (TensorProduct.map f g)
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.congr (.ofBijective f hf) (.ofBijective g hg) |>.bijective

name: Algebra.tensorEqualizer_comp_comp
statement:
lemma tensorEqualizer_comp_comp {R : Type*} (S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] (T : Type*) [CommRing T] [Algebra R T] [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
    {A A' : Type*} {B B' : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing A']
    [CommRing B] [CommRing B'] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R A']
    [Algebra R B] [Algebra R B'] (f g : A' →ₐ[R] B')
    (eA : A ≃ₐ[R] A') (eB : B ≃ₐ[R] B') :
    AlgHom.tensorEqualizer S T
      (eB.symm.toAlgHom.comp (f.comp eA.toAlgHom))
      (eB.symm.toAlgHom.comp (g.comp eA.toAlgHom)) =
        AlgHom.comp
          (AlgHom.equalizerCongr
            (TensorProduct.congr .refl eA.symm)
            (TensorProduct.congr .refl eB.symm)
            (by
              apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext'
              intro t x
              simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
                Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
                AlgEquiv.coe_refl, id_eq, AlgHom.id_apply, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply])
            (by
              apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext'
              intro t x
              simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
                Algebra.TensorProduct.congr_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
                AlgEquiv.coe_refl, id_eq, AlgHom.id_apply, AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply])).toAlgHom
          (AlgHom.comp (AlgHom.tensorEqualizer S T f g)
          (TensorProduct.congr .refl
            (AlgHom.equalizerCongr eA eB
              (by
                ext x
                exact eB.apply_symm_apply (f (eA x)))
              (by
                ext x
                exact eB.apply_symm_apply (g (eA x))))).toAlgHom)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  · simp [AlgHom.tensorEqualizer_tmul_one', AlgHom.equalizerCongr_apply]
  · simp [AlgHom.tensorEqualizer_one_tmul, AlgHom.equalizerCongr_apply]

name: Algebra.tensorEqualizer_bijective_of_finite_of_etale
statement:
nonrec theorem tensorEqualizer_bijective_of_finite_of_etale (f g : A →ₐ[R] B)
    [Module.Finite R A] [Algebra.Etale R A] [Module.Finite R B] [Algebra.Etale R B] :
    Function.Bijective (f.tensorEqualizer R S g)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hf : f.IsSplit
  · apply RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.codescendsAlong_bijective.algHom_of_forall_exists_flat
    · exact RingHom.Bijective.respectsIso
    · exact RingHom.Bijective.ofLocalizationSpan
    · intro p
      obtain ⟨T, _, _, _, ho, hmem, hf⟩ := exists_isSplit f p
      refine ⟨T, inferInstance, inferInstance, hmem, inferInstance, ho.isOpen_range, ?_⟩
      apply (TensorProduct.map_tensorEqualizer_bijective_iff_tensorEqualizer_map_bijective ..).mpr
      apply this
      exact hf
  obtain ⟨n, m, eA, eB, σ, rfl⟩ := hf
  let g' : (Fin n → R) →ₐ[R] (Fin m → R) :=
    eB.toAlgHom.comp (g.comp eA.symm.toAlgHom)
  have : g = eB.symm.toAlgHom.comp (g'.comp eA.toAlgHom) := by ext; simp [g']
  rw [this]
  have : Function.Bijective (AlgHom.tensorEqualizer R S (.compRight R R σ) g') := by
    let _ : AddCommMonoid ↥(AlgHom.compRight R R σ ≟ₐ g') := AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid
    let _ : CommRing (S ⊗[R] ↥(AlgHom.compRight R R σ ≟ₐ g')) := inferInstance
    apply RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.codescendsAlong_bijective.algHom_of_forall_exists_flat
      (B := TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R S) (.compRight R R σ) ≟ₐ TensorProduct.map (.id R S) g')
    · exact RingHom.Bijective.respectsIso
    · exact RingHom.Bijective.ofLocalizationSpan
    · intro p
      obtain ⟨r, hr, τ, h⟩ := AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_compRight'' g' p.asIdeal
      refine ⟨Localization.Away r, inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_, inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
      · change p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap <| algebraMap R (Localization.Away r))
        rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range _ r]
        exact hr
      · change IsOpen <| Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap <| algebraMap R (Localization.Away r))
        rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range _ r]
        exact PrimeSpectrum.isOpen_basicOpen
      · apply (TensorProduct.map_tensorEqualizer_bijective_iff_tensorEqualizer_map_bijective ..).mpr
        rw [h]
        apply (TensorProduct.map_tensorEqualizer_bijective_iff_tensorEqualizer_map_bijective ..).mp
        apply TensorProduct.map_bijective_of_bijective
        · exact Function.bijective_id
        · apply tensorEqualizer_compRight_bijective
  erw [tensorEqualizer_comp_comp]
  dsimp
  apply Function.Bijective.comp
  · apply AlgEquiv.bijective
  · apply Function.Bijective.comp
    · exact this
    · apply AlgEquiv.bijective

name: AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_of_eq
statement:
lemma AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_of_eq {R A B : Type*} [CommRing R] (S : Submonoid R)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    [Module.Finite R A]
    (Rₚ : Type*) (Aₚ Bₚ : Type u) [CommRing Rₚ] [CommRing Aₚ] [CommRing Bₚ]
    [Algebra R Rₚ] [Algebra R Aₚ] [Algebra R Bₚ] [Algebra Rₚ Aₚ] [Algebra Rₚ Bₚ]
    [Algebra A Aₚ] [Algebra B Bₚ]
    [IsScalarTower R A Aₚ] [IsScalarTower R B Bₚ] [IsScalarTower R Rₚ Aₚ] [IsScalarTower R Rₚ Bₚ]
    [IsLocalization S Rₚ] [IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid A S) Aₚ]
    [IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid B S) Bₚ]
    (f g : A →ₐ[R] B) (hf : IsLocalization.mapₐ S Rₚ Aₚ Bₚ f = IsLocalization.mapₐ S Rₚ Aₚ Bₚ g) :
    ∃ (r : S),
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (Away r.val) (Away r.val)) f =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (Away r.val) (Away r.val)) g
proof:
:= by
  let u : B →ₗ[R] Bₚ := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R B Bₚ).toLinearMap
  have : IsLocalizedModule S u := by
    simp only [u]
    rw [isLocalizedModule_iff_isLocalization]
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := by
    refine Module.Finite.exists_smul_of_comp_eq_of_isLocalizedModule S
      (N := B) (N' := Bₚ) (M := A) u f g ?_
    ext x
    change algebraMap B Bₚ (f x) = algebraMap B Bₚ (g x)
    simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun hf (algebraMap A Aₚ x)
  use s
  ext a
  simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_restrictScalars_comp_includeRight, coe_comp,
    Function.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
  have hun : IsUnit ((algebraMap R (Away s.val ⊗[R] B) s)) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (Away s.val) _]
    apply (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit s.val).map
  suffices s.val • ((1 : Away s.val) ⊗ₜ[R] f a) = s.val • (1 ⊗ₜ[R] g a) by
    apply hun.mul_left_cancel
    rwa [← Algebra.smul_def, ← Algebra.smul_def]
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun hs a
  simp only [Submonoid.smul_def, LinearMap.smul_apply] at this
  rw [← TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  rw [← TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun b : B ↦ (1 : Away s.val) ⊗ₜ[R] b) this

name: Algebra.exists_cover_rankAtStalk_eq
statement:
lemma Algebra.exists_cover_rankAtStalk_eq {R : Type*} (S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [Module.FinitePresentation R S] [Module.Flat R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    ∃ r ∉ p,
      Module.rankAtStalk (R := Localization.Away r) (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] S) =
        Module.rankAtStalk S ⟨p, inferInstance⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hp, heq⟩ := (Module.isLocallyConstant_rankAtStalk (M := S)).exists_open ⟨p, ‹_›⟩
  obtain ⟨V, ⟨r, rfl⟩, (hr : r ∉ p), hrU⟩ :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isTopologicalBasis_basic_opens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hp hU
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  ext q
  rw [Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
  apply heq
  apply hrU
  simp only [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_eq_zeroLocus_compl, Set.mem_compl_iff,
    PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus, Set.singleton_subset_iff,
    SetLike.mem_coe]
  obtain ⟨-, b⟩ := (IsLocalization.isPrime_iff_isPrime_disjoint (.powers r) _ q.asIdeal).mp q.2
  rw [Set.disjoint_left] at b
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.coe_comap, Set.mem_preimage] at b
  apply b
  exact ⟨1, pow_one r⟩

name: RingHom.compRight_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma RingHom.compRight_apply (R : Type*) [CommRing R] {E F : Type*} (σ : E → F)
    (x : F → R) (i : E) :
    compRight R σ x i = x (σ i)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgHom.eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem
statement:
lemma AlgHom.eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem {R E F : Type*} [_root_.Finite E]
    [Nonempty E] [CommRing R] (H : ∀ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1)
    (f : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R) : ∃ (σ : F → E), f = .compRight R R σ
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  cases nonempty_fintype E
  classical
  have hor (i) (j) : f (Pi.single j 1) i = 0 ∨ f (Pi.single j 1) i = 1 := by
    apply H
    unfold IsIdempotentElem
    rw [← Pi.mul_apply, ← map_mul, ← Pi.single_mul_left]
    simp only [Pi.single_eq_same, one_mul]
  have (x : F) : ∃ (y : E), f (Pi.single y 1) x = 1 := by
    by_contra! hc
    replace hc (y : E) : f (Pi.single y 1) x = 0 := by
      obtain (h|h) := hor x y
      · assumption
      · simp [hc] at h
    have : 1 = ∑ y : E, f (Pi.single y 1) x := by
      rw [← Fintype.sum_apply]
      rw [← map_sum, Finset.univ_sum_single, ← Pi.one_def, map_one, Pi.one_apply]
    simp_rw [hc] at this
    exact one_ne_zero (by simpa only [Finset.sum_const_zero] using this)
  have (x : F) : ∃! (y : E), f (Pi.single y 1) x = 1 := by
    apply existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique
    · exact this x
    · intro a b ha hb
      by_contra! h
      have : (Pi.single a 1) * (Pi.single b 1 : E → R) = 0 := by
        simp [← Pi.single_mul_left, h]
      apply_fun ((f ·) · x) at this
      simp [ha, hb] at this
  choose σ hσ hun using this
  use σ
  ext x i
  induction x using Pi.single_induction with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero, Pi.zero_apply, AlgHom.compRight_apply]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | single j r =>
      have : Pi.single j r = r • (Pi.single j 1 : E → R) := by simp [← Pi.single_smul]
      rw [this]
      simp only [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, AlgHom.compRight_apply]
      congr
      obtain (h|h) := hor i j
      · have : j ≠ σ i := by
          intro hj
          subst hj
          simp [hσ] at h
        simp [this, h]
      · have := hun i j h
        subst this
        simp [hσ]

name: AlgHom.eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem'
statement:
lemma AlgHom.eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem' {R E F : Type*} [_root_.Finite E]
    [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (H : ∀ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1)
    (f : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R) : ∃ (σ : F → E), f = .compRight R R σ
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty E
  · have : Subsingleton (F → R) := f.codomain_trivial
    cases isEmpty_or_nonempty F
    · use default
      apply Subsingleton.elim
    · simpa using false_of_nontrivial_of_subsingleton (F → R)
  · apply eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem H

name: IsLocalRing.isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one
statement:
lemma IsLocalRing.isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {e : R} : IsIdempotentElem e ↔ e = 0 ∨ e = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun he ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain (h|h) := IsLocalRing.isUnit_or_isUnit_one_sub_self e
    · exact Or.inr ((IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_one_of_isUnit h).mp he)
    · exact Or.inl
        (sub_eq_self.mp ((IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_one_of_isUnit h).mp he.one_sub))
  · rintro (h|h) <;> subst h
    · exact IsIdempotentElem.zero
    · exact IsIdempotentElem.one

name: RingHom.eq_compRight_of_isLocalHom
statement:
lemma RingHom.eq_compRight_of_isLocalHom {R E F : Type*} [_root_.Finite E] [CommRing R]
    (f : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R) [IsLocalRing R] :
    ∃ (σ : F → E), f = .compRight R R σ
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgHom.eq_compRight_of_no_nontrivial_isIdempotentElem'
  intro e he
  rwa [IsLocalRing.isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one] at he

name: AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_compRight''
statement:
lemma AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_compRight'' {R : Type*} {E F : Type u}
    [_root_.Finite E] [_root_.Finite F]
    [CommRing R]
    (f : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R) (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    ∃ r ∉ p, ∃ (σ : F → E),
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (Away r) (Away r)) f =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (Away r) (Away r)) (.compRight _ _ σ)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (E → R) p.primeCompl)
      (E → Localization.AtPrime p) := by
    rw [← isLocalizedModule_iff_isLocalization]
    convert IsLocalizedModule.pi p.primeCompl (fun _ ↦ Algebra.linearMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))
    all_goals first | rfl | infer_instance
  have : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (F → R) p.primeCompl)
      (F → Localization.AtPrime p) := by
    rw [← isLocalizedModule_iff_isLocalization]
    convert IsLocalizedModule.pi p.primeCompl (fun _ ↦ Algebra.linearMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))
    all_goals first | rfl | infer_instance
  let fₚ : (E → Localization.AtPrime p) →ₐ[Localization.AtPrime p] F → Localization.AtPrime p :=
    IsLocalization.mapₐ p.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (E → Localization.AtPrime p)
      (F → Localization.AtPrime p) f
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := RingHom.eq_compRight_of_isLocalHom fₚ
  let gₚ : (E → Localization.AtPrime p) →ₐ[Localization.AtPrime p] F → Localization.AtPrime p :=
    IsLocalization.mapₐ p.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (E → Localization.AtPrime p)
      (F → Localization.AtPrime p) (.compRight R R σ)
  have : fₚ = gₚ := by
    rw [hσ]
    apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (E → R) p.primeCompl)
    ext x i
    simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_comp, RingHom.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      AlgHom.compRight_apply, IsLocalization.mapₐ_coe, IsLocalization.map_eq, gₚ]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, heq⟩ := AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_of_eq _ _ _ _ f (.compRight R R σ) this
  exact ⟨r, hr, σ, heq⟩

name: AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_compRight''₂
statement:
lemma AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_compRight''₂ {R : Type*} {E F : Type u}
    [_root_.Finite E] [_root_.Finite F] [CommRing R] (f g : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R)
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    ∃ r ∉ p, ∃ (σ τ : F → E),
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (Away r) (Away r)) f =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (Away r) (Away r)) (.compRight _ _ σ) ∧
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (Away r) (Away r)) g =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id (Away r) (Away r)) (.compRight _ _ τ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, σ, hσ⟩ := AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_compRight'' f p
  obtain ⟨r', hr', τ, hτ⟩ := AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_compRight'' g p
  let : Algebra (Localization.Away r) (Localization.Away (r * r')) := by
    refine (IsLocalization.Away.lift r (g := algebraMap R _) ?_).toAlgebra
    apply isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left (y := algebraMap _ _ r')
    rw [← map_mul]
    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (r * r')
  let : Algebra (Localization.Away r') (Localization.Away (r * r')) := by
    refine (IsLocalization.Away.lift r' (g := algebraMap R _) ?_).toAlgebra
    apply isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right (x := algebraMap _ _ r)
    rw [← map_mul]
    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (r * r')
  have : IsScalarTower R (Away r) (Localization.Away (r * r')) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  have : IsScalarTower R (Away r') (Localization.Away (r * r')) := by
    apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
    intro x
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  let eE : Localization.Away (r * r') ⊗[R] (E → R) ≃ₐ[Localization.Away (r * r')]
      Localization.Away (r * r') ⊗[Away r] (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] (E → R)) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange _ _ _ _ _).symm
  let eF : Localization.Away (r * r') ⊗[R] (F → R) ≃ₐ[Localization.Away (r * r')]
      Localization.Away (r * r') ⊗[Away r] (Localization.Away r ⊗[R] (F → R)) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange _ _ _ _ _).symm
  let eE' : Localization.Away (r * r') ⊗[R] (E → R) ≃ₐ[Localization.Away (r * r')]
      Localization.Away (r * r') ⊗[Away r'] (Localization.Away r' ⊗[R] (E → R)) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange _ _ _ _ _).symm
  let eF' : Localization.Away (r * r') ⊗[R] (F → R) ≃ₐ[Localization.Away (r * r')]
      Localization.Away (r * r') ⊗[Away r'] (Localization.Away r' ⊗[R] (F → R)) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange _ _ _ _ _).symm
  have heq (u : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R) : Algebra.TensorProduct.map
      (AlgHom.id (Away (r * r')) (Away (r * r'))) u =
      eF.symm.toAlgHom.comp ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id _ _)
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id _ _) u)).comp eE.toAlgHom) := by
    ext
    simp [eF, eE]
  have heq' (u : (E → R) →ₐ[R] F → R) : Algebra.TensorProduct.map
      (AlgHom.id (Away (r * r')) (Away (r * r'))) u =
      eF'.symm.toAlgHom.comp ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id _ _)
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id _ _) u)).comp eE'.toAlgHom) := by
    ext
    simp [eF', eE']
  refine ⟨r * r', ?_, σ, τ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hr
    cases Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem inferInstance hr <;> contradiction
  · rw [heq, hσ, ← heq]
  · rw [heq', hτ, ← heq']

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.equalizer_fun
statement:
lemma Algebra.FiniteEtale.equalizer_fun {R : Type u} {E F : Type} [CommRing R] [Finite E] [Finite F]
    (f g : (E → R) →ₐ[R] (F → R)) :
    Algebra.FiniteEtale R (AlgHom.equalizer f g)
proof:
:= by
  apply Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_exists_of_isPrime
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨r, hr, σ, τ, hσ, hτ⟩ := AlgHom.exists_cover_eq_compRight''₂ f g p
  use r, hr
  set A := Localization.Away r
  let f' : A ⊗[R] (E → R) →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] (F → R) := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id _ _) f
  let g' : A ⊗[R] (E → R) →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] (F → R) := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id _ _) g
  let cong₁ : A ⊗[R] AlgHom.equalizer f g ≃ₐ[A] AlgHom.equalizer f' g' :=
    AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv A A f g
  let T := AlgHom.equalizer
    (TensorProduct.map (.id A A) (.compRight R R σ))
    (TensorProduct.map (.id A A) (.compRight R R τ))
  let cong₂ : AlgHom.equalizer f' g' ≃ₐ[A] T := AlgHom.equalizerCongrOfEq hσ hτ
  let cong₃ : T ≃ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] AlgHom.equalizer (AlgHom.compRight R R σ) (AlgHom.compRight R R τ) :=
    (AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv A A _ _).symm
  let cong : A ⊗[R] AlgHom.equalizer f g ≃ₐ[A] A ⊗[R]
      AlgHom.equalizer (AlgHom.compRight R R σ) (AlgHom.compRight R R τ) :=
    cong₁.trans (cong₂.trans cong₃)
  have : FiniteEtale
      A (A ⊗[R] ↥(AlgHom.equalizer (AlgHom.compRight R R σ) (AlgHom.compRight R R τ))) := by
    constructor
  apply Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_equiv cong.symm

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.equalizer_of_isFiniteSplit
statement:
lemma Algebra.FiniteEtale.equalizer_of_isFiniteSplit {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra R T] [Algebra.IsFiniteSplit R S] [Algebra.IsFiniteSplit R T] (f g : S →ₐ[R] T) :
    Algebra.FiniteEtale R (AlgHom.equalizer f g)

name: Algebra.FiniteEtale.equalizer_of_rankAtStalk_eq
statement:
lemma Algebra.FiniteEtale.equalizer_of_rankAtStalk_eq {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [CommRing T] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T]
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Finite R T] [Algebra.Etale R S] [Algebra.Etale R T]
    {n m : ℕ} (hn : Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) S = n) (hm : Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) T = m)
    (f g : S →ₐ[R] T) :
    Algebra.FiniteEtale R (AlgHom.equalizer f g)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hS : Algebra.IsFiniteSplit R S
  · obtain ⟨A, _, _, _, _, _, hA⟩ := Algebra.IsFiniteSplit.exists_tensorProduct_of_etale hn
    let f' : A ⊗[R] S →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) f
    let g' : A ⊗[R] S →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) g
    let cong : A ⊗[R] AlgHom.equalizer f g ≃ₐ[A] AlgHom.equalizer f' g' :=
      AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv A A f g
    have : Algebra.FiniteEtale A (AlgHom.equalizer f' g') := by
      apply this (n := n) (m := m)
      · ext p
        rw [Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange, hn]
        rfl
      · ext p
        rw [Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange, hm]
        rfl
      exact hA
    have : Algebra.FiniteEtale A (A ⊗[R] AlgHom.equalizer f g) :=
      Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_equiv cong.symm
    exact Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_finiteEtale_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat A
  clear n hn
  wlog hT : Algebra.IsFiniteSplit R T
  · obtain ⟨A, _, _, _, _, _, hA⟩ := Algebra.IsFiniteSplit.exists_tensorProduct_of_etale hm
    let f' : A ⊗[R] S →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) f
    let g' : A ⊗[R] S →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) g
    let cong : A ⊗[R] AlgHom.equalizer f g ≃ₐ[A] AlgHom.equalizer f' g' :=
      AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv A A f g
    have : Algebra.FiniteEtale A (AlgHom.equalizer f' g') := by
      apply this (m := m)
      · ext p
        rw [Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange, hm]
        rfl
      · infer_instance
      · exact hA
    have : Algebra.FiniteEtale A (A ⊗[R] AlgHom.equalizer f g) :=
      Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_equiv cong.symm
    exact Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_finiteEtale_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat A
  apply Algebra.FiniteEtale.equalizer_of_isFiniteSplit

name: Algebra.Etale.equalizer
statement:
theorem Algebra.Etale.equalizer {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T]
    [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Finite R T] [Algebra.Etale R S] [Algebra.Etale R T]
    (f g : S →ₐ[R] T) :
    Algebra.FiniteEtale R (AlgHom.equalizer f g)
proof:
:= by
  wlog h : ∃ (n : ℕ), Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) S = n
  · apply Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_exists_of_isPrime
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hn⟩ := Algebra.exists_cover_rankAtStalk_eq S p
    use r, hr
    let A := Localization.Away r
    let f' : A ⊗[R] S →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) f
    let g' : A ⊗[R] S →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) g
    let cong : A ⊗[R] AlgHom.equalizer f g ≃ₐ[A] AlgHom.equalizer f' g' :=
      AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv A A f g
    have : Algebra.FiniteEtale A (AlgHom.equalizer f' g') := by
      apply this
      use Module.rankAtStalk S ⟨p, hp⟩
    exact Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_equiv (S := AlgHom.equalizer f' g') cong.symm
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h
  wlog h : ∃ (m : ℕ), Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) T = m
  · apply Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_exists_of_isPrime
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hm⟩ := Algebra.exists_cover_rankAtStalk_eq T p
    use r, hr
    let A := Localization.Away r
    let f' : A ⊗[R] S →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) f
    let g' : A ⊗[R] S →ₐ[A] A ⊗[R] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) g
    let cong : A ⊗[R] AlgHom.equalizer f g ≃ₐ[A] AlgHom.equalizer f' g' :=
      AlgHom.tensorEqualizerEquiv A A f g
    have : Algebra.FiniteEtale A (AlgHom.equalizer f' g') := by
      apply this (n := n)
      · ext p
        rw [Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange, hn]
        rfl
      · use (Module.rankAtStalk T ⟨p, hp⟩)
    exact Algebra.FiniteEtale.of_equiv (S := AlgHom.equalizer f' g') cong.symm
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
  apply Algebra.FiniteEtale.equalizer_of_rankAtStalk_eq hn hm

name: Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.abelianModPowerMap_map_comp
statement:
theorem abelianModPowerMap_map_comp (q : ℕ) (f : K →+* L) (g : L →+* M) :
    abelianModPowerMap q (map (g.comp f)) =
      (abelianModPowerMap q (map f)).comp (abelianModPowerMap q (map g))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := abelianModPowerMk_surjective (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup M) q x
  change abelianModPowerMk (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K) q (map (g.comp f) σ) =
    abelianModPowerMk (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K) q (map f (map g σ))
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (character_map_comp f g
    (abelianModPowerMk (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K) q)) σ

name: ContinuousCohomology.hom_action
statement:
private theorem hom_action {R : Type} [Ring R] [TopologicalSpace R]
    {X Y : TopRep.{u} R G}
    (f : TopRep.res (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) X ⟶ Y) (g : G) (t : X) :
    f.hom (X.ρ g t) = Y.ρ g (f.hom t)
proof: := f.hom.isIntertwining g t

name: ContinuousCohomology.exists_crossedHom_lift_of_map_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_crossedHom_lift_of_map_surjective
    (X Y : TopRep.{u} ℤ G)
    (f : TopRep.res (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (horbit : ∀ a : X, Continuous (fun g : G => X.ρ g a))
    (hH1 : Function.Surjective (map (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1).hom)
    (c : CrossedHom Y) :
    ∃ d : CrossedHom X, ∀ g : G, f.hom (d.toFun g) = c.toFun g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hH1 (π Y 1 c.toCocycle)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := π_surjective X 1 a
  have hclass : π Y 1 (cocyclesMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1 z) =
      π Y 1 c.toCocycle := by
    have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (π_map (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1) z
    change (map (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1) (π X 1 z) = _ at hnat
    rw [hz] at hnat
    exact hnat.symm.trans ha
  let w := cocyclesMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1 z - c.toCocycle
  have hw : π Y 1 w = 0 := by
    change π Y 1 (cocyclesMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1 z - c.toCocycle) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hclass, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_boundary_of_π_eq_zero Y 0 w hw
  let e := crossedHomOfCocycle X z
  have hvalue (g : G) : f.hom (e.toFun g) - c.toFun g =
      Y.ρ g (b.1 1) - b.1 1 := by
    have hbi := congrArg (fun τ => τ g) (b.2 g)
    have hbi' : Y.ρ g (b.1 1) = b.1 g := by
      simpa only [coind₁_apply_apply, inv_mul_cancel] using hbi
    rw [hbi']
    have hbd := congrArg (fun τ => τ.1 1 g) hb
    have hd := congrArg (fun τ => τ 1 g) (homogeneousCochains.d_apply Y 0 b)
    rw [hd] at hbd
    simp only [d_succ, d_zero, TopRep.hom_sub, ContIntertwiningMap.sub_apply,
      coind₁ι_toFun, coind₁Map_toFun, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom,
      ContinuousMap.sub_apply] at hbd
    have hmap := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i (cochainsMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f) 1) z
    have hmap' : (homogeneousCochains Y).iCycles 1
        (cocyclesMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1 z) =
      (cochainsMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f).f 1
        ((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 1 z) := hmap
    change b.1 g - b.1 1 = ((homogeneousCochains Y).iCycles 1 w).1 1 g at hbd
    dsimp only [w] at hbd
    rw [map_sub, hmap', c.iCycles_toCocycle] at hbd
    change b.1 g - b.1 1 = f.hom (e.toFun g) - (c.toFun g - c.toFun 1) at hbd
    rw [c.map_one, sub_zero] at hbd
    exact hbd.symm
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hf (b.1 1)
  let d : CrossedHom X :=
    { toFun := fun g => e.toFun g - (X.ρ g t - t)
      continuous_toFun := e.continuous_toFun.sub ((horbit t).sub continuous_const)
      map_mul := by
        intro g h
        rw [e.map_mul, map_mul]
        change e.toFun g + X.ρ g (e.toFun h) - (X.ρ g (X.ρ h t) - t) = _
        rw [map_sub, map_sub]
        abel }
  refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
  intro g
  change f.hom (e.toFun g - (X.ρ g t - t)) = c.toFun g
  have hft := hom_action f g t
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, hft, ht]
  exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr ((sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp (hvalue g)).trans (add_comm _ _))

name: GaloisCohomology.continuous_galoisRestrictScalars
statement:
theorem continuous_galoisRestrictScalars [Algebra.IsAlgebraic E Ω] :
    Continuous (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom K : Gal(Ω/E) →* Gal(Ω/K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_one
  rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFU⟩ := (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff K Ω U).mp hU
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin (Module.finrank K F)) K F := Module.finBasis K F
  have hopen : IsOpen (⋂ j, (MulAction.stabilizer Gal(Ω/E) (b j : Ω) :
      Set Gal(Ω/E))) := isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun j =>
    stabilizer_isOpen_of_isIntegral (K := E) (b j : Ω)
  have hone : (1 : Gal(Ω/E)) ∈ ⋂ j,
      (MulAction.stabilizer Gal(Ω/E) (b j : Ω) : Set Gal(Ω/E)) :=
    Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun _ => Subgroup.one_mem _
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset (hopen.mem_nhds hone)
  intro σ hσ
  apply hFU
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff F (σ.restrictScalars K)).mpr
  have hlin : ((σ.restrictScalars K).toAlgHom.comp F.val).toLinearMap =
      F.val.toLinearMap := b.ext fun j =>
    MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp (Set.mem_iInter.mp hσ j)
  intro x hx
  exact congrArg (fun f : F →ₗ[K] Ω => f ⟨x, hx⟩) hlin

name: GaloisCohomology.galoisRestrictScalars_range
statement:
theorem galoisRestrictScalars_range :
    (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom K : Gal(Ω/E) →* Gal(Ω/K)).range =
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K E Ω).fieldRange.fixingSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  ext σ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨τ, rfl⟩
    apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _ _).mpr
    rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact τ.commutes y
  · intro hσ
    let τ : Gal(Ω/E) :=
      { σ.toRingEquiv with
        commutes' := fun y =>
          (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _ _).mp hσ _ ⟨y, rfl⟩ }
    exact ⟨τ, AlgEquiv.ext fun _ => rfl⟩

name: ContinuousCohomology.CrossedHom.map_one
statement: theorem map_one (c : CrossedHom X) : c.toFun 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc := c.map_mul 1 1
  rw [one_mul, _root_.map_one X.ρ, one_apply_eq_self] at hc
  exact add_eq_left.mp hc.symm

name: ContinuousCohomology.CrossedHom.homogeneous_apply
statement:
theorem homogeneous_apply (c : CrossedHom X) (g h : G) :
    c.homogeneous.1 g h = c.toFun h - c.toFun g
proof: := rfl

name: ContinuousCohomology.CrossedHom.homogeneous_mem_cycles
statement:
theorem homogeneous_mem_cycles (c : CrossedHom X) :
    ((homogeneousCochains X).d 1 2).hom c.homogeneous = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext g h k
  have hd := homogeneousCochains.d_apply X 1 c.homogeneous
  have hdh := congrArg (fun τ => τ g h k) hd
  rw [hdh]
  simp only [d_succ, d_zero, TopRep.hom_sub,
    ContIntertwiningMap.sub_apply, coind₁ι_toFun, coind₁Map_toFun,
    ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom]
  change (c.toFun k - c.toFun h) -
    ((c.toFun k - c.toFun g) - (c.toFun h - c.toFun g)) = 0
  abel

name: ContinuousCohomology.CrossedHom.scalarLine_one
statement:
private theorem scalarLine_one {R : Type} [Ring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [DiscreteTopology R]
    {M : TopModuleCat.{u} R} (x : M) : scalarLine x (ULift.up 1) = x
proof:
:=
  one_smul R x

name: ContinuousCohomology.CrossedHom.scalarLine_comp_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem scalarLine_comp_eq_zero
    {R : Type} [Ring R] [TopologicalSpace R] [DiscreteTopology R]
    {M N : TopModuleCat.{u} R} (x : M) (f : M ⟶ N) (hx : f.hom x = 0) :
    scalarLine x ≫ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  change f.hom (a.down • x) = 0
  rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: ContinuousCohomology.CrossedHom.iCycles_toCocycle
statement:
theorem iCycles_toCocycle (c : CrossedHom X) :
    (homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 1 c.toCocycle = c.homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  change (homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 1
    (((homogeneousCochains X).liftCycles (scalarLine c.homogeneous) 2
      (CochainComplex.next ℕ 1) _) (ULift.up 1)) = _
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, (homogeneousCochains X).liftCycles_i]
  exact scalarLine_one c.homogeneous

name: ContinuousCohomology.crossedHomOfCocycle_toCocycle
statement:
theorem crossedHomOfCocycle_toCocycle (X : TopRep.{u} ℤ G) (c : CrossedHom X) (g : G) :
    (crossedHomOfCocycle X c.toCocycle).toFun g = c.toFun g
proof:
:= by
  change ((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 1 c.toCocycle).1 1 g = c.toFun g
  rw [c.iCycles_toCocycle]
  change c.toFun g - c.toFun 1 = c.toFun g
  rw [c.map_one, sub_zero]

name: Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.separableClosureLift_coe
statement:
theorem separableClosureLift_coe (f : K →+* L) (s : SeparableClosure K) :
    (separableClosureLift f s : AlgebraicClosure L) = closureLift f (s : AlgebraicClosure K)
proof: := rfl

name: Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.separableClosureLift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem separableClosureLift_algebraMap (f : K →+* L) (x : K) :
    separableClosureLift f (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) x) =
      algebraMap L (SeparableClosure L) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact closureLift_algebraMap f x

name: Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map_separableClosureLift
statement:
theorem map_separableClosureLift (f : K →+* L)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) (s : SeparableClosure K) :
    separableClosureLift f
        (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv K (map f σ) s) =
      ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv L σ (separableClosureLift f s)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (congrArg (closureLift f)
    (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv_apply K (map f σ) s)).trans
      ((map_closureLift f σ (s : AlgebraicClosure K)).trans
        (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv_apply L σ
          (separableClosureLift f s)).symm)

name: ContinuousCohomology.degreeTwo_cocycle_equation
statement:
theorem degreeTwo_cocycle_equation (X : TopRep.{v} R G)
    (z : ContinuousCohomology.cocycles X 2)
    (x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃ : G) :
    (((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 2).hom z).1 x₁ x₂ x₃ -
        (((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 2).hom z).1 x₀ x₂ x₃ +
        (((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 2).hom z).1 x₀ x₁ x₃ -
      (((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 2).hom z).1 x₀ x₁ x₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  let C := homogeneousCochains X
  let z₀ : C.X 2 := (C.iCycles 2).hom z
  have hz : (C.d 2 3).hom z₀ = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f ↦ TopModuleCat.Hom.hom f z) (C.iCycles_d 2 3)
    simpa only [z₀, TopModuleCat.hom_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      TopModuleCat.hom_zero, _root_.zero_apply] using h
  have hzEval := congrArg (fun τ : C.X 3 => τ.1 x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃) hz
  have hd := TopRep.homogeneousCochains.d_apply X 2 z₀
  have hdEval := congrArg (fun τ => τ x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃) hd
  rw [hdEval] at hzEval
  change z₀.1 x₁ x₂ x₃ - (z₀.1 x₀ x₂ x₃ -
    (z₀.1 x₀ x₁ x₃ - z₀.1 x₀ x₁ x₂)) = 0 at hzEval
  abel_nf at hzEval ⊢
  exact hzEval

name: ContinuousCohomology.degreeTwo_equivariant
statement:
theorem degreeTwo_equivariant (X : TopRep.{v} R G)
    (z : cocycles X 2) (g x₀ x₁ x₂ : G) :
    X.ρ g ((((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 2).hom z).1 x₀ x₁ x₂) =
      (((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 2).hom z).1
        (g * x₀) (g * x₁) (g * x₂)
proof:
:= by
  let z₀ := ((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 2).hom z
  change (resolutionX X 3).ρ.invariants at z₀
  have h := congrArg (fun τ => τ (g * x₀) (g * x₁) (g * x₂)) (z₀.2 g)
  change X.ρ g (z₀.1 (g⁻¹ * (g * x₀)) (g⁻¹ * (g * x₁))
      (g⁻¹ * (g * x₂))) = z₀.1 (g * x₀) (g * x₁) (g * x₂) at h
  simpa only [inv_mul_cancel_left] using h

name: ContinuousCohomology.π_surjective
statement:
theorem π_surjective (A : TopRep.{v} R G) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (π A n)
proof:
:= by
  let K := TopRep.homogeneousCochains A
  let S := K.sc n
  have hleft : Function.Surjective S.leftHomologyπ := by
    let c : CokernelCofork S.toCycles :=
      CokernelCofork.ofπ (TopModuleCat.cokerπ S.toCycles)
        (TopModuleCat.comp_cokerπ S.toCycles)
    let hc : IsColimit c := TopModuleCat.isColimitCoker S.toCycles
    let d : CokernelCofork S.toCycles :=
      CokernelCofork.ofπ S.leftHomologyπ S.leftHomologyData.wπ
    let hd : IsColimit d := S.leftHomologyData.hπ
    let e : c.pt ≅ d.pt := hc.coconePointUniqueUpToIso hd
    have he : TopModuleCat.cokerπ S.toCycles ≫ e.hom = S.leftHomologyπ := by
      exact hc.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom hd WalkingParallelPair.one
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := TopModuleCat.cokerπ_surjective S.toCycles (e.inv y)
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    rw [← he]
    change e.hom (TopModuleCat.cokerπ S.toCycles x) = y
    rw [hx]
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom e.inv_hom_id y
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso S.leftHomologyIso.hom).2 y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hleft z
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  change S.leftHomologyIso.hom (S.leftHomologyπ x) = y
  rw [hx, hz]

name: ContinuousCohomology.exists_boundary_of_π_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_boundary_of_π_eq_zero (A : TopRep.{v} R G) (n : ℕ)
    (z : cocycles A (n + 1)) (hz : π A (n + 1) z = 0) :
    ∃ c : (TopRep.homogeneousCochains A).X n,
      ((TopRep.homogeneousCochains A).d n (n + 1)).hom c =
        ((TopRep.homogeneousCochains A).iCycles (n + 1)).hom z
proof:
:= by
  let K := TopRep.homogeneousCochains A
  let S : ShortComplex (TopModuleCat R) :=
    ShortComplex.mk (K.toCycles n (n + 1)) (K.homologyπ (n + 1))
      (K.toCycles_comp_homologyπ n (n + 1))
  have hS : S.Exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel S
    (K.homologyIsCokernel n (n + 1) (CochainComplex.prev_nat_succ n))
  let F := forget₂ (TopModuleCat R) (ModuleCat R)
  have hSM : (S.map F).Exact := hS.map F
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ((S.map F).exact_iff_of_hasForget.mp hSM) z hz
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  rw [← K.toCycles_i n (n + 1)]
