  have hc' : (K.toCycles n (n + 1)).hom c = z := hc
  exact congrArg (fun w => (K.iCycles (n + 1)).hom w) hc'

name: GaloisCohomology.isLocallyConstant_galois_apply
statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_galois_apply (x : Ω) :
    IsLocallyConstant (fun σ : Gal(Ω/K) => σ x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open _).mpr
  intro σ
  let E : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.adjoin K {x}
  have : FiniteDimensional K E :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral x)
  refine ⟨σ • (E.fixingSubgroup : Set Gal(Ω/K)),
    E.fixingSubgroup_isOpen.leftCoset σ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨1, E.fixingSubgroup.one_mem, mul_one σ⟩
  · rintro τ ⟨ρ, hρ, rfl⟩
    have hfix : ρ x = x :=
      (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff E ρ).mp hρ x
        (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self K x)
    change σ (ρ x) = σ x
    exact congrArg σ hfix

name: GaloisCohomology.isLocallyConstant_galois_units
statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_galois_units (x : Ωˣ) :
    IsLocallyConstant (fun σ : Gal(Ω/K) => σ • x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open _).mpr
  intro σ
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hσ, hconst⟩ := (isLocallyConstant_galois_apply (K := K) (x : Ω)).exists_open σ
  refine ⟨U, hU, hσ, ?_⟩
  intro τ hτ
  apply Units.ext
  exact hconst τ hτ

name: GaloisCohomology.exists_finiteGalois_factor_continuous_pair
statement:
theorem exists_finiteGalois_factor_continuous_pair
    {Y : Type w} [TopologicalSpace Y] [Finite Y] [DiscreteTopology Y]
    (z : Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K) → Y) (hz : Continuous z) :
    ∃ (E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ω) (zE : Gal(E/K) → Gal(E/K) → Y),
      ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K), zE (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ)
        (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E τ) = z (σ, τ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, zU, _hzU, hfac⟩ :=
    ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.exists_openNormalSubgroupInClass_factor_continuousMap_finite
      FiniteGroupClass.allFinite_formation hasOpenNormalBasisInClass_allFinite z hz
  let j₁ : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K) :=
    { toFun := fun σ => (σ, 1)
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun σ τ => by simp only [Prod.mk_mul_mk, one_mul]
      continuous_toFun := continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const }
  let j₂ : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K) :=
    { toFun := fun σ => (1, σ)
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun σ τ => by simp only [Prod.mk_mul_mk, one_mul]
      continuous_toFun := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id }
  let V : Set Gal(Ω/K) :=
    j₁ ⁻¹' ((U.1 : Subgroup (Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K))) : Set (Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K))) ∩
      j₂ ⁻¹' ((U.1 : Subgroup (Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K))) : Set (Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K)))
  have hVopen : IsOpen V :=
    ((openNormalSubgroup_isOpen U.1).preimage j₁.continuous).inter
      ((openNormalSubgroup_isOpen U.1).preimage j₂.continuous)
  have hVone : (1 : Gal(Ω/K)) ∈ V :=
    ⟨show j₁ 1 ∈ (U.1 : Subgroup _) from by rw [map_one]; exact Subgroup.one_mem _,
      show j₂ 1 ∈ (U.1 : Subgroup _) from by rw [map_one]; exact Subgroup.one_mem _⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := (InfiniteGalois.krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff_of_isGalois
    (k := K) (K := Ω) V).mp (hVopen.mem_nhds hVone)
  let r : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(E/K) := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E
  have hr : Function.Surjective r := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective Ω
  have hrel {σ τ : Gal(Ω/K)} (hστ : r σ = r τ) : σ * τ⁻¹ ∈ E.fixingSubgroup := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.restrictNormalHom_ker]
    change r (σ * τ⁻¹) = 1
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, hστ, mul_inv_cancel]
  have hfactor (σ τ σ' τ' : Gal(Ω/K))
      (hσ : r σ = r σ') (hτ : r τ = r τ') : z (σ, τ) = z (σ', τ') := by
    rw [congrFun hfac (σ, τ), congrFun hfac (σ', τ')]
    apply congrArg zU
    apply OpenNormalSubgroupInClass.quotientProj_eq_quotientProj_iff.mpr
    have hx : j₁ (σ * σ'⁻¹) ∈ (U.1 : Subgroup (Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K))) :=
      (hE (hrel hσ)).1
    have hy : j₂ (τ * τ'⁻¹) ∈ (U.1 : Subgroup (Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K))) :=
      (hE (hrel hτ)).2
    have hxy := (U.1 : Subgroup (Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K))).mul_mem hx hy
    change (σ * σ'⁻¹, 1) * (1, τ * τ'⁻¹) ∈
      (U.1 : Subgroup (Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K))) at hxy
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, Prod.mk_mul_mk, mul_one, one_mul, Prod.inv_mk] using hxy
  let zE : Gal(E/K) → Gal(E/K) → Y :=
    fun σ τ => z ((hr σ).choose, (hr τ).choose)
  refine ⟨E, zE, ?_⟩
  intro σ τ
  exact hfactor _ _ σ τ (hr (r σ)).choose_spec (hr (r τ)).choose_spec

name: GaloisCohomology.exists_lift_crossed_cocycle_succ
statement:
theorem exists_lift_crossed_cocycle_succ
    (hH2 : ∀ z : G → G → ZMod p,
      (∀ σ τ υ : G, z σ (τ * υ) + z τ υ = z (σ * τ) υ + z σ τ) →
      IsLocallyConstant (fun x : G × G => z x.1 x.2) →
      ∃ d : G → ZMod p, IsLocallyConstant d ∧
        ∀ σ τ : G, d τ - d (σ * τ) + d σ = z σ τ)
    (n : ℕ) (θ : G →ₜ* (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))ˣ)
    (hθ : ∀ g : G,
      ZMod.castHom (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)) (ZMod p)
        (θ g : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) = 1)
    (c : G → ZMod (p ^ n)) (hccont : Continuous c)
    (hc : ∀ σ τ : G, c (σ * τ) = c σ +
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n))
        (θ σ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * c τ) :
    ∃ d : G → ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)), Continuous d ∧
      (∀ σ τ : G, d (σ * τ) = d σ + (θ σ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * d τ) ∧
      ∀ σ : G, ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n))
        (ZMod (p ^ n)) (d σ) = c σ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : NeZero (p ^ n) := ⟨pow_ne_zero n (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  have : NeZero (p ^ (n + 1)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  let r := ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n))
  let e := ZMod.mulPowPrime p n
  have heinj : Function.Injective e := ZMod.mulPowPrime_injective (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero n
  have hfixed (σ : G) (a : ZMod p) : (θ σ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * e a = e a := by
    rw [← ZMod.mulPowPrime_mul_castHom, hθ, one_mul]
  let f (σ : G) : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)) := (c σ).val
  have hfcont : Continuous f :=
    (show Continuous (fun a : ZMod (p ^ n) => (a.val : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))) from
      continuous_of_discreteTopology).comp hccont
  have hred (σ : G) : r (f σ) = c σ := by
    change r ((c σ).val : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) = c σ
    rw [map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  let δ (σ τ : G) : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)) :=
    (θ σ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * f τ - f (σ * τ) + f σ
  have hδcont : Continuous (fun x : G × G => δ x.1 x.2) :=
    (((Units.continuous_val.comp θ.continuous).comp continuous_fst).mul
      (hfcont.comp continuous_snd)).sub (hfcont.comp continuous_mul) |>.add
        (hfcont.comp continuous_fst)
  have hδzero (σ τ : G) : r (δ σ τ) = 0 := by
    change r ((θ σ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * f τ - f (σ * τ) + f σ) = 0
    rw [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, hred, hred, hred, hc]
    ring
  let z (σ τ : G) : ZMod p :=
    (ZMod.exists_mulPowPrime_eq_of_castHom_eq_zero p n (δ σ τ) (hδzero σ τ)).choose
  have hzval (σ τ : G) : e (z σ τ) = δ σ τ :=
    (ZMod.exists_mulPowPrime_eq_of_castHom_eq_zero p n (δ σ τ) (hδzero σ τ)).choose_spec
  have hzcont : IsLocallyConstant (fun x : G × G => z x.1 x.2) := by
    apply (IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open _).mpr
    intro x
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hx, hconst⟩ :=
      ((IsLocallyConstant.iff_continuous _).mpr hδcont).exists_open x
    refine ⟨U, hU, hx, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    apply heinj
    rw [hzval, hzval]
    exact hconst y hy
  have hzcocycle (σ τ υ : G) : z σ (τ * υ) + z τ υ = z (σ * τ) υ + z σ τ := by
    apply heinj
    rw [map_add, map_add, hzval, hzval, hzval, hzval]
    have hfix := hfixed σ (z τ υ)
    rw [hzval] at hfix
    have hmul : (θ (σ * τ) : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) =
        (θ σ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * (θ τ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) := by
      rw [map_mul, Units.val_mul]
    dsimp only [δ] at hfix ⊢
    rw [hmul]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
    linear_combination -hfix
  obtain ⟨b, hbcont, hb⟩ := hH2 z hzcocycle hzcont
  let d (σ : G) := f σ - e (b σ)
  have hdcont : Continuous d := hfcont.sub (continuous_of_discreteTopology.comp hbcont.continuous)
  refine ⟨d, hdcont, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro σ τ
    have hb' := congrArg e (hb σ τ)
    rw [map_add, map_sub, hzval] at hb'
    have hfix := hfixed σ (b τ)
    dsimp only [d, δ] at hb' ⊢
    linear_combination hb' + hfix
  · intro σ
    change r (f σ - e (b σ)) = c σ
    rw [map_sub, hred, ZMod.castHom_mulPowPrime, sub_zero]

name: Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.character_map_apply_of_lift
statement:
theorem character_map_apply_of_lift
    {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    (f : K →+* L) (j : AlgebraicClosure K →+* AlgebraicClosure L)
    (hj : ∀ x : K, j (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) x) =
      algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (f x))
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) (θ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
    (hθ : ∀ x, j (θ x) = σ (j x))
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A) :
    χ (map f σ) = χ θ
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra K L := f.toAlgebra
  let j₁ : AlgebraicClosure K →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure L :=
    { toRingHom := closureLift f
      commutes' := closureLift_algebraMap f }
  let j₂ : AlgebraicClosure K →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure L :=
    { toRingHom := j
      commutes' := hj }
  let : Algebra (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure L) := j₁.toAlgebra
  let η : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) := j₂.restrictNormal' (AlgebraicClosure K)
  have hη (x : AlgebraicClosure K) : j₁ (η x) = j₂ x :=
    j₂.restrictNormal_commutes (AlgebraicClosure K) x
  let ρ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) := map f σ
  have hcomm : ρ * η = η * θ := by
    ext x
    apply j₁.injective
    change j₁ (ρ (η x)) = j₁ (η (θ x))
    calc
      j₁ (ρ (η x)) = σ (j₁ (η x)) := map_closureLift f σ (η x)
      _ = σ (j₂ x) := congrArg σ (hη x)
      _ = j₂ (θ x) := (hθ x).symm
      _ = j₁ (η (θ x)) := (hη (θ x)).symm
  have hχ := congrArg χ hcomm
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, mul_comm (χ η)] at hχ
  exact mul_right_cancel hχ

name: Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.closureLift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem closureLift_algebraMap (f : K →+* L) (x : K) :
    closureLift f (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) x) =
      algebraMap L (AlgebraicClosure L) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra K L := f.toAlgebra
  change (IsAlgClosed.lift : AlgebraicClosure K →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure L)
    (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) x) = _
  rw [AlgHom.commutes]
  rfl

name: Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map_closureLift
statement:
theorem map_closureLift (f : K →+* L)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) (x : AlgebraicClosure K) :
    closureLift f ((map f σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)).toAlgHom x) = σ (closureLift f x)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra K L := f.toAlgebra
  let j : AlgebraicClosure K →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure L := IsAlgClosed.lift
  let : Algebra (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure L) := j.toAlgebra
  change j (((σ.restrictScalars K).restrictNormal (AlgebraicClosure K)) x) = σ (j x)
  exact (σ.restrictScalars K).restrictNormal_commutes (AlgebraicClosure K) x

name: Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.exists_precomposition_aut
statement:
private theorem exists_precomposition_aut
    {Ω : Type*} [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    (j₁ j₂ : AlgebraicClosure K →ₐ[K] Ω) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K), ∀ x, j₁ (τ x) = j₂ x
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (AlgebraicClosure K) Ω := j₁.toAlgebra
  refine ⟨j₂.restrictNormal' (AlgebraicClosure K), fun x => ?_⟩
  exact j₂.restrictNormal_commutes (AlgebraicClosure K) x

name: Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.character_map_comp
statement:
theorem character_map_comp
    {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    (f : K →+* L) (g : L →+* M)
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A) :
    χ.comp (map (g.comp f)) = (χ.comp (map f)).comp (map g)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra K M := (g.comp f).toAlgebra
  let j₁ : AlgebraicClosure K →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure M :=
    { toRingHom := closureLift (g.comp f)
      commutes' := fun x => closureLift_algebraMap (g.comp f) x }
  let j₂ : AlgebraicClosure K →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure M :=
    { toRingHom := (closureLift g).comp (closureLift f)
      commutes' := by
        intro x
        change closureLift g (closureLift f (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) x)) = _
        rw [closureLift_algebraMap, closureLift_algebraMap]
        rfl }
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_precomposition_aut j₁ j₂
  ext σ
  let ρ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) := map (g.comp f) σ
  let θ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) := map f (map g σ)
  let σ' : Gal(AlgebraicClosure M/M) := σ
  let η : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) := map g σ
  have hcomm : ρ * τ = τ * θ := by
    ext x
    apply j₁.injective
    change j₁ (ρ (τ x)) = j₁ (τ (θ x))
    calc
      j₁ (ρ (τ x)) = σ' (j₁ (τ x)) := map_closureLift (g.comp f) σ' (τ x)
      _ = σ' (j₂ x) := congrArg σ' (hτ x)
      _ = closureLift g (η (closureLift f x)) := (map_closureLift g σ' _).symm
      _ = j₂ (θ x) := congrArg (closureLift g) (map_closureLift f η x).symm
      _ = j₁ (τ (θ x)) := (hτ (θ x)).symm
  have hχ := congrArg χ hcomm
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, mul_comm (χ τ)] at hχ
  exact mul_right_cancel hχ

name: ContinuousCohomology.homogeneous_oneCocycle_eq_difference
statement:
theorem homogeneous_oneCocycle_eq_difference
    (X : TopRep.{u} ℤ G) (z : cocycles X 1) (g h : G) :
    ((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 1 z).1 g h =
      (crossedHomOfCocycle X z).toFun h - (crossedHomOfCocycle X z).toFun g
proof:
:= by
  let σ := (homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 1 z
  have hz := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles_d 1 2) z
  have hd := congrArg (fun τ => τ 1 g h) (homogeneousCochains.d_apply X 1 σ)
  have hz' := congrArg (fun τ => τ.1 1 g h) hz
  change (((homogeneousCochains X).d 1 2).hom σ).1 1 g h = 0 at hz'
  rw [hd] at hz'
  simp only [d_succ, d_zero, TopRep.hom_sub,
    ContIntertwiningMap.sub_apply, coind₁ι_toFun, coind₁Map_toFun,
    ContinuousMap.const_apply, ContinuousMap.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom,
    ContinuousMap.sub_apply] at hz'
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz'

name: ContinuousCohomology.map_surjective_of_crossedHom_lifting
statement:
theorem map_surjective_of_crossedHom_lifting
    (X Y : TopRep.{u} ℤ G)
    (f : TopRep.res (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) X ⟶ Y)
    (hlift : ∀ c : CrossedHom Y, ∃ d : CrossedHom X,
      ∀ g : G, f.hom (d.toFun g) = c.toFun g) :
    Function.Surjective (map (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := π_surjective Y 1 a
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hlift (crossedHomOfCocycle Y z)
  refine ⟨π X 1 d.toCocycle, ?_⟩
  have hcycles : cocyclesMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1 d.toCocycle = z := by
    let F := forget₂ (TopModuleCat ℤ) (ModuleCat ℤ)
    have hinj := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (F.map ((homogeneousCochains Y).iCycles 1))).mp
      inferInstance
    apply hinj
    change (homogeneousCochains Y).iCycles 1
      (cocyclesMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1 d.toCocycle) =
        (homogeneousCochains Y).iCycles 1 z
    have hmap := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i (cochainsMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f) 1) d.toCocycle
    change (homogeneousCochains Y).iCycles 1
      (cocyclesMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1 d.toCocycle) =
      (cochainsMap (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f).f 1
        ((homogeneousCochains X).iCycles 1 d.toCocycle) at hmap
    rw [hmap, d.iCycles_toCocycle]
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext g h
    change f.hom (d.toFun h - d.toFun g) = ((homogeneousCochains Y).iCycles 1 z).1 g h
    rw [map_sub, hd, hd, homogeneous_oneCocycle_eq_difference]
  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (π_map (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1) d.toCocycle
  change (map (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) f 1) (π X 1 d.toCocycle) = _ at hnat
  exact hnat.trans (congrArg (π Y 1) hcycles)

name: ClassFieldTower.ProP.cyclicPrimePower_hasOpenNormalBasis
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero (p ^ s) := ⟨pow_ne_zero s (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  apply HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.of_finite_discrete
    (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_formation p).quotientClosed
  refine ⟨inferInstance, IsPGroup.of_card_dvd_pow (n := s) ?_⟩
  have hcard : Nat.card (ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ s)))) = p ^ s := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ulift : ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ s))) ≃
      Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ s)))]
    simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_multiplicative, ZMod.card]
  rw [hcard]

name: ClassFieldTower.ProP.residualAbelianization_conjugation_ne_one_of_cyclicCharacter_ne
statement:
theorem residualAbelianization_conjugation_ne_one_of_cyclicCharacter_ne
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (p s : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (hN : IsClosed (N : Set G)) (g : G)
    (χ : N →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ s))) (x : N)
    (hχ : χ (MulAut.conjNormal g x) ≠ χ x) :
    (TopologicalAbelianization.congr
      (residualQuotientConjugationContinuousMulEquiv
        (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) N hN g)).toMulEquiv ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace N := hN.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let χup : N →ₜ* ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ s))) :=
    { toMonoidHom := MulEquiv.ulift.symm.toMonoidHom.comp χ.toMonoidHom
      continuous_toFun := continuous_uliftUp.comp χ.continuous_toFun }
  let ψ : N ⧸ proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) N →ₜ*
      ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ s))) :=
    lift_proCResidualCoreQuotient (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_hereditary p)
      χup (cyclicPrimePower_hasOpenNormalBasis p s)
  apply KummerTheory.topologicalAbelianization_congr_ne_one_of_character_ne
    (χ := ψ) (x := QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) N) x)
  rw [residualQuotientConjugationContinuousMulEquiv_apply_mk]
  change ψ (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) N)
      (MulAut.conjNormal g x)) ≠
    ψ (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) N) x)
  simp only [ψ, lift_proCResidualCoreQuotient_mk]
  intro heq
  exact hχ (congrArg ULift.down heq)

name: ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.transfer_subtype_eq_pow_of_conjInvariant
statement:
theorem transfer_subtype_eq_pow_of_conjInvariant
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] [H.FiniteIndex] (φ : H →* A)
    (hinv : ∀ (g : G) (h : H), φ (MulAut.conjNormal g h) = φ h) (h : H) :
    MonoidHom.transfer φ (h : G) = φ h ^ H.index
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T : H.LeftTransversal := default
  let := H.fintypeQuotientOfFiniteIndex
  have hsmul (q : G ⧸ H) : (h : G)⁻¹ • q = q := by
    refine Quotient.inductionOn' q ?_
    intro g
    change (((h : G)⁻¹ * g : G) : G ⧸ H) = (g : G ⧸ H)
    rw [QuotientGroup.mk_mul, QuotientGroup.mk_inv,
      (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (h : G)).mpr h.property, inv_one, one_mul]
  rw [MonoidHom.transfer_def φ T]
  unfold Subgroup.leftTransversals.diff
  calc
    _ = ∏ q : G ⧸ H, φ h := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro q hq
      trans φ (MulAut.conjNormal ((T.2.leftQuotientEquiv q : G)⁻¹) h)
      · apply congrArg φ
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp only [Subgroup.smul_apply_eq_smul_apply_inv_smul, hsmul, smul_eq_mul,
          MulAut.conjNormal_apply, inv_inv, mul_assoc]
      · exact hinv ((T.2.leftQuotientEquiv q : G)⁻¹) h
    _ = φ h ^ H.index := by
      simp only [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Subgroup.index_eq_card,
        Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.cyclicCharacterRestriction_injective_of_index_coprime
statement:
theorem cyclicCharacterRestriction_injective_of_index_coprime
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (n : ℕ) (hcop : H.index.Coprime n) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun φ : G →* Multiplicative (ZMod n) => φ.comp H.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ ψ hres
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro g
  have hpow : g ^ H.index ∈ H := by
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (g ^ H.index)).mp
    change (QuotientGroup.mk' H) (g ^ H.index) = 1
    rw [map_pow, Subgroup.index_eq_card]
    exact pow_card_eq_one'
  have heq := DFunLike.congr_fun hres (⟨g ^ H.index, hpow⟩ : H)
  change φ (g ^ H.index) = ψ (g ^ H.index) at heq
  rw [map_pow, map_pow] at heq
  have hunit : IsUnit (H.index : ZMod n) :=
    (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime H.index n).mpr hcop
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  apply hunit.mul_left_cancel
  simpa only [toAdd_pow, nsmul_eq_mul] using
    congrArg (fun z : Multiplicative (ZMod n) => z.toAdd) heq

name: ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.primeToIndexCharacterExtension_subtype
statement:
theorem primeToIndexCharacterExtension_subtype
    (H : OpenSubgroup G) [H.toSubgroup.Normal] [H.toSubgroup.FiniteIndex]
    (n : ℕ) (hindex : H.toSubgroup.index.Coprime n)
    (φ : H →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (hinv : ∀ (g : G) (h : H), φ (MulAut.conjNormal g h) = φ h) (h : H) :
    primeToIndexCharacterExtension H n φ (h : G) = φ h
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  change (H.toSubgroup.index : ZMod n)⁻¹ * (openSubgroupTransfer H φ (h : G)).toAdd =
    (φ h).toAdd
  have htransfer : openSubgroupTransfer H φ (h : G) = φ h ^ H.toSubgroup.index :=
    transfer_subtype_eq_pow_of_conjInvariant H.toSubgroup φ.toMonoidHom hinv h
  rw [htransfer, toAdd_pow, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    ZMod.inv_mul_of_unit _ ((ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime _ _).mpr hindex), one_mul]

name: ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.continuous_transfer_of_openSubgroup
statement:
theorem continuous_transfer_of_openSubgroup
    (H : OpenSubgroup G) [H.toSubgroup.FiniteIndex]
    (φ : H →* A) (hφ : Continuous φ) : Continuous (MonoidHom.transfer φ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T : H.toSubgroup.LeftTransversal := default
  let := H.toSubgroup.fintypeQuotientOfFiniteIndex
  have hrep : Continuous (fun q : G ⧸ H.toSubgroup =>
      (T.2.leftQuotientEquiv q : G)) := continuous_of_discreteTopology
  have hdef : (MonoidHom.transfer φ : G → A) =
      fun g => Subgroup.leftTransversals.diff φ T (g • T) := by
    funext g
    exact MonoidHom.transfer_def φ T g
  rw [hdef]
  unfold Subgroup.leftTransversals.diff
  apply continuous_finsetProd
  intro q _hq
  apply hφ.comp
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  apply continuous_const.mul
  simp_rw [Subgroup.smul_apply_eq_smul_apply_inv_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  exact continuous_id.mul (hrep.comp (continuous_inv.smul continuous_const))

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_moved_class_of_degree_eq_char
statement:
theorem exists_moved_class_of_degree_eq_char
    [Infinite (K ⧸ ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range)]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = p) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ≠ 1 ∧ ∃ x : L, ∀ y : L, y ^ p - y ≠ τ x - x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos)
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = p :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdegree
  let e : Gal(L/K) ≃* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    mulEquivOfPrimeCardEq hcard
      (by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_multiplicative, ZMod.card])
  let τ : Gal(L/K) := e.symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod p))
  have hτ : τ ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have ht : e τ = Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod p) := e.apply_symm_apply _
    rw [h, map_one] at ht
    exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ZMod p) ≠ 0) (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd ht).symm
  by_contra hnone
  have hwp (x : L) : ∃ y : L, y ^ p - y = τ x - x := by
    by_contra h
    apply hnone
    refine ⟨τ, hτ, x, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact h ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hbase (a : K) : ∃ y : L, y ^ p - y = algebraMap K L a := by
    let c : Gal(L/K) → L :=
      fun σ => (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L) (e σ).toAdd * algebraMap K L a
    have hc : ∀ σ υ : Gal(L/K), c (σ * υ) = σ (c υ) + c σ := by
      intro σ υ
      have hfixed : σ (c υ) = c υ := by
        dsimp only [c]
        rw [map_mul, σ.commutes]
        simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, map_natCast]
      rw [hfixed]
      change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L) (e (σ * υ)).toAdd * algebraMap K L a =
        (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L) (e υ).toAdd * algebraMap K L a +
          (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L) (e σ).toAdd * algebraMap K L a
      rw [map_mul]
      change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L) ((e σ).toAdd + (e υ).toAdd) *
        algebraMap K L a = _
      rw [map_add, add_mul, add_comm]
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := GaloisCohomology.additiveHilbert90_finite c hc
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hwp β
    refine ⟨y, hy.trans ((hβ τ).trans ?_)⟩
    change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L) (e (e.symm _)).toAdd * algebraMap K L a =
      algebraMap K L a
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
    change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L) 1 * algebraMap K L a = _
    rw [map_one, one_mul]
  have hzero (q : K ⧸
      ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range) :
      classMap p (algebraMap K L) q = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
      ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range q
    change (algebraMap K L a : L ⧸
      ((frobenius L p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id L).range) = 0
    apply (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr
    exact hbase a
  have : Finite (classMap p (algebraMap K L)).ker := finite_classMap_kernel p
  have : Finite (K ⧸
      ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range) :=
    Finite.of_injective
      (fun q => (⟨q, hzero q⟩ : (classMap p (algebraMap K L)).ker))
      (fun _ _ h => congrArg Subtype.val h)
  exact not_finite (K ⧸
    ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range)

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_character_moved_by_map_of_pow_sub_ne
statement:
theorem exists_character_moved_by_map_of_pow_sub_ne
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (a : K) (ha : ∀ y : K, y ^ p - y ≠ τ a - a) :
    ∃ χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p),
      ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K),
        χ (map τ.toRingHom σ) ≠ χ σ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! hfixed
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_root p (SeparableClosure K)
    (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) a)
  let γ := separableClosureLift τ.toRingHom β
  have hγ : γ ^ p - γ = algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) (τ a) := by
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_sub, hβ, separableClosureLift_algebraMap]
    rfl
  let χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    (rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure K) a β hβ).comp
      (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom (separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K))
  have hchars (σ : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) :
      rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure K) (τ a) γ hγ σ =
        rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure K) a β hβ σ := by
    obtain ⟨ρ, rfl⟩ := (separableClosureAutEquiv K).surjective σ
    exact (rootCharacter_fieldMap p τ.toRingHom a β hβ hγ ρ).symm.trans
      (hfixed χ ρ)
  have hdiff (σ : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) : σ (γ - β) = γ - β := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun z : Multiplicative (ZMod p) =>
        (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) (SeparableClosure K)) z.toAdd) (hchars σ)
    rw [rootCharacter_cast, rootCharacter_cast] at h
    rw [map_sub]
    linear_combination h
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
    (InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed (γ - β)).mpr hdiff
  apply ha x
  apply (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).injective
  rw [map_sub, map_pow, hx, sub_pow_char, map_sub]
  linear_combination hγ - hβ

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.classMap_mk
statement:
theorem classMap_mk (f : K →+* L) (a : K) :
    classMap p f (a : K ⧸
      ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range) =
        (f a : L ⧸ ((frobenius L p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id L).range)
proof: := rfl

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.finite_classMap_kernel
statement:
theorem finite_classMap_kernel [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] :
    Finite (classMap p (algebraMap K L)).ker
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := (classMap p (algebraMap K L)).ker
  have hroot (q : R) : ∃ (a : K) (β : L),
      (a : K ⧸ ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range) = q.val ∧
        β ^ p - β = algebraMap K L a := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
      ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range q.val
    change (a : K ⧸ ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range) = q.val at ha
    have hz : (algebraMap K L a : L ⧸
        ((frobenius L p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id L).range) = 0 := by
      change classMap p (algebraMap K L) a = 0
      rw [ha]
      exact q.property
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff (algebraMap K L a)).mp hz
    exact ⟨a, β, ha, hβ⟩
  choose a β ha hβ using hroot
  let e : R → (Gal(L/K) → ZMod p) :=
    fun q σ => (rootCharacter p L (a q) (β q) (hβ q) σ).toAdd
  apply Finite.of_injective e
  intro q r heq
  have hfixed (σ : Gal(L/K)) : σ (β q - β r) = β q - β r := by
    have h := congrArg (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L) (congrFun heq σ)
    change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L)
      ((rootCharacter p L (a q) (β q) (hβ q) σ).toAdd) =
        (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) L)
          ((rootCharacter p L (a r) (β r) (hβ r) σ).toAdd) at h
    rw [rootCharacter_cast, rootCharacter_cast] at h
    rw [map_sub]
    linear_combination h
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
    (InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed (β q - β r)).mpr hfixed
  have hxAS : x ^ p - x = a q - a r := by
    apply (algebraMap K L).injective
    rw [map_sub, map_pow, hx, sub_pow_char, map_sub]
    linear_combination hβ q - hβ r
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [← ha q, ← ha r]
  apply QuotientAddGroup.eq.mpr
  refine ⟨-x, ?_⟩
  change (-x) ^ p - (-x) = -(a q) + a r
  have hneg := map_neg
    ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K) x
  change (-x) ^ p - (-x) = -(x ^ p - x) at hneg
  rw [hneg, hxAS]
  ring

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_zmod_primitive_of_two_cocycle_open
statement:
theorem exists_zmod_primitive_of_two_cocycle_open
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP Ω p]
    (H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K))
    (z : ↥(H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) → ↥(H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) → ZMod p)
    (hz : ∀ σ τ υ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)),
      z σ (τ * υ) + z τ υ = z (σ * τ) υ + z σ τ)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant
      (fun x : ↥(H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) × ↥(H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) => z x.1 x.2)) :
    ∃ d : ↥(H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) → ZMod p, IsLocallyConstant d ∧
      ∀ σ τ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)), d τ - d (σ * τ) + d σ = z σ τ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := KummerTheory.exists_finiteIntermediateField_openSubgroup_equiv H
  let zE : Gal(Ω/E) → Gal(Ω/E) → ZMod p := fun σ τ => z (e.symm σ) (e.symm τ)
  have hzE (σ τ υ : Gal(Ω/E)) :
      zE σ (τ * υ) + zE τ υ = zE (σ * τ) υ + zE σ τ := by
    simpa only [zE, map_mul] using hz (e.symm σ) (e.symm τ) (e.symm υ)
  obtain ⟨dE, hdElc, hdE⟩ := exists_zmod_primitive_of_two_cocycle (K := E) p zE hzE
    (hlc.comp_continuous (e.symm.continuous.prodMap e.symm.continuous))
  refine ⟨fun σ => dE (e σ), hdElc.comp_continuous e.continuous, ?_⟩
  intro σ τ
  simpa only [map_mul, zE, e.symm_apply_apply] using hdE (e σ) (e τ)

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.rootCharacter_fieldMap
statement:
theorem rootCharacter_fieldMap (f : K →+* L) (a : K) (β : SeparableClosure K)
    (hβ : β ^ p - β = algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) a)
    (hβL : (separableClosureLift f β) ^ p - separableClosureLift f β =
      algebraMap L (SeparableClosure L) (f a))
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) :
    rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure K) a β hβ
        (separableClosureAutEquiv K (map f σ)) =
      rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure L) (f a) (separableClosureLift f β) hβL
        (separableClosureAutEquiv L σ)
proof:
:= by
  change (rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure K) a β hβ
        (separableClosureAutEquiv K (map f σ))).toAdd =
      (rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure L) (f a) (separableClosureLift f β) hβL
        (separableClosureAutEquiv L σ)).toAdd
  apply (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) (SeparableClosure L)).injective
  rw [rootCharacter_cast]
  have h := congrArg (separableClosureLift f)
    (rootCharacter_cast p (SeparableClosure K) a β hβ
      (separableClosureAutEquiv K (map f σ)))
  rw [map_sub, map_separableClosureLift] at h
  simpa only [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, map_natCast] using h

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.surjective_characters_of_artinSchreierClasses
statement:
theorem surjective_characters_of_artinSchreierClasses
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] [∀ i, CharP (L i) p]
    (f : ∀ i, K →+* L i)
    (hclasses : Function.Surjective (fun (a : K) (i : ι) =>
      (f i a : (L i) ⧸
        ((frobenius (L i) p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id (L i)).range))) :
    Function.Surjective (fun χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) =>
      fun i => (χ.comp (map (f i)) :
        Gal(AlgebraicClosure (L i)/L i) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro χlocal
  let η (i : ι) : Gal(SeparableClosure (L i)/L i) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    (χlocal i).comp (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom
      (separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv (L i)).symm)
  choose a b hb hχ using fun i => exists_rootCharacter_eq p (η i)
  obtain ⟨a0, ha0⟩ := hclasses (fun i => (a i : (L i) ⧸
    ((frobenius (L i) p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id (L i)).range))
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_root p (SeparableClosure K) (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) a0)
  let χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    (rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure K) a0 β hβ).comp
      (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom (separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K))
  refine ⟨χ, funext (fun i => ?_)⟩
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  have hβi : (separableClosureLift (f i) β) ^ p - separableClosureLift (f i) β =
      algebraMap (L i) (SeparableClosure (L i)) (f i a0) := by
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_sub, hβ, separableClosureLift_algebraMap]
  change rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure K) a0 β hβ
    (separableClosureAutEquiv K (map (f i) σ)) = χlocal i σ
  calc
    _ = rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure (L i)) (f i a0)
        (separableClosureLift (f i) β) hβi (separableClosureAutEquiv (L i) σ) :=
      rootCharacter_fieldMap p (f i) a0 β hβ hβi σ
    _ = rootCharacter p (SeparableClosure (L i)) (a i) (b i) (hb i)
        (separableClosureAutEquiv (L i) σ) :=
      DFunLike.congr_fun (rootCharacter_eq_of_class_eq p (f i a0) (a i)
        (separableClosureLift (f i) β) (b i) hβi (hb i) (congrFun ha0 i)) _
    _ = η i (separableClosureAutEquiv (L i) σ) := DFunLike.congr_fun (hχ i) _
    _ = χlocal i σ := congrArg (χlocal i)
      ((separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv (L i)).symm_apply_apply σ)

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_rootCharacter_eq
statement:
theorem exists_rootCharacter_eq (χ : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p)) :
    ∃ (a : K) (β : Ω) (hβ : β ^ p - β = algebraMap K Ω a),
      rootCharacter p Ω a β hβ = χ
proof:
:= by
  let c : Gal(Ω/K) → Ω := fun σ => (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) (χ σ).toAdd
  have hc : ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K), c (σ * τ) = σ (c τ) + c σ := by
    intro σ τ
    have hfix : σ (c τ) = c τ := by
      simp only [c, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, map_natCast]
    rw [hfix]
    change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) (χ (σ * τ)).toAdd = _
    rw [map_mul]
    change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) ((χ σ).toAdd + (χ τ).toAdd) = _
    rw [map_add, add_comm]
  have hlc : IsLocallyConstant c :=
    ((IsLocallyConstant.iff_continuous χ).mpr χ.continuous).comp
      (fun z : Multiplicative (ZMod p) => (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) z.toAdd)
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := GaloisCohomology.additiveHilbert90_of_isLocallyConstant c hc hlc
  have hfixed : ∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K), σ (β ^ p - β) = β ^ p - β := by
    intro σ
    have hσ : σ β = c σ + β := (sub_eq_iff_eq_add).mp (hβ σ)
    have hpow : c σ ^ p = c σ := by
      change ((ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) (χ σ).toAdd) ^ p = _
      rw [← map_pow, ZMod.pow_card]
    rw [map_sub, map_pow, hσ, add_pow_char, hpow]
    ring
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed (β ^ p - β)).mpr hfixed
  refine ⟨a, β, ha.symm, ?_⟩
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  change (rootCharacter p Ω a β ha.symm σ).toAdd = (χ σ).toAdd
  apply (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω).injective
  exact (rootCharacter_cast p Ω a β ha.symm σ).trans (hβ σ)

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.rootCharacter_eq_of_class_eq
statement:
theorem rootCharacter_eq_of_class_eq (a b : K) (β γ : Ω)
    (hβ : β ^ p - β = algebraMap K Ω a)
    (hγ : γ ^ p - γ = algebraMap K Ω b)
    (hab : (a : K ⧸ ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range) =
      (b : K ⧸ ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range)) :
    rootCharacter p Ω a β hβ = rootCharacter p Ω b γ hγ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.eq.mp hab
  change x ^ p - x = -a + b at hx
  have hxmap := congrArg (algebraMap K Ω) hx
  rw [map_sub, map_pow, map_add, map_neg] at hxmap
  have hβ' : (β + algebraMap K Ω x) ^ p - (β + algebraMap K Ω x) =
      algebraMap K Ω b := by
    rw [add_pow_char]
    linear_combination hβ + hxmap
  apply Eq.trans ?_ (rootCharacter_eq p Ω b (β + algebraMap K Ω x) γ hβ' hγ)
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  change (rootCharacter p Ω a β hβ σ).toAdd =
    (rootCharacter p Ω b (β + algebraMap K Ω x) hβ' σ).toAdd
  apply (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω).injective
  rw [rootCharacter_cast, rootCharacter_cast, map_add, σ.commutes]
  ring

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_nontrivial_absolute_character_of_DVF
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_absolute_character_of_DVF
    (D : DVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] :
    ∃ χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p),
      ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K), χ σ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨χ, σ, hσ⟩ := exists_nontrivial_character_of_artinSchreier_not_surjective
    (K := K) (Ω := SeparableClosure K) p
    (D.exists_not_pow_sub p (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt)
  let e := ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K
  refine ⟨χ.comp (e : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)),
    e.symm σ, ?_⟩
  change χ (e (e.symm σ)) ≠ 1
  rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hσ

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_nontrivial_completion_character_of_DVF
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_completion_character_of_DVF
    (D : DVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p] :
    ∃ χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure D.valuation.Completion/D.valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
      Multiplicative (ZMod p),
      ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure D.valuation.Completion/D.valuation.Completion), χ σ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have : CharP D.valuation.Completion p :=
    (Algebra.charP_iff K D.valuation.Completion p).mp inferInstance
  have : (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation D.valuation.Completion
    D.ValueGroup).IsRankOneDiscrete := Valuation.completion_isRankOneDiscrete D.valuation
  let Dc : DVF D.valuation.Completion :=
    { ValueGroup := D.ValueGroup
      valuation := Valued.v }
  exact exists_nontrivial_absolute_character_of_DVF Dc p

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_additive_primitive_of_zmod_two_cocycle
statement:
theorem exists_additive_primitive_of_zmod_two_cocycle
    (z : Gal(Ω/K) → Gal(Ω/K) → ZMod p)
    (hz : ∀ σ τ υ : Gal(Ω/K),
      z σ (τ * υ) + z τ υ = z (σ * τ) υ + z σ τ)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant (fun x : Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K) => z x.1 x.2)) :
    ∃ b : Gal(Ω/K) → Ω, IsLocallyConstant b ∧
      ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K), σ (b τ) - b (σ * τ) + b σ =
        (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) (z σ τ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E, zE, hvalue⟩ := GaloisCohomology.exists_finiteGalois_factor_continuous_pair
    (fun x : Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K) => z x.1 x.2) hlc.continuous
  let r : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(E/K) := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E
  have hr : Function.Surjective r := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective Ω
  have hzE (σ τ υ : Gal(E/K)) :
      zE σ (τ * υ) + zE τ υ = zE (σ * τ) υ + zE σ τ := by
    obtain ⟨σ', rfl⟩ := hr σ
    obtain ⟨τ', rfl⟩ := hr τ
    obtain ⟨υ', rfl⟩ := hr υ
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul]
    exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hvalue σ' (τ' * υ')) (hvalue τ' υ')).trans
      ((hz σ' τ' υ').trans
        (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hvalue (σ' * τ') υ') (hvalue σ' τ')).symm)
  let φE : ZMod p →+* E := ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) E
  have hfix (σ : Gal(E/K)) (x : ZMod p) : σ (φE x) = φE x := by
    simp only [φE, ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, map_natCast]
  have hcE (σ τ υ : Gal(E/K)) :
      φE (zE σ (τ * υ)) + σ (φE (zE τ υ)) =
        φE (zE (σ * τ) υ) + φE (zE σ τ) := by
    rw [hfix, ← map_add, ← map_add, hzE]
  obtain ⟨bE, hbE⟩ := GaloisCohomology.additiveH2_finite
    (fun σ τ : Gal(E/K) => φE (zE σ τ)) hcE
  let b : Gal(Ω/K) → Ω := fun σ => (bE (r σ) : Ω)
  have hrlc : IsLocallyConstant r :=
    (IsLocallyConstant.iff_continuous r).mpr
      (InfiniteGalois.restrictNormalHom_continuous E.toIntermediateField)
  refine ⟨b, hrlc.comp (fun τ : Gal(E/K) => (bE τ : Ω)), ?_⟩
  intro σ τ
  have hφ (x : ZMod p) :
      ((φE x : E) : Ω) = (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) x := by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective x
    rw [map_intCast, map_intCast]
    rfl
  have h := congrArg (fun x : E => (x : Ω)) (hbE (r σ) (r τ))
  change ((r σ) (bE (r τ)) : Ω) - (bE (r σ * r τ) : Ω) +
    (bE (r σ) : Ω) = ((φE (zE (r σ) (r τ)) : E) : Ω) at h
  rw [AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_apply, ← map_mul, hφ, hvalue] at h
  exact h

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_zmod_primitive_of_two_cocycle
statement:
theorem exists_zmod_primitive_of_two_cocycle
    (z : Gal(Ω/K) → Gal(Ω/K) → ZMod p)
    (hz : ∀ σ τ υ : Gal(Ω/K),
      z σ (τ * υ) + z τ υ = z (σ * τ) υ + z σ τ)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant (fun x : Gal(Ω/K) × Gal(Ω/K) => z x.1 x.2)) :
    ∃ d : Gal(Ω/K) → ZMod p, IsLocallyConstant d ∧
      ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K), d τ - d (σ * τ) + d σ = z σ τ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, hblc, hb⟩ := exists_additive_primitive_of_zmod_two_cocycle p z hz hlc
  let φ : ZMod p →+* Ω := ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω
  let AS : Ω →+ Ω := (frobenius Ω p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id Ω
  have hAS (x : Ω) : AS x = x ^ p - x := rfl
  have hcomm (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (x : Ω) : AS (σ x) = σ (AS x) := by
    rw [hAS, hAS, map_sub, map_pow]
  have hφ (x : ZMod p) : AS (φ x) = 0 := by
    rw [hAS, ← map_pow]
    have hx : x ^ p = x := by
      simpa only [ZMod.card] using (FiniteField.pow_card x)
    rw [hx, sub_self]
  have hc (σ τ : Gal(Ω/K)) : AS (b (σ * τ)) = σ (AS (b τ)) + AS (b σ) := by
    have h := congrArg AS (hb σ τ)
    change AS (σ (b τ) - b (σ * τ) + b σ) = AS (φ (z σ τ)) at h
    rw [map_add, map_sub, hcomm, hφ] at h
    linear_combination -h
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := GaloisCohomology.additiveHilbert90_of_isLocallyConstant
    (fun σ => AS (b σ)) hc (hblc.comp AS)
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_root p Ω a
  have hASβ : AS β = a := hβ
  let D : Gal(Ω/K) → Ω := fun σ => b σ - (σ β - β)
  have hD (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : AS (D σ) = 0 := by
    change AS (b σ - (σ β - β)) = 0
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, hcomm, hASβ, ← ha, sub_self]
  have hDpow (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : D σ ^ p = D σ :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp (hD σ)
  choose d hd using fun σ => exists_zmod_of_pow_eq p Ω (hDpow σ)
  have hDlc : IsLocallyConstant D :=
    (hblc.prodMk ((GaloisCohomology.isLocallyConstant_galois_apply (K := K) β).comp
      (fun x : Ω => x - β))).comp (fun x : Ω × Ω => x.1 - x.2)
  have hdlc : IsLocallyConstant d := by
    rw [IsLocallyConstant.iff_eventually_eq] at hDlc ⊢
    intro σ
    filter_upwards [hDlc σ] with τ hτ
    apply φ.injective
    exact (hd τ).trans (hτ.trans (hd σ).symm)
  refine ⟨d, hdlc, ?_⟩
  intro σ τ
  have hfix : σ (D τ) = D τ := by
    rw [← hd τ]
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, map_natCast]
  have hδ : σ (D τ) - D (σ * τ) + D σ = φ (z σ τ) := by
    dsimp only [D]
    rw [map_sub, map_sub]
    change σ (b τ) - (σ (τ β) - σ β) -
      (b (σ * τ) - (σ (τ β) - β)) + (b σ - (σ β - β)) = φ (z σ τ)
    linear_combination hb σ τ
  apply φ.injective
  change φ (d τ - d (σ * τ) + d σ) = φ (z σ τ)
  rw [map_add, map_sub, hd, hd, hd]
  rw [hfix] at hδ
  exact hδ

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_nontrivial_character_of_artinSchreier_not_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_character_of_artinSchreier_not_surjective
    (hAS : ∃ a : K, ∀ x : K, x ^ p - x ≠ a) :
    ∃ χ : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p), ∃ σ : Gal(Ω/K), χ σ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hAS
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_root p Ω (algebraMap K Ω a)
  let χ := rootCharacter p Ω a β hβ
  refine ⟨χ, ?_⟩
  by_contra! h
  have hfixed (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : σ β = β := by
    have hc := rootCharacter_cast p Ω a β hβ σ
    change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) (χ σ).toAdd = σ β - β at hc
    rw [h σ] at hc
    change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) 0 = σ β - β at hc
    rw [map_zero] at hc
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hc.symm
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed β).mpr hfixed
  apply ha x
  apply (algebraMap K Ω).injective
  rw [map_sub, map_pow, hx]
  exact hβ

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_zmod_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem exists_zmod_of_pow_eq {x : Ω} (hx : x ^ p = x) :
    ∃ z : ZMod p, (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) z = x
proof:
:= by
  let f : (ZMod p)[X] := X ^ p - X
  have hr : f.roots = Finset.univ.val := by
    simpa only [ZMod.card] using FiniteField.roots_X_pow_card_sub_X (K := ZMod p)
  have hsplit : f.Splits := Polynomial.splits_iff_card_roots.mpr (by
    rw [hr]
    change Fintype.card (ZMod p) = f.natDegree
    rw [ZMod.card]
    exact (FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_natDegree_eq (ZMod p) (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt).symm)
  apply hsplit.mem_range_of_isRoot
    (FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_ne_zero (ZMod p) (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt)
  simp only [f, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X,
    Polynomial.IsRoot.def, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X,
    hx, sub_self]

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_root
statement: theorem exists_root [IsSepClosed Ω] (a : Ω) : ∃ β : Ω, β ^ p - β = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := IsSepClosed.exists_root_C_mul_X_pow_add_C_mul_X_add_C
    (1 : Ω) (-1) (-a) (CharP.cast_eq_zero Ω p) (Fact.out : p.Prime).two_le
    (neg_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero)
  refine ⟨β, ?_⟩
  simpa only [one_mul, neg_one_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_zero] using hβ

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.rootDifference_pow_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_pow_char]
  have hσ := congrArg σ hβ
  rw [map_sub, map_pow, σ.commutes] at hσ
  linear_combination hσ - hβ

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.rootCharacterValue_cast
statement:
theorem rootCharacterValue_cast (a : K) (β : Ω)
    (hβ : β ^ p - β = algebraMap K Ω a) (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) (rootCharacterValue p Ω a β hβ σ) = σ β - β
proof:
:=
  (exists_zmod_of_pow_eq p Ω (rootDifference_pow_eq p Ω a β hβ σ)).choose_spec

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.rootCharacter_cast
statement:
theorem rootCharacter_cast (a : K) (β : Ω)
    (hβ : β ^ p - β = algebraMap K Ω a) (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω) ((rootCharacter p Ω a β hβ σ).toAdd) = σ β - β
proof:
:=
  rootCharacterValue_cast p Ω a β hβ σ

name: ArtinSchreierTheory.rootCharacter_eq
statement:
theorem rootCharacter_eq (a : K) (β γ : Ω)
    (hβ : β ^ p - β = algebraMap K Ω a)
    (hγ : γ ^ p - γ = algebraMap K Ω a) :
    rootCharacter p Ω a β hβ = rootCharacter p Ω a γ hγ
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : (β - γ) ^ p = β - γ := by
    rw [sub_pow_char]
    linear_combination hβ - hγ
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_zmod_of_pow_eq p Ω hdiff
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  change (rootCharacter p Ω a β hβ σ).toAdd = (rootCharacter p Ω a γ hγ σ).toAdd
  apply (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl p) Ω).injective
  rw [rootCharacter_cast, rootCharacter_cast]
  have hfix : σ (β - γ) = β - γ := by
    rw [← hz]
    simp only [ZMod.castHom_apply, ZMod.cast_eq_val, map_natCast]
  rw [map_sub] at hfix
  linear_combination hfix

name: FieldTheory.torsionUnit_mem_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem torsionUnit_mem_algebraicClosure (z : Kˣ) (hz : IsOfFinOrder z) :
    (z : K) ∈ algebraicClosure F K
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_algebraicClosure_iff'.mpr
  apply IsIntegral.of_pow hz.orderOf_pos
  have hpow : (z : K) ^ orderOf z = 1 := by
    exact congrArg Units.val (pow_orderOf_eq_one z)
  rw [hpow]
  exact isIntegral_one

name: FieldTheory.finite_torsion_units_of_finite_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_units_of_finite_algebraicClosure
    [Finite (algebraicClosure F K)] : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  let f : CommGroup.torsion Kˣ → algebraicClosure F K := fun z =>
    ⟨(z.1 : K), torsionUnit_mem_algebraicClosure F K z.1 z.property⟩
  apply Finite.of_injective f
  intro x y h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Units.ext (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: FieldTheory.finite_primaryComponent_of_finite_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_of_finite_algebraicClosure
    [Finite (algebraicClosure F K)] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ) :=
    finite_torsion_units_of_finite_algebraicClosure F K
  have hle : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p ≤ CommGroup.torsion Kˣ := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hz
    exact isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨p ^ n, pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos n, hn⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective (Subgroup.inclusion hle) (Subgroup.inclusion_injective hle)

name: FieldTheory.exists_not_pow_sub_of_finite_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem exists_not_pow_sub_of_finite_algebraicClosure
    [Finite (algebraicClosure F K)] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) :
    ∃ a : K, ∀ x : K, x ^ n - x ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := algebraicClosure F K
  have hnot : ¬ Function.Surjective (fun x : C => x ^ n - x) := by
    intro hs
    have hi := (Finite.injective_iff_surjective).mpr hs
    have h01 : (0 : C) = 1 := hi (by simp only [zero_pow (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn),
      one_pow, sub_self])
    exact zero_ne_one h01
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := not_forall.mp hnot
  refine ⟨(a : K), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hxC : IsIntegral C x := by
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ n - (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C a), ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub
      rw [Polynomial.degree_X_add_C]
      exact WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr hn
    · change Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.X ^ n - (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C a)) = 0
      simp only [map_sub, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X, map_add,
        Polynomial.aeval_C]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr ((sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hx).trans (add_comm _ _))
  have hxF : IsIntegral F x := isIntegral_trans x hxC
  let y : C := ⟨x, mem_algebraicClosure_iff'.mpr hxF⟩
  apply ha
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hx

name: GaloisCohomology.additiveHilbert90_finite
statement:
theorem additiveHilbert90_finite [FiniteDimensional K Ω]
    (c : Gal(Ω/K) → Ω)
    (hc : ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K), c (σ * τ) = σ (c τ) + c σ) :
    ∃ β : Ω, ∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K), σ β - β = c σ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Algebra.trace_surjective K Ω 1
  have htrace : ∑ τ : Gal(Ω/K), τ a = 1 := by
    rw [← trace_eq_sum_automorphisms, ha, map_one]
  let B : Ω := ∑ τ : Gal(Ω/K), c τ * τ a
  have hB (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : σ B = B - c σ := by
    have hperm : (∑ τ : Gal(Ω/K), c (σ * τ) * (σ * τ) a) = B :=
      Fintype.sum_bijective (fun τ : Gal(Ω/K) => σ * τ)
        (Group.mulLeft_bijective σ) _ _ (fun _ => rfl)
    have hpermTrace : (∑ τ : Gal(Ω/K), (σ * τ) a) = 1 := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_bijective (fun τ : Gal(Ω/K) => σ * τ)
        (Group.mulLeft_bijective σ) _ (fun τ => τ a) (fun _ => rfl)]
      exact htrace
    calc
      σ B = ∑ τ : Gal(Ω/K), (c (σ * τ) - c σ) * (σ * τ) a := by
        dsimp only [B]
        rw [map_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro τ _
        rw [map_mul, hc, add_sub_cancel_right]
        rfl
      _ = (∑ τ : Gal(Ω/K), c (σ * τ) * (σ * τ) a) -
          c σ * (∑ τ : Gal(Ω/K), (σ * τ) a) := by
        simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = B - c σ := by rw [hperm, hpermTrace, mul_one]
  refine ⟨-B, ?_⟩
  intro σ
  rw [map_neg, hB]
  ring

name: GaloisCohomology.additive_cocycle_finite_stage
statement:
private theorem additive_cocycle_finite_stage
    (c : Gal(Ω/K) → Ω)
    (hc : ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K), c (σ * τ) = σ (c τ) + c σ)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant c) :
    ∃ (E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ω) (cE : Gal(E/K) → E),
      (∀ σ τ : Gal(E/K), cE (σ * τ) = σ (cE τ) + cE σ) ∧
      ∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K), (cE (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ) : Ω) = c σ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc1 : c 1 = 0 := by
    have h : c 1 = c 1 + c 1 := hc 1 1
    exact (add_left_cancel ((add_zero (c 1)).trans h)).symm
  have hnhds : {g : Gal(Ω/K) | c g = 0} ∈ 𝓝 1 :=
    (hlc.isOpen_fiber 0).mem_nhds hc1
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ :=
    (InfiniteGalois.krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff_of_isGalois
      (k := K) (K := Ω) {g : Gal(Ω/K) | c g = 0}).1 hnhds
  let r : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(E/K) := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E
  have hr : Function.Surjective r := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective Ω
  have hker (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (hσ : r σ = 1) : c σ = 0 := by
    apply hE
    change σ ∈ E.fixingSubgroup
    rw [← IntermediateField.restrictNormalHom_ker]
    exact hσ
  have hfactor (σ τ : Gal(Ω/K)) (heq : r σ = r τ) : c σ = c τ := by
    have hrel : r (τ⁻¹ * σ) = 1 := by rw [map_mul, map_inv, heq, inv_mul_cancel]
    have hc_rel := hker (τ⁻¹ * σ) hrel
    calc
      c σ = c (τ * (τ⁻¹ * σ)) := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]
      _ = c τ := by rw [hc, hc_rel, map_zero, zero_add]
  have hmem (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : c σ ∈ E.toIntermediateField := by
    rw [← InfiniteGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup E.toIntermediateField,
      IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff]
    intro τ hτ
    have hrτ : r τ = 1 := by
      change τ ∈ r.ker
      rw [IntermediateField.restrictNormalHom_ker]
      exact hτ
    have hcτ : c τ = 0 := hker τ hrτ
    calc
      τ (c σ) = c (τ * σ) := by rw [hc, hcτ, add_zero]
      _ = c σ := hfactor (τ * σ) σ (by rw [map_mul, hrτ, one_mul])
  let cE : Gal(E/K) → E := fun σ => ⟨c (hr σ).choose, hmem (hr σ).choose⟩
  have hvalue (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : (cE (r σ) : Ω) = c σ := by
    exact hfactor _ _ (hr (r σ)).choose_spec
  have hcE (σ τ : Gal(E/K)) : cE (σ * τ) = σ (cE τ) + cE σ := by
    obtain ⟨σ', rfl⟩ := hr σ
    obtain ⟨τ', rfl⟩ := hr τ
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (cE (r σ' * r τ') : Ω) =
      ((r σ') (cE (r τ')) : Ω) + (cE (r σ') : Ω)
    rw [← map_mul, hvalue,
      AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_apply E.toIntermediateField σ' (cE (r τ'))]
    rw [hvalue, hvalue]
    exact hc σ' τ'
  exact ⟨E, cE, hcE, hvalue⟩

name: GaloisCohomology.additiveHilbert90_of_isLocallyConstant
statement:
theorem additiveHilbert90_of_isLocallyConstant
    (c : Gal(Ω/K) → Ω)
    (hc : ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K), c (σ * τ) = σ (c τ) + c σ)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant c) :
    ∃ β : Ω, ∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K), σ β - β = c σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, cE, hcE, hvalue⟩ := additive_cocycle_finite_stage c hc hlc
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := additiveHilbert90_finite cE hcE
  refine ⟨(β : Ω), ?_⟩
  intro σ
  have h := congrArg (fun x : E => (x : Ω)) (hβ (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ))
  change ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ) β : Ω) - (β : Ω) =
    (cE (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ) : Ω) at h
  rw [AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_apply, hvalue] at h
  exact h

name: FieldTheory.isIntegral_torsionUnit
statement:
theorem isIntegral_torsionUnit (z : Kˣ) (hz : IsOfFinOrder z) :
    IsIntegral R (z : K)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsIntegral.of_pow hz.orderOf_pos
  have hp : (z : K) ^ orderOf z = 1 := congrArg Units.val (pow_orderOf_eq_one z)
  rw [hp]
  exact isIntegral_one

name: FieldTheory.finite_algebraic_subextension
statement:
theorem finite_algebraic_subextension
    (F : Type u) (C : Type v) (K : Type w)
    [Field F] [Field C] [Field K] [Algebra F C] [Algebra F K] [Algebra C K]
    [IsScalarTower F C K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F C] [Algebra.EssFiniteType F K] :
    Module.Finite F C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis F K
  let x : s → K := Subtype.val
  have hx : AlgebraicIndependent F x := hs.1
  have hxC : AlgebraicIndependent C x := hx.extendScalars C
  let P := MvPolynomial s F
  let Q := MvPolynomial s C
  let A := FractionRing P
  let B := FractionRing Q
  let T := IntermediateField.adjoin F (Set.range x)
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic T K := hs.isAlgebraic_field
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType T K := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp F T K
  have : Module.Finite T K := Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
  let : Algebra P K := (MvPolynomial.aeval x : P →ₐ[F] K).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra Q K := (MvPolynomial.aeval x : Q →ₐ[C] K).toAlgebra
  have : FaithfulSMul P K :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective P K).mpr hx
  have : FaithfulSMul Q K :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective Q K).mpr hxC
  have : IsScalarTower P Q K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun p => by
    change MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap F K) x p =
      MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap C K) x (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap F C) p)
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  have : Module.Finite A K := Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv
    hx.aevalEquivField.symm.toRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl K) (by
      ext t
      change IsFractionRing.lift hx (hx.aevalEquivField.symm t) = (t : K)
      exact hx.lift_reprField t)
  have : Module.Finite A B :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B K).toLinearMap
      (algebraMap B K).injective
  have hrank := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.rank_fractionRing_mvPolynomial (R := F) (S := C) s
  have hfinite : Module.rank A B < Cardinal.aleph0 := Module.rank_lt_aleph0 A B
  rw [hrank, Cardinal.lift_lt_aleph0] at hfinite
  exact Module.rank_lt_aleph0_iff.mp hfinite

name: FieldTheory.finite_algebraicClosure_of_finite_base
statement:
theorem finite_algebraicClosure_of_finite_base
    (F : Type u) (K : Type v) [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
    [Finite F] [Algebra.EssFiniteType F K] :
    Finite (algebraicClosure F K)
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Finite F (algebraicClosure F K) :=
    finite_algebraic_subextension F (algebraicClosure F K) K
  exact Finite.of_injective (Module.finBasis F (algebraicClosure F K)).equivFun
    (Module.finBasis F (algebraicClosure F K)).equivFun.injective

name: GaloisCohomology.additiveH2_finite
statement:
theorem additiveH2_finite
    (z : Gal(Ω/K) → Gal(Ω/K) → Ω)
    (hz : ∀ σ τ υ : Gal(Ω/K),
      z σ (τ * υ) + σ (z τ υ) = z (σ * τ) υ + z σ τ) :
    ∃ b : Gal(Ω/K) → Ω, ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K),
      σ (b τ) - b (σ * τ) + b σ = z σ τ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Algebra.trace_surjective K Ω 1
  have htrace : ∑ υ : Gal(Ω/K), υ a = 1 := by
    rw [← trace_eq_sum_automorphisms, ha, map_one]
  have htrace_mul (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : (∑ υ : Gal(Ω/K), (σ * υ) a) = 1 := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_bijective (fun υ : Gal(Ω/K) => σ * υ)
      (Group.mulLeft_bijective σ) _ (fun υ => υ a) (fun _ => rfl)]
    exact htrace
  let b : Gal(Ω/K) → Ω := fun σ => ∑ υ : Gal(Ω/K), z σ υ * (σ * υ) a
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  intro σ τ
  have hperm : b σ =
      ∑ υ : Gal(Ω/K), z σ (τ * υ) * (σ * (τ * υ)) a :=
    (Fintype.sum_bijective (fun υ : Gal(Ω/K) => τ * υ)
      (Group.mulLeft_bijective τ) _ (fun υ => z σ υ * (σ * υ) a) (fun _ => rfl)).symm
  have hσb : σ (b τ) = ∑ υ : Gal(Ω/K), σ (z τ υ) * ((σ * τ) * υ) a := by
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro υ _
    rw [map_mul]
    rfl
  calc
    σ (b τ) - b (σ * τ) + b σ =
        ∑ υ : Gal(Ω/K),
          (σ (z τ υ) - z (σ * τ) υ + z σ (τ * υ)) * ((σ * τ) * υ) a := by
      rw [hσb, hperm]
      dsimp only [b]
      simp only [mul_assoc, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        add_mul, sub_mul]
    _ = ∑ υ : Gal(Ω/K), z σ τ * ((σ * τ) * υ) a := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro υ _
      congr 1
      calc
        σ (z τ υ) - z (σ * τ) υ + z σ (τ * υ) =
            (z σ (τ * υ) + σ (z τ υ)) - z (σ * τ) υ := by ring
        _ = (z (σ * τ) υ + z σ τ) - z (σ * τ) υ := by rw [hz]
        _ = z σ τ := by ring
    _ = z σ τ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, htrace_mul, mul_one]

name: FieldTheory.essFiniteType_rat_of_fg
statement:
theorem essFiniteType_rat_of_fg
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K] (hfg : Field.FG K) :
    Algebra.EssFiniteType ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  let F := (⊥ : Subfield K)
  have hs : Function.Surjective (algebraMap ℚ F) := by
    intro x
    have hx : (x : K) ∈ (algebraMap ℚ K).fieldRange := by
      rw [← Subfield.bot_eq_of_charZero]
      exact x.property
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨r, Subtype.ext hr⟩
  have : Module.Finite ℚ F := Module.Finite.of_surjective (Algebra.linearMap ℚ F) hs
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType ℚ F := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_finiteType ℚ F
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType F K := Field.fg_iff_essFiniteType.mp hfg
  exact Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp ℚ F K

name: FieldTheory.finite_torsion_units_numberField
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_units_numberField
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [NumberField K] : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite (CommGroup.torsion (integralClosure ℤ K)ˣ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Finite (NumberField.Units.torsion K))
  exact Finite.of_injective (torsionUnitsIntegralClosureEquiv ℤ K)
    (torsionUnitsIntegralClosureEquiv ℤ K).injective

name: FieldTheory.finite_torsion_units_of_essFiniteType_rat
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_units_of_essFiniteType_rat
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K] [Algebra.EssFiniteType ℚ K] :
    Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  let C := algebraicClosure ℚ K
  have : Module.Finite ℚ C := finite_algebraic_subextension ℚ C K
  have : NumberField C := {}
  have : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Cˣ) := finite_torsion_units_numberField C
  have : Finite (CommGroup.torsion (integralClosure ℚ K)ˣ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Finite (CommGroup.torsion Cˣ))
  exact Finite.of_injective (torsionUnitsIntegralClosureEquiv ℚ K)
    (torsionUnitsIntegralClosureEquiv ℚ K).injective

name: FieldTheory.finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_fg_charZero
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_fg_charZero
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K] (hfg : Field.FG K)
    (L : Type v) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Lˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K L).injective
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType ℚ K := essFiniteType_rat_of_fg K hfg
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType K L := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_finiteType K L
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType ℚ L := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp ℚ K L
  have : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Lˣ) := finite_torsion_units_of_essFiniteType_rat L
  have hle : CommGroup.primaryComponent Lˣ p ≤ CommGroup.torsion Lˣ := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hz
    exact isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨p ^ n, pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos n, hn⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective (Subgroup.inclusion hle) (Subgroup.inclusion_injective hle)

name: FieldTheory.exists_finiteType_int_model
statement:
theorem exists_finiteType_int_model
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hfg : Field.FG K) :
    ∃ A : Subalgebra ℤ K, Algebra.FiniteType ℤ A ∧ IsFractionRing A K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hfg.finitely_generated
  let A := Algebra.adjoin ℤ (s : Set K)
  refine ⟨A, (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType A).mp (Subalgebra.fg_adjoin_finset s), ?_⟩
  apply IsFractionRing.of_field A K
  intro z
  have hz : z ∈ Subfield.closure (s : Set K) := by rw [hs]; exact Subfield.mem_top z
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Subfield.mem_closure_iff.mp hz
  have haA : a ∈ A := by rw [show A = _ from Algebra.adjoin_int (s : Set K)]; exact ha
  have hbA : b ∈ A := by rw [show A = _ from Algebra.adjoin_int (s : Set K)]; exact hb
  exact ⟨⟨a, haA⟩, ⟨b, hbA⟩, hab.symm⟩

name: FieldTheory.int_isJacobsonRing
statement: theorem int_isJacobsonRing : IsJacobsonRing ℤ
proof:
:= by
  apply isJacobsonRing_iff_prime_eq.mpr
  intro P hP
  by_cases hzero : P = ⊥
  · subst P
    apply le_antisymm ?_ Ideal.le_jacobson
    intro x hx
    have hu : IsUnit (x * 3 + 1) := (Ideal.mem_jacobson_bot.mp hx) 3
    rcases Int.isUnit_eq_one_or hu with h | h <;>
      simp only [Ideal.mem_bot] <;> omega
  · have : P.IsMaximal := hP.isMaximal hzero
    exact Ideal.jacobson_eq_self_of_isMaximal

name: FieldTheory.ringChar_ne_zero_of_finiteType_int
statement:
theorem ringChar_ne_zero_of_finiteType_int
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [hfin : Algebra.FiniteType ℤ K] : ringChar K ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hchar
  have : CharP K 0 := hchar ▸ (inferInstance : CharP K (ringChar K))
  have : CharZero K := CharP.charP_to_charZero K
  have : IsJacobsonRing ℤ := int_isJacobsonRing
  have : Module.Finite ℤ K := finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing ℤ K
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral ℤ K := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite ℤ K
  exact Int.not_isField
    (isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ℤ K)
      (Field.toIsField K))

name: FieldTheory.finite_primeSubfield_of_ringChar_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finite_primeSubfield_of_ringChar_ne_zero
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hchar : ringChar K ≠ 0) :
    Finite (⊥ : Subfield K)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (ringChar K).Prime :=
    ⟨(CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero K (ringChar K)).resolve_right hchar⟩
  rw [← ZMod.fieldRange_castHom_eq_bot (ringChar K)]
  exact Finite.of_surjective (ZMod.castHom (m := ringChar K) dvd_rfl K).rangeRestrictField
    (ZMod.castHom (m := ringChar K) dvd_rfl K).rangeRestrictField_bijective.surjective

name: FieldTheory.finite_constants_of_fg_posChar
statement:
theorem finite_constants_of_fg_posChar
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hfg : Field.FG K) (hchar : ringChar K ≠ 0) :
    Finite (algebraicClosure (⊥ : Subfield K) K)
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite (⊥ : Subfield K) := finite_primeSubfield_of_ringChar_ne_zero K hchar
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType (⊥ : Subfield K) K := Field.fg_iff_essFiniteType.mp hfg
  exact finite_algebraicClosure_of_finite_base (⊥ : Subfield K) K

name: FieldTheory.finite_torsion_units_of_fg_posChar
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_units_of_fg_posChar
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hfg : Field.FG K) (hchar : ringChar K ≠ 0) :
    Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite (algebraicClosure (⊥ : Subfield K) K) :=
    finite_constants_of_fg_posChar K hfg hchar
  exact finite_torsion_units_of_finite_algebraicClosure (⊥ : Subfield K) K

name: FieldTheory.exists_not_artinSchreier_of_fg_posChar
statement:
theorem exists_not_artinSchreier_of_fg_posChar
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hfg : Field.FG K) (hchar : ringChar K ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : K, ∀ x : K, x ^ ringChar K - x ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite (algebraicClosure (⊥ : Subfield K) K) :=
    finite_constants_of_fg_posChar K hfg hchar
  exact exists_not_pow_sub_of_finite_algebraicClosure (⊥ : Subfield K) K (ringChar K)
    ((CharP.char_is_prime_or_zero K (ringChar K)).resolve_right hchar).one_lt

name: FieldTheory.finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_fg_posChar
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_fg_posChar
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hfg : Field.FG K) (hchar : ringChar K ≠ 0)
    (L : Type v) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Lˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  let F := (⊥ : Subfield K)
  have : Finite F := finite_primeSubfield_of_ringChar_ne_zero K hchar
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType F K := Field.fg_iff_essFiniteType.mp hfg
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType K L := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_finiteType K L
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType F L := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp F K L
  have : Finite (algebraicClosure F L) := finite_algebraicClosure_of_finite_base F L
  exact finite_primaryComponent_of_finite_algebraicClosure F L p

name: FieldTheory.finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_fg
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_fg
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (hfg : Field.FG K)
    (L : Type v) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Lˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hchar : ringChar K = 0
  · have : CharP K 0 := hchar ▸ (inferInstance : CharP K (ringChar K))
    have : CharZero K := CharP.charP_to_charZero K
    exact finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_fg_charZero K hfg L p
  · exact finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_fg_posChar K hfg hchar L p

name: FieldTheory.ringHom_eq_id_of_div_mem_subfield
statement:
theorem ringHom_eq_id_of_div_mem_subfield
    (C : Subfield K) (hC : C ≠ ⊤) (τ : K →+* K)
    (hratio : ∀ x : K, x ≠ 0 → τ x / x ∈ C) : τ = RingHom.id K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfix (x : K) (hx : x ∉ C) : τ x = x := by
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (h ▸ C.zero_mem)
    have hx1 : x + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have he : x = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
      exact hx (he ▸ C.neg_mem C.one_mem)
    let c : K := τ x / x
    let d : K := τ (x + 1) / (x + 1)
    have hc : c ∈ C := hratio x hx0
    have hd : d ∈ C := hratio (x + 1) hx1
    have hcx : c * x = τ x := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx0
    have hdx : d * (x + 1) = τ x + 1 :=
      (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx1).trans (by rw [map_add, map_one])
    have hrel : (c - d) * x = d - 1 := by linear_combination hcx - hdx
    have hcd : c = d := by
      by_contra hne
      have he : x = (d - 1) / (c - d) := (eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)).mpr
        ((mul_comm x (c - d)).trans hrel)
      exact hx (he ▸ C.div_mem (C.sub_mem hd C.one_mem) (C.sub_mem hc hd))
    have hd1 : d = 1 := by
      rw [hcd, sub_self, zero_mul] at hrel
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hrel.symm
    exact hcx.symm.trans (by rw [hcd, hd1, one_mul])
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : K, y ∉ C := by
    by_contra hno
    apply hC
    apply top_unique
    intro x _
    exact not_not.mp (fun hx => hno ⟨x, hx⟩)
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ C
  · have hyx : y + x ∉ C := by
      intro h
      apply hy
      exact (add_sub_cancel_right y x) ▸ C.sub_mem h hx
    have h := hfix (y + x) hyx
    rw [map_add, hfix y hy] at h
    exact add_left_cancel h
  · exact hfix x hx

name: FieldTheory.fg_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem fg_of_finiteDimensional
    (K : Type u) (L : Type v) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] (hfg : Field.FG K) : Field.FG L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hfg.finitely_generated
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType K L := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_finiteType K L
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IntermediateField.fg_top K L
  let w : Finset L := s.image (algebraMap K L) ∪ t
  let S : Subfield L := Subfield.closure (w : Set L)
  have hbase : Set.range (algebraMap K L) ⊆ S := by
    have hle : (Subfield.closure (s : Set K)).map (algebraMap K L) ≤ S := by
      rw [RingHom.map_field_closure]
      apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
      rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      apply Subfield.subset_closure
      exact Finset.mem_union_left t (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
    rw [hs] at hle
    rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact hle (Subfield.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, Subfield.mem_top y, rfl⟩)
  have htop : (IntermediateField.adjoin K (t : Set L)).toSubfield ≤ S := by
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubfield]
    apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
    apply Set.union_subset hbase
    intro x hx
    exact Subfield.subset_closure (Finset.mem_union_right _ hx)
  have hS : S = ⊤ := by
    rw [ht] at htop
    exact top_unique htop
  exact ⟨⟨w, hS⟩⟩

name: GroupTheory.finiteOrbitProduct_invariant
statement:
theorem finiteOrbitProduct_invariant
    {G A : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G] [CommMonoid A]
    (ρ : G →* MulAut A) (C : A) (g : G) :
    ρ g (finiteOrbitProduct ρ C) = finiteOrbitProduct ρ C
proof:
:= by
  change ρ g (∏ h : G, ρ h C) = ∏ h : G, ρ h C
  rw [map_prod]
  calc
    (∏ h : G, ρ g (ρ h C)) = ∏ h : G, ρ (g * h) C := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro h _hh
      rw [map_mul, MulAut.mul_apply]
    _ = ∏ h : G, ρ h C := Equiv.prod_comp (Equiv.mulLeft g) (fun h : G => ρ h C)

name: GroupTheory.finiteOrbitProduct_map_div
statement:
theorem finiteOrbitProduct_map_div
    {G A : Type*} [Monoid G] [Fintype G] [CommGroup A]
    (ρ : G →* MulAut A) (α : MulAut A) (C D : A)
    (hcomm : ∀ g : G, Commute α (ρ g))
    (hdiff : α C / C = D) (hD : ∀ g : G, ρ g D = D) :
    α (finiteOrbitProduct ρ C) / finiteOrbitProduct ρ C = D ^ Fintype.card G
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor (g : G) : α (ρ g C) / ρ g C = D := by
    have hcomm_apply : α (ρ g C) = ρ g (α C) :=
      DFunLike.congr_fun (hcomm g).eq C
    rw [hcomm_apply, ← map_div, hdiff, hD g]
  change α (∏ g : G, ρ g C) / (∏ g : G, ρ g C) = D ^ Fintype.card G
  rw [map_prod, ← Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_pow_card (fun g _hg => hfactor g)

name: ZMod.mulPow_intCast
statement:
theorem mulPow_intCast (p n : ℕ) (a : ℤ) :
    mulPow p n (a : ZMod (p ^ n)) = (p : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * a
proof:
:=
  ZMod.lift_coe _ _ _

name: ZMod.mulPow_injective
statement:
theorem mulPow_injective {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (mulPow p n)
proof:
:= by
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero (mulPow p n)).2
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective z
  rw [mulPow_intCast] at hz
  have hd : (p : ℤ) * (p : ℤ) ^ n ∣ (p : ℤ) * a := by
    have hz' : (((p : ℤ) * a : ℤ) : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) = 0 := by
      rw [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
      exact hz
    rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hz'
    simpa only [pow_succ', Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow] using hz'
  have hpa : (p : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr hp
  have hdiv : (p : ℤ) ^ n ∣ a := (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hpa).mp hd
  rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hdiv

name: ZMod.exists_mulPow_eq_of_castHom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_mulPow_eq_of_castHom_eq_zero (p n : ℕ)
    (z : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hz : ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)))
      (ZMod (p ^ 1)) z = 0) :
    ∃ a : ZMod (p ^ n), mulPow p n a = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective z
  rw [map_intCast, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd, pow_one] at hz
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨(a : ZMod (p ^ n)), ?_⟩
  rw [mulPow_intCast, ha, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]

name: ZMod.mulPow_mul_castHom
statement:
theorem mulPow_mul_castHom (p n : ℕ) (a : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) (b : ZMod (p ^ n)) :
    mulPow p n (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n)) a * b) =
      a * mulPow p n b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective a
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective b
  rw [map_intCast, ← Int.cast_mul, mulPow_intCast, mulPow_intCast, Int.cast_mul]
  exact mul_left_comm _ _ _

name: ZMod.castHom_mulPow
statement:
theorem castHom_mulPow (p n : ℕ) (a : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))) (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
      (mulPow p (n + 1) a) =
    mulPow p n (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n)) a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective a
  rw [mulPow_intCast, map_mul, map_natCast, map_intCast, map_intCast, mulPow_intCast]

name: ProCGroups.ProC.finite_pGroup_basis
statement:
private theorem finite_pGroup_basis
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {B : Type u} [Group B] [TopologicalSpace B] [IsTopologicalGroup B]
    [Finite B] [DiscreteTopology B] (hB : IsPGroup p B) :
    HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) B
proof:
:= by
  apply HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.of_allOpenNormalQuotients
  intro U
  exact ⟨inferInstance, hB.of_surjective (QuotientGroup.mk' (U : Subgroup B))
    (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _)⟩

name: ProCGroups.ProC.proPResidualCore_le_ker_padicCharacter
statement:
theorem proPResidualCore_le_ker_padicCharacter
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {A : Type u} [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    [CompactSpace A] (f : A →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt p)) :
    proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A ≤ f.toMonoidHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  change (f a).toAdd = 0
  apply PadicInt.ext_of_toZModPow.mp
  intro n
  have : NeZero (p ^ n) := ⟨pow_ne_zero n (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  let ψ : A →ₜ* ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ n))) :=
    { toFun := fun a => ULift.up (Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (PadicInt.toZModPow n (f a).toAdd))
      map_one' := by
        change ULift.up (Multiplicative.ofAdd (PadicInt.toZModPow n (f 1).toAdd)) = 1
        rw [map_one]
        apply ULift.ext
        change PadicInt.toZModPow n 0 = 0
        exact map_zero _
      map_mul' := by
        intro a b
        apply ULift.ext
        change PadicInt.toZModPow n (f (a * b)).toAdd =
          PadicInt.toZModPow n (f a).toAdd + PadicInt.toZModPow n (f b).toAdd
        rw [map_mul]; exact map_add _ _ _
      continuous_toFun := continuous_uliftUp.comp
        ((PadicInt.continuous_toZModPow n).comp f.continuous) }
  have hP : IsPGroup p (ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ n)))) := by
    apply IsPGroup.of_card (n := n)
    simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_ulift,
      Fintype.card_multiplicative, ZMod.card]
  have hB : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p)
      (ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ n)))) := finite_pGroup_basis hP
  have hzero := proCResidualCore_le_ker_of_continuousMonoidHom_to_proC
    (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_hereditary p) ψ hB ha
  have hz := congrArg (fun x : ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ n))) =>
    x.down.toAdd) hzero
  exact hz.trans (map_zero _).symm

name: ProCGroups.ProC.liftPadicCharacter_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftPadicCharacter_mk
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {A : Type u} [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    [CompactSpace A] (f : A →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt p)) (a : A) :
    liftPadicCharacter f (QuotientGroup.mk' _ a) = f a
proof: := rfl

name: PadicInt.surjective_character_of_nonzero_reduction
statement:
theorem surjective_character_of_nonzero_reduction
    (χ : G →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt p))
    (hχ : ∃ g : G, toZModPow 1 (χ g).toAdd ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective χ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hχ
  let f : G → PadicInt p := fun x => (χ x).toAdd
  have hf : Continuous f := χ.continuous
  have hunit : IsUnit (f g) := by
    by_contra h
    have hd : (p : PadicInt p) ∣ f g :=
      (norm_lt_one_iff_dvd (f g)).mp (not_isUnit_iff.mp h)
    apply hg
    change f g ∈ RingHom.ker (toZModPow 1)
    rw [ker_toZModPow, pow_one, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact hd
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hunit
  have hclosed : IsClosed (Set.range f) := (isCompact_range hf).isClosed
  have hmul (z : PadicInt p) : z * (u : PadicInt p) ∈ Set.range f := by
    refine DenseRange.induction_on denseRange_natCast z
      (hclosed.preimage (continuous_id.mul continuous_const)) ?_
    intro n
    rw [hu]
    refine ⟨g ^ n, ?_⟩
    change (χ (g ^ n)).toAdd = (n : PadicInt p) * f g
    rw [map_pow]
    change n • f g = (n : PadicInt p) * f g
    exact nsmul_eq_mul n (f g)
  intro y
  have hy := hmul (y.toAdd * (↑u⁻¹ : PadicInt p))
  rw [mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, mul_one] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨x, congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd hx⟩

name: PadicInt.exists_prime_dvd_card_reduction_range
statement:
theorem exists_prime_dvd_card_reduction_range
    (χ : G →ₜ* (PadicInt p)ˣ) (hinf : Set.Infinite (Set.range χ)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, p ∣ Nat.card ((unitsReduction n).comp χ).toMonoidHom.range
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! h
  have (n : ℕ) : NeZero (p ^ (n + 1)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  let ρ (n : ℕ) := (unitsReduction n).comp χ
  have hcard (n : ℕ) : Nat.card (ρ n).toMonoidHom.range ∣ p - 1 := by
    have hd : Nat.card (ρ n).toMonoidHom.range ∣ p ^ n * (p - 1) := by
      have hsub := Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card (ρ n).toMonoidHom.range
      simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient,
        Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ (Fact.out : p.Prime)] using hsub
    exact ((Fact.out : p.Prime).coprime_pow_of_not_dvd (h n)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hd
  have hpow (n : ℕ) (g : G) : ρ n g ^ (p - 1) = 1 := by
    let x : (ρ n).toMonoidHom.range := ⟨ρ n g, ⟨g, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hcard n
    have hx : x ^ (p - 1) = 1 := by
      rw [hk, pow_mul, pow_card_eq_one', one_pow]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hx
  have hχpow (g : G) : χ g ^ (p - 1) = 1 := by
    apply Units.ext
    apply ext_of_toZModPow.mp
    intro n
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      have : Subsingleton (ZMod (p ^ 0)) := by rw [pow_zero]; infer_instance
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    | succ n =>
      have heq := congrArg Units.val (hpow n g)
      change (toZModPow (n + 1) (χ g : PadicInt p)) ^ (p - 1) = 1 at heq
      simpa only [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_one, map_pow, map_one] using heq
  have : NeZero (p - 1) := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt)⟩
