  have hfinite : Set.Finite (rootsOfUnity (p - 1) (PadicInt p) : Set (PadicInt p)ˣ) :=
    Set.finite_coe_iff.mp (inferInstanceAs (Finite (rootsOfUnity (p - 1) (PadicInt p))))
  apply hinf
  apply hfinite.subset
  rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
  exact hχpow g

name: PadicInt.exists_surjective_prime_character_of_infinite_unit_image
statement:
theorem exists_surjective_prime_character_of_infinite_unit_image
    (χ : G →ₜ* (PadicInt p)ˣ) (hinf : Set.Infinite (Set.range χ)) :
    ∃ ψ : G →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p), Function.Surjective ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_prime_dvd_card_reduction_range χ hinf
  have : NeZero (p ^ (n + 1)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero⟩
  let ρ : G →ₜ* (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))ˣ := (unitsReduction n).comp χ
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_surjective_prime_character_finite hn
  let ρrange : G →ₜ* ρ.toMonoidHom.range :=
    { toMonoidHom := ρ.toMonoidHom.rangeRestrict
      continuous_toFun := ρ.continuous.subtype_mk (fun g => ⟨g, rfl⟩) }
  let φcont : ρ.toMonoidHom.range →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    ⟨φ, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩
  exact ⟨φcont.comp ρrange, hφ.comp ρ.toMonoidHom.rangeRestrict_surjective⟩

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_cyclic_character_lift_of_power_injective
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_character_lift_of_power_injective
    {A : Type u} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    [CompactSpace A] [T2Space A] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace A]
    (N m : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero m]
    (hm : Function.Injective (fun a : A => a ^ m))
    (χ : A →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod N)) :
    ∃ ψ : A →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (N * m)), ∀ a : A,
      ZMod.castHom (dvd_mul_right N m) (ZMod N) (ψ a).toAdd = (χ a).toAdd
proof:
:= by
  let pow : A →ₜ* A := ⟨powMonoidHom m, continuous_id.pow m⟩
  let P : Subgroup A := pow.toMonoidHom.range
  have hP : IsClosed (P : Set A) := ContinuousMonoidHom.isClosed_range pow
  let powRange : A →* P := pow.toMonoidHom.rangeRestrict
  have hbij : Function.Bijective powRange :=
    ⟨fun x y h => hm (congrArg Subtype.val h), by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := x.2
      exact ⟨a, Subtype.ext ha⟩⟩
  let e : A ≃ₜ* P := ContinuousMulEquiv.ofBijectiveCompactToT2 powRange
    (pow.continuous.subtype_mk _) hbij
  let χP : P →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod N) :=
    { toMonoidHom := χ.toMonoidHom.comp e.symm.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
      continuous_toFun := χ.continuous.comp e.symm.continuous_toFun }
  let : DivisibleBy (Additive (Multiplicative UnitAddCircle)) ℤ := by
    change DivisibleBy UnitAddCircle ℤ
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ := ProCGroups.exists_continuous_character_extension_divisible
    P hP χP (ZMod.toAddCircle (N := N)).toMultiplicative
  have hpow (a : A) : m • (η a).toAdd = ZMod.toAddCircle (χ a).toAdd := by
    have hh := hη (e a)
    change η (a ^ m) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (ZMod.toAddCircle (χ (e.symm (e a))).toAdd) at hh
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply, map_pow] at hh
    exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hh
  have hexp (a : A) : (N * m) • (η a).toAdd = 0 := by
    rw [mul_smul, hpow, ← map_nsmul]
    have hz : N • (χ a).toAdd = 0 := by
      rw [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]
    rw [hz, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := ZMod.exists_continuous_zmod_character (N * m) η hexp
  refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
  intro a
  apply ZMod.toAddCircle_injective N
  rw [ZMod.toAddCircle_castHom_mul, hψ, hpow]

name: PadicInt.principalUnitResidue_pow
statement:
private theorem principalUnitResidue_pow (n : ℕ) :
    principalUnitResidue p n ^ (p ^ n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    have : Subsingleton (ZMod (p ^ 0)) := by rw [pow_zero]; infer_instance
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | succ n =>
    have : NeZero (p ^ (n + 1)) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero⟩
    let u : (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))ˣ := ZMod.unitOfCoprime (p + 1)
      ((Nat.coprime_self_add_left.mpr (Nat.coprime_one_left p)).pow_right (n + 1))
    have hu : u ^ (p ^ n * (p - 1)) = 1 := by
      simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient,
        Nat.totient_prime_pow_succ (Fact.out : p.Prime)] using (pow_card_eq_one' (x := u))
    change (u ^ (p - 1)) ^ (p ^ (n + 1)) = 1
    calc
      (u ^ (p - 1)) ^ (p ^ (n + 1)) = u ^ ((p ^ n * (p - 1)) * p) := by
        rw [← pow_mul]
        apply congrArg (fun m : ℕ => u ^ m)
        rw [pow_succ]
        ac_rfl
      _ = 1 := by rw [pow_mul, hu, one_pow]

name: PadicInt.principalUnitPowerResidue_intCast
proof:
:=
  congrArg Additive.toMul (ZMod.lift_coe (p ^ n) _ a)

name: PadicInt.principalUnitPowerResidue_compatible
statement:
private theorem principalUnitPowerResidue_compatible (n : ℕ)
    (a : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) :
    Units.map (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n))).toMonoidHom
      (principalUnitPowerResidue p (n + 1) a).toMul =
    (principalUnitPowerResidue p n
      (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n)) a)).toMul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective a
  rw [principalUnitPowerResidue_intCast, map_intCast,
    principalUnitPowerResidue_intCast, map_zpow]
  congr 1
  apply Units.ext
  change (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n)))
      (((p + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) ^ (p - 1)) =
    ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) ^ (p - 1)
  rw [map_pow, map_natCast]

name: PadicInt.exists_continuous_principal_unit_powers
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_principal_unit_powers :
    ∃ φ : Multiplicative (PadicInt p) →ₜ* (PadicInt p)ˣ,
      ((φ (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) : (PadicInt p)ˣ) : PadicInt p) =
        ((p + 1 : ℕ) : PadicInt p) ^ (p - 1) ∧
      ∀ x, toZModPow 1 (φ x : PadicInt p) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f (n : ℕ) (x : PadicInt p) : ZMod (p ^ n) :=
    (principalUnitPowerResidue p n (toZModPow n x)).toMul
  have hf (n : ℕ) : Continuous (f n) :=
    (continuous_of_discreteTopology (f := fun a : ZMod (p ^ n) =>
      ((principalUnitPowerResidue p n a).toMul : ZMod (p ^ n)))).comp
        (continuous_toZModPow n)
  have hc (n : ℕ) (x : PadicInt p) :
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n)) (f (n + 1) x) =
        f n x := by
    have h := congrArg Units.val
      (principalUnitPowerResidue_compatible p n (toZModPow (n + 1) x))
    change ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n))
      (f (n + 1) x) =
      ((principalUnitPowerResidue p n
        (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n))
          (toZModPow (n + 1) x))).toMul : ZMod (p ^ n)) at h
    rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, zmod_cast_comp_toZModPow n (n + 1) (Nat.le_succ n)] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨d, hdcont, hd⟩ := exists_continuous_of_compatible_residues f hf hc
  have hd0 : d 0 = 1 := by
    apply ext_of_toZModPow.mp
    intro n
    rw [hd, map_one]
    change ((principalUnitPowerResidue p n (toZModPow n 0)).toMul :
      ZMod (p ^ n)) = 1
    rw [map_zero, map_zero]
    rfl
  have hadd (x y : PadicInt p) : d (x + y) = d x * d y := by
    apply ext_of_toZModPow.mp
    intro n
    rw [map_mul, hd, hd, hd]
    change ((principalUnitPowerResidue p n (toZModPow n (x + y))).toMul :
        ZMod (p ^ n)) =
      ((principalUnitPowerResidue p n (toZModPow n x)).toMul : ZMod (p ^ n)) *
        ((principalUnitPowerResidue p n (toZModPow n y)).toMul : ZMod (p ^ n))
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    rfl
  let dHom : Multiplicative (PadicInt p) →* PadicInt p :=
    { toFun := fun x => d x.toAdd
      map_one' := hd0
      map_mul' := fun x y => hadd x.toAdd y.toAdd }
  let φ : Multiplicative (PadicInt p) →ₜ* (PadicInt p)ˣ :=
    ⟨dHom.toHomUnits,
      Units.continuous_iff.mpr ⟨hdcont, hdcont.comp continuous_inv⟩⟩
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change d 1 = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : PadicInt p) ^ (p - 1)
    apply ext_of_toZModPow.mp
    intro n
    rw [hd, map_pow, map_natCast]
    change ((principalUnitPowerResidue p n (toZModPow n 1)).toMul :
      ZMod (p ^ n)) = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) ^ (p - 1)
    rw [map_one]
    have h := principalUnitPowerResidue_intCast p n 1
    simp only [Int.cast_one, zpow_one] at h
    rw [h]
    rfl
  · intro x
    change toZModPow 1 (d x.toAdd) = 1
    rw [hd]
    change ((principalUnitPowerResidue p 1 (toZModPow 1 x.toAdd)).toMul :
      ZMod (p ^ 1)) = 1
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective (toZModPow 1 x.toAdd)
    rw [← ha, principalUnitPowerResidue_intCast]
    have hu : principalUnitResidue p 1 = 1 := by
      apply Units.ext
      change ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ 1)) ^ (p - 1) = 1
      have hp : ((p : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ 1)) = 0 := by
        rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff, pow_one]
      rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hp, zero_add, one_pow]
    rw [hu, one_zpow]
    rfl

name: PadicInt.exists_infinite_principal_unit_character
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_principal_unit_character :
    ∃ φ : Multiplicative (PadicInt p) →ₜ* (PadicInt p)ˣ,
      Set.Infinite (Set.range φ) ∧ ∀ x, toZModPow 1 (φ x : PadicInt p) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hmod⟩ := exists_continuous_principal_unit_powers p
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, hmod⟩
  let B : ℕ := (p + 1) ^ (p - 1)
  have hB : 1 < B := one_lt_pow₀ (by have := (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos; omega)
    (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt))
  let g : Multiplicative (PadicInt p) := Multiplicative.ofAdd 1
  have hg : (φ g : PadicInt p) = (B : PadicInt p) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_pow]
    exact hφ
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => φ g ^ n) := by
    intro a b h
    have hval := congrArg (fun u : (PadicInt p)ˣ => (u : PadicInt p)) h
    simp only [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, hg, ← Nat.cast_pow] at hval
    exact pow_right_injective₀ (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hB) (ne_of_gt hB)
      (Nat.cast_injective hval)
  apply (Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinj).mono
  rintro y ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨g ^ n, map_pow φ g n⟩

name: ZMod.exists_toAddCircle_eq_of_nsmul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_toAddCircle_eq_of_nsmul_eq_zero
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (z : UnitAddCircle) (hz : N • z = 0) :
    ∃ a : ZMod N, toAddCircle a = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := (AddCircle.nsmul_eq_zero_iff (NeZero.pos N)).mp hz
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  rw [toAddCircle_natCast]
  simpa only [mul_one] using hk

name: ZMod.toAddCircle_castHom_mul
statement:
theorem toAddCircle_castHom_mul
    (N m : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero m] (a : ZMod (N * m)) :
    toAddCircle (castHom (dvd_mul_right N m) (ZMod N) a) =
      m • toAddCircle a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective a
  rw [map_intCast, toAddCircle_intCast, toAddCircle_intCast, ← AddCircle.coe_nsmul]
  congr 1
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
  field_simp [show (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 from Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne N),
    show (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 from Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (NeZero.ne m)]

name: ZMod.exists_continuous_zmod_character
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_zmod_character
    {A : Type*} [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : A →ₜ* Multiplicative UnitAddCircle)
    (hf : ∀ a : A, N • (f a).toAdd = 0) :
    ∃ g : A →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod N), ∀ a : A,
      toAddCircle (g a).toAdd = (f a).toAdd
proof:
:= by
  choose g hg using fun a => exists_toAddCircle_eq_of_nsmul_eq_zero N (f a).toAdd (hf a)
  have hinj := toAddCircle_injective N
  let ghom : A →* Multiplicative (ZMod N) :=
    { toFun := fun a => Multiplicative.ofAdd (g a)
      map_one' := by
        change g 1 = 0
        apply hinj
        rw [hg, map_zero]
        exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (map_one f)
      map_mul' := by
        intro a b
        change g (a * b) = g a + g b
        apply hinj
        rw [map_add, hg, hg, hg]
        exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (map_mul f a b) }
  have hemb : Topology.IsEmbedding (toAddCircle : ZMod N → UnitAddCircle) :=
    (show Continuous (toAddCircle : ZMod N → UnitAddCircle) from
      continuous_of_discreteTopology).isClosedEmbedding hinj |>.isEmbedding
  have hcont : Continuous g := hemb.continuous_iff.mpr (by
    change Continuous (fun a => toAddCircle (g a))
    simpa only [hg] using (show Continuous (fun a : A => (f a).toAdd) from f.continuous))
  exact ⟨⟨ghom, hcont⟩, hg⟩

name: ZMod.mulPowPrime_intCast
statement:
theorem mulPowPrime_intCast (p n : ℕ) (a : ℤ) :
    mulPowPrime p n (a : ZMod p) = (p ^ n : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * a
proof:
:=
  ZMod.lift_coe _ _ _

name: ZMod.mulPowPrime_injective
statement:
theorem mulPowPrime_injective {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (mulPowPrime p n)
proof:
:= by
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero (mulPowPrime p n)).2
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective z
  rw [mulPowPrime_intCast] at hz
  have hd : (p : ℤ) ^ n * (p : ℤ) ∣ (p : ℤ) ^ n * a := by
    have hz' : (((p : ℤ) ^ n * a : ℤ) : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) = 0 := by
      rw [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_natCast]
      exact hz
    rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hz'
    simpa only [pow_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow] using hz'
  have hpn : (p : ℤ) ^ n ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero n (Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr hp)
  have hdiv : (p : ℤ) ∣ a := (mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hpn).mp hd
  rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  exact hdiv

name: ZMod.exists_mulPowPrime_eq_of_castHom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_mulPowPrime_eq_of_castHom_eq_zero (p n : ℕ)
    (z : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))
    (hz : ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n)) z = 0) :
    ∃ a : ZMod p, mulPowPrime p n a = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective z
  rw [map_intCast, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hz
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨(a : ZMod p), ?_⟩
  rw [mulPowPrime_intCast, ha, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_pow]

name: ZMod.castHom_mulPowPrime
statement:
theorem castHom_mulPowPrime (p n : ℕ) (a : ZMod p) :
    ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n))
      (mulPowPrime p n a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective a
  rw [mulPowPrime_intCast, map_mul, map_pow, map_natCast, ← Nat.cast_pow,
    ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]

name: ZMod.mulPowPrime_mul_castHom
statement:
theorem mulPowPrime_mul_castHom (p n : ℕ) (a : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) (b : ZMod p) :
    mulPowPrime p n (ZMod.castHom (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)) (ZMod p) a * b) =
      a * mulPowPrime p n b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective a
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective b
  rw [map_intCast, ← Int.cast_mul, mulPowPrime_intCast, mulPowPrime_intCast, Int.cast_mul]
  exact mul_left_comm _ _ _

name: PadicInt.exists_of_compatible_residues
statement:
theorem exists_of_compatible_residues
    (a : ∀ n : ℕ, ZMod (p ^ n))
    (ha : ∀ n, ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n))
      (ZMod (p ^ n)) (a (n + 1)) = a n) :
    ∃ z : PadicInt p, ∀ n, toZModPow n z = a n
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℤ := fun n => (a n).val
  have hf (n : ℕ) : (p : ℤ) ^ n ∣ f (n + 1) - f n := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub]
    symm
    change (((a (n + 1)).val : ℤ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) = (((a n).val : ℤ) : ZMod (p ^ n))
    simp only [Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    calc
      ((a (n + 1)).val : ZMod (p ^ n)) =
          ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n))
            ((a (n + 1)).val : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) := (map_natCast _ _).symm
      _ = a n := by rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, ha]
  refine ⟨PadicInt.ofIntSeq f (isCauSeq_padicNorm_of_pow_dvd_sub f p hf), ?_⟩
  intro n
  rw [toZModPow_ofIntSeq_of_pow_dvd_sub f p hf n]
  change (((a n).val : ℤ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) = a n
  rw [Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: PadicInt.continuous_toZModPow
statement: theorem continuous_toZModPow (n : ℕ) : Continuous (toZModPow n : PadicInt p → ZMod (p ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_continuousAt_zero (toZModPow n).toAddMonoidHom
  rw [ContinuousAt, nhds_discrete (ZMod (p ^ n)), Filter.tendsto_pure, map_zero]
  change ∀ᶠ z in nhds (0 : PadicInt p), toZModPow n z = 0
  have hrad : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) :=
    zpow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos) _
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : PadicInt p) hrad] with z hz
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hz
  rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, ker_toZModPow]
  exact (norm_le_pow_iff_mem_span_pow z n).mp hz.le

name: PadicInt.continuous_of_continuous_toZModPow
statement:
theorem continuous_of_continuous_toZModPow
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : X → PadicInt p)
    (hf : ∀ n, Continuous (fun x => toZModPow n (f x))) : Continuous f
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro x
  rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.nhds_basis_closedBall.tendsto_right_iff]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := PadicInt.exists_pow_neg_lt p hε
  have hnb : {y | toZModPow n (f y) = toZModPow n (f x)} ∈ nhds x :=
    (isOpen_discrete ({toZModPow n (f x)} : Set (ZMod (p ^ n)))).preimage
      (hf n) |>.mem_nhds rfl
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset hnb
  intro y hy
  change f y ∈ Metric.closedBall (f x) ε
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
  apply le_trans _ hn.le
  rw [norm_le_pow_iff_mem_span_pow, ← ker_toZModPow n, RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub,
    sub_eq_zero]
  exact hy

name: PadicInt.exists_continuous_of_compatible_residues
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_of_compatible_residues
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : ∀ n : ℕ, X → ZMod (p ^ n))
    (hf : ∀ n, Continuous (f n))
    (hcompat : ∀ n x, ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n))
      (ZMod (p ^ n)) (f (n + 1) x) = f n x) :
    ∃ d : X → PadicInt p, Continuous d ∧ ∀ n x, toZModPow n (d x) = f n x
proof:
:= by
  choose d hd using fun x => exists_of_compatible_residues
    (fun n => f n x) (fun n => hcompat n x)
  refine ⟨d, continuous_of_continuous_toZModPow d ?_, fun n x => hd x n⟩
  intro n
  convert hf n using 1
  funext x
  exact hd x n

name: KummerTheory.finite_primaryComponent_of_fieldEmbedding
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_of_fieldEmbedding
    {E : Type u} {F : Type v} [Field E] [Field F] (f : E →+* F)
    (p : ℕ) [Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Fˣ p)] :
    Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  let i : CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p → CommGroup.primaryComponent Fˣ p :=
    fun z => ⟨Units.map f.toMonoidHom z, by
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent.mp z.property
      apply CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent.mpr
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      simpa only [map_pow, map_one] using congrArg (Units.map f.toMonoidHom) hn⟩
  apply Finite.of_injective i
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Units.ext
  apply f.injective
  exact congrArg (fun z : CommGroup.primaryComponent Fˣ p => ((z : Fˣ) : F)) hab

name: KummerTheory.finite_primaryComponent_of_finiteExtension_embedding
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_of_finiteExtension_embedding
    {K : Type u} {E : Type v} {Ω : Type w}
    [Field K] [Field E] [Field Ω] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K Ω]
    [FiniteDimensional K E] (f : E →ₐ[K] Ω) (p : ℕ)
    (hRoots : ∀ L : IntermediateField K Ω, FiniteDimensional K L →
      Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Lˣ p)) :
    Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : FiniteDimensional K f.fieldRange :=
    Module.Finite.equiv f.equivFieldRange.toLinearEquiv
  have : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent f.fieldRangeˣ p) := hRoots f.fieldRange hF
  exact finite_primaryComponent_of_fieldEmbedding f.equivFieldRange.toRingHom p

name: KummerTheory.exists_invariant_completion_character
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_completion_character
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {K : Type u} {E : Type w}
    [Field K] [Field E] [Algebra K E] [FiniteDimensional K E] [IsGalois K E]
    (D : ι → DVF.{u, v} K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (V : ι → DVF.{w, z} E)
    [hV : ∀ i, (D i).valuation.HasExtension (V i).valuation]
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : E)]
    (hn : (Nat.card Gal(E/K)).Coprime (n : ℕ))
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) E).Nonempty)
    (χ : ∀ i, Gal(AlgebraicClosure (D i).valuation.Completion/(D i).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
      Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) :
    ∃ ψ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)),
      (∀ (δ : Gal(E/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)),
        ψ (absoluteGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv σ) = ψ σ) ∧
      ∀ i, (ψ.comp (map (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion)) :
        Gal(AlgebraicClosure (V i).valuation.Completion/(V i).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
          Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) =
        (χ i).comp (map (DVF.completionMap (D i) (V i)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype Gal(E/K) := Fintype.ofFinite Gal(E/K)
  let W (j : ι × Gal(E/K)) : DVF.{w,z} E :=
    { ValueGroup := (V j.1).ValueGroup
      valuation := (V j.1).valuation.comap j.2.toRingHom
      instRankOneDiscrete := Valuation.isRankOneDiscrete_comap_ringEquiv
        (V j.1).valuation j.2.toRingEquiv }
  have hWext : ∀ j : ι × Gal(E/K), (D j.1).valuation.HasExtension (W j).valuation := by
    intro j
    constructor
    intro x y
    change (D j.1).valuation x ≤ (D j.1).valuation y ↔
      (V j.1).valuation (j.2 (algebraMap K E x)) ≤
        (V j.1).valuation (j.2 (algebraMap K E y))
    rw [j.2.commutes, j.2.commutes]
    exact _root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_isEquiv_comap
      (vR := (D j.1).valuation) (vA := (V j.1).valuation) x y
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_completion_character_on_prolongations D hD W Prod.fst n hmu χ
  let ψ := absoluteCharacterAverage (K := K) (n : ℕ) φ
  refine ⟨ψ, fun δ σ => absoluteCharacterAverage_conjugate (n : ℕ) φ δ σ, ?_⟩
  intro i
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  apply absoluteCharacterAverage_eq_of_forall (n : ℕ)
    (by simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hn) φ
  intro δ
  let j : ι × Gal(E/K) := (i, δ)
  have : (D i).valuation.HasExtension (W j).valuation := hWext j
  have hequiv : (W j).valuation.IsEquiv ((V i).valuation.comap δ.toRingHom) :=
    _root_.Valuation.IsEquiv.refl
  let g := DVF.completionRingEquiv (W j) (V i) δ.toRingEquiv hequiv
  have hg : (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion).comp δ.toRingHom =
      g.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E (W j).valuation.Completion) := by
    ext x
    exact (DVF.completionRingEquiv_algebraMap (W j) (V i) δ.toRingEquiv hequiv x).symm
  have hgbase : g.toRingHom.comp (DVF.completionMap (D i) (W j)) =
      DVF.completionMap (D i) (V i) :=
    DVF.completionRingEquiv_comp_completionMap (D i) (W j) (V i) δ hequiv
  have heq : (φ.comp (map δ.toRingHom)).comp
      (map (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion)) =
      (φ.comp (map (algebraMap E (W j).valuation.Completion))).comp (map g.toRingHom) :=
    (character_map_comp δ.toRingHom (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion) φ).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun f => φ.comp (map f)) hg).trans
        (character_map_comp (algebraMap E (W j).valuation.Completion) g.toRingHom φ))
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun heq σ).trans
    ((DFunLike.congr_fun (hφ j) (map g.toRingHom σ)).trans
      (DFunLike.congr_fun
        ((character_map_comp (DVF.completionMap (D i) (W j)) g.toRingHom (χ i)).symm.trans
          (congrArg (fun f => (χ i).comp (map f)) hgbase)) σ))

name: KummerTheory.absoluteH1Transform_apply
statement:
theorem absoluteH1Transform_apply (τ : RingAut K)
    (c : ContinuousH1ZMod (p := n) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K))
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    absoluteH1Transform n τ c (Additive.ofMul (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K)) =
      c (Additive.ofMul
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.absoluteH1Transform_one
statement:
theorem absoluteH1Transform_one
    (c : ContinuousH1ZMod (p := n) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K)) :
    absoluteH1Transform n 1 c = c
proof:
:= by
  unfold absoluteH1Transform
  rw [absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform_one]
  exact (h1CharacterEquiv (p := n) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K)).left_inv c

name: KummerTheory.absoluteH1Transform_mul
statement:
theorem absoluteH1Transform_mul (τ υ : RingAut K)
    (c : ContinuousH1ZMod (p := n) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K)) :
    absoluteH1Transform n (τ * υ) c =
      absoluteH1Transform n τ (absoluteH1Transform n υ c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold absoluteH1Transform
  change h1OfCharacter (absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform (τ * υ) (characterOfH1 c)) =
    h1OfCharacter (absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform τ
      (absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform υ (characterOfH1 c)))
  rw [absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform_mul]

name: KummerTheory.relativeGaloisH1Action_apply
statement:
theorem relativeGaloisH1Action_apply (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (c : ContinuousH1ZMod (p := n) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) :
    (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := n) K L τ).toAdd c
        (Additive.ofMul (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L)) =
      c (Additive.ofMul
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv.symm σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.primeTo_cyclotomic_tower_data
statement:
theorem primeTo_cyclotomic_tower_data
    [IsGalois F M] (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} M E]
    (hrp : r ≠ p) (hdegree : Module.finrank F M = r) :
    FiniteDimensional F E ∧ IsGalois F E ∧
      p.Coprime (Nat.card Gal(E/F)) ∧
        Function.Surjective (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(M/F))
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional F M :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
  have : FiniteDimensional M E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} M E
  have : FiniteDimensional F E := FiniteDimensional.trans F M E
  have : IsGalois M E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {p} M E
  have : IsGalois F E :=
    { to_isSeparable := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans (F := F) (E := M) (K := E)
      to_normal := normal_cyclotomic_tower F M E p }
  have hFM : p.Coprime (Module.finrank F M) := by
    rw [hdegree]
    exact (Nat.coprime_primes (Fact.out : p.Prime) (Fact.out : r.Prime)).mpr hrp.symm
  have hME : p.Coprime (Module.finrank M E) := by
    rw [← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank M E]
    exact prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard M E p
  have hcard : p.Coprime (Nat.card Gal(E/F)) := by
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank F E, ← Module.finrank_mul_finrank F M E]
    exact hFM.mul_right hME
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, hcard,
    AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective (F := F) (K₁ := M) (E := E)⟩

name: KummerTheory.restrictScalarsHom_range_eq_normalRestrictionKer
statement:
theorem restrictScalarsHom_range_eq_normalRestrictionKer [Normal F M] :
    (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom F : Gal(E/M) →* Gal(E/F)).range =
      (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(M/F)).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro σ ⟨δ, rfl⟩
    change (δ.restrictScalars F).restrictNormal M = 1
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro m
    apply (algebraMap M E).injective
    change algebraMap M E ((δ.restrictScalars F).restrictNormal M m) =
      algebraMap M E m
    rw [AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes]
    exact δ.commutes m
  · intro σ hσ
    have hσ' : σ.restrictNormal M = 1 := hσ
    let δ : Gal(E/M) :=
      { σ.toRingEquiv with
        commutes' := fun m => by
          change σ (algebraMap M E m) = algebraMap M E m
          rw [← σ.restrictNormal_commutes M m, hσ']
          rfl }
    refine ⟨δ, ?_⟩
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    rfl

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_apply
    (σ : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K)).ker) (x : Ω) :
    normalRestrictionKernelEquiv M Ω σ x = (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) x
proof: := rfl

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_symm_apply (σ : Gal(Ω/M)) :
    ((normalRestrictionKernelEquiv (K := K) M Ω).symm σ : Gal(Ω/K)) =
      σ.restrictScalars K
proof: := rfl

name: KummerTheory.normalRestriction_algebraMap
statement:
theorem normalRestriction_algebraMap (g : Gal(Ω/K)) (m : M) :
    g.toRingEquiv (algebraMap M Ω m) =
      algebraMap M Ω ((g.restrictNormal M).toRingEquiv m)
proof:
:=
  (g.restrictNormal_commutes M m).symm

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_conjNormal
statement:
theorem normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_conjNormal (g : Gal(Ω/K))
    (σ : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K)).ker) :
    normalRestrictionKernelEquiv M Ω (MulAut.conjNormal g σ) =
      semilinearGaloisConjugate (g.restrictNormal M).toRingEquiv g.toRingEquiv
        (normalRestriction_algebraMap M Ω g) (normalRestrictionKernelEquiv M Ω σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  rw [normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_apply, semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply,
    normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_apply]
  change (g * (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) * g⁻¹) x = g ((σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (g.symm x))
  rw [AlgEquiv.mul_apply, AlgEquiv.mul_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_inv]

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_continuous
statement:
private theorem normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_continuous :
    Continuous (normalRestrictionKernelEquiv (K := K) M Ω)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_one (normalRestrictionKernelEquiv M Ω)
  rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEU⟩ := (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff M Ω U).mp hU
  have : FiniteDimensional K (E.restrictScalars K) := FiniteDimensional.trans K M E
  have hO : IsOpen ((Subtype.val :
      (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K)).ker → Gal(Ω/K)) ⁻¹'
      ((E.restrictScalars K).fixingSubgroup : Set Gal(Ω/K))) :=
    (E.restrictScalars K).fixingSubgroup_isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset
    (hO.mem_nhds (Subgroup.one_mem (E.restrictScalars K).fixingSubgroup))
  intro σ hσ
  apply hEU
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff E
    (normalRestrictionKernelEquiv M Ω σ)).mpr
  intro x hx
  rw [normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_apply]
  exact (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff (E.restrictScalars K) σ.val).mp hσ x hx

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv_apply
    (σ : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K)).ker) (x : Ω) :
    normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv M Ω σ x = (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) x
proof: := rfl

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv_symm_apply (σ : Gal(Ω/M)) :
    ((normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv (K := K) M Ω).symm σ : Gal(Ω/K)) =
      σ.restrictScalars K
proof: := rfl

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv_conjNormal
statement:
theorem normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv_conjNormal (g : Gal(Ω/K))
    (σ : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K)).ker) :
    normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv M Ω (MulAut.conjNormal g σ) =
      semilinearGaloisConjugate (g.restrictNormal M).toRingEquiv g.toRingEquiv
        (normalRestriction_algebraMap M Ω g)
        (normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv M Ω σ)
proof:
:=
  normalRestrictionKernelEquiv_conjNormal M Ω g σ

name: KummerTheory.semilinear_symm_algebraMap
statement:
theorem semilinear_symm_algebraMap (τ : K ≃+* K) (e : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k)) (k : K) :
    e.symm (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ.symm k)
proof:
:= by
  apply e.injective
  rw [e.apply_symm_apply, he, τ.apply_symm_apply]

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply (τ : K ≃+* K) (e : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (x : Ω) :
    semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e he σ x = e (σ (e.symm x))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.semilinear_multiplier_eq
statement:
theorem semilinear_multiplier_eq {L : Type*} [Field L]
    (ι : L →+* Ω) (τ : L ≃+* L) (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (hι : ∀ z : L, a (ι z) = ι (τ z))
    (β : Ω) (hβ : β ≠ 0) (c d : L) (z : Ω)
    (hc : ι c * β = z) (hd : ι d * a β = a z) : d = τ c
proof:
:= by
  apply ι.injective
  have h := congrArg a hc
  rw [map_mul, hι] at h
  have haβ : a β ≠ 0 := fun hz => hβ (a.injective (hz.trans (map_zero a).symm))
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ haβ (hd.trans h.symm)

name: KummerTheory.semilinear_refl_algebraMap
statement:
theorem semilinear_refl_algebraMap (k : K) :
    RingEquiv.refl Ω (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (RingEquiv.refl K k)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisConjugate_refl
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisConjugate_refl (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    semilinearGaloisConjugate (RingEquiv.refl K) (RingEquiv.refl Ω)
      (semilinear_refl_algebraMap (K := K) (Ω := Ω)) σ = σ
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.semilinear_trans_algebraMap
statement:
theorem semilinear_trans_algebraMap (τ υ : K ≃+* K) (e d : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (hd : ∀ k : K, d (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (υ k)) (k : K) :
    (e.trans d) (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω ((τ.trans υ) k)
proof:
:= by
  change d (e (algebraMap K Ω k)) = algebraMap K Ω (υ (τ k))
  rw [he, hd]

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisConjugate_trans
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisConjugate_trans (τ υ : K ≃+* K) (e d : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (hd : ∀ k : K, d (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (υ k))
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    semilinearGaloisConjugate (τ.trans υ) (e.trans d)
      (semilinear_trans_algebraMap τ υ e d he hd) σ =
        semilinearGaloisConjugate υ d hd (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e he σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  simp only [semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply, RingEquiv.trans_apply,
    RingEquiv.symm_trans_apply]

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv_apply (τ : K ≃+* K) (e : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv τ e he σ = semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e he σ
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference_apply
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference_apply (τ : K ≃+* K) (e e' : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (he' : ∀ k : K, e' (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k)) (x : Ω) :
    semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference τ e e' he he' x = e' (e.symm x)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference_inv_apply
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference_inv_apply
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (e e' : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (he' : ∀ k : K, e' (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k)) (x : Ω) :
    (semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference τ e e' he he')⁻¹ x = e (e'.symm x)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq_inner
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq_inner (τ : K ≃+* K) (e e' : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (he' : ∀ k : K, e' (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e' he' σ =
      semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference τ e e' he he' *
        semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e he σ *
          (semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference τ e e' he he')⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  simp only [AlgEquiv.mul_apply, semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference_apply,
    semilinearGaloisExtensionDifference_inv_apply, semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply,
    RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: KummerTheory.map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq
statement:
theorem map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq {A : Type*} [CommGroup A]
    (f : Gal(Ω/K) →* A) (τ : K ≃+* K) (e e' : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (he' : ∀ k : K, e' (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    f (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e' he' σ) =
      f (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e he σ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq_inner τ e e' he he', map_mul, map_mul, map_inv,
    mul_right_comm, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]

name: KummerTheory.cocycle_finite_stage
statement:
private theorem cocycle_finite_stage
    (c : Gal(Ω/K) → Ωˣ) (hc : IsMulCocycle₁ c)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant c) :
    ∃ (E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ω) (cE : Gal(E/K) → Eˣ),
      IsMulCocycle₁ cE ∧
      ∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K),
        ((cE (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ) : E) : Ω) = (c σ : Ω)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc1 : c 1 = 1 := map_one_of_isMulCocycle₁ hc
  have hnhds : {g : Gal(Ω/K) | c g = 1} ∈ 𝓝 1 :=
    (hlc.isOpen_fiber 1).mem_nhds hc1
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ :=
    (InfiniteGalois.krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff_of_isGalois
      (k := K) (K := Ω) {g : Gal(Ω/K) | c g = 1}).1 hnhds
  let r : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(E/K) := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E
  have hr : Function.Surjective r := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective Ω
  have hker (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (hσ : r σ = 1) : c σ = 1 := by
    apply hE
    change σ ∈ E.fixingSubgroup
    rw [← IntermediateField.restrictNormalHom_ker]
    exact hσ
  have hfactor (σ τ : Gal(Ω/K)) (heq : r σ = r τ) : c σ = c τ := by
    have hrel : r (τ⁻¹ * σ) = 1 := by rw [map_mul, map_inv, heq, inv_mul_cancel]
    have hc_rel := hker (τ⁻¹ * σ) hrel
    calc
      c σ = c (τ * (τ⁻¹ * σ)) := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]
      _ = c τ := by rw [hc, hc_rel, smul_one, one_mul]
  have hmem (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : (c σ : Ω) ∈ E.toIntermediateField := by
    rw [← InfiniteGalois.fixedField_fixingSubgroup E.toIntermediateField,
      IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff]
    intro τ hτ
    have hrτ : r τ = 1 := by
      change τ ∈ r.ker
      rw [IntermediateField.restrictNormalHom_ker]
      exact hτ
    have hcτ : c τ = 1 := hker τ hrτ
    have hfixed : τ • c σ = c σ := by
      calc
        τ • c σ = c (τ * σ) := by rw [hc, hcτ, mul_one]
        _ = c σ := hfactor (τ * σ) σ (by rw [map_mul, hrτ, one_mul])
    exact congrArg (fun z : Ωˣ => (z : Ω)) hfixed
  let cE : Gal(E/K) → Eˣ := fun σ =>
    Units.mk0 ⟨(c (hr σ).choose : Ω), hmem (hr σ).choose⟩
      (fun h => Units.ne_zero (c (hr σ).choose) (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  have hvalue (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
      ((cE (r σ) : E) : Ω) = (c σ : Ω) := by
    change (c ((hr (r σ)).choose) : Ω) = (c σ : Ω)
    exact congrArg Units.val (hfactor _ _ (hr (r σ)).choose_spec)
  have hcE : IsMulCocycle₁ cE := by
    intro σ τ
    obtain ⟨σ', rfl⟩ := hr σ
    obtain ⟨τ', rfl⟩ := hr τ
    apply Units.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((cE (r σ' * r τ') : E) : Ω) =
      (r σ') (cE (r τ') : E) * (cE (r σ') : E)
    rw [← map_mul, hvalue,
      show ((r σ') (cE (r τ') : E) : Ω) = σ' ((cE (r τ') : E) : Ω) from
        AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_apply E.toIntermediateField σ' (cE (r τ') : E)]
    rw [hvalue, hvalue]
    exact congrArg Units.val (hc σ' τ')
  exact ⟨E, cE, hcE, hvalue⟩

name: KummerTheory.noetherHilbert90_of_isLocallyConstant
statement:
theorem noetherHilbert90_of_isLocallyConstant
    (c : Gal(Ω/K) → Ωˣ) (hc : IsMulCocycle₁ c)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant c) :
    IsMulCoboundary₁ c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E, cE, hcE, hvalue⟩ := cocycle_finite_stage c hc hlc
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := isMulCoboundary₁_of_isMulCocycle₁_of_aut_to_units cE hcE
  refine ⟨Units.map (algebraMap E Ω).toMonoidHom β, ?_⟩
  intro σ
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [AlgEquiv.smul_units_def, Units.val_div_eq_div_val, Units.coe_map,
    MonoidHom.coe_ofClass]
  change σ (algebraMap E Ω (β : E)) / algebraMap E Ω (β : E) = (c σ : Ω)
  rw [← hvalue σ]
  have hβ' : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ) (β : E) / (β : E) =
      (cE (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ) : E) := by
    simpa only [AlgEquiv.smul_units_def, Units.val_div_eq_div_val, Units.coe_map,
      MonoidHom.coe_ofClass] using congrArg Units.val (hβ (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ))
  have h := congrArg (algebraMap E Ω) hβ'
  rw [map_div₀] at h
  change ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ) (β : E) : Ω) / ((β : E) : Ω) =
    ((cE (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ) : E) : Ω) at h
  rw [AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_apply] at h
  exact h

name: KummerTheory.exists_completion_character_on_prolongations
statement:
theorem exists_completion_character_on_prolongations
    {ι κ : Type*} [Finite κ] {K : Type u} {E : Type w}
    [Field K] [Field E] [Algebra K E]
    (D : ι → DVF.{u, v} K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (V : κ → DVF.{w, z} E) (π : κ → ι)
    [hV : ∀ j, (D (π j)).valuation.HasExtension (V j).valuation]
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : E)]
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) E).Nonempty)
    (χ : ∀ i, Gal(AlgebraicClosure (D i).valuation.Completion/(D i).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
      Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) :
    ∃ ψ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)),
      ∀ j, (ψ.comp (map (algebraMap E (V j).valuation.Completion)) :
        Gal(AlgebraicClosure (V j).valuation.Completion/(V j).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
          Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) =
        (χ (π j)).comp (map (DVF.completionMap (D (π j)) (V j)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Setoid κ :=
    { r := fun i j => (V i).valuation.IsEquiv (V j).valuation
      iseqv := ⟨fun _ => _root_.Valuation.IsEquiv.refl,
        fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩ }
  let J := Quotient s
  let : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  let W (j : J) : DVF.{w,z} E := V j.out
  have hW : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (W i).valuation.IsEquiv (W j).valuation) := by
    intro i j hij heq
    exact hij ((Quotient.out_eq i).symm.trans
      ((Quotient.sound heq).trans (Quotient.out_eq j)))
  let C (j : J) := (W j).valuation.Completion
  let : ∀ j, Field (C j) := fun j => inferInstanceAs (Field ((W j).valuation.Completion))
  let f (j : J) : E →+* C j := algebraMap E (W j).valuation.Completion
  have hclasses : Function.Surjective (fun (u : Eˣ) (j : J) =>
      (Units.map (f j).toMonoidHom u : (C j)ˣ ⧸
        (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : (C j)ˣ →* (C j)ˣ).range)) :=
    DVF.surjective_pi_completion_powerClasses W hW (n : ℕ) (NeZero.ne _)
  let η (j : J) : Gal(AlgebraicClosure (C j)/C j) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)) :=
    (χ (π j.out)).comp (map (DVF.completionMap (D (π j.out)) (V j.out)))
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.surjective_characters_of_powerClasses
    C f n hmu hclasses η
  refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
  intro j
  let q : J := Quotient.mk s j
  let i : κ := q.out
  have hij : (V i).valuation.IsEquiv (V j).valuation := Quotient.exact (Quotient.out_eq q)
  have hπ : π i = π j := by
    by_contra hne
    apply hD hne
    exact (_root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_isEquiv_comap
      (vR := (D (π i)).valuation) (vA := (V i).valuation)).trans
        ((_root_.Valuation.IsEquiv.comap (algebraMap K E) hij).trans
          (_root_.Valuation.HasExtension.val_isEquiv_comap
            (vR := (D (π j)).valuation) (vA := (V j).valuation)).symm)
  have hExt : (D (π i)).valuation.HasExtension (V j).valuation := hπ.symm ▸ hV j
  let g := DVF.completionRingEquiv (V i) (V j) (RingEquiv.refl E) hij
  have hg : g.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion) =
      algebraMap E (V j).valuation.Completion := by
    ext x
    exact DVF.completionRingEquiv_algebraMap (V i) (V j) (RingEquiv.refl E) hij x
  have hgbase : g.toRingHom.comp (DVF.completionMap (D (π i)) (V i)) =
      DVF.completionMap (D (π i)) (V j) :=
    DVF.completionRingEquiv_comp_completionMap (D (π i)) (V i) (V j) 1 hij
  have hrep : (ψ.comp (map (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion)) :
      Gal(AlgebraicClosure (V i).valuation.Completion/(V i).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
        Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) =
      (χ (π i)).comp (map (DVF.completionMap (D (π i)) (V i))) := congrFun hψ q
  have hlast : ((χ (π i)).comp (map (DVF.completionMap (D (π i)) (V j))) :
      Gal(AlgebraicClosure (V j).valuation.Completion/(V j).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
        Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) =
      (χ (π j)).comp (map (DVF.completionMap (D (π j)) (V j))) := by
    have transport (a b : ι) (hab : a = b)
        (ha : (D a).valuation.HasExtension (V j).valuation)
        (hb : (D b).valuation.HasExtension (V j).valuation) :
        (let _ := ha; (χ a).comp (map (DVF.completionMap (D a) (V j)))) =
          (let _ := hb; (χ b).comp (map (DVF.completionMap (D b) (V j)))) := by
      subst b
      rfl
    exact transport (π i) (π j) hπ hExt (hV j)
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
    ((congrArg (fun f => ψ.comp (map f)) hg.symm).trans
      (character_map_comp (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion) g.toRingHom ψ)) σ).trans
    ((DFunLike.congr_fun hrep (map g.toRingHom σ)).trans
      ((DFunLike.congr_fun
        ((character_map_comp (DVF.completionMap (D (π i)) (V i)) g.toRingHom (χ (π i))).symm.trans
          (congrArg (fun f => (χ (π i)).comp (map f)) hgbase)) σ).trans
        (DFunLike.congr_fun hlast σ)))

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroup_normal
statement: theorem fixingSubgroup_normal : L.fixingSubgroup.Normal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← L.restrictNormalHom_ker]
  exact MonoidHom.normal_ker (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom L)

name: KummerTheory.galois_restrictNormal_algebraMap
statement:
theorem galois_restrictNormal_algebraMap (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (x : L) :
    σ.toRingEquiv (algebraMap L Ω x) =
      algebraMap L Ω ((σ.restrictNormal L).toRingEquiv x)
proof:
:=
  (σ.restrictNormal_commutes L x).symm

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupEquiv_conjNormal
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupEquiv_conjNormal (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (ρ : L.fixingSubgroup) :
    L.fixingSubgroupEquiv (MulAut.conjNormal σ ρ) =
      semilinearGaloisConjugate (σ.restrictNormal L).toRingEquiv σ.toRingEquiv
        (galois_restrictNormal_algebraMap L σ) (L.fixingSubgroupEquiv ρ)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  rw [fixingSubgroupEquiv_apply, semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply]
  change (σ * (ρ : Gal(Ω/K)) * σ⁻¹) x = σ ((ρ : Gal(Ω/K)) (σ.symm x))
  rw [AlgEquiv.mul_apply, AlgEquiv.mul_apply, AlgEquiv.coe_inv]

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupAbelianization_conjugation
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupAbelianization_conjugation (σ : Gal(Ω/K))
    (x : _root_.TopologicalAbelianization L.fixingSubgroup) :
    TopologicalAbelianization.congr (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L)
        (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap L.fixingSubgroup
          (QuotientGroup.mk' L.fixingSubgroup σ) x) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.congr
        (semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv (σ.restrictNormal L).toRingEquiv
          σ.toRingEquiv (galois_restrictNormal_algebraMap L σ))
        (TopologicalAbelianization.congr (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L) x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk L.fixingSubgroup x
  rw [quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk,
    TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk, TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk, fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv_apply,
    fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv_apply, semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv_apply,
    fixingSubgroupEquiv_conjNormal]

name: KummerTheory.invariant_of_semilinear_extension
statement:
private theorem invariant_of_semilinear_extension
    {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [T1Space A]
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* A) (ψ : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* A)
    (hψ : ∀ σ : E.fixingSubgroup, ψ (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) =
      f (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv E Ω (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv E σ)))
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (υ : E ≃+* E) (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (haK : ∀ x : K, a (algebraMap K Ω x) = algebraMap K Ω (τ x))
    (haE : ∀ x : E, a (algebraMap E Ω x) = algebraMap E Ω (υ x))
    (hψinv : ∀ ρ : Gal(Ω/K), ψ (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ a haK ρ) = ψ ρ)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)) : f (absoluteGaloisConjugate υ σ) = f σ
proof:
:= by
  let e : Gal(Ω/E) ≃ₜ* Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) := absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv E Ω
  have hrestriction (ρ : Gal(Ω/E)) : ψ (ρ.restrictScalars K) = f (e ρ) := by
    have h := hψ (E.fixingSubgroupEquiv.symm ρ)
    have hscalar : (E.fixingSubgroupEquiv.symm ρ : Gal(Ω/K)) =
        ρ.restrictScalars K := by
      apply AlgEquiv.ext
      intro x
      rfl
    rw [fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv_apply, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hscalar] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨ρ, rfl⟩ := e.surjective σ
  have hrelative : f (e (semilinearGaloisConjugate υ a haE ρ)) = f (e ρ) := by
    rw [← hrestriction, semilinearGaloisConjugate_restrictScalars
      τ υ a haK haE, ← hrestriction]
    exact hψinv (ρ.restrictScalars K)
  exact (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv_character_conjugation υ a haE f ρ).symm.trans hrelative

name: KummerTheory.absoluteCharacter_invariant_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
statement:
theorem absoluteCharacter_invariant_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
    (n : ℕ) (hdegree : (Module.finrank K E).Coprime n)
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (hinv : ∀ (δ : Gal(E/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)),
      f (absoluteGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv σ) = f σ)
    (τ : Gal(K/F)) (υ : E ≃+* E)
    (hυ : ∀ x : K, υ (algebraMap K E x) = algebraMap K E (τ x))
    (hτ : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := n) F K τ = 1)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)) :
    f (absoluteGaloisConjugate υ σ) = f σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_character_extension_of_coprime_finrank E n hdegree f hinv
  let a : Ω ≃+* Ω := IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv Ω Ω υ
  have haE : ∀ x : E, a (algebraMap E Ω x) = algebraMap E Ω (υ x) :=
    IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap Ω Ω υ
  have haK (x : K) : a (algebraMap K Ω x) = algebraMap K Ω (τ x) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K E Ω x, haE, hυ,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K E Ω]
  exact invariant_of_semilinear_extension E f ψ hψ τ.toRingEquiv υ a haK haE
    (semilinearCharacter_invariant_of_relativeH1Action_eq_one τ hτ a haK ψ) σ

name: KummerTheory.exists_cyclotomic_cocycle_lift_open
statement:
theorem exists_cyclotomic_cocycle_lift_open
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [NeZero (p : Ω)]
    (H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K)) (k : ℕ)
    (c : ↥(H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) → ZMod (p ^ 1))
    (hc : ∀ σ τ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)), c (σ * τ) = c σ +
      ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p σ.val.toRingEquiv : PadicInt p).toZModPow 1) * c τ)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant c) :
    ∃ d : ↥(H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) → ZMod (p ^ (k + 1)),
      IsLocallyConstant d ∧
      (∀ σ τ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)), d (σ * τ) = d σ +
        ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p σ.val.toRingEquiv : PadicInt p).toZModPow (k + 1)) * d τ) ∧
      ∀ σ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)),
        ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : 1 ≤ k + 1))
          (ZMod (p ^ 1)) (d σ) = c σ
proof:
:= by
  let E : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  let closedH : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨H.toSubgroup, H.isClosed⟩
  have hfix : E.fixingSubgroup = (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField closedH
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite E).mp (by
    rw [hfix]
    exact H.isOpen)
  let e₀ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* E.fixingSubgroup :=
    { toMulEquiv := MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hfix.symm
      continuous_toFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix.symm ▸ x.property)
      continuous_invFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix ▸ x.property) }
  let e : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* Gal(Ω/E) :=
    e₀.trans (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv E)
  have he (σ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) : (e σ).toRingEquiv = σ.val.toRingEquiv := by
    rfl
  have hei (σ : Gal(Ω/E)) : (e.symm σ).val.toRingEquiv = σ.toRingEquiv := by
    rw [← he, e.apply_symm_apply]
  let cE : Gal(Ω/E) → ZMod (p ^ 1) := fun σ => c (e.symm σ)
  have hcE (σ τ : Gal(Ω/E)) : cE (σ * τ) = cE σ +
      ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p σ.toRingEquiv : PadicInt p).toZModPow 1) * cE τ := by
    change c (e.symm (σ * τ)) = _
    rw [map_mul, hc, hei]
  obtain ⟨dE, hdElc, hdE, hred⟩ := exists_cyclotomic_cocycle_lift
    (K := E) p k cE hcE (hlc.comp_continuous e.symm.continuous)
  refine ⟨fun σ => dE (e σ), hdElc.comp_continuous e.continuous, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro σ τ
    change dE (e (σ * τ)) = dE (e σ) +
      ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p σ.val.toRingEquiv : PadicInt p).toZModPow (k + 1)) * dE (e τ)
    rw [map_mul, hdE, he]
  · intro σ
    exact (hred (e σ)).trans (congrArg c (e.symm_apply_apply σ))

name: KummerTheory.residualAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
private theorem residualAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk
    (τ : RingAut K) (σ : G) :
    residualAbelianizationEquiv hC τ
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q (QuotientGroup.mk' R σ)) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q
        (QuotientGroup.mk' R (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [residualAbelianizationEquiv, TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    ← absoluteGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv_apply]
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.residualAbelianizationEquiv_one
statement:
private theorem residualAbelianizationEquiv_one :
    (residualAbelianizationEquiv hC (1 : RingAut K)).toMulEquiv = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk Q x
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective R q
  change residualAbelianizationEquiv hC (1 : RingAut K)
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q (QuotientGroup.mk' R σ)) =
    TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q (QuotientGroup.mk' R σ)
  rw [residualAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk, RingAut.one_eq_refl]
  change ((TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q).comp (QuotientGroup.mk' R))
      (absoluteGaloisConjugate (RingEquiv.refl K) σ) = _
  unfold absoluteGaloisConjugate
  rw [map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq
    ((TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q).comp (QuotientGroup.mk' R))
    (RingEquiv.refl K) (RingEquiv.refl (AlgebraicClosure K))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (RingEquiv.refl K))
    (semilinear_refl_algebraMap (K := K) (Ω := AlgebraicClosure K))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (RingEquiv.refl K)), semilinearGaloisConjugate_refl]
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.residualAbelianizationEquiv_mul
statement:
private theorem residualAbelianizationEquiv_mul (τ υ : RingAut K) :
    (residualAbelianizationEquiv hC (τ * υ)).toMulEquiv =
      (residualAbelianizationEquiv hC τ).toMulEquiv *
        (residualAbelianizationEquiv hC υ).toMulEquiv
proof:
:= by
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk Q x
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective R q
  change residualAbelianizationEquiv hC (τ * υ)
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q (QuotientGroup.mk' R σ)) =
    residualAbelianizationEquiv hC τ
      (residualAbelianizationEquiv hC υ
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q (QuotientGroup.mk' R σ)))
  rw [residualAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk, residualAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk,
    residualAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk]
  have hbase : (τ * υ : RingAut K) = υ.trans τ := rfl
  rw [hbase]
  change ((TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q).comp (QuotientGroup.mk' R))
      (absoluteGaloisConjugate (υ.trans τ) σ) = _
  unfold absoluteGaloisConjugate
  rw [map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq
    ((TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q).comp (QuotientGroup.mk' R)) (υ.trans τ)
    ((IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) υ).trans
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) (υ.trans τ))
    (semilinear_trans_algebraMap υ τ
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) υ)
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ)
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) υ)
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (υ.trans τ)), semilinearGaloisConjugate_trans]
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction_apply_mk
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction_apply_mk
    (τ : RingAut K) (σ : G) :
    absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction hC τ
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q (QuotientGroup.mk' R σ)) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q
        (QuotientGroup.mk' R (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ))
proof:
:=
  residualAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk hC τ σ

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction_apply_mk_of_lift
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction_apply_mk_of_lift
    (τ : RingAut K) (e : AlgebraicClosure K ≃+* AlgebraicClosure K)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) k) =
      algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (τ k))
    (σ : G) :
    absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction hC τ
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q (QuotientGroup.mk' R σ)) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q
        (QuotientGroup.mk' R (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e he σ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction_apply_mk]
  change ((TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q).comp (QuotientGroup.mk' R))
      (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) = _
  unfold absoluteGaloisConjugate
  exact map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq
    ((TopologicalAbelianization.mk Q).comp (QuotientGroup.mk' R)) τ e
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ) he
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ) σ

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv_character_conjugation
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv_character_conjugation
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (ha : ∀ k : K, a (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A) (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    f (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv K Ω (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ a ha σ)) =
      f (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv K Ω σ))
proof:
:= by
  have hconj := galoisClosureTransport_abelianization_conjugation_mk
    (IsAlgClosure.equiv K Ω (AlgebraicClosure K)) τ a ha σ
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_apply_mk] at hconj
  have hvalue := congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.lift f) hconj
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk,
    TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk] at hvalue
  exact hvalue

name: KummerTheory.galoisClosureTransport_abelianization_conjugation_mk
statement:
theorem galoisClosureTransport_abelianization_conjugation_mk
    (e : Ω ≃ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure K) (τ : K ≃+* K) (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (ha : ∀ k : K, a (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    TopologicalAbelianization.congr (galoisClosureTransport e)
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(Ω/K) (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ a ha σ)) =
      absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ
        (TopologicalAbelianization.congr (galoisClosureTransport e)
          (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(Ω/K) σ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk, TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_apply_mk]
  change TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
      (AlgEquiv.autCongr e (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ a ha σ)) = _
  rw [autCongr_semilinearGaloisConjugate]
  unfold absoluteGaloisConjugate
  exact (map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) τ
    (transportSemilinearEquiv e a)
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ)
    (transportSemilinearEquiv_algebraMap τ e a ha)
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ)
    (AlgEquiv.autCongr e σ)).symm

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv_conjugation
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv_conjugation
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (ha : ∀ k : K, a (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (x : _root_.TopologicalAbelianization Gal(Ω/K)) :
    absoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv K Ω
        (TopologicalAbelianization.congr (semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv τ a ha) x) =
      absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ (absoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv K Ω x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk Gal(Ω/K) x
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv_apply]
  exact galoisClosureTransport_abelianization_conjugation_mk
    (IsAlgClosure.equiv K Ω (AlgebraicClosure K)) τ a ha σ

name: KummerTheory.topologicalAbelianization_congr_ne_one_of_character_ne
statement:
theorem topologicalAbelianization_congr_ne_one_of_character_ne
    (e : G ≃ₜ* G) (χ : G →ₜ* A) {x : G} (hχ : χ (e x) ≠ χ x) :
    (TopologicalAbelianization.congr e).toMulEquiv ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hχ
  have hp := congrArg
    (fun a : MulAut (_root_.TopologicalAbelianization G) =>
      a (TopologicalAbelianization.mk G x)) h
  have hc : TopologicalAbelianization.mk G (e x) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk G x := by
    change TopologicalAbelianization.congr e (TopologicalAbelianization.mk G x) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk G x at hp
    rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk] at hp
    exact hp
  have hvalue := congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.lift χ) hc
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk,
    TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk] at hvalue
  exact hvalue

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_eq (τ : K ≃+* K) (e e' : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (he' : ∀ k : K, e' (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k)) :
    TopologicalAbelianization.congr (semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv τ e' he') =
      TopologicalAbelianization.congr (semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv τ e he)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk Gal(Ω/K) a
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk, TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv_apply,
    semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv_apply]
  exact map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(Ω/K))
    τ e e' he he' σ

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk (τ : RingAut K)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv τ
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) σ) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv, TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    absoluteGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv_apply]

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_eq_of_lift
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_eq_of_lift (τ : RingAut K)
    (e : AlgebraicClosure K ≃+* AlgebraicClosure K)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) k) =
      algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (τ k)) :
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv τ =
      TopologicalAbelianization.congr (semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv τ e he)
proof:
:=
  semilinearGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_eq τ e
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ) he
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ)

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_one
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_one :
    (absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv (1 : RingAut K)).toMulEquiv = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk
    Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) a
  change absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv (1 : RingAut K)
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) σ) =
    TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) σ
  rw [absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk, RingAut.one_eq_refl]
  unfold absoluteGaloisConjugate
  rw [map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) (RingEquiv.refl K)
    (RingEquiv.refl (AlgebraicClosure K))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) (RingEquiv.refl K))
    (semilinear_refl_algebraMap (K := K) (Ω := AlgebraicClosure K))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (RingEquiv.refl K)), semilinearGaloisConjugate_refl]

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_mul
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_mul (τ υ : RingAut K) :
    (absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv (τ * υ)).toMulEquiv =
      (absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv τ).toMulEquiv *
        (absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv υ).toMulEquiv
proof:
:= by
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk
    Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) a
  change absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv (τ * υ)
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) σ) =
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv τ
      (absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv υ
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) σ))
  rw [absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk,
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk, absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk]
  have hbase : (τ * υ : RingAut K) = υ.trans τ := by rfl
  rw [hbase]
  unfold absoluteGaloisConjugate
  rw [map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) (υ.trans τ)
    ((IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) υ).trans
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) (υ.trans τ))
    (semilinear_trans_algebraMap υ τ
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) υ)
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ)
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) υ)
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (υ.trans τ)), semilinearGaloisConjugate_trans]

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_apply_mk
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_apply_mk (τ : RingAut K)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) σ) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)
proof:
:=
  absoluteGaloisAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk τ σ

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_ne_one_of_character_ne
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_ne_one_of_character_ne
    {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [T1Space A]
    (τ : RingAut K) (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A)
    {σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)}
    (hχ : χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) ≠ χ σ) :
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  topologicalAbelianization_congr_ne_one_of_character_ne
    (absoluteGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv τ) χ hχ

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteGaloisLift_nthRoot_eq_pow
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisLift_nthRoot_eq_pow
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (a : ℕ)
    (hτ : ∀ ζ : K, ζ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ζ = ζ ^ a)
    (z : nthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ)) :
    Units.map (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (AlgebraicClosure K) τ).toMonoidHom (z : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) =
        (z : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) ^ a
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (z : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := z.property
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := nthRootsOfUnityInBase_of_primitiveRoots
    (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) n hmu (z : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) hz
  have hζpow : ζ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := by
    apply Units.map_injective (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).injective
    rw [map_pow, map_one, hζ, hz]
  have hζfield : (ζ : K) ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := congrArg Units.val hζpow
  rw [← hζ]
  apply Units.ext
  change IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ
      (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (ζ : K)) =
    (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (ζ : K)) ^ a
  rw [IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap, hτ (ζ : K) hζfield, map_pow]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_separableClosure_eq_top
statement:
theorem finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_separableClosure_eq_top
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)] :
    finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero ((n : ℕ) : SeparableClosure K) :=
    NeZero.nat_of_injective (f := algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K))
      (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).injective
  apply top_unique
  intro a _
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := IsSepClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq
    (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) (a : K)) (n : ℕ)
  have hβ_ne : β ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hmap_zero : algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) (a : K) = 0 := by
      rw [← hβ, hzero, zero_pow n.ne_zero]
    exact a.ne_zero ((algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).injective
      (hmap_zero.trans (map_zero (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K))).symm))
  refine ⟨Units.mk0 β hβ_ne, ?_⟩
  exact Units.ext hβ

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.map_powerRange_unitsEquivSeparableRadicalCarrier
statement:
private theorem map_powerRange_unitsEquivSeparableRadicalCarrier
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)] :
    (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range.map
        (unitsEquivSeparableRadicalCarrier K n).toMonoidHom =
      (chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum
        (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) n).ambientNthPowersSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  let D := chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) n
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨b, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact D.mem_ambientNthPowersSubgroup_iff.mpr ⟨b, rfl⟩
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := D.mem_ambientNthPowersSubgroup_iff.mp ha
    let x : Kˣ := a.1
    have hx : x = b ^ (n : ℕ) := hb.symm
    refine ⟨x, ⟨b, hx.symm⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)]
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (a : Kˣ) (β : (SeparableClosure K)ˣ)
    (hβ : β ^ (n : ℕ) =
      Units.map (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).toMonoidHom a)
    (σ : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) :
    ((separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ :
      DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (SeparableClosure K) (n : ℕ)) :
        (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) =
      rootQuotient (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) β σ
proof:
:= by
  let D := chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) n
  let δ : D.carrier := unitsEquivSeparableRadicalCarrier K n a
  let hbase := nthRootsOfUnityInBase_of_primitiveRoots
    (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) n hmu
  let hfixed := nthRootsOfUnity_fixed (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) n hbase
  have hδ : δ.1 = a := by
    dsimp only [δ, unitsEquivSeparableRadicalCarrier, MulEquiv.trans_apply]
    exact MulEquiv.subgroupCongr_apply
      (finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_separableClosure_eq_top K n).symm
      (Subgroup.topEquiv.symm a)
  have hclass :
      separablePowerClassEquivRadicalQuotient K n
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) =
      D.radicalQuotientMk δ := by
    unfold separablePowerClassEquivRadicalQuotient
    simp only [MulEquiv.trans_apply]
    apply D.radicalQuotientMulEquiv.injective
    rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply, D.radicalQuotientMk_apply]
    erw [QuotientGroup.congr_apply]
    rfl
  change ((infiniteKummerContinuousQuotientCharacter n hbase
      (separablePowerClassEquivRadicalQuotient K n
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range))).toMonoidHom σ :
      (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) =
    rootQuotient (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) β σ
  rw [hclass, infiniteKummerContinuousQuotientCharacter_toMonoidHom,
    D.quotientKummerCharacterWithoutSection_mk]
  change D.rootCharacter δ hfixed σ =
    rootQuotient (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) β σ
  exact (D.rootCharacter_eq_of_same_pow hfixed δ (hδ ▸ hβ) σ).symm

name: KummerTheory.absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform_apply
statement:
theorem absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform_apply (τ : RingAut K)
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform τ f σ =
      f (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm σ)
proof:
:= by

name: KummerTheory.absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform_one
statement:
theorem absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform_one
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A) :
    absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform 1 f = f
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ

name: KummerTheory.absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform_mul
statement:
theorem absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform_mul (τ υ : RingAut K)
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A) :
    absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform (τ * υ) f =
      absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform τ (absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform υ f)
proof:
:= by

name: KummerTheory.absoluteContinuousCharacterAction_apply
statement:
theorem absoluteContinuousCharacterAction_apply (τ : RingAut K)
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A) :
    absoluteContinuousCharacterAction τ f = absoluteContinuousCharacterTransform τ f
proof:
:= by

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupAbsoluteCharacter_conjNormal
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupAbsoluteCharacter_conjNormal
    {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [T1Space A]
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) →ₜ* A)
    (hinv : ∀ (δ : Gal(L/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)),
      f (absoluteGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv σ) = f σ)
    (g : Gal(Ω/K)) (σ : L.fixingSubgroup) :
    fixingSubgroupAbsoluteCharacter L f (MulAut.conjNormal g σ) =
      fixingSubgroupAbsoluteCharacter L f σ
proof:
:= by
  have hconj := fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_quotient_conjugation
    L g (TopologicalAbelianization.mk L.fixingSubgroup σ)
  rw [quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk
      L.fixingSubgroup g σ,
    fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk L (MulAut.conjNormal g σ),
    fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk L σ,
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_apply_mk] at hconj
  have hvalue := congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.lift f) hconj
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk,
    TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk] at hvalue
  change f (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv L Ω
      (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L (MulAut.conjNormal g σ))) =
    f (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv L Ω (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L σ))
  exact hvalue.trans (hinv (g.restrictNormal L)
    (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv L Ω (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L σ)))

name: KummerTheory.exists_character_extension_of_coprime_finrank
statement:
theorem exists_character_extension_of_coprime_finrank [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    (n : ℕ) (hdegree : (Module.finrank K L).Coprime n)
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (hinv : ∀ (δ : Gal(L/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)),
      f (absoluteGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv σ) = f σ) :
    ∃ ψ : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n),
      ∀ σ : L.fixingSubgroup, ψ (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) =
        f (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv L Ω (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L σ))
proof:
:= by
  have : IsGalois K L := { to_isSeparable := inferInstance, to_normal := inferInstance }
  let H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨L.fixingSubgroup, L.fixingSubgroup_isOpen⟩
  have hindex_eq : H.toSubgroup.index = Module.finrank K L := by
    change L.fixingSubgroup.index = _
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective
        (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom L : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(L/K)) :=
      AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective (F := K) (K₁ := L) (E := Ω)
    rw [← L.restrictNormalHom_ker, Subgroup.index_ker,
      MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj]
    exact (Nat.card_congr (Subgroup.topEquiv :
      (⊤ : Subgroup Gal(L/K)) ≃* Gal(L/K)).toEquiv).trans
        (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L)
  let : H.toSubgroup.FiniteIndex :=
    ⟨by
      rw [hindex_eq]
      exact (Module.finrank_pos (R := K) (M := L)).ne'⟩
  have hindex : H.toSubgroup.index.Coprime n := by
    rw [hindex_eq]
    exact hdegree
  let φ : H →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n) := fixingSubgroupAbsoluteCharacter L f
  refine ⟨ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.primeToIndexCharacterExtension H n φ, ?_⟩
  intro σ
  change ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.primeToIndexCharacterExtension H n φ
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) = φ σ
  exact ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.primeToIndexCharacterExtension_subtype H n hindex φ
    (fun g h => fixingSubgroupAbsoluteCharacter_conjNormal L f hinv g h) σ

name: KummerTheory.exists_surjective_prime_character_of_mixedChar
statement:
theorem exists_surjective_prime_character_of_mixedChar
    (base : DVF K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP base.residueField p] :
    ∃ ψ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p),
      Function.Surjective ψ
proof:
:= by
  have (i : ℕ) : HasEnoughRootsOfUnity (AlgebraicClosure K) (p ^ i) := by
    infer_instance
  have hRoots (E : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K))
      (hE : FiniteDimensional K E) : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p) := by
    have : Finite {ζ : E | ∃ n : ℕ, ζ ^ (p ^ n) = 1} :=
      (base.finite_primePowerRoots_of_finiteExtension (L := E) p).to_subtype
    let f : CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p → {ζ : E | ∃ n : ℕ, ζ ^ (p ^ n) = 1} :=
      fun z => ⟨(z.val : E), by
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := z.property
        exact ⟨n, congrArg Units.val hn⟩⟩
    apply Finite.of_injective f
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Units.ext
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hab
  let χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* (PadicInt p)ˣ :=
    ⟨(cyclotomicCharacter (AlgebraicClosure K) p).comp
      (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) (AlgebraicClosure K)),
      cyclotomicCharacter.continuous p K (AlgebraicClosure K)⟩
  exact PadicInt.exists_surjective_prime_character_of_infinite_unit_image χ
    (infinite_range_cyclotomicCharacter_of_finite_primary p hRoots)

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupEquiv_apply (σ : L.fixingSubgroup) (x : Ω) :
    L.fixingSubgroupEquiv σ x = (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) x
proof:
