name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupEquiv_symm_apply (σ : Gal(Ω/L)) (x : Ω) :
    (L.fixingSubgroupEquiv.symm σ : Gal(Ω/K)) x = σ x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupEquiv_continuous
statement: theorem fixingSubgroupEquiv_continuous : Continuous L.fixingSubgroupEquiv
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_one L.fixingSubgroupEquiv
  rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEU⟩ := (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff L Ω U).mp hU
  have hEK : FiniteDimensional K (E.restrictScalars K) :=
    FiniteDimensional.trans K L E
  have hO : IsOpen ((Subtype.val : L.fixingSubgroup → Gal(Ω/K)) ⁻¹'
      ((E.restrictScalars K).fixingSubgroup : Set Gal(Ω/K))) :=
    (E.restrictScalars K).fixingSubgroup_isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  apply Filter.mem_of_superset (hO.mem_nhds (Subgroup.one_mem
    (E.restrictScalars K).fixingSubgroup))
  intro σ hσ
  apply hEU
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff E (L.fixingSubgroupEquiv σ)).mpr
  intro x hx
  rw [fixingSubgroupEquiv_apply]
  exact (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff (E.restrictScalars K) σ.val).mp hσ x hx

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupEquiv_symm_continuous
statement: theorem fixingSubgroupEquiv_symm_continuous : Continuous L.fixingSubgroupEquiv.symm
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  let r : Gal(Ω/L) →* Gal(Ω/K) :=
    L.fixingSubgroup.subtype.comp L.fixingSubgroupEquiv.symm.toMonoidHom
  change Continuous r
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_one r
  rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEU⟩ := (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff K Ω U).mp hU
  let F : IntermediateField L Ω :=
    IntermediateField.extendScalars (show L ≤ L ⊔ E from le_sup_left)
  have hFK : FiniteDimensional K F := IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_sup L E
  have hF : FiniteDimensional L F := FiniteDimensional.right K L F
  apply (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff L Ω (r ⁻¹' U)).mpr
  refine ⟨F, hF, ?_⟩
  intro σ hσ
  apply hEU
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff E (r σ)).mpr
  intro x hx
  change σ x = x
  exact (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff F σ).mp hσ x
    ((show E ≤ L ⊔ E from le_sup_right) hx)

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv_apply (σ : L.fixingSubgroup) :

proof:
:= by

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv_symm_apply (σ : Gal(Ω/L)) :

name: KummerTheory.exists_finiteIntermediateField_openSubgroup_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_finiteIntermediateField_openSubgroup_equiv
    {K Ω : Type*} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsGalois K Ω]
    (H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :
    ∃ E : IntermediateField K Ω, FiniteDimensional K E ∧
      Nonempty ((H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* Gal(Ω/E))
proof:
:= by
  let E : IntermediateField K Ω :=
    IntermediateField.fixedField (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  let closedH : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨H.toSubgroup, H.isClosed⟩
  have hfix : E.fixingSubgroup = (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField closedH
  have hE : FiniteDimensional K E :=
    (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite E).mp (by
      rw [hfix]
      exact H.isOpen)
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := hE
  let e₀ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* E.fixingSubgroup :=
    { toMulEquiv := MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hfix.symm
      continuous_toFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix.symm ▸ x.property)
      continuous_invFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix ▸ x.property) }
  exact ⟨E, hE, ⟨e₀.trans (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv E)⟩⟩

    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ)

statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisConjugate_apply (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) (x : AlgebraicClosure K) :
    absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ x =
      IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ

name: KummerTheory.rootQuotient_absoluteGaloisConjugate
statement:
theorem rootQuotient_absoluteGaloisConjugate (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (β : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    rootQuotient (K := K)
      (Units.map (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K)
        (AlgebraicClosure K) τ).toMonoidHom β) (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
      Units.map (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K)
        (AlgebraicClosure K) τ).toMonoidHom (rootQuotient (K := K) β σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [rootQuotient, AlgEquiv.smul_units_def, Units.val_div_eq_div_val, Units.coe_map]
  change absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
        τ (β : AlgebraicClosure K)) /
      IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
        τ (β : AlgebraicClosure K) =
    IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ
      (σ (β : AlgebraicClosure K) / (β : AlgebraicClosure K))
  rw [absoluteGaloisConjugate_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_div₀]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.separableNthRootsFieldMapEquiv_coe
statement:
theorem separableNthRootsFieldMapEquiv_coe (f : K →+* L) (n : ℕ+)
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (u : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (SeparableClosure K) (n : ℕ)) :
    (separableNthRootsFieldMapEquiv f n hmu u : (SeparableClosure L)ˣ) =
      Units.map (separableClosureLift f).toMonoidHom (u : (SeparableClosure K)ˣ)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra K L := f.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (nthRootsSubgroupEquivOfPrimitiveRoots K
    (SeparableClosure K) n hmu).surjective u
  change ((nthRootsSubgroupEquivOfPrimitiveRoots K (SeparableClosure L) n hmu)
    ((nthRootsSubgroupEquivOfPrimitiveRoots K (SeparableClosure K) n hmu).symm
      ((nthRootsSubgroupEquivOfPrimitiveRoots K (SeparableClosure K) n hmu) a)) :
      (SeparableClosure L)ˣ) = _
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  apply Units.ext
  change algebraMap K (SeparableClosure L) ((a : Kˣ) : K) =
    separableClosureLift f (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) ((a : Kˣ) : K))
  exact (separableClosureLift_algebraMap f ((a : Kˣ) : K)).symm

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.separableKummerCharacter_fieldMap
statement:
theorem separableKummerCharacter_fieldMap
    (f : K →+* L) (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)] [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : L)]
    (hmuK : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (hmuL : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) L).Nonempty)
    (a : Kˣ) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) :
    Units.map (separableClosureLift f).toMonoidHom
      ((separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmuK
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (separableClosureAutEquiv K (map f σ)) :
          DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (SeparableClosure K) (n : ℕ)) :
          (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) =
      ((separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv L n hmuL
        ((Units.map f.toMonoidHom a) : Lˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Lˣ →* Lˣ).range)
        (separableClosureAutEquiv L σ) :
          DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (SeparableClosure L) (n : ℕ)) :
          (SeparableClosure L)ˣ)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ∈ finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) n := by
    rw [finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_separableClosure_eq_top K n]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top a
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := ha
  let βL := Units.map (separableClosureLift f).toMonoidHom β
  have hβL : βL ^ (n : ℕ) =
      Units.map (algebraMap L (SeparableClosure L)).toMonoidHom
        (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a) := by
    apply Units.ext
    change (separableClosureLift f (β : SeparableClosure K)) ^ (n : ℕ) =
      algebraMap L (SeparableClosure L) (f (a : K))
    rw [← map_pow]
    have hb : (β : SeparableClosure K) ^ (n : ℕ) =
        algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) (a : K) := congrArg Units.val hβ
    rw [hb, separableClosureLift_algebraMap]
  have hroot : Units.map (separableClosureLift f).toMonoidHom
      (rootQuotient (K := K) β (separableClosureAutEquiv K (map f σ))) =
      rootQuotient (K := L) βL (separableClosureAutEquiv L σ) := by
    apply Units.ext
    simp only [rootQuotient, AlgEquiv.smul_units_def, Units.val_div_eq_div_val, Units.coe_map]
    change separableClosureLift f
      (separableClosureAutEquiv K (map f σ) (β : SeparableClosure K) /
        (β : SeparableClosure K)) =
      separableClosureAutEquiv L σ (separableClosureLift f (β : SeparableClosure K)) /
        separableClosureLift f (β : SeparableClosure K)
    exact (map_div₀ (separableClosureLift f) _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun z => z / separableClosureLift f (β : SeparableClosure K))
        (map_separableClosureLift f σ (β : SeparableClosure K)))
  exact (congrArg (Units.map (separableClosureLift f).toMonoidHom)
    (separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq K n hmuK a β hβ
      (separableClosureAutEquiv K (map f σ)))).trans (hroot.trans
        (separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq L n hmuL
          (Units.map f.toMonoidHom a) βL hβL (separableClosureAutEquiv L σ)).symm)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.separableKummerCharacter_fieldMap_equiv
statement:
theorem separableKummerCharacter_fieldMap_equiv
    (f : K →+* L) (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)] [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : L)]
    (hmuK : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (hmuL : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) L).Nonempty)
    (a : Kˣ) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) :
    separableNthRootsFieldMapEquiv f n hmuK
      (separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmuK
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (separableClosureAutEquiv K (map f σ))) =
      separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv L n hmuL
        ((Units.map f.toMonoidHom a) : Lˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Lˣ →* Lˣ).range)
        (separableClosureAutEquiv L σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (separableNthRootsFieldMapEquiv_coe f n hmuK _).trans
    (separableKummerCharacter_fieldMap f n hmuK hmuL a σ)

name: KummerTheory.exists_primitiveRoot_prime_pow_of_infinite_primary
statement:
theorem exists_primitiveRoot_prime_pow_of_infinite_primary
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Infinite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p)] (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ ζ : Kˣ, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  have hunbounded : ∃ z : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p, (z : Kˣ) ^ (p ^ n) ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    let : NeZero (p ^ n) := ⟨pow_ne_zero n hp.ne_zero⟩
    let f : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p → rootsOfUnity (p ^ n) K :=
      fun z => ⟨z.1, (mem_rootsOfUnity _ _).2 (h z)⟩
    have hf : Function.Injective f := fun x y hxy =>
      Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : rootsOfUnity (p ^ n) K => (z : Kˣ)) hxy)
    have : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p) := Finite.of_injective f hf
    exact not_finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hunbounded
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent_iff_orderOf.mp z.property
  have hmn : n ≤ m := by
    by_contra h
    apply hz
    apply orderOf_dvd_iff_pow_eq_one.mp
    rw [hm]
    exact pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)
  have hprim : IsPrimitiveRoot (z : Kˣ) (p ^ m) := IsPrimitiveRoot.iff_orderOf.mpr hm
  refine ⟨(z : Kˣ) ^ (p ^ (m - n)), ?_⟩
  exact hprim.pow (pow_pos hp.pos m)
    (by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hmn])

name: KummerTheory.primaryComponent_prime_pow_surjective_of_infinite
statement:
theorem primaryComponent_prime_pow_surjective_of_infinite
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Infinite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p)]
    (q : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime) :
    Function.Surjective (fun z : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p => z ^ q)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent_iff_orderOf.mp z.property
  by_cases hqp : q = p
  · subst q
    obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ := exists_primitiveRoot_prime_pow_of_infinite_primary (K := K) p (m + 1)
    have hηp : IsPrimitiveRoot (η ^ p) (p ^ m) :=
      hη.pow (pow_pos hp.pos (m + 1)) (by rw [pow_succ, mul_comm])
    have hzpow : (z : Kˣ) ^ (p ^ m) = 1 := by rw [← hm, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
    let : NeZero (p ^ m) := ⟨pow_ne_zero m hp.ne_zero⟩
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := hηp.eq_pow_of_mem_rootsOfUnity
      ((mem_rootsOfUnity (p ^ m) (z : Kˣ)).mpr hzpow)
    have hηmem : η ∈ CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p := ⟨m + 1, hη.pow_eq_one⟩
    refine ⟨⟨η ^ i, (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p).pow_mem hηmem i⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (η ^ i) ^ p = (z : Kˣ)
    rw [pow_right_comm]
    exact hi
  · have hcop : q.Coprime (orderOf z) := by
      have hm' : orderOf z = p ^ m := by simpa only [orderOf_submonoid] using hm
      rw [hm']
      exact ((hq.coprime_iff_not_dvd).mpr
        (fun h => hqp ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hp).mp h))).pow_right m
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_pow_eq_self_of_coprime (x := z) hcop
    refine ⟨z ^ i, ?_⟩
    change (z ^ i) ^ q = z
    rw [pow_right_comm]
    exact hi

name: KummerTheory.primaryComponent_pow_surjective_of_infinite
statement:
theorem primaryComponent_pow_surjective_of_infinite
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Infinite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p)]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Function.Surjective (fun z : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p => z ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases hn1 : n = 1
    · subst n
      intro z
      exact ⟨z, pow_one z⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqn⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd (by omega : n ≠ 1)
    have hdivpos : 0 < n / q := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hn hqn) hq.pos
    have hdivlt : n / q < n := Nat.div_lt_self hn hq.one_lt
    intro z
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ih (n / q) hdivlt hdivpos z
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := primaryComponent_prime_pow_surjective_of_infinite p q hq y
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    change x ^ n = z
    rw [← Nat.mul_div_cancel' hqn, pow_mul]
    exact (congrArg (fun a => a ^ (n / q)) hx).trans hy

name: KummerTheory.finite_primaryComponent_of_no_infinitely_divisible_units
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_of_no_infinitely_divisible_units
    (hK : ∀ z : Kˣ, (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ y : Kˣ, y ^ n = z) → z = 1)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hfinite
  have : Infinite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p) := not_finite_iff_infinite.mp hfinite
  have hsub : Subsingleton (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p) := by
    apply subsingleton_of_forall_eq 1
    intro z
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (z : Kˣ) = 1
    apply hK
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := primaryComponent_pow_surjective_of_infinite p n hn z
    exact ⟨y.1, congrArg Subtype.val hy⟩
  have : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p) := inferInstance
  exact not_finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ p)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_apply
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)]
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
    (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K) :
    separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu a σ =
      separableDiscreteNthRootsContinuousMulEquivMultiplicativeZMod K n hmu
        (separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu a
          (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K σ))
proof: := rfl

name: KummerTheory.exists_last_primePower_primitiveRoot
statement:
theorem exists_last_primePower_primitiveRoot {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ζ : K | ∃ n : ℕ, ζ ^ (p ^ n) = 1}) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) K).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) K).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      ¬ (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 1)) K).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let levels : Set ℕ := {m : ℕ | (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) K).Nonempty}
  have hlevels : levels.Finite := by
    apply ((hfinite.image (orderOf : K → ℕ)).preimage
      (Nat.pow_right_injective hp.two_le).injOn).subset
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hm
    have hprim : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ m) := isPrimitiveRoot_of_mem_primitiveRoots hζ
    exact ⟨ζ, ⟨m, hprim.pow_eq_one⟩, hprim.eq_orderOf.symm⟩
  have hzero : 0 ∈ levels := by
    change (primitiveRoots (p ^ 0) K).Nonempty
    rw [pow_zero, IsPrimitiveRoot.primitiveRoots_one]
    exact Finset.singleton_nonempty (1 : K)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hmax⟩ := Set.exists_max_image levels (fun m : ℕ => m)
    hlevels ⟨0, hzero⟩
  refine ⟨s, hs, hmax, ?_⟩
  intro hnext
  exact Nat.not_succ_le_self s (hmax (s + 1) hnext)

name: KummerTheory.exists_last_primePowerRoot_nontrivial_class
statement:
theorem exists_last_primePowerRoot_nontrivial_class {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : K | ∃ n : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ n) = 1})
    {ζ : Kˣ} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) K).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) K).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      ¬ (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 1)) K).Nonempty ∧
      (ζ : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hmax, hnext⟩ := exists_last_primePower_primitiveRoot hp hfinite
  have hone : (primitiveRoots (p ^ 1) K).Nonempty := by
    rw [pow_one]
    exact ⟨(ζ : K), (mem_primitiveRoots hp.pos).mpr
      (IsPrimitiveRoot.coe_units_iff.mpr hζ)⟩
  exact ⟨s, hmax 1 hone, hs, hmax, hnext,
    primitiveRoot_primePowerClass_ne_one hp s hζ hnext⟩

name: KummerTheory.exists_bounded_coprime_power_action_on_roots
statement:
theorem exists_bounded_coprime_power_action_on_roots
    (K : Type*) [Field K] (n : ℕ+)
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty) (τ : K ≃+* K) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, a < (n : ℕ) ∧ a.Coprime (n : ℕ) ∧
      ∀ ζ : K, ζ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ζ = ζ ^ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμmem⟩ := hmu
  have hμ : IsPrimitiveRoot μ (n : ℕ) := isPrimitiveRoot_of_mem_primitiveRoots hμmem
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hcop, haction⟩ := hμ.isPrimitiveRoot_iff.mp
    (hμ.map_of_injective τ.injective)
  refine ⟨a, ha, hcop, ?_⟩
  intro ζ hζ
  obtain ⟨i, _hi, rfl⟩ := hμ.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hζ
  rw [map_pow, ← haction, pow_right_comm]

name: KummerTheory.absoluteCharacter_conjugation_invariant_of_relativeH1Action_eq_one
statement:
theorem absoluteCharacter_conjugation_invariant_of_relativeH1Action_eq_one
    (τ : Gal(L/K)) (hτ : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := n) K L τ = 1)
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) :
    f (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ) = f σ
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := n) K L τ⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [map_inv, hτ, inv_one]
  let c : ContinuousH1ZMod (p := n) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L) :=
    h1OfCharacter f
  have hvalue := congrArg
    (fun b : Multiplicative
      (AddAut (ContinuousH1ZMod (p := n) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))) =>
      b.toAdd c (Additive.ofMul (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))) hinv
  rw [relativeGaloisH1Action_apply] at hvalue
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  change (f (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ)).toAdd = (f σ).toAdd at hvalue
  exact hvalue

name: KummerTheory.semilinearCharacter_invariant_of_relativeH1Action_eq_one
statement:
theorem semilinearCharacter_invariant_of_relativeH1Action_eq_one
    (τ : Gal(L/K)) (hτ : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := n) K L τ = 1)
    (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (ha : ∀ l : L, a (algebraMap L Ω l) = algebraMap L Ω (τ l))
    (ψ : Gal(Ω/L) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n)) (σ : Gal(Ω/L)) :
    ψ (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv a ha σ) = ψ σ
proof:
:= by
  let e : Gal(Ω/L) ≃ₜ* Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) := absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv L Ω
  let f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n) :=
    ⟨ψ.toMonoidHom.comp e.symm.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom,
      ψ.continuous.comp e.symm.continuous⟩
  have hvalue := absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv_character_conjugation τ.toRingEquiv a ha f σ
  have hinvariant :=
    absoluteCharacter_conjugation_invariant_of_relativeH1Action_eq_one τ hτ f (e σ)
  have heq := hvalue.trans hinvariant
  change ψ (e.symm (e (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv a ha σ))) =
    ψ (e.symm (e σ)) at heq
  simpa only [ContinuousMulEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using heq

name: KummerTheory.galoisClosureTransport_continuous
statement:
theorem galoisClosureTransport_continuous (e : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω') :
    Continuous (AlgEquiv.autCongr e)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_one (AlgEquiv.autCongr e)
  rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEU⟩ := (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff K Ω' U).mp hU
  let F : IntermediateField K Ω := E.map e.symm.toAlgHom
  have hF : FiniteDimensional K F :=
    LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (IntermediateField.equivMap E e.symm.toAlgHom).toLinearEquiv
  apply (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff K Ω ((AlgEquiv.autCongr e) ⁻¹' U)).mpr
  refine ⟨F, hF, ?_⟩
  intro σ hσ
  apply hEU
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff E (AlgEquiv.autCongr e σ)).mpr
  intro x hx
  have hxF : e.symm x ∈ F := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hfix : σ (e.symm x) = e.symm x :=
    (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff F σ).mp hσ (e.symm x) hxF
  change e (σ (e.symm x)) = x
  rw [hfix, e.apply_symm_apply]

statement:

name: KummerTheory.galoisClosureTransport_symm
statement:
theorem galoisClosureTransport_symm (e : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω') :

proof:
:= by

    AlgEquiv.symm_symm]

name: KummerTheory.separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv_conjugation
statement:
theorem separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv_conjugation
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (ha : ∀ k : K, a (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (x : _root_.TopologicalAbelianization Gal(Ω/K)) :
    separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv K Ω
        (TopologicalAbelianization.congr (semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv τ a ha) x) =
      absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ
        (separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv K Ω x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk Gal(Ω/K) x
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv_apply]
  change TopologicalAbelianization.congr (separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureEquiv K Ω)
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(Ω/K) (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ a ha σ)) = _
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk]
  change _ = absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ
    (TopologicalAbelianization.congr (separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureEquiv K Ω)
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(Ω/K) σ))
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk, absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_apply_mk]
  let e := IsSepClosure.equiv K Ω (SeparableClosure K)
  let r := ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K
  let f : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) →*
      _root_.TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) :=
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)).comp r.symm.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
  change f (AlgEquiv.autCongr e (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ a ha σ)) =
    TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
      (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ (r.symm (AlgEquiv.autCongr e σ)))
  rw [autCongr_semilinearGaloisConjugate]
  rw [map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq f τ (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv τ)
    (transportSemilinearEquiv e a) (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap τ)
    (transportSemilinearEquiv_algebraMap τ e a ha)]
  apply congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
  apply r.injective
  change r (r.symm (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv τ)
    (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap τ) (AlgEquiv.autCongr e σ))) = _
  rw [ContinuousMulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change _ = ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv K
    (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ (r.symm (AlgEquiv.autCongr e σ)))
  rw [separableClosureAutEquiv_absoluteGaloisConjugate]
  exact congrArg (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv τ)
    (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap τ)) (r.apply_symm_apply _).symm

name: KummerTheory.finiteDimensionalOfCyclicGaloisExponent
statement:
private theorem finiteDimensionalOfCyclicGaloisExponent
    [IsGalois K L] [IsCyclic Gal(L/K)]
    (n : ℕ+) (hexponent : ∀ σ : Gal(L/K), σ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1) :
    FiniteDimensional K L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (inferInstance : IsCyclic Gal(L/K))
  have hσ_finite : IsOfFinOrder σ :=
    isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.2 ⟨(n : ℕ), n.pos, hexponent σ⟩
  let : Fintype (Subgroup.zpowers σ) :=
    Fintype.ofEquiv (Fin (orderOf σ)) (finEquivZPowers hσ_finite)
  let : Finite Gal(L/K) := Finite.of_surjective
    (fun x : Subgroup.zpowers σ => (x : Gal(L/K))) (by
      intro τ
      exact ⟨⟨τ, hσ τ⟩, rfl⟩)
  exact IsGalois.finiteDimensional_of_finite K L

name: KummerTheory.finrankDvdOfCyclicGaloisExponent
statement:
private theorem finrankDvdOfCyclicGaloisExponent
    [IsGalois K L] [IsCyclic Gal(L/K)]
    (n : ℕ+) (hexponent : ∀ σ : Gal(L/K), σ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1) :
    Module.finrank K L ∣ (n : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    finiteDimensionalOfCyclicGaloisExponent n hexponent
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (inferInstance : IsCyclic Gal(L/K))
  have horder : orderOf σ = Nat.card Gal(L/K) :=
    orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers hσ
  have horder_dvd : orderOf σ ∣ (n : ℕ) :=
    orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one (hexponent σ)
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = Module.finrank K L := by
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank]
  rw [horder, hcard] at horder_dvd
  exact horder_dvd

name: KummerTheory.exists_single_radical_generator_of_cyclic_galois_exponent
statement:
theorem exists_single_radical_generator_of_cyclic_galois_exponent
    [IsGalois K L] [IsCyclic Gal(L/K)]
    (n : ℕ+) (hμ : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (hexponent : ∀ σ : Gal(L/K), σ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1) :
    ∃ α : L, α ≠ 0 ∧
      α ^ (n : ℕ) ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L) ∧ K⟮α⟯ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    finiteDimensionalOfCyclicGaloisExponent n hexponent
  let d := Module.finrank K L
  have hd_pos : 0 < d := Module.finrank_pos
  have hd_dvd_n : d ∣ (n : ℕ) :=
    finrankDvdOfCyclicGaloisExponent (K := K) (L := L) n hexponent
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hμ
  have hζ_primitive : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (n : ℕ) :=
    (mem_primitiveRoots n.pos).1 hζ
  have hn_factor : (n : ℕ) = ((n : ℕ) / d) * d :=
    (Nat.div_mul_cancel hd_dvd_n).symm
  have hζd : IsPrimitiveRoot (ζ ^ ((n : ℕ) / d)) d :=
    hζ_primitive.pow n.pos hn_factor
  have hμd : (primitiveRoots d K).Nonempty :=
    ⟨ζ ^ ((n : ℕ) / d), (mem_primitiveRoots hd_pos).2 hζd⟩
  obtain ⟨α, hαd, hαgen⟩ :=
    exists_root_adjoin_eq_top_of_isCyclic K L hμd
  by_cases hαzero : α = 0
  · refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, ⟨1, by rw [map_one, one_pow]⟩, ?_⟩
    have hbot : (⊥ : IntermediateField K L) = ⊤ := by
      simpa [hαzero] using hαgen
    simpa using hbot
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hαd
  have hn_factor' : (n : ℕ) = d * ((n : ℕ) / d) := by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm]
    exact hn_factor
  refine ⟨α, hαzero, ⟨a ^ ((n : ℕ) / d), ?_⟩, hαgen⟩
  symm
  calc
    α ^ (n : ℕ) = α ^ (d * ((n : ℕ) / d)) :=
      congrArg (fun m : ℕ => α ^ m) hn_factor'
    _ = (α ^ d) ^ ((n : ℕ) / d) := pow_mul α d ((n : ℕ) / d)
    _ = (algebraMap K L a) ^ ((n : ℕ) / d) := by rw [← ha]
    _ = algebraMap K L (a ^ ((n : ℕ) / d)) := by rw [map_pow]

statement:
theorem separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap (τ : K ≃+* K) (x : K) :

      algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) (τ x)
proof:
:= by

      algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (τ x)

name: KummerTheory.separableClosureAutEquiv_absoluteGaloisConjugate
statement:
theorem separableClosureAutEquiv_absoluteGaloisConjugate
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv K
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
      semilinearGaloisConjugate τ (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv τ)
        (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap τ)
        (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv K σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv_apply,
    absoluteGaloisConjugate_apply, semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply,
    separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_apply_coe,
    ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv_apply,
    separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_symm_apply_coe]

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk (σ : L.fixingSubgroup) :
    fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv L
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk L.fixingSubgroup σ) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)
        (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv L Ω (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L σ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv, ContinuousMulEquiv.trans_apply,
    TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk]
  exact TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk
    (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv L Ω) (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L σ)

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_quotient_conjugation
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_quotient_conjugation
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (x : _root_.TopologicalAbelianization L.fixingSubgroup) :
    fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv L
        (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap L.fixingSubgroup
          (QuotientGroup.mk' L.fixingSubgroup σ) x) =
      absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction (σ.restrictNormal L).toRingEquiv
        (fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv L x)
proof:
:= by
  change absoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv L Ω
      (TopologicalAbelianization.congr (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L)
        (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap L.fixingSubgroup
          (QuotientGroup.mk' L.fixingSubgroup σ) x)) = _
  rw [fixingSubgroupAbelianization_conjugation]
  exact absoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv_conjugation L Ω
    (σ.restrictNormal L).toRingEquiv σ.toRingEquiv
    (galois_restrictNormal_algebraMap L σ)
    (TopologicalAbelianization.congr (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L) x)

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroup_quotient_action_ne_one_of_absolute_action_ne_one
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_quotient_action_ne_one_of_absolute_action_ne_one
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K))
    (hσ : absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction (σ.restrictNormal L).toRingEquiv ≠ 1) :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap L.fixingSubgroup
      (QuotientGroup.mk' L.fixingSubgroup σ) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hσ
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv L).surjective a
  have heq := fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_quotient_conjugation L σ x
  rw [h, MulAut.one_apply] at heq
  exact heq.symm

name: KummerTheory.transportSemilinearEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem transportSemilinearEquiv_apply (e : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω') (a : Ω ≃+* Ω) (x : Ω') :
    transportSemilinearEquiv e a x = e (a (e.symm x))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.transportSemilinearEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem transportSemilinearEquiv_symm_apply (e : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω') (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (x : Ω') :
    (transportSemilinearEquiv e a).symm x = e (a.symm (e.symm x))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.transportSemilinearEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem transportSemilinearEquiv_algebraMap (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (e : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω') (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (ha : ∀ k : K, a (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k)) (k : K) :
    transportSemilinearEquiv e a (algebraMap K Ω' k) = algebraMap K Ω' (τ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [transportSemilinearEquiv_apply, e.symm.commutes, ha, e.commutes]

name: KummerTheory.autCongr_semilinearGaloisConjugate
statement:
theorem autCongr_semilinearGaloisConjugate (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (e : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω') (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (ha : ∀ k : K, a (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    AlgEquiv.autCongr e (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ a ha σ) =
      semilinearGaloisConjugate τ (transportSemilinearEquiv e a)
        (transportSemilinearEquiv_algebraMap τ e a ha) (AlgEquiv.autCongr e σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  change e (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ a ha σ (e.symm x)) =
    semilinearGaloisConjugate τ (transportSemilinearEquiv e a)
      (transportSemilinearEquiv_algebraMap τ e a ha) (AlgEquiv.autCongr e σ) x
  rw [semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply, semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply,
    transportSemilinearEquiv_apply, transportSemilinearEquiv_symm_apply]
  simp only [AlgEquiv.autCongr_apply, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (a : Kˣ) (β : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ)
    (hβ : β ^ (n : ℕ) =
      Units.map (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).toMonoidHom a)
    (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K) :
    ((absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ :
      DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ)) :
        (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) =
      rootQuotient (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) β σ
proof:
:= by
  let D := chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) n
  let δ : D.carrier := unitsEquivAbsoluteRadicalCarrier K n a
  let hbase :=
    nthRootsOfUnityInBase_of_primitiveRoots
      (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) n hmu
  let hfixed := nthRootsOfUnity_fixed (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) n hbase
  have hδ : δ.1 = a := by
    dsimp only [δ, unitsEquivAbsoluteRadicalCarrier, MulEquiv.trans_apply]
    exact MulEquiv.subgroupCongr_apply
      (finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_algebraicClosure_eq_top K n).symm
      (Subgroup.topEquiv.symm a)
  have hclass :
      absolutePowerClassEquivRadicalQuotient K n
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) =
      D.radicalQuotientMk δ := by
    unfold absolutePowerClassEquivRadicalQuotient
    simp only [MulEquiv.trans_apply]
    apply D.radicalQuotientMulEquiv.injective
    rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply, D.radicalQuotientMk_apply]
    erw [QuotientGroup.congr_apply]
    rfl
  change ((infiniteKummerContinuousQuotientCharacter n hbase
      (absolutePowerClassEquivRadicalQuotient K n
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range))).toMonoidHom σ :
      (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) =
    rootQuotient (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) β σ
  rw [hclass, infiniteKummerContinuousQuotientCharacter_toMonoidHom,
    D.quotientKummerCharacterWithoutSection_mk]
  change D.rootCharacter δ hfixed σ =
    rootQuotient (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) β σ
  exact (D.rootCharacter_eq_of_same_pow hfixed δ (hδ ▸ hβ) σ).symm

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_conjugation_invariant_of_power_action
statement:
theorem absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_conjugation_invariant_of_power_action
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (u : Kˣ) (a : ℕ) (ha : a.Coprime (n : ℕ))
    (hu : ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) :
        Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) =
      (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ^ a)
    (hτ : ∀ ζ : K, ζ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ζ = ζ ^ a)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
      absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ
proof:
:= by
  let κ := absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
  let c := κ (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
  let x : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ) :=
    c (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)
  let y : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ) := c σ
  have hy : (y : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := y.property
  have hroots :
      Units.map (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K)
        (AlgebraicClosure K) τ).toMonoidHom (y : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) =
      (y : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) ^ a :=
    absoluteGaloisLift_nthRoot_eq_pow K n hmu τ a hτ y
  have hpowers : (x : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) ^ a =
      (y : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) ^ a := by
    have hnatural :=
      absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_naturality K n hmu τ u σ
    rw [hu, map_pow] at hnatural
    have heval := ContinuousMonoidHom.pow_apply c a
      (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)
    have hevalUnits := congrArg
      (fun z : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ) =>
        (z : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ)) heval
    rw [hevalUnits] at hnatural
    change (x : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) ^ a =
      Units.map (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K)
        (AlgebraicClosure K) τ).toMonoidHom (y : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) at hnatural
    exact hnatural.trans hroots
  have hquotient_a :
      ((x : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) / (y : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ)) ^ a = 1 := by
    rw [div_pow, hpowers, div_self']
  have hquotient_n :
      ((x : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) / (y : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ)) ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := by
    rw [div_pow, x.property, hy, div_self']
  have hquotient : (x : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) / (y : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) = 1 :=
    orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp (Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes ha
      (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hquotient_a)
      (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hquotient_n))
  change x = y
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact div_eq_one.mp hquotient

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_power_witness_of_invariant_absoluteKummerCharacter
statement:
theorem exists_power_witness_of_invariant_absoluteKummerCharacter
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (u : Kˣ) (a : ℕ)
    (hτ : ∀ ζ : K, ζ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ζ = ζ ^ a)
    (hinv : ∀ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K),
      absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
          (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
          (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
        absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
          (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ) :
    ∃ y : Kˣ, Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u / u ^ a = y ^ (n : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range
  let κ := absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
  let c : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K →ₜ*
      DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ) := κ (u : Q)
  have hcharacters : κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) : Q) = c ^ a := by
    apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
    intro ρ
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (absoluteGaloisConjugateEquiv τ).surjective ρ
    rw [absoluteGaloisConjugateEquiv_apply] at hσ
    have hcσ : c (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) = c σ := hinv σ
    have hnatural :
        κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) : Q) (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
          (c σ) ^ a := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_naturality K n hmu τ u σ).trans
        (absoluteGaloisLift_nthRoot_eq_pow K n hmu τ a hτ (c σ))
    calc
      κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) : Q) ρ =
          κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) : Q) (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) :=
        congrArg (κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) : Q)) hσ.symm
      _ = (c σ) ^ a := hnatural
      _ = (c (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)) ^ a :=
        congrArg (fun z : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ) => z ^ a)
          hcσ.symm
      _ = (c ^ a) (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) :=
        (ContinuousMonoidHom.pow_apply c a (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)).symm
      _ = (c ^ a) ρ := congrArg (c ^ a) hσ
  have hclass : ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) : Q) = (u : Q) ^ a := by
    apply κ.injective
    rw [map_pow]
    exact hcharacters
  rw [← QuotientGroup.mk_pow] at hclass
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem.mp hclass
  exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩

name: KummerTheory.exists_moving_primitiveRoot_of_not_all_roots_in_base
statement:
theorem exists_moving_primitiveRoot_of_not_all_roots_in_base
    (m : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (m : ℕ) E).Nonempty)
    (hnot : ¬ ∀ ξ : E, ξ ^ (m : ℕ) = 1 →
      ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap L E)) :
    ∃ (ζ : E) (τ : Gal(E/L)), IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (m : ℕ) ∧ τ ζ ≠ ζ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζmem⟩ := hmu
  have hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (m : ℕ) :=
    isPrimitiveRoot_of_mem_primitiveRoots hζmem
  have hout : ζ ∉ Set.range (algebraMap L E) := by
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    apply hnot
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨i, _hi, hpow⟩ := hζ.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hξ
    refine ⟨z ^ i, ?_⟩
    rw [map_pow, hz, hpow]
  have hnotfixed : ¬ ∀ τ : Gal(E/L), τ ζ = ζ := by
    intro hfixed
    exact hout ((IsGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed ζ).mpr hfixed)
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := not_forall.mp hnotfixed
  exact ⟨ζ, τ, hζ, hτ⟩

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisConjugate_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisConjugate_restrictScalars
    (τK : K ≃+* K) (τL : L ≃+* L) (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (haK : ∀ x : K, a (algebraMap K Ω x) = algebraMap K Ω (τK x))
    (haL : ∀ x : L, a (algebraMap L Ω x) = algebraMap L Ω (τL x))
    (σ : Gal(Ω/L)) :
    (semilinearGaloisConjugate τL a haL σ).restrictScalars K =
      semilinearGaloisConjugate τK a haK (σ.restrictScalars K)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.ext
  intro x
  change a (σ (a.symm x)) = a (σ (a.symm x))
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom_algebraMap
statement:
theorem restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom_algebraMap
    (τ : Gal(E/L)) (x : K) :
    τ (algebraMap K E x) = algebraMap K E
      (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E τ x)

:=
  ((MulSemiringAction.toAlgAut Gal(E/L) F E τ).restrictNormal_commutes K x).symm

name: KummerTheory.semilinear_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom_algebraMap
statement:
theorem semilinear_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom_algebraMap
    (τ : Gal(E/L)) (a : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (ha : ∀ x : E, a (algebraMap E Ω x) = algebraMap E Ω (τ x))
    (x : K) :
    a (algebraMap K Ω x) = algebraMap K Ω
      (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E τ x)
