name: KummerTheory.isLocallyConstant_rootQuotient
statement:
theorem isLocallyConstant_rootQuotient (γ : Ωˣ) :
    IsLocallyConstant (rootQuotient (K := K) γ)
proof:
:= by
  exact (GaloisCohomology.isLocallyConstant_galois_units (K := K) γ).comp
    (fun z : Ωˣ => z / γ)

name: KummerTheory.exists_mulCocycle_root_of_isLocallyConstant
statement:
theorem exists_mulCocycle_root_of_isLocallyConstant
    (c : Gal(Ω/K) → Ωˣ) (hc : IsMulCocycle₁ c)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant c) (m : ℕ) [NeZero (m : Ω)] :
    ∃ d : Gal(Ω/K) → Ωˣ, IsMulCocycle₁ d ∧ IsLocallyConstant d ∧
      ∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K), d σ ^ m = c σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := noetherHilbert90_of_isLocallyConstant c hc hlc
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := IsSepClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (β : Ω) m
  have hm : m ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact (NeZero.ne (m : Ω)) (by rw [h, Nat.cast_zero])
  have hγ0 : γ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_pow hm] at hγ
    exact Units.ne_zero β hγ.symm
  let u : Ωˣ := Units.mk0 γ hγ0
  have hu : u ^ m = β := Units.ext hγ
  refine ⟨rootQuotient (K := K) u, isMulCocycle₁_rootQuotient u,
    isLocallyConstant_rootQuotient u, ?_⟩
  intro σ
  change (σ • u / u) ^ m = c σ
  have hpow : (σ • u) ^ m = σ • (u ^ m) :=
    (map_pow (MulDistribMulAction.toMonoidHom Ωˣ σ) u m).symm
  rw [div_pow, hpow, hu]
  exact hβ σ

name: KummerTheory.exists_mulCocycle_rootsOfUnity_lift
statement:
theorem exists_mulCocycle_rootsOfUnity_lift
    (c : Gal(Ω/K) → Ωˣ) (hc : IsMulCocycle₁ c)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant c) (n m : ℕ) [NeZero (m : Ω)]
    (hcn : ∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K), c σ ^ n = 1) :
    ∃ d : Gal(Ω/K) → Ωˣ, IsMulCocycle₁ d ∧ IsLocallyConstant d ∧
      (∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K), d σ ^ (n * m) = 1) ∧
      ∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K), d σ ^ m = c σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hlcd, hpow⟩ :=
    exists_mulCocycle_root_of_isLocallyConstant c hc hlc m
  refine ⟨d, hd, hlcd, ?_, hpow⟩
  intro σ
  rw [Nat.mul_comm n m, pow_mul, hpow, hcn]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.invariant_moved_character_of_coprime
statement:
private theorem invariant_moved_character_of_coprime
    {G Γ A : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G] [Monoid Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ]
    [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    (ρ : G →* MulAut (Γ →ₜ* A)) (a : MulAut (Γ →ₜ* A)) (C D : Γ →ₜ* A)
    (hcomm : ∀ g : G, Commute a (ρ g)) (hdiff : a C / C = D)
    (hD : ∀ g : G, ρ g D = D) (hDne : D ≠ 1)
    (hcop : (Nat.card A).Coprime (Fintype.card G)) :
    ∃ T : Γ →ₜ* A, (∀ g : G, ρ g T = T) ∧ a T ≠ T
proof:
:= by
  let T : Γ →ₜ* A := finiteOrbitProduct ρ C
  have htrace : a T / T = D ^ Fintype.card G :=
    finiteOrbitProduct_map_div ρ a C D hcomm hdiff hD
  have hpowinj : Function.Injective (fun x : A => x ^ Fintype.card G) :=
    hcop.pow_left_bijective.injective
  refine ⟨T, finiteOrbitProduct_invariant ρ C, ?_⟩
  intro hfixed
  have hpow : D ^ Fintype.card G = 1 := by
    rw [← htrace, hfixed, div_self']
  apply hDne
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  change D σ = 1
  have heval := DFunLike.congr_fun hpow σ
  simp only [ContinuousMonoidHom.pow_apply, ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply] at heval
  exact hpowinj (heval.trans (one_pow (Fintype.card G)).symm)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_invariant_moved_cyclotomicKummerTrace
statement:
theorem exists_invariant_moved_cyclotomicKummerTrace
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} F L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    (s : ℕ) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 1)) E).Nonempty)
    (hdown : ∀ ξ : E, ξ ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) = 1 → ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap L E))
    (τ : E ≃ₐ[L] E) (α ζ : Eˣ)
    (hα : Units.map τ.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom α = ζ * α)
    (hζroot : (ζ : E) ^ p = 1)
    (hζclass : (ζ : Eˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ (s + 1)) : Eˣ →* Eˣ).range) ≠ 1) :
    ∃ T : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1))),
      (∀ δ : E ≃ₐ[K] E,
        absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := E)
          (A := Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))) δ.toRingEquiv T = T) ∧
      absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := E)
        (A := Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))) τ.toRingEquiv T ≠ T
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} K E
  let n : ℕ+ := ⟨p ^ (s + 1), pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos (s + 1)⟩
  let A := Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))
  let κ : (Eˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Eˣ →* Eˣ).range) ≃*
      (Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* A) := absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv E n hmu
  let C : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* A := κ α
  let D : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* A := κ ζ
  let act : RingAut E →* MulAut (Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* A) :=
    absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := E) (A := A)
  let ρ : (E ≃ₐ[K] E) →* MulAut (Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* A) :=
    act.comp (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv (E ≃ₐ[K] E) E)
  have hfix : ∀ ξ : E, ξ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ.toRingEquiv ξ = ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hdown ξ hξ
    exact τ.commutes x
  have hexact : act τ.toRingEquiv C / C = D ∧ D ≠ 1 :=
    absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_action_div_ne_one_of_eigenunit
      E n hmu τ.toRingEquiv hfix α ζ hα hζclass
  obtain ⟨hdiff, hDne⟩ := hexact
  have hζnth : (ζ : E) ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := by
    change (ζ : E) ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) = 1
    rw [pow_succ', pow_mul, hζroot, one_pow]
  have hD (δ : E ≃ₐ[K] E) : ρ δ D = D := by
    change act δ.toRingEquiv D = D
    exact absoluteContinuousCharacterAction_kummer_root E n hmu ζ hζnth δ.toRingEquiv
  have hcomm (δ : E ≃ₐ[K] E) : Commute (act τ.toRingEquiv) (ρ δ) := by
    change Commute (act τ.toRingEquiv) (act δ.toRingEquiv)
    exact (ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.cyclotomic_compositum_aut_commute
      F K L E p τ δ).map act
  have hcardp : p.Coprime (Fintype.card (E ≃ₐ[K] E)) := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
      ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard K E p
  have hcop : (Fintype.card (E ≃ₐ[K] E)).Coprime (n : ℕ) :=
    hcardp.symm.pow_right (s + 1)
  have hcopA : (Nat.card A).Coprime (Fintype.card (E ≃ₐ[K] E)) := by
    simpa only [A, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_multiplicative, ZMod.card]
      using hcop.symm
  exact invariant_moved_character_of_coprime
    ρ (act τ.toRingEquiv) C D hcomm hdiff hD hDne hcopA

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionResidualAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
theorem normalRestrictionResidualAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk
    (hC : FiniteGroupClass.Hereditary C) (x : N) :
    normalRestrictionResidualAbelianizationEquiv (K := K) (M := M) hC
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk (N ⧸ proCResidualCore C N)
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore C N) x)) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk (G ⧸ proCResidualCore C G)
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore C G)
          (normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv (K := K) M AC x))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionResidualAbelianizationEquiv_conjugation
statement:
theorem normalRestrictionResidualAbelianizationEquiv_conjugation
    (hC : FiniteGroupClass.FullFormation C) (g : Gal(AC/K))
    (a : TopologicalAbelianization (N ⧸ proCResidualCore C N)) :
    normalRestrictionResidualAbelianizationEquiv (K := K) (M := M) hC.hereditary
        (TopologicalAbelianization.congr
          (residualQuotientConjugationContinuousMulEquiv hC N
            ((N).isClosed_of_isOpen
              (normalRestrictionKernel_isOpen (K := K) (M := M) (Ω := AC))) g) a) =
      absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction hC.hereditary
        (g.restrictNormal M).toRingEquiv
        (normalRestrictionResidualAbelianizationEquiv (K := K) (M := M) hC.hereditary a)
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' a ?_
  intro q
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' q ?_
  intro x
  let j : G →* TopologicalAbelianization (G ⧸ proCResidualCore C G) :=
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk (G ⧸ proCResidualCore C G)).comp
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore C G))
  exact (congrArg j (normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv_conjNormal
      (K := K) M AC g x)).trans
    (absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction_apply_mk_of_lift (K := M) hC.hereditary
      (g.restrictNormal M).toRingEquiv g.toRingEquiv (normalRestriction_algebraMap M AC g)
      (normalRestrictionKernelContinuousEquiv (K := K) M AC x)).symm

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_action_of_fixes_roots
statement:
theorem absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_action_of_fixes_roots
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (hτ : ∀ ξ : K, ξ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ξ = ξ) (u : Kˣ) :
    absoluteContinuousCharacterAction
        (K := K) (A := DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ)) τ
        (absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
          (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)) =
      absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : ∀ ξ : K, ξ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ.symm ξ = ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    apply τ.injective
    rw [τ.apply_symm_apply, hτ ξ hξ]
  have hunit : Units.map τ.symm.toMonoidHom (Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u) = u := by
    apply Units.ext
    exact τ.symm_apply_apply (u : K)
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  change absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
      (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm σ) =
    absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) :
        Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ
  have hnatural := absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_fixes_roots
    K n hmu τ.symm hinv (Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u) σ
  rw [hunit] at hnatural
  exact hnatural

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_action_of_fixes_roots
statement:
theorem absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_action_of_fixes_roots
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (hτ : ∀ ξ : K, ξ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ξ = ξ) (u : Kˣ) :
    absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := K) (A := Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) τ
        (absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
          (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) :
          Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) =
      absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
proof:
:= by
  let e : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ) ≃ₜ*
      Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)) :=
    discreteNthRootsContinuousMulEquivMultiplicativeZMod K n hmu
  have hroot := absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_action_of_fixes_roots
    K n hmu τ hτ u
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  have hvalue := DFunLike.congr_fun hroot σ
  change absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
      (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm σ) =
    absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) :
        Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ at hvalue
  change e (absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
      (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm σ)) =
    e (absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u : Kˣ) :
        Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ)
  exact congrArg e hvalue

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_action_div_ne_one_of_eigenunit
statement:
theorem absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_action_div_ne_one_of_eigenunit
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (hτ : ∀ ξ : K, ξ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ξ = ξ)
    (α ζ : Kˣ) (hα : Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α = ζ * α)
    (hζ : (ζ : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ≠ 1) :
    let κ : (Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ≃*
        (Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)))
proof:
:=
      absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
    absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := K) (A := Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) τ
        (κ (α : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)) /
      κ (α : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) =
        κ (ζ : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ∧
      κ (ζ : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ≠ 1 := by
  intro κ
  have haction :
      absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := K) (A := Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) τ
          (κ (α : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)) =
        κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) :=
    absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_action_of_fixes_roots K n hmu τ hτ α
  constructor
  · rw [haction, hα, QuotientGroup.mk_mul, κ.map_mul, mul_div_cancel_right]
  · intro h
    apply hζ
    apply κ.injective
    simpa only [_root_.map_one] using h

name: KummerTheory.completion_abelianModPowerMap_injective
statement:
theorem completion_abelianModPowerMap_injective
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (D : DVF.{u, v} K) (q : ℕ)
    [Fact q.Prime] [NeZero (q : K)] :
    Function.Injective (abelianModPowerMap q
      (map (algebraMap K D.valuation.Completion)))
proof:
:= by
  let family : Fin 1 → DVF.{u,v} K := fun _ => D
  have hfamily : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (family i).valuation.IsEquiv (family j).valuation) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact False.elim (hij (Subsingleton.elim i j))
  let H : Fin 1 → Type u := fun _ =>
    Gal(AlgebraicClosure D.valuation.Completion/D.valuation.Completion)
  have (i : Fin 1) : CompactSpace (H i) :=
    (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv
      D.valuation.Completion).symm.toHomeomorph.compactSpace
  have hchar := surjective_completion_characters_of_ne_char family hfamily q
  have hi := injective_prod_abelianModPowerMap_of_character_surjective (q := q) H
    (fun _ => map (algebraMap K D.valuation.Completion)) hchar
  intro x y hxy
  have heq : (∏ i : Fin 1, abelianModPowerMap q
      (map (algebraMap K D.valuation.Completion)) ((fun _ => x) i)) =
      ∏ i : Fin 1, abelianModPowerMap q
        (map (algebraMap K D.valuation.Completion)) ((fun _ => y) i) := by
    simpa only [Fin.prod_univ_one] using hxy
  exact congrFun (hi heq) 0

name: KummerTheory.continuousCharacterIsOpenKer
statement:
private theorem continuousCharacterIsOpenKer (χ : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* A) :
    IsOpen (χ.toMonoidHom.ker : Set Gal(Ω/K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.coe_ker]
  exact (isOpen_discrete ({1} : Set A)).preimage χ.continuous

name: KummerTheory.continuousCharacterExistsFiniteGaloisFixingSubgroupLeKer
statement:
private theorem continuousCharacterExistsFiniteGaloisFixingSubgroupLeKer
    (χ : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* A) :
    ∃ E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ω,
      E.fixingSubgroup ≤ χ.toMonoidHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  have hnhds : (χ.toMonoidHom.ker : Set Gal(Ω/K)) ∈ 𝓝 1 :=
    (continuousCharacterIsOpenKer χ).mem_nhds χ.toMonoidHom.ker.one_mem
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ :=
    (InfiniteGalois.krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff_of_isGalois
      (k := K) (K := Ω) (χ.toMonoidHom.ker : Set Gal(Ω/K))).1 hnhds
  exact ⟨E, hE⟩

name: KummerTheory.continuousCharacter_factors_through_finiteGalois
statement:
theorem continuousCharacter_factors_through_finiteGalois
    (χ : Gal(Ω/K) →ₜ* A) :
    ∃ (E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ω) (χE : Gal(E/K) →* A),
      χE.comp (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E) = χ.toMonoidHom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ :=
    continuousCharacterExistsFiniteGaloisFixingSubgroupLeKer χ
  have hker : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E).ker ≤ χ.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    rw [IntermediateField.restrictNormalHom_ker]
    exact hE
  let χE : Gal(E/K) →* A :=
    (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E).liftOfSurjective
      (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective Ω) ⟨χ.toMonoidHom, hker⟩
  refine ⟨E, χE, ?_⟩
  simp [χE]

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionKernel_isOpen
statement:
theorem normalRestrictionKernel_isOpen [FiniteDimensional K M] [Normal K M] :
    IsOpen (((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K)).ker :
      Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) : Set Gal(Ω/K))
proof:
:= by
  let i : M →ₐ[K] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K M Ω
  let S : IntermediateField K Ω := i.fieldRange
  have : FiniteDimensional K S :=
    LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional i.equivFieldRange.toLinearEquiv
  have hker : (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K)).ker =
      S.fixingSubgroup := by
    ext σ
    change σ.restrictNormal M = 1 ↔ σ ∈ S.fixingSubgroup
    constructor
    · intro hσ
      apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff S σ).mpr
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hx
      change σ (algebraMap M Ω m) = algebraMap M Ω m
      rw [← σ.restrictNormal_commutes M m, hσ]
      rfl
    · intro hσ
      apply AlgEquiv.ext
      intro m
      apply (algebraMap M Ω).injective
      change algebraMap M Ω (σ.restrictNormal M m) = algebraMap M Ω m
      rw [σ.restrictNormal_commutes M m]
      exact (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff S σ).mp hσ
        (algebraMap M Ω m) ⟨m, rfl⟩
  rw [hker]
  exact S.fixingSubgroup_isOpen

name: KummerTheory.normalRestrictionKernel_index
statement:
theorem normalRestrictionKernel_index [FiniteDimensional K M] [IsGalois K M]
    [Normal K Ω] :
    (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K)).ker.index =
      Module.finrank K M
proof:
:= by
  let q : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K) := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective q := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective Ω
  exact q.ker.index_eq_card.trans
    ((Nat.card_congr (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective q hsurj).toEquiv).trans
      (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K M))

name: KummerTheory.absoluteCharacterAverage_map
statement:
theorem absoluteCharacterAverage_map (n : ℕ)
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (τ : Gal(E/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)) :
    absoluteCharacterAverage (K := K) n χ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map τ.toRingHom σ) =
      absoluteCharacterAverage (K := K) n χ σ
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  change (Fintype.card Gal(E/K) : ZMod n)⁻¹ * _ =
    (Fintype.card Gal(E/K) : ZMod n)⁻¹ * _
  congr 1
  calc
    ∑ δ : Gal(E/K), (χ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map δ.toRingHom
        (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map τ.toRingHom σ))).toAdd =
      ∑ δ : Gal(E/K), (χ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (τ * δ).toRingHom σ)).toAdd := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro δ _
        apply congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd
        exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
          (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.character_map_comp δ.toRingHom τ.toRingHom χ) σ).symm
    _ = ∑ δ : Gal(E/K), (χ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map δ.toRingHom σ)).toAdd :=
      Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.mulLeft τ)
        (fun δ : Gal(E/K) => (χ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map δ.toRingHom σ)).toAdd)

name: KummerTheory.absoluteCharacterAverage_conjugate
statement:
theorem absoluteCharacterAverage_conjugate (n : ℕ)
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (τ : Gal(E/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)) :
    absoluteCharacterAverage (K := K) n χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ) =
      absoluteCharacterAverage (K := K) n χ σ
proof:
:=
  (character_map_symm_eq_absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv
    (absoluteCharacterAverage (K := K) n χ) σ).symm.trans
      (absoluteCharacterAverage_map n χ τ.symm σ)

name: KummerTheory.absoluteCharacterAverage_eq_of_forall
statement:
theorem absoluteCharacterAverage_eq_of_forall (n : ℕ)
    (hn : (Fintype.card Gal(E/K)).Coprime n)
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)) (a : Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (ha : ∀ δ : Gal(E/K), χ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map δ.toRingHom σ) = a) :
    absoluteCharacterAverage (K := K) n χ σ = a
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  change (Fintype.card Gal(E/K) : ZMod n)⁻¹ *
    ∑ δ : Gal(E/K), (χ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map δ.toRingHom σ)).toAdd = a.toAdd
  simp only [ha, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ZMod.inv_mul_of_unit _ ((ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime _ _).mpr hn), one_mul]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.separableKummer_naturality
statement:
private theorem separableKummer_naturality
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)]
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (a : Kˣ) (σ : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) :
    ((separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (semilinearGaloisConjugate τ (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv τ)
          (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap τ) σ) :
      DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (SeparableClosure K) (n : ℕ)) :
        (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) =
      Units.map (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv τ).toMonoidHom
        ((separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
            (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ :
          DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (SeparableClosure K) (n : ℕ)) :
            (SeparableClosure K)ˣ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β : (SeparableClosure K)ˣ,
      β ^ (n : ℕ) = Units.map (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).toMonoidHom a := by
    apply (mem_finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_iff
      (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) n).mp
    rw [finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_separableClosure_eq_top K n]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top a
  let e : SeparableClosure K ≃+* SeparableClosure K := separableClosureEquivOfEquiv τ
  have hβτ : (Units.map e.toMonoidHom β) ^ (n : ℕ) =
      Units.map (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).toMonoidHom
        (Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a) := by
    rw [← map_pow, hβ]
    apply Units.ext
    exact separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap τ (a : K)
  rw [separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq
    K n hmu (Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a) (Units.map e.toMonoidHom β) hβτ,
    separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq K n hmu a β hβ]
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [rootQuotient, AlgEquiv.smul_units_def, Units.val_div_eq_div_val, Units.coe_map]
  change semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e
      (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap τ) σ (e (β : SeparableClosure K)) /
        e (β : SeparableClosure K) =
      e (σ (β : SeparableClosure K) / (β : SeparableClosure K))
  rw [semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_div₀]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_pow_roots
statement:
theorem separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_pow_roots
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)]
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (m : ℕ)
    (hτ : ∀ ξ : K, ξ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ξ = ξ ^ m)
    (a : Kˣ) (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K) :
    separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
      separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ ^ m
proof:
:= by
  refine (separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_apply K n hmu
    (((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a : Kˣ) :
      Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range))
    (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)).trans ?_
  rw [separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_apply K n hmu
    (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ, ← map_pow]
  apply congrArg (separableDiscreteNthRootsContinuousMulEquivMultiplicativeZMod K n hmu)
  change Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) at σ
  change separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a : Kˣ) :
        Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
      (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv K
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)) =
    separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
      (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv K σ) ^ m
  rw [separableClosureAutEquiv_absoluteGaloisConjugate]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [separableKummer_naturality K n hmu τ a]
  let u : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (SeparableClosure K) (n : ℕ) :=
    separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
      (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutEquiv K σ)
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := nthRootsOfUnityInBase_of_primitiveRoots
    (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K) n hmu (u : (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) u.property
  have hζpow : ζ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := by
    apply Units.map_injective (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).injective
    rw [map_pow, map_one, hζ]
    exact u.property
  change Units.map (separableClosureEquivOfEquiv τ).toMonoidHom
    (u : (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) = (u : (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) ^ m
  rw [← hζ]
  apply Units.ext
  change separableClosureEquivOfEquiv τ
      (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) (ζ : K)) =
    (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K) (ζ : K)) ^ m
  rw [separableClosureEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap,
    hτ (ζ : K) (congrArg Units.val hζpow), map_pow]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_fixes_roots
statement:
theorem separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_fixes_roots
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)]
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (hτ : ∀ ξ : K, ξ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ξ = ξ)
    (a : Kˣ) (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K) :
    separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
      separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_one] using
    separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_pow_roots
      K n hmu τ 1 (fun ξ hξ => (hτ ξ hξ).trans (pow_one ξ).symm) a σ

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_conjugation_invariant_of_root
statement:
theorem absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_conjugation_invariant_of_root
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (u : Kˣ) (hu : (u : K) ^ (n : ℕ) = 1) (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
      absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, _ha, hcop, hroots⟩ := exists_bounded_coprime_power_action_on_roots K n hmu τ
  have hunit : Units.map τ.toMonoidHom u = u ^ a := by
    apply Units.ext
    exact hroots (u : K) hu
  apply absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_conjugation_invariant_of_power_action
    K n hmu τ u a hcop ?_ hroots σ
  rw [hunit]
  exact map_pow (QuotientGroup.mk' (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) u a

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteContinuousCharacterAction_kummer_root
statement:
theorem absoluteContinuousCharacterAction_kummer_root
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (u : Kˣ) (hu : (u : K) ^ (n : ℕ) = 1) (τ : K ≃+* K) :
    absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := K) (A := Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) τ
        (absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
          (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)) =
      absoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  change discreteNthRootsContinuousMulEquivMultiplicativeZMod K n hmu
      (absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm σ)) =
    discreteNthRootsContinuousMulEquivMultiplicativeZMod K n hmu
      (absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ)
  exact congrArg (discreteNthRootsContinuousMulEquivMultiplicativeZMod K n hmu)
    (absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_conjugation_invariant_of_root
      K n hmu u hu τ.symm σ)

name: KummerTheory.quadratic_aut_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem quadratic_aut_fixed_iff
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (hdim : Module.finrank K L = 2) (τ : Gal(L/K)) (hτ : τ ≠ 1) (z : L) :
    τ z = z ↔ ∃ x : K, algebraMap K L x = z
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (by rw [hdim]; decide)
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = 2 := (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdim
  obtain ⟨υ, _, hυ⟩ := (Nat.card_eq_two_iff' (1 : Gal(L/K))).mp hcard
  constructor
  · intro hz
    apply (IsGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed (F := K) z).mpr
    intro σ
    by_cases hσ : σ = 1
    · rw [hσ]
      rfl
    · have heq : σ = τ := (hυ σ hσ).trans (hυ τ hτ).symm
      rw [heq]
      exact hz
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact τ.commutes x

name: KummerTheory.quadratic_aut_apply_twice
statement:
theorem quadratic_aut_apply_twice
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (hdim : Module.finrank K L = 2) (τ : Gal(L/K)) (z : L) :
    τ (τ z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (by rw [hdim]; decide)
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = 2 := (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdim
  have hpow : τ ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← hcard]; exact pow_card_eq_one'
  have heval := congrArg (fun σ : Gal(L/K) => σ z) hpow
  exact heval

name: KummerTheory.exists_quadratic_antiInvariant
statement:
theorem exists_quadratic_antiInvariant
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [CharZero K] (hdim : Module.finrank K L = 2) (τ : Gal(L/K)) (hτ : τ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ a : K, ∃ α : L, α ≠ 0 ∧ α ^ 2 = algebraMap K L a ∧
      τ α = -α ∧ ¬ IsSquare a
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K L).injective
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : L, τ x ≠ x := by
    by_contra hn
    apply hτ
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    exact not_not.mp (fun hx => hn ⟨x, hx⟩)
  let α : L := x - τ x
  have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := fun hz => hx (sub_eq_zero.mp hz).symm
  have hanti : τ α = -α := by
    dsimp only [α]
    rw [map_sub, quadratic_aut_apply_twice hdim]
    ring
  have hsqfix : τ (α ^ 2) = α ^ 2 := by
    rw [map_pow, hanti, neg_sq]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (quadratic_aut_fixed_iff hdim τ hτ (α ^ 2)).mp hsqfix
  refine ⟨a, α, hα0, ha.symm, hanti, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
  have heq : α ^ 2 = (algebraMap K L b) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← ha, hb, map_mul, pow_two]
  have hfixed : τ α = α := by
    rcases eq_or_eq_neg_of_sq_eq_sq α (algebraMap K L b) heq with hp | hn
    · rw [hp, τ.commutes]
    · rw [hn, map_neg, τ.commutes]
  have hneg : α = -α := hfixed.symm.trans hanti
  have hzero : (2 : L) * α = 0 := by linear_combination hneg
  exact hα0 ((mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left (by norm_num))

name: KummerTheory.isSquare_algebraMap_iff_of_quadratic
statement:
theorem isSquare_algebraMap_iff_of_quadratic
    {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (hdim : Module.finrank K L = 2) (τ : Gal(L/K)) (hτ : τ ≠ 1)
    (a : K) (α : L) (hα0 : α ≠ 0)
    (hαsq : α ^ 2 = algebraMap K L a) (hanti : τ α = -α) (c : K) :
    IsSquare (algebraMap K L c) ↔ IsSquare c ∨ IsSquare (c / a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨β, hβ⟩
    have hβsq : algebraMap K L c = β ^ 2 := by rw [hβ, pow_two]
    have hβτ : (τ β) ^ 2 = β ^ 2 := by
      rw [← map_pow, ← hβsq, τ.commutes]
    rcases eq_or_eq_neg_of_sq_eq_sq (τ β) β hβτ with hfixed | hneg
    · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (quadratic_aut_fixed_iff hdim τ hτ β).mp hfixed
      left
      refine ⟨b, (algebraMap K L).injective ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, hb]
      exact hβ
    · have hdivfixed : τ (β / α) = β / α := by
        rw [map_div₀, hneg, hanti, neg_div_neg_eq]
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (quadratic_aut_fixed_iff hdim τ hτ (β / α)).mp hdivfixed
      right
      refine ⟨b, (algebraMap K L).injective ?_⟩
      rw [map_div₀, hβsq, ← hαsq, map_mul, hb, ← div_pow, pow_two]
  · intro hc
    rcases hc with hc | hca
    · exact hc.map (algebraMap K L)
    · have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        rw [hz, map_zero] at hαsq
        exact (pow_ne_zero 2 hα0) hαsq
      have hsq : IsSquare (algebraMap K L a) := ⟨α, by rw [← hαsq, pow_two]⟩
      have hprod := hsq.mul (hca.map (algebraMap K L))
      rw [← map_mul, mul_div_cancel₀ c ha0] at hprod
      exact hprod

name: KummerTheory.exists_primitive_eigenunit_of_prime_degree
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_eigenunit_of_prime_degree
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    (hμ : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty)
    (σ : Gal(L/K)) (hσ : σ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ α : Lˣ, ∃ ζ : Lˣ,
      IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p ∧ Units.map σ.toMonoidHom α = ζ * α
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = p :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdeg
  let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let : IsCyclic Gal(L/K) := isCyclic_of_prime_card hcard
  have hexponent : ∀ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ^ p = 1 := by
    intro τ
    rw [← hcard]
    exact pow_card_eq_one'
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hapow, hagen⟩ :=
    exists_single_radical_generator_of_cyclic_galois_exponent
      (K := K) (L := L) ⟨p, hp.pos⟩ hμ hexponent
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hapow
  change algebraMap K L b = a ^ p at hb
  have hfixpow : σ (a ^ p) = a ^ p := by
    rw [← hb]
    exact σ.commutes b
  have hquotpow : (σ a / a) ^ p = 1 := by
    rw [div_pow, ← map_pow, hfixpow, div_self (pow_ne_zero p ha)]
  have hquotne : σ a / a ≠ 1 := by
    intro hquot
    have hfixa : σ a = a := (div_eq_one_iff_eq ha).1 hquot
    apply hσ
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ K⟮a⟯ := by
      rw [hagen]
      exact IntermediateField.mem_top
    change σ x = x
    refine IntermediateField.adjoin_induction K
      (p := fun y _hy => σ y = y) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro y hy
      have hya : y = a := Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hy
      rw [hya]
      exact hfixa
    · intro y
      exact σ.commutes y
    · intro y z hy hz hfy hfz
      rw [map_add, hfy, hfz]
    · intro y hy hfy
      rw [map_inv₀, hfy]
    · intro y z hy hz hfy hfz
      rw [map_mul, hfy, hfz]
  have hprim : IsPrimitiveRoot (σ a / a) p :=
    isPrimitiveRoot_of_mem_nthRootsFinset hp
      ((Polynomial.mem_nthRootsFinset hp.pos (1 : L)).2 hquotpow) hquotne
  let α : Lˣ := Units.mk0 a ha
  let ζ : Lˣ := Units.map σ.toMonoidHom α / α
  refine ⟨α, ζ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply IsPrimitiveRoot.coe_units_iff.1
    simp only [ζ, α, Units.val_div_eq_div_val, Units.coe_map, Units.val_mk0]
    exact hprim
  · exact (div_mul_cancel (Units.map σ.toMonoidHom α) α).symm

name: KummerTheory.character_map_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem character_map_algebraMap_eq
    {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A]
    (e : AlgebraicClosure K ≃ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure E)
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)) :
    χ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (algebraMap K E) σ) =
      χ ((galoisClosureTransport e).symm (σ.restrictScalars K))
proof:
:= by
  apply Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.character_map_apply_of_lift
    (algebraMap K E) e.toRingHom
  · intro x
    exact (e.commutes x).trans (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K E (AlgebraicClosure E) x)
  · intro x
    change e (e.symm (σ (e x))) = σ (e x)
    exact e.apply_symm_apply _

name: KummerTheory.finiteExtensionGaloisOpenSubgroup_index
statement:
theorem finiteExtensionGaloisOpenSubgroup_index
    (K E Ω : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K E] [Algebra E Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsScalarTower K E Ω]
    [FiniteDimensional K E] [IsGalois K E] [IsAlgClosure E Ω] :
    (GaloisCohomology.finiteExtensionGaloisOpenSubgroup K E Ω).toSubgroup.index =
      Module.finrank K E
proof:
:= by
  have : Normal K Ω := (IsAlgClosure.ofAlgebraic K E Ω).normal
  change (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom K : Gal(Ω/E) →* Gal(Ω/K)).range.index = _
  rw [restrictScalarsHom_range_eq_normalRestrictionKer K E Ω, Subgroup.index_ker,
    MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr
      (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective (F := K) (K₁ := E) (E := Ω))]
  exact (Nat.card_congr (Subgroup.topEquiv :
    (⊤ : Subgroup Gal(E/K)) ≃* Gal(E/K)).toEquiv).trans
      (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K E)

name: KummerTheory.absoluteCharacterRestriction_injective_of_coprime_finrank
statement:
theorem absoluteCharacterRestriction_injective_of_coprime_finrank
    [FiniteDimensional K E] [IsGalois K E]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (Module.finrank K E).Coprime n) :
    Function.Injective (fun χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n) =>
      (χ.comp (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (algebraMap K E)) :
        Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n)))
proof:
:= by
  have : IsAlgClosure K (AlgebraicClosure E) := IsAlgClosure.ofAlgebraic K E _
  let e := IsAlgClosure.equiv K (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure E)
  let c := galoisClosureTransport e
  let c' : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/K) →ₜ* Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) :=
    ⟨c.symm.toMonoidHom, c.symm.continuous⟩
  let H := GaloisCohomology.finiteExtensionGaloisOpenSubgroup K E (AlgebraicClosure E)
  let d := GaloisCohomology.finiteExtensionGaloisOpenSubgroupEquiv K E (AlgebraicClosure E)
  have : H.toSubgroup.Normal := by
    change (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom K :
      Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →* Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/K)).range.Normal
    rw [restrictScalarsHom_range_eq_normalRestrictionKer K E (AlgebraicClosure E)]
    infer_instance
  have hindex : H.toSubgroup.index.Coprime n := by
    rw [finiteExtensionGaloisOpenSubgroup_index K E (AlgebraicClosure E)]
    exact hn
  intro φ ψ hres
  have h : (φ.comp c').toMonoidHom =
      (ψ.comp c').toMonoidHom := by
    apply ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.cyclicCharacterRestriction_injective_of_index_coprime
      H.toSubgroup n hindex
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro h
    obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := d.surjective h
    change φ (c.symm (σ.restrictScalars K)) = ψ (c.symm (σ.restrictScalars K))
    exact (character_map_algebraMap_eq e φ σ).symm.trans
      ((DFunLike.congr_fun hres σ).trans (character_map_algebraMap_eq e ψ σ))
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  have heq := DFunLike.congr_fun h (c σ)
  change φ (c.symm (c σ)) = ψ (c.symm (c σ)) at heq
  simpa only [c.symm_apply_apply] using heq

name: KummerTheory.exists_absoluteCharacter_extension_of_coprime_finrank
statement:
theorem exists_absoluteCharacter_extension_of_coprime_finrank
    [FiniteDimensional K E] [IsGalois K E]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (Module.finrank K E).Coprime n)
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (hinv : ∀ (δ : Gal(E/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)),
      χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv σ) = χ σ) :
    ∃ ψ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n),
      (ψ.comp (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (algebraMap K E)) :
        Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n)) = χ
proof:
:= by
  have : IsAlgClosure K (AlgebraicClosure E) := IsAlgClosure.ofAlgebraic K E _
  let e := IsAlgClosure.equiv K (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure E)
  let c := galoisClosureTransport e
  let H := GaloisCohomology.finiteExtensionGaloisOpenSubgroup K E (AlgebraicClosure E)
  let d := GaloisCohomology.finiteExtensionGaloisOpenSubgroupEquiv K E (AlgebraicClosure E)
  have : H.toSubgroup.Normal := by
    change (AlgEquiv.restrictScalarsHom K :
      Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →* Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/K)).range.Normal
    rw [restrictScalarsHom_range_eq_normalRestrictionKer K E (AlgebraicClosure E)]
    infer_instance
  have hindex : H.toSubgroup.index = Module.finrank K E :=
    finiteExtensionGaloisOpenSubgroup_index K E (AlgebraicClosure E)
  have : H.toSubgroup.FiniteIndex := ⟨by
    rw [hindex]
    exact (Module.finrank_pos (R := K) (M := E)).ne'⟩
  let φ : H →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n) :=
    χ.comp ⟨d.symm.toMonoidHom, d.symm.continuous⟩
  have hφ : ∀ (g : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/K)) (h : H),
      φ (MulAut.conjNormal g h) = φ h := by
    intro g h
    let δ : Gal(E/K) := g.restrictNormal E
    have hg (x : E) : g (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x) =
        algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) (δ x) :=
      (g.restrictNormal_commutes E x).symm
    let σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) := d.symm h
    have hσ : σ.restrictScalars K = (h : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/K)) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (d.apply_symm_apply h)
    have hconj : d.symm (MulAut.conjNormal g h) =
        semilinearGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv g.toRingEquiv hg σ := by
      apply AlgEquiv.restrictScalars_injective K
      calc
        (d.symm (MulAut.conjNormal g h)).restrictScalars K =
            (MulAut.conjNormal g h : H) :=
          congrArg Subtype.val (d.apply_symm_apply (MulAut.conjNormal g h))
        _ = g * σ.restrictScalars K * g⁻¹ := by
          rw [hσ]
          rfl
        _ = (semilinearGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv g.toRingEquiv hg σ).restrictScalars K := by
          apply AlgEquiv.ext
          intro x
          rfl
    change χ (d.symm (MulAut.conjNormal g h)) = χ σ
    rw [hconj]
    exact (map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq χ.toMonoidHom δ.toRingEquiv
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure E) (AlgebraicClosure E) δ.toRingEquiv)
      g.toRingEquiv
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure E)
        (AlgebraicClosure E) δ.toRingEquiv) hg σ).trans (hinv δ σ)
  let ψΩ := ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.primeToIndexCharacterExtension H n φ
  let ψ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n) :=
    ψΩ.comp ⟨c.toMonoidHom, c.continuous⟩
  refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  change ψ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (algebraMap K E) σ) = χ σ
  calc
    ψ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (algebraMap K E) σ) =
        ψ (c.symm (σ.restrictScalars K)) := character_map_algebraMap_eq e ψ σ
    _ = ψΩ (σ.restrictScalars K) := congrArg ψΩ (c.apply_symm_apply _)
    _ = φ (d σ) :=
      ClassFieldTower.Cohomology.primeToIndexCharacterExtension_subtype H n
        (hindex.symm ▸ hn) φ hφ (d σ)
    _ = χ σ := congrArg χ (d.symm_apply_apply σ)

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_apply
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_apply (τ : RingAut K)
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →* A) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform τ f σ =
      f (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm σ)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_one
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_one (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →* A) :
    absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform 1 f = f
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  rw [absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_apply, RingAut.one_eq_refl, RingEquiv.symm_refl]
  unfold absoluteGaloisConjugate
  rw [map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq f (RingEquiv.refl K)
    (RingEquiv.refl (AlgebraicClosure K))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) (RingEquiv.refl K))
    (semilinear_refl_algebraMap (K := K) (Ω := AlgebraicClosure K))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (RingEquiv.refl K)), semilinearGaloisConjugate_refl]

name: KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_mul
statement:
theorem absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_mul (τ υ : RingAut K)
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →* A) :
    absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform (τ * υ) f =
      absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform τ (absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform υ f)
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  rw [absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_apply, absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_apply,
    absoluteGaloisCharacterTransform_apply]
  have hbase : (τ * υ).symm = τ.symm.trans υ.symm := by rfl
  rw [hbase]
  unfold absoluteGaloisConjugate
  rw [map_semilinearGaloisConjugate_eq f (τ.symm.trans υ.symm)
    ((IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ.symm).trans
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) υ.symm))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (τ.symm.trans υ.symm))
    (semilinear_trans_algebraMap τ.symm υ.symm
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ.symm)
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) υ.symm)
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ.symm)
      (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) υ.symm))
    (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (τ.symm.trans υ.symm)), semilinearGaloisConjugate_trans]

name: KummerTheory.character_map_symm_eq_absoluteGaloisConjugate
statement:
theorem character_map_symm_eq_absoluteGaloisConjugate
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* A)
    (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    χ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map τ.symm.toRingHom σ) =
      χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)
proof:
:= by
  let e := IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ
  have he (x : K) : e (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) x) =
      algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (τ x) :=
    IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ x
  apply Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.character_map_apply_of_lift
    τ.symm.toRingHom e.symm.toRingHom ?_ σ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) ?_ χ
  · intro x
    apply e.injective
    exact (e.apply_symm_apply _).trans
      ((he (τ.symm x)).trans
        (congrArg (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)) (τ.apply_symm_apply x))).symm
  · intro x
    change e.symm (e (σ (e.symm x))) = σ (e.symm x)
    exact e.symm_apply_apply _

name: KummerTheory.infinite_primaryComponent_of_primitive_roots
statement:
theorem infinite_primaryComponent_of_primitive_roots
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [∀ i : ℕ, HasEnoughRootsOfUnity Ω (p ^ i)] :
    Infinite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Ωˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose ζ hζ using fun n => HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.exists_primitiveRoot Ω (p ^ n)
  let z (n : ℕ) : Ωˣ := (hζ n).isUnit (NeZero.ne (p ^ n)) |>.unit'
  have hz (n : ℕ) : IsPrimitiveRoot (z n) (p ^ n) :=
    (hζ n).isUnit_unit' (NeZero.ne (p ^ n))
  let f : ℕ → CommGroup.primaryComponent Ωˣ p :=
    fun n => ⟨z n, n, (hz n).pow_eq_one⟩
  apply Infinite.of_injective f
  intro a b hab
  apply Nat.pow_right_injective (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt
  have he : z a = z b := congrArg Subtype.val hab
  exact (IsPrimitiveRoot.iff_orderOf.mp (hz a)).symm.trans
    ((congrArg orderOf he).trans (IsPrimitiveRoot.iff_orderOf.mp (hz b)))

name: KummerTheory.primaryUnit_mem_fixedField_cyclotomic_ker
statement:
theorem primaryUnit_mem_fixedField_cyclotomic_ker
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [∀ i : ℕ, HasEnoughRootsOfUnity Ω (p ^ i)]
    (z : CommGroup.primaryComponent Ωˣ p) :
    (z.val : Ω) ∈ IntermediateField.fixedField
      ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p).comp (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut Gal(Ω/K) Ω)).ker
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := z.property
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.exists_primitiveRoot Ω (p ^ n)
  let η : Ωˣ := hζ.isUnit (NeZero.ne (p ^ n)) |>.unit'
  have hη : IsPrimitiveRoot η (p ^ n) := hζ.isUnit_unit' (NeZero.ne _)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := primitiveRootCoordinate_surjective_roots hη z.val hn
  rw [IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff]
  intro σ hσ
  have hχ : cyclotomicCharacter Ω p σ.toRingEquiv = 1 := hσ
  have he := primitiveRootCoordinate_cyclotomic p n hη σ.toRingEquiv a
  rw [hχ, Units.val_one, map_one, one_mul, ha] at he
  exact congrArg Units.val he

name: KummerTheory.infinite_range_cyclotomicCharacter_of_finite_primary
statement:
theorem infinite_range_cyclotomicCharacter_of_finite_primary
    [IsGalois K Ω]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [∀ i : ℕ, HasEnoughRootsOfUnity Ω (p ^ i)]
    (hRoots : ∀ E : IntermediateField K Ω, FiniteDimensional K E →
      Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p)) :
    Set.Infinite (Set.range
      ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p).comp (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut Gal(Ω/K) Ω)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let χ : Gal(Ω/K) →* (PadicInt p)ˣ :=
    (cyclotomicCharacter Ω p).comp (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut Gal(Ω/K) Ω)
  intro hfin
  have : Finite (Set.range χ) := hfin.to_subtype
  have hcont : Continuous (fun σ : Gal(Ω/K) => (⟨χ σ, σ, rfl⟩ : Set.range χ)) :=
    (cyclotomicCharacter.continuous p K Ω).subtype_mk _
  let oneχ : Set.range χ := ⟨1, 1, map_one χ⟩
  have hopen : IsOpen (χ.ker : Set Gal(Ω/K)) := by
    have ho := (isOpen_discrete ({oneχ} : Set (Set.range χ))).preimage hcont
    convert ho using 1
    ext σ
    exact ⟨fun h => Subtype.ext h, fun h => congrArg Subtype.val h⟩
  let E : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField χ.ker
  have hfix : E.fixingSubgroup = χ.ker :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField
      ⟨χ.ker, (show IsClosed (χ.ker : Set Gal(Ω/K)) from
        isClosed_eq (cyclotomicCharacter.continuous p K Ω) continuous_const)⟩
  have hE : FiniteDimensional K E := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite E).mp (by
    rw [hfix]
    exact hopen)
  have : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p) := hRoots E hE
  let f : CommGroup.primaryComponent Ωˣ p → CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p := fun z =>
    ⟨Units.mk0 ⟨(z.val : Ω), primaryUnit_mem_fixedField_cyclotomic_ker p z⟩
      (fun h => Units.ne_zero z.val (congrArg Subtype.val h)), by
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := z.property
      refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      apply Units.ext
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg Units.val hn⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Units.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p => ((z.val : E) : Ω)) h
  have : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Ωˣ p) := Finite.of_injective f hf
  have : Infinite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Ωˣ p) :=
    infinite_primaryComponent_of_primitive_roots p
  exact not_finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Ωˣ p)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_algebraicClosure_eq_top
statement:
theorem finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_algebraicClosure_eq_top (n : ℕ+) :
    finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) n = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro a _
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq
    (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (a : K)) n.pos
  have hβ_ne : β ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hmap_zero : algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (a : K) = 0 := by
      rw [← hβ, hzero, zero_pow n.ne_zero]
    exact a.ne_zero ((algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).injective
      (hmap_zero.trans (map_zero (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K))).symm))
  refine ⟨Units.mk0 β hβ_ne, ?_⟩
  apply Units.ext
  exact hβ

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.map_powerRange_unitsEquivAbsoluteRadicalCarrier
statement:
private theorem map_powerRange_unitsEquivAbsoluteRadicalCarrier (n : ℕ+) :
    (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range.map
        (unitsEquivAbsoluteRadicalCarrier K n).toMonoidHom =
      (AbsoluteRadicalDatum K n).ambientNthPowersSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨b, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (AbsoluteRadicalDatum K n).mem_ambientNthPowersSubgroup_iff.mpr
      ⟨b, rfl⟩
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
      (AbsoluteRadicalDatum K n).mem_ambientNthPowersSubgroup_iff.mp ha
    let x : Kˣ := a.1
    have hx : x = b ^ (n : ℕ) := hb.symm
    refine ⟨x, ⟨b, hx.symm⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv_continuous
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv_continuous (τ : K ≃+* K) (e : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k)) :
    Continuous (semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv τ e he)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_tendsto_nhds_one (semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv τ e he)
  rw [Filter.tendsto_def]
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEU⟩ := (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff K Ω U).mp hU
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin (Module.finrank K E)) K E := Module.finBasis K E
  let S : Set Ω := Set.range (fun i : Fin (Module.finrank K E) => e.symm (b i : Ω))
  let F : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.adjoin K S
  have hF : FiniteDimensional K F :=
    IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin
      (fun (x : Ω) (_hx : x ∈ S) => (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x).isIntegral)
  apply (krullTopology_mem_nhds_one_iff K Ω
    ((semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv τ e he) ⁻¹' U)).mpr
  refine ⟨F, hF, ?_⟩
  intro σ hσ
  apply hEU
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff E
    (semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv τ e he σ)).mpr
  have hb : ((semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv τ e he σ).toAlgHom.comp E.val).toLinearMap =
      E.val.toLinearMap := by
    apply b.ext
    intro i
    change semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv τ e he σ (b i : Ω) = (b i : Ω)
    rw [semilinearGaloisConjugateEquiv_apply, semilinearGaloisConjugate_apply]
    have hfix : σ (e.symm (b i : Ω)) = e.symm (b i : Ω) :=
      (IntermediateField.mem_fixingSubgroup_iff F σ).mp hσ (e.symm (b i : Ω))
        (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K S ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    rw [hfix, e.apply_symm_apply]
  intro x hx
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hb (⟨x, hx⟩ : E)

name: KummerTheory.semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv_apply (τ : K ≃+* K) (e : Ω ≃+* Ω)
    (he : ∀ k : K, e (algebraMap K Ω k) = algebraMap K Ω (τ k))
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    semilinearGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv τ e he σ =
      semilinearGaloisConjugate τ e he σ
proof:
:= by
