name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.surjective_characters_of_powerClasses
statement:
theorem surjective_characters_of_powerClasses
    (f : ∀ i, K →+* L i) (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)]
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (hclasses : Function.Surjective (fun (u : Kˣ) (i : ι) =>
      (Units.map (f i).toMonoidHom u :
        (L i)ˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : (L i)ˣ →* (L i)ˣ).range))) :
    Function.Surjective (fun χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)) =>
      fun i => (χ.comp (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (f i)) :
        Gal(AlgebraicClosure (L i)/L i) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have (i : ι) : NeZero ((n : ℕ) : L i) :=
    NeZero.nat_of_injective (f := f i) (f i).injective
  have hmuL (i : ι) : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) (L i)).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hmu
    exact ⟨f i ζ, (mem_primitiveRoots n.pos).mpr
      (((mem_primitiveRoots n.pos).mp hζ).map_of_injective (f i).injective)⟩
  intro χlocal
  let d := separableDiscreteNthRootsContinuousMulEquivMultiplicativeZMod K n hmu
  let e (i : ι) := separableNthRootsFieldMapEquiv (f i) n hmu
  let η (i : ι) : Gal(SeparableClosure (L i)/L i) →ₜ*
      DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (SeparableClosure (L i)) (n : ℕ) :=
    (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom (e i)).comp
      ((ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom d.symm).comp
        ((χlocal i).comp (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom
          (separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv (L i)).symm)))
  let c (i : ι) := (separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv (L i) n (hmuL i)).symm (η i)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hclasses c
  let χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)) :=
    (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom d).comp
      ((separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)).comp
          (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom (separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K)))
  refine ⟨χ, funext (fun i => ?_)⟩
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  change d (separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
    (u : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
    (separableClosureAutEquiv K (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (f i) σ))) = χlocal i σ
  have hlocal :
      separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv (L i) n (hmuL i)
        ((Units.map (f i).toMonoidHom u) :
          (L i)ˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : (L i)ˣ →* (L i)ˣ).range)
        (separableClosureAutEquiv (L i) σ) =
      η i (separableClosureAutEquiv (L i) σ) := by
    exact (congrArg (fun a =>
      separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv (L i) n (hmuL i) a
        (separableClosureAutEquiv (L i) σ)) (congrFun hu i)).trans
      (DFunLike.congr_fun
        ((separableKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv (L i) n (hmuL i)).apply_symm_apply (η i))
        (separableClosureAutEquiv (L i) σ))
  have hinner : η i (separableClosureAutEquiv (L i) σ) =
      e i (d.symm (χlocal i σ)) := by
    exact congrArg (fun τ => e i (d.symm (χlocal i τ)))
      ((separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv (L i)).symm_apply_apply σ)
  have hroots := (separableKummerCharacter_fieldMap_equiv (f i) n hmu (hmuL i) u σ).trans
    (hlocal.trans hinner)
  exact (congrArg d ((e i).injective hroots)).trans (d.apply_symm_apply (χlocal i σ))

name: KummerTheory.exists_cyclotomic_cocycle_lift
statement:
theorem exists_cyclotomic_cocycle_lift
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [NeZero (p : Ω)]
    (k : ℕ) (c : Gal(Ω/K) → ZMod (p ^ 1))
    (hc : ∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K), c (σ * τ) = c σ +
      ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p σ.toRingEquiv : PadicInt p).toZModPow 1) * c τ)
    (hlc : IsLocallyConstant c) :
    ∃ d : Gal(Ω/K) → ZMod (p ^ (k + 1)),
      IsLocallyConstant d ∧
      (∀ σ τ : Gal(Ω/K), d (σ * τ) = d σ +
        ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p σ.toRingEquiv : PadicInt p).toZModPow (k + 1)) * d τ) ∧
      ∀ σ : Gal(Ω/K),
        ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (by omega : 1 ≤ k + 1))
          (ZMod (p ^ 1)) (d σ) = c σ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.exists_primitiveRoot Ω (p ^ (k + 1))
  let z : Ωˣ := hζ.isUnit (NeZero.ne (p ^ (k + 1))) |>.unit'
  have hz : IsPrimitiveRoot z (p ^ (k + 1)) := hζ.isUnit_unit' (NeZero.ne _)
  have hN : p ^ (k + 1) = p ^ 1 * p ^ k := by
    rw [pow_one, pow_succ, mul_comm]
  have hz₁ : IsPrimitiveRoot (z ^ (p ^ k)) (p ^ 1) :=
    hz.pow (Nat.pos_of_neZero _) (hN.trans (Nat.mul_comm _ _))
  let C : Gal(Ω/K) → Ωˣ := fun σ => primitiveRootCoordinate hz₁ (c σ)
  have hC : IsMulCocycle₁ C := by
    intro σ τ
    change primitiveRootCoordinate hz₁ (c (σ * τ)) =
      σ • primitiveRootCoordinate hz₁ (c τ) * primitiveRootCoordinate hz₁ (c σ)
    rw [hc, primitiveRootCoordinate_add]
    have hact := primitiveRootCoordinate_cyclotomic p 1 hz₁ σ.toRingEquiv (c τ)
    change σ • primitiveRootCoordinate hz₁ (c τ) =
      primitiveRootCoordinate hz₁
        ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p σ.toRingEquiv : PadicInt p).toZModPow 1 * c τ) at hact
    rw [hact, mul_comm]
  have hClc : IsLocallyConstant C := hlc.comp (primitiveRootCoordinate hz₁)
  have hCpow (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : C σ ^ (p ^ 1) = 1 :=
    primitiveRootCoordinate_pow_eq_one hz₁ (c σ)
  have : NeZero ((p ^ k : ℕ) : Ω) :=
    ⟨by rw [Nat.cast_pow]; exact pow_ne_zero k (NeZero.ne (p : Ω))⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hDlc, hDpow, hDm⟩ :=
    exists_mulCocycle_rootsOfUnity_lift C hC hClc (p ^ 1) (p ^ k) hCpow
  have hDmem (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) : D σ ^ (p ^ (k + 1)) = 1 := by
    rw [hN]
    exact hDpow σ
  choose d hd using fun σ => primitiveRootCoordinate_surjective_roots hz (D σ) (hDmem σ)
  have hdlc : IsLocallyConstant d := by
    rw [IsLocallyConstant.iff_eventually_eq] at hDlc ⊢
    intro σ
    filter_upwards [hDlc σ] with τ hτ
    apply primitiveRootCoordinate_injective hz
    rw [hd, hd]
    exact hτ
  refine ⟨d, hdlc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro σ τ
    apply primitiveRootCoordinate_injective hz
    rw [primitiveRootCoordinate_add, hd, hd]
    rw [← primitiveRootCoordinate_cyclotomic p (k + 1) hz σ.toRingEquiv (d τ), hd]
    exact (hD σ τ).trans (mul_comm _ _)
  · intro σ
    apply primitiveRootCoordinate_injective hz₁
    have hred := primitiveRootCoordinate_reduction (p ^ (k + 1)) (p ^ 1)
      (p ^ k) hN hz (d σ)
    rw [← hred, hd]
    exact hDm σ

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRoot_primePowerClass_ne_one
statement:
theorem primitiveRoot_primePowerClass_ne_one
    {r : ℕ} (hr : r.Prime) (s : ℕ) {ζ : Kˣ}
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ r)
    (hnext : ¬ (primitiveRoots (r ^ (s + 1)) K).Nonempty) :
    (ζ : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (r ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hclass
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff ζ).mp hclass
  change y ^ (r ^ s) = ζ at hy
  have hy_ne : y ^ (r ^ s) ≠ 1 := by
    rw [hy]
    exact hζ.ne_one hr.one_lt
  have hy_pow : y ^ (r ^ (s + 1)) = 1 := by
    rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, hy]
    exact hζ.pow_eq_one
  let : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hr⟩
  have hy_primitive : IsPrimitiveRoot y (r ^ (s + 1)) :=
    IsPrimitiveRoot.iff_orderOf.mpr (orderOf_eq_prime_pow hy_ne hy_pow)
  exact hnext ⟨(y : K), (mem_primitiveRoots (pow_pos hr.pos (s + 1))).mpr
    (IsPrimitiveRoot.coe_units_iff.mpr hy_primitive)⟩

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_apply_mk (σ : L.fixingSubgroup) :
    fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv L
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk L.fixingSubgroup σ) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)
        (separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureEquiv L Ω (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L σ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv, ContinuousMulEquiv.trans_apply,
    TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk]
  exact TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk
    (separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureEquiv L Ω) (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L σ)

name: KummerTheory.fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_quotient_conjugation
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_quotient_conjugation
    (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) (x : _root_.TopologicalAbelianization L.fixingSubgroup) :
    fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv L
        (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap L.fixingSubgroup
          (QuotientGroup.mk' L.fixingSubgroup σ) x) =
      absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction (σ.restrictNormal L).toRingEquiv
        (fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv L x)
proof:
:= by
  change separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv L Ω
      (TopologicalAbelianization.congr (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L)
        (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap L.fixingSubgroup
          (QuotientGroup.mk' L.fixingSubgroup σ) x)) = _
  rw [fixingSubgroupAbelianization_conjugation]
  exact separableAbsoluteGaloisClosureAbelianizationEquiv_conjugation L Ω
    (σ.restrictNormal L).toRingEquiv σ.toRingEquiv
    (galois_restrictNormal_algebraMap L σ)
    (TopologicalAbelianization.congr (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv L) x)

name: KummerTheory.surjective_completion_characters_of_cyclotomic
statement:
theorem surjective_completion_characters_of_cyclotomic
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {K : Type u} {E : Type w}
    [Field K] [Field E] [Algebra K E]
    (D : ι → DVF.{u, v} K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] [NeZero (q : K)]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {q} K E] :
    Function.Surjective (fun ψ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q) =>
      fun i => (ψ.comp (map (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion)) :
        Gal(AlgebraicClosure (D i).valuation.Completion/(D i).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
          Multiplicative (ZMod q)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {q} K E
  have : IsGalois K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {q} K E
  have hV (i : ι) : ∃ V : DVF.{w,v} E, (D i).valuation.HasExtension V.valuation := by
    obtain ⟨v, hd, he⟩ := (D i).exists_extension_on_valueGroup (L := E)
    exact ⟨{ ValueGroup := (D i).ValueGroup, valuation := v }, he⟩
  choose V hV using hV
  have : ∀ i, (D i).valuation.HasExtension (V i).valuation := hV
  let n : ℕ+ := ⟨q, (Fact.out : q.Prime).pos⟩
  have : NeZero ((n : ℕ) : E) :=
    (show NeZero (q : E) from
      NeZero.nat_of_injective (f := algebraMap K E) (algebraMap K E).injective)
  have hcard : (Nat.card Gal(E/K)).Coprime q :=
    (prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard K E q).symm
  have hdegree : (Module.finrank K E).Coprime q := by
    rw [← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K E]
    exact hcard
  have hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) E).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := IsCyclotomicExtension.exists_isPrimitiveRoot K E
      (Set.mem_singleton q) (NeZero.ne q)
    exact ⟨ζ, (mem_primitiveRoots n.pos).mpr hζ⟩
  intro χ
  obtain ⟨η, hηinv, hηlocal⟩ := exists_invariant_completion_character D hD V n hcard hmu χ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_absoluteCharacter_extension_of_coprime_finrank q hdegree η hηinv
  refine ⟨ψ, funext fun i => ?_⟩
  let : Algebra (D i).valuation.Completion (V i).valuation.Completion :=
    DVF.completionAlgebra (D i) (V i)
  have : IsCyclotomicExtension {q} (D i).valuation.Completion (V i).valuation.Completion :=
    DVF.completion_isCyclotomicExtension (D i) (V i) q
  have : FiniteDimensional (D i).valuation.Completion (V i).valuation.Completion :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {q} (D i).valuation.Completion
      (V i).valuation.Completion
  have : IsGalois (D i).valuation.Completion (V i).valuation.Completion :=
    IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {q} (D i).valuation.Completion (V i).valuation.Completion
  have hlocaldegree :
      (Module.finrank (D i).valuation.Completion (V i).valuation.Completion).Coprime q := by
    rw [← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank (D i).valuation.Completion (V i).valuation.Completion]
    exact (prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard (D i).valuation.Completion
      (V i).valuation.Completion q).symm
  apply absoluteCharacterRestriction_injective_of_coprime_finrank
    (K := (D i).valuation.Completion) (E := (V i).valuation.Completion) q hlocaldegree
  have hsquare : (DVF.completionMap (D i) (V i)).comp
      (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion) =
      (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion).comp (algebraMap K E) := by
    ext x
    exact DVF.completionMap_coe_base (D i) (V i) x
  exact (character_map_comp (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion)
    (DVF.completionMap (D i) (V i)) ψ).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun f => ψ.comp (map f)) hsquare).trans
        ((character_map_comp (algebraMap K E) (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion) ψ).trans
          ((congrArg (fun θ => θ.comp (map (algebraMap E (V i).valuation.Completion))) hψ).trans
            (hηlocal i))))

name: KummerTheory.surjective_completion_characters_of_ne_char
statement:
theorem surjective_completion_characters_of_ne_char
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {K : Type u} [Field K]
    (D : ι → DVF.{u, v} K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] [NeZero (q : K)] :
    Function.Surjective (fun ψ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q) =>
      fun i => (ψ.comp (map (algebraMap K (D i).valuation.Completion)) :
        Gal(AlgebraicClosure (D i).valuation.Completion/(D i).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
          Multiplicative (ZMod q)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := exists_cyclotomic_intermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K) q
  have : IsCyclotomicExtension {q} K E := hE
  exact surjective_completion_characters_of_cyclotomic (E := E) D hD q

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_naturality
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (a : Kˣ) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    ((absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) :
      DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ)) :
        (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) =
      Units.map (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K)
        (AlgebraicClosure K) τ).toMonoidHom
        ((absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
            (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ :
          DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ)) :
            (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ,
      β ^ (n : ℕ) =
        Units.map (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).toMonoidHom a := by
    apply (mem_finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_iff
      (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) n).mp
    rw [finiteKummerRadicalSubgroup_algebraicClosure_eq_top K n]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top a
  let e : AlgebraicClosure K ≃+* AlgebraicClosure K :=
    IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ
  have hβτ : (Units.map e.toMonoidHom β) ^ (n : ℕ) =
      Units.map (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).toMonoidHom
        (Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a) := by
    rw [← map_pow, hβ]
    apply Units.ext
    exact IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap
      (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ (a : K)
  exact (absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq
      K n hmu (Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a) (Units.map e.toMonoidHom β) hβτ
      (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ)).trans
    ((rootQuotient_absoluteGaloisConjugate τ β σ).trans
      (congrArg (Units.map e.toMonoidHom)
        (absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_apply_of_pow_eq
          K n hmu a β hβ σ).symm))

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_fixes_roots
statement:
theorem absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_fixes_roots
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (hτ : ∀ ζ : K, ζ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ζ = ζ)
    (a : Kˣ) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
    absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom a : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
      absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
        (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_naturality K n hmu τ a σ]
  let u : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (n : ℕ) :=
    absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
      (a : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ
  have hu : (u : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := u.property
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := nthRootsOfUnityInBase_of_primitiveRoots
    (K := K) (L := AlgebraicClosure K) n hmu (u : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) hu
  have hζpow : ζ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := by
    apply Units.map_injective (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)).injective
    rw [map_pow, map_one, hζ, hu]
  have hζfield : (ζ : K) ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := congrArg Units.val hζpow
  change Units.map (IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K)
      (AlgebraicClosure K) τ).toMonoidHom (u : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ) =
    (u : (AlgebraicClosure K)ˣ)
  rw [← hζ]
  apply Units.ext
  change IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv (AlgebraicClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K) τ
      (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (ζ : K)) =
    algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (ζ : K)
  rw [IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap, hτ (ζ : K) hζfield]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_moved_absoluteKummerCharacter_of_finite_primePowerRoots
statement:
theorem exists_moved_absoluteKummerCharacter_of_finite_primePowerRoots
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : K | ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (ζ : Kˣ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p)
    (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (hτ : ∀ ξ : K, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) → τ ξ = ξ)
    (α : Kˣ) (hα : Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α = ζ * α) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) K).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) K).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      ∃ χ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K →ₜ*
          DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure K) (p ^ s),
        ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K),
          χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) ≠ χ σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hmu, hmax, _, hζclass⟩ :=
    exists_last_primePowerRoot_nontrivial_class hp hfinite hζ
  let n : ℕ+ := ⟨p ^ s, pow_pos hp.pos s⟩
  let κ := absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv K n hmu
  have hαclass :
      ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α : Kˣ) :
        Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ≠
      (α : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) := by
    intro heq
    apply hζclass
    rw [hα] at heq
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff ζ).mpr
    have hmem := QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem.mp heq
    rw [mul_div_cancel_right] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hcharacters :
      κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α : Kˣ) :
        Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ≠
      κ (α : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) :=
    κ.injective.ne hαclass
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := DFunLike.exists_ne hcharacters
  refine ⟨s, hs, hmu, hmax, κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α : Kˣ) :
    Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range), σ, ?_⟩
  have hnatural :=
    absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_fixes_roots
      K n hmu τ (fun ξ hξ => hτ ξ ⟨s, hξ⟩) α σ
  intro hfixed
  exact hσ (hfixed.symm.trans hnatural)

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRootCoordinate_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  apply hζ.zmodEquivZPowers.injective
  change (hζ.zmodEquivZPowers a).toMul = (hζ.zmodEquivZPowers b).toMul
  exact Subtype.ext h

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRootCoordinate_natCast
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun z : Additive (Subgroup.zpowers ζ) => z.toMul.1)
    (hζ.zmodEquivZPowers_apply_coe_nat a)

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRootCoordinate_eq_pow_val
proof:
:= by
  calc
    primitiveRootCoordinate hζ a = primitiveRootCoordinate hζ (a.val : ZMod n) :=
      congrArg _ (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val a).symm
    _ = ζ ^ a.val := primitiveRootCoordinate_natCast hζ a.val

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRootCoordinate_add
statement:
theorem primitiveRootCoordinate_add {n : ℕ} {ζ : Ωˣ}
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) (a b : ZMod n) :
    primitiveRootCoordinate hζ (a + b) =
      primitiveRootCoordinate hζ a * primitiveRootCoordinate hζ b
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun z : Additive (Subgroup.zpowers ζ) => z.toMul.1)
    (hζ.zmodEquivZPowers.map_add a b)

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRootCoordinate_pow_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Subgroup.zpowers ζ ≤ rootsOfUnity n Ω :=
    Subgroup.zpowers_le_of_mem hζ.pow_eq_one
  exact hle (hζ.zmodEquivZPowers a).toMul.property

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRootCoordinate_surjective_roots
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := hζ.eq_pow_of_mem_rootsOfUnity (mem_rootsOfUnity n z |>.mpr hz)
  exact ⟨a, (primitiveRootCoordinate_natCast hζ a).trans ha⟩

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRootCoordinate_reduction
statement:
theorem primitiveRootCoordinate_reduction
    (N n m : ℕ) [NeZero N] [NeZero n] (hN : N = n * m) {ζ : Ωˣ}
    (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ N) (a : ZMod N) :
    primitiveRootCoordinate hζ a ^ m =
      primitiveRootCoordinate (hζ.pow (Nat.pos_of_neZero N) (hN.trans (Nat.mul_comm n m)))
        (ZMod.castHom (by rw [hN]; exact dvd_mul_right n m) (ZMod n) a)
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : ZMod.castHom (by rw [hN]; exact dvd_mul_right n m) (ZMod n) a =
      (a.val : ZMod n) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val a]
    rw [map_natCast]
  rw [hcast, primitiveRootCoordinate_eq_pow_val, primitiveRootCoordinate_natCast,
    pow_right_comm]

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRootCoordinate_cyclotomic
statement:
theorem primitiveRootCoordinate_cyclotomic
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [∀ i : ℕ, HasEnoughRootsOfUnity Ω (p ^ i)]
    (n : ℕ) {ζ : Ωˣ} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ n))
    (g : Ω ≃+* Ω) (a : ZMod (p ^ n)) :
    Units.map g.toMonoidHom (primitiveRootCoordinate hζ a) =
      primitiveRootCoordinate hζ
        ((cyclotomicCharacter Ω p g : PadicInt p).toZModPow n * a)
proof:
:= by
  let b : ZMod (p ^ n) := (cyclotomicCharacter Ω p g : PadicInt p).toZModPow n
  have hζfield : (ζ : Ω) ^ (p ^ n) = 1 :=
    congrArg (fun x : Ωˣ => (x : Ω)) hζ.pow_eq_one
  have hgζ : Units.map g.toMonoidHom ζ = ζ ^ b.val := by
    apply Units.ext
    exact cyclotomicCharacter.spec p g (ζ : Ω) hζfield
  change Units.map g.toMonoidHom (primitiveRootCoordinate hζ a) =
    primitiveRootCoordinate hζ (b * a)
  rw [primitiveRootCoordinate_eq_pow_val hζ a, map_pow, hgζ, ← pow_mul]
  symm
  calc
    primitiveRootCoordinate hζ (b * a) =
        primitiveRootCoordinate hζ ((b.val * a.val : ℕ) : ZMod (p ^ n)) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    _ = ζ ^ (b.val * a.val) := primitiveRootCoordinate_natCast hζ _

name: KummerTheory.primitiveRoots_intermediate_nonempty
statement:
private theorem primitiveRoots_intermediate_nonempty
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω) :
    (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) E).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hmu
  refine ⟨algebraMap K E ζ, (mem_primitiveRoots n.pos).2 ?_⟩
  exact ((mem_primitiveRoots n.pos).1 hζ).map_of_injective
    (algebraMap K E).injective

name: KummerTheory.intermediateNthRootsEquiv_apply_val
statement:
private theorem intermediateNthRootsEquiv_apply_val
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω) (u : nthRootsSubgroup E (n : ℕ)) :
    ((intermediateNthRootsEquiv n hmu E u : nthRootsSubgroup Ω (n : ℕ)) : Ωˣ) =
      Units.map (algebraMap E Ω).toMonoidHom (u : Eˣ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  exact (val_rootsOfUnityEquivOfPrimitiveRoots_apply_coe
    (algebraMap E Ω).injective (primitiveRoots_intermediate_nonempty n hmu E) u).symm

name: KummerTheory.rootQuotient_map_intermediate
statement:
private theorem rootQuotient_map_intermediate
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω) [Normal K E]
    (β : Eˣ) (σ : Gal(Ω/K)) :
    rootQuotient (K := K) (L := Ω)
        (Units.map (algebraMap E Ω).toMonoidHom β) σ =
      Units.map (algebraMap E Ω).toMonoidHom
        (rootQuotient (K := K) (L := E) β
          (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [rootQuotient, Units.val_div_eq_div_val, Units.coe_map]
  change σ (algebraMap E Ω (β : E)) / algebraMap E Ω (β : E) =
    algebraMap E Ω
      ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ) (β : E) / (β : E))
  rw [map_div₀]
  exact congrArg (fun x : Ω => x / algebraMap E Ω (β : E))
    (AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes σ E (β : E)).symm

name: KummerTheory.finiteRadicalToAmbient_mapped_root_pow
statement:
private theorem finiteRadicalToAmbient_mapped_root_pow
    (n : ℕ+) (E : IntermediateField K Ω)
    (a : (chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum (K := K) (L := E) n).carrier) :
    (Units.map (algebraMap E Ω).toMonoidHom
        ((chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum (K := K) (L := E) n).root a)) ^ (n : ℕ) =
      Units.map (algebraMap K Ω).toMonoidHom
        (finiteRadicalToAmbient n E a).1
proof:
:= by
  let DE := chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum (K := K) (L := E) n
  rw [← map_pow, DE.root_pow_eq_map]
  apply Units.ext
  exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K E Ω (a.1 : K)

name: KummerTheory.infiniteKummerContinuousQuotientCharacter_surjective_of_primitiveRoots
statement:
theorem infiniteKummerContinuousQuotientCharacter_surjective_of_primitiveRoots
    (n : ℕ+) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty) :
    Function.Surjective
      (infiniteKummerContinuousQuotientCharacter n
        (nthRootsOfUnityInBase_of_primitiveRoots (K := K) (L := Ω) n hmu))
proof:
:= by
  let hbaseΩ : NthRootsOfUnityInBase (K := K) (L := Ω) n :=
    nthRootsOfUnityInBase_of_primitiveRoots (K := K) (L := Ω) n hmu
  let DΩ := chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum (K := K) (L := Ω) n
  intro χ
  obtain ⟨E, χEΩ, hfactor⟩ :=
    continuousCharacter_factors_through_finiteGalois χ
  let DE := chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum (K := K) (L := E) n
  let hbaseE : NthRootsOfUnityInBase (K := K) (L := E) n :=
    nthRootsOfUnityInBase_of_primitiveRoots (K := K) (L := E) n hmu
  let hfixedE := nthRootsOfUnity_fixed (K := K) (L := E) n hbaseE
  let eμ : nthRootsSubgroup E (n : ℕ) ≃* nthRootsSubgroup Ω (n : ℕ) :=
    intermediateNthRootsEquiv n hmu E.toIntermediateField
  let χE : Gal(E/K) →* nthRootsSubgroup E (n : ℕ) :=
    eμ.symm.toMonoidHom.comp χEΩ
  obtain ⟨qE, hqE⟩ :=
    finiteKummerQuotientCharacter_surjective (K := K) (L := E) n hbaseE χE
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := DE.radicalQuotientMk_surjective qE
  let aΩ : DΩ.carrier := finiteRadicalToAmbient n E.toIntermediateField a
  refine ⟨DΩ.radicalQuotientMk aΩ, ?_⟩
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro σ
  apply Subtype.ext
  let τ : Gal(E/K) := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom E σ
  have hfinite : DE.rootCharacterToMuWithoutSection a hfixedE = χE := by
    change
      DE.quotientKummerCharacterWithoutSection hfixedE
          (DE.radicalQuotientMk a) = χE at hqE
    rw [DE.quotientKummerCharacterWithoutSection_mk] at hqE
    change DE.kummerCharacterWithoutSection hfixedE a = χE
    exact hqE
  have hfinite_at : DE.rootCharacterToMuWithoutSection a hfixedE τ = χE τ :=
    congrArg (fun ψ : Gal(E/K) →* nthRootsSubgroup E (n : ℕ) => ψ τ) hfinite
  have htransport : eμ (DE.rootCharacterToMuWithoutSection a hfixedE τ) = χEΩ τ := by
    rw [hfinite_at]
    change eμ (eμ.symm (χEΩ τ)) = χEΩ τ
    exact eμ.apply_symm_apply (χEΩ τ)
  have hfactor_at : χEΩ τ = χ σ := by
    exact congrArg
      (fun ψ : Gal(Ω/K) →* DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup Ω (n : ℕ) => ψ σ) hfactor
  change DΩ.rootCharacter aΩ
      (nthRootsOfUnity_fixed (K := K) (L := Ω) n hbaseΩ) σ = (χ σ : Ωˣ)
  rw [← DΩ.rootCharacter_eq_of_same_pow
    (nthRootsOfUnity_fixed (K := K) (L := Ω) n hbaseΩ) aΩ
      (finiteRadicalToAmbient_mapped_root_pow n E.toIntermediateField a) σ]
  rw [rootQuotient_map_intermediate E.toIntermediateField
    ((chosenFiniteKummerRadicalDatum (K := K) (L := E) n).root a) σ]
  change Units.map (algebraMap E.toIntermediateField Ω).toMonoidHom
      ((DE.rootCharacterToMuWithoutSection a hfixedE τ :
        nthRootsSubgroup E (n : ℕ)) : Eˣ) = (χ σ : Ωˣ)
  rw [← intermediateNthRootsEquiv_apply_val n hmu E.toIntermediateField
    (DE.rootCharacterToMuWithoutSection a hfixedE τ)]
  exact congrArg (fun u : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup Ω (n : ℕ) => (u : Ωˣ))
    (htransport.trans hfactor_at)

name: KummerTheory.exists_separableClosureRatAutomorphism_pow_of_unit
statement:
theorem exists_separableClosureRatAutomorphism_pow_of_unit
    (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (u : (ZMod m)ˣ) :
    ∃ σ : SeparableClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] SeparableClosure ℚ,
      ∀ z : SeparableClosure ℚ, z ^ m = 1 →
        σ z = z ^ u.val.val
proof:
:= by
  let n : ℕ+ := ⟨m, NeZero.pos m⟩
  let K : IntermediateField ℚ rationalCyclotomicField :=
    rationalCyclotomicLevel n
  have hK : IsCyclotomicExtension {m} ℚ K :=
    rationalCyclotomicLevel_isCyclotomicExtension n
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ :=
    (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.galEquivZMod m K (hK := hK)).surjective u
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ :=
    (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective
      (F := ℚ) (K₁ := K) (E := SeparableClosure ℚ)) τ
  change σ.restrictNormal K = τ at hσ
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  have hzCyc : z ∈ rationalCyclotomicField := by
    apply IntermediateField.subset_adjoin
    exact ⟨m, Set.mem_univ m, NeZero.ne m, hz⟩
  let zCyc : rationalCyclotomicField := ⟨z, hzCyc⟩
  have hzCyc_pow : zCyc ^ m = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hz
  have hzK : zCyc ∈ K := by
    apply IntermediateField.subset_adjoin
    exact ⟨m, Set.mem_singleton m, NeZero.ne m, hzCyc_pow⟩
  let y : K := ⟨zCyc, hzK⟩
  have hy : y ^ m = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hzCyc_pow
  have haction : τ y = y ^ u.val.val := by
    have h :=
      IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.galEquivZMod_apply_of_pow_eq
        m K (hK := hK) τ hy
    rw [hτ] at h
    exact h
  have hy_map : algebraMap K (SeparableClosure ℚ) y = z := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply
      K rationalCyclotomicField (SeparableClosure ℚ)]
    simp only [IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply, y, zCyc]
  have hcomm :=
    AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes σ K y
  rw [hσ] at hcomm
  calc
    σ z = algebraMap K (SeparableClosure ℚ) (τ y) := by
      rw [hcomm, hy_map]
    _ = algebraMap K (SeparableClosure ℚ) (y ^ u.val.val) :=
      congrArg (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure ℚ)) haction
    _ = z ^ u.val.val := by
      rw [map_pow, hy_map]

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.gl_map_quotient_eq_one_iff
statement:
private theorem gl_map_quotient_eq_one_iff
    {A ι : Type*} [CommRing A] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (I : Ideal A) (x : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι A) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) x = 1 ↔
      ∀ i j : ι, ((x : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) i j ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  let q := RingHom.mapMatrix (m := ι) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
  constructor
  · intro hx i j
    have hx' : q (x : Matrix ι ι A) = 1 := congrArg Units.val hx
    have hzero : q ((x : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_one, hx', sub_self]
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    exact congrFun (congrFun hzero i) j
  · intro hx
    apply Units.ext
    change q (x : Matrix ι ι A) = 1
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    rw [← map_one q, ← map_sub]
    apply Matrix.ext
    intro i j
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hx i j)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.matrix_error_product_eq_zero_mod_succ
statement:
private theorem matrix_error_product_eq_zero_mod_succ
    {A ι : Type*} [CommRing A] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (M N : Matrix ι ι A)
    (hM : ∀ i j, M i j ∈ I ^ r) (hN : ∀ i j, N i j ∈ I ^ r) :
    RingHom.mapMatrix (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (r + 1))) (M * N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
  change ∑ k : ι, M i k * N k j ∈ I ^ (r + 1)
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro k _
  have hprod : M i k * N k j ∈ I ^ r * I ^ r :=
    Ideal.mul_mem_mul (hM i k) (hN k j)
  have hpow : I ^ r * I ^ r ≤ I ^ (r + 1) := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    exact Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.add_le_add_left hr r)
  exact hpow hprod

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.gl_reductions_commute_of_congruent_one
statement:
private theorem gl_reductions_commute_of_congruent_one
    {A ι : Type*} [CommRing A] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (x y : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι A)
    (hx : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ r)) x = 1)
    (hy : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ r)) y = 1) :
    Commute
      (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (r + 1))) x)
      (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (r + 1))) y)
proof:
:= by
  let q := RingHom.mapMatrix (m := ι) (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (r + 1)))
  have hxy :
      (q (x : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) * (q (y : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) = 0 := by
    have hzero : q (((x : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) * ((y : Matrix ι ι A) - 1)) = 0 :=
      matrix_error_product_eq_zero_mod_succ I r hr _ _
        ((gl_map_quotient_eq_one_iff (I ^ r) x).mp hx)
        ((gl_map_quotient_eq_one_iff (I ^ r) y).mp hy)
    simpa only [map_mul, map_sub, map_one] using hzero
  have hyx :
      (q (y : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) * (q (x : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) = 0 := by
    have hzero : q (((y : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) * ((x : Matrix ι ι A) - 1)) = 0 :=
      matrix_error_product_eq_zero_mod_succ I r hr _ _
        ((gl_map_quotient_eq_one_iff (I ^ r) y).mp hy)
        ((gl_map_quotient_eq_one_iff (I ^ r) x).mp hx)
    simpa only [map_mul, map_sub, map_one] using hzero
  have herr : Commute (q (x : Matrix ι ι A) - 1)
      (q (y : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) := hxy.trans hyx.symm
  have hcomm : Commute (q (x : Matrix ι ι A)) (q (y : Matrix ι ι A)) := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using
      (herr.add_right (Commute.one_right _)).add_left (Commute.one_left _)
  apply Units.ext
  exact hcomm

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.continuous_quotient_of_isOpen
statement:
private theorem continuous_quotient_of_isOpen
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : IsOpen (I : Set A)) :
    letI : TopologicalSpace (A ⧸ I)
proof:
:= ⊥
    Continuous (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
  let : TopologicalSpace (A ⧸ I) := ⊥
  have : DiscreteTopology (A ⧸ I) := discreteTopology_bot _
  rw [continuous_discrete_rng]
  intro y
  rcases Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y with ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hpreimage : Ideal.Quotient.mk I ⁻¹' ({y} : Set (A ⧸ I)) =
      (fun z : A => z - x) ⁻¹' (I : Set A) := by
    ext z
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk I z = y ↔ z - x ∈ I
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, hx, sub_eq_zero]
  rw [hpreimage]
  exact hI.preimage (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.representation_eq_one_of_dense_commutator_of_commuting_image
statement:
private theorem representation_eq_one_of_dense_commutator_of_commuting_image
    {G H : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [Group H] [TopologicalSpace H] [T2Space H]
    (hperfect : (commutator G).topologicalClosure = ⊤)
    (ρ : G →ₜ* H) (hcomm : ∀ x y : G, Commute (ρ x) (ρ y)) :
    ∀ g : G, ρ g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcommutator : commutator G ≤ ρ.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    apply Subgroup.commutator_le.mpr
    intro x _ y _
    apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
    rw [map_commutatorElement]
    exact (hcomm x y).commutator_eq
  have hclosed : IsClosed (ρ.toMonoidHom.ker : Set G) :=
    isClosed_eq ρ.continuous_toFun continuous_const
  have htop : (⊤ : Subgroup G) ≤ ρ.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    rw [← hperfect]
    exact (commutator G).topologicalClosure_minimal hcommutator hclosed
  intro g
  exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp (htop (Subgroup.mem_top g))

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.adic_representation_eq_one_of_dense_commutator
statement:
theorem adic_representation_eq_one_of_dense_commutator
    {G A ι : Type*}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsHausdorff I A] (hAdic : IsAdic I)
    (hperfect : (commutator G).topologicalClosure = ⊤)
    (ρ : G →ₜ* Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι A)
    (hmod : ∀ g : G, Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (ρ g) = 1) :
    ∀ g : G, ρ g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpower : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ g : G,
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (r + 1))) (ρ g) = 1 := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
        intro g
        have hI1 : I ^ (0 + 1) = I := by
          simp only [Nat.zero_add, Submodule.pow_one]
        rw [hI1]
        exact hmod g
    | succ r ih =>
        let : TopologicalSpace (A ⧸ I ^ ((r + 1) + 1)) := ⊥
        have : DiscreteTopology (A ⧸ I ^ ((r + 1) + 1)) := discreteTopology_bot _
        have hq : Continuous (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ ((r + 1) + 1))) :=
          continuous_quotient_of_isOpen _ ((isAdic_iff.mp hAdic).1 _)
        let reduction : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι A →ₜ*
            Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup ι (A ⧸ I ^ ((r + 1) + 1)) :=
          { toMonoidHom := Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ ((r + 1) + 1)))
            continuous_toFun := hq.generalLinearGroup_map }
        apply representation_eq_one_of_dense_commutator_of_commuting_image
          hperfect (reduction.comp ρ)
        intro x y
        exact gl_reductions_commute_of_congruent_one I (r + 1)
          (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le r))
          (ρ x) (ρ y) (ih x) (ih y)
  intro g
  apply Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.ext
  intro i j
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply (inferInstance : IsHausdorff I A).haus
  intro r
  apply SModEq.zero.mpr
  have hmem : ((ρ g : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) i j ∈ I ^ r := by
    cases r with
    | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top, Submodule.mem_top]
    | succ r => exact (gl_map_quotient_eq_one_iff (I ^ (r + 1)) (ρ g)).mp (hpower r g) i j
  have hsmul :
      (((ρ g : Matrix ι ι A) - 1) i j) • (1 : A) ∈
        I ^ r • (⊤ : Submodule A A) :=
    Submodule.smul_mem_smul hmem (Submodule.mem_top : (1 : A) ∈ (⊤ : Submodule A A))
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Matrix.sub_apply,
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_one] using hsmul

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.isPerfect_kernel_image_of_openNormalAbelianizationInjective
statement:
theorem isPerfect_kernel_image_of_openNormalAbelianizationInjective
    {G Q S : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
    [TopologicalSpace Q] [Group Q] [IsTopologicalGroup Q] [T2Space Q]
    [TopologicalSpace S] [Group S] [DiscreteTopology S]
    (f : G →ₜ* Q) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (hAb : OpenNormalAbelianizationInjective f)
    (q : G →ₜ* S) (hq : Function.Surjective q) :
    Group.IsPerfect (f.ker.map q.toMonoidHom)
proof:
:= by
  let K : Subgroup G := f.ker
  let N : Subgroup S := K.map q.toMonoidHom
  let : N.Normal :=
    Subgroup.Normal.map (show K.Normal by infer_instance) q.toMonoidHom hq
  let : DiscreteTopology (S ⧸ N) :=
    QuotientGroup.discreteTopology (isOpen_discrete (N : Set S))
  let qN : G →ₜ* S ⧸ N :=
    { toMonoidHom := (QuotientGroup.mk' N).comp q.toMonoidHom
      continuous_toFun := QuotientGroup.continuous_mk.comp q.continuous_toFun }
  have hKqN : f.ker ≤ qN.ker := by
    intro x hx
    apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := N) (q x)).2
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  let r₀ : Q →* S ⧸ N :=
    f.toMonoidHom.liftOfSurjective hf ⟨qN.toMonoidHom, hKqN⟩
  have hcomp : r₀.comp f.toMonoidHom = qN.toMonoidHom := by
    ext x
    exact MonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply
      (f := f.toMonoidHom) (f_inv := Function.surjInv hf)
      (Function.rightInverse_surjInv hf) ⟨qN.toMonoidHom, hKqN⟩ x
  have hr : Continuous r₀ := by
    apply (Topology.IsQuotientMap.of_surjective_continuous
      hf f.continuous_toFun).continuous_iff.2
    change Continuous (r₀.comp f.toMonoidHom)
    rw [hcomp]
    exact qN.continuous_toFun
  let r : Q →ₜ* S ⧸ N := ⟨r₀, hr⟩
  let H : OpenNormalSubgroup Q := ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.ker r
  let P : Subgroup G := (H : Subgroup Q).comap f.toMonoidHom
  have hq_mem_N : ∀ x : P, q x.1 ∈ N := by
    intro x
    have hrf : r (f x.1) = 1 :=
      (ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.mem_ker (f := r)).1 x.2
    have hqNx : qN x.1 = 1 :=
      (DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp x.1).symm.trans hrf
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := N) (q x.1)).1 hqNx
  let qP : P →ₜ* N :=
    { toMonoidHom := (q.toMonoidHom.comp P.subtype).codRestrict N hq_mem_N
      continuous_toFun :=
        (q.continuous_toFun.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk hq_mem_N }
  have hNderived : topDerivedTop N 1 = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro n _
    rcases n.2 with ⟨k, hkK, hkq⟩
    have hkP : k ∈ P := by
      change f k ∈ (H : Subgroup Q)
      have hfk : f k = 1 := MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hkK
      rw [hfk]
      exact (H : Subgroup Q).one_mem
    let x : P := ⟨k, hkP⟩
    have hxker :
        x ∈ (ProCGroups.ContinuousMonoidHom.restrictPreimage f (H : Subgroup Q)).ker := by
      apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hkK
    have hxder : x ∈ topDerivedTop P 1 :=
      restrictPreimage_ker_le_topDerived_one hAb H hxker
    have hqPx : qP x ∈ topDerivedTop N 1 :=
      topDerived_map_le (f := qP) 1 ⟨x, hxder, rfl⟩
    have hqPx_eq : qP x = n := Subtype.ext hkq
    exact hqPx_eq ▸ hqPx
  apply Group.isPerfect_def.mpr
  rw [topDerivedTop_one_eq_topologicalCommutator,
    topologicalCommutator_eq_commutator_of_isClosed N (isClosed_discrete _)] at hNderived
  exact hNderived

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.kernel_topologicallyPerfect_of_openNormalAbelianizationInjective
statement:
theorem kernel_topologicallyPerfect_of_openNormalAbelianizationInjective
    {G Q : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [TopologicalSpace Q] [Group Q] [IsTopologicalGroup Q] [T2Space Q]
    (f : G →ₜ* Q) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (hAb : OpenNormalAbelianizationInjective f) :
    (commutator f.ker).topologicalClosure = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let K : Subgroup G := f.ker
  have hKclosed : IsClosed (K : Set G) := by
    change IsClosed (f ⁻¹' ({1} : Set Q))
    exact isClosed_singleton.preimage f.continuous_toFun
  let : CompactSpace K := hKclosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let C : Subgroup K := (commutator K).topologicalClosure
  let T : Set G := K.subtype '' (C : Set K)
  have hTclosed : IsClosed T :=
    ((Subgroup.isClosed_topologicalClosure (commutator K)).isCompact.image
      continuous_subtype_val).isClosed
  apply top_unique
  intro k _
  have hkT : (k : G) ∈ T := by
    apply (ProCGroups.mem_closed_iff_forall_openNormal_quotient hTclosed).2
    intro U
    let : DiscreteTopology (G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G)) :=
      QuotientGroup.discreteTopology U.isOpen'
    let q : G →ₜ* G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G) :=
      ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj U
    let N : Subgroup (G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G)) := K.map q.toMonoidHom
    have hNperfect : Group.IsPerfect N :=
      isPerfect_kernel_image_of_openNormalAbelianizationInjective f hf hAb q
        (ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_surjective U)
    let qK : K →* N :=
      (q.toMonoidHom.comp K.subtype).codRestrict N (fun a => ⟨a, a.2, rfl⟩)
    have hqK : Function.Surjective qK := by
      rintro ⟨s, a, ha, has⟩
      exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, Subtype.ext has⟩
    have hmap : (commutator K).map qK = ⊤ := by
      rw [map_commutator_eq, MonoidHom.range_eq_top_of_surjective qK hqK]
      exact Group.isPerfect_def.mp hNperfect
    have hqk : qK k ∈ (commutator K).map qK := by
      rw [hmap]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top (qK k)
    rcases hqk with ⟨a, ha, haq⟩
    refine ⟨a, ⟨a, Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure (commutator K) ha, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val haq
  rcases hkT with ⟨a, ha, hak⟩
  have hak' : a = k := Subtype.ext hak
  exact hak' ▸ ha

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.localizationAtPrimeTo_factor
statement:
private theorem localizationAtPrimeTo_factor
    (X : Scheme.{0}) (x : X) (q : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    [hq : q.asIdeal.IsPrime] :
    (Spec.map (Spec.stalkIso (X.presheaf.stalk x) q).hom ≫
      Spec.map ((X.fromSpecStalk x).stalkMap q)) ≫
        X.fromSpecStalk (X.fromSpecStalk x q) =
      Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x q.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk (X.fromSpecStalk x) (x := q),
    ← Category.assoc, Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq (X.presheaf.stalk x) q, ← Spec.map_comp]
  have h : ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (X.presheaf.stalk x)).inv ≫
      (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).presheaf.germ ⊤ q trivial) ≫
        (Spec.stalkIso (X.presheaf.stalk x) q).hom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) := by
    have hbase : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) ≫ (Spec.stalkIso (X.presheaf.stalk x) q).inv =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (X.presheaf.stalk x)).inv ≫
          (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)).presheaf.germ ⊤ q trivial :=
      Spec.algebraMap_stalkIso_inv (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) q
    exact (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (Spec.stalkIso (X.presheaf.stalk x) q).hom)
      hbase.symm).trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
        ((congrArg (fun k => CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) ≫ k)
            (Iso.inv_hom_id (Spec.stalkIso (X.presheaf.stalk x) q))).trans
              (Category.comp_id _)))
  exact congrArg (fun k => Spec.map k ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x) h

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.etale_pullback_snd_comp
statement:
private theorem etale_pullback_snd_comp
    {N X S T : Scheme.{0}} (g : N ⟶ X) (b : S ⟶ X) (l : T ⟶ S)
    [Etale (pullback.snd g b)] : Etale (pullback.snd g (l ≫ b))
proof:
:= by
  let H := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (pullback.snd g b) l).paste_horiz
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g b)
  let e := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g (l ≫ b)).isoIsPullback _ _ H
  have he : e.hom ≫ pullback.snd (pullback.snd g b) l =
      pullback.snd g (l ≫ b) :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd N T
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback g (l ≫ b)) H
  have ht : Etale (e.hom ≫ pullback.snd (pullback.snd g b) l) := inferInstance
  exact he ▸ ht

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.normalization_heightOne_etale_of_componentStalks
statement:
theorem normalization_heightOne_etale_of_componentStalks
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement)
    (hgeneric : ∀ E : Component D,
      Etale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
        (X.fromSpecStalk (componentPoint D E))))
    (x : X) (p : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [p.IsPrime]
    (hp : p.height = 1) (hDp : D.1.stalkIdeal x ≤ p) :
    Etale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
      (Scheme.localizationAtPrimeTo X x p))
proof:
:= by
  let q : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) := ⟨p, inferInstance⟩
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hZq⟩ := D.2.exists_componentGenericPoint_eq_fromSpecStalk x q hp hDp
  let E : Component D := ⟨Z, hZ⟩
  have hE : D.1.componentGenericPoint Z hZ = componentPoint D E :=
    D.1.componentGenericPoint_eq Z hZ
  have hEq : componentPoint D E = X.fromSpecStalk x q := hE.symm.trans hZq
  let g := (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
  have hEt : Etale (pullback.snd g (X.fromSpecStalk (X.fromSpecStalk x q))) := by
    apply Eq.mp (congrArg (fun y : X => Etale (pullback.snd g (X.fromSpecStalk y))) hEq)
    exact hgeneric E
  let l := Spec.map (Spec.stalkIso (X.presheaf.stalk x) q).hom ≫
    Spec.map ((X.fromSpecStalk x).stalkMap q)
  have ht : Etale (pullback.snd g (l ≫ X.fromSpecStalk (X.fromSpecStalk x q))) :=
    etale_pullback_snd_comp g _ l
  exact Eq.mp (congrArg (fun b => Etale (pullback.snd g b))
    (localizationAtPrimeTo_factor X x q (hq := q.isPrime))) ht

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryUnramified_normalization_componentStalk_etale
statement:
theorem boundaryUnramified_normalization_componentStalk_etale
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (hU : IsBoundaryUnramified D W) (E : Component D) :
    Etale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
      (X.fromSpecStalk (componentPoint D E)))
proof:
:= by
  have hE : D.1.componentGenericPoint E.val E.property = componentPoint D E :=
    D.1.componentGenericPoint_eq E.val E.property
  have hLocal : ∃ hDomain : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)),
      let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) := hDomain
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) := by
    apply Eq.mp (congrArg (fun y : X => ∃ hDomain : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk y),
      let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk y) := hDomain
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk y)) hE)
    exact ⟨isDomain_stalk_componentGenericPoint D hreg E.val E.property,
      isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk_componentGenericPoint D hreg E.val E.property⟩
  obtain ⟨hDomain, hDVR⟩ := hLocal
  let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) := hDomain
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) := hDVR
  exact boundaryUnramified_normalization_stalk_etale D E W hW hU

statement:
theorem boundaryUnramified_normalization_heightOne_etale
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)

:= by
