    (boundaryUnramified_normalization_componentStalk_etale D hreg W hW hU) x p hp hDp

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.finiteEtale_pullback_isEquivalence_of_isIso
statement:
private theorem finiteEtale_pullback_isEquivalence_of_isIso
    {X Y : Scheme.{0}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f] :
    (pullback f).IsEquivalence
proof:
:= by
  let P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{0} := @IsFiniteEtale
  let e : Functor.fromPUnit X ≅ Functor.fromPUnit Y :=
    Discrete.natIso fun _ => asIso f
  let E : P.Over ⊤ X ≌ P.Over ⊤ Y :=
    MorphismProperty.Comma.mapRightIso (P := P) (Q := ⊤) (W := ⊤) (𝟭 Scheme) e
  have adj : E.functor ⊣ MorphismProperty.Over.pullback P ⊤ f :=
    MorphismProperty.Over.mapPullbackAdj P ⊤ f (P.of_isIso f) trivial
  exact (Functor.isEquivalence_iff_of_iso
    (E.toAdjunction.rightAdjointUniq adj)).mp
      (Equivalence.isEquivalence_inverse E)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.fundamentalGroupHom_composite_eq_one
statement:
private theorem fundamentalGroupHom_composite_eq_one
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{0}} {Ω : Type} [Field Ω]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(point)) (ha : fundamentalGroupHom (f ≫ g) point a = 1) :
    fundamentalGroupHom g (point ≫ f) (fundamentalGroupHom f point a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let hξ : (point ≫ f) ≫ g = point ≫ (f ≫ g) := Category.assoc point f g
  have hcomp := fundamentalGroupHom_comp_transport_eq_autHomOfCompIso
    f g (f ≫ g) rfl point (point ≫ (f ≫ g)) hξ a
  have hconj := autHomOfCompIso_eq_conj (pullback (f ≫ g))
    (pullbackFiberIso (f ≫ g) point)
    (pullbackCompositeFiberIsoOfEq f g (f ≫ g) rfl point (point ≫ (f ≫ g)) hξ) a
  rw [← hcomp] at hconj
  change hξ ▸ fundamentalGroupHom g (point ≫ f) (fundamentalGroupHom f point a) =
    MulAut.conj _ (fundamentalGroupHom (f ≫ g) point a) at hconj
  rw [ha, map_one] at hconj
  have transport_eq_one : ∀ {η η' : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Z} (h : η = η')
      (b : π₁ᵉᵗ(η)), (h ▸ b) = 1 → b = 1 := by
    intro η η' h b hb
    cases h
    exact hb
  exact transport_eq_one hξ _ hconj

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundary_openNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel
statement:
theorem boundary_openNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel
    {X : Scheme.{0}} [ConnectedSpace X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hD : BoundaryCondition D) [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement) :
    OpenNormalFiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel
      (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point)
proof:
:= by
  intro H
  let M := openNormalPullbackModel D.1.supportComplement.ι point H
  let D' : M.targetScheme.EffectiveCartierDivisor := D.comapFiniteEtale M.targetCover
  have hX : IsLocallyNoetherian
      ((Functor.fromPUnit X).obj M.targetCover.right) := by
    change IsLocallyNoetherian X
    infer_instance
  let : IsLocallyNoetherian M.targetScheme :=
    @LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian _ _ M.targetCover.hom
      (inferInstance : LocallyOfFiniteType M.targetCover.hom) hX
  have hstability : IsHorizontal D' ∧ BoundaryCondition D' :=
    finite_etale_stability_2_4 D hhor hD M.targetCover
      (inferInstance : ConnectedSpace M.targetScheme)
  have hgeneric : HasGeometricallyIntegralGenericComponents D'.1 :=
    hD.2.2 M.targetCover (inferInstance : ConnectedSpace M.targetScheme)
  have hab := abelian_invariance_2_1 D' hstability.1
    hstability.2.1 hstability.2.2.1 hgeneric
  let : ConnectedSpace D'.1.supportComplement := hab.1
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : M.sourceScheme ≅ D'.1.supportComplement,
      e.hom ≫ D'.1.supportComplement.ι = M.hom := by
    let ep : ((pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj M.targetCover).left ≅
        D'.1.supportComplement := pullbackSupportComplementIso D.1 M.targetCover
    let : ConnectedSpace ((pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj M.targetCover).left :=
      ep.hom.homeomorph.connectedSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance
    let : IsConnected ((pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj M.targetCover) :=
      isConnected_of_connectedSpace_left
        ((pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj M.targetCover)
    let : IsGalois M.sourceCover := M.sourceIsGalois
    let : Mono M.inclusion := M.inclusionMono
    let : IsIso M.inclusion :=
      IsConnected.noTrivialComponent M.sourceCover M.inclusion
        (not_initial_of_inhabited (fiber point) M.sourcePoint)
    let : IsIso M.inclusion.hom :=
      (FiniteEtale.forget D.1.supportComplement).map_isIso M.inclusion
    let : IsIso M.inclusion.left :=
      (CategoryTheory.Over.forget (D.1.supportComplement : Scheme)).map_isIso
        M.inclusion.hom
    refine ⟨asIso M.inclusion.left ≪≫ ep, ?_⟩
    have hopen : ep.hom ≫ D'.1.supportComplement.ι =
        Limits.pullback.fst M.targetCover.hom D.1.supportComplement.ι := by
      change
        (pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict M.targetCover.hom D.1.supportComplement).hom ≫
          (M.targetCover.left.isoOfEq
            (D.1.supportComplement_comap M.targetCover.hom).symm).hom ≫
          D'.1.supportComplement.ι =
        Limits.pullback.fst M.targetCover.hom D.1.supportComplement.ι
      have hlast := Scheme.isoOfEq_hom_ι M.targetCover.left
        (D.1.supportComplement_comap M.targetCover.hom).symm
      exact
        (congrArg
          (fun k =>
            (pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict
              M.targetCover.hom D.1.supportComplement).hom ≫ k)
          hlast).trans
            (pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict_hom_ι _ _)
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, OpenNormalPullbackModel.hom,
      Category.assoc]
    rw [hopen]
  have hkill : ProCGroups.ProC.FiniteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel
      (fundamentalGroupHom M.hom M.geometricPoint) := by
    let : (pullback e.hom).IsEquivalence :=
      finiteEtale_pullback_isEquivalence_of_isIso e.hom
    let eg : π₁ᵉᵗ(M.geometricPoint) ≃ₜ* π₁ᵉᵗ(M.geometricPoint ≫ e.hom) :=
      fundamentalGroupEquivOfPullbackEquivalence e.hom M.geometricPoint
    obtain ⟨eab, heab⟩ := hab.2 Ω (M.geometricPoint ≫ e.hom)
    intro A _ _ _ _ φ a ha
    let φ' : π₁ᵉᵗ(M.geometricPoint ≫ e.hom) →ₜ* A :=
      φ.comp (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom eg.symm)
    have haComposite :
        fundamentalGroupHom (e.hom ≫ D'.1.supportComplement.ι) M.geometricPoint a = 1 := by
      rw [he]
      exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp ha
    have haComplement :
        fundamentalGroupHom D'.1.supportComplement.ι (M.geometricPoint ≫ e.hom)
          (eg a) = 1 :=
      fundamentalGroupHom_composite_eq_one e.hom D'.1.supportComplement.ι
        M.geometricPoint a haComposite
    have haAb : (QuotientGroup.mk (eg a) :
        TopologicalAbelianization π₁ᵉᵗ(M.geometricPoint ≫ e.hom)) = 1 := by
      apply eab.injective
      rw [heab, haComplement, QuotientGroup.mk_one, map_one]
    apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
    calc
      φ a = φ' (eg a) := by
        change φ a = φ (eg.symm (eg a))
        rw [eg.symm_apply_apply]
      _ = ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.lift φ'
          (QuotientGroup.mk (eg a)) := rfl
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [haAb]
        exact map_one _
  exact ProCGroups.ProC.finiteDiscreteAbelianMapsKillKernel_of_continuousMulEquiv
    (ProCGroups.ContinuousMonoidHom.restrictPreimage
      (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point) (H : Subgroup π₁ᵉᵗ(point ≫
          D.1.supportComplement.ι)))
    (fundamentalGroupHom M.hom M.geometricPoint)
    M.sourceEquiv M.targetEquiv M.commutes hkill

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.exists_nonzero_stalk_cartier_equation
statement:
private theorem exists_nonzero_stalk_cartier_equation
    {X : Scheme.{0}} (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (x : X)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x)] :
    ∃ d : X.presheaf.stalk x, d ≠ 0 ∧ D.1.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {d}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hx, t, ht, hI⟩ := D.2 x
  let : Algebra Γ(X, U.1) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hx).hom.toAlgebra
  let := U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
  let d : X.presheaf.stalk x := (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hx) t
  have hd : d ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    IsLocalization.nonZeroDivisors_le_comap
      (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      ht.mem_nonZeroDivisors
  refine ⟨d, mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp hd, ?_⟩
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_map_ideal D.1 x U hx, hI,
    Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.normalization_boundaryStalk_finiteEtale_of_componentStalks
statement:
theorem normalization_boundaryStalk_finiteEtale_of_componentStalks
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (hgeneric : ∀ E : Component D,
      Etale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
        (X.fromSpecStalk (componentPoint D E))))
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ D.1.support) :
    IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
      (X.fromSpecStalk x))
proof:
:= by
  let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let : IsRegularLocalRing R := hreg x hx
  let : IsDomain R := IsRegularLocalRing.isDomain R
  let : IsIntegrallyClosed R := SchemeTheory.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isRegularLocalRing R
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hD⟩ := exists_nonzero_stalk_cartier_equation D x
  let S := Localization.Away d
  let : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hd
  let c := D.1.stalkAwayToSupportComplement x d hD
  let A := (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W
  let a := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))
  let b := X.fromSpecStalk x
  let f : A.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := (show A.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from A.hom) ≫ a
  let F : W.left ⟶ X := W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι
  have hregular : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, d ∈ p.asIdeal →
      IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) := by
    intro p hp
    have hDp : D.1.stalkIdeal x ≤ p.asIdeal := by
      rw [hD, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hp
    have hsupport : X.fromSpecStalk x p ∈ D.1.support :=
      D.1.mem_support_fromSpecStalk_of_stalkIdeal_le x p hDp
    let : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (X.fromSpecStalk x p)) :=
      hreg (X.fromSpecStalk x p) hsupport
    exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (X.stalkFromSpecStalkEquivLocalization x p)
  let xi : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing S))) ⟶ Spec (.of S) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing S) (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing S))).comp
        (algebraMap S (FractionRing S))))
  have hf : Etale f.fromNormalization := by
    apply etale_normalization_of_galoisComponents c xi W hW f
    intro _w Y i _v _hiv hY hi
    let : IsGalois Y := hY
    let : Mono i := hi
    have hYEt : Etale ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫ a).fromNormalization := by
      apply finiteEtaleAway_normalization_etale_of_regular_boundary d hd Y hregular
      intro p _ hp hdp
      have hDp : D.1.stalkIdeal x ≤ p := by
        rw [hD, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
        exact hdp
      exact normalization_stalkComponent_heightOne_etale_of_componentStalks
        D W hgeneric x d hD Y i p hp hDp
    have hiw : i.left ≫ (show A.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from A.hom) =
        (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) := i.w
    have hiF : i.left ≫ f = (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of S) from Y.hom) ≫ a :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) hiw)
    exact Eq.mp (congrArg (fun k : Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) => Etale k.fromNormalization)
      hiF.symm) hYEt
  have H : IsPullback (pullback.fst W.hom c) f F b :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback W.hom c).paste_vert
      (D.1.isPullback_stalkAwayToSupportComplement x d hD)
  let e : pullback F b ≅ A.left := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b).isoIsPullback _ _ H
  have he : e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd F b :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd W.left (Spec (.of R))
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b) H
  let en := Inertia.normalizationSourceIso (pullback.snd F b) f e he
  have hPB : Etale (pullback.snd F b).fromNormalization := by
    have ht : Etale (en.hom ≫ f.fromNormalization) := inferInstance
    rw [Inertia.normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization] at ht
    exact ht
  let : IsIso (F.normalizationPullback b) := isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalk F x
  have heq : pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b =
      inv (F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ (pullback.snd F b).fromNormalization := by
    exact (IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc (F.normalizationPullback b)
      (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b)).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun k => inv (F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ k)
          (Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd F b))
  have hEt : Etale (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b) := by
    rw [heq]
    infer_instance
  have hFin : IsFinite (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b) :=
    (IsFinite.iff_isIntegralHom_and_locallyOfFiniteType _).mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  exact ⟨⟩

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryUnramified_normalization_boundaryStalk_finiteEtale
statement:
theorem boundaryUnramified_normalization_boundaryStalk_finiteEtale
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (hU : IsBoundaryUnramified D W) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ D.1.support) :
    IsFiniteEtale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
      (X.fromSpecStalk x))
proof:
:= by
  exact normalization_boundaryStalk_finiteEtale_of_componentStalks D hreg W hW
    (boundaryUnramified_normalization_componentStalk_etale D hreg W hW hU) x hx

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.integralClosurePoint_liesOver
statement:
private theorem integralClosurePoint_liesOver
    {R L Ω : Type} [CommRing R] [Field L] [Field Ω] [Algebra R L]
    (φ : integralClosure R L →+* Ω) (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (hy : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L))) = y) :
    (RingHom.ker φ).LiesOver (y (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rw [← hy]
  change Ideal.comap (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L))
    (Ideal.comap φ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Ω)) =
      Ideal.comap (algebraMap R (integralClosure R L)) (RingHom.ker φ)
  rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot]
  rfl

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.finiteCoverInertia_isConj_inv
statement:
theorem finiteCoverInertia_isConj_inv
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    (hgeom : HasGeometricallyIntegralGenericComponents D.1) :
    let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:= boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
    ∀ (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (_hW : IsGalois W)
      (E : Component D)
      (z : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E)))) ⟶
        (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).normalization),
      z ≫ (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization =
        componentGeometricPoint D E →
      ∀ σ : finiteCoverInertia D W E z,
        IsConj (MulOpposite.op (σ : Aut W)) (MulOpposite.op (σ : Aut W))⁻¹ := by
  intro hConnected
  let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement := hConnected
  intro W hW E z hz σ
  let x := componentPoint D E
  have hx_eq : D.1.componentGenericPoint E.val E.property = x :=
    D.1.componentGenericPoint_eq E.val E.property
  let R : Type := X.presheaf.stalk x
  have hLocal : ∃ hDomain : IsDomain R,
      let : IsDomain R := hDomain
      IsDiscreteValuationRing R := by
    apply Eq.mp (congrArg (fun q : X => ∃ hDomain : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk q),
      let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk q) := hDomain
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk q)) hx_eq)
    exact ⟨isDomain_stalk_componentGenericPoint D hreg E.val E.property,
      isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk_componentGenericPoint D hreg E.val E.property⟩
  obtain ⟨hDomain, hDVR⟩ := hLocal
  let : IsDomain R := hDomain
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing R := hDVR
  have hx : x ∈ D.1.support := hx_eq ▸ D.1.componentGenericPoint_mem_support E.val E.property
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField x)
  let y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.residueField x) Ω)) ≫ Spec.map (X.residue x)
  have hy : y ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x = componentGeometricPoint D E :=
    Category.assoc _ _ _
  have hyideal : (y (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)).asIdeal = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    change (Spec.map (X.residue x)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.residueField x) Ω))
        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))).asIdeal = _
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (Scheme.SpecMap_residue_apply x _)
  obtain ⟨qA, hqA, hfixA⟩ := exists_fractionStalk_normalizationPoint D.1 D.2 x hx W z y
    (hz.trans hy.symm)
  let F := FractionRing R
  let c := D.2.fractionStalkToSupportComplement x
  let a : Spec (.of F) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R F))
  let xi : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure F)) ⟶ Spec (.of F) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap F (AlgebraicClosure F)))
  obtain ⟨Z, i, qZ, zZ, w, hi, hZ, hiz, hqZ, hlift⟩ :=
    exists_galoisComponent_normalizationPoint_fixed_lift c xi W hW a qA
  let : Mono i := hi
  let : IsGalois Z := hZ
  let : IsIntegral Z.left := isIntegral_left_of_isConnected_finiteEtale Z
  let K := (Spec (.of F)).functionField
  let L := Z.left.functionField
  let : Algebra K L := finiteEtaleFunctionFieldAlgebra Z
  let : Algebra R K := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R a
  let : Algebra R L := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra R
    ((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of F) from Z.hom) ≫ a)
  let : IsScalarTower R K L := finiteEtaleMorphism_functionField_isScalarTower R a Z
  let : IsFractionRing R K := affineMorphismFunctionFieldAlgebra_isFractionRing R F
  let : FiniteDimensional K L := finiteDimensional_functionField_of_finiteEtale_isConnected Z
  let : _root_.IsGalois K L := isGalois_functionField_of_isGalois_finiteEtale Z hZ
  obtain ⟨φ, hφbase, hφfix⟩ :=
    exists_finiteEtaleMorphism_normalizationPoint_inertia_iff R a Z qZ
  let Q := RingHom.ker φ
  have : Q.IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime φ
  have : Q.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) := by
    have h : Q.LiesOver (y (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)).asIdeal :=
      integralClosurePoint_liesOver (R := R) (L := L) (Ω := Ω)
        φ y (hφbase.trans (hqZ.trans hqA))
    exact Eq.mp (congrArg (fun P : Ideal R => Q.LiesOver P) hyideal) h
  let k : Type := (Spec (.of ℤ)).residueField (genericPoint (Spec (.of ℤ)))
  have hres : ∃ hAlg : Algebra k (X.residueField x),
      let : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := hAlg
      GeometricallyIntegral (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (X.residueField x)))) := by
    apply Eq.mp (congrArg (fun q : X => ∃ hAlg : Algebra k (X.residueField q),
      let : Algebra k (X.residueField q) := hAlg
      GeometricallyIntegral (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (X.residueField q))))) hx_eq)
    exact D.1.componentGenericPoint_exists_geometricallyIntegralResidueAlgebra
      (toIntegers X) E.val E.property (hhor E.val E.property) (hgeom E.val E.property)
  obtain ⟨hAlg, hfield⟩ := hres
  let : Algebra k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) := hAlg
  have hσfixed : z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι)
      σ.val.hom.left (by
        rw [← Category.assoc]
        exact congrArg (fun t => t ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) σ.val.hom.w) = z := σ.property
  obtain ⟨τ, hτimage, hτfixed⟩ := hlift σ.val ((hfixA σ.val).mpr hσfixed)
  have hτmem : finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ ∈ Q.inertia Gal(L/K) :=
    (hφfix τ).mpr hτfixed
  have hτmemLocal :
      let : MulSemiringAction Gal(L/K) (integralClosure R L) :=
        IsIntegralClosure.MulSemiringAction R K L (integralClosure R L)
      finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ ∈ Q.toAddSubgroup.inertia Gal(L/K) := by
    have hcanonical := Ideal.mem_inertia.mp hτmem
    have hsmul (b : integralClosure R L) :
        (galRestrict R K L (integralClosure R L)) (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ) b =
          (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ) • b := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact algebraMap_galRestrict_apply R (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ) b
    intro hAction
    apply Ideal.mem_inertia.mpr
    intro b
    change (galRestrict R K L (integralClosure R L))
      (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ) b - b ∈ Q
    rw [hsmul b]
    exact hcanonical b
  have hconj :=
    (open _root_.TameAbhyankar.SGA1 in
      idealInertia_isConj_inv_of_geometricallyIntegral_dvrNormalizationResidue_of_ratEquiv
        k specZGenericResidueFieldEquivQ (A := R) (K := K) (L := L) Q hfield
          ⟨finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ, hτmemLocal⟩)
  let e : (Aut Z)ᵐᵒᵖ ≃* Gal(L/K) := finiteEtaleAutOpFunctionFieldMulEquiv Z hZ
  let μ : Gal(L/K) →* (Aut W)ᵐᵒᵖ :=
    (FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom c xi W hW w Z i zZ hiz hZ hi).comp
      e.symm.toMonoidHom
  have hμ : μ (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ) = MulOpposite.op σ.val := by
    change (FiniteEtale.galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom c xi W hW w Z i zZ hiz hZ hi)
      (e.symm (e (MulOpposite.op τ))) = _
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hτimage
  have hconj' : IsConj (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ)
      (finiteEtaleAutFunctionFieldAlgEquiv Z τ)⁻¹ := hconj
  have h := μ.map_isConj hconj'
  simpa only [map_inv, hμ] using h

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.fromSpecStalk_eq_of_ideal_transport
statement:
private theorem fromSpecStalk_eq_of_ideal_transport
    {X : Scheme} {x x' : X} (h : x = x')
    (r : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (q : Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x'))
    (hqr : q.asIdeal = h ▸ r.asIdeal) :
    X.fromSpecStalk x' q = X.fromSpecStalk x r
proof:
:= by
  subst x'
  exact congrArg (X.fromSpecStalk x) (PrimeSpectrum.ext hqr)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.image_etaleBranch_eq_componentPoint
statement:
theorem image_etaleBranch_eq_componentPoint
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (E : Component D)
    (x : D.1.subscheme) (hx : x ∈ E.val)
    {U : Scheme.{0}} (f : U ⟶ X) (u : U)
    (hfu : f u = D.1.subschemeι x)
    (q : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) [hq : q.IsPrime]
    (hqcomap : q.comap (f.stalkMap u).hom =
      hfu.symm ▸ (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt E.val E.property x hx).asIdeal) :
    f (U.fromSpecStalk u ⟨q, hq⟩) = componentPoint D E
proof:
:= by
  let qSpec : Spec (U.presheaf.stalk u) := ⟨q, hq⟩
  have htransport := fromSpecStalk_eq_of_ideal_transport hfu.symm
    (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt E.val E.property x hx)
    (Spec.map (f.stalkMap u) qSpec) hqcomap
  calc
    f (U.fromSpecStalk u qSpec) =
        X.fromSpecStalk (f u) (Spec.map (f.stalkMap u) qSpec) :=
      (congrArg (fun k : Spec (U.presheaf.stalk u) ⟶ X => k qSpec)
        (Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk f (x := u))).symm
    _ = X.fromSpecStalk (D.1.subschemeι x)
        (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt E.val E.property x hx) := htransport
    _ = componentPoint D E := by
      rw [D.1.fromSpecStalk_componentBranchPrimeAt, D.1.componentGenericPoint_eq]
      rfl

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.exists_componentGeometricPoint_localized_etaleBranch
statement:
theorem exists_componentGeometricPoint_localized_etaleBranch
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (E : Component D)
    (x : D.1.subscheme) (hx : x ∈ E.val)
    {U : Scheme.{0}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] (u : U)
    (hfu : f u = D.1.subschemeι x)
    (q : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) [hq : q.IsPrime]
    (hqcomap : q.comap (f.stalkMap u).hom =
      hfu.symm ▸ (D.1.componentBranchPrimeAt E.val E.property x hx).asIdeal)
    (P : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) [P.IsPrime] (hqP : q ≤ P) :
    ∃ y : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E)))) ⟶
        Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P)),
      (y (closedPoint (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E))))).asIdeal =
        q.map (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P)) ∧
      y ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P))) ≫
        U.fromSpecStalk u ≫ f = componentGeometricPoint D E
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_geometricPoint_localized_chart_branch f u ⟨q, hq⟩ P hqP
    (componentPoint D E)
    (image_etaleBranch_eq_componentPoint D E x hx f u hfu q hqcomap)
    (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E)))
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.residueField (componentPoint D E))
      (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E)))))

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.exists_arithmeticBoundaryChart_with_componentGeometricPoint
statement:
theorem exists_arithmeticBoundaryChart_with_componentGeometricPoint
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [ConnectedSpace X]
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hhor : IsHorizontal D)
    (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport) (E : Component D)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hnc : ∃ x : D.1.subscheme, x ∈ E.val ∧
      ringChar (X.residueField (D.1.subschemeι x)) = p ∧
        D.IsNormalCrossingsAt (D.1.subschemeι x)) :
    letI : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement
proof:
:=
      AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{0}) (f : U ⟶ X) (_hf : Etale f) (u : U)
      (q : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) (_hq : q.IsPrime),
      D.1.HasMappedQuotientIdealInertiaCoprime f u q p ∧
      ∀ (P : Ideal (U.presheaf.stalk u)) (_hP : P.IsPrime), q ≤ P →
        ∃ y : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E)))) ⟶
            Spec (.of (Localization.AtPrime P)),
          (y (closedPoint
            (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E))))).asIdeal =
              q.map (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P)) ∧
          y ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (algebraMap (U.presheaf.stalk u) (Localization.AtPrime P))) ≫
            U.fromSpecStalk u ≫ f = componentGeometricPoint D E := by
  let : ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtale.boundaryComplement_connectedSpace D hreg
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hchar, hnc⟩ := hnc
  let : CharZero ((Spec (.of ℤ)).residueField (genericPoint (Spec (.of ℤ)))) :=
    specZGenericResidueFieldEquivQ.toRingHom.charZero
  let : CharP (X.residueField (D.1.subschemeι x)) p := ringChar.of_eq hchar
  have hhorizontal : D.ComponentsThroughPointAreHorizontal (toIntegers X) x :=
    fun Z hZ _ => hhor Z hZ
  obtain ⟨U, f, u, hfu, hf, _, _, q, hq, _, _, hqcomap, hmapped⟩ :=
    hhorizontal.exists_etaleStrictChart_component_mappedQuotientIdealInertia_coprime
      D (toIntegers X) E.val E.property x hx hnc p hp
  let : Etale f := hf
  let : q.IsPrime := hq
  refine ⟨U, f, hf, u, q, hq, hmapped, ?_⟩
  intro P hP hqP
  let : P.IsPrime := hP
  exact exists_componentGeometricPoint_localized_etaleBranch
    D E x hx f u hfu q hqcomap P hqP

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.normalizationDeck_one
statement:
private theorem normalizationDeck_one (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor)
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) :
    normalizationDeck D W 1 =
      𝟙 (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).normalization
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Hom.normalization.hom_ext (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι)
    _ _ (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [normalizationDeck, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationDesc]
    change (𝟙 W.left) ≫ (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).toNormalization =
      (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).toNormalization ≫ 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  · exact Scheme.Hom.normalizationDesc_comp _ _ _ _
  · exact Category.id_comp _

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.normalizationDeck_mul
statement:
private theorem normalizationDeck_mul (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor)
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (σ τ : Aut W) :
    normalizationDeck D W (σ * τ) =
      normalizationDeck D W τ ≫ normalizationDeck D W σ
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Hom.normalization.hom_ext (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι)
    _ _ (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [normalizationDeck, Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationDesc,
      Scheme.Hom.toNormalization_normalizationDesc_assoc, Aut.Aut_mul_def,
      Category.assoc]
    rfl
  · exact Scheme.Hom.normalizationDesc_comp _ _ _ _
  · simp only [normalizationDeck, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.normalizationDesc_comp]

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.isBoundaryUnramified_of_extension
statement:
theorem isBoundaryUnramified_of_extension
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement)
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) [IsConnected W]
    (hW : ∃ V : FiniteEtale X,
      Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj V ≅ W)) :
    IsBoundaryUnramified D W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hW
  intro E z _hz
  apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
  intro σ hσ
  exact EtaleFundamentalGroups.Inertia.aut_eq_one_of_fixes_normalizationPoint_of_extension
    D.1.supportComplement.ι point
    (boundaryComplement_fundamentalGroupHom_surjective D hreg point) W V e z σ hσ

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryUnramifiedKernelIntersection_le_kernel
statement:
theorem boundaryUnramifiedKernelIntersection_le_kernel
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement) :
    boundaryUnramifiedKernelIntersection D point ≤
      (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point).toMonoidHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [fundamentalGroupHom_ker_eq_iInf_extendableGalois D.1.supportComplement.ι point
    (boundaryComplement_fundamentalGroupHom_surjective D hreg point)]
  intro g hg
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_iInf]
  intro W hW w hext
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  exact Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp
    (Subgroup.mem_iInf.mp hg W) hW) w)
      (isBoundaryUnramified_of_extension D hreg point W hext)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_strictGenerators_subset_kernel
statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_strictGenerators_subset_kernel
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement)
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) [IsGalois W]
    (w : (fiber point).obj W)
    (hs : boundaryStrictInertiaGenerators D hreg point ⊆
      (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom (fiber point) π₁ᵉᵗ(point) W w).ker) :
    ∃ V : FiniteEtale X,
      Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι).obj V ≅ W)
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_componentStalks D hreg W inferInstance
  intro E
  let : Field (boundaryStrictFractionField D E) := boundaryStrictFractionFieldField D hreg E
  let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) :=
    isDomain_stalk_componentPoint D hreg E
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk_componentPoint D hreg E
  have hx : componentPoint D E ∈ D.1.support :=
    D.1.range_subschemeι.le ⟨E.property.1.genericPoint, rfl⟩
  exact normalization_stalk_etale_of_strictGeneric_image_fixed
    D (componentPoint D E) hx (boundaryComponentResidueMap D E) W
    (boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E)
    (boundaryStrict_fiber_fixed_of_generators_subset_kernel D hreg point W w hs E)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.kernel_le_boundaryStrictInertiaClosure
statement:
theorem kernel_le_boundaryStrictInertiaClosure
    [ConnectedSpace X]
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement) :
    (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point).toMonoidHom.ker ≤
      boundaryStrictInertiaClosure D hreg point
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryStrictInertiaClosure_eq_iInf_galoisQuotient D hreg point]
  rw [fundamentalGroupHom_ker_eq_iInf_extendableGalois D.1.supportComplement.ι point
    (boundaryComplement_fundamentalGroupHom_surjective D hreg point)]
  intro g hg
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_iInf] at hg ⊢
  intro W hW w hs
  let : IsGalois W := hW
  exact hg W hW w
    (exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_strictGenerators_subset_kernel D hreg point W w hs)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.exists_componentNormalizationPoint_strictImage_le_inertia
statement:
theorem exists_componentNormalizationPoint_strictImage_le_inertia
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement] (E : Component D)
    {Ξ : Type} [Field Ξ] [IsSepClosed Ξ]
    (xi : Spec (.of Ξ) ⟶ Spec (.of (boundaryStrictFractionField D E)))
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (w : (FiniteEtale.fiber (xi ≫ boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E)).obj W) :
    ∃ z : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E)))) ⟶
        (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).normalization,
      z ≫ (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization = componentGeometricPoint D E ∧
      (finiteEtaleGaloisCoverQuotientOfMorphism
        (boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E) xi W hW w).range ≤
        (finiteCoverInertia D W E z).op
proof:
:= by
  let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) :=
    isDomain_stalk_componentPoint D hreg E
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk_componentPoint D hreg E
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hfixed⟩ :=
    exists_normalizationPoint_fixed_by_geometricStalk_finiteImage D (componentPoint D E)
      (boundaryComponentResidueMap D E) xi W hW w
  refine ⟨z, hz.trans ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (boundaryComponentResidueMap D E)) ≫
      X.fromSpecStalk (componentPoint D E) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.residueField (componentPoint D E))
        (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E))))) ≫
          X.fromSpecResidueField (componentPoint D E)
    rw [Scheme.fromSpecResidueField, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  · intro σ hσ
    exact hfixed σ hσ

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryUnramified_fractionPullback_normalization_etale
statement:
theorem boundaryUnramified_fractionPullback_normalization_etale
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (hU : IsBoundaryUnramified D W) :
    Etale (((show ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W).left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from
      ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W).hom) ≫ a₀).fromNormalization)
proof:
:= by
  let xi : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure K)) ⟶ Spec (.of K) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K)))
  let A := (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W
  let f : A.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := (show A.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from A.hom) ≫ a₀
  apply etale_normalization_of_galoisComponents c xi W hW f
  intro w Z i v hiv hZ hi
  have hZet : Etale (((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ a₀).fromNormalization) :=
    boundaryUnramified_localComponent_normalization_etale D E xi W hW hU w Z i v hiv hZ hi
  have hiw : i.left ≫ (show A.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from A.hom) =
      (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) := i.w
  have he : (Iso.refl Z.left).hom ≫ ((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ a₀) =
      i.left ≫ f := by
    exact (Category.id_comp _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a₀) hiw).symm.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _))
  let e := normalizationSourceIso (i.left ≫ f)
    ((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ a₀) (Iso.refl Z.left) he
  have ht : Etale (e.hom ≫ ((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ a₀).fromNormalization) :=
    inferInstance
  rw [normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization] at ht
  exact ht

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryUnramified_normalization_stalk_etale
statement:
theorem boundaryUnramified_normalization_stalk_etale
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (hU : IsBoundaryUnramified D W) :
    Etale (Limits.pullback.snd
      (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
      (X.fromSpecStalk (componentPoint D E)))
proof:
:= by
  let A := (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W
  let F : W.left ⟶ X := W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι
  let b : Spec (.of R) ⟶ X := X.fromSpecStalk (componentPoint D E)
  let f : A.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := (show A.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from A.hom) ≫ a₀
  have hx : componentPoint D E ∈ D.1.support :=
    D.1.range_subschemeι.le ⟨E.property.1.genericPoint, rfl⟩
  have H : IsPullback (Limits.pullback.fst W.hom c) f F b :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback W.hom c).paste_vert
      (D.2.isPullback_fractionStalkToSupportComplement (componentPoint D E) hx)
  let e : Limits.pullback F b ≅ A.left :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b).isoIsPullback _ _ H
  have he : e.hom ≫ f = Limits.pullback.snd F b :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd W.left (Spec (.of R))
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b) H
  let en := normalizationSourceIso (Limits.pullback.snd F b) f e he
  have hf : Etale f.fromNormalization :=
    boundaryUnramified_fractionPullback_normalization_etale D E W hW hU
  have hPB : Etale (Limits.pullback.snd F b).fromNormalization := by
    have ht : Etale (en.hom ≫ f.fromNormalization) := inferInstance
    rw [normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization] at ht
    exact ht
  let : IsIso (F.normalizationPullback b) :=
    isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalk F (componentPoint D E)
  have heq : Limits.pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b =
      inv (F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ (Limits.pullback.snd F b).fromNormalization := by
    exact (IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc (F.normalizationPullback b)
      (Limits.pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b)).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun k => inv (F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ k)
          (Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd F b))
  change Etale (Limits.pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b)
  rw [heq]
  infer_instance

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryUnramified_localComponent_fixed_eq_one
statement:
theorem boundaryUnramified_localComponent_fixed_eq_one
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (xi : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (hU : IsBoundaryUnramified D W)
    (w : (fiber (xi ≫ c)).obj W)
    (Z : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of K))) (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W)
    (v : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiv : (fiber xi).map i v =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (FiniteEtale.pullback c)
        (pullbackFiberIso c xi) W w)
    (hZ : IsGalois Z) (hi : Mono i)
    (z : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E)))) ⟶
      ((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ a₀).normalization)
    (hz : z ≫ ((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ a₀).fromNormalization =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        ((algebraMap (X.residueField (componentPoint D E))
          (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E)))).comp
            (IsLocalRing.residue R))))
    (τ : Aut Z)
    (hτ : z ≫ normalizationEndomorphism
      ((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ a₀) τ.hom.left
      (by
        have hw : τ.hom.left ≫ (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) =
            (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) := τ.hom.w
        exact (Category.assoc τ.hom.left (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) a₀).symm.trans
          (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a₀) hw)) = z) :
    τ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let f : Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ a₀
  let g : W.left ⟶ X := W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι
  let a : Z.left ⟶ W.left := i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.fst W.hom c
  let b : Spec (.of R) ⟶ X := X.fromSpecStalk (componentPoint D E)
  have hiw : i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd W.hom c =
      (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) := i.w
  have hsquare : a ≫ g = f ≫ b := by
    calc
      a ≫ g = i.left ≫ (Limits.pullback.fst W.hom c ≫ W.hom) ≫
          D.1.supportComplement.ι :=
        (Category.assoc i.left (Limits.pullback.fst W.hom c)
          (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι)).trans
          (congrArg (fun k => i.left ≫ k)
            (Category.assoc (Limits.pullback.fst W.hom c) W.hom
              D.1.supportComplement.ι).symm)
      _ = i.left ≫ (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom c ≫ c) ≫
          D.1.supportComplement.ι :=
        congrArg (fun k => i.left ≫ k ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι)
          (Limits.pullback.condition (f := W.hom) (g := c))
      _ = (i.left ≫ Limits.pullback.snd W.hom c) ≫
          (c ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) :=
        (congrArg (fun k => i.left ≫ k)
          (Category.assoc (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom c) c D.1.supportComplement.ι)).trans
          (Category.assoc i.left (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom c)
            (c ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι)).symm
      _ = (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫
          (c ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) :=
        congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (c ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι)) hiw
      _ = (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ (a₀ ≫ b) :=
        congrArg (fun k => (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫ k)
          (D.2.fractionStalkToSupportComplement_comp_ι (componentPoint D E))
      _ = f ≫ b := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  let q := galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom c xi W hW w Z i v hiv hZ hi
  let σ : Aut W := (q (MulOpposite.op τ)).unop
  have hσ : σ.hom.left ≫ g = g := by
    have hw : σ.hom.left ≫ (show W.left ⟶ D.1.supportComplement from W.hom) =
        (show W.left ⟶ D.1.supportComplement from W.hom) := σ.hom.w
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι) hw)
  have hequiv : τ.hom.left ≫ a = a ≫ σ.hom.left := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun k : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W => k.left)
      (galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_equivariant
        c xi W hW w Z i v hiv hZ hi (MulOpposite.op τ))
    change τ.hom.left ≫ i.left =
      i.left ≫ ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).left at hh
    have hmap : ((FiniteEtale.pullback c).map σ.hom).left ≫
        Limits.pullback.fst W.hom c = Limits.pullback.fst W.hom c ≫ σ.hom.left :=
      Limits.pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun k => k ≫ Limits.pullback.fst W.hom c) hh).trans
        ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
          ((congrArg (fun k => i.left ≫ k) hmap).trans (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)))
  let n := normalizationMapOfSquare f g a b hsquare
  have hnbase : (z ≫ n) ≫ g.fromNormalization = componentGeometricPoint D E := by
    rw [Category.assoc, normalizationMapOfSquare_base, ← Category.assoc, hz]
    dsimp only [componentGeometricPoint, Scheme.fromSpecResidueField,
      Scheme.residue, b]
    exact (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ X.fromSpecStalk (componentPoint D E))
      (Spec.map_comp (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue R))
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.residueField (componentPoint D E))
          (AlgebraicClosure (X.residueField (componentPoint D E))))))).trans
      (Category.assoc _ _ _)
  have hτf : τ.hom.left ≫ f = f := by
    have hw : τ.hom.left ≫ (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) =
        (show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) := τ.hom.w
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a₀) hw)
  have hnfix : (z ≫ n) ≫ normalizationDeck D W σ = z ≫ n := by
    change (z ≫ n) ≫ normalizationEndomorphism g σ.hom.left hσ = z ≫ n
    rw [Category.assoc, ← normalizationMapOfSquare_endomorphism
      f g a b hsquare τ.hom.left hτf
      σ.hom.left hσ hequiv, ← Category.assoc, hτ]
  have hσone : σ = 1 := by
    have hm : σ ∈ finiteCoverInertia D W E (z ≫ n) := hnfix
    rw [hU E (z ≫ n) hnbase] at hm
    exact Subgroup.mem_bot.mp hm
  apply MulOpposite.op_injective
  apply galoisPullbackComponentQuotientMonoidHom_injective c xi W hW w Z i v hiv hZ hi
  change q (MulOpposite.op τ) = q 1
  rw [map_one]
  exact MulOpposite.unop_injective hσone

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.etale_pullback_snd_source_comp
statement:
private theorem etale_pullback_snd_source_comp
    {J N X T : Scheme.{0}} (g : N ⟶ X) (b : T ⟶ X) (j : J ⟶ N)
    [Etale (pullback.snd g b)] [Etale j] :
    Etale (pullback.snd (j ≫ g) b)
proof:
:= by
  let e := pullbackRightPullbackFstIso g b j
  have ht : Etale (e.inv ≫ pullback.snd j (pullback.fst g b) ≫ pullback.snd g b) :=
    inferInstance
  exact (pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_inv_snd_snd g b j) ▸ ht

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.etale_iterated_pullback_snd
statement:
private theorem etale_iterated_pullback_snd
    {N X S T : Scheme.{0}} (g : N ⟶ X) (b : S ⟶ X) (a : T ⟶ S)
    [Etale (pullback.snd g (a ≫ b))] :
    Etale (pullback.snd (pullback.snd g b) a)
proof:
:= by
  let e := pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso g b a
  have ht : Etale (e.hom ≫ pullback.snd g (a ≫ b)) := inferInstance
  exact (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd g b a) ▸ ht

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.normalization_stalkComponent_heightOne_etale_of_componentStalks
statement:
theorem normalization_stalkComponent_heightOne_etale_of_componentStalks
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement)
    (hgeneric : ∀ E : Component D,
      Etale (pullback.snd (W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι).fromNormalization
        (X.fromSpecStalk (componentPoint D E))))
    (x : X) (d : X.presheaf.stalk x) (hd : D.1.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {d})
    [ConnectedSpace (Spec (.of (Localization.Away d)))]
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away d))))
    (i : Y ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback
      (D.1.stalkAwayToSupportComplement x d hd)).obj W) [Mono i]
    (p : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [p.IsPrime]
    (hp : p.height = 1) (hDp : D.1.stalkIdeal x ≤ p) :
    Etale (pullback.snd
      ((show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.Away d)) from Y.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.Away d)))).fromNormalization
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime p)))))
proof:
:= by
  let c := D.1.stalkAwayToSupportComplement x d hd
  let A := (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W
  let a := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.Away d)))
  let b := X.fromSpecStalk x
  let ap := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime p)))
  let F : W.left ⟶ X := W.hom ≫ D.1.supportComplement.ι
  let f : A.left ⟶ Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    (show A.left ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.Away d)) from A.hom) ≫ a
  have H : IsPullback (pullback.fst W.hom c) f F b :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback W.hom c).paste_vert
      (D.1.isPullback_stalkAwayToSupportComplement x d hd)
  let e : pullback F b ≅ A.left := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b).isoIsPullback _ _ H
  have he : e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd F b :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd W.left (Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback F b) H
  let en := normalizationSourceIso (pullback.snd F b) f e he
  let : IsIso (F.normalizationPullback b) := isIso_normalizationPullback_fromSpecStalk F x
  let ef : f.normalization ≅ pullback F.fromNormalization b :=
    en.symm ≪≫ asIso (F.normalizationPullback b)
  have hef : ef.hom ≫ pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b = f.fromNormalization := by
    change (en.inv ≫ F.normalizationPullback b) ≫ pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b = _
    rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.normalizationPullback_snd]
    exact (Iso.inv_comp_eq en).mpr (normalizationSourceIso_hom_fromNormalization _ _ _ _).symm
  let j := normalizationComponentInclusion f i
  have hj : j ≫ f.fromNormalization = (i.left ≫ f).fromNormalization :=
    Scheme.Hom.normalizationDesc_comp _ _ _ _
  let m := j ≫ ef.hom
  have hm : m ≫ pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b = (i.left ≫ f).fromNormalization := by
    change (j ≫ ef.hom) ≫ pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b = _
    rw [Category.assoc, hef]
    exact hj
  have hglobal : Etale (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization (ap ≫ b)) :=
    normalization_heightOne_etale_of_componentStalks D W hgeneric x p hp hDp
  have hwhole : Etale (pullback.snd (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b) ap) :=
    etale_iterated_pullback_snd F.fromNormalization b ap
  have hcomponent : Etale (pullback.snd (i.left ≫ f).fromNormalization ap) := by
    have ht : Etale (pullback.snd (m ≫ pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b) ap) :=
      etale_pullback_snd_source_comp (pullback.snd F.fromNormalization b) ap m
    exact Eq.mp (congrArg (fun k => Etale (pullback.snd k ap)) hm) ht
  have hi : i.left ≫ f = (show Y.left ⟶ Spec (.of (Localization.Away d)) from Y.hom) ≫ a :=
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a) i.w)
  exact Eq.mp (congrArg (fun k : Y.left ⟶ Spec (X.presheaf.stalk x) =>
    Etale (pullback.snd k.fromNormalization ap)) hi) hcomponent

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryUnramified_stalkComponent_normalization_heightOne_etale
statement:
theorem boundaryUnramified_stalkComponent_normalization_heightOne_etale
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)

    (x : X) (d : X.presheaf.stalk x) (hd : D.1.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {d})
    [ConnectedSpace (Spec (.of (Localization.Away d)))]
    (Y : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of (Localization.Away d))))
    (i : Y ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback
      (D.1.stalkAwayToSupportComplement x d hd)).obj W) [Mono i]

      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) (Localization.AtPrime p)))))

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryUnramified_localComponent_normalization_etale
statement:
theorem boundaryUnramified_localComponent_normalization_etale
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (xi : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)
    (hU : IsBoundaryUnramified D W)
    (w : (fiber (xi ≫ c)).obj W)
    (Z : FiniteEtale (Spec (.of K))) (i : Z ⟶ (FiniteEtale.pullback c).obj W)
    (v : (fiber xi).obj Z)
    (hiv : (fiber xi).map i v =
      transportedPointOfCompIso (FiniteEtale.pullback c)
        (pullbackFiberIso c xi) W w)
    (hZ : IsGalois Z) (hi : Mono i) :
    Etale (((show Z.left ⟶ Spec (.of K) from Z.hom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))).fromNormalization)
proof:
:= by

  intro z hz τ hτ

    D E xi W hW hU w Z i v hiv hZ hi z hz τ hτ

statement:
theorem isDomain_stalk_componentPoint

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk_componentPoint
proof:
:=
      isDomain_stalk_componentPoint D hreg E
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) := by

  have hlocal : ∃ h : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)),
      let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) := h
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) := by

      IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryStrictInertiaGenerators_subset_kernel
statement:
theorem boundaryStrictInertiaGenerators_subset_kernel
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement) :
    boundaryStrictInertiaGenerators D hreg point ⊆
      (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point).toMonoidHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  rintro g ⟨E, t, a, rfl⟩
  let : Field (boundaryStrictFractionField D E) := boundaryStrictFractionFieldField D hreg E
  let : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) :=
    isDomain_stalk_componentPoint D hreg E
  let : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk (componentPoint D E)) :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk_componentPoint D hreg E
  let j := boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E
  let xi := boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E
  have ha : fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι (xi ≫ j)
      (fundamentalGroupHom j xi a) = 1 := by
    apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp
    exact geometricStalkFractionField_image_le_boundaryKernel D (componentPoint D E)
      (boundaryComponentResidueMap D E) xi ⟨a, rfl⟩
  apply MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
  exact autHomOfCompIso_conj_eq_one_of_eq_one (pullback D.1.supportComplement.ι)
    t (pullbackFiberIso D.1.supportComplement.ι (xi ≫ j))
    (pullbackFiberIso D.1.supportComplement.ι point) (fundamentalGroupHom j xi a) ha

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryStrictInertiaClosure_le_kernel
statement:
theorem boundaryStrictInertiaClosure_le_kernel
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement) :
    boundaryStrictInertiaClosure D hreg point ≤
      (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point).toMonoidHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal
  · exact Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
      (boundaryStrictInertiaGenerators_subset_kernel D hreg point)
  · exact isClosed_singleton.preimage
      (fundamentalGroupHom D.1.supportComplement.ι point).continuous

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryStrictInertiaClosure_eq_iInf_galoisQuotient
statement:
theorem boundaryStrictInertiaClosure_eq_iInf_galoisQuotient
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)

    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement) :
    boundaryStrictInertiaClosure D hreg point =
      ⨅ (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) (hW : IsGalois W)

        let : IsGalois W
proof:
:= hW
        ⨅ (_h : boundaryStrictInertiaGenerators D hreg point ⊆
          (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom (fiber point) π₁ᵉᵗ(point) W w).ker),
          (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom (fiber point) π₁ᵉᵗ(point) W w).ker :=

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryStrict_fiber_fixed_of_generators_subset_kernel
statement:
theorem boundaryStrict_fiber_fixed_of_generators_subset_kernel
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement)
    (W : FiniteEtale D.1.supportComplement) [IsGalois W]
    (w : (fiber point).obj W)
    (hs : boundaryStrictInertiaGenerators D hreg point ⊆
      (galoisObjectQuotientMonoidHom (fiber point) π₁ᵉᵗ(point) W w).ker)
    (E : Component D) :
    let : Field (boundaryStrictFractionField D E)
proof:
:= boundaryStrictFractionFieldField D hreg E
    let j := boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E
    let xi := boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E
    ∀ (a : π₁ᵉᵗ(xi)) (y : (fiber (xi ≫ j)).obj W),
      fundamentalGroupHom j xi a • y = y := by
  intro hField j xi a y
  obtain ⟨t⟩ := nonempty_fiber_iso (xi ≫ j) point
  apply fiber_fixed_of_conj_fixed t (fundamentalGroupHom j xi a) W _ y
  intro v
  apply fiber_fixed_of_galoisObjectQuotient_eq_one (fiber point) W w _ _ v
  exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp (hs ⟨E, t, a, rfl⟩)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.exists_boundaryStrictFiberPaths
statement:
theorem exists_boundaryStrictFiberPaths
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    [ConnectedSpace D.1.supportComplement]
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement) :
    Nonempty (∀ E : Component D,
      let : Field (boundaryStrictFractionField D E) := boundaryStrictFractionFieldField D hreg E
      fiber (boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E ≫ boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E) ≅
        fiber point)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun E => ?_⟩
  intro hField
  exact Classical.choice (nonempty_fiber_iso
    (boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E ≫ boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E) point)

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.boundaryStrictInertiaClosure_eq_of_paths
statement:
theorem boundaryStrictInertiaClosure_eq_of_paths
    (D : X.EffectiveCartierDivisor) (hreg : D.IsAmbientRegularAlongSupport)
    {Ω : Type} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
    (point : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ D.1.supportComplement)
    (paths : ∀ E : Component D,
      let : Field (boundaryStrictFractionField D E) := boundaryStrictFractionFieldField D hreg E
      fiber (boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E ≫ boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E) ≅
        fiber point) :
    boundaryStrictInertiaClosure D hreg point =
      (Subgroup.normalClosure {g | ∃ E : Component D,
        let : Field (boundaryStrictFractionField D E) := boundaryStrictFractionFieldField D hreg E
        ∃ a : π₁ᵉᵗ(boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E),
          continuousConjAut (paths E)
            (fundamentalGroupHom (boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E)
              (boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E) a) = g}).topologicalClosure
proof:
:= by
  let s : Set π₁ᵉᵗ(point) := {g | ∃ E : Component D,
    let : Field (boundaryStrictFractionField D E) := boundaryStrictFractionFieldField D hreg E
    ∃ a : π₁ᵉᵗ(boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E),
      continuousConjAut (paths E)
        (fundamentalGroupHom (boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E)
          (boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E) a) = g}
  change boundaryStrictInertiaClosure D hreg point = (Subgroup.normalClosure s).topologicalClosure
  apply congrArg Subgroup.topologicalClosure
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    rintro g ⟨E, t, a, rfl⟩
    let : Field (boundaryStrictFractionField D E) := boundaryStrictFractionFieldField D hreg E
    rw [continuousConjAut_eq_conj (paths E) t]
    have ha : continuousConjAut (paths E)
        (fundamentalGroupHom (boundaryStrictGenericMorphism D hreg E)
          (boundaryStrictGenericPoint D hreg E) a) ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure s :=
      Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨E, a, rfl⟩
    exact Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem inferInstance _ ha _
  · apply Subgroup.normalClosure_mono
    rintro g ⟨E, a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨E, paths E, a, rfl⟩

name: Yamaguchi26SolvableCoverings.exists_finiteEtale_extension_of_componentStalks

name: ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.finite_torsion
statement:
theorem IsHigherLocalField.finite_torsion
    (n : ℕ) (K : Type u) [Field K] (hK : IsHigherLocalField.{u, v} n K) :
    Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing K with
  | zero =>
    have : Finite K := hK
    infer_instance
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hK
    have : Finite (CommGroup.torsion D.residueFieldˣ) := ih D.residueField hD
    rcases CharP.exists' K with hzero | ⟨p, hp, hKp⟩
    · have : CharZero K := hzero
      rcases CharP.exists' D.residueField with hreszero | ⟨p, hp, hresp⟩
      · have : CharZero D.residueField := hreszero
        exact D.toHenselianDVF.finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion
      · have : Fact p.Prime := hp
        have : CharP D.residueField p := hresp
        exact D.toDVF.finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion_mixedChar p
    · have : Fact p.Prime := hp
      have : CharP K p := hKp
      exact D.toDVF.finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion_charP p

name: ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.of_finiteExtension
statement:
theorem IsHigherLocalField.of_finiteExtension
    (n : ℕ) (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hK : IsHigherLocalField.{u, v} n K) :
    IsHigherLocalField.{u, v} n L
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing K L with
  | zero =>
    change Finite K at hK
    change Finite L
    have : Finite K := hK
    exact Module.finite_of_finite K
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hK
    let E : CompleteDVF.{u, v} L := D.finiteExtension L
    have : D.valuation.HasExtension E.valuation := D.finiteExtension_hasExtension L
    have : FiniteDimensional D.residueField E.residueField :=
      _root_.Valuation.finiteDimensional_residueField D.valuation E.valuation
    exact ⟨E, ih D.residueField E.residueField hD⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.higherLocal_openLayer_residual_faithful
statement:
private theorem higherLocal_openLayer_residual_faithful
    (n : ℕ) {K Ω : Type u} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsSepClosure K Ω]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (hK : ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.{u, v} n K) (hn : 0 < n)
    (H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K))
    [CompactSpace (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))]
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)))
    (hprime : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index.Prime) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p})
      (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) N.isClosed)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hn).elim
  | succ n =>
      let F : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
      let closedH : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨H.toSubgroup, H.isClosed⟩
      have hfix : F.fixingSubgroup = (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :=
        InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField closedH
      have : FiniteDimensional K F := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite F).mp (by
        rw [hfix]
        exact H.isOpen)
      have : IsSepClosure F Ω :=
        ⟨IsSepClosure.sep_closed K, Algebra.isSeparable_tower_top_of_isSeparable K F Ω⟩
      have : T2Space Gal(Ω/F) := krullTopology_t2 (K := F) (L := Ω)
      have : CharP F p := (Algebra.charP_iff K F p).mp inferInstance
      have hF : ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.{u, v} (n + 1) F :=
        ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.of_finiteExtension (n + 1) K F hK
      obtain ⟨D, _hD⟩ := hF
      let e₀ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* F.fixingSubgroup :=
        { toMulEquiv := MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hfix.symm
          continuous_toFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
            (fun x => hfix.symm ▸ x.property)
          continuous_invFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
            (fun x => hfix ▸ x.property) }
      let e : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* Gal(Ω/F) := e₀.trans (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv F)
      let M : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F) :=
        (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
      have : M.Normal :=
        (inferInstance : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).Normal).map
          e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom e.surjective
      have hM : IsOpen (M : Set Gal(Ω/F)) := e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap N N.isOpen
      let r : ℕ := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index
      have : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hprime⟩
      have hindex : M.index = r :=
        (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index_map_equiv e.toMulEquiv
      have hfaith := primeDegree_separable_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful p
        (fun S _ hdeg => by
          obtain ⟨τ, _, z, hz⟩ := prime_order_detection_of_complete_charP p r D hdeg
          exact ⟨τ, z, hz⟩) M hM hindex
      have hNfaith := (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
        (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p}) e
        (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) N.isClosed).mp hfaith
      exact hNfaith

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.higher_local_field_abFaithful_of_charP
statement:
theorem higher_local_field_abFaithful_of_charP
    (n : ℕ) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (hK : ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.{u, v} n K) (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
proof:
:= by
  have : T2Space Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) :=
    krullTopology_t2 (K := K) (L := SeparableClosure K)
  have hSep : IsSigmaAbFaithful {p} Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) := by
    apply isSigmaAbFaithful_iff_prime_order_test.mpr
    intro H
    have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) :=
      H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    intro N hprime
    have hfaith := higherLocal_openLayer_residual_faithful n p hK hn H N hprime
    exact (injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card _ hprime).mp hfaith
  exact (IsSigmaAbFaithful.of_continuousMulEquiv
    (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K) hSep).isAbFaithful

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finite_primaryComponent_of_higherLocalField
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_of_higherLocalField
    (n : ℕ) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (hK : ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.{u, v} n K) :
    ∀ (ℓ : ℕ), ℓ.Prime → Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Kˣ) :=
    ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.finite_torsion n K hK
  intro ℓ hℓ
  let f : CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ ℓ → CommGroup.torsion Kˣ :=
    fun z => ⟨z.1, by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent).mp z.2
      exact (CommGroup.mem_torsion z.1).mpr
        (isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨ℓ ^ m, pow_pos hℓ.pos m, hm⟩)⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (fun z : CommGroup.torsion Kˣ => (z : Kˣ)) hab
  exact Finite.of_injective f hf

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.higher_local_field_abFaithful_of_charZero
statement:
theorem higher_local_field_abFaithful_of_charZero
    (n : ℕ) (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (hK : ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.{u, v} n K) (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing K with
  | zero => exact (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 hn).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hK
    rcases CharP.exists' D.residueField with hzero | ⟨p, hp, hres⟩
    · have : CharZero D.residueField := hzero
      have hn : 0 < n := by
        by_contra hn
        have hn0 : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn
        subst n
        have : Finite D.residueField := hD
        exact not_finite D.residueField
      have hfaithful := ih D.residueField hD hn
      apply residueZero_abFaithful_of_finitePrimePowerRoots D.toHenselianDVF hfaithful
      intro E hfield halg hfinite ℓ hℓ
      have hE := ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.of_finiteExtension
        n D.residueField E hD
      exact finite_primaryComponent_of_higherLocalField n E hE ℓ hℓ
    · have : Fact p.Prime := hp
      have : CharP D.residueField p := hres
      exact (isSigmaAbFaithful_absoluteGaloisGroup_singleton_of_henselian_mixedChar
        D.toHenselianDVF p).isAbFaithful

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.higher_local_field_roots_and_abFaithful
statement:
theorem higher_local_field_roots_and_abFaithful
    (n : ℕ) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (hK : ValuationTheory.IsHigherLocalField.{u, v} n K) :
    (∀ (ℓ : ℕ), ℓ.Prime → Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Kˣ ℓ)) ∧
      (0 < n → IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
proof:
:= by
  have hroots := finite_primaryComponent_of_higherLocalField n K hK
  refine ⟨hroots, ?_⟩
  intro hn
  rcases CharP.exists' K with hzero | ⟨p, hp, hchar⟩
  · have : CharZero K := hzero
    exact higher_local_field_abFaithful_of_charZero n K hK hn
  · have : Fact p.Prime := hp
    have : CharP K p := hchar
    exact higher_local_field_abFaithful_of_charP n K p hK hn

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.IsSigmaAbFaithful.normal_proP_eq_bot
statement:
theorem IsSigmaAbFaithful.normal_proP_eq_bot
    {sigma : Set ℕ} {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (hG : IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ∉ sigma)
    (P : Subgroup G) [P.Normal]
    (hP : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) P) :
    P = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let hC : FiniteGroupClass.FullFormation (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup.{u} sigma) :=
    FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma
  have hfaith (N : OpenNormalSubgroup G) :
      Function.Injective
        (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation hC (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed) := by
    let H : OpenSubgroup G := ⊤
    have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
      H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    let e : G ≃ₜ* (H : Subgroup G) :=
      { toMulEquiv := Subgroup.topEquiv.symm
        continuous_toFun := continuous_id.subtype_mk (fun _ => Subgroup.mem_top _)
        continuous_invFun := continuous_subtype_val }
    let Nmap : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup G) :=
      ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.map
        (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom e)
        e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap e.surjective N
    exact (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
      hC e (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed).mp (hG H Nmap)
  apply bot_unique
  intro g hg
  change g = 1
  apply ProCGroups.ProfiniteGrp.eq_one_of_mem_all_openNormalSubgroups
  intro N
  have : CompactSpace (N : Subgroup G) :=
    N.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let R : Subgroup (N : Subgroup G) :=
    proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) (N : Subgroup G)
  have : R.Normal := proCResidualCore_normal _ _
  have : IsClosed (R : Set (N : Subgroup G)) := proCResidualCore_isClosed _ _
  have hR : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma)
      ((N : Subgroup G) ⧸ R) :=
    proCResidualCoreQuotient_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass hC.melnikovFormation.formation
  let Q : Subgroup P := (N : Subgroup G).comap P.subtype
  have hQclosed : IsClosed (Q : Set P) :=
    N.isClosed.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  have hQ : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) Q :=
    HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.of_isClosed_subgroup
      (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p).isomClosed
      (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_subgroupClosed p) hP Q hQclosed
  let incl : Q →ₜ* (N : Subgroup G) :=
    { toFun := fun z => ⟨((z : P) : G), z.property⟩
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      continuous_toFun :=
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk
          (fun z : Q => z.property) }
  let π : (N : Subgroup G) →ₜ* (N : Subgroup G) ⧸ R :=
    { toMonoidHom := QuotientGroup.mk' R
      continuous_toFun := continuous_quotient_mk' }
  have hdiff (n : (N : Subgroup G)) : MulAut.conjNormal g n / n ∈ R := by
    let d : (N : Subgroup G) := MulAut.conjNormal g n / n
    have hdP : (d : G) ∈ P := by
      have hc : (n : G) * g⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹ ∈ P :=
        (inferInstance : P.Normal).conj_mem g⁻¹ (P.inv_mem hg) (n : G)
      change (g * (n : G) * g⁻¹) / (n : G) ∈ P
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc] using P.mul_mem hg hc
    let dQ : Q := ⟨⟨(d : G), hdP⟩, d.property⟩
    have hd : QuotientGroup.mk' R d = 1 :=
      continuousMonoidHom_eq_one_of_proP_to_proSigma p hp hQ hR (π.comp incl) dQ
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := R) d).mp hd
  by_contra hgn
  apply (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_iff
    hC (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed).mp (hfaith N) g hgn
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' a ?_
  intro z
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' z ?_
  intro n
  change TopologicalAbelianization.congr
      (residualQuotientConjugationContinuousMulEquiv hC (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed g)
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk ((N : Subgroup G) ⧸ R) (QuotientGroup.mk' R n)) =
    TopologicalAbelianization.mk ((N : Subgroup G) ⧸ R) (QuotientGroup.mk' R n)
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    residualQuotientConjugationContinuousMulEquiv_apply_mk]
  apply congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.mk ((N : Subgroup G) ⧸ R))
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem (N := R)).mpr (hdiff n)

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.regularFiberNorm_equivariant
statement:
private theorem regularFiberNorm_equivariant
    {A Q B : Type u} [CommGroup A] [Group Q] [Finite Q] [Group B]
    (J : Subgroup Q) (ρ : J →* B) (j : J) (f : Q → A) :
    regularFiberNorm J ρ
      ((mulAutArrow (G := Q) (A := Q) (M := A)) (j : Q) f) =
      (mulAutArrow (G := B) (A := B) (M := A)) (ρ j) (regularFiberNorm J ρ f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  funext b
  change (∏ k : J, if ρ k = b then f ((j : Q)⁻¹ * k) else 1) =
    ∏ k : J, if ρ k = (ρ j)⁻¹ * b then f (k : Q) else 1
  let e : J ≃ J := Equiv.mulLeft j⁻¹
  apply Fintype.prod_equiv e
  intro k
  change (if ρ k = b then f ((j : Q)⁻¹ * k) else 1) =
    if ρ (j⁻¹ * k) = (ρ j)⁻¹ * b then f ((j⁻¹ * k : J) : Q) else 1
  have h : ρ k = b ↔ ρ (j⁻¹ * k) = (ρ j)⁻¹ * b := by
    simp only [map_mul, map_inv]
    constructor <;> intro hk
    · rw [hk]
    · apply (mul_left_cancel (a := (ρ j)⁻¹))
      exact hk
  simp only [h]
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.isSigmaAbFaithful_singleton_of_elementarySplit_solutions
statement:
theorem isSigmaAbFaithful_singleton_of_elementarySplit_solutions
    (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime]
    (hsolve : HasFiniteSplitAbelianKernelEmbeddingSolutions
      (FiniteGroupClass.abelianExponent q) G) :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful {q} G
proof:
:= by

  intro H B hBfinite hBdiscrete π hπ
  have : Finite B := hBfinite
  have : DiscreteTopology B := hBdiscrete
  have hH : HasFiniteSplitAbelianKernelEmbeddingSolutions
      (FiniteGroupClass.abelianExponent q) (H : Subgroup G) :=
    hsolve.openSubgroup (FiniteGroupClass.abelianExponent_subgroupClosed q)
      (FiniteGroupClass.abelianExponent_finiteProductClosed q) H

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.isSigmaAbFaithful_of_elementarySplit_solutions
statement:
theorem isSigmaAbFaithful_of_elementarySplit_solutions
    {sigma : Set ℕ} (hne : sigma.Nonempty)
    (hprime : ∀ q ∈ sigma, Nat.Prime q)
    (hsolve : ∀ q ∈ sigma, HasFiniteSplitAbelianKernelEmbeddingSolutions
      (FiniteGroupClass.abelianExponent q) G) :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G ∧ ∀ q ∈ sigma, IsSigmaAbFaithful {q} G
proof:
:= by
  have hsingleton : ∀ q ∈ sigma, IsSigmaAbFaithful {q} G := by
    intro q hq
    have : Fact q.Prime := ⟨hprime q hq⟩
    exact isSigmaAbFaithful_singleton_of_elementarySplit_solutions q (hsolve q hq)
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hne
  exact ⟨IsSigmaAbFaithful.mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hq) (hsingleton q hq),
    hsingleton⟩

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.isSigmaAbFaithful_of_abelianSigmaSplit_solutions
statement:
theorem isSigmaAbFaithful_of_abelianSigmaSplit_solutions
    {sigma : Set ℕ} (hne : sigma.Nonempty)
    (hprime : ∀ q ∈ sigma, Nat.Prime q)
    (hsolve : HasFiniteSplitAbelianKernelEmbeddingSolutions
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) G) :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G ∧ ∀ q ∈ sigma, IsSigmaAbFaithful {q} G
proof:
:= by
  apply isSigmaAbFaithful_of_elementarySplit_solutions hne hprime
  intro q hq
  have : Fact q.Prime := ⟨hprime q hq⟩
  intro P hAfin hAdisc hBfin hBdisc hsplit hker hcomm
  exact hsolve P hAfin hAdisc hBfin hBdisc hsplit
    (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_of_abelianExponent q hq hker) hcomm

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.regular_split_problems_suffice
statement:
theorem regular_split_problems_suffice
    {q : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u})
    (hregular :
      ∀ V : OpenNormalSubgroup G,
        let Q := G ⧸ (V : Subgroup G)
        let W := ProCGroups.WreathProducts.PermutationalWreathProduct
          (ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod q))) Q Q
        letI : TopologicalSpace W := ⊥
        ∃ θ : G →ₜ* W,
          Function.Surjective θ ∧
            ∀ g : G,
              (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : W →* Q) (θ g) =
                ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj V g) :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful {q} G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply HasFiniteFaithfulAbelianSigmaEmbeddingSolutions.isSigmaAbFaithful
  intro H B hBfinite hBdiscrete π hπ
  have : Finite B := hBfinite
  have : DiscreteTopology B := hBdiscrete
  obtain ⟨V, _hVH, η, ρ, _hη, hρ, hηval, hρη, hpreimage⟩ :=
    exists_finiteQuotient_factor_of_openSubgroup H π hπ
  let Q := G ⧸ (V : Subgroup G)
  let J : Subgroup Q :=
    ((QuotientGroup.mk' (V : Subgroup G)).comp (H : Subgroup G).subtype).range
  let A := ULift.{u} (Multiplicative (ZMod q))
  let W := ProCGroups.WreathProducts.PermutationalWreathProduct A Q Q
  let : TopologicalSpace W := ⊥
  have : DiscreteTopology W := ⟨rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hθright⟩ := hregular V
  have hθcoord (g : G) : (θ g).right =
      ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj V g := hθright g
  let N : Subgroup W := J.comap (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : W →* Q)
  have hθH (h : H) : θ (h : G) ∈ N := by
    change (θ (h : G)).right ∈ J
    rw [hθcoord]
    exact (hpreimage (h : G)).mpr h.property
  let θH : H →ₜ* N :=
    { toMonoidHom :=
        (θ.toMonoidHom.comp (H : Subgroup G).subtype).codRestrict N hθH
      continuous_toFun :=
        (θ.continuous_toFun.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk hθH }
  have hθHsurj : Function.Surjective θH := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hθ (w : W)
    have hxH : x ∈ H := (hpreimage x).mp (by
      rw [← hθcoord x, hx]
      exact w.property)
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxH⟩, Subtype.ext hx⟩
  let φ : Q →* MulAut (Q → A) := mulAutArrow (G := Q) (A := Q) (M := A)
  let eN : N ≃* (Q → A) ⋊[φ.comp J.subtype] J :=
    ProCGroups.semidirectRightPreimageEquiv φ J
  let W_B := ProCGroups.WreathProducts.PermutationalWreathProduct A B B
  let push : (Q → A) ⋊[φ.comp J.subtype] J →* W_B :=
    SemidirectProduct.map (ProCGroups.regularWreathFiberNorm J ρ.toMonoidHom)
      ρ.toMonoidHom (by
        intro j
        apply MonoidHom.ext
        intro f
        exact ProCGroups.regularWreathFiberNorm_equivariant J ρ.toMonoidHom j f)
  have hpush : Function.Surjective push := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ :=
      ProCGroups.regularWreathFiberNorm_surjective J ρ.toMonoidHom hρ w.left
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hρ w.right
    refine ⟨⟨f, j⟩, ?_⟩
    exact SemidirectProduct.ext hf hj
  let : TopologicalSpace W_B := ⊥
  have : DiscreteTopology W_B := ⟨rfl⟩
  have : Finite W_B := Finite.of_equiv ((B → A) × B)
    (show (B → A) × B ≃ W_B from SemidirectProduct.equivProd.symm)
  let E : TopGrp.{u} := TopGrp.of W_B
  let α : E →ₜ* B :=
    { toMonoidHom := (SemidirectProduct.rightHom : W_B →* B)
      continuous_toFun := continuous_of_discreteTopology }
  have hα : Function.Surjective α := SemidirectProduct.rightHom_surjective
  have hcomm : ∀ a b : α.toMonoidHom.ker, Commute (a : E) (b : E) :=
    regularWreathKernel_commute (A := A) (B := B)
  have hSigma : FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup {q} α.toMonoidHom.ker :=
    FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_of_abelianExponent q (Set.mem_singleton q)
      (regularWreathKernel_cyclicZMod_mem_abelianExponent (B := B) q)
  have hfaith : Function.Injective
      (abelianKernelConjugation α.toMonoidHom hα hcomm) :=
    regularWreathKernel_conjugation_injective (A := A) (B := B)
  let ψ : N →ₜ* E :=
    { toMonoidHom := push.comp eN.toMonoidHom
      continuous_toFun := continuous_of_discreteTopology }
  refine ⟨E, inferInstance, inferInstance, α, hα, hcomm, hSigma, hfaith,
    ⟨⟨ψ.comp θH, (hpush.comp eN.surjective).comp hθHsurj, ?_⟩⟩⟩
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
  intro h
  change ρ ⟨(θ (h : G)).right, hθH h⟩ = π h
  have hcoord : (⟨(θ (h : G)).right, hθH h⟩ : J) = η h := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (hθcoord (h : G)).trans (hηval h).symm
  rw [hcoord]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hρη h

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.invariantResidualAbelianQuotientKernel_mk_eq_iff
statement:
theorem invariantResidualAbelianQuotientKernel_mk_eq_iff
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup Ab) (n m : (N : Subgroup H)) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' (invariantResidualAbelianQuotientKernel hC N U : Subgroup H)
        (n : H) =
      QuotientGroup.mk' (invariantResidualAbelianQuotientKernel hC N U : Subgroup H)
        (m : H) ↔
      invariantResidualAbelianQuotientMap hC N U n =
        invariantResidualAbelianQuotientMap hC N U m
proof:
:= by
  change ((n : H) : H ⧸ (invariantResidualAbelianQuotientKernel hC N U : Subgroup H)) =
      ((m : H) : H ⧸ (invariantResidualAbelianQuotientKernel hC N U : Subgroup H)) ↔ _
  rw [QuotientGroup.eq]
  change ((n⁻¹ * m : (N : Subgroup H)) : H) ∈
    invariantResidualAbelianQuotientKernel hC N U ↔ _
  rw [mem_invariantResidualAbelianQuotientKernel_iff, map_mul, map_inv, inv_mul_eq_one]

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.invariantResidualAbelianQuotientKernel_commute
