name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.HasFiniteFaithfulAbelianSigmaEmbeddingSolutions.isSigmaAbFaithful
statement:
theorem HasFiniteFaithfulAbelianSigmaEmbeddingSolutions.isSigmaAbFaithful
    {sigma : Set ℕ} {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (hG : HasFiniteFaithfulAbelianSigmaEmbeddingSolutions sigma G) :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G
proof:
:= by
  intro H
  have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
    H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  intro N
  let B : TopGrp.{u} := TopGrp.of ((H : Subgroup G) ⧸ (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)))
  obtain ⟨E, hEfinite, hEdiscrete, α, hα, hcomm, hSigma, hfaithful, ⟨θ⟩⟩ :=
    hG H B inferInstance inferInstance (ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj N)
      (ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_surjective N)
  have : DiscreteTopology E := hEdiscrete
  have hsquare (h : (H : Subgroup G)) :
      α (θ.val h) = ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj N h :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun θ.property.2 h
  have hθN (n : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G))) :
      θ.val (n : (H : Subgroup G)) ∈ α.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    change α (θ.val (n : (H : Subgroup G))) = 1
    rw [hsquare]
    exact ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_eq_one_iff.mpr n.property
  let f : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) →* E :=
    θ.val.toMonoidHom.comp (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)).subtype
  let i : f.range →* α.toMonoidHom.ker :=
    { toFun := fun a => ⟨a.val, by
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := a.property
        rw [← hn]
        exact hθN n⟩
      map_one' := Subtype.ext rfl
      map_mul' := fun a b => Subtype.ext rfl }
  have hImage : FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma f.range :=
    (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma).hereditary.of_injective hSigma i
      (fun a b hab => Subtype.ext
        (congrArg (fun z : α.toMonoidHom.ker => (z : E)) hab))
  apply injective_residualQuotientConjugation_of_selfCentralizing_image
    (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma) N θ.val hImage
  · intro n m
    exact hcomm ⟨θ.val (n : (H : Subgroup G)), hθN n⟩
      ⟨θ.val (m : (H : Subgroup G)), hθN m⟩
  · intro h hh
    have hker : θ.val h ∈ α.toMonoidHom.ker := by
      apply (abelianKernelConjugation_injective_iff α.toMonoidHom hα hcomm).mp hfaithful
      intro a
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := θ.property.1 (a : E)
      have hnN : n ∈ N := by
        apply ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_eq_one_iff.mp
        rw [← hsquare, hn]
        exact a.property
      rw [← hn]
      exact hh ⟨n, hnN⟩
    apply ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_eq_one_iff.mp
    rw [← hsquare]
    exact hker

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.not_isSigmaAbFaithful_of_abelian_normal_prime_quotient
statement:
theorem not_isSigmaAbFaithful_of_abelian_normal_prime_quotient
    {sigma : Set ℕ} {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] (hr : r ∉ sigma)
    (I : Subgroup G) [I.Normal] [IsMulCommutative I]
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup G)
    (hcard : Nat.card (G ⧸ (N : Subgroup G)) = r)
    (hI : ¬ I ≤ (N : Subgroup G)) :
    ¬ IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G
proof:
:= by
  intro hG
  let hC : FiniteGroupClass.FullFormation (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup.{u} sigma) :=
    FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma
  have hfaith : Function.Injective
      (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation hC (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed) := by
    let H : OpenSubgroup G := ⊤
    have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
      H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    let e : G ≃ₜ* (H : Subgroup G) :=
      { toMulEquiv := Subgroup.topEquiv.symm
        continuous_toFun := continuous_id.subtype_mk (fun _ => Subgroup.mem_top _)
        continuous_invFun := continuous_subtype_val }
    let Nmap : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup G) :=
      ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.map
        (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom e)
        e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap e.surjective N
    exact (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
      hC e (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed).mp (hG H Nmap)
  have : CompactSpace (N : Subgroup G) :=
    N.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let R : Subgroup (N : Subgroup G) :=
    proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) (N : Subgroup G)
  let A := TopologicalAbelianization ((N : Subgroup G) ⧸ R)
  let q : (N : Subgroup G) →* A :=
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk ((N : Subgroup G) ⧸ R)).comp (QuotientGroup.mk' R)
  have hpowinj : Function.Injective (fun a : A => a ^ r) :=
    residualAbelianization_pow_left_injective_of_prime_not_mem (N : Subgroup G) r hr
  apply hI
  intro t htI
  have htr : t ^ r ∈ (N : Subgroup G) := by
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := (N : Subgroup G)) (t ^ r)).mp
    change QuotientGroup.mk' (N : Subgroup G) (t ^ r) = 1
    rw [map_pow, ← hcard]
    exact pow_card_eq_one'
  let tr : (N : Subgroup G) := ⟨t ^ r, htr⟩
  have hqconj (n : (N : Subgroup G)) : q (MulAut.conjNormal t n) = q n := by
    let c : (N : Subgroup G) := MulAut.conjNormal t n / n
    let uI : I :=
      ⟨(n : G) * t⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹,
        (inferInstance : I.Normal).conj_mem t⁻¹ (I.inv_mem htI) (n : G)⟩
    have hcomm : Commute t ((n : G) * t⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹) := by
      change t * ((n : G) * t⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹) =
        ((n : G) * t⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹) * t
      exact congrArg (fun z : I => (z : G)) (mul_comm (⟨t, htI⟩ : I) uI)
    have hupow : ((n : G) * t⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹) ^ r =
        (n : G) * (t ^ r)⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹ := by
      simpa only [MulAut.conj_apply, inv_pow] using
        (map_pow (MulAut.conj (n : G)) t⁻¹ r).symm
    have hcpow : c ^ r = tr * n * tr⁻¹ * n⁻¹ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ((t * (n : G) * t⁻¹) / (n : G)) ^ r =
        t ^ r * (n : G) * (t ^ r)⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹
      calc
        ((t * (n : G) * t⁻¹) / (n : G)) ^ r =
            (t * ((n : G) * t⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹)) ^ r := by
          simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc]
        _ = t ^ r * ((n : G) * t⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹) ^ r := hcomm.mul_pow r
        _ = t ^ r * (n : G) * (t ^ r)⁻¹ * (n : G)⁻¹ := by
          rw [hupow]
          simp only [mul_assoc]
    have hcp : (q c) ^ r = 1 := by
      rw [← map_pow, hcpow]
      simp only [map_mul, map_inv]
      rw [mul_comm (q tr) (q n), mul_assoc (q n) (q tr) (q tr)⁻¹,
        mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel]
    have hc : q c = 1 := hpowinj (by simpa only [one_pow] using hcp)
    exact div_eq_one.mp (by simpa only [c, map_div] using hc)
  by_contra htN
  apply (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_iff
    hC (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed).mp hfaith t htN
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' a ?_
  intro z
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' z ?_
  intro n
  change TopologicalAbelianization.congr
      (residualQuotientConjugationContinuousMulEquiv hC (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed t)
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk ((N : Subgroup G) ⧸ R) (QuotientGroup.mk' R n)) =
    TopologicalAbelianization.mk ((N : Subgroup G) ⧸ R) (QuotientGroup.mk' R n)
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    residualQuotientConjugationContinuousMulEquiv_apply_mk]
  exact hqconj n

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.IsSigmaAbFaithful.openSubgroup
statement:
theorem IsSigmaAbFaithful.openSubgroup {sigma : Set ℕ} {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (hG : IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G) (U : OpenSubgroup G) :
    letI : CompactSpace (U : Subgroup G)
proof:
:=
      U.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma (U : Subgroup G) := by
  have : CompactSpace (U : Subgroup G) :=
    U.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  intro H
  have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup (U : Subgroup G)) :=
    H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  intro N
  let Hmap : OpenSubgroup G :=
    { toSubgroup := (H : Subgroup (U : Subgroup G)).map (U : Subgroup G).subtype
      isOpen' := U.isOpen.isOpenMap_subtype_val _ H.isOpen }
  have : CompactSpace (Hmap : Subgroup G) :=
    Hmap.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let e : (H : Subgroup (U : Subgroup G)) ≃* (Hmap : Subgroup G) :=
    (H : Subgroup (U : Subgroup G)).equivMapOfInjective
      (U : Subgroup G).subtype Subtype.val_injective
  have he : Continuous e :=
    Continuous.subtype_mk (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val) _
  let t : (H : Subgroup (U : Subgroup G)) ≃ₜ* (Hmap : Subgroup G) :=
    { toMulEquiv := e
      continuous_toFun := he
      continuous_invFun :=
        (e.toEquiv.toHomeomorphOfContinuousClosed he he.isClosedMap).continuous_invFun }
  let Nmap : OpenNormalSubgroup (Hmap : Subgroup G) :=
    ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.map
      (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom t)
      t.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap t.surjective N
  exact (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
    (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma) t
    (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup (U : Subgroup G))) N.isClosed).mp (hG Hmap Nmap)

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.IsSigmaAbFaithful.of_continuousMulEquiv
statement:
theorem IsSigmaAbFaithful.of_continuousMulEquiv
    {G H : Type u} [Group G] [Group H]
    [TopologicalSpace G] [TopologicalSpace H]
    [IsTopologicalGroup G] [IsTopologicalGroup H]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    [CompactSpace H] [T2Space H] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace H]
    {sigma : Set ℕ} (e : G ≃ₜ* H) (hH : IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma H) :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G
proof:
:= by
  intro U
  have : CompactSpace (U : Subgroup G) := U.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let V : OpenSubgroup H :=
    { toSubgroup := (U : Subgroup G).map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
      isOpen' := e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap U U.isOpen }
  have : CompactSpace (V : Subgroup H) := V.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let f : (U : Subgroup G) ≃* (V : Subgroup H) :=
    (U : Subgroup G).equivMapOfInjective e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom e.injective
  have hf : Continuous f := (e.continuous_toFun.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
  let t : (U : Subgroup G) ≃ₜ* (V : Subgroup H) :=
    { f with
      continuous_toFun := hf
      continuous_invFun :=
        (f.toEquiv.toHomeomorphOfContinuousClosed hf hf.isClosedMap).continuous_invFun }
  intro N
  let M : OpenNormalSubgroup (V : Subgroup H) :=
    ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.map (t : (U : Subgroup G) →ₜ* (V : Subgroup H))
      t.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap t.surjective N
  exact (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
    (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma) t
    (N : Subgroup (U : Subgroup G)) N.isClosed).mp (hH V M)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.equivariant_action_kernels
statement:
theorem equivariant_action_kernels
    {Q : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type w} {C : Type x}
    [Group Q] [Group A] [Group B] [Group C]
    (ρA : Q →* MulAut A) (ρB : Q →* MulAut B) (ρC : Q →* MulAut C)
    (i : B →* A) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (s : B →* C) (hs : Function.Surjective s)
    (hi_equivariant : ∀ (q : Q) (b : B), i (ρB q b) = ρA q (i b))
    (hs_equivariant : ∀ (q : Q) (b : B), s (ρB q b) = ρC q (s b)) :
    (∀ q : Q, ρA q = 1 → ρB q = 1) ∧
      (∀ q : Q, ρB q = 1 → ρC q = 1) ∧
      ((∃ q : Q, ρC q ≠ 1) → ∃ q : Q, ρA q ≠ 1) ∧
      (Function.Injective ρC → Function.Injective ρA) ∧
      ((∀ q : Q, ρA q = 1) → ∀ q : Q, ρC q = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : ∀ q : Q, ρA q = 1 → ρB q = 1 := by
    intro q hA
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro b
    apply hi
    calc
      i (ρB q b) = ρA q (i b) := hi_equivariant q b
      _ = i b := by rw [hA]; rfl
  have hBC : ∀ q : Q, ρB q = 1 → ρC q = 1 := by
    intro q hB
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro c
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hs c
    calc
      ρC q (s b) = s (ρB q b) := (hs_equivariant q b).symm
      _ = s b := by rw [hB]; rfl
  refine ⟨hAB, hBC, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    exact ⟨q, fun hA => hq (hBC q (hAB q hA))⟩
  · intro hC x y hxy
    have hA : ρA (x * y⁻¹) = 1 := by
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, hxy, mul_inv_cancel]
    have hCxy := hBC (x * y⁻¹) (hAB (x * y⁻¹) hA)
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, mul_inv_eq_one] at hCxy
    exact hC hCxy
  · intro hA q
    exact hBC q (hAB q (hA q))

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.isSigmaAbFaithful_iff_isAbFaithful_of_proSigma
statement:
theorem isSigmaAbFaithful_iff_isAbFaithful_of_proSigma
    {sigma : Set ℕ} {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (hpro : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) G) :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G ↔ IsAbFaithful G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact IsSigmaAbFaithful.isAbFaithful
  · intro hfaith H
    have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
      H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    intro N
    have hH : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma)
        (H : Subgroup G) :=
      HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.of_isClosed_subgroup_of_fullFormation
        (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma) hpro
        (H : Subgroup G) H.isClosed
    have hN : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma)
        (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) :=
      HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.of_isClosed_subgroup_of_fullFormation
        (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma) hH
        (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) N.isClosed
    exact residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_of_ordinary_of_proC
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma)
      (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup G)) N.isClosed hN (hfaith H N)

name: ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.IsSigmaAbFaithful.isAbFaithful
statement:
theorem IsSigmaAbFaithful.isAbFaithful {sigma : Set ℕ} {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_primaryCharacter_transfer_fixed
statement:
theorem exists_primaryCharacter_transfer_fixed
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hD : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup G) (hDU : D ≤ (U : Subgroup G))
    (χ : (U : Subgroup G) →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt ℓ))
    (f : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt ℓ))
    (hχ : ∀ d : D, χ (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d) =
      f (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ)
        (TopologicalAbelianization D)) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d))) :
    ∃ F : GroupPrimaryAbelianization ℓ G →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt ℓ),
      ∀ a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D,
        a ∈ primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hD (⊤ : Subgroup G) →
          F (primaryInclusionMap ℓ D hD a) =
            f a ^ Nat.card (G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ψ := openNormalCharacterTransfer U χ
  let F := liftPadicCharacter (TopologicalAbelianization.lift ψ)
  refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
    (proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ) (TopologicalAbelianization D)) a
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk D b
  change ψ (d : G) =
    f (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ)
      (TopologicalAbelianization D)) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d)) ^
      Nat.card (G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G))
  let : Fintype (G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  change openNormalCharacterTransfer U χ (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d) = _
  rw [openNormalCharacterTransfer_apply_of_mem]
  have hterm (q : G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G)) :
      χ (MulAut.conjNormal ((quotientOpenSubgroupSection (U : Subgroup G) q)⁻¹)
        (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d)) =
      f (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ)
        (TopologicalAbelianization D)) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d)) := by
    let g := (quotientOpenSubgroupSection (U : Subgroup G) q)⁻¹
    have hconj : MulAut.conjNormal g (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d) =
        Subgroup.inclusion hDU (MulAut.conjNormal g d) := Subtype.ext rfl
    change χ (MulAut.conjNormal g (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d)) = _
    rw [hconj, hχ]
    have hfixed := ha (⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g⟩ : (⊤ : Subgroup G))
    change QuotientGroup.mk' _ (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D (MulAut.conjNormal g d)) =
      QuotientGroup.mk' _ (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d) at hfixed
    exact congrArg f hfixed
  calc
    _ = ∏ _q : G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G),
        f (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ)
          (TopologicalAbelianization D)) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d)) :=
      Fintype.prod_congr _ _ hterm
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_cyclic_extension
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_cyclic_extension
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharP K p]
    (L : IntermediateField K (SeparableClosure K)) [IsGalois K L]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = p) :
    ∃ θ : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K),
      FormalHilbert90 θ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range θ)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos)
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = p := (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdegree
  let e : Gal(L/K) ≃* Multiplicative (ZMod p) := mulEquivOfPrimeCardEq hcard
    (by rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_multiplicative, ZMod.card])
  let r : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) →ₜ* Gal(L/K) :=
    ⟨AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom L, InfiniteGalois.restrictNormalHom_continuous L⟩
  have hr : Function.Surjective r := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective (SeparableClosure K)
  let χsep : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    (⟨e.toMonoidHom, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩ : Gal(L/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p)).comp r
  let c := ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K
  let χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    χsep.comp (c : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Gal(SeparableClosure K/K))
  apply exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_character p K χ
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective χ := e.surjective.comp (hr.comp c.surjective)
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hsurj (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod p))
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  rw [hσ]
  change (1 : ZMod p) ≠ 0
  exact one_ne_zero

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.relativeDerived_mem_iff
statement:
theorem relativeDerived_mem_iff
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (D : Subgroup G) (hD : IsClosed (D : Set G)) (d : D) :
    (d : G) ∈ relativeDerived D ↔ TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show relativeDerived D = (Subgroup.closedCommutator D).map D.subtype from
    (map_closedCommutator_subtype D hD).symm]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he, hed⟩
    have : e = d := Subtype.ext hed
    subst e
    exact TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff.mpr he
  · intro hd
    exact ⟨d, TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff.mp hd, rfl⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.relativeDerived_quotient_mem_openNormal_of_centralizes
statement:
theorem relativeDerived_quotient_mem_openNormal_of_centralizes
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal]
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup G) (hDN : D ≤ (N : Subgroup G))
    (hN : Function.Injective
      (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) (N := (N : Subgroup G))))
    (x : G)
    (hx : QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D) x ∈
      Subgroup.centralizer (((N : Subgroup G).map
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D))) : Set (RelativeDerivedQuotient D))) :
    x ∈ (N : Subgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := (N : Subgroup G)) x).mp
  apply hN
  rw [map_one]
  apply quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_iff.mpr
  intro n
  have hc : ⁅x, (n : G)⁆ ∈ relativeDerived D := by
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := relativeDerived D) _).mp
    change QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D) ⁅x, (n : G)⁆ = 1
    rw [map_commutatorElement]
    exact Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff_commutator_eq_one'.mp hx _
      ⟨n, n.property, rfl⟩
  have hle : relativeDerived D ≤ relativeDerived (N : Subgroup G) :=
    Subgroup.topologicalClosure_mono (Subgroup.commutator_mono hDN hDN)
  have hmem : (((MulAut.conjNormal x) n) * n⁻¹ : (N : Subgroup G)) ∈
      Subgroup.closedCommutator (N : Subgroup G) := by
    apply TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff.mp
    apply (relativeDerived_mem_iff (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed _).mp
    exact hle hc
  exact hmem

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primaryAbelianization_mk_mem_fixed_of_quotient_centralizes
statement:
theorem primaryAbelianization_mk_mem_fixed_of_quotient_centralizes
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hD : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (H : Subgroup G) (d : D)
    (hd : QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D) (d : G) ∈
      Subgroup.centralizer (H.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D)) :
        Set (RelativeDerivedQuotient D)))
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p)
      (TopologicalAbelianization D)) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d) ∈
      primaryFixedSubgroup p D hD H
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc : ⁅(h : G), (d : G)⁆ ∈ relativeDerived D := by
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := relativeDerived D) _).mp
    change QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D) ⁅(h : G), (d : G)⁆ = 1
    rw [map_commutatorElement]
    exact Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff_commutator_eq_one.mp hd _
      ⟨h, h.property, rfl⟩
  have heq : TopologicalAbelianization.mk D ((MulAut.conjNormal (h : G)) d) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d := by
    apply mul_inv_eq_one.mp
    rw [← map_inv, ← map_mul]
    exact (relativeDerived_mem_iff D hD _).mp hc
  change QuotientGroup.mk' _ (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D ((MulAut.conjNormal (h : G)) d)) =
    QuotientGroup.mk' _ (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d)
  exact congrArg (QuotientGroup.mk' _) heq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.relativeDerived_quotient_eq_one_of_primaryFixed_eq_bot
statement:
theorem relativeDerived_quotient_eq_one_of_primaryFixed_eq_bot
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hD : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (hfixed : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime],
      Nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization p D) → primaryFixedSubgroup p D hD H = ⊥)
    (d : D)
    (hd : QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D) (d : G) ∈
      Subgroup.centralizer (H.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D)) :
        Set (RelativeDerivedQuotient D))) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D) (d : G) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := relativeDerived D) _).mpr
  apply (relativeDerived_mem_iff D hD d).mpr
  have : CompactSpace D := hD.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (TopologicalAbelianization D) :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (Subgroup.closedCommutator D) (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator D)
  apply eq_one_of_forall_primaryQuotient
  intro p _
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization p D) with
  | inl h => exact h.elim _ _
  | inr h =>
      exact Subgroup.mem_bot.mp ((hfixed p h) ▸
        primaryAbelianization_mk_mem_fixed_of_quotient_centralizes D hD H d hd p)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primaryFixed_eq_one_of_inclusion_eq_one
statement:
theorem primaryFixed_eq_one_of_inclusion_eq_one
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hD : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker)
    (hLift : RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ)
    (a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D)
    (ha : a ∈ primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hD (⊤ : Subgroup G))
    (hzero : primaryInclusionMap ℓ D hD a = 1) : a = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨U, hDU, c, hc⟩ :=
    exists_padicCocycle_detecting_primary D hD θ hDθ hLift a hne
  let f := c.primaryCharacter D hD hDθ hDU
  have hUθ : (U : Subgroup G) ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    intro u hu
    have hconj := c.primaryCharacter_conj D hD hDθ hDU ⟨u, hu⟩ a
    rw [ha (⟨u, Subgroup.mem_top u⟩ : (⊤ : Subgroup G))] at hconj
    have heq : (θ u : PadicInt ℓ) = 1 :=
      mul_right_cancel₀ hc (hconj.symm.trans (one_mul _).symm)
    exact Units.ext heq
  let χ : (U : Subgroup G) →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt ℓ) :=
    { toFun := fun u => Multiplicative.ofAdd (c.toFun u)
      map_one' := c.map_one
      map_mul' := by
        intro u v
        change c.toFun (u * v) = c.toFun u + c.toFun v
        rw [c.cocycle, show θ (u : G) = 1 from hUθ u.property, Units.val_one, one_mul]
      continuous_toFun := c.continuous_toFun }
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_primaryCharacter_transfer_fixed D hD U hDU χ f (by
    intro d
    exact (c.primaryCharacter_mk D hD hDθ hDU d).symm)
  have heval := hF a ha
  rw [hzero, map_one] at heval
  have hpow : Nat.card (G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G)) • (f a).toAdd = 0 :=
    congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd heval.symm
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul] at hpow
  have hcard : (Nat.card (G ⧸ (U : Subgroup G)) : PadicInt ℓ) ≠ 0 :=
    Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.card_ne_zero.mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩)
  exact hc ((mul_eq_zero.mp hpow).resolve_left hcard)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primaryInclusionMap_injective_on_fixed
statement:
theorem primaryInclusionMap_injective_on_fixed
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hD : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker)
    (hLift : RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun a : primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hD (⊤ : Subgroup G) =>
        primaryInclusionMap ℓ D hD (a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  change primaryInclusionMap ℓ D hD (a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) =
    primaryInclusionMap ℓ D hD (b : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) at hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply mul_inv_eq_one.mp
  apply primaryFixed_eq_one_of_inclusion_eq_one D hD θ hDθ hLift
  · exact (primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hD (⊤ : Subgroup G)).mul_mem a.property
      ((primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hD (⊤ : Subgroup G)).inv_mem b.property)
  · rw [map_mul, map_inv, hab, mul_inv_cancel]

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.infinite_range_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation_of_infinite_extension
statement:
theorem infinite_range_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation_of_infinite_extension
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type u) [Field K] [NeZero (p : K)]
    (hdegree : ¬ FiniteDimensional K (primaryCyclotomicExtension K p)) :
    Set.Infinite (Set.range (absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : NeZero (p : SeparableClosure K) := ⟨by
    intro hp
    apply NeZero.ne (p : K)
    apply (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).injective
    rw [map_natCast, map_zero]
    exact hp⟩
  let χ := galoisCyclotomicOrientation p K (SeparableClosure K)
  have hsep : Set.Infinite (Set.range χ) := by
    intro hfin
    have : Finite (Set.range χ) := hfin.to_subtype
    have hcont : Continuous (fun σ : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) =>
        (⟨χ σ, σ, rfl⟩ : Set.range χ)) := χ.continuous.subtype_mk _
    let oneχ : Set.range χ := ⟨1, 1, map_one χ⟩
    have hopen : IsOpen (χ.toMonoidHom.ker : Set Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) := by
      have ho := (isOpen_discrete ({oneχ} : Set (Set.range χ))).preimage hcont
      convert ho using 1
      ext σ
      exact ⟨fun h => Subtype.ext h, fun h => congrArg Subtype.val h⟩
    let E := IntermediateField.fixedField χ.toMonoidHom.ker
    have hfix : E.fixingSubgroup = χ.toMonoidHom.ker :=
      InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField
        ⟨χ.toMonoidHom.ker, isClosed_eq χ.continuous continuous_const⟩
    have : FiniteDimensional K E := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite E).mp (by
      rw [hfix]
      exact hopen)
    have hle : primaryCyclotomicExtension K p ≤ E := by
      apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
      exact KummerTheory.primaryUnit_mem_fixedField_cyclotomic_ker p z
    apply hdegree
    exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective (IntermediateField.inclusion hle).toLinearMap
      (IntermediateField.inclusion hle).injective
  intro hfin
  apply hsep
  have hrange : Set.range χ = Set.range (absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K) := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨τ, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ :=
        (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K).surjective τ
      exact ⟨σ, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K σ, rfl⟩
  exact hrange ▸ hfin

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.relative_centerfree_and_slim_criterion
statement:
theorem relative_centerfree_and_slim_criterion
    (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u})
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal]
    (hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G)) (hDderived : D ≤ topDerivedTop G 1)
    (hFaithful : ∀ N : OpenNormalSubgroup G,
      D ≤ (N : Subgroup G) →
      Function.Injective
        (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
          (G := G) (N := (N : Subgroup G))))
    (hOrient : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime],
      Nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) →
        ∃ θ : Orientation ℓ G, RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ) :
    Subgroup.center (RelativeDerivedQuotient D) = ⊥ ∧
      ((∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime],
        Nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) →
          ∃ θ : Orientation ℓ G,
            RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range θ)) →
        IsSlim (RelativeDerivedQuotient D))
proof:
:= by
  have hDθ {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime] (θ : Orientation ℓ G) :
      D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    intro d hd
    change θ d = 1
    have hdcomm : d ∈ Subgroup.closedCommutator G := by
      simpa only [topDerivedTop, closedDerivedSeries_top_one_eq_closedCommutator] using
        hDderived hd
    rw [← TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk θ d,
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff.mpr hdcomm, map_one]
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (relativeDerived D)
  have hf (N : OpenNormalSubgroup G) (hDN : D ≤ (N : Subgroup G)) (x : G)
      (hx : q x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ((N : Subgroup G).map q : Set (RelativeDerivedQuotient D))) :
      x ∈ (N : Subgroup G) :=
    relativeDerived_quotient_mem_openNormal_of_centralizes D N hDN (hFaithful N hDN) x hx
  constructor
  · apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (relativeDerived D) z
    have hxD : x ∈ D := by
      apply ProCGroups.ProC.mem_closedSubgroup_of_forall_openNormal_sup ⟨D, hDclosed⟩
      intro U
      exact hf (ProCGroups.ProC.openNormalSubgroup_sup_normal D U) le_sup_left x
        (Subgroup.center_le_centralizer _ hz)
    apply relativeDerived_quotient_eq_one_of_primaryFixed_eq_bot D hDclosed
      (⊤ : Subgroup G) (d := ⟨x, hxD⟩)
    · intro ℓ _ hNontrivial
      obtain ⟨θ, hLift⟩ := hOrient ℓ hNontrivial
      exact (oriented_invariants G D hDclosed θ (hDθ θ) hLift).2.2.1 hDderived
    · exact Subgroup.center_le_centralizer _ hz
  · intro hInfinite U
    apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (relativeDerived D) z
    let V : OpenSubgroup G := OpenSubgroup.comap q QuotientGroup.continuous_mk U
    have hxV : q x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ((V : Subgroup G).map q :
        Set (RelativeDerivedQuotient D)) := by
      rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact hz (q v) hv
    apply ProCGroups.quotient_eq_one_of_relative_fixedPoints q
      (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _) D hDclosed hf _ V x hxV
    intro H d hd hfixed
    apply relativeDerived_quotient_eq_one_of_primaryFixed_eq_bot D hDclosed
      (H : Subgroup G) (d := ⟨d, hd⟩) _ hfixed
    intro ℓ _ hNontrivial
    obtain ⟨θ, hLift, hImage⟩ := hInfinite ℓ hNontrivial
    exact (oriented_invariants G D hDclosed θ (hDθ θ) hLift).2.2.2 hImage H

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_finiteCocycle_lift_succ_of_twoCocycles
statement:
theorem exists_finiteCocycle_lift_succ_of_twoCocycles
    (θ : Orientation p G) (H : Subgroup G)
    (hθ : ∀ g : G, PadicInt.toZModPow 1 (θ g : PadicInt p) = 1)
    (hH2 : ∀ z : H → H → ZMod p,
      (∀ σ τ υ : H, z σ (τ * υ) + z τ υ = z (σ * τ) υ + z σ τ) →
      IsLocallyConstant (fun x : H × H => z x.1 x.2) →
      ∃ d : H → ZMod p, IsLocallyConstant d ∧
        ∀ σ τ : H, d τ - d (σ * τ) + d σ = z σ τ)
    (n : ℕ) (c : FiniteCocycle θ H n) :
    ∃ d : FiniteCocycle θ H (n + 1), ∀ g : H,
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n))
        (d.toFun g) = c.toFun g
proof:
:= by
  let θH : H →ₜ* (PadicInt p)ˣ :=
    θ.comp ⟨H.subtype, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let θn : H →ₜ* (ZMod (p ^ (n + 1)))ˣ :=
    { toMonoidHom := (Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow (n + 1)).toMonoidHom).comp
        θH.toMonoidHom
      continuous_toFun := ((PadicInt.continuous_toZModPow (n + 1)).units_map
        (PadicInt.toZModPow (n + 1)).toMonoidHom).comp θH.continuous }
  have hθn (g : H) :
      ZMod.castHom (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)) (ZMod p)
        (θn g : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) = 1 := by
    have h := RingHom.congr_fun
      (PadicInt.zmod_cast_comp_toZModPow 1 (n + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)))
      (θ (g : G) : PadicInt p)
    have hh := h.trans (hθ g)
    change ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)))
      (ZMod (p ^ 1)) (PadicInt.toZModPow (n + 1) (θ (g : G) : PadicInt p)) = 1 at hh
    change ZMod.castHom (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)) (ZMod p)
      (PadicInt.toZModPow (n + 1) (θ (g : G) : PadicInt p)) = 1
    have hh' := congrArg (ZMod.castHom (show p ∣ p ^ 1 by rw [pow_one]) (ZMod p)) hh
    rw [map_one] at hh'
    have hcomp := RingHom.congr_fun
      (ZMod.castHom_comp (show p ∣ p ^ 1 by rw [pow_one])
        (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n))))
      (PadicInt.toZModPow (n + 1) (θ (g : G) : PadicInt p))
    exact hcomp.symm.trans hh'
  have hc (σ τ : H) : c.toFun (σ * τ) = c.toFun σ +
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (p ^ n))
        (θn σ : ZMod (p ^ (n + 1))) * c.toFun τ := by
    rw [c.cocycle]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    exact (RingHom.congr_fun
      (PadicInt.zmod_cast_comp_toZModPow n (n + 1) (Nat.le_succ n))
      (θ (σ : G) : PadicInt p)).symm
  obtain ⟨d, hdcont, hd, hred⟩ :=
    GaloisCohomology.exists_lift_crossed_cocycle_succ hH2 n θn hθn
      c.toFun c.continuous_toFun hc
  exact ⟨⟨d, hdcont, hd⟩, hred⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.formalHilbert90_of_twoCocycles
statement:
theorem formalHilbert90_of_twoCocycles
    (θ : Orientation p G)
    (hθ : ∀ g : G, PadicInt.toZModPow 1 (θ g : PadicInt p) = 1)
    (hH2 : ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G, ∀ z : ↥(H : Subgroup G) → ↥(H : Subgroup G) → ZMod p,
      (∀ σ τ υ : (H : Subgroup G),
        z σ (τ * υ) + z τ υ = z (σ * τ) υ + z σ τ) →
      IsLocallyConstant (fun x : ↥(H : Subgroup G) × ↥(H : Subgroup G) => z x.1 x.2) →
      ∃ d : ↥(H : Subgroup G) → ZMod p, IsLocallyConstant d ∧
        ∀ σ τ : (H : Subgroup G), d τ - d (σ * τ) + d σ = z σ τ) :
    FormalHilbert90 θ
proof:
:= by
  intro H n hn
  apply h1_reduction_surjective_of_finiteCocycle_lifting
  intro c
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k =>
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      intro g
      rw [ZMod.castHom_self]
      rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ih (by omega)
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_finiteCocycle_lift_succ_of_twoCocycles
        θ H hθ (hH2 H) (k + 1) d
      refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
      intro g
      have hcast := RingHom.congr_fun
        (ZMod.castHom_comp (pow_dvd_pow p (show 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega))
          (pow_dvd_pow p (Nat.le_succ (k + 1)))) (e.toFun g)
      exact hcast.symm.trans ((congrArg
        (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow p (show 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega)) (ZMod (p ^ 1)))
        (he g)).trans (hd g))

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.formalHilbert90_galoisCyclotomicOrientation
statement:
theorem formalHilbert90_galoisCyclotomicOrientation
    [IsGalois K Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] [NeZero (p : Ω)] :
    FormalHilbert90 (galoisCyclotomicOrientation p K Ω)
proof:
:= by
  intro H n hn
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k =>
    apply h1_reduction_surjective_of_finiteCocycle_lifting
    intro c
    obtain ⟨d, hdlc, hd, hred⟩ := KummerTheory.exists_cyclotomic_cocycle_lift_open
      p H k c.toFun c.cocycle
      ((IsLocallyConstant.iff_continuous c.toFun).mpr c.continuous_toFun)
    exact ⟨⟨d, (IsLocallyConstant.iff_continuous d).mp hdlc, hd⟩, hred⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.formalHilbert90_trivial_iff_no_primary_torsion
statement:
theorem formalHilbert90_trivial_iff_no_primary_torsion
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u}) :
    FormalHilbert90 (1 : Orientation ℓ G) ↔
      ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G,
        ∀ a : TopologicalAbelianization (H : Subgroup G),
          a ^ ℓ = 1 → a = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hG H a ha
    let : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
      H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    exact no_prime_torsion_of_h1Reduction_trivial (H : Subgroup G) (hG H) a ha
  · intro hG H n hn
    let : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
      H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    exact h1Reduction_trivial_of_no_prime_torsion (H : Subgroup G) (hG H) n hn

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.formalHilbert90_trivial_iff_primary_torsionFree
statement:
theorem formalHilbert90_trivial_iff_primary_torsionFree
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u}) :
    FormalHilbert90 (1 : Orientation ℓ G) ↔
      ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G, IsMulTorsionFree (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ (H : Subgroup G))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hG H
    let : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
      H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    exact primaryAbelianization_isMulTorsionFree_of_h1_trivial (H : Subgroup G) (hG H)
  · intro hG
    apply (formalHilbert90_trivial_iff_no_primary_torsion G).mpr
    intro H a ha
    let : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) :=
      H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    let : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (TopologicalAbelianization (H : Subgroup G)) :=
      ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
        (Subgroup.closedCommutator (H : Subgroup G))
        (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator (H : Subgroup G))
    let : IsMulTorsionFree (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ (H : Subgroup G)) := hG H
    apply ProCGroups.ProC.eq_one_of_prime_torsion_of_primaryQuotient_eq_one a ha
    apply (pow_eq_one_iff_left (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).ne_zero).mp
    rw [← map_pow, ha, map_one]

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.formalHilbert90_trivial_of_isAbTorsionFree
statement:
theorem formalHilbert90_trivial_of_isAbTorsionFree
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u})
    (hG : IsAbTorsionFree G) :
    FormalHilbert90 (1 : Orientation ℓ G)
proof:
:= by
  apply (formalHilbert90_trivial_iff_no_primary_torsion G).2
  intro H a ha
  have hℓ : ℓ ≠ 0 := (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).ne_zero
  exact (@pow_eq_one_iff_left _ _ (hG H) ℓ a hℓ).mp ha

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.h1_reduction_surjective_of_finiteCocycle_lifting
statement:
theorem h1_reduction_surjective_of_finiteCocycle_lifting
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (H : Subgroup G) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hlift : ∀ c : FiniteCocycle θ H 1, ∃ d : FiniteCocycle θ H n,
      ∀ g : H, ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ hn) (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1)) (d.toFun g) = c.toFun g) :
    HasH1ReductionSurjective θ H n hn
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousCohomology.map_surjective_of_crossedHom_lifting
    (finiteOrientationTopRep θ H n) (finiteOrientationTopRep θ H 1)
    (finiteOrientationReduction θ H n hn)
  intro c
  let c₀ : FiniteCocycle θ H 1 :=
    { toFun := fun g => (c.toFun g).down
      continuous_toFun := continuous_uliftDown.comp c.continuous_toFun
      cocycle := fun g h => congrArg ULift.down (c.map_mul g h) }
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hlift c₀
  let d' : ContinuousCohomology.CrossedHom (finiteOrientationTopRep θ H n) :=
    { toFun := fun g => ULift.up (d.toFun g)
      continuous_toFun := continuous_uliftUp.comp d.continuous_toFun
      map_mul := by
        intro g h
        rw [finiteOrientationTopRep_action]
        exact ULift.ext (d.cocycle g h) }
  exact ⟨d', fun g => ULift.ext (hd g)⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_character
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_character
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharP K p]
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p))
    (hχ : ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K), χ σ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ θ : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K),
      FormalHilbert90 θ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range θ)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : FormalHilbert90 (1 : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) := by
    apply formalHilbert90_absolute_of_charP p K
    intro σ
    rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, map_one]
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ := exists_surjective_padic_character_of_formalHilbert90_trivial hF χ hχ
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hmod⟩ := PadicInt.exists_infinite_principal_unit_character p
  let θ : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) := φ.comp ν
  refine ⟨θ, formalHilbert90_absolute_of_charP p K θ (fun σ => hmod (ν σ)), ?_⟩
  apply hφ.mono
  rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := hν x
  exact ⟨σ, rfl⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_artinSchreier
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_artinSchreier
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharP K p]
    (hAS : ∃ a : K, ∀ x : K, x ^ p - x ≠ a) :
    ∃ θ : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K),
      FormalHilbert90 θ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range θ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨χsep, σsep, hσsep⟩ :=
    ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_nontrivial_character_of_artinSchreier_not_surjective
      p (K := K) (Ω := SeparableClosure K) hAS
  let e := ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K
  let χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    χsep.comp (e : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Gal(SeparableClosure K/K))
  have hχ : ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K), χ σ ≠ 1 := by
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := e.surjective σsep
    exact ⟨σ, by change χsep (e σ) ≠ 1; rw [hσ]; exact hσsep⟩
  exact exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_character p K χ hχ

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_surjective_padic_character_of_formalHilbert90_trivial
statement:
theorem exists_surjective_padic_character_of_formalHilbert90_trivial
    (hF : FormalHilbert90 (1 : Orientation p G))
    (χ : G →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p)) (hχ : ∃ g : G, χ g ≠ 1) :
    ∃ ν : G →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt p), Function.Surjective ν
proof:
:= by
  let e : ZMod p ≃+* ZMod (p ^ 1) := ZMod.ringEquivCongr (pow_one p).symm
  let c : FiniteCocycle (1 : Orientation p G) ⊤ 1 :=
    { toFun := fun x => e (χ (x : G)).toAdd
      continuous_toFun := continuous_of_discreteTopology.comp
        (χ.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val)
      cocycle := by
        intro x y
        rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one,
          map_one, one_mul]
        change e (χ ((x : G) * (y : G))).toAdd =
          e (χ (x : G)).toAdd + e (χ (y : G)).toAdd
        rw [map_mul]
        exact map_add e _ _ }
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := finiteCocycle_lift_padic_of_fixed_group
    (1 : Orientation p G) ⊤ (hF ⊤) 1 (by decide) c
  let ν : G →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt p) :=
    { toFun := fun x => Multiplicative.ofAdd (d.toFun ⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top x⟩)
      map_one' := d.map_one
      map_mul' := by
        intro x y
        change d.toFun (⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top x⟩ * ⟨y, Subgroup.mem_top y⟩) =
          d.toFun ⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top x⟩ + d.toFun ⟨y, Subgroup.mem_top y⟩
        rw [d.cocycle]
        rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, one_mul]
      continuous_toFun := d.continuous_toFun.comp
        (continuous_id.subtype_mk (fun x => Subgroup.mem_top x)) }
  refine ⟨ν, PadicInt.surjective_character_of_nonzero_reduction ν ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hχ
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  change PadicInt.toZModPow 1 (d.toFun ⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g⟩) ≠ 0
  rw [hd]
  intro hzero
  apply hg
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  exact e.injective (hzero.trans (map_zero e).symm)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.sigmaAbelianizationProjection_apply
statement:
theorem sigmaAbelianizationProjection_apply (sigma : Set ℕ)
    (A : Type u) [Group A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A] (a : A) :
    sigmaAbelianizationProjection sigma A a =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk _
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) A) a)
proof: := rfl

proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨d, _, rfl⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.mem_sigmaResidualKernel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sigmaResidualKernel_iff {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (D : ClosedSubgroup G) (d : (D : Subgroup G)) :
    (d : G) ∈ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D ↔
      sigmaAbelianizationProjection sigma (D : Subgroup G) d = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, he, hed⟩
    have heq : e = d := Subtype.ext hed
    exact heq ▸ he
  · intro hd
    exact ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.sigmaResidualKernel_isClosed
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace (D : Subgroup G) := D.isClosed'.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace

    (sigmaAbelianizationProjection sigma (D : Subgroup G))).isCompact.image
    continuous_subtype_val).isClosed

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.sigmaResidualKernel_mono
statement:
theorem sigmaResidualKernel_mono {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (D E : ClosedSubgroup G) (hDE : (D : Subgroup G) ≤ (E : Subgroup G)) :
    sigmaResidualKernel sigma D ≤ sigmaResidualKernel sigma E
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace (D : Subgroup G) := D.isClosed'.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let i : (D : Subgroup G) →ₜ* (E : Subgroup G) :=
    ⟨Subgroup.inclusion hDE, continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _⟩
  let f := ProCGroups.QuotientGroup.mapₜ
    (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) (D : Subgroup G))
    (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) (E : Subgroup G)) i
    (Subgroup.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp (map_proCResidualCore_le_of_continuousMonoidHom
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma).hereditary i))
  rintro _ ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨i d, ?_, rfl⟩
  have heq := congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.map f)
    (show sigmaAbelianizationProjection sigma (D : Subgroup G) d = 1 from hd)
  change sigmaAbelianizationProjection sigma (E : Subgroup G) (i d) = 1
  rw [sigmaAbelianizationProjection_apply]
  rw [sigmaAbelianizationProjection_apply, TopologicalAbelianization.map_apply_mk,
    map_one] at heq
  exact heq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.sigmaResidualKernel_iff_primePower_roots
statement:
theorem sigmaResidualKernel_iff_primePower_roots {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (D : ClosedSubgroup G) (d : (D : Subgroup G)) :
    (d : G) ∈ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D ↔
      ∀ p : ℕ, p ∈ sigma → p.Prime → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
        ∃ b : TopologicalAbelianization (D : Subgroup G),
          b ^ (p ^ n) = TopologicalAbelianization.mk (D : Subgroup G) d
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace (D : Subgroup G) := D.isClosed'.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  rw [mem_sigmaResidualKernel_iff]
  have h := residualAbelianization_map_eq_iff_primePower (sigma := sigma) (D : Subgroup G)
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk (D : Subgroup G) d) 1
  dsimp only at h
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.map_apply_mk, map_one] at h
  change sigmaAbelianizationProjection sigma (D : Subgroup G) d = 1 ↔ _ at h
  simpa only [one_mul, eq_comm] using h

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primaryProjection_eq_one_of_mem_sigmaResidualKernel
statement:
theorem primaryProjection_eq_one_of_mem_sigmaResidualKernel {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (D : ClosedSubgroup G) (d : (D : Subgroup G))
    (hd : (d : G) ∈ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ∈ sigma) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p)
      (TopologicalAbelianization (D : Subgroup G)))
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk (D : Subgroup G) d) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace (D : Subgroup G) := D.isClosed'.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let A := TopologicalAbelianization (D : Subgroup G)
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace A := ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
    (Subgroup.closedCommutator (D : Subgroup G))
    (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator (D : Subgroup G))
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A)
  have : IsClosed (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A : Set A) :=
    proCResidualCore_isClosed (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A
  have hQ := proCResidualCoreQuotient_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass
    (G := A) (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_formation p)
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨n, hn, χ, hχ⟩ := exists_primePower_character_proP hQ hne
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (sigmaResidualKernel_iff_primePower_roots sigma D d).mp hd
    p hp (Fact.out : p.Prime) n hn
  apply hχ
  rw [← hb, map_pow, map_pow]
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  change (p ^ n) • (χ (q b)).toAdd = 0
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.mem_sigmaResidualKernel_of_primaryProjections
statement:
theorem mem_sigmaResidualKernel_of_primaryProjections {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (D : ClosedSubgroup G) (d : (D : Subgroup G))
    (hd : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p ∈ sigma →
      QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p)
        (TopologicalAbelianization (D : Subgroup G)))
          (TopologicalAbelianization.mk (D : Subgroup G) d) = 1) :
    (d : G) ∈ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace (D : Subgroup G) := D.isClosed'.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let A := TopologicalAbelianization (D : Subgroup G)
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace A := ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
    (Subgroup.closedCommutator (D : Subgroup G))
    (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator (D : Subgroup G))
  apply (sigmaResidualKernel_iff_primePower_roots sigma D d).mpr
  intro p hp hpprime n _
  have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hpprime⟩
  let P : Subgroup A := (powMonoidHom (α := A) (p ^ n)).range
  let powerMap : A →ₜ* A := ⟨powMonoidHom (p ^ n), continuous_id.pow _⟩
  have hP : IsClosed (P : Set A) := ContinuousMonoidHom.isClosed_range powerMap
  have : IsClosed (P : Set A) := hP
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (A ⧸ P) :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal P hP
  have hQ : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) (A ⧸ P) := by
    apply HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.of_allOpenNormalQuotients
    intro U
    refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
    apply isPGroup_iff_pow_pow_eq_one.mpr
    intro q
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (U : Subgroup (A ⧸ P)) q
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective P b
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow]
    have hb : QuotientGroup.mk' P (b ^ (p ^ n)) = 1 :=
      (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := P) _).mpr ⟨b, rfl⟩
    rw [hb, map_one]
  have hle : proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A ≤ P :=
    proCResidualCore_le_of_proCQuotient P hP hQ
  exact hle ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N :=
    proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A) _).mp (hd p hp))

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.oriented_invariants
statement:
theorem oriented_invariants
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (G : ProfiniteGrp.{u})
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker)
    (hLift : RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ) :
    IsMulTorsionFree (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) ∧
      Function.Injective
        (fun a : primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hDclosed (⊤ : Subgroup G) =>
          primaryInclusionMap ℓ D hDclosed (a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D)) ∧
      (D ≤ topDerivedTop G 1 →
        primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hDclosed (⊤ : Subgroup G) = ⊥) ∧
      (Set.Infinite (Set.range θ) →
        ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G,
          primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hDclosed (H : Subgroup G) = ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  have hMain :
      IsMulTorsionFree (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) ∧
        Function.Injective
          (fun a : primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hDclosed (⊤ : Subgroup G) =>
            primaryInclusionMap ℓ D hDclosed (a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D)) ∧
        (Set.Infinite (Set.range θ) →
          ∀ H : OpenSubgroup G,
            primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hDclosed (H : Subgroup G) = ⊥) := by
    exact ⟨primaryAbelianization_isMulTorsionFree D hDclosed θ hDθ hLift,
      primaryInclusionMap_injective_on_fixed D hDclosed θ hDθ hLift,
      primaryFixedSubgroup_eq_bot_of_infinite_orientation D hDclosed θ hDθ hLift⟩
  rcases hMain with ⟨hTF, hInj, hInfinite⟩
  refine ⟨hTF, hInj, ?_, hInfinite⟩
  intro hDerived
  have hDcomm : D ≤ Subgroup.closedCommutator G := by
    simpa only [topDerivedTop, closedDerivedSeries_top_one_eq_closedCommutator] using hDerived
  have hAbZero (a : TopologicalAbelianization D) :
      abelianizationInclusion D a = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk D a
    change TopologicalAbelianization.mk G (d : G) = 1
    exact TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff.mpr (hDcomm d.property)
  have hPrimaryZero (a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) :
      primaryInclusionMap ℓ D hDclosed a = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
      (proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ)
        (TopologicalAbelianization D)) a
    change QuotientGroup.mk'
      (proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ)
        (TopologicalAbelianization G)) (abelianizationInclusion D b) = 1
    rw [hAbZero b]
    exact map_one _
  apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
  intro a ha
  have hEq : (⟨a, ha⟩ : primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hDclosed (⊤ : Subgroup G)) = 1 :=
    hInj (by simpa using hPrimaryZero a)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hEq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finiteCocycle_lift_succ_of_fixed_group
statement:
theorem finiteCocycle_lift_succ_of_fixed_group
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (H : Subgroup G)
    (hH : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ hn : 1 ≤ n,
      HasH1ReductionSurjective θ H n hn)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (c : FiniteCocycle θ H n) :
    ∃ d : FiniteCocycle θ H (n + 1),
      ∀ x : H,
        ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ n))
          (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) (d.toFun x) = c.toFun x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      exact finiteCocycle_lift_mod_one_of_h1 θ H 2 (by decide) (hH 2 (by decide)) c
    | succ k =>
      let c₁ := c.reduce (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le (k + 1)))
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := finiteCocycle_lift_mod_one_of_h1 θ H ((k + 1) + 1 + 1)
        (by omega) (hH _ (by omega)) c₁
      let e := c.sub (a.reduce (Nat.le_succ ((k + 1) + 1)))
      have he (x : H) :
          ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le (k + 1))))
            (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1)) (e.toFun x) = 0 := by
        change ZMod.castHom _ (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1))
          (c.toFun x - ZMod.castHom _ (ZMod (ℓ ^ ((k + 1) + 1))) (a.toFun x)) = 0
        rw [map_sub]
        have hcomp :
            ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le (k + 1))))
              (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1))
              (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ ((k + 1) + 1)))
                (ZMod (ℓ ^ ((k + 1) + 1))) (a.toFun x)) =
            ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (by omega : 1 ≤ (k + 1) + 1 + 1))
              (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1)) (a.toFun x) := by
          exact RingHom.congr_fun (ZMod.castHom_comp
            (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le (k + 1))))
            (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ ((k + 1) + 1)))) (a.toFun x)
        rw [hcomp, ha]
        exact sub_self _
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := e.exists_divPrime he
      obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := ih (by omega) b
      refine ⟨a.add b'.mulPrime, ?_⟩
      intro x
      change ZMod.castHom _ (ZMod (ℓ ^ ((k + 1) + 1)))
        (a.toFun x + ZMod.mulPow ℓ ((k + 1) + 1) (b'.toFun x)) = c.toFun x
      rw [map_add, ZMod.castHom_mulPow, hb', hb]
      change ZMod.castHom _ (ZMod (ℓ ^ ((k + 1) + 1))) (a.toFun x) +
        (c.toFun x - ZMod.castHom _ (ZMod (ℓ ^ ((k + 1) + 1))) (a.toFun x)) = c.toFun x
      abel

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finiteCocycle_lift_padic_of_fixed_group
statement:
theorem finiteCocycle_lift_padic_of_fixed_group
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (H : Subgroup G)
    (hH : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ hn : 1 ≤ n,
      HasH1ReductionSurjective θ H n hn)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (c : FiniteCocycle θ H n) :
    ∃ d : PadicCocycle θ H,
      ∀ x : H, PadicInt.toZModPow n (d.toFun x) = c.toFun x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let lift (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (b : FiniteCocycle θ H m) :=
    Classical.choose (finiteCocycle_lift_succ_of_fixed_group θ H hH m hm b)
  have hlift (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (b : FiniteCocycle θ H m) (x : H) :
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ m)) (ZMod (ℓ ^ m))
        ((lift m hm b).toFun x) = b.toFun x :=
    Classical.choose_spec (finiteCocycle_lift_succ_of_fixed_group θ H hH m hm b) x
  let seq : ∀ k : ℕ, FiniteCocycle θ H (n + k) :=
    fun k => Nat.rec c (fun k b => lift (n + k) (hn.trans (Nat.le_add_right n k)) b) k
  have hseq (k : ℕ) (x : H) :
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ (n + k))) (ZMod (ℓ ^ (n + k)))
        ((seq (k + 1)).toFun x) = (seq k).toFun x :=
    hlift (n + k) (hn.trans (Nat.le_add_right n k)) (seq k) x
  let f (k : ℕ) (x : H) : ZMod (ℓ ^ k) :=
    ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_add_left k n)) (ZMod (ℓ ^ k))
      ((seq k).toFun x)
  have hcast {a b d : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbd : b ≤ d) (z : ZMod (ℓ ^ d)) :
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ hab) (ZMod (ℓ ^ a))
        (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ hbd) (ZMod (ℓ ^ b)) z) =
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (hab.trans hbd)) (ZMod (ℓ ^ a)) z :=
    by
      change ((ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ hab) (ZMod (ℓ ^ a))).comp
        (ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ hbd) (ZMod (ℓ ^ b)))) z = _
      exact RingHom.congr_fun (Subsingleton.elim _ _) z
  have hfcompat (k : ℕ) (x : H) :
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ k)) (ZMod (ℓ ^ k))
        (f (k + 1) x) = f k x := by
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [hcast (Nat.le_succ k) (Nat.le_add_left (k + 1) n), ← hseq k x,
      hcast (Nat.le_add_left k n) (Nat.le_succ (n + k))]
  obtain ⟨d, hdcont, hd⟩ := PadicInt.exists_continuous_of_compatible_residues f
    (fun k => (continuous_of_discreteTopology).comp (seq k).continuous_toFun) hfcompat
  have hdcocycle (x y : H) : d (x * y) = d x + (θ (x : G) : PadicInt ℓ) * d y := by
    apply PadicInt.ext_of_toZModPow.mp
    intro k
    rw [map_add, map_mul, hd, hd, hd]
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [(seq k).cocycle, map_add, map_mul]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    exact RingHom.congr_fun (PadicInt.zmod_cast_comp_toZModPow k (n + k)
      (Nat.le_add_left k n)) (θ (x : G) : PadicInt ℓ)
  refine ⟨⟨d, hdcont, hdcocycle⟩, ?_⟩
  intro x
  change PadicInt.toZModPow n (d x) = c.toFun x
  rw [hd]
  have hbase (k : ℕ) :
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_add_right n k)) (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))
        ((seq k).toFun x) = c.toFun x := by
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      change (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl (ℓ ^ n)) (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) (c.toFun x) = c.toFun x
      exact RingHom.congr_fun (Subsingleton.elim _ (RingHom.id (ZMod (ℓ ^ n)))) _
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [← ih, ← hseq k x, hcast (Nat.le_add_right n k) (Nat.le_succ (n + k))]
  exact hbase n

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primaryAbelianization_isMulTorsionFree
statement:
theorem primaryAbelianization_isMulTorsionFree
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker)
    (hLift : RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ) :
    IsMulTorsionFree (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro n hn x y hxy
  by_contra hne
  have hne' : x * y⁻¹ ≠ 1 := fun h => hne (mul_inv_eq_one.mp h)
  obtain ⟨U, hDU, c, hc⟩ := exists_padicCocycle_detecting_primary
    D hDclosed θ hDθ hLift (x * y⁻¹) hne'
  let f := c.primaryCharacter D hDclosed hDθ hDU
  have heq : f x = f y := by
    apply IsMulTorsionFree.pow_left_injective hn
    change (f x) ^ n = (f y) ^ n
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow]
    exact congrArg f hxy
  apply hc
  change (f (x * y⁻¹)).toAdd = 0
  rw [map_mul, map_inv, heq, mul_inv_cancel]
  rfl

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primaryFixedSubgroup_eq_bot_of_infinite_orientation
statement:
theorem primaryFixedSubgroup_eq_bot_of_infinite_orientation
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker)
    (hLift : RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ) (hθ : Set.Infinite (Set.range θ))
    (H : OpenSubgroup G) : primaryFixedSubgroup ℓ D hDclosed (H : Subgroup G) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply (Subgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall _).mpr
  intro a ha
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨U, hDU, c, hc⟩ := exists_padicCocycle_detecting_primary
    D hDclosed θ hDθ hLift a hne
  have hker : (U : Subgroup G) ⊓ (H : Subgroup G) ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    intro g hg
    have hconj := c.primaryCharacter_conj D hDclosed hDθ hDU ⟨g, hg.1⟩ a
    rw [ha ⟨g, hg.2⟩] at hconj
    apply Units.ext
    change (θ g : PadicInt ℓ) = 1
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hc
    exact hconj.symm.trans (one_mul _).symm
  have hopen : IsOpen (θ.toMonoidHom.ker : Set G) :=
    Subgroup.isOpen_mono hker (U.isOpen.inter H.isOpen)
  let K : OpenNormalSubgroup G :=
    { toSubgroup := θ.toMonoidHom.ker
      isOpen' := hopen }
  let : Finite (G ⧸ θ.toMonoidHom.ker) :=
    ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientFinite K
  let : Finite θ.toMonoidHom.range :=
    Finite.of_equiv (G ⧸ θ.toMonoidHom.ker)
      (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange θ.toMonoidHom).toEquiv
  apply hθ
  change Set.Finite (θ.toMonoidHom.range : Set (PadicInt ℓ)ˣ)
  exact Set.toFinite _

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.absoluteGalois_finiteStepSolvable_slim_of_roots_and_artinSchreier
statement:
theorem absoluteGalois_finiteStepSolvable_slim_of_roots_and_artinSchreier
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (hG : IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
    (hRoots : ∀ (L : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K)),
      FiniteDimensional K L →
      ∀ (ℓ : ℕ), ℓ.Prime → ringChar K ≠ ℓ →
        Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Lˣ ℓ))
    (hAS : ringChar K ≠ 0 →
      ∃ a : K, ∀ x : K, x ^ ringChar K - x ≠ a) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m →
      IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) m)
proof:
:= by
  have hOrient (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
      ∃ θ : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K),
        FormalHilbert90 θ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range θ) := by
    by_cases hp : (p : K) = 0
    · have hpchar : ringChar K = p :=
        CharP.ringChar_of_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : p.Prime) hp
      have : CharP K p := (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : p.Prime)).mpr hp
      apply exists_infinite_formalHilbert90_orientation_of_artinSchreier p K
      have hnonzero : ringChar K ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hpchar]
        exact (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
      simpa only [hpchar] using hAS hnonzero
    · have : NeZero (p : K) := ⟨hp⟩
      refine ⟨absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K,
        formalHilbert90_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K, ?_⟩
      apply infinite_range_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation_of_finite_primary p K
      intro L hL
      apply hRoots L hL p (Fact.out : p.Prime)
      intro heq
      have : CharP K p := heq ▸ (inferInstance : CharP K (ringChar K))
      exact hp (CharP.cast_eq_zero K p)
  exact (finiteStepSolvable_centerfree_and_slim_of_formalHilbert90
    (ProfiniteGrp.of Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) hG
    (fun p _ => ⟨(hOrient p).choose, (hOrient p).choose_spec.1⟩)).2 hOrient

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.FiniteCocycle.exists_divPrime
statement:
theorem exists_divPrime {n : ℕ} (c : FiniteCocycle θ H (n + 1))
    (hc : ∀ x : H, ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)))
      (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1)) (c.toFun x) = 0) :
    ∃ d : FiniteCocycle θ H n, ∀ x : H, ZMod.mulPow ℓ n (d.toFun x) = c.toFun x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : H → ZMod (ℓ ^ n) := fun x => Function.invFun (ZMod.mulPow ℓ n) (c.toFun x)
  have hf (x : H) : ZMod.mulPow ℓ n (f x) = c.toFun x :=
    Function.invFun_eq (ZMod.exists_mulPow_eq_of_castHom_eq_zero ℓ n (c.toFun x) (hc x))
  have hfcont : Continuous f :=
    (show Continuous (Function.invFun (ZMod.mulPow ℓ n)) from
      continuous_of_discreteTopology).comp c.continuous_toFun
  refine ⟨⟨f, hfcont, ?_⟩, hf⟩
  intro x y
  apply ZMod.mulPow_injective (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).ne_zero n
  rw [hf, map_add]
  have hcast := RingHom.congr_fun (PadicInt.zmod_cast_comp_toZModPow n (n + 1)
    (Nat.le_succ n)) (θ (x : G) : PadicInt ℓ)
  change ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ n)) (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))
    (PadicInt.toZModPow (n + 1) (θ (x : G) : PadicInt ℓ)) = _ at hcast
  rw [← hcast, ZMod.mulPow_mul_castHom, hf, hf]
  exact c.cocycle x y

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_openNormal_padicCocycle_lifting_character
statement:
theorem exists_openNormal_padicCocycle_lifting_character
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker)
    (hLift : RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (χ : D →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))) :
    ∃ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G, ∃ hDU : D ≤ (U : Subgroup G),
      ∃ c : PadicCocycle θ (U : Subgroup G), ∀ d : D,
        PadicInt.toZModPow n (c.toFun (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d)) = (χ d).toAdd
proof:
:= by
  let θn : G →ₜ* (ZMod (ℓ ^ n))ˣ :=
    { toMonoidHom := (Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow n).toMonoidHom).comp θ.toMonoidHom
      continuous_toFun := ((PadicInt.continuous_toZModPow n).units_map
        (PadicInt.toZModPow n).toMonoidHom).comp θ.continuous }
  let V : OpenNormalSubgroup G := ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.ker θn
  obtain ⟨U, hDU, hUV, η, hη⟩ :=
    ProCGroups.exists_openNormal_character_extension D hDclosed χ V
  have hDθn : D ≤ θn.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    intro d hd
    change Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow n).toMonoidHom (θ d) = 1
    rw [show θ d = 1 from hDθ hd, map_one]
  have hUθn : (U : Subgroup G) ≤ θn.toMonoidHom.ker :=
    hUV.trans (sup_le hDθn le_rfl)
  let c₀ : FiniteCocycle θ (U : Subgroup G) n :=
    { toFun := fun x => (η x).toAdd
      continuous_toFun := η.continuous
      cocycle := by
        intro x y
        have hθ : PadicInt.toZModPow n (θ (x : G) : PadicInt ℓ) = 1 :=
          congrArg Units.val (hUθn x.2)
        rw [hθ, one_mul]
        exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (map_mul η x y) }
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := finiteCocycle_lift_padic_of_fixed_group θ (U : Subgroup G)
    (hLift U hDU) n hn c₀
  refine ⟨U, hDU, c, ?_⟩
  intro d
  rw [hc]
  exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (hη d)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.formalHilbert90_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation
statement:
theorem formalHilbert90_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation [NeZero (p : K)] :
    FormalHilbert90 (absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero (p : SeparableClosure K) := ⟨by
    intro hp
    apply NeZero.ne (p : K)
    apply (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).injective
    rw [map_natCast, map_zero]
    exact hp⟩
  exact formalHilbert90_comp_continuousMulEquiv
    (galoisCyclotomicOrientation p K (SeparableClosure K))
    (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K)
    (formalHilbert90_galoisCyclotomicOrientation p K (SeparableClosure K))

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.infinite_range_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation_of_finite_primary
statement:
theorem infinite_range_absoluteCyclotomicOrientation_of_finite_primary
    [NeZero (p : K)]
    (hRoots : ∀ L : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K), FiniteDimensional K L →
      Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Lˣ p)) :
    Set.Infinite (Set.range (absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K))
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero (p : SeparableClosure K) := ⟨by
    intro hp
    apply NeZero.ne (p : K)
    apply (algebraMap K (SeparableClosure K)).injective
    rw [map_natCast, map_zero]
    exact hp⟩
  have hsep : Set.Infinite (Set.range
      (galoisCyclotomicOrientation p K (SeparableClosure K))) := by
    apply KummerTheory.infinite_range_cyclotomicCharacter_of_finite_primary p
    intro E hE
    have : FiniteDimensional K E := hE
    let j : E →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure K :=
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (SeparableClosure K) (AlgebraicClosure K)).comp E.val
    exact KummerTheory.finite_primaryComponent_of_finiteExtension_embedding j p hRoots
  have hrange : Set.range (absoluteCyclotomicOrientation p K) =
      Set.range (galoisCyclotomicOrientation p K (SeparableClosure K)) := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K σ, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨τ, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ :=
        (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K).surjective τ
      exact ⟨σ, rfl⟩
  rw [hrange]
  exact hsep

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.PadicCocycle.map_one
statement: theorem map_one (c : PadicCocycle θ U) : c.toFun 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := c.cocycle 1 1
  simp only [one_mul, Subgroup.coe_one, _root_.map_one, Units.val_one] at h
  exact (add_left_cancel (h.symm.trans (add_zero (c.toFun 1)).symm) : c.toFun 1 = 0)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.PadicCocycle.map_conj
statement:
theorem map_conj (c : PadicCocycle θ U) (u d : U) (hd : θ (d : G) = 1) :
    c.toFun (u * d * u⁻¹) = (θ (u : G) : PadicInt ℓ) * c.toFun d
proof:
:= by
  have hi := c.cocycle u u⁻¹
  rw [mul_inv_cancel, c.map_one] at hi
  rw [c.cocycle, c.cocycle]
  simp only [Subgroup.coe_mul, _root_.map_mul, hd, mul_one]
  linear_combination -hi

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.PadicCocycle.primaryCharacter_mk
statement:
theorem primaryCharacter_mk [CompactSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) (hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker) (hDU : D ≤ U) (c : PadicCocycle θ U) (d : D) :
    (c.primaryCharacter D hDclosed hDθ hDU
      (QuotientGroup.mk' _ (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D d))).toAdd =
        c.toFun (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d)
proof: := rfl

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.PadicCocycle.primaryCharacter_conj
statement:
theorem primaryCharacter_conj [CompactSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker) (hDU : D ≤ U) (c : PadicCocycle θ U)
    (u : U) (a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) :
    (c.primaryCharacter D hDclosed hDθ hDU
      (primaryConjugationMap ℓ D hDclosed (u : G) a)).toAdd =
        (θ (u : G) : PadicInt ℓ) *
          (c.primaryCharacter D hDclosed hDθ hDU a).toAdd
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _ a
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk D b
  change c.toFun (Subgroup.inclusion hDU ((MulAut.conjNormal (u : G)) d)) = _
  rw [primaryCharacter_mk]
  exact c.map_conj u (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d) (hDθ d.2)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_padicCocycle_detecting_primary
statement:
theorem exists_padicCocycle_detecting_primary
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (hDθ : D ≤ θ.toMonoidHom.ker)
    (hLift : RelativeFormalHilbert90 D θ)
    (a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    ∃ U : OpenNormalSubgroup G, ∃ hDU : D ≤ (U : Subgroup G),
      ∃ c : PadicCocycle θ (U : Subgroup G),
        (c.primaryCharacter D hDclosed hDθ hDU a).toAdd ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let : CompactSpace D := hDclosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (TopologicalAbelianization D) :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (Subgroup.closedCommutator D) (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator D)
  have : IsClosed (proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ)
      (TopologicalAbelianization D) : Set (TopologicalAbelianization D)) :=
    proCResidualCore_isClosed _ _
  have hP : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ)
      (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) :=
    proCResidualCoreQuotient_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass
      (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_formation ℓ)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, χ, hχ⟩ := exists_primePower_character_proP hP ha
  let π : D →ₜ* PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D :=
    { toMonoidHom := (QuotientGroup.mk' _).comp (TopologicalAbelianization.mk D)
      continuous_toFun := QuotientGroup.continuous_mk.comp
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mkₜ D).continuous }
  obtain ⟨U, hDU, c, hc⟩ := exists_openNormal_padicCocycle_lifting_character
    D hDclosed θ hDθ hLift n hn (χ.comp π)
  refine ⟨U, hDU, c, ?_⟩
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _ a
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk D b
  have hπ : π d = a := congrArg (QuotientGroup.mk' _) hd |>.trans hb
  apply hχ
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  have hc0 : c.toFun (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d) = 0 := by
    rw [← c.primaryCharacter_mk D hDclosed hDθ hDU d]
    change (c.primaryCharacter D hDclosed hDθ hDU (π d)).toAdd = 0
    rw [hπ, hz]
  have hh := hc d
  change PadicInt.toZModPow n (c.toFun (Subgroup.inclusion hDU d)) =
    (χ (π d)).toAdd at hh
  rw [hc0, map_zero, hπ] at hh
  exact hh.symm

theorem formalHilbert90_galois_of_charP

:=
