name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.formalHilbert90_absolute_of_charP
statement:
theorem formalHilbert90_absolute_of_charP [CharP K p]
    (θ : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
    (hθ : ∀ g : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K), PadicInt.toZModPow 1 (θ g : PadicInt p) = 1) :
    FormalHilbert90 θ
proof:
:= by
  let e := ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K
  let θs : Orientation p Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) :=
    θ.comp (e.symm : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) →ₜ* Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
  have hs : FormalHilbert90 θs :=
    formalHilbert90_galois_of_charP p K (SeparableClosure K) θs
      (fun g => hθ (e.symm g))
  have h := formalHilbert90_comp_continuousMulEquiv θs e hs
  have heq : θs.comp (e : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) = θ := by
    apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
    intro g
    change θ (e.symm (e g)) = θ g
    exact congrArg θ (e.symm_apply_apply g)
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.h1Reduction_trivial_of_no_prime_torsion
statement:
theorem h1Reduction_trivial_of_no_prime_torsion
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (H : Subgroup G) [CompactSpace H] [T2Space H] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace H]
    (hH : ∀ a : TopologicalAbelianization H, a ^ ℓ = 1 → a = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : HasH1ReductionSurjective (1 : Orientation ℓ G) H n hn
proof:
:= by
  let A := TopologicalAbelianization H
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace A :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (Subgroup.closedCommutator H) (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator H)
  have hpinj : Function.Injective (fun a : A => a ^ ℓ) := by
    intro a b hab
    change a ^ ℓ = b ^ ℓ at hab
    apply mul_inv_eq_one.mp
    apply hH
    rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, hab, mul_inv_cancel]
  have hpow (k : ℕ) : Function.Injective (fun a : A => a ^ (ℓ ^ k)) := by
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro a b hab
      simpa only [pow_zero, pow_one] using hab
    | succ k ih =>
      intro a b hab
      apply ih
      apply hpinj
      simpa only [← pow_mul, pow_succ] using hab
  apply h1_reduction_surjective_of_finiteCocycle_lifting
  intro c
  let χH : H →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1)) :=
    { toFun := fun h => Multiplicative.ofAdd (c.toFun h)
      map_one' := by
        have hh := c.cocycle 1 1
        simp only [one_mul, Subgroup.coe_one, Units.val_one, map_one] at hh
        exact add_eq_left.mp hh.symm
      map_mul' := by
        intro a b
        change c.toFun (a * b) = c.toFun a + c.toFun b
        exact c.cocycle a b |>.trans (by
          rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, map_one, one_mul])
      continuous_toFun := c.continuous_toFun }
  let χ := TopologicalAbelianization.lift χH
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k =>
    have : NeZero (ℓ ^ 1) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).ne_zero⟩
    have : NeZero (ℓ ^ k) := ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).ne_zero⟩
    have hlift (M : ℕ) (hM : ℓ ^ 1 ∣ M) (hEq : M = ℓ ^ 1 * ℓ ^ k) :
        ∃ ψ : A →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod M), ∀ a : A,
          ZMod.castHom hM (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1)) (ψ a).toAdd = (χ a).toAdd := by
      subst M
      exact exists_cyclic_character_lift_of_power_injective (ℓ ^ 1) (ℓ ^ k) (hpow k) χ
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hlift (ℓ ^ (k + 1)) (pow_dvd_pow ℓ hn)
      (by rw [pow_one, pow_succ'])
    let d : FiniteCocycle (1 : Orientation ℓ G) H (k + 1) :=
      { toFun := fun h => (ψ (TopologicalAbelianization.mk H h)).toAdd
        continuous_toFun := ψ.continuous.comp (TopologicalAbelianization.mkₜ H).continuous
        cocycle := by
          intro a b
          rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, map_one, one_mul]
          rw [map_mul]
          exact congrArg (fun z : Multiplicative (ZMod (ℓ ^ (k + 1))) => z.toAdd)
            (map_mul ψ _ _) }
    exact ⟨d, fun h => hψ (TopologicalAbelianization.mk H h)⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.no_prime_torsion_of_h1Reduction_trivial
statement:
theorem no_prime_torsion_of_h1Reduction_trivial
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (H : Subgroup G) [CompactSpace H] [T2Space H] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace H]
    (hH : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ hn : 1 ≤ n, HasH1ReductionSurjective (1 : Orientation ℓ G) H n hn)
    (a : TopologicalAbelianization H) (ha : a ^ ℓ = 1) : a = 1
proof:
:= by
  let A := TopologicalAbelianization H
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace A :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (Subgroup.closedCommutator H) (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator H)
  let R := proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ) A
  have : IsClosed (R : Set A) := proCResidualCore_isClosed _ _
  let q : A →ₜ* A ⧸ R := ⟨QuotientGroup.mk' R, QuotientGroup.continuous_mk⟩
  by_contra hne
  have hqa : q a ≠ 1 := fun h => hne
    (eq_one_of_prime_torsion_of_primaryQuotient_eq_one a ha h)
  have hP : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ) (A ⧸ R) :=
    proCResidualCoreQuotient_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass
      (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_formation ℓ)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, χ, hχ⟩ := exists_primePower_character_proP hP hqa
  let χA := χ.comp q
  let χH := χA.comp (TopologicalAbelianization.mkₜ H)
  let c : FiniteCocycle (1 : Orientation ℓ G) H n :=
    { toFun := fun h => (χH h).toAdd
      continuous_toFun := χH.continuous
      cocycle := by
        intro x y
        rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, map_one, one_mul]
        exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (map_mul χH x y) }
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := finiteCocycle_lift_padic_of_fixed_group (1 : Orientation ℓ G) H hH n hn c
  let f : H →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt ℓ) :=
    { toFun := fun h => Multiplicative.ofAdd (d.toFun h)
      map_one' := d.map_one
      map_mul' := by
        intro x y
        change d.toFun (x * y) = d.toFun x + d.toFun y
        exact d.cocycle x y |>.trans (by
          rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, one_mul])
      continuous_toFun := d.continuous_toFun }
  let fA := TopologicalAbelianization.lift f
  have hfa : fA a = 1 := by
    apply (pow_eq_one_iff_left (a := fA a) (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).ne_zero).mp
    rw [← map_pow, ha, map_one]
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk H a
  have hzero : d.toFun b = 0 := by
    have heq := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hfa
    rw [← hb] at heq
    exact heq
  apply hχ
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  have hh := hd b
  change PadicInt.toZModPow n (d.toFun b) = (χ (q (TopologicalAbelianization.mk H b))).toAdd at hh
  rw [hzero, map_zero, hb] at hh
  exact hh.symm

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_padic_character_detecting_primary_of_h1_trivial
statement:
theorem exists_padic_character_detecting_primary_of_h1_trivial
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (H : Subgroup G) [CompactSpace H] [T2Space H] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace H]
    (hH : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ hn : 1 ≤ n, HasH1ReductionSurjective (1 : Orientation ℓ G) H n hn)
    (a : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ H) (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    ∃ f : PrimaryAbelianization ℓ H →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt ℓ), f a ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  let A := TopologicalAbelianization H
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace A :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (Subgroup.closedCommutator H) (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator H)
  let R := proCResidualCore (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ) A
  have : IsClosed (R : Set A) := proCResidualCore_isClosed _ _
  let q : A →ₜ* A ⧸ R := ⟨QuotientGroup.mk' R, QuotientGroup.continuous_mk⟩
  have hP : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup ℓ) (A ⧸ R) :=
    proCResidualCoreQuotient_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass
      (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_formation ℓ)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, χ, hχ⟩ := exists_primePower_character_proP hP ha
  let χH := (χ.comp q).comp (TopologicalAbelianization.mkₜ H)
  let c : FiniteCocycle (1 : Orientation ℓ G) H n :=
    { toFun := fun h => (χH h).toAdd
      continuous_toFun := χH.continuous
      cocycle := by
        intro x y
        rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, map_one, one_mul]
        exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd (map_mul χH x y) }
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := finiteCocycle_lift_padic_of_fixed_group (1 : Orientation ℓ G) H hH n hn c
  let f : H →ₜ* Multiplicative (PadicInt ℓ) :=
    { toFun := fun h => Multiplicative.ofAdd (d.toFun h)
      map_one' := d.map_one
      map_mul' := by
        intro x y
        change d.toFun (x * y) = d.toFun x + d.toFun y
        exact d.cocycle x y |>.trans (by
          rw [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_one, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, one_mul])
      continuous_toFun := d.continuous_toFun }
  let fA := liftPadicCharacter (TopologicalAbelianization.lift f)
  refine ⟨fA, ?_⟩
  intro hfa
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective R a
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk H b
  have hzero : d.toFun e = 0 := by
    have heq := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hfa
    rw [← hb, ← he] at heq
    exact heq
  apply hχ
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  have hh := hd e
  change PadicInt.toZModPow n (d.toFun e) = (χ (q (TopologicalAbelianization.mk H e))).toAdd at hh
  rw [hzero, map_zero, he] at hh
  exact (hh.trans (congrArg (fun z => (χ z).toAdd) hb)).symm

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primaryAbelianization_isMulTorsionFree_of_h1_trivial
statement:
theorem primaryAbelianization_isMulTorsionFree_of_h1_trivial
    {ℓ : ℕ} [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (H : Subgroup G) [CompactSpace H] [T2Space H] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace H]
    (hH : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ hn : 1 ≤ n, HasH1ReductionSurjective (1 : Orientation ℓ G) H n hn) :
    IsMulTorsionFree (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ H)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro n hn x y hxy
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_padic_character_detecting_primary_of_h1_trivial H hH
    (x * y⁻¹) (fun h => hne (mul_inv_eq_one.mp h))
  have heq : f x = f y := by
    apply IsMulTorsionFree.pow_left_injective hn
    change f x ^ n = f y ^ n
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow]
    exact congrArg f hxy
  apply hf
  rw [map_mul, map_inv, heq, mul_inv_cancel]

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.formalHilbert90_comp_continuousMulEquiv
statement:
theorem formalHilbert90_comp_continuousMulEquiv
    (θ : Orientation p G') (e : G ≃ₜ* G') (hθ : FormalHilbert90 θ) :
    FormalHilbert90 (θ.comp (e : G →ₜ* G'))
proof:
:= by
  intro H n hn
  let H' : OpenSubgroup G' := H.comap e.symm.toMonoidHom e.symm.continuous
  let f : (H : Subgroup G) ≃ₜ* (H' : Subgroup G') :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨e x, by
        change e.symm (e x) ∈ H
        rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
        exact x.property⟩
      invFun := fun y => ⟨e.symm y, y.property⟩
      left_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (e.symm_apply_apply x)
      right_inv := fun y => Subtype.ext (e.apply_symm_apply y)
      map_mul' := fun x y => Subtype.ext (map_mul e (x : G) (y : G))
      continuous_toFun := (e.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk
        (fun x => by
          change e.symm (e x) ∈ H
          rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
          exact x.property)
      continuous_invFun := (e.symm.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk
        (fun y => y.property) }
  apply h1_reduction_surjective_of_finiteCocycle_lifting
  intro c
  let c' : FiniteCocycle θ (H' : Subgroup G') 1 :=
    { toFun := fun y => c.toFun (f.symm y)
      continuous_toFun := c.continuous_toFun.comp f.symm.continuous
      cocycle := by
        intro x y
        rw [map_mul, c.cocycle]
        change c.toFun (f.symm x) + (PadicInt.toZModPow 1) (θ (e (e.symm x)) : PadicInt p) *
          c.toFun (f.symm y) = _
        rw [e.apply_symm_apply] }
  obtain ⟨d', hd'⟩ := finiteCocycle_lift_mod_one_of_h1 θ (H' : Subgroup G') n hn
    (hθ H' n hn) c'
  let d : FiniteCocycle (θ.comp (e : G →ₜ* G')) (H : Subgroup G) n :=
    { toFun := fun x => d'.toFun (f x)
      continuous_toFun := d'.continuous_toFun.comp f.continuous
      cocycle := by
        intro x y
        rw [map_mul, d'.cocycle]
        rfl }
  refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
  intro x
  change ZMod.castHom _ (ZMod (p ^ 1)) (d'.toFun (f x)) = c.toFun x
  exact (hd' (f x)).trans (congrArg c.toFun (f.symm_apply_apply x))

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primaryProjection_mem_fixed_of_sigmaQuotient_centralizes
statement:
theorem primaryProjection_mem_fixed_of_sigmaQuotient_centralizes {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (D : ClosedSubgroup G) [(D : Subgroup G).Normal]
    (H : Subgroup G) (d : (D : Subgroup G))
    (hd : QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) (d : G) ∈
      Subgroup.centralizer (H.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D)) :
        Set (G ⧸ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D)))
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ∈ sigma) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p)
      (TopologicalAbelianization (D : Subgroup G)))
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk (D : Subgroup G) d) ∈
          primaryFixedSubgroup p (D : Subgroup G) D.isClosed' H
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc : ⁅(h : G), (d : G)⁆ ∈ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D := by
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) _).mp
    change QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) ⁅(h : G), (d : G)⁆ = 1
    rw [map_commutatorElement]
    exact Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff_commutator_eq_one.mp hd _ ⟨h, h.property, rfl⟩
  have heq := primaryProjection_eq_one_of_mem_sigmaResidualKernel sigma D
    (MulAut.conjNormal (h : G) d * d⁻¹) hc p hp
  rw [map_mul, map_inv, map_mul, map_inv, mul_inv_eq_one] at heq
  exact heq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.sigmaQuotient_eq_one_of_primaryFixed_eq_bot
statement:
theorem sigmaQuotient_eq_one_of_primaryFixed_eq_bot {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (D : ClosedSubgroup G) [(D : Subgroup G).Normal]
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (hfixed : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p ∈ sigma →
      Nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization p (D : Subgroup G)) →
        primaryFixedSubgroup p (D : Subgroup G) D.isClosed' H = ⊥)
    (d : (D : Subgroup G))
    (hd : QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) (d : G) ∈
      Subgroup.centralizer (H.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D)) :
        Set (G ⧸ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D))) :
    QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) (d : G) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) _).mpr
  apply mem_sigmaResidualKernel_of_primaryProjections sigma D d
  intro p _ hp
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization p (D : Subgroup G)) with
  | inl h => exact h.elim _ _
  | inr h =>
      exact Subgroup.mem_bot.mp ((hfixed p hp h) ▸
        primaryProjection_mem_fixed_of_sigmaQuotient_centralizes sigma D H d hd p hp)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finiteCocycle_lift_mod_one_of_h1
statement:
theorem finiteCocycle_lift_mod_one_of_h1
    (θ : Orientation ℓ G) (H : Subgroup G)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hH : HasH1ReductionSurjective θ H n hn)
    (c : FiniteCocycle θ H 1) :
    ∃ d : FiniteCocycle θ H n, ∀ x : H,
      ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ hn) (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1)) (d.toFun x) = c.toFun x
proof:
:= by
  have hf : Function.Surjective (finiteOrientationReduction θ H n hn).hom := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨ULift.up (a.down.val : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)), ?_⟩
    apply ULift.ext
    change ZMod.castHom (pow_dvd_pow ℓ hn) (ZMod (ℓ ^ 1))
      (a.down.val : ZMod (ℓ ^ n)) = a.down
    rw [map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  have horbit (a : finiteOrientationTopRep θ H n) :
      Continuous (fun g : H => (finiteOrientationTopRep θ H n).ρ g a) := by
    change Continuous (fun g : H => ULift.up
      (PadicInt.toZModPow n (θ (g : G) : PadicInt ℓ) * a.down))
    apply continuous_uliftUp.comp
    exact ((PadicInt.continuous_toZModPow n).comp
      (Units.continuous_val.comp (θ.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val))).mul continuous_const
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ContinuousCohomology.exists_crossedHom_lift_of_map_surjective
    (finiteOrientationTopRep θ H n) (finiteOrientationTopRep θ H 1)
    (finiteOrientationReduction θ H n hn) hf horbit hH
    (finiteCocycleCrossedHom θ H 1 c)
  refine ⟨⟨fun x => (d.toFun x).down,
    continuous_uliftDown.comp d.continuous_toFun, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    have hc := congrArg ULift.down (d.map_mul x y)
    exact hc
  · intro x
    exact congrArg ULift.down (hd x)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.sigmaFaithful_openNormal_action
statement:
theorem sigmaFaithful_openNormal_action {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (hG : IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G) (N : OpenNormalSubgroup G) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma) (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed)
proof:
:= by
  let H : OpenSubgroup G := ⊤
  have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup G) := H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  let e : G ≃ₜ* (H : Subgroup G) :=
    { toMulEquiv := Subgroup.topEquiv.symm
      continuous_toFun := continuous_id.subtype_mk (fun _ => Subgroup.mem_top _)
      continuous_invFun := continuous_subtype_val }
  let Nmap : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup G) :=
    ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.map
      (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom e) e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap e.surjective N
  exact (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
    (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma) e (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed).mp (hG H Nmap)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.sigmaQuotient_mem_openNormal_of_centralizes
statement:
theorem sigmaQuotient_mem_openNormal_of_centralizes {G : Type u}
    [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (sigma : Set ℕ) (hG : IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma G)
    (D : ClosedSubgroup G) [(D : Subgroup G).Normal]
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup G) (hDN : (D : Subgroup G) ≤ (N : Subgroup G))
    (x : G) (hx : QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) x ∈
      Subgroup.centralizer ((N : Subgroup G).map (QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D)) :
        Set (G ⧸ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D))) : x ∈ (N : Subgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  have : CompactSpace (N : Subgroup G) := N.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  by_contra hxn
  apply (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_iff
    (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation sigma) (N : Subgroup G) N.isClosed).mp
      (sigmaFaithful_openNormal_action sigma hG N) x hxn
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk _ a
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _ z
  have hc : ⁅x, (n : G)⁆ ∈ sigmaResidualKernel sigma D := by
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) _).mp
    change QuotientGroup.mk' (sigmaResidualKernel sigma D) ⁅x, (n : G)⁆ = 1
    rw [map_commutatorElement]
    exact Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff_commutator_eq_one'.mp hx _ ⟨n, n.property, rfl⟩
  have hcN := sigmaResidualKernel_mono sigma D ⟨(N : Subgroup G), N.isClosed⟩ hDN hc
  have heq := (mem_sigmaResidualKernel_iff sigma ⟨(N : Subgroup G), N.isClosed⟩
    (MulAut.conjNormal x n * n⁻¹)).mp hcN
  rw [map_mul, map_inv, mul_inv_eq_one] at heq
  change TopologicalAbelianization.congr _
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk _ (QuotientGroup.mk' _ n)) = _
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk,
    residualQuotientConjugationContinuousMulEquiv_apply_mk]
  exact heq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.mixedChar_DVF_of_discreteValuationSubring
statement:
theorem mixedChar_DVF_of_discreteValuationSubring
    {E : Type u} [Field E] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (W : ValuationSubring E) [IsDiscreteValuationRing W] (hp : (p : E) ∈ W.nonunits) :
    ∃ D : DVF.{u, 0} E, CharP D.residueField p
proof:
:= by
  let D : DVF.{u, 0} E :=
    { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)
      valuation := (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal W).valuation E }
  let e : W ≃+* D.valuationSubring :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.equivValuationSubring (A := W) (K := E)
  have hnunit : ¬ IsUnit (p : W) := (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal (p : W)).mp
    (W.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mp hp)
  have hpD : (p : D.valuationSubring) ∈ D.maximalIdeal := by
    apply (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal (p : D.valuationSubring)).mpr
    intro hu
    apply hnunit
    have huW := hu.map e.symm.toMonoidHom
    change IsUnit (e.symm (p : D.valuationSubring)) at huW
    simpa only [map_natCast] using huW
  refine ⟨D, (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : p.Prime)).mpr ?_⟩
  have hzero := (D.residue_eq_zero_iff (p : D.valuationSubring)).mpr hpD
  simpa only [map_natCast] using hzero

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_mixedChar_DVF_of_essFiniteType
statement:
theorem exists_mixedChar_DVF_of_essFiniteType
    (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
    [CharZero F] [Algebra.EssFiniteType F E]
    (base : DVF.{u, w} F) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP base.residueField p] :
    ∃ D : DVF.{v, 0} E, CharP D.residueField p
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero E := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F E).injective
  have : IsDiscreteValuationRing base.valuationSubring :=
    base.valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing
  obtain ⟨V, hR, hlocal, _⟩ := Valuation.exists_extension_valuationSubring (L := E) base.valuation
  have : IsLocalHom ((algebraMap base.valuationSubring E).codRestrict V.toSubring hR) := hlocal
  have hpbase : (p : base.valuationSubring) ∈ base.maximalIdeal := by
    apply (base.residue_eq_zero_iff _).mp
    rw [map_natCast, CharP.cast_eq_zero]
  have hpV : (p : E) ∈ V.nonunits := by
    apply (V.coe_mem_nonunits_iff (a := (p : V))).mpr
    apply (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal (p : V)).mpr
    intro hu
    apply (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal (p : base.valuationSubring)).mp hpbase
    apply IsUnit.of_map ((algebraMap base.valuationSubring E).codRestrict V.toSubring hR)
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hu
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hpW⟩ := exists_discreteValuationSubring_preserving_nonunit
    base.valuationSubring F E V hR (p : base.valuationSubring)
    (by rw [map_natCast]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero)
    (by simpa only [map_natCast] using hpV)
  have : IsDiscreteValuationRing W := hW
  apply mixedChar_DVF_of_discreteValuationSubring p W
  simpa only [map_natCast] using hpW

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_mixedChar_DVF_of_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_mixedChar_DVF_of_embedding
    {K : Type u} {E : Type v} [Field K] [Field E] [CharZero E]
    (f : K →+* E) (base : DVF.{v, w} E) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP base.residueField p] : ∃ D : DVF.{u, 0} K, CharP D.residueField p
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero K := charZero_of_inj_zero (fun n hn => by
    apply (Nat.cast_eq_zero (R := E)).mp
    rw [← map_natCast f n, hn, map_zero])
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hring⟩ := base.exists_normalized_valuation
  have : v.IsRankOneDiscrete := hv
  have : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p := by
    rw [hring]
    infer_instance
  let w := v.comap f
  have hwp : w (p : K) < 1 := by
    change v (f (p : K)) < 1
    rw [map_natCast]
    exact v.natCast_residueChar_lt_one p
  have : w.IsNontrivial :=
    ⟨p, w.ne_zero_iff.mpr (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero), hwp.ne⟩
  have : IsCyclic w.valueGroup := inferInstance
  have : w.IsRankOneDiscrete := Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.mk' w
  let D : DVF.{u, 0} K := { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ), valuation := w }
  refine ⟨D, (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : p.Prime)).mpr ?_⟩
  have hm : (p : D.valuationSubring) ∈ D.maximalIdeal :=
    (Valuation.mem_maximalIdeal_iff (v := w)).mpr hwp
  have hz := (D.residue_eq_zero_iff (p : D.valuationSubring)).mpr hm
  simpa only [map_natCast] using hz

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finiteExtension_embedding_over_subfield
statement:
theorem finiteExtension_embedding_over_subfield
    (K : Type u) (E : Type v) (L : Type w)
    [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] :
    ∃ T : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E), FiniteDimensional E T ∧
      Nonempty (L →+* T)
proof:
:= by
  let j : L →ₐ[K] AlgebraicClosure E := IsAlgClosed.lift
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Field.exists_primitive_element K L
  let T := IntermediateField.adjoin E ({j x} : Set (AlgebraicClosure E))
  have hfinite : FiniteDimensional E T := IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional
    ((Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := K) x).map j).tower_top
  have hle : j.fieldRange ≤ T.restrictScalars K := by
    have hm : j.fieldRange = IntermediateField.adjoin K ({j x} : Set (AlgebraicClosure E)) := by
      rw [← Set.image_singleton, ← IntermediateField.adjoin_map, hx]
      ext y
      exact ⟨fun ⟨z, hz⟩ => ⟨z, IntermediateField.mem_top, hz⟩,
        fun ⟨z, _, hz⟩ => ⟨z, hz⟩⟩
    rw [hm]
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    intro y hy
    exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin E _ hy
  let f : L →+* T :=
    { toFun := fun y => ⟨j y, hle ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩
      map_zero' := Subtype.ext j.map_zero
      map_one' := Subtype.ext j.map_one
      map_add' := fun a b => Subtype.ext (j.map_add a b)
      map_mul' := fun a b => Subtype.ext (j.map_mul a b) }
  exact ⟨T, hfinite, ⟨f⟩⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_subfield
statement:
theorem finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_subfield
    (K : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field K] [Field E] [Algebra K E] [CharZero K]
    (p : ℕ)
    (hRoots : ∀ T : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E), FiniteDimensional E T →
      Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Tˣ p))
    (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Lˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, ⟨f⟩⟩ := finiteExtension_embedding_over_subfield K E L
  have : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Tˣ p) := hRoots T hT
  exact KummerTheory.finite_primaryComponent_of_fieldEmbedding f p

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.subpadic_isAbFaithful_and_finite_roots
statement:
theorem subpadic_isAbFaithful_and_finite_roots
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type u) (E : Type v)
    [Field K] [Field E] [Algebra (Padic p) E] [Algebra.EssFiniteType (Padic p) E]
    (f : K →+* E) :
    IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) ∧
      ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L],
        ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime], Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Lˣ ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero E := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap (Padic p) E).injective
  have : CharZero K := charZero_of_inj_zero (fun n hn => by
    apply (Nat.cast_eq_zero (R := E)).mp
    rw [← map_natCast f n, hn, map_zero])
  have : CharP (padicCompleteDVF p).residueField p := padicCompleteDVF_residue_char p
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_mixedChar_DVF_of_essFiniteType (Padic p) E (padicCompleteDVF p).toDVF p
  have : CharP D.residueField p := hD
  obtain ⟨DK, hDK⟩ := exists_mixedChar_DVF_of_embedding f D p
  have : CharP DK.residueField p := hDK
  refine ⟨(mixed_characteristic_properties_3_6 K DK p).2.isAbFaithful, ?_⟩
  intro L _ _ _ ℓ _
  let : Algebra K E := f.toAlgebra
  apply finite_primaryComponent_finiteExtension_of_subfield K E ℓ _ L
  intro T hT
  have : FiniteDimensional E T := hT
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType E T := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_finiteType E T
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType (Padic p) T := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp (Padic p) E T
  have : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Tˣ) := finite_torsion_of_essFiniteType_padic p T
  have hle : CommGroup.primaryComponent Tˣ ℓ ≤ CommGroup.torsion Tˣ := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hz
    exact isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨ℓ ^ n, pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos n, hn⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective (Subgroup.inclusion hle) (Subgroup.inclusion_injective hle)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finiteType_model_in_valuation
statement:
theorem finiteType_model_in_valuation
    (R : Type u) (F : Type v) (E : Type w)
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Field F] [Field E]
    [Algebra R F] [IsFractionRing R F] [Algebra F E] [Algebra R E]
    [IsScalarTower R F E] [Algebra.EssFiniteType F E]
    (V : ValuationSubring E) (hR : ∀ r : R, algebraMap R E r ∈ V) :
    ∃ A : Subalgebra R E, Algebra.FiniteType R A ∧ IsFractionRing A E ∧
      A.toSubring ≤ V.toSubring
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := IntermediateField.fg_top F E
  let f : E → E := fun x => if x ∈ V then x else x⁻¹
  let t := s.image f
  let A := Algebra.adjoin R (t : Set E)
  have hAV : A.toSubring ≤ V.toSubring := by
    let B : Subalgebra R E := { V.toSubring with algebraMap_mem' := hR }
    change A ≤ B
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    change f y ∈ V
    dsimp only [f]
    split_ifs with hyV
    · exact hyV
    · exact (V.mem_or_inv_mem y).resolve_left hyV
  let S := Subfield.closure (A : Set E)
  have hF : ∀ x : F, algebraMap F E x ∈ S := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective R x
    rw [map_div₀, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
    exact S.div_mem (Subfield.subset_closure (A.algebraMap_mem a))
      (Subfield.subset_closure (A.algebraMap_mem b))
  let T : IntermediateField F E := { S with algebraMap_mem' := hF }
  have hst : IntermediateField.adjoin F (s : Set E) ≤ T := by
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ S
    have hfx : f x ∈ S := Subfield.subset_closure
      (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩))
    by_cases hxV : x ∈ V
    · simpa only [f, ite_eq_left hxV] using hfx
    · have hi := S.inv_mem hfx
      simpa only [f, ite_eq_right hxV, inv_inv] using hi
  have htop : T = ⊤ := top_unique (hs ▸ hst)
  refine ⟨A, (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType A).mp (Subalgebra.fg_adjoin_finset t), ?_, hAV⟩
  apply IsFractionRing.of_field A E
  intro z
  have hz : z ∈ S := by
    change z ∈ T
    rw [htop]
    exact IntermediateField.mem_top
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Subfield.mem_closure_iff.mp hz
  change a ∈ Subring.closure (A.toSubring : Set E) at ha
  change b ∈ Subring.closure (A.toSubring : Set E) at hb
  rw [Subring.closure_eq] at ha hb
  exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, hab.symm⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.mixedChar_separablyClosedResidue_finiteStepSolvable_slim
statement:
theorem mixedChar_separablyClosedResidue_finiteStepSolvable_slim
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP base.residueField p] [IsSepClosed base.residueField] :
    ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m →
      IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) m)
proof:
:= by
  have hG := (isSigmaAbFaithful_absoluteGaloisGroup_singleton_of_henselian_mixedChar
    base p).isAbFaithful
  let θ : Orientation p Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) :=
    galoisCyclotomicOrientation p K (AlgebraicClosure K)
  have hθ : FormalHilbert90 θ :=
    formalHilbert90_galoisCyclotomicOrientation p K (AlgebraicClosure K)
  have hImage : Set.Infinite (Set.range θ) := by
    apply KummerTheory.infinite_range_cyclotomicCharacter_of_finite_primary p
    intro E hE
    have : FiniteDimensional K E := hE
    have hf := base.toDVF.finite_primePowerRoots_of_finiteExtension (L := E) p
    have : Finite {z : E | ∃ n : ℕ, z ^ (p ^ n) = 1} := hf.to_subtype
    let i : CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p → {z : E | ∃ n : ℕ, z ^ (p ^ n) = 1} :=
      fun z => ⟨((z : Eˣ) : E), by
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := CommGroup.mem_primaryComponent.mp z.property
        exact ⟨n, congrArg Units.val hn⟩⟩
    apply Finite.of_injective i
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Units.ext
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hab
  have hFaithful (N : OpenNormalSubgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
      Function.Injective
        (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
          (G := Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) (N := (N : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)))) := by
    apply quotientConjAbelianization_injective_of_continuousMulEquiv_image
      (ProCGroups.OpenSubgroup.topContinuousMulEquiv Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)).symm N
    exact hG ⊤ _
  intro m hm
  let G := Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
  let D : Subgroup G := topDerivedTop G (m - 1)
  have hDclosed : IsClosed (D : Set G) := inferInstance
  have hDderived : D ≤ topDerivedTop G 1 := topDerivedTop_antitone (by omega)
  have hDp := base.topDerived_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass_of_separablyClosedResidue
    p (m - 1) (by omega)
  have : CompactSpace D := hDclosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (TopologicalAbelianization D) :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (Subgroup.closedCommutator D) (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator D)
  have hAbp : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p)
      (TopologicalAbelianization D) :=
    hDp.of_surjective
      (ProCGroups.FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p).melnikovFormation.formation
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mkₜ D) (TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk D)
  have hprime (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
      (hNontrivial : Nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D)) : ℓ = p := by
    by_contra hne
    have : Subsingleton (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D) :=
      residualQuotient_subsingleton_of_distinct_primes p ℓ (Ne.symm hne) hAbp
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hNontrivial.exists_pair_ne
    exact hab (Subsingleton.elim a b)
  have hOrient (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
      (hNontrivial : Nontrivial (PrimaryAbelianization ℓ D)) :
      ∃ ψ : Orientation ℓ G, RelativeFormalHilbert90 D ψ ∧ Set.Infinite (Set.range ψ) := by
    obtain rfl := hprime ℓ hNontrivial
    exact ⟨θ, (fun N _ n hn => hθ N.toOpenSubgroup n hn), hImage⟩
  have hResult := relative_centerfree_and_slim_criterion (ProfiniteGrp.of G) D hDclosed
    hDderived (fun N _ => hFaithful N)
    (fun ℓ _ hℓ => ⟨(hOrient ℓ hℓ).choose, (hOrient ℓ hℓ).choose_spec.1⟩)
  have hSlim : IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot G (m - 1 + 1)) := hResult.2 hOrient
  have hIndex : m - 1 + 1 = m := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)
  exact (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => IsSlim (MaxSolvQuot G n)) hIndex).mp hSlim

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_discreteValuationSubring_preserving_nonunit
statement:
theorem exists_discreteValuationSubring_preserving_nonunit
    (R : Type u) (F : Type v) (E : Type w)
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Field F] [Field E]
    [Algebra R F] [IsFractionRing R F] [Algebra F E] [Algebra R E]
    [IsScalarTower R F E] [Algebra.EssFiniteType F E]
    (V : ValuationSubring E) (hR : ∀ r : R, algebraMap R E r ∈ V)
    (r : R) (hr0 : algebraMap R E r ≠ 0) (hr : algebraMap R E r ∈ V.nonunits) :
    ∃ W : ValuationSubring E, IsDiscreteValuationRing W ∧ algebraMap R E r ∈ W.nonunits
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hAfin, hAfrac, hAV⟩ := finiteType_model_in_valuation R F E V hR
  have : Algebra.FiniteType R A := hAfin
  have : IsFractionRing A E := hAfrac
  have : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing R A
  let toV : A →+* V := Subring.inclusion hAV
  let P : Ideal A := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V).comap toV
  have : P.IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime toV _
  have hrP : algebraMap R A r ∈ P := V.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.mp hr
  let B := Localization.subalgebra.ofField E P.primeCompl P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
  have : IsLocalRing B := IsLocalization.AtPrime.isLocalRing B P
  have : IsNoetherianRing B := IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing P.primeCompl B inferInstance
  have : IsFractionRing B E :=
    IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isDomain_of_isLocalization P.primeCompl B E
  have hrB : algebraMap A B (algebraMap R A r) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B :=
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff B P _).mpr hrP
  have hrB0 : algebraMap A B (algebraMap R A r) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hr0
    have h := congrArg (algebraMap B E) hzero
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, map_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hB : ¬ IsField B := by
    intro hfield
    have hbot := IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hfield
    exact hrB0 (by simpa only [hbot, Ideal.mem_bot] using hrB)
  obtain ⟨W, hW, _, hdom⟩ :=
    IsLocalRing.exists_valuationSubring_isDiscreteValuationRing_dominates hB E
  refine ⟨W, hW, ?_⟩
  have h := (hdom (algebraMap A B (algebraMap R A r))).mp hrB
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply] at h
  exact h

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.padicCompleteDVF_residue_char
statement:
theorem padicCompleteDVF_residue_char (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    CharP (padicCompleteDVF p).residueField p
proof:
:= by
  let e := (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv (padicIntEquivValuationSubring p)).symm.trans
    (padicIntResidueFieldEquivZMod p)
  exact charP_of_injective_ringHom (f := e.symm.toRingHom) e.symm.injective p

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finite_torsion_finiteExtension_padic
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_finiteExtension_padic
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (C : Type u) [Field C] [Algebra (Padic p) C]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic p) C] : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Cˣ)
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero C := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap (Padic p) C).injective
  let base := padicCompleteDVF p
  let D := base.finiteExtension C
  have : base.valuation.HasExtension D.valuation := base.finiteExtension_hasExtension C
  have : Finite base.residueField := padicCompleteDVF_residueField_finite p
  have : CharP base.residueField p := padicCompleteDVF_residue_char p
  have : FiniteDimensional base.residueField D.residueField :=
    Valuation.finiteDimensional_residueField base.valuation D.valuation
  have : Finite D.residueField := Module.finite_of_finite base.residueField
  have : CharP D.residueField p := charP_of_injective_algebraMap
    (algebraMap base.residueField D.residueField).injective p
  exact D.toDVF.finite_torsion_of_finite_residueTorsion_mixedChar p

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finite_torsion_of_essFiniteType_padic
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_of_essFiniteType_padic
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic p) E]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType (Padic p) E] : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Eˣ)
proof:
:= by
  let C := algebraicClosure (Padic p) E
  have : Module.Finite (Padic p) C := FieldTheory.finite_algebraic_subextension (Padic p) C E
  have : Finite (CommGroup.torsion Cˣ) := finite_torsion_finiteExtension_padic p C
  have : Finite (CommGroup.torsion (integralClosure (Padic p) E)ˣ) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Finite (CommGroup.torsion Cˣ))
  exact Finite.of_injective (FieldTheory.torsionUnitsIntegralClosureEquiv (Padic p) E)
    (FieldTheory.torsionUnitsIntegralClosureEquiv (Padic p) E).injective

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_nonzero_characterEigenvector_log_image
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_characterEigenvector_log_image
    (v : _root_.Valuation M (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (χ : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Kˣ) :
    ∃ b : Lˣ,
      (∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, σ (b : L) = (χ σ : K) • (b : L)) ∧
      ∃ u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
        (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = algebraMap L M (b : L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀, heigen⟩ := exists_nonzero_characterEigenvector χ
  have himage : algebraMap L M b₀ ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero (algebraMap L M)).mpr hb₀
  obtain ⟨n, u, hlog, hlogne⟩ :=
    exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_pow_mul_ne_zero v p (algebraMap L M b₀) himage
  let b : L := (p : L) ^ n * b₀
  have hmap : algebraMap L M b = (p : M) ^ n * algebraMap L M b₀ := by
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [_root_.map_mul, _root_.map_pow, _root_.map_natCast]
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hbzero
    apply hlogne
    rw [hlog, ← hmap, hbzero, _root_.map_zero]
  refine ⟨Units.mk0 b hb, ?_, u, hlog.trans hmap.symm⟩
  intro σ
  change σ ((p : L) ^ n * b₀) = (χ σ : K) • ((p : L) ^ n * b₀)
  rw [_root_.map_mul, _root_.map_pow, _root_.map_natCast, heigen σ, mul_smul_comm]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_principalUnit_log_of_fieldUnit_power_witness
statement:
theorem exists_principalUnit_log_of_fieldUnit_power_witness
    (v : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (υ : E ≃+* E) (hval : ∀ x : E, v (υ x) = v x)
    (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1)
    (a s : ℕ) (y : Eˣ)
    (hy :
      let u₀ : Eˣ :=
        (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v)
          (u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ))
      Units.map υ.toMonoidHom u₀ / u₀ ^ a = y ^ (p ^ s)) :
    ∃ z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
      (((z : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ) :
        (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubring) : E) = (y : E) ∧
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p z).toAdd =
        (υ (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd -
          (a : E) * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd) / (p : E) ^ s
proof:
:= by
  let Fv := completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v
  have hmem (x : E) : x ∈ Fv.valuation.valuationSubring ↔
      υ x ∈ Fv.valuation.valuationSubring := by
    change v x ≤ 1 ↔ v (υ x) ≤ 1
    rw [hval x]
  let eU : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup Fv 1 ≃*
      CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup Fv 1 :=
    CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.equivOfPreserves Fv υ hmem 1
  let ι : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup Fv 1 →* Eˣ :=
    (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits Fv).comp
      (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup Fv 1).subtype
  have hcoe (w : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup Fv 1) :
      (ι w : E) = (((w : Fv.valuationSubringˣ) : Fv.valuationSubring) : E) :=
    CompleteDVF.coe_valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits_apply Fv
      (w : Fv.valuationSubringˣ)
  let r : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup Fv 1 := eU u / u ^ a
  have hr : ι r = Units.map υ.toMonoidHom (ι u) / (ι u) ^ a := by
    change ι (eU u / u ^ a) = Units.map υ.toMonoidHom (ι u) / (ι u) ^ a
    rw [map_div, map_pow]
    apply congrArg (fun t : Eˣ => t / (ι u) ^ a)
    apply Units.ext
    rw [hcoe, Units.coe_map, hcoe]
    exact CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.equivOfPreserves_apply_coe Fv υ hmem 1 u
  change Units.map υ.toMonoidHom (ι u) / (ι u) ^ a = y ^ (p ^ s) at hy
  have hroot := congrArg (fun t : Eˣ => (t : E)) (hr.trans hy).symm
  rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, hcoe] at hroot
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzpow⟩ :=
    CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup.exists_primePower_root_of_field_root
      Fv p s (y : E) r hroot
      (hres := by change CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p; infer_instance)
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  have hlog := congrArg (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p) hzpow
  change principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p (z ^ (p ^ s)) =
    principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p (eU u / u ^ a) at hlog
  rw [map_pow, map_div, map_pow] at hlog
  have hadd := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hlog
  simp only [toAdd_pow, toAdd_div, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_pow] at hadd
  have haut : (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p (eU u)).toAdd =
      υ (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd :=
    principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_equivOfPreserves v p υ hval u
  rw [haut] at hadd
  have hp : (p : E) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  apply (eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero s hp)).mpr
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact hadd

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.representation_eq_self_of_log_image_of_action_sub_prime_divisible
statement:
private theorem representation_eq_self_of_log_image_of_action_sub_prime_divisible
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    {M : Type*} [hMAdd : AddCommGroup M] [hMModule : Module ℤ_[p] M]
    (ρ : Representation ℤ_[p] Γ M) (ι : M →+ K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hlog : ∀ x : M, ι x ∈
      Set.range (fun u => (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd))
    (hcard : p.Coprime (Fintype.card Γ))
    (hdiv : ∀ (g : Γ) (x : M), ∃ y : M, ρ g x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • y) :
    ∀ (g : Γ) (x : M), ρ g x = x
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (Fintype.card Γ : ℤ_[p]) :=
    PadicInt.isUnit_iff.mpr (PadicInt.norm_natCast_eq_one_iff.mpr hcard)
  let : Invertible (Fintype.card Γ : ℤ_[p]) := hunit.invertible
  let J : AddSubgroup K := (LinearMap.ker ρ.averageMap).toAddSubgroup.map ι
  have hJlog : (J : Set K) ⊆
      Set.range (fun u => (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd) := by
    rintro b ⟨x, _hx, rfl⟩
    exact hlog x
  have hJdiv : ∀ b : K, b ∈ J → ∃ c : K, c ∈ J ∧ p • c = b := by
    rintro b ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hpy⟩ :=
      averageMap_ker_divisible_of_action_sub_divisible ρ (p : ℤ_[p]) hdiv x hx
    refine ⟨ι y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← map_nsmul, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℤ_[p], hpy]
  have hJ : J = ⊥ :=
    addSubgroup_eq_bot_of_principalUnitLog_image_of_p_divisible v p J hJlog hJdiv
  have hker (x : M) (hx : ρ.averageMap x = 0) : x = 0 := by
    apply hι
    have hxJ : ι x ∈ J := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [hJ, AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hxJ
    exact hxJ.trans ι.map_zero.symm
  have havg (x : M) : ρ.averageMap x = x := by
    apply (sub_eq_zero.mp (hker (x - ρ.averageMap x) ?_)).symm
    rw [map_sub, ρ.averageMap_id (ρ.averageMap x) (ρ.averageMap_invariant x), sub_self]
  intro g x
  rw [← havg x]
  exact ρ.averageMap_invariant x g

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.characterLogRepresentation_eq_self_of_action_sub_prime_divisible
statement:
theorem characterLogRepresentation_eq_self_of_action_sub_prime_divisible
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (σ : Γ →* (K ≃+* K)) (hval : ∀ (g : Γ) (x : K), v (σ g x) = v x)
    (χ : Γ →* ℤ_[p]ˣ) (Δ : Subgroup Γ) [Δ.Normal]
    (hcard : p.Coprime (Fintype.card Γ))
    (hdiv : ∀ (g : Γ) (x : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ),
      ∃ y : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ,
        characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ g x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • y) :
    ∀ (g : Γ) (x : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ),
      characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ g x = x
proof:
:= by
  exact representation_eq_self_of_log_image_of_action_sub_prime_divisible
    (Γ := Γ) (M := CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ)
    (hMAdd := (characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ).addCommGroup)
    (hMModule := (characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ).module) v p
    (characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ)
    (characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ)
    (characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar_injective v p σ hval χ Δ)
    (exists_principalUnit_log_eq_characterLogInclusion v p σ hval χ Δ) hcard hdiv

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.addMonoidEnd_eq_self_of_log_image_of_primeOrder
statement:
private theorem addMonoidEnd_eq_self_of_log_image_of_primeOrder
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {M : Type*} [hMAdd : AddCommGroup M]
    (T : AddMonoid.End M) (ι : M →+ K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hlog : ∀ x : M, ι x ∈
      Set.range (fun u => (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd))
    (hT : T ^ p = 1) (hdiv : ∀ x : M, ∃ y : M, T x - x = p • y) :
    ∀ x : M, T x = x
proof:
:= by
  let : IsAddTorsionFree M := {
    nsmul_right_injective n hn x y hxy := by
      apply hι
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn : (n : K) ≠ 0)
      simpa only [map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul] using congrArg ι hxy }
  let D : AddMonoid.End M := T - 1
  let J : AddSubgroup K := (ι.comp D).range
  have hJlog : (J : Set K) ⊆
      Set.range (fun u => (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd) := by
    rintro a ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact hlog (D x)
  have haug := primeOrder_action_sub_divisible T p (Fact.out : p.Prime) hp2 hT hdiv
  have hJdiv : ∀ a : K, a ∈ J → ∃ b : K, b ∈ J ∧ p • b = a := by
    rintro a ⟨x, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := haug x
    refine ⟨ι (D y), ⟨y, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    change p • ι (T y - y) = ι (T x - x)
    rw [← map_nsmul, hy]
  have hJ := addSubgroup_eq_bot_of_principalUnitLog_image_of_p_divisible v p J hJlog hJdiv
  intro x
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply hι
  have hx : ι (D x) ∈ J := ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [hJ, AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hx
  exact hx.trans ι.map_zero.symm

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.characterLogRepresentation_eq_self_of_oddPrimeOrder
statement:
theorem characterLogRepresentation_eq_self_of_oddPrimeOrder
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (σ : Γ →* (K ≃+* K)) (hval : ∀ (g : Γ) (x : K), v (σ g x) = v x)
    (χ : Γ →* ℤ_[p]ˣ) (Δ : Subgroup Γ) [Δ.Normal]
    (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (g : Γ) (hg : g ^ p ∈ Δ)
    (hdiv : ∀ x : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ,
      ∃ y : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ,
        characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ g x - x = (p : ℤ_[p]) • y) :
    ∀ x : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ,
      characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ g x = x
proof:
:= by
  let M := CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ
  let ρ := characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ
  let ψ : Γ →* AddMonoid.End M :=
    { toFun := fun a => (ρ a).toAddMonoidHom
      map_one' := by
        apply AddMonoidHom.ext
        intro x
        exact congrArg (fun f => f x) ρ.map_one
      map_mul' := fun a b => by
        apply AddMonoidHom.ext
        intro x
        exact congrArg (fun f => f x) (ρ.map_mul a b) }
  have hpow : (ψ g) ^ p = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow]
    apply AddMonoidHom.ext
    intro x
    exact Subtype.ext (x.property ⟨g ^ p, hg⟩)
  have hdiv' (x : M) : ∃ y : M, ψ g x - x = p • y := by
    change ∃ y : M, ρ g x - x = p • y
    simpa only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul] using hdiv x
  exact addMonoidEnd_eq_self_of_log_image_of_primeOrder
    (M := CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ)
    (hMAdd := (characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ).addCommGroup)
    v p hp2 (ψ g)
    (characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ)
    (characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar_injective v p σ hval χ Δ)
    (exists_principalUnit_log_eq_characterLogInclusion v p σ hval χ Δ) hpow
    hdiv'

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.principal_unit_exp_log
statement:
theorem principal_unit_exp_log
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    let P : Set K
proof:
:= {x | ∃ a : v.valuationSubring, x = (p : K) ^ 2 * (a : K)}
    let U : Set K := {u | ∃ x : K, x ∈ P ∧ u = 1 + x}
    let exp : K → K := fun x =>
      expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x
        (fun m => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero m))
    let log : K → K := fun u =>
      logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v (u - 1)
        (fun m => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero m))
    (∀ x : K, x ∈ P → exp x ∈ U) ∧
      (∀ u : K, u ∈ U → log u ∈ P) ∧
      (∀ x : K, x ∈ P → log (exp x) = x) ∧
      (∀ u : K, u ∈ U → exp (log u) = u) ∧
      (∀ x y : K, x ∈ P → y ∈ P → exp (x + y) = exp x * exp y) ∧
      (∀ u w : K, u ∈ U → w ∈ U → log (u * w) = log u + log w) := by
  let q : K := (p : K) ^ 2
  let P : Set K := {x | ∃ a : v.valuationSubring, x = q * (a : K)}
  let U : Set K := {u | ∃ x : K, x ∈ P ∧ u = 1 + x}
  have hnexp : ∀ n : ℕ, (n.factorial : K) ≠ 0 :=
    fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
  have hnlog : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 :=
    fun n => Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  let E : K → K := fun x => expSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnexp
  let L : K → K := fun u => logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v (u - 1) hnlog
  change (∀ x : K, x ∈ P → E x ∈ U) ∧
    (∀ u : K, u ∈ U → L u ∈ P) ∧
    (∀ x : K, x ∈ P → L (E x) = x) ∧
    (∀ u : K, u ∈ U → E (L u) = u) ∧
    (∀ x y : K, x ∈ P → y ∈ P → E (x + y) = E x * E y) ∧
    (∀ u w : K, u ∈ U → w ∈ U → L (u * w) = L u + L w)
  let e : ℕ := v.residueRamificationIndex p
  have hvexp : ∀ n : ℕ, v (n.factorial : K) =
      WithZero.exp (-((e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p n.factorial : ℤ))) :=
    fun n => v.natCast_eq_exp_neg_ramificationIndex_mul_padicValNat p
      n.factorial (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
  have hvlog : ∀ n : ℕ, v ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K) =
      WithZero.exp (-((e : ℤ) * (padicValNat p (n + 1) : ℤ))) :=
    fun n => v.natCast_eq_exp_neg_ramificationIndex_mul_padicValNat p
      (n + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
  have hcomplete : @CompleteSpace K (Valued.mk' v).toUniformSpace :=
    ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.completeSpace_ofWithZeroValuation v
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).ne_zero)
  have memP_iff (z : K) : z ∈ P ↔ v z ≤ v q := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
      rw [v.map_mul]
      calc
        v q * v (a : K) ≤ v q * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a.property zero_le
        _ = v q := mul_one _
    · intro hz
      refine ⟨⟨z / q, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · change v (z / q) ≤ 1
        rw [v.map_div]
        exact (div_le_one₀ ((v.pos_iff).mpr hq)).mpr hz
      · change z = q * (z / q)
        field_simp
  have threshold {x : K} (hxP : x ∈ P) :
      ∀ hx : x ≠ 0,
        (e : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) <
          ((ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 x hx) : ℝ) := by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hxP
    exact fun hx => exp_threshold_natCast_sq_mul v p a hx
  have hvlt {x : K} (hxP : x ∈ P) : v x < 1 :=
    valuation_lt_one_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_threshold_real
      (p := p) v e (threshold hxP)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hxP
    refine ⟨E x - 1, ?_, by ring⟩
    apply (memP_iff _).mpr
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · simp only [hx, E, expSeriesField_zero_ofWithZeroValuation, sub_self, v.map_zero]
      exact zero_le
    · have hrat : (e : ℚ) / ((p : ℚ) - 1) <
          ((ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 x hx) : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast threshold hxP hx
      calc
        v (E x - 1) = v x :=
          valuation_expSeriesField_sub_one_eq_self_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_of_threshold
            (p := p) v e hx hnexp hvexp hrat hcomplete
        _ ≤ v q := (memP_iff x).mp hxP
  · intro u hu
    obtain ⟨x, hxP, rfl⟩ := hu
    apply (memP_iff _).mpr
    change v (logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v ((1 + x) - 1) hnlog) ≤ v q
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · simp only [hx, logOnePlusSeriesField_zero_ofWithZeroValuation, v.map_zero]
      exact zero_le
    · have hrat : (e : ℚ) / ((p : ℚ) - 1) <
          ((ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.mk0 x hx) : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast threshold hxP hx
      calc
        v (logOnePlusSeriesFieldOfWithZeroValuation v x hnlog) = v x :=
          valuation_logOnePlusSeriesField_eq_self_of_scaled_inv_sub_one_lt
            (p := p) v e hx hnlog hvlog (hvlt hxP) hrat hcomplete
        _ ≤ v q := (memP_iff x).mp hxP
  · intro x hxP
    exact logOnePlusSeries_expSeries_sub_one_eq_self_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_of_threshold
      (p := p) v e x hnexp hvexp hnlog hvlog (threshold hxP) hcomplete
  · intro u hu
    obtain ⟨x, hxP, rfl⟩ := hu
    have h := expSeries_logOnePlusSeries_eq_one_add_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_of_threshold
      (p := p) v e x hnlog hvlog hnexp hvexp (threshold hxP) hcomplete
    simpa only [L, E, add_sub_cancel_left] using h
  · intro x y hxP hyP
    exact expSeriesField_add_eq_mul_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled_of_threshold
      (p := p) v e x y hnexp hvexp (threshold hxP) (threshold hyP) hcomplete
  · intro u w hu hw
    obtain ⟨x, hxP, rfl⟩ := hu
    obtain ⟨y, hyP, rfl⟩ := hw
    have h := logOnePlusSeriesField_mul_argument_eq_add_ofWithZeroValuation_scaled
      (p := p) v e x y hnlog hvlog (hvlt hxP) (hvlt hyP) hcomplete
    simpa only [L, show (1 + x) * (1 + y) - 1 = x + y + x * y by ring,
      add_sub_cancel_left] using h

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.mem_characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar_iff
statement:
theorem mem_characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar_iff
    (x : PrincipalUnitLogImageOfMixedChar v p) :
    x ∈ characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ ↔
      ∀ δ : Δ, σ (δ : Γ) (x : K) =
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p (χ (δ : Γ) : ℤ_[p]) * (x : K)
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ (inverseCharacterTwist (χ.comp Δ.subtype)
    ((principalUnitLogImageRepresentationOfMixedChar v p σ hval).comp Δ.subtype)).invariants ↔ _
  rw [inverseCharacterTwist_mem_invariants_iff]

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.mem_characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar_of_nsmul_mem
statement:
theorem mem_characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar_of_nsmul_mem
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (x : PrincipalUnitLogImageOfMixedChar v p)
    (hx : n • x ∈ characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ) :
    x ∈ characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar v p σ hval χ Δ
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar_iff v p σ hval χ Δ x).mpr
  intro δ
  have hδ := (mem_characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar_iff v p σ hval χ Δ (n • x)).mp hx δ
  change σ (δ : Γ) (n • (x : K)) =
    padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p (χ (δ : Γ) : ℤ_[p]) * (n • (x : K)) at hδ
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn : (n : K) ≠ 0)
  simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_natCast, mul_left_comm] using hδ
