name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.valuation_algEquiv_eq_of_complete
statement:
private theorem valuation_algEquiv_eq_of_complete
    {F E : Type*} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [FiniteDimensional F E]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    [vE.IsRankOneDiscrete] [vF.HasExtension vE]
    (σ : E ≃ₐ[F] E) (x : E) : vE (σ x) = vE x

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_minimal_cyclotomic_log_eigenunit
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_cyclotomic_log_eigenunit
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    [vF.HasExtension vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} F K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} L E] :
    ∃ (b : Kˣ)
      (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1),
      (∀ γ : K ≃ₐ[F] K, algebraMap K E (γ (b : K)) =
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
          (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter F K p γ : ℤ_[p]) *
            algebraMap K E (b : K)) ∧
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd = algebraMap K E (b : K) ∧
      (∀ δ : E ≃ₐ[L] E,
        δ (((u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ) :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubring) : E) =
        (((principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar vE p
          (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter L E p δ : ℤ_[p]) u :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ) :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubring) : E)) ∧
      ∀ c : Kˣ,
        (∀ γ : K ≃ₐ[F] K, algebraMap K E (γ (c : K)) =
          padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
            (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter F K p γ : ℤ_[p]) *
              algebraMap K E (c : K)) →
        (∃ z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1,
          (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p z).toAdd = algebraMap K E (c : K)) →
        (ofWithZeroValuation vE).val (Units.map (algebraMap K E).toMonoidHom b) ≤
          (ofWithZeroValuation vE).val (Units.map (algebraMap K E).toMonoidHom c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vF.valuationSubring) p :=
    (Algebra.charP_iff (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vF.valuationSubring)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p).mpr inferInstance
  have : FiniteDimensional F K := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} F K
  have : IsGalois F K := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {p} F K
  have : FiniteDimensional L E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} L E
  let χF : (K ≃ₐ[F] K) →* Fˣ :=
    (Units.map (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vF p).toMonoidHom).comp
      (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter F K p)
  have hscalar (γ : K ≃ₐ[F] K) (x : K) :
      algebraMap K E ((χF γ : F) • x) =
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
          (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter F K p γ : ℤ_[p]) *
            algebraMap K E x := by
    simp only [χF, MonoidHom.comp_apply, Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe,
      MonoidHom.coe_ofClass, Algebra.smul_def, _root_.map_mul]
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F K E, map_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vF vE p]
  obtain ⟨b, hbeigen, hbimage, hbmin⟩ :=
    exists_minimal_characterEigenvector_log_image vE p χF
  have hΓ (γ : K ≃ₐ[F] K) : algebraMap K E (γ (b : K)) =
      padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
        (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter F K p γ : ℤ_[p]) *
          algebraMap K E (b : K) := by
    rw [hbeigen γ]
    exact hscalar γ (b : K)
  have hΔ (δ : E ≃ₐ[L] E) : δ (algebraMap K E (b : K)) =
      padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
        (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter L E p δ : ℤ_[p]) *
          algebraMap K E (b : K) := by
    have hcomm := (MulSemiringAction.toAlgAut (E ≃ₐ[L] E) F E δ).restrictNormal_commutes
      K (b : K)
    calc
      δ (algebraMap K E (b : K)) = algebraMap K E
          (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E δ (b : K)) :=
        hcomm.symm
      _ = padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
          (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter F K p
            (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E δ) : ℤ_[p]) *
              algebraMap K E (b : K) :=
        hΓ (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E δ)
      _ = _ := by rw [primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom]
  have hval (δ : E ≃ₐ[L] E) (x : E) : vE (δ x) = vE x :=
    valuation_algEquiv_eq_of_complete vF vE (δ.restrictScalars F) x
  have hcard : p.Coprime (Fintype.card (E ≃ₐ[L] E)) := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
      ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard L E p
  obtain ⟨u, hulog, hueigen⟩ := exists_principalUnit_log_eigen_lift vE p
    (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv (E ≃ₐ[L] E) E) hval hcard
    (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter L E p) (algebraMap K E (b : K)) hbimage hΔ
  refine ⟨b, u, hΓ, hulog, hueigen, ?_⟩
  intro c hceigen hcimage
  apply hbmin c ?_ hcimage
  intro γ
  apply (algebraMap K E).injective
  rw [hscalar]
  exact hceigen γ

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_minimal_characterEigenvector_log_image
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_characterEigenvector_log_image
    (v : _root_.Valuation M (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (χ : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Kˣ) :
    ∃ b : Lˣ,
      (∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, σ (b : L) = (χ σ : K) • (b : L)) ∧
      (∃ u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
        (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = algebraMap L M (b : L)) ∧
      ∀ c : Lˣ,
        (∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, σ (c : L) = (χ σ : K) • (c : L)) →
        (∃ u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
          (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = algebraMap L M (c : L)) →
        (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.map (algebraMap L M).toMonoidHom b) ≤
          (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.map (algebraMap L M).toMonoidHom c)
proof:
:= by
  let P : Lˣ → Prop := fun b =>
    (∀ σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L, σ (b : L) = (χ σ : K) • (b : L)) ∧
    ∃ u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = algebraMap L M (b : L)
  let f : Lˣ → ℤ := fun b =>
    (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.map (algebraMap L M).toMonoidHom b)
  obtain ⟨m, _hm, hbound⟩ := exists_principalUnitLog_denominator_min_bound v p
  let d : ℤ := ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) *
    (padicValNat p (m + 1) : ℤ)
  have hlower (b : Lˣ) (hb : P b) : d ≤ f b := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hb.2
    have hune : (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hu]
      exact (map_ne_zero (algebraMap L M)).mpr b.ne_zero
    have hunit : Units.mk0 (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd hune =
        Units.map (algebraMap L M).toMonoidHom b := by
      apply Units.ext
      simpa only [Units.val_mk0, Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe,
        MonoidHom.coe_ofClass] using hu
    have h := hbound u hune
    rw [hunit] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀eigen, hb₀image⟩ := exists_nonzero_characterEigenvector_log_image v p χ
  obtain ⟨z, ⟨b, hb, hbz⟩, hz⟩ :=
    Int.exists_least_of_bdd (P := fun z => ∃ b : Lˣ, P b ∧ f b = z)
      (by
        refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
        rintro z ⟨b, hb, hbz⟩
        rw [← hbz]
        exact hlower b hb)
      ⟨f b₀, b₀, ⟨hb₀eigen, hb₀image⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨b, hb.1, hb.2, ?_⟩
  intro c hceigen hcimage
  change f b ≤ f c
  rw [hbz]
  exact hz (f c) ⟨c, ⟨hceigen, hcimage⟩, rfl⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.principal_unit_log_image_open_closed
statement:
theorem principal_unit_log_image_open_closed
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    letI : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
proof:
:= Valued.mk' v
    let Λ : Set K := Set.range
      (fun u : LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1 =>
        (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd)
    IsOpen Λ ∧ IsClosed Λ := by
  let : Valued K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := Valued.mk' v
  let f : Additive
      (LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
        (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1) →+ K :=
    (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p).toAdditiveLeft
  let L : AddSubgroup K := f.range
  have hp : (p : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  let e : K ≃ₜ K := Homeomorph.mulLeft₀ ((p : K) ^ 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hp)
  let B : Set K := e '' (v.valuationSubring : Set K)
  have hBopen : IsOpen B :=
    e.isOpen_image.mpr (show IsOpen (v.valuationSubring : Set K) from
      Valued.isOpen_valuationSubring K)
  have h0B : (0 : K) ∈ B := by
    refine ⟨0, (v.valuationSubring).zero_mem, ?_⟩
    change (p : K) ^ 2 * 0 = 0
    exact mul_zero _
  have hBsub : B ⊆ (L : Set K) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_sq_mul v p
      (⟨a, ha⟩ : v.valuationSubring)
    apply AddMonoidHom.mem_range.mpr
    refine ⟨Additive.ofMul u, ?_⟩
    change (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = (p : K) ^ 2 * a
    exact hu
  have hLopen : IsOpen (L : Set K) :=
    AddSubgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds L
      (Filter.mem_of_superset (hBopen.mem_nhds h0B) hBsub)
  have hLclosed : IsClosed (L : Set K) := AddSubgroup.isClosed_of_isOpen L hLopen
  change IsOpen (L : Set K) ∧ IsClosed (L : Set K)
  exact ⟨hLopen, hLclosed⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.principal_unit_log_image_torsion_free
statement:
theorem principal_unit_log_image_torsion_free
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p] :
    let Λ : Set K
proof:
:= Set.range
      (fun u : LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1 =>
        (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd)
    ∀ (a : ℤ_[p]) (x : K), x ∈ Λ →
      padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p a * x = 0 → a = 0 ∨ x = 0 := by
  let f : ℤ_[p] →+* K := padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    apply (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot f).mpr
    by_contra hker
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := PadicInt.ideal_eq_span_pow_p hker
    have hpow : (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n ∈ RingHom.ker f := by
      rw [hn]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
    have hzero : f ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n) = 0 := RingHom.mem_ker.mp hpow
    have hpKpow : (p : K) ^ n = 0 := by
      simpa only [map_pow, map_natCast] using hzero
    have hpK : (p : K) ≠ 0 := by
      exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
    exact (pow_ne_zero n hpK) hpKpow
  intro Λ a x _ hax
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hax with ha | hx
  · left
    apply hf
    simpa only [map_zero] using ha
  · exact Or.inr hx

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.principal_unit_log_image_separated
statement:
theorem principal_unit_log_image_separated
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (x : K)
    (hx : ∀ m : ℕ,
      ∃ u : LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
        x = (p : K) ^ m * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hxne
  obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := exists_principalUnitLog_denominator_min_bound v p
  let d : ℤ := ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - (v.residueRamificationIndex p : ℤ) *
    (padicValNat p (k + 1) : ℤ)
  let V := ofWithZeroValuation v
  have hp : (p : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  let ep : ℤ := V.val (Units.mk0 (p : K) hp)
  have hep : 0 < ep := by
    change 0 < -WithZero.log (v (p : K))
    exact neg_pos.mpr (v.log_natCast_residueChar_neg p)
  let vx : ℤ := V.val (Units.mk0 x hxne)
  let m : ℕ := Int.toNat (vx - d) + 1
  have hm : vx - d < (m : ℤ) := by
    dsimp [m]
    omega
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hx m
  let y : K := (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd
  have hyne : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro hy
    apply hxne
    rw [hu, show (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = 0 from hy, mul_zero]
  have hylower : d ≤ V.val (Units.mk0 y hyne) := hk u hyne
  have hunit : Units.mk0 x hxne = (Units.mk0 (p : K) hp) ^ m * Units.mk0 y hyne := by
    apply Units.ext
    change x = (p : K) ^ m * y
    exact hu
  have hvx : vx = (m : ℤ) * ep + V.val (Units.mk0 y hyne) := by
    dsimp [vx, ep]
    rw [hunit, V.val_mul, V.val_pow]
  have hmle : (m : ℤ) ≤ (m : ℤ) * ep := by
    calc
      (m : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ (m : ℤ) * ep :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by omega) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le m)
  omega

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_smaller_characterEigenvector_log_of_power_witness
statement:
theorem exists_smaller_characterEigenvector_log_of_power_witness
    (v : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (υ : E ≃ₐ[L] E) (hval : ∀ x : E, v (υ x) = v x)
    (b : Lˣ)
    (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1)
    (hlog : (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p u).toAdd = algebraMap L E (b : L))
    (χ : (L ≃ₐ[F] L) → E)
    (hbeigen : ∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[F] L,
      algebraMap L E (γ (b : L)) = χ γ * algebraMap L E (b : L))
    (a s : ℕ) (ha : a < p ^ (s + 1)) (haone : a ≠ 1) (y : Eˣ)
    (hy :
      let u₀ : Eˣ :=
        (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v)
          (u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ))
      Units.map υ.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom u₀ / u₀ ^ a = y ^ (p ^ (s + 1))) :
    ∃ (c : Lˣ)
      (z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1),
      (∀ γ : L ≃ₐ[F] L,
        algebraMap L E (γ (c : L)) = χ γ * algebraMap L E (c : L)) ∧
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p z).toAdd = algebraMap L E (c : L) ∧
      (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.map (algebraMap L E).toMonoidHom c) <
        (ofWithZeroValuation v).val (Units.map (algebraMap L E).toMonoidHom b)
proof:
:= by
  let q : L := (1 - (a : L)) / (p : L) ^ (s + 1)
  let qE : E := (1 - (a : E)) / (p : E) ^ (s + 1)
  have hqmap : algebraMap L E q = qE := by
    simp only [q, qE, map_div₀, _root_.map_sub, _root_.map_one,
      _root_.map_natCast, _root_.map_pow]
  have hcoeff : 1 < v qE := v.one_lt_boundedCyclotomicCoefficient p a s ha haone
  have hqE : qE ≠ 0 := (v.pos_iff).mp (lt_trans zero_lt_one hcoeff)
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hqE
    rw [← hqmap, hzero, _root_.map_zero]
  let c : Lˣ := Units.mk0 q hq * b
  have hcmap : algebraMap L E (c : L) = qE * algebraMap L E (b : L) := by
    change algebraMap L E (q * (b : L)) = qE * algebraMap L E (b : L)
    rw [_root_.map_mul, hqmap]
  have hqfixed (γ : L ≃ₐ[F] L) : γ q = q := by
    simp only [q, map_div₀, _root_.map_sub, _root_.map_one,
      _root_.map_natCast, _root_.map_pow]
  obtain ⟨z, _hz, hzlog⟩ :=
    exists_principalUnit_log_of_fieldUnit_power_witness v p υ.toRingEquiv hval
      u a (s + 1) y hy
  refine ⟨c, z, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro γ
    calc
      algebraMap L E (γ (c : L)) =
          algebraMap L E q * algebraMap L E (γ (b : L)) := by
        change algebraMap L E (γ (q * (b : L))) =
          algebraMap L E q * algebraMap L E (γ (b : L))
        rw [_root_.map_mul, hqfixed γ, _root_.map_mul]
      _ = χ γ * algebraMap L E (c : L) := by
        rw [hbeigen γ]
        change algebraMap L E q * (χ γ * algebraMap L E (b : L)) =
          χ γ * algebraMap L E (q * (b : L))
        rw [_root_.map_mul]
        exact mul_left_comm (algebraMap L E q) (χ γ) (algebraMap L E (b : L))
  · have hfix : υ.toRingEquiv (algebraMap L E (b : L)) = algebraMap L E (b : L) :=
      υ.commutes (b : L)
    rw [hlog, hfix] at hzlog
    refine hzlog.trans ?_
    rw [hcmap]
    change (algebraMap L E (b : L) - (a : E) * algebraMap L E (b : L)) /
        (p : E) ^ (s + 1) =
      ((1 - (a : E)) / (p : E) ^ (s + 1)) * algebraMap L E (b : L)
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div₀, sub_mul, one_mul]
  · apply ofWithZeroValuation_val_lt_of_valuation_lt v
    change v (algebraMap L E (b : L)) < v (algebraMap L E (c : L))
    rw [hcmap, v.map_mul]
    have hbpos : 0 < v (algebraMap L E (b : L)) :=
      (v.pos_iff).mpr ((map_ne_zero (algebraMap L E)).mpr b.ne_zero)
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcoeff hbpos

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_principalUnit_log_subgroupCharacter_eigen_not_eigen
statement:
theorem exists_principalUnit_log_subgroupCharacter_eigen_not_eigen
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    [vF.HasExtension vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    (Δ : Subgroup Gal(E/F)) (χ : Gal(E/F) →* ℤ_[p]ˣ)
    (g : Gal(E/F)) (hg : g ∉ Δ) :
    ∃ u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1,
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ δ : Δ, (δ : Gal(E/F)) (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd =
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ (δ : Gal(E/F)) : ℤ_[p]) *
          (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd) ∧
      g (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd ≠
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) *
          (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd
proof:
:= by
  have : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vF.valuationSubring) p :=
    (Algebra.charP_iff (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vF.valuationSubring)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p).mpr inferInstance
  let χF : Gal(E/F) →* Fˣ :=
    (Units.map (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vF p).toMonoidHom).comp χ
  have hscalar (γ : Gal(E/F)) (x : E) :
      (χF γ : F) • x = padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ γ : ℤ_[p]) * x := by
    simp only [χF, MonoidHom.comp_apply, Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe,
      MonoidHom.coe_ofClass, Algebra.smul_def]
    rw [map_padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vF vE p]
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbeigen, hbnot⟩ :=
    exists_nonzero_subgroupCharacterEigenvector_not_eigen Δ χF g hg
  obtain ⟨n, u, hulog, hune⟩ :=
    exists_principalUnit_log_eq_natCast_pow_mul_ne_zero vE p b hb
  refine ⟨u, hune, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro δ
    rw [hulog, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_pow, map_natCast, hbeigen δ, hscalar]
    exact mul_left_comm ((p : E) ^ n)
      (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ (δ : Gal(E/F)) : ℤ_[p])) b
  · intro hgeigen
    apply hbnot
    have hpn : (p : E) ^ n ≠ 0 :=
      pow_ne_zero n (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero)
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hpn
    rw [hscalar]
    rw [hulog, _root_.map_mul, _root_.map_pow, map_natCast] at hgeigen
    exact hgeigen.trans (mul_left_comm
      (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ g : ℤ_[p])) ((p : E) ^ n) b)

name: LocalFieldTheory.DiscreteValuationField.MultiplicativeIntegerValuation.exists_principalUnit_log_eigen_lift
statement:
theorem exists_principalUnit_log_eigen_lift
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (σ : Δ →* (K ≃+* K)) (hval : ∀ (g : Δ) (x : K), v (σ g x) = v x)
    (hcard : p.Coprime (Fintype.card Δ)) (χ : Δ →* ℤ_[p]ˣ) (b : K)
    (himage : ∃ x : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p x).toAdd = b)
    (heigen : ∀ g : Δ, σ g b = padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) * b) :
    ∃ x : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1,
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar v p x).toAdd = b ∧
      ∀ g : Δ,
        σ g (((x : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ) :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubring) : K) =
        (((principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) x :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ) :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubring) : K)
proof:
:= by
  let F := completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v
  let : Module ℤ_[p] (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1)) :=
    principalUnitPadicModuleOfMixedChar v p
  let : Module ℤ_[p] K := (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar v p).toModule
  have hunit : IsUnit (Fintype.card Δ : ℤ_[p]) :=
    PadicInt.isUnit_iff.mpr (PadicInt.norm_natCast_eq_one_iff.mpr hcard)
  let : Invertible (Fintype.card Δ : ℤ_[p]) := hunit.invertible
  let ρU : Representation ℤ_[p] Δ (Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1)) :=
    principalUnitRepresentationOfMixedChar v p σ hval
  let ρK : Representation ℤ_[p] Δ K := fieldRepresentationOfMixedChar v p σ hval
  let logIntertwiner : Representation.IntertwiningMap ρU ρK :=
    principalUnitLogIntertwinerOfMixedChar v p σ hval
  have hlogImage : b ∈ Set.range logIntertwiner := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := himage
    exact ⟨Additive.ofMul x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxlog, hxeigen⟩ := exists_eigen_preimage χ logIntertwiner b heigen hlogImage
  refine ⟨Additive.toMul x, hxlog, ?_⟩
  intro g
  have h := congrArg
    (fun z : Additive (CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1) =>
      ((((Additive.toMul z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup F 1) :
        F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K)) (hxeigen g)
  change (((equivOfPreserves F (σ g)
      (fun z => by change v z ≤ 1 ↔ v (σ g z) ≤ 1; rw [hval g z]) 1
      (Additive.toMul x) : F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K) =
    (((principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) (Additive.toMul x) :
      F.valuationSubringˣ) : F.valuationSubring) : K) at h
  rw [equivOfPreserves_apply_coe] at h
  exact h

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.mixedChar_openLayer_prime_index_faithful
statement:
private theorem mixedChar_openLayer_prime_index_faithful
    {K Ω : Type u} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP base.residueField p]
    (H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K)) [CompactSpace (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))]
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)))
    (hprime : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index.Prime) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p)
      (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) N.isClosed)
proof:
:= by
  let F : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  let closedH : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨H.toSubgroup, H.isClosed⟩
  have hfix : F.fixingSubgroup = (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField closedH
  have : FiniteDimensional K F := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite F).mp (by
    rw [hfix]
    exact H.isOpen)
  have : IsAlgClosure F Ω :=
    ⟨IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed K, Algebra.IsAlgebraic.tower_top (K := K) F⟩
  have : T2Space Gal(Ω/F) := krullTopology_t2 (K := F) (L := Ω)
  let target : HenselianDVF F := FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF base
  have : base.toDVF.valuation.HasExtension target.toDVF.valuation :=
    FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF_hasExtension base
  have : CharP target.residueField p :=
    (Algebra.charP_iff base.residueField target.residueField p).mp inferInstance
  let e₀ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* F.fixingSubgroup :=
    { toMulEquiv := MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hfix.symm
      continuous_toFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix.symm ▸ x.property)
      continuous_invFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix ▸ x.property) }
  let e : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* Gal(Ω/F) := e₀.trans (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv F)
  let M : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F) := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
  have : M.Normal :=
    (inferInstance : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).Normal).map
      e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom e.surjective
  have hM : IsOpen (M : Set Gal(Ω/F)) := e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap N N.isOpen
  let r : ℕ := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index
  have : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hprime⟩
  have hindex : M.index = r := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index_map_equiv e.toMulEquiv
  have hfaith := mixedChar_henselian_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
    target p M hM hindex
  exact (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
    (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) e
    (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) N.isClosed).mp hfaith

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.isSigmaAbFaithful_absoluteGaloisGroup_singleton_of_henselian_mixedChar
statement:
theorem isSigmaAbFaithful_absoluteGaloisGroup_singleton_of_henselian_mixedChar
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP base.residueField p] :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful {p} Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
proof:
:= by
  apply isSigmaAbFaithful_iff_prime_order_test.mpr
  intro H
  have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :=
    H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  intro N hprime
  have hfaith := mixedChar_openLayer_prime_index_faithful base p H N hprime
  have hSigma := residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_of_class_inclusion
    (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p})
    (fun {Q : Type u} [Group Q] hQ => (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_singleton_iff_pGroup p Q).mpr hQ)
    (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))) N.isClosed hfaith
  exact (injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card
    (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p})
      (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))) N.isClosed) hprime).mp hSigma

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.isSigmaAbFaithful_absoluteGaloisGroup_and_maximalProSigma_of_henselian_mixedChar
statement:
theorem isSigmaAbFaithful_absoluteGaloisGroup_and_maximalProSigma_of_henselian_mixedChar
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP base.residueField p]
    {sigma : Set ℕ} (hp : p ∈ sigma) :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) ∧
      IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) ∧
        IsAbFaithful (Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) ⧸
          proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup sigma) Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
proof:
:= by
  have hG : IsSigmaAbFaithful sigma Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) :=
    IsSigmaAbFaithful.mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hp)
      (isSigmaAbFaithful_absoluteGaloisGroup_singleton_of_henselian_mixedChar base p)
  exact ⟨hG, hG.isAbFaithful, hG.isAbFaithful_residualQuotient⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one_of_moved_abelianModPower
statement:
theorem inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one_of_moved_abelianModPower
    (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [CharZero L]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p)
    (hz : relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z ≠ z) :
    relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) K L τ⁻¹ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdiff : relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z * z⁻¹ ≠ 1 :=
    fun h => hz (mul_inv_eq_one.mp h)
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_prime_character_abelianModPower hdiff
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := abelianModPowerMk_surjective (G := Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) p z
  let ψ := χ.comp (abelianModPowerMk Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p)
  intro htrivial
  have heq := congrArg (fun e => e.toAdd (h1OfCharacter ψ)
    (Additive.ofMul (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))) htrivial
  have hvalue : ψ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ) = ψ σ :=
    Multiplicative.toAdd.injective heq
  apply hχ
  rw [map_mul, map_inv, show χ (relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ
    (abelianModPowerMk Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p σ)) =
      χ (abelianModPowerMk Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p σ) from hvalue,
    mul_inv_cancel]

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform_naturality
statement:
theorem relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform_naturality
    (q : ℕ) (f : L →+* E) (τ : Gal(L/K)) (σ : Gal(E/F))
    (hcompat : ∀ x : L, σ (f x) = f (τ x))
    (z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) q) :
    abelianModPowerMap q (map f)
        (relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F E q σ z) =
      relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L q τ
        (abelianModPowerMap q (map f) z)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : f.comp τ.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      σ.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp f := by
    ext x
    apply σ.injective
    exact (hcompat (τ.symm x)).trans
      ((congrArg f (τ.apply_symm_apply x)).trans (σ.apply_symm_apply (f x)).symm)
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := abelianModPowerMk_surjective (G := Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)) q z
  let χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) →ₜ* abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) q :=
    abelianModPowerMk _ q
  change χ (map f (absoluteGaloisConjugate σ.toRingEquiv a)) =
    χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv (map f a))
  have hσ := character_map_symm_eq_absoluteGaloisConjugate σ.toRingEquiv
    (χ.comp (map f)) a
  have hτ := character_map_symm_eq_absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv χ (map f a)
  exact hσ.symm.trans ((DFunLike.congr_fun (character_map_comp f
    σ.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom χ) a).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun h : L →+* E => χ (map h a)) heq.symm).trans
      ((DFunLike.congr_fun (character_map_comp τ.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom f χ) a).trans hτ)))

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_moved_mod_prime_of_moved_valuation_posChar
statement:
theorem exists_moved_mod_prime_of_moved_valuation_posChar
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (target : DVF.{u, v} L) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP L p]
    (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (hτ : ¬ target.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) :
    ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
      relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ.symm z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let moved : DVF.{u,v} L :=
    { ValueGroup := target.ValueGroup
      valuation := target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
      instRankOneDiscrete := Valuation.isRankOneDiscrete_comap_ringEquiv
        target.valuation τ.toRingEquiv }
  let D : Fin 2 → DVF.{u,v} L := ![target, moved]
  have hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation) := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact False.elim (hij rfl)
    · exact hτ
    · intro h
      exact hτ h.symm
    · exact False.elim (hij rfl)
  obtain ⟨χ, a, ha⟩ :=
    ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_nontrivial_completion_character_of_DVF (D 0) p
  exact exists_moved_mod_prime_of_inequivalent_completions D hD p τ
    (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl) χ a ha

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.prime_order_detection_of_fg_posChar
statement:
theorem prime_order_detection_of_fg_posChar
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime] [CharP K p] [Infinite K]
    (hfg : Field.FG K) (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = r) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ≠ 1 ∧
      ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
        relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
  have : CharP L p := charP_of_injective_ringHom (algebraMap K L).injective p
  have : Infinite L := Infinite.of_injective (algebraMap K L) (algebraMap K L).injective
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = r := (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdegree
  have : Nontrivial Gal(L/K) := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp
    (hcard.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).one_lt)
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Gal(L/K))
  let φ : Gal(L/K) →* RingAut L :=
    { toFun := AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  have hne : φ τ ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hτ
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x
  have hpow : (φ τ) ^ orderOf τ = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow, pow_orderOf_eq_one, map_one]
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := FieldTheory.exists_moved_DVF_of_fg_posChar L
    (FieldTheory.fg_of_finiteDimensional K L hfg)
    ((ringChar.eq L p).trans_ne (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero)
    (φ τ) hne (orderOf τ) (orderOf_pos τ) hpow
  exact ⟨τ.symm, inv_ne_one.mpr hτ,
    exists_moved_mod_prime_of_moved_valuation_posChar D p τ hD⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_moved_mod_prime_of_moved_valuation
statement:
theorem exists_moved_mod_prime_of_moved_valuation
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [CharZero L]
    (target : DVF.{u, v} L) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP target.residueField p]
    (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (hτ : ¬ target.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) :
    ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
      relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ.symm z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let moved : DVF.{u,v} L :=
    { ValueGroup := target.ValueGroup
      valuation := target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
      instRankOneDiscrete := Valuation.isRankOneDiscrete_comap_ringEquiv
        target.valuation τ.toRingEquiv }
  let D : Fin 2 → DVF.{u,v} L := ![target, moved]
  have hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation) := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact False.elim (hij rfl)
    · exact hτ
    · intro h
      exact hτ h.symm
    · exact False.elim (hij rfl)
  let targetHat : DVF.{u,v} (D 0).valuation.Completion :=
    { ValueGroup := (D 0).ValueGroup
      valuation := Valued.v
      instRankOneDiscrete := Valuation.completion_isRankOneDiscrete (D 0).valuation }
  have : CharP (D 0).residueField p := inferInstanceAs (CharP target.residueField p)
  have : CharP targetHat.residueField p := Valuation.completion_residueChar (D 0).valuation p
  have : CharZero (D 0).valuation.Completion :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap L (D 0).valuation.Completion).injective
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_surjective_prime_character_of_mixedChar targetHat p
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hχ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod p))
  have ha' : χ a ≠ 1 := by
    rw [ha]
    intro h
    exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ZMod p) ≠ 0)
      (congrArg (fun x : Multiplicative (ZMod p) => x.toAdd) h)
  exact exists_moved_mod_prime_of_inequivalent_completions D hD p τ
    (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl) χ a ha'

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.dyadic_mod_two
statement:
theorem dyadic_mod_two
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [CharZero K] (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K)
    [CharP base.residueField 2]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = 2) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ≠ 1 ∧
      ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) 2,
        relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L 2 τ z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (by rw [hdegree]; decide)
  have : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K L).injective
  have : Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension K L := ⟨hdegree⟩
  have : IsGalois K L := inferInstance
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = 2 :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdegree
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, _⟩ := (Nat.card_eq_two_iff' (1 : Gal(L/K))).mp hcard
  refine ⟨τ, hτ, ?_⟩
  by_contra hnone
  have hfixed (z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) 2) :
      relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L 2 τ z = z :=
    not_not.mp (fun hz => hnone ⟨z, hz⟩)
  have hcharacters
      (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
      (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) :
      χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ) = χ σ := by
    have hpow : ∀ a : Multiplicative (ZMod 2), a ^ 2 = 1 := by
      intro a
      apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
      change 2 • a.toAdd = (0 : ZMod 2)
      simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]
    let χbar := abelianModPowerLift 2 χ hpow
    have heq := congrArg χbar (hfixed
      ((ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.mk _ σ :
        TopologicalAbelianization _) :
          abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) 2))
    exact heq
  have hmu : (primitiveRoots 2 L).Nonempty :=
    ⟨-1, (mem_primitiveRoots (by decide : 0 < 2)).mpr
      (IsPrimitiveRoot.neg_one 0 (by decide))⟩
  have hroots (ξ : L) (hξ : ξ ^ 2 = 1) : τ.toRingEquiv ξ = ξ ^ 1 := by
    rw [pow_one]
    rcases eq_or_eq_neg_of_sq_eq_sq ξ (1 : L)
      (by simpa only [one_pow] using hξ) with hp | hn
    · rw [hp, map_one]
    · rw [hn, map_neg, map_one]
  let n : ℕ+ := ⟨2, by decide⟩
  have : NeZero ((n : ℕ) : L) := ⟨by change (2 : L) ≠ 0; norm_num⟩
  have hunits := (kummer_trivial_action_criterion L n hmu
    τ.toRingEquiv 1 hroots).mp hcharacters
  obtain ⟨a, α, hα0, hαsq, hanti, hns⟩ := exists_quadratic_antiInvariant hdegree τ hτ
  obtain ⟨x, y, hn, hna⟩ := base.exists_quadraticForm_outside_squareClasses a hns
  let z : L := algebraMap K L x + α * algebraMap K L y
  have hnorm : z * τ z = algebraMap K L (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) := by
    calc
      z * τ z = (algebraMap K L x) ^ 2 - α ^ 2 * (algebraMap K L y) ^ 2 := by
        dsimp only [z]
        rw [map_add, map_mul, τ.commutes, τ.commutes, hanti]
        ring
      _ = algebraMap K L (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) := by
        rw [hαsq, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow]
  have hnormns : ¬ IsSquare (algebraMap K L (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2)) := by
    intro hs
    exact ((isSquare_algebraMap_iff_of_quadratic hdegree τ hτ a α hα0 hαsq hanti _).mp
      hs).elim hn hna
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hnormns
    rw [← hnorm, hz, zero_mul]
    exact ⟨0, (zero_mul 0).symm⟩
  let u : Lˣ := Units.mk0 z hz0
  have hu := hunits u
  rw [pow_one] at hu
  have hmem : u⁻¹ * Units.map τ.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom u ∈
      (powMonoidHom 2 : Lˣ →* Lˣ).range := QuotientGroup.eq.mp hu.symm
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hmem
  have hbval : (b : L) ^ 2 = z⁻¹ * τ z := congrArg Units.val hb
  have hprod : z * (b : L) ^ 2 = τ z := by
    rw [hbval, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hz0, one_mul]
  apply hnormns
  refine ⟨z * (b : L), ?_⟩
  rw [← hnorm, ← hprod]
  ring

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.prime_degree_cohomology_of_mixedChar
statement:
theorem prime_degree_cohomology_of_mixedChar
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [CharZero K] (base : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime] [CharP base.residueField p]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = r) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) K L τ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K L).injective
  obtain ⟨τ, _, z, hz⟩ := prime_order_detection_of_mixedChar base p r hdegree
  exact ⟨τ⁻¹, inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one_of_moved_abelianModPower K L p τ z hz⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.prime_order_detection_of_stable_valuation
statement:
theorem prime_order_detection_of_stable_valuation
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [CharZero K] (base : DVF.{u, v} K) (target : DVF.{u, v} L)
    [base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation]
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime]
    [CharP base.residueField p]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = r)
    (hstable : ∀ τ : Gal(L/K),
      target.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ≠ 1 ∧
      ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
        relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
  have : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K L).injective
  let _ : Algebra base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion :=
    DVF.completionAlgebra base target
  have : FiniteDimensional base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion :=
    DVF.completion_finiteDimensional base target
  have : IsGalois base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion :=
    DVF.completion_isGalois_of_stable base target hstable
  have : CharZero base.valuation.Completion :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K base.valuation.Completion).injective
  let baseHat : CompleteDVF.{u,v} base.valuation.Completion :=
    { ValueGroup := base.ValueGroup
      valuation := Valued.v
      instCompleteDiscrete := Valuation.completion_isCompleteDiscrete base.valuation }
  have : CharP baseHat.residueField p := Valuation.completion_residueChar base.valuation p
  have hdegreeHat : Module.finrank base.valuation.Completion target.valuation.Completion = r :=
    (DVF.finrank_completion_eq_of_galois_stable base target hstable).trans hdegree
  have hdetect := prime_order_detection (K := base.valuation.Completion)
    (L := target.valuation.Completion) baseHat p r hdegreeHat
  rcases hdetect with ⟨τHat, hτHat, z, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := DVF.completionAlgEquiv_surjective base target hstable τHat
  subst τHat
  refine ⟨τ, ?_, abelianModPowerMap p (map (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion)) z, ?_⟩
  · intro heq
    apply hτHat
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    have hh : Continuous (DVF.completionAlgEquiv base target τ (hstable τ)) :=
      UniformSpace.Completion.continuous_map
    have hone : (fun y => DVF.completionAlgEquiv base target τ (hstable τ) y) =
        (fun y => y) := by
      apply UniformSpace.Completion.ext hh continuous_id
      intro y
      have hy := DVF.completionAlgEquiv_algebraMap base target τ (hstable τ)
        (WithVal.equiv target.valuation y)
      have hy' : τ (WithVal.equiv target.valuation y) = WithVal.equiv target.valuation y := by
        rw [heq]
        rfl
      exact hy.trans (congrArg (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion) hy')
    exact congrFun hone x
  · intro heq
    apply hz
    apply completion_abelianModPowerMap_injective target p
    exact (relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform_naturality p
      (algebraMap L target.valuation.Completion) τ
      (DVF.completionAlgEquiv base target τ (hstable τ))
      (DVF.completionAlgEquiv_algebraMap base target τ (hstable τ)) z).trans heq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.isAbFaithful_maximalProPGaloisGroup_iff_completion
statement:
theorem isAbFaithful_maximalProPGaloisGroup_iff_completion
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (base : HenselianDVF K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :

      proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K)) ↔
    IsAbFaithful (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup base.valuation.Completion ⧸

:=
  isAbFaithful_iff_continuousMulEquiv (completionMaximalProPGaloisEquiv base p)

statement:
