name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.fixingSubgroup_residualAbelianization_ne_one_of_moved_mod_prime_separable
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_residualAbelianization_ne_one_of_moved_mod_prime_separable
    {F Ω : Type u} [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsSepClosure F Ω]
    (S : IntermediateField F Ω) [FiniteDimensional F S] [IsGalois F S]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (τ : Gal(S/F))
    (z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S) p)
    (hz : relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F S p τ z ≠ z) :
    residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p}) S.fixingSubgroup
        (InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_isClosed S) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro htriv
  have hpow := (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_eq_one_iff_primePower
    (sigma := {p}) S.fixingSubgroup (InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_isClosed S)).mp htriv
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective Ω τ
  let e := fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv S
  let q : TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S) →*
      abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S) p := QuotientGroup.mk' _
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
    (powMonoidHom (α := TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S)) p).range z
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hpow (QuotientGroup.mk' S.fixingSubgroup g) (e.symm a)
    p rfl (Fact.out : p.Prime) 1 (by decide)
  rw [pow_one] at hb
  have heq := congrArg e hb
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, ContinuousMulEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at heq
  rw [fixingSubgroupSeparableAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_quotient_conjugation,
    ContinuousMulEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at heq
  change absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction
    ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom S) g).toRingEquiv a = a * (e b) ^ p at heq
  rw [hg] at heq
  have hqpow : q (e b) ^ p = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow]
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff
      (N := (powMonoidHom (α := TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S)) p).range)
      ((e b)^p)).mpr ⟨e b, rfl⟩
  have hq := congrArg q heq
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, hqpow, mul_one] at hq
  apply hz
  calc
    relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F S p τ (q a) =
        q (absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ.toRingEquiv a) := by
      obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk _ a
      rfl
    _ = q a := hq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primeDegree_separable_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
statement:
theorem primeDegree_separable_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
    {F Ω : Type u} [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsSepClosure F Ω]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime]
    (hdetect : ∀ (S : IntermediateField F Ω) [IsGalois F S],
      Module.finrank F S = r →
        ∃ τ : Gal(S/F), ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S) p,
          relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F S p τ z ≠ z)
    (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F)) [N.Normal]
    (hN : IsOpen (N : Set Gal(Ω/F))) (hindex : N.index = r) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p}) N (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN))
proof:
:= by
  let H : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/F) := ⟨N, N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN⟩
  let S : IntermediateField F Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField N
  have hfix : S.fixingSubgroup = N := InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField H
  have : FiniteDimensional F S := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite S).mp
    (by rw [hfix]; exact hN)
  have hcard : Nat.card (Gal(Ω/F) ⧸ N) = r := N.index_eq_card.symm.trans hindex
  have hdegree : Module.finrank F S = r :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank F S).symm.trans
      ((Nat.card_congr (InfiniteGalois.normalAutEquivQuotient H).toEquiv).symm.trans hcard)
  obtain ⟨τ, z, hz⟩ := hdetect S hdegree
  have hfaith :=
    fixingSubgroup_residualAbelianization_ne_one_of_moved_mod_prime_separable S p τ z hz
  let P : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F) → Prop := fun U =>
    ∀ hU : U.Normal, letI : U.Normal := hU
      ∀ hclosed : IsClosed (U : Set Gal(Ω/F)),
        residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
          (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p}) U hclosed ≠ 1
  have hP : P S.fixingSubgroup := fun _ _ => hfaith
  have hPN : P N := hfix ▸ hP
  apply (injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card _ (hcard.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime))).mpr
  exact hPN inferInstance (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primeDegree_separable_openLayer_residual_faithful
statement:
private theorem primeDegree_separable_openLayer_residual_faithful
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hdetect : ∀ (F E : Type u) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
      [IsGalois F E] [CharP F p] [Infinite F], Field.FG F →
      ∀ (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime], Module.finrank F E = r →
        ∃ τ : Gal(E/F), τ ≠ 1 ∧
          ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) p,
            relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F E p τ z ≠ z)
    {K Ω : Type u} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsSepClosure K Ω] [CharP K p] [Infinite K]
    (hfg : Field.FG K)
    (H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K))
    [CompactSpace (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))]
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)))
    (hprime : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index.Prime) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p})
      (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) N.isClosed)
proof:
:= by
  let F : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  let closedH : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨H.toSubgroup, H.isClosed⟩
  have hfix : F.fixingSubgroup = (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField closedH
  have : FiniteDimensional K F := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite F).mp (by
    rw [hfix]
    exact H.isOpen)
  have : IsSepClosure F Ω :=
    ⟨IsSepClosure.sep_closed K, Algebra.isSeparable_tower_top_of_isSeparable K F Ω⟩
  have : T2Space Gal(Ω/F) := krullTopology_t2 (K := F) (L := Ω)
  have : CharP F p := (Algebra.charP_iff K F p).mp inferInstance
  have : Infinite F := Infinite.of_injective (algebraMap K F) (algebraMap K F).injective
  have hFfg : Field.FG F := FieldTheory.fg_of_finiteDimensional K F hfg
  let e₀ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* F.fixingSubgroup :=
    { toMulEquiv := MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hfix.symm
      continuous_toFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix.symm ▸ x.property)
      continuous_invFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix ▸ x.property) }
  let e : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* Gal(Ω/F) := e₀.trans (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv F)
  let M : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F) := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
  have : M.Normal :=
    (inferInstance : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).Normal).map
      e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom e.surjective
  have hM : IsOpen (M : Set Gal(Ω/F)) := e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap N N.isOpen
  let r : ℕ := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index
  have : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hprime⟩
  have hindex : M.index = r := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index_map_equiv e.toMulEquiv
  have hfaith := primeDegree_separable_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful p
    (fun S _ hdeg => by
      obtain ⟨τ, _, z, hz⟩ := hdetect F S hFfg r hdeg
      exact ⟨τ, z, hz⟩) M hM hindex
  have hNfaith := (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
    (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p}) e
    (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) N.isClosed).mp hfaith
  exact hNfaith

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.isSigmaAbFaithful_of_primeDegree_detection_fg_charP
statement:
theorem isSigmaAbFaithful_of_primeDegree_detection_fg_charP
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hdetect : ∀ (F E : Type u) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
      [IsGalois F E] [CharP F p] [Infinite F], Field.FG F →
      ∀ (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime], Module.finrank F E = r →
        ∃ τ : Gal(E/F), τ ≠ 1 ∧
          ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) p,
            relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F E p τ z ≠ z)
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharP K p] [Infinite K] (hfg : Field.FG K) :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful {p} Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
proof:
:= by
  have hSep : IsSigmaAbFaithful {p} Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) := by
    apply isSigmaAbFaithful_iff_prime_order_test.mpr
    intro H
    have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)) :=
      H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
    intro N hprime
    have hNfaith := primeDegree_separable_openLayer_residual_faithful p hdetect hfg H N hprime
    exact (injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card _ hprime).mp hNfaith
  exact IsSigmaAbFaithful.of_continuousMulEquiv
    (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv K) hSep

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.residueZero_openLayer_prime_index_faithful
statement:
private theorem residueZero_openLayer_prime_index_faithful
    {K Ω : Type u} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (D : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) [CharZero D.residueField]
    (hres : IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure D.residueField/D.residueField))
    (hroots : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra D.residueField E]
      [FiniteDimensional D.residueField E] (p : ℕ), p.Prime →
      Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p))
    (H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K))
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)))
    (hprime : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index.Prime) :
    Function.Injective (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
      (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))))
proof:
:= by
  let F : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  let closedH : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨H.toSubgroup, H.isClosed⟩
  have hfix : F.fixingSubgroup = (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField closedH
  have : FiniteDimensional K F := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite F).mp
    (by rw [hfix]; exact H.isOpen)
  have : IsAlgClosure F Ω :=
    ⟨IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed K, Algebra.IsAlgebraic.tower_top (K := K) F⟩
  let target : HenselianDVF F := FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF D
  have : D.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation :=
    FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF_hasExtension D
  have : CharZero target.residueField :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap D.residueField target.residueField).injective
  have : FiniteDimensional D.residueField target.residueField :=
    _root_.Valuation.finiteDimensional_residueField D.valuation target.valuation
  have htarget : IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure target.residueField/target.residueField) :=
    isAbFaithful_absoluteGaloisGroup_of_finiteExtension hres
  have htargetRoots : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra target.residueField E]
      [FiniteDimensional target.residueField E] (p : ℕ), p.Prime →
      Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p) := by
    intro E hE hA hfd p hp
    let : Algebra D.residueField E :=
      ((algebraMap target.residueField E).comp
        (algebraMap D.residueField target.residueField)).toAlgebra
    have : IsScalarTower D.residueField target.residueField E :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    have : FiniteDimensional D.residueField E :=
      FiniteDimensional.trans D.residueField target.residueField E
    exact hroots E p hp
  let e₀ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* F.fixingSubgroup :=
    { toMulEquiv := MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hfix.symm
      continuous_toFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix.symm ▸ x.property)
      continuous_invFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix ▸ x.property) }
  let e : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* Gal(Ω/F) :=
    e₀.trans (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv F)
  let M : OpenNormalSubgroup Gal(Ω/F) := ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.map
    (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom e) e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap e.surjective N
  have hindex : (M : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F)).index =
      (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index :=
    (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index_map_equiv e.toMulEquiv
  have hMprime : (M : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F)).index.Prime := hindex.symm ▸ hprime
  exact quotientConjAbelianization_injective_of_continuousMulEquiv_image e N
    (residueZero_openNormal_prime_index_faithful target htarget htargetRoots M hMprime)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.residueZero_abFaithful_of_finitePrimePowerRoots
statement:
theorem residueZero_abFaithful_of_finitePrimePowerRoots
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (D : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) [CharZero D.residueField]
    (hres : IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure D.residueField/D.residueField))
    (hroots : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra D.residueField E]
      [FiniteDimensional D.residueField E] (p : ℕ), p.Prime →
      Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p)) :
    IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero K := by
    refine ⟨fun m n h => ?_⟩
    apply Nat.cast_injective (R := D.residueField)
    have hv : (m : D.valuation.valuationSubring) = n := Subtype.ext h
    have hr := congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue D.valuation.valuationSubring) hv
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hr
  apply isAbFaithful_iff_prime_order_test.mpr
  intro H N hprime
  have hindex : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))).index.Prime := by
    rwa [(N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))).index_eq_card]
  exact (injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card _ hprime).mp
    (residueZero_openLayer_prime_index_faithful D hres hroots H N hindex)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.relativeModPowerAction_apply
statement:
private theorem relativeModPowerAction_apply
    (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (p : ℕ) (τ : Gal(L/K)) (z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p) :
    relativeModPowerAction K L p τ z =
      relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
    (powMonoidHom (α := TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) p).range z
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk _ a
  change QuotientGroup.mk' _ (absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ.toRingEquiv
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk _ σ)) = _
  rw [absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_apply_mk]
  rfl

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform_faithful_of_primeDegree_detection
statement:
theorem relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform_faithful_of_primeDegree_detection
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hdetect : ∀ (F E : Type u) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
      [IsGalois F E] [CharZero F]
      (base : DVF.{u, v} F) [CharP base.residueField p]
      (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime], Module.finrank F E = r →
        ∃ τ : Gal(E/F), τ ≠ 1 ∧
          ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) p,
            relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F E p τ z ≠ z)
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) [CharP base.residueField p]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] :
    ∀ τ : Gal(L/K),
      (∀ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
        relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z = z) → τ = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ρ := relativeModPowerAction K L p
  have hfaith : Function.Injective ρ := by
    by_contra hρ
    obtain ⟨C, hCprime, hCker⟩ :=
      exists_prime_card_subgroup_le_ker_of_not_injective ρ hρ
    let F : IntermediateField K L := IntermediateField.fixedField C
    have : Fact (Nat.card C).Prime := ⟨hCprime⟩
    have hdegree : Module.finrank F L = Nat.card C :=
      IntermediateField.finrank_fixedField_eq_card C
    obtain ⟨target, _, hres⟩ := base.exists_extension_residueChar (L := F) p
    have : CharP target.residueField p := hres
    obtain ⟨τ, _hτ, z, hz⟩ := hdetect F L target (Nat.card C) hdegree
    let e : C ≃* Gal(L/F) := IntermediateField.subgroupEquivAlgEquiv C
    let s : C := e.symm τ
    have hs : ρ (s : Gal(L/K)) = 1 := hCker s.property
    have he : (s : Gal(L/K)).toRingEquiv = τ.toRingEquiv :=
      congrArg AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv (e.apply_symm_apply τ)
    have hzfix := congrArg
      (fun a : MulAut (abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p) => a z) hs
    change relativeModPowerAction K L p (s : Gal(L/K)) z = z at hzfix
    rw [relativeModPowerAction_apply] at hzfix
    apply hz
    change abelianModPowerMap p
      (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom
        (absoluteGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv τ.toRingEquiv)) z = z
    change abelianModPowerMap p
      (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom
        (absoluteGaloisConjugateContinuousEquiv (s : Gal(L/K)).toRingEquiv)) z = z at hzfix
    rw [he] at hzfix
    exact hzfix
  intro τ hτ
  apply hfaith
  rw [map_one]
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro z
  change relativeModPowerAction K L p τ z = z
  rw [relativeModPowerAction_apply]
  exact hτ z

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.kummer_trivial_action_criterion
statement:
theorem kummer_trivial_action_criterion
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)]
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty)
    (τ : K ≃+* K) (a : ℕ)
    (hpower : ∀ ξ : K, ξ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → τ ξ = ξ ^ a) :
    (∀ (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ*
          Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)))
        (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)),
        χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) = χ σ) ↔
      ∀ x : Kˣ,
        ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom x : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) =
          (x : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ^ a
proof:
:= by
  let e : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range ≃*
      (Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ))) :=
    ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv
      K n hmu
  have hnat (x : Kˣ) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :
      e ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom x : Kˣ) :
          Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)
          (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) =
        e (x : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ ^ a :=
    (open _root_.ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich in
      separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_pow_roots
        K n hmu τ a hpower x σ)
  constructor
  · intro h x
    apply e.injective
    apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
    intro σ
    rw [map_pow, ContinuousMonoidHom.pow_apply]
    exact (h (e ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom x : Kˣ) :
      Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range)) σ).symm.trans (hnat x σ)
  · intro h χ σ
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := e.surjective χ
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
      (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range z
    let y : Kˣ := Units.map τ.symm.toMonoidHom x
    have hy : Units.map τ.toMonoidHom y = x := by
      apply Units.ext
      exact τ.apply_symm_apply (x : K)
    have hx : (x : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) =
        (y : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ^ a := by
      rw [← hy]
      exact h y
    have hn := hnat y σ
    rw [hy] at hn
    refine hn.trans ?_
    change e (y : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ ^ a =
      e (x : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) σ
    rw [hx, map_pow, ContinuousMonoidHom.pow_apply]

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finitePrimePowerRoots_of_residueZero_slim
statement:
theorem finitePrimePowerRoots_of_residueZero_slim
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (D : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) [CharZero D.residueField]
    (hK : IsSlim Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra D.residueField E] [FiniteDimensional D.residueField E]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hfinite
  have : Infinite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p) := not_finite_iff_infinite.mp hfinite
  have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have : CharZero K := by
    refine ⟨fun m n h => ?_⟩
    apply Nat.cast_injective (R := D.residueField)
    have hv : (m : D.valuation.valuationSubring) = n := Subtype.ext h
    have hr := congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue D.valuation.valuationSubring) hv
    simpa only [map_natCast] using hr
  obtain ⟨Γ, hΓ, z, hz⟩ :=
    Valuation.chevalley_hasSomeExtensionTo (L := AlgebraicClosure K) D.valuation
  let : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ := hΓ
  have : D.valuation.HasExtension z := hz
  obtain ⟨F, hfd, hF⟩ :=
    ValuationTheory.Henselian.exists_finiteIntermediateField_lifting_residue_roots
      D.valuation z E
  have : FiniteDimensional K F := hfd
  have hFroots (n : ℕ) : ∃ ζ : F, IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ n) := by
    apply hF (p ^ n) (pow_pos hp.pos n)
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := KummerTheory.exists_primitiveRoot_prime_pow_of_infinite_primary (K := E) p n
    exact ⟨(ζ : E), IsPrimitiveRoot.coe_units_iff.mpr hζ⟩
  let FD : HenselianDVF F := FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF D
  have : D.valuation.HasExtension FD.valuation :=
    FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF_hasExtension D
  have : CharZero FD.residueField :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap D.residueField FD.residueField).injective
  have hFF : Subgroup.center Gal(AlgebraicClosure F/F) = ⊥ :=
    center_eq_bot_absoluteGaloisGroup_of_finiteExtension_of_isSlim hK
  obtain ⟨σ, hσc, hσ⟩ :=
    FD.exists_ne_one_mem_absoluteGalois_center_of_all_primePowerRoots p hFroots
  apply hσ
  rw [hFF] at hσc
  exact hσc

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.finitePrimePowerRoots_of_residueZero_abFaithful
statement:
theorem finitePrimePowerRoots_of_residueZero_abFaithful
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (D : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) [CharZero D.residueField]
    (hK : IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra D.residueField E] [FiniteDimensional D.residueField E]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p)
proof:
:=
  finitePrimePowerRoots_of_residueZero_slim D (isSlim_of_isAbFaithful hK) E p hp

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.mixed_characteristic_reduction
statement:
theorem mixed_characteristic_reduction
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    (∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
      (base : DVF.{u, v} K) [CharP base.residueField p],
      ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L]
        (Γ : Type w) [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
        (vL : Valuation L Γ),
        base.valuation.HasExtension vL →
          ringChar L = 0 ∧ vL.IsRankOneDiscrete ∧
            CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vL.valuationSubring) p) ∧
      ((∀ (F E : Type u) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
        [IsGalois F E] [CharZero F]
        (base : DVF.{u, v} F) [CharP base.residueField p]
        (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime],
          Module.finrank F E = r →
            ∃ τ : Gal(E/F), τ ≠ 1 ∧
              ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) p,
                relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F E p τ z ≠ z) →
        ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
          (base : DVF.{u, v} K) [CharP base.residueField p],
          IsSigmaAbFaithful {p} Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro K _ _ base _ L _ _ _ Γ _ vL hExt
    have : base.valuation.HasExtension vL := hExt
    have : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K L).injective
    refine ⟨ringChar.eq_zero, base.isRankOneDiscrete_of_finite_separable vL, ?_⟩
    exact (Algebra.charP_iff base.residueField
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vL.valuationSubring) p).mp inferInstance
  · intro hdetect K _ _ base _
    exact isSigmaAbFaithful_of_primeDegree_detection p hdetect base

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_changed_character_of_inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one
statement:
theorem exists_changed_character_of_inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (q : ℕ) (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (hτ : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := q) K L τ⁻¹ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q),
      ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L),
        χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ) ≠ χ σ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ContinuousH1ZMod (p := q)
      (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L),
      (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := q) K L τ⁻¹).toAdd c ≠ c := by
    by_contra hnot
    apply hτ
    apply AddEquiv.ext
    intro c
    exact not_not.mp (fun hne => hnot ⟨c, hne⟩)
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : Additive (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L),
      (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := q) K L τ⁻¹).toAdd c σ ≠ c σ := by
    by_contra hnot
    apply hc
    apply ContinuousAddMonoidHom.ext
    intro σ
    exact not_not.mp (fun hne => hnot ⟨σ, hne⟩)
  let σ₀ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) := σ.toMul
  let χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q) := characterOfH1 c
  refine ⟨χ, σ₀, ?_⟩
  intro heq
  apply hσ
  change c (Additive.ofMul (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ₀)) =
    c (Additive.ofMul σ₀)
  exact congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd heq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform_apply_mk
statement:
theorem relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform_apply_mk
    (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (q : ℕ) (τ : Gal(L/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) :
    relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L q τ
        ((TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) σ :
          TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) :
          abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) q) =
      ((TopologicalAbelianization.mk Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)
          (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ) :
        TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L)) :
        abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) q)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_moved_abelianModPower_of_inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one
statement:
theorem exists_moved_abelianModPower_of_inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one
    (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (q : ℕ) (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (hτ : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := q) K L τ⁻¹ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) q,
      relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L q τ z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨χ, σ, hχ⟩ :=
    ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_changed_character_of_inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one
      q τ hτ
  let z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) q :=
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk _ σ : TopologicalAbelianization _)
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  intro hz
  have hpow : ∀ a : Multiplicative (ZMod q), a ^ q = 1 := by
    intro a
    apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
    change q • a.toAdd = (0 : ZMod q)
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]
  let χbar := abelianModPowerLift q χ hpow
  have hquotient :
      ((TopologicalAbelianization.mk _
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ) : TopologicalAbelianization _) :
        abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) q) = z := by
    rw [← relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform_apply_mk]
    exact hz
  have hvalue := congrArg χbar hquotient
  apply hχ
  simp only [χbar, z] at hvalue
  change χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ) = χ σ at hvalue
  exact hvalue

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_moved_mod_prime_of_artinSchreier_difference
statement:
theorem exists_moved_mod_prime_of_artinSchreier_difference
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP L p] (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (x : L) (hx : ∀ y : L, y ^ p - y ≠ τ x - x) :
    ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
      relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ.symm z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨χ, σ, hχ⟩ :=
    ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_character_moved_by_map_of_pow_sub_ne p τ.toRingEquiv x hx
  refine ⟨abelianModPowerMk _ p σ, ?_⟩
  intro hfixed
  have hpow : ∀ a : Multiplicative (ZMod p), a ^ p = 1 := by
    intro a
    apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
    change p • a.toAdd = (0 : ZMod p)
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]
  have h := congrArg (abelianModPowerLift p χ hpow) hfixed
  change χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm.toRingEquiv σ) = χ σ at h
  apply hχ
  exact (character_map_symm_eq_absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm.toRingEquiv χ σ).trans h

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.prime_order_detection_of_complete_charP
statement:
theorem prime_order_detection_of_complete_charP
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime] [CharP K p]
    (D : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K) (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = r) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ≠ 1 ∧
      ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
        relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
  have : CharP L p := charP_of_injective_ringHom (algebraMap K L).injective p
  have hmoved : ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ≠ 1 ∧ ∃ x : L,
      ∀ y : L, y ^ p - y ≠ τ x - x := by
    by_cases hrp : r = p
    · have : Infinite (K ⧸ ((frobenius K p).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id K).range) :=
        D.toDVF.infinite_artinSchreier_quotient p
      exact ArtinSchreierTheory.exists_moved_class_of_degree_eq_char p (hdegree.trans hrp)
    · have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = r :=
        (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdegree
      have : Nontrivial Gal(L/K) := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp
        (hcard.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).one_lt)
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Gal(L/K))
      have hpd : ¬ p ∣ Module.finrank K L := by
        rw [hdegree]
        intro h
        exact hrp ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq (Fact.out : p.Prime)
          (Fact.out : r.Prime)).mp h).symm
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := D.exists_moved_pow_sub_class_of_not_dvd_finrank
        p (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt hpd τ hτ
      exact ⟨τ, hτ, x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, x, hx⟩ := hmoved
  exact ⟨τ.symm, inv_ne_one.mpr hτ,
    exists_moved_mod_prime_of_artinSchreier_difference p τ x hx⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.fixingSubgroup_residualAbelianization_ne_one_of_moved_mod_prime
statement:
theorem fixingSubgroup_residualAbelianization_ne_one_of_moved_mod_prime
    {F Ω : Type u} [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] [CharZero F]
    (S : IntermediateField F Ω) [FiniteDimensional F S] [IsGalois F S]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (τ : Gal(S/F))
    (z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S) p)
    (hz : relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F S p τ z ≠ z) :
    residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p}) S.fixingSubgroup
        (InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_isClosed S) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro htriv
  have hpow := (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_eq_one_iff_primePower
    (sigma := {p}) S.fixingSubgroup (InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_isClosed S)).mp htriv
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective Ω τ
  let e := fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv S
  let q : TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S) →*
      abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S) p := QuotientGroup.mk' _
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
    (powMonoidHom (α := TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S)) p).range z
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hpow (QuotientGroup.mk' S.fixingSubgroup g) (e.symm a)
    p rfl (Fact.out : p.Prime) 1 (by decide)
  rw [pow_one] at hb
  have heq := congrArg e hb
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, ContinuousMulEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at heq
  rw [fixingSubgroupAbsoluteAbelianizationEquiv_quotient_conjugation,
    ContinuousMulEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at heq
  change absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction
    ((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom S) g).toRingEquiv a = a * (e b) ^ p at heq
  rw [hg] at heq
  have hqpow : q (e b) ^ p = 1 := by
    rw [← map_pow]
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff
      (N := (powMonoidHom (α := TopologicalAbelianization Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S)) p).range)
      ((e b)^p)).mpr ⟨e b, rfl⟩
  have hq := congrArg q heq
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, hqpow, mul_one] at hq
  apply hz
  calc
    relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F S p τ (q a) =
        q (absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ.toRingEquiv a) := by
      obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk _ a
      rfl
    _ = q a := hq

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primeDegree_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
statement:
private theorem primeDegree_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
    {F Ω : Type u} [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] [CharZero F]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime]
    (hdetect : ∀ (S : IntermediateField F Ω) [IsGalois F S],
      Module.finrank F S = r →
        ∃ τ : Gal(S/F), ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S) p,
          relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F S p τ z ≠ z)
    (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F)) [N.Normal]
    (hN : IsOpen (N : Set Gal(Ω/F))) (hindex : N.index = r) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p}) N (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN))
proof:
:= by
  let H : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/F) := ⟨N, N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN⟩
  let S : IntermediateField F Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField N
  have hfix : S.fixingSubgroup = N := InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField H
  have : FiniteDimensional F S := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite S).mp
    (by rw [hfix]; exact hN)
  have hcard : Nat.card (Gal(Ω/F) ⧸ N) = r := N.index_eq_card.symm.trans hindex
  have hdegree : Module.finrank F S = r :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank F S).symm.trans
      ((Nat.card_congr (InfiniteGalois.normalAutEquivQuotient H).toEquiv).symm.trans hcard)
  obtain ⟨τ, z, hz⟩ := hdetect S hdegree
  have hfaith := fixingSubgroup_residualAbelianization_ne_one_of_moved_mod_prime S p τ z hz
  let P : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F) → Prop := fun U =>
    ∀ hU : U.Normal, letI : U.Normal := hU
      ∀ hclosed : IsClosed (U : Set Gal(Ω/F)),
        residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
          (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p}) U hclosed ≠ 1
  have hP : P S.fixingSubgroup := fun _ _ => hfaith
  have hPN : P N := hfix ▸ hP
  apply (injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card _ (hcard.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime))).mpr
  exact hPN inferInstance (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.primeDegree_openLayer_residual_faithful
statement:
private theorem primeDegree_openLayer_residual_faithful
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hdetect : ∀ (F E : Type u) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
      [IsGalois F E] [CharZero F]
      (base : DVF.{u, v} F) [CharP base.residueField p]
      (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime], Module.finrank F E = r →
        ∃ τ : Gal(E/F), τ ≠ 1 ∧
          ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) p,
            relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F E p τ z ≠ z)
    {K Ω : Type u} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) [CharP base.residueField p]
    (H : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K))
    [CompactSpace (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))]
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)))
    (hprime : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index.Prime) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p})
      (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) N.isClosed)
proof:
:= by
  let F : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  let closedH : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨H.toSubgroup, H.isClosed⟩
  have hfix : F.fixingSubgroup = (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField closedH
  have : FiniteDimensional K F := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite F).mp (by
    rw [hfix]
    exact H.isOpen)
  have : IsAlgClosure F Ω :=
    ⟨IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed K, Algebra.IsAlgebraic.tower_top (K := K) F⟩
  have : T2Space Gal(Ω/F) := krullTopology_t2 (K := F) (L := Ω)
  obtain ⟨target, _, hres⟩ := base.exists_extension_residueChar (L := F) p
  have : CharP target.residueField p := hres
  let e₀ : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* F.fixingSubgroup :=
    { toMulEquiv := MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hfix.symm
      continuous_toFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix.symm ▸ x.property)
      continuous_invFun := Continuous.subtype_mk continuous_subtype_val
        (fun x => hfix ▸ x.property) }
  let e : (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) ≃ₜ* Gal(Ω/F) := e₀.trans (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv F)
  let M : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F) := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
  have : M.Normal :=
    (inferInstance : (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).Normal).map
      e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom e.surjective
  have hM : IsOpen (M : Set Gal(Ω/F)) := e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap N N.isOpen
  let r : ℕ := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index
  have : Fact r.Prime := ⟨hprime⟩
  have hindex : M.index = r := (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))).index_map_equiv e.toMulEquiv
  have hfaith := primeDegree_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful p
    (fun S _ hdeg => by
      obtain ⟨τ, _, z, hz⟩ := hdetect F S target r hdeg
      exact ⟨τ, z, hz⟩) M hM hindex
  have hNfaith := (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
    (FiniteGroupClass.sigmaGroup_fullFormation {p}) e
    (N : Subgroup (H : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) N.isClosed).mp hfaith
  exact hNfaith

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.isSigmaAbFaithful_of_primeDegree_detection
statement:
theorem isSigmaAbFaithful_of_primeDegree_detection
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hdetect : ∀ (F E : Type u) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E]
      [IsGalois F E] [CharZero F]
      (base : DVF.{u, v} F) [CharP base.residueField p]
      (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime], Module.finrank F E = r →
        ∃ τ : Gal(E/F), τ ≠ 1 ∧
          ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) p,
            relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform F E p τ z ≠ z)
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (base : DVF.{u, v} K) [CharP base.residueField p] :
    IsSigmaAbFaithful {p} Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)
proof:
:= by
  apply isSigmaAbFaithful_iff_prime_order_test.mpr
  intro H
  have : CompactSpace (H : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) :=
    H.isClosed.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.compactSpace
  intro N hprime
  have hNfaith := primeDegree_openLayer_residual_faithful p hdetect base H N hprime
  exact (injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card _ hprime).mp hNfaith

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.prime_order_detection
statement:
theorem prime_order_detection
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [CharZero K] (base : CompleteDVF.{u, v} K)
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime]
    [CharP base.residueField p]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = r) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ≠ 1 ∧
      ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
        relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hrp : r = p
  · by_cases hp2 : p = 2
    · have hdegree2 : Module.finrank K L = 2 := hdegree.trans (hrp.trans hp2)
      let : CharP base.toHenselianDVF.residueField 2 := by
        change CharP base.residueField 2
        rw [← hp2]
        infer_instance
      rw [hp2]
      exact dyadic_mod_two base.toHenselianDVF hdegree2
    · obtain ⟨w, hw, hring⟩ := base.toDVF.exists_normalized_valuation
      let : Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete w := by
        refine { isRankOneDiscrete := hw, isAdicComplete := ?_ }
        let P : ValuationSubring K → Prop := fun V =>
          IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) V
        have hcomplete : P base.valuation.valuationSubring :=
          Valuation.isAdicComplete base.valuation
        exact hring ▸ hcomplete
      let : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField w.valuationSubring) p := by
        rw [hring]
        exact inferInstance
      have hfaith :=
        (open _root_.ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich in
          faithful_relativeH1Action_of_complete_mixedChar_prime_degree
            w p r (Or.inr hp2) hdegree)
      have : FiniteDimensional K L :=
        FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
      have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = r :=
        (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdegree
      have : Nontrivial Gal(L/K) :=
        Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (hcard.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).one_lt)
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Gal(L/K))
      refine ⟨τ, hτ, ?_⟩
      apply exists_moved_abelianModPower_of_inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one K L p τ
      intro htriv
      have hτinv : τ⁻¹ = 1 := hfaith
        (htriv.trans (map_one (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) K L)).symm)
      exact (inv_ne_one.mpr hτ) hτinv
  · obtain ⟨w, hw, hring⟩ := base.toDVF.exists_normalized_valuation
    let : Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete w := by
      refine { isRankOneDiscrete := hw, isAdicComplete := ?_ }
      let P : ValuationSubring K → Prop := fun V =>
        IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal V) V
      have hcomplete : P base.valuation.valuationSubring :=
        Valuation.isAdicComplete base.valuation
      exact hring ▸ hcomplete
    let : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField w.valuationSubring) p := by
      rw [hring]
      exact inferInstance
    have hfaith :=
      (open _root_.ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich in
        faithful_relativeH1Action_of_complete_mixedChar_primeTo_degree w p r hrp hdegree)
    have : FiniteDimensional K L :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
    have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = r :=
      (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdegree
    have : Nontrivial Gal(L/K) :=
      Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (hcard.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).one_lt)
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Gal(L/K))
    refine ⟨τ, hτ, ?_⟩
    apply exists_moved_abelianModPower_of_inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one K L p τ
    intro htriv
    have hτinv : τ⁻¹ = 1 := hfaith
      (htriv.trans (map_one (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) K L)).symm)
    exact (inv_ne_one.mpr hτ) hτinv

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.prime_order_detection_of_mixedChar
statement:
theorem prime_order_detection_of_mixedChar
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [CharZero K] (base : DVF.{u, v} K)
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime] [CharP base.residueField p]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K L = r) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ≠ 1 ∧
      ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
        relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : FiniteDimensional K L :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
  have : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K L).injective
  obtain ⟨target, htarget, hres⟩ := base.exists_extension_residueChar (L := L) p
  have : base.valuation.HasExtension target.valuation := htarget
  have : CharP target.residueField p := hres
  by_cases hstable : ∀ τ : Gal(L/K),
      target.valuation.IsEquiv (target.valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
  · exact prime_order_detection_of_stable_valuation base target p r hdegree hstable
  · obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := not_forall.mp hstable
    have hne : τ ≠ 1 := by
      intro heq
      apply hτ
      intro x y
      change target.valuation x ≤ target.valuation y ↔
        target.valuation (τ x) ≤ target.valuation (τ y)
      rw [heq]
      rfl
    exact ⟨τ.symm, inv_ne_one.mpr hne,
      exists_moved_mod_prime_of_moved_valuation target p τ hτ⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.completionMapsEquivariant
statement:
theorem completionMapsEquivariant
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → DVF.{u, v} K) (q : ℕ) :
    ∀ (σ : K ≃+* K) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin r)),
        (∀ i : Fin r,
          (D i).valuation.IsEquiv
            ((D (π i)).valuation.comap σ.toRingHom)) →
        ∃ e : ∀ i : Fin r,
            (D i).valuation.Completion ≃+* (D (π i)).valuation.Completion,
          (∀ (i : Fin r) (x : K),
            e i (algebraMap K ((D i).valuation.Completion) x) =
              algebraMap K ((D (π i)).valuation.Completion) (σ x)) ∧
          (∀ (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q))
            (i : Fin r),
            completionCharacterRestriction (D (π i)) q
                (χ.comp (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map σ.toRingHom)) =
              (completionCharacterRestriction (D i) q χ).comp
                (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (e i).toRingHom)) ∧
          (∀ g : (j : Fin r) →
              abelianModPower
                Gal(AlgebraicClosure ((D j).valuation.Completion)/
                  ((D j).valuation.Completion)) q,
            abelianModPowerMap q (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map σ.toRingHom)
                (completionAbelianModPowerMap r D q g) =
              completionAbelianModPowerMap r D q
                (fun i : Fin r =>
                  abelianModPowerMap q
                    (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (e i).toRingHom)
                    (g (π i))))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ π hσ
  let e := fun i => DVF.completionRingEquiv (D i) (D (π i)) σ (hσ i)
  have he (i : Fin r) :
      (algebraMap K ((D (π i)).valuation.Completion)).comp σ.toRingHom =
        (e i).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap K ((D i).valuation.Completion)) := by
    ext x
    exact (DVF.completionRingEquiv_algebraMap (D i) (D (π i)) σ (hσ i) x).symm
  refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i x
    exact DVF.completionRingEquiv_algebraMap (D i) (D (π i)) σ (hσ i) x
  · intro χ i
    unfold completionCharacterRestriction
    calc
      _ = χ.comp (map ((algebraMap K ((D (π i)).valuation.Completion)).comp
          σ.toRingHom)) := (character_map_comp σ.toRingHom
            (algebraMap K ((D (π i)).valuation.Completion)) χ).symm
      _ = χ.comp (map ((e i).toRingHom.comp
          (algebraMap K ((D i).valuation.Completion)))) :=
        congrArg (fun f => χ.comp (map f)) (he i)
      _ = _ := character_map_comp (algebraMap K ((D i).valuation.Completion))
        (e i).toRingHom χ
  · intro g
    change abelianModPowerMap q (map σ.toRingHom)
      (∏ j, abelianModPowerMap q (map (algebraMap K ((D j).valuation.Completion))) (g j)) =
        ∏ i, abelianModPowerMap q (map (algebraMap K ((D i).valuation.Completion)))
          (abelianModPowerMap q (map (e i).toRingHom) (g (π i)))
    rw [map_prod]
    calc
      _ = ∏ i, abelianModPowerMap q (map σ.toRingHom)
          (abelianModPowerMap q (map (algebraMap K ((D (π i)).valuation.Completion)))
            (g (π i))) := (Equiv.prod_comp π _).symm
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i _
        have hh := congrArg (fun h => h (g (π i)))
          ((abelianModPowerMap_map_comp q σ.toRingHom
            (algebraMap K ((D (π i)).valuation.Completion))).symm)
        rw [he i, abelianModPowerMap_map_comp] at hh
        exact hh

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.completionAbelianModPowerMap_injective_of_character_surjective
statement:
theorem completionAbelianModPowerMap_injective_of_character_surjective
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → DVF.{u, v} K)
    (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime]
    (hchar : Function.Surjective
      (fun (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q))
        (i : Fin r) => completionCharacterRestriction (D i) q χ)) :
    Function.Injective (completionAbelianModPowerMap r D q)
proof:
:= by
  let H := fun i : Fin r =>
    Gal(AlgebraicClosure ((D i).valuation.Completion)/((D i).valuation.Completion))
  have (i : Fin r) : CompactSpace (H i) :=
    (ValuationTheory.Completion.separableClosureAutContinuousEquiv
      ((D i).valuation.Completion)).symm.toHomeomorph.compactSpace
  exact injective_prod_abelianModPowerMap_of_character_surjective H
    (fun i => Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map
      (algebraMap K ((D i).valuation.Completion))) hchar

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.completionCharacterRestriction_surjective_of_primitiveRoots
statement:
theorem completionCharacterRestriction_surjective_of_primitiveRoots
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → DVF.{u, v} K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (n : ℕ+) [NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K)]
    (hmu : (primitiveRoots (n : ℕ) K).Nonempty) :
    Function.Surjective (fun χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)) =>
      fun i => completionCharacterRestriction (D i) (n : ℕ) χ)
proof:
:= by
  let C (i : Fin r) := (D i).valuation.Completion
  let _ : ∀ i, Field (C i) := fun i => inferInstanceAs (Field ((D i).valuation.Completion))
  let f (i : Fin r) : K →+* C i := algebraMap K ((D i).valuation.Completion)
  have hpower : Function.Surjective (fun (a : Kˣ) (i : Fin r) =>
      (Units.map (f i).toMonoidHom a :
        (C i)ˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : (C i)ˣ →* (C i)ˣ).range)) :=
    DVF.surjective_pi_completion_powerClasses D hD (n : ℕ)
      (NeZero.ne ((n : ℕ) : K))
  exact ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.surjective_characters_of_powerClasses
    C f n hmu hpower

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.completionCharacterRestriction_surjective_of_charP
statement:
private theorem completionCharacterRestriction_surjective_of_charP
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → DVF.{u, v} K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] [CharP K q] :
    Function.Surjective (fun χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q) =>
      fun i => completionCharacterRestriction (D i) q χ)
proof:
:= by
  let C (i : Fin r) := (D i).valuation.Completion
  let _ : ∀ i, Field (C i) := fun i => inferInstanceAs (Field ((D i).valuation.Completion))
  let f (i : Fin r) : K →+* C i := algebraMap K ((D i).valuation.Completion)
  have (i : Fin r) : CharP (C i) q := charP_of_injective_ringHom (f i).injective q
  have hclasses : Function.Surjective (fun (a : K) (i : Fin r) =>
      (f i a : C i ⧸ ((frobenius (C i) q).toAddMonoidHom - AddMonoidHom.id (C i)).range)) :=
    DVF.surjective_pi_completion_artinSchreierClasses D hD q

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.weakApproximationForCharacters
statement:
theorem weakApproximationForCharacters
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → DVF.{u, v} K)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j : Fin r =>
      ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (q : ℕ) [Fact q.Prime] :
    Function.Surjective
      (fun (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q))
        (i : Fin r) => completionCharacterRestriction (D i) q χ) ∧
      Function.Injective (completionAbelianModPowerMap r D q) ∧
      (∀ (σ : K ≃+* K) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin r)),
        (∀ i : Fin r,
          (D i).valuation.IsEquiv
            ((D (π i)).valuation.comap σ.toRingHom)) →
        ∃ e : ∀ i : Fin r,
            (D i).valuation.Completion ≃+* (D (π i)).valuation.Completion,
          (∀ (i : Fin r) (x : K),
            e i (algebraMap K ((D i).valuation.Completion) x) =
              algebraMap K ((D (π i)).valuation.Completion) (σ x)) ∧
          (∀ (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q))
            (i : Fin r),
            completionCharacterRestriction (D (π i)) q
                (χ.comp (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map σ.toRingHom)) =
              (completionCharacterRestriction (D i) q χ).comp
                (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (e i).toRingHom)) ∧
          (∀ g : (j : Fin r) →
              abelianModPower
                Gal(AlgebraicClosure ((D j).valuation.Completion)/
                  ((D j).valuation.Completion)) q,
            abelianModPowerMap q (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map σ.toRingHom)
                (completionAbelianModPowerMap r D q g) =
              completionAbelianModPowerMap r D q
                (fun i : Fin r =>
                  abelianModPowerMap q
                    (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup.map (e i).toRingHom)
                    (g (π i)))))
proof:
:= by
  suffices hchar : Function.Surjective
      (fun (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q))
        (i : Fin r) => completionCharacterRestriction (D i) q χ) by
    exact ⟨hchar, completionAbelianModPowerMap_injective_of_character_surjective
      r D q hchar, completionMapsEquivariant r D q⟩
  by_cases hq : (q : K) ≠ 0
  · have : NeZero (q : K) := ⟨hq⟩
    exact KummerTheory.surjective_completion_characters_of_ne_char D hD q
  · have : CharP K q :=
      (CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero (Fact.out : q.Prime)).mpr (not_ne_iff.mp hq)
    exact completionCharacterRestriction_surjective_of_charP r D hD q

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.completion_character_prescribed_pair
statement:
private theorem completion_character_prescribed_pair
    {L : Type u} [Field L] (D : Fin 2 → DVF.{u, v} L)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure (D 0).valuation.Completion/(D 0).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
      Multiplicative (ZMod p)) :
    ∃ ψ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod p),
      completionCharacterRestriction (D 0) p ψ = χ ∧
      completionCharacterRestriction (D 1) p ψ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let chars : (i : Fin 2) →
      Gal(AlgebraicClosure (D i).valuation.Completion/(D i).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
        Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    Fin.cases (motive := fun i : Fin 2 =>
      Gal(AlgebraicClosure (D i).valuation.Completion/(D i).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
        Multiplicative (ZMod p)) χ (fun _ => 1)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := (weakApproximationForCharacters 2 D hD p).1 chars
  exact ⟨ψ, congrFun hψ 0, congrFun hψ 1⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.exists_moved_mod_prime_of_inequivalent_completions
statement:
theorem exists_moved_mod_prime_of_inequivalent_completions
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (D : Fin 2 → DVF.{u, v} L)
    (hD : Pairwise (fun i j => ¬ (D i).valuation.IsEquiv (D j).valuation))
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (τ : Gal(L/K))
    (hτ : (D 1).valuation.IsEquiv ((D 0).valuation.comap τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom))
    (χ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure (D 0).valuation.Completion/(D 0).valuation.Completion) →ₜ*
      Multiplicative (ZMod p))
    (a : Gal(AlgebraicClosure (D 0).valuation.Completion/(D 0).valuation.Completion))
    (ha' : χ a ≠ 1) :
    ∃ z : abelianModPower Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) p,
      relativeGaloisAbelianModPowerTransform K L p τ.symm z ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ0, hψ1⟩ := completion_character_prescribed_pair D hD p χ
  let e : (D 1).valuation.Completion ≃+* (D 0).valuation.Completion :=
    DVF.completionRingEquiv (D 1) (D 0) τ.toRingEquiv hτ
  have heq : (algebraMap L (D 0).valuation.Completion).comp τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap L (D 1).valuation.Completion) := by
    ext x
    exact (DVF.completionRingEquiv_algebraMap (D 1) (D 0) τ.toRingEquiv
      hτ x).symm
  let b : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) := map (algebraMap L (D 0).valuation.Completion) a
  refine ⟨abelianModPowerMk _ p b, ?_⟩
  intro hfix
  have hpow : ∀ c : Multiplicative (ZMod p), c ^ p = 1 := by
    intro c
    apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
    change p • c.toAdd = (0 : ZMod p)
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]
  have hχfix := congrArg (abelianModPowerLift p ψ hpow) hfix
  change ψ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm.toRingEquiv b) = ψ b at hχfix
  have hmapfix : ψ (map τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom b) = ψ b :=
    (character_map_symm_eq_absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.symm.toRingEquiv ψ b).trans hχfix
  have hzero : ψ (map τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom b) = 1 := by
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (character_map_comp τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
      (algebraMap L (D 0).valuation.Completion) ψ) a).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun f : L →+* (D 0).valuation.Completion => ψ (map f a)) heq).trans
        ((DFunLike.congr_fun (character_map_comp
          (algebraMap L (D 1).valuation.Completion) e.toRingHom ψ) a).trans
            (DFunLike.congr_fun hψ1 (map e.toRingHom a))))
  apply ha'
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun hψ0 a).symm.trans (hmapfix.symm.trans hzero)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_cyclotomic_tower
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_cyclotomic_tower
    {F K Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K] [IsGalois F K]
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω) [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower F K E]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    [vF.HasExtension vE]
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime]
    [hres : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    (hprime : r ≠ p ∨ p ≠ 2) (hdegree : Module.finrank F K = r) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(K/F), relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) F K τ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : FiniteDimensional F K :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} K E
  have : FiniteDimensional F E := FiniteDimensional.trans F K E
  have : IsGalois K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {p} K E
  have : IsGalois F E :=
    { to_isSeparable := Algebra.IsSeparable.trans (F := F) (E := K) (K := E)
      to_normal := ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.normal_cyclotomic_tower F K E p }
  have hsurj := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective (F := F) (K₁ := K) (E := E)
  have : Nontrivial Gal(K/F) := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (by
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank F K, hdegree]
    exact (Fact.out : r.Prime).one_lt)
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Gal(K/F))
  obtain ⟨g, hgτ⟩ := hsurj τ
  let base : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF F :=
    { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ), valuation := vF }
  let target : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF E :=
    { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ), valuation := vE }
  have hval (a : Gal(E/F)) (b : E) :
      vE (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv Gal(E/F) E a b) = vE b :=
    base.toHenselianDVF.valuation_algEquiv_eq target a b
  let σ := MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv Gal(E/F) E
  let χ := primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K E)
  let Δ := (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom K : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(K/F)).ker
  have hg : g ∉ Δ := by
    intro hg
    exact hτ (hgτ.symm.trans hg)
  by_contra hnone
  have htriv (τ : Gal(K/F)) : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) F K τ = 1 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hnone ⟨τ, h⟩
  have hdiv := characterLog_action_sub_prime_divisible_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
    E vE p hval htriv
  have hfix (a : Gal(E/F)) (x : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ) :
      characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ a x = x := by
    by_cases hrp : r = p
    · have hp2 : p ≠ 2 := hprime.elim (fun h => False.elim (h hrp)) id
      have hcard : Nat.card Gal(K/F) = p :=
        (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank F K).trans (hdegree.trans hrp)
      have hpow : a ^ p ∈ Δ := by
        change (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom K : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(K/F)) (a ^ p) = 1
        rw [map_pow, ← hcard]
        exact pow_card_eq_one'
      exact characterLogRepresentation_eq_self_of_oddPrimeOrder
        vE p σ hval χ Δ hp2 a hpow (hdiv a) x
    · have hcard := (primeTo_cyclotomic_tower_data F K E p r hrp hdegree).2.2.1
      exact characterLogRepresentation_eq_self_of_action_sub_prime_divisible
        vE p σ hval χ Δ (by simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hcard) hdiv a x
  obtain ⟨u, _hne, heigen, hnot⟩ :=
    exists_principalUnit_log_subgroupCharacter_eigen_not_eigen vF vE p Δ χ g hg
  let x₀ : PrincipalUnitLogImageOfMixedChar vE p :=
    ⟨(principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd, Additive.ofMul u, rfl⟩
  have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ :=
    (mem_characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar_iff vE p σ hval χ Δ x₀).mpr heigen
  let x : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ := ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩
  have hx := congrArg (characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ) (hfix g x)
  rw [characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar_action vE p σ hval χ Δ g x] at hx
  have h := congrArg (fun b : E => padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) * b) hx
  change padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) *
      (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (((χ g)⁻¹ : ℤ_[p]ˣ) : ℤ_[p]) *
        g (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd) =
    padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) *
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd at h
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← _root_.map_mul, Units.mul_inv, _root_.map_one, one_mul] at h
  exact hnot h

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_primeTo_cyclotomic_tower
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_primeTo_cyclotomic_tower
    {F K Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K] [IsGalois F K]
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω) [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower F K E]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    [vF.HasExtension vE]
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact r.Prime]
    [hres : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    (hrp : r ≠ p) (hdegree : Module.finrank F K = r) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(K/F), relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) F K τ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_cyclotomic_tower
    E vF vE p r (Or.inl hrp) hdegree

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.mixedChar_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
statement:
theorem mixedChar_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
    {F Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] [CharZero F]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [hres : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vF.valuationSubring) p]
    (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F)) [N.Normal]
    (hN : IsOpen (N : Set Gal(Ω/F))) {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime]
    (hindex : N.index = r) :
    Function.Injective
      (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
        (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) N (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN))
proof:
:= by
  let H : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/F) := ⟨N, N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN⟩
  let S : IntermediateField F Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField N
  have hfix : S.fixingSubgroup = N := InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField H
  have : FiniteDimensional F S := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite S).mp
    (by rw [hfix]; exact hN)
  have hcard : Nat.card (Gal(Ω/F) ⧸ N) = r := N.index_eq_card.symm.trans hindex
  have hdegree : Module.finrank F S = r :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank F S).symm.trans
      ((Nat.card_congr (InfiniteGalois.normalAutEquivQuotient H).toEquiv).symm.trans hcard)
  have hfaith := mixedChar_fixingSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful S vF p hdegree
  let P : Subgroup Gal(Ω/F) → Prop := fun U =>
    ∀ hU : U.Normal, letI : U.Normal := hU
      ∀ hclosed : IsClosed (U : Set Gal(Ω/F)),
        Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
          (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) U hclosed)
  have hP : P S.fixingSubgroup := fun _ _ => hfaith
  have hPN : P N := hfix ▸ hP
  exact hPN inferInstance (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN)

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.residueZero_openNormal_prime_index_faithful
statement:
theorem residueZero_openNormal_prime_index_faithful
    {K Ω : Type u} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (D : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) [CharZero D.residueField]
    (hres : IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure D.residueField/D.residueField))
    (hroots : ∀ (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra D.residueField E]
      [FiniteDimensional D.residueField E] (p : ℕ), p.Prime →
      Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent Eˣ p))
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup Gal(Ω/K))
    (hprime : (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)).index.Prime) :
    Function.Injective (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
      (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨N.toSubgroup, N.isClosed⟩
  let L : IntermediateField K Ω := IntermediateField.fixedField (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  have hfix : L.fixingSubgroup = (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField H
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite L).mp
    (by rw [hfix]; exact N.isOpen)
  have hdeg : Module.finrank K L = (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)).index :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).symm.trans
      ((Nat.card_congr (InfiniteGalois.normalAutEquivQuotient H).toEquiv).symm.trans
        (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)).index_eq_card.symm)
  let F : HenselianDVF L := FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF D
  have : D.valuation.HasExtension F.valuation :=
    FiniteExtensionLocalization.henselianDVF_hasExtension D
  have : CharZero F.residueField :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap D.residueField F.residueField).injective
  obtain ⟨Γ, hΓ, w, hw⟩ :=
    Valuation.chevalley_hasSomeExtensionTo (L := Ω) F.valuation
  let : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ := hΓ
  have : F.valuation.HasExtension w := hw
  have : D.valuation.HasExtension w :=
    Valuation.hasExtension_trans D.valuation F.valuation w
  by_cases hI : (henselianResidueAction D.valuation w).ker ≤
      (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))
  · exact residueZero_openNormal_faithful_of_inertia_le D w hres N hI
  · obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσN⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hI
    have hσres : henselianResidueAction D.valuation w σ = 1 := hσ
    have hτres := henselianResidueAction_restrictNormal_eq_one
      D.valuation F.valuation w σ hσres
    let τ : inertiaGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring :=
      ⟨henselianGalToDecomposition D.valuation F.valuation (σ.restrictNormal L),
        congrArg AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv hτres⟩
    have hτ : τ ≠ 1 := by
      intro heq
      apply hσN
      rw [← hfix, ← L.restrictNormalHom_ker]
      exact congrArg (fun z : inertiaGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring =>
        ((z : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) : Gal(L/K))) heq
    have : FiniteDimensional D.residueField F.residueField :=
      _root_.Valuation.finiteDimensional_residueField D.valuation F.valuation
    have : Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent F.residueFieldˣ
        (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)).index) := hroots F.residueField _ hprime
    have hact := residueZero_inertia_abelianization_action_ne_one F hprime hdeg τ hτ
    have hquot := fixingSubgroup_quotient_action_ne_one_of_absolute_action_ne_one L σ hact
    have hfaith : Function.Injective
        (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap L.fixingSubgroup) := by
      apply (injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card _ ?_).mpr
      · intro h
        apply hquot
        rw [h]
        rfl
      · rw [← L.fixingSubgroup.index_eq_card, hfix]
        exact hprime
    let P : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K) → Prop := fun U =>
      ∀ hU : U.Normal, letI : U.Normal := hU
        Function.Injective (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap U)
    have hP : P L.fixingSubgroup := fun _ => hfaith
    exact (hfix ▸ hP) inferInstance

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.rootsDownstairs_fixedSubgroup_quotient_action_faithful
statement:
theorem rootsDownstairs_fixedSubgroup_quotient_action_faithful
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    (hμ : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : L | ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (hdown : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
      ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L)) :
    Function.Injective
      (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap L.fixingSubgroup)
proof:
:= by
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_one
    (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap L.fixingSubgroup)).mpr

  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective q
  apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := L.fixingSubgroup) σ).mpr
  by_contra hσ
  have hrestrict : σ.restrictNormal L ≠ 1 := by
    intro heq
    apply hσ
    rw [← L.restrictNormalHom_ker]
    exact heq
  have hdetect := rootsDownstairs_abelianization_action_ne_one
    hp hdeg hμ hfinite hdown (σ.restrictNormal L) hrestrict

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.trivial_relativeH1Action_fixes_primePower_roots
statement:
theorem trivial_relativeH1Action_fixes_primePower_roots
    {F K L Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field L] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω)
    [Algebra F L] [Algebra F E] [Algebra L E]
    [IsScalarTower F K E] [IsScalarTower F L E]
    [FiniteDimensional F K] [Normal F K]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    [vF.HasExtension vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} F L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    (s : ℕ) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 1)) E).Nonempty)
    (τupper : Gal(E/L))
    (hτ : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ (s + 1)) F K
      (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E τupper) = 1) :
    ∀ ζ : E, ζ ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) = 1 → τupper ζ = ζ
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} K E
  have : FiniteDimensional F E := FiniteDimensional.trans F K E
  obtain ⟨b, u, hbeigen, hlog, hueigen, hminimal⟩ :=
    exists_minimal_cyclotomic_log_eigenunit (K := L) (L := K) vF vE p
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hroots, y, hy⟩ :=
    exists_cyclotomic_power_witness_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
      E vE p s hmu u hueigen
      (IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E τupper)
      τupper.toRingEquiv
      (restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom_algebraMap F K L E τupper) hτ
  have hval (x : E) : vE (τupper x) = vE x := by
    let base : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.CompleteDVF F :=
      { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ), valuation := vF }
    let target : ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.DVF E :=
      { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ), valuation := vE }
    exact base.toHenselianDVF.valuation_algEquiv_eq target (τupper.restrictScalars F) x
  have haone : a = 1 := by
    by_contra haone
    obtain ⟨c, z, hceigen, hclog, hstrict⟩ :=
      exists_smaller_characterEigenvector_log_of_power_witness vE p τupper hval
        b u hlog
        (fun γ : L ≃ₐ[F] L => padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
          (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter F L p γ : ℤ_[p]))
        hbeigen a s ha haone y hy
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hminimal c hceigen ⟨z, hclog⟩)) hstrict
  intro ζ hζ
  change τupper.toRingEquiv ζ = ζ
  rw [hroots ζ hζ, haone, pow_one]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_nontrivial_H1Action_in_closure
statement:
private theorem exists_nontrivial_H1Action_in_closure
    {F K Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [Normal F K] [CharZero F]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vF.valuationSubring) p]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank F K = p) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ ∃ τ : Gal(K/F),
      relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) F K τ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  have : FiniteDimensional F K :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ hp.pos)
  have : CharZero K := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F K).injective
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := exists_cyclotomic_intermediateField K Ω p
  have : IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E := hE
  let : Algebra F E := Algebra.compHom E (algebraMap F K)
  have : IsScalarTower F K E := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} K E
  have : FiniteDimensional F E := FiniteDimensional.trans F K E
  have hextension : ∃ vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)),
      Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE ∧ vF.HasExtension vE ∧
        CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p :=
    ValuedExtension.exists_complete_valuation_of_finite_separable_of_residueChar vF p
  obtain ⟨vE, hcomplete, hext, hres⟩ := hextension
  have : Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE := hcomplete
  have : vF.HasExtension vE := hext
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := IsCyclotomicExtension.exists_isPrimitiveRoot K E
    (Set.mem_singleton p) hp.ne_zero
  let L : IntermediateField F E := IntermediateField.adjoin F {ζ}
  have : IsCyclotomicExtension {p} F L :=
    hζ.intermediateField_adjoin_isCyclotomicExtension F
  exact exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_prime_degree_cyclotomic_tower
    (L := L) E vF vE p hdegree (hres := hres)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_faithful_relativeH1Action_of_complete_mixedChar_prime_degree
statement:
theorem exists_faithful_relativeH1Action_of_complete_mixedChar_prime_degree
    {F K : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [IsGalois F K] [CharZero F]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]

    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ Function.Injective (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) F K)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out

    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ hp.pos)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, τ, hτ⟩ :=
    exists_nontrivial_H1Action_in_closure (Ω := AlgebraicClosure K) vF p hdegree

    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank F K).trans hdegree
  refine ⟨s, hs, (ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card
    (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) F K) (hcard.symm ▸ hp)).mpr ?_⟩
  intro h

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_cyclotomic_power_witness_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
statement:
theorem exists_cyclotomic_power_witness_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω)
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    (s : ℕ) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 1)) E).Nonempty)
    (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1)
    (hueigen : ∀ δ : E ≃ₐ[K] E,
      δ (((u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ) :
        (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubring) : E) =
      (((principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar vE p
        (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K E p δ : ℤ_[p]) u :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ) :
            (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubring) : E))
    (τ : Gal(K/F)) (υ : E ≃+* E)
    (hυ : ∀ x : K, υ (algebraMap K E x) = algebraMap K E (τ x))
    (hτ : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ (s + 1)) F K τ = 1) :
    let u₀ : Eˣ
proof:
:= CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits
      (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE)
      (u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ)
    ∃ a : ℕ, a < p ^ (s + 1) ∧
      (∀ ζ : E, ζ ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) = 1 → υ ζ = ζ ^ a) ∧
      ∃ y : Eˣ, Units.map υ.toMonoidHom u₀ / u₀ ^ a = y ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) := by
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} K E
  have : IsGalois K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {p} K E
  let n : ℕ+ := ⟨p ^ (s + 1), pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos (s + 1)⟩
  let u₀ : Eˣ := CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits
    (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE)
    (u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ)
  let c : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ*
      DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure E) (n : ℕ) :=
    absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv E n hmu
      (u₀ : Eˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Eˣ →* Eˣ).range)
  let coordinate : DiscreteNthRootsSubgroup (AlgebraicClosure E) (n : ℕ) ≃ₜ*
      Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)) :=
    discreteNthRootsContinuousMulEquivMultiplicativeZMod E n hmu
  let f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (n : ℕ)) :=
    (ContinuousMonoidHom.toContinuousMonoidHom coordinate).comp c
  have hinv : ∀ (δ : Gal(E/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)),
      f (absoluteGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv σ) = f σ := by
    intro δ σ
    exact congrArg coordinate
      (principalUnit_cyclotomicKummerCharacter_conjugation_invariant
        vE p s hmu u hueigen δ σ)
  have hdegree_prime : (Module.finrank K E).Coprime p := by
    have hcard :=
      ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard K E p
    rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K E] at hcard
    exact hcard.symm
  have hdegree : (Module.finrank K E).Coprime (n : ℕ) :=
    hdegree_prime.pow_right (s + 1)
  have hcinv : ∀ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E),
      c (absoluteGaloisConjugate υ σ) = c σ := by
    intro σ
    apply coordinate.injective
    exact absoluteCharacter_invariant_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
      E (n : ℕ) hdegree f hinv τ υ hυ hτ σ
  obtain ⟨a, ha, _hcop, hroots⟩ := exists_bounded_coprime_power_action_on_roots E n hmu υ
  refine ⟨a, ha, hroots, ?_⟩
  exact exists_power_witness_of_invariant_absoluteKummerCharacter
    E n hmu υ u₀ a hroots hcinv

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_nontrivial_primeDegree_H1Action_in_closure
statement:

    {F K Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field Ω]

  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} K E
