name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.mixedChar_wild_residualAbelianization_faithful
statement:
theorem mixedChar_wild_residualAbelianization_faithful
    {K M : Type u} [Field K] [Field M] [Algebra K M] [IsGalois K M] [CharZero K]
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP base.residueField p] {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank K M = r) :
    Function.Injective (fun τ : Gal(M/K) =>
      absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction
        (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p).hereditary τ.toRingEquiv)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K M :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure M
  let q : Gal(Ω/K) →* Gal(M/K) := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom M
  let N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K) := q.ker
  have hN : IsOpen (N : Set Gal(Ω/K)) :=
    normalRestrictionKernel_isOpen (K := K) (M := M) (Ω := Ω)
  have hindex : N.index = r :=
    (normalRestrictionKernel_index (K := K) (M := M) (Ω := Ω)).trans hdegree
  have hfaith := mixedChar_henselian_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
    base p N hN hindex
  let hC : FiniteGroupClass.FullFormation (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) :=
    FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p
  let f : Gal(M/K) →* MulAut (TopologicalAbelianization
      (Gal(Ω/M) ⧸ proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) Gal(Ω/M))) :=
    (absoluteGaloisResidualAbelianizationAction (K := M) hC.hereditary).comp
    (MulSemiringAction.toRingAut Gal(M/K) M)
  change Function.Injective f
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_one f).mpr
  intro τ hτ
  by_contra hτne
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_surjective Ω τ
  have hgN : g ∉ N := by
    intro h
    change q g = 1 at h
    exact hτne (hg.symm.trans h)
  have hdetect := (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_iff
    hC N (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN)).mp hfaith g hgN
  apply hdetect
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  let t : TopologicalAbelianization (N ⧸ proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) N) ≃ₜ*
      TopologicalAbelianization (Gal(Ω/M) ⧸
        proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) Gal(Ω/M)) :=
    normalRestrictionResidualAbelianizationEquiv (K := K) (M := M) hC.hereditary
  apply t.injective
  have hcomm := normalRestrictionResidualAbelianizationEquiv_conjugation
    (K := K) (M := M) hC g a
  exact hcomm.trans (DFunLike.congr_fun ((congrArg f hg).trans hτ) (t a))

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.cyclotomicTeichmuller_power_action_on_roots
statement:
private theorem cyclotomicTeichmuller_power_action_on_roots
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} L E]
    (s : ℕ) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 1)) E).Nonempty)
    (δ : E ≃ₐ[L] E) (ξ : E) (hξ : ξ ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) = 1) :
    δ ξ = ξ ^ (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)
      (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter L E p δ : ℤ_[p])).val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζmem⟩ := hmu
  have hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (s + 1)) :=
    (mem_primitiveRoots (pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos (s + 1))).mp hζmem
  have haction := primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter_spec L E p s hζ δ
  obtain ⟨i, _hi, rfl⟩ := hζ.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hξ
  rw [map_pow, ← haction, pow_right_comm]

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.principalUnit_cyclotomicKummerCharacter_conjugation_invariant
statement:
theorem principalUnit_cyclotomicKummerCharacter_conjugation_invariant
    [CharZero E]
    (v : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete v]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} L E]
    (s : ℕ) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 1)) E).Nonempty)
    (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v) 1)
    (hueigen : ∀ δ : E ≃ₐ[L] E,
      δ (((u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ) :
        (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubring) : E) =
      (((principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p
        (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter L E p δ : ℤ_[p]) u :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ) :
            (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubring) : E))
    (δ : E ≃ₐ[L] E) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)) :
    let n : ℕ+
proof:
:= ⟨p ^ (s + 1), pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos (s + 1)⟩
    let u₀ : Eˣ := CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits
      (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v)
      (u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v).valuationSubringˣ)
    absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv E n hmu
        (u₀ : Eˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Eˣ →* Eˣ).range)
        (absoluteGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv σ) =
      absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv E n hmu
        (u₀ : Eˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Eˣ →* Eˣ).range) σ := by
  let Fv := completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation v
  let j : Fv.valuationSubringˣ →* Eˣ := CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits Fv
  let u₀ : Eˣ := j (u : Fv.valuationSubringˣ)
  let χδ : ℤ_[p]ˣ := primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter L E p δ
  let a : ℕ := (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1) (χδ : ℤ_[p])).val
  let n : ℕ+ := ⟨p ^ (s + 1), pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos (s + 1)⟩
  let Q := Eˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (n : ℕ) : Eˣ →* Eˣ).range
  have heigen : Units.map δ.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom u₀ =
      j (principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar v p (χδ : ℤ_[p]) u :
        Fv.valuationSubringˣ) := by
    apply Units.ext
    exact hueigen δ
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ :=
    exists_fieldUnit_principalUnitPadicPow_div_natCast_eq_pow v p (χδ : ℤ_[p]) u (s + 1)
  have hdiv : Units.map δ.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom u₀ / u₀ ^ a = w ^ (n : ℕ) := by
    rw [heigen]
    exact hw
  have hclass : ((Units.map δ.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom u₀ : Eˣ) : Q) =
      (u₀ : Q) ^ a := by
    rw [← QuotientGroup.mk_pow]
    apply QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem.mpr
    exact ⟨w, hdiv.symm⟩
  have ha : a.Coprime (n : ℕ) :=
    ZMod.val_coe_unit_coprime
      (Units.map (PadicInt.toZModPow (s + 1)).toMonoidHom χδ)
  have hroots : ∀ ξ : E, ξ ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 → δ.toRingEquiv ξ = ξ ^ a :=
    cyclotomicTeichmuller_power_action_on_roots p s hmu δ
  exact absoluteKummerContinuousNthRootsCharacterEquiv_conjugation_invariant_of_power_action
    E n hmu δ.toRingEquiv u₀ a ha hclass hroots σ

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.characterLog_action_sub_prime_divisible_of_log_difference
statement:
private theorem characterLog_action_sub_prime_divisible_of_log_difference
    {M Γ : Type*} [Field M] [CharZero M] [Group Γ]
    (vE : _root_.Valuation M (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    (σ : Γ →* (M ≃+* M)) (hval : ∀ (g : Γ) (b : M), vE (σ g b) = vE b)
    (χ : Γ →* ℤ_[p]ˣ) (Δ : Subgroup Γ) [Δ.Normal]
    (g : Γ) (x : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ)
    (z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1)
    (hz : σ g (characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ x) -
      padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) *
        characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ x =
      (p : M) * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p z).toAdd) :
    ∃ y : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ,
      characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ g x - x =
        (p : ℤ_[p]) • y
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ
  let ι := characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ
  let z₀ : PrincipalUnitLogImageOfMixedChar vE p :=
    ⟨(principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p z).toAdd, Additive.ofMul z, rfl⟩
  let y₀ : PrincipalUnitLogImageOfMixedChar vE p :=
    (((χ g)⁻¹ : ℤ_[p]ˣ) : ℤ_[p]) • z₀
  have hscalar :
      padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (((χ g)⁻¹ : ℤ_[p]ˣ) : ℤ_[p]) *
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) = 1 := by
    rw [← _root_.map_mul, Units.inv_mul, _root_.map_one]
  have hpy : p • y₀ = (ρ g x - x).val := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change p • (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (((χ g)⁻¹ : ℤ_[p]ˣ) : ℤ_[p]) *
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p z).toAdd) = ι (ρ g x) - ι x
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul,
      characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar_action vE p σ hval χ Δ g x]
    change σ g (ι x) - padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (χ g : ℤ_[p]) * ι x =
      (p : M) * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p z).toAdd at hz
    have h := congrArg
      (fun b : M => padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p (((χ g)⁻¹ : ℤ_[p]ˣ) : ℤ_[p]) * b) hz
    rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, hscalar, one_mul, mul_left_comm] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hy₀ : y₀ ∈ characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ :=
    mem_characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar_of_nsmul_mem vE p σ hval χ Δ p
      (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero y₀ (by rw [hpy]; exact (ρ g x - x).property)
  refine ⟨⟨y₀, hy₀⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  exact Subtype.ext hpy.symm

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_cyclotomic_eigenunit_of_characterLog
statement:
private theorem exists_cyclotomic_eigenunit_of_characterLog
    {F K E : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field E]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra K E] [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower F K E]
    [CharZero E] [Normal F K]
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    (hval : ∀ (g : Gal(E/F)) (b : E),
      vE (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv Gal(E/F) E g b) = vE b)
    (x : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar vE p
      (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv Gal(E/F) E) hval
      (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K E))
      (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom K : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(K/F)).ker) :
    ∃ u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1,
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd =
        characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar vE p
          (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv Gal(E/F) E) hval
          (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K E))
          (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom K : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(K/F)).ker x ∧
      ∀ δ : Gal(E/K),
        δ (((u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ) :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubring) : E) =
        (((principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar vE p
          (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K E p δ : ℤ_[p]) u :
            (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ) :
              (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubring) : E)
proof:
:= by
  let σ := MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv Gal(E/F) E
  let χ := primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K E)
  let Δ := (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom K : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(K/F)).ker
  let ι := characterLogInclusionOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} K E
  have heigen (δ : Gal(E/K)) :
      δ (ι x) = padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
        (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K E p δ : ℤ_[p]) * ι x := by
    have hδ : δ.restrictScalars F ∈ Δ := by
      change δ.restrictScalars F ∈
        (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom K : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(K/F)).ker
      rw [← restrictScalarsHom_range_eq_normalRestrictionKer F K E]
      exact ⟨δ, rfl⟩
    have h := (mem_characterLogSubmoduleOfMixedChar_iff vE p σ hval χ Δ x.val).mp
      x.property ⟨δ.restrictScalars F, hδ⟩
    have hc : χ (δ.restrictScalars F) = primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K E p δ := by
      exact congrArg (fun f : Gal(E/K) →* ℤ_[p]ˣ => f δ)
        (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter_comp_restrictScalars F p
          (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K E))
    change δ (ι x) = padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
      (χ (δ.restrictScalars F) : ℤ_[p]) * ι x at h
    rw [hc] at h
    exact h
  have hvalK (δ : Gal(E/K)) (b : E) : vE (δ b) = vE b :=
    hval (δ.restrictScalars F) b
  have hcard : p.Coprime (Fintype.card Gal(E/K)) := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
      ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard K E p
  exact exists_principalUnit_log_eigen_lift vE p
    (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv Gal(E/K) E) hvalK hcard
    (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K E p) (ι x)
    (exists_principalUnit_log_eq_characterLogInclusion vE p σ hval χ Δ x) heigen

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.characterLog_action_sub_prime_divisible_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
statement:
theorem characterLog_action_sub_prime_divisible_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
    {F K Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K] [Normal F K]
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω) [Algebra F E] [IsScalarTower F K E]
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    (hval : ∀ (g : Gal(E/F)) (b : E),
      vE (MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv Gal(E/F) E g b) = vE b)
    (htriv : ∀ τ : Gal(K/F), relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) F K τ = 1) :
    let σ
proof:
:= MulSemiringAction.toRingEquiv Gal(E/F) E
    let χ := primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K E)
    let Δ := (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom K : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(K/F)).ker
    ∀ (g : Gal(E/F)) (x : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ),
      ∃ y : CharacterLogSpaceOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ,
        characterLogRepresentationOfMixedChar vE p σ hval χ Δ g x - x =
          (p : ℤ_[p]) • y := by
  classical
  intro σ χ Δ g x
  obtain ⟨u, hulog, hueigen⟩ :=
    exists_cyclotomic_eigenunit_of_characterLog (F := F) (K := K) vE p hval x
  let τ := (AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom K : Gal(E/F) →* Gal(K/F)) g
  have hcompat (b : K) : g (algebraMap K E b) = algebraMap K E (τ b) :=
    (g.restrictNormal_commutes K b).symm
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_principalUnit_log_character_difference_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
    E vE p (IsCyclotomicExtension.zeta_spec p K E) u hueigen τ g hcompat (hval g) (htriv τ)
  rw [hulog] at hz
  exact characterLog_action_sub_prime_divisible_of_log_difference
    vE p σ hval χ Δ g x z hz

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.rootsDownstairs_exists_moved_h1
statement:
theorem rootsDownstairs_exists_moved_h1
    [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    (hμ : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : L | ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (hdown : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
      ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (τ : Gal(L/K)) (hτ : τ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) L).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) L).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      ∃ c : ClassFieldTower.ProP.ContinuousH1ZMod
          (p := p ^ s) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L),
        ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L),
          c (Additive.ofMul
              (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L)) ≠
            c (Additive.ofMul (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K L).injective
  obtain ⟨α, ζ, hζ, hα⟩ := exists_primitive_eigenunit_of_prime_degree hp hdeg hμ τ hτ
  have hfixed : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) → τ.toRingEquiv ξ = ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hdown ξ hξ
    exact τ.commutes a
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax, χ, σ, hσ⟩ :=
    exists_moved_absoluteKummerCharacter_of_finite_primePowerRoots
      L hp hfinite ζ hζ τ.toRingEquiv hfixed α hα
  let n : ℕ+ := ⟨p ^ s, pow_pos hp.pos s⟩
  let e := discreteNthRootsContinuousMulEquivMultiplicativeZMod L n hμs
  let ψ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ s)) :=
    ⟨e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom.comp χ.toMonoidHom, e.continuous.comp χ.continuous⟩
  refine ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax, ClassFieldTower.ProP.h1OfCharacter ψ, σ, ?_⟩
  intro heq
  apply hσ
  apply e.injective
  exact congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd heq

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.rootsDownstairs_nontrivial_h1
statement:
theorem rootsDownstairs_nontrivial_h1
    [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    (hμ : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : L | ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (hdown : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
      ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L)) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) L).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) L).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      ∃ τ : Gal(L/K), τ ≠ 1 ∧
        ∃ c : ClassFieldTower.ProP.ContinuousH1ZMod
            (p := p ^ s) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L),
          ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L),
            c (Additive.ofMul
                (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L)) ≠
              c (Additive.ofMul (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = p :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdeg
  have : Nontrivial Gal(L/K) :=
    Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (hcard.symm ▸ hp.one_lt)
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Gal(L/K))
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax, c, σ, hσ⟩ :=
    rootsDownstairs_exists_moved_h1 hp hdeg hμ hfinite hdown τ hτ
  exact ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax, τ, hτ, c, σ, hσ⟩

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.henselian_openNormal_faithful_of_inertia_le
statement:
theorem henselian_openNormal_faithful_of_inertia_le
    {K : Type u} {Ω : Type v} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsGalois K Ω]
    (D : HenselianDVF.{u, w} K)
    {Γ : Type x} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (vΩ : _root_.Valuation Ω Γ) [D.valuation.HasExtension vΩ]
    (hres : IsAbFaithful Gal(ResidueField vΩ.valuationSubring/D.residueField))
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup Gal(Ω/K))
    (hI : (henselianResidueAction D.valuation vΩ).ker ≤ (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) :
    Function.Injective (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
      (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)))
proof:
:= by
  let f := henselianResidueContinuousHom D.valuation vΩ
  have hopen : IsOpenMap f := (henselianResidueAction_isOpenQuotientMap D.valuation vΩ).isOpenMap
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := henselianResidueAction_surjective D.valuation vΩ
  let M := ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.map f hopen hsurj N
  have : ((N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)).map f.toMonoidHom).Normal := M.isNormal'
  apply quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_injective_of_map f
    (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) hI
  exact inj_quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_of_openNormalSubgroupTop
    M (hres ⊤ (openNormalSubgroupTop M))

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.residueZero_openNormal_faithful_of_inertia_le
statement:
theorem residueZero_openNormal_faithful_of_inertia_le
    {K : Type u} {Ω : Type v} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (D : HenselianDVF.{u, w} K) [CharZero D.residueField]
    {Γ : Type x} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ]
    (vΩ : _root_.Valuation Ω Γ) [D.valuation.HasExtension vΩ]
    (hres : IsAbFaithful Gal(AlgebraicClosure D.residueField/D.residueField))
    (N : OpenNormalSubgroup Gal(Ω/K))
    (hI : (henselianResidueAction D.valuation vΩ).ker ≤ (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K))) :
    Function.Injective (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
      (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)))
proof:
:= by
  have : IsAlgClosed Ω := IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed K
  have : IsAlgClosure D.residueField (ResidueField vΩ.valuationSubring) :=
    henselianResidueExtension_isAlgClosure D.valuation vΩ
  have hactual : IsAbFaithful Gal(ResidueField vΩ.valuationSubring / D.residueField) :=
    isAbFaithful_of_continuousMulEquiv

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.residualFaithfulness_of_complete_galois_equiv
statement:
private theorem residualFaithfulness_of_complete_galois_equiv
    {K D : Type u} [Field K] [Field D] [CharZero K] [CharZero D]
    (w : _root_.Valuation D (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete w] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField w.valuationSubring) p]
    (e : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) ≃ₜ* Gal(AlgebraicClosure D/D))
    (N : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) [hNormal : N.Normal]
    (hN : IsOpen (N : Set Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))) {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime]
    (hindex : N.index = r) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) N (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN))
proof:
:= by
  let M : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure D/D) := N.map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
  have : M.Normal := hNormal.map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom e.surjective
  have hM : IsOpen (M : Set Gal(AlgebraicClosure D/D)) := e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap N hN
  have hMindex : M.index = r := (N.index_map_equiv e.toMulEquiv).trans hindex
  have hfaith := mixedChar_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful w p M hM hMindex
  exact (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
    (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) e N (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN)).mp hfaith

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.mixedChar_henselian_openSubgroup_faithful_of_integerValuation
statement:
private theorem mixedChar_henselian_openSubgroup_faithful_of_integerValuation
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (v : _root_.Valuation K (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) [v.IsRankOneDiscrete]
    [HenselianRing v.valuationSubring (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring)]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [hres : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p]
    (N : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) [hNormal : N.Normal]
    (hN : IsOpen (N : Set Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K))) {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime]
    (hindex : N.index = r) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) N (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN))
proof:
:= by
  have : CharZero v.Completion :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap K v.Completion).injective
  let base : HenselianDVF K :=
    { ValueGroup := WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ), valuation := v }
  let i : SeparableClosure K →ₐ[K] SeparableClosure v.Completion := IsSepClosed.lift
  let e : Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) ≃ₜ*
      Gal(AlgebraicClosure v.Completion/v.Completion) :=
    base.completionAbsoluteGaloisEquiv i
  have : Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete
      (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation v.Completion (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) :=
    Valuation.completion_isCompleteDiscrete v
  have : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
      (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation v.Completion
        (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))).valuationSubring) p :=
    Valuation.completion_residueChar v p
  exact residualFaithfulness_of_complete_galois_equiv
    (Valued.v : _root_.Valuation v.Completion (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) p e N hN hindex

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.mixedChar_henselian_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
statement:
theorem mixedChar_henselian_openSubgroup_residualAbelianization_faithful
    {K Ω : Type u} [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (base : HenselianDVF.{u, v} K) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [hres : CharP base.residueField p]
    (N : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K)) [hNormal : N.Normal]
    (hN : IsOpen (N : Set Gal(Ω/K))) {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime]
    (hindex : N.index = r) :
    Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) N (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN))
proof:
:= by
  let e : Gal(Ω/K) ≃ₜ* Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) :=
    KummerTheory.absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv K Ω
  let M : Subgroup Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K) := N.map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom
  have : M.Normal := hNormal.map e.toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom e.surjective
  have hM : IsOpen (M : Set Gal(AlgebraicClosure K/K)) := e.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap N hN
  have hMindex : M.index = r := (N.index_map_equiv e.toMulEquiv).trans hindex
  have hfaith : Function.Injective (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation
      (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) M (M.isClosed_of_isOpen hM)) := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hring⟩ := base.toDVF.exists_normalized_valuation
    have : HenselianRing v.valuationSubring
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal v.valuationSubring) := by
      rw [hring]
      infer_instance
    have : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField v.valuationSubring) p := by
      rw [hring]
      exact hres
    exact mixedChar_henselian_openSubgroup_faithful_of_integerValuation v p M hM hMindex
  exact (residualAbelianizationQuotientConjugation_injective_map_iff
    (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) e N (N.isClosed_of_isOpen hN)).mp hfaith

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_moved_separableKummerCharacter_of_finite_primePowerRoots
statement:
private theorem exists_moved_separableKummerCharacter_of_finite_primePowerRoots
    (K : Type*) [Field K] {p : ℕ} [NeZero (p : K)] (hp : p.Prime)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : K | ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (ζ : Kˣ) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p)
    (τ : K ≃+* K)
    (hτ : ∀ ξ : K, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) → τ ξ = ξ)
    (α : Kˣ) (hα : Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α = ζ * α) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) K).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) K).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      ∃ χ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ s)),
        ∃ σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup K,
          χ (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ σ) ≠ χ σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hmu, hmax, _, hζclass⟩ :=
    exists_last_primePowerRoot_nontrivial_class hp hfinite hζ
  let n : ℕ+ := ⟨p ^ s, pow_pos hp.pos s⟩
  have : NeZero ((n : ℕ) : K) := by
    change NeZero ((p ^ s : ℕ) : K)
    rw [Nat.cast_pow]
    exact ⟨pow_ne_zero s (NeZero.ne (p : K))⟩
  let κ := separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv K n hmu
  have hαclass :
      ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α : Kˣ) :
        Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ≠
      (α : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) := by
    intro heq
    apply hζclass
    rw [hα] at heq
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff ζ).mpr
    have hmem := QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem.mp heq
    rw [mul_div_cancel_right] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hcharacters :
      κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α : Kˣ) :
        Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) ≠
      κ (α : Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range) :=
    κ.injective.ne hαclass
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := DFunLike.exists_ne hcharacters
  refine ⟨s, hs, hmu, hmax, κ ((Units.map τ.toMonoidHom α : Kˣ) :
    Kˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom (p ^ s) : Kˣ →* Kˣ).range), σ, ?_⟩
  have hnatural :=
    separableAbsoluteKummerContinuousZModCharacterEquiv_naturality_of_fixes_roots
      K n hmu τ (fun ξ hξ => hτ ξ ⟨s, hξ⟩) α σ
  intro hfixed
  exact hσ (hfixed.symm.trans hnatural)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.rootsDownstairs_faithful_h1_action_of_char_ne
statement:
theorem rootsDownstairs_faithful_h1_action_of_char_ne
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hchar : ringChar K ≠ p)
    (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    (hμ : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : L | ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (hdown : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
      ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L)) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) L).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) L).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      Function.Injective (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) K L)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdeg.symm ▸ hp.pos)
  have : NeZero (p : K) := ⟨CharP.cast_ne_zero_of_ne_of_prime K hp hchar⟩
  have : NeZero (p : L) := NeZero.nat_of_injective
    (f := algebraMap K L) (algebraMap K L).injective
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = p :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdeg
  have : Nontrivial Gal(L/K) :=
    Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (hcard.symm ▸ hp.one_lt)
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Gal(L/K))
  obtain ⟨α, ζ, hζ, hα⟩ :=
    exists_primitive_eigenunit_of_prime_degree hp hdeg hμ τ⁻¹ (inv_ne_one.mpr hτ)
  have hfixed : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
      (τ⁻¹).toRingEquiv ξ = ξ := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hdown ξ hξ
    exact (τ⁻¹).commutes a
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax, χ, σ, hσ⟩ :=
    exists_moved_separableKummerCharacter_of_finite_primePowerRoots
      L hp hfinite ζ hζ (τ⁻¹).toRingEquiv hfixed α hα
  let c : ContinuousH1ZMod (p := p ^ s) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L) :=
    h1OfCharacter χ
  have haction : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) K L τ ≠ 1 := by
    intro heq
    change Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L) at σ
    have hvalue := congrArg
      (fun a : Multiplicative
        (AddAut (ContinuousH1ZMod (p := p ^ s) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))) =>
        a.toAdd c (Additive.ofMul σ)) heq
    rw [relativeGaloisH1Action_apply] at hvalue
    exact hσ (congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd hvalue)
  refine ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax,
    (ProCGroups.FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.injective_iff_ne_one_of_prime_card
      (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) K L) (hcard.symm ▸ hp)).mpr ?_⟩
  intro heq
  exact haction (DFunLike.congr_fun heq τ)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.rootsDownstairs_h1_action_ne_one
statement:
theorem rootsDownstairs_h1_action_ne_one
    [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    (hμ : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : L | ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (hdown : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
      ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (τ : Gal(L/K)) (hτ : τ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) L).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) L).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) K L τ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax, c, σ, hσ⟩ :=
    rootsDownstairs_exists_moved_h1 hp hdeg hμ hfinite hdown τ⁻¹ (inv_ne_one.mpr hτ)
  refine ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax, ?_⟩
  intro heq
  have hvalue := congrArg
    (fun a : Multiplicative
      (AddAut (ContinuousH1ZMod (p := p ^ s) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))) =>
      a.toAdd c (Additive.ofMul (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))) heq
  rw [relativeGaloisH1Action_apply] at hvalue
  exact hσ hvalue

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.rootsDownstairs_faithful_h1_action
statement:
theorem rootsDownstairs_faithful_h1_action
    [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    (hμ : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : L | ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (hdown : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
      ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L)) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) L).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) L).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      Function.Injective (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) K L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax, _τ, _hτ, _c, _σ, _hσ⟩ :=
    rootsDownstairs_nontrivial_h1 hp hdeg hμ hfinite hdown
  refine ⟨s, hs, hμs, hmax, (injective_iff_map_eq_one
    (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) K L)).mpr ?_⟩
  intro τ hτ
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨t, _ht, hμt, hmaxt, hdetect⟩ :=
    rootsDownstairs_h1_action_ne_one hp hdeg hμ hfinite hdown τ hne
  have ht : t = s := Nat.le_antisymm (hmax t hμt) (hmaxt s hμs)
  subst t
  exact hdetect hτ

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.rootsDownstairs_abelianization_action_ne_one
statement:
theorem rootsDownstairs_abelianization_action_ne_one
    [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    (hμ : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : L | ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (hdown : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
      ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L))
    (τ : Gal(L/K)) (hτ : τ ≠ 1) :
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction τ.toRingEquiv ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, _hs, _hμs, _hmax, c, σ, hσ⟩ :=
    rootsDownstairs_exists_moved_h1 hp hdeg hμ hfinite hdown τ hτ
  apply absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_ne_one_of_character_ne
    τ.toRingEquiv (characterOfH1 c) (σ := σ)
  intro heq
  exact hσ (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd heq)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.log_character_difference_of_power_witness
statement:
private theorem log_character_difference_of_power_witness
    {F E : Type*} [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [CharZero E]
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    {ζ : E} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p)
    (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1)
    (υ : Gal(E/F)) (hval : ∀ x : E, vE (υ x) = vE x)
    (a : ℕ) (ha : a < p) (hroot : υ ζ = ζ ^ a) (y : Eˣ)
    (hy : Units.map υ.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom
        (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE)
          (u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ)) /
        (CompleteDVF.valuationSubringUnitsToFieldUnits (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE)
          (u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ)) ^ a = y ^ (p ^ 1)) :
    ∃ z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1,
      υ (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd -
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
          (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ υ : ℤ_[p]) *
            (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd =
        (p : E) * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p z).toAdd
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter_sub_natCast_eq_prime_mul
    F p hζ υ a ha hroot
  obtain ⟨z, _hzval, hzlog⟩ :=
    exists_principalUnit_log_of_fieldUnit_power_witness
      vE p υ.toRingEquiv hval u a 1 y hy
  simp only [pow_one] at hzlog
  let w := z / principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar vE p c u
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  have hwlog : (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p w).toAdd =
      (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p z).toAdd -
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p c * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd := by
    change (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p
      (z / principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar vE p c u)).toAdd = _
    rw [map_div, toAdd_div, principalUnitLogOfMixedChar_padicPow]
  have hcE := congrArg (padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p) hc
  rw [map_sub, _root_.map_mul, map_natCast, map_natCast] at hcE
  have hpE : (p : E) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
  have hz : (p : E) * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p z).toAdd =
      υ (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd -
        (a : E) * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd := by
    rw [hzlog, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hpE]
    rfl
  rw [hwlog, mul_sub, hz, ← mul_assoc, ← hcE]
  ring

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_principalUnit_log_character_difference_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
statement:
theorem exists_principalUnit_log_character_difference_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω) [Algebra F E]
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    {ζ : E} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ p)
    (u : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1)
    (hueigen : ∀ δ : E ≃ₐ[K] E,
      δ (((u : (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ) :
        (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubring) : E) =
      (((principalUnitPadicPowOfMixedChar vE p
        (primeCyclotomicTeichmullerCharacter K E p δ : ℤ_[p]) u :
          (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubringˣ) :
            (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).valuationSubring) : E))
    (τ : Gal(K/F)) (υ : Gal(E/F))
    (hυ : ∀ x : K, υ (algebraMap K E x) = algebraMap K E (τ x))
    (hval : ∀ x : E, vE (υ x) = vE x)
    (hτ : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p) F K τ = 1) :
    ∃ z : CompleteDVF.higherPrincipalUnitGroup (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE) 1,
      υ (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd -
        padicIntToFieldOfMixedChar vE p
          (primitiveRootTeichmullerCharacter F p hζ υ : ℤ_[p]) *
            (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p u).toAdd =
        (p : E) * (principalUnitLogOfMixedChar vE p z).toAdd
proof:
:= by
  have hmu : (primitiveRoots (p ^ (0 + 1)) E).Nonempty := by
    rw [Nat.zero_add, pow_one]
    exact ⟨ζ, (mem_primitiveRoots (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos).mpr hζ⟩
  have hτ' : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ (0 + 1)) F K τ = 1 := by
    exact (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => relativeGaloisH1Action (n := n) F K τ = 1)
      (pow_one p : p ^ (0 + 1) = p)).mpr hτ
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hroots, y, hy⟩ :=
    exists_cyclotomic_power_witness_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
      E vE p 0 hmu u hueigen τ υ.toRingEquiv hυ hτ'
  simp only [Nat.zero_add, pow_one] at ha hroots hy
  exact log_character_difference_of_power_witness vE p hζ u υ hval
    a ha (hroots ζ hζ.pow_eq_one) y (by simpa only [pow_one] using hy)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.rootsDownstairs_openSubgroup_quotient_action_faithful
statement:
theorem rootsDownstairs_openSubgroup_quotient_action_faithful
    (N : OpenSubgroup Gal(Ω/K)) [N.toSubgroup.Normal]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hcard : Nat.card (Gal(Ω/K) ⧸ N.toSubgroup) = p)
    (hμ : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty)
    (hfinite : Set.Finite {ξ : IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup |
      ∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1})
    (hdown : ∀ ξ : IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup,
      (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
        ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K (IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup))) :
    Function.Injective (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap N.toSubgroup)
proof:
:= by
  let H : ClosedSubgroup Gal(Ω/K) := ⟨N.toSubgroup, N.isClosed⟩
  have hfix : (IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup).fixingSubgroup = N.toSubgroup :=
    InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_fixedField H
  have : FiniteDimensional K (IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup) :=
    (InfiniteGalois.isOpen_iff_finite (IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup)).mp
      (by rw [hfix]; exact N.isOpen)
  have hdeg : Module.finrank K (IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup) = p :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K (IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup)).symm.trans
      ((Nat.card_congr (InfiniteGalois.normalAutEquivQuotient H).toEquiv).symm.trans hcard)
  have hfaith := rootsDownstairs_fixedSubgroup_quotient_action_faithful
    (IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup) hp hdeg hμ hfinite hdown
  let P : Subgroup Gal(Ω/K) → Prop := fun U =>
    ∀ hU : U.Normal, letI : U.Normal := hU
      Function.Injective (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap U)
  have hP : P (IntermediateField.fixedField N.toSubgroup).fixingSubgroup := fun _ => hfaith
  have hPN : P N.toSubgroup := hfix ▸ hP
  exact hPN inferInstance

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_roots_not_in_cyclotomic_base
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_roots_not_in_cyclotomic_base
    {F K L Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field L] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω)
    [Algebra F L] [Algebra F E] [Algebra L E]
    [IsScalarTower F K E] [IsScalarTower F L E]
    [FiniteDimensional F K] [Normal F K]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    [vF.HasExtension vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} F L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    (s : ℕ) (hmu : (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 1)) E).Nonempty)
    (hnot : ¬ ∀ ζ : E, ζ ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) = 1 →
      ζ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap L E)) :
    ∃ τ : Gal(K/F), relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ (s + 1)) F K τ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} K E
  have : FiniteDimensional F E := FiniteDimensional.trans F K E
  have : FiniteDimensional L E := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite F L E
  have : Normal F E := ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.normal_cyclotomic_tower F K E p
  have : CharZero L := (algebraMap L E).charZero
  have : IsGalois L E :=
    { to_normal := Normal.tower_top_of_normal F L E
      to_isSeparable := inferInstance }
  let m : ℕ+ := ⟨p ^ (s + 1), pow_pos (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos (s + 1)⟩
  obtain ⟨ζ, τupper, hζ, hmoved⟩ :=
    exists_moving_primitiveRoot_of_not_all_roots_in_base L E m hmu hnot
  refine ⟨IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E τupper, ?_⟩
  intro htrivial
  exact hmoved (trivial_relativeH1Action_fixes_primePower_roots
    E vF vE p s hmu τupper htrivial ζ hζ.pow_eq_one)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_lastLevel_invariant_moved_cyclotomicKummerTrace
statement:
theorem exists_lastLevel_invariant_moved_cyclotomicKummerTrace
    (F K L E : Type*) [Field F] [Field K] [Field L] [Field E]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra F L] [Algebra F E] [Algebra K E] [Algebra L E]
    [IsScalarTower F K E] [IsScalarTower F L E] [Normal F K] [CharZero E]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} F L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank F K = p)
    (V : DVF E) [hres : CharP V.residueField p] :
    ∃ s : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 1)) E).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) E).Nonempty → m ≤ s + 1) ∧
      ¬ (primitiveRoots (p ^ (s + 2)) E).Nonempty ∧
      ((∀ ξ : E, ξ ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) = 1 → ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap L E)) →
        ∃ (τ : E ≃ₐ[L] E)
          (T : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))),
          (∀ δ : E ≃ₐ[K] E,
            absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := E)
              (A := Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))) δ.toRingEquiv T = T) ∧
          absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := E)
            (A := Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (s + 1)))) τ.toRingEquiv T ≠ T)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  have hdeg : Module.finrank L E = p :=
    cyclotomic_compositum_finrank_eq_prime F K L E p hdegree
  have : FiniteDimensional L E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdeg.symm ▸ hp.pos)
  have : IsGalois L E := by
    have : Normal F E := by
      have : FiniteDimensional F K :=
        FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ hp.pos)
      exact normal_cyclotomic_tower F K E p
    have : CharZero L := (algebraMap L E).charZero
    exact { to_normal := Normal.tower_top_of_normal F L E }
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(E/L) = p :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank L E).trans hdeg
  have : Nontrivial Gal(E/L) :=
    Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp (hcard.symm ▸ hp.one_lt)
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_ne (1 : Gal(E/L))
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ := IsCyclotomicExtension.exists_isPrimitiveRoot F L
    (Set.mem_singleton p) hp.ne_zero
  have hmuL : (primitiveRoots p L).Nonempty :=
    ⟨η, (mem_primitiveRoots hp.pos).mpr hη⟩
  obtain ⟨α, ζ, hζ, hα⟩ :=
    exists_primitive_eigenunit_of_prime_degree hp hdeg hmuL τ hτ
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hmu, hmax, hnext, hclass⟩ :=
    exists_last_primePowerRoot_nontrivial_class hp (V.finite_primePowerRoots p) hζ
  have hqzero : q ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hq)
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hqzero
  refine ⟨s, hmu, hmax, hnext, ?_⟩
  intro hdown
  have hζroot : (ζ : E) ^ p = 1 := (IsPrimitiveRoot.coe_units_iff.mpr hζ).pow_eq_one
  obtain ⟨T, hinvariant, hmoved⟩ := exists_invariant_moved_cyclotomicKummerTrace
    (F := F) (K := K) (L := L) (E := E) p s hmu hdown τ α ζ hα hζroot hclass
  exact ⟨τ, T, hinvariant, hmoved⟩

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.mixedChar_fixingSubgroup_residualAbelianization_conjugation_ne_one
statement:
theorem mixedChar_fixingSubgroup_residualAbelianization_conjugation_ne_one
    {F Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosure F Ω] [CharZero F]
    (S : IntermediateField F Ω) [IsGalois F S]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vF.valuationSubring) p]
    {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime] (hdegree : Module.finrank F S = r)
    (g : Gal(Ω/F)) (hg : g ∉ S.fixingSubgroup) :
    (TopologicalAbelianization.congr
      (residualQuotientConjugationContinuousMulEquiv
        (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p) S.fixingSubgroup
        (InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_isClosed S) g)).toMulEquiv ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : FiniteDimensional F S :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ (Fact.out : r.Prime).pos)
  obtain ⟨s, _hs, hfaith⟩ :=
    exists_faithful_relativeH1Action_of_complete_mixedChar_prime_order vF p hdegree
  let τ : Gal(S/F) := g.restrictNormal S
  have hτ : τ ≠ 1 := by
    intro heq
    apply hg
    rw [← S.restrictNormalHom_ker]
    exact heq
  have hτinv : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) F S τ⁻¹ ≠ 1 := by
    intro heq
    exact (inv_ne_one.mpr hτ)
      (hfaith (heq.trans (map_one (relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) F S)).symm))
  obtain ⟨f, σ₀, hvalue⟩ :=
    exists_changed_character_of_inverse_relativeH1Action_ne_one (p ^ s) τ hτinv
  let e : S.fixingSubgroup ≃ₜ* Gal(AlgebraicClosure S/S) :=
    (fixingSubgroupContinuousEquiv S).trans (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv S Ω)
  let χ : S.fixingSubgroup →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ s)) :=
    fixingSubgroupAbsoluteCharacter S f
  let x : S.fixingSubgroup := e.symm σ₀
  have hconj : χ (MulAut.conjNormal g x) = f (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ₀) := by
    change f (absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv S Ω
      (S.fixingSubgroupEquiv (MulAut.conjNormal g x))) =
        f (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ₀)
    rw [fixingSubgroupEquiv_conjNormal,
      absoluteGaloisClosureEquiv_character_conjugation]
    change f (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv (e (e.symm σ₀))) =
      f (absoluteGaloisConjugate τ.toRingEquiv σ₀)
    rw [ContinuousMulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hx : χ x = f σ₀ := by
    change f (e (e.symm σ₀)) = f σ₀
    rw [ContinuousMulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hχ : χ (MulAut.conjNormal g x) ≠ χ x := by
    rw [hconj, hx]
    exact hvalue
  exact residualAbelianization_conjugation_ne_one_of_cyclicCharacter_ne
    p s S.fixingSubgroup (InfiniteGalois.fixingSubgroup_isClosed S) g χ x hχ

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.residueZero_inertia_exists_moved_h1
statement:
theorem residueZero_inertia_exists_moved_h1
    [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (F : HenselianDVF.{v, w} L) [CharZero F.residueField]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    [Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent F.residueFieldˣ p)]
    (τ : inertiaGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) (hτ : τ ≠ 1) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ (primitiveRoots (p ^ s) L).Nonempty ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, (primitiveRoots (p ^ m) L).Nonempty → m ≤ s) ∧
      ∃ c : ClassFieldTower.ProP.ContinuousH1ZMod
          (p := p ^ s) (G := Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L),
        ∃ σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure L/L),
          c (Additive.ofMul
              (absoluteGaloisConjugate
                ((τ : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) :
                  Gal(L/K)).toRingEquiv σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L)) ≠
            c (Additive.ofMul (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup L))
proof:
:= by
  let τ₀ : Gal(L/K) :=
    ((τ : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) : Gal(L/K))
  have hτ₀ : τ₀ ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hτ
    exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h)
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(L/K) = p :=
    (IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K L).trans hdeg
  have hτpow : τ ^ p = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    change τ₀ ^ p = 1
    rw [← hcard]
    exact pow_card_eq_one'
  have hres : (primitiveRoots p F.residueField).Nonempty :=
    exists_primitiveRoot_residue_of_inertia_prime_order K
      F.valuation.valuationSubring hp τ hτ hτpow
  have hμL := F.primitiveRoots_prime_nonempty_of_residue hp hres
  have hdown : ∀ ξ : L, (∃ m : ℕ, ξ ^ (p ^ m) = 1) →
      ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L) := by
    intro ξ hξ
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hξ
    have hfixed : τ₀ ξ = ξ := inertia_fixes_of_isOfFinOrder K F τ ξ
      (isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨p ^ m, pow_pos hp.pos m, hm⟩)
    apply (IsGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed ξ).mpr
    intro σ
    let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_powers_of_prime_card hcard (g' := σ) hτ₀
    rw [← hn]
    change (τ₀ ^ n) ξ = ξ
    clear hn
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      change (τ₀ ^ n) (τ₀ ξ) = ξ
      rw [hfixed, ih]
  have hμK : (primitiveRoots p K).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ := hμL
    have hprim := (mem_primitiveRoots hp.pos).mp hξ
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hdown ξ ⟨1, by simpa only [pow_one] using hprim.pow_eq_one⟩
    rw [← hζ] at hprim
    exact ⟨ζ, (mem_primitiveRoots hp.pos).mpr
      (hprim.of_map_of_injective (algebraMap K L).injective)⟩
  exact ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.rootsDownstairs_exists_moved_h1
    hp hdeg hμK (F.finite_primePowerRoots_of_finite_residuePrimaryComponent hp)
    hdown τ₀ hτ₀

name: Yamaguchi26AbfaithfulGalois.residueZero_inertia_abelianization_action_ne_one
statement:
theorem residueZero_inertia_abelianization_action_ne_one
    [CharZero K] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    (F : HenselianDVF.{v, w} L) [CharZero F.residueField]
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hdeg : Module.finrank K L = p)
    [Finite (CommGroup.primaryComponent F.residueFieldˣ p)]
    (τ : inertiaGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) (hτ : τ ≠ 1) :
    absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction
      ((τ : decompositionGroup K F.valuation.valuationSubring) : Gal(L/K)).toRingEquiv ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, _hs, _hμs, _hmax, c, σ, hσ⟩ :=
    residueZero_inertia_exists_moved_h1 F hp hdeg τ hτ
  apply absoluteGaloisAbelianizationAction_ne_one_of_character_ne
    _ (ClassFieldTower.ProP.characterOfH1 c) (σ := σ)
  intro heq
  exact hσ (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd heq)

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.characterAction_fixed_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
statement:
private theorem characterAction_fixed_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
    {F K Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω) [FiniteDimensional K E] [Normal K E]
    (n : ℕ) (hdegree : (Module.finrank K E).Coprime n)
    (f : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n))
    (hinv : ∀ δ : Gal(E/K), absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := E)
      (A := Multiplicative (ZMod n)) δ.toRingEquiv f = f)
    (τ : Gal(K/F)) (υ : E ≃+* E)
    (hυ : ∀ x : K, υ (algebraMap K E x) = algebraMap K E (τ x))
    (hτ : relativeGaloisH1Action (n := n) F K τ = 1) :
    absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := E)
      (A := Multiplicative (ZMod n)) υ f = f
proof:
:= by
  have hforward : ∀ (δ : Gal(E/K)) (σ : Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E)),
      f (absoluteGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv σ) = f σ := by
    intro δ σ
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (hinv δ.symm) σ
    change f (absoluteGaloisConjugate δ.toRingEquiv σ) = f σ at h
    exact h
  let a : RingAut E →* MulAut (Gal(AlgebraicClosure E/E) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod n)) :=
    absoluteContinuousCharacterAction (K := E) (A := Multiplicative (ZMod n))
  have hback : a υ⁻¹ f = f := by
    apply ContinuousMonoidHom.ext
    intro σ
    change f (absoluteGaloisConjugate υ σ) = f σ
    exact absoluteCharacter_invariant_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
      E n hdegree f hforward τ υ hυ hτ σ
  rw [map_inv] at hback
  have h := congrArg (a υ) hback
  rw [MulAut.apply_inv_self] at h
  exact h.symm

name: ClassFieldTower.Martinet.Shafarevich.exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_prime_degree_cyclotomic_tower
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_prime_degree_cyclotomic_tower
    {F K L Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field K] [Field L] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosure K Ω] [CharZero K]
    (E : IntermediateField K Ω)
    [Algebra F L] [Algebra F E] [Algebra L E]
    [IsScalarTower F K E] [IsScalarTower F L E] [Normal F K]
    (vF : _root_.Valuation F (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    (vE : _root_.Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vF]
    [ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.Valuation.IsCompleteDiscrete vE]
    [vF.HasExtension vE]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    [hres : CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} F L] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} K E]
    (hdegree : Module.finrank F K = p) :
    ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧ ∃ τ : Gal(K/F),
      relativeGaloisH1Action (n := p ^ s) F K τ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  have : FiniteDimensional F K :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (hdegree.symm ▸ hp.pos)
  have : FiniteDimensional K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.finiteDimensional {p} K E
  have : IsGalois K E := IsCyclotomicExtension.isGalois {p} K E
  obtain ⟨s, hmu, _hmax, _hnext, hpositive⟩ :=
    exists_lastLevel_invariant_moved_cyclotomicKummerTrace F K L E p hdegree
      (completeDVFOfWithZeroValuation vE).toDVF
      (hres := by change CharP (IsLocalRing.ResidueField vE.valuationSubring) p; exact hres)
  refine ⟨s + 1, Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le s), ?_⟩
  by_cases hdown : ∀ ξ : E, ξ ^ (p ^ (s + 1)) = 1 → ξ ∈ Set.range (algebraMap L E)
  · obtain ⟨τ, T, hT, hmoved⟩ := hpositive hdown
    let τlower : Gal(K/F) := IntermediateField.restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom F K L E τ
    refine ⟨τlower, ?_⟩
    intro htrivial
    apply hmoved
    have hcop : (Module.finrank K E).Coprime p := by
      have hcard :=
        ValuationTheory.DiscreteValuationField.prime_coprime_cyclotomicGalois_natCard K E p
      rw [IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank K E] at hcard
      exact hcard.symm
    exact characterAction_fixed_of_trivial_lowerH1Action
      E (p ^ (s + 1)) (hcop.pow_right (s + 1)) T hT τlower τ.toRingEquiv
      (restrictRestrictAlgEquivMapHom_algebraMap F K L E τ) htrivial
  · exact exists_nontrivial_relativeH1Action_of_roots_not_in_cyclotomic_base
      E vF vE p s hmu hdown

name: ProCGroups.ProC.subsingleton_of_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass_distinct_primes
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass_distinct_primes
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G]
    (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hp : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) G)
    (hq : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup q) G) : Subsingleton G
proof:
:= by
  apply subsingleton_of_forall_eq 1
  intro x
  apply hp.eq_one_of_mem_all_openNormalSubgroupInClass
  intro U
  have hQ :=
    hq.quotient_mem (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation q).melnikovFormation.formation U.1
  let z : G ⧸ (U.1 : Subgroup G) := QuotientGroup.mk' (U.1 : Subgroup G) x
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := U.property.2 z
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hQ.2 z
  have heq : z = 1 := orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp
    (Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes
      ((Nat.coprime_primes (Fact.out : p.Prime) (Fact.out : q.Prime)).mpr hpq |>.pow a b)
      (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one ha) (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hb))
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := (U.1 : Subgroup G)) x).mp heq

name: ProCGroups.ProC.residualQuotient_subsingleton_of_distinct_primes
statement:
theorem residualQuotient_subsingleton_of_distinct_primes
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hp : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) G) :
    Subsingleton (G ⧸ proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup q) G)
proof:
:= by
  let R := proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup q) G
  have : IsClosed (R : Set G) := proCResidualCore_isClosed _ _
  let π : G →ₜ* G ⧸ R :=
    { toMonoidHom := QuotientGroup.mk' R
      continuous_toFun := QuotientGroup.continuous_mk }
  have hp' := hp.of_surjective
    (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation p).melnikovFormation.formation π
    (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective R)
  exact subsingleton_of_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass_distinct_primes p q hpq hp'
    (proCResidualCoreQuotient_hasOpenNormalBasisInClass
      (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup_fullFormation q).melnikovFormation.formation)

      (kernelAbelianizationToProfiniteKernelAbelianization
        (G := G) (H := H) psi)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  change ∃ y : Additive (Abelianization (ProfiniteKernelSubgroup psi)),
    Additive.ofMul
      (kernelAbelianizationToProfiniteKernelAbelianizationHom
        (G := G) (H := H) psi (Additive.toMul y)) = x
