name: ProCGroups.quotient_eq_one_of_relative_fixedPoints
statement:
theorem quotient_eq_one_of_relative_fixedPoints
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    {Q : Type v} [Group Q]
    (q : G →* Q) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (D : Subgroup G) [D.Normal] (hD : IsClosed (D : Set G))
    (hfaith : ∀ N : OpenNormalSubgroup G, D ≤ (N : Subgroup G) →
      ∀ x : G, q x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ((N : Subgroup G).map q : Set Q) →
        x ∈ (N : Subgroup G))
    (hfixed : ∀ U : OpenSubgroup G, ∀ x ∈ D,
      q x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ((U : Subgroup G).map q : Set Q) → q x = 1)
    (U : OpenSubgroup G) (x : G)
    (hx : q x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ((U : Subgroup G).map q : Set Q)) :
    q x = 1
proof:
:= by
  let V : OpenNormalSubgroup G := ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.normalCore U
  have hVU : (V : Subgroup G) ≤ (U : Subgroup G) :=
    ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.normalCore_le U
  have hxV : q x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ((V : Subgroup G).map q : Set Q) :=
    Subgroup.centralizer_le (Subgroup.map_mono hVU) hx
  have : ((V : Subgroup G).map q).Normal := Subgroup.Normal.map inferInstance q hq
  let C : Subgroup G :=
    (Subgroup.centralizer ((V : Subgroup G).map q : Set Q)).comap q
  have : C.Normal := inferInstance
  have hxC : x ∈ C := hxV
  have hxDcentral : q x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (D.map q : Set Q) := by
    apply Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff_commutator_eq_one'.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
    have hcD : ⁅x, d⁆ ∈ D :=
      Subgroup.commutator_le_right (⊤ : Subgroup G) D
        (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator (Subgroup.mem_top x) hd)
    have hcC : ⁅x, d⁆ ∈ C :=
      Subgroup.commutator_le_left C (⊤ : Subgroup G)
        (Subgroup.commutator_mem_commutator hxC (Subgroup.mem_top d))
    have hc := hfixed V.toOpenSubgroup ⁅x, d⁆ hcD hcC
    simpa only [map_commutatorElement] using hc
  have hxD : x ∈ D := by
    by_contra hxD
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW⟩ :=
      ProC.exists_openNormalSubgroup_le_not_mem_sup_closedSubgroup ⟨D, hD⟩ hxD V
    let N := ProC.openNormalSubgroup_sup_normal D W
    apply hxW
    apply hfaith N le_sup_left
    have hDle : D.map q ≤ Subgroup.centralizer ({q x} : Set Q) := by
      intro d hd
      exact Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mpr (hxDcentral d hd)
    have hWle : (W : Subgroup G).map q ≤ Subgroup.centralizer ({q x} : Set Q) := by
      intro w hw
      exact Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mpr
        (hxV w (Subgroup.map_mono hWV hw))
    intro n hn
    have hn' : n ∈ (D.map q) ⊔ ((W : Subgroup G).map q) := by
      rw [← Subgroup.map_sup]
      exact hn
    exact Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mp ((sup_le hDle hWle) hn')
  exact hfixed U x hxD hx

name: ProCGroups.exists_prime_power_order_lift_of_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_prime_power_order_lift_of_surjective
    {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] [Finite G]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (hH : IsPGroup p H) (y : H) :
    ∃ x : G, f x = y ∧ ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ (p ^ n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P : Sylow p G := Classical.choice Sylow.nonempty
  have htop : (P.mapSurjective hf : Subgroup H) = ⊤ :=
    ((P.mapSurjective hf).is_maximal' (hH.to_subgroup ⊤) le_top).symm
  have hy : y ∈ (P : Subgroup G).map f := by
    change y ∈ (P.mapSurjective hf : Subgroup H)
    rw [htop]
    exact Subgroup.mem_top y
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := P.isPGroup' ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hxy, n, congrArg (fun z : P => (z : G)) hn⟩

name: ProCGroups.splitKernelSemidirectMulEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem splitKernelSemidirectMulEquiv_apply
    (α : E →* B) (s : B →* E) (hs : α.comp s = MonoidHom.id B)
    (a : α.ker) (b : B) :
    splitKernelSemidirectMulEquiv α s hs ⟨a, b⟩ = (a : E) * s b
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.splitKernelSemidirectMulEquiv_commutes
statement:
theorem splitKernelSemidirectMulEquiv_commutes
    (α : E →* B) (s : B →* E) (hs : α.comp s = MonoidHom.id B)
    (x : α.ker ⋊[(MulAut.conjNormal : E →* MulAut α.ker).comp s] B) :
    α (splitKernelSemidirectMulEquiv α s hs x) = x.right
proof:
:= by
  change α ((x.left : E) * s x.right) = x.right
  rw [map_mul, x.left.property, one_mul]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hs x.right

name: ProCGroups.regularWreathFiberNorm_equivariant
statement:
theorem regularWreathFiberNorm_equivariant (J : Subgroup Q) (ρ : J →* B)
    (j : J) (f : Q → A) :
    regularWreathFiberNorm J ρ
        (mulAutArrow (G := Q) (A := Q) (M := A) (j : Q) f) =
      mulAutArrow (G := B) (A := B) (M := A) (ρ j)
        (regularWreathFiberNorm J ρ f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  funext b
  change (∏ k : J, if ρ k = b then f ((j : Q)⁻¹ * k) else 1) =
    ∏ k : J, if ρ k = (ρ j)⁻¹ * b then f (k : Q) else 1
  apply Fintype.prod_equiv (Equiv.mulLeft j⁻¹)
  intro k
  change (if ρ k = b then f ((j : Q)⁻¹ * k) else 1) =
    if ρ (j⁻¹ * k) = (ρ j)⁻¹ * b then f ((j⁻¹ * k : J) : Q) else 1
  have h : ρ k = b ↔ ρ (j⁻¹ * k) = (ρ j)⁻¹ * b := by
    rw [map_mul, map_inv]
    exact (mul_left_cancel_iff).symm
  simp only [h]
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.regularWreathFiberNorm_mulSingle
statement:
theorem regularWreathFiberNorm_mulSingle [DecidableEq Q] [DecidableEq B]
    (J : Subgroup Q) (ρ : J →* B)
    (j : J) (a : A) :
    regularWreathFiberNorm J ρ (Pi.mulSingle (j : Q) a) =
      (Pi.mulSingle (ρ j) a : B → A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  funext b
  simp only [regularWreathFiberNorm, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single j]
  · simp only [Pi.mulSingle_eq_same, Pi.mulSingle_apply]
    by_cases h : ρ j = b
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left h.symm]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm h)]
  · intro k _ hkj
    have hval : (k : Q) ≠ (j : Q) := fun h => hkj (Subtype.ext h)
    rw [Pi.mulSingle_eq_of_ne hval, ite_self]
  · intro hj
    exact False.elim (hj (Finset.mem_univ j))

name: ProCGroups.regularWreathFiberNorm_surjective
statement:
theorem regularWreathFiberNorm_surjective (J : Subgroup Q) (ρ : J →* B)
    (hρ : Function.Surjective ρ) :
    Function.Surjective (regularWreathFiberNorm (A := A) J ρ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Finite B := Finite.of_surjective ρ hρ
  let : Fintype B := Fintype.ofFinite B
  intro f
  let s : B → J := Function.surjInv hρ
  have hs (b : B) : ρ (s b) = b := Function.rightInverse_surjInv hρ b
  refine ⟨∏ b : B, Pi.mulSingle ((s b : J) : Q) (f b), ?_⟩
  rw [map_prod]
  simp only [regularWreathFiberNorm_mulSingle, hs]
  funext b
  rw [Finset.prod_apply, Finset.prod_eq_single b]
  · rw [Pi.mulSingle_eq_same]
  · intro c _ hcb
    rw [Pi.mulSingle_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hcb)]
  · intro hb
    exact False.elim (hb (Finset.mem_univ b))

name: ProCGroups.Subgroup.Characteristic.quotientMulEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientMulEquiv_mk
    (hH : H.Characteristic) (e : G ≃* G) (g : G) :
    quotientMulEquiv hH e (QuotientGroup.mk' H g) = QuotientGroup.mk' H (e g)
proof:

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.quotientConjugationOnCharacteristicQuotient_mk_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientConjugationOnCharacteristicQuotient_mk_apply_mk
    {G : Type u} [Group G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (K : Subgroup N) [K.Characteristic]
    (hNactsTrivially :
      ∀ n x : N, (((MulAut.conjNormal (n : G)) x) * x⁻¹ : N) ∈ K)
    (g : G) (n : N) :
    quotientConjugationOnCharacteristicQuotient
      (G := G) N K hNactsTrivially
      (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) (QuotientGroup.mk' K n) =
        QuotientGroup.mk' K ((MulAut.conjNormal g) n)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [quotientConjugationOnCharacteristicQuotient]
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.mem_centralizer_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_centralizer_iff {S : Set G} {g : G} :
    g ∈ centralizer S ↔ ∀ h ∈ S, h * g = g * h
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.mem_centralizerOf_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_centralizerOf_iff {x g : G} :
    x ∈ centralizerOf g ↔ x * g = g * x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [centralizerOf, centralizer] using
    (Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff (g := g) (k := x))

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.mem_centralizerOf_pow_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_centralizerOf_pow_of_mem {x y : G} (hy : y ∈ centralizerOf x) (n : ℕ) :
    y ∈ centralizerOf (x ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_centralizerOf_iff] at hy ⊢
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, one_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        y * x ^ (n + 1) = (y * x ^ n) * x := by rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]
        _ = (x ^ n * y) * x := by rw [ih]
        _ = x ^ n * (y * x) := by rw [mul_assoc]
        _ = x ^ n * (x * y) := by rw [hy]
        _ = x ^ (n + 1) * y := by rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.mem_centralizerOf_inv_iff
statement:
theorem mem_centralizerOf_inv_iff {x y : G} :
    y ∈ centralizerOf x⁻¹ ↔ y ∈ centralizerOf x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_centralizerOf_iff, mem_centralizerOf_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg (fun z => x * z * x) h
    simpa [mul_assoc] using h'.symm
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg (fun z => x⁻¹ * z * x⁻¹) h
    simpa [mul_assoc] using h'.symm

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.centralizerOf_zpow_eq_natAbs
statement:
theorem centralizerOf_zpow_eq_natAbs (x : G) {n : ℤ} (_hn : n ≠ 0) :
    centralizerOf (x ^ n) = centralizerOf (x ^ (n.natAbs : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat k =>
      simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast, Int.natAbs_natCast]
  | negSucc k =>
      ext y
      simp only [Int.natAbs, zpow_negSucc, zpow_natCast]
      exact mem_centralizerOf_inv_iff

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.mem_centralizerOf_zpow_natAbs_of_mem_zpow
statement:
theorem mem_centralizerOf_zpow_natAbs_of_mem_zpow {x y : G} {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hy : y ∈ centralizerOf (x ^ n)) :
    y ∈ centralizerOf (x ^ (n.natAbs : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← centralizerOf_zpow_eq_natAbs x hn]

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.right_factor_mem_centralizerOf_of_mul_mem_and_left_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_centralizerOf_iff] at hc hcd ⊢
  calc
    d * x = c⁻¹ * (c * d * x) := by simp [mul_assoc]
    _ = c⁻¹ * (x * (c * d)) := by rw [hcd]
    _ = c⁻¹ * ((x * c) * d) := by simp [mul_assoc]
    _ = c⁻¹ * ((c * x) * d) := by rw [← hc]
    _ = x * d := by simp [mul_assoc]

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.centralizerOf_isClosed
statement:
theorem centralizerOf_isClosed
    [TopologicalSpace G] [ContinuousMul G] [T2Space G] (g : G) :
    IsClosed ((centralizerOf g : Subgroup G) : Set G)
proof:
:= by
  change IsClosed ({g} : Set G).centralizer
  exact Set.isClosed_centralizer (M := G) ({g} : Set G)

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.closedSubgroupGenerated_le_centralizer_of_subset
statement:
theorem closedSubgroupGenerated_le_centralizer_of_subset
    [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G]
    {S T : Set G} (hS : S ⊆ (centralizer T : Set G)) :
    (ProCGroups.Generation.closedSubgroupGenerated (G := G) S : Subgroup G) ≤ centralizer T
proof:
:= by
  have hclosure : Subgroup.closure S ≤ centralizer T := by
    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    exact hS
  exact
    Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal
      _
      hclosure
      (by
        change IsClosed T.centralizer
        exact Set.isClosed_centralizer (M := G) T)

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.centralizer_eq_centralizer_topologicalClosure
statement:
theorem centralizer_eq_centralizer_topologicalClosure
    [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G] (S : Subgroup G) :
    centralizer ((S.topologicalClosure : Subgroup G) : Set G) = centralizer (S : Set G)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Subgroup.centralizer_le (G := G) (Subgroup.le_topologicalClosure (s := S))
  · intro g hg
    rw [mem_centralizer_iff] at hg ⊢
    have hclosure : (S.topologicalClosure : Subgroup G) ≤ centralizerOf g := by
      exact
        Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal
          S
          (by
            intro x hx
            exact mem_centralizerOf_iff.mpr (hg x hx))
          (centralizerOf_isClosed (G := G) g)
    intro x hx
    exact mem_centralizerOf_iff.mp (hclosure hx)

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.closedSubgroupGenerated_singleton_le_centralizerOf_zpow
statement:
theorem closedSubgroupGenerated_singleton_le_centralizerOf_zpow
    [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G]
    (g : G) (n : ℤ) :
    (ProCGroups.Generation.closedSubgroupGenerated (G := G) ({g} : Set G) : Subgroup G) ≤
      centralizerOf (g ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have hclosure :
      Subgroup.closure ({g} : Set G) ≤ centralizerOf (g ^ n) := by
    rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst y
    exact mem_centralizerOf_iff.mpr
      (by simpa using (Commute.zpow_zpow_self g (1 : ℤ) n).eq)
  exact
    Subgroup.topologicalClosure_minimal
      _
      hclosure
      (centralizerOf_isClosed (G := G) (g ^ n))

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.mem_centralizerOf_zpow_of_mem_closedSubgroupGenerated
statement:
theorem mem_centralizerOf_zpow_of_mem_closedSubgroupGenerated
    [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G]
    {x c : G} (n : ℤ)
    (hc : c ∈ (ProCGroups.Generation.closedSubgroupGenerated (G := G) ({x} : Set G) :
      Subgroup G)) :
    c ∈ centralizerOf (x ^ n)
proof:
:=
  (closedSubgroupGenerated_singleton_le_centralizerOf_zpow (G := G) x n) hc

name: ProCGroups.GroupTheory.centralizerOf_zpow_eq_closedSubgroupGenerated_of_topologicallyGenerates
statement:
theorem centralizerOf_zpow_eq_closedSubgroupGenerated_of_topologicallyGenerates
    [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T2Space G]
    (x : G) (n : ℤ)
    (hgen : ProCGroups.Generation.TopologicallyGenerates (G := G) ({x} : Set G)) :
    centralizerOf (x ^ n) =
      (ProCGroups.Generation.closedSubgroupGenerated (G := G) ({x} : Set G) : Subgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  have hcyc :
      (ProCGroups.Generation.closedSubgroupGenerated (G := G) ({x} : Set G) : Subgroup G) =
        ⊤ := by
    unfold ProCGroups.Generation.TopologicallyGenerates at hgen
    simpa [ProCGroups.Generation.closedSubgroupGenerated] using hgen
  have hcent_top : centralizerOf (x ^ n) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hcyc]
    exact closedSubgroupGenerated_singleton_le_centralizerOf_zpow (G := G) x n
  simpa [hcyc] using hcent_top

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_surjective_prime_character_finite
statement:
theorem exists_surjective_prime_character_finite
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [Finite A]
    (hp : p ∣ Nat.card A) :
    ∃ χ : A →* Multiplicative (ZMod p), Function.Surjective χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ι, instι, m, hm, ⟨e⟩⟩ := CommGroup.equiv_prod_multiplicative_zmod_of_finite A
  have (i : ι) : NeZero (m i) := ⟨ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (hm i))⟩
  have hcard : Nat.card A = ∏ i : ι, m i := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr e.toEquiv, Nat.card_pi]
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _hi
    simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_multiplicative, ZMod.card]
  rw [hcard] at hp
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := ((Fact.out : p.Prime).prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff m).mp hp
  let ψ : A →* Multiplicative (ZMod (m i)) :=
    (Pi.evalMonoidHom (fun j : ι => Multiplicative (ZMod (m j))) i).comp e.toMonoidHom
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨e.symm (Function.update 1 i a), ?_⟩
    change e (e.symm (Function.update 1 i a)) i = a
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, Function.update_self]
  let c : Multiplicative (ZMod (m i)) →* Multiplicative (ZMod p) :=
    (ZMod.castHom hi (ZMod p)).toAddMonoidHom.toMultiplicative
  refine ⟨c.comp ψ, ?_⟩
  exact (ZMod.castHom_surjective hi).comp hψ

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_map
statement:
theorem quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_map
    (g : G)
    (hg : quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap N (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) = 1) :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (N.map f.toMonoidHom)
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (N.map f.toMonoidHom) (f g)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let M := N.map f.toMonoidHom
  let r : N →ₜ* M :=
    { toMonoidHom :=
        { toFun x := ⟨f x, ⟨x, x.property, rfl⟩⟩
          map_one' := Subtype.ext (map_one f)
          map_mul' x y := Subtype.ext (map_mul f (x : G) (y : G)) }
      continuous_toFun := Continuous.subtype_mk
        (f.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val) (fun x => ⟨x, x.property, rfl⟩) }
  apply MulEquiv.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk M a
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := y.property
  let z : N := ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hrz : r z = y := Subtype.ext hxy
  have hpoint : TopologicalAbelianization.mk N (MulAut.conjNormal g z) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk N z := by
    have h := congrArg (fun e : MulAut (TopologicalAbelianization N) =>
      e (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N z)) hg
    exact h
  have hconj : r (MulAut.conjNormal g z) = MulAut.conjNormal (f g) (r z) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change f (g * (z : G) * g⁻¹) = f g * f (z : G) * (f g)⁻¹
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_inv]
  have h := congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.map r) hpoint
  rw [TopologicalAbelianization.map_apply_mk,
    TopologicalAbelianization.map_apply_mk, hconj, hrz] at h
  exact h

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_injective_of_map
statement:
theorem quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_injective_of_map
    (hker : f.toMonoidHom.ker ≤ N)
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (N.map f.toMonoidHom))) :
    Function.Injective (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap N)
proof:
:= by
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_one (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap N)).mpr
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective N q
  have hmap := quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_map f N g hq
  have heq : QuotientGroup.mk' (N.map f.toMonoidHom) (f g) = 1 := by
    apply hinj
    exact hmap.trans (map_one (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap
      (N.map f.toMonoidHom))).symm
  have hmem : f g ∈ N.map f.toMonoidHom :=
    (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := N.map f.toMonoidHom) (f g)).mp heq
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩ := hmem
  change f x = f g at hfx
  have hcorrection : g * x⁻¹ ∈ f.toMonoidHom.ker := by
    change f (g * x⁻¹) = 1
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, hfx, mul_inv_cancel]
  have hg : g ∈ N := by
    have h := N.mul_mem (hker hcorrection) hx
    simpa only [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one] using h
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := N) g).mpr hg

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.topologicalAbelianizationFunctor_map_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem topologicalAbelianizationFunctor_map_apply_mk
    {G H : TopGrp.{u}} (f : G ⟶ H) (x : G) :
    topologicalAbelianizationFunctor.map f (TopologicalAbelianization.mk G x) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk H (f x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.topologicalAbelianizationHomEquiv_apply_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem topologicalAbelianizationHomEquiv_apply_hom
    (G : TopGrp.{u}) (A : CommTopGrp.{u}) [T1Space A]
    (φ : topologicalAbelianizationFunctor.obj G ⟶ A) :
    (topologicalAbelianizationHomEquiv G A φ).hom =
      φ.hom.comp (TopologicalAbelianization.mkₜ G)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.topologicalAbelianizationHomEquiv_symm_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem topologicalAbelianizationHomEquiv_symm_apply_mk
    (G : TopGrp.{u}) (A : CommTopGrp.{u}) [T1Space A]
    (f : G ⟶ commTopGrpForgetToTopGrp.obj A) (x : G) :

      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk G x) = f x

:=

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.topologicalAbelianizationTopMulEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem topologicalAbelianizationTopMulEquiv_apply_mk
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (x : ↥((⊤ : OpenSubgroup G) : Subgroup G)) :
    topologicalAbelianizationTopMulEquiv
        (G := G) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk ↥((⊤ : OpenSubgroup G) : Subgroup G) x) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk G x.1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    topologicalAbelianizationTopMulEquiv
          (G := G) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk ↥((⊤ : OpenSubgroup G) : Subgroup G) x) =
        TopologicalAbelianization.mk G ((OpenSubgroup.topContinuousMulEquiv G) x) :=
      TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk
        (OpenSubgroup.topContinuousMulEquiv G) x
    _ = TopologicalAbelianization.mk G x.1 := rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.conjugationTopologicalAbelianizationContinuousAut_toMulAut_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugationTopologicalAbelianizationContinuousAut_toMulAut_apply_mk
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (g : G) (n : N) :
    conjugationTopologicalAbelianizationContinuousAut (G := G) N g
      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N n) =
        quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) (N := N)
          (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N n)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] (g : G) (n : N) :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) (N := N)
      (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N n) =
        TopologicalAbelianization.mk N ((MulAut.conjNormal g) n)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap, TopologicalAbelianization.mk,
    TopologicalAbelianization.mkₜ]
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_of_commutator_mem_closure
statement:
theorem quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_of_commutator_mem_closure
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] {x : G}
    (hx :
      ∀ n : N,
        (((MulAut.conjNormal x) n) * n⁻¹ : N) ∈ Subgroup.closedCommutator N) :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) (N := N)
      (QuotientGroup.mk' N x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (Subgroup.closedCommutator N) a
  exact
    (QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem (N := Subgroup.closedCommutator N)
      (x := (MulAut.conjNormal x) n) (y := n)).2 (by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using hx n)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk_eq_iff
statement:
theorem quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk_eq_iff
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {N : Subgroup G} [N.Normal] {x : G} {n : N} :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) (N := N)
        (QuotientGroup.mk' N x) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N n) =
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk N n ↔
    (((MulAut.conjNormal x) n) * n⁻¹ : N) ∈ Subgroup.closedCommutator N
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk]
  change
    QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator N) ((MulAut.conjNormal x) n) =
        QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator N) n ↔
      (((MulAut.conjNormal x) n) * n⁻¹ : N) ∈
        Subgroup.closedCommutator N
  rw [show
      QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator N) ((MulAut.conjNormal x) n) =
        ((MulAut.conjNormal x) n : TopologicalAbelianization N) by rfl,
    show
      QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator N) n =
        (n : TopologicalAbelianization N) by rfl,
    QuotientGroup.eq_iff_div_mem, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_iff
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {N : Subgroup G} [N.Normal] {x : G} :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) (N := N)
        (QuotientGroup.mk' N x) = 1 ↔
      ∀ n : N,
        (((MulAut.conjNormal x) n) * n⁻¹ : N) ∈ Subgroup.closedCommutator N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h n
    have hpoint :=
      congrArg
        (fun φ : MulAut (TopologicalAbelianization N) => φ (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N n))
        h
    exact
      (quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk_eq_iff
        (G := G) (N := N) (x := x) (n := n)).1 (by simpa using hpoint)
  · intro hx
    exact quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_of_commutator_mem_closure
      (G := G) (N := N) (x := x) hx

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_of_mem_center
statement:
theorem quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_of_mem_center
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] {x : G} (hx : x ∈ Subgroup.center G) :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) (N := N)
      (QuotientGroup.mk' N x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_eq_one_of_commutator_mem_closure
    (G := G) (N := N)
  intro n
  have hxn : x * (n : G) = (n : G) * x := by
    exact (Subgroup.mem_center_iff.mp hx (n : G)).symm
  have hconj : MulAut.conjNormal x n = n := by
    ext
    rw [MulAut.conjNormal_apply]
    simp only [hxn, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
  simp only [hconj, mul_inv_cancel, one_mem]

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjAbMap_apply_mk_of_commute
statement:
theorem quotientConjAbMap_apply_mk_of_commute
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal] {g : G} {x : N}
    (hgx : g * (x : G) = (x : G) * g) :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) (N := N)
      (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N x) =
        TopologicalAbelianization.mk N x
proof:
:= by
  have hconj : (MulAut.conjNormal g) x = x := by
    ext
    rw [MulAut.conjNormal_apply]
    simp only [hgx, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
  rw [quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk, hconj]

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.mem_subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_iff
    {Q : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Q] [Group Q] [IsTopologicalGroup Q]
    {S : Subgroup Q} {U : OpenNormalSubgroup Q}
    {y : TopologicalAbelianization ↥(U : Subgroup Q)} :
    y ∈ subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization (Q := Q) S U ↔
      ∃ x : ↥(U : Subgroup Q), (x : Q) ∈ S ∧ TopologicalAbelianization.mk _ x = y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization, ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_toMonoidHom,
  Subgroup.inf_subgroupOf_right, Subgroup.mem_map, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf, MonoidHom.coe_ofClass,
      Subtype.exists,
  OpenSubgroup.mem_toSubgroup, exists_and_left]

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_mono_left
statement:
theorem subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_mono_left
    {Q : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Q] [Group Q] [IsTopologicalGroup Q]
    {S T : Subgroup Q} (hST : S ≤ T) (U : OpenNormalSubgroup Q) :
    subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization (Q := Q) S U ≤
      subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization (Q := Q) T U
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rcases (mem_subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_iff
    (Q := Q) (S := S) (U := U) (y := y)).1 hy with
    ⟨x, hxS, hxy⟩
  exact (mem_subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_iff
    (Q := Q) (S := T) (U := U) (y := y)).2
    ⟨x, hST hxS, hxy⟩

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.topologicalAbelianizationMapOfOpenNormalSubgroupLe_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem topologicalAbelianizationMapOfOpenNormalSubgroupLe_apply_mk
    {Q : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Q] [Group Q] [IsTopologicalGroup Q]
    {U V : OpenNormalSubgroup Q} (hUV : (U : Subgroup Q) ≤ (V : Subgroup Q))
    (x : ↥(U : Subgroup Q)) :

      (TopologicalAbelianization.mk ↥(U : Subgroup Q) x) =

:=

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_map_le_of_openNormalSubgroup_le
statement:
theorem subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_map_le_of_openNormalSubgroup_le
    {Q : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Q] [Group Q] [IsTopologicalGroup Q]
    (S : Subgroup Q) {U V : OpenNormalSubgroup Q}
    (hUV : (U : Subgroup Q) ≤ (V : Subgroup Q)) :
    (subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization (Q := Q) S U).map
        (topologicalAbelianizationMapOfOpenNormalSubgroupLe (Q := Q) hUV).toMonoidHom ≤
      subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization (Q := Q) S V
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rcases hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rcases (mem_subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_iff
    (Q := Q) (S := S) (U := U) (y := x)).1 hx with
    ⟨a, haS, hax⟩
  rw [← hax]
  exact (mem_subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_iff
    (Q := Q) (S := S) (U := V) (y := _)).2
    ⟨⟨a.1, hUV a.2⟩, haS, rfl⟩

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_le_comap_of_openNormalSubgroup_le
statement:
theorem subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_le_comap_of_openNormalSubgroup_le
    {Q : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Q] [Group Q] [IsTopologicalGroup Q]
    (S : Subgroup Q) {U V : OpenNormalSubgroup Q}
    (hUV : (U : Subgroup Q) ≤ (V : Subgroup Q)) :
    subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization (Q := Q) S U ≤
      (subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization (Q := Q) S V).comap
        (topologicalAbelianizationMapOfOpenNormalSubgroupLe (Q := Q) hUV).toMonoidHom
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp
    (subgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_map_le_of_openNormalSubgroup_le
      (Q := Q) S hUV)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.OpenNormalAbelianizationImage.closedSubgroupImageInTopologicalAbelianization_eq_topologicalClosure

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.mem_invariantOpenNormalCore_iff
statement:
theorem mem_invariantOpenNormalCore_iff
    (ρ : C →* MulAut A) (hρ : ∀ c : C, Continuous (ρ c))
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup A) (x : A) :
    x ∈ invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U ↔ ∀ c : C, ρ c x ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  change (fun c : C => ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj U (ρ c x)) =
      (1 : C → A ⧸ (U : Subgroup A)) ↔ ∀ c : C, ρ c x ∈ U
  constructor
  · intro hx c
    exact ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_eq_one_iff.mp (congrFun hx c)
  · intro hx
    funext c
    exact ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_eq_one_iff.mpr (hx c)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.invariantOpenNormalCore_le
statement:
theorem invariantOpenNormalCore_le
    (ρ : C →* MulAut A) (hρ : ∀ c : C, Continuous (ρ c))
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup A) :
    (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A) ≤ (U : Subgroup A)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h := (mem_invariantOpenNormalCore_iff ρ hρ U x).mp hx 1
  change x ∈ U
  simpa only [map_one, MulAut.one_apply] using h

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.action_mem_invariantOpenNormalCore
statement:
theorem action_mem_invariantOpenNormalCore
    (ρ : C →* MulAut A) (hρ : ∀ c : C, Continuous (ρ c))
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup A) (c : C) {x : A}
    (hx : x ∈ invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U) :
    ρ c x ∈ invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_invariantOpenNormalCore_iff ρ hρ U (ρ c x)).mpr
  intro d
  have h := (mem_invariantOpenNormalCore_iff ρ hρ U x).mp hx (d * c)
  simpa only [map_mul, MulAut.mul_apply] using h

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.map_invariantOpenNormalCore
statement:
theorem map_invariantOpenNormalCore
    (ρ : C →* MulAut A) (hρ : ∀ c : C, Continuous (ρ c))
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup A) (c : C) :
    (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A).map (ρ c).toMonoidHom =
      (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact action_mem_invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U c hx
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨ρ c⁻¹ y, action_mem_invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U c⁻¹ hy, ?_⟩
    change ρ c (ρ c⁻¹ y) = y
    rw [← MulAut.mul_apply, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel, map_one, MulAut.one_apply]

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.invariantOpenNormalQuotientAction_apply_mk
statement:
theorem invariantOpenNormalQuotientAction_apply_mk
    (ρ : C →* MulAut A) (hρ : ∀ c : C, Continuous (ρ c))
    (U : OpenNormalSubgroup A) (c : C) (x : A) :
    invariantOpenNormalQuotientAction ρ hρ U c
        (QuotientGroup.mk' (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A) x) =
      QuotientGroup.mk' (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A) (ρ c x)
proof:
:= by
  exact QuotientGroup.congr_mk'
    (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A)
    (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A)
    (ρ c) (map_invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U c) x

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_invariantOpenNormalCore_not_mem
statement:
theorem exists_invariantOpenNormalCore_not_mem
    [CompactSpace A] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace A]
    (ρ : C →* MulAut A) (hρ : ∀ c : C, Continuous (ρ c))
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ U : OpenNormalSubgroup A, x ∉ invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen (({x} : Set A)ᶜ) := isClosed_singleton.isOpen_compl
  have hone : (1 : A) ∈ ({x} : Set A)ᶜ := by
    intro heq
    exact hx (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp heq).symm
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := ProC.exists_openNormalSubgroup_sub_open_nhds_of_one hopen hone
  refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
  intro hcore
  exact hU (invariantOpenNormalCore_le ρ hρ U hcore) (Set.mem_singleton x)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_faithful_invariantOpenNormalQuotientAction
statement:
theorem exists_faithful_invariantOpenNormalQuotientAction
    [CompactSpace A] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace A]
    (ρ : C →* MulAut A) (hρ : ∀ c : C, Continuous (ρ c))
    (hfaithful : Function.Injective ρ) :
    ∃ U : OpenNormalSubgroup A,
      Function.Injective (invariantOpenNormalQuotientAction ρ hρ U)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ c : C, ∃ U : OpenNormalSubgroup A, ∃ x : A,
      c ≠ 1 → (ρ c x)⁻¹ * x ∉ U := by
    intro c
    by_cases hc : c = 1
    · exact ⟨⊤, 1, fun hne => False.elim (hne hc)⟩
    · have hmove : ∃ x : A, ρ c x ≠ x := by
        by_contra hnone
        apply hc
        apply hfaithful
        apply MulEquiv.ext
        intro x
        rw [map_one, MulAut.one_apply]
        exact Classical.not_not.mp (fun hx => hnone ⟨x, hx⟩)
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hmove
      have hdiff : (ρ c x)⁻¹ * x ≠ 1 := by
        intro h
        exact hx (inv_mul_eq_one.mp h)
      obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_invariantOpenNormalCore_not_mem ρ hρ hdiff
      exact ⟨invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U, x, fun _hc => hU⟩
  choose V x hV using hex
  let f : A →ₜ* (∀ c : C, A ⧸ (V c : Subgroup A)) :=
    { toMonoidHom :=
        { toFun := fun a c => ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj (V c) a
          map_one' := by
            funext c
            exact map_one (ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj (V c))
          map_mul' := by
            intro a b
            funext c
            exact map_mul (ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj (V c)) a b }
      continuous_toFun := continuous_pi fun c =>
        (ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj (V c)).continuous_toFun }
  let U : OpenNormalSubgroup A := ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.ker f
  have hUV : ∀ c : C, (U : Subgroup A) ≤ (V c : Subgroup A) := by
    intro c a ha
    have hf : f a = 1 := ha
    exact ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj_eq_one_iff.mp (congrFun hf c)
  refine ⟨U, ?_⟩
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_one (invariantOpenNormalQuotientAction ρ hρ U)).mpr
  intro c hc
  by_contra hne
  have hpoint := congrArg
    (fun e : MulAut (A ⧸ (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A)) =>
      e (QuotientGroup.mk' (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A) (x c))) hc
  have hclasses :
      QuotientGroup.mk' (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A) (ρ c (x c)) =
        QuotientGroup.mk' (invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U : Subgroup A) (x c) := by
    simpa only [invariantOpenNormalQuotientAction_apply_mk, MulAut.one_apply] using hpoint
  have hcore : (ρ c (x c))⁻¹ * x c ∈ invariantOpenNormalCore ρ hρ U :=
    QuotientGroup.eq.mp hclasses
  exact hV c hne (hUV c (invariantOpenNormalCore_le ρ hρ U hcore))

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.exists_finite_character_of_mk_ne
statement:
theorem exists_finite_character_of_mk_ne
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    {x y : G} (hxy : mk G x ≠ mk G y) :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : CommGroup A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
      (_ : Finite A) (_ : DiscreteTopology A),
      ∃ χ : G →ₜ* A, χ x ≠ χ y
proof:
:= by
  let B : Type u := _root_.TopologicalAbelianization G
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace B :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (Subgroup.closedCommutator G) (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator G)
  have hdiff : mk G x / mk G y ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hxy (div_eq_one.mp h)
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := ProCGroups.ProC.exists_openNormalSubgroup_not_mem
    (G := B) (x := mk G x / mk G y) hdiff
  let A : Type u := B ⧸ (U : Subgroup B)
  let χ : G →ₜ* A :=
    (ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj U).comp (mkₜ G)
  refine ⟨A, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, χ, ?_⟩
  intro hχ
  apply hU
  apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff
    (N := (U : Subgroup B)) (mk G x / mk G y)).mp
  change ProCGroups.ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj U
    (mk G x / mk G y) = 1
  rw [map_div]
  exact div_eq_one.mpr hχ

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_iff_finite_characters_eq
statement:
theorem mk_eq_iff_finite_characters_eq
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    {x y : G} :
    mk G x = mk G y ↔
      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A]
        [Finite A] [DiscreteTopology A],
        ∀ χ : G →ₜ* A, χ x = χ y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h A _instCommGroupA _instTopologyA _instFiniteA _instDiscreteA χ
    calc
      χ x = lift χ (mk G x) := (lift_apply_mk χ x).symm
      _ = lift χ (mk G y) := congrArg (lift χ) h
      _ = χ y := lift_apply_mk χ y
  · intro h
    by_contra hxy
    obtain ⟨A, _instCommGroupA, _instTopologyA, _instFiniteA, _instDiscreteA,
      χ, hχ⟩ := exists_finite_character_of_mk_ne hxy
    exact hχ (h A χ)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_ne_one_of_character_ne
statement:
theorem quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_ne_one_of_character_ne
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {N : Subgroup G} [N.Normal]
    {A : Type v} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [T1Space A]
    (χ : N →ₜ* A) {g : G} {n : N}
    (hχ : χ (MulAut.conjNormal g n) ≠ χ n) :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) N
      (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hχ
  have hpoint := congrArg
    (fun a : MulAut (_root_.TopologicalAbelianization N) =>
      a (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N n)) h
  have hclasses :
      TopologicalAbelianization.mk N (MulAut.conjNormal g n) =
        TopologicalAbelianization.mk N n := by
    simpa only [quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk,
      MulAut.one_apply] using hpoint
  calc
    χ (MulAut.conjNormal g n) =
        TopologicalAbelianization.lift χ
          (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N (MulAut.conjNormal g n)) :=
      (TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk χ (MulAut.conjNormal g n)).symm
    _ = TopologicalAbelianization.lift χ (TopologicalAbelianization.mk N n) :=
      congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.lift χ) hclasses
    _ = χ n := TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk χ n

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_eq_one_iff_finite_characters_fixed
statement:
theorem quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_eq_one_iff_finite_characters_fixed
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {N : Subgroup G} [N.Normal]
    [CompactSpace N] [T2Space N] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace N]
    {g : G} :
    quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap (G := G) N
        (QuotientGroup.mk' N g) = 1 ↔
      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A]
        [Finite A] [DiscreteTopology A],
        ∀ (χ : N →ₜ* A) (n : N), χ (MulAut.conjNormal g n) = χ n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h A _instCommGroupA _instTopologyA _instFiniteA _instDiscreteA χ n
    by_contra hχ
    exact
      quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_ne_one_of_character_ne χ hχ h
  · intro h
    apply MulEquiv.ext
    intro a
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk N a
    rw [quotientConjugationTopologicalAbelianizationMap_mk_apply_mk,
      MulAut.one_apply]
    apply TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_iff_finite_characters_eq.mpr
    intro A _instCommGroupA _instTopologyA _instFiniteA _instDiscreteA χ
    exact h A χ n

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_primePower_character_finite
statement:
theorem exists_primePower_character_finite
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {A : Type u} [CommGroup A] [Finite A]
    (hA : IsPGroup p A) {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ χ : A →* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ n)), χ x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ι, instι, m, hm, ⟨e⟩⟩ := CommGroup.equiv_prod_multiplicative_zmod_of_finite A
  have hcoord : ∃ i : ι, e x i ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra! h
    apply hx
    apply e.injective
    rw [map_one]
    exact funext h
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcoord
  let ψ : A →* Multiplicative (ZMod (m i)) :=
    (Pi.evalMonoidHom (fun j : ι => Multiplicative (ZMod (m j))) i).comp e.toMonoidHom
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨e.symm (Function.update 1 i a), ?_⟩
    change e (e.symm (Function.update 1 i a)) i = a
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, Function.update_self]
  have hP := hA.of_surjective ψ hψ
  have : NeZero (m i) := ⟨ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one (hm i))⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hP.exists_card_eq
  have hmn : m i = p ^ n := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_multiplicative, ZMod.card] using hn
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    by_contra hn0
    have hzero : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn0
    rw [hzero, pow_zero] at hmn
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (hm i)) hmn
  let ec := (ZMod.ringEquivCongr hmn).toAddEquiv.toMultiplicative
  refine ⟨n, hnpos, ec.toMonoidHom.comp ψ, ?_⟩
  intro hχ
  apply hi
  apply ec.injective
  exact hχ.trans (map_one ec).symm

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_primePower_character_proP
statement:
theorem exists_primePower_character_proP
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {A : Type u} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    [T2Space A]
    (hA : ProC.HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A)
    {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ χ : A →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ n)), χ x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hA.exists_openNormalSubgroupInClass_not_mem hx
  have : Finite (A ⧸ (U.1 : Subgroup A)) := U.2.1
  have hq : QuotientGroup.mk' (U.1 : Subgroup A) x ≠ 1 := by
    intro heq
    exact hU ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := (U.1 : Subgroup A)) x).mp heq)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, χ, hχ⟩ := exists_primePower_character_finite U.2.2 hq
  let χcont : (A ⧸ (U.1 : Subgroup A)) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ n)) :=
    ⟨χ, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩
  refine ⟨n, hn, χcont.comp (ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj U.1), ?_⟩
  exact hχ

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.π_topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison
statement:
@[simp 900] theorem π_topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (S : InverseSystems.InverseSystem (I := I))
    [∀ i, Group (S.X i)] [InverseSystems.IsGroupSystem S]
    [∀ i, IsTopologicalGroup (S.X i)]
    (i : I) :
    (abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i ∘
        topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S =
      TopologicalAbelianization.map
        { toMonoidHom :=
            { toFun := S.projection i
              map_one' := rfl
              map_mul' := by intro x y; rfl }
          continuous_toFun := S.continuous_projection i }
proof:
:= by
  let T : InverseSystems.InverseSystem (I := I) := abelianizationInverseSystem S
  let ψ : ∀ i, TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit →ₜ* T.X i := fun i =>
    TopologicalAbelianization.map
      { toMonoidHom := InverseSystems.projectionHom (S := S) i
        continuous_toFun := S.continuous_projection i }
  let ψFun : ∀ i, TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit → T.X i := fun i => ψ i
  have hcompat : T.CompatibleMaps ψFun := by
    intro i j hij
    funext x
    refine Quotient.inductionOn' x ?_
    intro a
    change
      QuotientGroup.mk'
          (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator (S.X i)))
          (S.map hij (S.projection j a)) =
        QuotientGroup.mk'
          (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator (S.X i)))
          (S.projection i a)
    exact congrArg
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator (S.X i))))
      (S.projection_compatible a i j hij)
  funext x
  change T.projection i (T.inverseLimitLift ψFun hcompat x) = ψFun i x
  exact T.projection_inverseLimitLift_apply ψFun hcompat i x

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.inj_topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison_of_profinite_inverse_system
statement:
private theorem inj_topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison_of_profinite_inverse_system
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I]
    (S : InverseSystems.InverseSystem (I := I))
    [∀ i, Group (S.X i)] [InverseSystems.IsGroupSystem S]
    [∀ i, IsTopologicalGroup (S.X i)]
    [∀ i, CompactSpace (S.X i)] [∀ i, T2Space (S.X i)]
    [∀ i, TotallyDisconnectedSpace (S.X i)]
    (hdir : Directed (· ≤ ·) (id : I → I)) :
    Function.Injective (topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S)
proof:
:= by
  let f : TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit →ₜ*
      (abelianizationInverseSystem S).inverseLimit :=
    topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit) :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit)
      (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator S.inverseLimit)
  have hkerbot : f.toMonoidHom.ker = ⊥ := by
    ext a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      by_contra hane
      rcases ProCGroups.ProC.exists_openNormalSubgroup_not_mem
          (G := TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit) (x := a) hane with ⟨U, haU⟩
      let Q := TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit ⧸
        (U : Subgroup (TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit))
      have : Finite Q := openNormalSubgroup_finiteQuotient
        (G := TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit) U
      have : DiscreteTopology Q :=
        QuotientGroup.discreteTopology
          (openNormalSubgroup_isOpen (G := TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit) U)
      let qInv : S.inverseLimit →ₜ* TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit :=
        { toMonoidHom := TopologicalAbelianization.mk S.inverseLimit
          continuous_toFun := continuous_quotient_mk' }
      let β : S.inverseLimit →ₜ* Q :=
        { toMonoidHom :=
            (QuotientGroup.mk' (U : Subgroup (TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit))).comp
              qInv.toMonoidHom
          continuous_toFun := continuous_quotient_mk'.comp qInv.continuous_toFun
        }
      rcases InverseSystems.InverseSystem.factors_through_projection_finite_group_hom
          (S := S) hdir β.toMonoidHom β.continuous_toFun with ⟨i, βi, hβi_continuous, hβfac⟩
      let βiCont : S.X i →ₜ* Q :=
        { toMonoidHom := βi
          continuous_toFun := hβi_continuous }
      have hq : QuotientGroup.mk' (U : Subgroup (TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit)) a =
          1 := by
        rcases QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective
            (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator S.inverseLimit)) a with ⟨x, rfl⟩
        calc
          QuotientGroup.mk'
              (U : Subgroup (TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit))
              (TopologicalAbelianization.mk S.inverseLimit x)
              = β x := rfl
          _ = βi (S.projection i x) := by
              exact congrFun hβfac x
          _ = TopologicalAbelianization.lift βiCont
                (TopologicalAbelianization.mk (S.X i) (S.projection i x)) := by
              symm
              exact TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk βiCont (S.projection i x)
            _ = TopologicalAbelianization.lift βiCont
                  ((abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i
                    (topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S
                      (QuotientGroup.mk'
                        (Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit) x))) := by
                exact congrArg (TopologicalAbelianization.lift βiCont)
                  (π_topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison_mk (S := S) i x).symm
          _ = TopologicalAbelianization.lift βiCont
                ((abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i 1) := by
              rw [show topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S
                    (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit) x) = 1 by
                    simpa [MonoidHom.mem_ker, f] using ha]
          _ = TopologicalAbelianization.lift βiCont (1 : TopologicalAbelianization (S.X i)) := by
              rfl
          _ = 1 := by simp only [map_one]
      exact haU <| (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff
        (N := (U : Subgroup (TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit))) a).1 hq
    · intro hx
      rw [Subgroup.mem_bot] at hx
      rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker]
      simp only [ContinuousMonoidHom.coe_toMonoidHom, hx, map_one]
  exact (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff (f := f.toMonoidHom)).mp hkerbot

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.mem_closedCommutator_inverseLimit_iff
statement:
theorem mem_closedCommutator_inverseLimit_iff
      {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I]
      {S : InverseSystems.InverseSystem (I := I)}
      [∀ i, Group (S.X i)] [InverseSystems.IsGroupSystem S]
      [∀ i, IsTopologicalGroup (S.X i)]
      [∀ i, CompactSpace (S.X i)] [∀ i, T2Space (S.X i)]
      [∀ i, TotallyDisconnectedSpace (S.X i)]
      (hdir : Directed (· ≤ ·) (id : I → I)) {x : S.inverseLimit} :
      x ∈ Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit ↔
        ∀ i, S.projection i x ∈ Subgroup.closedCommutator (S.X i)
proof:
:= by
    constructor
    · intro hx i
      have hxmk :
          QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit) x = 1 :=
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff (G := S.inverseLimit) (x := x)).2 hx
      have hcoord :=
        π_topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison_mk (S := S) i x
      have hcoord' :
          (abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i
              ((topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S)
                (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit) x)) =
            QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator (S.X i)) (S.projection i x) := by
        exact hcoord
      rw [hxmk] at hcoord'
      have hmk :
          QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator (S.X i)) (S.projection i x) = 1 := by
        exact hcoord'.symm.trans
          (InverseSystems.projection_one (S := abelianizationInverseSystem S) i)
      exact (TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff
        (G := S.X i) (x := S.projection i x)).1 hmk
    · intro hxcoord
      let f := topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S
      have hf :
          f (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit) x) = 1 := by
        apply (abelianizationInverseSystem S).ext
        intro i
        have hmk :
            QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator (S.X i)) (S.projection i x) = 1 :=
          (TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff
            (G := S.X i) (x := S.projection i x)).2 (hxcoord i)
        change (abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i
            (topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S
              (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit) x)) =
          (abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i 1
        exact (π_topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison_mk (S := S) i x).trans
          (hmk.trans
            (InverseSystems.projection_one (S := abelianizationInverseSystem S) i).symm)
      have hxmk :
          QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit) x = 1 := by
        apply inj_topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison_of_profinite_inverse_system (S
            := S) hdir
        simpa only [f, map_one] using hf
      exact (TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff (G := S.inverseLimit) (x := x)).1 hxmk

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.closedCommutator_inverseLimit_eq_iInf_comap
statement:
theorem closedCommutator_inverseLimit_eq_iInf_comap
      {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I]
      (S : InverseSystems.InverseSystem (I := I))
      [∀ i, Group (S.X i)] [InverseSystems.IsGroupSystem S]
      [∀ i, IsTopologicalGroup (S.X i)]
      [∀ i, CompactSpace (S.X i)] [∀ i, T2Space (S.X i)]
      [∀ i, TotallyDisconnectedSpace (S.X i)]
      (hdir : Directed (· ≤ ·) (id : I → I)) :
      Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit =
        ⨅ i, (Subgroup.closedCommutator (S.X i)).comap
          ({ toFun := S.projection i
             map_one' := rfl
             map_mul' := by intro x y; rfl } : S.inverseLimit →* S.X i)
proof:
:= by
    change Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit =
      ⨅ i, (Subgroup.closedCommutator (S.X i)).comap
        (InverseSystems.projectionHom (S := S) i)
    ext x
    simp only [Subgroup.mem_iInf, Subgroup.mem_comap, InverseSystems.projectionHom_apply]
    exact mem_closedCommutator_inverseLimit_iff (S := S) hdir (x := x)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.closedCommutatorCompatibleClosedNormalSubgroups_inverseLimitKernel
statement:

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.projection_closedCommutatorQuotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp 900] theorem projection_closedCommutatorQuotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv_mk
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I]
    (S : InverseSystems.InverseSystem (I := I))
    [∀ i, Group (S.X i)] [InverseSystems.IsGroupSystem S]
    [∀ i, IsTopologicalGroup (S.X i)]
    [∀ i, CompactSpace (S.X i)] [∀ i, T2Space (S.X i)]
    [∀ i, TotallyDisconnectedSpace (S.X i)]
    (hdir : Directed (· ≤ ·) (id : I → I))
    (i : I) (x : S.inverseLimit) :
    (closedCommutatorCompatibleClosedNormalSubgroups S).quotientInverseSystem.projection i
        (closedCommutatorQuotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv (S := S) hdir
          (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.closedCommutator S.inverseLimit) x)) =
      QuotientGroup.mk'
        ((closedCommutatorCompatibleClosedNormalSubgroups S).N i)
        (S.projection i x)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := closedCommutatorCompatibleClosedNormalSubgroups S
  unfold closedCommutatorQuotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv
  dsimp
  change Q.quotientInverseSystem.projection i
      (Q.quotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv hdir
        (QuotientGroup.mk' Q.inverseLimitKernel x)) =
    QuotientGroup.mk' (Q.N i) (S.projection i x)
  unfold quotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv

      (Q.quotientInverseLimitComparison (QuotientGroup.mk' Q.inverseLimitKernel x)) =
    QuotientGroup.mk' (Q.N i) (S.projection i x)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp 900] theorem topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv_apply
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I]
    (S : InverseSystems.InverseSystem (I := I))
    [∀ i, Group (S.X i)] [InverseSystems.IsGroupSystem S]
    [∀ i, IsTopologicalGroup (S.X i)]
    [∀ i, CompactSpace (S.X i)] [∀ i, T2Space (S.X i)]
    [∀ i, TotallyDisconnectedSpace (S.X i)]
    (hdir : Directed (· ≤ ·) (id : I → I))
    (x : TopologicalAbelianization S.inverseLimit) :
    topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv (S := S) hdir x =
      topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S x
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' x ?_
  intro g
  apply (abelianizationInverseSystem S).ext
  intro i
  let Q := closedCommutatorCompatibleClosedNormalSubgroups S
  let E : InverseSystems.InverseSystem.InverseSystemIso Q.quotientInverseSystem
      (abelianizationInverseSystem S) :=
    { stageEquiv := fun _ => ContinuousMulEquiv.refl _
      comm := by intro i j hij x; rfl }
  change (abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i
      (E.inverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv
        ((closedCommutatorQuotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv (S := S) hdir)
          (QuotientGroup.mk'
            (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator S.inverseLimit)) g))) =
    (abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i
      (topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S
        (QuotientGroup.mk'
          (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator S.inverseLimit)) g))
  change (abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i
      (Q.quotientInverseSystem.limMap E.toMorphism
        ((closedCommutatorQuotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv (S := S) hdir)
          (QuotientGroup.mk'
            (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator S.inverseLimit)) g))) =
    (abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i
      (topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S
        (QuotientGroup.mk'
          (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator S.inverseLimit)) g))
  rw [Q.quotientInverseSystem.π_limMap_apply E.toMorphism i]
  change Q.quotientInverseSystem.projection i
      ((closedCommutatorQuotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv (S := S) hdir)
        (QuotientGroup.mk'
          (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator S.inverseLimit)) g)) =
    (abelianizationInverseSystem S).projection i
      (topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison S
        (QuotientGroup.mk'
          (Subgroup.topologicalClosure (commutator S.inverseLimit)) g))
  rw [projection_closedCommutatorQuotientInverseLimitContinuousMulEquiv_mk]
  rw [π_topologicalAbelianizationInverseLimitComparison_mk]
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.ProC.eq_one_of_forall_primaryQuotient
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_forall_primaryQuotient
    {A : Type u} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    [CompactSpace A] [T2Space A] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace A]
    (a : A)
    (ha : ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime],
      QuotientGroup.mk' (proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A) a = 1) :
    a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hroots (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (s : ℕ) : ∃ b : A, b ^ (p ^ s) = a := by
    have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
    let P : Subgroup A := (powMonoidHom (α := A) (p ^ s)).range
    let powerMap : A →ₜ* A := ⟨powMonoidHom (p ^ s), continuous_id.pow _⟩
    have hP : IsClosed (P : Set A) := ContinuousMonoidHom.isClosed_range powerMap
    have : IsClosed (P : Set A) := hP
    have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (A ⧸ P) :=
      ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal P hP
    have hQ : HasOpenNormalBasisInClass (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) (A ⧸ P) := by
      apply HasOpenNormalBasisInClass.of_allOpenNormalQuotients
      intro U
      refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
      apply isPGroup_iff_pow_pow_eq_one.mpr
      intro q
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (U : Subgroup (A ⧸ P)) q
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective P b
      refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
      rw [← map_pow, ← map_pow]
      have hb : QuotientGroup.mk' P (b ^ (p ^ s)) = 1 :=
        (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := P) _).mpr ⟨b, rfl⟩
      rw [hb, map_one]
    have hle : proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A ≤ P :=
      proCResidualCore_le_of_proCQuotient P hP hQ
    exact hle ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N :=
      proCResidualCore (FiniteGroupClass.pGroup p) A) a).mp (ha p))
  apply ProCGroups.ProfiniteGrp.eq_one_of_mem_all_openNormalSubgroups
  intro U
  apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := (U : Subgroup A)) a).mp
  apply FiniteGroupClass.eq_one_of_primePower_roots (sigma := Set.univ)
    ⟨inferInstance, fun p _ hp => False.elim (hp (Set.mem_univ p))⟩
  intro p _ hp s _
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hroots p hp s
  exact ⟨QuotientGroup.mk' (U : Subgroup A) b, by rw [← map_pow, hb]; rfl⟩

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.map_closedCommutator_subtype
statement:
theorem map_closedCommutator_subtype
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (D : Subgroup G) (hD : IsClosed (D : Set G)) :
    (Subgroup.closedCommutator D).map D.subtype = ⁅D, D⁆.topologicalClosure
proof:
:= by
  let f : D →ₜ* G := ⟨D.subtype, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  have htop : (⊤ : Subgroup D).map f.toMonoidHom = D := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_top]
    exact D.range_subtype
  change (closedCommutator (⊤ : Subgroup D) ⊤).map f.toMonoidHom =
    closedCommutator D D
  apply map_closedCommutator_eq_of_map_eq (f := f) htop htop
  exact hD.isClosedMap_subtype_val _ (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator D)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.ker_map_of_surjective
statement:
theorem ker_map_of_surjective (f : G →ₜ* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (map f).toMonoidHom.ker = f.toMonoidHom.ker.map (mk G)
proof:
:= by
  have htop : (⊤ : Subgroup G).map f.toMonoidHom = ⊤ := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_top, MonoidHom.range_eq_top]
    exact hf
  have hcomm : (Subgroup.closedCommutator G).map f.toMonoidHom =
      Subgroup.closedCommutator H := by
    apply FiniteStepSolvableQuotients.map_closedCommutator_eq_of_map_eq
      (f := f) htop htop
    exact f.continuous.isClosedMap _ (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator G)
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := surjective_mk G a
    have hfg : f g ∈ Subgroup.closedCommutator H := by
      apply mk_eq_one_iff.mp
      exact ha
    rw [← hcomm] at hfg
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hfd⟩ := hfg
    change f d = f g at hfd
    refine ⟨g * d⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change f (g * d⁻¹) = 1
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, hfd, mul_inv_cancel]
    · rw [map_mul, map_inv, mk_eq_one_iff.mpr hd, inv_one, mul_one]
  · rintro a ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    change mk H (f g) = 1
    change f g = 1 at hg
    rw [hg, map_one]

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.injective_map_iff_ker_le_closedCommutator
statement:
theorem injective_map_iff_ker_le_closedCommutator
    (f : G →ₜ* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Injective (map f) ↔
      f.toMonoidHom.ker ≤ Subgroup.closedCommutator G
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Injective (map f).toMonoidHom ↔ _
  rw [← MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff, ker_map_of_surjective f hf,
    Subgroup.map_eq_bot_iff]
  exact forall_congr' fun g ↦ forall_congr' fun _ ↦ mk_eq_one_iff

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.abelianModPowerMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem abelianModPowerMap_mk
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {H : Type v} [TopologicalSpace H] [Group H] [IsTopologicalGroup H]
    (q : ℕ) (f : G →ₜ* H) (g : G) :
    abelianModPowerMap q f
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (powMonoidHom (α := TopologicalAbelianization G) q).range
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk G g)) =
      QuotientGroup.mk' (powMonoidHom (α := TopologicalAbelianization H) q).range
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk H (f g))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.abelianModPowerLift_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem abelianModPowerLift_mk
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {A : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] [CommGroup A] [T1Space A]
    (q : ℕ) (f : G →ₜ* A) (hpow : ∀ a : A, a ^ q = 1) (g : G) :
    abelianModPowerLift q f hpow
      (QuotientGroup.mk' (powMonoidHom (α := TopologicalAbelianization G) q).range
        (TopologicalAbelianization.mk G g)) = f g
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [abelianModPowerLift, ProCGroups.QuotientGroup.liftₜ_apply_mk] using
    (TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk f g)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.abelianModPowerLift_surjective
statement:
theorem abelianModPowerLift_surjective
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {A : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] [CommGroup A] [T1Space A]
    (q : ℕ) (f : G →ₜ* A) (hpow : ∀ a : A, a ^ q = 1)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Surjective (abelianModPowerLift q f hpow)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hf a
  exact ⟨QuotientGroup.mk' (powMonoidHom (α := TopologicalAbelianization G) q).range
    (TopologicalAbelianization.mk G g), abelianModPowerLift_mk q f hpow g⟩

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.abelianModPowerMk_surjective
statement:
theorem abelianModPowerMk_surjective (q : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (abelianModPowerMk G q)
proof:
:=
  (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _).comp (TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk G)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.abelianModPowerMap_comp
statement:
theorem abelianModPowerMap_comp (q : ℕ) (f : G →ₜ* H) (g : H →ₜ* J) :
    abelianModPowerMap q (g.comp f) =
      (abelianModPowerMap q g).comp (abelianModPowerMap q f)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := abelianModPowerMk_surjective (G := G) q x
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.abelianModPowerMap_mk_apply
statement:
theorem abelianModPowerMap_mk_apply (q : ℕ) (f : G →ₜ* H) (a : G) :
    abelianModPowerMap q f (abelianModPowerMk G q a) =
      abelianModPowerMk H q (f a)
proof: := rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_prime_character_finite
statement:
theorem exists_prime_character_finite
    {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [Finite A]
    (hA : ∀ a : A, a ^ q = 1) {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ χ : A →* Multiplicative (ZMod q), χ x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ι, instι, m, hm, ⟨e⟩⟩ := CommGroup.equiv_prod_multiplicative_zmod_of_finite A
  have hcoord : ∃ i : ι, e x i ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra! h
    apply hx
    apply e.injective
    rw [map_one]
    exact funext h
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcoord
  let ψ : A →* Multiplicative (ZMod (m i)) :=
    (Pi.evalMonoidHom (fun j : ι => Multiplicative (ZMod (m j))) i).comp e.toMonoidHom
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ := by
    intro a
    refine ⟨e.symm (Function.update 1 i a), ?_⟩
    change e (e.symm (Function.update 1 i a)) i = a
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, Function.update_self]
  have hmdiv : m i ∣ q := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hψ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod (m i)))
    have hp : (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod (m i))) ^ q = 1 := by
      rw [← ha, ← map_pow, hA, map_one]
    apply (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff q (m i)).mp
    have h := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hp
    change q • (1 : ZMod (m i)) = 0 at h
    simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using h
  have hmi : m i = q := ((Nat.dvd_prime (Fact.out : q.Prime)).mp hmdiv).resolve_left
    (Nat.ne_of_gt (hm i))
  let ec := (ZMod.ringEquivCongr hmi).toAddEquiv.toMultiplicative
  refine ⟨ec.toMonoidHom.comp ψ, ?_⟩
  intro hχ
  apply hi
  apply ec.injective
  exact hχ.trans (map_one ec).symm

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_prime_character_profinite
statement:
theorem exists_prime_character_profinite
    {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalGroup A]
    [CompactSpace A] [T2Space A] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace A]
    (hA : ∀ a : A, a ^ q = 1) {x : A} (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ χ : A →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q), χ x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := ProCGroups.ProC.exists_openNormalSubgroup_not_mem hx
  have hquot : ∀ a : A ⧸ (U : Subgroup A), a ^ q = 1 := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (U : Subgroup A) a
    rw [← map_pow, hA, map_one]
  have hxquot : QuotientGroup.mk' (U : Subgroup A) x ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hU ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := (U : Subgroup A)) x).mp h)
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_prime_character_finite hquot hxquot
  let χcont : (A ⧸ (U : Subgroup A)) →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q) :=
    ⟨χ, continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩
  exact ⟨χcont.comp (ProC.OpenNormalSubgroup.quotientProj U), hχ⟩

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.exists_prime_character_abelianModPower
statement:
theorem exists_prime_character_abelianModPower
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    {x : abelianModPower G q} (hx : x ≠ 1) :
    ∃ χ : abelianModPower G q →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q), χ x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  let B := TopologicalAbelianization G
  let P : Subgroup B := (powMonoidHom (α := B) q).range
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace B :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal
      (Subgroup.closedCommutator G) (Subgroup.isClosed_closedCommutator G)
  let powerMap : B →ₜ* B := ⟨powMonoidHom q, continuous_id.pow _⟩
  have hP : IsClosed (P : Set B) := ContinuousMonoidHom.isClosed_range powerMap
  have : IsClosed (P : Set B) := hP
  have : TotallyDisconnectedSpace (B ⧸ P) :=
    ProCGroups.totallyDisconnectedSpace_quotient_closedNormal P hP
  have hpow : ∀ z : B ⧸ P, z ^ q = 1 := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective P z
    rw [← map_pow]
    exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := P) _).mpr ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact exists_prime_character_profinite hpow hx

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.injective_prod_abelianModPowerMap_of_character_surjective
statement:
theorem injective_prod_abelianModPowerMap_of_character_surjective
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {G : Type*} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    (H : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Group (H i)] [∀ i, TopologicalSpace (H i)]
    [∀ i, IsTopologicalGroup (H i)] [∀ i, CompactSpace (H i)]
    [∀ i, T2Space (H i)] [∀ i, TotallyDisconnectedSpace (H i)]
    (f : ∀ i, H i →ₜ* G)
    (hchar : Function.Surjective (fun χ : G →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q) =>
      fun i => χ.comp (f i))) :
    Function.Injective (fun z : ∀ i, abelianModPower (H i) q =>
      ∏ i, abelianModPowerMap q (f i) (z i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpow : ∀ a : Multiplicative (ZMod q), a ^ q = 1 := by
    intro a
    apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
    change q • a.toAdd = (0 : ZMod q)
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]
  have hker : ∀ z : (∀ i, abelianModPower (H i) q),
      (∏ i, abelianModPowerMap q (f i) (z i)) = 1 → z = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    funext i
    by_contra hzi
    obtain ⟨χi, hχi⟩ := exists_prime_character_abelianModPower hzi
    let ψ : ∀ j, H j →ₜ* Multiplicative (ZMod q) :=
      Function.update 1 i (χi.comp (abelianModPowerMk (H i) q))
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := hchar ψ
    let χbar := abelianModPowerLift q χ hpow
    have hi : χbar (abelianModPowerMap q (f i) (z i)) = χi (z i) := by
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := abelianModPowerMk_surjective (G := H i) q (z i)
      rw [← ha]
      change χ (f i a) = χi (abelianModPowerMk (H i) q a)
      have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (congrFun hχ i) a
      simp only [ψ, Function.update_self] at h
      exact h
    have hj (j : ι) (hji : j ≠ i) : χbar (abelianModPowerMap q (f j) (z j)) = 1 := by
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := abelianModPowerMk_surjective (G := H j) q (z j)
      rw [← ha]
      change χ (f j a) = 1
      have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (congrFun hχ j) a
      simp only [ψ, Function.update_of_ne hji, Pi.one_apply] at h
      exact h
    have hprod : (∏ j, χbar (abelianModPowerMap q (f j) (z j))) = χi (z i) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i]
      · exact hi
      · intro j _ hji
        exact hj j hji
      · intro h
        exact False.elim (h (Finset.mem_univ i))
    apply hχi
    rw [← hprod, ← map_prod, hz, map_one]
  intro x y hxy
  have hdiv : (∏ i, abelianModPowerMap q (f i) ((x / y) i)) = 1 := by
    change (∏ i, abelianModPowerMap q (f i) (x i / y i)) = 1
    simp only [map_div, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
    exact div_eq_one.mpr hxy
  exact div_eq_one.mp (hker (x / y) hdiv)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.ker_mk
statement:
theorem ker_mk
    (G : Type u) [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] :
    (mk G).ker =
      Subgroup.closedCommutator G
proof:
:= by
  exact QuotientGroup.ker_mk' _

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.mk_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_one_iff
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {x : G} :
    mk G x = 1 ↔
      x ∈ Subgroup.closedCommutator G
proof:
:= by
  exact QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := Subgroup.closedCommutator G) x

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.closedCommutator_eq_bot_of_commGroup_t1
statement:
@[simp] theorem closedCommutator_eq_bot_of_commGroup_t1
    (G : Type u) [TopologicalSpace G] [CommGroup G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] [T1Space G] :
    Subgroup.closedCommutator G = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : commutator G = ⊥ := by
    rw [commutator_eq_bot_iff_center_eq_top, CommGroup.center_eq_top]
  rw [Subgroup.closedCommutator, hcomm]
  ext x
  change x ∈ closure ({(1 : G)} : Set G) ↔ x = 1
  rw [closure_singleton]
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.surjective_mk
statement:
theorem surjective_mk
    (G : Type u) [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] :
    Function.Surjective (mk G)
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (Subgroup.closedCommutator G)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.lift_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_apply_mk
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {A : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] [CommGroup A] [T1Space A]
    (f : G →ₜ* A) (x : G) :
    lift f (mk G x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem hom_ext
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {A : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] [Group A]
    (φ ψ : TopologicalAbelianization G →ₜ* A)
    (h : ∀ x : G, φ (mk G x) = ψ (mk G x)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMonoidHom.toMonoidHom_injective
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  exact Quotient.inductionOn' x h

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {A : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] [CommGroup A] [T1Space A]
    (f : G →ₜ* A)
    (φ : TopologicalAbelianization G →ₜ* A)
    (hφ : ∀ x : G, φ (mk G x) = f x) :
    φ = lift f
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro x
  calc
    φ (mk G x) = f x := hφ x
    _ = lift f (mk G x) := (lift_apply_mk f x).symm

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.homEquiv_apply

@[simp] theorem homEquiv_apply

:=
  rfl

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.homEquiv_symm_apply_mk

@[simp] theorem homEquiv_symm_apply_mk

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.map_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_apply_mk
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]

@[simp] theorem map_comp_mk
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]

    (f : G →ₜ* H) :

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.map_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_id
    (G : Type u) [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G] :

        (ContinuousMonoidHom.id G) =
      ContinuousMonoidHom.id (TopologicalAbelianization G)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.map_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_comp
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
    {H : Type v} [TopologicalSpace H] [Group H] [IsTopologicalGroup H]

      (map g).comp (map f)

name: ProCGroups.Abelian.TopologicalAbelianization.congr_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem congr_apply_mk
    {G : Type u} [TopologicalSpace G] [Group G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]
